hebrew.text: וַיִּבְרָא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הַתַּנִּינִם הַגְּדֹלִים וְאֵת כָּל נֶפֶשׁ הַחַיָּה הָרֹמֶשֶׂת אֲשֶׁר שָׁרְצוּ הַמַּיִם לְמִינֵהֶם וְאֵת כָּל עוֹף כָּנָף לְמִינֵהוּ וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים כִּי טוֹב

english.text:
And God created the big sea serpents
and all the living beings that creep, with which the water swarmed, by
their kinds, and every winged bird by its kind.
And God saw that it was good.

translation.text: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

verses.english:
And God created the big sea serpents
and all the living beings that creep, with which the water swarmed, by
their kinds, and every winged bird by its kind.
And God saw that it was good.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתָם אֱלֹהִים לֵאמֹר פְּרוּ
וּרְבוּ וּמִלְאוּ אֶת הַמַּיִם בַּיַּמִּים
וְהָעוֹף יִרֶב בָּאָרֶץ

hebrew.text: וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתָם אֱלֹהִים לֵאמֹר פְּרוּ וּרְבוּ וּמִלְאוּ אֶת הַמַּיִם בַּיַּמִּים וְהָעוֹף יִרֶב בָּאָרֶץ

english.text:
And God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful
and multiply and fill the water in the seas,
and let the birds multiply in the earth.”

translation.text: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.

verses.english:
And God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful
and multiply and fill the water in the seas,
and let the birds multiply in the earth.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עֶרֶב וַיְהִי בֹקֶר יוֹם חֲמִישִׁי

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי עֶרֶב וַיְהִי בֹקֶר יוֹם חֲמִישִׁי

english.text: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

translation.text: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.

verses.english: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים תּוֹצֵא הָאָרֶץ נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה לְמִינָהּ בְּהֵמָה
וָרֶמֶשׂ וְחַיְתוֹ אֶרֶץ לְמִינָהּ
וַיְהִי כֵן

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים תּוֹצֵא הָאָרֶץ נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה לְמִינָהּ בְּהֵמָה וָרֶמֶשׂ וְחַיְתוֹ אֶרֶץ לְמִינָהּ וַיְהִי כֵן

english.text:
And God said, “Let the earth bring out living beings by their kind,
domestic animal and creeping thing
and wild animals of the earth by their kind.”
And it was so.

translation.text: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.

verses.english:
And God said, “Let the earth bring out living beings by their kind,
domestic animal and creeping thing
and wild animals of the earth by their kind.”
And it was so.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַשׂ אֱלֹהִים אֶת חַיַּת הָאָרֶץ לְמִינָהּ
וְאֶת הַבְּהֵמָה לְמִינָהּ וְאֵת כָּל רֶמֶשׂ הָאֲדָמָה לְמִינֵהוּ
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים כִּי טוֹב

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֱלֹהִים אֶת חַיַּת הָאָרֶץ לְמִינָהּ וְאֶת הַבְּהֵמָה לְמִינָהּ וְאֵת כָּל רֶמֶשׂ הָאֲדָמָה לְמִינֵהוּ וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים כִּי טוֹב

english.text:
And God made the wild animals of the earth by their kind
and the domestic animals by their kind
and every creeping thing of the ground by their kind.
And God saw that it was good.

translation.text: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

verses.english:
And God made the wild animals of the earth by their kind
and the domestic animals by their kind
and every creeping thing of the ground by their kind.
And God saw that it was good.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים נַעֲשֶׂה אָדָם בְּצַלְמֵנוּ כִּדְמוּתֵנוּ
וְיִרְדּוּ בִדְגַת הַיָּם וּבְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם
וּבַבְּהֵמָה וּבְכָל הָאָרֶץ וּבְכָל הָרֶמֶשׂ הָרֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים נַעֲשֶׂה אָדָם בְּצַלְמֵנוּ כִּדְמוּתֵנוּ וְיִרְדּוּ בִדְגַת הַיָּם וּבְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּבַבְּהֵמָה וּבְכָל הָאָרֶץ וּבְכָל הָרֶמֶשׂ הָרֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ

english.text:
And God said, “Let us make a human, in our image, according to our
likeness, and let them dominate the fish of the sea
and the birds of the skies and the domestic animals
and all the earth and all the creeping things that creep on the earth.”

translation.text: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

verses.english:
And God said, “Let us make a human, in our image, according to our
likeness, and let them dominate the fish of the sea
and the birds of the skies and the domestic animals
and all the earth and all the creeping things that creep on the earth.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּבְרָא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאָדָם בְּצַלְמוֹ בְּצֶלֶם אֱלֹהִים בָּרָא
אֹתוֹ זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה בָּרָא אֹתָם

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְרָא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאָדָם בְּצַלְמוֹ בְּצֶלֶם אֱלֹהִים בָּרָא אֹתוֹ זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה בָּרָא אֹתָם

english.text:
And God created the human in His image. He created it in the image of
God; He created them male and female.

translation.text: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

verses.english:
And God created the human in His image. He created it in the image of
God; He created them male and female.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתָם אֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם אֱלֹהִים פְּרוּ
וּרְבוּ וּמִלְאוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְכִבְשֻׁהָ
וּרְדוּ בִּדְגַת הַיָּם וּבְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם
וּבְכָל חַיָּה הָרֹמֶשֶׂת עַל הָאָרֶץ

hebrew.text: וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתָם אֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם אֱלֹהִים פְּרוּ וּרְבוּ וּמִלְאוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְכִבְשֻׁהָ וּרְדוּ בִּדְגַת הַיָּם וּבְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּבְכָל חַיָּה הָרֹמֶשֶׂת עַל הָאָרֶץ

english.text:
And God blessed them, and God said to them, “Be fruitful
and multiply and fill the earth and subdue it
and dominate the fish of the sea
and the birds of the skies and every animal that creeps on the earth.”

translation.text: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.

verses.english:
And God blessed them, and God said to them, “Be fruitful
and multiply and fill the earth and subdue it
and dominate the fish of the sea
and the birds of the skies and every animal that creeps on the earth.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי לָכֶם אֶת כָּל עֵשֶׂב זֹרֵעַ זֶרַע
אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי כָל הָאָרֶץ וְאֶת כָּל הָעֵץ אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ פְרִי עֵץ
זֹרֵעַ זָרַע לָכֶם יִהְיֶה לְאָכְלָה

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי לָכֶם אֶת כָּל עֵשֶׂב זֹרֵעַ זֶרַע אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי כָל הָאָרֶץ וְאֶת כָּל הָעֵץ אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ פְרִי עֵץ זֹרֵעַ זָרַע לָכֶם יִהְיֶה לְאָכְלָה

english.text:
And God said, “Here, I have placed all the vegetation that produces seed
that is on the face of all the earth for you
and every tree, which has in it the fruit of a tree producing seed. It
will be food for you

translation.text: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.

verses.english:
And God said, “Here, I have placed all the vegetation that produces seed
that is on the face of all the earth for you
and every tree, which has in it the fruit of a tree producing seed. It
will be food for you

verses.hebrew:
וּלְכָל חַיַּת הָאָרֶץ וּלְכָל עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם
וּלְכֹל רוֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה אֶת כָּל יֶרֶק
עֵשֶׂב לְאָכְלָה וַיְהִי כֵן

hebrew.text: וּלְכָל חַיַּת הָאָרֶץ וּלְכָל עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְכֹל רוֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה אֶת כָּל יֶרֶק עֵשֶׂב לְאָכְלָה וַיְהִי כֵן

english.text:
and for all the wild animals of the earth
and for all the birds of the skies
and for all the creeping things on the earth, everything in which there
is a living being: every plant of vegetation, for food.”
And it was so.

translation.text: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.

verses.english:
and for all the wild animals of the earth
and for all the birds of the skies
and for all the creeping things on the earth, everything in which there
is a living being: every plant of vegetation, for food.”
And it was so.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
וְהִנֵּה טוֹב מְאֹד וַיְהִי עֶרֶב
וַיְהִי בֹקֶר יוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְהִנֵּה טוֹב מְאֹד וַיְהִי עֶרֶב וַיְהִי בֹקֶר יוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי

english.text:
And God saw everything that He had made,
and, here, it was very good. And there was evening
and there was morning, the sixth day.

translation.text: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.

verses.english:
And God saw everything that He had made,
and, here, it was very good. And there was evening
and there was morning, the sixth day.

verses.hebrew: וַיְכֻלּוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהָאָרֶץ וְכָל־צְבָאָם

hebrew.text: וַיְכֻלּוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהָאָרֶץ וְכָל־צְבָאָם

english.text: And the skies and the earth and all their array were finished.

translation.text: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.

verses.english: And the skies and the earth and all their array were finished.

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַל אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וַיִּשְׁבֹּת בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה

hebrew.text: וַיְכַל אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וַיִּשְׁבֹּת בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה

english.text: And in the seventh day God finished His work that He had done and ceased in the seventh day from all His work that He had done.

translation.text: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

verses.english: And in the seventh day God finished His work that He had done and ceased in the seventh day from all His work that He had done.

verses.hebrew: וַיְבָרֶךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶת יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ כִּי בוֹ שָׁבַת מִכָּל מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים לַעֲשׂוֹת

hebrew.text: וַיְבָרֶךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶת יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ כִּי בוֹ שָׁבַת מִכָּל מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים לַעֲשׂוֹת

english.text:
And God blessed the seventh day and made it holy because
he ceased in it from doing all His work, which God had created.

translation.text: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.

verses.english:
And God blessed the seventh day and made it holy because
he ceased in it from doing all His work, which God had created.

verses.hebrew:
אֵלֶּה תוֹלְדוֹת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהָאָרֶץ בְּ הִבָּרְאָם
בְּיוֹם עֲשׂוֹת יְהֹוָה
אֱלֹהִים
אֶרֶץ וְשָׁמָיִם

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה תוֹלְדוֹת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהָאָרֶץ בְּ הִבָּרְאָם
בְּיוֹם עֲשׂוֹת יְהֹוָה
אֱלֹהִים
אֶרֶץ וְשָׁמָיִם

in the day that YHWH
God
made earth and skies

in the day that the LORD
God
made the earth and the heavens,

verses.english:
These are the records of the skies and the earth when they were created
in the day that YHWH
God
made earth and skies
verses.translation: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,

verses.hebrew:
וְכֹל שִׂיחַ הַשָּׂדֶה טֶרֶם יִהְיֶה בָאָרֶץ וְכל עֵשֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶה טֶרֶם יִצְמָח כִּי לֹא הִמְטִיר יְהֹוָה

עַל הָאָרֶץ וְאָדָם אַיִן לַעֲבֹד אֶת־הָאֲדָמָה

hebrew.text: וְכֹל שִׂיחַ הַשָּׂדֶה טֶרֶם יִהְיֶה בָאָרֶץ וְכל עֵשֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶה טֶרֶם יִצְמָח כִּי לֹא הִמְטִיר יְהֹוָה
אלהים
עַל הָאָרֶץ וְאָדָם אַיִן לַעֲבֹד אֶת־הָאֲדָמָה

english.text:
when all produce of the field had not yet been in the earth,
and all vegetation of the field had not yet grown, for YHWH
God
had not rained on the earth, and there had been no human to work the ground,

translation.text: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD
God
had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.

verses.english:
when all produce of the field had not yet been in the earth,
and all vegetation of the field had not yet grown, for YHWH
God
had not rained on the earth, and there had been no human to work the ground,
verses.translation: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.

hebrew.text: וְ אֵד יַעֲלֶה מִן הָאָרֶץ וְהִשְׁקָה אֶת כּל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה

english.text: and a river had come up from the earth and watered the whole face of the ground—

verses.english: a river had come up from the earth and watered the whole face of the ground—

english.text: And a river had come up from the earth And watered the whole face of the ground And YHWH
God
fashioned The human dust from The ground And blew into his nostrils the breath of life And the human became a living being

translation.text:
But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
And the LORD
God
formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

verses.english:
a river had come up from the earth

And watered the whole face of the ground

And YHWH
God
fashioned

human dust from

ground

And blew into his nostrils the breath of life

And the human became a living being
verses.translation:
But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

english.text: And YHWH
God
planted a garden in Eden at the east, and he set the human whom He had fashioned there.

translation.text: And the LORD
God
planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.

verses.english: YHWH God planted a garden in Eden at the east, and he set the human whom He had fashioned there.
verses.translation: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.

english.text: And YHWH
God

made grow from

The ground every tree pleasant to the sight

And good to eat

And the tree of life within the garden

And the tree of knowledge of good and bad

translation.text: And out of the ground made the LORD
God
to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

verses.english:
And YHWH God made grow from

The ground every tree pleasant to the sight

And good to eat

And the tree of life within the garden

And the tree of knowledge of good and bad
verses.translation: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

verses.hebrew:
וְנָהָר יֹצֵא מֵעֵדֶן

לְהַשְׁקוֹת אֶת הַגָּן

וּמִשָּׁם יִפָּרֵד

וְהָיָה לְאַרְבָּעָה רָאשִׁים

hebrew.text: וְנָהָר יֹצֵא מֵעֵדֶן לְהַשְׁקוֹת אֶת הַגָּן וּמִשָּׁם יִפָּרֵד וְהָיָה לְאַרְבָּעָה רָאשִׁים

english.text:
And a river was coming out from Eden

To give drink to the garden

And from there it was divided

And became four heads

translation.text: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.

verses.english:
And a river was coming out from Eden

To give drink to the garden

And from there it was divided

And became four heads

english.text: The name of one was Pishon, that is the one that circles all the land of Havilah where there is gold.

verses.english:
name of one was Pishon,

that is the one that circles all the land of

Havilah where there is gold.

translation.text: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

verses.english:
The name of one was Pishon,

that is the one that circles all

the land of Havilah where there is gold.

verses.hebrew: וּזְהַב הָאָרֶץ הַהִוא טוֹב שָׁם הַבְּדֹלַח וְאֶבֶן הַשֹּׁהַם

english.text: And that land’s gold is good; bdellium and onyx stone are there.

translation.text: And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.

verses.english: And that land’s gold is good; bdellium and onyx stone are there.

english.text: And the name of the second river is Gihon; that is the one that circles all the land of Kush.

translation.text: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.

verses.english: And the name of the second river is Gihon; that is the one that circles all the land of Kush.

english.text:
And the name of the third river is Tigris; that is the one that
goes east of Assyria. And the fourth river: that is Euphrates.

translation.text: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.

verses.english:
And the name of the third river is Tigris; that is the one that
goes east of Assyria. And the fourth river: that is Euphrates.

God
took the human and put him in the garden of Eden to work it and to watch over it.

translation.text: And the LORD
God
took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

verses.english: YHWH God took the human and put him in the garden of Eden to work it and to watch over it.
verses.translation: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

english.text: And YHWH
God
commanded the human, saying, “You may eat from every tree of the garden.”

translation.text: And the LORD
God
commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:

verses.english: YHWH God commanded the human, saying, “You may eat from every tree of the garden.”
verses.translation: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:

וּמֵעֵץ הַדַּעַת טוֹב וָרָע לֹא תֹאכַל מִמֶּנּוּ כִּי

english.text: But from the tree of knowledge of good and bad: you shall not eat from it, because in the day you eat from it: you’ll die!”

translation.text: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.

verses.english:
But from the tree of knowledge of good and bad: you shall not eat from it, because

in the day you eat from it: you’ll die!”

english.text: And YHWH
God

said,
“It’s not good for the human to be by himself.

I’ll make for him a strength corresponding to him.”

translation.text: And the LORD
God
said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.

verses.english:
And YHWH God said,
“It’s not good for the human to be by himself.

I’ll make for him a strength corresponding to him.”
verses.translation: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.

english.text: And YHWH
God

made from the ground every animal
of the field and every bird of the skies.

And brought it to the human to see what he would call it.

And whatever the human would call it, each living being, that would be its name.

translation.text: And out of the ground the LORD
God
formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.

verses.english:
YHWH God made from the ground every animal
of the field and every bird of the skies.

And brought it to the human to see what he would call it.

And whatever the human would call it, each living being, that would be its name.
verses.translation: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא הָאָדָם שֵׁמוֹת לְכל הַבְּהֵמָה וּלְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְכֹל חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה וּלְאָדָם לֹא מָצָא עֵזֶר כְּנֶגְדּוֹ

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא הָאָדָם שֵׁמוֹת לְכל הַבְּהֵמָה וּלְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְכֹל חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה וּלְאָדָם לֹא מָצָא עֵזֶר כְּנֶגְדּוֹ

english.text:
And the human gave names to every domestic animal and bird of the skies.

And every animal of the field.

And he did not find for the human a strength corresponding to him.

translation.text: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.

verses.english:
And the human gave names to every domestic animal and bird of the skies.

And every animal of the field.

And he did not find for the human a strength corresponding to him.

God

caused a slumber to descend on the human. And he slept.

And He took one of his ribs and closed flesh in its place.

God
caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;

verses.english:
YHWH God caused a slumber to descend on the human. And he slept.

And He took one of his ribs and closed flesh in its place.
verses.translation: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;

english.text: And YHWH
God

built the rib that He had taken
from the human into a woman and brought her to the human.

translation.text: And the rib, which the LORD
God
had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.

verses.english:
YHWH God built the rib that He had taken
from the human into a woman and brought her to the human.
verses.translation: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאָדָם זֹאת הַפַּעַם עֶצֶם מֵעֲצָמַי וּבָשָׂר מִבְּשָׂרִי לְזֹאת יִקָּרֵא אִשָּׁה כִּי מֵאִישׁ לֻקְחָה זֹּאת

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאָדָם זֹאת הַפַּעַם עֶצֶם מֵעֲצָמַי וּבָשָׂר מִבְּשָׂרִי לְזֹאת יִקָּרֵא אִשָּׁה כִּי מֵאִישׁ לֻקְחָה זֹּאת

english.text: And the human said, “This time is it: bone from my bones and flesh from my flesh. This will be called woman,’ for this one was taken from man.”

verses.hebrew: וּלְאָדָם אָמַר כִּי שָׁמַעְתָּ לְקוֹל אִשְׁתֶּךָ וַתֹּאכַל מִן הָעֵץ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִיךָ לֵאמֹר לֹא תֹאכַל מִמֶּנּוּ אֲרוּרָה הָאֲדָמָה בַּעֲבוּרֶךָ בְּעִצָּבוֹן תֹּאכְלֶנָּה כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ

hebrew.text: וּלְאָדָם אָמַר כִּי שָׁמַעְתָּ לְקוֹל אִשְׁתֶּךָ וַתֹּאכַל מִן הָעֵץ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִיךָ לֵאמֹר לֹא תֹאכַל מִמֶּנּוּ אֲרוּרָה הָאֲדָמָה בַּעֲבוּרֶךָ בְּעִצָּבוֹן תֹּאכְלֶנָּה כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ

english.text: And to the human He said, “Because you listened to your woman’s voice and ate from the tree about which I commanded you saying, ‘You shall not eat from it,’ the ground is cursed on your account. You’ll eat from it with suffering all the days of your life.”

translation.text: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;

verses.english: And to the human He said, “Because you listened to your woman’s voice and ate from the tree about which I commanded you saying, ‘You shall not eat from it,’ the ground is cursed on your account. You’ll eat from it with suffering all the days of your life.”

verses.hebrew: וְקוֹץ וְדַרְדַּר תַּצְמִיחַ לָךְ וְאָכַלְתָּ אֶת עֵשֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶה

hebrew.text: וְקוֹץ וְדַרְדַּר תַּצְמִיחַ לָךְ וְאָכַלְתָּ אֶת עֵשֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶה

english.text: And it will grow thorn and thistle at you, and you’ll eat the field’s vegetation.

translation.text: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;

verses.english: And it will grow thorn and thistle at you, and you’ll eat the field’s vegetation.

verses.hebrew: בְּזֵעַת אַפֶּיךָ תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם עַד שׁוּבְךָ אֶל הָאֲדָמָה כִּי מִמֶּנָּה לֻקָּחְתָּ כִּי עָפָר אַתָּה וְאֶל עָפָר תָּשׁוּב

hebrew.text: בְּזֵעַת אַפֶּיךָ תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם עַד שׁוּבְךָ אֶל הָאֲדָמָה כִּי מִמֶּנָּה לֻקָּחְתָּ כִּי עָפָר אַתָּה וְאֶל עָפָר תָּשׁוּב

english.text:
By the sweat of your nostrils you’ll eat bread until you go back to the ground,
because you were taken from it; because you are dust and you’ll go back to dust.”

translation.text: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.

verses.english:
By the sweat of your nostrils you’ll eat bread until you go back to the ground,
because you were taken from it; because you are dust and you’ll go back to dust.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא הָאָדָם שֵׁם אִשְׁתּוֹ חַוָּה כִּי הִוא הָיְתָה אֵם כּל חָי

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא הָאָדָם שֵׁם אִשְׁתּוֹ חַוָּה כִּי הִוא הָיְתָה אֵם כּל חָי

english.text: And the human called his woman “Eve,” because she was mother of all living.

translation.text: And Adam called his wife’s name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.

verses.english: And the human called his woman “Eve,” because she was mother of all living.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה
אֱלֹהִים
לְאָדָם וּלְאִשְׁתּוֹ כּתְנוֹת עוֹר וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁם

אֱלֹהִים
לְאָדָם וּלְאִשְׁתּוֹ כּתְנוֹת עוֹר וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁם

english.text: And YHWH
God
made skin garments for the human and his woman and dressed them.

translation.text: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD
God
make coats of skins, and clothed them.

verses.english:
And YHWH
God
made skin garments for the human and his woman and dressed them.
verses.translation: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה
אֱלֹהִים
הֵן הָאָדָם הָיָה כְּאַחַד מִמֶּנּוּ לָדַעַת טוֹב וָרָע וְעַתָּה פֶּן יִשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וְלָקַח גַּם מֵעֵץ הַחַיִּים וְאָכַל וָחַי לְעֹלָם

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה
אֱלֹהִים
הֵן הָאָדָם הָיָה כְּאַחַד מִמֶּנּוּ לָדַעַת טוֹב וָרָע וְעַתָּה פֶּן יִשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וְלָקַח גַּם מֵעֵץ הַחַיִּים וְאָכַל וָחַי לְעֹלָם

english.text: And YHWH
God

said, “Here, the human has become like one of us, to know good and bad.
And now, in case he’ll put out his hand and take from the tree of life as well,
and eat and live forever:”

translation.text: And the LORD
God
said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:

verses.english:
And YHWH
God
said, “Here, the human has become like one of us, to know good and bad.
And now, in case he’ll put out his hand and take from the tree of life as well,
and eat and live forever:”
verses.translation: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:

verses.hebrew:
וַיְשַׁלְּחֵהוּ יְהֹוָה
אֱלֹהִים
מִגַּן עֵדֶן לַעֲבֹד אֶת הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר לֻקַּח מִשָּׁם

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁלְּחֵהוּ יְהֹוָה
אֱלֹהִים
מִגַּן עֵדֶן לַעֲבֹד אֶת הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר לֻקַּח מִשָּׁם

english.text: And YHWH
God
put him out of the garden of Eden, to work the ground from which he was taken.

translation.text: Therefore the LORD
God
sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.

verses.english:
And YHWH
God
put him out of the garden of Eden, to work the ground from which he was taken.
verses.translation: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.

verses.hebrew: וַיְגָרֶשׁ אֶת הָאָדָם וַיַּשְׁכֵּן מִקֶּדֶם לְגַן עֵדֶן אֶת הַכְּרֻבִים וְאֵת לַהַט הַחֶרֶב הַמִּתְהַפֶּכֶת לִשְׁמֹר אֶת דֶּרֶךְ עֵץ הַחַיִּים

hebrew.text: וַיְגָרֶשׁ אֶת הָאָדָם וַיַּשְׁכֵּן מִקֶּדֶם לְגַן עֵדֶן אֶת הַכְּרֻבִים וְאֵת לַהַט הַחֶרֶב הַמִּתְהַפֶּכֶת לִשְׁמֹר אֶת דֶּרֶךְ עֵץ הַחַיִּים

english.text:
And he expelled the human. And he had the sphinxes and the flame of a revolving sword reside
at the east of the garden of Eden to watch over the way to the tree of life.

translation.text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

verses.english:
And he expelled the human. And he had the sphinxes and the flame of a revolving sword reside
at the east of the garden of Eden to watch over the way to the tree of life.

verses.hebrew:
וְהָ
\hJאָדָם
\hJיָדַע
אֶת חַוָּה אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד אֶת קַיִן וַתֹּאמֶר קָנִיתִי אִישׁ אֶת יְהֹוָה

hebrew.text: וְהָ אָדָם יָדַע אֶת חַוָּה אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד אֶת קַיִן וַתֹּאמֶר קָנִיתִי אִישׁ אֶת יְהֹוָה

english.text:
And the human had known Eve, his woman,
and she became pregnant and gave birth to Cain,
and said, “I’ve created a man with YHWH.”

translation.text: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.

verses.english:
And the human had known Eve, his woman,
and she became pregnant and gave birth to Cain,
and said, “I’ve created a man with YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּסֶף לָלֶדֶת אֶת אָחִיו אֶת הָבֶל וַיְהִי הֶבֶל רֹעֵה צֹאן וְקַיִן הָיָה עֹבֵד אֲדָמָה

hebrew.text: וַתֹּסֶף לָלֶדֶת אֶת אָחִיו אֶת הָבֶל וַיְהִי הֶבֶל רֹעֵה צֹאן וְקַיִן הָיָה עֹבֵד אֲדָמָה

english.text:
And she went on to give birth to his brother, Abel.
And Abel was a shepherd of flocks,
and Cain was a worker of ground.

translation.text: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

verses.english:
And she went on to give birth to his brother, Abel.
And Abel was a shepherd of flocks,
and Cain was a worker of ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ יָמִים וַיָּבֵא קַיִן מִפְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה מִנְחָה לַיהֹוָה

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ יָמִים וַיָּבֵא קַיִן מִפְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה מִנְחָה לַיהֹוָה

english.text:
And it was at the end of some days
and Cain brought an offering to YHWH from
the fruit of the ground.

translation.text: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And it was at the end of some days
and Cain brought an offering to YHWH from
the fruit of the ground.

verses.hebrew: וְהֶבֶל הֵבִיא גַם הוּא מִבְּכֹרת צֹאנוֹ וּמֵחֶלְבֵהֶן וַיִּשַׁע יְהֹוָה אֶל הֶבֶל וְאֶל מִנְחָתוֹ

hebrew.text: וְהֶבֶל הֵבִיא גַם הוּא מִבְּכֹרת צֹאנוֹ וּמֵחֶלְבֵהֶן וַיִּשַׁע יְהֹוָה אֶל הֶבֶל וְאֶל מִנְחָתוֹ

english.text:
And Abel brought, as well, from the firstborn of his flock and their fat.
And YHWH paid attention to Abel and his offering.

translation.text: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering:

verses.english:
And Abel brought, as well, from the firstborn of his flock and their fat.
And YHWH paid attention to Abel and his offering.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל קַיִן וְאֶל מִנְחָתוֹ לֹא שָׁעָה וַיִּחַר לְקַיִן מְאֹד וַיִּפְּלוּ פָּנָיו

hebrew.text: וְאֶל קַיִן וְאֶל מִנְחָתוֹ לֹא שָׁעָה וַיִּחַר לְקַיִן מְאֹד וַיִּפְּלוּ פָּנָיו

english.text:
And to Cain and his offering he did not pay attention.
And Cain was very upset, and his face was fallen.

translation.text: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.

verses.english:
And to Cain and his offering he did not pay attention.
And Cain was very upset, and his face was fallen.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל קָיִן לָמָּה חָרָה לָךְ וְלָמָּה נָפְלוּ פָנֶיךָ

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל קָיִן לָמָּה חָרָה לָךְ וְלָמָּה נָפְלוּ פָנֶיךָ

english.text:
And YHWH said to Cain, “Why are you upset,

and why has your face fallen?”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Cain, “Why are you upset,

and why has your face fallen?”

verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא אִם תֵּיטִיב שְׂאֵת וְאִם לֹא תֵיטִיב לַפֶּתַח חַטָּאת רֹבֵץ וְאֵלֶיךָ תְּשׁוּקָתוֹ וְאַתָּה תִּמְשׁל בּוֹ

hebrew.text: הֲלוֹא אִם תֵּיטִיב שְׂאֵת וְאִם לֹא תֵיטִיב לַפֶּתַח חַטָּאת רֹבֵץ וְאֵלֶיךָ תְּשׁוּקָתוֹ וְאַתָּה תִּמְשׁל בּוֹ

english.text:
Is it not that if you do well you'll be raised,
and if you don't do well then sin crouches at the threshold?
And its desire will be for you.
And you'll dominate it.

translation.text: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.

verses.english:
Is it not that if you do well you'll be raised,
and if you don't do well then sin crouches at the threshold?
And its desire will be for you.
And you'll dominate it.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר קַיִן אֶל הֶבֶל אָחִיו וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹתָם בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיָּקם קַיִן אֶל הֶבֶל אָחִיו וַיַּהַרְגֵהוּ

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר קַיִן אֶל הֶבֶל אָחִיו וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹתָם בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיָּקם קַיִן אֶל הֶבֶל אָחִיו וַיַּהַרְגֵהוּ

english.text:
And Cain said to his brother Abel.
And it was while they were in the field,
and Cain rose against Abel his brother
and killed him.

translation.text: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

verses.english:
And Cain said to his brother Abel.
And it was while they were in the field,
and Cain rose against Abel his brother
and killed him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל קַיִן אֵי הֶבֶל אָחִיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא יָדַעְתִּי הֲשֹׁמֵר אָחִי אָנֹכִי

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל קַיִן אֵי הֶבֶל אָחִיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא יָדַעְתִּי הֲשֹׁמֵר אָחִי אָנֹכִי

english.text:
And YHWH said to Cain,
“Where is Abel your brother?”
And he said, “I don’t know.
Am I my brother’s watchman?”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother’s keeper?

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Cain,
“Where is Abel your brother?”
And he said, “I don’t know.
Am I my brother’s watchman?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה עָשִׂיתָ קוֹל דְּמֵי אָחִיךָ צֹעֲקִים אֵלַי מִן הָאֲדָמָה

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה עָשִׂיתָ קוֹל דְּמֵי אָחִיךָ צֹעֲקִים אֵלַי מִן הָאֲדָמָה

english.text:
And He said, “What have you done? The sound!
Your brother’s blood is crying to me from the ground!

translation.text: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground.

verses.english:
And He said, “What have you done? The sound!
Your brother’s blood is crying to me from the ground!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אָרוּר אָתָּה מִן הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר פָּצְתָה אֶת פִּיהָ לָקַחַת אֶת דְּמֵי אָחִיךָ מִיָּדֶךָ

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אָרוּר אָתָּה מִן הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר פָּצְתָה אֶת פִּיהָ לָקַחַת אֶת דְּמֵי אָחִיךָ מִיָּדֶךָ

english.text:
And now you’re cursed from the ground that opened its mouth
to take your brother’s blood from your hand.

translation.text: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother’s blood from thy hand;

verses.english:
And now you’re cursed from the ground that opened its mouth
to take your brother’s blood from your hand.

verses.hebrew: כִּי תַעֲבֹד אֶת הָאֲדָמָה לֹא תֹסֵף תֵּת כֹּחָהּ לָךְ נָע וָנָד תִּהְיֶה בָאָרֶץ

hebrew.text: כִּי תַעֲבֹד אֶת הָאֲדָמָה לֹא תֹסֵף תֵּת כֹּחָהּ לָךְ נָע וָנָד תִּהְיֶה בָאָרֶץ

english.text:
When you work the ground it won’t continue to give its potency to you.
You’ll be a roamer and rover in the earth.”

translation.text: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.

verses.english:
When you work the ground it won’t continue to give its potency to you.
You’ll be a roamer and rover in the earth.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר קַיִן אֶל יְהֹוָה גָּדוֹל עֲוֺנִי מִנְּשֹׂא

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר קַיִן אֶל יְהֹוָה גָּדוֹל עֲוֺנִי מִנְּשֹׂא

english.text: And Cain said to YHWH, “My crime is greater than I can bear.

translation.text: And Cain said unto the LORD, My punishment is greater than I can bear.

verses.english: And Cain said to YHWH, “My crime is greater than I can bear.

verses.hebrew: הֵן גֵּרַשְׁתָּ אֹתִי הַיּוֹם מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה וּמִפָּנֶיךָ אֶסָּתֵר וְהָיִיתִי נָע וָנָד בָּאָרֶץ וְהָיָה כל מֹצְאִי יַהַרְגֵנִי

hebrew.text: הֵן גֵּרַשְׁתָּ אֹתִי הַיּוֹם מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה וּמִפָּנֶיךָ אֶסָּתֵר וְהָיִיתִי נָע וָנָד בָּאָרֶץ וְהָיָה כל מֹצְאִי יַהַרְגֵנִי

english.text:
Here, you’ve expelled me from the face of the ground today
and I’ll be hidden from your presence,
and I’ll be a roamer and rover in the earth,
and anyone who finds me will kill me.”

translation.text: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.

verses.english:
Here, you’ve expelled me from the face of the ground today
and I’ll be hidden from your presence,
and I’ll be a roamer and rover in the earth,
and anyone who finds me will kill me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהֹוָה לָכֵן כּל הֹרֵג קַיִן שִׁבְעָתַיִם יֻקָּם וַיָּשֶׂם יְהֹוָה לְקַיִן אוֹת לְבִלְתִּי הַכּוֹת אֹתוֹ כּל מֹצְאוֹ

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהֹוָה לָכֵן כּל הֹרֵג קַיִן שִׁבְעָתַיִם יֻקָּם וַיָּשֶׂם יְהֹוָה לְקַיִן אוֹת לְבִלְתִּי הַכּוֹת אֹתוֹ כּל מֹצְאוֹ

english.text:
And YHWH said to him,
“Therefore: anyone who kills Cain,
he’ll be avenged sevenfold.”
And YHWH set a sign for Cain
so that anyone who finds him would not strike him.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to him,
“Therefore: anyone who kills Cain,
he’ll be avenged sevenfold.”
And YHWH set a sign for Cain
so that anyone who finds him would not strike him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא קַיִן מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּאֶרֶץ נוֹד קִדְמַת עֵדֶן

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא קַיִן מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּאֶרֶץ נוֹד קִדְמַת עֵדֶן

english.text:
And Cain went out from YHWH’s presence
and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

translation.text: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

verses.english:
And Cain went out from YHWH’s presence
and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

verses.hebrew:
וַ
\hJיָדַע
\hJקַיִן
אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד אֶת חֲנוֹךְ וַיְהִי בֹּנֶה עִיר וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הָעִיר כְּשֵׁם בְּנוֹ חֲנוֹךְ

hebrew.text: וַ יָדַע קַיִן אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד אֶת חֲנוֹךְ וַיְהִי בֹּנֶה עִיר וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הָעִיר כְּשֵׁם בְּנוֹ חֲנוֹךְ

english.text:
And Cain knew his wife,
and she became pregnant and gave birth to Enoch.
And he was a builder of a city,
and he called the name of the city
like the name of his son: Enoch.

translation.text: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.

verses.english:
And Cain knew his wife,
and she became pregnant and gave birth to Enoch.
And he was a builder of a city,
and he called the name of the city
like the name of his son: Enoch.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּלֵד לַחֲנוֹךְ אֶת עִירָד וְעִירָד יָלַד אֶת מְחוּיָאֵל וּמְחִויאֵל יָלַד אֶת מְתוּשָׁאֵל וּמְתוּשָׁאֵל יָלַד אֶת לָמֶךְ

hebrew.text: וַיִּוָּלֵד לַחֲנוֹךְ אֶת עִירָד וְעִירָד יָלַד אֶת מְחוּיָאֵל וּמְחִויאֵל יָלַד אֶת מְתוּשָׁאֵל וּמְתוּשָׁאֵל יָלַד אֶת לָמֶךְ

english.text:
And Irad was born to Enoch,
and Irad fathered Mehuya-el,
and Mehuya-el fathered Metusha-el,
and Metusha-el fathered Lamech.

translation.text: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.

verses.english:
And Irad was born to Enoch,
and Irad fathered Mehuya-el,
and Mehuya-el fathered Metusha-el,
and Metusha-el fathered Lamech.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח לוֹ לֶמֶךְ שְׁתֵּי נָשִׁים שֵׁם הָאַחַת עָדָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית צִלָּה

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח לוֹ לֶמֶךְ שְׁתֵּי נָשִׁים שֵׁם הָאַחַת עָדָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית צִלָּה

english.text:
And Lamech took two wives.
The one’s name was Adah,
and the second’s name was Zillah.

translation.text: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.

verses.english:
And Lamech took two wives.
The one’s name was Adah,
and the second’s name was Zillah.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד עָדָה אֶת יָבָל הוּא הָיָה אֲבִי יֹשֵׁב אֹהֶל וּמִקְנֶה

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד עָדָה אֶת יָבָל הוּא הָיָה אֲבִי יֹשֵׁב אֹהֶל וּמִקְנֶה

english.text:
And Adah gave birth to Jabal.
He was father of tent-dweller and cattleman.

translation.text: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.

verses.english:
And Adah gave birth to Jabal.
He was father of tent-dweller and cattleman.

verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם אָחִיו יוּבָל הוּא הָיָה אֲבִי כּל תֹּפֵשׂ כִּנּוֹר וְעוּגָב

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁם אָחִיו יוּבָל הוּא הָיָה אֲבִי כּל תֹּפֵשׂ כִּנּוֹר וְעוּגָב

english.text:
And his brother’s name was Jubal.
He was father of every player of lyre and pipe.

translation.text: And his brother’s name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.

verses.english:
And his brother’s name was Jubal.
He was father of every player of lyre and pipe.

verses.hebrew: וְצִלָּה גַם הִוא יָלְדָה אֶת תּוּבַל קַיִן לֹטֵשׁ כּל חֹרֵשׁ נְחֹשֶׁת וּבַרְזֶל וַאֲחוֹת תּוּבַל קַיִן נַעֲמָה

hebrew.text: וְצִלָּה גַם הִוא יָלְדָה אֶת תּוּבַל קַיִן לֹטֵשׁ כּל חֹרֵשׁ נְחֹשֶׁת וּבַרְזֶל וַאֲחוֹת תּוּבַל קַיִן נַעֲמָה

english.text:
And Zillah, too, gave birth to Tubal-Cain,
forger of every implement of bronze and iron.
And Tubal-Cain’s sister was Naamah.

translation.text: And Zillah, she also bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah.

verses.english:
And Zillah, too, gave birth to Tubal-Cain,
forger of every implement of bronze and iron.
And Tubal-Cain’s sister was Naamah.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֶמֶךְ לְנָשָׁיו עָדָה וְצִלָּה שְׁמַעַן קוֹלִי נְשֵׁי לֶמֶךְ הַאְזֵנָּה אִמְרָתִי כִּי אִישׁ הָרַגְתִּי לְפִצְעִי וְיֶלֶד לְחַבֻּרָתִי

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לֶמֶךְ לְנָשָׁיו עָדָה וְצִלָּה שְׁמַעַן קוֹלִי נְשֵׁי לֶמֶךְ הַאְזֵנָּה אִמְרָתִי כִּי אִישׁ הָרַגְתִּי לְפִצְעִי וְיֶלֶד לְחַבֻּרָתִי

english.text:
And Lamech said to his wives:
Adah and Zillah, listen to my voice,
Wives of Lamech, hear what I say.
For I’ve killed a man for a wound to me
And a boy for a hurt to me,

translation.text: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.

verses.english:
And Lamech said to his wives:
Adah and Zillah, listen to my voice,
Wives of Lamech, hear what I say.
For I’ve killed a man for a wound to me
And a boy for a hurt to me,

verses.hebrew: כִּי שִׁבְעָתַיִם יֻקַּם קָיִן וְלֶמֶךְ שִׁבְעִים וְשִׁבְעָה

hebrew.text: כִּי שִׁבְעָתַיִם יֻקַּם קָיִן וְלֶמֶךְ שִׁבְעִים וְשִׁבְעָה

english.text:
For Cain will be avenged sevenfold
And Lamech seventy-seven.

translation.text: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.

verses.english:
For Cain will be avenged sevenfold
And Lamech seventy-seven.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּדַע אָדָם עוֹד אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ שֵׁת כִּי שָׁת לִי אֱלֹהִים זֶרַע אַחֵר תַּחַת הֶבֶל כִּי הֲרָגוֹ קָיִן

hebrew.text: וַיֵּדַע אָדָם עוֹד אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ שֵׁת כִּי שָׁת לִי אֱלֹהִים זֶרַע אַחֵר תַּחַת הֶבֶל כִּי הֲרָגוֹ קָיִן

english.text:
And Adam knew his wife again,
and she gave birth to a son,
and she called his name Seth
“because God put another seed for me
in place of Abel because Cain killed him.”

translation.text: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.

verses.english:
And Adam knew his wife again,
and she gave birth to a son,
and she called his name Seth
“because God put another seed for me
in place of Abel because Cain killed him.”

verses.hebrew:
וּלְשֵׁת גַּם הוּא יֻלַּד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ אֱנוֹשׁ
אָז הוּחַל לִקְרֹא בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה

hebrew.text: וּלְשֵׁת גַּם הוּא יֻלַּד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ אֱנוֹשׁ
אָז הוּחַל לִקְרֹא בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה

english.text:
And a son was born to Seth, him as well,
and he called his name Enosh.
Then it was begun to invoke the name YHWH.

translation.text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos:
then began men to call upon the name of the LORD.

verses.english:
And a son was born to Seth, him as well,
and he called his name Enosh.

Then it was begun to invoke the name YHWH.
verses.translation: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD.

verses.hebrew: זֶה סֵפֶר תּוֹלְדֹת אָדָם בְּיוֹם בְּרֹא אֱלֹהִים אָדָם בִּדְמוּת אֱלֹהִים עָשָׂה אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: זֶה סֵפֶר תּוֹלְדֹת אָדָם בְּיוֹם בְּרֹא אֱלֹהִים אָדָם בִּדְמוּת אֱלֹהִים עָשָׂה אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
This is the Book of Records of the Human. In the day of
God’s creating a human, He made it in the likeness of God.

translation.text: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;

verses.english:
This is the Book of Records of the Human. In the day of
God’s creating a human, He made it in the likeness of God.

verses.hebrew: זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה בְּרָאָם וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתָם וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמָם אָדָם בְּיוֹם הִבָּרְאָם׃

hebrew.text: זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה בְּרָאָם וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתָם וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמָם אָדָם בְּיוֹם הִבָּרְאָם׃

english.text:
He created them male and female, and He blessed them and
called their name “Human” in the day of their being
created.

translation.text: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.

verses.english:
He created them male and female, and He blessed them and
called their name “Human” in the day of their being
created.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי אָדָם שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בִּדְמוּתוֹ כְּצַלְמוֹ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ שֵׁת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי אָדָם שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בִּדְמוּתוֹ כְּצַלְמוֹ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ שֵׁת׃

english.text:
And the human lived a hundred thirty years, and he
fathered in his likeness—like his image—and called his
name Seth.

translation.text: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, and after his image; and called his name Seth:

verses.english:
And the human lived a hundred thirty years, and he
fathered in his likeness—like his image—and called his
name Seth.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ יְמֵי אָדָם אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת שֵׁת שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ יְמֵי אָדָם אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת שֵׁת שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And the human’s days after his fathering Seth were eight
hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

translation.text: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:

verses.english:
And the human’s days after his fathering Seth were eight
hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי אָדָם אֲשֶׁר חַי תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי אָדָם אֲשֶׁר חַי תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
And all of the human’s days that he lived were nine
hundred years and thirty years. And he died.

translation.text: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.

verses.english:
And all of the human’s days that he lived were nine
hundred years and thirty years. And he died.

translation.text: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.

verses.english:
and called his name Noah, saying, “This one will console
us from our labor and from our hands’ suffering from the
ground, which YHWH has cursed.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי לֶמֶךְ אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת נֹחַ חָמֵשׁ וְתִשְׁעִים שָׁנָה וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי לֶמֶךְ אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת נֹחַ חָמֵשׁ וְתִשְׁעִים שָׁנָה וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Lamech lived after his fathering Noah ninety-five
years and five hundred years, and he fathered sons and
daughters.

translation.text: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:

verses.english:
And Lamech lived after his fathering Noah ninety-five
years and five hundred years, and he fathered sons and
daughters.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כּל יְמֵי לֶמֶךְ שֶׁבַע וְשִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כּל יְמֵי לֶמֶךְ שֶׁבַע וְשִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
And all of Lamech’s days were seventy-seven years and
seven hundred years. And he died.

translation.text: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.

verses.english:
And all of Lamech’s days were seventy-seven years and
seven hundred years. And he died.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי נֹחַ בֶּן חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד נֹחַ אֶת שֵׁם אֶת חָם וְאֶת יָפֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי נֹחַ בֶּן חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד נֹחַ אֶת שֵׁם אֶת חָם וְאֶת יָפֶת׃

english.text:
And Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah fathered
Shem, Ham, and Yaphet.

translation.text: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.english:
And Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah fathered
Shem, Ham, and Yaphet.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי הֵחֵל הָאָדָם לָרֹב עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה וּבָנוֹת יֻלְּדוּ לָהֶם

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי הֵחֵל הָאָדָם לָרֹב עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה וּבָנוֹת יֻלְּדוּ לָהֶם

english.text:
And it was when humankind began to multiply on the face of the ground
and daughters were born to them:

translation.text: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,

verses.english:
And it was when humankind began to multiply on the face of the ground
and daughters were born to them:

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ בְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת בְּנוֹת הָאָדָם כִּי טֹבֹת הֵנָּה וַיִּקְחוּ לָהֶם נָשִׁים מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרוּ

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ בְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת בְּנוֹת הָאָדָם כִּי טֹבֹת הֵנָּה וַיִּקְחוּ לָהֶם נָשִׁים מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרוּ

english.text:
and the sons of the gods saw the daughters of humankind,
that they were attractive,
and they took women, from all they chose.

translation.text: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

verses.english:
and the sons of the gods saw the daughters of humankind,
that they were attractive,
and they took women, from all they chose.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לֹא יָדוֹן רוּחִי בָאָדָם לְעֹלָם בְּשַׁגַּם הוּא בָשָׂר וְהָיוּ יָמָיו מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה

english.text:
And YHWH said,
“My spirit won’t stay in humankind forever,
since they’re also flesh;
and their days shall be a hundred twenty years.”

translation.text: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.

verses.english:
And YHWH said,
“My spirit won’t stay in humankind forever,
since they’re also flesh;
and their days shall be a hundred twenty years.”
