And he drank from the wine and was drunk. And he was
exposed inside his tent.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא חָם אֲבִי כְנַעַן אֵת עֶרְוַת אָבִיו וַיַּגֵּד לִשְׁנֵי אֶחָיו בַּחוּץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא חָם אֲבִי כְנַעַן אֵת עֶרְוַת אָבִיו וַיַּגֵּד לִשְׁנֵי אֶחָיו בַּחוּץ׃

english.text:
And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father’s nakedness
and told his two brothers outside.

translation.text: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.

verses.english:
And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father’s nakedness
and told his two brothers outside.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח שֵׁם וָיֶפֶת אֶת הַשִּׂמְלָה וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל שְׁכֶם שְׁנֵיהֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ אֲחֹרַנִּית וַיְכַסּוּ אֵת עֶרְוַת אֲבִיהֶם וּפְנֵיהֶם אֲחֹרַנִּית וְעֶרְוַת אֲבִיהֶם לֹא רָאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח שֵׁם וָיֶפֶת אֶת הַשִּׂמְלָה וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל שְׁכֶם שְׁנֵיהֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ אֲחֹרַנִּית וַיְכַסּוּ אֵת עֶרְוַת אֲבִיהֶם וּפְנֵיהֶם אֲחֹרַנִּית וְעֶרְוַת אֲבִיהֶם לֹא רָאוּ׃

english.text:
And Shem and Yaphet took a garment and put it on both
their shoulders and went backwards and covered their
father’s nakedness. And they faced backwards and did not
see their father’s nakedness.

translation.text: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father’s nakedness.

verses.english:
And Shem and Yaphet took a garment and put it on both
their shoulders and went backwards and covered their
father’s nakedness. And they faced backwards and did not
see their father’s nakedness.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּיקֶץ נֹחַ מִיֵּינוֹ וַיֵּדַע אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לוֹ בְּנוֹ הַקָּטָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּיקֶץ נֹחַ מִיֵּינוֹ וַיֵּדַע אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לוֹ בְּנוֹ הַקָּטָן׃

english.text:
And Noah woke up from his wine, and he knew what his
youngest son had done to him.

translation.text: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.

verses.english:
And Noah woke up from his wine, and he knew what his
youngest son had done to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָרוּר כְּנָעַן עֶבֶד עֲבָדִים יִהְיֶה לְאֶחָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָרוּר כְּנָעַן עֶבֶד עֲבָדִים יִהְיֶה לְאֶחָיו׃

english.text:
And he said, “Canaan is cursed. He’ll be a servant of
servants to his brothers.”

translation.text: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.

verses.english:
And he said, “Canaan is cursed. He’ll be a servant of
servants to his brothers.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי שֵׁם וִיהִי כְנַעַן עֶבֶד לָמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי שֵׁם וִיהִי כְנַעַן עֶבֶד לָמוֹ׃

english.text:
And he said, “Blessed is YHWH, God of Shem, and may Canaan
be a servant to them.

translation.text: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

verses.english:
And he said, “Blessed is YHWH, God of Shem, and may Canaan
be a servant to them.

verses.hebrew: יַפְתְּ אֱלֹהִים לְיֶפֶת וְיִשְׁכֹּן בְּאהֳלֵי שֵׁם וִיהִי כְנַעַן עֶבֶד לָמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: יַפְתְּ אֱלֹהִים לְיֶפֶת וְיִשְׁכֹּן בְּאהֳלֵי שֵׁם וִיהִי כְנַעַן עֶבֶד לָמוֹ׃

english.text:
May God enlarge Yaphet, and may he dwell in the tents of
Shem, and may Canaan be a servant to them.”

translation.text: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

verses.english:
May God enlarge Yaphet, and may he dwell in the tents of
Shem, and may Canaan be a servant to them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי נֹחַ אַחַר הַמַּבּוּל שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי נֹחַ אַחַר הַמַּבּוּל שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
And Noah lived after the flood three hundred years and
fifty years,

translation.text: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.

verses.english:
And Noah lived after the flood three hundred years and
fifty years,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי נֹחַ תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ כּל יְמֵי נֹחַ תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
and all of Noah’s days were nine hundred years and fifty
years. And he died.

translation.text: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.

verses.english:
and all of Noah’s days were nine hundred years and fifty
years. And he died.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת בְּנֵי נֹחַ שֵׁם חָם וָיָפֶת וַיִּוָּלְדוּ לָהֶם בָּנִים אַחַר הַמַּבּוּל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת בְּנֵי נֹחַ שֵׁם חָם וָיָפֶת וַיִּוָּלְדוּ לָהֶם בָּנִים אַחַר הַמַּבּוּל׃

english.text:
And these are the records of Noah’s sons, Shem, Ham,
and Yaphet: And children were born to them after the
flood.

translation.text: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.

verses.english:
And these are the records of Noah’s sons, Shem, Ham,
and Yaphet: And children were born to them after the
flood.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יֶפֶת גֹּמֶר וּמָגוֹג וּמָדַי וְיָוָן וְתֻבָל וּמֶשֶׁךְ וְתִירָס׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי יֶפֶת גֹּמֶר וּמָגוֹג וּמָדַי וְיָוָן וְתֻבָל וּמֶשֶׁךְ וְתִירָס׃

english.text:
Yaphet’s children were Gomer and Magog and Madai and Yawan
and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.

translation.text: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

verses.english:
Yaphet’s children were Gomer and Magog and Madai and Yawan
and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי גֹּמֶר אַשְׁכְּנַז וְרִיפַת וְתֹגַרְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי גֹּמֶר אַשְׁכְּנַז וְרִיפַת וְתֹגַרְמָה׃

english.text: And Gomer’s children were Ashkenaz and Riphath and Togarmah.

translation.text: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

verses.english: And Gomer’s children were Ashkenaz and Riphath and Togarmah.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יָוָן אֱלִישָׁה וְתַרְשִׁישׁ כִּתִּים וְדֹדָנִים׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי יָוָן אֱלִישָׁה וְתַרְשִׁישׁ כִּתִּים וְדֹדָנִים׃

english.text:
And Yawan’s children were El-isha and Tarshish, Kittim and
Dodanim.

translation.text: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

verses.english:
And Yawan’s children were El-isha and Tarshish, Kittim and
Dodanim.

verses.hebrew: מֵאֵלֶּה נִפְרְדוּ אִיֵּי הַגּוֹיִם בְּאַרְצֹתָם אִישׁ לִלְשֹׁנוֹ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם בְּגוֹיֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: מֵאֵלֶּה נִפְרְדוּ אִיֵּי הַגּוֹיִם בְּאַרְצֹתָם אִישׁ לִלְשֹׁנוֹ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם בְּגוֹיֵהֶם׃

english.text:
The islands of the nations in their lands were dispersed
out from these, each by its language, by their families
within their nations.

translation.text: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.

verses.english:
The islands of the nations in their lands were dispersed
out from these, each by its language, by their families
within their nations.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי חָם כּוּשׁ וּמִצְרַיִם וּפוּט וּכְנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי חָם כּוּשׁ וּמִצְרַיִם וּפוּט וּכְנָעַן׃

english.text: And Ham’s children were Cush and Egypt and Put and Canaan.

translation.text: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.

verses.english: And Ham’s children were Cush and Egypt and Put and Canaan.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי כוּשׁ סְבָא וַחֲוִילָה וְסַבְתָּה וְרַעְמָה וְסַבְתְּכָא וּבְנֵי רַעְמָה שְׁבָא וּדְדָן׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי כוּשׁ סְבָא וַחֲוִילָה וְסַבְתָּה וְרַעְמָה וְסַבְתְּכָא וּבְנֵי רַעְמָה שְׁבָא וּדְדָן׃

english.text:
And Cush’s children were Seba and Havilah and Sabtah and
Raamah and Sabteca. And Raamah’s children were Sheba and
Dedan.

translation.text: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtechah: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

verses.english:
And Cush’s children were Seba and Havilah and Sabtah and
Raamah and Sabteca. And Raamah’s children were Sheba and
Dedan.

verses.hebrew: וְכוּשׁ יָלַד אֶת נִמְרֹד הוּא הֵחֵל לִהְיוֹת גִּבֹּר בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְכוּשׁ יָלַד אֶת נִמְרֹד הוּא הֵחֵל לִהְיוֹת גִּבֹּר בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And Cush fathered Nimrod. He began being a man of power in
the earth.

translation.text: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

verses.english:
And Cush fathered Nimrod. He began being a man of power in
the earth.

verses.hebrew: הוּא הָיָה גִבֹּר צַיִד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל כֵּן יֵאָמַר כְּנִמְרֹד גִּבּוֹר צַיִד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: הוּא הָיָה גִבֹּר צַיִד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל כֵּן יֵאָמַר כְּנִמְרֹד גִּבּוֹר צַיִד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
He was a powerful hunter before YHWH. On account of this
it is said: “A powerful hunter before YHWH like Nimrod!”

translation.text: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.

verses.english:
He was a powerful hunter before YHWH. On account of this
it is said: “A powerful hunter before YHWH like Nimrod!”

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי רֵאשִׁית מַמְלַכְתּוֹ בָּבֶל וְאֶרֶךְ וְאַכַּד וְכַלְנֵה בְּאֶרֶץ שִׁנְעָר׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי רֵאשִׁית מַמְלַכְתּוֹ בָּבֶל וְאֶרֶךְ וְאַכַּד וְכַלְנֵה בְּאֶרֶץ שִׁנְעָר׃

english.text:
And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel and Erech and
Accad and Calneh in the land of Shinar.

translation.text: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

verses.english:
And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel and Erech and
Accad and Calneh in the land of Shinar.

verses.hebrew: מִן הָאָרֶץ הַהִוא יָצָא אַשּׁוּר וַיִּבֶן אֶת נִינְוֵה וְאֶת רְחֹבֹת עִיר וְאֶת כָּלַח׃

hebrew.text: מִן הָאָרֶץ הַהִוא יָצָא אַשּׁוּר וַיִּבֶן אֶת נִינְוֵה וְאֶת רְחֹבֹת עִיר וְאֶת כָּלַח׃

english.text:
Asshur came out of that land and built Nineveh and
Rehovoth-Ir and Calah,

translation.text: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,

verses.english:
Asshur came out of that land and built Nineveh and
Rehovoth-Ir and Calah,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת רֶסֶן בֵּין נִינְוֵה וּבֵין כָּלַח הִוא הָעִיר הַגְּדֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת רֶסֶן בֵּין נִינְוֵה וּבֵין כָּלַח הִוא הָעִיר הַגְּדֹלָה׃

english.text: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah. It is the big city.

translation.text: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.

verses.english: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah. It is the big city.

verses.hebrew: וּמִצְרַיִם יָלַד אֶת לוּדִים וְאֶת עֲנָמִים וְאֶת לְהָבִים וְאֶת נַפְתֻּחִים׃

hebrew.text: וּמִצְרַיִם יָלַד אֶת לוּדִים וְאֶת עֲנָמִים וְאֶת לְהָבִים וְאֶת נַפְתֻּחִים׃

english.text:
And Egypt fathered Ludim and Anamim and Lehabim and
Naphtuhim

translation.text: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

verses.english:
And Egypt fathered Ludim and Anamim and Lehabim and
Naphtuhim

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת פַּתְרֻסִים וְאֶת כַּסְלֻחִים אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ מִשָּׁם פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְאֶת כַּפְתֹּרִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת פַּתְרֻסִים וְאֶת כַּסְלֻחִים אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ מִשָּׁם פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְאֶת כַּפְתֹּרִים׃

english.text:
and Pathrusim and Casluhim, from which the Philistines
came out, and Caphtorim.

translation.text: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.

verses.english:
and Pathrusim and Casluhim, from which the Philistines
came out, and Caphtorim.

verses.hebrew: וּכְנַעַן יָלַד אֶת צִידֹן בְּכֹרוֹ וְאֶת חֵת׃

hebrew.text: וּכְנַעַן יָלַד אֶת צִידֹן בְּכֹרוֹ וְאֶת חֵת׃

english.text: And Canaan fathered Sidon, his firstborn, and Heth

translation.text: And Canaan begat Sidon his first born, and Heth,

verses.english: And Canaan fathered Sidon, his firstborn, and Heth

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַיְבוּסִי וְאֶת הָאֱמֹרִי וְאֵת הַגִּרְגָּשִׁי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַיְבוּסִי וְאֶת הָאֱמֹרִי וְאֵת הַגִּרְגָּשִׁי׃

english.text: and the Jebusite and the Amorite and the Gir-gashite

translation.text: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,

verses.english: and the Jebusite and the Amorite and the Gir-gashite

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַחִוִּי וְאֶת הַעַרְקִי וְאֶת הַסִּינִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַחִוִּי וְאֶת הַעַרְקִי וְאֶת הַסִּינִי׃

english.text: and the Hivite and the Arkite and the Sinite

translation.text: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

verses.english: and the Hivite and the Arkite and the Sinite

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָאַרְוָדִי וְאֶת הַצְּמָרִי וְאֶת הַחֲמָתִי וְאַחַר נָפֹצוּ מִשְׁפְּחוֹת הַכְּנַעֲנִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָאַרְוָדִי וְאֶת הַצְּמָרִי וְאֶת הַחֲמָתִי וְאַחַר נָפֹצוּ מִשְׁפְּחוֹת הַכְּנַעֲנִי׃

english.text:
and the Arvadite and the Zemarite and the Hamathite. And
later the families of the Canaanites were dispersed.

translation.text: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.

verses.english:
and the Arvadite and the Zemarite and the Hamathite. And
later the families of the Canaanites were dispersed.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְּבוּל הַכְּנַעֲנִי מִצִּידֹן בֹּאֲכָה גְרָרָה עַד עַזָּה בֹּאֲכָה סְדֹמָה וַעֲמֹרָה וְאַדְמָה וּצְבֹיִם עַד לָשַׁע׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי גְּבוּל הַכְּנַעֲנִי מִצִּידֹן בֹּאֲכָה גְרָרָה עַד עַזָּה בֹּאֲכָה סְדֹמָה וַעֲמֹרָה וְאַדְמָה וּצְבֹיִם עַד לָשַׁע׃

english.text:
And the Canaanite border was from Sidon, as you come to
Gerar, up to Gaza, as you come to Sodom and Gomorrah and
Admah and Zeboim, up to Lasha.

translation.text: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.

verses.english:
And the Canaanite border was from Sidon, as you come to
Gerar, up to Gaza, as you come to Sodom and Gomorrah and
Admah and Zeboim, up to Lasha.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי חָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִלְשֹׁנֹתָם בְּאַרְצֹתָם בְּגוֹיֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי חָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִלְשֹׁנֹתָם בְּאַרְצֹתָם בְּגוֹיֵהֶם׃

english.text:
These are Ham’s children, by their families, by their
languages, in their lands, within their nations.

translation.text: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.

verses.english:
These are Ham’s children, by their families, by their
languages, in their lands, within their nations.

verses.hebrew: וּלְשֵׁם יֻלַּד גַּם הוּא אֲבִי כּל בְּנֵי עֵבֶר אֲחִי יֶפֶת הַגָּדוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וּלְשֵׁם יֻלַּד גַּם הוּא אֲבִי כּל בְּנֵי עֵבֶר אֲחִי יֶפֶת הַגָּדוֹל׃

english.text:
Children were born to Shem, him as well, father of all of
Eber’s children, older brother of Yaphet.

translation.text: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.

verses.english:
Children were born to Shem, him as well, father of all of
Eber’s children, older brother of Yaphet.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי שֵׁם עֵילָם וְאַשּׁוּר וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁד וְלוּד וַאֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי שֵׁם עֵילָם וְאַשּׁוּר וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁד וְלוּד וַאֲרָם׃

english.text:
Shem’s children were Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad and
Lud and Aram.

translation.text: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.

verses.english:
Shem’s children were Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad and
Lud and Aram.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי אֲרָם עוּץ וְחוּל וְגֶתֶר וָמַשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי אֲרָם עוּץ וְחוּל וְגֶתֶר וָמַשׁ׃

english.text: And Aram’s children were Uz and Hul and Gether and Mash.

translation.text: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.

verses.english: And Aram’s children were Uz and Hul and Gether and Mash.

verses.hebrew: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁד יָלַד אֶת שָׁלַח וְשֶׁלַח יָלַד אֶת עֵבֶר׃

hebrew.text: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁד יָלַד אֶת שָׁלַח וְשֶׁלַח יָלַד אֶת עֵבֶר׃

english.text: And Arpachshad fathered Shelah, and Shelah fathered Eber.

translation.text: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.

verses.english: And Arpachshad fathered Shelah, and Shelah fathered Eber.

verses.hebrew: וּלְעֵבֶר יֻלַּד שְׁנֵי בָנִים שֵׁם הָאֶחָד פֶּלֶג כִּי בְיָמָיו נִפְלְגָה הָאָרֶץ וְשֵׁם אָחִיו יקְטָן׃

hebrew.text: וּלְעֵבֶר יֻלַּד שְׁנֵי בָנִים שֵׁם הָאֶחָד פֶּלֶג כִּי בְיָמָיו נִפְלְגָה הָאָרֶץ וְשֵׁם אָחִיו יקְטָן׃

english.text:
And two sons were born to Eber. The name of one was Peleg,
because in his days the earth was divided, and his
brother’s name was Joktan.

translation.text: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.

verses.english:
And two sons were born to Eber. The name of one was Peleg,
because in his days the earth was divided, and his
brother’s name was Joktan.

verses.hebrew: וְיקְטָן יָלַד אֶת אַלְמוֹדָד וְאֶת שָׁלֶף וְאֶת חֲצַרְמָוֶת וְאֶת יָרַח׃

hebrew.text: וְיקְטָן יָלַד אֶת אַלְמוֹדָד וְאֶת שָׁלֶף וְאֶת חֲצַרְמָוֶת וְאֶת יָרַח׃

english.text:
And Joktan fathered Almodad and Sheleph and Hazarmaveth
and Jerah

translation.text: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

verses.english:
And Joktan fathered Almodad and Sheleph and Hazarmaveth
and Jerah

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הֲדוֹרָם וְאֶת אוּזָל וְאֶת דִּקְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הֲדוֹרָם וְאֶת אוּזָל וְאֶת דִּקְלָה׃

english.text: and Hadoram and Uzal and Diklah

translation.text: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

verses.english: and Hadoram and Uzal and Diklah

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת עוֹבָל וְאֶת אֲבִימָאֵל וְאֶת שְׁבָא׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת עוֹבָל וְאֶת אֲבִימָאֵל וְאֶת שְׁבָא׃

english.text: and Obal and Abimael and Sheba

translation.text: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

verses.english: and Obal and Abimael and Sheba

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת אוֹפִר וְאֶת חֲוִילָה וְאֶת יוֹבָב כּל אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי יקְטָן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת אוֹפִר וְאֶת חֲוִילָה וְאֶת יוֹבָב כּל אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי יקְטָן׃

english.text:
and Ophir and Havilah and Jobab. All these are Joktan’s
children.

translation.text: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.

verses.english:
and Ophir and Havilah and Jobab. All these are Joktan’s
children.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מוֹשָׁבָם מִמֵּשָׁא בֹּאֲכָה סְפָרָה הַר הַקֶּדֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מוֹשָׁבָם מִמֵּשָׁא בֹּאֲכָה סְפָרָה הַר הַקֶּדֶם׃

english.text:
And their home was from Mesha, as you come to Sephar, to
the mountain of the east.

translation.text: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.

verses.english:
And their home was from Mesha, as you come to Sephar, to
the mountain of the east.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי שֵׁם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִלְשֹׁנֹתָם בְּאַרְצֹתָם לְגוֹיֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי שֵׁם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִלְשֹׁנֹתָם בְּאַרְצֹתָם לְגוֹיֵהֶם׃

english.text:
These are Shem’s children, by their families, by their
languages, in their lands, by their nations.

translation.text: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.

verses.english:
These are Shem’s children, by their families, by their
languages, in their lands, by their nations.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי נֹחַ לְתוֹלְדֹתָם בְּגוֹיֵהֶם וּמֵאֵלֶּה נִפְרְדוּ הַגּוֹיִם בָּאָרֶץ אַחַר הַמַּבּוּל׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי נֹחַ לְתוֹלְדֹתָם בְּגוֹיֵהֶם וּמֵאֵלֶּה נִפְרְדוּ הַגּוֹיִם בָּאָרֶץ אַחַר הַמַּבּוּל׃

english.text:
These are the families of Noah’s children by their records
in their nations, and the nations were dispersed from
these in the earth after the flood.

translation.text: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.

verses.english:
These are the families of Noah’s children by their records
in their nations, and the nations were dispersed from
these in the earth after the flood.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כל הָאָרֶץ שָׂפָה אֶחָת וּדְבָרִים אֲחָדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כל הָאָרֶץ שָׂפָה אֶחָת וּדְבָרִים אֲחָדִים׃

english.text:
And it was: all the earth was one language and the same
words.

translation.text: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.

verses.english:
And it was: all the earth was one language and the same
words.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּנסְעָם מִקֶּדֶם וַיִּמְצְאוּ בִקְעָה בְּאֶרֶץ שִׁנְעָר וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּנסְעָם מִקֶּדֶם וַיִּמְצְאוּ בִקְעָה בְּאֶרֶץ שִׁנְעָר וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם׃

english.text:
And it was when they were traveling from the east: and
they found a valley in the land of Shinar and lived there.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.

verses.english:
And it was when they were traveling from the east: and
they found a valley in the land of Shinar and lived there.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ הָבָה נִלְבְּנָה לְבֵנִים וְנִשְׂרְפָה לִשְׂרֵפָה וַתְּהִי לָהֶם הַלְּבֵנָה לְאָבֶן וְהַחֵמָר הָיָה לָהֶם לַחֹמֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ הָבָה נִלְבְּנָה לְבֵנִים וְנִשְׂרְפָה לִשְׂרֵפָה וַתְּהִי לָהֶם הַלְּבֵנָה לְאָבֶן וְהַחֵמָר הָיָה לָהֶם לַחֹמֶר׃

english.text:
And they said to one another, “Come on, let’s make bricks
and fire them.” And they had brick for stone, and they had
bitumen for mortar.

translation.text: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.

verses.english:
And they said to one another, “Come on, let’s make bricks
and fire them.” And they had brick for stone, and they had
bitumen for mortar.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָבָה נִבְנֶה לָּנוּ עִיר וּמִגְדָּל וְרֹאשׁוֹ בַשָּׁמַיִם

וְנַעֲשֶׂה לָּנוּ שֵׁם פֶּן נָפוּץ עַל פְּנֵי כל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָבָה נִבְנֶה לָּנוּ עִיר וּמִגְדָּל וְרֹאשׁוֹ בַשָּׁמַיִם וְנַעֲשֶׂה לָּנוּ שֵׁם פֶּן נָפוּץ עַל פְּנֵי כל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And they said, “Come on, let’s build ourselves a city and
a tower that reaches to the heavens.

And we’ll make ourselves a name, or else we’ll scatter over the face of
all the earth.”

translation.text: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.

verses.english:
And they said, “Come on, let’s build ourselves a city and
a tower that reaches to the heavens.

And we’ll make ourselves a name, or else we’ll scatter over the face of
all the earth.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד יְהֹוָה לִרְאֹת אֶת הָעִיר וְאֶת הַמִּגְדָּל אֲשֶׁר בָּנוּ בְּנֵי הָאָדָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד יְהֹוָה לִרְאֹת אֶת הָעִיר וְאֶת הַמִּגְדָּל אֲשֶׁר בָּנוּ בְּנֵי הָאָדָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH went down to see the city and the tower that the
children of humankind had built.

translation.text: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.

verses.english:
And YHWH went down to see the city and the tower that the
children of humankind had built.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה הֵן עַם אֶחָד וְשָׂפָה אַחַת לְכֻלָּם וְזֶה הַחִלָּם לַעֲשׂוֹת וְעַתָּה לֹא יִבָּצֵר מֵהֶם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יָזְמוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה הֵן עַם אֶחָד וְשָׂפָה אַחַת לְכֻלָּם וְזֶה הַחִלָּם לַעֲשׂוֹת וְעַתָּה לֹא יִבָּצֵר מֵהֶם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יָזְמוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

english.text:
And YHWH said, “Here, they’re one people, and they all
have one language, and this is what they’ve begun to do.
And now nothing that they’ll scheme to do will be
precluded from them.

translation.text: And the LORD said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.

verses.english:
And YHWH said, “Here, they’re one people, and they all
have one language, and this is what they’ve begun to do.
And now nothing that they’ll scheme to do will be
precluded from them.

verses.hebrew: הָבָה נֵרְדָה וְנָבְלָה שָׁם שְׂפָתָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ אִישׁ שְׂפַת רֵעֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: הָבָה נֵרְדָה וְנָבְלָה שָׁם שְׂפָתָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ אִישׁ שְׂפַת רֵעֵהוּ׃

english.text:
Come on, let’s go down and babble their language there so
that one won’t understand another’s language.”

translation.text: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.

verses.english:
Come on, let’s go down and babble their language there so
that one won’t understand another’s language.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּפֶץ יְהֹוָה אֹתָם מִשָּׁם עַל פְּנֵי כל הָאָרֶץ וַיַּחְדְּלוּ לִבְנֹת הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּפֶץ יְהֹוָה אֹתָם מִשָּׁם עַל פְּנֵי כל הָאָרֶץ וַיַּחְדְּלוּ לִבְנֹת הָעִיר׃

english.text:
And YHWH scattered them from there over the face of all
the earth, and they stopped building the city.

translation.text: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.

verses.english:
And YHWH scattered them from there over the face of all
the earth, and they stopped building the city.

verses.hebrew: עַל כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמָהּ בָּבֶל כִּי שָׁם בָּלַל יְהֹוָה שְׂפַת כּל הָאָרֶץ וּמִשָּׁם הֱפִיצָם יְהֹוָה עַל פְּנֵי כּל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: עַל כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמָהּ בָּבֶל כִּי שָׁם בָּלַל יְהֹוָה שְׂפַת כּל הָאָרֶץ וּמִשָּׁם הֱפִיצָם יְהֹוָה עַל פְּנֵי כּל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
On account of this its name was called Babylon, because
YHWH babbled the language of all the earth there, and YHWH
scattered them from there over the face of all the earth.

translation.text: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.

verses.english:
On account of this its name was called Babylon, because
YHWH babbled the language of all the earth there, and YHWH
scattered them from there over the face of all the earth.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת שֵׁם שֵׁם בֶּן מְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת אַרְפַּכְשָׁד שְׁנָתַיִם אַחַר הַמַּבּוּל׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת שֵׁם שֵׁם בֶּן מְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת אַרְפַּכְשָׁד שְׁנָתַיִם אַחַר הַמַּבּוּל׃

english.text:
These are the records of Shem: Shem was a hundred years
old, and he fathered Arpachshad, two years after the
flood.

translation.text: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:

verses.english:
These are the records of Shem: Shem was a hundred years
old, and he fathered Arpachshad, two years after the
flood.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי שֵׁם אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת אַרְפַּכְשָׁד חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי שֵׁם אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת אַרְפַּכְשָׁד חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Shem lived after his fathering Arpachshad five hundred
years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

translation.text: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.english:
And Shem lived after his fathering Arpachshad five hundred
years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

verses.hebrew: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁד חַי חָמֵשׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת שָׁלַח׃

hebrew.text: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁד חַי חָמֵשׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת שָׁלַח׃

english.text:
And Arpachshad lived thirty-five years, and he fathered
She-lah.

translation.text: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:

verses.english:
And Arpachshad lived thirty-five years, and he fathered
She-lah.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי אַרְפַּכְשַׁד אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת שֶׁלַח שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי אַרְפַּכְשַׁד אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת שֶׁלַח שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Arpachshad lived after his fathering Shelah three
years and four hundred years, and he fathered sons and
daughters.

translation.text: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.english:
And Arpachshad lived after his fathering Shelah three
years and four hundred years, and he fathered sons and
daughters.

verses.hebrew: וְשֶׁלַח חַי שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת עֵבֶר׃

hebrew.text: וְשֶׁלַח חַי שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת עֵבֶר׃

english.text: And Shelah lived thirty years, and he fathered Eber.

translation.text: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:

verses.english: And Shelah lived thirty years, and he fathered Eber.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי שֶׁלַח אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת עֵבֶר שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי שֶׁלַח אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת עֵבֶר שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Shelah lived after his fathering Eber three years and
four hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

translation.text: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.english:
And Shelah lived after his fathering Eber three years and
four hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי עֵבֶר אַרְבַּע וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת פָּלֶג׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי עֵבֶר אַרְבַּע וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת פָּלֶג׃

english.text: And Eber lived forty-three years, and he fathered Peleg.

translation.text: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:

verses.english: And Eber lived forty-three years, and he fathered Peleg.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי עֵבֶר אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת פֶּלֶג שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי עֵבֶר אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת פֶּלֶג שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Eber lived after his fathering Peleg thirty years and
four hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

translation.text: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.english:
And Eber lived after his fathering Peleg thirty years and
four hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי פֶלֶג שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת רְעוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי פֶלֶג שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת רְעוּ׃

english.text: And Peleg lived thirty years, and he fathered Reu.

translation.text: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:

verses.english: And Peleg lived thirty years, and he fathered Reu.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי פֶלֶג אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת רְעוּ תֵּשַׁע שָׁנִים וּמָאתַיִם שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי פֶלֶג אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת רְעוּ תֵּשַׁע שָׁנִים וּמָאתַיִם שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Peleg lived after his fathering Reu nine years and two
hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

translation.text: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.english:
And Peleg lived after his fathering Reu nine years and two
hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי רְעוּ שְׁתַּיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת שְׂרוּג׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי רְעוּ שְׁתַּיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת שְׂרוּג׃

english.text: And Reu lived thirty-two years, and he fathered Serug.

translation.text: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:

verses.english: And Reu lived thirty-two years, and he fathered Serug.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי רְעוּ אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת שְׂרוּג שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וּמָאתַיִם שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי רְעוּ אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת שְׂרוּג שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וּמָאתַיִם שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Reu lived after his fathering Serug seven years and
two hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

translation.text: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.english:
And Reu lived after his fathering Serug seven years and
two hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי שְׂרוּג שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת נָחוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי שְׂרוּג שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת נָחוֹר׃

english.text: And Serug lived thirty years, and he fathered Nahor.

translation.text: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:

verses.english: And Serug lived thirty years, and he fathered Nahor.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי שְׂרוּג אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת נָחוֹר מָאתַיִם שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי שְׂרוּג אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת נָחוֹר מָאתַיִם שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Serug lived after his fathering Nahor two hundred
years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

translation.text: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.english:
And Serug lived after his fathering Nahor two hundred
years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי נָחוֹר תֵּשַׁע וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת תָּרַח׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי נָחוֹר תֵּשַׁע וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת תָּרַח׃

english.text: And Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and he fathered Terah.

translation.text: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:

verses.english: And Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and he fathered Terah.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי נָחוֹר אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת תֶּרַח תְּשַׁע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי נָחוֹר אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת תֶּרַח תְּשַׁע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Nahor lived after his fathering Terah nineteen years
and a hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

translation.text: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.

verses.english:
And Nahor lived after his fathering Terah nineteen years
and a hundred years, and he fathered sons and daughters.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי תֶרַח שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת אַבְרָם אֶת נָחוֹר וְאֶת הָרָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי תֶרַח שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת אַבְרָם אֶת נָחוֹר וְאֶת הָרָן׃

english.text:
And Terah lived seventy years, and he fathered Abram,
Nahor, and Haran.

translation.text: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

verses.english:
And Terah lived seventy years, and he fathered Abram,
Nahor, and Haran.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת תֶּרַח תֶּרַח הוֹלִיד אֶת אַבְרָם אֶת נָחוֹר וְאֶת הָרָן וְהָרָן הוֹלִיד אֶת לוֹט׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת תֶּרַח תֶּרַח הוֹלִיד אֶת אַבְרָם אֶת נָחוֹר וְאֶת הָרָן וְהָרָן הוֹלִיד אֶת לוֹט׃

english.text:
And these are the records of Terah: Terah had fathered
Abram, Nahor, and Haran, and Haran had fathered Lot.

translation.text: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.

verses.english:
And these are the records of Terah: Terah had fathered
Abram, Nahor, and Haran, and Haran had fathered Lot.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת הָרָן עַל פְּנֵי תֶּרַח אָבִיו בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹלַדְתּוֹ בְּאוּר כַּשְׂדִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת הָרָן עַל פְּנֵי תֶּרַח אָבִיו בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹלַדְתּוֹ בְּאוּר כַּשְׂדִּים׃

english.text:
And Haran died in the lifetime of Terah, his father, in
the land of his birthplace, in Ur of the Chaldees.

translation.text: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.

verses.english:
And Haran died in the lifetime of Terah, his father, in
the land of his birthplace, in Ur of the Chaldees.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָם וְנָחוֹר לָהֶם נָשִׁים שֵׁם אֵשֶׁת אַבְרָם שָׂרָי וְשֵׁם אֵשֶׁת נָחוֹר מִלְכָּה בַּת הָרָן אֲבִי מִלְכָּה וַאֲבִי יִסְכָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָם וְנָחוֹר לָהֶם נָשִׁים שֵׁם אֵשֶׁת אַבְרָם שָׂרָי וְשֵׁם אֵשֶׁת נָחוֹר מִלְכָּה בַּת הָרָן אֲבִי מִלְכָּה וַאֲבִי יִסְכָּה׃

english.text:
And Abram and Nahor took wives. Abram's wife's name was
Sarai, and Nahor's wife's name was Milcah, daughter of
Haran, father of Milcah and father of Iscah.

translation.text: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram’s wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.

verses.english:
And Abram and Nahor took wives. Abram's wife's name was
Sarai, and Nahor's wife's name was Milcah, daughter of
Haran, father of Milcah and father of Iscah.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי שָׂרַי עֲקָרָה אֵין לָהּ וָלָד׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי שָׂרַי עֲקָרָה אֵין לָהּ וָלָד׃

english.text: And Sarai was infertile. She did not have a child.

translation.text: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.

verses.english: And Sarai was infertile. She did not have a child.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח תֶּרַח אֶת אַבְרָם בְּנוֹ וְאֶת לוֹט בֶּן הָרָן בֶּן בְּנוֹ וְאֵת שָׂרַי כַּלָּתוֹ אֵשֶׁת אַבְרָם בְּנוֹ וַיֵּצְאוּ אִתָּם מֵאוּר כַּשְׂדִּים לָלֶכֶת אַרְצָה כְּנַעַן וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד חָרָן וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח תֶּרַח אֶת אַבְרָם בְּנוֹ וְאֶת לוֹט בֶּן הָרָן בֶּן בְּנוֹ וְאֵת שָׂרַי כַּלָּתוֹ אֵשֶׁת אַבְרָם בְּנוֹ וַיֵּצְאוּ אִתָּם מֵאוּר כַּשְׂדִּים לָלֶכֶת אַרְצָה כְּנַעַן וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד חָרָן וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם׃

english.text:
And Terah took Abram, his son, and Lot, son of Haran, his
grandson, and Sarai, his daughter-in-law, the wife of
Abram, his son; and they went with them from Ur of the
Chaldees to go to the land of Canaan. And they came as far
as Haran, and they stayed there.

translation.text: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram’s wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

verses.english:
And Terah took Abram, his son, and Lot, son of Haran, his
grandson, and Sarai, his daughter-in-law, the wife of
Abram, his son; and they went with them from Ur of the
Chaldees to go to the land of Canaan. And they came as far
as Haran, and they stayed there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ יְמֵי תֶרַח חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וּמָאתַיִם שָׁנָה וַיָּמת תֶּרַח בְּחָרָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ יְמֵי תֶרַח חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וּמָאתַיִם שָׁנָה וַיָּמת תֶּרַח בְּחָרָן׃

english.text:
And Terah's days were five years and two hundred years.
And Terah died in Haran.

translation.text: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.

verses.english:
And Terah's days were five years and two hundred years.
And Terah died in Haran.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַבְרָם לֶךְ לְךָ מֵאַרְצְךָ וּמִמּוֹלַדְתְּךָ וּמִבֵּית אָבִיךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַרְאֶךָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַבְרָם לֶךְ לְךָ מֵאַרְצְךָ וּמִמּוֹלַדְתְּךָ וּמִבֵּית אָבִיךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַרְאֶךָּ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Abram, “Go from your land and from your
birthplace and from your father’s house to the land that
I’ll show you.

translation.text: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto a land that I will shew thee:

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Abram, “Go from your land and from your
birthplace and from your father’s house to the land that
I’ll show you.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶעֶשְׂךָ לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל וַאֲבָרֶכְךָ וַאֲגַדְּלָה שְׁמֶךָ וֶהְיֵה בְּרָכָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶעֶשְׂךָ לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל וַאֲבָרֶכְךָ וַאֲגַדְּלָה שְׁמֶךָ וֶהְיֵה בְּרָכָה׃

english.text:
And I’ll make you into a big nation, and I’ll bless you
and make your name great. And be a blessing!

translation.text: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:

verses.english:
And I’ll make you into a big nation, and I’ll bless you
and make your name great. And be a blessing!

verses.hebrew: וַאֲבָרְכָה מְבָרְכֶיךָ וּמְקַלֶּלְךָ אָאֹר וְנִבְרְכוּ בְךָ כֹּל מִשְׁפְּחֹת הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲבָרְכָה מְבָרְכֶיךָ וּמְקַלֶּלְךָ אָאֹר וְנִבְרְכוּ בְךָ כֹּל מִשְׁפְּחֹת הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
And I’ll bless those who bless you, and those who affront
you I’ll curse. And all the families of the earth will be
blessed through you.”

translation.text: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.

verses.english:
And I’ll bless those who bless you, and those who affront
you I’ll curse. And all the families of the earth will be
blessed through you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אַבְרָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ אִתּוֹ לוֹט וְאַבְרָם בֶּן חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וְשִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה בְּצֵאתוֹ מֵחָרָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ אַבְרָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ אִתּוֹ לוֹט וְאַבְרָם בֶּן חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וְשִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה בְּצֵאתוֹ מֵחָרָן׃

english.text:
And Abram went as YHWH had spoken to him, and Lot went
with him. And Abram was seventy-five years old when he
went out from Haran.

translation.text: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.

verses.english:
And Abram went as YHWH had spoken to him, and Lot went
with him. And Abram was seventy-five years old when he
went out from Haran.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָם אֶת שָׂרַי אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת לוֹט בֶּן אָחִיו וְאֶת כּל רְכוּשָׁם אֲשֶׁר רָכָשׁוּ וְאֶת הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ בְחָרָן וַיֵּצְאוּ לָלֶכֶת אַרְצָה כְּנַעַן וַיָּבֹאוּ אַרְצָה כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָם אֶת שָׂרַי אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת לוֹט בֶּן אָחִיו וְאֶת כּל רְכוּשָׁם אֲשֶׁר רָכָשׁוּ וְאֶת הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ בְחָרָן וַיֵּצְאוּ לָלֶכֶת אַרְצָה כְּנַעַן וַיָּבֹאוּ אַרְצָה כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
And Abram took Sarai, his wife, and Lot, his brother’s
son, and all their property that they had accumulated and
the persons whom they had gotten in Haran; and they went
out to go to the land of Canaan. And they came to the land
of Canaan.

translation.text: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother’s son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.

verses.english:
And Abram took Sarai, his wife, and Lot, his brother’s
son, and all their property that they had accumulated and
the persons whom they had gotten in Haran; and they went
out to go to the land of Canaan. And they came to the land
of Canaan.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר אַבְרָם בָּאָרֶץ עַד מְקוֹם שְׁכֶם עַד אֵלוֹן מוֹרֶה וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי אָז בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר אַבְרָם בָּאָרֶץ עַד מְקוֹם שְׁכֶם עַד אֵלוֹן מוֹרֶה וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי אָז בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And Abram passed through the land as far as the place of
Shechem, as far as the oak of Moreh. And the Canaanite was
in the land then.

translation.text: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.

verses.english:
And Abram passed through the land as far as the place of
Shechem, as far as the oak of Moreh. And the Canaanite was
in the land then.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא יְהֹוָה אֶל אַבְרָם וַיֹּאמֶר לְזַרְעֲךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וַיִּבֶן שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה הַנִּרְאֶה אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָא יְהֹוָה אֶל אַבְרָם וַיֹּאמֶר לְזַרְעֲךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וַיִּבֶן שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה הַנִּרְאֶה אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
And YHWH appeared to Abram and said, “I’ll give this land
to your seed.” And he built an altar there to YHWH who had
appeared to him.

translation.text: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.

verses.english:
And YHWH appeared to Abram and said, “I’ll give this land
to your seed.” And he built an altar there to YHWH who had
appeared to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעְתֵּק מִשָּׁם הָהָרָה מִקֶּדֶם לְבֵית אֵל וַיֵּט אהֳלֹה בֵּית אֵל מִיָּם וְהָעַי מִקֶּדֶם וַיִּבֶן שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה וַיִּקְרָא בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעְתֵּק מִשָּׁם הָהָרָה מִקֶּדֶם לְבֵית אֵל וַיֵּט אהֳלֹה בֵּית אֵל מִיָּם וְהָעַי מִקֶּדֶם וַיִּבֶן שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה וַיִּקְרָא בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he moved on from there to the hill country east of
Beth-El and pitched his tent—Beth-El to the west and Ai to
the east—and he built an altar there to YHWH and invoked
the name YHWH.

translation.text: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.

verses.english:
And he moved on from there to the hill country east of
Beth-El and pitched his tent—Beth-El to the west and Ai to
the east—and he built an altar there to YHWH and invoked
the name YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסַּע אַבְרָם הָלוֹךְ וְנָסוֹעַ הַנֶּגְבָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסַּע אַבְרָם הָלוֹךְ וְנָסוֹעַ הַנֶּגְבָּה׃

english.text: And Abram traveled on, going to the Negeb.

translation.text: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.

verses.english: And Abram traveled on, going to the Negeb.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי רָעָב בָּאָרֶץ וַיֵּרֶד אַבְרָם מִצְרַיְמָה לָגוּר שָׁם כִּי כָבֵד הָרָעָב בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי רָעָב בָּאָרֶץ וַיֵּרֶד אַבְרָם מִצְרַיְמָה לָגוּר שָׁם כִּי כָבֵד הָרָעָב בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to
Egypt to reside there because the famine was heavy in the
land.

translation.text: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.

verses.english:
And there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to
Egypt to reside there because the famine was heavy in the
land.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר הִקְרִיב לָבוֹא מִצְרָיְמָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל שָׂרַי אִשְׁתּוֹ הִנֵּה נָא יָדַעְתִּי כִּי אִשָּׁה יְפַת מַרְאֶה אָתְּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר הִקְרִיב לָבוֹא מִצְרָיְמָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל שָׂרַי אִשְׁתּוֹ הִנֵּה נָא יָדַעְתִּי כִּי אִשָּׁה יְפַת מַרְאֶה אָתְּ׃

english.text:
And it was when he was close to coming to Egypt: and he
said to Sarai, his wife, “Here, I know that you’re a
beautiful woman.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:

verses.english:
And it was when he was close to coming to Egypt: and he
said to Sarai, his wife, “Here, I know that you’re a
beautiful woman.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי יִרְאוּ אֹתָךְ הַמִּצְרִים וְאָמְרוּ אִשְׁתּוֹ זֹאת וְהָרְגוּ אֹתִי וְאֹתָךְ יְחַיּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי יִרְאוּ אֹתָךְ הַמִּצְרִים וְאָמְרוּ אִשְׁתּוֹ זֹאת וְהָרְגוּ אֹתִי וְאֹתָךְ יְחַיּוּ׃

english.text:
And it will be when the Egyptians see you that they’ll
say, ‘This is his wife,’ and they’ll kill me and keep you
alive.

translation.text: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.

verses.english:
And it will be when the Egyptians see you that they’ll
say, ‘This is his wife,’ and they’ll kill me and keep you
alive.

verses.hebrew: אִמְרִי נָא אֲחֹתִי אָתְּ לְמַעַן יִיטַב לִי בַעֲבוּרֵךְ וְחָיְתָה נַפְשִׁי בִּגְלָלֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: אִמְרִי נָא אֲחֹתִי אָתְּ לְמַעַן יִיטַב לִי בַעֲבוּרֵךְ וְחָיְתָה נַפְשִׁי בִּגְלָלֵךְ׃

english.text:
Say you’re my sister so it will be good for me on your
account and I’ll stay alive because of you.”

translation.text: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.

verses.english:
Say you’re my sister so it will be good for me on your
account and I’ll stay alive because of you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּבוֹא אַבְרָם מִצְרָיְמָה וַיִּרְאוּ הַמִּצְרִים אֶת הָאִשָּׁה כִּי יָפָה הִוא מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּבוֹא אַבְרָם מִצְרָיְמָה וַיִּרְאוּ הַמִּצְרִים אֶת הָאִשָּׁה כִּי יָפָה הִוא מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And it was as Abram came to Egypt, and the Egyptians saw
the woman, that she was very beautiful.

translation.text: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.

verses.english:
And it was as Abram came to Egypt, and the Egyptians saw
the woman, that she was very beautiful.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ אֹתָהּ שָׂרֵי פַרְעֹה וַיְהַלְלוּ אֹתָהּ אֶל פַּרְעֹה וַתֻּקַּח הָאִשָּׁה בֵּית פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ אֹתָהּ שָׂרֵי פַרְעֹה וַיְהַלְלוּ אֹתָהּ אֶל פַּרְעֹה וַתֻּקַּח הָאִשָּׁה בֵּית פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh’s officers saw her and praised her to Pharaoh,
and the woman was taken to Pharaoh’s house.

translation.text: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh’s officers saw her and praised her to Pharaoh,
and the woman was taken to Pharaoh’s house.

verses.hebrew: וּלְאַבְרָם הֵיטִיב בַּעֲבוּרָהּ וַיְהִי לוֹ צֹאן וּבָקָר וַחֲמֹרִים וַעֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחֹת וַאֲתֹנֹת וּגְמַלִּים׃

hebrew.text: וּלְאַבְרָם הֵיטִיב בַּעֲבוּרָהּ וַיְהִי לוֹ צֹאן וּבָקָר וַחֲמֹרִים וַעֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחֹת וַאֲתֹנֹת וּגְמַלִּים׃

english.text:
And he was good to Abram on her account, and he had a
flock and oxen and he-asses and servants and maids and
she-asses and camels.

translation.text: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.

verses.english:
And he was good to Abram on her account, and he had a
flock and oxen and he-asses and servants and maids and
she-asses and camels.

verses.hebrew: וַיְנַגַּע יְהֹוָה אֶת פַּרְעֹה נְגָעִים גְּדֹלִים וְאֶת בֵּיתוֹ עַל דְּבַר שָׂרַי אֵשֶׁת אַבְרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְנַגַּע יְהֹוָה אֶת פַּרְעֹה נְגָעִים גְּדֹלִים וְאֶת בֵּיתוֹ עַל דְּבַר שָׂרַי אֵשֶׁת אַבְרָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH plagued Pharaoh and his house, big plagues, over
the matter of Sarai, Abram’s wife.

translation.text: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram’s wife.

verses.english:
And YHWH plagued Pharaoh and his house, big plagues, over
the matter of Sarai, Abram’s wife.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא פַרְעֹה לְאַבְרָם וַיֹּאמֶר מַה זֹּאת עָשִׂיתָ לִּי לָמָּה לֹא הִגַּדְתָּ לִּי כִּי אִשְׁתְּךָ הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא פַרְעֹה לְאַבְרָם וַיֹּאמֶר מַה זֹּאת עָשִׂיתָ לִּי לָמָּה לֹא הִגַּדְתָּ לִּי כִּי אִשְׁתְּךָ הִוא׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this you’ve
done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?

translation.text: And Pharaoh called Abram and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?

verses.english:
And Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this you’ve
done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?

verses.hebrew: לָמָה אָמַרְתָּ אֲחֹתִי הִוא וָאֶקַּח אֹתָהּ לִי לְאִשָּׁה וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה אִשְׁתְּךָ קַח וָלֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: לָמָה אָמַרְתָּ אֲחֹתִי הִוא וָאֶקַּח אֹתָהּ לִי לְאִשָּׁה וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה אִשְׁתְּךָ קַח וָלֵךְ׃

english.text:
Why did you say, ‘She’s my sister,’ so I took her for a
wife for myself! And now, here’s your wife. Take her and
go.”

translation.text: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.

verses.english:
Why did you say, ‘She’s my sister,’ so I took her for a
wife for myself! And now, here’s your wife. Take her and
go.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו עָלָיו פַּרְעֹה אֲנָשִׁים וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו עָלָיו פַּרְעֹה אֲנָשִׁים וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh commanded people over him, and they let him
and his wife and all he had go.

translation.text: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh commanded people over him, and they let him
and his wife and all he had go.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל אַבְרָם מִמִּצְרַיִם הוּא וְאִשְׁתּוֹ וְכל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְלוֹט עִמּוֹ הַנֶּגְבָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל אַבְרָם מִמִּצְרַיִם הוּא וְאִשְׁתּוֹ וְכל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְלוֹט עִמּוֹ הַנֶּגְבָּה׃

english.text:
And Abram went up from Egypt, he and his wife and all
he had and Lot with him, to the Negeb.

translation.text: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.

verses.english:
And Abram went up from Egypt, he and his wife and all
he had and Lot with him, to the Negeb.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְרָם כָּבֵד מְאֹד בַּמִּקְנֶה בַּכֶּסֶף וּבַזָּהָב׃

hebrew.text: וְאַבְרָם כָּבֵד מְאֹד בַּמִּקְנֶה בַּכֶּסֶף וּבַזָּהָב׃

english.text: And Abram was very heavy with livestock and silver and gold.

translation.text: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.

verses.english: And Abram was very heavy with livestock and silver and gold.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ לְמַסָּעָיו מִנֶּגֶב וְעַד בֵּית אֵל עַד הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר הָיָה שָׁם אהֳלֹה בַּתְּחִלָּה בֵּין בֵּית אֵל וּבֵין הָעָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ לְמַסָּעָיו מִנֶּגֶב וְעַד בֵּית אֵל עַד הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר הָיָה שָׁם אהֳלֹה בַּתְּחִלָּה בֵּין בֵּית אֵל וּבֵין הָעָי׃

english.text:
And he went on his travels from the Negeb as far as
Beth-El, as far as the place where his tent was at the
start, between Beth-El and Ai,

translation.text: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;

verses.english:
And he went on his travels from the Negeb as far as
Beth-El, as far as the place where his tent was at the
start, between Beth-El and Ai,

verses.hebrew: אֶל מְקוֹם הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה שָׁם בָּרִאשֹׁנָה וַיִּקְרָא שָׁם אַבְרָם בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אֶל מְקוֹם הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה שָׁם בָּרִאשֹׁנָה וַיִּקְרָא שָׁם אַבְרָם בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
to the place of the altar that he had made there at the
beginning. And Abram invoked the name YHWH there.

translation.text: Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD.

verses.english:
to the place of the altar that he had made there at the
beginning. And Abram invoked the name YHWH there.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם לְלוֹט הַהֹלֵךְ אֶת אַבְרָם הָיָה צֹאן וּבָקָר וְאֹהָלִים׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם לְלוֹט הַהֹלֵךְ אֶת אַבְרָם הָיָה צֹאן וּבָקָר וְאֹהָלִים׃

english.text:
And Lot, who was going with Abram, also had a flock and
oxen and tents.

translation.text: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.

verses.english:
And Lot, who was going with Abram, also had a flock and
oxen and tents.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא נָשָׂא אֹתָם הָאָרֶץ לָשֶׁבֶת יַחְדָּו כִּי הָיָה רְכוּשָׁם רָב וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לָשֶׁבֶת יַחְדָּו׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא נָשָׂא אֹתָם הָאָרֶץ לָשֶׁבֶת יַחְדָּו כִּי הָיָה רְכוּשָׁם רָב וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לָשֶׁבֶת יַחְדָּו׃

english.text:
And the land did not suffice them to live together,
because their property was great, and they were not able
to live together.

translation.text: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.

verses.english:
And the land did not suffice them to live together,
because their property was great, and they were not able
to live together.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי רִיב בֵּין רֹעֵי מִקְנֵה אַבְרָם וּבֵין רֹעֵי מִקְנֵה לוֹט וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי אָז יֹשֵׁב בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי רִיב בֵּין רֹעֵי מִקְנֵה אַבְרָם וּבֵין רֹעֵי מִקְנֵה לוֹט וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי אָז יֹשֵׁב בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And there was a quarrel between those who herded Abram’s
livestock and those who herded Lot’s livestock. And the
Canaanite and the Perizzite lived in the land then.

translation.text: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram’s cattle and the herdmen of Lot’s cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.

verses.english:
And there was a quarrel between those who herded Abram’s
livestock and those who herded Lot’s livestock. And the
Canaanite and the Perizzite lived in the land then.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָם אֶל לוֹט אַל נָא תְהִי מְרִיבָה בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ וּבֵין רֹעַי וּבֵין רֹעֶיךָ כִּי אֲנָשִׁים אַחִים אֲנָחְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָם אֶל לוֹט אַל נָא תְהִי מְרִיבָה בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ וּבֵין רֹעַי וּבֵין רֹעֶיךָ כִּי אֲנָשִׁים אַחִים אֲנָחְנוּ׃

english.text:
And Abram said to Lot, “Let there be no quarreling between
me and you and between my herders and your herders,
because we’re brothers.

translation.text: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.

verses.english:
And Abram said to Lot, “Let there be no quarreling between
me and you and between my herders and your herders,
because we’re brothers.

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא כל הָאָרֶץ לְפָנֶיךָ הִפָּרֶד נָא מֵעָלָי אִם הַשְּׂמֹאל וְאֵימִנָה וְאִם הַיָּמִין וְאַשְׂמְאִילָה׃

hebrew.text: הֲלֹא כל הָאָרֶץ לְפָנֶיךָ הִפָּרֶד נָא מֵעָלָי אִם הַשְּׂמֹאל וְאֵימִנָה וְאִם הַיָּמִין וְאַשְׂמְאִילָה׃

english.text:
Isn’t the whole land before you? Separate from me: if left
then I’ll go right, and if right then I’ll go left.”

translation.text: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.

verses.english:
Isn’t the whole land before you? Separate from me: if left
then I’ll go right, and if right then I’ll go left.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא לוֹט אֶת עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת כּל כִּכַּר הַיַּרְדֵּן כִּי כֻלָּהּ מַשְׁקֶה לִפְנֵי שַׁחֵת יְהֹוָה אֶת סְדֹם וְאֶת עֲמֹרָה כְּגַן יְהֹוָה כְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בֹּאֲכָה צֹעַר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא לוֹט אֶת עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת כּל כִּכַּר הַיַּרְדֵּן כִּי כֻלָּהּ מַשְׁקֶה לִפְנֵי שַׁחֵת יְהֹוָה אֶת סְדֹם וְאֶת עֲמֹרָה כְּגַן יְהֹוָה כְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בֹּאֲכָה צֹעַר׃

english.text:
And Lot raised his eyes and saw all the plain of the
Jordan, that all of it was well watered (before YHWH’s
destroying Sodom and Gomorrah) like YHWH’s garden, like
the land of Egypt, as you come to Zoar.

translation.text: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.

verses.english:
And Lot raised his eyes and saw all the plain of the
Jordan, that all of it was well watered (before YHWH’s
destroying Sodom and Gomorrah) like YHWH’s garden, like
the land of Egypt, as you come to Zoar.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְחַר לוֹ לוֹט אֵת כּל כִּכַּר הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּסַּע לוֹט מִקֶּדֶם וַיִּפָּרְדוּ אִישׁ מֵעַל אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְחַר לוֹ לוֹט אֵת כּל כִּכַּר הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּסַּע לוֹט מִקֶּדֶם וַיִּפָּרְדוּ אִישׁ מֵעַל אָחִיו׃

english.text:
And Lot chose all the plain of the Jordan for himself, and
Lot traveled east. And they separated, each from his
brother.

translation.text: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.

verses.english:
And Lot chose all the plain of the Jordan for himself, and
Lot traveled east. And they separated, each from his
brother.

verses.hebrew: אַבְרָם יָשַׁב בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְלוֹט יָשַׁב בְּעָרֵי הַכִּכָּר וַיֶּאֱהַל עַד סְדֹם׃

hebrew.text: אַבְרָם יָשַׁב בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְלוֹט יָשַׁב בְּעָרֵי הַכִּכָּר וַיֶּאֱהַל עַד סְדֹם׃

english.text:
Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the
cities of the plain and tented as far as Sodom.

translation.text: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.

verses.english:
Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the
cities of the plain and tented as far as Sodom.

verses.hebrew: וְאַנְשֵׁי סְדֹם רָעִים וְחַטָּאִים לַיהֹוָה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְאַנְשֵׁי סְדֹם רָעִים וְחַטָּאִים לַיהֹוָה מְאֹד׃

english.text: And the people of Sodom were very bad and sinful to YHWH.

translation.text: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.

verses.english: And the people of Sodom were very bad and sinful to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה אָמַר אֶל אַבְרָם אַחֲרֵי הִפָּרֶד לוֹט מֵעִמּוֹ שָׂא נָא עֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה מִן הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה שָׁם צָפֹנָה וָנֶגְבָּה וָקֵדְמָה וָיָמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה אָמַר אֶל אַבְרָם אַחֲרֵי הִפָּרֶד לוֹט מֵעִמּוֹ שָׂא נָא עֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה מִן הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה שָׁם צָפֹנָה וָנֶגְבָּה וָקֵדְמָה וָיָמָּה׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Abram after Lot’s separation from him,
“Lift your eyes and see from the place where you are to
the north and south and east and west.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Abram after Lot’s separation from him,
“Lift your eyes and see from the place where you are to
the north and south and east and west.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶת כּל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה רֹאֶה לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וּלְזַרְעֲךָ עַד עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֶת כּל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה רֹאֶה לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וּלְזַרְעֲךָ עַד עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
For all the land that you see, I’ll give it to you and to
your seed forever.

translation.text: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.

verses.english:
For all the land that you see, I’ll give it to you and to
your seed forever.

verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתִּי אֶת זַרְעֲךָ כַּעֲפַר הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אִם יוּכַל אִישׁ לִמְנוֹת אֶת עֲפַר הָאָרֶץ גַּם זַרְעֲךָ יִמָּנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתִּי אֶת זַרְעֲךָ כַּעֲפַר הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אִם יוּכַל אִישׁ לִמְנוֹת אֶת עֲפַר הָאָרֶץ גַּם זַרְעֲךָ יִמָּנֶה׃

english.text:
And I’ll make your seed like the dust of the earth, so
that if a man could count the dust of the earth then your
seed also could be counted.

translation.text: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.

verses.english:
And I’ll make your seed like the dust of the earth, so
that if a man could count the dust of the earth then your
seed also could be counted.

verses.hebrew: קוּם הִתְהַלֵּךְ בָּאָרֶץ לְארְכָּהּ וּלְרחְבָּהּ כִּי לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: קוּם הִתְהַלֵּךְ בָּאָרֶץ לְארְכָּהּ וּלְרחְבָּהּ כִּי לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה׃

english.text:
Get up, go around in the land to its length and its width,
because I’m giving it to you.”

translation.text: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.

verses.english:
Get up, go around in the land to its length and its width,
because I’m giving it to you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱהַל אַבְרָם וַיָּבֹא וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּאֵלֹנֵי מַמְרֵא אֲשֶׁר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּבֶן שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאֱהַל אַבְרָם וַיָּבֹא וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּאֵלֹנֵי מַמְרֵא אֲשֶׁר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּבֶן שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Abram took up his tent and came and lived among the
oaks of Mamre which are in Hebron, and he built an altar
to YHWH there.

translation.text: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And Abram took up his tent and came and lived among the
oaks of Mamre which are in Hebron, and he built an altar
to YHWH there.

verses.hebrew:

english.text:
And it was in the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar, Arioch, king of
Ellasar, Chedorlaomer, king of Elam,
and Tidal, king of Goiim.

translation.text: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;

verses.english:
And it was in the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar, Arioch, king of
Ellasar, Chedorlaomer, king of Elam,
and Tidal, king of Goiim.

english.text:
They made war with Bera, king of Sodom,
and Birsha, king of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah,
and Shemeber, king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela. (That is Zoar.)

translation.text: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.

verses.english:
They made war with Bera, king of Sodom,
and Birsha, king of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah,
and Shemeber, king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela. (That is Zoar.)

hebrew.text: כּל אֵלֶּה חָבְרוּ אֶל עֵמֶק הַשִּׂדִּים הוּא יָם הַמֶּלַח׃

english.text: All these were allied at the Siddim Valley. (That is the Dead Sea.)

translation.text: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.

verses.english: All these were allied at the Siddim Valley. (That is the Dead Sea.)

verses.hebrew:
שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה עָבְדוּ אֶת כְּדרְלָעֹמֶר
וּשְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָרָדוּ׃

english.text: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and the thirteenth year they revolted,

translation.text: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

verses.english: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and the thirteenth year they revolted,

verses.hebrew:
וּבְאַרְבַּע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בָּא כְדרְלָעֹמֶר
וְהַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת רְפָאִים בְּעַשְׁתְּרֹת
קַרְנַיִם וְאֶת הַזּוּזִים בְּהָם
וְאֵת הָאֵימִים בְּשָׁוֵה קִרְיָתָיִם׃

hebrew.text:
וּבְאַרְבַּע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בָּא כְדרְלָעֹמֶר

english.text:
and in the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer
and the kings who were with him came,
and they struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim
and the Zuzum in Ham and the Emim in Shaveh Kiriataim

translation.text: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emins in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

verses.english:
and in the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer
and the kings who were with him came,
and they struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim
and the Zuzum in Ham and the Emim in Shaveh Kiriataim

verses.hebrew:
וְאֶת הַחֹרִי בְּהַרְרָם שֵׂעִיר עַד אֵיל פָּארָן אֲשֶׁר עַל
הַמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֶת הַחֹרִי בְּהַרְרָם שֵׂעִיר עַד אֵיל פָּארָן אֲשֶׁר עַל

english.text:
and the Horites in their mountain Seir to El Paran, which is by the
wilderness.

translation.text: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto Elparan, which is by the wilderness.

verses.english:
and the Horites in their mountain Seir to El Paran, which is by the
wilderness.

verses.hebrew:

english.text:
And they came back and came to En Mishpat (that is Kadesh)
and struck the area of the Amalekites
and also the Amorites who live in Hazazon Tamar.

translation.text: And they returned, and came to Enmishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezontamar.

verses.english:
And they came back and came to En Mishpat (that is Kadesh)
and struck the area of the Amalekites
and also the Amorites who live in Hazazon Tamar.

and the king of Admah and the king of Zeboiim

and aligned with them for war in the Siddim Valley

translation.text: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;

And the king of Sodom and the king of Gomorrah

and the king of Bela (that is Zoar) went out

verses.english:
with Chedorlaomer, king of Elam,
and Tidal, king of Goiim, and Amraphel, king of Shinar,
and Arioch, king of Ellasar---four kings with five.

And Siddim Valley was pits, pits of bitumen,
and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled,
and they fell there; and those who were left fled to the mountain.

translation.text: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.

verses.english:
And Siddim Valley was pits, pits of bitumen,
and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled,
and they fell there; and those who were left fled to the mountain.

verses.hebrew:

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת כּל רְכֻשׁ סְדֹם
וַעֲמֹרָה וְאֶת כּל אכְלָם וַיֵּלֵכוּ׃

english.text:
And they took all the property of Sodom
and Gomorrah and all their food,
and they went.

translation.text: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.

verses.english:
And they took all the property of Sodom
and Gomorrah and all their food,
and they went.

verses.hebrew:

english.text:

and his property when they went.
And he had been living in Sodom.

verses.english:
And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son,
and his property when they went.
And he had been living in Sodom.

and he was tenting among the oaks of Mamre the Amorite, brother of
Eshcol and brother of Aner; and they were covenant partners of Abram.

verses.english:
And an escapee came and told Abram the Hebrew,
and he was tenting among the oaks of Mamre the Amorite, brother of
Eshcol and brother of Aner; and they were covenant partners of Abram.

and he had his trained men, born in his house, unsheathe: three hundred
eighteen. And he pursued as far as Dan.

verses.english:
And Abram heard that his brother had been taken prisoner,
and he had his trained men, born in his house, unsheathe: three hundred
eighteen. And he pursued as far as Dan.

and his servants, and he struck them

verses.english:
And he divided against them by night, he
and his servants, and he struck them
and pursued them as far as Hobah, which is at the left of Damascus.

וְאֶת הָעָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשֶׁב אֵת כּל הָרְכֻשׁ וְגַם אֶת לוֹט אָחִיו
וּרְכֻשׁוֹ הֵשִׁיב וְגַם אֶת הַנָּשִׁים
וְאֶת הָעָם׃

english.text:
And he brought back all the property,
and he also brought back Lot, his brother,
and his property, and also the women
and the people.

translation.text: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.

verses.english:
And he brought back all the property,
and he also brought back Lot, his brother,
and his property, and also the women
and the people.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּצֵא מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם לִקְרָאתוֹ אַחֲרֵי שׁוּבוֹ מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת
כְּדרְלָעֹמֶר וְאֶת הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ אֶל עֵמֶק שָׁוֵה הוּא
עֵמֶק הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּצֵא מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם לִקְרָאתוֹ אַחֲרֵי שׁוּבוֹ מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת
כְּדרְלָעֹמֶר וְאֶת הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ אֶל עֵמֶק שָׁוֵה הוּא
