english.text:
And the king of Sodom came out to him after he came back from
striking Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him at the Shaveh
Valley. (That is the valley of the king.)

translation.text: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king’s dale.

verses.english:
And the king of Sodom came out to him after he came back from
striking Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him at the Shaveh
Valley. (That is the valley of the king.)

verses.hebrew:
וּמַלְכִּי צֶדֶק מֶלֶךְ שָׁלֵם הוֹצִיא לֶחֶם
וָיָיִן וְהוּא כֹהֵן לְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
וּמַלְכִּי צֶדֶק מֶלֶךְ שָׁלֵם הוֹצִיא לֶחֶם
וָיָיִן וְהוּא כֹהֵן לְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן׃

english.text:
And Melchizedek, king of Salem, had brought out bread
and wine. And he was a priest of El the Highest.

translation.text: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.

verses.english:
And Melchizedek, king of Salem, had brought out bread
and wine. And he was a priest of El the Highest.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיֹּאמַר בָּרוּךְ אַבְרָם לְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן קֹנֵה
שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיֹּאמַר בָּרוּךְ אַבְרָם לְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן קֹנֵה
שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And he blessed him and said, "Blessed is Abram to El the Highest,
creator of skies and earth.

translation.text: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:

verses.english:
And he blessed him and said, "Blessed is Abram to El the Highest,
creator of skies and earth.

verses.hebrew:
וּבָרוּךְ אֵל עֶלְיוֹן אֲשֶׁר מִגֵּן צָרֶיךָ בְּיָדֶךָ
וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ מַעֲשֵׂר מִכֹּל׃

hebrew.text:
וּבָרוּךְ אֵל עֶלְיוֹן אֲשֶׁר מִגֵּן צָרֶיךָ בְּיָדֶךָ
וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ מַעֲשֵׂר מִכֹּל׃

english.text:
And blessed is El the Highest, who delivered your foes into your
hand." And he gave him a tithe from everything.

translation.text: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.

verses.english:
And blessed is El the Highest, who delivered your foes into your
hand." And he gave him a tithe from everything.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם אֶל אַבְרָם תֶּן לִי הַנֶּפֶשׁ
וְהָרְכֻשׁ קַח לָךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם אֶל אַבְרָם תֶּן לִי הַנֶּפֶשׁ
וְהָרְכֻשׁ קַח לָךְ׃

english.text:
And the king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give the persons to me,
and take the property for you."

translation.text: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.

verses.english:
And the king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give the persons to me,
and take the property for you."

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָם אֶל מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם הֲרִמֹתִי יָדִי אֶל
יהוה
אֵל עֶלְיוֹן קֹנֵה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָם אֶל מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם הֲרִמֹתִי יָדִי אֶל
יהוה
אֵל עֶלְיוֹן קֹנֵה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃

english.text: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, "I've lifted my hand to
YHWH
El the Highest, creator of skies and earth,

translation.text: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto
the LORD
, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,

verses.english:
And Abram said to the king of Sodom, "I've lifted my hand to
YHWH
El the Highest, creator of skies and earth,
verses.translation: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,

verses.hebrew:
אִם מִחוּט וְעַד שְׂרוֹךְ נַעַל
וְאִם אֶקַּח מִכּל אֲשֶׁר לָךְ וְלֹא תֹאמַר אֲנִי הֶעֱשַׁרְתִּי אֶת אַבְרָם׃

hebrew.text: אִם מִחוּט וְעַד שְׂרוֹךְ נַעַל וְאִם אֶקַּח מִכּל אֲשֶׁר לָךְ וְלֹא תֹאמַר אֲנִי הֶעֱשַׁרְתִּי אֶת אַבְרָם׃

english.text:
that, from a thread to a shoelace,
I won't take anything that is
yours, so you won't say,
'I made Abram rich.'

translation.text: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:

verses.english:
that, from a thread to a shoelace,
I won't take anything that is
yours, so you won't say,
'I made Abram rich.'

verses.hebrew:
בִּלְעָדַי רַק אֲשֶׁר אָכְלוּ הַנְּעָרִים
וְחֵלֶק הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ אִתִּי עָנֵר אֶשְׁכֹּל
וּמַמְרֵא הֵם יִקְחוּ חֶלְקָם׃

hebrew.text:
בִּלְעָדַי רַק אֲשֶׁר אָכְלוּ הַנְּעָרִים
וְחֵלֶק הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ אִתִּי עָנֵר אֶשְׁכֹּל
וּמַמְרֵא הֵם יִקְחוּ חֶלְקָם׃

english.text:
Except only what the boys have eaten
and the share of the people who went with me: Aner, Eshcol,
and Mamre. They shall take their share."

translation.text: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.

verses.english:
Except only what the boys have eaten
and the share of the people who went with me: Aner, Eshcol,
and Mamre. They shall take their share."

verses.hebrew: אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה הָיָה דְבַר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַבְרָם בַּמַּחֲזֶה לֵאמֹר אַל תִּירָא אַבְרָם אָנֹכִי מָגֵן לָךְ שְׂכָרְךָ הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה הָיָה דְבַר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַבְרָם בַּמַּחֲזֶה לֵאמֹר אַל תִּירָא אַבְרָם אָנֹכִי מָגֵן לָךְ שְׂכָרְךָ הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

english.text:
After these things YHWH’s word came to Abram in a
vision, saying, “Don’t fear, Abram. I’m a shield for you.
Your reward is very much.”

translation.text: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.

verses.english:
After these things YHWH’s word came to Abram in a
vision, saying, “Don’t fear, Abram. I’m a shield for you.
Your reward is very much.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָם אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה מַה תִּתֶּן לִי וְאָנֹכִי הוֹלֵךְ עֲרִירִי וּבֶן מֶשֶׁק בֵּיתִי הוּא דַּמֶּשֶׂק אֱלִיעֶזֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָם אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה מַה תִּתֶּן לִי וְאָנֹכִי הוֹלֵךְ עֲרִירִי וּבֶן מֶשֶׁק בֵּיתִי הוּא דַּמֶּשֶׂק אֱלִיעֶזֶר׃

english.text:
And Abram said, “My Lord, YHWH, what would you give me
when I go childless and my household is an acquired
person!” (That is Damascus Eliezer.)

translation.text: And Abram said, LORD God, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?

verses.english:
And Abram said, “My Lord, YHWH, what would you give me
when I go childless and my household is an acquired
person!” (That is Damascus Eliezer.)

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָם הֵן לִי לֹא נָתַתָּה זָרַע וְהִנֵּה בֶן בֵּיתִי יוֹרֵשׁ אֹתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָם הֵן לִי לֹא נָתַתָּה זָרַע וְהִנֵּה בֶן בֵּיתִי יוֹרֵשׁ אֹתִי׃

english.text:
And Abram said, “Here, you haven’t given me seed. And,
here, a member of my household is taking possession of
what is mine.”

translation.text: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.

verses.english:
And Abram said, “Here, you haven’t given me seed. And,
here, a member of my household is taking possession of
what is mine.”

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה דְבַר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר לֹא יִירָשְׁךָ זֶה כִּי אִם אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מִמֵּעֶיךָ הוּא יִירָשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה דְבַר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר לֹא יִירָשְׁךָ זֶה כִּי אִם אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מִמֵּעֶיךָ הוּא יִירָשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
And, here, YHWH’s word came to him, saying, “This one
won’t take possession from you, but rather one who will
come out of your in-sides: he will take possession from
you.”

translation.text: And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.

verses.english:
And, here, YHWH’s word came to him, saying, “This one
won’t take possession from you, but rather one who will
come out of your in-sides: he will take possession from
you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצֵא אֹתוֹ הַחוּצָה וַיֹּאמֶר הַבֶּט נָא הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וּסְפֹר הַכּוֹכָבִים אִם תּוּכַל לִסְפֹּר אֹתָם וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כֹּה יִהְיֶה זַרְעֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹצֵא אֹתוֹ הַחוּצָה וַיֹּאמֶר הַבֶּט נָא הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וּסְפֹר הַכּוֹכָבִים אִם תּוּכַל לִסְפֹּר אֹתָם וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כֹּה יִהְיֶה זַרְעֶךָ׃

english.text:
And He brought him outside and said, “Look at the skies
and count the stars—if you’ll be able to count them.” And
He said to him, “That is how your seed will be.”

translation.text: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.

verses.english:
And He brought him outside and said, “Look at the skies
and count the stars—if you’ll be able to count them.” And
He said to him, “That is how your seed will be.”

verses.hebrew: וְהֶאֱמִן בַּיהֹוָה וַיַּחְשְׁבֶהָ לּוֹ צְדָקָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶאֱמִן בַּיהֹוָה וַיַּחְשְׁבֶהָ לּוֹ צְדָקָה׃

english.text:
And he trusted in YHWH, and He considered it for him as
virtue.

translation.text: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.

verses.english:
And he trusted in YHWH, and He considered it for him as
virtue.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִיךָ מֵאוּר כַּשְׂדִּים לָתֶת לְךָ אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִיךָ מֵאוּר כַּשְׂדִּים לָתֶת לְךָ אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
And He said to him, “I am YHWH, who brought you out of Ur
of the Chaldees to give you this land, to possess it.”

translation.text: And he said unto him, I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.

verses.english:
And He said to him, “I am YHWH, who brought you out of Ur
of the Chaldees to give you this land, to possess it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה בַּמָּה אֵדַע כִּי אִירָשֶׁנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה בַּמָּה אֵדַע כִּי אִירָשֶׁנָּה׃

english.text:
And he said, “My Lord YHWH, how will I know that I’ll
possess it?”

translation.text: And he said, LORD God, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?

verses.english:
And he said, “My Lord YHWH, how will I know that I’ll
possess it?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו קְחָה לִי עֶגְלָה מְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת וְעֵז מְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת וְאַיִל מְשֻׁלָּשׁ וְתֹר וְגוֹזָל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו קְחָה לִי עֶגְלָה מְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת וְעֵז מְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת וְאַיִל מְשֻׁלָּשׁ וְתֹר וְגוֹזָל׃

english.text:
And He said to him, “Take a three-year-old heifer and a
three-year-old she-goat and a three-year-old ram and a
dove and a pigeon for me.”

translation.text: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

verses.english:
And He said to him, “Take a three-year-old heifer and a
three-year-old she-goat and a three-year-old ram and a
dove and a pigeon for me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח לוֹ אֶת כּל אֵלֶּה וַיְבַתֵּר אֹתָם בַּתָּוֶךְ וַיִּתֵּן אִישׁ בִּתְרוֹ לִקְרַאת רֵעֵהוּ וְאֶת הַצִּפֹּר לֹא בָתָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח לוֹ אֶת כּל אֵלֶּה וַיְבַתֵּר אֹתָם בַּתָּוֶךְ וַיִּתֵּן אִישׁ בִּתְרוֹ לִקְרַאת רֵעֵהוּ וְאֶת הַצִּפֹּר לֹא בָתָר׃

english.text:
And he took all of these for Him and split them up the
middle and set each half opposite its other half, but he
did not split the birds.

translation.text: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.

verses.english:
And he took all of these for Him and split them up the
middle and set each half opposite its other half, but he
did not split the birds.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד הָעַיִט עַל הַפְּגָרִים וַיַּשֵּׁב אֹתָם אַבְרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד הָעַיִט עַל הַפְּגָרִים וַיַּשֵּׁב אֹתָם אַבְרָם׃

english.text:
And birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram
retrieved them.

translation.text: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.

And birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram
retrieved them.

english.text:
And the sun was about to set, and a slumber had come over
Abram; and, here, a big, dark terror was coming over him.

translation.text: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.

And the sun was about to set, and a slumber had come over

And He said to Abram, “You shall know that your seed will
be an alien in a land that is not theirs, and they will
serve them, and they will degrade them four hundred years.

But I’ll judge the nation whom they’ll serve as well, and

But I’ll judge the nation whom they’ll serve as well, and
after that they’ll go out with much property.

And you: you’ll come to your fathers in peace. You’ll be

And a fourth generation will come back here, because the

And Abram’s wife Sarai had not given birth by him.

giving birth. Come to my maid. Maybe I’ll get ‘childed’

land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram, her husband, as a
wife to him.

And Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar, the Egyptian, her

translation.text: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.

verses.english:
And the angel of YHWH said to her, “Go back to your
mistress, and suffer the degradation under her hands.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הַרְבָּה אַרְבֶּה אֶת זַרְעֵךְ וְלֹא יִסָּפֵר מֵרֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הַרְבָּה אַרְבֶּה אֶת זַרְעֵךְ וְלֹא יִסָּפֵר מֵרֹב׃

english.text:
And the angel of YHWH said, “I’ll multiply your seed, and
it won’t be countable because of its great number.”

translation.text: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.

verses.english:
And the angel of YHWH said, “I’ll multiply your seed, and
it won’t be countable because of its great number.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הִנָּךְ הָרָה וְיֹלַדְתְּ בֵּן וְקָרָאת שְׁמוֹ יִשְׁמָעֵאל כִּי שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֶל ענְיֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הִנָּךְ הָרָה וְיֹלַדְתְּ בֵּן וְקָרָאת שְׁמוֹ יִשְׁמָעֵאל כִּי שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֶל ענְיֵךְ׃

english.text:
And the angel of YHWH said to her, “Here, you’re pregnant
and will give birth to a son, and you shall call his name
Ishmael, for YHWH has listened to your suffering.

translation.text: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold, thou art with child and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction.

verses.english:
And the angel of YHWH said to her, “Here, you’re pregnant
and will give birth to a son, and you shall call his name
Ishmael, for YHWH has listened to your suffering.

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא יִהְיֶה פֶּרֶא אָדָם יָדוֹ בַכֹּל וְיַד כֹּל בּוֹ וְעַל פְּנֵי כל אֶחָיו יִשְׁכֹּן׃

hebrew.text: וְהוּא יִהְיֶה פֶּרֶא אָדָם יָדוֹ בַכֹּל וְיַד כֹּל בּוֹ וְעַל פְּנֵי כל אֶחָיו יִשְׁכֹּן׃

english.text:
And he’ll be a wild ass of a man, his hand against
everyone, and everyone’s hand against him, and he
will live in hostility toward all his brothers.”

translation.text: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.

verses.english:
And he’ll be a wild ass of a man, his hand against
everyone, and everyone’s hand against him, and he
will live in hostility toward all his brothers.”

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרָא שֵׁם יְהֹוָה הַדֹּבֵר אֵלֶיהָ אַתָּה אֵל רֳאִי כִּי אָמְרָה הֲגַם הֲלֹם רָאִיתִי אַחֲרֵי רֹאִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקְרָא שֵׁם יְהֹוָה הַדֹּבֵר אֵלֶיהָ אַתָּה אֵל רֳאִי כִּי אָמְרָה הֲגַם הֲלֹם רָאִיתִי אַחֲרֵי רֹאִי׃

english.text:
And she called the name of YHWH who spoke to her “You are
El-roi,” for she said, “Have I also seen after the one who
sees me here?”

translation.text: And she called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?

verses.english:
And she called the name of YHWH who spoke to her “You are
El-roi,” for she said, “Have I also seen after the one who
sees me here?”

verses.hebrew: עַל כֵּן קָרָא לַבְּאֵר בְּאֵר לַחַי רֹאִי הִנֵּה בֵין קָדֵשׁ וּבֵין בָּרֶד׃

hebrew.text: עַל כֵּן קָרָא לַבְּאֵר בְּאֵר לַחַי רֹאִי הִנֵּה בֵין קָדֵשׁ וּבֵין בָּרֶד׃

english.text:
On account of this the well was called Beer Lahai Roi.
Here it is between Kadesh and Bered.

translation.text: Wherefore the well was called Beerlahairoi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

verses.english:
On account of this the well was called Beer Lahai Roi.
Here it is between Kadesh and Bered.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד הָגָר לְאַבְרָם בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אַבְרָם שֶׁם בְּנוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה הָגָר יִשְׁמָעֵאל׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד הָגָר לְאַבְרָם בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אַבְרָם שֶׁם בְּנוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה הָגָר יִשְׁמָעֵאל׃

english.text:
And Hagar gave birth to a son for Abram, and Abram called
the name of his son whom Hagar had borne Ishmael.

translation.text: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son’s name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.

verses.english:
And Hagar gave birth to a son for Abram, and Abram called
the name of his son whom Hagar had borne Ishmael.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְרָם בֶּן שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וְשֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים בְּלֶדֶת הָגָר אֶת יִשְׁמָעֵאל לְאַבְרָם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַבְרָם בֶּן שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וְשֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים בְּלֶדֶת הָגָר אֶת יִשְׁמָעֵאל לְאַבְרָם׃

english.text:
And Abram was eighty years and six years old when Hagar
gave birth to Ishmael for Abram.

translation.text: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.

verses.english:
And Abram was eighty years and six years old when Hagar
gave birth to Ishmael for Abram.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַבְרָם בֶּן תִּשְׁעִים שָׁנָה וְתֵשַׁע שָׁנִים וַיֵּרָא יְהֹוָה אֶל אַבְרָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֲנִי אֵל שַׁדַּי הִתְהַלֵּךְ לְפָנַי וֶהְיֵה תָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַבְרָם בֶּן תִּשְׁעִים שָׁנָה וְתֵשַׁע שָׁנִים וַיֵּרָא יְהֹוָה אֶל אַבְרָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֲנִי אֵל שַׁדַּי הִתְהַלֵּךְ לְפָנַי וֶהְיֵה תָמִים׃

english.text:
And Abram was ninety years and nine years old, and YHWH
appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am El Shadday.
Walk
before me and be unblemished,

translation.text: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

verses.english:
And Abram was ninety years and nine years old, and YHWH
appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am El Shadday.
Walk
before me and be unblemished,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶתְּנָה בְרִיתִי בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ וְאַרְבֶּה אוֹתְךָ בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶתְּנָה בְרִיתִי בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ וְאַרְבֶּה אוֹתְךָ בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד׃

english.text:
and let me place my covenant between me and you, and I’ll
make you very, very numerous.”

translation.text: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.

verses.english:
and let me place my covenant between me and you, and I’ll
make you very, very numerous.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֹּל אַבְרָם עַל פָּנָיו וַיְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ אֱלֹהִים לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֹּל אַבְרָם עַל פָּנָיו וַיְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ אֱלֹהִים לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And Abram fell on his face, and God spoke with him,
saying,

translation.text: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,

verses.english:
And Abram fell on his face, and God spoke with him,
saying,

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי הִנֵּה בְרִיתִי אִתָּךְ וְהָיִיתָ לְאַב הֲמוֹן גּוֹיִם׃

hebrew.text: אֲנִי הִנֵּה בְרִיתִי אִתָּךְ וְהָיִיתָ לְאַב הֲמוֹן גּוֹיִם׃

english.text:
“I: here, my covenant is with you, and you’ll become a
father of a mass of nations.

translation.text: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.

verses.english:
“I: here, my covenant is with you, and you’ll become a
father of a mass of nations.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יִקָּרֵא עוֹד אֶת שִׁמְךָ אַבְרָם וְהָיָה שִׁמְךָ אַבְרָהָם כִּי אַב הֲמוֹן גּוֹיִם נְתַתִּיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יִקָּרֵא עוֹד אֶת שִׁמְךָ אַבְרָם וְהָיָה שִׁמְךָ אַבְרָהָם כִּי אַב הֲמוֹן גּוֹיִם נְתַתִּיךָ׃

english.text:
And your name will not be called Abram anymore, but your
name will be Abraham, because I’ve set you to be a father
of a mass of nations.

translation.text: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.

verses.english:
And your name will not be called Abram anymore, but your
name will be Abraham, because I’ve set you to be a father
of a mass of nations.

verses.hebrew: וְהִפְרֵתִי אֹתְךָ בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד וּנְתַתִּיךָ לְגוֹיִם וּמְלָכִים מִמְּךָ יֵצֵאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִפְרֵתִי אֹתְךָ בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד וּנְתַתִּיךָ לְגוֹיִם וּמְלָכִים מִמְּךָ יֵצֵאוּ׃

english.text:
And I’ll make you very, very fruitful and make you into
nations. And kings will come out of you.

translation.text: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.

verses.english:
And I’ll make you very, very fruitful and make you into
nations. And kings will come out of you.

verses.hebrew: וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת בְּרִיתִי בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ וּבֵין זַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ לְדֹרֹתָם לִבְרִית עוֹלָם לִהְיוֹת לְךָ לֵאלֹהִים וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת בְּרִיתִי בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ וּבֵין זַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ לְדֹרֹתָם לִבְרִית עוֹלָם לִהְיוֹת לְךָ לֵאלֹהִים וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And I’ll establish my covenant between me and you and your
seed after you for their generations as an eternal
covenant, to become God to you and to your seed after you.

translation.text: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.

verses.english:
And I’ll establish my covenant between me and you and your
seed after you for their generations as an eternal
covenant, to become God to you and to your seed after you.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי לְךָ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֵת אֶרֶץ מְגֻרֶיךָ אֵת כּל אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לַאֲחֻזַּת עוֹלָם וְהָיִיתִי לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי לְךָ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֵת אֶרֶץ מְגֻרֶיךָ אֵת כּל אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לַאֲחֻזַּת עוֹלָם וְהָיִיתִי לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And I’ll give you and your seed after you the land where
you’re residing, all the land of Canaan, as an eternal
possession, and I’ll become a God to them.”

translation.text: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.

verses.english:
And I’ll give you and your seed after you the land where
you’re residing, all the land of Canaan, as an eternal
possession, and I’ll become a God to them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל אַבְרָהָם וְאַתָּה אֶת בְּרִיתִי תִשְׁמֹר אַתָּה וְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ לְדֹרֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל אַבְרָהָם וְאַתָּה אֶת בְּרִיתִי תִשְׁמֹר אַתָּה וְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ לְדֹרֹתָם׃

english.text:
And God said to Abraham, “And you: you shall observe my
covenant, you and your seed after you through their
generations.

translation.text: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.

verses.english:
And God said to Abraham, “And you: you shall observe my
covenant, you and your seed after you through their
generations.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת בְּרִיתִי אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמְרוּ בֵּינִי וּבֵינֵיכֶם וּבֵין זַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ הִמּוֹל לָכֶם כּל זָכָר׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת בְּרִיתִי אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמְרוּ בֵּינִי וּבֵינֵיכֶם וּבֵין זַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ הִמּוֹל לָכֶם כּל זָכָר׃

english.text:
This is my covenant that you shall observe between me and
you and your seed after you: every male is to be
circumcised among you.

translation.text: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.

verses.english:
This is my covenant that you shall observe between me and
you and your seed after you: every male is to be
circumcised among you.

verses.hebrew: וּנְמַלְתֶּם אֵת בְּשַׂר ערְלַתְכֶם וְהָיָה לְאוֹת בְּרִית בֵּינִי וּבֵינֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּנְמַלְתֶּם אֵת בְּשַׂר ערְלַתְכֶם וְהָיָה לְאוֹת בְּרִית בֵּינִי וּבֵינֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall be circumcised at the flesh of your
foreskin, and it will become a sign of a covenant between
me and you.

translation.text: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.

verses.english:
And you shall be circumcised at the flesh of your
foreskin, and it will become a sign of a covenant between
me and you.

verses.hebrew: וּבֶן שְׁמֹנַת יָמִים יִמּוֹל לָכֶם כּל זָכָר לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם יְלִיד בָּיִת וּמִקְנַת כֶּסֶף מִכֹּל בֶּן נֵכָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא מִזַּרְעֲךָ הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וּבֶן שְׁמֹנַת יָמִים יִמּוֹל לָכֶם כּל זָכָר לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם יְלִיד בָּיִת וּמִקְנַת כֶּסֶף מִכֹּל בֶּן נֵכָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא מִזַּרְעֲךָ הוּא׃

english.text:
And at eight days old every male shall be circumcised
among you through your generations: homeborn or purchased
with money from any foreigner who is not from your seed.

translation.text: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.

verses.english:
And at eight days old every male shall be circumcised
among you through your generations: homeborn or purchased
with money from any foreigner who is not from your seed.

verses.hebrew: הִמּוֹל יִמּוֹל יְלִיד בֵּיתְךָ וּמִקְנַת כַּסְפֶּךָ וְהָיְתָה בְרִיתִי בִּבְשַׂרְכֶם לִבְרִית עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: הִמּוֹל יִמּוֹל יְלִיד בֵּיתְךָ וּמִקְנַת כַּסְפֶּךָ וְהָיְתָה בְרִיתִי בִּבְשַׂרְכֶם לִבְרִית עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
Your homeborn and the one purchased with your money will
be circumcised. And my covenant will become an eternal
covenant in your flesh.

translation.text: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

verses.english:
Your homeborn and the one purchased with your money will
be circumcised. And my covenant will become an eternal
covenant in your flesh.

verses.hebrew: וְעָרֵל זָכָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִמּוֹל אֶת בְּשַׂר ערְלָתוֹ וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ אֶת בְּרִיתִי הֵפַר׃

hebrew.text: וְעָרֵל זָכָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִמּוֹל אֶת בְּשַׂר ערְלָתוֹ וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ אֶת בְּרִיתִי הֵפַר׃

english.text:
And an uncircumcised—a male the flesh of whose foreskin
will not be circumcised—that person will be cut off from
his people. He has broken my covenant.”

translation.text: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.

verses.english:
And an uncircumcised—a male the flesh of whose foreskin
will not be circumcised—that person will be cut off from
his people. He has broken my covenant.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל אַבְרָהָם שָׂרַי אִשְׁתְּךָ לֹא תִקְרָא אֶת שְׁמָהּ שָׂרָי כִּי שָׂרָה שְׁמָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל אַבְרָהָם שָׂרַי אִשְׁתְּךָ לֹא תִקְרָא אֶת שְׁמָהּ שָׂרָי כִּי שָׂרָה שְׁמָהּ׃

english.text:
And God said to Abraham, “Sarai, your wife: you shall not
call her name Sarai, because her name is Sarah."

translation.text: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.

verses.english:
And God said to Abraham, “Sarai, your wife: you shall not
call her name Sarai, because her name is Sarah."

verses.hebrew: וּבֵרַכְתִּי אֹתָהּ וְגַם נָתַתִּי מִמֶּנָּה לְךָ בֵּן וּבֵרַכְתִּיהָ וְהָיְתָה לְגוֹיִם מַלְכֵי עַמִּים מִמֶּנָּה יִהְיוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבֵרַכְתִּי אֹתָהּ וְגַם נָתַתִּי מִמֶּנָּה לְךָ בֵּן וּבֵרַכְתִּיהָ וְהָיְתָה לְגוֹיִם מַלְכֵי עַמִּים מִמֶּנָּה יִהְיוּ׃

english.text:
And I’ll bless her, and I’ll also give you a son from her.
And I’ll bless her, and she’ll become nations. Kings of
peoples will be from her.”

translation.text: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.

verses.english:
And I’ll bless her, and I’ll also give you a son from her.
And I’ll bless her, and she’ll become nations. Kings of
peoples will be from her.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֹּל אַבְרָהָם עַל פָּנָיו וַיִּצְחָק וַיֹּאמֶר בְּלִבּוֹ הַלְּבֶן מֵאָה שָׁנָה יִוָּלֵד וְאִם שָׂרָה הֲבַת תִּשְׁעִים שָׁנָה תֵּלֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֹּל אַבְרָהָם עַל פָּנָיו וַיִּצְחָק וַיֹּאמֶר בְּלִבּוֹ הַלְּבֶן מֵאָה שָׁנָה יִוָּלֵד וְאִם שָׂרָה הֲבַת תִּשְׁעִים שָׁנָה תֵּלֵד׃

english.text:
And Abraham fell on his face and laughed and said in his
heart, “Will he be born to someone who’s a hundred years
old?! And will Sarah, who’s ninety years old, give
birth?!”

translation.text: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?

verses.english:
And Abraham fell on his face and laughed and said in his
heart, “Will he be born to someone who’s a hundred years
old?! And will Sarah, who’s ninety years old, give
birth?!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים לוּ יִשְׁמָעֵאל יִחְיֶה לְפָנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים לוּ יִשְׁמָעֵאל יִחְיֶה לְפָנֶיךָ׃

english.text: And Abraham said to God, “If only Ishmael will live before you.”

translation.text: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!

verses.english: And Abraham said to God, “If only Ishmael will live before you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֲבָל שָׂרָה אִשְׁתְּךָ יֹלֶדֶת לְךָ בֵּן וְקָרָאתָ אֶת שְׁמוֹ יִצְחָק וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת בְּרִיתִי אִתּוֹ לִבְרִית עוֹלָם לְזַרְעוֹ אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֲבָל שָׂרָה אִשְׁתְּךָ יֹלֶדֶת לְךָ בֵּן וְקָרָאתָ אֶת שְׁמוֹ יִצְחָק וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת בְּרִיתִי אִתּוֹ לִבְרִית עוֹלָם לְזַרְעוֹ אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
And God said, “But Sarah, your wife, is giving birth to a
son for you. And you shall call his name Isaac. And I’ll
establish my covenant with him as an eternal covenant for
his seed after him.

translation.text: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.

verses.english:
And God said, “But Sarah, your wife, is giving birth to a
son for you. And you shall call his name Isaac. And I’ll
establish my covenant with him as an eternal covenant for
his seed after him.

verses.hebrew: וּלְיִשְׁמָעֵאל שְׁמַעְתִּיךָ הִנֵּה בֵּרַכְתִּי אֹתוֹ וְהִפְרֵיתִי אֹתוֹ וְהִרְבֵּיתִי אֹתוֹ בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר נְשִׂיאִם יוֹלִיד וּנְתַתִּיו לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וּלְיִשְׁמָעֵאל שְׁמַעְתִּיךָ הִנֵּה בֵּרַכְתִּי אֹתוֹ וְהִפְרֵיתִי אֹתוֹ וְהִרְבֵּיתִי אֹתוֹ בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר נְשִׂיאִם יוֹלִיד וּנְתַתִּיו לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל׃

english.text:
And I’ve listened to you about Ishmael. Here, I’ve blessed
him, and I’ll make him fruitful and make him very, very
numerous. He’ll father twelve chieftains, and I’ll make
him into a big nation.

translation.text: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.

verses.english:
And I’ve listened to you about Ishmael. Here, I’ve blessed
him, and I’ll make him fruitful and make him very, very
numerous. He’ll father twelve chieftains, and I’ll make
him into a big nation.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת בְּרִיתִי אָקִים אֶת יִצְחָק אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵד לְךָ שָׂרָה לַמּוֹעֵד הַזֶּה בַּשָּׁנָה הָאַחֶרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת בְּרִיתִי אָקִים אֶת יִצְחָק אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵד לְךָ שָׂרָה לַמּוֹעֵד הַזֶּה בַּשָּׁנָה הָאַחֶרֶת׃

english.text:
But I’ll establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will
bear for you at this appointed time in the next year.”

translation.text: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.

verses.english:
But I’ll establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will
bear for you at this appointed time in the next year.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַל לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ וַיַּעַל אֱלֹהִים מֵעַל אַבְרָהָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְכַל לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ וַיַּעַל אֱלֹהִים מֵעַל אַבְרָהָם׃

english.text: And He finished speaking with him, and God went up from Abraham.

translation.text: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.

verses.english: And He finished speaking with him, and God went up from Abraham.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָהָם אֶת יִשְׁמָעֵאל בְּנוֹ וְאֵת כּל יְלִידֵי בֵיתוֹ וְאֵת כּל מִקְנַת כַּסְפּוֹ כּל זָכָר בְּאַנְשֵׁי בֵּית אַבְרָהָם וַיָּמל אֶת בְּשַׂר ערְלָתָם בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָהָם אֶת יִשְׁמָעֵאל בְּנוֹ וְאֵת כּל יְלִידֵי בֵיתוֹ וְאֵת כּל מִקְנַת כַּסְפּוֹ כּל זָכָר בְּאַנְשֵׁי בֵּית אַבְרָהָם וַיָּמל אֶת בְּשַׂר ערְלָתָם בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And Abraham took Ishmael, his son, and all his homeborn
and everyone purchased with his money, every male among
the men of Abraham’s house, and he circumcised the flesh
of their foreskin in that very day, as God had spoken with
him.

translation.text: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.

verses.english:
And Abraham took Ishmael, his son, and all his homeborn
and everyone purchased with his money, every male among
the men of Abraham’s house, and he circumcised the flesh
of their foreskin in that very day, as God had spoken with
him.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְרָהָם בֶּן תִּשְׁעִים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה בְּהִמֹּלוֹ בְּשַׂר ערְלָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַבְרָהָם בֶּן תִּשְׁעִים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה בְּהִמֹּלוֹ בְּשַׂר ערְלָתוֹ׃

english.text:
And Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was
circumcised, the flesh of his foreskin,

translation.text: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

verses.english:
And Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was
circumcised, the flesh of his foreskin,

verses.hebrew: וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל בְּנוֹ בֶּן שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בְּהִמֹּלוֹ אֵת בְּשַׂר ערְלָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל בְּנוֹ בֶּן שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בְּהִמֹּלוֹ אֵת בְּשַׂר ערְלָתוֹ׃

english.text:
and Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was
circumcised at the flesh of his foreskin.

translation.text: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

verses.english:
and Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was
circumcised at the flesh of his foreskin.

verses.hebrew: בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה נִמּוֹל אַבְרָהָם וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל בְּנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה נִמּוֹל אַבְרָהָם וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל בְּנוֹ׃

english.text: In that very day Abraham was circumcised, and Ishmael, his son;

translation.text: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.

verses.english: In that very day Abraham was circumcised, and Ishmael, his son;

verses.hebrew: וְכל אַנְשֵׁי בֵיתוֹ יְלִיד בָּיִת וּמִקְנַת כֶּסֶף מֵאֵת בֶּן נֵכָר נִמֹּלוּ אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל אַנְשֵׁי בֵיתוֹ יְלִיד בָּיִת וּמִקְנַת כֶּסֶף מֵאֵת בֶּן נֵכָר נִמֹּלוּ אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
and all the men of his house, homeborn and purchased with
money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

translation.text: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.

verses.english:
and all the men of his house, homeborn and purchased with
money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה בְּאֵלֹנֵי מַמְרֵא וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל כְּחֹם הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה בְּאֵלֹנֵי מַמְרֵא וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל כְּחֹם הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And YHWH appeared to him at the oaks of Mamre. And he was
sitting at the tent entrance in the heat of the day,

translation.text: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;

verses.english:
And YHWH appeared to him at the oaks of Mamre. And he was
sitting at the tent entrance in the heat of the day,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה שְׁלֹשָׁה אֲנָשִׁים נִצָּבִים עָלָיו וַיַּרְא וַיָּרץ לִקְרָאתָם מִפֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה שְׁלֹשָׁה אֲנָשִׁים נִצָּבִים עָלָיו וַיַּרְא וַיָּרץ לִקְרָאתָם מִפֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
and he raised his eyes and saw, and here were three people
standing over him. And he saw and ran toward them from the
tent entrance and bowed to the ground.

translation.text: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,

verses.english:
and he raised his eyes and saw, and here were three people
standing over him. And he saw and ran toward them from the
tent entrance and bowed to the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אַל נָא תַעֲבֹר מֵעַל עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אַל נָא תַעֲבֹר מֵעַל עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And he said, “My Lord, if I’ve found favor in your eyes
don’t pass on from your servant.

translation.text: And said, My LORD, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:

verses.english:
And he said, “My Lord, if I’ve found favor in your eyes
don’t pass on from your servant.

verses.hebrew: יֻקַּח נָא מְעַט מַיִם וְרַחֲצוּ רַגְלֵיכֶם וְהִשָּׁעֲנוּ תַּחַת הָעֵץ׃

hebrew.text: יֻקַּח נָא מְעַט מַיִם וְרַחֲצוּ רַגְלֵיכֶם וְהִשָּׁעֲנוּ תַּחַת הָעֵץ׃

english.text:
Let a little water be gotten, and wash your feet and relax
under a tree,

translation.text: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:

verses.english:
Let a little water be gotten, and wash your feet and relax
under a tree,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶקְחָה פַת לֶחֶם וְסַעֲדוּ לִבְּכֶם אַחַר תַּעֲבֹרוּ כִּי עַל כֵּן עֲבַרְתֶּם עַל עַבְדְּכֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ כֵּן תַּעֲשֶׂה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶקְחָה פַת לֶחֶם וְסַעֲדוּ לִבְּכֶם אַחַר תַּעֲבֹרוּ כִּי עַל כֵּן עֲבַרְתֶּם עַל עַבְדְּכֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ כֵּן תַּעֲשֶׂה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ׃

english.text:
and let me get a bit of bread, and satisfy your heart.
Afterward you’ll pass on, for that’s why you’ve passed by
your servant.” And they said, “Do that, as you’ve spoken.”

translation.text: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.

verses.english:
and let me get a bit of bread, and satisfy your heart.
Afterward you’ll pass on, for that’s why you’ve passed by
your servant.” And they said, “Do that, as you’ve spoken.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֵר אַבְרָהָם הָאֹהֱלָה אֶל שָׂרָה וַיֹּאמֶר מַהֲרִי שְׁלֹשׁ סְאִים קֶמַח סֹלֶת לוּשִׁי וַעֲשִׂי עֻגוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַהֵר אַבְרָהָם הָאֹהֱלָה אֶל שָׂרָה וַיֹּאמֶר מַהֲרִי שְׁלֹשׁ סְאִים קֶמַח סֹלֶת לוּשִׁי וַעֲשִׂי עֻגוֹת׃

english.text:
And Abraham hurried to the tent, to Sarah, and said,
“Hurry, three measures of fine flour. Knead it and make
cakes.”

translation.text: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.

verses.english:
And Abraham hurried to the tent, to Sarah, and said,
“Hurry, three measures of fine flour. Knead it and make
cakes.”

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל הַבָּקָר רָץ אַבְרָהָם וַיִּקַּח בֶּן בָּקָר רַךְ וָטוֹב וַיִּתֵּן אֶל הַנַּעַר וַיְמַהֵר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל הַבָּקָר רָץ אַבְרָהָם וַיִּקַּח בֶּן בָּקָר רַךְ וָטוֹב וַיִּתֵּן אֶל הַנַּעַר וַיְמַהֵר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And Abraham ran to the herd and took a calf, tender and
good, and he gave it to a servant, and he hurried to
prepare it.

translation.text: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.

verses.english:
And Abraham ran to the herd and took a calf, tender and
good, and he gave it to a servant, and he hurried to
prepare it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח חֶמְאָה וְחָלָב וּבֶן הַבָּקָר אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וַיִּתֵּן לִפְנֵיהֶם וְהוּא עֹמֵד עֲלֵיהֶם תַּחַת הָעֵץ וַיֹּאכֵלוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח חֶמְאָה וְחָלָב וּבֶן הַבָּקָר אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וַיִּתֵּן לִפְנֵיהֶם וְהוּא עֹמֵד עֲלֵיהֶם תַּחַת הָעֵץ וַיֹּאכֵלוּ׃

english.text:
And he took curds and milk and the calf that he had
prepared and placed them in front of them, and he was
standing over them under the tree, and they ate.

translation.text: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.

verses.english:
And he took curds and milk and the calf that he had
prepared and placed them in front of them, and he was
standing over them under the tree, and they ate.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אַיֵּה שָׂרָה אִשְׁתֶּךָ וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה בָאֹהֶל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אַיֵּה שָׂרָה אִשְׁתֶּךָ וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה בָאֹהֶל׃

english.text:
And they said to him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” And he
said, “Here in the tent.”

translation.text: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.

verses.english:
And they said to him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” And he
said, “Here in the tent.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שׁוֹב אָשׁוּב אֵלֶיךָ כָּעֵת חַיָּה וְהִנֵּה בֵן לְשָׂרָה אִשְׁתֶּךָ וְשָׂרָה שֹׁמַעַת פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וְהוּא אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שׁוֹב אָשׁוּב אֵלֶיךָ כָּעֵת חַיָּה וְהִנֵּה בֵן לְשָׂרָה אִשְׁתֶּךָ וְשָׂרָה שֹׁמַעַת פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וְהוּא אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
And He said, “I shall come back to you at the time of
life, and, here, Sarah, your wife, will have a son.” And
Sarah was listening at the tent entrance, which was behind
him.

translation.text: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.

verses.english:
And He said, “I shall come back to you at the time of
life, and, here, Sarah, your wife, will have a son.” And
Sarah was listening at the tent entrance, which was behind
him.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְרָהָם וְשָׂרָה זְקֵנִים בָּאִים בַּיָּמִים חָדַל לִהְיוֹת לְשָׂרָה אֹרַח כַּנָּשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וְאַבְרָהָם וְשָׂרָה זְקֵנִים בָּאִים בַּיָּמִים חָדַל לִהְיוֹת לְשָׂרָה אֹרַח כַּנָּשִׁים׃

english.text:
And Abraham and Sarah were old, well along in days; Sarah
had stopped having the way of women.

translation.text: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.

verses.english:
And Abraham and Sarah were old, well along in days; Sarah
had stopped having the way of women.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּצְחַק שָׂרָה בְּקִרְבָּהּ לֵאמֹר אַחֲרֵי בְלֹתִי הָיְתָה לִּי עֶדְנָה וַאדֹנִי זָקֵן׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּצְחַק שָׂרָה בְּקִרְבָּהּ לֵאמֹר אַחֲרֵי בְלֹתִי הָיְתָה לִּי עֶדְנָה וַאדֹנִי זָקֵן׃

english.text:
And Sarah laughed inside her and said, “After I’ve become
worn out am I to have pleasure?! And my lord is old!”

translation.text: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?

verses.english:
And Sarah laughed inside her and said, “After I’ve become
worn out am I to have pleasure?! And my lord is old!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַבְרָהָם לָמָּה זֶּה צָחֲקָה שָׂרָה לֵאמֹר הַאַף אֻמְנָם אֵלֵד וַאֲנִי זָקַנְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַבְרָהָם לָמָּה זֶּה צָחֲקָה שָׂרָה לֵאמֹר הַאַף אֻמְנָם אֵלֵד וַאֲנִי זָקַנְתִּי׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Abraham, “Why is this? Sarah laughed,
saying, ‘Shall I indeed give birth? And I am old!’ Is
anything too wondrous for YHWH?

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Abraham, “Why is this? Sarah laughed,
saying, ‘Shall I indeed give birth? And I am old!’ Is
anything too wondrous for YHWH?

verses.hebrew: הֲיִפָּלֵא מֵיְהֹוָה דָּבָר לַמּוֹעֵד אָשׁוּב אֵלֶיךָ כָּעֵת חַיָּה וּלְשָׂרָה בֵן׃

hebrew.text: הֲיִפָּלֵא מֵיְהֹוָה דָּבָר לַמּוֹעֵד אָשׁוּב אֵלֶיךָ כָּעֵת חַיָּה וּלְשָׂרָה בֵן׃

english.text:
At the appointed time I’ll come back to you, at the time
of life, and Sarah will have a son.”

translation.text: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.

verses.english:
At the appointed time I’ll come back to you, at the time
of life, and Sarah will have a son.”

verses.hebrew: וַתְּכַחֵשׁ שָׂרָה לֵאמֹר לֹא צָחַקְתִּי כִּי יָרֵאָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא כִּי צָחָקְתְּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּכַחֵשׁ שָׂרָה לֵאמֹר לֹא צָחַקְתִּי כִּי יָרֵאָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא כִּי צָחָקְתְּ׃

english.text:
And Sarah lied, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” because she was
afraid. And He said, “No, but you did laugh.”

translation.text: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.

verses.english:
And Sarah lied, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” because she was
afraid. And He said, “No, but you did laugh.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ מִשָּׁם הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיַּשְׁקִפוּ עַל פְּנֵי סְדֹם וְאַבְרָהָם הֹלֵךְ עִמָּם לְשַׁלְּחָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֻמוּ מִשָּׁם הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיַּשְׁקִפוּ עַל פְּנֵי סְדֹם וְאַבְרָהָם הֹלֵךְ עִמָּם לְשַׁלְּחָם׃

english.text:
And the people got up from there and gazed at the sight of
Sodom, and Abraham was going with them to send them off.

translation.text: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.

verses.english:
And the people got up from there and gazed at the sight of
Sodom, and Abraham was going with them to send them off.

verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה אָמָר הַמְכַסֶּה אֲנִי מֵאַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי עֹשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה אָמָר הַמְכַסֶּה אֲנִי מֵאַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי עֹשֶׂה׃

english.text: And YHWH had said, “Shall I conceal what I’m doing from Abraham,

translation.text: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;

verses.english: And YHWH had said, “Shall I conceal what I’m doing from Abraham,

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְרָהָם הָיוֹ יִהְיֶה לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל וְעָצוּם וְנִבְרְכוּ בוֹ כֹּל גּוֹיֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַבְרָהָם הָיוֹ יִהְיֶה לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל וְעָצוּם וְנִבְרְכוּ בוֹ כֹּל גּוֹיֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
since Abraham will become a big and powerful nation, and
all the nations of the earth will be blessed through him?

translation.text: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?

verses.english:
since Abraham will become a big and powerful nation, and
all the nations of the earth will be blessed through him?

verses.hebrew: כִּי יְדַעְתִּיו לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר יְצַוֶּה אֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת בֵּיתוֹ אַחֲרָיו וְשָׁמְרוּ דֶּרֶךְ יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת צְדָקָה וּמִשְׁפָּט לְמַעַן הָבִיא יְהֹוָה עַל אַבְרָהָם אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יְדַעְתִּיו לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר יְצַוֶּה אֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת בֵּיתוֹ אַחֲרָיו וְשָׁמְרוּ דֶּרֶךְ יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת צְדָקָה וּמִשְׁפָּט לְמַעַן הָבִיא יְהֹוָה עַל אַבְרָהָם אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר עָלָיו׃

english.text:
For I've chosen him so that he'll command his children and
his household after him, and they'll keep YHWH's way by
practicing righteousness and justice, so that YHWH will
fulfill what He promised Abraham.

translation.text: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the LORD, to do justice and judgment; that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.

verses.english:
For I've chosen him so that he'll command his children and
his household after him, and they'll keep YHWH's way by
practicing righteousness and justice, so that YHWH will
fulfill what He promised Abraham.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה זַעֲקַת סְדֹם וַעֲמֹרָה כִּי רָבָּה וְחַטָּאתָם כִּי כָבְדָה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה זַעֲקַת סְדֹם וַעֲמֹרָה כִּי רָבָּה וְחַטָּאתָם כִּי כָבְדָה מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And YHWH said, “The cry of Sodom and Gomorrah: how great
it is. And their sin: how very heavy it is.

translation.text: And the LORD said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;

verses.english:
And YHWH said, “The cry of Sodom and Gomorrah: how great
it is. And their sin: how very heavy it is.

verses.hebrew: אֵרְדָה נָּא וְאֶרְאֶה הַכְּצַעֲקָתָהּ הַבָּאָה אֵלַי עָשׂוּ כָּלָה וְאִם לֹא אֵדָעָה׃

hebrew.text: אֵרְדָה נָּא וְאֶרְאֶה הַכְּצַעֲקָתָהּ הַבָּאָה אֵלַי עָשׂוּ כָּלָה וְאִם לֹא אֵדָעָה׃

english.text:
Let me go down, and I’ll see if they’ve done, all told,
like the cry that has come to me. And if not, let me
know.”

translation.text: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.

verses.english:
Let me go down, and I’ll see if they’ve done, all told,
like the cry that has come to me. And if not, let me
know.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְנוּ מִשָּׁם הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיֵּלְכוּ סְדֹמָה וְאַבְרָהָם עוֹדֶנּוּ עֹמֵד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְנוּ מִשָּׁם הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיֵּלְכוּ סְדֹמָה וְאַבְרָהָם עוֹדֶנּוּ עֹמֵד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the people turned from there and went to Sodom. And
Abraham was still standing before YHWH,

translation.text: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.

verses.english:
And the people turned from there and went to Sodom. And
Abraham was still standing before YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמַר הַאַף תִּסְפֶּה צַדִּיק עִם רָשָׁע׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגַּשׁ אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמַר הַאַף תִּסְפֶּה צַדִּיק עִם רָשָׁע׃

english.text:
and Abraham came over and said, “Will you also annihilate
the virtuous with the wicked?

translation.text: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?

verses.english:
and Abraham came over and said, “Will you also annihilate
the virtuous with the wicked?

verses.hebrew: אוּלַי יֵשׁ חֲמִשִּׁים צַדִּיקִם בְּתוֹךְ הָעִיר הַאַף תִּסְפֶּה וְלֹא תִשָּׂא לַמָּקוֹם לְמַעַן חֲמִשִּׁים הַצַּדִּיקִם אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: אוּלַי יֵשׁ חֲמִשִּׁים צַדִּיקִם בְּתוֹךְ הָעִיר הַאַף תִּסְפֶּה וְלֹא תִשָּׂא לַמָּקוֹם לְמַעַן חֲמִשִּׁים הַצַּדִּיקִם אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבָּהּ׃

english.text:
Maybe there are fifty virtuous people within the city.
Will you also annihilate and not sustain the place for the
fifty virtuous who are in it?

translation.text: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?

verses.english:
Maybe there are fifty virtuous people within the city.
Will you also annihilate and not sustain the place for the
fifty virtuous who are in it?

verses.hebrew: חָלִלָה לְּךָ מֵעֲשֹׂת כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְהָמִית צַדִּיק עִם רָשָׁע וְהָיָה כַצַּדִּיק כָּרָשָׁע חָלִלָה לָּךְ הֲשֹׁפֵט כּל הָאָרֶץ לֹא יַעֲשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט׃

hebrew.text: חָלִלָה לְּךָ מֵעֲשֹׂת כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְהָמִית צַדִּיק עִם רָשָׁע וְהָיָה כַצַּדִּיק כָּרָשָׁע חָלִלָה לָּךְ הֲשֹׁפֵט כּל הָאָרֶץ לֹא יַעֲשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט׃

english.text:
Far be it from you to do a thing like this, to kill
virtuous with wicked—and it will be the same for the
virtuous and the wicked—far be it from you. Will the judge
of all the earth not do justice?”

translation.text: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?

verses.english:
Far be it from you to do a thing like this, to kill
virtuous with wicked—and it will be the same for the
virtuous and the wicked—far be it from you. Will the judge
of all the earth not do justice?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אִם אֶמְצָא בִסְדֹם חֲמִשִּׁים צַדִּיקִם בְּתוֹךְ הָעִיר וְנָשָׂאתִי לְכל הַמָּקוֹם בַּעֲבוּרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אִם אֶמְצָא בִסְדֹם חֲמִשִּׁים צַדִּיקִם בְּתוֹךְ הָעִיר וְנָשָׂאתִי לְכל הַמָּקוֹם בַּעֲבוּרָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said, “If I find in Sodom fifty virtuous people
within the city, then I’ll sustain the whole place for
their sake.”

translation.text: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.

verses.english:
And YHWH said, “If I find in Sodom fifty virtuous people
within the city, then I’ll sustain the whole place for
their sake.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמַר הִנֵּה נָא הוֹאַלְתִּי לְדַבֵּר אֶל אֲדֹנָי וְאָנֹכִי עָפָר וָאֵפֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמַר הִנֵּה נָא הוֹאַלְתִּי לְדַבֵּר אֶל אֲדֹנָי וְאָנֹכִי עָפָר וָאֵפֶר׃

english.text:
And Abraham answered, and he said, “Here I’ve undertaken
to speak to my Lord, and I’m dust and ashes.

translation.text: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the LORD, which am but dust and ashes:

verses.english:
And Abraham answered, and he said, “Here I’ve undertaken
to speak to my Lord, and I’m dust and ashes.

verses.hebrew: אוּלַי יַחְסְרוּן חֲמִשִּׁים הַצַּדִּיקִם חֲמִשָּׁה הֲתַשְׁחִית בַּחֲמִשָּׁה אֶת כּל הָעִיר וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אַשְׁחִית אִם אֶמְצָא שָׁם אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: אוּלַי יַחְסְרוּן חֲמִשִּׁים הַצַּדִּיקִם חֲמִשָּׁה הֲתַשְׁחִית בַּחֲמִשָּׁה אֶת כּל הָעִיר וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אַשְׁחִית אִם אֶמְצָא שָׁם אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
Maybe the fifty virtuous people will be short by five.
Will you destroy the whole city for the five?” And He
said, “I won’t destroy if I find forty-five there.”

translation.text: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.

verses.english:
Maybe the fifty virtuous people will be short by five.
Will you destroy the whole city for the five?” And He
said, “I won’t destroy if I find forty-five there.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד לְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמַר אוּלַי יִמָּצְאוּן שָׁם אַרְבָּעִים וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֶעֱשֶׂה בַּעֲבוּר הָאַרְבָּעִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד לְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמַר אוּלַי יִמָּצְאוּן שָׁם אַרְבָּעִים וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֶעֱשֶׂה בַּעֲבוּר הָאַרְבָּעִים׃

english.text:
And he went on again to speak to Him and said, “Maybe
forty will be found there.” And He said, “I won’t do it
for the sake of the forty.”

translation.text: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty’s sake.

verses.english:
And he went on again to speak to Him and said, “Maybe
forty will be found there.” And He said, “I won’t do it
for the sake of the forty.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל נָא יִחַר לַאדֹנָי וַאֲדַבֵּרָה אוּלַי יִמָּצְאוּן שָׁם שְׁלֹשִׁים וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֶעֱשֶׂה אִם אֶמְצָא שָׁם שְׁלֹשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל נָא יִחַר לַאדֹנָי וַאֲדַבֵּרָה אוּלַי יִמָּצְאוּן שָׁם שְׁלֹשִׁים וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֶעֱשֶׂה אִם אֶמְצָא שָׁם שְׁלֹשִׁים׃

english.text:
And he said, “May my Lord not be angry, and let me speak.
Maybe thirty will be found there.” And He said, “I won’t
do it if I find thirty there.”

translation.text: And he said unto him, Oh let not the LORD be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.

verses.english:
And he said, “May my Lord not be angry, and let me speak.
Maybe thirty will be found there.” And He said, “I won’t
do it if I find thirty there.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה נָא הוֹאַלְתִּי לְדַבֵּר אֶל אֲדֹנָי אוּלַי יִמָּצְאוּן שָׁם עֶשְׂרִים וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אַשְׁחִית בַּעֲבוּר הָעֶשְׂרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה נָא הוֹאַלְתִּי לְדַבֵּר אֶל אֲדֹנָי אוּלַי יִמָּצְאוּן שָׁם עֶשְׂרִים וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אַשְׁחִית בַּעֲבוּר הָעֶשְׂרִים׃

english.text:
And he said, “Here I’ve undertaken to speak to my Lord.
Maybe twenty will be found there.” And He said, “I won’t
destroy for the sake of the twenty.”

translation.text: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the LORD: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty’s sake.

verses.english:
And he said, “Here I’ve undertaken to speak to my Lord.
Maybe twenty will be found there.” And He said, “I won’t
destroy for the sake of the twenty.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל נָא יִחַר לַאדֹנָי וַאֲדַבְּרָה אַךְ הַפַּעַם אוּלַי יִמָּצְאוּן שָׁם עֲשָׂרָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אַשְׁחִית בַּעֲבוּר הָעֲשָׂרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל נָא יִחַר לַאדֹנָי וַאֲדַבְּרָה אַךְ הַפַּעַם אוּלַי יִמָּצְאוּן שָׁם עֲשָׂרָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אַשְׁחִית בַּעֲבוּר הָעֲשָׂרָה׃

english.text:
And he said, “May my Lord not be angry, and let me speak
just this one time. Maybe ten will be found there.” And He
said there, “I won’t destroy for the sake of the ten.”

translation.text: And he said, Oh let not the LORD be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for ten’s sake.

verses.english:
And he said, “May my Lord not be angry, and let me speak
just this one time. Maybe ten will be found there.” And He
said there, “I won’t destroy for the sake of the ten.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלָּה לְדַבֵּר אֶל אַבְרָהָם וְאַבְרָהָם שָׁב לִמְקֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלָּה לְדַבֵּר אֶל אַבְרָהָם וְאַבְרָהָם שָׁב לִמְקֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH went when He had finished speaking to Abraham,
and Abraham went back to his place.

translation.text: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.

verses.english:
And YHWH went when He had finished speaking to Abraham,
and Abraham went back to his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ שְׁנֵי הַמַּלְאָכִים סְדֹמָה בָּעֶרֶב וְלוֹט יֹשֵׁב בְּשַׁעַר סְדֹם וַיַּרְא לוֹט וַיָּקם לִקְרָאתָם וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ אַפַּיִם אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ שְׁנֵי הַמַּלְאָכִים סְדֹמָה בָּעֶרֶב וְלוֹט יֹשֵׁב בְּשַׁעַר סְדֹם וַיַּרְא לוֹט וַיָּקם לִקְרָאתָם וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ אַפַּיִם אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
And the two angels came to Sodom in the evening, and
Lot was sitting at Sodom’s gate, and Lot saw and got up
toward them, and he bowed, nose to the ground.

translation.text: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;

verses.english:
And the two angels came to Sodom in the evening, and
Lot was sitting at Sodom’s gate, and Lot saw and got up
toward them, and he bowed, nose to the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֶּה נָּא אֲדֹנַי סוּרוּ נָא אֶל בֵּית עַבְדְּכֶם וְלִינוּ וְרַחֲצוּ רַגְלֵיכֶם וְהִשְׁכַּמְתֶּם וַהֲלַכְתֶּם לְדַרְכְּכֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹּא כִּי בָרְחוֹב נָלִין׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֶּה נָּא אֲדֹנַי סוּרוּ נָא אֶל בֵּית עַבְדְּכֶם וְלִינוּ וְרַחֲצוּ רַגְלֵיכֶם וְהִשְׁכַּמְתֶּם וַהֲלַכְתֶּם לְדַרְכְּכֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹּא כִּי בָרְחוֹב נָלִין׃

english.text:
And he said, “Here, my lords, turn to your servant’s house
and spend the night and wash your feet, and you’ll get up
early and go your way.” And they said, “No, we’ll spend
the night in the square.”

translation.text: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant’s house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.

verses.english:
And he said, “Here, my lords, turn to your servant’s house
and spend the night and wash your feet, and you’ll get up
early and go your way.” And they said, “No, we’ll spend
the night in the square.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְצַר בָּם מְאֹד וַיָּסֻרוּ אֵלָיו וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל בֵּיתוֹ וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם מִשְׁתֶּה וּמַצּוֹת אָפָה וַיֹּאכֵלוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְצַר בָּם מְאֹד וַיָּסֻרוּ אֵלָיו וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל בֵּיתוֹ וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם מִשְׁתֶּה וּמַצּוֹת אָפָה וַיֹּאכֵלוּ׃

english.text:
And he pressed them very much, and they turned to him and
came to his house, and he made a feast and baked
unleavened bread for them, and they ate.

translation.text: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.

verses.english:
And he pressed them very much, and they turned to him and
came to his house, and he made a feast and baked
unleavened bread for them, and they ate.

verses.hebrew: טֶרֶם יִשְׁכָּבוּ וְאַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר אַנְשֵׁי סְדֹם נָסַבּוּ עַל הַבַּיִת מִנַּעַר וְעַד זָקֵן כּל הָעָם מִקָּצֶה׃

hebrew.text: טֶרֶם יִשְׁכָּבוּ וְאַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר אַנְשֵׁי סְדֹם נָסַבּוּ עַל הַבַּיִת מִנַּעַר וְעַד זָקֵן כּל הָעָם מִקָּצֶה׃

english.text:
They had not yet lain down, and the people of the city,
the people of Sodom, surrounded the house, from youth to
old man, all the people, from the farthest reaches.

translation.text: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:

verses.english:
They had not yet lain down, and the people of the city,
the people of Sodom, surrounded the house, from youth to
old man, all the people, from the farthest reaches.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ אֶל לוֹט וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אַיֵּה הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בָּאוּ אֵלֶיךָ הַלָּיְלָה הוֹצִיאֵם אֵלֵינוּ וְנֵדְעָה אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ אֶל לוֹט וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אַיֵּה הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בָּאוּ אֵלֶיךָ הַלָּיְלָה הוֹצִיאֵם אֵלֵינוּ וְנֵדְעָה אֹתָם׃

english.text:
And they called to Lot and said to him, “Where are the
people who came to you tonight? Bring them out to us, and
let’s know them!”

translation.text: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.

verses.english:
And they called to Lot and said to him, “Where are the
people who came to you tonight? Bring them out to us, and
let’s know them!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא אֲלֵהֶם לוֹט הַפֶּתְחָה וְהַדֶּלֶת סָגַר אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא אֲלֵהֶם לוֹט הַפֶּתְחָה וְהַדֶּלֶת סָגַר אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
And Lot went out to them at the entrance and closed the
door behind him,

translation.text: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,

verses.english:
And Lot went out to them at the entrance and closed the
door behind him,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר אַל נָא אַחַי תָּרֵעוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר אַל נָא אַחַי תָּרֵעוּ׃

english.text: and he said, “Don’t do bad, my brothers.

translation.text: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.

verses.english: and he said, “Don’t do bad, my brothers.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה נָא לִי שְׁתֵּי בָנוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ אִישׁ אוֹצִיאָה נָּא אֶתְהֶן אֲלֵיכֶם וַעֲשׂוּ לָהֶן כַּטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶם רַק לָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵל אַל תַּעֲשׂוּ דָבָר כִּי עַל כֵּן בָּאוּ בְּצֵל קֹרָתִי׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה נָא לִי שְׁתֵּי בָנוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ אִישׁ אוֹצִיאָה נָּא אֶתְהֶן אֲלֵיכֶם וַעֲשׂוּ לָהֶן כַּטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶם רַק לָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵל אַל תַּעֲשׂוּ דָבָר כִּי עַל כֵּן בָּאוּ בְּצֵל קֹרָתִי׃

english.text:
Here I have two daughters who haven’t known a man. Let me
bring them out to you, and do to them as is good in your
eyes. Only don’t do anything to these people, because that
is why they came under the shadow of my roof.”

translation.text: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.

verses.english:
Here I have two daughters who haven’t known a man. Let me
bring them out to you, and do to them as is good in your
eyes. Only don’t do anything to these people, because that
is why they came under the shadow of my roof.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ גֶּשׁ הָלְאָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָאֶחָד בָּא לָגוּר וַיִּשְׁפֹּט שָׁפוֹט עַתָּה נָרַע לְךָ מֵהֶם וַיִּפְצְרוּ בָאִישׁ בְּלוֹט מְאֹד וַיִּגְּשׁוּ לִשְׁבֹּר הַדָּלֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ גֶּשׁ הָלְאָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָאֶחָד בָּא לָגוּר וַיִּשְׁפֹּט שָׁפוֹט עַתָּה נָרַע לְךָ מֵהֶם וַיִּפְצְרוּ בָאִישׁ בְּלוֹט מְאֹד וַיִּגְּשׁוּ לִשְׁבֹּר הַדָּלֶת׃

english.text:
And they said, “Come over here,” and they said, “This one
comes to live, and then he judges! Now we’ll be worse to
you than to them.” And they pressed the man, Lot, very
much and came over to break down the door.

translation.text: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.

verses.english:
And they said, “Come over here,” and they said, “This one
comes to live, and then he judges! Now we’ll be worse to
you than to them.” And they pressed the man, Lot, very
much and came over to break down the door.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים אֶת יָדָם וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת לוֹט אֲלֵיהֶם הַבָּיְתָה וְאֶת הַדֶּלֶת סָגָרוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים אֶת יָדָם וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת לוֹט אֲלֵיהֶם הַבָּיְתָה וְאֶת הַדֶּלֶת סָגָרוּ׃

english.text:
And the people reached their hand out and brought Lot in
to them in the house, and they closed the door.

translation.text: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.

verses.english:
And the people reached their hand out and brought Lot in
to them in the house, and they closed the door.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר פֶּתַח הַבַּיִת הִכּוּ בַּסַּנְוֵרִים מִקָּטֹן וְעַד גָּדוֹל וַיִּלְאוּ לִמְצֹא הַפָּתַח׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר פֶּתַח הַבַּיִת הִכּוּ בַּסַּנְוֵרִים מִקָּטֹן וְעַד גָּדוֹל וַיִּלְאוּ לִמְצֹא הַפָּתַח׃

english.text:
And they struck the people who were at the house’s
entrance with blindness, from smallest to biggest, and
they wearied themselves with finding the entrance.

translation.text: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

verses.english:
And they struck the people who were at the house’s
entrance with blindness, from smallest to biggest, and
they wearied themselves with finding the entrance.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים אֶל לוֹט עֹד מִי לְךָ פֹה חָתָן וּבָנֶיךָ וּבְנֹתֶיךָ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לְךָ בָּעִיר הוֹצֵא מִן הַמָּקוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים אֶל לוֹט עֹד מִי לְךָ פֹה חָתָן וּבָנֶיךָ וּבְנֹתֶיךָ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לְךָ בָּעִיר הוֹצֵא מִן הַמָּקוֹם׃

english.text:
And the people said to Lot, “Who else do you have
here—son-in-law and your sons and your daughters and all
that you have in the city-take them out from the place,

translation.text: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:

verses.english:
And the people said to Lot, “Who else do you have
here—son-in-law and your sons and your daughters and all
that you have in the city-take them out from the place,

verses.hebrew: כִּי מַשְׁחִתִים אֲנַחְנוּ אֶת הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי גָדְלָה צַעֲקָתָם אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְשַׁלְּחֵנוּ יְהֹוָה לְשַׁחֲתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי מַשְׁחִתִים אֲנַחְנוּ אֶת הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי גָדְלָה צַעֲקָתָם אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְשַׁלְּחֵנוּ יְהֹוָה לְשַׁחֲתָהּ׃

english.text:
because we’re destroying this place, because its cry has
grown big before YHWH’s face, and YHWH has sent us to
destroy it.”

translation.text: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the LORD; and the LORD hath sent us to destroy it.

verses.english:
because we’re destroying this place, because its cry has
grown big before YHWH’s face, and YHWH has sent us to
destroy it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא לוֹט וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל חֲתָנָיו לֹקְחֵי בְנֹתָיו וַיֹּאמֶר קוּמוּ צְּאוּ מִן הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי מַשְׁחִית יְהֹוָה אֶת הָעִיר וַיְהִי כִמְצַחֵק בְּעֵינֵי חֲתָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא לוֹט וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל חֲתָנָיו לֹקְחֵי בְנֹתָיו וַיֹּאמֶר קוּמוּ צְּאוּ מִן הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי מַשְׁחִית יְהֹוָה אֶת הָעִיר וַיְהִי כִמְצַחֵק בְּעֵינֵי חֲתָנָיו׃

english.text:
And Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, who had
married his daughters, and said, “Get up, get out of this
place, for YHWH is destroying the city.” And he was like a
joker in his sons-in-law’s eyes.

translation.text: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the LORD will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.

verses.english:
And Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, who had
married his daughters, and said, “Get up, get out of this
place, for YHWH is destroying the city.” And he was like a
joker in his sons-in-law’s eyes.

verses.hebrew: וּכְמוֹ הַשַּׁחַר עָלָה וַיָּאִיצוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים בְּלוֹט לֵאמֹר קוּם קַח אֶת אִשְׁתְּךָ וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי בְנֹתֶיךָ הַנִּמְצָאֹת פֶּן תִּסָּפֶה בַּעֲוֺן הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וּכְמוֹ הַשַּׁחַר עָלָה וַיָּאִיצוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים בְּלוֹט לֵאמֹר קוּם קַח אֶת אִשְׁתְּךָ וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי בְנֹתֶיךָ הַנִּמְצָאֹת פֶּן תִּסָּפֶה בַּעֲוֺן הָעִיר׃

english.text:
And as the dawn rose the angels urged Lot, saying, “Get
up, take your wife and your two daughters who are present,
or else you’ll be annihilated for the city’s crime.”

translation.text: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.

verses.english:
And as the dawn rose the angels urged Lot, saying, “Get
up, take your wife and your two daughters who are present,
or else you’ll be annihilated for the city’s crime.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְמַהְמָהּ וַיַּחֲזִיקוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים בְּיָדוֹ וּבְיַד אִשְׁתּוֹ וּבְיַד שְׁתֵּי בְנֹתָיו בְּחֶמְלַת יְהֹוָה עָלָיו וַיֹּצִאֻהוּ וַיַּנִּחֻהוּ מִחוּץ לָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְמַהְמָהּ וַיַּחֲזִיקוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים בְּיָדוֹ וּבְיַד אִשְׁתּוֹ וּבְיַד שְׁתֵּי בְנֹתָיו בְּחֶמְלַת יְהֹוָה עָלָיו וַיֹּצִאֻהוּ וַיַּנִּחֻהוּ מִחוּץ לָעִיר׃

english.text:
And he delayed. And the people took hold of his hand and
his wife’s hand and his two daughters’ hands because of
YHWH’s compassion for him, and they brought him out and
set him outside the city.

translation.text: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.

verses.english:
And he delayed. And the people took hold of his hand and
his wife’s hand and his two daughters’ hands because of
YHWH’s compassion for him, and they brought him out and
set him outside the city.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְהוֹצִיאָם אֹתָם הַחוּצָה וַיֹּאמֶר הִמָּלֵט עַל נַפְשֶׁךָ אַל תַּבִּיט אַחֲרֶיךָ וְאַל תַּעֲמֹד בְּכל הַכִּכָּר הָהָרָה הִמָּלֵט פֶּן תִּסָּפֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְהוֹצִיאָם אֹתָם הַחוּצָה וַיֹּאמֶר הִמָּלֵט עַל נַפְשֶׁךָ אַל תַּבִּיט אַחֲרֶיךָ וְאַל תַּעֲמֹד בְּכל הַכִּכָּר הָהָרָה הִמָּלֵט פֶּן תִּסָּפֶה׃

english.text:
And it was as they were bringing them outside, and He
said, “Escape for your life. Don’t look behind you and
don’t stop in all of the plain. Escape to the mountain or
else you’ll be annihilated.”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.

verses.english:
And it was as they were bringing them outside, and He
said, “Escape for your life. Don’t look behind you and
don’t stop in all of the plain. Escape to the mountain or
else you’ll be annihilated.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹט אֲלֵהֶם אַל נָא אֲדֹנָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹט אֲלֵהֶם אַל נָא אֲדֹנָי׃

english.text: And Lot said to them, “Let it not be, my Lord.

translation.text: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my LORD:

verses.english: And Lot said to them, “Let it not be, my Lord.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה נָא מָצָא עַבְדְּךָ חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וַתַּגְדֵּל חַסְדְּךָ אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ עִמָּדִי לְהַחֲיוֹת אֶת נַפְשִׁי וְאָנֹכִי לֹא אוּכַל לְהִמָּלֵט הָהָרָה פֶּן תִּדְבָּקַנִי הָרָעָה וָמַתִּי׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה נָא מָצָא עַבְדְּךָ חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וַתַּגְדֵּל חַסְדְּךָ אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ עִמָּדִי לְהַחֲיוֹת אֶת נַפְשִׁי וְאָנֹכִי לֹא אוּכַל לְהִמָּלֵט הָהָרָה פֶּן תִּדְבָּקַנִי הָרָעָה וָמַתִּי׃

english.text:
Here, your servant has found favor in your eyes, and
you’ve magnified your kindness that you’ve done for me,
keeping my soul alive, and I’m not able to escape to the
mountain, in case the bad thing will cling to me and I’ll
die.

translation.text: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:

verses.english:
Here, your servant has found favor in your eyes, and
you’ve magnified your kindness that you’ve done for me,
keeping my soul alive, and I’m not able to escape to the
mountain, in case the bad thing will cling to me and I’ll
die.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה נָא הָעִיר הַזֹּאת קְרֹבָה לָנוּס שָׁמָּה וְהִוא מִצְעָר אִמָּלְטָה נָּא שָׁמָּה הֲלֹא מִצְעָר הִוא וּתְחִי נַפְשִׁי׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה נָא הָעִיר הַזֹּאת קְרֹבָה לָנוּס שָׁמָּה וְהִוא מִצְעָר אִמָּלְטָה נָּא שָׁמָּה הֲלֹא מִצְעָר הִוא וּתְחִי נַפְשִׁי׃

english.text:
Here, this city is close to flee there, and it’s small.
Let me escape there—isn’t it small?—and my soul will
live.”

translation.text: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.

verses.english:
Here, this city is close to flee there, and it’s small.
Let me escape there—isn’t it small?—and my soul will
live.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה נָשָׂאתִי פָנֶיךָ גַּם לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְבִלְתִּי הפְכִּי אֶת הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה נָשָׂאתִי פָנֶיךָ גַּם לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְבִלְתִּי הפְכִּי אֶת הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ׃

english.text:
And He said to him, “Here, I’ve granted you this thing,
too, that I won’t overturn the city of which you spoke.

translation.text: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.

verses.english:
And He said to him, “Here, I’ve granted you this thing,
too, that I won’t overturn the city of which you spoke.

verses.hebrew: מַהֵר הִמָּלֵט שָׁמָּה כִּי לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲשׂוֹת דָּבָר עַד בֹּאֲךָ שָׁמָּה עַל כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם הָעִיר צוֹעַר׃

hebrew.text: מַהֵר הִמָּלֵט שָׁמָּה כִּי לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲשׂוֹת דָּבָר עַד בֹּאֲךָ שָׁמָּה עַל כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם הָעִיר צוֹעַר׃

english.text:
Quickly, escape there, because I can’t do a thing until
you get there.” On account of this the city’s name was
called Zoar.

translation.text: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do anything till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

verses.english:
Quickly, escape there, because I can’t do a thing until
you get there.” On account of this the city’s name was
called Zoar.

verses.hebrew: הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יָצָא עַל הָאָרֶץ וְלוֹט בָּא צֹעֲרָה׃

hebrew.text: הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יָצָא עַל הָאָרֶץ וְלוֹט בָּא צֹעֲרָה׃

english.text: The sun rose on the earth, and Lot came to Zoar.

translation.text: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.

verses.english: The sun rose on the earth, and Lot came to Zoar.

verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה הִמְטִיר עַל סְדֹם וְעַל עֲמֹרָה גּפְרִית וָאֵשׁ מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה מִן הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה הִמְטִיר עַל סְדֹם וְעַל עֲמֹרָה גּפְרִית וָאֵשׁ מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה מִן הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
And YHWH rained brimstone and fire on Sodom and on
Gomorrah, from YHWH out of the skies.

translation.text: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;

verses.english:
And YHWH rained brimstone and fire on Sodom and on
Gomorrah, from YHWH out of the skies.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּהֲפֹךְ אֶת הֶעָרִים הָאֵל וְאֵת כּל הַכִּכָּר וְאֵת כּל יֹשְׁבֵי הֶעָרִים וְצֶמַח הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּהֲפֹךְ אֶת הֶעָרִים הָאֵל וְאֵת כּל הַכִּכָּר וְאֵת כּל יֹשְׁבֵי הֶעָרִים וְצֶמַח הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
And He overturned these cities and all of the plain and
all of the residents of the cities and all the growth of
the ground.

translation.text: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.

verses.english:
And He overturned these cities and all of the plain and
all of the residents of the cities and all the growth of
the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּבֵּט אִשְׁתּוֹ מֵאַחֲרָיו וַתְּהִי נְצִיב מֶלַח׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּבֵּט אִשְׁתּוֹ מֵאַחֲרָיו וַתְּהִי נְצִיב מֶלַח׃

english.text:
And his wife looked behind him, and she was a pillar of
salt!

translation.text: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

verses.english:
And his wife looked behind him, and she was a pillar of
salt!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אַבְרָהָם בַּבֹּקֶר אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר עָמַד שָׁם אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אַבְרָהָם בַּבֹּקֶר אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר עָמַד שָׁם אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where
he had stood in YHWH’s presence,

translation.text: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD:

verses.english:
And Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where
he had stood in YHWH’s presence,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁקֵף עַל פְּנֵי סְדֹם וַעֲמֹרָה וְעַל כּל פְּנֵי אֶרֶץ הַכִּכָּר וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה עָלָה קִיטֹר הָאָרֶץ כְּקִיטֹר הַכִּבְשָׁן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁקֵף עַל פְּנֵי סְדֹם וַעֲמֹרָה וְעַל כּל פְּנֵי אֶרֶץ הַכִּכָּר וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה עָלָה קִיטֹר הָאָרֶץ כְּקִיטֹר הַכִּבְשָׁן׃

english.text:
and he gazed at the sight of Sodom and Gomorrah and at the
sight of all the land of the plain. And he saw: and, here,
the smoke of the land went up like the smoke of a furnace.

translation.text: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.

verses.english:
and he gazed at the sight of Sodom and Gomorrah and at the
sight of all the land of the plain. And he saw: and, here,
the smoke of the land went up like the smoke of a furnace.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּשַׁחֵת אֱלֹהִים אֶת עָרֵי הַכִּכָּר וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת אַבְרָהָם וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת לוֹט מִתּוֹךְ הַהֲפֵכָה בַּהֲפֹךְ אֶת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁב בָּהֵן לוֹט׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּשַׁחֵת אֱלֹהִים אֶת עָרֵי הַכִּכָּר וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת אַבְרָהָם וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת לוֹט מִתּוֹךְ הַהֲפֵכָה בַּהֲפֹךְ אֶת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁב בָּהֵן לוֹט׃

english.text:
And it was, when God destroyed the cities of the plain,
