that God remembered Abraham and let Lot go from inside the
overthrow: at the overthrowing of the cities in which Lot
lived.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.

verses.english:
And it was, when God destroyed the cities of the plain,
that God remembered Abraham and let Lot go from inside the
overthrow: at the overthrowing of the cities in which Lot
lived.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל לוֹט מִצּוֹעַר וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהָר וּשְׁתֵּי בְנֹתָיו עִמּוֹ כִּי יָרֵא לָשֶׁבֶת בְּצוֹעַר וַיֵּשֶׁב בַּמְּעָרָה הוּא וּשְׁתֵּי בְנֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל לוֹט מִצּוֹעַר וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהָר וּשְׁתֵּי בְנֹתָיו עִמּוֹ כִּי יָרֵא לָשֶׁבֶת בְּצוֹעַר וַיֵּשֶׁב בַּמְּעָרָה הוּא וּשְׁתֵּי בְנֹתָיו׃

english.text:
And Lot went up from Zoar and lived in the mountain, and
his two daughters with him, because he feared to live in
Zoar, and he lived in a cave, he and his two daughters.

translation.text: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.

verses.english:
And Lot went up from Zoar and lived in the mountain, and
his two daughters with him, because he feared to live in
Zoar, and he lived in a cave, he and his two daughters.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הַבְּכִירָה אֶל הַצְּעִירָה אָבִינוּ זָקֵן וְאִישׁ אֵין בָּאָרֶץ לָבוֹא עָלֵינוּ כְּדֶרֶךְ כּל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר הַבְּכִירָה אֶל הַצְּעִירָה אָבִינוּ זָקֵן וְאִישׁ אֵין בָּאָרֶץ לָבוֹא עָלֵינוּ כְּדֶרֶךְ כּל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And the firstborn said to the younger one, “Our father is
old, and there’s no man in the earth to come to us in the
way of all the earth.

translation.text: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:

verses.english:
And the firstborn said to the younger one, “Our father is
old, and there’s no man in the earth to come to us in the
way of all the earth.

verses.hebrew: לְכָה נַשְׁקֶה אֶת אָבִינוּ יַיִן וְנִשְׁכְּבָה עִמּוֹ וּנְחַיֶּה מֵאָבִינוּ זָרַע׃

hebrew.text: לְכָה נַשְׁקֶה אֶת אָבִינוּ יַיִן וְנִשְׁכְּבָה עִמּוֹ וּנְחַיֶּה מֵאָבִינוּ זָרַע׃

english.text:
Come on, let’s make our father drink wine, and let’s lie
with him and make seed live from our father.”

translation.text: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

verses.english:
Come on, let’s make our father drink wine, and let’s lie
with him and make seed live from our father.”

verses.hebrew: וַתַּשְׁקֶיןָ אֶת אֲבִיהֶן יַיִן בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא וַתָּבֹא הַבְּכִירָה וַתִּשְׁכַּב אֶת אָבִיהָ וְלֹא יָדַע בְּשִׁכְבָהּ וּבְקוּמָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּשְׁקֶיןָ אֶת אֲבִיהֶן יַיִן בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא וַתָּבֹא הַבְּכִירָה וַתִּשְׁכַּב אֶת אָבִיהָ וְלֹא יָדַע בְּשִׁכְבָהּ וּבְקוּמָהּ׃

english.text:
And they made their father drink wine in that night, and
the firstborn came and lay with her father. And he did not
know of her lying down and her getting up.

translation.text: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

verses.english:
And they made their father drink wine in that night, and
the firstborn came and lay with her father. And he did not
know of her lying down and her getting up.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַתֹּאמֶר הַבְּכִירָה אֶל הַצְּעִירָה הֵן שָׁכַבְתִּי אֶמֶשׁ אֶת אָבִי נַשְׁקֶנּוּ יַיִן גַּם הַלַּיְלָה וּבֹאִי שִׁכְבִי עִמּוֹ וּנְחַיֶּה מֵאָבִינוּ זָרַע׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַתֹּאמֶר הַבְּכִירָה אֶל הַצְּעִירָה הֵן שָׁכַבְתִּי אֶמֶשׁ אֶת אָבִי נַשְׁקֶנּוּ יַיִן גַּם הַלַּיְלָה וּבֹאִי שִׁכְבִי עִמּוֹ וּנְחַיֶּה מֵאָבִינוּ זָרַע׃

english.text:
And it was on the next day, and the firstborn said to the
younger one, “Here, I lay with my father last night. Let’s
make him drink wine tonight as well, and you come and lie
with him, and we’ll make seed live from our father.”

translation.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

verses.english:
And it was on the next day, and the firstborn said to the
younger one, “Here, I lay with my father last night. Let’s
make him drink wine tonight as well, and you come and lie
with him, and we’ll make seed live from our father.”

verses.hebrew: וַתַּשְׁקֶיןָ גַּם בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא אֶת אֲבִיהֶן יָיִן וַתָּקם הַצְּעִירָה וַתִּשְׁכַּב עִמּוֹ וְלֹא יָדַע בְּשִׁכְבָהּ וּבְקֻמָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּשְׁקֶיןָ גַּם בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא אֶת אֲבִיהֶן יָיִן וַתָּקם הַצְּעִירָה וַתִּשְׁכַּב עִמּוֹ וְלֹא יָדַע בְּשִׁכְבָהּ וּבְקֻמָהּ׃

english.text:
And they made their father drink wine in that night as
well, and the younger one got up and lay with him, and he
did not know of her lying down and her getting up.

translation.text: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

verses.english:
And they made their father drink wine in that night as
well, and the younger one got up and lay with him, and he
did not know of her lying down and her getting up.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהֲרֶיןָ שְׁתֵּי בְנוֹת לוֹט מֵאֲבִיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהֲרֶיןָ שְׁתֵּי בְנוֹת לוֹט מֵאֲבִיהֶן׃

english.text: And Lot’s two daughters became pregnant by their father.

translation.text: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.

verses.english: And Lot’s two daughters became pregnant by their father.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד הַבְּכִירָה בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ מוֹאָב הוּא אֲבִי מוֹאָב עַד הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד הַבְּכִירָה בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ מוֹאָב הוּא אֲבִי מוֹאָב עַד הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And the firstborn gave birth to a son and called his name
Moab. He is the father of Moab to this day.

translation.text: And the first born bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.

verses.english:
And the firstborn gave birth to a son and called his name
Moab. He is the father of Moab to this day.

verses.hebrew: וְהַצְּעִירָה גַם הִוא יָלְדָה בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ בֶּן עַמִּי הוּא אֲבִי בְנֵי עַמּוֹן עַד הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַצְּעִירָה גַם הִוא יָלְדָה בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ בֶּן עַמִּי הוּא אֲבִי בְנֵי עַמּוֹן עַד הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And the younger one, she too gave birth to a son and
called his name ben-Ammi. He is the father of the children
of Ammon to this day.

translation.text: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.

verses.english:
And the younger one, she too gave birth to a son and
called his name ben-Ammi. He is the father of the children
of Ammon to this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסַּע מִשָּׁם אַבְרָהָם אַרְצָה הַנֶּגֶב וַיֵּשֶׁב בֵּין קָדֵשׁ וּבֵין שׁוּר וַיָּגר בִּגְרָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסַּע מִשָּׁם אַבְרָהָם אַרְצָה הַנֶּגֶב וַיֵּשֶׁב בֵּין קָדֵשׁ וּבֵין שׁוּר וַיָּגר בִּגְרָר׃

english.text:
And Abraham traveled from there to the Negeb country
and lived between Kadesh and Shur and resided in Gerar.

translation.text: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.

verses.english:
And Abraham traveled from there to the Negeb country
and lived between Kadesh and Shur and resided in Gerar.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֶל שָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ אֲחֹתִי הִוא וַיִּשְׁלַח אֲבִימֶלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ גְּרָר וַיִּקַּח אֶת שָׂרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֶל שָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ אֲחֹתִי הִוא וַיִּשְׁלַח אֲבִימֶלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ גְּרָר וַיִּקַּח אֶת שָׂרָה׃

english.text:
And Abraham said of Sarah, his wife, “She’s my sister.”
And Abimelek, king of Gerar, sent and took Sarah.

translation.text: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

verses.english:
And Abraham said of Sarah, his wife, “She’s my sister.”
And Abimelek, king of Gerar, sent and took Sarah.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בַּחֲלוֹם הַלָּיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הִנְּךָ מֵת עַל הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר לָקַחְתָּ וְהִוא בְּעֻלַת בָּעַל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בַּחֲלוֹם הַלָּיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הִנְּךָ מֵת עַל הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר לָקַחְתָּ וְהִוא בְּעֻלַת בָּעַל׃

english.text:
And God came to Abimelek in a night dream and said to him,
“Here, you’re dead over the woman whom you took, for she’s
a man’s wife!”

translation.text: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man’s wife.

verses.english:
And God came to Abimelek in a night dream and said to him,
“Here, you’re dead over the woman whom you took, for she’s
a man’s wife!”

verses.hebrew: וַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ לֹא קָרַב אֵלֶיהָ וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי הֲגוֹי גַּם צַדִּיק תַּהֲרֹג׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ לֹא קָרַב אֵלֶיהָ וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי הֲגוֹי גַּם צַדִּיק תַּהֲרֹג׃

english.text:
And Abimelek had not come close to her, and he said, “My
Lord, will you kill a virtuous nation as well?

translation.text: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, LORD, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?

verses.english:
And Abimelek had not come close to her, and he said, “My
Lord, will you kill a virtuous nation as well?

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא הוּא אָמַר לִי אֲחֹתִי הִוא וְהִיא גַם הִוא אָמְרָה אָחִי הוּא בְּתם לְבָבִי וּבְנִקְיֹן כַּפַּי עָשִׂיתִי זֹאת׃

hebrew.text: הֲלֹא הוּא אָמַר לִי אֲחֹתִי הִוא וְהִיא גַם הִוא אָמְרָה אָחִי הוּא בְּתם לְבָבִי וּבְנִקְיֹן כַּפַּי עָשִׂיתִי זֹאת׃

english.text:
Didn’t he say to me, ‘She’s my sister’? And she—she,
too—said, ‘He’s my brother.’ I did this in my heart’s
innocence and in my hands’ cleanness.”

translation.text: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.

verses.english:
Didn’t he say to me, ‘She’s my sister’? And she—she,
too—said, ‘He’s my brother.’ I did this in my heart’s
innocence and in my hands’ cleanness.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הָאֱלֹהִים בַּחֲלֹם גַּם אָנֹכִי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי בְתם לְבָבְךָ עָשִׂיתָ זֹּאת וָאֶחְשֹׂךְ גַּם אָנֹכִי אוֹתְךָ מֵחֲטוֹ לִי עַל כֵּן לֹא נְתַתִּיךָ לִנְגֹּעַ אֵלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הָאֱלֹהִים בַּחֲלֹם גַּם אָנֹכִי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי בְתם לְבָבְךָ עָשִׂיתָ זֹּאת וָאֶחְשֹׂךְ גַּם אָנֹכִי אוֹתְךָ מֵחֲטוֹ לִי עַל כֵּן לֹא נְתַתִּיךָ לִנְגֹּעַ אֵלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And God said to him in the dream, “I, too, knew that you
did this in your heart’s innocence; and I, too, held you
back from sinning against me. On account of this, I didn’t
let you touch her.

translation.text: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.

verses.english:
And God said to him in the dream, “I, too, knew that you
did this in your heart’s innocence; and I, too, held you
back from sinning against me. On account of this, I didn’t
let you touch her.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הָשֵׁב אֵשֶׁת הָאִישׁ כִּי נָבִיא הוּא וְיִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעַדְךָ וֶחְיֵה וְאִם אֵינְךָ מֵשִׁיב דַּע כִּי מוֹת תָּמוּת אַתָּה וְכל אֲשֶׁר לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הָשֵׁב אֵשֶׁת הָאִישׁ כִּי נָבִיא הוּא וְיִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעַדְךָ וֶחְיֵה וְאִם אֵינְךָ מֵשִׁיב דַּע כִּי מוֹת תָּמוּת אַתָּה וְכל אֲשֶׁר לָךְ׃

english.text:
And now, give the man’s wife back, because he’s a prophet,
and he’ll pray for you. And live! And if you don’t give
back, know that you will die, you and all that you have.”

translation.text: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.

verses.english:
And now, give the man’s wife back, because he’s a prophet,
and he’ll pray for you. And live! And if you don’t give
back, know that you will die, you and all that you have.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּקְרָא לְכל עֲבָדָיו וַיְדַבֵּר אֶת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּאזְנֵיהֶם וַיִּירְאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּקְרָא לְכל עֲבָדָיו וַיְדַבֵּר אֶת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּאזְנֵיהֶם וַיִּירְאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And Abimelek got up in the morning and called to all his
servants and spoke all these things in their ears, and the
people were very afraid.

translation.text: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.

verses.english:
And Abimelek got up in the morning and called to all his
servants and spoke all these things in their ears, and the
people were very afraid.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֲבִימֶלֶךְ לְאַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מֶה עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ וּמֶה חָטָאתִי לָךְ כִּי הֵבֵאתָ עָלַי וְעַל מַמְלַכְתִּי חֲטָאָה גְדֹלָה מַעֲשִׂים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יֵעָשׂוּ עָשִׂיתָ עִמָּדִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֲבִימֶלֶךְ לְאַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מֶה עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ וּמֶה חָטָאתִי לָךְ כִּי הֵבֵאתָ עָלַי וְעַל מַמְלַכְתִּי חֲטָאָה גְדֹלָה מַעֲשִׂים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יֵעָשׂוּ עָשִׂיתָ עִמָּדִי׃

english.text:
And Abimelek called Abraham and said to him, “What have
you done to us, and how did I sin against you, that you
brought a big sin over me and over my kingdom? You’ve done
things with me that are not done!”

translation.text: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.

verses.english:
And Abimelek called Abraham and said to him, “What have
you done to us, and how did I sin against you, that you
brought a big sin over me and over my kingdom? You’ve done
things with me that are not done!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶל אַבְרָהָם מָה רָאִיתָ כִּי עָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶל אַבְרָהָם מָה רָאִיתָ כִּי עָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And Abimelek said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you
did this thing?”

translation.text: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?

verses.english:
And Abimelek said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you
did this thing?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם כִּי אָמַרְתִּי רַק אֵין יִרְאַת אֱלֹהִים בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וַהֲרָגוּנִי עַל דְּבַר אִשְׁתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם כִּי אָמַרְתִּי רַק אֵין יִרְאַת אֱלֹהִים בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וַהֲרָגוּנִי עַל דְּבַר אִשְׁתִּי׃

english.text:
And Abraham said, “Because I said, There just isn’t the
fear of God in this place, and they’ll kill me on account
of my wife.’

translation.text: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife’s sake.

verses.english:
And Abraham said, “Because I said, There just isn’t the
fear of God in this place, and they’ll kill me on account
of my wife.’

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אמְנָה אֲחֹתִי בַת אָבִי הִוא אַךְ לֹא בַת אִמִּי וַתְּהִי לִי לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אמְנָה אֲחֹתִי בַת אָבִי הִוא אַךְ לֹא בַת אִמִּי וַתְּהִי לִי לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
And also she is, in fact, my sister, my father’s daughter
but not my mother’s daughter, and she became a wife to me.

translation.text: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

verses.english:
And also she is, in fact, my sister, my father’s daughter
but not my mother’s daughter, and she became a wife to me.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר הִתְעוּ אֹתִי אֱלֹהִים מִבֵּית אָבִי וָאֹמַר לָהּ זֶה חַסְדֵּךְ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשִׂי עִמָּדִי אֶל כּל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר נָבוֹא שָׁמָּה אִמְרִי לִי אָחִי הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר הִתְעוּ אֹתִי אֱלֹהִים מִבֵּית אָבִי וָאֹמַר לָהּ זֶה חַסְדֵּךְ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשִׂי עִמָּדִי אֶל כּל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר נָבוֹא שָׁמָּה אִמְרִי לִי אָחִי הוּא׃

english.text:
And it was when God had me roam from my father’s house,
and I said to her, This will be your kindness that you’ll
do with me: to every place where we come, say about me,
“He’s my brother.”‘”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.

verses.english:
And it was when God had me roam from my father’s house,
and I said to her, This will be your kindness that you’ll
do with me: to every place where we come, say about me,
“He’s my brother.”‘”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֲבִימֶלֶךְ צֹאן וּבָקָר וַעֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחֹת וַיִּתֵּן לְאַבְרָהָם וַיָּשֶׁב לוֹ אֵת שָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֲבִימֶלֶךְ צֹאן וּבָקָר וַעֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחֹת וַיִּתֵּן לְאַבְרָהָם וַיָּשֶׁב לוֹ אֵת שָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Abimelek took sheep and oxen and servants and maids,
and he gave them to Abraham, and he gave Sarah, his wife,
back to him.

translation.text: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.

verses.english:
And Abimelek took sheep and oxen and servants and maids,
and he gave them to Abraham, and he gave Sarah, his wife,
back to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ הִנֵּה אַרְצִי לְפָנֶיךָ בַּטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ שֵׁב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ הִנֵּה אַרְצִי לְפָנֶיךָ בַּטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ שֵׁב׃

english.text:
And Abimelek said, “Here’s my land in front of you. Live
wherever it’s good in your eyes.”

translation.text: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.

verses.english:
And Abimelek said, “Here’s my land in front of you. Live
wherever it’s good in your eyes.”

verses.hebrew: וּלְשָׂרָה אָמַר הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי אֶלֶף כֶּסֶף לְאָחִיךְ הִנֵּה הוּא לָךְ כְּסוּת עֵינַיִם לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר אִתָּךְ וְאֵת כֹּל וְנֹכָחַת׃

hebrew.text: וּלְשָׂרָה אָמַר הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי אֶלֶף כֶּסֶף לְאָחִיךְ הִנֵּה הוּא לָךְ כְּסוּת עֵינַיִם לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר אִתָּךְ וְאֵת כֹּל וְנֹכָחַת׃

english.text:
And to Sarah he said, “Here, I’ve given a thousand weights
of silver to your brother. Here, it’s a covering of eyes
for you with everyone with you, and you’re justified with
everyone.”

translation.text: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.

verses.english:
And to Sarah he said, “Here, I’ve given a thousand weights
of silver to your brother. Here, it’s a covering of eyes
for you with everyone with you, and you’re justified with
everyone.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אַבְרָהָם אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּרְפָּא אֱלֹהִים אֶת אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְאֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאַמְהֹתָיו וַיֵּלֵדוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אַבְרָהָם אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּרְפָּא אֱלֹהִים אֶת אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְאֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאַמְהֹתָיו וַיֵּלֵדוּ׃

english.text:
And Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelek and his
wife and his maids, and they gave birth,

translation.text: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children.

verses.english:
And Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelek and his
wife and his maids, and they gave birth,

verses.hebrew: כִּי עָצֹר עָצַר יְהֹוָה בְּעַד כּל רֶחֶם לְבֵית אֲבִימֶלֶךְ עַל דְּבַר שָׂרָה אֵשֶׁת אַבְרָהָם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי עָצֹר עָצַר יְהֹוָה בְּעַד כּל רֶחֶם לְבֵית אֲבִימֶלֶךְ עַל דְּבַר שָׂרָה אֵשֶׁת אַבְרָהָם׃

english.text:
because YHWH had held back every womb of Abimelek’s house
on account of Sarah, Abraham’s wife!

translation.text: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham’s wife.

verses.english:
because YHWH had held back every womb of Abimelek’s house
on account of Sarah, Abraham’s wife!

verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה פָּקַד אֶת שָׂרָה כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמָר וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה לְשָׂרָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה פָּקַד אֶת שָׂרָה כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמָר וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה לְשָׂרָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃

english.text:
And YHWH took account of Sarah as He had said, and YHWH
did to Sarah as He had spoken.

translation.text: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.

verses.english:
And YHWH took account of Sarah as He had said, and YHWH
did to Sarah as He had spoken.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד שָׂרָה לְאַבְרָהָם בֵּן לִזְקֻנָיו לַמּוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד שָׂרָה לְאַבְרָהָם בֵּן לִזְקֻנָיו לַמּוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And Sarah became pregnant and gave birth to a son for
Abraham in his old age at the appointed time that God had
spoken.

translation.text: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

verses.english:
And Sarah became pregnant and gave birth to a son for
Abraham in his old age at the appointed time that God had
spoken.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אַבְרָהָם אֶת שֶׁם בְּנוֹ הַנּוֹלַד לוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לּוֹ שָׂרָה יִצְחָק׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אַבְרָהָם אֶת שֶׁם בְּנוֹ הַנּוֹלַד לוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לּוֹ שָׂרָה יִצְחָק׃

english.text:
And Abraham called the name of his son who was born to
him, to whom Sarah had given birth for him: Isaac.

translation.text: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.

verses.english:
And Abraham called the name of his son who was born to
him, to whom Sarah had given birth for him: Isaac.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמל אַבְרָהָם אֶת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ בֶּן שְׁמֹנַת יָמִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמל אַבְרָהָם אֶת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ בֶּן שְׁמֹנַת יָמִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And Abraham circumcised Isaac, his son, at eight days old,
as God had commanded him.

translation.text: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.

verses.english:
And Abraham circumcised Isaac, his son, at eight days old,
as God had commanded him.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְרָהָם בֶּן מְאַת שָׁנָה בְּהִוָּלֶד לוֹ אֵת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַבְרָהָם בֶּן מְאַת שָׁנָה בְּהִוָּלֶד לוֹ אֵת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ׃

english.text:
And Abraham was a hundred years old when Isaac, his son,
was born to him.

translation.text: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.

verses.english:
And Abraham was a hundred years old when Isaac, his son,
was born to him.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר שָׂרָה צְחֹק עָשָׂה לִי אֱלֹהִים כּל הַשֹּׁמֵעַ יִצְחַק לִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר שָׂרָה צְחֹק עָשָׂה לִי אֱלֹהִים כּל הַשֹּׁמֵעַ יִצְחַק לִי׃

english.text:
And Sarah said, “God has made laughter for me. Everyone
who hears will laugh for me.”

translation.text: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.

verses.english:
And Sarah said, “God has made laughter for me. Everyone
who hears will laugh for me.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר מִי מִלֵּל לְאַבְרָהָם הֵינִיקָה בָנִים שָׂרָה כִּי יָלַדְתִּי בֵן לִזְקֻנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר מִי מִלֵּל לְאַבְרָהָם הֵינִיקָה בָנִים שָׂרָה כִּי יָלַדְתִּי בֵן לִזְקֻנָיו׃

english.text:
And she said, “Who would have said to Abraham, ‘Sarah has
nursed children’? Yet I’ve given birth to a son in his old
age.”

translation.text: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.

verses.english:
And she said, “Who would have said to Abraham, ‘Sarah has
nursed children’? Yet I’ve given birth to a son in his old
age.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְדַּל הַיֶּלֶד וַיִּגָּמַל וַיַּעַשׂ אַבְרָהָם מִשְׁתֶּה גָדוֹל בְּיוֹם הִגָּמֵל אֶת יִצְחָק׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְדַּל הַיֶּלֶד וַיִּגָּמַל וַיַּעַשׂ אַבְרָהָם מִשְׁתֶּה גָדוֹל בְּיוֹם הִגָּמֵל אֶת יִצְחָק׃

english.text:
And the boy grew and was weaned. And Abraham made a big
feast in the day that Isaac was weaned.

translation.text: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.

verses.english:
And the boy grew and was weaned. And Abraham made a big
feast in the day that Isaac was weaned.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא שָׂרָה אֶת בֶּן הָגָר הַמִּצְרִית אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְאַבְרָהָם מְצַחֵק׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרֶא שָׂרָה אֶת בֶּן הָגָר הַמִּצְרִית אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְאַבְרָהָם מְצַחֵק׃

english.text:
And Sarah saw the son of Hagar, the Egyptian, whom she had
borne to Abraham, fooling around.

translation.text: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.

verses.english:
And Sarah saw the son of Hagar, the Egyptian, whom she had
borne to Abraham, fooling around.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לְאַבְרָהָם גָּרֵשׁ הָאָמָה הַזֹּאת וְאֶת בְּנָהּ כִּי לֹא יִירַשׁ בֶּן הָאָמָה הַזֹּאת עִם בְּנִי עִם יִצְחָק׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לְאַבְרָהָם גָּרֵשׁ הָאָמָה הַזֹּאת וְאֶת בְּנָהּ כִּי לֹא יִירַשׁ בֶּן הָאָמָה הַזֹּאת עִם בְּנִי עִם יִצְחָק׃

english.text:
And she said to Abraham, “Drive this maid out—and her son,
because the son of this maid will not inherit with my son,
with Isaac.”

translation.text: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.

verses.english:
And she said to Abraham, “Drive this maid out—and her son,
because the son of this maid will not inherit with my son,
with Isaac.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרַע הַדָּבָר מְאֹד בְּעֵינֵי אַבְרָהָם עַל אוֹדֹת בְּנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרַע הַדָּבָר מְאֹד בְּעֵינֵי אַבְרָהָם עַל אוֹדֹת בְּנוֹ׃

english.text:
And the thing was very bad in Abraham’s eyes in regard to
his son.

translation.text: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight because of his son.

verses.english:
And the thing was very bad in Abraham’s eyes in regard to
his son.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל אַבְרָהָם אַל יֵרַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ עַל הַנַּעַר וְעַל אֲמָתֶךָ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַר אֵלֶיךָ שָׂרָה שְׁמַע בְּקֹלָהּ כִּי בְיִצְחָק יִקָּרֵא לְךָ זָרַע׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל אַבְרָהָם אַל יֵרַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ עַל הַנַּעַר וְעַל אֲמָתֶךָ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַר אֵלֶיךָ שָׂרָה שְׁמַע בְּקֹלָהּ כִּי בְיִצְחָק יִקָּרֵא לְךָ זָרַע׃

english.text:
And God said to Abraham, “Let it not be bad in your eyes
about the boy and about your maid. Everything that Sarah
tells you: listen to her voice; because seed for you will
be called by Isaac.

translation.text: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.

verses.english:
And God said to Abraham, “Let it not be bad in your eyes
about the boy and about your maid. Everything that Sarah
tells you: listen to her voice; because seed for you will
be called by Isaac.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֶת בֶּן הָאָמָה לְגוֹי אֲשִׂימֶנּוּ כִּי זַרְעֲךָ הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אֶת בֶּן הָאָמָה לְגוֹי אֲשִׂימֶנּוּ כִּי זַרְעֲךָ הוּא׃

english.text:
And I’ll make the maid’s son into a nation as well,
because he’s your seed.”

translation.text: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.

verses.english:
And I’ll make the maid’s son into a nation as well,
because he’s your seed.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אַבְרָהָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּקַּח לֶחֶם וְחֵמַת מַיִם וַיִּתֵּן אֶל הָגָר שָׂם עַל שִׁכְמָהּ וְאֶת הַיֶּלֶד וַיְשַׁלְּחֶהָ וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתֵּתַע בְּמִדְבַּר בְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אַבְרָהָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּקַּח לֶחֶם וְחֵמַת מַיִם וַיִּתֵּן אֶל הָגָר שָׂם עַל שִׁכְמָהּ וְאֶת הַיֶּלֶד וַיְשַׁלְּחֶהָ וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתֵּתַע בְּמִדְבַּר בְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃

english.text:
And Abraham got up early in the morning and took bread and
a bottle of water and gave to Hagar—he put them on her
shoulder—and the boy and he sent her off. And she went and
strayed in the Beer-sheba wilderness.

translation.text: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

verses.english:
And Abraham got up early in the morning and took bread and
a bottle of water and gave to Hagar—he put them on her
shoulder—and the boy and he sent her off. And she went and
strayed in the Beer-sheba wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְלוּ הַמַּיִם מִן הַחֵמֶת וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶת הַיֶּלֶד תַּחַת אַחַד הַשִּׂיחִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְלוּ הַמַּיִם מִן הַחֵמֶת וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶת הַיֶּלֶד תַּחַת אַחַד הַשִּׂיחִם׃

english.text:
And the water was finished from the bottle, and she thrust
the boy under one of the shrubs,

translation.text: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.

verses.english:
And the water was finished from the bottle, and she thrust
the boy under one of the shrubs,

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתֵּשֶׁב לָהּ מִנֶּגֶד הַרְחֵק כִּמְטַחֲוֵי קֶשֶׁת כִּי אָמְרָה אַל אֶרְאֶה בְּמוֹת הַיָּלֶד וַתֵּשֶׁב מִנֶּגֶד וַתִּשָּׂא אֶת קֹלָהּ וַתֵּבְךְּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתֵּשֶׁב לָהּ מִנֶּגֶד הַרְחֵק כִּמְטַחֲוֵי קֶשֶׁת כִּי אָמְרָה אַל אֶרְאֶה בְּמוֹת הַיָּלֶד וַתֵּשֶׁב מִנֶּגֶד וַתִּשָּׂא אֶת קֹלָהּ וַתֵּבְךְּ׃

english.text:
and she went and sat opposite, going as far as a bow-shot,
because she said, “Let me not see the boy’s death.” And
she sat opposite and raised her voice and wept.

translation.text: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bow shot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.

verses.english:
and she went and sat opposite, going as far as a bow-shot,
because she said, “Let me not see the boy’s death.” And
she sat opposite and raised her voice and wept.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת קוֹל הַנַּעַר וַיִּקְרָא מַלְאַךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶל הָגָר מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מַה לָּךְ הָגָר אַל תִּירְאִי כִּי שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶל קוֹל הַנַּעַר בַּאֲשֶׁר הוּא שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת קוֹל הַנַּעַר וַיִּקְרָא מַלְאַךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶל הָגָר מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מַה לָּךְ הָגָר אַל תִּירְאִי כִּי שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶל קוֹל הַנַּעַר בַּאֲשֶׁר הוּא שָׁם׃

english.text:
And God heard the boy’s voice. And an angel of God called
to Hagar from the heavens and said to her, “What trouble
do you have, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. Because God has heard
the boy’s voice where he is.

translation.text: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.

verses.english:
And God heard the boy’s voice. And an angel of God called
to Hagar from the heavens and said to her, “What trouble
do you have, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. Because God has heard
the boy’s voice where he is.

verses.hebrew: קוּמִי שְׂאִי אֶת הַנַּעַר וְהַחֲזִיקִי אֶת יָדֵךְ בּוֹ כִּי לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל אֲשִׂימֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: קוּמִי שְׂאִי אֶת הַנַּעַר וְהַחֲזִיקִי אֶת יָדֵךְ בּוֹ כִּי לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל אֲשִׂימֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
Get up. Carry the boy and hold him up in your hand,
because I shall make him into a big nation.”

translation.text: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.

verses.english:
Get up. Carry the boy and hold him up in your hand,
because I shall make him into a big nation.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקַח אֱלֹהִים אֶת עֵינֶיהָ וַתֵּרֶא בְּאֵר מָיִם וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתְּמַלֵּא אֶת הַחֵמֶת מַיִם וַתַּשְׁקְ אֶת הַנָּעַר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְקַח אֱלֹהִים אֶת עֵינֶיהָ וַתֵּרֶא בְּאֵר מָיִם וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתְּמַלֵּא אֶת הַחֵמֶת מַיִם וַתַּשְׁקְ אֶת הַנָּעַר׃

english.text:
And God opened her eyes, and she saw a water well, and she
went and filled the bottle with water and had the boy
drink.

translation.text: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.

verses.english:
And God opened her eyes, and she saw a water well, and she
went and filled the bottle with water and had the boy
drink.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אֱלֹהִים אֶת הַנַּעַר וַיִּגְדָּל וַיֵּשֶׁב בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיְהִי רֹבֶה קַשָּׁת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אֱלֹהִים אֶת הַנַּעַר וַיִּגְדָּל וַיֵּשֶׁב בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיְהִי רֹבֶה קַשָּׁת׃

english.text:
And God was with the boy, and he grew, and he lived in the
wilderness and was a bowman.

translation.text: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.

verses.english:
And God was with the boy, and he grew, and he lived in the
wilderness and was a bowman.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּמִדְבַּר פָּארָן וַתִּקַּח לוֹ אִמּוֹ אִשָּׁה מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּמִדְבַּר פָּארָן וַתִּקַּח לוֹ אִמּוֹ אִשָּׁה מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And he lived in the Paran wilderness, and his mother took
him a wife from the land of Egypt.

translation.text: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And he lived in the Paran wilderness, and his mother took
him a wife from the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בָּעֵת הַהִוא וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וּפִיכֹל שַׂר צְבָאוֹ אֶל אַבְרָהָם לֵאמֹר אֱלֹהִים עִמְּךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בָּעֵת הַהִוא וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וּפִיכֹל שַׂר צְבָאוֹ אֶל אַבְרָהָם לֵאמֹר אֱלֹהִים עִמְּךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה׃

english.text:
And it was at that time, and Abimelek and Phichol, the
commander of his army, said to Abraham, saying, “God is
with you in everything that you do.

translation.text: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:

verses.english:
And it was at that time, and Abimelek and Phichol, the
commander of his army, said to Abraham, saying, “God is
with you in everything that you do.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִשָּׁבְעָה לִּי בֵאלֹהִים הֵנָּה אִם תִּשְׁקֹר לִי וּלְנִינִי וּלְנֶכְדִּי כַּחֶסֶד אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי עִמְּךָ תַּעֲשֶׂה עִמָּדִי וְעִם הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר גַּרְתָּה בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִשָּׁבְעָה לִּי בֵאלֹהִים הֵנָּה אִם תִּשְׁקֹר לִי וּלְנִינִי וּלְנֶכְדִּי כַּחֶסֶד אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי עִמְּךָ תַּעֲשֶׂה עִמָּדִי וְעִם הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר גַּרְתָּה בָּהּ׃

english.text:
And now, swear to me here by God that you won’t act
falsely to me and to my offspring and to my posterity Like
the kindness that I’ve done with you, you’ll do with me
and with the land in which you’ve resided.”

translation.text: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.

verses.english:
And now, swear to me here by God that you won’t act
falsely to me and to my offspring and to my posterity Like
the kindness that I’ve done with you, you’ll do with me
and with the land in which you’ve resided.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אָנֹכִי אִשָּׁבֵעַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אָנֹכִי אִשָּׁבֵעַ׃

english.text: And Abraham said, “I’ll swear,”

translation.text: And Abraham said, I will swear.

verses.english: And Abraham said, “I’ll swear,”

verses.hebrew: וְהוֹכִחַ אַבְרָהָם אֶת אֲבִימֶלֶךְ עַל אֹדוֹת בְּאֵר הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר גָּזְלוּ עַבְדֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹכִחַ אַבְרָהָם אֶת אֲבִימֶלֶךְ עַל אֹדוֹת בְּאֵר הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר גָּזְלוּ עַבְדֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
and Abraham criticized Abimelek about a water well that
Abimelek’s servants had seized.

translation.text: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

verses.english:
and Abraham criticized Abimelek about a water well that
Abimelek’s servants had seized.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ לֹא יָדַעְתִּי מִי עָשָׂה אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְגַם אַתָּה לֹא הִגַּדְתָּ לִּי וְגַם אָנֹכִי לֹא שָׁמַעְתִּי בִּלְתִּי הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ לֹא יָדַעְתִּי מִי עָשָׂה אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְגַם אַתָּה לֹא הִגַּדְתָּ לִּי וְגַם אָנֹכִי לֹא שָׁמַעְתִּי בִּלְתִּי הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And Abimelek said, “I don’t know who did this thing; and
also, you didn’t tell me; and also, I didn’t hear of it
except for today.”

translation.text: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing; neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.

verses.english:
And Abimelek said, “I don’t know who did this thing; and
also, you didn’t tell me; and also, I didn’t hear of it
except for today.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָהָם צֹאן וּבָקָר וַיִּתֵּן לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיִּכְרְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם בְּרִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָהָם צֹאן וּבָקָר וַיִּתֵּן לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיִּכְרְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם בְּרִית׃

english.text:
And Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave to Abimelek, and
the two of them made a covenant.

translation.text: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.

verses.english:
And Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave to Abimelek, and
the two of them made a covenant.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּצֵּב אַבְרָהָם אֶת שֶׁבַע כִּבְשֹׂת הַצֹּאן לְבַדְּהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּצֵּב אַבְרָהָם אֶת שֶׁבַע כִּבְשֹׂת הַצֹּאן לְבַדְּהֶן׃

english.text: And Abraham stood seven ewes of the sheep by themselves.

translation.text: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

verses.english: And Abraham stood seven ewes of the sheep by themselves.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶל אַבְרָהָם מָה הֵנָּה שֶׁבַע כְּבָשֹׂת הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִצַּבְתָּ לְבַדָּנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶל אַבְרָהָם מָה הֵנָּה שֶׁבַע כְּבָשֹׂת הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִצַּבְתָּ לְבַדָּנָה׃

english.text:
And Abimelek said to Abraham, “What are these seven ewes
that you’ve stood by themselves?”

translation.text: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?

verses.english:
And Abimelek said to Abraham, “What are these seven ewes
that you’ve stood by themselves?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי אֶת שֶׁבַע כְּבָשֹׂת תִּקַּח מִיָּדִי בַּעֲבוּר תִּהְיֶה לִּי לְעֵדָה כִּי חָפַרְתִּי אֶת הַבְּאֵר הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי אֶת שֶׁבַע כְּבָשֹׂת תִּקַּח מִיָּדִי בַּעֲבוּר תִּהְיֶה לִּי לְעֵדָה כִּי חָפַרְתִּי אֶת הַבְּאֵר הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
And he said, “Because you’ll take these seven ewes from my
hand so that it will be evidence for me that I dug this
well.”

translation.text: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.

verses.english:
And he said, “Because you’ll take these seven ewes from my
hand so that it will be evidence for me that I dug this
well.”

verses.hebrew: עַל כֵּן קָרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בְּאֵר שָׁבַע כִּי שָׁם נִשְׁבְּעוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: עַל כֵּן קָרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בְּאֵר שָׁבַע כִּי שָׁם נִשְׁבְּעוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
On account of this he called that place Beer-sheba,
because the two of them swore there

translation.text: Wherefore he called that place Beersheba; because there they sware both of them.

verses.english:
On account of this he called that place Beer-sheba,
because the two of them swore there

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרְתוּ בְרִית בִּבְאֵר שָׁבַע וַיָּקם אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וּפִיכֹל שַׂר צְבָאוֹ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ אֶל אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְרְתוּ בְרִית בִּבְאֵר שָׁבַע וַיָּקם אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וּפִיכֹל שַׂר צְבָאוֹ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ אֶל אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
and made a covenant in Beer-sheba. And Abimelek and
Phichol, the commander of his army, got up and went to the
land of the Philistines.

translation.text: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

verses.english:
and made a covenant in Beer-sheba. And Abimelek and
Phichol, the commander of his army, got up and went to the
land of the Philistines.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּטַּע אֶשֶׁל בִּבְאֵר שָׁבַע וַיִּקְרָא שָׁם בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֵל עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּטַּע אֶשֶׁל בִּבְאֵר שָׁבַע וַיִּקְרָא שָׁם בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֵל עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
And he planted a tamarisk in Beer-sheba and he called the
name of YHWH El Olam.

translation.text: And Abraham planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.

verses.english:
And he planted a tamarisk in Beer-sheba and he called the
name of YHWH El Olam.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּגר אַבְרָהָם בְּאֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים יָמִים רַבִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּגר אַבְרָהָם בְּאֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים יָמִים רַבִּים׃

english.text:
And Abraham resided in the land of the Philistines many
days.

translation.text: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines’ land many days.

verses.english:
And Abraham resided in the land of the Philistines many
days.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְהָאֱלֹהִים נִסָּה אֶת אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְהָאֱלֹהִים נִסָּה אֶת אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי

english.text:
And it was after these things,
and God tested Abraham.
And He said to him, “Abraham.”
And he said, “I’m here.”

translation.text: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.

verses.english:
And it was after these things,
and God tested Abraham.
And He said to him, “Abraham.”
And he said, “I’m here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר קַח נָא אֶת בִּנְךָ אֶת יְחִידְךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהַבְתָּ אֶת יִצְחָק וְלֶךְ לְךָ אֶל אֶרֶץ הַמֹּרִיָּה וְהַעֲלֵהוּ שָׁם לְעֹלָה עַל אַחַד הֶהָרִים אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר קַח נָא אֶת בִּנְךָ אֶת יְחִידְךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהַבְתָּ אֶת יִצְחָק וְלֶךְ לְךָ אֶל אֶרֶץ הַמֹּרִיָּה וְהַעֲלֵהוּ שָׁם לְעֹלָה עַל אַחַד הֶהָרִים אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ

english.text:
And He said, “Take your son,
your only one, whom you love,
Isaac,
and go to the land of Mo-riah
and make him a burnt offering there
on one of the mountains that I’ll say to you.”

translation.text: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

verses.english:
And He said, “Take your son,
your only one, whom you love,
Isaac,
and go to the land of Mo-riah
and make him a burnt offering there
on one of the mountains that I’ll say to you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אַבְרָהָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת חֲמֹרוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת שְׁנֵי נְעָרָיו אִתּוֹ וְאֵת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיְבַקַּע עֲצֵי עֹלָה וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר לוֹ הָאֱלֹהִים

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אַבְרָהָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת חֲמֹרוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת שְׁנֵי נְעָרָיו אִתּוֹ וְאֵת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיְבַקַּע עֲצֵי עֹלָה וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר לוֹ הָאֱלֹהִים

english.text:
And Abraham got up early in the morning
and harnessed his ass
and took his two boys with him
and Isaac, his son.
And he cut the wood for the burnt offering,
and he got up and went to the place
that God had said to him.

translation.text: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.

verses.english:
And Abraham got up early in the morning
and harnessed his ass
and took his two boys with him
and Isaac, his son.
And he cut the wood for the burnt offering,
and he got up and went to the place
that God had said to him.

verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וַיִּשָּׂא אַבְרָהָם אֶת עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת הַמָּקוֹם מֵרָחֹק

hebrew.text: בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וַיִּשָּׂא אַבְרָהָם אֶת עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת הַמָּקוֹם מֵרָחֹק

english.text:
On the third day:
and Abraham raised his eyes
and saw the place from a distance.

translation.text: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.

verses.english:
On the third day:
and Abraham raised his eyes
and saw the place from a distance.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֶל נְעָרָיו שְׁבוּ לָכֶם פֹּה עִם הַחֲמוֹר וַאֲנִי וְהַנַּעַר נֵלְכָה עַד כֹּה וְנִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְנָשׁוּבָה אֲלֵיכֶם

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֶל נְעָרָיו שְׁבוּ לָכֶם פֹּה עִם הַחֲמוֹר וַאֲנִי וְהַנַּעַר נֵלְכָה עַד כֹּה וְנִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְנָשׁוּבָה אֲלֵיכֶם

english.text:
And Abraham said to his boys,
“Sit here with the ass;
and I and the boy:
we’ll go over there,
and we’ll bow,
and we’ll come back to you.”

translation.text: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.

verses.english:
And Abraham said to his boys,
“Sit here with the ass;
and I and the boy:
we’ll go over there,
and we’ll bow,

hebrew.text: וּבְתוּאֵל יָלַד אֶת רִבְקָה שְׁמֹנָה אֵלֶּה יָלְדָה מִלְכָּה לְנָחוֹר אֲחִי אַבְרָהָם

english.text:
And Bethuel fathered Rebekah.”
Milcah gave birth to these eight
for Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

translation.text: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

verses.english:
And Bethuel fathered Rebekah.”
Milcah gave birth to these eight
for Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

verses.hebrew: וּפִילַגְשׁוֹ וּשְׁמָהּ רְאוּמָה וַתֵּלֶד גַּם הִוא אֶת טֶבַח וְאֶת גַּחַם וְאֶת תַּחַשׁ וְאֶת מַעֲכָה

hebrew.text: וּפִילַגְשׁוֹ וּשְׁמָהּ רְאוּמָה וַתֵּלֶד גַּם הִוא אֶת טֶבַח וְאֶת גַּחַם וְאֶת תַּחַשׁ וְאֶת מַעֲכָה

english.text:
And his concubine,
whose name was Reumah,
she too gave birth,
to Tebah and Gaham
and Tahash and Maacah.

translation.text: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.

verses.english:
And his concubine,
whose name was Reumah,
she too gave birth,
to Tebah and Gaham
and Tahash and Maacah.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְהָאֱלֹהִים נִסָּה אֶת אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְהָאֱלֹהִים נִסָּה אֶת אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי

english.text:
And it was after these things,
and God tested Abraham.
And He said to him, “Abraham. Abraham.”
And he said, “I’m here.”

translation.text: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.

verses.english:
And it was after these things,
and God tested Abraham.
And He said to him, “Abraham. Abraham.”
And he said, “I’m here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר קַח נָא אֶת בִּנְךָ אֶת יְחִידְךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהַבְתָּ אֶת יִצְחָק וְלֶךְ לְךָ אֶל אֶרֶץ הַמֹּרִיָּה וְהַעֲלֵהוּ שָׁם לְעֹלָה עַל אַחַד הֶהָרִים אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר קַח נָא אֶת בִּנְךָ אֶת יְחִידְךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהַבְתָּ אֶת יִצְחָק וְלֶךְ לְךָ אֶל אֶרֶץ הַמֹּרִיָּה וְהַעֲלֵהוּ שָׁם לְעֹלָה עַל אַחַד הֶהָרִים אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ

english.text:
And He said, “Take your son,
your only one, whom you love,
Isaac,
and go to the land of Mo-riah
and make him a burnt offering there
on one of the mountains that I’ll say to you.”

translation.text: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

verses.english:
And He said, “Take your son,
your only one, whom you love,
Isaac,
and go to the land of Mo-riah
and make him a burnt offering there
on one of the mountains that I’ll say to you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אַבְרָהָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת חֲמֹרוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת שְׁנֵי נְעָרָיו אִתּוֹ וְאֵת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיְבַקַּע עֲצֵי עֹלָה וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר לוֹ הָאֱלֹהִים

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם אַבְרָהָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת חֲמֹרוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת שְׁנֵי נְעָרָיו אִתּוֹ וְאֵת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיְבַקַּע עֲצֵי עֹלָה וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר לוֹ הָאֱלֹהִים

english.text:
And Abraham got up early in the morning
and harnessed his ass
and took his two boys with him
and Isaac, his son.
And he cut the wood for the burnt offering,
and he got up and went to the place
that God had said to him.

translation.text: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.

verses.english:
And Abraham got up early in the morning
and harnessed his ass
and took his two boys with him
and Isaac, his son.
And he cut the wood for the burnt offering,
and he got up and went to the place
that God had said to him.

verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וַיִּשָּׂא אַבְרָהָם אֶת עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת הַמָּקוֹם מֵרָחֹק

hebrew.text: בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וַיִּשָּׂא אַבְרָהָם אֶת עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת הַמָּקוֹם מֵרָחֹק

english.text:
On the third day:
and Abraham raised his eyes
and saw the place from a distance.

translation.text: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.

verses.english:
On the third day:
and Abraham raised his eyes
and saw the place from a distance.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֶל נְעָרָיו שְׁבוּ לָכֶם פֹּה עִם הַחֲמוֹר וַאֲנִי וְהַנַּעַר נֵלְכָה עַד כֹּה וְנִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְנָשׁוּבָה אֲלֵיכֶם

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֶל נְעָרָיו שְׁבוּ לָכֶם פֹּה עִם הַחֲמוֹר וַאֲנִי וְהַנַּעַר נֵלְכָה עַד כֹּה וְנִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְנָשׁוּבָה אֲלֵיכֶם

english.text:
And Abraham said to his boys,
“Sit here with the ass;
and I and the boy:
we’ll go over there,
and we’ll bow,
and we’ll come back to you.”

translation.text: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.

verses.english:
And Abraham said to his boys,
“Sit here with the ass;
and I and the boy:
we’ll go over there,
and we’ll bow,
and we’ll come back to you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָהָם אֶת עֲצֵי הָעֹלָה וַיָּשֶׂם עַל יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיִּקַּח בְּיָדוֹ אֶת הָאֵשׁ וְאֶת הַמַּאֲכֶלֶת וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם יַחְדָּו

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָהָם אֶת עֲצֵי הָעֹלָה וַיָּשֶׂם עַל יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיִּקַּח בְּיָדוֹ אֶת הָאֵשׁ וְאֶת הַמַּאֲכֶלֶת וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם יַחְדָּו

english.text:
And Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering
and put it on Isaac, his son,
and took the fire and the knife in his hand.
And the two of them went together.

translation.text: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.

verses.english:
And Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering
and put it on Isaac, his son,
and took the fire and the knife in his hand.
And the two of them went together.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִצְחָק אֶל אַבְרָהָם אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֶּנִּי בְנִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה הָאֵשׁ וְהָעֵצִים וְאַיֵּה הַשֶּׂה לְעֹלָה

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִצְחָק אֶל אַבְרָהָם אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֶּנִּי בְנִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה הָאֵשׁ וְהָעֵצִים וְאַיֵּה הַשֶּׂה לְעֹלָה

english.text:
And Isaac said to Abraham, his father;
and he said, “My father.”
And he said, “I’m here, my son.”
And he said, “Here are the fire and the wood,
but where is the sheep for the burnt offering?”

translation.text: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?

verses.english:
And Isaac said to Abraham, his father;
and he said, “My father.”
And he said, “I’m here, my son.”
And he said, “Here are the fire and the wood,
but where is the sheep for the burnt offering?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהִים יִרְאֶה לּוֹ הַשֶּׂה לְעֹלָה בְּנִי וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם יַחְדָּו

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהִים יִרְאֶה לּוֹ הַשֶּׂה לְעֹלָה בְּנִי וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם יַחְדָּו

english.text:
And Abraham said,
“God will see to the sheep for the burnt offering,
my son.”
And the two of them went together.

translation.text: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

verses.english:
And Abraham said,
“God will see to the sheep for the burnt offering,
my son.”
And the two of them went together.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר לוֹ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּבֶן שָׁם אַבְרָהָם אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיַּעֲרֹךְ אֶת הָעֵצִים וַיַּעֲקֹד אֶת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם אֹתוֹ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִמַּעַל לָעֵצִים

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר לוֹ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּבֶן שָׁם אַבְרָהָם אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיַּעֲרֹךְ אֶת הָעֵצִים וַיַּעֲקֹד אֶת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם אֹתוֹ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִמַּעַל לָעֵצִים

english.text:
And they came to the place
that God had said to him.
And Abraham built the altar there
and arranged the wood,
and he bound Isaac, his son,
and put him on the altar
on top of the wood.

translation.text: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.

verses.english:
And they came to the place
that God had said to him.
And Abraham built the altar there
and arranged the wood,
and he bound Isaac, his son,
and put him on the altar
on top of the wood.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְרָהָם אֶת יָדוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת הַמַּאֲכֶלֶת לִשְׁחֹט אֶת בְּנוֹ

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְרָהָם אֶת יָדוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת הַמַּאֲכֶלֶת לִשְׁחֹט אֶת בְּנוֹ

english.text:
And Abraham put out his hand
and took the knife
to slaughter his son.

translation.text: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.

verses.english:
And Abraham put out his hand
and took the knife
to slaughter his son.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי

english.text:
And an angel of YHWH called to him from the skies
and said, “Abraham! Abraham!”
And he said, “I’m here.”

translation.text: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.

verses.english:
And an angel of YHWH called to him from the skies
and said, “Abraham! Abraham!”
And he said, “I’m here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל תִּשְׁלַח יָדְךָ אֶל הַנַּעַר וְאַל תַּעַשׂ לוֹ מְאוּמָה כִּי עַתָּה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי יְרֵא אֱלֹהִים אַתָּה וְלֹא חָשַׂכְתָּ אֶת בִּנְךָ אֶת יְחִידְךָ מִמֶּנִּי

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל תִּשְׁלַח יָדְךָ אֶל הַנַּעַר וְאַל תַּעַשׂ לוֹ מְאוּמָה כִּי עַתָּה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי יְרֵא אֱלֹהִים אַתָּה וְלֹא חָשַׂכְתָּ אֶת בִּנְךָ אֶת יְחִידְךָ מִמֶּנִּי

english.text:
And he said,
“Don’t put your hand out toward the boy,
and don’t do anything to him,
because now I know that you fear L-0.22emꞀ,
and you didn’t withhold your son,
your only one, from me.”

translation.text: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.

verses.english:
And he said,
“Don’t put your hand out toward the boy,
and don’t do anything to him,
because now I know that you fear L-0.22emꞀ,
and you didn’t withhold your son,
your only one, from me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא אַבְרָהָם אֶת עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה אַיִל אַחַר נֶאֱחַז בַּסְּבַךְ בְּקַרְנָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ אַבְרָהָם וַיִּקַּח אֶת הָאַיִל וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ לְעֹלָה תַּחַת בְּנוֹ

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא אַבְרָהָם אֶת עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה אַיִל אַחַר נֶאֱחַז בַּסְּבַךְ בְּקַרְנָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ אַבְרָהָם וַיִּקַּח אֶת הָאַיִל וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ לְעֹלָה תַּחַת בְּנוֹ

english.text:
And Abraham raised his eyes and saw,
and here was a ram behind,
caught in the thicket by its horns.
And Abraham went and took the ram
and made it a burnt offering
instead of his son.

translation.text: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

verses.english:
And Abraham raised his eyes and saw,
and here was a ram behind,
caught in the thicket by its horns.
And Abraham went and took the ram
and made it a burnt offering
instead of his son.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אַבְרָהָם שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא יְהֹוָה יִרְאֶה אֲשֶׁר יֵאָמֵר הַיּוֹם בְּהַר יְהֹוָה יֵרָאֶה

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אַבְרָהָם שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא יְהֹוָה יִרְאֶה אֲשֶׁר יֵאָמֵר הַיּוֹם בְּהַר יְהֹוָה יֵרָאֶה

english.text:
And Abraham called the name of that place
“YHWH Yir’eh,”
as is said today:
“In YHWH’s mountain it will be seen.”

translation.text: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.

verses.english:
And Abraham called the name of that place
“YHWH Yir’eh,”
as is said today:
“In YHWH’s mountain it will be seen.”

verses.translation: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:

verses.hebrew: כִּי בָרֵךְ אֲבָרֶכְךָ וְהַרְבָּה אַרְבֶּה אֶת זַרְעֲךָ כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם וְכַחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל שְׂפַת הַיָּם וְיִרַשׁ זַרְעֲךָ אֵת שַׁעַר אֹיְבָיו

translation.text: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;

verses.english:
that I’ll bless you
and multiply your seed
like the stars of the skies

and your seed will possess its enemies’ gate.

And Sarah’s life was a hundred years and
twenty years and seven years: the years of Sarah’s life.

verses.english:
“I’m an alien and a visitor with you. Give me a possession
for a tomb with you so I may bury my dead from in front of
me.”

dead.”

hebrew.text: וְעֶפְרוֹן יֹשֵׁב בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי חֵת וַיַּעַן עֶפְרוֹן הַחִתִּי אֶת אַבְרָהָם בְּאזְנֵי בְנֵי חֵת לְכֹל בָּאֵי שַׁעַר עִירוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And Ephron was sitting among the children of Heth, and
Ephron, the Hittite, answered Abraham in the ears of the
children of Heth, for all who were coming to his city’s
gate, saying,

translation.text: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,

verses.english:
And Ephron was sitting among the children of Heth, and
Ephron, the Hittite, answered Abraham in the ears of the
children of Heth, for all who were coming to his city’s
gate, saying,

verses.hebrew: לֹא אֲדֹנִי שְׁמָעֵנִי הַשָּׂדֶה נָתַתִּי לָךְ וְהַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ לְךָ נְתַתִּיהָ לְעֵינֵי בְנֵי עַמִּי נְתַתִּיהָ לָּךְ קְבֹר מֵתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא אֲדֹנִי שְׁמָעֵנִי הַשָּׂדֶה נָתַתִּי לָךְ וְהַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ לְךָ נְתַתִּיהָ לְעֵינֵי בְנֵי עַמִּי נְתַתִּיהָ לָּךְ קְבֹר מֵתֶךָ׃

english.text:
“No, sir. Listen to me: I’ve given the field to you, and
I’ve given the cave that’s in it to you. I’ve given it to
you before the eyes of the children of my people. Bury
your dead.”

translation.text: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.

verses.english:
“No, sir. Listen to me: I’ve given the field to you, and
I’ve given the cave that’s in it to you. I’ve given it to
you before the eyes of the children of my people. Bury
your dead.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ אַבְרָהָם לִפְנֵי עַם הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ אַבְרָהָם לִפְנֵי עַם הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text: And Abraham bowed in front of the people of the land,

translation.text: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.

verses.english: And Abraham bowed in front of the people of the land,

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל עֶפְרוֹן בְּאזְנֵי עַם הָאָרֶץ לֵאמֹר אַךְ אִם אַתָּה לוּ שְׁמָעֵנִי נָתַתִּי כֶּסֶף הַשָּׂדֶה קַח מִמֶּנִּי וְאֶקְבְּרָה אֶת מֵתִי שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל עֶפְרוֹן בְּאזְנֵי עַם הָאָרֶץ לֵאמֹר אַךְ אִם אַתָּה לוּ שְׁמָעֵנִי נָתַתִּי כֶּסֶף הַשָּׂדֶה קַח מִמֶּנִּי וְאֶקְבְּרָה אֶת מֵתִי שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
and he spoke to Ephron in the ears of the people of the
land, saying, “Just if you’ll listen to me: I’ve given the
money for the field. Take it from me so I may bury my dead
there.”

translation.text: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.

verses.english:
and he spoke to Ephron in the ears of the people of the
land, saying, “Just if you’ll listen to me: I’ve given the
money for the field. Take it from me so I may bury my dead
there.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן עֶפְרוֹן אֶת אַבְרָהָם לֵאמֹר לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן עֶפְרוֹן אֶת אַבְרָהָם לֵאמֹר לוֹ׃

english.text: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

translation.text: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,

verses.english: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנִי שְׁמָעֵנִי אֶרֶץ אַרְבַּע מֵאֹת שֶׁקֶל כֶּסֶף בֵּינִי וּבֵינְךָ מַה הִוא וְאֶת מֵתְךָ קְבֹר׃

hebrew.text: אֲדֹנִי שְׁמָעֵנִי אֶרֶץ אַרְבַּע מֵאֹת שֶׁקֶל כֶּסֶף בֵּינִי וּבֵינְךָ מַה הִוא וְאֶת מֵתְךָ קְבֹר׃

english.text:
“Sir, listen to me. Land worth four hundred shekels of
silver: what’s that between me and you?! And bury your
dead.”

translation.text: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.

verses.english:
“Sir, listen to me. Land worth four hundred shekels of
silver: what’s that between me and you?! And bury your
dead.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אַבְרָהָם אֶל עֶפְרוֹן וַיִּשְׁקֹל אַבְרָהָם לְעֶפְרֹן אֶת הַכֶּסֶף אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּאזְנֵי בְנֵי חֵת אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שֶׁקֶל כֶּסֶף עֹבֵר לַסֹּחֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע אַבְרָהָם אֶל עֶפְרוֹן וַיִּשְׁקֹל אַבְרָהָם לְעֶפְרֹן אֶת הַכֶּסֶף אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּאזְנֵי בְנֵי חֵת אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שֶׁקֶל כֶּסֶף עֹבֵר לַסֹּחֵר׃

english.text:
And Abraham listened to Ephron, and Abraham weighed out to
Ephron the money that he had spoken in the ears of the
children of Heth: four hundred shekels of silver, at the
merchant’s current rate.

translation.text: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.

verses.english:
And Abraham listened to Ephron, and Abraham weighed out to
Ephron the money that he had spoken in the ears of the
children of Heth: four hundred shekels of silver, at the
merchant’s current rate.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם שְׂדֵה עֶפְרוֹן אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּכְפֵּלָה אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי מַמְרֵא הַשָּׂדֶה וְהַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ וְכל הָעֵץ אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר בְּכל גְּבֻלוֹ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם שְׂדֵה עֶפְרוֹן אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּכְפֵּלָה אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי מַמְרֵא הַשָּׂדֶה וְהַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ וְכל הָעֵץ אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר בְּכל גְּבֻלוֹ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And Ephron’s field that was in Machpelah, which faces
Mamre, the field and the cave that was in it and every
tree that was in the field, that was in all of its border
all around, was established

translation.text: And the field of Ephron which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure

verses.english:
And Ephron’s field that was in Machpelah, which faces
Mamre, the field and the cave that was in it and every
tree that was in the field, that was in all of its border
all around, was established

verses.hebrew: לְאַבְרָהָם לְמִקְנָה לְעֵינֵי בְנֵי חֵת בְּכֹל בָּאֵי שַׁעַר עִירוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לְאַבְרָהָם לְמִקְנָה לְעֵינֵי בְנֵי חֵת בְּכֹל בָּאֵי שַׁעַר עִירוֹ׃

english.text:
for Abraham as a purchase in the eyes of the children of
Heth, among all who were coming to his city’s gate.

translation.text: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.

verses.english:
for Abraham as a purchase in the eyes of the children of
Heth, among all who were coming to his city’s gate.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן קָבַר אַבְרָהָם אֶת שָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ אֶל מְעָרַת שְׂדֵה הַמַּכְפֵּלָה עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵא הִוא חֶבְרוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן קָבַר אַבְרָהָם אֶת שָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ אֶל מְעָרַת שְׂדֵה הַמַּכְפֵּלָה עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵא הִוא חֶבְרוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
And after that Abraham buried Sarah, his wife, at the cave
of the field of Machpelah, facing Mamre—it is Hebron—in
the land of Canaan.

translation.text: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.

verses.english:
And after that Abraham buried Sarah, his wife, at the cave
of the field of Machpelah, facing Mamre—it is Hebron—in
the land of Canaan.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם הַשָּׂדֶה וְהַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ לְאַבְרָהָם לַאֲחֻזַּת קָבֶר מֵאֵת בְּנֵי חֵת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם הַשָּׂדֶה וְהַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ לְאַבְרָהָם לַאֲחֻזַּת קָבֶר מֵאֵת בְּנֵי חֵת׃

english.text:
And the field and the cave that was in it were established
for Abraham as a possession for a tomb from the children
of Heth.

translation.text: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.

verses.english:
And the field and the cave that was in it were established
for Abraham as a possession for a tomb from the children
of Heth.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְרָהָם זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים וַיהֹוָה בֵּרַךְ אֶת אַבְרָהָם בַּכֹּל׃

hebrew.text: וְאַבְרָהָם זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים וַיהֹוָה בֵּרַךְ אֶת אַבְרָהָם בַּכֹּל׃

english.text:
And Abraham was old, well along in 24 days, and YHWH
had blessed Abraham in everything.

translation.text: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.

verses.english:
And Abraham was old, well along in 24 days, and YHWH
had blessed Abraham in everything.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֶל עַבְדּוֹ זְקַן בֵּיתוֹ הַמֹּשֵׁל בְּכל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ שִׂים נָא יָדְךָ תַּחַת יְרֵכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֶל עַבְדּוֹ זְקַן בֵּיתוֹ הַמֹּשֵׁל בְּכל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ שִׂים נָא יָדְךָ תַּחַת יְרֵכִי׃

english.text:
And Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house,
who was in charge of all that he had, “Place your hand
under my thigh,

translation.text: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:

verses.english:
And Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house,
who was in charge of all that he had, “Place your hand
under my thigh,

verses.hebrew: וְאַשְׁבִּיעֲךָ בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם וֵאלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לֹא תִקַּח אִשָּׁה לִבְנִי מִבְּנוֹת הַכְּנַעֲנִי אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי יוֹשֵׁב בְּקִרְבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַשְׁבִּיעֲךָ בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם וֵאלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לֹא תִקַּח אִשָּׁה לִבְנִי מִבְּנוֹת הַכְּנַעֲנִי אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי יוֹשֵׁב בְּקִרְבּוֹ׃

english.text:
and I’ll have you swear by YHWH, God of the skies and God
of the earth, that you won’t take a wife for my son from
the daughters of the Canaanite among whom I live,

translation.text: And I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:

verses.english:
and I’ll have you swear by YHWH, God of the skies and God
of the earth, that you won’t take a wife for my son from
the daughters of the Canaanite among whom I live,

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶל אַרְצִי וְאֶל מוֹלַדְתִּי תֵּלֵךְ וְלָקַחְתָּ אִשָּׁה לִבְנִי לְיִצְחָק׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֶל אַרְצִי וְאֶל מוֹלַדְתִּי תֵּלֵךְ וְלָקַחְתָּ אִשָּׁה לִבְנִי לְיִצְחָק׃

english.text:
but you’ll go to my land and my birthplace and take a wife
for my son, for Isaac.”

translation.text: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.

verses.english:
but you’ll go to my land and my birthplace and take a wife
for my son, for Isaac.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הָעֶבֶד אוּלַי לֹא תֹאבֶה הָאִשָּׁה לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרַי אֶל הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת הֶהָשֵׁב אָשִׁיב אֶת בִּנְךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יָצָאתָ מִשָּׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הָעֶבֶד אוּלַי לֹא תֹאבֶה הָאִשָּׁה לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרַי אֶל הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת הֶהָשֵׁב אָשִׁיב אֶת בִּנְךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יָצָאתָ מִשָּׁם׃

english.text:
And the servant said to him, “Maybe the woman won’t be
willing to follow me to this land. Shall I take back your
son to the land you came from?”

translation.text: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?

verses.english:
And the servant said to him, “Maybe the woman won’t be
willing to follow me to this land. Shall I take back your
son to the land you came from?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְרָהָם הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תָּשִׁיב אֶת בְּנִי שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְרָהָם הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תָּשִׁיב אֶת בְּנִי שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And Abraham said to him, “Watch yourself, that you don’t
take my son back there.

translation.text: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.

verses.english:
And Abraham said to him, “Watch yourself, that you don’t
take my son back there.

verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם אֲשֶׁר לְקָחַנִי מִבֵּית אָבִי וּמֵאֶרֶץ מוֹלַדְתִּי וַאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לִי וַאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לִי לֵאמֹר לְזַרְעֲךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת הוּא יִשְׁלַח מַלְאָכוֹ לְפָנֶיךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ אִשָּׁה לִבְנִי מִשָּׁם׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם אֲשֶׁר לְקָחַנִי מִבֵּית אָבִי וּמֵאֶרֶץ מוֹלַדְתִּי וַאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לִי וַאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לִי לֵאמֹר לְזַרְעֲךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת הוּא יִשְׁלַח מַלְאָכוֹ לְפָנֶיךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ אִשָּׁה לִבְנִי מִשָּׁם׃

english.text:
YHWH, God of the skies, who took me from my father’s house
and from the land of my birth and who spoke to me and who
swore to me, saying, ‘I’ll give this land to your seed,’
He’ll send His angel ahead of you, and you shall take a
wife for my son from there.

translation.text: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.

verses.english:
YHWH, God of the skies, who took me from my father’s house
and from the land of my birth and who spoke to me and who
swore to me, saying, ‘I’ll give this land to your seed,’
He’ll send His angel ahead of you, and you shall take a
wife for my son from there.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא תֹאבֶה הָאִשָּׁה לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֶיךָ וְנִקִּיתָ מִשְּׁבֻעָתִי זֹאת רַק אֶת בְּנִי לֹא תָשֵׁב שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא תֹאבֶה הָאִשָּׁה לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֶיךָ וְנִקִּיתָ מִשְּׁבֻעָתִי זֹאת רַק אֶת בְּנִי לֹא תָשֵׁב שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And if the woman won’t be willing to go after you, then
you’ll be freed from this oath of mine. Only you are not
to take my son back there.”

translation.text: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.

verses.english:
And if the woman won’t be willing to go after you, then
you’ll be freed from this oath of mine. Only you are not
to take my son back there.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם הָעֶבֶד אֶת יָדוֹ תַּחַת יֶרֶךְ אַבְרָהָם אֲדֹנָיו וַיִּשָּׁבַע לוֹ עַל הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם הָעֶבֶד אֶת יָדוֹ תַּחַת יֶרֶךְ אַבְרָהָם אֲדֹנָיו וַיִּשָּׁבַע לוֹ עַל הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And the servant placed his hand under his lord Abraham’s
thigh and swore to him about this thing.

translation.text: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.

verses.english:
And the servant placed his hand under his lord Abraham’s
thigh and swore to him about this thing.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח הָעֶבֶד עֲשָׂרָה גְמַלִּים מִגְּמַלֵּי אֲדֹנָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ וְכל טוּב אֲדֹנָיו בְּיָדוֹ וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל אֲרַם נַהֲרַיִם אֶל עִיר נָחוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח הָעֶבֶד עֲשָׂרָה גְמַלִּים מִגְּמַלֵּי אֲדֹנָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ וְכל טוּב אֲדֹנָיו בְּיָדוֹ וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל אֲרַם נַהֲרַיִם אֶל עִיר נָחוֹר׃

english.text:
And the servant took ten camels of his lord’s camels and
went, and all of his lord’s best things were in his hand.
And he got up and went to Aram Naharaim, to the city of
Nahor,

translation.text: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.

verses.english:
And the servant took ten camels of his lord’s camels and
went, and all of his lord’s best things were in his hand.
And he got up and went to Aram Naharaim, to the city of
Nahor,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּבְרֵךְ הַגְּמַלִּים מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל בְּאֵר הַמָּיִם לְעֵת עֶרֶב לְעֵת צֵאת הַשֹּׁאֲבֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּבְרֵךְ הַגְּמַלִּים מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל בְּאֵר הַמָּיִם לְעֵת עֶרֶב לְעֵת צֵאת הַשֹּׁאֲבֹת׃

english.text:
and he had the camels kneel outside the city at the water
well at evening time, the time that the women went out to
draw water.

translation.text: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.

verses.english:
and he had the camels kneel outside the city at the water
well at evening time, the time that the women went out to
draw water.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲדֹנִי אַבְרָהָם הַקְרֵה נָא לְפָנַי הַיּוֹם וַעֲשֵׂה חֶסֶד עִם אֲדֹנִי אַבְרָהָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲדֹנִי אַבְרָהָם הַקְרֵה נָא לְפָנַי הַיּוֹם וַעֲשֵׂה חֶסֶד עִם אֲדֹנִי אַבְרָהָם׃

english.text:
And he said, “YHWH, God of my lord Abraham, make something
happen in front of me today and show kindness to my lord
Abraham:

translation.text: And he said O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.

verses.english:
And he said, “YHWH, God of my lord Abraham, make something
happen in front of me today and show kindness to my lord
Abraham:

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי נִצָּב עַל עֵין הַמָּיִם וּבְנוֹת אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר יֹצְאֹת לִשְׁאֹב מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי נִצָּב עַל עֵין הַמָּיִם וּבְנוֹת אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר יֹצְאֹת לִשְׁאֹב מָיִם׃

english.text:
Here I am, standing over the spring of water, and the
daughters of the people of the city are going out to draw
water.

translation.text: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:

verses.english:
Here I am, standing over the spring of water, and the
daughters of the people of the city are going out to draw
water.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַנַּעֲרָ אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶיהָ הַטִּי נָא כַדֵּךְ וְאֶשְׁתֶּה וְאָמְרָה שְׁתֵה וְגַם גְּמַלֶּיךָ אַשְׁקֶה אֹתָהּ הֹכַחְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ לְיִצְחָק וּבָהּ אֵדַע כִּי עָשִׂיתָ חֶסֶד עִם אֲדֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הַנַּעֲרָ אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶיהָ הַטִּי נָא כַדֵּךְ וְאֶשְׁתֶּה וְאָמְרָה שְׁתֵה וְגַם גְּמַלֶּיךָ אַשְׁקֶה אֹתָהּ הֹכַחְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ לְיִצְחָק וּבָהּ אֵדַע כִּי עָשִׂיתָ חֶסֶד עִם אֲדֹנִי׃

english.text:
And let it be that the girl to whom I’ll say, ‘Tip your
jar so I may drink,’ and she’ll say, ‘Drink, and I’ll
water your camels, too,’ she’ll be the one you’ve pointed
out for your servant, for Isaac, and I’ll know by this
that you’ve shown kindness to my lord.”

translation.text: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.

verses.english:
And let it be that the girl to whom I’ll say, ‘Tip your
jar so I may drink,’ and she’ll say, ‘Drink, and I’ll
water your camels, too,’ she’ll be the one you’ve pointed
out for your servant, for Isaac, and I’ll know by this
that you’ve shown kindness to my lord.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הוּא טֶרֶם כִּלָּה לְדַבֵּר וְהִנֵּה רִבְקָה יֹצֵאת אֲשֶׁר יֻלְּדָה לִבְתוּאֵל בֶּן מִלְכָּה אֵשֶׁת נָחוֹר אֲחִי אַבְרָהָם וְכַדָּהּ עַל שִׁכְמָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הוּא טֶרֶם כִּלָּה לְדַבֵּר וְהִנֵּה רִבְקָה יֹצֵאת אֲשֶׁר יֻלְּדָה לִבְתוּאֵל בֶּן מִלְכָּה אֵשֶׁת נָחוֹר אֲחִי אַבְרָהָם וְכַדָּהּ עַל שִׁכְמָהּ׃

english.text:
And he had not even finished speaking, and here was
Rebekah—who was born to Bethuel son of Milcah, wife of
Nahor, Abraham’s brother—coming out, and her jar was on
her shoulder.

translation.text: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.

verses.english:
And he had not even finished speaking, and here was
Rebekah—who was born to Bethuel son of Milcah, wife of
Nahor, Abraham’s brother—coming out, and her jar was on
her shoulder.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנַּעֲרָ טֹבַת מַרְאֶה מְאֹד בְּתוּלָה וְאִישׁ לֹא יְדָעָהּ וַתֵּרֶד הָעַיְנָה וַתְּמַלֵּא כַדָּהּ וַתָּעַל׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנַּעֲרָ טֹבַת מַרְאֶה מְאֹד בְּתוּלָה וְאִישׁ לֹא יְדָעָהּ וַתֵּרֶד הָעַיְנָה וַתְּמַלֵּא כַדָּהּ וַתָּעַל׃

english.text:
And the girl was very good-looking, a virgin, and no man
had known her. And she went down to the spring and filled
her jar and went up.

translation.text: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

verses.english:
And the girl was very good-looking, a virgin, and no man
had known her. And she went down to the spring and filled
her jar and went up.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרץ הָעֶבֶד לִקְרָאתָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר הַגְמִיאִינִי נָא מְעַט מַיִם מִכַּדֵּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּרץ הָעֶבֶד לִקְרָאתָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר הַגְמִיאִינִי נָא מְעַט מַיִם מִכַּדֵּךְ׃

english.text:
And the servant ran toward her and said, “Give me a little
water from your jar.”

translation.text: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.

verses.english:
And the servant ran toward her and said, “Give me a little
water from your jar.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר שְׁתֵה אֲדֹנִי וַתְּמַהֵר וַתֹּרֶד כַּדָּהּ עַל יָדָהּ וַתַּשְׁקֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר שְׁתֵה אֲדֹנִי וַתְּמַהֵר וַתֹּרֶד כַּדָּהּ עַל יָדָהּ וַתַּשְׁקֵהוּ׃

english.text:
And she said, “Drink, my lord,” and she hurried and
lowered her jar on her arm and let him drink.

translation.text: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.

verses.english:
