And she said, “Drink, my lord,” and she hurried and
lowered her jar on her arm and let him drink.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּכַל לְהַשְׁקֹתוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר גַּם לִגְמַלֶּיךָ אֶשְׁאָב עַד אִם כִּלּוּ לִשְׁתֹּת׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּכַל לְהַשְׁקֹתוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר גַּם לִגְמַלֶּיךָ אֶשְׁאָב עַד אִם כִּלּוּ לִשְׁתֹּת׃

english.text:
And she finished letting him drink, and she said, “I’ll
draw water for your camels, too, until they finish
drinking.”

translation.text: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.

verses.english:
And she finished letting him drink, and she said, “I’ll
draw water for your camels, too, until they finish
drinking.”

verses.hebrew: וַתְּמַהֵר וַתְּעַר כַּדָּהּ אֶל הַשֹּׁקֶת וַתָּרץ עוֹד אֶל הַבְּאֵר לִשְׁאֹב וַתִּשְׁאַב לְכל גְּמַלָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּמַהֵר וַתְּעַר כַּדָּהּ אֶל הַשֹּׁקֶת וַתָּרץ עוֹד אֶל הַבְּאֵר לִשְׁאֹב וַתִּשְׁאַב לְכל גְּמַלָּיו׃

english.text:
And she hurried and emptied her jar into the trough and
ran again to the well to draw water, and she drew water
for all his camels.

translation.text: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.

verses.english:
And she hurried and emptied her jar into the trough and
ran again to the well to draw water, and she drew water
for all his camels.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאִישׁ מִשְׁתָּאֵה לָהּ מַחֲרִישׁ לָדַעַת הַהִצְלִיחַ יְהֹוָה דַּרְכּוֹ אִם לֹא׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאִישׁ מִשְׁתָּאֵה לָהּ מַחֲרִישׁ לָדַעַת הַהִצְלִיחַ יְהֹוָה דַּרְכּוֹ אִם לֹא׃

english.text:
And the man, astonished at her, was keeping quiet so as to
know if YHWH had made his trip successful or not.

translation.text: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.

verses.english:
And the man, astonished at her, was keeping quiet so as to
know if YHWH had made his trip successful or not.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלּוּ הַגְּמַלִּים לִשְׁתּוֹת וַיִּקַּח הָאִישׁ נֶזֶם זָהָב בֶּקַע מִשְׁקָלוֹ וּשְׁנֵי צְמִידִים עַל יָדֶיהָ עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מִשְׁקָלָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלּוּ הַגְּמַלִּים לִשְׁתּוֹת וַיִּקַּח הָאִישׁ נֶזֶם זָהָב בֶּקַע מִשְׁקָלוֹ וּשְׁנֵי צְמִידִים עַל יָדֶיהָ עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מִשְׁקָלָם׃

english.text:
And it was when the camels finished drinking: and the man
took a gold ring—its weight was a beqa—and two bracelets
for her arms—their weight was ten of gold.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;

verses.english:
And it was when the camels finished drinking: and the man
took a gold ring—its weight was a beqa—and two bracelets
for her arms—their weight was ten of gold.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בַּת מִי אַתְּ הַגִּידִי נָא לִי הֲיֵשׁ בֵּית אָבִיךְ מָקוֹם לָנוּ לָלִין׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בַּת מִי אַתְּ הַגִּידִי נָא לִי הֲיֵשׁ בֵּית אָבִיךְ מָקוֹם לָנוּ לָלִין׃

english.text:
And he said, “Tell me, whose daughter are you? Is there a
place at your father’s house for us to spend the night?”

translation.text: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father’s house for us to lodge in?

verses.english:
And he said, “Tell me, whose daughter are you? Is there a
place at your father’s house for us to spend the night?”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בַּת בְּתוּאֵל אָנֹכִי בֶּן מִלְכָּה אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְנָחוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בַּת בְּתוּאֵל אָנֹכִי בֶּן מִלְכָּה אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְנָחוֹר׃

english.text:
And she said to him, “I’m a daughter of Bethuel, Milcah’s
son whom she bore to Nahor.”

translation.text: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.

verses.english:
And she said to him, “I’m a daughter of Bethuel, Milcah’s
son whom she bore to Nahor.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו גַּם תֶּבֶן גַּם מִסְפּוֹא רַב עִמָּנוּ גַּם מָקוֹם לָלוּן׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו גַּם תֶּבֶן גַּם מִסְפּוֹא רַב עִמָּנוּ גַּם מָקוֹם לָלוּן׃

english.text:
And she said to him, “We also have plenty of both straw
and fodder, also a place to spend the night.”

translation.text: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.

verses.english:
And she said to him, “We also have plenty of both straw
and fodder, also a place to spend the night.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקֹּד הָאִישׁ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקֹּד הָאִישׁ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text: And the man knelt and bowed to YHWH

translation.text: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the LORD.

verses.english: And the man knelt and bowed to YHWH

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲדֹנִי אַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא עָזַב חַסְדּוֹ וַאֲמִתּוֹ מֵעִם אֲדֹנִי אָנֹכִי בַּדֶּרֶךְ נָחַנִי יְהֹוָה בֵּית אֲחֵי אֲדֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲדֹנִי אַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא עָזַב חַסְדּוֹ וַאֲמִתּוֹ מֵעִם אֲדֹנִי אָנֹכִי בַּדֶּרֶךְ נָחַנִי יְהֹוָה בֵּית אֲחֵי אֲדֹנִי׃

english.text:
and said, “Blessed is YHWH, God of my lord Abraham, whose
kindness and faithfulness have not left my lord. I: YHWH
has led me to the house of my lord’s brother.”

translation.text: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master’s brethren.

verses.english:
and said, “Blessed is YHWH, God of my lord Abraham, whose
kindness and faithfulness have not left my lord. I: YHWH
has led me to the house of my lord’s brother.”

verses.hebrew: וַתָּרץ הַנַּעֲרָ וַתַּגֵּד לְבֵית אִמָּהּ כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּרץ הַנַּעֲרָ וַתַּגֵּד לְבֵית אִמָּהּ כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
And the girl ran and told her mother’s household about
these things.

translation.text: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother’s house these things.

verses.english:
And the girl ran and told her mother’s household about
these things.

verses.hebrew: וּלְרִבְקָה אָח וּשְׁמוֹ לָבָן וַיָּרץ לָבָן אֶל הָאִישׁ הַחוּצָה אֶל הָעָיִן׃

hebrew.text: וּלְרִבְקָה אָח וּשְׁמוֹ לָבָן וַיָּרץ לָבָן אֶל הָאִישׁ הַחוּצָה אֶל הָעָיִן׃

english.text:
And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban, and
Laban ran outside to the man, at the spring.

translation.text: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.

verses.english:
And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban, and
Laban ran outside to the man, at the spring.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאֹת אֶת הַנֶּזֶם וְאֶת הַצְּמִדִים עַל יְדֵי אֲחֹתוֹ וּכְשׁמְעוֹ אֶת דִּבְרֵי רִבְקָה אֲחֹתוֹ לֵאמֹר כֹּה דִבֶּר אֵלַי הָאִישׁ וַיָּבֹא אֶל הָאִישׁ וְהִנֵּה עֹמֵד עַל הַגְּמַלִּים עַל הָעָיִן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאֹת אֶת הַנֶּזֶם וְאֶת הַצְּמִדִים עַל יְדֵי אֲחֹתוֹ וּכְשׁמְעוֹ אֶת דִּבְרֵי רִבְקָה אֲחֹתוֹ לֵאמֹר כֹּה דִבֶּר אֵלַי הָאִישׁ וַיָּבֹא אֶל הָאִישׁ וְהִנֵּה עֹמֵד עַל הַגְּמַלִּים עַל הָעָיִן׃

english.text:
And it was when he saw the ring and the bracelets on his
sister’s hands and when he heard his sister Rebekah’s
words, saying, “The man spoke like this to me.” And he
came to the man, and here he was standing by the camels at
the spring.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.

verses.english:
And it was when he saw the ring and the bracelets on his
sister’s hands and when he heard his sister Rebekah’s
words, saying, “The man spoke like this to me.” And he
came to the man, and here he was standing by the camels at
the spring.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בּוֹא בְּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה לָמָּה תַעֲמֹד בַּחוּץ וְאָנֹכִי פִּנִּיתִי הַבַּיִת וּמָקוֹם לַגְּמַלִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בּוֹא בְּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה לָמָּה תַעֲמֹד בַּחוּץ וְאָנֹכִי פִּנִּיתִי הַבַּיִת וּמָקוֹם לַגְּמַלִּים׃

english.text:
And he said, “Come, blessed one of YHWH. Why do you stand
outside when I’ve prepared the house and a place for the
camels!”

translation.text: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.

verses.english:
And he said, “Come, blessed one of YHWH. Why do you stand
outside when I’ve prepared the house and a place for the
camels!”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הָאִישׁ הַבַּיְתָה וַיְפַתַּח הַגְּמַלִּים וַיִּתֵּן תֶּבֶן וּמִסְפּוֹא לַגְּמַלִּים וּמַיִם לִרְחֹץ רַגְלָיו וְרַגְלֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא הָאִישׁ הַבַּיְתָה וַיְפַתַּח הַגְּמַלִּים וַיִּתֵּן תֶּבֶן וּמִסְפּוֹא לַגְּמַלִּים וּמַיִם לִרְחֹץ רַגְלָיו וְרַגְלֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And the man came to the house and unloaded the camels and
gave straw and fodder to the camels and water to wash his
feet and the feet of the people who were with him.

translation.text: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men’s feet that were with him.

verses.english:
And the man came to the house and unloaded the camels and
gave straw and fodder to the camels and water to wash his
feet and the feet of the people who were with him.

verses.hebrew: (ויישם) [וַיּוּשַׂם] לְפָנָיו לֶאֱכֹל וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֹכַל עַד אִם דִּבַּרְתִּי דְּבָרָי וַיֹּאמֶר דַּבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: (ויישם) [וַיּוּשַׂם] לְפָנָיו לֶאֱכֹל וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֹכַל עַד אִם דִּבַּרְתִּי דְּבָרָי וַיֹּאמֶר דַּבֵּר׃

english.text:
And [bread] was set in front of him to eat. And he said,
“I won’t eat until I’ve said what I have to say.” And he
said, “Speak.”

translation.text: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.

verses.english:
And [bread] was set in front of him to eat. And he said,
“I won’t eat until I’ve said what I have to say.” And he
said, “Speak.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר עֶבֶד אַבְרָהָם אָנֹכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר עֶבֶד אַבְרָהָם אָנֹכִי׃

english.text: And he said, “I am Abraham’s servant.

translation.text: And he said, I am Abraham’s servant.

verses.english: And he said, “I am Abraham’s servant.

verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה בֵּרַךְ אֶת אֲדֹנִי מְאֹד וַיִּגְדָּל וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ צֹאן וּבָקָר וְכֶסֶף וְזָהָב וַעֲבָדִם וּשְׁפָחֹת וּגְמַלִּים וַחֲמֹרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה בֵּרַךְ אֶת אֲדֹנִי מְאֹד וַיִּגְדָּל וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ צֹאן וּבָקָר וְכֶסֶף וְזָהָב וַעֲבָדִם וּשְׁפָחֹת וּגְמַלִּים וַחֲמֹרִים׃

english.text:
And YHWH has blessed my lord very much, and he has become
great. And He has given him a flock and oxen and silver
and gold and male and female servants and camels and
asses.

translation.text: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.

verses.english:
And YHWH has blessed my lord very much, and he has become
great. And He has given him a flock and oxen and silver
and gold and male and female servants and camels and
asses.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד שָׂרָה אֵשֶׁת אֲדֹנִי בֵן לַאדֹנִי אַחֲרֵי זִקְנָתָהּ וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ אֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד שָׂרָה אֵשֶׁת אֲדֹנִי בֵן לַאדֹנִי אַחֲרֵי זִקְנָתָהּ וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ אֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ׃

english.text:
And my lord’s wife Sarah gave birth to a son by my lord in
her old age, and he has given him everything that he has.

translation.text: And Sarah my master’s wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.

verses.english:
And my lord’s wife Sarah gave birth to a son by my lord in
her old age, and he has given him everything that he has.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁבִּעֵנִי אֲדֹנִי לֵאמֹר לֹא תִקַּח אִשָּׁה לִבְנִי מִבְּנוֹת הַכְּנַעֲנִי אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי יֹשֵׁב בְּאַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁבִּעֵנִי אֲדֹנִי לֵאמֹר לֹא תִקַּח אִשָּׁה לִבְנִי מִבְּנוֹת הַכְּנַעֲנִי אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי יֹשֵׁב בְּאַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
And my lord had me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a
wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanite in
whose land I live,

translation.text: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:

verses.english:
And my lord had me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a
wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanite in
whose land I live,

verses.hebrew: אִם לֹא אֶל בֵּית אָבִי תֵּלֵךְ וְאֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתִּי וְלָקַחְתָּ אִשָּׁה לִבְנִי׃

hebrew.text: אִם לֹא אֶל בֵּית אָבִי תֵּלֵךְ וְאֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתִּי וְלָקַחְתָּ אִשָּׁה לִבְנִי׃

english.text:
but you shall go to my father’s house and to my family and
take a wife for my son.’

translation.text: But thou shalt go unto my father’s house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.

verses.english:
but you shall go to my father’s house and to my family and
take a wife for my son.’

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אֶל אֲדֹנִי אֻלַי לֹא תֵלֵךְ הָאִשָּׁה אַחֲרָי׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר אֶל אֲדֹנִי אֻלַי לֹא תֵלֵךְ הָאִשָּׁה אַחֲרָי׃

english.text: And I said to my lord, ‘Maybe the woman won’t follow me.’

translation.text: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.

verses.english: And I said to my lord, ‘Maybe the woman won’t follow me.’

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי לְפָנָיו יִשְׁלַח מַלְאָכוֹ אִתָּךְ וְהִצְלִיחַ דַּרְכֶּךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ אִשָּׁה לִבְנִי מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתִּי וּמִבֵּית אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי לְפָנָיו יִשְׁלַח מַלְאָכוֹ אִתָּךְ וְהִצְלִיחַ דַּרְכֶּךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ אִשָּׁה לִבְנִי מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתִּי וּמִבֵּית אָבִי׃

english.text:
And he said to me, ‘YHWH, before whom I have walked, will
send His angel with you and make your trip successful, and
you shall take a wife for my son from my family and from
my father’s house.

translation.text: And he said unto me, The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father’s house:

verses.english:
And he said to me, ‘YHWH, before whom I have walked, will
send His angel with you and make your trip successful, and
you shall take a wife for my son from my family and from
my father’s house.

verses.hebrew: אָז תִּנָּקֶה מֵאָלָתִי כִּי תָבוֹא אֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתִּי וְאִם לֹא יִתְּנוּ לָךְ וְהָיִיתָ נָקִי מֵאָלָתִי׃

hebrew.text: אָז תִּנָּקֶה מֵאָלָתִי כִּי תָבוֹא אֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתִּי וְאִם לֹא יִתְּנוּ לָךְ וְהָיִיתָ נָקִי מֵאָלָתִי׃

english.text:
Then you’ll be freed from my oath: when you’ll come to my
family, and if they won’t give her to you, then you’ll be
free from my oath.’

translation.text: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.

verses.english:
Then you’ll be freed from my oath: when you’ll come to my
family, and if they won’t give her to you, then you’ll be
free from my oath.’

verses.hebrew: וָאָבֹא הַיּוֹם אֶל הָעָיִן וָאֹמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲדֹנִי אַבְרָהָם אִם יֶשְׁךָ נָּא מַצְלִיחַ דַּרְכִּי אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי הֹלֵךְ עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וָאָבֹא הַיּוֹם אֶל הָעָיִן וָאֹמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲדֹנִי אַבְרָהָם אִם יֶשְׁךָ נָּא מַצְלִיחַ דַּרְכִּי אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי הֹלֵךְ עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And I came to the spring today and I said, ‘YHWH, God of
my lord Abraham, if you’re making my trip on which I’m
going successful,

translation.text: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:

verses.english:
And I came to the spring today and I said, ‘YHWH, God of
my lord Abraham, if you’re making my trip on which I’m
going successful,

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי נִצָּב עַל עֵין הַמָּיִם וְהָיָה הָעַלְמָה הַיֹּצֵאת לִשְׁאֹב וְאָמַרְתִּי אֵלֶיהָ הַשְׁקִינִי נָא מְעַט מַיִם מִכַּדֵּךְ׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי נִצָּב עַל עֵין הַמָּיִם וְהָיָה הָעַלְמָה הַיֹּצֵאת לִשְׁאֹב וְאָמַרְתִּי אֵלֶיהָ הַשְׁקִינִי נָא מְעַט מַיִם מִכַּדֵּךְ׃

english.text:
here I am, standing at the spring of water, and let it be
that the young woman who goes to draw water and I say to
her, “Let me drink a little water from your jar,”

translation.text: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;

verses.english:
here I am, standing at the spring of water, and let it be
that the young woman who goes to draw water and I say to
her, “Let me drink a little water from your jar,”

verses.hebrew: וְאָמְרָה אֵלַי גַּם אַתָּה שְׁתֵה וְגַם לִגְמַלֶּיךָ אֶשְׁאָב הִוא הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר הֹכִיחַ יְהֹוָה לְבֶן אֲדֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמְרָה אֵלַי גַּם אַתָּה שְׁתֵה וְגַם לִגְמַלֶּיךָ אֶשְׁאָב הִוא הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר הֹכִיחַ יְהֹוָה לְבֶן אֲדֹנִי׃

english.text:
and she says to me, “Both drink yourself and I’ll draw
water for your camels, too,” she will be the woman whom
YHWH has designated for my lord’s son.’

translation.text: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed out for my master’s son.

verses.english:
and she says to me, “Both drink yourself and I’ll draw
water for your camels, too,” she will be the woman whom
YHWH has designated for my lord’s son.’

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי טֶרֶם אֲכַלֶּה לְדַבֵּר אֶל לִבִּי וְהִנֵּה רִבְקָה יֹצֵאת וְכַדָּהּ עַל שִׁכְמָהּ וַתֵּרֶד הָעַיְנָה וַתִּשְׁאָב וָאֹמַר אֵלֶיהָ הַשְׁקִינִי נָא׃

hebrew.text: אֲנִי טֶרֶם אֲכַלֶּה לְדַבֵּר אֶל לִבִּי וְהִנֵּה רִבְקָה יֹצֵאת וְכַדָּהּ עַל שִׁכְמָהּ וַתֵּרֶד הָעַיְנָה וַתִּשְׁאָב וָאֹמַר אֵלֶיהָ הַשְׁקִינִי נָא׃

english.text:
I hadn’t even finished speaking in my heart, and here was
Rebekah coming out, and her jar was on her shoulder, and
she went down to the spring and drew water. And I said to
her, ‘Give me a drink.’

translation.text: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.

verses.english:
I hadn’t even finished speaking in my heart, and here was
Rebekah coming out, and her jar was on her shoulder, and
she went down to the spring and drew water. And I said to
her, ‘Give me a drink.’

verses.hebrew: וַתְּמַהֵר וַתּוֹרֶד כַּדָּהּ מֵעָלֶיהָ וַתֹּאמֶר שְׁתֵה וְגַם גְּמַלֶּיךָ אַשְׁקֶה וָאֵשְׁתְּ וְגַם הַגְּמַלִּים הִשְׁקָתָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּמַהֵר וַתּוֹרֶד כַּדָּהּ מֵעָלֶיהָ וַתֹּאמֶר שְׁתֵה וְגַם גְּמַלֶּיךָ אַשְׁקֶה וָאֵשְׁתְּ וְגַם הַגְּמַלִּים הִשְׁקָתָה׃

english.text:
And she hurried and lowered her jar from on her and said,
‘Drink, and I’ll water your camels, too.’ And I drank, and
she watered the camels, too.

translation.text: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.

verses.english:
And she hurried and lowered her jar from on her and said,
‘Drink, and I’ll water your camels, too.’ And I drank, and
she watered the camels, too.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁאַל אֹתָהּ וָאֹמַר בַּת מִי אַתְּ וַתֹּאמֶר בַּת בְּתוּאֵל בֶּן נָחוֹר אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לּוֹ מִלְכָּה וָאָשִׂם הַנֶּזֶם עַל אַפָּהּ וְהַצְּמִידִים עַל יָדֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶשְׁאַל אֹתָהּ וָאֹמַר בַּת מִי אַתְּ וַתֹּאמֶר בַּת בְּתוּאֵל בֶּן נָחוֹר אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לּוֹ מִלְכָּה וָאָשִׂם הַנֶּזֶם עַל אַפָּהּ וְהַצְּמִידִים עַל יָדֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And I asked her and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ And
she said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, son of Nahor, whom
Milcah bore for him.’ And I put the ring on her nose and
the bracelets on her hands,

translation.text: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, the daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.

verses.english:
And I asked her and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ And
she said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, son of Nahor, whom
Milcah bore for him.’ And I put the ring on her nose and
the bracelets on her hands,

verses.hebrew: וָאֶקֹּד וָאֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לַיהֹוָה וָאֲבָרֵךְ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲדֹנִי אַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר הִנְחַנִי בְּדֶרֶךְ אֱמֶת לָקַחַת אֶת בַּת אֲחִי אֲדֹנִי לִבְנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶקֹּד וָאֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לַיהֹוָה וָאֲבָרֵךְ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲדֹנִי אַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר הִנְחַנִי בְּדֶרֶךְ אֱמֶת לָקַחַת אֶת בַּת אֲחִי אֲדֹנִי לִבְנוֹ׃

english.text:
and I knelt and bowed to YHWH and blessed YHWH, my lord
Abraham’s God, who had led me in a faithful way to take a
daughter of my lord’s brother for his son.

translation.text: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the LORD, and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter unto his son.

verses.english:
and I knelt and bowed to YHWH and blessed YHWH, my lord
Abraham’s God, who had led me in a faithful way to take a
daughter of my lord’s brother for his son.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אִם יֶשְׁכֶם עֹשִׂים חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת אֶת אֲדֹנִי הַגִּידוּ לִי וְאִם לֹא הַגִּידוּ לִי וְאֶפְנֶה עַל יָמִין אוֹ עַל שְׂמֹאל׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אִם יֶשְׁכֶם עֹשִׂים חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת אֶת אֲדֹנִי הַגִּידוּ לִי וְאִם לֹא הַגִּידוּ לִי וְאֶפְנֶה עַל יָמִין אוֹ עַל שְׂמֹאל׃

english.text:
And now, if you’re exercising kindness and faithfulness
with my lord, tell me; and if not, tell me; so I’ll turn
to right or to left.”

translation.text: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.

verses.english:
And now, if you’re exercising kindness and faithfulness
with my lord, tell me; and if not, tell me; so I’ll turn
to right or to left.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן לָבָן וּבְתוּאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵיְהֹוָה יָצָא הַדָּבָר לֹא נוּכַל דַּבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ רַע אוֹ טוֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן לָבָן וּבְתוּאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵיְהֹוָה יָצָא הַדָּבָר לֹא נוּכַל דַּבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ רַע אוֹ טוֹב׃

english.text:
And Laban and Bethuel answered, and they said, “The thing
has come from YHWH. We can’t speak bad or good to you.

translation.text: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the LORD: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.

verses.english:
And Laban and Bethuel answered, and they said, “The thing
has come from YHWH. We can’t speak bad or good to you.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה רִבְקָה לְפָנֶיךָ קַח וָלֵךְ וּתְהִי אִשָּׁה לְבֶן אֲדֹנֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה רִבְקָה לְפָנֶיךָ קַח וָלֵךְ וּתְהִי אִשָּׁה לְבֶן אֲדֹנֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Here is Rebekah before you. Take her and go, and let her
be a wife to your lord’s son as YHWH has spoken.”

translation.text: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master’s son’s wife, as the LORD hath spoken.

verses.english:
Here is Rebekah before you. Take her and go, and let her
be a wife to your lord’s son as YHWH has spoken.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע עֶבֶד אַבְרָהָם אֶת דִּבְרֵיהֶם וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ אַרְצָה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע עֶבֶד אַבְרָהָם אֶת דִּבְרֵיהֶם וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ אַרְצָה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And it was, when Abraham’s servant heard their words, that
he bowed to the ground to YHWH.

translation.text: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham’s servant heard their words, he worshipped the LORD, bowing himself to the earth.

verses.english:
And it was, when Abraham’s servant heard their words, that
he bowed to the ground to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצֵא הָעֶבֶד כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב וּבְגָדִים וַיִּתֵּן לְרִבְקָה וּמִגְדָּנֹת נָתַן לְאָחִיהָ וּלְאִמָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹצֵא הָעֶבֶד כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב וּבְגָדִים וַיִּתֵּן לְרִבְקָה וּמִגְדָּנֹת נָתַן לְאָחִיהָ וּלְאִמָּהּ׃

english.text:
And the servant brought out silver articles and gold
articles and garments and gave them to Rebekah and gave
precious things to her brother and to her mother.

translation.text: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.

verses.english:
And the servant brought out silver articles and gold
articles and garments and gave them to Rebekah and gave
precious things to her brother and to her mother.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ הוּא וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ וַיָּלִינוּ וַיָּקוּמוּ בַבֹּקֶר וַיֹּאמֶר שַׁלְּחֻנִי לַאדֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ הוּא וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ וַיָּלִינוּ וַיָּקוּמוּ בַבֹּקֶר וַיֹּאמֶר שַׁלְּחֻנִי לַאדֹנִי׃

english.text:
And they ate and drank, he and the people who were with
him, and spent the night. And they got up in the morning,
and he said, “Send me back to my lord.”

translation.text: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.

verses.english:
And they ate and drank, he and the people who were with
him, and spent the night. And they got up in the morning,
and he said, “Send me back to my lord.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָחִיהָ וְאִמָּהּ תֵּשֵׁב הַנַּעֲרָ אִתָּנוּ יָמִים אוֹ עָשׂוֹר אַחַר תֵּלֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָחִיהָ וְאִמָּהּ תֵּשֵׁב הַנַּעֲרָ אִתָּנוּ יָמִים אוֹ עָשׂוֹר אַחַר תֵּלֵךְ׃

english.text:
And her brother and her mother said, “Let the girl stay
with us a few days—or ten. After that, she’ll go.”

translation.text: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.

verses.english:
And her brother and her mother said, “Let the girl stay
with us a few days—or ten. After that, she’ll go.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַל תְּאַחֲרוּ אֹתִי וַיהֹוָה הִצְלִיחַ דַּרְכִּי שַׁלְּחוּנִי וְאֵלְכָה לַאדֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַל תְּאַחֲרוּ אֹתִי וַיהֹוָה הִצְלִיחַ דַּרְכִּי שַׁלְּחוּנִי וְאֵלְכָה לַאדֹנִי׃

english.text:
And he said to them, “Don’t hold me back, since YHWH has
made my trip successful. Send me away, so I may go to my
lord.”

translation.text: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.

verses.english:
And he said to them, “Don’t hold me back, since YHWH has
made my trip successful. Send me away, so I may go to my
lord.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ נִקְרָא לַנַּעֲרָ וְנִשְׁאֲלָה אֶת פִּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ נִקְרָא לַנַּעֲרָ וְנִשְׁאֲלָה אֶת פִּיהָ׃

english.text:
And they said, “We’ll call the girl and ask her from her
own mouth.”

translation.text: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.

verses.english:
And they said, “We’ll call the girl and ask her from her
own mouth.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ לְרִבְקָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלֶיהָ הֲתֵלְכִי עִם הָאִישׁ הַזֶּה וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ לְרִבְקָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלֶיהָ הֲתֵלְכִי עִם הָאִישׁ הַזֶּה וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלֵךְ׃

english.text:
And they called Re-bekah and said to her, “Will you go
with this man?” And she said, “I’ll go.”

translation.text: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.

verses.english:
And they called Re-bekah and said to her, “Will you go
with this man?” And she said, “I’ll go.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ אֶת רִבְקָה אֲחֹתָם וְאֶת מֵנִקְתָּהּ וְאֶת עֶבֶד אַבְרָהָם וְאֶת אֲנָשָׁיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ אֶת רִבְקָה אֲחֹתָם וְאֶת מֵנִקְתָּהּ וְאֶת עֶבֶד אַבְרָהָם וְאֶת אֲנָשָׁיו׃

english.text:
And they sent their sister Rebekah and her nurse and
Abraham’s servant and his people.

translation.text: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham’s servant, and his men.

verses.english:
And they sent their sister Rebekah and her nurse and
Abraham’s servant and his people.

verses.hebrew: וַיְבָרְכוּ אֶת רִבְקָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהּ אֲחֹתֵנוּ אַתְּ הֲיִי לְאַלְפֵי רְבָבָה וְיִירַשׁ זַרְעֵךְ אֵת שַׁעַר שֹׂנְאָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבָרְכוּ אֶת רִבְקָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהּ אֲחֹתֵנוּ אַתְּ הֲיִי לְאַלְפֵי רְבָבָה וְיִירַשׁ זַרְעֵךְ אֵת שַׁעַר שֹׂנְאָיו׃

english.text:
And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, “You’re our
sister. Become thousands of ten-thousands. And may your
seed possess the gate of those who hate him.”

translation.text: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.

verses.english:
And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, “You’re our
sister. Become thousands of ten-thousands. And may your
seed possess the gate of those who hate him.”

verses.hebrew: וַתָּקם רִבְקָה וְנַעֲרֹתֶיהָ וַתִּרְכַּבְנָה עַל הַגְּמַלִּים וַתֵּלַכְנָה אַחֲרֵי הָאִישׁ וַיִּקַּח הָעֶבֶד אֶת רִבְקָה וַיֵּלַךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּקם רִבְקָה וְנַעֲרֹתֶיהָ וַתִּרְכַּבְנָה עַל הַגְּמַלִּים וַתֵּלַכְנָה אַחֲרֵי הָאִישׁ וַיִּקַּח הָעֶבֶד אֶת רִבְקָה וַיֵּלַךְ׃

english.text:
And Rebekah and her maids got up and rode on the camels
and followed the man, and the servant took Rebekah and
went.

translation.text: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

verses.english:
And Rebekah and her maids got up and rode on the camels
and followed the man, and the servant took Rebekah and
went.

verses.hebrew: וְיִצְחָק בָּא מִבּוֹא בְּאֵר לַחַי רֹאִי וְהוּא יוֹשֵׁב בְּאֶרֶץ הַנֶּגֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְיִצְחָק בָּא מִבּוֹא בְּאֵר לַחַי רֹאִי וְהוּא יוֹשֵׁב בְּאֶרֶץ הַנֶּגֶב׃

english.text:
And Isaac was coming from the area of the well Lahai-roi,
and he was living in the territory of the Negeb,

translation.text: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahairoi; for he dwelt in the south country.

verses.english:
And Isaac was coming from the area of the well Lahai-roi,
and he was living in the territory of the Negeb,

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא יִצְחָק לָשׂוּחַ בַּשָּׂדֶה לִפְנוֹת עָרֶב וַיִּשָּׂא עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה גְמַלִּים בָּאִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא יִצְחָק לָשׂוּחַ בַּשָּׂדֶה לִפְנוֹת עָרֶב וַיִּשָּׂא עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה גְמַלִּים בָּאִים׃

english.text:
and Isaac went to meditate in a field toward evening, and
he raised his eyes and saw, and here were camels coming.

translation.text: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.

verses.english:
and Isaac went to meditate in a field toward evening, and
he raised his eyes and saw, and here were camels coming.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּשָּׂא רִבְקָה אֶת עֵינֶיהָ וַתֵּרֶא אֶת יִצְחָק וַתִּפֹּל מֵעַל הַגָּמָל׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּשָּׂא רִבְקָה אֶת עֵינֶיהָ וַתֵּרֶא אֶת יִצְחָק וַתִּפֹּל מֵעַל הַגָּמָל׃

english.text:
And Rebekah raised her eyes and saw Isaac, and she fell
from the camel.

translation.text: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.

verses.english:
And Rebekah raised her eyes and saw Isaac, and she fell
from the camel.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל הָעֶבֶד מִי הָאִישׁ הַלָּזֶה הַהֹלֵךְ בַּשָּׂדֶה לִקְרָאתֵנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר הָעֶבֶד הוּא אֲדֹנִי וַתִּקַּח הַצָּעִיף וַתִּתְכָּס׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל הָעֶבֶד מִי הָאִישׁ הַלָּזֶה הַהֹלֵךְ בַּשָּׂדֶה לִקְרָאתֵנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר הָעֶבֶד הוּא אֲדֹנִי וַתִּקַּח הַצָּעִיף וַתִּתְכָּס׃

english.text:
And she said to the servant, “Who is that man who’s
walking in the field toward us?” And the servant said,
“He’s my lord.” And she took a veil and covered herself.

translation.text: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.

verses.english:
And she said to the servant, “Who is that man who’s
walking in the field toward us?” And the servant said,
“He’s my lord.” And she took a veil and covered herself.

verses.hebrew: וַיְסַפֵּר הָעֶבֶד לְיִצְחָק אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְסַפֵּר הָעֶבֶד לְיִצְחָק אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

english.text:
And the servant told Isaac all the things that he had
done.

translation.text: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.

verses.english:
And the servant told Isaac all the things that he had
done.

verses.hebrew: וַיְבִאֶהָ יִצְחָק הָאֹהֱלָה שָׂרָה אִמּוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת רִבְקָה וַתְּהִי לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וַיֶּאֱהָבֶהָ וַיִּנָּחֵם יִצְחָק אַחֲרֵי אִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבִאֶהָ יִצְחָק הָאֹהֱלָה שָׂרָה אִמּוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת רִבְקָה וַתְּהִי לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וַיֶּאֱהָבֶהָ וַיִּנָּחֵם יִצְחָק אַחֲרֵי אִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Isaac brought her to his mother Sarah’s tent. And he
took Rebekah, and she became his wife, and he loved her.
And Isaac was consoled after his mother.

translation.text: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.

verses.english:
And Isaac brought her to his mother Sarah’s tent. And he
took Rebekah, and she became his wife, and he loved her.
And Isaac was consoled after his mother.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף אַבְרָהָם וַיִּקַּח אִשָּׁה וּשְׁמָהּ קְטוּרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסֶף אַבְרָהָם וַיִּקַּח אִשָּׁה וּשְׁמָהּ קְטוּרָה׃

english.text:
And Abraham went on and took a wife, and her name was
Keturah,

translation.text: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.

verses.english:
And Abraham went on and took a wife, and her name was
Keturah,

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֶת זִמְרָן וְאֶת יקְשָׁן וְאֶת מְדָן וְאֶת מִדְיָן וְאֶת יִשְׁבָּק וְאֶת שׁוּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֶת זִמְרָן וְאֶת יקְשָׁן וְאֶת מְדָן וְאֶת מִדְיָן וְאֶת יִשְׁבָּק וְאֶת שׁוּחַ׃

english.text:
and she gave birth to Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and
Midian and Ishbak and Shuah for him.

translation.text: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

verses.english:
and she gave birth to Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and
Midian and Ishbak and Shuah for him.

verses.hebrew: וְיקְשָׁן יָלַד אֶת שְׁבָא וְאֶת דְּדָן וּבְנֵי דְדָן הָיוּ אַשּׁוּרִם וּלְטוּשִׁם וּלְאֻמִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְיקְשָׁן יָלַד אֶת שְׁבָא וְאֶת דְּדָן וּבְנֵי דְדָן הָיוּ אַשּׁוּרִם וּלְטוּשִׁם וּלְאֻמִּים׃

english.text:
And Jokshan fathered Sheba and Dedan. And the children of
Dedan were Ashurim and Letushim and Leummim.

translation.text: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.

verses.english:
And Jokshan fathered Sheba and Dedan. And the children of
Dedan were Ashurim and Letushim and Leummim.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי מִדְיָן עֵיפָה וָעֵפֶר וַחֲנֹךְ וַאֲבִידָע וְאֶלְדָּעָה כּל אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי קְטוּרָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי מִדְיָן עֵיפָה וָעֵפֶר וַחֲנֹךְ וַאֲבִידָע וְאֶלְדָּעָה כּל אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי קְטוּרָה׃

english.text:
And the children of Midian: Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and
Abida and Eldaah. All these were children of Keturah.

translation.text: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

verses.english:
And the children of Midian: Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and
Abida and Eldaah. All these were children of Keturah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אַבְרָהָם אֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ לְיִצְחָק׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן אַבְרָהָם אֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ לְיִצְחָק׃

english.text: And Abraham gave everything that he had to Isaac.

translation.text: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.

verses.english: And Abraham gave everything that he had to Isaac.

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי הַפִּילַגְשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לְאַבְרָהָם נָתַן אַבְרָהָם מַתָּנֹת וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם מֵעַל יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ בְּעוֹדֶנּוּ חַי קֵדְמָה אֶל אֶרֶץ קֶדֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְלִבְנֵי הַפִּילַגְשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לְאַבְרָהָם נָתַן אַבְרָהָם מַתָּנֹת וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם מֵעַל יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ בְּעוֹדֶנּוּ חַי קֵדְמָה אֶל אֶרֶץ קֶדֶם׃

english.text:
And Abraham gave gifts to the children of the concubines
that Abraham had, and he sent them away from Isaac, his
son, while he was still living: east, to the land of the
East.

translation.text: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.

verses.english:
And Abraham gave gifts to the children of the concubines
that Abraham had, and he sent them away from Isaac, his
son, while he was still living: east, to the land of the
East.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיֵּי אַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר חָי מְאַת שָׁנָה וְשִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיֵּי אַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר חָי מְאַת שָׁנָה וְשִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
And these are the days of the years of Abraham’s life that
he lived: a hundred years and seventy years and five
years.

translation.text: And these are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.

verses.english:
And these are the days of the years of Abraham’s life that
he lived: a hundred years and seventy years and five
years.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְוַע וַיָּמת אַבְרָהָם בְּשֵׂיבָה טוֹבָה זָקֵן וְשָׂבֵעַ וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְוַע וַיָּמת אַבְרָהָם בְּשֵׂיבָה טוֹבָה זָקֵן וְשָׂבֵעַ וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו׃

english.text:
And he expired. And Abraham died at a good old age, old
and full, and was gathered to his people.

translation.text: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.

verses.english:
And he expired. And Abraham died at a good old age, old
and full, and was gathered to his people.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ יִצְחָק וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל בָּנָיו אֶל מְעָרַת הַמַּכְפֵּלָה אֶל שְׂדֵה עֶפְרֹן בֶּן צֹחַר הַחִתִּי אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ יִצְחָק וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל בָּנָיו אֶל מְעָרַת הַמַּכְפֵּלָה אֶל שְׂדֵה עֶפְרֹן בֶּן צֹחַר הַחִתִּי אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵא׃

english.text:
And Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him at the cave of
Machpelah at the field of Ephron, son of Zohar, the
Hittite, facing Mamre,

translation.text: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;

verses.english:
And Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him at the cave of
Machpelah at the field of Ephron, son of Zohar, the
Hittite, facing Mamre,

verses.hebrew: הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה אַבְרָהָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי חֵת שָׁמָּה קֻבַּר אַבְרָהָם וְשָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה אַבְרָהָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי חֵת שָׁמָּה קֻבַּר אַבְרָהָם וְשָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ׃

english.text:
the field that Abraham bought from the children of Heth.
Abraham was buried there—and Sarah, his wife.

translation.text: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.

verses.english:
the field that Abraham bought from the children of Heth.
Abraham was buried there—and Sarah, his wife.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי מוֹת אַבְרָהָם וַיְבָרֶךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיֵּשֶׁב יִצְחָק עִם בְּאֵר לַחַי רֹאִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי מוֹת אַבְרָהָם וַיְבָרֶךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיֵּשֶׁב יִצְחָק עִם בְּאֵר לַחַי רֹאִי׃

english.text:
And it was after Abraham’s death, and God blessed Isaac,
his son. And Isaac lived at the well Lahai-roi.

translation.text: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahairoi.

verses.english:
And it was after Abraham’s death, and God blessed Isaac,
his son. And Isaac lived at the well Lahai-roi.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה תֹּלְדֹת יִשְׁמָעֵאל בֶּן אַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה הָגָר הַמִּצְרִית שִׁפְחַת שָׂרָה לְאַבְרָהָם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה תֹּלְדֹת יִשְׁמָעֵאל בֶּן אַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה הָגָר הַמִּצְרִית שִׁפְחַת שָׂרָה לְאַבְרָהָם׃

english.text:
And these are the records of Ishmael, son of Abraham, to
whom Hagar, the Egyptian, Sarah’s maid, gave birth for
Abraham:

translation.text: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bare unto Abraham:

verses.english:
And these are the records of Ishmael, son of Abraham, to
whom Hagar, the Egyptian, Sarah’s maid, gave birth for
Abraham:

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׁמָעֵאל בִּשְׁמֹתָם לְתוֹלְדֹתָם בְּכֹר יִשְׁמָעֵאל נְבָיֹת וְקֵדָר וְאַדְבְּאֵל וּמִבְשָׂם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׁמָעֵאל בִּשְׁמֹתָם לְתוֹלְדֹתָם בְּכֹר יִשְׁמָעֵאל נְבָיֹת וְקֵדָר וְאַדְבְּאֵל וּמִבְשָׂם׃

english.text:
And these are the names of Ishmael’s sons, by their names,
according to their records: Ishmael’s firstborn was
Nebaioth, and Kedar and Adbeel and Mibsam

translation.text: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

verses.english:
And these are the names of Ishmael’s sons, by their names,
according to their records: Ishmael’s firstborn was
Nebaioth, and Kedar and Adbeel and Mibsam

verses.hebrew: וּמִשְׁמָע וְדוּמָה וּמַשָּׂא׃

hebrew.text: וּמִשְׁמָע וְדוּמָה וּמַשָּׂא׃

english.text: and Mishma and Dumah and Massa,

translation.text: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,

verses.english: and Mishma and Dumah and Massa,

verses.hebrew: חֲדַד וְתֵימָא יְטוּר נָפִישׁ וָקֵדְמָה׃

hebrew.text: חֲדַד וְתֵימָא יְטוּר נָפִישׁ וָקֵדְמָה׃

english.text: Hadar and Tema, Jetur, Naphish and Kedmah.

translation.text: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:

verses.english: Hadar and Tema, Jetur, Naphish and Kedmah.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הֵם בְּנֵי יִשְׁמָעֵאל וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמֹתָם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶם וּבְטִירֹתָם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר נְשִׂיאִם לְאֻמֹּתָם׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה הֵם בְּנֵי יִשְׁמָעֵאל וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמֹתָם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶם וּבְטִירֹתָם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר נְשִׂיאִם לְאֻמֹּתָם׃

english.text:
These are they, Ishmael’s sons, and these are their names
in their settlements and in their encampments, twelve
chieftains by their clans.

translation.text: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.

verses.english:
These are they, Ishmael’s sons, and these are their names
in their settlements and in their encampments, twelve
chieftains by their clans.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁנֵי חַיֵּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל מְאַת שָׁנָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וְשֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וַיִּגְוַע וַיָּמת וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁנֵי חַיֵּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל מְאַת שָׁנָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וְשֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וַיִּגְוַע וַיָּמת וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו׃

english.text:
And these are the years of Ishmael’s life: a hundred years
and thirty years and seven years. And he expired and died
and was gathered to his people.

translation.text: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.

verses.english:
And these are the years of Ishmael’s life: a hundred years
and thirty years and seven years. And he expired and died
and was gathered to his people.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכְּנוּ מֵחֲוִילָה עַד שׁוּר אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי מִצְרַיִם בֹּאֲכָה אַשּׁוּרָה עַל פְּנֵי כל אֶחָיו נָפָל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכְּנוּ מֵחֲוִילָה עַד שׁוּר אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי מִצְרַיִם בֹּאֲכָה אַשּׁוּרָה עַל פְּנֵי כל אֶחָיו נָפָל׃

english.text:
And they tented from Havilah to Shur, which faces Egypt,
as you come toward Asshur. He fell facing all of his
brothers.

translation.text: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.

verses.english:
And they tented from Havilah to Shur, which faces Egypt,
as you come toward Asshur. He fell facing all of his
brothers.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת יִצְחָק בֶּן אַבְרָהָם אַבְרָהָם הוֹלִיד אֶת יִצְחָק׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת יִצְחָק בֶּן אַבְרָהָם אַבְרָהָם הוֹלִיד אֶת יִצְחָק׃

english.text:
And these are the records of Isaac, son of
Abraham: Abraham had fathered Isaac.

translation.text: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son: Abraham begat Isaac:

verses.english:
And these are the records of Isaac, son of
Abraham: Abraham had fathered Isaac.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יִצְחָק בֶּן אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בְּקַחְתּוֹ אֶת רִבְקָה בַּת בְּתוּאֵל הָאֲרַמִּי מִפַּדַּן אֲרָם אֲחוֹת לָבָן הָאֲרַמִּי לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי יִצְחָק בֶּן אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בְּקַחְתּוֹ אֶת רִבְקָה בַּת בְּתוּאֵל הָאֲרַמִּי מִפַּדַּן אֲרָם אֲחוֹת לָבָן הָאֲרַמִּי לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah,
daughter of Bethuel, the Aramean, from Paddan Aram, sister
of Laban, the Aramean, to him as a wife.

translation.text: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padanaram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.

verses.english:
And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah,
daughter of Bethuel, the Aramean, from Paddan Aram, sister
of Laban, the Aramean, to him as a wife.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּעְתַּר יִצְחָק לַיהֹוָה לְנֹכַח אִשְׁתּוֹ כִּי עֲקָרָה הִוא וַיֵּעָתֶר לוֹ יְהֹוָה וַתַּהַר רִבְקָה אִשְׁתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּעְתַּר יִצְחָק לַיהֹוָה לְנֹכַח אִשְׁתּוֹ כִּי עֲקָרָה הִוא וַיֵּעָתֶר לוֹ יְהֹוָה וַתַּהַר רִבְקָה אִשְׁתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Isaac prayed to YHWH for his wife because she was
infertile, and YHWH was prevailed upon by him, and his
wife Rebekah became pregnant.

translation.text: And Isaac intreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren: and the LORD was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

verses.english:
And Isaac prayed to YHWH for his wife because she was
infertile, and YHWH was prevailed upon by him, and his
wife Rebekah became pregnant.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְרֹצְצוּ הַבָּנִים בְּקִרְבָּהּ וַתֹּאמֶר אִם כֵּן לָמָּה זֶּה אָנֹכִי וַתֵּלֶךְ לִדְרֹשׁ אֶת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְרֹצְצוּ הַבָּנִים בְּקִרְבָּהּ וַתֹּאמֶר אִם כֵּן לָמָּה זֶּה אָנֹכִי וַתֵּלֶךְ לִדְרֹשׁ אֶת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the children struggled inside her, and she said, “If
it’s like this, why do I exist?” And she went to inquire
of YHWH.

translation.text: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of the LORD.

verses.english:
And the children struggled inside her, and she said, “If
it’s like this, why do I exist?” And she went to inquire
of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לָהּ שְׁנֵי (גיים) [גוֹיִם] בְּבִטְנֵךְ וּשְׁנֵי לְאֻמִּים מִמֵּעַיִךְ יִפָּרֵדוּ וּלְאֹם מִלְאֹם יֶאֱמָץ וְרַב יַעֲבֹד צָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לָהּ שְׁנֵי (גיים) [גוֹיִם] בְּבִטְנֵךְ וּשְׁנֵי לְאֻמִּים מִמֵּעַיִךְ יִפָּרֵדוּ וּלְאֹם מִלְאֹם יֶאֱמָץ וְרַב יַעֲבֹד צָעִיר׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to her, Two nations are in your womb, and
two peoples will be dispersed from your insides, and one
people will be mightier than the other people, and the
older the younger will serve.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to her, Two nations are in your womb, and
two peoples will be dispersed from your insides, and one
people will be mightier than the other people, and the
older the younger will serve.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְלְאוּ יָמֶיהָ לָלֶדֶת וְהִנֵּה תוֹמִם בְּבִטְנָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְלְאוּ יָמֶיהָ לָלֶדֶת וְהִנֵּה תוֹמִם בְּבִטְנָהּ׃

english.text:
And her days to give birth were completed, and here were
twins in her womb.

translation.text: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

verses.english:
And her days to give birth were completed, and here were
twins in her womb.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הָרִאשׁוֹן אַדְמוֹנִי כֻּלּוֹ כְּאַדֶּרֶת שֵׂעָר וַיִּקְרְאוּ שְׁמוֹ עֵשָׂו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא הָרִאשׁוֹן אַדְמוֹנִי כֻּלּוֹ כְּאַדֶּרֶת שֵׂעָר וַיִּקְרְאוּ שְׁמוֹ עֵשָׂו׃

english.text:
And the first came out all ruddy, like a hairy robe, and
they called his name Esau.

translation.text: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.

verses.english:
And the first came out all ruddy, like a hairy robe, and
they called his name Esau.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יָצָא אָחִיו וְיָדוֹ אֹחֶזֶת בַּעֲקֵב עֵשָׂו וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ יַעֲקֹב וְיִצְחָק בֶּן שִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה בְּלֶדֶת אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יָצָא אָחִיו וְיָדוֹ אֹחֶזֶת בַּעֲקֵב עֵשָׂו וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ יַעֲקֹב וְיִצְחָק בֶּן שִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה בְּלֶדֶת אֹתָם׃

english.text:
And after that his brother came out, and his hand was
holding Esau’s heel, and he called his name Jacob. And
Isaac was sixty years old at their birth.

translation.text: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau’s heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.

verses.english:
And after that his brother came out, and his hand was
holding Esau’s heel, and he called his name Jacob. And
Isaac was sixty years old at their birth.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְדְּלוּ הַנְּעָרִים וַיְהִי עֵשָׂו אִישׁ יֹדֵעַ צַיִד אִישׁ שָׂדֶה וְיַעֲקֹב אִישׁ תָּם יֹשֵׁב אֹהָלִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְדְּלוּ הַנְּעָרִים וַיְהִי עֵשָׂו אִישׁ יֹדֵעַ צַיִד אִישׁ שָׂדֶה וְיַעֲקֹב אִישׁ תָּם יֹשֵׁב אֹהָלִים׃

english.text:
And the boys grew up, and Esau was a man who knew hunting,
a man of the field, and Jacob was a simple man, living in
tents.

translation.text: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.

verses.english:
And the boys grew up, and Esau was a man who knew hunting,
a man of the field, and Jacob was a simple man, living in
tents.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱהַב יִצְחָק אֶת עֵשָׂו כִּי צַיִד בְּפִיו וְרִבְקָה אֹהֶבֶת אֶת יַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאֱהַב יִצְחָק אֶת עֵשָׂו כִּי צַיִד בְּפִיו וְרִבְקָה אֹהֶבֶת אֶת יַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And Isaac loved Esau because he put game meat in his
mouth, and Rebekah loved Jacob.

translation.text: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.

verses.english:
And Isaac loved Esau because he put game meat in his
mouth, and Rebekah loved Jacob.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּזֶד יַעֲקֹב נָזִיד וַיָּבֹא עֵשָׂו מִן הַשָּׂדֶה וְהוּא עָיֵף׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּזֶד יַעֲקֹב נָזִיד וַיָּבֹא עֵשָׂו מִן הַשָּׂדֶה וְהוּא עָיֵף׃

english.text:
And Jacob made a stew, and Esau came from the field, and
he was exhausted.

translation.text: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:

verses.english:
And Jacob made a stew, and Esau came from the field, and
he was exhausted.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר עֵשָׂו אֶל יַעֲקֹב הַלְעִיטֵנִי נָא מִן הָאָדֹם הָאָדֹם הַזֶּה כִּי עָיֵף אָנֹכִי עַל כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמוֹ אֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר עֵשָׂו אֶל יַעֲקֹב הַלְעִיטֵנִי נָא מִן הָאָדֹם הָאָדֹם הַזֶּה כִּי עָיֵף אָנֹכִי עַל כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמוֹ אֱדוֹם׃

english.text:
And Esau said to Jacob, “Will you feed me some of the red
stuff, this red stuff, because I’m exhausted.” (On account
of this he called his name “Edom.”)

translation.text: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.

verses.english:
And Esau said to Jacob, “Will you feed me some of the red
stuff, this red stuff, because I’m exhausted.” (On account
of this he called his name “Edom.”)

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב מִכְרָה כַיּוֹם אֶת בְּכֹרָתְךָ לִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב מִכְרָה כַיּוֹם אֶת בְּכֹרָתְךָ לִי׃

english.text: And Jacob said, “Sell your birthright to me, today.”

translation.text: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.

verses.english: And Jacob said, “Sell your birthright to me, today.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר עֵשָׂו הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הוֹלֵךְ לָמוּת וְלָמָּה זֶּה לִי בְּכֹרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר עֵשָׂו הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הוֹלֵךְ לָמוּת וְלָמָּה זֶּה לִי בְּכֹרָה׃

english.text:
And Esau said, “Here I’m going to die, and what use is
this, that I have a birthright?”

translation.text: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?

verses.english:
And Esau said, “Here I’m going to die, and what use is
this, that I have a birthright?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב הִשָּׁבְעָה לִּי כַּיּוֹם וַיִּשָּׁבַע לוֹ וַיִּמְכֹּר אֶת בְּכֹרָתוֹ לְיַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב הִשָּׁבְעָה לִּי כַּיּוֹם וַיִּשָּׁבַע לוֹ וַיִּמְכֹּר אֶת בְּכֹרָתוֹ לְיַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And Jacob said, “Swear to me, today.” And he swore to him
and sold his birthright to Jacob.

translation.text: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.

verses.english:
And Jacob said, “Swear to me, today.” And he swore to him
and sold his birthright to Jacob.

verses.hebrew: וְיַעֲקֹב נָתַן לְעֵשָׂו לֶחֶם וּנְזִיד עֲדָשִׁים וַיֹּאכַל וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיָּקם וַיֵּלַךְ וַיִּבֶז עֵשָׂו אֶת הַבְּכֹרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיַעֲקֹב נָתַן לְעֵשָׂו לֶחֶם וּנְזִיד עֲדָשִׁים וַיֹּאכַל וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיָּקם וַיֵּלַךְ וַיִּבֶז עֵשָׂו אֶת הַבְּכֹרָה׃

english.text:
And Jacob gave bread and lentil stew to Esau.
And he ate and drank and got up and went.
And Esau disdained the birthright.

translation.text: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.

verses.english:
And Jacob gave bread and lentil stew to Esau.
And he ate and drank and got up and went.
And Esau disdained the birthright.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי רָעָב בָּאָרֶץ מִלְּבַד הָרָעָב הָרִאשׁוֹן אֲשֶׁר הָיָה בִּימֵי אַבְרָהָם וַיֵּלֶךְ יִצְחָק אֶל אֲבִימֶלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ פְּלִשְׁתִּים גְּרָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי רָעָב בָּאָרֶץ מִלְּבַד הָרָעָב הָרִאשׁוֹן אֲשֶׁר הָיָה בִּימֵי אַבְרָהָם וַיֵּלֶךְ יִצְחָק אֶל אֲבִימֶלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ פְּלִשְׁתִּים גְּרָרָה׃

english.text:
And there was a famine in the land (other than the
first famine, which was in Abraham’s days), and Isaac went
to Abimelek, king of the Philistines, at Gerar.

translation.text: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.

verses.english:
And there was a famine in the land (other than the
first famine, which was in Abraham’s days), and Isaac went
to Abimelek, king of the Philistines, at Gerar.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אַל תֵּרֵד מִצְרָיְמָה שְׁכֹן בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אַל תֵּרֵד מִצְרָיְמָה שְׁכֹן בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And YHWH appeared to him and said, “Don’t go down to
Egypt. Reside in the land that I say to you.

translation.text: And the LORD appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:

verses.english:
And YHWH appeared to him and said, “Don’t go down to
Egypt. Reside in the land that I say to you.

verses.hebrew: גּוּר בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וְאֶהְיֶה עִמְּךָ וַאֲבָרְכֶךָּ כִּי לְךָ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת כּל הָאֲרָצֹת הָאֵל וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת הַשְּׁבֻעָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: גּוּר בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וְאֶהְיֶה עִמְּךָ וַאֲבָרְכֶךָּ כִּי לְךָ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת כּל הָאֲרָצֹת הָאֵל וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת הַשְּׁבֻעָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִיךָ׃

english.text:
Stay on in this land, and I’ll be with you and bless you,
for I’ll give all these lands to you and your seed, and
I’ll uphold the oath that I swore to Abraham your father,

translation.text: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;

verses.english:
Stay on in this land, and I’ll be with you and bless you,
for I’ll give all these lands to you and your seed, and
I’ll uphold the oath that I swore to Abraham your father,

verses.hebrew: וְהִרְבֵּיתִי אֶת זַרְעֲךָ כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם וְנָתַתִּי לְזַרְעֲךָ אֵת כּל הָאֲרָצֹת הָאֵל וְהִתְבָּרְכוּ בְזַרְעֲךָ כֹּל גּוֹיֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִרְבֵּיתִי אֶת זַרְעֲךָ כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם וְנָתַתִּי לְזַרְעֲךָ אֵת כּל הָאֲרָצֹת הָאֵל וְהִתְבָּרְכוּ בְזַרְעֲךָ כֹּל גּוֹיֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
and I’ll multiply your seed like the stars of the skies
and give to your seed all these lands, and all the nations
of the earth will be blessed through your seed

translation.text: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;

verses.english:
and I’ll multiply your seed like the stars of the skies
and give to your seed all these lands, and all the nations
of the earth will be blessed through your seed

verses.hebrew: עֵקֶב אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע אַבְרָהָם בְּקֹלִי וַיִּשְׁמֹר מִשְׁמַרְתִּי מִצְוֺתַי חֻקּוֹתַי וְתוֹרֹתָי׃

hebrew.text: עֵקֶב אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע אַבְרָהָם בְּקֹלִי וַיִּשְׁמֹר מִשְׁמַרְתִּי מִצְוֺתַי חֻקּוֹתַי וְתוֹרֹתָי׃

english.text:
because Abraham listened to my voice and kept my watch, my
commandments, my laws, and my instructions.”

translation.text: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.

verses.english:
because Abraham listened to my voice and kept my watch, my
commandments, my laws, and my instructions.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב יִצְחָק בִּגְרָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב יִצְחָק בִּגְרָר׃

english.text: And so Isaac lived in Gerar.

translation.text: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:

verses.english: And so Isaac lived in Gerar.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ אַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם לְאִשְׁתּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲחֹתִי הִוא כִּי יָרֵא לֵאמֹר אִשְׁתִּי פֶּן יַהַרְגֻנִי אַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם עַל רִבְקָה כִּי טוֹבַת מַרְאֶה הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ אַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם לְאִשְׁתּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲחֹתִי הִוא כִּי יָרֵא לֵאמֹר אִשְׁתִּי פֶּן יַהַרְגֻנִי אַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם עַל רִבְקָה כִּי טוֹבַת מַרְאֶה הִוא׃

english.text:
And the people of the place asked about his wife, and he
said, “She’s my sister,” because he was afraid to say, “My
wife,” or else “the people of the place will kill me for
Rebekah, because she’s good-looking.”

translation.text: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.

verses.english:
And the people of the place asked about his wife, and he
said, “She’s my sister,” because he was afraid to say, “My
wife,” or else “the people of the place will kill me for
Rebekah, because she’s good-looking.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי אָרְכוּ לוֹ שָׁם הַיָּמִים וַיַּשְׁקֵף אֲבִימֶלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ פְּלִשְׁתִּים בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה יִצְחָק מְצַחֵק אֵת רִבְקָה אִשְׁתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי אָרְכוּ לוֹ שָׁם הַיָּמִים וַיַּשְׁקֵף אֲבִימֶלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ פְּלִשְׁתִּים בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה יִצְחָק מְצַחֵק אֵת רִבְקָה אִשְׁתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And it was when his days extended there: and Abimelek,
king of the Philistines, gazed through the window, and he
saw: and here was Isaac “fooling around” with Rebekah his
wife!

translation.text: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.

verses.english:
And it was when his days extended there: and Abimelek,
king of the Philistines, gazed through the window, and he
saw: and here was Isaac “fooling around” with Rebekah his
wife!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֲבִימֶלֶךְ לְיִצְחָק וַיֹּאמֶר אַךְ הִנֵּה אִשְׁתְּךָ הִוא וְאֵיךְ אָמַרְתָּ אֲחֹתִי הִוא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יִצְחָק כִּי אָמַרְתִּי פֶּן אָמוּת עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֲבִימֶלֶךְ לְיִצְחָק וַיֹּאמֶר אַךְ הִנֵּה אִשְׁתְּךָ הִוא וְאֵיךְ אָמַרְתָּ אֲחֹתִי הִוא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יִצְחָק כִּי אָמַרְתִּי פֶּן אָמוּת עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And Abimelek called Isaac and said, “But, here, she’s your
wife! And how could you say, ‘She’s my sister’?” And Isaac
said to him, “Because I said, ‘Or else I’ll die over
her.’”

translation.text: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife; and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.

verses.english:
And Abimelek called Isaac and said, “But, here, she’s your
wife! And how could you say, ‘She’s my sister’?” And Isaac
said to him, “Because I said, ‘Or else I’ll die over
her.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ מַה זֹּאת עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ כִּמְעַט שָׁכַב אַחַד הָעָם אֶת אִשְׁתֶּךָ וְהֵבֵאתָ עָלֵינוּ אָשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ מַה זֹּאת עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ כִּמְעַט שָׁכַב אַחַד הָעָם אֶת אִשְׁתֶּךָ וְהֵבֵאתָ עָלֵינוּ אָשָׁם׃

english.text:
And Abimelek said, “What is this you’ve done to us? One of
the people nearly could have lain with your wife, and you
would have brought guilt on us.”

translation.text: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.

verses.english:
And Abimelek said, “What is this you’ve done to us? One of
the people nearly could have lain with your wife, and you
would have brought guilt on us.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶת כּל הָעָם לֵאמֹר הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּאִישׁ הַזֶּה וּבְאִשְׁתּוֹ מוֹת יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶת כּל הָעָם לֵאמֹר הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּאִישׁ הַזֶּה וּבְאִשְׁתּוֹ מוֹת יוּמָת׃

english.text:
And Abimelek commanded all the people saying, “He who
touches this man or his wife will be put to death!”

translation.text: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.

verses.english:
And Abimelek commanded all the people saying, “He who
touches this man or his wife will be put to death!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְרַע יִצְחָק בָּאָרֶץ הַהִוא וַיִּמְצָא בַּשָּׁנָה הַהִוא מֵאָה שְׁעָרִים וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזְרַע יִצְחָק בָּאָרֶץ הַהִוא וַיִּמְצָא בַּשָּׁנָה הַהִוא מֵאָה שְׁעָרִים וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Isaac planted seed in that land, and he harvested a
hundredfold in that year. And YHWH blessed him,

translation.text: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the LORD blessed him.

verses.english:
And Isaac planted seed in that land, and he harvested a
hundredfold in that year. And YHWH blessed him,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְדַּל הָאִישׁ וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וְגָדֵל עַד כִּי גָדַל מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְדַּל הָאִישׁ וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וְגָדֵל עַד כִּי גָדַל מְאֹד׃

english.text:
and the man became great, and he went on getting greater
until he was very great

translation.text: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:

verses.english:
and the man became great, and he went on getting greater
until he was very great

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לוֹ מִקְנֵה צֹאן וּמִקְנֵה בָקָר וַעֲבֻדָּה רַבָּה וַיְקַנְאוּ אֹתוֹ פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לוֹ מִקְנֵה צֹאן וּמִקְנֵה בָקָר וַעֲבֻדָּה רַבָּה וַיְקַנְאוּ אֹתוֹ פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
and had livestock of flocks and livestock of herds and a
large number of servants. And the Philistines envied him.

translation.text: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.

verses.english:
and had livestock of flocks and livestock of herds and a
large number of servants. And the Philistines envied him.

verses.hebrew: וְכל הַבְּאֵרֹת אֲשֶׁר חָפְרוּ עַבְדֵי אָבִיו בִּימֵי אַבְרָהָם אָבִיו סִתְּמוּם פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיְמַלְאוּם עָפָר׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הַבְּאֵרֹת אֲשֶׁר חָפְרוּ עַבְדֵי אָבִיו בִּימֵי אַבְרָהָם אָבִיו סִתְּמוּם פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיְמַלְאוּם עָפָר׃

english.text:
And the Philistines stopped up all the wells that his
father’s servants had dug in his father Abraham’s days,
and they filled them with dirt.

translation.text: For all the wells which his father’s servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.

verses.english:
And the Philistines stopped up all the wells that his
father’s servants had dug in his father Abraham’s days,
and they filled them with dirt.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶל יִצְחָק לֵךְ מֵעִמָּנוּ כִּי עָצַמְתָּ מִמֶּנּוּ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶל יִצְחָק לֵךְ מֵעִמָּנוּ כִּי עָצַמְתָּ מִמֶּנּוּ מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And Abimelek said to Isaac, “Go from among us, because
you’ve become much mightier than we are.”

translation.text: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.

verses.english:
And Abimelek said to Isaac, “Go from among us, because
you’ve become much mightier than we are.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם יִצְחָק וַיִּחַן בְּנַחַל גְּרָר וַיֵּשֶׁב שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם יִצְחָק וַיִּחַן בְּנַחַל גְּרָר וַיֵּשֶׁב שָׁם׃

english.text:
And Isaac went from there and camped in the wadi of Gerar
and lived there.

translation.text: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.

verses.english:
And Isaac went from there and camped in the wadi of Gerar
and lived there.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב יִצְחָק וַיַּחְפֹּר אֶת בְּאֵרֹת הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר חָפְרוּ בִּימֵי אַבְרָהָם אָבִיו וַיְסַתְּמוּם פְּלִשְׁתִּים אַחֲרֵי מוֹת אַבְרָהָם וַיִּקְרָא לָהֶן שֵׁמוֹת כַּשֵּׁמֹת אֲשֶׁר קָרָא לָהֶן אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב יִצְחָק וַיַּחְפֹּר אֶת בְּאֵרֹת הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר חָפְרוּ בִּימֵי אַבְרָהָם אָבִיו וַיְסַתְּמוּם פְּלִשְׁתִּים אַחֲרֵי מוֹת אַבְרָהָם וַיִּקְרָא לָהֶן שֵׁמוֹת כַּשֵּׁמֹת אֲשֶׁר קָרָא לָהֶן אָבִיו׃

english.text:
And Isaac went back and dug the water wells that they had
dug in the days of his father Abraham and that the
Philistines had stopped up after Abraham’s death, and he
called them by names, like the names that his father had
called them.

translation.text: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

verses.english:
And Isaac went back and dug the water wells that they had
dug in the days of his father Abraham and that the
Philistines had stopped up after Abraham’s death, and he
called them by names, like the names that his father had
called them.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחְפְּרוּ עַבְדֵי יִצְחָק בַּנָּחַל וַיִּמְצְאוּ שָׁם בְּאֵר מַיִם חַיִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחְפְּרוּ עַבְדֵי יִצְחָק בַּנָּחַל וַיִּמְצְאוּ שָׁם בְּאֵר מַיִם חַיִּים׃

english.text:
And Isaac’s servants dug in the wadi and found a well of
fresh water there.

translation.text: And Isaac’s servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.

verses.english:
And Isaac’s servants dug in the wadi and found a well of
fresh water there.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרִיבוּ רֹעֵי גְרָר עִם רֹעֵי יִצְחָק לֵאמֹר לָנוּ הַמָּיִם וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הַבְּאֵר עֵשֶׂק כִּי הִתְעַשְּׂקוּ עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּרִיבוּ רֹעֵי גְרָר עִם רֹעֵי יִצְחָק לֵאמֹר לָנוּ הַמָּיִם וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הַבְּאֵר עֵשֶׂק כִּי הִתְעַשְּׂקוּ עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And the shepherds of Gerar quarreled with Isaac’s
shepherds, saying, “The water is ours.” And he called the
name of the well Esek because they tangled with him.

translation.text: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac’s herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.

verses.english:
And the shepherds of Gerar quarreled with Isaac’s
shepherds, saying, “The water is ours.” And he called the
name of the well Esek because they tangled with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחְפְּרוּ בְּאֵר אַחֶרֶת וַיָּרִיבוּ גַּם עָלֶיהָ וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמָהּ שִׂטְנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחְפְּרוּ בְּאֵר אַחֶרֶת וַיָּרִיבוּ גַּם עָלֶיהָ וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמָהּ שִׂטְנָה׃

english.text:
And they dug another well, and they quarreled over it
also, and he called its name Sitnah.

translation.text: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.

verses.english:
And they dug another well, and they quarreled over it
also, and he called its name Sitnah.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעְתֵּק מִשָּׁם וַיַּחְפֹּר בְּאֵר אַחֶרֶת וְלֹא רָבוּ עָלֶיהָ וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמָהּ רְחֹבוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי עַתָּה הִרְחִיב יְהֹוָה לָנוּ וּפָרִינוּ בָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעְתֵּק מִשָּׁם וַיַּחְפֹּר בְּאֵר אַחֶרֶת וְלֹא רָבוּ עָלֶיהָ וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמָהּ רְחֹבוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי עַתָּה הִרְחִיב יְהֹוָה לָנוּ וּפָרִינוּ בָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And he moved on from there and dug another well, and they
did not quarrel over it, and he called its name Rehovot
and said, “Because now YHWH has widened for us, and we’ve
been fruitful in the land.”

translation.text: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

verses.english:
And he moved on from there and dug another well, and they
did not quarrel over it, and he called its name Rehovot
and said, “Because now YHWH has widened for us, and we’ve
been fruitful in the land.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מִשָּׁם בְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל מִשָּׁם בְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃

english.text: And he went up from there to Beer-sheba.

translation.text: And he went up from thence to Beersheba.

verses.english: And he went up from there to Beer-sheba.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אָבִיךָ אַל תִּירָא כִּי אִתְּךָ אָנֹכִי וּבֵרַכְתִּיךָ וְהִרְבֵּיתִי אֶת זַרְעֲךָ בַּעֲבוּר אַבְרָהָם עַבְדִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אָבִיךָ אַל תִּירָא כִּי אִתְּךָ אָנֹכִי וּבֵרַכְתִּיךָ וְהִרְבֵּיתִי אֶת זַרְעֲךָ בַּעֲבוּר אַבְרָהָם עַבְדִּי׃

english.text:
And YHWH appeared to him that night and said, “I’m your
father Abraham’s God. Don’t be afraid, because I’m with
you, and I’ll bless you and multiply your seed on account
of Abraham, my servant.”

translation.text: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham’s sake.

verses.english:
And YHWH appeared to him that night and said, “I’m your
father Abraham’s God. Don’t be afraid, because I’m with
you, and I’ll bless you and multiply your seed on account
of Abraham, my servant.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרָא בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה וַיֶּט שָׁם אהֳלוֹ וַיִּכְרוּ שָׁם עַבְדֵי יִצְחָק בְּאֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרָא בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה וַיֶּט שָׁם אהֳלוֹ וַיִּכְרוּ שָׁם עַבְדֵי יִצְחָק בְּאֵר׃

english.text:
And he built an altar there and invoked the name YHWH. And
he pitched his tent there, and Isaac’s servants dug a well
there.

translation.text: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac’s servants digged a well.

verses.english:
And he built an altar there and invoked the name YHWH. And
he pitched his tent there, and Isaac’s servants dug a well
there.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ הָלַךְ אֵלָיו מִגְּרָר וַאֲחֻזַּת מֵרֵעֵהוּ וּפִיכֹל שַׂר צְבָאוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ הָלַךְ אֵלָיו מִגְּרָר וַאֲחֻזַּת מֵרֵעֵהוּ וּפִיכֹל שַׂר צְבָאוֹ׃

english.text:
And Abimelek and Ahuzat, his companion, and Phicol, the
commander of his army, went to him from Gerar.

translation.text: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.

verses.english:
And Abimelek and Ahuzat, his companion, and Phicol, the
commander of his army, went to him from Gerar.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יִצְחָק מַדּוּעַ בָּאתֶם אֵלָי וְאַתֶּם שְׂנֵאתֶם אֹתִי וַתְּשַׁלְּחוּנִי מֵאִתְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יִצְחָק מַדּוּעַ בָּאתֶם אֵלָי וְאַתֶּם שְׂנֵאתֶם אֹתִי וַתְּשַׁלְּחוּנִי מֵאִתְּכֶם׃

english.text:
And Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since
you hated me and sent me away from you?”

translation.text: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?

verses.english:
And Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since
you hated me and sent me away from you?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ רָאוֹ רָאִינוּ כִּי הָיָה יְהֹוָה עִמָּךְ וַנֹּאמֶר תְּהִי נָא אָלָה בֵּינוֹתֵינוּ בֵּינֵינוּ וּבֵינֶךָ וְנִכְרְתָה בְרִית עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ רָאוֹ רָאִינוּ כִּי הָיָה יְהֹוָה עִמָּךְ וַנֹּאמֶר תְּהִי נָא אָלָה בֵּינוֹתֵינוּ בֵּינֵינוּ וּבֵינֶךָ וְנִכְרְתָה בְרִית עִמָּךְ׃

translation.text: And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;

verses.hebrew: אִם תַּעֲשֵׂה עִמָּנוּ רָעָה כַּאֲשֶׁר לֹא נְגַעֲנוּךָ וְכַאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂינוּ עִמְּךָ רַק טוֹב וַנְּשַׁלֵּחֲךָ בְּשָׁלוֹם אַתָּה עַתָּה בְּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אִם תַּעֲשֵׂה עִמָּנוּ רָעָה כַּאֲשֶׁר לֹא נְגַעֲנוּךָ וְכַאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂינוּ עִמְּךָ רַק טוֹב וַנְּשַׁלֵּחֲךָ בְּשָׁלוֹם אַתָּה עַתָּה בְּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
that you won’t do bad toward us as we haven’t touched you
and as we’ve done only good toward you and sent you away
in peace. You are now blessed by YHWH.’”

translation.text: That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the LORD.

verses.english:
that you won’t do bad toward us as we haven’t touched you
and as we’ve done only good toward you and sent you away
in peace. You are now blessed by YHWH.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם מִשְׁתֶּה וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם מִשְׁתֶּה וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ׃

english.text: And he made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.

translation.text: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.

verses.english: And he made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ בַבֹּקֶר וַיִּשָּׁבְעוּ אִישׁ לְאָחִיו וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם יִצְחָק וַיֵּלְכוּ מֵאִתּוֹ בְּשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ בַבֹּקֶר וַיִּשָּׁבְעוּ אִישׁ לְאָחִיו וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם יִצְחָק וַיֵּלְכוּ מֵאִתּוֹ בְּשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
And they got up early in the morning and swore, each man
to his brother, and Isaac sent them away, and they went
from him in peace.

translation.text: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

verses.english:
And they got up early in the morning and swore, each man
to his brother, and Isaac sent them away, and they went
from him in peace.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי יִצְחָק וַיַּגִּדוּ לוֹ עַל אֹדוֹת הַבְּאֵר אֲשֶׁר חָפָרוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ מָצָאנוּ מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי יִצְחָק וַיַּגִּדוּ לוֹ עַל אֹדוֹת הַבְּאֵר אֲשֶׁר חָפָרוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ מָצָאנוּ מָיִם׃

english.text:
And it was in that day and Isaac’s servants came and told
him about the well that they had dug and said to him, “We
found water.”

translation.text: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.

verses.english:
And it was in that day and Isaac’s servants came and told
him about the well that they had dug and said to him, “We
found water.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֹתָהּ שִׁבְעָה עַל כֵּן שֵׁם הָעִיר בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֹתָהּ שִׁבְעָה עַל כֵּן שֵׁם הָעִיר בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And he called it Seven. On account of this the name of the
city is Beer-sheba to this day.

translation.text: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beersheba unto this day.

verses.english:
And he called it Seven. On account of this the name of the
city is Beer-sheba to this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עֵשָׂו בֶּן אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַיִּקַּח אִשָּׁה אֶת יְהוּדִית בַּת בְּאֵרִי הַחִתִּי וְאֶת בָּשְׂמַת בַּת אֵילֹן הַחִתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי עֵשָׂו בֶּן אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַיִּקַּח אִשָּׁה אֶת יְהוּדִית בַּת בְּאֵרִי הַחִתִּי וְאֶת בָּשְׂמַת בַּת אֵילֹן הַחִתִּי׃

english.text:
And Esau was forty years old, and he took a wife: Judith,
daughter of Beeri, the Hittite, and Basemath, daughter of
Elon, the Hittite.

translation.text: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:

verses.english:
And Esau was forty years old, and he took a wife: Judith,
daughter of Beeri, the Hittite, and Basemath, daughter of
Elon, the Hittite.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּהְיֶיןָ מֹרַת רוּחַ לְיִצְחָק וּלְרִבְקָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּהְיֶיןָ מֹרַת רוּחַ לְיִצְחָק וּלְרִבְקָה׃

english.text:
And they were a bitterness of spirit to Isaac and to
Re-bekah.

translation.text: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.

verses.english:
And they were a bitterness of spirit to Isaac and to
Re-bekah.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי זָקֵן יִצְחָק וַתִּכְהֶיןָ עֵינָיו מֵרְאֹת וַיִּקְרָא אֶת עֵשָׂו בְּנוֹ הַגָּדֹל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בְּנִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּנִי׃

english.text:
And it was when Isaac was old and his eyes were too dim
for seeing: and he called Esau, his older son, and said to
him, “My son.” And he said to him, “I’m here.”

translation.text: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.

verses.english:
And it was when Isaac was old and his eyes were too dim
for seeing: and he called Esau, his older son, and said to
him, “My son.” And he said to him, “I’m here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה נָא זָקַנְתִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי יוֹם מוֹתִי׃

english.text:
And he said, “Here, I’ve become old. I don’t know the day
of my death.

translation.text: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:

verses.english:
And he said, “Here, I’ve become old. I don’t know the day
of my death.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שָׂא נָא כֵלֶיךָ תֶּלְיְךָ וְקַשְׁתֶּךָ וְצֵא הַשָּׂדֶה וְצוּדָה לִּי (צידה) [צָיִד]׃
