english.text:
And now, take up your implements: your quiver and your
bow, and go out to the field and hunt me some game

translation.text: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;

verses.english:
And now, take up your implements: your quiver and your
bow, and go out to the field and hunt me some game

verses.hebrew: וַעֲשֵׂה לִי מַטְעַמִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר אָהַבְתִּי וְהָבִיאָה לִּי וְאֹכֵלָה בַּעֲבוּר תְּבָרֶכְךָ נַפְשִׁי בְּטֶרֶם אָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲשֵׂה לִי מַטְעַמִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר אָהַבְתִּי וְהָבִיאָה לִּי וְאֹכֵלָה בַּעֲבוּר תְּבָרֶכְךָ נַפְשִׁי בְּטֶרֶם אָמוּת׃

english.text:
and make me the kind of delicacies that I love and bring
them to me and let me eat, so my soul will bless you
before I die.”

translation.text: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.

verses.english:
and make me the kind of delicacies that I love and bring
them to me and let me eat, so my soul will bless you
before I die.”

verses.hebrew: וְרִבְקָה שֹׁמַעַת בְּדַבֵּר יִצְחָק אֶל עֵשָׂו בְּנוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ עֵשָׂו הַשָּׂדֶה לָצוּד צַיִד לְהָבִיא׃

english.text:
And Rebekah was listening as Isaac was speaking to Esau,
his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt game to bring.

translation.text: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

verses.english:
And Rebekah was listening as Isaac was speaking to Esau,
his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt game to bring.

verses.hebrew: וְרִבְקָה אָמְרָה אֶל יַעֲקֹב בְּנָהּ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת אָבִיךָ מְדַבֵּר אֶל עֵשָׂו אָחִיךָ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְרִבְקָה אָמְרָה אֶל יַעֲקֹב בְּנָהּ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת אָבִיךָ מְדַבֵּר אֶל עֵשָׂו אָחִיךָ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And Rebekah said to Jacob, her son, saying, “Here I’ve
heard your father speaking to Esau, your brother, saying,

translation.text: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,

verses.english:
And Rebekah said to Jacob, her son, saying, “Here I’ve
heard your father speaking to Esau, your brother, saying,

verses.hebrew: הָבִיאָה לִּי צַיִד וַעֲשֵׂה לִי מַטְעַמִּים וְאֹכֵלָה וַאֲבָרֶכְכָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵי מוֹתִי׃

hebrew.text: הָבִיאָה לִּי צַיִד וַעֲשֵׂה לִי מַטְעַמִּים וְאֹכֵלָה וַאֲבָרֶכְכָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵי מוֹתִי׃

english.text:
‘Bring me game and make me delicacies so I may eat, and
I’ll bless you in the presence of YHWH before my death.’

translation.text: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.

verses.english:
‘Bring me game and make me delicacies so I may eat, and
I’ll bless you in the presence of YHWH before my death.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה בְנִי שְׁמַע בְּקֹלִי לַאֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מְצַוָּה אֹתָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה בְנִי שְׁמַע בְּקֹלִי לַאֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מְצַוָּה אֹתָךְ׃

english.text:
And now, my son, listen to my voice, to what I’m
commanding you.

translation.text: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.

verses.english:
And now, my son, listen to my voice, to what I’m
commanding you.

verses.hebrew: לֶךְ נָא אֶל הַצֹּאן וְקַח לִי מִשָּׁם שְׁנֵי גְּדָיֵי עִזִּים טֹבִים וְאֶעֱשֶׂה אֹתָם מַטְעַמִּים לְאָבִיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר אָהֵב׃

hebrew.text: לֶךְ נָא אֶל הַצֹּאן וְקַח לִי מִשָּׁם שְׁנֵי גְּדָיֵי עִזִּים טֹבִים וְאֶעֱשֶׂה אֹתָם מַטְעַמִּים לְאָבִיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר אָהֵב׃

english.text:
Go to the flock and take two good goat kids for me from
there, and I’ll make them the kind of delicacies that your
father loves.

translation.text: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:

verses.english:
Go to the flock and take two good goat kids for me from
there, and I’ll make them the kind of delicacies that your
father loves.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵבֵאתָ לְאָבִיךָ וְאָכָל בַּעֲבֻר אֲשֶׁר יְבָרֶכְךָ לִפְנֵי מוֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבֵאתָ לְאָבִיךָ וְאָכָל בַּעֲבֻר אֲשֶׁר יְבָרֶכְךָ לִפְנֵי מוֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And bring them to your father, and he’ll eat, so he’ll
bless you before his death.”

translation.text: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.

verses.english:
And bring them to your father, and he’ll eat, so he’ll
bless you before his death.”

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל רִבְקָה אִמּוֹ הֵן עֵשָׂו אָחִי אִישׁ שָׂעִר וְאָנֹכִי אִישׁ חָלָק׃

english.text:
And Jacob said to Rebekah, his mother, “Here, Esau, my
brother, is a hairy man and I’m a smooth man.

translation.text: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:

verses.english:
And Jacob said to Rebekah, his mother, “Here, Esau, my
brother, is a hairy man and I’m a smooth man.

verses.hebrew: אוּלַי יְמֻשֵּׁנִי אָבִי וְהָיִיתִי בְעֵינָיו כִּמְתַעְתֵּעַ וְהֵבֵאתִי עָלַי קְלָלָה וְלֹא בְרָכָה׃

english.text:
Maybe my father will feel me, and I’ll be like a trickster
in his eyes, and I’ll bring a curse on me and not a
blessing.”

translation.text: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.

verses.english:
Maybe my father will feel me, and I’ll be like a trickster
in his eyes, and I’ll bring a curse on me and not a
blessing.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִמּוֹ עָלַי קִלְלָתְךָ בְּנִי אַךְ שְׁמַע בְּקֹלִי וְלֵךְ קַח לִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִמּוֹ עָלַי קִלְלָתְךָ בְּנִי אַךְ שְׁמַע בְּקֹלִי וְלֵךְ קַח לִי׃

english.text:
And his mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my
son; just listen to my voice and go take them for me.”

translation.text: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.

verses.english:
And his mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my
son; just listen to my voice and go take them for me.”

And he went and took and brought them to his mother, and
his mother made the kind of delicacies that his father
loved.

translation.text: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.

verses.english:
And he went and took and brought them to his mother, and
his mother made the kind of delicacies that his father
loved.

hebrew.text: וַתִּקַּח רִבְקָה אֶת בִּגְדֵי עֵשָׂו בְּנָהּ הַגָּדֹל הַחֲמֻדֹת אֲשֶׁר אִתָּהּ בַּבָּיִת וַתַּלְבֵּשׁ אֶת יַעֲקֹב בְּנָהּ הַקָּטָן׃

english.text:
And Rebekah took the finest clothes of Esau, her older
son, that were with her in the house and put them on
Jacob, her younger son,

And Rebekah took the finest clothes of Esau, her older
son, that were with her in the house and put them on
Jacob, her younger son,

and put the skins of the goat kids on his hands and on the
smooth part of his neck.

translation.text: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:

and put the skins of the goat kids on his hands and on the
smooth part of his neck.

hebrew.text: וַתִּתֵּן אֶת הַמַּטְעַמִּים וְאֶת הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂתָה בְּיַד יַעֲקֹב בְּנָהּ׃

And she put the delicacies and the bread that she’d made

And she put the delicacies and the bread that she’d made
in the hand of Jacob, her son.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֶל אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֶּנִּי מִי אַתָּה בְּנִי׃

And he came to his father. And he said, “My father.” And
he said, “I’m here. Who are you, my son?”

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל אָבִיו אָנֹכִי עֵשָׂו בְּכֹרֶךָ עָשִׂיתִי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ אֵלָי קוּם נָא שְׁבָה וְאכְלָה מִצֵּידִי בַּעֲבוּר תְּבָרְכַנִּי נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

did as you spoke to me. Get up, sit, and eat some of my

And Jacob said to his father, “I’m Esau, your firstborn. I

game so your soul will bless me.”

find it, my son.” And he said, “Because YHWH your God made
it happen for me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִצְחָק אֶל יַעֲקֹב גְּשָׁה נָּא וַאֲמֻשְׁךָ בְּנִי הַאַתָּה זֶה בְּנִי עֵשָׂו אִם לֹא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִצְחָק אֶל יַעֲקֹב גְּשָׁה נָּא וַאֲמֻשְׁךָ בְּנִי הַאַתָּה זֶה בְּנִי עֵשָׂו אִם לֹא׃

english.text:
And Isaac said to Jacob, “Come over, and I’ll feel you, my
son: is this you, my son Esau, or not?”

translation.text: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.

verses.english:
And Isaac said to Jacob, “Come over, and I’ll feel you, my
son: is this you, my son Esau, or not?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ יַעֲקֹב אֶל יִצְחָק אָבִיו וַיְמֻשֵּׁהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר הַקֹּל קוֹל יַעֲקֹב וְהַיָּדַיִם יְדֵי עֵשָׂו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגַּשׁ יַעֲקֹב אֶל יִצְחָק אָבִיו וַיְמֻשֵּׁהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר הַקֹּל קוֹל יַעֲקֹב וְהַיָּדַיִם יְדֵי עֵשָׂו׃

english.text:
And Jacob came over to Isaac, his father, and he felt him.
And he said, “The voice is the voice of Jacob, and the
hands are the hands of Esau.”

translation.text: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

verses.english:
And Jacob came over to Isaac, his father, and he felt him.
And he said, “The voice is the voice of Jacob, and the
hands are the hands of Esau.”

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא הִכִּירוֹ כִּי הָיוּ יָדָיו כִּידֵי עֵשָׂו אָחִיו שְׂעִרֹת וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא הִכִּירוֹ כִּי הָיוּ יָדָיו כִּידֵי עֵשָׂו אָחִיו שְׂעִרֹת וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ׃

english.text:
And he did not recognize him because his hands were hairy
like the hands of Esau, his brother, and he blessed him.

translation.text: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau’s hands: so he blessed him.

verses.english:
And he did not recognize him because his hands were hairy
like the hands of Esau, his brother, and he blessed him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַתָּה זֶה בְּנִי עֵשָׂו וַיֹּאמֶר אָנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַתָּה זֶה בְּנִי עֵשָׂו וַיֹּאמֶר אָנִי׃

english.text:
And he said, “Is this you, my son Esau?” And he said, “I
am.”

translation.text: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.

verses.english:
And he said, “Is this you, my son Esau?” And he said, “I
am.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַגִּשָׁה לִּי וְאֹכְלָה מִצֵּיד בְּנִי לְמַעַן תְּבָרֶכְךָ נַפְשִׁי וַיַּגֶּשׁ לוֹ וַיֹּאכַל וַיָּבֵא לוֹ יַיִן וַיֵּשְׁתְּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַגִּשָׁה לִּי וְאֹכְלָה מִצֵּיד בְּנִי לְמַעַן תְּבָרֶכְךָ נַפְשִׁי וַיַּגֶּשׁ לוֹ וַיֹּאכַל וַיָּבֵא לוֹ יַיִן וַיֵּשְׁתְּ׃

english.text:
And he said, “Bring it over to me and let me eat some of
my son’s game so that my soul will bless you. And he
brought it over to him, and he ate; and he brought him
wine, and he drank.

translation.text: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine and he drank.

verses.english:
And he said, “Bring it over to me and let me eat some of
my son’s game so that my soul will bless you. And he
brought it over to him, and he ate; and he brought him
wine, and he drank.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יִצְחָק אָבִיו גְּשָׁה נָּא וּשְׁקָה לִּי בְּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יִצְחָק אָבִיו גְּשָׁה נָּא וּשְׁקָה לִּי בְּנִי׃

english.text:
And Isaac, his father, said to him, “Come over and kiss
me, my son.”

translation.text: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.

verses.english:
And Isaac, his father, said to him, “Come over and kiss
me, my son.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ וַיִּשַּׁק לוֹ וַיָּרַח אֶת רֵיחַ בְּגָדָיו וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר רְאֵה רֵיחַ בְּנִי כְּרֵיחַ שָׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר בֵּרְכוֹ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגַּשׁ וַיִּשַּׁק לוֹ וַיָּרַח אֶת רֵיחַ בְּגָדָיו וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר רְאֵה רֵיחַ בְּנִי כְּרֵיחַ שָׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר בֵּרְכוֹ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he came over and kissed him, and he smelled the aroma
of his clothes and blessed him and said, “See, my son’s
aroma is like the aroma of a field that YHWH has blessed.

translation.text: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed:

verses.english:
And he came over and kissed him, and he smelled the aroma
of his clothes and blessed him and said, “See, my son’s
aroma is like the aroma of a field that YHWH has blessed.

verses.hebrew: וְיִתֶּן לְךָ הָאֱלֹהִים מִטַּל הַשָּׁמַיִם וּמִשְׁמַנֵּי הָאָרֶץ וְרֹב דָּגָן וְתִירֹשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְיִתֶּן לְךָ הָאֱלֹהִים מִטַּל הַשָּׁמַיִם וּמִשְׁמַנֵּי הָאָרֶץ וְרֹב דָּגָן וְתִירֹשׁ׃

english.text:
And may God give you from the dew of the skies and from
the fat of the earth and much grain and wine.

translation.text: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:

verses.english:
And may God give you from the dew of the skies and from
the fat of the earth and much grain and wine.

verses.hebrew: יַעַבְדוּךָ עַמִּים (וישתחו) [וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ] לְךָ לְאֻמִּים הֱוֵה גְבִיר לְאַחֶיךָ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְךָ בְּנֵי אִמֶּךָ אֹרְרֶיךָ אָרוּר וּמְבָרְכֶיךָ בָּרוּךְ׃

hebrew.text: יַעַבְדוּךָ עַמִּים (וישתחו) [וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ] לְךָ לְאֻמִּים הֱוֵה גְבִיר לְאַחֶיךָ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְךָ בְּנֵי אִמֶּךָ אֹרְרֶיךָ אָרוּר וּמְבָרְכֶיךָ בָּרוּךְ׃

english.text:
May peoples serve you and nations bow to you. Be your
brothers’ superior, and may your mother’s sons bow to you.
May those who curse you be cursed and those who bless you
be blessed.”

translation.text: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother’s sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.

verses.english:
May peoples serve you and nations bow to you. Be your
brothers’ superior, and may your mother’s sons bow to you.
May those who curse you be cursed and those who bless you
be blessed.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלָּה יִצְחָק לְבָרֵךְ אֶת יַעֲקֹב וַיְהִי אַךְ יָצֹא יָצָא יַעֲקֹב מֵאֵת פְּנֵי יִצְחָק אָבִיו וְעֵשָׂו אָחִיו בָּא מִצֵּידוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלָּה יִצְחָק לְבָרֵךְ אֶת יַעֲקֹב וַיְהִי אַךְ יָצֹא יָצָא יַעֲקֹב מֵאֵת פְּנֵי יִצְחָק אָבִיו וְעֵשָׂו אָחִיו בָּא מִצֵּידוֹ׃

english.text:
And it was as Isaac finished blessing Jacob, and it was:
Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac, his
father!—and Esau, his brother, came from his hunting.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

verses.english:
And it was as Isaac finished blessing Jacob, and it was:
Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac, his
father!—and Esau, his brother, came from his hunting.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ גַּם הוּא מַטְעַמִּים וַיָּבֵא לְאָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר לְאָבִיו יָקֻם אָבִי וְיֹאכַל מִצֵּיד בְּנוֹ בַּעֲבֻר תְּבָרְכַנִּי נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ גַּם הוּא מַטְעַמִּים וַיָּבֵא לְאָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר לְאָבִיו יָקֻם אָבִי וְיֹאכַל מִצֵּיד בְּנוֹ בַּעֲבֻר תְּבָרְכַנִּי נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
And he, too, had made delicacies and brought them to his
father. And he said to his father, “Let my father get up
and eat some of his son’s game so you yourself will bless
me.”

translation.text: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that thy soul may bless me.

verses.english:
And he, too, had made delicacies and brought them to his
father. And he said to his father, “Let my father get up
and eat some of his son’s game so you yourself will bless
me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יִצְחָק אָבִיו מִי אָתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי בִּנְךָ בְכֹרְךָ עֵשָׂו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יִצְחָק אָבִיו מִי אָתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי בִּנְךָ בְכֹרְךָ עֵשָׂו׃

english.text:
And Isaac, his father, said to him, “Who are you?” And he
said, “I’m your son, your firstborn, Esau.”

translation.text: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.

verses.english:
And Isaac, his father, said to him, “Who are you?” And he
said, “I’m your son, your firstborn, Esau.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחֱרַד יִצְחָק חֲרָדָה גְּדֹלָה עַד מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אֵפוֹא הוּא הַצָּד צַיִד וַיָּבֵא לִי וָאֹכַל מִכֹּל בְּטֶרֶם תָּבוֹא וָאֲבָרְכֵהוּ גַּם בָּרוּךְ יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּחֱרַד יִצְחָק חֲרָדָה גְּדֹלָה עַד מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אֵפוֹא הוּא הַצָּד צַיִד וַיָּבֵא לִי וָאֹכַל מִכֹּל בְּטֶרֶם תָּבוֹא וָאֲבָרְכֵהוּ גַּם בָּרוּךְ יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
And Isaac trembled—a very big trembling. And he said, “Who
then is the one who hunted game and brought it to me, and
I ate some of it all before you came, and I blessed him?
He will in fact be blessed.”

translation.text: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.

verses.english:
And Isaac trembled—a very big trembling. And he said, “Who
then is the one who hunted game and brought it to me, and
I ate some of it all before you came, and I blessed him?
He will in fact be blessed.”

verses.hebrew: כִּשְׁמֹעַ עֵשָׂו אֶת דִּבְרֵי אָבִיו וַיִּצְעַק צְעָקָה גְּדֹלָה וּמָרָה עַד מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר לְאָבִיו בָּרְכֵנִי גַם אָנִי אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: כִּשְׁמֹעַ עֵשָׂו אֶת דִּבְרֵי אָבִיו וַיִּצְעַק צְעָקָה גְּדֹלָה וּמָרָה עַד מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר לְאָבִיו בָּרְכֵנִי גַם אָנִי אָבִי׃

english.text:
When Esau heard his father’s words he cried—a very big and
bitter cry. And he said to his father, “Bless me, also me,
my father.”

translation.text: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.

verses.english:
When Esau heard his father’s words he cried—a very big and
bitter cry. And he said to his father, “Bless me, also me,
my father.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּא אָחִיךָ בְּמִרְמָה וַיִּקַּח בִּרְכָתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּא אָחִיךָ בְּמִרְמָה וַיִּקַּח בִּרְכָתֶךָ׃

english.text:
And he said, “Your brother came with deception, and he
took your blessing.”

translation.text: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.

verses.english:
And he said, “Your brother came with deception, and he
took your blessing.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הֲכִי קָרָא שְׁמוֹ יַעֲקֹב וַיַּעְקְבֵנִי זֶה פַעֲמַיִם אֶת בְּכֹרָתִי לָקָח וְהִנֵּה עַתָּה לָקַח בִּרְכָתִי וַיֹּאמַר הֲלֹא אָצַלְתָּ לִּי בְּרָכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הֲכִי קָרָא שְׁמוֹ יַעֲקֹב וַיַּעְקְבֵנִי זֶה פַעֲמַיִם אֶת בְּכֹרָתִי לָקָח וְהִנֵּה עַתָּה לָקַח בִּרְכָתִי וַיֹּאמַר הֲלֹא אָצַלְתָּ לִּי בְּרָכָה׃

english.text:
And he said, “Was his name really called Jacob! And he’s
usurped me two times now. He’s taken my birthright, and,
here, now he’s taken my blessing.” And he said, “Haven’t
you saved a blessing for me?”

translation.text: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?

verses.english:
And he said, “Was his name really called Jacob! And he’s
usurped me two times now. He’s taken my birthright, and,
here, now he’s taken my blessing.” And he said, “Haven’t
you saved a blessing for me?”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יִצְחָק וַיֹּאמֶר לְעֵשָׂו הֵן גְּבִיר שַׂמְתִּיו לָךְ וְאֶת כּל אֶחָיו נָתַתִּי לוֹ לַעֲבָדִים וְדָגָן וְתִירֹשׁ סְמַכְתִּיו וּלְכָה אֵפוֹא מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה בְּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן יִצְחָק וַיֹּאמֶר לְעֵשָׂו הֵן גְּבִיר שַׂמְתִּיו לָךְ וְאֶת כּל אֶחָיו נָתַתִּי לוֹ לַעֲבָדִים וְדָגָן וְתִירֹשׁ סְמַכְתִּיו וּלְכָה אֵפוֹא מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה בְּנִי׃

english.text:
And Isaac answered, and he said to Esau, “Here I’ve made
him your superior, and I’ve given all his brothers as
servants, and I’ve endowed him with grain and wine. And
for you: where, what, will I do, my son?”

translation.text: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?

verses.english:
And Isaac answered, and he said to Esau, “Here I’ve made
him your superior, and I’ve given all his brothers as
servants, and I’ve endowed him with grain and wine. And
for you: where, what, will I do, my son?”

english.text:
And Esau said to his father, “Is it one blessing that you
have, my father? Bless me, also me, my father.” And Esau
raised his voice and wept.

translation.text: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

verses.english:
And Esau said to his father, “Is it one blessing that you
have, my father? Bless me, also me, my father.” And Esau
raised his voice and wept.

english.text:

And Isaac, his father, answered, and he said to him,

and from the dew of the skies from above.

And you’ll live by your sword. And you’ll serve your
brother. And it will be that when you get dominion you’ll
break his yoke from your neck.”

translation.text: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.

And you’ll live by your sword. And you’ll serve your
brother. And it will be that when you get dominion you’ll
break his yoke from your neck.”

english.text:
And Esau despised Jacob because of the blessing with which
his father blessed him, and Esau said in his heart, “The
days of mourning for my father will be soon, and then I’ll
kill Jacob, my brother.”

translation.text: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.

And Esau despised Jacob because of the blessing with which

days of mourning for my father will be soon, and then I’ll
kill Jacob, my brother.”

Rebekah, and she sent and called to Jacob, her younger
son, and said to him, “Here, Esau, your brother, consoles
himself regarding you with the idea of killing you.

verses.english:
And the words of Esau, her older son, were told to
Rebekah, and she sent and called to Jacob, her younger

himself regarding you with the idea of killing you.

And now, my son, listen to my voice and get up, flee to
Laban, my brother, at Haran

english.text:
and live with him for a number of days until your
brother’s fury will turn back,

and live with him for a number of days until your
brother’s fury will turn back,

until your brother’s anger turns back from you and he

from the daughters of Heth like these daughters of the
land, why do I have a life!”

translation.text: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?

And Rebekah said to Isaac, “I’m disgusted with my life

commanded him, and he said to him, “You shall not take a
wife from the daughters of Canaan.

And Isaac called Jacob, and he blessed him and
commanded him, and he said to him, “You shall not take a
wife from the daughters of Canaan.

translation.text: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;

verses.english:
And Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan were bad in his
father Isaac’s eyes.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ עֵשָׂו אֶל יִשְׁמָעֵאל וַיִּקַּח אֶת מָחֲלַת בַּת יִשְׁמָעֵאל בֶּן אַבְרָהָם אֲחוֹת נְבָיוֹת עַל נָשָׁיו לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ עֵשָׂו אֶל יִשְׁמָעֵאל וַיִּקַּח אֶת מָחֲלַת בַּת יִשְׁמָעֵאל בֶּן אַבְרָהָם אֲחוֹת נְבָיוֹת עַל נָשָׁיו לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
And Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahalath, daughter of
Ishmael, son of Abraham, sister of Nebaioth, in addition
to his wives as a wife for him.

translation.text: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.

verses.english:
And Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahalath, daughter of
Ishmael, son of Abraham, sister of Nebaioth, in addition
to his wives as a wife for him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא יַעֲקֹב מִבְּאֵר שָׁבַע וַיֵּלֶךְ חָרָנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא יַעֲקֹב מִבְּאֵר שָׁבַע וַיֵּלֶךְ חָרָנָה׃

english.text: And Jacob left Beer-sheba and went to Haran.

translation.text: And Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

verses.english: And Jacob left Beer-sheba and went to Haran.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְגַּע בַּמָּקוֹם וַיָּלֶן שָׁם כִּי בָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וַיִּקַּח מֵאַבְנֵי הַמָּקוֹם וַיָּשֶׂם מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּמָּקוֹם הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְגַּע בַּמָּקוֹם וַיָּלֶן שָׁם כִּי בָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וַיִּקַּח מֵאַבְנֵי הַמָּקוֹם וַיָּשֶׂם מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּמָּקוֹם הַהוּא׃

english.text:
And he happened upon a place and stayed the night there
because the sun was setting. And he took from the stones
of the place and set it as his headrest and lay down in
that place.

translation.text: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.

verses.english:
And he happened upon a place and stayed the night there
because the sun was setting. And he took from the stones
of the place and set it as his headrest and lay down in
that place.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲלֹם וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲלֹם וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ׃

english.text:
And he dreamed. And here was a ladder, set up on the
earth, and its top reaching to the skies. And here were
angels of God, going up and going down by it.

translation.text: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

verses.english:
And he dreamed. And here was a ladder, set up on the
earth, and its top reaching to the skies. And here were
angels of God, going up and going down by it.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה יְהֹוָה נִצָּב עָלָיו וַיֹּאמַר אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אָבִיךָ וֵאלֹהֵי יִצְחָק הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה שֹׁכֵב עָלֶיהָ לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וּלְזַרְעֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה יְהֹוָה נִצָּב עָלָיו וַיֹּאמַר אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אָבִיךָ וֵאלֹהֵי יִצְחָק הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה שֹׁכֵב עָלֶיהָ לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וּלְזַרְעֶךָ׃

english.text:
And here was YHWH standing over him, and He said, “I am
YHWH, your father Abraham’s God and Isaac’s God. The land
on which you’re lying: I’ll give it to you and to your
seed.

translation.text: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I am the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;

verses.english:
And here was YHWH standing over him, and He said, “I am
YHWH, your father Abraham’s God and Isaac’s God. The land
on which you’re lying: I’ll give it to you and to your
seed.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה זַרְעֲךָ כַּעֲפַר הָאָרֶץ וּפָרַצְתָּ יָמָּה וָקֵדְמָה וְצָפֹנָה וָנֶגְבָּה וְנִבְרְכוּ בְךָ כּל מִשְׁפְּחֹת הָאֲדָמָה וּבְזַרְעֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה זַרְעֲךָ כַּעֲפַר הָאָרֶץ וּפָרַצְתָּ יָמָּה וָקֵדְמָה וְצָפֹנָה וָנֶגְבָּה וְנִבְרְכוּ בְךָ כּל מִשְׁפְּחֹת הָאֲדָמָה וּבְזַרְעֶךָ׃

english.text:
And your seed will be like the dust of the earth, and
you’ll expand to the west and east and north and south,
and all the families on the earth will be blessed through
you and through your seed.

translation.text: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

verses.english:
And your seed will be like the dust of the earth, and
you’ll expand to the west and east and north and south,
and all the families on the earth will be blessed through
you and through your seed.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי עִמָּךְ וּשְׁמַרְתִּיךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵךְ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִיךָ אֶל הָאֲדָמָה הַזֹּאת כִּי לֹא אֶעֱזבְךָ עַד אֲשֶׁר אִם עָשִׂיתִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי עִמָּךְ וּשְׁמַרְתִּיךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵךְ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִיךָ אֶל הָאֲדָמָה הַזֹּאת כִּי לֹא אֶעֱזבְךָ עַד אֲשֶׁר אִם עָשִׂיתִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי לָךְ׃

english.text:
And here I am with you, and I’ll watch over you everywhere
that you’ll go, and I’ll bring you back to this land, for
I won’t leave you until I’ve done what I’ve spoken to
you.”

translation.text: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

verses.english:
And here I am with you, and I’ll watch over you everywhere
that you’ll go, and I’ll bring you back to this land, for
I won’t leave you until I’ve done what I’ve spoken to
you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּיקַץ יַעֲקֹב מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אָכֵן יֵשׁ יְהֹוָה בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאָנֹכִי לֹא יָדָעְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּיקַץ יַעֲקֹב מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אָכֵן יֵשׁ יְהֹוָה בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאָנֹכִי לֹא יָדָעְתִּי׃

english.text:
And Jacob woke from his sleep and said, “YHWH is actually
in this place, and I didn’t know!”

translation.text: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.

verses.english:
And Jacob woke from his sleep and said, “YHWH is actually
in this place, and I didn’t know!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּירָא וַיֹּאמַר מַה נּוֹרָא הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה אֵין זֶה כִּי אִם בֵּית אֱלֹהִים וְזֶה שַׁעַר הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּירָא וַיֹּאמַר מַה נּוֹרָא הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה אֵין זֶה כִּי אִם בֵּית אֱלֹהִים וְזֶה שַׁעַר הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
And he was afraid, and he said, “How awesome this place
is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the
gate of the skies!”

translation.text: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

verses.english:
And he was afraid, and he said, “How awesome this place
is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the
gate of the skies!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יַעֲקֹב בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּקַּח אֶת הָאֶבֶן אֲשֶׁר שָׂם מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו וַיָּשֶׂם אֹתָהּ מַצֵּבָה וַיִּצֹק שֶׁמֶן עַל רֹאשָׁהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יַעֲקֹב בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּקַּח אֶת הָאֶבֶן אֲשֶׁר שָׂם מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו וַיָּשֶׂם אֹתָהּ מַצֵּבָה וַיִּצֹק שֶׁמֶן עַל רֹאשָׁהּ׃

english.text:
And Jacob got up early in the morning and took the stone
that he had set as his headrest and set it as a pillar and
poured oil on its top.

translation.text: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.

verses.english:
And Jacob got up early in the morning and took the stone
that he had set as his headrest and set it as a pillar and
poured oil on its top.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בֵּית אֵל וְאוּלָם לוּז שֵׁם הָעִיר לָרִאשֹׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בֵּית אֵל וְאוּלָם לוּז שֵׁם הָעִיר לָרִאשֹׁנָה׃

english.text:
And he called that place’s name Beth-El, though in fact
Luz was the name of the city at first.

translation.text: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.

verses.english:
And he called that place’s name Beth-El, though in fact
Luz was the name of the city at first.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּדַּר יַעֲקֹב נֶדֶר לֵאמֹר אִם יִהְיֶה אֱלֹהִים עִמָּדִי וּשְׁמָרַנִי בַּדֶּרֶךְ הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי הוֹלֵךְ וְנָתַן לִי לֶחֶם לֶאֱכֹל וּבֶגֶד לִלְבֹּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּדַּר יַעֲקֹב נֶדֶר לֵאמֹר אִם יִהְיֶה אֱלֹהִים עִמָּדִי וּשְׁמָרַנִי בַּדֶּרֶךְ הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי הוֹלֵךְ וְנָתַן לִי לֶחֶם לֶאֱכֹל וּבֶגֶד לִלְבֹּשׁ׃

english.text:
And Jacob made a vow, saying, “If God will be with me and
watch over me in this way that I’m going and give me bread
to eat and clothing to wear,

translation.text: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,

verses.english:
And Jacob made a vow, saying, “If God will be with me and
watch over me in this way that I’m going and give me bread
to eat and clothing to wear,

verses.hebrew: וְשַׁבְתִּי בְשָׁלוֹם אֶל בֵּית אָבִי וְהָיָה יְהֹוָה לִי לֵאלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׁבְתִּי בְשָׁלוֹם אֶל בֵּית אָבִי וְהָיָה יְהֹוָה לִי לֵאלֹהִים׃

english.text:
and I come back in peace to my father’s house, then YHWH
will become my God,

translation.text: So that I come again to my father’s house in peace; then shall the LORD be my God:

verses.english:
and I come back in peace to my father’s house, then YHWH
will become my God,

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֶבֶן הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי מַצֵּבָה יִהְיֶה בֵּית אֱלֹהִים וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תִּתֶּן לִי עַשֵּׂר אֲעַשְּׂרֶנּוּ לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֶבֶן הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי מַצֵּבָה יִהְיֶה בֵּית אֱלֹהִים וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תִּתֶּן לִי עַשֵּׂר אֲעַשְּׂרֶנּוּ לָךְ׃

english.text:
and this stone that I set as a pillar will be God’s house,
and everything that you’ll give me I’ll tithe to you.”

translation.text: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God’s house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.

verses.english:
and this stone that I set as a pillar will be God’s house,
and everything that you’ll give me I’ll tithe to you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא יַעֲקֹב רַגְלָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ אַרְצָה בְנֵי קֶדֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא יַעֲקֹב רַגְלָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ אַרְצָה בְנֵי קֶדֶם׃

english.text:
And Jacob lifted his feet and went to the land of the
people of the east.

translation.text: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.

verses.english:
And Jacob lifted his feet and went to the land of the
people of the east.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה בְאֵר בַּשָּׂדֶה וְהִנֵּה שָׁם שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶדְרֵי צֹאן רֹבְצִים עָלֶיהָ כִּי מִן הַבְּאֵר הַהִוא יַשְׁקוּ הָעֲדָרִים וְהָאֶבֶן גְּדֹלָה עַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה בְאֵר בַּשָּׂדֶה וְהִנֵּה שָׁם שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶדְרֵי צֹאן רֹבְצִים עָלֶיהָ כִּי מִן הַבְּאֵר הַהִוא יַשְׁקוּ הָעֲדָרִים וְהָאֶבֶן גְּדֹלָה עַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר׃

english.text:
And he looked, and here was a well in the field, and here
were three flocks of sheep lying by it, because they
watered the flocks from that well, and the stone on the
mouth of the well was big,

translation.text: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well’s mouth.

verses.english:
And he looked, and here was a well in the field, and here
were three flocks of sheep lying by it, because they
watered the flocks from that well, and the stone on the
mouth of the well was big,

verses.hebrew: וְנֶאֶסְפוּ שָׁמָּה כל הָעֲדָרִים וְגָלְלוּ אֶת הָאֶבֶן מֵעַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר וְהִשְׁקוּ אֶת הַצֹּאן וְהֵשִׁיבוּ אֶת הָאֶבֶן עַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר לִמְקֹמָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְנֶאֶסְפוּ שָׁמָּה כל הָעֲדָרִים וְגָלְלוּ אֶת הָאֶבֶן מֵעַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר וְהִשְׁקוּ אֶת הַצֹּאן וְהֵשִׁיבוּ אֶת הָאֶבֶן עַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר לִמְקֹמָהּ׃

english.text:
and all the flocks would be gathered there, and they would
roll the stone from the mouth of the well and would water
the sheep and then would put the stone back in its place
on the mouth of the well.

translation.text: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well’s mouth in his place.

verses.english:
and all the flocks would be gathered there, and they would
roll the stone from the mouth of the well and would water
the sheep and then would put the stone back in its place
on the mouth of the well.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם יַעֲקֹב אַחַי מֵאַיִן אַתֶּם וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵחָרָן אֲנָחְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם יַעֲקֹב אַחַי מֵאַיִן אַתֶּם וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵחָרָן אֲנָחְנוּ׃

english.text:
4And Jacob said to them, “My brothers, where are you
from?” And they said, “We’re from Haran.”

translation.text: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.

verses.english:
4And Jacob said to them, “My brothers, where are you
from?” And they said, “We’re from Haran.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַיְדַעְתֶּם אֶת לָבָן בֶּן נָחוֹר וַיֹּאמְרוּ יָדָעְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַיְדַעְתֶּם אֶת לָבָן בֶּן נָחוֹר וַיֹּאמְרוּ יָדָעְנוּ׃

english.text:
And he said to them, “Do you know Laban, son of Nahor?”
And they said, “We know.”

translation.text: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.

verses.english:
And he said to them, “Do you know Laban, son of Nahor?”
And they said, “We know.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הֲשָׁלוֹם לוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׁלוֹם וְהִנֵּה רָחֵל בִּתּוֹ בָּאָה עִם הַצֹּאן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הֲשָׁלוֹם לוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׁלוֹם וְהִנֵּה רָחֵל בִּתּוֹ בָּאָה עִם הַצֹּאן׃

english.text:
And he said to them, “Is he well?” And they said, “Well.
And here’s Rachel, his daughter, coming with the sheep.”

translation.text: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

verses.english:
And he said to them, “Is he well?” And they said, “Well.
And here’s Rachel, his daughter, coming with the sheep.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הֵן עוֹד הַיּוֹם גָּדוֹל לֹא עֵת הֵאָסֵף הַמִּקְנֶה הַשְׁקוּ הַצֹּאן וּלְכוּ רְעוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הֵן עוֹד הַיּוֹם גָּדוֹל לֹא עֵת הֵאָסֵף הַמִּקְנֶה הַשְׁקוּ הַצֹּאן וּלְכוּ רְעוּ׃

english.text:
And he said, “Here, it will still be daytime for a long
time, not the time for gathering the livestock. Water the
sheep and go, pasture them.”

translation.text: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.

verses.english:
And he said, “Here, it will still be daytime for a long
time, not the time for gathering the livestock. Water the
sheep and go, pasture them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא נוּכַל עַד אֲשֶׁר יֵאָסְפוּ כּל הָעֲדָרִים וְגָלְלוּ אֶת הָאֶבֶן מֵעַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר וְהִשְׁקִינוּ הַצֹּאן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא נוּכַל עַד אֲשֶׁר יֵאָסְפוּ כּל הָעֲדָרִים וְגָלְלוּ אֶת הָאֶבֶן מֵעַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר וְהִשְׁקִינוּ הַצֹּאן׃

english.text:
And they said, “We can’t until all the flocks will be
gathered and they’ll roll the stone from the mouth of the
well, and then we’ll water the sheep.”

translation.text: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well’s mouth; then we water the sheep.

verses.english:
And they said, “We can’t until all the flocks will be
gathered and they’ll roll the stone from the mouth of the
well, and then we’ll water the sheep.”

verses.hebrew: עוֹדֶנּוּ מְדַבֵּר עִמָּם וְרָחֵל בָּאָה עִם הַצֹּאן אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִיהָ כִּי רֹעָה הִוא׃

hebrew.text: עוֹדֶנּוּ מְדַבֵּר עִמָּם וְרָחֵל בָּאָה עִם הַצֹּאן אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִיהָ כִּי רֹעָה הִוא׃

english.text:
He was still speaking with them, and Rachel came with her
father’s sheep, because she was a shepherdess.

translation.text: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep; for she kept them.

verses.english:
He was still speaking with them, and Rachel came with her
father’s sheep, because she was a shepherdess.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאָה יַעֲקֹב אֶת רָחֵל בַּת לָבָן אֲחִי אִמּוֹ וְאֶת צֹאן לָבָן אֲחִי אִמּוֹ וַיִּגַּשׁ יַעֲקֹב וַיָּגֶל אֶת הָאֶבֶן מֵעַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת צֹאן לָבָן אֲחִי אִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאָה יַעֲקֹב אֶת רָחֵל בַּת לָבָן אֲחִי אִמּוֹ וְאֶת צֹאן לָבָן אֲחִי אִמּוֹ וַיִּגַּשׁ יַעֲקֹב וַיָּגֶל אֶת הָאֶבֶן מֵעַל פִּי הַבְּאֵר וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת צֹאן לָבָן אֲחִי אִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And it was when Jacob saw Rachel, daughter of Laban, his
mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s
brother: and he went over and rolled the stone from the
mouth of the well and watered the sheep of Laban, his
mother’s brother.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

verses.english:
And it was when Jacob saw Rachel, daughter of Laban, his
mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s
brother: and he went over and rolled the stone from the
mouth of the well and watered the sheep of Laban, his
mother’s brother.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשַּׁק יַעֲקֹב לְרָחֵל וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת קֹלוֹ וַיֵּבְךְּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשַּׁק יַעֲקֹב לְרָחֵל וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת קֹלוֹ וַיֵּבְךְּ׃

english.text: And Jacob kissed Rachel and raised his voice and wept.

translation.text: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

verses.english: And Jacob kissed Rachel and raised his voice and wept.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד יַעֲקֹב לְרָחֵל כִּי אֲחִי אָבִיהָ הוּא וְכִי בֶן רִבְקָה הוּא וַתָּרץ וַתַּגֵּד לְאָבִיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֵּד יַעֲקֹב לְרָחֵל כִּי אֲחִי אָבִיהָ הוּא וְכִי בֶן רִבְקָה הוּא וַתָּרץ וַתַּגֵּד לְאָבִיהָ׃

english.text:
And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s kin and
that he was Rebekah’s son, and she ran and told her
father.

translation.text: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s brother, and that he was Rebekah’s son: and she ran and told her father.

verses.english:
And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s kin and
that he was Rebekah’s son, and she ran and told her
father.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ לָבָן אֶת שֵׁמַע יַעֲקֹב בֶּן אֲחֹתוֹ וַיָּרץ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיְחַבֶּק לוֹ וַיְנַשֶּׁק לוֹ וַיְבִיאֵהוּ אֶל בֵּיתוֹ וַיְסַפֵּר לְלָבָן אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ לָבָן אֶת שֵׁמַע יַעֲקֹב בֶּן אֲחֹתוֹ וַיָּרץ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיְחַבֶּק לוֹ וַיְנַשֶּׁק לוֹ וַיְבִיאֵהוּ אֶל בֵּיתוֹ וַיְסַפֵּר לְלָבָן אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
And it was, when Laban heard the news of Jacob, his
sister’s son, that he ran to him and embraced him and
kissed him and brought him to his house. And he told Laban
all these things.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister’s son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

verses.english:
And it was, when Laban heard the news of Jacob, his
sister’s son, that he ran to him and embraced him and
kissed him and brought him to his house. And he told Laban
all these things.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לָבָן אַךְ עַצְמִי וּבְשָׂרִי אָתָּה וַיֵּשֶׁב עִמּוֹ חֹדֶשׁ יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לָבָן אַךְ עַצְמִי וּבְשָׂרִי אָתָּה וַיֵּשֶׁב עִמּוֹ חֹדֶשׁ יָמִים׃

english.text:
And Laban said to him, “You are indeed my bone and my
flesh.” And he stayed with him a month.

translation.text: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.

verses.english:
And Laban said to him, “You are indeed my bone and my
flesh.” And he stayed with him a month.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן לְיַעֲקֹב הֲכִי אָחִי אַתָּה וַעֲבַדְתַּנִי חִנָּם הַגִּידָה לִּי מַה מַּשְׂכֻּרְתֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן לְיַעֲקֹב הֲכִי אָחִי אַתָּה וַעֲבַדְתַּנִי חִנָּם הַגִּידָה לִּי מַה מַּשְׂכֻּרְתֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And Laban said to Jacob, “Is it right because you’re my
brother that you should work for me for free? Tell me what
your pay should be.”

translation.text: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?

verses.english:
And Laban said to Jacob, “Is it right because you’re my
brother that you should work for me for free? Tell me what
your pay should be.”

verses.hebrew: וּלְלָבָן שְׁתֵּי בָנוֹת שֵׁם הַגְּדֹלָה לֵאָה וְשֵׁם הַקְּטַנָּה רָחֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּלְלָבָן שְׁתֵּי בָנוֹת שֵׁם הַגְּדֹלָה לֵאָה וְשֵׁם הַקְּטַנָּה רָחֵל׃

english.text:
And Laban had two daughters. The older one’s name was
Leah, and the younger one’s name was Rachel.

translation.text: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

verses.english:
And Laban had two daughters. The older one’s name was
Leah, and the younger one’s name was Rachel.

verses.hebrew: וְעֵינֵי לֵאָה רַכּוֹת וְרָחֵל הָיְתָה יְפַת תֹּאַר וִיפַת מַרְאֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְעֵינֵי לֵאָה רַכּוֹת וְרָחֵל הָיְתָה יְפַת תֹּאַר וִיפַת מַרְאֶה׃

english.text:
And Leah’s eyes were tender, and Rachel had an attractive
figure and was beautiful.

translation.text: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.

verses.english:
And Leah’s eyes were tender, and Rachel had an attractive
figure and was beautiful.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱהַב יַעֲקֹב אֶת רָחֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֶעֱבדְךָ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים בְּרָחֵל בִּתְּךָ הַקְּטַנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאֱהַב יַעֲקֹב אֶת רָחֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֶעֱבדְךָ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים בְּרָחֵל בִּתְּךָ הַקְּטַנָּה׃

english.text:
And Jacob loved Rachel. And he said, “I’ll work for you
seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”

translation.text: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.

verses.english:
And Jacob loved Rachel. And he said, “I’ll work for you
seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן טוֹב תִּתִּי אֹתָהּ לָךְ מִתִּתִּי אֹתָהּ לְאִישׁ אַחֵר שְׁבָה עִמָּדִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן טוֹב תִּתִּי אֹתָהּ לָךְ מִתִּתִּי אֹתָהּ לְאִישׁ אַחֵר שְׁבָה עִמָּדִי׃

english.text:
And Laban said, “Better for me to give her to you than for
me to give her to another man. Live with me.”

translation.text: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.

verses.english:
And Laban said, “Better for me to give her to you than for
me to give her to another man. Live with me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹד יַעֲקֹב בְּרָחֵל שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וַיִּהְיוּ בְעֵינָיו כְּיָמִים אֲחָדִים בְּאַהֲבָתוֹ אֹתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹד יַעֲקֹב בְּרָחֵל שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וַיִּהְיוּ בְעֵינָיו כְּיָמִים אֲחָדִים בְּאַהֲבָתוֹ אֹתָהּ׃

english.text:
And Jacob worked seven years for Rachel, and they were
like a few days in his eyes because of his loving her.

translation.text: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.

verses.english:
And Jacob worked seven years for Rachel, and they were
like a few days in his eyes because of his loving her.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל לָבָן הָבָה אֶת אִשְׁתִּי כִּי מָלְאוּ יָמָי וְאָבוֹאָה אֵלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל לָבָן הָבָה אֶת אִשְׁתִּי כִּי מָלְאוּ יָמָי וְאָבוֹאָה אֵלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, because my days
have been completed, and let me come to her.”

translation.text: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.

verses.english:
And Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, because my days
have been completed, and let me come to her.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱסֹף לָבָן אֶת כּל אַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם וַיַּעַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף לָבָן אֶת כּל אַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם וַיַּעַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּה׃

english.text:
And Laban gathered all the people of the place and made a
feast.

translation.text: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

verses.english:
And Laban gathered all the people of the place and made a
feast.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בָעֶרֶב וַיִּקַּח אֶת לֵאָה בִתּוֹ וַיָּבֵא אֹתָהּ אֵלָיו וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בָעֶרֶב וַיִּקַּח אֶת לֵאָה בִתּוֹ וַיָּבֵא אֹתָהּ אֵלָיו וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And it was in the evening, and he took Leah, his daughter,
and brought her to him. And he came to her.

translation.text: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.

verses.english:
And it was in the evening, and he took Leah, his daughter,
and brought her to him. And he came to her.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לָבָן לָהּ אֶת זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחָתוֹ לְלֵאָה בִתּוֹ שִׁפְחָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן לָבָן לָהּ אֶת זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחָתוֹ לְלֵאָה בִתּוֹ שִׁפְחָה׃

english.text:
And Laban gave her his maid Zilpah—to Leah, his daughter,
as a maid.

translation.text: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.

verses.english:
And Laban gave her his maid Zilpah—to Leah, his daughter,
as a maid.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה הִוא לֵאָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל לָבָן מַה זֹּאת עָשִׂיתָ לִּי הֲלֹא בְרָחֵל עָבַדְתִּי עִמָּךְ וְלָמָּה רִמִּיתָנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה הִוא לֵאָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל לָבָן מַה זֹּאת עָשִׂיתָ לִּי הֲלֹא בְרָחֵל עָבַדְתִּי עִמָּךְ וְלָמָּה רִמִּיתָנִי׃

english.text:
And it was in the morning, and here she was: Leah! And he
said to Laban, “What is this you’ve done to me? Didn’t I
work with you for Rachel? And why have you deceived me?”

translation.text: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?

verses.english:
And it was in the morning, and here she was: Leah! And he
said to Laban, “What is this you’ve done to me? Didn’t I
work with you for Rachel? And why have you deceived me?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן לֹא יֵעָשֶׂה כֵן בִּמְקוֹמֵנוּ לָתֵת הַצְּעִירָה לִפְנֵי הַבְּכִירָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן לֹא יֵעָשֶׂה כֵן בִּמְקוֹמֵנוּ לָתֵת הַצְּעִירָה לִפְנֵי הַבְּכִירָה׃

english.text:
And Laban said, “It’s not done like that in our place, to
give the younger one before the firstborn.

translation.text: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.

verses.english:
And Laban said, “It’s not done like that in our place, to
give the younger one before the firstborn.

verses.hebrew: מַלֵּא שְׁבֻעַ זֹאת וְנִתְּנָה לְךָ גַּם אֶת זֹאת בַּעֲבֹדָה אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲבֹד עִמָּדִי עוֹד שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים אֲחֵרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: מַלֵּא שְׁבֻעַ זֹאת וְנִתְּנָה לְךָ גַּם אֶת זֹאת בַּעֲבֹדָה אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲבֹד עִמָּדִי עוֹד שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים אֲחֵרוֹת׃

english.text:
Complete this week, and this one will be given to you as
well—for the work that you’ll do with me: another seven
years.”

translation.text: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.

verses.english:
Complete this week, and this one will be given to you as
well—for the work that you’ll do with me: another seven
years.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ יַעֲקֹב כֵּן וַיְמַלֵּא שְׁבֻעַ זֹאת וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ אֶת רָחֵל בִּתּוֹ לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ יַעֲקֹב כֵּן וַיְמַלֵּא שְׁבֻעַ זֹאת וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ אֶת רָחֵל בִּתּוֹ לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
And Jacob did so; and he completed this week, and he gave
him Rachel, his daughter, for a wife.

translation.text: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.

verses.english:
And Jacob did so; and he completed this week, and he gave
him Rachel, his daughter, for a wife.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לָבָן לְרָחֵל בִּתּוֹ אֶת בִּלְהָה שִׁפְחָתוֹ לָהּ לְשִׁפְחָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן לָבָן לְרָחֵל בִּתּוֹ אֶת בִּלְהָה שִׁפְחָתוֹ לָהּ לְשִׁפְחָה׃

english.text:
And Laban gave his maid Bilhah to Rachel, his daughter—to
her as a maid.

translation.text: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.

verses.english:
And Laban gave his maid Bilhah to Rachel, his daughter—to
her as a maid.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא גַּם אֶל רָחֵל וַיֶּאֱהַב גַּם אֶת רָחֵל מִלֵּאָה וַיַּעֲבֹד עִמּוֹ עוֹד שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים אֲחֵרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא גַּם אֶל רָחֵל וַיֶּאֱהַב גַּם אֶת רָחֵל מִלֵּאָה וַיַּעֲבֹד עִמּוֹ עוֹד שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים אֲחֵרוֹת׃

english.text:
And he also came to Rachel. And he also loved Rachel more
than Leah. And he worked with him another seven years.

translation.text: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

verses.english:
And he also came to Rachel. And he also loved Rachel more
than Leah. And he worked with him another seven years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יְהֹוָה כִּי שְׂנוּאָה לֵאָה וַיִּפְתַּח אֶת רַחְמָהּ וְרָחֵל עֲקָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יְהֹוָה כִּי שְׂנוּאָה לֵאָה וַיִּפְתַּח אֶת רַחְמָהּ וְרָחֵל עֲקָרָה׃

english.text:
And YHWH saw that Leah was hated, and He opened her womb,
and Rachel was infertile.

translation.text: And when the LORD saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.

verses.english:
And YHWH saw that Leah was hated, and He opened her womb,
and Rachel was infertile.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר לֵאָה וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ רְאוּבֵן כִּי אָמְרָה כִּי רָאָה יְהֹוָה בְּענְיִי כִּי עַתָּה יֶאֱהָבַנִי אִישִׁי׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר לֵאָה וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ רְאוּבֵן כִּי אָמְרָה כִּי רָאָה יְהֹוָה בְּענְיִי כִּי עַתָּה יֶאֱהָבַנִי אִישִׁי׃

english.text:
And Leah became pregnant and gave birth to a son and
called his name Reuben because she said, “Because YHWH
looked at my suffering, so that now my man will love me.”

translation.text: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.

verses.english:
And Leah became pregnant and gave birth to a son and
called his name Reuben because she said, “Because YHWH
looked at my suffering, so that now my man will love me.”

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתֹּאמֶר כִּי שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה כִּי שְׂנוּאָה אָנֹכִי וַיִּתֶּן לִי גַּם אֶת זֶה וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ שִׁמְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתֹּאמֶר כִּי שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה כִּי שְׂנוּאָה אָנֹכִי וַיִּתֶּן לִי גַּם אֶת זֶה וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ שִׁמְעוֹן׃

english.text:
And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son and
said, “Because YHWH listened because I was hated and gave
me this one, too.” And she called his name Simeon.

translation.text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.

verses.english:
And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son and
said, “Because YHWH listened because I was hated and gave
me this one, too.” And she called his name Simeon.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתֹּאמֶר עַתָּה הַפַּעַם יִלָּוֶה אִישִׁי אֵלַי כִּי יָלַדְתִּי לוֹ שְׁלֹשָׁה בָנִים עַל כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמוֹ לֵוִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתֹּאמֶר עַתָּה הַפַּעַם יִלָּוֶה אִישִׁי אֵלַי כִּי יָלַדְתִּי לוֹ שְׁלֹשָׁה בָנִים עַל כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמוֹ לֵוִי׃

english.text:
And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son, and
she said, “Now, this time my man will become bound to me
because I’ve given birth to three sons for him.” On
account of this his name was called Levi.

translation.text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.

verses.english:
And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son, and
she said, “Now, this time my man will become bound to me
because I’ve given birth to three sons for him.” On
account of this his name was called Levi.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתֹּאמֶר הַפַּעַם אוֹדֶה אֶת יְהֹוָה עַל כֵּן קָרְאָה שְׁמוֹ יְהוּדָה וַתַּעֲמֹד מִלֶּדֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתֹּאמֶר הַפַּעַם אוֹדֶה אֶת יְהֹוָה עַל כֵּן קָרְאָה שְׁמוֹ יְהוּדָה וַתַּעֲמֹד מִלֶּדֶת׃

english.text:
And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son and
said, “This time I’ll praise YHWH.” On account of this she
called his name Judah. And she stopped giving birth.

translation.text: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the LORD: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.

verses.english:
And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son and
said, “This time I’ll praise YHWH.” On account of this she
called his name Judah. And she stopped giving birth.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא רָחֵל כִּי לֹא יָלְדָה לְיַעֲקֹב וַתְּקַנֵּא רָחֵל בַּאֲחֹתָהּ וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל יַעֲקֹב הָבָה לִּי בָנִים וְאִם אַיִן מֵתָה אָנֹכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרֶא רָחֵל כִּי לֹא יָלְדָה לְיַעֲקֹב וַתְּקַנֵּא רָחֵל בַּאֲחֹתָהּ וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל יַעֲקֹב הָבָה לִּי בָנִים וְאִם אַיִן מֵתָה אָנֹכִי׃

english.text:
And Rachel saw that she had not given birth for Jacob,
and Rachel was jealous of her sister, and she said to
Jacob, “Give me children. And if not I’m dying!”

translation.text: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.

verses.english:
And Rachel saw that she had not given birth for Jacob,
and Rachel was jealous of her sister, and she said to
Jacob, “Give me children. And if not I’m dying!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר אַף יַעֲקֹב בְּרָחֵל וַיֹּאמֶר הֲתַחַת אֱלֹהִים אָנֹכִי אֲשֶׁר מָנַע מִמֵּךְ פְּרִי בָטֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר אַף יַעֲקֹב בְּרָחֵל וַיֹּאמֶר הֲתַחַת אֱלֹהִים אָנֹכִי אֲשֶׁר מָנַע מִמֵּךְ פְּרִי בָטֶן׃

english.text:
And Jacob’s anger flared at Rachel, and he said, “Am I in
place of God, who has held back the fruit of the womb from
you?!”

translation.text: And Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God’s stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?

verses.english:
And Jacob’s anger flared at Rachel, and he said, “Am I in
place of God, who has held back the fruit of the womb from
you?!”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה אֲמָתִי בִלְהָה בֹּא אֵלֶיהָ וְתֵלֵד עַל בִּרְכַּי וְאִבָּנֶה גַם אָנֹכִי מִמֶּנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה אֲמָתִי בִלְהָה בֹּא אֵלֶיהָ וְתֵלֵד עַל בִּרְכַּי וְאִבָּנֶה גַם אָנֹכִי מִמֶּנָּה׃

english.text:
And she said, “Here’s my maid, Bilhah. Come to her, and
she’ll give birth on my knees, and I too will get a child
through her.”

translation.text: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.

verses.english:
And she said, “Here’s my maid, Bilhah. Come to her, and
she’ll give birth on my knees, and I too will get a child
through her.”

verses.hebrew: וַתִּתֶּן לוֹ אֶת בִּלְהָה שִׁפְחָתָהּ לְאִשָּׁה וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ יַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּתֶּן לוֹ אֶת בִּלְהָה שִׁפְחָתָהּ לְאִשָּׁה וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ יַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And she gave him Bilhah, her maid, as a wife, and Jacob
came to her.

translation.text: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.

verses.english:
And she gave him Bilhah, her maid, as a wife, and Jacob
came to her.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר בִּלְהָה וַתֵּלֶד לְיַעֲקֹב בֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר בִּלְהָה וַתֵּלֶד לְיַעֲקֹב בֵּן׃

english.text:
And Bilhah became pregnant and gave birth to a son for
Jacob.

translation.text: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.

verses.english:
And Bilhah became pregnant and gave birth to a son for
Jacob.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל דָּנַנִּי אֱלֹהִים וְגַם שָׁמַע בְּקֹלִי וַיִּתֶּן לִי בֵּן עַל כֵּן קָרְאָה שְׁמוֹ דָּן׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל דָּנַנִּי אֱלֹהִים וְגַם שָׁמַע בְּקֹלִי וַיִּתֶּן לִי בֵּן עַל כֵּן קָרְאָה שְׁמוֹ דָּן׃

english.text:
And Rachel said, “God has judged me and heard my prayer as
well and has given me a son.” On account of this she
called his name Dan.

translation.text: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.

verses.english:
And Rachel said, “God has judged me and heard my prayer as
well and has given me a son.” On account of this she
called his name Dan.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בִּלְהָה שִׁפְחַת רָחֵל בֵּן שֵׁנִי לְיַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בִּלְהָה שִׁפְחַת רָחֵל בֵּן שֵׁנִי לְיַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And Bilhah, Rachel’s maid, became pregnant again and gave
birth to a second son for Jacob.

translation.text: And Bilhah Rachel’s maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.

verses.english:
And Bilhah, Rachel’s maid, became pregnant again and gave
birth to a second son for Jacob.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל נַפְתּוּלֵי אֱלֹהִים נִפְתַּלְתִּי עִם אֲחֹתִי גַּם יָכֹלְתִּי וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ נַפְתָּלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל נַפְתּוּלֵי אֱלֹהִים נִפְתַּלְתִּי עִם אֲחֹתִי גַּם יָכֹלְתִּי וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ נַפְתָּלִי׃

english.text:
And Rachel said, “I’ve had Godlike struggles with my
sister. I’ve also prevailed.” And she called his name
Naphtali.

translation.text: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.

verses.english:
And Rachel said, “I’ve had Godlike struggles with my
sister. I’ve also prevailed.” And she called his name
Naphtali.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא לֵאָה כִּי עָמְדָה מִלֶּדֶת וַתִּקַּח אֶת זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחָתָהּ וַתִּתֵּן אֹתָהּ לְיַעֲקֹב לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרֶא לֵאָה כִּי עָמְדָה מִלֶּדֶת וַתִּקַּח אֶת זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחָתָהּ וַתִּתֵּן אֹתָהּ לְיַעֲקֹב לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
And Leah saw that she had stopped giving birth, and she
took Zilpah, her maid, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

translation.text: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.

verses.english:
And Leah saw that she had stopped giving birth, and she
took Zilpah, her maid, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחַת לֵאָה לְיַעֲקֹב בֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחַת לֵאָה לְיַעֲקֹב בֵּן׃

english.text: And Zilpah, Leah’s maid, gave birth to a son for Jacob.

translation.text: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a son.

verses.english: And Zilpah, Leah’s maid, gave birth to a son for Jacob.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאָה (בגד) [בָּא גָד] וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ גָּד׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאָה (בגד) [בָּא גָד] וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ גָּד׃

english.text: And Leah said, “With fortune!” and called his name Gad.

translation.text: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.

verses.english: And Leah said, “With fortune!” and called his name Gad.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחַת לֵאָה בֵּן שֵׁנִי לְיַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחַת לֵאָה בֵּן שֵׁנִי לְיַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And Zilpah, Leah’s maid, gave birth to a second son for
Jacob.

translation.text: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a second son.

verses.english:
And Zilpah, Leah’s maid, gave birth to a second son for
Jacob.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאָה בְּאשְׁרִי כִּי אִשְּׁרוּנִי בָּנוֹת וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ אָשֵׁר׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאָה בְּאשְׁרִי כִּי אִשְּׁרוּנִי בָּנוֹת וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ אָשֵׁר׃

english.text:
And Leah said, “With my happiness!—because daughters will
wish me happiness,” and called his name Asher.

translation.text: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.

verses.english:
And Leah said, “With my happiness!—because daughters will
wish me happiness,” and called his name Asher.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ רְאוּבֵן בִּימֵי קְצִיר חִטִּים וַיִּמְצָא דוּדָאִים בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיָּבֵא אֹתָם אֶל לֵאָה אִמּוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל אֶל לֵאָה תְּנִי נָא לִי מִדּוּדָאֵי בְּנֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ רְאוּבֵן בִּימֵי קְצִיר חִטִּים וַיִּמְצָא דוּדָאִים בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיָּבֵא אֹתָם אֶל לֵאָה אִמּוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל אֶל לֵאָה תְּנִי נָא לִי מִדּוּדָאֵי בְּנֵךְ׃

english.text:
And in the days of wheat harvest Reuben went and found
mandrakes in the field and brought them to Leah, his
mother. And Rachel said to Leah, “Give me some of your
son’s mandrakes.”

translation.text: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son’s mandrakes.

verses.english:
And in the days of wheat harvest Reuben went and found
mandrakes in the field and brought them to Leah, his
mother. And Rachel said to Leah, “Give me some of your
son’s mandrakes.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ הַמְעַט קַחְתֵּךְ אֶת אִישִׁי וְלָקַחַת גַּם אֶת דּוּדָאֵי בְּנִי וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל לָכֵן יִשְׁכַּב עִמָּךְ הַלַּיְלָה תַּחַת דּוּדָאֵי בְנֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ הַמְעַט קַחְתֵּךְ אֶת אִישִׁי וְלָקַחַת גַּם אֶת דּוּדָאֵי בְּנִי וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל לָכֵן יִשְׁכַּב עִמָּךְ הַלַּיְלָה תַּחַת דּוּדָאֵי בְנֵךְ׃

english.text:
And she said to her, “Is your taking my man a small thing?
And you’re taking my son’s mandrakes, too?!” And Rachel
said, “Then let him lie with you tonight in return for
your son’s mandrakes.”

translation.text: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son’s mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son’s mandrakes.

verses.english:
And she said to her, “Is your taking my man a small thing?
And you’re taking my son’s mandrakes, too?!” And Rachel
said, “Then let him lie with you tonight in return for
your son’s mandrakes.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב מִן הַשָּׂדֶה בָּעֶרֶב וַתֵּצֵא לֵאָה לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלַי תָּבוֹא כִּי שָׂכֹר שְׂכַרְתִּיךָ בְּדוּדָאֵי בְּנִי וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִמָּהּ בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב מִן הַשָּׂדֶה בָּעֶרֶב וַתֵּצֵא לֵאָה לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלַי תָּבוֹא כִּי שָׂכֹר שְׂכַרְתִּיךָ בְּדוּדָאֵי בְּנִי וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִמָּהּ בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא׃

english.text:
And Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah
went out to him and said, “You are to come to me, because
I’ve hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” And he lay with
her that night.

translation.text: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son’s mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.

verses.english:
And Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah
went out to him and said, “You are to come to me, because
I’ve hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” And he lay with
her that night.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶל לֵאָה וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד לְיַעֲקֹב בֵּן חֲמִישִׁי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶל לֵאָה וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד לְיַעֲקֹב בֵּן חֲמִישִׁי׃

english.text:
And God listened to Leah, and she became pregnant and gave
birth to a fifth son for Jacob.

translation.text: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.

verses.english:
And God listened to Leah, and she became pregnant and gave
birth to a fifth son for Jacob.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאָה נָתַן אֱלֹהִים שְׂכָרִי אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי שִׁפְחָתִי לְאִישִׁי וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ יִשָּׂשכָר׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאָה נָתַן אֱלֹהִים שְׂכָרִי אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי שִׁפְחָתִי לְאִישִׁי וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ יִשָּׂשכָר׃

english.text:
And Leah said, “God has given my hire because I gave my
maid to my man,” and she called his name Issachar.

translation.text: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.

verses.english:
And Leah said, “God has given my hire because I gave my
maid to my man,” and she called his name Issachar.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר עוֹד לֵאָה וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן שִׁשִּׁי לְיַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר עוֹד לֵאָה וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן שִׁשִּׁי לְיַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And Leah became pregnant again and gave birth to a sixth
son for Jacob.

translation.text: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.

verses.english:
And Leah became pregnant again and gave birth to a sixth
son for Jacob.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאָה זְבָדַנִי אֱלֹהִים אֹתִי זֵבֶד טוֹב הַפַּעַם יִזְבְּלֵנִי אִישִׁי כִּי יָלַדְתִּי לוֹ שִׁשָּׁה בָנִים וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ זְבֻלוּן׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאָה זְבָדַנִי אֱלֹהִים אֹתִי זֵבֶד טוֹב הַפַּעַם יִזְבְּלֵנִי אִישִׁי כִּי יָלַדְתִּי לוֹ שִׁשָּׁה בָנִים וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ זְבֻלוּן׃

english.text:
And Leah said, “God has given me a good gift. This time my
man will value me highly, because I’ve given birth to six
sons for him,” and she called his name Zebulun.

translation.text: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.

verses.english:
And Leah said, “God has given me a good gift. This time my
man will value me highly, because I’ve given birth to six
sons for him,” and she called his name Zebulun.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר יָלְדָה בַּת וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמָהּ דִּינָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחַר יָלְדָה בַּת וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמָהּ דִּינָה׃

english.text:
And after that she gave birth to a daughter and called her
name Dinah.

translation.text: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

verses.english:
And after that she gave birth to a daughter and called her
name Dinah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת רָחֵל וַיִּשְׁמַע אֵלֶיהָ אֱלֹהִים וַיִּפְתַּח אֶת רַחְמָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת רָחֵל וַיִּשְׁמַע אֵלֶיהָ אֱלֹהִים וַיִּפְתַּח אֶת רַחְמָהּ׃

english.text:
And God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her and
opened her womb,

translation.text: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

verses.english:
And God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her and
opened her womb,

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתֹּאמֶר אָסַף אֱלֹהִים אֶת חֶרְפָּתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתֹּאמֶר אָסַף אֱלֹהִים אֶת חֶרְפָּתִי׃

english.text:
and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. And she
said, “God has taken away my humiliation”

translation.text: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:

verses.english:
and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. And she
said, “God has taken away my humiliation”

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ יוֹסֵף לֵאמֹר יֹסֵף יְהֹוָה לִי בֵּן אַחֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ יוֹסֵף לֵאמֹר יֹסֵף יְהֹוָה לִי בֵּן אַחֵר׃

english.text:
and called his name Joseph, saying, “May YHWH add another
son to me.”

translation.text: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son.

verses.english:
and called his name Joseph, saying, “May YHWH add another
son to me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה רָחֵל אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל לָבָן שַׁלְּחֵנִי וְאֵלְכָה אֶל מְקוֹמִי וּלְאַרְצִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה רָחֵל אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל לָבָן שַׁלְּחֵנִי וְאֵלְכָה אֶל מְקוֹמִי וּלְאַרְצִי׃

english.text:
And it was when Rachel had given birth to Joseph: and
Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away so I may go to my place
and my land.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.

verses.english:
And it was when Rachel had given birth to Joseph: and
Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away so I may go to my place
and my land.

verses.hebrew: תְּנָה אֶת נָשַׁי וְאֶת יְלָדַי אֲשֶׁר עָבַדְתִּי אֹתְךָ בָּהֵן וְאֵלֵכָה כִּי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת עֲבֹדָתִי אֲשֶׁר עֲבַדְתִּיךָ׃

hebrew.text: תְּנָה אֶת נָשַׁי וְאֶת יְלָדַי אֲשֶׁר עָבַדְתִּי אֹתְךָ בָּהֵן וְאֵלֵכָה כִּי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת עֲבֹדָתִי אֲשֶׁר עֲבַדְתִּיךָ׃

english.text:
Give me my wives and my children for whom I’ve worked for
you and let me go; because you know my work that I’ve done
for you.”

translation.text: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.

verses.english:
Give me my wives and my children for whom I’ve worked for
you and let me go; because you know my work that I’ve done
for you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לָבָן אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ נִחַשְׁתִּי וַיְבָרְכֵנִי יְהֹוָה בִּגְלָלֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לָבָן אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ נִחַשְׁתִּי וַיְבָרְכֵנִי יְהֹוָה בִּגְלָלֶךָ׃

english.text:
And Laban said to him, “If I’ve found favor in your eyes,
I’ve divined that YHWH has blessed me because of you,”

translation.text: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.

verses.english:
And Laban said to him, “If I’ve found favor in your eyes,
I’ve divined that YHWH has blessed me because of you,”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר נקְבָה שְׂכָרְךָ עָלַי וְאֶתֵּנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר נקְבָה שְׂכָרְךָ עָלַי וְאֶתֵּנָה׃

english.text:
and he said, “Designate your pay for me, and I’ll give
it.”

translation.text: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.

verses.english:
and he said, “Designate your pay for me, and I’ll give
it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר עֲבַדְתִּיךָ וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר הָיָה מִקְנְךָ אִתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר עֲבַדְתִּיךָ וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר הָיָה מִקְנְךָ אִתִּי׃

english.text:
And he said to him, “You know how I’ve worked for you and
how your cattle have become with me,

translation.text: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.

verses.english:
And he said to him, “You know how I’ve worked for you and
how your cattle have become with me,

verses.hebrew: כִּי מְעַט אֲשֶׁר הָיָה לְךָ לְפָנַי וַיִּפְרֹץ לָרֹב וַיְבָרֶךְ יְהֹוָה אֹתְךָ לְרַגְלִי וְעַתָּה מָתַי אֶעֱשֶׂה גַם אָנֹכִי לְבֵיתִי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי מְעַט אֲשֶׁר הָיָה לְךָ לְפָנַי וַיִּפְרֹץ לָרֹב וַיְבָרֶךְ יְהֹוָה אֹתְךָ לְרַגְלִי וְעַתָּה מָתַי אֶעֱשֶׂה גַם אָנֹכִי לְבֵיתִי׃

english.text:
that a little that you had before me expanded into a lot,
and YHWH blessed you wherever I set foot. And now, when
shall I also take care of my house?”

translation.text: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?

verses.english:
that a little that you had before me expanded into a lot,
and YHWH blessed you wherever I set foot. And now, when
shall I also take care of my house?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה אֶתֶּן לָךְ וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב לֹא תִתֶּן לִי מְאוּמָה אִם תַּעֲשֶׂה לִּי הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אָשׁוּבָה אֶרְעֶה צֹאנְךָ אֶשְׁמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה אֶתֶּן לָךְ וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב לֹא תִתֶּן לִי מְאוּמָה אִם תַּעֲשֶׂה לִּי הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אָשׁוּבָה אֶרְעֶה צֹאנְךָ אֶשְׁמֹר׃

english.text:
And he said, “What shall I give you?” And Jacob said, “You
won’t give me anything—if you’ll do this thing for me: Let
me go back; I’ll tend and watch over your flock.

translation.text: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock.

verses.english:
And he said, “What shall I give you?” And Jacob said, “You
won’t give me anything—if you’ll do this thing for me: Let
me go back; I’ll tend and watch over your flock.

verses.hebrew: אֶעֱבֹר בְּכל צֹאנְךָ הַיּוֹם הָסֵר מִשָּׁם כּל שֶׂה נָקֹד וְטָלוּא וְכל שֶׂה חוּם בַּכְּשָׂבִים וְטָלוּא וְנָקֹד בָּעִזִּים וְהָיָה שְׂכָרִי׃

hebrew.text: אֶעֱבֹר בְּכל צֹאנְךָ הַיּוֹם הָסֵר מִשָּׁם כּל שֶׂה נָקֹד וְטָלוּא וְכל שֶׂה חוּם בַּכְּשָׂבִים וְטָלוּא וְנָקֹד בָּעִזִּים וְהָיָה שְׂכָרִי׃

english.text:
I’ll pass among all your flock today removing from there
every speckled and spotted lamb and every brown lamb among
the sheep and every spotted and speckled one among the
goats—and that will be my pay.

translation.text: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.

verses.english:
I’ll pass among all your flock today removing from there
every speckled and spotted lamb and every brown lamb among
the sheep and every spotted and speckled one among the
goats—and that will be my pay.

verses.hebrew: וְעָנְתָה בִּי צִדְקָתִי בְּיוֹם מָחָר כִּי תָבוֹא עַל שְׂכָרִי לְפָנֶיךָ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר אֵינֶנּוּ נָקֹד וְטָלוּא בָּעִזִּים וְחוּם בַּכְּשָׂבִים גָּנוּב הוּא אִתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְעָנְתָה בִּי צִדְקָתִי בְּיוֹם מָחָר כִּי תָבוֹא עַל שְׂכָרִי לְפָנֶיךָ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר אֵינֶנּוּ נָקֹד וְטָלוּא בָּעִזִּים וְחוּם בַּכְּשָׂבִים גָּנוּב הוּא אִתִּי׃

english.text:
And my virtue will answer for me in a future day: when
you’ll come upon my pay, it will be in front of you. Any
one that isn’t speckled and spotted among the goats and
brown among the sheep, it’s stolen with me.”

translation.text: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.

verses.english:
And my virtue will answer for me in a future day: when
you’ll come upon my pay, it will be in front of you. Any
one that isn’t speckled and spotted among the goats and
brown among the sheep, it’s stolen with me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן הֵן לוּ יְהִי כִדְבָרֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן הֵן לוּ יְהִי כִדְבָרֶךָ׃

english.text: And Laban said, “Here, let it be according to your word.”

translation.text: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.

verses.english: And Laban said, “Here, let it be according to your word.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּסַר בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת הַתְּיָשִׁים הָעֲקֻדִּים וְהַטְּלֻאִים וְאֵת כּל הָעִזִּים הַנְּקֻדּוֹת וְהַטְּלֻאֹת כֹּל אֲשֶׁר לָבָן בּוֹ וְכל חוּם בַּכְּשָׂבִים וַיִּתֵּן בְּיַד בָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּסַר בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת הַתְּיָשִׁים הָעֲקֻדִּים וְהַטְּלֻאִים וְאֵת כּל הָעִזִּים הַנְּקֻדּוֹת וְהַטְּלֻאֹת כֹּל אֲשֶׁר לָבָן בּוֹ וְכל חוּם בַּכְּשָׂבִים וַיִּתֵּן בְּיַד בָּנָיו׃

english.text:
And in that day he removed the he-goats that were streaked
and spotted and the she-goats that were speckled and
spotted, every one that had white in it, and every brown
one among the sheep, and set them in his sons’ hand

translation.text: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

verses.english:
And in that day he removed the he-goats that were streaked
and spotted and the she-goats that were speckled and
spotted, every one that had white in it, and every brown
one among the sheep, and set them in his sons’ hand

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים בֵּינוֹ וּבֵין יַעֲקֹב וְיַעֲקֹב רֹעֶה אֶת צֹאן לָבָן הַנּוֹתָרֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים בֵּינוֹ וּבֵין יַעֲקֹב וְיַעֲקֹב רֹעֶה אֶת צֹאן לָבָן הַנּוֹתָרֹת׃

english.text:
and put three days’ distance between him and Jacob. And
Jacob was tending Laban’s remaining sheep.

translation.text: And he set three days’ journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

verses.english:
and put three days’ distance between him and Jacob. And
Jacob was tending Laban’s remaining sheep.
