verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח לוֹ יַעֲקֹב מַקַּל לִבְנֶה לַח וְלוּז וְעַרְמוֹן וַיְפַצֵּל בָּהֵן פְּצָלוֹת לְבָנוֹת מַחְשֹׂף הַלָּבָן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמַּקְלוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח לוֹ יַעֲקֹב מַקַּל לִבְנֶה לַח וְלוּז וְעַרְמוֹן וַיְפַצֵּל בָּהֵן פְּצָלוֹת לְבָנוֹת מַחְשֹׂף הַלָּבָן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמַּקְלוֹת׃

english.text:
And Jacob took a rod of fresh poplar and one of almond
tree and one of plane tree, and he peeled white stripes in
them, exposing the white that was on the rods.

translation.text: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chestnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

verses.english:
And Jacob took a rod of fresh poplar and one of almond
tree and one of plane tree, and he peeled white stripes in
them, exposing the white that was on the rods.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּצֵּג אֶת הַמַּקְלוֹת אֲשֶׁר פִּצֵּל בָּרְהָטִים בְּשִׁקְתוֹת הַמָּיִם אֲשֶׁר תָּבֹאןָ הַצֹּאן לִשְׁתּוֹת לְנֹכַח הַצֹּאן וַיֵּחַמְנָה בְּבֹאָן לִשְׁתּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּצֵּג אֶת הַמַּקְלוֹת אֲשֶׁר פִּצֵּל בָּרְהָטִים בְּשִׁקְתוֹת הַמָּיִם אֲשֶׁר תָּבֹאןָ הַצֹּאן לִשְׁתּוֹת לְנֹכַח הַצֹּאן וַיֵּחַמְנָה בְּבֹאָן לִשְׁתּוֹת׃

english.text:
And he set up the rods that he had peeled in the channels
in the watering troughs at which the flock came to drink,
facing the flock. And they copulated when they came to
drink.

translation.text: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

verses.english:
And he set up the rods that he had peeled in the channels
in the watering troughs at which the flock came to drink,
facing the flock. And they copulated when they came to
drink.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחֱמוּ הַצֹּאן אֶל הַמַּקְלוֹת וַתֵּלַדְןָ הַצֹּאן עֲקֻדִּים נְקֻדִּים וּטְלֻאִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּחֱמוּ הַצֹּאן אֶל הַמַּקְלוֹת וַתֵּלַדְןָ הַצֹּאן עֲקֻדִּים נְקֻדִּים וּטְלֻאִים׃

english.text:
And the flock mated at the rods, and the flock gave birth
to streaked, speckled, and spotted ones.

translation.text: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.

verses.english:
And the flock mated at the rods, and the flock gave birth
to streaked, speckled, and spotted ones.

verses.hebrew: וְהַכְּשָׂבִים הִפְרִיד יַעֲקֹב וַיִּתֵּן פְּנֵי הַצֹּאן אֶל עָקֹד וְכל חוּם בְּצֹאן לָבָן וַיָּשֶׁת לוֹ עֲדָרִים לְבַדּוֹ וְלֹא שָׁתָם עַל צֹאן לָבָן׃

hebrew.text: וְהַכְּשָׂבִים הִפְרִיד יַעֲקֹב וַיִּתֵּן פְּנֵי הַצֹּאן אֶל עָקֹד וְכל חוּם בְּצֹאן לָבָן וַיָּשֶׁת לוֹ עֲדָרִים לְבַדּוֹ וְלֹא שָׁתָם עַל צֹאן לָבָן׃

english.text:
And Jacob separated the sheep and had the flock face the
streaked and every brown one among Laban’s flock, and he
set his own droves apart and did not set them by Laban’s
flock.

translation.text: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban’s cattle.

verses.english:
And Jacob separated the sheep and had the flock face the
streaked and every brown one among Laban’s flock, and he
set his own droves apart and did not set them by Laban’s
flock.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בְּכל יַחֵם הַצֹּאן הַמְקֻשָּׁרוֹת וְשָׂם יַעֲקֹב אֶת הַמַּקְלוֹת לְעֵינֵי הַצֹּאן בָּרְהָטִים לְיַחְמֵנָּה בַּמַּקְלוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בְּכל יַחֵם הַצֹּאן הַמְקֻשָּׁרוֹת וְשָׂם יַעֲקֹב אֶת הַמַּקְלוֹת לְעֵינֵי הַצֹּאן בָּרְהָטִים לְיַחְמֵנָּה בַּמַּקְלוֹת׃

english.text:
And it was that whenever the fittest sheep would copulate
Jacob would put the rods in the channels before the
sheep’s eyes so that they would copulate by the rods,

translation.text: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.

verses.english:
And it was that whenever the fittest sheep would copulate
Jacob would put the rods in the channels before the
sheep’s eyes so that they would copulate by the rods,

verses.hebrew: וּבְהַעֲטִיף הַצֹּאן לֹא יָשִׂים וְהָיָה הָעֲטֻפִים לְלָבָן וְהַקְּשֻׁרִים לְיַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וּבְהַעֲטִיף הַצֹּאן לֹא יָשִׂים וְהָיָה הָעֲטֻפִים לְלָבָן וְהַקְּשֻׁרִים לְיַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
and when the sheep were feebler he would not put them, so
the feeble ones became Laban’s and the fitter ones became
Jacob’s.

translation.text: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

verses.english:
and when the sheep were feebler he would not put them, so
the feeble ones became Laban’s and the fitter ones became
Jacob’s.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְרֹץ הָאִישׁ מְאֹד מְאֹד וַיְהִי לוֹ צֹאן רַבּוֹת וּשְׁפָחוֹת וַעֲבָדִים וּגְמַלִּים וַחֲמֹרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְרֹץ הָאִישׁ מְאֹד מְאֹד וַיְהִי לוֹ צֹאן רַבּוֹת וּשְׁפָחוֹת וַעֲבָדִים וּגְמַלִּים וַחֲמֹרִים׃

english.text:
And the man expanded very, very much, and he had many
sheep and female and male servants and camels and asses.

translation.text: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.

verses.english:
And the man expanded very, very much, and he had many
sheep and female and male servants and camels and asses.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֶת דִּבְרֵי בְנֵי לָבָן לֵאמֹר לָקַח יַעֲקֹב אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִינוּ וּמֵאֲשֶׁר לְאָבִינוּ עָשָׂה אֵת כּל הַכָּבֹד הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֶת דִּבְרֵי בְנֵי לָבָן לֵאמֹר לָקַח יַעֲקֹב אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִינוּ וּמֵאֲשֶׁר לְאָבִינוּ עָשָׂה אֵת כּל הַכָּבֹד הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And he heard Laban’s sons’ words, saying, “Jacob has
taken everything that was our father’s, and he has made
all this wealth from what was our father’s.”

translation.text: And he heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father’s; and of that which was our father’s hath he gotten all this glory.

verses.english:
And he heard Laban’s sons’ words, saying, “Jacob has
taken everything that was our father’s, and he has made
all this wealth from what was our father’s.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יַעֲקֹב אֶת פְּנֵי לָבָן וְהִנֵּה אֵינֶנּוּ עִמּוֹ כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יַעֲקֹב אֶת פְּנֵי לָבָן וְהִנֵּה אֵינֶנּוּ עִמּוֹ כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃

english.text:
And Jacob saw Laban’s face; and, here, he was not like the
day before yesterday with him.

translation.text: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

verses.english:
And Jacob saw Laban’s face; and, here, he was not like the
day before yesterday with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל יַעֲקֹב שׁוּב אֶל אֶרֶץ אֲבוֹתֶיךָ וּלְמוֹלַדְתֶּךָ וְאֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל יַעֲקֹב שׁוּב אֶל אֶרֶץ אֲבוֹתֶיךָ וּלְמוֹלַדְתֶּךָ וְאֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Jacob, “Go back to your fathers’ land and
to your birthplace, and I’ll be with you.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Jacob, “Go back to your fathers’ land and
to your birthplace, and I’ll be with you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יַעֲקֹב וַיִּקְרָא לְרָחֵל וּלְלֵאָה הַשָּׂדֶה אֶל צֹאנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יַעֲקֹב וַיִּקְרָא לְרָחֵל וּלְלֵאָה הַשָּׂדֶה אֶל צֹאנוֹ׃

english.text:
And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field, to
his flock,

translation.text: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,

verses.english:
And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field, to
his flock,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶן רֹאֶה אָנֹכִי אֶת פְּנֵי אֲבִיכֶן כִּי אֵינֶנּוּ אֵלַי כִּתְמֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וֵאלֹהֵי אָבִי הָיָה עִמָּדִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶן רֹאֶה אָנֹכִי אֶת פְּנֵי אֲבִיכֶן כִּי אֵינֶנּוּ אֵלַי כִּתְמֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וֵאלֹהֵי אָבִי הָיָה עִמָּדִי׃

english.text:
and said to them, “I see your father’s face, that he’s not
like the day before yesterday to me. And my father’s God
has been with me,

translation.text: And said unto them, I see your father’s countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.

verses.english:
and said to them, “I see your father’s face, that he’s not
like the day before yesterday to me. And my father’s God
has been with me,

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֵּנָה יְדַעְתֶּן כִּי בְּכל כֹּחִי עָבַדְתִּי אֶת אֲבִיכֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֵּנָה יְדַעְתֶּן כִּי בְּכל כֹּחִי עָבַדְתִּי אֶת אֲבִיכֶן׃

english.text: and you know that I served your father with all my might,

translation.text: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.

verses.english: and you know that I served your father with all my might,

verses.hebrew: וַאֲבִיכֶן הֵתֶל בִּי וְהֶחֱלִף אֶת מַשְׂכֻּרְתִּי עֲשֶׂרֶת מֹנִים וְלֹא נְתָנוֹ אֱלֹהִים לְהָרַע עִמָּדִי׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲבִיכֶן הֵתֶל בִּי וְהֶחֱלִף אֶת מַשְׂכֻּרְתִּי עֲשֶׂרֶת מֹנִים וְלֹא נְתָנוֹ אֱלֹהִים לְהָרַע עִמָּדִי׃

english.text:
and your father has toyed with me and changed my pay ten
times, and God hasn’t let him do bad with me.

translation.text: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.

verses.english:
and your father has toyed with me and changed my pay ten
times, and God hasn’t let him do bad with me.

verses.hebrew: אִם כֹּה יֹאמַר נְקֻדִּים יִהְיֶה שְׂכָרֶךָ וְיָלְדוּ כל הַצֹּאן נְקֻדִּים וְאִם כֹּה יֹאמַר עֲקֻדִּים יִהְיֶה שְׂכָרֶךָ וְיָלְדוּ כל הַצֹּאן עֲקֻדִּים׃

hebrew.text: אִם כֹּה יֹאמַר נְקֻדִּים יִהְיֶה שְׂכָרֶךָ וְיָלְדוּ כל הַצֹּאן נְקֻדִּים וְאִם כֹּה יֹאמַר עֲקֻדִּים יִהְיֶה שְׂכָרֶךָ וְיָלְדוּ כל הַצֹּאן עֲקֻדִּים׃

english.text:
If he would say this: ‘The speckled will be your pay’,
then all the flock gave birth to speckled. And if he would
say this: ‘The streaked will be your pay’, then all the
flock gave birth to streaked.

translation.text: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.

verses.english:
If he would say this: ‘The speckled will be your pay’,
then all the flock gave birth to speckled. And if he would
say this: ‘The streaked will be your pay’, then all the
flock gave birth to streaked.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּצֵּל אֱלֹהִים אֶת מִקְנֵה אֲבִיכֶם וַיִּתֶּן לִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּצֵּל אֱלֹהִים אֶת מִקְנֵה אֲבִיכֶם וַיִּתֶּן לִי׃

english.text:
And God has delivered your father’s livestock and given
them to me.

translation.text: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.

verses.english:
And God has delivered your father’s livestock and given
them to me.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּעֵת יַחֵם הַצֹּאן וָאֶשָּׂא עֵינַי וָאֵרֶא בַּחֲלוֹם וְהִנֵּה הָעַתֻּדִים הָעֹלִים עַל הַצֹּאן עֲקֻדִּים נְקֻדִּים וּבְרֻדִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּעֵת יַחֵם הַצֹּאן וָאֶשָּׂא עֵינַי וָאֵרֶא בַּחֲלוֹם וְהִנֵּה הָעַתֻּדִים הָעֹלִים עַל הַצֹּאן עֲקֻדִּים נְקֻדִּים וּבְרֻדִּים׃

english.text:
And it was at the time of the flock’s being in heat, and I
raised my eyes and saw in a dream: and here were the
he-goats that were going up on the flock: streaked,
speckled, and spotted.

translation.text: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.

verses.english:
And it was at the time of the flock’s being in heat, and I
raised my eyes and saw in a dream: and here were the
he-goats that were going up on the flock: streaked,
speckled, and spotted.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים בַּחֲלוֹם יַעֲקֹב וָאֹמַר הִנֵּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים בַּחֲלוֹם יַעֲקֹב וָאֹמַר הִנֵּנִי׃

english.text:
“And an angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob.’
“And I said, ‘I’m here.’

translation.text: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here am I.

verses.english:
“And an angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob.’
“And I said, ‘I’m here.’

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׂא נָא עֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה כּל הָעַתֻּדִים הָעֹלִים עַל הַצֹּאן עֲקֻדִּים נְקֻדִּים וּבְרֻדִּים כִּי רָאִיתִי אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר לָבָן עֹשֶׂה לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׂא נָא עֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה כּל הָעַתֻּדִים הָעֹלִים עַל הַצֹּאן עֲקֻדִּים נְקֻדִּים וּבְרֻדִּים כִּי רָאִיתִי אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר לָבָן עֹשֶׂה לָּךְ׃

english.text:
“And he said, ‘Raise your eyes and see all the he-goats
that are going up on the flock: streaked, speckled, and
spotted. Because I’ve seen everything that Laban is doing
to you.

translation.text: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.

verses.english:
“And he said, ‘Raise your eyes and see all the he-goats
that are going up on the flock: streaked, speckled, and
spotted. Because I’ve seen everything that Laban is doing
to you.

verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי הָאֵל בֵּית אֵל אֲשֶׁר מָשַׁחְתָּ שָּׁם מַצֵּבָה אֲשֶׁר נָדַרְתָּ לִּי שָׁם נֶדֶר עַתָּה קוּם צֵא מִן הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וְשׁוּב אֶל אֶרֶץ מוֹלַדְתֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: אָנֹכִי הָאֵל בֵּית אֵל אֲשֶׁר מָשַׁחְתָּ שָּׁם מַצֵּבָה אֲשֶׁר נָדַרְתָּ לִּי שָׁם נֶדֶר עַתָּה קוּם צֵא מִן הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וְשׁוּב אֶל אֶרֶץ מוֹלַדְתֶּךָ׃

english.text:
I am the God at Beth-El, where you anointed a pillar,
where you made a vow to me. Now get up, go from this land,
and go back to the land of your birth.’”

translation.text: I am the God of Bethel, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.

verses.english:
I am the God at Beth-El, where you anointed a pillar,
where you made a vow to me. Now get up, go from this land,
and go back to the land of your birth.’”

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעַן רָחֵל וְלֵאָה וַתֹּאמַרְנָה לוֹ הַעוֹד לָנוּ חֵלֶק וְנַחֲלָה בְּבֵית אָבִינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעַן רָחֵל וְלֵאָה וַתֹּאמַרְנָה לוֹ הַעוֹד לָנוּ חֵלֶק וְנַחֲלָה בְּבֵית אָבִינוּ׃

english.text:
And Rachel and Leah answered, and they said to him, “Do we
still have a portion and legacy in our father’s house?

translation.text: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?

verses.english:
And Rachel and Leah answered, and they said to him, “Do we
still have a portion and legacy in our father’s house?

verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא נכְרִיּוֹת נֶחְשַׁבְנוּ לוֹ כִּי מְכָרָנוּ וַיֹּאכַל גַּם אָכוֹל אֶת כַּסְפֵּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: הֲלוֹא נכְרִיּוֹת נֶחְשַׁבְנוּ לוֹ כִּי מְכָרָנוּ וַיֹּאכַל גַּם אָכוֹל אֶת כַּסְפֵּנוּ׃

english.text:
Aren’t we thought of as foreigners by him, because he sold
us and has eaten up our money as well?!

translation.text: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.

verses.english:
Aren’t we thought of as foreigners by him, because he sold
us and has eaten up our money as well?!

verses.hebrew: כִּי כל הָעֹשֶׁר אֲשֶׁר הִצִּיל אֱלֹהִים מֵאָבִינוּ לָנוּ הוּא וּלְבָנֵינוּ וְעַתָּה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר אָמַר אֱלֹהִים אֵלֶיךָ עֲשֵׂה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי כל הָעֹשֶׁר אֲשֶׁר הִצִּיל אֱלֹהִים מֵאָבִינוּ לָנוּ הוּא וּלְבָנֵינוּ וְעַתָּה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר אָמַר אֱלֹהִים אֵלֶיךָ עֲשֵׂה׃

english.text:
Because all the wealth that God has delivered from our
father: it’s ours and our children’s. And now, do
everything that that God has said to you.”

translation.text: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children’s: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.

verses.english:
Because all the wealth that God has delivered from our
father: it’s ours and our children’s. And now, do
everything that that God has said to you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם יַעֲקֹב וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת נָשָׁיו עַל הַגְּמַלִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם יַעֲקֹב וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת נָשָׁיו עַל הַגְּמַלִּים׃

english.text:
And Jacob got up and carried his children and his wives on
the camels.

translation.text: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;

verses.english:
And Jacob got up and carried his children and his wives on
the camels.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּנְהַג אֶת כּל מִקְנֵהוּ וְאֶת כּל רְכֻשׁוֹ אֲשֶׁר רָכָשׁ מִקְנֵה קִנְיָנוֹ אֲשֶׁר רָכַשׁ בְּפַדַּן אֲרָם לָבוֹא אֶל יִצְחָק אָבִיו אַרְצָה כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּנְהַג אֶת כּל מִקְנֵהוּ וְאֶת כּל רְכֻשׁוֹ אֲשֶׁר רָכָשׁ מִקְנֵה קִנְיָנוֹ אֲשֶׁר רָכַשׁ בְּפַדַּן אֲרָם לָבוֹא אֶל יִצְחָק אָבִיו אַרְצָה כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
And he drove all his cattle and all his property that he
had acquired, the cattle that were in his possession that
he had acquired in Paddan Aram, to come to Isaac, his
father, at the land of Canaan.

translation.text: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padanaram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.

verses.english:
And he drove all his cattle and all his property that he
had acquired, the cattle that were in his possession that
he had acquired in Paddan Aram, to come to Isaac, his
father, at the land of Canaan.

verses.hebrew: וְלָבָן הָלַךְ לִגְזֹז אֶת צֹאנוֹ וַתִּגְנֹב רָחֵל אֶת הַתְּרָפִים אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָבָן הָלַךְ לִגְזֹז אֶת צֹאנוֹ וַתִּגְנֹב רָחֵל אֶת הַתְּרָפִים אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִיהָ׃

english.text:
And Laban had gone to shear his flock. And Rachel stole
the teraphim that her father had.

translation.text: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father’s.

verses.english:
And Laban had gone to shear his flock. And Rachel stole
the teraphim that her father had.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְנֹב יַעֲקֹב אֶת לֵב לָבָן הָאֲרַמִּי עַל בְּלִי הִגִּיד לוֹ כִּי בֹרֵחַ הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְנֹב יַעֲקֹב אֶת לֵב לָבָן הָאֲרַמִּי עַל בְּלִי הִגִּיד לוֹ כִּי בֹרֵחַ הוּא׃

english.text:
And Jacob stole the heart of Laban, the Aramean, by not
telling him that he was fleeing.

translation.text: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.

verses.english:
And Jacob stole the heart of Laban, the Aramean, by not
telling him that he was fleeing.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְרַח הוּא וְכל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וַיָּקם וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת הַנָּהָר וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת פָּנָיו הַר הַגִּלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְרַח הוּא וְכל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וַיָּקם וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת הַנָּהָר וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת פָּנָיו הַר הַגִּלְעָד׃

english.text:
And he fled, he and everyone he had, and he got up and
crossed the river and set his face toward the mountain of
Gilead.

translation.text: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.

verses.english:
And he fled, he and everyone he had, and he got up and
crossed the river and set his face toward the mountain of
Gilead.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְלָבָן בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי כִּי בָרַח יַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לְלָבָן בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי כִּי בָרַח יַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And it was told to Laban on the third day that Jacob had
fled.

translation.text: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.

verses.english:
And it was told to Laban on the third day that Jacob had
fled.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת אֶחָיו עִמּוֹ וַיִּרְדֹּף אַחֲרָיו דֶּרֶךְ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וַיַּדְבֵּק אֹתוֹ בְּהַר הַגִּלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֶת אֶחָיו עִמּוֹ וַיִּרְדֹּף אַחֲרָיו דֶּרֶךְ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וַיַּדְבֵּק אֹתוֹ בְּהַר הַגִּלְעָד׃

english.text:
And he took his brothers with him and pursued him seven
days’ journey and caught up to him in the mountain of
Gilead.

translation.text: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days’ journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.

verses.english:
And he took his brothers with him and pursued him seven
days’ journey and caught up to him in the mountain of
Gilead.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל לָבָן הָאֲרַמִּי בַּחֲלֹם הַלָּיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תְּדַבֵּר עִם יַעֲקֹב מִטּוֹב עַד רָע׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל לָבָן הָאֲרַמִּי בַּחֲלֹם הַלָּיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תְּדַבֵּר עִם יַעֲקֹב מִטּוֹב עַד רָע׃

english.text:
And God came to Laban, the Aramean, in a night dream and
said to him, “Watch yourself in case you speak with Jacob:
from good to bad.”

translation.text: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

verses.english:
And God came to Laban, the Aramean, in a night dream and
said to him, “Watch yourself in case you speak with Jacob:
from good to bad.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשֵּׂג לָבָן אֶת יַעֲקֹב וְיַעֲקֹב תָּקַע אֶת אהֳלוֹ בָּהָר וְלָבָן תָּקַע אֶת אֶחָיו בְּהַר הַגִּלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשֵּׂג לָבָן אֶת יַעֲקֹב וְיַעֲקֹב תָּקַע אֶת אהֳלוֹ בָּהָר וְלָבָן תָּקַע אֶת אֶחָיו בְּהַר הַגִּלְעָד׃

english.text:
And Laban caught up to Jacob, and Jacob had set up his
tent in the mountain, and Laban set up with his brothers
in the mountain of Gilead.

translation.text: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.

verses.english:
And Laban caught up to Jacob, and Jacob had set up his
tent in the mountain, and Laban set up with his brothers
in the mountain of Gilead.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן לְיַעֲקֹב מֶה עָשִׂיתָ וַתִּגְנֹב אֶת לְבָבִי וַתְּנַהֵג אֶת בְּנֹתַי כִּשְׁבֻיוֹת חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן לְיַעֲקֹב מֶה עָשִׂיתָ וַתִּגְנֹב אֶת לְבָבִי וַתְּנַהֵג אֶת בְּנֹתַי כִּשְׁבֻיוֹת חָרֶב׃

english.text:
And Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you’ve
stolen my heart and driven off my daughters like prisoners
by the sword?

translation.text: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?

verses.english:
And Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you’ve
stolen my heart and driven off my daughters like prisoners
by the sword?

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה נַחְבֵּאתָ לִבְרֹחַ וַתִּגְנֹב אֹתִי וְלֹא הִגַּדְתָּ לִּי וָאֲשַׁלֵּחֲךָ בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְשִׁרִים בְּתֹף וּבְכִנּוֹר׃

hebrew.text: לָמָּה נַחְבֵּאתָ לִבְרֹחַ וַתִּגְנֹב אֹתִי וְלֹא הִגַּדְתָּ לִּי וָאֲשַׁלֵּחֲךָ בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְשִׁרִים בְּתֹף וּבְכִנּוֹר׃

english.text:
Why did you hide so as to flee, and you stole from me, and
you didn’t tell me? And I would have sent you off with
happiness and with songs and with a drum and with a lyre.

translation.text: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?

verses.english:
Why did you hide so as to flee, and you stole from me, and
you didn’t tell me? And I would have sent you off with
happiness and with songs and with a drum and with a lyre.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא נְטַשְׁתַּנִי לְנַשֵּׁק לְבָנַי וְלִבְנֹתָי עַתָּה הִסְכַּלְתָּ עֲשׂוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא נְטַשְׁתַּנִי לְנַשֵּׁק לְבָנַי וְלִבְנֹתָי עַתָּה הִסְכַּלְתָּ עֲשׂוֹ׃

english.text:
And you didn’t permit me to kiss my sons and my daughters.
Now you’ve been foolish to do this.

translation.text: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.

verses.english:
And you didn’t permit me to kiss my sons and my daughters.
Now you’ve been foolish to do this.

verses.hebrew: יֶשׁ לְאֵל יָדִי לַעֲשׂוֹת עִמָּכֶם רָע וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבִיכֶם אֶמֶשׁ אָמַר אֵלַי לֵאמֹר הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ מִדַּבֵּר עִם יַעֲקֹב מִטּוֹב עַד רָע׃

hebrew.text: יֶשׁ לְאֵל יָדִי לַעֲשׂוֹת עִמָּכֶם רָע וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבִיכֶם אֶמֶשׁ אָמַר אֵלַי לֵאמֹר הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ מִדַּבֵּר עִם יַעֲקֹב מִטּוֹב עַד רָע׃

english.text:
The god at my hand has the means to do bad to you. But
your father’s God said to me yesterday saying, ‘Watch
yourself from speaking with Jacob: from good to bad.’

translation.text: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

verses.english:
The god at my hand has the means to do bad to you. But
your father’s God said to me yesterday saying, ‘Watch
yourself from speaking with Jacob: from good to bad.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הָלֹךְ הָלַכְתָּ כִּי נִכְסֹף נִכְסַפְתָּה לְבֵית אָבִיךָ לָמָּה גָנַבְתָּ אֶת אֱלֹהָי׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הָלֹךְ הָלַכְתָּ כִּי נִכְסֹף נִכְסַפְתָּה לְבֵית אָבִיךָ לָמָּה גָנַבְתָּ אֶת אֱלֹהָי׃

english.text:
And now, you went, because you longed for your father’s
house. Why did you steal my gods?”

translation.text: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father’s house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?

verses.english:
And now, you went, because you longed for your father’s
house. Why did you steal my gods?”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יַעֲקֹב וַיֹּאמֶר לְלָבָן כִּי יָרֵאתִי כִּי אָמַרְתִּי פֶּן תִּגְזֹל אֶת בְּנוֹתֶיךָ מֵעִמִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן יַעֲקֹב וַיֹּאמֶר לְלָבָן כִּי יָרֵאתִי כִּי אָמַרְתִּי פֶּן תִּגְזֹל אֶת בְּנוֹתֶיךָ מֵעִמִּי׃

english.text:
And Jacob answered, and he said to Laban, “Because I was
afraid. Because I said, ‘In case you’ll seize your
daughters from me.’

translation.text: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.

verses.english:
And Jacob answered, and he said to Laban, “Because I was
afraid. Because I said, ‘In case you’ll seize your
daughters from me.’

verses.hebrew: עִם אֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא אֶת אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא יִחְיֶה נֶגֶד אַחֵינוּ הַכֶּר לְךָ מָה עִמָּדִי וְקַח לָךְ וְלֹא יָדַע יַעֲקֹב כִּי רָחֵל גְּנָבָתַם׃

hebrew.text: עִם אֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא אֶת אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא יִחְיֶה נֶגֶד אַחֵינוּ הַכֶּר לְךָ מָה עִמָּדִי וְקַח לָךְ וְלֹא יָדַע יַעֲקֹב כִּי רָחֵל גְּנָבָתַם׃

english.text:
Let the one with whom you’ll find your gods not live. In
front of our brothers, recognize and take what of yours is
with me.” And Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen
them.

translation.text: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.

verses.english:
Let the one with whom you’ll find your gods not live. In
front of our brothers, recognize and take what of yours is
with me.” And Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen
them.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא לָבָן בְּאֹהֶל יַעֲקֹב וּבְאֹהֶל לֵאָה וּבְאֹהֶל שְׁתֵּי הָאֲמָהֹת וְלֹא מָצָא וַיֵּצֵא מֵאֹהֶל לֵאָה וַיָּבֹא בְּאֹהֶל רָחֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא לָבָן בְּאֹהֶל יַעֲקֹב וּבְאֹהֶל לֵאָה וּבְאֹהֶל שְׁתֵּי הָאֲמָהֹת וְלֹא מָצָא וַיֵּצֵא מֵאֹהֶל לֵאָה וַיָּבֹא בְּאֹהֶל רָחֵל׃

english.text:
And Laban came in Jacob’s tent and Leah’s tent and the two
maids’ tent, and he did not find them. And he came out
from Leah’s tent and came in Rachel’s tent.

translation.text: And Laban went into Jacob’s tent, and into Leah’s tent, and into the two maidservants’ tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.

verses.english:
And Laban came in Jacob’s tent and Leah’s tent and the two
maids’ tent, and he did not find them. And he came out
from Leah’s tent and came in Rachel’s tent.

verses.hebrew: וְרָחֵל לָקְחָה אֶת הַתְּרָפִים וַתְּשִׂמֵם בְּכַר הַגָּמָל וַתֵּשֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶם וַיְמַשֵּׁשׁ לָבָן אֶת כּל הָאֹהֶל וְלֹא מָצָא׃

hebrew.text: וְרָחֵל לָקְחָה אֶת הַתְּרָפִים וַתְּשִׂמֵם בְּכַר הַגָּמָל וַתֵּשֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶם וַיְמַשֵּׁשׁ לָבָן אֶת כּל הָאֹהֶל וְלֹא מָצָא׃

english.text:
And Rachel had taken the teraphim and put them in the
camel’s saddle and sat on them. And Laban felt around the
whole tent and did not find them.

translation.text: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel’s furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.

verses.english:
And Rachel had taken the teraphim and put them in the
camel’s saddle and sat on them. And Laban felt around the
whole tent and did not find them.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל אָבִיהָ אַל יִחַר בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנִי כִּי לוֹא אוּכַל לָקוּם מִפָּנֶיךָ כִּי דֶרֶךְ נָשִׁים לִי וַיְחַפֵּשׂ וְלֹא מָצָא אֶת הַתְּרָפִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל אָבִיהָ אַל יִחַר בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנִי כִּי לוֹא אוּכַל לָקוּם מִפָּנֶיךָ כִּי דֶרֶךְ נָשִׁים לִי וַיְחַפֵּשׂ וְלֹא מָצָא אֶת הַתְּרָפִים׃

english.text:
And she said to her father, “Let it not offend in my
lord’s eyes that I’m not able to get up before you,
because I have the way of women.” And he searched and did
not find the teraphim.

translation.text: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched but found not the images.

verses.english:
And she said to her father, “Let it not offend in my
lord’s eyes that I’m not able to get up before you,
because I have the way of women.” And he searched and did
not find the teraphim.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר לְיַעֲקֹב וַיָּרֶב בְּלָבָן וַיַּעַן יַעֲקֹב וַיֹּאמֶר לְלָבָן מַה פִּשְׁעִי מַה חַטָּאתִי כִּי דָלַקְתָּ אַחֲרָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר לְיַעֲקֹב וַיָּרֶב בְּלָבָן וַיַּעַן יַעֲקֹב וַיֹּאמֶר לְלָבָן מַה פִּשְׁעִי מַה חַטָּאתִי כִּי דָלַקְתָּ אַחֲרָי׃

english.text:
And Jacob was angered, and he quarreled with Laban, and
Jacob answered, and he said to Laban, “What is my offense?
What is my sin, that you blazed after me,

translation.text: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?

verses.english:
And Jacob was angered, and he quarreled with Laban, and
Jacob answered, and he said to Laban, “What is my offense?
What is my sin, that you blazed after me,

verses.hebrew: כִּי מִשַּׁשְׁתָּ אֶת כּל כֵּלַי מַה מָּצָאתָ מִכֹּל כְּלֵי בֵיתֶךָ שִׂים כֹּה נֶגֶד אַחַי וְאַחֶיךָ וְיוֹכִיחוּ בֵּין שְׁנֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי מִשַּׁשְׁתָּ אֶת כּל כֵּלַי מַה מָּצָאתָ מִכֹּל כְּלֵי בֵיתֶךָ שִׂים כֹּה נֶגֶד אַחַי וְאַחֶיךָ וְיוֹכִיחוּ בֵּין שְׁנֵינוּ׃

english.text:
that you felt around all my belongings? What did you find
out of all of your house’s belongings? Set it here, in
front of my brothers and your brothers, and let them judge
between the two of us.

translation.text: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.

verses.english:
that you felt around all my belongings? What did you find
out of all of your house’s belongings? Set it here, in
front of my brothers and your brothers, and let them judge
between the two of us.

verses.hebrew: זֶה עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה אָנֹכִי עִמָּךְ רְחֵלֶיךָ וְעִזֶּיךָ לֹא שִׁכֵּלוּ וְאֵילֵי צֹאנְךָ לֹא אָכָלְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: זֶה עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה אָנֹכִי עִמָּךְ רְחֵלֶיךָ וְעִזֶּיךָ לֹא שִׁכֵּלוּ וְאֵילֵי צֹאנְךָ לֹא אָכָלְתִּי׃

english.text:
This twenty years I’ve been with you, your ewes and your
she-goats haven’t lost their offspring, and I haven’t
eaten your flock’s rams.

translation.text: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.

verses.english:
This twenty years I’ve been with you, your ewes and your
she-goats haven’t lost their offspring, and I haven’t
eaten your flock’s rams.

verses.hebrew: טְרֵפָה לֹא הֵבֵאתִי אֵלֶיךָ אָנֹכִי אֲחַטֶּנָּה מִיָּדִי תְּבַקְשֶׁנָּה גְּנֻבְתִי יוֹם וּגְנֻבְתִי לָיְלָה׃

hebrew.text: טְרֵפָה לֹא הֵבֵאתִי אֵלֶיךָ אָנֹכִי אֲחַטֶּנָּה מִיָּדִי תְּבַקְשֶׁנָּה גְּנֻבְתִי יוֹם וּגְנֻבְתִי לָיְלָה׃

english.text:
I haven’t brought you one torn up. I would miss it: you
would ask it from my hand, be it stolen by day or stolen
by night.

translation.text: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.

verses.english:
I haven’t brought you one torn up. I would miss it: you
would ask it from my hand, be it stolen by day or stolen
by night.

verses.hebrew: הָיִיתִי בַיּוֹם אֲכָלַנִי חֹרֶב וְקֶרַח בַּלָּיְלָה וַתִּדַּד שְׁנָתִי מֵעֵינָי׃

hebrew.text: הָיִיתִי בַיּוֹם אֲכָלַנִי חֹרֶב וְקֶרַח בַּלָּיְלָה וַתִּדַּד שְׁנָתִי מֵעֵינָי׃

english.text:
I was … In the daytime heat ate me up, and ice in the
night. And my sleep fled from my eyes.

translation.text: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.

verses.english:
I was … In the daytime heat ate me up, and ice in the
night. And my sleep fled from my eyes.

verses.hebrew: זֶה לִּי עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה בְּבֵיתֶךָ עֲבַדְתִּיךָ אַרְבַּע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בִּשְׁתֵּי בְנֹתֶיךָ וְשֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים בְּצֹאנֶךָ וַתַּחֲלֵף אֶת מַשְׂכֻּרְתִּי עֲשֶׂרֶת מֹנִים׃

hebrew.text: זֶה לִּי עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה בְּבֵיתֶךָ עֲבַדְתִּיךָ אַרְבַּע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בִּשְׁתֵּי בְנֹתֶיךָ וְשֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים בְּצֹאנֶךָ וַתַּחֲלֵף אֶת מַשְׂכֻּרְתִּי עֲשֶׂרֶת מֹנִים׃

english.text:
This twenty years I’ve had in your house: I worked for you
fourteen years for your two daughters and six years for
your flock, and you changed my pay ten times.

translation.text: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.

verses.english:
This twenty years I’ve had in your house: I worked for you
fourteen years for your two daughters and six years for
your flock, and you changed my pay ten times.

verses.hebrew: לוּלֵי אֱלֹהֵי אָבִי אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם וּפַחַד יִצְחָק הָיָה לִי כִּי עַתָּה רֵיקָם שִׁלַּחְתָּנִי אֶת ענְיִי וְאֶת יְגִיעַ כַּפַּי רָאָה אֱלֹהִים וַיּוֹכַח אָמֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: לוּלֵי אֱלֹהֵי אָבִי אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם וּפַחַד יִצְחָק הָיָה לִי כִּי עַתָּה רֵיקָם שִׁלַּחְתָּנִי אֶת ענְיִי וְאֶת יְגִיעַ כַּפַּי רָאָה אֱלֹהִים וַיּוֹכַח אָמֶשׁ׃

english.text:
If I hadn’t had my father’s God, the God of Abraham and
Awe of Isaac, by now you would have sent me away
empty-handed. saw my degradation and my hands’
exhaustion, and He pointed it out last night.”

translation.text: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.

verses.english:
If I hadn’t had my father’s God, the God of Abraham and
Awe of Isaac, by now you would have sent me away
empty-handed. saw my degradation and my hands’
exhaustion, and He pointed it out last night.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן לָבָן וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל יַעֲקֹב הַבָּנוֹת בְּנֹתַי וְהַבָּנִים בָּנַי וְהַצֹּאן צֹאנִי וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה רֹאֶה לִי הוּא וְלִבְנֹתַי מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לָאֵלֶּה הַיּוֹם אוֹ לִבְנֵיהֶן אֲשֶׁר יָלָדוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן לָבָן וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל יַעֲקֹב הַבָּנוֹת בְּנֹתַי וְהַבָּנִים בָּנַי וְהַצֹּאן צֹאנִי וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה רֹאֶה לִי הוּא וְלִבְנֹתַי מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לָאֵלֶּה הַיּוֹם אוֹ לִבְנֵיהֶן אֲשֶׁר יָלָדוּ׃

english.text:
And Laban answered, and he said to Jacob, “The daughters
are my daughters, and the sons are my sons, and the flock
is my flock, and everything that you see: it’s mine. But
what shall I do to my daughters, to these, today, or to
their children to whom they’ve given birth?

translation.text: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?

verses.english:
And Laban answered, and he said to Jacob, “The daughters
are my daughters, and the sons are my sons, and the flock
is my flock, and everything that you see: it’s mine. But
what shall I do to my daughters, to these, today, or to
their children to whom they’ve given birth?

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לְכָה נִכְרְתָה בְרִית אֲנִי וָאָתָּה וְהָיָה לְעֵד בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לְכָה נִכְרְתָה בְרִית אֲנִי וָאָתָּה וְהָיָה לְעֵד בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ׃

english.text:
So now, come and let’s make a covenant, I and you, and let
it be a witness between me and you.”

translation.text: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.

verses.english:
So now, come and let’s make a covenant, I and you, and let
it be a witness between me and you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יַעֲקֹב אָבֶן וַיְרִימֶהָ מַצֵּבָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח יַעֲקֹב אָבֶן וַיְרִימֶהָ מַצֵּבָה׃

english.text: And Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar,

translation.text: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

verses.english: And Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב לְאֶחָיו לִקְטוּ אֲבָנִים וַיִּקְחוּ אֲבָנִים וַיַּעֲשׂוּ גָל וַיֹּאכְלוּ שָׁם עַל הַגָּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב לְאֶחָיו לִקְטוּ אֲבָנִים וַיִּקְחוּ אֲבָנִים וַיַּעֲשׂוּ גָל וַיֹּאכְלוּ שָׁם עַל הַגָּל׃

english.text:
and Jacob said to his brothers, “Collect stones.” And they
took stones and made a pile and ate there at the pile.

translation.text: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.

verses.english:
and Jacob said to his brothers, “Collect stones.” And they
took stones and made a pile and ate there at the pile.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא לוֹ לָבָן יְגַר שָׂהֲדוּתָא וְיַעֲקֹב קָרָא לוֹ גַּלְעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא לוֹ לָבָן יְגַר שָׂהֲדוּתָא וְיַעֲקֹב קָרָא לוֹ גַּלְעֵד׃

english.text:
And Laban called it ygar shdta’, and Jacob called it
gal-‘d.

translation.text: And Laban called it Jegarsahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.

verses.english:
And Laban called it ygar shdta’, and Jacob called it
gal-‘d.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן הַגַּל הַזֶּה עֵד בֵּינִי וּבֵינְךָ הַיּוֹם עַל כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמוֹ גַּלְעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן הַגַּל הַזֶּה עֵד בֵּינִי וּבֵינְךָ הַיּוֹם עַל כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמוֹ גַּלְעֵד׃

english.text:
And Laban said, “This pile is a witness between me and you
today.” On account of this he called its name Gal-Ed.

translation.text: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day.

verses.english:
And Laban said, “This pile is a witness between me and you
today.” On account of this he called its name Gal-Ed.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמִּצְפָּה אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יִצֶף יְהֹוָה בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ כִּי נִסָּתֵר אִישׁ מֵרֵעֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמִּצְפָּה אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יִצֶף יְהֹוָה בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ כִּי נִסָּתֵר אִישׁ מֵרֵעֵהוּ׃

english.text:
( And Mizpah, because he said, “May YHWH observe between
me and you when one is hidden from the other.”)

verses.english:
( And Mizpah, because he said, “May YHWH observe between
me and you when one is hidden from the other.”)

verses.hebrew: אִם תְּעַנֶּה אֶת בְּנֹתַי וְאִם תִּקַּח נָשִׁים עַל בְּנֹתַי אֵין אִישׁ עִמָּנוּ רְאֵה אֱלֹהִים עֵד בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אִם תְּעַנֶּה אֶת בְּנֹתַי וְאִם תִּקַּח נָשִׁים עַל בְּנֹתַי אֵין אִישׁ עִמָּנוּ רְאֵה אֱלֹהִים עֵד בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ׃

english.text:
“If you degrade my daughters and if you take wives in
addition to my daughters, no man is with us. See: God is
witness between me and you.”

translation.text: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.

verses.english:
“If you degrade my daughters and if you take wives in
addition to my daughters, no man is with us. See: God is
witness between me and you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן לְיַעֲקֹב הִנֵּה הַגַּל הַזֶּה וְהִנֵּה הַמַּצֵּבָה אֲשֶׁר יָרִיתִי בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן לְיַעֲקֹב הִנֵּה הַגַּל הַזֶּה וְהִנֵּה הַמַּצֵּבָה אֲשֶׁר יָרִיתִי בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ׃

english.text:
And Laban said to Jacob, “Here is this pile, and here is
the pillar that I’ve cast between me and you.

translation.text: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee:

verses.english:
And Laban said to Jacob, “Here is this pile, and here is
the pillar that I’ve cast between me and you.

verses.hebrew: עֵד הַגַּל הַזֶּה וְעֵדָה הַמַּצֵּבָה אִם אָנִי לֹא אֶעֱבֹר אֵלֶיךָ אֶת הַגַּל הַזֶּה וְאִם אַתָּה לֹא תַעֲבֹר אֵלַי אֶת הַגַּל הַזֶּה וְאֶת הַמַּצֵּבָה הַזֹּאת לְרָעָה׃

hebrew.text: עֵד הַגַּל הַזֶּה וְעֵדָה הַמַּצֵּבָה אִם אָנִי לֹא אֶעֱבֹר אֵלֶיךָ אֶת הַגַּל הַזֶּה וְאִם אַתָּה לֹא תַעֲבֹר אֵלַי אֶת הַגַּל הַזֶּה וְאֶת הַמַּצֵּבָה הַזֹּאת לְרָעָה׃

english.text:
This pile is a witness, and the pillar is a witness that I
won’t cross this pile to you and you won’t cross this pile
and this pillar to me for bad.

translation.text: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.

verses.english:
This pile is a witness, and the pillar is a witness that I
won’t cross this pile to you and you won’t cross this pile
and this pillar to me for bad.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם וֵאלֹהֵי נָחוֹר יִשְׁפְּטוּ בֵינֵינוּ אֱלֹהֵי אֲבִיהֶם וַיִּשָּׁבַע יַעֲקֹב בְּפַחַד אָבִיו יִצְחָק׃

hebrew.text: אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם וֵאלֹהֵי נָחוֹר יִשְׁפְּטוּ בֵינֵינוּ אֱלֹהֵי אֲבִיהֶם וַיִּשָּׁבַע יַעֲקֹב בְּפַחַד אָבִיו יִצְחָק׃

english.text:
Let Abraham’s God and Nahor’s gods, their father’s gods,
judge between us.” And Jacob swore by the Awe of his
father, Isaac.

translation.text: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.

verses.english:
Let Abraham’s God and Nahor’s gods, their father’s gods,
judge between us.” And Jacob swore by the Awe of his
father, Isaac.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְבַּח יַעֲקֹב זֶבַח בָּהָר וַיִּקְרָא לְאֶחָיו לֶאֱכל לָחֶם וַיֹּאכְלוּ לֶחֶם וַיָּלִינוּ בָּהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזְבַּח יַעֲקֹב זֶבַח בָּהָר וַיִּקְרָא לְאֶחָיו לֶאֱכל לָחֶם וַיֹּאכְלוּ לֶחֶם וַיָּלִינוּ בָּהָר׃

english.text:
And Jacob made a sacrifice in the mountain and called his
brothers to eat bread, and they ate bread and spent the
night in the mountain.

translation.text: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.

verses.english:
And Jacob made a sacrifice in the mountain and called his
brothers to eat bread, and they ate bread and spent the
night in the mountain.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם לָבָן בַּבֹּקֶר וַיְנַשֵּׁק לְבָנָיו וְלִבְנוֹתָיו וַיְבָרֶךְ אֶתְהֶם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּשׁב לָבָן לִמְקֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם לָבָן בַּבֹּקֶר וַיְנַשֵּׁק לְבָנָיו וְלִבְנוֹתָיו וַיְבָרֶךְ אֶתְהֶם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּשׁב לָבָן לִמְקֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
And Laban got up early in the morning and kissed his
sons and his daughters and blessed them and went. And
Laban went back to his place,

translation.text: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

verses.english:
And Laban got up early in the morning and kissed his
sons and his daughters and blessed them and went. And
Laban went back to his place,

verses.hebrew: וְיַעֲקֹב הָלַךְ לְדַרְכּוֹ וַיִּפְגְּעוּ בוֹ מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וְיַעֲקֹב הָלַךְ לְדַרְכּוֹ וַיִּפְגְּעוּ בוֹ מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text: and Jacob went his way. And angels of God came upon him.

translation.text: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God’s host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

verses.english: and Jacob went his way. And angels of God came upon him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאָם מַחֲנֵה אֱלֹהִים זֶה וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא מַחֲנָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאָם מַחֲנֵה אֱלֹהִים זֶה וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא מַחֲנָיִם׃

english.text:
And Jacob said when he saw them, “This is a camp of God,”
and he called that place’s name Mahanaim.

translation.text: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

verses.english:
And Jacob said when he saw them, “This is a camp of God,”
and he called that place’s name Mahanaim.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יַעֲקֹב מַלְאָכִים לְפָנָיו אֶל עֵשָׂו אָחִיו אַרְצָה שֵׂעִיר שְׂדֵה אֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יַעֲקֹב מַלְאָכִים לְפָנָיו אֶל עֵשָׂו אָחִיו אַרְצָה שֵׂעִיר שְׂדֵה אֱדוֹם׃

english.text:
And Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to
Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the territory of
Edom,

translation.text: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:

verses.english:
And Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to
Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the territory of
Edom,

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו אֹתָם לֵאמֹר כֹּה תֹאמְרוּן לַאדֹנִי לְעֵשָׂו כֹּה אָמַר עַבְדְּךָ יַעֲקֹב עִם לָבָן גַּרְתִּי וָאֵחַר עַד עָתָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו אֹתָם לֵאמֹר כֹּה תֹאמְרוּן לַאדֹנִי לְעֵשָׂו כֹּה אָמַר עַבְדְּךָ יַעֲקֹב עִם לָבָן גַּרְתִּי וָאֵחַר עַד עָתָּה׃

english.text:
and commanded them saying, “You shall say this: ‘To my
lord, to Esau, your servant Jacob said this, “I’ve stayed
with Laban and delayed until now,

translation.text: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.

verses.english:
and commanded them saying, “You shall say this: ‘To my
lord, to Esau, your servant Jacob said this, “I’ve stayed
with Laban and delayed until now,

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִי שׁוֹר וַחֲמוֹר צֹאן וְעֶבֶד וְשִׁפְחָה וָאֶשְׁלְחָה לְהַגִּיד לַאדֹנִי לִמְצֹא חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לִי שׁוֹר וַחֲמוֹר צֹאן וְעֶבֶד וְשִׁפְחָה וָאֶשְׁלְחָה לְהַגִּיד לַאדֹנִי לִמְצֹא חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
and ox and ass and sheep and male and female servant have
become mine. And I’m sending to tell my lord so as to find
favor in your eyes.”’”

translation.text: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.

verses.english:
and ox and ass and sheep and male and female servant have
become mine. And I’m sending to tell my lord so as to find
favor in your eyes.”’”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים אֶל יַעֲקֹב לֵאמֹר בָּאנוּ אֶל אָחִיךָ אֶל עֵשָׂו וְגַם הֹלֵךְ לִקְרָאתְךָ וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים אֶל יַעֲקֹב לֵאמֹר בָּאנוּ אֶל אָחִיךָ אֶל עֵשָׂו וְגַם הֹלֵךְ לִקְרָאתְךָ וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And the messengers came back to Jacob saying, “We came to
your brother, to Esau, and also he’s coming to you—and
four hundred men with him.”

translation.text: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;

verses.english:
And the messengers came back to Jacob saying, “We came to
your brother, to Esau, and also he’s coming to you—and
four hundred men with him.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּירָא יַעֲקֹב מְאֹד וַיֵּצֶר לוֹ וַיַּחַץ אֶת הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וְאֶת הַצֹּאן וְאֶת הַבָּקָר וְהַגְּמַלִּים לִשְׁנֵי מַחֲנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּירָא יַעֲקֹב מְאֹד וַיֵּצֶר לוֹ וַיַּחַץ אֶת הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וְאֶת הַצֹּאן וְאֶת הַבָּקָר וְהַגְּמַלִּים לִשְׁנֵי מַחֲנוֹת׃

english.text:
And Jacob was very afraid, and he had anguish. And he
divided the people who were with him and the sheep and the
oxen and the camels into two camps.

translation.text: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.

verses.english:
And Jacob was very afraid, and he had anguish. And he
divided the people who were with him and the sheep and the
oxen and the camels into two camps.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם יָבוֹא עֵשָׂו אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה הָאַחַת וְהִכָּהוּ וְהָיָה הַמַּחֲנֶה הַנִּשְׁאָר לִפְלֵיטָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם יָבוֹא עֵשָׂו אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה הָאַחַת וְהִכָּהוּ וְהָיָה הַמַּחֲנֶה הַנִּשְׁאָר לִפְלֵיטָה׃

english.text:
And he said, “If Esau will come to one camp and strike it,
then the camp that is left will survive.”

translation.text: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:

verses.english:
And he said, “If Esau will come to one camp and strike it,
then the camp that is left will survive.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֱלֹהֵי אָבִי אַבְרָהָם וֵאלֹהֵי אָבִי יִצְחָק יְהֹוָה הָאֹמֵר אֵלַי שׁוּב לְאַרְצְךָ וּלְמוֹלַדְתְּךָ וְאֵיטִיבָה עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֱלֹהֵי אָבִי אַבְרָהָם וֵאלֹהֵי אָבִי יִצְחָק יְהֹוָה הָאֹמֵר אֵלַי שׁוּב לְאַרְצְךָ וּלְמוֹלַדְתְּךָ וְאֵיטִיבָה עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
And Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham and God of my
father Isaac, YHWH, who said to me, ‘Go back to your land
and to your birthplace, and I’ll deal well with you,’

translation.text: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.

verses.english:
And Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham and God of my
father Isaac, YHWH, who said to me, ‘Go back to your land
and to your birthplace, and I’ll deal well with you,’

verses.hebrew: קָטֹנְתִּי מִכֹּל הַחֲסָדִים וּמִכּל הָאֱמֶת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ אֶת עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי בְמַקְלִי עָבַרְתִּי אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה וְעַתָּה הָיִיתִי לִשְׁנֵי מַחֲנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: קָטֹנְתִּי מִכֹּל הַחֲסָדִים וּמִכּל הָאֱמֶת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ אֶת עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי בְמַקְלִי עָבַרְתִּי אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה וְעַתָּה הָיִיתִי לִשְׁנֵי מַחֲנוֹת׃

english.text:
I’m not worthy of all the kindnesses and all the
faithfulness that you’ve done with your servant, because I
crossed this Jordan with just my rod, and now I’ve become
two camps.

translation.text: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.

verses.english:
I’m not worthy of all the kindnesses and all the
faithfulness that you’ve done with your servant, because I
crossed this Jordan with just my rod, and now I’ve become
two camps.

verses.hebrew: הַצִּילֵנִי נָא מִיַּד אָחִי מִיַּד עֵשָׂו כִּי יָרֵא אָנֹכִי אֹתוֹ פֶּן יָבוֹא וְהִכַּנִי אֵם עַל בָּנִים׃

hebrew.text: הַצִּילֵנִי נָא מִיַּד אָחִי מִיַּד עֵשָׂו כִּי יָרֵא אָנֹכִי אֹתוֹ פֶּן יָבוֹא וְהִכַּנִי אֵם עַל בָּנִים׃

english.text:
Save me from my brother’s hand, from Esau’s hand, because
I fear him, in case he’ll come and strike me, mother with
children.

translation.text: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

verses.english:
Save me from my brother’s hand, from Esau’s hand, because
I fear him, in case he’ll come and strike me, mother with
children.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה אָמַרְתָּ הֵיטֵב אֵיטִיב עִמָּךְ וְשַׂמְתִּי אֶת זַרְעֲךָ כְּחוֹל הַיָּם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִסָּפֵר מֵרֹב׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה אָמַרְתָּ הֵיטֵב אֵיטִיב עִמָּךְ וְשַׂמְתִּי אֶת זַרְעֲךָ כְּחוֹל הַיָּם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִסָּפֵר מֵרֹב׃

english.text:
And you’ ve said, ‘I’ll do well with you, and I’ll make
your seed like the sand of the sea, that it won’t be
countable because of its great number.’”

translation.text: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;

verses.english:
And you’ ve said, ‘I’ll do well with you, and I’ll make
your seed like the sand of the sea, that it won’t be
countable because of its great number.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּלֶן שָׁם בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיִּקַּח מִן הַבָּא בְיָדוֹ מִנְחָה לְעֵשָׂו אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּלֶן שָׁם בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיִּקַּח מִן הַבָּא בְיָדוֹ מִנְחָה לְעֵשָׂו אָחִיו׃

english.text:
And he spent that night there. And he took an offering for
Esau, his brother, from what had come into his hand:

translation.text: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,

verses.english:
And he spent that night there. And he took an offering for
Esau, his brother, from what had come into his hand:

verses.hebrew: עִזִּים מָאתַיִם וּתְיָשִׁים עֶשְׂרִים רְחֵלִים מָאתַיִם וְאֵילִים עֶשְׂרִים׃

hebrew.text: עִזִּים מָאתַיִם וּתְיָשִׁים עֶשְׂרִים רְחֵלִים מָאתַיִם וְאֵילִים עֶשְׂרִים׃

english.text:
two hundred she-goats and twenty he-goats, two hundred
ewes and twenty rams,

translation.text: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.

verses.english:
two hundred she-goats and twenty he-goats, two hundred
ewes and twenty rams,

verses.hebrew: גְּמַלִּים מֵינִיקוֹת וּבְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשִׁים פָּרוֹת אַרְבָּעִים וּפָרִים עֲשָׂרָה אֲתֹנֹת עֶשְׂרִים וַעְיָרִם עֲשָׂרָה׃

hebrew.text: גְּמַלִּים מֵינִיקוֹת וּבְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשִׁים פָּרוֹת אַרְבָּעִים וּפָרִים עֲשָׂרָה אֲתֹנֹת עֶשְׂרִים וַעְיָרִם עֲשָׂרָה׃

english.text:
thirty nursing camels and their offspring, forty cows and
ten bulls, twenty she-asses and ten he-asses.

translation.text: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.

verses.english:
thirty nursing camels and their offspring, forty cows and
ten bulls, twenty she-asses and ten he-asses.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן בְּיַד עֲבָדָיו עֵדֶר עֵדֶר לְבַדּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל עֲבָדָיו עִבְרוּ לְפָנַי וְרֶוַח תָּשִׂימוּ בֵּין עֵדֶר וּבֵין עֵדֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן בְּיַד עֲבָדָיו עֵדֶר עֵדֶר לְבַדּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל עֲבָדָיו עִבְרוּ לְפָנַי וְרֶוַח תָּשִׂימוּ בֵּין עֵדֶר וּבֵין עֵדֶר׃

english.text:
And he placed them in his servants’ hands, each herd by
itself, and he said to his servants, “Pass on in front of
me, and keep a distance between each herd and the next.”

translation.text: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?

verses.english:
And he placed them in his servants’ hands, each herd by
itself, and he said to his servants, “Pass on in front of
me, and keep a distance between each herd and the next.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו אֶת הָרִאשׁוֹן לֵאמֹר כִּי יִפְגשְׁךָ עֵשָׂו אָחִי וּשְׁאֵלְךָ לֵאמֹר לְמִי אַתָּה וְאָנָה תֵלֵךְ וּלְמִי אֵלֶּה לְפָנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו אֶת הָרִאשׁוֹן לֵאמֹר כִּי יִפְגשְׁךָ עֵשָׂו אָחִי וּשְׁאֵלְךָ לֵאמֹר לְמִי אַתָּה וְאָנָה תֵלֵךְ וּלְמִי אֵלֶּה לְפָנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And he commanded the first, saying, “When my brother,
Esau, meets you and asks you, saying, ‘To whom do you
belong, and where are you going, and to whom do these in
front of you belong?’

translation.text: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob’s; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.

verses.english:
And he commanded the first, saying, “When my brother,
Esau, meets you and asks you, saying, ‘To whom do you
belong, and where are you going, and to whom do these in
front of you belong?’

verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ לְיַעֲקֹב מִנְחָה הִוא שְׁלוּחָה לַאדֹנִי לְעֵשָׂו וְהִנֵּה גַם הוּא אַחֲרֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ לְיַעֲקֹב מִנְחָה הִוא שְׁלוּחָה לַאדֹנִי לְעֵשָׂו וְהִנֵּה גַם הוּא אַחֲרֵינוּ׃

english.text:
then you’ll say, ‘To your servant, to Jacob. It’s an
offering sent to my lord, to Esau. And here he is behind
us as well.’”

translation.text: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.

verses.english:
then you’ll say, ‘To your servant, to Jacob. It’s an
offering sent to my lord, to Esau. And here he is behind
us as well.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו גַּם אֶת הַשֵּׁנִי גַּם אֶת הַשְּׁלִישִׁי גַּם אֶת כּל הַהֹלְכִים אַחֲרֵי הָעֲדָרִים לֵאמֹר כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה תְּדַבְּרוּן אֶל עֵשָׂו בְּמֹצַאֲכֶם אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו גַּם אֶת הַשֵּׁנִי גַּם אֶת הַשְּׁלִישִׁי גַּם אֶת כּל הַהֹלְכִים אַחֲרֵי הָעֲדָרִים לֵאמֹר כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה תְּדַבְּרוּן אֶל עֵשָׂו בְּמֹצַאֲכֶם אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And he also commanded the second, also the third, also all
of those who were going behind the herds, saying, “You’ll
speak this way to Esau when you find him,

translation.text: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.

verses.english:
And he also commanded the second, also the third, also all
of those who were going behind the herds, saying, “You’ll
speak this way to Esau when you find him,

verses.hebrew: וַאֲמַרְתֶּם גַּם הִנֵּה עַבְדְּךָ יַעֲקֹב אַחֲרֵינוּ כִּי אָמַר אֲכַפְּרָה פָנָיו בַּמִּנְחָה הַהֹלֶכֶת לְפָנָי וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן אֶרְאֶה פָנָיו אוּלַי יִשָּׂא פָנָי׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲמַרְתֶּם גַּם הִנֵּה עַבְדְּךָ יַעֲקֹב אַחֲרֵינוּ כִּי אָמַר אֲכַפְּרָה פָנָיו בַּמִּנְחָה הַהֹלֶכֶת לְפָנָי וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן אֶרְאֶה פָנָיו אוּלַי יִשָּׂא פָנָי׃

english.text:
and you’ll say, ‘Here is your servant, Jacob, behind us as
well.’” Because he said, “Let me appease his face with the
offering that’s going in front of me, and after that I’ll
see his face; maybe he’ll raise my face.”

translation.text: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.

verses.english:
and you’ll say, ‘Here is your servant, Jacob, behind us as
well.’” Because he said, “Let me appease his face with the
offering that’s going in front of me, and after that I’ll
see his face; maybe he’ll raise my face.”

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲבֹר הַמִּנְחָה עַל פָּנָיו וְהוּא לָן בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעֲבֹר הַמִּנְחָה עַל פָּנָיו וְהוּא לָן בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And the offering passed ahead of him. And he spent that
night in the camp.

translation.text: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

verses.english:
And the offering passed ahead of him. And he spent that
night in the camp.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא וַיִּקַּח אֶת שְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי שִׁפְחֹתָיו וְאֶת אַחַד עָשָׂר יְלָדָיו וַיַּעֲבֹר אֵת מַעֲבַר יַבֹּק׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא וַיִּקַּח אֶת שְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי שִׁפְחֹתָיו וְאֶת אַחַד עָשָׂר יְלָדָיו וַיַּעֲבֹר אֵת מַעֲבַר יַבֹּק׃

english.text:
And he got up in that night and took his two wives and his
two maids and his eleven boys and crossed the Jabbok ford.

translation.text: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.

verses.english:
And he got up in that night and took his two wives and his
two maids and his eleven boys and crossed the Jabbok ford.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּחֵם וַיַּעֲבִרֵם אֶת הַנָּחַל וַיַּעֲבֵר אֶת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּחֵם וַיַּעֲבִרֵם אֶת הַנָּחַל וַיַּעֲבֵר אֶת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ׃

english.text:
And he took them and had them cross the wadi, and he had
everything that was his cross.

translation.text: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.

verses.english:
And he took them and had them cross the wadi, and he had
everything that was his cross.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּתֵר יַעֲקֹב לְבַדּוֹ וַיֵּאָבֵק אִישׁ עִמּוֹ עַד עֲלוֹת הַשָּׁחַר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּוָּתֵר יַעֲקֹב לְבַדּוֹ וַיֵּאָבֵק אִישׁ עִמּוֹ עַד עֲלוֹת הַשָּׁחַר׃

english.text:
And Jacob was left by himself. And a man wrestled with him
until the dawn’s rising.

translation.text: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.

verses.english:
And Jacob was left by himself. And a man wrestled with him
until the dawn’s rising.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא כִּי לֹא יָכֹל לוֹ וַיִּגַּע בְּכַף יְרֵכוֹ וַתֵּקַע כַּף יֶרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב בְּהֵאָבְקוֹ עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא כִּי לֹא יָכֹל לוֹ וַיִּגַּע בְּכַף יְרֵכוֹ וַתֵּקַע כַּף יֶרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב בְּהֵאָבְקוֹ עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And he saw that he was not able against him, and he
touched the inside of his thigh, and the inside of Jacob’s
thigh was dislocated during his wrestling with him.

translation.text: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

verses.english:
And he saw that he was not able against him, and he
touched the inside of his thigh, and the inside of Jacob’s
thigh was dislocated during his wrestling with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שַׁלְּחֵנִי כִּי עָלָה הַשָּׁחַר וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֲשַׁלֵּחֲךָ כִּי אִם בֵּרַכְתָּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שַׁלְּחֵנִי כִּי עָלָה הַשָּׁחַר וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֲשַׁלֵּחֲךָ כִּי אִם בֵּרַכְתָּנִי׃

english.text:
And he said, “Let me go, because the dawn has risen.” And
he said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”

translation.text: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.

verses.english:
And he said, “Let me go, because the dawn has risen.” And
he said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מַה שְּׁמֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מַה שְּׁמֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And he said to him, “What is your name?” And he said,
“Jacob.”

translation.text: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

verses.english:
And he said to him, “What is your name?” And he said,
“Jacob.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא יַעֲקֹב יֵאָמֵר עוֹד שִׁמְךָ כִּי אִם יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי שָׂרִיתָ עִם אֱלֹהִים וְעִם אֲנָשִׁים וַתּוּכָל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא יַעֲקֹב יֵאָמֵר עוֹד שִׁמְךָ כִּי אִם יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי שָׂרִיתָ עִם אֱלֹהִים וְעִם אֲנָשִׁים וַתּוּכָל׃

english.text:
And he said, “Your name won’t be said ‘Jacob’ anymore but
‘Israel,’ because you’ve struggled with God and with
people and were able.”

translation.text: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.

verses.english:
And he said, “Your name won’t be said ‘Jacob’ anymore but
‘Israel,’ because you’ve struggled with God and with
people and were able.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל יַעֲקֹב וַיֹּאמֶר הַגִּידָה נָּא שְׁמֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָּה זֶּה תִּשְׁאַל לִשְׁמִי וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתוֹ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל יַעֲקֹב וַיֹּאמֶר הַגִּידָה נָּא שְׁמֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָּה זֶּה תִּשְׁאַל לִשְׁמִי וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתוֹ שָׁם׃

english.text:
And Jacob asked, and he said, “Tell your name.” And he
said, “Why is this that you ask my name?” And he blessed
him there.

translation.text: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

verses.english:
And Jacob asked, and he said, “Tell your name.” And he
said, “Why is this that you ask my name?” And he blessed
him there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יַעֲקֹב שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם פְּנִיאֵל כִּי רָאִיתִי אֱלֹהִים פָּנִים אֶל פָּנִים וַתִּנָּצֵל נַפְשִׁי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יַעֲקֹב שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם פְּנִיאֵל כִּי רָאִיתִי אֱלֹהִים פָּנִים אֶל פָּנִים וַתִּנָּצֵל נַפְשִׁי׃

english.text:
And Jacob called the place’s name Peni-El, “because I’ve
seen God face-to-face, and my life has been delivered.”

translation.text: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.

verses.english:
And Jacob called the place’s name Peni-El, “because I’ve
seen God face-to-face, and my life has been delivered.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְרַח לוֹ הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָבַר אֶת פְּנוּאֵל וְהוּא צֹלֵעַ עַל יְרֵכוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזְרַח לוֹ הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָבַר אֶת פְּנוּאֵל וְהוּא צֹלֵעַ עַל יְרֵכוֹ׃

english.text:
And the sun rose on him as he passed Penuel, and he was
faltering on his thigh.

translation.text: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew that shrank.

verses.english:
And the sun rose on him as he passed Penuel, and he was
faltering on his thigh.

verses.hebrew: עַל כֵּן לֹא יֹאכְלוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת גִּיד הַנָּשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר עַל כַּף הַיָּרֵךְ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי נָגַע בְּכַף יֶרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב בְּגִיד הַנָּשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: עַל כֵּן לֹא יֹאכְלוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת גִּיד הַנָּשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר עַל כַּף הַיָּרֵךְ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי נָגַע בְּכַף יֶרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב בְּגִיד הַנָּשֶׁה׃

english.text:
On account of this the children of Israel to this day will
not eat the tendon of the vein that is on the inside of
the thigh, because he touched the inside of Jacob’s thigh,
the tendon of the vein.

verses.english:
On account of this the children of Israel to this day will
not eat the tendon of the vein that is on the inside of
the thigh, because he touched the inside of Jacob’s thigh,
the tendon of the vein.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא יַעֲקֹב עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה עֵשָׂו בָּא וְעִמּוֹ אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיַּחַץ אֶת הַיְלָדִים עַל לֵאָה וְעַל רָחֵל וְעַל שְׁתֵּי הַשְּׁפָחוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא יַעֲקֹב עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה עֵשָׂו בָּא וְעִמּוֹ אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיַּחַץ אֶת הַיְלָדִים עַל לֵאָה וְעַל רָחֵל וְעַל שְׁתֵּי הַשְּׁפָחוֹת׃

translation.text: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַשְּׁפָחוֹת וְאֶת יַלְדֵיהֶן רִאשֹׁנָה וְאֶת לֵאָה וִילָדֶיהָ אַחֲרֹנִים וְאֶת רָחֵל וְאֶת יוֹסֵף אַחֲרֹנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַשְּׁפָחוֹת וְאֶת יַלְדֵיהֶן רִאשֹׁנָה וְאֶת לֵאָה וִילָדֶיהָ אַחֲרֹנִים וְאֶת רָחֵל וְאֶת יוֹסֵף אַחֲרֹנִים׃

english.text:
and he placed the maids and their children first, and Leah
and her children following, and Rachel and Joseph
following,

translation.text: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.

verses.english:
and he placed the maids and their children first, and Leah
and her children following, and Rachel and Joseph
following,

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא עָבַר לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ אַרְצָה שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים עַד גִּשְׁתּוֹ עַד אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וְהוּא עָבַר לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ אַרְצָה שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים עַד גִּשְׁתּוֹ עַד אָחִיו׃

english.text:
and he passed in front of them. And he bowed to the ground
seven times until he came up to his brother.

translation.text: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

verses.english:
and he passed in front of them. And he bowed to the ground
seven times until he came up to his brother.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרץ עֵשָׂו לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיְחַבְּקֵהוּ וַיִּפֹּל עַל צַוָּארָו וַיִּשָּׁקֵהוּ וַיִּבְכּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּרץ עֵשָׂו לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיְחַבְּקֵהוּ וַיִּפֹּל עַל צַוָּארָו וַיִּשָּׁקֵהוּ וַיִּבְכּוּ׃

english.text:
And Esau ran to him and embraced him and fell on his neck
and kissed him. And they wept.

translation.text: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.

verses.english:
And Esau ran to him and embraced him and fell on his neck
and kissed him. And they wept.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת הַנָּשִׁים וְאֶת הַיְלָדִים וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אֵלֶּה לָּךְ וַיֹּאמַר הַיְלָדִים אֲשֶׁר חָנַן אֱלֹהִים אֶת עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת הַנָּשִׁים וְאֶת הַיְלָדִים וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אֵלֶּה לָּךְ וַיֹּאמַר הַיְלָדִים אֲשֶׁר חָנַן אֱלֹהִים אֶת עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And he raised his eyes and saw the women and the children,
and he said, “Who are these whom you have?” And he said,
“The children with whom God has graced your servant.”

translation.text: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.

verses.english:
And he raised his eyes and saw the women and the children,
and he said, “Who are these whom you have?” And he said,
“The children with whom God has graced your servant.”

verses.hebrew: וַתִּגַּשְׁןָ הַשְּׁפָחוֹת הֵנָּה וְיַלְדֵיהֶן וַתִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶיןָ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּגַּשְׁןָ הַשְּׁפָחוֹת הֵנָּה וְיַלְדֵיהֶן וַתִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶיןָ׃

english.text:
And the maids came over, they and their children, and
bowed.

translation.text: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.

verses.english:
And the maids came over, they and their children, and
bowed.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּגַּשׁ גַּם לֵאָה וִילָדֶיהָ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ וְאַחַר נִגַּשׁ יוֹסֵף וְרָחֵל וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּגַּשׁ גַּם לֵאָה וִילָדֶיהָ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ וְאַחַר נִגַּשׁ יוֹסֵף וְרָחֵל וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ׃

english.text:
And Leah and her children, too, came over, and they bowed.
And then Joseph and Rachel came over, and they bowed.

translation.text: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

verses.english:
And Leah and her children, too, came over, and they bowed.
And then Joseph and Rachel came over, and they bowed.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִי לְךָ כּל הַמַּחֲנֶה הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר פָּגָשְׁתִּי וַיֹּאמֶר לִמְצֹא חֵן בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מִי לְךָ כּל הַמַּחֲנֶה הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר פָּגָשְׁתִּי וַיֹּאמֶר לִמְצֹא חֵן בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנִי׃

english.text:
And he said, “Who is all this camp of yours that I met?”
And he said, “To find favor in my lord’s eyes.”

translation.text: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.

verses.english:
And he said, “Who is all this camp of yours that I met?”
And he said, “To find favor in my lord’s eyes.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר עֵשָׂו יֶשׁ לִי רָב אָחִי יְהִי לְךָ אֲשֶׁר לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר עֵשָׂו יֶשׁ לִי רָב אָחִי יְהִי לְךָ אֲשֶׁר לָךְ׃

english.text:
And Esau said, “I have a great deal, my brother. Let
what’s yours be yours.”

translation.text: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.

verses.english:
And Esau said, “I have a great deal, my brother. Let
what’s yours be yours.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אַל נָא אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ מִנְחָתִי מִיָּדִי כִּי עַל כֵּן רָאִיתִי פָנֶיךָ כִּרְאֹת פְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים וַתִּרְצֵנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אַל נָא אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ מִנְחָתִי מִיָּדִי כִּי עַל כֵּן רָאִיתִי פָנֶיךָ כִּרְאֹת פְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים וַתִּרְצֵנִי׃

english.text:
And Jacob said, “Don’t. If I’ve found favor in your eyes,
then you’ll take my offering from my hand, because on
account of this I’ve seen your face—like seeing God’s
face!—and you’ve accepted me.

translation.text: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.

verses.english:
And Jacob said, “Don’t. If I’ve found favor in your eyes,
then you’ll take my offering from my hand, because on
account of this I’ve seen your face—like seeing God’s
face!—and you’ve accepted me.

verses.hebrew: קַח נָא אֶת בִּרְכָתִי אֲשֶׁר הֻבָאת לָךְ כִּי חַנַּנִי אֱלֹהִים וְכִי יֶשׁ לִי כֹל וַיִּפְצַר בּוֹ וַיִּקָּח׃

hebrew.text: קַח נָא אֶת בִּרְכָתִי אֲשֶׁר הֻבָאת לָךְ כִּי חַנַּנִי אֱלֹהִים וְכִי יֶשׁ לִי כֹל וַיִּפְצַר בּוֹ וַיִּקָּח׃

english.text:
Take my blessing that’s been brought to you, because God
has been gracious to me and because I have everything.”
And he pressed him, and he took it.

translation.text: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.

verses.english:
Take my blessing that’s been brought to you, because God
has been gracious to me and because I have everything.”
And he pressed him, and he took it.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נִסְעָה וְנֵלֵכָה וְאֵלְכָה לְנֶגְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר נִסְעָה וְנֵלֵכָה וְאֵלְכָה לְנֶגְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And he said, “Let’s travel, and let’s go. And let me go
alongside you.”

translation.text: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.

verses.english:
And he said, “Let’s travel, and let’s go. And let me go
alongside you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֲדֹנִי יֹדֵעַ כִּי הַיְלָדִים רַכִּים וְהַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר עָלוֹת עָלָי וּדְפָקוּם יוֹם אֶחָד וָמֵתוּ כּל הַצֹּאן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֲדֹנִי יֹדֵעַ כִּי הַיְלָדִים רַכִּים וְהַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר עָלוֹת עָלָי וּדְפָקוּם יוֹם אֶחָד וָמֵתוּ כּל הַצֹּאן׃

english.text:
And he said to him, “My lord knows that the children are
weak and the nursing sheep and oxen are with me, and
they’ll drive them one day and all the sheep will die.

translation.text: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

verses.english:
And he said to him, “My lord knows that the children are
weak and the nursing sheep and oxen are with me, and
they’ll drive them one day and all the sheep will die.

verses.hebrew: יַעֲבר נָא אֲדֹנִי לִפְנֵי עַבְדּוֹ וַאֲנִי אֶתְנָהֲלָה לְאִטִּי לְרֶגֶל הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר לְפָנַי וּלְרֶגֶל הַיְלָדִים עַד אֲשֶׁר אָבֹא אֶל אֲדֹנִי שֵׂעִירָה׃

hebrew.text: יַעֲבר נָא אֲדֹנִי לִפְנֵי עַבְדּוֹ וַאֲנִי אֶתְנָהֲלָה לְאִטִּי לְרֶגֶל הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר לְפָנַי וּלְרֶגֶל הַיְלָדִים עַד אֲשֶׁר אָבֹא אֶל אֲדֹנִי שֵׂעִירָה׃

english.text:
Let my lord pass on in front of his servant; and I, let me
move along at my pace required by the task that’s before
me and required by the children until I come to my lord at
Seir.”

translation.text: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.

verses.english:
Let my lord pass on in front of his servant; and I, let me
move along at my pace required by the task that’s before
me and required by the children until I come to my lord at
Seir.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר עֵשָׂו אַצִּיגָה נָּא עִמְּךָ מִן הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתִּי וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָּה זֶּה אֶמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר עֵשָׂו אַצִּיגָה נָּא עִמְּךָ מִן הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתִּי וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָּה זֶּה אֶמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנִי׃

english.text:
And Esau said, “Let me set with you some of the people who
are with me.” And he said, “Why have I found favor in my
lord’s eyes?”

translation.text: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.

verses.english:
And Esau said, “Let me set with you some of the people who
are with me.” And he said, “Why have I found favor in my
lord’s eyes?”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עֵשָׂו לְדַרְכּוֹ שֵׂעִירָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עֵשָׂו לְדַרְכּוֹ שֵׂעִירָה׃

english.text: And Esau went back on his way to Seir that day,

translation.text: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.

verses.english: And Esau went back on his way to Seir that day,

verses.hebrew: וְיַעֲקֹב נָסַע סֻכֹּתָה וַיִּבֶן לוֹ בָּיִת וּלְמִקְנֵהוּ עָשָׂה סֻכֹּת עַל כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם סֻכּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְיַעֲקֹב נָסַע סֻכֹּתָה וַיִּבֶן לוֹ בָּיִת וּלְמִקְנֵהוּ עָשָׂה סֻכֹּת עַל כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם סֻכּוֹת׃

english.text:
and Jacob traveled to Sukkot. And he built a house for
himself and made booths for his cattle. On account of this
he called the place’s name Sukkot.

translation.text: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

verses.english:
and Jacob traveled to Sukkot. And he built a house for
himself and made booths for his cattle. On account of this
he called the place’s name Sukkot.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב שָׁלֵם עִיר שְׁכֶם אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן בְּבֹאוֹ מִפַּדַּן אֲרָם וַיִּחַן אֶת פְּנֵי הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב שָׁלֵם עִיר שְׁכֶם אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן בְּבֹאוֹ מִפַּדַּן אֲרָם וַיִּחַן אֶת פְּנֵי הָעִיר׃

english.text:
And Jacob came, safe, to the city of Shechem, which was in
the land of Canaan, when he was coming from Paddan Aram,
and camped in front of the city.

translation.text: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padanaram; and pitched his tent before the city.

verses.english:
And Jacob came, safe, to the city of Shechem, which was in
the land of Canaan, when he was coming from Paddan Aram,
and camped in front of the city.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקֶן אֶת חֶלְקַת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר נָטָה שָׁם אהֳלוֹ מִיַּד בְּנֵי חֲמוֹר אֲבִי שְׁכֶם בְּמֵאָה קְשִׂיטָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקֶן אֶת חֶלְקַת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר נָטָה שָׁם אהֳלוֹ מִיַּד בְּנֵי חֲמוֹר אֲבִי שְׁכֶם בְּמֵאָה קְשִׂיטָה׃

english.text:
And he bought the section of field in which he pitched his
tent from the hand of the sons of Hamor, father of
Shechem, for a hundred qesita.

translation.text: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for an hundred pieces of money.

verses.english:
And he bought the section of field in which he pitched his
tent from the hand of the sons of Hamor, father of
Shechem, for a hundred qesita.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּצֶּב שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרָא לוֹ אֵל אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּצֶּב שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרָא לוֹ אֵל אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And he set up an altar there and called it “El, God of
Israel.”

translation.text: And he erected there an altar, and called it EleloheIsrael.

verses.english:
And he set up an altar there and called it “El, God of
Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּצֵא דִינָה בַּת לֵאָה אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְיַעֲקֹב לִרְאוֹת בִּבְנוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּצֵא דִינָה בַּת לֵאָה אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְיַעֲקֹב לִרְאוֹת בִּבְנוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And Dinah, Leah’s daughter, whom she had borne to
Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

translation.text: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

verses.english:
And Dinah, Leah’s daughter, whom she had borne to
Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֹתָהּ שְׁכֶם בֶּן חֲמוֹר הַחִוִּי נְשִׂיא הָאָרֶץ וַיִּקַּח אֹתָהּ וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֹתָהּ וַיְעַנֶּהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אֹתָהּ שְׁכֶם בֶּן חֲמוֹר הַחִוִּי נְשִׂיא הָאָרֶץ וַיִּקַּח אֹתָהּ וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֹתָהּ וַיְעַנֶּהָ׃

english.text:
And Shechem, son of Hamor, the Hivite, the chieftain of
the land, saw her. And he took her and lay with her and
degraded her.

translation.text: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.

verses.english:
And Shechem, son of Hamor, the Hivite, the chieftain of
the land, saw her. And he took her and lay with her and
degraded her.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּדְבַּק נַפְשׁוֹ בְּדִינָה בַּת יַעֲקֹב וַיֶּאֱהַב אֶת הַנַּעֲרָ וַיְדַבֵּר עַל לֵב הַנַּעֲרָ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּדְבַּק נַפְשׁוֹ בְּדִינָה בַּת יַעֲקֹב וַיֶּאֱהַב אֶת הַנַּעֲרָ וַיְדַבֵּר עַל לֵב הַנַּעֲרָ׃

english.text:
And his soul clung to Dinah, Jacob’s daughter, and he
loved the girl and spoke on the girl’s heart.

translation.text: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.

verses.english:
And his soul clung to Dinah, Jacob’s daughter, and he
