loved the girl and spoke on the girl’s heart.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁכֶם אֶל חֲמוֹר אָבִיו לֵאמֹר קַח לִי אֶת הַיַּלְדָּה הַזֹּאת לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁכֶם אֶל חֲמוֹר אָבִיו לֵאמֹר קַח לִי אֶת הַיַּלְדָּה הַזֹּאת לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
And Shechem said to Hamor, his father, “Get me this girl
for a wife.”

translation.text: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.

verses.english:
And Shechem said to Hamor, his father, “Get me this girl
for a wife.”

verses.hebrew: וְיַעֲקֹב שָׁמַע כִּי טִמֵּא אֶת דִּינָה בִתּוֹ וּבָנָיו הָיוּ אֶת מִקְנֵהוּ בַּשָּׂדֶה וְהֶחֱרִשׁ יַעֲקֹב עַד בֹּאָם׃

hebrew.text: וְיַעֲקֹב שָׁמַע כִּי טִמֵּא אֶת דִּינָה בִתּוֹ וּבָנָיו הָיוּ אֶת מִקְנֵהוּ בַּשָּׂדֶה וְהֶחֱרִשׁ יַעֲקֹב עַד בֹּאָם׃

translation.text: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא חֲמוֹר אֲבִי שְׁכֶם אֶל יַעֲקֹב לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא חֲמוֹר אֲבִי שְׁכֶם אֶל יַעֲקֹב לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Hamor, Shechem’s father, went out to Jacob to speak
with him.

translation.text: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.

verses.english:
And Hamor, Shechem’s father, went out to Jacob to speak
with him.

Jacob’s daughter, and such a thing is not done.

translation.text: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter: which thing ought not to be done.

And Jacob’s sons came from the field when they heard, and

Jacob’s daughter, and such a thing is not done.

and marry with us; give your daughters to us and take our

and live with us; and the land will be before you: live

and live with us; and the land will be before you: live

And Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let

verses.english:
And Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let
me find favor in your eyes, and I’ll give whatever you say
to me.

english.text:
Make a bride-price and gift on me very great, and let me
give whatever you say to me, and give me the girl as a
wife.”

translation.text: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.

verses.english:
Make a bride-price and gift on me very great, and let me
give whatever you say to me, and give me the girl as a
wife.”

english.text:
And Jacob’s sons answered Shechem and Hamor, his father,
with deception as they spoke because he had defiled Dinah,
their sister.

translation.text: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:

verses.english:
And Jacob’s sons answered Shechem and Hamor, his father,
with deception as they spoke because he had defiled Dinah,
their sister.

english.text:
And they said to them, “We aren’t able to do this thing,
to give our sister to a man who has a foreskin, because
that’s a disgrace to us.

translation.text: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:

verses.english:
And they said to them, “We aren’t able to do this thing,
to give our sister to a man who has a foreskin, because
that’s a disgrace to us.

verses.english:
Only this way will we consent to you: if you’ll be like
us, every male among you to be circumcised.

And we’ll give our daughters to you and take your

daughters to us, and we’ll live with you, and we’ll become
one people.

we’ll take our daughter and go.”

And their words were good in Hamor’s eyes and in Hamor’s

And the boy did not delay to do the thing, for he desired

And Hamor and his son Shechem came to the gate of their
city and spoke to the people of their city, saying,

hebrew.text: הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה שְׁלֵמִים הֵם אִתָּנוּ וְיֵשְׁבוּ בָאָרֶץ וְיִסְחֲרוּ אֹתָהּ וְהָאָרֶץ הִנֵּה רַחֲבַת יָדַיִם לִפְנֵיהֶם אֶת בְּנֹתָם נִקַּח לָנוּ לְנָשִׁים וְאֶת בְּנֹתֵינוּ נִתֵּן לָהֶם׃

english.text:
“These people are peaceable with us, and they’ll live in
the land and go around in it, and the land, here, has
enough breadth for them. Let’s take their daughters for us
as wives and give our daughters to them.

translation.text: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

verses.english:
“These people are peaceable with us, and they’ll live in
the land and go around in it, and the land, here, has
enough breadth for them. Let’s take their daughters for us

Only in this way will these people consent to us to live
with us, to be one people: if every male among us is
circumcised as they are circumcised.

Their cattle and possessions and all their animals: won’t

verses.english:

they be ours? Only let’s consent to them, and they’ll live
with us.”

And everyone who went out of the gate of his city listened
to Hamor and to his son Shechem; and every male, everyone
who went out of the gate of his city, was circumcised.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בִּהְיוֹתָם כֹּאֲבִים וַיִּקְחוּ שְׁנֵי בְנֵי יַעֲקֹב שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי אֲחֵי דִינָה אִישׁ חַרְבּוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַל הָעִיר בֶּטַח וַיַּהַרְגוּ כּל זָכָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בִּהְיוֹתָם כֹּאֲבִים וַיִּקְחוּ שְׁנֵי בְנֵי יַעֲקֹב שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי אֲחֵי דִינָה אִישׁ חַרְבּוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַל הָעִיר בֶּטַח וַיַּהַרְגוּ כּל זָכָר׃

english.text:
And it was on the third day, when they were hurting, and
two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers,
each took his sword, and they came upon the city
stealthily, and they killed every male.

translation.text: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.

verses.english:
And it was on the third day, when they were hurting, and
two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers,
each took his sword, and they came upon the city
stealthily, and they killed every male.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת חֲמוֹר וְאֶת שְׁכֶם בְּנוֹ הָרְגוּ לְפִי חָרֶב וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת דִּינָה מִבֵּית שְׁכֶם וַיֵּצֵאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת חֲמוֹר וְאֶת שְׁכֶם בְּנוֹ הָרְגוּ לְפִי חָרֶב וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת דִּינָה מִבֵּית שְׁכֶם וַיֵּצֵאוּ׃

english.text:
And they killed Hamor and his son Shechem by the sword and
took Dinah from Shechem’s house and went out.

translation.text: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went out.

verses.english:
And they killed Hamor and his son Shechem by the sword and
took Dinah from Shechem’s house and went out.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב בָּאוּ עַל הַחֲלָלִים וַיָּבֹזּוּ הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר טִמְּאוּ אֲחוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב בָּאוּ עַל הַחֲלָלִים וַיָּבֹזּוּ הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר טִמְּאוּ אֲחוֹתָם׃

english.text:
Jacob’s sons had come upon the corpses and despoiled the
city because they had defiled their sister.

translation.text: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.

verses.english:
Jacob’s sons had come upon the corpses and despoiled the
city because they had defiled their sister.

verses.hebrew: אֶת צֹאנָם וְאֶת בְּקָרָם וְאֶת חֲמֹרֵיהֶם וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר בָּעִיר וְאֶת אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה לָקָחוּ׃

hebrew.text: אֶת צֹאנָם וְאֶת בְּקָרָם וְאֶת חֲמֹרֵיהֶם וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר בָּעִיר וְאֶת אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה לָקָחוּ׃

english.text:
They took their sheep and their oxen and their asses and
what was in the city and what was in the field.

translation.text: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,

verses.english:
They took their sheep and their oxen and their asses and
what was in the city and what was in the field.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת כּל חֵילָם וְאֶת כּל טַפָּם וְאֶת נְשֵׁיהֶם שָׁבוּ וַיָּבֹזּוּ וְאֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת כּל חֵילָם וְאֶת כּל טַפָּם וְאֶת נְשֵׁיהֶם שָׁבוּ וַיָּבֹזּוּ וְאֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּיִת׃

english.text:
And they captured and despoiled all their wealth and all
their infants and their wives and everything that was in
the house.

translation.text: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.

verses.english:
And they captured and despoiled all their wealth and all
their infants and their wives and everything that was in
the house.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל שִׁמְעוֹן וְאֶל לֵוִי עֲכַרְתֶּם אֹתִי לְהַבְאִישֵׁנִי בְּיֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ בַּכְּנַעֲנִי וּבַפְּרִזִּי וַאֲנִי מְתֵי מִסְפָּר וְנֶאֶסְפוּ עָלַי וְהִכּוּנִי וְנִשְׁמַדְתִּי אֲנִי וּבֵיתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל שִׁמְעוֹן וְאֶל לֵוִי עֲכַרְתֶּם אֹתִי לְהַבְאִישֵׁנִי בְּיֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ בַּכְּנַעֲנִי וּבַפְּרִזִּי וַאֲנִי מְתֵי מִסְפָּר וְנֶאֶסְפוּ עָלַי וְהִכּוּנִי וְנִשְׁמַדְתִּי אֲנִי וּבֵיתִי׃

english.text:
And Jacob said to Simeon and to Levi, “You’ve caused me
anguish, making me odious to those who live in the land,
to the Canaanite and to the Per-izzite, and I’m few in
number, and they’ll be gathered against me and strike me,
and I’ll be destroyed, I and my house.”

translation.text: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.

verses.english:
And Jacob said to Simeon and to Levi, “You’ve caused me
anguish, making me odious to those who live in the land,
to the Canaanite and to the Per-izzite, and I’m few in
number, and they’ll be gathered against me and strike me,
and I’ll be destroyed, I and my house.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הַכְזוֹנָה יַעֲשֶׂה אֶת אֲחוֹתֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הַכְזוֹנָה יַעֲשֶׂה אֶת אֲחוֹתֵנוּ׃

english.text:
And they said, “Shall he treat our sister like a
prostitute?”

translation.text: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?

verses.english:
And they said, “Shall he treat our sister like a
prostitute?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל יַעֲקֹב קוּם עֲלֵה בֵית אֵל וְשֶׁב שָׁם וַעֲשֵׂה שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לָאֵל הַנִּרְאֶה אֵלֶיךָ בְּברְחֲךָ מִפְּנֵי עֵשָׂו אָחִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל יַעֲקֹב קוּם עֲלֵה בֵית אֵל וְשֶׁב שָׁם וַעֲשֵׂה שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לָאֵל הַנִּרְאֶה אֵלֶיךָ בְּברְחֲךָ מִפְּנֵי עֵשָׂו אָחִיךָ׃

english.text:
And God said to Jacob, “Get up. Go up to Beth-El and
live there and make an altar there to God, who appeared to
you when you were fleeing from Esau, your brother.”

translation.text: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

verses.english:
And God said to Jacob, “Get up. Go up to Beth-El and
live there and make an altar there to God, who appeared to
you when you were fleeing from Esau, your brother.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶל כּל אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ הָסִרוּ אֶת אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר אֲשֶׁר בְּתֹכְכֶם וְהִטַּהֲרוּ וְהַחֲלִיפוּ שִׂמְלֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶל כּל אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ הָסִרוּ אֶת אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר אֲשֶׁר בְּתֹכְכֶם וְהִטַּהֲרוּ וְהַחֲלִיפוּ שִׂמְלֹתֵיכֶם׃

translation.text: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:

verses.hebrew: וְנָקוּמָה וְנַעֲלֶה בֵּית אֵל וְאֶעֱשֶׂה שָּׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לָאֵל הָעֹנֶה אֹתִי בְּיוֹם צָרָתִי וַיְהִי עִמָּדִי בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלָכְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְנָקוּמָה וְנַעֲלֶה בֵּית אֵל וְאֶעֱשֶׂה שָּׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לָאֵל הָעֹנֶה אֹתִי בְּיוֹם צָרָתִי וַיְהִי עִמָּדִי בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלָכְתִּי׃

english.text:
and let’s get up and go up to Beth-El, and I’ll make an
altar there to God, who answered me in a day of my
trouble, and He was with me in the way that I went.”

translation.text: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

verses.english:
and let’s get up and go up to Beth-El, and I’ll make an
altar there to God, who answered me in a day of my
trouble, and He was with me in the way that I went.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶל יַעֲקֹב אֵת כּל אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדָם וְאֶת הַנְּזָמִים אֲשֶׁר בְּאזְנֵיהֶם וַיִּטְמֹן אֹתָם יַעֲקֹב תַּחַת הָאֵלָה אֲשֶׁר עִם שְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶל יַעֲקֹב אֵת כּל אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדָם וְאֶת הַנְּזָמִים אֲשֶׁר בְּאזְנֵיהֶם וַיִּטְמֹן אֹתָם יַעֲקֹב תַּחַת הָאֵלָה אֲשֶׁר עִם שְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
And they gave all the foreign gods that were in their hand
and the rings that were in their ears to Jacob, and Jacob
stashed them under the oak that was by Shechem.

translation.text: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

verses.english:
And they gave all the foreign gods that were in their hand
and the rings that were in their ears to Jacob, and Jacob
stashed them under the oak that was by Shechem.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסָּעוּ וַיְהִי חִתַּת אֱלֹהִים עַל הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיהֶם וְלֹא רָדְפוּ אַחֲרֵי בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסָּעוּ וַיְהִי חִתַּת אֱלֹהִים עַל הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיהֶם וְלֹא רָדְפוּ אַחֲרֵי בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And they traveled, and God’s terror was on the cities that
were around them, and they did not pursue the children of
Jacob.

translation.text: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

verses.english:
And they traveled, and God’s terror was on the cities that
were around them, and they did not pursue the children of
Jacob.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב לוּזָה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן הִוא בֵּית אֵל הוּא וְכל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב לוּזָה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן הִוא בֵּית אֵל הוּא וְכל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan—it
is Beth-El—he and all the people who were with him.

translation.text: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people that were with him.

verses.english:
And Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan—it
is Beth-El—he and all the people who were with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם אֵל בֵּית אֵל כִּי שָׁם נִגְלוּ אֵלָיו הָאֱלֹהִים בְּברְחוֹ מִפְּנֵי אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם אֵל בֵּית אֵל כִּי שָׁם נִגְלוּ אֵלָיו הָאֱלֹהִים בְּברְחוֹ מִפְּנֵי אָחִיו׃

english.text:
And he built an altar there and called the place El of
Beth-El because God was revealed to him there when he was
fleeing from his brother.

translation.text: And he built there an altar, and called the place Elbethel: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

verses.english:
And he built an altar there and called the place El of
Beth-El because God was revealed to him there when he was
fleeing from his brother.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּמת דְּבֹרָה מֵינֶקֶת רִבְקָה וַתִּקָּבֵר מִתַּחַת לְבֵית אֵל תַּחַת הָאַלּוֹן וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ אַלּוֹן בָּכוּת׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּמת דְּבֹרָה מֵינֶקֶת רִבְקָה וַתִּקָּבֵר מִתַּחַת לְבֵית אֵל תַּחַת הָאַלּוֹן וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ אַלּוֹן בָּכוּת׃

english.text:
And Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried beneath
Beth-El, beneath an oak, and he called its name Oak of
Weeping.

translation.text: But Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allonbachuth.

verses.english:
And Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried beneath
Beth-El, beneath an oak, and he called its name Oak of
Weeping.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא אֱלֹהִים אֶל יַעֲקֹב עוֹד בְּבֹאוֹ מִפַּדַּן אֲרָם וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָא אֱלֹהִים אֶל יַעֲקֹב עוֹד בְּבֹאוֹ מִפַּדַּן אֲרָם וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And God appeared to Jacob again when he was coming from
Paddan Aram, and He blessed him.

translation.text: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padanaram, and blessed him.

verses.english:
And God appeared to Jacob again when he was coming from
Paddan Aram, and He blessed him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלֹהִים שִׁמְךָ יַעֲקֹב לֹא יִקָּרֵא שִׁמְךָ עוֹד יַעֲקֹב כִּי אִם יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיֶה שְׁמֶךָ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלֹהִים שִׁמְךָ יַעֲקֹב לֹא יִקָּרֵא שִׁמְךָ עוֹד יַעֲקֹב כִּי אִם יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיֶה שְׁמֶךָ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name will
not be called Jacob anymore, but rather Israel will be
your name.” And He called his name Israel.

translation.text: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.

verses.english:
And God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name will
not be called Jacob anymore, but rather Israel will be
your name.” And He called his name Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלֹהִים אֲנִי אֵל שַׁדַּי פְּרֵה וּרְבֵה גּוֹי וּקְהַל גּוֹיִם יִהְיֶה מִמֶּךָּ וּמְלָכִים מֵחֲלָצֶיךָ יֵצֵאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלֹהִים אֲנִי אֵל שַׁדַּי פְּרֵה וּרְבֵה גּוֹי וּקְהַל גּוֹיִם יִהְיֶה מִמֶּךָּ וּמְלָכִים מֵחֲלָצֶיךָ יֵצֵאוּ׃

english.text:
And God said to him, “I am El Shadday Be fruitful and
multiply. A nation and a community of nations will be from
you, and kings will come out from your hips.

translation.text: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;

verses.english:
And God said to him, “I am El Shadday Be fruitful and
multiply. A nation and a community of nations will be from
you, and kings will come out from your hips.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם וּלְיִצְחָק לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם וּלְיִצְחָק לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And the land that I gave to Abraham and to Isaac: I’ll
give it to you, and I’ll give the land to your seed after
you.”

translation.text: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.

verses.english:
And the land that I gave to Abraham and to Isaac: I’ll
give it to you, and I’ll give the land to your seed after
you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מֵעָלָיו אֱלֹהִים בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל מֵעָלָיו אֱלֹהִים בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And God went up from on him in the place where He had
spoken with him.

translation.text: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.

verses.english:
And God went up from on him in the place where He had
spoken with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּצֵּב יַעֲקֹב מַצֵּבָה בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ מַצֶּבֶת אָבֶן וַיַּסֵּךְ עָלֶיהָ נֶסֶךְ וַיִּצֹק עָלֶיהָ שָׁמֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּצֵּב יַעֲקֹב מַצֵּבָה בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ מַצֶּבֶת אָבֶן וַיַּסֵּךְ עָלֶיהָ נֶסֶךְ וַיִּצֹק עָלֶיהָ שָׁמֶן׃

english.text:
And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He had spoken
with him, a stone pillar, and he poured a libation on it
and spilled oil on it.

translation.text: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.

verses.english:
And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He had spoken
with him, a stone pillar, and he poured a libation on it
and spilled oil on it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יַעֲקֹב אֶת שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ שָׁם אֱלֹהִים בֵּית אֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יַעֲקֹב אֶת שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ שָׁם אֱלֹהִים בֵּית אֵל׃

english.text:
And Jacob called the name of the place where God had
spoken to him there Beth-El.

translation.text: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.

verses.english:
And Jacob called the name of the place where God had
spoken to him there Beth-El.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִבֵּית אֵל וַיְהִי עוֹד כִּבְרַת הָאָרֶץ לָבוֹא אֶפְרָתָה וַתֵּלֶד רָחֵל וַתְּקַשׁ בְּלִדְתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִבֵּית אֵל וַיְהִי עוֹד כִּבְרַת הָאָרֶץ לָבוֹא אֶפְרָתָה וַתֵּלֶד רָחֵל וַתְּקַשׁ בְּלִדְתָּהּ׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Beth-El, and there was still the
span of the land to come to Ephrat, and Rachel gave birth,
and she had difficulty in her labor.

translation.text: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Beth-El, and there was still the
span of the land to come to Ephrat, and Rachel gave birth,
and she had difficulty in her labor.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְהַקְשֹׁתָהּ בְּלִדְתָּהּ וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ הַמְיַלֶּדֶת אַל תִּירְאִי כִּי גַם זֶה לָךְ בֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְהַקְשֹׁתָהּ בְּלִדְתָּהּ וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ הַמְיַלֶּדֶת אַל תִּירְאִי כִּי גַם זֶה לָךְ בֵּן׃

english.text:
And it was when she was having difficulty in her labor,
and the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, because
this, too, is a son for you.”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.

verses.english:
And it was when she was having difficulty in her labor,
and the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, because
this, too, is a son for you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּצֵאת נַפְשָׁהּ כִּי מֵתָה וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ בֶּן אוֹנִי וְאָבִיו קָרָא לוֹ בִנְיָמִין׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּצֵאת נַפְשָׁהּ כִּי מֵתָה וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ בֶּן אוֹנִי וְאָבִיו קָרָא לוֹ בִנְיָמִין׃

english.text:
And it was as her soul was going out—because she died—and
she called his name Ben-oni. And his father called him
Benjamin.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Benoni: but his father called him Benjamin.

verses.english:
And it was as her soul was going out—because she died—and
she called his name Ben-oni. And his father called him
Benjamin.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּמת רָחֵל וַתִּקָּבֵר בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶפְרָתָה הִוא בֵּית לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּמת רָחֵל וַתִּקָּבֵר בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶפְרָתָה הִוא בֵּית לָחֶם׃

english.text:
And Rachel died. And she was buried on the road to Ephrat.
It is Bethlehem.

translation.text: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.

verses.english:
And Rachel died. And she was buried on the road to Ephrat.
It is Bethlehem.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּצֵּב יַעֲקֹב מַצֵּבָה עַל קְבֻרָתָהּ הִוא מַצֶּבֶת קְבֻרַת רָחֵל עַד הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּצֵּב יַעֲקֹב מַצֵּבָה עַל קְבֻרָתָהּ הִוא מַצֶּבֶת קְבֻרַת רָחֵל עַד הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. It is the pillar
of Rachel’s grave to this day.

translation.text: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel’s grave unto this day.

verses.english:
And Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. It is the pillar
of Rachel’s grave to this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסַּע יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּט אהֳלֹה מֵהָלְאָה לְמִגְדַּל עֵדֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסַּע יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּט אהֳלֹה מֵהָלְאָה לְמִגְדַּל עֵדֶר׃

english.text: And Israel traveled and pitched his tent past Migdal-Eder.

translation.text: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.

verses.english: And Israel traveled and pitched his tent past Migdal-Eder.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁכֹּן יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָרֶץ הַהִוא וַיֵּלֶךְ רְאוּבֵן וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֶת בִּלְהָה פִּילֶגֶשׁ אָבִיו וַיִּשְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵ͏ל׃ פ וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי יַעֲקֹב שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁכֹּן יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָרֶץ הַהִוא וַיֵּלֶךְ רְאוּבֵן וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֶת בִּלְהָה פִּילֶגֶשׁ אָבִיו וַיִּשְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵ͏ל׃ פ וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי יַעֲקֹב שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

english.text:
And it was when Israel was tenting in that land: and
Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine.
And Israel heard. And Jacob’s sons were twelve.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:

verses.english:
And it was when Israel was tenting in that land: and
Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine.
And Israel heard. And Jacob’s sons were twelve.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי לֵאָה בְּכוֹר יַעֲקֹב רְאוּבֵן וְשִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי וִיהוּדָה וְיִשָּׂשכָר וּזְבֻלוּן׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי לֵאָה בְּכוֹר יַעֲקֹב רְאוּבֵן וְשִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי וִיהוּדָה וְיִשָּׂשכָר וּזְבֻלוּן׃

english.text:
The sons of Leah were Jacob’s firstborn, Reuben, and
Simeon and Levi and Judah and Issachar and Zebulun.

translation.text: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:

verses.english:
The sons of Leah were Jacob’s firstborn, Reuben, and
Simeon and Levi and Judah and Issachar and Zebulun.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי רָחֵל יוֹסֵף וּבִנְיָמִן׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי רָחֵל יוֹסֵף וּבִנְיָמִן׃

english.text: The sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.

translation.text: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:

verses.english: The sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי בִלְהָה שִׁפְחַת רָחֵל דָּן וְנַפְתָּלִי׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי בִלְהָה שִׁפְחַת רָחֵל דָּן וְנַפְתָּלִי׃

english.text:
And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s maid, were Dan and
Naphtali.

translation.text: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:

verses.english:
And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s maid, were Dan and
Naphtali.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחַת לֵאָה גָּד וְאָשֵׁר אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר יֻלַּד לוֹ בְּפַדַּן אֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחַת לֵאָה גָּד וְאָשֵׁר אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר יֻלַּד לוֹ בְּפַדַּן אֲרָם׃

english.text:
And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s maid, were Gad and Asher.
These were Jacob’s sons, who were born to him in Paddan
Aram.

translation.text: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid: Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padanaram.

verses.english:
And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s maid, were Gad and Asher.
These were Jacob’s sons, who were born to him in Paddan
Aram.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב אֶל יִצְחָק אָבִיו מַמְרֵא קִרְיַת הָאַרְבַּע הִוא חֶבְרוֹן אֲשֶׁר גָּר שָׁם אַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב אֶל יִצְחָק אָבִיו מַמְרֵא קִרְיַת הָאַרְבַּע הִוא חֶבְרוֹן אֲשֶׁר גָּר שָׁם אַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק׃

english.text:
And Jacob came to Isaac, his father, at Mamre, at Kiriath
Arba—it is Hebron—where Abraham and Isaac had resided.

translation.text: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

verses.english:
And Jacob came to Isaac, his father, at Mamre, at Kiriath
Arba—it is Hebron—where Abraham and Isaac had resided.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ יְמֵי יִצְחָק מְאַת שָׁנָה וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ יְמֵי יִצְחָק מְאַת שָׁנָה וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text: And Isaac’s days were a hundred years and eighty years,

translation.text: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.

verses.english: And Isaac’s days were a hundred years and eighty years,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְוַע יִצְחָק וַיָּמת וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו זָקֵן וּשְׂבַע יָמִים וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עֵשָׂו וְיַעֲקֹב בָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְוַע יִצְחָק וַיָּמת וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו זָקֵן וּשְׂבַע יָמִים וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עֵשָׂו וְיַעֲקֹב בָּנָיו׃

english.text:
and Isaac expired. And he died and was gathered to his
people, old and full of days. And Esau and Jacob, his
sons, buried him.

translation.text: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

verses.english:
and Isaac expired. And he died and was gathered to his
people, old and full of days. And Esau and Jacob, his
sons, buried him.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹת עֵשָׂו הוּא אֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹת עֵשָׂו הוּא אֱדוֹם׃

english.text: And these are the records of Esau: He is Edom.

translation.text: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.

verses.english: And these are the records of Esau: He is Edom.

verses.hebrew: עֵשָׂו לָקַח אֶת נָשָׁיו מִבְּנוֹת כְּנָעַן אֶת עָדָה בַּת אֵילוֹן הַחִתִּי וְאֶת אהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת עֲנָה בַּת צִבְעוֹן הַחִוִּי׃

hebrew.text: עֵשָׂו לָקַח אֶת נָשָׁיו מִבְּנוֹת כְּנָעַן אֶת עָדָה בַּת אֵילוֹן הַחִתִּי וְאֶת אהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת עֲנָה בַּת צִבְעוֹן הַחִוִּי׃

english.text:
Esau had taken his wives from the daughters of Canaan:
Adah, daughter of Elon, the Hittite, and Aholibamah,
daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite,

translation.text: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;

verses.english:
Esau had taken his wives from the daughters of Canaan:
Adah, daughter of Elon, the Hittite, and Aholibamah,
daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת בָּשְׂמַת בַּת יִשְׁמָעֵאל אֲחוֹת נְבָיוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת בָּשְׂמַת בַּת יִשְׁמָעֵאל אֲחוֹת נְבָיוֹת׃

english.text: and Basemath, daughter of Ishmael, sister of Nebaioth.

translation.text: And Bashemath Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebajoth.

verses.english: and Basemath, daughter of Ishmael, sister of Nebaioth.

english.text:
And Adah gave birth for Esau to Eliphaz, and Basemath gave
birth to Reuel,

translation.text: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;

And Adah gave birth for Esau to Eliphaz, and Basemath gave
birth to Reuel,

and Aholibamah gave birth to Jeush and Jalam and Korah.
These are Esau’s sons, who were born to him in the land of
Canaan.

translation.text: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.

verses.english:
and Aholibamah gave birth to Jeush and Jalam and Korah.
These are Esau’s sons, who were born to him in the land of
Canaan.

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח עֵשָׂו אֶת נָשָׁיו וְאֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת בְּנֹתָיו וְאֶת כּל נַפְשׁוֹת בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶת מִקְנֵהוּ וְאֶת כּל בְּהֶמְתּוֹ וְאֵת כּל קִנְיָנוֹ אֲשֶׁר רָכַשׁ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל אֶרֶץ מִפְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב אָחִיו׃

english.text:
And Esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters and
all the persons of his household and his cattle and all of
his animals and all of his possessions that he had
acquired in the land of Canaan, and he went to a land,
from the presence of Jacob, his brother,

translation.text: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.

verses.english:
And Esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters and
all the persons of his household and his cattle and all of
his animals and all of his possessions that he had
acquired in the land of Canaan, and he went to a land,
from the presence of Jacob, his brother,

verses.hebrew: כִּי הָיָה רְכוּשָׁם רָב מִשֶּׁבֶת יַחְדָּו וְלֹא יָכְלָה אֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵיהֶם לָשֵׂאת אֹתָם מִפְּנֵי מִקְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הָיָה רְכוּשָׁם רָב מִשֶּׁבֶת יַחְדָּו וְלֹא יָכְלָה אֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵיהֶם לָשֵׂאת אֹתָם מִפְּנֵי מִקְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
because their property was too great for them to live
together, and the land of their residences was not able to
suffice them because of their cattle.

translation.text: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.

verses.english:
because their property was too great for them to live
together, and the land of their residences was not able to
suffice them because of their cattle.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב עֵשָׂו בְּהַר שֵׂעִיר עֵשָׂו הוּא אֱדוֹם׃

english.text: And Esau lived in Mount Seir. Esau: he is Edom.

translation.text: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

verses.english: And Esau lived in Mount Seir. Esau: he is Edom.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹת עֵשָׂו אֲבִי אֱדוֹם בְּהַר שֵׂעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹת עֵשָׂו אֲבִי אֱדוֹם בְּהַר שֵׂעִיר׃

english.text:
And these are the records of Esau, father of Edom, in
Mount Seir.

translation.text: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:

verses.english:
And these are the records of Esau, father of Edom, in
Mount Seir.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו אֱלִיפַז בֶּן עָדָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו רְעוּאֵל בֶּן בָּשְׂמַת אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו אֱלִיפַז בֶּן עָדָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו רְעוּאֵל בֶּן בָּשְׂמַת אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

english.text:
These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, son of Adah,
Esau’s wife; Reuel, son of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

translation.text: These are the names of Esau’s sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.

verses.english:
These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, son of Adah,
Esau’s wife; Reuel, son of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

Kenaz.

translation.text: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

verses.english:
And Eliphaz’s sons were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam and
Kenaz.

hebrew.text: וְתִמְנַע הָיְתָה פִילֶגֶשׁ לֶאֱלִיפַז בֶּן עֵשָׂו וַתֵּלֶד לֶאֱלִיפַז אֶת עֲמָלֵק אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי עָדָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

english.text:
And Timna had been a concubine of Eliphaz, son of Esau,

sons of Adah, Esau’s wife.

translation.text: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau’s son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau’s wife.

verses.english:
And Timna had been a concubine of Eliphaz, son of Esau,
and she gave birth to Amalek for Eliphaz. These are the
sons of Adah, Esau’s wife.

And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath and Zerah, Shammah

verses.english:
And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath and Zerah, Shammah
and Mizzeh. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the

And these are the sons of Reuel, son of Esau: chief

sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

And these are the sons of Reuel, son of Esau: chief

the Horites, the children of Seir, in the land of Edom.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי לוֹטָן חֹרִי וְהֵימָם וַאֲחוֹת לוֹטָן תִּמְנָע׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי לוֹטָן חֹרִי וְהֵימָם וַאֲחוֹת לוֹטָן תִּמְנָע׃

english.text:
And the children of Lotan are Hori and Hemam, and Lotan’s
sister is Timna.

translation.text: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.

verses.english:
And the children of Lotan are Hori and Hemam, and Lotan’s
sister is Timna.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי שׁוֹבָל עַלְוָן וּמָנַחַת וְעֵיבָל שְׁפוֹ וְאוֹנָם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי שׁוֹבָל עַלְוָן וּמָנַחַת וְעֵיבָל שְׁפוֹ וְאוֹנָם׃

english.text:
And these are the children of Shobal: Alvan and Manahath
and Ebal, Shepho and Onam.

translation.text: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

verses.english:
And these are the children of Shobal: Alvan and Manahath
and Ebal, Shepho and Onam.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְנֵי צִבְעוֹן וְאַיָּה וַעֲנָה הוּא עֲנָה אֲשֶׁר מָצָא אֶת הַיֵּמִם בַּמִּדְבָּר בִּרְעֹתוֹ אֶת הַחֲמֹרִים לְצִבְעוֹן אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה בְנֵי צִבְעוֹן וְאַיָּה וַעֲנָה הוּא עֲנָה אֲשֶׁר מָצָא אֶת הַיֵּמִם בַּמִּדְבָּר בִּרְעֹתוֹ אֶת הַחֲמֹרִים לְצִבְעוֹן אָבִיו׃

english.text:
And these are the children of Zibeon: Ajah and Anah—that
is Anah who found the water in the wilderness when he
tended the asses of Zibeon, his father.

translation.text: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.

verses.english:
And these are the children of Zibeon: Ajah and Anah—that
is Anah who found the water in the wilderness when he
tended the asses of Zibeon, his father.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְנֵי עֲנָה דִּשֹׁן וְאהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת עֲנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה בְנֵי עֲנָה דִּשֹׁן וְאהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת עֲנָה׃

english.text:
And these are the children of Anah: Dishon and Aholibamah,
daughter of Anah.

translation.text: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.

verses.english:
And these are the children of Anah: Dishon and Aholibamah,
daughter of Anah.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי דִישָׁן חֶמְדָּן וְאֶשְׁבָּן וְיִתְרָן וּכְרָן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי דִישָׁן חֶמְדָּן וְאֶשְׁבָּן וְיִתְרָן וּכְרָן׃

english.text:
And these are the children of Dishon: Hemdan and Eshban
and Ithran and Cheran.

translation.text: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

verses.english:
And these are the children of Dishon: Hemdan and Eshban
and Ithran and Cheran.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אֵצֶר בִּלְהָן וְזַעֲוָן וַעֲקָן׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אֵצֶר בִּלְהָן וְזַעֲוָן וַעֲקָן׃

english.text:
These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan and
Akan.

translation.text: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.

verses.english:
These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan and
Akan.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי דִישָׁן עוּץ וַאֲרָן׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי דִישָׁן עוּץ וַאֲרָן׃

english.text: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

translation.text: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.

verses.english: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי אַלּוּף לוֹטָן אַלּוּף שׁוֹבָל אַלּוּף צִבְעוֹן אַלּוּף עֲנָה׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי אַלּוּף לוֹטָן אַלּוּף שׁוֹבָל אַלּוּף צִבְעוֹן אַלּוּף עֲנָה׃

english.text:
These are the chiefs of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief
Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

translation.text: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,

verses.english:
These are the chiefs of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief
Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

verses.hebrew: אַלּוּף דִּשֹׁן אַלּוּף אֵצֶר אַלּוּף דִּישָׁן אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי לְאַלֻּפֵיהֶם בְּאֶרֶץ שֵׂעִיר׃

hebrew.text: אַלּוּף דִּשֹׁן אַלּוּף אֵצֶר אַלּוּף דִּישָׁן אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי לְאַלֻּפֵיהֶם בְּאֶרֶץ שֵׂעִיר׃

english.text:
chief Dishon, chief Ezer, chief Dishan. These are the
chiefs of the Horites by their chiefdoms in the land of
Seir.

translation.text: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.

verses.english:
chief Dishon, chief Ezer, chief Dishan. These are the
chiefs of the Horites by their chiefdoms in the land of
Seir.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר מָלְכוּ בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם לִפְנֵי מְלךְ מֶלֶךְ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר מָלְכוּ בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם לִפְנֵי מְלךְ מֶלֶךְ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And these are the kings who ruled in the land of Edom
before a king ruled the children of Israel.

translation.text: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And these are the kings who ruled in the land of Edom
before a king ruled the children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְלֹךְ בֶּאֱדוֹם בֶּלַע בֶּן בְּעוֹר וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ דִּנְהָבָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְלֹךְ בֶּאֱדוֹם בֶּלַע בֶּן בְּעוֹר וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ דִּנְהָבָה׃

english.text:
And Bela son of Beor ruled in Edom, and the name of his
city was Dinhabah.

translation.text: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

verses.english:
And Bela son of Beor ruled in Edom, and the name of his
city was Dinhabah.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת בָּלַע וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו יוֹבָב בֶּן זֶרַח מִבּצְרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת בָּלַע וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו יוֹבָב בֶּן זֶרַח מִבּצְרָה׃

english.text:
And Bela died, and Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah ruled in
his place.

translation.text: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
And Bela died, and Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah ruled in
his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת יוֹבָב וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו חֻשָׁם מֵאֶרֶץ הַתֵּימָנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת יוֹבָב וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו חֻשָׁם מֵאֶרֶץ הַתֵּימָנִי׃

english.text:
And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani ruled in
his place.

translation.text: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani ruled in
his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת חֻשָׁם וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו הֲדַד בֶּן בְּדַד הַמַּכֶּה אֶת מִדְיָן בִּשְׂדֵה מוֹאָב וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ עֲוִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת חֻשָׁם וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו הֲדַד בֶּן בְּדַד הַמַּכֶּה אֶת מִדְיָן בִּשְׂדֵה מוֹאָב וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ עֲוִית׃

english.text:
And Husham died, and Hadad son of Bedad, who struck Midian
in the field of Moab, ruled in his place, and the name of
his city was Avith.

translation.text: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

verses.english:
And Husham died, and Hadad son of Bedad, who struck Midian
in the field of Moab, ruled in his place, and the name of
his city was Avith.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת הֲדָד וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו שַׂמְלָה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת הֲדָד וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו שַׂמְלָה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָה׃

english.text: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah ruled in his place.

translation.text: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

verses.english: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah ruled in his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת שַׂמְלָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו שָׁאוּל מֵרְחֹבוֹת הַנָּהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת שַׂמְלָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו שָׁאוּל מֵרְחֹבוֹת הַנָּהָר׃

english.text:
And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth on the river ruled
in his place.

translation.text: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth on the river ruled
in his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת שָׁאוּל וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו בַּעַל חָנָן בֶּן עַכְבּוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת שָׁאוּל וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו בַּעַל חָנָן בֶּן עַכְבּוֹר׃

english.text:
And Saul died, and Baal-hanan son of Achbor ruled in his
place.

translation.text: And Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
And Saul died, and Baal-hanan son of Achbor ruled in his
place.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת בַּעַל חָנָן בֶּן עַכְבּוֹר וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו הֲדַר וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ פָּעוּ וְשֵׁם אִשְׁתּוֹ מְהֵיטַבְאֵל בַּת מַטְרֵד בַּת מֵי זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת בַּעַל חָנָן בֶּן עַכְבּוֹר וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו הֲדַר וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ פָּעוּ וְשֵׁם אִשְׁתּוֹ מְהֵיטַבְאֵל בַּת מַטְרֵד בַּת מֵי זָהָב׃

english.text:
And Baal-hanan son of Achbor died, and Hadar ruled in his
place, and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s
name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred daughter of Mezahab.

translation.text: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

verses.english:
And Baal-hanan son of Achbor died, and Hadar ruled in his
place, and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s
name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred daughter of Mezahab.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת אַלּוּפֵי עֵשָׂו לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִמְקֹמֹתָם בִּשְׁמֹתָם אַלּוּף תִּמְנָע אַלּוּף עַלְוָה אַלּוּף יְתֵת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת אַלּוּפֵי עֵשָׂו לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִמְקֹמֹתָם בִּשְׁמֹתָם אַלּוּף תִּמְנָע אַלּוּף עַלְוָה אַלּוּף יְתֵת׃

english.text:
And these are the names of the chiefs of Esau by their
families, by their places, by their names: chief Timnah,
chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

translation.text: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,

verses.english:
And these are the names of the chiefs of Esau by their
families, by their places, by their names: chief Timnah,
chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

verses.hebrew: אַלּוּף אהֳלִיבָמָה אַלּוּף אֵלָה אַלּוּף פִּינֹן׃

hebrew.text: אַלּוּף אהֳלִיבָמָה אַלּוּף אֵלָה אַלּוּף פִּינֹן׃

english.text: chief Aholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

translation.text: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

verses.english: chief Aholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

verses.hebrew: אַלּוּף קְנַז אַלּוּף תֵּימָן אַלּוּף מִבְצָר׃

hebrew.text: אַלּוּף קְנַז אַלּוּף תֵּימָן אַלּוּף מִבְצָר׃

english.text: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

translation.text: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

verses.english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

verses.hebrew: אַלּוּף מַגְדִּיאֵל אַלּוּף עִירָם אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי אֱדוֹם לְמֹשְׁבֹתָם בְּאֶרֶץ אֲחֻזָּתָם הוּא עֵשָׂו אֲבִי אֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: אַלּוּף מַגְדִּיאֵל אַלּוּף עִירָם אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי אֱדוֹם לְמֹשְׁבֹתָם בְּאֶרֶץ אֲחֻזָּתָם הוּא עֵשָׂו אֲבִי אֱדוֹם׃

english.text:
chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom by
their homes in the land of their possession. That is Esau,
father of Edom.

translation.text: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.

verses.english:
chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom by
their homes in the land of their possession. That is Esau,
father of Edom.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב יַעֲקֹב בְּאֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב יַעֲקֹב בְּאֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
And Jacob lived in the land of his father’s residences, in
the land of Canaan.

translation.text: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.

verses.english:
And Jacob lived in the land of his father’s residences, in
the land of Canaan.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף בֶּן שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה הָיָה רֹעֶה אֶת אֶחָיו בַּצֹּאן וְהוּא נַעַר אֶת בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וְאֶת בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה נְשֵׁי אָבִיו וַיָּבֵא יוֹסֵף אֶת דִּבָּתָם רָעָה אֶל אֲבִיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף בֶּן שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה הָיָה רֹעֶה אֶת אֶחָיו בַּצֹּאן וְהוּא נַעַר אֶת בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וְאֶת בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה נְשֵׁי אָבִיו וַיָּבֵא יוֹסֵף אֶת דִּבָּתָם רָעָה אֶל אֲבִיהֶם׃

english.text:
These are the records of Jacob: Joseph, at seventeen years
old, had been tending the sheep with his brothers, and he
was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and the sons of Zilpah,
his father’s wives; and Joseph brought a bad report of
them to their father.

translation.text: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.

verses.english:
These are the records of Jacob: Joseph, at seventeen years
old, had been tending the sheep with his brothers, and he
was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and the sons of Zilpah,
his father’s wives; and Joseph brought a bad report of
them to their father.

verses.hebrew: וְיִשְׂרָאֵל אָהַב אֶת יוֹסֵף מִכּל בָּנָיו כִּי בֶן זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ וְעָשָׂה לוֹ כְּתֹנֶת פַּסִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְיִשְׂרָאֵל אָהַב אֶת יוֹסֵף מִכּל בָּנָיו כִּי בֶן זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ וְעָשָׂה לוֹ כְּתֹנֶת פַּסִּים׃

english.text:
And Israel had loved Joseph the most of all his children
because he was a son of old age to him. And he made him a
coat of many colors.

translation.text: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.

verses.english:
And Israel had loved Joseph the most of all his children
because he was a son of old age to him. And he made him a
coat of many colors.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ אֶחָיו כִּי אֹתוֹ אָהַב אֲבִיהֶם מִכּל אֶחָיו וַיִּשְׂנְאוּ אֹתוֹ וְלֹא יָכְלוּ דַּבְּרוֹ לְשָׁלֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ אֶחָיו כִּי אֹתוֹ אָהַב אֲבִיהֶם מִכּל אֶחָיו וַיִּשְׂנְאוּ אֹתוֹ וְלֹא יָכְלוּ דַּבְּרוֹ לְשָׁלֹם׃

english.text:
And his brothers saw that their father loved him the most
of all his brothers. And they hated him. And they were not
able to speak a greeting to him.

translation.text: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.

verses.english:
And his brothers saw that their father loved him the most
of all his brothers. And they hated him. And they were not
able to speak a greeting to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲלֹם יוֹסֵף חֲלוֹם וַיַּגֵּד לְאֶחָיו וַיּוֹסִפוּ עוֹד שְׂנֹא אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲלֹם יוֹסֵף חֲלוֹם וַיַּגֵּד לְאֶחָיו וַיּוֹסִפוּ עוֹד שְׂנֹא אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And Joseph had a dream and told it to his brothers, and
they went on to hate him more.

translation.text: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.

verses.english:
And Joseph had a dream and told it to his brothers, and
they went on to hate him more.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם שִׁמְעוּ נָא הַחֲלוֹם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר חָלָמְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם שִׁמְעוּ נָא הַחֲלוֹם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר חָלָמְתִּי׃

english.text: And he said to them, “Listen to this dream that I had:

translation.text: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:

verses.english: And he said to them, “Listen to this dream that I had:

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים בְּתוֹךְ הַשָּׂדֶה וְהִנֵּה קָמָה אֲלֻמָּתִי וְגַם נִצָּבָה וְהִנֵּה תְסֻבֶּינָה אֲלֻמֹּתֵיכֶם וַתִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶיןָ לַאֲלֻמָּתִי׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים בְּתוֹךְ הַשָּׂדֶה וְהִנֵּה קָמָה אֲלֻמָּתִי וְגַם נִצָּבָה וְהִנֵּה תְסֻבֶּינָה אֲלֻמֹּתֵיכֶם וַתִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶיןָ לַאֲלֻמָּתִי׃

english.text:
and here we were binding sheaves in the field; and here
was my sheaf rising and standing up, too; and, here, your
sheaves surrounded and bowed to my sheaf.”

translation.text: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.

verses.english:
and here we were binding sheaves in the field; and here
was my sheaf rising and standing up, too; and, here, your
sheaves surrounded and bowed to my sheaf.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אֶחָיו הֲמָלֹךְ תִּמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ אִם מָשׁוֹל תִּמְשֹׁל בָּנוּ וַיּוֹסִפוּ עוֹד שְׂנֹא אֹתוֹ עַל חֲלֹמֹתָיו וְעַל דְּבָרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אֶחָיו הֲמָלֹךְ תִּמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ אִם מָשׁוֹל תִּמְשֹׁל בָּנוּ וַיּוֹסִפוּ עוֹד שְׂנֹא אֹתוֹ עַל חֲלֹמֹתָיו וְעַל דְּבָרָיו׃

english.text:
And his brothers said to him, “Will you rule over us?!
Will you dominate us?!” And they went on to hate him more
because of his dreams and because of his words.

translation.text: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.

verses.english:
And his brothers said to him, “Will you rule over us?!
Will you dominate us?!” And they went on to hate him more
because of his dreams and because of his words.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲלֹם עוֹד חֲלוֹם אַחֵר וַיְסַפֵּר אֹתוֹ לְאֶחָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה חָלַמְתִּי חֲלוֹם עוֹד וְהִנֵּה הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְהַיָּרֵחַ וְאַחַד עָשָׂר כּוֹכָבִים מִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲלֹם עוֹד חֲלוֹם אַחֵר וַיְסַפֵּר אֹתוֹ לְאֶחָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה חָלַמְתִּי חֲלוֹם עוֹד וְהִנֵּה הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְהַיָּרֵחַ וְאַחַד עָשָׂר כּוֹכָבִים מִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לִי׃

english.text:
And he had yet another dream and told it to his brothers.
And he said, “Here, I’ve had another dream, and here were
the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowing to me.”

translation.text: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.

verses.english:
And he had yet another dream and told it to his brothers.
And he said, “Here, I’ve had another dream, and here were
the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowing to me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְסַפֵּר אֶל אָבִיו וְאֶל אֶחָיו וַיִּגְעַר בּוֹ אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מָה הַחֲלוֹם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר חָלָמְתָּ הֲבוֹא נָבוֹא אֲנִי וְאִמְּךָ וְאַחֶיךָ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לְךָ אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְסַפֵּר אֶל אָבִיו וְאֶל אֶחָיו וַיִּגְעַר בּוֹ אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מָה הַחֲלוֹם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר חָלָמְתָּ הֲבוֹא נָבוֹא אֲנִי וְאִמְּךָ וְאַחֶיךָ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לְךָ אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
And he told it to his father and to his brothers. And his
father was annoyed at him and said to him, “What is this
dream that you’ve had? Shall we come, I and your mother
and your brothers, to bow to you to the ground?!”

translation.text: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?

verses.english:
And he told it to his father and to his brothers. And his
father was annoyed at him and said to him, “What is this
dream that you’ve had? Shall we come, I and your mother
and your brothers, to bow to you to the ground?!”

verses.hebrew: וַיְקַנְאוּ בוֹ אֶחָיו וְאָבִיו שָׁמַר אֶת הַדָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְקַנְאוּ בוֹ אֶחָיו וְאָבִיו שָׁמַר אֶת הַדָּבָר׃

english.text:
And his brothers were jealous of him, and his father took
note of the thing.

translation.text: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.

verses.english:
And his brothers were jealous of him, and his father took
note of the thing.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶחָיו לִרְעוֹת אֶת צֹאן אֲבִיהֶם בִּשְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶחָיו לִרְעוֹת אֶת צֹאן אֲבִיהֶם בִּשְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
And his brothers went to feed their father’s sheep in
Shechem.

translation.text: And his brethren went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.

verses.english:
And his brothers went to feed their father’s sheep in
Shechem.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל יוֹסֵף הֲלוֹא אַחֶיךָ רֹעִים בִּשְׁכֶם לְכָה וְאֶשְׁלָחֲךָ אֲלֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הִנֵּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל יוֹסֵף הֲלוֹא אַחֶיךָ רֹעִים בִּשְׁכֶם לְכָה וְאֶשְׁלָחֲךָ אֲלֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הִנֵּנִי׃

english.text:
And Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding
in Shechem? Come on and I’ll send you to them.” And he
said to him, “I’m here.”

translation.text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.

verses.english:
And Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding
in Shechem? Come on and I’ll send you to them.” And he
said to him, “I’m here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֶךְ נָא רְאֵה אֶת שְׁלוֹם אַחֶיךָ וְאֶת שְׁלוֹם הַצֹּאן וַהֲשִׁבֵנִי דָּבָר וַיִּשְׁלָחֵהוּ מֵעֵמֶק חֶבְרוֹן וַיָּבֹא שְׁכֶמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֶךְ נָא רְאֵה אֶת שְׁלוֹם אַחֶיךָ וְאֶת שְׁלוֹם הַצֹּאן וַהֲשִׁבֵנִי דָּבָר וַיִּשְׁלָחֵהוּ מֵעֵמֶק חֶבְרוֹן וַיָּבֹא שְׁכֶמָה׃

english.text:
And he said to him, “Go, see how your brothers are and how
the sheep are and bring me back word.” And he sent him
from the valley of Hebron. And he came to Shechem.

translation.text: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

verses.english:
And he said to him, “Go, see how your brothers are and how
the sheep are and bring me back word.” And he sent him
from the valley of Hebron. And he came to Shechem.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצָאֵהוּ אִישׁ וְהִנֵּה תֹעֶה בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיִּשְׁאָלֵהוּ הָאִישׁ לֵאמֹר מַה תְּבַקֵּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְצָאֵהוּ אִישׁ וְהִנֵּה תֹעֶה בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיִּשְׁאָלֵהוּ הָאִישׁ לֵאמֹר מַה תְּבַקֵּשׁ׃

english.text:
And a man found him, and here he was straying in a field.
And the man asked him, saying, “What are you looking for?”

translation.text: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?

verses.english:
And a man found him, and here he was straying in a field.
And the man asked him, saying, “What are you looking for?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶת אַחַי אָנֹכִי מְבַקֵּשׁ הַגִּידָה נָּא לִי אֵיפֹה הֵם רֹעִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶת אַחַי אָנֹכִי מְבַקֵּשׁ הַגִּידָה נָּא לִי אֵיפֹה הֵם רֹעִים׃

english.text:
And he said, “I’m looking for my brothers. Tell me, where
are they feeding?”

translation.text: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.

verses.english:
And he said, “I’m looking for my brothers. Tell me, where
are they feeding?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ נָסְעוּ מִזֶּה כִּי שָׁמַעְתִּי אֹמְרִים נֵלְכָה דֹּתָיְנָה וַיֵּלֶךְ יוֹסֵף אַחַר אֶחָיו וַיִּמְצָאֵם בְּדֹתָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ נָסְעוּ מִזֶּה כִּי שָׁמַעְתִּי אֹמְרִים נֵלְכָה דֹּתָיְנָה וַיֵּלֶךְ יוֹסֵף אַחַר אֶחָיו וַיִּמְצָאֵם בְּדֹתָן׃

english.text:
And the man said, “They traveled on from here. Because I
heard them saying, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” And Joseph went
after his brothers and found them in Dothan.

translation.text: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.

verses.english:
And the man said, “They traveled on from here. Because I
heard them saying, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” And Joseph went
after his brothers and found them in Dothan.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ אֹתוֹ מֵרָחֹק וּבְטֶרֶם יִקְרַב אֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּתְנַכְּלוּ אֹתוֹ לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ אֹתוֹ מֵרָחֹק וּבְטֶרֶם יִקְרַב אֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּתְנַכְּלוּ אֹתוֹ לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃

english.text:
And they saw him from a distance, and before he came close
to them they conspired against him: to kill him.

translation.text: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.

verses.english:
And they saw him from a distance, and before he came close
to them they conspired against him: to kill him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו הִנֵּה בַּעַל הַחֲלֹמוֹת הַלָּזֶה בָּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו הִנֵּה בַּעַל הַחֲלֹמוֹת הַלָּזֶה בָּא׃

english.text:
And the brothers said to one another, “Here comes the
dream-master, that one there!

translation.text: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.

verses.english:
And the brothers said to one another, “Here comes the
dream-master, that one there!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לְכוּ וְנַהַרְגֵהוּ וְנַשְׁלִכֵהוּ בְּאַחַד הַבֹּרוֹת וְאָמַרְנוּ חַיָּה רָעָה אֲכָלָתְהוּ וְנִרְאֶה מַה יִּהְיוּ חֲלֹמֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לְכוּ וְנַהַרְגֵהוּ וְנַשְׁלִכֵהוּ בְּאַחַד הַבֹּרוֹת וְאָמַרְנוּ חַיָּה רָעָה אֲכָלָתְהוּ וְנִרְאֶה מַה יִּהְיוּ חֲלֹמֹתָיו׃

english.text:
And now, come on and let’s kill him and throw him in one
of the pits, and we’ll say a wild animal ate him, and
we’ll see what his dreams will be!”

translation.text: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.

verses.english:
And now, come on and let’s kill him and throw him in one
of the pits, and we’ll say a wild animal ate him, and
we’ll see what his dreams will be!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע רְאוּבֵן וַיַּצִּלֵהוּ מִיָּדָם וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא נַכֶּנּוּ נָפֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע רְאוּבֵן וַיַּצִּלֵהוּ מִיָּדָם וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא נַכֶּנּוּ נָפֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And Reuben heard, and he saved him from their hand. And he
said, “Let’s not take his life.”

translation.text: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.

verses.english:
And Reuben heard, and he saved him from their hand. And he
said, “Let’s not take his life.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם רְאוּבֵן אַל תִּשְׁפְּכוּ דָם הַשְׁלִיכוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל הַבּוֹר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בַּמִּדְבָּר וְיָד אַל תִּשְׁלְחוּ בוֹ לְמַעַן הַצִּיל אֹתוֹ מִיָּדָם לַהֲשִׁיבוֹ אֶל אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם רְאוּבֵן אַל תִּשְׁפְּכוּ דָם הַשְׁלִיכוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל הַבּוֹר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בַּמִּדְבָּר וְיָד אַל תִּשְׁלְחוּ בוֹ לְמַעַן הַצִּיל אֹתוֹ מִיָּדָם לַהֲשִׁיבוֹ אֶל אָבִיו׃

english.text:
And Reuben said to them, “Don’t spill blood. Throw him
into this pit that’s in the wilderness, and don’t put out
a hand against him”—in order to save him from their hand,
to bring him back to his father.

translation.text: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.

verses.english:
And Reuben said to them, “Don’t spill blood. Throw him
into this pit that’s in the wilderness, and don’t put out
a hand against him”—in order to save him from their hand,
to bring him back to his father.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּא יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו וַיַּפְשִׁיטוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף אֶת כֻּתּנְתּוֹ אֶת כְּתֹנֶת הַפַּסִּים אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּא יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו וַיַּפְשִׁיטוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף אֶת כֻּתּנְתּוֹ אֶת כְּתֹנֶת הַפַּסִּים אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו׃

english.text:
And it was when Joseph came to his brothers: and they took
off Joseph’s coat, the coat of many colors, which he had
on.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;

verses.english:
And it was when Joseph came to his brothers: and they took
off Joseph’s coat, the coat of many colors, which he had
on.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּחֻהוּ וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ אֹתוֹ הַבֹּרָה וְהַבּוֹר רֵק אֵין בּוֹ מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּחֻהוּ וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ אֹתוֹ הַבֹּרָה וְהַבּוֹר רֵק אֵין בּוֹ מָיִם׃

english.text:
And they took him and threw him into the pit. And the pit
was empty; there was no water in it.

translation.text: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.

verses.english:
And they took him and threw him into the pit. And the pit
was empty; there was no water in it.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ לֶאֱכל לֶחֶם וַיִּשְׂאוּ עֵינֵיהֶם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה אֹרְחַת יִשְׁמְעֵאלִים בָּאָה מִגִּלְעָד וּגְמַלֵּיהֶם נֹשְׂאִים נְכֹאת וּצְרִי וָלֹט הוֹלְכִים לְהוֹרִיד מִצְרָיְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ לֶאֱכל לֶחֶם וַיִּשְׂאוּ עֵינֵיהֶם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה אֹרְחַת יִשְׁמְעֵאלִים בָּאָה מִגִּלְעָד וּגְמַלֵּיהֶם נֹשְׂאִים נְכֹאת וּצְרִי וָלֹט הוֹלְכִים לְהוֹרִיד מִצְרָיְמָה׃

english.text:
And they sat down to eat bread. And they raised their eyes
and saw, and here was a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from
Gilead, and their camels were carrying spices and balsam
and myrrh, going to bring them down to Egypt.

translation.text: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

verses.english:
And they sat down to eat bread. And they raised their eyes
and saw, and here was a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from
Gilead, and their camels were carrying spices and balsam
and myrrh, going to bring them down to Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה אֶל אֶחָיו מַה בֶּצַע כִּי נַהֲרֹג אֶת אָחִינוּ וְכִסִּינוּ אֶת דָּמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה אֶל אֶחָיו מַה בֶּצַע כִּי נַהֲרֹג אֶת אָחִינוּ וְכִסִּינוּ אֶת דָּמוֹ׃

english.text:
And Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is there if
we kill our brother and cover his blood?

translation.text: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?

verses.english:
And Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is there if
we kill our brother and cover his blood?

verses.hebrew: לְכוּ וְנִמְכְּרֶנּוּ לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים וְיָדֵנוּ אַל תְּהִי בוֹ כִּי אָחִינוּ בְשָׂרֵנוּ הוּא וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶחָיו׃

hebrew.text: לְכוּ וְנִמְכְּרֶנּוּ לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים וְיָדֵנוּ אַל תְּהִי בוֹ כִּי אָחִינוּ בְשָׂרֵנוּ הוּא וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶחָיו׃

english.text:
Come on and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let our
hand not be on him, because he’s our brother, our flesh.”
And his brothers listened.

translation.text: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.

verses.english:
Come on and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let our
hand not be on him, because he’s our brother, our flesh.”
And his brothers listened.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֲנָשִׁים מִדְיָנִים סֹחֲרִים וַיִּמְשְׁכוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף מִן הַבּוֹר וַיִּמְכְּרוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים בְּעֶשְׂרִים כָּסֶף וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף מִצְרָיְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֲנָשִׁים מִדְיָנִים סֹחֲרִים וַיִּמְשְׁכוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף מִן הַבּוֹר וַיִּמְכְּרוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים בְּעֶשְׂרִים כָּסֶף וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף מִצְרָיְמָה׃

english.text:
And Midianite people, merchants, passed, and they pulled
and lifted Joseph from the pit. And they sold Joseph to
the Ishmaelites for twenty weights of silver. And they
brought Joseph to Egypt.

translation.text: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.

verses.english:
And Midianite people, merchants, passed, and they pulled
and lifted Joseph from the pit. And they sold Joseph to
the Ishmaelites for twenty weights of silver. And they
brought Joseph to Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב רְאוּבֵן אֶל הַבּוֹר וְהִנֵּה אֵין יוֹסֵף בַּבּוֹר וַיִּקְרַע אֶת בְּגָדָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב רְאוּבֵן אֶל הַבּוֹר וְהִנֵּה אֵין יוֹסֵף בַּבּוֹר וַיִּקְרַע אֶת בְּגָדָיו׃

english.text:
And Reuben came back to the pit, and here: Joseph was not
in the pit. And he tore his clothes.

translation.text: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.

verses.english:
And Reuben came back to the pit, and here: Joseph was not
in the pit. And he tore his clothes.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב אֶל אֶחָיו וַיֹּאמַר הַיֶּלֶד אֵינֶנּוּ וַאֲנִי אָנָה אֲנִי בָא׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב אֶל אֶחָיו וַיֹּאמַר הַיֶּלֶד אֵינֶנּוּ וַאֲנִי אָנָה אֲנִי בָא׃

english.text:
And he went back to his brothers and said, “The boy’s
gone! And I, where can I go?”

translation.text: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?

verses.english:
And he went back to his brothers and said, “The boy’s
gone! And I, where can I go?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת כְּתֹנֶת יוֹסֵף וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים וַיִּטְבְּלוּ אֶת הַכֻּתֹּנֶת בַּדָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת כְּתֹנֶת יוֹסֵף וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים וַיִּטְבְּלוּ אֶת הַכֻּתֹּנֶת בַּדָּם׃

english.text:
And they took Joseph’s coat and slaughtered a he-goat and
dipped the coat in the blood.

translation.text: And they took Joseph’s coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;

verses.english:
And they took Joseph’s coat and slaughtered a he-goat and
dipped the coat in the blood.

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ אֶת כְּתֹנֶת הַפַּסִּים וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶל אֲבִיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ זֹאת מָצָאנוּ הַכֶּר נָא הַכְּתֹנֶת בִּנְךָ הִוא אִם לֹא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ אֶת כְּתֹנֶת הַפַּסִּים וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶל אֲבִיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ זֹאת מָצָאנוּ הַכֶּר נָא הַכְּתֹנֶת בִּנְךָ הִוא אִם לֹא׃

english.text:
And they sent the coat of many colors and brought it to
their father and said, “We found this. Recognize: is it
your son’s coat or not?”

translation.text: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son’s coat or no.

verses.english:
And they sent the coat of many colors and brought it to
their father and said, “We found this. Recognize: is it
your son’s coat or not?”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכִּירָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר כְּתֹנֶת בְּנִי חַיָּה רָעָה אֲכָלָתְהוּ טָרֹף טֹרַף יוֹסֵף׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכִּירָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר כְּתֹנֶת בְּנִי חַיָּה רָעָה אֲכָלָתְהוּ טָרֹף טֹרַף יוֹסֵף׃

english.text:
And he recognized it and said, “My son’s coat. A wild
animal ate him. Joseph is torn up!”

translation.text: And he knew it, and said, It is my son’s coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.

verses.english:
And he recognized it and said, “My son’s coat. A wild
animal ate him. Joseph is torn up!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרַע יַעֲקֹב שִׂמְלֹתָיו וַיָּשֶׂם שַׂק בְּמתְנָיו וַיִּתְאַבֵּל עַל בְּנוֹ יָמִים רַבִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרַע יַעֲקֹב שִׂמְלֹתָיו וַיָּשֶׂם שַׂק בְּמתְנָיו וַיִּתְאַבֵּל עַל בְּנוֹ יָמִים רַבִּים׃

english.text:
And Jacob ripped his clothes and wore sackcloth on his
hips and mourned over his son many days.

translation.text: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

verses.english:
And Jacob ripped his clothes and wore sackcloth on his
hips and mourned over his son many days.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ כל בָּנָיו וְכל בְּנֹתָיו לְנַחֲמוֹ וַיְמָאֵן לְהִתְנַחֵם וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי אֵרֵד אֶל בְּנִי אָבֵל שְׁאֹלָה וַיֵּבְךְּ אֹתוֹ אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֻמוּ כל בָּנָיו וְכל בְּנֹתָיו לְנַחֲמוֹ וַיְמָאֵן לְהִתְנַחֵם וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי אֵרֵד אֶל בְּנִי אָבֵל שְׁאֹלָה וַיֵּבְךְּ אֹתוֹ אָבִיו׃

english.text:
And all his sons and all his daughters got up to console
him, and he refused to be consoled, and he said, “Because
I’ll go down mourning to my son at Sheol,” and his father
wept for him.

translation.text: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.

verses.english:
And all his sons and all his daughters got up to console
him, and he refused to be consoled, and he said, “Because
I’ll go down mourning to my son at Sheol,” and his father
wept for him.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמְּדָנִים מָכְרוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל מִצְרָיִם לְפוֹטִיפַר סְרִיס פַּרְעֹה שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמְּדָנִים מָכְרוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל מִצְרָיִם לְפוֹטִיפַר סְרִיס פַּרְעֹה שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים׃

english.text:
And the Medanites sold him to Egypt, to Potiphar, an
official of Pharaoh, chief of the guards.

translation.text: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, and captain of the guard.

verses.english:
And the Medanites sold him to Egypt, to Potiphar, an
official of Pharaoh, chief of the guards.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בָּעֵת הַהִוא וַיֵּרֶד יְהוּדָה מֵאֵת אֶחָיו וַיֵּט עַד אִישׁ עֲדֻלָּמִי וּשְׁמוֹ חִירָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בָּעֵת הַהִוא וַיֵּרֶד יְהוּדָה מֵאֵת אֶחָיו וַיֵּט עַד אִישׁ עֲדֻלָּמִי וּשְׁמוֹ חִירָה׃

english.text:
And it was at that time, and Judah went down from
his brothers and turned to an Adullamite man, and his name
was Hirah.

translation.text: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

verses.english:
And it was at that time, and Judah went down from
his brothers and turned to an Adullamite man, and his name
was Hirah.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא שָׁם יְהוּדָה בַּת אִישׁ כְּנַעֲנִי וּשְׁמוֹ שׁוּעַ וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא שָׁם יְהוּדָה בַּת אִישׁ כְּנַעֲנִי וּשְׁמוֹ שׁוּעַ וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And Judah saw a daughter of a Canaanite man there, and his
name was Shua. And he took her and came to her.

translation.text: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.

verses.english:
And Judah saw a daughter of a Canaanite man there, and his
name was Shua. And he took her and came to her.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ עֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ עֵר׃

english.text:
And she became pregnant and gave birth to a son, and he
called his name Er.

translation.text: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.

verses.english:
And she became pregnant and gave birth to a son, and he
called his name Er.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ אוֹנָן׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ אוֹנָן׃

english.text:
And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son, and
she called his name Onan.

translation.text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.

verses.english:
And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son, and
she called his name Onan.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּסֶף עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ שֵׁלָה וְהָיָה בִכְזִיב בְּלִדְתָּהּ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּסֶף עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ שֵׁלָה וְהָיָה בִכְזִיב בְּלִדְתָּהּ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And she proceeded again to give birth to a son, and she
called his name Shelah. (And he was at Chezib when she
gave birth to him.)

translation.text: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.

verses.english:
And she proceeded again to give birth to a son, and she
called his name Shelah. (And he was at Chezib when she
gave birth to him.)

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יְהוּדָה אִשָּׁה לְעֵר בְּכוֹרוֹ וּשְׁמָהּ תָּמָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח יְהוּדָה אִשָּׁה לְעֵר בְּכוֹרוֹ וּשְׁמָהּ תָּמָר׃

english.text:
And Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name
was Tamar.

translation.text: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.

verses.english:
And Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name
was Tamar.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עֵר בְּכוֹר יְהוּדָה רַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְמִתֵהוּ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי עֵר בְּכוֹר יְהוּדָה רַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְמִתֵהוּ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Er, Judah’s firstborn, was bad in YHWH’s eyes, and
YHWH killed him.

translation.text: And Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD slew him.

verses.english:
And Er, Judah’s firstborn, was bad in YHWH’s eyes, and
YHWH killed him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה לְאוֹנָן בֹּא אֶל אֵשֶׁת אָחִיךָ וְיַבֵּם אֹתָהּ וְהָקֵם זֶרַע לְאָחִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה לְאוֹנָן בֹּא אֶל אֵשֶׁת אָחִיךָ וְיַבֵּם אֹתָהּ וְהָקֵם זֶרַע לְאָחִיךָ׃

english.text:
And Judah said to Onan, “Come to your brother’s wife and
couple as a brother-in-law with her and raise seed for
your brother.”

translation.text: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother’s wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.

verses.english:
And Judah said to Onan, “Come to your brother’s wife and
couple as a brother-in-law with her and raise seed for
your brother.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּדַע אוֹנָן כִּי לֹּא לוֹ יִהְיֶה הַזָּרַע וְהָיָה אִם בָּא אֶל אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו וְשִׁחֵת אַרְצָה לְבִלְתִּי נְתן זֶרַע לְאָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּדַע אוֹנָן כִּי לֹּא לוֹ יִהְיֶה הַזָּרַע וְהָיָה אִם בָּא אֶל אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו וְשִׁחֵת אַרְצָה לְבִלְתִּי נְתן זֶרַע לְאָחִיו׃

english.text:
And Onan knew that the seed would not be his. And it was
when he came to his brother’s wife: and he spent on the
ground so as not to give seed for his brother.

translation.text: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother’s wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.

verses.english:
And Onan knew that the seed would not be his. And it was
when he came to his brother’s wife: and he spent on the
ground so as not to give seed for his brother.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וַיָּמֶת גַּם אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וַיָּמֶת גַּם אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And what he did was bad in YHWH’s eyes, and He killed him,
too.

translation.text: And the thing which he did displeased the LORD: wherefore he slew him also.

verses.english:
And what he did was bad in YHWH’s eyes, and He killed him,
too.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה לְתָמָר כַּלָּתוֹ שְׁבִי אַלְמָנָה בֵית אָבִיךְ עַד יִגְדַּל שֵׁלָה בְנִי כִּי אָמַר פֶּן יָמוּת גַּם הוּא כְּאֶחָיו וַתֵּלֶךְ תָּמָר וַתֵּשֶׁב בֵּית אָבִיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה לְתָמָר כַּלָּתוֹ שְׁבִי אַלְמָנָה בֵית אָבִיךְ עַד יִגְדַּל שֵׁלָה בְנִי כִּי אָמַר פֶּן יָמוּת גַּם הוּא כְּאֶחָיו וַתֵּלֶךְ תָּמָר וַתֵּשֶׁב בֵּית אָבִיהָ׃

english.text:
And Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Live as a
widow at your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up”
(because he said, “Or else he, too, will die like his
brothers”). And Tamar went and lived at her father’s
house.

translation.text: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father’s house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house.

verses.english:
And Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Live as a
widow at your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up”
(because he said, “Or else he, too, will die like his
brothers”). And Tamar went and lived at her father’s
house.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְבּוּ הַיָּמִים וַתָּמת בַּת שׁוּעַ אֵשֶׁת יְהוּדָה וַיִּנָּחֶם יְהוּדָה וַיַּעַל עַל גֹּזְזֵי צֹאנוֹ הוּא וְחִירָה רֵעֵהוּ הָעֲדֻלָּמִי תִּמְנָתָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְבּוּ הַיָּמִים וַתָּמת בַּת שׁוּעַ אֵשֶׁת יְהוּדָה וַיִּנָּחֶם יְהוּדָה וַיַּעַל עַל גֹּזְזֵי צֹאנוֹ הוּא וְחִירָה רֵעֵהוּ הָעֲדֻלָּמִי תִּמְנָתָה׃

english.text:
And the days were many, and Judah’s wife, the daughter of
Shua, died. And Judah was consoled. And he went up to his
sheepshearers, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite, to
Timnah.

translation.text: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah’s wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

verses.english:
And the days were many, and Judah’s wife, the daughter of
Shua, died. And Judah was consoled. And he went up to his
sheepshearers, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite, to
Timnah.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְתָמָר לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה חָמִיךְ עֹלֶה תִמְנָתָה לָגֹז צֹאנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לְתָמָר לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה חָמִיךְ עֹלֶה תִמְנָתָה לָגֹז צֹאנוֹ׃

english.text:
And it was told to Tamar, saying, “Here, your
father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”

translation.text: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.

verses.english:
And it was told to Tamar, saying, “Here, your
father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”

verses.hebrew: וַתָּסַר בִּגְדֵי אַלְמְנוּתָהּ מֵעָלֶיהָ וַתְּכַס בַּצָּעִיף וַתִּתְעַלָּף וַתֵּשֶׁב בְּפֶתַח עֵינַיִם אֲשֶׁר עַל דֶּרֶךְ תִּמְנָתָה כִּי רָאֲתָה כִּי גָדַל שֵׁלָה וְהִוא לֹא נִתְּנָה לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃
