hebrew.text: וַתָּסַר בִּגְדֵי אַלְמְנוּתָהּ מֵעָלֶיהָ וַתְּכַס בַּצָּעִיף וַתִּתְעַלָּף וַתֵּשֶׁב בְּפֶתַח עֵינַיִם אֲשֶׁר עַל דֶּרֶךְ תִּמְנָתָה כִּי רָאֲתָה כִּי גָדַל שֵׁלָה וְהִוא לֹא נִתְּנָה לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
And she took off her widowhood clothes from on her and
covered herself with a veil and wrapped herself and sat in
a visible place that was on the road to Timnah, because
she saw that Shelah had grown up and she had not been
given to him as a wife.

translation.text: And she put her widow’s garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.

verses.english:
And she took off her widowhood clothes from on her and
covered herself with a veil and wrapped herself and sat in
a visible place that was on the road to Timnah, because
she saw that Shelah had grown up and she had not been
given to him as a wife.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאֶהָ יְהוּדָה וַיַּחְשְׁבֶהָ לְזוֹנָה כִּי כִסְּתָה פָּנֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאֶהָ יְהוּדָה וַיַּחְשְׁבֶהָ לְזוֹנָה כִּי כִסְּתָה פָּנֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And Judah saw her and thought her to be a prostitute
because she had covered her face.

translation.text: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.

verses.english:
And Judah saw her and thought her to be a prostitute
because she had covered her face.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּט אֵלֶיהָ אֶל הַדֶּרֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הָבָה נָּא אָבוֹא אֵלַיִךְ כִּי לֹא יָדַע כִּי כַלָּתוֹ הִוא וַתֹּאמֶר מַה תִּתֶּן לִי כִּי תָבוֹא אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּט אֵלֶיהָ אֶל הַדֶּרֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הָבָה נָּא אָבוֹא אֵלַיִךְ כִּי לֹא יָדַע כִּי כַלָּתוֹ הִוא וַתֹּאמֶר מַה תִּתֶּן לִי כִּי תָבוֹא אֵלָי׃

english.text:
And he turned to her by the road. And he said, “Come on.
Let me come to you,” because he did not know that she was
his daughter-in-law. And she said, “What will you give me
when you come to me?”

translation.text: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?

verses.english:
And he turned to her by the road. And he said, “Come on.
Let me come to you,” because he did not know that she was
his daughter-in-law. And she said, “What will you give me
when you come to me?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי אֲשַׁלַּח גְּדִי עִזִּים מִן הַצֹּאן וַתֹּאמֶר אִם תִּתֵּן עֵרָבוֹן עַד שׁלְחֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי אֲשַׁלַּח גְּדִי עִזִּים מִן הַצֹּאן וַתֹּאמֶר אִם תִּתֵּן עֵרָבוֹן עַד שׁלְחֶךָ׃

english.text:
And he said, “I’ll have a goat kid sent from the flock.”
And she said, “If you’ll give a pledge until you send it.”

translation.text: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?

verses.english:
And he said, “I’ll have a goat kid sent from the flock.”
And she said, “If you’ll give a pledge until you send it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הָעֵרָבוֹן אֲשֶׁר אֶתֶּן לָךְ וַתֹּאמֶר חֹתָמְךָ וּפְתִילֶךָ וּמַטְּךָ אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדֶךָ וַיִּתֶּן לָהּ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וַתַּהַר לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הָעֵרָבוֹן אֲשֶׁר אֶתֶּן לָךְ וַתֹּאמֶר חֹתָמְךָ וּפְתִילֶךָ וּמַטְּךָ אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדֶךָ וַיִּתֶּן לָהּ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וַתַּהַר לוֹ׃

english.text:
And he said, “What is the pledge that I’ll give you?” And
she said, “Your seal and your cord and your staff that’s
in your hand.” And he gave them to her, and he came to
her, and she became pregnant by him.

translation.text: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.

verses.english:
And he said, “What is the pledge that I’ll give you?” And
she said, “Your seal and your cord and your staff that’s
in your hand.” And he gave them to her, and he came to
her, and she became pregnant by him.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּקם וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתָּסַר צְעִיפָהּ מֵעָלֶיהָ וַתִּלְבַּשׁ בִּגְדֵי אַלְמְנוּתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּקם וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתָּסַר צְעִיפָהּ מֵעָלֶיהָ וַתִּלְבַּשׁ בִּגְדֵי אַלְמְנוּתָהּ׃

english.text:
And she got up and went and took off her veil from on her
and put on her widowhood clothes.

translation.text: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

verses.english:
And she got up and went and took off her veil from on her
and put on her widowhood clothes.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוּדָה אֶת גְּדִי הָעִזִּים בְּיַד רֵעֵהוּ הָעֲדֻלָּמִי לָקַחַת הָעֵרָבוֹן מִיַּד הָאִשָּׁה וְלֹא מְצָאָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוּדָה אֶת גְּדִי הָעִזִּים בְּיַד רֵעֵהוּ הָעֲדֻלָּמִי לָקַחַת הָעֵרָבוֹן מִיַּד הָאִשָּׁה וְלֹא מְצָאָהּ׃

english.text:
And Judah sent the goat kid by the hand of his friend the
Adullamite to take back the pledge from the woman’s hand,
and he did not find her.

translation.text: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman’s hand: but he found her not.

verses.english:
And Judah sent the goat kid by the hand of his friend the
Adullamite to take back the pledge from the woman’s hand,
and he did not find her.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל אֶת אַנְשֵׁי מְקֹמָהּ לֵאמֹר אַיֵּה הַקְּדֵשָׁה הִוא בָעֵינַיִם עַל הַדָּרֶךְ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא הָיְתָה בָזֶה קְדֵשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל אֶת אַנְשֵׁי מְקֹמָהּ לֵאמֹר אַיֵּה הַקְּדֵשָׁה הִוא בָעֵינַיִם עַל הַדָּרֶךְ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא הָיְתָה בָזֶה קְדֵשָׁה׃

english.text:
And he asked the people of her place, saying, “Where is
the sacred prostitute? She was visibly by the road.” And
they said, “There was no sacred prostitute here.”

translation.text: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place.

verses.english:
And he asked the people of her place, saying, “Where is
the sacred prostitute? She was visibly by the road.” And
they said, “There was no sacred prostitute here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב אֶל יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא מְצָאתִיהָ וְגַם אַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם אָמְרוּ לֹא הָיְתָה בָזֶה קְדֵשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב אֶל יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא מְצָאתִיהָ וְגַם אַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם אָמְרוּ לֹא הָיְתָה בָזֶה קְדֵשָׁה׃

english.text:
And he came back to Judah and said, “I didn’t find her,
and also the people of the place said There was no sacred
prostitute here.’”

translation.text: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.

verses.english:
And he came back to Judah and said, “I didn’t find her,
and also the people of the place said There was no sacred
prostitute here.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה תִּקַּח לָהּ פֶּן נִהְיֶה לָבוּז הִנֵּה שָׁלַחְתִּי הַגְּדִי הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה לֹא מְצָאתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה תִּקַּח לָהּ פֶּן נִהְיֶה לָבוּז הִנֵּה שָׁלַחְתִּי הַגְּדִי הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה לֹא מְצָאתָהּ׃

english.text:
And Judah said, “Let her take them or else we’ll be a
disgrace. Here, I’ve sent this goat kid, and you didn’t
find her.”

translation.text: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.

verses.english:
And Judah said, “Let her take them or else we’ll be a
disgrace. Here, I’ve sent this goat kid, and you didn’t
find her.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּמִשְׁלֹשׁ חֳדָשִׁים וַיֻּגַּד לִיהוּדָה לֵאמֹר זָנְתָה תָּמָר כַּלָּתֶךָ וְגַם הִנֵּה הָרָה לִזְנוּנִים וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה הוֹצִיאוּהָ וְתִשָּׂרֵף׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּמִשְׁלֹשׁ חֳדָשִׁים וַיֻּגַּד לִיהוּדָה לֵאמֹר זָנְתָה תָּמָר כַּלָּתֶךָ וְגַם הִנֵּה הָרָה לִזְנוּנִים וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה הוֹצִיאוּהָ וְתִשָּׂרֵף׃

english.text:
And it was about three months, and it was told to Judah,
saying, “Your daughter-in-law Tamar has whored, and, here,
she’s pregnant by whoring as well.” And Judah said, “Bring
her out and let her be burned.”

translation.text: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.

verses.english:
And it was about three months, and it was told to Judah,
saying, “Your daughter-in-law Tamar has whored, and, here,
she’s pregnant by whoring as well.” And Judah said, “Bring
her out and let her be burned.”

verses.hebrew: הִוא מוּצֵאת וְהִיא שָׁלְחָה אֶל חָמִיהָ לֵאמֹר לְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אֵלֶּה לּוֹ אָנֹכִי הָרָה וַתֹּאמֶר הַכֶּר נָא לְמִי הַחֹתֶמֶת וְהַפְּתִילִים וְהַמַּטֶּה הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: הִוא מוּצֵאת וְהִיא שָׁלְחָה אֶל חָמִיהָ לֵאמֹר לְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אֵלֶּה לּוֹ אָנֹכִי הָרָה וַתֹּאמֶר הַכֶּר נָא לְמִי הַחֹתֶמֶת וְהַפְּתִילִים וְהַמַּטֶּה הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
She was brought out. And she sent to her father-in-law,
saying, “I’m pregnant by the man to whom these belong,”
and she said, “Recognize: to whom do these seal and cords
and staff belong?”

translation.text: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.

verses.english:
She was brought out. And she sent to her father-in-law,
saying, “I’m pregnant by the man to whom these belong,”
and she said, “Recognize: to whom do these seal and cords
and staff belong?”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּר יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר צָדְקָה מִמֶּנִּי כִּי עַל כֵּן לֹא נְתַתִּיהָ לְשֵׁלָה בְנִי וְלֹא יָסַף עוֹד לְדַעְתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכֵּר יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר צָדְקָה מִמֶּנִּי כִּי עַל כֵּן לֹא נְתַתִּיהָ לְשֵׁלָה בְנִי וְלֹא יָסַף עוֹד לְדַעְתָּהּ׃

english.text:
And Judah recognized and said, “She’s more right than I
am, because of the fact that I didn’t give her to my son
Shelah.” And he did not go on to know her again.

translation.text: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

verses.english:
And Judah recognized and said, “She’s more right than I
am, because of the fact that I didn’t give her to my son
Shelah.” And he did not go on to know her again.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּעֵת לִדְתָּהּ וְהִנֵּה תְאוֹמִים בְּבִטְנָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּעֵת לִדְתָּהּ וְהִנֵּה תְאוֹמִים בְּבִטְנָהּ׃

english.text:
And it was at the time that she was giving birth, and here
were twins in her womb.

translation.text: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.

verses.english:
And it was at the time that she was giving birth, and here
were twins in her womb.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְלִדְתָּהּ וַיִּתֶּן יָד וַתִּקַּח הַמְיַלֶּדֶת וַתִּקְשֹׁר עַל יָדוֹ שָׁנִי לֵאמֹר זֶה יָצָא רִאשֹׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְלִדְתָּהּ וַיִּתֶּן יָד וַתִּקַּח הַמְיַלֶּדֶת וַתִּקְשֹׁר עַל יָדוֹ שָׁנִי לֵאמֹר זֶה יָצָא רִאשֹׁנָה׃

english.text:
And it was as she was giving birth, and one put out his
hand, and the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it on
his hand, saying, “This one came out first.”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.

verses.english:
And it was as she was giving birth, and one put out his
hand, and the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it on
his hand, saying, “This one came out first.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּמֵשִׁיב יָדוֹ וְהִנֵּה יָצָא אָחִיו וַתֹּאמֶר מַה פָּרַצְתָּ עָלֶיךָ פָּרֶץ וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ פָּרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּמֵשִׁיב יָדוֹ וְהִנֵּה יָצָא אָחִיו וַתֹּאמֶר מַה פָּרַצְתָּ עָלֶיךָ פָּרֶץ וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ פָּרֶץ׃

english.text:
And it was as he pulled his hand back, and here his
brother came out. And she said, “What a breach you’ve made
for yourself!” And he called his name Perez.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.

verses.english:
And it was as he pulled his hand back, and here his
brother came out. And she said, “What a breach you’ve made
for yourself!” And he called his name Perez.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר יָצָא אָחִיו אֲשֶׁר עַל יָדוֹ הַשָּׁנִי וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ זָרַח׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחַר יָצָא אָחִיו אֲשֶׁר עַל יָדוֹ הַשָּׁנִי וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ זָרַח׃

english.text:
And his brother who had the scarlet thread on his hand
came out after. And he called his name Zerah.

translation.text: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.

verses.english:
And his brother who had the scarlet thread on his hand
came out after. And he called his name Zerah.

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹסֵף הוּרַד מִצְרָיְמָה וַיִּקְנֵהוּ פּוֹטִיפַר סְרִיס פַּרְעֹה שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אִישׁ מִצְרִי מִיַּד הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִדֻהוּ שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹסֵף הוּרַד מִצְרָיְמָה וַיִּקְנֵהוּ פּוֹטִיפַר סְרִיס פַּרְעֹה שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אִישׁ מִצְרִי מִיַּד הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִדֻהוּ שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And Joseph had been brought down to Egypt. And an
Egyptian man, Potiphar, an official of Pharaoh, chief of
the guards, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites
who had brought him down there.

translation.text: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.

verses.english:
And Joseph had been brought down to Egypt. And an
Egyptian man, Potiphar, an official of Pharaoh, chief of
the guards, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites
who had brought him down there.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יְהֹוָה אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיְהִי אִישׁ מַצְלִיחַ וַיְהִי בְּבֵית אֲדֹנָיו הַמִּצְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי יְהֹוָה אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיְהִי אִישׁ מַצְלִיחַ וַיְהִי בְּבֵית אֲדֹנָיו הַמִּצְרִי׃

english.text:
And YHWH was with Joseph, and he was a successful man, and
he was in his Egyptian lord’s house.

translation.text: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

verses.english:
And YHWH was with Joseph, and he was a successful man, and
he was in his Egyptian lord’s house.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֲדֹנָיו כִּי יְהֹוָה אִתּוֹ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר הוּא עֹשֶׂה יְהֹוָה מַצְלִיחַ בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אֲדֹנָיו כִּי יְהֹוָה אִתּוֹ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר הוּא עֹשֶׂה יְהֹוָה מַצְלִיחַ בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
And his lord saw that YHWH was with him, and YHWH made
everything he was doing successful in his hand.

translation.text: And his master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand.

verses.english:
And his lord saw that YHWH was with him, and YHWH made
everything he was doing successful in his hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצָא יוֹסֵף חֵן בְּעֵינָיו וַיְשָׁרֶת אֹתוֹ וַיַּפְקִדֵהוּ עַל בֵּיתוֹ וְכל יֶשׁ לוֹ נָתַן בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְצָא יוֹסֵף חֵן בְּעֵינָיו וַיְשָׁרֶת אֹתוֹ וַיַּפְקִדֵהוּ עַל בֵּיתוֹ וְכל יֶשׁ לוֹ נָתַן בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
And Joseph found favor in his eyes, and he attended him,
and he appointed him over his house and put everything he
had in his hand.

translation.text: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

verses.english:
And Joseph found favor in his eyes, and he attended him,
and he appointed him over his house and put everything he
had in his hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מֵאָז הִפְקִיד אֹתוֹ בְּבֵיתוֹ וְעַל כּל אֲשֶׁר יֶשׁ לוֹ וַיְבָרֶךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת בֵּית הַמִּצְרִי בִּגְלַל יוֹסֵף וַיְהִי בִּרְכַּת יְהֹוָה בְּכל אֲשֶׁר יֶשׁ לוֹ בַּבַּיִת וּבַשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מֵאָז הִפְקִיד אֹתוֹ בְּבֵיתוֹ וְעַל כּל אֲשֶׁר יֶשׁ לוֹ וַיְבָרֶךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת בֵּית הַמִּצְרִי בִּגְלַל יוֹסֵף וַיְהִי בִּרְכַּת יְהֹוָה בְּכל אֲשֶׁר יֶשׁ לוֹ בַּבַּיִת וּבַשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
And it was from the time that he appointed him in his
house and over all that he had that YHWH blessed the
Egyptian’s house because of Joseph, and YHWH’s blessing
was in everything that he had, in the house and in the
field.

translation.text: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.

verses.english:
And it was from the time that he appointed him in his
house and over all that he had that YHWH blessed the
Egyptian’s house because of Joseph, and YHWH’s blessing
was in everything that he had, in the house and in the
field.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲזֹב כּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ בְּיַד יוֹסֵף וְלֹא יָדַע אִתּוֹ מְאוּמָה כִּי אִם הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר הוּא אוֹכֵל וַיְהִי יוֹסֵף יְפֵה תֹאַר וִיפֵה מַרְאֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲזֹב כּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ בְּיַד יוֹסֵף וְלֹא יָדַע אִתּוֹ מְאוּמָה כִּי אִם הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר הוּא אוֹכֵל וַיְהִי יוֹסֵף יְפֵה תֹאַר וִיפֵה מַרְאֶה׃

english.text:
And he left everything that he had in Joseph’s hand and
did not know a thing about what he had except the bread
that he was eating. And Joseph had an attractive figure
and was handsome.

translation.text: And he left all that he had in Joseph’s hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person, and well favoured.

verses.english:
And he left everything that he had in Joseph’s hand and
did not know a thing about what he had except the bread
that he was eating. And Joseph had an attractive figure
and was handsome.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַתִּשָּׂא אֵשֶׁת אֲדֹנָיו אֶת עֵינֶיהָ אֶל יוֹסֵף וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁכְבָה עִמִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַתִּשָּׂא אֵשֶׁת אֲדֹנָיו אֶת עֵינֶיהָ אֶל יוֹסֵף וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁכְבָה עִמִּי׃

english.text:
And it was after these things, and his lord’s wife raised
her eyes to Joseph and said, “Lie with me.”

translation.text: And it came to pass after these things, that his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.

verses.english:
And it was after these things, and his lord’s wife raised
her eyes to Joseph and said, “Lie with me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְמָאֵן וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל אֵשֶׁת אֲדֹנָיו הֵן אֲדֹנִי לֹא יָדַע אִתִּי מַה בַּבָּיִת וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יֶשׁ לוֹ נָתַן בְּיָדִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמָאֵן וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל אֵשֶׁת אֲדֹנָיו הֵן אֲדֹנִי לֹא יָדַע אִתִּי מַה בַּבָּיִת וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יֶשׁ לוֹ נָתַן בְּיָדִי׃

english.text:
And he refused, and he said to his lord’s wife, “Here, my
lord doesn’t know what he has with me in the house, and
he’s put everything that he has in my hand.

translation.text: But he refused, and said unto his master’s wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;

verses.english:
And he refused, and he said to his lord’s wife, “Here, my
lord doesn’t know what he has with me in the house, and
he’s put everything that he has in my hand.

verses.hebrew: אֵינֶנּוּ גָדוֹל בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה מִמֶּנִּי וְלֹא חָשַׂךְ מִמֶּנִּי מְאוּמָה כִּי אִם אוֹתָךְ בַּאֲשֶׁר אַתְּ אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֵיךְ אֶעֱשֶׂה הָרָעָה הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת וְחָטָאתִי לֵאלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: אֵינֶנּוּ גָדוֹל בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה מִמֶּנִּי וְלֹא חָשַׂךְ מִמֶּנִּי מְאוּמָה כִּי אִם אוֹתָךְ בַּאֲשֶׁר אַתְּ אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֵיךְ אֶעֱשֶׂה הָרָעָה הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת וְחָטָאתִי לֵאלֹהִים׃

english.text:
No one is bigger than I am in this house, and he hasn’t
held back a thing from me except you because you’re his
wife, and how could I do this great wrong? And I would sin
against God.”

translation.text: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

verses.english:
No one is bigger than I am in this house, and he hasn’t
held back a thing from me except you because you’re his
wife, and how could I do this great wrong? And I would sin
against God.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּדַבְּרָהּ אֶל יוֹסֵף יוֹם יוֹם וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֵלֶיהָ לִשְׁכַּב אֶצְלָהּ לִהְיוֹת עִמָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּדַבְּרָהּ אֶל יוֹסֵף יוֹם יוֹם וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֵלֶיהָ לִשְׁכַּב אֶצְלָהּ לִהְיוֹת עִמָּהּ׃

english.text:
And it was, when she spoke to Joseph day after day, that
he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, to be with her.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

verses.english:
And it was, when she spoke to Joseph day after day, that
he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, to be with her.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיָּבֹא הַבַּיְתָה לַעֲשׂוֹת מְלַאכְתּוֹ וְאֵין אִישׁ מֵאַנְשֵׁי הַבַּיִת שָׁם בַּבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיָּבֹא הַבַּיְתָה לַעֲשׂוֹת מְלַאכְתּוֹ וְאֵין אִישׁ מֵאַנְשֵׁי הַבַּיִת שָׁם בַּבָּיִת׃

english.text:
And it was on a day like this, and he came to the house to
do his work, and not one of the people of the house was
there in the house.

translation.text: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.

verses.english:
And it was on a day like this, and he came to the house to
do his work, and not one of the people of the house was
there in the house.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂהוּ בְּבִגְדוֹ לֵאמֹר שִׁכְבָה עִמִּי וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ בְּיָדָהּ וַיָּנס וַיֵּצֵא הַחוּצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂהוּ בְּבִגְדוֹ לֵאמֹר שִׁכְבָה עִמִּי וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ בְּיָדָהּ וַיָּנס וַיֵּצֵא הַחוּצָה׃

english.text:
And she grasped him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!”
And he left his garment in her hand and fled and went
outside.

translation.text: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.

verses.english:
And she grasped him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!”
And he left his garment in her hand and fled and went
outside.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹתָהּ כִּי עָזַב בִּגְדוֹ בְּיָדָהּ וַיָּנס הַחוּצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹתָהּ כִּי עָזַב בִּגְדוֹ בְּיָדָהּ וַיָּנס הַחוּצָה׃

english.text:
And it was, when she saw that he had left his garment in
her hand and run off outside,

translation.text: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,

verses.english:
And it was, when she saw that he had left his garment in
her hand and run off outside,

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרָא לְאַנְשֵׁי בֵיתָהּ וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לֵאמֹר רְאוּ הֵבִיא לָנוּ אִישׁ עִבְרִי לְצַחֶק בָּנוּ בָּא אֵלַי לִשְׁכַּב עִמִּי וָאֶקְרָא בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקְרָא לְאַנְשֵׁי בֵיתָהּ וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לֵאמֹר רְאוּ הֵבִיא לָנוּ אִישׁ עִבְרִי לְצַחֶק בָּנוּ בָּא אֵלַי לִשְׁכַּב עִמִּי וָאֶקְרָא בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל׃

english.text:
that she called to the people of her house and said to
them, saying, “See, he brought us a Hebrew man to fool
with us. He came to me, to lie with me, and I called in a
loud voice.

translation.text: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:

verses.english:
that she called to the people of her house and said to
them, saying, “See, he brought us a Hebrew man to fool
with us. He came to me, to lie with me, and I called in a
loud voice.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְשׁמְעוֹ כִּי הֲרִימֹתִי קוֹלִי וָאֶקְרָא וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ אֶצְלִי וַיָּנס וַיֵּצֵא הַחוּצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְשׁמְעוֹ כִּי הֲרִימֹתִי קוֹלִי וָאֶקְרָא וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ אֶצְלִי וַיָּנס וַיֵּצֵא הַחוּצָה׃

english.text:
And it was when he heard that I raised my voice and called
that he left his garment by me and fled and went outside.”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.

verses.english:
And it was when he heard that I raised my voice and called
that he left his garment by me and fled and went outside.”

verses.hebrew: וַתַּנַּח בִּגְדוֹ אֶצְלָהּ עַד בּוֹא אֲדֹנָיו אֶל בֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּנַּח בִּגְדוֹ אֶצְלָהּ עַד בּוֹא אֲדֹנָיו אֶל בֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
And she laid his garment down by her until his lord came
to his house.

translation.text: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.

verses.english:
And she laid his garment down by her until his lord came
to his house.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלָיו כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לֵאמֹר בָּא אֵלַי הָעֶבֶד הָעִבְרִי אֲשֶׁר הֵבֵאתָ לָּנוּ לְצַחֶק בִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלָיו כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לֵאמֹר בָּא אֵלַי הָעֶבֶד הָעִבְרִי אֲשֶׁר הֵבֵאתָ לָּנוּ לְצַחֶק בִּי׃

english.text:
And she spoke things like these to him, saying, “The
Hebrew slave, whom you brought us, came to me, to fool
with me.

translation.text: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:

verses.english:
And she spoke things like these to him, saying, “The
Hebrew slave, whom you brought us, came to me, to fool
with me.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּהֲרִימִי קוֹלִי וָאֶקְרָא וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ אֶצְלִי וַיָּנס הַחוּצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּהֲרִימִי קוֹלִי וָאֶקְרָא וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ אֶצְלִי וַיָּנס הַחוּצָה׃

english.text:
And it was when I raised my voice and called that he left
his garment by me and fled outside.”

translation.text: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.

verses.english:
And it was when I raised my voice and called that he left
his garment by me and fled outside.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ אֲדֹנָיו אֶת דִּבְרֵי אִשְׁתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה עָשָׂה לִי עַבְדֶּךָ וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ אֲדֹנָיו אֶת דִּבְרֵי אִשְׁתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה עָשָׂה לִי עַבְדֶּךָ וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ׃

english.text:
And it was, when his lord heard his wife’s words that she
spoke to him, saying, “Your servant did things like these
to me,” that his anger flared.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.

verses.english:
And it was, when his lord heard his wife’s words that she
spoke to him, saying, “Your servant did things like these
to me,” that his anger flared.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֲדֹנֵי יוֹסֵף אֹתוֹ וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ אֶל בֵּית הַסֹּהַר מְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר [אֲסִירֵי] (אסורי) הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲסוּרִים וַיְהִי שָׁם בְּבֵית הַסֹּהַר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֲדֹנֵי יוֹסֵף אֹתוֹ וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ אֶל בֵּית הַסֹּהַר מְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר [אֲסִירֵי] (אסורי) הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲסוּרִים וַיְהִי שָׁם בְּבֵית הַסֹּהַר׃

english.text:
And Joseph’s lord took him and put him in prison, a place
where the king’s prisoners were kept. And he was there in
the prison,

translation.text: And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king’s prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.

verses.english:
And Joseph’s lord took him and put him in prison, a place
where the king’s prisoners were kept. And he was there in
the prison,

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יְהֹוָה אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיֵּט אֵלָיו חָסֶד וַיִּתֵּן חִנּוֹ בְּעֵינֵי שַׂר בֵּית הַסֹּהַר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי יְהֹוָה אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיֵּט אֵלָיו חָסֶד וַיִּתֵּן חִנּוֹ בְּעֵינֵי שַׂר בֵּית הַסֹּהַר׃

english.text:
and YHWH was with Joseph and extended kindness to him and
gave him favor in the eyes of the warden.

translation.text: But the LORD was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

verses.english:
and YHWH was with Joseph and extended kindness to him and
gave him favor in the eyes of the warden.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן שַׂר בֵּית הַסֹּהַר בְּיַד יוֹסֵף אֵת כּל הָאֲסִירִם אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית הַסֹּהַר וְאֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר עֹשִׂים שָׁם הוּא הָיָה עֹשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן שַׂר בֵּית הַסֹּהַר בְּיַד יוֹסֵף אֵת כּל הָאֲסִירִם אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית הַסֹּהַר וְאֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר עֹשִׂים שָׁם הוּא הָיָה עֹשֶׂה׃

english.text:
And the warden put all the prisoners who were in the
prison into Joseph’s hand, and he was doing all the things
that they do there.

translation.text: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.

verses.english:
And the warden put all the prisoners who were in the
prison into Joseph’s hand, and he was doing all the things
that they do there.

verses.hebrew: אֵין שַׂר בֵּית הַסֹּהַר רֹאֶה אֶת כּל מְאוּמָה בְּיָדוֹ בַּאֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אִתּוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר הוּא עֹשֶׂה יְהֹוָה מַצְלִיחַ׃

hebrew.text: אֵין שַׂר בֵּית הַסֹּהַר רֹאֶה אֶת כּל מְאוּמָה בְּיָדוֹ בַּאֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אִתּוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר הוּא עֹשֶׂה יְהֹוָה מַצְלִיחַ׃

english.text:
The warden was not seeing anything in his hand because
YHWH was with him, and YHWH would make whatever he did
successful.

translation.text: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand; because the LORD was with him, and that which he did, the LORD made it to prosper.

verses.english:
The warden was not seeing anything in his hand because
YHWH was with him, and YHWH would make whatever he did
successful.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה חָטְאוּ מַשְׁקֵה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם וְהָאֹפֶה לַאֲדֹנֵיהֶם לְמֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה חָטְאוּ מַשְׁקֵה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם וְהָאֹפֶה לַאֲדֹנֵיהֶם לְמֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And it was, after these things, the drink-steward of
the king of Egypt and the baker sinned against their lord,
against the king of Egypt.

translation.text: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.

verses.english:
And it was, after these things, the drink-steward of
the king of Egypt and the baker sinned against their lord,
against the king of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְצֹף פַּרְעֹה עַל שְׁנֵי סָרִיסָיו עַל שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים וְעַל שַׂר הָאוֹפִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְצֹף פַּרְעֹה עַל שְׁנֵי סָרִיסָיו עַל שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים וְעַל שַׂר הָאוֹפִים׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh was angry at his two officers, at the chief of
the drink-stewards and at the chief of the bakers,

translation.text: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh was angry at his two officers, at the chief of
the drink-stewards and at the chief of the bakers,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָם בְּמִשְׁמַר בֵּית שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אֶל בֵּית הַסֹּהַר מְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יוֹסֵף אָסוּר שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָם בְּמִשְׁמַר בֵּית שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אֶל בֵּית הַסֹּהַר מְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יוֹסֵף אָסוּר שָׁם׃

english.text:
and he put them under watch at the house of the chief of
the guards, into prison, the place where Joseph was held.

translation.text: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

verses.english:
and he put them under watch at the house of the chief of
the guards, into prison, the place where Joseph was held.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקֹד שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אֶת יוֹסֵף אִתָּם וַיְשָׁרֶת אֹתָם וַיִּהְיוּ יָמִים בְּמִשְׁמָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְקֹד שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אֶת יוֹסֵף אִתָּם וַיְשָׁרֶת אֹתָם וַיִּהְיוּ יָמִים בְּמִשְׁמָר׃

english.text:
And the chief of the guards assigned Joseph with them, and
he attended them. And they were under watch for days.

translation.text: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.

verses.english:
And the chief of the guards assigned Joseph with them, and
he attended them. And they were under watch for days.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחַלְמוּ חֲלוֹם שְׁנֵיהֶם אִישׁ חֲלֹמוֹ בְּלַיְלָה אֶחָד אִישׁ כְּפִתְרוֹן חֲלֹמוֹ הַמַּשְׁקֶה וְהָאֹפֶה אֲשֶׁר לְמֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר אֲסוּרִים בְּבֵית הַסֹּהַר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחַלְמוּ חֲלוֹם שְׁנֵיהֶם אִישׁ חֲלֹמוֹ בְּלַיְלָה אֶחָד אִישׁ כְּפִתְרוֹן חֲלֹמוֹ הַמַּשְׁקֶה וְהָאֹפֶה אֲשֶׁר לְמֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר אֲסוּרִים בְּבֵית הַסֹּהַר׃

english.text:
And the two of them had a dream, each his own dream, in
one night, each with his own dream’s meaning, the
drink-steward and the baker whom the king of Egypt had,
who were held in the prison.

translation.text: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.

verses.english:
And the two of them had a dream, each his own dream, in
one night, each with his own dream’s meaning, the
drink-steward and the baker whom the king of Egypt had,
who were held in the prison.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֲלֵיהֶם יוֹסֵף בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּרְא אֹתָם וְהִנָּם זֹעֲפִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֲלֵיהֶם יוֹסֵף בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּרְא אֹתָם וְהִנָּם זֹעֲפִים׃

english.text:
And Joseph came to them in the morning and saw them, and
here they were upset.

translation.text: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.

verses.english:
And Joseph came to them in the morning and saw them, and
here they were upset.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל אֶת סְרִיסֵי פַרְעֹה אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בְמִשְׁמַר בֵּית אֲדֹנָיו לֵאמֹר מַדּוּעַ פְּנֵיכֶם רָעִים הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל אֶת סְרִיסֵי פַרְעֹה אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בְמִשְׁמַר בֵּית אֲדֹנָיו לֵאמֹר מַדּוּעַ פְּנֵיכֶם רָעִים הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And he asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him under
watch at his lord’s house, saying, “Why are your faces bad
today?”

translation.text: And he asked Pharaoh’s officers that were with him in the ward of his lord’s house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?

verses.english:
And he asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him under
watch at his lord’s house, saying, “Why are your faces bad
today?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו חֲלוֹם חָלַמְנוּ וּפֹתֵר אֵין אֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יוֹסֵף הֲלוֹא לֵאלֹהִים פִּתְרֹנִים סַפְּרוּ נָא לִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו חֲלוֹם חָלַמְנוּ וּפֹתֵר אֵין אֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יוֹסֵף הֲלוֹא לֵאלֹהִים פִּתְרֹנִים סַפְּרוּ נָא לִי׃

english.text:
And they said to him, “We had a dream, and there’s no one
who can tell the meaning of it.” And Joseph said to them,
“Don’t meanings belong to God? Tell me.”

translation.text: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them, I pray you.

verses.english:
And they said to him, “We had a dream, and there’s no one
who can tell the meaning of it.” And Joseph said to them,
“Don’t meanings belong to God? Tell me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְסַפֵּר שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים אֶת חֲלֹמוֹ לְיוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בַּחֲלוֹמִי וְהִנֵּה גֶפֶן לְפָנָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְסַפֵּר שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים אֶת חֲלֹמוֹ לְיוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בַּחֲלוֹמִי וְהִנֵּה גֶפֶן לְפָנָי׃

english.text:
And the chief of the drink-stewards told his dream to
Joseph, and he said to him, “In my dream: And here was a
vine in front of me,

translation.text: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;

verses.english:
And the chief of the drink-stewards told his dream to
Joseph, and he said to him, “In my dream: And here was a
vine in front of me,

verses.hebrew: וּבַגֶּפֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה שָׂרִיגִם וְהִוא כְפֹרַחַת עָלְתָה נִצָּהּ הִבְשִׁילוּ אַשְׁכְּלֹתֶיהָ עֲנָבִים׃

hebrew.text: וּבַגֶּפֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה שָׂרִיגִם וְהִוא כְפֹרַחַת עָלְתָה נִצָּהּ הִבְשִׁילוּ אַשְׁכְּלֹתֶיהָ עֲנָבִים׃

english.text:
and in the vine were three branches, and it was like it
was blooming: its blossom came up; its clusters produced
grapes.

translation.text: And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:

verses.english:
and in the vine were three branches, and it was like it
was blooming: its blossom came up; its clusters produced
grapes.

verses.hebrew: וְכוֹס פַּרְעֹה בְּיָדִי וָאֶקַּח אֶת הָעֲנָבִים וָאֶשְׂחַט אֹתָם אֶל כּוֹס פַּרְעֹה וָאֶתֵּן אֶת הַכּוֹס עַל כַּף פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וְכוֹס פַּרְעֹה בְּיָדִי וָאֶקַּח אֶת הָעֲנָבִים וָאֶשְׂחַט אֹתָם אֶל כּוֹס פַּרְעֹה וָאֶתֵּן אֶת הַכּוֹס עַל כַּף פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand. And I took the grapes
and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup and set the cup on
Pharaoh’s hand.”

translation.text: And Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand. And I took the grapes
and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup and set the cup on
Pharaoh’s hand.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יוֹסֵף זֶה פִּתְרֹנוֹ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַשָּׂרִגִים שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים הֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יוֹסֵף זֶה פִּתְרֹנוֹ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַשָּׂרִגִים שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים הֵם׃

english.text:
And Joseph said to him, “This is its meaning: The three
branches, they’re three days.

translation.text: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:

verses.english:
And Joseph said to him, “This is its meaning: The three
branches, they’re three days.

verses.hebrew: בְּעוֹד שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים יִשָּׂא פַרְעֹה אֶת רֹאשֶׁךָ וַהֲשִׁיבְךָ עַל כַּנֶּךָ וְנָתַתָּ כוֹס פַּרְעֹה בְּיָדוֹ כַּמִּשְׁפָּט הָרִאשׁוֹן אֲשֶׁר הָיִיתָ מַשְׁקֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: בְּעוֹד שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים יִשָּׂא פַרְעֹה אֶת רֹאשֶׁךָ וַהֲשִׁיבְךָ עַל כַּנֶּךָ וְנָתַתָּ כוֹס פַּרְעֹה בְּיָדוֹ כַּמִּשְׁפָּט הָרִאשׁוֹן אֲשֶׁר הָיִיתָ מַשְׁקֵהוּ׃

english.text:
In three more days Pharaoh will lift your head up, and
he’ll put you back at your station, and you’ll set
Pharaoh’s cup in his hand—like the original manner when
you were his drink-steward.

translation.text: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.

verses.english:
In three more days Pharaoh will lift your head up, and
he’ll put you back at your station, and you’ll set
Pharaoh’s cup in his hand—like the original manner when
you were his drink-steward.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם זְכַרְתַּנִי אִתְּךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִיטַב לָךְ וְעָשִׂיתָ נָּא עִמָּדִי חָסֶד וְהִזְכַּרְתַּנִי אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְהוֹצֵאתַנִי מִן הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם זְכַרְתַּנִי אִתְּךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִיטַב לָךְ וְעָשִׂיתָ נָּא עִמָּדִי חָסֶד וְהִזְכַּרְתַּנִי אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְהוֹצֵאתַנִי מִן הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
So if you’ll remember me with you when it will be good for
you, and you’ll practice kindness with me, then you’ll
bring up the memory of me to Pharaoh, and you’ll bring me
out of this house.

translation.text: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:

verses.english:
So if you’ll remember me with you when it will be good for
you, and you’ll practice kindness with me, then you’ll
bring up the memory of me to Pharaoh, and you’ll bring me
out of this house.

verses.hebrew: כִּי גֻנֹּב גֻּנַּבְתִּי מֵאֶרֶץ הָעִבְרִים וְגַם פֹּה לֹא עָשִׂיתִי מְאוּמָה כִּי שָׂמוּ אֹתִי בַּבּוֹר׃

hebrew.text: כִּי גֻנֹּב גֻּנַּבְתִּי מֵאֶרֶץ הָעִבְרִים וְגַם פֹּה לֹא עָשִׂיתִי מְאוּמָה כִּי שָׂמוּ אֹתִי בַּבּוֹר׃

english.text:
Because I was stolen from the land of the Hebrews; and
here, too, I haven’t done anything that they should have
put me in the pit.”

translation.text: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.

verses.english:
Because I was stolen from the land of the Hebrews; and
here, too, I haven’t done anything that they should have
put me in the pit.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא שַׂר הָאֹפִים כִּי טוֹב פָּתָר וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל יוֹסֵף אַף אֲנִי בַּחֲלוֹמִי וְהִנֵּה שְׁלֹשָׁה סַלֵּי חֹרִי עַל רֹאשִׁי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא שַׂר הָאֹפִים כִּי טוֹב פָּתָר וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל יוֹסֵף אַף אֲנִי בַּחֲלוֹמִי וְהִנֵּה שְׁלֹשָׁה סַלֵּי חֹרִי עַל רֹאשִׁי׃

english.text:
And the chief of the bakers saw that he told a good
meaning, and he said to Joseph, “Me, too. In my dream: And
here were three baskets of white bread on my head,

translation.text: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:

verses.english:
And the chief of the bakers saw that he told a good
meaning, and he said to Joseph, “Me, too. In my dream: And
here were three baskets of white bread on my head,

verses.hebrew: וּבַסַּל הָעֶלְיוֹן מִכֹּל מַאֲכַל פַּרְעֹה מַעֲשֵׂה אֹפֶה וְהָעוֹף אֹכֵל אֹתָם מִן הַסַּל מֵעַל רֹאשִׁי׃

hebrew.text: וּבַסַּל הָעֶלְיוֹן מִכֹּל מַאֲכַל פַּרְעֹה מַעֲשֵׂה אֹפֶה וְהָעוֹף אֹכֵל אֹתָם מִן הַסַּל מֵעַל רֹאשִׁי׃

english.text:
and in the highest basket were some of all of Pharaoh’s
foods, baked goods. And the birds were eating them from
the basket, from on my head.”

translation.text: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.

verses.english:
and in the highest basket were some of all of Pharaoh’s
foods, baked goods. And the birds were eating them from
the basket, from on my head.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמֶר זֶה פִּתְרֹנוֹ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַסַּלִּים שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים הֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן יוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמֶר זֶה פִּתְרֹנוֹ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַסַּלִּים שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים הֵם׃

english.text:
And Joseph answered, and he said, “This is its meaning:
The three baskets, they’re three days.

translation.text: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:

verses.english:
And Joseph answered, and he said, “This is its meaning:
The three baskets, they’re three days.

verses.hebrew: בְּעוֹד שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים יִשָּׂא פַרְעֹה אֶת רֹאשְׁךָ מֵעָלֶיךָ וְתָלָה אוֹתְךָ עַל עֵץ וְאָכַל הָעוֹף אֶת בְּשָׂרְךָ מֵעָלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: בְּעוֹד שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים יִשָּׂא פַרְעֹה אֶת רֹאשְׁךָ מֵעָלֶיךָ וְתָלָה אוֹתְךָ עַל עֵץ וְאָכַל הָעוֹף אֶת בְּשָׂרְךָ מֵעָלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
In three more days Pharaoh will lift your head up from
you, and he’ll hang you on a tree, and the birds will eat
your flesh from you.”

translation.text: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.

verses.english:
In three more days Pharaoh will lift your head up from
you, and he’ll hang you on a tree, and the birds will eat
your flesh from you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי יוֹם הֻלֶּדֶת אֶת פַּרְעֹה וַיַּעַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּה לְכל עֲבָדָיו וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת רֹאשׁ שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים וְאֶת רֹאשׁ שַׂר הָאֹפִים בְּתוֹךְ עֲבָדָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי יוֹם הֻלֶּדֶת אֶת פַּרְעֹה וַיַּעַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּה לְכל עֲבָדָיו וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת רֹאשׁ שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים וְאֶת רֹאשׁ שַׂר הָאֹפִים בְּתוֹךְ עֲבָדָיו׃

english.text:
And it was in the third day, Pharaoh’s birthday, and
Pharaoh made a feast for all his servants. And he held up
the head of the chief of the drink-stewards and the head
of the chief of the bakers among his servants.

translation.text: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.

verses.english:
And it was in the third day, Pharaoh’s birthday, and
Pharaoh made a feast for all his servants. And he held up
the head of the chief of the drink-stewards and the head
of the chief of the bakers among his servants.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים עַל מַשְׁקֵהוּ וַיִּתֵּן הַכּוֹס עַל כַּף פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים עַל מַשְׁקֵהוּ וַיִּתֵּן הַכּוֹס עַל כַּף פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And he put the chief of the drink-stewards back over his
stewardship, and he set the cup on Pharaoh’s hand;

translation.text: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand:

verses.english:
And he put the chief of the drink-stewards back over his
stewardship, and he set the cup on Pharaoh’s hand;

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שַׂר הָאֹפִים תָּלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר פָּתַר לָהֶם יוֹסֵף׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שַׂר הָאֹפִים תָּלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר פָּתַר לָהֶם יוֹסֵף׃

english.text:
and he hanged the chief of the bakers—as Joseph had told
the meaning for them.

translation.text: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.

verses.english:
and he hanged the chief of the bakers—as Joseph had told
the meaning for them.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא זָכַר שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיִּשְׁכָּחֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא זָכַר שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיִּשְׁכָּחֵהוּ׃

english.text:
And the chief of the drink-stewards did not remember
Joseph. And he forgot him.

translation.text: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.

verses.english:
And the chief of the drink-stewards did not remember
Joseph. And he forgot him.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ שְׁנָתַיִם יָמִים וּפַרְעֹה חֹלֵם וְהִנֵּה עֹמֵד עַל הַיְאֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ שְׁנָתַיִם יָמִים וּפַרְעֹה חֹלֵם וְהִנֵּה עֹמֵד עַל הַיְאֹר׃

english.text:
And it was at the end of two years’time, and Pharaoh was
dreaming: and here he was standing by the Nile.

translation.text: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.

verses.english:
And it was at the end of two years’time, and Pharaoh was
dreaming: and here he was standing by the Nile.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה מִן הַיְאֹר עֹלֹת שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת יְפוֹת מַרְאֶה וּבְרִיאֹת בָּשָׂר וַתִּרְעֶינָה בָּאָחוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה מִן הַיְאֹר עֹלֹת שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת יְפוֹת מַרְאֶה וּבְרִיאֹת בָּשָׂר וַתִּרְעֶינָה בָּאָחוּ׃

english.text:
And here, coming up from the Nile, were seven cows,
beautiful-looking and fat-fleshed, and they fed in the
reeds.

translation.text: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.

verses.english:
And here, coming up from the Nile, were seven cows,
beautiful-looking and fat-fleshed, and they fed in the
reeds.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת אֲחֵרוֹת עֹלוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן מִן הַיְאֹר רָעוֹת מַרְאֶה וְדַקּוֹת בָּשָׂר וַתַּעֲמֹדְנָה אֵצֶל הַפָּרוֹת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת אֲחֵרוֹת עֹלוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן מִן הַיְאֹר רָעוֹת מַרְאֶה וְדַקּוֹת בָּשָׂר וַתַּעֲמֹדְנָה אֵצֶל הַפָּרוֹת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר׃

english.text:
And here were seven other cows coming up after them from
the Nile, bad-looking and thin-fleshed, and they stood by
the cows that were by the bank of the Nile.

translation.text: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.

verses.english:
And here were seven other cows coming up after them from
the Nile, bad-looking and thin-fleshed, and they stood by
the cows that were by the bank of the Nile.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאכַלְנָה הַפָּרוֹת רָעוֹת הַמַּרְאֶה וְדַקֹּת הַבָּשָׂר אֵת שֶׁבַע הַפָּרוֹת יְפֹת הַמַּרְאֶה וְהַבְּרִיאֹת וַיִּיקַץ פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאכַלְנָה הַפָּרוֹת רָעוֹת הַמַּרְאֶה וְדַקֹּת הַבָּשָׂר אֵת שֶׁבַע הַפָּרוֹת יְפֹת הַמַּרְאֶה וְהַבְּרִיאֹת וַיִּיקַץ פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And the bad-looking and thin-fleshed cows ate the seven
beautiful-looking and fat cows—and Pharaoh woke up.

translation.text: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.

verses.english:
And the bad-looking and thin-fleshed cows ate the seven
beautiful-looking and fat cows—and Pharaoh woke up.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּישָׁן וַיַּחֲלֹם שֵׁנִית וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים עֹלוֹת בְּקָנֶה אֶחָד בְּרִיאוֹת וְטֹבוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּישָׁן וַיַּחֲלֹם שֵׁנִית וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים עֹלוֹת בְּקָנֶה אֶחָד בְּרִיאוֹת וְטֹבוֹת׃

english.text:
And he slept and dreamed a second time, and here were
seven ears of grain coming up on one stalk, fat and good.

translation.text: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.

verses.english:
And he slept and dreamed a second time, and here were
seven ears of grain coming up on one stalk, fat and good.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים דַּקּוֹת וּשְׁדוּפֹת קָדִים צֹמְחוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים דַּקּוֹת וּשְׁדוּפֹת קָדִים צֹמְחוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
And here were seven ears of grain, thin and scorched by
the east wind, growing after them.

translation.text: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.

verses.english:
And here were seven ears of grain, thin and scorched by
the east wind, growing after them.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּבְלַעְנָה הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַדַּקּוֹת אֵת שֶׁבַע הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַבְּרִיאוֹת וְהַמְּלֵאוֹת וַיִּיקַץ פַּרְעֹה וְהִנֵּה חֲלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּבְלַעְנָה הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַדַּקּוֹת אֵת שֶׁבַע הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַבְּרִיאוֹת וְהַמְּלֵאוֹת וַיִּיקַץ פַּרְעֹה וְהִנֵּה חֲלוֹם׃

english.text:
And the thin ears of grain swallowed the seven fat and
full ears of grain—and Pharaoh woke up, and here it was a
dream.

translation.text: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.

verses.english:
And the thin ears of grain swallowed the seven fat and
full ears of grain—and Pharaoh woke up, and here it was a
dream.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַתִּפָּעֶם רוּחוֹ וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיִּקְרָא אֶת כּל חַרְטֻמֵּי מִצְרַיִם וְאֶת כּל חֲכָמֶיהָ וַיְסַפֵּר פַּרְעֹה לָהֶם אֶת חֲלֹמוֹ וְאֵין פּוֹתֵר אוֹתָם לְפַרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַתִּפָּעֶם רוּחוֹ וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיִּקְרָא אֶת כּל חַרְטֻמֵּי מִצְרַיִם וְאֶת כּל חֲכָמֶיהָ וַיְסַפֵּר פַּרְעֹה לָהֶם אֶת חֲלֹמוֹ וְאֵין פּוֹתֵר אוֹתָם לְפַרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And it was in the morning, and his spirit was moved, and
he sent and called all of Egypt’s magicians and all its
wise men. And Pharaoh told them his dream, and there was
no one who could tell the meaning of them to Pharaoh.

translation.text: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.

verses.english:
And it was in the morning, and his spirit was moved, and
he sent and called all of Egypt’s magicians and all its
wise men. And Pharaoh told them his dream, and there was
no one who could tell the meaning of them to Pharaoh.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים אֶת פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר אֶת חֲטָאַי אֲנִי מַזְכִּיר הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים אֶת פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר אֶת חֲטָאַי אֲנִי מַזְכִּיר הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And the chief of the drink-stewards spoke to Pharaoh,
saying, “I’m recalling my sins today:

translation.text: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:

verses.english:
And the chief of the drink-stewards spoke to Pharaoh,
saying, “I’m recalling my sins today:

verses.hebrew: פַּרְעֹה קָצַף עַל עֲבָדָיו וַיִּתֵּן אֹתִי בְּמִשְׁמַר בֵּית שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אֹתִי וְאֵת שַׂר הָאֹפִים׃

hebrew.text: פַּרְעֹה קָצַף עַל עֲבָדָיו וַיִּתֵּן אֹתִי בְּמִשְׁמַר בֵּית שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אֹתִי וְאֵת שַׂר הָאֹפִים׃

english.text:
Pharaoh had been angry at his servants, and he put me
under watch at the house of the chief of the guards, me
and the chief of the bakers.

translation.text: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard’s house, both me and the chief baker:

verses.english:
Pharaoh had been angry at his servants, and he put me
under watch at the house of the chief of the guards, me
and the chief of the bakers.

verses.hebrew: וַנַּחַלְמָה חֲלוֹם בְּלַיְלָה אֶחָד אֲנִי וָהוּא אִישׁ כְּפִתְרוֹן חֲלֹמוֹ חָלָמְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַנַּחַלְמָה חֲלוֹם בְּלַיְלָה אֶחָד אֲנִי וָהוּא אִישׁ כְּפִתְרוֹן חֲלֹמוֹ חָלָמְנוּ׃

english.text:
And we had a dream in one night, I and he; we each dreamed
with his own dream’s meaning.

translation.text: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.

verses.english:
And we had a dream in one night, I and he; we each dreamed
with his own dream’s meaning.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁם אִתָּנוּ נַעַר עִבְרִי עֶבֶד לְשַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים וַנְּסַפֶּר לוֹ וַיִּפְתּר לָנוּ אֶת חֲלֹמֹתֵינוּ אִישׁ כַּחֲלֹמוֹ פָּתָר׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁם אִתָּנוּ נַעַר עִבְרִי עֶבֶד לְשַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים וַנְּסַפֶּר לוֹ וַיִּפְתּר לָנוּ אֶת חֲלֹמֹתֵינוּ אִישׁ כַּחֲלֹמוֹ פָּתָר׃

english.text:
And there, with us, was a Hebrew boy, a slave of the chief
of the guards; and we told him, and he told us the meaning
of our dreams. He told the meaning according to each one’s
dream.

translation.text: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.

verses.english:
And there, with us, was a Hebrew boy, a slave of the chief
of the guards; and we told him, and he told us the meaning
of our dreams. He told the meaning according to each one’s
dream.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר פָּתַר לָנוּ כֵּן הָיָה אֹתִי הֵשִׁיב עַל כַּנִּי וְאֹתוֹ תָלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר פָּתַר לָנוּ כֵּן הָיָה אֹתִי הֵשִׁיב עַל כַּנִּי וְאֹתוֹ תָלָה׃

english.text:
And it was—as he told the meaning for us, so it was: me he
put back at my station, and him he hanged.”

translation.text: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.

verses.english:
And it was—as he told the meaning for us, so it was: me he
put back at my station, and him he hanged.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח פַּרְעֹה וַיִּקְרָא אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיְרִיצֻהוּ מִן הַבּוֹר וַיְגַלַּח וַיְחַלֵּף שִׂמְלֹתָיו וַיָּבֹא אֶל פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח פַּרְעֹה וַיִּקְרָא אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיְרִיצֻהוּ מִן הַבּוֹר וַיְגַלַּח וַיְחַלֵּף שִׂמְלֹתָיו וַיָּבֹא אֶל פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they rushed him
from the pit, and he shaved and changed his clothing and
came to Pharaoh.

translation.text: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they rushed him
from the pit, and he shaved and changed his clothing and
came to Pharaoh.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף חֲלוֹם חָלַמְתִּי וּפֹתֵר אֵין אֹתוֹ וַאֲנִי שָׁמַעְתִּי עָלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר תִּשְׁמַע חֲלוֹם לִפְתֹּר אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף חֲלוֹם חָלַמְתִּי וּפֹתֵר אֵין אֹתוֹ וַאֲנִי שָׁמַעְתִּי עָלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר תִּשְׁמַע חֲלוֹם לִפְתֹּר אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I’ve had a dream, and there’s
no one who can tell the meaning of it, and I’ve heard
about you, saying you hear a dream so as to tell the
meaning of it.”

translation.text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I’ve had a dream, and there’s
no one who can tell the meaning of it, and I’ve heard
about you, saying you hear a dream so as to tell the
meaning of it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יוֹסֵף אֶת פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר בִּלְעָדָי אֱלֹהִים יַעֲנֶה אֶת שְׁלוֹם פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן יוֹסֵף אֶת פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר בִּלְעָדָי אֱלֹהִים יַעֲנֶה אֶת שְׁלוֹם פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “Not I. will
answer regarding Pharaoh’s well-being.”

translation.text: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.

verses.english:
And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “Not I. will
answer regarding Pharaoh’s well-being.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף בַּחֲלֹמִי הִנְנִי עֹמֵד עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף בַּחֲלֹמִי הִנְנִי עֹמֵד עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, here I was
standing by the bank of the Nile.

translation.text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:

verses.english:
And Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, here I was
standing by the bank of the Nile.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה מִן הַיְאֹר עֹלֹת שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת בְּרִיאוֹת בָּשָׂר וִיפֹת תֹּאַר וַתִּרְעֶינָה בָּאָחוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה מִן הַיְאֹר עֹלֹת שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת בְּרִיאוֹת בָּשָׂר וִיפֹת תֹּאַר וַתִּרְעֶינָה בָּאָחוּ׃

english.text:
And here, coming up from the Nile, were seven cows,
fat-fleshed and beautiful-figured, and they fed in the
reeds.

translation.text: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:

verses.english:
And here, coming up from the Nile, were seven cows,
fat-fleshed and beautiful-figured, and they fed in the
reeds.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת אֲחֵרוֹת עֹלוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן דַּלּוֹת וְרָעוֹת תֹּאַר מְאֹד וְרַקּוֹת בָּשָׂר לֹא רָאִיתִי כָהֵנָּה בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לָרֹעַ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת אֲחֵרוֹת עֹלוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן דַּלּוֹת וְרָעוֹת תֹּאַר מְאֹד וְרַקּוֹת בָּשָׂר לֹא רָאִיתִי כָהֵנָּה בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לָרֹעַ׃

english.text:
And here were seven other cows coming up after them, weak
and very bad-figured and scrawny-fleshed. I haven’t seen
any like these in all the land of Egypt for bad!

translation.text: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:

verses.english:
And here were seven other cows coming up after them, weak
and very bad-figured and scrawny-fleshed. I haven’t seen
any like these in all the land of Egypt for bad!

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאכַלְנָה הַפָּרוֹת הָרַקּוֹת וְהָרָעוֹת אֵת שֶׁבַע הַפָּרוֹת הָרִאשֹׁנוֹת הַבְּרִיאֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאכַלְנָה הַפָּרוֹת הָרַקּוֹת וְהָרָעוֹת אֵת שֶׁבַע הַפָּרוֹת הָרִאשֹׁנוֹת הַבְּרִיאֹת׃

english.text:
And the cows that were scrawny and bad ate the first seven
cows that were fat,

translation.text: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:

verses.english:
And the cows that were scrawny and bad ate the first seven
cows that were fat,

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹאנָה אֶל קִרְבֶּנָה וְלֹא נוֹדַע כִּי בָאוּ אֶל קִרְבֶּנָה וּמַרְאֵיהֶן רַע כַּאֲשֶׁר בַּתְּחִלָּה וָאִיקָץ׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּבֹאנָה אֶל קִרְבֶּנָה וְלֹא נוֹדַע כִּי בָאוּ אֶל קִרְבֶּנָה וּמַרְאֵיהֶן רַע כַּאֲשֶׁר בַּתְּחִלָּה וָאִיקָץ׃

english.text:
and they came inside, and it wasn’t known that they had
come inside! And their appearance was bad, as at first.
And I woke up.

translation.text: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

verses.english:
and they came inside, and it wasn’t known that they had
come inside! And their appearance was bad, as at first.
And I woke up.

verses.hebrew: וָאֵרֶא בַּחֲלֹמִי וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים עֹלֹת בְּקָנֶה אֶחָד מְלֵאֹת וְטֹבוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וָאֵרֶא בַּחֲלֹמִי וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים עֹלֹת בְּקָנֶה אֶחָד מְלֵאֹת וְטֹבוֹת׃

english.text:
“And I saw in my dream, and here were seven ears of grain
coming up on one stalk, full and good.

translation.text: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:

verses.english:
“And I saw in my dream, and here were seven ears of grain
coming up on one stalk, full and good.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים צְנֻמוֹת דַּקּוֹת שְׁדֻפוֹת קָדִים צֹמְחוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים צְנֻמוֹת דַּקּוֹת שְׁדֻפוֹת קָדִים צֹמְחוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And here were seven ears of grain, dried up, thin,
scorched by the east wind, growing after them.

translation.text: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:

verses.english:
And here were seven ears of grain, dried up, thin,
scorched by the east wind, growing after them.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּבְלַעְןָ הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַדַּקֹּת אֵת שֶׁבַע הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַטֹּבוֹת וָאֹמַר אֶל הַחַרְטֻמִּים וְאֵין מַגִּיד לִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּבְלַעְןָ הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַדַּקֹּת אֵת שֶׁבַע הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַטֹּבוֹת וָאֹמַר אֶל הַחַרְטֻמִּים וְאֵין מַגִּיד לִי׃

english.text:
And the thin ears of grain swallowed the seven good ears
of grain. “And I said it to the magicians, and there’s no
one who can tell me.”

translation.text: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.

verses.english:
And the thin ears of grain swallowed the seven good ears
of grain. “And I said it to the magicians, and there’s no
one who can tell me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל פַּרְעֹה חֲלוֹם פַּרְעֹה אֶחָד הוּא אֵת אֲשֶׁר הָאֱלֹהִים עֹשֶׂה הִגִּיד לְפַרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל פַּרְעֹה חֲלוֹם פַּרְעֹה אֶחָד הוּא אֵת אֲשֶׁר הָאֱלֹהִים עֹשֶׂה הִגִּיד לְפַרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Joseph said to Pharaoh, “Pharaoh’s dream: it is one.
It has told to Pharaoh what God is doing.

translation.text: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.

verses.english:
And Joseph said to Pharaoh, “Pharaoh’s dream: it is one.
It has told to Pharaoh what God is doing.

verses.hebrew: שֶׁבַע פָּרֹת הַטֹּבֹת שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים הֵנָּה וְשֶׁבַע הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַטֹּבֹת שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים הֵנָּה חֲלוֹם אֶחָד הוּא׃

hebrew.text: שֶׁבַע פָּרֹת הַטֹּבֹת שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים הֵנָּה וְשֶׁבַע הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַטֹּבֹת שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים הֵנָּה חֲלוֹם אֶחָד הוּא׃

english.text:
The seven good cows: they’re seven years. And the seven
good ears of grain: they’re seven years. It’s one dream.

translation.text: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.

verses.english:
The seven good cows: they’re seven years. And the seven
good ears of grain: they’re seven years. It’s one dream.

verses.hebrew: וְשֶׁבַע הַפָּרוֹת הָרַקּוֹת וְהָרָעֹת הָעֹלֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים הֵנָּה וְשֶׁבַע הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הָרֵקוֹת שְׁדֻפוֹת הַקָּדִים יִהְיוּ שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי רָעָב׃

hebrew.text: וְשֶׁבַע הַפָּרוֹת הָרַקּוֹת וְהָרָעֹת הָעֹלֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים הֵנָּה וְשֶׁבַע הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הָרֵקוֹת שְׁדֻפוֹת הַקָּדִים יִהְיוּ שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי רָעָב׃

english.text:
And the seven cows that were scrawny and bad that were
coming up after them: they’re seven years. And the seven
ears of grain that were scrawny, scorched by the east
wind, will be seven years of famine.

translation.text: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.

verses.english:
And the seven cows that were scrawny and bad that were
coming up after them: they’re seven years. And the seven
ears of grain that were scrawny, scorched by the east
wind, will be seven years of famine.

verses.hebrew: הוּא הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶל פַּרְעֹה אֲשֶׁר הָאֱלֹהִים עֹשֶׂה הֶרְאָה אֶת פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: הוּא הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶל פַּרְעֹה אֲשֶׁר הָאֱלֹהִים עֹשֶׂה הֶרְאָה אֶת פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
That is the thing that I spoke to Pharaoh: it has shown
Pharaoh what God is doing.

translation.text: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.

verses.english:
That is the thing that I spoke to Pharaoh: it has shown
Pharaoh what God is doing.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים בָּאוֹת שָׂבָע גָּדוֹל בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים בָּאוֹת שָׂבָע גָּדוֹל בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
Here, seven years are coming: big bountifulness in all the
land of Egypt.

translation.text: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:

verses.english:
Here, seven years are coming: big bountifulness in all the
land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וְקָמוּ שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי רָעָב אַחֲרֵיהֶן וְנִשְׁכַּח כּל הַשָּׂבָע בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְכִלָּה הָרָעָב אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְקָמוּ שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי רָעָב אַחֲרֵיהֶן וְנִשְׁכַּח כּל הַשָּׂבָע בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְכִלָּה הָרָעָב אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And seven years of famine will rise after them, and all
the bountifulness in the land of Egypt will be forgotten,
and the famine will finish off the land.

translation.text: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;

verses.english:
And seven years of famine will rise after them, and all
the bountifulness in the land of Egypt will be forgotten,
and the famine will finish off the land.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יִוָּדַע הַשָּׂבָע בָּאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵי הָרָעָב הַהוּא אַחֲרֵי כֵן כִּי כָבֵד הוּא מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יִוָּדַע הַשָּׂבָע בָּאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵי הָרָעָב הַהוּא אַחֲרֵי כֵן כִּי כָבֵד הוּא מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And the bountifulness won’t be known in the land on
account of that famine afterwards because it will be very
heavy.

translation.text: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.

verses.english:
And the bountifulness won’t be known in the land on
account of that famine afterwards because it will be very
heavy.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל הִשָּׁנוֹת הַחֲלוֹם אֶל פַּרְעֹה פַּעֲמָיִם כִּי נָכוֹן הַדָּבָר מֵעִם הָאֱלֹהִים וּמְמַהֵר הָאֱלֹהִים לַעֲשֹׂתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל הִשָּׁנוֹת הַחֲלוֹם אֶל פַּרְעֹה פַּעֲמָיִם כִּי נָכוֹן הַדָּבָר מֵעִם הָאֱלֹהִים וּמְמַהֵר הָאֱלֹהִים לַעֲשֹׂתוֹ׃

english.text:
And about the recurrence of the dream to Pharaoh two
times: because the thing is right from God, and God is
hurrying to do it.

translation.text: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

verses.english:
And about the recurrence of the dream to Pharaoh two
times: because the thing is right from God, and God is
hurrying to do it.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יֵרֶא פַרְעֹה אִישׁ נָבוֹן וְחָכָם וִישִׁיתֵהוּ עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה יֵרֶא פַרְעֹה אִישׁ נָבוֹן וְחָכָם וִישִׁיתֵהוּ עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And now, let Pharaoh look out for an understanding and
wise man and set him over the land of Egypt.

translation.text: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And now, let Pharaoh look out for an understanding and
wise man and set him over the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: יַעֲשֶׂה פַרְעֹה וְיַפְקֵד פְּקִדִים עַל הָאָרֶץ וְחִמֵּשׁ אֶת אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּשֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָע׃

hebrew.text: יַעֲשֶׂה פַרְעֹה וְיַפְקֵד פְּקִדִים עַל הָאָרֶץ וְחִמֵּשׁ אֶת אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּשֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָע׃

english.text:
Let Pharaoh do it and appoint overseers over the land and
five-out the land of Egypt in the seven years of
bountifulness.

translation.text: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.

verses.english:
Let Pharaoh do it and appoint overseers over the land and
five-out the land of Egypt in the seven years of
bountifulness.

verses.hebrew: וְיִקְבְּצוּ אֶת כּל אֹכֶל הַשָּׁנִים הַטֹּבוֹת הַבָּאֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְיִצְבְּרוּ בָר תַּחַת יַד פַּרְעֹה אֹכֶל בֶּעָרִים וְשָׁמָרוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְיִקְבְּצוּ אֶת כּל אֹכֶל הַשָּׁנִים הַטֹּבוֹת הַבָּאֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְיִצְבְּרוּ בָר תַּחַת יַד פַּרְעֹה אֹכֶל בֶּעָרִים וְשָׁמָרוּ׃

english.text:
And let them gather all the food of these coming good
years and pile up grain under Pharaoh’s hand, food in the
cities, and watch over it.

translation.text: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.

verses.english:
And let them gather all the food of these coming good
years and pile up grain under Pharaoh’s hand, food in the
cities, and watch over it.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הָאֹכֶל לְפִקָּדוֹן לָאָרֶץ לְשֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הָרָעָב אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶיןָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְלֹא תִכָּרֵת הָאָרֶץ בָּרָעָב׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הָאֹכֶל לְפִקָּדוֹן לָאָרֶץ לְשֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הָרָעָב אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶיןָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְלֹא תִכָּרֵת הָאָרֶץ בָּרָעָב׃

english.text:
And the food will become a deposit for the land for the
seven years of famine that will be in the land of Egypt so
the land won’t be cut off in the famine.”

translation.text: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.

verses.english:
And the food will become a deposit for the land for the
seven years of famine that will be in the land of Egypt so
the land won’t be cut off in the famine.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה וּבְעֵינֵי כּל עֲבָדָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה וּבְעֵינֵי כּל עֲבָדָיו׃

english.text:
And the thing was good in Pharaoh’s eyes and in all his
servants’ eyes.

translation.text: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

verses.english:
And the thing was good in Pharaoh’s eyes and in all his
servants’ eyes.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל עֲבָדָיו הֲנִמְצָא כָזֶה אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל עֲבָדָיו הֲנִמְצָא כָזֶה אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים בּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said to his servants, “Will we find such a man
as this, that God’s spirit is in him?”

translation.text: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said to his servants, “Will we find such a man
as this, that God’s spirit is in him?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף אַחֲרֵי הוֹדִיעַ אֱלֹהִים אוֹתְךָ אֶת כּל זֹאת אֵין נָבוֹן וְחָכָם כָּמוֹךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף אַחֲרֵי הוֹדִיעַ אֱלֹהִים אוֹתְךָ אֶת כּל זֹאת אֵין נָבוֹן וְחָכָם כָּמוֹךָ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Since God has made you know
all this, there’s no one as understanding and wise as you.

translation.text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Since God has made you know
all this, there’s no one as understanding and wise as you.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה תִּהְיֶה עַל בֵּיתִי וְעַל פִּיךָ יִשַּׁק כּל עַמִּי רַק הַכִּסֵּא אֶגְדַּל מִמֶּךָּ׃

hebrew.text: אַתָּה תִּהְיֶה עַל בֵּיתִי וְעַל פִּיךָ יִשַּׁק כּל עַמִּי רַק הַכִּסֵּא אֶגְדַּל מִמֶּךָּ׃

english.text:
You shall be over my house, and at your mouth all my
people shall conform. I shall be greater than you only in
the throne.”

translation.text: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.

verses.english:
You shall be over my house, and at your mouth all my
people shall conform. I shall be greater than you only in
the throne.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף רְאֵה נָתַתִּי אֹתְךָ עַל כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף רְאֵה נָתַתִּי אֹתְךָ עַל כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “See, I’ve put you over all
the land of Egypt.”

translation.text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “See, I’ve put you over all
the land of Egypt.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּסַר פַּרְעֹה אֶת טַבַּעְתּוֹ מֵעַל יָדוֹ וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָהּ עַל יַד יוֹסֵף וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ בִּגְדֵי שֵׁשׁ וַיָּשֶׂם רְבִד הַזָּהָב עַל צַוָּארוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּסַר פַּרְעֹה אֶת טַבַּעְתּוֹ מֵעַל יָדוֹ וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָהּ עַל יַד יוֹסֵף וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ בִּגְדֵי שֵׁשׁ וַיָּשֶׂם רְבִד הַזָּהָב עַל צַוָּארוֹ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand and put it on
Joseph’s hand, and he had him dressed in linen garments,
and he set a gold chain on his neck,

translation.text: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;

verses.english:
And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand and put it on
Joseph’s hand, and he had him dressed in linen garments,
and he set a gold chain on his neck,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְכֵּב אֹתוֹ בְּמִרְכֶּבֶת הַמִּשְׁנֶה אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וַיִּקְרְאוּ לְפָנָיו אַבְרֵךְ וְנָתוֹן אֹתוֹ עַל כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְכֵּב אֹתוֹ בְּמִרְכֶּבֶת הַמִּשְׁנֶה אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וַיִּקְרְאוּ לְפָנָיו אַבְרֵךְ וְנָתוֹן אֹתוֹ עַל כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
and he had him driven in the chariot of the
second-in-command whom he had, and they called in front of
him, “Kneel,” so putting him over all the land of Egypt.

translation.text: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
and he had him driven in the chariot of the
second-in-command whom he had, and they called in front of
him, “Kneel,” so putting him over all the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף אֲנִי פַרְעֹה וּבִלְעָדֶיךָ לֹא יָרִים אִישׁ אֶת יָדוֹ וְאֶת רַגְלוֹ בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף אֲנִי פַרְעֹה וּבִלְעָדֶיךָ לֹא יָרִים אִישׁ אֶת יָדוֹ וְאֶת רַגְלוֹ בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, and without you
a man won’t lift his hand and his foot in all the land of
Egypt.”

translation.text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, and without you
a man won’t lift his hand and his foot in all the land of
Egypt.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא פַרְעֹה שֵׁם יוֹסֵף צָפְנַת פַּעְנֵחַ וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ אֶת אָסְנַת בַּת פּוֹטִי פֶרַע כֹּהֵן אֹן לְאִשָּׁה וַיֵּצֵא יוֹסֵף עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא פַרְעֹה שֵׁם יוֹסֵף צָפְנַת פַּעְנֵחַ וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ אֶת אָסְנַת בַּת פּוֹטִי פֶרַע כֹּהֵן אֹן לְאִשָּׁה וַיֵּצֵא יוֹסֵף עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphe-nath-paneah. And he
gave him Asenath, daughter of Poti-phera, priest of On, as
a wife. And Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

translation.text: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphnathpaaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphe-nath-paneah. And he
gave him Asenath, daughter of Poti-phera, priest of On, as
a wife. And Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹסֵף בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה בְּעמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם וַיֵּצֵא יוֹסֵף מִלִּפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹסֵף בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה בְּעמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם וַיֵּצֵא יוֹסֵף מִלִּפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood in front of
Pharaoh, king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from in front
of Pharaoh and passed through all the land of Egypt.

translation.text: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood in front of
Pharaoh, king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from in front
of Pharaoh and passed through all the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעַשׂ הָאָרֶץ בְּשֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָע לִקְמָצִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעַשׂ הָאָרֶץ בְּשֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָע לִקְמָצִים׃

english.text:
And the land produced in the seven years of bountifulness
by fistfuls.

translation.text: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.

verses.english:
And the land produced in the seven years of bountifulness
by fistfuls.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבֹּץ אֶת כּל אֹכֶל שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיִּתֶּן אֹכֶל בֶּעָרִים אֹכֶל שְׂדֵה הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֶיהָ נָתַן בְּתוֹכָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבֹּץ אֶת כּל אֹכֶל שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיִּתֶּן אֹכֶל בֶּעָרִים אֹכֶל שְׂדֵה הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֶיהָ נָתַן בְּתוֹכָהּ׃

english.text:
And he gathered all the food of the seven years, which
were in the land of Egypt, and he put food in cities; he
put the food of the city’s fields that were around it
inside of it.

translation.text: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.

verses.english:
And he gathered all the food of the seven years, which
were in the land of Egypt, and he put food in cities; he
put the food of the city’s fields that were around it
inside of it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְבֹּר יוֹסֵף בָּר כְּחוֹל הַיָּם הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד עַד כִּי חָדַל לִסְפֹּר כִּי אֵין מִסְפָּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצְבֹּר יוֹסֵף בָּר כְּחוֹל הַיָּם הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד עַד כִּי חָדַל לִסְפֹּר כִּי אֵין מִסְפָּר׃

english.text:
And Joseph piled up grain like the sand of the sea, very
much, until he stopped counting, because it was without
number.

translation.text: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.

verses.english:
And Joseph piled up grain like the sand of the sea, very
much, until he stopped counting, because it was without
number.

verses.hebrew: וּלְיוֹסֵף יֻלַּד שְׁנֵי בָנִים בְּטֶרֶם תָּבוֹא שְׁנַת הָרָעָב אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לּוֹ אָסְנַת בַּת פּוֹטִי פֶרַע כֹּהֵן אוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וּלְיוֹסֵף יֻלַּד שְׁנֵי בָנִים בְּטֶרֶם תָּבוֹא שְׁנַת הָרָעָב אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לּוֹ אָסְנַת בַּת פּוֹטִי פֶרַע כֹּהֵן אוֹן׃

english.text:
And two sons were born to Joseph before the year of famine
came—to whom Asenath, daughter of Poti-phera, priest of
On, gave birth for him.

translation.text: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.

verses.english:
And two sons were born to Joseph before the year of famine
came—to whom Asenath, daughter of Poti-phera, priest of
On, gave birth for him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יוֹסֵף אֶת שֵׁם הַבְּכוֹר מְנַשֶּׁה כִּי נַשַּׁנִי אֱלֹהִים אֶת כּל עֲמָלִי וְאֵת כּל בֵּית אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יוֹסֵף אֶת שֵׁם הַבְּכוֹר מְנַשֶּׁה כִּי נַשַּׁנִי אֱלֹהִים אֶת כּל עֲמָלִי וְאֵת כּל בֵּית אָבִי׃

english.text:
And Joseph called the firstborn’s name Manasseh, “because
God has made me forget all of my trouble and all of my
father’s house.”

translation.text: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.

verses.english:
And Joseph called the firstborn’s name Manasseh, “because
