God has made me forget all of my trouble and all of my
father’s house.”

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִי קָרָא אֶפְרָיִם כִּי הִפְרַנִי אֱלֹהִים בְּאֶרֶץ ענְיִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִי קָרָא אֶפְרָיִם כִּי הִפְרַנִי אֱלֹהִים בְּאֶרֶץ ענְיִי׃

english.text:
And he called the second one’s name Ephraim, “because God
has made me fruitful in the land of my degradation.”

translation.text: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

verses.english:
And he called the second one’s name Ephraim, “because God
has made me fruitful in the land of my degradation.”

verses.hebrew: וַתִּכְלֶינָה שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָע אֲשֶׁר הָיָה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּכְלֶינָה שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָע אֲשֶׁר הָיָה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And the seven years of the bountifulness that was in the
land of Egypt finished,

translation.text: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.

verses.english:
And the seven years of the bountifulness that was in the
land of Egypt finished,

verses.hebrew: וַתְּחִלֶּינָה שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הָרָעָב לָבוֹא כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר יוֹסֵף וַיְהִי רָעָב בְּכל הָאֲרָצוֹת וּבְכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם הָיָה לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּחִלֶּינָה שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הָרָעָב לָבוֹא כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר יוֹסֵף וַיְהִי רָעָב בְּכל הָאֲרָצוֹת וּבְכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם הָיָה לָחֶם׃

english.text:
and the seven years of famine started to come, as Joseph
had said. And there was famine in all the lands, and in
all the land of Egypt there was bread.

translation.text: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

verses.english:
and the seven years of famine started to come, as Joseph
had said. And there was famine in all the lands, and in
all the land of Egypt there was bread.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּרְעַב כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיִּצְעַק הָעָם אֶל פַּרְעֹה לַלָּחֶם וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה לְכל מִצְרַיִם לְכוּ אֶל יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר לָכֶם תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּרְעַב כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיִּצְעַק הָעָם אֶל פַּרְעֹה לַלָּחֶם וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה לְכל מִצְרַיִם לְכוּ אֶל יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר לָכֶם תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
And all the land of Egypt hungered, and the people cried
to Pharaoh for the bread, and Pharaoh said to all Egypt,
“Go to Joseph. Do what he’ll tell you.”

translation.text: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.

verses.english:
And all the land of Egypt hungered, and the people cried
to Pharaoh for the bread, and Pharaoh said to all Egypt,
“Go to Joseph. Do what he’ll tell you.”

verses.hebrew: וְהָרָעָב הָיָה עַל כּל פְּנֵי הָאָרֶץ וַיִּפְתַּח יוֹסֵף אֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בָּהֶם וַיִּשְׁבֹּר לְמִצְרַיִם וַיֶּחֱזַק הָרָעָב בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָרָעָב הָיָה עַל כּל פְּנֵי הָאָרֶץ וַיִּפְתַּח יוֹסֵף אֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בָּהֶם וַיִּשְׁבֹּר לְמִצְרַיִם וַיֶּחֱזַק הָרָעָב בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And the famine was on all the face of the earth. And
Joseph opened everything that was in them and sold to
Egypt. And the famine was strong in the land of Egypt.

translation.text: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And the famine was on all the face of the earth. And
Joseph opened everything that was in them and sold to
Egypt. And the famine was strong in the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וְכל הָאָרֶץ בָּאוּ מִצְרַיְמָה לִשְׁבֹּר אֶל יוֹסֵף כִּי חָזַק הָרָעָב בְּכל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הָאָרֶץ בָּאוּ מִצְרַיְמָה לִשְׁבֹּר אֶל יוֹסֵף כִּי חָזַק הָרָעָב בְּכל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And all the earth came to Egypt to buy, to Joseph, because
the famine was strong in all the earth.

translation.text: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.

verses.english:
And all the earth came to Egypt to buy, to Joseph, because
the famine was strong in all the earth.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יַעֲקֹב כִּי יֶשׁ שֶׁבֶר בְּמִצְרָיִם וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב לְבָנָיו לָמָּה תִּתְרָאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יַעֲקֹב כִּי יֶשׁ שֶׁבֶר בְּמִצְרָיִם וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב לְבָנָיו לָמָּה תִּתְרָאוּ׃

english.text:
And Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob
said to his sons, “Why do you look at each other?”

translation.text: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?

verses.english:
And Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob
said to his sons, “Why do you look at each other?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה שָׁמַעְתִּי כִּי יֶשׁ שֶׁבֶר בְּמִצְרָיִם רְדוּ שָׁמָּה וְשִׁבְרוּ לָנוּ מִשָּׁם וְנִחְיֶה וְלֹא נָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה שָׁמַעְתִּי כִּי יֶשׁ שֶׁבֶר בְּמִצְרָיִם רְדוּ שָׁמָּה וְשִׁבְרוּ לָנוּ מִשָּׁם וְנִחְיֶה וְלֹא נָמוּת׃

english.text:
And he said, “Here I’ve heard that there’s grain in Egypt.
Go down there and buy grain for us from there, and we’ll
live and not die.”

translation.text: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.

verses.english:
And he said, “Here I’ve heard that there’s grain in Egypt.
Go down there and buy grain for us from there, and we’ll
live and not die.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרְדוּ אֲחֵי יוֹסֵף עֲשָׂרָה לִשְׁבֹּר בָּר מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרְדוּ אֲחֵי יוֹסֵף עֲשָׂרָה לִשְׁבֹּר בָּר מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain from
Egypt,

translation.text: And Joseph’s ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.

verses.english:
And ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain from
Egypt,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת בִּנְיָמִין אֲחִי יוֹסֵף לֹא שָׁלַח יַעֲקֹב אֶת אֶחָיו כִּי אָמַר פֶּן יִקְרָאֶנּוּ אָסוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת בִּנְיָמִין אֲחִי יוֹסֵף לֹא שָׁלַח יַעֲקֹב אֶת אֶחָיו כִּי אָמַר פֶּן יִקְרָאֶנּוּ אָסוֹן׃

english.text:
and Jacob did not send Joseph’s brother Benjamin with his
brothers because, he said, “In case some harm will happen
to him.”

translation.text: But Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.

verses.english:
and Jacob did not send Joseph’s brother Benjamin with his
brothers because, he said, “In case some harm will happen
to him.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִשְׁבֹּר בְּתוֹךְ הַבָּאִים כִּי הָיָה הָרָעָב בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִשְׁבֹּר בְּתוֹךְ הַבָּאִים כִּי הָיָה הָרָעָב בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
And the sons of Israel came to buy among those who were
coming, because the famine was in the land of Canaan.

translation.text: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

verses.english:
And the sons of Israel came to buy among those who were
coming, because the famine was in the land of Canaan.

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹסֵף הוּא הַשַּׁלִּיט עַל הָאָרֶץ הוּא הַמַּשְׁבִּיר לְכל עַם הָאָרֶץ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֲחֵי יוֹסֵף וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לוֹ אַפַּיִם אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹסֵף הוּא הַשַּׁלִּיט עַל הָאָרֶץ הוּא הַמַּשְׁבִּיר לְכל עַם הָאָרֶץ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֲחֵי יוֹסֵף וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לוֹ אַפַּיִם אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
And Joseph was the one in charge over the land; he was the
one who sold grain to all the people of the land. And
Joseph’s brothers came and bowed to him, noses to the
ground.

translation.text: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph’s brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.

verses.english:
And Joseph was the one in charge over the land; he was the
one who sold grain to all the people of the land. And
Joseph’s brothers came and bowed to him, noses to the
ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יוֹסֵף אֶת אֶחָיו וַיַּכִּרֵם וַיִּתְנַכֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם וַיְדַבֵּר אִתָּם קָשׁוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מֵאַיִן בָּאתֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לִשְׁבּר אֹכֶל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יוֹסֵף אֶת אֶחָיו וַיַּכִּרֵם וַיִּתְנַכֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם וַיְדַבֵּר אִתָּם קָשׁוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מֵאַיִן בָּאתֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לִשְׁבּר אֹכֶל׃

english.text:
And Joseph saw his brothers and recognized them, but he
made himself unrecognizable to them, and he spoke with
them in hard tones. And he said to them, “From where have
you come?” And they said, “From the land of Canaan, to buy
food.”

translation.text: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

verses.english:
And Joseph saw his brothers and recognized them, but he
made himself unrecognizable to them, and he spoke with
them in hard tones. And he said to them, “From where have
you come?” And they said, “From the land of Canaan, to buy
food.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּר יוֹסֵף אֶת אֶחָיו וְהֵם לֹא הִכִּרֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכֵּר יוֹסֵף אֶת אֶחָיו וְהֵם לֹא הִכִּרֻהוּ׃

english.text:
And Joseph recognized his brothers, but they did not
recognize him,

translation.text: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.

verses.english:
And Joseph recognized his brothers, but they did not
recognize him,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְכֹּר יוֹסֵף אֵת הַחֲלֹמוֹת אֲשֶׁר חָלַם לָהֶם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מְרַגְּלִים אַתֶּם לִרְאוֹת אֶת עֶרְוַת הָאָרֶץ בָּאתֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזְכֹּר יוֹסֵף אֵת הַחֲלֹמוֹת אֲשֶׁר חָלַם לָהֶם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מְרַגְּלִים אַתֶּם לִרְאוֹת אֶת עֶרְוַת הָאָרֶץ בָּאתֶם׃

english.text:
and Joseph remembered the dreams that he had had about
them. And he said to them, “You’re spies. You came to see
the land exposed.”

translation.text: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

verses.english:
and Joseph remembered the dreams that he had had about
them. And he said to them, “You’re spies. You came to see
the land exposed.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו לֹא אֲדֹנִי וַעֲבָדֶיךָ בָּאוּ לִשְׁבּר אֹכֶל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו לֹא אֲדֹנִי וַעֲבָדֶיךָ בָּאוּ לִשְׁבּר אֹכֶל׃

english.text:
And they said to him, “No, my lord, your servants came to
buy food.

translation.text: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.

verses.english:
And they said to him, “No, my lord, your servants came to
buy food.

verses.hebrew: כֻּלָּנוּ בְּנֵי אִישׁ אֶחָד נָחְנוּ כֵּנִים אֲנַחְנוּ לֹא הָיוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ מְרַגְּלִים׃

hebrew.text: כֻּלָּנוּ בְּנֵי אִישׁ אֶחָד נָחְנוּ כֵּנִים אֲנַחְנוּ לֹא הָיוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ מְרַגְּלִים׃

english.text:
We’re all sons of one man. We’re honest men. Your servants
weren’t spying.”

translation.text: We are all one man’s sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.

verses.english:
We’re all sons of one man. We’re honest men. Your servants
weren’t spying.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם לֹא כִּי עֶרְוַת הָאָרֶץ בָּאתֶם לִרְאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם לֹא כִּי עֶרְוַת הָאָרֶץ בָּאתֶם לִרְאוֹת׃

english.text:
And he said to them, “No, but you’ve come to see the land
exposed.”

translation.text: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

verses.english:
And he said to them, “No, but you’ve come to see the land
exposed.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר עֲבָדֶיךָ אַחִים אֲנַחְנוּ בְּנֵי אִישׁ אֶחָד בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְהִנֵּה הַקָּטֹן אֶת אָבִינוּ הַיּוֹם וְהָאֶחָד אֵינֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר עֲבָדֶיךָ אַחִים אֲנַחְנוּ בְּנֵי אִישׁ אֶחָד בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְהִנֵּה הַקָּטֹן אֶת אָבִינוּ הַיּוֹם וְהָאֶחָד אֵינֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
And they said, “Your servants are twelve brothers. We’re
sons of one man in the land of Canaan, and, here, the
youngest is with our father today, and one is no more.”

translation.text: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.

verses.english:
And they said, “Your servants are twelve brothers. We’re
sons of one man in the land of Canaan, and, here, the
youngest is with our father today, and one is no more.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יוֹסֵף הוּא אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֲלֵכֶם לֵאמֹר מְרַגְּלִים אַתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יוֹסֵף הוּא אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֲלֵכֶם לֵאמֹר מְרַגְּלִים אַתֶּם׃

english.text:
And Joseph said to them, “It’s as I spoke to you, saying:
you’re spies.

translation.text: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye are spies:

verses.english:
And Joseph said to them, “It’s as I spoke to you, saying:
you’re spies.

verses.hebrew: בְּזֹאת תִּבָּחֵנוּ חֵי פַרְעֹה אִם תֵּצְאוּ מִזֶּה כִּי אִם בְּבוֹא אֲחִיכֶם הַקָּטֹן הֵנָּה׃

hebrew.text: בְּזֹאת תִּבָּחֵנוּ חֵי פַרְעֹה אִם תֵּצְאוּ מִזֶּה כִּי אִם בְּבוֹא אֲחִיכֶם הַקָּטֹן הֵנָּה׃

english.text:
By this you’ll be tested: by Pharaoh’s life, you won’t go
out of here except by your youngest brother’s coming here.

translation.text: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.

verses.english:
By this you’ll be tested: by Pharaoh’s life, you won’t go
out of here except by your youngest brother’s coming here.

verses.hebrew: שִׁלְחוּ מִכֶּם אֶחָד וְיִקַּח אֶת אֲחִיכֶם וְאַתֶּם הֵאָסְרוּ וְיִבָּחֲנוּ דִּבְרֵיכֶם הַאֱמֶת אִתְּכֶם וְאִם לֹא חֵי פַרְעֹה כִּי מְרַגְּלִים אַתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: שִׁלְחוּ מִכֶּם אֶחָד וְיִקַּח אֶת אֲחִיכֶם וְאַתֶּם הֵאָסְרוּ וְיִבָּחֲנוּ דִּבְרֵיכֶם הַאֱמֶת אִתְּכֶם וְאִם לֹא חֵי פַרְעֹה כִּי מְרַגְּלִים אַתֶּם׃

english.text:
Send one from among you, and let him get your brother, and
you remain in prison, and your words will be tested: is
the truth with you? And if not, then by Pharaoh’s life
you’re spies.”

translation.text: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.

verses.english:
Send one from among you, and let him get your brother, and
you remain in prison, and your words will be tested: is
the truth with you? And if not, then by Pharaoh’s life
you’re spies.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֹתָם אֶל מִשְׁמָר שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֹתָם אֶל מִשְׁמָר שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים׃

english.text: And he gathered them under watch for three days.

translation.text: And he put them all together into ward three days.

verses.english: And he gathered them under watch for three days.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יוֹסֵף בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי זֹאת עֲשׂוּ וִחְיוּ אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים אֲנִי יָרֵא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יוֹסֵף בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי זֹאת עֲשׂוּ וִחְיוּ אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים אֲנִי יָרֵא׃

english.text:
And Joseph said to them on the third day, “Do this and
live, as I fear God:

translation.text: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:

verses.english:
And Joseph said to them on the third day, “Do this and
live, as I fear God:

verses.hebrew: אִם כֵּנִים אַתֶּם אֲחִיכֶם אֶחָד יֵאָסֵר בְּבֵית מִשְׁמַרְכֶם וְאַתֶּם לְכוּ הָבִיאוּ שֶׁבֶר רַעֲבוֹן בָּתֵּיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אִם כֵּנִים אַתֶּם אֲחִיכֶם אֶחָד יֵאָסֵר בְּבֵית מִשְׁמַרְכֶם וְאַתֶּם לְכוּ הָבִיאוּ שֶׁבֶר רַעֲבוֹן בָּתֵּיכֶם׃

english.text:
If you’re honest, one brother from among you will be held
at the place where you’re under watch; and you, go, bring
grain for the famine in your houses.

translation.text: If ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:

verses.english:
If you’re honest, one brother from among you will be held
at the place where you’re under watch; and you, go, bring
grain for the famine in your houses.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת אֲחִיכֶם הַקָּטֹן תָּבִיאוּ אֵלַי וְיֵאָמְנוּ דִבְרֵיכֶם וְלֹא תָמוּתוּ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת אֲחִיכֶם הַקָּטֹן תָּבִיאוּ אֵלַי וְיֵאָמְנוּ דִבְרֵיכֶם וְלֹא תָמוּתוּ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן׃

english.text:
And you will bring your youngest brother to me, and your
words will be confirmed, and you won’t die.” And they did
so.

translation.text: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.

verses.english:
And you will bring your youngest brother to me, and your
words will be confirmed, and you won’t die.” And they did
so.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו אֲבָל אֲשֵׁמִים אֲנַחְנוּ עַל אָחִינוּ אֲשֶׁר רָאִינוּ צָרַת נַפְשׁוֹ בְּהִתְחַנְנוֹ אֵלֵינוּ וְלֹא שָׁמָעְנוּ עַל כֵּן בָּאָה אֵלֵינוּ הַצָּרָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו אֲבָל אֲשֵׁמִים אֲנַחְנוּ עַל אָחִינוּ אֲשֶׁר רָאִינוּ צָרַת נַפְשׁוֹ בְּהִתְחַנְנוֹ אֵלֵינוּ וְלֹא שָׁמָעְנוּ עַל כֵּן בָּאָה אֵלֵינוּ הַצָּרָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
And they said, each to his brother, “But we’re guilty over
our brother, because we saw his soul’s distress when he
implored us and we didn’t listen. On account of that this
distress has come to us!”

translation.text: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

verses.english:
And they said, each to his brother, “But we’re guilty over
our brother, because we saw his soul’s distress when he
implored us and we didn’t listen. On account of that this
distress has come to us!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן רְאוּבֵן אֹתָם לֵאמֹר הֲלוֹא אָמַרְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם לֵאמֹר אַל תֶּחֶטְאוּ בַיֶּלֶד וְלֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּם וְגַם דָּמוֹ הִנֵּה נִדְרָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן רְאוּבֵן אֹתָם לֵאמֹר הֲלוֹא אָמַרְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם לֵאמֹר אַל תֶּחֶטְאוּ בַיֶּלֶד וְלֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּם וְגַם דָּמוֹ הִנֵּה נִדְרָשׁ׃

english.text:
And Reuben answered them, saying, “Didn’t I say to you,
saying, ‘Don’t sin against the boy’? And you didn’t
listen. And his blood, too, is required here!”

translation.text: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.

verses.english:
And Reuben answered them, saying, “Didn’t I say to you,
saying, ‘Don’t sin against the boy’? And you didn’t
listen. And his blood, too, is required here!”

verses.hebrew: וְהֵם לֹא יָדְעוּ כִּי שֹׁמֵעַ יוֹסֵף כִּי הַמֵּלִיץ בֵּינֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵם לֹא יָדְעוּ כִּי שֹׁמֵעַ יוֹסֵף כִּי הַמֵּלִיץ בֵּינֹתָם׃

english.text:
And they did not know that Joseph was listening, because
an interpreter was between them.

translation.text: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.

verses.english:
And they did not know that Joseph was listening, because
an interpreter was between them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסֹּב מֵעֲלֵיהֶם וַיֵּבְךְּ וַיָּשׁב אֲלֵהֶם וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם וַיִּקַּח מֵאִתָּם אֶת שִׁמְעוֹן וַיֶּאֱסֹר אֹתוֹ לְעֵינֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסֹּב מֵעֲלֵיהֶם וַיֵּבְךְּ וַיָּשׁב אֲלֵהֶם וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם וַיִּקַּח מֵאִתָּם אֶת שִׁמְעוֹן וַיֶּאֱסֹר אֹתוֹ לְעֵינֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And he turned from them and wept. And he came back to them
and spoke to them and took Simeon from them and shackled
him before their eyes.

translation.text: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.

verses.english:
And he turned from them and wept. And he came back to them
and spoke to them and took Simeon from them and shackled
him before their eyes.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו יוֹסֵף וַיְמַלְאוּ אֶת כְּלֵיהֶם בָּר וּלְהָשִׁיב כַּסְפֵּיהֶם אִישׁ אֶל שַׂקּוֹ וְלָתֵת לָהֶם צֵדָה לַדָּרֶךְ וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם כֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו יוֹסֵף וַיְמַלְאוּ אֶת כְּלֵיהֶם בָּר וּלְהָשִׁיב כַּסְפֵּיהֶם אִישׁ אֶל שַׂקּוֹ וְלָתֵת לָהֶם צֵדָה לַדָּרֶךְ וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם כֵּן׃

english.text:
And Joseph commanded that they fill their containers with
grain and to put their silver back in each man’s sack and
to give them provisions for the road. And he did that for
them.

translation.text: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man’s money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.

verses.english:
And Joseph commanded that they fill their containers with
grain and to put their silver back in each man’s sack and
to give them provisions for the road. And he did that for
them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת שִׁבְרָם עַל חֲמֹרֵיהֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ מִשָּׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת שִׁבְרָם עַל חֲמֹרֵיהֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ מִשָּׁם׃

english.text:
And they loaded their grain on their asses and went from
there.

translation.text: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.

verses.english:
And they loaded their grain on their asses and went from
there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְתַּח הָאֶחָד אֶת שַׂקּוֹ לָתֵת מִסְפּוֹא לַחֲמֹרוֹ בַּמָּלוֹן וַיַּרְא אֶת כַּסְפּוֹ וְהִנֵּה הוּא בְּפִי אַמְתַּחְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְתַּח הָאֶחָד אֶת שַׂקּוֹ לָתֵת מִסְפּוֹא לַחֲמֹרוֹ בַּמָּלוֹן וַיַּרְא אֶת כַּסְפּוֹ וְהִנֵּה הוּא בְּפִי אַמְתַּחְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And one opened his sack to give fodder to his ass at a
lodging place, and he saw his silver, and here it was in
the mouth of his bag.

translation.text: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack’s mouth.

verses.english:
And one opened his sack to give fodder to his ass at a
lodging place, and he saw his silver, and here it was in
the mouth of his bag.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל אֶחָיו הוּשַׁב כַּסְפִּי וְגַם הִנֵּה בְאַמְתַּחְתִּי וַיֵּצֵא לִבָּם וַיֶּחֶרְדוּ אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו לֵאמֹר מַה זֹּאת עָשָׂה אֱלֹהִים לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל אֶחָיו הוּשַׁב כַּסְפִּי וְגַם הִנֵּה בְאַמְתַּחְתִּי וַיֵּצֵא לִבָּם וַיֶּחֶרְדוּ אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו לֵאמֹר מַה זֹּאת עָשָׂה אֱלֹהִים לָנוּ׃

english.text:
And he said to his brothers, “My silver’s been put back,
and here it is in my bag, too.” And their heart went out,
and the brothers trembled to one another, saying, “What is
this that God has done to us?”

translation.text: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that God hath done unto us?

verses.english:
And he said to his brothers, “My silver’s been put back,
and here it is in my bag, too.” And their heart went out,
and the brothers trembled to one another, saying, “What is
this that God has done to us?”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל יַעֲקֹב אֲבִיהֶם אַרְצָה כְּנָעַן וַיַּגִּידוּ לוֹ אֵת כּל הַקֹּרֹת אֹתָם לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל יַעֲקֹב אֲבִיהֶם אַרְצָה כְּנָעַן וַיַּגִּידוּ לוֹ אֵת כּל הַקֹּרֹת אֹתָם לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And they came to Jacob, their father, to the land of
Canaan, and told him all the things that happened to them,
saying,

translation.text: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,

verses.english:
And they came to Jacob, their father, to the land of
Canaan, and told him all the things that happened to them,
saying,

verses.hebrew: דִּבֶּר הָאִישׁ אֲדֹנֵי הָאָרֶץ אִתָּנוּ קָשׁוֹת וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָנוּ כִּמְרַגְּלִים אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: דִּבֶּר הָאִישׁ אֲדֹנֵי הָאָרֶץ אִתָּנוּ קָשׁוֹת וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָנוּ כִּמְרַגְּלִים אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
“The man, the lord of the land, spoke with us hard and
accused us of spying on the land.

translation.text: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.

verses.english:
“The man, the lord of the land, spoke with us hard and
accused us of spying on the land.

verses.hebrew: וַנֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֵּנִים אֲנָחְנוּ לֹא הָיִינוּ מְרַגְּלִים׃

hebrew.text: וַנֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֵּנִים אֲנָחְנוּ לֹא הָיִינוּ מְרַגְּלִים׃

english.text: And we said to him, ‘We’re honest. We weren’t spying.

translation.text: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:

verses.english: And we said to him, ‘We’re honest. We weren’t spying.

verses.hebrew: שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֲנַחְנוּ אַחִים בְּנֵי אָבִינוּ הָאֶחָד אֵינֶנּוּ וְהַקָּטֹן הַיּוֹם אֶת אָבִינוּ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֲנַחְנוּ אַחִים בְּנֵי אָבִינוּ הָאֶחָד אֵינֶנּוּ וְהַקָּטֹן הַיּוֹם אֶת אָבִינוּ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
We’re twelve brothers, our father’s sons; one is no more,
and the youngest is with our father in the land of Canaan
today’.

translation.text: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

verses.english:
We’re twelve brothers, our father’s sons; one is no more,
and the youngest is with our father in the land of Canaan
today’.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֵינוּ הָאִישׁ אֲדֹנֵי הָאָרֶץ בְּזֹאת אֵדַע כִּי כֵנִים אַתֶּם אֲחִיכֶם הָאֶחָד הַנִּיחוּ אִתִּי וְאֶת רַעֲבוֹן בָּתֵּיכֶם קְחוּ וָלֵכוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֵינוּ הָאִישׁ אֲדֹנֵי הָאָרֶץ בְּזֹאת אֵדַע כִּי כֵנִים אַתֶּם אֲחִיכֶם הָאֶחָד הַנִּיחוּ אִתִּי וְאֶת רַעֲבוֹן בָּתֵּיכֶם קְחוּ וָלֵכוּ׃

english.text:
And the man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this
I’ll know that you’re honest: leave one brother from among
you with me, and take for the famine in your houses and
go,

translation.text: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:

verses.english:
And the man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this
I’ll know that you’re honest: leave one brother from among
you with me, and take for the famine in your houses and
go,

verses.hebrew: וְהָבִיאוּ אֶת אֲחִיכֶם הַקָּטֹן אֵלַי וְאֵדְעָה כִּי לֹא מְרַגְּלִים אַתֶּם כִּי כֵנִים אַתֶּם אֶת אֲחִיכֶם אֶתֵּן לָכֶם וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ תִּסְחָרוּ׃

And Reuben said to his father, saying, “Kill my two sons

translation.text: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.

verses.english:
And Reuben said to his father, saying, “Kill my two sons
if I don’t bring him back to you. Put him in my hand, and

And he said, “My son will not go down with you. Because
his brother’s dead, and he’s left by himself, and if some
harm would happen to him on the way in which you’re going
then you’ll bring down my gray hair in anguish to Sheol.”

translation.text: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

verses.english:
And he said, “My son will not go down with you. Because

verses.english: And the famine was heavy in the land.

And it was when they had finished eating the grain that

them, “Go back. Buy us a little food.”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.

verses.english:
And it was when they had finished eating the grain that
they had brought from Egypt: and their father said to
them, “Go back. Buy us a little food.”

translation.text: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

you.’

If you’re sending our brother with us, we’ll go down and

If you’re sending our brother with us, we’ll go down and
buy food for you,

and if you’re not sending, we won’t go down, because the

english.text:
And Israel said, “Why have you done me wrong, to tell the
man that you have another brother?”

translation.text: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?

verses.english:
And Israel said, “Why have you done me wrong, to tell the
man that you have another brother?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׁאוֹל שָׁאַל הָאִישׁ לָנוּ וּלְמוֹלַדְתֵּנוּ לֵאמֹר הַעוֹד אֲבִיכֶם חַי הֲיֵשׁ לָכֶם אָח וַנַּגֶּד לוֹ עַל פִּי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה הֲיָדוֹעַ נֵדַע כִּי יֹאמַר הוֹרִידוּ אֶת אֲחִיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׁאוֹל שָׁאַל הָאִישׁ לָנוּ וּלְמוֹלַדְתֵּנוּ לֵאמֹר הַעוֹד אֲבִיכֶם חַי הֲיֵשׁ לָכֶם אָח וַנַּגֶּד לוֹ עַל פִּי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה הֲיָדוֹעַ נֵדַע כִּי יֹאמַר הוֹרִידוּ אֶת אֲחִיכֶם׃

english.text:
And they said, “The man asked about us and about our
birthplace, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Do you
have a brother?’ And we told him about these things. Could
we have known that he would say, ‘Bring your brother
down’?”

translation.text: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

verses.english:
And they said, “The man asked about us and about our
birthplace, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Do you
have a brother?’ And we told him about these things. Could
we have known that he would say, ‘Bring your brother
down’?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבִיו שִׁלְחָה הַנַּעַר אִתִּי וְנָקוּמָה וְנֵלֵכָה וְנִחְיֶה וְלֹא נָמוּת גַּם אֲנַחְנוּ גַם אַתָּה גַּם טַפֵּנוּ׃

english.text:

me, so we may get up and go, and we’ll live and not die,
we and you and our infants as well.

translation.text: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.

verses.english:
And Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with
me, so we may get up and go, and we’ll live and not die,
we and you and our infants as well.

verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי אֶעֶרְבֶנּוּ מִיָּדִי תְּבַקְשֶׁנּוּ אִם לֹא הֲבִיאֹתִיו אֵלֶיךָ וְהִצַּגְתִּיו לְפָנֶיךָ וְחָטָאתִי לְךָ כּל הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
I’ll be security for him. You’ll seek him from my hand. If

verses.english:
I’ll be security for him. You’ll seek him from my hand. If
I don’t bring him to you and set him before you, then I’ll
have sinned against you for all time.

For, if we hadn’t delayed, by now we would have come back

For, if we hadn’t delayed, by now we would have come back

english.text:

is, then do this: Take some of the best fruit of the land
in your containers and take a gift down to the man, a
little balm and a little honey, gum and myrrh, pistachios
and almonds.

translation.text: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:

verses.english:
And Israel, their father, said to them, “If that’s how it
is, then do this: Take some of the best fruit of the land
in your containers and take a gift down to the man, a
little balm and a little honey, gum and myrrh, pistachios
and almonds.

verses.hebrew: וְכֶסֶף מִשְׁנֶה קְחוּ בְיֶדְכֶם וְאֶת הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּשָׁב בְּפִי אַמְתְּחֹתֵיכֶם תָּשִׁיבוּ בְיֶדְכֶם אוּלַי מִשְׁגֶּה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְכֶסֶף מִשְׁנֶה קְחוּ בְיֶדְכֶם וְאֶת הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּשָׁב בְּפִי אַמְתְּחֹתֵיכֶם תָּשִׁיבוּ בְיֶדְכֶם אוּלַי מִשְׁגֶּה הוּא׃

english.text:
And take double the silver in your hand, and take back in
your hand the silver that was put back in the mouth of
your bags. Maybe it was a mistake.

translation.text: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:

verses.english:
And take double the silver in your hand, and take back in
your hand the silver that was put back in the mouth of
your bags. Maybe it was a mistake.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת אֲחִיכֶם קָחוּ וְקוּמוּ שׁוּבוּ אֶל הָאִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת אֲחִיכֶם קָחוּ וְקוּמוּ שׁוּבוּ אֶל הָאִישׁ׃

english.text: And take your brother. And get up, go back to the man.

translation.text: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:

verses.english: And take your brother. And get up, go back to the man.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵל שַׁדַּי יִתֵּן לָכֶם רַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי הָאִישׁ וְשִׁלַּח לָכֶם אֶת אֲחִיכֶם אַחֵר וְאֶת בִּנְיָמִין וַאֲנִי כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁכֹלְתִּי שָׁכָלְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵל שַׁדַּי יִתֵּן לָכֶם רַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי הָאִישׁ וְשִׁלַּח לָכֶם אֶת אֲחִיכֶם אַחֵר וְאֶת בִּנְיָמִין וַאֲנִי כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁכֹלְתִּי שָׁכָלְתִּי׃

english.text:
And may El Shadday give you mercy before the man, so he’ll
send your other brother and Benjamin to you. And I: if I’m
bereaved I’m bereaved!”

translation.text: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.

verses.english:
And may El Shadday give you mercy before the man, so he’ll
send your other brother and Benjamin to you. And I: if I’m
bereaved I’m bereaved!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים אֶת הַמִּנְחָה הַזֹּאת וּמִשְׁנֶה כֶּסֶף לָקְחוּ בְיָדָם וְאֶת בִּנְיָמִן וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיֵּרְדוּ מִצְרַיִם וַיַּעַמְדוּ לִפְנֵי יוֹסֵף׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים אֶת הַמִּנְחָה הַזֹּאת וּמִשְׁנֶה כֶּסֶף לָקְחוּ בְיָדָם וְאֶת בִּנְיָמִן וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיֵּרְדוּ מִצְרַיִם וַיַּעַמְדוּ לִפְנֵי יוֹסֵף׃

english.text:
And the men took this gift and took double the silver in
their hand and Benjamin and got up and went down to Egypt
and stood before Joseph.

translation.text: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

verses.english:
And the men took this gift and took double the silver in
their hand and Benjamin and got up and went down to Egypt
and stood before Joseph.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יוֹסֵף אִתָּם אֶת בִּנְיָמִין וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲשֶׁר עַל בֵּיתוֹ הָבֵא אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים הַבָּיְתָה וּטְבֹחַ טֶבַח וְהָכֵן כִּי אִתִּי יֹאכְלוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים בַּצּהֳרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יוֹסֵף אִתָּם אֶת בִּנְיָמִין וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲשֶׁר עַל בֵּיתוֹ הָבֵא אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים הַבָּיְתָה וּטְבֹחַ טֶבַח וְהָכֵן כִּי אִתִּי יֹאכְלוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים בַּצּהֳרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Joseph saw Benjamin with them and said to the one who
was over his house, “Bring the men to the house, and
slaughter and prepare an animal, because the men will eat
with me at noon.”

translation.text: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.

verses.english:
And Joseph saw Benjamin with them and said to the one who
was over his house, “Bring the men to the house, and
slaughter and prepare an animal, because the men will eat
with me at noon.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָאִישׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר יוֹסֵף וַיָּבֵא הָאִישׁ אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים בֵּיתָה יוֹסֵף׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָאִישׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר יוֹסֵף וַיָּבֵא הָאִישׁ אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים בֵּיתָה יוֹסֵף׃

english.text:
And the man did as Joseph said, and the man brought the
men to Joseph’s house.

translation.text: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph’s house.

verses.english:
And the man did as Joseph said, and the man brought the
men to Joseph’s house.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּירְאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים כִּי הוּבְאוּ בֵּית יוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַל דְּבַר הַכֶּסֶף הַשָּׁב בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵינוּ בַּתְּחִלָּה אֲנַחְנוּ מוּבָאִים לְהִתְגֹּלֵל עָלֵינוּ וּלְהִתְנַפֵּל עָלֵינוּ וְלָקַחַת אֹתָנוּ לַעֲבָדִים וְאֶת חֲמֹרֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּירְאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים כִּי הוּבְאוּ בֵּית יוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַל דְּבַר הַכֶּסֶף הַשָּׁב בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵינוּ בַּתְּחִלָּה אֲנַחְנוּ מוּבָאִים לְהִתְגֹּלֵל עָלֵינוּ וּלְהִתְנַפֵּל עָלֵינוּ וְלָקַחַת אֹתָנוּ לַעֲבָדִים וְאֶת חֲמֹרֵינוּ׃

english.text:
And the men were afraid because they were brought to
Joseph’s house, and they said, “We’re being brought on
account of the silver that came back in our bags the first
time, in order to roll over us and to fall upon us and to
take us as slaves—and our asses.”

translation.text: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph’s house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

verses.english:
And the men were afraid because they were brought to
Joseph’s house, and they said, “We’re being brought on
account of the silver that came back in our bags the first
time, in order to roll over us and to fall upon us and to
take us as slaves—and our asses.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ אֶל הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר עַל בֵּית יוֹסֵף וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו פֶּתַח הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ אֶל הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר עַל בֵּית יוֹסֵף וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו פֶּתַח הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
And they went over to the man who was over Joseph’s house
and spoke to him at the entrance of the house

translation.text: And they came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,

verses.english:
And they went over to the man who was over Joseph’s house
and spoke to him at the entrance of the house

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בִּי אֲדֹנִי יָרֹד יָרַדְנוּ בַּתְּחִלָּה לִשְׁבּר אֹכֶל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בִּי אֲדֹנִי יָרֹד יָרַדְנוּ בַּתְּחִלָּה לִשְׁבּר אֹכֶל׃

english.text:
and said, “Please, my lord, we came down the first time to
buy food,

translation.text: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:

verses.english:
and said, “Please, my lord, we came down the first time to
buy food,

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי בָאנוּ אֶל הַמָּלוֹן וַנִּפְתְּחָה אֶת אַמְתְּחֹתֵינוּ וְהִנֵּה כֶסֶף אִישׁ בְּפִי אַמְתַּחְתּוֹ כַּסְפֵּנוּ בְּמִשְׁקָלוֹ וַנָּשֶׁב אֹתוֹ בְּיָדֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי בָאנוּ אֶל הַמָּלוֹן וַנִּפְתְּחָה אֶת אַמְתְּחֹתֵינוּ וְהִנֵּה כֶסֶף אִישׁ בְּפִי אַמְתַּחְתּוֹ כַּסְפֵּנוּ בְּמִשְׁקָלוֹ וַנָּשֶׁב אֹתוֹ בְּיָדֵנוּ׃

english.text:
and it was when we came to the lodging place, and we
opened our bags, and here was each man’s silver in the
mouth of his bag, our money in its full weight. And we’ve
brought it in our hand,

translation.text: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.

verses.english:
and it was when we came to the lodging place, and we
opened our bags, and here was each man’s silver in the
mouth of his bag, our money in its full weight. And we’ve
brought it in our hand,

verses.hebrew: וְכֶסֶף אַחֵר הוֹרַדְנוּ בְיָדֵנוּ לִשְׁבּר אֹכֶל לֹא יָדַעְנוּ מִי שָׂם כַּסְפֵּנוּ בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכֶסֶף אַחֵר הוֹרַדְנוּ בְיָדֵנוּ לִשְׁבּר אֹכֶל לֹא יָדַעְנוּ מִי שָׂם כַּסְפֵּנוּ בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵינוּ׃

english.text:
and we’ve brought down additional silver in our hand to
buy food. We don’t know who put our silver in our bags.”

translation.text: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.

verses.english:
and we’ve brought down additional silver in our hand to
buy food. We don’t know who put our silver in our bags.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם לָכֶם אַל תִּירָאוּ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבִיכֶם נָתַן לָכֶם מַטְמוֹן בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵיכֶם כַּסְפְּכֶם בָּא אֵלָי וַיּוֹצֵא אֲלֵהֶם אֶת שִׁמְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם לָכֶם אַל תִּירָאוּ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבִיכֶם נָתַן לָכֶם מַטְמוֹן בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵיכֶם כַּסְפְּכֶם בָּא אֵלָי וַיּוֹצֵא אֲלֵהֶם אֶת שִׁמְעוֹן׃

english.text:
And he said, “Peace to you. Don’t be afraid. Your God and
your father’s God put treasure in your bags for you. Your
silver came to me.” And he brought Simeon out to them.

translation.text: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.

verses.english:
And he said, “Peace to you. Don’t be afraid. Your God and
your father’s God put treasure in your bags for you. Your
silver came to me.” And he brought Simeon out to them.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֵא הָאִישׁ אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים בֵּיתָה יוֹסֵף וַיִּתֶּן מַיִם וַיִּרְחֲצוּ רַגְלֵיהֶם וַיִּתֵּן מִסְפּוֹא לַחֲמֹרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֵא הָאִישׁ אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים בֵּיתָה יוֹסֵף וַיִּתֶּן מַיִם וַיִּרְחֲצוּ רַגְלֵיהֶם וַיִּתֵּן מִסְפּוֹא לַחֲמֹרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And the man brought the men to Joseph’s house, and he gave
water, and they washed their feet, and he gave fodder for
their asses.

translation.text: And the man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.

verses.english:
And the man brought the men to Joseph’s house, and he gave
water, and they washed their feet, and he gave fodder for
their asses.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּכִינוּ אֶת הַמִּנְחָה עַד בּוֹא יוֹסֵף בַּצּהֳרָיִם כִּי שָׁמְעוּ כִּי שָׁם יֹאכְלוּ לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּכִינוּ אֶת הַמִּנְחָה עַד בּוֹא יוֹסֵף בַּצּהֳרָיִם כִּי שָׁמְעוּ כִּי שָׁם יֹאכְלוּ לָחֶם׃

english.text:
And they prepared the gift until Joseph’s arrival at noon
because they heard that they would eat bread there.

translation.text: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.

verses.english:
And they prepared the gift until Joseph’s arrival at noon
because they heard that they would eat bread there.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יוֹסֵף הַבַּיְתָה וַיָּבִיאּוּ לוֹ אֶת הַמִּנְחָה אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדָם הַבָּיְתָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לוֹ אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יוֹסֵף הַבַּיְתָה וַיָּבִיאּוּ לוֹ אֶת הַמִּנְחָה אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדָם הַבָּיְתָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לוֹ אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
And Joseph came to the house, and they brought the gift
for him that was in their hand to the house, and they
bowed to him to the ground.

translation.text: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.

verses.english:
And Joseph came to the house, and they brought the gift
for him that was in their hand to the house, and they
bowed to him to the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל לָהֶם לְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם אֲבִיכֶם הַזָּקֵן אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם הַעוֹדֶנּוּ חָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל לָהֶם לְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם אֲבִיכֶם הַזָּקֵן אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם הַעוֹדֶנּוּ חָי׃

english.text:
And he asked if they were well, and he said, “Is your old
father whom you mentioned well? Is he still alive?”

translation.text: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?

verses.english:
And he asked if they were well, and he said, “Is your old
father whom you mentioned well? Is he still alive?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׁלוֹם לְעַבְדְּךָ לְאָבִינוּ עוֹדֶנּוּ חָי וַיִּקְּדוּ (וישתחו) [וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ]׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׁלוֹם לְעַבְדְּךָ לְאָבִינוּ עוֹדֶנּוּ חָי וַיִּקְּדוּ (וישתחו) [וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ]׃

english.text:
And they said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He’s
still alive.” And they knelt and bowed.

translation.text: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.

verses.english:
And they said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He’s
still alive.” And they knelt and bowed.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת בִּנְיָמִין אָחִיו בֶּן אִמּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲזֶה אֲחִיכֶם הַקָּטֹן אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם אֵלָי וַיֹּאמַר אֱלֹהִים יחְנְךָ בְּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת בִּנְיָמִין אָחִיו בֶּן אִמּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲזֶה אֲחִיכֶם הַקָּטֹן אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם אֵלָי וַיֹּאמַר אֱלֹהִים יחְנְךָ בְּנִי׃

english.text:
And he raised his eyes and saw Benjamin, his brother, his
mother’s son, and said, “Is this your youngest brother
whom you mentioned to me?” And he said, “May God be
gracious to you, my son.”

translation.text: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother’s son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.

verses.english:
And he raised his eyes and saw Benjamin, his brother, his
mother’s son, and said, “Is this your youngest brother
whom you mentioned to me?” And he said, “May God be
gracious to you, my son.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֵר יוֹסֵף כִּי נִכְמְרוּ רַחֲמָיו אֶל אָחִיו וַיְבַקֵּשׁ לִבְכּוֹת וַיָּבֹא הַחַדְרָה וַיֵּבְךְּ שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַהֵר יוֹסֵף כִּי נִכְמְרוּ רַחֲמָיו אֶל אָחִיו וַיְבַקֵּשׁ לִבְכּוֹת וַיָּבֹא הַחַדְרָה וַיֵּבְךְּ שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And Joseph hurried because his feelings for his brother
were boiling, and he looked for a place to weep and came
to his room and wept there.

translation.text: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.

verses.english:
And Joseph hurried because his feelings for his brother
were boiling, and he looked for a place to weep and came
to his room and wept there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְחַץ פָּנָיו וַיֵּצֵא וַיִּתְאַפַּק וַיֹּאמֶר שִׂימוּ לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְחַץ פָּנָיו וַיֵּצֵא וַיִּתְאַפַּק וַיֹּאמֶר שִׂימוּ לָחֶם׃

english.text:
And he washed his face and went out and restrained himself
and said, “Put out bread.”

translation.text: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.

verses.english:
And he washed his face and went out and restrained himself
and said, “Put out bread.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ לוֹ לְבַדּוֹ וְלָהֶם לְבַדָּם וְלַמִּצְרִים הָאֹכְלִים אִתּוֹ לְבַדָּם כִּי לֹא יוּכְלוּן הַמִּצְרִים לֶאֱכֹל אֶת הָעִבְרִים לֶחֶם כִּי תוֹעֵבָה הִוא לְמִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ לוֹ לְבַדּוֹ וְלָהֶם לְבַדָּם וְלַמִּצְרִים הָאֹכְלִים אִתּוֹ לְבַדָּם כִּי לֹא יוּכְלוּן הַמִּצְרִים לֶאֱכֹל אֶת הָעִבְרִים לֶחֶם כִּי תוֹעֵבָה הִוא לְמִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And they put it out for him by himself and for them by
themselves and for the Egyptians who were eating with him
by themselves, because the Egyptians could not eat bread
with the Hebrews because that is an offensive thing to
Egypt.

translation.text: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

verses.english:
And they put it out for him by himself and for them by
themselves and for the Egyptians who were eating with him
by themselves, because the Egyptians could not eat bread
with the Hebrews because that is an offensive thing to
Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ לְפָנָיו הַבְּכֹר כִּבְכֹרָתוֹ וְהַצָּעִיר כִּצְעִרָתוֹ וַיִּתְמְהוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ לְפָנָיו הַבְּכֹר כִּבְכֹרָתוֹ וְהַצָּעִיר כִּצְעִרָתוֹ וַיִּתְמְהוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ׃

english.text:
And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his
birthright and the youngest according to his youth. And
the men looked amazed at one another.

translation.text: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.

verses.english:
And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his
birthright and the youngest according to his youth. And
the men looked amazed at one another.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא מַשְׂאֹת מֵאֵת פָּנָיו אֲלֵהֶם וַתֵּרֶב מַשְׂאַת בִּנְיָמִן מִמַּשְׂאֹת כֻּלָּם חָמֵשׁ יָדוֹת וַיִּשְׁתּוּ וַיִּשְׁכְּרוּ עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא מַשְׂאֹת מֵאֵת פָּנָיו אֲלֵהֶם וַתֵּרֶב מַשְׂאַת בִּנְיָמִן מִמַּשְׂאֹת כֻּלָּם חָמֵשׁ יָדוֹת וַיִּשְׁתּוּ וַיִּשְׁכְּרוּ עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And he conveyed portions from before him to them, and he
made Benjamin’s portion five times more than the portions
of all of them, and they drank and were drunk with him.

translation.text: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin’s mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.

verses.english:
And he conveyed portions from before him to them, and he
made Benjamin’s portion five times more than the portions
of all of them, and they drank and were drunk with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו אֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל בֵּיתוֹ לֵאמֹר מַלֵּא אֶת אַמְתְּחֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים אֹכֶל כַּאֲשֶׁר יוּכְלוּן שְׂאֵת וְשִׂים כֶּסֶף אִישׁ בְּפִי אַמְתַּחְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו אֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל בֵּיתוֹ לֵאמֹר מַלֵּא אֶת אַמְתְּחֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים אֹכֶל כַּאֲשֶׁר יוּכְלוּן שְׂאֵת וְשִׂים כֶּסֶף אִישׁ בְּפִי אַמְתַּחְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And he commanded the one who was over his house,
saying, “Fill the men’s bags with as much food as they can
carry and put each man’s silver in the mouth of his bag,

translation.text: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man’s money in his sack’s mouth.

verses.english:
And he commanded the one who was over his house,
saying, “Fill the men’s bags with as much food as they can
carry and put each man’s silver in the mouth of his bag,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת גְּבִיעִי גְּבִיעַ הַכֶּסֶף תָּשִׂים בְּפִי אַמְתַּחַת הַקָּטֹן וְאֵת כֶּסֶף שִׁבְרוֹ וַיַּעַשׂ כִּדְבַר יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת גְּבִיעִי גְּבִיעַ הַכֶּסֶף תָּשִׂים בְּפִי אַמְתַּחַת הַקָּטֹן וְאֵת כֶּסֶף שִׁבְרוֹ וַיַּעַשׂ כִּדְבַר יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃

english.text:
and put my cup, the silver cup, in the mouth of the
youngest one’s bag, and the silver for his grain.” And he
did according to Joseph’s word that he spoke.

translation.text: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

verses.english:
and put my cup, the silver cup, in the mouth of the
youngest one’s bag, and the silver for his grain.” And he
did according to Joseph’s word that he spoke.

verses.hebrew: הַבֹּקֶר אוֹר וְהָאֲנָשִׁים שֻׁלְּחוּ הֵמָּה וַחֲמֹרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: הַבֹּקֶר אוֹר וְהָאֲנָשִׁים שֻׁלְּחוּ הֵמָּה וַחֲמֹרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
The morning was light: and the men had been sent away,
they and their asses.

translation.text: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

verses.english:
The morning was light: and the men had been sent away,
they and their asses.

verses.hebrew: הֵם יָצְאוּ אֶת הָעִיר לֹא הִרְחִיקוּ וְיוֹסֵף אָמַר לַאֲשֶׁר עַל בֵּיתוֹ קוּם רְדֹף אַחֲרֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים וְהִשַּׂגְתָּם וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם לָמָּה שִׁלַּמְתֶּם רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה׃

hebrew.text: הֵם יָצְאוּ אֶת הָעִיר לֹא הִרְחִיקוּ וְיוֹסֵף אָמַר לַאֲשֶׁר עַל בֵּיתוֹ קוּם רְדֹף אַחֲרֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים וְהִשַּׂגְתָּם וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם לָמָּה שִׁלַּמְתֶּם רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה׃

english.text:
They had gone out of the city. They had not gone far, and
Joseph had said to the one who was over his house, “Get
up. Pursue the men, and you’ll catch up with them and say
to them, ‘Why did you pay back bad for good?

translation.text: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?

verses.english:
They had gone out of the city. They had not gone far, and
Joseph had said to the one who was over his house, “Get
up. Pursue the men, and you’ll catch up with them and say
to them, ‘Why did you pay back bad for good?

verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא זֶה אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁתֶּה אֲדֹנִי בּוֹ וְהוּא נַחֵשׁ יְנַחֵשׁ בּוֹ הֲרֵעֹתֶם אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם׃

hebrew.text: הֲלוֹא זֶה אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁתֶּה אֲדֹנִי בּוֹ וְהוּא נַחֵשׁ יְנַחֵשׁ בּוֹ הֲרֵעֹתֶם אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם׃

english.text:
Isn’t this the thing from which my lord drinks? And he
divines by it! You’ve done bad, this thing that you’ve
done.’”

translation.text: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.

verses.english:
Isn’t this the thing from which my lord drinks? And he
divines by it! You’ve done bad, this thing that you’ve
done.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשִּׂגֵם וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשִּׂגֵם וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text: And he caught up with them and spoke these things to them.

translation.text: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.

verses.english: And he caught up with them and spoke these things to them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו לָמָּה יְדַבֵּר אֲדֹנִי כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה חָלִילָה לַעֲבָדֶיךָ מֵעֲשׂוֹת כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו לָמָּה יְדַבֵּר אֲדֹנִי כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה חָלִילָה לַעֲבָדֶיךָ מֵעֲשׂוֹת כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And they said to him, “Why would my lord speak things like
these? Far be it from your servants to do a thing like
this.

translation.text: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:

verses.english:
And they said to him, “Why would my lord speak things like
these? Far be it from your servants to do a thing like
this.

verses.hebrew: הֵן כֶּסֶף אֲשֶׁר מָצָאנוּ בְּפִי אַמְתְּחֹתֵינוּ הֱשִׁיבֹנוּ אֵלֶיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְאֵיךְ נִגְנֹב מִבֵּית אֲדֹנֶיךָ כֶּסֶף אוֹ זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: הֵן כֶּסֶף אֲשֶׁר מָצָאנוּ בְּפִי אַמְתְּחֹתֵינוּ הֱשִׁיבֹנוּ אֵלֶיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְאֵיךְ נִגְנֹב מִבֵּית אֲדֹנֶיךָ כֶּסֶף אוֹ זָהָב׃

english.text:
Here, we brought the silver that we found in the mouth of
our bags back to you from the land of Canaan, so how would
we steal silver or gold from your lord’s house?!

translation.text: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord’s house silver or gold?

verses.english:
Here, we brought the silver that we found in the mouth of
our bags back to you from the land of Canaan, so how would
we steal silver or gold from your lord’s house?!

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר יִמָּצֵא אִתּוֹ מֵעֲבָדֶיךָ וָמֵת וְגַם אֲנַחְנוּ נִהְיֶה לַאדֹנִי לַעֲבָדִים׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר יִמָּצֵא אִתּוֹ מֵעֲבָדֶיךָ וָמֵת וְגַם אֲנַחְנוּ נִהְיֶה לַאדֹנִי לַעֲבָדִים׃

english.text:
The one among your servants with whom it’s found, let him
die, and also we’ll become my lord’s servants.”

translation.text: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord’s bondmen.

verses.english:
The one among your servants with whom it’s found, let him
die, and also we’ll become my lord’s servants.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם עַתָּה כְדִבְרֵיכֶם כֶּן הוּא אֲשֶׁר יִמָּצֵא אִתּוֹ יִהְיֶה לִּי עָבֶד וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ נְקִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם עַתָּה כְדִבְרֵיכֶם כֶּן הוּא אֲשֶׁר יִמָּצֵא אִתּוֹ יִהְיֶה לִּי עָבֶד וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ נְקִיִּם׃

english.text:
And he said, “Now, also, it will be so according to your
words: the one with whom it’s found will become my
servant. And you will be free.”

translation.text: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.

verses.english:
And he said, “Now, also, it will be so according to your
words: the one with whom it’s found will become my
servant. And you will be free.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֲרוּ וַיּוֹרִדוּ אִישׁ אֶת אַמְתַּחְתּוֹ אָרְצָה וַיִּפְתְּחוּ אִישׁ אַמְתַּחְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַהֲרוּ וַיּוֹרִדוּ אִישׁ אֶת אַמְתַּחְתּוֹ אָרְצָה וַיִּפְתְּחוּ אִישׁ אַמְתַּחְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And they hurried, and each man lowered his bag to the
ground, and each man opened his bag.

verses.english:
And they hurried, and each man lowered his bag to the
ground, and each man opened his bag.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַפֵּשׂ בַּגָּדוֹל הֵחֵל וּבַקָּטֹן כִּלָּה וַיִּמָּצֵא הַגָּבִיעַ בְּאַמְתַּחַת בִּנְיָמִן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחַפֵּשׂ בַּגָּדוֹל הֵחֵל וּבַקָּטֹן כִּלָּה וַיִּמָּצֵא הַגָּבִיעַ בְּאַמְתַּחַת בִּנְיָמִן׃

english.text:
And he searched. With the oldest he began, and with the
youngest he finished. And the cup was found in Benjamin’s
bag.

translation.text: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

verses.english:
And he searched. With the oldest he began, and with the
youngest he finished. And the cup was found in Benjamin’s
bag.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְעוּ שִׂמְלֹתָם וַיַּעֲמֹס אִישׁ עַל חֲמֹרוֹ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הָעִירָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְעוּ שִׂמְלֹתָם וַיַּעֲמֹס אִישׁ עַל חֲמֹרוֹ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הָעִירָה׃

english.text:
And they ripped their clothes, and each man loaded his
ass, and they went back to the city.

translation.text: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.

verses.english:
And they ripped their clothes, and each man loaded his
ass, and they went back to the city.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יְהוּדָה וְאֶחָיו בֵּיתָה יוֹסֵף וְהוּא עוֹדֶנּוּ שָׁם וַיִּפְּלוּ לְפָנָיו אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יְהוּדָה וְאֶחָיו בֵּיתָה יוֹסֵף וְהוּא עוֹדֶנּוּ שָׁם וַיִּפְּלוּ לְפָנָיו אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
And Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he
was still there, and they fell to the ground before him.

translation.text: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph’s house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.

verses.english:
And Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he
was still there, and they fell to the ground before him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם יוֹסֵף מָה הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם הֲלוֹא יְדַעְתֶּם כִּי נַחֵשׁ יְנַחֵשׁ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר כָּמֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם יוֹסֵף מָה הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם הֲלוֹא יְדַעְתֶּם כִּי נַחֵשׁ יְנַחֵשׁ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר כָּמֹנִי׃

english.text:
And Joseph said to them, “What is this thing that you’ve
done? Didn’t you know that a man like me would divine?”

translation.text: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?

verses.english:
And Joseph said to them, “What is this thing that you’ve
done? Didn’t you know that a man like me would divine?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה מַה נֹּאמַר לַאדֹנִי מַה נְּדַבֵּר וּמַה נִּצְטַדָּק הָאֱלֹהִים מָצָא אֶת עֲוֺן עֲבָדֶיךָ הִנֶּנּוּ עֲבָדִים לַאדֹנִי גַּם אֲנַחְנוּ גַּם אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא הַגָּבִיעַ בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה מַה נֹּאמַר לַאדֹנִי מַה נְּדַבֵּר וּמַה נִּצְטַדָּק הָאֱלֹהִים מָצָא אֶת עֲוֺן עֲבָדֶיךָ הִנֶּנּוּ עֲבָדִים לַאדֹנִי גַּם אֲנַחְנוּ גַּם אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא הַגָּבִיעַ בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
And Judah said, “What shall we say to my lord? What shall
we speak? By what shall we justify ourselves? has
found your servants’ crime. Here we’re my lord’s servants,
both we and the one in whose hand the cup was found.”

translation.text: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord’s servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.

verses.english:
And Judah said, “What shall we say to my lord? What shall
we speak? By what shall we justify ourselves? has
found your servants’ crime. Here we’re my lord’s servants,
both we and the one in whose hand the cup was found.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חָלִילָה לִּי מֵעֲשׂוֹת זֹאת הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא הַגָּבִיעַ בְּיָדוֹ הוּא יִהְיֶה לִּי עָבֶד וְאַתֶּם עֲלוּ לְשָׁלוֹם אֶל אֲבִיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר חָלִילָה לִּי מֵעֲשׂוֹת זֹאת הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא הַגָּבִיעַ בְּיָדוֹ הוּא יִהְיֶה לִּי עָבֶד וְאַתֶּם עֲלוּ לְשָׁלוֹם אֶל אֲבִיכֶם׃

english.text:
And he said, “Far be it from me to do this. The man in
whose hand the cup was found: he will be my servant; and
you, go up in peace to your father.”

translation.text: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.

verses.english:
And he said, “Far be it from me to do this. The man in
whose hand the cup was found: he will be my servant; and
you, go up in peace to your father.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ אֵלָיו יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר בִּי אֲדֹנִי יְדַבֶּר נָא עַבְדְּךָ דָבָר בְּאזְנֵי אֲדֹנִי וְאַל יִחַר אַפְּךָ בְּעַבְדֶּךָ כִּי כָמוֹךָ כְּפַרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגַּשׁ אֵלָיו יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר בִּי אֲדֹנִי יְדַבֶּר נָא עַבְדְּךָ דָבָר בְּאזְנֵי אֲדֹנִי וְאַל יִחַר אַפְּךָ בְּעַבְדֶּךָ כִּי כָמוֹךָ כְּפַרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Judah went over to him and said,
“Please, my lord, let your servant speak something in my
lord’s ears, and let your anger not flare at your servant,
because you’re like Pharaoh himself.

translation.text: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord’s ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.

verses.english:
And Judah went over to him and said,
“Please, my lord, let your servant speak something in my
lord’s ears, and let your anger not flare at your servant,
because you’re like Pharaoh himself.

verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנִי שָׁאַל אֶת עֲבָדָיו לֵאמֹר הֲיֵשׁ לָכֶם אָב אוֹ אָח׃

hebrew.text: אֲדֹנִי שָׁאַל אֶת עֲבָדָיו לֵאמֹר הֲיֵשׁ לָכֶם אָב אוֹ אָח׃

english.text:
My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Do you have a father
or brother?’

translation.text: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?

verses.english:
My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Do you have a father
or brother?’

verses.hebrew: וַנֹּאמֶר אֶל אֲדֹנִי יֶשׁ לָנוּ אָב זָקֵן וְיֶלֶד זְקֻנִים קָטָן וְאָחִיו מֵת וַיִּוָּתֵר הוּא לְבַדּוֹ לְאִמּוֹ וְאָבִיו אֲהֵבוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַנֹּאמֶר אֶל אֲדֹנִי יֶשׁ לָנוּ אָב זָקֵן וְיֶלֶד זְקֻנִים קָטָן וְאָחִיו מֵת וַיִּוָּתֵר הוּא לְבַדּוֹ לְאִמּוֹ וְאָבִיו אֲהֵבוֹ׃

english.text:
and we said to my lord, ‘We have an old father and a young
son of his old age, and his brother’s dead, and he’s left
alone of his mother, and his father loves him.’

translation.text: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.

verses.english:
and we said to my lord, ‘We have an old father and a young
son of his old age, and his brother’s dead, and he’s left
alone of his mother, and his father loves him.’

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל עֲבָדֶיךָ הוֹרִדֻהוּ אֵלָי וְאָשִׂימָה עֵינִי עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל עֲבָדֶיךָ הוֹרִדֻהוּ אֵלָי וְאָשִׂימָה עֵינִי עָלָיו׃

english.text:
And you said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, so I
may set my eye on him.’

translation.text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.

verses.english:
And you said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, so I
may set my eye on him.’

verses.hebrew: וַנֹּאמֶר אֶל אֲדֹנִי לֹא יוּכַל הַנַּעַר לַעֲזֹב אֶת אָבִיו וְעָזַב אֶת אָבִיו וָמֵת׃

hebrew.text: וַנֹּאמֶר אֶל אֲדֹנִי לֹא יוּכַל הַנַּעַר לַעֲזֹב אֶת אָבִיו וְעָזַב אֶת אָבִיו וָמֵת׃

english.text:
And we said to my lord, The boy can’t leave his father; if
he left his father he’d die.’

translation.text: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.

verses.english:
And we said to my lord, The boy can’t leave his father; if
he left his father he’d die.’

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל עֲבָדֶיךָ אִם לֹא יֵרֵד אֲחִיכֶם הַקָּטֹן אִתְּכֶם לֹא תֹסִפוּן לִרְאוֹת פָּנָי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל עֲבָדֶיךָ אִם לֹא יֵרֵד אֲחִיכֶם הַקָּטֹן אִתְּכֶם לֹא תֹסִפוּן לִרְאוֹת פָּנָי׃

english.text:
And you said to your servants, ‘If your youngest brother
doesn’t come down with you, you won’t see my face again.’

translation.text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.

verses.english:
And you said to your servants, ‘If your youngest brother
doesn’t come down with you, you won’t see my face again.’

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי עָלִינוּ אֶל עַבְדְּךָ אָבִי וַנַּגֶּד לוֹ אֵת דִּבְרֵי אֲדֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי עָלִינוּ אֶל עַבְדְּךָ אָבִי וַנַּגֶּד לוֹ אֵת דִּבְרֵי אֲדֹנִי׃

english.text:
And it was, when we went up to your servant, my father,
and told him my lord’s words,

translation.text: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

verses.english:
And it was, when we went up to your servant, my father,
and told him my lord’s words,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִינוּ שֻׁבוּ שִׁבְרוּ לָנוּ מְעַט אֹכֶל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִינוּ שֻׁבוּ שִׁבְרוּ לָנוּ מְעַט אֹכֶל׃

english.text: that our father said, ‘Go back. Buy us a little food.’

translation.text: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.

verses.english: that our father said, ‘Go back. Buy us a little food.’

verses.hebrew: וַנֹּאמֶר לֹא נוּכַל לָרֶדֶת אִם יֵשׁ אָחִינוּ הַקָּטֹן אִתָּנוּ וְיָרַדְנוּ כִּי לֹא נוּכַל לִרְאוֹת פְּנֵי הָאִישׁ וְאָחִינוּ הַקָּטֹן אֵינֶנּוּ אִתָּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַנֹּאמֶר לֹא נוּכַל לָרֶדֶת אִם יֵשׁ אָחִינוּ הַקָּטֹן אִתָּנוּ וְיָרַדְנוּ כִּי לֹא נוּכַל לִרְאוֹת פְּנֵי הָאִישׁ וְאָחִינוּ הַקָּטֹן אֵינֶנּוּ אִתָּנוּ׃

english.text:
And we said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is
with us then we’ll go down, because we can’t see the man’s
face if our youngest brother isn’t with us.’

translation.text: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man’s face, except our youngest brother be with us.

verses.english:
And we said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is
with us then we’ll go down, because we can’t see the man’s
face if our youngest brother isn’t with us.’

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר עַבְדְּךָ אָבִי אֵלֵינוּ אַתֶּם יְדַעְתֶּם כִּי שְׁנַיִם יָלְדָה לִּי אִשְׁתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר עַבְדְּךָ אָבִי אֵלֵינוּ אַתֶּם יְדַעְתֶּם כִּי שְׁנַיִם יָלְדָה לִּי אִשְׁתִּי׃

english.text:
And your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my
wife gave birth to two for me,

translation.text: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:

verses.english:
And your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my
wife gave birth to two for me,

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הָאֶחָד מֵאִתִּי וָאֹמַר אַךְ טָרֹף טֹרָף וְלֹא רְאִיתִיו עַד הֵנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא הָאֶחָד מֵאִתִּי וָאֹמַר אַךְ טָרֹף טֹרָף וְלֹא רְאִיתִיו עַד הֵנָּה׃

english.text:
and one went away from me, and I said he’s surely torn up,
and I haven’t seen him since.

translation.text: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:

verses.english:
and one went away from me, and I said he’s surely torn up,
and I haven’t seen him since.

verses.hebrew: וּלְקַחְתֶּם גַּם אֶת זֶה מֵעִם פָּנַי וְקָרָהוּ אָסוֹן וְהוֹרַדְתֶּם אֶת שֵׂיבָתִי בְּרָעָה שְׁאֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וּלְקַחְתֶּם גַּם אֶת זֶה מֵעִם פָּנַי וְקָרָהוּ אָסוֹן וְהוֹרַדְתֶּם אֶת שֵׂיבָתִי בְּרָעָה שְׁאֹלָה׃

english.text:
And if you take this one from me as well and some harm
happens to him, then you’ll bring down my gray hair in
wretchedness to Sheol.’

translation.text: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

verses.english:
And if you take this one from me as well and some harm
happens to him, then you’ll bring down my gray hair in
wretchedness to Sheol.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה כְּבֹאִי אֶל עַבְדְּךָ אָבִי וְהַנַּעַר אֵינֶנּוּ אִתָּנוּ וְנַפְשׁוֹ קְשׁוּרָה בְנַפְשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה כְּבֹאִי אֶל עַבְדְּךָ אָבִי וְהַנַּעַר אֵינֶנּוּ אִתָּנוּ וְנַפְשׁוֹ קְשׁוּרָה בְנַפְשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
And now, when I come to your servant, my father, and the
boy isn’t with us, and he’s bound to him soul to soul,

translation.text: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad’s life;

verses.english:
And now, when I come to your servant, my father, and the
boy isn’t with us, and he’s bound to him soul to soul,

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּרְאוֹתוֹ כִּי אֵין הַנַּעַר וָמֵת וְהוֹרִידוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶת שֵׂיבַת עַבְדְּךָ אָבִינוּ בְּיָגוֹן שְׁאֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּרְאוֹתוֹ כִּי אֵין הַנַּעַר וָמֵת וְהוֹרִידוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶת שֵׂיבַת עַבְדְּךָ אָבִינוּ בְּיָגוֹן שְׁאֹלָה׃

english.text:
it will be, when he sees that the boy isn’t there, that
he’ll die. And your servants will have brought down your
servant our father’s gray hair in anguish to Sheol,

translation.text: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

verses.english:
it will be, when he sees that the boy isn’t there, that
he’ll die. And your servants will have brought down your
servant our father’s gray hair in anguish to Sheol,

verses.hebrew: כִּי עַבְדְּךָ עָרַב אֶת הַנַּעַר מֵעִם אָבִי לֵאמֹר אִם לֹא אֲבִיאֶנּוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְחָטָאתִי לְאָבִי כּל הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: כִּי עַבְדְּךָ עָרַב אֶת הַנַּעַר מֵעִם אָבִי לֵאמֹר אִם לֹא אֲבִיאֶנּוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְחָטָאתִי לְאָבִי כּל הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
because your servant offered security for the boy to my
father, saying, ‘If I don’t bring him to you, then I’ll
have sinned against my father for all time.’

translation.text: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.

verses.english:
because your servant offered security for the boy to my
father, saying, ‘If I don’t bring him to you, then I’ll
have sinned against my father for all time.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יֵשֶׁב נָא עַבְדְּךָ תַּחַת הַנַּעַר עֶבֶד לַאדֹנִי וְהַנַּעַר יַעַל עִם אֶחָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה יֵשֶׁב נָא עַבְדְּךָ תַּחַת הַנַּעַר עֶבֶד לַאדֹנִי וְהַנַּעַר יַעַל עִם אֶחָיו׃

english.text:
And now, let your servant stay as my lord’s servant in
place of the boy, and let the boy go up with his brothers—

translation.text: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.

verses.english:
And now, let your servant stay as my lord’s servant in
place of the boy, and let the boy go up with his brothers—

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵיךְ אֶעֱלֶה אֶל אָבִי וְהַנַּעַר אֵינֶנּוּ אִתִּי פֶּן אֶרְאֶה בָרָע אֲשֶׁר יִמְצָא אֶת אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֵיךְ אֶעֱלֶה אֶל אָבִי וְהַנַּעַר אֵינֶנּוּ אִתִּי פֶּן אֶרְאֶה בָרָע אֲשֶׁר יִמְצָא אֶת אָבִי׃

english.text:
for how could I go up to my father and the boy isn’t with
me—or else I’ll see the wretchedness that will find my
father.”

translation.text: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.

verses.english:
for how could I go up to my father and the boy isn’t with
me—or else I’ll see the wretchedness that will find my
father.”

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יָכֹל יוֹסֵף לְהִתְאַפֵּק לְכֹל הַנִּצָּבִים עָלָיו וַיִּקְרָא הוֹצִיאוּ כל אִישׁ מֵעָלָי וְלֹא עָמַד אִישׁ אִתּוֹ בְּהִתְוַדַּע יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יָכֹל יוֹסֵף לְהִתְאַפֵּק לְכֹל הַנִּצָּבִים עָלָיו וַיִּקְרָא הוֹצִיאוּ כל אִישׁ מֵעָלָי וְלֹא עָמַד אִישׁ אִתּוֹ בְּהִתְוַדַּע יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו׃

english.text:
And Joseph was not able to restrain himself in front of
everyone who was standing by him, and he called, “Take
everyone out from my presence.” And not a man stood with
him when Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

translation.text: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

verses.english:
And Joseph was not able to restrain himself in front of
everyone who was standing by him, and he called, “Take
everyone out from my presence.” And not a man stood with
him when Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת קֹלוֹ בִּבְכִי וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ מִצְרַיִם וַיִּשְׁמַע בֵּית פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת קֹלוֹ בִּבְכִי וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ מִצְרַיִם וַיִּשְׁמַע בֵּית פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And he wept out loud. And Egypt heard, and Pharaoh’s house
heard.

translation.text: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

verses.english:
And he wept out loud. And Egypt heard, and Pharaoh’s house
heard.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו אֲנִי יוֹסֵף הַעוֹד אָבִי חָי וְלֹא יָכְלוּ אֶחָיו לַעֲנוֹת אֹתוֹ כִּי נִבְהֲלוּ מִפָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו אֲנִי יוֹסֵף הַעוֹד אָבִי חָי וְלֹא יָכְלוּ אֶחָיו לַעֲנוֹת אֹתוֹ כִּי נִבְהֲלוּ מִפָּנָיו׃

english.text:
And Joseph said to his brothers, “I’m Joseph. Is my father
still alive?” And his brothers were not able to answer
him, because they were terrified in front of him.

translation.text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.

verses.english:
And Joseph said to his brothers, “I’m Joseph. Is my father
still alive?” And his brothers were not able to answer
him, because they were terrified in front of him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו גְּשׁוּ נָא אֵלַי וַיִּגָּשׁוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי יוֹסֵף אֲחִיכֶם אֲשֶׁר מְכַרְתֶּם אֹתִי מִצְרָיְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו גְּשׁוּ נָא אֵלַי וַיִּגָּשׁוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי יוֹסֵף אֲחִיכֶם אֲשֶׁר מְכַרְתֶּם אֹתִי מִצְרָיְמָה׃

english.text:
And Joseph said to his brothers, “Come over to me.” And
they went over. And he said, “I’m Joseph, your brother,
whom you sold to Egypt.

translation.text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

verses.english:
And Joseph said to his brothers, “Come over to me.” And
they went over. And he said, “I’m Joseph, your brother,
whom you sold to Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אַל תֵּעָצְבוּ וְאַל יִחַר בְּעֵינֵיכֶם כִּי מְכַרְתֶּם אֹתִי הֵנָּה כִּי לְמִחְיָה שְׁלָחַנִי אֱלֹהִים לִפְנֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אַל תֵּעָצְבוּ וְאַל יִחַר בְּעֵינֵיכֶם כִּי מְכַרְתֶּם אֹתִי הֵנָּה כִּי לְמִחְיָה שְׁלָחַנִי אֱלֹהִים לִפְנֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And now, don’t be sad and let there be no anger in your
eyes because you sold me here, because God sent me before
you to preserve life.

translation.text: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

verses.english:
And now, don’t be sad and let there be no anger in your
eyes because you sold me here, because God sent me before
you to preserve life.

verses.hebrew: כִּי זֶה שְׁנָתַיִם הָרָעָב בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ וְעוֹד חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים אֲשֶׁר אֵין חָרִישׁ וְקָצִיר׃

hebrew.text: כִּי זֶה שְׁנָתַיִם הָרָעָב בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ וְעוֹד חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים אֲשֶׁר אֵין חָרִישׁ וְקָצִיר׃

english.text:
For it’s two years that the famine is in the land, and for
five more years there’ll be no plowing and harvest.

translation.text: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.

verses.english:
For it’s two years that the famine is in the land, and for
five more years there’ll be no plowing and harvest.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלָחֵנִי אֱלֹהִים לִפְנֵיכֶם לָשׂוּם לָכֶם שְׁאֵרִית בָּאָרֶץ וּלְהַחֲיוֹת לָכֶם לִפְלֵיטָה גְּדֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלָחֵנִי אֱלֹהִים לִפְנֵיכֶם לָשׂוּם לָכֶם שְׁאֵרִית בָּאָרֶץ וּלְהַחֲיוֹת לָכֶם לִפְלֵיטָה גְּדֹלָה׃

english.text:
And God sent me ahead of you to provide a remnant for you
in the earth and to keep you alive as a big, surviving
community.

translation.text: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

verses.english:
And God sent me ahead of you to provide a remnant for you
in the earth and to keep you alive as a big, surviving
community.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לֹא אַתֶּם שְׁלַחְתֶּם אֹתִי הֵנָּה כִּי הָאֱלֹהִים וַיְשִׂימֵנִי לְאָב לְפַרְעֹה וּלְאָדוֹן לְכל בֵּיתוֹ וּמֹשֵׁל בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לֹא אַתֶּם שְׁלַחְתֶּם אֹתִי הֵנָּה כִּי הָאֱלֹהִים וַיְשִׂימֵנִי לְאָב לְפַרְעֹה וּלְאָדוֹן לְכל בֵּיתוֹ וּמֹשֵׁל בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And now, it wasn’t you who sent me here, but God, and he
made me into a father to Pharaoh and a lord to all his
house and a ruler in all the land of Egypt.

translation.text: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And now, it wasn’t you who sent me here, but God, and he
made me into a father to Pharaoh and a lord to all his
house and a ruler in all the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: מַהֲרוּ וַעֲלוּ אֶל אָבִי וַאֲמַרְתֶּם אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר בִּנְךָ יוֹסֵף שָׂמַנִי אֱלֹהִים לְאָדוֹן לְכל מִצְרָיִם רְדָה אֵלַי אַל תַּעֲמֹד׃

hebrew.text: מַהֲרוּ וַעֲלוּ אֶל אָבִי וַאֲמַרְתֶּם אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר בִּנְךָ יוֹסֵף שָׂמַנִי אֱלֹהִים לְאָדוֹן לְכל מִצְרָיִם רְדָה אֵלַי אַל תַּעֲמֹד׃

english.text:
Hurry, and go up to my father and say to him: ‘Your son
Joseph said this: God has made me a lord to all Egypt.
Come down to me. Don’t stand back.

translation.text: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:

verses.english:
Hurry, and go up to my father and say to him: ‘Your son
Joseph said this: God has made me a lord to all Egypt.
Come down to me. Don’t stand back.

verses.hebrew: וְיָשַׁבְתָּ בְאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן וְהָיִיתָ קָרוֹב אֵלַי אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ וּבְנֵי בָנֶיךָ וְצֹאנְךָ וּבְקָרְךָ וְכל אֲשֶׁר לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְיָשַׁבְתָּ בְאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן וְהָיִיתָ קָרוֹב אֵלַי אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ וּבְנֵי בָנֶיךָ וְצֹאנְךָ וּבְקָרְךָ וְכל אֲשֶׁר לָךְ׃

english.text:
And you’ll live in the land of Goshen, and you’ll be close
to me, you and your children and your children’s children
and your flock and your oxen and everything you have.

translation.text: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children’s children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

verses.english:
And you’ll live in the land of Goshen, and you’ll be close
to me, you and your children and your children’s children
and your flock and your oxen and everything you have.

verses.hebrew: וְכִלְכַּלְתִּי אֹתְךָ שָׁם כִּי עוֹד חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים רָעָב פֶּן תִּוָּרֵשׁ אַתָּה וּבֵיתְךָ וְכל אֲשֶׁר לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִלְכַּלְתִּי אֹתְךָ שָׁם כִּי עוֹד חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים רָעָב פֶּן תִּוָּרֵשׁ אַתָּה וּבֵיתְךָ וְכל אֲשֶׁר לָךְ׃

english.text:
And I’ll provide for you there, because there are five
more years of famine, or else you and your house and
everything you have will be impoverished.’

translation.text: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.

verses.english:
And I’ll provide for you there, because there are five
more years of famine, or else you and your house and
everything you have will be impoverished.’

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה עֵינֵיכֶם רֹאוֹת וְעֵינֵי אָחִי בִנְיָמִין כִּי פִי הַמְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה עֵינֵיכֶם רֹאוֹת וְעֵינֵי אָחִי בִנְיָמִין כִּי פִי הַמְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And here your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother
Benjamin, that it’s my mouth that speaks to you.
