translation.text: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.

verses.english:
And here your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother
Benjamin, that it’s my mouth that speaks to you.

verses.hebrew: וְהִגַּדְתֶּם לְאָבִי אֶת כּל כְּבוֹדִי בְּמִצְרַיִם וְאֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר רְאִיתֶם וּמִהַרְתֶּם וְהוֹרַדְתֶּם אֶת אָבִי הֵנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִגַּדְתֶּם לְאָבִי אֶת כּל כְּבוֹדִי בְּמִצְרַיִם וְאֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר רְאִיתֶם וּמִהַרְתֶּם וְהוֹרַדְתֶּם אֶת אָבִי הֵנָּה׃

english.text:
And you’ll tell my father of all my glory in Egypt and of
all that you’ve seen, and hurry and bring my father down
here.”

translation.text: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.

verses.english:
And you’ll tell my father of all my glory in Egypt and of
all that you’ve seen, and hurry and bring my father down
here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֹּל עַל צַוְּארֵי בִנְיָמִן אָחִיו וַיֵּבְךְּ וּבִנְיָמִן בָּכָה עַל צַוָּארָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֹּל עַל צַוְּארֵי בִנְיָמִן אָחִיו וַיֵּבְךְּ וּבִנְיָמִן בָּכָה עַל צַוָּארָיו׃

english.text:
And he fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and
Benjamin wept on his neck.

translation.text: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

verses.english:
And he fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and
Benjamin wept on his neck.

verses.hebrew: וַיְנַשֵּׁק לְכל אֶחָיו וַיֵּבְךְּ עֲלֵהֶם וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן דִּבְּרוּ אֶחָיו אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְנַשֵּׁק לְכל אֶחָיו וַיֵּבְךְּ עֲלֵהֶם וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן דִּבְּרוּ אֶחָיו אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And he kissed all his brothers and wept over them. And
after that his brothers spoke with him.

translation.text: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

verses.english:
And he kissed all his brothers and wept over them. And
after that his brothers spoke with him.

verses.hebrew: וְהַקֹּל נִשְׁמַע בֵּית פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר בָּאוּ אֲחֵי יוֹסֵף וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה וּבְעֵינֵי עֲבָדָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְהַקֹּל נִשְׁמַע בֵּית פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר בָּאוּ אֲחֵי יוֹסֵף וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה וּבְעֵינֵי עֲבָדָיו׃

english.text:
And the report was heard at Pharaoh’s house, saying,
“Joseph’s brothers have come.” And it was good in
Pharaoh’s eyes and in his servants’ eyes.

translation.text: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, Joseph’s brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

verses.english:
And the report was heard at Pharaoh’s house, saying,
“Joseph’s brothers have come.” And it was good in
Pharaoh’s eyes and in his servants’ eyes.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף אֱמֹר אֶל אַחֶיךָ זֹאת עֲשׂוּ טַעֲנוּ אֶת בְּעִירְכֶם וּלְכוּ בֹאוּ אַרְצָה כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף אֱמֹר אֶל אַחֶיךָ זֹאת עֲשׂוּ טַעֲנוּ אֶת בְּעִירְכֶם וּלְכוּ בֹאוּ אַרְצָה כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Say to your brothers, ‘Do
this: load your beasts and go; come to the land of Canaan,

translation.text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Say to your brothers, ‘Do
this: load your beasts and go; come to the land of Canaan,

verses.hebrew: וּקְחוּ אֶת אֲבִיכֶם וְאֶת בָּתֵּיכֶם וּבֹאוּ אֵלָי וְאֶתְּנָה לָכֶם אֶת טוּב אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וְאִכְלוּ אֶת חֵלֶב הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וּקְחוּ אֶת אֲבִיכֶם וְאֶת בָּתֵּיכֶם וּבֹאוּ אֵלָי וְאֶתְּנָה לָכֶם אֶת טוּב אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וְאִכְלוּ אֶת חֵלֶב הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
and take your father and your households and come to me,
and I’ll give you the best of the land of Egypt; and eat
the fat of the land.’

translation.text: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

verses.english:
and take your father and your households and come to me,
and I’ll give you the best of the land of Egypt; and eat
the fat of the land.’

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה צֻוֵּיתָה זֹאת עֲשׂוּ קְחוּ לָכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם עֲגָלוֹת לְטַפְּכֶם וְלִנְשֵׁיכֶם וּנְשָׂאתֶם אֶת אֲבִיכֶם וּבָאתֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה צֻוֵּיתָה זֹאת עֲשׂוּ קְחוּ לָכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם עֲגָלוֹת לְטַפְּכֶם וְלִנְשֵׁיכֶם וּנְשָׂאתֶם אֶת אֲבִיכֶם וּבָאתֶם׃

english.text:
And you are commanded, ‘Do this: Take wagons from the land
of Egypt for your infants and for your wives, and carry
your father and come.

translation.text: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

verses.english:
And you are commanded, ‘Do this: Take wagons from the land
of Egypt for your infants and for your wives, and carry
your father and come.

verses.hebrew: וְעֵינְכֶם אַל תָּחֹס עַל כְּלֵיכֶם כִּי טוּב כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לָכֶם הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְעֵינְכֶם אַל תָּחֹס עַל כְּלֵיכֶם כִּי טוּב כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לָכֶם הוּא׃

english.text:
And let your eye not care about your possessions, for the
best of all the land of Egypt is yours.’”

translation.text: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.

verses.english:
And let your eye not care about your possessions, for the
best of all the land of Egypt is yours.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם יוֹסֵף עֲגָלוֹת עַל פִּי פַרְעֹה וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם צֵדָה לַדָּרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם יוֹסֵף עֲגָלוֹת עַל פִּי פַרְעֹה וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם צֵדָה לַדָּרֶךְ׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel did so. And Joseph gave them
wagons by order of Pharaoh and gave them provisions for
the road.

translation.text: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel did so. And Joseph gave them
wagons by order of Pharaoh and gave them provisions for
the road.

verses.hebrew: לְכֻלָּם נָתַן לָאִישׁ חֲלִפוֹת שְׂמָלֹת וּלְבִנְיָמִן נָתַן שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת כֶּסֶף וְחָמֵשׁ חֲלִפֹת שְׂמָלֹת׃

hebrew.text: לְכֻלָּם נָתַן לָאִישׁ חֲלִפוֹת שְׂמָלֹת וּלְבִנְיָמִן נָתַן שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת כֶּסֶף וְחָמֵשׁ חֲלִפֹת שְׂמָלֹת׃

english.text:
For all of them he gave each man changes of clothes, and
he gave Benjamin three hundred weights of silver and five
changes of clothes.

translation.text: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.

verses.english:
For all of them he gave each man changes of clothes, and
he gave Benjamin three hundred weights of silver and five
changes of clothes.

verses.hebrew: וּלְאָבִיו שָׁלַח כְּזֹאת עֲשָׂרָה חֲמֹרִים נֹשְׂאִים מִטּוּב מִצְרָיִם וְעֶשֶׂר אֲתֹנֹת נֹשְׂאֹת בָּר וָלֶחֶם וּמָזוֹן לְאָבִיו לַדָּרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וּלְאָבִיו שָׁלַח כְּזֹאת עֲשָׂרָה חֲמֹרִים נֹשְׂאִים מִטּוּב מִצְרָיִם וְעֶשֶׂר אֲתֹנֹת נֹשְׂאֹת בָּר וָלֶחֶם וּמָזוֹן לְאָבִיו לַדָּרֶךְ׃

english.text:
And to his father he sent as follows: ten asses bearing
Egypt’s best, and ten she-asses bearing grain, bread, and
food supply for his father for the road.

translation.text: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.

verses.english:
And to his father he sent as follows: ten asses bearing
Egypt’s best, and ten she-asses bearing grain, bread, and
food supply for his father for the road.

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת אֶחָיו וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַל תִּרְגְּזוּ בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת אֶחָיו וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַל תִּרְגְּזוּ בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

english.text:
And he sent his brothers off, and they went, and he said
to them, “Don’t quarrel on the road.”

translation.text: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.

verses.english:
And he sent his brothers off, and they went, and he said
to them, “Don’t quarrel on the road.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ מִמִּצְרָיִם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֶל יַעֲקֹב אֲבִיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ מִמִּצְרָיִם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֶל יַעֲקֹב אֲבִיהֶם׃

english.text:
And they went up from Egypt and came to the land of
Canaan, to Jacob, their father,

translation.text: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,

verses.english:
And they went up from Egypt and came to the land of
Canaan, to Jacob, their father,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּדוּ לוֹ לֵאמֹר עוֹד יוֹסֵף חַי וְכִי הוּא מֹשֵׁל בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וַיָּפג לִבּוֹ כִּי לֹא הֶאֱמִין לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגִּדוּ לוֹ לֵאמֹר עוֹד יוֹסֵף חַי וְכִי הוּא מֹשֵׁל בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וַיָּפג לִבּוֹ כִּי לֹא הֶאֱמִין לָהֶם׃

english.text:
and told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive! And he rules
all the land of Egypt!” And his heart grew numb because he
did not believe them.

translation.text: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob’s heart fainted, for he believed them not.

verses.english:
and told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive! And he rules
all the land of Egypt!” And his heart grew numb because he
did not believe them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו אֵת כּל דִּבְרֵי יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲלֵהֶם וַיַּרְא אֶת הָעֲגָלוֹת אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח יוֹסֵף לָשֵׂאת אֹתוֹ וַתְּחִי רוּחַ יַעֲקֹב אֲבִיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו אֵת כּל דִּבְרֵי יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲלֵהֶם וַיַּרְא אֶת הָעֲגָלוֹת אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח יוֹסֵף לָשֵׂאת אֹתוֹ וַתְּחִי רוּחַ יַעֲקֹב אֲבִיהֶם׃

english.text:
And they spoke to him all of Joseph’s words that he had
spoken to them, and he saw the wagons that Joseph had sent
to carry him, and their father Jacob’s spirit came alive.

translation.text: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:

verses.english:
And they spoke to him all of Joseph’s words that he had
spoken to them, and he saw the wagons that Joseph had sent
to carry him, and their father Jacob’s spirit came alive.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל רַב עוֹד יוֹסֵף בְּנִי חָי אֵלְכָה וְאֶרְאֶנּוּ בְּטֶרֶם אָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל רַב עוֹד יוֹסֵף בְּנִי חָי אֵלְכָה וְאֶרְאֶנּוּ בְּטֶרֶם אָמוּת׃

english.text:
And Israel said, “So much! Joseph, my son, is still alive.
Let me go and see him before I die.”

translation.text: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.

verses.english:
And Israel said, “So much! Joseph, my son, is still alive.
Let me go and see him before I die.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסַּע יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וַיָּבֹא בְּאֵרָה שָּׁבַע וַיִּזְבַּח זְבָחִים לֵאלֹהֵי אָבִיו יִצְחָק׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסַּע יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וַיָּבֹא בְּאֵרָה שָּׁבַע וַיִּזְבַּח זְבָחִים לֵאלֹהֵי אָבִיו יִצְחָק׃

english.text:
And Israel and everyone he had traveled and came to
Beer-sheba, and he offered sacrifices to the God of his
father, Isaac.

translation.text: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.

verses.english:
And Israel and everyone he had traveled and came to
Beer-sheba, and he offered sacrifices to the God of his
father, Isaac.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמַרְאֹת הַלַּיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב יַעֲקֹב וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמַרְאֹת הַלַּיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב יַעֲקֹב וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי׃

english.text:
And God said to Israel in night visions, and He said,
“Jacob, Jacob.” And he said, “I’m here.”

translation.text: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.

verses.english:
And God said to Israel in night visions, and He said,
“Jacob, Jacob.” And he said, “I’m here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי הָאֵל אֱלֹהֵי אָבִיךָ אַל תִּירָא מֵרְדָה מִצְרַיְמָה כִּי לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל אֲשִׂימְךָ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי הָאֵל אֱלֹהֵי אָבִיךָ אַל תִּירָא מֵרְדָה מִצְרַיְמָה כִּי לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל אֲשִׂימְךָ שָׁם׃

english.text:
And He said, “I am God, your father’s God. Don’t be afraid
of going down to Egypt, because I’ll make you into a big
nation there.

translation.text: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:

verses.english:
And He said, “I am God, your father’s God. Don’t be afraid
of going down to Egypt, because I’ll make you into a big
nation there.

verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי אֵרֵד עִמְּךָ מִצְרַיְמָה וְאָנֹכִי אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה וְיוֹסֵף יָשִׁית יָדוֹ עַל עֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: אָנֹכִי אֵרֵד עִמְּךָ מִצְרַיְמָה וְאָנֹכִי אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה וְיוֹסֵף יָשִׁית יָדוֹ עַל עֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
I shall go down with you to Egypt, and I shall also bring
you up. And Joseph will set his hand on your eyes.”

translation.text: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.

verses.english:
I shall go down with you to Egypt, and I shall also bring
you up. And Joseph will set his hand on your eyes.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם יַעֲקֹב מִבְּאֵר שָׁבַע וַיִּשְׂאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת יַעֲקֹב אֲבִיהֶם וְאֶת טַפָּם וְאֶת נְשֵׁיהֶם בָּעֲגָלוֹת אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח פַּרְעֹה לָשֵׂאת אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם יַעֲקֹב מִבְּאֵר שָׁבַע וַיִּשְׂאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת יַעֲקֹב אֲבִיהֶם וְאֶת טַפָּם וְאֶת נְשֵׁיהֶם בָּעֲגָלוֹת אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח פַּרְעֹה לָשֵׂאת אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And Jacob got up from Beer-sheba. And the children of
Israel carried Jacob, their father, and their infants and
their wives in the wagons that Pharaoh had sent to carry
him.

translation.text: And Jacob rose up from Beersheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

verses.english:
And Jacob got up from Beer-sheba. And the children of
Israel carried Jacob, their father, and their infants and
their wives in the wagons that Pharaoh had sent to carry
him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת מִקְנֵיהֶם וְאֶת רְכוּשָׁם אֲשֶׁר רָכְשׁוּ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן וַיָּבֹאוּ מִצְרָיְמָה יַעֲקֹב וְכל זַרְעוֹ אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת מִקְנֵיהֶם וְאֶת רְכוּשָׁם אֲשֶׁר רָכְשׁוּ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן וַיָּבֹאוּ מִצְרָיְמָה יַעֲקֹב וְכל זַרְעוֹ אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And they took their cattle and their property that they
had acquired in the land of Canaan, and they came to
Egypt, Jacob and all his seed with him.

translation.text: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:

verses.english:
And they took their cattle and their property that they
had acquired in the land of Canaan, and they came to
Egypt, Jacob and all his seed with him.

verses.hebrew: בָּנָיו וּבְנֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ בְּנֹתָיו וּבְנוֹת בָּנָיו וְכל זַרְעוֹ הֵבִיא אִתּוֹ מִצְרָיְמָה׃

hebrew.text: בָּנָיו וּבְנֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ בְּנֹתָיו וּבְנוֹת בָּנָיו וְכל זַרְעוֹ הֵבִיא אִתּוֹ מִצְרָיְמָה׃

english.text:
He brought his sons and his grandsons with him, his
daughters and his granddaughters and all his seed with him
to Egypt.

translation.text: His sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.

verses.english:
He brought his sons and his grandsons with him, his
daughters and his granddaughters and all his seed with him
to Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַבָּאִים מִצְרַיְמָה יַעֲקֹב וּבָנָיו בְּכֹר יַעֲקֹב רְאוּבֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַבָּאִים מִצְרַיְמָה יַעֲקֹב וּבָנָיו בְּכֹר יַעֲקֹב רְאוּבֵן׃

english.text:
And these are the names of the children of Israel who came
to Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Jacob’s firstborn was
Reuben.

translation.text: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

verses.english:
And these are the names of the children of Israel who came
to Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Jacob’s firstborn was
Reuben.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן חֲנוֹךְ וּפַלּוּא וְחֶצְרֹן וְכַרְמִי׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן חֲנוֹךְ וּפַלּוּא וְחֶצְרֹן וְכַרְמִי׃

english.text:
And Reuben’s sons were Hanoch and Pallu and Hezron and
Carmi.

translation.text: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

verses.english:
And Reuben’s sons were Hanoch and Pallu and Hezron and
Carmi.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן יְמוּאֵל וְיָמִין וְאֹהַד וְיָכִין וְצֹחַר וְשָׁאוּל בֶּן הַכְּנַעֲנִית׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן יְמוּאֵל וְיָמִין וְאֹהַד וְיָכִין וְצֹחַר וְשָׁאוּל בֶּן הַכְּנַעֲנִית׃

english.text:
And Simeon’s sons were Jemuel and Jamin and Ohad and
Jachin and Zohar and Saul, the son of a Canaanite woman.

translation.text: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

verses.english:
And Simeon’s sons were Jemuel and Jamin and Ohad and
Jachin and Zohar and Saul, the son of a Canaanite woman.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי לֵוִי גֵּרְשׁוֹן קְהָת וּמְרָרִי׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי לֵוִי גֵּרְשׁוֹן קְהָת וּמְרָרִי׃

english.text: And Levi’s sons were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

translation.text: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.english: And Levi’s sons were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יְהוּדָה עֵר וְאוֹנָן וְשֵׁלָה וָפֶרֶץ וָזָרַח וַיָּמת עֵר וְאוֹנָן בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי פֶרֶץ חֶצְרֹן וְחָמוּל׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי יְהוּדָה עֵר וְאוֹנָן וְשֵׁלָה וָפֶרֶץ וָזָרַח וַיָּמת עֵר וְאוֹנָן בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי פֶרֶץ חֶצְרֹן וְחָמוּל׃

english.text:
And Judah’s sons were Er and Onan and Shelah and Perez and
Zerah. And Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan, and
Perez’s sons were Hezron and Hamul.

translation.text: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zarah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.

verses.english:
And Judah’s sons were Er and Onan and Shelah and Perez and
Zerah. And Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan, and
Perez’s sons were Hezron and Hamul.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר תּוֹלָע וּפֻוָה וְיוֹב וְשִׁמְרֹן׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר תּוֹלָע וּפֻוָה וְיוֹב וְשִׁמְרֹן׃

english.text:
And Issachar’s sons were Tola and Puvah and Job and
Shimron.

translation.text: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.

verses.english:
And Issachar’s sons were Tola and Puvah and Job and
Shimron.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי זְבֻלוּן סֶרֶד וְאֵלוֹן וְיַחְלְאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי זְבֻלוּן סֶרֶד וְאֵלוֹן וְיַחְלְאֵל׃

english.text: And Zebulun’s sons were Sered and Elon and Jahleel.

translation.text: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.

verses.english: And Zebulun’s sons were Sered and Elon and Jahleel.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי לֵאָה אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְיַעֲקֹב בְּפַדַּן אֲרָם וְאֵת דִּינָה בִתּוֹ כּל נֶפֶשׁ בָּנָיו וּבְנוֹתָיו שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשָׁלֹשׁ׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי לֵאָה אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְיַעֲקֹב בְּפַדַּן אֲרָם וְאֵת דִּינָה בִתּוֹ כּל נֶפֶשׁ בָּנָיו וּבְנוֹתָיו שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשָׁלֹשׁ׃

english.text:
These were the sons of Leah, to whom she gave birth for
Jacob in Paddan Aram, and Dinah, his daughter, every
person of his sons and his daughters, thirty-three.

translation.text: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padanaram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.

verses.english:
These were the sons of Leah, to whom she gave birth for
Jacob in Paddan Aram, and Dinah, his daughter, every
person of his sons and his daughters, thirty-three.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי גָד צִפְיוֹן וְחַגִּי שׁוּנִי וְאֶצְבֹּן עֵרִי וַאֲרוֹדִי וְאַרְאֵלִי׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי גָד צִפְיוֹן וְחַגִּי שׁוּנִי וְאֶצְבֹּן עֵרִי וַאֲרוֹדִי וְאַרְאֵלִי׃

english.text:
And Gad’s sons were Ziphion and Haggai and Shuni and
Ezbon, Eri and Arodi and Areli.

translation.text: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

verses.english:
And Gad’s sons were Ziphion and Haggai and Shuni and
Ezbon, Eri and Arodi and Areli.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי אָשֵׁר יִמְנָה וְיִשְׁוָה וְיִשְׁוִי וּבְרִיעָה וְשֶׂרַח אֲחֹתָם וּבְנֵי בְרִיעָה חֶבֶר וּמַלְכִּיאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי אָשֵׁר יִמְנָה וְיִשְׁוָה וְיִשְׁוִי וּבְרִיעָה וְשֶׂרַח אֲחֹתָם וּבְנֵי בְרִיעָה חֶבֶר וּמַלְכִּיאֵל׃

english.text:
And Asher’s sons were Imnah and Ishvah and Ishvi and
Beriah, and Serah was their sister. And Beriah’s sons were
Hever and Malchiel.

translation.text: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.

verses.english:
And Asher’s sons were Imnah and Ishvah and Ishvi and
Beriah, and Serah was their sister. And Beriah’s sons were
Hever and Malchiel.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָבָן לְלֵאָה בִתּוֹ וַתֵּלֶד אֶת אֵלֶּה לְיַעֲקֹב שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה נָפֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָבָן לְלֵאָה בִתּוֹ וַתֵּלֶד אֶת אֵלֶּה לְיַעֲקֹב שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה נָפֶשׁ׃

english.text:
These were the sons of Zil-pah, whom Laban gave to Leah,
his daughter, and she gave birth to these for Jacob,
sixteen persons.

translation.text: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.

verses.english:
These were the sons of Zil-pah, whom Laban gave to Leah,
his daughter, and she gave birth to these for Jacob,
sixteen persons.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי רָחֵל אֵשֶׁת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף וּבִנְיָמִן׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי רָחֵל אֵשֶׁת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף וּבִנְיָמִן׃

english.text:
The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife, were Joseph and
Benjamin.

translation.text: The sons of Rachel Jacob’s wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.

verses.english:
The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife, were Joseph and
Benjamin.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּלֵד לְיוֹסֵף בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לּוֹ אָסְנַת בַּת פּוֹטִי פֶרַע כֹּהֵן אֹן אֶת מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶת אֶפְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּוָּלֵד לְיוֹסֵף בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לּוֹ אָסְנַת בַּת פּוֹטִי פֶרַע כֹּהֵן אֹן אֶת מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶת אֶפְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph in the land
of Egypt, to whom Asenath, daughter of Poti-phera, priest
of On, gave birth for him.

translation.text: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.

verses.english:
And Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph in the land
of Egypt, to whom Asenath, daughter of Poti-phera, priest
of On, gave birth for him.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי בִנְיָמִן בֶּלַע וָבֶכֶר וְאַשְׁבֵּל גֵּרָא וְנַעֲמָן אֵחִי וָרֹאשׁ מֻפִּים וְחֻפִּים וָאָרְדְּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי בִנְיָמִן בֶּלַע וָבֶכֶר וְאַשְׁבֵּל גֵּרָא וְנַעֲמָן אֵחִי וָרֹאשׁ מֻפִּים וְחֻפִּים וָאָרְדְּ׃

english.text:
And Benjamin’s sons were Bela and Becher and Ashbel, Gera
and Naaman, Ehi and Rosh, Muppim and Huppim and Ard.

translation.text: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

verses.english:
And Benjamin’s sons were Bela and Becher and Ashbel, Gera
and Naaman, Ehi and Rosh, Muppim and Huppim and Ard.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי רָחֵל אֲשֶׁר יֻלַּד לְיַעֲקֹב כּל נֶפֶשׁ אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי רָחֵל אֲשֶׁר יֻלַּד לְיַעֲקֹב כּל נֶפֶשׁ אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר׃

english.text:
These were Rachel’s sons, who were born to Jacob. All the
persons were fourteen.

translation.text: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

verses.english:
These were Rachel’s sons, who were born to Jacob. All the
persons were fourteen.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי דָן חֻשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי דָן חֻשִׁים׃

english.text: And Dan’s sons: Hushim.

translation.text: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.

verses.english: And Dan’s sons: Hushim.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי יַחְצְאֵל וְגוּנִי וְיֵצֶר וְשִׁלֵּם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי יַחְצְאֵל וְגוּנִי וְיֵצֶר וְשִׁלֵּם׃

english.text:
And Naphtali’s sons were Jahzeel and Guni and Jezer and
Shillem.

translation.text: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

verses.english:
And Naphtali’s sons were Jahzeel and Guni and Jezer and
Shillem.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי בִלְהָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָבָן לְרָחֵל בִּתּוֹ וַתֵּלֶד אֶת אֵלֶּה לְיַעֲקֹב כּל נֶפֶשׁ שִׁבְעָה׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי בִלְהָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָבָן לְרָחֵל בִּתּוֹ וַתֵּלֶד אֶת אֵלֶּה לְיַעֲקֹב כּל נֶפֶשׁ שִׁבְעָה׃

english.text:
These were the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel,
his daughter, and she gave birth to these for Jacob. All
the persons were seven.

translation.text: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.

verses.english:
These were the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel,
his daughter, and she gave birth to these for Jacob. All
the persons were seven.

verses.hebrew: כּל הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַבָּאָה לְיַעֲקֹב מִצְרַיְמָה יֹצְאֵי יְרֵכוֹ מִלְּבַד נְשֵׁי בְנֵי יַעֲקֹב כּל נֶפֶשׁ שִׁשִּׁים וָשֵׁשׁ׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַבָּאָה לְיַעֲקֹב מִצְרַיְמָה יֹצְאֵי יְרֵכוֹ מִלְּבַד נְשֵׁי בְנֵי יַעֲקֹב כּל נֶפֶשׁ שִׁשִּׁים וָשֵׁשׁ׃

english.text:
All the persons of Jacob’s who came to Egypt, who came out
from his thigh, outside of Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the
persons were sixty-six.

translation.text: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were threescore and six;

verses.english:
All the persons of Jacob’s who came to Egypt, who came out
from his thigh, outside of Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the
persons were sixty-six.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר יֻלַּד לוֹ בְמִצְרַיִם נֶפֶשׁ שְׁנָיִם כּל הַנֶּפֶשׁ לְבֵית יַעֲקֹב הַבָּאָה מִצְרַיְמָה שִׁבְעִים׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר יֻלַּד לוֹ בְמִצְרַיִם נֶפֶשׁ שְׁנָיִם כּל הַנֶּפֶשׁ לְבֵית יַעֲקֹב הַבָּאָה מִצְרַיְמָה שִׁבְעִים׃

english.text:
And Joseph’s sons who were born to him in Egypt were two
persons. All the persons of Jacob’s house who came to
Egypt were seventy.

translation.text: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.

verses.english:
And Joseph’s sons who were born to him in Egypt were two
persons. All the persons of Jacob’s house who came to
Egypt were seventy.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת יְהוּדָה שָׁלַח לְפָנָיו אֶל יוֹסֵף לְהוֹרֹת לְפָנָיו גֹּשְׁנָה וַיָּבֹאוּ אַרְצָה גֹּשֶׁן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת יְהוּדָה שָׁלַח לְפָנָיו אֶל יוֹסֵף לְהוֹרֹת לְפָנָיו גֹּשְׁנָה וַיָּבֹאוּ אַרְצָה גֹּשֶׁן׃

english.text:
And he sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to direct him in
advance to Goshen. And they came to the land of Goshen.

translation.text: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.

verses.english:
And he sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to direct him in
advance to Goshen. And they came to the land of Goshen.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאְסֹר יוֹסֵף מֶרְכַּבְתּוֹ וַיַּעַל לִקְרַאת יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבִיו גֹּשְׁנָה וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו וַיִּפֹּל עַל צַוָּארָיו וַיֵּבְךְּ עַל צַוָּארָיו עוֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאְסֹר יוֹסֵף מֶרְכַּבְתּוֹ וַיַּעַל לִקְרַאת יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבִיו גֹּשְׁנָה וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו וַיִּפֹּל עַל צַוָּארָיו וַיֵּבְךְּ עַל צַוָּארָיו עוֹד׃

english.text:
And Joseph hitched his chariot and went up to Israel, his
father, at Goshen. And he appeared to him and fell on his
neck and wept on his neck a long time.

translation.text: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

verses.english:
And Joseph hitched his chariot and went up to Israel, his
father, at Goshen. And he appeared to him and fell on his
neck and wept on his neck a long time.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל יוֹסֵף אָמוּתָה הַפָּעַם אַחֲרֵי רְאוֹתִי אֶת פָּנֶיךָ כִּי עוֹדְךָ חָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל יוֹסֵף אָמוּתָה הַפָּעַם אַחֲרֵי רְאוֹתִי אֶת פָּנֶיךָ כִּי עוֹדְךָ חָי׃

english.text:
And Israel said to Joseph, “Let me die now after I’ve seen
your face, that you’re still alive.”

translation.text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.

verses.english:
And Israel said to Joseph, “Let me die now after I’ve seen
your face, that you’re still alive.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו וְאֶל בֵּית אָבִיו אֶעֱלֶה וְאַגִּידָה לְפַרְעֹה וְאֹמְרָה אֵלָיו אַחַי וּבֵית אָבִי אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן בָּאוּ אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו וְאֶל בֵּית אָבִיו אֶעֱלֶה וְאַגִּידָה לְפַרְעֹה וְאֹמְרָה אֵלָיו אַחַי וּבֵית אָבִי אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן בָּאוּ אֵלָי׃

english.text:
And Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s house,
“Let me go up and tell Pharaoh and say to him, ‘My
brothers and my father’s house that were in the land of
Canaan have come to me.

translation.text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father’s house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father’s house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;

verses.english:
And Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s house,
“Let me go up and tell Pharaoh and say to him, ‘My
brothers and my father’s house that were in the land of
Canaan have come to me.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים רֹעֵי צֹאן כִּי אַנְשֵׁי מִקְנֶה הָיוּ וְצֹאנָם וּבְקָרָם וְכל אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם הֵבִיאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים רֹעֵי צֹאן כִּי אַנְשֵׁי מִקְנֶה הָיוּ וְצֹאנָם וּבְקָרָם וְכל אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם הֵבִיאוּ׃

english.text:
And the people are shepherds, because they were livestock
people, and they’ve brought their flock and their oxen and
all they have.’

translation.text: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

verses.english:
And the people are shepherds, because they were livestock
people, and they’ve brought their flock and their oxen and
all they have.’

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי יִקְרָא לָכֶם פַּרְעֹה וְאָמַר מַה מַּעֲשֵׂיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי יִקְרָא לָכֶם פַּרְעֹה וְאָמַר מַה מַּעֲשֵׂיכֶם׃

english.text:
And it will be, when Pharaoh will call you and say, ‘What
is your occupation?’

translation.text: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?

verses.english:
And it will be, when Pharaoh will call you and say, ‘What
is your occupation?’

verses.hebrew: וַאֲמַרְתֶּם אַנְשֵׁי מִקְנֶה הָיוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ מִנְּעוּרֵינוּ וְעַד עַתָּה גַּם אֲנַחְנוּ גַּם אֲבֹתֵינוּ בַּעֲבוּר תֵּשְׁבוּ בְּאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן כִּי תוֹעֲבַת מִצְרַיִם כּל רֹעֵה צֹאן׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲמַרְתֶּם אַנְשֵׁי מִקְנֶה הָיוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ מִנְּעוּרֵינוּ וְעַד עַתָּה גַּם אֲנַחְנוּ גַּם אֲבֹתֵינוּ בַּעֲבוּר תֵּשְׁבוּ בְּאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן כִּי תוֹעֲבַת מִצְרַיִם כּל רֹעֵה צֹאן׃

english.text:
that you’ll say, ‘Your servants were livestock people from
our youth until now, both we and our fathers,’ so that
you’ll live in the land of Goshen, because any shepherd is
an offensive thing to Egypt.”

translation.text: That ye shall say, Thy servants’ trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

verses.english:
that you’ll say, ‘Your servants were livestock people from
our youth until now, both we and our fathers,’ so that
you’ll live in the land of Goshen, because any shepherd is
an offensive thing to Egypt.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יוֹסֵף וַיַּגֵּד לְפַרְעֹה וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִי וְאַחַי וְצֹאנָם וּבְקָרָם וְכל אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם בָּאוּ מֵאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְהִנָּם בְּאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יוֹסֵף וַיַּגֵּד לְפַרְעֹה וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִי וְאַחַי וְצֹאנָם וּבְקָרָם וְכל אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם בָּאוּ מֵאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְהִנָּם בְּאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן׃

english.text:
And Joseph came and told Pharaoh and said, “My father
and my brothers and their flock and their oxen and all
that they own have come from the land of Canaan, and here
they are in the land of Goshen.”

translation.text: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.

verses.english:
And Joseph came and told Pharaoh and said, “My father
and my brothers and their flock and their oxen and all
that they own have come from the land of Canaan, and here
they are in the land of Goshen.”

verses.hebrew: וּמִקְצֵה אֶחָיו לָקַח חֲמִשָּׁה אֲנָשִׁים וַיַּצִּגֵם לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וּמִקְצֵה אֶחָיו לָקַח חֲמִשָּׁה אֲנָשִׁים וַיַּצִּגֵם לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And he took several of his brothers, five men, and set
them before Pharaoh.

translation.text: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.

verses.english:
And he took several of his brothers, five men, and set
them before Pharaoh.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל אֶחָיו מַה מַּעֲשֵׂיכֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל פַּרְעֹה רֹעֵה צֹאן עֲבָדֶיךָ גַּם אֲנַחְנוּ גַּם אֲבוֹתֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל אֶחָיו מַה מַּעֲשֵׂיכֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל פַּרְעֹה רֹעֵה צֹאן עֲבָדֶיךָ גַּם אֲנַחְנוּ גַּם אֲבוֹתֵינוּ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said to his brothers, “What is your work?” And
they said to Pharaoh, “Your servants are shepherds, both
we and our fathers,”

translation.text: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said to his brothers, “What is your work?” And
they said to Pharaoh, “Your servants are shepherds, both
we and our fathers,”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל פַּרְעֹה לָגוּר בָּאָרֶץ בָּאנוּ כִּי אֵין מִרְעֶה לַצֹּאן אֲשֶׁר לַעֲבָדֶיךָ כִּי כָבֵד הָרָעָב בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְעַתָּה יֵשְׁבוּ נָא עֲבָדֶיךָ בְּאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל פַּרְעֹה לָגוּר בָּאָרֶץ בָּאנוּ כִּי אֵין מִרְעֶה לַצֹּאן אֲשֶׁר לַעֲבָדֶיךָ כִּי כָבֵד הָרָעָב בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְעַתָּה יֵשְׁבוּ נָא עֲבָדֶיךָ בְּאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן׃

english.text:
and they said to Pharaoh, “We came to reside in the land
because there’s no pasture for your servants’ flock
because the famine is heavy in the land of Canaan. And now
may your servants live in the land of Goshen.”

translation.text: They said morever unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

verses.english:
and they said to Pharaoh, “We came to reside in the land
because there’s no pasture for your servants’ flock
because the famine is heavy in the land of Canaan. And now
may your servants live in the land of Goshen.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף לֵאמֹר אָבִיךָ וְאַחֶיךָ בָּאוּ אֵלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף לֵאמֹר אָבִיךָ וְאַחֶיךָ בָּאוּ אֵלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, saying, “Your father and your
brothers have come to you.

translation.text: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said to Joseph, saying, “Your father and your
brothers have come to you.

verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְפָנֶיךָ הִוא בְּמֵיטַב הָאָרֶץ הוֹשֵׁב אֶת אָבִיךָ וְאֶת אַחֶיךָ יֵשְׁבוּ בְּאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן וְאִם יָדַעְתָּ וְיֶשׁ בָּם אַנְשֵׁי חַיִל וְשַׂמְתָּם שָׂרֵי מִקְנֶה עַל אֲשֶׁר לִי׃

hebrew.text: אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְפָנֶיךָ הִוא בְּמֵיטַב הָאָרֶץ הוֹשֵׁב אֶת אָבִיךָ וְאֶת אַחֶיךָ יֵשְׁבוּ בְּאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן וְאִם יָדַעְתָּ וְיֶשׁ בָּם אַנְשֵׁי חַיִל וְשַׂמְתָּם שָׂרֵי מִקְנֶה עַל אֲשֶׁר לִי׃

english.text:
The land of Egypt is before you. Settle your father and
your brothers in the best of the land. Let them live in
the land of Goshen. And if you know—and if there are among
them—worthy men, then you shall make them livestock
officers over those that I have.”

translation.text: The land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.

verses.english:
The land of Egypt is before you. Settle your father and
your brothers in the best of the land. Let them live in
the land of Goshen. And if you know—and if there are among
them—worthy men, then you shall make them livestock
officers over those that I have.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֵא יוֹסֵף אֶת יַעֲקֹב אָבִיו וַיַּעֲמִדֵהוּ לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וַיְבָרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב אֶת פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֵא יוֹסֵף אֶת יַעֲקֹב אָבִיו וַיַּעֲמִדֵהוּ לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וַיְבָרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב אֶת פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Joseph brought Jacob, his father, and stood him in
front of Pharaoh. And Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

translation.text: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

verses.english:
And Joseph brought Jacob, his father, and stood him in
front of Pharaoh. And Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יַעֲקֹב כַּמָּה יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיֶּיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יַעֲקֹב כַּמָּה יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיֶּיךָ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How many are the days of the
years of your life?”

translation.text: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How many are the days of the
years of your life?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל פַּרְעֹה יְמֵי שְׁנֵי מְגוּרַי שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה מְעַט וְרָעִים הָיוּ יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיַּי וְלֹא הִשִּׂיגוּ אֶת יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיֵּי אֲבֹתַי בִּימֵי מְגוּרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל פַּרְעֹה יְמֵי שְׁנֵי מְגוּרַי שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה מְעַט וְרָעִים הָיוּ יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיַּי וְלֹא הִשִּׂיגוּ אֶת יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיֵּי אֲבֹתַי בִּימֵי מְגוּרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The days of the years of my
residences are a hundred thirty years. The days of the
years of my life have been few and bad, and they haven’t
attained the days of the years of my fathers’ lives, in
the days of their residences.”

translation.text: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

verses.english:
And Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The days of the years of my
residences are a hundred thirty years. The days of the
years of my life have been few and bad, and they haven’t
attained the days of the years of my fathers’ lives, in
the days of their residences.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְבָרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב אֶת פַּרְעֹה וַיֵּצֵא מִלִּפְנֵי פַרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבָרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב אֶת פַּרְעֹה וַיֵּצֵא מִלִּפְנֵי פַרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Jacob blessed Pharaoh and went out from in front of
Pharaoh.

translation.text: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.

verses.english:
And Jacob blessed Pharaoh and went out from in front of
Pharaoh.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹשֵׁב יוֹסֵף אֶת אָבִיו וְאֶת אֶחָיו וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם אֲחֻזָּה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּמֵיטַב הָאָרֶץ בְּאֶרֶץ רַעְמְסֵס כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה פַרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹשֵׁב יוֹסֵף אֶת אָבִיו וְאֶת אֶחָיו וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם אֲחֻזָּה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּמֵיטַב הָאָרֶץ בְּאֶרֶץ רַעְמְסֵס כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה פַרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Joseph settled his father and his brothers and gave
them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the
land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

translation.text: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

verses.english:
And Joseph settled his father and his brothers and gave
them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the
land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַלְכֵּל יוֹסֵף אֶת אָבִיו וְאֶת אֶחָיו וְאֵת כּל בֵּית אָבִיו לֶחֶם לְפִי הַטָּף׃

hebrew.text: וַיְכַלְכֵּל יוֹסֵף אֶת אָבִיו וְאֶת אֶחָיו וְאֵת כּל בֵּית אָבִיו לֶחֶם לְפִי הַטָּף׃

english.text:
And Joseph supported his father and his brothers and all
of his father’s household, bread by the number of infants.

translation.text: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.

verses.english:
And Joseph supported his father and his brothers and all
of his father’s household, bread by the number of infants.

verses.hebrew: וְלֶחֶם אֵין בְּכל הָאָרֶץ כִּי כָבֵד הָרָעָב מְאֹד וַתֵּלַהּ אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וְאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן מִפְּנֵי הָרָעָב׃

hebrew.text: וְלֶחֶם אֵין בְּכל הָאָרֶץ כִּי כָבֵד הָרָעָב מְאֹד וַתֵּלַהּ אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וְאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן מִפְּנֵי הָרָעָב׃

english.text:
And there was no bread in all the land of Egypt, because
the famine was very heavy, and the land of Egypt and the
land of Canaan languished because of the famine.

translation.text: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

verses.english:
And there was no bread in all the land of Egypt, because
the famine was very heavy, and the land of Egypt and the
land of Canaan languished because of the famine.

verses.hebrew: וַיְלַקֵּט יוֹסֵף אֶת כּל הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בְאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וּבְאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן בַּשֶּׁבֶר אֲשֶׁר הֵם שֹׁבְרִים וַיָּבֵא יוֹסֵף אֶת הַכֶּסֶף בֵּיתָה פַרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְלַקֵּט יוֹסֵף אֶת כּל הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בְאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וּבְאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן בַּשֶּׁבֶר אֲשֶׁר הֵם שֹׁבְרִים וַיָּבֵא יוֹסֵף אֶת הַכֶּסֶף בֵּיתָה פַרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Joseph collected all the silver that was found in the
land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan for the grain that
they were buying, and Joseph brought the silver to
Pharaoh’s house.

translation.text: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.

verses.english:
And Joseph collected all the silver that was found in the
land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan for the grain that
they were buying, and Joseph brought the silver to
Pharaoh’s house.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֹּם הַכֶּסֶף מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וּמֵאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן וַיָּבֹאוּ כל מִצְרַיִם אֶל יוֹסֵף לֵאמֹר הָבָה לָּנוּ לֶחֶם וְלָמָּה נָמוּת נֶגְדֶּךָ כִּי אָפֵס כָּסֶף׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֹּם הַכֶּסֶף מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וּמֵאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן וַיָּבֹאוּ כל מִצְרַיִם אֶל יוֹסֵף לֵאמֹר הָבָה לָּנוּ לֶחֶם וְלָמָּה נָמוּת נֶגְדֶּךָ כִּי אָפֵס כָּסֶף׃

english.text:
And the silver came to an end from the land of Egypt and
from the land of Canaan. And all of Egypt came to Joseph,
saying, “Give us bread! And why should we die in front of
you? Because there’s no more silver!”

translation.text: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.

verses.english:
And the silver came to an end from the land of Egypt and
from the land of Canaan. And all of Egypt came to Joseph,
saying, “Give us bread! And why should we die in front of
you? Because there’s no more silver!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף הָבוּ מִקְנֵיכֶם וְאֶתְּנָה לָכֶם בְּמִקְנֵיכֶם אִם אָפֵס כָּסֶף׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף הָבוּ מִקְנֵיכֶם וְאֶתְּנָה לָכֶם בְּמִקְנֵיכֶם אִם אָפֵס כָּסֶף׃

english.text:
And Joseph said, “Give your livestock, and I’ll give it to
you for your livestock if there’s no more silver.”

translation.text: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.

verses.english:
And Joseph said, “Give your livestock, and I’ll give it to
you for your livestock if there’s no more silver.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת מִקְנֵיהֶם אֶל יוֹסֵף וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם יוֹסֵף לֶחֶם בַּסּוּסִים וּבְמִקְנֵה הַצֹּאן וּבְמִקְנֵה הַבָּקָר וּבַחֲמֹרִים וַיְנַהֲלֵם בַּלֶּחֶם בְּכל מִקְנֵהֶם בַּשָּׁנָה הַהִוא׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת מִקְנֵיהֶם אֶל יוֹסֵף וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם יוֹסֵף לֶחֶם בַּסּוּסִים וּבְמִקְנֵה הַצֹּאן וּבְמִקְנֵה הַבָּקָר וּבַחֲמֹרִים וַיְנַהֲלֵם בַּלֶּחֶם בְּכל מִקְנֵהֶם בַּשָּׁנָה הַהִוא׃

english.text:
And they brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph
gave them bread for the horses and for the livestock of
the flocks and for the livestock of the oxen and for the
asses, and he sustained them with bread for all their
livestock in that year.

translation.text: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

verses.english:
And they brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph
gave them bread for the horses and for the livestock of
the flocks and for the livestock of the oxen and for the
asses, and he sustained them with bread for all their
livestock in that year.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּתֹּם הַשָּׁנָה הַהִוא וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵלָיו בַּשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ לֹא נְכַחֵד מֵאֲדֹנִי כִּי אִם תַּם הַכֶּסֶף וּמִקְנֵה הַבְּהֵמָה אֶל אֲדֹנִי לֹא נִשְׁאַר לִפְנֵי אֲדֹנִי בִּלְתִּי אִם גְּוִיָּתֵנוּ וְאַדְמָתֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּתֹּם הַשָּׁנָה הַהִוא וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵלָיו בַּשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ לֹא נְכַחֵד מֵאֲדֹנִי כִּי אִם תַּם הַכֶּסֶף וּמִקְנֵה הַבְּהֵמָה אֶל אֲדֹנִי לֹא נִשְׁאַר לִפְנֵי אֲדֹנִי בִּלְתִּי אִם גְּוִיָּתֵנוּ וְאַדְמָתֵנוּ׃

english.text:
And that year came to an end, and they came to him in the
second year and said to him, “We won’t conceal from my
lord that the silver has come to an end and the cattle
livestock have gone to my lord. Nothing is left in front
of my lord except our body and our land.

translation.text: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:

verses.english:
And that year came to an end, and they came to him in the
second year and said to him, “We won’t conceal from my
lord that the silver has come to an end and the cattle
livestock have gone to my lord. Nothing is left in front
of my lord except our body and our land.

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה נָמוּת לְעֵינֶיךָ גַּם אֲנַחְנוּ גַּם אַדְמָתֵנוּ קְנֵה אֹתָנוּ וְאֶת אַדְמָתֵנוּ בַּלָּחֶם וְנִהְיֶה אֲנַחְנוּ וְאַדְמָתֵנוּ עֲבָדִים לְפַרְעֹה וְתֶן זֶרַע וְנִחְיֶה וְלֹא נָמוּת וְהָאֲדָמָה לֹא תֵשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: לָמָּה נָמוּת לְעֵינֶיךָ גַּם אֲנַחְנוּ גַּם אַדְמָתֵנוּ קְנֵה אֹתָנוּ וְאֶת אַדְמָתֵנוּ בַּלָּחֶם וְנִהְיֶה אֲנַחְנוּ וְאַדְמָתֵנוּ עֲבָדִים לְפַרְעֹה וְתֶן זֶרַע וְנִחְיֶה וְלֹא נָמוּת וְהָאֲדָמָה לֹא תֵשָׁם׃

english.text:
Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land?
Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be
servants to Pharaoh; and give seed so we’ll live and not
die, and the land won’t be devastated.”

translation.text: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.

verses.english:
Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land?
Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be
servants to Pharaoh; and give seed so we’ll live and not
die, and the land won’t be devastated.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקֶן יוֹסֵף אֶת כּל אַדְמַת מִצְרַיִם לְפַרְעֹה כִּי מָכְרוּ מִצְרַיִם אִישׁ שָׂדֵהוּ כִּי חָזַק עֲלֵהֶם הָרָעָב וַתְּהִי הָאָרֶץ לְפַרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקֶן יוֹסֵף אֶת כּל אַדְמַת מִצְרַיִם לְפַרְעֹה כִּי מָכְרוּ מִצְרַיִם אִישׁ שָׂדֵהוּ כִּי חָזַק עֲלֵהֶם הָרָעָב וַתְּהִי הָאָרֶץ לְפַרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh,
because Egypt, each man, sold his field, because the
famine was strong on them. And the land became Pharaoh’s.

translation.text: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh’s.

verses.english:
And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh,
because Egypt, each man, sold his field, because the
famine was strong on them. And the land became Pharaoh’s.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָעָם הֶעֱבִיר אֹתוֹ לֶעָרִים מִקְצֵה גְבוּל מִצְרַיִם וְעַד קָצֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָעָם הֶעֱבִיר אֹתוֹ לֶעָרִים מִקְצֵה גְבוּל מִצְרַיִם וְעַד קָצֵהוּ׃

english.text:
And the people: he moved them to cities, from one edge of
Egypt’s border to its other edge.

translation.text: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.

verses.english:
And the people: he moved them to cities, from one edge of
Egypt’s border to its other edge.

verses.hebrew: רַק אַדְמַת הַכֹּהֲנִים לֹא קָנָה כִּי חֹק לַכֹּהֲנִים מֵאֵת פַּרְעֹה וְאָכְלוּ אֶת חֻקָּם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם פַּרְעֹה עַל כֵּן לֹא מָכְרוּ אֶת אַדְמָתָם׃

hebrew.text: רַק אַדְמַת הַכֹּהֲנִים לֹא קָנָה כִּי חֹק לַכֹּהֲנִים מֵאֵת פַּרְעֹה וְאָכְלוּ אֶת חֻקָּם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם פַּרְעֹה עַל כֵּן לֹא מָכְרוּ אֶת אַדְמָתָם׃

english.text:
Only the priests’ land he did not buy, because it was a
law for the priests from Pharaoh, and they ate their
statutory share that Pharaoh had given them. On account of
this they did not sell their land.

translation.text: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.

verses.english:
Only the priests’ land he did not buy, because it was a
law for the priests from Pharaoh, and they ate their
statutory share that Pharaoh had given them. On account of
this they did not sell their land.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל הָעָם הֵן קָנִיתִי אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם וְאֶת אַדְמַתְכֶם לְפַרְעֹה הֵא לָכֶם זֶרַע וּזְרַעְתֶּם אֶת הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל הָעָם הֵן קָנִיתִי אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם וְאֶת אַדְמַתְכֶם לְפַרְעֹה הֵא לָכֶם זֶרַע וּזְרַעְתֶּם אֶת הָאֲדָמָה׃

translation.text: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַּתְּבוּאֹת וּנְתַתֶּם חֲמִישִׁית לְפַרְעֹה וְאַרְבַּע הַיָּדֹת יִהְיֶה לָכֶם לְזֶרַע הַשָּׂדֶה וּלְאכְלְכֶם וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּבָתֵּיכֶם וְלֶאֱכֹל לְטַפְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בַּתְּבוּאֹת וּנְתַתֶּם חֲמִישִׁית לְפַרְעֹה וְאַרְבַּע הַיָּדֹת יִהְיֶה לָכֶם לְזֶרַע הַשָּׂדֶה וּלְאכְלְכֶם וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּבָתֵּיכֶם וְלֶאֱכֹל לְטַפְּכֶם׃

english.text:
and it will be, at the harvests, that you’ll give a fifth
to Pharaoh, and the four parts will be yours for field
seed and for you to eat and for whoever is in your
households and for your infants to eat.”

translation.text: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.

verses.english:
and it will be, at the harvests, that you’ll give a fifth
to Pharaoh, and the four parts will be yours for field
seed and for you to eat and for whoever is in your
households and for your infants to eat.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הֶחֱיִתָנוּ נִמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנִי וְהָיִינוּ עֲבָדִים לְפַרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הֶחֱיִתָנוּ נִמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנִי וְהָיִינוּ עֲבָדִים לְפַרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And they said, “You’ve kept us alive! Let us find favor in
my lord’s eyes, and we’ll be servants to Pharaoh.”

translation.text: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.

verses.english:
And they said, “You’ve kept us alive! Let us find favor in
my lord’s eyes, and we’ll be servants to Pharaoh.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֹתָהּ יוֹסֵף לְחֹק עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה עַל אַדְמַת מִצְרַיִם לְפַרְעֹה לַחֹמֶשׁ רַק אַדְמַת הַכֹּהֲנִים לְבַדָּם לֹא הָיְתָה לְפַרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֹתָהּ יוֹסֵף לְחֹק עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה עַל אַדְמַת מִצְרַיִם לְפַרְעֹה לַחֹמֶשׁ רַק אַדְמַת הַכֹּהֲנִים לְבַדָּם לֹא הָיְתָה לְפַרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Joseph set it as a law to this day on Egypt’s land: to
Pharaoh the fifth. Only the land of the priests alone was
not Pharaoh’s.

translation.text: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part, except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh’s.

verses.english:
And Joseph set it as a law to this day on Egypt’s land: to
Pharaoh the fifth. Only the land of the priests alone was
not Pharaoh’s.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן וַיֵּאָחֲזוּ בָהּ וַיִּפְרוּ וַיִּרְבּוּ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן וַיֵּאָחֲזוּ בָהּ וַיִּפְרוּ וַיִּרְבּוּ מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And Israel lived in Egypt in the land of Goshen, and they
held property in it. And they were fruitful and multiplied
very much.

translation.text: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

verses.english:
And Israel lived in Egypt in the land of Goshen, and they
held property in it. And they were fruitful and multiplied
very much.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי יַעֲקֹב בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וַיְהִי יְמֵי יַעֲקֹב שְׁנֵי חַיָּיו שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְאַרְבָּעִים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי יַעֲקֹב בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וַיְהִי יְמֵי יַעֲקֹב שְׁנֵי חַיָּיו שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְאַרְבָּעִים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt
seventeen years. And Jacob’s days, the years of his life,
were seven years and a hundred forty years.

translation.text: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.

verses.english:
And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt
seventeen years. And Jacob’s days, the years of his life,
were seven years and a hundred forty years.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְבוּ יְמֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָמוּת וַיִּקְרָא לִבְנוֹ לְיוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ שִׂים נָא יָדְךָ תַּחַת יְרֵכִי וְעָשִׂיתָ עִמָּדִי חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת אַל נָא תִקְבְּרֵנִי בְּמִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְבוּ יְמֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָמוּת וַיִּקְרָא לִבְנוֹ לְיוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ שִׂים נָא יָדְךָ תַּחַת יְרֵכִי וְעָשִׂיתָ עִמָּדִי חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת אַל נָא תִקְבְּרֵנִי בְּמִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Israel’s days to die drew close. And he called his
son, Joseph, and said to him, “If I’ve found favor in your
eyes, place your hand under my thigh and practice kindness
and faithfulness with me: don’t bury me in Egypt.

translation.text: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:

verses.english:
And Israel’s days to die drew close. And he called his
son, Joseph, and said to him, “If I’ve found favor in your
eyes, place your hand under my thigh and practice kindness
and faithfulness with me: don’t bury me in Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁכַבְתִּי עִם אֲבֹתַי וּנְשָׂאתַנִי מִמִּצְרַיִם וּקְבַרְתַּנִי בִּקְבֻרָתָם וַיֹּאמַר אָנֹכִי אֶעֱשֶׂה כִדְבָרֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁכַבְתִּי עִם אֲבֹתַי וּנְשָׂאתַנִי מִמִּצְרַיִם וּקְבַרְתַּנִי בִּקְבֻרָתָם וַיֹּאמַר אָנֹכִי אֶעֱשֶׂה כִדְבָרֶךָ׃

english.text:
And I’ll lie with my fathers, and you’ll carry me out of
Egypt and bury me in their burial place.” And he said,
“I’ll do according to your word.”

translation.text: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.

verses.english:
And I’ll lie with my fathers, and you’ll carry me out of
Egypt and bury me in their burial place.” And he said,
“I’ll do according to your word.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הִשָּׁבְעָה לִי וַיִּשָּׁבַע לוֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל רֹאשׁ הַמִּטָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הִשָּׁבְעָה לִי וַיִּשָּׁבַע לוֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל רֹאשׁ הַמִּטָּה׃

english.text:
And he said, “Swear to me.” And he swore to him. And Israel
bowed at the head of the bed.

translation.text: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed’s head.

verses.english:
And he said, “Swear to me.” And he swore to him. And Israel
bowed at the head of the bed.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר לְיוֹסֵף הִנֵּה אָבִיךָ חֹלֶה וַיִּקַּח אֶת שְׁנֵי בָנָיו עִמּוֹ אֶת מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶת אֶפְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר לְיוֹסֵף הִנֵּה אָבִיךָ חֹלֶה וַיִּקַּח אֶת שְׁנֵי בָנָיו עִמּוֹ אֶת מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶת אֶפְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And it was after these things, and one said to Joseph,
“Here, your father is sick.” And he took his two sons with
him, Man-asseh and Ephraim.

translation.text: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

verses.english:
And it was after these things, and one said to Joseph,
“Here, your father is sick.” And he took his two sons with
him, Man-asseh and Ephraim.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד לְיַעֲקֹב וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה בִּנְךָ יוֹסֵף בָּא אֵלֶיךָ וַיִּתְחַזֵּק יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל הַמִּטָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֵּד לְיַעֲקֹב וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה בִּנְךָ יוֹסֵף בָּא אֵלֶיךָ וַיִּתְחַזֵּק יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל הַמִּטָּה׃

english.text:
And one told Jacob and said, “Here, your son Joseph is
coming to you.” And Israel fortified himself and sat up on
the bed.

translation.text: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

verses.english:
And one told Jacob and said, “Here, your son Joseph is
coming to you.” And Israel fortified himself and sat up on
the bed.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל יוֹסֵף אֵל שַׁדַּי נִרְאָה אֵלַי בְּלוּז בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל יוֹסֵף אֵל שַׁדַּי נִרְאָה אֵלַי בְּלוּז בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתִי׃

english.text:
And Jacob said to Joseph, “El Shadday appeared to me in
Luz in the land of Canaan, and He blessed me

translation.text: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

verses.english:
And Jacob said to Joseph, “El Shadday appeared to me in
Luz in the land of Canaan, and He blessed me

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי הִנְנִי מַפְרְךָ וְהִרְבִּיתִךָ וּנְתַתִּיךָ לִקְהַל עַמִּים וְנָתַתִּי אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֲחֻזַּת עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי הִנְנִי מַפְרְךָ וְהִרְבִּיתִךָ וּנְתַתִּיךָ לִקְהַל עַמִּים וְנָתַתִּי אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֲחֻזַּת עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
and said to me, ‘Here, I’m making you fruitful and
multiplying you, and I’ll make you into a community of
peoples, and I’ll give this land to your seed after you,
an eternal possession.’

translation.text: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.

verses.english:
and said to me, ‘Here, I’m making you fruitful and
multiplying you, and I’ll make you into a community of
peoples, and I’ll give this land to your seed after you,
an eternal possession.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שְׁנֵי בָנֶיךָ הַנּוֹלָדִים לְךָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם עַד בֹּאִי אֵלֶיךָ מִצְרַיְמָה לִי הֵם אֶפְרַיִם וּמְנַשֶּׁה כִּרְאוּבֵן וְשִׁמְעוֹן יִהְיוּ לִי׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שְׁנֵי בָנֶיךָ הַנּוֹלָדִים לְךָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם עַד בֹּאִי אֵלֶיךָ מִצְרַיְמָה לִי הֵם אֶפְרַיִם וּמְנַשֶּׁה כִּרְאוּבֵן וְשִׁמְעוֹן יִהְיוּ לִי׃

english.text:
And now, your two sons who were born to you in the land of
Egypt by my arrival to you at Egypt: they’re mine. Ephraim
and Man-asseh will be like Reuben and Simeon to me.

translation.text: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

verses.english:
And now, your two sons who were born to you in the land of
Egypt by my arrival to you at Egypt: they’re mine. Ephraim
and Man-asseh will be like Reuben and Simeon to me.

verses.hebrew: וּמוֹלַדְתְּךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹלַדְתָּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם לְךָ יִהְיוּ עַל שֵׁם אֲחֵיהֶם יִקָּרְאוּ בְּנַחֲלָתָם׃

hebrew.text: וּמוֹלַדְתְּךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹלַדְתָּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם לְךָ יִהְיוּ עַל שֵׁם אֲחֵיהֶם יִקָּרְאוּ בְּנַחֲלָתָם׃

english.text:
And your offspring that you’ll have after them will be
yours. They shall be called by their brothers’ names with
regard to their inheritance.

translation.text: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

verses.english:
And your offspring that you’ll have after them will be
yours. They shall be called by their brothers’ names with
regard to their inheritance.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בְּבֹאִי מִפַּדָּן מֵתָה עָלַי רָחֵל בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּעוֹד כִּבְרַת אֶרֶץ לָבֹא אֶפְרָתָה וָאֶקְבְּרֶהָ שָּׁם בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶפְרָת הִוא בֵּית לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי בְּבֹאִי מִפַּדָּן מֵתָה עָלַי רָחֵל בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּעוֹד כִּבְרַת אֶרֶץ לָבֹא אֶפְרָתָה וָאֶקְבְּרֶהָ שָּׁם בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶפְרָת הִוא בֵּית לָחֶם׃

english.text:
And I: when I was coming from Paddan Aram, Rachel died by
me in the land of Canaan on the way when there was still a
span of land to come to Ephrat, and I buried her there on
the Ephrat road. That’s Bethlehem.”

translation.text: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Bethlehem.

verses.english:
And I: when I was coming from Paddan Aram, Rachel died by
me in the land of Canaan on the way when there was still a
span of land to come to Ephrat, and I buried her there on
the Ephrat road. That’s Bethlehem.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אֵלֶּה׃

english.text: And Israel saw Joseph’s sons and said, “Who are these?”

translation.text: And Israel beheld Joseph’s sons, and said, Who are these?

verses.english: And Israel saw Joseph’s sons and said, “Who are these?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל אָבִיו בָּנַי הֵם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לִי אֱלֹהִים בָּזֶה וַיֹּאמַר קָחֶם נָא אֵלַי וַאֲבָרְכֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל אָבִיו בָּנַי הֵם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לִי אֱלֹהִים בָּזֶה וַיֹּאמַר קָחֶם נָא אֵלַי וַאֲבָרְכֵם׃

english.text:
And Joseph said to his father, “They’re my sons, whom God
has given me here.” And he said, “Bring them to me, and
I’ll bless them.”

translation.text: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.

verses.english:
And Joseph said to his father, “They’re my sons, whom God
has given me here.” And he said, “Bring them to me, and
I’ll bless them.”

verses.hebrew: וְעֵינֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּבְדוּ מִזֹּקֶן לֹא יוּכַל לִרְאוֹת וַיַּגֵּשׁ אֹתָם אֵלָיו וַיִּשַּׁק לָהֶם וַיְחַבֵּק לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעֵינֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּבְדוּ מִזֹּקֶן לֹא יוּכַל לִרְאוֹת וַיַּגֵּשׁ אֹתָם אֵלָיו וַיִּשַּׁק לָהֶם וַיְחַבֵּק לָהֶם׃

english.text:
And Israel’s eyes were heavy from old age. He was not able
to see. And he brought them close to him, and he kissed
them and embraced them.

translation.text: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see.

verses.english:
And Israel’s eyes were heavy from old age. He was not able
to see. And he brought them close to him, and he kissed
them and embraced them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל יוֹסֵף רְאֹה פָנֶיךָ לֹא פִלָּלְתִּי וְהִנֵּה הֶרְאָה אֹתִי אֱלֹהִים גַּם אֶת זַרְעֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל יוֹסֵף רְאֹה פָנֶיךָ לֹא פִלָּלְתִּי וְהִנֵּה הֶרְאָה אֹתִי אֱלֹהִים גַּם אֶת זַרְעֶךָ׃

english.text:
And Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t expect to see your
face; and, here, God has shown me your seed as well.”

translation.text: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.

verses.english:
And Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t expect to see your
face; and, here, God has shown me your seed as well.”

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצֵא יוֹסֵף אֹתָם מֵעִם בִּרְכָּיו וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לְאַפָּיו אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹצֵא יוֹסֵף אֹתָם מֵעִם בִּרְכָּיו וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לְאַפָּיו אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he
bowed, his nose to the ground.

translation.text: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

verses.english:
And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he
bowed, his nose to the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יוֹסֵף אֶת שְׁנֵיהֶם אֶת אֶפְרַיִם בִּימִינוֹ מִשְּׂמֹאל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת מְנַשֶּׁה בִשְׂמֹאלוֹ מִימִין יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּגֵּשׁ אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח יוֹסֵף אֶת שְׁנֵיהֶם אֶת אֶפְרַיִם בִּימִינוֹ מִשְּׂמֹאל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת מְנַשֶּׁה בִשְׂמֹאלוֹ מִימִין יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּגֵּשׁ אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
And Joseph took the two of them, Ephraim in his right
hand, at Israel’s left; and Manasseh in his left hand, at
Israel’s right; and he brought them over to him.

translation.text: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near unto him.

verses.english:
And Joseph took the two of them, Ephraim in his right
hand, at Israel’s left; and Manasseh in his left hand, at
Israel’s right; and he brought them over to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת יְמִינוֹ וַיָּשֶׁת עַל רֹאשׁ אֶפְרַיִם וְהוּא הַצָּעִיר וְאֶת שְׂמֹאלוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ מְנַשֶּׁה שִׂכֵּל אֶת יָדָיו כִּי מְנַשֶּׁה הַבְּכוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת יְמִינוֹ וַיָּשֶׁת עַל רֹאשׁ אֶפְרַיִם וְהוּא הַצָּעִיר וְאֶת שְׂמֹאלוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ מְנַשֶּׁה שִׂכֵּל אֶת יָדָיו כִּי מְנַשֶּׁה הַבְּכוֹר׃

english.text:
And Israel put out his right hand and placed it on
Ephraim’s head—and he was the younger—and his left hand on
Manasseh’s head. He crossed his hands—because Manasseh was
the firstborn.

translation.text: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.

verses.english:
And Israel put out his right hand and placed it on
Ephraim’s head—and he was the younger—and his left hand on
Manasseh’s head. He crossed his hands—because Manasseh was
the firstborn.

verses.hebrew: וַיְבָרֶךְ אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמַר הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר הִתְהַלְּכוּ אֲבֹתַי לְפָנָיו אַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק הָאֱלֹהִים הָרֹעֶה אֹתִי מֵעוֹדִי עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבָרֶךְ אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמַר הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר הִתְהַלְּכוּ אֲבֹתַי לְפָנָיו אַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק הָאֱלֹהִים הָרֹעֶה אֹתִי מֵעוֹדִי עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And he blessed Joseph and said, “The God before whom my
fathers, Abraham and Isaac, walked, who shepherded me from
my start to this day,

translation.text: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,

verses.english:
And he blessed Joseph and said, “The God before whom my
fathers, Abraham and Isaac, walked, who shepherded me from
my start to this day,

verses.hebrew: הַמַּלְאָךְ הַגֹּאֵל אֹתִי מִכּל רָע יְבָרֵךְ אֶת הַנְּעָרִים וְיִקָּרֵא בָהֶם שְׁמִי וְשֵׁם אֲבֹתַי אַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק וְיִדְגּוּ לָרֹב בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: הַמַּלְאָךְ הַגֹּאֵל אֹתִי מִכּל רָע יְבָרֵךְ אֶת הַנְּעָרִים וְיִקָּרֵא בָהֶם שְׁמִי וְשֵׁם אֲבֹתַי אַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק וְיִדְגּוּ לָרֹב בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
the angel who redeemed me from all bad, may He bless the
boys. And may my name be called on them, and the name of
my fathers, Abraham and Isaac. And may they spawn into a
great number within the earth.”

translation.text: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

verses.english:
the angel who redeemed me from all bad, may He bless the
boys. And may my name be called on them, and the name of
my fathers, Abraham and Isaac. And may they spawn into a
great number within the earth.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יוֹסֵף כִּי יָשִׁית אָבִיו יַד יְמִינוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ אֶפְרַיִם וַיֵּרַע בְּעֵינָיו וַיִּתְמֹךְ יַד אָבִיו לְהָסִיר אֹתָהּ מֵעַל רֹאשׁ אֶפְרַיִם עַל רֹאשׁ מְנַשֶּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יוֹסֵף כִּי יָשִׁית אָבִיו יַד יְמִינוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ אֶפְרַיִם וַיֵּרַע בְּעֵינָיו וַיִּתְמֹךְ יַד אָבִיו לְהָסִיר אֹתָהּ מֵעַל רֹאשׁ אֶפְרַיִם עַל רֹאשׁ מְנַשֶּׁה׃

english.text:
And Joseph saw that his father had placed his right hand
on Ephraim’s head, and it was bad in his eyes, and he held
up his father’s hand to turn it from on Ephraim’s head
onto Manasseh’s head,

translation.text: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head unto Manasseh’s head.

verses.english:
And Joseph saw that his father had placed his right hand
on Ephraim’s head, and it was bad in his eyes, and he held
up his father’s hand to turn it from on Ephraim’s head
onto Manasseh’s head,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל אָבִיו לֹא כֵן אָבִי כִּי זֶה הַבְּכֹר שִׂים יְמִינְךָ עַל רֹאשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל אָבִיו לֹא כֵן אָבִי כִּי זֶה הַבְּכֹר שִׂים יְמִינְךָ עַל רֹאשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
and Joseph said to his father, “Not like that, my father,
because this is the firstborn. Set your right hand on his
head.”

translation.text: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.

verses.english:
and Joseph said to his father, “Not like that, my father,
because this is the firstborn. Set your right hand on his
head.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְמָאֵן אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר יָדַעְתִּי בְנִי יָדַעְתִּי גַּם הוּא יִהְיֶה לְּעָם וְגַם הוּא יִגְדָּל וְאוּלָם אָחִיו הַקָּטֹן יִגְדַּל מִמֶּנּוּ וְזַרְעוֹ יִהְיֶה מְלֹא הַגּוֹיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמָאֵן אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר יָדַעְתִּי בְנִי יָדַעְתִּי גַּם הוּא יִהְיֶה לְּעָם וְגַם הוּא יִגְדָּל וְאוּלָם אָחִיו הַקָּטֹן יִגְדַּל מִמֶּנּוּ וְזַרְעוֹ יִהְיֶה מְלֹא הַגּוֹיִם׃

english.text:
And his father refused and said, “I know, my son, I know.
He, too, will become a people; and he, too, will be great.
But in fact his little brother will be greater than he,
and his seed will be full-fledged of nations.”

translation.text: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

verses.english:
And his father refused and said, “I know, my son, I know.
He, too, will become a people; and he, too, will be great.
But in fact his little brother will be greater than he,
and his seed will be full-fledged of nations.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְבָרְכֵם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמוֹר בְּךָ יְבָרֵךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר יְשִׂמְךָ אֱלֹהִים כְּאֶפְרַיִם וְכִמְנַשֶּׁה וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת אֶפְרַיִם לִפְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבָרְכֵם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמוֹר בְּךָ יְבָרֵךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר יְשִׂמְךָ אֱלֹהִים כְּאֶפְרַיִם וְכִמְנַשֶּׁה וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת אֶפְרַיִם לִפְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה׃

english.text:
And he blessed them in that day, saying, “Israel will
bless with you, saying: ‘May God make you like Ephraim and
like Manasseh.’” And he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

translation.text: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

verses.english:
And he blessed them in that day, saying, “Israel will
bless with you, saying: ‘May God make you like Ephraim and
like Manasseh.’” And he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל יוֹסֵף הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מֵת וְהָיָה אֱלֹהִים עִמָּכֶם וְהֵשִׁיב אֶתְכֶם אֶל אֶרֶץ אֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל יוֹסֵף הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מֵת וְהָיָה אֱלֹהִים עִמָּכֶם וְהֵשִׁיב אֶתְכֶם אֶל אֶרֶץ אֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And Israel said to Joseph, “Here, I’m dying. And God will
be with you and will bring you back to your fathers’ land.

translation.text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

verses.english:
And Israel said to Joseph, “Here, I’m dying. And God will
be with you and will bring you back to your fathers’ land.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי נָתַתִּי לְךָ שְׁכֶם אַחַד עַל אַחֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר לָקַחְתִּי מִיַּד הָאֱמֹרִי בְּחַרְבִּי וּבְקַשְׁתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי נָתַתִּי לְךָ שְׁכֶם אַחַד עַל אַחֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר לָקַחְתִּי מִיַּד הָאֱמֹרִי בְּחַרְבִּי וּבְקַשְׁתִּי׃

english.text:
And I’ve given you one shoulder over your brothers, which
I took from the Amorite’s hand with my sword and my bow.

translation.text: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.

verses.english:
And I’ve given you one shoulder over your brothers, which
I took from the Amorite’s hand with my sword and my bow.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יַעֲקֹב אֶל בָּנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הֵאָסְפוּ וְאַגִּידָה לָכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָא אֶתְכֶם בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יַעֲקֹב אֶל בָּנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הֵאָסְפוּ וְאַגִּידָה לָכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָא אֶתְכֶם בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
And Jacob called to his sons and said: Gather, and I’ll
tell you what will happen to you in the future days.

translation.text: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.

verses.english:
And Jacob called to his sons and said: Gather, and I’ll
tell you what will happen to you in the future days.

verses.hebrew: הִקָּבְצוּ וְשִׁמְעוּ בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב וְשִׁמְעוּ אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲבִיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: הִקָּבְצוּ וְשִׁמְעוּ בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב וְשִׁמְעוּ אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲבִיכֶם׃

english.text:
Assemble and listen, sons of Jacob, and listen to Israel,
your father.

translation.text: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.

verses.english:
Assemble and listen, sons of Jacob, and listen to Israel,
your father.

verses.hebrew: רְאוּבֵן בְּכֹרִי אַתָּה כֹּחִי וְרֵאשִׁית אוֹנִי יֶתֶר שְׂאֵת וְיֶתֶר עָז׃

hebrew.text: רְאוּבֵן בְּכֹרִי אַתָּה כֹּחִי וְרֵאשִׁית אוֹנִי יֶתֶר שְׂאֵת וְיֶתֶר עָז׃

english.text:
Reuben, you’re my firstborn, my power, and the beginning
of my might, preeminent in bearing and preeminent in
strength.

translation.text: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:

verses.english:
Reuben, you’re my firstborn, my power, and the beginning
of my might, preeminent in bearing and preeminent in
strength.

verses.hebrew: פַּחַז כַּמַּיִם אַל תּוֹתַר כִּי עָלִיתָ מִשְׁכְּבֵי אָבִיךָ אָז חִלַּלְתָּ יְצוּעִי עָלָה׃

hebrew.text: פַּחַז כַּמַּיִם אַל תּוֹתַר כִּי עָלִיתָ מִשְׁכְּבֵי אָבִיךָ אָז חִלַּלְתָּ יְצוּעִי עָלָה׃

english.text:
Unstable as water, you’ll not be preeminent, for you
ascended your father’s bed; then you defiled, going up to
my couch.

translation.text: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father’s bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.

verses.english:
Unstable as water, you’ll not be preeminent, for you
ascended your father’s bed; then you defiled, going up to
my couch.

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי אַחִים כְּלֵי חָמָס מְכֵרֹתֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי אַחִים כְּלֵי חָמָס מְכֵרֹתֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Simeon and Levi are brothers: Implements of violence are
their tools of trade.

translation.text: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.

verses.english:
Simeon and Levi are brothers: Implements of violence are
their tools of trade.

verses.hebrew: בְּסֹדָם אַל תָּבֹא נַפְשִׁי בִּקְהָלָם אַל תֵּחַד כְּבֹדִי כִּי בְאַפָּם הָרְגוּ אִישׁ וּבִרְצֹנָם עִקְּרוּ שׁוֹר׃

hebrew.text: בְּסֹדָם אַל תָּבֹא נַפְשִׁי בִּקְהָלָם אַל תֵּחַד כְּבֹדִי כִּי בְאַפָּם הָרְגוּ אִישׁ וּבִרְצֹנָם עִקְּרוּ שׁוֹר׃

english.text:
Let my soul not come in their council; let my glory not be
united in their society. For in their anger they killed a
man, and by their will they crippled an ox.

translation.text: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

verses.english:
Let my soul not come in their council; let my glory not be
united in their society. For in their anger they killed a
man, and by their will they crippled an ox.

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר אַפָּם כִּי עָז וְעֶבְרָתָם כִּי קָשָׁתָה אֲחַלְּקֵם בְּיַעֲקֹב וַאֲפִיצֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר אַפָּם כִּי עָז וְעֶבְרָתָם כִּי קָשָׁתָה אֲחַלְּקֵם בְּיַעֲקֹב וַאֲפִיצֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Cursed is their anger, for it’s strong, and their wrath,
for it’s hard. I’ll divide them in Jacob, and I’ll scatter
them in Israel.

translation.text: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

verses.english:
Cursed is their anger, for it’s strong, and their wrath,
for it’s hard. I’ll divide them in Jacob, and I’ll scatter
them in Israel.

verses.hebrew: יְהוּדָה אַתָּה יוֹדוּךָ אַחֶיךָ יָדְךָ בְּעֹרֶף אֹיְבֶיךָ יִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְךָ בְּנֵי אָבִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: יְהוּדָה אַתָּה יוֹדוּךָ אַחֶיךָ יָדְךָ בְּעֹרֶף אֹיְבֶיךָ יִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְךָ בְּנֵי אָבִיךָ׃

english.text:
Judah: You, your brothers will praise you. Your hand on
your enemies’ neck, your father’s sons will bow to you.

translation.text: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father’s children shall bow down before thee.

verses.english:
Judah: You, your brothers will praise you. Your hand on
your enemies’ neck, your father’s sons will bow to you.

verses.hebrew: גּוּר אַרְיֵה יְהוּדָה מִטֶּרֶף בְּנִי עָלִיתָ כָּרַע רָבַץ כְּאַרְיֵה וּכְלָבִיא מִי יְקִימֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: גּוּר אַרְיֵה יְהוּדָה מִטֶּרֶף בְּנִי עָלִיתָ כָּרַע רָבַץ כְּאַרְיֵה וּכְלָבִיא מִי יְקִימֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
A lion’s whelp is Judah; from prey, my son, you’ve risen.
