He bent, crouched, like a lion; and, like a feline, who
will rouse him?

translation.text: Judah is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

verses.english:
A lion’s whelp is Judah; from prey, my son, you’ve risen.
He bent, crouched, like a lion; and, like a feline, who
will rouse him?

verses.hebrew: לֹא יָסוּר שֵׁבֶט מִיהוּדָה וּמְחֹקֵק מִבֵּין רַגְלָיו עַד כִּי יָבֹא שִׁילֹה וְלוֹ יִקְּהַת עַמִּים׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יָסוּר שֵׁבֶט מִיהוּדָה וּמְחֹקֵק מִבֵּין רַגְלָיו עַד כִּי יָבֹא שִׁילֹה וְלוֹ יִקְּהַת עַמִּים׃

english.text:
The scepter won’t depart from Judah or a ruler from
between his legs until he comes to Shiloh, and peoples’
obedience is his.

translation.text: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

verses.english:
The scepter won’t depart from Judah or a ruler from
between his legs until he comes to Shiloh, and peoples’
obedience is his.

verses.hebrew: אֹסְרִי לַגֶּפֶן עִירֹה וְלַשֹּׂרֵקָה בְּנִי אֲתֹנוֹ כִּבֵּס בַּיַּיִן לְבֻשׁוֹ וּבְדַם עֲנָבִים סוּתֹה׃

hebrew.text: אֹסְרִי לַגֶּפֶן עִירֹה וְלַשֹּׂרֵקָה בְּנִי אֲתֹנוֹ כִּבֵּס בַּיַּיִן לְבֻשׁוֹ וּבְדַם עֲנָבִים סוּתֹה׃

english.text:
Tying his ass to the vine and his she-ass’s foal to the
choice vine, he washed in wine his clothing and in blood
of grapes his garment,

translation.text: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass’s colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:

verses.english:
Tying his ass to the vine and his she-ass’s foal to the
choice vine, he washed in wine his clothing and in blood
of grapes his garment,

verses.hebrew: חַכְלִילִי עֵינַיִם מִיָּיִן וּלְבֶן שִׁנַּיִם מֵחָלָב׃

hebrew.text: חַכְלִילִי עֵינַיִם מִיָּיִן וּלְבֶן שִׁנַּיִם מֵחָלָב׃

english.text: eyes darker than wine and teeth whiter than milk.

translation.text: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.

verses.english: eyes darker than wine and teeth whiter than milk.

verses.hebrew: זְבוּלֻן לְחוֹף יַמִּים יִשְׁכֹּן וְהוּא לְחוֹף אֳנִיֹּת וְיַרְכָתוֹ עַל צִידֹן׃

hebrew.text: זְבוּלֻן לְחוֹף יַמִּים יִשְׁכֹּן וְהוּא לְחוֹף אֳנִיֹּת וְיַרְכָתוֹ עַל צִידֹן׃

english.text:
Zebulun will dwell by seashores: and he’ll be a shore for
boats, and his border at Sidon.

translation.text: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.

verses.english:
Zebulun will dwell by seashores: and he’ll be a shore for
boats, and his border at Sidon.

verses.hebrew: יִשָּׂשכָר חֲמֹר גָּרֶם רֹבֵץ בֵּין הַמִּשְׁפְּתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: יִשָּׂשכָר חֲמֹר גָּרֶם רֹבֵץ בֵּין הַמִּשְׁפְּתָיִם׃

english.text:
Issachar is a strong ass crouching between the
saddle-packs:

translation.text: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:

verses.english:
Issachar is a strong ass crouching between the
saddle-packs:

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא מְנֻחָה כִּי טוֹב וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ כִּי נָעֵמָה וַיֵּט שִׁכְמוֹ לִסְבֹּל וַיְהִי לְמַס עֹבֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא מְנֻחָה כִּי טוֹב וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ כִּי נָעֵמָה וַיֵּט שִׁכְמוֹ לִסְבֹּל וַיְהִי לְמַס עֹבֵד׃

english.text:
and he saw rest, that it was good, and the land, that it
was pleasant, and he leaned his shoulder to bear and
became a work-company servant.

translation.text: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.

verses.english:
and he saw rest, that it was good, and the land, that it
was pleasant, and he leaned his shoulder to bear and
became a work-company servant.

verses.hebrew: דָּן יָדִין עַמּוֹ כְּאַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: דָּן יָדִין עַמּוֹ כְּאַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text: Dan will judge his people as one of the tribes of Israel:

translation.text: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

verses.english: Dan will judge his people as one of the tribes of Israel:

verses.hebrew: יְהִי דָן נָחָשׁ עֲלֵי דֶרֶךְ שְׁפִיפֹן עֲלֵי אֹרַח הַנֹּשֵׁךְ עִקְּבֵי סוּס וַיִּפֹּל רֹכְבוֹ אָחוֹר׃

hebrew.text: יְהִי דָן נָחָשׁ עֲלֵי דֶרֶךְ שְׁפִיפֹן עֲלֵי אֹרַח הַנֹּשֵׁךְ עִקְּבֵי סוּס וַיִּפֹּל רֹכְבוֹ אָחוֹר׃

english.text:
Dan will be a snake on a road, a venomous snake on a path,
that bites a horse’s heels, and its rider falls backward.

translation.text: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.

verses.english:
Dan will be a snake on a road, a venomous snake on a path,
that bites a horse’s heels, and its rider falls backward.

verses.hebrew: לִישׁוּעָתְךָ קִוִּיתִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: לִישׁוּעָתְךָ קִוִּיתִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text: I wait for your salvation, YHWH.

translation.text: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.

verses.english: I wait for your salvation, YHWH.

verses.hebrew: גָּד גְּדוּד יְגוּדֶנּוּ וְהוּא יָגֻד עָקֵב׃

hebrew.text: גָּד גְּדוּד יְגוּדֶנּוּ וְהוּא יָגֻד עָקֵב׃

english.text: Gad: a troop will trap him, and he’ll trap their heel.

translation.text: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.

verses.english: Gad: a troop will trap him, and he’ll trap their heel.

verses.hebrew: מֵאָשֵׁר שְׁמֵנָה לַחְמוֹ וְהוּא יִתֵּן מַעֲדַנֵּי מֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: מֵאָשֵׁר שְׁמֵנָה לַחְמוֹ וְהוּא יִתֵּן מַעֲדַנֵּי מֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Asher: his bread will be rich, and he’ll provide a king’s
delights.

translation.text: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.

verses.english:
Asher: his bread will be rich, and he’ll provide a king’s
delights.

verses.hebrew: נַפְתָּלִי אַיָּלָה שְׁלֻחָה הַנֹּתֵן אִמְרֵי שָׁפֶר׃

hebrew.text: נַפְתָּלִי אַיָּלָה שְׁלֻחָה הַנֹּתֵן אִמְרֵי שָׁפֶר׃

english.text: Naphtali: a hind let loose, who gives lovely words.

translation.text: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.

verses.english: Naphtali: a hind let loose, who gives lovely words.

verses.hebrew: בֵּן פֹּרָת יוֹסֵף בֵּן פֹּרָת עֲלֵי עָיִן בָּנוֹת צָעֲדָה עֲלֵי שׁוּר׃

hebrew.text: בֵּן פֹּרָת יוֹסֵף בֵּן פֹּרָת עֲלֵי עָיִן בָּנוֹת צָעֲדָה עֲלֵי שׁוּר׃

english.text:
A fruitful bough is Joseph, a fruitful bough over a
spring, branches running over a wall:

translation.text: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:

verses.english:
A fruitful bough is Joseph, a fruitful bough over a
spring, branches running over a wall:

verses.hebrew: וַיְמָרְרֻהוּ וָרֹבּוּ וַיִּשְׂטְמֻהוּ בַּעֲלֵי חִצִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמָרְרֻהוּ וָרֹבּוּ וַיִּשְׂטְמֻהוּ בַּעֲלֵי חִצִּים׃

english.text:
And archers bitterly attacked him, shot at him, and
despised him.

translation.text: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:

verses.english:
And archers bitterly attacked him, shot at him, and
despised him.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּשֶׁב בְּאֵיתָן קַשְׁתּוֹ וַיָּפֹזּוּ זְרֹעֵי יָדָיו מִידֵי אֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב מִשָּׁם רֹעֶה אֶבֶן יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּשֶׁב בְּאֵיתָן קַשְׁתּוֹ וַיָּפֹזּוּ זְרֹעֵי יָדָיו מִידֵי אֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב מִשָּׁם רֹעֶה אֶבֶן יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And his bow stayed strong, and his forearms were nimble,
from the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, from there, the
shepherd, the rock of Israel,

translation.text: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)

verses.english:
And his bow stayed strong, and his forearms were nimble,
from the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, from there, the
shepherd, the rock of Israel,

verses.hebrew: מֵאֵל אָבִיךָ וְיַעְזְרֶךָּ וְאֵת שַׁדַּי וִיבָרְכֶךָּ בִּרְכֹת שָׁמַיִם מֵעָל בִּרְכֹת תְּהוֹם רֹבֶצֶת תָּחַת בִּרְכֹת שָׁדַיִם וָרָחַם׃

hebrew.text: מֵאֵל אָבִיךָ וְיַעְזְרֶךָּ וְאֵת שַׁדַּי וִיבָרְכֶךָּ בִּרְכֹת שָׁמַיִם מֵעָל בִּרְכֹת תְּהוֹם רֹבֶצֶת תָּחַת בִּרְכֹת שָׁדַיִם וָרָחַם׃

english.text:
from your father’s God, and He’ll strengthen you, and
Shadday, and He’ll bless you, blessings of skies from
above, blessings of deep, crouching below, blessings of
breast and womb.

translation.text: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:

verses.english:
from your father’s God, and He’ll strengthen you, and
Shadday, and He’ll bless you, blessings of skies from
above, blessings of deep, crouching below, blessings of
breast and womb.

verses.hebrew: בִּרְכֹת אָבִיךָ גָּבְרוּ עַל בִּרְכֹת הוֹרַי עַד תַּאֲוַת גִּבְעֹת עוֹלָם תִּהְיֶיןָ לְרֹאשׁ יוֹסֵף וּלְקדְקֹד נְזִיר אֶחָיו׃

hebrew.text: בִּרְכֹת אָבִיךָ גָּבְרוּ עַל בִּרְכֹת הוֹרַי עַד תַּאֲוַת גִּבְעֹת עוֹלָם תִּהְיֶיןָ לְרֹאשׁ יוֹסֵף וּלְקדְקֹד נְזִיר אֶחָיו׃

english.text:
blessings of your father, the mighty and most high,
blessings of the mountains of old desired object of the
hills of antiquity. They’ll be on Joseph’s head, on the
top of the head of the one separate from his brothers.

translation.text: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.

verses.english:
blessings of your father, the mighty and most high,
blessings of the mountains of old desired object of the
hills of antiquity. They’ll be on Joseph’s head, on the
top of the head of the one separate from his brothers.

verses.hebrew: בִּנְיָמִין זְאֵב יִטְרָף בַּבֹּקֶר יֹאכַל עַד וְלָעֶרֶב יְחַלֵּק שָׁלָל׃

hebrew.text: בִּנְיָמִין זְאֵב יִטְרָף בַּבֹּקֶר יֹאכַל עַד וְלָעֶרֶב יְחַלֵּק שָׁלָל׃

english.text:
Benjamin is a tearing wolf: in the morning eating prey,
and at evening dividing booty.

translation.text: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.

verses.english:
Benjamin is a tearing wolf: in the morning eating prey,
and at evening dividing booty.

verses.hebrew: כּל אֵלֶּה שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר וְזֹאת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם אֲבִיהֶם וַיְבָרֶךְ אוֹתָם אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר כְּבִרְכָתוֹ בֵּרַךְ אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: כּל אֵלֶּה שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר וְזֹאת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם אֲבִיהֶם וַיְבָרֶךְ אוֹתָם אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר כְּבִרְכָתוֹ בֵּרַךְ אֹתָם׃

english.text:
All these are the tribes of Israel, twelve, and this is
what their father spoke to them, and he blessed them. He
blessed them each according to his blessing.

translation.text: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

verses.english:
All these are the tribes of Israel, twelve, and this is
what their father spoke to them, and he blessed them. He
blessed them each according to his blessing.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו אוֹתָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אֲנִי נֶאֱסָף אֶל עַמִּי קִבְרוּ אֹתִי אֶל אֲבֹתָי אֶל הַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂדֵה עֶפְרוֹן הַחִתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו אוֹתָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אֲנִי נֶאֱסָף אֶל עַמִּי קִבְרוּ אֹתִי אֶל אֲבֹתָי אֶל הַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂדֵה עֶפְרוֹן הַחִתִּי׃

english.text:
And he commanded them and said to them, “I’m being
gathered to my people. Bury me: to my fathers, to the cave
that’s in the field of Ephron, the Hittite,

verses.english:
And he commanded them and said to them, “I’m being
gathered to my people. Bury me: to my fathers, to the cave
that’s in the field of Ephron, the Hittite,

verses.hebrew: בַּמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂדֵה הַמַּכְפֵּלָה אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵא בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן אֲשֶׁר קָנָה אַבְרָהָם אֶת הַשָּׂדֶה מֵאֵת עֶפְרֹן הַחִתִּי לַאֲחֻזַּת קָבֶר׃

hebrew.text: בַּמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂדֵה הַמַּכְפֵּלָה אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵא בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן אֲשֶׁר קָנָה אַבְרָהָם אֶת הַשָּׂדֶה מֵאֵת עֶפְרֹן הַחִתִּי לַאֲחֻזַּת קָבֶר׃

english.text:
in the cave that’s in the field of Machpelah, which faces
Mamre in the land of Canaan, as Abraham bought the field
from Ephron, the Hittite, as a possession for a tomb.

translation.text: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.

verses.english:
in the cave that’s in the field of Machpelah, which faces
Mamre in the land of Canaan, as Abraham bought the field
from Ephron, the Hittite, as a possession for a tomb.

verses.hebrew: שָׁמָּה קָבְרוּ אֶת אַבְרָהָם וְאֵת שָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ שָׁמָּה קָבְרוּ אֶת יִצְחָק וְאֵת רִבְקָה אִשְׁתּוֹ וְשָׁמָּה קָבַרְתִּי אֶת לֵאָה׃

hebrew.text: שָׁמָּה קָבְרוּ אֶת אַבְרָהָם וְאֵת שָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ שָׁמָּה קָבְרוּ אֶת יִצְחָק וְאֵת רִבְקָה אִשְׁתּוֹ וְשָׁמָּה קָבַרְתִּי אֶת לֵאָה׃

english.text:
There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they
buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife. And there I buried
Leah.

translation.text: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.

verses.english:
There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they
buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife. And there I buried
Leah.

verses.hebrew: מִקְנֵה הַשָּׂדֶה וְהַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מֵאֵת בְּנֵי חֵת׃

hebrew.text: מִקְנֵה הַשָּׂדֶה וְהַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מֵאֵת בְּנֵי חֵת׃

english.text:
The field and the cave that’s in it were a purchase from
the children of Heth.”

translation.text: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.

verses.english:
The field and the cave that’s in it were a purchase from
the children of Heth.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַל יַעֲקֹב לְצַוֺּת אֶת בָּנָיו וַיֶּאֱסֹף רַגְלָיו אֶל הַמִּטָּה וַיִּגְוַע וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְכַל יַעֲקֹב לְצַוֺּת אֶת בָּנָיו וַיֶּאֱסֹף רַגְלָיו אֶל הַמִּטָּה וַיִּגְוַע וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו׃

english.text:
And Jacob finished commanding his sons, and he gathered
his feet into the bed, and he expired, and he was gathered
to his people.

translation.text: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.

verses.english:
And Jacob finished commanding his sons, and he gathered
his feet into the bed, and he expired, and he was gathered
to his people.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֹּל יוֹסֵף עַל פְּנֵי אָבִיו וַיֵּבְךְּ עָלָיו וַיִּשַּׁק לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֹּל יוֹסֵף עַל פְּנֵי אָבִיו וַיֵּבְךְּ עָלָיו וַיִּשַּׁק לוֹ׃

english.text:
And Joseph fell upon his father’s face and wept over
him and kissed him.

translation.text: And Joseph fell upon his father’s face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.

verses.english:
And Joseph fell upon his father’s face and wept over
him and kissed him.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו יוֹסֵף אֶת עֲבָדָיו אֶת הָרֹפְאִים לַחֲנֹט אֶת אָבִיו וַיַּחַנְטוּ הָרֹפְאִים אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו יוֹסֵף אֶת עֲבָדָיו אֶת הָרֹפְאִים לַחֲנֹט אֶת אָבִיו וַיַּחַנְטוּ הָרֹפְאִים אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to
embalm his father. And the physicians embalmed Israel,

translation.text: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.

verses.english:
And Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to
embalm his father. And the physicians embalmed Israel,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְלְאוּ לוֹ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם כִּי כֵּן יִמְלְאוּ יְמֵי הַחֲנֻטִים וַיִּבְכּוּ אֹתוֹ מִצְרַיִם שִׁבְעִים יוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְלְאוּ לוֹ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם כִּי כֵּן יִמְלְאוּ יְמֵי הַחֲנֻטִים וַיִּבְכּוּ אֹתוֹ מִצְרַיִם שִׁבְעִים יוֹם׃

english.text:
and they spent forty days on him, because that is the
number of days they spent on the embalming, and Egypt
mourned him seventy days.

translation.text: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.

verses.english:
and they spent forty days on him, because that is the
number of days they spent on the embalming, and Egypt
mourned him seventy days.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְרוּ יְמֵי בְכִיתוֹ וַיְדַבֵּר יוֹסֵף אֶל בֵּית פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֵיכֶם דַּבְּרוּ נָא בְּאזְנֵי פַרְעֹה לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַבְרוּ יְמֵי בְכִיתוֹ וַיְדַבֵּר יוֹסֵף אֶל בֵּית פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֵיכֶם דַּבְּרוּ נָא בְּאזְנֵי פַרְעֹה לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And his mourning days passed, and Joseph spoke to
Pharaoh’s house, saying, “If I’ve found favor in your
eyes, speak in Pharaoh’s ears, saying,

translation.text: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

verses.english:
And his mourning days passed, and Joseph spoke to
Pharaoh’s house, saying, “If I’ve found favor in your
eyes, speak in Pharaoh’s ears, saying,

verses.hebrew: אָבִי הִשְׁבִּיעַנִי לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מֵת בְּקִבְרִי אֲשֶׁר כָּרִיתִי לִי בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן שָׁמָּה תִּקְבְּרֵנִי וְעַתָּה אֶעֱלֶה נָּא וְאֶקְבְּרָה אֶת אָבִי וְאָשׁוּבָה׃

hebrew.text: אָבִי הִשְׁבִּיעַנִי לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מֵת בְּקִבְרִי אֲשֶׁר כָּרִיתִי לִי בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן שָׁמָּה תִּקְבְּרֵנִי וְעַתָּה אֶעֱלֶה נָּא וְאֶקְבְּרָה אֶת אָבִי וְאָשׁוּבָה׃

english.text:
‘My father had me swear, saying, “Here I’m dying. In my
tomb, which I dug for me in the land of Canaan: you shall
bury me there.” And now, let me go up so I may bury my
father and come back.’”

translation.text: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.

verses.english:
‘My father had me swear, saying, “Here I’m dying. In my
tomb, which I dug for me in the land of Canaan: you shall
bury me there.” And now, let me go up so I may bury my
father and come back.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה עֲלֵה וּקְבֹר אֶת אָבִיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר הִשְׁבִּיעֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה עֲלֵה וּקְבֹר אֶת אָבִיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר הִשְׁבִּיעֶךָ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said, “Go up and bury your father as he had
you swear.”

translation.text: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said, “Go up and bury your father as he had
you swear.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל יוֹסֵף לִקְבֹּר אֶת אָבִיו וַיַּעֲלוּ אִתּוֹ כּל עַבְדֵי פַרְעֹה זִקְנֵי בֵיתוֹ וְכֹל זִקְנֵי אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל יוֹסֵף לִקְבֹּר אֶת אָבִיו וַיַּעֲלוּ אִתּוֹ כּל עַבְדֵי פַרְעֹה זִקְנֵי בֵיתוֹ וְכֹל זִקְנֵי אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Joseph went up to bury his father, and all of
Pharaoh’s servants, the elders of his house, and all the
elders of the land of Egypt,

translation.text: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

verses.english:
And Joseph went up to bury his father, and all of
Pharaoh’s servants, the elders of his house, and all the
elders of the land of Egypt,

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל בֵּית יוֹסֵף וְאֶחָיו וּבֵית אָבִיו רַק טַפָּם וְצֹאנָם וּבְקָרָם עָזְבוּ בְּאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל בֵּית יוֹסֵף וְאֶחָיו וּבֵית אָבִיו רַק טַפָּם וְצֹאנָם וּבְקָרָם עָזְבוּ בְּאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן׃

english.text:
and all of Joseph’s house and his brothers and his
father’s house. Only their infants and their flock and
their oxen they left in the land of Goshen.

translation.text: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father’s house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

verses.english:
and all of Joseph’s house and his brothers and his
father’s house. Only their infants and their flock and
their oxen they left in the land of Goshen.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל עִמּוֹ גַּם רֶכֶב גַּם פָּרָשִׁים וַיְהִי הַמַּחֲנֶה כָּבֵד מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל עִמּוֹ גַּם רֶכֶב גַּם פָּרָשִׁים וַיְהִי הַמַּחֲנֶה כָּבֵד מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And both chariots and horsemen went up with him. It was a
very heavy camp.

translation.text: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.

verses.english:
And both chariots and horsemen went up with him. It was a
very heavy camp.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד גֹּרֶן הָאָטָד אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּסְפְּדוּ שָׁם מִסְפֵּד גָּדוֹל וְכָבֵד מְאֹד וַיַּעַשׂ לְאָבִיו אֵבֶל שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד גֹּרֶן הָאָטָד אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּסְפְּדוּ שָׁם מִסְפֵּד גָּדוֹל וְכָבֵד מְאֹד וַיַּעַשׂ לְאָבִיו אֵבֶל שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

english.text:
And they came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is
across the Jordan, and they had a very big and heavy
funeral, and he made a mourning for his father or seven
days.

translation.text: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.

verses.english:
And they came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is
across the Jordan, and they had a very big and heavy
funeral, and he made a mourning for his father or seven
days.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי אֶת הָאֵבֶל בְּגֹרֶן הָאָטָד וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵבֶל כָּבֵד זֶה לְמִצְרָיִם עַל כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמָהּ אָבֵל מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי אֶת הָאֵבֶל בְּגֹרֶן הָאָטָד וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵבֶל כָּבֵד זֶה לְמִצְרָיִם עַל כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמָהּ אָבֵל מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
And the Canaanite residents of the land saw the mourning
at the threshing floor of Atad and said, “This is a heavy
mourning to Egypt.” On account of this its name was called
Abel of Egypt, which is beyond the Jordan.

translation.text: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abelmizraim, which is beyond Jordan.

verses.english:
And the Canaanite residents of the land saw the mourning
at the threshing floor of Atad and said, “This is a heavy
mourning to Egypt.” On account of this its name was called
Abel of Egypt, which is beyond the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בָנָיו לוֹ כֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בָנָיו לוֹ כֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּם׃

english.text: And his sons did so for him, as he had commanded them.

translation.text: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:

verses.english: And his sons did so for him, as he had commanded them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֹתוֹ בָנָיו אַרְצָה כְּנַעַן וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בִּמְעָרַת שְׂדֵה הַמַּכְפֵּלָה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה אַבְרָהָם אֶת הַשָּׂדֶה לַאֲחֻזַּת קֶבֶר מֵאֵת עֶפְרֹן הַחִתִּי עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֹתוֹ בָנָיו אַרְצָה כְּנַעַן וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בִּמְעָרַת שְׂדֵה הַמַּכְפֵּלָה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה אַבְרָהָם אֶת הַשָּׂדֶה לַאֲחֻזַּת קֶבֶר מֵאֵת עֶפְרֹן הַחִתִּי עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵא׃

english.text:
And his sons carried him to the land of Canaan and buried
him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, as Abraham had
bought the field as a possession for a tomb from Ephron,
the Hittite, facing Mamre.

translation.text: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.

verses.english:
And his sons carried him to the land of Canaan and buried
him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, as Abraham had
bought the field as a possession for a tomb from Ephron,
the Hittite, facing Mamre.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב יוֹסֵף מִצְרַיְמָה הוּא וְאֶחָיו וְכל הָעֹלִים אִתּוֹ לִקְבֹּר אֶת אָבִיו אַחֲרֵי קבְרוֹ אֶת אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב יוֹסֵף מִצְרַיְמָה הוּא וְאֶחָיו וְכל הָעֹלִים אִתּוֹ לִקְבֹּר אֶת אָבִיו אַחֲרֵי קבְרוֹ אֶת אָבִיו׃

english.text:
And, after his burial of his father, Joseph came back to
Egypt, he and his brothers and all those who went up with
him to bury his father.

translation.text: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

verses.english:
And, after his burial of his father, Joseph came back to
Egypt, he and his brothers and all those who went up with
him to bury his father.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ אֲחֵי יוֹסֵף כִּי מֵת אֲבִיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוּ יִשְׂטְמֵנוּ יוֹסֵף וְהָשֵׁב יָשִׁיב לָנוּ אֵת כּל הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר גָּמַלְנוּ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ אֲחֵי יוֹסֵף כִּי מֵת אֲבִיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוּ יִשְׂטְמֵנוּ יוֹסֵף וְהָשֵׁב יָשִׁיב לָנוּ אֵת כּל הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר גָּמַלְנוּ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, and
they said, “If Joseph will despise us he’ll pay us back
all the bad that we dealt to him.”

translation.text: And when Joseph’s brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.

verses.english:
And Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, and
they said, “If Joseph will despise us he’ll pay us back
all the bad that we dealt to him.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַוּוּ אֶל יוֹסֵף לֵאמֹר אָבִיךָ צִוָּה לִפְנֵי מוֹתוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַוּוּ אֶל יוֹסֵף לֵאמֹר אָבִיךָ צִוָּה לִפְנֵי מוֹתוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And they commanded to Joseph, saying, “Your father had
commanded before his death, saying,

translation.text: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,

verses.english:
And they commanded to Joseph, saying, “Your father had
commanded before his death, saying,

verses.hebrew: כֹּה תֹאמְרוּ לְיוֹסֵף אָנָּא שָׂא נָא פֶּשַׁע אַחֶיךָ וְחַטָּאתָם כִּי רָעָה גְמָלוּךָ וְעַתָּה שָׂא נָא לְפֶשַׁע עַבְדֵי אֱלֹהֵי אָבִיךָ וַיֵּבְךְּ יוֹסֵף בְּדַבְּרָם אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: כֹּה תֹאמְרוּ לְיוֹסֵף אָנָּא שָׂא נָא פֶּשַׁע אַחֶיךָ וְחַטָּאתָם כִּי רָעָה גְמָלוּךָ וְעַתָּה שָׂא נָא לְפֶשַׁע עַבְדֵי אֱלֹהֵי אָבִיךָ וַיֵּבְךְּ יוֹסֵף בְּדַבְּרָם אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
‘You shall say this to Joseph: Please, bear your brothers’
offense and their sin, because they dealt you bad.’ And
now bear the offense of the servants of your father’s
God.” And Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

translation.text: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.

verses.english:
‘You shall say this to Joseph: Please, bear your brothers’
offense and their sin, because they dealt you bad.’ And
now bear the offense of the servants of your father’s
God.” And Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ גַּם אֶחָיו וַיִּפְּלוּ לְפָנָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ הִנֶּנּוּ לְךָ לַעֲבָדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ גַּם אֶחָיו וַיִּפְּלוּ לְפָנָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ הִנֶּנּוּ לְךָ לַעֲבָדִים׃

english.text:
And his brothers also went and fell in front of him and
said, “Here, we’re yours as slaves.”

translation.text: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.

verses.english:
And his brothers also went and fell in front of him and
said, “Here, we’re yours as slaves.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יוֹסֵף אַל תִּירָאוּ כִּי הֲתַחַת אֱלֹהִים אָנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יוֹסֵף אַל תִּירָאוּ כִּי הֲתַחַת אֱלֹהִים אָנִי׃

english.text:
And Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, because am I in
God’s place?

translation.text: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?

verses.english:
And Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, because am I in
God’s place?

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם חֲשַׁבְתֶּם עָלַי רָעָה אֱלֹהִים חֲשָׁבָהּ לְטֹבָה לְמַעַן עֲשֹׂה כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְהַחֲיֹת עַם רָב׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם חֲשַׁבְתֶּם עָלַי רָעָה אֱלֹהִים חֲשָׁבָהּ לְטֹבָה לְמַעַן עֲשֹׂה כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְהַחֲיֹת עַם רָב׃

english.text:
And you thought bad against me. thought for good: in
order to do as it is today, to keep alive a numerous
people.

translation.text: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

verses.english:
And you thought bad against me. thought for good: in
order to do as it is today, to keep alive a numerous
people.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אַל תִּירָאוּ אָנֹכִי אֲכַלְכֵּל אֶתְכֶם וְאֶת טַפְּכֶם וַיְנַחֵם אוֹתָם וַיְדַבֵּר עַל לִבָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אַל תִּירָאוּ אָנֹכִי אֲכַלְכֵּל אֶתְכֶם וְאֶת טַפְּכֶם וַיְנַחֵם אוֹתָם וַיְדַבֵּר עַל לִבָּם׃

english.text:
And now, don’t be afraid. I’ll provide for you and your
infants.” And he consoled them. And he spoke on their
heart.

translation.text: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones.

verses.english:
And now, don’t be afraid. I’ll provide for you and your
infants.” And he consoled them. And he spoke on their
heart.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב יוֹסֵף בְּמִצְרַיִם הוּא וּבֵית אָבִיו וַיְחִי יוֹסֵף מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב יוֹסֵף בְּמִצְרַיִם הוּא וּבֵית אָבִיו וַיְחִי יוֹסֵף מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
And Joseph lived in Egypt, he and his father’s house. And
Joseph lived a hundred ten years,

translation.text: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father’s house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.

verses.english:
And Joseph lived in Egypt, he and his father’s house. And
Joseph lived a hundred ten years,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יוֹסֵף לְאֶפְרַיִם בְּנֵי שִׁלֵּשִׁים גַּם בְּנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה יֻלְּדוּ עַל בִּרְכֵּי יוֹסֵף׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יוֹסֵף לְאֶפְרַיִם בְּנֵי שִׁלֵּשִׁים גַּם בְּנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה יֻלְּדוּ עַל בִּרְכֵּי יוֹסֵף׃

english.text:
and Joseph saw children of Ephraim’s of the third
generation. Also children of Machir, son of Manasseh, were
born on Joseph’s knees.

translation.text: And Joseph saw Ephraim’s children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph’s knees.

verses.english:
and Joseph saw children of Ephraim’s of the third
generation. Also children of Machir, son of Manasseh, were
born on Joseph’s knees.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו אָנֹכִי מֵת וֵאלֹהִים פָּקֹד יִפְקֹד אֶתְכֶם וְהֶעֱלָה אֶתְכֶם מִן הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו אָנֹכִי מֵת וֵאלֹהִים פָּקֹד יִפְקֹד אֶתְכֶם וְהֶעֱלָה אֶתְכֶם מִן הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And Joseph said to his brothers, “I’m dying. And God will
take account of you and will bring you up from this land
to the land that He swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to
Jacob.”

translation.text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

verses.english:
And Joseph said to his brothers, “I’m dying. And God will
take account of you and will bring you up from this land
to the land that He swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to
Jacob.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁבַּע יוֹסֵף אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר פָּקֹד יִפְקֹד אֱלֹהִים אֶתְכֶם וְהַעֲלִתֶם אֶת עַצְמֹתַי מִזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁבַּע יוֹסֵף אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר פָּקֹד יִפְקֹד אֱלֹהִים אֶתְכֶם וְהַעֲלִתֶם אֶת עַצְמֹתַי מִזֶּה׃

english.text:
And Joseph had the children of Israel swear, saying, “God
will take account of you, and you’ll bring up my bones
from here.”

translation.text: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.

verses.english:
And Joseph had the children of Israel swear, saying, “God
will take account of you, and you’ll bring up my bones
from here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת יוֹסֵף בֶּן מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים וַיַּחַנְטוּ אֹתוֹ וַיִּישֶׂם בָּאָרוֹן בְּמִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת יוֹסֵף בֶּן מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים וַיַּחַנְטוּ אֹתוֹ וַיִּישֶׂם בָּאָרוֹן בְּמִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Joseph died, a hundred ten years old, and they
embalmed him and set him in a coffin in Egypt.

translation.text: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

verses.english:
And Joseph died, a hundred ten years old, and they
embalmed him and set him in a coffin in Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּימֵי אַמְרָפֶל מֶלֶךְ שִׁנְעָר אַרְיוֹךְ מֶלֶךְ אֶלָּסָר כְּדרְלָעֹמֶר מֶלֶךְ עֵילָם וְתִדְעָל מֶלֶךְ גּוֹיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּימֵי אַמְרָפֶל מֶלֶךְ שִׁנְעָר אַרְיוֹךְ מֶלֶךְ אֶלָּסָר כְּדרְלָעֹמֶר מֶלֶךְ עֵילָם וְתִדְעָל מֶלֶךְ גּוֹיִם׃

english.text:
And it was in the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar,
Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedor-laomer, king of Elam, and
Tidal, king of Goiim.

verses.english:
And it was in the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar,
Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedor-laomer, king of Elam, and
Tidal, king of Goiim.

verses.hebrew: עָשׂוּ מִלְחָמָה אֶת בֶּרַע מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם וְאֶת בִּרְשַׁע מֶלֶךְ עֲמֹרָה שִׁנְאָב מֶלֶךְ אַדְמָה וְשֶׁמְאֵבֶר מֶלֶךְ (צביים) [צְבוֹיִם] וּמֶלֶךְ בֶּלַע הִיא צֹעַר׃

hebrew.text: עָשׂוּ מִלְחָמָה אֶת בֶּרַע מֶלֶךְ סְדֹם וְאֶת בִּרְשַׁע מֶלֶךְ עֲמֹרָה שִׁנְאָב מֶלֶךְ אַדְמָה וְשֶׁמְאֵבֶר מֶלֶךְ (צביים) [צְבוֹיִם] וּמֶלֶךְ בֶּלַע הִיא צֹעַר׃

english.text:
They made war with Bera, king of Sodom, and Birsha, king
of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of
Zeboiim, and the king of Bela. (That is Zoar.)

verses.english:
They made war with Bera, king of Sodom, and Birsha, king
of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of
Zeboiim, and the king of Bela. (That is Zoar.)

verses.hebrew: כּל אֵלֶּה חָבְרוּ אֶל עֵמֶק הַשִּׂדִּים הוּא יָם הַמֶּלַח׃

hebrew.text: כּל אֵלֶּה חָבְרוּ אֶל עֵמֶק הַשִּׂדִּים הוּא יָם הַמֶּלַח׃

english.text:
All these were allied at the Siddim Valley. (That is the
Dead Sea.)

verses.english:
All these were allied at the Siddim Valley. (That is the
Dead Sea.)

verses.hebrew: שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה עָבְדוּ אֶת כְּדרְלָעֹמֶר וּשְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָרָדוּ׃

hebrew.text: שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה עָבְדוּ אֶת כְּדרְלָעֹמֶר וּשְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָרָדוּ׃

english.text:
Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and the thirteenth
year they revolted,

verses.english:
Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and the thirteenth
year they revolted,

hebrew.text: בִּלְעָדַי רַק אֲשֶׁר אָכְלוּ הַנְּעָרִים וְחֵלֶק הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ אִתִּי עָנֵר אֶשְׁכֹּל וּמַמְרֵא הֵם יִקְחוּ חֶלְקָם׃

english.text:
Except only what the boys have eaten and the share of the
people who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. They
shall take their share.”

verses.english:
Except only what the boys have eaten and the share of the
people who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. They
shall take their share.”

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַבָּאִים מִצְרָיְמָה אֵת יַעֲקֹב אִישׁ וּבֵיתוֹ בָּאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַבָּאִים מִצְרָיְמָה אֵת יַעֲקֹב אִישׁ וּבֵיתוֹ בָּאוּ׃

english.text:
And these are the names of the children of Israel who came
to Egypt. With Jacob, each and his household had come:

translation.text: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.

verses.english:
And these are the names of the children of Israel who came
to Egypt. With Jacob, each and his household had come:

verses.hebrew: רְאוּבֵן שִׁמְעוֹן לֵוִי וִיהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: רְאוּבֵן שִׁמְעוֹן לֵוִי וִיהוּדָה׃

english.text: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

translation.text: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

verses.english: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

verses.hebrew: יִשָּׂשכָר זְבוּלֻן וּבִנְיָמִן׃

hebrew.text: יִשָּׂשכָר זְבוּלֻן וּבִנְיָמִן׃

english.text: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

translation.text: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

verses.english: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

verses.hebrew: דָּן וְנַפְתָּלִי גָּד וְאָשֵׁר׃

hebrew.text: דָּן וְנַפְתָּלִי גָּד וְאָשֵׁר׃

english.text: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

translation.text: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

verses.english: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כּל נֶפֶשׁ יֹצְאֵי יֶרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב שִׁבְעִים נָפֶשׁ וְיוֹסֵף הָיָה בְמִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כּל נֶפֶשׁ יֹצְאֵי יֶרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב שִׁבְעִים נָפֶשׁ וְיוֹסֵף הָיָה בְמִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And all the persons coming out from Jacob’s thigh were
seventy persons. And Joseph had been in Egypt.

translation.text: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.

verses.english:
And all the persons coming out from Jacob’s thigh were
seventy persons. And Joseph had been in Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת יוֹסֵף וְכל אֶחָיו וְכֹל הַדּוֹר הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת יוֹסֵף וְכל אֶחָיו וְכֹל הַדּוֹר הַהוּא׃

english.text:
And Joseph and all of his brothers and all of that
generation died.

translation.text: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.

verses.english:
And Joseph and all of his brothers and all of that
generation died.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל פָּרוּ וַיִּשְׁרְצוּ וַיִּרְבּוּ וַיַּעַצְמוּ בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל פָּרוּ וַיִּשְׁרְצוּ וַיִּרְבּוּ וַיַּעַצְמוּ בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ אֹתָם׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel were fruitful and teemed and
multiplied and became very, very powerful, and the land
was filled with them.

translation.text: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel were fruitful and teemed and
multiplied and became very, very powerful, and the land
was filled with them.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם מֶלֶךְ חָדָשׁ עַל מִצְרָיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַע אֶת יוֹסֵף׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם מֶלֶךְ חָדָשׁ עַל מִצְרָיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַע אֶת יוֹסֵף׃

english.text: And a new king rose over Egypt—who did not know Joseph.

translation.text: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.

verses.english: And a new king rose over Egypt—who did not know Joseph.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל עַמּוֹ הִנֵּה עַם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַב וְעָצוּם מִמֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל עַמּוֹ הִנֵּה עַם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַב וְעָצוּם מִמֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
And he said to his people, “Here, the people of the
children of Israel is more numerous and powerful than we.

translation.text: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:

verses.english:
And he said to his people, “Here, the people of the
children of Israel is more numerous and powerful than we.

verses.hebrew: הָבָה נִתְחַכְּמָה לוֹ פֶּן יִרְבֶּה וְהָיָה כִּי תִקְרֶאנָה מִלְחָמָה וְנוֹסַף גַּם הוּא עַל שֹׂנְאֵינוּ וְנִלְחַם בָּנוּ וְעָלָה מִן הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: הָבָה נִתְחַכְּמָה לוֹ פֶּן יִרְבֶּה וְהָיָה כִּי תִקְרֶאנָה מִלְחָמָה וְנוֹסַף גַּם הוּא עַל שֹׂנְאֵינוּ וְנִלְחַם בָּנוּ וְעָלָה מִן הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Come on, let’s be wise toward it or else it will increase;
and it will be, when war will happen, that it, too, will
be added to our enemies and will war against us and go up
from the land.”

translation.text: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.

verses.english:
Come on, let’s be wise toward it or else it will increase;
and it will be, when war will happen, that it, too, will
be added to our enemies and will war against us and go up
from the land.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ עָלָיו שָׂרֵי מִסִּים לְמַעַן עַנֹּתוֹ בְּסִבְלֹתָם וַיִּבֶן עָרֵי מִסְכְּנוֹת לְפַרְעֹה אֶת פִּתֹם וְאֶת רַעַמְסֵס׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ עָלָיו שָׂרֵי מִסִּים לְמַעַן עַנֹּתוֹ בְּסִבְלֹתָם וַיִּבֶן עָרֵי מִסְכְּנוֹת לְפַרְעֹה אֶת פִּתֹם וְאֶת רַעַמְסֵס׃

english.text:
And they set commanders of work-companies over it in order
to degrade it with their burdens. And they built storage
cities for Pharaoh: Pithom and Rameses.

translation.text: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.

verses.english:
And they set commanders of work-companies over it in order
to degrade it with their burdens. And they built storage
cities for Pharaoh: Pithom and Rameses.

verses.hebrew: וְכַאֲשֶׁר יְעַנּוּ אֹתוֹ כֵּן יִרְבֶּה וְכֵן יִפְרֹץ וַיָּקֻצוּ מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְכַאֲשֶׁר יְעַנּוּ אֹתוֹ כֵּן יִרְבֶּה וְכֵן יִפְרֹץ וַיָּקֻצוּ מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the more they degraded it, the more it increased, and
the more it expanded; and they felt a disgust at the
children of Israel.

translation.text: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew.

verses.english:
And the more they degraded it, the more it increased, and
the more it expanded; and they felt a disgust at the
children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבִדוּ מִצְרַיִם אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּפָרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבִדוּ מִצְרַיִם אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּפָרֶךְ׃

english.text:
And Egypt made the children of Israel serve with
harshness;

translation.text: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:

verses.english:
And Egypt made the children of Israel serve with
harshness;

verses.hebrew: וַיְמָרְרוּ אֶת חַיֵּיהֶם בַּעֲבֹדָה קָשָׁה בְּחֹמֶר וּבִלְבֵנִים וּבְכל עֲבֹדָה בַּשָּׂדֶה אֵת כּל עֲבֹדָתָם אֲשֶׁר עָבְדוּ בָהֶם בְּפָרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמָרְרוּ אֶת חַיֵּיהֶם בַּעֲבֹדָה קָשָׁה בְּחֹמֶר וּבִלְבֵנִים וּבְכל עֲבֹדָה בַּשָּׂדֶה אֵת כּל עֲבֹדָתָם אֲשֶׁר עָבְדוּ בָהֶם בְּפָרֶךְ׃

english.text:
and they made their lives bitter with hard work, with
mortar and with bricks and with all work in the field—all
their work that they did for them—with harshness.

translation.text: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.

verses.english:
and they made their lives bitter with hard work, with
mortar and with bricks and with all work in the field—all
their work that they did for them—with harshness.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לַמְיַלְּדֹת הָעִבְרִיֹּת אֲשֶׁר שֵׁם הָאַחַת שִׁפְרָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית פּוּעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לַמְיַלְּדֹת הָעִבְרִיֹּת אֲשֶׁר שֵׁם הָאַחַת שִׁפְרָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית פּוּעָה׃

english.text:
And the king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives—of whom
the name of one was Shiphrah and the name of the second
was Puah—

translation.text: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:

verses.english:
And the king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives—of whom
the name of one was Shiphrah and the name of the second
was Puah—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בְּיַלֶּדְכֶן אֶת הָעִבְרִיּוֹת וּרְאִיתֶן עַל הָאבְנָיִם אִם בֵּן הוּא וַהֲמִתֶּן אֹתוֹ וְאִם בַּת הִוא וָחָיָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בְּיַלֶּדְכֶן אֶת הָעִבְרִיּוֹת וּרְאִיתֶן עַל הָאבְנָיִם אִם בֵּן הוּא וַהֲמִתֶּן אֹתוֹ וְאִם בַּת הִוא וָחָיָה׃

english.text:
and he said, “When you deliver the Hebrew women, and you
look at the two stones, if it’s a boy then kill him, and
if it’s a girl then she’ll live.”

translation.text: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.

verses.english:
and he said, “When you deliver the Hebrew women, and you
look at the two stones, if it’s a boy then kill him, and
if it’s a girl then she’ll live.”

verses.hebrew: וַתִּירֶאןָ הַמְיַלְּדֹת אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים וְלֹא עָשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲלֵיהֶן מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם וַתְּחַיֶּיןָ אֶת הַיְלָדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּירֶאןָ הַמְיַלְּדֹת אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים וְלֹא עָשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲלֵיהֶן מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם וַתְּחַיֶּיןָ אֶת הַיְלָדִים׃

english.text:
And the midwives feared God and did not do what the king
of Egypt had spoken to them, and they kept the boys alive.

translation.text: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.

verses.english:
And the midwives feared God and did not do what the king
of Egypt had spoken to them, and they kept the boys alive.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לַמְיַלְּדֹת וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶן מַדּוּעַ עֲשִׂיתֶן הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַתְּחַיֶּיןָ אֶת הַיְלָדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לַמְיַלְּדֹת וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶן מַדּוּעַ עֲשִׂיתֶן הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַתְּחַיֶּיןָ אֶת הַיְלָדִים׃

english.text:
And the king of Egypt called the midwives and said to
them, “Why have you done this thing and kept the boys
alive?”

translation.text: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?

verses.english:
And the king of Egypt called the midwives and said to
them, “Why have you done this thing and kept the boys
alive?”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמַרְןָ הַמְיַלְּדֹת אֶל פַּרְעֹה כִּי לֹא כַנָּשִׁים הַמִּצְרִיֹּת הָעִבְרִיֹּת כִּי חָיוֹת הֵנָּה בְּטֶרֶם תָּבוֹא אֲלֵהֶן הַמְיַלֶּדֶת וְיָלָדוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמַרְןָ הַמְיַלְּדֹת אֶל פַּרְעֹה כִּי לֹא כַנָּשִׁים הַמִּצְרִיֹּת הָעִבְרִיֹּת כִּי חָיוֹת הֵנָּה בְּטֶרֶם תָּבוֹא אֲלֵהֶן הַמְיַלֶּדֶת וְיָלָדוּ׃

english.text:
And the midwives said to Pharaoh, “Because the Hebrews
aren’t like the Egyptian women, because they’re animals!
Before the midwife comes to them, they’ve given birth!”

translation.text: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.

verses.english:
And the midwives said to Pharaoh, “Because the Hebrews
aren’t like the Egyptian women, because they’re animals!
Before the midwife comes to them, they’ve given birth!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּיטֶב אֱלֹהִים לַמְיַלְּדֹת וַיִּרֶב הָעָם וַיַּעַצְמוּ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּיטֶב אֱלֹהִים לַמְיַלְּדֹת וַיִּרֶב הָעָם וַיַּעַצְמוּ מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And God was good to the midwives. And the people
increased, and they became very powerful,

translation.text: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.

verses.english:
And God was good to the midwives. And the people
increased, and they became very powerful,

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי יָרְאוּ הַמְיַלְּדֹת אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם בָּתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי יָרְאוּ הַמְיַלְּדֹת אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם בָּתִּים׃

english.text:
and it was because the midwives feared God, and He made
them households.

translation.text: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.

verses.english:
and it was because the midwives feared God, and He made
them households.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו פַּרְעֹה לְכל עַמּוֹ לֵאמֹר כּל הַבֵּן הַיִּלּוֹד הַיְאֹרָה תַּשְׁלִיכֻהוּ וְכל הַבַּת תְּחַיּוּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו פַּרְעֹה לְכל עַמּוֹ לֵאמֹר כּל הַבֵּן הַיִּלּוֹד הַיְאֹרָה תַּשְׁלִיכֻהוּ וְכל הַבַּת תְּחַיּוּן׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh commanded all of his people, saying, “Every
son who is born: you shall throw him into the Nile. And
every daughter you shall keep alive.”

translation.text: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh commanded all of his people, saying, “Every
son who is born: you shall throw him into the Nile. And
every daughter you shall keep alive.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אִישׁ מִבֵּית לֵוִי וַיִּקַּח אֶת בַּת לֵוִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ אִישׁ מִבֵּית לֵוִי וַיִּקַּח אֶת בַּת לֵוִי׃

english.text:
And a man from the house of Levi went and took a
daughter of Levi.

translation.text: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.

verses.english:
And a man from the house of Levi went and took a
daughter of Levi.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר הָאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתֵּרֶא אֹתוֹ כִּי טוֹב הוּא וַתִּצְפְּנֵהוּ שְׁלֹשָׁה יְרָחִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר הָאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתֵּרֶא אֹתוֹ כִּי טוֹב הוּא וַתִּצְפְּנֵהוּ שְׁלֹשָׁה יְרָחִים׃

english.text:
And the woman became pregnant and gave birth to a son. And
she saw him, that he was good, and she concealed him for
three months.

translation.text: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.

verses.english:
And the woman became pregnant and gave birth to a son. And
she saw him, that he was good, and she concealed him for
three months.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יָכְלָה עוֹד הַצְּפִינוֹ וַתִּקַּח לוֹ תֵּבַת גֹּמֶא וַתַּחְמְרָה בַחֵמָר וּבַזָּפֶת וַתָּשֶׂם בָּהּ אֶת הַיֶּלֶד וַתָּשֶׂם בַּסּוּף עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יָכְלָה עוֹד הַצְּפִינוֹ וַתִּקַּח לוֹ תֵּבַת גֹּמֶא וַתַּחְמְרָה בַחֵמָר וּבַזָּפֶת וַתָּשֶׂם בָּהּ אֶת הַיֶּלֶד וַתָּשֶׂם בַּסּוּף עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר׃

english.text:
And she was not able to conceal him anymore, and she took
an ark made of bulrushes for him and smeared it with
bitumen and with pitch and put the boy in it and put it in
the reeds by the bank of the Nile.

translation.text: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river’s brink.

verses.english:
And she was not able to conceal him anymore, and she took
an ark made of bulrushes for him and smeared it with
bitumen and with pitch and put the boy in it and put it in
the reeds by the bank of the Nile.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּתַצַּב אֲחֹתוֹ מֵרָחֹק לְדֵעָה מַה יֵּעָשֶׂה לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּתַצַּב אֲחֹתוֹ מֵרָחֹק לְדֵעָה מַה יֵּעָשֶׂה לוֹ׃

english.text:
And his sister stood still at a distance to know what
would be done to him.

translation.text: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.

verses.english:
And his sister stood still at a distance to know what
would be done to him.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶד בַּת פַּרְעֹה לִרְחֹץ עַל הַיְאֹר וְנַעֲרֹתֶיהָ הֹלְכֹת עַל יַד הַיְאֹר וַתֵּרֶא אֶת הַתֵּבָה בְּתוֹךְ הַסּוּף וַתִּשְׁלַח אֶת אֲמָתָהּ וַתִּקָּחֶהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרֶד בַּת פַּרְעֹה לִרְחֹץ עַל הַיְאֹר וְנַעֲרֹתֶיהָ הֹלְכֹת עַל יַד הַיְאֹר וַתֵּרֶא אֶת הַתֵּבָה בְּתוֹךְ הַסּוּף וַתִּשְׁלַח אֶת אֲמָתָהּ וַתִּקָּחֶהָ׃

english.text:
And the Pharaoh’s daughter went down to bathe at the Nile,
and her girls were going alongside the Nile, and she saw
the ark among the reeds and sent her maid, and she took
it.

translation.text: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river’s side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.

verses.english:
And the Pharaoh’s daughter went down to bathe at the Nile,
and her girls were going alongside the Nile, and she saw
the ark among the reeds and sent her maid, and she took
it.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּפְתַּח וַתִּרְאֵהוּ אֶת הַיֶּלֶד וְהִנֵּה נַעַר בֹּכֶה וַתַּחְמֹל עָלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר מִיַּלְדֵי הָעִבְרִים זֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּפְתַּח וַתִּרְאֵהוּ אֶת הַיֶּלֶד וְהִנֵּה נַעַר בֹּכֶה וַתַּחְמֹל עָלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר מִיַּלְדֵי הָעִבְרִים זֶה׃

english.text:
And she opened it and saw him, the child: and here was a
boy crying, and she had compassion on him, and she said,
“This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”

translation.text: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews’ children.

verses.english:
And she opened it and saw him, the child: and here was a
boy crying, and she had compassion on him, and she said,
“This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֲחֹתוֹ אֶל בַּת פַּרְעֹה הַאֵלֵךְ וְקָרָאתִי לָךְ אִשָּׁה מֵינֶקֶת מִן הָעִבְרִיֹּת וְתֵינִק לָךְ אֶת הַיָּלֶד׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֲחֹתוֹ אֶל בַּת פַּרְעֹה הַאֵלֵךְ וְקָרָאתִי לָךְ אִשָּׁה מֵינֶקֶת מִן הָעִבְרִיֹּת וְתֵינִק לָךְ אֶת הַיָּלֶד׃

english.text:
And his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Shall I go and
call a nursing woman from the Hebrews for you, and she’ll
nurse the child for you?”

translation.text: Then said his sister to Pharaoh’s daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?

verses.english:
And his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Shall I go and
call a nursing woman from the Hebrews for you, and she’ll
nurse the child for you?”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ בַּת פַּרְעֹה לֵכִי וַתֵּלֶךְ הָעַלְמָה וַתִּקְרָא אֶת אֵם הַיָּלֶד׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ בַּת פַּרְעֹה לֵכִי וַתֵּלֶךְ הָעַלְמָה וַתִּקְרָא אֶת אֵם הַיָּלֶד׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” And the girl
went and called the child’s mother.

translation.text: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child’s mother.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” And the girl
went and called the child’s mother.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ בַּת פַּרְעֹה הֵילִיכִי אֶת הַיֶּלֶד הַזֶּה וְהֵינִקִהוּ לִי וַאֲנִי אֶתֵּן אֶת שְׂכָרֵךְ וַתִּקַּח הָאִשָּׁה הַיֶּלֶד וַתְּנִיקֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ בַּת פַּרְעֹה הֵילִיכִי אֶת הַיֶּלֶד הַזֶּה וְהֵינִקִהוּ לִי וַאֲנִי אֶתֵּן אֶת שְׂכָרֵךְ וַתִּקַּח הָאִשָּׁה הַיֶּלֶד וַתְּנִיקֵהוּ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child and
nurse him for me, and I’ll give your pay.” And the woman
took the boy and nursed him.

translation.text: And Pharaoh’s daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child and
nurse him for me, and I’ll give your pay.” And the woman
took the boy and nursed him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְדַּל הַיֶּלֶד וַתְּבִאֵהוּ לְבַת פַּרְעֹה וַיְהִי לָהּ לְבֵן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ מֹשֶׁה וַתֹּאמֶר כִּי מִן הַמַּיִם מְשִׁיתִהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְדַּל הַיֶּלֶד וַתְּבִאֵהוּ לְבַת פַּרְעֹה וַיְהִי לָהּ לְבֵן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ מֹשֶׁה וַתֹּאמֶר כִּי מִן הַמַּיִם מְשִׁיתִהוּ׃

english.text:
And the boy grew older, and she brought him to Pharaoh’
daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name
Moses, and she said, “Because I drew him from the water.”

translation.text: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.

verses.english:
And the boy grew older, and she brought him to Pharaoh’
daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name
Moses, and she said, “Because I drew him from the water.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וַיִּגְדַּל מֹשֶׁה וַיֵּצֵא אֶל אֶחָיו וַיַּרְא בְּסִבְלֹתָם וַיַּרְא אִישׁ מִצְרִי מַכֶּה אִישׁ עִבְרִי מֵאֶחָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וַיִּגְדַּל מֹשֶׁה וַיֵּצֵא אֶל אֶחָיו וַיַּרְא בְּסִבְלֹתָם וַיַּרְא אִישׁ מִצְרִי מַכֶּה אִישׁ עִבְרִי מֵאֶחָיו׃

english.text:
And it was in those days, and Moses grew older, and he
went out to his brothers and saw their burdens, and he saw
an Egyptian man striking a Hebrew man, one of his
brothers.

translation.text: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.

verses.english:
And it was in those days, and Moses grew older, and he
went out to his brothers and saw their burdens, and he saw
an Egyptian man striking a Hebrew man, one of his
brothers.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן כֹּה וָכֹה וַיַּרְא כִּי אֵין אִישׁ וַיַּךְ אֶת הַמִּצְרִי וַיִּטְמְנֵהוּ בַּחוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֶן כֹּה וָכֹה וַיַּרְא כִּי אֵין אִישׁ וַיַּךְ אֶת הַמִּצְרִי וַיִּטְמְנֵהוּ בַּחוֹל׃

english.text:
And he turned this way and that way and saw that there was
no man, and he struck the Egyptian and hid him in the
sand.

translation.text: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.

verses.english:
And he turned this way and that way and saw that there was
no man, and he struck the Egyptian and hid him in the
sand.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי וְהִנֵּה שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים עִבְרִים נִצִּים וַיֹּאמֶר לָרָשָׁע לָמָּה תַכֶּה רֵעֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי וְהִנֵּה שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים עִבְרִים נִצִּים וַיֹּאמֶר לָרָשָׁע לָמָּה תַכֶּה רֵעֶךָ׃

english.text:
And he went out on the second day, and here were two
Hebrew men fighting. And he said to the one who was in the
wrong, “Why do you strike your companion?”

translation.text: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?

verses.english:
And he went out on the second day, and here were two
Hebrew men fighting. And he said to the one who was in the
wrong, “Why do you strike your companion?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִי שָׂמְךָ לְאִישׁ שַׂר וְשֹׁפֵט עָלֵינוּ הַלְהרְגֵנִי אַתָּה אֹמֵר כַּאֲשֶׁר הָרַגְתָּ אֶת הַמִּצְרִי וַיִּירָא מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמַר אָכֵן נוֹדַע הַדָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מִי שָׂמְךָ לְאִישׁ שַׂר וְשֹׁפֵט עָלֵינוּ הַלְהרְגֵנִי אַתָּה אֹמֵר כַּאֲשֶׁר הָרַגְתָּ אֶת הַמִּצְרִי וַיִּירָא מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמַר אָכֵן נוֹדַע הַדָּבָר׃

english.text:
And he said, “Who made you a commander and judge over us?
Are you saying you’d kill me—the way you killed the
Egyptian?!” And Moses was afraid and said, “The thing is
known for sure.”

translation.text: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.

verses.english:
And he said, “Who made you a commander and judge over us?
Are you saying you’d kill me—the way you killed the
Egyptian?!” And Moses was afraid and said, “The thing is
known for sure.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע פַּרְעֹה אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיְבַקֵּשׁ לַהֲרֹג אֶת מֹשֶׁה וַיִּבְרַח מֹשֶׁה מִפְּנֵי פַרְעֹה וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּאֶרֶץ מִדְיָן וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל הַבְּאֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע פַּרְעֹה אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיְבַקֵּשׁ לַהֲרֹג אֶת מֹשֶׁה וַיִּבְרַח מֹשֶׁה מִפְּנֵי פַרְעֹה וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּאֶרֶץ מִדְיָן וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל הַבְּאֵר׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh heard this thing and sought to kill Moses, and
Moses fled from Pharaoh’s presence and lived in the land
of Midian. And he sat by a well.

translation.text: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh heard this thing and sought to kill Moses, and
Moses fled from Pharaoh’s presence and lived in the land
of Midian. And he sat by a well.

verses.hebrew: וּלְכֹהֵן מִדְיָן שֶׁבַע בָּנוֹת וַתָּבֹאנָה וַתִּדְלֶנָה וַתְּמַלֶּאנָה אֶת הָרְהָטִים לְהַשְׁקוֹת צֹאן אֲבִיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וּלְכֹהֵן מִדְיָן שֶׁבַע בָּנוֹת וַתָּבֹאנָה וַתִּדְלֶנָה וַתְּמַלֶּאנָה אֶת הָרְהָטִים לְהַשְׁקוֹת צֹאן אֲבִיהֶן׃

english.text:
And a priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came
and drew water and filled the troughs to water their
father’s flock,

translation.text: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.

verses.english:
And a priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came
and drew water and filled the troughs to water their
father’s flock,

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ הָרֹעִים וַיְגָרְשׁוּם וַיָּקם מֹשֶׁה וַיּוֹשִׁעָן וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת צֹאנָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ הָרֹעִים וַיְגָרְשׁוּם וַיָּקם מֹשֶׁה וַיּוֹשִׁעָן וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת צֹאנָם׃

english.text:
and the shepherds came and drove them away. And Moses got
up and saved them and watered their flock.

translation.text: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.

verses.english:
and the shepherds came and drove them away. And Moses got
up and saved them and watered their flock.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹאנָה אֶל רְעוּאֵל אֲבִיהֶן וַיֹּאמֶר מַדּוּעַ מִהַרְתֶּן בֹּא הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּבֹאנָה אֶל רְעוּאֵל אֲבִיהֶן וַיֹּאמֶר מַדּוּעַ מִהַרְתֶּן בֹּא הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And they came to Reuel, their father, and he said, “Why
were you so quick to come today?”

translation.text: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to day?

verses.english:
And they came to Reuel, their father, and he said, “Why
were you so quick to come today?”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמַרְןָ אִישׁ מִצְרִי הִצִּילָנוּ מִיַּד הָרֹעִים וְגַם דָּלֹה דָלָה לָנוּ וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת הַצֹּאן׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמַרְןָ אִישׁ מִצְרִי הִצִּילָנוּ מִיַּד הָרֹעִים וְגַם דָּלֹה דָלָה לָנוּ וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת הַצֹּאן׃

english.text:
And they said, “An Egyptian man rescued us from the
shepherds’ hand, and he drew water for us and watered the
flock, too.”

translation.text: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.

verses.english:
And they said, “An Egyptian man rescued us from the
shepherds’ hand, and he drew water for us and watered the
flock, too.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל בְּנֹתָיו וְאַיּוֹ לָמָּה זֶּה עֲזַבְתֶּן אֶת הָאִישׁ קִרְאֶן לוֹ וְיֹאכַל לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל בְּנֹתָיו וְאַיּוֹ לָמָּה זֶּה עֲזַבְתֶּן אֶת הָאִישׁ קִרְאֶן לוֹ וְיֹאכַל לָחֶם׃

english.text:
And he said to his daughters, “And where is he? Why is
this that you’ve left the man? Call him, and let him eat
bread.”

translation.text: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.

verses.english:
And he said to his daughters, “And where is he? Why is
this that you’ve left the man? Call him, and let him eat
bread.”

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹאֶל מֹשֶׁה לָשֶׁבֶת אֶת הָאִישׁ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת צִפֹּרָה בִתּוֹ לְמֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹאֶל מֹשֶׁה לָשֶׁבֶת אֶת הָאִישׁ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת צִפֹּרָה בִתּוֹ לְמֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Moses was content to live with the man. And he gave
Zipporah, his daughter, to Moses,

translation.text: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.

verses.english:
And Moses was content to live with the man. And he gave
Zipporah, his daughter, to Moses,

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ גֵּרְשֹׁם כִּי אָמַר גֵּר הָיִיתִי בְּאֶרֶץ נכְרִיָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ גֵּרְשֹׁם כִּי אָמַר גֵּר הָיִיתִי בְּאֶרֶץ נכְרִיָּה׃

english.text:
and she gave birth to a son, and he called his name
Gershom, “because,” he said, “I was an alien in a foreign
land.”

translation.text: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.

verses.english:
and she gave birth to a son, and he called his name
Gershom, “because,” he said, “I was an alien in a foreign
land.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַיָּמִים הָרַבִּים הָהֵם וַיָּמת מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם וַיֵּאָנְחוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן הָעֲבֹדָה וַיִּזְעָקוּ וַתַּעַל שַׁוְעָתָם אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים מִן הָעֲבֹדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַיָּמִים הָרַבִּים הָהֵם וַיָּמת מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם וַיֵּאָנְחוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן הָעֲבֹדָה וַיִּזְעָקוּ וַתַּעַל שַׁוְעָתָם אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים מִן הָעֲבֹדָה׃

english.text:
And it was after those many days, and the king of Egypt
died. And the children of Israel groaned from the work,
and they cried out, and their wail went up to God from the
work.

translation.text: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.

verses.english:
And it was after those many days, and the king of Egypt
died. And the children of Israel groaned from the work,
and they cried out, and their wail went up to God from the
work.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת נַאֲקָתָם וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת בְּרִיתוֹ אֶת אַבְרָהָם אֶת יִצְחָק וְאֶת יַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת נַאֲקָתָם וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת בְּרִיתוֹ אֶת אַבְרָהָם אֶת יִצְחָק וְאֶת יַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
And God heard their moaning, and God remembered His
covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

translation.text: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

verses.english:
And God heard their moaning, and God remembered His
covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּדַע אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּדַע אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text: And God saw the children of Israel. And God knew!

translation.text: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them.

verses.english: And God saw the children of Israel. And God knew!

verses.hebrew: וּמֹשֶׁה הָיָה רֹעֶה אֶת צֹאן יִתְרוֹ חֹתְנוֹ כֹּהֵן מִדְיָן וַיִּנְהַג אֶת הַצֹּאן אַחַר הַמִּדְבָּר וַיָּבֹא אֶל הַר הָאֱלֹהִים חֹרֵבָה׃

hebrew.text: וּמֹשֶׁה הָיָה רֹעֶה אֶת צֹאן יִתְרוֹ חֹתְנוֹ כֹּהֵן מִדְיָן וַיִּנְהַג אֶת הַצֹּאן אַחַר הַמִּדְבָּר וַיָּבֹא אֶל הַר הָאֱלֹהִים חֹרֵבָה׃

english.text:
And Moses had been shepherding the flock of Jethro, his
father-in-law, priest of Midian. And he drove the flock at
the far side of the wilderness, and he came to the
Mountain of God, to Horeb.

translation.text: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.

verses.english:
And Moses had been shepherding the flock of Jethro, his
father-in-law, priest of Midian. And he drove the flock at
the far side of the wilderness, and he came to the
Mountain of God, to Horeb.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו בְּלַבַּת אֵשׁ מִתּוֹךְ הַסְּנֶה וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה הַסְּנֶה בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ וְהַסְּנֶה אֵינֶנּוּ אֻכָּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו בְּלַבַּת אֵשׁ מִתּוֹךְ הַסְּנֶה וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה הַסְּנֶה בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ וְהַסְּנֶה אֵינֶנּוּ אֻכָּל׃

english.text:
And an angel of YHWH appeared to him in a fire’s flame
from inside a bush. And he looked, and here: the bush was
burning in the fire, and the bush was not consumed!

translation.text: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

verses.english:
And an angel of YHWH appeared to him in a fire’s flame
from inside a bush. And he looked, and here: the bush was
burning in the fire, and the bush was not consumed!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אָסֻרָה נָּא וְאֶרְאֶה אֶת הַמַּרְאֶה הַגָּדֹל הַזֶּה מַדּוּעַ לֹא יִבְעַר הַסְּנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אָסֻרָה נָּא וְאֶרְאֶה אֶת הַמַּרְאֶה הַגָּדֹל הַזֶּה מַדּוּעַ לֹא יִבְעַר הַסְּנֶה׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “Let me turn and see this great sight. Why
doesn’t the bush burn?”

translation.text: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “Let me turn and see this great sight. Why
doesn’t the bush burn?”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יְהֹוָה כִּי סָר לִרְאוֹת וַיִּקְרָא אֵלָיו אֱלֹהִים מִתּוֹךְ הַסְּנֶה וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יְהֹוָה כִּי סָר לִרְאוֹת וַיִּקְרָא אֵלָיו אֱלֹהִים מִתּוֹךְ הַסְּנֶה וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי׃

english.text:
And YHWH saw that he turned to see. And God called to him
from inside the bush, and He said, “Moses, Moses.” And he
said, “I’m here.”

translation.text: And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.

verses.english:
And YHWH saw that he turned to see. And God called to him
from inside the bush, and He said, “Moses, Moses.” And he
said, “I’m here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל תִּקְרַב הֲלֹם שַׁל נְעָלֶיךָ מֵעַל רַגְלֶיךָ כִּי הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עוֹמֵד עָלָיו אַדְמַת קֹדֶשׁ הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל תִּקְרַב הֲלֹם שַׁל נְעָלֶיךָ מֵעַל רַגְלֶיךָ כִּי הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עוֹמֵד עָלָיו אַדְמַת קֹדֶשׁ הוּא׃

english.text:
And He said, “Don’t come close here. Take off your shoes
from your feet, because the place on which you’re
standing: it’s holy ground.”

translation.text: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.

verses.english:
And He said, “Don’t come close here. Take off your shoes
from your feet, because the place on which you’re
standing: it’s holy ground.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי אֱלֹהֵי אָבִיךָ אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב וַיַּסְתֵּר מֹשֶׁה פָּנָיו כִּי יָרֵא מֵהַבִּיט אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי אֱלֹהֵי אָבִיךָ אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב וַיַּסְתֵּר מֹשֶׁה פָּנָיו כִּי יָרֵא מֵהַבִּיט אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And He said, “I’m your father’s God, Abraham’s God,
Isaac’s God, and Jacob’s God.” And Moses hid his face,
because he was afraid of looking at God.

translation.text: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.

verses.english:
And He said, “I’m your father’s God, Abraham’s God,
Isaac’s God, and Jacob’s God.” And Moses hid his face,
because he was afraid of looking at God.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה רָאֹה רָאִיתִי אֶת עֳנִי עַמִּי אֲשֶׁר בְּמִצְרָיִם וְאֶת צַעֲקָתָם שָׁמַעְתִּי מִפְּנֵי נֹגְשָׂיו כִּי יָדַעְתִּי אֶת מַכְאֹבָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה רָאֹה רָאִיתִי אֶת עֳנִי עַמִּי אֲשֶׁר בְּמִצְרָיִם וְאֶת צַעֲקָתָם שָׁמַעְתִּי מִפְּנֵי נֹגְשָׂיו כִּי יָדַעְתִּי אֶת מַכְאֹבָיו׃

english.text:
And YHWH said, “I’ve seen the degradation of my people who
are in Egypt, and I’ve heard their wail on account of
their taskmasters, because I know their pains.

translation.text: And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;

verses.english:
And YHWH said, “I’ve seen the degradation of my people who
are in Egypt, and I’ve heard their wail on account of
their taskmasters, because I know their pains.

verses.hebrew: וָאֵרֵד לְהַצִּילוֹ מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם וּלְהַעֲלֹתוֹ מִן הָאָרֶץ הַהִוא אֶל אֶרֶץ טוֹבָה וּרְחָבָה אֶל אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ אֶל מְקוֹם הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃

hebrew.text: וָאֵרֵד לְהַצִּילוֹ מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם וּלְהַעֲלֹתוֹ מִן הָאָרֶץ הַהִוא אֶל אֶרֶץ טוֹבָה וּרְחָבָה אֶל אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ אֶל מְקוֹם הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃

english.text:
And I’ve come down to rescue them from Egypt’s hand and to
bring them up from that land to a good and widespread
land, to a land flowing with milk and honey, to the place
of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the
Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite.

translation.text: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

verses.english:
And I’ve come down to rescue them from Egypt’s hand and to
bring them up from that land to a good and widespread
land, to a land flowing with milk and honey, to the place
of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the
Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה צַעֲקַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָה אֵלָי וְגַם רָאִיתִי אֶת הַלַּחַץ אֲשֶׁר מִצְרַיִם לֹחֲצִים אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה צַעֲקַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָה אֵלָי וְגַם רָאִיתִי אֶת הַלַּחַץ אֲשֶׁר מִצְרַיִם לֹחֲצִים אֹתָם׃

english.text:
“And now, here, the cry of the children of Israel has come
to me, and also I’ve seen the oppression that Egypt is
causing them.

translation.text: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.

verses.english:
“And now, here, the cry of the children of Israel has come
to me, and also I’ve seen the oppression that Egypt is
causing them.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לְכָה וְאֶשְׁלָחֲךָ אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְהוֹצֵא אֶת עַמִּי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לְכָה וְאֶשְׁלָחֲךָ אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְהוֹצֵא אֶת עַמִּי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And now go, and I’ll send you to Pharaoh, and bring out my
people, the children of Israel, from Egypt.”

translation.text: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.

verses.english:
And now go, and I’ll send you to Pharaoh, and bring out my
people, the children of Israel, from Egypt.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים מִי אָנֹכִי כִּי אֵלֵךְ אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְכִי אוֹצִיא אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים מִי אָנֹכִי כִּי אֵלֵךְ אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְכִי אוֹצִיא אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Moses said to God, “Who am I that I should go to
Pharaoh and that I should bring out the children of Israel
from Egypt?”

translation.text: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?

verses.english:
And Moses said to God, “Who am I that I should go to
Pharaoh and that I should bring out the children of Israel
from Egypt?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי אֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ וְזֶה לְּךָ הָאוֹת כִּי אָנֹכִי שְׁלַחְתִּיךָ בְּהוֹצִיאֲךָ אֶת הָעָם מִמִּצְרַיִם תַּעַבְדוּן אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים עַל הָהָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי אֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ וְזֶה לְּךָ הָאוֹת כִּי אָנֹכִי שְׁלַחְתִּיךָ בְּהוֹצִיאֲךָ אֶת הָעָם מִמִּצְרַיִם תַּעַבְדוּן אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים עַל הָהָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And He said, “Because I’ll be with you. And this is the
sign for you that I have sent you. When you bring out the
people from Egypt you shall serve God on this mountain.”

translation.text: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.

verses.english:
And He said, “Because I’ll be with you. And this is the
sign for you that I have sent you. When you bring out the
people from Egypt you shall serve God on this mountain.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי בָא אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתִּי לָהֶם אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶם וְאָמְרוּ לִי מַה שְּׁמוֹ מָה אֹמַר אֲלֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי בָא אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתִּי לָהֶם אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶם וְאָמְרוּ לִי מַה שְּׁמוֹ מָה אֹמַר אֲלֵהֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses said to God, “Here, I’m coming to the children
of Israel, and I’ll say to them, ‘Your fathers’ God sent
me to you.’ And they’ll say to me, ‘What is His name?’
What shall I say to them?”

translation.text: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?

verses.english:
And Moses said to God, “Here, I’m coming to the children
of Israel, and I’ll say to them, ‘Your fathers’ God sent
me to you.’ And they’ll say to me, ‘What is His name?’
What shall I say to them?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֶהְיֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶהְיֶה וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה תֹאמַר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶהְיֶה שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֶהְיֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶהְיֶה וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה תֹאמַר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶהְיֶה שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And God said to Moses, “I am who I am.” And He said, “You
shall say this to the children of Israel: ‘I Am’ has sent
me to you.”

translation.text: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.

verses.english:
And God said to Moses, “I am who I am.” And He said, “You
shall say this to the children of Israel: ‘I Am’ has sent
me to you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר עוֹד אֱלֹהִים אֶל מֹשֶׁה כֹּה תֹאמַר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶם זֶה שְּׁמִי לְעֹלָם וְזֶה זִכְרִי לְדֹר דֹּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר עוֹד אֱלֹהִים אֶל מֹשֶׁה כֹּה תֹאמַר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶם זֶה שְּׁמִי לְעֹלָם וְזֶה זִכְרִי לְדֹר דֹּר׃

english.text:
And God said further to Moses, “You shall say this to the
children of Israel: YHWH, your fathers’ God, Abraham’s
God, Isaac’s God, and Jacob’s God has sent me to you. This
is my name forever, and this is how I am to be remembered
for generation after generation.

translation.text: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, the LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.

verses.english:
And God said further to Moses, “You shall say this to the
children of Israel: YHWH, your fathers’ God, Abraham’s
God, Isaac’s God, and Jacob’s God has sent me to you. This
is my name forever, and this is how I am to be remembered
for generation after generation.

verses.hebrew: לֵךְ וְאָסַפְתָּ אֶת זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם נִרְאָה אֵלַי אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב לֵאמֹר פָּקֹד פָּקַדְתִּי אֶתְכֶם וְאֶת הֶעָשׂוּי לָכֶם בְּמִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: לֵךְ וְאָסַפְתָּ אֶת זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם נִרְאָה אֵלַי אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב לֵאמֹר פָּקֹד פָּקַדְתִּי אֶתְכֶם וְאֶת הֶעָשׂוּי לָכֶם בְּמִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
“Go and gather Israel’s elders and say to them, ‘YHWH,
your fathers’ God, has appeared to me—the God of Abraham,
Isaac, and Jacob—saying: I have taken account of you and
what has been done to you in Egypt,

translation.text: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt:

verses.english:
“Go and gather Israel’s elders and say to them, ‘YHWH,
your fathers’ God, has appeared to me—the God of Abraham,
Isaac, and Jacob—saying: I have taken account of you and
what has been done to you in Egypt,

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אַעֲלֶה אֶתְכֶם מֵעֳנִי מִצְרַיִם אֶל אֶרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי אֶל אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃
