hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר אַעֲלֶה אֶתְכֶם מֵעֳנִי מִצְרַיִם אֶל אֶרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי אֶל אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

english.text:
and I say I shall bring you up from the degradation of
Egypt to the land of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the
Amorite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite,
to a land flowing with milk and honey.

translation.text: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.english:
and I say I shall bring you up from the degradation of
Egypt to the land of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the
Amorite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite,
to a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמְעוּ לְקֹלֶךָ וּבָאתָ אַתָּה וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם וַאֲמַרְתֶּם אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִיִּים נִקְרָה עָלֵינוּ וְעַתָּה נֵלְכָה נָּא דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים בַּמִּדְבָּר וְנִזְבְּחָה לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמְעוּ לְקֹלֶךָ וּבָאתָ אַתָּה וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם וַאֲמַרְתֶּם אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִיִּים נִקְרָה עָלֵינוּ וְעַתָּה נֵלְכָה נָּא דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים בַּמִּדְבָּר וְנִזְבְּחָה לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text:
And they’ll listen to your voice, and you’ll come, you and
Israel’s elders, to the king of Egypt, and you’ll say to
him, ‘YHWH, God of the Hebrews, has communicated with us.
And now, let us go on a trip of three days in the
wilderness so we may sacrifice to YHWH, our God.’

translation.text: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.

verses.english:
And they’ll listen to your voice, and you’ll come, you and
Israel’s elders, to the king of Egypt, and you’ll say to
him, ‘YHWH, God of the Hebrews, has communicated with us.
And now, let us go on a trip of three days in the
wilderness so we may sacrifice to YHWH, our God.’

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי לֹא יִתֵּן אֶתְכֶם מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לַהֲלֹךְ וְלֹא בְּיָד חֲזָקָה׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי לֹא יִתֵּן אֶתְכֶם מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לַהֲלֹךְ וְלֹא בְּיָד חֲזָקָה׃

english.text:
And I know that the king of Egypt won’t allow you to go,
and not by a strong hand,

translation.text: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.

verses.english:
And I know that the king of Egypt won’t allow you to go,
and not by a strong hand,

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁלַחְתִּי אֶת יָדִי וְהִכֵּיתִי אֶת מִצְרַיִם בְּכֹל נִפְלְאֹתַי אֲשֶׁר אֶעֱשֶׂה בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יְשַׁלַּח אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁלַחְתִּי אֶת יָדִי וְהִכֵּיתִי אֶת מִצְרַיִם בְּכֹל נִפְלְאֹתַי אֲשֶׁר אֶעֱשֶׂה בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יְשַׁלַּח אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
and I’ll put out my hand and strike Egypt with all my
wonders that I’ll do among them, and after that he’ll let
you go.

translation.text: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.

verses.english:
and I’ll put out my hand and strike Egypt with all my
wonders that I’ll do among them, and after that he’ll let
you go.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת חֵן הָעָם הַזֶּה בְּעֵינֵי מִצְרָיִם וְהָיָה כִּי תֵלֵכוּן לֹא תֵלְכוּ רֵיקָם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת חֵן הָעָם הַזֶּה בְּעֵינֵי מִצְרָיִם וְהָיָה כִּי תֵלֵכוּן לֹא תֵלְכוּ רֵיקָם׃

english.text:
And I’ll put this people’s favor in Egypt’s eyes; and it
will be, when you go, you won’t go empty-handed.

translation.text: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty.

verses.english:
And I’ll put this people’s favor in Egypt’s eyes; and it
will be, when you go, you won’t go empty-handed.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁאֲלָה אִשָּׁה מִשְּׁכֶנְתָּהּ וּמִגָּרַת בֵּיתָהּ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב וּשְׂמָלֹת וְשַׂמְתֶּם עַל בְּנֵיכֶם וְעַל בְּנֹתֵיכֶם וְנִצַּלְתֶּם אֶת מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁאֲלָה אִשָּׁה מִשְּׁכֶנְתָּהּ וּמִגָּרַת בֵּיתָהּ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב וּשְׂמָלֹת וְשַׂמְתֶּם עַל בְּנֵיכֶם וְעַל בְּנֹתֵיכֶם וְנִצַּלְתֶּם אֶת מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And each woman will ask for silver articles and gold
articles and clothes from her neighbor and from anyone
staying in her house, and you’ll put them on your sons and
on your daughters, and you’ll despoil Egypt.”

translation.text: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.

verses.english:
And each woman will ask for silver articles and gold
articles and clothes from her neighbor and from anyone
staying in her house, and you’ll put them on your sons and
on your daughters, and you’ll despoil Egypt.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר וְהֵן לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ לִי וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ בְּקֹלִי כִּי יֹאמְרוּ לֹא נִרְאָה אֵלֶיךָ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר וְהֵן לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ לִי וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ בְּקֹלִי כִּי יֹאמְרוּ לֹא נִרְאָה אֵלֶיךָ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Moses answered, and he said, “And here, they won’t
believe me and won’t listen to my voice, because they’ll
say, ‘YHWH hasn’t appeared to you!’”

translation.text: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The LORD hath not appeared unto thee.

verses.english:
And Moses answered, and he said, “And here, they won’t
believe me and won’t listen to my voice, because they’ll
say, ‘YHWH hasn’t appeared to you!’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה (מזה) [מַה זֶּה] בְיָדֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר מַטֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה (מזה) [מַה זֶּה] בְיָדֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר מַטֶּה׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to him, “What’s this in your hand?” And he
said, “A staff.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to him, “What’s this in your hand?” And he
said, “A staff.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַשְׁלִיכֵהוּ אַרְצָה וַיַּשְׁלִכֵהוּ אַרְצָה וַיְהִי לְנָחָשׁ וַיָּנס מֹשֶׁה מִפָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַשְׁלִיכֵהוּ אַרְצָה וַיַּשְׁלִכֵהוּ אַרְצָה וַיְהִי לְנָחָשׁ וַיָּנס מֹשֶׁה מִפָּנָיו׃

english.text:
And He said, “Throw it to the ground.” And he threw it to
the ground. And it became a snake! And Moses fled from it.

translation.text: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.

verses.english:
And He said, “Throw it to the ground.” And he threw it to
the ground. And it became a snake! And Moses fled from it.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה שְׁלַח יָדְךָ וֶאֱחֹז בִּזְנָבוֹ וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיַּחֲזֶק בּוֹ וַיְהִי לְמַטֶּה בְּכַפּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה שְׁלַח יָדְךָ וֶאֱחֹז בִּזְנָבוֹ וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיַּחֲזֶק בּוֹ וַיְהִי לְמַטֶּה בְּכַפּוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Put out your hand and take hold
of its tail.” And he put out his hand and held onto it,
and it became a staff in his hand.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Put out your hand and take hold
of its tail.” And he put out his hand and held onto it,
and it became a staff in his hand.

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יַאֲמִינוּ כִּי נִרְאָה אֵלֶיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתָם אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן יַאֲמִינוּ כִּי נִרְאָה אֵלֶיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתָם אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
“So that they will believe that YHWH, their fathers’ God,
Abraham’s God, Isaac’s God, and Jacob’s God, has appeared
to you!”

translation.text: That they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.

verses.english:
“So that they will believe that YHWH, their fathers’ God,
Abraham’s God, Isaac’s God, and Jacob’s God, has appeared
to you!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לוֹ עוֹד הָבֵא נָא יָדְךָ בְּחֵיקֶךָ וַיָּבֵא יָדוֹ בְּחֵיקוֹ וַיּוֹצִאָהּ וְהִנֵּה יָדוֹ מְצֹרַעַת כַּשָּׁלֶג׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לוֹ עוֹד הָבֵא נָא יָדְךָ בְּחֵיקֶךָ וַיָּבֵא יָדוֹ בְּחֵיקוֹ וַיּוֹצִאָהּ וְהִנֵּה יָדוֹ מְצֹרַעַת כַּשָּׁלֶג׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to him further, “Bring your hand into your
bosom.” And he brought his hand into his bosom. And he
brought it out; and, here, his hand was leprous like snow!

translation.text: And the LORD said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to him further, “Bring your hand into your
bosom.” And he brought his hand into his bosom. And he
brought it out; and, here, his hand was leprous like snow!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָשֵׁב יָדְךָ אֶל חֵיקֶךָ וַיָּשֶׁב יָדוֹ אֶל חֵיקוֹ וַיּוֹצִאָהּ מֵחֵיקוֹ וְהִנֵּה שָׁבָה כִּבְשָׂרוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָשֵׁב יָדְךָ אֶל חֵיקֶךָ וַיָּשֶׁב יָדוֹ אֶל חֵיקוֹ וַיּוֹצִאָהּ מֵחֵיקוֹ וְהִנֵּה שָׁבָה כִּבְשָׂרוֹ׃

english.text:
And He said, “Put your hand back to your bosom.” And he
put his hand back to his bosom. And he brought it out from
his bosom; and, here, it had gone back like its flesh.

translation.text: And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his other flesh.

verses.english:
And He said, “Put your hand back to your bosom.” And he
put his hand back to his bosom. And he brought it out from
his bosom; and, here, it had gone back like its flesh.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ לָךְ וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ לְקֹל הָאֹת הָרִאשׁוֹן וְהֶאֱמִינוּ לְקֹל הָאֹת הָאַחֲרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ לָךְ וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ לְקֹל הָאֹת הָרִאשׁוֹן וְהֶאֱמִינוּ לְקֹל הָאֹת הָאַחֲרוֹן׃

english.text:
“And it will be, if they won’t believe you and won’t
listen to the voice of the first sign, then they’ll
believe the voice of the latter one.

translation.text: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.

verses.english:
“And it will be, if they won’t believe you and won’t
listen to the voice of the first sign, then they’ll
believe the voice of the latter one.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ גַּם לִשְׁנֵי הָאֹתוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּן לְקֹלֶךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ מִמֵּימֵי הַיְאֹר וְשָׁפַכְתָּ הַיַּבָּשָׁה וְהָיוּ הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר תִּקַּח מִן הַיְאֹר וְהָיוּ לְדָם בַּיַּבָּשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ גַּם לִשְׁנֵי הָאֹתוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּן לְקֹלֶךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ מִמֵּימֵי הַיְאֹר וְשָׁפַכְתָּ הַיַּבָּשָׁה וְהָיוּ הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר תִּקַּח מִן הַיְאֹר וְהָיוּ לְדָם בַּיַּבָּשֶׁת׃

english.text:
And it will be, if they also won’t believe in these two
signs and won’t listen to your voice, then you’ll take
some of the water of the Nile and spill it on the dry
ground. And it will be water that you’ll take from the
Nile, and it will become blood on the dry ground.”

translation.text: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land.

verses.english:
And it will be, if they also won’t believe in these two
signs and won’t listen to your voice, then you’ll take
some of the water of the Nile and spill it on the dry
ground. And it will be water that you’ll take from the
Nile, and it will become blood on the dry ground.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה בִּי אֲדֹנָי לֹא אִישׁ דְּבָרִים אָנֹכִי גַּם מִתְּמוֹל גַּם מִשִּׁלְשֹׁם גַּם מֵאָז דַּבֶּרְךָ אֶל עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי כְבַד פֶּה וּכְבַד לָשׁוֹן אָנֹכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה בִּי אֲדֹנָי לֹא אִישׁ דְּבָרִים אָנֹכִי גַּם מִתְּמוֹל גַּם מִשִּׁלְשֹׁם גַּם מֵאָז דַּבֶּרְךָ אֶל עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי כְבַד פֶּה וּכְבַד לָשׁוֹן אָנֹכִי׃

english.text:
And Moses said to YHWH, “Please, my Lord, I’m not a man of
words. Neither yesterday nor the day before—nor since you
spoke to your servant! Because I’m heavy of mouth and
heavy of tongue.”

translation.text: And Moses said unto the LORD, O my LORD, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.

verses.english:
And Moses said to YHWH, “Please, my Lord, I’m not a man of
words. Neither yesterday nor the day before—nor since you
spoke to your servant! Because I’m heavy of mouth and
heavy of tongue.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו מִי שָׂם פֶּה לָאָדָם אוֹ מִי יָשׂוּם אִלֵּם אוֹ חֵרֵשׁ אוֹ פִקֵּחַ אוֹ עִוֵּר הֲלֹא אָנֹכִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו מִי שָׂם פֶּה לָאָדָם אוֹ מִי יָשׂוּם אִלֵּם אוֹ חֵרֵשׁ אוֹ פִקֵּחַ אוֹ עִוֵּר הֲלֹא אָנֹכִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to him, “Who set a mouth for humans? Or who
will set a mute or deaf or seeing or blind? Is it not I,
YHWH?

translation.text: And the LORD said unto him, Who hath made man’s mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the LORD?

verses.english:
And YHWH said to him, “Who set a mouth for humans? Or who
will set a mute or deaf or seeing or blind? Is it not I,
YHWH?

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לֵךְ וְאָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה עִם פִּיךָ וְהוֹרֵיתִיךָ אֲשֶׁר תְּדַבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לֵךְ וְאָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה עִם פִּיךָ וְהוֹרֵיתִיךָ אֲשֶׁר תְּדַבֵּר׃

english.text:
And now go, and I’ll be with your mouth, and I’ll instruct
you what you shall speak.”

translation.text: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.

verses.english:
And now go, and I’ll be with your mouth, and I’ll instruct
you what you shall speak.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּי אֲדֹנָי שְׁלַח נָא בְּיַד תִּשְׁלָח׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּי אֲדֹנָי שְׁלַח נָא בְּיַד תִּשְׁלָח׃

english.text:
And he said, “Please, my Lord, send by the hand you’ll
send.”

translation.text: And he said, O my LORD, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.

verses.english:
And he said, “Please, my Lord, send by the hand you’ll
send.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בְּמֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלֹא אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ הַלֵּוִי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי דַבֵּר יְדַבֵּר הוּא וְגַם הִנֵּה הוּא יֹצֵא לִקְרָאתֶךָ וְרָאֲךָ וְשָׂמַח בְּלִבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בְּמֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלֹא אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ הַלֵּוִי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי דַבֵּר יְדַבֵּר הוּא וְגַם הִנֵּה הוּא יֹצֵא לִקְרָאתֶךָ וְרָאֲךָ וְשָׂמַח בְּלִבּוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH’s anger flared at Moses, and He said, “Isn’t
Aaron your Levite brother? I knew that he will speak! And
also here he is, coming out toward you! And he’ll see you
and be happy in his heart.

translation.text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.

verses.english:
And YHWH’s anger flared at Moses, and He said, “Isn’t
Aaron your Levite brother? I knew that he will speak! And
also here he is, coming out toward you! And he’ll see you
and be happy in his heart.

verses.hebrew: וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֵלָיו וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת הַדְּבָרִים בְּפִיו וְאָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה עִם פִּיךָ וְעִם פִּיהוּ וְהוֹרֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּן׃

hebrew.text: וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֵלָיו וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת הַדְּבָרִים בְּפִיו וְאָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה עִם פִּיךָ וְעִם פִּיהוּ וְהוֹרֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּן׃

english.text:
And you’ll speak to him and set the words in his mouth,
and I, I shall be with your mouth and with his mouth, and
I shall instruct you what you shall do.

translation.text: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.

verses.english:
And you’ll speak to him and set the words in his mouth,
and I, I shall be with your mouth and with his mouth, and
I shall instruct you what you shall do.

verses.hebrew: וְדִבֶּר הוּא לְךָ אֶל הָעָם וְהָיָה הוּא יִהְיֶה לְּךָ לְפֶה וְאַתָּה תִּהְיֶה לּוֹ לֵאלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וְדִבֶּר הוּא לְךָ אֶל הָעָם וְהָיָה הוּא יִהְיֶה לְּךָ לְפֶה וְאַתָּה תִּהְיֶה לּוֹ לֵאלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And he will speak for you to the people. And it will be:
he will become a mouth for you, and you will become a god
for him!

translation.text: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.

verses.english:
And he will speak for you to the people. And it will be:
he will become a mouth for you, and you will become a god
for him!

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַמַּטֶּה הַזֶּה תִּקַּח בְּיָדֶךָ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה בּוֹ אֶת הָאֹתֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַמַּטֶּה הַזֶּה תִּקַּח בְּיָדֶךָ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה בּוֹ אֶת הָאֹתֹת׃

english.text:
And you shall take this staff in your hand, by which
you’ll do the signs.”

translation.text: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.

verses.english:
And you shall take this staff in your hand, by which
you’ll do the signs.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה וַיָּשׁב אֶל יֶתֶר חֹתְנוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֵלְכָה נָּא וְאָשׁוּבָה אֶל אַחַי אֲשֶׁר בְּמִצְרַיִם וְאֶרְאֶה הַעוֹדָם חַיִּים וַיֹּאמֶר יִתְרוֹ לְמֹשֶׁה לֵךְ לְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה וַיָּשׁב אֶל יֶתֶר חֹתְנוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֵלְכָה נָּא וְאָשׁוּבָה אֶל אַחַי אֲשֶׁר בְּמִצְרַיִם וְאֶרְאֶה הַעוֹדָם חַיִּים וַיֹּאמֶר יִתְרוֹ לְמֹשֶׁה לֵךְ לְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
And Moses went. And he went back to Jether, his
father-in-law, and said to him, “Let me go so I may go
back to my brothers who are in Egypt and see if they’re
still living.” And Jethro said to Moses, “Go in peace.”

translation.text: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.

verses.english:
And Moses went. And he went back to Jether, his
father-in-law, and said to him, “Let me go so I may go
back to my brothers who are in Egypt and see if they’re
still living.” And Jethro said to Moses, “Go in peace.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּמִדְיָן לֵךְ שֻׁב מִצְרָיִם כִּי מֵתוּ כּל הָאֲנָשִׁים הַמְבַקְשִׁים אֶת נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּמִדְיָן לֵךְ שֻׁב מִצְרָיִם כִּי מֵתוּ כּל הָאֲנָשִׁים הַמְבַקְשִׁים אֶת נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses in Midian, “Go. Go back to Egypt,
because all the people who sought your life have died.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses in Midian, “Go. Go back to Egypt,
because all the people who sought your life have died.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת בָּנָיו וַיַּרְכִּבֵם עַל הַחֲמֹר וַיָּשׁב אַרְצָה מִצְרָיִם וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת מַטֵּה הָאֱלֹהִים בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת בָּנָיו וַיַּרְכִּבֵם עַל הַחֲמֹר וַיָּשׁב אַרְצָה מִצְרָיִם וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת מַטֵּה הָאֱלֹהִים בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
And Moses took his wife and his sons and rode them on an
ass, and he went back to the land of Egypt. And Moses took
the staff of God in his hand.

translation.text: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.

verses.english:
And Moses took his wife and his sons and rode them on an
ass, and he went back to the land of Egypt. And Moses took
the staff of God in his hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּלֶכְתְּךָ לָשׁוּב מִצְרַיְמָה רְאֵה כּל הַמֹּפְתִים אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי בְיָדֶךָ וַעֲשִׂיתָם לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וַאֲנִי אֲחַזֵּק אֶת לִבּוֹ וְלֹא יְשַׁלַּח אֶת הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּלֶכְתְּךָ לָשׁוּב מִצְרַיְמָה רְאֵה כּל הַמֹּפְתִים אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי בְיָדֶךָ וַעֲשִׂיתָם לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וַאֲנִי אֲחַזֵּק אֶת לִבּוֹ וְלֹא יְשַׁלַּח אֶת הָעָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “When you’re going to go back to
Egypt, see all the wonders that I’ve set in your hand, and
you shall do them in front of Pharaoh. And I: I’ll
strengthen his heart, and he won’t let the people go.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “When you’re going to go back to
Egypt, see all the wonders that I’ve set in your hand, and
you shall do them in front of Pharaoh. And I: I’ll
strengthen his heart, and he won’t let the people go.

verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל פַּרְעֹה כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה בְּנִי בְכֹרִי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל פַּרְעֹה כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה בְּנִי בְכֹרִי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And you shall say to Pharaoh, ‘YHWH said this: My child,
my firstborn, is Israel.

translation.text: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD, Israel is my son, even my firstborn:

verses.english:
And you shall say to Pharaoh, ‘YHWH said this: My child,
my firstborn, is Israel.

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ שַׁלַּח אֶת בְּנִי וְיַעַבְדֵנִי וַתְּמָאֵן לְשַׁלְּחוֹ הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הֹרֵג אֶת בִּנְךָ בְּכֹרֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ שַׁלַּח אֶת בְּנִי וְיַעַבְדֵנִי וַתְּמָאֵן לְשַׁלְּחוֹ הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הֹרֵג אֶת בִּנְךָ בְּכֹרֶךָ׃

english.text:
And I’ve said to you: Let my child go and serve me. And
should you refuse to let it go, here: I’m killing your
child, your firstborn!’”

translation.text: And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, even thy firstborn.

verses.english:
And I’ve said to you: Let my child go and serve me. And
should you refuse to let it go, here: I’m killing your
child, your firstborn!’”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַדֶּרֶךְ בַּמָּלוֹן וַיִּפְגְּשֵׁהוּ יְהֹוָה וַיְבַקֵּשׁ הֲמִיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַדֶּרֶךְ בַּמָּלוֹן וַיִּפְגְּשֵׁהוּ יְהֹוָה וַיְבַקֵּשׁ הֲמִיתוֹ׃

english.text:
And he was on the way, at a lodging place, and YHWH met
him, and he asked to kill him.

translation.text: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the LORD met him, and sought to kill him.

verses.english:
And he was on the way, at a lodging place, and YHWH met
him, and he asked to kill him.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח צִפֹּרָה צֹר וַתִּכְרֹת אֶת ערְלַת בְּנָהּ וַתַּגַּע לְרַגְלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר כִּי חֲתַן דָּמִים אַתָּה לִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקַּח צִפֹּרָה צֹר וַתִּכְרֹת אֶת ערְלַת בְּנָהּ וַתַּגַּע לְרַגְלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר כִּי חֲתַן דָּמִים אַתָּה לִי׃

english.text:
And Zipporah took a flint and cut her son’s foreskin and
touched his feet, and she said, “Because you’re a
bridegroom of blood to me.”

translation.text: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband art thou to me.

verses.english:
And Zipporah took a flint and cut her son’s foreskin and
touched his feet, and she said, “Because you’re a
bridegroom of blood to me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרֶף מִמֶּנּוּ אָז אָמְרָה חֲתַן דָּמִים לַמּוּלֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרֶף מִמֶּנּוּ אָז אָמְרָה חֲתַן דָּמִים לַמּוּלֹת׃

english.text:
And he held back from Him. Then she said, “A bridegroom of
blood for circumcisions.”

translation.text: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband thou art, because of the circumcision.

verses.english:
And he held back from Him. Then she said, “A bridegroom of
blood for circumcisions.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵךְ לִקְרַאת מֹשֶׁה הַמִּדְבָּרָה וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּפְגְּשֵׁהוּ בְּהַר הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּשַּׁק לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵךְ לִקְרַאת מֹשֶׁה הַמִּדְבָּרָה וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּפְגְּשֵׁהוּ בְּהַר הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּשַּׁק לוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Aaron, “Go toward Moses, to the
wilderness.” And he went, and he met him in the Mountain
of God, and he kissed him.

translation.text: And the LORD said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Aaron, “Go toward Moses, to the
wilderness.” And he went, and he met him in the Mountain
of God, and he kissed him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד מֹשֶׁה לְאַהֲרֹן אֵת כּל דִּבְרֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ וְאֵת כּל הָאֹתֹת אֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֵּד מֹשֶׁה לְאַהֲרֹן אֵת כּל דִּבְרֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ וְאֵת כּל הָאֹתֹת אֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ׃

english.text:
And Moses told Aaron all YHWH’s words that He had sent him
and all the signs that He had commanded him.

translation.text: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.

verses.english:
And Moses told Aaron all YHWH’s words that He had sent him
and all the signs that He had commanded him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֶת כּל זִקְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֶת כּל זִקְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses went, and Aaron, and they gathered all the
elders of the children of Israel,

translation.text: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:

verses.english:
And Moses went, and Aaron, and they gathered all the
elders of the children of Israel,

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אַהֲרֹן אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיַּעַשׂ הָאֹתֹת לְעֵינֵי הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר אַהֲרֹן אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיַּעַשׂ הָאֹתֹת לְעֵינֵי הָעָם׃

english.text:
and Aaron spoke all the words that YHWH had spoken to
Moses. And he did the signs before the people’s eyes.

translation.text: And Aaron spake all the words which the LORD had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.

verses.english:
and Aaron spoke all the words that YHWH had spoken to
Moses. And he did the signs before the people’s eyes.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּאֲמֵן הָעָם וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כִּי פָקַד יְהֹוָה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִי רָאָה אֶת ענְיָם וַיִּקְּדוּ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּאֲמֵן הָעָם וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כִּי פָקַד יְהֹוָה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִי רָאָה אֶת ענְיָם וַיִּקְּדוּ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ׃

english.text:
And the people believed, and they heard that YHWH had
taken account of the children of Israel and that He had
seen their degradation. And they knelt and bowed.

translation.text: And the people believed: and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.

verses.english:
And the people believed, and they heard that YHWH had
taken account of the children of Israel and that He had
seen their degradation. And they knelt and bowed.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר בָּאוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל פַּרְעֹה כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שַׁלַּח אֶת עַמִּי וְיָחֹגּוּ לִי בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחַר בָּאוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל פַּרְעֹה כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שַׁלַּח אֶת עַמִּי וְיָחֹגּוּ לִי בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
And after that Moses and Aaron came and said to Pharaoh,
“YHWH, God of Israel, said this: ‘Let my people go, so
they will celebrate a festival for me in the wilderness.’”

translation.text: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.

verses.english:
And after that Moses and Aaron came and said to Pharaoh,
“YHWH, God of Israel, said this: ‘Let my people go, so
they will celebrate a festival for me in the wilderness.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה מִי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר אֶשְׁמַע בְּקֹלוֹ לְשַׁלַּח אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יָדַעְתִּי אֶת יְהֹוָה וְגַם אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא אֲשַׁלֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה מִי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר אֶשְׁמַע בְּקֹלוֹ לְשַׁלַּח אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יָדַעְתִּי אֶת יְהֹוָה וְגַם אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא אֲשַׁלֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said, “Who is YHWH that I should listen to His
voice, to let Israel go?! I don’t know YHWH, and also I
won’t let Israel go.”

translation.text: And Pharaoh said, Who is the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the LORD, neither will I let Israel go.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said, “Who is YHWH that I should listen to His
voice, to let Israel go?! I don’t know YHWH, and also I
won’t let Israel go.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִים נִקְרָא עָלֵינוּ נֵלְכָה נָּא דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים בַּמִּדְבָּר וְנִזְבְּחָה לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ פֶּן יִפְגָּעֵנוּ בַּדֶּבֶר אוֹ בֶחָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִים נִקְרָא עָלֵינוּ נֵלְכָה נָּא דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים בַּמִּדְבָּר וְנִזְבְּחָה לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ פֶּן יִפְגָּעֵנוּ בַּדֶּבֶר אוֹ בֶחָרֶב׃

english.text:
And they said, “The God of the Hebrews has communicated
with us. Let us go on a trip of three days in the
wilderness so we may sacrifice to YHWH, our God, or else
He’ll strike us with an epidemic or with the sword.”

translation.text: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days’ journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the LORD our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.

verses.english:
And they said, “The God of the Hebrews has communicated
with us. Let us go on a trip of three days in the
wilderness so we may sacrifice to YHWH, our God, or else
He’ll strike us with an epidemic or with the sword.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לָמָּה מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן תַּפְרִיעוּ אֶת הָעָם מִמַּעֲשָׂיו לְכוּ לְסִבְלֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לָמָּה מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן תַּפְרִיעוּ אֶת הָעָם מִמַּעֲשָׂיו לְכוּ לְסִבְלֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And the king of Egypt said to them, “Why, Moses and Aaron,
do you turn the people loose from its work? Go to your
burdens!”

translation.text: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.

verses.english:
And the king of Egypt said to them, “Why, Moses and Aaron,
do you turn the people loose from its work? Go to your
burdens!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה הֵן רַבִּים עַתָּה עַם הָאָרֶץ וְהִשְׁבַּתֶּם אֹתָם מִסִּבְלֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה הֵן רַבִּים עַתָּה עַם הָאָרֶץ וְהִשְׁבַּתֶּם אֹתָם מִסִּבְלֹתָם׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said, “Here, the people of the land are now
many, and you’ve made them cease from their burdens.”

translation.text: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said, “Here, the people of the land are now
many, and you’ve made them cease from their burdens.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו פַּרְעֹה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת הַנֹּגְשִׂים בָּעָם וְאֶת שֹׁטְרָיו לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו פַּרְעֹה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת הַנֹּגְשִׂים בָּעָם וְאֶת שֹׁטְרָיו לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters among the people and
its officers in that day, saying,

translation.text: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,

verses.english:
And Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters among the people and
its officers in that day, saying,

verses.hebrew: לֹא תֹאסִפוּן לָתֵת תֶּבֶן לָעָם לִלְבֹּן הַלְּבֵנִים כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם הֵם יֵלְכוּ וְקֹשְׁשׁוּ לָהֶם תֶּבֶן׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֹאסִפוּן לָתֵת תֶּבֶן לָעָם לִלְבֹּן הַלְּבֵנִים כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם הֵם יֵלְכוּ וְקֹשְׁשׁוּ לָהֶם תֶּבֶן׃

english.text:
“You shall not continue to give straw to the people to
make bricks as yesterday and the day before. They shall go
and collect straw for themselves.

translation.text: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.

verses.english:
“You shall not continue to give straw to the people to
make bricks as yesterday and the day before. They shall go
and collect straw for themselves.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת מַתְכֹּנֶת הַלְּבֵנִים אֲשֶׁר הֵם עֹשִׂים תְּמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם תָּשִׂימוּ עֲלֵיהֶם לֹא תִגְרְעוּ מִמֶּנּוּ כִּי נִרְפִּים הֵם עַל כֵּן הֵם צֹעֲקִים לֵאמֹר נֵלְכָה נִזְבְּחָה לֵאלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת מַתְכֹּנֶת הַלְּבֵנִים אֲשֶׁר הֵם עֹשִׂים תְּמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם תָּשִׂימוּ עֲלֵיהֶם לֹא תִגְרְעוּ מִמֶּנּוּ כִּי נִרְפִּים הֵם עַל כֵּן הֵם צֹעֲקִים לֵאמֹר נֵלְכָה נִזְבְּחָה לֵאלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text:
And you shall impose on them the quota of the bricks that
they were making yesterday and the day before. You shall
not subtract from it. Because they’re lazy. On account of
this they’re crying, saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to
our God.’

translation.text: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.

verses.english:
And you shall impose on them the quota of the bricks that
they were making yesterday and the day before. You shall
not subtract from it. Because they’re lazy. On account of
this they’re crying, saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to
our God.’

verses.hebrew: תִּכְבַּד הָעֲבֹדָה עַל הָאֲנָשִׁים וְיַעֲשׂוּ בָהּ וְאַל יִשְׁעוּ בְּדִבְרֵי שָׁקֶר׃

hebrew.text: תִּכְבַּד הָעֲבֹדָה עַל הָאֲנָשִׁים וְיַעֲשׂוּ בָהּ וְאַל יִשְׁעוּ בְּדִבְרֵי שָׁקֶר׃

english.text:
Let the work be heavy on the people, and let them do it,
and let them not pay attention to words that are a lie!”

translation.text: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.

verses.english:
Let the work be heavy on the people, and let them do it,
and let them not pay attention to words that are a lie!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ נֹגְשֵׂי הָעָם וְשֹׁטְרָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל הָעָם לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר פַּרְעֹה אֵינֶנִּי נֹתֵן לָכֶם תֶּבֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ נֹגְשֵׂי הָעָם וְשֹׁטְרָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל הָעָם לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר פַּרְעֹה אֵינֶנִּי נֹתֵן לָכֶם תֶּבֶן׃

english.text:
And the people’s taskmasters and its officers went out and
said to the people, saying, “Pharaoh said this: ‘I am not
giving you straw.

translation.text: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.

verses.english:
And the people’s taskmasters and its officers went out and
said to the people, saying, “Pharaoh said this: ‘I am not
giving you straw.

verses.hebrew: אַתֶּם לְכוּ קְחוּ לָכֶם תֶּבֶן מֵאֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָאוּ כִּי אֵין נִגְרָע מֵעֲבֹדַתְכֶם דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: אַתֶּם לְכוּ קְחוּ לָכֶם תֶּבֶן מֵאֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָאוּ כִּי אֵין נִגְרָע מֵעֲבֹדַתְכֶם דָּבָר׃

english.text:
You, go, take straw for yourselves from wherever you’ll
find it, because not a thing is subtracted from your
work.’”

translation.text: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.

verses.english:
You, go, take straw for yourselves from wherever you’ll
find it, because not a thing is subtracted from your
work.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּפֶץ הָעָם בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לְקֹשֵׁשׁ קַשׁ לַתֶּבֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּפֶץ הָעָם בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לְקֹשֵׁשׁ קַשׁ לַתֶּבֶן׃

english.text:
And the people scattered through all the land of Egypt to
collect stubble for straw.

translation.text: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.

verses.english:
And the people scattered through all the land of Egypt to
collect stubble for straw.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנֹּגְשִׂים אָצִים לֵאמֹר כַּלּוּ מַעֲשֵׂיכֶם דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר בִּהְיוֹת הַתֶּבֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנֹּגְשִׂים אָצִים לֵאמֹר כַּלּוּ מַעֲשֵׂיכֶם דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר בִּהְיוֹת הַתֶּבֶן׃

english.text:
And the taskmasters were prodding, saying, “Finish your
work, the day’s thing in that very day, as when there was
the straw.”

translation.text: And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.

verses.english:
And the taskmasters were prodding, saying, “Finish your
work, the day’s thing in that very day, as when there was
the straw.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּכּוּ שֹׁטְרֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר שָׂמוּ עֲלֵהֶם נֹגְשֵׂי פַרְעֹה לֵאמֹר מַדּוּעַ לֹא כִלִּיתֶם חקְכֶם לִלְבֹּן כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם גַּם תְּמוֹל גַּם הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּכּוּ שֹׁטְרֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר שָׂמוּ עֲלֵהֶם נֹגְשֵׂי פַרְעֹה לֵאמֹר מַדּוּעַ לֹא כִלִּיתֶם חקְכֶם לִלְבֹּן כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם גַּם תְּמוֹל גַּם הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And the officers of the children of Israel whom Pharaoh’s
taskmasters had set over them were beaten—saying, “Why
haven’t you finished your requirement to make brick like
the day before yesterday, also yesterday, also today?”

translation.text: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?

verses.english:
And the officers of the children of Israel whom Pharaoh’s
taskmasters had set over them were beaten—saying, “Why
haven’t you finished your requirement to make brick like
the day before yesterday, also yesterday, also today?”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ שֹׁטְרֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר לָמָּה תַעֲשֶׂה כֹה לַעֲבָדֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ שֹׁטְרֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר לָמָּה תַעֲשֶׂה כֹה לַעֲבָדֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And the officers of the children of Israel came and cried
to Pharaoh, saying, “Why do you do a thing like this to
your servants?

translation.text: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?

verses.english:
And the officers of the children of Israel came and cried
to Pharaoh, saying, “Why do you do a thing like this to
your servants?

verses.hebrew: תֶּבֶן אֵין נִתָּן לַעֲבָדֶיךָ וּלְבֵנִים אֹמְרִים לָנוּ עֲשׂוּ וְהִנֵּה עֲבָדֶיךָ מֻכִּים וְחָטָאת עַמֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: תֶּבֶן אֵין נִתָּן לַעֲבָדֶיךָ וּלְבֵנִים אֹמְרִים לָנוּ עֲשׂוּ וְהִנֵּה עֲבָדֶיךָ מֻכִּים וְחָטָאת עַמֶּךָ׃

english.text:
Straw isn’t given to your servants, and they say to us:
Make bricks. And here, your servants are beaten, and it’s
your people’s sin.”

translation.text: There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants are beaten; but the fault is in thine own people.

verses.english:
Straw isn’t given to your servants, and they say to us:
Make bricks. And here, your servants are beaten, and it’s
your people’s sin.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נִרְפִּים אַתֶּם נִרְפִּים עַל כֵּן אַתֶּם אֹמְרִים נֵלְכָה נִזְבְּחָה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר נִרְפִּים אַתֶּם נִרְפִּים עַל כֵּן אַתֶּם אֹמְרִים נֵלְכָה נִזְבְּחָה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he said, “You’re lazy, lazy! On account of this you’re
saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to YHWH.’

translation.text: But he said, Ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go and do sacrifice to the LORD.

verses.english:
And he said, “You’re lazy, lazy! On account of this you’re
saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to YHWH.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לְכוּ עִבְדוּ וְתֶבֶן לֹא יִנָּתֵן לָכֶם וְתֹכֶן לְבֵנִים תִּתֵּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לְכוּ עִבְדוּ וְתֶבֶן לֹא יִנָּתֵן לָכֶם וְתֹכֶן לְבֵנִים תִּתֵּנוּ׃

english.text:
And now go, work! And straw will not be given to you, and
you shall give the quota of bricks!”

translation.text: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.

verses.english:
And now go, work! And straw will not be given to you, and
you shall give the quota of bricks!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ שֹׁטְרֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֹתָם בְּרָע לֵאמֹר לֹא תִגְרְעוּ מִלִּבְנֵיכֶם דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ שֹׁטְרֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֹתָם בְּרָע לֵאמֹר לֹא תִגְרְעוּ מִלִּבְנֵיכֶם דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
And the officers of the children of Israel saw themselves
in a bad state—saying, “You shall not subtract from your
bricks, the day’s thing in that very day.”

translation.text: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case, after it was said, Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task.

verses.english:
And the officers of the children of Israel saw themselves
in a bad state—saying, “You shall not subtract from your
bricks, the day’s thing in that very day.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְגְּעוּ אֶת מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן נִצָּבִים לִקְרָאתָם בְּצֵאתָם מֵאֵת פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְגְּעוּ אֶת מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן נִצָּבִים לִקְרָאתָם בְּצֵאתָם מֵאֵת פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And they met Moses and Aaron, standing opposite them when
they came out from Pharaoh,

translation.text: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:

verses.english:
And they met Moses and Aaron, standing opposite them when
they came out from Pharaoh,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם יֵרֶא יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם וְיִשְׁפֹּט אֲשֶׁר הִבְאַשְׁתֶּם אֶת רֵיחֵנוּ בְּעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה וּבְעֵינֵי עֲבָדָיו לָתֶת חֶרֶב בְּיָדָם לְהרְגֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם יֵרֶא יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם וְיִשְׁפֹּט אֲשֶׁר הִבְאַשְׁתֶּם אֶת רֵיחֵנוּ בְּעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה וּבְעֵינֵי עֲבָדָיו לָתֶת חֶרֶב בְּיָדָם לְהרְגֵנוּ׃

english.text:
and they said to them, “May YHWH look on you and judge,
that you’ve made our smell odious in Pharaoh’s eyes and in
his servants’ eyes, to give a sword in their hand to kill
us!”

translation.text: And they said unto them, The LORD look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.

verses.english:
and they said to them, “May YHWH look on you and judge,
that you’ve made our smell odious in Pharaoh’s eyes and in
his servants’ eyes, to give a sword in their hand to kill
us!”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי לָמָה הֲרֵעֹתָה לָעָם הַזֶּה לָמָּה זֶּה שְׁלַחְתָּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי לָמָה הֲרֵעֹתָה לָעָם הַזֶּה לָמָּה זֶּה שְׁלַחְתָּנִי׃

english.text:
And Moses went back to YHWH and said, “My Lord, why have
you done bad to this people? Why did you send me here?

translation.text: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, LORD, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?

verses.english:
And Moses went back to YHWH and said, “My Lord, why have
you done bad to this people? Why did you send me here?

verses.hebrew: וּמֵאָז בָּאתִי אֶל פַּרְעֹה לְדַבֵּר בִּשְׁמֶךָ הֵרַע לָעָם הַזֶּה וְהַצֵּל לֹא הִצַּלְתָּ אֶת עַמֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּמֵאָז בָּאתִי אֶל פַּרְעֹה לְדַבֵּר בִּשְׁמֶךָ הֵרַע לָעָם הַזֶּה וְהַצֵּל לֹא הִצַּלְתָּ אֶת עַמֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name he has
done bad to this people, and you haven’t rescued your
people!”

translation.text: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.

verses.english:
And since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name he has
done bad to this people, and you haven’t rescued your
people!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עַתָּה תִרְאֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶעֱשֶׂה לְפַרְעֹה כִּי בְיָד חֲזָקָה יְשַׁלְּחֵם וּבְיָד חֲזָקָה יְגָרְשֵׁם מֵאַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עַתָּה תִרְאֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶעֱשֶׂה לְפַרְעֹה כִּי בְיָד חֲזָקָה יְשַׁלְּחֵם וּבְיָד חֲזָקָה יְגָרְשֵׁם מֵאַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Now you’ll see what I shall do
to Pharaoh, because with a strong hand he’ll let them go,
and with a strong hand he’ll drive them from his land.”

translation.text: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Now you’ll see what I shall do
to Pharaoh, because with a strong hand he’ll let them go,
and with a strong hand he’ll drive them from his land.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֱלֹהִים אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר אֱלֹהִים אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And God spoke to Moses and said to him, “I
am YHWH.

translation.text: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am the LORD:

verses.english:
And God spoke to Moses and said to him, “I
am YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וָאֵרָא אֶל אַבְרָהָם אֶל יִצְחָק וְאֶל יַעֲקֹב בְּאֵל שַׁדָּי וּשְׁמִי יְהֹוָה לֹא נוֹדַעְתִּי לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וָאֵרָא אֶל אַבְרָהָם אֶל יִצְחָק וְאֶל יַעֲקֹב בְּאֵל שַׁדָּי וּשְׁמִי יְהֹוָה לֹא נוֹדַעְתִּי לָהֶם׃

english.text:
And I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as El
Shadday, and I was not known to them by my name, YHWH.

translation.text: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.

verses.english:
And I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as El
Shadday, and I was not known to them by my name, YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם הֲקִמֹתִי אֶת בְּרִיתִי אִתָּם לָתֵת לָהֶם אֶת אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן אֵת אֶרֶץ מְגֻרֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר גָּרוּ בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם הֲקִמֹתִי אֶת בְּרִיתִי אִתָּם לָתֵת לָהֶם אֶת אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן אֵת אֶרֶץ מְגֻרֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר גָּרוּ בָהּ׃

english.text:
And I also established my covenant with them, to give them
the land of Canaan, the land of their residences, in which
they resided.

translation.text: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.

verses.english:
And I also established my covenant with them, to give them
the land of Canaan, the land of their residences, in which
they resided.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֲנִי שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת נַאֲקַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר מִצְרַיִם מַעֲבִדִים אֹתָם וָאֶזְכֹּר אֶת בְּרִיתִי׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אֲנִי שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת נַאֲקַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר מִצְרַיִם מַעֲבִדִים אֹתָם וָאֶזְכֹּר אֶת בְּרִיתִי׃

english.text:
And also: I’ve heard the cry of the children of Israel as
Egypt is enslaving them, and I’ve remembered my covenant.

translation.text: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.

verses.english:
And also: I’ve heard the cry of the children of Israel as
Egypt is enslaving them, and I’ve remembered my covenant.

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אֱמֹר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנִי יְהֹוָה וְהוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מִתַּחַת סִבְלֹת מִצְרַיִם וְהִצַּלְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מֵעֲבֹדָתָם וְגָאַלְתִּי אֶתְכֶם בִּזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה וּבִשְׁפָטִים גְּדֹלִים׃

hebrew.text: לָכֵן אֱמֹר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנִי יְהֹוָה וְהוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מִתַּחַת סִבְלֹת מִצְרַיִם וְהִצַּלְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מֵעֲבֹדָתָם וְגָאַלְתִּי אֶתְכֶם בִּזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה וּבִשְׁפָטִים גְּדֹלִים׃

english.text:
Therefore, say to the children of Israel: ‘I am YHWH, and
I shall bring you out from under Egypt’s burdens, and I
shall rescue you from their toil, and I shall redeem you
with an outstretched arm and with tremendous judgments,

translation.text: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:

verses.english:
Therefore, say to the children of Israel: ‘I am YHWH, and
I shall bring you out from under Egypt’s burdens, and I
shall rescue you from their toil, and I shall redeem you
with an outstretched arm and with tremendous judgments,

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶתְכֶם לִי לְעָם וְהָיִיתִי לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הַמּוֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מִתַּחַת סִבְלוֹת מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶתְכֶם לִי לְעָם וְהָיִיתִי לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הַמּוֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מִתַּחַת סִבְלוֹת מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
and I shall take you to me as a people, and I shall become
your God, and you’ll know that I am YHWH, your God, who is
bringing you out from under Egypt’s burdens.

translation.text: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

verses.english:
and I shall take you to me as a people, and I shall become
your God, and you’ll know that I am YHWH, your God, who is
bringing you out from under Egypt’s burdens.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵבֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָשָׂאתִי אֶת יָדִי לָתֵת אֹתָהּ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב וְנָתַתִּי אֹתָהּ לָכֶם מוֹרָשָׁה אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָשָׂאתִי אֶת יָדִי לָתֵת אֹתָהּ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב וְנָתַתִּי אֹתָהּ לָכֶם מוֹרָשָׁה אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And I shall bring you to the land that I raised my hand to
give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, and I shall give
it to you as a possession. I am YHWH.’”

translation.text: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
And I shall bring you to the land that I raised my hand to
give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, and I shall give
it to you as a possession. I am YHWH.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה כֵּן אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה מִקֹּצֶר רוּחַ וּמֵעֲבֹדָה קָשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה כֵּן אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה מִקֹּצֶר רוּחַ וּמֵעֲבֹדָה קָשָׁה׃

english.text:
And Moses spoke this to the children of Israel, and they
did not listen to Moses because of shortage of spirit and
because of hard work.

translation.text: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

verses.english:
And Moses spoke this to the children of Israel, and they
did not listen to Moses because of shortage of spirit and
because of hard work.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: בֹּא דַבֵּר אֶל פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם וִישַׁלַּח אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בֹּא דַבֵּר אֶל פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם וִישַׁלַּח אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
“Come, speak to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, that he should let
the children of Israel go from his land.”

translation.text: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.

verses.english:
“Come, speak to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, that he should let
the children of Israel go from his land.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הֵן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא שָׁמְעוּ אֵלַי וְאֵיךְ יִשְׁמָעֵנִי פַרְעֹה וַאֲנִי עֲרַל שְׂפָתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הֵן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא שָׁמְעוּ אֵלַי וְאֵיךְ יִשְׁמָעֵנִי פַרְעֹה וַאֲנִי עֲרַל שְׂפָתָיִם׃

english.text:
And Moses spoke in front of YHWH, saying, “Here, the
children of Israel didn’t listen to me, and how will
Pharaoh listen to me?! And I’m uncircumcised of lips!”

translation.text: And Moses spake before the LORD, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?

verses.english:
And Moses spoke in front of YHWH, saying, “Here, the
children of Israel didn’t listen to me, and how will
Pharaoh listen to me?! And I’m uncircumcised of lips!”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן וַיְצַוֵּם אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶל פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם לְהוֹצִיא אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן וַיְצַוֵּם אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶל פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם לְהוֹצִיא אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron and commanded them
regarding the children of Israel and regarding Pharaoh,
king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from
the land of Egypt.

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron and commanded them
regarding the children of Israel and regarding Pharaoh,
king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from
the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה רָאשֵׁי בֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן בְּכֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲנוֹךְ וּפַלּוּא חֶצְרֹן וְכַרְמִי אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת רְאוּבֵן׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה רָאשֵׁי בֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן בְּכֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲנוֹךְ וּפַלּוּא חֶצְרֹן וְכַרְמִי אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת רְאוּבֵן׃

english.text:
These are the heads of their fathers’ houses: The sons of
Reuben, Israel’s firstborn: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron, and
Carmi. These are the families of Reuben.

translation.text: These be the heads of their fathers’ houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these be the families of Reuben.

verses.english:
These are the heads of their fathers’ houses: The sons of
Reuben, Israel’s firstborn: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron, and
Carmi. These are the families of Reuben.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן יְמוּאֵל וְיָמִין וְאֹהַד וְיָכִין וְצֹחַר וְשָׁאוּל בֶּן הַכְּנַעֲנִית אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת שִׁמְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן יְמוּאֵל וְיָמִין וְאֹהַד וְיָכִין וְצֹחַר וְשָׁאוּל בֶּן הַכְּנַעֲנִית אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת שִׁמְעוֹן׃

english.text:
And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel and Jamin and Ohad and
Jachin and Zohar and Saul, son of a Canaanite woman. These
are the families of Simeon.

translation.text: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these are the families of Simeon.

verses.english:
And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel and Jamin and Ohad and
Jachin and Zohar and Saul, son of a Canaanite woman. These
are the families of Simeon.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי לֵוִי לְתֹלְדֹתָם גֵּרְשׁוֹן וּקְהָת וּמְרָרִי וּשְׁנֵי חַיֵּי לֵוִי שֶׁבַע וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי לֵוִי לְתֹלְדֹתָם גֵּרְשׁוֹן וּקְהָת וּמְרָרִי וּשְׁנֵי חַיֵּי לֵוִי שֶׁבַע וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
And these are the names of the sons of Levi by their
records: Gershon and Kohath and Merari. And the years of
Levi’s life were a hundred thirty-seven years.

translation.text: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years.

verses.english:
And these are the names of the sons of Levi by their
records: Gershon and Kohath and Merari. And the years of
Levi’s life were a hundred thirty-seven years.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן לִבְנִי וְשִׁמְעִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן לִבְנִי וְשִׁמְעִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

english.text: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, by their families.

translation.text: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.

verses.english: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, by their families.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי קְהָת עַמְרָם וְיִצְהָר וְחֶבְרוֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵל וּשְׁנֵי חַיֵּי קְהָת שָׁלֹשׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי קְהָת עַמְרָם וְיִצְהָר וְחֶבְרוֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵל וּשְׁנֵי חַיֵּי קְהָת שָׁלֹשׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
And the sons of Kohath: Amram and Izhar and Hebron and
Uzziel. And the years of Kohath’s life were a hundred
thirty-three years.

translation.text: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years.

verses.english:
And the sons of Kohath: Amram and Izhar and Hebron and
Uzziel. And the years of Kohath’s life were a hundred
thirty-three years.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי מְרָרִי מַחְלִי וּמוּשִׁי אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַלֵּוִי לְתֹלְדֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי מְרָרִי מַחְלִי וּמוּשִׁי אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַלֵּוִי לְתֹלְדֹתָם׃

english.text:
And the sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the
families of Levi by their records.

translation.text: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these are the families of Levi according to their generations.

verses.english:
And the sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the
families of Levi by their records.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח עַמְרָם אֶת יוֹכֶבֶד דֹּדָתוֹ לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת מֹשֶׁה וּשְׁנֵי חַיֵּי עַמְרָם שֶׁבַע וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח עַמְרָם אֶת יוֹכֶבֶד דֹּדָתוֹ לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת מֹשֶׁה וּשְׁנֵי חַיֵּי עַמְרָם שֶׁבַע וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
And Amram took Jochebed, his aunt, as a wife; and she gave
birth to Aaron and Moses for him. And the years of Amram’s
life were a hundred thirty-seven years.

translation.text: And Amram took him Jochebed his father’s sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.

verses.english:
And Amram took Jochebed, his aunt, as a wife; and she gave
birth to Aaron and Moses for him. And the years of Amram’s
life were a hundred thirty-seven years.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִצְהָר קֹרַח וָנֶפֶג וְזִכְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי יִצְהָר קֹרַח וָנֶפֶג וְזִכְרִי׃

english.text: And the sons of Izhar: Korah and Nepheg and Zichri.

translation.text: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

verses.english: And the sons of Izhar: Korah and Nepheg and Zichri.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי עֻזִּיאֵל מִישָׁאֵל וְאֶלְצָפָן וְסִתְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי עֻזִּיאֵל מִישָׁאֵל וְאֶלְצָפָן וְסִתְרִי׃

english.text: And the sons of Uzziel: Mishael and Elzaphan and Sithri.

translation.text: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.

verses.english: And the sons of Uzziel: Mishael and Elzaphan and Sithri.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אַהֲרֹן אֶת אֱלִישֶׁבַע בַּת עַמִּינָדָב אֲחוֹת נַחְשׁוֹן לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֶת נָדָב וְאֶת אֲבִיהוּא אֶת אֶלְעָזָר וְאֶת אִיתָמָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אַהֲרֹן אֶת אֱלִישֶׁבַע בַּת עַמִּינָדָב אֲחוֹת נַחְשׁוֹן לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֶת נָדָב וְאֶת אֲבִיהוּא אֶת אֶלְעָזָר וְאֶת אִיתָמָר׃

english.text:
And Aaron took Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of
Nahshon as a wife; and she gave birth to Nadab and Abihu,
Eleazar, and Ithamar for him.

translation.text: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.english:
And Aaron took Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of
Nahshon as a wife; and she gave birth to Nadab and Abihu,
Eleazar, and Ithamar for him.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי קֹרַח אַסִּיר וְאֶלְקָנָה וַאֲבִיאָסָף אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקּרְחִי׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי קֹרַח אַסִּיר וְאֶלְקָנָה וַאֲבִיאָסָף אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקּרְחִי׃

english.text:
And the sons of Korah: Assir and Elkanah and Abiasaph.
These are the families of the Korahites.

translation.text: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korhites.

verses.english:
And the sons of Korah: Assir and Elkanah and Abiasaph.
These are the families of the Korahites.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן לָקַח לוֹ מִבְּנוֹת פּוּטִיאֵל לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֶת פִּינְחָס אֵלֶּה רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַלְוִיִּם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן לָקַח לוֹ מִבְּנוֹת פּוּטִיאֵל לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֶת פִּינְחָס אֵלֶּה רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַלְוִיִּם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

english.text:
And Eleazar son of Aaron had taken one of the daughters of
Putiel as a wife, and she gave birth for him to Phinehas.
These are the heads of the fathers of the Levites
according to their families.

translation.text: And Eleazar Aaron’s son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.

verses.english:
And Eleazar son of Aaron had taken one of the daughters of
Putiel as a wife, and she gave birth for him to Phinehas.
These are the heads of the fathers of the Levites
according to their families.

verses.hebrew: הוּא אַהֲרֹן וּמֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה לָהֶם הוֹצִיאוּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם עַל צִבְאֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: הוּא אַהֲרֹן וּמֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה לָהֶם הוֹצִיאוּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם עַל צִבְאֹתָם׃

english.text:
That is Aaron and Moses, to whom YHWH said, “Bring out the
children of Israel from the land of Egypt by their
masses.”

translation.text: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the LORD said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.

verses.english:
That is Aaron and Moses, to whom YHWH said, “Bring out the
children of Israel from the land of Egypt by their
masses.”

verses.hebrew: הֵם הַמְדַבְּרִים אֶל פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לְהוֹצִיא אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם הוּא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן׃

hebrew.text: הֵם הַמְדַבְּרִים אֶל פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לְהוֹצִיא אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם הוּא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן׃

english.text:
They were the ones speaking to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, to
bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. That is Moses
and Aaron.

translation.text: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.

verses.english:
They were the ones speaking to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, to
bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. That is Moses
and Aaron.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּיוֹם דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּיוֹם דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And it was in the day that YHWH spoke to Moses in the land
of Egypt,

translation.text: And it came to pass on the day when the LORD spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,

verses.english:
And it was in the day that YHWH spoke to Moses in the land
of Egypt,

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר אֲנִי יְהֹוָה דַּבֵּר אֶל פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי דֹּבֵר אֵלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר אֲנִי יְהֹוָה דַּבֵּר אֶל פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי דֹּבֵר אֵלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
and YHWH spoke to Moses, saying, “I am YHWH. Speak to
Pharaoh, king of Egypt, everything that I speak to you.”

translation.text: That the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, I am the LORD: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.

verses.english:
and YHWH spoke to Moses, saying, “I am YHWH. Speak to
Pharaoh, king of Egypt, everything that I speak to you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה הֵן אֲנִי עֲרַל שְׂפָתַיִם וְאֵיךְ יִשְׁמַע אֵלַי פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה הֵן אֲנִי עֲרַל שְׂפָתַיִם וְאֵיךְ יִשְׁמַע אֵלַי פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Moses said in front of YHWH, “Here, I’m uncircumcised
of lips, and how will Pharaoh listen to me?!”

translation.text: And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?

verses.english:
And Moses said in front of YHWH, “Here, I’m uncircumcised
of lips, and how will Pharaoh listen to me?!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה רְאֵה נְתַתִּיךָ אֱלֹהִים לְפַרְעֹה וְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ יִהְיֶה נְבִיאֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה רְאֵה נְתַתִּיךָ אֱלֹהִים לְפַרְעֹה וְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ יִהְיֶה נְבִיאֶךָ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “See, I’ve made you a god to
Pharaoh, and Aaron, your brother, will be your prophet.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “See, I’ve made you a god to
Pharaoh, and Aaron, your brother, will be your prophet.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה תְדַבֵּר אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר אֲצַוֶּךָּ וְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ יְדַבֵּר אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְשִׁלַּח אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אַתָּה תְדַבֵּר אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר אֲצַוֶּךָּ וְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ יְדַבֵּר אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְשִׁלַּח אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
You shall speak everything that I’ll command you; and
Aaron, your brother, shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let
the children of Israel go from his land.

translation.text: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.

verses.english:
You shall speak everything that I’ll command you; and
Aaron, your brother, shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let
the children of Israel go from his land.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אַקְשֶׁה אֶת לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְהִרְבֵּיתִי אֶת אֹתֹתַי וְאֶת מוֹפְתַי בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי אַקְשֶׁה אֶת לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְהִרְבֵּיתִי אֶת אֹתֹתַי וְאֶת מוֹפְתַי בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And I, I’ll harden Pharaoh’s heart, and I’ll multiply my
signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

translation.text: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And I, I’ll harden Pharaoh’s heart, and I’ll multiply my
signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יִשְׁמַע אֲלֵכֶם פַּרְעֹה וְנָתַתִּי אֶת יָדִי בְּמִצְרָיִם וְהוֹצֵאתִי אֶת צִבְאֹתַי אֶת עַמִּי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בִּשְׁפָטִים גְּדֹלִים׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יִשְׁמַע אֲלֵכֶם פַּרְעֹה וְנָתַתִּי אֶת יָדִי בְּמִצְרָיִם וְהוֹצֵאתִי אֶת צִבְאֹתַי אֶת עַמִּי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בִּשְׁפָטִים גְּדֹלִים׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh won’t listen to you, and I’ll set my hand in
Egypt and bring out my masses, my people, the children of
Israel, from the land of Egypt with great judgments.

translation.text: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh won’t listen to you, and I’ll set my hand in
Egypt and bring out my masses, my people, the children of
Israel, from the land of Egypt with great judgments.

verses.hebrew: וְיָדְעוּ מִצְרַיִם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה בִּנְטֹתִי אֶת יָדִי עַל מִצְרָיִם וְהוֹצֵאתִי אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָם׃

hebrew.text: וְיָדְעוּ מִצְרַיִם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה בִּנְטֹתִי אֶת יָדִי עַל מִצְרָיִם וְהוֹצֵאתִי אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָם׃

english.text:
And Egypt will know that I am YHWH when I reach out my
hand on Egypt, and I’ll bring out the children of Israel
from among them.”

translation.text: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD, when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.

verses.english:
And Egypt will know that I am YHWH when I reach out my
hand on Egypt, and I’ll bring out the children of Israel
from among them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתָם כֵּן עָשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתָם כֵּן עָשׂוּ׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron did as YHWH had commanded them. They
did so.

translation.text: And Moses and Aaron did as the LORD commanded them, so did they.

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron did as YHWH had commanded them. They
did so.

verses.hebrew: וּמֹשֶׁה בֶּן שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וְאַהֲרֹן בֶּן שָׁלֹשׁ וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה בְּדַבְּרָם אֶל פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וּמֹשֶׁה בֶּן שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וְאַהֲרֹן בֶּן שָׁלֹשׁ וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה בְּדַבְּרָם אֶל פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron was eighty-three
years old when they spoke to Pharaoh.

translation.text: And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.

verses.english:
And Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron was eighty-three
years old when they spoke to Pharaoh.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH said to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH said to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.hebrew: כִּי יְדַבֵּר אֲלֵכֶם פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר תְּנוּ לָכֶם מוֹפֵת וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל אַהֲרֹן קַח אֶת מַטְּךָ וְהַשְׁלֵךְ לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה יְהִי לְתַנִּין׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יְדַבֵּר אֲלֵכֶם פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר תְּנוּ לָכֶם מוֹפֵת וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל אַהֲרֹן קַח אֶת מַטְּךָ וְהַשְׁלֵךְ לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה יְהִי לְתַנִּין׃

english.text:
“When Pharaoh will speak to you, saying, ‘Produce a
wonder!’ then say to Aaron, ‘Take your staff and throw it
in front of Pharaoh. Let it become a serpent.’”

translation.text: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent.

verses.english:
“When Pharaoh will speak to you, saying, ‘Produce a
wonder!’ then say to Aaron, ‘Take your staff and throw it
in front of Pharaoh. Let it become a serpent.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶל פַּרְעֹה וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אַהֲרֹן אֶת מַטֵּהוּ לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וְלִפְנֵי עֲבָדָיו וַיְהִי לְתַנִּין׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶל פַּרְעֹה וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אַהֲרֹן אֶת מַטֵּהוּ לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וְלִפְנֵי עֲבָדָיו וַיְהִי לְתַנִּין׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron came to Pharaoh and did so, as YHWH
had commanded, and Aaron threw his staff in front of
Pharaoh and in front of his servants, and it became a
serpent.

translation.text: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the LORD had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron came to Pharaoh and did so, as YHWH
had commanded, and Aaron threw his staff in front of
Pharaoh and in front of his servants, and it became a
serpent.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא גַּם פַּרְעֹה לַחֲכָמִים וְלַמְכַשְּׁפִים וַיַּעֲשׂוּ גַם הֵם חַרְטֻמֵּי מִצְרַיִם בְּלַהֲטֵיהֶם כֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא גַּם פַּרְעֹה לַחֲכָמִים וְלַמְכַשְּׁפִים וַיַּעֲשׂוּ גַם הֵם חַרְטֻמֵּי מִצְרַיִם בְּלַהֲטֵיהֶם כֵּן׃

translation.text: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ אִישׁ מַטֵּהוּ וַיִּהְיוּ לְתַנִּינִם וַיִּבְלַע מַטֵּה אַהֲרֹן אֶת מַטֹּתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ אִישׁ מַטֵּהוּ וַיִּהְיוּ לְתַנִּינִם וַיִּבְלַע מַטֵּה אַהֲרֹן אֶת מַטֹּתָם׃

english.text:
and they each threw his staff, and they became serpents.
And Aaron’s staff swallowed their staffs!

translation.text: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.

verses.english:
and they each threw his staff, and they became serpents.
And Aaron’s staff swallowed their staffs!

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחֱזַק לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּחֱזַק לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh’s heart was strong, and he did not listen to
them—as YHWH had spoken.

translation.text: And he hardened Pharaoh’s heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh’s heart was strong, and he did not listen to
them—as YHWH had spoken.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה כָּבֵד לֵב פַּרְעֹה מֵאֵן לְשַׁלַּח הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה כָּבֵד לֵב פַּרְעֹה מֵאֵן לְשַׁלַּח הָעָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is heavy. He has
refused to let the people go.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh’s heart is hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is heavy. He has
refused to let the people go.

verses.hebrew: לֵךְ אֶל פַּרְעֹה בַּבֹּקֶר הִנֵּה יֹצֵא הַמַּיְמָה וְנִצַּבְתָּ לִקְרָאתוֹ עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר וְהַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר נֶהְפַּךְ לְנָחָשׁ תִּקַּח בְּיָדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: לֵךְ אֶל פַּרְעֹה בַּבֹּקֶר הִנֵּה יֹצֵא הַמַּיְמָה וְנִצַּבְתָּ לִקְרָאתוֹ עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר וְהַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר נֶהְפַּךְ לְנָחָשׁ תִּקַּח בְּיָדֶךָ׃

english.text:
Go to Pharaoh in the morning—here, he’ll be going out to
the water—and you’ll stand opposite him on the bank of the
Nile, and you shall take in your hand the staff that was
changed into a snake.

translation.text: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river’s brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.

verses.english:
Go to Pharaoh in the morning—here, he’ll be going out to
the water—and you’ll stand opposite him on the bank of the
Nile, and you shall take in your hand the staff that was
changed into a snake.

verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִים שְׁלָחַנִי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר שַׁלַּח אֶת עַמִּי וְיַעַבְדֻנִי בַּמִּדְבָּר וְהִנֵּה לֹא שָׁמַעְתָּ עַד כֹּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִים שְׁלָחַנִי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר שַׁלַּח אֶת עַמִּי וְיַעַבְדֻנִי בַּמִּדְבָּר וְהִנֵּה לֹא שָׁמַעְתָּ עַד כֹּה׃

english.text:
And you’ll say to him, ‘YHWH, the God of the Hebrews, sent
me to you, saying: “Let my people go so they may serve me
in the wilderness.” And here, you haven’t listened so far.

translation.text: And thou shalt say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.

verses.english:
And you’ll say to him, ‘YHWH, the God of the Hebrews, sent
me to you, saying: “Let my people go so they may serve me
in the wilderness.” And here, you haven’t listened so far.

verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה בְּזֹאת תֵּדַע כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מַכֶּה בַּמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדִי עַל הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר בַּיְאֹר וְנֶהֶפְכוּ לְדָם׃

hebrew.text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה בְּזֹאת תֵּדַע כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מַכֶּה בַּמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדִי עַל הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר בַּיְאֹר וְנֶהֶפְכוּ לְדָם׃

english.text:
YHWH said this: “By this you’ll know that I am YHWH.”
Here, I’m striking with the staff that’s in my hand on the
waters that are in the Nile, and they’ll be changed into
blood.

translation.text: Thus saith the LORD, In this thou shalt know that I am the LORD: behold, I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

verses.english:
YHWH said this: “By this you’ll know that I am YHWH.”
Here, I’m striking with the staff that’s in my hand on the
waters that are in the Nile, and they’ll be changed into
blood.

verses.hebrew: וְהַדָּגָה אֲשֶׁר בַּיְאֹר תָּמוּת וּבָאַשׁ הַיְאֹר וְנִלְאוּ מִצְרַיִם לִשְׁתּוֹת מַיִם מִן הַיְאֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְהַדָּגָה אֲשֶׁר בַּיְאֹר תָּמוּת וּבָאַשׁ הַיְאֹר וְנִלְאוּ מִצְרַיִם לִשְׁתּוֹת מַיִם מִן הַיְאֹר׃

english.text:
And the fish that are in the Nile will die, and the Nile
will stink, and Egypt will weary themselves to drink water
from the Nile.’”

translation.text: And the fish that is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.

verses.english:
And the fish that are in the Nile will die, and the Nile
will stink, and Egypt will weary themselves to drink water
from the Nile.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֱמֹר אֶל אַהֲרֹן קַח מַטְּךָ וּנְטֵה יָדְךָ עַל מֵימֵי מִצְרַיִם עַל נַהֲרֹתָם עַל יְאֹרֵיהֶם וְעַל אַגְמֵיהֶם וְעַל כּל מִקְוֵה מֵימֵיהֶם וְיִהְיוּ דָם וְהָיָה דָם בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וּבָעֵצִים וּבָאֲבָנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֱמֹר אֶל אַהֲרֹן קַח מַטְּךָ וּנְטֵה יָדְךָ עַל מֵימֵי מִצְרַיִם עַל נַהֲרֹתָם עַל יְאֹרֵיהֶם וְעַל אַגְמֵיהֶם וְעַל כּל מִקְוֵה מֵימֵיהֶם וְיִהְיוּ דָם וְהָיָה דָם בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וּבָעֵצִים וּבָאֲבָנִים׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Say to Aaron, ‘Take your staff
and reach your hand over Egypt’s waters, over their
rivers, over their canals, and over their pools, and over
every concentration of their waters.’ And they will be
blood! And blood will be in all the land of Egypt—and in
the trees and in the stones!”

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Say to Aaron, ‘Take your staff
and reach your hand over Egypt’s waters, over their
rivers, over their canals, and over their pools, and over
every concentration of their waters.’ And they will be
blood! And blood will be in all the land of Egypt—and in
the trees and in the stones!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה וַיָּרֶם בַּמַּטֶּה וַיַּךְ אֶת הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר בַּיְאֹר לְעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה וּלְעֵינֵי עֲבָדָיו וַיֵּהָפְכוּ כּל הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר בַּיְאֹר לְדָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה וַיָּרֶם בַּמַּטֶּה וַיַּךְ אֶת הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר בַּיְאֹר לְעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה וּלְעֵינֵי עֲבָדָיו וַיֵּהָפְכוּ כּל הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר בַּיְאֹר לְדָם׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron did so, as YHWH had commanded. And he
raised the staff and struck the waters that were in the
Nile before Pharaoh’s eyes and before his servants’ eyes,
and all the waters that were in the Nile were changed into
blood.

translation.text: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron did so, as YHWH had commanded. And he
raised the staff and struck the waters that were in the
Nile before Pharaoh’s eyes and before his servants’ eyes,
and all the waters that were in the Nile were changed into
blood.

verses.hebrew: וְהַדָּגָה אֲשֶׁר בַּיְאֹר מֵתָה וַיִּבְאַשׁ הַיְאֹר וְלֹא יָכְלוּ מִצְרַיִם לִשְׁתּוֹת מַיִם מִן הַיְאֹר וַיְהִי הַדָּם בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַדָּגָה אֲשֶׁר בַּיְאֹר מֵתָה וַיִּבְאַשׁ הַיְאֹר וְלֹא יָכְלוּ מִצְרַיִם לִשְׁתּוֹת מַיִם מִן הַיְאֹר וַיְהִי הַדָּם בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
