And the fish in the Nile died, and the Nile had an odor,
and Egypt was not able to drink water from the Nile. And
the blood was in all the land of Egypt.

translation.text: And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And the fish in the Nile died, and the Nile had an odor,
and Egypt was not able to drink water from the Nile. And
the blood was in all the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן חַרְטֻמֵּי מִצְרַיִם בְּלָטֵיהֶם וַיֶּחֱזַק לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן חַרְטֻמֵּי מִצְרַיִם בְּלָטֵיהֶם וַיֶּחֱזַק לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Egypt’s magicians did so with their charms. And
Pharaoh’s heart was strong, and he did not listen to
them—as YHWH had spoken.

translation.text: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, neither did he hearken unto them; as the LORD had said.

verses.english:
And Egypt’s magicians did so with their charms. And
Pharaoh’s heart was strong, and he did not listen to
them—as YHWH had spoken.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן פַּרְעֹה וַיָּבֹא אֶל בֵּיתוֹ וְלֹא שָׁת לִבּוֹ גַּם לָזֹאת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֶן פַּרְעֹה וַיָּבֹא אֶל בֵּיתוֹ וְלֹא שָׁת לִבּוֹ גַּם לָזֹאת׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh turned and came into his house and did not pay
heed to this as well.

translation.text: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh turned and came into his house and did not pay
heed to this as well.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחְפְּרוּ כל מִצְרַיִם סְבִיבֹת הַיְאֹר מַיִם לִשְׁתּוֹת כִּי לֹא יָכְלוּ לִשְׁתֹּת מִמֵּימֵי הַיְאֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחְפְּרוּ כל מִצְרַיִם סְבִיבֹת הַיְאֹר מַיִם לִשְׁתּוֹת כִּי לֹא יָכְלוּ לִשְׁתֹּת מִמֵּימֵי הַיְאֹר׃

english.text:
And all Egypt dug around the Nile for water to drink,
because they were not able to drink from the Nile’s
waters.

translation.text: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.

verses.english:
And all Egypt dug around the Nile for water to drink,
because they were not able to drink from the Nile’s
waters.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמָּלֵא שִׁבְעַת יָמִים אַחֲרֵי הַכּוֹת יְהֹוָה אֶת הַיְאֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמָּלֵא שִׁבְעַת יָמִים אַחֲרֵי הַכּוֹת יְהֹוָה אֶת הַיְאֹר׃

english.text: And seven days were filled after YHWH’s striking the Nile.

translation.text: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the LORD had smitten the river.

verses.english: And seven days were filled after YHWH’s striking the Nile.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בֹּא אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה שַׁלַּח אֶת עַמִּי וְיַעַבְדֻנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בֹּא אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה שַׁלַּח אֶת עַמִּי וְיַעַבְדֻנִי׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Come to Pharaoh, and you’ll say
to him, ‘YHWH said this: Let my people go, so they may
serve me.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Come to Pharaoh, and you’ll say
to him, ‘YHWH said this: Let my people go, so they may
serve me.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם מָאֵן אַתָּה לְשַׁלֵּחַ הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי נֹגֵף אֶת כּל גְּבוּלְךָ בַּצְפַרְדְּעִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מָאֵן אַתָּה לְשַׁלֵּחַ הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי נֹגֵף אֶת כּל גְּבוּלְךָ בַּצְפַרְדְּעִים׃

english.text:
And if you refuse to let go, here, I’m plaguing all your
border with frogs,

verses.english:
And if you refuse to let go, here, I’m plaguing all your
border with frogs,

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁרַץ הַיְאֹר צְפַרְדְּעִים וְעָלוּ וּבָאוּ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבַחֲדַר מִשְׁכָּבְךָ וְעַל מִטָּתֶךָ וּבְבֵית עֲבָדֶיךָ וּבְעַמֶּךָ וּבְתַנּוּרֶיךָ וּבְמִשְׁאֲרוֹתֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁרַץ הַיְאֹר צְפַרְדְּעִים וְעָלוּ וּבָאוּ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבַחֲדַר מִשְׁכָּבְךָ וְעַל מִטָּתֶךָ וּבְבֵית עֲבָדֶיךָ וּבְעַמֶּךָ וּבְתַנּוּרֶיךָ וּבְמִשְׁאֲרוֹתֶיךָ׃

english.text:
and the Nile will teem with frogs, and they’ll go up and
come in your house and in your bedroom and on your bed and
in your servants’ house and among your people and in your
ovens and in your bowls,

verses.english:
and the Nile will teem with frogs, and they’ll go up and
come in your house and in your bedroom and on your bed and
in your servants’ house and among your people and in your
ovens and in your bowls,

verses.hebrew: וּבְכָה וּבְעַמְּךָ וּבְכל עֲבָדֶיךָ יַעֲלוּ הַצְפַרְדְּעִים׃

hebrew.text: וּבְכָה וּבְעַמְּךָ וּבְכל עֲבָדֶיךָ יַעֲלוּ הַצְפַרְדְּעִים׃

english.text:
and the frogs will go up on you and on your people and on
all your servants.’”

verses.english:
and the frogs will go up on you and on your people and on
all your servants.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֱמֹר אֶל אַהֲרֹן נְטֵה אֶת יָדְךָ בְּמַטֶּךָ עַל הַנְּהָרֹת עַל הַיְאֹרִים וְעַל הָאֲגַמִּים וְהַעַל אֶת הַצְפַרְדְּעִים עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֱמֹר אֶל אַהֲרֹן נְטֵה אֶת יָדְךָ בְּמַטֶּךָ עַל הַנְּהָרֹת עַל הַיְאֹרִים וְעַל הָאֲגַמִּים וְהַעַל אֶת הַצְפַרְדְּעִים עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Say to Aaron, ‘Reach out your
hand with your staff over the rivers, over the canals, and
over the pools, and bring up the frogs on the land of
Egypt.’”

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Say to Aaron, ‘Reach out your
hand with your staff over the rivers, over the canals, and
over the pools, and bring up the frogs on the land of
Egypt.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּט אַהֲרֹן אֶת יָדוֹ עַל מֵימֵי מִצְרָיִם וַתַּעַל הַצְּפַרְדֵּעַ וַתְּכַס אֶת אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּט אַהֲרֹן אֶת יָדוֹ עַל מֵימֵי מִצְרָיִם וַתַּעַל הַצְּפַרְדֵּעַ וַתְּכַס אֶת אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Aaron reached out his hand over Egypt’s waters, and
the frogs came up and covered the land of Egypt.

translation.text: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:

verses.english:
And Aaron reached out his hand over Egypt’s waters, and
the frogs came up and covered the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן הַחַרְטֻמִּים בְּלָטֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶת הַצְפַרְדְּעִים עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן הַחַרְטֻמִּים בְּלָטֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶת הַצְפַרְדְּעִים עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And the magicians did so with their charms. And they
brought up the frogs on the land of Egypt.

translation.text: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into thine house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thine ovens, and into thy kneadingtroughs:

verses.english:
And the magicians did so with their charms. And they
brought up the frogs on the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא פַרְעֹה לְמֹשֶׁה וּלְאַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר הַעְתִּירוּ אֶל יְהֹוָה וְיָסֵר הַצְפַרְדְּעִים מִמֶּנִּי וּמֵעַמִּי וַאֲשַׁלְּחָה אֶת הָעָם וְיִזְבְּחוּ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא פַרְעֹה לְמֹשֶׁה וּלְאַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר הַעְתִּירוּ אֶל יְהֹוָה וְיָסֵר הַצְפַרְדְּעִים מִמֶּנִּי וּמֵעַמִּי וַאֲשַׁלְּחָה אֶת הָעָם וְיִזְבְּחוּ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron and said, “Pray to YHWH
that He will take away the frogs from me and from my
people so I may let the people go, and they’ll sacrifice
to YHWH.”

translation.text: And the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron and said, “Pray to YHWH
that He will take away the frogs from me and from my
people so I may let the people go, and they’ll sacrifice
to YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לְפַרְעֹה הִתְפָּאֵר עָלַי לְמָתַי אַעְתִּיר לְךָ וְלַעֲבָדֶיךָ וּלְעַמְּךָ לְהַכְרִית הַצְפַרְדְּעִים מִמְּךָ וּמִבָּתֶּיךָ רַק בַּיְאֹר תִּשָּׁאַרְנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לְפַרְעֹה הִתְפָּאֵר עָלַי לְמָתַי אַעְתִּיר לְךָ וְלַעֲבָדֶיךָ וּלְעַמְּךָ לְהַכְרִית הַצְפַרְדְּעִים מִמְּךָ וּמִבָּתֶּיךָ רַק בַּיְאֹר תִּשָּׁאַרְנָה׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Pharaoh, “Be honored over me as to when
I’ll pray for you and for your servants and for your
people to cut off the frogs from you and from your
houses—they’ll be left only in the river.”

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And Moses said to Pharaoh, “Be honored over me as to when
I’ll pray for you and for your servants and for your
people to cut off the frogs from you and from your
houses—they’ll be left only in the river.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְמָחָר וַיֹּאמֶר כִּדְבָרְךָ לְמַעַן תֵּדַע כִּי אֵין כַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְמָחָר וַיֹּאמֶר כִּדְבָרְךָ לְמַעַן תֵּדַע כִּי אֵין כַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text:
And he said, “As of tomorrow.” And he said, “According to
your word: so that you’ll know that there’s none like
YHWH, our God.

translation.text: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And he said, “As of tomorrow.” And he said, “According to
your word: so that you’ll know that there’s none like
YHWH, our God.

verses.hebrew: וְסָרוּ הַצְפַרְדְּעִים מִמְּךָ וּמִבָּתֶּיךָ וּמֵעֲבָדֶיךָ וּמֵעַמֶּךָ רַק בַּיְאֹר תִּשָּׁאַרְנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְסָרוּ הַצְפַרְדְּעִים מִמְּךָ וּמִבָּתֶּיךָ וּמֵעֲבָדֶיךָ וּמֵעַמֶּךָ רַק בַּיְאֹר תִּשָּׁאַרְנָה׃

english.text:
And the frogs will turn away from you and from your houses
and from your servants and from your people—they’ll be
left only in the river.”

translation.text: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And the frogs will turn away from you and from your houses
and from your servants and from your people—they’ll be
left only in the river.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה וַיִּצְעַק מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה עַל דְּבַר הַצְפַרְדְּעִים אֲשֶׁר שָׂם לְפַרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה וַיִּצְעַק מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה עַל דְּבַר הַצְפַרְדְּעִים אֲשֶׁר שָׂם לְפַרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh. And Moses cried
to YHWH over the matter of the frogs that he had set upon
Pharaoh.

translation.text: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Intreat the LORD, that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh. And Moses cried
to YHWH over the matter of the frogs that he had set upon
Pharaoh.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה כִּדְבַר מֹשֶׁה וַיָּמֻתוּ הַצְפַרְדְּעִים מִן הַבָּתִּים מִן הַחֲצֵרֹת וּמִן הַשָּׂדֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה כִּדְבַר מֹשֶׁה וַיָּמֻתוּ הַצְפַרְדְּעִים מִן הַבָּתִּים מִן הַחֲצֵרֹת וּמִן הַשָּׂדֹת׃

english.text:
And YHWH did according to Moses’ word, and the frogs died
from the houses, from the yards, and from the fields.

translation.text: And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Glory over me: when shall I intreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people, to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses, that they may remain in the river only?

verses.english:
And YHWH did according to Moses’ word, and the frogs died
from the houses, from the yards, and from the fields.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְבְּרוּ אֹתָם חֳמָרִם חֳמָרִם וַתִּבְאַשׁ הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצְבְּרוּ אֹתָם חֳמָרִם חֳמָרִם וַתִּבְאַשׁ הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And they piled them up, heaps and heaps, and the land
smelled.

translation.text: And he said, To morrow. And he said, Be it according to thy word: that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the LORD our God.

verses.english:
And they piled them up, heaps and heaps, and the land
smelled.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא פַּרְעֹה כִּי הָיְתָה הָרְוָחָה וְהַכְבֵּד אֶת לִבּוֹ וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא פַּרְעֹה כִּי הָיְתָה הָרְוָחָה וְהַכְבֵּד אֶת לִבּוֹ וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh saw that there was a break, and he made his
heart heavy, and he did not listen to them—as YHWH had
spoken.

translation.text: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh saw that there was a break, and he made his
heart heavy, and he did not listen to them—as YHWH had
spoken.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֱמֹר אֶל אַהֲרֹן נְטֵה אֶת מַטְּךָ וְהַךְ אֶת עֲפַר הָאָרֶץ וְהָיָה לְכִנִּם בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֱמֹר אֶל אַהֲרֹן נְטֵה אֶת מַטְּךָ וְהַךְ אֶת עֲפַר הָאָרֶץ וְהָיָה לְכִנִּם בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Say to Aaron, ‘Reach out your
staff and strike the dust of the earth, and it will become
lice in all the land of Egypt.’”

translation.text: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto the LORD because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Say to Aaron, ‘Reach out your
staff and strike the dust of the earth, and it will become
lice in all the land of Egypt.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן וַיֵּט אַהֲרֹן אֶת יָדוֹ בְמַטֵּהוּ וַיַּךְ אֶת עֲפַר הָאָרֶץ וַתְּהִי הַכִּנָּם בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה כּל עֲפַר הָאָרֶץ הָיָה כִנִּים בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן וַיֵּט אַהֲרֹן אֶת יָדוֹ בְמַטֵּהוּ וַיַּךְ אֶת עֲפַר הָאָרֶץ וַתְּהִי הַכִּנָּם בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה כּל עֲפַר הָאָרֶץ הָיָה כִנִּים בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And they did so, and Aaron reached out his hand with his
staff and struck the dust of the earth, and the lice were
in the humans and in the animals. All the dust of the
earth was lice in all the land of Egypt.

translation.text: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.

verses.english:
And they did so, and Aaron reached out his hand with his
staff and struck the dust of the earth, and the lice were
in the humans and in the animals. All the dust of the
earth was lice in all the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן הַחַרְטֻמִּים בְּלָטֵיהֶם לְהוֹצִיא אֶת הַכִּנִּים וְלֹא יָכֹלוּ וַתְּהִי הַכִּנָּם בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן הַחַרְטֻמִּים בְּלָטֵיהֶם לְהוֹצִיא אֶת הַכִּנִּים וְלֹא יָכֹלוּ וַתְּהִי הַכִּנָּם בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה׃

english.text:
And the magicians did so with their charms, to bring out
the lice, and they were not able. And the lice were in the
humans and in the animals.

translation.text: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.

verses.english:
And the magicians did so with their charms, to bring out
the lice, and they were not able. And the lice were in the
humans and in the animals.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הַחַרְטֻמִּם אֶל פַּרְעֹה אֶצְבַּע אֱלֹהִים הִוא וַיֶּחֱזַק לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הַחַרְטֻמִּם אֶל פַּרְעֹה אֶצְבַּע אֱלֹהִים הִוא וַיֶּחֱזַק לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the magicians said to Pharaoh, “It’s the finger of
God!” And Pharaoh’s heart was strong, and he did not
listen to them—as YHWH had spoken.

translation.text: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

verses.english:
And the magicians said to Pharaoh, “It’s the finger of
God!” And Pharaoh’s heart was strong, and he did not
listen to them—as YHWH had spoken.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הַשְׁכֵּם בַּבֹּקֶר וְהִתְיַצֵּב לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה הִנֵּה יוֹצֵא הַמָּיְמָה וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה שַׁלַּח עַמִּי וְיַעַבְדֻנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הַשְׁכֵּם בַּבֹּקֶר וְהִתְיַצֵּב לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה הִנֵּה יוֹצֵא הַמָּיְמָה וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה שַׁלַּח עַמִּי וְיַעַבְדֻנִי׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Get up early in the morning and
stand up in front of Pharaoh. Here, he’s going out to the
water. And you’ll say to him, ‘YHWH said this: Let my
people go so they may serve me.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Get up early in the morning and
stand up in front of Pharaoh. Here, he’s going out to the
water. And you’ll say to him, ‘YHWH said this: Let my
people go so they may serve me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם אֵינְךָ מְשַׁלֵּחַ אֶת עַמִּי הִנְנִי מַשְׁלִיחַ בְּךָ וּבַעֲבָדֶיךָ וּבְעַמְּךָ וּבְבָתֶּיךָ אֶת הֶעָרֹב וּמָלְאוּ בָּתֵּי מִצְרַיִם אֶת הֶעָרֹב וְגַם הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר הֵם עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם אֵינְךָ מְשַׁלֵּחַ אֶת עַמִּי הִנְנִי מַשְׁלִיחַ בְּךָ וּבַעֲבָדֶיךָ וּבְעַמְּךָ וּבְבָתֶּיךָ אֶת הֶעָרֹב וּמָלְאוּ בָּתֵּי מִצְרַיִם אֶת הֶעָרֹב וְגַם הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר הֵם עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
Because if you’re not letting my people go, here, I’m
causing an insect swarm to be let go on you and on your
servants and on your people and on your houses. And the
houses of Egypt will be filled with the insect swarm, and
also the ground that they’re on.

translation.text: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
Because if you’re not letting my people go, here, I’m
causing an insect swarm to be let go on you and on your
servants and on your people and on your houses. And the
houses of Egypt will be filled with the insect swarm, and
also the ground that they’re on.

verses.hebrew: וְהִפְלֵיתִי בַיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת אֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן אֲשֶׁר עַמִּי עֹמֵד עָלֶיהָ לְבִלְתִּי הֱיוֹת שָׁם עָרֹב לְמַעַן תֵּדַע כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִפְלֵיתִי בַיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת אֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן אֲשֶׁר עַמִּי עֹמֵד עָלֶיהָ לְבִלְתִּי הֱיוֹת שָׁם עָרֹב לְמַעַן תֵּדַע כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And I shall distinguish in that day the land of Goshen, on
which my people is standing, for no insect swarm to be
there, so that you will know that I, YHWH, am within the
land.

translation.text: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.

verses.english:
And I shall distinguish in that day the land of Goshen, on
which my people is standing, for no insect swarm to be
there, so that you will know that I, YHWH, am within the
land.

verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתִּי פְדֻת בֵּין עַמִּי וּבֵין עַמֶּךָ לְמָחָר יִהְיֶה הָאֹת הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתִּי פְדֻת בֵּין עַמִּי וּבֵין עַמֶּךָ לְמָחָר יִהְיֶה הָאֹת הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And I shall set a distinction between my people and your
people. This sign will be tomorrow.’”

translation.text: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

verses.english:
And I shall set a distinction between my people and your
people. This sign will be tomorrow.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה כֵּן וַיָּבֹא עָרֹב כָּבֵד בֵּיתָה פַרְעֹה וּבֵית עֲבָדָיו וּבְכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם תִּשָּׁחֵת הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵי הֶעָרֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה כֵּן וַיָּבֹא עָרֹב כָּבֵד בֵּיתָה פַרְעֹה וּבֵית עֲבָדָיו וּבְכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם תִּשָּׁחֵת הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵי הֶעָרֹב׃

english.text:
And YHWH did so. And a heavy insect swarm came to
Pharaoh’s house and his servants’ house, and in all the
land of Egypt the land was corrupted because of the insect
swarm.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

verses.english:
And YHWH did so. And a heavy insect swarm came to
Pharaoh’s house and his servants’ house, and in all the
land of Egypt the land was corrupted because of the insect
swarm.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא פַרְעֹה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וּלְאַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר לְכוּ זִבְחוּ לֵאלֹהֵיכֶם בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא פַרְעֹה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וּלְאַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר לְכוּ זִבְחוּ לֵאלֹהֵיכֶם בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron. And he said, “Go.
Sacrifice to your God in the land.”

translation.text: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground whereon they are.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron. And he said, “Go.
Sacrifice to your God in the land.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לֹא נָכוֹן לַעֲשׂוֹת כֵּן כִּי תּוֹעֲבַת מִצְרַיִם נִזְבַּח לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הֵן נִזְבַּח אֶת תּוֹעֲבַת מִצְרַיִם לְעֵינֵיהֶם וְלֹא יִסְקְלֻנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לֹא נָכוֹן לַעֲשׂוֹת כֵּן כִּי תּוֹעֲבַת מִצְרַיִם נִזְבַּח לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הֵן נִזְבַּח אֶת תּוֹעֲבַת מִצְרַיִם לְעֵינֵיהֶם וְלֹא יִסְקְלֻנוּ׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “It’s not right to do so, because we’ll be
sacrificing to YHWH, our God, an offensive thing to Egypt.
Here, we’ll be sacrificing an offensive thing to Egypt
before their eyes; and will they not stone us?!

translation.text: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I am the LORD in the midst of the earth.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “It’s not right to do so, because we’ll be
sacrificing to YHWH, our God, an offensive thing to Egypt.
Here, we’ll be sacrificing an offensive thing to Egypt
before their eyes; and will they not stone us?!

verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים נֵלֵךְ בַּמִּדְבָּר וְזָבַחְנוּ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר אֵלֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים נֵלֵךְ בַּמִּדְבָּר וְזָבַחְנוּ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר אֵלֵינוּ׃

english.text:
We’ll go on a trip of three days in the wilderness, and
we’ll sacrifice to YHWH, our God, whatever He’ll say to
us.”

translation.text: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.

verses.english:
We’ll go on a trip of three days in the wilderness, and
we’ll sacrifice to YHWH, our God, whatever He’ll say to
us.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אָנֹכִי אֲשַׁלַּח אֶתְכֶם וּזְבַחְתֶּם לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בַּמִּדְבָּר רַק הַרְחֵק לֹא תַרְחִיקוּ לָלֶכֶת הַעְתִּירוּ בַּעֲדִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אָנֹכִי אֲשַׁלַּח אֶתְכֶם וּזְבַחְתֶּם לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בַּמִּדְבָּר רַק הַרְחֵק לֹא תַרְחִיקוּ לָלֶכֶת הַעְתִּירוּ בַּעֲדִי׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said, “I’ll let you go, and you’ll sacrifice
to YHWH, your God, in the wilderness. Only you shall not
go far. Pray for me.”

translation.text: And the LORD did so; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said, “I’ll let you go, and you’ll sacrifice
to YHWH, your God, in the wilderness. Only you shall not
go far. Pray for me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי יוֹצֵא מֵעִמָּךְ וְהַעְתַּרְתִּי אֶל יְהֹוָה וְסָר הֶעָרֹב מִפַּרְעֹה מֵעֲבָדָיו וּמֵעַמּוֹ מָחָר רַק אַל יֹסֵף פַּרְעֹה הָתֵל לְבִלְתִּי שַׁלַּח אֶת הָעָם לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי יוֹצֵא מֵעִמָּךְ וְהַעְתַּרְתִּי אֶל יְהֹוָה וְסָר הֶעָרֹב מִפַּרְעֹה מֵעֲבָדָיו וּמֵעַמּוֹ מָחָר רַק אַל יֹסֵף פַּרְעֹה הָתֵל לְבִלְתִּי שַׁלַּח אֶת הָעָם לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “Here, I’m going out from you, and I’ll
pray to YHWH, and the insect swarm will turn away from
Pharaoh and from his servants and from his people
tomorrow. Only let Pharaoh not continue to toy so as not
to let the people go to sacrifice to YHWH.”

translation.text: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go ye, sacrifice to your God in the land.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “Here, I’m going out from you, and I’ll
pray to YHWH, and the insect swarm will turn away from
Pharaoh and from his servants and from his people
tomorrow. Only let Pharaoh not continue to toy so as not
to let the people go to sacrifice to YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא מֹשֶׁה מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה וַיֶּעְתַּר אֶל יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא מֹשֶׁה מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה וַיֶּעְתַּר אֶל יְהֹוָה׃

english.text: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and he prayed to YHWH.

translation.text: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?

verses.english: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and he prayed to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה כִּדְבַר מֹשֶׁה וַיָּסַר הֶעָרֹב מִפַּרְעֹה מֵעֲבָדָיו וּמֵעַמּוֹ לֹא נִשְׁאַר אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה כִּדְבַר מֹשֶׁה וַיָּסַר הֶעָרֹב מִפַּרְעֹה מֵעֲבָדָיו וּמֵעַמּוֹ לֹא נִשְׁאַר אֶחָד׃

english.text:
And YHWH did according to Moses’ word, and the insect
swarm turned away from Pharaoh and from his servants and
from his people. Not one was left.

translation.text: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.

verses.english:
And YHWH did according to Moses’ word, and the insect
swarm turned away from Pharaoh and from his servants and
from his people. Not one was left.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכְבֵּד פַּרְעֹה אֶת לִבּוֹ גַּם בַּפַּעַם הַזֹּאת וְלֹא שִׁלַּח אֶת הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכְבֵּד פַּרְעֹה אֶת לִבּוֹ גַּם בַּפַּעַם הַזֹּאת וְלֹא שִׁלַּח אֶת הָעָם׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh made his heart heavy this time as well, and he
did not let the people go.

translation.text: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness; only ye shall not go very far away: intreat for me.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh made his heart heavy this time as well, and he
did not let the people go.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בֹּא אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִים שַׁלַּח אֶת עַמִּי וְיַעַבְדֻנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בֹּא אֶל פַּרְעֹה וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִים שַׁלַּח אֶת עַמִּי וְיַעַבְדֻנִי׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Come to Pharaoh and speak to
him: ‘YHWH, God of the Hebrews, said this: Let my people
go, so they may serve me.

translation.text: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Come to Pharaoh and speak to
him: ‘YHWH, God of the Hebrews, said this: Let my people
go, so they may serve me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם מָאֵן אַתָּה לְשַׁלֵּחַ וְעוֹדְךָ מַחֲזִיק בָּם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם מָאֵן אַתָּה לְשַׁלֵּחַ וְעוֹדְךָ מַחֲזִיק בָּם׃

english.text:
Because if you refuse to let go and you are still holding
on to them,

translation.text: For if thou refuse to let them go, and wilt hold them still,

verses.english:
Because if you refuse to let go and you are still holding
on to them,

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה יַד יְהֹוָה הוֹיָה בְּמִקְנְךָ אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה בַּסּוּסִים בַּחֲמֹרִים בַּגְּמַלִּים בַּבָּקָר וּבַצֹּאן דֶּבֶר כָּבֵד מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה יַד יְהֹוָה הוֹיָה בְּמִקְנְךָ אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה בַּסּוּסִים בַּחֲמֹרִים בַּגְּמַלִּים בַּבָּקָר וּבַצֹּאן דֶּבֶר כָּבֵד מְאֹד׃

english.text:
here, YHWH’s hand is on your livestock that are in the
field, on the horses, on the asses, on the camels, on the
oxen, and on the flock—a very heavy epidemic.

translation.text: Behold, the hand of the LORD is upon thy cattle which is in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep: there shall be a very grievous murrain.

verses.english:
here, YHWH’s hand is on your livestock that are in the
field, on the horses, on the asses, on the camels, on the
oxen, and on the flock—a very heavy epidemic.

verses.hebrew: וְהִפְלָה יְהֹוָה בֵּין מִקְנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵין מִקְנֵה מִצְרָיִם וְלֹא יָמוּת מִכּל לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: וְהִפְלָה יְהֹוָה בֵּין מִקְנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵין מִקְנֵה מִצְרָיִם וְלֹא יָמוּת מִכּל לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דָּבָר׃

english.text:
And YHWH will distinguish between Israel’s livestock and
Egypt’s livestock, and not a thing out of all that Israel
has will die.

translation.text: And the LORD shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt: and there shall nothing die of all that is the children’s of Israel.

verses.english:
And YHWH will distinguish between Israel’s livestock and
Egypt’s livestock, and not a thing out of all that Israel
has will die.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם יְהֹוָה מוֹעֵד לֵאמֹר מָחָר יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם יְהֹוָה מוֹעֵד לֵאמֹר מָחָר יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And YHWH has set an appointed time, saying: Tomorrow YHWH
will do this thing in the land.’”

translation.text: And the LORD appointed a set time, saying, To morrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.

verses.english:
And YHWH has set an appointed time, saying: Tomorrow YHWH
will do this thing in the land.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה מִמּחֳרָת וַיָּמת כֹּל מִקְנֵה מִצְרָיִם וּמִמִּקְנֵה בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא מֵת אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה מִמּחֳרָת וַיָּמת כֹּל מִקְנֵה מִצְרָיִם וּמִמִּקְנֵה בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא מֵת אֶחָד׃

english.text:
And YHWH did this thing on the next day, and all Egypt’s
livestock died, and of all the livestock of the children
of Israel not one died.

translation.text: And the LORD did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.

verses.english:
And YHWH did this thing on the next day, and all Egypt’s
livestock died, and of all the livestock of the children
of Israel not one died.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח פַּרְעֹה וְהִנֵּה לֹא מֵת מִמִּקְנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד אֶחָד וַיִּכְבַּד לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שִׁלַּח אֶת הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח פַּרְעֹה וְהִנֵּה לֹא מֵת מִמִּקְנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד אֶחָד וַיִּכְבַּד לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שִׁלַּח אֶת הָעָם׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh sent; and, here, not even one of Israel’s
livestock had died. And Pharaoh’s heart was heavy, and he
did not let the people go.

translation.text: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh sent; and, here, not even one of Israel’s
livestock had died. And Pharaoh’s heart was heavy, and he
did not let the people go.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן קְחוּ לָכֶם מְלֹא חפְנֵיכֶם פִּיחַ כִּבְשָׁן וּזְרָקוֹ מֹשֶׁה הַשָּׁמַיְמָה לְעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן קְחוּ לָכֶם מְלֹא חפְנֵיכֶם פִּיחַ כִּבְשָׁן וּזְרָקוֹ מֹשֶׁה הַשָּׁמַיְמָה לְעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses and to Aaron, “Take handfuls of
furnace ash, and let Moses fling it to the skies before
Pharaoh’s eyes.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses and to Aaron, “Take handfuls of
furnace ash, and let Moses fling it to the skies before
Pharaoh’s eyes.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה לְאָבָק עַל כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְהָיָה עַל הָאָדָם וְעַל הַבְּהֵמָה לִשְׁחִין פֹּרֵחַ אֲבַעְבֻּעֹת בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה לְאָבָק עַל כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְהָיָה עַל הָאָדָם וְעַל הַבְּהֵמָה לִשְׁחִין פֹּרֵחַ אֲבַעְבֻּעֹת בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And it will become a powder on all the land of Egypt, and
it will become a boil breaking out in sores on the humans
and on the animals in all the land of Egypt.”

translation.text: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And it will become a powder on all the land of Egypt, and
it will become a boil breaking out in sores on the humans
and on the animals in all the land of Egypt.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת פִּיחַ הַכִּבְשָׁן וַיַּעַמְדוּ לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וַיִּזְרֹק אֹתוֹ מֹשֶׁה הַשָּׁמָיְמָה וַיְהִי שְׁחִין אֲבַעְבֻּעֹת פֹּרֵחַ בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת פִּיחַ הַכִּבְשָׁן וַיַּעַמְדוּ לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וַיִּזְרֹק אֹתוֹ מֹשֶׁה הַשָּׁמָיְמָה וַיְהִי שְׁחִין אֲבַעְבֻּעֹת פֹּרֵחַ בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה׃

english.text:
And they took the furnace ash and stood in front of
Pharaoh, and Moses flung it to the skies, and it was a
boil breaking out in sores in the humans and in the
animals.

translation.text: And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast.

verses.english:
And they took the furnace ash and stood in front of
Pharaoh, and Moses flung it to the skies, and it was a
boil breaking out in sores in the humans and in the
animals.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יָכְלוּ הַחַרְטֻמִּים לַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה מִפְּנֵי הַשְּׁחִין כִּי הָיָה הַשְּׁחִין בַּחַרְטֻמִּם וּבְכל מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יָכְלוּ הַחַרְטֻמִּים לַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה מִפְּנֵי הַשְּׁחִין כִּי הָיָה הַשְּׁחִין בַּחַרְטֻמִּם וּבְכל מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And the magicians were not able to stand in front of Moses
on account of the boil, because the boil was in the
magicians and in all Egypt.

translation.text: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.

verses.english:
And the magicians were not able to stand in front of Moses
on account of the boil, because the boil was in the
magicians and in all Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַזֵּק יְהֹוָה אֶת לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחַזֵּק יְהֹוָה אֶת לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And YHWH strengthened Pharaoh’s heart, and he did not
listen to them—as YHWH had spoken to Moses.

translation.text: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had spoken unto Moses.

verses.english:
And YHWH strengthened Pharaoh’s heart, and he did not
listen to them—as YHWH had spoken to Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הַשְׁכֵּם בַּבֹּקֶר וְהִתְיַצֵּב לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִים שַׁלַּח אֶת עַמִּי וְיַעַבְדֻנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הַשְׁכֵּם בַּבֹּקֶר וְהִתְיַצֵּב לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִים שַׁלַּח אֶת עַמִּי וְיַעַבְדֻנִי׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Get up early in the morning and
stand in front of Pharaoh, and you’ll say to him, ‘YHWH,
God of the Hebrews, said this: Let my people go so they
may serve me.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Get up early in the morning and
stand in front of Pharaoh, and you’ll say to him, ‘YHWH,
God of the Hebrews, said this: Let my people go so they
may serve me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי בַּפַּעַם הַזֹּאת אֲנִי שֹׁלֵחַ אֶת כּל מַגֵּפֹתַי אֶל לִבְּךָ וּבַעֲבָדֶיךָ וּבְעַמֶּךָ בַּעֲבוּר תֵּדַע כִּי אֵין כָּמֹנִי בְּכל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי בַּפַּעַם הַזֹּאת אֲנִי שֹׁלֵחַ אֶת כּל מַגֵּפֹתַי אֶל לִבְּךָ וּבַעֲבָדֶיךָ וּבְעַמֶּךָ בַּעֲבוּר תֵּדַע כִּי אֵין כָּמֹנִי בְּכל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Because this time I am sending all my plagues at your
heart and at your servants and at your people, so that
you’ll know that there is none like me in all the land.

translation.text: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people; that thou mayest know that there is none like me in all the earth.

verses.english:
Because this time I am sending all my plagues at your
heart and at your servants and at your people, so that
you’ll know that there is none like me in all the land.

verses.hebrew: כִּי עַתָּה שָׁלַחְתִּי אֶת יָדִי וָאַךְ אוֹתְךָ וְאֶת עַמְּךָ בַּדָּבֶר וַתִּכָּחֵד מִן הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי עַתָּה שָׁלַחְתִּי אֶת יָדִי וָאַךְ אוֹתְךָ וְאֶת עַמְּךָ בַּדָּבֶר וַתִּכָּחֵד מִן הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Because by now I could have put out my hand and struck you
and your people with an epidemic, and you would have been
obliterated from the land.

translation.text: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.

verses.english:
Because by now I could have put out my hand and struck you
and your people with an epidemic, and you would have been
obliterated from the land.

verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם בַּעֲבוּר זֹאת הֶעֱמַדְתִּיךָ בַּעֲבוּר הַרְאֹתְךָ אֶת כֹּחִי וּלְמַעַן סַפֵּר שְׁמִי בְּכל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְאוּלָם בַּעֲבוּר זֹאת הֶעֱמַדְתִּיךָ בַּעֲבוּר הַרְאֹתְךָ אֶת כֹּחִי וּלְמַעַן סַפֵּר שְׁמִי בְּכל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And in fact I established you for this purpose, for the
purpose of showing you my power—and in order to tell my
name in all the earth.

translation.text: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up, for to shew in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.

verses.english:
And in fact I established you for this purpose, for the
purpose of showing you my power—and in order to tell my
name in all the earth.

verses.hebrew: עוֹדְךָ מִסְתּוֹלֵל בְּעַמִּי לְבִלְתִּי שַׁלְּחָם׃

hebrew.text: עוֹדְךָ מִסְתּוֹלֵל בְּעַמִּי לְבִלְתִּי שַׁלְּחָם׃

english.text:
You are still elevating yourself against my people by not
letting them go.

translation.text: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?

verses.english:
You are still elevating yourself against my people by not
letting them go.

verses.hebrew: הִנְנִי מַמְטִיר כָּעֵת מָחָר בָּרָד כָּבֵד מְאֹד אֲשֶׁר לֹא הָיָה כָמֹהוּ בְּמִצְרַיִם לְמִן הַיּוֹם הִוָּסְדָה וְעַד עָתָּה׃

hebrew.text: הִנְנִי מַמְטִיר כָּעֵת מָחָר בָּרָד כָּבֵד מְאֹד אֲשֶׁר לֹא הָיָה כָמֹהוּ בְּמִצְרַיִם לְמִן הַיּוֹם הִוָּסְדָה וְעַד עָתָּה׃

english.text:
Here, I’ll be showering at this time tomorrow a very heavy
hail, that there hasn’t been one like it in Egypt from the
day of its founding until now.

translation.text: Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now.

verses.english:
Here, I’ll be showering at this time tomorrow a very heavy
hail, that there hasn’t been one like it in Egypt from the
day of its founding until now.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שְׁלַח הָעֵז אֶת מִקְנְךָ וְאֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר לְךָ בַּשָּׂדֶה כּל הָאָדָם וְהַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר יִמָּצֵא בַשָּׂדֶה וְלֹא יֵאָסֵף הַבַּיְתָה וְיָרַד עֲלֵהֶם הַבָּרָד וָמֵתוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שְׁלַח הָעֵז אֶת מִקְנְךָ וְאֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר לְךָ בַּשָּׂדֶה כּל הָאָדָם וְהַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר יִמָּצֵא בַשָּׂדֶה וְלֹא יֵאָסֵף הַבַּיְתָה וְיָרַד עֲלֵהֶם הַבָּרָד וָמֵתוּ׃

english.text:
And now send, protect your livestock and everything that
you have in the field. Every human and animal that will be
found in the field and will not be gathered to the house:
the hail will come down on them, and they’ll die.’”

translation.text: Send therefore now, and gather thy cattle, and all that thou hast in the field; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field, and shall not be brought home, the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.

verses.english:
And now send, protect your livestock and everything that
you have in the field. Every human and animal that will be
found in the field and will not be gathered to the house:
the hail will come down on them, and they’ll die.’”

verses.hebrew: הַיָּרֵא אֶת דְּבַר יְהֹוָה מֵעַבְדֵי פַּרְעֹה הֵנִיס אֶת עֲבָדָיו וְאֶת מִקְנֵהוּ אֶל הַבָּתִּים׃

hebrew.text: הַיָּרֵא אֶת דְּבַר יְהֹוָה מֵעַבְדֵי פַּרְעֹה הֵנִיס אֶת עֲבָדָיו וְאֶת מִקְנֵהוּ אֶל הַבָּתִּים׃

english.text:
Whoever feared YHWH’s word among Pharaoh’s servants had
his servants and his livestock flee to the houses.

translation.text: He that feared the word of the LORD among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:

verses.english:
Whoever feared YHWH’s word among Pharaoh’s servants had
his servants and his livestock flee to the houses.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲשֶׁר לֹא שָׂם לִבּוֹ אֶל דְּבַר יְהֹוָה וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת עֲבָדָיו וְאֶת מִקְנֵהוּ בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲשֶׁר לֹא שָׂם לִבּוֹ אֶל דְּבַר יְהֹוָה וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת עֲבָדָיו וְאֶת מִקְנֵהוּ בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
And whoever did not pay heed to YHWH’s word left his
servants and his livestock in the field.

translation.text: And he that regarded not the word of the LORD left his servants and his cattle in the field.

verses.english:
And whoever did not pay heed to YHWH’s word left his
servants and his livestock in the field.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה נְטֵה אֶת יָדְךָ עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם וִיהִי בָרָד בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם עַל הָאָדָם וְעַל הַבְּהֵמָה וְעַל כּל עֵשֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה נְטֵה אֶת יָדְךָ עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם וִיהִי בָרָד בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם עַל הָאָדָם וְעַל הַבְּהֵמָה וְעַל כּל עֵשֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Reach out your hand at the skies,
and let there be hail in all the land of Egypt: on human
and on animal and on all vegetation of the field in the
land of Egypt.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Reach out your hand at the skies,
and let there be hail in all the land of Egypt: on human
and on animal and on all vegetation of the field in the
land of Egypt.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּט מֹשֶׁה אֶת מַטֵּהוּ עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיהֹוָה נָתַן קֹלֹת וּבָרָד וַתִּהֲלַךְ אֵשׁ אָרְצָה וַיַּמְטֵר יְהֹוָה בָּרָד עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּט מֹשֶׁה אֶת מַטֵּהוּ עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיהֹוָה נָתַן קֹלֹת וּבָרָד וַתִּהֲלַךְ אֵשׁ אָרְצָה וַיַּמְטֵר יְהֹוָה בָּרָד עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Moses reached out his staff at the skies, and YHWH
gave out thunders and hail, and lightning went to the
ground. And YHWH showered hail on the land of Egypt.

translation.text: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the LORD sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And Moses reached out his staff at the skies, and YHWH
gave out thunders and hail, and lightning went to the
ground. And YHWH showered hail on the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בָרָד וְאֵשׁ מִתְלַקַּחַת בְּתוֹךְ הַבָּרָד כָּבֵד מְאֹד אֲשֶׁר לֹא הָיָה כָמֹהוּ בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מֵאָז הָיְתָה לְגוֹי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בָרָד וְאֵשׁ מִתְלַקַּחַת בְּתוֹךְ הַבָּרָד כָּבֵד מְאֹד אֲשֶׁר לֹא הָיָה כָמֹהוּ בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מֵאָז הָיְתָה לְגוֹי׃

english.text:
And it was hail with lightning flashing in the hail, very
heavy, that there had not been anything like it in all the
land of Egypt since the time it became a nation.

translation.text: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.

verses.english:
And it was hail with lightning flashing in the hail, very
heavy, that there had not been anything like it in all the
land of Egypt since the time it became a nation.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ הַבָּרָד בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה מֵאָדָם וְעַד בְּהֵמָה וְאֵת כּל עֵשֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶה הִכָּה הַבָּרָד וְאֶת כּל עֵץ הַשָּׂדֶה שִׁבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּךְ הַבָּרָד בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה מֵאָדָם וְעַד בְּהֵמָה וְאֵת כּל עֵשֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶה הִכָּה הַבָּרָד וְאֶת כּל עֵץ הַשָּׂדֶה שִׁבֵּר׃

english.text:
And the hail struck in all the land of Egypt everything
that was in the field, from human to animal, and the hail
struck all the vegetation of the field and shattered every
tree of the field.

translation.text: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.

verses.english:
And the hail struck in all the land of Egypt everything
that was in the field, from human to animal, and the hail
struck all the vegetation of the field and shattered every
tree of the field.

verses.hebrew: רַק בְּאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן אֲשֶׁר שָׁם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא הָיָה בָּרָד׃

hebrew.text: רַק בְּאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן אֲשֶׁר שָׁם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא הָיָה בָּרָד׃

english.text:
Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel
were, there was no hail.

translation.text: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, was there no hail.

verses.english:
Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel
were, there was no hail.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח פַּרְעֹה וַיִּקְרָא לְמֹשֶׁה וּלְאַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם חָטָאתִי הַפָּעַם יְהֹוָה הַצַּדִּיק וַאֲנִי וְעַמִּי הָרְשָׁעִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח פַּרְעֹה וַיִּקְרָא לְמֹשֶׁה וּלְאַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם חָטָאתִי הַפָּעַם יְהֹוָה הַצַּדִּיק וַאֲנִי וְעַמִּי הָרְשָׁעִים׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh sent and called Moses and Aaron and said to
them, “I sinned this time. YHWH is the virtuous one, and I
and my people are the wicked ones.

translation.text: And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto them, I have sinned this time: the LORD is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh sent and called Moses and Aaron and said to
them, “I sinned this time. YHWH is the virtuous one, and I
and my people are the wicked ones.

verses.hebrew: הַעְתִּירוּ אֶל יְהֹוָה וְרַב מִהְיֹת קֹלֹת אֱלֹהִים וּבָרָד וַאֲשַׁלְּחָה אֶתְכֶם וְלֹא תֹסִפוּן לַעֲמֹד׃

hebrew.text: הַעְתִּירוּ אֶל יְהֹוָה וְרַב מִהְיֹת קֹלֹת אֱלֹהִים וּבָרָד וַאֲשַׁלְּחָה אֶתְכֶם וְלֹא תֹסִפוּן לַעֲמֹד׃

english.text:
Pray to YHWH, and enough of there being God’s thunders and
hail, so I may let you go, and you won’t continue to
stay.”

translation.text: Intreat the LORD (for it is enough) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and ye shall stay no longer.

verses.english:
Pray to YHWH, and enough of there being God’s thunders and
hail, so I may let you go, and you won’t continue to
stay.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מֹשֶׁה כְּצֵאתִי אֶת הָעִיר אֶפְרֹשׂ אֶת כַּפַּי אֶל יְהֹוָה הַקֹּלוֹת יֶחְדָּלוּן וְהַבָּרָד לֹא יִהְיֶה עוֹד לְמַעַן תֵּדַע כִּי לַיהֹוָה הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מֹשֶׁה כְּצֵאתִי אֶת הָעִיר אֶפְרֹשׂ אֶת כַּפַּי אֶל יְהֹוָה הַקֹּלוֹת יֶחְדָּלוּן וְהַבָּרָד לֹא יִהְיֶה עוֹד לְמַעַן תֵּדַע כִּי לַיהֹוָה הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And Moses said to him, “As I go out of the city I’ll
spread my hands to YHWH, the thunders will stop, and the
hail won’t be anymore, so that you’ll know that the earth
is YHWH’s.

translation.text: And Moses said unto him, As soon as I am gone out of the city, I will spread abroad my hands unto the LORD; and the thunder shall cease, neither shall there be any more hail; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the LORD’s.

verses.english:
And Moses said to him, “As I go out of the city I’ll
spread my hands to YHWH, the thunders will stop, and the
hail won’t be anymore, so that you’ll know that the earth
is YHWH’s.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה וַעֲבָדֶיךָ יָדַעְתִּי כִּי טֶרֶם תִּירְאוּן מִפְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה וַעֲבָדֶיךָ יָדַעְתִּי כִּי טֶרֶם תִּירְאוּן מִפְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And you and your servants: I know that you don’t yet fear
in front of YHWH, God.”

translation.text: But as for thee and thy servants, I know that ye will not yet fear the LORD God.

verses.english:
And you and your servants: I know that you don’t yet fear
in front of YHWH, God.”

verses.hebrew: וְהַפִּשְׁתָּה וְהַשְּׂעֹרָה נֻכָּתָה כִּי הַשְּׂעֹרָה אָבִיב וְהַפִּשְׁתָּה גִּבְעֹל׃

( And the flax and the barley were struck, because the

( And the flax and the barley were struck, because the

hebrew.text: וְהַחִטָּה וְהַכֻּסֶּמֶת לֹא נֻכּוּ כִּי אֲפִילֹת הֵנָּה׃

english.text:
And the wheat and the spelt were not struck, because they
were late crops.)

verses.english:
And the wheat and the spelt were not struck, because they
were late crops.)

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא מֹשֶׁה מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה אֶת הָעִיר וַיִּפְרֹשׂ כַּפָּיו אֶל יְהֹוָה וַיַּחְדְּלוּ הַקֹּלוֹת וְהַבָּרָד וּמָטָר לֹא נִתַּךְ אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא מֹשֶׁה מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה אֶת הָעִיר וַיִּפְרֹשׂ כַּפָּיו אֶל יְהֹוָה וַיַּחְדְּלוּ הַקֹּלוֹת וְהַבָּרָד וּמָטָר לֹא נִתַּךְ אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
And Moses went out from Pharaoh, from the city, and spread
his hands to YHWH, and the thunders and the hail stopped,
and a shower did not pour to the earth.

translation.text: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands unto the LORD: and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.

verses.english:
And Moses went out from Pharaoh, from the city, and spread
his hands to YHWH, and the thunders and the hail stopped,
and a shower did not pour to the earth.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא פַּרְעֹה כִּי חָדַל הַמָּטָר וְהַבָּרָד וְהַקֹּלֹת וַיֹּסֶף לַחֲטֹא וַיַּכְבֵּד לִבּוֹ הוּא וַעֲבָדָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא פַּרְעֹה כִּי חָדַל הַמָּטָר וְהַבָּרָד וְהַקֹּלֹת וַיֹּסֶף לַחֲטֹא וַיַּכְבֵּד לִבּוֹ הוּא וַעֲבָדָיו׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh saw that the shower and the hail and the
thunder stopped, and he continued to sin, and he made his
heart heavy, he and his servants.

translation.text: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh saw that the shower and the hail and the
thunder stopped, and he continued to sin, and he made his
heart heavy, he and his servants.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחֱזַק לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שִׁלַּח אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּחֱזַק לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שִׁלַּח אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh’s heart was strong, and he did not let the
children of Israel go—as YHWH had spoken by Moses’ hand.

translation.text: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the children of Israel go; as the LORD had spoken by Moses.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh’s heart was strong, and he did not let the
children of Israel go—as YHWH had spoken by Moses’ hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בֹּא אֶל פַּרְעֹה כִּי אֲנִי הִכְבַּדְתִּי אֶת לִבּוֹ וְאֶת לֵב עֲבָדָיו לְמַעַן שִׁתִי אֹתֹתַי אֵלֶּה בְּקִרְבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בֹּא אֶל פַּרְעֹה כִּי אֲנִי הִכְבַּדְתִּי אֶת לִבּוֹ וְאֶת לֵב עֲבָדָיו לְמַעַן שִׁתִי אֹתֹתַי אֵלֶּה בְּקִרְבּוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Come to Pharaoh, because I have
made his heart and his servants’ heart heavy for the
purpose of my setting these signs of mine among them

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants, that I might shew these my signs before him:

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Come to Pharaoh, because I have
made his heart and his servants’ heart heavy for the
purpose of my setting these signs of mine among them

verses.hebrew: וּלְמַעַן תְּסַפֵּר בְּאזְנֵי בִנְךָ וּבֶן בִּנְךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִתְעַלַּלְתִּי בְּמִצְרַיִם וְאֶת אֹתֹתַי אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי בָם וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַעַן תְּסַפֵּר בְּאזְנֵי בִנְךָ וּבֶן בִּנְךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִתְעַלַּלְתִּי בְּמִצְרַיִם וְאֶת אֹתֹתַי אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי בָם וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and for the purpose that you will tell in the ears of your
son and your son’s son about how I abused Egypt and about
my signs that I set among them, and you will know that I
am YHWH.”

translation.text: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son, and of thy son’s son, what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that ye may know how that I am the LORD.

verses.english:
and for the purpose that you will tell in the ears of your
son and your son’s son about how I abused Egypt and about
my signs that I set among them, and you will know that I
am YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶל פַּרְעֹה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִים עַד מָתַי מֵאַנְתָּ לֵעָנֹת מִפָּנָי שַׁלַּח עַמִּי וְיַעַבְדֻנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶל פַּרְעֹה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִים עַד מָתַי מֵאַנְתָּ לֵעָנֹת מִפָּנָי שַׁלַּח עַמִּי וְיַעַבְדֻנִי׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron came to Pharaoh and said to him,
“YHWH, God of the Hebrews, said this: ‘How long do you
refuse to be humbled in front of me? Let my people go, so
they may serve me.

translation.text: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron came to Pharaoh and said to him,
“YHWH, God of the Hebrews, said this: ‘How long do you
refuse to be humbled in front of me? Let my people go, so
they may serve me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם מָאֵן אַתָּה לְשַׁלֵּחַ אֶת עַמִּי הִנְנִי מֵבִיא מָחָר אַרְבֶּה בִּגְבֻלֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם מָאֵן אַתָּה לְשַׁלֵּחַ אֶת עַמִּי הִנְנִי מֵבִיא מָחָר אַרְבֶּה בִּגְבֻלֶךָ׃

english.text:
Because if you refuse to let my people go, here, I’m
bringing a locust swarm in your border tomorrow,

translation.text: Else, if thou refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast:

verses.english:
Because if you refuse to let my people go, here, I’m
bringing a locust swarm in your border tomorrow,

verses.hebrew: וְכִסָּה אֶת עֵין הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא יוּכַל לִרְאֹת אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְאָכַל אֶת יֶתֶר הַפְּלֵטָה הַנִּשְׁאֶרֶת לָכֶם מִן הַבָּרָד וְאָכַל אֶת כּל הָעֵץ הַצֹּמֵחַ לָכֶם מִן הַשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְכִסָּה אֶת עֵין הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא יוּכַל לִרְאֹת אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְאָכַל אֶת יֶתֶר הַפְּלֵטָה הַנִּשְׁאֶרֶת לָכֶם מִן הַבָּרָד וְאָכַל אֶת כּל הָעֵץ הַצֹּמֵחַ לָכֶם מִן הַשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
and it will cover the eye of the land, and one won’t be
able to see the land! And it will eat the remains of what
has survived that is left to you from the hail, and it
will eat every tree that is growing for you from the
field.

translation.text: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:

verses.english:
and it will cover the eye of the land, and one won’t be
able to see the land! And it will eat the remains of what
has survived that is left to you from the hail, and it
will eat every tree that is growing for you from the
field.

verses.hebrew: וּמָלְאוּ בָתֶּיךָ וּבָתֵּי כל עֲבָדֶיךָ וּבָתֵּי כל מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא רָאוּ אֲבֹתֶיךָ וַאֲבוֹת אֲבֹתֶיךָ מִיּוֹם הֱיוֹתָם עַל הָאֲדָמָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיִּפֶן וַיֵּצֵא מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וּמָלְאוּ בָתֶּיךָ וּבָתֵּי כל עֲבָדֶיךָ וּבָתֵּי כל מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא רָאוּ אֲבֹתֶיךָ וַאֲבוֹת אֲבֹתֶיךָ מִיּוֹם הֱיוֹתָם עַל הָאֲדָמָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיִּפֶן וַיֵּצֵא מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
And they’ll fill your houses and the houses of all your
servants and the houses of all Egypt, which your fathers
and your fathers’ fathers did not see, from the day they
were on the land until this day’.” And he turned and went
out from Pharaoh.

translation.text: And they shall fill thy houses, and the houses of all thy servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians; which neither thy fathers, nor thy fathers’ fathers have seen, since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day. And he turned himself, and went out from Pharaoh.

verses.english:
And they’ll fill your houses and the houses of all your
servants and the houses of all Egypt, which your fathers
and your fathers’ fathers did not see, from the day they
were on the land until this day’.” And he turned and went
out from Pharaoh.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי פַרְעֹה אֵלָיו עַד מָתַי יִהְיֶה זֶה לָנוּ לְמוֹקֵשׁ שַׁלַּח אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים וְיַעַבְדוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הֲטֶרֶם תֵּדַע כִּי אָבְדָה מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי פַרְעֹה אֵלָיו עַד מָתַי יִהְיֶה זֶה לָנוּ לְמוֹקֵשׁ שַׁלַּח אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים וְיַעַבְדוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הֲטֶרֶם תֵּדַע כִּי אָבְדָה מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh’s servants said to him, “How long will this be
a trap for us? Let the people go, so they may serve YHWH,
their God. Don’t you know yet that Egypt has perished?!”

translation.text: And Pharaoh’s servants said unto him, How long shall this man be a snare unto us? let the men go, that they may serve the LORD their God: knowest thou not yet that Egypt is destroyed?

verses.english:
And Pharaoh’s servants said to him, “How long will this be
a trap for us? Let the people go, so they may serve YHWH,
their God. Don’t you know yet that Egypt has perished?!”

verses.hebrew: וַיּוּשַׁב אֶת מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן אֶל פַּרְעֹה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם לְכוּ עִבְדוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מִי וָמִי הַהֹלְכִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוּשַׁב אֶת מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן אֶל פַּרְעֹה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם לְכוּ עִבְדוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מִי וָמִי הַהֹלְכִים׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron were brought back to Pharaoh. And he
said to them, “Go. Serve YHWH, your God. Who are the ones
who are going?”

translation.text: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh: and he said unto them, Go, serve the LORD your God: but who are they that shall go?

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron were brought back to Pharaoh. And he
said to them, “Go. Serve YHWH, your God. Who are the ones
who are going?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה בִּנְעָרֵינוּ וּבִזְקֵנֵינוּ נֵלֵךְ בְּבָנֵינוּ וּבִבְנוֹתֵנוּ בְּצֹאנֵנוּ וּבִבְקָרֵנוּ נֵלֵךְ כִּי חַג יְהֹוָה לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה בִּנְעָרֵינוּ וּבִזְקֵנֵינוּ נֵלֵךְ בְּבָנֵינוּ וּבִבְנוֹתֵנוּ בְּצֹאנֵנוּ וּבִבְקָרֵנוּ נֵלֵךְ כִּי חַג יְהֹוָה לָנוּ׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “We’ll go with our young and with our old,
we’ll go with our sons and with our daughters, with our
sheep and with our oxen, because we have a festival of
YHWH.”

translation.text: And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds will we go; for we must hold a feast unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “We’ll go with our young and with our old,
we’ll go with our sons and with our daughters, with our
sheep and with our oxen, because we have a festival of
YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יְהִי כֵן יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲשַׁלַּח אֶתְכֶם וְאֶת טַפְּכֶם רְאוּ כִּי רָעָה נֶגֶד פְּנֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יְהִי כֵן יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲשַׁלַּח אֶתְכֶם וְאֶת טַפְּכֶם רְאוּ כִּי רָעָה נֶגֶד פְּנֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And he said to them, “YHWH would be with you like that,
when I would let you and your infants go, see, because bad
is in front of your faces.

translation.text: And he said unto them, Let the LORD be so with you, as I will let you go, and your little ones: look to it; for evil is before you.

verses.english:
And he said to them, “YHWH would be with you like that,
when I would let you and your infants go, see, because bad
is in front of your faces.

verses.hebrew: לֹא כֵן לְכוּ נָא הַגְּבָרִים וְעִבְדוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה כִּי אֹתָהּ אַתֶּם מְבַקְשִׁים וַיְגָרֶשׁ אֹתָם מֵאֵת פְּנֵי פַרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא כֵן לְכוּ נָא הַגְּבָרִים וְעִבְדוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה כִּי אֹתָהּ אַתֶּם מְבַקְשִׁים וַיְגָרֶשׁ אֹתָם מֵאֵת פְּנֵי פַרְעֹה׃

english.text:
It is not like that. Go—the men!—and serve YHWH, because
that is what you’re asking.” And he drove them out from
Pharaoh’s face.

translation.text: Not so: go now ye that are men, and serve the LORD; for that ye did desire. And they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.

verses.english:
It is not like that. Go—the men!—and serve YHWH, because
that is what you’re asking.” And he drove them out from
Pharaoh’s face.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה נְטֵה יָדְךָ עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בָּאַרְבֶּה וְיַעַל עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְיֹאכַל אֶת כּל עֵשֶׂב הָאָרֶץ אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁאִיר הַבָּרָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה נְטֵה יָדְךָ עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בָּאַרְבֶּה וְיַעַל עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְיֹאכַל אֶת כּל עֵשֶׂב הָאָרֶץ אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁאִיר הַבָּרָד׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Reach out your hand at the land
of Egypt for the locust, and it will come up on the land
of Egypt and eat all the land’s vegetation, everything
that the hail has left.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail hath left.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Reach out your hand at the land
of Egypt for the locust, and it will come up on the land
of Egypt and eat all the land’s vegetation, everything
that the hail has left.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּט מֹשֶׁה אֶת מַטֵּהוּ עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיהֹוָה נִהַג רוּחַ קָדִים בָּאָרֶץ כּל הַיּוֹם הַהוּא וְכל הַלָּיְלָה הַבֹּקֶר הָיָה וְרוּחַ הַקָּדִים נָשָׂא אֶת הָאַרְבֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּט מֹשֶׁה אֶת מַטֵּהוּ עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיהֹוָה נִהַג רוּחַ קָדִים בָּאָרֶץ כּל הַיּוֹם הַהוּא וְכל הַלָּיְלָה הַבֹּקֶר הָיָה וְרוּחַ הַקָּדִים נָשָׂא אֶת הָאַרְבֶּה׃

english.text:
And Moses reached out his staff at the land of Egypt, and
YHWH drove an east wind through the land all that day and
all the night. It was the morning: and the east wind had
carried the locust swarm.

translation.text: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.

verses.english:
And Moses reached out his staff at the land of Egypt, and
YHWH drove an east wind through the land all that day and
all the night. It was the morning: and the east wind had
carried the locust swarm.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל הָאַרְבֶּה עַל כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיָּנַח בְּכֹל גְּבוּל מִצְרָיִם כָּבֵד מְאֹד לְפָנָיו לֹא הָיָה כֵן אַרְבֶּה כָּמֹהוּ וְאַחֲרָיו לֹא יִהְיֶה כֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל הָאַרְבֶּה עַל כּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיָּנַח בְּכֹל גְּבוּל מִצְרָיִם כָּבֵד מְאֹד לְפָנָיו לֹא הָיָה כֵן אַרְבֶּה כָּמֹהוּ וְאַחֲרָיו לֹא יִהְיֶה כֵּן׃

english.text:
And the locust swarm came up over all the land of Egypt
and lingered in all of Egypt’s border, very heavy: before
it there was no such locust swarm like it, and after it
there will not be such.

translation.text: And the locust went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the coasts of Egypt: very grievous were they; before them there were no such locusts as they, neither after them shall be such.

verses.english:
And the locust swarm came up over all the land of Egypt
and lingered in all of Egypt’s border, very heavy: before
it there was no such locust swarm like it, and after it
there will not be such.

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַס אֶת עֵין כּל הָאָרֶץ וַתֶּחְשַׁךְ הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאכַל אֶת כּל עֵשֶׂב הָאָרֶץ וְאֵת כּל פְּרִי הָעֵץ אֲשֶׁר הוֹתִיר הַבָּרָד וְלֹא נוֹתַר כּל יֶרֶק בָּעֵץ וּבְעֵשֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶה בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְכַס אֶת עֵין כּל הָאָרֶץ וַתֶּחְשַׁךְ הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאכַל אֶת כּל עֵשֶׂב הָאָרֶץ וְאֵת כּל פְּרִי הָעֵץ אֲשֶׁר הוֹתִיר הַבָּרָד וְלֹא נוֹתַר כּל יֶרֶק בָּעֵץ וּבְעֵשֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶה בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And it covered the eye of all the land, and the land was
dark; and it ate all the land’s vegetation and the fruit
of every tree that the hail had left, and not any plant
was left, in the tree and in the field’s vegetation, in
all the land of Egypt.

translation.text: For they covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened; and they did eat every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left: and there remained not any green thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And it covered the eye of all the land, and the land was
dark; and it ate all the land’s vegetation and the fruit
of every tree that the hail had left, and not any plant
was left, in the tree and in the field’s vegetation, in
all the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֵר פַּרְעֹה לִקְרֹא לְמֹשֶׁה וּלְאַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר חָטָאתִי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְלָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַהֵר פַּרְעֹה לִקְרֹא לְמֹשֶׁה וּלְאַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר חָטָאתִי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְלָכֶם׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh hurried to call Moses and Aaron, and he said,
“I’ve sinned against YHWH, your God, and against you.

translation.text: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and he said, I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh hurried to call Moses and Aaron, and he said,
“I’ve sinned against YHWH, your God, and against you.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שָׂא נָא חַטָּאתִי אַךְ הַפַּעַם וְהַעְתִּירוּ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְיָסֵר מֵעָלַי רַק אֶת הַמָּוֶת הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שָׂא נָא חַטָּאתִי אַךְ הַפַּעַם וְהַעְתִּירוּ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְיָסֵר מֵעָלַי רַק אֶת הַמָּוֶת הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And now, bear my sin just this one time and pray to YHWH,
your God, that He’ll turn just this death away from me.”

translation.text: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and intreat the LORD your God, that he may take away from me this death only.

verses.english:
And now, bear my sin just this one time and pray to YHWH,
your God, that He’ll turn just this death away from me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה וַיֶּעְתַּר אֶל יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה וַיֶּעְתַּר אֶל יְהֹוָה׃

english.text: And he went out from Pharaoh and prayed to YHWH,

translation.text: And he went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.

verses.english: And he went out from Pharaoh and prayed to YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּהֲפֹךְ יְהֹוָה רוּחַ יָם חָזָק מְאֹד וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת הָאַרְבֶּה וַיִּתְקָעֵהוּ יָמָּה סּוּף לֹא נִשְׁאַר אַרְבֶּה אֶחָד בְּכֹל גְּבוּל מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּהֲפֹךְ יְהֹוָה רוּחַ יָם חָזָק מְאֹד וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת הָאַרְבֶּה וַיִּתְקָעֵהוּ יָמָּה סּוּף לֹא נִשְׁאַר אַרְבֶּה אֶחָד בְּכֹל גְּבוּל מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
and YHWH turned back a very strong west wind, and it
picked up the locust swarm and blew it to the Red Sea. Not
one locust was left in all of Egypt’s border.

translation.text: And the LORD turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts, and cast them into the Red sea; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt.

verses.english:
and YHWH turned back a very strong west wind, and it
picked up the locust swarm and blew it to the Red Sea. Not
one locust was left in all of Egypt’s border.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַזֵּק יְהֹוָה אֶת לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שִׁלַּח אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחַזֵּק יְהֹוָה אֶת לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שִׁלַּח אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And YHWH strengthened Pharaoh’s heart, and he did not let
the children of Israel go.

translation.text: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go.

verses.english:
And YHWH strengthened Pharaoh’s heart, and he did not let
the children of Israel go.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה נְטֵה יָדְךָ עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם וִיהִי חֹשֶׁךְ עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְיָמֵשׁ חֹשֶׁךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה נְטֵה יָדְךָ עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם וִיהִי חֹשֶׁךְ עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְיָמֵשׁ חֹשֶׁךְ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Reach out your hand at the skies,
and let there be darkness on the land of Egypt, and one
will feel darkness.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Reach out your hand at the skies,
and let there be darkness on the land of Egypt, and one
will feel darkness.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּט מֹשֶׁה אֶת יָדוֹ עַל הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיְהִי חֹשֶׁךְ אֲפֵלָה בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּט מֹשֶׁה אֶת יָדוֹ עַל הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיְהִי חֹשֶׁךְ אֲפֵלָה בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים׃

english.text:
And Moses reached out his hand at the skies, and there was
dismal darkness in all the land of Egypt—three days.

translation.text: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:

verses.english:
And Moses reached out his hand at the skies, and there was
dismal darkness in all the land of Egypt—three days.

verses.hebrew: לֹא רָאוּ אִישׁ אֶת אָחִיו וְלֹא קָמוּ אִישׁ מִתַּחְתָּיו שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וּלְכל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיָה אוֹר בְּמוֹשְׁבֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא רָאוּ אִישׁ אֶת אָחִיו וְלֹא קָמוּ אִישׁ מִתַּחְתָּיו שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וּלְכל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיָה אוֹר בְּמוֹשְׁבֹתָם׃

english.text:
Each man did not see his brother, and each man did not get
up from under it—three days. And for all the children of
Israel there was light in their homes.

translation.text: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

verses.english:
Each man did not see his brother, and each man did not get
up from under it—three days. And for all the children of
Israel there was light in their homes.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא פַרְעֹה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר לְכוּ עִבְדוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה רַק צֹאנְכֶם וּבְקַרְכֶם יֻצָּג גַּם טַפְּכֶם יֵלֵךְ עִמָּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא פַרְעֹה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר לְכוּ עִבְדוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה רַק צֹאנְכֶם וּבְקַרְכֶם יֻצָּג גַּם טַפְּכֶם יֵלֵךְ עִמָּכֶם׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh called Moses, and he said, “Go. Serve YHWH.
Only your sheep and your oxen will stay put. Your infants
will go with you as well.”

translation.text: And Pharaoh called unto Moses, and said, Go ye, serve the LORD; only let your flocks and your herds be stayed: let your little ones also go with you.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh called Moses, and he said, “Go. Serve YHWH.
Only your sheep and your oxen will stay put. Your infants
will go with you as well.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה גַּם אַתָּה תִּתֵּן בְּיָדֵנוּ זְבָחִים וְעֹלֹת וְעָשִׂינוּ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה גַּם אַתָּה תִּתֵּן בְּיָדֵנוּ זְבָחִים וְעֹלֹת וְעָשִׂינוּ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “You shall put sacrifices and offerings in
our hand as well, so we’ll do them for YHWH, our God.

translation.text: And Moses said, Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice unto the LORD our God.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “You shall put sacrifices and offerings in
our hand as well, so we’ll do them for YHWH, our God.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם מִקְנֵנוּ יֵלֵךְ עִמָּנוּ לֹא תִשָּׁאֵר פַּרְסָה כִּי מִמֶּנּוּ נִקַּח לַעֲבֹד אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַאֲנַחְנוּ לֹא נֵדַע מַה נַּעֲבֹד אֶת יְהֹוָה עַד בֹּאֵנוּ שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם מִקְנֵנוּ יֵלֵךְ עִמָּנוּ לֹא תִשָּׁאֵר פַּרְסָה כִּי מִמֶּנּוּ נִקַּח לַעֲבֹד אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַאֲנַחְנוּ לֹא נֵדַע מַה נַּעֲבֹד אֶת יְהֹוָה עַד בֹּאֵנוּ שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And our livestock will go with us as well. Not a hoof will
be left. Because we’ll take from it to serve YHWH, our
God, and we won’t know how we’ll serve YHWH until we come
there.”

translation.text: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left behind; for thereof must we take to serve the LORD our God; and we know not with what we must serve the LORD, until we come thither.

verses.english:
And our livestock will go with us as well. Not a hoof will
be left. Because we’ll take from it to serve YHWH, our
God, and we won’t know how we’ll serve YHWH until we come
there.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַזֵּק יְהֹוָה אֶת לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא אָבָה לְשַׁלְּחָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחַזֵּק יְהֹוָה אֶת לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא אָבָה לְשַׁלְּחָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH strengthened Pharaoh’s heart, and he was not
willing to let them go.

translation.text: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not let them go.

verses.english:
And YHWH strengthened Pharaoh’s heart, and he was not
willing to let them go.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ פַרְעֹה לֵךְ מֵעָלָי הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ אַל תֹּסֶף רְאוֹת פָּנַי כִּי בְּיוֹם רְאֹתְךָ פָנַי תָּמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ פַרְעֹה לֵךְ מֵעָלָי הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ אַל תֹּסֶף רְאוֹת פָּנַי כִּי בְּיוֹם רְאֹתְךָ פָנַי תָּמוּת׃

english.text:
And Pharaoh said to him, “Go away from me! Watch yourself!
Don’t continue to see my face. Because in the day you see
my face you’ll die!”

translation.text: And Pharaoh said unto him, Get thee from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die.

verses.english:
And Pharaoh said to him, “Go away from me! Watch yourself!
Don’t continue to see my face. Because in the day you see
my face you’ll die!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה כֵּן דִּבַּרְתָּ לֹא אֹסִף עוֹד רְאוֹת פָּנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה כֵּן דִּבַּרְתָּ לֹא אֹסִף עוֹד רְאוֹת פָּנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “So you’ve spoken: I won’t continue to see
your face anymore.”

translation.text: And Moses said, Thou hast spoken well, I will see thy face again no more.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “So you’ve spoken: I won’t continue to see
your face anymore.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עוֹד נֶגַע אֶחָד אָבִיא עַל פַּרְעֹה וְעַל מִצְרַיִם אַחֲרֵי כֵן יְשַׁלַּח אֶתְכֶם מִזֶּה כְּשַׁלְּחוֹ כָּלָה גָּרֵשׁ יְגָרֵשׁ אֶתְכֶם מִזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עוֹד נֶגַע אֶחָד אָבִיא עַל פַּרְעֹה וְעַל מִצְרַיִם אַחֲרֵי כֵן יְשַׁלַּח אֶתְכֶם מִזֶּה כְּשַׁלְּחוֹ כָּלָה גָּרֵשׁ יְגָרֵשׁ אֶתְכֶם מִזֶּה׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “I’ll bring one more plague on
Pharaoh and on Egypt. After that he’ll let you go from
here. When he lets go completely he’ll drive you out from
here!

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence: when he shall let you go, he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “I’ll bring one more plague on
Pharaoh and on Egypt. After that he’ll let you go from
here. When he lets go completely he’ll drive you out from
here!

verses.hebrew: דַּבֶּר נָא בְּאזְנֵי הָעָם וְיִשְׁאֲלוּ אִישׁ מֵאֵת רֵעֵהוּ וְאִשָּׁה מֵאֵת רְעוּתָהּ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֶּר נָא בְּאזְנֵי הָעָם וְיִשְׁאֲלוּ אִישׁ מֵאֵת רֵעֵהוּ וְאִשָּׁה מֵאֵת רְעוּתָהּ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב׃

english.text:
Speak in the people’s ears that each man will ask of his
neighbor and each woman of her neighbor items of silver
and items of gold.”

translation.text: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow of his neighbour, and every woman of her neighbour, jewels of silver and jewels of gold.

verses.english:
Speak in the people’s ears that each man will ask of his
neighbor and each woman of her neighbor items of silver
and items of gold.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת חֵן הָעָם בְּעֵינֵי מִצְרָיִם גַּם הָאִישׁ מֹשֶׁה גָּדוֹל מְאֹד בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּעֵינֵי עַבְדֵי פַרְעֹה וּבְעֵינֵי הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת חֵן הָעָם בְּעֵינֵי מִצְרָיִם גַּם הָאִישׁ מֹשֶׁה גָּדוֹל מְאֹד בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּעֵינֵי עַבְדֵי פַרְעֹה וּבְעֵינֵי הָעָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH put the people’s favor in the Egyptians’ eyes.
Also, the man Moses was very big in the land of Egypt in
the eyes of Pharaoh’s servants and in the people’s eyes.

translation.text: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians.

verses.english:
And YHWH put the people’s favor in the Egyptians’ eyes.
Also, the man Moses was very big in the land of Egypt in
the eyes of Pharaoh’s servants and in the people’s eyes.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה כַּחֲצֹת הַלַּיְלָה אֲנִי יוֹצֵא בְּתוֹךְ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה כַּחֲצֹת הַלַּיְלָה אֲנִי יוֹצֵא בְּתוֹךְ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “YHWH said this: In the middle of the
night I am going out through Egypt,

translation.text: And Moses said, Thus saith the LORD, About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:

verses.english:
And Moses said, “YHWH said this: In the middle of the
night I am going out through Egypt,

verses.hebrew: וּמֵת כּל בְּכוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבְּכוֹר פַּרְעֹה הַיֹּשֵׁב עַל כִּסְאוֹ עַד בְּכוֹר הַשִּׁפְחָה אֲשֶׁר אַחַר הָרֵחָיִם וְכֹל בְּכוֹר בְּהֵמָה׃

hebrew.text: וּמֵת כּל בְּכוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבְּכוֹר פַּרְעֹה הַיֹּשֵׁב עַל כִּסְאוֹ עַד בְּכוֹר הַשִּׁפְחָה אֲשֶׁר אַחַר הָרֵחָיִם וְכֹל בְּכוֹר בְּהֵמָה׃

english.text:
and every firstborn in the land of Egypt will die, from
the firstborn of Pharaoh who is sitting on his throne to
the firstborn of the maid who is behind the mill and every
firstborn of an animal.

translation.text: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the first born of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.

verses.english:
and every firstborn in the land of Egypt will die, from
the firstborn of Pharaoh who is sitting on his throne to
the firstborn of the maid who is behind the mill and every
firstborn of an animal.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה צְעָקָה גְדֹלָה בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲשֶׁר כָּמֹהוּ לֹא נִהְיָתָה וְכָמֹהוּ לֹא תֹסִף׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה צְעָקָה גְדֹלָה בְּכל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲשֶׁר כָּמֹהוּ לֹא נִהְיָתָה וְכָמֹהוּ לֹא תֹסִף׃

english.text:
And there will be a big cry in all the land of Egypt, that
there has been none like it and there won’t continue to be
like it.

translation.text: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.

verses.english:
And there will be a big cry in all the land of Egypt, that
there has been none like it and there won’t continue to be
like it.

verses.hebrew: וּלְכֹל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יֶחֱרַץ כֶּלֶב לְשֹׁנוֹ לְמֵאִישׁ וְעַד בְּהֵמָה לְמַעַן תֵּדְעוּן אֲשֶׁר יַפְלֶה יְהֹוָה בֵּין מִצְרַיִם וּבֵין יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּלְכֹל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יֶחֱרַץ כֶּלֶב לְשֹׁנוֹ לְמֵאִישׁ וְעַד בְּהֵמָה לְמַעַן תֵּדְעוּן אֲשֶׁר יַפְלֶה יְהֹוָה בֵּין מִצְרַיִם וּבֵין יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
