translation.text: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.

verses.english:
And the waters went back and covered the chariots and the
horsemen—all of Pharaoh’s army who were coming after them
in the sea. Not even one of them was left.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָלְכוּ בַיַּבָּשָׁה בְּתוֹךְ הַיָּם וְהַמַּיִם לָהֶם חֹמָה מִימִינָם וּמִשְּׂמֹאלָם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָלְכוּ בַיַּבָּשָׁה בְּתוֹךְ הַיָּם וְהַמַּיִם לָהֶם חֹמָה מִימִינָם וּמִשְּׂמֹאלָם׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel had gone on the dry ground
through the sea, and the water had been a wall to them at
their right and at their left.

translation.text: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel had gone on the dry ground
through the sea, and the water had been a wall to them at
their right and at their left.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹשַׁע יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד מִצְרָיִם וַיַּרְא יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת מִצְרַיִם מֵת עַל שְׂפַת הַיָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹשַׁע יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד מִצְרָיִם וַיַּרְא יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת מִצְרַיִם מֵת עַל שְׂפַת הַיָּם׃

english.text:
And YHWH saved Israel from Egypt’s hand that day. And
Israel saw Egypt dead on the seashore,

translation.text: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.

verses.english:
And YHWH saved Israel from Egypt’s hand that day. And
Israel saw Egypt dead on the seashore,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַיָּד הַגְּדֹלָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה בְּמִצְרַיִם וַיִּירְאוּ הָעָם אֶת יְהֹוָה וַיַּאֲמִינוּ בַּיהֹוָה וּבְמֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַיָּד הַגְּדֹלָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה בְּמִצְרַיִם וַיִּירְאוּ הָעָם אֶת יְהֹוָה וַיַּאֲמִינוּ בַּיהֹוָה וּבְמֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ׃

english.text:
and Israel saw the big hand that YHWH had used against
Egypt, and the people feared YHWH, and they trusted in
YHWH and in Moses His servant.

translation.text: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the LORD, and believed the LORD, and his servant Moses.

verses.english:
and Israel saw the big hand that YHWH had used against
Egypt, and the people feared YHWH, and they trusted in
YHWH and in Moses His servant.

verses.hebrew:
אָז יָשִׁיר מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת לַיהֹוָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֵאמֹר

אָשִׁירָה לַיהֹוָה כִּי גָאֹה גָּאָה סוּס וְרֹכְבוֹ רָמָה בַיָּם׃

hebrew.text: אָז יָשִׁיר מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת לַיהֹוָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֵאמֹר
אָשִׁירָה לַיהֹוָה כִּי גָאֹה גָּאָה סוּס וְרֹכְבוֹ רָמָה בַיָּם׃

english.text:
Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to
YHWH. And they said, saying:

Let me sing to YHWH, for He triumphed! Horse and its
rider He cast in the sea.

translation.text: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying,
I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

verses.english:
Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to
YHWH. And they said, saying:

Let me sing to YHWH, for He triumphed! Horse and its
rider He cast in the sea.
verses.translation: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

verses.hebrew: עזִּי וְזִמְרָת יָהּ וַיְהִי לִי לִישׁוּעָה זֶה אֵלִי וְאַנְוֵהוּ אֱלֹהֵי אָבִי וַאֲרֹמְמֶנְהוּ׃

hebrew.text: עזִּי וְזִמְרָת יָהּ וַיְהִי לִי לִישׁוּעָה זֶה אֵלִי וְאַנְוֵהוּ אֱלֹהֵי אָבִי וַאֲרֹמְמֶנְהוּ׃

english.text:
My strength and song are Yah, and He became a salvation
for me. This is my God, and I’ll praise Him, my father’s
God, and I’ll hail Him.

translation.text: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

verses.english:
My strength and song are Yah, and He became a salvation
for me. This is my God, and I’ll praise Him, my father’s
God, and I’ll hail Him.

verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה יְהֹוָה שְׁמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה יְהֹוָה שְׁמוֹ׃

english.text: YHWH is a warrior. YHWH is His name.

translation.text: The LORD is a man of war: the LORD is his name.

verses.english: YHWH is a warrior. YHWH is His name.

verses.hebrew: מַרְכְּבֹת פַּרְעֹה וְחֵילוֹ יָרָה בַיָּם וּמִבְחַר שָׁלִשָׁיו טֻבְּעוּ בְיַם סוּף׃

hebrew.text: מַרְכְּבֹת פַּרְעֹה וְחֵילוֹ יָרָה בַיָּם וּמִבְחַר שָׁלִשָׁיו טֻבְּעוּ בְיַם סוּף׃

english.text:
Pharaoh’s chariots and his army He plunged in the sea and
the choice of his troops drowned in the Red Sea.

translation.text: Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.

verses.english:
Pharaoh’s chariots and his army He plunged in the sea and
the choice of his troops drowned in the Red Sea.

verses.hebrew: תְּהֹמֹת יְכַסְיֻמוּ יָרְדוּ בִמְצוֹלֹת כְּמוֹ אָבֶן׃

hebrew.text: תְּהֹמֹת יְכַסְיֻמוּ יָרְדוּ בִמְצוֹלֹת כְּמוֹ אָבֶן׃

english.text:
The deeps covered them. They sank in the depths like a
stone.

translation.text: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.

verses.english:
The deeps covered them. They sank in the depths like a
stone.

verses.hebrew: יְמִינְךָ יְהֹוָה נֶאְדָּרִי בַּכֹּחַ יְמִינְךָ יְהֹוָה תִּרְעַץ אוֹיֵב׃

hebrew.text: יְמִינְךָ יְהֹוָה נֶאְדָּרִי בַּכֹּחַ יְמִינְךָ יְהֹוָה תִּרְעַץ אוֹיֵב׃

english.text:
Your right hand, YHWH, awesome in power, your right hand,
YHWH, crushed the foe.

translation.text: Thy right hand, O LORD, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O LORD, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.

verses.english:
Your right hand, YHWH, awesome in power, your right hand,
YHWH, crushed the foe.

verses.hebrew: וּבְרֹב גְּאוֹנְךָ תַּהֲרֹס קָמֶיךָ תְּשַׁלַּח חֲרֹנְךָ יֹאכְלֵמוֹ כַּקַּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְרֹב גְּאוֹנְךָ תַּהֲרֹס קָמֶיךָ תְּשַׁלַּח חֲרֹנְךָ יֹאכְלֵמוֹ כַּקַּשׁ׃

english.text:
And in your triumph’s greatness you threw down your
adversaries. You let go your fury: it consumed them like
straw.

translation.text: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.

verses.english:
And in your triumph’s greatness you threw down your
adversaries. You let go your fury: it consumed them like
straw.

verses.hebrew: וּבְרוּחַ אַפֶּיךָ נֶעֶרְמוּ מַיִם נִצְּבוּ כְמוֹ נֵד נֹזְלִים קָפְאוּ תְהֹמֹת בְּלֶב יָם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְרוּחַ אַפֶּיךָ נֶעֶרְמוּ מַיִם נִצְּבוּ כְמוֹ נֵד נֹזְלִים קָפְאוּ תְהֹמֹת בְּלֶב יָם׃

english.text:
And by wind from your nostrils water was massed, surf
piled up like a heap, the deeps congealed in the heart of
the sea.

translation.text: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.

verses.english:
And by wind from your nostrils water was massed, surf
piled up like a heap, the deeps congealed in the heart of
the sea.

verses.hebrew: אָמַר אוֹיֵב אֶרְדֹּף אַשִּׂיג אֲחַלֵּק שָׁלָל תִּמְלָאֵמוֹ נַפְשִׁי אָרִיק חַרְבִּי תּוֹרִישֵׁמוֹ יָדִי׃

hebrew.text: אָמַר אוֹיֵב אֶרְדֹּף אַשִּׂיג אֲחַלֵּק שָׁלָל תִּמְלָאֵמוֹ נַפְשִׁי אָרִיק חַרְבִּי תּוֹרִישֵׁמוֹ יָדִי׃

english.text:
The enemy said, “I’ll pursue! I’ll catch up! I’ll divide
spoil! My soul will be sated! I’ll unsheathe my sword! My
hand will deprive them!”

translation.text: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.

verses.english:
The enemy said, “I’ll pursue! I’ll catch up! I’ll divide
spoil! My soul will be sated! I’ll unsheathe my sword! My
hand will deprive them!”

verses.hebrew: נָשַׁפְתָּ בְרוּחֲךָ כִּסָּמוֹ יָם צָלְלוּ כַּעוֹפֶרֶת בְּמַיִם אַדִּירִים׃

hebrew.text: נָשַׁפְתָּ בְרוּחֲךָ כִּסָּמוֹ יָם צָלְלוּ כַּעוֹפֶרֶת בְּמַיִם אַדִּירִים׃

english.text:
You blew with your wind. Sea covered them. They sank like
lead in the awesome water.

translation.text: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.

verses.english:
You blew with your wind. Sea covered them. They sank like
lead in the awesome water.

verses.hebrew: מִי כָמֹכָה בָּאֵלִם יְהֹוָה מִי כָּמֹכָה נֶאְדָּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ נוֹרָא תְהִלֹּת עֹשֵׂה פֶלֶא׃

hebrew.text: מִי כָמֹכָה בָּאֵלִם יְהֹוָה מִי כָּמֹכָה נֶאְדָּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ נוֹרָא תְהִלֹּת עֹשֵׂה פֶלֶא׃

english.text:
Who is like you among the gods, YHWH! Who is like you:
awesome in holiness! fearsome with splendors! making
miracles!

translation.text: Who is like unto thee, O LORD, among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

verses.english:
Who is like you among the gods, YHWH! Who is like you:
awesome in holiness! fearsome with splendors! making
miracles!

verses.hebrew: נָטִיתָ יְמִינְךָ תִּבְלָעֵמוֹ אָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: נָטִיתָ יְמִינְךָ תִּבְלָעֵמוֹ אָרֶץ׃

english.text: You reached your right hand: earth swallowed them.

translation.text: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.

verses.english: You reached your right hand: earth swallowed them.

verses.hebrew: נָחִיתָ בְחַסְדְּךָ עַם זוּ גָּאָלְתָּ נֵהַלְתָּ בְעזְּךָ אֶל נְוֵה קדְשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: נָחִיתָ בְחַסְדְּךָ עַם זוּ גָּאָלְתָּ נֵהַלְתָּ בְעזְּךָ אֶל נְוֵה קדְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
You led, in your kindness, the people you redeemed; you
ushered, in your strength, to your holy abode.

translation.text: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.

verses.english:
You led, in your kindness, the people you redeemed; you
ushered, in your strength, to your holy abode.

verses.hebrew: שָׁמְעוּ עַמִּים יִרְגָּזוּן חִיל אָחַז יֹשְׁבֵי פְּלָשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: שָׁמְעוּ עַמִּים יִרְגָּזוּן חִיל אָחַז יֹשְׁבֵי פְּלָשֶׁת׃

english.text:
Peoples heard—they shuddered. Shaking seized Philistia’s
residents.

translation.text: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.

verses.english:
Peoples heard—they shuddered. Shaking seized Philistia’s
residents.

verses.hebrew: אָז נִבְהֲלוּ אַלּוּפֵי אֱדוֹם אֵילֵי מוֹאָב יֹאחֲזֵמוֹ רָעַד נָמֹגוּ כֹּל יֹשְׁבֵי כְנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: אָז נִבְהֲלוּ אַלּוּפֵי אֱדוֹם אֵילֵי מוֹאָב יֹאחֲזֵמוֹ רָעַד נָמֹגוּ כֹּל יֹשְׁבֵי כְנָעַן׃

english.text:
Then Edom’s chiefs were terrified. Moab’s chieftains:
trembling seized them. All Canaan’s residents melted.

translation.text: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.

verses.english:
Then Edom’s chiefs were terrified. Moab’s chieftains:
trembling seized them. All Canaan’s residents melted.

verses.hebrew: תִּפֹּל עֲלֵיהֶם אֵימָתָה וָפַחַד בִּגְדֹל זְרוֹעֲךָ יִדְּמוּ כָּאָבֶן עַד יַעֲבֹר עַמְּךָ יְהֹוָה עַד יַעֲבֹר עַם זוּ קָנִיתָ׃

hebrew.text: תִּפֹּל עֲלֵיהֶם אֵימָתָה וָפַחַד בִּגְדֹל זְרוֹעֲךָ יִדְּמוּ כָּאָבֶן עַד יַעֲבֹר עַמְּךָ יְהֹוָה עַד יַעֲבֹר עַם זוּ קָנִיתָ׃

english.text:
Terror and fear came over them. At the power of your arm
they’re silent like stone. ’Til your people passed, YHWH,
’til the people you created passed.

translation.text: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O LORD, till the people pass over, which thou hast purchased.

verses.english:
Terror and fear came over them. At the power of your arm
they’re silent like stone. ’Til your people passed, YHWH,
’til the people you created passed.

verses.hebrew: תְּבִאֵמוֹ וְתִטָּעֵמוֹ בְּהַר נַחֲלָתְךָ מָכוֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ פָּעַלְתָּ יְהֹוָה מִקְּדָשׁ אֲדֹנָי כּוֹנְנוּ יָדֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: תְּבִאֵמוֹ וְתִטָּעֵמוֹ בְּהַר נַחֲלָתְךָ מָכוֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ פָּעַלְתָּ יְהֹוָה מִקְּדָשׁ אֲדֹנָי כּוֹנְנוּ יָדֶיךָ׃

english.text:
You’ll bring them and plant them in your legacy’s
mountain, your throne’s platform, that you made, YHWH; a
holy place, Lord, that your hands reared.

translation.text: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, in the place, O LORD, which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O LORD, which thy hands have established.

verses.english:
You’ll bring them and plant them in your legacy’s
mountain, your throne’s platform, that you made, YHWH; a
holy place, Lord, that your hands reared.

verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד׃

english.text: YHWH will reign forever and ever!

translation.text: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.

verses.english: YHWH will reign forever and ever!

verses.hebrew: כִּי בָא סוּס פַּרְעֹה בְּרִכְבּוֹ וּבְפָרָשָׁיו בַּיָּם וַיָּשֶׁב יְהֹוָה עֲלֵהֶם אֶת מֵי הַיָּם וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָלְכוּ בַיַּבָּשָׁה בְּתוֹךְ הַיָּם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי בָא סוּס פַּרְעֹה בְּרִכְבּוֹ וּבְפָרָשָׁיו בַּיָּם וַיָּשֶׁב יְהֹוָה עֲלֵהֶם אֶת מֵי הַיָּם וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָלְכוּ בַיַּבָּשָׁה בְּתוֹךְ הַיָּם׃

english.text:
Because Pharaoh’s horses with his chariots and with his
horsemen came in the sea, and YHWH brought back the water
of the sea over them, and the children of Israel had gone
on the dry ground through the sea.

translation.text: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.

verses.english:
Because Pharaoh’s horses with his chariots and with his
horsemen came in the sea, and YHWH brought back the water
of the sea over them, and the children of Israel had gone
on the dry ground through the sea.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח מִרְיָם הַנְּבִיאָה אֲחוֹת אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַתֹּף בְּיָדָהּ וַתֵּצֶאןָ כל הַנָּשִׁים אַחֲרֶיהָ בְּתֻפִּים וּבִמְחֹלֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקַּח מִרְיָם הַנְּבִיאָה אֲחוֹת אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַתֹּף בְּיָדָהּ וַתֵּצֶאןָ כל הַנָּשִׁים אַחֲרֶיהָ בְּתֻפִּים וּבִמְחֹלֹת׃

english.text:
And Miriam, the prophetess, Aaron’s sister, took a drum in
her hand, and all the women went out behind her with drums
and with dances.

translation.text: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.

verses.english:
And Miriam, the prophetess, Aaron’s sister, took a drum in
her hand, and all the women went out behind her with drums
and with dances.

verses.hebrew:
וַתַּעַן לָהֶם מִרְיָם\\
שִׁירוּ לַיהֹוָה כִּי גָאֹה גָּאָה סוּס וְרֹכְבוֹ רָמָה בַיָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעַן לָהֶם מִרְיָם
שִׁירוּ לַיהֹוָה כִּי גָאֹה גָּאָה סוּס וְרֹכְבוֹ רָמָה בַיָּם׃

english.text: And Miriam sang to them
Sing to YHWH for he triumphed! Horse and its rider he cast in the sea.

translation.text: And Miriam answered them,
Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

verses.english:
And Miriam sang to them\\
Sing to YHWH for he triumphed! Horse and its rider he cast in the sea.
verses.translation: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּסַּע מֹשֶׁה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּם סוּף וַיֵּצְאוּ אֶל מִדְבַּר שׁוּר וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים בַּמִּדְבָּר וְלֹא מָצְאוּ מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּסַּע מֹשֶׁה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּם סוּף וַיֵּצְאוּ אֶל מִדְבַּר שׁוּר וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים בַּמִּדְבָּר וְלֹא מָצְאוּ מָיִם׃

english.text:
And Moses had Israel travel from the Red Sea, and they
went out to the wilderness of Shur. And they went three
days in the wilderness. And they did not find water.

translation.text: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

verses.english:
And Moses had Israel travel from the Red Sea, and they
went out to the wilderness of Shur. And they went three
days in the wilderness. And they did not find water.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ מָרָתָה וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לִשְׁתֹּת מַיִם מִמָּרָה כִּי מָרִים הֵם עַל כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמָהּ מָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ מָרָתָה וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לִשְׁתֹּת מַיִם מִמָּרָה כִּי מָרִים הֵם עַל כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמָהּ מָרָה׃

english.text:
And they came to Marah, and they were not able to drink
water from Marah because it was bitter. On account of this
he called its name Marah.

translation.text: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.

verses.english:
And they came to Marah, and they were not able to drink
water from Marah because it was bitter. On account of this
he called its name Marah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלֹּנוּ הָעָם עַל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר מַה נִּשְׁתֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלֹּנוּ הָעָם עַל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר מַה נִּשְׁתֶּה׃

english.text:
And the people complained at Moses, saying, “What shall we
drink?”

translation.text: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?

verses.english:
And the people complained at Moses, saying, “What shall we
drink?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְעַק אֶל יְהֹוָה וַיּוֹרֵהוּ יְהֹוָה עֵץ וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶל הַמַּיִם וַיִּמְתְּקוּ הַמָּיִם שָׁם שָׂם לוֹ חֹק וּמִשְׁפָּט וְשָׁם נִסָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצְעַק אֶל יְהֹוָה וַיּוֹרֵהוּ יְהֹוָה עֵץ וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶל הַמַּיִם וַיִּמְתְּקוּ הַמָּיִם שָׁם שָׂם לוֹ חֹק וּמִשְׁפָּט וְשָׁם נִסָּהוּ׃

english.text:
And he cried to YHWH, and YHWH showed him a tree, and he
threw it into the water, and the water sweetened. He set
law and judgment for them there, and He tested them there.

translation.text: And he cried unto the LORD; and the LORD shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,

verses.english:
And he cried to YHWH, and YHWH showed him a tree, and he
threw it into the water, and the water sweetened. He set
law and judgment for them there, and He tested them there.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם שָׁמוֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע לְקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו תַּעֲשֶׂה וְהַאֲזַנְתָּ לְמִצְוֺתָיו וְשָׁמַרְתָּ כּל חֻקָּיו כּל הַמַּחֲלָה אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי בְמִצְרַיִם לֹא אָשִׂים עָלֶיךָ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה רֹפְאֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם שָׁמוֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע לְקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו תַּעֲשֶׂה וְהַאֲזַנְתָּ לְמִצְוֺתָיו וְשָׁמַרְתָּ כּל חֻקָּיו כּל הַמַּחֲלָה אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי בְמִצְרַיִם לֹא אָשִׂים עָלֶיךָ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה רֹפְאֶךָ׃

english.text:
And He said, “If you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH, your
God, and you’ll do what is right in His eyes and turn your
ear to His commandments and observe all His laws, I won’t
set on you any of the sickness that I set on Egypt,
because I, YHWH, am your healer.”

translation.text: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the LORD that healeth thee.

verses.english:
And He said, “If you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH, your
God, and you’ll do what is right in His eyes and turn your
ear to His commandments and observe all His laws, I won’t
set on you any of the sickness that I set on Egypt,
because I, YHWH, am your healer.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵילִמָה וְשָׁם שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה עֵינֹת מַיִם וְשִׁבְעִים תְּמָרִים וַיַּחֲנוּ שָׁם עַל הַמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵילִמָה וְשָׁם שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה עֵינֹת מַיִם וְשִׁבְעִים תְּמָרִים וַיַּחֲנוּ שָׁם עַל הַמָּיִם׃

english.text:
And they came to Elim. And twelve springs of water and
seventy palm trees were there. And they camped there by
the water.

translation.text: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.

verses.english:
And they came to Elim. And twelve springs of water and
seventy palm trees were there. And they camped there by
the water.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֵילִם וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל מִדְבַּר סִין אֲשֶׁר בֵּין אֵילִם וּבֵין סִינָי בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי לְצֵאתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֵילִם וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל מִדְבַּר סִין אֲשֶׁר בֵּין אֵילִם וּבֵין סִינָי בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי לְצֵאתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Elim, and all of the
congregation of the children of Israel came to the
wilderness of Sîn, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the
fifteenth day of the second month after their exodus from
the land of Egypt.

translation.text: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Elim, and all of the
congregation of the children of Israel came to the
wilderness of Sîn, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the
fifteenth day of the second month after their exodus from
the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: (וילינו) [וַיִּלּוֹנוּ] כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: (וילינו) [וַיִּלּוֹנוּ] כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
And all of the congregation of the children of Israel
complained at Moses and at Aaron in the wilderness.

translation.text: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:

verses.english:
And all of the congregation of the children of Israel
complained at Moses and at Aaron in the wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִי יִתֵּן מוּתֵנוּ בְיַד יְהֹוָה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּשִׁבְתֵּנוּ עַל סִיר הַבָּשָׂר בְּאכְלֵנוּ לֶחֶם לָשֹׂבַע כִּי הוֹצֵאתֶם אֹתָנוּ אֶל הַמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה לְהָמִית אֶת כּל הַקָּהָל הַזֶּה בָּרָעָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִי יִתֵּן מוּתֵנוּ בְיַד יְהֹוָה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּשִׁבְתֵּנוּ עַל סִיר הַבָּשָׂר בְּאכְלֵנוּ לֶחֶם לָשֹׂבַע כִּי הוֹצֵאתֶם אֹתָנוּ אֶל הַמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה לְהָמִית אֶת כּל הַקָּהָל הַזֶּה בָּרָעָב׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel said to them, “Who would make
it so that we had died by YHWH’s hand in the land of
Egypt, when we sat by a pot of meat, when we ate bread to
the full! Because you brought us out to this wilderness to
kill this whole community with starvation!”

translation.text: And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel said to them, “Who would make
it so that we had died by YHWH’s hand in the land of
Egypt, when we sat by a pot of meat, when we ate bread to
the full! Because you brought us out to this wilderness to
kill this whole community with starvation!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הִנְנִי מַמְטִיר לָכֶם לֶחֶם מִן הַשָּׁמָיִם וְיָצָא הָעָם וְלָקְטוּ דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ לְמַעַן אֲנַסֶּנּוּ הֲיֵלֵךְ בְּתוֹרָתִי אִם לֹא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הִנְנִי מַמְטִיר לָכֶם לֶחֶם מִן הַשָּׁמָיִם וְיָצָא הָעָם וְלָקְטוּ דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ לְמַעַן אֲנַסֶּנּוּ הֲיֵלֵךְ בְּתוֹרָתִי אִם לֹא׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Here, I’m raining bread from the
skies for you, and let the people go out and gather the
daily ration in its day in order that I can test them:
will they go by my instruction or not.

translation.text: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Here, I’m raining bread from the
skies for you, and let the people go out and gather the
daily ration in its day in order that I can test them:
will they go by my instruction or not.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי וְהֵכִינוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר יָבִיאוּ וְהָיָה מִשְׁנֶה עַל אֲשֶׁר יִלְקְטוּ יוֹם יוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי וְהֵכִינוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר יָבִיאוּ וְהָיָה מִשְׁנֶה עַל אֲשֶׁר יִלְקְטוּ יוֹם יוֹם׃

english.text:
And it will be that on the sixth day they’ll prepare what
they bring in, and it will be twice as much as they’ll
gather on regular days.”

translation.text: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.

verses.english:
And it will be that on the sixth day they’ll prepare what
they bring in, and it will be twice as much as they’ll
gather on regular days.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶרֶב וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי יְהֹוָה הוֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶרֶב וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי יְהֹוָה הוֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel,
“At evening you’ll know that YHWH brought you out from the
land of Egypt,

translation.text: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel,
“At evening you’ll know that YHWH brought you out from the
land of Egypt,

verses.hebrew: וּבֹקֶר וּרְאִיתֶם אֶת כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה בְּשׁמְעוֹ אֶת תְּלֻנֹּתֵיכֶם עַל יְהֹוָה וְנַחְנוּ מָה כִּי (תלונו) [תַלִּינוּ] עָלֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבֹקֶר וּרְאִיתֶם אֶת כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה בְּשׁמְעוֹ אֶת תְּלֻנֹּתֵיכֶם עַל יְהֹוָה וְנַחְנוּ מָה כִּי (תלונו) [תַלִּינוּ] עָלֵינוּ׃

english.text:
and in the morning you’ll see YHWH’s glory, because He has
heard your complaints about YHWH. And what are we, that
you complain at us?!”

translation.text: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD; for that he heareth your murmurings against the LORD: and what are we, that ye murmur against us?

verses.english:
and in the morning you’ll see YHWH’s glory, because He has
heard your complaints about YHWH. And what are we, that
you complain at us?!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה בְּתֵת יְהֹוָה לָכֶם בָּעֶרֶב בָּשָׂר לֶאֱכֹל וְלֶחֶם בַּבֹּקֶר לִשְׂבֹּעַ בִּשְׁמֹעַ יְהֹוָה אֶת תְּלֻנֹּתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם מַלִּינִם עָלָיו וְנַחְנוּ מָה לֹא עָלֵינוּ תְלֻנֹּתֵיכֶם כִּי עַל יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה בְּתֵת יְהֹוָה לָכֶם בָּעֶרֶב בָּשָׂר לֶאֱכֹל וְלֶחֶם בַּבֹּקֶר לִשְׂבֹּעַ בִּשְׁמֹעַ יְהֹוָה אֶת תְּלֻנֹּתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם מַלִּינִם עָלָיו וְנַחְנוּ מָה לֹא עָלֵינוּ תְלֻנֹּתֵיכֶם כִּי עַל יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “When YHWH gives you meat to eat in the
evening and bread to the full in the morning, because YHWH
has heard your complaints that you’re making at Him! And
what are we? Your complaints are not at us but at YHWH!”

translation.text: And Moses said, This shall be, when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the LORD heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “When YHWH gives you meat to eat in the
evening and bread to the full in the morning, because YHWH
has heard your complaints that you’re making at Him! And
what are we? Your complaints are not at us but at YHWH!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן אֱמֹר אֶל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל קִרְבוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי שָׁמַע אֵת תְּלֻנֹּתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן אֱמֹר אֶל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל קִרְבוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי שָׁמַע אֵת תְּלֻנֹּתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Aaron, “Say to all of the congregation
of the children of Israel, ‘Come close in front of YHWH,
because He has heard your complaints.’”

translation.text: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your murmurings.

verses.english:
And Moses said to Aaron, “Say to all of the congregation
of the children of Israel, ‘Come close in front of YHWH,
because He has heard your complaints.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּדַבֵּר אַהֲרֹן אֶל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּפְנוּ אֶל הַמִּדְבָּר וְהִנֵּה כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה נִרְאָה בֶּעָנָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּדַבֵּר אַהֲרֹן אֶל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּפְנוּ אֶל הַמִּדְבָּר וְהִנֵּה כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה נִרְאָה בֶּעָנָן׃

english.text:
And it was as Aaron was speaking to all of the
congregation of the children of Israel: and they turned to
the wilderness, and here was YHWH’s glory appearing in a
cloud.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud.

verses.english:
And it was as Aaron was speaking to all of the
congregation of the children of Israel: and they turned to
the wilderness, and here was YHWH’s glory appearing in a
cloud.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת תְּלוּנֹּת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דַּבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם לֵאמֹר בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם תֹּאכְלוּ בָשָׂר וּבַבֹּקֶר תִּשְׂבְּעוּ לָחֶם וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת תְּלוּנֹּת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דַּבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם לֵאמֹר בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם תֹּאכְלוּ בָשָׂר וּבַבֹּקֶר תִּשְׂבְּעוּ לָחֶם וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“I’ve heard the complaints of the children of Israel.
Speak to them, saying, ‘Between the two evenings you shall
eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with
bread, and you will know that I am YHWH, your God.’”

translation.text: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“I’ve heard the complaints of the children of Israel.
Speak to them, saying, ‘Between the two evenings you shall
eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with
bread, and you will know that I am YHWH, your God.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בָעֶרֶב וַתַּעַל הַשְּׂלָו וַתְּכַס אֶת הַמַּחֲנֶה וּבַבֹּקֶר הָיְתָה שִׁכְבַת הַטַּל סָבִיב לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בָעֶרֶב וַתַּעַל הַשְּׂלָו וַתְּכַס אֶת הַמַּחֲנֶה וּבַבֹּקֶר הָיְתָה שִׁכְבַת הַטַּל סָבִיב לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And it was in the evening, and quail went up and covered
the camp. And in the morning there was a layer of dew
around the camp.

translation.text: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.

verses.english:
And it was in the evening, and quail went up and covered
the camp. And in the morning there was a layer of dew
around the camp.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעַל שִׁכְבַת הַטָּל וְהִנֵּה עַל פְּנֵי הַמִּדְבָּר דַּק מְחֻסְפָּס דַּק כַּכְּפֹר עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעַל שִׁכְבַת הַטָּל וְהִנֵּה עַל פְּנֵי הַמִּדְבָּר דַּק מְחֻסְפָּס דַּק כַּכְּפֹר עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And the layer of dew went up, and here, on the face of the
wilderness: scaly thin, thin as frost on the ground.

translation.text: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.

verses.english:
And the layer of dew went up, and here, on the face of the
wilderness: scaly thin, thin as frost on the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו מָן הוּא כִּי לֹא יָדְעוּ מַה הוּא וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֲלֵהֶם הוּא הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה לָכֶם לְאכְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו מָן הוּא כִּי לֹא יָדְעוּ מַה הוּא וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֲלֵהֶם הוּא הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה לָכֶם לְאכְלָה׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel saw, and each said to his
brother, “What is it?”—because they did not know what it
was. And Moses said to them, “That is the bread that YHWH
has given you for food.

translation.text: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel saw, and each said to his
brother, “What is it?”—because they did not know what it
was. And Moses said to them, “That is the bread that YHWH
has given you for food.

verses.hebrew: זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לִקְטוּ מִמֶּנּוּ אִישׁ לְפִי אכְלוֹ עֹמֶר לַגֻּלְגֹּלֶת מִסְפַּר נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם אִישׁ לַאֲשֶׁר בְּאהֳלוֹ תִּקָּחוּ׃

hebrew.text: זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לִקְטוּ מִמֶּנּוּ אִישׁ לְפִי אכְלוֹ עֹמֶר לַגֻּלְגֹּלֶת מִסְפַּר נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם אִישׁ לַאֲשֶׁר בְּאהֳלוֹ תִּקָּחוּ׃

english.text:
This is the thing that YHWH has commanded: Collect some of
it, each according to what he eats; you shall take an omer
per head, the number of your persons, each for whoever is
in his tent.”

translation.text: This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for them which are in his tents.

verses.english:
This is the thing that YHWH has commanded: Collect some of
it, each according to what he eats; you shall take an omer
per head, the number of your persons, each for whoever is
in his tent.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּלְקְטוּ הַמַּרְבֶּה וְהַמַּמְעִיט׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּלְקְטוּ הַמַּרְבֶּה וְהַמַּמְעִיט׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel did so. And they collected—the
one who took the most and the one who took the least.

translation.text: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel did so. And they collected—the
one who took the most and the one who took the least.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמֹדּוּ בָעֹמֶר וְלֹא הֶעְדִּיף הַמַּרְבֶּה וְהַמַּמְעִיט לֹא הֶחְסִיר אִישׁ לְפִי אכְלוֹ לָקָטוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמֹדּוּ בָעֹמֶר וְלֹא הֶעְדִּיף הַמַּרְבֶּה וְהַמַּמְעִיט לֹא הֶחְסִיר אִישׁ לְפִי אכְלוֹ לָקָטוּ׃

english.text:
And they measured by the omer, and the one who took the
most had not exceeded, and the one who took the least had
not fallen short. Each had collected according to what he
eats.

translation.text: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.

verses.english:
And they measured by the omer, and the one who took the
most had not exceeded, and the one who took the least had
not fallen short. Each had collected according to what he
eats.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אַל יוֹתֵר מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אַל יוֹתֵר מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר׃

english.text:
And Moses said to them, “Let no one leave any of it over
until morning.”

translation.text: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.

verses.english:
And Moses said to them, “Let no one leave any of it over
until morning.”

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיּוֹתִרוּ אֲנָשִׁים מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר וַיָּרֻם תּוֹלָעִים וַיִּבְאַשׁ וַיִּקְצֹף עֲלֵהֶם מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיּוֹתִרוּ אֲנָשִׁים מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר וַיָּרֻם תּוֹלָעִים וַיִּבְאַשׁ וַיִּקְצֹף עֲלֵהֶם מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And they did not listen to Moses, and people left some of
it over until morning, and it yielded worms and stank. And
Moses was angry at them.

translation.text: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.

verses.english:
And they did not listen to Moses, and people left some of
it over until morning, and it yielded worms and stank. And
Moses was angry at them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְקְטוּ אֹתוֹ בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר אִישׁ כְּפִי אכְלוֹ וְחַם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְנָמָס׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְקְטוּ אֹתוֹ בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר אִישׁ כְּפִי אכְלוֹ וְחַם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְנָמָס׃

english.text:
And they collected it morning by morning, each by what he
eats, and when the sun was hot it melted.

translation.text: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.

verses.english:
And they collected it morning by morning, each by what he
eats, and when the sun was hot it melted.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי לָקְטוּ לֶחֶם מִשְׁנֶה שְׁנֵי הָעֹמֶר לָאֶחָד וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה וַיַּגִּידוּ לְמֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי לָקְטוּ לֶחֶם מִשְׁנֶה שְׁנֵי הָעֹמֶר לָאֶחָד וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה וַיַּגִּידוּ לְמֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And it was: on the sixth day they collected double bread,
two times the omer for each one, and all the chiefs of the
congregation came and told Moses.

translation.text: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

verses.english:
And it was: on the sixth day they collected double bread,
two times the omer for each one, and all the chiefs of the
congregation came and told Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם הוּא אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה שַׁבָּתוֹן שַׁבַּת קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה מָחָר אֵת אֲשֶׁר תֹּאפוּ אֵפוּ וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר תְּבַשְּׁלוּ בַּשֵּׁלוּ וְאֵת כּל הָעֹדֵף הַנִּיחוּ לָכֶם לְמִשְׁמֶרֶת עַד הַבֹּקֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם הוּא אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה שַׁבָּתוֹן שַׁבַּת קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה מָחָר אֵת אֲשֶׁר תֹּאפוּ אֵפוּ וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר תְּבַשְּׁלוּ בַּשֵּׁלוּ וְאֵת כּל הָעֹדֵף הַנִּיחוּ לָכֶם לְמִשְׁמֶרֶת עַד הַבֹּקֶר׃

english.text:
And he said to them, “That is what YHWH spoke. Tomorrow is
a ceasing, a holy Sabbath to YHWH. Bake what you’ll bake,
and cook what you’ll cook, and leave what is left over for
keeping until the morning.”

translation.text: And he said unto them, This is that which the LORD hath said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the LORD: bake that which ye will bake to day, and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.

verses.english:
And he said to them, “That is what YHWH spoke. Tomorrow is
a ceasing, a holy Sabbath to YHWH. Bake what you’ll bake,
and cook what you’ll cook, and leave what is left over for
keeping until the morning.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּנִּיחוּ אֹתוֹ עַד הַבֹּקֶר כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה וְלֹא הִבְאִישׁ וְרִמָּה לֹא הָיְתָה בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּנִּיחוּ אֹתוֹ עַד הַבֹּקֶר כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה וְלֹא הִבְאִישׁ וְרִמָּה לֹא הָיְתָה בּוֹ׃

english.text:
And they left it until the morning, as Moses had
commanded, and it did not stink, and there was not a worm
in it.

translation.text: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.

verses.english:
And they left it until the morning, as Moses had
commanded, and it did not stink, and there was not a worm
in it.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אִכְלֻהוּ הַיּוֹם כִּי שַׁבָּת הַיּוֹם לַיהֹוָה הַיּוֹם לֹא תִמְצָאֻהוּ בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אִכְלֻהוּ הַיּוֹם כִּי שַׁבָּת הַיּוֹם לַיהֹוָה הַיּוֹם לֹא תִמְצָאֻהוּ בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “Eat it today, because today is a Sabbath
to YHWH. Today you won’t find it in the field.

translation.text: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto the LORD: to day ye shall not find it in the field.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “Eat it today, because today is a Sabbath
to YHWH. Today you won’t find it in the field.

verses.hebrew: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תִּלְקְטֻהוּ וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבָּת לֹא יִהְיֶה בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תִּלְקְטֻהוּ וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבָּת לֹא יִהְיֶה בּוֹ׃

english.text:
Six days you shall collect it. And on the seventh day is a
Sabbath; there will not be any in it.”

translation.text: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.

verses.english:
Six days you shall collect it. And on the seventh day is a
Sabbath; there will not be any in it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי יָצְאוּ מִן הָעָם לִלְקֹט וְלֹא מָצָאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי יָצְאוּ מִן הָעָם לִלְקֹט וְלֹא מָצָאוּ׃

english.text:
And it was: on the seventh day some of the people went out
to collect, and they did not find any.

translation.text: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.

verses.english:
And it was: on the seventh day some of the people went out
to collect, and they did not find any.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עַד אָנָה מֵאַנְתֶּם לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתַי וְתוֹרֹתָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עַד אָנָה מֵאַנְתֶּם לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתַי וְתוֹרֹתָי׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to observe
my commandments and my instructions?

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to observe
my commandments and my instructions?

verses.hebrew: רְאוּ כִּי יְהֹוָה נָתַן לָכֶם הַשַּׁבָּת עַל כֵּן הוּא נֹתֵן לָכֶם בַּיּוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי לֶחֶם יוֹמָיִם שְׁבוּ אִישׁ תַּחְתָּיו אַל יֵצֵא אִישׁ מִמְּקֹמוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי׃

hebrew.text: רְאוּ כִּי יְהֹוָה נָתַן לָכֶם הַשַּׁבָּת עַל כֵּן הוּא נֹתֵן לָכֶם בַּיּוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי לֶחֶם יוֹמָיִם שְׁבוּ אִישׁ תַּחְתָּיו אַל יֵצֵא אִישׁ מִמְּקֹמוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי׃

english.text:
See that YHWH has given you the Sabbath. On account of
this He is giving you two days’ bread on the sixth day.
Stay, each in his place. Let no man go out from his place
in the seventh day.”

translation.text: See, for that the LORD hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.

verses.english:
See that YHWH has given you the Sabbath. On account of
this He is giving you two days’ bread on the sixth day.
Stay, each in his place. Let no man go out from his place
in the seventh day.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁבְּתוּ הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִעִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁבְּתוּ הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִעִי׃

english.text: And the people ceased in the seventh day.

translation.text: So the people rested on the seventh day.

verses.english: And the people ceased in the seventh day.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ בֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת שְׁמוֹ מָן וְהוּא כְּזֶרַע גַּד לָבָן וְטַעְמוֹ כְּצַפִּיחִת בִּדְבָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ בֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת שְׁמוֹ מָן וְהוּא כְּזֶרַע גַּד לָבָן וְטַעְמוֹ כְּצַפִּיחִת בִּדְבָשׁ׃

english.text:
And the house of Israel called its name “manna.” And it
was like a coriander seed, white, and its taste was like a
wafer in honey.

translation.text: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.

verses.english:
And the house of Israel called its name “manna.” And it
was like a coriander seed, white, and its taste was like a
wafer in honey.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה מְלֹא הָעֹמֶר מִמֶּנּוּ לְמִשְׁמֶרֶת לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם לְמַעַן יִרְאוּ אֶת הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר הֶאֱכַלְתִּי אֶתְכֶם בַּמִּדְבָּר בְּהוֹצִיאִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה מְלֹא הָעֹמֶר מִמֶּנּוּ לְמִשְׁמֶרֶת לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם לְמַעַן יִרְאוּ אֶת הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר הֶאֱכַלְתִּי אֶתְכֶם בַּמִּדְבָּר בְּהוֹצִיאִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “This is the thing that YHWH has
commanded: ‘an omer-ful of it is for watching over through
your generations so that they will see the bread that I
fed you in the wilderness when I brought you out from the
land of Egypt.’”

translation.text: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “This is the thing that YHWH has
commanded: ‘an omer-ful of it is for watching over through
your generations so that they will see the bread that I
fed you in the wilderness when I brought you out from the
land of Egypt.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן קַח צִנְצֶנֶת אַחַת וְתֶן שָׁמָּה מְלֹא הָעֹמֶר מָן וְהַנַּח אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְמִשְׁמֶרֶת לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן קַח צִנְצֶנֶת אַחַת וְתֶן שָׁמָּה מְלֹא הָעֹמֶר מָן וְהַנַּח אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְמִשְׁמֶרֶת לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Aaron, “Take one jar and place an
omer-ful of manna there and lay it in front of YHWH for
watching over through your generations,”

translation.text: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations.

verses.english:
And Moses said to Aaron, “Take one jar and place an
omer-ful of manna there and lay it in front of YHWH for
watching over through your generations,”

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיַּנִּיחֵהוּ אַהֲרֹן לִפְנֵי הָעֵדֻת לְמִשְׁמָרֶת׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיַּנִּיחֵהוּ אַהֲרֹן לִפְנֵי הָעֵדֻת לְמִשְׁמָרֶת׃

english.text:
as YHWH had commanded Moses. And Aaron laid it in front of
the Testimony for watching over.

translation.text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

verses.english:
as YHWH had commanded Moses. And Aaron laid it in front of
the Testimony for watching over.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָכְלוּ אֶת הַמָּן אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה עַד בֹּאָם אֶל אֶרֶץ נוֹשָׁבֶת אֶת הַמָּן אָכְלוּ עַד בֹּאָם אֶל קְצֵה אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָכְלוּ אֶת הַמָּן אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה עַד בֹּאָם אֶל אֶרֶץ נוֹשָׁבֶת אֶת הַמָּן אָכְלוּ עַד בֹּאָם אֶל קְצֵה אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel ate the manna forty years until
they came to settled land. They ate the manna until they
came to the edge of the land of Canaan.

translation.text: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel ate the manna forty years until
they came to settled land. They ate the manna until they
came to the edge of the land of Canaan.

verses.hebrew: וְהָעֹמֶר עֲשִׂרִית הָאֵיפָה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעֹמֶר עֲשִׂרִית הָאֵיפָה הוּא׃

english.text: (And an omer is a tenth of an ephah.)

translation.text: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.

verses.english: (And an omer is a tenth of an ephah.)

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּדְבַּר סִין לְמַסְעֵיהֶם עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּרְפִידִים וְאֵין מַיִם לִשְׁתֹּת הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּדְבַּר סִין לְמַסְעֵיהֶם עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּרְפִידִים וְאֵין מַיִם לִשְׁתֹּת הָעָם׃

english.text:
And all of the congregation of the children of Israel
traveled from the wilderness of Sîn on their travels by
YHWH’s word, and they camped in Rephidim. And there was no
water for the people to drink.

translation.text: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the LORD, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.

verses.english:
And all of the congregation of the children of Israel
traveled from the wilderness of Sîn on their travels by
YHWH’s word, and they camped in Rephidim. And there was no
water for the people to drink.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרֶב הָעָם עִם מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמְרוּ תְּנוּ לָנוּ מַיִם וְנִשְׁתֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה מַה תְּרִיבוּן עִמָּדִי מַה תְּנַסּוּן אֶת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּרֶב הָעָם עִם מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמְרוּ תְּנוּ לָנוּ מַיִם וְנִשְׁתֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה מַה תְּרִיבוּן עִמָּדִי מַה תְּנַסּוּן אֶת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the people quarreled with Moses. And they said, “Give
us water, and let us drink.” And Moses said to them, “Why
do you quarrel with me? Why do you test YHWH?!”

translation.text: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the LORD?

verses.english:
And the people quarreled with Moses. And they said, “Give
us water, and let us drink.” And Moses said to them, “Why
do you quarrel with me? Why do you test YHWH?!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְמָא שָׁם הָעָם לַמַּיִם וַיָּלֶן הָעָם עַל מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָּה זֶּה הֶעֱלִיתָנוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם לְהָמִית אֹתִי וְאֶת בָּנַי וְאֶת מִקְנַי בַּצָּמָא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצְמָא שָׁם הָעָם לַמַּיִם וַיָּלֶן הָעָם עַל מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָּה זֶּה הֶעֱלִיתָנוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם לְהָמִית אֹתִי וְאֶת בָּנַי וְאֶת מִקְנַי בַּצָּמָא׃

english.text:
And the people thirsted for water there, and the people
complained at Moses and said, “Why is this that you
brought us up from Egypt: to kill me and my children and
my cattle with thirst?!”

translation.text: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?

verses.english:
And the people thirsted for water there, and the people
complained at Moses and said, “Why is this that you
brought us up from Egypt: to kill me and my children and
my cattle with thirst?!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְעַק מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לָעָם הַזֶּה עוֹד מְעַט וּסְקָלֻנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצְעַק מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לָעָם הַזֶּה עוֹד מְעַט וּסְקָלֻנִי׃

english.text:
And Moses cried to YHWH, saying, “What shall I do to this
people? A little more and they’ll stone me!”

translation.text: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.

verses.english:
And Moses cried to YHWH, saying, “What shall I do to this
people? A little more and they’ll stone me!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עֲבֹר לִפְנֵי הָעָם וְקַח אִתְּךָ מִזִּקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמַטְּךָ אֲשֶׁר הִכִּיתָ בּוֹ אֶת הַיְאֹר קַח בְּיָדְךָ וְהָלָכְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עֲבֹר לִפְנֵי הָעָם וְקַח אִתְּךָ מִזִּקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמַטְּךָ אֲשֶׁר הִכִּיתָ בּוֹ אֶת הַיְאֹר קַח בְּיָדְךָ וְהָלָכְתָּ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Pass in front of the people and
take some of Israel’s elders with you, and take your staff
with which you struck the Nile in your hand, and you’ll
go.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Pass in front of the people and
take some of Israel’s elders with you, and take your staff
with which you struck the Nile in your hand, and you’ll
go.

verses.hebrew: הִנְנִי עֹמֵד לְפָנֶיךָ שָּׁם עַל הַצּוּר בְּחֹרֵב וְהִכִּיתָ בַצּוּר וְיָצְאוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מַיִם וְשָׁתָה הָעָם וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן מֹשֶׁה לְעֵינֵי זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: הִנְנִי עֹמֵד לְפָנֶיךָ שָּׁם עַל הַצּוּר בְּחֹרֵב וְהִכִּיתָ בַצּוּר וְיָצְאוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מַיִם וְשָׁתָה הָעָם וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן מֹשֶׁה לְעֵינֵי זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Here, I’ll be standing in front of you there on a rock at
Horeb. And you’ll strike the rock, and water will come out
of it, and the people will drink.” And Moses did so before
the eyes of Israel’s elders.

translation.text: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

verses.english:
Here, I’ll be standing in front of you there on a rock at
Horeb. And you’ll strike the rock, and water will come out
of it, and the people will drink.” And Moses did so before
the eyes of Israel’s elders.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם מַסָּה וּמְרִיבָה עַל רִיב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל נַסֹּתָם אֶת יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הֲיֵשׁ יְהֹוָה בְּקִרְבֵּנוּ אִם אָיִן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם מַסָּה וּמְרִיבָה עַל רִיב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל נַסֹּתָם אֶת יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הֲיֵשׁ יְהֹוָה בְּקִרְבֵּנוּ אִם אָיִן׃

english.text:
And he called the place’s name Massah and Meribah because
of the quarrel of the children of Israel and because of
their testing YHWH, saying, “Is YHWH among us or not?”

translation.text: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us, or not?

verses.english:
And he called the place’s name Massah and Meribah because
of the quarrel of the children of Israel and because of
their testing YHWH, saying, “Is YHWH among us or not?”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא עֲמָלֵק וַיִּלָּחֶם עִם יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּרְפִידִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא עֲמָלֵק וַיִּלָּחֶם עִם יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּרְפִידִם׃

english.text: And Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

translation.text: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

verses.english: And Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בְּחַר לָנוּ אֲנָשִׁים וְצֵא הִלָּחֵם בַּעֲמָלֵק מָחָר אָנֹכִי נִצָּב עַל רֹאשׁ הַגִּבְעָה וּמַטֵּה הָאֱלֹהִים בְּיָדִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בְּחַר לָנוּ אֲנָשִׁים וְצֵא הִלָּחֵם בַּעֲמָלֵק מָחָר אָנֹכִי נִצָּב עַל רֹאשׁ הַגִּבְעָה וּמַטֵּה הָאֱלֹהִים בְּיָדִי׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us and go, fight
against Amalek. Tomorrow I’ll be standing up on the
hilltop, and the staff of God in my hand.”

translation.text: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.

verses.english:
And Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us and go, fight
against Amalek. Tomorrow I’ll be standing up on the
hilltop, and the staff of God in my hand.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר לוֹ מֹשֶׁה לְהִלָּחֵם בַּעֲמָלֵק וּמֹשֶׁה אַהֲרֹן וְחוּר עָלוּ רֹאשׁ הַגִּבְעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר לוֹ מֹשֶׁה לְהִלָּחֵם בַּעֲמָלֵק וּמֹשֶׁה אַהֲרֹן וְחוּר עָלוּ רֹאשׁ הַגִּבְעָה׃

english.text:
And Joshua did as Moses said to him, to fight against
Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the hilltop.

translation.text: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

verses.english:
And Joshua did as Moses said to him, to fight against
Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the hilltop.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר יָרִים מֹשֶׁה יָדוֹ וְגָבַר יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכַאֲשֶׁר יָנִיחַ יָדוֹ וְגָבַר עֲמָלֵק׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר יָרִים מֹשֶׁה יָדוֹ וְגָבַר יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכַאֲשֶׁר יָנִיחַ יָדוֹ וְגָבַר עֲמָלֵק׃

english.text:
And it was: when Moses would lift his hand, then Israel
would predominate; and when he would rest his hand, then
Amalek would predominate.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

verses.english:
And it was: when Moses would lift his hand, then Israel
would predominate; and when he would rest his hand, then
Amalek would predominate.

verses.hebrew: וִידֵי מֹשֶׁה כְּבֵדִים וַיִּקְחוּ אֶבֶן וַיָּשִׂימוּ תַחְתָּיו וַיֵּשֶׁב עָלֶיהָ וְאַהֲרֹן וְחוּר תָּמְכוּ בְיָדָיו מִזֶּה אֶחָד וּמִזֶּה אֶחָד וַיְהִי יָדָיו אֱמוּנָה עַד בֹּא הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וִידֵי מֹשֶׁה כְּבֵדִים וַיִּקְחוּ אֶבֶן וַיָּשִׂימוּ תַחְתָּיו וַיֵּשֶׁב עָלֶיהָ וְאַהֲרֹן וְחוּר תָּמְכוּ בְיָדָיו מִזֶּה אֶחָד וּמִזֶּה אֶחָד וַיְהִי יָדָיו אֱמוּנָה עַד בֹּא הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And Moses’ hands were heavy. And they took a stone and set
it under him, and he sat on it, and Aaron and Hur held up
his hands, one from this side and one from this side, and
his hands were supported until the sunset.

translation.text: But Moses’ hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

verses.english:
And Moses’ hands were heavy. And they took a stone and set
it under him, and he sat on it, and Aaron and Hur held up
his hands, one from this side and one from this side, and
his hands were supported until the sunset.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲלֹשׁ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת עֲמָלֵק וְאֶת עַמּוֹ לְפִי חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲלֹשׁ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת עֲמָלֵק וְאֶת עַמּוֹ לְפִי חָרֶב׃

english.text: And Joshua defeated Amalek and his people by the sword.

translation.text: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

verses.english: And Joshua defeated Amalek and his people by the sword.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה כְּתֹב זֹאת זִכָּרוֹן בַּסֵּפֶר וְשִׂים בְּאזְנֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כִּי מָחֹה אֶמְחֶה אֶת זֵכֶר עֲמָלֵק מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה כְּתֹב זֹאת זִכָּרוֹן בַּסֵּפֶר וְשִׂים בְּאזְנֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כִּי מָחֹה אֶמְחֶה אֶת זֵכֶר עֲמָלֵק מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Write this—a memorial—in a scroll
and set it in Joshua’s ears, because I shall wipe out the
memory of Amalek from under the skies!”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Write this—a memorial—in a scroll
and set it in Joshua’s ears, because I shall wipe out the
memory of Amalek from under the skies!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן מֹשֶׁה מִזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ יְהֹוָה נִסִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן מֹשֶׁה מִזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ יְהֹוָה נִסִּי׃

english.text:
And Moses built an altar and called its name “YHWH is my
standard.”

translation.text: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovahnissi:

verses.english:
And Moses built an altar and called its name “YHWH is my
standard.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי יָד עַל כֵּס יָהּ מִלְחָמָה לַיהֹוָה בַּעֲמָלֵק מִדֹּר דֹּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי יָד עַל כֵּס יָהּ מִלְחָמָה לַיהֹוָה בַּעֲמָלֵק מִדֹּר דֹּר׃

english.text:
And he said, “Because—hand on YH’s throne—YHWH has war
against Amalek from generation to generation.”

translation.text: For he said, Because the LORD hath sworn that the LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.

verses.english:
And he said, “Because—hand on YH’s throne—YHWH has war
against Amalek from generation to generation.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע יִתְרוֹ כֹהֵן מִדְיָן חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֱלֹהִים לְמֹשֶׁה וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ כִּי הוֹצִיא יְהֹוָה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע יִתְרוֹ כֹהֵן מִדְיָן חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֱלֹהִים לְמֹשֶׁה וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ כִּי הוֹצִיא יְהֹוָה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Jethro, priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard
everything that God had done for Moses and for Israel, His
people, that YHWH had brought Israel out from Egypt.

translation.text: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;

verses.english:
And Jethro, priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard
everything that God had done for Moses and for Israel, His
people, that YHWH had brought Israel out from Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יִתְרוֹ חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה אֶת צִפֹּרָה אֵשֶׁת מֹשֶׁה אַחַר שִׁלּוּחֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח יִתְרוֹ חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה אֶת צִפֹּרָה אֵשֶׁת מֹשֶׁה אַחַר שִׁלּוּחֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took Zipporah, Moses’
wife, after her being sent off,

translation.text: Then Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her back,

verses.english:
And Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took Zipporah, Moses’
wife, after her being sent off,

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שְׁנֵי בָנֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר שֵׁם הָאֶחָד גֵּרְשֹׁם כִּי אָמַר גֵּר הָיִיתִי בְּאֶרֶץ נכְרִיָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שְׁנֵי בָנֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר שֵׁם הָאֶחָד גֵּרְשֹׁם כִּי אָמַר גֵּר הָיִיתִי בְּאֶרֶץ נכְרִיָּה׃

english.text:
and her two sons, of whom one’s name was Gershom, because
he said, “I was an alien in a foreign land,”

translation.text: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:

verses.english:
and her two sons, of whom one’s name was Gershom, because
he said, “I was an alien in a foreign land,”

verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם הָאֶחָד אֱלִיעֶזֶר כִּי אֱלֹהֵי אָבִי בְּעֶזְרִי וַיַּצִּלֵנִי מֵחֶרֶב פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁם הָאֶחָד אֱלִיעֶזֶר כִּי אֱלֹהֵי אָבִי בְּעֶזְרִי וַיַּצִּלֵנִי מֵחֶרֶב פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
and one’s name was Eliezer, “because my father’s God was
my help and rescued me from Pharaoh’s sword.”

translation.text: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:

verses.english:
and one’s name was Eliezer, “because my father’s God was
my help and rescued me from Pharaoh’s sword.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יִתְרוֹ חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה וּבָנָיו וְאִשְׁתּוֹ אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֶל הַמִּדְבָּר אֲשֶׁר הוּא חֹנֶה שָׁם הַר הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יִתְרוֹ חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה וּבָנָיו וְאִשְׁתּוֹ אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֶל הַמִּדְבָּר אֲשֶׁר הוּא חֹנֶה שָׁם הַר הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, and his sons and his
wife came to Moses, to the wilderness in which he was
camping, at the Mountain of God.

translation.text: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:

verses.english:
And Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, and his sons and his
wife came to Moses, to the wilderness in which he was
camping, at the Mountain of God.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֲנִי חֹתֶנְךָ יִתְרוֹ בָּא אֵלֶיךָ וְאִשְׁתְּךָ וּשְׁנֵי בָנֶיהָ עִמָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֲנִי חֹתֶנְךָ יִתְרוֹ בָּא אֵלֶיךָ וְאִשְׁתְּךָ וּשְׁנֵי בָנֶיהָ עִמָּהּ׃

english.text:
And he said to Moses, “I, your father-in-law, Jethro, have
come to you, and your wife and her two sons with her.”

translation.text: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.

verses.english:
And he said to Moses, “I, your father-in-law, Jethro, have
come to you, and your wife and her two sons with her.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא מֹשֶׁה לִקְרַאת חֹתְנוֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ וַיִּשַּׁק לוֹ וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ אִישׁ לְרֵעֵהוּ לְשָׁלוֹם וַיָּבֹאוּ הָאֹהֱלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא מֹשֶׁה לִקְרַאת חֹתְנוֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ וַיִּשַּׁק לוֹ וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ אִישׁ לְרֵעֵהוּ לְשָׁלוֹם וַיָּבֹאוּ הָאֹהֱלָה׃

english.text:
And Moses went out to his father-in-law, and he bowed, and
he kissed him, and they asked each other how they were,
and they came to the tent.

translation.text: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.

verses.english:
And Moses went out to his father-in-law, and he bowed, and
he kissed him, and they asked each other how they were,
and they came to the tent.

verses.hebrew: וַיְסַפֵּר מֹשֶׁה לְחֹתְנוֹ אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לְפַרְעֹה וּלְמִצְרַיִם עַל אוֹדֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל הַתְּלָאָה אֲשֶׁר מְצָאָתַם בַּדֶּרֶךְ וַיַּצִּלֵם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְסַפֵּר מֹשֶׁה לְחֹתְנוֹ אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לְפַרְעֹה וּלְמִצְרַיִם עַל אוֹדֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל הַתְּלָאָה אֲשֶׁר מְצָאָתַם בַּדֶּרֶךְ וַיַּצִּלֵם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Moses told his father-in-law everything that YHWH had
done to Pharaoh and to Egypt with regard to Israel, all
the hardship that had found them on the way, and YHWH
rescued them.

translation.text: And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the LORD delivered them.

verses.english:
And Moses told his father-in-law everything that YHWH had
done to Pharaoh and to Egypt with regard to Israel, all
the hardship that had found them on the way, and YHWH
rescued them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַדְּ יִתְרוֹ עַל כּל הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הִצִּילוֹ מִיַּד מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַדְּ יִתְרוֹ עַל כּל הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הִצִּילוֹ מִיַּד מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Jethro rejoiced over all the good that YHWH had done
for Israel, that He had rescued it from Egypt’s hand.

translation.text: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.

verses.english:
And Jethro rejoiced over all the good that YHWH had done
for Israel, that He had rescued it from Egypt’s hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִתְרוֹ בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הִצִּיל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם וּמִיַּד פַּרְעֹה אֲשֶׁר הִצִּיל אֶת הָעָם מִתַּחַת יַד מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִתְרוֹ בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הִצִּיל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם וּמִיַּד פַּרְעֹה אֲשֶׁר הִצִּיל אֶת הָעָם מִתַּחַת יַד מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And Jethro said, “Blessed is YHWH, who rescued you from
Egypt’s hand and from Pharaoh’s hand, who rescued the
people from under Egypt’s hand:

translation.text: And Jethro said, Blessed be the LORD, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

verses.english:
And Jethro said, “Blessed is YHWH, who rescued you from
Egypt’s hand and from Pharaoh’s hand, who rescued the
people from under Egypt’s hand:

verses.hebrew: עַתָּה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי גָדוֹל יְהֹוָה מִכּל הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי בַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר זָדוּ עֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: עַתָּה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי גָדוֹל יְהֹוָה מִכּל הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי בַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר זָדוּ עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
now I know that YHWH is bigger than all the gods, because
of the thing that they plotted against them.”

translation.text: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.

verses.english:
now I know that YHWH is bigger than all the gods, because
of the thing that they plotted against them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יִתְרוֹ חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה עֹלָה וּזְבָחִים לֵאלֹהִים וַיָּבֹא אַהֲרֹן וְכֹל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֶאֱכל לֶחֶם עִם חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח יִתְרוֹ חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה עֹלָה וּזְבָחִים לֵאלֹהִים וַיָּבֹא אַהֲרֹן וְכֹל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֶאֱכל לֶחֶם עִם חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering
and sacrifices to God. And Aaron and all of Israel’s
elders came to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before
God.

translation.text: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father in law before God.

verses.english:
And Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering
and sacrifices to God. And Aaron and all of Israel’s
elders came to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before
God.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיֵּשֶׁב מֹשֶׁה לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת הָעָם וַיַּעֲמֹד הָעָם עַל מֹשֶׁה מִן הַבֹּקֶר עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיֵּשֶׁב מֹשֶׁה לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת הָעָם וַיַּעֲמֹד הָעָם עַל מֹשֶׁה מִן הַבֹּקֶר עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And it was the next day, and Moses sat to judge the
people. And the people stood by Moses from the morning to
the evening.

translation.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.

verses.english:
And it was the next day, and Moses sat to judge the
people. And the people stood by Moses from the morning to
the evening.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר הוּא עֹשֶׂה לָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה לָעָם מַדּוּעַ אַתָּה יוֹשֵׁב לְבַדֶּךָ וְכל הָעָם נִצָּב עָלֶיךָ מִן בֹּקֶר עַד עָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר הוּא עֹשֶׂה לָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה לָעָם מַדּוּעַ אַתָּה יוֹשֵׁב לְבַדֶּךָ וְכל הָעָם נִצָּב עָלֶיךָ מִן בֹּקֶר עַד עָרֶב׃

english.text:
And Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he was doing for the
people, and he said, “What’s this thing that you’re doing
for the people? Why are you sitting by yourself, and the
entire people is standing up by you from morning until
evening?”

translation.text: And when Moses’ father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?

verses.english:
And Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he was doing for the
people, and he said, “What’s this thing that you’re doing
for the people? Why are you sitting by yourself, and the
entire people is standing up by you from morning until
evening?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לְחֹתְנוֹ כִּי יָבֹא אֵלַי הָעָם לִדְרֹשׁ אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לְחֹתְנוֹ כִּי יָבֹא אֵלַי הָעָם לִדְרֹשׁ אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people
come to me to inquire of God.

translation.text: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:

verses.english:
And Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people
come to me to inquire of God.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִהְיֶה לָהֶם דָּבָר בָּא אֵלַי וְשָׁפַטְתִּי בֵּין אִישׁ וּבֵין רֵעֵהוּ וְהוֹדַעְתִּי אֶת חֻקֵּי הָאֱלֹהִים וְאֶת תּוֹרֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִהְיֶה לָהֶם דָּבָר בָּא אֵלַי וְשָׁפַטְתִּי בֵּין אִישׁ וּבֵין רֵעֵהוּ וְהוֹדַעְתִּי אֶת חֻקֵּי הָאֱלֹהִים וְאֶת תּוֹרֹתָיו׃

english.text:
When they have a matter, it comes to me, and I judge
between each one and his companion, and I make known God’s
laws and His instructions.”

translation.text: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.

verses.english:
When they have a matter, it comes to me, and I judge
between each one and his companion, and I make known God’s
laws and His instructions.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה אֵלָיו לֹא טוֹב הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה אֵלָיו לֹא טוֹב הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה׃

english.text:
And Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that
you’re doing isn’t good.

translation.text: And Moses’ father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.

verses.english:
And Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that
you’re doing isn’t good.

verses.hebrew: נָבֹל תִּבֹּל גַּם אַתָּה גַּם הָעָם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עִמָּךְ כִּי כָבֵד מִמְּךָ הַדָּבָר לֹא תוּכַל עֲשֹׂהוּ לְבַדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: נָבֹל תִּבֹּל גַּם אַתָּה גַּם הָעָם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עִמָּךְ כִּי כָבֵד מִמְּךָ הַדָּבָר לֹא תוּכַל עֲשֹׂהוּ לְבַדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
You’ll be worn out, both you and this people who are with
you, because the thing is too heavy for you. You won’t be
able to do it by yourself.

translation.text: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.

verses.english:
You’ll be worn out, both you and this people who are with
you, because the thing is too heavy for you. You won’t be
able to do it by yourself.

verses.hebrew: עַתָּה שְׁמַע בְּקֹלִי אִיעָצְךָ וִיהִי אֱלֹהִים עִמָּךְ הֱיֵה אַתָּה לָעָם מוּל הָאֱלֹהִים וְהֵבֵאתָ אַתָּה אֶת הַדְּבָרִים אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: עַתָּה שְׁמַע בְּקֹלִי אִיעָצְךָ וִיהִי אֱלֹהִים עִמָּךְ הֱיֵה אַתָּה לָעָם מוּל הָאֱלֹהִים וְהֵבֵאתָ אַתָּה אֶת הַדְּבָרִים אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
Now listen to my voice, and I’ll advise you, and may God
be with you. You be for the people toward God, and you
will bring the matters to God.

translation.text: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:

verses.english:
Now listen to my voice, and I’ll advise you, and may God
be with you. You be for the people toward God, and you
will bring the matters to God.

verses.hebrew: וְהִזְהַרְתָּה אֶתְהֶם אֶת הַחֻקִּים וְאֶת הַתּוֹרֹת וְהוֹדַעְתָּ לָהֶם אֶת הַדֶּרֶךְ יֵלְכוּ בָהּ וְאֶת הַמַּעֲשֶׂה אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּן׃

hebrew.text: וְהִזְהַרְתָּה אֶתְהֶם אֶת הַחֻקִּים וְאֶת הַתּוֹרֹת וְהוֹדַעְתָּ לָהֶם אֶת הַדֶּרֶךְ יֵלְכוּ בָהּ וְאֶת הַמַּעֲשֶׂה אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּן׃

english.text:
And you’ll enlighten them with the laws and the
instructions, and you’ll make known to them the way in
which they’ll go and the thing that they’ll do.

translation.text: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.

verses.english:
And you’ll enlighten them with the laws and the
instructions, and you’ll make known to them the way in
which they’ll go and the thing that they’ll do.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תֶחֱזֶה מִכּל הָעָם אַנְשֵׁי חַיִל יִרְאֵי אֱלֹהִים אַנְשֵׁי אֱמֶת שֹׂנְאֵי בָצַע וְשַׂמְתָּ עֲלֵהֶם שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים שָׂרֵי מֵאוֹת שָׂרֵי חֲמִשִּׁים וְשָׂרֵי עֲשָׂרֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה תֶחֱזֶה מִכּל הָעָם אַנְשֵׁי חַיִל יִרְאֵי אֱלֹהִים אַנְשֵׁי אֱמֶת שֹׂנְאֵי בָצַע וְשַׂמְתָּ עֲלֵהֶם שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים שָׂרֵי מֵאוֹת שָׂרֵי חֲמִשִּׁים וְשָׂרֵי עֲשָׂרֹת׃

english.text:
And you will envision, out of all the people, worthy men,
who fear God, men of truth, who hate bribery, and you’ll
set chiefs of thousands, chiefs of hundreds, chiefs of
fifties, and chiefs of tens over them.

translation.text: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:

verses.english:
And you will envision, out of all the people, worthy men,
who fear God, men of truth, who hate bribery, and you’ll
set chiefs of thousands, chiefs of hundreds, chiefs of
fifties, and chiefs of tens over them.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁפְטוּ אֶת הָעָם בְּכל עֵת וְהָיָה כּל הַדָּבָר הַגָּדֹל יָבִיאוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְכל הַדָּבָר הַקָּטֹן יִשְׁפְּטוּ הֵם וְהָקֵל מֵעָלֶיךָ וְנָשְׂאוּ אִתָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁפְטוּ אֶת הָעָם בְּכל עֵת וְהָיָה כּל הַדָּבָר הַגָּדֹל יָבִיאוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְכל הַדָּבָר הַקָּטֹן יִשְׁפְּטוּ הֵם וְהָקֵל מֵעָלֶיךָ וְנָשְׂאוּ אִתָּךְ׃

english.text:
And they’ll judge the people at all times. And it will be:
they’ll bring every matter that is big to you, and they
will judge every matter that is small. And make it lighter
on you, and they’ll bear it with you.

translation.text: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.

verses.english:
And they’ll judge the people at all times. And it will be:
they’ll bring every matter that is big to you, and they
will judge every matter that is small. And make it lighter
on you, and they’ll bear it with you.

verses.hebrew: אִם אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה תַּעֲשֶׂה וְצִוְּךָ אֱלֹהִים וְיָכלְתָּ עֲמֹד וְגַם כּל הָעָם הַזֶּה עַל מְקֹמוֹ יָבֹא בְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: אִם אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה תַּעֲשֶׂה וְצִוְּךָ אֱלֹהִים וְיָכלְתָּ עֲמֹד וְגַם כּל הָעָם הַזֶּה עַל מְקֹמוֹ יָבֹא בְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
If you’ll do this thing, and YHWH will command you, then
you’ll be able to stand, and also this entire people will
come to its place in peace.”

translation.text: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.

verses.english:
If you’ll do this thing, and YHWH will command you, then
you’ll be able to stand, and also this entire people will
come to its place in peace.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע מֹשֶׁה לְקוֹל חֹתְנוֹ וַיַּעַשׂ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר אָמָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע מֹשֶׁה לְקוֹל חֹתְנוֹ וַיַּעַשׂ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר אָמָר׃

english.text:
And Moses listened to his father-in-law’s voice and did
everything that he had said.

translation.text: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.

verses.english:
And Moses listened to his father-in-law’s voice and did
everything that he had said.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְחַר מֹשֶׁה אַנְשֵׁי חַיִל מִכּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָם רָאשִׁים עַל הָעָם שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים שָׂרֵי מֵאוֹת שָׂרֵי חֲמִשִּׁים וְשָׂרֵי עֲשָׂרֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְחַר מֹשֶׁה אַנְשֵׁי חַיִל מִכּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָם רָאשִׁים עַל הָעָם שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים שָׂרֵי מֵאוֹת שָׂרֵי חֲמִשִּׁים וְשָׂרֵי עֲשָׂרֹת׃

english.text:
And Moses chose worthy men out of all of Israel and made
them heads over the people: chiefs of thousands, chiefs of
hundreds, chiefs of fifties, and chiefs of tens.

translation.text: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

verses.english:
And Moses chose worthy men out of all of Israel and made
them heads over the people: chiefs of thousands, chiefs of
hundreds, chiefs of fifties, and chiefs of tens.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁפְטוּ אֶת הָעָם בְּכל עֵת אֶת הַדָּבָר הַקָּשֶׁה יְבִיאוּן אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְכל הַדָּבָר הַקָּטֹן יִשְׁפּוּטוּ הֵם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁפְטוּ אֶת הָעָם בְּכל עֵת אֶת הַדָּבָר הַקָּשֶׁה יְבִיאוּן אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְכל הַדָּבָר הַקָּטֹן יִשְׁפּוּטוּ הֵם׃

english.text:
And they judged the people at all times. They would bring
the matter that was hard to Moses, and they would judge
every matter that was small.

translation.text: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

verses.english:
And they judged the people at all times. They would bring
the matter that was hard to Moses, and they would judge
every matter that was small.

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת חֹתְנוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ לוֹ אֶל אַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁלַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת חֹתְנוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ לוֹ אֶל אַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
And Moses let his father-in-law go, and he went to his
land.
