translation.text: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.

verses.english:
And Moses let his father-in-law go, and he went to his
land.

verses.hebrew: בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לְצֵאת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה בָּאוּ מִדְבַּר סִינָי׃

hebrew.text: בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לְצֵאת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה בָּאוּ מִדְבַּר סִינָי׃

english.text:
In the third month after the exodus of the children of
Israel from the land of Egypt, on this day, they came to
the wilderness of Sinai.

translation.text: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.english:
In the third month after the exodus of the children of
Israel from the land of Egypt, on this day, they came to
the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרְפִידִים וַיָּבֹאוּ מִדְבַּר סִינַי וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיִּחַן שָׁם יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶגֶד הָהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרְפִידִים וַיָּבֹאוּ מִדְבַּר סִינַי וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיִּחַן שָׁם יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶגֶד הָהָר׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Rephidim and came to the wilderness
of Sinai and camped in the wilderness. And Israel camped
there opposite the mountain.

translation.text: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Rephidim and came to the wilderness
of Sinai and camped in the wilderness. And Israel camped
there opposite the mountain.

verses.hebrew: וּמֹשֶׁה עָלָה אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּקְרָא אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה מִן הָהָר לֵאמֹר כֹּה תֹאמַר לְבֵית יַעֲקֹב וְתַגֵּיד לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּמֹשֶׁה עָלָה אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּקְרָא אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה מִן הָהָר לֵאמֹר כֹּה תֹאמַר לְבֵית יַעֲקֹב וְתַגֵּיד לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses had gone up to God. And YHWH called to him from
the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall say to the
house of Jacob and tell to the children of Israel:

translation.text: And Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;

verses.english:
And Moses had gone up to God. And YHWH called to him from
the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall say to the
house of Jacob and tell to the children of Israel:

verses.hebrew: אַתֶּם רְאִיתֶם אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי לְמִצְרָיִם וָאֶשָּׂא אֶתְכֶם עַל כַּנְפֵי נְשָׁרִים וָאָבִא אֶתְכֶם אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: אַתֶּם רְאִיתֶם אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי לְמִצְרָיִם וָאֶשָּׂא אֶתְכֶם עַל כַּנְפֵי נְשָׁרִים וָאָבִא אֶתְכֶם אֵלָי׃

english.text:
‘You’ve seen what I did to Egypt, and I carried you on
eagles’ wings and brought you to me.

translation.text: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.

verses.english:
‘You’ve seen what I did to Egypt, and I carried you on
eagles’ wings and brought you to me.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אִם שָׁמוֹעַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ בְּקֹלִי וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת בְּרִיתִי וִהְיִיתֶם לִי סְגֻלָּה מִכּל הָעַמִּים כִּי לִי כּל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אִם שָׁמוֹעַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ בְּקֹלִי וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת בְּרִיתִי וִהְיִיתֶם לִי סְגֻלָּה מִכּל הָעַמִּים כִּי לִי כּל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And now, if you’ll listen to my voice and observe my
covenant, then you’ll be a treasure to me out of all the
peoples, because all the earth is mine.

translation.text: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:

verses.english:
And now, if you’ll listen to my voice and observe my
covenant, then you’ll be a treasure to me out of all the
peoples, because all the earth is mine.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ לִי מַמְלֶכֶת כֹּהֲנִים וְגוֹי קָדוֹשׁ אֵלֶּה הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר תְּדַבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ לִי מַמְלֶכֶת כֹּהֲנִים וְגוֹי קָדוֹשׁ אֵלֶּה הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר תְּדַבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And you’ll be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation to
me.’ These are the words that you shall speak to the
children of Israel.”

translation.text: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation.

verses.english:
And you’ll be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation to
me.’ These are the words that you shall speak to the
children of Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וַיִּקְרָא לְזִקְנֵי הָעָם וַיָּשֶׂם לִפְנֵיהֶם אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וַיִּקְרָא לְזִקְנֵי הָעָם וַיָּשֶׂם לִפְנֵיהֶם אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Moses came and called the people’s elders and set
before them all these words that YHWH had commanded him.

translation.text: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.

verses.english:
And Moses came and called the people’s elders and set
before them all these words that YHWH had commanded him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנוּ כל הָעָם יַחְדָּו וַיֹּאמְרוּ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה נַעֲשֶׂה וַיָּשֶׁב מֹשֶׁה אֶת דִּבְרֵי הָעָם אֶל יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲנוּ כל הָעָם יַחְדָּו וַיֹּאמְרוּ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה נַעֲשֶׂה וַיָּשֶׁב מֹשֶׁה אֶת דִּבְרֵי הָעָם אֶל יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And all the people responded together, and they said,
“We’ll do everything that YHWH has spoken.” And Moses
brought back the people’s words to YHWH.

translation.text: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And all the people responded together, and they said,
“We’ll do everything that YHWH has spoken.” And Moses
brought back the people’s words to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי בָּא אֵלֶיךָ בְּעַב הֶעָנָן בַּעֲבוּר יִשְׁמַע הָעָם בְּדַבְּרִי עִמָּךְ וְגַם בְּךָ יַאֲמִינוּ לְעוֹלָם וַיַּגֵּד מֹשֶׁה אֶת דִּבְרֵי הָעָם אֶל יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי בָּא אֵלֶיךָ בְּעַב הֶעָנָן בַּעֲבוּר יִשְׁמַע הָעָם בְּדַבְּרִי עִמָּךְ וְגַם בְּךָ יַאֲמִינוּ לְעוֹלָם וַיַּגֵּד מֹשֶׁה אֶת דִּבְרֵי הָעָם אֶל יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Here, I am coming to you in a
mass of cloud for the purpose that the people will hear
when I am speaking with you, and they will believe in you
as well forever.” And Moses told the people’s words to
YHWH.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Here, I am coming to you in a
mass of cloud for the purpose that the people will hear
when I am speaking with you, and they will believe in you
as well forever.” And Moses told the people’s words to
YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵךְ אֶל הָעָם וְקִדַּשְׁתָּם הַיּוֹם וּמָחָר וְכִבְּסוּ שִׂמְלֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵךְ אֶל הָעָם וְקִדַּשְׁתָּם הַיּוֹם וּמָחָר וְכִבְּסוּ שִׂמְלֹתָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Go to the people and consecrate
them today and tomorrow; and they shall wash their clothes

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Go to the people and consecrate
them today and tomorrow; and they shall wash their clothes

verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ נְכֹנִים לַיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי כִּי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִשִׁי יֵרֵד יְהֹוָה לְעֵינֵי כל הָעָם עַל הַר סִינָי׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ נְכֹנִים לַיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי כִּי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִשִׁי יֵרֵד יְהֹוָה לְעֵינֵי כל הָעָם עַל הַר סִינָי׃

english.text:
and be ready for the third day, because on the third day
YHWH will come down on Mount Sinai before the eyes of all
the people.

translation.text: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.

verses.english:
and be ready for the third day, because on the third day
YHWH will come down on Mount Sinai before the eyes of all
the people.

verses.hebrew: וְהִגְבַּלְתָּ אֶת הָעָם סָבִיב לֵאמֹר הִשָּׁמְרוּ לָכֶם עֲלוֹת בָּהָר וּנְגֹעַ בְּקָצֵהוּ כּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהָר מוֹת יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וְהִגְבַּלְתָּ אֶת הָעָם סָבִיב לֵאמֹר הִשָּׁמְרוּ לָכֶם עֲלוֹת בָּהָר וּנְגֹעַ בְּקָצֵהוּ כּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהָר מוֹת יוּמָת׃

english.text:
And you shall limit the people all around, saying, ‘Watch
yourselves about going up in the mountain and touching its
edge. Anyone who touches the mountain shall be put to
death.

translation.text: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:

verses.english:
And you shall limit the people all around, saying, ‘Watch
yourselves about going up in the mountain and touching its
edge. Anyone who touches the mountain shall be put to
death.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִגַּע בּוֹ יָד כִּי סָקוֹל יִסָּקֵל אוֹ יָרֹה יִיָּרֶה אִם בְּהֵמָה אִם אִישׁ לֹא יִחְיֶה בִּמְשֹׁךְ הַיֹּבֵל הֵמָּה יַעֲלוּ בָהָר׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִגַּע בּוֹ יָד כִּי סָקוֹל יִסָּקֵל אוֹ יָרֹה יִיָּרֶה אִם בְּהֵמָה אִם אִישׁ לֹא יִחְיֶה בִּמְשֹׁךְ הַיֹּבֵל הֵמָּה יַעֲלוּ בָהָר׃

english.text:
A hand shall not touch him, but he shall be stoned or
shot. Whether animal or man, he will not live.’ At the
blowing of the horn they shall go up the mountain.”

translation.text: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.

verses.english:
A hand shall not touch him, but he shall be stoned or
shot. Whether animal or man, he will not live.’ At the
blowing of the horn they shall go up the mountain.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד מֹשֶׁה מִן הָהָר אֶל הָעָם וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת הָעָם וַיְכַבְּסוּ שִׂמְלֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד מֹשֶׁה מִן הָהָר אֶל הָעָם וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת הָעָם וַיְכַבְּסוּ שִׂמְלֹתָם׃

english.text:
And Moses went down from the mountain to the people. And
he consecrated the people, and they washed their clothes.

translation.text: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

verses.english:
And Moses went down from the mountain to the people. And
he consecrated the people, and they washed their clothes.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל הָעָם הֱיוּ נְכֹנִים לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים אַל תִּגְּשׁוּ אֶל אִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל הָעָם הֱיוּ נְכֹנִים לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים אַל תִּגְּשׁוּ אֶל אִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
And he said to the people, “Be ready for three days. Don’t
come close to a woman.”

translation.text: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.

verses.english:
And he said to the people, “Be ready for three days. Don’t
come close to a woman.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בִּהְיֹת הַבֹּקֶר וַיְהִי קֹלֹת וּבְרָקִים וְעָנָן כָּבֵד עַל הָהָר וְקֹל שֹׁפָר חָזָק מְאֹד וַיֶּחֱרַד כּל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בִּהְיֹת הַבֹּקֶר וַיְהִי קֹלֹת וּבְרָקִים וְעָנָן כָּבֵד עַל הָהָר וְקֹל שֹׁפָר חָזָק מְאֹד וַיֶּחֱרַד כּל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And it was on the third day, when it was morning, and it
was: thunders and lightning and a heavy cloud on the
mountain, and a sound of a horn, very strong. And the
entire people that was in the camp trembled.

translation.text: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.

verses.english:
And it was on the third day, when it was morning, and it
was: thunders and lightning and a heavy cloud on the
mountain, and a sound of a horn, very strong. And the
entire people that was in the camp trembled.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצֵא מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָעָם לִקְרַאת הָאֱלֹהִים מִן הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיִּתְיַצְּבוּ בְּתַחְתִּית הָהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹצֵא מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָעָם לִקְרַאת הָאֱלֹהִים מִן הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיִּתְיַצְּבוּ בְּתַחְתִּית הָהָר׃

english.text:
And Moses brought out the people toward God from the camp,
and they stood up at the bottom of the mountain.

translation.text: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.

verses.english:
And Moses brought out the people toward God from the camp,
and they stood up at the bottom of the mountain.

verses.hebrew: וְהַר סִינַי עָשַׁן כֻּלּוֹ מִפְּנֵי אֲשֶׁר יָרַד עָלָיו יְהֹוָה בָּאֵשׁ וַיַּעַל עֲשָׁנוֹ כְּעֶשֶׁן הַכִּבְשָׁן וַיֶּחֱרַד כּל הָהָר מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְהַר סִינַי עָשַׁן כֻּלּוֹ מִפְּנֵי אֲשֶׁר יָרַד עָלָיו יְהֹוָה בָּאֵשׁ וַיַּעַל עֲשָׁנוֹ כְּעֶשֶׁן הַכִּבְשָׁן וַיֶּחֱרַד כּל הָהָר מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And Mount Sinai was all smoke because YHWH came down on it
in fire, and its smoke went up like the smoke of a
furnace, and the whole mountain trembled greatly.

translation.text: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.

verses.english:
And Mount Sinai was all smoke because YHWH came down on it
in fire, and its smoke went up like the smoke of a
furnace, and the whole mountain trembled greatly.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר הוֹלֵךְ וְחָזֵק מְאֹד מֹשֶׁה יְדַבֵּר וְהָאֱלֹהִים יַעֲנֶנּוּ בְקוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר הוֹלֵךְ וְחָזֵק מְאֹד מֹשֶׁה יְדַבֵּר וְהָאֱלֹהִים יַעֲנֶנּוּ בְקוֹל׃

english.text:
And the sound of the horn was getting much stronger. Moses
would speak, and God would answer him in a voice.

translation.text: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.

verses.english:
And the sound of the horn was getting much stronger. Moses
would speak, and God would answer him in a voice.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד יְהֹוָה עַל הַר סִינַי אֶל רֹאשׁ הָהָר וַיִּקְרָא יְהֹוָה לְמֹשֶׁה אֶל רֹאשׁ הָהָר וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד יְהֹוָה עַל הַר סִינַי אֶל רֹאשׁ הָהָר וַיִּקְרָא יְהֹוָה לְמֹשֶׁה אֶל רֹאשׁ הָהָר וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And YHWH came down on Mount Sinai, at the top of the
mountain, and YHWH called to Moses at the top of the
mountain, and Moses went up.

translation.text: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.

verses.english:
And YHWH came down on Mount Sinai, at the top of the
mountain, and YHWH called to Moses at the top of the
mountain, and Moses went up.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה רֵד הָעֵד בָּעָם פֶּן יֶהֶרְסוּ אֶל יְהֹוָה לִרְאוֹת וְנָפַל מִמֶּנּוּ רָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה רֵד הָעֵד בָּעָם פֶּן יֶהֶרְסוּ אֶל יְהֹוָה לִרְאוֹת וְנָפַל מִמֶּנּוּ רָב׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Go down. Warn the people in case
they break through to YHWH, to see, and many of them fall.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Go down. Warn the people in case
they break through to YHWH, to see, and many of them fall.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם הַכֹּהֲנִים הַנִּגָּשִׁים אֶל יְהֹוָה יִתְקַדָּשׁוּ פֶּן יִפְרֹץ בָּהֶם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם הַכֹּהֲנִים הַנִּגָּשִׁים אֶל יְהֹוָה יִתְקַדָּשׁוּ פֶּן יִפְרֹץ בָּהֶם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And also let the priests who approach YHWH consecrate
themselves, or else YHWH will break out against them.”

translation.text: And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.

verses.english:
And also let the priests who approach YHWH consecrate
themselves, or else YHWH will break out against them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה לֹא יוּכַל הָעָם לַעֲלֹת אֶל הַר סִינָי כִּי אַתָּה הַעֵדֹתָה בָּנוּ לֵאמֹר הַגְבֵּל אֶת הָהָר וְקִדַּשְׁתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה לֹא יוּכַל הָעָם לַעֲלֹת אֶל הַר סִינָי כִּי אַתָּה הַעֵדֹתָה בָּנוּ לֵאמֹר הַגְבֵּל אֶת הָהָר וְקִדַּשְׁתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Moses said to YHWH, “The people is not able to go up
to Mount Sinai, because you warned us, saying, ‘Limit the
mountain and consecrate it.’”

translation.text: And Moses said unto the LORD, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.

verses.english:
And Moses said to YHWH, “The people is not able to go up
to Mount Sinai, because you warned us, saying, ‘Limit the
mountain and consecrate it.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה לֶךְ רֵד וְעָלִיתָ אַתָּה וְאַהֲרֹן עִמָּךְ וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהָעָם אַל יֶהֶרְסוּ לַעֲלֹת אֶל יְהֹוָה פֶּן יִפְרץ בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה לֶךְ רֵד וְעָלִיתָ אַתָּה וְאַהֲרֹן עִמָּךְ וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהָעָם אַל יֶהֶרְסוּ לַעֲלֹת אֶל יְהֹוָה פֶּן יִפְרץ בָּם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to him, “Go. Go down. Then you’ll come up,
you and Aaron with you. And let the priests and the people
not break through to come up to YHWH, or else He’ll break
out against them.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD, lest he break forth upon them.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to him, “Go. Go down. Then you’ll come up,
you and Aaron with you. And let the priests and the people
not break through to come up to YHWH, or else He’ll break
out against them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם׃

english.text: And Moses went down to the people, and he said it to them.

translation.text: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.

verses.english: And Moses went down to the people, and he said it to them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֱלֹהִים אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר אֱלֹהִים אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And God spoke all these words, saying:

translation.text: And God spake all these words, saying,

verses.english: And God spoke all these words, saying:

verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִ͏ים׃

hebrew.text: אָנֹכִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִ͏ים׃

english.text:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt, from a house of slaves.

translation.text: I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

verses.english:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt, from a house of slaves.

verses.hebrew: לֹא יִהְיֶ͏ה לְךָ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים עַל פָּנָ͏ַי׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יִהְיֶ͏ה לְךָ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים עַל פָּנָ͏ַי׃

english.text: You shall not have other gods before my face.

translation.text: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

verses.english: You shall not have other gods before my face.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה לְךָ פֶסֶל וְכל תְּמוּנָה אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וַאֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ מִתָּ͏ַחַת וַאֲשֶׁר בַּמַּיִם מִתַּחַת לָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה לְךָ פֶסֶל וְכל תְּמוּנָה אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וַאֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ מִתָּ͏ַחַת וַאֲשֶׁר בַּמַּיִם מִתַּחַת לָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
You shall not make a statue or any form that is in the
skies above or that is in the earth below or that is in
the water below the earth.

translation.text: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.

verses.english:
You shall not make a statue or any form that is in the
skies above or that is in the earth below or that is in
the water below the earth.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לָהֶם וְלֹא תעבְדֵם כִּי אָנֹכִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵל קַנָּא פֹּקֵד עֲוֺן אָבֹת עַל בָּנִים עַל שִׁלֵּשִׁים וְעַל רִבֵּעִים לְשֹׂנְאָי׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לָהֶם וְלֹא תעבְדֵם כִּי אָנֹכִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵל קַנָּא פֹּקֵד עֲוֺן אָבֹת עַל בָּנִים עַל שִׁלֵּשִׁים וְעַל רִבֵּעִים לְשֹׂנְאָי׃

english.text:
You shall not bow to them, and you shall not serve them.
Because I, YHWH, your God, am a jealous God, counting
parents’ crime on children, on the third generation, and
on the fourth generation of those who hate me,

translation.text: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;

verses.english:
You shall not bow to them, and you shall not serve them.
Because I, YHWH, your God, am a jealous God, counting
parents’ crime on children, on the third generation, and
on the fourth generation of those who hate me,

verses.hebrew: וְעֹשֶׂה חֶסֶד לַאֲלָפִים לְאֹהֲבַי וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי מִצְוֺתָי׃

hebrew.text: וְעֹשֶׂה חֶסֶד לַאֲלָפִים לְאֹהֲבַי וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי מִצְוֺתָי׃

english.text:
but practicing kindness to thousands for those who love me
and for those who observe my commandments.

translation.text: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.

verses.english:
but practicing kindness to thousands for those who love me
and for those who observe my commandments.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִשָּׂא אֶת שֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַשָּׁוְא כִּי לֹא יְנַקֶּה יְהֹוָה אֵת אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׂא אֶת שְׁמוֹ לַשָּׁוְא׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִשָּׂא אֶת שֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַשָּׁוְא כִּי לֹא יְנַקֶּה יְהֹוָה אֵת אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׂא אֶת שְׁמוֹ לַשָּׁוְא׃

english.text:
You shall not bring up the name of YHWH, your God, for a
falsehood, because YHWH will not make one innocent who
will bring up His name for a falsehood.

translation.text: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

verses.english:
You shall not bring up the name of YHWH, your God, for a
falsehood, because YHWH will not make one innocent who
will bring up His name for a falsehood.

verses.hebrew: זָכוֹר אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת לְקַדְּשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: זָכוֹר אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת לְקַדְּשׁוֹ׃

english.text: Remember the Sabbath day, to make it holy.

translation.text: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

verses.english: Remember the Sabbath day, to make it holy.

verses.hebrew: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תַּעֲבֹד וְעָשִׂיתָ כּל מְלַאכְתֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תַּעֲבֹד וְעָשִׂיתָ כּל מְלַאכְתֶּךָ׃

english.text: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

translation.text: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:

verses.english: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבָּת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה כל מְלָאכָה אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ͏ וּבִתֶּךָ עַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתְךָ וּבְהֶמְתֶּךָ וְגֵרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבָּת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה כל מְלָאכָה אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ͏ וּבִתֶּךָ עַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתְךָ וּבְהֶמְתֶּךָ וְגֵרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

english.text:
and the seventh day is a Sabbath to YHWH, your God. You
shall not do any work: you and your son and your daughter,
your servant and your maid and your animal and your alien
who is in your gates.

translation.text: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:

verses.english:
and the seventh day is a Sabbath to YHWH, your God. You
shall not do any work: you and your son and your daughter,
your servant and your maid and your animal and your alien
who is in your gates.

verses.hebrew: כִּי שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ אֶת הַיָּם וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בָּם וַיָּנַח בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי עַל כֵּן בֵּרַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת וַיְקַדְּשֵׁהוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ אֶת הַיָּם וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בָּם וַיָּנַח בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי עַל כֵּן בֵּרַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת וַיְקַדְּשֵׁהוּ׃

english.text:
Because for six days YHWH made the skies and the earth,
the sea, and everything that is in them, and He rested on
the seventh day. On account of this, YHWH blessed the
Sabbath day and made it holy.

translation.text: For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

verses.english:
Because for six days YHWH made the skies and the earth,
the sea, and everything that is in them, and He rested on
the seventh day. On account of this, YHWH blessed the
Sabbath day and made it holy.

verses.hebrew: כַּבֵּד אֶת אָבִיךָ וְאֶת אִמֶּךָ לְמַעַן יַאֲרִכוּן יָמֶיךָ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: כַּבֵּד אֶת אָבִיךָ וְאֶת אִמֶּךָ לְמַעַן יַאֲרִכוּן יָמֶיךָ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

english.text:
Honor your father and your mother, so that your days will
be extended on the land that YHWH, your God, is giving
you.

translation.text: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

verses.english:
Honor your father and your mother, so that your days will
be extended on the land that YHWH, your God, is giving
you.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִּרְצָ͏ח׃ ס לֹא תִּנְאָ͏ף׃ ס לֹא תִּגְנֹב׃ ס לֹא תַעֲנֶה בְרֵעֲךָ עֵד שָׁקֶר׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִּרְצָ͏ח׃ ס לֹא תִּנְאָ͏ף׃ ס לֹא תִּגְנֹב׃ ס לֹא תַעֲנֶה בְרֵעֲךָ עֵד שָׁקֶר׃

english.text:
You shall not murder. You shall not commit adultery. You
shall not steal. You shall not testify against your
neighbor as a lying witness.

translation.text: Thou shalt not kill.

verses.english:
You shall not murder. You shall not commit adultery. You
shall not steal. You shall not testify against your
neighbor as a lying witness.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תַחְמֹד בֵּית רֵעֶךָ ס לֹא תַחְמֹד אֵשֶׁת רֵעֶךָ וְעַבְדּוֹ וַאֲמָתוֹ וְשׁוֹרוֹ וַחֲמֹרוֹ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לְרֵעֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַחְמֹד בֵּית רֵעֶךָ ס לֹא תַחְמֹד אֵשֶׁת רֵעֶךָ וְעַבְדּוֹ וַאֲמָתוֹ וְשׁוֹרוֹ וַחֲמֹרוֹ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לְרֵעֶךָ׃

english.text:
You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not
covet your neighbor’s wife or his servant or his maid or
his ox or his ass or anything that your neighbor has.

translation.text: Thou shalt not commit adultery.

verses.english:
You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not
covet your neighbor’s wife or his servant or his maid or
his ox or his ass or anything that your neighbor has.

verses.hebrew: וְכל הָעָם רֹאִים אֶת הַקּוֹלֹת וְאֶת הַלַּפִּידִם וְאֵת קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר וְאֶת הָהָר עָשֵׁן וַיַּרְא הָעָם וַיָּנֻעוּ וַיַּעַמְדוּ מֵרָחֹק׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הָעָם רֹאִים אֶת הַקּוֹלֹת וְאֶת הַלַּפִּידִם וְאֵת קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר וְאֶת הָהָר עָשֵׁן וַיַּרְא הָעָם וַיָּנֻעוּ וַיַּעַמְדוּ מֵרָחֹק׃

english.text:
And all the people were seeing the thunders and the
flashes and the sound of the horn and the mountain
smoking. And the people saw, and they moved and stood at a
distance,

translation.text: Thou shalt not steal.

verses.english:
And all the people were seeing the thunders and the
flashes and the sound of the horn and the mountain
smoking. And the people saw, and they moved and stood at a
distance,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה דַּבֵּר אַתָּה עִמָּנוּ וְנִשְׁמָעָה וְאַל יְדַבֵּר עִמָּנוּ אֱלֹהִים פֶּן נָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה דַּבֵּר אַתָּה עִמָּנוּ וְנִשְׁמָעָה וְאַל יְדַבֵּר עִמָּנוּ אֱלֹהִים פֶּן נָמוּת׃

english.text:
and they said to Moses, “You speak with us so we may
listen, but let God not speak with us or else we’ll die.”

translation.text: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.

verses.english:
and they said to Moses, “You speak with us so we may
listen, but let God not speak with us or else we’ll die.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעָם אַל תִּירָאוּ כִּי לְבַעֲבוּר נַסּוֹת אֶתְכֶם בָּא הָאֱלֹהִים וּבַעֲבוּר תִּהְיֶה יִרְאָתוֹ עַל פְּנֵיכֶם לְבִלְתִּי תֶחֱטָאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעָם אַל תִּירָאוּ כִּי לְבַעֲבוּר נַסּוֹת אֶתְכֶם בָּא הָאֱלֹהִים וּבַעֲבוּר תִּהְיֶה יִרְאָתוֹ עַל פְּנֵיכֶם לְבִלְתִּי תֶחֱטָאוּ׃

english.text:
And Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, because
God is coming for the purpose of testing you and for the
purpose that his fear will be on your faces so that you
won’t sin.”

translation.text: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour’s.

verses.english:
And Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, because
God is coming for the purpose of testing you and for the
purpose that his fear will be on your faces so that you
won’t sin.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד הָעָם מֵרָחֹק וּמֹשֶׁה נִגַּשׁ אֶל הָעֲרָפֶל אֲשֶׁר שָׁם הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲמֹד הָעָם מֵרָחֹק וּמֹשֶׁה נִגַּשׁ אֶל הָעֲרָפֶל אֲשֶׁר שָׁם הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And the people stood at a distance, and Moses went over to
the nimbus where God was.

translation.text: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.

verses.english:
And the people stood at a distance, and Moses went over to
the nimbus where God was.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה כֹּה תֹאמַר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתֶּם רְאִיתֶם כִּי מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם דִּבַּרְתִּי עִמָּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה כֹּה תֹאמַר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתֶּם רְאִיתֶם כִּי מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם דִּבַּרְתִּי עִמָּכֶם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “You shall say this to the
children of Israel: You have seen that I have spoken with
you from the skies.

translation.text: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “You shall say this to the
children of Israel: You have seen that I have spoken with
you from the skies.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּן אִתִּי אֱלֹהֵי כֶסֶף וֵאלֹהֵי זָהָב לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּן אִתִּי אֱלֹהֵי כֶסֶף וֵאלֹהֵי זָהָב לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶם׃

english.text:
You shall not make gods of silver with me, and you shall
not make gods of gold for yourselves.

translation.text: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.

verses.english:
You shall not make gods of silver with me, and you shall
not make gods of gold for yourselves.

verses.hebrew: מִזְבַּח אֲדָמָה תַּעֲשֶׂה לִּי וְזָבַחְתָּ עָלָיו אֶת עֹלֹתֶיךָ וְאֶת שְׁלָמֶיךָ אֶת צֹאנְךָ וְאֶת בְּקָרֶךָ בְּכל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַזְכִּיר אֶת שְׁמִי אָבוֹא אֵלֶיךָ וּבֵרַכְתִּיךָ׃

hebrew.text: מִזְבַּח אֲדָמָה תַּעֲשֶׂה לִּי וְזָבַחְתָּ עָלָיו אֶת עֹלֹתֶיךָ וְאֶת שְׁלָמֶיךָ אֶת צֹאנְךָ וְאֶת בְּקָרֶךָ בְּכל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַזְכִּיר אֶת שְׁמִי אָבוֹא אֵלֶיךָ וּבֵרַכְתִּיךָ׃

english.text:
You shall make an altar of earth for me, and you shall
sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace
offerings, your sheep and your oxen. In every place where
I’ll have my name commemorated I’ll come to you, and I’ll
bless you.

translation.text: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was.

verses.english:
You shall make an altar of earth for me, and you shall
sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace
offerings, your sheep and your oxen. In every place where
I’ll have my name commemorated I’ll come to you, and I’ll
bless you.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִזְבַּח אֲבָנִים תַּעֲשֶׂה לִּי לֹא תִבְנֶה אֶתְהֶן גָּזִית כִּי חַרְבְּךָ הֵנַפְתָּ עָלֶיהָ וַתְּחַלְלֶהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מִזְבַּח אֲבָנִים תַּעֲשֶׂה לִּי לֹא תִבְנֶה אֶתְהֶן גָּזִית כִּי חַרְבְּךָ הֵנַפְתָּ עָלֶיהָ וַתְּחַלְלֶהָ׃

english.text:
And if you’ll make an altar of stones for me, you shall
not make them cut. When you have elevated your sword over
it, then you have desecrated it.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

verses.english:
And if you’ll make an altar of stones for me, you shall
not make them cut. When you have elevated your sword over
it, then you have desecrated it.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תַעֲלֶה בְמַעֲלֹת עַל מִזְבְּחִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא תִגָּלֶה עֶרְוָתְךָ עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תַעֲלֶה בְמַעֲלֹת עַל מִזְבְּחִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא תִגָּלֶה עֶרְוָתְךָ עָלָיו׃

english.text:
And you shall not go up by stairs on my altar, so that
your nudity will not be exposed over it.”

translation.text: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.

verses.english:
And you shall not go up by stairs on my altar, so that
your nudity will not be exposed over it.”

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר תָּשִׂים לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר תָּשִׂים לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
“And these are the judgments that you shall set before
them:

translation.text: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.

verses.english:
“And these are the judgments that you shall set before
them:

verses.hebrew: כִּי תִקְנֶה עֶבֶד עִבְרִי שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים יַעֲבֹד וּבַשְּׁבִעִת יֵצֵא לַחפְשִׁי חִנָּם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תִקְנֶה עֶבֶד עִבְרִי שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים יַעֲבֹד וּבַשְּׁבִעִת יֵצֵא לַחפְשִׁי חִנָּם׃

english.text:
“When you will buy a Hebrew slave, he shall work six
years, and in the seventh he shall go out liberated for
free.

translation.text: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.

verses.english:
“When you will buy a Hebrew slave, he shall work six
years, and in the seventh he shall go out liberated for
free.

verses.hebrew: אִם בְּגַפּוֹ יָבֹא בְּגַפּוֹ יֵצֵא אִם בַּעַל אִשָּׁה הוּא וְיָצְאָה אִשְׁתּוֹ עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אִם בְּגַפּוֹ יָבֹא בְּגַפּוֹ יֵצֵא אִם בַּעַל אִשָּׁה הוּא וְיָצְאָה אִשְׁתּוֹ עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
If he will come by himself, he shall go out by himself. If
he is a woman’s husband, then his wife shall go out with
him.

translation.text: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.

verses.english:
If he will come by himself, he shall go out by himself. If
he is a woman’s husband, then his wife shall go out with
him.

verses.hebrew: אִם אֲדֹנָיו יִתֶּן לוֹ אִשָּׁה וְיָלְדָה לוֹ בָנִים אוֹ בָנוֹת הָאִשָּׁה וִילָדֶיהָ תִּהְיֶה לַאדֹנֶיהָ וְהוּא יֵצֵא בְגַפּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אִם אֲדֹנָיו יִתֶּן לוֹ אִשָּׁה וְיָלְדָה לוֹ בָנִים אוֹ בָנוֹת הָאִשָּׁה וִילָדֶיהָ תִּהְיֶה לַאדֹנֶיהָ וְהוּא יֵצֵא בְגַפּוֹ׃

english.text:
If his master will give him a wife, and she will give
birth to sons or daughters for him, the wife and her
children will be her master’s, and he shall go out by
himself.

translation.text: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.

verses.english:
If his master will give him a wife, and she will give
birth to sons or daughters for him, the wife and her
children will be her master’s, and he shall go out by
himself.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם אָמֹר יֹאמַר הָעֶבֶד אָהַבְתִּי אֶת אֲדֹנִי אֶת אִשְׁתִּי וְאֶת בָּנָי לֹא אֵצֵא חפְשִׁי׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם אָמֹר יֹאמַר הָעֶבֶד אָהַבְתִּי אֶת אֲדֹנִי אֶת אִשְׁתִּי וְאֶת בָּנָי לֹא אֵצֵא חפְשִׁי׃

english.text:
And if the slave will say: ‘I love my master, my wife, and
my children; I won’t go out liberated!’

translation.text: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:

verses.english:
And if the slave will say: ‘I love my master, my wife, and
my children; I won’t go out liberated!’

verses.hebrew: וְהִגִּישׁוֹ אֲדֹנָיו אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים וְהִגִּישׁוֹ אֶל הַדֶּלֶת אוֹ אֶל הַמְּזוּזָה וְרָצַע אֲדֹנָיו אֶת אזְנוֹ בַּמַּרְצֵעַ וַעֲבָדוֹ לְעֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִגִּישׁוֹ אֲדֹנָיו אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים וְהִגִּישׁוֹ אֶל הַדֶּלֶת אוֹ אֶל הַמְּזוּזָה וְרָצַע אֲדֹנָיו אֶת אזְנוֹ בַּמַּרְצֵעַ וַעֲבָדוֹ לְעֹלָם׃

english.text:
then his master shall bring him over to God and bring him
over to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall
pierce his ear with an awl, and he shall serve him
forever.

translation.text: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.

verses.english:
then his master shall bring him over to God and bring him
over to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall
pierce his ear with an awl, and he shall serve him
forever.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִמְכֹּר אִישׁ אֶת בִּתּוֹ לְאָמָה לֹא תֵצֵא כְּצֵאת הָעֲבָדִים׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִמְכֹּר אִישׁ אֶת בִּתּוֹ לְאָמָה לֹא תֵצֵא כְּצֵאת הָעֲבָדִים׃

english.text:
“And if a man will sell his daughter as a maid, she shall
not go out as the slaves go out.

translation.text: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.

verses.english:
“And if a man will sell his daughter as a maid, she shall
not go out as the slaves go out.

verses.hebrew: אִם רָעָה בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר [לוֹ] (לא) יְעָדָהּ וְהֶפְדָּהּ לְעַם נכְרִי לֹא יִמְשֹׁל לְמכְרָהּ בְּבִגְדוֹ בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: אִם רָעָה בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר [לוֹ] (לא) יְעָדָהּ וְהֶפְדָּהּ לְעַם נכְרִי לֹא יִמְשֹׁל לְמכְרָהּ בְּבִגְדוֹ בָהּ׃

english.text:
If she is bad in the eyes of her master who has designated
her for himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He
shall not dominate so as to sell her to a foreign people
in his betrayal of her.

translation.text: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.

verses.english:
If she is bad in the eyes of her master who has designated
her for himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He
shall not dominate so as to sell her to a foreign people
in his betrayal of her.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לִבְנוֹ יִיעָדֶנָּה כְּמִשְׁפַּט הַבָּנוֹת יַעֲשֶׂה לָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לִבְנוֹ יִיעָדֶנָּה כְּמִשְׁפַּט הַבָּנוֹת יַעֲשֶׂה לָּהּ׃

english.text:
And if he will designate her for his son, he shall treat
her according to the manner of daughters.

translation.text: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.

verses.english:
And if he will designate her for his son, he shall treat
her according to the manner of daughters.

verses.hebrew: אִם אַחֶרֶת יִקַּח לוֹ שְׁאֵרָהּ כְּסוּתָהּ וְעֹנָתָהּ לֹא יִגְרָע׃

hebrew.text: אִם אַחֶרֶת יִקַּח לוֹ שְׁאֵרָהּ כְּסוּתָהּ וְעֹנָתָהּ לֹא יִגְרָע׃

english.text:
If he will take another for himself, he shall not subtract
from her food, her apparel, and her hygiene.

translation.text: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.

verses.english:
If he will take another for himself, he shall not subtract
from her food, her apparel, and her hygiene.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם שְׁלשׁ אֵלֶּה לֹא יַעֲשֶׂה לָהּ וְיָצְאָה חִנָּם אֵין כָּסֶף׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם שְׁלשׁ אֵלֶּה לֹא יַעֲשֶׂה לָהּ וְיָצְאָה חִנָּם אֵין כָּסֶף׃

english.text:
And if he will not do these three for her, then she shall
go out free. There is no money.

translation.text: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.

verses.english:
And if he will not do these three for her, then she shall
go out free. There is no money.

verses.hebrew: מַכֵּה אִישׁ וָמֵת מוֹת יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: מַכֵּה אִישׁ וָמֵת מוֹת יוּמָת׃

english.text:
“One who strikes a man, and he dies, he shall be put to
death.

translation.text: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.

verses.english:
“One who strikes a man, and he dies, he shall be put to
death.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲשֶׁר לֹא צָדָה וְהָאֱלֹהִים אִנָּה לְיָדוֹ וְשַׂמְתִּי לְךָ מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יָנוּס שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲשֶׁר לֹא צָדָה וְהָאֱלֹהִים אִנָּה לְיָדוֹ וְשַׂמְתִּי לְךָ מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יָנוּס שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And one who did not scheme, but God conveyed it to his
hand, I shall set a place for you, that he shall flee
there.

translation.text: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.

verses.english:
And one who did not scheme, but God conveyed it to his
hand, I shall set a place for you, that he shall flee
there.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יָזִד אִישׁ עַל רֵעֵהוּ לְהרְגוֹ בְערְמָה מֵעִם מִזְבְּחִי תִּקָּחֶנּוּ לָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יָזִד אִישׁ עַל רֵעֵהוּ לְהרְגוֹ בְערְמָה מֵעִם מִזְבְּחִי תִּקָּחֶנּוּ לָמוּת׃

english.text:
But if a man will plot against his neighbor, to kill him
with treachery, you shall take him from my altar to die.

translation.text: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.

verses.english:
But if a man will plot against his neighbor, to kill him
with treachery, you shall take him from my altar to die.

verses.hebrew: וּמַכֵּה אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ מוֹת יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וּמַכֵּה אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ מוֹת יוּמָת׃

english.text:
“And one who strikes his father and his mother shall be
put to death.

translation.text: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.

verses.english:
“And one who strikes his father and his mother shall be
put to death.

verses.hebrew: וְגֹנֵב אִישׁ וּמְכָרוֹ וְנִמְצָא בְיָדוֹ מוֹת יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וְגֹנֵב אִישׁ וּמְכָרוֹ וְנִמְצָא בְיָדוֹ מוֹת יוּמָת׃

english.text:
“And one who steals a man and has sold him, or he was
found in his hand, will be put to death.

translation.text: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

verses.english:
“And one who steals a man and has sold him, or he was
found in his hand, will be put to death.

verses.hebrew: וּמְקַלֵּל אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ מוֹת יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וּמְקַלֵּל אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ מוֹת יוּמָת׃

english.text:
“And one who curses his father and his mother shall be put
to death.

translation.text: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.

verses.english:
“And one who curses his father and his mother shall be put
to death.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יְרִיבֻן אֲנָשִׁים וְהִכָּה אִישׁ אֶת רֵעֵהוּ בְּאֶבֶן אוֹ בְאֶגְרֹף וְלֹא יָמוּת וְנָפַל לְמִשְׁכָּב׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יְרִיבֻן אֲנָשִׁים וְהִכָּה אִישׁ אֶת רֵעֵהוּ בְּאֶבֶן אוֹ בְאֶגְרֹף וְלֹא יָמוּת וְנָפַל לְמִשְׁכָּב׃

english.text:
“And if people will quarrel, and a man strikes his
neighbor with a stone or with a fist, and he does not die,
and he falls to bed,

translation.text: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed:

verses.english:
“And if people will quarrel, and a man strikes his
neighbor with a stone or with a fist, and he does not die,
and he falls to bed,

verses.hebrew: אִם יָקוּם וְהִתְהַלֵּךְ בַּחוּץ עַל מִשְׁעַנְתּוֹ וְנִקָּה הַמַּכֶּה רַק שִׁבְתּוֹ יִתֵּן וְרַפֹּא יְרַפֵּא׃

hebrew.text: אִם יָקוּם וְהִתְהַלֵּךְ בַּחוּץ עַל מִשְׁעַנְתּוֹ וְנִקָּה הַמַּכֶּה רַק שִׁבְתּוֹ יִתֵּן וְרַפֹּא יְרַפֵּא׃

translation.text: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יַכֶּה אִישׁ אֶת עַבְדּוֹ אוֹ אֶת אֲמָתוֹ בַּשֵּׁבֶט וּמֵת תַּחַת יָדוֹ נָקֹם יִנָּקֵם׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יַכֶּה אִישׁ אֶת עַבְדּוֹ אוֹ אֶת אֲמָתוֹ בַּשֵּׁבֶט וּמֵת תַּחַת יָדוֹ נָקֹם יִנָּקֵם׃

english.text:
“And if a man will strike his slave or his maid with a
rod, and he dies by his hand, he shall be avenged.

translation.text: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.

verses.english:
“And if a man will strike his slave or his maid with a
rod, and he dies by his hand, he shall be avenged.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ אִם יוֹם אוֹ יוֹמַיִם יַעֲמֹד לֹא יֻקַּם כִּי כַסְפּוֹ הוּא׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ אִם יוֹם אוֹ יוֹמַיִם יַעֲמֹד לֹא יֻקַּם כִּי כַסְפּוֹ הוּא׃

english.text:
Just: if he will stand for a day or two days, he shall not
be avenged, because he is his money.

translation.text: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.

verses.english:
Just: if he will stand for a day or two days, he shall not
be avenged, because he is his money.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִנָּצוּ אֲנָשִׁים וְנָגְפוּ אִשָּׁה הָרָה וְיָצְאוּ יְלָדֶיהָ וְלֹא יִהְיֶה אָסוֹן עָנוֹשׁ יֵעָנֵשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר יָשִׁית עָלָיו בַּעַל הָאִשָּׁה וְנָתַן בִּפְלִלִים׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִנָּצוּ אֲנָשִׁים וְנָגְפוּ אִשָּׁה הָרָה וְיָצְאוּ יְלָדֶיהָ וְלֹא יִהְיֶה אָסוֹן עָנוֹשׁ יֵעָנֵשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר יָשִׁית עָלָיו בַּעַל הָאִשָּׁה וְנָתַן בִּפְלִלִים׃

english.text:
“And if people will fight, and they strike a pregnant
woman, and her children go out, and there will not be an
injury, he shall be penalized according to what the
woman’s husband will impose on him, and he will give it by
the judges.

translation.text: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman’s husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.

verses.english:
“And if people will fight, and they strike a pregnant
woman, and her children go out, and there will not be an
injury, he shall be penalized according to what the
woman’s husband will impose on him, and he will give it by
the judges.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם אָסוֹן יִהְיֶה וְנָתַתָּה נֶפֶשׁ תַּחַת נָפֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם אָסוֹן יִהְיֶה וְנָתַתָּה נֶפֶשׁ תַּחַת נָפֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And if there will be an injury, then you shall give a life
for a life,

translation.text: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,

verses.english:
And if there will be an injury, then you shall give a life
for a life,

verses.hebrew: עַיִן תַּחַת עַיִן שֵׁן תַּחַת שֵׁן יָד תַּחַת יָד רֶגֶל תַּחַת רָגֶל׃

hebrew.text: עַיִן תַּחַת עַיִן שֵׁן תַּחַת שֵׁן יָד תַּחַת יָד רֶגֶל תַּחַת רָגֶל׃

english.text:
an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth, a hand for a hand,
a foot for a foot,

translation.text: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

verses.english:
an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth, a hand for a hand,
a foot for a foot,

verses.hebrew: כְּוִיָּה תַּחַת כְּוִיָּה פֶּצַע תַּחַת פָּצַע חַבּוּרָה תַּחַת חַבּוּרָה׃

hebrew.text: כְּוִיָּה תַּחַת כְּוִיָּה פֶּצַע תַּחַת פָּצַע חַבּוּרָה תַּחַת חַבּוּרָה׃

english.text: a burn for a burn, a wound for a wound, a hurt for a hurt.

translation.text: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

verses.english: a burn for a burn, a wound for a wound, a hurt for a hurt.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יַכֶּה אִישׁ אֶת עֵין עַבְדּוֹ אוֹ אֶת עֵין אֲמָתוֹ וְשִׁחֲתָהּ לַחפְשִׁי יְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ תַּחַת עֵינוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יַכֶּה אִישׁ אֶת עֵין עַבְדּוֹ אוֹ אֶת עֵין אֲמָתוֹ וְשִׁחֲתָהּ לַחפְשִׁי יְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ תַּחַת עֵינוֹ׃

english.text:
“And if a man will strike his slave’s eye or his maid’s
eye and destroy it, he shall let him go, liberated, for
his eye.

translation.text: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

verses.english:
“And if a man will strike his slave’s eye or his maid’s
eye and destroy it, he shall let him go, liberated, for
his eye.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם שֵׁן עַבְדּוֹ אוֹ שֵׁן אֲמָתוֹ יַפִּיל לַחפְשִׁי יְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ תַּחַת שִׁנּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם שֵׁן עַבְדּוֹ אוֹ שֵׁן אֲמָתוֹ יַפִּיל לַחפְשִׁי יְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ תַּחַת שִׁנּוֹ׃

english.text:
And if he will knock out his slave’s tooth or his maid’s
tooth, he shall let him go liberated for his tooth.

translation.text: And if he smite out his manservant’s tooth, or his maidservant’s tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.

verses.english:
And if he will knock out his slave’s tooth or his maid’s
tooth, he shall let him go liberated for his tooth.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִגַּח שׁוֹר אֶת אִישׁ אוֹ אֶת אִשָּׁה וָמֵת סָקוֹל יִסָּקֵל הַשּׁוֹר וְלֹא יֵאָכֵל אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ וּבַעַל הַשּׁוֹר נָקִי׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִגַּח שׁוֹר אֶת אִישׁ אוֹ אֶת אִשָּׁה וָמֵת סָקוֹל יִסָּקֵל הַשּׁוֹר וְלֹא יֵאָכֵל אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ וּבַעַל הַשּׁוֹר נָקִי׃

english.text:
“And if an ox will gore a man or a woman and they die, the
ox shall be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten—and
the ox’s owner is innocent.

translation.text: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.

verses.english:
“And if an ox will gore a man or a woman and they die, the
ox shall be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten—and
the ox’s owner is innocent.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם שׁוֹר נַגָּח הוּא מִתְּמֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וְהוּעַד בִּבְעָלָיו וְלֹא יִשְׁמְרֶנּוּ וְהֵמִית אִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה הַשּׁוֹר יִסָּקֵל וְגַם בְּעָלָיו יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם שׁוֹר נַגָּח הוּא מִתְּמֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וְהוּעַד בִּבְעָלָיו וְלֹא יִשְׁמְרֶנּוּ וְהֵמִית אִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה הַשּׁוֹר יִסָּקֵל וְגַם בְּעָלָיו יוּמָת׃

english.text:
And if it was a goring ox from the day before yesterday,
and it had been so testified to its owner, and he did not
watch it, and it killed a man or a woman, the ox will be
stoned, and its owner will be put to death as well.

translation.text: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.

verses.english:
And if it was a goring ox from the day before yesterday,
and it had been so testified to its owner, and he did not
watch it, and it killed a man or a woman, the ox will be
stoned, and its owner will be put to death as well.

verses.hebrew: אִם כֹּפֶר יוּשַׁת עָלָיו וְנָתַן פִּדְיֹן נַפְשׁוֹ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יוּשַׁת עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: אִם כֹּפֶר יוּשַׁת עָלָיו וְנָתַן פִּדְיֹן נַפְשׁוֹ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יוּשַׁת עָלָיו׃

english.text:
If a ransom will be set on him, then he shall give
everything that will be set on him for the redemption of
his life.

translation.text: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.

verses.english:
If a ransom will be set on him, then he shall give
everything that will be set on him for the redemption of
his life.

verses.hebrew: אוֹ בֵן יִגָּח אוֹ בַת יִגָּח כַּמִּשְׁפָּט הַזֶּה יֵעָשֶׂה לּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ בֵן יִגָּח אוֹ בַת יִגָּח כַּמִּשְׁפָּט הַזֶּה יֵעָשֶׂה לּוֹ׃

english.text:
Whether it will gore a son or it will gore a daughter,
according to this judgment shall be done to it.

translation.text: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.

verses.english:
Whether it will gore a son or it will gore a daughter,
according to this judgment shall be done to it.

verses.hebrew: אִם עֶבֶד יִגַּח הַשּׁוֹר אוֹ אָמָה כֶּסֶף שְׁלֹשִׁים שְׁקָלִים יִתֵּן לַאדֹנָיו וְהַשּׁוֹר יִסָּקֵל׃

hebrew.text: אִם עֶבֶד יִגַּח הַשּׁוֹר אוֹ אָמָה כֶּסֶף שְׁלֹשִׁים שְׁקָלִים יִתֵּן לַאדֹנָיו וְהַשּׁוֹר יִסָּקֵל׃

english.text:
If the ox will gore a slave or a maid, he shall pay thirty
silver shekels to his owner, and the ox shall be stoned.

translation.text: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

verses.english:
If the ox will gore a slave or a maid, he shall pay thirty
silver shekels to his owner, and the ox shall be stoned.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִפְתַּח אִישׁ בּוֹר אוֹ כִּי יִכְרֶה אִישׁ בֹּר וְלֹא יְכַסֶּנּוּ וְנָפַל שָׁמָּה שּׁוֹר אוֹ חֲמוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִפְתַּח אִישׁ בּוֹר אוֹ כִּי יִכְרֶה אִישׁ בֹּר וְלֹא יְכַסֶּנּוּ וְנָפַל שָׁמָּה שּׁוֹר אוֹ חֲמוֹר׃

english.text:
“And if a man will open a pit, or if a man will dig a pit,
and he will not cover it, and an ox or an ass will fall
there,

translation.text: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;

verses.english:
“And if a man will open a pit, or if a man will dig a pit,
and he will not cover it, and an ox or an ass will fall
there,

verses.hebrew: בַּעַל הַבּוֹר יְשַׁלֵּם כֶּסֶף יָשִׁיב לִבְעָלָיו וְהַמֵּת יִהְיֶה לּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בַּעַל הַבּוֹר יְשַׁלֵּם כֶּסֶף יָשִׁיב לִבְעָלָיו וְהַמֵּת יִהְיֶה לּוֹ׃

english.text:
the owner of the pit shall pay; he shall pay back money to
its owner, and the dead one will be his.

translation.text: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.

verses.english:
the owner of the pit shall pay; he shall pay back money to
its owner, and the dead one will be his.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִגֹּף שׁוֹר אִישׁ אֶת שׁוֹר רֵעֵהוּ וָמֵת וּמָכְרוּ אֶת הַשּׁוֹר הַחַי וְחָצוּ אֶת כַּסְפּוֹ וְגַם אֶת הַמֵּת יֶחֱצוּן׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִגֹּף שׁוֹר אִישׁ אֶת שׁוֹר רֵעֵהוּ וָמֵת וּמָכְרוּ אֶת הַשּׁוֹר הַחַי וְחָצוּ אֶת כַּסְפּוֹ וְגַם אֶת הַמֵּת יֶחֱצוּן׃

english.text:
And if a man’s ox will strike his neighbor’s ox, and it
dies, then they shall sell the live ox and split the money
for it, and they shall split the dead one as well.

translation.text: And if one man’s ox hurt another’s, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.

verses.english:
And if a man’s ox will strike his neighbor’s ox, and it
dies, then they shall sell the live ox and split the money
for it, and they shall split the dead one as well.

verses.hebrew: אוֹ נוֹדַע כִּי שׁוֹר נַגָּח הוּא מִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וְלֹא יִשְׁמְרֶנּוּ בְּעָלָיו שַׁלֵּם יְשַׁלֵּם שׁוֹר תַּחַת הַשּׁוֹר וְהַמֵּת יִהְיֶה לּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ נוֹדַע כִּי שׁוֹר נַגָּח הוּא מִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וְלֹא יִשְׁמְרֶנּוּ בְּעָלָיו שַׁלֵּם יְשַׁלֵּם שׁוֹר תַּחַת הַשּׁוֹר וְהַמֵּת יִהְיֶה לּוֹ׃

english.text:
Or: if it was known that it was a goring ox from the day
before yesterday, and its owner did not watch it, he shall
pay an ox for the ox, and the dead one shall be his.

translation.text: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.

verses.english:
Or: if it was known that it was a goring ox from the day
before yesterday, and its owner did not watch it, he shall
pay an ox for the ox, and the dead one shall be his.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִגְנֹב אִישׁ שׁוֹר אוֹ שֶׂה וּטְבָחוֹ אוֹ מְכָרוֹ חֲמִשָּׁה בָקָר יְשַׁלֵּם תַּחַת הַשּׁוֹר וְאַרְבַּע צֹאן תַּחַת הַשֶּׂה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִגְנֹב אִישׁ שׁוֹר אוֹ שֶׂה וּטְבָחוֹ אוֹ מְכָרוֹ חֲמִשָּׁה בָקָר יְשַׁלֵּם תַּחַת הַשּׁוֹר וְאַרְבַּע צֹאן תַּחַת הַשֶּׂה׃

english.text:
“If a man will steal an ox or a sheep and slaughter it or
sell it, he shall pay five oxen for the ox and four sheep
for the sheep.

verses.english:
“If a man will steal an ox or a sheep and slaughter it or
sell it, he shall pay five oxen for the ox and four sheep
for the sheep.

verses.hebrew: אִם בַּמַּחְתֶּרֶת יִמָּצֵא הַגַּנָּב וְהֻכָּה וָמֵת אֵין לוֹ דָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: אִם בַּמַּחְתֶּרֶת יִמָּצֵא הַגַּנָּב וְהֻכָּה וָמֵת אֵין לוֹ דָּמִים׃

english.text:
“If the thief will be found while breaking in and will
be struck, and he dies, there is no blood for him.

translation.text: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

verses.english:
“If the thief will be found while breaking in and will
be struck, and he dies, there is no blood for him.

verses.hebrew: אִם זָרְחָה הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ עָלָיו דָּמִים לוֹ שַׁלֵּם יְשַׁלֵּם אִם אֵין לוֹ וְנִמְכַּר בִּגְנֵבָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אִם זָרְחָה הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ עָלָיו דָּמִים לוֹ שַׁלֵּם יְשַׁלֵּם אִם אֵין לוֹ וְנִמְכַּר בִּגְנֵבָתוֹ׃

english.text:
If the sun has risen on him there is blood for him. He shall pay. If
he does not have it, then he shall be sold for his theft.

translation.text: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.

verses.english:
If the sun has risen on him there is blood for him. He shall pay. If
he does not have it, then he shall be sold for his theft.

verses.hebrew: אִם הִמָּצֵא תִמָּצֵא בְיָדוֹ הַגְּנֵבָה מִשּׁוֹר עַד חֲמוֹר עַד שֶׂה חַיִּים שְׁנַיִם יְשַׁלֵּם׃

hebrew.text: אִם הִמָּצֵא תִמָּצֵא בְיָדוֹ הַגְּנֵבָה מִשּׁוֹר עַד חֲמוֹר עַד שֶׂה חַיִּים שְׁנַיִם יְשַׁלֵּם׃

english.text:
If the theft will be found in his hand—from ox to ass to
sheep—alive, he shall pay two.

translation.text: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

verses.english:
If the theft will be found in his hand—from ox to ass to
sheep—alive, he shall pay two.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יַבְעֶר אִישׁ שָׂדֶה אוֹ כֶרֶם וְשִׁלַּח אֶת בְּעִירֹה וּבִעֵר בִּשְׂדֵה אַחֵר מֵיטַב שָׂדֵהוּ וּמֵיטַב כַּרְמוֹ יְשַׁלֵּם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יַבְעֶר אִישׁ שָׂדֶה אוֹ כֶרֶם וְשִׁלַּח אֶת בְּעִירֹה וּבִעֵר בִּשְׂדֵה אַחֵר מֵיטַב שָׂדֵהוּ וּמֵיטַב כַּרְמוֹ יְשַׁלֵּם׃

english.text:
“If a man will have a field or a vineyard grazed, and he
will let his beast go and graze in another person’s field,
he shall pay the best of his field and the best of his
vineyard.

translation.text: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.

verses.english:
“If a man will have a field or a vineyard grazed, and he
will let his beast go and graze in another person’s field,
he shall pay the best of his field and the best of his
vineyard.

verses.hebrew: כִּי תֵצֵא אֵשׁ וּמָצְאָה קֹצִים וְנֶאֱכַל גָּדִישׁ אוֹ הַקָּמָה אוֹ הַשָּׂדֶה שַׁלֵּם יְשַׁלֵּם הַמַּבְעִר אֶת הַבְּעֵרָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תֵצֵא אֵשׁ וּמָצְאָה קֹצִים וְנֶאֱכַל גָּדִישׁ אוֹ הַקָּמָה אוֹ הַשָּׂדֶה שַׁלֵּם יְשַׁלֵּם הַמַּבְעִר אֶת הַבְּעֵרָה׃

english.text:
“If fire will break out and find thorns and stacked grain
or standing grain or a field is consumed, the one who set
the blaze shall pay.

translation.text: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.

verses.english:
“If fire will break out and find thorns and stacked grain
or standing grain or a field is consumed, the one who set
the blaze shall pay.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִתֵּן אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ כֶּסֶף אוֹ כֵלִים לִשְׁמֹר וְגֻנַּב מִבֵּית הָאִישׁ אִם יִמָּצֵא הַגַּנָּב יְשַׁלֵּם שְׁנָיִם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִתֵּן אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ כֶּסֶף אוֹ כֵלִים לִשְׁמֹר וְגֻנַּב מִבֵּית הָאִישׁ אִם יִמָּצֵא הַגַּנָּב יְשַׁלֵּם שְׁנָיִם׃

english.text:
“If a man will give his neighbor money or items to watch,
and it will be stolen from the man’s house, if the thief
will be found he shall pay two.

translation.text: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

verses.english:
“If a man will give his neighbor money or items to watch,
and it will be stolen from the man’s house, if the thief
will be found he shall pay two.

verses.hebrew: אִם לֹא יִמָּצֵא הַגַּנָּב וְנִקְרַב בַּעַל הַבַּיִת אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים אִם לֹא שָׁלַח יָדוֹ בִּמְלֶאכֶת רֵעֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: אִם לֹא יִמָּצֵא הַגַּנָּב וְנִקְרַב בַּעַל הַבַּיִת אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים אִם לֹא שָׁלַח יָדוֹ בִּמְלֶאכֶת רֵעֵהוּ׃

english.text:
If the thief will not be found, then the owner of the
house shall be brought near to God: that he has not put
out his hand into his neighbor’s property.

translation.text: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.

verses.english:
If the thief will not be found, then the owner of the
house shall be brought near to God: that he has not put
out his hand into his neighbor’s property.

verses.hebrew: עַל כּל דְּבַר פֶּשַׁע עַל שׁוֹר עַל חֲמוֹר עַל שֶׂה עַל שַׂלְמָה עַל כּל אֲבֵדָה אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר כִּי הוּא זֶה עַד הָאֱלֹהִים יָבֹא דְּבַר שְׁנֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר יַרְשִׁיעֻן אֱלֹהִים יְשַׁלֵּם שְׁנַיִם לְרֵעֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: עַל כּל דְּבַר פֶּשַׁע עַל שׁוֹר עַל חֲמוֹר עַל שֶׂה עַל שַׂלְמָה עַל כּל אֲבֵדָה אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר כִּי הוּא זֶה עַד הָאֱלֹהִים יָבֹא דְּבַר שְׁנֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר יַרְשִׁיעֻן אֱלֹהִים יְשַׁלֵּם שְׁנַיִם לְרֵעֵהוּ׃

english.text:
“Over every case of an offense, over an ox, over an ass,
over a sheep, over clothing, over every loss about which
one will say that ‘This is it,’ the word of the two of
them shall come to God. The one whom God will implicate
shall pay two to his neighbor.

translation.text: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods.

verses.english:
“Over every case of an offense, over an ox, over an ass,
over a sheep, over clothing, over every loss about which
one will say that ‘This is it,’ the word of the two of
them shall come to God. The one whom God will implicate
shall pay two to his neighbor.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִתֵּן אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ חֲמוֹר אוֹ שׁוֹר אוֹ שֶׂה וְכל בְּהֵמָה לִשְׁמֹר וּמֵת אוֹ נִשְׁבַּר אוֹ נִשְׁבָּה אֵין רֹאֶה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִתֵּן אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ חֲמוֹר אוֹ שׁוֹר אוֹ שֶׂה וְכל בְּהֵמָה לִשְׁמֹר וּמֵת אוֹ נִשְׁבַּר אוֹ נִשְׁבָּה אֵין רֹאֶה׃

english.text:
“If a man will give an ass or an ox or a sheep or any
animal to his neighbor to watch, and it dies or is injured
or is seized—no one seeing—

translation.text: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.

verses.english:
“If a man will give an ass or an ox or a sheep or any
animal to his neighbor to watch, and it dies or is injured
or is seized—no one seeing—

verses.hebrew: שְׁבֻעַת יְהֹוָה תִּהְיֶה בֵּין שְׁנֵיהֶם אִם לֹא שָׁלַח יָדוֹ בִּמְלֶאכֶת רֵעֵהוּ וְלָקַח בְּעָלָיו וְלֹא יְשַׁלֵּם׃

hebrew.text: שְׁבֻעַת יְהֹוָה תִּהְיֶה בֵּין שְׁנֵיהֶם אִם לֹא שָׁלַח יָדוֹ בִּמְלֶאכֶת רֵעֵהוּ וְלָקַח בְּעָלָיו וְלֹא יְשַׁלֵּם׃

english.text:
an oath of YHWH shall be between the two of them: that he
has not put out his hand into his neighbor’s property; and
its owner shall take it, and he shall not pay.

translation.text: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:

verses.english:
an oath of YHWH shall be between the two of them: that he
has not put out his hand into his neighbor’s property; and
its owner shall take it, and he shall not pay.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם גָּנֹב יִגָּנֵב מֵעִמּוֹ יְשַׁלֵּם לִבְעָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם גָּנֹב יִגָּנֵב מֵעִמּוֹ יְשַׁלֵּם לִבְעָלָיו׃

english.text: And if it will be stolen from him, he shall pay its owner.

translation.text: Then shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.

verses.english: And if it will be stolen from him, he shall pay its owner.

verses.hebrew: אִם טָרֹף יִטָּרֵף יְבִאֵהוּ עֵד הַטְּרֵפָה לֹא יְשַׁלֵּם׃

hebrew.text: אִם טָרֹף יִטָּרֵף יְבִאֵהוּ עֵד הַטְּרֵפָה לֹא יְשַׁלֵּם׃

english.text:
If it will be torn, he shall bring it in witness; he shall
not pay for the torn one.

translation.text: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.

verses.english:
If it will be torn, he shall bring it in witness; he shall
not pay for the torn one.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִשְׁאַל אִישׁ מֵעִם רֵעֵהוּ וְנִשְׁבַּר אוֹ מֵת בְּעָלָיו אֵין עִמּוֹ שַׁלֵּם יְשַׁלֵּם׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִשְׁאַל אִישׁ מֵעִם רֵעֵהוּ וְנִשְׁבַּר אוֹ מֵת בְּעָלָיו אֵין עִמּוֹ שַׁלֵּם יְשַׁלֵּם׃

english.text:
And if a man will ask it of his neighbor, and it is
injured or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall
pay.

translation.text: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.

verses.english:
And if a man will ask it of his neighbor, and it is
injured or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall
pay.

verses.hebrew: אִם בְּעָלָיו עִמּוֹ לֹא יְשַׁלֵּם אִם שָׂכִיר הוּא בָּא בִּשְׂכָרוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אִם בְּעָלָיו עִמּוֹ לֹא יְשַׁלֵּם אִם שָׂכִיר הוּא בָּא בִּשְׂכָרוֹ׃

english.text:
If its owner is with it, he shall not pay. If it was
hired, he has its hire coming to him.

translation.text: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.

verses.english:
If its owner is with it, he shall not pay. If it was
hired, he has its hire coming to him.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יְפַתֶּה אִישׁ בְּתוּלָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא אֹרָשָׂה וְשָׁכַב עִמָּהּ מָהֹר יִמְהָרֶנָּה לּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יְפַתֶּה אִישׁ בְּתוּלָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא אֹרָשָׂה וְשָׁכַב עִמָּהּ מָהֹר יִמְהָרֶנָּה לּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
“And if a man will deceive a virgin who is not betrothed,
and he lies with her, he shall espouse her by a
bride-price to him as a wife.

translation.text: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.

verses.english:
“And if a man will deceive a virgin who is not betrothed,
and he lies with her, he shall espouse her by a
bride-price to him as a wife.

verses.hebrew: אִם מָאֵן יְמָאֵן אָבִיהָ לְתִתָּהּ לוֹ כֶּסֶף יִשְׁקֹל כְּמֹהַר הַבְּתוּלֹת׃

hebrew.text: אִם מָאֵן יְמָאֵן אָבִיהָ לְתִתָּהּ לוֹ כֶּסֶף יִשְׁקֹל כְּמֹהַר הַבְּתוּלֹת׃

english.text:
If her father will refuse to give her to him, he shall
weigh out money corresponding to the bride-price of
virgins.

translation.text: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.

verses.english:
If her father will refuse to give her to him, he shall
weigh out money corresponding to the bride-price of
virgins.

verses.hebrew: מְכַשֵּׁפָה לֹא תְחַיֶּה׃

hebrew.text: מְכַשֵּׁפָה לֹא תְחַיֶּה׃

english.text: “You shall not let a witch live.

translation.text: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

verses.english: “You shall not let a witch live.

verses.hebrew: כּל שֹׁכֵב עִם בְּהֵמָה מוֹת יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: כּל שֹׁכֵב עִם בְּהֵמָה מוֹת יוּמָת׃

english.text: “Anyone who lies with an animal shall be put to death.

translation.text: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.

verses.english: “Anyone who lies with an animal shall be put to death.

verses.hebrew: זֹבֵחַ לָאֱלֹהִים יחֳרָם בִּלְתִּי לַיהֹוָה לְבַדּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: זֹבֵחַ לָאֱלֹהִים יחֳרָם בִּלְתִּי לַיהֹוָה לְבַדּוֹ׃

english.text:
“One who sacrifices to gods shall be completely
destroyed—except to YHWH alone.

translation.text: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.

verses.english:
“One who sacrifices to gods shall be completely
destroyed—except to YHWH alone.

verses.hebrew: וְגֵר לֹא תוֹנֶה וְלֹא תִלְחָצֶנּוּ כִּי גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְגֵר לֹא תוֹנֶה וְלֹא תִלְחָצֶנּוּ כִּי גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
“And you shall not persecute an alien, and you shall not
oppress him, because you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

translation.text: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.

verses.english:
“And you shall not persecute an alien, and you shall not
oppress him, because you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: כּל אַלְמָנָה וְיָתוֹם לֹא תְעַנּוּן׃

hebrew.text: כּל אַלְמָנָה וְיָתוֹם לֹא תְעַנּוּן׃

english.text: “You shall not degrade any widow or orphan.

translation.text: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

verses.english: “You shall not degrade any widow or orphan.

verses.hebrew: אִם עַנֵּה תְעַנֶּה אֹתוֹ כִּי אִם צָעֹק יִצְעַק אֵלַי שָׁמֹעַ אֶשְׁמַע צַעֲקָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אִם עַנֵּה תְעַנֶּה אֹתוֹ כִּי אִם צָעֹק יִצְעַק אֵלַי שָׁמֹעַ אֶשְׁמַע צַעֲקָתוֹ׃

english.text:
If you will degrade them, when they will cry out to me
I’ll hear their cry,

translation.text: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

verses.english:
If you will degrade them, when they will cry out to me
I’ll hear their cry,

verses.hebrew: וְחָרָה אַפִּי וְהָרַגְתִּי אֶתְכֶם בֶּחָרֶב וְהָיוּ נְשֵׁיכֶם אַלְמָנוֹת וּבְנֵיכֶם יְתֹמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְחָרָה אַפִּי וְהָרַגְתִּי אֶתְכֶם בֶּחָרֶב וְהָיוּ נְשֵׁיכֶם אַלְמָנוֹת וּבְנֵיכֶם יְתֹמִים׃

english.text:
and my anger will flare, and I’ll kill you with a sword,
and your wives will be widows and your children orphans!

translation.text: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;

verses.english:
and my anger will flare, and I’ll kill you with a sword,
and your wives will be widows and your children orphans!

verses.hebrew: אִם כֶּסֶף תַּלְוֶה אֶת עַמִּי אֶת הֶעָנִי עִמָּךְ לֹא תִהְיֶה לוֹ כְּנֹשֶׁה לֹא תְשִׂימוּן עָלָיו נֶשֶׁךְ׃

hebrew.text: אִם כֶּסֶף תַּלְוֶה אֶת עַמִּי אֶת הֶעָנִי עִמָּךְ לֹא תִהְיֶה לוֹ כְּנֹשֶׁה לֹא תְשִׂימוּן עָלָיו נֶשֶׁךְ׃

english.text:
“If you will lend money to my people, to the poor who is
with you, you shall not be like a creditor to him; you
shall not impose interest on him.

translation.text: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

verses.english:
“If you will lend money to my people, to the poor who is
with you, you shall not be like a creditor to him; you
shall not impose interest on him.

verses.hebrew: אִם חָבֹל תַּחְבֹּל שַׂלְמַת רֵעֶךָ עַד בֹּא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ תְּשִׁיבֶנּוּ לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אִם חָבֹל תַּחְבֹּל שַׂלְמַת רֵעֶךָ עַד בֹּא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ תְּשִׁיבֶנּוּ לוֹ׃

english.text:
If you take your neighbor’s clothing as security, you
shall give it back to him by the sunset,

translation.text: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.

verses.english:
If you take your neighbor’s clothing as security, you
shall give it back to him by the sunset,

verses.hebrew: כִּי הִוא כְסוּתֹה לְבַדָּהּ הִוא שִׂמְלָתוֹ לְעֹרוֹ בַּמֶּה יִשְׁכָּב וְהָיָה כִּי יִצְעַק אֵלַי וְשָׁמַעְתִּי כִּי חַנּוּן אָנִי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הִוא כְסוּתֹה לְבַדָּהּ הִוא שִׂמְלָתוֹ לְעֹרוֹ בַּמֶּה יִשְׁכָּב וְהָיָה כִּי יִצְעַק אֵלַי וְשָׁמַעְתִּי כִּי חַנּוּן אָנִי׃

english.text:
because it is his only apparel; it is his clothing for his
skin. In what will he sleep? And it will be, when he will
cry out to me, that I shall listen, because I am gracious.

translation.text: If thou at all take thy neighbour’s raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:

verses.english:
because it is his only apparel; it is his clothing for his
skin. In what will he sleep? And it will be, when he will
cry out to me, that I shall listen, because I am gracious.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים לֹא תְקַלֵּל וְנָשִׂיא בְעַמְּךָ לֹא תָאֹר׃

hebrew.text: אֱלֹהִים לֹא תְקַלֵּל וְנָשִׂיא בְעַמְּךָ לֹא תָאֹר׃

english.text:
“You shall not blaspheme God, and you shall not curse a
chieftain among your people.

translation.text: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.

verses.english:
“You shall not blaspheme God, and you shall not curse a
chieftain among your people.

verses.hebrew: מְלֵאָתְךָ וְדִמְעֲךָ לֹא תְאַחֵר בְּכוֹר בָּנֶיךָ תִּתֶּן לִי׃

hebrew.text: מְלֵאָתְךָ וְדִמְעֲךָ לֹא תְאַחֵר בְּכוֹר בָּנֶיךָ תִּתֶּן לִי׃

english.text:
“You shall not delay your fulfillment and your flowing.
“You shall give me the firstborn of your sons.

translation.text: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.

verses.english:
“You shall not delay your fulfillment and your flowing.
“You shall give me the firstborn of your sons.

verses.hebrew: כֵּן תַּעֲשֶׂה לְשֹׁרְךָ לְצֹאנֶךָ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים יִהְיֶה עִם אִמּוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי תִּתְּנוֹ לִי׃

hebrew.text: כֵּן תַּעֲשֶׂה לְשֹׁרְךָ לְצֹאנֶךָ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים יִהְיֶה עִם אִמּוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי תִּתְּנוֹ לִי׃

english.text:
“You shall do this to your ox and to your sheep: Seven
days it will be with its mother. On the eighth day you
shall give it to me.

translation.text: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.

verses.english:
“You shall do this to your ox and to your sheep: Seven
days it will be with its mother. On the eighth day you
shall give it to me.

verses.hebrew: וְאַנְשֵׁי קֹדֶשׁ תִּהְיוּן לִי וּבָשָׂר בַּשָּׂדֶה טְרֵפָה לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ לַכֶּלֶב תַּשְׁלִכוּן אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַנְשֵׁי קֹדֶשׁ תִּהְיוּן לִי וּבָשָׂר בַּשָּׂדֶה טְרֵפָה לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ לַכֶּלֶב תַּשְׁלִכוּן אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
“And you shall be holy people to me. “And you shall not
eat meat in the field that is torn. You shall throw it to
the dog.

translation.text: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.

verses.english:
“And you shall be holy people to me. “And you shall not
eat meat in the field that is torn. You shall throw it to
the dog.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִשָּׂא שֵׁמַע שָׁוְא אַל תָּשֶׁת יָדְךָ עִם רָשָׁע לִהְיֹת עֵד חָמָס׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִשָּׂא שֵׁמַע שָׁוְא אַל תָּשֶׁת יָדְךָ עִם רָשָׁע לִהְיֹת עֵד חָמָס׃

english.text:
“You shall not bring up a false report. Do not join
your hand with a wicked person to be a malevolent witness.

translation.text: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

verses.english:
“You shall not bring up a false report. Do not join
your hand with a wicked person to be a malevolent witness.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִהְיֶה אַחֲרֵי רַבִּים לְרָעֹת וְלֹא תַעֲנֶה עַל רִב לִנְטֹת אַחֲרֵי רַבִּים לְהַטֹּת׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִהְיֶה אַחֲרֵי רַבִּים לְרָעֹת וְלֹא תַעֲנֶה עַל רִב לִנְטֹת אַחֲרֵי רַבִּים לְהַטֹּת׃

english.text:
You shall not be following many to do bad. And you shall
not testify about a dispute to bend following many, to
bend it.

translation.text: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:

verses.english:
You shall not be following many to do bad. And you shall
not testify about a dispute to bend following many, to
bend it.

verses.hebrew: וְדָל לֹא תֶהְדַּר בְּרִיבוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְדָל לֹא תֶהְדַּר בְּרִיבוֹ׃

english.text: And you shall not favor a weak person in his dispute.

translation.text: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.

verses.english: And you shall not favor a weak person in his dispute.

verses.hebrew: כִּי תִפְגַּע שׁוֹר אֹיִבְךָ אוֹ חֲמֹרוֹ תֹּעֶה הָשֵׁב תְּשִׁיבֶנּוּ לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תִפְגַּע שׁוֹר אֹיִבְךָ אוֹ חֲמֹרוֹ תֹּעֶה הָשֵׁב תְּשִׁיבֶנּוּ לוֹ׃

english.text:
“If you will happen upon your enemy’s ox or his ass
straying, you shall bring it back to him.

translation.text: If thou meet thine enemy’s ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.

verses.english:
“If you will happen upon your enemy’s ox or his ass
straying, you shall bring it back to him.

verses.hebrew: כִּי תִרְאֶה חֲמוֹר שֹׂנַאֲךָ רֹבֵץ תַּחַת מַשָּׂאוֹ וְחָדַלְתָּ מֵעֲזֹב לוֹ עָזֹב תַּעֲזֹב עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תִרְאֶה חֲמוֹר שֹׂנַאֲךָ רֹבֵץ תַּחַת מַשָּׂאוֹ וְחָדַלְתָּ מֵעֲזֹב לוֹ עָזֹב תַּעֲזֹב עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
If you will see the ass of someone who hates you sagging
under its burden, and you would hold back from helping
him: you shall help with him.

translation.text: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.

verses.english:
If you will see the ass of someone who hates you sagging
under its burden, and you would hold back from helping
him: you shall help with him.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תַטֶּה מִשְׁפַּט אֶבְיֹנְךָ בְּרִיבוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַטֶּה מִשְׁפַּט אֶבְיֹנְךָ בְּרִיבוֹ׃

english.text:
“You shall not bend the judgment of your poor in his
dispute.

translation.text: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.

verses.english:
“You shall not bend the judgment of your poor in his
dispute.

verses.hebrew: מִדְּבַר שֶׁקֶר תִּרְחָק וְנָקִי וְצַדִּיק אַל תַּהֲרֹג כִּי לֹא אַצְדִּיק רָשָׁע׃

hebrew.text: מִדְּבַר שֶׁקֶר תִּרְחָק וְנָקִי וְצַדִּיק אַל תַּהֲרֹג כִּי לֹא אַצְדִּיק רָשָׁע׃

english.text:
“You shall keep far from a word of a lie, and do not kill
an innocent and a virtuous person, because I shall not
vindicate a wicked person.

translation.text: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.

verses.english:
“You shall keep far from a word of a lie, and do not kill
an innocent and a virtuous person, because I shall not
vindicate a wicked person.

verses.hebrew: וְשֹׁחַד לֹא תִקָּח כִּי הַשֹּׁחַד יְעַוֵּר פִּקְחִים וִיסַלֵּף דִּבְרֵי צַדִּיקִים׃

hebrew.text: וְשֹׁחַד לֹא תִקָּח כִּי הַשֹּׁחַד יְעַוֵּר פִּקְחִים וִיסַלֵּף דִּבְרֵי צַדִּיקִים׃

english.text:
“And you shall not take a bribe, because bribery will
blind those who can see and will undermine the words of
the virtuous.

translation.text: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.

verses.english:
“And you shall not take a bribe, because bribery will
blind those who can see and will undermine the words of
the virtuous.

verses.hebrew: וְגֵר לֹא תִלְחָץ וְאַתֶּם יְדַעְתֶּם אֶת נֶפֶשׁ הַגֵּר כִּי גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְגֵר לֹא תִלְחָץ וְאַתֶּם יְדַעְתֶּם אֶת נֶפֶשׁ הַגֵּר כִּי גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
“And you shall not oppress an alien—since you know the
alien’s soul, because you were aliens in the land of
Egypt.

translation.text: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
“And you shall not oppress an alien—since you know the
alien’s soul, because you were aliens in the land of
Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים תִּזְרַע אֶת אַרְצֶךָ וְאָסַפְתָּ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים תִּזְרַע אֶת אַרְצֶךָ וְאָסַפְתָּ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָהּ׃

english.text:
“And six years you shall sow your land and gather its
produce;

translation.text: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:

verses.english:
