translation.text: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.

verses.english:
And you shall make five acacia columns for the cover and
plate them with gold, their hooks of gold, and cast five
bases of bronze for them.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת אֹרֶךְ וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת רֹחַב רָבוּעַ יִהְיֶה הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְשָׁלֹשׁ אַמּוֹת קֹמָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת אֹרֶךְ וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת רֹחַב רָבוּעַ יִהְיֶה הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְשָׁלֹשׁ אַמּוֹת קֹמָתוֹ׃

english.text:
“And you shall make the altar of acacia wood. Five
cubits long and five cubits wide, the altar shall be
square—and its height three cubits.

translation.text: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.

verses.english:
“And you shall make the altar of acacia wood. Five
cubits long and five cubits wide, the altar shall be
square—and its height three cubits.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ קַרְנֹתָיו עַל אַרְבַּע פִּנֹּתָיו מִמֶּנּוּ תִּהְיֶיןָ קַרְנֹתָיו וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתוֹ נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ קַרְנֹתָיו עַל אַרְבַּע פִּנֹּתָיו מִמֶּנּוּ תִּהְיֶיןָ קַרְנֹתָיו וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתוֹ נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
And you shall make its horns on its four corners. Its
horns shall be part of it. And you shall plate it with
bronze.

translation.text: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.

verses.english:
And you shall make its horns on its four corners. Its
horns shall be part of it. And you shall plate it with
bronze.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ סִּירֹתָיו לְדַשְּׁנוֹ וְיָעָיו וּמִזְרְקֹתָיו וּמִזְלְגֹתָיו וּמַחְתֹּתָיו לְכל כֵּלָיו תַּעֲשֶׂה נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ סִּירֹתָיו לְדַשְּׁנוֹ וְיָעָיו וּמִזְרְקֹתָיו וּמִזְלְגֹתָיו וּמַחְתֹּתָיו לְכל כֵּלָיו תַּעֲשֶׂה נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
And you shall make its pots to remove ashes from it, and
its shovels and its basins and its forks and its
fire-holders. You shall make all of its equipment bronze.

translation.text: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.

verses.english:
And you shall make its pots to remove ashes from it, and
its shovels and its basins and its forks and its
fire-holders. You shall make all of its equipment bronze.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ מִכְבָּר מַעֲשֵׂה רֶשֶׁת נְחֹשֶׁת וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל הָרֶשֶׁת אַרְבַּע טַבְּעֹת נְחֹשֶׁת עַל אַרְבַּע קְצוֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ מִכְבָּר מַעֲשֵׂה רֶשֶׁת נְחֹשֶׁת וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל הָרֶשֶׁת אַרְבַּע טַבְּעֹת נְחֹשֶׁת עַל אַרְבַּע קְצוֹתָיו׃

english.text:
And you shall make a grate for it, a network of bronze,
and on the net you shall make four rings of bronze on its
four ends.

translation.text: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.

verses.english:
And you shall make a grate for it, a network of bronze,
and on the net you shall make four rings of bronze on its
four ends.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה אֹתָהּ תַּחַת כַּרְכֹּב הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִלְּמָטָּה וְהָיְתָה הָרֶשֶׁת עַד חֲצִי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּה אֹתָהּ תַּחַת כַּרְכֹּב הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִלְּמָטָּה וְהָיְתָה הָרֶשֶׁת עַד חֲצִי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And you shall place it under the altar’s ledge below so
that the net will be up to the middle of the altar.

translation.text: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.

verses.english:
And you shall place it under the altar’s ledge below so
that the net will be up to the middle of the altar.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ בַדִּים לַמִּזְבֵּחַ בַּדֵּי עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתָם נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ בַדִּים לַמִּזְבֵּחַ בַּדֵּי עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתָם נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
And you shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia
wood, and plate them with bronze.

translation.text: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.

verses.english:
And you shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia
wood, and plate them with bronze.

verses.hebrew: וְהוּבָא אֶת בַּדָּיו בַּטַּבָּעֹת וְהָיוּ הַבַּדִּים עַל שְׁתֵּי צַלְעֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בִּשְׂאֵת אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהוּבָא אֶת בַּדָּיו בַּטַּבָּעֹת וְהָיוּ הַבַּדִּים עַל שְׁתֵּי צַלְעֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בִּשְׂאֵת אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And its poles shall be brought through rings so that the
poles shall be on the altar’s two sides when carrying it.

translation.text: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.

verses.english:
And its poles shall be brought through rings so that the
poles shall be on the altar’s two sides when carrying it.

verses.hebrew: נְבוּב לֻחֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָה אֹתְךָ בָּהָר כֵּן יַעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: נְבוּב לֻחֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָה אֹתְךָ בָּהָר כֵּן יַעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
You shall make it hollow of boards, as it was shown to you
in the mountain. They shall do it so.

translation.text: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.

verses.english:
You shall make it hollow of boards, as it was shown to you
in the mountain. They shall do it so.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֵת חֲצַר הַמִּשְׁכָּן לִפְאַת נֶגֶב תֵּימָנָה קְלָעִים לֶחָצֵר שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מֵאָה בָאַמָּה אֹרֶךְ לַפֵּאָה הָאֶחָת׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֵת חֲצַר הַמִּשְׁכָּן לִפְאַת נֶגֶב תֵּימָנָה קְלָעִים לֶחָצֵר שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מֵאָה בָאַמָּה אֹרֶךְ לַפֵּאָה הָאֶחָת׃

english.text:
“And you shall make the Tabernacle’s courtyard: for the
south side—to the south, hangings for the courtyard of
woven linen, one side having a hundred in cubits,

translation.text: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:

verses.english:
“And you shall make the Tabernacle’s courtyard: for the
south side—to the south, hangings for the courtyard of
woven linen, one side having a hundred in cubits,

verses.hebrew: וְעַמֻּדָיו עֶשְׂרִים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָעַמֻּדִים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

hebrew.text: וְעַמֻּדָיו עֶשְׂרִים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָעַמֻּדִים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

english.text:
and its columns twenty, and their bases twenty of bronze,
and the columns’ hooks and their rods of silver.

translation.text: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

verses.english:
and its columns twenty, and their bases twenty of bronze,
and the columns’ hooks and their rods of silver.

verses.hebrew: וְכֵן לִפְאַת צָפוֹן בָּאֹרֶךְ קְלָעִים מֵאָה אֹרֶךְ וְעַמֻּדָו עֶשְׂרִים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָעַמֻּדִים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

hebrew.text: וְכֵן לִפְאַת צָפוֹן בָּאֹרֶךְ קְלָעִים מֵאָה אֹרֶךְ וְעַמֻּדָו עֶשְׂרִים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָעַמֻּדִים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

english.text:
And so for the north side: in length, hangings of a
hundred long, and its columns twenty, and their bases
twenty of bronze, and the columns’ hooks and their bands
of silver.

translation.text: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

verses.english:
And so for the north side: in length, hangings of a
hundred long, and its columns twenty, and their bases
twenty of bronze, and the columns’ hooks and their bands
of silver.

verses.hebrew: וְרֹחַב הֶחָצֵר לִפְאַת יָם קְלָעִים חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה עַמֻּדֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְרֹחַב הֶחָצֵר לִפְאַת יָם קְלָעִים חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה עַמֻּדֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה׃

english.text:
And the courtyard’s width for the west side: hangings of
fifty cubits, their columns ten and their bases ten.

translation.text: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

verses.english:
And the courtyard’s width for the west side: hangings of
fifty cubits, their columns ten and their bases ten.

verses.hebrew: וְרֹחַב הֶחָצֵר לִפְאַת קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְרֹחַב הֶחָצֵר לִפְאַת קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה׃

english.text:
And the courtyard’s width for the east side—to the
east—fifty cubits.

translation.text: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

verses.english:
And the courtyard’s width for the east side—to the
east—fifty cubits.

verses.hebrew: וַחֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קְלָעִים לַכָּתֵף עַמֻּדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַחֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קְלָעִים לַכָּתֵף עַמֻּדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

english.text:
And the panel shall have fifteen cubits of hangings, their
columns three and their bases three;

translation.text: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

verses.english:
And the panel shall have fifteen cubits of hangings, their
columns three and their bases three;

verses.hebrew: וְלַכָּתֵף הַשֵּׁנִית חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה קְלָעִים עַמֻּדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְלַכָּתֵף הַשֵּׁנִית חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה קְלָעִים עַמֻּדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

english.text:
and the second panel shall have fifteen of hangings, their
columns three and their bases three.

translation.text: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

verses.english:
and the second panel shall have fifteen of hangings, their
columns three and their bases three.

verses.hebrew: וּלְשַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר מָסָךְ עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם עַמֻּדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה׃

hebrew.text: וּלְשַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר מָסָךְ עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם עַמֻּדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה׃

english.text:
And the courtyard’s gate shall have a cover of twenty
cubits: blue and purple and scarlet and woven linen,
embroiderer’s work, their columns four and their bases
four.

translation.text: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.

verses.english:
And the courtyard’s gate shall have a cover of twenty
cubits: blue and purple and scarlet and woven linen,
embroiderer’s work, their columns four and their bases
four.

verses.hebrew: כּל עַמּוּדֵי הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב מְחֻשָּׁקִים כֶּסֶף וָוֵיהֶם כָּסֶף וְאַדְנֵיהֶם נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: כּל עַמּוּדֵי הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב מְחֻשָּׁקִים כֶּסֶף וָוֵיהֶם כָּסֶף וְאַדְנֵיהֶם נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
All of the courtyard’s columns all around shall be banded
with silver, their hooks of silver and their bases bronze.

translation.text: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.

verses.english:
All of the courtyard’s columns all around shall be banded
with silver, their hooks of silver and their bases bronze.

verses.hebrew: אֹרֶךְ הֶחָצֵר מֵאָה בָאַמָּה וְרֹחַב חֲמִשִּׁים בַּחֲמִשִּׁים וְקֹמָה חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר וְאַדְנֵיהֶם נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: אֹרֶךְ הֶחָצֵר מֵאָה בָאַמָּה וְרֹחַב חֲמִשִּׁים בַּחֲמִשִּׁים וְקֹמָה חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר וְאַדְנֵיהֶם נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
The courtyard’s length a hundred in cubits, and width
consistently fifty, and height five cubits of woven linen,
and their bases of bronze.

translation.text: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.

verses.english:
The courtyard’s length a hundred in cubits, and width
consistently fifty, and height five cubits of woven linen,
and their bases of bronze.

verses.hebrew: לְכֹל כְּלֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן בְּכֹל עֲבֹדָתוֹ וְכל יְתֵדֹתָיו וְכל יִתְדֹת הֶחָצֵר נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: לְכֹל כְּלֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן בְּכֹל עֲבֹדָתוֹ וְכל יְתֵדֹתָיו וְכל יִתְדֹת הֶחָצֵר נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
For all of the Tabernacle’s equipment in all of the
service of it, and all of its pegs and all of the
courtyard’s pegs: bronze.

translation.text: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.

verses.english:
For all of the Tabernacle’s equipment in all of the
service of it, and all of its pegs and all of the
courtyard’s pegs: bronze.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תְּצַוֶּה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִקְחוּ אֵלֶיךָ שֶׁמֶן זַיִת זָךְ כָּתִית לַמָּאוֹר לְהַעֲלֹת נֵר תָּמִיד׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה תְּצַוֶּה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִקְחוּ אֵלֶיךָ שֶׁמֶן זַיִת זָךְ כָּתִית לַמָּאוֹר לְהַעֲלֹת נֵר תָּמִיד׃

english.text:
COMMAND “And you: you shall command the children of Israel
that they shall bring clear pressed olive oil to you for
the light, to keep up a lamp always.

translation.text: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.

verses.english:
COMMAND “And you: you shall command the children of Israel
that they shall bring clear pressed olive oil to you for
the light, to keep up a lamp always.

verses.hebrew: בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד מִחוּץ לַפָּרֹכֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל הָעֵדֻת יַעֲרֹךְ אֹתוֹ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מֵעֶרֶב עַד בֹּקֶר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד מִחוּץ לַפָּרֹכֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל הָעֵדֻת יַעֲרֹךְ אֹתוֹ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מֵעֶרֶב עַד בֹּקֶר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
In the Tent of Meeting, outside the pavilion that is over
the Testimony, Aaron and his sons shall arrange it from
evening until morning in front of YHWH, an eternal law
through their generations from the children of Israel.

translation.text: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

verses.english:
In the Tent of Meeting, outside the pavilion that is over
the Testimony, Aaron and his sons shall arrange it from
evening until morning in front of YHWH, an eternal law
through their generations from the children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה הַקְרֵב אֵלֶיךָ אֶת אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וְאֶת בָּנָיו אִתּוֹ מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְכַהֲנוֹ לִי אַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָר בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה הַקְרֵב אֵלֶיךָ אֶת אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וְאֶת בָּנָיו אִתּוֹ מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְכַהֲנוֹ לִי אַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָר בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן׃

english.text:
“And you, bring Aaron, your brother, forward to you,
and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel,
for him to function as a priest for me: Aaron, Nadab and
Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

translation.text: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

verses.english:
“And you, bring Aaron, your brother, forward to you,
and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel,
for him to function as a priest for me: Aaron, Nadab and
Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ בִגְדֵי קֹדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ לְכָבוֹד וּלְתִפְאָרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ בִגְדֵי קֹדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ לְכָבוֹד וּלְתִפְאָרֶת׃

english.text:
And you shall make holy clothes for Aaron, your brother, for glory
and for beauty.

translation.text: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.

verses.english:
And you shall make holy clothes for Aaron, your brother, for glory
and for beauty.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תְּדַבֵּר אֶל כּל חַכְמֵי לֵב אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּאתִיו רוּחַ חכְמָה וְעָשׂוּ אֶת בִּגְדֵי אַהֲרֹן לְקַדְּשׁוֹ לְכַהֲנוֹ לִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה תְּדַבֵּר אֶל כּל חַכְמֵי לֵב אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּאתִיו רוּחַ חכְמָה וְעָשׂוּ אֶת בִּגְדֵי אַהֲרֹן לְקַדְּשׁוֹ לְכַהֲנוֹ לִי׃

english.text:
And you shall speak to all the wise of heart whom I have
filled with a spirit of wisdom, that they shall make
Aaron’s clothes, to sanctify him for him to function as a
priest for me.

translation.text: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron’s garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.english:
And you shall speak to all the wise of heart whom I have
filled with a spirit of wisdom, that they shall make
Aaron’s clothes, to sanctify him for him to function as a
priest for me.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הַבְּגָדִים אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּ חֹשֶׁן וְאֵפוֹד וּמְעִיל וּכְתֹנֶת תַּשְׁבֵּץ מִצְנֶפֶת וְאַבְנֵט וְעָשׂוּ בִגְדֵי קֹדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וּלְבָנָיו לְכַהֲנוֹ לִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה הַבְּגָדִים אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּ חֹשֶׁן וְאֵפוֹד וּמְעִיל וּכְתֹנֶת תַּשְׁבֵּץ מִצְנֶפֶת וְאַבְנֵט וְעָשׂוּ בִגְדֵי קֹדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וּלְבָנָיו לְכַהֲנוֹ לִי׃

english.text:
And these are the clothes that they shall make:
breastplate and ephod and robe and patterned coat, a
headdress and a sash. And they shall make holy clothes for
Aaron, your brother, and for his sons, for him to function
as a priest for me.

translation.text: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.english:
And these are the clothes that they shall make:
breastplate and ephod and robe and patterned coat, a
headdress and a sash. And they shall make holy clothes for
Aaron, your brother, and for his sons, for him to function
as a priest for me.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵם יִקְחוּ אֶת הַזָּהָב וְאֶת הַתְּכֵלֶת וְאֶת הָאַרְגָּמָן וְאֶת תּוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי וְאֶת הַשֵּׁשׁ׃

“And they shall make the ephod: gold, blue, and purple,

verses.english:
It shall have two connected shoulder-pieces at its two
ends, and it will be connected.

scarlet and woven linen.

And the ephod’s designed belt that is on it shall be like

And you shall take two onyx stones and inscribe the names

And you shall take two onyx stones and inscribe the names

six of their names on one stone and the names of the

stones with signet inscriptions according to the names of
the children of Israel. You shall make them surrounded by
settings of gold.

verses.english:
By a stone engraver’s work you shall inscribe the two

english.text:
And you shall set the two stones on the ephod’s
shoulder-pieces, commemorative stones for the children of
Israel, and Aaron shall carry their names in front of YHWH
on his two shoulders as a commemoration.

verses.english:
And you shall set the two stones on the ephod’s
shoulder-pieces, commemorative stones for the children of
Israel, and Aaron shall carry their names in front of YHWH
