hebrew.text: סָרוּ מַהֵר מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִם עָשׂוּ לָהֶם עֵגֶל מַסֵּכָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לוֹ וַיִּזְבְּחוּ לוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלֶּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלוּךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
They’ve turned quickly from the way that I commanded them.
They’ve made themselves a molten calf, and they’ve bowed
to it and sacrificed to it and said, ‘These are your gods,
Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt!’”

translation.text: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
They’ve turned quickly from the way that I commanded them.
They’ve made themselves a molten calf, and they’ve bowed
to it and sacrificed to it and said, ‘These are your gods,
Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt!’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה רָאִיתִי אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה וְהִנֵּה עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה רָאִיתִי אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה וְהִנֵּה עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף הוּא׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “I’ve seen this people; and, here,
it’s a hard-necked people.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “I’ve seen this people; and, here,
it’s a hard-necked people.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הַנִּיחָה לִּי וְיִחַר אַפִּי בָהֶם וַאֲכַלֵּם וְאֶעֱשֶׂה אוֹתְךָ לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הַנִּיחָה לִּי וְיִחַר אַפִּי בָהֶם וַאֲכַלֵּם וְאֶעֱשֶׂה אוֹתְךָ לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל׃

english.text:
And now, leave off from me, and my anger will flare at
them, and I’ll finish them, and I’ll make you into a big
nation!”

translation.text: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.

verses.english:
And now, leave off from me, and my anger will flare at
them, and I’ll finish them, and I’ll make you into a big
nation!”

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַל מֹשֶׁה אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָה יְהֹוָה יֶחֱרֶה אַפְּךָ בְּעַמֶּךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּכֹחַ גָּדוֹל וּבְיָד חֲזָקָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחַל מֹשֶׁה אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָה יְהֹוָה יֶחֱרֶה אַפְּךָ בְּעַמֶּךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּכֹחַ גָּדוֹל וּבְיָד חֲזָקָה׃

english.text:
And Moses conciliated in front of YHWH, his God, and said,
“Why, YHWH, should your anger flare at your people whom
you brought out from the land of Egypt with big power and
with a strong hand?

translation.text: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?

verses.english:
And Moses conciliated in front of YHWH, his God, and said,
“Why, YHWH, should your anger flare at your people whom
you brought out from the land of Egypt with big power and
with a strong hand?

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ מִצְרַיִם לֵאמֹר בְּרָעָה הוֹצִיאָם לַהֲרֹג אֹתָם בֶּהָרִים וּלְכַלֹּתָם מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה שׁוּב מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּךָ וְהִנָּחֵם עַל הָרָעָה לְעַמֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ מִצְרַיִם לֵאמֹר בְּרָעָה הוֹצִיאָם לַהֲרֹג אֹתָם בֶּהָרִים וּלְכַלֹּתָם מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה שׁוּב מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּךָ וְהִנָּחֵם עַל הָרָעָה לְעַמֶּךָ׃

english.text:
Why should Egypt say, saying, ‘He brought them out for
bad, to kill them in the mountains, and to finish them
from on the face of the earth’? Turn back from your
flaring anger, and relent about the bad to your people.

translation.text: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.

verses.english:
Why should Egypt say, saying, ‘He brought them out for
bad, to kill them in the mountains, and to finish them
from on the face of the earth’? Turn back from your
flaring anger, and relent about the bad to your people.

verses.hebrew: זְכֹר לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לָהֶם בָּךְ וַתְּדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם אַרְבֶּה אֶת זַרְעֲכֶם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם וְכל הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי אֶתֵּן לְזַרְעֲכֶם וְנָחֲלוּ לְעֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: זְכֹר לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לָהֶם בָּךְ וַתְּדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם אַרְבֶּה אֶת זַרְעֲכֶם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם וְכל הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי אֶתֵּן לְזַרְעֲכֶם וְנָחֲלוּ לְעֹלָם׃

english.text:
Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, that
you swore to them by yourself, and you spoke to them:
‘I’ll multiply your seed like the stars of the skies, and
I’ll give to your seed all this land that I’ve said, and
they’ll possess it forever.’”

translation.text: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.

verses.english:
Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, that
you swore to them by yourself, and you spoke to them:
‘I’ll multiply your seed like the stars of the skies, and
I’ll give to your seed all this land that I’ve said, and
they’ll possess it forever.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּנָּחֶם יְהֹוָה עַל הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לַעֲשׂוֹת לְעַמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּנָּחֶם יְהֹוָה עַל הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לַעֲשׂוֹת לְעַמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH relented about the bad that He had spoken, to do
to His people.

translation.text: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.

verses.english:
And YHWH relented about the bad that He had spoken, to do
to His people.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן וַיֵּרֶד מֹשֶׁה מִן הָהָר וּשְׁנֵי לֻחֹת הָעֵדֻת בְּיָדוֹ לֻחֹת כְּתֻבִים מִשְּׁנֵי עֶבְרֵיהֶם מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה הֵם כְּתֻבִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֶן וַיֵּרֶד מֹשֶׁה מִן הָהָר וּשְׁנֵי לֻחֹת הָעֵדֻת בְּיָדוֹ לֻחֹת כְּתֻבִים מִשְּׁנֵי עֶבְרֵיהֶם מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה הֵם כְּתֻבִים׃

english.text:
And Moses turned and went down from the mountain. And the
two tablets of witness were in his hand, tablets written
from their two sides: from this side and from this side
they were written.

translation.text: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.

verses.english:
And Moses turned and went down from the mountain. And the
two tablets of witness were in his hand, tablets written
from their two sides: from this side and from this side
they were written.

verses.hebrew: וְהַלֻּחֹת מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהִים הֵמָּה וְהַמִּכְתָּב מִכְתַּב אֱלֹהִים הוּא חָרוּת עַל הַלֻּחֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְהַלֻּחֹת מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהִים הֵמָּה וְהַמִּכְתָּב מִכְתַּב אֱלֹהִים הוּא חָרוּת עַל הַלֻּחֹת׃

english.text:
And the tablets: they were God’s doing. And the writing:
it was God’s writing, inscribed on the tablets.

translation.text: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.

verses.english:
And the tablets: they were God’s doing. And the writing:
it was God’s writing, inscribed on the tablets.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת קוֹל הָעָם בְּרֵעֹה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל מֹשֶׁה קוֹל מִלְחָמָה בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת קוֹל הָעָם בְּרֵעֹה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל מֹשֶׁה קוֹל מִלְחָמָה בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And Joshua heard the sound of the people in its shouting,
and he said to Moses, “A sound of war is in the camp.”

translation.text: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.

verses.english:
And Joshua heard the sound of the people in its shouting,
and he said to Moses, “A sound of war is in the camp.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין קוֹל עֲנוֹת גְּבוּרָה וְאֵין קוֹל עֲנוֹת חֲלוּשָׁה קוֹל עַנּוֹת אָנֹכִי שֹׁמֵעַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין קוֹל עֲנוֹת גְּבוּרָה וְאֵין קוֹל עֲנוֹת חֲלוּשָׁה קוֹל עַנּוֹת אָנֹכִי שֹׁמֵעַ׃

english.text:
And he said, “It’s not a sound of singing of victory, and
it’s not a sound of singing of defeat. It’s just the sound
of singing I hear!”

translation.text: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.

verses.english:
And he said, “It’s not a sound of singing of victory, and
it’s not a sound of singing of defeat. It’s just the sound
of singing I hear!”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר קָרַב אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיַּרְא אֶת הָעֵגֶל וּמְחֹלֹת וַיִּחַר אַף מֹשֶׁה וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ מִיָּדָו אֶת הַלֻּחֹת וַיְשַׁבֵּר אֹתָם תַּחַת הָהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר קָרַב אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיַּרְא אֶת הָעֵגֶל וּמְחֹלֹת וַיִּחַר אַף מֹשֶׁה וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ מִיָּדָו אֶת הַלֻּחֹת וַיְשַׁבֵּר אֹתָם תַּחַת הָהָר׃

english.text:
And it was when he came close to the camp, and he saw the
calf and dancing: and Moses’ anger flared, and he threw
the tablets from his hands and shattered them below the
mountain.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses’ anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.

verses.english:
And it was when he came close to the camp, and he saw the
calf and dancing: and Moses’ anger flared, and he threw
the tablets from his hands and shattered them below the
mountain.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת הָעֵגֶל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ וַיִּשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ וַיִּטְחַן עַד אֲשֶׁר דָּק וַיִּזֶר עַל פְּנֵי הַמַּיִם וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֶת הָעֵגֶל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ וַיִּשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ וַיִּטְחַן עַד אֲשֶׁר דָּק וַיִּזֶר עַל פְּנֵי הַמַּיִם וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And he took the calf that they had made, and he burned it
in fire and ground it until it was thin, and he scattered
it on the face of the water, and he made the children of
Israel drink!

translation.text: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.

verses.english:
And he took the calf that they had made, and he burned it
in fire and ground it until it was thin, and he scattered
it on the face of the water, and he made the children of
Israel drink!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן מֶה עָשָׂה לְךָ הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי הֵבֵאתָ עָלָיו חֲטָאָה גְדֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן מֶה עָשָׂה לְךָ הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי הֵבֵאתָ עָלָיו חֲטָאָה גְדֹלָה׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Aaron, “What did this people do to you,
that you’ve brought a big sin on it?!”

translation.text: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?

verses.english:
And Moses said to Aaron, “What did this people do to you,
that you’ve brought a big sin on it?!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַהֲרֹן אַל יִחַר אַף אֲדֹנִי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת הָעָם כִּי בְרָע הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַהֲרֹן אַל יִחַר אַף אֲדֹנִי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת הָעָם כִּי בְרָע הוּא׃

english.text:
And Aaron said, “Let my lord’s anger not flare. You know
the people, that it’s in a bad state.

translation.text: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.

verses.english:
And Aaron said, “Let my lord’s anger not flare. You know
the people, that it’s in a bad state.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לִי עֲשֵׂה לָנוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר יֵלְכוּ לְפָנֵינוּ כִּי זֶה מֹשֶׁה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לֹא יָדַעְנוּ מֶה הָיָה לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לִי עֲשֵׂה לָנוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר יֵלְכוּ לְפָנֵינוּ כִּי זֶה מֹשֶׁה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לֹא יָדַעְנוּ מֶה הָיָה לוֹ׃

english.text:
And they said to me, ‘Make gods for us who will go in
front of us, because this Moses, the man who brought us up
from the land of Egypt: we don’t know what has become of
him!’

translation.text: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

verses.english:
And they said to me, ‘Make gods for us who will go in
front of us, because this Moses, the man who brought us up
from the land of Egypt: we don’t know what has become of
him!’

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר לָהֶם לְמִי זָהָב הִתְפָּרָקוּ וַיִּתְּנוּ לִי וָאַשְׁלִכֵהוּ בָאֵשׁ וַיֵּצֵא הָעֵגֶל הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר לָהֶם לְמִי זָהָב הִתְפָּרָקוּ וַיִּתְּנוּ לִי וָאַשְׁלִכֵהוּ בָאֵשׁ וַיֵּצֵא הָעֵגֶל הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And I said to them, ‘Whoever has gold: take it off.’ And
they gave it to me, and I threw it into the fire, and this
calf came out!”

translation.text: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.

verses.english:
And I said to them, ‘Whoever has gold: take it off.’ And
they gave it to me, and I threw it into the fire, and this
calf came out!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָעָם כִּי פָרֻעַ הוּא כִּי פְרָעֹה אַהֲרֹן לְשִׁמְצָה בְּקָמֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָעָם כִּי פָרֻעַ הוּא כִּי פְרָעֹה אַהֲרֹן לְשִׁמְצָה בְּקָמֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses saw the people, that it was turned loose,
because Aaron had turned it loose—to denigration among
their adversaries!

translation.text: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)

verses.english:
And Moses saw the people, that it was turned loose,
because Aaron had turned it loose—to denigration among
their adversaries!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד מֹשֶׁה בְּשַׁעַר הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיֹּאמֶר מִי לַיהֹוָה אֵלָי וַיֵּאָסְפוּ אֵלָיו כּל בְּנֵי לֵוִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲמֹד מֹשֶׁה בְּשַׁעַר הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיֹּאמֶר מִי לַיהֹוָה אֵלָי וַיֵּאָסְפוּ אֵלָיו כּל בְּנֵי לֵוִי׃

english.text:
And Moses stood in the gate of the camp and said, “Whoever
is for YHWH: to me!” And all the children of Levi were
gathered to him.

translation.text: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD’s side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.

verses.english:
And Moses stood in the gate of the camp and said, “Whoever
is for YHWH: to me!” And all the children of Levi were
gathered to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׂימוּ אִישׁ חַרְבּוֹ עַל יְרֵכוֹ עִבְרוּ וָשׁוּבוּ מִשַּׁעַר לָשַׁעַר בַּמַּחֲנֶה וְהִרְגוּ אִישׁ אֶת אָחִיו וְאִישׁ אֶת רֵעֵהוּ וְאִישׁ אֶת קְרֹבוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׂימוּ אִישׁ חַרְבּוֹ עַל יְרֵכוֹ עִבְרוּ וָשׁוּבוּ מִשַּׁעַר לָשַׁעַר בַּמַּחֲנֶה וְהִרְגוּ אִישׁ אֶת אָחִיו וְאִישׁ אֶת רֵעֵהוּ וְאִישׁ אֶת קְרֹבוֹ׃

english.text:
And he said to them, “YHWH, God of Israel, said this:
‘Set, each man, his sword on his thigh; cross over and
come back from gate to gate in the camp; and kill, each
man, his brother and, each man, his neighbor and, each
man, his relative.’”

translation.text: And he said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.

verses.english:
And he said to them, “YHWH, God of Israel, said this:
‘Set, each man, his sword on his thigh; cross over and
come back from gate to gate in the camp; and kill, each
man, his brother and, each man, his neighbor and, each
man, his relative.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי לֵוִי כִּדְבַר מֹשֶׁה וַיִּפֹּל מִן הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אַלְפֵי אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי לֵוִי כִּדְבַר מֹשֶׁה וַיִּפֹּל מִן הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אַלְפֵי אִישׁ׃

english.text:
And the children of Levi did according to Moses’ word, and
about three thousand men fell from the people in that day.

translation.text: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.

verses.english:
And the children of Levi did according to Moses’ word, and
about three thousand men fell from the people in that day.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה מִלְאוּ יֶדְכֶם הַיּוֹם לַיהֹוָה כִּי אִישׁ בִּבְנוֹ וּבְאָחִיו וְלָתֵת עֲלֵיכֶם הַיּוֹם בְּרָכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה מִלְאוּ יֶדְכֶם הַיּוֹם לַיהֹוָה כִּי אִישׁ בִּבְנוֹ וּבְאָחִיו וְלָתֵת עֲלֵיכֶם הַיּוֹם בְּרָכָה׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “Fill your hand to YHWH today—because each
man was at his son and at his brother—and to put a
blessing on you today.”

translation.text: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves today to the LORD, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “Fill your hand to YHWH today—because each
man was at his son and at his brother—and to put a
blessing on you today.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעָם אַתֶּם חֲטָאתֶם חֲטָאָה גְדֹלָה וְעַתָּה אֶעֱלֶה אֶל יְהֹוָה אוּלַי אֲכַפְּרָה בְּעַד חַטַּאתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעָם אַתֶּם חֲטָאתֶם חֲטָאָה גְדֹלָה וְעַתָּה אֶעֱלֶה אֶל יְהֹוָה אוּלַי אֲכַפְּרָה בְּעַד חַטַּאתְכֶם׃

english.text:
And it was on the next day, and Moses said to the people,
“You’ve committed a big sin. And now I’ll go up to YHWH.
Perhaps I may make atonement for your sin.”

translation.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the LORD; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.

verses.english:
And it was on the next day, and Moses said to the people,
“You’ve committed a big sin. And now I’ll go up to YHWH.
Perhaps I may make atonement for your sin.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר אָנָּא חָטָא הָעָם הַזֶּה חֲטָאָה גְדֹלָה וַיַּעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם אֱלֹהֵי זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר אָנָּא חָטָא הָעָם הַזֶּה חֲטָאָה גְדֹלָה וַיַּעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם אֱלֹהֵי זָהָב׃

english.text:
And Moses went back to YHWH and said, “Please, this people
has committed a big sin and made gods of gold for
themselves.

translation.text: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.

verses.english:
And Moses went back to YHWH and said, “Please, this people
has committed a big sin and made gods of gold for
themselves.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אִם תִּשָּׂא חַטָּאתָם וְאִם אַיִן מְחֵנִי נָא מִסִּפְרְךָ אֲשֶׁר כָּתָבְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אִם תִּשָּׂא חַטָּאתָם וְאִם אַיִן מְחֵנִי נָא מִסִּפְרְךָ אֲשֶׁר כָּתָבְתָּ׃

english.text:
And now, if you will bear their sin—and if not, wipe me
out from your scroll that you’ve written.”

translation.text: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin--; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.

verses.english:
And now, if you will bear their sin—and if not, wipe me
out from your scroll that you’ve written.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה מִי אֲשֶׁר חָטָא לִי אֶמְחֶנּוּ מִסִּפְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה מִי אֲשֶׁר חָטָא לִי אֶמְחֶנּוּ מִסִּפְרִי׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “The one who has sinned against
me, I’ll wipe him out from my scroll.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “The one who has sinned against
me, I’ll wipe him out from my scroll.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לֵךְ נְחֵה אֶת הָעָם אֶל אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי לָךְ הִנֵּה מַלְאָכִי יֵלֵךְ לְפָנֶיךָ וּבְיוֹם פּקְדִי וּפָקַדְתִּי עֲלֵהֶם חַטָּאתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לֵךְ נְחֵה אֶת הָעָם אֶל אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי לָךְ הִנֵּה מַלְאָכִי יֵלֵךְ לְפָנֶיךָ וּבְיוֹם פּקְדִי וּפָקַדְתִּי עֲלֵהֶם חַטָּאתָם׃

english.text:
And now, go. Lead the people to where I spoke to you.
Here, my angel will go ahead of you. And, in the day that
I take account, I’ll account their sin on them.”

translation.text: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.

verses.english:
And now, go. Lead the people to where I spoke to you.
Here, my angel will go ahead of you. And, in the day that
I take account, I’ll account their sin on them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגֹּף יְהֹוָה אֶת הָעָם עַל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֶת הָעֵגֶל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אַהֲרֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגֹּף יְהֹוָה אֶת הָעָם עַל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֶת הָעֵגֶל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אַהֲרֹן׃

english.text:
And YHWH struck the people because they had made the calf,
which Aaron had made.

translation.text: And the LORD plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.

verses.english:
And YHWH struck the people because they had made the calf,
which Aaron had made.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵךְ עֲלֵה מִזֶּה אַתָּה וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלִיתָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לֵאמֹר לְזַרְעֲךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵךְ עֲלֵה מִזֶּה אַתָּה וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלִיתָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לֵאמֹר לְזַרְעֲךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה׃

english.text:
And YHWH spoke to Moses: “Go. Go up from here, you and
the people whom you brought up from the land of Egypt, to
the land that I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob,
saying, ‘I’ll give it to your seed.’

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:

verses.english:
And YHWH spoke to Moses: “Go. Go up from here, you and
the people whom you brought up from the land of Egypt, to
the land that I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob,
saying, ‘I’ll give it to your seed.’

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁלַחְתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ מַלְאָךְ וְגֵרַשְׁתִּי אֶת הַכְּנַעֲנִי הָאֱמֹרִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַפְּרִזִּי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁלַחְתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ מַלְאָךְ וְגֵרַשְׁתִּי אֶת הַכְּנַעֲנִי הָאֱמֹרִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַפְּרִזִּי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃

english.text:
And I’ll send an angel ahead of you—and I’ll drive out the
Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite and the Perizzite
and the Hivite and the Jebusite—

translation.text: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

verses.english:
And I’ll send an angel ahead of you—and I’ll drive out the
Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite and the Perizzite
and the Hivite and the Jebusite—

verses.hebrew: אֶל אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ כִּי לֹא אֶעֱלֶה בְּקִרְבְּךָ כִּי עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף אַתָּה פֶּן אֲכֶלְךָ בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: אֶל אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ כִּי לֹא אֶעֱלֶה בְּקִרְבְּךָ כִּי עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף אַתָּה פֶּן אֲכֶלְךָ בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

english.text:
to a land flowing with milk and honey, because I won’t go
up among you, because you’re a hard-necked people, or else
I’ll finish you on the way.”

translation.text: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.

verses.english:
to a land flowing with milk and honey, because I won’t go
up among you, because you’re a hard-necked people, or else
I’ll finish you on the way.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע הָעָם אֶת הַדָּבָר הָרָע הַזֶּה וַיִּתְאַבָּלוּ וְלֹא שָׁתוּ אִישׁ עֶדְיוֹ עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע הָעָם אֶת הַדָּבָר הָרָע הַזֶּה וַיִּתְאַבָּלוּ וְלֹא שָׁתוּ אִישׁ עֶדְיוֹ עָלָיו׃

english.text:
And the people heard this bad thing, and they mourned, and
not a man put his jewelry on him.

translation.text: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.

verses.english:
And the people heard this bad thing, and they mourned, and
not a man put his jewelry on him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֱמֹר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתֶּם עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף רֶגַע אֶחָד אֶעֱלֶה בְקִרְבְּךָ וְכִלִּיתִיךָ וְעַתָּה הוֹרֵד עֶדְיְךָ מֵעָלֶיךָ וְאֵדְעָה מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֱמֹר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתֶּם עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף רֶגַע אֶחָד אֶעֱלֶה בְקִרְבְּךָ וְכִלִּיתִיךָ וְעַתָּה הוֹרֵד עֶדְיְךָ מֵעָלֶיךָ וְאֵדְעָה מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לָּךְ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Say to the children of Israel:
‘You’re a hard-necked people. If I would go up among you
for one moment, I would finish you! And now, put your
jewelry down from on you, so I may know what I’ll do with
you.’”

translation.text: For the LORD had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Say to the children of Israel:
‘You’re a hard-necked people. If I would go up among you
for one moment, I would finish you! And now, put your
jewelry down from on you, so I may know what I’ll do with
you.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְנַצְּלוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת עֶדְיָם מֵהַר חוֹרֵב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְנַצְּלוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת עֶדְיָם מֵהַר חוֹרֵב׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel divested their jewelry from
Mount Horeb.

translation.text: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel divested their jewelry from
Mount Horeb.

verses.hebrew: וּמֹשֶׁה יִקַּח אֶת הָאֹהֶל וְנָטָה לוֹ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה הַרְחֵק מִן הַמַּחֲנֶה וְקָרָא לוֹ אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהָיָה כּל מְבַקֵּשׁ יְהֹוָה יֵצֵא אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וּמֹשֶׁה יִקַּח אֶת הָאֹהֶל וְנָטָה לוֹ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה הַרְחֵק מִן הַמַּחֲנֶה וְקָרָא לוֹ אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהָיָה כּל מְבַקֵּשׁ יְהֹוָה יֵצֵא אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And Moses would take the tent and pitch it outside of the
camp, going far from the camp, and he called it the Tent
of Meeting. And it would be: everyone seeking YHWH would
go out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside of the
camp.

translation.text: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.

verses.english:
And Moses would take the tent and pitch it outside of the
camp, going far from the camp, and he called it the Tent
of Meeting. And it would be: everyone seeking YHWH would
go out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside of the
camp.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כְּצֵאת מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָאֹהֶל יָקוּמוּ כּל הָעָם וְנִצְּבוּ אִישׁ פֶּתַח אהֳלוֹ וְהִבִּיטוּ אַחֲרֵי מֹשֶׁה עַד בֹּאוֹ הָאֹהֱלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כְּצֵאת מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָאֹהֶל יָקוּמוּ כּל הָעָם וְנִצְּבוּ אִישׁ פֶּתַח אהֳלוֹ וְהִבִּיטוּ אַחֲרֵי מֹשֶׁה עַד בֹּאוֹ הָאֹהֱלָה׃

english.text:
And it would be, when Moses would go out to the Tent, all
the people would get up, and they would stand up, each one
at the entrance of his tent, and they would look after
Moses until he came to the Tent.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.

verses.english:
And it would be, when Moses would go out to the Tent, all
the people would get up, and they would stand up, each one
at the entrance of his tent, and they would look after
Moses until he came to the Tent.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כְּבֹא מֹשֶׁה הָאֹהֱלָה יֵרֵד עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן וְעָמַד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וְדִבֶּר עִם מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כְּבֹא מֹשֶׁה הָאֹהֱלָה יֵרֵד עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן וְעָמַד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וְדִבֶּר עִם מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And it would be, when Moses came to the Tent, the column
of cloud would come down, and it would stand at the
entrance of the Tent, and He would speak with Moses.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the Lord talked with Moses.

verses.english:
And it would be, when Moses came to the Tent, the column
of cloud would come down, and it would stand at the
entrance of the Tent, and He would speak with Moses.

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה כל הָעָם אֶת עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן עֹמֵד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וְקָם כּל הָעָם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ אִישׁ פֶּתַח אהֳלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה כל הָעָם אֶת עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן עֹמֵד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וְקָם כּל הָעָם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ אִישׁ פֶּתַח אהֳלוֹ׃

english.text:
And all the people would see the column of cloud standing
at the entrance of the Tent, and all the people would get
up and bow, each at the entrance of his tent.

translation.text: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.

verses.english:
And all the people would see the column of cloud standing
at the entrance of the Tent, and all the people would get
up and bow, each at the entrance of his tent.

verses.hebrew: וְדִבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה פָּנִים אֶל פָּנִים כַּאֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ וְשָׁב אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה וּמְשָׁרְתוֹ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן נַעַר לֹא יָמִישׁ מִתּוֹךְ הָאֹהֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְדִבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה פָּנִים אֶל פָּנִים כַּאֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ וְשָׁב אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה וּמְשָׁרְתוֹ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן נַעַר לֹא יָמִישׁ מִתּוֹךְ הָאֹהֶל׃

english.text:
And YHWH would speak to Moses face-to-face, the way a man
speaks to his fellow man. And he would come back to the
camp. And his attendant, Joshua, son of Nun, a young man,
would not depart from inside the Tent.

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.

verses.english:
And YHWH would speak to Moses face-to-face, the way a man
speaks to his fellow man. And he would come back to the
camp. And his attendant, Joshua, son of Nun, a young man,
would not depart from inside the Tent.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה רְאֵה אַתָּה אֹמֵר אֵלַי הַעַל אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה לֹא הוֹדַעְתַּנִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁלַח עִמִּי וְאַתָּה אָמַרְתָּ יְדַעְתִּיךָ בְשֵׁם וְגַם מָצָאתָ חֵן בְּעֵינָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה רְאֵה אַתָּה אֹמֵר אֵלַי הַעַל אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה לֹא הוֹדַעְתַּנִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁלַח עִמִּי וְאַתָּה אָמַרְתָּ יְדַעְתִּיךָ בְשֵׁם וְגַם מָצָאתָ חֵן בְּעֵינָי׃

english.text:
And Moses said to YHWH, “See, you say to me, ‘Bring this
people up,’ and you haven’t made known to me whom you will
send with me. And you’ve said, ‘I’ve known you by name,’
and also ‘You’ve found favor in my eyes.’

translation.text: And Moses said unto the LORD, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.

verses.english:
And Moses said to YHWH, “See, you say to me, ‘Bring this
people up,’ and you haven’t made known to me whom you will
send with me. And you’ve said, ‘I’ve known you by name,’
and also ‘You’ve found favor in my eyes.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ הוֹדִעֵנִי נָא אֶת דְּרָכֶךָ וְאֵדָעֲךָ לְמַעַן אֶמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה כִּי עַמְּךָ הַגּוֹי הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ הוֹדִעֵנִי נָא אֶת דְּרָכֶךָ וְאֵדָעֲךָ לְמַעַן אֶמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה כִּי עַמְּךָ הַגּוֹי הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And now, if I’ve found favor in your eyes, make your way
known to me, so I may know you, so that I’ll find favor in
your eyes. And see that this nation is your people.”

translation.text: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.

verses.english:
And now, if I’ve found favor in your eyes, make your way
known to me, so I may know you, so that I’ll find favor in
your eyes. And see that this nation is your people.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר פָּנַי יֵלֵכוּ וַהֲנִחֹתִי לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר פָּנַי יֵלֵכוּ וַהֲנִחֹתִי לָךְ׃

english.text: And He said, “My face will go, and I’ll let you rest.”

translation.text: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.

verses.english: And He said, “My face will go, and I’ll let you rest.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אִם אֵין פָּנֶיךָ הֹלְכִים אַל תַּעֲלֵנוּ מִזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אִם אֵין פָּנֶיךָ הֹלְכִים אַל תַּעֲלֵנוּ מִזֶּה׃

english.text:
And he said to Him, “If your face isn’t going, don’t take
us up from here.

translation.text: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.

verses.english:
And he said to Him, “If your face isn’t going, don’t take
us up from here.

verses.hebrew: וּבַמֶּה יִוָּדַע אֵפוֹא כִּי מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲנִי וְעַמֶּךָ הֲלוֹא בְּלֶכְתְּךָ עִמָּנוּ וְנִפְלִינוּ אֲנִי וְעַמְּךָ מִכּל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבַמֶּה יִוָּדַע אֵפוֹא כִּי מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲנִי וְעַמֶּךָ הֲלוֹא בְּלֶכְתְּךָ עִמָּנוּ וְנִפְלִינוּ אֲנִי וְעַמְּךָ מִכּל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
And by what then will it be known that I’ve found favor in
your eyes, I and your people? Is it not by your going with
us? And we’ll be distinguished, I and your people, from
every people that is on the face of the earth.”

translation.text: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.

verses.english:
And by what then will it be known that I’ve found favor in
your eyes, I and your people? Is it not by your going with
us? And we’ll be distinguished, I and your people, from
every people that is on the face of the earth.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה גַּם אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ אֶעֱשֶׂה כִּי מָצָאתָ חֵן בְּעֵינַי וָאֵדָעֲךָ בְּשֵׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה גַּם אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ אֶעֱשֶׂה כִּי מָצָאתָ חֵן בְּעֵינַי וָאֵדָעֲךָ בְּשֵׁם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “I’ll do this thing that you’ve
spoken as well, because you’ve found favor in my eyes, and
I’ve known you by name.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “I’ll do this thing that you’ve
spoken as well, because you’ve found favor in my eyes, and
I’ve known you by name.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר הַרְאֵנִי נָא אֶת כְּבֹדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר הַרְאֵנִי נָא אֶת כְּבֹדֶךָ׃

english.text: And he said, “Show me your glory!”

translation.text: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.

verses.english: And he said, “Show me your glory!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי אַעֲבִיר כּל טוּבִי עַל פָּנֶיךָ וְקָרָאתִי בְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה לְפָנֶיךָ וְחַנֹּתִי אֶת אֲשֶׁר אָחֹן וְרִחַמְתִּי אֶת אֲשֶׁר אֲרַחֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי אַעֲבִיר כּל טוּבִי עַל פָּנֶיךָ וְקָרָאתִי בְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה לְפָנֶיךָ וְחַנֹּתִי אֶת אֲשֶׁר אָחֹן וְרִחַמְתִּי אֶת אֲשֶׁר אֲרַחֵם׃

english.text:
And He said, “I shall have all my good pass in front of
you, and I shall invoke the name YHWH in front of you. And
I shall show grace to whomever I shall show grace, and I
shall show mercy to whomever I shall show mercy.”

translation.text: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.

verses.english:
And He said, “I shall have all my good pass in front of
you, and I shall invoke the name YHWH in front of you. And
I shall show grace to whomever I shall show grace, and I
shall show mercy to whomever I shall show mercy.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תוּכַל לִרְאֹת אֶת פָּנָי כִּי לֹא יִרְאַנִי הָאָדָם וָחָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תוּכַל לִרְאֹת אֶת פָּנָי כִּי לֹא יִרְאַנִי הָאָדָם וָחָי׃

english.text:
And He said, “You won’t be able to see my face, because a
human will not see me and live.”

translation.text: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.

verses.english:
And He said, “You won’t be able to see my face, because a
human will not see me and live.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה הִנֵּה מָקוֹם אִתִּי וְנִצַּבְתָּ עַל הַצּוּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה הִנֵּה מָקוֹם אִתִּי וְנִצַּבְתָּ עַל הַצּוּר׃

english.text:
And YHWH said, “Here is a place with me, and you’ll stand
up on a rock;

translation.text: And the LORD said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:

verses.english:
And YHWH said, “Here is a place with me, and you’ll stand
up on a rock;

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַּעֲבֹר כְּבֹדִי וְשַׂמְתִּיךָ בְּנִקְרַת הַצּוּר וְשַׂכֹּתִי כַפִּי עָלֶיךָ עַד עבְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בַּעֲבֹר כְּבֹדִי וְשַׂמְתִּיךָ בְּנִקְרַת הַצּוּר וְשַׂכֹּתִי כַפִּי עָלֶיךָ עַד עבְרִי׃

english.text:
and it will be, when my glory passes, that I’ll set you in
a cleft of the rock, and I’ll cover my hand over you until
I’ve passed,

translation.text: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:

verses.english:
and it will be, when my glory passes, that I’ll set you in
a cleft of the rock, and I’ll cover my hand over you until
I’ve passed,

verses.hebrew: וַהֲסִרֹתִי אֶת כַּפִּי וְרָאִיתָ אֶת אֲחֹרָי וּפָנַי לֹא יֵרָאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַהֲסִרֹתִי אֶת כַּפִּי וְרָאִיתָ אֶת אֲחֹרָי וּפָנַי לֹא יֵרָאוּ׃

english.text:
and I’ll turn my hand away, and you’ll see my back, but my
face won’t be seen.”

translation.text: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.

verses.english:
and I’ll turn my hand away, and you’ll see my back, but my
face won’t be seen.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה פְּסל לְךָ שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים כָּרִאשֹׁנִים וְכָתַבְתִּי עַל הַלֻּחֹת אֶת הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ עַל הַלֻּחֹת הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר שִׁבַּרְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה פְּסל לְךָ שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים כָּרִאשֹׁנִים וְכָתַבְתִּי עַל הַלֻּחֹת אֶת הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ עַל הַלֻּחֹת הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר שִׁבַּרְתָּ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Carve two tablets of stones
like the first ones, and I’ll write on the tablets the
words that were on the first tablets, which you shattered.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Carve two tablets of stones
like the first ones, and I’ll write on the tablets the
words that were on the first tablets, which you shattered.

verses.hebrew: וֶהְיֵה נָכוֹן לַבֹּקֶר וְעָלִיתָ בַבֹּקֶר אֶל הַר סִינַי וְנִצַּבְתָּ לִי שָׁם עַל רֹאשׁ הָהָר׃

hebrew.text: וֶהְיֵה נָכוֹן לַבֹּקֶר וְעָלִיתָ בַבֹּקֶר אֶל הַר סִינַי וְנִצַּבְתָּ לִי שָׁם עַל רֹאשׁ הָהָר׃

english.text:
And be ready for the morning, and you shall go up in the
morning to Mount Sinai and present yourself to me there on
the top of the mountain.

translation.text: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.

verses.english:
And be ready for the morning, and you shall go up in the
morning to Mount Sinai and present yourself to me there on
the top of the mountain.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ לֹא יַעֲלֶה עִמָּךְ וְגַם אִישׁ אַל יֵרָא בְּכל הָהָר גַּם הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר אַל יִרְעוּ אֶל מוּל הָהָר הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ לֹא יַעֲלֶה עִמָּךְ וְגַם אִישׁ אַל יֵרָא בְּכל הָהָר גַּם הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר אַל יִרְעוּ אֶל מוּל הָהָר הַהוּא׃

english.text:
And no man shall go up with you, and also let no man be
seen in all of the mountain. Also let the flock and the
oxen not feed opposite that mountain.”

translation.text: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.

verses.english:
And no man shall go up with you, and also let no man be
seen in all of the mountain. Also let the flock and the
oxen not feed opposite that mountain.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְסֹל שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים כָּרִאשֹׁנִים וַיַּשְׁכֵּם מֹשֶׁה בַבֹּקֶר וַיַּעַל אֶל הַר סִינַי כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ וַיִּקַּח בְּיָדוֹ שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְסֹל שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים כָּרִאשֹׁנִים וַיַּשְׁכֵּם מֹשֶׁה בַבֹּקֶר וַיַּעַל אֶל הַר סִינַי כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ וַיִּקַּח בְּיָדוֹ שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים׃

english.text:
And he carved two tablets of stones like the first ones,
and Moses got up early in the morning and went up to Mount
Sinai as YHWH had commanded him, and he took in his hand
two tablets of stones.

translation.text: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.

verses.english:
And he carved two tablets of stones like the first ones,
and Moses got up early in the morning and went up to Mount
Sinai as YHWH had commanded him, and he took in his hand
two tablets of stones.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּעָנָן וַיִּתְיַצֵּב עִמּוֹ שָׁם וַיִּקְרָא בְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּעָנָן וַיִּתְיַצֵּב עִמּוֹ שָׁם וַיִּקְרָא בְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And YHWH came down in a cloud and stood with him there,
and he invoked the name YHWH.

translation.text: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.

verses.english:
And YHWH came down in a cloud and stood with him there,
and he invoked the name YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהֹוָה עַל פָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא יְהֹוָה יְהֹוָה אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהֹוָה עַל פָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא יְהֹוָה יְהֹוָה אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃

english.text:
And YHWH passed in front of him and called, YHWH, YHWH,
merciful and gracious God, slow to anger and abounding in
kindness and faithfulness,

translation.text: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

verses.english:
And YHWH passed in front of him and called, YHWH, YHWH,
merciful and gracious God, slow to anger and abounding in
kindness and faithfulness,

verses.hebrew: נֹצֵר חֶסֶד לָאֲלָפִים נֹשֵׂא עָוֺן וָפֶשַׁע וְחַטָּאָה וְנַקֵּה לֹא יְנַקֶּה פֹּקֵד עֲוֺן אָבוֹת עַל בָּנִים וְעַל בְּנֵי בָנִים עַל שִׁלֵּשִׁים וְעַל רִבֵּעִים׃

hebrew.text: נֹצֵר חֶסֶד לָאֲלָפִים נֹשֵׂא עָוֺן וָפֶשַׁע וְחַטָּאָה וְנַקֵּה לֹא יְנַקֶּה פֹּקֵד עֲוֺן אָבוֹת עַל בָּנִים וְעַל בְּנֵי בָנִים עַל שִׁלֵּשִׁים וְעַל רִבֵּעִים׃

english.text:
keeping kindness for thousands, bearing crime and offense and sin;
though not making one innocent: reckoning fathers’ crime on children
and on children’s children, on third generations and on fourth
generations.

translation.text: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.

verses.english:
keeping kindness for thousands, bearing crime and offense and sin;
though not making one innocent: reckoning fathers’ crime on children
and on children’s children, on third generations and on fourth
generations.

verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֵר מֹשֶׁה וַיִּקֹּד אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַהֵר מֹשֶׁה וַיִּקֹּד אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ׃

english.text: And Moses hurried and knelt to the ground and bowed,

translation.text: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.

verses.english: And Moses hurried and knelt to the ground and bowed,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי יֵלֶךְ נָא אֲדֹנָי בְּקִרְבֵּנוּ כִּי עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף הוּא וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֺנֵנוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵנוּ וּנְחַלְתָּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי יֵלֶךְ נָא אֲדֹנָי בְּקִרְבֵּנוּ כִּי עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף הוּא וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֺנֵנוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵנוּ וּנְחַלְתָּנוּ׃

english.text:
and he said, “If I’ve found favor in your eyes, my Lord,
may my Lord go among us, because it is a stiff-necked
people, and forgive our crime and our sin, and make us
your legacy.”

translation.text: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O LORD, let my LORD, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.

verses.english:
and he said, “If I’ve found favor in your eyes, my Lord,
may my Lord go among us, because it is a stiff-necked
people, and forgive our crime and our sin, and make us
your legacy.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי כֹּרֵת בְּרִית נֶגֶד כּל עַמְּךָ אֶעֱשֶׂה נִפְלָאֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא נִבְרְאוּ בְכל הָאָרֶץ וּבְכל הַגּוֹיִם וְרָאָה כל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בְקִרְבּוֹ אֶת מַעֲשֵׂה יְהֹוָה כִּי נוֹרָא הוּא אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי עֹשֶׂה עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי כֹּרֵת בְּרִית נֶגֶד כּל עַמְּךָ אֶעֱשֶׂה נִפְלָאֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא נִבְרְאוּ בְכל הָאָרֶץ וּבְכל הַגּוֹיִם וְרָאָה כל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בְקִרְבּוֹ אֶת מַעֲשֵׂה יְהֹוָה כִּי נוֹרָא הוּא אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי עֹשֶׂה עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
And He said, “Here, I’m making a covenant. Before all your
people I’ll do wonders that haven’t been created in all
the earth and among all the nations; and all the people
whom you’re among will see YHWH’s deeds, because that
which I’m doing with you is awesome.

translation.text: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the LORD: for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.

verses.english:
And He said, “Here, I’m making a covenant. Before all your
people I’ll do wonders that haven’t been created in all
the earth and among all the nations; and all the people
whom you’re among will see YHWH’s deeds, because that
which I’m doing with you is awesome.

verses.hebrew: שְׁמר לְךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם הִנְנִי גֹרֵשׁ מִפָּנֶיךָ אֶת הָאֱמֹרִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃

hebrew.text: שְׁמר לְךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם הִנְנִי גֹרֵשׁ מִפָּנֶיךָ אֶת הָאֱמֹרִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃

english.text:
Watch yourself regarding what I command you today. Here,
I’m driving out from before you the Amorite and the
Canaanite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Hivite
and the Jebusite.

translation.text: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

verses.english:
Watch yourself regarding what I command you today. Here,
I’m driving out from before you the Amorite and the
Canaanite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Hivite
and the Jebusite.

verses.hebrew: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תִּכְרֹת בְּרִית לְיוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָּא עָלֶיהָ פֶּן יִהְיֶה לְמוֹקֵשׁ בְּקִרְבֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תִּכְרֹת בְּרִית לְיוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָּא עָלֶיהָ פֶּן יִהְיֶה לְמוֹקֵשׁ בְּקִרְבֶּךָ׃

english.text:
Be watchful of yourself that you don’t make a covenant
with the resident of the land onto which you’re coming,
that he doesn’t become a trap among you.

translation.text: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:

verses.english:
Be watchful of yourself that you don’t make a covenant
with the resident of the land onto which you’re coming,
that he doesn’t become a trap among you.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶת מִזְבְּחֹתָם תִּתֹּצוּן וְאֶת מַצֵּבֹתָם תְּשַׁבֵּרוּן וְאֶת אֲשֵׁרָיו תִּכְרֹתוּן׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֶת מִזְבְּחֹתָם תִּתֹּצוּן וְאֶת מַצֵּבֹתָם תְּשַׁבֵּרוּן וְאֶת אֲשֵׁרָיו תִּכְרֹתוּן׃

english.text:
But you shall demolish their altars and shatter their
pillars and cut down their Asherahs.

translation.text: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:

verses.english:
But you shall demolish their altars and shatter their
pillars and cut down their Asherahs.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לְאֵל אַחֵר כִּי יְהֹוָה קַנָּא שְׁמוֹ אֵל קַנָּא הוּא׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לְאֵל אַחֵר כִּי יְהֹוָה קַנָּא שְׁמוֹ אֵל קַנָּא הוּא׃

english.text:
For you shall not bow to another god—because YHWH: His
name is Jealous, He is a jealous God—

translation.text: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:

verses.english:
For you shall not bow to another god—because YHWH: His
name is Jealous, He is a jealous God—

verses.hebrew: פֶּן תִּכְרֹת בְּרִית לְיוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ וְזָנוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וְזָבְחוּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם וְקָרָא לְךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ מִזִּבְחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: פֶּן תִּכְרֹת בְּרִית לְיוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ וְזָנוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וְזָבְחוּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם וְקָרָא לְךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ מִזִּבְחוֹ׃

english.text:
that you not make a covenant with the resident of the
land, and they will prostitute themselves after their gods
and sacrifice to their gods, and he will call to you, and
you will eat from his sacrifice.

translation.text: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;

verses.english:
that you not make a covenant with the resident of the
land, and they will prostitute themselves after their gods
and sacrifice to their gods, and he will call to you, and
you will eat from his sacrifice.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ מִבְּנֹתָיו לְבָנֶיךָ וְזָנוּ בְנֹתָיו אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶן וְהִזְנוּ אֶת בָּנֶיךָ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ מִבְּנֹתָיו לְבָנֶיךָ וְזָנוּ בְנֹתָיו אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶן וְהִזְנוּ אֶת בָּנֶיךָ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
And you will take some of his daughters for your sons, and
his daughters will prostitute themselves after their gods
and cause your sons to prostitute themselves after their
gods.

translation.text: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.

verses.english:
And you will take some of his daughters for your sons, and
his daughters will prostitute themselves after their gods
and cause your sons to prostitute themselves after their
gods.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵי מַסֵּכָה לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: אֱלֹהֵי מַסֵּכָה לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה לָּךְ׃

english.text: You shall not make molten gods for yourself.

translation.text: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.

verses.english: You shall not make molten gods for yourself.

verses.hebrew: אֶת חַג הַמַּצּוֹת תִּשְׁמֹר שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תֹּאכַל מַצּוֹת אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִךָ לְמוֹעֵד חֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב כִּי בְּחֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב יָצָאתָ מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: אֶת חַג הַמַּצּוֹת תִּשְׁמֹר שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תֹּאכַל מַצּוֹת אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִךָ לְמוֹעֵד חֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב כִּי בְּחֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב יָצָאתָ מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
You shall observe the Festival of Unleavened Bread. Seven
days you shall eat unleavened bread, which I commanded
you, at the appointed time, the month of Abib; because in
the month of Abib you went out of Egypt.

translation.text: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.

verses.english:
You shall observe the Festival of Unleavened Bread. Seven
days you shall eat unleavened bread, which I commanded
you, at the appointed time, the month of Abib; because in
the month of Abib you went out of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: כּל פֶּטֶר רֶחֶם לִי וְכל מִקְנְךָ תִּזָּכָר פֶּטֶר שׁוֹר וָשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: כּל פֶּטֶר רֶחֶם לִי וְכל מִקְנְךָ תִּזָּכָר פֶּטֶר שׁוֹר וָשֶׂה׃

english.text:
Every first birth of a womb is mine, and all your animals
that have a male first birth, ox or sheep.

translation.text: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.

verses.english:
Every first birth of a womb is mine, and all your animals
that have a male first birth, ox or sheep.

verses.hebrew: וּפֶטֶר חֲמוֹר תִּפְדֶּה בְשֶׂה וְאִם לֹא תִפְדֶּה וַעֲרַפְתּוֹ כֹּל בְּכוֹר בָּנֶיךָ תִּפְדֶּה וְלֹא יֵרָאוּ פָנַי רֵיקָם׃

hebrew.text: וּפֶטֶר חֲמוֹר תִּפְדֶּה בְשֶׂה וְאִם לֹא תִפְדֶּה וַעֲרַפְתּוֹ כֹּל בְּכוֹר בָּנֶיךָ תִּפְדֶּה וְלֹא יֵרָאוּ פָנַי רֵיקָם׃

english.text:
And you shall redeem an ass’s first birth with a sheep,
and if you do not redeem it then you shall break its neck.
You shall redeem every firstborn of your sons. And none
shall appear before me empty-handed.

translation.text: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.

verses.english:
And you shall redeem an ass’s first birth with a sheep,
and if you do not redeem it then you shall break its neck.
You shall redeem every firstborn of your sons. And none
shall appear before me empty-handed.

verses.hebrew: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תַּעֲבֹד וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי תִּשְׁבֹּת בֶּחָרִישׁ וּבַקָּצִיר תִּשְׁבֹּת׃

hebrew.text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תַּעֲבֹד וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי תִּשְׁבֹּת בֶּחָרִישׁ וּבַקָּצִיר תִּשְׁבֹּת׃

english.text:
Six days you shall work, and in the seventh day you shall
cease. In plowing time and in harvest, you shall cease.

translation.text: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.

verses.english:
Six days you shall work, and in the seventh day you shall
cease. In plowing time and in harvest, you shall cease.

verses.hebrew: וְחַג שָׁבֻעֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה לְךָ בִּכּוּרֵי קְצִיר חִטִּים וְחַג הָאָסִיף תְּקוּפַת הַשָּׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְחַג שָׁבֻעֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה לְךָ בִּכּוּרֵי קְצִיר חִטִּים וְחַג הָאָסִיף תְּקוּפַת הַשָּׁנָה׃

english.text:
And you shall make a Festival of Weeks, of the firstfruits
of the wheat harvest, and the Festival of Gathering at the
end of the year.

translation.text: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year’s end.

verses.english:
And you shall make a Festival of Weeks, of the firstfruits
of the wheat harvest, and the Festival of Gathering at the
end of the year.

verses.hebrew: שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה יֵרָאֶה כּל זְכוּרְךָ אֶת פְּנֵי הָאָדֹן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה יֵרָאֶה כּל זְכוּרְךָ אֶת פְּנֵי הָאָדֹן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Three times in the year every one of your males shall
appear before the Lord YHWH, God of Israel.

translation.text: Thrice in the year shall all your menchildren appear before the LORD God, the God of Israel.

verses.english:
Three times in the year every one of your males shall
appear before the Lord YHWH, God of Israel.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אוֹרִישׁ גּוֹיִם מִפָּנֶיךָ וְהִרְחַבְתִּי אֶת גְּבֻלֶךָ וְלֹא יַחְמֹד אִישׁ אֶת אַרְצְךָ בַּעֲלֹתְךָ לֵרָאוֹת אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אוֹרִישׁ גּוֹיִם מִפָּנֶיךָ וְהִרְחַבְתִּי אֶת גְּבֻלֶךָ וְלֹא יַחְמֹד אִישׁ אֶת אַרְצְךָ בַּעֲלֹתְךָ לֵרָאוֹת אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה׃

english.text:
For I shall dispossess nations before you and widen your
border, and no man will covet your land while you are
going up to appear before YHWH, your God, three times in
the year.

translation.text: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the LORD thy God thrice in the year.

verses.english:
For I shall dispossess nations before you and widen your
border, and no man will covet your land while you are
going up to appear before YHWH, your God, three times in
the year.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִשְׁחַט עַל חָמֵץ דַּם זִבְחִי וְלֹא יָלִין לַבֹּקֶר זֶבַח חַג הַפָּסַח׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִשְׁחַט עַל חָמֵץ דַּם זִבְחִי וְלֹא יָלִין לַבֹּקֶר זֶבַח חַג הַפָּסַח׃

english.text:
You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice on leavened
bread. And the sacrifice of the Festival of Passover shall
not remain until the morning.

translation.text: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.

verses.english:
You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice on leavened
bread. And the sacrifice of the Festival of Passover shall
not remain until the morning.

verses.hebrew: רֵאשִׁית בִּכּוּרֵי אַדְמָתְךָ תָּבִיא בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תְבַשֵּׁל גְּדִי בַּחֲלֵב אִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: רֵאשִׁית בִּכּוּרֵי אַדְמָתְךָ תָּבִיא בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תְבַשֵּׁל גְּדִי בַּחֲלֵב אִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
You shall bring the first of the firstfruits of your land
to the house of YHWH, your God. You shall not cook a kid
in its mother’s milk.

translation.text: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

verses.english:
You shall bring the first of the firstfruits of your land
to the house of YHWH, your God. You shall not cook a kid
in its mother’s milk.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה כְּתב לְךָ אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה כִּי עַל פִּי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה כָּרַתִּי אִתְּךָ בְּרִית וְאֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה כְּתב לְךָ אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה כִּי עַל פִּי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה כָּרַתִּי אִתְּךָ בְּרִית וְאֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Write these words for yourself,
because I’ve made a covenant with you and with Israel
based on these words.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Write these words for yourself,
because I’ve made a covenant with you and with Israel
based on these words.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי שָׁם עִם יְהֹוָה אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לַיְלָה לֶחֶם לֹא אָכַל וּמַיִם לֹא שָׁתָה וַיִּכְתֹּב עַל הַלֻּחֹת אֵת דִּבְרֵי הַבְּרִית עֲשֶׂרֶת הַדְּבָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי שָׁם עִם יְהֹוָה אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לַיְלָה לֶחֶם לֹא אָכַל וּמַיִם לֹא שָׁתָה וַיִּכְתֹּב עַל הַלֻּחֹת אֵת דִּבְרֵי הַבְּרִית עֲשֶׂרֶת הַדְּבָרִים׃

english.text:
And he was there with YHWH forty days and forty nights. He
did not eat bread, and he did not drink water. And he
wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten
Commandments.

translation.text: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

verses.english:
And he was there with YHWH forty days and forty nights. He
did not eat bread, and he did not drink water. And he
wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten
Commandments.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּרֶדֶת מֹשֶׁה מֵהַר סִינַי וּשְׁנֵי לֻחֹת הָעֵדֻת בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה בְּרִדְתּוֹ מִן הָהָר וּמֹשֶׁה לֹא יָדַע כִּי קָרַן עוֹר פָּנָיו בְּדַבְּרוֹ אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּרֶדֶת מֹשֶׁה מֵהַר סִינַי וּשְׁנֵי לֻחֹת הָעֵדֻת בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה בְּרִדְתּוֹ מִן הָהָר וּמֹשֶׁה לֹא יָדַע כִּי קָרַן עוֹר פָּנָיו בְּדַבְּרוֹ אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And it was when Moses was coming down from Mount Sinai,
and the two tablets of the Testimony were in Moses’ hand
when he was coming down from the mountain. And Moses had
not known that the skin of his face was transformed when
He was speaking with him.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.

verses.english:
And it was when Moses was coming down from Mount Sinai,
and the two tablets of the Testimony were in Moses’ hand
when he was coming down from the mountain. And Moses had
not known that the skin of his face was transformed when
He was speaking with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אַהֲרֹן וְכל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת מֹשֶׁה וְהִנֵּה קָרַן עוֹר פָּנָיו וַיִּירְאוּ מִגֶּשֶׁת אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אַהֲרֹן וְכל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת מֹשֶׁה וְהִנֵּה קָרַן עוֹר פָּנָיו וַיִּירְאוּ מִגֶּשֶׁת אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
And Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses; and,
here, the skin of his face was transformed, and they were
afraid of going over to him.

translation.text: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.

verses.english:
And Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses; and,
here, the skin of his face was transformed, and they were
afraid of going over to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֲלֵהֶם מֹשֶׁה וַיָּשֻׁבוּ אֵלָיו אַהֲרֹן וְכל הַנְּשִׂאִים בָּעֵדָה וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֲלֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֲלֵהֶם מֹשֶׁה וַיָּשֻׁבוּ אֵלָיו אַהֲרֹן וְכל הַנְּשִׂאִים בָּעֵדָה וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֲלֵהֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses called to them. And Aaron and all the chiefs in
the congregation came back to him, and he spoke to them.

translation.text: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.

verses.english:
And Moses called to them. And Aaron and all the chiefs in
the congregation came back to him, and he spoke to them.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן נִגְּשׁוּ כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְצַוֵּם אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אִתּוֹ בְּהַר סִינָי׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן נִגְּשׁוּ כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְצַוֵּם אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אִתּוֹ בְּהַר סִינָי׃

english.text:
And after that all the children of Israel went over. And
he commanded them everything that YHWH had spoken with him
in Mount Sinai.

translation.text: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai.

verses.english:
And after that all the children of Israel went over. And
he commanded them everything that YHWH had spoken with him
in Mount Sinai.

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַל מֹשֶׁה מִדַּבֵּר אִתָּם וַיִּתֵּן עַל פָּנָיו מַסְוֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְכַל מֹשֶׁה מִדַּבֵּר אִתָּם וַיִּתֵּן עַל פָּנָיו מַסְוֶה׃

english.text:
And Moses finished speaking with them, and he put a veil
on his face.

translation.text: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.

verses.english:
And Moses finished speaking with them, and he put a veil
on his face.

verses.hebrew: וּבְבֹא מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ יָסִיר אֶת הַמַּסְוֶה עַד צֵאתוֹ וְיָצָא וְדִבֶּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת אֲשֶׁר יְצֻוֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וּבְבֹא מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ יָסִיר אֶת הַמַּסְוֶה עַד צֵאתוֹ וְיָצָא וְדִבֶּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת אֲשֶׁר יְצֻוֶּה׃

english.text:
And when Moses would come in front of YHWH to speak with
Him, he would turn away the veil until he would go out;
and he would go out and speak to the children of Israel
what he had been commanded.

translation.text: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

verses.english:
And when Moses would come in front of YHWH to speak with
Him, he would turn away the veil until he would go out;
and he would go out and speak to the children of Israel
what he had been commanded.

verses.hebrew: וְרָאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת פְּנֵי מֹשֶׁה כִּי קָרַן עוֹר פְּנֵי מֹשֶׁה וְהֵשִׁיב מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמַּסְוֶה עַל פָּנָיו עַד בֹּאוֹ לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת פְּנֵי מֹשֶׁה כִּי קָרַן עוֹר פְּנֵי מֹשֶׁה וְהֵשִׁיב מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמַּסְוֶה עַל פָּנָיו עַד בֹּאוֹ לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel would see Moses’ face, that the
skin of Moses’ face was transformed, and Moses would put
back the veil on his face until he would come to speak
with Him.

translation.text: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel would see Moses’ face, that the
skin of Moses’ face was transformed, and Moses would put
back the veil on his face until he would come to speak
with Him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְהֵל מֹשֶׁה אֶת כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אֵלֶּה הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לַעֲשֹׂת אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְהֵל מֹשֶׁה אֶת כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אֵלֶּה הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לַעֲשֹׂת אֹתָם׃

And Moses assembled all of the congregation of the
children of Israel and said to them, “These are the things
that YHWH commanded, to do them:

And Moses assembled all of the congregation of the
children of Israel and said to them, “These are the things
that YHWH commanded, to do them:

hebrew.text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תֵּעָשֶׂה מְלָאכָה וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי יִהְיֶה לָכֶם קֹדֶשׁ שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן לַיהֹוָה כּל הָעֹשֶׂה בוֹ מְלָאכָה יוּמָת׃

english.text:
Six days work shall be done, and in the seventh day you
shall have a holy thing, a Sabbath, a ceasing to YHWH.
Anyone who does work in shall be put to death.

translation.text: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.

verses.english:
Six days work shall be done, and in the seventh day you
shall have a holy thing, a Sabbath, a ceasing to YHWH.
Anyone who does work in shall be put to death.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תְבַעֲרוּ אֵשׁ בְּכֹל מֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תְבַעֲרוּ אֵשׁ בְּכֹל מֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת׃

You shall not burn a fire in all of your homes on the
Sabbath day.”

translation.text: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.

verses.english:
You shall not burn a fire in all of your homes on the
Sabbath day.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר׃

And Moses said to all of the congregation of the children

saying,

silver and bronze

‘Take a donation for YHWH from among you. Everyone whose

silver and bronze

the fabric clothes for ministering in the Holy, the holy

And everyone whose heart inspired him came, and everyone

And the men came together with the women. All whose hearts

and every man with whom was found blue and purple and
scarlet and linen and goats’ hair and rams’ skins dyed red

verses.english:
Everyone making a donation of silver and bronze had

acacia wood for all the work of the construction had
brought it.

verses.english:
And every woman who was wise of heart with her hands had

Judah by name,

and to form conceptions to make in gold and in silver and

and in cutting stone for setting and in cutting wood, for

conceptions.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה בְצַלְאֵל וְאהֳלִיאָב וְכֹל אִישׁ חֲכַם לֵב אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה חכְמָה וּתְבוּנָה בָּהֵמָּה לָדַעַת לַעֲשֹׂת אֶת כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשָׂה בְצַלְאֵל וְאהֳלִיאָב וְכֹל אִישׁ חֲכַם לֵב אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה חכְמָה וּתְבוּנָה בָּהֵמָּה לָדַעַת לַעֲשֹׂת אֶת כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Bezalel and Oholiab and every man who is wise of
heart, in whom YHWH has put wisdom and understanding to
know how to do all the work of the service of the Holy
shall do it, for everything that YHWH has commanded.”

translation.text: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.

verses.english:
And Bezalel and Oholiab and every man who is wise of
heart, in whom YHWH has put wisdom and understanding to
know how to do all the work of the service of the Holy
shall do it, for everything that YHWH has commanded.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּצַלְאֵל וְאֶל אהֳלִיאָב וְאֶל כּל אִישׁ חֲכַם לֵב אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה חכְמָה בְּלִבּוֹ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר נְשָׂאוֹ לִבּוֹ לְקרְבָה אֶל הַמְּלָאכָה לַעֲשֹׂת אֹתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּצַלְאֵל וְאֶל אהֳלִיאָב וְאֶל כּל אִישׁ חֲכַם לֵב אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה חכְמָה בְּלִבּוֹ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר נְשָׂאוֹ לִבּוֹ לְקרְבָה אֶל הַמְּלָאכָה לַעֲשֹׂת אֹתָהּ׃

english.text:
And Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab and every man who was
wise of heart, in whose heart YHWH had put wisdom,
everyone whose heart inspired him to come forward for the
work, to do it.

translation.text: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:

verses.english:
And Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab and every man who was
wise of heart, in whose heart YHWH had put wisdom,
everyone whose heart inspired him to come forward for the
work, to do it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ מִלִּפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה אֵת כּל הַתְּרוּמָה אֲשֶׁר הֵבִיאוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִמְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ לַעֲשֹׂת אֹתָהּ וְהֵם הֵבִיאוּ אֵלָיו עוֹד נְדָבָה בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ מִלִּפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה אֵת כּל הַתְּרוּמָה אֲשֶׁר הֵבִיאוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִמְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ לַעֲשֹׂת אֹתָהּ וְהֵם הֵבִיאוּ אֵלָיו עוֹד נְדָבָה בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר׃

english.text:
And they took from in front of Moses all of the donation
that the children of Israel had brought for the work of
the construction of the Holy, to do it. And they had
brought him more contribution, morning by morning.

translation.text: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.

verses.english:
And they took from in front of Moses all of the donation
that the children of Israel had brought for the work of
the construction of the Holy, to do it. And they had
brought him more contribution, morning by morning.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל הַחֲכָמִים הָעֹשִׂים אֵת כּל מְלֶאכֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ אִישׁ אִישׁ מִמְּלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֵמָּה עֹשִׂים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל הַחֲכָמִים הָעֹשִׂים אֵת כּל מְלֶאכֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ אִישׁ אִישׁ מִמְּלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֵמָּה עֹשִׂים׃

english.text:
And all the wise persons who were doing all the work of
the Holy came, each from his kind of work that they were
doing,

translation.text: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;

verses.english:
And all the wise persons who were doing all the work of
the Holy came, each from his kind of work that they were
doing,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר מַרְבִּים הָעָם לְהָבִיא מִדֵּי הָעֲבֹדָה לַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לַעֲשֹׂת אֹתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר מַרְבִּים הָעָם לְהָבִיא מִדֵּי הָעֲבֹדָה לַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לַעֲשֹׂת אֹתָהּ׃

english.text:
and they said to Moses, saying, “The people are bringing
more than enough for the construction, for the work that
YHWH has commanded, to do it!”

translation.text: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.

verses.english:
and they said to Moses, saying, “The people are bringing
more than enough for the construction, for the work that
YHWH has commanded, to do it!”

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה וַיַּעֲבִירוּ קוֹל בַּמַּחֲנֶה לֵאמֹר אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה אַל יַעֲשׂוּ עוֹד מְלָאכָה לִתְרוּמַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וַיִּכָּלֵא הָעָם מֵהָבִיא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה וַיַּעֲבִירוּ קוֹל בַּמַּחֲנֶה לֵאמֹר אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה אַל יַעֲשׂוּ עוֹד מְלָאכָה לִתְרוּמַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וַיִּכָּלֵא הָעָם מֵהָבִיא׃

english.text:
And Moses commanded, and they passed an announcement
through the camp saying, “Man and woman: let them not do
any more work for the donation for the Holy.” And the
people were held back from bringing.

translation.text: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.

verses.english:
And Moses commanded, and they passed an announcement
through the camp saying, “Man and woman: let them not do
any more work for the donation for the Holy.” And the
people were held back from bringing.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמְּלָאכָה הָיְתָה דַיָּם לְכל הַמְּלָאכָה לַעֲשׂוֹת אֹתָהּ וְהוֹתֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמְּלָאכָה הָיְתָה דַיָּם לְכל הַמְּלָאכָה לַעֲשׂוֹת אֹתָהּ וְהוֹתֵר׃

english.text:
And the work had been enough for them, for all the work,
to do it and more.

translation.text: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.

verses.english:
And the work had been enough for them, for all the work,
to do it and more.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כל חֲכַם לֵב בְּעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן עֶשֶׂר יְרִיעֹת שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר וּתְכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי כְּרֻבִים מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב עָשָׂה אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כל חֲכַם לֵב בְּעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן עֶשֶׂר יְרִיעֹת שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר וּתְכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי כְּרֻבִים מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב עָשָׂה אֹתָם׃

english.text:
And all those who were wise of heart among those who were
doing the work made the Tabernacle with ten curtains of
woven linen and blue and purple and scarlet, with cherubs.
They made them designer’s work.

translation.text: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.

verses.english:
And all those who were wise of heart among those who were
doing the work made the Tabernacle with ten curtains of
woven linen and blue and purple and scarlet, with cherubs.
They made them designer’s work.

verses.hebrew: אֹרֶךְ הַיְרִיעָה הָאַחַת שְׁמֹנֶה וְעֶשְׂרִים בָּאַמָּה וְרֹחַב אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה הַיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת מִדָּה אַחַת לְכל הַיְרִיעֹת׃

hebrew.text: אֹרֶךְ הַיְרִיעָה הָאַחַת שְׁמֹנֶה וְעֶשְׂרִים בָּאַמָּה וְרֹחַב אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה הַיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת מִדָּה אַחַת לְכל הַיְרִיעֹת׃

english.text:
The length of one curtain was twenty-eight in cubits, and
the width of one curtain four in cubits: one size to all
the curtains.

translation.text: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.

verses.english:
The length of one curtain was twenty-eight in cubits, and
the width of one curtain four in cubits: one size to all
the curtains.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַבֵּר אֶת חֲמֵשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת אַחַת אֶל אֶחָת וְחָמֵשׁ יְרִיעֹת חִבַּר אַחַת אֶל אֶחָת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחַבֵּר אֶת חֲמֵשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת אַחַת אֶל אֶחָת וְחָמֵשׁ יְרִיעֹת חִבַּר אַחַת אֶל אֶחָת׃

english.text:
And he connected five of the curtains, one to one; and he
connected five curtains, one to one.

translation.text: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.

verses.english:
And he connected five of the curtains, one to one; and he
connected five curtains, one to one.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לֻלְאֹת תְּכֵלֶת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת מִקָּצָה בַּמַּחְבָּרֶת כֵּן עָשָׂה בִּשְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַקִּיצוֹנָה בַּמַּחְבֶּרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ לֻלְאֹת תְּכֵלֶת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת מִקָּצָה בַּמַּחְבָּרֶת כֵּן עָשָׂה בִּשְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַקִּיצוֹנָה בַּמַּחְבֶּרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

english.text:
And he made loops of blue on the side of one curtain at
the end of the connected group. He did so in the side of
the end curtain in the second connected group.

translation.text: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

verses.english:
And he made loops of blue on the side of one curtain at
the end of the connected group. He did so in the side of
the end curtain in the second connected group.

verses.hebrew: חֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת עָשָׂה בַּיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת וַחֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת עָשָׂה בִּקְצֵה הַיְרִיעָה אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחְבֶּרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית מַקְבִּילֹת הַלֻּלָאֹת אַחַת אֶל אֶחָת׃

hebrew.text: חֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת עָשָׂה בַּיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת וַחֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת עָשָׂה בִּקְצֵה הַיְרִיעָה אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחְבֶּרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית מַקְבִּילֹת הַלֻּלָאֹת אַחַת אֶל אֶחָת׃

english.text:
He made fifty loops in the one curtain and made fifty
loops in the end of the curtain that was in the second
connected group with the loops parallel: one to one.

translation.text: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.

verses.english:
He made fifty loops in the one curtain and made fifty
loops in the end of the curtain that was in the second
connected group with the loops parallel: one to one.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ חֲמִשִּׁים קַרְסֵי זָהָב וַיְחַבֵּר אֶת הַיְרִיעֹת אַחַת אֶל אַחַת בַּקְּרָסִים וַיְהִי הַמִּשְׁכָּן אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ חֲמִשִּׁים קַרְסֵי זָהָב וַיְחַבֵּר אֶת הַיְרִיעֹת אַחַת אֶל אַחַת בַּקְּרָסִים וַיְהִי הַמִּשְׁכָּן אֶחָד׃

english.text:
And he made fifty clasps of gold and connected the
curtains, one to one, with the clasps. And the Tabernacle
was one.

translation.text: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.

verses.english:
And he made fifty clasps of gold and connected the
curtains, one to one, with the clasps. And the Tabernacle
was one.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ יְרִיעֹת עִזִּים לְאֹהֶל עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן עַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה יְרִיעֹת עָשָׂה אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ יְרִיעֹת עִזִּים לְאֹהֶל עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן עַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה יְרִיעֹת עָשָׂה אֹתָם׃

english.text:
And he made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the
Tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.

translation.text: And he made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.

verses.english:
