And he made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the
Tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.

verses.hebrew: אֹרֶךְ הַיְרִיעָה הָאַחַת שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּאַמָּה וְאַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת רֹחַב הַיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת מִדָּה אַחַת לְעַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה יְרִיעֹת׃

hebrew.text: אֹרֶךְ הַיְרִיעָה הָאַחַת שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּאַמָּה וְאַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת רֹחַב הַיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת מִדָּה אַחַת לְעַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה יְרִיעֹת׃

english.text:
The length of one curtain was thirty in cubits, and the
width of one curtain was four cubits: one size for eleven
curtains.

translation.text: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.

verses.english:
The length of one curtain was thirty in cubits, and the
width of one curtain was four cubits: one size for eleven
curtains.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַבֵּר אֶת חֲמֵשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת לְבָד וְאֶת שֵׁשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת לְבָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחַבֵּר אֶת חֲמֵשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת לְבָד וְאֶת שֵׁשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת לְבָד׃

english.text:
And he connected five of the curtains by themselves and
six of the curtains by themselves.

translation.text: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

verses.english:
And he connected five of the curtains by themselves and
six of the curtains by themselves.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לֻלָאֹת חֲמִשִּׁים עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַקִּיצֹנָה בַּמַּחְבָּרֶת וַחֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת עָשָׂה עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַחֹבֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ לֻלָאֹת חֲמִשִּׁים עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַקִּיצֹנָה בַּמַּחְבָּרֶת וַחֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת עָשָׂה עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַחֹבֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

english.text:
And he made fifty loops on the side of the end curtain in
the connected group and made fifty loops on the side of
the curtain of the second connected group.

translation.text: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

verses.english:
And he made fifty loops on the side of the end curtain in
the connected group and made fifty loops on the side of
the curtain of the second connected group.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ קַרְסֵי נְחֹשֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁים לְחַבֵּר אֶת הָאֹהֶל לִהְיֹת אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ קַרְסֵי נְחֹשֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁים לְחַבֵּר אֶת הָאֹהֶל לִהְיֹת אֶחָד׃

english.text:
And he made fifty bronze clasps to connect the tent, to be
one.

translation.text: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.

verses.english:
And he made fifty bronze clasps to connect the tent, to be
one.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מִכְסֶה לָאֹהֶל עֹרֹת אֵילִם מְאדָּמִים וּמִכְסֵה עֹרֹת תְּחָשִׁים מִלְמָעְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ מִכְסֶה לָאֹהֶל עֹרֹת אֵילִם מְאדָּמִים וּמִכְסֵה עֹרֹת תְּחָשִׁים מִלְמָעְלָה׃

english.text:
And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed
red and a covering of leather skins above.

translation.text: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers’ skins above that.

verses.english:
And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed
red and a covering of leather skins above.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים לַמִּשְׁכָּן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים עֹמְדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים לַמִּשְׁכָּן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים עֹמְדִים׃

english.text:
And he made the frames for the Tabernacle of acacia wood,
standing.

translation.text: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.

verses.english:
And he made the frames for the Tabernacle of acacia wood,
standing.

verses.hebrew: עֶשֶׂר אַמֹּת אֹרֶךְ הַקָּרֶשׁ וְאַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָאַמָּה רֹחַב הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: עֶשֶׂר אַמֹּת אֹרֶךְ הַקָּרֶשׁ וְאַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָאַמָּה רֹחַב הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד׃

english.text:
The frame’s length was ten cubits, and the width of one
frame was a cubit and a half cubit.

translation.text: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.

verses.english:
The frame’s length was ten cubits, and the width of one
frame was a cubit and a half cubit.

verses.hebrew: שְׁתֵּי יָדֹת לַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד מְשֻׁלָּבֹת אַחַת אֶל אֶחָת כֵּן עָשָׂה לְכֹל קַרְשֵׁי הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: שְׁתֵּי יָדֹת לַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד מְשֻׁלָּבֹת אַחַת אֶל אֶחָת כֵּן עָשָׂה לְכֹל קַרְשֵׁי הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
One frame had two projections, aligned one to one: so he
made for all of the Tabernacle’s frames.

translation.text: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

verses.english:
One frame had two projections, aligned one to one: so he
made for all of the Tabernacle’s frames.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים לַמִּשְׁכָּן עֶשְׂרִים קְרָשִׁים לִפְאַת נֶגֶב תֵּימָנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים לַמִּשְׁכָּן עֶשְׂרִים קְרָשִׁים לִפְאַת נֶגֶב תֵּימָנָה׃

english.text:
And he made the frames for the Tabernacle: twenty frames
for the south side—to the south.

translation.text: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:

verses.english:
And he made the frames for the Tabernacle: twenty frames
for the south side—to the south.

verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעִים אַדְנֵי כֶסֶף עָשָׂה תַּחַת עֶשְׂרִים הַקְּרָשִׁים שְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד לִשְׁתֵּי יְדֹתָיו וּשְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד לִשְׁתֵּי יְדֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאַרְבָּעִים אַדְנֵי כֶסֶף עָשָׂה תַּחַת עֶשְׂרִים הַקְּרָשִׁים שְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד לִשְׁתֵּי יְדֹתָיו וּשְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד לִשְׁתֵּי יְדֹתָיו׃

english.text:
And he made forty bases of silver under the twenty frames:
two bases under one frame for its two projections and two
bases under each other frame for its two projections.

translation.text: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

verses.english:
And he made forty bases of silver under the twenty frames:
two bases under one frame for its two projections and two
bases under each other frame for its two projections.

verses.hebrew: וּלְצֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הַשֵּׁנִית לִפְאַת צָפוֹן עָשָׂה עֶשְׂרִים קְרָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וּלְצֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הַשֵּׁנִית לִפְאַת צָפוֹן עָשָׂה עֶשְׂרִים קְרָשִׁים׃

english.text:
And for the Tabernacle’s second side, for the north side,
he made twenty frames

translation.text: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,

verses.english:
And for the Tabernacle’s second side, for the north side,
he made twenty frames

verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעִים אַדְנֵיהֶם כָּסֶף שְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד וּשְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וְאַרְבָּעִים אַדְנֵיהֶם כָּסֶף שְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד וּשְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד׃

english.text:
and their forty bases of silver, two bases under one frame
and two bases under each other frame.

translation.text: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

verses.english:
and their forty bases of silver, two bases under one frame
and two bases under each other frame.

verses.hebrew: וּלְיַרְכְּתֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן יָמָּה עָשָׂה שִׁשָּׁה קְרָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וּלְיַרְכְּתֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן יָמָּה עָשָׂה שִׁשָּׁה קְרָשִׁים׃

english.text:
And for the rear of the Tabernacle, to the west, he made
six frames.

translation.text: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

verses.english:
And for the rear of the Tabernacle, to the west, he made
six frames.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁנֵי קְרָשִׁים עָשָׂה לִמְקֻצְעֹת הַמִּשְׁכָּן בַּיַּרְכָתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁנֵי קְרָשִׁים עָשָׂה לִמְקֻצְעֹת הַמִּשְׁכָּן בַּיַּרְכָתָיִם׃

english.text:
And he made two frames for the Tabernacle’s corners in the
rear,

translation.text: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

verses.english:
And he made two frames for the Tabernacle’s corners in the
rear,

verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ תוֹאֲמִם מִלְּמַטָּה וְיַחְדָּו יִהְיוּ תַמִּים אֶל רֹאשׁוֹ אֶל הַטַּבַּעַת הָאֶחָת כֵּן עָשָׂה לִשְׁנֵיהֶם לִשְׁנֵי הַמִּקְצֹעֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ תוֹאֲמִם מִלְּמַטָּה וְיַחְדָּו יִהְיוּ תַמִּים אֶל רֹאשׁוֹ אֶל הַטַּבַּעַת הָאֶחָת כֵּן עָשָׂה לִשְׁנֵיהֶם לִשְׁנֵי הַמִּקְצֹעֹת׃

english.text:
and they were doubles from below, and together they were
integrated on its top to one ring. He made it so for the
two of them, for the two corners.

translation.text: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.

verses.english:
and they were doubles from below, and together they were
integrated on its top to one ring. He made it so for the
two of them, for the two corners.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ שְׁמֹנָה קְרָשִׁים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם כֶּסֶף שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר אֲדָנִים שְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים שְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ שְׁמֹנָה קְרָשִׁים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם כֶּסֶף שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר אֲדָנִים שְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים שְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד׃

english.text:
And they were eight frames and their bases of silver,
sixteen bases, two bases and two bases under each one
frame.

translation.text: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.

verses.english:
And they were eight frames and their bases of silver,
sixteen bases, two bases and two bases under each one
frame.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ בְּרִיחֵי עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים חֲמִשָּׁה לְקַרְשֵׁי צֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הָאֶחָת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ בְּרִיחֵי עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים חֲמִשָּׁה לְקַרְשֵׁי צֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הָאֶחָת׃

english.text:
And he made bars of acacia wood: five for the frames of
one side of the Tabernacle

translation.text: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

verses.english:
And he made bars of acacia wood: five for the frames of
one side of the Tabernacle

verses.hebrew: וַחֲמִשָּׁה בְרִיחִם לְקַרְשֵׁי צֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הַשֵּׁנִית וַחֲמִשָּׁה בְרִיחִם לְקַרְשֵׁי הַמִּשְׁכָּן לַיַּרְכָתַיִם יָמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַחֲמִשָּׁה בְרִיחִם לְקַרְשֵׁי צֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הַשֵּׁנִית וַחֲמִשָּׁה בְרִיחִם לְקַרְשֵׁי הַמִּשְׁכָּן לַיַּרְכָתַיִם יָמָּה׃

english.text:
and five bars for the frames of the second side of the
Tabernacle and five bars for the frames of the side of the
Tabernacle at the rear, to the west.

translation.text: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.

verses.english:
and five bars for the frames of the second side of the
Tabernacle and five bars for the frames of the side of the
Tabernacle at the rear, to the west.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַבְּרִיחַ הַתִּיכֹן לִבְרֹחַ בְּתוֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁים מִן הַקָּצֶה אֶל הַקָּצֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַבְּרִיחַ הַתִּיכֹן לִבְרֹחַ בְּתוֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁים מִן הַקָּצֶה אֶל הַקָּצֶה׃

english.text:
And he made the middle bar to extend through the frames
from end to end.

translation.text: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.

verses.english:
And he made the middle bar to extend through the frames
from end to end.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים צִפָּה זָהָב וְאֶת טַבְּעֹתָם עָשָׂה זָהָב בָּתִּים לַבְּרִיחִם וַיְצַף אֶת הַבְּרִיחִם זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים צִפָּה זָהָב וְאֶת טַבְּעֹתָם עָשָׂה זָהָב בָּתִּים לַבְּרִיחִם וַיְצַף אֶת הַבְּרִיחִם זָהָב׃

english.text:
And he plated the frames with gold, and he made their
rings gold, housings for the bars, and he plated the bars
with gold.

translation.text: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

verses.english:
And he plated the frames with gold, and he made their
rings gold, housings for the bars, and he plated the bars
with gold.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַפָּרֹכֶת תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב עָשָׂה אֹתָהּ כְּרֻבִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַפָּרֹכֶת תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב עָשָׂה אֹתָהּ כְּרֻבִים׃

english.text:
And he made the pavilion of blue and purple and scarlet
and woven linen; he made it designer’s work with cherubs.

translation.text: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.

verses.english:
And he made the pavilion of blue and purple and scarlet
and woven linen; he made it designer’s work with cherubs.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהּ אַרְבָּעָה עַמּוּדֵי שִׁטִּים וַיְצַפֵּם זָהָב וָוֵיהֶם זָהָב וַיִּצֹק לָהֶם אַרְבָּעָה אַדְנֵי כָסֶף׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהּ אַרְבָּעָה עַמּוּדֵי שִׁטִּים וַיְצַפֵּם זָהָב וָוֵיהֶם זָהָב וַיִּצֹק לָהֶם אַרְבָּעָה אַדְנֵי כָסֶף׃

english.text:
And he made four acacia columns for it and plated them
with gold, their hooks of gold, and he cast four bases of
silver for them.

translation.text: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.

verses.english:
And he made four acacia columns for it and plated them
with gold, their hooks of gold, and he cast four bases of
silver for them.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מָסָךְ לְפֶתַח הָאֹהֶל תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ מָסָךְ לְפֶתַח הָאֹהֶל תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם׃

english.text:
And he made a cover for the entrance of the tent: blue and
purple and scarlet and woven linen—embroiderer’s work—

translation.text: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;

verses.english:
And he made a cover for the entrance of the tent: blue and
purple and scarlet and woven linen—embroiderer’s work—

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת עַמּוּדָיו חֲמִשָּׁה וְאֶת וָוֵיהֶם וְצִפָּה רָאשֵׁיהֶם וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם זָהָב וְאַדְנֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת עַמּוּדָיו חֲמִשָּׁה וְאֶת וָוֵיהֶם וְצִפָּה רָאשֵׁיהֶם וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם זָהָב וְאַדְנֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
and its five columns and their hooks, and he plated their
tops and their bands with gold, and their five bases were
bronze.

translation.text: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.

verses.english:
and its five columns and their hooks, and he plated their
tops and their bands with gold, and their five bases were
bronze.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ בְּצַלְאֵל אֶת הָאָרֹן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים אַמָּתַיִם וָחֵצִי ארְכּוֹ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי רחְבּוֹ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי קֹמָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ בְּצַלְאֵל אֶת הָאָרֹן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים אַמָּתַיִם וָחֵצִי ארְכּוֹ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי רחְבּוֹ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי קֹמָתוֹ׃

english.text:
And Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood, its length two
and a half cubits and its width a cubit and a half and its
height a cubit and a half.

translation.text: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:

verses.english:
And Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood, its length two
and a half cubits and its width a cubit and a half and its
height a cubit and a half.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב טָהוֹר מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ זֵר זָהָב סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב טָהוֹר מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ זֵר זָהָב סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And he plated it with pure gold inside and outside. And he
made a border of gold all around for it.

translation.text: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.

verses.english:
And he plated it with pure gold inside and outside. And he
made a border of gold all around for it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצֹק לוֹ אַרְבַּע טַבְּעֹת זָהָב עַל אַרְבַּע פַּעֲמֹתָיו וּשְׁתֵּי טַבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעוֹ הָאֶחָת וּשְׁתֵּי טַבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעוֹ הַשֵּׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצֹק לוֹ אַרְבַּע טַבְּעֹת זָהָב עַל אַרְבַּע פַּעֲמֹתָיו וּשְׁתֵּי טַבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעוֹ הָאֶחָת וּשְׁתֵּי טַבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעוֹ הַשֵּׁנִית׃

english.text:
And he cast four rings of gold for it on its four bottoms:
and two rings on its one side and two rings on its second
side.

translation.text: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.

verses.english:
And he cast four rings of gold for it on its four bottoms:
and two rings on its one side and two rings on its second
side.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ בַּדֵּי עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וַיְצַף אֹתָם זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ בַּדֵּי עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וַיְצַף אֹתָם זָהָב׃

english.text: And he made poles of acacia wood and plated them with gold

translation.text: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

verses.english: And he made poles of acacia wood and plated them with gold

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֵא אֶת הַבַּדִּים בַּטַּבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעֹת הָאָרֹן לָשֵׂאת אֶת הָאָרֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֵא אֶת הַבַּדִּים בַּטַּבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעֹת הָאָרֹן לָשֵׂאת אֶת הָאָרֹן׃

english.text:
and brought the poles through the rings on the ark’s
sides, in order to carry the ark.

translation.text: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

verses.english:
and brought the poles through the rings on the ark’s
sides, in order to carry the ark.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ כַּפֹּרֶת זָהָב טָהוֹר אַמָּתַיִם וָחֵצִי ארְכָּהּ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי רחְבָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ כַּפֹּרֶת זָהָב טָהוֹר אַמָּתַיִם וָחֵצִי ארְכָּהּ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי רחְבָּהּ׃

english.text:
And he made an atonement dais of pure gold, its length two
and a half cubits and its width a cubit and a half.

translation.text: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

verses.english:
And he made an atonement dais of pure gold, its length two
and a half cubits and its width a cubit and a half.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁנֵי כְרֻבִים זָהָב מִקְשָׁה עָשָׂה אֹתָם מִשְּׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁנֵי כְרֻבִים זָהָב מִקְשָׁה עָשָׂה אֹתָם מִשְּׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

english.text:
And he made two cherubs of gold—he made them of hammered
work—at the two ends of the atonement dais,

translation.text: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;

verses.english:
And he made two cherubs of gold—he made them of hammered
work—at the two ends of the atonement dais,

verses.hebrew: כְּרוּב אֶחָד מִקָּצָה מִזֶּה וּכְרוּב אֶחָד מִקָּצָה מִזֶּה מִן הַכַּפֹּרֶת עָשָׂה אֶת הַכְּרֻבִים מִשְּׁנֵי (קצוותו) [קְצוֹתָיו]׃

hebrew.text: כְּרוּב אֶחָד מִקָּצָה מִזֶּה וּכְרוּב אֶחָד מִקָּצָה מִזֶּה מִן הַכַּפֹּרֶת עָשָׂה אֶת הַכְּרֻבִים מִשְּׁנֵי (קצוותו) [קְצוֹתָיו]׃

english.text:
one cherub at this end and one cherub at that end. He made
the cherubs from the atonement dais at its two sides.

translation.text: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

verses.english:
one cherub at this end and one cherub at that end. He made
the cherubs from the atonement dais at its two sides.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ הַכְּרֻבִים פֹּרְשֵׂי כְנָפַיִם לְמַעְלָה סֹכְכִים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם עַל הַכַּפֹּרֶת וּפְנֵיהֶם אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו אֶל הַכַּפֹּרֶת הָיוּ פְּנֵי הַכְּרֻבִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ הַכְּרֻבִים פֹּרְשֵׂי כְנָפַיִם לְמַעְלָה סֹכְכִים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם עַל הַכַּפֹּרֶת וּפְנֵיהֶם אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו אֶל הַכַּפֹּרֶת הָיוּ פְּנֵי הַכְּרֻבִים׃

english.text:
And the two cherubs were spreading wings above, covering
over the atonement dais with their wings, and their faces
each toward its brother: the cherubs’ faces were toward
the atonement dais.

translation.text: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.

verses.english:
And the two cherubs were spreading wings above, covering
over the atonement dais with their wings, and their faces
each toward its brother: the cherubs’ faces were toward
the atonement dais.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים אַמָּתַיִם ארְכּוֹ וְאַמָּה רחְבּוֹ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי קֹמָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים אַמָּתַיִם ארְכּוֹ וְאַמָּה רחְבּוֹ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי קֹמָתוֹ׃

english.text:
And he made the table of acacia wood, its length two
cubits and its width a cubit and its height a cubit and a
half.

translation.text: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:

verses.english:
And he made the table of acacia wood, its length two
cubits and its width a cubit and its height a cubit and a
half.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַף אֹתוֹ זָהָב טָהוֹר וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ זֵר זָהָב סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַף אֹתוֹ זָהָב טָהוֹר וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ זֵר זָהָב סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And he plated it with pure gold and made a border of gold
all around for it

translation.text: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.

verses.english:
And he plated it with pure gold and made a border of gold
all around for it

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ מִסְגֶּרֶת טֹפַח סָבִיב וַיַּעַשׂ זֵר זָהָב לְמִסְגַּרְתּוֹ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ מִסְגֶּרֶת טֹפַח סָבִיב וַיַּעַשׂ זֵר זָהָב לְמִסְגַּרְתּוֹ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
and made a rim of a handbreadth for it all around and made
a border of gold for its rim all around.

translation.text: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.

verses.english:
and made a rim of a handbreadth for it all around and made
a border of gold for its rim all around.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצֹק לוֹ אַרְבַּע טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַטַּבָּעֹת עַל אַרְבַּע הַפֵּאֹת אֲשֶׁר לְאַרְבַּע רַגְלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצֹק לוֹ אַרְבַּע טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַטַּבָּעֹת עַל אַרְבַּע הַפֵּאֹת אֲשֶׁר לְאַרְבַּע רַגְלָיו׃

english.text:
And he cast four rings of gold for it and put the rings on
the four corners that its four legs had.

translation.text: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.

verses.english:
And he cast four rings of gold for it and put the rings on
the four corners that its four legs had.

verses.hebrew: לְעֻמַּת הַמִּסְגֶּרֶת הָיוּ הַטַּבָּעֹת בָּתִּים לַבַּדִּים לָשֵׂאת אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן׃

hebrew.text: לְעֻמַּת הַמִּסְגֶּרֶת הָיוּ הַטַּבָּעֹת בָּתִּים לַבַּדִּים לָשֵׂאת אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן׃

english.text:
The rings were in juxtaposition to the rim, housings for
the poles in order to carry the table.

translation.text: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.

verses.english:
The rings were in juxtaposition to the rim, housings for
the poles in order to carry the table.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַבַּדִּים עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וַיְצַף אֹתָם זָהָב לָשֵׂאת אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַבַּדִּים עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וַיְצַף אֹתָם זָהָב לָשֵׂאת אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן׃

english.text:
And he made the poles of acacia wood and plated them with
gold in order to carry the table.

translation.text: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.

verses.english:
And he made the poles of acacia wood and plated them with
gold in order to carry the table.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַכֵּלִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָן אֶת קְעָרֹתָיו וְאֶת כַּפֹּתָיו וְאֵת מְנַקִּיֹּתָיו וְאֶת הַקְּשָׂוֺת אֲשֶׁר יֻסַּךְ בָּהֵן זָהָב טָהוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַכֵּלִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָן אֶת קְעָרֹתָיו וְאֶת כַּפֹּתָיו וְאֵת מְנַקִּיֹּתָיו וְאֶת הַקְּשָׂוֺת אֲשֶׁר יֻסַּךְ בָּהֵן זָהָב טָהוֹר׃

english.text:
And he made the items that were on the table—its dishes
and its pans and its bowls and its jars with which
libations would be poured—of pure gold.

translation.text: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.

verses.english:
And he made the items that were on the table—its dishes
and its pans and its bowls and its jars with which
libations would be poured—of pure gold.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה זָהָב טָהוֹר מִקְשָׁה עָשָׂה אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה יְרֵכָהּ וְקָנָהּ גְּבִיעֶיהָ כַּפְתֹּרֶיהָ וּפְרָחֶיהָ מִמֶּנָּה הָיוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה זָהָב טָהוֹר מִקְשָׁה עָשָׂה אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה יְרֵכָהּ וְקָנָהּ גְּבִיעֶיהָ כַּפְתֹּרֶיהָ וּפְרָחֶיהָ מִמֶּנָּה הָיוּ׃

english.text:
And he made the menorah of pure gold. He made the menorah
of hammered work—its shaft and its branch, its cups, its
ornaments, and its flowers were part of it—

translation.text: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:

verses.english:
And he made the menorah of pure gold. He made the menorah
of hammered work—its shaft and its branch, its cups, its
ornaments, and its flowers were part of it—

verses.hebrew: וְשִׁשָּׁה קָנִים יֹצְאִים מִצִּדֶּיהָ שְׁלֹשָׁה קְנֵי מְנֹרָה מִצִּדָּהּ הָאֶחָד וּשְׁלֹשָׁה קְנֵי מְנֹרָה מִצִּדָּהּ הַשֵּׁנִי׃

hebrew.text: וְשִׁשָּׁה קָנִים יֹצְאִים מִצִּדֶּיהָ שְׁלֹשָׁה קְנֵי מְנֹרָה מִצִּדָּהּ הָאֶחָד וּשְׁלֹשָׁה קְנֵי מְנֹרָה מִצִּדָּהּ הַשֵּׁנִי׃

english.text:
and six branches coming out from its sides, three of the
menorah’s branches from its one side and three of the
menorah’s branches from its second side,

translation.text: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:

verses.english:
and six branches coming out from its sides, three of the
menorah’s branches from its one side and three of the
menorah’s branches from its second side,

verses.hebrew: שְׁלֹשָׁה גְבִעִים מְשֻׁקָּדִים בַּקָּנֶה הָאֶחָד כַּפְתֹּר וָפֶרַח וּשְׁלֹשָׁה גְבִעִים מְשֻׁקָּדִים בְּקָנֶה אֶחָד כַּפְתֹּר וָפָרַח כֵּן לְשֵׁשֶׁת הַקָּנִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִן הַמְּנֹרָה׃

hebrew.text: שְׁלֹשָׁה גְבִעִים מְשֻׁקָּדִים בַּקָּנֶה הָאֶחָד כַּפְתֹּר וָפֶרַח וּשְׁלֹשָׁה גְבִעִים מְשֻׁקָּדִים בְּקָנֶה אֶחָד כַּפְתֹּר וָפָרַח כֵּן לְשֵׁשֶׁת הַקָּנִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִן הַמְּנֹרָה׃

english.text:
three almond-shaped cups in the one branch, with ornament
and flower, and three almond-shaped cups in the other
branch, with ornament and flower. So it was for the six
branches that came out from the menorah,

translation.text: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.

verses.english:
three almond-shaped cups in the one branch, with ornament
and flower, and three almond-shaped cups in the other
branch, with ornament and flower. So it was for the six
branches that came out from the menorah,

verses.hebrew: וּבַמְּנֹרָה אַרְבָּעָה גְבִעִים מְשֻׁקָּדִים כַּפְתֹּרֶיהָ וּפְרָחֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וּבַמְּנֹרָה אַרְבָּעָה גְבִעִים מְשֻׁקָּדִים כַּפְתֹּרֶיהָ וּפְרָחֶיהָ׃

english.text:
and four almond-shaped cups within the menorah, with its
ornaments and its flowers,

translation.text: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:

verses.english:
and four almond-shaped cups within the menorah, with its
ornaments and its flowers,

verses.hebrew: וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה לְשֵׁשֶׁת הַקָּנִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִמֶּנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה לְשֵׁשֶׁת הַקָּנִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִמֶּנָּה׃

english.text:
and an ornament under the two branches from it, and an
ornament under the two branches from it, and an ornament
under the two branches from it, for the six branches that
came out from it.

translation.text: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.

verses.english:
and an ornament under the two branches from it, and an
ornament under the two branches from it, and an ornament
under the two branches from it, for the six branches that
came out from it.

verses.hebrew: כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶם וּקְנֹתָם מִמֶּנָּה הָיוּ כֻּלָּהּ מִקְשָׁה אַחַת זָהָב טָהוֹר׃

hebrew.text: כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶם וּקְנֹתָם מִמֶּנָּה הָיוּ כֻּלָּהּ מִקְשָׁה אַחַת זָהָב טָהוֹר׃

english.text:
Their ornaments and their branches were part of it, all of
it one hammered work of pure gold.

translation.text: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.

verses.english:
Their ornaments and their branches were part of it, all of
it one hammered work of pure gold.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ שִׁבְעָה וּמַלְקָחֶיהָ וּמַחְתֹּתֶיהָ זָהָב טָהוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ שִׁבְעָה וּמַלְקָחֶיהָ וּמַחְתֹּתֶיהָ זָהָב טָהוֹר׃

english.text:
And he made its lamps, seven, and its tongs and its
fire-holders of pure gold.

translation.text: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.

verses.english:
And he made its lamps, seven, and its tongs and its
fire-holders of pure gold.

verses.hebrew: כִּכָּר זָהָב טָהוֹר עָשָׂה אֹתָהּ וְאֵת כּל כֵּלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּכָּר זָהָב טָהוֹר עָשָׂה אֹתָהּ וְאֵת כּל כֵּלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
He made it and all of its equipment out of a talent of
pure gold.

translation.text: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.

verses.english:
He made it and all of its equipment out of a talent of
pure gold.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת מִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹרֶת עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים אַמָּה ארְכּוֹ וְאַמָּה רחְבּוֹ רָבוּעַ וְאַמָּתַיִם קֹמָתוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ הָיוּ קַרְנֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת מִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹרֶת עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים אַמָּה ארְכּוֹ וְאַמָּה רחְבּוֹ רָבוּעַ וְאַמָּתַיִם קֹמָתוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ הָיוּ קַרְנֹתָיו׃

english.text:
And he made the incense altar of acacia wood: its length a
cubit and its width a cubit, square, and its height two
cubits; its horns were a part of it.

translation.text: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.

verses.english:
And he made the incense altar of acacia wood: its length a
cubit and its width a cubit, square, and its height two
cubits; its horns were a part of it.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַף אֹתוֹ זָהָב טָהוֹר אֶת גַּגּוֹ וְאֶת קִירֹתָיו סָבִיב וְאֶת קַרְנֹתָיו וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ זֵר זָהָב סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַף אֹתוֹ זָהָב טָהוֹר אֶת גַּגּוֹ וְאֶת קִירֹתָיו סָבִיב וְאֶת קַרְנֹתָיו וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ זֵר זָהָב סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And he plated it with pure gold, its roof and its walls
all around and its horns. And he made a border of gold for
it all around.

translation.text: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.

verses.english:
And he plated it with pure gold, its roof and its walls
all around and its horns. And he made a border of gold for
it all around.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי טַבְּעֹת זָהָב עָשָׂה לוֹ מִתַּחַת לְזֵרוֹ עַל שְׁתֵּי צַלְעֹתָיו עַל שְׁנֵי צִדָּיו לְבָתִּים לְבַדִּים לָשֵׂאת אֹתוֹ בָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁתֵּי טַבְּעֹת זָהָב עָשָׂה לוֹ מִתַּחַת לְזֵרוֹ עַל שְׁתֵּי צַלְעֹתָיו עַל שְׁנֵי צִדָּיו לְבָתִּים לְבַדִּים לָשֵׂאת אֹתוֹ בָּהֶם׃

english.text:
And he made two rings of gold for it below its rim on its
two sides, on its two sidewalls, for housings for poles
with which to carry it.

translation.text: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.

verses.english:
And he made two rings of gold for it below its rim on its
two sides, on its two sidewalls, for housings for poles
with which to carry it.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַבַּדִּים עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וַיְצַף אֹתָם זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַבַּדִּים עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וַיְצַף אֹתָם זָהָב׃

english.text:
And he made the poles of acacia wood and plated them with
gold.

translation.text: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

verses.english:
And he made the poles of acacia wood and plated them with
gold.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה קֹדֶשׁ וְאֶת קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים טָהוֹר מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה קֹדֶשׁ וְאֶת קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים טָהוֹר מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵחַ׃

english.text:
And he made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense
fragrances, the work of an ointment-maker.

translation.text: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.

verses.english:
And he made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense
fragrances, the work of an ointment-maker.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת ארְכּוֹ וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת רחְבּוֹ רָבוּעַ וְשָׁלֹשׁ אַמּוֹת קֹמָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת ארְכּוֹ וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת רחְבּוֹ רָבוּעַ וְשָׁלֹשׁ אַמּוֹת קֹמָתוֹ׃

english.text:
And he made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood,
its length five cubits and its width five cubits, square,
and its height three cubits.

translation.text: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.

verses.english:
And he made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood,
its length five cubits and its width five cubits, square,
and its height three cubits.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ קַרְנֹתָיו עַל אַרְבַּע פִּנֹּתָיו מִמֶּנּוּ הָיוּ קַרְנֹתָיו וַיְצַף אֹתוֹ נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ קַרְנֹתָיו עַל אַרְבַּע פִּנֹּתָיו מִמֶּנּוּ הָיוּ קַרְנֹתָיו וַיְצַף אֹתוֹ נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
And he made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were
part of it. And he plated it with bronze.

translation.text: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.

verses.english:
And he made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were
part of it. And he plated it with bronze.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת כּל כְּלֵי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֶת הַסִּירֹת וְאֶת הַיָּעִים וְאֶת הַמִּזְרָקֹת אֶת הַמִּזְלָגֹת וְאֶת הַמַּחְתֹּת כּל כֵּלָיו עָשָׂה נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת כּל כְּלֵי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֶת הַסִּירֹת וְאֶת הַיָּעִים וְאֶת הַמִּזְרָקֹת אֶת הַמִּזְלָגֹת וְאֶת הַמַּחְתֹּת כּל כֵּלָיו עָשָׂה נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
And he made all the altar’s equipment: the pots, the
shovels and the basins, the forks and the fire-holders. He
made all of its equipment bronze.

translation.text: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.

verses.english:
And he made all the altar’s equipment: the pots, the
shovels and the basins, the forks and the fire-holders. He
made all of its equipment bronze.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִכְבָּר מַעֲשֵׂה רֶשֶׁת נְחֹשֶׁת תַּחַת כַּרְכֻּבּוֹ מִלְּמַטָּה עַד חֶצְיוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ לַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִכְבָּר מַעֲשֵׂה רֶשֶׁת נְחֹשֶׁת תַּחַת כַּרְכֻּבּוֹ מִלְּמַטָּה עַד חֶצְיוֹ׃

english.text:
And he made a grate for the altar, a network of bronze,
under its ledge up to the middle of it.

translation.text: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.

verses.english:
And he made a grate for the altar, a network of bronze,
under its ledge up to the middle of it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצֹק אַרְבַּע טַבָּעֹת בְּאַרְבַּע הַקְּצָוֺת לְמִכְבַּר הַנְּחֹשֶׁת בָּתִּים לַבַּדִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצֹק אַרְבַּע טַבָּעֹת בְּאַרְבַּע הַקְּצָוֺת לְמִכְבַּר הַנְּחֹשֶׁת בָּתִּים לַבַּדִּים׃

english.text:
And he cast four rings in the bronze grate’s four ends:
housings for the poles.

translation.text: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.

verses.english:
And he cast four rings in the bronze grate’s four ends:
housings for the poles.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַבַּדִּים עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וַיְצַף אֹתָם נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַבַּדִּים עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וַיְצַף אֹתָם נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
And he made the poles of acacia wood and plated them with
bronze

translation.text: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.

verses.english:
And he made the poles of acacia wood and plated them with
bronze

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֵא אֶת הַבַּדִּים בַּטַּבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לָשֵׂאת אֹתוֹ בָּהֶם נְבוּב לֻחֹת עָשָׂה אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֵא אֶת הַבַּדִּים בַּטַּבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לָשֵׂאת אֹתוֹ בָּהֶם נְבוּב לֻחֹת עָשָׂה אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
and brought the poles through the rings on the altar’s
sides in order to carry it with them. He made it hollow of
boards.

translation.text: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.

verses.english:
and brought the poles through the rings on the altar’s
sides in order to carry it with them. He made it hollow of
boards.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֵת הַכִּיּוֹר נְחֹשֶׁת וְאֵת כַּנּוֹ נְחֹשֶׁת בְּמַרְאֹת הַצֹּבְאֹת אֲשֶׁר צָבְאוּ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֵת הַכִּיּוֹר נְחֹשֶׁת וְאֵת כַּנּוֹ נְחֹשֶׁת בְּמַרְאֹת הַצֹּבְאֹת אֲשֶׁר צָבְאוּ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And he made the basin of bronze and its stand of bronze
with the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance
of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.english:
And he made the basin of bronze and its stand of bronze
with the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance
of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הֶחָצֵר לִפְאַת נֶגֶב תֵּימָנָה קַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מֵאָה בָּאַמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הֶחָצֵר לִפְאַת נֶגֶב תֵּימָנָה קַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר מֵאָה בָּאַמָּה׃

english.text:
And he made the courtyard: for the south side—to the
south, the courtyard’s hangings of woven linen, a hundred
in cubits,

translation.text: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:

verses.english:
And he made the courtyard: for the south side—to the
south, the courtyard’s hangings of woven linen, a hundred
in cubits,

verses.hebrew: עַמּוּדֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָעַמּוּדִים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

hebrew.text: עַמּוּדֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָעַמּוּדִים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

english.text:
their columns twenty, and their bases twenty of bronze,
and the columns’ hooks and their rods of silver.

translation.text: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

verses.english:
their columns twenty, and their bases twenty of bronze,
and the columns’ hooks and their rods of silver.

verses.hebrew: וְלִפְאַת צָפוֹן מֵאָה בָאַמָּה עַמּוּדֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָעַמּוּדִים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

hebrew.text: וְלִפְאַת צָפוֹן מֵאָה בָאַמָּה עַמּוּדֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָעַמּוּדִים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

english.text:
And for the north side: a hundred in cubits, their columns
twenty, and their bases twenty of bronze, and the columns’
hooks and their bands of silver.

translation.text: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

verses.english:
And for the north side: a hundred in cubits, their columns
twenty, and their bases twenty of bronze, and the columns’
hooks and their bands of silver.

verses.hebrew: וְלִפְאַת יָם קְלָעִים חֲמִשִּׁים בָּאַמָּה עַמּוּדֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה וָוֵי הָעַמֻּדִים וַחֲשׁוּקֵיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

hebrew.text: וְלִפְאַת יָם קְלָעִים חֲמִשִּׁים בָּאַמָּה עַמּוּדֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה וָוֵי הָעַמֻּדִים וַחֲשׁוּקֵיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

english.text:
And for the west side: hangings of fifty in cubits, their
columns ten, and their bases ten, the columns’ hooks and
their bands of silver.

translation.text: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

verses.english:
And for the west side: hangings of fifty in cubits, their
columns ten, and their bases ten, the columns’ hooks and
their bands of silver.

verses.hebrew: וְלִפְאַת קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְלִפְאַת קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה׃

english.text:
And the courtyard’s width for the east side—to the
east—fifty cubits.

translation.text: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.

verses.english:
And the courtyard’s width for the east side—to the
east—fifty cubits.

verses.hebrew: קְלָעִים חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה אֶל הַכָּתֵף עַמּוּדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: קְלָעִים חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה אֶל הַכָּתֵף עַמּוּדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

english.text:
Fifteen cubits of hangings to the panel, their columns
three and their bases three;

translation.text: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

verses.english:
Fifteen cubits of hangings to the panel, their columns
three and their bases three;

verses.hebrew: וְלַכָּתֵף הַשֵּׁנִית מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה לְשַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר קְלָעִים חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה עַמֻּדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְלַכָּתֵף הַשֵּׁנִית מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה לְשַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר קְלָעִים חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה עַמֻּדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

english.text:
and the second panel—on this side and that side of the
courtyard’s gate—hangings of fifteen cubits, their columns
three and their bases three.

translation.text: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

verses.english:
and the second panel—on this side and that side of the
courtyard’s gate—hangings of fifteen cubits, their columns
three and their bases three.

verses.hebrew: כּל קַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר׃

hebrew.text: כּל קַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר׃

english.text:
All of the courtyard’s hangings, all around, were woven
linen.

translation.text: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.

verses.english:
All of the courtyard’s hangings, all around, were woven
linen.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֲדָנִים לָעַמֻּדִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָעַמּוּדִים וַחֲשׁוּקֵיהֶם כֶּסֶף וְצִפּוּי רָאשֵׁיהֶם כָּסֶף וְהֵם מְחֻשָּׁקִים כֶּסֶף כֹּל עַמֻּדֵי הֶחָצֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֲדָנִים לָעַמֻּדִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָעַמּוּדִים וַחֲשׁוּקֵיהֶם כֶּסֶף וְצִפּוּי רָאשֵׁיהֶם כָּסֶף וְהֵם מְחֻשָּׁקִים כֶּסֶף כֹּל עַמֻּדֵי הֶחָצֵר׃

english.text:
And the column’s bases were bronze, the columns’ hooks and
their bands were silver, and the plating of their tops was
silver, and they were banded with silver: all of the
courtyard’s columns.

translation.text: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.

verses.english:
And the column’s bases were bronze, the columns’ hooks and
their bands were silver, and the plating of their tops was
silver, and they were banded with silver: all of the
courtyard’s columns.

verses.hebrew: וּמָסַךְ שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה אֹרֶךְ וְקוֹמָה בְרֹחַב חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת לְעֻמַּת קַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר׃

hebrew.text: וּמָסַךְ שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה אֹרֶךְ וְקוֹמָה בְרֹחַב חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת לְעֻמַּת קַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר׃

english.text:
And the cover of the courtyard’s gate was embroiderer’s
work, blue and purple and scarlet and woven linen, and
twenty cubits in length, and five cubits in height in the
width, in juxtaposition to the courtyard’s hangings.

translation.text: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.

verses.english:
And the cover of the courtyard’s gate was embroiderer’s
work, blue and purple and scarlet and woven linen, and
twenty cubits in length, and five cubits in height in the
width, in juxtaposition to the courtyard’s hangings.

verses.hebrew: וְעַמֻּדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵיהֶם כֶּסֶף וְצִפּוּי רָאשֵׁיהֶם וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

hebrew.text: וְעַמֻּדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵיהֶם כֶּסֶף וְצִפּוּי רָאשֵׁיהֶם וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

english.text:
And their columns were four and their bases four of
bronze, their hooks silver, and the plating of their tops
and their bands silver.

translation.text: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.

verses.english:
And their columns were four and their bases four of
bronze, their hooks silver, and the plating of their tops
and their bands silver.

verses.hebrew: וְכל הַיְתֵדֹת לַמִּשְׁכָּן וְלֶחָצֵר סָבִיב נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הַיְתֵדֹת לַמִּשְׁכָּן וְלֶחָצֵר סָבִיב נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
And all of the pegs of the Tabernacle and the courtyard
all around were bronze.

translation.text: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.

verses.english:
And all of the pegs of the Tabernacle and the courtyard
all around were bronze.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה פְקוּדֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן מִשְׁכַּן הָעֵדֻת אֲשֶׁר פֻּקַּד עַל פִּי מֹשֶׁה עֲבֹדַת הַלְוִיִּם בְּיַד אִיתָמָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה פְקוּדֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן מִשְׁכַּן הָעֵדֻת אֲשֶׁר פֻּקַּד עַל פִּי מֹשֶׁה עֲבֹדַת הַלְוִיִּם בְּיַד אִיתָמָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
These are the accounts of the Tabernacle, the
Tabernacle of the Testimony, that were made by Moses’
word, the work of the Levites by the hand of Ithamar, son
of Aaron, the priest.

translation.text: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.

verses.english:
These are the accounts of the Tabernacle, the
Tabernacle of the Testimony, that were made by Moses’
word, the work of the Levites by the hand of Ithamar, son
of Aaron, the priest.

verses.hebrew: וּבְצַלְאֵל בֶּן אוּרִי בֶן חוּר לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה עָשָׂה אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וּבְצַלְאֵל בֶּן אוּרִי בֶן חוּר לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה עָשָׂה אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Bezalel, son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of
Judah, made everything that YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And Bezalel, son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of
Judah, made everything that YHWH had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וְאִתּוֹ אהֳלִיאָב בֶּן אֲחִיסָמָךְ לְמַטֵּה דָן חָרָשׁ וְחֹשֵׁב וְרֹקֵם בַּתְּכֵלֶת וּבָאַרְגָּמָן וּבְתוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי וּבַשֵּׁשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִתּוֹ אהֳלִיאָב בֶּן אֲחִיסָמָךְ לְמַטֵּה דָן חָרָשׁ וְחֹשֵׁב וְרֹקֵם בַּתְּכֵלֶת וּבָאַרְגָּמָן וּבְתוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי וּבַשֵּׁשׁ׃

english.text:
And with him was Oholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe
of Dan, an engraver and designer and embroiderer in blue
and in purple and in scarlet and in linen.

translation.text: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.

verses.english:
And with him was Oholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe
of Dan, an engraver and designer and embroiderer in blue
and in purple and in scarlet and in linen.

verses.hebrew: כּל הַזָּהָב הֶעָשׂוּי לַמְּלָאכָה בְּכֹל מְלֶאכֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וַיְהִי זְהַב הַתְּנוּפָה תֵּשַׁע וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכָּר וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שֶׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַזָּהָב הֶעָשׂוּי לַמְּלָאכָה בְּכֹל מְלֶאכֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וַיְהִי זְהַב הַתְּנוּפָה תֵּשַׁע וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכָּר וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שֶׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
All the gold that was used for the work, in all the work
of the Holy: and the gold of the elevation offering was
twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels by
the shekel of the Holy.

translation.text: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

verses.english:
All the gold that was used for the work, in all the work
of the Holy: and the gold of the elevation offering was
twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels by
the shekel of the Holy.

verses.hebrew: וְכֶסֶף פְּקוּדֵי הָעֵדָה מְאַת כִּכָּר וְאֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשָּׁה וְשִׁבְעִים שֶׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְכֶסֶף פְּקוּדֵי הָעֵדָה מְאַת כִּכָּר וְאֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשָּׁה וְשִׁבְעִים שֶׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And the silver of the congregation’s accounts was a
hundred talents and a thousand seven hundred seventy-five
shekels by the shekel of the Holy:

translation.text: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

verses.english:
And the silver of the congregation’s accounts was a
hundred talents and a thousand seven hundred seventy-five
shekels by the shekel of the Holy:

verses.hebrew: בֶּקַע לַגֻּלְגֹּלֶת מַחֲצִית הַשֶּׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְכֹל הָעֹבֵר עַל הַפְּקֻדִים מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה לְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים׃

hebrew.text: בֶּקַע לַגֻּלְגֹּלֶת מַחֲצִית הַשֶּׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְכֹל הָעֹבֵר עַל הַפְּקֻדִים מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה לְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים׃

english.text:
a beqa per head, half of a shekel by the shekel of the
Holy, for everyone who passed through the counts, from
twenty years old and up, for six hundred thousand and
three thousand five hundred fifty.

translation.text: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.

verses.english:
a beqa per head, half of a shekel by the shekel of the
Holy, for everyone who passed through the counts, from
twenty years old and up, for six hundred thousand and
three thousand five hundred fifty.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מְאַת כִּכַּר הַכֶּסֶף לָצֶקֶת אֵת אַדְנֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֵת אַדְנֵי הַפָּרֹכֶת מְאַת אֲדָנִים לִמְאַת הַכִּכָּר כִּכָּר לָאָדֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מְאַת כִּכַּר הַכֶּסֶף לָצֶקֶת אֵת אַדְנֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֵת אַדְנֵי הַפָּרֹכֶת מְאַת אֲדָנִים לִמְאַת הַכִּכָּר כִּכָּר לָאָדֶן׃

english.text:
And the hundred talents of silver were for casting the
bases of the Holy and the bases of the pavilion, a hundred
bases to the hundred talents, a talent per base.

translation.text: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.

verses.english:
And the hundred talents of silver were for casting the
bases of the Holy and the bases of the pavilion, a hundred
bases to the hundred talents, a talent per base.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָאֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע הַמֵּאוֹת וַחֲמִשָּׁה וְשִׁבְעִים עָשָׂה וָוִים לָעַמּוּדִים וְצִפָּה רָאשֵׁיהֶם וְחִשַּׁק אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָאֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע הַמֵּאוֹת וַחֲמִשָּׁה וְשִׁבְעִים עָשָׂה וָוִים לָעַמּוּדִים וְצִפָּה רָאשֵׁיהֶם וְחִשַּׁק אֹתָם׃

english.text:
And he made the thousand seven hundred seventy-five into
hooks for the columns, and he plated their tops and banded
them.

translation.text: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.

verses.english:
And he made the thousand seven hundred seventy-five into
hooks for the columns, and he plated their tops and banded
them.

verses.hebrew: וּנְחֹשֶׁת הַתְּנוּפָה שִׁבְעִים כִּכָּר וְאַלְפַּיִם וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁקֶל׃

hebrew.text: וּנְחֹשֶׁת הַתְּנוּפָה שִׁבְעִים כִּכָּר וְאַלְפַּיִם וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁקֶל׃

english.text:
And the bronze of the elevation offering was seventy
talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

translation.text: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.

verses.english:
And the bronze of the elevation offering was seventy
talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ בָּהּ אֶת אַדְנֵי פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת וְאֶת מִכְבַּר הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְאֵת כּל כְּלֵי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ בָּהּ אֶת אַדְנֵי פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת וְאֶת מִכְבַּר הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְאֵת כּל כְּלֵי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And with it he made the bases of the entrance of the Tent
of Meeting and the bronze altar and the bronze network
that it had and all of the altar’s equipment

translation.text: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,

verses.english:
And with it he made the bases of the entrance of the Tent
of Meeting and the bronze altar and the bronze network
that it had and all of the altar’s equipment

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת אַדְנֵי הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב וְאֶת אַדְנֵי שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר וְאֵת כּל יִתְדֹת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת כּל יִתְדֹת הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת אַדְנֵי הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב וְאֶת אַדְנֵי שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר וְאֵת כּל יִתְדֹת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת כּל יִתְדֹת הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב׃

english.text:
and the bases of the courtyard all around and the bases of
the courtyard’s gate and all of the Tabernacle’s pegs and
all of the courtyard’s pegs all around.

translation.text: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.

verses.english:
and the bases of the courtyard all around and the bases of
the courtyard’s gate and all of the Tabernacle’s pegs and
all of the courtyard’s pegs all around.

verses.hebrew: וּמִן הַתְּכֵלֶת וְהָאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי עָשׂוּ בִגְדֵי שְׂרָד לְשָׁרֵת בַּקֹּדֶשׁ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר לְאַהֲרֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וּמִן הַתְּכֵלֶת וְהָאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי עָשׂוּ בִגְדֵי שְׂרָד לְשָׁרֵת בַּקֹּדֶשׁ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר לְאַהֲרֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And from the blue and the purple and the scarlet they
made fabric clothes for ministering in the Holy, and they
made the holy clothes that were Aaron’s, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.

translation.text: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And from the blue and the purple and the scarlet they
made fabric clothes for ministering in the Holy, and they
made the holy clothes that were Aaron’s, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הָאֵפֹד זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הָאֵפֹד זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר׃

english.text:
And he made the ephod: gold, blue, and purple and scarlet
and woven linen.

translation.text: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

verses.english:
And he made the ephod: gold, blue, and purple and scarlet
and woven linen.

verses.hebrew: וַיְרַקְּעוּ אֶת פַּחֵי הַזָּהָב וְקִצֵּץ פְּתִילִם לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּתוֹךְ הַתְּכֵלֶת וּבְתוֹךְ הָאַרְגָּמָן וּבְתוֹךְ תּוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי וּבְתוֹךְ הַשֵּׁשׁ מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב׃

hebrew.text: וַיְרַקְּעוּ אֶת פַּחֵי הַזָּהָב וְקִצֵּץ פְּתִילִם לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּתוֹךְ הַתְּכֵלֶת וּבְתוֹךְ הָאַרְגָּמָן וּבְתוֹךְ תּוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי וּבְתוֹךְ הַשֵּׁשׁ מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב׃

english.text:
And they hammered out foil sheets of the gold, and he cut
threads to use among the blue and among the purple and
among the scarlet and among the linen—designer’s work.

translation.text: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.

verses.english:
And they hammered out foil sheets of the gold, and he cut
threads to use among the blue and among the purple and
among the scarlet and among the linen—designer’s work.

verses.hebrew: כְּתֵפֹת עָשׂוּ לוֹ חֹבְרֹת עַל שְׁנֵי (קצוותו) [קְצוֹתָיו] חֻבָּר׃

hebrew.text: כְּתֵפֹת עָשׂוּ לוֹ חֹבְרֹת עַל שְׁנֵי (קצוותו) [קְצוֹתָיו] חֻבָּר׃

english.text:
They made shoulder-pieces for it, connected: on its two
ends it was connected.

translation.text: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.

verses.english:
They made shoulder-pieces for it, connected: on its two
ends it was connected.

verses.hebrew: וְחֵשֶׁב אֲפֻדָּתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו מִמֶּנּוּ הוּא כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְחֵשֶׁב אֲפֻדָּתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו מִמֶּנּוּ הוּא כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And its ephod designed belt that was on it was a part of
it, like its work, gold, blue, and purple and scarlet and
woven linen, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And its ephod designed belt that was on it was a part of
it, like its work, gold, blue, and purple and scarlet and
woven linen, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת אַבְנֵי הַשֹּׁהַם מֻסַבֹּת מִשְׁבְּצֹת זָהָב מְפֻתָּחֹת פִּתּוּחֵי חוֹתָם עַל שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת אַבְנֵי הַשֹּׁהַם מֻסַבֹּת מִשְׁבְּצֹת זָהָב מְפֻתָּחֹת פִּתּוּחֵי חוֹתָם עַל שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And they made the onyx stones surrounded by settings of
gold, inscribed with signet inscriptions with the names of
the children of Israel.

translation.text: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And they made the onyx stones surrounded by settings of
gold, inscribed with signet inscriptions with the names of
the children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֹתָם עַל כִּתְפֹת הָאֵפֹד אַבְנֵי זִכָּרוֹן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֹתָם עַל כִּתְפֹת הָאֵפֹד אַבְנֵי זִכָּרוֹן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he set them on the ephod’s shoulder-pieces,
commemorative stones for the children of Israel, as YHWH
had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he set them on the ephod’s shoulder-pieces,
commemorative stones for the children of Israel, as YHWH
had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אֵפֹד זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אֵפֹד זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר׃

english.text:
And he made the breastplate, designer’s work, like the
work of the ephod: gold, blue, and purple and scarlet and
woven linen.

translation.text: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

verses.english:
And he made the breastplate, designer’s work, like the
work of the ephod: gold, blue, and purple and scarlet and
woven linen.

verses.hebrew: רָבוּעַ הָיָה כָּפוּל עָשׂוּ אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן זֶרֶת ארְכּוֹ וְזֶרֶת רחְבּוֹ כָּפוּל׃

hebrew.text: רָבוּעַ הָיָה כָּפוּל עָשׂוּ אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן זֶרֶת ארְכּוֹ וְזֶרֶת רחְבּוֹ כָּפוּל׃

english.text:
It was square. They made the breastplate doubled, its
length a span and its width a span, doubled.

translation.text: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.

verses.english:
It was square. They made the breastplate doubled, its
length a span and its width a span, doubled.

verses.hebrew: וַיְמַלְאוּ בוֹ אַרְבָּעָה טוּרֵי אָבֶן טוּר אֹדֶם פִּטְדָה וּבָרֶקֶת הַטּוּר הָאֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַלְאוּ בוֹ אַרְבָּעָה טוּרֵי אָבֶן טוּר אֹדֶם פִּטְדָה וּבָרֶקֶת הַטּוּר הָאֶחָד׃

english.text:
And they mounted four rows of stones in it: a row of a
carnelian, a topaz, and an emerald: the one row;

translation.text: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.

verses.english:
And they mounted four rows of stones in it: a row of a
carnelian, a topaz, and an emerald: the one row;

verses.hebrew: וְהַטּוּר הַשֵּׁנִי נֹפֶךְ סַפִּיר וְיָהֲלֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַטּוּר הַשֵּׁנִי נֹפֶךְ סַפִּיר וְיָהֲלֹם׃

english.text: and the second row: a ruby, a sapphire, and a diamond;

translation.text: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

verses.english: and the second row: a ruby, a sapphire, and a diamond;

verses.hebrew: וְהַטּוּר הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לֶשֶׁם שְׁבוֹ וְאַחְלָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַטּוּר הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לֶשֶׁם שְׁבוֹ וְאַחְלָמָה׃

english.text: and the third row: a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

translation.text: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

verses.english: and the third row: a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

verses.hebrew: וְהַטּוּר הָרְבִיעִי תַּרְשִׁישׁ שֹׁהַם וְיָשְׁפֵה מוּסַבֹּת מִשְׁבְּצֹת זָהָב בְּמִלֻּאֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַטּוּר הָרְבִיעִי תַּרְשִׁישׁ שֹׁהַם וְיָשְׁפֵה מוּסַבֹּת מִשְׁבְּצֹת זָהָב בְּמִלֻּאֹתָם׃

english.text:
and the fourth row: a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper—set in
gold in their mountings.

translation.text: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.

verses.english:
and the fourth row: a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper—set in
gold in their mountings.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֲבָנִים עַל שְׁמֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵנָּה שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה עַל שְׁמֹתָם פִּתּוּחֵי חֹתָם אִישׁ עַל שְׁמוֹ לִשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר שָׁבֶט׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֲבָנִים עַל שְׁמֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵנָּה שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה עַל שְׁמֹתָם פִּתּוּחֵי חֹתָם אִישׁ עַל שְׁמוֹ לִשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר שָׁבֶט׃

english.text:
And the stones: they were with the names of the children
of Israel, twelve with their names, signet engravings,
each with its name, for twelve tribes.

translation.text: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.

verses.english:
And the stones: they were with the names of the children
of Israel, twelve with their names, signet engravings,
each with its name, for twelve tribes.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ עַל הַחֹשֶׁן שַׁרְשְׁרֹת גַּבְלֻת מַעֲשֵׂה עֲבֹת זָהָב טָהוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ עַל הַחֹשֶׁן שַׁרְשְׁרֹת גַּבְלֻת מַעֲשֵׂה עֲבֹת זָהָב טָהוֹר׃

english.text:
And they made twisted chains, rope work, of pure gold, on
the breastplate.

translation.text: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.

verses.english:
And they made twisted chains, rope work, of pure gold, on
the breastplate.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ שְׁתֵּי מִשְׁבְּצֹת זָהָב וּשְׁתֵּי טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת שְׁתֵּי הַטַּבָּעֹת עַל שְׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַחֹשֶׁן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ שְׁתֵּי מִשְׁבְּצֹת זָהָב וּשְׁתֵּי טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת שְׁתֵּי הַטַּבָּעֹת עַל שְׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַחֹשֶׁן׃

english.text:
And they made two settings of gold and two rings of gold
and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate

translation.text: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.

verses.english:
And they made two settings of gold and two rings of gold
and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ שְׁתֵּי הָעֲבֹתֹת הַזָּהָב עַל שְׁתֵּי הַטַּבָּעֹת עַל קְצוֹת הַחֹשֶׁן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ שְׁתֵּי הָעֲבֹתֹת הַזָּהָב עַל שְׁתֵּי הַטַּבָּעֹת עַל קְצוֹת הַחֹשֶׁן׃

english.text:
and put the two ropes of gold on the two rings at the ends
of the breastplate.

translation.text: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.

verses.english:
and put the two ropes of gold on the two rings at the ends
of the breastplate.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי קְצוֹת שְׁתֵּי הָעֲבֹתֹת נָתְנוּ עַל שְׁתֵּי הַמִּשְׁבְּצֹת וַיִּתְּנֻם עַל כִּתְפֹת הָאֵפֹד אֶל מוּל פָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי קְצוֹת שְׁתֵּי הָעֲבֹתֹת נָתְנוּ עַל שְׁתֵּי הַמִּשְׁבְּצֹת וַיִּתְּנֻם עַל כִּתְפֹת הָאֵפֹד אֶל מוּל פָּנָיו׃

english.text:
And they put the two ends of the two ropes on the two
settings and put them on the ephod’s shoulder-pieces
opposite the front of it.

translation.text: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.

verses.english:
And they put the two ends of the two ropes on the two
settings and put them on the ephod’s shoulder-pieces
opposite the front of it.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ שְׁתֵּי טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל שְׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַחֹשֶׁן עַל שְׂפָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר אֶל עֵבֶר הָאֵפֹד בָּיְתָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ שְׁתֵּי טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל שְׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַחֹשֶׁן עַל שְׂפָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר אֶל עֵבֶר הָאֵפֹד בָּיְתָה׃

english.text:
And they made two rings of gold and put them on the
breastplate’s two ends on its side that is adjacent to the
ephod, inward.

translation.text: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.

verses.english:
And they made two rings of gold and put them on the
breastplate’s two ends on its side that is adjacent to the
ephod, inward.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ שְׁתֵּי טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וַיִּתְּנֻם עַל שְׁתֵּי כִתְפֹת הָאֵפֹד מִלְּמַטָּה מִמּוּל פָּנָיו לְעֻמַּת מַחְבַּרְתּוֹ מִמַּעַל לְחֵשֶׁב הָאֵפֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ שְׁתֵּי טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וַיִּתְּנֻם עַל שְׁתֵּי כִתְפֹת הָאֵפֹד מִלְּמַטָּה מִמּוּל פָּנָיו לְעֻמַּת מַחְבַּרְתּוֹ מִמַּעַל לְחֵשֶׁב הָאֵפֹד׃

english.text:
And they made two rings of gold and put them on the
ephod’s two shoulder-pieces below, opposite the front of
it, by its connection, above the ephod’s designed belt.

translation.text: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

verses.english:
And they made two rings of gold and put them on the
ephod’s two shoulder-pieces below, opposite the front of
it, by its connection, above the ephod’s designed belt.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְכְּסוּ אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן מִטַּבְּעֹתָיו אֶל טַבְּעֹת הָאֵפֹד בִּפְתִיל תְּכֵלֶת לִהְיֹת עַל חֵשֶׁב הָאֵפֹד וְלֹא יִזַּח הַחֹשֶׁן מֵעַל הָאֵפֹד כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְכְּסוּ אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן מִטַּבְּעֹתָיו אֶל טַבְּעֹת הָאֵפֹד בִּפְתִיל תְּכֵלֶת לִהְיֹת עַל חֵשֶׁב הָאֵפֹד וְלֹא יִזַּח הַחֹשֶׁן מֵעַל הָאֵפֹד כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And they attached the breastplate from its rings to the
ephod’s rings with a blue string so it would be on the
ephod’s designed belt and the breastplate would not be
detached from the ephod, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And they attached the breastplate from its rings to the
ephod’s rings with a blue string so it would be on the
ephod’s designed belt and the breastplate would not be
detached from the ephod, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת מְעִיל הָאֵפֹד מַעֲשֵׂה אֹרֵג כְּלִיל תְּכֵלֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת מְעִיל הָאֵפֹד מַעֲשֵׂה אֹרֵג כְּלִיל תְּכֵלֶת׃

english.text:
And he made the robe of the ephod, weaver’s work, all of
blue,

translation.text: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

verses.english:
And he made the robe of the ephod, weaver’s work, all of
blue,

verses.hebrew: וּפִי הַמְּעִיל בְּתוֹכוֹ כְּפִי תַחְרָא שָׂפָה לְפִיו סָבִיב לֹא יִקָּרֵעַ׃

hebrew.text: וּפִי הַמְּעִיל בְּתוֹכוֹ כְּפִי תַחְרָא שָׂפָה לְפִיו סָבִיב לֹא יִקָּרֵעַ׃

english.text:
and the robe’s opening within it like the opening of a
coat of mail, a binding for its opening all around so it
would not be torn.

translation.text: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.

verses.english:
and the robe’s opening within it like the opening of a
coat of mail, a binding for its opening all around so it
would not be torn.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ עַל שׁוּלֵי הַמְּעִיל רִמּוֹנֵי תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי משְׁזָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ עַל שׁוּלֵי הַמְּעִיל רִמּוֹנֵי תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי משְׁזָר׃

english.text:
And they made on the robe’s skirts pomegranates of blue
and purple and scarlet, woven.

translation.text: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.

verses.english:
And they made on the robe’s skirts pomegranates of blue
and purple and scarlet, woven.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ פַעֲמֹנֵי זָהָב טָהוֹר וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת הַפַּעֲמֹנִים בְּתוֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִים עַל שׁוּלֵי הַמְּעִיל סָבִיב בְּתוֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ פַעֲמֹנֵי זָהָב טָהוֹר וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת הַפַּעֲמֹנִים בְּתוֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִים עַל שׁוּלֵי הַמְּעִיל סָבִיב בְּתוֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִים׃

english.text:
And they made bells of pure gold and put the bells among
the pomegranates on the robe’s skirts all around among the
pomegranates:

translation.text: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;

verses.english:
And they made bells of pure gold and put the bells among
the pomegranates on the robe’s skirts all around among the
pomegranates:

verses.hebrew: פַּעֲמֹן וְרִמֹּן פַּעֲמֹן וְרִמֹּן עַל שׁוּלֵי הַמְּעִיל סָבִיב לְשָׁרֵת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: פַּעֲמֹן וְרִמֹּן פַּעֲמֹן וְרִמֹּן עַל שׁוּלֵי הַמְּעִיל סָבִיב לְשָׁרֵת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
bell and pomegranate, bell and pomegranate, on the robe’s
skirts all around, for ministering, as YHWH had commanded
Moses.

translation.text: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
bell and pomegranate, bell and pomegranate, on the robe’s
skirts all around, for ministering, as YHWH had commanded
Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת הַכּתְנֹת שֵׁשׁ מַעֲשֵׂה אֹרֵג לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת הַכּתְנֹת שֵׁשׁ מַעֲשֵׂה אֹרֵג לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו׃

english.text:
And they made the coats of linen, weaver’s work, for Aaron
and for his sons,

translation.text: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,

verses.english:
And they made the coats of linen, weaver’s work, for Aaron
and for his sons,

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת הַמִּצְנֶפֶת שֵׁשׁ וְאֶת פַּאֲרֵי הַמִּגְבָּעֹת שֵׁשׁ וְאֶת מִכְנְסֵי הַבָּד שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת הַמִּצְנֶפֶת שֵׁשׁ וְאֶת פַּאֲרֵי הַמִּגְבָּעֹת שֵׁשׁ וְאֶת מִכְנְסֵי הַבָּד שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר׃

english.text:
and the headdress of linen and the beautiful hats of linen
and the shorts of linen, woven linen,

translation.text: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,

verses.english:
and the headdress of linen and the beautiful hats of linen
and the shorts of linen, woven linen,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָאַבְנֵט שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר וּתְכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָאַבְנֵט שֵׁשׁ משְׁזָר וּתְכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
and the sash of woven linen and blue and purple and
scarlet, embroiderer’s work, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
and the sash of woven linen and blue and purple and
scarlet, embroiderer’s work, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת צִיץ נֵזֶר הַקֹּדֶשׁ זָהָב טָהוֹר וַיִּכְתְּבוּ עָלָיו מִכְתַּב פִּתּוּחֵי חוֹתָם קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת צִיץ נֵזֶר הַקֹּדֶשׁ זָהָב טָהוֹר וַיִּכְתְּבוּ עָלָיו מִכְתַּב פִּתּוּחֵי חוֹתָם קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And they made the plate of the crown of Holiness of pure
gold, and they wrote on it a text of signet inscriptions:
“Holiness to YHWH.”

translation.text: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.

verses.english:
And they made the plate of the crown of Holiness of pure
gold, and they wrote on it a text of signet inscriptions:
“Holiness to YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ עָלָיו פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת לָתֵת עַל הַמִּצְנֶפֶת מִלְמָעְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ עָלָיו פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת לָתֵת עַל הַמִּצְנֶפֶת מִלְמָעְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And they put a blue string on it for putting it on the
headdress above, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And they put a blue string on it for putting it on the
headdress above, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּכֶל כּל עֲבֹדַת מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּכֶל כּל עֲבֹדַת מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ׃

english.text:
And all of the construction of the Tabernacle of the Tent
of Meeting was finished. And the children of Israel did
according to everything that YHWH had commanded Moses.
They did so.

translation.text: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.

verses.english:
And all of the construction of the Tabernacle of the Tent
of Meeting was finished. And the children of Israel did
according to everything that YHWH had commanded Moses.
They did so.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָאֹהֶל וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו קְרָסָיו קְרָשָׁיו בְּרִיחָו וְעַמֻּדָיו וַאֲדָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָאֹהֶל וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו קְרָסָיו קְרָשָׁיו בְּרִיחָו וְעַמֻּדָיו וַאֲדָנָיו׃

english.text:
And they brought the Tabernacle to Moses: the tent and all
of its equipment, its clasps, its frames, its bars, and
its columns and its bases,

translation.text: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,

verses.english:
And they brought the Tabernacle to Moses: the tent and all
of its equipment, its clasps, its frames, its bars, and
its columns and its bases,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת מִכְסֵה עוֹרֹת הָאֵילִם הַמְאדָּמִים וְאֶת מִכְסֵה עֹרֹת הַתְּחָשִׁים וְאֵת פָּרֹכֶת הַמָּסָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת מִכְסֵה עוֹרֹת הָאֵילִם הַמְאדָּמִים וְאֶת מִכְסֵה עֹרֹת הַתְּחָשִׁים וְאֵת פָּרֹכֶת הַמָּסָךְ׃

english.text:
and the covering of rams’ skins dyed red and the covering
of leather skins, and the covering pavilion,

translation.text: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,

verses.english:
and the covering of rams’ skins dyed red and the covering
of leather skins, and the covering pavilion,

verses.hebrew: אֶת אֲרוֹן הָעֵדֻת וְאֶת בַּדָּיו וְאֵת הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

hebrew.text: אֶת אֲרוֹן הָעֵדֻת וְאֶת בַּדָּיו וְאֵת הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

english.text:
the Ark of the Testimony and its poles and the atonement
dais,

translation.text: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,

verses.english:
the Ark of the Testimony and its poles and the atonement
dais,

verses.hebrew: אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן אֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֵת לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים׃

hebrew.text: אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן אֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֵת לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים׃

english.text: the table and all of its equipment and the show bread,

translation.text: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,

verses.english: the table and all of its equipment and the show bread,

verses.hebrew: אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה הַטְּהֹרָה אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ נֵרֹת הַמַּעֲרָכָה וְאֶת כּל כֵּלֶיהָ וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמָּאוֹר׃

hebrew.text: אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה הַטְּהֹרָה אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ נֵרֹת הַמַּעֲרָכָה וְאֶת כּל כֵּלֶיהָ וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמָּאוֹר׃

english.text:
the pure menorah, its lamps, lamps for the row, and all of
its equipment, and the oil for lighting,

translation.text: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,

verses.english:
the pure menorah, its lamps, lamps for the row, and all of
