its equipment, and the oil for lighting,

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְאֵת קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים וְאֵת מָסַךְ פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְאֵת קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים וְאֵת מָסַךְ פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל׃

english.text:
and the golden altar and the anointing oil and the incense
of fragrances and the cover of the entrance of the Tent,

translation.text: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,

verses.english:
and the golden altar and the anointing oil and the incense
of fragrances and the cover of the entrance of the Tent,

verses.hebrew: אֵת מִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת וְאֶת מִכְבַּר הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ אֶת בַּדָּיו וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו אֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אֵת מִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת וְאֶת מִכְבַּר הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ אֶת בַּדָּיו וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו אֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ׃

english.text:
the bronze altar and the bronze grate that it had, its
poles and all of its equipment, the basin and its stand,

translation.text: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

verses.english:
the bronze altar and the bronze grate that it had, its
poles and all of its equipment, the basin and its stand,

verses.hebrew: אֵת קַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר אֶת עַמֻּדֶיהָ וְאֶת אֲדָנֶיהָ וְאֶת הַמָּסָךְ לְשַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר אֶת מֵיתָרָיו וִיתֵדֹתֶיהָ וְאֵת כּל כְּלֵי עֲבֹדַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן לְאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: אֵת קַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר אֶת עַמֻּדֶיהָ וְאֶת אֲדָנֶיהָ וְאֶת הַמָּסָךְ לְשַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר אֶת מֵיתָרָיו וִיתֵדֹתֶיהָ וְאֵת כּל כְּלֵי עֲבֹדַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן לְאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
the courtyard’s hangings, its columns and its bases and
the cover for the courtyard’s gate, its cords and its
pegs, and all the equipment for the service of the
Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting,

translation.text: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,

verses.english:
the courtyard’s hangings, its columns and its bases and
the cover for the courtyard’s gate, its cords and its
pegs, and all the equipment for the service of the
Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting,

verses.hebrew: אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַשְּׂרָד לְשָׁרֵת בַּקֹּדֶשׁ אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו לְכַהֵן׃

hebrew.text: אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַשְּׂרָד לְשָׁרֵת בַּקֹּדֶשׁ אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו לְכַהֵן׃

english.text:
the fabric clothes for ministering in the Holy, the holy
clothes for Aaron, the priest, and his sons’ clothes for
functioning as priests.

translation.text: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister in the priest’s office.

verses.english:
the fabric clothes for ministering in the Holy, the holy
clothes for Aaron, the priest, and his sons’ clothes for
functioning as priests.

verses.hebrew: כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל הָעֲבֹדָה׃

hebrew.text: כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל הָעֲבֹדָה׃

english.text:
According to everything that YHWH had commanded Moses: so
the children of Israel did all of the construction.

translation.text: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.

verses.english:
According to everything that YHWH had commanded Moses: so
the children of Israel did all of the construction.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא מֹשֶׁה אֶת כּל הַמְּלָאכָה וְהִנֵּה עָשׂוּ אֹתָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה כֵּן עָשׂוּ וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא מֹשֶׁה אֶת כּל הַמְּלָאכָה וְהִנֵּה עָשׂוּ אֹתָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה כֵּן עָשׂוּ וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Moses saw all of the work; and, here, they had done it
as YHWH had commanded. They did so. And Moses blessed
them.

translation.text: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.

verses.english:
And Moses saw all of the work; and, here, they had done it
as YHWH had commanded. They did so. And Moses blessed
them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם הַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ תָּקִים אֶת מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: בְּיוֹם הַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ תָּקִים אֶת מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
“On the day of the first month, on the first of the month,
you shall set up the Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

verses.english:
“On the day of the first month, on the first of the month,
you shall set up the Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתָּ שָׁם אֵת אֲרוֹן הָעֵדוּת וְסַכֹּתָ עַל הָאָרֹן אֶת הַפָּרֹכֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ שָׁם אֵת אֲרוֹן הָעֵדוּת וְסַכֹּתָ עַל הָאָרֹן אֶת הַפָּרֹכֶת׃

english.text:
And you shall set the Ark of the Testimony there and have
the pavilion cover over the ark.

translation.text: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.

verses.english:
And you shall set the Ark of the Testimony there and have
the pavilion cover over the ark.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן וְעָרַכְתָּ אֶת עֶרְכּוֹ וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה וְהַעֲלֵיתָ אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן וְעָרַכְתָּ אֶת עֶרְכּוֹ וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה וְהַעֲלֵיתָ אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And you shall bring the table and make its arrangement,
and bring the menorah and put up its lamps.

translation.text: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.

verses.english:
And you shall bring the table and make its arrangement,
and bring the menorah and put up its lamps.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה אֶת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב לִקְטֹרֶת לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן הָעֵדֻת וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת מָסַךְ הַפֶּתַח לַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּה אֶת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב לִקְטֹרֶת לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן הָעֵדֻת וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת מָסַךְ הַפֶּתַח לַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
And you shall put the golden altar for incense in front of
the Ark of the Testimony, and you shall set the cover of
the entrance of the Tabernacle.

translation.text: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.

verses.english:
And you shall put the golden altar for incense in front of
the Ark of the Testimony, and you shall set the cover of
the entrance of the Tabernacle.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה אֵת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה לִפְנֵי פֶּתַח מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּה אֵת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה לִפְנֵי פֶּתַח מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And you shall put the altar of burnt offering in front of
the entrance of the Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

verses.english:
And you shall put the altar of burnt offering in front of
the entrance of the Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ אֶת הַכִּיֹּר בֵּין אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְנָתַתָּ שָׁם מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּ אֶת הַכִּיֹּר בֵּין אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְנָתַתָּ שָׁם מָיִם׃

english.text:
And you shall put the basin between the Tent of Meeting
and the altar and put water there.

translation.text: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.

verses.english:
And you shall put the basin between the Tent of Meeting
and the altar and put water there.

verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב וְנָתַתָּ אֶת מָסַךְ שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב וְנָתַתָּ אֶת מָסַךְ שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר׃

english.text:
And you shall set the courtyard all around and put on the
cover of the courtyard’s gate.

translation.text: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.

verses.english:
And you shall set the courtyard all around and put on the
cover of the courtyard’s gate.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְהָיָה קֹדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְהָיָה קֹדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And you shall take the anointing oil and anoint the
Tabernacle and everything that is in it, and you shall
make it and all of its equipment holy, and it will be
holiness.

translation.text: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.

verses.english:
And you shall take the anointing oil and anoint the
Tabernacle and everything that is in it, and you shall
make it and all of its equipment holy, and it will be
holiness.

verses.hebrew: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהָיָה הַמִּזְבֵּחַ קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהָיָה הַמִּזְבֵּחַ קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים׃

english.text:
And you shall anoint the altar of burnt offering and all
of its equipment, and you shall make the altar holy: and
the altar will be holy of holies.

translation.text: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.

verses.english:
And you shall anoint the altar of burnt offering and all
of its equipment, and you shall make the altar holy: and
the altar will be holy of holies.

verses.hebrew: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And you shall anoint the basin and its stand and make it
holy.

translation.text: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.

verses.english:
And you shall anoint the basin and its stand and make it
holy.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְרָחַצְתָּ אֹתָם בַּמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְרָחַצְתָּ אֹתָם בַּמָּיִם׃

english.text:
“And you shall bring Aaron and his sons forward to the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.

translation.text: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.

verses.english:
“And you shall bring Aaron and his sons forward to the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.

verses.hebrew: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ אֶת אַהֲרֹן אֵת בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתוֹ וְכִהֵן לִי׃

hebrew.text: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ אֶת אַהֲרֹן אֵת בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתוֹ וְכִהֵן לִי׃

english.text:
And you shall dress Aaron with the holy clothes and anoint
him and make him holy, and he shall function as a priest
for me.

translation.text: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.english:
And you shall dress Aaron with the holy clothes and anoint
him and make him holy, and he shall function as a priest
for me.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת בָּנָיו תַּקְרִיב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ אֹתָם כֻּתֳּנֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת בָּנָיו תַּקְרִיב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ אֹתָם כֻּתֳּנֹת׃

english.text:
And you shall bring his sons forward and dress them with
coats

translation.text: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:

verses.english:
And you shall bring his sons forward and dress them with
coats

verses.hebrew: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר מָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת אֲבִיהֶם וְכִהֲנוּ לִי וְהָיְתָה לִהְיֹת לָהֶם משְׁחָתָם לִכְהֻנַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר מָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת אֲבִיהֶם וְכִהֲנוּ לִי וְהָיְתָה לִהְיֹת לָהֶם משְׁחָתָם לִכְהֻנַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתָם׃

english.text:
and anoint them as you anointed their father, and they
shall function as priests for me. And it will be for their
anointing to be theirs as an eternal priesthood through
their generations.”

translation.text: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.

verses.english:
and anoint them as you anointed their father, and they
shall function as priests for me. And it will be for their
anointing to be theirs as an eternal priesthood through
their generations.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ כֵּן עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ כֵּן עָשָׂה׃

english.text:
And Moses did it. According to everything that YHWH
commanded him, he did so.

translation.text: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.

verses.english:
And Moses did it. According to everything that YHWH
commanded him, he did so.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בַּשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הוּקַם הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בַּשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הוּקַם הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
And it was: in the first month, in the second year, on the
first of the month, the Tabernacle was set up.

translation.text: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.

verses.english:
And it was: in the first month, in the second year, on the
first of the month, the Tabernacle was set up.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וַיִּתֵּן אֶת אֲדָנָיו וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת קְרָשָׁיו וַיִּתֵּן אֶת בְּרִיחָיו וַיָּקֶם אֶת עַמּוּדָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֶם מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וַיִּתֵּן אֶת אֲדָנָיו וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת קְרָשָׁיו וַיִּתֵּן אֶת בְּרִיחָיו וַיָּקֶם אֶת עַמּוּדָיו׃

english.text:
And Moses set up the Tabernacle and put on its bases and
set its frames and put on its bars and set up its columns.

translation.text: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.

verses.english:
And Moses set up the Tabernacle and put on its bases and
set its frames and put on its bars and set up its columns.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְרֹשׂ אֶת הָאֹהֶל עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מִכְסֵה הָאֹהֶל עָלָיו מִלְמָעְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְרֹשׂ אֶת הָאֹהֶל עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מִכְסֵה הָאֹהֶל עָלָיו מִלְמָעְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he spread the Tent over the Tabernacle and set the
Tent’s covering on it above, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he spread the Tent over the Tabernacle and set the
Tent’s covering on it above, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הָעֵדֻת אֶל הָאָרֹן וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַבַּדִּים עַל הָאָרֹן וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת עַל הָאָרֹן מִלְמָעְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הָעֵדֻת אֶל הָאָרֹן וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַבַּדִּים עַל הָאָרֹן וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת עַל הָאָרֹן מִלְמָעְלָה׃

english.text:
And he took the Testimony and put it into the ark, and he
set the poles on the ark, and he put the atonement dais on
the ark above.

translation.text: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:

verses.english:
And he took the Testimony and put it into the ark, and he
set the poles on the ark, and he put the atonement dais on
the ark above.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֵא אֶת הָאָרֹן אֶל הַמִּשְׁכָּן וַיָּשֶׂם אֵת פָּרֹכֶת הַמָּסָךְ וַיָּסֶךְ עַל אֲרוֹן הָעֵדוּת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֵא אֶת הָאָרֹן אֶל הַמִּשְׁכָּן וַיָּשֶׂם אֵת פָּרֹכֶת הַמָּסָךְ וַיָּסֶךְ עַל אֲרוֹן הָעֵדוּת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he brought the ark into the Tabernacle and set the
covering pavilion and covered over the Ark of the
Testimony, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he brought the ark into the Tabernacle and set the
covering pavilion and covered over the Ark of the
Testimony, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן צָפֹנָה מִחוּץ לַפָּרֹכֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן צָפֹנָה מִחוּץ לַפָּרֹכֶת׃

english.text:
And he put the table in the Tent of Meeting on the
northward side of the Tabernacle, outside of the pavilion.

translation.text: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.

verses.english:
And he put the table in the Tent of Meeting on the
northward side of the Tabernacle, outside of the pavilion.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲרֹךְ עָלָיו עֵרֶךְ לֶחֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲרֹךְ עָלָיו עֵרֶךְ לֶחֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he made the arrangement of bread on it in front of
YHWH, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he made the arrangement of bread on it in front of
YHWH, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד נֹכַח הַשֻּׁלְחָן עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן נֶגְבָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד נֹכַח הַשֻּׁלְחָן עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן נֶגְבָּה׃

english.text:
And he set the menorah in the Tent of Meeting opposite the
table, on the southward side of the Tabernacle,

translation.text: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

verses.english:
And he set the menorah in the Tent of Meeting opposite the
table, on the southward side of the Tabernacle,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל הַנֵּרֹת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל הַנֵּרֹת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
and he put up the lamps in front of YHWH, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.

translation.text: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
and he put up the lamps in front of YHWH, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי הַפָּרֹכֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי הַפָּרֹכֶת׃

english.text:
And he set the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting in
front of the pavilion,

translation.text: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:

verses.english:
And he set the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting in
front of the pavilion,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְטֵר עָלָיו קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְטֵר עָלָיו קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
and he burned the incense of fragrances on it, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.

translation.text: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
and he burned the incense of fragrances on it, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מָסַךְ הַפֶּתַח לַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מָסַךְ הַפֶּתַח לַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text: And he set the cover of the entrance of the Tabernacle.

translation.text: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.

verses.english: And he set the cover of the entrance of the Tabernacle.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה שָׂם פֶּתַח מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיַּעַל עָלָיו אֶת הָעֹלָה וְאֶת הַמִּנְחָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה שָׂם פֶּתַח מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיַּעַל עָלָיו אֶת הָעֹלָה וְאֶת הַמִּנְחָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he set the altar of burnt offering at the entrance of
Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and he offered up the
burnt offering and the grain offering on it, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.

translation.text: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he set the altar of burnt offering at the entrance of
Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and he offered up the
burnt offering and the grain offering on it, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַכִּיֹּר בֵּין אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּתֵּן שָׁמָּה מַיִם לְרחְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַכִּיֹּר בֵּין אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּתֵּן שָׁמָּה מַיִם לְרחְצָה׃

english.text:
And he set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the
altar, and he put water for washing there.

translation.text: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.

verses.english:
And he set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the
altar, and he put water for washing there.

verses.hebrew: וְרָחֲצוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת רַגְלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְרָחֲצוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת רַגְלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and
their feet from it.

translation.text: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and
their feet from it.

verses.hebrew: בְּבֹאָם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבְקרְבָתָם אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ יִרְחָצוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: בְּבֹאָם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבְקרְבָתָם אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ יִרְחָצוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
When they came to the Tent of Meeting and when they came
forward to the altar they would wash, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.

translation.text: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
When they came to the Tent of Meeting and when they came
forward to the altar they would wash, as YHWH had
commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם אֶת הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב לַמִּשְׁכָּן וְלַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת מָסַךְ שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר וַיְכַל מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמְּלָאכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֶם אֶת הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב לַמִּשְׁכָּן וְלַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת מָסַךְ שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר וַיְכַל מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמְּלָאכָה׃

english.text:
And he set up the courtyard all around the Tabernacle and
the altar, and he put on the cover of the courtyard’s
gate. And Moses finished the work.

translation.text: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.

verses.english:
And he set up the courtyard all around the Tabernacle and
the altar, and he put on the cover of the courtyard’s
gate. And Moses finished the work.

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַס הֶעָנָן אֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּכְבוֹד יְהֹוָה מָלֵא אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְכַס הֶעָנָן אֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּכְבוֹד יְהֹוָה מָלֵא אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
And the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and YHWH’s
glory filled the Tabernacle.

translation.text: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

verses.english:
And the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and YHWH’s
glory filled the Tabernacle.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יָכֹל מֹשֶׁה לָבוֹא אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד כִּי שָׁכַן עָלָיו הֶעָנָן וּכְבוֹד יְהֹוָה מָלֵא אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יָכֹל מֹשֶׁה לָבוֹא אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד כִּי שָׁכַן עָלָיו הֶעָנָן וּכְבוֹד יְהֹוָה מָלֵא אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
And Moses was not able to come into the Tent of Meeting,
because the cloud had settled on it and YHWH’s glory
filled the Tabernacle.

translation.text: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

verses.english:
And Moses was not able to come into the Tent of Meeting,
because the cloud had settled on it and YHWH’s glory
filled the Tabernacle.

verses.hebrew: וּבְהֵעָלוֹת הֶעָנָן מֵעַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יִסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכֹל מַסְעֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְהֵעָלוֹת הֶעָנָן מֵעַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יִסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכֹל מַסְעֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And when the cloud was lifted from on the Tabernacle, the
children of Israel would travel—in all their travels—

translation.text: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:

verses.english:
And when the cloud was lifted from on the Tabernacle, the
children of Israel would travel—in all their travels—

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא יֵעָלֶה הֶעָנָן וְלֹא יִסְעוּ עַד יוֹם הֵעָלֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא יֵעָלֶה הֶעָנָן וְלֹא יִסְעוּ עַד יוֹם הֵעָלֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
and if the cloud would not be lifted, then they would not
travel until the day that it would be lifted.

translation.text: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.

verses.english:
and if the cloud would not be lifted, then they would not
travel until the day that it would be lifted.

verses.hebrew: כִּי עֲנַן יְהֹוָה עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יוֹמָם וְאֵשׁ תִּהְיֶה לַיְלָה בּוֹ לְעֵינֵי כל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל מַסְעֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי עֲנַן יְהֹוָה עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יוֹמָם וְאֵשׁ תִּהְיֶה לַיְלָה בּוֹ לְעֵינֵי כל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל מַסְעֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Because YHWH’s cloud was on the Tabernacle by day, and
fire would be in it at night, before the eyes of all the
house of Israel in all their travels.

translation.text: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

verses.english:
Because YHWH’s cloud was on the Tabernacle by day, and
fire would be in it at night, before the eyes of all the
house of Israel in all their travels.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו מֵאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו מֵאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And He called to Moses, and YHWH spoke to him from the
Tent of Meeting, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

verses.english:
And He called to Moses, and YHWH spoke to him from the
Tent of Meeting, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אָדָם כִּי יַקְרִיב מִכֶּם קרְבָּן לַיהֹוָה מִן הַבְּהֵמָה מִן הַבָּקָר וּמִן הַצֹּאן תַּקְרִיבוּ אֶת קרְבַּנְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אָדָם כִּי יַקְרִיב מִכֶּם קרְבָּן לַיהֹוָה מִן הַבְּהֵמָה מִן הַבָּקָר וּמִן הַצֹּאן תַּקְרִיבוּ אֶת קרְבַּנְכֶם׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel. And you shall say to
them: A human from you who will make an offering to
YHWH—you shall make your offering from the domestic
animals: from the herd and from the flock.

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel. And you shall say to
them: A human from you who will make an offering to
YHWH—you shall make your offering from the domestic
animals: from the herd and from the flock.

verses.hebrew: אִם עֹלָה קרְבָּנוֹ מִן הַבָּקָר זָכָר תָּמִים יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יַקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לִרְצֹנוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אִם עֹלָה קרְבָּנוֹ מִן הַבָּקָר זָכָר תָּמִים יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יַקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לִרְצֹנוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he
shall make it an unblemished male. He shall bring it
forward to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting for his
acceptance in front of YHWH.

translation.text: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.

verses.english:
“If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he
shall make it an unblemished male. He shall bring it
forward to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting for his
acceptance in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְסָמַךְ יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ הָעֹלָה וְנִרְצָה לוֹ לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְסָמַךְ יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ הָעֹלָה וְנִרְצָה לוֹ לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו׃

english.text:
And he shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt
offering, and it will be accepted for him, to atone for
him.

translation.text: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

verses.english:
And he shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt
offering, and it will be accepted for him, to atone for
him.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַט אֶת בֶּן הַבָּקָר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְהִקְרִיבוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת הַדָּם וְזָרְקוּ אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב אֲשֶׁר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁחַט אֶת בֶּן הַבָּקָר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְהִקְרִיבוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת הַדָּם וְזָרְקוּ אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב אֲשֶׁר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And he shall slaughter the herd animal in front of YHWH,
and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall bring the blood
forward and fling the blood on the altar, all around,
which is at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.english:
And he shall slaughter the herd animal in front of YHWH,
and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall bring the blood
forward and fling the blood on the altar, all around,
which is at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וְהִפְשִׁיט אֶת הָעֹלָה וְנִתַּח אֹתָהּ לִנְתָחֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִפְשִׁיט אֶת הָעֹלָה וְנִתַּח אֹתָהּ לִנְתָחֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And he shall flay the burnt offering and cut it into its
parts.

translation.text: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.

verses.english:
And he shall flay the burnt offering and cut it into its
parts.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן אֵשׁ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְעָרְכוּ עֵצִים עַל הָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתְנוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן אֵשׁ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְעָרְכוּ עֵצִים עַל הָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
And the sons of Aaron, the priest, shall put fire on the
altar and arrange wood on the fire.

translation.text: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:

verses.english:
And the sons of Aaron, the priest, shall put fire on the
altar and arrange wood on the fire.

verses.hebrew: וְעָרְכוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים אֵת הַנְּתָחִים אֶת הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת הַפָּדֶר עַל הָעֵצִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָרְכוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים אֵת הַנְּתָחִים אֶת הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת הַפָּדֶר עַל הָעֵצִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall arrange the
parts, the head, and the suet on the wood that is on the
fire that is on the altar.

translation.text: And the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

verses.english:
And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall arrange the
parts, the head, and the suet on the wood that is on the
fire that is on the altar.

verses.hebrew: וְקִרְבּוֹ וּכְרָעָיו יִרְחַץ בַּמָּיִם וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַכֹּל הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחוֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְקִרְבּוֹ וּכְרָעָיו יִרְחַץ בַּמָּיִם וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַכֹּל הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחוֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. And
the priest shall burn it all to smoke at the altar, a
burnt offering, an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to
YHWH.

translation.text: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. And
the priest shall burn it all to smoke at the altar, a
burnt offering, an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to
YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִן הַצֹּאן קרְבָּנוֹ מִן הַכְּשָׂבִים אוֹ מִן הָעִזִּים לְעֹלָה זָכָר תָּמִים יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מִן הַצֹּאן קרְבָּנוֹ מִן הַכְּשָׂבִים אוֹ מִן הָעִזִּים לְעֹלָה זָכָר תָּמִים יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
“And if his offering is from the flock—from the sheep or
from the goats—for a burnt offering, he shall make it an
unblemished male.

translation.text: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.

verses.english:
“And if his offering is from the flock—from the sheep or
from the goats—for a burnt offering, he shall make it an
unblemished male.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַט אֹתוֹ עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ צָפֹנָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְזָרְקוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת דָּמוֹ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁחַט אֹתוֹ עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ צָפֹנָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְזָרְקוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת דָּמוֹ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And he shall slaughter it on the northward side of the
altar in front of YHWH. And the sons of Aaron, the
priests, shall fling its blood on the altar, all around.

translation.text: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.

verses.english:
And he shall slaughter it on the northward side of the
altar in front of YHWH. And the sons of Aaron, the
priests, shall fling its blood on the altar, all around.

verses.hebrew: וְנִתַּח אֹתוֹ לִנְתָחָיו וְאֶת רֹאשׁוֹ וְאֶת פִּדְרוֹ וְעָרַךְ הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם עַל הָעֵצִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְנִתַּח אֹתוֹ לִנְתָחָיו וְאֶת רֹאשׁוֹ וְאֶת פִּדְרוֹ וְעָרַךְ הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם עַל הָעֵצִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And he shall cut it into its parts and its head and its
suet. And the priest shall arrange them on the wood that
is on the fire that is on the altar.

translation.text: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

verses.english:
And he shall cut it into its parts and its head and its
suet. And the priest shall arrange them on the wood that
is on the fire that is on the altar.

verses.hebrew: וְהַקֶּרֶב וְהַכְּרָעַיִם יִרְחַץ בַּמָּיִם וְהִקְרִיב הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַכֹּל וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה הוּא אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַקֶּרֶב וְהַכְּרָעַיִם יִרְחַץ בַּמָּיִם וְהִקְרִיב הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַכֹּל וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה הוּא אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he shall wash the innards and the legs with water. And
the priest shall bring it all forward and burn it to smoke
at the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering by fire
of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And he shall wash the innards and the legs with water. And
the priest shall bring it all forward and burn it to smoke
at the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering by fire
of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִן הָעוֹף עֹלָה קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה וְהִקְרִיב מִן הַתֹּרִים אוֹ מִן בְּנֵי הַיּוֹנָה אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מִן הָעוֹף עֹלָה קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה וְהִקְרִיב מִן הַתֹּרִים אוֹ מִן בְּנֵי הַיּוֹנָה אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ׃

english.text:
“And if his offering to YHWH is a burnt offering from
birds, then he shall make his offering from turtledoves or
from pigeons.

translation.text: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.

verses.english:
“And if his offering to YHWH is a burnt offering from
birds, then he shall make his offering from turtledoves or
from pigeons.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיבוֹ הַכֹּהֵן אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמָלַק אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְנִמְצָה דָמוֹ עַל קִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיבוֹ הַכֹּהֵן אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמָלַק אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְנִמְצָה דָמוֹ עַל קִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall bring it forward to the altar and
wring its head and burn it to smoke at the altar, and its
blood shall be drained on the wall of the altar.

translation.text: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:

verses.english:
And the priest shall bring it forward to the altar and
wring its head and burn it to smoke at the altar, and its
blood shall be drained on the wall of the altar.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵסִיר אֶת מֻרְאָתוֹ בְּנֹצָתָהּ וְהִשְׁלִיךְ אֹתָהּ אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ קֵדְמָה אֶל מְקוֹם הַדָּשֶׁן׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵסִיר אֶת מֻרְאָתוֹ בְּנֹצָתָהּ וְהִשְׁלִיךְ אֹתָהּ אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ קֵדְמָה אֶל מְקוֹם הַדָּשֶׁן׃

english.text:
And he shall take away its crop with its feathers and
throw it beside the altar eastward to the place of the
ashes.

translation.text: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:

verses.english:
And he shall take away its crop with its feathers and
throw it beside the altar eastward to the place of the
ashes.

verses.hebrew: וְשִׁסַּע אֹתוֹ בִכְנָפָיו לֹא יַבְדִּיל וְהִקְטִיר אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל הָעֵצִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאֵשׁ עֹלָה הוּא אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְשִׁסַּע אֹתוֹ בִכְנָפָיו לֹא יַבְדִּיל וְהִקְטִיר אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל הָעֵצִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאֵשׁ עֹלָה הוּא אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he shall tear it open by its wings—he shall not divide
it—and the priest shall burn it to smoke at the altar on
the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an
offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And he shall tear it open by its wings—he shall not divide
it—and the priest shall burn it to smoke at the altar on
the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an
offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תַקְרִיב קרְבַּן מִנְחָה לַיהֹוָה סֹלֶת יִהְיֶה קרְבָּנוֹ וְיָצַק עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן וְנָתַן עָלֶיהָ לְבֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תַקְרִיב קרְבַּן מִנְחָה לַיהֹוָה סֹלֶת יִהְיֶה קרְבָּנוֹ וְיָצַק עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן וְנָתַן עָלֶיהָ לְבֹנָה׃

english.text:
“And a person who will make an offering of a grain
offering to YHWH, his offering shall be of fine flour, and
he shall pour oil on it and put frankincense on it.

translation.text: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:

verses.english:
“And a person who will make an offering of a grain
offering to YHWH, his offering shall be of fine flour, and
he shall pour oil on it and put frankincense on it.

verses.hebrew: וֶהֱבִיאָהּ אֶל בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים וְקָמַץ מִשָּׁם מְלֹא קֻמְצוֹ מִסּלְתָּהּ וּמִשַּׁמְנָהּ עַל כּל לְבֹנָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וֶהֱבִיאָהּ אֶל בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים וְקָמַץ מִשָּׁם מְלֹא קֻמְצוֹ מִסּלְתָּהּ וּמִשַּׁמְנָהּ עַל כּל לְבֹנָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he shall bring it to the sons of Aaron, the priests.
And he shall take the fill of his fist from there: from
its fine flour and from its oil in addition to all of its
frankincense. And the priest shall burn a representative
portion of it to smoke at the altar, an offering by fire
of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: And he shall bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD:

verses.english:
And he shall bring it to the sons of Aaron, the priests.
And he shall take the fill of his fist from there: from
its fine flour and from its oil in addition to all of its
frankincense. And the priest shall burn a representative
portion of it to smoke at the altar, an offering by fire
of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִן הַמִּנְחָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִן הַמִּנְחָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the remainder from the grain offering is Aaron’s and
his sons’, the holy of holies from YHWH’s offerings by
fire.

translation.text: And the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

verses.english:
And the remainder from the grain offering is Aaron’s and
his sons’, the holy of holies from YHWH’s offerings by
fire.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי תַקְרִב קרְבַּן מִנְחָה מַאֲפֵה תַנּוּר סֹלֶת חַלּוֹת מַצֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תַקְרִב קרְבַּן מִנְחָה מַאֲפֵה תַנּוּר סֹלֶת חַלּוֹת מַצֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן׃

english.text:
“And if he will make an offering of an oven-baked grain
offering: fine flour, unleavened cakes mixed with oil and
unleavened wafers with oil poured on them.

translation.text: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

verses.english:
“And if he will make an offering of an oven-baked grain
offering: fine flour, unleavened cakes mixed with oil and
unleavened wafers with oil poured on them.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִנְחָה עַל הַמַּחֲבַת קרְבָּנֶךָ סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן מַצָּה תִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מִנְחָה עַל הַמַּחֲבַת קרְבָּנֶךָ סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן מַצָּה תִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
“And if your offering is a grain offering on a griddle, it
shall be fine flour, mixed with oil, unleavened.

translation.text: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.

verses.english:
“And if your offering is a grain offering on a griddle, it
shall be fine flour, mixed with oil, unleavened.

verses.hebrew: פָּתוֹת אֹתָהּ פִּתִּים וְיָצַקְתָּ עָלֶיהָ שָׁמֶן מִנְחָה הִוא׃

hebrew.text: פָּתוֹת אֹתָהּ פִּתִּים וְיָצַקְתָּ עָלֶיהָ שָׁמֶן מִנְחָה הִוא׃

english.text:
Break it into pieces and pour oil on it. It is a grain
offering.

translation.text: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.

verses.english:
Break it into pieces and pour oil on it. It is a grain
offering.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִנְחַת מַרְחֶשֶׁת קרְבָּנֶךָ סֹלֶת בַּשֶּׁמֶן תֵּעָשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מִנְחַת מַרְחֶשֶׁת קרְבָּנֶךָ סֹלֶת בַּשֶּׁמֶן תֵּעָשֶׂה׃

english.text:
“And if your offering is a grain offering from a pan, it
shall be made of fine flour in oil.

translation.text: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

verses.english:
“And if your offering is a grain offering from a pan, it
shall be made of fine flour in oil.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַמִּנְחָה אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה מֵאֵלֶּה לַיהֹוָה וְהִקְרִיבָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְהִגִּישָׁהּ אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַמִּנְחָה אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה מֵאֵלֶּה לַיהֹוָה וְהִקְרִיבָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְהִגִּישָׁהּ אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
“And you shall bring the grain offering that one will make
from these things to YHWH, and one shall bring it forward
to the priest, and he shall bring it over to the altar.

translation.text: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the LORD: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.

verses.english:
“And you shall bring the grain offering that one will make
from these things to YHWH, and one shall bring it forward
to the priest, and he shall bring it over to the altar.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵרִים הַכֹּהֵן מִן הַמִּנְחָה אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵרִים הַכֹּהֵן מִן הַמִּנְחָה אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the priest shall lift from the grain offering a
representative portion of it and burn it to smoke at the
altar, an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And the priest shall lift from the grain offering a
representative portion of it and burn it to smoke at the
altar, an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִן הַמִּנְחָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִן הַמִּנְחָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the remainder from the grain offering is Aaron’s and
his sons’, the holy of holies from YHWH’s offerings by
fire.

translation.text: And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

verses.english:
And the remainder from the grain offering is Aaron’s and
his sons’, the holy of holies from YHWH’s offerings by
fire.

verses.hebrew: כּל הַמִּנְחָה אֲשֶׁר תַּקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה לֹא תֵעָשֶׂה חָמֵץ כִּי כל שְׂאֹר וְכל דְּבַשׁ לֹא תַקְטִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַמִּנְחָה אֲשֶׁר תַּקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה לֹא תֵעָשֶׂה חָמֵץ כִּי כל שְׂאֹר וְכל דְּבַשׁ לֹא תַקְטִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Every grain offering that you will bring forward to YHWH
shall not be made with leavening, because all leaven and
all honey: you shall not burn any of it to smoke as an
offering by fire to YHWH.

translation.text: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.

verses.english:
Every grain offering that you will bring forward to YHWH
shall not be made with leavening, because all leaven and
all honey: you shall not burn any of it to smoke as an
offering by fire to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: קרְבַּן רֵאשִׁית תַּקְרִיבוּ אֹתָם לַיהֹוָה וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יַעֲלוּ לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ׃

hebrew.text: קרְבַּן רֵאשִׁית תַּקְרִיבוּ אֹתָם לַיהֹוָה וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יַעֲלוּ לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ׃

english.text:
You shall bring them forward to YHWH as an offering of a
first thing, but they shall not go up to the altar as a
pleasant smell.

translation.text: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.

verses.english:
You shall bring them forward to YHWH as an offering of a
first thing, but they shall not go up to the altar as a
pleasant smell.

verses.hebrew: וְכל קרְבַּן מִנְחָתְךָ בַּמֶּלַח תִּמְלָח וְלֹא תַשְׁבִּית מֶלַח בְּרִית אֱלֹהֶיךָ מֵעַל מִנְחָתֶךָ עַל כּל קרְבָּנְךָ תַּקְרִיב מֶלַח׃

hebrew.text: וְכל קרְבַּן מִנְחָתְךָ בַּמֶּלַח תִּמְלָח וְלֹא תַשְׁבִּית מֶלַח בְּרִית אֱלֹהֶיךָ מֵעַל מִנְחָתֶךָ עַל כּל קרְבָּנְךָ תַּקְרִיב מֶלַח׃

english.text:
And you shall sprinkle every offering of a grain offering
with salt. And you shall not let the salt of your God’s
covenant cease from on your grain offering; you shall
bring salt on all your offerings.

translation.text: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.

verses.english:
And you shall sprinkle every offering of a grain offering
with salt. And you shall not let the salt of your God’s
covenant cease from on your grain offering; you shall
bring salt on all your offerings.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם תַּקְרִיב מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרִים לַיהֹוָה אָבִיב קָלוּי בָּאֵשׁ גֶּרֶשׂ כַּרְמֶל תַּקְרִיב אֵת מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם תַּקְרִיב מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרִים לַיהֹוָה אָבִיב קָלוּי בָּאֵשׁ גֶּרֶשׂ כַּרְמֶל תַּקְרִיב אֵת מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרֶיךָ׃

english.text:
“And if you will bring a grain offering of firstfruits to
YHWH, you shall bring the grain offering of your
firstfruits ripe, parched with fire, groats of fresh
grain.

translation.text: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.

verses.english:
“And if you will bring a grain offering of firstfruits to
YHWH, you shall bring the grain offering of your
firstfruits ripe, parched with fire, groats of fresh
grain.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן וְשַׂמְתָּ עָלֶיהָ לְבֹנָה מִנְחָה הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּ עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן וְשַׂמְתָּ עָלֶיהָ לְבֹנָה מִנְחָה הִוא׃

english.text:
And you shall put oil on it and set frankincense on it. It
is a grain offering.

translation.text: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.

verses.english:
And you shall put oil on it and set frankincense on it. It
is a grain offering.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ מִגִּרְשָׂהּ וּמִשַּׁמְנָהּ עַל כּל לְבֹנָתָהּ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ מִגִּרְשָׂהּ וּמִשַּׁמְנָהּ עַל כּל לְבֹנָתָהּ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the priest shall burn a representative portion of it
to smoke, from its groats and from its oil, in addition to
all of its frankincense, an offering by fire to YHWH.

translation.text: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And the priest shall burn a representative portion of it
to smoke, from its groats and from its oil, in addition to
all of its frankincense, an offering by fire to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים קרְבָּנוֹ אִם מִן הַבָּקָר הוּא מַקְרִיב אִם זָכָר אִם נְקֵבָה תָּמִים יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים קרְבָּנוֹ אִם מִן הַבָּקָר הוּא מַקְרִיב אִם זָכָר אִם נְקֵבָה תָּמִים יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“And if his offering is a peace-offering sacrifice, if
he is offering from the herd, whether male or female, he
shall make it unblemished in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer it of the herd; whether it be a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.

verses.english:
“And if his offering is a peace-offering sacrifice, if
he is offering from the herd, whether male or female, he
shall make it unblemished in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְסָמַךְ יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ קרְבָּנוֹ וּשְׁחָטוֹ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְזָרְקוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְסָמַךְ יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ קרְבָּנוֹ וּשְׁחָטוֹ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְזָרְקוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering and
slaughter it at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting. And
the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall fling the blood on
the altar all around.

translation.text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

verses.english:
And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering and
slaughter it at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting. And
the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall fling the blood on
the altar all around.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב מִזֶּבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה אֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמְכַסֶּה אֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב מִזֶּבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה אֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמְכַסֶּה אֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב׃

english.text:
And he shall bring forward from the peace-offering
sacrifice an offering by fire to YHWH: the fat that overs
the innards and all the fat that is on the innards

translation.text: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

verses.english:
And he shall bring forward from the peace-offering
sacrifice an offering by fire to YHWH: the fat that overs
the innards and all the fat that is on the innards

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיוֹת יְסִירֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיוֹת יְסִירֶנָּה׃

english.text:
and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that is
on the loins; and the lobe on the liver: he shall take it
away with the kidneys.

translation.text: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

verses.english:
and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that is
on the loins; and the lobe on the liver: he shall take it
away with the kidneys.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְטִירוּ אֹתוֹ בְנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל הָעֹלָה אֲשֶׁר עַל הָעֵצִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאֵשׁ אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְטִירוּ אֹתוֹ בְנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל הָעֹלָה אֲשֶׁר עַל הָעֵצִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאֵשׁ אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the sons of Aaron shall burn it to smoke at the altar
upon the burnt offering that is on the wood that is on the
fire, an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: And Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And the sons of Aaron shall burn it to smoke at the altar
upon the burnt offering that is on the wood that is on the
fire, an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִן הַצֹּאן קרְבָּנוֹ לְזֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה זָכָר אוֹ נְקֵבָה תָּמִים יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מִן הַצֹּאן קרְבָּנוֹ לְזֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה זָכָר אוֹ נְקֵבָה תָּמִים יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
“And if his offering as a peace-offering sacrifice to YHWH
is from the flock, male or female, he shall make it
unblemished.

translation.text: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the LORD be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.

verses.english:
“And if his offering as a peace-offering sacrifice to YHWH
is from the flock, male or female, he shall make it
unblemished.

verses.hebrew: אִם כֶּשֶׂב הוּא מַקְרִיב אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ וְהִקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אִם כֶּשֶׂב הוּא מַקְרִיב אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ וְהִקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
If he is making his offering a sheep, then he shall bring
it forward in front of YHWH

translation.text: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD.

verses.english:
If he is making his offering a sheep, then he shall bring
it forward in front of YHWH

verses.hebrew: וְסָמַךְ אֶת יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ קרְבָּנוֹ וְשָׁחַט אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְזָרְקוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֶת דָּמוֹ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְסָמַךְ אֶת יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ קרְבָּנוֹ וְשָׁחַט אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְזָרְקוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֶת דָּמוֹ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
and lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter
it in front of the Tent of Meeting. And the sons of Aaron
shall fling its blood on the altar all around.

translation.text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.

verses.english:
and lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter
it in front of the Tent of Meeting. And the sons of Aaron
shall fling its blood on the altar all around.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב מִזֶּבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה חֶלְבּוֹ הָאַלְיָה תְמִימָה לְעֻמַּת הֶעָצֶה יְסִירֶנָּה וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמְכַסֶּה אֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב מִזֶּבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה חֶלְבּוֹ הָאַלְיָה תְמִימָה לְעֻמַּת הֶעָצֶה יְסִירֶנָּה וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמְכַסֶּה אֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב׃

english.text:
And he shall bring forward from the peace-offering
sacrifice an offering by fire to YHWH: its fat, the entire
fat tail—he shall take it away from the backbone—and the
fat that covers the innards and all the fat that is on the
innards

translation.text: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat thereof, and the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

verses.english:
And he shall bring forward from the peace-offering
sacrifice an offering by fire to YHWH: its fat, the entire
fat tail—he shall take it away from the backbone—and the
fat that covers the innards and all the fat that is on the
innards

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיֹת יְסִירֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיֹת יְסִירֶנָּה׃

english.text:
and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that is
on the loins; and the lobe on the liver: he shall take it
away with the kidneys.

translation.text: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

verses.english:
and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that is
on the loins; and the lobe on the liver: he shall take it
away with the kidneys.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְטִירוֹ הַכֹּהֵן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה לֶחֶם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְטִירוֹ הַכֹּהֵן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה לֶחֶם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the priest shall burn it to smoke at the altar: food,
an offering by fire to YHWH.

translation.text: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And the priest shall burn it to smoke at the altar: food,
an offering by fire to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם עֵז קרְבָּנוֹ וְהִקְרִיבוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that is

And the priest shall burn them to smoke at the altar:
food, an offering by fire as a pleasant smell. All fat is

“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: A person who
sins by mistake—of any of YHWH’s commandments that are not

translation.text: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.

verses.english:
“If the anointed priest will sin, causing the people’s

pure place, to the place where ash is spilled, and burn it
on wood in fire. It shall be burned at the place where ash
is spilled.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם כּל עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל יִשְׁגּוּ וְנֶעְלַם דָּבָר מֵעֵינֵי הַקָּהָל וְעָשׂוּ אַחַת מִכּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂינָה וְאָשֵׁמוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם כּל עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל יִשְׁגּוּ וְנֶעְלַם דָּבָר מֵעֵינֵי הַקָּהָל וְעָשׂוּ אַחַת מִכּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂינָה וְאָשֵׁמוּ׃

english.text:
“And if all the congregation of Israel will make a
mistake, and something will be hidden from the community’s
eyes, and they do one of any of YHWH’s commandments that
are not to be done, and they are guilty,

translation.text: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;

verses.english:
“And if all the congregation of Israel will make a
mistake, and something will be hidden from the community’s
eyes, and they do one of any of YHWH’s commandments that
are not to be done, and they are guilty,

verses.hebrew: וְנוֹדְעָה הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר חָטְאוּ עָלֶיהָ וְהִקְרִיבוּ הַקָּהָל פַּר בֶּן בָּקָר לְחַטָּאת וְהֵבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְנוֹדְעָה הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר חָטְאוּ עָלֶיהָ וְהִקְרִיבוּ הַקָּהָל פַּר בֶּן בָּקָר לְחַטָּאת וְהֵבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
and the sin over which they have sinned will become known,
then the community shall bring forward a bull of the
cattle as a sin offering, and they shall bring it in front
of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.english:
and the sin over which they have sinned will become known,
then the community shall bring forward a bull of the
cattle as a sin offering, and they shall bring it in front
of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וְסָמְכוּ זִקְנֵי הָעֵדָה אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הַפָּר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַפָּר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְסָמְכוּ זִקְנֵי הָעֵדָה אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הַפָּר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַפָּר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the community’s elders shall lay their hands on the
bull’s head in front of YHWH, and he shall slaughter the
bull in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD: and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD.

verses.english:
And the community’s elders shall lay their hands on the
bull’s head in front of YHWH, and he shall slaughter the
bull in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵבִיא הַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ מִדַּם הַפָּר אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבִיא הַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ מִדַּם הַפָּר אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And the anointed priest shall bring some of the bull’s
blood to the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock’s blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:

verses.english:
And the anointed priest shall bring some of the bull’s
blood to the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וְטָבַל הַכֹּהֵן אֶצְבָּעוֹ מִן הַדָּם וְהִזָּה שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֵת פְּנֵי הַפָּרֹכֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְטָבַל הַכֹּהֵן אֶצְבָּעוֹ מִן הַדָּם וְהִזָּה שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֵת פְּנֵי הַפָּרֹכֶת׃

english.text:
And the priest shall dip his finger from the blood and
sprinkle seven times in front of YHWH before the pavilion.

translation.text: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, even before the vail.

verses.english:
And the priest shall dip his finger from the blood and
sprinkle seven times in front of YHWH before the pavilion.

verses.hebrew: וּמִן הַדָּם יִתֵּן עַל קַרְנֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֵת כּל הַדָּם יִשְׁפֹּךְ אֶל יְסוֹד מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה אֲשֶׁר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וּמִן הַדָּם יִתֵּן עַל קַרְנֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֵת כּל הַדָּם יִשְׁפֹּךְ אֶל יְסוֹד מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה אֲשֶׁר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And he shall put some of the blood on the horns of the
altar that is in front of YHWH, that is in the Tent of
Meeting, and he shall spill all of the blood at the base
of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the entrance
of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.english:
And he shall put some of the blood on the horns of the
altar that is in front of YHWH, that is in the Tent of
Meeting, and he shall spill all of the blood at the base
of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the entrance
of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כּל חֶלְבּוֹ יָרִים מִמֶּנּוּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת כּל חֶלְבּוֹ יָרִים מִמֶּנּוּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

english.text:
And he shall take off all of its fat from it and burn it
to smoke at the altar.

translation.text: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.

verses.english:
And he shall take off all of its fat from it and burn it
to smoke at the altar.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה לַפָּר כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְפַר הַחַטָּאת כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה לּוֹ וְכִפֶּר עֲלֵהֶם הַכֹּהֵן וְנִסְלַח לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשָׂה לַפָּר כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְפַר הַחַטָּאת כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה לּוֹ וְכִפֶּר עֲלֵהֶם הַכֹּהֵן וְנִסְלַח לָהֶם׃

english.text:
And he shall do to the bull as he did to the bull of the
sin offering. So he shall do to it. And the priest shall
make atonement over them, and it will be forgiven for
them.

translation.text: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.

verses.english:
And he shall do to the bull as he did to the bull of the
sin offering. So he shall do to it. And the priest shall
make atonement over them, and it will be forgiven for
them.

verses.hebrew: וְהוֹצִיא אֶת הַפָּר אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְשָׂרַף אֹתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׂרַף אֵת הַפָּר הָרִאשׁוֹן חַטַּאת הַקָּהָל הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹצִיא אֶת הַפָּר אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְשָׂרַף אֹתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׂרַף אֵת הַפָּר הָרִאשׁוֹן חַטַּאת הַקָּהָל הוּא׃

english.text:
And he shall bring the bull outside the camp and burn it
as he burned the first bull. It is the community’s sin
offering.

translation.text: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.

verses.english:
And he shall bring the bull outside the camp and burn it
as he burned the first bull. It is the community’s sin
offering.

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר נָשִׂיא יֶחֱטָא וְעָשָׂה אַחַת מִכּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂינָה בִּשְׁגָגָה וְאָשֵׁם׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר נָשִׂיא יֶחֱטָא וְעָשָׂה אַחַת מִכּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂינָה בִּשְׁגָגָה וְאָשֵׁם׃

english.text:
“When a chieftain will sin and do one of any of the
commandments of YHWH, his God, that are not to be done, by
mistake, and he is guilty,

translation.text: When a ruler hath sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD his God concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;

verses.english:
“When a chieftain will sin and do one of any of the
commandments of YHWH, his God, that are not to be done, by
mistake, and he is guilty,

verses.hebrew: אוֹ הוֹדַע אֵלָיו חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא בָּהּ וְהֵבִיא אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים זָכָר תָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ הוֹדַע אֵלָיו חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא בָּהּ וְהֵבִיא אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים זָכָר תָּמִים׃

english.text:
or his sin by which he has sinned has been made known to
him, then he shall bring his offering, a goat, male,
unblemished.

translation.text: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:

verses.english:
or his sin by which he has sinned has been made known to
him, then he shall bring his offering, a goat, male,
unblemished.

verses.hebrew: וְסָמַךְ יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר וְשָׁחַט אֹתוֹ בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט אֶת הָעֹלָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה חַטָּאת הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְסָמַךְ יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר וְשָׁחַט אֹתוֹ בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט אֶת הָעֹלָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה חַטָּאת הוּא׃

english.text:
And he shall lay his hand on the goat’s head and slaughter
it at the place where he would slaughter a burnt offering
in front of YHWH. It is a sin offering.

translation.text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD: it is a sin offering.

verses.english:
And he shall lay his hand on the goat’s head and slaughter
it at the place where he would slaughter a burnt offering
in front of YHWH. It is a sin offering.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִדַּם הַחַטָּאת בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ וְנָתַן עַל קַרְנֹת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה וְאֶת דָּמוֹ יִשְׁפֹּךְ אֶל יְסוֹד מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִדַּם הַחַטָּאת בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ וְנָתַן עַל קַרְנֹת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה וְאֶת דָּמוֹ יִשְׁפֹּךְ אֶל יְסוֹד מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה׃

english.text:
And the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin
offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the
altar of burnt offering, and he shall spill its blood at
the base of the altar of burnt offering.

translation.text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.

verses.english:
And the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin
offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the
altar of burnt offering, and he shall spill its blood at
the base of the altar of burnt offering.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת כּל חֶלְבּוֹ יַקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה כְּחֵלֶב זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן מֵחַטָּאתוֹ וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת כּל חֶלְבּוֹ יַקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה כְּחֵלֶב זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן מֵחַטָּאתוֹ וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

english.text:
And he shall burn all its fat to smoke at the altar like
the fat of the peace-offering sacrifice. And the priest
shall make atonement over him from his sin, and it will be
forgiven for him.

translation.text: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.

verses.english:
And he shall burn all its fat to smoke at the altar like
the fat of the peace-offering sacrifice. And the priest
shall make atonement over him from his sin, and it will be
forgiven for him.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם נֶפֶשׁ אַחַת תֶּחֱטָא בִשְׁגָגָה מֵעַם הָאָרֶץ בַּעֲשֹׂתָהּ אַחַת מִמִּצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂינָה וְאָשֵׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם נֶפֶשׁ אַחַת תֶּחֱטָא בִשְׁגָגָה מֵעַם הָאָרֶץ בַּעֲשֹׂתָהּ אַחַת מִמִּצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂינָה וְאָשֵׁם׃

english.text:
“And if one person from the people of the land will sin by
mistake by doing one of YHWH’s commandments that are not
to be done and is guilty,

translation.text: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;

verses.english:
“And if one person from the people of the land will sin by
mistake by doing one of YHWH’s commandments that are not
to be done and is guilty,

verses.hebrew: אוֹ הוֹדַע אֵלָיו חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְהֵבִיא קרְבָּנוֹ שְׂעִירַת עִזִּים תְּמִימָה נְקֵבָה עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ הוֹדַע אֵלָיו חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְהֵבִיא קרְבָּנוֹ שְׂעִירַת עִזִּים תְּמִימָה נְקֵבָה עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא׃

english.text:
or his sin that he has committed has been made known to
him, then he shall bring his offering, a goat,
unblemished, female, for his sin that he committed.

translation.text: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.

verses.english:
or his sin that he has committed has been made known to
him, then he shall bring his offering, a goat,
unblemished, female, for his sin that he committed.

verses.hebrew: וְסָמַךְ אֶת יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ הַחַטָּאת וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַחַטָּאת בִּמְקוֹם הָעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְסָמַךְ אֶת יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ הַחַטָּאת וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַחַטָּאת בִּמְקוֹם הָעֹלָה׃

english.text:
And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering
and slaughter the sin offering at the place of burnt
offering.

translation.text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.

verses.english:
And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering
and slaughter the sin offering at the place of burnt
offering.

finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt
offering, and he shall spill all its blood at the base of
the altar.

And the priest shall take some of its blood with his

hebrew.text: וְאֶת כּל חֶלְבָּהּ יָסִיר כַּאֲשֶׁר הוּסַר חֵלֶב מֵעַל זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

english.text:
And he shall take away all of its fat as the fat was taken
away from on the peace-offering sacrifice, and the priest
shall burn it to smoke at the altar as a pleasant smell to
YHWH, and the priest shall make atonement over him, and it
will be forgiven for him.

translation.text: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

And he shall take away all of its fat as the fat was taken

will be forgiven for him.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם כֶּבֶשׂ יָבִיא קרְבָּנוֹ לְחַטָּאת נְקֵבָה תְמִימָה יְבִיאֶנָּה׃

english.text:
“And if he will bring a lamb as his offering for a sin
offering, he shall bring a female, unblemished.

translation.text: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.

verses.english:
“And if he will bring a lamb as his offering for a sin
offering, he shall bring a female, unblemished.
