hebrew.text: וְסָמַךְ אֶת יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ הַחַטָּאת וְשָׁחַט אֹתָהּ לְחַטָּאת בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט אֶת הָעֹלָה׃

english.text:
And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering
and slaughter it as a sin offering at the place where he
would slaughter a burnt offering.

translation.text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

verses.english:
And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering
and slaughter it as a sin offering at the place where he
would slaughter a burnt offering.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִדַּם הַחַטָּאת בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ וְנָתַן עַל קַרְנֹת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה וְאֶת כּל דָּמָהּ יִשְׁפֹּךְ אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִדַּם הַחַטָּאת בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ וְנָתַן עַל קַרְנֹת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה וְאֶת כּל דָּמָהּ יִשְׁפֹּךְ אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin
offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the
altar of burnt offering, and he shall spill all its blood
at the base of the altar.

translation.text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:

verses.english:
And the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin
offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the
altar of burnt offering, and he shall spill all its blood
at the base of the altar.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת כּל חֶלְבָּהּ יָסִיר כַּאֲשֶׁר יוּסַר חֵלֶב הַכֶּשֶׂב מִזֶּבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת כּל חֶלְבָּהּ יָסִיר כַּאֲשֶׁר יוּסַר חֵלֶב הַכֶּשֶׂב מִזֶּבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

english.text:
And he shall take away all of its fat as the sheep’s fat
was taken away from the peace-offering sacrifice, and the
priest shall burn them to smoke at the altar with YHWH’s
offerings by fire, and the priest shall make atonement
over him, over his sin that he committed, and it will be
forgiven for him.

translation.text: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.

verses.english:
And he shall take away all of its fat as the sheep’s fat
was taken away from the peace-offering sacrifice, and the
priest shall burn them to smoke at the altar with YHWH’s
offerings by fire, and the priest shall make atonement
over him, over his sin that he committed, and it will be
forgiven for him.

verses.hebrew: וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא וְשָׁמְעָה קוֹל אָלָה וְהוּא עֵד אוֹ רָאָה אוֹ יָדָע אִם לוֹא יַגִּיד וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא וְשָׁמְעָה קוֹל אָלָה וְהוּא עֵד אוֹ רָאָה אוֹ יָדָע אִם לוֹא יַגִּיד וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ׃

english.text:
“And a person who will sin in that he has heard a
pronouncement of an oath, and he was a witness—whether he
saw or he knew: if he will not tell, then he shall bear
his crime.

translation.text: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

verses.english:
“And a person who will sin in that he has heard a
pronouncement of an oath, and he was a witness—whether he
saw or he knew: if he will not tell, then he shall bear
his crime.

verses.hebrew: אוֹ נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּגַּע בְּכל דָּבָר טָמֵא אוֹ בְנִבְלַת חַיָּה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּנִבְלַת בְּהֵמָה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּנִבְלַת שֶׁרֶץ טָמֵא וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא טָמֵא וְאָשֵׁם׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּגַּע בְּכל דָּבָר טָמֵא אוֹ בְנִבְלַת חַיָּה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּנִבְלַת בְּהֵמָה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּנִבְלַת שֶׁרֶץ טָמֵא וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא טָמֵא וְאָשֵׁם׃

english.text:
“Or a person who will touch any impure thing or the
carcass of an impure wild animal or the carcass of an
impure domestic animal or the carcass of an impure
swarming creature, and it was hidden from him, so he had
become impure and had become guilty;

translation.text: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and if it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.

verses.english:
“Or a person who will touch any impure thing or the
carcass of an impure wild animal or the carcass of an
impure domestic animal or the carcass of an impure
swarming creature, and it was hidden from him, so he had
become impure and had become guilty;

verses.hebrew: אוֹ כִי יִגַּע בְּטֻמְאַת אָדָם לְכֹל טֻמְאָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא בָּהּ וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ כִי יִגַּע בְּטֻמְאַת אָדָם לְכֹל טֻמְאָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא בָּהּ וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם׃

english.text:
or when he will touch a human’s impurity—for any impurity
of his through which he will become impure—and it was
hidden from him, and then he had come to know and had
become guilty;

translation.text: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty.

verses.english:
or when he will touch a human’s impurity—for any impurity
of his through which he will become impure—and it was
hidden from him, and then he had come to know and had
become guilty;

verses.hebrew: אוֹ נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִשָּׁבַע לְבַטֵּא בִשְׂפָתַיִם לְהָרַע אוֹ לְהֵיטִיב לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יְבַטֵּא הָאָדָם בִּשְׁבֻעָה וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם לְאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִשָּׁבַע לְבַטֵּא בִשְׂפָתַיִם לְהָרַע אוֹ לְהֵיטִיב לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יְבַטֵּא הָאָדָם בִּשְׁבֻעָה וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם לְאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
or a person who will swear so as to let out of his lips to
do bad or to do good—for anything that a human would let
out in an oath—and it was hidden from him, and then he had
come to know and had become guilty by one of these:

translation.text: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these.

verses.english:
or a person who will swear so as to let out of his lips to
do bad or to do good—for anything that a human would let
out in an oath—and it was hidden from him, and then he had
come to know and had become guilty by one of these:

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִי יֶאְשַׁם לְאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה וְהִתְוַדָּה אֲשֶׁר חָטָא עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִי יֶאְשַׁם לְאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה וְהִתְוַדָּה אֲשֶׁר חָטָא עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And it will be that when he becomes guilty by one of these
he shall confess that he has sinned over it,

translation.text: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things, that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing:

verses.english:
And it will be that when he becomes guilty by one of these
he shall confess that he has sinned over it,

verses.hebrew: וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ לַיהֹוָה עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא נְקֵבָה מִן הַצֹּאן כִּשְׂבָּה אוֹ שְׂעִירַת עִזִּים לְחַטָּאת וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן מֵחַטָּאתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ לַיהֹוָה עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא נְקֵבָה מִן הַצֹּאן כִּשְׂבָּה אוֹ שְׂעִירַת עִזִּים לְחַטָּאת וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן מֵחַטָּאתוֹ׃

english.text:
and he shall bring his guilt offering to YHWH over his sin
that he has committed: a female from the flock, a sheep or
a goat, as a sin offering, and the priest shall make
atonement over him from his sin.

translation.text: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.

verses.english:
and he shall bring his guilt offering to YHWH over his sin
that he has committed: a female from the flock, a sheep or
a goat, as a sin offering, and the priest shall make
atonement over him from his sin.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא תַגִּיעַ יָדוֹ דֵּי שֶׂה וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְנֵי יוֹנָה לַיהֹוָה אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וְאֶחָד לְעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא תַגִּיעַ יָדוֹ דֵּי שֶׂה וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְנֵי יוֹנָה לַיהֹוָה אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וְאֶחָד לְעֹלָה׃

english.text:
“And if his hand will not attain enough for a sheep, then
he shall bring as his guilt offering for having sinned two
turtledoves or two pigeons to YHWH: one for a sin offering
and one for a burnt offering.

translation.text: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto the LORD; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

verses.english:
“And if his hand will not attain enough for a sheep, then
he shall bring as his guilt offering for having sinned two
turtledoves or two pigeons to YHWH: one for a sin offering
and one for a burnt offering.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵבִיא אֹתָם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְהִקְרִיב אֶת אֲשֶׁר לַחַטָּאת רִאשׁוֹנָה וּמָלַק אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ מִמּוּל ערְפּוֹ וְלֹא יַבְדִּיל׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבִיא אֹתָם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְהִקְרִיב אֶת אֲשֶׁר לַחַטָּאת רִאשׁוֹנָה וּמָלַק אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ מִמּוּל ערְפּוֹ וְלֹא יַבְדִּיל׃

english.text:
And he shall bring them to the priest, and he shall bring
forward the one that is for the sin offering first and
will wring but not separate its head at the point opposite
its neck.

translation.text: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide it asunder:

verses.english:
And he shall bring them to the priest, and he shall bring
forward the one that is for the sin offering first and
will wring but not separate its head at the point opposite
its neck.

verses.hebrew: וְהִזָּה מִדַּם הַחַטָּאת עַל קִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהַנִּשְׁאָר בַּדָּם יִמָּצֵה אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ חַטָּאת הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְהִזָּה מִדַּם הַחַטָּאת עַל קִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהַנִּשְׁאָר בַּדָּם יִמָּצֵה אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ חַטָּאת הוּא׃

english.text:
And he shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin
offering on the wall of the altar, and what remains of the
blood shall be drained at the base of the altar. It is a
sin offering.

translation.text: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it is a sin offering.

verses.english:
And he shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin
offering on the wall of the altar, and what remains of the
blood shall be drained at the base of the altar. It is a
sin offering.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַשֵּׁנִי יַעֲשֶׂה עֹלָה כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן מֵחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַשֵּׁנִי יַעֲשֶׂה עֹלָה כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן מֵחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

english.text:
And he shall make the second one a burnt offering
according to the required manner. And the priest shall
make atonement over him from his sin that he committed,
and it shall be forgiven for him.

translation.text: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

verses.english:
And he shall make the second one a burnt offering
according to the required manner. And the priest shall
make atonement over him from his sin that he committed,
and it shall be forgiven for him.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא תַשִּׂיג יָדוֹ לִשְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ לִשְׁנֵי בְנֵי יוֹנָה וְהֵבִיא אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא עֲשִׂירִת הָאֵפָה סֹלֶת לְחַטָּאת לֹא יָשִׂים עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן וְלֹא יִתֵּן עָלֶיהָ לְבֹנָה כִּי חַטָּאת הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא תַשִּׂיג יָדוֹ לִשְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ לִשְׁנֵי בְנֵי יוֹנָה וְהֵבִיא אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא עֲשִׂירִת הָאֵפָה סֹלֶת לְחַטָּאת לֹא יָשִׂים עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן וְלֹא יִתֵּן עָלֶיהָ לְבֹנָה כִּי חַטָּאת הִוא׃

english.text:
“And if his hand cannot attain enough for two turtledoves
or two pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for
having sinned a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin
offering. He shall not set oil on it, and he shall not put
frankincense on it, because it is a sin offering.

translation.text: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.

verses.english:
“And if his hand cannot attain enough for two turtledoves
or two pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for
having sinned a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin
offering. He shall not set oil on it, and he shall not put
frankincense on it, because it is a sin offering.

verses.hebrew: וֶהֱבִיאָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְקָמַץ הַכֹּהֵן מִמֶּנָּה מְלוֹא קֻמְצוֹ אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה חַטָּאת הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וֶהֱבִיאָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְקָמַץ הַכֹּהֵן מִמֶּנָּה מְלוֹא קֻמְצוֹ אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה חַטָּאת הִוא׃

english.text:
And he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall
take the fill of his fist from it, a representative
portion of it, and he shall burn it to smoke at the altar
with YHWH’s offerings by fire. It is a sin offering.

translation.text: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: it is a sin offering.

verses.english:
And he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall
take the fill of his fist from it, a representative
portion of it, and he shall burn it to smoke at the altar
with YHWH’s offerings by fire. It is a sin offering.

verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא מֵאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה וְנִסְלַח לוֹ וְהָיְתָה לַכֹּהֵן כַּמִּנְחָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא מֵאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה וְנִסְלַח לוֹ וְהָיְתָה לַכֹּהֵן כַּמִּנְחָה׃

english.text:
And the priest shall make atonement over him, over his sin
that he committed, from one of these, and it shall be
forgiven for him. And it shall be the priest’s, like the
grain offering.”

translation.text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and the remnant shall be the priest’s, as a meat offering.

verses.english:
And the priest shall make atonement over him, over his sin
that he committed, from one of these, and it shall be
forgiven for him. And it shall be the priest’s, like the
grain offering.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִמְעֹל מַעַל וְחָטְאָה בִּשְׁגָגָה מִקּדְשֵׁי יְהֹוָה וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ לַיהֹוָה אַיִל תָּמִים מִן הַצֹּאן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ כֶּסֶף שְׁקָלִים בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְאָשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִמְעֹל מַעַל וְחָטְאָה בִּשְׁגָגָה מִקּדְשֵׁי יְהֹוָה וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ לַיהֹוָה אַיִל תָּמִים מִן הַצֹּאן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ כֶּסֶף שְׁקָלִים בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְאָשָׁם׃

english.text:
“A person who will make a breach and sin by mistake among
YHWH’s holy things: he shall bring his guilt offering to
YHWH, an unblemished ram from the flock by your evaluation
of silver by shekels, by the shekel of the Holy, as a
guilt offering.

translation.text: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the LORD; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.

verses.english:
“A person who will make a breach and sin by mistake among
YHWH’s holy things: he shall bring his guilt offering to
YHWH, an unblemished ram from the flock by your evaluation
of silver by shekels, by the shekel of the Holy, as a
guilt offering.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר חָטָא מִן הַקֹּדֶשׁ יְשַׁלֵּם וְאֶת חֲמִישִׁתוֹ יוֹסֵף עָלָיו וְנָתַן אֹתוֹ לַכֹּהֵן וְהַכֹּהֵן יְכַפֵּר עָלָיו בְּאֵיל הָאָשָׁם וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר חָטָא מִן הַקֹּדֶשׁ יְשַׁלֵּם וְאֶת חֲמִישִׁתוֹ יוֹסֵף עָלָיו וְנָתַן אֹתוֹ לַכֹּהֵן וְהַכֹּהֵן יְכַפֵּר עָלָיו בְּאֵיל הָאָשָׁם וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

english.text:
And for what he sinned from the Holy he shall pay and add
to it a fifth of it and give it to the priest, and the
priest shall make atonement over him with the ram of the
guilt offering, and it shall be forgiven for him.

translation.text: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.

verses.english:
And for what he sinned from the Holy he shall pay and add
to it a fifth of it and give it to the priest, and the
priest shall make atonement over him with the ram of the
guilt offering, and it shall be forgiven for him.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא וְעָשְׂתָה אַחַת מִכּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂינָה וְלֹא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא וְעָשְׂתָה אַחַת מִכּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂינָה וְלֹא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ׃

english.text:
“And if a person who will sin and commit one of any of
YHWH’s commandments that are not to be done and did not
know and became guilty, then he shall bear his crime.

translation.text: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the LORD; though he wist it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

verses.english:
“And if a person who will sin and commit one of any of
YHWH’s commandments that are not to be done and did not
know and became guilty, then he shall bear his crime.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵבִיא אַיִל תָּמִים מִן הַצֹּאן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ לְאָשָׁם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן עַל שִׁגְגָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר שָׁגָג וְהוּא לֹא יָדַע וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבִיא אַיִל תָּמִים מִן הַצֹּאן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ לְאָשָׁם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן עַל שִׁגְגָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר שָׁגָג וְהוּא לֹא יָדַע וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

english.text:
And he shall bring an unblemished ram from the flock by
your evaluation as a guilt offering to the priest, and the
priest shall make atonement over him, over his mistake
that he made and had not known, and it shall be forgiven
for him.

translation.text: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven him.

verses.english:
And he shall bring an unblemished ram from the flock by
your evaluation as a guilt offering to the priest, and the
priest shall make atonement over him, over his mistake
that he made and had not known, and it shall be forgiven
for him.

verses.hebrew: אָשָׁם הוּא אָשֹׁם אָשַׁם לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אָשָׁם הוּא אָשֹׁם אָשַׁם לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text: It is a guilt offering. He is guilty to YHWH.”

translation.text: It is a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the LORD.

verses.english: It is a guilt offering. He is guilty to YHWH.”

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא וּמָעֲלָה מַעַל בַּיהֹוָה וְכִחֵשׁ בַּעֲמִיתוֹ בְּפִקָּדוֹן אוֹ בִתְשׂוּמֶת יָד אוֹ בְגָזֵל אוֹ עָשַׁק אֶת עֲמִיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא וּמָעֲלָה מַעַל בַּיהֹוָה וְכִחֵשׁ בַּעֲמִיתוֹ בְּפִקָּדוֹן אוֹ בִתְשׂוּמֶת יָד אוֹ בְגָזֵל אוֹ עָשַׁק אֶת עֲמִיתוֹ׃

english.text:
“A person who will sin and make a breach against YHWH and
tell a lie against his fellow in a matter of a deposit or
something set in hand or by robbery, or has exploited his
fellow

verses.english:
“A person who will sin and make a breach against YHWH and
tell a lie against his fellow in a matter of a deposit or
something set in hand or by robbery, or has exploited his
fellow

verses.hebrew: אוֹ מָצָא אֲבֵדָה וְכִחֶשׁ בָּהּ וְנִשְׁבַּע עַל שָׁקֶר עַל אַחַת מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה הָאָדָם לַחֲטֹא בָהֵנָּה׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ מָצָא אֲבֵדָה וְכִחֶשׁ בָּהּ וְנִשְׁבַּע עַל שָׁקֶר עַל אַחַת מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה הָאָדָם לַחֲטֹא בָהֵנָּה׃

english.text:
or has found something that was lost and has lied about it
or sworn to a falsehood—for one of any of these that a
human will do to sin:

or has found something that was lost and has lied about it

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי יֶחֱטָא וְאָשֵׁם וְהֵשִׁיב אֶת הַגְּזֵלָה אֲשֶׁר גָּזָל אוֹ אֶת הָעֹשֶׁק אֲשֶׁר עָשָׁק אוֹ אֶת הַפִּקָּדוֹן אֲשֶׁר הפְקַד אִתּוֹ אוֹ אֶת הָאֲבֵדָה אֲשֶׁר מָצָא׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי יֶחֱטָא וְאָשֵׁם וְהֵשִׁיב אֶת הַגְּזֵלָה אֲשֶׁר גָּזָל אוֹ אֶת הָעֹשֶׁק אֲשֶׁר עָשָׁק אוֹ אֶת הַפִּקָּדוֹן אֲשֶׁר הפְקַד אִתּוֹ אוֹ אֶת הָאֲבֵדָה אֲשֶׁר מָצָא׃

it will be, when he sins and is guilty, that he shall

or anything about which he swore as a falsehood, and he

unblemished ram from the flock by your evaluation as a
guilt offering, to the priest.

verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְנִסְלַח לוֹ עַל אַחַת מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה לְאַשְׁמָה בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְנִסְלַח לוֹ עַל אַחַת מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה לְאַשְׁמָה בָהּ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall atone over him in front of YHWH, and
it will be forgiven for him, for any one out of all that
he will do to become guilty through it.”

verses.english:
And the priest shall atone over him in front of YHWH, and
it will be forgiven for him, for any one out of all that
he will do to become guilty through it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: צַו אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר זֹאת תּוֹרַת הָעֹלָה הִוא הָעֹלָה עַל מוֹקְדָה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כּל הַלַּיְלָה עַד הַבֹּקֶר וְאֵשׁ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ תּוּקַד בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: צַו אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר זֹאת תּוֹרַת הָעֹלָה הִוא הָעֹלָה עַל מוֹקְדָה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כּל הַלַּיְלָה עַד הַבֹּקֶר וְאֵשׁ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ תּוּקַד בּוֹ׃

english.text:
“Command Aaron and his sons, saying: This is the
instruction for the burnt offering. It is the one that
goes up on its place of burning on the altar all night
until morning, and the altar’s fire shall be kept burning
through it.

translation.text: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the LORD, and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;

verses.english:
“Command Aaron and his sons, saying: This is the
instruction for the burnt offering. It is the one that
goes up on its place of burning on the altar all night
until morning, and the altar’s fire shall be kept burning
through it.

verses.hebrew: וְלָבַשׁ הַכֹּהֵן מִדּוֹ בַד וּמִכְנְסֵי בַד יִלְבַּשׁ עַל בְּשָׂרוֹ וְהֵרִים אֶת הַדֶּשֶׁן אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל הָאֵשׁ אֶת הָעֹלָה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְשָׂמוֹ אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָבַשׁ הַכֹּהֵן מִדּוֹ בַד וּמִכְנְסֵי בַד יִלְבַּשׁ עַל בְּשָׂרוֹ וְהֵרִים אֶת הַדֶּשֶׁן אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל הָאֵשׁ אֶת הָעֹלָה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְשָׂמוֹ אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall wear his linen garment and shall wear
linen drawers on his flesh. And he shall lift the ashes to
which the fire will consume the burnt offering on the
altar, and he shall set them beside the altar.

translation.text: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:

verses.english:
And the priest shall wear his linen garment and shall wear
linen drawers on his flesh. And he shall lift the ashes to
which the fire will consume the burnt offering on the
altar, and he shall set them beside the altar.

verses.hebrew: וּפָשַׁט אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְלָבַשׁ בְּגָדִים אֲחֵרִים וְהוֹצִיא אֶת הַדֶּשֶׁן אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה אֶל מָקוֹם טָהוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וּפָשַׁט אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְלָבַשׁ בְּגָדִים אֲחֵרִים וְהוֹצִיא אֶת הַדֶּשֶׁן אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה אֶל מָקוֹם טָהוֹר׃

english.text:
And he shall take off his clothes and wear other clothes,
and he shall take the ashes outside the camp, to a pure
place.

translation.text: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,

verses.english:
And he shall take off his clothes and wear other clothes,
and he shall take the ashes outside the camp, to a pure
place.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֵשׁ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ תּוּקַד בּוֹ לֹא תִכְבֶּה וּבִעֵר עָלֶיהָ הַכֹּהֵן עֵצִים בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר וְעָרַךְ עָלֶיהָ הָעֹלָה וְהִקְטִיר עָלֶיהָ חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁלָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֵשׁ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ תּוּקַד בּוֹ לֹא תִכְבֶּה וּבִעֵר עָלֶיהָ הַכֹּהֵן עֵצִים בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר וְעָרַךְ עָלֶיהָ הָעֹלָה וְהִקְטִיר עָלֶיהָ חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁלָמִים׃

english.text:
And the fire on the altar shall be kept burning through
it. It shall not go out. And the priest shall burn wood on
it morning by morning, and he shall arrange the burnt
offering on it, and he shall burn the fat of the peace
offerings to smoke on it.

translation.text: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.

verses.english:
And the fire on the altar shall be kept burning through
it. It shall not go out. And the priest shall burn wood on
it morning by morning, and he shall arrange the burnt
offering on it, and he shall burn the fat of the peace
offerings to smoke on it.

verses.hebrew: אֵשׁ תָּמִיד תּוּקַד עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא תִכְבֶּה׃

hebrew.text: אֵשׁ תָּמִיד תּוּקַד עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא תִכְבֶּה׃

english.text:
Fire always shall be kept burning on the altar. It shall
not go out.

translation.text: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:

verses.english:
Fire always shall be kept burning on the altar. It shall
not go out.

verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הַמִּנְחָה הַקְרֵב אֹתָהּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֶל פְּנֵי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הַמִּנְחָה הַקְרֵב אֹתָהּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֶל פְּנֵי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
“And this is the instruction for the grain offering. The
sons of Aaron shall bring it forward in front of YHWH to
the front of the altar.

translation.text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD: and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.

verses.english:
“And this is the instruction for the grain offering. The
sons of Aaron shall bring it forward in front of YHWH to
the front of the altar.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵרִים מִמֶּנּוּ בְּקֻמְצוֹ מִסֹּלֶת הַמִּנְחָה וּמִשַּׁמְנָהּ וְאֵת כּל הַלְּבֹנָה אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּנְחָה וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אַזְכָּרָתָהּ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵרִים מִמֶּנּוּ בְּקֻמְצוֹ מִסֹּלֶת הַמִּנְחָה וּמִשַּׁמְנָהּ וְאֵת כּל הַלְּבֹנָה אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּנְחָה וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אַזְכָּרָתָהּ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he shall lift some of it in his fist, some of the fine
flour of the grain offering and some of its oil and all of
the frankincense that is on the grain offering, and he
shall burn a representative portion of it to smoke at the
altar as a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english:
And he shall lift some of it in his fist, some of the fine
flour of the grain offering and some of its oil and all of
the frankincense that is on the grain offering, and he
shall burn a representative portion of it to smoke at the
altar as a pleasant smell to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִמֶּנָּה יֹאכְלוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מַצּוֹת תֵּאָכֵל בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ בַּחֲצַר אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יֹאכְלוּהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִמֶּנָּה יֹאכְלוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מַצּוֹת תֵּאָכֵל בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ בַּחֲצַר אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יֹאכְלוּהָ׃

english.text:
And Aaron and his sons shall eat the remainder of it. It
shall be eaten as unleavened bread, in a holy place. They
shall eat it in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.

verses.english:
And Aaron and his sons shall eat the remainder of it. It
shall be eaten as unleavened bread, in a holy place. They
shall eat it in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תֵאָפֶה חָמֵץ חֶלְקָם נָתַתִּי אֹתָהּ מֵאִשָּׁי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא כַּחַטָּאת וְכָאָשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֵאָפֶה חָמֵץ חֶלְקָם נָתַתִּי אֹתָהּ מֵאִשָּׁי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא כַּחַטָּאת וְכָאָשָׁם׃

english.text:
It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as
their portion from my offerings by fire. It is the holy of
holies, like the sin offering and like the guilt offering.

translation.text: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

verses.english:
It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as
their portion from my offerings by fire. It is the holy of
holies, like the sin offering and like the guilt offering.

verses.hebrew: כּל זָכָר בִּבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן יֹאכְלֶנָּה חק עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בָּהֶם יִקְדָּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: כּל זָכָר בִּבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן יֹאכְלֶנָּה חק עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בָּהֶם יִקְדָּשׁ׃

english.text:
Every male among the sons of Aaron shall eat it—an eternal
law through your generations—from YHWH’s offerings by
fire. Anything that will touch them will become holy.”

translation.text: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.

verses.english:
Every male among the sons of Aaron shall eat it—an eternal
law through your generations—from YHWH’s offerings by
fire. Anything that will touch them will become holy.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: זֶה קרְבַּן אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה בְּיוֹם הִמָּשַׁח אֹתוֹ עֲשִׂירִת הָאֵפָה סֹלֶת מִנְחָה תָּמִיד מַחֲצִיתָהּ בַּבֹּקֶר וּמַחֲצִיתָהּ בָּעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: זֶה קרְבַּן אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה בְּיוֹם הִמָּשַׁח אֹתוֹ עֲשִׂירִת הָאֵפָה סֹלֶת מִנְחָה תָּמִיד מַחֲצִיתָהּ בַּבֹּקֶר וּמַחֲצִיתָהּ בָּעָרֶב׃

english.text:
“This is the offering of Aaron and his sons that they
shall bring to YHWH in the day of his being anointed: a
tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a continual grain
offering, half of it in the morning and half of it in the
evening.

translation.text: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.

verses.english:
“This is the offering of Aaron and his sons that they
shall bring to YHWH in the day of his being anointed: a
tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a continual grain
offering, half of it in the morning and half of it in the
evening.

verses.hebrew: עַל מַחֲבַת בַּשֶּׁמֶן תֵּעָשֶׂה מֻרְבֶּכֶת תְּבִיאֶנָּה תֻּפִינֵי מִנְחַת פִּתִּים תַּקְרִיב רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: עַל מַחֲבַת בַּשֶּׁמֶן תֵּעָשֶׂה מֻרְבֶּכֶת תְּבִיאֶנָּה תֻּפִינֵי מִנְחַת פִּתִּים תַּקְרִיב רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
It shall be made on a griddle in oil. You shall bring it
well mixed. You shall offer it as cakes of a grain
offering of pieces, a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.

verses.english:
It shall be made on a griddle in oil. You shall bring it
well mixed. You shall offer it as cakes of a grain
offering of pieces, a pleasant smell to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְהַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ תַּחְתָּיו מִבָּנָיו יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָהּ חק עוֹלָם לַיהֹוָה כָּלִיל תּקְטָר׃

hebrew.text: וְהַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ תַּחְתָּיו מִבָּנָיו יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָהּ חק עוֹלָם לַיהֹוָה כָּלִיל תּקְטָר׃

english.text:
And the anointed priest in his place from among his sons
shall do it, an eternal law, for YHWH: it shall be burned
to smoke entirely.

translation.text: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour, even the memorial of it, unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And the anointed priest in his place from among his sons
shall do it, an eternal law, for YHWH: it shall be burned
to smoke entirely.

verses.hebrew: וְכל מִנְחַת כֹּהֵן כָּלִיל תִּהְיֶה לֹא תֵאָכֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְכל מִנְחַת כֹּהֵן כָּלִיל תִּהְיֶה לֹא תֵאָכֵל׃

english.text:
And every grain offering of a priest shall be done
entirely. It shall not be eaten.”

translation.text: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.

verses.english:
And every grain offering of a priest shall be done
entirely. It shall not be eaten.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַחַטָּאת בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר תִּשָּׁחֵט הָעֹלָה תִּשָּׁחֵט הַחַטָּאת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַחַטָּאת בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר תִּשָּׁחֵט הָעֹלָה תִּשָּׁחֵט הַחַטָּאת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא׃

english.text:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying: This is the
instruction for the sin offering. In the place where the
burnt offering will be slaughtered, the sin offering shall
be slaughtered, in front of YHWH. It is the holy of
holies.

translation.text: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the LORD made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.

verses.english:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying: This is the
instruction for the sin offering. In the place where the
burnt offering will be slaughtered, the sin offering shall
be slaughtered, in front of YHWH. It is the holy of
holies.

verses.hebrew: הַכֹּהֵן הַמְחַטֵּא אֹתָהּ יֹאכְלֶנָּה בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ תֵּאָכֵל בַּחֲצַר אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: הַכֹּהֵן הַמְחַטֵּא אֹתָהּ יֹאכְלֶנָּה בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ תֵּאָכֵל בַּחֲצַר אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
The priest who makes it a sin offering shall eat it. It
shall be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the
Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english:
The priest who makes it a sin offering shall eat it. It
shall be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the
Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בִּבְשָׂרָהּ יִקְדָּשׁ וַאֲשֶׁר יִזֶּה מִדָּמָהּ עַל הַבֶּגֶד אֲשֶׁר יִזֶּה עָלֶיהָ תְּכַבֵּס בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בִּבְשָׂרָהּ יִקְדָּשׁ וַאֲשֶׁר יִזֶּה מִדָּמָהּ עַל הַבֶּגֶד אֲשֶׁר יִזֶּה עָלֶיהָ תְּכַבֵּס בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ׃

english.text:
Anything that will touch the meat of it will become holy.
And if some of its blood will spatter on clothing, you
shall wash the thing on which it will spatter in a holy
place.

translation.text: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.

verses.english:
Anything that will touch the meat of it will become holy.
And if some of its blood will spatter on clothing, you
shall wash the thing on which it will spatter in a holy
place.

verses.hebrew: וּכְלִי חֶרֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר תְּבֻשַּׁל בּוֹ יִשָּׁבֵר וְאִם בִּכְלִי נְחֹשֶׁת בֻּשָּׁלָה וּמֹרַק וְשֻׁטַּף בַּמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וּכְלִי חֶרֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר תְּבֻשַּׁל בּוֹ יִשָּׁבֵר וְאִם בִּכְלִי נְחֹשֶׁת בֻּשָּׁלָה וּמֹרַק וְשֻׁטַּף בַּמָּיִם׃

english.text:
And a clay container in which it will be boiled shall be
broken. And if it was boiled in a brass container then it
shall be scoured and rinsed with water.

translation.text: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, thou shalt bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And a clay container in which it will be boiled shall be
broken. And if it was boiled in a brass container then it
shall be scoured and rinsed with water.

verses.hebrew: כּל זָכָר בַּכֹּהֲנִים יֹאכַל אֹתָהּ קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא׃

hebrew.text: כּל זָכָר בַּכֹּהֲנִים יֹאכַל אֹתָהּ קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא׃

english.text:
Every male among the priests shall eat it. It is the holy
of holies.

translation.text: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: it is a statute for ever unto the LORD; it shall be wholly burnt.

verses.english:
Every male among the priests shall eat it. It is the holy
of holies.

verses.hebrew: וְכל חַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר יוּבָא מִדָּמָהּ אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לְכַפֵּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ לֹא תֵאָכֵל בָּאֵשׁ תִּשָּׂרֵף׃

hebrew.text: וְכל חַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר יוּבָא מִדָּמָהּ אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לְכַפֵּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ לֹא תֵאָכֵל בָּאֵשׁ תִּשָּׂרֵף׃

english.text:
And every sin offering some of whose blood will be brought
to the Tent of Meeting for atoning in the Holy shall not
be eaten. It shall be burned in fire.

translation.text: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.

verses.english:
And every sin offering some of whose blood will be brought
to the Tent of Meeting for atoning in the Holy shall not
be eaten. It shall be burned in fire.

verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הָאָשָׁם קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הָאָשָׁם קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא׃

english.text:
“And this is the instruction for the guilt offering. It
is the holy of holies.

translation.text: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.

verses.english:
“And this is the instruction for the guilt offering. It
is the holy of holies.

verses.hebrew: בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת הָעֹלָה יִשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת הָאָשָׁם וְאֶת דָּמוֹ יִזְרֹק עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת הָעֹלָה יִשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת הָאָשָׁם וְאֶת דָּמוֹ יִזְרֹק עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
They shall slaughter the guilt offering in the place where
they slaughter the burnt offering. And he shall fling its
blood on the altar all around.

translation.text: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.

verses.english:
They shall slaughter the guilt offering in the place where
they slaughter the burnt offering. And he shall fling its
blood on the altar all around.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כּל חֶלְבּוֹ יַקְרִיב מִמֶּנּוּ אֵת הָאַלְיָה וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמְכַסֶּה אֶת הַקֶּרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת כּל חֶלְבּוֹ יַקְרִיב מִמֶּנּוּ אֵת הָאַלְיָה וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמְכַסֶּה אֶת הַקֶּרֶב׃

english.text:
And he shall bring forward from it all its fat, the fat
tail and the fat that covers the innards,

translation.text: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,

verses.english:
And he shall bring forward from it all its fat, the fat
tail and the fat that covers the innards,

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵיהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיֹת יְסִירֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵיהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיֹת יְסִירֶנָּה׃

english.text:
and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that is
on the loins; and the lobe on the liver: he shall take it
away with the kidneys.

translation.text: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:

verses.english:
and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that is
on the loins; and the lobe on the liver: he shall take it
away with the kidneys.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְטִיר אֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה אָשָׁם הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְטִיר אֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה אָשָׁם הוּא׃

english.text:
And the priest shall burn them to smoke at the altar, an
offering by fire to YHWH. It is a guilt offering.

translation.text: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it is a trespass offering.

verses.english:
And the priest shall burn them to smoke at the altar, an
offering by fire to YHWH. It is a guilt offering.

verses.hebrew: כּל זָכָר בַּכֹּהֲנִים יֹאכְלֶנּוּ בְּמָקוֹם קָדוֹשׁ יֵאָכֵל קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא׃

hebrew.text: כּל זָכָר בַּכֹּהֲנִים יֹאכְלֶנּוּ בְּמָקוֹם קָדוֹשׁ יֵאָכֵל קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא׃

english.text:
Every male among the priests shall eat it. It shall be
eaten in a holy place. It is the holy of holies.

translation.text: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.

verses.english:
Every male among the priests shall eat it. It shall be
eaten in a holy place. It is the holy of holies.

verses.hebrew: כַּחַטָּאת כָּאָשָׁם תּוֹרָה אַחַת לָהֶם הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר יְכַפֶּר בּוֹ לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: כַּחַטָּאת כָּאָשָׁם תּוֹרָה אַחַת לָהֶם הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר יְכַפֶּר בּוֹ לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
As with the sin offering, so with the guilt offering: they
have one instruction. The priest who will make atonement
with it: it shall be his.

translation.text: As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it.

verses.english:
As with the sin offering, so with the guilt offering: they
have one instruction. The priest who will make atonement
with it: it shall be his.

verses.hebrew: וְהַכֹּהֵן הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת עֹלַת אִישׁ עוֹר הָעֹלָה אֲשֶׁר הִקְרִיב לַכֹּהֵן לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַכֹּהֵן הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת עֹלַת אִישׁ עוֹר הָעֹלָה אֲשֶׁר הִקְרִיב לַכֹּהֵן לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
And the priest who brings forward a man’s burnt offering:
the skin of the burnt offering that he brought forward is
for the priest; it shall be his.

translation.text: And the priest that offereth any man’s burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.

verses.english:
And the priest who brings forward a man’s burnt offering:
the skin of the burnt offering that he brought forward is
for the priest; it shall be his.

verses.hebrew: וְכל מִנְחָה אֲשֶׁר תֵּאָפֶה בַּתַּנּוּר וְכל נַעֲשָׂה בַמַּרְחֶשֶׁת וְעַל מַחֲבַת לַכֹּהֵן הַמַּקְרִיב אֹתָהּ לוֹ תִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְכל מִנְחָה אֲשֶׁר תֵּאָפֶה בַּתַּנּוּר וְכל נַעֲשָׂה בַמַּרְחֶשֶׁת וְעַל מַחֲבַת לַכֹּהֵן הַמַּקְרִיב אֹתָהּ לוֹ תִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
And every grain offering that will be baked in an oven and
every one made in a pan and on a griddle shall be for the
priest who brings it; it shall be his.

translation.text: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest’s that offereth it.

verses.english:
And every grain offering that will be baked in an oven and
every one made in a pan and on a griddle shall be for the
priest who brings it; it shall be his.

verses.hebrew: וְכל מִנְחָה בְלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וַחֲרֵבָה לְכל בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן תִּהְיֶה אִישׁ כְּאָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וְכל מִנְחָה בְלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וַחֲרֵבָה לְכל בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן תִּהְיֶה אִישׁ כְּאָחִיו׃

english.text:
And every grain offering mixed with oil or dry shall be
for all the sons of Aaron, each like his brother.

translation.text: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.

verses.english:
And every grain offering mixed with oil or dry shall be
for all the sons of Aaron, each like his brother.

verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“And this is the instruction of the peace-offering
sacrifice that one shall bring forward to YHWH.

translation.text: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the LORD.

verses.english:
“And this is the instruction of the peace-offering
sacrifice that one shall bring forward to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: אִם עַל תּוֹדָה יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ וְהִקְרִיב עַל זֶבַח הַתּוֹדָה חַלּוֹת מַצּוֹת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן וְסֹלֶת מֻרְבֶּכֶת חַלֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשָּׁמֶן׃

hebrew.text: אִם עַל תּוֹדָה יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ וְהִקְרִיב עַל זֶבַח הַתּוֹדָה חַלּוֹת מַצּוֹת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן וְסֹלֶת מֻרְבֶּכֶת חַלֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשָּׁמֶן׃

english.text:
If he will bring it forward out of thanks then he shall
bring forward with the sacrifice of thanks unleavened
cakes mixed with oil and unleavened wafers with oil poured
on them and fine flour well mixed, cakes, mixed with oil.

translation.text: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.

verses.english:
If he will bring it forward out of thanks then he shall
bring forward with the sacrifice of thanks unleavened
cakes mixed with oil and unleavened wafers with oil poured
on them and fine flour well mixed, cakes, mixed with oil.

verses.hebrew: עַל חַלֹּת לֶחֶם חָמֵץ יַקְרִיב קרְבָּנוֹ עַל זֶבַח תּוֹדַת שְׁלָמָיו׃

hebrew.text: עַל חַלֹּת לֶחֶם חָמֵץ יַקְרִיב קרְבָּנוֹ עַל זֶבַח תּוֹדַת שְׁלָמָיו׃

english.text:
He shall make his offering with cakes of leavened bread,
with his peace-offering sacrifice of thanks.

translation.text: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.

verses.english:
He shall make his offering with cakes of leavened bread,
with his peace-offering sacrifice of thanks.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב מִמֶּנּוּ אֶחָד מִכּל קרְבָּן תְּרוּמָה לַיהֹוָה לַכֹּהֵן הַזֹּרֵק אֶת דַּם הַשְּׁלָמִים לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב מִמֶּנּוּ אֶחָד מִכּל קרְבָּן תְּרוּמָה לַיהֹוָה לַכֹּהֵן הַזֹּרֵק אֶת דַּם הַשְּׁלָמִים לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
And he shall bring forward from it one of each offering as
a donation for YHWH. For the priest who flings the blood
of the peace offerings: it shall be his.

translation.text: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the LORD, and it shall be the priest’s that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.

verses.english:
And he shall bring forward from it one of each offering as
a donation for YHWH. For the priest who flings the blood
of the peace offerings: it shall be his.

verses.hebrew: וּבְשַׂר זֶבַח תּוֹדַת שְׁלָמָיו בְּיוֹם קרְבָּנוֹ יֵאָכֵל לֹא יַנִּיחַ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר׃

hebrew.text: וּבְשַׂר זֶבַח תּוֹדַת שְׁלָמָיו בְּיוֹם קרְבָּנוֹ יֵאָכֵל לֹא יַנִּיחַ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר׃

english.text:
And the meat of his peace-offering sacrifice shall be
eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any
of it until morning.

translation.text: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.

verses.english:
And the meat of his peace-offering sacrifice shall be
eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any
of it until morning.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם נֶדֶר אוֹ נְדָבָה זֶבַח קרְבָּנוֹ בְּיוֹם הַקְרִיבוֹ אֶת זִבְחוֹ יֵאָכֵל וּמִמּחֳרָת וְהַנּוֹתָר מִמֶּנּוּ יֵאָכֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם נֶדֶר אוֹ נְדָבָה זֶבַח קרְבָּנוֹ בְּיוֹם הַקְרִיבוֹ אֶת זִבְחוֹ יֵאָכֵל וּמִמּחֳרָת וְהַנּוֹתָר מִמֶּנּוּ יֵאָכֵל׃

english.text:
And if his sacrificial offering is a vow or a
contribution, it shall be eaten on the day that he brings
forward his sacrifice, and on the next day what is left of
it may be eaten.

translation.text: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:

verses.english:
And if his sacrificial offering is a vow or a
contribution, it shall be eaten on the day that he brings
forward his sacrifice, and on the next day what is left of
it may be eaten.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנּוֹתָר מִבְּשַׂר הַזָּבַח בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנּוֹתָר מִבְּשַׂר הַזָּבַח בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף׃

english.text:
And what is left of the meat of the sacrifice on the third
day shall be burned in fire.

translation.text: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.

verses.english:
And what is left of the meat of the sacrifice on the third
day shall be burned in fire.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם הֵאָכֹל יֵאָכֵל מִבְּשַׂר זֶבַח שְׁלָמָיו בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לֹא יֵרָצֶה הַמַּקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לֹא יֵחָשֵׁב לוֹ פִּגּוּל יִהְיֶה וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת מִמֶּנּוּ עֲוֺנָהּ תִּשָּׂא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם הֵאָכֹל יֵאָכֵל מִבְּשַׂר זֶבַח שְׁלָמָיו בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לֹא יֵרָצֶה הַמַּקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לֹא יֵחָשֵׁב לוֹ פִּגּוּל יִהְיֶה וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת מִמֶּנּוּ עֲוֺנָהּ תִּשָּׂא׃

english.text:
And if any of the meat of his peace-offering sacrifice
will be eaten on the third day, it shall not be
acceptable. The one who brings it forward: it shall not be
counted for him. It shall be a repugnant thing. And the
person who eats any of it shall bear his crime.

translation.text: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.

verses.english:
And if any of the meat of his peace-offering sacrifice
will be eaten on the third day, it shall not be
acceptable. The one who brings it forward: it shall not be
counted for him. It shall be a repugnant thing. And the
person who eats any of it shall bear his crime.

verses.hebrew: וְהַבָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בְּכל טָמֵא לֹא יֵאָכֵל בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף וְהַבָּשָׂר כּל טָהוֹר יֹאכַל בָּשָׂר׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בְּכל טָמֵא לֹא יֵאָכֵל בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף וְהַבָּשָׂר כּל טָהוֹר יֹאכַל בָּשָׂר׃

english.text:
And meat that will touch any impure thing shall not be
eaten. It shall be burned in fire. And meat: everyone who
is pure may eat meat,

translation.text: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.

verses.english:
And meat that will touch any impure thing shall not be
eaten. It shall be burned in fire. And meat: everyone who
is pure may eat meat,

verses.hebrew: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל בָּשָׂר מִזֶּבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר לַיהֹוָה וְטֻמְאָתוֹ עָלָיו וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל בָּשָׂר מִזֶּבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר לַיהֹוָה וְטֻמְאָתוֹ עָלָיו וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
but the person who will eat meat from the peace-offering
sacrifice that is YHWH’s while his impurity is on him,
that person will be cut off from his people.

translation.text: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

verses.english:
but the person who will eat meat from the peace-offering
sacrifice that is YHWH’s while his impurity is on him,
that person will be cut off from his people.

verses.hebrew: וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִגַּע בְּכל טָמֵא בְּטֻמְאַת אָדָם אוֹ בִּבְהֵמָה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּכל שֶׁקֶץ טָמֵא וְאָכַל מִבְּשַׂר זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר לַיהֹוָה וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִגַּע בְּכל טָמֵא בְּטֻמְאַת אָדָם אוֹ בִּבְהֵמָה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּכל שֶׁקֶץ טָמֵא וְאָכַל מִבְּשַׂר זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר לַיהֹוָה וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
And a person who will touch any impure thing, human
impurity or an impure animal or any impure detestable
thing, and will eat some of the meat of the peace-offering
sacrifice that is YHWH’s: that person will be cut off from
his people.”

translation.text: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto the LORD, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

verses.english:
And a person who will touch any impure thing, human
impurity or an impure animal or any impure detestable
thing, and will eat some of the meat of the peace-offering
sacrifice that is YHWH’s: that person will be cut off from
his people.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר כּל חֵלֶב שׁוֹר וְכֶשֶׂב וָעֵז לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר כּל חֵלֶב שׁוֹר וְכֶשֶׂב וָעֵז לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: You shall not
eat any fat of an ox or sheep or goat.

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: You shall not
eat any fat of an ox or sheep or goat.

verses.hebrew: וְחֵלֶב נְבֵלָה וְחֵלֶב טְרֵפָה יֵעָשֶׂה לְכל מְלָאכָה וְאָכֹל לֹא תֹאכְלֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְחֵלֶב נְבֵלָה וְחֵלֶב טְרֵפָה יֵעָשֶׂה לְכל מְלָאכָה וְאָכֹל לֹא תֹאכְלֻהוּ׃

english.text:
And fat of a carcass and fat of a torn animal may be used
for any work, but you shall not eat it.

translation.text: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.

verses.english:
And fat of a carcass and fat of a torn animal may be used
for any work, but you shall not eat it.

verses.hebrew: כִּי כּל אֹכֵל חֵלֶב מִן הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב מִמֶּנָּה אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי כּל אֹכֵל חֵלֶב מִן הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב מִמֶּנָּה אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
Because anyone who eats fat from an animal from which one
would bring forward an offering by fire to YHWH, the
person who eats it will be cut off from his people.

translation.text: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.

verses.english:
Because anyone who eats fat from an animal from which one
would bring forward an offering by fire to YHWH, the
person who eats it will be cut off from his people.

verses.hebrew: וְכל דָּם לֹא תֹאכְלוּ בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם לָעוֹף וְלַבְּהֵמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכל דָּם לֹא תֹאכְלוּ בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם לָעוֹף וְלַבְּהֵמָה׃

english.text:
And you shall not eat any blood in all of your homes, a
bird’s or an animal’s.

translation.text: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.

verses.english:
And you shall not eat any blood in all of your homes, a
bird’s or an animal’s.

verses.hebrew: כּל נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל כּל דָּם וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: כּל נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל כּל דָּם וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
Any person who will eat any blood, that person will be cut
off from his people.”

translation.text: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

verses.english:
Any person who will eat any blood, that person will be cut
off from his people.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת זֶבַח שְׁלָמָיו לַיהֹוָה יָבִיא אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה מִזֶּבַח שְׁלָמָיו׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת זֶבַח שְׁלָמָיו לַיהֹוָה יָבִיא אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה מִזֶּבַח שְׁלָמָיו׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: The one who
brings forward his peace-offering sacrifice to YHWH shall
bring his offering to YHWH from his peace-offering
sacrifice:

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the LORD shall bring his oblation unto the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: The one who
brings forward his peace-offering sacrifice to YHWH shall
bring his offering to YHWH from his peace-offering
sacrifice:

verses.hebrew: יָדָיו תְּבִיאֶינָה אֵת אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה אֶת הַחֵלֶב עַל הֶחָזֶה יְבִיאֶנּוּ אֵת הֶחָזֶה לְהָנִיף אֹתוֹ תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: יָדָיו תְּבִיאֶינָה אֵת אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה אֶת הַחֵלֶב עַל הֶחָזֶה יְבִיאֶנּוּ אֵת הֶחָזֶה לְהָנִיף אֹתוֹ תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
his hands shall bring YHWH’s offerings by fire. He shall
bring it, the fat with the breast: the breast so as to
elevate it, an elevation offering in front of YHWH.

translation.text: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD.

verses.english:
his hands shall bring YHWH’s offerings by fire. He shall
bring it, the fat with the breast: the breast so as to
elevate it, an elevation offering in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְהָיָה הֶחָזֶה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְהָיָה הֶחָזֶה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו׃

english.text:
And the priest shall burn the fat to smoke at the altar,
and the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

translation.text: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

verses.english:
And the priest shall burn the fat to smoke at the altar,
and the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין תִּתְּנוּ תְרוּמָה לַכֹּהֵן מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין תִּתְּנוּ תְרוּמָה לַכֹּהֵן מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall give the right thigh as a donation to the
priest from your peace-offering sacrifices.

translation.text: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

verses.english:
And you shall give the right thigh as a donation to the
priest from your peace-offering sacrifices.

verses.hebrew: הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת דַּם הַשְּׁלָמִים וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב מִבְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן לוֹ תִהְיֶה שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין לְמָנָה׃

hebrew.text: הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת דַּם הַשְּׁלָמִים וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב מִבְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן לוֹ תִהְיֶה שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין לְמָנָה׃

english.text:
The one from the sons of Aaron who brings forward the
blood of the peace offerings and the fat: the right thigh
shall be his as a portion.

translation.text: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.

verses.english:
The one from the sons of Aaron who brings forward the
blood of the peace offerings and the fat: the right thigh
shall be his as a portion.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶת חֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה לָקַחְתִּי מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיהֶם וָאֶתֵּן אֹתָם לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וּלְבָנָיו לְחק עוֹלָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֶת חֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה לָקַחְתִּי מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיהֶם וָאֶתֵּן אֹתָם לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וּלְבָנָיו לְחק עוֹלָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Because I have taken the breast of the elevation offering
and the thigh of the donation from the children of Israel,
from their peace-offering sacrifices, and I have given
them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as an eternal law
from the children of Israel.”

translation.text: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.

verses.english:
Because I have taken the breast of the elevation offering
and the thigh of the donation from the children of Israel,
from their peace-offering sacrifices, and I have given
them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as an eternal law
from the children of Israel.”

verses.hebrew: זֹאת מִשְׁחַת אַהֲרֹן וּמִשְׁחַת בָּנָיו מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה בְּיוֹם הִקְרִיב אֹתָם לְכַהֵן לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת מִשְׁחַת אַהֲרֹן וּמִשְׁחַת בָּנָיו מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה בְּיוֹם הִקְרִיב אֹתָם לְכַהֵן לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
This is the anointing of Aaron and the anointing of his
sons from YHWH’s offerings by fire in the day He brought
them forward to function as priests for YHWH,

translation.text: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto the LORD in the priest’s office;

verses.english:
This is the anointing of Aaron and the anointing of his
sons from YHWH’s offerings by fire in the day He brought
them forward to function as priests for YHWH,

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לָתֵת לָהֶם בְּיוֹם משְׁחוֹ אֹתָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לָתֵת לָהֶם בְּיוֹם משְׁחוֹ אֹתָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתָם׃

english.text:
which YHWH commanded to give to them in the day of His
anointing them from among the children of Israel, an
eternal law through their generations.

translation.text: Which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.

verses.english:
which YHWH commanded to give to them in the day of His
anointing them from among the children of Israel, an
eternal law through their generations.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת הַתּוֹרָה לָעֹלָה לַמִּנְחָה וְלַחַטָּאת וְלָאָשָׁם וְלַמִּלּוּאִים וּלְזֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת הַתּוֹרָה לָעֹלָה לַמִּנְחָה וְלַחַטָּאת וְלָאָשָׁם וְלַמִּלּוּאִים וּלְזֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים׃

english.text:
This is the instruction of the burnt offering, of the
grain offering, and of the sin offering and of the guilt
offering and of the ordination and of the peace-offering
sacrifice,

translation.text: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;

verses.english:
This is the instruction of the burnt offering, of the
grain offering, and of the sin offering and of the guilt
offering and of the ordination and of the peace-offering
sacrifice,

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה בְּהַר סִינָי בְּיוֹם צַוֺּתוֹ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַקְרִיב אֶת קרְבְּנֵיהֶם לַיהֹוָה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה בְּהַר סִינָי בְּיוֹם צַוֺּתוֹ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַקְרִיב אֶת קרְבְּנֵיהֶם לַיהֹוָה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי׃

english.text:
which YHWH commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that
He commanded the children of Israel to make their
offerings to YHWH in the wilderness of Sinai.

translation.text: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.english:
which YHWH commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that
He commanded the children of Israel to make their
offerings to YHWH in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: קַח אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו אִתּוֹ וְאֵת הַבְּגָדִים וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְאֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וְאֵת שְׁנֵי הָאֵילִים וְאֵת סַל הַמַּצּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: קַח אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו אִתּוֹ וְאֵת הַבְּגָדִים וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְאֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וְאֵת שְׁנֵי הָאֵילִים וְאֵת סַל הַמַּצּוֹת׃

english.text:
“Take Aaron and his sons with him and the clothes and the
anointing oil and the bull for the sin offering and the
two rams and the basket of unleavened bread,

translation.text: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;

verses.english:
“Take Aaron and his sons with him and the clothes and the
anointing oil and the bull for the sin offering and the
two rams and the basket of unleavened bread,

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כּל הָעֵדָה הַקְהֵל אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת כּל הָעֵדָה הַקְהֵל אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
and assemble all of the congregation to the entrance of
the Tent of Meeting.”

translation.text: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.english:
and assemble all of the congregation to the entrance of
the Tent of Meeting.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ וַתִּקָּהֵל הָעֵדָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ וַתִּקָּהֵל הָעֵדָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And Moses did as YHWH commanded him. And the congregation
was gathered to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.english:
And Moses did as YHWH commanded him. And the congregation
was gathered to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעֵדָה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעֵדָה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

english.text:
And Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing
that YHWH has commanded to do.”

translation.text: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.

verses.english:
And Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing
that YHWH has commanded to do.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו וַיִּרְחַץ אֹתָם בַּמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו וַיִּרְחַץ אֹתָם בַּמָּיִם׃

english.text:
And Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward, and he
washed them with water.

translation.text: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

verses.english:
And Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward, and he
washed them with water.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת הַכֻּתֹּנֶת וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתוֹ בָּאַבְנֵט וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ אֶת הַמְּעִיל וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת הָאֵפֹד וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתוֹ בְּחֵשֶׁב הָאֵפֹד וַיֶּאְפֹּד לוֹ בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת הַכֻּתֹּנֶת וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתוֹ בָּאַבְנֵט וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ אֶת הַמְּעִיל וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת הָאֵפֹד וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתוֹ בְּחֵשֶׁב הָאֵפֹד וַיֶּאְפֹּד לוֹ בּוֹ׃

english.text:
And he put the coat on him and belted him with the sash
and dressed him with the robe and put the ephod on him and
belted him with the ephod’s designed belt and put on the
ephod for him with it.

translation.text: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.

verses.english:
And he put the coat on him and belted him with the sash
and dressed him with the robe and put the ephod on him and
belted him with the ephod’s designed belt and put on the
ephod for him with it.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם עָלָיו אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן וַיִּתֵּן אֶל הַחֹשֶׁן אֶת הָאוּרִים וְאֶת הַתֻּמִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם עָלָיו אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן וַיִּתֵּן אֶל הַחֹשֶׁן אֶת הָאוּרִים וְאֶת הַתֻּמִּים׃

english.text:
And he set the breastplate on him and put the Urim and
Tummim into the breastplate.

translation.text: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.

verses.english:
And he set the breastplate on him and put the Urim and
Tummim into the breastplate.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַמִּצְנֶפֶת עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם עַל הַמִּצְנֶפֶת אֶל מוּל פָּנָיו אֵת צִיץ הַזָּהָב נֵזֶר הַקֹּדֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַמִּצְנֶפֶת עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם עַל הַמִּצְנֶפֶת אֶל מוּל פָּנָיו אֵת צִיץ הַזָּהָב נֵזֶר הַקֹּדֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he set the headdress on his head and set the gold
plate, the crown of Holiness, on the headdress opposite
the front of it, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he set the headdress on his head and set the gold
plate, the crown of Holiness, on the headdress opposite
the front of it, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וַיִּמְשַׁח אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וַיִּמְשַׁח אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתָם׃

english.text:
And Moses took the anointing oil, and he anointed the
Tabernacle and everything that was in it, so he
consecrated them.

translation.text: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.

verses.english:
And Moses took the anointing oil, and he anointed the
Tabernacle and everything that was in it, so he
consecrated them.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּז מִמֶּנּוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וַיִּמְשַׁח אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ לְקַדְּשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּז מִמֶּנּוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וַיִּמְשַׁח אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ לְקַדְּשָׁם׃

english.text:
And he sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times and
anointed the altar and all of its equipment and the basin
and its stand to consecrate them.

translation.text: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.

verses.english:
And he sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times and
anointed the altar and all of its equipment and the basin
and its stand to consecrate them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצֹק מִשֶּׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה עַל רֹאשׁ אַהֲרֹן וַיִּמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ לְקַדְּשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצֹק מִשֶּׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה עַל רֹאשׁ אַהֲרֹן וַיִּמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ לְקַדְּשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
And he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head
and anointed him to consecrate him.

translation.text: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

verses.english:
And he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head
and anointed him to consecrate him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁם כֻּתֳּנֹת וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתָם אַבְנֵט וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ לָהֶם מִגְבָּעוֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁם כֻּתֳּנֹת וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתָם אַבְנֵט וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ לָהֶם מִגְבָּעוֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Moses brought forward Aaron’s sons and dressed them in
coats and belted them with a sash and put on hats for
them, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And Moses brought forward Aaron’s sons and dressed them in
coats and belted them with a sash and put on hats for
them, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּשׁ אֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וַיִּסְמֹךְ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ פַּר הַחַטָּאת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֵּשׁ אֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וַיִּסְמֹךְ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ פַּר הַחַטָּאת׃

english.text:
And he brought up the bull for the sin offering. And Aaron
and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull for
the sin offering.

translation.text: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.

verses.english:
And he brought up the bull for the sin offering. And Aaron
and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull for
the sin offering.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם וַיִּתֵּן עַל קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ וַיְחַטֵּא אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת הַדָּם יָצַק אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיְקַדְּשֵׁהוּ לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם וַיִּתֵּן עַל קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ וַיְחַטֵּא אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת הַדָּם יָצַק אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיְקַדְּשֵׁהוּ לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו׃

english.text:
And Moses slaughtered it and took the blood and put it on
the altar’s horns all around with his finger and purified
the altar from sin, and he poured the blood at the base of
the altar, and he consecrated it to make atonement on it.

translation.text: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.

verses.english:
And Moses slaughtered it and took the blood and put it on
the altar’s horns all around with his finger and purified
the altar from sin, and he poured the blood at the base of
the altar, and he consecrated it to make atonement on it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת יֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת חֶלְבְּהֶן וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֶת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת יֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת חֶלְבְּהֶן וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

english.text:
And he took all the fat that was on the innards and the
lobe of the liver and the two kidneys and their fat, and
Moses burned them to smoke at the altar.

translation.text: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.

verses.english:
And he took all the fat that was on the innards and the
lobe of the liver and the two kidneys and their fat, and
Moses burned them to smoke at the altar.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַפָּר וְאֶת עֹרוֹ וְאֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ וְאֶת פִּרְשׁוֹ שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַפָּר וְאֶת עֹרוֹ וְאֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ וְאֶת פִּרְשׁוֹ שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he burned the bull and its skin and its meat and its
dung in fire outside the camp, as YHWH had commanded
Moses.

translation.text: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he burned the bull and its skin and its meat and its
dung in fire outside the camp, as YHWH had commanded
Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֵת אֵיל הָעֹלָה וַיִּסְמְכוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֵת אֵיל הָעֹלָה וַיִּסְמְכוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל׃

english.text:
And he brought forward the ram for the burnt offering. And
Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the ram’s head.

translation.text: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

verses.english:
And he brought forward the ram for the burnt offering. And
Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the ram’s head.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּזְרֹק מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּזְרֹק מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And he slaughtered it, and Moses flung the blood on the
altar all around.

translation.text: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

verses.english:
And he slaughtered it, and Moses flung the blood on the
altar all around.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָאַיִל נִתַּח לִנְתָחָיו וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת הַנְּתָחִים וְאֶת הַפָּדֶר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָאַיִל נִתַּח לִנְתָחָיו וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת הַנְּתָחִים וְאֶת הַפָּדֶר׃

english.text:
And he cut the ram into its parts, and Moses burned the
head and the parts and the suet to smoke.
