translation.text: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

verses.english:
And he cut the ram into its parts, and Moses burned the
head and the parts and the suet to smoke.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֶת הַכְּרָעַיִם רָחַץ בַּמָּיִם וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה אֶת כּל הָאַיִל הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה הוּא לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה הוּא לַיהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֶת הַכְּרָעַיִם רָחַץ בַּמָּיִם וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה אֶת כּל הָאַיִל הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה הוּא לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה הוּא לַיהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he washed the innards and the legs with water. And
Moses burned all of the ram to smoke at the altar. It was
a burnt offering as a pleasant smell. It was an offering
by fire to YHWH, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he washed the innards and the legs with water. And
Moses burned all of the ram to smoke at the altar. It was
a burnt offering as a pleasant smell. It was an offering
by fire to YHWH, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת הָאַיִל הַשֵּׁנִי אֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים וַיִּסְמְכוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת הָאַיִל הַשֵּׁנִי אֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים וַיִּסְמְכוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל׃

english.text:
And he brought forward the second ram, the ram of
ordination. And Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the
ram’s head.

translation.text: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

verses.english:
And he brought forward the second ram, the ram of
ordination. And Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the
ram’s head.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה מִדָּמוֹ וַיִּתֵּן עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן אַהֲרֹן הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה מִדָּמוֹ וַיִּתֵּן עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן אַהֲרֹן הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית׃

english.text:
And he slaughtered it, and Moses took some of its blood
and put it on Aaron’s right earlobe and on the thumb of
his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

translation.text: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.

verses.english:
And he slaughtered it, and Moses took some of its blood
and put it on Aaron’s right earlobe and on the thumb of
his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה מִן הַדָּם עַל תְּנוּךְ אזְנָם הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדָם הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלָם הַיְמָנִית וַיִּזְרֹק מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה מִן הַדָּם עַל תְּנוּךְ אזְנָם הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדָם הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלָם הַיְמָנִית וַיִּזְרֹק מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And he brought Aaron’s sons forward, and Moses put some of
the blood on their right earlobe and on the thumb of their
right hand and on the big toe of their right foot. And
Moses flung the blood on the altar all around.

translation.text: And he brought Aaron’s sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

verses.english:
And he brought Aaron’s sons forward, and Moses put some of
the blood on their right earlobe and on the thumb of their
right hand and on the big toe of their right foot. And
Moses flung the blood on the altar all around.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת הַחֵלֶב וְאֶת הָאַלְיָה וְאֶת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת יֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת חֶלְבְּהֶן וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֶת הַחֵלֶב וְאֶת הָאַלְיָה וְאֶת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת יֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת חֶלְבְּהֶן וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין׃

english.text:
And he took the fat and the fat tail and all the fat that
was on the innards and the lobe of the liver and the two
kidneys and their fat and the right thigh.

translation.text: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:

verses.english:
And he took the fat and the fat tail and all the fat that
was on the innards and the lobe of the liver and the two
kidneys and their fat and the right thigh.

verses.hebrew: וּמִסַּל הַמַּצּוֹת אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לָקַח חַלַּת מַצָּה אַחַת וְחַלַּת לֶחֶם שֶׁמֶן אַחַת וְרָקִיק אֶחָד וַיָּשֶׂם עַל הַחֲלָבִים וְעַל שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין׃

hebrew.text: וּמִסַּל הַמַּצּוֹת אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לָקַח חַלַּת מַצָּה אַחַת וְחַלַּת לֶחֶם שֶׁמֶן אַחַת וְרָקִיק אֶחָד וַיָּשֶׂם עַל הַחֲלָבִים וְעַל שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין׃

english.text:
And from the basket of unleavened bread that was in front
of YHWH he took one cake of unleavened bread and one cake
of bread with oil and one wafer, and he set them on the
fats and on the right thigh.

translation.text: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:

verses.english:
And from the basket of unleavened bread that was in front
of YHWH he took one cake of unleavened bread and one cake
of bread with oil and one wafer, and he set them on the
fats and on the right thigh.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַכֹּל עַל כַּפֵּי אַהֲרֹן וְעַל כַּפֵּי בָנָיו וַיָּנֶף אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַכֹּל עַל כַּפֵּי אַהֲרֹן וְעַל כַּפֵּי בָנָיו וַיָּנֶף אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he put it all on Aaron’s hands and on his sons’ hands
and elevated them, an elevation offering in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And he put all upon Aaron’s hands, and upon his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.

verses.english:
And he put it all on Aaron’s hands and on his sons’ hands
and elevated them, an elevation offering in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֹתָם מֵעַל כַּפֵּיהֶם וַיַּקְטֵר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל הָעֹלָה מִלֻּאִים הֵם לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה הוּא לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֹתָם מֵעַל כַּפֵּיהֶם וַיַּקְטֵר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל הָעֹלָה מִלֻּאִים הֵם לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה הוּא לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Moses took them from on their hands and burned them to
smoke at the altar with the burnt offering. They were an
ordination offering as a pleasant smell. It was an
offering by fire to YHWH.

translation.text: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And Moses took them from on their hands and burned them to
smoke at the altar with the burnt offering. They were an
ordination offering as a pleasant smell. It was an
offering by fire to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הֶחָזֶה וַיְנִיפֵהוּ תְנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה מֵאֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים לְמֹשֶׁה הָיָה לְמָנָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הֶחָזֶה וַיְנִיפֵהוּ תְנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה מֵאֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים לְמֹשֶׁה הָיָה לְמָנָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Moses took the breast and elevated it, an elevation
offering in front of YHWH from the ram of ordination. It
was Moses’ for a portion, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses’ part; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And Moses took the breast and elevated it, an elevation
offering in front of YHWH from the ram of ordination. It
was Moses’ for a portion, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה מִשֶּׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וּמִן הַדָּם אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיַּז עַל אַהֲרֹן עַל בְּגָדָיו וְעַל בָּנָיו וְעַל בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת אַהֲרֹן אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְאֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה מִשֶּׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וּמִן הַדָּם אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיַּז עַל אַהֲרֹן עַל בְּגָדָיו וְעַל בָּנָיו וְעַל בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת אַהֲרֹן אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְאֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the
blood that was on the altar and sprinkled them on Aaron,
on his clothes, and on his sons and on his sons’ clothes
with him, and he consecrated Aaron, his clothes, and his
sons and his sons’ clothes with him.

translation.text: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons’ garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

verses.english:
And Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the
blood that was on the altar and sprinkled them on Aaron,
on his clothes, and on his sons and on his sons’ clothes
with him, and he consecrated Aaron, his clothes, and his
sons and his sons’ clothes with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו בַּשְּׁלוּ אֶת הַבָּשָׂר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְשָׁם תֹּאכְלוּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר בְּסַל הַמִּלֻּאִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוֵּיתִי לֵאמֹר אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו יֹאכְלֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו בַּשְּׁלוּ אֶת הַבָּשָׂר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְשָׁם תֹּאכְלוּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר בְּסַל הַמִּלֻּאִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוֵּיתִי לֵאמֹר אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו יֹאכְלֻהוּ׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Cook the meat at
the entrance of the Tent of Meeting and eat it and the
bread that’s in the basket of ordination there, as I
commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’

translation.text: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.

verses.english:
And Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Cook the meat at
the entrance of the Tent of Meeting and eat it and the
bread that’s in the basket of ordination there, as I
commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’

verses.hebrew: וְהַנּוֹתָר בַּבָּשָׂר וּבַלָּחֶם בָּאֵשׁ תִּשְׂרֹפוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנּוֹתָר בַּבָּשָׂר וּבַלָּחֶם בָּאֵשׁ תִּשְׂרֹפוּ׃

english.text:
And you shall burn what is left of the meat and of the
bread in fire.

translation.text: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.

verses.english:
And you shall burn what is left of the meat and of the
bread in fire.

verses.hebrew: וּמִפֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֹא תֵצְאוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים עַד יוֹם מְלֹאת יְמֵי מִלֻּאֵיכֶם כִּי שִׁבְעַת יָמִים יְמַלֵּא אֶת יֶדְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּמִפֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֹא תֵצְאוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים עַד יוֹם מְלֹאת יְמֵי מִלֻּאֵיכֶם כִּי שִׁבְעַת יָמִים יְמַלֵּא אֶת יֶדְכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall not go out from the Tent of Meeting for
seven days, until the day of completion of the days of
your ordination, because He will fill your hand for seven
days.

translation.text: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.

verses.english:
And you shall not go out from the Tent of Meeting for
seven days, until the day of completion of the days of
your ordination, because He will fill your hand for seven
days.

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לַעֲשֹׂת לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לַעֲשֹׂת לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
What has been done on this day YHWH commanded to do, to
make atonement over you.

translation.text: As he hath done this day, so the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.

verses.english:
What has been done on this day YHWH commanded to do, to
make atonement over you.

verses.hebrew: וּפֶתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד תֵּשְׁבוּ יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת יְהֹוָה וְלֹא תָמוּתוּ כִּי כֵן צֻוֵּיתִי׃

hebrew.text: וּפֶתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד תֵּשְׁבוּ יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת יְהֹוָה וְלֹא תָמוּתוּ כִּי כֵן צֻוֵּיתִי׃

english.text:
And you shall sit at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting
day and night, seven days, and you shall keep YHWH’s
charge, and you will not die, because that is what I was
commanded.”

translation.text: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.

verses.english:
And you shall sit at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting
day and night, seven days, and you shall keep YHWH’s
charge, and you will not die, because that is what I was
commanded.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Aaron and his sons did all the things that YHWH
commanded by Moses’ hand.

translation.text: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

verses.english:
And Aaron and his sons did all the things that YHWH
commanded by Moses’ hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי קָרָא מֹשֶׁה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו וּלְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי קָרָא מֹשֶׁה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו וּלְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And it was, on the eighth day, Moses called to Aaron and
to his sons and to Israel’s elders.

translation.text: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

verses.english:
And it was, on the eighth day, Moses called to Aaron and
to his sons and to Israel’s elders.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל אַהֲרֹן קַח לְךָ עֵגֶל בֶּן בָּקָר לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל לְעֹלָה תְּמִימִם וְהַקְרֵב לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל אַהֲרֹן קַח לְךָ עֵגֶל בֶּן בָּקָר לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל לְעֹלָה תְּמִימִם וְהַקְרֵב לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he said to Aaron, “Take a calf of the cattle for a sin
offering and a ram for a burnt offering—unblemished—and
bring them forward in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the LORD.

verses.english:
And he said to Aaron, “Take a calf of the cattle for a sin
offering and a ram for a burnt offering—unblemished—and
bring them forward in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּדַבֵּר לֵאמֹר קְחוּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים לְחַטָּאת וְעֵגֶל וָכֶבֶשׂ בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם לְעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּדַבֵּר לֵאמֹר קְחוּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים לְחַטָּאת וְעֵגֶל וָכֶבֶשׂ בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם לְעֹלָה׃

english.text:
And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying,
‘Take a goat for a sin offering and a calf and a lamb,
unblemished one-year-olds, for a burnt offering

translation.text: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;

verses.english:
And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying,
‘Take a goat for a sin offering and a calf and a lamb,
unblemished one-year-olds, for a burnt offering

verses.hebrew: וְשׁוֹר וָאַיִל לִשְׁלָמִים לִזְבֹּחַ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּמִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן כִּי הַיּוֹם יְהֹוָה נִרְאָה אֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְשׁוֹר וָאַיִל לִשְׁלָמִים לִזְבֹּחַ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּמִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן כִּי הַיּוֹם יְהֹוָה נִרְאָה אֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
and an ox and a ram for peace offerings to sacrifice in
front of YHWH, and a grain offering mixed with oil,
because today YHWH is appearing to you.’”

translation.text: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the LORD will appear unto you.

verses.english:
and an ox and a ram for peace offerings to sacrifice in
front of YHWH, and a grain offering mixed with oil,
because today YHWH is appearing to you.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה אֶל פְּנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיִּקְרְבוּ כּל הָעֵדָה וַיַּעַמְדוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה אֶל פְּנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיִּקְרְבוּ כּל הָעֵדָה וַיַּעַמְדוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And they took what Moses had commanded to the front of the
Tent of Meeting, and they brought forward all of the
congregation, and they stood in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.

verses.english:
And they took what Moses had commanded to the front of the
Tent of Meeting, and they brought forward all of the
congregation, and they stood in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה תַּעֲשׂוּ וְיֵרָא אֲלֵיכֶם כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה תַּעֲשׂוּ וְיֵרָא אֲלֵיכֶם כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “This is the thing that YHWH has commanded
that you shall do, and YHWH’s glory will appear to you.”

translation.text: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the LORD shall appear unto you.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “This is the thing that YHWH has commanded
that you shall do, and YHWH’s glory will appear to you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן קְרַב אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַעֲשֵׂה אֶת חַטָּאתְךָ וְאֶת עֹלָתֶךָ וְכַפֵּר בַּעַדְךָ וּבְעַד הָעָם וַעֲשֵׂה אֶת קרְבַּן הָעָם וְכַפֵּר בַּעֲדָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן קְרַב אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַעֲשֵׂה אֶת חַטָּאתְךָ וְאֶת עֹלָתֶךָ וְכַפֵּר בַּעַדְךָ וּבְעַד הָעָם וַעֲשֵׂה אֶת קרְבַּן הָעָם וְכַפֵּר בַּעֲדָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Aaron, “Come forward to the altar and
make your sin offering and your burnt offering and make
atonement for yourself and for the people, and make the
people’s offering and make atonement for them as YHWH
commanded.”

translation.text: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the LORD commanded.

verses.english:
And Moses said to Aaron, “Come forward to the altar and
make your sin offering and your burnt offering and make
atonement for yourself and for the people, and make the
people’s offering and make atonement for them as YHWH
commanded.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרַב אַהֲרֹן אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּשְׁחַט אֶת עֵגֶל הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרַב אַהֲרֹן אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּשְׁחַט אֶת עֵגֶל הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ׃

english.text:
And Aaron came forward to the altar and slaughtered the
calf for the sin offering that he had.

translation.text: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

verses.english:
And Aaron came forward to the altar and slaughtered the
calf for the sin offering that he had.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרִבוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַדָּם אֵלָיו וַיִּטְבֹּל אֶצְבָּעוֹ בַּדָּם וַיִּתֵּן עַל קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת הַדָּם יָצַק אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרִבוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַדָּם אֵלָיו וַיִּטְבֹּל אֶצְבָּעוֹ בַּדָּם וַיִּתֵּן עַל קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת הַדָּם יָצַק אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And Aaron’s sons brought forward the blood to him, and he
dipped his finger in the blood and put it on the altar’s
horns, and he poured the blood to the base of the altar.

translation.text: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:

verses.english:
And Aaron’s sons brought forward the blood to him, and he
dipped his finger in the blood and put it on the altar’s
horns, and he poured the blood to the base of the altar.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב וְאֶת הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת מִן הַכָּבֵד מִן הַחַטָּאת הִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב וְאֶת הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת מִן הַכָּבֵד מִן הַחַטָּאת הִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he burned the fat and the kidneys and the lobe from
the liver from the sin offering to smoke at the altar, as
YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And he burned the fat and the kidneys and the lobe from
the liver from the sin offering to smoke at the altar, as
YHWH had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַבָּשָׂר וְאֶת הָעוֹר שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַבָּשָׂר וְאֶת הָעוֹר שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And he burned the meat and the skin in fire outside the
camp.

translation.text: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.

verses.english:
And he burned the meat and the skin in fire outside the
camp.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁחַט אֶת הָעֹלָה וַיַּמְצִאוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֵלָיו אֶת הַדָּם וַיִּזְרְקֵהוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁחַט אֶת הָעֹלָה וַיַּמְצִאוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֵלָיו אֶת הַדָּם וַיִּזְרְקֵהוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And he slaughtered the burnt offering. And Aaron’s sons
presented the blood to him, and he flung it on the altar
all around.

translation.text: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.

verses.english:
And he slaughtered the burnt offering. And Aaron’s sons
presented the blood to him, and he flung it on the altar
all around.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָעֹלָה הִמְצִיאוּ אֵלָיו לִנְתָחֶיהָ וְאֶת הָרֹאשׁ וַיַּקְטֵר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָעֹלָה הִמְצִיאוּ אֵלָיו לִנְתָחֶיהָ וְאֶת הָרֹאשׁ וַיַּקְטֵר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And they presented the burnt offering to him in its parts
and the head, and he burned it to smoke on the altar.

translation.text: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.

verses.english:
And they presented the burnt offering to him in its parts
and the head, and he burned it to smoke on the altar.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְחַץ אֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֶת הַכְּרָעָיִם וַיַּקְטֵר עַל הָעֹלָה הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְחַץ אֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֶת הַכְּרָעָיִם וַיַּקְטֵר עַל הָעֹלָה הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

english.text:
And he washed the innards and the legs and burned them to
smoke with the burnt offering at the altar.

translation.text: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.

verses.english:
And he washed the innards and the legs and burned them to
smoke with the burnt offering at the altar.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֵת קרְבַּן הָעָם וַיִּקַּח אֶת שְׂעִיר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לָעָם וַיִּשְׁחָטֵהוּ וַיְחַטְּאֵהוּ כָּרִאשׁוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֵת קרְבַּן הָעָם וַיִּקַּח אֶת שְׂעִיר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לָעָם וַיִּשְׁחָטֵהוּ וַיְחַטְּאֵהוּ כָּרִאשׁוֹן׃

english.text:
And he made the people’s offering: and he took the goat
for the sin offering that was the people’s, and he
slaughtered it and made a sin offering with it like the
first one.

translation.text: And he brought the people’s offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.

verses.english:
And he made the people’s offering: and he took the goat
for the sin offering that was the people’s, and he
slaughtered it and made a sin offering with it like the
first one.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת הָעֹלָה וַיַּעֲשֶׂהָ כַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת הָעֹלָה וַיַּעֲשֶׂהָ כַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃

english.text:
And he brought forward the burnt offering and made it
according to the required manner.

translation.text: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.

verses.english:
And he brought forward the burnt offering and made it
according to the required manner.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת הַמִּנְחָה וַיְמַלֵּא כַפּוֹ מִמֶּנָּה וַיַּקְטֵר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַבֹּקֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת הַמִּנְחָה וַיְמַלֵּא כַפּוֹ מִמֶּנָּה וַיַּקְטֵר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַבֹּקֶר׃

english.text:
And he brought forward the grain offering and filled his
hand from it and burned it to smoke on the altar—apart
from the morning’s burnt offering.

translation.text: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.

verses.english:
And he brought forward the grain offering and filled his
hand from it and burned it to smoke on the altar—apart
from the morning’s burnt offering.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁחַט אֶת הַשּׁוֹר וְאֶת הָאַיִל זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר לָעָם וַיַּמְצִאוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַדָּם אֵלָיו וַיִּזְרְקֵהוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁחַט אֶת הַשּׁוֹר וְאֶת הָאַיִל זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר לָעָם וַיַּמְצִאוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַדָּם אֵלָיו וַיִּזְרְקֵהוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And he slaughtered the ox and the ram, the peace-offering
sacrifice that was the people’s. And Aaron’s sons
presented the blood to him, and he flung it on the altar
all around,

translation.text: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,

verses.english:
And he slaughtered the ox and the ram, the peace-offering
sacrifice that was the people’s. And Aaron’s sons
presented the blood to him, and he flung it on the altar
all around,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַחֲלָבִים מִן הַשּׁוֹר וּמִן הָאַיִל הָאַלְיָה וְהַמְכַסֶּה וְהַכְּלָיֹת וְיֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַחֲלָבִים מִן הַשּׁוֹר וּמִן הָאַיִל הָאַלְיָה וְהַמְכַסֶּה וְהַכְּלָיֹת וְיֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד׃

english.text:
and the fats from the ox and from the ram, the fat tail
and the covering and the kidneys and the lobe of the
liver.

translation.text: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:

verses.english:
and the fats from the ox and from the ram, the fat tail
and the covering and the kidneys and the lobe of the
liver.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת הַחֲלָבִים עַל הֶחָזוֹת וַיַּקְטֵר הַחֲלָבִים הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת הַחֲלָבִים עַל הֶחָזוֹת וַיַּקְטֵר הַחֲלָבִים הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

english.text:
And they set the fats on the breasts, and he burned the
fats to smoke at the altar.

translation.text: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:

verses.english:
And they set the fats on the breasts, and he burned the
fats to smoke at the altar.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת הֶחָזוֹת וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין הֵנִיף אַהֲרֹן תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת הֶחָזוֹת וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין הֵנִיף אַהֲרֹן תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Aaron elevated the breasts and the right thigh, an
elevation offering in front of YHWH, as Moses had
commanded.

translation.text: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the LORD; as Moses commanded.

verses.english:
And Aaron elevated the breasts and the right thigh, an
elevation offering in front of YHWH, as Moses had
commanded.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא אַהֲרֹן אֶת יָדָו אֶל הָעָם וַיְבָרְכֵם וַיֵּרֶד מֵעֲשֹׂת הַחַטָּאת וְהָעֹלָה וְהַשְּׁלָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא אַהֲרֹן אֶת יָדָו אֶל הָעָם וַיְבָרְכֵם וַיֵּרֶד מֵעֲשֹׂת הַחַטָּאת וְהָעֹלָה וְהַשְּׁלָמִים׃

english.text:
And Aaron raised his hands to the people and blessed them.
And he went down from making the sin offering and the
burnt offering and the peace offering.

translation.text: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.

verses.english:
And Aaron raised his hands to the people and blessed them.
And he went down from making the sin offering and the
burnt offering and the peace offering.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיֵּצְאוּ וַיְבָרְכוּ אֶת הָעָם וַיֵּרָא כְבוֹד יְהֹוָה אֶל כּל הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיֵּצְאוּ וַיְבָרְכוּ אֶת הָעָם וַיֵּרָא כְבוֹד יְהֹוָה אֶל כּל הָעָם׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron came to the Tent of Meeting, and they
went out and blessed the people. And YHWH’s glory appeared
to all the people.

translation.text: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the people.

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron came to the Tent of Meeting, and they
went out and blessed the people. And YHWH’s glory appeared
to all the people.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּצֵא אֵשׁ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֶת הָעֹלָה וְאֶת הַחֲלָבִים וַיַּרְא כּל הָעָם וַיָּרֹנּוּ וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל פְּנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּצֵא אֵשׁ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֶת הָעֹלָה וְאֶת הַחֲלָבִים וַיַּרְא כּל הָעָם וַיָּרֹנּוּ וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל פְּנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And fire came out from in front of YHWH and consumed the
burnt offering and the fats on the altar! And all the
people saw, and they shouted, and they fell on their
faces!

translation.text: And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

verses.english:
And fire came out from in front of YHWH and consumed the
burnt offering and the fats on the altar! And all the
people saw, and they shouted, and they fell on their
faces!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ בְנֵי אַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ וַיִּתְּנוּ בָהֵן אֵשׁ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עָלֶיהָ קְטֹרֶת וַיַּקְרִיבוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֵשׁ זָרָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא צִוָּה אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ בְנֵי אַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ וַיִּתְּנוּ בָהֵן אֵשׁ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עָלֶיהָ קְטֹרֶת וַיַּקְרִיבוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֵשׁ זָרָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא צִוָּה אֹתָם׃

english.text:
And Aaron’s sons, Nadab and Abihu, each took his
fire-holder, and they put fire in them and set incense on
it. And they brought forward unfitting fire, which He had
not commanded them, in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.

verses.english:
And Aaron’s sons, Nadab and Abihu, each took his
fire-holder, and they put fire in them and set incense on
it. And they brought forward unfitting fire, which He had
not commanded them, in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּצֵא אֵשׁ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל אוֹתָם וַיָּמֻתוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּצֵא אֵשׁ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל אוֹתָם וַיָּמֻתוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And fire came out from in front of YHWH and consumed them!
And they died in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And there went out fire from the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.

verses.english:
And fire came out from in front of YHWH and consumed them!
And they died in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן הוּא אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר בִּקְרֹבַי אֶקָּדֵשׁ וְעַל פְּנֵי כל הָעָם אֶכָּבֵד וַיִּדֹּם אַהֲרֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן הוּא אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר בִּקְרֹבַי אֶקָּדֵשׁ וְעַל פְּנֵי כל הָעָם אֶכָּבֵד וַיִּדֹּם אַהֲרֹן׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Aaron, “That is what YHWH spoke, saying,
‘I shall be made holy through those who are close to me,
and I shall be honored in front of all the people.’” And
Aaron was silent.

translation.text: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that the LORD spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.

verses.english:
And Moses said to Aaron, “That is what YHWH spoke, saying,
‘I shall be made holy through those who are close to me,
and I shall be honored in front of all the people.’” And
Aaron was silent.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה אֶל מִישָׁאֵל וְאֶל אֶלְצָפָן בְּנֵי עֻזִּיאֵל דֹּד אַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם קִרְבוּ שְׂאוּ אֶת אֲחֵיכֶם מֵאֵת פְּנֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה אֶל מִישָׁאֵל וְאֶל אֶלְצָפָן בְּנֵי עֻזִּיאֵל דֹּד אַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם קִרְבוּ שְׂאוּ אֶת אֲחֵיכֶם מֵאֵת פְּנֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And Moses called to Mishael and to Elzaphan, sons of
Uzziel, Aaron’s uncle, and said to them, “Come forward.
Carry your brothers from in front of the Holy to the
outside of the camp.”

translation.text: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.

verses.english:
And Moses called to Mishael and to Elzaphan, sons of
Uzziel, Aaron’s uncle, and said to them, “Come forward.
Carry your brothers from in front of the Holy to the
outside of the camp.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְבוּ וַיִּשָּׂאֻם בְּכֻתֳּנֹתָם אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְבוּ וַיִּשָּׂאֻם בְּכֻתֳּנֹתָם אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And they came forward and carried them by their coats to
the outside of the camp as Moses had spoken.

translation.text: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.

verses.english:
And they came forward and carried them by their coats to
the outside of the camp as Moses had spoken.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן וּלְאֶלְעָזָר וּלְאִיתָמָר בָּנָיו רָאשֵׁיכֶם אַל תִּפְרָעוּ וּבִגְדֵיכֶם לֹא תִפְרֹמוּ וְלֹא תָמֻתוּ וְעַל כּל הָעֵדָה יִקְצֹף וַאֲחֵיכֶם כּל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל יִבְכּוּ אֶת הַשְּׂרֵפָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂרַף יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן וּלְאֶלְעָזָר וּלְאִיתָמָר בָּנָיו רָאשֵׁיכֶם אַל תִּפְרָעוּ וּבִגְדֵיכֶם לֹא תִפְרֹמוּ וְלֹא תָמֻתוּ וְעַל כּל הָעֵדָה יִקְצֹף וַאֲחֵיכֶם כּל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל יִבְכּוּ אֶת הַשְּׂרֵפָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂרַף יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his
sons, “Don’t let loose the hair of your heads and don’t
tear your clothes, so you won’t die and He’ll be angry at
all the congregation. And your brothers, all the house of
Israel, will weep for the burning that YHWH has made.

translation.text: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled.

verses.english:
And Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his
sons, “Don’t let loose the hair of your heads and don’t
tear your clothes, so you won’t die and He’ll be angry at
all the congregation. And your brothers, all the house of
Israel, will weep for the burning that YHWH has made.

verses.hebrew: וּמִפֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֹא תֵצְאוּ פֶּן תָּמֻתוּ כִּי שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כִּדְבַר מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וּמִפֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֹא תֵצְאוּ פֶּן תָּמֻתוּ כִּי שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כִּדְבַר מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And you shall not go out from the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting, or else you’ll die, because YHWH’s anointing oil
is on you.” And they did according to Moses’ word.

translation.text: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the LORD is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.

verses.english:
And you shall not go out from the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting, or else you’ll die, because YHWH’s anointing oil
is on you.” And they did according to Moses’ word.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Aaron, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Aaron, saying,

verses.hebrew: יַיִן וְשֵׁכָר אַל תֵּשְׁתְּ אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ אִתָּךְ בְּבֹאֲכֶם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְלֹא תָמֻתוּ חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: יַיִן וְשֵׁכָר אַל תֵּשְׁתְּ אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ אִתָּךְ בְּבֹאֲכֶם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְלֹא תָמֻתוּ חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“You shall not drink wine and beer, you and your sons with
you, when you come to the Tent of Meeting, so you won’t
die. It is an eternal law through your generations,

translation.text: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:

verses.english:
“You shall not drink wine and beer, you and your sons with
you, when you come to the Tent of Meeting, so you won’t
die. It is an eternal law through your generations,

verses.hebrew: וּלְהַבְדִּיל בֵּין הַקֹּדֶשׁ וּבֵין הַחֹל וּבֵין הַטָּמֵא וּבֵין הַטָּהוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וּלְהַבְדִּיל בֵּין הַקֹּדֶשׁ וּבֵין הַחֹל וּבֵין הַטָּמֵא וּבֵין הַטָּהוֹר׃

english.text:
and to distinguish between the holy and the secular, and
between the impure and the pure,

translation.text: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;

verses.english:
and to distinguish between the holy and the secular, and
between the impure and the pure,

verses.hebrew: וּלְהוֹרֹת אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל הַחֻקִּים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיהֶם בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וּלְהוֹרֹת אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל הַחֻקִּים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיהֶם בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
and to instruct the children of Israel all the laws that
YHWH has spoken to them by the hand of Moses.”

translation.text: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.

verses.english:
and to instruct the children of Israel all the laws that
YHWH has spoken to them by the hand of Moses.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָר וְאֶל אִיתָמָר בָּנָיו הַנּוֹתָרִים קְחוּ אֶת הַמִּנְחָה הַנּוֹתֶרֶת מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה וְאִכְלוּהָ מַצּוֹת אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כִּי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָר וְאֶל אִיתָמָר בָּנָיו הַנּוֹתָרִים קְחוּ אֶת הַמִּנְחָה הַנּוֹתֶרֶת מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה וְאִכְלוּהָ מַצּוֹת אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כִּי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his
sons who were left, “Take the grain offering that is left
from YHWH’s offerings by fire and eat it as unleavened
bread beside the altar, because it is the holy of holies.

translation.text: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it is most holy:

verses.english:
And Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his
sons who were left, “Take the grain offering that is left
from YHWH’s offerings by fire and eat it as unleavened
bread beside the altar, because it is the holy of holies.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם אֹתָהּ בְּמָקוֹם קָדוֹשׁ כִּי חקְךָ וְחק בָּנֶיךָ הִוא מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה כִּי כֵן צֻוֵּיתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם אֹתָהּ בְּמָקוֹם קָדוֹשׁ כִּי חקְךָ וְחק בָּנֶיךָ הִוא מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה כִּי כֵן צֻוֵּיתִי׃

english.text:
And you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your
statutory share, and it is your sons’ statutory share from
YHWH’s offerings by fire, because that is what I was
commanded.

translation.text: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons’ due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire: for so I am commanded.

verses.english:
And you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your
statutory share, and it is your sons’ statutory share from
YHWH’s offerings by fire, because that is what I was
commanded.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת חֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה תֹּאכְלוּ בְּמָקוֹם טָהוֹר אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ וּבְנֹתֶיךָ אִתָּךְ כִּי חקְךָ וְחק בָּנֶיךָ נִתְּנוּ מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת חֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה תֹּאכְלוּ בְּמָקוֹם טָהוֹר אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ וּבְנֹתֶיךָ אִתָּךְ כִּי חקְךָ וְחק בָּנֶיךָ נִתְּנוּ מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And you shall eat the breast of the elevation offering and
the thigh of the donation in a pure place—you and your
sons and your daughters with you—because they have been
given as your statutory share and your sons’ statutory
share from the peace-offering sacrifices of the children
of Israel.

translation.text: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they be thy due, and thy sons’ due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And you shall eat the breast of the elevation offering and
the thigh of the donation in a pure place—you and your
sons and your daughters with you—because they have been
given as your statutory share and your sons’ statutory
share from the peace-offering sacrifices of the children
of Israel.

verses.hebrew: שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה וַחֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה עַל אִשֵּׁי הַחֲלָבִים יָבִיאוּ לְהָנִיף תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְהָיָה לְךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ אִתְּךָ לְחק עוֹלָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה וַחֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה עַל אִשֵּׁי הַחֲלָבִים יָבִיאוּ לְהָנִיף תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְהָיָה לְךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ אִתְּךָ לְחק עוֹלָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
They shall bring the thigh of the donation and the breast
of the elevation offering with the offerings by fire of
the fats to elevate, an elevation offering in front of
YHWH; and it will be yours and your sons’ with you as an
eternal law, as YHWH commanded.”

translation.text: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD; and it shall be thine, and thy sons’ with thee, by a statute for ever; as the LORD hath commanded.

verses.english:
They shall bring the thigh of the donation and the breast
of the elevation offering with the offerings by fire of
the fats to elevate, an elevation offering in front of
YHWH; and it will be yours and your sons’ with you as an
eternal law, as YHWH commanded.”

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שְׂעִיר הַחַטָּאת דָּרֹשׁ דָּרַשׁ מֹשֶׁה וְהִנֵּה שֹׂרָף וַיִּקְצֹף עַל אֶלְעָזָר וְעַל אִיתָמָר בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַנּוֹתָרִם לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שְׂעִיר הַחַטָּאת דָּרֹשׁ דָּרַשׁ מֹשֶׁה וְהִנֵּה שֹׂרָף וַיִּקְצֹף עַל אֶלְעָזָר וְעַל אִיתָמָר בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַנּוֹתָרִם לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And Moses inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and
here it was burnt! And he was angry at Eleazar and at
Ithamar, Aaron’s sons who were left, saying,

translation.text: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive, saying,

verses.english:
And Moses inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and
here it was burnt! And he was angry at Eleazar and at
Ithamar, Aaron’s sons who were left, saying,

verses.hebrew: מַדּוּעַ לֹא אֲכַלְתֶּם אֶת הַחַטָּאת בִּמְקוֹם הַקֹּדֶשׁ כִּי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא וְאֹתָהּ נָתַן לָכֶם לָשֵׂאת אֶת עֲוֺן הָעֵדָה לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיהֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: מַדּוּעַ לֹא אֲכַלְתֶּם אֶת הַחַטָּאת בִּמְקוֹם הַקֹּדֶשׁ כִּי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא וְאֹתָהּ נָתַן לָכֶם לָשֵׂאת אֶת עֲוֺן הָעֵדָה לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיהֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Why didn’t you eat the sin offering in the place of the
Holy—because it’s the holy of holies, and He gave it to
you for bearing the congregation’s crime, for making
atonement over them in front of YHWH!

translation.text: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?

verses.english:
“Why didn’t you eat the sin offering in the place of the
Holy—because it’s the holy of holies, and He gave it to
you for bearing the congregation’s crime, for making
atonement over them in front of YHWH!

verses.hebrew: הֵן לֹא הוּבָא אֶת דָּמָהּ אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ פְּנִימָה אָכוֹל תֹּאכְלוּ אֹתָהּ בַּקֹּדֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוֵּיתִי׃

hebrew.text: הֵן לֹא הוּבָא אֶת דָּמָהּ אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ פְּנִימָה אָכוֹל תֹּאכְלוּ אֹתָהּ בַּקֹּדֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוֵּיתִי׃

english.text:
Here, its blood hasn’t been brought to the Holy, inside.
You should have eaten it in the Holy as I commanded!”

translation.text: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded.

verses.english:
Here, its blood hasn’t been brought to the Holy, inside.
You should have eaten it in the Holy as I commanded!”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אַהֲרֹן אֶל מֹשֶׁה הֵן הַיּוֹם הִקְרִיבוּ אֶת חַטָּאתָם וְאֶת עֹלָתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַתִּקְרֶאנָה אֹתִי כָּאֵלֶּה וְאָכַלְתִּי חַטָּאת הַיּוֹם הַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר אַהֲרֹן אֶל מֹשֶׁה הֵן הַיּוֹם הִקְרִיבוּ אֶת חַטָּאתָם וְאֶת עֹלָתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַתִּקְרֶאנָה אֹתִי כָּאֵלֶּה וְאָכַלְתִּי חַטָּאת הַיּוֹם הַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Aaron spoke to Moses: “Here, today they brought
forward their sin offering and their burnt offering in
front of YHWH. When things like these have happened to me,
if I had eaten a sin offering today would it be good in
YHWH’s eyes?”

translation.text: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD?

verses.english:
And Aaron spoke to Moses: “Here, today they brought
forward their sin offering and their burnt offering in
front of YHWH. When things like these have happened to me,
if I had eaten a sin offering today would it be good in
YHWH’s eyes?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע מֹשֶׁה וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע מֹשֶׁה וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינָיו׃

english.text: And Moses listened, and it was good in his eyes.

translation.text: And when Moses heard that, he was content.

verses.english: And Moses listened, and it was good in his eyes.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר אֲלֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר אֲלֵהֶם׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,

verses.hebrew: דַּבְּרוּ אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר זֹאת הַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכְלוּ מִכּל הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: דַּבְּרוּ אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר זֹאת הַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכְלוּ מִכּל הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: This is the
animal that you shall eat out of all the domestic animals
that are on the earth:

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: This is the
animal that you shall eat out of all the domestic animals
that are on the earth:

verses.hebrew: כֹּל מַפְרֶסֶת פַּרְסָה וְשֹׁסַעַת שֶׁסַע פְּרָסֹת מַעֲלַת גֵּרָה בַּבְּהֵמָה אֹתָהּ תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל מַפְרֶסֶת פַּרְסָה וְשֹׁסַעַת שֶׁסַע פְּרָסֹת מַעֲלַת גֵּרָה בַּבְּהֵמָה אֹתָהּ תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

english.text:
every one that has a hoof and that has a split of hooves,
that regurgitates cud among animals, you shall eat it.

translation.text: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.

verses.english:
every one that has a hoof and that has a split of hooves,
that regurgitates cud among animals, you shall eat it.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ אֶת זֶה לֹא תֹאכְלוּ מִמַּעֲלֵי הַגֵּרָה וּמִמַּפְרִסֵי הַפַּרְסָה אֶת הַגָּמָל כִּי מַעֲלֵה גֵרָה הוּא וּפַרְסָה אֵינֶנּוּ מַפְרִיס טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ אֶת זֶה לֹא תֹאכְלוּ מִמַּעֲלֵי הַגֵּרָה וּמִמַּפְרִסֵי הַפַּרְסָה אֶת הַגָּמָל כִּי מַעֲלֵה גֵרָה הוּא וּפַרְסָה אֵינֶנּוּ מַפְרִיס טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם׃

english.text:
Except you shall not eat this out of those that
regurgitate the cud and out of those that have a hoof: The
camel, because it regurgitates cud and does not have a
hoof; it is impure to you.

translation.text: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

verses.english:
Except you shall not eat this out of those that
regurgitate the cud and out of those that have a hoof: The
camel, because it regurgitates cud and does not have a
hoof; it is impure to you.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַשָּׁפָן כִּי מַעֲלֵה גֵרָה הוּא וּפַרְסָה לֹא יַפְרִיס טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַשָּׁפָן כִּי מַעֲלֵה גֵרָה הוּא וּפַרְסָה לֹא יַפְרִיס טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And the rock-badger, because it regurgitates cud and does
not have a hoof; it is impure to you.

translation.text: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

verses.english:
And the rock-badger, because it regurgitates cud and does
not have a hoof; it is impure to you.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָאַרְנֶבֶת כִּי מַעֲלַת גֵּרָה הִוא וּפַרְסָה לֹא הִפְרִיסָה טְמֵאָה הִוא לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָאַרְנֶבֶת כִּי מַעֲלַת גֵּרָה הִוא וּפַרְסָה לֹא הִפְרִיסָה טְמֵאָה הִוא לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And the hare, because it regurgitates cud and does not
have a hoof; it is impure to you.

translation.text: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

verses.english:
And the hare, because it regurgitates cud and does not
have a hoof; it is impure to you.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַחֲזִיר כִּי מַפְרִיס פַּרְסָה הוּא וְשֹׁסַע שֶׁסַע פַּרְסָה וְהוּא גֵּרָה לֹא יִגָּר טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַחֲזִיר כִּי מַפְרִיס פַּרְסָה הוּא וְשֹׁסַע שֶׁסַע פַּרְסָה וְהוּא גֵּרָה לֹא יִגָּר טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And the pig, because it has a hoof and has a split of
hooves, and it does not chew cud; it is impure to you.

translation.text: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.

verses.english:
And the pig, because it has a hoof and has a split of
hooves, and it does not chew cud; it is impure to you.

verses.hebrew: מִבְּשָׂרָם לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ וּבְנִבְלָתָם לֹא תִגָּעוּ טְמֵאִים הֵם לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: מִבְּשָׂרָם לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ וּבְנִבְלָתָם לֹא תִגָּעוּ טְמֵאִים הֵם לָכֶם׃

english.text:
You shall not eat from their meat, and you shall not touch
their carcass. They are impure to you.

translation.text: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they are unclean to you.

verses.english:
You shall not eat from their meat, and you shall not touch
their carcass. They are impure to you.

verses.hebrew: אֶת זֶה תֹּאכְלוּ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר בַּמָּיִם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ סְנַפִּיר וְקַשְׂקֶשֶׂת בַּמַּיִם בַּיַּמִּים וּבַנְּחָלִים אֹתָם תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

hebrew.text: אֶת זֶה תֹּאכְלוּ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר בַּמָּיִם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ סְנַפִּיר וְקַשְׂקֶשֶׂת בַּמַּיִם בַּיַּמִּים וּבַנְּחָלִים אֹתָם תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

english.text:
“You shall eat this out of all that are in the water:
every one that has fins and scales in the water—in the
seas and in the streams—you shall eat them.

translation.text: These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.

verses.english:
“You shall eat this out of all that are in the water:
every one that has fins and scales in the water—in the
seas and in the streams—you shall eat them.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר אֵין לוֹ סְנַפִּיר וְקַשְׂקֶשֶׂת בַּיַּמִּים וּבַנְּחָלִים מִכֹּל שֶׁרֶץ הַמַּיִם וּמִכֹּל נֶפֶשׁ הַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר בַּמָּיִם שֶׁקֶץ הֵם לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר אֵין לוֹ סְנַפִּיר וְקַשְׂקֶשֶׂת בַּיַּמִּים וּבַנְּחָלִים מִכֹּל שֶׁרֶץ הַמַּיִם וּמִכֹּל נֶפֶשׁ הַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר בַּמָּיִם שֶׁקֶץ הֵם לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And any one that does not have fins and scales in the seas
and in the streams—out of every swarming thing of the
water and out of every living being that is in the
water—they are a detestable thing to you,

translation.text: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:

verses.english:
And any one that does not have fins and scales in the seas
and in the streams—out of every swarming thing of the

verses.hebrew: וְשֶׁקֶץ יִהְיוּ לָכֶם מִבְּשָׂרָם לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ וְאֶת נִבְלָתָם תְּשַׁקֵּצוּ׃

and they shall be a detestable thing to you. You shall not

english.text:
Every one that does not have scales and fins in the water,
it is a detestable thing to you.

translation.text: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an abomination unto you.

verses.english:
Every one that does not have scales and fins in the water,
it is a detestable thing to you.

the bat.

verses.hebrew: כֹּל שֶׁרֶץ הָעוֹף הַהֹלֵךְ עַל אַרְבַּע שֶׁקֶץ הוּא לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל שֶׁרֶץ הָעוֹף הַהֹלֵךְ עַל אַרְבַּע שֶׁקֶץ הוּא לָכֶם׃

english.text:
Every swarming thing of flying creatures that goes on
four—it is a detestable thing to you.

translation.text: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.

verses.english:
Every swarming thing of flying creatures that goes on
four—it is a detestable thing to you.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ אֶת זֶה תֹּאכְלוּ מִכֹּל שֶׁרֶץ הָעוֹף הַהֹלֵךְ עַל אַרְבַּע אֲשֶׁר [לוֹ] (לא) כְרָעַיִם מִמַּעַל לְרַגְלָיו לְנַתֵּר בָּהֵן עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ אֶת זֶה תֹּאכְלוּ מִכֹּל שֶׁרֶץ הָעוֹף הַהֹלֵךְ עַל אַרְבַּע אֲשֶׁר [לוֹ] (לא) כְרָעַיִם מִמַּעַל לְרַגְלָיו לְנַתֵּר בָּהֵן עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Except you shall eat this out of every swarming thing of
flying creatures that goes on four: that which has jointed
legs above its feet, to leap by them on the earth.

translation.text: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;

verses.english:
Except you shall eat this out of every swarming thing of
flying creatures that goes on four: that which has jointed
legs above its feet, to leap by them on the earth.

verses.hebrew: אֶת אֵלֶּה מֵהֶם תֹּאכֵלוּ אֶת הָאַרְבֶּה לְמִינוֹ וְאֶת הַסּלְעָם לְמִינֵהוּ וְאֶת הַחַרְגֹּל לְמִינֵהוּ וְאֶת הֶחָגָב לְמִינֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: אֶת אֵלֶּה מֵהֶם תֹּאכֵלוּ אֶת הָאַרְבֶּה לְמִינוֹ וְאֶת הַסּלְעָם לְמִינֵהוּ וְאֶת הַחַרְגֹּל לְמִינֵהוּ וְאֶת הֶחָגָב לְמִינֵהוּ׃

english.text:
You shall eat these out of them: the locust by its kind
and the bald locust by its kind and the cricket by its
kind and the grasshopper by its kind.

translation.text: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.

verses.english:
You shall eat these out of them: the locust by its kind
and the bald locust by its kind and the cricket by its
kind and the grasshopper by its kind.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל שֶׁרֶץ הָעוֹף אֲשֶׁר לוֹ אַרְבַּע רַגְלָיִם שֶׁקֶץ הוּא לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל שֶׁרֶץ הָעוֹף אֲשֶׁר לוֹ אַרְבַּע רַגְלָיִם שֶׁקֶץ הוּא לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And every swarming thing of flying creatures that has four
legs—it is a detestable thing to you.

translation.text: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.

verses.english:
And every swarming thing of flying creatures that has four
legs—it is a detestable thing to you.

verses.hebrew: וּלְאֵלֶּה תִּטַּמָּאוּ כּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּנִבְלָתָם יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וּלְאֵלֶּה תִּטַּמָּאוּ כּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּנִבְלָתָם יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
“And you will become impure by these—everyone who touches
their carcass will be impure until evening,

translation.text: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
“And you will become impure by these—everyone who touches
their carcass will be impure until evening,

verses.hebrew: וְכל הַנֹּשֵׂא מִנִּבְלָתָם יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הַנֹּשֵׂא מִנִּבְלָתָם יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
and everyone who carries their carcass shall wash his
clothes and be impure until evening—

translation.text: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
and everyone who carries their carcass shall wash his
clothes and be impure until evening—

verses.hebrew: לְכל הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר הִוא מַפְרֶסֶת פַּרְסָה וְשֶׁסַע אֵינֶנָּה שֹׁסַעַת וְגֵרָה אֵינֶנָּה מַעֲלָה טְמֵאִים הֵם לָכֶם כּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהֶם יִטְמָא׃

hebrew.text: לְכל הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר הִוא מַפְרֶסֶת פַּרְסָה וְשֶׁסַע אֵינֶנָּה שֹׁסַעַת וְגֵרָה אֵינֶנָּה מַעֲלָה טְמֵאִים הֵם לָכֶם כּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהֶם יִטְמָא׃

english.text:
by every animal that has a hoof and does not have a split
of hooves and does not regurgitate its cud. They are
impure to you. Everyone who touches them will be impure.

translation.text: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.

verses.english:
by every animal that has a hoof and does not have a split
of hooves and does not regurgitate its cud. They are
impure to you. Everyone who touches them will be impure.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל הוֹלֵךְ עַל כַּפָּיו בְּכל הַחַיָּה הַהֹלֶכֶת עַל אַרְבַּע טְמֵאִים הֵם לָכֶם כּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּנִבְלָתָם יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל הוֹלֵךְ עַל כַּפָּיו בְּכל הַחַיָּה הַהֹלֶכֶת עַל אַרְבַּע טְמֵאִים הֵם לָכֶם כּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּנִבְלָתָם יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And every one that goes on its paws among all the animals
that go on four, they are impure to you. Everyone who
touches their carcass will be impure until evening,

translation.text: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
And every one that goes on its paws among all the animals
that go on four, they are impure to you. Everyone who
touches their carcass will be impure until evening,

verses.hebrew: וְהַנֹּשֵׂא אֶת נִבְלָתָם יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב טְמֵאִים הֵמָּה לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנֹּשֵׂא אֶת נִבְלָתָם יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב טְמֵאִים הֵמָּה לָכֶם׃

english.text:
and one who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes
and be impure until evening. They are impure to you.

translation.text: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.

verses.english:
and one who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes
and be impure until evening. They are impure to you.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה לָכֶם הַטָּמֵא בַּשֶּׁרֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵץ עַל הָאָרֶץ הַחֹלֶד וְהָעַכְבָּר וְהַצָּב לְמִינֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה לָכֶם הַטָּמֵא בַּשֶּׁרֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵץ עַל הָאָרֶץ הַחֹלֶד וְהָעַכְבָּר וְהַצָּב לְמִינֵהוּ׃

english.text:
“And this is the impure to you among the things that swarm
on the earth: the rat, the mouse, and the great lizard by
its kind

translation.text: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,

verses.english:
“And this is the impure to you among the things that swarm
on the earth: the rat, the mouse, and the great lizard by
its kind

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֲנָקָה וְהַכֹּחַ וְהַלְּטָאָה וְהַחֹמֶט וְהַתִּנְשָׁמֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֲנָקָה וְהַכֹּחַ וְהַלְּטָאָה וְהַחֹמֶט וְהַתִּנְשָׁמֶת׃

english.text:
and the gecko and the spotted lizard and the lizard and
the sand lizard and the chameleon.

translation.text: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.

verses.english:
and the gecko and the spotted lizard and the lizard and
the sand lizard and the chameleon.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַטְּמֵאִים לָכֶם בְּכל הַשָּׁרֶץ כּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהֶם בְּמֹתָם יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה הַטְּמֵאִים לָכֶם בְּכל הַשָּׁרֶץ כּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהֶם בְּמֹתָם יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
These are the impure to you among all the swarming things.
Everyone who touches them when they are dead will be
impure until evening.

translation.text: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
These are the impure to you among all the swarming things.
Everyone who touches them when they are dead will be
impure until evening.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִפֹּל עָלָיו מֵהֶם בְּמֹתָם יִטְמָא מִכּל כְּלִי עֵץ אוֹ בֶגֶד אוֹ עוֹר אוֹ שָׂק כּל כְּלִי אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה מְלָאכָה בָּהֶם בַּמַּיִם יוּבָא וְטָמֵא עַד הָעֶרֶב וְטָהֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִפֹּל עָלָיו מֵהֶם בְּמֹתָם יִטְמָא מִכּל כְּלִי עֵץ אוֹ בֶגֶד אוֹ עוֹר אוֹ שָׂק כּל כְּלִי אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה מְלָאכָה בָּהֶם בַּמַּיִם יוּבָא וְטָמֵא עַד הָעֶרֶב וְטָהֵר׃

english.text:
And everything on which one of them will fall when they
are dead will be impure, out of every wooden item or
clothing or leather or sack, every item with which work
may be done shall be put in water and will be impure until
evening and then will be pure.

translation.text: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.

verses.english:
And everything on which one of them will fall when they
are dead will be impure, out of every wooden item or
clothing or leather or sack, every item with which work
may be done shall be put in water and will be impure until
evening and then will be pure.

verses.hebrew: וְכל כְּלִי חֶרֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר יִפֹּל מֵהֶם אֶל תּוֹכוֹ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹכוֹ יִטְמָא וְאֹתוֹ תִשְׁבֹּרוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל כְּלִי חֶרֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר יִפֹּל מֵהֶם אֶל תּוֹכוֹ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹכוֹ יִטְמָא וְאֹתוֹ תִשְׁבֹּרוּ׃

english.text:
And every clay container into which any of them will fall:
everything that is inside it will be impure, and you shall
break it.

translation.text: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.

verses.english:
And every clay container into which any of them will fall:
everything that is inside it will be impure, and you shall
break it.

verses.hebrew: מִכּל הָאֹכֶל אֲשֶׁר יֵאָכֵל אֲשֶׁר יָבוֹא עָלָיו מַיִם יִטְמָא וְכל מַשְׁקֶה אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׁתֶה בְּכל כְּלִי יִטְמָא׃

hebrew.text: מִכּל הָאֹכֶל אֲשֶׁר יֵאָכֵל אֲשֶׁר יָבוֹא עָלָיו מַיִם יִטְמָא וְכל מַשְׁקֶה אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׁתֶה בְּכל כְּלִי יִטְמָא׃

english.text:
Every food that may be eaten on which water will come will
be impure, and every liquid that may be drunk in any
container will be impure.

translation.text: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

verses.english:
Every food that may be eaten on which water will come will
be impure, and every liquid that may be drunk in any
container will be impure.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִפֹּל מִנִּבְלָתָם עָלָיו יִטְמָא תַּנּוּר וְכִירַיִם יֻתָּץ טְמֵאִים הֵם וּטְמֵאִים יִהְיוּ לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִפֹּל מִנִּבְלָתָם עָלָיו יִטְמָא תַּנּוּר וְכִירַיִם יֻתָּץ טְמֵאִים הֵם וּטְמֵאִים יִהְיוּ לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And everything on which some of their carcass will fall
will be impure. An oven or stove shall be demolished. They
are impure, and they shall be impure to you.

translation.text: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean and shall be unclean unto you.

verses.english:
And everything on which some of their carcass will fall
will be impure. An oven or stove shall be demolished. They
are impure, and they shall be impure to you.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ מַעְיָן וּבוֹר מִקְוֵה מַיִם יִהְיֶה טָהוֹר וְנֹגֵעַ בְּנִבְלָתָם יִטְמָא׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ מַעְיָן וּבוֹר מִקְוֵה מַיִם יִהְיֶה טָהוֹר וְנֹגֵעַ בְּנִבְלָתָם יִטְמָא׃

english.text:
Except a spring or a cistern with a concentration of
waters will be pure. And one who touches their carcass
will be impure.

translation.text: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.

verses.english:
Except a spring or a cistern with a concentration of
waters will be pure. And one who touches their carcass
will be impure.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִפֹּל מִנִּבְלָתָם עַל כּל זֶרַע זֵרוּעַ אֲשֶׁר יִזָּרֵעַ טָהוֹר הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִפֹּל מִנִּבְלָתָם עַל כּל זֶרַע זֵרוּעַ אֲשֶׁר יִזָּרֵעַ טָהוֹר הוּא׃

english.text:
And if some of their carcass will fall on any sowing seed
that will be sown, it is pure.

translation.text: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.

verses.english:
And if some of their carcass will fall on any sowing seed
that will be sown, it is pure.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יֻתַּן מַיִם עַל זֶרַע וְנָפַל מִנִּבְלָתָם עָלָיו טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יֻתַּן מַיִם עַל זֶרַע וְנָפַל מִנִּבְלָתָם עָלָיו טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And if water will be put on a seed, and some of their
carcass will fall on it, it is impure to you.

translation.text: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.

verses.english:
And if water will be put on a seed, and some of their
carcass will fall on it, it is impure to you.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יָמוּת מִן הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר הִיא לָכֶם לְאכְלָה הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּנִבְלָתָהּ יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יָמוּת מִן הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר הִיא לָכֶם לְאכְלָה הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּנִבְלָתָהּ יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
“And if any of the animals that are yours for food will
die, the one who touches its carcass will be impure until
evening,

translation.text: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
“And if any of the animals that are yours for food will
die, the one who touches its carcass will be impure until
evening,

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֹכֵל מִנִּבְלָתָהּ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב וְהַנֹּשֵׂא אֶת נִבְלָתָהּ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֹכֵל מִנִּבְלָתָהּ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב וְהַנֹּשֵׂא אֶת נִבְלָתָהּ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
and the one who eats some of its carcass shall wash his
clothes and is impure until evening, and the one who
carries its carcass shall wash his clothes and is impure
until evening.

translation.text: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
and the one who eats some of its carcass shall wash his
clothes and is impure until evening, and the one who
carries its carcass shall wash his clothes and is impure
until evening.

verses.hebrew: וְכל הַשֶּׁרֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵץ עַל הָאָרֶץ שֶׁקֶץ הוּא לֹא יֵאָכֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הַשֶּׁרֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵץ עַל הָאָרֶץ שֶׁקֶץ הוּא לֹא יֵאָכֵל׃

english.text:
“And every swarming creature that swarms on the earth, it
is a detestable thing. It shall not be eaten.

translation.text: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.

verses.english:
“And every swarming creature that swarms on the earth, it
is a detestable thing. It shall not be eaten.

verses.hebrew: כֹּל הוֹלֵךְ עַל גָּחוֹן וְכֹל הוֹלֵךְ עַל אַרְבַּע עַד כּל מַרְבֵּה רַגְלַיִם לְכל הַשֶּׁרֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵץ עַל הָאָרֶץ לֹא תֹאכְלוּם כִּי שֶׁקֶץ הֵם׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל הוֹלֵךְ עַל גָּחוֹן וְכֹל הוֹלֵךְ עַל אַרְבַּע עַד כּל מַרְבֵּה רַגְלַיִם לְכל הַשֶּׁרֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵץ עַל הָאָרֶץ לֹא תֹאכְלוּם כִּי שֶׁקֶץ הֵם׃

english.text:
Everything going on a belly and everything going on four
as well as everything having a great number of legs of
every swarming creature that swarms on the earth: you
shall not eat them because they are a detestable thing.

translation.text: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

verses.english:
Everything going on a belly and everything going on four
as well as everything having a great number of legs of
every swarming creature that swarms on the earth: you
shall not eat them because they are a detestable thing.

verses.hebrew: אַל תְּשַׁקְּצוּ אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם בְּכל הַשֶּׁרֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵץ וְלֹא תִטַּמְּאוּ בָּהֶם וְנִטְמֵתֶם בָּם׃

hebrew.text: אַל תְּשַׁקְּצוּ אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם בְּכל הַשֶּׁרֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵץ וְלֹא תִטַּמְּאוּ בָּהֶם וְנִטְמֵתֶם בָּם׃

english.text:
Do not make yourselves detestable with any swarming
creature that swarms, and you shall not become impure with
them, so that you will be impure through them.

translation.text: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.

verses.english:
Do not make yourselves detestable with any swarming
creature that swarms, and you shall not become impure with
them, so that you will be impure through them.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתֶּם וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אָנִי וְלֹא תְטַמְּאוּ אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם בְּכל הַשֶּׁרֶץ הָרֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתֶּם וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אָנִי וְלֹא תְטַמְּאוּ אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם בְּכל הַשֶּׁרֶץ הָרֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Because I am YHWH, your God, and you shall make yourselves
holy, and you shall be holy because I am holy. And you
shall not make yourselves impure with any swarming
creature that creeps on the earth.

translation.text: For I am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

verses.english:
Because I am YHWH, your God, and you shall make yourselves
holy, and you shall be holy because I am holy. And you
shall not make yourselves impure with any swarming
creature that creeps on the earth.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה הַמַּעֲלֶה אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִהְיֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אָנִי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה הַמַּעֲלֶה אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִהְיֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אָנִי׃

english.text:
Because I am YHWH, who brought you up from the land of
Egypt to be God to you, and you shall be holy because I am
holy.

translation.text: For I am the LORD that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

verses.english:
Because I am YHWH, who brought you up from the land of
Egypt to be God to you, and you shall be holy because I am
holy.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַבְּהֵמָה וְהָעוֹף וְכֹל נֶפֶשׁ הַחַיָּה הָרֹמֶשֶׂת בַּמָּיִם וּלְכל נֶפֶשׁ הַשֹּׁרֶצֶת עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַבְּהֵמָה וְהָעוֹף וְכֹל נֶפֶשׁ הַחַיָּה הָרֹמֶשֶׂת בַּמָּיִם וּלְכל נֶפֶשׁ הַשֹּׁרֶצֶת עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
“This is the instruction for animal and bird and every
living being that moves in the water and for every being
that swarms on the earth,

translation.text: This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:

verses.english:
“This is the instruction for animal and bird and every
living being that moves in the water and for every being
that swarms on the earth,

verses.hebrew: לְהַבְדִּיל בֵּין הַטָּמֵא וּבֵין הַטָּהֹר וּבֵין הַחַיָּה הַנֶּאֱכֶלֶת וּבֵין הַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵאָכֵל׃

hebrew.text: לְהַבְדִּיל בֵּין הַטָּמֵא וּבֵין הַטָּהֹר וּבֵין הַחַיָּה הַנֶּאֱכֶלֶת וּבֵין הַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵאָכֵל׃

english.text:
to distinguish between the impure and the pure, and
between the living thing that is eaten and the living
thing that shall not be eaten.”

translation.text: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.

verses.english:
to distinguish between the impure and the pure, and
between the living thing that is eaten and the living
thing that shall not be eaten.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אִשָּׁה כִּי תַזְרִיעַ וְיָלְדָה זָכָר וְטָמְאָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים כִּימֵי נִדַּת דְּוֺתָהּ תִּטְמָא׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אִשָּׁה כִּי תַזְרִיעַ וְיָלְדָה זָכָר וְטָמְאָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים כִּימֵי נִדַּת דְּוֺתָהּ תִּטְמָא׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: A woman, when
she will bear seed and give birth to a male, will be
impure seven days. She will be impure like the days of the
impurity of her menstruation.

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: A woman, when
she will bear seed and give birth to a male, will be
impure seven days. She will be impure like the days of the
impurity of her menstruation.

verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי יִמּוֹל בְּשַׂר ערְלָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי יִמּוֹל בְּשַׂר ערְלָתוֹ׃

english.text:
And on the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be
circumcised.

translation.text: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

verses.english:
And on the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be
circumcised.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים תֵּשֵׁב בִּדְמֵי טהֳרָה בְּכל קֹדֶשׁ לֹא תִגָּע וְאֶל הַמִּקְדָּשׁ לֹא תָבֹא עַד מְלֹאת יְמֵי טהֳרָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים תֵּשֵׁב בִּדְמֵי טהֳרָה בְּכל קֹדֶשׁ לֹא תִגָּע וְאֶל הַמִּקְדָּשׁ לֹא תָבֹא עַד מְלֹאת יְמֵי טהֳרָהּ׃

english.text:
And thirty days and three days she shall remain in blood
of purity. She shall not touch any holy thing, and she
shall not come to the holy place until the completion of
the days of her purification.

translation.text: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.

verses.english:
And thirty days and three days she shall remain in blood
of purity. She shall not touch any holy thing, and she
shall not come to the holy place until the completion of
the days of her purification.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם נְקֵבָה תֵלֵד וְטָמְאָה שְׁבֻעַיִם כְּנִדָּתָהּ וְשִׁשִּׁים יוֹם וְשֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תֵּשֵׁב עַל דְּמֵי טהֳרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם נְקֵבָה תֵלֵד וְטָמְאָה שְׁבֻעַיִם כְּנִדָּתָהּ וְשִׁשִּׁים יוֹם וְשֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תֵּשֵׁב עַל דְּמֵי טהֳרָה׃

english.text:
And if she will give birth to a female, then she will be
impure two weeks, like her impurity. And sixty days and
six days she shall remain with blood of purity.

translation.text: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.

verses.english:
And if she will give birth to a female, then she will be
impure two weeks, like her impurity. And sixty days and
six days she shall remain with blood of purity.

verses.hebrew: וּבִמְלֹאת יְמֵי טהֳרָהּ לְבֵן אוֹ לְבַת תָּבִיא כֶּבֶשׂ בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָה וּבֶן יוֹנָה אוֹ תֹר לְחַטָּאת אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וּבִמְלֹאת יְמֵי טהֳרָהּ לְבֵן אוֹ לְבַת תָּבִיא כֶּבֶשׂ בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָה וּבֶן יוֹנָה אוֹ תֹר לְחַטָּאת אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
And at the completion of the days of her purification, for
a son or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb in its
first year for a burnt offering and a pigeon or a
turtledove for a sin offering to the entrance of the Tent
of Meeting, to the priest.

translation.text: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:

verses.english:
And at the completion of the days of her purification, for
a son or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb in its
first year for a burnt offering and a pigeon or a
turtledove for a sin offering to the entrance of the Tent
of Meeting, to the priest.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיבוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְכִפֶּר עָלֶיהָ וְטָהֲרָה מִמְּקֹר דָּמֶיהָ זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַיֹּלֶדֶת לַזָּכָר אוֹ לַנְּקֵבָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיבוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְכִפֶּר עָלֶיהָ וְטָהֲרָה מִמְּקֹר דָּמֶיהָ זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַיֹּלֶדֶת לַזָּכָר אוֹ לַנְּקֵבָה׃

english.text:
And he shall bring it forward in front of YHWH and make
atonement over her, and she will be purified from the
source of her blood. This is the instruction for the one
giving birth to a male or to a female.
