translation.text: Who shall offer it before the LORD, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.

verses.english:
And he shall bring it forward in front of YHWH and make
atonement over her, and she will be purified from the
source of her blood. This is the instruction for the one
giving birth to a male or to a female.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא תִמְצָא יָדָהּ דֵּי שֶׂה וְלָקְחָה שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה אֶחָד לְעֹלָה וְאֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וְכִפֶּר עָלֶיהָ הַכֹּהֵן וְטָהֵרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא תִמְצָא יָדָהּ דֵּי שֶׂה וְלָקְחָה שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה אֶחָד לְעֹלָה וְאֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וְכִפֶּר עָלֶיהָ הַכֹּהֵן וְטָהֵרָה׃

english.text:
And if her hand will not find enough for a sheep, then she
shall take two turtledoves or two pigeons, one for a burnt
offering and one for a sin offering, and the priest shall
make atonement over her, and she will be purified.”

translation.text: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.

verses.english:
And if her hand will not find enough for a sheep, then she
shall take two turtledoves or two pigeons, one for a burnt
offering and one for a sin offering, and the priest shall
make atonement over her, and she will be purified.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.hebrew: אָדָם כִּי יִהְיֶה בְעוֹר בְּשָׂרוֹ שְׂאֵת אוֹ סַפַּחַת אוֹ בַהֶרֶת וְהָיָה בְעוֹר בְּשָׂרוֹ לְנֶגַע צָרָעַת וְהוּבָא אֶל אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן אוֹ אֶל אַחַד מִבָּנָיו הַכֹּהֲנִים׃

hebrew.text: אָדָם כִּי יִהְיֶה בְעוֹר בְּשָׂרוֹ שְׂאֵת אוֹ סַפַּחַת אוֹ בַהֶרֶת וְהָיָה בְעוֹר בְּשָׂרוֹ לְנֶגַע צָרָעַת וְהוּבָא אֶל אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן אוֹ אֶל אַחַד מִבָּנָיו הַכֹּהֲנִים׃

english.text:
“When a person will have a swelling or a rash or a bright
spot in his flesh’s skin, and it becomes an affliction of
leprosy in his flesh’s skin, and he will be brought to
Aaron, the priest, or to one of his sons, the priests,

translation.text: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:

verses.english:
“When a person will have a swelling or a rash or a bright
spot in his flesh’s skin, and it becomes an affliction of
leprosy in his flesh’s skin, and he will be brought to
Aaron, the priest, or to one of his sons, the priests,

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנֶּגַע בְּעוֹר הַבָּשָׂר וְשֵׂעָר בַּנֶּגַע הָפַךְ לָבָן וּמַרְאֵה הַנֶּגַע עָמֹק מֵעוֹר בְּשָׂרוֹ נֶגַע צָרַעַת הוּא וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן וְטִמֵּא אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנֶּגַע בְּעוֹר הַבָּשָׂר וְשֵׂעָר בַּנֶּגַע הָפַךְ לָבָן וּמַרְאֵה הַנֶּגַע עָמֹק מֵעוֹר בְּשָׂרוֹ נֶגַע צָרַעַת הוּא וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן וְטִמֵּא אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
and the priest will see the affliction in the flesh’s
skin, and hair in the affliction will have turned white,
and the affliction’s appearance is deeper than his flesh’s
skin, it is an affliction of leprosy. And when the priest
will see it he shall identify him as impure.

translation.text: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.

verses.english:
and the priest will see the affliction in the flesh’s
skin, and hair in the affliction will have turned white,
and the affliction’s appearance is deeper than his flesh’s
skin, it is an affliction of leprosy. And when the priest
will see it he shall identify him as impure.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם בַּהֶרֶת לְבָנָה הִוא בְּעוֹר בְּשָׂרוֹ וְעָמֹק אֵין מַרְאֶהָ מִן הָעוֹר וּשְׂעָרָה לֹא הָפַךְ לָבָן וְהִסְגִּיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנֶּגַע שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בַּהֶרֶת לְבָנָה הִוא בְּעוֹר בְּשָׂרוֹ וְעָמֹק אֵין מַרְאֶהָ מִן הָעוֹר וּשְׂעָרָה לֹא הָפַךְ לָבָן וְהִסְגִּיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנֶּגַע שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

english.text:
And if it is a white bright spot in his flesh’s skin, and
its appearance is not deeper than the skin, and its hair
has not turned white, then the priest shall shut in the
one with the affliction seven days.

translation.text: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days:

verses.english:
And if it is a white bright spot in his flesh’s skin, and
its appearance is not deeper than the skin, and its hair
has not turned white, then the priest shall shut in the
one with the affliction seven days.

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְהִנֵּה הַנֶּגַע עָמַד בְּעֵינָיו לֹא פָשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בָּעוֹר וְהִסְגִּירוֹ הַכֹּהֵן שִׁבְעַת יָמִים שֵׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְהִנֵּה הַנֶּגַע עָמַד בְּעֵינָיו לֹא פָשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בָּעוֹר וְהִסְגִּירוֹ הַכֹּהֵן שִׁבְעַת יָמִים שֵׁנִית׃

english.text:
And the priest shall see him on the seventh day; and,
here, in his eyes the affliction will have stayed the
same—the affliction has not spread in the skin—then the
priest shall shut him in seven days a second time.

translation.text: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:

verses.english:
And the priest shall see him on the seventh day; and,
here, in his eyes the affliction will have stayed the
same—the affliction has not spread in the skin—then the
priest shall shut him in seven days a second time.

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֹתוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שֵׁנִית וְהִנֵּה כֵּהָה הַנֶּגַע וְלֹא פָשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בָּעוֹר וְטִהֲרוֹ הַכֹּהֵן מִסְפַּחַת הִוא וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָהֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֹתוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שֵׁנִית וְהִנֵּה כֵּהָה הַנֶּגַע וְלֹא פָשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בָּעוֹר וְטִהֲרוֹ הַכֹּהֵן מִסְפַּחַת הִוא וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָהֵר׃

english.text:
And the priest shall see him on the seventh day a second
time; and, here, the affliction has become dim, and the
affliction has not spread in the skin, then the priest
shall identify him as pure. It is a rash. And he shall
wash his clothes and be pure.

translation.text: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague be somewhat dark, and the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is but a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

verses.english:
And the priest shall see him on the seventh day a second
time; and, here, the affliction has become dim, and the
affliction has not spread in the skin, then the priest
shall identify him as pure. It is a rash. And he shall
wash his clothes and be pure.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם פָּשֹׂה תִפְשֶׂה הַמִּסְפַּחַת בָּעוֹר אַחֲרֵי הֵרָאֹתוֹ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן לְטהֳרָתוֹ וְנִרְאָה שֵׁנִית אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם פָּשֹׂה תִפְשֶׂה הַמִּסְפַּחַת בָּעוֹר אַחֲרֵי הֵרָאֹתוֹ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן לְטהֳרָתוֹ וְנִרְאָה שֵׁנִית אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
But if the rash has spread in the skin after his being
seen by the priest for pronouncing him pure, and he is
seen a second time by the priest,

translation.text: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again.

verses.english:
But if the rash has spread in the skin after his being
seen by the priest for pronouncing him pure, and he is
seen a second time by the priest,

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה פָּשְׂתָה הַמִּסְפַּחַת בָּעוֹר וְטִמְּאוֹ הַכֹּהֵן צָרַעַת הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה פָּשְׂתָה הַמִּסְפַּחַת בָּעוֹר וְטִמְּאוֹ הַכֹּהֵן צָרַעַת הִוא׃

english.text:
and the priest sees, and, here, the rash has spread in the
skin, then the priest shall identify him as impure. It is
leprosy.

translation.text: And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.

verses.english:
and the priest sees, and, here, the rash has spread in the
skin, then the priest shall identify him as impure. It is
leprosy.

verses.hebrew: נֶגַע צָרַעַת כִּי תִהְיֶה בְּאָדָם וְהוּבָא אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: נֶגַע צָרַעַת כִּי תִהְיֶה בְּאָדָם וְהוּבָא אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
“When an affliction of leprosy will be in a human, and he
will be brought to the priest,

translation.text: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;

verses.english:
“When an affliction of leprosy will be in a human, and he
will be brought to the priest,

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה שְׂאֵת לְבָנָה בָּעוֹר וְהִיא הָפְכָה שֵׂעָר לָבָן וּמִחְיַת בָּשָׂר חַי בַּשְׂאֵת׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה שְׂאֵת לְבָנָה בָּעוֹר וְהִיא הָפְכָה שֵׂעָר לָבָן וּמִחְיַת בָּשָׂר חַי בַּשְׂאֵת׃

english.text:
and the priest will see; and, here, a white swelling will
be in the skin, and it will have turned hair white, and
some vital flesh will be in the swelling,

translation.text: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;

verses.english:
and the priest will see; and, here, a white swelling will
be in the skin, and it will have turned hair white, and
some vital flesh will be in the swelling,

verses.hebrew: צָרַעַת נוֹשֶׁנֶת הִוא בְּעוֹר בְּשָׂרוֹ וְטִמְּאוֹ הַכֹּהֵן לֹא יַסְגִּרֶנּוּ כִּי טָמֵא הוּא׃

hebrew.text: צָרַעַת נוֹשֶׁנֶת הִוא בְּעוֹר בְּשָׂרוֹ וְטִמְּאוֹ הַכֹּהֵן לֹא יַסְגִּרֶנּוּ כִּי טָמֵא הוּא׃

english.text:
it is chronic leprosy in his flesh’s skin, and the priest
shall identify him as impure. He shall not shut him in,
because he is impure.

translation.text: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.

verses.english:
it is chronic leprosy in his flesh’s skin, and the priest
shall identify him as impure. He shall not shut him in,
because he is impure.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם פָּרוֹחַ תִּפְרַח הַצָּרַעַת בָּעוֹר וְכִסְּתָה הַצָּרַעַת אֵת כּל עוֹר הַנֶּגַע מֵרֹאשׁוֹ וְעַד רַגְלָיו לְכל מַרְאֵה עֵינֵי הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם פָּרוֹחַ תִּפְרַח הַצָּרַעַת בָּעוֹר וְכִסְּתָה הַצָּרַעַת אֵת כּל עוֹר הַנֶּגַע מֵרֹאשׁוֹ וְעַד רַגְלָיו לְכל מַרְאֵה עֵינֵי הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
And if the leprosy will develop in the skin, and the
leprosy will cover all the skin of the one with the
affliction from his head to his feet, to wherever it is
within sight of the priest’s eyes,

translation.text: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;

verses.english:
And if the leprosy will develop in the skin, and the
leprosy will cover all the skin of the one with the
affliction from his head to his feet, to wherever it is
within sight of the priest’s eyes,

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה כִסְּתָה הַצָּרַעַת אֶת כּל בְּשָׂרוֹ וְטִהַר אֶת הַנָּגַע כֻּלּוֹ הָפַךְ לָבָן טָהוֹר הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה כִסְּתָה הַצָּרַעַת אֶת כּל בְּשָׂרוֹ וְטִהַר אֶת הַנָּגַע כֻּלּוֹ הָפַךְ לָבָן טָהוֹר הוּא׃

english.text:
and the priest will see, and, here, the leprosy has
covered all his flesh, then he shall identify the one with
the affliction as pure. All of him has turned white. He is
pure.

translation.text: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.

verses.english:
and the priest will see, and, here, the leprosy has
covered all his flesh, then he shall identify the one with
the affliction as pure. All of him has turned white. He is
pure.

verses.hebrew: וּבְיוֹם הֵרָאוֹת בּוֹ בָּשָׂר חַי יִטְמָא׃

hebrew.text: וּבְיוֹם הֵרָאוֹת בּוֹ בָּשָׂר חַי יִטְמָא׃

english.text:
And on the day that vital flesh will appear in him he will
be impure.

translation.text: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.

verses.english:
And on the day that vital flesh will appear in him he will
be impure.

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַבָּשָׂר הַחַי וְטִמְּאוֹ הַבָּשָׂר הַחַי טָמֵא הוּא צָרַעַת הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַבָּשָׂר הַחַי וְטִמְּאוֹ הַבָּשָׂר הַחַי טָמֵא הוּא צָרַעַת הוּא׃

english.text:
And the priest will see the vital flesh and shall identify
him as impure. The vital flesh: it is impure. It is
leprosy.

translation.text: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.

verses.english:
And the priest will see the vital flesh and shall identify
him as impure. The vital flesh: it is impure. It is
leprosy.

verses.hebrew: אוֹ כִי יָשׁוּב הַבָּשָׂר הַחַי וְנֶהְפַּךְ לְלָבָן וּבָא אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ כִי יָשׁוּב הַבָּשָׂר הַחַי וְנֶהְפַּךְ לְלָבָן וּבָא אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
Or when the vital flesh will go back and turn to white,
and he will come to the priest,

translation.text: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;

verses.english:
Or when the vital flesh will go back and turn to white,
and he will come to the priest,

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה נֶהְפַּךְ הַנֶּגַע לְלָבָן וְטִהַר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנֶּגַע טָהוֹר הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה נֶהְפַּךְ הַנֶּגַע לְלָבָן וְטִהַר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנֶּגַע טָהוֹר הוּא׃

english.text:
and the priest will see him, and, here, the affliction has
turned to white, then the priest shall identify the
affliction as pure. He is pure.

translation.text: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: he is clean.

verses.english:
and the priest will see him, and, here, the affliction has
turned to white, then the priest shall identify the
affliction as pure. He is pure.

verses.hebrew: וּבָשָׂר כִּי יִהְיֶה בוֹ בְעֹרוֹ שְׁחִין וְנִרְפָּא׃

hebrew.text: וּבָשָׂר כִּי יִהְיֶה בוֹ בְעֹרוֹ שְׁחִין וְנִרְפָּא׃

english.text:
“And when flesh will have a boil in it, in its skin, and
will be healed,

translation.text: The flesh also, in which, even in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,

verses.english:
“And when flesh will have a boil in it, in its skin, and
will be healed,

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בִּמְקוֹם הַשְּׁחִין שְׂאֵת לְבָנָה אוֹ בַהֶרֶת לְבָנָה אֲדַמְדָּמֶת וְנִרְאָה אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בִּמְקוֹם הַשְּׁחִין שְׂאֵת לְבָנָה אוֹ בַהֶרֶת לְבָנָה אֲדַמְדָּמֶת וְנִרְאָה אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
and in place of the boil there will be a white swelling or
a reddish white bright spot, and he will be seen by the
priest,

translation.text: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;

verses.english:
and in place of the boil there will be a white swelling or
a reddish white bright spot, and he will be seen by the
priest,

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה מַרְאֶהָ שָׁפָל מִן הָעוֹר וּשְׂעָרָהּ הָפַךְ לָבָן וְטִמְּאוֹ הַכֹּהֵן נֶגַע צָרַעַת הִוא בַּשְּׁחִין פָּרָחָה׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה מַרְאֶהָ שָׁפָל מִן הָעוֹר וּשְׂעָרָהּ הָפַךְ לָבָן וְטִמְּאוֹ הַכֹּהֵן נֶגַע צָרַעַת הִוא בַּשְּׁחִין פָּרָחָה׃

english.text:
and the priest will see, and, here, its appearance is
lower than the skin, and its hair has turned white, then
the priest shall identify him as impure. It is an
affliction of leprosy. It has developed in the boil.

translation.text: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it be in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.

verses.english:
and the priest will see, and, here, its appearance is
lower than the skin, and its hair has turned white, then
the priest shall identify him as impure. It is an
affliction of leprosy. It has developed in the boil.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם יִרְאֶנָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה אֵין בָּהּ שֵׂעָר לָבָן וּשְׁפָלָה אֵינֶנָּה מִן הָעוֹר וְהִיא כֵהָה וְהִסְגִּירוֹ הַכֹּהֵן שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם יִרְאֶנָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה אֵין בָּהּ שֵׂעָר לָבָן וּשְׁפָלָה אֵינֶנָּה מִן הָעוֹר וְהִיא כֵהָה וְהִסְגִּירוֹ הַכֹּהֵן שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

english.text:
And if the priest will see it, and, here, there is not
white hair in it, and it is not lower than the skin, and
it has become dim, then the priest shall shut him in seven
days.

translation.text: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and if it be not lower than the skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

verses.english:
And if the priest will see it, and, here, there is not
white hair in it, and it is not lower than the skin, and
it has become dim, then the priest shall shut him in seven
days.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם פָּשֹׂה תִפְשֶׂה בָּעוֹר וְטִמֵּא הַכֹּהֵן אֹתוֹ נֶגַע הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם פָּשֹׂה תִפְשֶׂה בָּעוֹר וְטִמֵּא הַכֹּהֵן אֹתוֹ נֶגַע הִוא׃

english.text:
And if it will spread in the skin, then the priest shall
identify him as impure. It is an affliction.

translation.text: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.

verses.english:
And if it will spread in the skin, then the priest shall
identify him as impure. It is an affliction.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם תַּחְתֶּיהָ תַּעֲמֹד הַבַּהֶרֶת לֹא פָשָׂתָה צָרֶבֶת הַשְּׁחִין הִוא וְטִהֲרוֹ הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם תַּחְתֶּיהָ תַּעֲמֹד הַבַּהֶרֶת לֹא פָשָׂתָה צָרֶבֶת הַשְּׁחִין הִוא וְטִהֲרוֹ הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
And if the bright spot will have stayed the same in its
place—it has not spread—it is the scar of the boil, and
the priest shall identify him as pure.

translation.text: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

verses.english:
And if the bright spot will have stayed the same in its
place—it has not spread—it is the scar of the boil, and
the priest shall identify him as pure.

verses.hebrew: אוֹ בָשָׂר כִּי יִהְיֶה בְעֹרוֹ מִכְוַת אֵשׁ וְהָיְתָה מִחְיַת הַמִּכְוָה בַּהֶרֶת לְבָנָה אֲדַמְדֶּמֶת אוֹ לְבָנָה׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ בָשָׂר כִּי יִהְיֶה בְעֹרוֹ מִכְוַת אֵשׁ וְהָיְתָה מִחְיַת הַמִּכְוָה בַּהֶרֶת לְבָנָה אֲדַמְדֶּמֶת אוֹ לְבָנָה׃

english.text:
“Or when flesh will have a burn from a fire in its skin,
and the vital part of the burn is a bright spot of reddish
white or white,

translation.text: Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot burning, and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;

verses.english:
“Or when flesh will have a burn from a fire in its skin,
and the vital part of the burn is a bright spot of reddish
white or white,

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה אֹתָהּ הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה נֶהְפַּךְ שֵׂעָר לָבָן בַּבַּהֶרֶת וּמַרְאֶהָ עָמֹק מִן הָעוֹר צָרַעַת הִוא בַּמִּכְוָה פָּרָחָה וְטִמֵּא אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן נֶגַע צָרַעַת הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה אֹתָהּ הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה נֶהְפַּךְ שֵׂעָר לָבָן בַּבַּהֶרֶת וּמַרְאֶהָ עָמֹק מִן הָעוֹר צָרַעַת הִוא בַּמִּכְוָה פָּרָחָה וְטִמֵּא אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן נֶגַע צָרַעַת הִוא׃

english.text:
and the priest will see it, and, here, hair has turned
white in the bright spot, and its appearance is lower than
the skin, it is leprosy. It has developed in the burn. And
the priest shall identify him as impure. It is an
affliction of leprosy.

translation.text: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it be in sight deeper than the skin; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.

verses.english:
and the priest will see it, and, here, hair has turned
white in the bright spot, and its appearance is lower than
the skin, it is leprosy. It has developed in the burn. And
the priest shall identify him as impure. It is an
affliction of leprosy.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם יִרְאֶנָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה אֵין בַּבַּהֶרֶת שֵׂעָר לָבָן וּשְׁפָלָה אֵינֶנָּה מִן הָעוֹר וְהִוא כֵהָה וְהִסְגִּירוֹ הַכֹּהֵן שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם יִרְאֶנָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה אֵין בַּבַּהֶרֶת שֵׂעָר לָבָן וּשְׁפָלָה אֵינֶנָּה מִן הָעוֹר וְהִוא כֵהָה וְהִסְגִּירוֹ הַכֹּהֵן שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

english.text:
And if the priest will see it, and, here, there is not
white hair in the bright spot, and it is not lower than
the skin, and it has become dim, then the priest shall
shut him in seven days.

translation.text: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the other skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

verses.english:
And if the priest will see it, and, here, there is not
white hair in the bright spot, and it is not lower than
the skin, and it has become dim, then the priest shall
shut him in seven days.

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי אִם פָּשֹׂה תִפְשֶׂה בָּעוֹר וְטִמֵּא הַכֹּהֵן אֹתוֹ נֶגַע צָרַעַת הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי אִם פָּשֹׂה תִפְשֶׂה בָּעוֹר וְטִמֵּא הַכֹּהֵן אֹתוֹ נֶגַע צָרַעַת הִוא׃

english.text:
And the priest shall see him on the seventh day. If it
will spread in the skin, then the priest shall identify
him as impure. It is an affliction of leprosy.

translation.text: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: and if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.

verses.english:
And the priest shall see him on the seventh day. If it
will spread in the skin, then the priest shall identify
him as impure. It is an affliction of leprosy.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם תַּחְתֶּיהָ תַעֲמֹד הַבַּהֶרֶת לֹא פָשְׂתָה בָעוֹר וְהִוא כֵהָה שְׂאֵת הַמִּכְוָה הִוא וְטִהֲרוֹ הַכֹּהֵן כִּי צָרֶבֶת הַמִּכְוָה הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם תַּחְתֶּיהָ תַעֲמֹד הַבַּהֶרֶת לֹא פָשְׂתָה בָעוֹר וְהִוא כֵהָה שְׂאֵת הַמִּכְוָה הִוא וְטִהֲרוֹ הַכֹּהֵן כִּי צָרֶבֶת הַמִּכְוָה הִוא׃

english.text:
And if the bright spot will have stayed the same in its
place—it has not spread in the skin—and it has become dim,
it is the swelling of the burn, and the priest shall
identify him as pure, because it is the scar of the burn.

translation.text: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.

verses.english:
And if the bright spot will have stayed the same in its
place—it has not spread in the skin—and it has become dim,
it is the swelling of the burn, and the priest shall
identify him as pure, because it is the scar of the burn.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּי יִהְיֶה בוֹ נָגַע בְּרֹאשׁ אוֹ בְזָקָן׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּי יִהְיֶה בוֹ נָגַע בְּרֹאשׁ אוֹ בְזָקָן׃

english.text:
“And when a man or woman will have an affliction in the
head or beard,

translation.text: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;

verses.english:
“And when a man or woman will have an affliction in the
head or beard,

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנֶּגַע וְהִנֵּה מַרְאֵהוּ עָמֹק מִן הָעוֹר וּבוֹ שֵׂעָר צָהֹב דָּק וְטִמֵּא אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן נֶתֶק הוּא צָרַעַת הָרֹאשׁ אוֹ הַזָּקָן הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנֶּגַע וְהִנֵּה מַרְאֵהוּ עָמֹק מִן הָעוֹר וּבוֹ שֵׂעָר צָהֹב דָּק וְטִמֵּא אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן נֶתֶק הוּא צָרַעַת הָרֹאשׁ אוֹ הַזָּקָן הוּא׃

english.text:
and the priest will see the affliction, and, here, its
appearance is deeper than the skin, and there is thin
yellow hair in it, then the priest shall identify him as
impure. It is a scab. It is leprosy of the head or the
beard.

translation.text: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it be in sight deeper than the skin; and there be in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a dry scall, even a leprosy upon the head or beard.

verses.english:
and the priest will see the affliction, and, here, its
appearance is deeper than the skin, and there is thin
yellow hair in it, then the priest shall identify him as
impure. It is a scab. It is leprosy of the head or the
beard.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִרְאֶה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת נֶגַע הַנֶּתֶק וְהִנֵּה אֵין מַרְאֵהוּ עָמֹק מִן הָעוֹר וְשֵׂעָר שָׁחֹר אֵין בּוֹ וְהִסְגִּיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת נֶגַע הַנֶּתֶק שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִרְאֶה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת נֶגַע הַנֶּתֶק וְהִנֵּה אֵין מַרְאֵהוּ עָמֹק מִן הָעוֹר וְשֵׂעָר שָׁחֹר אֵין בּוֹ וְהִסְגִּיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת נֶגַע הַנֶּתֶק שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

english.text:
And when the priest will see the affliction of the scab,
and, here, its appearance is not deeper than the skin, and
there is not black hair in it, then the priest shall shut
in the affliction of the scab seven days.

translation.text: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it be not in sight deeper than the skin, and that there is no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days:

verses.english:
And when the priest will see the affliction of the scab,
and, here, its appearance is not deeper than the skin, and
there is not black hair in it, then the priest shall shut
in the affliction of the scab seven days.

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנֶּגַע בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְהִנֵּה לֹא פָשָׂה הַנֶּתֶק וְלֹא הָיָה בוֹ שֵׂעָר צָהֹב וּמַרְאֵה הַנֶּתֶק אֵין עָמֹק מִן הָעוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנֶּגַע בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְהִנֵּה לֹא פָשָׂה הַנֶּתֶק וְלֹא הָיָה בוֹ שֵׂעָר צָהֹב וּמַרְאֵה הַנֶּתֶק אֵין עָמֹק מִן הָעוֹר׃

english.text:
And the priest shall see the affliction on the seventh
day. And, here, the scab has not spread, and there is not
yellow hair in it, and the scab’s appearance is not deeper
than the skin.

translation.text: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin;

verses.english:
And the priest shall see the affliction on the seventh
day. And, here, the scab has not spread, and there is not
yellow hair in it, and the scab’s appearance is not deeper
than the skin.

verses.hebrew: וְהִתְגַּלָּח וְאֶת הַנֶּתֶק לֹא יְגַלֵּחַ וְהִסְגִּיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנֶּתֶק שִׁבְעַת יָמִים שֵׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: וְהִתְגַּלָּח וְאֶת הַנֶּתֶק לֹא יְגַלֵּחַ וְהִסְגִּיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנֶּתֶק שִׁבְעַת יָמִים שֵׁנִית׃

english.text:
Then he shall shave himself, and he shall not shave the
scab. And the priest shall shut in the one with the scab
seven days a second time.

translation.text: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:

verses.english:
Then he shall shave himself, and he shall not shave the
scab. And the priest shall shut in the one with the scab
seven days a second time.

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנֶּתֶק בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְהִנֵּה לֹא פָשָׂה הַנֶּתֶק בָּעוֹר וּמַרְאֵהוּ אֵינֶנּוּ עָמֹק מִן הָעוֹר וְטִהַר אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָהֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנֶּתֶק בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְהִנֵּה לֹא פָשָׂה הַנֶּתֶק בָּעוֹר וּמַרְאֵהוּ אֵינֶנּוּ עָמֹק מִן הָעוֹר וְטִהַר אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָהֵר׃

english.text:
And the priest shall see the scab on the seventh day. And,
here, the scab has not spread in the skin, and its
appearance is not deeper than the skin. Then the priest
shall identify him as pure. And he shall wash his clothes,
and he shall be pure.

translation.text: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, nor be in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

verses.english:
And the priest shall see the scab on the seventh day. And,
here, the scab has not spread in the skin, and its
appearance is not deeper than the skin. Then the priest
shall identify him as pure. And he shall wash his clothes,
and he shall be pure.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם פָּשֹׂה יִפְשֶׂה הַנֶּתֶק בָּעוֹר אַחֲרֵי טהֳרָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם פָּשֹׂה יִפְשֶׂה הַנֶּתֶק בָּעוֹר אַחֲרֵי טהֳרָתוֹ׃

english.text:
But if the scab has spread in the skin, after his
purification,

translation.text: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;

verses.english:
But if the scab has spread in the skin, after his
purification,

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה פָּשָׂה הַנֶּתֶק בָּעוֹר לֹא יְבַקֵּר הַכֹּהֵן לַשֵּׂעָר הַצָּהֹב טָמֵא הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה פָּשָׂה הַנֶּתֶק בָּעוֹר לֹא יְבַקֵּר הַכֹּהֵן לַשֵּׂעָר הַצָּהֹב טָמֵא הוּא׃

english.text:
and the priest will see him, and, here, the scab has
spread in the skin, the priest shall not inspect for the
yellow hair. He is impure.

translation.text: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he is unclean.

verses.english:
and the priest will see him, and, here, the scab has
spread in the skin, the priest shall not inspect for the
yellow hair. He is impure.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּעֵינָיו עָמַד הַנֶּתֶק וְשֵׂעָר שָׁחֹר צָמַח בּוֹ נִרְפָּא הַנֶּתֶק טָהוֹר הוּא וְטִהֲרוֹ הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּעֵינָיו עָמַד הַנֶּתֶק וְשֵׂעָר שָׁחֹר צָמַח בּוֹ נִרְפָּא הַנֶּתֶק טָהוֹר הוּא וְטִהֲרוֹ הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
And if, in his eyes, the scab has stayed the same, and
black hair has developed in it, the scab has been healed.
He is pure. And the priest shall identify him as pure.

translation.text: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and that there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

verses.english:
And if, in his eyes, the scab has stayed the same, and
black hair has developed in it, the scab has been healed.
He is pure. And the priest shall identify him as pure.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּי יִהְיֶה בְעוֹר בְּשָׂרָם בֶּהָרֹת בֶּהָרֹת לְבָנֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּי יִהְיֶה בְעוֹר בְּשָׂרָם בֶּהָרֹת בֶּהָרֹת לְבָנֹת׃

english.text:
“And when a man or woman will have bright spots in the
skin of their flesh, white bright spots,

translation.text: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;

verses.english:
“And when a man or woman will have bright spots in the
skin of their flesh, white bright spots,

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה בְעוֹר בְּשָׂרָם בֶּהָרֹת כֵּהוֹת לְבָנֹת בֹּהַק הוּא פָּרַח בָּעוֹר טָהוֹר הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה בְעוֹר בְּשָׂרָם בֶּהָרֹת כֵּהוֹת לְבָנֹת בֹּהַק הוּא פָּרַח בָּעוֹר טָהוֹר הוּא׃

english.text:
and the priest will see, and, here, bright spots in the
skin of their flesh are dim white, it is a tetter. It has
developed in the skin. He is pure.

translation.text: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.

verses.english:
and the priest will see, and, here, bright spots in the
skin of their flesh are dim white, it is a tetter. It has
developed in the skin. He is pure.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִמָּרֵט רֹאשׁוֹ קֵרֵחַ הוּא טָהוֹר הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִמָּרֵט רֹאשׁוֹ קֵרֵחַ הוּא טָהוֹר הוּא׃

english.text:
“And when a man’s head will become hairless, he is bald.
He is pure.

translation.text: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.

verses.english:
“And when a man’s head will become hairless, he is bald.
He is pure.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִפְּאַת פָּנָיו יִמָּרֵט רֹאשׁוֹ גִּבֵּחַ הוּא טָהוֹר הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מִפְּאַת פָּנָיו יִמָּרֵט רֹאשׁוֹ גִּבֵּחַ הוּא טָהוֹר הוּא׃

english.text:
And if his head will become hairless from the corner of
his face, he has a bald forehead. He is pure.

translation.text: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he is forehead bald: yet is he clean.

verses.english:
And if his head will become hairless from the corner of
his face, he has a bald forehead. He is pure.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִהְיֶה בַקָּרַחַת אוֹ בַגַּבַּחַת נֶגַע לָבָן אֲדַמְדָּם צָרַעַת פֹּרַחַת הִוא בְּקָרַחְתּוֹ אוֹ בְגַבַּחְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִהְיֶה בַקָּרַחַת אוֹ בַגַּבַּחַת נֶגַע לָבָן אֲדַמְדָּם צָרַעַת פֹּרַחַת הִוא בְּקָרַחְתּוֹ אוֹ בְגַבַּחְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And when there will be in the bald head or in the bald
forehead a reddish white affliction, it is leprosy
developing in his bald head or in his bald forehead.

translation.text: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.

verses.english:
And when there will be in the bald head or in the bald
forehead a reddish white affliction, it is leprosy
developing in his bald head or in his bald forehead.

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה שְׂאֵת הַנֶּגַע לְבָנָה אֲדַמְדֶּמֶת בְּקָרַחְתּוֹ אוֹ בְגַבַּחְתּוֹ כְּמַרְאֵה צָרַעַת עוֹר בָּשָׂר׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה שְׂאֵת הַנֶּגַע לְבָנָה אֲדַמְדֶּמֶת בְּקָרַחְתּוֹ אוֹ בְגַבַּחְתּוֹ כְּמַרְאֵה צָרַעַת עוֹר בָּשָׂר׃

english.text:
And the priest will see it, and, here, the affliction’s
swelling is reddish white in his bald head or in his bald
forehead, like the appearance of leprosy of skin of flesh,

translation.text: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;

verses.english:
And the priest will see it, and, here, the affliction’s
swelling is reddish white in his bald head or in his bald
forehead, like the appearance of leprosy of skin of flesh,

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ צָרוּעַ הוּא טָמֵא הוּא טַמֵּא יְטַמְּאֶנּוּ הַכֹּהֵן בְּרֹאשׁוֹ נִגְעוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אִישׁ צָרוּעַ הוּא טָמֵא הוּא טַמֵּא יְטַמְּאֶנּוּ הַכֹּהֵן בְּרֹאשׁוֹ נִגְעוֹ׃

english.text:
he is a leprous man. He is impure. The priest shall
identify him as impure. His affliction is in his head.

translation.text: He is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.

verses.english:
he is a leprous man. He is impure. The priest shall
identify him as impure. His affliction is in his head.

verses.hebrew: וְהַצָּרוּעַ אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ הַנֶּגַע בְּגָדָיו יִהְיוּ פְרֻמִים וְרֹאשׁוֹ יִהְיֶה פָרוּעַ וְעַל שָׂפָם יַעְטֶה וְטָמֵא טָמֵא יִקְרָא׃

hebrew.text: וְהַצָּרוּעַ אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ הַנֶּגַע בְּגָדָיו יִהְיוּ פְרֻמִים וְרֹאשׁוֹ יִהְיֶה פָרוּעַ וְעַל שָׂפָם יַעְטֶה וְטָמֵא טָמֵא יִקְרָא׃

english.text:
And the leper in whom is the affliction: his clothes shall
be torn, and the hair of his head shall be loosed, and he
shall cover over his mustache. And he shall call, ‘Impure!
Impure!’

translation.text: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.

verses.english:
And the leper in whom is the affliction: his clothes shall
be torn, and the hair of his head shall be loosed, and he
shall cover over his mustache. And he shall call, ‘Impure!
Impure!’

verses.hebrew: כּל יְמֵי אֲשֶׁר הַנֶּגַע בּוֹ יִטְמָא טָמֵא הוּא בָּדָד יֵשֵׁב מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה מוֹשָׁבוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כּל יְמֵי אֲשֶׁר הַנֶּגַע בּוֹ יִטְמָא טָמֵא הוּא בָּדָד יֵשֵׁב מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה מוֹשָׁבוֹ׃

english.text:
All the days that the affliction is in him he will be
impure. He is impure. He shall live separate. His home is
outside of the camp.

translation.text: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his habitation be.

verses.english:
All the days that the affliction is in him he will be
impure. He is impure. He shall live separate. His home is
outside of the camp.

verses.hebrew: וְהַבֶּגֶד כִּי יִהְיֶה בוֹ נֶגַע צָרָעַת בְּבֶגֶד צֶמֶר אוֹ בְּבֶגֶד פִּשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבֶּגֶד כִּי יִהְיֶה בוֹ נֶגַע צָרָעַת בְּבֶגֶד צֶמֶר אוֹ בְּבֶגֶד פִּשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
“And when clothing will have an affliction of leprosy in
it—in clothing of wool or in clothing of linen,

translation.text: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;

verses.english:
“And when clothing will have an affliction of leprosy in
it—in clothing of wool or in clothing of linen,

verses.hebrew: אוֹ בִשְׁתִי אוֹ בְעֵרֶב לַפִּשְׁתִּים וְלַצָּמֶר אוֹ בְעוֹר אוֹ בְּכל מְלֶאכֶת עוֹר׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ בִשְׁתִי אוֹ בְעֵרֶב לַפִּשְׁתִּים וְלַצָּמֶר אוֹ בְעוֹר אוֹ בְּכל מְלֶאכֶת עוֹר׃

english.text:
either in the warp or in the woof of the linen or of the
wool, or in leather or in anything made of leather:

translation.text: Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;

verses.english:
either in the warp or in the woof of the linen or of the
wool, or in leather or in anything made of leather:

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַנֶּגַע יְרַקְרַק אוֹ אֲדַמְדָּם בַּבֶּגֶד אוֹ בָעוֹר אוֹ בַשְּׁתִי אוֹ בָעֵרֶב אוֹ בְכל כְּלִי עוֹר נֶגַע צָרַעַת הוּא וְהרְאָה אֶת הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הַנֶּגַע יְרַקְרַק אוֹ אֲדַמְדָּם בַּבֶּגֶד אוֹ בָעוֹר אוֹ בַשְּׁתִי אוֹ בָעֵרֶב אוֹ בְכל כְּלִי עוֹר נֶגַע צָרַעַת הוּא וְהרְאָה אֶת הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
if the affliction will be greenish or reddish in the
clothing or in the leather or in the warp or in the woof
or in any item of leather, it is an affliction of
leprosy—and it will be shown to the priest,

translation.text: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:

verses.english:
if the affliction will be greenish or reddish in the
clothing or in the leather or in the warp or in the woof
or in any item of leather, it is an affliction of
leprosy—and it will be shown to the priest,

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנָּגַע וְהִסְגִּיר אֶת הַנֶּגַע שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנָּגַע וְהִסְגִּיר אֶת הַנֶּגַע שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

english.text:
and the priest will see the affliction, and he shall shut
in the thing with the affliction seven days.

translation.text: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that hath the plague seven days:

verses.english:
and the priest will see the affliction, and he shall shut
in the thing with the affliction seven days.

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה אֶת הַנֶּגַע בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי כִּי פָשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בַּבֶּגֶד אוֹ בַשְּׁתִי אוֹ בָעֵרֶב אוֹ בָעוֹר לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה הָעוֹר לִמְלָאכָה צָרַעַת מַמְאֶרֶת הַנֶּגַע טָמֵא הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה אֶת הַנֶּגַע בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי כִּי פָשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בַּבֶּגֶד אוֹ בַשְּׁתִי אוֹ בָעֵרֶב אוֹ בָעוֹר לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה הָעוֹר לִמְלָאכָה צָרַעַת מַמְאֶרֶת הַנֶּגַע טָמֵא הוּא׃

english.text:
And he shall see the affliction on the seventh day: if the
affliction has spread in the clothing or in the warp or in
the woof or in the leather, or any work into which the
leather will be made, the affliction is malignant leprosy.
It is impure.

translation.text: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, or in any work that is made of skin; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.

verses.english:
And he shall see the affliction on the seventh day: if the
affliction has spread in the clothing or in the warp or in
the woof or in the leather, or any work into which the
leather will be made, the affliction is malignant leprosy.
It is impure.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׂרַף אֶת הַבֶּגֶד אוֹ אֶת הַשְּׁתִי אוֹ אֶת הָעֵרֶב בַּצֶּמֶר אוֹ בַפִּשְׁתִּים אוֹ אֶת כּל כְּלִי הָעוֹר אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בוֹ הַנָּגַע כִּי צָרַעַת מַמְאֶרֶת הִוא בָּאֵשׁ תִּשָּׂרֵף׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׂרַף אֶת הַבֶּגֶד אוֹ אֶת הַשְּׁתִי אוֹ אֶת הָעֵרֶב בַּצֶּמֶר אוֹ בַפִּשְׁתִּים אוֹ אֶת כּל כְּלִי הָעוֹר אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בוֹ הַנָּגַע כִּי צָרַעַת מַמְאֶרֶת הִוא בָּאֵשׁ תִּשָּׂרֵף׃

english.text:
And he shall burn the clothing or the warp or the woof in
the wool or in the linen or any item of leather in which
the affliction will be, because it is malignant leprosy.
It shall be burned in fire.

translation.text: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.

verses.english:
And he shall burn the clothing or the warp or the woof in
the wool or in the linen or any item of leather in which
the affliction will be, because it is malignant leprosy.
It shall be burned in fire.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם יִרְאֶה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה לֹא פָשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בַּבֶּגֶד אוֹ בַשְּׁתִי אוֹ בָעֵרֶב אוֹ בְּכל כְּלִי עוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם יִרְאֶה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה לֹא פָשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בַּבֶּגֶד אוֹ בַשְּׁתִי אוֹ בָעֵרֶב אוֹ בְּכל כְּלִי עוֹר׃

english.text:
And if the priest will look, and, here, the affliction has
not spread in the clothing or in the warp or in the woof
or any item of leather,

translation.text: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;

verses.english:
And if the priest will look, and, here, the affliction has
not spread in the clothing or in the warp or in the woof
or any item of leather,

verses.hebrew: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְכִבְּסוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ הַנָּגַע וְהִסְגִּירוֹ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים שֵׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְכִבְּסוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ הַנָּגַע וְהִסְגִּירוֹ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים שֵׁנִית׃

english.text:
then the priest shall command, and they shall wash the
thing in which the affliction is, and he shall shut it in
seven days a second time.

translation.text: Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:

verses.english:
then the priest shall command, and they shall wash the
thing in which the affliction is, and he shall shut it in
seven days a second time.

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אַחֲרֵי הֻכַּבֵּס אֶת הַנֶּגַע וְהִנֵּה לֹא הָפַךְ הַנֶּגַע אֶת עֵינוֹ וְהַנֶּגַע לֹא פָשָׂה טָמֵא הוּא בָּאֵשׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶנּוּ פְּחֶתֶת הִוא בְּקָרַחְתּוֹ אוֹ בְגַבַּחְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אַחֲרֵי הֻכַּבֵּס אֶת הַנֶּגַע וְהִנֵּה לֹא הָפַךְ הַנֶּגַע אֶת עֵינוֹ וְהַנֶּגַע לֹא פָשָׂה טָמֵא הוּא בָּאֵשׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶנּוּ פְּחֶתֶת הִוא בְּקָרַחְתּוֹ אוֹ בְגַבַּחְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall see the affliction after it will be
washed, and, here, the affliction has not changed its
appearance, and the affliction will not have spread, it is
impure. You shall burn it in fire. It is a deterioration,
in its ‘bald head’ or in its ‘forehead.’

translation.text: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, if the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it is fret inward, whether it be bare within or without.

verses.english:
And the priest shall see the affliction after it will be
washed, and, here, the affliction has not changed its
appearance, and the affliction will not have spread, it is
impure. You shall burn it in fire. It is a deterioration,
in its ‘bald head’ or in its ‘forehead.’

verses.hebrew: וְאִם רָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה כֵּהָה הַנֶּגַע אַחֲרֵי הֻכַּבֵּס אֹתוֹ וְקָרַע אֹתוֹ מִן הַבֶּגֶד אוֹ מִן הָעוֹר אוֹ מִן הַשְּׁתִי אוֹ מִן הָעֵרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם רָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה כֵּהָה הַנֶּגַע אַחֲרֵי הֻכַּבֵּס אֹתוֹ וְקָרַע אֹתוֹ מִן הַבֶּגֶד אוֹ מִן הָעוֹר אוֹ מִן הַשְּׁתִי אוֹ מִן הָעֵרֶב׃

english.text:
If the priest will see, and, here, the affliction has
become dim after it was washed, then he shall rip it from
the clothing or from the leather or from the warp or from
the woof.

translation.text: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:

verses.english:
If the priest will see, and, here, the affliction has
become dim after it was washed, then he shall rip it from
the clothing or from the leather or from the warp or from
the woof.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם תֵּרָאֶה עוֹד בַּבֶּגֶד אוֹ בַשְּׁתִי אוֹ בָעֵרֶב אוֹ בְכל כְּלִי עוֹר פֹּרַחַת הִוא בָּאֵשׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶנּוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ הַנָּגַע׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם תֵּרָאֶה עוֹד בַּבֶּגֶד אוֹ בַשְּׁתִי אוֹ בָעֵרֶב אוֹ בְכל כְּלִי עוֹר פֹּרַחַת הִוא בָּאֵשׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶנּוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ הַנָּגַע׃

english.text:
And if it will appear again in the clothing or in the warp
or in the woof or in any item of leather, it is
developing. You shall burn it, the thing in which the
affliction is, in fire.

translation.text: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a spreading plague: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.

verses.english:
And if it will appear again in the clothing or in the warp
or in the woof or in any item of leather, it is
developing. You shall burn it, the thing in which the
affliction is, in fire.

verses.hebrew: וְהַבֶּגֶד אוֹ הַשְּׁתִי אוֹ הָעֵרֶב אוֹ כל כְּלִי הָעוֹר אֲשֶׁר תְּכַבֵּס וְסָר מֵהֶם הַנָּגַע וְכֻבַּס שֵׁנִית וְטָהֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבֶּגֶד אוֹ הַשְּׁתִי אוֹ הָעֵרֶב אוֹ כל כְּלִי הָעוֹר אֲשֶׁר תְּכַבֵּס וְסָר מֵהֶם הַנָּגַע וְכֻבַּס שֵׁנִית וְטָהֵר׃

english.text:
And the clothing or the warp or the woof or any item of
leather that you will wash: if the affliction will turn
away from them, then it shall be washed a second time, and
it will be pure.

translation.text: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.

verses.english:
And the clothing or the warp or the woof or any item of
leather that you will wash: if the affliction will turn
away from them, then it shall be washed a second time, and
it will be pure.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת תּוֹרַת נֶגַע צָרַעַת בֶּגֶד הַצֶּמֶר אוֹ הַפִּשְׁתִּים אוֹ הַשְּׁתִי אוֹ הָעֵרֶב אוֹ כּל כְּלִי עוֹר לְטַהֲרוֹ אוֹ לְטַמְּאוֹ׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת תּוֹרַת נֶגַע צָרַעַת בֶּגֶד הַצֶּמֶר אוֹ הַפִּשְׁתִּים אוֹ הַשְּׁתִי אוֹ הָעֵרֶב אוֹ כּל כְּלִי עוֹר לְטַהֲרוֹ אוֹ לְטַמְּאוֹ׃

english.text:
“This is the instruction for the affliction of leprosy of
clothing of wool or linen or warp or woof or any item of
leather, to identify it as pure or to identify it as
impure.”

translation.text: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.

verses.english:
“This is the instruction for the affliction of leprosy of
clothing of wool or linen or warp or woof or any item of
leather, to identify it as pure or to identify it as
impure.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: זֹאת תִּהְיֶה תּוֹרַת הַמְּצֹרָע בְּיוֹם טהֳרָתוֹ וְהוּבָא אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת תִּהְיֶה תּוֹרַת הַמְּצֹרָע בְּיוֹם טהֳרָתוֹ וְהוּבָא אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
“This shall be the instruction for the leper in the day of
his purification: And he shall be brought to the priest,

translation.text: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:

verses.english:
“This shall be the instruction for the leper in the day of
his purification: And he shall be brought to the priest,

verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא הַכֹּהֵן אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה נִרְפָּא נֶגַע הַצָּרַעַת מִן הַצָּרוּעַ׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצָא הַכֹּהֵן אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה נִרְפָּא נֶגַע הַצָּרַעַת מִן הַצָּרוּעַ׃

english.text:
and the priest shall go outside the camp, and the priest
shall see, and if, here, the affliction of leprosy has
been healed from the leper,

translation.text: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;

verses.english:
and the priest shall go outside the camp, and the priest
shall see, and if, here, the affliction of leprosy has
been healed from the leper,

verses.hebrew: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְלָקַח לַמִּטַּהֵר שְׁתֵּי צִפֳּרִים חַיּוֹת טְהֹרוֹת וְעֵץ אֶרֶז וּשְׁנִי תוֹלַעַת וְאֵזֹב׃

hebrew.text: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְלָקַח לַמִּטַּהֵר שְׁתֵּי צִפֳּרִים חַיּוֹת טְהֹרוֹת וְעֵץ אֶרֶז וּשְׁנִי תוֹלַעַת וְאֵזֹב׃

english.text:
then the priest shall command, and one shall take two
live, pure birds and cedarwood and scarlet and hyssop for
the one being purified.

translation.text: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

verses.english:
then the priest shall command, and one shall take two
live, pure birds and cedarwood and scarlet and hyssop for
the one being purified.

verses.hebrew: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַצִּפּוֹר הָאֶחָת אֶל כְּלִי חֶרֶשׂ עַל מַיִם חַיִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַצִּפּוֹר הָאֶחָת אֶל כְּלִי חֶרֶשׂ עַל מַיִם חַיִּים׃

english.text:
And the priest shall command, and he shall slaughter one
of the birds in a clay container over living water.

translation.text: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:

verses.english:
And the priest shall command, and he shall slaughter one
of the birds in a clay container over living water.

verses.hebrew: אֶת הַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה יִקַּח אֹתָהּ וְאֶת עֵץ הָאֶרֶז וְאֶת שְׁנִי הַתּוֹלַעַת וְאֶת הָאֵזֹב וְטָבַל אוֹתָם וְאֵת הַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה בְּדַם הַצִּפֹּר הַשְּׁחֻטָה עַל הַמַּיִם הַחַיִּים׃

hebrew.text: אֶת הַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה יִקַּח אֹתָהּ וְאֶת עֵץ הָאֶרֶז וְאֶת שְׁנִי הַתּוֹלַעַת וְאֶת הָאֵזֹב וְטָבַל אוֹתָם וְאֵת הַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה בְּדַם הַצִּפֹּר הַשְּׁחֻטָה עַל הַמַּיִם הַחַיִּים׃

english.text:
The live bird: he shall take it and the cedarwood and the
scarlet and the hyssop, and he shall dip them and the live
bird in the slaughtered bird’s blood over the living
water.

translation.text: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:

verses.english:
The live bird: he shall take it and the cedarwood and the
scarlet and the hyssop, and he shall dip them and the live
bird in the slaughtered bird’s blood over the living
water.

verses.hebrew: וְהִזָּה עַל הַמִּטַּהֵר מִן הַצָּרַעַת שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְטִהֲרוֹ וְשִׁלַּח אֶת הַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה עַל פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִזָּה עַל הַמִּטַּהֵר מִן הַצָּרַעַת שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְטִהֲרוֹ וְשִׁלַּח אֶת הַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה עַל פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
And he shall sprinkle it on the one being purified from
the leprosy seven times. And he shall identify him as
pure. And he shall let the live bird go at the open field.

translation.text: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.

verses.english:
And he shall sprinkle it on the one being purified from
the leprosy seven times. And he shall identify him as
pure. And he shall let the live bird go at the open field.

verses.hebrew: וְכִבֶּס הַמִּטַּהֵר אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְגִלַּח אֶת כּל שְׂעָרוֹ וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָהֵר וְאַחַר יָבוֹא אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה וְיָשַׁב מִחוּץ לְאהֳלוֹ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְכִבֶּס הַמִּטַּהֵר אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְגִלַּח אֶת כּל שְׂעָרוֹ וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָהֵר וְאַחַר יָבוֹא אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה וְיָשַׁב מִחוּץ לְאהֳלוֹ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

english.text:
And the one being purified shall wash his clothes and
shave all his hair and wash in water, and he will be pure,
and after that he shall come to the camp. And he shall
live outside his tent seven days.

translation.text: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.

verses.english:
And the one being purified shall wash his clothes and
shave all his hair and wash in water, and he will be pure,
and after that he shall come to the camp. And he shall
live outside his tent seven days.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי יְגַלַּח אֶת כּל שְׂעָרוֹ אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ וְאֶת זְקָנוֹ וְאֵת גַּבֹּת עֵינָיו וְאֶת כּל שְׂעָרוֹ יְגַלֵּחַ וְכִבֶּס אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמַּיִם וְטָהֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי יְגַלַּח אֶת כּל שְׂעָרוֹ אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ וְאֶת זְקָנוֹ וְאֵת גַּבֹּת עֵינָיו וְאֶת כּל שְׂעָרוֹ יְגַלֵּחַ וְכִבֶּס אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמַּיִם וְטָהֵר׃

english.text:
And it will be, on the seventh day: he shall shave all his
hair—he shall shave his head and his beard and his
eyebrows and all his hair—and he shall wash his clothes
and wash his flesh in water, and he will be pure.

translation.text: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.

verses.english:
And it will be, on the seventh day: he shall shave all his
hair—he shall shave his head and his beard and his
eyebrows and all his hair—and he shall wash his clothes
and wash his flesh in water, and he will be pure.

verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי יִקַּח שְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים תְּמִימִם וְכַבְשָׂה אַחַת בַּת שְׁנָתָהּ תְּמִימָה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וְלֹג אֶחָד שָׁמֶן׃

hebrew.text: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי יִקַּח שְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים תְּמִימִם וְכַבְשָׂה אַחַת בַּת שְׁנָתָהּ תְּמִימָה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וְלֹג אֶחָד שָׁמֶן׃

english.text:
And on the eighth day he shall take two unblemished
he-lambs and one unblemished ewe-lamb in its first year
and three-tenths of a measure of fine flour as a grain
offering mixed with oil and one log of oil.

translation.text: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.

verses.english:
And on the eighth day he shall take two unblemished
he-lambs and one unblemished ewe-lamb in its first year
and three-tenths of a measure of fine flour as a grain
offering mixed with oil and one log of oil.

verses.hebrew: וְהֶעֱמִיד הַכֹּהֵן הַמְטַהֵר אֵת הָאִישׁ הַמִּטַּהֵר וְאֹתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶעֱמִיד הַכֹּהֵן הַמְטַהֵר אֵת הָאִישׁ הַמִּטַּהֵר וְאֹתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And the priest who is purifying shall have the man being
purified and them stand in front of YHWH at the entrance
of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

verses.english:
And the priest who is purifying shall have the man being
purified and them stand in front of YHWH at the entrance
of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד וְהִקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לְאָשָׁם וְאֶת לֹג הַשָּׁמֶן וְהֵנִיף אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד וְהִקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לְאָשָׁם וְאֶת לֹג הַשָּׁמֶן וְהֵנִיף אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the priest shall take one of the lambs and bring it
forward as a guilt offering and the log of oil, and he
shall elevate them, an elevation offering in front of
YHWH.

translation.text: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:

verses.english:
And the priest shall take one of the lambs and bring it
forward as a guilt offering and the log of oil, and he
shall elevate them, an elevation offering in front of
YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַכֶּבֶשׂ בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט אֶת הַחַטָּאת וְאֶת הָעֹלָה בִּמְקוֹם הַקֹּדֶשׁ כִּי כַּחַטָּאת הָאָשָׁם הוּא לַכֹּהֵן קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַכֶּבֶשׂ בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט אֶת הַחַטָּאת וְאֶת הָעֹלָה בִּמְקוֹם הַקֹּדֶשׁ כִּי כַּחַטָּאת הָאָשָׁם הוּא לַכֹּהֵן קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא׃

english.text:
And he shall slaughter the lamb in the place where he
slaughters the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the
place of the Holy, because, like the sin offering, the
guilt offering is the priest’s. It is the holy of holies.

translation.text: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:

verses.english:
And he shall slaughter the lamb in the place where he
slaughters the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the
place of the Holy, because, like the sin offering, the
guilt offering is the priest’s. It is the holy of holies.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִדַּם הָאָשָׁם וְנָתַן הַכֹּהֵן עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִדַּם הָאָשָׁם וְנָתַן הַכֹּהֵן עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית׃

english.text:
And the priest shall take some of the blood of the guilt
offering, and the priest shall put it on the right earlobe
of the one being purified and on the thumb of his right
hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

translation.text: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

verses.english:
And the priest shall take some of the blood of the guilt
offering, and the priest shall put it on the right earlobe
of the one being purified and on the thumb of his right
hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִלֹּג הַשָּׁמֶן וְיָצַק עַל כַּף הַכֹּהֵן הַשְּׂמָאלִית׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִלֹּג הַשָּׁמֶן וְיָצַק עַל כַּף הַכֹּהֵן הַשְּׂמָאלִית׃

english.text:
And the priest shall take some of the log of oil and pour
it on the priest’s left hand.

translation.text: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:

verses.english:
And the priest shall take some of the log of oil and pour
it on the priest’s left hand.

verses.hebrew: וְטָבַל הַכֹּהֵן אֶת אֶצְבָּעוֹ הַיְמָנִית מִן הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל כַּפּוֹ הַשְּׂמָאלִית וְהִזָּה מִן הַשֶּׁמֶן בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְטָבַל הַכֹּהֵן אֶת אֶצְבָּעוֹ הַיְמָנִית מִן הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל כַּפּוֹ הַשְּׂמָאלִית וְהִזָּה מִן הַשֶּׁמֶן בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the priest shall dip his right finger in some of the
oil that is on his left hand and sprinkle some of the oil
with his finger seven times in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD:

verses.english:
And the priest shall dip his right finger in some of the
oil that is on his left hand and sprinkle some of the oil
with his finger seven times in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וּמִיֶּתֶר הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל כַּפּוֹ יִתֵּן הַכֹּהֵן עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית עַל דַּם הָאָשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וּמִיֶּתֶר הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל כַּפּוֹ יִתֵּן הַכֹּהֵן עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית עַל דַּם הָאָשָׁם׃

english.text:
And the priest shall put some of the remaining oil that is
on his hand on the right earlobe of the one being purified
and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of
his right foot, over the blood of the guilt offering.

translation.text: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:

verses.english:
And the priest shall put some of the remaining oil that is
on his hand on the right earlobe of the one being purified
and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of
his right foot, over the blood of the guilt offering.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנּוֹתָר בַּשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל כַּף הַכֹּהֵן יִתֵּן עַל רֹאשׁ הַמִּטַּהֵר וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנּוֹתָר בַּשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל כַּף הַכֹּהֵן יִתֵּן עַל רֹאשׁ הַמִּטַּהֵר וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he shall put what is left of the oil that is on the
priest’s hand on the head of the one being purified. And
the priest shall make atonement over him in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD.

verses.english:
And he shall put what is left of the oil that is on the
priest’s hand on the head of the one being purified. And
the priest shall make atonement over him in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַחַטָּאת וְכִפֶּר עַל הַמִּטַּהֵר מִטֻּמְאָתוֹ וְאַחַר יִשְׁחַט אֶת הָעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַחַטָּאת וְכִפֶּר עַל הַמִּטַּהֵר מִטֻּמְאָתוֹ וְאַחַר יִשְׁחַט אֶת הָעֹלָה׃

english.text:
And the priest shall make the sin offering and make
atonement over the one being purified from his impurity,
and after that he shall slaughter the burnt offering.

translation.text: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:

verses.english:
And the priest shall make the sin offering and make
atonement over the one being purified from his impurity,
and after that he shall slaughter the burnt offering.

verses.hebrew: וְהֶעֱלָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הָעֹלָה וְאֶת הַמִּנְחָה הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן וְטָהֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶעֱלָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הָעֹלָה וְאֶת הַמִּנְחָה הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן וְטָהֵר׃

english.text:
And the priest shall make the burnt offering and the grain
offering at the altar. And the priest shall make atonement
over him, and he will be pure.

translation.text: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

verses.english:
And the priest shall make the burnt offering and the grain
offering at the altar. And the priest shall make atonement
over him, and he will be pure.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם דַּל הוּא וְאֵין יָדוֹ מַשֶּׂגֶת וְלָקַח כֶּבֶשׂ אֶחָד אָשָׁם לִתְנוּפָה לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו וְעִשָּׂרוֹן סֹלֶת אֶחָד בָּלוּל בַּשֶּׁמֶן לְמִנְחָה וְלֹג שָׁמֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם דַּל הוּא וְאֵין יָדוֹ מַשֶּׂגֶת וְלָקַח כֶּבֶשׂ אֶחָד אָשָׁם לִתְנוּפָה לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו וְעִשָּׂרוֹן סֹלֶת אֶחָד בָּלוּל בַּשֶּׁמֶן לְמִנְחָה וְלֹג שָׁמֶן׃

english.text:
“And if he is poor, and his hand cannot attain enough,
then he shall take one lamb, a guilt offering, for
elevation, for making atonement over him, and one-tenth of
a measure of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain
offering and a log of oil

translation.text: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;

verses.english:
“And if he is poor, and his hand cannot attain enough,
then he shall take one lamb, a guilt offering, for
elevation, for making atonement over him, and one-tenth of
a measure of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain
offering and a log of oil

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה אֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יָדוֹ וְהָיָה אֶחָד חַטָּאת וְהָאֶחָד עֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה אֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יָדוֹ וְהָיָה אֶחָד חַטָּאת וְהָאֶחָד עֹלָה׃

english.text:
and two turtledoves or two pigeons, whichever his hand can
attain, and one shall be a sin offering and one a burnt
offering.

translation.text: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

verses.english:
and two turtledoves or two pigeons, whichever his hand can
attain, and one shall be a sin offering and one a burnt
offering.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵבִיא אֹתָם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי לְטהֳרָתוֹ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבִיא אֹתָם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי לְטהֳרָתוֹ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he shall bring them on the eighth day of his
purification to the priest, to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting, in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the LORD.

verses.english:
And he shall bring them on the eighth day of his
purification to the priest, to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting, in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן אֶת כֶּבֶשׂ הָאָשָׁם וְאֶת לֹג הַשָּׁמֶן וְהֵנִיף אֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן אֶת כֶּבֶשׂ הָאָשָׁם וְאֶת לֹג הַשָּׁמֶן וְהֵנִיף אֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the priest shall take the lamb of the guilt offering
and the log of oil, and the priest shall elevate them, an
elevation offering in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:

verses.english:
And the priest shall take the lamb of the guilt offering
and the log of oil, and the priest shall elevate them, an
elevation offering in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַט אֶת כֶּבֶשׂ הָאָשָׁם וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִדַּם הָאָשָׁם וְנָתַן עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁחַט אֶת כֶּבֶשׂ הָאָשָׁם וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִדַּם הָאָשָׁם וְנָתַן עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית׃

english.text:
And he shall slaughter the lamb of the guilt offering, and
the priest shall take some of the blood of the guilt
offering and put it on the right earlobe of the one being
purified and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big
toe of his right foot.

translation.text: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

verses.english:
And he shall slaughter the lamb of the guilt offering, and
the priest shall take some of the blood of the guilt
offering and put it on the right earlobe of the one being
purified and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big
toe of his right foot.

verses.hebrew: וּמִן הַשֶּׁמֶן יִצֹק הַכֹּהֵן עַל כַּף הַכֹּהֵן הַשְּׂמָאלִית׃

hebrew.text: וּמִן הַשֶּׁמֶן יִצֹק הַכֹּהֵן עַל כַּף הַכֹּהֵן הַשְּׂמָאלִית׃

english.text:
And the priest shall pour some of the oil on the priest’s
left hand,

translation.text: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:

verses.english:
And the priest shall pour some of the oil on the priest’s
left hand,

verses.hebrew: וְהִזָּה הַכֹּהֵן בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ הַיְמָנִית מִן הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל כַּפּוֹ הַשְּׂמָאלִית שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִזָּה הַכֹּהֵן בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ הַיְמָנִית מִן הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל כַּפּוֹ הַשְּׂמָאלִית שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and the priest shall sprinkle some of the oil that is on
his left hand with his right finger seven times in front
of YHWH.

translation.text: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD:

verses.english:
and the priest shall sprinkle some of the oil that is on
his left hand with his right finger seven times in front
of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן הַכֹּהֵן מִן הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל כַּפּוֹ עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית עַל מְקוֹם דַּם הָאָשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַן הַכֹּהֵן מִן הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל כַּפּוֹ עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית עַל מְקוֹם דַּם הָאָשָׁם׃

english.text:
And the priest shall put some of the oil that is on his
hand on the right earlobe of the one being purified and on
the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his
right foot, over the place of the blood of the guilt
offering.

translation.text: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:

verses.english:
And the priest shall put some of the oil that is on his
hand on the right earlobe of the one being purified and on
the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his
right foot, over the place of the blood of the guilt
offering.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנּוֹתָר מִן הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל כַּף הַכֹּהֵן יִתֵּן עַל רֹאשׁ הַמִּטַּהֵר לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנּוֹתָר מִן הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל כַּף הַכֹּהֵן יִתֵּן עַל רֹאשׁ הַמִּטַּהֵר לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And what is left of the oil that is on the priest’s hand
he shall put on the head of the one being purified to make
atonement over him in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the LORD.

verses.english:
And what is left of the oil that is on the priest’s hand
he shall put on the head of the one being purified to make
atonement over him in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה אֶת הָאֶחָד מִן הַתֹּרִים אוֹ מִן בְּנֵי הַיּוֹנָה מֵאֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשָׂה אֶת הָאֶחָד מִן הַתֹּרִים אוֹ מִן בְּנֵי הַיּוֹנָה מֵאֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יָדוֹ׃

english.text:
And he shall make one of the turtledoves or the pigeons,
from those which his hand can attain—

translation.text: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;

verses.english:
And he shall make one of the turtledoves or the pigeons,
from those which his hand can attain—

verses.hebrew: אֵת אֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יָדוֹ אֶת הָאֶחָד חַטָּאת וְאֶת הָאֶחָד עֹלָה עַל הַמִּנְחָה וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן עַל הַמִּטַּהֵר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אֵת אֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יָדוֹ אֶת הָאֶחָד חַטָּאת וְאֶת הָאֶחָד עֹלָה עַל הַמִּנְחָה וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן עַל הַמִּטַּהֵר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
whichever his hand will attain—one a sin offering and one
a burnt offering, with the grain offering, and the priest
shall make atonement over the one being purified in front
of YHWH.

translation.text: Even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the LORD.

verses.english:
whichever his hand will attain—one a sin offering and one
a burnt offering, with the grain offering, and the priest
shall make atonement over the one being purified in front
of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת תּוֹרַת אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ נֶגַע צָרָעַת אֲשֶׁר לֹא תַשִּׂיג יָדוֹ בְּטהֳרָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת תּוֹרַת אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ נֶגַע צָרָעַת אֲשֶׁר לֹא תַשִּׂיג יָדוֹ בְּטהֳרָתוֹ׃

english.text:
“This is the instruction for one who has an affliction of
leprosy in him, whose hand cannot attain enough for his
purification.”

translation.text: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing.

verses.english:
“This is the instruction for one who has an affliction of
leprosy in him, whose hand cannot attain enough for his
purification.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.hebrew: כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם לַאֲחֻזָּה וְנָתַתִּי נֶגַע צָרַעַת בְּבֵית אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם לַאֲחֻזָּה וְנָתַתִּי נֶגַע צָרַעַת בְּבֵית אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם׃

english.text:
“When you will come to the land of Canaan, which I am
giving to you as a possession, and I shall put an
affliction of leprosy in a house at the land of your
possession,

translation.text: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;

verses.english:
“When you will come to the land of Canaan, which I am
giving to you as a possession, and I shall put an
affliction of leprosy in a house at the land of your
possession,

verses.hebrew: וּבָא אֲשֶׁר לוֹ הַבַּיִת וְהִגִּיד לַכֹּהֵן לֵאמֹר כְּנֶגַע נִרְאָה לִי בַּבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וּבָא אֲשֶׁר לוֹ הַבַּיִת וְהִגִּיד לַכֹּהֵן לֵאמֹר כְּנֶגַע נִרְאָה לִי בַּבָּיִת׃

english.text:
and the one whose house it is will come and tell the
priest, saying, ‘It appears like an affliction to me in
the house,’

translation.text: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house:

verses.english:
and the one whose house it is will come and tell the
priest, saying, ‘It appears like an affliction to me in
the house,’

verses.hebrew: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וּפִנּוּ אֶת הַבַּיִת בְּטֶרֶם יָבֹא הַכֹּהֵן לִרְאוֹת אֶת הַנֶּגַע וְלֹא יִטְמָא כּל אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּיִת וְאַחַר כֵּן יָבֹא הַכֹּהֵן לִרְאוֹת אֶת הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וּפִנּוּ אֶת הַבַּיִת בְּטֶרֶם יָבֹא הַכֹּהֵן לִרְאוֹת אֶת הַנֶּגַע וְלֹא יִטְמָא כּל אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּיִת וְאַחַר כֵּן יָבֹא הַכֹּהֵן לִרְאוֹת אֶת הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
then the priest shall command, and they shall clear the
house before the priest will come to see the affliction,
so everything that is in the house will not become impure.
And, after that, the priest shall come to see the house.

translation.text: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:

verses.english:
then the priest shall command, and they shall clear the
house before the priest will come to see the affliction,
so everything that is in the house will not become impure.
And, after that, the priest shall come to see the house.

verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה אֶת הַנֶּגַע וְהִנֵּה הַנֶּגַע בְּקִירֹת הַבַּיִת שְׁקַעֲרוּרֹת יְרַקְרַקֹּת אוֹ אֲדַמְדַּמֹּת וּמַרְאֵיהֶן שָׁפָל מִן הַקִּיר׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאָה אֶת הַנֶּגַע וְהִנֵּה הַנֶּגַע בְּקִירֹת הַבַּיִת שְׁקַעֲרוּרֹת יְרַקְרַקֹּת אוֹ אֲדַמְדַּמֹּת וּמַרְאֵיהֶן שָׁפָל מִן הַקִּיר׃

translation.text: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall;

verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא הַכֹּהֵן מִן הַבַּיִת אֶל פֶּתַח הַבָּיִת וְהִסְגִּיר אֶת הַבַּיִת שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצָא הַכֹּהֵן מִן הַבַּיִת אֶל פֶּתַח הַבָּיִת וְהִסְגִּיר אֶת הַבַּיִת שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

english.text:
then the priest shall come out from the house, to the
entrance of the house, and he shall shut the house up
seven days.

translation.text: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:

verses.english:
then the priest shall come out from the house, to the
entrance of the house, and he shall shut the house up
seven days.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁב הַכֹּהֵן בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְרָאָה וְהִנֵּה פָּשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בְּקִירֹת הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁב הַכֹּהֵן בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְרָאָה וְהִנֵּה פָּשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בְּקִירֹת הַבָּיִת׃

translation.text: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;

verses.hebrew: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְחִלְּצוּ אֶת הָאֲבָנִים אֲשֶׁר בָּהֵן הַנָּגַע וְהִשְׁלִיכוּ אֶתְהֶן אֶל מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל מָקוֹם טָמֵא׃

hebrew.text: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְחִלְּצוּ אֶת הָאֲבָנִים אֲשֶׁר בָּהֵן הַנָּגַע וְהִשְׁלִיכוּ אֶתְהֶן אֶל מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל מָקוֹם טָמֵא׃

english.text:
then the priest shall command, and they shall extract the
stones in which is the affliction, and they shall throw
them outside the city, to an impure place.

translation.text: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is, and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:

verses.english:
then the priest shall command, and they shall extract the
stones in which is the affliction, and they shall throw
them outside the city, to an impure place.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַבַּיִת יַקְצִעַ מִבַּיִת סָבִיב וְשָׁפְכוּ אֶת הֶעָפָר אֲשֶׁר הִקְצוּ אֶל מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל מָקוֹם טָמֵא׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַבַּיִת יַקְצִעַ מִבַּיִת סָבִיב וְשָׁפְכוּ אֶת הֶעָפָר אֲשֶׁר הִקְצוּ אֶל מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל מָקוֹם טָמֵא׃

english.text:
And he shall have the house scraped inside, all around,
and they shall spill the dust that they have scraped
outside the city, to an impure place.

translation.text: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:

verses.english:
And he shall have the house scraped inside, all around,
and they shall spill the dust that they have scraped
outside the city, to an impure place.
