verses.hebrew: וְלָקְחוּ אֲבָנִים אֲחֵרוֹת וְהֵבִיאוּ אֶל תַּחַת הָאֲבָנִים וְעָפָר אַחֵר יִקַּח וְטָח אֶת הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקְחוּ אֲבָנִים אֲחֵרוֹת וְהֵבִיאוּ אֶל תַּחַת הָאֲבָנִים וְעָפָר אַחֵר יִקַּח וְטָח אֶת הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
And they shall take other stones and bring them in place
of the stones, and he shall take other dust and coat the
house.

translation.text: And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.

verses.english:
And they shall take other stones and bring them in place
of the stones, and he shall take other dust and coat the
house.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם יָשׁוּב הַנֶּגַע וּפָרַח בַּבַּיִת אַחַר חִלֵּץ אֶת הָאֲבָנִים וְאַחֲרֵי הִקְצוֹת אֶת הַבַּיִת וְאַחֲרֵי הִטּוֹחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם יָשׁוּב הַנֶּגַע וּפָרַח בַּבַּיִת אַחַר חִלֵּץ אֶת הָאֲבָנִים וְאַחֲרֵי הִקְצוֹת אֶת הַבַּיִת וְאַחֲרֵי הִטּוֹחַ׃

english.text:
And if the affliction will come back and develop in the
house after he has extracted the stones and after scraping
the house and after being coated,

translation.text: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;

verses.english:
And if the affliction will come back and develop in the
house after he has extracted the stones and after scraping
the house and after being coated,

verses.hebrew: וּבָא הַכֹּהֵן וְרָאָה וְהִנֵּה פָּשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בַּבָּיִת צָרַעַת מַמְאֶרֶת הִוא בַּבַּיִת טָמֵא הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וּבָא הַכֹּהֵן וְרָאָה וְהִנֵּה פָּשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בַּבָּיִת צָרַעַת מַמְאֶרֶת הִוא בַּבַּיִת טָמֵא הוּא׃

english.text:
then the priest shall come and see, and, here, the
affliction has spread in the house, it is malignant
leprosy in the house. It is impure.

translation.text: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house; it is unclean.

verses.english:
then the priest shall come and see, and, here, the
affliction has spread in the house, it is malignant
leprosy in the house. It is impure.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַץ אֶת הַבַּיִת אֶת אֲבָנָיו וְאֶת עֵצָיו וְאֵת כּל עֲפַר הַבָּיִת וְהוֹצִיא אֶל מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל מָקוֹם טָמֵא׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַץ אֶת הַבַּיִת אֶת אֲבָנָיו וְאֶת עֵצָיו וְאֵת כּל עֲפַר הַבָּיִת וְהוֹצִיא אֶל מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל מָקוֹם טָמֵא׃

english.text:
And he shall demolish the house: its stones and its wood
and all the dust of the house; and he shall take it
outside the city, to an impure place.

translation.text: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the morter of the house; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place.

verses.english:
And he shall demolish the house: its stones and its wood
and all the dust of the house; and he shall take it
outside the city, to an impure place.

verses.hebrew: וְהַבָּא אֶל הַבַּיִת כּל יְמֵי הִסְגִּיר אֹתוֹ יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבָּא אֶל הַבַּיִת כּל יְמֵי הִסְגִּיר אֹתוֹ יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And one who comes into the house all the days that it is
shut up will be impure until evening,

translation.text: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
And one who comes into the house all the days that it is
shut up will be impure until evening,

verses.hebrew: וְהַשֹּׁכֵב בַּבַּיִת יְכַבֵּס אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְהָאֹכֵל בַּבַּיִת יְכַבֵּס אֶת בְּגָדָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשֹּׁכֵב בַּבַּיִת יְכַבֵּס אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְהָאֹכֵל בַּבַּיִת יְכַבֵּס אֶת בְּגָדָיו׃

english.text:
and one who lies in the house shall wash his clothes, and
one who eats in the house shall wash his clothes.

translation.text: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.

verses.english:
and one who lies in the house shall wash his clothes, and
one who eats in the house shall wash his clothes.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם בֹּא יָבֹא הַכֹּהֵן וְרָאָה וְהִנֵּה לֹא פָשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בַּבַּיִת אַחֲרֵי הִטֹּחַ אֶת הַבָּיִת וְטִהַר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַבַּיִת כִּי נִרְפָּא הַנָּגַע׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בֹּא יָבֹא הַכֹּהֵן וְרָאָה וְהִנֵּה לֹא פָשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בַּבַּיִת אַחֲרֵי הִטֹּחַ אֶת הַבָּיִת וְטִהַר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַבַּיִת כִּי נִרְפָּא הַנָּגַע׃

english.text:
And if the priest will come and see, and, here, the
affliction has not spread in the house after coating the
house, then the priest shall identify the house as pure,
because the affliction has been healed.

translation.text: And if the priest shall come in, and look upon it, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

verses.english:
And if the priest will come and see, and, here, the
affliction has not spread in the house after coating the
house, then the priest shall identify the house as pure,
because the affliction has been healed.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח לְחַטֵּא אֶת הַבַּיִת שְׁתֵּי צִפֳּרִים וְעֵץ אֶרֶז וּשְׁנִי תוֹלַעַת וְאֵזֹב׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח לְחַטֵּא אֶת הַבַּיִת שְׁתֵּי צִפֳּרִים וְעֵץ אֶרֶז וּשְׁנִי תוֹלַעַת וְאֵזֹב׃

english.text:
And, to decontaminate the house, he shall take two birds
and cedarwood and scarlet and hyssop,

translation.text: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

verses.english:
And, to decontaminate the house, he shall take two birds
and cedarwood and scarlet and hyssop,

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַצִּפֹּר הָאֶחָת אֶל כְּלִי חֶרֶשׂ עַל מַיִם חַיִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַצִּפֹּר הָאֶחָת אֶל כְּלִי חֶרֶשׂ עַל מַיִם חַיִּים׃

english.text:
and he shall slaughter one of the birds in a clay
container over living water.

translation.text: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:

verses.english:
and he shall slaughter one of the birds in a clay
container over living water.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח אֶת עֵץ הָאֶרֶז וְאֶת הָאֵזֹב וְאֵת שְׁנִי הַתּוֹלַעַת וְאֵת הַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה וְטָבַל אֹתָם בְּדַם הַצִּפֹּר הַשְּׁחוּטָה וּבַמַּיִם הַחַיִּים וְהִזָּה אֶל הַבַּיִת שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח אֶת עֵץ הָאֶרֶז וְאֶת הָאֵזֹב וְאֵת שְׁנִי הַתּוֹלַעַת וְאֵת הַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה וְטָבַל אֹתָם בְּדַם הַצִּפֹּר הַשְּׁחוּטָה וּבַמַּיִם הַחַיִּים וְהִזָּה אֶל הַבַּיִת שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים׃

english.text:
And he shall take the cedarwood and the hyssop and the
scarlet and the live bird and dip them in the blood of the
slaughtered bird and in the living water, and he shall
sprinkle it at the house seven times.

translation.text: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:

verses.english:
And he shall take the cedarwood and the hyssop and the
scarlet and the live bird and dip them in the blood of the
slaughtered bird and in the living water, and he shall
sprinkle it at the house seven times.

verses.hebrew: וְחִטֵּא אֶת הַבַּיִת בְּדַם הַצִּפּוֹר וּבַמַּיִם הַחַיִּים וּבַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה וּבְעֵץ הָאֶרֶז וּבָאֵזֹב וּבִשְׁנִי הַתּוֹלָעַת׃

hebrew.text: וְחִטֵּא אֶת הַבַּיִת בְּדַם הַצִּפּוֹר וּבַמַּיִם הַחַיִּים וּבַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה וּבְעֵץ הָאֶרֶז וּבָאֵזֹב וּבִשְׁנִי הַתּוֹלָעַת׃

english.text:
And he shall decontaminate the house with the bird’s blood
and with the living water and with the live bird and with
the cedarwood and with the hyssop and with the scarlet.

translation.text: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:

verses.english:
And he shall decontaminate the house with the bird’s blood
and with the living water and with the live bird and with
the cedarwood and with the hyssop and with the scarlet.

verses.hebrew: וְשִׁלַּח אֶת הַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה אֶל מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה וְכִפֶּר עַל הַבַּיִת וְטָהֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְשִׁלַּח אֶת הַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה אֶל מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה וְכִפֶּר עַל הַבַּיִת וְטָהֵר׃

english.text:
And he shall let the live bird go outside the city at the
open field. And he shall make atonement over the house,
and it will be pure.

translation.text: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.

verses.english:
And he shall let the live bird go outside the city at the
open field. And he shall make atonement over the house,
and it will be pure.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת הַתּוֹרָה לְכל נֶגַע הַצָּרַעַת וְלַנָּתֶק׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת הַתּוֹרָה לְכל נֶגַע הַצָּרַעַת וְלַנָּתֶק׃

english.text:
“This is the instruction for every affliction of leprosy
and for a scab

translation.text: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,

verses.english:
“This is the instruction for every affliction of leprosy
and for a scab

verses.hebrew: וּלְצָרַעַת הַבֶּגֶד וְלַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וּלְצָרַעַת הַבֶּגֶד וְלַבָּיִת׃

english.text: and for leprosy of clothing and for a house

translation.text: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,

verses.english: and for leprosy of clothing and for a house

verses.hebrew: וְלַשְׂאֵת וְלַסַּפַּחַת וְלַבֶּהָרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְלַשְׂאֵת וְלַסַּפַּחַת וְלַבֶּהָרֶת׃

english.text: and for a swelling and for a rash and for a bright spot,

translation.text: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:

verses.english: and for a swelling and for a rash and for a bright spot,

verses.hebrew: לְהוֹרֹת בְּיוֹם הַטָּמֵא וּבְיוֹם הַטָּהֹר זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַצָּרָעַת׃

hebrew.text: לְהוֹרֹת בְּיוֹם הַטָּמֵא וּבְיוֹם הַטָּהֹר זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַצָּרָעַת׃

english.text:
to instruct on the day of the impure and on the day of the
pure. This is the instruction for leprosy.”

translation.text: To teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean: this is the law of leprosy.

verses.english:
to instruct on the day of the impure and on the day of the
pure. This is the instruction for leprosy.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבְּרוּ אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲמַרְתֶּם אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אִישׁ כִּי יִהְיֶה זָב מִבְּשָׂרוֹ זוֹבוֹ טָמֵא הוּא׃

hebrew.text: דַּבְּרוּ אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲמַרְתֶּם אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אִישׁ כִּי יִהְיֶה זָב מִבְּשָׂרוֹ זוֹבוֹ טָמֵא הוּא׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When any man will have an emission from his flesh,
his emission: it is impure.

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When any man will have an emission from his flesh,
his emission: it is impure.

verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת תִּהְיֶה טֻמְאָתוֹ בְּזוֹבוֹ רָר בְּשָׂרוֹ אֶת זוֹבוֹ אוֹ הֶחְתִּים בְּשָׂרוֹ מִזּוֹבוֹ טֻמְאָתוֹ הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וְזֹאת תִּהְיֶה טֻמְאָתוֹ בְּזוֹבוֹ רָר בְּשָׂרוֹ אֶת זוֹבוֹ אוֹ הֶחְתִּים בְּשָׂרוֹ מִזּוֹבוֹ טֻמְאָתוֹ הִוא׃

english.text:
And this shall be his impurity when he has an emission:
his flesh leaks with his emission, or his flesh is
obstructed from his emission. It is his impurity.

translation.text: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.

verses.english:
And this shall be his impurity when he has an emission:
his flesh leaks with his emission, or his flesh is
obstructed from his emission. It is his impurity.

verses.hebrew: כּל הַמִּשְׁכָּב אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב עָלָיו הַזָּב יִטְמָא וְכל הַכְּלִי אֲשֶׁר יֵשֵׁב עָלָיו יִטְמָא׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַמִּשְׁכָּב אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב עָלָיו הַזָּב יִטְמָא וְכל הַכְּלִי אֲשֶׁר יֵשֵׁב עָלָיו יִטְמָא׃

english.text:
Any bed on which the one with the emission will lie will
be impure, and any item on which he will sit will be
impure.

translation.text: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.

verses.english:
Any bed on which the one with the emission will lie will
be impure, and any item on which he will sit will be
impure.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בְּמִשְׁכָּבוֹ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בְּמִשְׁכָּבוֹ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And a man who will touch his bed shall wash his clothes
and shall wash in water and will be impure until evening.

translation.text: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
And a man who will touch his bed shall wash his clothes
and shall wash in water and will be impure until evening.

verses.hebrew: וְהַיֹּשֵׁב עַל הַכְּלִי אֲשֶׁר יֵשֵׁב עָלָיו הַזָּב יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְהַיֹּשֵׁב עַל הַכְּלִי אֲשֶׁר יֵשֵׁב עָלָיו הַזָּב יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And one who sits on an item on which the one with the
emission has sat shall wash his clothes and shall wash in
water and will be impure until evening.

translation.text: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
And one who sits on an item on which the one with the
emission has sat shall wash his clothes and shall wash in
water and will be impure until evening.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנֹּגֵעַ בִּבְשַׂר הַזָּב יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנֹּגֵעַ בִּבְשַׂר הַזָּב יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And one who touches the flesh of the one with the emission
shall wash his clothes and shall wash in water and will be
impure until evening.

translation.text: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
And one who touches the flesh of the one with the emission
shall wash his clothes and shall wash in water and will be
impure until evening.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יָרֹק הַזָּב בַּטָּהוֹר וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יָרֹק הַזָּב בַּטָּהוֹר וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And if the one with the emission will spit on one who is
pure, then he shall wash his clothes and shall wash in
water and will be impure until evening.

translation.text: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
And if the one with the emission will spit on one who is
pure, then he shall wash his clothes and shall wash in
water and will be impure until evening.

verses.hebrew: וְכל הַמֶּרְכָּב אֲשֶׁר יִרְכַּב עָלָיו הַזָּב יִטְמָא׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הַמֶּרְכָּב אֲשֶׁר יִרְכַּב עָלָיו הַזָּב יִטְמָא׃

english.text:
And any conveyance on which the one with the emission will
ride will be impure.

translation.text: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.

verses.english:
And any conveyance on which the one with the emission will
ride will be impure.

verses.hebrew: וְכל הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה תַחְתָּיו יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב וְהַנּוֹשֵׂא אוֹתָם יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה תַחְתָּיו יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב וְהַנּוֹשֵׂא אוֹתָם יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And anyone who touches anything that has been under him
will be impure until evening. And one who carries them
shall wash his clothes and shall wash in water and will be
impure until evening.

translation.text: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
And anyone who touches anything that has been under him
will be impure until evening. And one who carries them
shall wash his clothes and shall wash in water and will be
impure until evening.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בּוֹ הַזָּב וְיָדָיו לֹא שָׁטַף בַּמָּיִם וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בּוֹ הַזָּב וְיָדָיו לֹא שָׁטַף בַּמָּיִם וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And anyone whom the one with the emission will touch when
he has not rinsed his hands in water shall wash his
clothes and shall wash in water and will be impure until
evening.

translation.text: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
And anyone whom the one with the emission will touch when
he has not rinsed his hands in water shall wash his
clothes and shall wash in water and will be impure until
evening.

verses.hebrew: וּכְלִי חֶרֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בּוֹ הַזָּב יִשָּׁבֵר וְכל כְּלִי עֵץ יִשָּׁטֵף בַּמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וּכְלִי חֶרֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בּוֹ הַזָּב יִשָּׁבֵר וְכל כְּלִי עֵץ יִשָּׁטֵף בַּמָּיִם׃

english.text:
And a clay container that the one with the emission will
touch shall be broken, and any wood container shall be
rinsed in water.

translation.text: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

verses.english:
And a clay container that the one with the emission will
touch shall be broken, and any wood container shall be
rinsed in water.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִטְהַר הַזָּב מִזּוֹבוֹ וְסָפַר לוֹ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים לְטהֳרָתוֹ וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בְּשָׂרוֹ בְּמַיִם חַיִּים וְטָהֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִטְהַר הַזָּב מִזּוֹבוֹ וְסָפַר לוֹ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים לְטהֳרָתוֹ וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בְּשָׂרוֹ בְּמַיִם חַיִּים וְטָהֵר׃

english.text:
And when the one with the emission will be purified from
his emission, he shall count seven days for his
purification and shall wash his clothes and shall wash his
flesh in living water and will be pure.

translation.text: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

verses.english:
And when the one with the emission will be purified from
his emission, he shall count seven days for his
purification and shall wash his clothes and shall wash his
flesh in living water and will be pure.

verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי יִקַּח לוֹ שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה וּבָא לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּנְתָנָם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי יִקַּח לוֹ שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה וּבָא לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּנְתָנָם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
And on the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves or two
pigeons and shall come in front of YHWH, to the entrance
of the Tent of Meeting, and shall give them to the priest.

translation.text: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:

verses.english:
And on the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves or two
pigeons and shall come in front of YHWH, to the entrance
of the Tent of Meeting, and shall give them to the priest.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה אֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן אֶחָד חַטָּאת וְהָאֶחָד עֹלָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה מִזּוֹבוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשָׂה אֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן אֶחָד חַטָּאת וְהָאֶחָד עֹלָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה מִזּוֹבוֹ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall do them: one a sin offering and one a
burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement over
him in front of YHWH from his emission.

translation.text: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.

verses.english:
And the priest shall do them: one a sin offering and one a
burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement over
him in front of YHWH from his emission.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי תֵצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ שִׁכְבַת זָרַע וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם אֶת כּל בְּשָׂרוֹ וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי תֵצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ שִׁכְבַת זָרַע וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם אֶת כּל בְּשָׂרוֹ וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
“And when a man’s intercourse seed will come out from him:
he shall wash all his flesh in water and will be impure
until evening.

translation.text: And if any man’s seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
“And when a man’s intercourse seed will come out from him:
he shall wash all his flesh in water and will be impure
until evening.

verses.hebrew: וְכל בֶּגֶד וְכל עוֹר אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה עָלָיו שִׁכְבַת זָרַע וְכֻבַּס בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְכל בֶּגֶד וְכל עוֹר אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה עָלָיו שִׁכְבַת זָרַע וְכֻבַּס בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And any clothing and any leather on which there will be
intercourse seed: it shall be washed with water and will
be impure until evening.

translation.text: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
And any clothing and any leather on which there will be
intercourse seed: it shall be washed with water and will
be impure until evening.

verses.hebrew: וְאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אִישׁ אֹתָהּ שִׁכְבַת זָרַע וְרָחֲצוּ בַמַּיִם וְטָמְאוּ עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אִישׁ אֹתָהּ שִׁכְבַת זָרַע וְרָחֲצוּ בַמַּיִם וְטָמְאוּ עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And a woman with whom a man will lie—an intercourse of
seed—they shall wash with water and will be impure until
evening.

translation.text: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
And a woman with whom a man will lie—an intercourse of
seed—they shall wash with water and will be impure until
evening.

verses.hebrew: וְאִשָּׁה כִּי תִהְיֶה זָבָה דָּם יִהְיֶה זֹבָהּ בִּבְשָׂרָהּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תִּהְיֶה בְנִדָּתָהּ וְכל הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהּ יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְאִשָּׁה כִּי תִהְיֶה זָבָה דָּם יִהְיֶה זֹבָהּ בִּבְשָׂרָהּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תִּהְיֶה בְנִדָּתָהּ וְכל הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהּ יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
“And when a woman will have an emission—her emission will
be blood in her flesh—she shall be in her impurity seven
days. And anyone who touches her will be impure until
evening.

translation.text: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
“And when a woman will have an emission—her emission will
be blood in her flesh—she shall be in her impurity seven
days. And anyone who touches her will be impure until
evening.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁכַּב עָלָיו בְּנִדָּתָהּ יִטְמָא וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֵּשֵׁב עָלָיו יִטְמָא׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁכַּב עָלָיו בְּנִדָּתָהּ יִטְמָא וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֵּשֵׁב עָלָיו יִטְמָא׃

english.text:
And anything on which she will lie during her impurity
will be impure, and anything on which she will sit will be
impure.

translation.text: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.

verses.english:
And anything on which she will lie during her impurity
will be impure, and anything on which she will sit will be
impure.

verses.hebrew: וְכל הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּמִשְׁכָּבָהּ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּמִשְׁכָּבָהּ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And anyone who touches her bed shall wash his clothes and
shall wash in water and will be impure until evening.

translation.text: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
And anyone who touches her bed shall wash his clothes and
shall wash in water and will be impure until evening.

verses.hebrew: וְכל הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּכל כְּלִי אֲשֶׁר תֵּשֵׁב עָלָיו יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּכל כְּלִי אֲשֶׁר תֵּשֵׁב עָלָיו יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And anyone who touches any item on which she will sit
shall wash his clothes and shall wash in water and will be
impure until evening.

translation.text: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
And anyone who touches any item on which she will sit
shall wash his clothes and shall wash in water and will be
impure until evening.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּב הוּא אוֹ עַל הַכְּלִי אֲשֶׁר הִוא יֹשֶׁבֶת עָלָיו בְּנגְעוֹ בוֹ יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּב הוּא אוֹ עַל הַכְּלִי אֲשֶׁר הִוא יֹשֶׁבֶת עָלָיו בְּנגְעוֹ בוֹ יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And if he is on the bed or on the item on which she sits
while he is touching it, he will be impure until evening.

translation.text: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
And if he is on the bed or on the item on which she sits
while he is touching it, he will be impure until evening.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם שָׁכֹב יִשְׁכַּב אִישׁ אֹתָהּ וּתְהִי נִדָּתָהּ עָלָיו וְטָמֵא שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְכל הַמִּשְׁכָּב אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב עָלָיו יִטְמָא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם שָׁכֹב יִשְׁכַּב אִישׁ אֹתָהּ וּתְהִי נִדָּתָהּ עָלָיו וְטָמֵא שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְכל הַמִּשְׁכָּב אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב עָלָיו יִטְמָא׃

english.text:
And if a man will lie with her, and her impurity will be
on him, then he will be impure seven days. And any bed on
which he will lie will be impure.

translation.text: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.

verses.english:
And if a man will lie with her, and her impurity will be
on him, then he will be impure seven days. And any bed on
which he will lie will be impure.

verses.hebrew: וְאִשָּׁה כִּי יָזוּב זוֹב דָּמָהּ יָמִים רַבִּים בְּלֹא עֶת נִדָּתָהּ אוֹ כִי תָזוּב עַל נִדָּתָהּ כּל יְמֵי זוֹב טֻמְאָתָהּ כִּימֵי נִדָּתָהּ תִּהְיֶה טְמֵאָה הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִשָּׁה כִּי יָזוּב זוֹב דָּמָהּ יָמִים רַבִּים בְּלֹא עֶת נִדָּתָהּ אוֹ כִי תָזוּב עַל נִדָּתָהּ כּל יְמֵי זוֹב טֻמְאָתָהּ כִּימֵי נִדָּתָהּ תִּהְיֶה טְמֵאָה הִוא׃

english.text:
“And when a woman will have an emission of her blood many
days when it is not the time of her impurity, or when she
will have an emission beyond her impurity, for all the
days of her impure emission she shall be like the days of
her impurity. She is impure.

translation.text: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.

verses.english:
“And when a woman will have an emission of her blood many
days when it is not the time of her impurity, or when she
will have an emission beyond her impurity, for all the
days of her impure emission she shall be like the days of
her impurity. She is impure.

verses.hebrew: כּל הַמִּשְׁכָּב אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁכַּב עָלָיו כּל יְמֵי זוֹבָהּ כְּמִשְׁכַּב נִדָּתָהּ יִהְיֶה לָּהּ וְכל הַכְּלִי אֲשֶׁר תֵּשֵׁב עָלָיו טָמֵא יִהְיֶה כְּטֻמְאַת נִדָּתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַמִּשְׁכָּב אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁכַּב עָלָיו כּל יְמֵי זוֹבָהּ כְּמִשְׁכַּב נִדָּתָהּ יִהְיֶה לָּהּ וְכל הַכְּלִי אֲשֶׁר תֵּשֵׁב עָלָיו טָמֵא יִהְיֶה כְּטֻמְאַת נִדָּתָהּ׃

english.text:
Any bed on which she will lie all the days of her emission
will be like a bed of her impurity for her, and any item
on which she will sit will be impure like the impurity of
her menstruation.

translation.text: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.

verses.english:
Any bed on which she will lie all the days of her emission
will be like a bed of her impurity for her, and any item
on which she will sit will be impure like the impurity of
her menstruation.

verses.hebrew: וְכל הַנּוֹגֵעַ בָּם יִטְמָא וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הַנּוֹגֵעַ בָּם יִטְמָא וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And anyone who touches them will be impure. And he shall
wash his clothes and shall wash with water and will be
impure until evening.

translation.text: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
And anyone who touches them will be impure. And he shall
wash his clothes and shall wash with water and will be
impure until evening.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם טָהֲרָה מִזּוֹבָהּ וְסָפְרָה לָּהּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְאַחַר תִּטְהָר׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם טָהֲרָה מִזּוֹבָהּ וְסָפְרָה לָּהּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְאַחַר תִּטְהָר׃

english.text:
“And if she has become purified from her emission, then
she shall count seven days, and after that she will be
pure.

translation.text: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

verses.english:
“And if she has become purified from her emission, then
she shall count seven days, and after that she will be
pure.

verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי תִּקַּח לָהּ שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה וְהֵבִיאָה אוֹתָם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי תִּקַּח לָהּ שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה וְהֵבִיאָה אוֹתָם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And on the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves or
two pigeons, and she shall bring them to the priest at the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.english:
And on the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves or
two pigeons, and she shall bring them to the priest at the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הָאֶחָד חַטָּאת וְאֶת הָאֶחָד עֹלָה וְכִפֶּר עָלֶיהָ הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה מִזּוֹב טֻמְאָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הָאֶחָד חַטָּאת וְאֶת הָאֶחָד עֹלָה וְכִפֶּר עָלֶיהָ הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה מִזּוֹב טֻמְאָתָהּ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall make one a sin offering and one a
burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement over
her in front of YHWH from her impure emission.

translation.text: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.

verses.english:
And the priest shall make one a sin offering and one a
burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement over
her in front of YHWH from her impure emission.

verses.hebrew: וְהִזַּרְתֶּם אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִטֻּמְאָתָם וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ בְּטֻמְאָתָם בְּטַמְּאָם אֶת מִשְׁכָּנִי אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹכָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִזַּרְתֶּם אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִטֻּמְאָתָם וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ בְּטֻמְאָתָם בְּטַמְּאָם אֶת מִשְׁכָּנִי אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹכָם׃

english.text:
“And you shall alert the children of Israel regarding
their impurity so they will not die through their impurity
when they defile my Tabernacle that is among them.

translation.text: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.

verses.english:
“And you shall alert the children of Israel regarding
their impurity so they will not die through their impurity
when they defile my Tabernacle that is among them.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַזָּב וַאֲשֶׁר תֵּצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע לְטמְאָה בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַזָּב וַאֲשֶׁר תֵּצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע לְטמְאָה בָהּ׃

english.text:
This is the instruction for one who has an emission and
for one from whom seed of intercourse will come out, so as
to become impure by it,

translation.text: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;

verses.english:
This is the instruction for one who has an emission and
for one from whom seed of intercourse will come out, so as
to become impure by it,

verses.hebrew: וְהַדָּוָה בְּנִדָּתָהּ וְהַזָּב אֶת זוֹבוֹ לַזָּכָר וְלַנְּקֵבָה וּלְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב עִם טְמֵאָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַדָּוָה בְּנִדָּתָהּ וְהַזָּב אֶת זוֹבוֹ לַזָּכָר וְלַנְּקֵבָה וּלְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב עִם טְמֵאָה׃

english.text:
and one who is in her menstrual impurity and one who has
an emission—for a male and for a female—and for a man who
will lie with a woman who is impure.”

translation.text: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.

verses.english:
and one who is in her menstrual impurity and one who has
an emission—for a male and for a female—and for a man who
will lie with a woman who is impure.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אַחֲרֵי מוֹת שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן בְּקרְבָתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיָּמֻתוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אַחֲרֵי מוֹת שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן בְּקרְבָתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיָּמֻתוּ׃

english.text:
And YHWH spoke to Moses after the death of Aaron’s two
sons—when they came forward in front of YHWH and died.

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;

verses.english:
And YHWH spoke to Moses after the death of Aaron’s two
sons—when they came forward in front of YHWH and died.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וְאַל יָבֹא בְכל עֵת אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת אֶל פְּנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאָרֹן וְלֹא יָמוּת כִּי בֶּעָנָן אֵרָאֶה עַל הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וְאַל יָבֹא בְכל עֵת אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת אֶל פְּנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל הָאָרֹן וְלֹא יָמוּת כִּי בֶּעָנָן אֵרָאֶה עַל הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Speak to Aaron, your brother, and
let him not come at all times to the Holy, inside the
pavilion, in front of the atonement dais that is over the
ark, so he will not die, because I shall appear in a cloud
over the atonement dais.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Speak to Aaron, your brother, and
let him not come at all times to the Holy, inside the
pavilion, in front of the atonement dais that is over the
ark, so he will not die, because I shall appear in a cloud
over the atonement dais.

verses.hebrew: בְּזֹאת יָבֹא אַהֲרֹן אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּפַר בֶּן בָּקָר לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל לְעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: בְּזֹאת יָבֹא אַהֲרֹן אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּפַר בֶּן בָּקָר לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל לְעֹלָה׃

english.text:
Aaron shall come to the Holy with this: with a bull of the
cattle for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

translation.text: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

verses.english:
Aaron shall come to the Holy with this: with a bull of the
cattle for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

verses.hebrew: כְּתֹנֶת בַּד קֹדֶשׁ יִלְבָּשׁ וּמִכְנְסֵי בַד יִהְיוּ עַל בְּשָׂרוֹ וּבְאַבְנֵט בַּד יַחְגֹּר וּבְמִצְנֶפֶת בַּד יִצְנֹף בִּגְדֵי קֹדֶשׁ הֵם וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ וּלְבֵשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: כְּתֹנֶת בַּד קֹדֶשׁ יִלְבָּשׁ וּמִכְנְסֵי בַד יִהְיוּ עַל בְּשָׂרוֹ וּבְאַבְנֵט בַּד יַחְגֹּר וּבְמִצְנֶפֶת בַּד יִצְנֹף בִּגְדֵי קֹדֶשׁ הֵם וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ וּלְבֵשָׁם׃

english.text:
He shall wear a holy linen coat, and linen drawers shall
be on his flesh, and he shall be belted with a linen sash,
and he shall wear a linen headdress. They are holy
clothes: and he shall wash his flesh with water and put
them on.

translation.text: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.

verses.english:
He shall wear a holy linen coat, and linen drawers shall
be on his flesh, and he shall be belted with a linen sash,
and he shall wear a linen headdress. They are holy
clothes: and he shall wash his flesh with water and put
them on.

verses.hebrew: וּמֵאֵת עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יִקַּח שְׁנֵי שְׂעִירֵי עִזִּים לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל אֶחָד לְעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וּמֵאֵת עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יִקַּח שְׁנֵי שְׂעִירֵי עִזִּים לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל אֶחָד לְעֹלָה׃

english.text:
And he shall take from the congregation of the children of
Israel two goats for a sin offering and one ram for a
burnt offering.

translation.text: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

verses.english:
And he shall take from the congregation of the children of
Israel two goats for a sin offering and one ram for a
burnt offering.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת פַּר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת פַּר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
And Aaron shall bring forward the bull of the sin offering
that is his and shall make atonement for himself and for
his house.

translation.text: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.

verses.english:
And Aaron shall bring forward the bull of the sin offering
that is his and shall make atonement for himself and for
his house.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח אֶת שְׁנֵי הַשְּׂעִירִם וְהֶעֱמִיד אֹתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח אֶת שְׁנֵי הַשְּׂעִירִם וְהֶעֱמִיד אֹתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And he shall take the two goats and stand them in front of
YHWH, at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.english:
And he shall take the two goats and stand them in front of
YHWH, at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן אַהֲרֹן עַל שְׁנֵי הַשְּׂעִירִם גֹּרָלוֹת גּוֹרָל אֶחָד לַיהֹוָה וְגוֹרָל אֶחָד לַעֲזָאזֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַן אַהֲרֹן עַל שְׁנֵי הַשְּׂעִירִם גֹּרָלוֹת גּוֹרָל אֶחָד לַיהֹוָה וְגוֹרָל אֶחָד לַעֲזָאזֵל׃

english.text:
And Aaron shall cast lots on the two goats, one lot for
YHWH and one lot for Azazel.

translation.text: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

verses.english:
And Aaron shall cast lots on the two goats, one lot for
YHWH and one lot for Azazel.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר אֲשֶׁר עָלָה עָלָיו הַגּוֹרָל לַיהֹוָה וְעָשָׂהוּ חַטָּאת׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר אֲשֶׁר עָלָה עָלָיו הַגּוֹרָל לַיהֹוָה וְעָשָׂהוּ חַטָּאת׃

english.text:
And Aaron shall bring forward the goat on which the lot
for YHWH arose, and he shall make it a sin offering.

translation.text: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD’s lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.

verses.english:
And Aaron shall bring forward the goat on which the lot
for YHWH arose, and he shall make it a sin offering.

verses.hebrew: וְהַשָּׂעִיר אֲשֶׁר עָלָה עָלָיו הַגּוֹרָל לַעֲזָאזֵל יעֳמַד חַי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו לְשַׁלַּח אֹתוֹ לַעֲזָאזֵל הַמִּדְבָּרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשָּׂעִיר אֲשֶׁר עָלָה עָלָיו הַגּוֹרָל לַעֲזָאזֵל יעֳמַד חַי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו לְשַׁלַּח אֹתוֹ לַעֲזָאזֵל הַמִּדְבָּרָה׃

english.text:
And the goat on which the lot for Azazel arose shall be
stood alive in front of YHWH to make atonement over it, to
let it go to Azazel, into the wilderness.

translation.text: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.

verses.english:
And the goat on which the lot for Azazel arose shall be
stood alive in front of YHWH to make atonement over it, to
let it go to Azazel, into the wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת פַּר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתוֹ וְשָׁחַט אֶת פַּר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת פַּר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתוֹ וְשָׁחַט אֶת פַּר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ׃

english.text:
And Aaron shall bring forward the bull of the sin offering
that is his and shall make atonement for him and for his
house, and he shall slaughter the bull of the sin offering
that he has.

translation.text: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:

verses.english:
And Aaron shall bring forward the bull of the sin offering
that is his and shall make atonement for him and for his
house, and he shall slaughter the bull of the sin offering
that he has.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח מְלֹא הַמַּחְתָּה גַּחֲלֵי אֵשׁ מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּמְלֹא חפְנָיו קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים דַּקָּה וְהֵבִיא מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח מְלֹא הַמַּחְתָּה גַּחֲלֵי אֵשׁ מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּמְלֹא חפְנָיו קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים דַּקָּה וְהֵבִיא מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת׃

english.text:
And he shall take a fire-holder-full of coals of fire from
on the altar, from in front of YHWH, and handfuls of fine
incense of fragrances, and he shall bring it inside the
pavilion

translation.text: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:

verses.english:
And he shall take a fire-holder-full of coals of fire from
on the altar, from in front of YHWH, and handfuls of fine
incense of fragrances, and he shall bring it inside the
pavilion

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן אֶת הַקְּטֹרֶת עַל הָאֵשׁ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְכִסָּה עֲנַן הַקְּטֹרֶת אֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל הָעֵדוּת וְלֹא יָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַן אֶת הַקְּטֹרֶת עַל הָאֵשׁ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְכִסָּה עֲנַן הַקְּטֹרֶת אֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל הָעֵדוּת וְלֹא יָמוּת׃

english.text:
and put the incense on the fire in front of YHWH so that
the cloud of the incense will cover the atonement dais
that is over the Testimony, and he will not die.

translation.text: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:

verses.english:
and put the incense on the fire in front of YHWH so that
the cloud of the incense will cover the atonement dais
that is over the Testimony, and he will not die.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח מִדַּם הַפָּר וְהִזָּה בְאֶצְבָּעוֹ עַל פְּנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת קֵדְמָה וְלִפְנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת יַזֶּה שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים מִן הַדָּם בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח מִדַּם הַפָּר וְהִזָּה בְאֶצְבָּעוֹ עַל פְּנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת קֵדְמָה וְלִפְנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת יַזֶּה שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים מִן הַדָּם בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ׃

english.text:
And he shall take some of the bull’s blood and sprinkle
with his finger on the front of the atonement dais
eastward, and he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his
finger in front of the atonement dais seven times.

translation.text: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.

verses.english:
And he shall take some of the bull’s blood and sprinkle
with his finger on the front of the atonement dais
eastward, and he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his
finger in front of the atonement dais seven times.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַט אֶת שְׂעִיר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לָעָם וְהֵבִיא אֶת דָּמוֹ אֶל מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת וְעָשָׂה אֶת דָּמוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְדַם הַפָּר וְהִזָּה אֹתוֹ עַל הַכַּפֹּרֶת וְלִפְנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁחַט אֶת שְׂעִיר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לָעָם וְהֵבִיא אֶת דָּמוֹ אֶל מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת וְעָשָׂה אֶת דָּמוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְדַם הַפָּר וְהִזָּה אֹתוֹ עַל הַכַּפֹּרֶת וְלִפְנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

english.text:
And he shall slaughter the goat of the sin offering that
is the people’s and shall bring its blood inside the
pavilion and shall do its blood as he did to the bull’s
blood: and he shall sprinkle it on the atonement dais and
in front of the atonement dais.

translation.text: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:

verses.english:
And he shall slaughter the goat of the sin offering that
is the people’s and shall bring its blood inside the
pavilion and shall do its blood as he did to the bull’s
blood: and he shall sprinkle it on the atonement dais and
in front of the atonement dais.

verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר עַל הַקֹּדֶשׁ מִטֻּמְאֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִפִּשְׁעֵיהֶם לְכל חַטֹּאתָם וְכֵן יַעֲשֶׂה לְאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד הַשֹּׁכֵן אִתָּם בְּתוֹךְ טֻמְאֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְכִפֶּר עַל הַקֹּדֶשׁ מִטֻּמְאֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִפִּשְׁעֵיהֶם לְכל חַטֹּאתָם וְכֵן יַעֲשֶׂה לְאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד הַשֹּׁכֵן אִתָּם בְּתוֹךְ טֻמְאֹתָם׃

english.text:
And he shall make atonement over the Holy from the
impurities of the children of Israel and from their
offenses, for all their sins, and he shall do so for the
Tent of Meeting that tents with them among their
impurities.

translation.text: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

verses.english:
And he shall make atonement over the Holy from the
impurities of the children of Israel and from their
offenses, for all their sins, and he shall do so for the
Tent of Meeting that tents with them among their
impurities.

verses.hebrew: וְכל אָדָם לֹא יִהְיֶה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד בְּבֹאוֹ לְכַפֵּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ עַד צֵאתוֹ וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתוֹ וּבְעַד כּל קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְכל אָדָם לֹא יִהְיֶה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד בְּבֹאוֹ לְכַפֵּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ עַד צֵאתוֹ וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתוֹ וּבְעַד כּל קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And no human shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he comes
to make atonement in the Holy until he comes out. And he
shall make atonement for him and for his house and for all
the community of Israel.

translation.text: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.

verses.english:
And no human shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he comes
to make atonement in the Holy until he comes out. And he
shall make atonement for him and for his house and for all
the community of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו וְלָקַח מִדַּם הַפָּר וּמִדַּם הַשָּׂעִיר וְנָתַן עַל קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצָא אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו וְלָקַח מִדַּם הַפָּר וּמִדַּם הַשָּׂעִיר וְנָתַן עַל קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
“And he shall go out to the altar that is in front of YHWH
and make atonement over it, and he shall take some of the
bull’s blood and some of the goat’s blood and put it on
the altar’s horns all around.

translation.text: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the LORD, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.

verses.english:
“And he shall go out to the altar that is in front of YHWH
and make atonement over it, and he shall take some of the
bull’s blood and some of the goat’s blood and put it on
the altar’s horns all around.

verses.hebrew: וְהִזָּה עָלָיו מִן הַדָּם בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְטִהֲרוֹ וְקִדְּשׁוֹ מִטֻּמְאֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְהִזָּה עָלָיו מִן הַדָּם בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְטִהֲרוֹ וְקִדְּשׁוֹ מִטֻּמְאֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And he shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his
finger seven times and purify it and make it holy from the
impurities of the children of Israel.

translation.text: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And he shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his
finger seven times and purify it and make it holy from the
impurities of the children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְכִלָּה מִכַּפֵּר אֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהִקְרִיב אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר הֶחָי׃

hebrew.text: וְכִלָּה מִכַּפֵּר אֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהִקְרִיב אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר הֶחָי׃

english.text:
“And when he will finish making atonement for the Holy and
the Tent of Meeting and the altar, then he shall bring
forward the live goat.

translation.text: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:

verses.english:
“And when he will finish making atonement for the Holy and
the Tent of Meeting and the altar, then he shall bring
forward the live goat.

verses.hebrew: וְסָמַךְ אַהֲרֹן אֶת שְׁתֵּי יָדָו עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר הַחַי וְהִתְוַדָּה עָלָיו אֶת כּל עֲוֺנֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת כּל פִּשְׁעֵיהֶם לְכל חַטֹּאתָם וְנָתַן אֹתָם עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר וְשִׁלַּח בְּיַד אִישׁ עִתִּי הַמִּדְבָּרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְסָמַךְ אַהֲרֹן אֶת שְׁתֵּי יָדָו עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר הַחַי וְהִתְוַדָּה עָלָיו אֶת כּל עֲוֺנֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת כּל פִּשְׁעֵיהֶם לְכל חַטֹּאתָם וְנָתַן אֹתָם עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר וְשִׁלַּח בְּיַד אִישׁ עִתִּי הַמִּדְבָּרָה׃

english.text:
And Aaron shall lay his two hands on the live goat’s head
and confess over it all the crimes of the children of
Israel and all their offenses, for all their sins, and he
shall put them on the goat’s head and let it go by the
hand of an appointed man to the wilderness.

translation.text: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:

verses.english:
And Aaron shall lay his two hands on the live goat’s head
and confess over it all the crimes of the children of
Israel and all their offenses, for all their sins, and he
shall put them on the goat’s head and let it go by the
hand of an appointed man to the wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וְנָשָׂא הַשָּׂעִיר עָלָיו אֶת כּל עֲוֺנֹתָם אֶל אֶרֶץ גְּזֵרָה וְשִׁלַּח אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וְנָשָׂא הַשָּׂעִיר עָלָיו אֶת כּל עֲוֺנֹתָם אֶל אֶרֶץ גְּזֵרָה וְשִׁלַּח אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
And the goat will carry all their crimes on it to an
inaccessible land. And he shall let the goat go in the
wilderness.

translation.text: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.

verses.english:
And the goat will carry all their crimes on it to an
inaccessible land. And he shall let the goat go in the
wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וּבָא אַהֲרֹן אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּפָשַׁט אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַבָּד אֲשֶׁר לָבַשׁ בְּבֹאוֹ אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְהִנִּיחָם שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וּבָא אַהֲרֹן אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּפָשַׁט אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַבָּד אֲשֶׁר לָבַשׁ בְּבֹאוֹ אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְהִנִּיחָם שָׁם׃

english.text:
“And Aaron shall come to the Tent of Meeting and take off
the linen clothes that he wore when he came to the Holy,
and he shall leave them there.

translation.text: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:

verses.english:
“And Aaron shall come to the Tent of Meeting and take off
the linen clothes that he wore when he came to the Holy,
and he shall leave them there.

verses.hebrew: וְרָחַץ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בַמַּיִם בְּמָקוֹם קָדוֹשׁ וְלָבַשׁ אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְיָצָא וְעָשָׂה אֶת עֹלָתוֹ וְאֶת עֹלַת הָעָם וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וְרָחַץ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בַמַּיִם בְּמָקוֹם קָדוֹשׁ וְלָבַשׁ אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְיָצָא וְעָשָׂה אֶת עֹלָתוֹ וְאֶת עֹלַת הָעָם וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד הָעָם׃

english.text:
And he shall wash his flesh with water in a holy place and
put on his clothes, and he shall go out and make his burnt
offering and the people’s burnt offering and make
atonement for him and for the people.

translation.text: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.

verses.english:
And he shall wash his flesh with water in a holy place and
put on his clothes, and he shall go out and make his burnt
offering and the people’s burnt offering and make
atonement for him and for the people.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת חֵלֶב הַחַטָּאת יַקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת חֵלֶב הַחַטָּאת יַקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

english.text:
And he shall burn the fat of the sin offering into smoke
at the altar.

translation.text: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.

verses.english:
And he shall burn the fat of the sin offering into smoke
at the altar.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמְשַׁלֵּחַ אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר לַעֲזָאזֵל יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יָבוֹא אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמְשַׁלֵּחַ אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר לַעֲזָאזֵל יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יָבוֹא אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And the one who let the goat go to Azazel shall wash his
clothes and wash his flesh with water, and after that he
shall come to the camp.

translation.text: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.

verses.english:
And the one who let the goat go to Azazel shall wash his
clothes and wash his flesh with water, and after that he
shall come to the camp.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וְאֵת שְׂעִיר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר הוּבָא אֶת דָּמָם לְכַפֵּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ יוֹצִיא אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְשָׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ אֶת עֹרֹתָם וְאֶת בְּשָׂרָם וְאֶת פִּרְשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וְאֵת שְׂעִיר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר הוּבָא אֶת דָּמָם לְכַפֵּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ יוֹצִיא אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְשָׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ אֶת עֹרֹתָם וְאֶת בְּשָׂרָם וְאֶת פִּרְשָׁם׃

english.text:
And he shall take the bull of the sin offering and the
goat of the sin offering, whose blood was brought to make
atonement in the Holy, outside the camp; and they shall
burn their skin and their meat and their dung in fire.

translation.text: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.

verses.english:
And he shall take the bull of the sin offering and the
goat of the sin offering, whose blood was brought to make
atonement in the Holy, outside the camp; and they shall
burn their skin and their meat and their dung in fire.

verses.hebrew: וְהַשֹּׂרֵף אֹתָם יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יָבוֹא אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשֹּׂרֵף אֹתָם יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יָבוֹא אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And the one who burns them shall wash his clothes and wash
his flesh with water, and after that he shall come to the
camp.

translation.text: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

verses.english:
And the one who burns them shall wash his clothes and wash
his flesh with water, and after that he shall come to the
camp.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ תְּעַנּוּ אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם וְכל מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ הָאֶזְרָח וְהַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ תְּעַנּוּ אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם וְכל מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ הָאֶזְרָח וְהַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

english.text:
“And it shall be an eternal law for you: in the seventh
month, on the tenth of the month, you shall degrade
yourselves, and you shall not do any work: the citizen and
the alien who resides among you.

translation.text: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:

verses.english:
“And it shall be an eternal law for you: in the seventh
month, on the tenth of the month, you shall degrade
yourselves, and you shall not do any work: the citizen and
the alien who resides among you.

verses.hebrew: כִּי בַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תִּטְהָרוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי בַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תִּטְהָרוּ׃

english.text:
Because on this day he shall make atonement over you, to
purify you. You will be pure from all your sins in front
of YHWH.

translation.text: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.

verses.english:
Because on this day he shall make atonement over you, to
purify you. You will be pure from all your sins in front
of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן הִיא לָכֶם וְעִנִּיתֶם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן הִיא לָכֶם וְעִנִּיתֶם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
It is a Sabbath, a ceasing, to you. And you shall degrade
yourselves—an eternal law.

translation.text: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.

verses.english:
It is a Sabbath, a ceasing, to you. And you shall degrade
yourselves—an eternal law.

verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר יִמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר יְמַלֵּא אֶת יָדוֹ לְכַהֵן תַּחַת אָבִיו וְלָבַשׁ אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַבָּד בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר יִמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר יְמַלֵּא אֶת יָדוֹ לְכַהֵן תַּחַת אָבִיו וְלָבַשׁ אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַבָּד בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And the priest whom one will anoint and who will fill his
hand to function as a priest in his father’s place shall
make atonement. And he shall wear the linen clothes, the
holy clothes.

translation.text: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest’s office in his father’s stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, even the holy garments:

verses.english:
And the priest whom one will anoint and who will fill his
hand to function as a priest in his father’s place shall
make atonement. And he shall wear the linen clothes, the
holy clothes.

verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר אֶת מִקְדַּשׁ הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ יְכַפֵּר וְעַל הַכֹּהֲנִים וְעַל כּל עַם הַקָּהָל יְכַפֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וְכִפֶּר אֶת מִקְדַּשׁ הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ יְכַפֵּר וְעַל הַכֹּהֲנִים וְעַל כּל עַם הַקָּהָל יְכַפֵּר׃

english.text:
And he shall make atonement for the holy place of the
Holy, and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting
and for the altar, and he shall make atonement over the
priests and over all the people of the community.

translation.text: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.

verses.english:
And he shall make atonement for the holy place of the
Holy, and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting
and for the altar, and he shall make atonement over the
priests and over all the people of the community.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה זֹּאת לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְכַפֵּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכּל חַטֹּאתָם אַחַת בַּשָּׁנָה וַיַּעַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה זֹּאת לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְכַפֵּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכּל חַטֹּאתָם אַחַת בַּשָּׁנָה וַיַּעַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And this shall become an eternal law for you, to make
atonement over the children of Israel from all their sins,
once in the year.” And he did as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And this shall become an eternal law for you, to make
atonement over the children of Israel from all their sins,
once in the year.” And he did as YHWH had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו וְאֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו וְאֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of
Israel and say to them: This is the thing that YHWH has
commanded, saying:

translation.text: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying,

verses.english:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of
Israel and say to them: This is the thing that YHWH has
commanded, saying:

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט שׁוֹר אוֹ כֶשֶׂב אוֹ עֵז בַּמַּחֲנֶה אוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט שׁוֹר אוֹ כֶשֶׂב אוֹ עֵז בַּמַּחֲנֶה אוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
Any man from the house of Israel who slaughters an ox or a
sheep or a goat in the camp or who slaughters outside the
camp

translation.text: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it out of the camp,

verses.english:
Any man from the house of Israel who slaughters an ox or a
sheep or a goat in the camp or who slaughters outside the
camp

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֹא הֱבִיאוֹ לְהַקְרִיב קרְבָּן לַיהֹוָה לִפְנֵי מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה דָּם יֵחָשֵׁב לָאִישׁ הַהוּא דָּם שָׁפָךְ וְנִכְרַת הָאִישׁ הַהוּא מִקֶּרֶב עַמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֹא הֱבִיאוֹ לְהַקְרִיב קרְבָּן לַיהֹוָה לִפְנֵי מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה דָּם יֵחָשֵׁב לָאִישׁ הַהוּא דָּם שָׁפָךְ וְנִכְרַת הָאִישׁ הַהוּא מִקֶּרֶב עַמּוֹ׃

english.text:
and has not brought it to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting to bring forward an offering to YHWH in front of
YHWH’s Tabernacle: blood will be counted to that man. He
has spilled blood. And that man will be cut off from among
his people.

translation.text: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:

verses.english:
and has not brought it to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting to bring forward an offering to YHWH in front of
YHWH’s Tabernacle: blood will be counted to that man. He
has spilled blood. And that man will be cut off from among
his people.

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר יָבִיאוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת זִבְחֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הֵם זֹבְחִים עַל פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה וֶהֱבִיאֻם לַיהֹוָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְזָבְחוּ זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה אוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר יָבִיאוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת זִבְחֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הֵם זֹבְחִים עַל פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה וֶהֱבִיאֻם לַיהֹוָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְזָבְחוּ זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה אוֹתָם׃

english.text:
So that the children of Israel will bring their
sacrifices—which they are making at the open field—and
will bring them to YHWH, to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting, to the priest, and make them sacrifices of peace
offerings to YHWH.

translation.text: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto the LORD.

verses.english:
So that the children of Israel will bring their
sacrifices—which they are making at the open field—and
will bring them to YHWH, to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting, to the priest, and make them sacrifices of peace
offerings to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְזָרַק הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַדָּם עַל מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהִקְטִיר הַחֵלֶב לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְזָרַק הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַדָּם עַל מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהִקְטִיר הַחֵלֶב לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the priest shall fling the blood on YHWH’s altar at
the entrance of the Tent of Meeting and burn the fat to
smoke as a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And the priest shall fling the blood on YHWH’s altar at
the entrance of the Tent of Meeting and burn the fat to
smoke as a pleasant smell to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יִזְבְּחוּ עוֹד אֶת זִבְחֵיהֶם לַשְּׂעִירִם אֲשֶׁר הֵם זֹנִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה זֹּאת לָהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יִזְבְּחוּ עוֹד אֶת זִבְחֵיהֶם לַשְּׂעִירִם אֲשֶׁר הֵם זֹנִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה זֹּאת לָהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם׃

english.text:
And they shall not make their sacrifices anymore to the
satyrs, after whom they are whoring. This shall be an
eternal law to them through their generations.

translation.text: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.

verses.english:
And they shall not make their sacrifices anymore to the
satyrs, after whom they are whoring. This shall be an
eternal law to them through their generations.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲלֵהֶם תֹּאמַר אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר אֲשֶׁר יָגוּר בְּתוֹכָם אֲשֶׁר יַעֲלֶה עֹלָה אוֹ זָבַח׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲלֵהֶם תֹּאמַר אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר אֲשֶׁר יָגוּר בְּתוֹכָם אֲשֶׁר יַעֲלֶה עֹלָה אוֹ זָבַח׃

english.text:
“And you shall say to them: Any man from the house of
Israel and from the aliens who will reside among them who
will make a burnt offering or a sacrifice

translation.text: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,

verses.english:
“And you shall say to them: Any man from the house of
Israel and from the aliens who will reside among them who
will make a burnt offering or a sacrifice

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֹא יְבִיאֶנּוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֹתוֹ לַיהֹוָה וְנִכְרַת הָאִישׁ הַהוּא מֵעַמָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֹא יְבִיאֶנּוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֹתוֹ לַיהֹוָה וְנִכְרַת הָאִישׁ הַהוּא מֵעַמָּיו׃

english.text:
and will not bring it to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting to make it to YHWH: that man will be cut off from
his people.

translation.text: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the LORD; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.english:
and will not bring it to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting to make it to YHWH: that man will be cut off from
his people.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם אֲשֶׁר יֹאכַל כּל דָּם וְנָתַתִּי פָנַי בַּנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת אֶת הַדָּם וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתָהּ מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם אֲשֶׁר יֹאכַל כּל דָּם וְנָתַתִּי פָנַי בַּנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת אֶת הַדָּם וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתָהּ מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּהּ׃

english.text:
“And any man from the house of Israel and from the aliens
who will reside among them who will eat any blood: then I
shall set my face against the person who eats the blood,
and I shall cut him off from among his people.

translation.text: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

verses.english:
“And any man from the house of Israel and from the aliens
who will reside among them who will eat any blood: then I
shall set my face against the person who eats the blood,
and I shall cut him off from among his people.

verses.hebrew: כִּי נֶפֶשׁ הַבָּשָׂר בַּדָּם הִוא וַאֲנִי נְתַתִּיו לָכֶם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לְכַפֵּר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם כִּי הַדָּם הוּא בַּנֶּפֶשׁ יְכַפֵּר׃

hebrew.text: כִּי נֶפֶשׁ הַבָּשָׂר בַּדָּם הִוא וַאֲנִי נְתַתִּיו לָכֶם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לְכַפֵּר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם כִּי הַדָּם הוּא בַּנֶּפֶשׁ יְכַפֵּר׃

english.text:
Because the flesh’s life is in the blood, and I have given
it to you on the altar to make atonement over your lives,
because it is the blood that makes atonement for life.

translation.text: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.

verses.english:
Because the flesh’s life is in the blood, and I have given
it to you on the altar to make atonement over your lives,
because it is the blood that makes atonement for life.

verses.hebrew: עַל כֵּן אָמַרְתִּי לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל נֶפֶשׁ מִכֶּם לֹא תֹאכַל דָּם וְהַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם לֹא יֹאכַל דָּם׃

hebrew.text: עַל כֵּן אָמַרְתִּי לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל נֶפֶשׁ מִכֶּם לֹא תֹאכַל דָּם וְהַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם לֹא יֹאכַל דָּם׃

english.text:
On account of this I have said to the children of Israel:
every person among you shall not eat blood, and the alien
who resides among you shall not eat blood.

translation.text: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.

verses.english:
On account of this I have said to the children of Israel:
every person among you shall not eat blood, and the alien
who resides among you shall not eat blood.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם אֲשֶׁר יָצוּד צֵיד חַיָּה אוֹ עוֹף אֲשֶׁר יֵאָכֵל וְשָׁפַךְ אֶת דָּמוֹ וְכִסָּהוּ בֶּעָפָר׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם אֲשֶׁר יָצוּד צֵיד חַיָּה אוֹ עוֹף אֲשֶׁר יֵאָכֵל וְשָׁפַךְ אֶת דָּמוֹ וְכִסָּהוּ בֶּעָפָר׃

english.text:
“And any man from the children of Israel and from the
aliens who reside among them who will hunt game, animal or
bird, that may be eaten: he shall spill out its blood and
cover it with dust.

translation.text: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.

verses.english:
“And any man from the children of Israel and from the
aliens who reside among them who will hunt game, animal or
bird, that may be eaten: he shall spill out its blood and
cover it with dust.

verses.hebrew: כִּי נֶפֶשׁ כּל בָּשָׂר דָּמוֹ בְנַפְשׁוֹ הוּא וָאֹמַר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דַּם כּל בָּשָׂר לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ כִּי נֶפֶשׁ כּל בָּשָׂר דָּמוֹ הִוא כּל אֹכְלָיו יִכָּרֵת׃

hebrew.text: כִּי נֶפֶשׁ כּל בָּשָׂר דָּמוֹ בְנַפְשׁוֹ הוּא וָאֹמַר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דַּם כּל בָּשָׂר לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ כִּי נֶפֶשׁ כּל בָּשָׂר דָּמוֹ הִוא כּל אֹכְלָיו יִכָּרֵת׃

english.text:
Because all flesh’s life: its blood is one with its life.
So I say to the children of Israel: you shall not eat the
blood of all flesh—because all flesh’s life: it is its
blood. Everyone of those who eat it will be cut off.

translation.text: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.

verses.english:
Because all flesh’s life: its blood is one with its life.
So I say to the children of Israel: you shall not eat the
blood of all flesh—because all flesh’s life: it is its
blood. Everyone of those who eat it will be cut off.

verses.hebrew: וְכל נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל נְבֵלָה וּטְרֵפָה בָּאֶזְרָח וּבַגֵּר וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעֶרֶב וְטָהֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְכל נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל נְבֵלָה וּטְרֵפָה בָּאֶזְרָח וּבַגֵּר וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעֶרֶב וְטָהֵר׃

english.text:
And any living being, whether a citizen or an alien, who
will eat carcass or a torn animal shall wash his clothes
and shall wash with water and will be impure until evening
and then will be pure.

translation.text: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.

verses.english:
And any living being, whether a citizen or an alien, who
will eat carcass or a torn animal shall wash his clothes
and shall wash with water and will be impure until evening
and then will be pure.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא יְכַבֵּס וּבְשָׂרוֹ לֹא יִרְחָץ וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא יְכַבֵּס וּבְשָׂרוֹ לֹא יִרְחָץ וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ׃

english.text:
And if he will not wash them and will not wash his flesh,
then he shall bear his crime.”

translation.text: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.

verses.english:
And if he will not wash them and will not wash his flesh,
then he shall bear his crime.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: I am YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יְשַׁבְתֶּם בָּהּ לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וּכְמַעֲשֵׂה אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וּבְחֻקֹּתֵיהֶם לֹא תֵלֵכוּ׃

hebrew.text: כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יְשַׁבְתֶּם בָּהּ לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וּכְמַעֲשֵׂה אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וּבְחֻקֹּתֵיהֶם לֹא תֵלֵכוּ׃

english.text:
You shall shall not do like what is done in the land of
Egypt, in which you lived; and you shall not do like what
is done in the land of Canaan, to which I’m bringing you;
and you shall not go by their laws.

translation.text: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.

verses.english:
You shall shall not do like what is done in the land of
Egypt, in which you lived; and you shall not do like what
is done in the land of Canaan, to which I’m bringing you;
and you shall not go by their laws.

verses.hebrew: אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי תַּעֲשׂוּ וְאֶת חֻקֹּתַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ לָלֶכֶת בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי תַּעֲשׂוּ וְאֶת חֻקֹּתַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ לָלֶכֶת בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
You shall do my judgments, and you shall observe my laws,
to go by them. I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
You shall do my judgments, and you shall observe my laws,
to go by them. I am YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם הָאָדָם וָחַי בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם הָאָדָם וָחַי בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall observe my laws and my judgments, which,
when a human will do them, he’ll live through them! I am
YHWH.

translation.text: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall observe my laws and my judgments, which,
when a human will do them, he’ll live through them! I am
YHWH.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ אִישׁ אֶל כּל שְׁאֵר בְּשָׂרוֹ לֹא תִקְרְבוּ לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָה אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אִישׁ אִישׁ אֶל כּל שְׁאֵר בְּשָׂרוֹ לֹא תִקְרְבוּ לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָה אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Any man, to any close relative of his: you shall not come
