close to expose nudity. I am YHWH.

translation.text: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
“Any man, to any close relative of his: you shall not come
close to expose nudity. I am YHWH.

verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אָבִיךָ וְעֶרְוַת אִמְּךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אִמְּךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת אָבִיךָ וְעֶרְוַת אִמְּךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אִמְּךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

english.text:
You shall not expose your father’s nudity and your
mother’s nudity. She is your mother. You shall not expose
her nudity.

translation.text: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

verses.english:
You shall not expose your father’s nudity and your
mother’s nudity. She is your mother. You shall not expose
her nudity.

verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אֵשֶׁת אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה עֶרְוַת אָבִיךָ הִוא׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת אֵשֶׁת אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה עֶרְוַת אָבִיךָ הִוא׃

english.text:
You shall not expose your father’s wife’s nudity. It is
your father’s nudity.

translation.text: The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father’s nakedness.

verses.english:
You shall not expose your father’s wife’s nudity. It is
your father’s nudity.

verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אֲחוֹתְךָ בַת אָבִיךָ אוֹ בַת אִמֶּךָ מוֹלֶדֶת בַּיִת אוֹ מוֹלֶדֶת חוּץ לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָן׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת אֲחוֹתְךָ בַת אָבִיךָ אוֹ בַת אִמֶּךָ מוֹלֶדֶת בַּיִת אוֹ מוֹלֶדֶת חוּץ לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָן׃

english.text:
Your sister’s nudity—your father’s daughter or your
mother’s daughter, born home or born outside—you shall not
expose their nudity.

translation.text: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.

verses.english:
Your sister’s nudity—your father’s daughter or your
mother’s daughter, born home or born outside—you shall not
expose their nudity.

verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת בַּת בִּנְךָ אוֹ בַת בִּתְּךָ לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָן כִּי עֶרְוָתְךָ הֵנָּה׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת בַּת בִּנְךָ אוֹ בַת בִּתְּךָ לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָן כִּי עֶרְוָתְךָ הֵנָּה׃

english.text:
The nudity of your son’s daughter or your daughter’s
daughter—you shall not expose their nudity, because they
are your nudity.

translation.text: The nakedness of thy son’s daughter, or of thy daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.

verses.english:
The nudity of your son’s daughter or your daughter’s
daughter—you shall not expose their nudity, because they
are your nudity.

verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת בַּת אֵשֶׁת אָבִיךָ מוֹלֶדֶת אָבִיךָ אֲחוֹתְךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת בַּת אֵשֶׁת אָבִיךָ מוֹלֶדֶת אָבִיךָ אֲחוֹתְךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

english.text:
The nudity of your father’s wife’s daughter, born of your
father: she is your sister; you shall not expose her
nudity.

translation.text: The nakedness of thy father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

verses.english:
The nudity of your father’s wife’s daughter, born of your
father: she is your sister; you shall not expose her
nudity.

verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה שְׁאֵר אָבִיךָ הִוא׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה שְׁאֵר אָבִיךָ הִוא׃

english.text:
You shall not expose your father’s sister’s nudity. She is
your father’s close relative.

translation.text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s sister: she is thy father’s near kinswoman.

verses.english:
You shall not expose your father’s sister’s nudity. She is
your father’s close relative.

verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת אִמְּךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה כִּי שְׁאֵר אִמְּךָ הִוא׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת אִמְּךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה כִּי שְׁאֵר אִמְּךָ הִוא׃

english.text:
You shall not expose your mother’s sister’s nudity. She is
your mother’s close relative.

translation.text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister: for she is thy mother’s near kinswoman.

verses.english:
You shall not expose your mother’s sister’s nudity. She is
your mother’s close relative.

verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אֲחִי אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ לֹא תִקְרָב דֹּדָתְךָ הִוא׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת אֲחִי אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ לֹא תִקְרָב דֹּדָתְךָ הִוא׃

english.text:
You shall not expose your father’s brother’s nudity: you
shall not come close to his wife. She is your aunt.

translation.text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.

verses.english:
You shall not expose your father’s brother’s nudity: you
shall not come close to his wife. She is your aunt.

verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת כַּלָּתְךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אֵשֶׁת בִּנְךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת כַּלָּתְךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אֵשֶׁת בִּנְךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

english.text:
You shall not expose your daughter-in-law’s nudity. She is
your son’s wife. You shall not expose her nudity.

translation.text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son’s wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

verses.english:
You shall not expose your daughter-in-law’s nudity. She is
your son’s wife. You shall not expose her nudity.

verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אֵשֶׁת אָחִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה עֶרְוַת אָחִיךָ הִוא׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת אֵשֶׁת אָחִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה עֶרְוַת אָחִיךָ הִוא׃

english.text:
You shall not expose your brother’s wife’s nudity. It is
your brother’s nudity.

translation.text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother’s wife: it is thy brother’s nakedness.

verses.english:
You shall not expose your brother’s wife’s nudity. It is
your brother’s nudity.

verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אִשָּׁה וּבִתָּהּ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אֶת בַּת בְּנָהּ וְאֶת בַּת בִּתָּהּ לֹא תִקַּח לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָהּ שַׁאֲרָה הֵנָּה זִמָּה הִוא׃

hebrew.text: עֶרְוַת אִשָּׁה וּבִתָּהּ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אֶת בַּת בְּנָהּ וְאֶת בַּת בִּתָּהּ לֹא תִקַּח לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָהּ שַׁאֲרָה הֵנָּה זִמָּה הִוא׃

english.text:
You shall not expose the nudity of a woman and her
daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter or her
daughter’s daughter to expose her nudity. They are close
relatives. It is perversion.

translation.text: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

verses.english:
You shall not expose the nudity of a woman and her
daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter or her
daughter’s daughter to expose her nudity. They are close
relatives. It is perversion.

verses.hebrew: וְאִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ לֹא תִקָּח לִצְרֹר לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָהּ עָלֶיהָ בְּחַיֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ לֹא תִקָּח לִצְרֹר לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָהּ עָלֶיהָ בְּחַיֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
And you shall not take a woman to her sister to rival, to
expose her nudity along with her in her lifetime.

translation.text: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.

verses.english:
And you shall not take a woman to her sister to rival, to
expose her nudity along with her in her lifetime.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל אִשָּׁה בְּנִדַּת טֻמְאָתָהּ לֹא תִקְרַב לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל אִשָּׁה בְּנִדַּת טֻמְאָתָהּ לֹא תִקְרַב לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

english.text:
And you shall not come close to a woman during her
menstrual impurity to expose her nudity.

translation.text: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.

verses.english:
And you shall not come close to a woman during her
menstrual impurity to expose her nudity.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל אֵשֶׁת עֲמִיתְךָ לֹא תִתֵּן שְׁכבְתְּךָ לְזָרַע לְטמְאָה בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל אֵשֶׁת עֲמִיתְךָ לֹא תִתֵּן שְׁכבְתְּךָ לְזָרַע לְטמְאָה בָהּ׃

english.text:
And you shall not give your intercourse of seed to your
fellow’s wife, to become impure by it.

translation.text: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour’s wife, to defile thyself with her.

verses.english:
And you shall not give your intercourse of seed to your
fellow’s wife, to become impure by it.

verses.hebrew: וּמִזַּרְעֲךָ לֹא תִתֵּן לְהַעֲבִיר לַמֹּלֶךְ וְלֹא תְחַלֵּל אֶת שֵׁם אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּמִזַּרְעֲךָ לֹא תִתֵּן לְהַעֲבִיר לַמֹּלֶךְ וְלֹא תְחַלֵּל אֶת שֵׁם אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall not give any of your seed for passing to the
Molech, and you shall not desecrate your God’s name. I am
YHWH.

translation.text: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall not give any of your seed for passing to the
Molech, and you shall not desecrate your God’s name. I am
YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת זָכָר לֹא תִשְׁכַּב מִשְׁכְּבֵי אִשָּׁה תּוֹעֵבָה הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת זָכָר לֹא תִשְׁכַּב מִשְׁכְּבֵי אִשָּׁה תּוֹעֵבָה הִוא׃

english.text:
And you shall not lie with a male like lying with a woman.
It is an offensive thing.

translation.text: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.

verses.english:
And you shall not lie with a male like lying with a woman.
It is an offensive thing.

verses.hebrew: וּבְכל בְּהֵמָה לֹא תִתֵּן שְׁכבְתְּךָ לְטמְאָה בָהּ וְאִשָּׁה לֹא תַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי בְהֵמָה לְרִבְעָהּ תֶּבֶל הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וּבְכל בְּהֵמָה לֹא תִתֵּן שְׁכבְתְּךָ לְטמְאָה בָהּ וְאִשָּׁה לֹא תַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי בְהֵמָה לְרִבְעָהּ תֶּבֶל הוּא׃

english.text:
And you shall not give your intercourse with any animal,
to become impure by it. And a woman shall not stand in
front of an animal to mate with it. It is an aberration.

translation.text: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.

verses.english:
And you shall not give your intercourse with any animal,
to become impure by it. And a woman shall not stand in
front of an animal to mate with it. It is an aberration.

verses.hebrew: אַל תִּטַּמְּאוּ בְּכל אֵלֶּה כִּי בְכל אֵלֶּה נִטְמְאוּ הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מְשַׁלֵּחַ מִפְּנֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אַל תִּטַּמְּאוּ בְּכל אֵלֶּה כִּי בְכל אֵלֶּה נִטְמְאוּ הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מְשַׁלֵּחַ מִפְּנֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“You shall not become impure by all of these, because the
nations that I am putting out from in front of you became
impure by all of these,

translation.text: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:

verses.english:
“You shall not become impure by all of these, because the
nations that I am putting out from in front of you became
impure by all of these,

verses.hebrew: וַתִּטְמָא הָאָרֶץ וָאֶפְקֹד עֲוֺנָהּ עָלֶיהָ וַתָּקִא הָאָרֶץ אֶת יֹשְׁבֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּטְמָא הָאָרֶץ וָאֶפְקֹד עֲוֺנָהּ עָלֶיהָ וַתָּקִא הָאָרֶץ אֶת יֹשְׁבֶיהָ׃

english.text:
and the land became impure, and I reckoned its sin on it,
and the land vomited out its residents.

translation.text: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.

verses.english:
and the land became impure, and I reckoned its sin on it,
and the land vomited out its residents.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אַתֶּם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ מִכֹּל הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵלֶּה הָאֶזְרָח וְהַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אַתֶּם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ מִכֹּל הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵלֶּה הָאֶזְרָח וְהַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

english.text:
But you: you shall observe my laws and my judgments and
not do any of all these offensive things, the citizen and
the alien who resides among you—

translation.text: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:

verses.english:
But you: you shall observe my laws and my judgments and
not do any of all these offensive things, the citizen and
the alien who resides among you—

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶת כּל הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵל עָשׂוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵיכֶם וַתִּטְמָא הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֶת כּל הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵל עָשׂוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵיכֶם וַתִּטְמָא הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
because the people of the land who were before you did all
of these offensive things, and the land became impure—

translation.text: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)

verses.english:
because the people of the land who were before you did all
of these offensive things, and the land became impure—

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תָקִיא הָאָרֶץ אֶתְכֶם בְּטַמַּאֲכֶם אֹתָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר קָאָה אֶת הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תָקִיא הָאָרֶץ אֶתְכֶם בְּטַמַּאֲכֶם אֹתָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר קָאָה אֶת הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
so the land will not vomit you out for your making it
impure as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

translation.text: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.

verses.english:
so the land will not vomit you out for your making it
impure as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

verses.hebrew: כִּי כּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה מִכֹּל הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְנִכְרְתוּ הַנְּפָשׁוֹת הָעֹשֹׂת מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי כּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה מִכֹּל הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְנִכְרְתוּ הַנְּפָשׁוֹת הָעֹשֹׂת מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּם׃

english.text:
Because anyone who will do any of these offensive things:
the persons who do will be cut off from among their
people.

translation.text: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.

verses.english:
Because anyone who will do any of these offensive things:
the persons who do will be cut off from among their
people.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתִּי לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת מֵחֻקּוֹת הַתּוֹעֵבֹת אֲשֶׁר נַעֲשׂוּ לִפְנֵיכֶם וְלֹא תִטַּמְּאוּ בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתִּי לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת מֵחֻקּוֹת הַתּוֹעֵבֹת אֲשֶׁר נַעֲשׂוּ לִפְנֵיכֶם וְלֹא תִטַּמְּאוּ בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall keep my charge: not to do any of the
abominable customs that were done before you; and you will
not become impure by them. I am YHWH, your God.”

translation.text: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
And you shall keep my charge: not to do any of the
abominable customs that were done before you; and you will
not become impure by them. I am YHWH, your God.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם קְדֹשִׁים תִּהְיוּ כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם קְדֹשִׁים תִּהְיוּ כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel,
and you shall say to them: You shall be holy, because I,
YHWH, your God, am holy.

translation.text: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God am holy.

verses.english:
“Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel,
and you shall say to them: You shall be holy, because I,
YHWH, your God, am holy.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ אִמּוֹ וְאָבִיו תִּירָאוּ וְאֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אִישׁ אִמּוֹ וְאָבִיו תִּירָאוּ וְאֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“You shall each fear his mother and his father, and you
shall observe my Sabbaths. I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“You shall each fear his mother and his father, and you
shall observe my Sabbaths. I am YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: אַל תִּפְנוּ אֶל הָאֱלִילִם וֵאלֹהֵי מַסֵּכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אַל תִּפְנוּ אֶל הָאֱלִילִם וֵאלֹהֵי מַסֵּכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“Do not turn to idols, and you shall not make molten gods
for yourselves. I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“Do not turn to idols, and you shall not make molten gods
for yourselves. I am YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי תִזְבְּחוּ זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה לִרְצֹנְכֶם תִּזְבָּחֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תִזְבְּחוּ זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה לִרְצֹנְכֶם תִּזְבָּחֻהוּ׃

english.text:
“And when you will make a peace-offering sacrifice to
YHWH, you shall sacrifice it so that it will be accepted
for you.

translation.text: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.

verses.english:
“And when you will make a peace-offering sacrifice to
YHWH, you shall sacrifice it so that it will be accepted
for you.

verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם זִבְחֲכֶם יֵאָכֵל וּמִמּחֳרָת וְהַנּוֹתָר עַד יוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף׃

hebrew.text: בְּיוֹם זִבְחֲכֶם יֵאָכֵל וּמִמּחֳרָת וְהַנּוֹתָר עַד יוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף׃

english.text:
It shall be eaten on the day of your sacrifice and on the
next day; and what is left until the third day shall be
burned in fire.

translation.text: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.

verses.english:
It shall be eaten on the day of your sacrifice and on the
next day; and what is left until the third day shall be
burned in fire.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם הֵאָכֹל יֵאָכֵל בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי פִּגּוּל הוּא לֹא יֵרָצֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם הֵאָכֹל יֵאָכֵל בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי פִּגּוּל הוּא לֹא יֵרָצֶה׃

english.text:
And if it will be eaten on the third day it is a repugnant
thing. It shall not be acceptable.

translation.text: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.

verses.english:
And if it will be eaten on the third day it is a repugnant
thing. It shall not be acceptable.

verses.hebrew: וְאֹכְלָיו עֲוֺנוֹ יִשָּׂא כִּי אֶת קֹדֶשׁ יְהֹוָה חִלֵּל וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֹכְלָיו עֲוֺנוֹ יִשָּׂא כִּי אֶת קֹדֶשׁ יְהֹוָה חִלֵּל וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
And anyone who eats it shall bear his crime, because he
desecrated YHWH’s holy thing, and that person will be cut
off from his people.

translation.text: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.english:
And anyone who eats it shall bear his crime, because he
desecrated YHWH’s holy thing, and that person will be cut
off from his people.

verses.hebrew: וּבְקֻצְרְכֶם אֶת קְצִיר אַרְצְכֶם לֹא תְכַלֶּה פְּאַת שָׂדְךָ לִקְצֹר וְלֶקֶט קְצִירְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט׃

hebrew.text: וּבְקֻצְרְכֶם אֶת קְצִיר אַרְצְכֶם לֹא תְכַלֶּה פְּאַת שָׂדְךָ לִקְצֹר וְלֶקֶט קְצִירְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט׃

english.text:
And when you reap your land’s harvest, you shall not
finish harvesting your field’s corner, and you shall not
gather your harvest’s gleaning.

translation.text: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.

verses.english:
And when you reap your land’s harvest, you shall not
finish harvesting your field’s corner, and you shall not
gather your harvest’s gleaning.

verses.hebrew: וְכַרְמְךָ לֹא תְעוֹלֵל וּפֶרֶט כַּרְמְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט לֶעָנִי וְלַגֵּר תַּעֲזֹב אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְכַרְמְךָ לֹא תְעוֹלֵל וּפֶרֶט כַּרְמְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט לֶעָנִי וְלַגֵּר תַּעֲזֹב אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall not strip your vineyard, and you shall not
collect the vineyard’s fallen fruit. You shall leave them
for the poor and for the alien. I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
And you shall not strip your vineyard, and you shall not
collect the vineyard’s fallen fruit. You shall leave them
for the poor and for the alien. I am YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִּגְנֹבוּ וְלֹא תְכַחֲשׁוּ וְלֹא תְשַׁקְּרוּ אִישׁ בַּעֲמִיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִּגְנֹבוּ וְלֹא תְכַחֲשׁוּ וְלֹא תְשַׁקְּרוּ אִישׁ בַּעֲמִיתוֹ׃

english.text:
“You shall not steal, and you shall not lie, and you shall
not act false, each against his fellow.

translation.text: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.

verses.english:
“You shall not steal, and you shall not lie, and you shall
not act false, each against his fellow.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תִשָּׁבְעוּ בִשְׁמִי לַשָּׁקֶר וְחִלַּלְתָּ אֶת שֵׁם אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תִשָּׁבְעוּ בִשְׁמִי לַשָּׁקֶר וְחִלַּלְתָּ אֶת שֵׁם אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall not swear by my name falsely, so that you
would desecrate your God’s name. I am YHWH.

translation.text: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall not swear by my name falsely, so that you
would desecrate your God’s name. I am YHWH.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲשֹׁק אֶת רֵעֲךָ וְלֹא תִגְזֹל לֹא תָלִין פְּעֻלַּת שָׂכִיר אִתְּךָ עַד בֹּקֶר׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲשֹׁק אֶת רֵעֲךָ וְלֹא תִגְזֹל לֹא תָלִין פְּעֻלַּת שָׂכִיר אִתְּךָ עַד בֹּקֶר׃

english.text:
“You shall not exploit your neighbor, and you shall not
rob. An employee’s wages shall not stay through the night
with you until morning.

translation.text: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

verses.english:
“You shall not exploit your neighbor, and you shall not
rob. An employee’s wages shall not stay through the night
with you until morning.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תְקַלֵּל חֵרֵשׁ וְלִפְנֵי עִוֵּר לֹא תִתֵּן מִכְשֹׁל וְיָרֵאתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תְקַלֵּל חֵרֵשׁ וְלִפְנֵי עִוֵּר לֹא תִתֵּן מִכְשֹׁל וְיָרֵאתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall not curse a deaf person, and you shall not place
a stumbling block in front of a blind person. And you
shall fear your God. I am YHWH.

translation.text: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
You shall not curse a deaf person, and you shall not place
a stumbling block in front of a blind person. And you
shall fear your God. I am YHWH.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ עָוֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט לֹא תִשָּׂא פְנֵי דָל וְלֹא תֶהְדַּר פְּנֵי גָדוֹל בְּצֶדֶק תִּשְׁפֹּט עֲמִיתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ עָוֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט לֹא תִשָּׂא פְנֵי דָל וְלֹא תֶהְדַּר פְּנֵי גָדוֹל בְּצֶדֶק תִּשְׁפֹּט עֲמִיתֶךָ׃

english.text:
“You shall not do an injustice in judgment. You shall not
be partial to a weak person, and you shall not favor a big
person. You shall judge your fellow with justice.

translation.text: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.

verses.english:
“You shall not do an injustice in judgment. You shall not
be partial to a weak person, and you shall not favor a big
person. You shall judge your fellow with justice.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תֵלֵךְ רָכִיל בְּעַמֶּיךָ לֹא תַעֲמֹד עַל דַּם רֵעֶךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֵלֵךְ רָכִיל בְּעַמֶּיךָ לֹא תַעֲמֹד עַל דַּם רֵעֶךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall not go with slander among your people. You shall
not stand by at your neighbor’s blood. I am YHWH.

translation.text: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour; I am the LORD.

verses.english:
You shall not go with slander among your people. You shall
not stand by at your neighbor’s blood. I am YHWH.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִשְׂנָא אֶת אָחִיךָ בִּלְבָבֶךָ הוֹכֵחַ תּוֹכִיחַ אֶת עֲמִיתֶךָ וְלֹא תִשָּׂא עָלָיו חֵטְא׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִשְׂנָא אֶת אָחִיךָ בִּלְבָבֶךָ הוֹכֵחַ תּוֹכִיחַ אֶת עֲמִיתֶךָ וְלֹא תִשָּׂא עָלָיו חֵטְא׃

english.text:
“You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall
criticize your fellow, so you shall not bear sin over him.

translation.text: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.

verses.english:
“You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall
criticize your fellow, so you shall not bear sin over him.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִקֹּם וְלֹא תִטֹּר אֶת בְּנֵי עַמֶּךָ וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִקֹּם וְלֹא תִטֹּר אֶת בְּנֵי עַמֶּךָ וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall not take revenge, and you shall not keep on at
the children of your people. And you shall love your
neighbor as yourself. I am YHWH.

translation.text: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
You shall not take revenge, and you shall not keep on at
the children of your people. And you shall love your
neighbor as yourself. I am YHWH.

verses.hebrew: אֶת חֻקֹּתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ בְּהֶמְתְּךָ לֹא תַרְבִּיעַ כִּלְאַיִם שָׂדְךָ לֹא תִזְרַע כִּלְאָיִם וּבֶגֶד כִּלְאַיִם שַׁעַטְנֵז לֹא יַעֲלֶה עָלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: אֶת חֻקֹּתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ בְּהֶמְתְּךָ לֹא תַרְבִּיעַ כִּלְאַיִם שָׂדְךָ לֹא תִזְרַע כִּלְאָיִם וּבֶגֶד כִּלְאַיִם שַׁעַטְנֵז לֹא יַעֲלֶה עָלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
“You shall observe my laws. Your animal: you shall not
mate two kinds. Your field: you shall not seed two kinds.
And a garment of two kinds, sha‘atnez: it shall not go on
you.

translation.text: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.

verses.english:
“You shall observe my laws. Your animal: you shall not
mate two kinds. Your field: you shall not seed two kinds.
And a garment of two kinds, sha‘atnez: it shall not go on
you.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִשְׁכַּב אֶת אִשָּׁה שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע וְהִוא שִׁפְחָה נֶחֱרֶפֶת לְאִישׁ וְהפְדֵּה לֹא נִפְדָּתָה אוֹ חֻפְשָׁה לֹא נִתַּן לָהּ בִּקֹּרֶת תִּהְיֶה לֹא יוּמְתוּ כִּי לֹא חֻפָּשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִשְׁכַּב אֶת אִשָּׁה שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע וְהִוא שִׁפְחָה נֶחֱרֶפֶת לְאִישׁ וְהפְדֵּה לֹא נִפְדָּתָה אוֹ חֻפְשָׁה לֹא נִתַּן לָהּ בִּקֹּרֶת תִּהְיֶה לֹא יוּמְתוּ כִּי לֹא חֻפָּשָׁה׃

english.text:
“And when a man will lie with a woman—an intercourse of
seed—and she is a maid designated to a man, and she has
not been redeemed, or freedom has not been given to her,
there will be a reparation. They shall not be put to
death, because she was not freed.

translation.text: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

verses.english:
“And when a man will lie with a woman—an intercourse of
seed—and she is a maid designated to a man, and she has
not been redeemed, or freedom has not been given to her,
there will be a reparation. They shall not be put to
death, because she was not freed.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ לַיהֹוָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֵיל אָשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ לַיהֹוָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֵיל אָשָׁם׃

english.text:
And he shall bring his guilt offering to YHWH, to the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting, a ram for a guilt
offering.

translation.text: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.

verses.english:
And he shall bring his guilt offering to YHWH, to the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting, a ram for a guilt
offering.

verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן בְּאֵיל הָאָשָׁם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְנִסְלַח לוֹ מֵחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא׃

hebrew.text: וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן בְּאֵיל הָאָשָׁם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְנִסְלַח לוֹ מֵחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא׃

english.text:
And the priest shall atone over him with the ram for the
guilt offering in front of YHWH over his sin that he
committed, and it will be forgiven for him from his sin
that he committed.

translation.text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.

verses.english:
And the priest shall atone over him with the ram for the
guilt offering in front of YHWH over his sin that he
committed, and it will be forgiven for him from his sin
that he committed.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי תָבֹאוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ וּנְטַעְתֶּם כּל עֵץ מַאֲכָל וַעֲרַלְתֶּם ערְלָתוֹ אֶת פִּרְיוֹ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים יִהְיֶה לָכֶם עֲרֵלִים לֹא יֵאָכֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תָבֹאוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ וּנְטַעְתֶּם כּל עֵץ מַאֲכָל וַעֲרַלְתֶּם ערְלָתוֹ אֶת פִּרְיוֹ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים יִהְיֶה לָכֶם עֲרֵלִים לֹא יֵאָכֵל׃

english.text:
“And when you will come to the land, and you will plant
any tree for eating, you shall leave its top with its
fruit uncircumcised. It shall be uncircumcised for three
years for you. It shall not be eaten.

translation.text: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.

verses.english:
“And when you will come to the land, and you will plant
any tree for eating, you shall leave its top with its
fruit uncircumcised. It shall be uncircumcised for three
years for you. It shall not be eaten.

verses.hebrew: וּבַשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִת יִהְיֶה כּל פִּרְיוֹ קֹדֶשׁ הִלּוּלִים לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבַשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִת יִהְיֶה כּל פִּרְיוֹ קֹדֶשׁ הִלּוּלִים לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And in the fourth year all of its fruit shall be holy,
tributes for YHWH.

translation.text: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD withal.

verses.english:
And in the fourth year all of its fruit shall be holy,
tributes for YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וּבַשָּׁנָה הַחֲמִישִׁת תֹּאכְלוּ אֶת פִּרְיוֹ לְהוֹסִיף לָכֶם תְּבוּאָתוֹ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּבַשָּׁנָה הַחֲמִישִׁת תֹּאכְלוּ אֶת פִּרְיוֹ לְהוֹסִיף לָכֶם תְּבוּאָתוֹ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And in the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, to increase
its produce for you. I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
And in the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, to increase
its produce for you. I am YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תֹאכְלוּ עַל הַדָּם לֹא תְנַחֲשׁוּ וְלֹא תְעוֹנֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֹאכְלוּ עַל הַדָּם לֹא תְנַחֲשׁוּ וְלֹא תְעוֹנֵנוּ׃

english.text:
“You shall not eat with the blood. You shall not practice
divination, and you shall not practice soothsaying.

translation.text: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.

verses.english:
“You shall not eat with the blood. You shall not practice
divination, and you shall not practice soothsaying.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תַקִּפוּ פְּאַת רֹאשְׁכֶם וְלֹא תַשְׁחִית אֵת פְּאַת זְקָנֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַקִּפוּ פְּאַת רֹאשְׁכֶם וְלֹא תַשְׁחִית אֵת פְּאַת זְקָנֶךָ׃

english.text:
You shall not trim your head’s edge, and you shall not
destroy your beard’s edge.

translation.text: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.

verses.english:
You shall not trim your head’s edge, and you shall not
destroy your beard’s edge.

verses.hebrew: וְשֶׂרֶט לָנֶפֶשׁ לֹא תִתְּנוּ בִּבְשַׂרְכֶם וּכְתֹבֶת קַעֲקַע לֹא תִתְּנוּ בָּכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְשֶׂרֶט לָנֶפֶשׁ לֹא תִתְּנוּ בִּבְשַׂרְכֶם וּכְתֹבֶת קַעֲקַע לֹא תִתְּנוּ בָּכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall not put a cut in your flesh for a person, and
you shall not put an inscription of a tattoo in you. I am
YHWH.

translation.text: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
You shall not put a cut in your flesh for a person, and
you shall not put an inscription of a tattoo in you. I am
YHWH.

verses.hebrew: אַל תְּחַלֵּל אֶת בִּתְּךָ לְהַזְנוֹתָהּ וְלֹא תִזְנֶה הָאָרֶץ וּמָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ זִמָּה׃

hebrew.text: אַל תְּחַלֵּל אֶת בִּתְּךָ לְהַזְנוֹתָהּ וְלֹא תִזְנֶה הָאָרֶץ וּמָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ זִמָּה׃

english.text:
“Do not desecrate your daughter to make her a prostitute,
so the land will not go to prostitution, and the land will
fill with perversion.

translation.text: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.

verses.english:
“Do not desecrate your daughter to make her a prostitute,
so the land will not go to prostitution, and the land will
fill with perversion.

verses.hebrew: אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁי תִּירָאוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁי תִּירָאוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall observe my Sabbaths and fear my holy place. I am
YHWH.

translation.text: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
You shall observe my Sabbaths and fear my holy place. I am
YHWH.

verses.hebrew: אַל תִּפְנוּ אֶל הָאֹבֹת וְאֶל הַיִּדְּעֹנִים אַל תְּבַקְשׁוּ לְטמְאָה בָהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אַל תִּפְנוּ אֶל הָאֹבֹת וְאֶל הַיִּדְּעֹנִים אַל תְּבַקְשׁוּ לְטמְאָה בָהֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“Do not turn to ghosts, and do not seek spirits of
acquaintances, to become impure by them. I am YHWH, your
God.

translation.text: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“Do not turn to ghosts, and do not seek spirits of
acquaintances, to become impure by them. I am YHWH, your
God.

verses.hebrew: מִפְּנֵי שֵׂיבָה תָּקוּם וְהָדַרְתָּ פְּנֵי זָקֵן וְיָרֵאתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: מִפְּנֵי שֵׂיבָה תָּקוּם וְהָדַרְתָּ פְּנֵי זָקֵן וְיָרֵאתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“You shall get up in front of an aged person, and you
shall show respect in front of an elderly person. And you
shall fear your God. I am YHWH.

translation.text: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
“You shall get up in front of an aged person, and you
shall show respect in front of an elderly person. And you
shall fear your God. I am YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יָגוּר אִתְּךָ גֵּר בְּאַרְצְכֶם לֹא תוֹנוּ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יָגוּר אִתְּךָ גֵּר בְּאַרְצְכֶם לֹא תוֹנוּ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
“And if an alien will reside with you in your land, you
shall not persecute him.

translation.text: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.

verses.english:
“And if an alien will reside with you in your land, you
shall not persecute him.

verses.hebrew: כְּאֶזְרָח מִכֶּם יִהְיֶה לָכֶם הַגֵּר הַגָּר אִתְּכֶם וְאָהַבְתָּ לוֹ כָּמוֹךָ כִּי גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כְּאֶזְרָח מִכֶּם יִהְיֶה לָכֶם הַגֵּר הַגָּר אִתְּכֶם וְאָהַבְתָּ לוֹ כָּמוֹךָ כִּי גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
The alien who resides with you shall be to you like a
citizen of yours, and you shall love him as yourself,
because you were aliens in the land of Egypt. I am YHWH,
your God.

translation.text: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
The alien who resides with you shall be to you like a
citizen of yours, and you shall love him as yourself,
because you were aliens in the land of Egypt. I am YHWH,
your God.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ עָוֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט בַּמִּדָּה בַּמִּשְׁקָל וּבַמְּשׂוּרָה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ עָוֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט בַּמִּדָּה בַּמִּשְׁקָל וּבַמְּשׂוּרָה׃

english.text:
“You shall not do an injustice in judgment, in
measurement, in weight, and in quantity.

translation.text: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.

verses.english:
“You shall not do an injustice in judgment, in
measurement, in weight, and in quantity.

verses.hebrew: מֹאזְנֵי צֶדֶק אַבְנֵי צֶדֶק אֵיפַת צֶדֶק וְהִין צֶדֶק יִהְיֶה לָכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: מֹאזְנֵי צֶדֶק אַבְנֵי צֶדֶק אֵיפַת צֶדֶק וְהִין צֶדֶק יִהְיֶה לָכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
You shall have just scales, just weights, a just ephah,
and a just hin. I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out
from the land of Egypt.

translation.text: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
You shall have just scales, just weights, a just ephah,
and a just hin. I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out
from the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת כּל חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת כּל מִשְׁפָּטַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת כּל חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת כּל מִשְׁפָּטַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“And you shall observe all my laws and all my judgments
and do them. I am YHWH.”

translation.text: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
“And you shall observe all my laws and all my judgments
and do them. I am YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תֹּאמַר אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מִזַּרְעוֹ לַמֹּלֶךְ מוֹת יוּמָת עַם הָאָרֶץ יִרְגְּמֻהוּ בָאָבֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תֹּאמַר אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מִזַּרְעוֹ לַמֹּלֶךְ מוֹת יוּמָת עַם הָאָרֶץ יִרְגְּמֻהוּ בָאָבֶן׃

english.text:
“And to the children of Israel you shall say: Any man from
the children of Israel and from the alien who resides in
Israel who will give any of his seed to the Molech shall
be put to death. The people of the land shall batter him
with stone.

translation.text: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

verses.english:
“And to the children of Israel you shall say: Any man from
the children of Israel and from the alien who resides in
Israel who will give any of his seed to the Molech shall
be put to death. The people of the land shall batter him
with stone.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אֶתֵּן אֶת פָּנַי בָּאִישׁ הַהוּא וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתוֹ מִקֶּרֶב עַמּוֹ כִּי מִזַּרְעוֹ נָתַן לַמֹּלֶךְ לְמַעַן טַמֵּא אֶת מִקְדָּשִׁי וּלְחַלֵּל אֶת שֵׁם קדְשִׁי׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי אֶתֵּן אֶת פָּנַי בָּאִישׁ הַהוּא וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתוֹ מִקֶּרֶב עַמּוֹ כִּי מִזַּרְעוֹ נָתַן לַמֹּלֶךְ לְמַעַן טַמֵּא אֶת מִקְדָּשִׁי וּלְחַלֵּל אֶת שֵׁם קדְשִׁי׃

english.text:
And I shall set my face against that man, and I shall cut
him off from among his people because he gave any of his
seed for the Molech so as to make my holy place impure and
to desecrate my holy name.

translation.text: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

verses.english:
And I shall set my face against that man, and I shall cut
him off from among his people because he gave any of his
seed for the Molech so as to make my holy place impure and
to desecrate my holy name.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם הַעְלֵם יַעְלִימוּ עַם הָאָרֶץ אֶת עֵינֵיהֶם מִן הָאִישׁ הַהוּא בְּתִתּוֹ מִזַּרְעוֹ לַמֹּלֶךְ לְבִלְתִּי הָמִית אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם הַעְלֵם יַעְלִימוּ עַם הָאָרֶץ אֶת עֵינֵיהֶם מִן הָאִישׁ הַהוּא בְּתִתּוֹ מִזַּרְעוֹ לַמֹּלֶךְ לְבִלְתִּי הָמִית אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And if the people of the land will hide their eyes from
that man when he gives any of his seed for the Molech, not
to put him to death,

translation.text: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:

verses.english:
And if the people of the land will hide their eyes from
that man when he gives any of his seed for the Molech, not
to put him to death,

verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתִּי אֲנִי אֶת פָּנַי בָּאִישׁ הַהוּא וּבְמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתוֹ וְאֵת כּל הַזֹּנִים אַחֲרָיו לִזְנוֹת אַחֲרֵי הַמֹּלֶךְ מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתִּי אֲנִי אֶת פָּנַי בָּאִישׁ הַהוּא וּבְמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתוֹ וְאֵת כּל הַזֹּנִים אַחֲרָיו לִזְנוֹת אַחֲרֵי הַמֹּלֶךְ מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּם׃

english.text:
then I shall set my face at that man and at his family,
and I shall cut off him and all who whore after him, to
whore after the Molech, from among their people.

translation.text: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.

verses.english:
then I shall set my face at that man and at his family,
and I shall cut off him and all who whore after him, to
whore after the Molech, from among their people.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּפְנֶה אֶל הָאֹבֹת וְאֶל הַיִּדְּעֹנִים לִזְנֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת פָּנַי בַּנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתוֹ מִקֶּרֶב עַמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּפְנֶה אֶל הָאֹבֹת וְאֶל הַיִּדְּעֹנִים לִזְנֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת פָּנַי בַּנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתוֹ מִקֶּרֶב עַמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And the person who will turn to ghosts and to spirits of
acquaintances to whore after them: I shall set my face
against that person and cut him off from among his people.

translation.text: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.

verses.english:
And the person who will turn to ghosts and to spirits of
acquaintances to whore after them: I shall set my face
against that person and cut him off from among his people.

verses.hebrew: וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתֶּם וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתֶּם וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“And you shall make yourselves holy, and you shall be
holy, because I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“And you shall make yourselves holy, and you shall be
holy, because I am YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall observe my laws and do them. I am YHWH, who
makes you holy.

translation.text: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the LORD which sanctify you.

verses.english:
And you shall observe my laws and do them. I am YHWH, who
makes you holy.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִישׁ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יְקַלֵּל אֶת אָבִיו וְאֶת אִמּוֹ מוֹת יוּמָת אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ קִלֵּל דָּמָיו בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִישׁ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יְקַלֵּל אֶת אָבִיו וְאֶת אִמּוֹ מוֹת יוּמָת אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ קִלֵּל דָּמָיו בּוֹ׃

english.text:
“Because any man who will curse his father and his mother
shall be put to death. He has cursed his father and his
mother: his blood is on him!

translation.text: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.

verses.english:
“Because any man who will curse his father and his mother
shall be put to death. He has cursed his father and his
mother: his blood is on him!

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִנְאַף אֶת אֵשֶׁת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִנְאַף אֶת אֵשֶׁת רֵעֵהוּ מוֹת יוּמַת הַנֹּאֵף וְהַנֹּאָפֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִנְאַף אֶת אֵשֶׁת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִנְאַף אֶת אֵשֶׁת רֵעֵהוּ מוֹת יוּמַת הַנֹּאֵף וְהַנֹּאָפֶת׃

english.text:
“And a man who will commit adultery with a man’s wife—who
will commit adultery with his neighbor’s wife!—shall be
put to death: the adulterer and the adulteress.

translation.text: And the man that committeth adultery with another man’s wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

verses.english:
“And a man who will commit adultery with a man’s wife—who
will commit adultery with his neighbor’s wife!—shall be
put to death: the adulterer and the adulteress.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת אֵשֶׁת אָבִיו עֶרְוַת אָבִיו גִּלָּה מוֹת יוּמְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת אֵשֶׁת אָבִיו עֶרְוַת אָבִיו גִּלָּה מוֹת יוּמְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

english.text:
And a man who will lie with his father’s wife, he has
exposed his father’s nudity: the two of them shall be put
to death. Their blood is on them.

translation.text: And the man that lieth with his father’s wife hath uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

verses.english:
And a man who will lie with his father’s wife, he has
exposed his father’s nudity: the two of them shall be put
to death. Their blood is on them.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת כַּלָּתוֹ מוֹת יוּמְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם תֶּבֶל עָשׂוּ דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת כַּלָּתוֹ מוֹת יוּמְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם תֶּבֶל עָשׂוּ דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

english.text:
And a man who will lie with his daughter-in-law: the two
of them shall be put to death. They have done an
aberration. Their blood is on them.

translation.text: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.

verses.english:
And a man who will lie with his daughter-in-law: the two
of them shall be put to death. They have done an
aberration. Their blood is on them.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת זָכָר מִשְׁכְּבֵי אִשָּׁה תּוֹעֵבָה עָשׂוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מוֹת יוּמָתוּ דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת זָכָר מִשְׁכְּבֵי אִשָּׁה תּוֹעֵבָה עָשׂוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מוֹת יוּמָתוּ דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

english.text:
And a man who will lie with a male like lying with a
woman: the two of them have done an offensive thing. They
shall be put to death. Their blood is on them.

translation.text: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

verses.english:
And a man who will lie with a male like lying with a
woman: the two of them have done an offensive thing. They
shall be put to death. Their blood is on them.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקַּח אֶת אִשָּׁה וְאֶת אִמָּהּ זִמָּה הִוא בָּאֵשׁ יִשְׂרְפוּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶתְהֶן וְלֹא תִהְיֶה זִמָּה בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקַּח אֶת אִשָּׁה וְאֶת אִמָּהּ זִמָּה הִוא בָּאֵשׁ יִשְׂרְפוּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶתְהֶן וְלֹא תִהְיֶה זִמָּה בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

english.text:
And a man who will take a woman and her mother: it is a
perversion. You shall burn him and them in fire, so there
will not be perversion among you.

translation.text: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.

verses.english:
And a man who will take a woman and her mother: it is a
perversion. You shall burn him and them in fire, so there
will not be perversion among you.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן שְׁכבְתּוֹ בִּבְהֵמָה מוֹת יוּמָת וְאֶת הַבְּהֵמָה תַּהֲרֹגוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן שְׁכבְתּוֹ בִּבְהֵמָה מוֹת יוּמָת וְאֶת הַבְּהֵמָה תַּהֲרֹגוּ׃

english.text:
And a man who will have his intercourse with an animal
shall be put to death. And you shall kill the animal.

translation.text: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.

verses.english:
And a man who will have his intercourse with an animal
shall be put to death. And you shall kill the animal.

verses.hebrew: וְאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרַב אֶל כּל בְּהֵמָה לְרִבְעָה אֹתָהּ וְהָרַגְתָּ אֶת הָאִשָּׁה וְאֶת הַבְּהֵמָה מוֹת יוּמָתוּ דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרַב אֶל כּל בְּהֵמָה לְרִבְעָה אֹתָהּ וְהָרַגְתָּ אֶת הָאִשָּׁה וְאֶת הַבְּהֵמָה מוֹת יוּמָתוּ דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

english.text:
And a woman who will go up to any animal to mate with it:
you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall be put
to death. Their blood is on them.

translation.text: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

verses.english:
And a woman who will go up to any animal to mate with it:
you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall be put
to death. Their blood is on them.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקַּח אֶת אֲחֹתוֹ בַּת אָבִיו אוֹ בַת אִמּוֹ וְרָאָה אֶת עֶרְוָתָהּ וְהִיא תִרְאֶה אֶת עֶרְוָתוֹ חֶסֶד הוּא וְנִכְרְתוּ לְעֵינֵי בְּנֵי עַמָּם עֶרְוַת אֲחֹתוֹ גִּלָּה עֲוֺנוֹ יִשָּׂא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקַּח אֶת אֲחֹתוֹ בַּת אָבִיו אוֹ בַת אִמּוֹ וְרָאָה אֶת עֶרְוָתָהּ וְהִיא תִרְאֶה אֶת עֶרְוָתוֹ חֶסֶד הוּא וְנִכְרְתוּ לְעֵינֵי בְּנֵי עַמָּם עֶרְוַת אֲחֹתוֹ גִּלָּה עֲוֺנוֹ יִשָּׂא׃

english.text:
And a man who will take his sister, his father’s daughter
or his mother’s daughter, and see her nudity, and she will
see his nudity, it is shame; and they will be cut off in
the eyes of the children of their people. He has exposed
his sister’s nudity. He shall bear his crime.

translation.text: And if a man shall take his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

verses.english:
And a man who will take his sister, his father’s daughter
or his mother’s daughter, and see her nudity, and she will
see his nudity, it is shame; and they will be cut off in
the eyes of the children of their people. He has exposed
his sister’s nudity. He shall bear his crime.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת אִשָּׁה דָּוָה וְגִלָּה אֶת עֶרְוָתָהּ אֶת מְקֹרָהּ הֶעֱרָה וְהִוא גִּלְּתָה אֶת מְקוֹר דָּמֶיהָ וְנִכְרְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת אִשָּׁה דָּוָה וְגִלָּה אֶת עֶרְוָתָהּ אֶת מְקֹרָהּ הֶעֱרָה וְהִוא גִּלְּתָה אֶת מְקוֹר דָּמֶיהָ וְנִכְרְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּם׃

english.text:
And a man who will lie with a menstruating woman and will
expose her nudity: he has uncovered her source, and she
has exposed the source of her blood. And the two of them
will be cut off from among their people.

translation.text: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

verses.english:
And a man who will lie with a menstruating woman and will
expose her nudity: he has uncovered her source, and she
has exposed the source of her blood. And the two of them
will be cut off from among their people.

verses.hebrew: וְעֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת אִמְּךָ וַאֲחוֹת אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה כִּי אֶת שְׁאֵרוֹ הֶעֱרָה עֲוֺנָם יִשָּׂאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת אִמְּךָ וַאֲחוֹת אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה כִּי אֶת שְׁאֵרוֹ הֶעֱרָה עֲוֺנָם יִשָּׂאוּ׃

english.text:
And you shall not expose the nudity of your mother’s
sister or your father’s sister, because one has thus
uncovered his close relative. They shall bear their crime.

translation.text: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister, nor of thy father’s sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.

verses.english:
And you shall not expose the nudity of your mother’s
sister or your father’s sister, because one has thus
uncovered his close relative. They shall bear their crime.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת דֹּדָתוֹ עֶרְוַת דֹּדוֹ גִּלָּה חֶטְאָם יִשָּׂאוּ עֲרִירִים יָמֻתוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת דֹּדָתוֹ עֶרְוַת דֹּדוֹ גִּלָּה חֶטְאָם יִשָּׂאוּ עֲרִירִים יָמֻתוּ׃

english.text:
And a man who will lie with his aunt: he has exposed his
uncle’s nudity. They shall bear their sin. They shall die
childless.

translation.text: And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife, he hath uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

verses.english:
And a man who will lie with his aunt: he has exposed his
uncle’s nudity. They shall bear their sin. They shall die
childless.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקַּח אֶת אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו נִדָּה הִוא עֶרְוַת אָחִיו גִּלָּה עֲרִירִים יִהְיוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקַּח אֶת אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו נִדָּה הִוא עֶרְוַת אָחִיו גִּלָּה עֲרִירִים יִהְיוּ׃

english.text:
And a man who will take his brother’s wife: it is an
impurity. He has exposed his brother’s nudity. They will
be childless.

translation.text: And if a man shall take his brother’s wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.

verses.english:
And a man who will take his brother’s wife: it is an
impurity. He has exposed his brother’s nudity. They will
be childless.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת כּל חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת כּל מִשְׁפָּטַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וְלֹא תָקִיא אֶתְכֶם הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה לָשֶׁבֶת בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת כּל חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת כּל מִשְׁפָּטַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וְלֹא תָקִיא אֶתְכֶם הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה לָשֶׁבֶת בָּהּ׃

english.text:
“And you shall observe all my laws and all my judgments
and do them, and the land to which I am bringing you to
live in it will not vomit you out.

translation.text: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.

verses.english:
“And you shall observe all my laws and all my judgments
and do them, and the land to which I am bringing you to
live in it will not vomit you out.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תֵלְכוּ בְּחֻקֹּת הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מְשַׁלֵּחַ מִפְּנֵיכֶם כִּי אֶת כּל אֵלֶּה עָשׂוּ וָאָקֻץ בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תֵלְכוּ בְּחֻקֹּת הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מְשַׁלֵּחַ מִפְּנֵיכֶם כִּי אֶת כּל אֵלֶּה עָשׂוּ וָאָקֻץ בָּם׃

english.text:
And you shall not go by the laws of the nation that I am
ejecting from in front of you, because they have done all
of these, and I am disgusted with them.

translation.text: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

verses.english:
And you shall not go by the laws of the nation that I am
ejecting from in front of you, because they have done all
of these, and I am disgusted with them.

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר לָכֶם אַתֶּם תִּירְשׁוּ אֶת אַדְמָתָם וַאֲנִי אֶתְּנֶנָּה לָכֶם לָרֶשֶׁת אֹתָהּ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הִבְדַּלְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מִן הָעַמִּים׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר לָכֶם אַתֶּם תִּירְשׁוּ אֶת אַדְמָתָם וַאֲנִי אֶתְּנֶנָּה לָכֶם לָרֶשֶׁת אֹתָהּ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הִבְדַּלְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מִן הָעַמִּים׃

english.text:
And I have said to you: You shall possess their land, and
I shall give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with
milk and honey. I am YHWH, your God, who has distinguished
you from the peoples,

translation.text: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the LORD your God, which have separated you from other people.

verses.english:
And I have said to you: You shall possess their land, and
I shall give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with
milk and honey. I am YHWH, your God, who has distinguished
you from the peoples,

verses.hebrew: וְהִבְדַּלְתֶּם בֵּין הַבְּהֵמָה הַטְּהֹרָה לַטְּמֵאָה וּבֵין הָעוֹף הַטָּמֵא לַטָּהֹר וְלֹא תְשַׁקְּצוּ אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם בַּבְּהֵמָה וּבָעוֹף וּבְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תִּרְמֹשׂ הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר הִבְדַּלְתִּי לָכֶם לְטַמֵּא׃

hebrew.text: וְהִבְדַּלְתֶּם בֵּין הַבְּהֵמָה הַטְּהֹרָה לַטְּמֵאָה וּבֵין הָעוֹף הַטָּמֵא לַטָּהֹר וְלֹא תְשַׁקְּצוּ אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם בַּבְּהֵמָה וּבָעוֹף וּבְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תִּרְמֹשׂ הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר הִבְדַּלְתִּי לָכֶם לְטַמֵּא׃

english.text:
and you shall distinguish between the pure animal and the
impure, and between the impure bird and the pure, and you
shall not make yourselves detestable by an animal or by a
bird or by anything that creeps on the ground that I have
distinguished as impure for you.

translation.text: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.

verses.english:
and you shall distinguish between the pure animal and the
impure, and between the impure bird and the pure, and you
shall not make yourselves detestable by an animal or by a
bird or by anything that creeps on the ground that I have
distinguished as impure for you.

verses.hebrew: וִהְיִיתֶם לִי קְדֹשִׁים כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה וָאַבְדִּל אֶתְכֶם מִן הָעַמִּים לִהְיוֹת לִי׃

hebrew.text: וִהְיִיתֶם לִי קְדֹשִׁים כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה וָאַבְדִּל אֶתְכֶם מִן הָעַמִּים לִהְיוֹת לִי׃

english.text:
And you shall be holy to me because I, YHWH, am holy, and
I have distinguished you from the peoples to be mine.

translation.text: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.

verses.english:
And you shall be holy to me because I, YHWH, am holy, and
I have distinguished you from the peoples to be mine.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּי יִהְיֶה בָהֶם אוֹב אוֹ יִדְּעֹנִי מוֹת יוּמָתוּ בָּאֶבֶן יִרְגְּמוּ אֹתָם דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּי יִהְיֶה בָהֶם אוֹב אוֹ יִדְּעֹנִי מוֹת יוּמָתוּ בָּאֶבֶן יִרְגְּמוּ אֹתָם דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

english.text:
“And a man or woman: if there will be among them a ghost
or a spirit of an acquaintance, they shall be put to
death. They shall batter them with stone. Their blood is
on them.”

translation.text: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.

verses.english:
“And a man or woman: if there will be among them a ghost
or a spirit of an acquaintance, they shall be put to
death. They shall batter them with stone. Their blood is
on them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֱמֹר אֶל הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם לְנֶפֶשׁ לֹא יִטַּמָּא בְּעַמָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֱמֹר אֶל הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם לְנֶפֶשׁ לֹא יִטַּמָּא בְּעַמָּיו׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Say to the priests, the sons of
Aaron, and say to them: One shall not become impure for a
person among his people

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Say to the priests, the sons of
Aaron, and say to them: One shall not become impure for a
person among his people

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם לִשְׁאֵרוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֵלָיו לְאִמּוֹ וּלְאָבִיו וְלִבְנוֹ וּלְבִתּוֹ וּלְאָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם לִשְׁאֵרוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֵלָיו לְאִמּוֹ וּלְאָבִיו וְלִבְנוֹ וּלְבִתּוֹ וּלְאָחִיו׃

english.text:
except for his relative who is close to him: for his
mother and for his father and for his son and for his
daughter and for his brother

translation.text: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother.

verses.english:
except for his relative who is close to him: for his
mother and for his father and for his son and for his
daughter and for his brother

verses.hebrew: וְלַאֲחֹתוֹ הַבְּתוּלָה הַקְּרוֹבָה אֵלָיו אֲשֶׁר לֹא הָיְתָה לְאִישׁ לָהּ יִטַּמָּא׃

hebrew.text: וְלַאֲחֹתוֹ הַבְּתוּלָה הַקְּרוֹבָה אֵלָיו אֲשֶׁר לֹא הָיְתָה לְאִישׁ לָהּ יִטַּמָּא׃

english.text:
and for his virgin sister who is close to him, who has not
been a husband’s; he may become impure for her.

translation.text: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.

verses.english:
and for his virgin sister who is close to him, who has not
been a husband’s; he may become impure for her.

verses.hebrew: לֹא יִטַּמָּא בַּעַל בְּעַמָּיו לְהֵחַלּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יִטַּמָּא בַּעַל בְּעַמָּיו לְהֵחַלּוֹ׃

english.text:
He shall not become impure as a husband among his people,
for him to be desecrated.

translation.text: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

verses.english:
He shall not become impure as a husband among his people,
for him to be desecrated.

verses.hebrew: לֹא [יִקְרְחוּ] (יקרחה) קרְחָה בְּרֹאשָׁם וּפְאַת זְקָנָם לֹא יְגַלֵּחוּ וּבִבְשָׂרָם לֹא יִשְׂרְטוּ שָׂרָטֶת׃

hebrew.text: לֹא [יִקְרְחוּ] (יקרחה) קרְחָה בְּרֹאשָׁם וּפְאַת זְקָנָם לֹא יְגַלֵּחוּ וּבִבְשָׂרָם לֹא יִשְׂרְטוּ שָׂרָטֶת׃

english.text:
They shall not make a bald place on their head and shall
not shave the corner of their beard and not make a cut in
their flesh.

translation.text: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

verses.english:
They shall not make a bald place on their head and shall
not shave the corner of their beard and not make a cut in
their flesh.

verses.hebrew: קְדֹשִׁים יִהְיוּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ שֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כִּי אֶת אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה לֶחֶם אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הֵם מַקְרִיבִם וְהָיוּ קֹדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: קְדֹשִׁים יִהְיוּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ שֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כִּי אֶת אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה לֶחֶם אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הֵם מַקְרִיבִם וְהָיוּ קֹדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
They shall be holy to their God and shall not desecrate
their God’s name, because they are bringing forward YHWH’s
offerings by fire, their God’s bread, so they shall be a
holy thing.

translation.text: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.

verses.english:
They shall be holy to their God and shall not desecrate
their God’s name, because they are bringing forward YHWH’s
offerings by fire, their God’s bread, so they shall be a
holy thing.

verses.hebrew: אִשָּׁה זֹנָה וַחֲלָלָה לֹא יִקָּחוּ וְאִשָּׁה גְּרוּשָׁה מֵאִישָׁהּ לֹא יִקָּחוּ כִּי קָדֹשׁ הוּא לֵאלֹהָיו׃

hebrew.text: אִשָּׁה זֹנָה וַחֲלָלָה לֹא יִקָּחוּ וְאִשָּׁה גְּרוּשָׁה מֵאִישָׁהּ לֹא יִקָּחוּ כִּי קָדֹשׁ הוּא לֵאלֹהָיו׃

english.text:
They shall not take a woman who is a prostitute and
desecrated, and they shall not take a woman who is
divorced from her husband, because he is holy to his God.

translation.text: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.

verses.english:
They shall not take a woman who is a prostitute and
desecrated, and they shall not take a woman who is
divorced from her husband, because he is holy to his God.

verses.hebrew: וְקִדַּשְׁתּוֹ כִּי אֶת לֶחֶם אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא מַקְרִיב קָדֹשׁ יִהְיֶה לָּךְ כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְקִדַּשְׁתּוֹ כִּי אֶת לֶחֶם אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא מַקְרִיב קָדֹשׁ יִהְיֶה לָּךְ כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall regard him as holy because he is bringing
forward your God’s bread. He shall be holy to you because
I, YHWH, who makes you holy, am holy.

translation.text: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the LORD, which sanctify you, am holy.

verses.english:
And you shall regard him as holy because he is bringing
forward your God’s bread. He shall be holy to you because
I, YHWH, who makes you holy, am holy.

verses.hebrew: וּבַת אִישׁ כֹּהֵן כִּי תֵחֵל לִזְנוֹת אֶת אָבִיהָ הִיא מְחַלֶּלֶת בָּאֵשׁ תִּשָּׂרֵף׃

hebrew.text: וּבַת אִישׁ כֹּהֵן כִּי תֵחֵל לִזְנוֹת אֶת אָבִיהָ הִיא מְחַלֶּלֶת בָּאֵשׁ תִּשָּׂרֵף׃

english.text:
And the daughter of a man who is a priest who will become
desecrated, to whore: she is desecrating her father. She
shall be burned in fire.

translation.text: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.

verses.english:
And the daughter of a man who is a priest who will become
desecrated, to whore: she is desecrating her father. She
shall be burned in fire.

verses.hebrew: וְהַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל מֵאֶחָיו אֲשֶׁר יוּצַק עַל רֹאשׁוֹ שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וּמִלֵּא אֶת יָדוֹ לִלְבֹּשׁ אֶת הַבְּגָדִים אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ לֹא יִפְרָע וּבְגָדָיו לֹא יִפְרֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל מֵאֶחָיו אֲשֶׁר יוּצַק עַל רֹאשׁוֹ שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וּמִלֵּא אֶת יָדוֹ לִלְבֹּשׁ אֶת הַבְּגָדִים אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ לֹא יִפְרָע וּבְגָדָיו לֹא יִפְרֹם׃

english.text:
“And the priest who is the most senior of his brothers, on
whose head the anointing oil will be poured and who has
filled his hand to wear the clothes, he shall not let
loose the hair of his head and not tear his clothes

translation.text: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;

verses.english:
“And the priest who is the most senior of his brothers, on
whose head the anointing oil will be poured and who has
filled his hand to wear the clothes, he shall not let
loose the hair of his head and not tear his clothes

verses.hebrew: וְעַל כּל נַפְשֹׁת מֵת לֹא יָבֹא לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ לֹא יִטַּמָּא׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל כּל נַפְשֹׁת מֵת לֹא יָבֹא לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ לֹא יִטַּמָּא׃

english.text:
and he shall not come to any dead persons; he shall not
become impure for his father and for his mother.

translation.text: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

verses.english:
and he shall not come to any dead persons; he shall not
become impure for his father and for his mother.

verses.hebrew: וּמִן הַמִּקְדָּשׁ לֹא יֵצֵא וְלֹא יְחַלֵּל אֵת מִקְדַּשׁ אֱלֹהָיו כִּי נֵזֶר שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת אֱלֹהָיו עָלָיו אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּמִן הַמִּקְדָּשׁ לֹא יֵצֵא וְלֹא יְחַלֵּל אֵת מִקְדַּשׁ אֱלֹהָיו כִּי נֵזֶר שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת אֱלֹהָיו עָלָיו אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he shall not go out from the holy place, so he will
not desecrate his God’s holy place, because the crown with
his God’s anointing oil is on him. I am YHWH.

translation.text: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
And he shall not go out from the holy place, so he will
not desecrate his God’s holy place, because the crown with
his God’s anointing oil is on him. I am YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא אִשָּׁה בִבְתוּלֶיהָ יִקָּח׃

hebrew.text: וְהוּא אִשָּׁה בִבְתוּלֶיהָ יִקָּח׃

english.text: “And he shall take a woman in her virginity.

translation.text: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

verses.english: “And he shall take a woman in her virginity.

verses.hebrew: אַלְמָנָה וּגְרוּשָׁה וַחֲלָלָה זֹנָה אֶת אֵלֶּה לֹא יִקָּח כִּי אִם בְּתוּלָה מֵעַמָּיו יִקַּח אִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: אַלְמָנָה וּגְרוּשָׁה וַחֲלָלָה זֹנָה אֶת אֵלֶּה לֹא יִקָּח כִּי אִם בְּתוּלָה מֵעַמָּיו יִקַּח אִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
A widow and a divorcée and a desecrated woman, a
prostitute: he shall not take these; he shall take none
except a virgin from his people.

translation.text: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.

verses.english:
A widow and a divorcée and a desecrated woman, a
prostitute: he shall not take these; he shall take none
except a virgin from his people.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יְחַלֵּל זַרְעוֹ בְּעַמָּיו כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדְּשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יְחַלֵּל זַרְעוֹ בְּעַמָּיו כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדְּשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
And he shall not desecrate his seed among his people,
because I, YHWH, make him holy.”

translation.text: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD do sanctify him.

verses.english:
And he shall not desecrate his seed among his people,
because I, YHWH, make him holy.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר אִישׁ מִזַּרְעֲךָ לְדֹרֹתָם אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בוֹ מוּם לֹא יִקְרַב לְהַקְרִיב לֶחֶם אֱלֹהָיו׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר אִישׁ מִזַּרְעֲךָ לְדֹרֹתָם אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בוֹ מוּם לֹא יִקְרַב לְהַקְרִיב לֶחֶם אֱלֹהָיו׃

english.text:
“Speak to Aaron, saying: A man from your seed, through
their generations, in whom will be an injury shall not
come forward to bring forward his God’s bread.

translation.text: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.

verses.english:
“Speak to Aaron, saying: A man from your seed, through
their generations, in whom will be an injury shall not
come forward to bring forward his God’s bread.

verses.hebrew: כִּי כל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם לֹא יִקְרָב אִישׁ עִוֵּר אוֹ פִסֵּחַ אוֹ חָרֻם אוֹ שָׂרוּעַ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי כל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם לֹא יִקְרָב אִישׁ עִוֵּר אוֹ פִסֵּחַ אוֹ חָרֻם אוֹ שָׂרוּעַ׃

english.text:
Because any man in whom is an injury shall not come
forward: a blind man or a cripple or mutilated or who has
an elongated limb

translation.text: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,

verses.english:
Because any man in whom is an injury shall not come
forward: a blind man or a cripple or mutilated or who has
an elongated limb

verses.hebrew: אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בוֹ שֶׁבֶר רָגֶל אוֹ שֶׁבֶר יָד׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בוֹ שֶׁבֶר רָגֶל אוֹ שֶׁבֶר יָד׃

english.text:
or a man who has a break of the leg or a break of the arm
in him

translation.text: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,

verses.english:
or a man who has a break of the leg or a break of the arm
in him

verses.hebrew: אוֹ גִבֵּן אוֹ דַק אוֹ תְּבַלֻּל בְּעֵינוֹ אוֹ גָרָב אוֹ יַלֶּפֶת אוֹ מְרוֹחַ אָשֶׁךְ׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ גִבֵּן אוֹ דַק אוֹ תְּבַלֻּל בְּעֵינוֹ אוֹ גָרָב אוֹ יַלֶּפֶת אוֹ מְרוֹחַ אָשֶׁךְ׃

english.text:
or a hunchback or a dwarf or who has a spotting in his eye
or is scabbed or scurvied or has crushed testicles.

translation.text: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;

verses.english:
or a hunchback or a dwarf or who has a spotting in his eye
or is scabbed or scurvied or has crushed testicles.

verses.hebrew: כּל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם מִזֶּרַע אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן לֹא יִגַּשׁ לְהַקְרִיב אֶת אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה מוּם בּוֹ אֵת לֶחֶם אֱלֹהָיו לֹא יִגַּשׁ לְהַקְרִיב׃

hebrew.text: כּל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם מִזֶּרַע אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן לֹא יִגַּשׁ לְהַקְרִיב אֶת אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה מוּם בּוֹ אֵת לֶחֶם אֱלֹהָיו לֹא יִגַּשׁ לְהַקְרִיב׃

english.text:
Any man from the seed of Aaron the priest in whom is an
injury shall not come near to bring forward YHWH’s
offerings by fire. He has an injury in him. He shall not
come near to bring forward his God’s bread.

translation.text: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.

verses.english:
Any man from the seed of Aaron the priest in whom is an
injury shall not come near to bring forward YHWH’s
offerings by fire. He has an injury in him. He shall not
come near to bring forward his God’s bread.

verses.hebrew: לֶחֶם אֱלֹהָיו מִקּדְשֵׁי הַקֳּדָשִׁים וּמִן הַקֳּדָשִׁים יֹאכֵל׃

hebrew.text: לֶחֶם אֱלֹהָיו מִקּדְשֵׁי הַקֳּדָשִׁים וּמִן הַקֳּדָשִׁים יֹאכֵל׃

english.text:
He shall eat his God’s bread, from the holies of holies
and from the holies.

translation.text: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

verses.english:
He shall eat his God’s bread, from the holies of holies
and from the holies.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ אֶל הַפָּרֹכֶת לֹא יָבֹא וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יִגַּשׁ כִּי מוּם בּוֹ וְלֹא יְחַלֵּל אֶת מִקְדָּשַׁי כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדְּשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ אֶל הַפָּרֹכֶת לֹא יָבֹא וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יִגַּשׁ כִּי מוּם בּוֹ וְלֹא יְחַלֵּל אֶת מִקְדָּשַׁי כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדְּשָׁם׃

english.text:
Just: he shall not come to the pavilion, and he shall not
come near to the altar, because he has an injury in him.
And he shall not desecrate my holy places, because I,
YHWH, make them holy.”

translation.text: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the LORD do sanctify them.

verses.english:
Just: he shall not come to the pavilion, and he shall not
come near to the altar, because he has an injury in him.
And he shall not desecrate my holy places, because I,
YHWH, make them holy.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו וְאֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו וְאֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
So Moses spoke to Aaron and to his sons and to all the
children of Israel.

translation.text: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.

verses.english:
So Moses spoke to Aaron and to his sons and to all the
children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו וְיִנָּזְרוּ מִקּדְשֵׁי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ אֶת שֵׁם קדְשִׁי אֲשֶׁר הֵם מַקְדִּשִׁים לִי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו וְיִנָּזְרוּ מִקּדְשֵׁי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ אֶת שֵׁם קדְשִׁי אֲשֶׁר הֵם מַקְדִּשִׁים לִי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons that they be alerted
regarding the holy things of the children of Israel that
they consecrate to me, so they will not desecrate my holy
name. I am YHWH.

translation.text: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons that they be alerted
regarding the holy things of the children of Israel that
they consecrate to me, so they will not desecrate my holy
name. I am YHWH.

verses.hebrew: אֱמֹר אֲלֵהֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם כּל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקְרַב מִכּל זַרְעֲכֶם אֶל הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יַקְדִּישׁוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַיהֹוָה וְטֻמְאָתוֹ עָלָיו וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִלְּפָנַי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אֱמֹר אֲלֵהֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם כּל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקְרַב מִכּל זַרְעֲכֶם אֶל הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יַקְדִּישׁוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַיהֹוָה וְטֻמְאָתוֹ עָלָיו וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִלְּפָנַי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Say to them: Through your generations, any man who will
come close, from all of your seed, to the holy things that
the children of Israel will consecrate to YHWH, while his
impurity is on him: that person will be cut off from in
front of me. I am YHWH.

translation.text: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
Say to them: Through your generations, any man who will
come close, from all of your seed, to the holy things that
the children of Israel will consecrate to YHWH, while his
impurity is on him: that person will be cut off from in
front of me. I am YHWH.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ אִישׁ מִזֶּרַע אַהֲרֹן וְהוּא צָרוּעַ אוֹ זָב בַּקֳּדָשִׁים לֹא יֹאכַל עַד אֲשֶׁר יִטְהָר וְהַנֹּגֵעַ בְּכל טְמֵא נֶפֶשׁ אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר תֵּצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ שִׁכְבַת זָרַע׃

hebrew.text: אִישׁ אִישׁ מִזֶּרַע אַהֲרֹן וְהוּא צָרוּעַ אוֹ זָב בַּקֳּדָשִׁים לֹא יֹאכַל עַד אֲשֶׁר יִטְהָר וְהַנֹּגֵעַ בְּכל טְמֵא נֶפֶשׁ אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר תֵּצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ שִׁכְבַת זָרַע׃

english.text:
“Any man from Aaron’s seed and who is a leper or has an
emission shall not eat any of the holy things until he
becomes pure. And one who touches anything that is impure
by a person, or a man from whom intercourse seed will come
out,

translation.text: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;

verses.english:
“Any man from Aaron’s seed and who is a leper or has an
emission shall not eat any of the holy things until he
becomes pure. And one who touches anything that is impure
