by a person, or a man from whom intercourse seed will come
out,

verses.hebrew: אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בְּכל שֶׁרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא לוֹ אוֹ בְאָדָם אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא לוֹ לְכֹל טֻמְאָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בְּכל שֶׁרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא לוֹ אוֹ בְאָדָם אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא לוֹ לְכֹל טֻמְאָתוֹ׃

english.text:
or a man who will touch any swarming creature by which he
will become impure or a human by whom he will become
impure, whatever his impurity:

translation.text: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;

verses.english:
or a man who will touch any swarming creature by which he
will become impure or a human by whom he will become
impure, whatever his impurity:

verses.hebrew: נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּגַּע בּוֹ וְטָמְאָה עַד הָעָרֶב וְלֹא יֹאכַל מִן הַקֳּדָשִׁים כִּי אִם רָחַץ בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּגַּע בּוֹ וְטָמְאָה עַד הָעָרֶב וְלֹא יֹאכַל מִן הַקֳּדָשִׁים כִּי אִם רָחַץ בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם׃

translation.text: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.

verses.hebrew: וּבָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְטָהֵר וְאַחַר יֹאכַל מִן הַקֳּדָשִׁים כִּי לַחְמוֹ הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וּבָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְטָהֵר וְאַחַר יֹאכַל מִן הַקֳּדָשִׁים כִּי לַחְמוֹ הוּא׃

english.text:
And when the sun has set, he shall be pure, and after that
he shall eat from the holy things, because it is his food.

translation.text: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.

verses.english:
And when the sun has set, he shall be pure, and after that
he shall eat from the holy things, because it is his food.

verses.hebrew: נְבֵלָה וּטְרֵפָה לֹא יֹאכַל לְטמְאָה בָהּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: נְבֵלָה וּטְרֵפָה לֹא יֹאכַל לְטמְאָה בָהּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
He shall not eat a carcass or a torn animal, to become
impure by it. I am YHWH.

translation.text: That which dieth of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith; I am the LORD.

verses.english:
He shall not eat a carcass or a torn animal, to become
impure by it. I am YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתִּי וְלֹא יִשְׂאוּ עָלָיו חֵטְא וּמֵתוּ בוֹ כִּי יְחַלְּלֻהוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדְּשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתִּי וְלֹא יִשְׂאוּ עָלָיו חֵטְא וּמֵתוּ בוֹ כִּי יְחַלְּלֻהוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדְּשָׁם׃

english.text:
“And they shall keep my charge so they will not bear sin
over it and die through it when they desecrate it. I,
YHWH, make them holy.

translation.text: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the LORD do sanctify them.

verses.english:
“And they shall keep my charge so they will not bear sin
over it and die through it when they desecrate it. I,
YHWH, make them holy.

verses.hebrew: וְכל זָר לֹא יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ תּוֹשַׁב כֹּהֵן וְשָׂכִיר לֹא יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל זָר לֹא יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ תּוֹשַׁב כֹּהֵן וְשָׂכִיר לֹא יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
“And any outsider shall not eat what is holy: a priest’s
visitor and an employee shall not eat what is holy.

translation.text: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

verses.english:
“And any outsider shall not eat what is holy: a priest’s
visitor and an employee shall not eat what is holy.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹהֵן כִּי יִקְנֶה נֶפֶשׁ קִנְיַן כַּסְפּוֹ הוּא יֹאכַל בּוֹ וִילִיד בֵּיתוֹ הֵם יֹאכְלוּ בְלַחְמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹהֵן כִּי יִקְנֶה נֶפֶשׁ קִנְיַן כַּסְפּוֹ הוּא יֹאכַל בּוֹ וִילִיד בֵּיתוֹ הֵם יֹאכְלוּ בְלַחְמוֹ׃

english.text:
But when a priest buys a person as a possession by his
money, he may eat it; and one who is born in his
household: they may eat his bread.

translation.text: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.

verses.english:
But when a priest buys a person as a possession by his
money, he may eat it; and one who is born in his
household: they may eat his bread.

verses.hebrew: וּבַת כֹּהֵן כִּי תִהְיֶה לְאִישׁ זָר הִוא בִּתְרוּמַת הַקֳּדָשִׁים לֹא תֹאכֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּבַת כֹּהֵן כִּי תִהְיֶה לְאִישׁ זָר הִוא בִּתְרוּמַת הַקֳּדָשִׁים לֹא תֹאכֵל׃

english.text:
And a priest’s daughter who will become an outsider’s: she
shall not eat the donated holy things;

translation.text: If the priest’s daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.

verses.english:
And a priest’s daughter who will become an outsider’s: she
shall not eat the donated holy things;

verses.hebrew: וּבַת כֹּהֵן כִּי תִהְיֶה אַלְמָנָה וּגְרוּשָׁה וְזֶרַע אֵין לָהּ וְשָׁבָה אֶל בֵּית אָבִיהָ כִּנְעוּרֶיהָ מִלֶּחֶם אָבִיהָ תֹּאכֵל וְכל זָר לֹא יֹאכַל בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּבַת כֹּהֵן כִּי תִהְיֶה אַלְמָנָה וּגְרוּשָׁה וְזֶרַע אֵין לָהּ וְשָׁבָה אֶל בֵּית אָבִיהָ כִּנְעוּרֶיהָ מִלֶּחֶם אָבִיהָ תֹּאכֵל וְכל זָר לֹא יֹאכַל בּוֹ׃

english.text:
but a priest’s daughter who will be a widow or a divorcée
and has no seed and returns to her father’s house as in
her youth, she may eat from her father’s bread. But any
outsider shall not eat it.

translation.text: But if the priest’s daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father’s house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father’s meat: but there shall be no stranger eat thereof.

verses.english:
but a priest’s daughter who will be a widow or a divorcée
and has no seed and returns to her father’s house as in
her youth, she may eat from her father’s bread. But any
outsider shall not eat it.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה וְיָסַף חֲמִשִׁיתוֹ עָלָיו וְנָתַן לַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה וְיָסַף חֲמִשִׁיתוֹ עָלָיו וְנָתַן לַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And a man who eats what is holy by mistake shall add to it
a fifth of it and shall give the holy thing to the priest.

translation.text: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.

verses.english:
And a man who eats what is holy by mistake shall add to it
a fifth of it and shall give the holy thing to the priest.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ אֶת קדְשֵׁי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת אֲשֶׁר יָרִימוּ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ אֶת קדְשֵׁי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת אֲשֶׁר יָרִימוּ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And they shall not desecrate the holy things of the
children of Israel that they will donate to YHWH

translation.text: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the LORD;

verses.english:
And they shall not desecrate the holy things of the
children of Israel that they will donate to YHWH

verses.hebrew: וְהִשִּׂיאוּ אוֹתָם עֲוֺן אַשְׁמָה בְּאכְלָם אֶת קדְשֵׁיהֶם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדְּשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִשִּׂיאוּ אוֹתָם עֲוֺן אַשְׁמָה בְּאכְלָם אֶת קדְשֵׁיהֶם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדְּשָׁם׃

english.text:
so that they would make them bear a crime requiring a
guilt offering by their eating their holy things, because
I, YHWH, make them holy.”

translation.text: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the LORD do sanctify them.

verses.english:
so that they would make them bear a crime requiring a
guilt offering by their eating their holy things, because
I, YHWH, make them holy.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו וְאֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב קרְבָּנוֹ לְכל נִדְרֵיהֶם וּלְכל נִדְבוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה לְעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו וְאֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַגֵּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב קרְבָּנוֹ לְכל נִדְרֵיהֶם וּלְכל נִדְבוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה לְעֹלָה׃

english.text:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of
Israel, and you shall say to them: Any man from the house
of Israel or from the aliens in Israel who will make his
offering—for all their vows and all their contributions
that they bring forward to YHWH as a burnt offering—

translation.text: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the LORD for a burnt offering;

verses.english:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of
Israel, and you shall say to them: Any man from the house
of Israel or from the aliens in Israel who will make his
offering—for all their vows and all their contributions
that they bring forward to YHWH as a burnt offering—

verses.hebrew: לִרְצֹנְכֶם תָּמִים זָכָר בַּבָּקָר בַּכְּשָׂבִים וּבָעִזִּים׃

hebrew.text: לִרְצֹנְכֶם תָּמִים זָכָר בַּבָּקָר בַּכְּשָׂבִים וּבָעִזִּים׃

english.text:
for acceptance for you it is to be unblemished, male of
the cattle, of the sheep, or of the goats.

translation.text: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.

verses.english:
for acceptance for you it is to be unblemished, male of
the cattle, of the sheep, or of the goats.

verses.hebrew: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ כִּי לֹא לְרָצוֹן יִהְיֶה לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ כִּי לֹא לְרָצוֹן יִהְיֶה לָכֶם׃

english.text:
You shall not bring forward any that has an injury in it,
because it will not be acceptable for you.

translation.text: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.

verses.english:
You shall not bring forward any that has an injury in it,
because it will not be acceptable for you.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי יַקְרִיב זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה לְפַלֵּא נֶדֶר אוֹ לִנְדָבָה בַּבָּקָר אוֹ בַצֹּאן תָּמִים יִהְיֶה לְרָצוֹן כּל מוּם לֹא יִהְיֶה בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יַקְרִיב זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה לְפַלֵּא נֶדֶר אוֹ לִנְדָבָה בַּבָּקָר אוֹ בַצֹּאן תָּמִים יִהְיֶה לְרָצוֹן כּל מוּם לֹא יִהְיֶה בּוֹ׃

english.text:
And a man who will bring forward a peace-offering
sacrifice to YHWH to express a vow or as a contribution of
the cattle or of the flock: it shall be unblemished for
acceptance; there shall not be any injury in it.

translation.text: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.

verses.english:
And a man who will bring forward a peace-offering
sacrifice to YHWH to express a vow or as a contribution of
the cattle or of the flock: it shall be unblemished for
acceptance; there shall not be any injury in it.

verses.hebrew: עַוֶּרֶת אוֹ שָׁבוּר אוֹ חָרוּץ אוֹ יַבֶּלֶת אוֹ גָרָב אוֹ יַלֶּפֶת לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ אֵלֶּה לַיהֹוָה וְאִשֶּׁה לֹא תִתְּנוּ מֵהֶם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: עַוֶּרֶת אוֹ שָׁבוּר אוֹ חָרוּץ אוֹ יַבֶּלֶת אוֹ גָרָב אוֹ יַלֶּפֶת לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ אֵלֶּה לַיהֹוָה וְאִשֶּׁה לֹא תִתְּנוּ מֵהֶם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Blind or broken or slashed or sore or scabbed or scurvied:
you shall not bring these forward to YHWH, and you shall
not give an offering by fire of them on the altar to YHWH.

translation.text: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD.

verses.english:
Blind or broken or slashed or sore or scabbed or scurvied:
you shall not bring these forward to YHWH, and you shall
not give an offering by fire of them on the altar to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְשׁוֹר וָשֶׂה שָׂרוּעַ וְקָלוּט נְדָבָה תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתוֹ וּלְנֵדֶר לֹא יֵרָצֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְשׁוֹר וָשֶׂה שָׂרוּעַ וְקָלוּט נְדָבָה תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתוֹ וּלְנֵדֶר לֹא יֵרָצֶה׃

english.text:
An ox or a sheep that has an elongated limb or a short
limb: you may make it a contribution, but it shall not be
accepted for a vow.

translation.text: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

verses.english:
An ox or a sheep that has an elongated limb or a short
limb: you may make it a contribution, but it shall not be
accepted for a vow.

verses.hebrew: וּמָעוּךְ וְכָתוּת וְנָתוּק וְכָרוּת לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה וּבְאַרְצְכֶם לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּמָעוּךְ וְכָתוּת וְנָתוּק וְכָרוּת לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה וּבְאַרְצְכֶם לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
And you shall not bring forward to YHWH one that is
bruised, crushed, torn, or cut. And you shall not do it in
your land,

translation.text: Ye shall not offer unto the LORD that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land.

verses.english:
And you shall not bring forward to YHWH one that is
bruised, crushed, torn, or cut. And you shall not do it in
your land,

verses.hebrew: וּמִיַּד בֶּן נֵכָר לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ אֶת לֶחֶם אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מִכּל אֵלֶּה כִּי משְׁחָתָם בָּהֶם מוּם בָּם לֹא יֵרָצוּ לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּמִיַּד בֶּן נֵכָר לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ אֶת לֶחֶם אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מִכּל אֵלֶּה כִּי משְׁחָתָם בָּהֶם מוּם בָּם לֹא יֵרָצוּ לָכֶם׃

english.text:
and you shall not bring forward your God’s bread from any
of these from a foreigner’s hand, because their flaw is in
them, an injury is in them; they shall not be accepted for
you.”

translation.text: Neither from a stranger’s hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.

verses.english:
and you shall not bring forward your God’s bread from any
of these from a foreigner’s hand, because their flaw is in
them, an injury is in them; they shall not be accepted for
you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: שׁוֹר אוֹ כֶשֶׂב אוֹ עֵז כִּי יִוָּלֵד וְהָיָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תַּחַת אִמּוֹ וּמִיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי וָהָלְאָה יֵרָצֶה לְקרְבַּן אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: שׁוֹר אוֹ כֶשֶׂב אוֹ עֵז כִּי יִוָּלֵד וְהָיָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תַּחַת אִמּוֹ וּמִיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי וָהָלְאָה יֵרָצֶה לְקרְבַּן אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“When an ox or a sheep or a goat will be born, it will be
under its mother seven days, and from the eighth day on it
will be accepted as an offering, an offering by fire to
YHWH.

translation.text: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.english:
“When an ox or a sheep or a goat will be born, it will be
under its mother seven days, and from the eighth day on it
will be accepted as an offering, an offering by fire to
YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְשׁוֹר אוֹ שֶׂה אֹתוֹ וְאֶת בְּנוֹ לֹא תִשְׁחֲטוּ בְּיוֹם אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וְשׁוֹר אוֹ שֶׂה אֹתוֹ וְאֶת בְּנוֹ לֹא תִשְׁחֲטוּ בְּיוֹם אֶחָד׃

english.text:
And an ox or a sheep: you shall not slaughter it and its
child on one day.

translation.text: And whether it be cow, or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.

verses.english:
And an ox or a sheep: you shall not slaughter it and its
child on one day.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי תִזְבְּחוּ זֶבַח תּוֹדָה לַיהֹוָה לִרְצֹנְכֶם תִּזְבָּחוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תִזְבְּחוּ זֶבַח תּוֹדָה לַיהֹוָה לִרְצֹנְכֶם תִּזְבָּחוּ׃

english.text:
And if you will make a sacrifice of thanks to YHWH, you
shall sacrifice it so it will be acceptable for you.

translation.text: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the LORD, offer it at your own will.

verses.english:
And if you will make a sacrifice of thanks to YHWH, you
shall sacrifice it so it will be acceptable for you.

verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יֵאָכֵל לֹא תוֹתִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יֵאָכֵל לֹא תוֹתִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
It shall be eaten on that day. Do not leave any of it
until morning. I am YHWH.

translation.text: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
It shall be eaten on that day. Do not leave any of it
until morning. I am YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם מִצְוֺתַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם מִצְוֺתַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“And you shall observe my commandments and do them. I am
YHWH.

translation.text: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
“And you shall observe my commandments and do them. I am
YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תְחַלְּלוּ אֶת שֵׁם קדְשִׁי וְנִקְדַּשְׁתִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תְחַלְּלוּ אֶת שֵׁם קדְשִׁי וְנִקְדַּשְׁתִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנִי יְהֹוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
“And you shall not desecrate my holy name, so I shall be
sanctified among the children of Israel. I am YHWH, who
makes you holy,

translation.text: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the LORD which hallow you,

verses.english:
“And you shall not desecrate my holy name, so I shall be
sanctified among the children of Israel. I am YHWH, who
makes you holy,

verses.hebrew: הַמּוֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: הַמּוֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
who brought brought you out from the land of Egypt to be
God to you. I am YHWH.”

translation.text: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
who brought brought you out from the land of Egypt to be
God to you. I am YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם מוֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְאוּ אֹתָם מִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ אֵלֶּה הֵם מוֹעֲדָי׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם מוֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְאוּ אֹתָם מִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ אֵלֶּה הֵם מוֹעֲדָי׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: YHWH’s appointed times, which you shall call holy
assemblies—these are my appointed times:

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: YHWH’s appointed times, which you shall call holy
assemblies—these are my appointed times:

verses.hebrew: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תֵּעָשֶׂה מְלָאכָה וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ כּל מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ שַׁבָּת הִוא לַיהֹוָה בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תֵּעָשֶׂה מְלָאכָה וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ כּל מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ שַׁבָּת הִוא לַיהֹוָה בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
Six days work shall be done, and in the seventh day is a
Sabbath, a ceasing, a holy assembly. You shall not do any
work. It is a Sabbath to YHWH in all your homes.

translation.text: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.

verses.english:
Six days work shall be done, and in the seventh day is a
Sabbath, a ceasing, a holy assembly. You shall not do any
work. It is a Sabbath to YHWH in all your homes.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מוֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה מִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְאוּ אֹתָם בְּמוֹעֲדָם׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מוֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה מִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְאוּ אֹתָם בְּמוֹעֲדָם׃

english.text:
“These are YHWH’s appointed times, holy assemblies that
you shall proclaim at their appointed time:

translation.text: These are the feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.

verses.english:
“These are YHWH’s appointed times, holy assemblies that
you shall proclaim at their appointed time:

verses.hebrew: בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם פֶּסַח לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם פֶּסַח לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
In the first month, on the fourteenth of the month,
‘between the two evenings,’ is YHWH’s Passover.

translation.text: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD’s passover.

verses.english:
In the first month, on the fourteenth of the month,
‘between the two evenings,’ is YHWH’s Passover.

verses.hebrew: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה חַג הַמַּצּוֹת לַיהֹוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מַצּוֹת תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה חַג הַמַּצּוֹת לַיהֹוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מַצּוֹת תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

english.text:
And on the fifteenth day of this month is YHWH’s Festival
of Unleavened Bread. You shall eat unleavened bread seven
days.

translation.text: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.

verses.english:
And on the fifteenth day of this month is YHWH’s Festival
of Unleavened Bread. You shall eat unleavened bread seven
days.

verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
On the first day you shall have a holy assembly. You shall
not do any act of work.

translation.text: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

verses.english:
On the first day you shall have a holy assembly. You shall
not do any act of work.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
And you shall bring forward an offering by fire to YHWH
for seven days. On the seventh day you shall have a holy
assembly. You shall not do any act of work.”

translation.text: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

verses.english:
And you shall bring forward an offering by fire to YHWH
for seven days. On the seventh day you shall have a holy
assembly. You shall not do any act of work.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם וּקְצַרְתֶּם אֶת קְצִירָהּ וַהֲבֵאתֶם אֶת עֹמֶר רֵאשִׁית קְצִירְכֶם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם וּקְצַרְתֶּם אֶת קְצִירָהּ וַהֲבֵאתֶם אֶת עֹמֶר רֵאשִׁית קְצִירְכֶם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you will come to the land that I am giving to
you and you reap its harvest, you shall bring the first
sheaf of your harvest to the priest,

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you will come to the land that I am giving to
you and you reap its harvest, you shall bring the first
sheaf of your harvest to the priest,

verses.hebrew: וְהֵנִיף אֶת הָעֹמֶר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לִרְצֹנְכֶם מִמּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת יְנִיפֶנּוּ הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵנִיף אֶת הָעֹמֶר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לִרְצֹנְכֶם מִמּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת יְנִיפֶנּוּ הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
and he shall elevate the sheaf in front of YHWH for
acceptance for you. The priest shall elevate it on the day
after the Sabbath.

translation.text: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

verses.english:
and he shall elevate the sheaf in front of YHWH for
acceptance for you. The priest shall elevate it on the day
after the Sabbath.

verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם בְּיוֹם הֲנִיפְכֶם אֶת הָעֹמֶר כֶּבֶשׂ תָּמִים בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם בְּיוֹם הֲנִיפְכֶם אֶת הָעֹמֶר כֶּבֶשׂ תָּמִים בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And on the day of your elevating the sheaf, you shall do
an unblemished lamb in its first year as a burnt offering
to YHWH,

translation.text: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And on the day of your elevating the sheaf, you shall do
an unblemished lamb in its first year as a burnt offering
to YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָתוֹ שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ וְנִסְכֹּה יַיִן רְבִיעִת הַהִין׃

hebrew.text: וּמִנְחָתוֹ שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ וְנִסְכֹּה יַיִן רְבִיעִת הַהִין׃

english.text:
and its grain offering shall be two-tenths of a measure of
fine flour mixed with oil, an offering by fire to YHWH, a
pleasant smell, and its libation shall be wine, a fourth
of a hin.

translation.text: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.

verses.english:
and its grain offering shall be two-tenths of a measure of
fine flour mixed with oil, an offering by fire to YHWH, a
pleasant smell, and its libation shall be wine, a fourth
of a hin.

verses.hebrew: וְלֶחֶם וְקָלִי וְכַרְמֶל לֹא תֹאכְלוּ עַד עֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה עַד הֲבִיאֲכֶם אֶת קרְבַּן אֱלֹהֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֶחֶם וְקָלִי וְכַרְמֶל לֹא תֹאכְלוּ עַד עֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה עַד הֲבִיאֲכֶם אֶת קרְבַּן אֱלֹהֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall not eat bread or parched or fresh grain
until that very day, until you have brought your God’s
offering. It is an eternal law through your generations in
all your homes.

translation.text: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

verses.english:
And you shall not eat bread or parched or fresh grain
until that very day, until you have brought your God’s
offering. It is an eternal law through your generations in
all your homes.

verses.hebrew: וּסְפַרְתֶּם לָכֶם מִמּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת מִיּוֹם הֲבִיאֲכֶם אֶת עֹמֶר הַתְּנוּפָה שֶׁבַע שַׁבָּתוֹת תְּמִימֹת תִּהְיֶינָה׃

hebrew.text: וּסְפַרְתֶּם לָכֶם מִמּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת מִיּוֹם הֲבִיאֲכֶם אֶת עֹמֶר הַתְּנוּפָה שֶׁבַע שַׁבָּתוֹת תְּמִימֹת תִּהְיֶינָה׃

english.text:
And you shall count from the day after the Sabbath, from
the day of your bringing the sheaf for an elevation
offering, seven Sabbaths. They shall be complete.

translation.text: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:

verses.english:
And you shall count from the day after the Sabbath, from
the day of your bringing the sheaf for an elevation
offering, seven Sabbaths. They shall be complete.

verses.hebrew: עַד מִמּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת הַשְּׁבִיעִת תִּסְפְּרוּ חֲמִשִּׁים יוֹם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם מִנְחָה חֲדָשָׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: עַד מִמּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת הַשְּׁבִיעִת תִּסְפְּרוּ חֲמִשִּׁים יוֹם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם מִנְחָה חֲדָשָׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall count until the day after the seventh Sabbath:
fifty days. And you shall bring forward a new grain
offering to YHWH.

translation.text: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD.

verses.english:
You shall count until the day after the seventh Sabbath:
fifty days. And you shall bring forward a new grain
offering to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: מִמּוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם תָּבִיאּוּ לֶחֶם תְּנוּפָה שְׁתַּיִם שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת תִּהְיֶינָה חָמֵץ תֵּאָפֶינָה בִּכּוּרִים לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: מִמּוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם תָּבִיאּוּ לֶחֶם תְּנוּפָה שְׁתַּיִם שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת תִּהְיֶינָה חָמֵץ תֵּאָפֶינָה בִּכּוּרִים לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
From your homes you shall bring bread for an elevation
offering: two of them. They shall be two-tenths of a
measure of fine flour, baked with leaven, firstfruits to
YHWH.

translation.text: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals; they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto the LORD.

verses.english:
From your homes you shall bring bread for an elevation
offering: two of them. They shall be two-tenths of a
measure of fine flour, baked with leaven, firstfruits to
YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם עַל הַלֶּחֶם שִׁבְעַת כְּבָשִׂים תְּמִימִם בְּנֵי שָׁנָה וּפַר בֶּן בָּקָר אֶחָד וְאֵילִם שְׁנָיִם יִהְיוּ עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם עַל הַלֶּחֶם שִׁבְעַת כְּבָשִׂים תְּמִימִם בְּנֵי שָׁנָה וּפַר בֶּן בָּקָר אֶחָד וְאֵילִם שְׁנָיִם יִהְיוּ עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall bring forward with the bread seven lambs,
unblemished one-year-olds, and one bull of the cattle and
two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to YHWH, with
their grain offering and their libations, an offering by
fire, a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto the LORD, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall bring forward with the bread seven lambs,
unblemished one-year-olds, and one bull of the cattle and
two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to YHWH, with
their grain offering and their libations, an offering by
fire, a pleasant smell to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם שְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וּשְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה לְזֶבַח שְׁלָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם שְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וּשְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה לְזֶבַח שְׁלָמִים׃

english.text:
And you shall do one goat as a sin offering and two
one-year-old lambs as a peace-offering sacrifice.

translation.text: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

verses.english:
And you shall do one goat as a sin offering and two
one-year-old lambs as a peace-offering sacrifice.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵנִיף הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם עַל לֶחֶם הַבִּכֻּרִים תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל שְׁנֵי כְּבָשִׂים קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיוּ לַיהֹוָה לַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵנִיף הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם עַל לֶחֶם הַבִּכֻּרִים תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל שְׁנֵי כְּבָשִׂים קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיוּ לַיהֹוָה לַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
And the priest shall elevate them with the bread of
firstfruits, an elevation offering in front of YHWH with
the two sheep. They shall be a holy thing to YHWH: for the
priest.

translation.text: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

verses.english:
And the priest shall elevate them with the bread of
firstfruits, an elevation offering in front of YHWH with
the two sheep. They shall be a holy thing to YHWH: for the
priest.

verses.hebrew: וּקְרָאתֶם בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ חֻקַּת עוֹלָם בְּכל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּקְרָאתֶם בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ חֻקַּת עוֹלָם בְּכל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall proclaim on that very day: you shall have a
holy assembly. You shall not do any act of work: an
eternal law in all your homes through your generations.

translation.text: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

verses.english:
And you shall proclaim on that very day: you shall have a
holy assembly. You shall not do any act of work: an
eternal law in all your homes through your generations.

verses.hebrew: וּבְקֻצְרְכֶם אֶת קְצִיר אַרְצְכֶם לֹא תְכַלֶּה פְּאַת שָׂדְךָ בְּקֻצְרֶךָ וְלֶקֶט קְצִירְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט לֶעָנִי וְלַגֵּר תַּעֲזֹב אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְקֻצְרְכֶם אֶת קְצִיר אַרְצְכֶם לֹא תְכַלֶּה פְּאַת שָׂדְךָ בְּקֻצְרֶךָ וְלֶקֶט קְצִירְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט לֶעָנִי וְלַגֵּר תַּעֲזֹב אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And when you reap your land’s harvest, you shall not
finish your field’s corner when you harvest, and you shall
not gather your harvest’s gleaning. You shall leave them
for the poor and for the alien. I am YHWH, your God.”

translation.text: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
And when you reap your land’s harvest, you shall not
finish your field’s corner when you harvest, and you shall
not gather your harvest’s gleaning. You shall leave them
for the poor and for the alien. I am YHWH, your God.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם שַׁבָּתוֹן זִכְרוֹן תְּרוּעָה מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם שַׁבָּתוֹן זִכְרוֹן תְּרוּעָה מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: In the seventh
month, on the first of the month you shall have a ceasing,
a commemoration with horn-blasting, a holy assembly.

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: In the seventh
month, on the first of the month you shall have a ceasing,
a commemoration with horn-blasting, a holy assembly.

verses.hebrew: כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall not do any act of work. And you shall bring
forward an offering by fire to YHWH.”

offering by fire to YHWH.

And you shall not do any work on this very day, because it
is a day of atonement, to atone for you in front of YHWH,
your God.

Because any person who will not be degraded on this very

And any person who will do any work in this very day: I
shall destroy that person from among his people.

And any person who will do any work in this very day: I

You shall not do any work: an eternal law through your
generations in all your homes.

verses.english:
You shall not do any work: an eternal law through your
generations in all your homes.

yourselves: on the ninth of the month in the evening, from
evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”

verses.english:
It is a Sabbath, a ceasing, for you, and you shall degrade

“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: On the fifteenth

days, for YHWH.

“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: On the fifteenth

days, for YHWH.

and you shall bring forward an offering by fire to YHWH.
It is a convocation. You shall not do any act of work.

For seven days you shall bring forward an offering by fire

It is a convocation. You shall not do any act of work.

libations, each day’s thing on its day,

“These are YHWH’s appointed times, which you shall call

libations, each day’s thing on its day,

aside from YHWH’s Sabbaths and aside from your gifts and

“Just: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month when you

trees, branches of palms, boughs of thick trees, and
willows of a wadi, and you shall be happy in front of
YHWH, your God, seven days.

verses.english:
And on the first day you shall take fruit of appealing
trees, branches of palms, boughs of thick trees, and
willows of a wadi, and you shall be happy in front of
YHWH, your God, seven days.

shall celebrate it in the seventh month.

verses.english:
And you shall celebrate it, a holiday to YHWH, seven days
in the year, an eternal law through your generations; you
shall celebrate it in the seventh month.

You shall live in booths seven days. Every citizen in
Israel shall live in booths,

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּ דֹרֹתֵיכֶם כִּי בַסֻּכּוֹת הוֹשַׁבְתִּי אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהוֹצִיאִי אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּ דֹרֹתֵיכֶם כִּי בַסֻּכּוֹת הוֹשַׁבְתִּי אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהוֹצִיאִי אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
so your generations will know that I had the children of
Israel live in booths when I brought them out from the
land of Egypt. I am YHWH, your God.”

translation.text: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
so your generations will know that I had the children of
Israel live in booths when I brought them out from the
land of Egypt. I am YHWH, your God.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶת מֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶת מֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses spoke YHWH’s appointed times to the children of
Israel.

translation.text: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the LORD.

verses.english:
And Moses spoke YHWH’s appointed times to the children of
Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִקְחוּ אֵלֶיךָ שֶׁמֶן זַיִת זָךְ כָּתִית לַמָּאוֹר לְהַעֲלֹת נֵר תָּמִיד׃

hebrew.text: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִקְחוּ אֵלֶיךָ שֶׁמֶן זַיִת זָךְ כָּתִית לַמָּאוֹר לְהַעֲלֹת נֵר תָּמִיד׃

english.text:
“Command the children of Israel that they shall take clear
pressed olive oil to you for the light, to keep up a lamp
always.

translation.text: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.

verses.english:
“Command the children of Israel that they shall take clear
pressed olive oil to you for the light, to keep up a lamp
always.

verses.hebrew: מִחוּץ לְפָרֹכֶת הָעֵדֻת בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יַעֲרֹךְ אֹתוֹ אַהֲרֹן מֵעֶרֶב עַד בֹּקֶר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תָּמִיד חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: מִחוּץ לְפָרֹכֶת הָעֵדֻת בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יַעֲרֹךְ אֹתוֹ אַהֲרֹן מֵעֶרֶב עַד בֹּקֶר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תָּמִיד חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
Outside of the pavilion of the Testimony, in the Tent of
Meeting, Aaron shall arrange it from evening until morning
in front of YHWH always, an eternal law through your
generations.

translation.text: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the LORD continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.

verses.english:
Outside of the pavilion of the Testimony, in the Tent of
Meeting, Aaron shall arrange it from evening until morning
in front of YHWH always, an eternal law through your
generations.

verses.hebrew: עַל הַמְּנֹרָה הַטְּהֹרָה יַעֲרֹךְ אֶת הַנֵּרוֹת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תָּמִיד׃

hebrew.text: עַל הַמְּנֹרָה הַטְּהֹרָה יַעֲרֹךְ אֶת הַנֵּרוֹת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תָּמִיד׃

english.text:
He shall arrange the lamps on the pure menorah in front of
YHWH always.

translation.text: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the LORD continually.

verses.english:
He shall arrange the lamps on the pure menorah in front of
YHWH always.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ סֹלֶת וְאָפִיתָ אֹתָהּ שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה חַלּוֹת שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים יִהְיֶה הַחַלָּה הָאֶחָת׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ סֹלֶת וְאָפִיתָ אֹתָהּ שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה חַלּוֹת שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים יִהְיֶה הַחַלָּה הָאֶחָת׃

english.text:
“And you shall take fine flour and bake it into twelve
loaves: each loaf shall be two-tenths of a measure.

translation.text: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.

verses.english:
“And you shall take fine flour and bake it into twelve
loaves: each loaf shall be two-tenths of a measure.

verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתָּ אוֹתָם שְׁתַּיִם מַעֲרָכוֹת שֵׁשׁ הַמַּעֲרָכֶת עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָן הַטָּהֹר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ אוֹתָם שְׁתַּיִם מַעֲרָכוֹת שֵׁשׁ הַמַּעֲרָכֶת עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָן הַטָּהֹר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall set them in two rows, six to a row, on the
pure table in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall set them in two rows, six to a row, on the
pure table in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ עַל הַמַּעֲרֶכֶת לְבֹנָה זַכָּה וְהָיְתָה לַלֶּחֶם לְאַזְכָּרָה אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּ עַל הַמַּעֲרֶכֶת לְבֹנָה זַכָּה וְהָיְתָה לַלֶּחֶם לְאַזְכָּרָה אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall put clear frankincense on each row, and it
will be a representative portion for the bread, an
offering by fire to YHWH.

translation.text: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall put clear frankincense on each row, and it
will be a representative portion for the bread, an
offering by fire to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת יַעַרְכֶנּוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תָּמִיד מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרִית עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת יַעַרְכֶנּוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תָּמִיד מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרִית עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
On the Sabbath day, on the Sabbath day, he shall arrange
it in front of YHWH always from the children of Israel, an
eternal covenant.

translation.text: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.

verses.english:
On the Sabbath day, on the Sabbath day, he shall arrange
it in front of YHWH always from the children of Israel, an
eternal covenant.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו וַאֲכָלֻהוּ בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ כִּי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא לוֹ מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה חק עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו וַאֲכָלֻהוּ בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ כִּי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא לוֹ מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה חק עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’, and they shall eat
it in a holy place, because it is the holy of holies to
him from YHWH’s offerings by fire, an eternal law.”

translation.text: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.

verses.english:
And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’, and they shall eat
it in a holy place, because it is the holy of holies to
him from YHWH’s offerings by fire, an eternal law.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא בֶּן אִשָּׁה יִשְׂרְאֵלִית וְהוּא בֶּן אִישׁ מִצְרִי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּנָּצוּ בַּמַּחֲנֶה בֶּן הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִית וְאִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא בֶּן אִשָּׁה יִשְׂרְאֵלִית וְהוּא בֶּן אִישׁ מִצְרִי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּנָּצוּ בַּמַּחֲנֶה בֶּן הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִית וְאִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי׃

english.text:
And a son of an Israelite woman—and he was a son of an Egyptian
man—went out among the children of Israel, and the son of the
Israelite woman fought with an Israelite man in the camp.

translation.text: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;

verses.english:
And a son of an Israelite woman—and he was a son of an Egyptian
man—went out among the children of Israel, and the son of the
Israelite woman fought with an Israelite man in the camp.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקֹּב בֶּן הָאִשָּׁה הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִית אֶת הַשֵּׁם וַיְקַלֵּל וַיָּבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ שְׁלֹמִית בַּת דִּבְרִי לְמַטֵּה דָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקֹּב בֶּן הָאִשָּׁה הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִית אֶת הַשֵּׁם וַיְקַלֵּל וַיָּבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ שְׁלֹמִית בַּת דִּבְרִי לְמַטֵּה דָן׃

english.text:
And the son of the Israelite woman profaned the name and
cursed. And they brought him to Moses. And his mother’s
name was Shelomith, daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of
Dan.

translation.text: And the Israelitish woman’s son blasphemed the name of the Lord, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)

verses.english:
And the son of the Israelite woman profaned the name and
cursed. And they brought him to Moses. And his mother’s
name was Shelomith, daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of
Dan.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּנִּיחֻהוּ בַּמִּשְׁמָר לִפְרֹשׁ לָהֶם עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּנִּיחֻהוּ בַּמִּשְׁמָר לִפְרֹשׁ לָהֶם עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And they left him under watch, to determine it for them by
YHWH’s word.

translation.text: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them.

verses.english:
And they left him under watch, to determine it for them by
YHWH’s word.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: הוֹצֵא אֶת הַמְקַלֵּל אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְסָמְכוּ כל הַשֹּׁמְעִים אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וְרָגְמוּ אֹתוֹ כּל הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: הוֹצֵא אֶת הַמְקַלֵּל אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְסָמְכוּ כל הַשֹּׁמְעִים אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וְרָגְמוּ אֹתוֹ כּל הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
“Take out the one who cursed to the outside of the camp,
and let all who heard lay their hands on his head, and all
the congregation shall batter him.

translation.text: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

verses.english:
“Take out the one who cursed to the outside of the camp,
and let all who heard lay their hands on his head, and all
the congregation shall batter him.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּדַבֵּר לֵאמֹר אִישׁ אִישׁ כִּי יְקַלֵּל אֱלֹהָיו וְנָשָׂא חֶטְאוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּדַבֵּר לֵאמֹר אִישׁ אִישׁ כִּי יְקַלֵּל אֱלֹהָיו וְנָשָׂא חֶטְאוֹ׃

english.text:
“And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying:
Any man who curses his God: he shall bear his sin.

translation.text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.

verses.english:
“And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying:
Any man who curses his God: he shall bear his sin.

verses.hebrew: וְנֹקֵב שֵׁם יְהֹוָה מוֹת יוּמָת רָגוֹם יִרְגְּמוּ בוֹ כּל הָעֵדָה כַּגֵּר כָּאֶזְרָח בְּנקְבוֹ שֵׁם יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וְנֹקֵב שֵׁם יְהֹוָה מוֹת יוּמָת רָגוֹם יִרְגְּמוּ בוֹ כּל הָעֵדָה כַּגֵּר כָּאֶזְרָח בְּנקְבוֹ שֵׁם יוּמָת׃

english.text:
And one who profanes YHWH’s name shall be put to death.
All the congregation shall batter him. The same for the
alien and the citizen: when he profanes the name he shall
be put to death.

translation.text: And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the Lord, shall be put to death.

verses.english:
And one who profanes YHWH’s name shall be put to death.
All the congregation shall batter him. The same for the
alien and the citizen: when he profanes the name he shall
be put to death.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי יַכֶּה כּל נֶפֶשׁ אָדָם מוֹת יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יַכֶּה כּל נֶפֶשׁ אָדָם מוֹת יוּמָת׃

english.text:
“And a man who will strike any human’s life shall be put
to death,

translation.text: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.

verses.english:
“And a man who will strike any human’s life shall be put
to death,

verses.hebrew: וּמַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ בְּהֵמָה יְשַׁלְּמֶנָּה נֶפֶשׁ תַּחַת נָפֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וּמַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ בְּהֵמָה יְשַׁלְּמֶנָּה נֶפֶשׁ תַּחַת נָפֶשׁ׃

english.text:
and one who strikes an animal’s life shall pay for it: a
life for a life.

translation.text: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.

verses.english:
and one who strikes an animal’s life shall pay for it: a
life for a life.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִתֵּן מוּם בַּעֲמִיתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה כֵּן יֵעָשֶׂה לּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִתֵּן מוּם בַּעֲמִיתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה כֵּן יֵעָשֶׂה לּוֹ׃

english.text:
And a man who will make an injury in his fellow: as he has
done, so it shall be done to him.

translation.text: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;

verses.english:
And a man who will make an injury in his fellow: as he has
done, so it shall be done to him.

verses.hebrew: שֶׁבֶר תַּחַת שֶׁבֶר עַיִן תַּחַת עַיִן שֵׁן תַּחַת שֵׁן כַּאֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מוּם בָּאָדָם כֵּן יִנָּתֶן בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: שֶׁבֶר תַּחַת שֶׁבֶר עַיִן תַּחַת עַיִן שֵׁן תַּחַת שֵׁן כַּאֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מוּם בָּאָדָם כֵּן יִנָּתֶן בּוֹ׃

english.text:
A break for a break, an eye for an eye, a tooth for a
tooth: as he will make an injury in a human, so it shall
be made in him.

translation.text: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.

verses.english:
A break for a break, an eye for an eye, a tooth for a
tooth: as he will make an injury in a human, so it shall
be made in him.

verses.hebrew: וּמַכֵּה בְהֵמָה יְשַׁלְּמֶנָּה וּמַכֵּה אָדָם יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וּמַכֵּה בְהֵמָה יְשַׁלְּמֶנָּה וּמַכֵּה אָדָם יוּמָת׃

english.text:
And one who strikes an animal shall pay for it, and one
who strikes a human shall be put to death.

translation.text: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.

verses.english:
And one who strikes an animal shall pay for it, and one
who strikes a human shall be put to death.

verses.hebrew: מִשְׁפַּט אֶחָד יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כַּגֵּר כָּאֶזְרָח יִהְיֶה כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: מִשְׁפַּט אֶחָד יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כַּגֵּר כָּאֶזְרָח יִהְיֶה כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
You shall have one judgment: it will be the same for the
alien and the citizen; because I am YHWH, your God.”

translation.text: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
You shall have one judgment: it will be the same for the
alien and the citizen; because I am YHWH, your God.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיּוֹצִיאוּ אֶת הַמְקַלֵּל אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וַיִּרְגְּמוּ אֹתוֹ אָבֶן וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עָשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיּוֹצִיאוּ אֶת הַמְקַלֵּל אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וַיִּרְגְּמוּ אֹתוֹ אָבֶן וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עָשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Moses spoke to the children of Israel. And they
brought out the one who cursed to the outside of the camp,
and they battered him with stone. And the children of
Israel had done as YHWH commanded Moses.

translation.text: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And Moses spoke to the children of Israel. And they
brought out the one who cursed to the outside of the camp,
and they battered him with stone. And the children of
Israel had done as YHWH commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּהַר סִינַי לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּהַר סִינַי לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses in Mount Sinai, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses in Mount Sinai, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם וְשָׁבְתָה הָאָרֶץ שַׁבָּת לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם וְשָׁבְתָה הָאָרֶץ שַׁבָּת לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel. And you shall say to
them: When you will come to the land that I am giving to
you, then the land shall have a Sabbath for YHWH.

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel. And you shall say to
them: When you will come to the land that I am giving to
you, then the land shall have a Sabbath for YHWH.

verses.hebrew: שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים תִּזְרַע שָׂדֶךָ וְשֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים תִּזְמֹר כַּרְמֶךָ וְאָסַפְתָּ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים תִּזְרַע שָׂדֶךָ וְשֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים תִּזְמֹר כַּרְמֶךָ וְאָסַפְתָּ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָהּ׃

english.text:
Six years you shall seed your field, and six years you
shall prune your vineyard, and you shall gather its
produce.

translation.text: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;

verses.english:
Six years you shall seed your field, and six years you
shall prune your vineyard, and you shall gather its
produce.

verses.hebrew: וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִת שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן יִהְיֶה לָאָרֶץ שַׁבָּת לַיהֹוָה שָׂדְךָ לֹא תִזְרָע וְכַרְמְךָ לֹא תִזְמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִת שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן יִהְיֶה לָאָרֶץ שַׁבָּת לַיהֹוָה שָׂדְךָ לֹא תִזְרָע וְכַרְמְךָ לֹא תִזְמֹר׃

english.text:
And in the seventh year the land shall have a Sabbath, a
ceasing, a Sabbath for YHWH: you shall not seed your
field, and you shall not prune your vineyard,

translation.text: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

verses.english:
And in the seventh year the land shall have a Sabbath, a
ceasing, a Sabbath for YHWH: you shall not seed your
field, and you shall not prune your vineyard,

verses.hebrew: אֵת סְפִיחַ קְצִירְךָ לֹא תִקְצוֹר וְאֶת עִנְּבֵי נְזִירֶךָ לֹא תִבְצֹר שְׁנַת שַׁבָּתוֹן יִהְיֶה לָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: אֵת סְפִיחַ קְצִירְךָ לֹא תִקְצוֹר וְאֶת עִנְּבֵי נְזִירֶךָ לֹא תִבְצֹר שְׁנַת שַׁבָּתוֹן יִהְיֶה לָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
you shall not reap your harvest’s free growth, and you
shall not cut off your untrimmed grapes. The land shall
have a year of ceasing.

translation.text: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.

verses.english:
you shall not reap your harvest’s free growth, and you
shall not cut off your untrimmed grapes. The land shall
have a year of ceasing.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה שַׁבַּת הָאָרֶץ לָכֶם לְאכְלָה לְךָ וּלְעַבְדְּךָ וְלַאֲמָתֶךָ וְלִשְׂכִירְךָ וּלְתוֹשָׁבְךָ הַגָּרִים עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה שַׁבַּת הָאָרֶץ לָכֶם לְאכְלָה לְךָ וּלְעַבְדְּךָ וְלַאֲמָתֶךָ וְלִשְׂכִירְךָ וּלְתוֹשָׁבְךָ הַגָּרִים עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
And the land’s Sabbath shall be yours for food: for you
and for your servant and for your maid and for your
employee and for your visitor who are residing with you

translation.text: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee.

verses.english:
And the land’s Sabbath shall be yours for food: for you
and for your servant and for your maid and for your
employee and for your visitor who are residing with you

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְהֶמְתְּךָ וְלַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר בְּאַרְצֶךָ תִּהְיֶה כל תְּבוּאָתָהּ לֶאֱכֹל׃

hebrew.text: וְלִבְהֶמְתְּךָ וְלַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר בְּאַרְצֶךָ תִּהְיֶה כל תְּבוּאָתָהּ לֶאֱכֹל׃

english.text:
and for your domestic animal and for the wild animal that
are in your land shall be all of its produce to eat.

translation.text: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.

verses.english:
and for your domestic animal and for the wild animal that
are in your land shall be all of its produce to eat.

verses.hebrew: וְסָפַרְתָּ לְךָ שֶׁבַע שַׁבְּתֹת שָׁנִים שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְהָיוּ לְךָ יְמֵי שֶׁבַע שַׁבְּתֹת הַשָּׁנִים תֵּשַׁע וְאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְסָפַרְתָּ לְךָ שֶׁבַע שַׁבְּתֹת שָׁנִים שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְהָיוּ לְךָ יְמֵי שֶׁבַע שַׁבְּתֹת הַשָּׁנִים תֵּשַׁע וְאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
“And you shall count seven Sabbaths of years: seven years,
seven times. And the days of the seven Sabbaths of years
shall be for you forty-nine years.

translation.text: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.

verses.english:
“And you shall count seven Sabbaths of years: seven years,
seven times. And the days of the seven Sabbaths of years
shall be for you forty-nine years.

verses.hebrew: וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ שׁוֹפַר תְּרוּעָה בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִעִי בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ בְּיוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים תַּעֲבִירוּ שׁוֹפָר בְּכל אַרְצְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ שׁוֹפַר תְּרוּעָה בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִעִי בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ בְּיוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים תַּעֲבִירוּ שׁוֹפָר בְּכל אַרְצְכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall pass a blasting horn in the seventh month on
the tenth of the month: on the Day of Atonement you shall
have the horn pass through all your land.

translation.text: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.

verses.english:
And you shall pass a blasting horn in the seventh month on
the tenth of the month: on the Day of Atonement you shall
have the horn pass through all your land.

verses.hebrew: וְקִדַּשְׁתֶּם אֵת שְׁנַת הַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּקְרָאתֶם דְּרוֹר בָּאָרֶץ לְכל יֹשְׁבֶיהָ יוֹבֵל הִוא תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם וְשַׁבְתֶּם אִישׁ אֶל אֲחֻזָּתוֹ וְאִישׁ אֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ תָּשֻׁבוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְקִדַּשְׁתֶּם אֵת שְׁנַת הַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּקְרָאתֶם דְּרוֹר בָּאָרֶץ לְכל יֹשְׁבֶיהָ יוֹבֵל הִוא תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם וְשַׁבְתֶּם אִישׁ אֶל אֲחֻזָּתוֹ וְאִישׁ אֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ תָּשֻׁבוּ׃

english.text:
And you shall consecrate the year that makes fifty years
and proclaim liberty in the land, to all its inhabitants.
It shall be a jubilee for you. And you shall go back, each
to his possession; and you shall go back, each to his
family.

translation.text: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

verses.english:
And you shall consecrate the year that makes fifty years
and proclaim liberty in the land, to all its inhabitants.
It shall be a jubilee for you. And you shall go back, each
to his possession; and you shall go back, each to his
family.

verses.hebrew: יוֹבֵל הִוא שְׁנַת הַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם לֹא תִזְרָעוּ וְלֹא תִקְצְרוּ אֶת סְפִיחֶיהָ וְלֹא תִבְצְרוּ אֶת נְזִרֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: יוֹבֵל הִוא שְׁנַת הַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם לֹא תִזְרָעוּ וְלֹא תִקְצְרוּ אֶת סְפִיחֶיהָ וְלֹא תִבְצְרוּ אֶת נְזִרֶיהָ׃

english.text:
It, the year that makes fifty years, shall be a jubilee
for you. You shall not seed, and you shall not harvest its
free growths, and you shall not cut off its untrimmed
fruits,

translation.text: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.

verses.english:
It, the year that makes fifty years, shall be a jubilee
for you. You shall not seed, and you shall not harvest its
free growths, and you shall not cut off its untrimmed
fruits,

verses.hebrew: כִּי יוֹבֵל הִוא קֹדֶשׁ תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם מִן הַשָּׂדֶה תֹּאכְלוּ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יוֹבֵל הִוא קֹדֶשׁ תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם מִן הַשָּׂדֶה תֹּאכְלוּ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָהּ׃

english.text:
because it is a jubilee; it shall be a holy thing to you.
You shall eat its produce from the field.

translation.text: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.

verses.english:
because it is a jubilee; it shall be a holy thing to you.
You shall eat its produce from the field.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל הַזֹּאת תָּשֻׁבוּ אִישׁ אֶל אֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל הַזֹּאת תָּשֻׁבוּ אִישׁ אֶל אֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
In this jubilee year you shall go back, each to his
possession.

translation.text: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.

verses.english:
In this jubilee year you shall go back, each to his
possession.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי תִמְכְּרוּ מִמְכָּר לַעֲמִיתֶךָ אוֹ קָנֹה מִיַּד עֲמִיתֶךָ אַל תּוֹנוּ אִישׁ אֶת אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תִמְכְּרוּ מִמְכָּר לַעֲמִיתֶךָ אוֹ קָנֹה מִיַּד עֲמִיתֶךָ אַל תּוֹנוּ אִישׁ אֶת אָחִיו׃

english.text:
And when you will make a sale to your fellow or buy from
your fellow’s hand: each of you, do not persecute his
brother.

translation.text: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour’s hand, ye shall not oppress one another:

verses.english:
And when you will make a sale to your fellow or buy from
your fellow’s hand: each of you, do not persecute his
brother.

verses.hebrew: בְּמִסְפַּר שָׁנִים אַחַר הַיּוֹבֵל תִּקְנֶה מֵאֵת עֲמִיתֶךָ בְּמִסְפַּר שְׁנֵי תְבוּאֹת יִמְכּר לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: בְּמִסְפַּר שָׁנִים אַחַר הַיּוֹבֵל תִּקְנֶה מֵאֵת עֲמִיתֶךָ בְּמִסְפַּר שְׁנֵי תְבוּאֹת יִמְכּר לָךְ׃

english.text:
You shall buy from your fellow by the number of years
after the jubilee. He shall sell to you by the number of
years of yields—

translation.text: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:

verses.english:
You shall buy from your fellow by the number of years
after the jubilee. He shall sell to you by the number of
years of yields—

verses.hebrew: לְפִי רֹב הַשָּׁנִים תַּרְבֶּה מִקְנָתוֹ וּלְפִי מְעֹט הַשָּׁנִים תַּמְעִיט מִקְנָתוֹ כִּי מִסְפַּר תְּבוּאֹת הוּא מֹכֵר לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: לְפִי רֹב הַשָּׁנִים תַּרְבֶּה מִקְנָתוֹ וּלְפִי מְעֹט הַשָּׁנִים תַּמְעִיט מִקְנָתוֹ כִּי מִסְפַּר תְּבוּאֹת הוּא מֹכֵר לָךְ׃

english.text:
corresponding to a greater amount of the years, you shall
make its price greater; and corresponding to a smaller
amount of the years, you shall make its price
smaller—because it is a number of yields that he is
selling to you.

translation.text: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.

verses.english:
corresponding to a greater amount of the years, you shall
make its price greater; and corresponding to a smaller
amount of the years, you shall make its price
smaller—because it is a number of yields that he is
selling to you.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תוֹנוּ אִישׁ אֶת עֲמִיתוֹ וְיָרֵאתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תוֹנוּ אִישׁ אֶת עֲמִיתוֹ וְיָרֵאתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall not persecute—each of you—his brother, but
you shall fear your God, because I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
And you shall not persecute—each of you—his brother, but
you shall fear your God, because I am YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וִישַׁבְתֶּם עַל הָאָרֶץ לָבֶטַח׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וִישַׁבְתֶּם עַל הָאָרֶץ לָבֶטַח׃

english.text:
“And you shall do my laws and observe my judgments and do
them, so you will live on the land in security.

translation.text: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.

verses.english:
“And you shall do my laws and observe my judgments and do
them, so you will live on the land in security.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנָה הָאָרֶץ פִּרְיָהּ וַאֲכַלְתֶּם לָשֹׂבַע וִישַׁבְתֶּם לָבֶטַח עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתְנָה הָאָרֶץ פִּרְיָהּ וַאֲכַלְתֶּם לָשֹׂבַע וִישַׁבְתֶּם לָבֶטַח עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And the land will give its fruit, and you will eat to the
full, and you will live in security on it.

translation.text: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

verses.english:
And the land will give its fruit, and you will eat to the
full, and you will live in security on it.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי תֹאמְרוּ מַה נֹּאכַל בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִת הֵן לֹא נִזְרָע וְלֹא נֶאֱסֹף אֶת תְּבוּאָתֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תֹאמְרוּ מַה נֹּאכַל בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִת הֵן לֹא נִזְרָע וְלֹא נֶאֱסֹף אֶת תְּבוּאָתֵנוּ׃

english.text:
And if you will say, ‘What shall we eat in the seventh
year? Here, we won’t seed and won’t gather our produce,’

translation.text: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:

verses.english:
And if you will say, ‘What shall we eat in the seventh
year? Here, we won’t seed and won’t gather our produce,’

verses.hebrew: וְצִוִּיתִי אֶת בִּרְכָתִי לָכֶם בַּשָּׁנָה הַשִּׁשִּׁית וְעָשָׂת אֶת הַתְּבוּאָה לִשְׁלֹשׁ הַשָּׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וְצִוִּיתִי אֶת בִּרְכָתִי לָכֶם בַּשָּׁנָה הַשִּׁשִּׁית וְעָשָׂת אֶת הַתְּבוּאָה לִשְׁלֹשׁ הַשָּׁנִים׃

english.text:
I shall command my blessing for you in the sixth year, and
it will make the produce for the three years.

translation.text: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.

verses.english:
I shall command my blessing for you in the sixth year, and
it will make the produce for the three years.

verses.hebrew: וּזְרַעְתֶּם אֵת הַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁמִינִת וַאֲכַלְתֶּם מִן הַתְּבוּאָה יָשָׁן עַד הַשָּׁנָה הַתְּשִׁיעִת עַד בּוֹא תְּבוּאָתָהּ תֹּאכְלוּ יָשָׁן׃

hebrew.text: וּזְרַעְתֶּם אֵת הַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁמִינִת וַאֲכַלְתֶּם מִן הַתְּבוּאָה יָשָׁן עַד הַשָּׁנָה הַתְּשִׁיעִת עַד בּוֹא תְּבוּאָתָהּ תֹּאכְלוּ יָשָׁן׃

english.text:
And you will seed the eighth year and eat from the old
produce until the ninth year; you will eat the old until
its produce comes.

translation.text: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.

verses.english:
And you will seed the eighth year and eat from the old
produce until the ninth year; you will eat the old until
its produce comes.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאָרֶץ לֹא תִמָּכֵר לִצְמִתֻת כִּי לִי הָאָרֶץ כִּי גֵרִים וְתוֹשָׁבִים אַתֶּם עִמָּדִי׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאָרֶץ לֹא תִמָּכֵר לִצְמִתֻת כִּי לִי הָאָרֶץ כִּי גֵרִים וְתוֹשָׁבִים אַתֶּם עִמָּדִי׃

english.text:
But the land shall not be sold permanently, because the
land is mine, because you are aliens and visitors with me!

translation.text: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine, for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.

verses.english:
But the land shall not be sold permanently, because the
land is mine, because you are aliens and visitors with me!

verses.hebrew: וּבְכֹל אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם גְּאֻלָּה תִּתְּנוּ לָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְכֹל אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם גְּאֻלָּה תִּתְּנוּ לָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
So in all the land in your possession you shall give a
redemption for the land.

translation.text: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.

verses.english:
So in all the land in your possession you shall give a
redemption for the land.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ וּמָכַר מֵאֲחֻזָּתוֹ וּבָא גֹאֲלוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֵלָיו וְגָאַל אֵת מִמְכַּר אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ וּמָכַר מֵאֲחֻזָּתוֹ וּבָא גֹאֲלוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֵלָיו וְגָאַל אֵת מִמְכַּר אָחִיו׃

english.text:
When your brother will be low so that he will sell any of his
possession, then his redeemer who is the closest relative to him
shall come and redeem his brother’s sale.

translation.text: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.

verses.english:
When your brother will be low so that he will sell any of his
possession, then his redeemer who is the closest relative to him
shall come and redeem his brother’s sale.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי לֹא יִהְיֶה לּוֹ גֹּאֵל וְהִשִּׂיגָה יָדוֹ וּמָצָא כְּדֵי גְאֻלָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי לֹא יִהְיֶה לּוֹ גֹּאֵל וְהִשִּׂיגָה יָדוֹ וּמָצָא כְּדֵי גְאֻלָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
And when a man will not have a redeemer, but his hand has
come to attain it and he has found enough for his
redemption,

translation.text: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;

verses.english:
And when a man will not have a redeemer, but his hand has
come to attain it and he has found enough for his
redemption,

verses.hebrew: וְחִשַּׁב אֶת שְׁנֵי מִמְכָּרוֹ וְהֵשִׁיב אֶת הָעֹדֵף לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר מָכַר לוֹ וְשָׁב לַאֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְחִשַּׁב אֶת שְׁנֵי מִמְכָּרוֹ וְהֵשִׁיב אֶת הָעֹדֵף לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר מָכַר לוֹ וְשָׁב לַאֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
then he shall figure the years of his sale and pay back
what is left over to the man to whom he sold it, and he
shall go back to his possession.

translation.text: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.

verses.english:
then he shall figure the years of his sale and pay back
what is left over to the man to whom he sold it, and he
shall go back to his possession.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא מָצְאָה יָדוֹ דֵּי הָשִׁיב לוֹ וְהָיָה מִמְכָּרוֹ בְּיַד הַקֹּנֶה אֹתוֹ עַד שְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל וְיָצָא בַּיֹּבֵל וְשָׁב לַאֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא מָצְאָה יָדוֹ דֵּי הָשִׁיב לוֹ וְהָיָה מִמְכָּרוֹ בְּיַד הַקֹּנֶה אֹתוֹ עַד שְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל וְיָצָא בַּיֹּבֵל וְשָׁב לַאֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
And if his hand has not found enough to pay it back to
him, then his sale shall be in the hand of the one who
bought it until the jubilee year, and it shall come out in
the jubilee, and he shall go back to his possession.

translation.text: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.

verses.english:
And if his hand has not found enough to pay it back to
him, then his sale shall be in the hand of the one who
bought it until the jubilee year, and it shall come out in
the jubilee, and he shall go back to his possession.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִמְכֹּר בֵּית מוֹשַׁב עִיר חוֹמָה וְהָיְתָה גְּאֻלָּתוֹ עַד תֹּם שְׁנַת מִמְכָּרוֹ יָמִים תִּהְיֶה גְאֻלָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִמְכֹּר בֵּית מוֹשַׁב עִיר חוֹמָה וְהָיְתָה גְּאֻלָּתוֹ עַד תֹּם שְׁנַת מִמְכָּרוֹ יָמִים תִּהְיֶה גְאֻלָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
“And when a man will sell a home in a walled city, then
its redemption shall be until the end of the year of its
sale. Its redemption shall be for days.

translation.text: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.

verses.english:
“And when a man will sell a home in a walled city, then
its redemption shall be until the end of the year of its
sale. Its redemption shall be for days.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא יִגָּאֵל עַד מְלֹאת לוֹ שָׁנָה תְמִימָה וְקָם הַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר בָּעִיר אֲשֶׁר [לוֹ] (לא) חֹמָה לַצְּמִיתֻת לַקֹּנֶה אֹתוֹ לְדֹרֹתָיו לֹא יֵצֵא בַּיֹּבֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא יִגָּאֵל עַד מְלֹאת לוֹ שָׁנָה תְמִימָה וְקָם הַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר בָּעִיר אֲשֶׁר [לוֹ] (לא) חֹמָה לַצְּמִיתֻת לַקֹּנֶה אֹתוֹ לְדֹרֹתָיו לֹא יֵצֵא בַּיֹּבֵל׃

english.text:
And if it will not be redeemed by the completion of a full
year for it, then the house that is in a city that has a
wall shall be established permanently for the one who
bought it, through his generations. It shall not come out
in the jubilee.

translation.text: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.

verses.english:
And if it will not be redeemed by the completion of a full
year for it, then the house that is in a city that has a
wall shall be established permanently for the one who
bought it, through his generations. It shall not come out
in the jubilee.

verses.hebrew: וּבָתֵּי הַחֲצֵרִים אֲשֶׁר אֵין לָהֶם חֹמָה סָבִיב עַל שְׂדֵה הָאָרֶץ יֵחָשֵׁב גְּאֻלָּה תִּהְיֶה לּוֹ וּבַיֹּבֵל יֵצֵא׃

hebrew.text: וּבָתֵּי הַחֲצֵרִים אֲשֶׁר אֵין לָהֶם חֹמָה סָבִיב עַל שְׂדֵה הָאָרֶץ יֵחָשֵׁב גְּאֻלָּה תִּהְיֶה לּוֹ וּבַיֹּבֵל יֵצֵא׃

english.text:
“As for houses of the villages that do not have a wall
around them: it shall be figured along with the land’s
field. It shall have redemption, and it shall come out in
the jubilee.

translation.text: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.

verses.english:
“As for houses of the villages that do not have a wall
around them: it shall be figured along with the land’s
field. It shall have redemption, and it shall come out in
the jubilee.

verses.hebrew: וְעָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם בָּתֵּי עָרֵי אֲחֻזָּתָם גְּאֻלַּת עוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה לַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: וְעָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם בָּתֵּי עָרֵי אֲחֻזָּתָם גְּאֻלַּת עוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה לַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
“As for the Levites’ cities, the houses in the cities of
their possession: the Levites shall have eternal
redemption.

translation.text: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.

verses.english:
“As for the Levites’ cities, the houses in the cities of
their possession: the Levites shall have eternal
redemption.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲשֶׁר יִגְאַל מִן הַלְוִיִּם וְיָצָא מִמְכַּר בַּיִת וְעִיר אֲחֻזָּתוֹ בַּיֹּבֵל כִּי בָתֵּי עָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם הִוא אֲחֻזָּתָם בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲשֶׁר יִגְאַל מִן הַלְוִיִּם וְיָצָא מִמְכַּר בַּיִת וְעִיר אֲחֻזָּתוֹ בַּיֹּבֵל כִּי בָתֵּי עָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם הִוא אֲחֻזָּתָם בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And that which one from the Levites will redeem: it shall
come out, a sale of a house and of a city of his
possession, in the jubilee, because that—the houses of the
Levites’ cities—is their possession among the children of
Israel.

translation.text: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And that which one from the Levites will redeem: it shall
come out, a sale of a house and of a city of his
possession, in the jubilee, because that—the houses of the
Levites’ cities—is their possession among the children of
Israel.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׂדֵה מִגְרַשׁ עָרֵיהֶם לֹא יִמָּכֵר כִּי אֲחֻזַּת עוֹלָם הוּא לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׂדֵה מִגְרַשׁ עָרֵיהֶם לֹא יִמָּכֵר כִּי אֲחֻזַּת עוֹלָם הוּא לָהֶם׃

english.text:
But a field of their cities’ surrounding land shall not be
sold, because it is an eternal possession for them.

translation.text: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

verses.english:
But a field of their cities’ surrounding land shall not be
sold, because it is an eternal possession for them.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ וּמָטָה יָדוֹ עִמָּךְ וְהֶחֱזַקְתָּ בּוֹ גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב וָחַי עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ וּמָטָה יָדוֹ עִמָּךְ וְהֶחֱזַקְתָּ בּוֹ גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב וָחַי עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
“And when your brother will be low so that his hand is
slipping with you, then you shall take hold of him—an
alien and a visitor—and he shall live with you.

translation.text: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.

verses.english:
“And when your brother will be low so that his hand is
slipping with you, then you shall take hold of him—an
alien and a visitor—and he shall live with you.
