verses.hebrew: אַל תִּקַּח מֵאִתּוֹ נֶשֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּית וְיָרֵאתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶיךָ וְחֵי אָחִיךָ עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: אַל תִּקַּח מֵאִתּוֹ נֶשֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּית וְיָרֵאתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶיךָ וְחֵי אָחִיךָ עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
Do not take interest or a charge from him; but you shall
fear your God, and your brother will live with you.

translation.text: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.

verses.english:
Do not take interest or a charge from him; but you shall
fear your God, and your brother will live with you.

verses.hebrew: אֶת כַּסְפְּךָ לֹא תִתֵּן לוֹ בְּנֶשֶׁךְ וּבְמַרְבִּית לֹא תִתֵּן אכְלֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אֶת כַּסְפְּךָ לֹא תִתֵּן לוֹ בְּנֶשֶׁךְ וּבְמַרְבִּית לֹא תִתֵּן אכְלֶךָ׃

english.text:
You shall not give him your money for interest, and you
shall not give him your food for a charge.

translation.text: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.

verses.english:
You shall not give him your money for interest, and you
shall not give him your food for a charge.

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לָתֵת לָכֶם אֶת אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לָתֵת לָכֶם אֶת אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃

english.text:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt to give you the land of Canaan, to be God to you.

translation.text: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

verses.english:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt to give you the land of Canaan, to be God to you.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ עִמָּךְ וְנִמְכַּר לָךְ לֹא תַעֲבֹד בּוֹ עֲבֹדַת עָבֶד׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ עִמָּךְ וְנִמְכַּר לָךְ לֹא תַעֲבֹד בּוֹ עֲבֹדַת עָבֶד׃

english.text:
“And when your brother will be low with you so that he is
sold to you, you shall not have him work a slave’s work.

translation.text: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:

verses.english:
“And when your brother will be low with you so that he is
sold to you, you shall not have him work a slave’s work.

verses.hebrew: כְּשָׂכִיר כְּתוֹשָׁב יִהְיֶה עִמָּךְ עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל יַעֲבֹד עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: כְּשָׂכִיר כְּתוֹשָׁב יִהְיֶה עִמָּךְ עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל יַעֲבֹד עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
He shall be like an employee, like a visitor, with you. He
shall work with you until the jubilee year.

translation.text: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile.

verses.english:
He shall be like an employee, like a visitor, with you. He
shall work with you until the jubilee year.

verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא מֵעִמָּךְ הוּא וּבָנָיו עִמּוֹ וְשָׁב אֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ וְאֶל אֲחֻזַּת אֲבֹתָיו יָשׁוּב׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצָא מֵעִמָּךְ הוּא וּבָנָיו עִמּוֹ וְשָׁב אֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ וְאֶל אֲחֻזַּת אֲבֹתָיו יָשׁוּב׃

english.text:
And he shall go out from you, he and his children with
him, and go back to his family, and he shall go back to
his fathers’ possession.

translation.text: And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.

verses.english:
And he shall go out from you, he and his children with
him, and go back to his family, and he shall go back to
his fathers’ possession.

verses.hebrew: כִּי עֲבָדַי הֵם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לֹא יִמָּכְרוּ מִמְכֶּרֶת עָבֶד׃

hebrew.text: כִּי עֲבָדַי הֵם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לֹא יִמָּכְרוּ מִמְכֶּרֶת עָבֶד׃

english.text:
Because they are my servants, whom I brought out from the
land of Egypt; they shall not be sold like the sale of a
slave.

translation.text: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.

verses.english:
Because they are my servants, whom I brought out from the
land of Egypt; they shall not be sold like the sale of a
slave.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִרְדֶּה בוֹ בְּפָרֶךְ וְיָרֵאתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִרְדֶּה בוֹ בְּפָרֶךְ וְיָרֵאתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
You shall not dominate him with harshness, but you shall
fear your God.

translation.text: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.

verses.english:
You shall not dominate him with harshness, but you shall
fear your God.

verses.hebrew: וְעַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתְךָ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיוּ לָךְ מֵאֵת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵיכֶם מֵהֶם תִּקְנוּ עֶבֶד וְאָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתְךָ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיוּ לָךְ מֵאֵת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵיכֶם מֵהֶם תִּקְנוּ עֶבֶד וְאָמָה׃

english.text:
“And your slave and your maid that you will have: from the
nations that are around you, you shall buy a slave or a
maid from them.

translation.text: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.

verses.english:
“And your slave and your maid that you will have: from the
nations that are around you, you shall buy a slave or a
maid from them.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם מִבְּנֵי הַתּוֹשָׁבִים הַגָּרִים עִמָּכֶם מֵהֶם תִּקְנוּ וּמִמִּשְׁפַּחְתָּם אֲשֶׁר עִמָּכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹלִידוּ בְּאַרְצְכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לַאֲחֻזָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם מִבְּנֵי הַתּוֹשָׁבִים הַגָּרִים עִמָּכֶם מֵהֶם תִּקְנוּ וּמִמִּשְׁפַּחְתָּם אֲשֶׁר עִמָּכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹלִידוּ בְּאַרְצְכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לַאֲחֻזָּה׃

english.text:
And also from the children of the visitors who reside with
you—you shall buy from them and from their families that
are with you—to whom they gave birth in your land. And
they shall become a possession for you.

translation.text: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.

verses.english:
And also from the children of the visitors who reside with
you—you shall buy from them and from their families that
are with you—to whom they gave birth in your land. And
they shall become a possession for you.

verses.hebrew: וְהִתְנַחַלְתֶּם אֹתָם לִבְנֵיכֶם אַחֲרֵיכֶם לָרֶשֶׁת אֲחֻזָּה לְעֹלָם בָּהֶם תַּעֲבֹדוּ וּבְאַחֵיכֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ בְּאָחִיו לֹא תִרְדֶּה בוֹ בְּפָרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִתְנַחַלְתֶּם אֹתָם לִבְנֵיכֶם אַחֲרֵיכֶם לָרֶשֶׁת אֲחֻזָּה לְעֹלָם בָּהֶם תַּעֲבֹדוּ וּבְאַחֵיכֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ בְּאָחִיו לֹא תִרְדֶּה בוֹ בְּפָרֶךְ׃

english.text:
And you shall make them a legacy for your children after
you to inherit as a possession. You may have them work
forever, but as for your brothers, the children of
Israel—a man toward his brother—you shall not dominate him
with harshness.

translation.text: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.

verses.english:
And you shall make them a legacy for your children after
you to inherit as a possession. You may have them work
forever, but as for your brothers, the children of
Israel—a man toward his brother—you shall not dominate him
with harshness.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי תַשִּׂיג יַד גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב עִמָּךְ וּמָךְ אָחִיךָ עִמּוֹ וְנִמְכַּר לְגֵר תּוֹשָׁב עִמָּךְ אוֹ לְעֵקֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת גֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תַשִּׂיג יַד גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב עִמָּךְ וּמָךְ אָחִיךָ עִמּוֹ וְנִמְכַּר לְגֵר תּוֹשָׁב עִמָּךְ אוֹ לְעֵקֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת גֵּר׃

english.text:
“And if the hand of an alien and visitor with you will
attain it, and your brother is low with him and is sold to
the alien and visitor with you or to an offshoot of an
alien’s family,

translation.text: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger’s family:

verses.english:
“And if the hand of an alien and visitor with you will
attain it, and your brother is low with him and is sold to
the alien and visitor with you or to an offshoot of an
alien’s family,

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרֵי נִמְכַּר גְּאֻלָּה תִּהְיֶה לּוֹ אֶחָד מֵאֶחָיו יִגְאָלֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: אַחֲרֵי נִמְכַּר גְּאֻלָּה תִּהְיֶה לּוֹ אֶחָד מֵאֶחָיו יִגְאָלֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
after he is sold he shall have redemption. One of his
brothers shall redeem him,

translation.text: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:

verses.english:
after he is sold he shall have redemption. One of his
brothers shall redeem him,

verses.hebrew: אוֹ דֹדוֹ אוֹ בֶן דֹּדוֹ יִגְאָלֶנּוּ אוֹ מִשְּׁאֵר בְּשָׂרוֹ מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ יִגְאָלֶנּוּ אוֹ הִשִּׂיגָה יָדוֹ וְנִגְאָל׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ דֹדוֹ אוֹ בֶן דֹּדוֹ יִגְאָלֶנּוּ אוֹ מִשְּׁאֵר בְּשָׂרוֹ מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ יִגְאָלֶנּוּ אוֹ הִשִּׂיגָה יָדוֹ וְנִגְאָל׃

english.text:
or his uncle or his uncle’s son shall redeem him, or some
close relative of his from his family shall redeem him; or
if his hand can attain it then he can redeem himself.

translation.text: Either his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.

verses.english:
or his uncle or his uncle’s son shall redeem him, or some
close relative of his from his family shall redeem him; or
if his hand can attain it then he can redeem himself.

verses.hebrew: וְחִשַּׁב עִם קֹנֵהוּ מִשְּׁנַת הִמָּכְרוֹ לוֹ עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְהָיָה כֶּסֶף מִמְכָּרוֹ בְּמִסְפַּר שָׁנִים כִּימֵי שָׂכִיר יִהְיֶה עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְחִשַּׁב עִם קֹנֵהוּ מִשְּׁנַת הִמָּכְרוֹ לוֹ עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְהָיָה כֶּסֶף מִמְכָּרוֹ בְּמִסְפַּר שָׁנִים כִּימֵי שָׂכִיר יִהְיֶה עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And he shall figure with the one who buys him: from the
year he was sold to him to the jubilee year; and the price
of his sale shall be by the number of years. It shall be
with him like the days of an employee:

translation.text: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.

verses.english:
And he shall figure with the one who buys him: from the
year he was sold to him to the jubilee year; and the price
of his sale shall be by the number of years. It shall be
with him like the days of an employee:

verses.hebrew: אִם עוֹד רַבּוֹת בַּשָּׁנִים לְפִיהֶן יָשִׁיב גְּאֻלָּתוֹ מִכֶּסֶף מִקְנָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אִם עוֹד רַבּוֹת בַּשָּׁנִים לְפִיהֶן יָשִׁיב גְּאֻלָּתוֹ מִכֶּסֶף מִקְנָתוֹ׃

english.text:
If there are still a great number of years, he shall pay
back his redemption according to them from his purchase
price.

translation.text: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

verses.english:
If there are still a great number of years, he shall pay
back his redemption according to them from his purchase
price.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם מְעַט נִשְׁאַר בַּשָּׁנִים עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְחִשַּׁב לוֹ כְּפִי שָׁנָיו יָשִׁיב אֶת גְּאֻלָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מְעַט נִשְׁאַר בַּשָּׁנִים עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְחִשַּׁב לוֹ כְּפִי שָׁנָיו יָשִׁיב אֶת גְּאֻלָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
And if a small amount of years remain until the jubilee
year, then he shall figure it for him. He shall pay back
his redemption according to his years.

translation.text: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.

verses.english:
And if a small amount of years remain until the jubilee
year, then he shall figure it for him. He shall pay back
his redemption according to his years.

verses.hebrew: כִּשְׂכִיר שָׁנָה בְּשָׁנָה יִהְיֶה עִמּוֹ לֹא יִרְדֶּנּוּ בְּפֶרֶךְ לְעֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּשְׂכִיר שָׁנָה בְּשָׁנָה יִהְיֶה עִמּוֹ לֹא יִרְדֶּנּוּ בְּפֶרֶךְ לְעֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
He shall be with him like a year-by-year employee. He
shall not dominate him with harshness before your eyes.

translation.text: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.

verses.english:
He shall be with him like a year-by-year employee. He
shall not dominate him with harshness before your eyes.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא יִגָּאֵל בְּאֵלֶּה וְיָצָא בִּשְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל הוּא וּבָנָיו עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא יִגָּאֵל בְּאֵלֶּה וְיָצָא בִּשְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל הוּא וּבָנָיו עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And if he will not be redeemed by these, then he shall go
out in the jubilee year, he and his children with him.

translation.text: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.

verses.english:
And if he will not be redeemed by these, then he shall go
out in the jubilee year, he and his children with him.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לִי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדִים עֲבָדַי הֵם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לִי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדִים עֲבָדַי הֵם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
Because the children of Israel are servants to me. They
are my servants, whom I brought out from the land of
Egypt. I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
Because the children of Israel are servants to me. They
are my servants, whom I brought out from the land of
Egypt. I am YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶם אֱלִילִם וּפֶסֶל וּמַצֵּבָה לֹא תָקִימוּ לָכֶם וְאֶבֶן מַשְׂכִּית לֹא תִתְּנוּ בְּאַרְצְכֶם לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת עָלֶיהָ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶם אֱלִילִם וּפֶסֶל וּמַצֵּבָה לֹא תָקִימוּ לָכֶם וְאֶבֶן מַשְׂכִּית לֹא תִתְּנוּ בְּאַרְצְכֶם לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת עָלֶיהָ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“You shall not make idols, and you shall not set up an
image or a pillar, and you shall not put a carved stone in
your land to bow at it, because I am YHWH, your God.

translation.text: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
“You shall not make idols, and you shall not set up an
image or a pillar, and you shall not put a carved stone in
your land to bow at it, because I am YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁי תִּירָאוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁי תִּירָאוּ אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“You shall observe my Sabbaths and fear my sanctuary. I am
YHWH.

translation.text: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
“You shall observe my Sabbaths and fear my sanctuary. I am
YHWH.

verses.hebrew: אִם בְּחֻקֹּתַי תֵּלֵכוּ וְאֶת מִצְוֺתַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: אִם בְּחֻקֹּתַי תֵּלֵכוּ וְאֶת מִצְוֺתַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם׃

english.text:
BY MY LAWS “If you will go by my laws, and if you will
observe my commandments, and you will do them:

translation.text: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

verses.english:
BY MY LAWS “If you will go by my laws, and if you will
observe my commandments, and you will do them:

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי גִשְׁמֵיכֶם בְּעִתָּם וְנָתְנָה הָאָרֶץ יְבוּלָהּ וְעֵץ הַשָּׂדֶה יִתֵּן פִּרְיוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי גִשְׁמֵיכֶם בְּעִתָּם וְנָתְנָה הָאָרֶץ יְבוּלָהּ וְעֵץ הַשָּׂדֶה יִתֵּן פִּרְיוֹ׃

english.text:
then I shall give your rains in their time, and the earth
will give its crop, and the tree of the field will give
its fruit,

translation.text: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

verses.english:
then I shall give your rains in their time, and the earth
will give its crop, and the tree of the field will give
its fruit,

verses.hebrew: וְהִשִּׂיג לָכֶם דַּיִשׁ אֶת בָּצִיר וּבָצִיר יַשִּׂיג אֶת זָרַע וַאֲכַלְתֶּם לַחְמְכֶם לָשֹׂבַע וִישַׁבְתֶּם לָבֶטַח בְּאַרְצְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִשִּׂיג לָכֶם דַּיִשׁ אֶת בָּצִיר וּבָצִיר יַשִּׂיג אֶת זָרַע וַאֲכַלְתֶּם לַחְמְכֶם לָשֹׂבַע וִישַׁבְתֶּם לָבֶטַח בְּאַרְצְכֶם׃

english.text:
and threshing will extend to vintage for you, and vintage
will extend to seeding, and you will eat your bread to the
full, and you will live in security in your land,

translation.text: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

verses.english:
and threshing will extend to vintage for you, and vintage
will extend to seeding, and you will eat your bread to the
full, and you will live in security in your land,

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי שָׁלוֹם בָּאָרֶץ וּשְׁכַבְתֶּם וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי חַיָּה רָעָה מִן הָאָרֶץ וְחֶרֶב לֹא תַעֲבֹר בְּאַרְצְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי שָׁלוֹם בָּאָרֶץ וּשְׁכַבְתֶּם וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי חַיָּה רָעָה מִן הָאָרֶץ וְחֶרֶב לֹא תַעֲבֹר בְּאַרְצְכֶם׃

english.text:
and I shall give peace in the land, and you will lie down
with no one making you afraid, and I shall make wild
animals cease from the land, and a sword will not pass
through your land,

translation.text: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

verses.english:
and I shall give peace in the land, and you will lie down
with no one making you afraid, and I shall make wild
animals cease from the land, and a sword will not pass
through your land,

verses.hebrew: וּרְדַפְתֶּם אֶת אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְנָפְלוּ לִפְנֵיכֶם לֶחָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וּרְדַפְתֶּם אֶת אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְנָפְלוּ לִפְנֵיכֶם לֶחָרֶב׃

english.text:
and you will chase your enemies, and they will fall in
front of you by the sword,

translation.text: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

verses.english:
and you will chase your enemies, and they will fall in
front of you by the sword,

verses.hebrew: וְרָדְפוּ מִכֶּם חֲמִשָּׁה מֵאָה וּמֵאָה מִכֶּם רְבָבָה יִרְדֹּפוּ וְנָפְלוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶם לִפְנֵיכֶם לֶחָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְרָדְפוּ מִכֶּם חֲמִשָּׁה מֵאָה וּמֵאָה מִכֶּם רְבָבָה יִרְדֹּפוּ וְנָפְלוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶם לִפְנֵיכֶם לֶחָרֶב׃

english.text:
and five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you
will chase ten thousand, and your enemies will fall in
front of you by the sword,

translation.text: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

verses.english:
and five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you
will chase ten thousand, and your enemies will fall in
front of you by the sword,

verses.hebrew: וּפָנִיתִי אֲלֵיכֶם וְהִפְרֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם וְהִרְבֵּיתִי אֶתְכֶם וַהֲקִימֹתִי אֶת בְּרִיתִי אִתְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּפָנִיתִי אֲלֵיכֶם וְהִפְרֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם וְהִרְבֵּיתִי אֶתְכֶם וַהֲקִימֹתִי אֶת בְּרִיתִי אִתְּכֶם׃

english.text:
and I shall turn to you, and I shall make you fruitful and
make you multiply, and I shall establish my covenant with
you,

translation.text: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.

verses.english:
and I shall turn to you, and I shall make you fruitful and
make you multiply, and I shall establish my covenant with
you,

verses.hebrew: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם יָשָׁן נוֹשָׁן וְיָשָׁן מִפְּנֵי חָדָשׁ תּוֹצִיאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם יָשָׁן נוֹשָׁן וְיָשָׁן מִפְּנֵי חָדָשׁ תּוֹצִיאוּ׃

english.text:
and you will eat the oldest of the old, and you will take
out the old because of the new,

translation.text: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.

verses.english:
and you will eat the oldest of the old, and you will take
out the old because of the new,

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי מִשְׁכָּנִי בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְלֹא תִגְעַל נַפְשִׁי אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי מִשְׁכָּנִי בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְלֹא תִגְעַל נַפְשִׁי אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
and I shall put my Tabernacle among you, and my soul will
not scorn you,

translation.text: And I set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.

verses.english:
and I shall put my Tabernacle among you, and my soul will
not scorn you,

verses.hebrew: וְהִתְהַלַּכְתִּי בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְהָיִיתִי לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ לִי לְעָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִתְהַלַּכְתִּי בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְהָיִיתִי לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ לִי לְעָם׃

english.text:
and I shall walk among you, and I shall be God to you, and
you will be a people to me.

translation.text: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.

verses.english:
and I shall walk among you, and I shall be God to you, and
you will be a people to me.

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִהְיֹת לָהֶם עֲבָדִים וָאֶשְׁבֹּר מֹטֹת עֻלְּכֶם וָאוֹלֵךְ אֶתְכֶם קוֹמְמִיּוּת׃

hebrew.text: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִהְיֹת לָהֶם עֲבָדִים וָאֶשְׁבֹּר מֹטֹת עֻלְּכֶם וָאוֹלֵךְ אֶתְכֶם קוֹמְמִיּוּת׃

english.text:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt, from being slaves to them, and I broke the beams of
your yoke and had you go standing tall.

translation.text: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.

verses.english:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt, from being slaves to them, and I broke the beams of
your yoke and had you go standing tall.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֵת כּל הַמִּצְוֺת הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֵת כּל הַמִּצְוֺת הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
“But if you will not listen to me and not do all these
commandments,

translation.text: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;

verses.english:
“But if you will not listen to me and not do all these
commandments,

verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּחֻקֹּתַי תִּמְאָסוּ וְאִם אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי תִּגְעַל נַפְשְׁכֶם לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתַי לְהַפְרְכֶם אֶת בְּרִיתִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּחֻקֹּתַי תִּמְאָסוּ וְאִם אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי תִּגְעַל נַפְשְׁכֶם לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתַי לְהַפְרְכֶם אֶת בְּרִיתִי׃

english.text:
and if you will reject my laws, and if your souls will
scorn my judgments so as not to do all my commandments, so
that you break my covenant,

translation.text: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:

verses.english:
and if you will reject my laws, and if your souls will
scorn my judgments so as not to do all my commandments, so
that you break my covenant,

verses.hebrew: אַף אֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה זֹּאת לָכֶם וְהִפְקַדְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם בֶּהָלָה אֶת הַשַּׁחֶפֶת וְאֶת הַקַּדַּחַת מְכַלּוֹת עֵינַיִם וּמְדִיבֹת נָפֶשׁ וּזְרַעְתֶּם לָרִיק זַרְעֲכֶם וַאֲכָלֻהוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אַף אֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה זֹּאת לָכֶם וְהִפְקַדְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם בֶּהָלָה אֶת הַשַּׁחֶפֶת וְאֶת הַקַּדַּחַת מְכַלּוֹת עֵינַיִם וּמְדִיבֹת נָפֶשׁ וּזְרַעְתֶּם לָרִיק זַרְעֲכֶם וַאֲכָלֻהוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
I, too, I shall do this to you: Then I shall appoint
terror over you with consumption and with fever,
exhausting eyes and grieving the soul, and you will sow
your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it,

translation.text: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

verses.english:
I, too, I shall do this to you: Then I shall appoint
terror over you with consumption and with fever,
exhausting eyes and grieving the soul, and you will sow
your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it,

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי פָנַי בָּכֶם וְנִגַּפְתֶּם לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְרָדוּ בָכֶם שֹׂנְאֵיכֶם וְנַסְתֶּם וְאֵין רֹדֵף אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי פָנַי בָּכֶם וְנִגַּפְתֶּם לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְרָדוּ בָכֶם שֹׂנְאֵיכֶם וְנַסְתֶּם וְאֵין רֹדֵף אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
and I shall set my face against you, and you will be
struck before your enemies, and ones who hate you will
dominate you, and you will flee though no one is pursuing
you.

translation.text: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.

verses.english:
and I shall set my face against you, and you will be
struck before your enemies, and ones who hate you will
dominate you, and you will flee though no one is pursuing
you.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם עַד אֵלֶּה לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וְיָסַפְתִּי לְיַסְּרָה אֶתְכֶם שֶׁבַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם עַד אֵלֶּה לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וְיָסַפְתִּי לְיַסְּרָה אֶתְכֶם שֶׁבַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And if, even after these, you will not listen to me, then
I shall add seven times more to discipline you for your
sins:

translation.text: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

verses.english:
And if, even after these, you will not listen to me, then
I shall add seven times more to discipline you for your
sins:

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁבַרְתִּי אֶת גְּאוֹן עֻזְּכֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת שְׁמֵיכֶם כַּבַּרְזֶל וְאֶת אַרְצְכֶם כַּנְּחֻשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁבַרְתִּי אֶת גְּאוֹן עֻזְּכֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת שְׁמֵיכֶם כַּבַּרְזֶל וְאֶת אַרְצְכֶם כַּנְּחֻשָׁה׃

english.text:
and I shall break your strong pride, and I shall make your
skies like iron and your land like bronze,

translation.text: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:

verses.english:
and I shall break your strong pride, and I shall make your
skies like iron and your land like bronze,

verses.hebrew: וְתַם לָרִיק כֹּחֲכֶם וְלֹא תִתֵּן אַרְצְכֶם אֶת יְבוּלָהּ וְעֵץ הָאָרֶץ לֹא יִתֵּן פִּרְיוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְתַם לָרִיק כֹּחֲכֶם וְלֹא תִתֵּן אַרְצְכֶם אֶת יְבוּלָהּ וְעֵץ הָאָרֶץ לֹא יִתֵּן פִּרְיוֹ׃

english.text:
and your power will be used up in vain, and your land will
not give its crop, and the tree of the land will not give
its fruit.

translation.text: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.

verses.english:
and your power will be used up in vain, and your land will
not give its crop, and the tree of the land will not give
its fruit.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם תֵּלְכוּ עִמִּי קֶרִי וְלֹא תֹאבוּ לִשְׁמֹעַ לִי וְיָסַפְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם מַכָּה שֶׁבַע כְּחַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם תֵּלְכוּ עִמִּי קֶרִי וְלֹא תֹאבוּ לִשְׁמֹעַ לִי וְיָסַפְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם מַכָּה שֶׁבַע כְּחַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And if you will go on with me in defiance and will not be
willing to listen to me, then I shall add seven times more
striking on you, corresponding to your sins:

translation.text: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.

verses.english:
And if you will go on with me in defiance and will not be
willing to listen to me, then I shall add seven times more
striking on you, corresponding to your sins:

verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁלַחְתִּי בָכֶם אֶת חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה וְשִׁכְּלָה אֶתְכֶם וְהִכְרִיתָה אֶת בְּהֶמְתְּכֶם וְהִמְעִיטָה אֶתְכֶם וְנָשַׁמּוּ דַּרְכֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִשְׁלַחְתִּי בָכֶם אֶת חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה וְשִׁכְּלָה אֶתְכֶם וְהִכְרִיתָה אֶת בְּהֶמְתְּכֶם וְהִמְעִיטָה אֶתְכֶם וְנָשַׁמּוּ דַּרְכֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
and I shall let loose the wild animal among you, and it
will bereave you, and it will cut off your cattle, and it
will diminish you, and your roads will be desolated.

translation.text: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.

verses.english:
and I shall let loose the wild animal among you, and it
will bereave you, and it will cut off your cattle, and it
will diminish you, and your roads will be desolated.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּאֵלֶּה לֹא תִוָּסְרוּ לִי וַהֲלַכְתֶּם עִמִּי קֶרִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּאֵלֶּה לֹא תִוָּסְרוּ לִי וַהֲלַכְתֶּם עִמִּי קֶרִי׃

english.text:
And if you will not be disciplined for me by these, and
you will go on with me in defiance,

translation.text: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;

verses.english:
And if you will not be disciplined for me by these, and
you will go on with me in defiance,

verses.hebrew: וְהָלַכְתִּי אַף אֲנִי עִמָּכֶם בְּקֶרִי וְהִכֵּיתִי אֶתְכֶם גַּם אָנִי שֶׁבַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָלַכְתִּי אַף אֲנִי עִמָּכֶם בְּקֶרִי וְהִכֵּיתִי אֶתְכֶם גַּם אָנִי שֶׁבַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
then I shall go on with you, I also, in defiance. And I
shall strike you, I too, seven times more for your sins:

translation.text: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.

verses.english:
then I shall go on with you, I also, in defiance. And I
shall strike you, I too, seven times more for your sins:

verses.hebrew: וְהֵבֵאתִי עֲלֵיכֶם חֶרֶב נֹקֶמֶת נְקַם בְּרִית וְנֶאֱסַפְתֶּם אֶל עָרֵיכֶם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי דֶבֶר בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְנִתַּתֶּם בְּיַד אוֹיֵב׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבֵאתִי עֲלֵיכֶם חֶרֶב נֹקֶמֶת נְקַם בְּרִית וְנֶאֱסַפְתֶּם אֶל עָרֵיכֶם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי דֶבֶר בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְנִתַּתֶּם בְּיַד אוֹיֵב׃

english.text:
and I shall bring a sword over you, requiting covenant
retribution, and you will be gathered to your cities, and
I shall let an epidemic go among you, and you will be put
in your enemy’s hand.

translation.text: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

verses.english:
and I shall bring a sword over you, requiting covenant
retribution, and you will be gathered to your cities, and
I shall let an epidemic go among you, and you will be put
in your enemy’s hand.

verses.hebrew: בְּשִׁבְרִי לָכֶם מַטֵּה לֶחֶם וְאָפוּ עֶשֶׂר נָשִׁים לַחְמְכֶם בְּתַנּוּר אֶחָד וְהֵשִׁיבוּ לַחְמְכֶם בַּמִּשְׁקָל וַאֲכַלְתֶּם וְלֹא תִשְׂבָּעוּ׃

hebrew.text: בְּשִׁבְרִי לָכֶם מַטֵּה לֶחֶם וְאָפוּ עֶשֶׂר נָשִׁים לַחְמְכֶם בְּתַנּוּר אֶחָד וְהֵשִׁיבוּ לַחְמְכֶם בַּמִּשְׁקָל וַאֲכַלְתֶּם וְלֹא תִשְׂבָּעוּ׃

english.text:
When I break the staff of bread for you, then ten women
will bake your bread in one oven, and they will give back
your bread by weight, and you will eat and not be full.

translation.text: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.

verses.english:
When I break the staff of bread for you, then ten women
will bake your bread in one oven, and they will give back
your bread by weight, and you will eat and not be full.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּזֹאת לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וַהֲלַכְתֶּם עִמִּי בְּקֶרִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּזֹאת לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וַהֲלַכְתֶּם עִמִּי בְּקֶרִי׃

english.text:
And if, through this, you will not listen to me, and you
will go on with me in defiance,

translation.text: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;

verses.english:
And if, through this, you will not listen to me, and you
will go on with me in defiance,

verses.hebrew: וְהָלַכְתִּי עִמָּכֶם בַּחֲמַת קֶרִי וְיִסַּרְתִּי אֶתְכֶם אַף אָנִי שֶׁבַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָלַכְתִּי עִמָּכֶם בַּחֲמַת קֶרִי וְיִסַּרְתִּי אֶתְכֶם אַף אָנִי שֶׁבַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
then I shall go on with you in a fury of defiance, and I
shall discipline you, I also, seven times more for your
sins:

translation.text: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.

verses.english:
then I shall go on with you in a fury of defiance, and I
shall discipline you, I also, seven times more for your
sins:

verses.hebrew: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם בְּשַׂר בְּנֵיכֶם וּבְשַׂר בְּנֹתֵיכֶם תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם בְּשַׂר בְּנֵיכֶם וּבְשַׂר בְּנֹתֵיכֶם תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

english.text:
and you will eat your sons’ flesh, and your daughters’
flesh you will eat,

translation.text: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.

verses.english:
and you will eat your sons’ flesh, and your daughters’
flesh you will eat,

verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּי אֶת בָּמֹתֵיכֶם וְהִכְרַתִּי אֶת חַמָּנֵיכֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת פִּגְרֵיכֶם עַל פִּגְרֵי גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם וְגָעֲלָה נַפְשִׁי אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּי אֶת בָּמֹתֵיכֶם וְהִכְרַתִּי אֶת חַמָּנֵיכֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת פִּגְרֵיכֶם עַל פִּגְרֵי גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם וְגָעֲלָה נַפְשִׁי אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
and I shall destroy your high places, and I shall cut off
your incense altars, and I shall put your carcasses on
your idols’ carcasses, and my soul will scorn you,

translation.text: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.

verses.english:
and I shall destroy your high places, and I shall cut off
your incense altars, and I shall put your carcasses on
your idols’ carcasses, and my soul will scorn you,

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת עָרֵיכֶם חרְבָּה וַהֲשִׁמּוֹתִי אֶת מִקְדְּשֵׁיכֶם וְלֹא אָרִיחַ בְּרֵיחַ נִיחֹחֲכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת עָרֵיכֶם חרְבָּה וַהֲשִׁמּוֹתִי אֶת מִקְדְּשֵׁיכֶם וְלֹא אָרִיחַ בְּרֵיחַ נִיחֹחֲכֶם׃

english.text:
and I shall make your cities a ruin, and I shall devastate
your holy places, and I shall not smell your pleasant
smell,

translation.text: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.

verses.english:
and I shall make your cities a ruin, and I shall devastate
your holy places, and I shall not smell your pleasant
smell,

verses.hebrew: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִי אֲנִי אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְשָׁמְמוּ עָלֶיהָ אֹיְבֵיכֶם הַיֹּשְׁבִים בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִי אֲנִי אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְשָׁמְמוּ עָלֶיהָ אֹיְבֵיכֶם הַיֹּשְׁבִים בָּהּ׃

english.text:
and I, I, shall devastate the land, so your enemies who
live in it will be astonished,

translation.text: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.

verses.english:
and I, I, shall devastate the land, so your enemies who
live in it will be astonished,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶתְכֶם אֱזָרֶה בַגּוֹיִם וַהֲרִיקֹתִי אַחֲרֵיכֶם חָרֶב וְהָיְתָה אַרְצְכֶם שְׁמָמָה וְעָרֵיכֶם יִהְיוּ חרְבָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶתְכֶם אֱזָרֶה בַגּוֹיִם וַהֲרִיקֹתִי אַחֲרֵיכֶם חָרֶב וְהָיְתָה אַרְצְכֶם שְׁמָמָה וְעָרֵיכֶם יִהְיוּ חרְבָּה׃

english.text:
and you: I shall scatter among the nations, and I shall
unsheathe my sword after you, and your land will be a
devastation, and your cities will be a ruin.

translation.text: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.

verses.english:
and you: I shall scatter among the nations, and I shall
unsheathe my sword after you, and your land will be a
devastation, and your cities will be a ruin.

verses.hebrew: אָז תִּרְצֶה הָאָרֶץ אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתֶיהָ כֹּל יְמֵי השַּׁמָּה וְאַתֶּם בְּאֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶם אָז תִּשְׁבַּת הָאָרֶץ וְהִרְצָת אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: אָז תִּרְצֶה הָאָרֶץ אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתֶיהָ כֹּל יְמֵי השַּׁמָּה וְאַתֶּם בְּאֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶם אָז תִּשְׁבַּת הָאָרֶץ וְהִרְצָת אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתֶיהָ׃

english.text:
Then the land will accept its Sabbaths: all the days of
devastation, while you are in your enemies’ land. Then the
land will cease and accept its Sabbaths.

translation.text: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies’ land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.

verses.english:
Then the land will accept its Sabbaths: all the days of
devastation, while you are in your enemies’ land. Then the
land will cease and accept its Sabbaths.

verses.hebrew: כּל יְמֵי השַּׁמָּה תִּשְׁבֹּת אֵת אֲשֶׁר לֹא שָׁבְתָה בְּשַׁבְּתֹתֵיכֶם בְּשִׁבְתְּכֶם עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: כּל יְמֵי השַּׁמָּה תִּשְׁבֹּת אֵת אֲשֶׁר לֹא שָׁבְתָה בְּשַׁבְּתֹתֵיכֶם בְּשִׁבְתְּכֶם עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
All the days of the desolation it will cease, the amount
that it did not cease on your Sabbaths when you lived on
it.

translation.text: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.

verses.english:
All the days of the desolation it will cease, the amount
that it did not cease on your Sabbaths when you lived on
it.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִים בָּכֶם וְהֵבֵאתִי מֹרֶךְ בִּלְבָבָם בְּאַרְצֹת אֹיְבֵיהֶם וְרָדַף אֹתָם קוֹל עָלֶה נִדָּף וְנָסוּ מְנֻסַת חֶרֶב וְנָפְלוּ וְאֵין רֹדֵף׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִים בָּכֶם וְהֵבֵאתִי מֹרֶךְ בִּלְבָבָם בְּאַרְצֹת אֹיְבֵיהֶם וְרָדַף אֹתָם קוֹל עָלֶה נִדָּף וְנָסוּ מְנֻסַת חֶרֶב וְנָפְלוּ וְאֵין רֹדֵף׃

english.text:
And those of you who remain: I shall bring faintness in
their hearts in their enemies’ lands, and the sound of a
driven leaf will chase them, and they will flee like the
flight from a sword, and they will fall when there is no
one pursuing,

translation.text: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.

verses.english:
And those of you who remain: I shall bring faintness in
their hearts in their enemies’ lands, and the sound of a
driven leaf will chase them, and they will flee like the
flight from a sword, and they will fall when there is no
one pursuing,

verses.hebrew: וְכָשְׁלוּ אִישׁ בְּאָחִיו כְּמִפְּנֵי חֶרֶב וְרֹדֵף אָיִן וְלֹא תִהְיֶה לָכֶם תְּקוּמָה לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְכָשְׁלוּ אִישׁ בְּאָחִיו כְּמִפְּנֵי חֶרֶב וְרֹדֵף אָיִן וְלֹא תִהְיֶה לָכֶם תְּקוּמָה לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
and they will stumble, each over his brother, as in front
of a sword, when there is no one pursuing, and you will
not have a footing in front of your enemies,

translation.text: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.

verses.english:
and they will stumble, each over his brother, as in front
of a sword, when there is no one pursuing, and you will
not have a footing in front of your enemies,

verses.hebrew: וַאֲבַדְתֶּם בַּגּוֹיִם וְאָכְלָה אֶתְכֶם אֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲבַדְתֶּם בַּגּוֹיִם וְאָכְלָה אֶתְכֶם אֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
and you will perish among the nations, and your enemies’
land will eat you up,

translation.text: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.

verses.english:
and you will perish among the nations, and your enemies’
land will eat you up,

verses.hebrew: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִים בָּכֶם יִמַּקּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָם בְּאַרְצֹת אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְאַף בַּעֲוֺנֹת אֲבֹתָם אִתָּם יִמָּקּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִים בָּכֶם יִמַּקּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָם בְּאַרְצֹת אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְאַף בַּעֲוֺנֹת אֲבֹתָם אִתָּם יִמָּקּוּ׃

english.text:
and those of you who remain will rot for their crime in
your enemies’ lands, and also for their fathers’ crimes
with them they will rot.

translation.text: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

verses.english:
and those of you who remain will rot for their crime in
your enemies’ lands, and also for their fathers’ crimes
with them they will rot.

verses.hebrew: וְהִתְוַדּוּ אֶת עֲוֺנָם וְאֶת עֲוֺן אֲבֹתָם בְּמַעֲלָם אֲשֶׁר מָעֲלוּ בִי וְאַף אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ עִמִּי בְּקֶרִי׃

hebrew.text: וְהִתְוַדּוּ אֶת עֲוֺנָם וְאֶת עֲוֺן אֲבֹתָם בְּמַעֲלָם אֲשֶׁר מָעֲלוּ בִי וְאַף אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ עִמִּי בְּקֶרִי׃

english.text:
“When they will confess their crime and their fathers’
crime for their breach that they made against me, and also
that they went on with me in defiance,

translation.text: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;

verses.english:
“When they will confess their crime and their fathers’
crime for their breach that they made against me, and also
that they went on with me in defiance,

verses.hebrew: אַף אֲנִי אֵלֵךְ עִמָּם בְּקֶרִי וְהֵבֵאתִי אֹתָם בְּאֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶם אוֹ אָז יִכָּנַע לְבָבָם הֶעָרֵל וְאָז יִרְצוּ אֶת עֲוֺנָם׃

hebrew.text: אַף אֲנִי אֵלֵךְ עִמָּם בְּקֶרִי וְהֵבֵאתִי אֹתָם בְּאֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶם אוֹ אָז יִכָּנַע לְבָבָם הֶעָרֵל וְאָז יִרְצוּ אֶת עֲוֺנָם׃

english.text:
so I, I also, would go on with them in defiance, and I
brought them into their enemies’ land; or if then their
uncircumcised heart will be humbled and then they will
accept their crime,

translation.text: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:

verses.english:
so I, I also, would go on with them in defiance, and I
brought them into their enemies’ land; or if then their
uncircumcised heart will be humbled and then they will
accept their crime,

verses.hebrew: וְזָכַרְתִּי אֶת בְּרִיתִי יַעֲקוֹב וְאַף אֶת בְּרִיתִי יִצְחָק וְאַף אֶת בְּרִיתִי אַבְרָהָם אֶזְכֹּר וְהָאָרֶץ אֶזְכֹּר׃

hebrew.text: וְזָכַרְתִּי אֶת בְּרִיתִי יַעֲקוֹב וְאַף אֶת בְּרִיתִי יִצְחָק וְאַף אֶת בְּרִיתִי אַבְרָהָם אֶזְכֹּר וְהָאָרֶץ אֶזְכֹּר׃

english.text:
then I shall remember my covenant of Jacob, and I shall
remember also my covenant of Isaac and also my covenant of
Abraham, and I shall remember the land.

translation.text: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.

verses.english:
then I shall remember my covenant of Jacob, and I shall
remember also my covenant of Isaac and also my covenant of
Abraham, and I shall remember the land.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאָרֶץ תֵּעָזֵב מֵהֶם וְתִרֶץ אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתֶיהָ בּהְשַׁמָּה מֵהֶם וְהֵם יִרְצוּ אֶת עֲוֺנָם יַעַן וּבְיַעַן בְּמִשְׁפָּטַי מָאָסוּ וְאֶת חֻקֹּתַי גָּעֲלָה נַפְשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאָרֶץ תֵּעָזֵב מֵהֶם וְתִרֶץ אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתֶיהָ בּהְשַׁמָּה מֵהֶם וְהֵם יִרְצוּ אֶת עֲוֺנָם יַעַן וּבְיַעַן בְּמִשְׁפָּטַי מָאָסוּ וְאֶת חֻקֹּתַי גָּעֲלָה נַפְשָׁם׃

english.text:
And the land will be left from them, and it will accept
its Sabbaths while it is devastated from them, and they
will accept their crime, because and only because they
rejected my judgments and their soul scorned my laws.

translation.text: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.

verses.english:
And the land will be left from them, and it will accept
its Sabbaths while it is devastated from them, and they
will accept their crime, because and only because they
rejected my judgments and their soul scorned my laws.

verses.hebrew: וְאַף גַּם זֹאת בִּהְיוֹתָם בְּאֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶם לֹא מְאַסְתִּים וְלֹא גְעַלְתִּים לְכַלֹּתָם לְהָפֵר בְּרִיתִי אִתָּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַף גַּם זֹאת בִּהְיוֹתָם בְּאֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶם לֹא מְאַסְתִּים וְלֹא גְעַלְתִּים לְכַלֹּתָם לְהָפֵר בְּרִיתִי אִתָּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
“And even despite this, when they were in their enemies’
land I did not reject them and did not scorn them, to
finish them, to break my covenant with them, because I am
YHWH, their God!

translation.text: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the LORD their God.

verses.english:
“And even despite this, when they were in their enemies’
land I did not reject them and did not scorn them, to
finish them, to break my covenant with them, because I am
YHWH, their God!

verses.hebrew: וְזָכַרְתִּי לָהֶם בְּרִית רִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם לִהְיוֹת לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְזָכַרְתִּי לָהֶם בְּרִית רִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם לִהְיוֹת לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
So I shall remember for them the covenant of the first
ones, whom I brought out from the land of Egypt before the
eyes of the nations to be God to them. I am YHWH.”

translation.text: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the LORD.

verses.english:
So I shall remember for them the covenant of the first
ones, whom I brought out from the land of Egypt before the
eyes of the nations to be God to them. I am YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים וְהַתּוֹרֹת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה בֵּינוֹ וּבֵין בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַר סִינַי בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה הַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים וְהַתּוֹרֹת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה בֵּינוֹ וּבֵין בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַר סִינַי בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
These are the laws and the judgments and the instructions
that YHWH gave between Him and the children of Israel in
Mount Sinai by Moses’ hand.

translation.text: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.

verses.english:
These are the laws and the judgments and the instructions
that YHWH gave between Him and the children of Israel in
Mount Sinai by Moses’ hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ כִּי יַפְלִא נֶדֶר בְּעֶרְכְּךָ נְפָשֹׁת לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ כִּי יַפְלִא נֶדֶר בְּעֶרְכְּךָ נְפָשֹׁת לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel. And you shall say to
them: When a man will express a vow by your appraisal of
persons for YHWH,

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the LORD by thy estimation.

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel. And you shall say to
them: When a man will express a vow by your appraisal of
persons for YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ הַזָּכָר מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וְעַד בֶּן שִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ חֲמִשִּׁים שֶׁקֶל כֶּסֶף בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ הַזָּכָר מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וְעַד בֶּן שִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ חֲמִשִּׁים שֶׁקֶל כֶּסֶף בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
then your appraisal shall be: “A male from twenty years
old up to sixty years old: then your appraisal shall be
fifty shekels of silver by the shekel of the Holy.

translation.text: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

verses.english:
then your appraisal shall be: “A male from twenty years
old up to sixty years old: then your appraisal shall be
fifty shekels of silver by the shekel of the Holy.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם נְקֵבָה הִוא וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁקֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם נְקֵבָה הִוא וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁקֶל׃

english.text:
And if it is a female, then your appraisal shall be thirty
shekels.

translation.text: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.

verses.english:
And if it is a female, then your appraisal shall be thirty
shekels.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִבֶּן חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וְעַד בֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ הַזָּכָר עֶשְׂרִים שְׁקָלִים וְלַנְּקֵבָה עֲשֶׂרֶת שְׁקָלִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מִבֶּן חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וְעַד בֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ הַזָּכָר עֶשְׂרִים שְׁקָלִים וְלַנְּקֵבָה עֲשֶׂרֶת שְׁקָלִים׃

english.text:
And if one is from five years old up to twenty years old,
then your appraisal for a male shall be twenty shekels and
for a female ten shekels.

translation.text: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

verses.english:
And if one is from five years old up to twenty years old,
then your appraisal for a male shall be twenty shekels and
for a female ten shekels.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וְעַד בֶּן חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ הַזָּכָר חֲמִשָּׁה שְׁקָלִים כָּסֶף וְלַנְּקֵבָה עֶרְכְּךָ שְׁלֹשֶׁת שְׁקָלִים כָּסֶף׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וְעַד בֶּן חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ הַזָּכָר חֲמִשָּׁה שְׁקָלִים כָּסֶף וְלַנְּקֵבָה עֶרְכְּךָ שְׁלֹשֶׁת שְׁקָלִים כָּסֶף׃

english.text:
And if one is from a month old up to five years old, then
your appraisal for a male shall be five shekels of silver
and your appraisal for a female three shekels.

translation.text: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.

verses.english:
And if one is from a month old up to five years old, then
your appraisal for a male shall be five shekels of silver
and your appraisal for a female three shekels.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִבֶּן שִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה אִם זָכָר וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר שָׁקֶל וְלַנְּקֵבָה עֲשָׂרָה שְׁקָלִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מִבֶּן שִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה אִם זָכָר וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר שָׁקֶל וְלַנְּקֵבָה עֲשָׂרָה שְׁקָלִים׃

english.text:
And if one is from sixty years old and up, if a male then
your appraisal shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female
ten shekels.

translation.text: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

verses.english:
And if one is from sixty years old and up, if a male then
your appraisal shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female
ten shekels.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם מָךְ הוּא מֵעֶרְכֶּךָ וְהֶעֱמִידוֹ לִפְנֵי הַכֹּהֵן וְהֶעֱרִיךְ אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן עַל פִּי אֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יַד הַנֹּדֵר יַעֲרִיכֶנּוּ הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מָךְ הוּא מֵעֶרְכֶּךָ וְהֶעֱמִידוֹ לִפְנֵי הַכֹּהֵן וְהֶעֱרִיךְ אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן עַל פִּי אֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יַד הַנֹּדֵר יַעֲרִיכֶנּוּ הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
And if he is lower than your estimate, then one shall
stand him in front of the priest, and the priest shall
appraise him. The priest shall appraise him on the basis
of what the hand of the one making the vow can attain.

translation.text: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.

verses.english:
And if he is lower than your estimate, then one shall
stand him in front of the priest, and the priest shall
appraise him. The priest shall appraise him on the basis
of what the hand of the one making the vow can attain.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ מִמֶּנָּה קרְבָּן לַיהֹוָה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מִמֶּנּוּ לַיהֹוָה יִהְיֶה קֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ מִמֶּנָּה קרְבָּן לַיהֹוָה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מִמֶּנּוּ לַיהֹוָה יִהְיֶה קֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
“And if it is an animal from which people would bring an
offering to YHWH, everything that he will give of it to
YHWH will be a holy thing.

translation.text: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that any man giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.

verses.english:
“And if it is an animal from which people would bring an
offering to YHWH, everything that he will give of it to
YHWH will be a holy thing.

verses.hebrew: לֹא יַחֲלִיפֶנּוּ וְלֹא יָמִיר אֹתוֹ טוֹב בְּרָע אוֹ רַע בְּטוֹב וְאִם הָמֵר יָמִיר בְּהֵמָה בִּבְהֵמָה וְהָיָה הוּא וּתְמוּרָתוֹ יִהְיֶה קֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יַחֲלִיפֶנּוּ וְלֹא יָמִיר אֹתוֹ טוֹב בְּרָע אוֹ רַע בְּטוֹב וְאִם הָמֵר יָמִיר בְּהֵמָה בִּבְהֵמָה וְהָיָה הוּא וּתְמוּרָתוֹ יִהְיֶה קֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And he shall not exchange it and shall not trade it, good
for bad or bad for good; and if he does trade an animal
for an animal, then both it and the one traded for it
shall be a holy thing.

translation.text: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.

verses.english:
And he shall not exchange it and shall not trade it, good
for bad or bad for good; and if he does trade an animal
for an animal, then both it and the one traded for it
shall be a holy thing.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם כּל בְּהֵמָה טְמֵאָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא יַקְרִיבוּ מִמֶּנָּה קרְבָּן לַיהֹוָה וְהֶעֱמִיד אֶת הַבְּהֵמָה לִפְנֵי הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם כּל בְּהֵמָה טְמֵאָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא יַקְרִיבוּ מִמֶּנָּה קרְבָּן לַיהֹוָה וְהֶעֱמִיד אֶת הַבְּהֵמָה לִפְנֵי הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
And if it is any impure animal, from which people would
not bring an offering to YHWH, then he shall stand the
animal in front of the priest,

translation.text: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:

verses.english:
And if it is any impure animal, from which people would
not bring an offering to YHWH, then he shall stand the
animal in front of the priest,

verses.hebrew: וְהֶעֱרִיךְ הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָהּ בֵּין טוֹב וּבֵין רָע כְּעֶרְכְּךָ הַכֹּהֵן כֵּן יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶעֱרִיךְ הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָהּ בֵּין טוֹב וּבֵין רָע כְּעֶרְכְּךָ הַכֹּהֵן כֵּן יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
and the priest shall appraise it. Whether good or bad:
according to your appraisal by the priest, so it shall be.

translation.text: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.

verses.english:
and the priest shall appraise it. Whether good or bad:
according to your appraisal by the priest, so it shall be.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם גָּאֹל יִגְאָלֶנָּה וְיָסַף חֲמִישִׁתוֹ עַל עֶרְכֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם גָּאֹל יִגְאָלֶנָּה וְיָסַף חֲמִישִׁתוֹ עַל עֶרְכֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And if he will redeem it, then he shall add a fifth of it
to your appraisal.

translation.text: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.

verses.english:
And if he will redeem it, then he shall add a fifth of it
to your appraisal.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי יַקְדִּשׁ אֶת בֵּיתוֹ קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה וְהֶעֱרִיכוֹ הַכֹּהֵן בֵּין טוֹב וּבֵין רָע כַּאֲשֶׁר יַעֲרִיךְ אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן כֵּן יָקוּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יַקְדִּשׁ אֶת בֵּיתוֹ קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה וְהֶעֱרִיכוֹ הַכֹּהֵן בֵּין טוֹב וּבֵין רָע כַּאֲשֶׁר יַעֲרִיךְ אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן כֵּן יָקוּם׃

english.text:
“And when a man will consecrate his house to be a holy
thing to YHWH, then the priest shall appraise it. Whether
good or bad: as the priest will appraise it, so it shall
stand.

translation.text: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.

verses.english:
“And when a man will consecrate his house to be a holy
thing to YHWH, then the priest shall appraise it. Whether
good or bad: as the priest will appraise it, so it shall
stand.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם הַמַּקְדִּישׁ יִגְאַל אֶת בֵּיתוֹ וְיָסַף חֲמִישִׁית כֶּסֶף עֶרְכְּךָ עָלָיו וְהָיָה לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם הַמַּקְדִּישׁ יִגְאַל אֶת בֵּיתוֹ וְיָסַף חֲמִישִׁית כֶּסֶף עֶרְכְּךָ עָלָיו וְהָיָה לוֹ׃

english.text:
And if the one who consecrates it will redeem his house,
then he shall add a fifth of the money of your appraisal
to it, and it shall be his.

translation.text: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.

verses.english:
And if the one who consecrates it will redeem his house,
then he shall add a fifth of the money of your appraisal
to it, and it shall be his.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִשְּׂדֵה אֲחֻזָּתוֹ יַקְדִּישׁ אִישׁ לַיהֹוָה וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ לְפִי זַרְעוֹ זֶרַע חֹמֶר שְׂעֹרִים בַּחֲמִשִּׁים שֶׁקֶל כָּסֶף׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם מִשְּׂדֵה אֲחֻזָּתוֹ יַקְדִּישׁ אִישׁ לַיהֹוָה וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ לְפִי זַרְעוֹ זֶרַע חֹמֶר שְׂעֹרִים בַּחֲמִשִּׁים שֶׁקֶל כָּסֶף׃

english.text:
“And if a man will consecrate any of a field of his
possession to YHWH, then your appraisal shall be on the
basis of its seed: the seed of a homer of barley at fifty
shekels of silver.

translation.text: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

verses.english:
“And if a man will consecrate any of a field of his
possession to YHWH, then your appraisal shall be on the
basis of its seed: the seed of a homer of barley at fifty
shekels of silver.

verses.hebrew: אִם מִשְּׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל יַקְדִּישׁ שָׂדֵהוּ כְּעֶרְכְּךָ יָקוּם׃

hebrew.text: אִם מִשְּׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל יַקְדִּישׁ שָׂדֵהוּ כְּעֶרְכְּךָ יָקוּם׃

english.text:
If he will consecrate his field from the jubilee year, it
shall stand according to your appraisal;

translation.text: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.

verses.english:
If he will consecrate his field from the jubilee year, it
shall stand according to your appraisal;

verses.hebrew: וְאִם אַחַר הַיֹּבֵל יַקְדִּישׁ שָׂדֵהוּ וְחִשַּׁב לוֹ הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַכֶּסֶף עַל פִּי הַשָּׁנִים הַנּוֹתָרֹת עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְנִגְרַע מֵעֶרְכֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם אַחַר הַיֹּבֵל יַקְדִּישׁ שָׂדֵהוּ וְחִשַּׁב לוֹ הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַכֶּסֶף עַל פִּי הַשָּׁנִים הַנּוֹתָרֹת עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְנִגְרַע מֵעֶרְכֶּךָ׃

english.text:
and if he will consecrate his field after the jubilee,
then the priest shall figure the money for him on the
basis of the years that are left until the jubilee year,
and it shall be subtracted from your appraisal.

translation.text: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.

verses.english:
and if he will consecrate his field after the jubilee,
then the priest shall figure the money for him on the
basis of the years that are left until the jubilee year,
and it shall be subtracted from your appraisal.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם גָּאֹל יִגְאַל אֶת הַשָּׂדֶה הַמַּקְדִּישׁ אֹתוֹ וְיָסַף חֲמִשִׁית כֶּסֶף עֶרְכְּךָ עָלָיו וְקָם לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם גָּאֹל יִגְאַל אֶת הַשָּׂדֶה הַמַּקְדִּישׁ אֹתוֹ וְיָסַף חֲמִשִׁית כֶּסֶף עֶרְכְּךָ עָלָיו וְקָם לוֹ׃

english.text:
And if the one who consecrates it will redeem the field,
then he shall add a fifth of the money of your appraisal
to it, and it will stand as his.

translation.text: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.

verses.english:
And if the one who consecrates it will redeem the field,
then he shall add a fifth of the money of your appraisal
to it, and it will stand as his.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא יִגְאַל אֶת הַשָּׂדֶה וְאִם מָכַר אֶת הַשָּׂדֶה לְאִישׁ אַחֵר לֹא יִגָּאֵל עוֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא יִגְאַל אֶת הַשָּׂדֶה וְאִם מָכַר אֶת הַשָּׂדֶה לְאִישׁ אַחֵר לֹא יִגָּאֵל עוֹד׃

english.text:
And if he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the
field to another man, it shall not be redeemed anymore.

translation.text: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.

verses.english:
And if he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the
field to another man, it shall not be redeemed anymore.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַשָּׂדֶה בְּצֵאתוֹ בַיֹּבֵל קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה כִּשְׂדֵה הַחֵרֶם לַכֹּהֵן תִּהְיֶה אֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הַשָּׂדֶה בְּצֵאתוֹ בַיֹּבֵל קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה כִּשְׂדֵה הַחֵרֶם לַכֹּהֵן תִּהְיֶה אֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
And when it goes out in the jubilee, the field shall be a
holy thing to YHWH, like a devoted field; his possession
shall be the priest’s.

translation.text: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest’s.

verses.english:
And when it goes out in the jubilee, the field shall be a
holy thing to YHWH, like a devoted field; his possession
shall be the priest’s.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם אֶת שְׂדֵה מִקְנָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר לֹא מִשְּׂדֵה אֲחֻזָּתוֹ יַקְדִּישׁ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם אֶת שְׂדֵה מִקְנָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר לֹא מִשְּׂדֵה אֲחֻזָּתוֹ יַקְדִּישׁ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“And if he will consecrate any of a field that he has
bought, that is not from a field of his possession, to
YHWH,

translation.text: And if a man sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;

verses.english:
“And if he will consecrate any of a field that he has
bought, that is not from a field of his possession, to
YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וְחִשַּׁב לוֹ הַכֹּהֵן אֵת מִכְסַת הָעֶרְכְּךָ עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְנָתַן אֶת הָעֶרְכְּךָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְחִשַּׁב לוֹ הַכֹּהֵן אֵת מִכְסַת הָעֶרְכְּךָ עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְנָתַן אֶת הָעֶרְכְּךָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
then the priest shall figure for him the count of your
appraisal up to the jubilee year, and he shall give your
appraisal on that day, a holy thing to YHWH.

translation.text: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the LORD.

verses.english:
then the priest shall figure for him the count of your
appraisal up to the jubilee year, and he shall give your
appraisal on that day, a holy thing to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל יָשׁוּב הַשָּׂדֶה לַאֲשֶׁר קָנָהוּ מֵאִתּוֹ לַאֲשֶׁר לוֹ אֲחֻזַּת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל יָשׁוּב הַשָּׂדֶה לַאֲשֶׁר קָנָהוּ מֵאִתּוֹ לַאֲשֶׁר לוֹ אֲחֻזַּת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
In the jubilee year the field shall go back to the one
from whom it was bought, to the one to whom the possession
of the land belongs.

translation.text: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.

verses.english:
In the jubilee year the field shall go back to the one
from whom it was bought, to the one to whom the possession
of the land belongs.

verses.hebrew: וְכל עֶרְכְּךָ יִהְיֶה בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִים גֵּרָה יִהְיֶה הַשָּׁקֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְכל עֶרְכְּךָ יִהְיֶה בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִים גֵּרָה יִהְיֶה הַשָּׁקֶל׃

english.text:
And all of your appraisal shall be by the shekel of the
Holy. (The shekel shall be twenty gerah.)

translation.text: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.

verses.english:
And all of your appraisal shall be by the shekel of the
Holy. (The shekel shall be twenty gerah.)

verses.hebrew: אַךְ בְּכוֹר אֲשֶׁר יְבֻכַּר לַיהֹוָה בִּבְהֵמָה לֹא יַקְדִּישׁ אִישׁ אֹתוֹ אִם שׁוֹר אִם שֶׂה לַיהֹוָה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ בְּכוֹר אֲשֶׁר יְבֻכַּר לַיהֹוָה בִּבְהֵמָה לֹא יַקְדִּישׁ אִישׁ אֹתוֹ אִם שׁוֹר אִם שֶׂה לַיהֹוָה הוּא׃

english.text:
“Except: a firstling of the animals—which as a firstling
is committed to YHWH—no man shall consecrate it. Whether
an ox or a sheep, it is YHWH’s.

translation.text: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD’s firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the LORD’s.

verses.english:
“Except: a firstling of the animals—which as a firstling
is committed to YHWH—no man shall consecrate it. Whether
an ox or a sheep, it is YHWH’s.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם בַּבְּהֵמָה הַטְּמֵאָה וּפָדָה בְעֶרְכֶּךָ וְיָסַף חֲמִשִׁתוֹ עָלָיו וְאִם לֹא יִגָּאֵל וְנִמְכַּר בְּעֶרְכֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בַּבְּהֵמָה הַטְּמֵאָה וּפָדָה בְעֶרְכֶּךָ וְיָסַף חֲמִשִׁתוֹ עָלָיו וְאִם לֹא יִגָּאֵל וְנִמְכַּר בְּעֶרְכֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And if it is of the impure animals, then he shall redeem
it at your appraisal, and he shall add to it a fifth of
it. And if it will not be redeemed then it shall be sold
at your appraisal.

translation.text: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.

verses.english:
And if it is of the impure animals, then he shall redeem
it at your appraisal, and he shall add to it a fifth of
it. And if it will not be redeemed then it shall be sold
at your appraisal.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ כּל חֵרֶם אֲשֶׁר יַחֲרִם אִישׁ לַיהֹוָה מִכּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ מֵאָדָם וּבְהֵמָה וּמִשְּׂדֵה אֲחֻזָּתוֹ לֹא יִמָּכֵר וְלֹא יִגָּאֵל כּל חֵרֶם קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ כּל חֵרֶם אֲשֶׁר יַחֲרִם אִישׁ לַיהֹוָה מִכּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ מֵאָדָם וּבְהֵמָה וּמִשְּׂדֵה אֲחֻזָּתוֹ לֹא יִמָּכֵר וְלֹא יִגָּאֵל כּל חֵרֶם קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Except: any devoted thing that a man will devote to YHWH
from anything that he has—from human or animal or from a
field of his possession—shall not be sold and shall not be
redeemed. Any devoted thing: it is a holy of holies to
YHWH.

translation.text: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the LORD.

verses.english:
“Except: any devoted thing that a man will devote to YHWH
from anything that he has—from human or animal or from a
field of his possession—shall not be sold and shall not be
redeemed. Any devoted thing: it is a holy of holies to
YHWH.

verses.hebrew: כּל חֵרֶם אֲשֶׁר יחֳרַם מִן הָאָדָם לֹא יִפָּדֶה מוֹת יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: כּל חֵרֶם אֲשֶׁר יחֳרַם מִן הָאָדָם לֹא יִפָּדֶה מוֹת יוּמָת׃

english.text:
Anyone who will be devoted from humans shall not be
redeemed. He shall be put to death.

translation.text: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.

verses.english:
Anyone who will be devoted from humans shall not be
redeemed. He shall be put to death.

verses.hebrew: וְכל מַעְשַׂר הָאָרֶץ מִזֶּרַע הָאָרֶץ מִפְּרִי הָעֵץ לַיהֹוָה הוּא קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכל מַעְשַׂר הָאָרֶץ מִזֶּרַע הָאָרֶץ מִפְּרִי הָעֵץ לַיהֹוָה הוּא קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“And all the tithe of the land, from the land’s seed, from
the tree’s fruit: it is YHWH’s, a holy thing to YHWH.

translation.text: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD’s: it is holy unto the LORD.

verses.english:
“And all the tithe of the land, from the land’s seed, from
the tree’s fruit: it is YHWH’s, a holy thing to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם גָּאֹל יִגְאַל אִישׁ מִמַּעַשְׂרוֹ חֲמִשִׁיתוֹ יֹסֵף עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם גָּאֹל יִגְאַל אִישׁ מִמַּעַשְׂרוֹ חֲמִשִׁיתוֹ יֹסֵף עָלָיו׃

english.text:
And if a man will redeem some of his tithe, he shall add
to it a fifth of it.

translation.text: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.

verses.english:
And if a man will redeem some of his tithe, he shall add
to it a fifth of it.

verses.hebrew: וְכל מַעְשַׂר בָּקָר וָצֹאן כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲבֹר תַּחַת הַשָּׁבֶט הָעֲשִׂירִי יִהְיֶה קֹּדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכל מַעְשַׂר בָּקָר וָצֹאן כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲבֹר תַּחַת הַשָּׁבֶט הָעֲשִׂירִי יִהְיֶה קֹּדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And all the tithe of a herd or a flock, everything that
passes under the rod: the tenth shall be a holy thing to
YHWH.

translation.text: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And all the tithe of a herd or a flock, everything that
passes under the rod: the tenth shall be a holy thing to
YHWH.

verses.hebrew: לֹא יְבַקֵּר בֵּין טוֹב לָרַע וְלֹא יְמִירֶנּוּ וְאִם הָמֵר יְמִירֶנּוּ וְהָיָה הוּא וּתְמוּרָתוֹ יִהְיֶה קֹּדֶשׁ לֹא יִגָּאֵל׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יְבַקֵּר בֵּין טוֹב לָרַע וְלֹא יְמִירֶנּוּ וְאִם הָמֵר יְמִירֶנּוּ וְהָיָה הוּא וּתְמוּרָתוֹ יִהְיֶה קֹּדֶשׁ לֹא יִגָּאֵל׃

english.text:
He shall not inspect it either for good or for bad. And he
shall not trade it. And if he will trade it, then both it
and the one traded for it shall be a holy thing. It shall
not be redeemed.”

translation.text: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

verses.english:
He shall not inspect it either for good or for bad. And he
shall not trade it. And if he will trade it, then both it
and the one traded for it shall be a holy thing. It shall
not be redeemed.”

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַמִּצְוֺת אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַר סִינָי׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה הַמִּצְוֺת אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַר סִינָי׃

english.text:
These are the commandments that YHWH commanded Moses for
the children of Israel in Mount Sinai.

translation.text: These are the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.

verses.english:
These are the commandments that YHWH commanded Moses for
the children of Israel in Mount Sinai.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינַי בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי בַּשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית לְצֵאתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינַי בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי בַּשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית לְצֵאתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And YHWH spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai in the
Tent of Meeting on the first day of the second month in
the second year of their exodus from the land of Egypt,
saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.english:
And YHWH spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai in the
Tent of Meeting on the first day of the second month in
the second year of their exodus from the land of Egypt,
saying,

verses.hebrew: שְׂאוּ אֶת רֹאשׁ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמוֹת כּל זָכָר לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: שְׂאוּ אֶת רֹאשׁ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמוֹת כּל זָכָר לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָם׃

english.text:
“Add up the heads of all of the congregation of Israel by
their families, by their fathers’ houses, with the number
of names of every male by their heads.

translation.text: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;

verses.english:
“Add up the heads of all of the congregation of Israel by
their families, by their fathers’ houses, with the number
of names of every male by their heads.

verses.hebrew: מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה כּל יֹצֵא צָבָא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל תִּפְקְדוּ אֹתָם לְצִבְאֹתָם אַתָּה וְאַהֲרֹן׃

hebrew.text: מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה כּל יֹצֵא צָבָא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל תִּפְקְדוּ אֹתָם לְצִבְאֹתָם אַתָּה וְאַהֲרֹן׃

english.text:
From twenty years old and up, everyone going out to the
army in Israel: you shall count them by their army units,
you and Aaron.

translation.text: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.

verses.english:
From twenty years old and up, everyone going out to the
army in Israel: you shall count them by their army units,
you and Aaron.

verses.hebrew: וְאִתְּכֶם יִהְיוּ אִישׁ אִישׁ לַמַּטֶּה אִישׁ רֹאשׁ לְבֵית אֲבֹתָיו הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִתְּכֶם יִהְיוּ אִישׁ אִישׁ לַמַּטֶּה אִישׁ רֹאשׁ לְבֵית אֲבֹתָיו הוּא׃

english.text:
“And a man for each tribe shall be with you; each is the
head of his fathers’ house.

translation.text: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.

verses.english:
“And a man for each tribe shall be with you; each is the
head of his fathers’ house.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יַעַמְדוּ אִתְּכֶם לִרְאוּבֵן אֱלִיצוּר בֶּן שְׁדֵיאוּר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יַעַמְדוּ אִתְּכֶם לִרְאוּבֵן אֱלִיצוּר בֶּן שְׁדֵיאוּר׃

english.text:
And these are the names of the men who will stand with
you: For Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur.

translation.text: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.

verses.english:
And these are the names of the men who will stand with
you: For Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur.

verses.hebrew: לְשִׁמְעוֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵל בֶּן צוּרִישַׁדָּי׃

hebrew.text: לְשִׁמְעוֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵל בֶּן צוּרִישַׁדָּי׃

english.text: For Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishadday.

translation.text: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.english: For Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishadday.

verses.hebrew: לִיהוּדָה נַחְשׁוֹן בֶּן עַמִּינָדָב׃

hebrew.text: לִיהוּדָה נַחְשׁוֹן בֶּן עַמִּינָדָב׃

english.text: For Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab.

translation.text: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

verses.english: For Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab.
