Merari whom Moses and Aaron counted by YHWH’s word through
Moses’ hand.

verses.hebrew: כּל הַפְּקֻדִים אֲשֶׁר פָּקַד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּנְשִׂיאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַלְוִיִּם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וּלְבֵית אֲבֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַפְּקֻדִים אֲשֶׁר פָּקַד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּנְשִׂיאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַלְוִיִּם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וּלְבֵית אֲבֹתָם׃

english.text:
All the counts that Moses and Aaron and Israel’s
chieftains made of the Levites by their families and by
their fathers’ house

translation.text: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

verses.english:
All the counts that Moses and Aaron and Israel’s
chieftains made of the Levites by their families and by
their fathers’ house

verses.hebrew: מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה וְעַד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה כּל הַבָּא לַעֲבֹד עֲבֹדַת עֲבֹדָה וַעֲבֹדַת מַשָּׂא בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה וְעַד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה כּל הַבָּא לַעֲבֹד עֲבֹדַת עֲבֹדָה וַעֲבֹדַת מַשָּׂא בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
from thirty years old and up to fifty years old, everyone
who was coming to do the service of work and the service
of carrying in the Tent of Meeting:

translation.text: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.english:
from thirty years old and up to fifty years old, everyone
who was coming to do the service of work and the service
of carrying in the Tent of Meeting:

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ פְּקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁמֹנַת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וּשְׁמֹנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ פְּקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁמֹנַת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וּשְׁמֹנִים׃

english.text: And their counts were eight thousand five hundred eighty.

translation.text: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore,

verses.english: And their counts were eight thousand five hundred eighty.

verses.hebrew: עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה פָּקַד אוֹתָם בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה אִישׁ אִישׁ עַל עֲבֹדָתוֹ וְעַל מַשָּׂאוֹ וּפְקֻדָיו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה פָּקַד אוֹתָם בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה אִישׁ אִישׁ עַל עֲבֹדָתוֹ וְעַל מַשָּׂאוֹ וּפְקֻדָיו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
By YHWH’s word he counted them by Moses’ hand, each man by
his work or by his carrying, and his counts were as YHWH
commanded Moses.

translation.text: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
By YHWH’s word he counted them by Moses’ hand, each man by
his work or by his carrying, and his counts were as YHWH
commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וִישַׁלְּחוּ מִן הַמַּחֲנֶה כּל צָרוּעַ וְכל זָב וְכֹל טָמֵא לָנָפֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וִישַׁלְּחוּ מִן הַמַּחֲנֶה כּל צָרוּעַ וְכל זָב וְכֹל טָמֵא לָנָפֶשׁ׃

english.text:
“Command the children of Israel that they shall have every
leper and everyone who has an emission and everyone who is
impure by a person go from the camp.

translation.text: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:

verses.english:
“Command the children of Israel that they shall have every
leper and everyone who has an emission and everyone who is
impure by a person go from the camp.

verses.hebrew: מִזָּכָר עַד נְקֵבָה תְּשַׁלֵּחוּ אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה תְּשַׁלְּחוּם וְלֹא יְטַמְּאוּ אֶת מַחֲנֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי שֹׁכֵן בְּתוֹכָם׃

hebrew.text: מִזָּכָר עַד נְקֵבָה תְּשַׁלֵּחוּ אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה תְּשַׁלְּחוּם וְלֹא יְטַמְּאוּ אֶת מַחֲנֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי שֹׁכֵן בְּתוֹכָם׃

english.text:
Male or female, you shall have them go; you shall have
them go outside the camp so they will not make their
camps, among which I tent, impure.”

translation.text: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.

verses.english:
Male or female, you shall have them go; you shall have
them go outside the camp so they will not make their
camps, among which I tent, impure.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ אוֹתָם אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ אוֹתָם אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel did so, and they had them go
outside the camp. As YHWH spoke to Moses, so the children
of Israel did.

translation.text: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel did so, and they had them go
outside the camp. As YHWH spoke to Moses, so the children
of Israel did.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּי יַעֲשׂוּ מִכּל חַטֹּאת הָאָדָם לִמְעֹל מַעַל בַּיהֹוָה וְאָשְׁמָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּי יַעֲשׂוּ מִכּל חַטֹּאת הָאָדָם לִמְעֹל מַעַל בַּיהֹוָה וְאָשְׁמָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel: A man or a woman—when
they will do any of the sins of humans, to make a breach
against YHWH—so that person has guilt,

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD, and that person be guilty;

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel: A man or a woman—when
they will do any of the sins of humans, to make a breach
against YHWH—so that person has guilt,

verses.hebrew: וְהִתְוַדּוּ אֶת חַטָּאתָם אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ וְהֵשִׁיב אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וַחֲמִישִׁתוֹ יֹסֵף עָלָיו וְנָתַן לַאֲשֶׁר אָשַׁם לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִתְוַדּוּ אֶת חַטָּאתָם אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ וְהֵשִׁיב אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וַחֲמִישִׁתוֹ יֹסֵף עָלָיו וְנָתַן לַאֲשֶׁר אָשַׁם לוֹ׃

english.text:
then they shall confess their sin that they have done. And
he shall pay back for his guilt with its principal, and he
shall add to it a fifth of it, and he shall give it to the
one whom he wronged.

translation.text: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.

verses.english:
then they shall confess their sin that they have done. And
he shall pay back for his guilt with its principal, and he
shall add to it a fifth of it, and he shall give it to the
one whom he wronged.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם אֵין לָאִישׁ גֹּאֵל לְהָשִׁיב הָאָשָׁם אֵלָיו הָאָשָׁם הַמּוּשָׁב לַיהֹוָה לַכֹּהֵן מִלְּבַד אֵיל הַכִּפֻּרִים אֲשֶׁר יְכַפֶּר בּוֹ עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם אֵין לָאִישׁ גֹּאֵל לְהָשִׁיב הָאָשָׁם אֵלָיו הָאָשָׁם הַמּוּשָׁב לַיהֹוָה לַכֹּהֵן מִלְּבַד אֵיל הַכִּפֻּרִים אֲשֶׁר יְכַפֶּר בּוֹ עָלָיו׃

english.text:
And if the man does not have a redeemer, to pay him back
for the guilt, the guilt that is paid back is YHWH’s, for
the priest, apart from the ram of atonement by which he
will make atonement for him.

translation.text: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD, even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.

verses.english:
And if the man does not have a redeemer, to pay him back
for the guilt, the guilt that is paid back is YHWH’s, for
the priest, apart from the ram of atonement by which he
will make atonement for him.

verses.hebrew: וְכל תְּרוּמָה לְכל קדְשֵׁי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ לַכֹּהֵן לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְכל תְּרוּמָה לְכל קדְשֵׁי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ לַכֹּהֵן לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
And every donation of all the holy things of the children
of Israel that they will bring forward to the priest shall
be his.

translation.text: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.

verses.english:
And every donation of all the holy things of the children
of Israel that they will bring forward to the priest shall
be his.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֶת קֳדָשָׁיו לוֹ יִהְיוּ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן לַכֹּהֵן לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֶת קֳדָשָׁיו לוֹ יִהְיוּ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן לַכֹּהֵן לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
And each man’s holy things shall be his; what each man
gives to the priest shall be his.”

translation.text: And every man’s hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.

verses.english:
And each man’s holy things shall be his; what each man
gives to the priest shall be his.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אִישׁ כִּי תִשְׂטֶה אִשְׁתּוֹ וּמָעֲלָה בוֹ מָעַל׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אִישׁ כִּי תִשְׂטֶה אִשְׁתּוֹ וּמָעֲלָה בוֹ מָעַל׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: Any man whose wife will go astray and will make a
breach of faith with him,

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man’s wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: Any man whose wife will go astray and will make a
breach of faith with him,

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁכַב אִישׁ אֹתָהּ שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע וְנֶעְלַם מֵעֵינֵי אִישָׁהּ וְנִסְתְּרָה וְהִיא נִטְמָאָה וְעֵד אֵין בָּהּ וְהִוא לֹא נִתְפָּשָׂה׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁכַב אִישׁ אֹתָהּ שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע וְנֶעְלַם מֵעֵינֵי אִישָׁהּ וְנִסְתְּרָה וְהִיא נִטְמָאָה וְעֵד אֵין בָּהּ וְהִוא לֹא נִתְפָּשָׂה׃

english.text:
and a man has lain with her—an intercourse of seed—and it
has been hidden from her husband’s eyes, and she has kept
concealed, and she has been made impure, and there is no
witness against her, and she has not been caught,

translation.text: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;

verses.english:
and a man has lain with her—an intercourse of seed—and it
has been hidden from her husband’s eyes, and she has kept
concealed, and she has been made impure, and there is no
witness against her, and she has not been caught,

verses.hebrew: וְעָבַר עָלָיו רוּחַ קִנְאָה וְקִנֵּא אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְהִוא נִטְמָאָה אוֹ עָבַר עָלָיו רוּחַ קִנְאָה וְקִנֵּא אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְהִיא לֹא נִטְמָאָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעָבַר עָלָיו רוּחַ קִנְאָה וְקִנֵּא אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְהִוא נִטְמָאָה אוֹ עָבַר עָלָיו רוּחַ קִנְאָה וְקִנֵּא אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְהִיא לֹא נִטְמָאָה׃

english.text:
and a spirit of jealousy has come over him, and he is
jealous about his wife, and she has been made impure, or a
spirit of jealousy has come over him, and he is jealous
about his wife, and she has not been made impure:

translation.text: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:

verses.english:
and a spirit of jealousy has come over him, and he is
jealous about his wife, and she has been made impure, or a
spirit of jealousy has come over him, and he is jealous
about his wife, and she has not been made impure:

verses.hebrew: וְהֵבִיא הָאִישׁ אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְהֵבִיא אֶת קרְבָּנָהּ עָלֶיהָ עֲשִׂירִת הָאֵיפָה קֶמַח שְׂעֹרִים לֹא יִצֹק עָלָיו שֶׁמֶן וְלֹא יִתֵּן עָלָיו לְבֹנָה כִּי מִנְחַת קְנָאֹת הוּא מִנְחַת זִכָּרוֹן מַזְכֶּרֶת עָוֺן׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵבִיא הָאִישׁ אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְהֵבִיא אֶת קרְבָּנָהּ עָלֶיהָ עֲשִׂירִת הָאֵיפָה קֶמַח שְׂעֹרִים לֹא יִצֹק עָלָיו שֶׁמֶן וְלֹא יִתֵּן עָלָיו לְבֹנָה כִּי מִנְחַת קְנָאֹת הוּא מִנְחַת זִכָּרוֹן מַזְכֶּרֶת עָוֺן׃

english.text:
then the man shall bring his wife to the priest and shall
bring her offering along with her: a tenth of an ephah of
barley flour. He shall not pour oil on it and shall not
put frankincense on it, because it is an offering about
jealousies, an offering of bringing to mind: causing a
crime to be brought to mind.

translation.text: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.

verses.english:
then the man shall bring his wife to the priest and shall
bring her offering along with her: a tenth of an ephah of
barley flour. He shall not pour oil on it and shall not
put frankincense on it, because it is an offering about
jealousies, an offering of bringing to mind: causing a
crime to be brought to mind.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב אֹתָהּ הַכֹּהֵן וְהֶעֱמִדָהּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב אֹתָהּ הַכֹּהֵן וְהֶעֱמִדָהּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“And the priest shall bring her forward and stand her in
front of YHWH.

translation.text: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD:

verses.english:
“And the priest shall bring her forward and stand her in
front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מַיִם קְדֹשִׁים בִּכְלִי חָרֶשׂ וּמִן הֶעָפָר אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בְּקַרְקַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן יִקַּח הַכֹּהֵן וְנָתַן אֶל הַמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מַיִם קְדֹשִׁים בִּכְלִי חָרֶשׂ וּמִן הֶעָפָר אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בְּקַרְקַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן יִקַּח הַכֹּהֵן וְנָתַן אֶל הַמָּיִם׃

english.text:
And the priest shall take holy water in a clay container,
and the priest shall take some of the dust that will be on
the Tabernacle’s floor and put it into the water.

translation.text: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:

verses.english:
And the priest shall take holy water in a clay container,
and the priest shall take some of the dust that will be on
the Tabernacle’s floor and put it into the water.

verses.hebrew: וְהֶעֱמִיד הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הָאִשָּׁה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּפָרַע אֶת רֹאשׁ הָאִשָּׁה וְנָתַן עַל כַּפֶּיהָ אֵת מִנְחַת הַזִּכָּרוֹן מִנְחַת קְנָאֹת הִוא וּבְיַד הַכֹּהֵן יִהְיוּ מֵי הַמָּרִים הַמְאָרְרִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶעֱמִיד הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הָאִשָּׁה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּפָרַע אֶת רֹאשׁ הָאִשָּׁה וְנָתַן עַל כַּפֶּיהָ אֵת מִנְחַת הַזִּכָּרוֹן מִנְחַת קְנָאֹת הִוא וּבְיַד הַכֹּהֵן יִהְיוּ מֵי הַמָּרִים הַמְאָרְרִים׃

english.text:
And the priest shall stand the woman in front of YHWH and
loosen the hair of the woman’s head and put the offering
of bringing to mind on her hands; it is an offering of
jealousies. And in the priest’s hand shall be the bitter
cursing water.

translation.text: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and uncover the woman’s head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:

verses.english:
And the priest shall stand the woman in front of YHWH and
loosen the hair of the woman’s head and put the offering
of bringing to mind on her hands; it is an offering of
jealousies. And in the priest’s hand shall be the bitter
cursing water.

verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁבִּיעַ אֹתָהּ הַכֹּהֵן וְאָמַר אֶל הָאִשָּׁה אִם לֹא שָׁכַב אִישׁ אֹתָךְ וְאִם לֹא שָׂטִית טֻמְאָה תַּחַת אִישֵׁךְ הִנָּקִי מִמֵּי הַמָּרִים הַמְאָרְרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִשְׁבִּיעַ אֹתָהּ הַכֹּהֵן וְאָמַר אֶל הָאִשָּׁה אִם לֹא שָׁכַב אִישׁ אֹתָךְ וְאִם לֹא שָׂטִית טֻמְאָה תַּחַת אִישֵׁךְ הִנָּקִי מִמֵּי הַמָּרִים הַמְאָרְרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
And the priest shall have her swear, and he shall say to
the woman: ‘If a man has not lain with you, and if you
have not gone astray in impurity with someone in place of
your husband, be cleared by this bitter cursing water.

translation.text: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:

verses.english:
And the priest shall have her swear, and he shall say to
the woman: ‘If a man has not lain with you, and if you
have not gone astray in impurity with someone in place of
your husband, be cleared by this bitter cursing water.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתְּ כִּי שָׂטִית תַּחַת אִישֵׁךְ וְכִי נִטְמֵאת וַיִּתֵּן אִישׁ בָּךְ אֶת שְׁכבְתּוֹ מִבַּלְעֲדֵי אִישֵׁךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתְּ כִּי שָׂטִית תַּחַת אִישֵׁךְ וְכִי נִטְמֵאת וַיִּתֵּן אִישׁ בָּךְ אֶת שְׁכבְתּוֹ מִבַּלְעֲדֵי אִישֵׁךְ׃

english.text:
But you, if you have gone astray with someone in place of
your husband and if you have been made impure, and if a
man other than your husband has had his intercourse with
you,’

translation.text: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:

verses.english:
But you, if you have gone astray with someone in place of
your husband and if you have been made impure, and if a
man other than your husband has had his intercourse with
you,’

verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁבִּיעַ הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הָאִשָּׁה בִּשְׁבֻעַת הָאָלָה וְאָמַר הַכֹּהֵן לָאִשָּׁה יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה אוֹתָךְ לְאָלָה וְלִשְׁבֻעָה בְּתוֹךְ עַמֵּךְ בְּתֵת יְהֹוָה אֶת יְרֵכֵךְ נֹפֶלֶת וְאֶת בִּטְנֵךְ צָבָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִשְׁבִּיעַ הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הָאִשָּׁה בִּשְׁבֻעַת הָאָלָה וְאָמַר הַכֹּהֵן לָאִשָּׁה יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה אוֹתָךְ לְאָלָה וְלִשְׁבֻעָה בְּתוֹךְ עַמֵּךְ בְּתֵת יְהֹוָה אֶת יְרֵכֵךְ נֹפֶלֶת וְאֶת בִּטְנֵךְ צָבָה׃

english.text:
then the priest shall have the woman swear a curse oath,
and the priest shall say to the woman, ‘let YHWH make you
a curse and an oath among your people when YHWH sets your
thigh sagging and your womb swelling,

translation.text: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;

verses.english:
then the priest shall have the woman swear a curse oath,
and the priest shall say to the woman, ‘let YHWH make you
a curse and an oath among your people when YHWH sets your
thigh sagging and your womb swelling,

verses.hebrew: וּבָאוּ הַמַּיִם הַמְאָרְרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּמֵעַיִךְ לַצְבּוֹת בֶּטֶן וְלַנְפִּל יָרֵךְ וְאָמְרָה הָאִשָּׁה אָמֵן אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: וּבָאוּ הַמַּיִם הַמְאָרְרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּמֵעַיִךְ לַצְבּוֹת בֶּטֶן וְלַנְפִּל יָרֵךְ וְאָמְרָה הָאִשָּׁה אָמֵן אָמֵן׃

english.text:
and this cursing water will come in your insides, to swell
the womb and make the thigh sag.’ “And the woman shall
say, ‘Amen, amen.’

translation.text: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.

verses.english:
and this cursing water will come in your insides, to swell
the womb and make the thigh sag.’ “And the woman shall
say, ‘Amen, amen.’

verses.hebrew: וְכָתַב אֶת הָאָלֹת הָאֵלֶּה הַכֹּהֵן בַּסֵּפֶר וּמָחָה אֶל מֵי הַמָּרִים׃

hebrew.text: וְכָתַב אֶת הָאָלֹת הָאֵלֶּה הַכֹּהֵן בַּסֵּפֶר וּמָחָה אֶל מֵי הַמָּרִים׃

english.text:
“And the priest shall write these curses in a scroll and
rub them into the bitter water.

translation.text: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:

verses.english:
“And the priest shall write these curses in a scroll and
rub them into the bitter water.

verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁקָה אֶת הָאִשָּׁה אֶת מֵי הַמָּרִים הַמְאָרְרִים וּבָאוּ בָהּ הַמַּיִם הַמְאָרְרִים לְמָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהִשְׁקָה אֶת הָאִשָּׁה אֶת מֵי הַמָּרִים הַמְאָרְרִים וּבָאוּ בָהּ הַמַּיִם הַמְאָרְרִים לְמָרִים׃

english.text:
And he shall have the woman drink the bitter cursing
water, and the bitter cursing water will come into her.

translation.text: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.

verses.english:
And he shall have the woman drink the bitter cursing
water, and the bitter cursing water will come into her.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִיַּד הָאִשָּׁה אֵת מִנְחַת הַקְּנָאֹת וְהֵנִיף אֶת הַמִּנְחָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְהִקְרִיב אֹתָהּ אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִיַּד הָאִשָּׁה אֵת מִנְחַת הַקְּנָאֹת וְהֵנִיף אֶת הַמִּנְחָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְהִקְרִיב אֹתָהּ אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall take the offering of jealousies from
the woman’s hand and elevate the offering in front of
YHWH, and he shall bring her forward to the altar.

translation.text: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:

verses.english:
And the priest shall take the offering of jealousies from
the woman’s hand and elevate the offering in front of
YHWH, and he shall bring her forward to the altar.

verses.hebrew: וְקָמַץ הַכֹּהֵן מִן הַמִּנְחָה אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְאַחַר יַשְׁקֶה אֶת הָאִשָּׁה אֶת הַמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְקָמַץ הַכֹּהֵן מִן הַמִּנְחָה אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְאַחַר יַשְׁקֶה אֶת הָאִשָּׁה אֶת הַמָּיִם׃

english.text:
And the priest shall take a fistful from the grain
offering, a representative portion of it, and burn it to
smoke at the altar, and after that he shall have the woman
drink the water.

translation.text: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.

verses.english:
And the priest shall take a fistful from the grain
offering, a representative portion of it, and burn it to
smoke at the altar, and after that he shall have the woman
drink the water.

verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁקָהּ אֶת הַמַּיִם וְהָיְתָה אִם נִטְמְאָה וַתִּמְעֹל מַעַל בְּאִישָׁהּ וּבָאוּ בָהּ הַמַּיִם הַמְאָרְרִים לְמָרִים וְצָבְתָה בִטְנָהּ וְנָפְלָה יְרֵכָהּ וְהָיְתָה הָאִשָּׁה לְאָלָה בְּקֶרֶב עַמָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִשְׁקָהּ אֶת הַמַּיִם וְהָיְתָה אִם נִטְמְאָה וַתִּמְעֹל מַעַל בְּאִישָׁהּ וּבָאוּ בָהּ הַמַּיִם הַמְאָרְרִים לְמָרִים וְצָבְתָה בִטְנָהּ וְנָפְלָה יְרֵכָהּ וְהָיְתָה הָאִשָּׁה לְאָלָה בְּקֶרֶב עַמָּהּ׃

english.text:
When he has had her drink the water, then it will be, if
she has been made impure and has made a breach of faith
with her husband, when the bitter cursing water will come
into her, and her womb will swell and her thigh will sag,
then the woman will become a curse among her people.

translation.text: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.

verses.english:
When he has had her drink the water, then it will be, if
she has been made impure and has made a breach of faith
with her husband, when the bitter cursing water will come
into her, and her womb will swell and her thigh will sag,
then the woman will become a curse among her people.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא נִטְמְאָה הָאִשָּׁה וּטְהֹרָה הִוא וְנִקְּתָה וְנִזְרְעָה זָרַע׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא נִטְמְאָה הָאִשָּׁה וּטְהֹרָה הִוא וְנִקְּתָה וְנִזְרְעָה זָרַע׃

english.text:
And if the woman has not been made impure, and she is
pure, then she shall be cleared and shall conceive seed.

translation.text: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.

verses.english:
And if the woman has not been made impure, and she is
pure, then she shall be cleared and shall conceive seed.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַקְּנָאֹת אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׂטֶה אִשָּׁה תַּחַת אִישָׁהּ וְנִטְמָאָה׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַקְּנָאֹת אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׂטֶה אִשָּׁה תַּחַת אִישָׁהּ וְנִטְמָאָה׃

english.text:
“This is the instruction for jealousies, when a woman will
go astray with someone in place of her husband and be made
impure,

translation.text: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;

verses.english:
“This is the instruction for jealousies, when a woman will
go astray with someone in place of her husband and be made
impure,

verses.hebrew: אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲבֹר עָלָיו רוּחַ קִנְאָה וְקִנֵּא אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְהֶעֱמִיד אֶת הָאִשָּׁה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְעָשָׂה לָהּ הַכֹּהֵן אֵת כּל הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲבֹר עָלָיו רוּחַ קִנְאָה וְקִנֵּא אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְהֶעֱמִיד אֶת הָאִשָּׁה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְעָשָׂה לָהּ הַכֹּהֵן אֵת כּל הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
or when a spirit of jealousy will come over a man and he
will be jealous about his wife. And the priest shall stand
the woman in front of YHWH and do all of this instruction
to her.

translation.text: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.

verses.english:
or when a spirit of jealousy will come over a man and he
will be jealous about his wife. And the priest shall stand
the woman in front of YHWH and do all of this instruction
to her.

verses.hebrew: וְנִקָּה הָאִישׁ מֵעָוֺן וְהָאִשָּׁה הַהִוא תִּשָּׂא אֶת עֲוֺנָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְנִקָּה הָאִישׁ מֵעָוֺן וְהָאִשָּׁה הַהִוא תִּשָּׂא אֶת עֲוֺנָהּ׃

english.text:
And the man shall be clear of a crime, and that woman
shall bear her crime.”

translation.text: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.

verses.english:
And the man shall be clear of a crime, and that woman
shall bear her crime.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּי יַפְלִא לִנְדֹּר נֶדֶר נָזִיר לְהַזִּיר לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּי יַפְלִא לִנְדֹּר נֶדֶר נָזִיר לְהַזִּיר לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When a man or a woman will expressly make a Nazirite
vow to make a separation for YHWH,

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto the LORD:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When a man or a woman will expressly make a Nazirite
vow to make a separation for YHWH,

verses.hebrew: מִיַּיִן וְשֵׁכָר יַזִּיר חֹמֶץ יַיִן וְחֹמֶץ שֵׁכָר לֹא יִשְׁתֶּה וְכל מִשְׁרַת עֲנָבִים לֹא יִשְׁתֶּה וַעֲנָבִים לַחִים וִיבֵשִׁים לֹא יֹאכֵל׃

hebrew.text: מִיַּיִן וְשֵׁכָר יַזִּיר חֹמֶץ יַיִן וְחֹמֶץ שֵׁכָר לֹא יִשְׁתֶּה וְכל מִשְׁרַת עֲנָבִים לֹא יִשְׁתֶּה וַעֲנָבִים לַחִים וִיבֵשִׁים לֹא יֹאכֵל׃

english.text:
he shall separate from wine and beer; he shall not drink
any vinegar of wine or vinegar of beer, and he shall not
drink any juice of grapes, and he shall not eat fresh or
dried grapes.

translation.text: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.

verses.english:
he shall separate from wine and beer; he shall not drink
any vinegar of wine or vinegar of beer, and he shall not
drink any juice of grapes, and he shall not eat fresh or
dried grapes.

verses.hebrew: כֹּל יְמֵי נִזְרוֹ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה מִגֶּפֶן הַיַּיִן מֵחַרְצַנִּים וְעַד זָג לֹא יֹאכֵל׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל יְמֵי נִזְרוֹ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה מִגֶּפֶן הַיַּיִן מֵחַרְצַנִּים וְעַד זָג לֹא יֹאכֵל׃

english.text:
All the days of his being a Nazirite, he shall not eat
anything that is made from the grapevine, from seeds to
skin.

translation.text: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

verses.english:
All the days of his being a Nazirite, he shall not eat
anything that is made from the grapevine, from seeds to
skin.

verses.hebrew: כּל יְמֵי נֶדֶר נִזְרוֹ תַּעַר לֹא יַעֲבֹר עַל רֹאשׁוֹ עַד מְלֹאת הַיָּמִם אֲשֶׁר יַזִּיר לַיהֹוָה קָדֹשׁ יִהְיֶה גַּדֵּל פֶּרַע שְׂעַר רֹאשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כּל יְמֵי נֶדֶר נִזְרוֹ תַּעַר לֹא יַעֲבֹר עַל רֹאשׁוֹ עַד מְלֹאת הַיָּמִם אֲשֶׁר יַזִּיר לַיהֹוָה קָדֹשׁ יִהְיֶה גַּדֵּל פֶּרַע שְׂעַר רֹאשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
All the days of his Nazirite vow, a razor shall not pass
on his head; until the fulfillment of the days that he
will make a separation for YHWH, he shall be holy, growing
the hair of his head loose.

translation.text: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the LORD, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.

verses.english:
All the days of his Nazirite vow, a razor shall not pass
on his head; until the fulfillment of the days that he
will make a separation for YHWH, he shall be holy, growing
the hair of his head loose.

verses.hebrew: כּל יְמֵי הַזִּירוֹ לַיהֹוָה עַל נֶפֶשׁ מֵת לֹא יָבֹא׃

hebrew.text: כּל יְמֵי הַזִּירוֹ לַיהֹוָה עַל נֶפֶשׁ מֵת לֹא יָבֹא׃

english.text:
All the days of his making a separation for YHWH he shall
not come to a dead person.

translation.text: All the days that he separateth himself unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.

verses.english:
All the days of his making a separation for YHWH he shall
not come to a dead person.

verses.hebrew: לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ לְאָחִיו וּלְאַחֹתוֹ לֹא יִטַּמָּא לָהֶם בְּמֹתָם כִּי נֵזֶר אֱלֹהָיו עַל רֹאשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ לְאָחִיו וּלְאַחֹתוֹ לֹא יִטַּמָּא לָהֶם בְּמֹתָם כִּי נֵזֶר אֱלֹהָיו עַל רֹאשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
For his father and for his mother, for his brother and for
his sister: he shall not become impure for them when they
die, because the crown of his God is on his head.

translation.text: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.

verses.english:
For his father and for his mother, for his brother and for
his sister: he shall not become impure for them when they
die, because the crown of his God is on his head.

verses.hebrew: כֹּל יְמֵי נִזְרוֹ קָדֹשׁ הוּא לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל יְמֵי נִזְרוֹ קָדֹשׁ הוּא לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text: All the days of his being a Nazirite he is holy to YHWH.

translation.text: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the LORD.

verses.english: All the days of his being a Nazirite he is holy to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יָמוּת מֵת עָלָיו בְּפֶתַע פִּתְאֹם וְטִמֵּא רֹאשׁ נִזְרוֹ וְגִלַּח רֹאשׁוֹ בְּיוֹם טהֳרָתוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי יְגַלְּחֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יָמוּת מֵת עָלָיו בְּפֶתַע פִּתְאֹם וְטִמֵּא רֹאשׁ נִזְרוֹ וְגִלַּח רֹאשׁוֹ בְּיוֹם טהֳרָתוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי יְגַלְּחֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
And if someone will die by chance suddenly by him and will
make his head’s crown impure, then he shall shave his head
on the day of his purification: he shall shave it on the
seventh day.

translation.text: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.

verses.english:
And if someone will die by chance suddenly by him and will
make his head’s crown impure, then he shall shave his head
on the day of his purification: he shall shave it on the
seventh day.

verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי יָבִא שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה אֶל הַכֹּהֵן אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי יָבִא שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה אֶל הַכֹּהֵן אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or
two pigeons to the priest, to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting.

translation.text: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

verses.english:
And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or
two pigeons to the priest, to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וְאֶחָד לְעֹלָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו מֵאֲשֶׁר חָטָא עַל הַנָּפֶשׁ וְקִדַּשׁ אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וְאֶחָד לְעֹלָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו מֵאֲשֶׁר חָטָא עַל הַנָּפֶשׁ וְקִדַּשׁ אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

english.text:
And the priest shall do one as a sin offering and one as a
burnt offering and shall make atonement over him in that
he has sinned over a person. And he shall make his head
holy on that day.

translation.text: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.

verses.english:
And the priest shall do one as a sin offering and one as a
burnt offering and shall make atonement over him in that
he has sinned over a person. And he shall make his head
holy on that day.

verses.hebrew: וְהִזִּיר לַיהֹוָה אֶת יְמֵי נִזְרוֹ וְהֵבִיא כֶּבֶשׂ בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְאָשָׁם וְהַיָּמִים הָרִאשֹׁנִים יִפְּלוּ כִּי טָמֵא נִזְרוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִזִּיר לַיהֹוָה אֶת יְמֵי נִזְרוֹ וְהֵבִיא כֶּבֶשׂ בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְאָשָׁם וְהַיָּמִים הָרִאשֹׁנִים יִפְּלוּ כִּי טָמֵא נִזְרוֹ׃

english.text:
And he shall make a separation for YHWH for the days of
his being a Nazirite, and he shall bring a lamb in its
first year for a guilt offering, and the first days shall
fall because his Nazirite state became impure.

translation.text: And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.

verses.english:
And he shall make a separation for YHWH for the days of
his being a Nazirite, and he shall bring a lamb in its
first year for a guilt offering, and the first days shall
fall because his Nazirite state became impure.

verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הַנָּזִיר בְּיוֹם מְלֹאת יְמֵי נִזְרוֹ יָבִיא אֹתוֹ אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הַנָּזִיר בְּיוֹם מְלֹאת יְמֵי נִזְרוֹ יָבִיא אֹתוֹ אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
“And this is the instruction for the Nazirite: On the day
of the fulfillment of the days of his being a Nazirite one
shall bring him to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

verses.english:
“And this is the instruction for the Nazirite: On the day
of the fulfillment of the days of his being a Nazirite one
shall bring him to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה כֶּבֶשׂ בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ תָמִים אֶחָד לְעֹלָה וְכַבְשָׂה אַחַת בַּת שְׁנָתָהּ תְּמִימָה לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל אֶחָד תָּמִים לִשְׁלָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה כֶּבֶשׂ בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ תָמִים אֶחָד לְעֹלָה וְכַבְשָׂה אַחַת בַּת שְׁנָתָהּ תְּמִימָה לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל אֶחָד תָּמִים לִשְׁלָמִים׃

english.text:
And he shall make his offering to YHWH: one unblemished
lamb in its first year for a burnt offering and one
unblemished ewe-lamb in its first year for a sin offering
and one unblemished ram for a peace offering

translation.text: And he shall offer his offering unto the LORD, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,

verses.english:
And he shall make his offering to YHWH: one unblemished
lamb in its first year for a burnt offering and one
unblemished ewe-lamb in its first year for a sin offering
and one unblemished ram for a peace offering

verses.hebrew: וְסַל מַצּוֹת סֹלֶת חַלֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְסַל מַצּוֹת סֹלֶת חַלֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם׃

english.text:
and a basket of unleavened bread of fine flour, cakes
mixed with oil and unleavened wafers with oil poured on
them with their grain offering and their libations.

translation.text: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.

verses.english:
and a basket of unleavened bread of fine flour, cakes
mixed with oil and unleavened wafers with oil poured on
them with their grain offering and their libations.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְעָשָׂה אֶת חַטָּאתוֹ וְאֶת עֹלָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְעָשָׂה אֶת חַטָּאתוֹ וְאֶת עֹלָתוֹ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall bring it forward in front of YHWH and
shall do his sin offering and his burnt offering.

translation.text: And the priest shall bring them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:

verses.english:
And the priest shall bring it forward in front of YHWH and
shall do his sin offering and his burnt offering.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָאַיִל יַעֲשֶׂה זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה עַל סַל הַמַּצּוֹת וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת מִנְחָתוֹ וְאֶת נִסְכּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָאַיִל יַעֲשֶׂה זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה עַל סַל הַמַּצּוֹת וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת מִנְחָתוֹ וְאֶת נִסְכּוֹ׃

english.text:
And he shall make the ram a peace-offering sacrifice to
YHWH with the basket of unleavened bread, and the priest
shall do his grain offering and his libation.

translation.text: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.

verses.english:
And he shall make the ram a peace-offering sacrifice to
YHWH with the basket of unleavened bread, and the priest
shall do his grain offering and his libation.

verses.hebrew: וְגִלַּח הַנָּזִיר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֶת רֹאשׁ נִזְרוֹ וְלָקַח אֶת שְׂעַר רֹאשׁ נִזְרוֹ וְנָתַן עַל הָאֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר תַּחַת זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְגִלַּח הַנָּזִיר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֶת רֹאשׁ נִזְרוֹ וְלָקַח אֶת שְׂעַר רֹאשׁ נִזְרוֹ וְנָתַן עַל הָאֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר תַּחַת זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים׃

english.text:
And the Nazirite shall shave his head’s crown at the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting and shall take the hair of
his head’s crown and put it on the fire that is under the
peace-offering sacrifice.

translation.text: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.

verses.english:
And the Nazirite shall shave his head’s crown at the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting and shall take the hair of
his head’s crown and put it on the fire that is under the
peace-offering sacrifice.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַזְּרֹעַ בְּשֵׁלָה מִן הָאַיִל וְחַלַּת מַצָּה אַחַת מִן הַסַּל וּרְקִיק מַצָּה אֶחָד וְנָתַן עַל כַּפֵּי הַנָּזִיר אַחַר הִתְגַּלְּחוֹ אֶת נִזְרוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַזְּרֹעַ בְּשֵׁלָה מִן הָאַיִל וְחַלַּת מַצָּה אַחַת מִן הַסַּל וּרְקִיק מַצָּה אֶחָד וְנָתַן עַל כַּפֵּי הַנָּזִיר אַחַר הִתְגַּלְּחוֹ אֶת נִזְרוֹ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall take the cooked shoulder from the ram
and one unleavened cake from the basket and one unleavened
wafer and put them on the Nazirite’s hands after his crown
is shaved.

translation.text: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:

verses.english:
And the priest shall take the cooked shoulder from the ram
and one unleavened cake from the basket and one unleavened
wafer and put them on the Nazirite’s hands after his crown
is shaved.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵנִיף אוֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קֹדֶשׁ הוּא לַכֹּהֵן עַל חֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וְעַל שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה וְאַחַר יִשְׁתֶּה הַנָּזִיר יָיִן׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵנִיף אוֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קֹדֶשׁ הוּא לַכֹּהֵן עַל חֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וְעַל שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה וְאַחַר יִשְׁתֶּה הַנָּזִיר יָיִן׃

english.text:
And the priest shall elevate them, an elevation offering
in front of YHWH. It is holy for the priest along with the
breast of the elevation offering and the thigh of the
donation. And after that the Nazirite may drink wine.

translation.text: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD: this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.

verses.english:
And the priest shall elevate them, an elevation offering
in front of YHWH. It is holy for the priest along with the
breast of the elevation offering and the thigh of the
donation. And after that the Nazirite may drink wine.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַנָּזִיר אֲשֶׁר יִדֹּר קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה עַל נִזְרוֹ מִלְּבַד אֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יָדוֹ כְּפִי נִדְרוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִדֹּר כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה עַל תּוֹרַת נִזְרוֹ׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַנָּזִיר אֲשֶׁר יִדֹּר קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה עַל נִזְרוֹ מִלְּבַד אֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יָדוֹ כְּפִי נִדְרוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִדֹּר כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה עַל תּוֹרַת נִזְרוֹ׃

english.text:
This is the instruction for the Nazirite who will vow his
offering to YHWH for his being a Nazirite outside of what
his hand may attain. According to his vow that he will
make, so he shall do along with the instruction of his
being a Nazirite.”

translation.text: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the LORD for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.

verses.english:
This is the instruction for the Nazirite who will vow his
offering to YHWH for his being a Nazirite outside of what
his hand may attain. According to his vow that he will
make, so he shall do along with the instruction of his
being a Nazirite.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר כֹּה תְבָרְכוּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָמוֹר לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר כֹּה תְבָרְכוּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָמוֹר לָהֶם׃

english.text:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is how you
shall bless the children of Israel; say to them:

translation.text: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,

verses.english:
“Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is how you
shall bless the children of Israel; say to them:

verses.hebrew: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה וְיִשְׁמְרֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה וְיִשְׁמְרֶךָ׃

english.text: May YHWH bless you and watch over you.

translation.text: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:

verses.english: May YHWH bless you and watch over you.
verses.translation: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:

verses.hebrew: יָאֵר יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וִיחֻנֶּךָּ׃

hebrew.text: יָאֵר יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וִיחֻנֶּךָּ׃

english.text:
May YHWH make His face shine to you and be gracious to
you.

translation.text: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:

verses.english:
May YHWH make His face shine to you and be gracious to
you.
verses.translation: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:

verses.hebrew: יִשָּׂא יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: יִשָּׂא יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם׃

english.text: May YHWH raise His face to you and give you peace.

translation.text: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

verses.english: May YHWH raise His face to you and give you peace.
verses.translation: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׂמוּ אֶת שְׁמִי עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲנִי אֲבָרְכֵם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׂמוּ אֶת שְׁמִי עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲנִי אֲבָרְכֵם׃

english.text:
And they shall set my name on the children of Israel, and
I shall bless them.”

translation.text: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel, and I will bless them.

verses.english:
And they shall set my name on the children of Israel, and
I shall bless them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּיוֹם כַּלּוֹת מֹשֶׁה לְהָקִים אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וַיִּמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וַיִּמְשָׁחֵם וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּיוֹם כַּלּוֹת מֹשֶׁה לְהָקִים אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וַיִּמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וַיִּמְשָׁחֵם וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתָם׃

english.text:
And it was on the day that Moses finished setting up the
Tabernacle, and he anointed it and made it and all its
equipment and the altar and all its equipment holy. He
anointed them and made them holy.

translation.text: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;

verses.english:
And it was on the day that Moses finished setting up the
Tabernacle, and he anointed it and made it and all its
equipment and the altar and all its equipment holy. He
anointed them and made them holy.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרִיבוּ נְשִׂיאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאשֵׁי בֵּית אֲבֹתָם הֵם נְשִׂיאֵי הַמַּטֹּת הֵם הָעֹמְדִים עַל הַפְּקֻדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרִיבוּ נְשִׂיאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאשֵׁי בֵּית אֲבֹתָם הֵם נְשִׂיאֵי הַמַּטֹּת הֵם הָעֹמְדִים עַל הַפְּקֻדִים׃

english.text:
And Israel’s chieftains, the heads of their fathers’ house
brought forward—they were the tribes’ chieftains; they
were the ones standing over those who were counted—

translation.text: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:

verses.english:
And Israel’s chieftains, the heads of their fathers’ house
brought forward—they were the tribes’ chieftains; they
were the ones standing over those who were counted—

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת קרְבָּנָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה שֵׁשׁ עֶגְלֹת צָב וּשְׁנֵי עָשָׂר בָּקָר עֲגָלָה עַל שְׁנֵי הַנְּשִׂאִים וְשׁוֹר לְאֶחָד וַיַּקְרִיבוּ אוֹתָם לִפְנֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת קרְבָּנָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה שֵׁשׁ עֶגְלֹת צָב וּשְׁנֵי עָשָׂר בָּקָר עֲגָלָה עַל שְׁנֵי הַנְּשִׂאִים וְשׁוֹר לְאֶחָד וַיַּקְרִיבוּ אוֹתָם לִפְנֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
and they brought their offering in front of YHWH: six
covered wagons and twelve oxen, a wagon for two chieftains
and an ox for each one. And they brought them in front of
the Tabernacle.

translation.text: And they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.

verses.english:
and they brought their offering in front of YHWH: six
covered wagons and twelve oxen, a wagon for two chieftains
and an ox for each one. And they brought them in front of
the Tabernacle.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH said to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH said to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: קַח מֵאִתָּם וְהָיוּ לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְנָתַתָּה אוֹתָם אֶל הַלְוִיִּם אִישׁ כְּפִי עֲבֹדָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: קַח מֵאִתָּם וְהָיוּ לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְנָתַתָּה אוֹתָם אֶל הַלְוִיִּם אִישׁ כְּפִי עֲבֹדָתוֹ׃

english.text:
“Take them from them, and they will be for doing the work
of the Tent of Meeting. And you shall give them to the
Levites, to each man according to his work.”

translation.text: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.

verses.english:
“Take them from them, and they will be for doing the work
of the Tent of Meeting. And you shall give them to the
Levites, to each man according to his work.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָעֲגָלֹת וְאֶת הַבָּקָר וַיִּתֵּן אוֹתָם אֶל הַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָעֲגָלֹת וְאֶת הַבָּקָר וַיִּתֵּן אוֹתָם אֶל הַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
And Moses took the wagons and the oxen and gave them to
the Levites.

translation.text: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.

verses.english:
And Moses took the wagons and the oxen and gave them to
the Levites.

verses.hebrew: אֵת שְׁתֵּי הָעֲגָלוֹת וְאֵת אַרְבַּעַת הַבָּקָר נָתַן לִבְנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן כְּפִי עֲבֹדָתָם׃

hebrew.text: אֵת שְׁתֵּי הָעֲגָלוֹת וְאֵת אַרְבַּעַת הַבָּקָר נָתַן לִבְנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן כְּפִי עֲבֹדָתָם׃

english.text:
He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon
according to their work.

translation.text: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:

verses.english:
He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon
according to their work.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת אַרְבַּע הָעֲגָלֹת וְאֵת שְׁמֹנַת הַבָּקָר נָתַן לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי כְּפִי עֲבֹדָתָם בְּיַד אִיתָמָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת אַרְבַּע הָעֲגָלֹת וְאֵת שְׁמֹנַת הַבָּקָר נָתַן לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי כְּפִי עֲבֹדָתָם בְּיַד אִיתָמָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
And he gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of
Merari according to their work in the hand of Ithamar son
of Aaron, the priest.

translation.text: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

verses.english:
And he gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of
Merari according to their work in the hand of Ithamar son
of Aaron, the priest.

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי קְהָת לֹא נָתָן כִּי עֲבֹדַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ עֲלֵהֶם בַּכָּתֵף יִשָּׂאוּ׃

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו בְּהַעֲלֹתְךָ אֶת הַנֵּרֹת אֶל מוּל פְּנֵי הַמְּנוֹרָה יָאִירוּ שִׁבְעַת הַנֵּרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו בְּהַעֲלֹתְךָ אֶת הַנֵּרֹת אֶל מוּל פְּנֵי הַמְּנוֹרָה יָאִירוּ שִׁבְעַת הַנֵּרוֹת׃

english.text:
“Speak to Aaron, and you shall say to him: ‘When you put
up the lamps, the seven lamps shall shed light opposite
the front of the menorah.’”

translation.text: Speak unto Aaron and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.

verses.english:
“Speak to Aaron, and you shall say to him: ‘When you put
up the lamps, the seven lamps shall shed light opposite
the front of the menorah.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן אַהֲרֹן אֶל מוּל פְּנֵי הַמְּנוֹרָה הֶעֱלָה נֵרֹתֶיהָ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן אַהֲרֹן אֶל מוּל פְּנֵי הַמְּנוֹרָה הֶעֱלָה נֵרֹתֶיהָ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Aaron did so. He put up its lamps opposite the front
of the menorah as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And Aaron did so. He put up its lamps opposite the front
of the menorah as YHWH had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה מַעֲשֵׂה הַמְּנֹרָה מִקְשָׁה זָהָב עַד יְרֵכָהּ עַד פִּרְחָהּ מִקְשָׁה הִוא כַּמַּרְאֶה אֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשָׂה אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה מַעֲשֵׂה הַמְּנֹרָה מִקְשָׁה זָהָב עַד יְרֵכָהּ עַד פִּרְחָהּ מִקְשָׁה הִוא כַּמַּרְאֶה אֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשָׂה אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה׃

english.text:
And this was the menorah’s construction: hammered work of
gold; including its shaft, including its flower, it was
hammered work. According to the appearance that YHWH had
shown Moses, so he made the menorah.

translation.text: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.

verses.english:
And this was the menorah’s construction: hammered work of
gold; including its shaft, including its flower, it was
hammered work. According to the appearance that YHWH had
shown Moses, so he made the menorah.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: קַח אֶת הַלְוִיִּם מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְטִהַרְתָּ אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: קַח אֶת הַלְוִיִּם מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְטִהַרְתָּ אֹתָם׃

english.text:
“Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and
make them pure.

translation.text: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

verses.english:
“Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and
make them pure.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹה תַעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם לְטַהֲרָם הַזֵּה עֲלֵיהֶם מֵי חַטָּאת וְהֶעֱבִירוּ תַעַר עַל כּל בְּשָׂרָם וְכִבְּסוּ בִגְדֵיהֶם וְהִטֶּהָרוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹה תַעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם לְטַהֲרָם הַזֵּה עֲלֵיהֶם מֵי חַטָּאת וְהֶעֱבִירוּ תַעַר עַל כּל בְּשָׂרָם וְכִבְּסוּ בִגְדֵיהֶם וְהִטֶּהָרוּ׃

english.text:
And this is what you shall do to them to make them pure:
you shall sprinkle water of sin expiation on them, and
they shall pass a razor over all of their flesh, and they
shall wash their clothes, and so they will be made pure.

translation.text: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.

verses.english:
And this is what you shall do to them to make them pure:
you shall sprinkle water of sin expiation on them, and
they shall pass a razor over all of their flesh, and they
shall wash their clothes, and so they will be made pure.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקְחוּ פַּר בֶּן בָּקָר וּמִנְחָתוֹ סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן וּפַר שֵׁנִי בֶן בָּקָר תִּקַּח לְחַטָּאת׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקְחוּ פַּר בֶּן בָּקָר וּמִנְחָתוֹ סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן וּפַר שֵׁנִי בֶן בָּקָר תִּקַּח לְחַטָּאת׃

english.text:
And they shall take a bull of the cattle and its grain
offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and you shall take a
second bull of the cattle for a sin offering.

translation.text: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.

verses.english:
And they shall take a bull of the cattle and its grain
offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and you shall take a
second bull of the cattle for a sin offering.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ אֶת הַלְוִיִּם לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהִקְהַלְתָּ אֶת כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ אֶת הַלְוִיִּם לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהִקְהַלְתָּ אֶת כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And you shall bring the Levites forward in front of the
Tent of Meeting, and you shall assemble all of the
congregation of the children of Israel.

translation.text: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:

verses.english:
And you shall bring the Levites forward in front of the
Tent of Meeting, and you shall assemble all of the
congregation of the children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ אֶת הַלְוִיִּם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְסָמְכוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל הַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ אֶת הַלְוִיִּם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְסָמְכוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל הַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
And you shall bring the Levites forward in front of YHWH,
and the children of Israel shall lay their hands on the
Levites.

translation.text: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:

verses.english:
And you shall bring the Levites forward in front of YHWH,
and the children of Israel shall lay their hands on the
Levites.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵנִיף אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַלְוִיִּם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיוּ לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵנִיף אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַלְוִיִּם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיוּ לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Aaron shall make the Levites an elevation offering in
front of YHWH from the children of Israel, and they shall
be to do YHWH’s service.

translation.text: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD.

verses.english:
And Aaron shall make the Levites an elevation offering in
front of YHWH from the children of Israel, and they shall
be to do YHWH’s service.

verses.hebrew: וְהַלְוִיִּם יִסְמְכוּ אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הַפָּרִים וַעֲשֵׂה אֶת הָאֶחָד חַטָּאת וְאֶת הָאֶחָד עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה לְכַפֵּר עַל הַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַלְוִיִּם יִסְמְכוּ אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הַפָּרִים וַעֲשֵׂה אֶת הָאֶחָד חַטָּאת וְאֶת הָאֶחָד עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה לְכַפֵּר עַל הַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
And the Levites shall lay their hands on the bulls’ heads.
And make one a sin offering and one a burnt offering for
YHWH to make atonement for the Levites.

translation.text: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.

verses.english:
And the Levites shall lay their hands on the bulls’ heads.
And make one a sin offering and one a burnt offering for
YHWH to make atonement for the Levites.

verses.hebrew: וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ אֶת הַלְוִיִּם לִפְנֵי אַהֲרֹן וְלִפְנֵי בָנָיו וְהֵנַפְתָּ אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ אֶת הַלְוִיִּם לִפְנֵי אַהֲרֹן וְלִפְנֵי בָנָיו וְהֵנַפְתָּ אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall stand the Levites in front of Aaron and in
front of his sons and make them an elevation offering for
YHWH.

translation.text: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall stand the Levites in front of Aaron and in
front of his sons and make them an elevation offering for
YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְהִבְדַּלְתָּ אֶת הַלְוִיִּם מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיוּ לִי הַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִבְדַּלְתָּ אֶת הַלְוִיִּם מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיוּ לִי הַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
And you shall distinguish the Levites from among the
children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.

translation.text: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.

verses.english:
And you shall distinguish the Levites from among the
children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יָבֹאוּ הַלְוִיִּם לַעֲבֹד אֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְטִהַרְתָּ אֹתָם וְהֵנַפְתָּ אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יָבֹאוּ הַלְוִיִּם לַעֲבֹד אֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְטִהַרְתָּ אֹתָם וְהֵנַפְתָּ אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה׃

english.text:
And after that the Levites shall come to work at the Tent
of Meeting, when you have made them pure and made them an
elevation offering.

translation.text: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.

verses.english:
And after that the Levites shall come to work at the Tent
of Meeting, when you have made them pure and made them an
elevation offering.

verses.hebrew: כִּי נְתֻנִים נְתֻנִים הֵמָּה לִי מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תַּחַת פִּטְרַת כּל רֶחֶם בְּכוֹר כֹּל מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָקַחְתִּי אֹתָם לִי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי נְתֻנִים נְתֻנִים הֵמָּה לִי מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תַּחַת פִּטְרַת כּל רֶחֶם בְּכוֹר כֹּל מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָקַחְתִּי אֹתָם לִי׃

english.text:
Because they are given, given, to me from among the
children of Israel. I have taken them to me in place of
the first birth of every womb, the firstborn of everyone
from the children of Israel.

translation.text: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.

verses.english:
Because they are given, given, to me from among the
children of Israel. I have taken them to me in place of
the first birth of every womb, the firstborn of everyone
from the children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לִי כל בְּכוֹר בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה בְּיוֹם הַכֹּתִי כל בְּכוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי אֹתָם לִי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לִי כל בְּכוֹר בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה בְּיוֹם הַכֹּתִי כל בְּכוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי אֹתָם לִי׃

english.text:
Because every firstborn of the children Israel is mine, of
human and of animal; on the day that I struck every
firstborn in the land of Egypt I consecrated them to me.

translation.text: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.

verses.english:
Because every firstborn of the children Israel is mine, of
human and of animal; on the day that I struck every
firstborn in the land of Egypt I consecrated them to me.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶקַּח אֶת הַלְוִיִּם תַּחַת כּל בְּכוֹר בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶקַּח אֶת הַלְוִיִּם תַּחַת כּל בְּכוֹר בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And I took the Levites in place of every firstborn of the
children of Israel

translation.text: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And I took the Levites in place of every firstborn of the
children of Israel

verses.hebrew: וָאֶתְּנָה אֶת הַלְוִיִּם נְתֻנִים לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּלְכַפֵּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא יִהְיֶה בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶגֶף בְּגֶשֶׁת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶתְּנָה אֶת הַלְוִיִּם נְתֻנִים לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּלְכַפֵּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא יִהְיֶה בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶגֶף בְּגֶשֶׁת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
and gave the Levites—they are given—to Aaron and to his
sons from among the children of Israel to do the work of
the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting and to make
atonement for the children of Israel, so there will not be
a plague in the children of Israel when the children of
Israel would come near to the Holy.”

translation.text: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.

verses.english:
and gave the Levites—they are given—to Aaron and to his
sons from among the children of Israel to do the work of
the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting and to make
atonement for the children of Israel, so there will not be
a plague in the children of Israel when the children of
Israel would come near to the Holy.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וְכל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְוִיִּם כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה לַלְוִיִּם כֵּן עָשׂוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וְכל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְוִיִּם כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה לַלְוִיִּם כֵּן עָשׂוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the
children of Israel did to the Levites according to all
that YHWH commanded Moses about the Levites; the children
of Israel did so to them.

translation.text: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the
children of Israel did to the Levites according to all
that YHWH commanded Moses about the Levites; the children
of Israel did so to them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְחַטְּאוּ הַלְוִיִּם וַיְכַבְּסוּ בִּגְדֵיהֶם וַיָּנֶף אַהֲרֹן אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיהֶם אַהֲרֹן לְטַהֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְחַטְּאוּ הַלְוִיִּם וַיְכַבְּסוּ בִּגְדֵיהֶם וַיָּנֶף אַהֲרֹן אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיהֶם אַהֲרֹן לְטַהֲרָם׃

english.text:
And the Levites did sin expiation and washed their
clothes, and Aaron made them an elevation offering in
front of YHWH, and Aaron made atonement for them to make
them pure.

translation.text: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.

verses.english:
And the Levites did sin expiation and washed their
clothes, and Aaron made them an elevation offering in
front of YHWH, and Aaron made atonement for them to make
them pure.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן בָּאוּ הַלְוִיִּם לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדָתָם בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי אַהֲרֹן וְלִפְנֵי בָנָיו כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה עַל הַלְוִיִּם כֵּן עָשׂוּ לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן בָּאוּ הַלְוִיִּם לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדָתָם בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי אַהֲרֹן וְלִפְנֵי בָנָיו כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה עַל הַלְוִיִּם כֵּן עָשׂוּ לָהֶם׃

english.text:
And after that the Levites came to do their work in the
Tent of Meeting in front of Aaron and in front of his
sons. As YHWH commanded Moses about the Levites, so they
did to them.

translation.text: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.

verses.english:
And after that the Levites came to do their work in the
Tent of Meeting in front of Aaron and in front of his
sons. As YHWH commanded Moses about the Levites, so they
did to them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: זֹאת אֲשֶׁר לַלְוִיִּם מִבֶּן חָמֵשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה יָבוֹא לִצְבֹא צָבָא בַּעֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת אֲשֶׁר לַלְוִיִּם מִבֶּן חָמֵשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה יָבוֹא לִצְבֹא צָבָא בַּעֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

translation.text: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:

verses.hebrew: וּמִבֶּן חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה יָשׁוּב מִצְּבָא הָעֲבֹדָה וְלֹא יַעֲבֹד עוֹד׃

hebrew.text: וּמִבֶּן חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה יָשׁוּב מִצְּבָא הָעֲבֹדָה וְלֹא יַעֲבֹד עוֹד׃

english.text:
and from fifty years old he shall go back from the army
service and shall not work anymore;

translation.text: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:

verses.english:
and from fifty years old he shall go back from the army
service and shall not work anymore;

verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁרֵת אֶת אֶחָיו בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִשְׁמֹר מִשְׁמֶרֶת וַעֲבֹדָה לֹא יַעֲבֹד כָּכָה תַּעֲשֶׂה לַלְוִיִּם בְּמִשְׁמְרֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁרֵת אֶת אֶחָיו בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִשְׁמֹר מִשְׁמֶרֶת וַעֲבֹדָה לֹא יַעֲבֹד כָּכָה תַּעֲשֶׂה לַלְוִיִּם בְּמִשְׁמְרֹתָם׃

english.text:
and he shall minister with his brothers in the Tent of
Meeting to keep the charge, but he shall not do work. You
shall do thus to the Levites regarding their charge.”

translation.text: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.

verses.english:
and he shall minister with his brothers in the Tent of
Meeting to keep the charge, but he shall not do work. You
shall do thus to the Levites regarding their charge.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְמִדְבַּר סִינַי בַּשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית לְצֵאתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְמִדְבַּר סִינַי בַּשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית לְצֵאתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And YHWH had spoken to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai
in the second year of their exodus from the land of Egypt,
in the first month, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.english:
And YHWH had spoken to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai
in the second year of their exodus from the land of Egypt,
in the first month, saying,

verses.hebrew: וְיַעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַפָּסַח בְּמוֹעֲדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְיַעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַפָּסַח בְּמוֹעֲדוֹ׃

english.text:
“And the children of Israel shall do the Passover at its
appointed time.

translation.text: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.

verses.english:
“And the children of Israel shall do the Passover at its
appointed time.

verses.hebrew: בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם תַּעֲשׂוּ אֹתוֹ בְּמֹעֲדוֹ כְּכל חֻקֹּתָיו וּכְכל מִשְׁפָּטָיו תַּעֲשׂוּ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם תַּעֲשׂוּ אֹתוֹ בְּמֹעֲדוֹ כְּכל חֻקֹּתָיו וּכְכל מִשְׁפָּטָיו תַּעֲשׂוּ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
On the fourteenth day in this month ‘between the two
evenings’ you shall do it at its appointed time. You shall
do it according to all of its law and according to all of
its judgments.”

translation.text: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.

verses.english:
On the fourteenth day in this month ‘between the two
evenings’ you shall do it at its appointed time. You shall
do it according to all of its law and according to all of
its judgments.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשֹׂת הַפָּסַח׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשֹׂת הַפָּסַח׃

english.text:
And Moses had spoken to the children of Israel to do the
Passover,

translation.text: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.

verses.english:
And Moses had spoken to the children of Israel to do the
Passover,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת הַפֶּסַח בָּרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת הַפֶּסַח בָּרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
and they had done the Passover in the first month on the
fourteenth day of the month “between the two evenings” in
the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that YHWH had
commanded Moses, so the children of Israel had done.

translation.text: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.

verses.english:
and they had done the Passover in the first month on the
fourteenth day of the month “between the two evenings” in
the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that YHWH had
commanded Moses, so the children of Israel had done.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ טְמֵאִים לְנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לַעֲשֹׂת הַפֶּסַח בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּקְרְבוּ לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וְלִפְנֵי אַהֲרֹן בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ טְמֵאִים לְנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לַעֲשֹׂת הַפֶּסַח בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּקְרְבוּ לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וְלִפְנֵי אַהֲרֹן בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

english.text:
And there had been people who were impure by a human being
and so had not been able to do the Passover on that day,
and they had come forward in front of Moses and in front
of Aaron on that day,

translation.text: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:

verses.english:
And there had been people who were impure by a human being
and so had not been able to do the Passover on that day,
and they had come forward in front of Moses and in front
of Aaron on that day,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים הָהֵמָּה אֵלָיו אֲנַחְנוּ טְמֵאִים לְנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם לָמָּה נִגָּרַע לְבִלְתִּי הַקְרִיב אֶת קרְבַּן יְהֹוָה בְּמֹעֲדוֹ בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים הָהֵמָּה אֵלָיו אֲנַחְנוּ טְמֵאִים לְנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם לָמָּה נִגָּרַע לְבִלְתִּי הַקְרִיב אֶת קרְבַּן יְהֹוָה בְּמֹעֲדוֹ בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
and those people had said to him, “We’re impure by a human
being. Why should we be excluded so as not to make YHWH’s
offering at its appointed time among the children of
Israel?”

translation.text: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?

verses.english:
and those people had said to him, “We’re impure by a human
being. Why should we be excluded so as not to make YHWH’s
offering at its appointed time among the children of
Israel?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מֹשֶׁה עִמְדוּ וְאֶשְׁמְעָה מַה יְצַוֶּה יְהֹוָה לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מֹשֶׁה עִמְדוּ וְאֶשְׁמְעָה מַה יְצַוֶּה יְהֹוָה לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses had said, “Stay, and let me hear what YHWH will
command about you.”

translation.text: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.

verses.english:
And Moses had said, “Stay, and let me hear what YHWH will
command about you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH had spoken to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH had spoken to Moses, saying,

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אִישׁ אִישׁ כִּי יִהְיֶה טָמֵא לָנֶפֶשׁ אוֹ בְדֶרֶךְ רְחֹקָה לָכֶם אוֹ לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם וְעָשָׂה פֶסַח לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: Any man who will
be impure by a person or on a faraway journey—among you or
through your generations—and will do the Passover for
YHWH,

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD.

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying: Any man who will
be impure by a person or on a faraway journey—among you or
through your generations—and will do the Passover for
YHWH,
