hebrew.text: בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם יַעֲשׂוּ אֹתוֹ עַל מַצּוֹת וּמְרֹרִים יֹאכְלֻהוּ׃

english.text:
they shall do it in the second month on the fourteenth day
‘between the two evenings.’ They shall eat it with
unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

translation.text: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

verses.english:
they shall do it in the second month on the fourteenth day
‘between the two evenings.’ They shall eat it with
unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

verses.hebrew: לֹא יַשְׁאִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר וְעֶצֶם לֹא יִשְׁבְּרוּ בוֹ כְּכל חֻקַּת הַפֶּסַח יַעֲשׂוּ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יַשְׁאִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר וְעֶצֶם לֹא יִשְׁבְּרוּ בוֹ כְּכל חֻקַּת הַפֶּסַח יַעֲשׂוּ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
They shall not leave any of it until morning, and they
shall not break a bone of it. They shall do it according
to all of the law of the Passover.

translation.text: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.

verses.english:
They shall not leave any of it until morning, and they
shall not break a bone of it. They shall do it according
to all of the law of the Passover.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הוּא טָהוֹר וּבְדֶרֶךְ לֹא הָיָה וְחָדַל לַעֲשׂוֹת הַפֶּסַח וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ כִּי קרְבַּן יְהֹוָה לֹא הִקְרִיב בְּמֹעֲדוֹ חֶטְאוֹ יִשָּׂא הָאִישׁ הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הוּא טָהוֹר וּבְדֶרֶךְ לֹא הָיָה וְחָדַל לַעֲשׂוֹת הַפֶּסַח וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ כִּי קרְבַּן יְהֹוָה לֹא הִקְרִיב בְּמֹעֲדוֹ חֶטְאוֹ יִשָּׂא הָאִישׁ הַהוּא׃

english.text:
But a man who is pure and has not been on a journey and
has failed to do the Passover: that person will be cut off
from his people, because he did not make YHWH’s offering
at its appointed time. That man shall bear his sin.

translation.text: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

verses.english:
But a man who is pure and has not been on a journey and
has failed to do the Passover: that person will be cut off
from his people, because he did not make YHWH’s offering
at its appointed time. That man shall bear his sin.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יָגוּר אִתְּכֶם גֵּר וְעָשָׂה פֶסַח לַיהֹוָה כְּחֻקַּת הַפֶּסַח וּכְמִשְׁפָּטוֹ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה חֻקָּה אַחַת יִהְיֶה לָכֶם וְלַגֵּר וּלְאֶזְרַח הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יָגוּר אִתְּכֶם גֵּר וְעָשָׂה פֶסַח לַיהֹוָה כְּחֻקַּת הַפֶּסַח וּכְמִשְׁפָּטוֹ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה חֻקָּה אַחַת יִהְיֶה לָכֶם וְלַגֵּר וּלְאֶזְרַח הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And if an alien will reside with you and will do the
Passover for YHWH: according to the law of the Passover
and according to its required manner, so he shall do it.
You shall have one law, for the alien and for the citizen
of the land.”

translation.text: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.

verses.english:
And if an alien will reside with you and will do the
Passover for YHWH: according to the law of the Passover
and according to its required manner, so he shall do it.
You shall have one law, for the alien and for the citizen
of the land.”

verses.hebrew: וּבְיוֹם הָקִים אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן כִּסָּה הֶעָנָן אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן לְאֹהֶל הָעֵדֻת וּבָעֶרֶב יִהְיֶה עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן כְּמַרְאֵה אֵשׁ עַד בֹּקֶר׃

hebrew.text: וּבְיוֹם הָקִים אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן כִּסָּה הֶעָנָן אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן לְאֹהֶל הָעֵדֻת וּבָעֶרֶב יִהְיֶה עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן כְּמַרְאֵה אֵשׁ עַד בֹּקֶר׃

english.text:
And on the day that the Tabernacle was set up, the cloud
covered the Tabernacle of the tent of the Testimony, and
in the evening it would be over the Tabernacle like the
appearance of fire until morning.

translation.text: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.

verses.english:
And on the day that the Tabernacle was set up, the cloud
covered the Tabernacle of the tent of the Testimony, and
in the evening it would be over the Tabernacle like the
appearance of fire until morning.

verses.hebrew: כֵּן יִהְיֶה תָמִיד הֶעָנָן יְכַסֶּנּוּ וּמַרְאֵה אֵשׁ לָיְלָה׃

hebrew.text: כֵּן יִהְיֶה תָמִיד הֶעָנָן יְכַסֶּנּוּ וּמַרְאֵה אֵשׁ לָיְלָה׃

english.text:
So it would be always: the cloud would cover it and the
appearance of fire at night.

translation.text: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.

verses.english:
So it would be always: the cloud would cover it and the
appearance of fire at night.

verses.hebrew: וּלְפִי הֵעָלוֹת הֶעָנָן מֵעַל הָאֹהֶל וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יִסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכּן שָׁם הֶעָנָן שָׁם יַחֲנוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּלְפִי הֵעָלוֹת הֶעָנָן מֵעַל הָאֹהֶל וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יִסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכּן שָׁם הֶעָנָן שָׁם יַחֲנוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And according to when the cloud was lifted from over the
tent, after that the children of Israel would travel. And
in a place where the cloud would tent, the children of
Israel would camp there.

translation.text: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.

verses.english:
And according to when the cloud was lifted from over the
tent, after that the children of Israel would travel. And
in a place where the cloud would tent, the children of
Israel would camp there.

verses.hebrew: עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה יִסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל פִּי יְהֹוָה יַחֲנוּ כּל יְמֵי אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכֹּן הֶעָנָן עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יַחֲנוּ׃

hebrew.text: עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה יִסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל פִּי יְהֹוָה יַחֲנוּ כּל יְמֵי אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכֹּן הֶעָנָן עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יַחֲנוּ׃

english.text:
By YHWH’s word the children of Israel would travel, and by
YHWH’s word they would camp. All the days that the cloud
would tent over the Tabernacle they would camp.

translation.text: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.

verses.english:
By YHWH’s word the children of Israel would travel, and by
YHWH’s word they would camp. All the days that the cloud
would tent over the Tabernacle they would camp.

verses.hebrew: וּבְהַאֲרִיךְ הֶעָנָן עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יָמִים רַבִּים וְשָׁמְרוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת יְהֹוָה וְלֹא יִסָּעוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְהַאֲרִיךְ הֶעָנָן עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יָמִים רַבִּים וְשָׁמְרוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת יְהֹוָה וְלֹא יִסָּעוּ׃

english.text:
And when the cloud would extend many days over the
Tabernacle, then the children of Israel kept YHWH’s charge
and would not travel.

translation.text: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD, and journeyed not.

verses.english:
And when the cloud would extend many days over the
Tabernacle, then the children of Israel kept YHWH’s charge
and would not travel.

verses.hebrew: וְיֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה הֶעָנָן יָמִים מִסְפָּר עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה יַחֲנוּ וְעַל פִּי יְהֹוָה יִסָּעוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְיֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה הֶעָנָן יָמִים מִסְפָּר עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה יַחֲנוּ וְעַל פִּי יְהֹוָה יִסָּעוּ׃

english.text:
And there were times that the cloud would be over the
Tabernacle for a number of days: by YHWH’s word they would
camp, and by YHWH’s word they would travel.

translation.text: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.

verses.english:
And there were times that the cloud would be over the
Tabernacle for a number of days: by YHWH’s word they would
camp, and by YHWH’s word they would travel.

verses.hebrew: וְיֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה הֶעָנָן מֵעֶרֶב עַד בֹּקֶר וְנַעֲלָה הֶעָנָן בַּבֹּקֶר וְנָסָעוּ אוֹ יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה וְנַעֲלָה הֶעָנָן וְנָסָעוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְיֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה הֶעָנָן מֵעֶרֶב עַד בֹּקֶר וְנַעֲלָה הֶעָנָן בַּבֹּקֶר וְנָסָעוּ אוֹ יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה וְנַעֲלָה הֶעָנָן וְנָסָעוּ׃

english.text:
And there were times that the cloud would be there from
evening until morning, and the cloud was lifted in the
morning, and then they would travel; or for a day and a
night, and the cloud was lifted, and then they traveled.

translation.text: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.

verses.english:
And there were times that the cloud would be there from
evening until morning, and the cloud was lifted in the
morning, and then they would travel; or for a day and a
night, and the cloud was lifted, and then they traveled.

verses.hebrew: אוֹ יֹמַיִם אוֹ חֹדֶשׁ אוֹ יָמִים בְּהַאֲרִיךְ הֶעָנָן עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן לִשְׁכֹּן עָלָיו יַחֲנוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא יִסָּעוּ וּבְהֵעָלֹתוֹ יִסָּעוּ׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ יֹמַיִם אוֹ חֹדֶשׁ אוֹ יָמִים בְּהַאֲרִיךְ הֶעָנָן עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן לִשְׁכֹּן עָלָיו יַחֲנוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא יִסָּעוּ וּבְהֵעָלֹתוֹ יִסָּעוּ׃

english.text:
Whether two days or a month or a year, when the cloud
would extend long over the Tabernacle, to tent over it,
the children of Israel would camp and would not travel,
and when it was lifted they would travel.

translation.text: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.

verses.english:
Whether two days or a month or a year, when the cloud
would extend long over the Tabernacle, to tent over it,
the children of Israel would camp and would not travel,
and when it was lifted they would travel.

verses.hebrew: עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה יַחֲנוּ וְעַל פִּי יְהֹוָה יִסָּעוּ אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת יְהֹוָה שָׁמָרוּ עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה יַחֲנוּ וְעַל פִּי יְהֹוָה יִסָּעוּ אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת יְהֹוָה שָׁמָרוּ עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
By YHWH’s word they would camp, and by YHWH’s word they
would travel. They kept YHWH’s charge, by YHWH’s word
through Moses’ hand.

translation.text: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD, at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

verses.english:
By YHWH’s word they would camp, and by YHWH’s word they
would travel. They kept YHWH’s charge, by YHWH’s word
through Moses’ hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: עֲשֵׂה לְךָ שְׁתֵּי חֲצוֹצְרֹת כֶּסֶף מִקְשָׁה תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם וְהָיוּ לְךָ לְמִקְרָא הָעֵדָה וּלְמַסַּע אֶת הַמַּחֲנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: עֲשֵׂה לְךָ שְׁתֵּי חֲצוֹצְרֹת כֶּסֶף מִקְשָׁה תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם וְהָיוּ לְךָ לְמִקְרָא הָעֵדָה וּלְמַסַּע אֶת הַמַּחֲנוֹת׃

english.text:
“Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them hammered
work. And you shall have them for calling the congregation
and for having the camps travel.

translation.text: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.

verses.english:
“Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them hammered
work. And you shall have them for calling the congregation
and for having the camps travel.

verses.hebrew: וְתָקְעוּ בָּהֵן וְנוֹעֲדוּ אֵלֶיךָ כּל הָעֵדָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְתָקְעוּ בָּהֵן וְנוֹעֲדוּ אֵלֶיךָ כּל הָעֵדָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And when they will blow them, then all the congregation
shall be gathered to you, to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting.

translation.text: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.english:
And when they will blow them, then all the congregation
shall be gathered to you, to the entrance of the Tent of
Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּאַחַת יִתְקָעוּ וְנוֹעֲדוּ אֵלֶיךָ הַנְּשִׂיאִים רָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּאַחַת יִתְקָעוּ וְנוֹעֲדוּ אֵלֶיךָ הַנְּשִׂיאִים רָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And if they will blow with one, then the chieftains, the
heads of thousands of Israel shall be gathered to you.

translation.text: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.

verses.english:
And if they will blow with one, then the chieftains, the
heads of thousands of Israel shall be gathered to you.

verses.hebrew: וּתְקַעְתֶּם תְּרוּעָה וְנָסְעוּ הַמַּחֲנוֹת הַחֹנִים קֵדְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וּתְקַעְתֶּם תְּרוּעָה וְנָסְעוּ הַמַּחֲנוֹת הַחֹנִים קֵדְמָה׃

english.text:
And when you will blow a blasting sound, then the camps
that are camping on the east shall travel.

translation.text: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.

verses.english:
And when you will blow a blasting sound, then the camps
that are camping on the east shall travel.

verses.hebrew: וּתְקַעְתֶּם תְּרוּעָה שֵׁנִית וְנָסְעוּ הַמַּחֲנוֹת הַחֹנִים תֵּימָנָה תְּרוּעָה יִתְקְעוּ לְמַסְעֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּתְקַעְתֶּם תְּרוּעָה שֵׁנִית וְנָסְעוּ הַמַּחֲנוֹת הַחֹנִים תֵּימָנָה תְּרוּעָה יִתְקְעוּ לְמַסְעֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And when you will blow a second blasting sound, then the
camps that are camping on the west shall travel. They
shall blow a blasting sound for their travels.

translation.text: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

verses.english:
And when you will blow a second blasting sound, then the
camps that are camping on the west shall travel. They
shall blow a blasting sound for their travels.

verses.hebrew: וּבְהַקְהִיל אֶת הַקָּהָל תִּתְקְעוּ וְלֹא תָרִיעוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְהַקְהִיל אֶת הַקָּהָל תִּתְקְעוּ וְלֹא תָרִיעוּ׃

english.text:
And for assembling the community you shall blow, but you
shall not make a blast.

translation.text: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.

verses.english:
And for assembling the community you shall blow, but you
shall not make a blast.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים יִתְקְעוּ בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים יִתְקְעוּ בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the
trumpets; and they shall be an eternal law for you through
your generations.

translation.text: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.

verses.english:
And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the
trumpets; and they shall be an eternal law for you through
your generations.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי תָבֹאוּ מִלְחָמָה בְּאַרְצְכֶם עַל הַצַּר הַצֹּרֵר אֶתְכֶם וַהֲרֵעֹתֶם בַּחֲצֹצְרֹת וְנִזְכַּרְתֶּם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְנוֹשַׁעְתֶּם מֵאֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תָבֹאוּ מִלְחָמָה בְּאַרְצְכֶם עַל הַצַּר הַצֹּרֵר אֶתְכֶם וַהֲרֵעֹתֶם בַּחֲצֹצְרֹת וְנִזְכַּרְתֶּם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְנוֹשַׁעְתֶּם מֵאֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And when you will go to war in your land against a foe who
afflicts you, then you shall blast the trumpets, and you
will be brought to mind in front of YHWH, your God, and
you will be saved from your enemies.

translation.text: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.

verses.english:
And when you will go to war in your land against a foe who
afflicts you, then you shall blast the trumpets, and you
will be brought to mind in front of YHWH, your God, and
you will be saved from your enemies.

verses.hebrew: וּבְיוֹם שִׂמְחַתְכֶם וּבְמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם וּבְרָאשֵׁי חדְשֵׁיכֶם וּתְקַעְתֶּם בַּחֲצֹצְרֹת עַל עֹלֹתֵיכֶם וְעַל זִבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְזִכָּרוֹן לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְיוֹם שִׂמְחַתְכֶם וּבְמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם וּבְרָאשֵׁי חדְשֵׁיכֶם וּתְקַעְתֶּם בַּחֲצֹצְרֹת עַל עֹלֹתֵיכֶם וְעַל זִבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְזִכָּרוֹן לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And on your happy occasion and at your appointed times and
on your new moons, you shall blow the trumpets over your
burnt offerings and over your peace-offering sacrifices,
and they shall be for a commemoration for you in front of
your God. I am YHWH, your God.”

translation.text: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
And on your happy occasion and at your appointed times and
on your new moons, you shall blow the trumpets over your
burnt offerings and over your peace-offering sacrifices,
and they shall be for a commemoration for you in front of
your God. I am YHWH, your God.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי בְּעֶשְׂרִים בַּחֹדֶשׁ נַעֲלָה הֶעָנָן מֵעַל מִשְׁכַּן הָעֵדֻת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי בְּעֶשְׂרִים בַּחֹדֶשׁ נַעֲלָה הֶעָנָן מֵעַל מִשְׁכַּן הָעֵדֻת׃

english.text:
And it was in the second year, in the second month, on the
twentieth of the month that the cloud was lifted from over
the Tabernacle of the Testimony.

translation.text: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.

verses.english:
And it was in the second year, in the second month, on the
twentieth of the month that the cloud was lifted from over
the Tabernacle of the Testimony.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמַסְעֵיהֶם מִמִּדְבַּר סִינָי וַיִּשְׁכֹּן הֶעָנָן בְּמִדְבַּר פָּארָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמַסְעֵיהֶם מִמִּדְבַּר סִינָי וַיִּשְׁכֹּן הֶעָנָן בְּמִדְבַּר פָּארָן׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel set out on their travels from
the wilderness of Sinai. And the cloud tented in the
wilderness of Paran.

translation.text: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel set out on their travels from
the wilderness of Sinai. And the cloud tented in the
wilderness of Paran.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ בָּרִאשֹׁנָה עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ בָּרִאשֹׁנָה עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And they traveled from the first by YHWH’s word through
Moses’ hand.

translation.text: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

verses.english:
And they traveled from the first by YHWH’s word through
Moses’ hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסַּע דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה בְנֵי יְהוּדָה בָּרִאשֹׁנָה לְצִבְאֹתָם וְעַל צְבָאוֹ נַחְשׁוֹן בֶּן עַמִּינָדָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסַּע דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה בְנֵי יְהוּדָה בָּרִאשֹׁנָה לְצִבְאֹתָם וְעַל צְבָאוֹ נַחְשׁוֹן בֶּן עַמִּינָדָב׃

english.text:
And the flag of the camp of the children of Judah traveled
first by their armies, and over its army was Nahshon son
of Amminadab.

translation.text: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

verses.english:
And the flag of the camp of the children of Judah traveled
first by their armies, and over its army was Nahshon son
of Amminadab.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר נְתַנְאֵל בֶּן צוּעָר׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר נְתַנְאֵל בֶּן צוּעָר׃

english.text:
And over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar
was Nethanel son of Zuar.

translation.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

verses.english:
And over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar
was Nethanel son of Zuar.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי זְבוּלֻן אֱלִיאָב בֶּן חֵלֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי זְבוּלֻן אֱלִיאָב בֶּן חֵלֹן׃

english.text:
And over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun
was Eliab son of Helon.

translation.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.

verses.english:
And over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun
was Eliab son of Helon.

verses.hebrew: וְהוּרַד הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְנָסְעוּ בְנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן וּבְנֵי מְרָרִי נֹשְׂאֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: וְהוּרַד הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְנָסְעוּ בְנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן וּבְנֵי מְרָרִי נֹשְׂאֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
And the Tabernacle was taken down; and the children of
Gershon and the children of Merari, who carried the
Tabernacle, traveled.

translation.text: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.

verses.english:
And the Tabernacle was taken down; and the children of
Gershon and the children of Merari, who carried the
Tabernacle, traveled.

verses.hebrew: וְנָסַע דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה רְאוּבֵן לְצִבְאֹתָם וְעַל צְבָאוֹ אֱלִיצוּר בֶּן שְׁדֵיאוּר׃

hebrew.text: וְנָסַע דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה רְאוּבֵן לְצִבְאֹתָם וְעַל צְבָאוֹ אֱלִיצוּר בֶּן שְׁדֵיאוּר׃

english.text:
And the flag of Reuben’s camp by their armies traveled,
and over its army was Elizur son of Shedeur.

translation.text: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.

verses.english:
And the flag of Reuben’s camp by their armies traveled,
and over its army was Elizur son of Shedeur.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵל בֶּן צוּרִישַׁדָּי׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵל בֶּן צוּרִישַׁדָּי׃

english.text:
And over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon
was Shelumiel son of Zurishadday.

translation.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.english:
And over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon
was Shelumiel son of Zurishadday.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְנֵי גָד אֶלְיָסָף בֶּן דְּעוּאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְנֵי גָד אֶלְיָסָף בֶּן דְּעוּאֵל׃

english.text:
And over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad was
Eliasaph son of Deuel.

translation.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

verses.english:
And over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad was
Eliasaph son of Deuel.

verses.hebrew: וְנָסְעוּ הַקְּהָתִים נֹשְׂאֵי הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וְהֵקִימוּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן עַד בֹּאָם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָסְעוּ הַקְּהָתִים נֹשְׂאֵי הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וְהֵקִימוּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן עַד בֹּאָם׃

english.text:
And the Kohathites, who carried the holy place, traveled;
and they set up the Tabernacle by the time they came.

translation.text: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.

verses.english:
And the Kohathites, who carried the holy place, traveled;
and they set up the Tabernacle by the time they came.

verses.hebrew: וְנָסַע דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה בְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם לְצִבְאֹתָם וְעַל צְבָאוֹ אֱלִישָׁמָע בֶּן עַמִּיהוּד׃

hebrew.text: וְנָסַע דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה בְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם לְצִבְאֹתָם וְעַל צְבָאוֹ אֱלִישָׁמָע בֶּן עַמִּיהוּד׃

english.text:
And the flag of the camp of the children of Ephraim by
their armies traveled, and over its army was Elishama son
of Ammihud.

translation.text: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.

verses.english:
And the flag of the camp of the children of Ephraim by
their armies traveled, and over its army was Elishama son
of Ammihud.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה גַּמְלִיאֵל בֶּן פְּדָהצוּר׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה גַּמְלִיאֵל בֶּן פְּדָהצוּר׃

english.text:
And over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh
was Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.

translation.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

verses.english:
And over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh
was Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן אֲבִידָן בֶּן גִּדְעוֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן אֲבִידָן בֶּן גִּדְעוֹנִי׃

english.text:
And over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin
was Abidan son of Gideoni.

translation.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.english:
And over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin
was Abidan son of Gideoni.

verses.hebrew: וְנָסַע דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה בְנֵי דָן מְאַסֵּף לְכל הַמַּחֲנֹת לְצִבְאֹתָם וְעַל צְבָאוֹ אֲחִיעֶזֶר בֶּן עַמִּישַׁדָּי׃

hebrew.text: וְנָסַע דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה בְנֵי דָן מְאַסֵּף לְכל הַמַּחֲנֹת לְצִבְאֹתָם וְעַל צְבָאוֹ אֲחִיעֶזֶר בֶּן עַמִּישַׁדָּי׃

english.text:
And the flag of the camp of the children of Dan, the final
one of all the camps, by their armies, traveled, and over
its army was Ahiezer son of Ammishadday.

translation.text: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

verses.english:
And the flag of the camp of the children of Dan, the final
one of all the camps, by their armies, traveled, and over
its army was Ahiezer son of Ammishadday.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי אָשֵׁר פַּגְעִיאֵל בֶּן עכְרָן׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי אָשֵׁר פַּגְעִיאֵל בֶּן עכְרָן׃

english.text:
And over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher
was Pagiel son of Ochran.

translation.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.

verses.english:
And over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher
was Pagiel son of Ochran.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי נַפְתָּלִי אֲחִירַע בֶּן עֵינָן׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי נַפְתָּלִי אֲחִירַע בֶּן עֵינָן׃

english.text:
And over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali
was Ahira son of Enan.

translation.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.english:
And over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali
was Ahira son of Enan.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מַסְעֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְצִבְאֹתָם וַיִּסָּעוּ׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מַסְעֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְצִבְאֹתָם וַיִּסָּעוּ׃

english.text:
These were the orders of travel of the children of Israel
by their armies when they traveled.

translation.text: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.

verses.english:
These were the orders of travel of the children of Israel
by their armies when they traveled.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לְחֹבָב בֶּן רְעוּאֵל הַמִּדְיָנִי חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה נֹסְעִים אֲנַחְנוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ אֶתֵּן לָכֶם לְכָה אִתָּנוּ וְהֵטַבְנוּ לָךְ כִּי יְהֹוָה דִּבֶּר טוֹב עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לְחֹבָב בֶּן רְעוּאֵל הַמִּדְיָנִי חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה נֹסְעִים אֲנַחְנוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ אֶתֵּן לָכֶם לְכָה אִתָּנוּ וְהֵטַבְנוּ לָךְ כִּי יְהֹוָה דִּבֶּר טוֹב עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite,
Moses’ father-in-law, “We’re traveling to the place that
YHWH said, ‘I’ll give it to you.’ Come with us, and we’ll
be good to you, because YHWH has spoken of good regarding
Israel.”

translation.text: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses’ father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.

verses.english:
And Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite,
Moses’ father-in-law, “We’re traveling to the place that
YHWH said, ‘I’ll give it to you.’ Come with us, and we’ll
be good to you, because YHWH has spoken of good regarding
Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לֹא אֵלֵךְ כִּי אִם אֶל אַרְצִי וְאֶל מוֹלַדְתִּי אֵלֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לֹא אֵלֵךְ כִּי אִם אֶל אַרְצִי וְאֶל מוֹלַדְתִּי אֵלֵךְ׃

english.text:
And he said to him, “I won’t go, but rather I’ll go to my
land and to my birthplace.”

translation.text: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.

verses.english:
And he said to him, “I won’t go, but rather I’ll go to my
land and to my birthplace.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל נָא תַּעֲזֹב אֹתָנוּ כִּי עַל כֵּן יָדַעְתָּ חֲנֹתֵנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר וְהָיִיתָ לָּנוּ לְעֵינָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל נָא תַּעֲזֹב אֹתָנוּ כִּי עַל כֵּן יָדַעְתָּ חֲנֹתֵנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר וְהָיִיתָ לָּנוּ לְעֵינָיִם׃

english.text:
And he said, “Don’t leave us, because you know the way we
should camp in the wilderness, and you’ll be eyes for us.

translation.text: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.

verses.english:
And he said, “Don’t leave us, because you know the way we
should camp in the wilderness, and you’ll be eyes for us.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי תֵלֵךְ עִמָּנוּ וְהָיָה הַטּוֹב הַהוּא אֲשֶׁר יֵיטִיב יְהֹוָה עִמָּנוּ וְהֵטַבְנוּ לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי תֵלֵךְ עִמָּנוּ וְהָיָה הַטּוֹב הַהוּא אֲשֶׁר יֵיטִיב יְהֹוָה עִמָּנוּ וְהֵטַבְנוּ לָךְ׃

english.text:
And it will be, when you go with us, that we’ll do good
for you in proportion to the good that YHWH will do for
us.”

translation.text: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.

verses.english:
And it will be, when you go with us, that we’ll do good
for you in proportion to the good that YHWH will do for
us.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהַר יְהֹוָה דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וַאֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה נֹסֵעַ לִפְנֵיהֶם דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים לָתוּר לָהֶם מְנוּחָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהַר יְהֹוָה דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וַאֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה נֹסֵעַ לִפְנֵיהֶם דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים לָתוּר לָהֶם מְנוּחָה׃

english.text:
And they traveled from the mountain of YHWH three days’
journey. And the ark of the covenant of YHWH traveled in
front of them three days’ journey to scout a resting place
for them.

translation.text: And they departed from the mount of the LORD three days’ journey: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days’ journey, to search out a resting place for them.

verses.english:
And they traveled from the mountain of YHWH three days’
journey. And the ark of the covenant of YHWH traveled in
front of them three days’ journey to scout a resting place
for them.

verses.hebrew: וַעֲנַן יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיהֶם יוֹמָם בְּנסְעָם מִן הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲנַן יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיהֶם יוֹמָם בְּנסְעָם מִן הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And YHWH’s cloud was over them by day as they traveled
from the camp.

translation.text: And the cloud of the LORD was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.

verses.english:
And YHWH’s cloud was over them by day as they traveled
from the camp.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּנְסֹעַ הָאָרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה קוּמָה יְהֹוָה וְיָפֻצוּ אֹיְבֶיךָ וְיָנֻסוּ מְשַׂנְאֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּנְסֹעַ הָאָרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה קוּמָה יְהֹוָה וְיָפֻצוּ אֹיְבֶיךָ וְיָנֻסוּ מְשַׂנְאֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And it was, when the ark traveled, that Moses said,
“Arise, YHWH, and let your enemies be scattered, and let
those who hate you flee from your presence,”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.

verses.english:
And it was, when the ark traveled, that Moses said,
“Arise, YHWH, and let your enemies be scattered, and let
those who hate you flee from your presence,”

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֻחֹה יֹאמַר שׁוּבָה יְהֹוָה רִבְבוֹת אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֻחֹה יֹאמַר שׁוּבָה יְהֹוָה רִבְבוֹת אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
and when it rested, he said, “Come back, YHWH, the ten
thousands of thousands of Israel.”

translation.text: And when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD, unto the many thousands of Israel.

verses.english:
and when it rested, he said, “Come back, YHWH, the ten
thousands of thousands of Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הָעָם כְּמִתְאֹנְנִים רַע בְּאזְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ וַתִּבְעַר בָּם אֵשׁ יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל בִּקְצֵה הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הָעָם כְּמִתְאֹנְנִים רַע בְּאזְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ וַתִּבְעַר בָּם אֵשׁ יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל בִּקְצֵה הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And the people were like grumblers, bad in YHWH’s ears,
and YHWH heard, and His anger flared, and a fire of YHWH
burned among them and consumed at the edge of the camp.

translation.text: And when the people complained, it displeased the LORD: and the LORD heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the LORD burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.

verses.english:
And the people were like grumblers, bad in YHWH’s ears,
and YHWH heard, and His anger flared, and a fire of YHWH
burned among them and consumed at the edge of the camp.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְעַק הָעָם אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה וַתִּשְׁקַע הָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצְעַק הָעָם אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה וַתִּשְׁקַע הָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
And the people cried out to Moses, and Moses prayed to
YHWH, and the fire subsided.

translation.text: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the LORD, the fire was quenched.

verses.english:
And the people cried out to Moses, and Moses prayed to
YHWH, and the fire subsided.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא תַּבְעֵרָה כִּי בָעֲרָה בָם אֵשׁ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא תַּבְעֵרָה כִּי בָעֲרָה בָם אֵשׁ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he called that place’s name Taberah because a fire of
YHWH burned among them.

translation.text: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.

verses.english:
And he called that place’s name Taberah because a fire of
YHWH burned among them.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאסַפְסֻף אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבּוֹ הִתְאַוּוּ תַּאֲוָה וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיִּבְכּוּ גַּם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ מִי יַאֲכִלֵנוּ בָּשָׂר׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאסַפְסֻף אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבּוֹ הִתְאַוּוּ תַּאֲוָה וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיִּבְכּוּ גַּם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ מִי יַאֲכִלֵנוּ בָּשָׂר׃

english.text:
And the gathered mass who were among them had a longing,
and the children of Israel, as well, went back and cried,
and they said, “Who will feed us meat?

translation.text: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?

verses.english:
And the gathered mass who were among them had a longing,
and the children of Israel, as well, went back and cried,
and they said, “Who will feed us meat?

verses.hebrew: זָכַרְנוּ אֶת הַדָּגָה אֲשֶׁר נֹאכַל בְּמִצְרַיִם חִנָּם אֵת הַקִּשֻּׁאִים וְאֵת הָאֲבַטִּחִים וְאֶת הֶחָצִיר וְאֶת הַבְּצָלִים וְאֶת הַשּׁוּמִים׃

hebrew.text: זָכַרְנוּ אֶת הַדָּגָה אֲשֶׁר נֹאכַל בְּמִצְרַיִם חִנָּם אֵת הַקִּשֻּׁאִים וְאֵת הָאֲבַטִּחִים וְאֶת הֶחָצִיר וְאֶת הַבְּצָלִים וְאֶת הַשּׁוּמִים׃

english.text:
We remember the fish that we would eat in Egypt for free:
the cucumbers and the melons and the leek and the onions
and the garlics.

translation.text: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:

verses.english:
We remember the fish that we would eat in Egypt for free:
the cucumbers and the melons and the leek and the onions
and the garlics.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה נַפְשֵׁנוּ יְבֵשָׁה אֵין כֹּל בִּלְתִּי אֶל הַמָּן עֵינֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה נַפְשֵׁנוּ יְבֵשָׁה אֵין כֹּל בִּלְתִּי אֶל הַמָּן עֵינֵינוּ׃

english.text:
And now, our soul is dried up. There isn’t anything—except
the manna before our eyes.”

translation.text: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.

verses.english:
And now, our soul is dried up. There isn’t anything—except
the manna before our eyes.”

verses.hebrew: וְהַמָּן כִּזְרַע גַּד הוּא וְעֵינוֹ כְּעֵין הַבְּדֹלַח׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמָּן כִּזְרַע גַּד הוּא וְעֵינוֹ כְּעֵין הַבְּדֹלַח׃

english.text:
And the manna: it was like a seed of coriander, and its
appearance was like the appearance of bdellium.

translation.text: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.

verses.english:
And the manna: it was like a seed of coriander, and its
appearance was like the appearance of bdellium.

verses.hebrew: שָׁטוּ הָעָם וְלָקְטוּ וְטָחֲנוּ בָרֵחַיִם אוֹ דָכוּ בַּמְּדֹכָה וּבִשְּׁלוּ בַּפָּרוּר וְעָשׂוּ אֹתוֹ עֻגוֹת וְהָיָה טַעְמוֹ כְּטַעַם לְשַׁד הַשָּׁמֶן׃

hebrew.text: שָׁטוּ הָעָם וְלָקְטוּ וְטָחֲנוּ בָרֵחַיִם אוֹ דָכוּ בַּמְּדֹכָה וּבִשְּׁלוּ בַּפָּרוּר וְעָשׂוּ אֹתוֹ עֻגוֹת וְהָיָה טַעְמוֹ כְּטַעַם לְשַׁד הַשָּׁמֶן׃

english.text:
The people went around and collected and ground it in
mills or pounded it in a mortar and cooked it in a pot and
made it into cakes. And its taste was like the taste of
something creamy made with oil.

translation.text: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.

verses.english:
The people went around and collected and ground it in
mills or pounded it in a mortar and cooked it in a pot and
made it into cakes. And its taste was like the taste of
something creamy made with oil.

verses.hebrew: וּבְרֶדֶת הַטַּל עַל הַמַּחֲנֶה לָיְלָה יֵרֵד הַמָּן עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וּבְרֶדֶת הַטַּל עַל הַמַּחֲנֶה לָיְלָה יֵרֵד הַמָּן עָלָיו׃

english.text:
And when the dew descended on the camp at night, the manna
would descend on it.

translation.text: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.

verses.english:
And when the dew descended on the camp at night, the manna
would descend on it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָעָם בֹּכֶה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָיו אִישׁ לְפֶתַח אהֳלוֹ וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה מְאֹד וּבְעֵינֵי מֹשֶׁה רָע׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָעָם בֹּכֶה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָיו אִישׁ לְפֶתַח אהֳלוֹ וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה מְאֹד וּבְעֵינֵי מֹשֶׁה רָע׃

english.text:
And Moses heard the people crying by their families, each
at his tent entrance, and YHWH’s anger flared very much,
and it was bad in Moses’ eyes.

translation.text: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.

verses.english:
And Moses heard the people crying by their families, each
at his tent entrance, and YHWH’s anger flared very much,
and it was bad in Moses’ eyes.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה לָמָה הֲרֵעֹתָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ וְלָמָּה לֹא מָצָתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ לָשׂוּם אֶת מַשָּׂא כּל הָעָם הַזֶּה עָלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה לָמָה הֲרֵעֹתָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ וְלָמָּה לֹא מָצָתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ לָשׂוּם אֶת מַשָּׂא כּל הָעָם הַזֶּה עָלָי׃

english.text:
And Moses said to YHWH, “Why have you done bad to your
servant, and why have I not found favor in your eyes, to
set the burden of this entire people on me?

translation.text: And Moses said unto the LORD, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?

verses.english:
And Moses said to YHWH, “Why have you done bad to your
servant, and why have I not found favor in your eyes, to
set the burden of this entire people on me?

verses.hebrew: הֶאָנֹכִי הָרִיתִי אֵת כּל הָעָם הַזֶּה אִם אָנֹכִי יְלִדְתִּיהוּ כִּי תֹאמַר אֵלַי שָׂאֵהוּ בְחֵיקֶךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִשָּׂא הָאֹמֵן אֶת הַיֹּנֵק עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לַאֲבֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: הֶאָנֹכִי הָרִיתִי אֵת כּל הָעָם הַזֶּה אִם אָנֹכִי יְלִדְתִּיהוּ כִּי תֹאמַר אֵלַי שָׂאֵהוּ בְחֵיקֶךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִשָּׂא הָאֹמֵן אֶת הַיֹּנֵק עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לַאֲבֹתָיו׃

english.text:
Did I conceive this entire people? Did I give birth to it,
that you should say to me, ‘Carry it in your bosom,’ the
way a nurse carries a suckling, to the land that you swore
to its fathers?

translation.text: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?

verses.english:
Did I conceive this entire people? Did I give birth to it,
that you should say to me, ‘Carry it in your bosom,’ the
way a nurse carries a suckling, to the land that you swore
to its fathers?

verses.hebrew: מֵאַיִן לִי בָּשָׂר לָתֵת לְכל הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי יִבְכּוּ עָלַי לֵאמֹר תְּנָה לָּנוּ בָשָׂר וְנֹאכֵלָה׃

hebrew.text: מֵאַיִן לִי בָּשָׂר לָתֵת לְכל הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי יִבְכּוּ עָלַי לֵאמֹר תְּנָה לָּנוּ בָשָׂר וְנֹאכֵלָה׃

english.text:
From where do I have meat to give to this entire people,
that they cry at me, saying, ‘Give us meat, and let’s
eat’?

translation.text: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.

verses.english:
From where do I have meat to give to this entire people,
that they cry at me, saying, ‘Give us meat, and let’s
eat’?

verses.hebrew: לֹא אוּכַל אָנֹכִי לְבַדִּי לָשֵׂאת אֶת כּל הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי כָבֵד מִמֶּנִּי׃

hebrew.text: לֹא אוּכַל אָנֹכִי לְבַדִּי לָשֵׂאת אֶת כּל הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי כָבֵד מִמֶּנִּי׃

english.text:
I’m not able, I, by myself, to carry this entire people,
because it’s too heavy for me.

translation.text: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

verses.english:
I’m not able, I, by myself, to carry this entire people,
because it’s too heavy for me.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם כָּכָה אַתְּ עֹשֶׂה לִּי הרְגֵנִי נָא הָרֹג אִם מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וְאַל אֶרְאֶה בְּרָעָתִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם כָּכָה אַתְּ עֹשֶׂה לִּי הרְגֵנִי נָא הָרֹג אִם מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וְאַל אֶרְאֶה בְּרָעָתִי׃

english.text:
And if this is how you treat me, kill me, if I’ve found
favor in your eyes, and let me not see my suffering.”

translation.text: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.

verses.english:
And if this is how you treat me, kill me, if I’ve found
favor in your eyes, and let me not see my suffering.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֶסְפָה לִּי שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ מִזִּקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יָדַעְתָּ כִּי הֵם זִקְנֵי הָעָם וְשֹׁטְרָיו וְלָקַחְתָּ אֹתָם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהִתְיַצְּבוּ שָׁם עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֶסְפָה לִּי שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ מִזִּקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יָדַעְתָּ כִּי הֵם זִקְנֵי הָעָם וְשֹׁטְרָיו וְלָקַחְתָּ אֹתָם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהִתְיַצְּבוּ שָׁם עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men from
Israel’s elders whom you’ve known because they’re the
people’s elders and its officers, and you’ll take them to
the Tent of Meeting, and they’ll stand up there with you.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men from
Israel’s elders whom you’ve known because they’re the
people’s elders and its officers, and you’ll take them to
the Tent of Meeting, and they’ll stand up there with you.

verses.hebrew: וְיָרַדְתִּי וְדִבַּרְתִּי עִמְּךָ שָׁם וְאָצַלְתִּי מִן הָרוּחַ אֲשֶׁר עָלֶיךָ וְשַׂמְתִּי עֲלֵיהֶם וְנָשְׂאוּ אִתְּךָ בְּמַשָּׂא הָעָם וְלֹא תִשָּׂא אַתָּה לְבַדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְיָרַדְתִּי וְדִבַּרְתִּי עִמְּךָ שָׁם וְאָצַלְתִּי מִן הָרוּחַ אֲשֶׁר עָלֶיךָ וְשַׂמְתִּי עֲלֵיהֶם וְנָשְׂאוּ אִתְּךָ בְּמַשָּׂא הָעָם וְלֹא תִשָּׂא אַתָּה לְבַדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And I’ll come down and speak with you there, and I’ll take
some of the spirit that is on you, and I’ll set it on
them, and they’ll carry the burden of the people with you,
and you won’t bear it, you, by yourself.

translation.text: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.

verses.english:
And I’ll come down and speak with you there, and I’ll take
some of the spirit that is on you, and I’ll set it on
them, and they’ll carry the burden of the people with you,
and you won’t bear it, you, by yourself.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל הָעָם תֹּאמַר הִתְקַדְּשׁוּ לְמָחָר וַאֲכַלְתֶּם בָּשָׂר כִּי בְּכִיתֶם בְּאזְנֵי יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר מִי יַאֲכִלֵנוּ בָּשָׂר כִּי טוֹב לָנוּ בְּמִצְרָיִם וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה לָכֶם בָּשָׂר וַאֲכַלְתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל הָעָם תֹּאמַר הִתְקַדְּשׁוּ לְמָחָר וַאֲכַלְתֶּם בָּשָׂר כִּי בְּכִיתֶם בְּאזְנֵי יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר מִי יַאֲכִלֵנוּ בָּשָׂר כִּי טוֹב לָנוּ בְּמִצְרָיִם וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה לָכֶם בָּשָׂר וַאֲכַלְתֶּם׃

english.text:
And you shall say to the people, ‘Consecrate yourselves
for tomorrow, and you’ll eat meat, because you cried in
YHWH’s ears saying: Who will feed us meat, because we had
it good in Egypt. And YHWH will give you meat, and you’ll
eat.

translation.text: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.

verses.english:
And you shall say to the people, ‘Consecrate yourselves
for tomorrow, and you’ll eat meat, because you cried in
YHWH’s ears saying: Who will feed us meat, because we had
it good in Egypt. And YHWH will give you meat, and you’ll
eat.

verses.hebrew: לֹא יוֹם אֶחָד תֹּאכְלוּן וְלֹא יוֹמָיִם וְלֹא חֲמִשָּׁה יָמִים וְלֹא עֲשָׂרָה יָמִים וְלֹא עֶשְׂרִים יוֹם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יוֹם אֶחָד תֹּאכְלוּן וְלֹא יוֹמָיִם וְלֹא חֲמִשָּׁה יָמִים וְלֹא עֲשָׂרָה יָמִים וְלֹא עֶשְׂרִים יוֹם׃

english.text:
You’ll eat not for one day and not two days and not five
days and not ten days and not ten days and not twenty
days.

translation.text: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;

verses.english:
You’ll eat not for one day and not two days and not five
days and not ten days and not ten days and not twenty
days.

verses.hebrew: עַד חֹדֶשׁ יָמִים עַד אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מֵאַפְּכֶם וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְזָרָא יַעַן כִּי מְאַסְתֶּם אֶת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וַתִּבְכּוּ לְפָנָיו לֵאמֹר לָמָּה זֶּה יָצָאנוּ מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: עַד חֹדֶשׁ יָמִים עַד אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מֵאַפְּכֶם וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְזָרָא יַעַן כִּי מְאַסְתֶּם אֶת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וַתִּבְכּוּ לְפָנָיו לֵאמֹר לָמָּה זֶּה יָצָאנוּ מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
Until a month of days! Until it will come out of your
nose, and it will be a revulsion to you! Because you
rejected YHWH, who was among you, and you cried in front
of him, saying: Why is this that we went out from Egypt?’”

translation.text: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the LORD which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?

verses.english:
Until a month of days! Until it will come out of your
nose, and it will be a revulsion to you! Because you
rejected YHWH, who was among you, and you cried in front
of him, saying: Why is this that we went out from Egypt?’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף רַגְלִי הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְאַתָּה אָמַרְתָּ בָּשָׂר אֶתֵּן לָהֶם וְאָכְלוּ חֹדֶשׁ יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף רַגְלִי הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְאַתָּה אָמַרְתָּ בָּשָׂר אֶתֵּן לָהֶם וְאָכְלוּ חֹדֶשׁ יָמִים׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “The people among whom I am are six
hundred thousand on foot, and you’ve said, ‘I’ll give them
meat, and they’ll eat for a month of days!’

translation.text: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “The people among whom I am are six
hundred thousand on foot, and you’ve said, ‘I’ll give them
meat, and they’ll eat for a month of days!’

verses.hebrew: הֲצֹאן וּבָקָר יִשָּׁחֵט לָהֶם וּמָצָא לָהֶם אִם אֶת כּל דְּגֵי הַיָּם יֵאָסֵף לָהֶם וּמָצָא לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: הֲצֹאן וּבָקָר יִשָּׁחֵט לָהֶם וּמָצָא לָהֶם אִם אֶת כּל דְּגֵי הַיָּם יֵאָסֵף לָהֶם וּמָצָא לָהֶם׃

english.text:
Will flock and herd be slaughtered for them, and would it
provide for them? Or will all the sea’s fish be gathered
for them, and would it provide for them?”

translation.text: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?

verses.english:
Will flock and herd be slaughtered for them, and would it
provide for them? Or will all the sea’s fish be gathered
for them, and would it provide for them?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הֲיַד יְהֹוָה תִּקְצָר עַתָּה תִרְאֶה הֲיִקְרְךָ דְבָרִי אִם לֹא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הֲיַד יְהֹוָה תִּקְצָר עַתָּה תִרְאֶה הֲיִקְרְךָ דְבָרִי אִם לֹא׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Is YHWH’s hand getting short?!
Now you’ll see if my word happens to you or not.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD’s hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Is YHWH’s hand getting short?!
Now you’ll see if my word happens to you or not.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא מֹשֶׁה וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל הָעָם אֵת דִּבְרֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֶּאֱסֹף שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ מִזִּקְנֵי הָעָם וַיַּעֲמֵד אֹתָם סְבִיבֹת הָאֹהֶל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא מֹשֶׁה וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל הָעָם אֵת דִּבְרֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֶּאֱסֹף שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ מִזִּקְנֵי הָעָם וַיַּעֲמֵד אֹתָם סְבִיבֹת הָאֹהֶל׃

english.text:
And Moses went out and spoke YHWH’s words to the people.
And he gathered seventy men from the people’s elders, and
he stood them around the tent.

translation.text: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.

verses.english:
And Moses went out and spoke YHWH’s words to the people.
And he gathered seventy men from the people’s elders, and
he stood them around the tent.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּעָנָן וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו וַיָּאצֶל מִן הָרוּחַ אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו וַיִּתֵּן עַל שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ הַזְּקֵנִים וַיְהִי כְּנוֹחַ עֲלֵיהֶם הָרוּחַ וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ וְלֹא יָסָפוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּעָנָן וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו וַיָּאצֶל מִן הָרוּחַ אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו וַיִּתֵּן עַל שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ הַזְּקֵנִים וַיְהִי כְּנוֹחַ עֲלֵיהֶם הָרוּחַ וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ וְלֹא יָסָפוּ׃

english.text:
And YHWH came down in a cloud and spoke to him and took
some of the spirit that was on him and put it on the
seventy men of the elders. And it was when the spirit
rested on them: and they prophesied. Then they did not do
it anymore.

translation.text: And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.

verses.english:
And YHWH came down in a cloud and spoke to him and took
some of the spirit that was on him and put it on the
seventy men of the elders. And it was when the spirit
rested on them: and they prophesied. Then they did not do
it anymore.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׁאֲרוּ שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים בַּמַּחֲנֶה שֵׁם הָאֶחָד אֶלְדָּד וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִי מֵידָד וַתָּנַח עֲלֵהֶם הָרוּחַ וְהֵמָּה בַּכְּתֻבִים וְלֹא יָצְאוּ הָאֹהֱלָה וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׁאֲרוּ שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים בַּמַּחֲנֶה שֵׁם הָאֶחָד אֶלְדָּד וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִי מֵידָד וַתָּנַח עֲלֵהֶם הָרוּחַ וְהֵמָּה בַּכְּתֻבִים וְלֹא יָצְאוּ הָאֹהֱלָה וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And two men had been left in the camp. One’s name was
Eldad, and the second’s name was Medad. And the spirit
rested on them. And they were among the ones who were
written, but they did not go out to the tent, and they
prophesied in the camp.

translation.text: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.

verses.english:
And two men had been left in the camp. One’s name was
Eldad, and the second’s name was Medad. And the spirit
rested on them. And they were among the ones who were
written, but they did not go out to the tent, and they
prophesied in the camp.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרץ הַנַּעַר וַיַּגֵּד לְמֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמַר אֶלְדָּד וּמֵידָד מִתְנַבְּאִים בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּרץ הַנַּעַר וַיַּגֵּד לְמֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמַר אֶלְדָּד וּמֵידָד מִתְנַבְּאִים בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And a boy ran and told Moses, and he said, “Eldad and
Medad are prophesying in the camp!”

translation.text: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.

verses.english:
And a boy ran and told Moses, and he said, “Eldad and
Medad are prophesying in the camp!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן מְשָׁרֵת מֹשֶׁה מִבְּחֻרָיו וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנִי מֹשֶׁה כְּלָאֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן מְשָׁרֵת מֹשֶׁה מִבְּחֻרָיו וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנִי מֹשֶׁה כְּלָאֵם׃

english.text:
And Joshua, son of Nun, Moses’ attendant from his chosen
ones, answered, and he said, “My lord Moses, restrain
them!”

translation.text: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.

verses.english:
And Joshua, son of Nun, Moses’ attendant from his chosen
ones, answered, and he said, “My lord Moses, restrain
them!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מֹשֶׁה הַמְקַנֵּא אַתָּה לִי וּמִי יִתֵּן כּל עַם יְהֹוָה נְבִיאִים כִּי יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת רוּחוֹ עֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מֹשֶׁה הַמְקַנֵּא אַתָּה לִי וּמִי יִתֵּן כּל עַם יְהֹוָה נְבִיאִים כִּי יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת רוּחוֹ עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for me? And who
would make it so that all of YHWH’s people were prophets,
that YHWH would put His spirit on them!”

translation.text: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the LORD’s people were prophets, and that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!

verses.english:
And Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for me? And who
would make it so that all of YHWH’s people were prophets,
that YHWH would put His spirit on them!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּאָסֵף מֹשֶׁה אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה הוּא וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּאָסֵף מֹשֶׁה אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה הוּא וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses was gathered back to the camp, he and Israel’s
elders.

translation.text: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

verses.english:
And Moses was gathered back to the camp, he and Israel’s
elders.

verses.hebrew: וְרוּחַ נָסַע מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה וַיָּגז שַׂלְוִים מִן הַיָּם וַיִּטֹּשׁ עַל הַמַּחֲנֶה כְּדֶרֶךְ יוֹם כֹּה וּכְדֶרֶךְ יוֹם כֹּה סְבִיבוֹת הַמַּחֲנֶה וּכְאַמָּתַיִם עַל פְּנֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְרוּחַ נָסַע מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה וַיָּגז שַׂלְוִים מִן הַיָּם וַיִּטֹּשׁ עַל הַמַּחֲנֶה כְּדֶרֶךְ יוֹם כֹּה וּכְדֶרֶךְ יוֹם כֹּה סְבִיבוֹת הַמַּחֲנֶה וּכְאַמָּתַיִם עַל פְּנֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And a wind traveled from YHWH and transported quails from
the sea and left them on the camp, about a day’s journey
in one direction and about a day’s journey in the other
around the camp, and about two cubits on the face of the
earth.

translation.text: And there went forth a wind from the LORD, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day’s journey on this side, and as it were a day’s journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.

verses.english:
And a wind traveled from YHWH and transported quails from
the sea and left them on the camp, about a day’s journey
in one direction and about a day’s journey in the other
around the camp, and about two cubits on the face of the
earth.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם הָעָם כּל הַיּוֹם הַהוּא וְכל הַלַּיְלָה וְכֹל יוֹם הַמּחֳרָת וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֶת הַשְּׂלָו הַמַּמְעִיט אָסַף עֲשָׂרָה חֳמָרִים וַיִּשְׁטְחוּ לָהֶם שָׁטוֹחַ סְבִיבוֹת הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם הָעָם כּל הַיּוֹם הַהוּא וְכל הַלַּיְלָה וְכֹל יוֹם הַמּחֳרָת וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֶת הַשְּׂלָו הַמַּמְעִיט אָסַף עֲשָׂרָה חֳמָרִים וַיִּשְׁטְחוּ לָהֶם שָׁטוֹחַ סְבִיבוֹת הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And the people got up all that day and all night and all
the next day and gathered the quail. The one who had the
least gathered ten homers. And they spread them out,
spreading around the camp.

translation.text: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.

verses.english:
And the people got up all that day and all night and all
the next day and gathered the quail. The one who had the
least gathered ten homers. And they spread them out,
spreading around the camp.

verses.hebrew: הַבָּשָׂר עוֹדֶנּוּ בֵּין שִׁנֵּיהֶם טֶרֶם יִכָּרֵת וְאַף יְהֹוָה חָרָה בָעָם וַיַּךְ יְהֹוָה בָּעָם מַכָּה רַבָּה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: הַבָּשָׂר עוֹדֶנּוּ בֵּין שִׁנֵּיהֶם טֶרֶם יִכָּרֵת וְאַף יְהֹוָה חָרָה בָעָם וַיַּךְ יְהֹוָה בָּעָם מַכָּה רַבָּה מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And the meat was still between their teeth, not yet
chewed, and YHWH’s anger flared at the people, and YHWH
struck at the people, a very great strike.

translation.text: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.

verses.english:
And the meat was still between their teeth, not yet
chewed, and YHWH’s anger flared at the people, and YHWH
struck at the people, a very great strike.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא קִבְרוֹת הַתַּאֲוָה כִּי שָׁם קָבְרוּ אֶת הָעָם הַמִּתְאַוִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא קִבְרוֹת הַתַּאֲוָה כִּי שָׁם קָבְרוּ אֶת הָעָם הַמִּתְאַוִּים׃

english.text:
And he called that place’s name Kibroth Hattaavah, because
they buried the people who were longing there.

translation.text: And he called the name of that place Kibrothhattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.

verses.english:
And he called that place’s name Kibroth Hattaavah, because
they buried the people who were longing there.

verses.hebrew: מִקִּבְרוֹת הַתַּאֲוָה נָסְעוּ הָעָם חֲצֵרוֹת וַיִּהְיוּ בַּחֲצֵרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: מִקִּבְרוֹת הַתַּאֲוָה נָסְעוּ הָעָם חֲצֵרוֹת וַיִּהְיוּ בַּחֲצֵרוֹת׃

english.text:
From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth,
and they were in Hazeroth.

translation.text: And the people journeyed from Kibrothhattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.

verses.english:
From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth,
and they were in Hazeroth.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּדַבֵּר מִרְיָם וְאַהֲרֹן בְּמֹשֶׁה עַל אֹדוֹת הָאִשָּׁה הַכֻּשִׁית אֲשֶׁר לָקָח כִּי אִשָּׁה כֻשִׁית לָקָח׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּדַבֵּר מִרְיָם וְאַהֲרֹן בְּמֹשֶׁה עַל אֹדוֹת הָאִשָּׁה הַכֻּשִׁית אֲשֶׁר לָקָח כִּי אִשָּׁה כֻשִׁית לָקָח׃

english.text:
And Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses about the
Cushite wife whom he had taken—because he had taken a
Cushite wife.

translation.text: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.

verses.english:
And Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses about the
Cushite wife whom he had taken—because he had taken a
Cushite wife.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הֲרַק אַךְ בְּמֹשֶׁה דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה הֲלֹא גַּם בָּנוּ דִבֵּר וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הֲרַק אַךְ בְּמֹשֶׁה דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה הֲלֹא גַּם בָּנוּ דִבֵּר וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And they said, “Has YHWH only just spoken through Moses?
Hasn’t He also spoken through us?” And YHWH heard.

translation.text: And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard it.

verses.english:
And they said, “Has YHWH only just spoken through Moses?
Hasn’t He also spoken through us?” And YHWH heard.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאִישׁ מֹשֶׁה עָנָו מְאֹד מִכֹּל הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאִישׁ מֹשֶׁה עָנָו מְאֹד מִכֹּל הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
And the man Moses was very humble, more than every human
who was on the face of the earth.

translation.text: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)

verses.english:
And the man Moses was very humble, more than every human
who was on the face of the earth.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה פִּתְאֹם אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל מִרְיָם צְאוּ שְׁלשְׁתְּכֶם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁלשְׁתָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה פִּתְאֹם אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל מִרְיָם צְאוּ שְׁלשְׁתְּכֶם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁלשְׁתָּם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said suddenly to Moses and to Aaron and to
Miriam, “Go out, the three of you, to the Tent of
Meeting.” And the three of them went out.

translation.text: And the LORD spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.

verses.english:
And YHWH said suddenly to Moses and to Aaron and to
Miriam, “Go out, the three of you, to the Tent of
Meeting.” And the three of them went out.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד יְהֹוָה בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן וַיַּעֲמֹד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וַיִּקְרָא אַהֲרֹן וּמִרְיָם וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד יְהֹוָה בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן וַיַּעֲמֹד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וַיִּקְרָא אַהֲרֹן וּמִרְיָם וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And YHWH came down in a column of cloud and stood at the
entrance of the tent. And He called, “Aaron and Miriam.”
And the two of them went out.

translation.text: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.

verses.english:
And YHWH came down in a column of cloud and stood at the
entrance of the tent. And He called, “Aaron and Miriam.”
And the two of them went out.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְעוּ נָא דְבָרָי אִם יִהְיֶה נְבִיאֲכֶם יְהֹוָה בַּמַּרְאָה אֵלָיו אֶתְוַדָּע בַּחֲלוֹם אֲדַבֶּר בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְעוּ נָא דְבָרָי אִם יִהְיֶה נְבִיאֲכֶם יְהֹוָה בַּמַּרְאָה אֵלָיו אֶתְוַדָּע בַּחֲלוֹם אֲדַבֶּר בּוֹ׃

english.text:
And He said, “Hear my words: If there will be a prophet
among you, I, YHWH, shall be known to him in a vision; in
a dream I shall speak through him.

translation.text: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.

verses.english:
And He said, “Hear my words: If there will be a prophet
among you, I, YHWH, shall be known to him in a vision; in
a dream I shall speak through him.

verses.hebrew: לֹא כֵן עַבְדִּי מֹשֶׁה בְּכל בֵּיתִי נֶאֱמָן הוּא׃

hebrew.text: לֹא כֵן עַבְדִּי מֹשֶׁה בְּכל בֵּיתִי נֶאֱמָן הוּא׃

english.text:
Not so is my servant Moses; in all my house he is
faithful.

translation.text: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.

verses.english:
Not so is my servant Moses; in all my house he is
faithful.

verses.hebrew: פֶּה אֶל פֶּה אֲדַבֶּר בּוֹ וּמַרְאֶה וְלֹא בְחִידֹת וּתְמֻנַת יְהֹוָה יַבִּיט וּמַדּוּעַ לֹא יְרֵאתֶם לְדַבֵּר בְּעַבְדִּי בְמֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: פֶּה אֶל פֶּה אֲדַבֶּר בּוֹ וּמַרְאֶה וְלֹא בְחִידֹת וּתְמֻנַת יְהֹוָה יַבִּיט וּמַדּוּעַ לֹא יְרֵאתֶם לְדַבֵּר בְּעַבְדִּי בְמֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
Mouth to mouth I shall speak through him and vision and
not in enigmas, and he will see the form of YHWH. And why
did you not fear to speak against my servant, against
Moses?”

translation.text: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?

verses.english:
Mouth to mouth I shall speak through him and vision and
not in enigmas, and he will see the form of YHWH. And why
did you not fear to speak against my servant, against
Moses?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בָּם וַיֵּלַךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בָּם וַיֵּלַךְ׃

english.text: And YHWH’s anger flared against them, and He went.

translation.text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.

verses.english: And YHWH’s anger flared against them, and He went.

verses.hebrew: וְהֶעָנָן סָר מֵעַל הָאֹהֶל וְהִנֵּה מִרְיָם מְצֹרַעַת כַּשָּׁלֶג וַיִּפֶן אַהֲרֹן אֶל מִרְיָם וְהִנֵּה מְצֹרָעַת׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶעָנָן סָר מֵעַל הָאֹהֶל וְהִנֵּה מִרְיָם מְצֹרַעַת כַּשָּׁלֶג וַיִּפֶן אַהֲרֹן אֶל מִרְיָם וְהִנֵּה מְצֹרָעַת׃

english.text:
And the cloud turned from over the tent; and, here, Miriam
was leprous, like snow. And Aaron turned to Miriam, and,
here, she was leprous.

translation.text: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.

verses.english:
And the cloud turned from over the tent; and, here, Miriam
was leprous, like snow. And Aaron turned to Miriam, and,
here, she was leprous.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַהֲרֹן אֶל מֹשֶׁה בִּי אֲדֹנִי אַל נָא תָשֵׁת עָלֵינוּ חַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר נוֹאַלְנוּ וַאֲשֶׁר חָטָאנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַהֲרֹן אֶל מֹשֶׁה בִּי אֲדֹנִי אַל נָא תָשֵׁת עָלֵינוּ חַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר נוֹאַלְנוּ וַאֲשֶׁר חָטָאנוּ׃

english.text:
And Aaron said to Moses, “In me, my lord. Don’t set a sin
on us, which we did foolishly and which we sinned.

translation.text: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.

verses.english:
And Aaron said to Moses, “In me, my lord. Don’t set a sin
on us, which we did foolishly and which we sinned.

verses.hebrew: אַל נָא תְהִי כַּמֵּת אֲשֶׁר בְּצֵאתוֹ מֵרֶחֶם אִמּוֹ וַיֵּאָכֵל חֲצִי בְשָׂרוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אַל נָא תְהִי כַּמֵּת אֲשֶׁר בְּצֵאתוֹ מֵרֶחֶם אִמּוֹ וַיֵּאָכֵל חֲצִי בְשָׂרוֹ׃

english.text:
Let her not be like the dead who, when he comes out of his
mother’s womb, half of his flesh is eaten up!”

translation.text: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother’s womb.

verses.english:
Let her not be like the dead who, when he comes out of his
mother’s womb, half of his flesh is eaten up!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְעַק מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר אֵל נָא רְפָא נָא לָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצְעַק מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר אֵל נָא רְפָא נָא לָהּ׃

english.text: And Moses cried out to YHWH, saying, “Oh, God, heal her!”

translation.text: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.

verses.english: And Moses cried out to YHWH, saying, “Oh, God, heal her!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאָבִיהָ יָרֹק יָרַק בְּפָנֶיהָ הֲלֹא תִכָּלֵם שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תִּסָּגֵר שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְאַחַר תֵּאָסֵף׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאָבִיהָ יָרֹק יָרַק בְּפָנֶיהָ הֲלֹא תִכָּלֵם שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תִּסָּגֵר שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְאַחַר תֵּאָסֵף׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “And if her father had spit in her
face, wouldn’t she be humiliated seven days? Let her be
closed up seven days outside the camp, and after that let
her be gathered back.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “And if her father had spit in her
face, wouldn’t she be humiliated seven days? Let her be
closed up seven days outside the camp, and after that let
her be gathered back.”

verses.hebrew: וַתִּסָּגֵר מִרְיָם מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְהָעָם לֹא נָסַע עַד הֵאָסֵף מִרְיָם׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּסָּגֵר מִרְיָם מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְהָעָם לֹא נָסַע עַד הֵאָסֵף מִרְיָם׃

english.text:
And Miriam was closed up outside the camp seven days. And
the people did not travel until Miriam was gathered back,
and after that the people traveled from Hazeroth. And they
camped in the Paran wilderness.

translation.text: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.

verses.english:
And Miriam was closed up outside the camp seven days. And
the people did not travel until Miriam was gathered back,
and after that the people traveled from Hazeroth. And they
camped in the Paran wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר נָסְעוּ הָעָם מֵחֲצֵרוֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִדְבַּר פָּארָן׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחַר נָסְעוּ הָעָם מֵחֲצֵרוֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִדְבַּר פָּארָן׃

translation.text: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: שְׁלַח לְךָ אֲנָשִׁים וְיָתֻרוּ אֶת אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ אֶחָד אִישׁ אֶחָד לְמַטֵּה אֲבֹתָיו תִּשְׁלָחוּ כֹּל נָשִׂיא בָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: שְׁלַח לְךָ אֲנָשִׁים וְיָתֻרוּ אֶת אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ אֶחָד אִישׁ אֶחָד לְמַטֵּה אֲבֹתָיו תִּשְׁלָחוּ כֹּל נָשִׂיא בָהֶם׃

english.text:
“Send men and let them scout the land of Canaan that I’m
giving to the children of Israel. You shall send one man
for each tribe of his fathers, every one of them a
chieftain.”

translation.text: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.

verses.english:
“Send men and let them scout the land of Canaan that I’m
giving to the children of Israel. You shall send one man
for each tribe of his fathers, every one of them a
chieftain.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה מִמִּדְבַּר פָּארָן עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה כֻּלָּם אֲנָשִׁים רָאשֵׁי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה מִמִּדְבַּר פָּארָן עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה כֻּלָּם אֲנָשִׁים רָאשֵׁי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵמָּה׃

english.text:
And Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran by YHWH’s
word. They were all men who were heads of the children of
Israel.

translation.text: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran by YHWH’s

the land. And Moses called Hoshea son of Nun Joshua.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה לָתוּר אֶת אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם עֲלוּ זֶה בַּנֶּגֶב וַעֲלִיתֶם אֶת הָהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה לָתוּר אֶת אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם עֲלוּ זֶה בַּנֶּגֶב וַעֲלִיתֶם אֶת הָהָר׃

english.text:
And Moses sent them to scout the land of Canaan. And he
said to them, “Go up there in the Negeb, and you shall go
up the mountain

translation.text: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:

verses.english:
And Moses sent them to scout the land of Canaan. And he
said to them, “Go up there in the Negeb, and you shall go
up the mountain

verses.hebrew: וּרְאִיתֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ מַה הִוא וְאֶת הָעָם הַיֹּשֵׁב עָלֶיהָ הֶחָזָק הוּא הֲרָפֶה הַמְעַט הוּא אִם רָב׃

hebrew.text: וּרְאִיתֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ מַה הִוא וְאֶת הָעָם הַיֹּשֵׁב עָלֶיהָ הֶחָזָק הוּא הֲרָפֶה הַמְעַט הוּא אִם רָב׃

english.text:
and see the land, how it is; and the people who live on
it, are they strong or weak, are they few or many;

translation.text: And see the land, what it is, and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;

verses.english:
and see the land, how it is; and the people who live on
it, are they strong or weak, are they few or many;

verses.hebrew: וּמָה הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הוּא יֹשֵׁב בָּהּ הֲטוֹבָה הִוא אִם רָעָה וּמָה הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר הוּא יוֹשֵׁב בָּהֵנָּה הַבְּמַחֲנִים אִם בְּמִבְצָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וּמָה הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הוּא יֹשֵׁב בָּהּ הֲטוֹבָה הִוא אִם רָעָה וּמָה הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר הוּא יוֹשֵׁב בָּהֵנָּה הַבְּמַחֲנִים אִם בְּמִבְצָרִים׃

translation.text: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;

verses.hebrew: וּמָה הָאָרֶץ הַשְּׁמֵנָה הִוא אִם רָזָה הֲיֵשׁ בָּהּ עֵץ אִם אַיִן וְהִתְחַזַּקְתֶּם וּלְקַחְתֶּם מִפְּרִי הָאָרֶץ וְהַיָּמִים יְמֵי בִּכּוּרֵי עֲנָבִים׃

hebrew.text: וּמָה הָאָרֶץ הַשְּׁמֵנָה הִוא אִם רָזָה הֲיֵשׁ בָּהּ עֵץ אִם אַיִן וְהִתְחַזַּקְתֶּם וּלְקַחְתֶּם מִפְּרִי הָאָרֶץ וְהַיָּמִים יְמֵי בִּכּוּרֵי עֲנָבִים׃

english.text:
and how is the land, is it fat or meager; does it have
trees or not; and exert strength and take some fruit of
the land.” And it was the days of the first grapes.

translation.text: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.

verses.english:
and how is the land, is it fat or meager; does it have
trees or not; and exert strength and take some fruit of
the land.” And it was the days of the first grapes.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיָּתֻרוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ מִמִּדְבַּר צִן עַד רְחֹב לְבֹא חֲמָת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיָּתֻרוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ מִמִּדְבַּר צִן עַד רְחֹב לְבֹא חֲמָת׃

english.text:
And they went up and scouted the land from the wilderness
of Zin to Rehob at the entrance of Hamath.

translation.text: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

verses.english:
And they went up and scouted the land from the wilderness
of Zin to Rehob at the entrance of Hamath.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ בַנֶּגֶב וַיָּבֹא עַד חֶבְרוֹן וְשָׁם אֲחִימַן שֵׁשַׁי וְתַלְמַי יְלִידֵי הָעֲנָק וְחֶבְרוֹן שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים נִבְנְתָה לִפְנֵי צֹעַן מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ בַנֶּגֶב וַיָּבֹא עַד חֶבְרוֹן וְשָׁם אֲחִימַן שֵׁשַׁי וְתַלְמַי יְלִידֵי הָעֲנָק וְחֶבְרוֹן שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים נִבְנְתָה לִפְנֵי צֹעַן מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And they went up in the Negeb and came to Hebron. And
Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the offspring of the giants,
were there. (And Hebron was built seven years before Zoan
of Egypt.)

translation.text: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

verses.english:
And they went up in the Negeb and came to Hebron. And
Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the offspring of the giants,
were there. (And Hebron was built seven years before Zoan
of Egypt.)

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד נַחַל אֶשְׁכֹּל וַיִּכְרְתוּ מִשָּׁם זְמוֹרָה וְאֶשְׁכּוֹל עֲנָבִים אֶחָד וַיִּשָּׂאֻהוּ בַמּוֹט בִּשְׁנָיִם וּמִן הָרִמֹּנִים וּמִן הַתְּאֵנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד נַחַל אֶשְׁכֹּל וַיִּכְרְתוּ מִשָּׁם זְמוֹרָה וְאֶשְׁכּוֹל עֲנָבִים אֶחָד וַיִּשָּׂאֻהוּ בַמּוֹט בִּשְׁנָיִם וּמִן הָרִמֹּנִים וּמִן הַתְּאֵנִים׃

english.text:
And they came to the Wadi Eshcol, and they cut a branch
and one cluster of grapes from there—and carried it on a
pole by two people—and some pomegranates and some figs.

translation.text: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

verses.english:
And they came to the Wadi Eshcol, and they cut a branch
and one cluster of grapes from there—and carried it on a
pole by two people—and some pomegranates and some figs.

verses.hebrew: לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא קָרָא נַחַל אֶשְׁכּוֹל עַל אֹדוֹת הָאֶשְׁכּוֹל אֲשֶׁר כָּרְתוּ מִשָּׁם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא קָרָא נַחַל אֶשְׁכּוֹל עַל אֹדוֹת הָאֶשְׁכּוֹל אֲשֶׁר כָּרְתוּ מִשָּׁם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
That place was called Wadi Eshcol on account of the
cluster that the children of Israel cut from there.

translation.text: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

verses.english:
That place was called Wadi Eshcol on account of the
cluster that the children of Israel cut from there.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ מִתּוּר הָאָרֶץ מִקֵּץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ מִתּוּר הָאָרֶץ מִקֵּץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם׃

english.text:
And they came back from scouting the land at the end of
forty days.

translation.text: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.

verses.english:
And they came back from scouting the land at the end of
forty days.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל מִדְבַּר פָּארָן קָדֵשָׁה וַיָּשִׁיבוּ אֹתָם דָּבָר וְאֶת כּל הָעֵדָה וַיַּרְאוּם אֶת פְּרִי הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל מִדְבַּר פָּארָן קָדֵשָׁה וַיָּשִׁיבוּ אֹתָם דָּבָר וְאֶת כּל הָעֵדָה וַיַּרְאוּם אֶת פְּרִי הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And they went and came to Moses and to Aaron and to all
the congregation of the children of Israel, to the
wilderness of Paran, at Kadesh; and they brought back word
to them and all the congregation and showed them the
land’s fruit.
