translation.text: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.

verses.english:
And they went and came to Moses and to Aaron and to all
the congregation of the children of Israel, to the
wilderness of Paran, at Kadesh; and they brought back word
to them and all the congregation and showed them the
land’s fruit.

verses.hebrew: וַיְסַפְּרוּ לוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ בָּאנוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר שְׁלַחְתָּנוּ וְגַם זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ הִוא וְזֶה פִּרְיָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְסַפְּרוּ לוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ בָּאנוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר שְׁלַחְתָּנוּ וְגַם זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ הִוא וְזֶה פִּרְיָהּ׃

english.text:
And they told him and said, “We came to the land where you
sent us, and also it’s flowing with milk and honey, and
this is its fruit.

translation.text: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.

verses.english:
And they told him and said, “We came to the land where you
sent us, and also it’s flowing with milk and honey, and
this is its fruit.

verses.hebrew: אֶפֶס כִּי עַז הָעָם הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּאָרֶץ וְהֶעָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת גְּדֹלֹת מְאֹד וְגַם יְלִדֵי הָעֲנָק רָאִינוּ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: אֶפֶס כִּי עַז הָעָם הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּאָרֶץ וְהֶעָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת גְּדֹלֹת מְאֹד וְגַם יְלִדֵי הָעֲנָק רָאִינוּ שָׁם׃

english.text:
Nonetheless: the people who live in the land are strong.
And the cities are fortified, very big. And also we saw
the offspring of the giants there.

translation.text: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

verses.english:
Nonetheless: the people who live in the land are strong.
And the cities are fortified, very big. And also we saw
the offspring of the giants there.

verses.hebrew: עֲמָלֵק יוֹשֵׁב בְּאֶרֶץ הַנֶּגֶב וְהַחִתִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי וְהָאֱמֹרִי יוֹשֵׁב בָּהָר וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב עַל הַיָּם וְעַל יַד הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: עֲמָלֵק יוֹשֵׁב בְּאֶרֶץ הַנֶּגֶב וְהַחִתִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי וְהָאֱמֹרִי יוֹשֵׁב בָּהָר וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב עַל הַיָּם וְעַל יַד הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
Amalek lives in the land of the Negeb, and the Hittite and
the Jebusite and the Amorite live in the mountains, and
the Canaanite lives by the sea and along the Jordan.”

translation.text: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.

verses.english:
Amalek lives in the land of the Negeb, and the Hittite and
the Jebusite and the Amorite live in the mountains, and
the Canaanite lives by the sea and along the Jordan.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּהַס כָּלֵב אֶת הָעָם אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר עָלֹה נַעֲלֶה וְיָרַשְׁנוּ אֹתָהּ כִּי יָכוֹל נוּכַל לָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּהַס כָּלֵב אֶת הָעָם אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר עָלֹה נַעֲלֶה וְיָרַשְׁנוּ אֹתָהּ כִּי יָכוֹל נוּכַל לָהּ׃

english.text:
And Caleb quieted the people toward Moses and said, “Let’s
go up, and we’ll take possession of it, because we’ll be
able to handle it.”

translation.text: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

verses.english:
And Caleb quieted the people toward Moses and said, “Let’s
go up, and we’ll take possession of it, because we’ll be
able to handle it.”

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר עָלוּ עִמּוֹ אָמְרוּ לֹא נוּכַל לַעֲלוֹת אֶל הָעָם כִּי חָזָק הוּא מִמֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר עָלוּ עִמּוֹ אָמְרוּ לֹא נוּכַל לַעֲלוֹת אֶל הָעָם כִּי חָזָק הוּא מִמֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
And the men who went up with him said, “We won’t be able
to go up against the people, because they’re stronger than
we are.”

translation.text: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

verses.english:
And the men who went up with him said, “We won’t be able
to go up against the people, because they’re stronger than
we are.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּצִיאוּ דִּבַּת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תָּרוּ אֹתָהּ אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ בָהּ לָתוּר אֹתָהּ אֶרֶץ אֹכֶלֶת יוֹשְׁבֶיהָ הִוא וְכל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר רָאִינוּ בְתוֹכָהּ אַנְשֵׁי מִדּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּצִיאוּ דִּבַּת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תָּרוּ אֹתָהּ אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ בָהּ לָתוּר אֹתָהּ אֶרֶץ אֹכֶלֶת יוֹשְׁבֶיהָ הִוא וְכל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר רָאִינוּ בְתוֹכָהּ אַנְשֵׁי מִדּוֹת׃

english.text:
And they brought out a report of the land that they had
scouted to the children of Israel, saying, “The land
through which we passed to scout it: it’s a land that eats
those who live in it, and all the people whom we saw in it
were people of size!

translation.text: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.

verses.english:
And they brought out a report of the land that they had
scouted to the children of Israel, saying, “The land
through which we passed to scout it: it’s a land that eats
those who live in it, and all the people whom we saw in it
were people of size!

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁם רָאִינוּ אֶת הַנְּפִילִים בְּנֵי עֲנָק מִן הַנְּפִלִים וַנְּהִי בְעֵינֵינוּ כַּחֲגָבִים וְכֵן הָיִינוּ בְּעֵינֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁם רָאִינוּ אֶת הַנְּפִילִים בְּנֵי עֲנָק מִן הַנְּפִלִים וַנְּהִי בְעֵינֵינוּ כַּחֲגָבִים וְכֵן הָיִינוּ בְּעֵינֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And we saw the Nephilim there, sons of giants from the
Nephilim, and we were like grasshoppers in our eyes, and
so were we in their eyes.”

translation.text: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.

verses.english:
And we saw the Nephilim there, sons of giants from the
Nephilim, and we were like grasshoppers in our eyes, and
so were we in their eyes.”

verses.hebrew: וַתִּשָּׂא כּל הָעֵדָה וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ הָעָם בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּשָּׂא כּל הָעֵדָה וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ הָעָם בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא׃

english.text:
And all the congregation raised and let out their
voices! And the people wept that night.

translation.text: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

verses.english:
And all the congregation raised and let out their
voices! And the people wept that night.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלֹּנוּ עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן כֹּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם כּל הָעֵדָה לוּ מַתְנוּ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם אוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה לוּ מָתְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלֹּנוּ עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן כֹּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם כּל הָעֵדָה לוּ מַתְנוּ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם אוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה לוּ מָתְנוּ׃

english.text:
And all the children of Israel complained at Moses and at
Aaron, and all the congregation said to them, “If only we
had died in the land of Egypt! Or in this wilderness, if
only we had died!

translation.text: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!

verses.english:
And all the children of Israel complained at Moses and at
Aaron, and all the congregation said to them, “If only we
had died in the land of Egypt! Or in this wilderness, if
only we had died!

verses.hebrew: וְלָמָה יְהֹוָה מֵבִיא אֹתָנוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לִנְפֹּל בַּחֶרֶב נָשֵׁינוּ וְטַפֵּנוּ יִהְיוּ לָבַז הֲלוֹא טוֹב לָנוּ שׁוּב מִצְרָיְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלָמָה יְהֹוָה מֵבִיא אֹתָנוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לִנְפֹּל בַּחֶרֶב נָשֵׁינוּ וְטַפֵּנוּ יִהְיוּ לָבַז הֲלוֹא טוֹב לָנוּ שׁוּב מִצְרָיְמָה׃

english.text:
And why is YHWH bringing us to this land to fall by the
sword? Our wives and our infants will become a spoil!
Isn’t it better for us to go back to Egypt?”

translation.text: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?

verses.english:
And why is YHWH bringing us to this land to fall by the
sword? Our wives and our infants will become a spoil!
Isn’t it better for us to go back to Egypt?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו נִתְּנָה רֹאשׁ וְנָשׁוּבָה מִצְרָיְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו נִתְּנָה רֹאשׁ וְנָשׁוּבָה מִצְרָיְמָה׃

english.text:
And they said, each man to his brother, “Let’s appoint a
chief and go back to Egypt.”

translation.text: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.

verses.english:
And they said, each man to his brother, “Let’s appoint a
chief and go back to Egypt.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֹּל מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן עַל פְּנֵיהֶם לִפְנֵי כּל קְהַל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֹּל מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן עַל פְּנֵיהֶם לִפְנֵי כּל קְהַל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron fell on their faces in front of all
the community of the congregation of the children of
Israel.

translation.text: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron fell on their faces in front of all
the community of the congregation of the children of
Israel.

verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן וְכָלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה מִן הַתָּרִים אֶת הָאָרֶץ קָרְעוּ בִּגְדֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן וְכָלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה מִן הַתָּרִים אֶת הָאָרֶץ קָרְעוּ בִּגְדֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, from
those who had scouted the land, had torn their clothes.

translation.text: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:

verses.english:
And Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, from
those who had scouted the land, had torn their clothes.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ בָהּ לָתוּר אֹתָהּ טוֹבָה הָאָרֶץ מְאֹד מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ בָהּ לָתוּר אֹתָהּ טוֹבָה הָאָרֶץ מְאֹד מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And they said to all the congregation of the children of
Israel, saying, “The land through which we passed to scout
it: the land is very, very good!

translation.text: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.

verses.english:
And they said to all the congregation of the children of
Israel, saying, “The land through which we passed to scout
it: the land is very, very good!

verses.hebrew: אִם חָפֵץ בָּנוּ יְהֹוָה וְהֵבִיא אֹתָנוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וּנְתָנָהּ לָנוּ אֶרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִוא זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: אִם חָפֵץ בָּנוּ יְהֹוָה וְהֵבִיא אֹתָנוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וּנְתָנָהּ לָנוּ אֶרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִוא זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

english.text:
If YHWH desires us, then He’ll bring us to this land and
give it to us, a land that flows with milk and honey!

translation.text: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.

verses.english:
If YHWH desires us, then He’ll bring us to this land and
give it to us, a land that flows with milk and honey!

verses.hebrew: אַךְ בַּיהֹוָה אַל תִּמְרֹדוּ וְאַתֶּם אַל תִּירְאוּ אֶת עַם הָאָרֶץ כִּי לַחְמֵנוּ הֵם סָר צִלָּם מֵעֲלֵיהֶם וַיהֹוָה אִתָּנוּ אַל תִּירָאֻם׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ בַּיהֹוָה אַל תִּמְרֹדוּ וְאַתֶּם אַל תִּירְאוּ אֶת עַם הָאָרֶץ כִּי לַחְמֵנוּ הֵם סָר צִלָּם מֵעֲלֵיהֶם וַיהֹוָה אִתָּנוּ אַל תִּירָאֻם׃

english.text:
Just don’t revolt against YHWH. And you, don’t fear the
people of the land, because they’re our bread! Their
protection has turned from them, while YHWH is with us.
Don’t fear them.”

translation.text: Only rebel not ye against the LORD, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the LORD is with us: fear them not.

verses.english:
Just don’t revolt against YHWH. And you, don’t fear the
people of the land, because they’re our bread! Their
protection has turned from them, while YHWH is with us.
Don’t fear them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ כּל הָעֵדָה לִרְגּוֹם אֹתָם בָּאֲבָנִים וּכְבוֹד יְהֹוָה נִרְאָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ כּל הָעֵדָה לִרְגּוֹם אֹתָם בָּאֲבָנִים וּכְבוֹד יְהֹוָה נִרְאָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And all the congregation said to batter them with stones.
And YHWH’s glory appeared at the Tent of Meeting to all
the children of Israel!

translation.text: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And all the congregation said to batter them with stones.
And YHWH’s glory appeared at the Tent of Meeting to all
the children of Israel!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עַד אָנָה יְנַאֲצֻנִי הָעָם הַזֶּה וְעַד אָנָה לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ בִי בְּכֹל הָאֹתוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עַד אָנָה יְנַאֲצֻנִי הָעָם הַזֶּה וְעַד אָנָה לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ בִי בְּכֹל הָאֹתוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “How long will this people reject
me, and how long will they not trust in me, with all the
signs that I’ve done among them?

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “How long will this people reject
me, and how long will they not trust in me, with all the
signs that I’ve done among them?

verses.hebrew: אַכֶּנּוּ בַדֶּבֶר וְאוֹרִשֶׁנּוּ וְאֶעֱשֶׂה אֹתְךָ לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל וְעָצוּם מִמֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: אַכֶּנּוּ בַדֶּבֶר וְאוֹרִשֶׁנּוּ וְאֶעֱשֶׂה אֹתְךָ לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל וְעָצוּם מִמֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
I’ll strike them with an epidemic and dispossess them, and
I’ll make you into a bigger and more powerful nation than
they are.”

translation.text: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.

verses.english:
I’ll strike them with an epidemic and dispossess them, and
I’ll make you into a bigger and more powerful nation than
they are.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה וְשָׁמְעוּ מִצְרַיִם כִּי הֶעֱלִיתָ בְכֹחֲךָ אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה מִקִּרְבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה וְשָׁמְעוּ מִצְרַיִם כִּי הֶעֱלִיתָ בְכֹחֲךָ אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה מִקִּרְבּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Moses said to YHWH, “And Egypt will hear it, for you
brought this people up from among them with your power,

translation.text: And Moses said unto the LORD, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)

verses.english:
And Moses said to YHWH, “And Egypt will hear it, for you
brought this people up from among them with your power,

verses.hebrew: וְאָמְרוּ אֶל יוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת שָׁמְעוּ כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה בְּקֶרֶב הָעָם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עַיִן בְּעַיִן נִרְאָה אַתָּה יְהֹוָה וַעֲנָנְךָ עֹמֵד עֲלֵהֶם וּבְעַמֻּד עָנָן אַתָּה הֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵיהֶם יוֹמָם וּבְעַמּוּד אֵשׁ לָיְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמְרוּ אֶל יוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת שָׁמְעוּ כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה בְּקֶרֶב הָעָם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עַיִן בְּעַיִן נִרְאָה אַתָּה יְהֹוָה וַעֲנָנְךָ עֹמֵד עֲלֵהֶם וּבְעַמֻּד עָנָן אַתָּה הֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵיהֶם יוֹמָם וּבְעַמּוּד אֵשׁ לָיְלָה׃

english.text:
and they’ll say it to those who live in this land. They’ve
heard that you, YHWH, are among this people; that you,
YHWH, have appeared eye-to-eye; and your cloud stands over
them; and you go in front of them in a column of cloud by
day and in a column of fire by night.

translation.text: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou LORD art among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.

verses.english:
and they’ll say it to those who live in this land. They’ve
heard that you, YHWH, are among this people; that you,
YHWH, have appeared eye-to-eye; and your cloud stands over
them; and you go in front of them in a column of cloud by
day and in a column of fire by night.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵמַתָּה אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד וְאָמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר שָׁמְעוּ אֶת שִׁמְעֲךָ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵמַתָּה אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד וְאָמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר שָׁמְעוּ אֶת שִׁמְעֲךָ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And if you kill this people as one man, then the nations
that have heard about you will say it, saying,

translation.text: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,

verses.english:
And if you kill this people as one man, then the nations
that have heard about you will say it, saying,

verses.hebrew: מִבִּלְתִּי יְכֹלֶת יְהֹוָה לְהָבִיא אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָהֶם וַיִּשְׁחָטֵם בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: מִבִּלְתִּי יְכֹלֶת יְהֹוָה לְהָבִיא אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָהֶם וַיִּשְׁחָטֵם בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
‘Because YHWH wasn’t able to bring this people to the land
that He swore to them, He slaughtered them in the
wilderness.’

translation.text: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.

verses.english:
‘Because YHWH wasn’t able to bring this people to the land
that He swore to them, He slaughtered them in the
wilderness.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יִגְדַּל נָא כֹּחַ אֲדֹנָי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה יִגְדַּל נָא כֹּחַ אֲדֹנָי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And now, let my Lord’s power be big, as you spoke, saying,

translation.text: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my LORD be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,

verses.english: And now, let my Lord’s power be big, as you spoke, saying,

verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד נֹשֵׂא עָוֺן וָפָשַׁע וְנַקֵּה לֹא יְנַקֶּה פֹּקֵד עֲוֺן אָבוֹת עַל בָּנִים עַל שִׁלֵּשִׁים וְעַל רִבֵּעִים׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד נֹשֵׂא עָוֺן וָפָשַׁע וְנַקֵּה לֹא יְנַקֶּה פֹּקֵד עֲוֺן אָבוֹת עַל בָּנִים עַל שִׁלֵּשִׁים וְעַל רִבֵּעִים׃

english.text:
‘YHWH is slow to anger and abounding in kindness, bearing
crime and offense; though not making one innocent:
reckoning fathers’ crime on children, on third generations
and on fourth generations.’

translation.text: The LORD is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.

verses.english:
‘YHWH is slow to anger and abounding in kindness, bearing
crime and offense; though not making one innocent:
reckoning fathers’ crime on children, on third generations
and on fourth generations.’

verses.hebrew: סְלַח נָא לַעֲוֺן הָעָם הַזֶּה כְּגֹדֶל חַסְדֶּךָ וְכַאֲשֶׁר נָשָׂאתָה לָעָם הַזֶּה מִמִּצְרַיִם וְעַד הֵנָּה׃

hebrew.text: סְלַח נָא לַעֲוֺן הָעָם הַזֶּה כְּגֹדֶל חַסְדֶּךָ וְכַאֲשֶׁר נָשָׂאתָה לָעָם הַזֶּה מִמִּצְרַיִם וְעַד הֵנָּה׃

english.text:
Forgive this people’s crime in proportion to the magnitude
of your kindness and as you’ve borne this people from
Egypt to here.”

translation.text: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.

verses.english:
Forgive this people’s crime in proportion to the magnitude
of your kindness and as you’ve borne this people from
Egypt to here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה סָלַחְתִּי כִּדְבָרֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה סָלַחְתִּי כִּדְבָרֶךָ׃

english.text: And YHWH said, “I’ve forgiven according to your word.

translation.text: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:

verses.english: And YHWH said, “I’ve forgiven according to your word.

verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם חַי אָנִי וְיִמָּלֵא כְבוֹד יְהֹוָה אֶת כּל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְאוּלָם חַי אָנִי וְיִמָּלֵא כְבוֹד יְהֹוָה אֶת כּל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
But indeed, as I live, and as YHWH’s glory has filled all
the earth,

translation.text: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD.

verses.english:
But indeed, as I live, and as YHWH’s glory has filled all
the earth,

verses.hebrew: כִּי כל הָאֲנָשִׁים הָרֹאִים אֶת כְּבֹדִי וְאֶת אֹתֹתַי אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי בְמִצְרַיִם וּבַמִּדְבָּר וַיְנַסּוּ אֹתִי זֶה עֶשֶׂר פְּעָמִים וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹלִי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי כל הָאֲנָשִׁים הָרֹאִים אֶת כְּבֹדִי וְאֶת אֹתֹתַי אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי בְמִצְרַיִם וּבַמִּדְבָּר וַיְנַסּוּ אֹתִי זֶה עֶשֶׂר פְּעָמִים וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹלִי׃

english.text:
I swear that all of these people, who have seen my glory
and my signs that I did in Egypt and in the wilderness and
who have tested me ten times now and haven’t listened to
my voice,

translation.text: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;

verses.english:
I swear that all of these people, who have seen my glory
and my signs that I did in Egypt and in the wilderness and
who have tested me ten times now and haven’t listened to
my voice,

verses.hebrew: אִם יִרְאוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָם וְכל מְנַאֲצַי לֹא יִרְאוּהָ׃

hebrew.text: אִם יִרְאוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָם וְכל מְנַאֲצַי לֹא יִרְאוּהָ׃

english.text:
won’t see the land that I swore to their fathers, and all
those who rejected me won’t see it.

translation.text: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:

verses.english:
won’t see the land that I swore to their fathers, and all
those who rejected me won’t see it.

verses.hebrew: וְעַבְדִּי כָלֵב עֵקֶב הָיְתָה רוּחַ אַחֶרֶת עִמּוֹ וַיְמַלֵּא אַחֲרָי וַהֲבִיאֹתִיו אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר בָּא שָׁמָּה וְזַרְעוֹ יוֹרִשֶׁנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַבְדִּי כָלֵב עֵקֶב הָיְתָה רוּחַ אַחֶרֶת עִמּוֹ וַיְמַלֵּא אַחֲרָי וַהֲבִיאֹתִיו אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר בָּא שָׁמָּה וְזַרְעוֹ יוֹרִשֶׁנָּה׃

english.text:
And my servant Caleb, because a different spirit was with
him, and he went after me completely, I’ll bring him to
the land where he went, and his seed will possess it.

translation.text: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.

verses.english:
And my servant Caleb, because a different spirit was with
him, and he went after me completely, I’ll bring him to
the land where he went, and his seed will possess it.

verses.hebrew: וְהָעֲמָלֵקִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב בָּעֵמֶק מָחָר פְּנוּ וּסְעוּ לָכֶם הַמִּדְבָּר דֶּרֶךְ יַם סוּף׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעֲמָלֵקִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב בָּעֵמֶק מָחָר פְּנוּ וּסְעוּ לָכֶם הַמִּדְבָּר דֶּרֶךְ יַם סוּף׃

english.text:
And the Amalekite and the Canaanite live in the valley.
Turn and travel tomorrow to the wilderness by the way of
the Red Sea.”

translation.text: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) Tomorrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

verses.english:
And the Amalekite and the Canaanite live in the valley.
Turn and travel tomorrow to the wilderness by the way of
the Red Sea.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.hebrew: עַד מָתַי לָעֵדָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר הֵמָּה מַלִּינִים עָלָי אֶת תְּלֻנּוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הֵמָּה מַלִּינִים עָלַי שָׁמָעְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: עַד מָתַי לָעֵדָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר הֵמָּה מַלִּינִים עָלָי אֶת תְּלֻנּוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הֵמָּה מַלִּינִים עָלַי שָׁמָעְתִּי׃

english.text:
“How much further for this bad congregation, that they’re
complaining against me? I’ve heard the complaints of the
children of Israel that they’re making against me.

translation.text: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

verses.english:
“How much further for this bad congregation, that they’re
complaining against me? I’ve heard the complaints of the
children of Israel that they’re making against me.

verses.hebrew: אֱמֹר אֲלֵהֶם חַי אָנִי נְאֻם יְהֹוָה אִם לֹא כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתֶּם בְּאזְנָי כֵּן אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אֱמֹר אֲלֵהֶם חַי אָנִי נְאֻם יְהֹוָה אִם לֹא כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתֶּם בְּאזְנָי כֵּן אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם׃

english.text:
Say to them: As I live—word of YHWH—what you have spoken
in my ears, that is what I’ll do to you!

translation.text: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the LORD, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:

verses.english:
Say to them: As I live—word of YHWH—what you have spoken
in my ears, that is what I’ll do to you!

verses.hebrew: בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה יִפְּלוּ פִגְרֵיכֶם וְכל פְּקֻדֵיכֶם לְכל מִסְפַּרְכֶם מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמָעְלָה אֲשֶׁר הֲלִינֹתֶם עָלָי׃

hebrew.text: בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה יִפְּלוּ פִגְרֵיכֶם וְכל פְּקֻדֵיכֶם לְכל מִסְפַּרְכֶם מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמָעְלָה אֲשֶׁר הֲלִינֹתֶם עָלָי׃

english.text:
In this wilderness your carcasses will fall; and all of
you who were counted, for all your number, from twenty
years old and up, who complained against me,

translation.text: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward which have murmured against me.

verses.english:
In this wilderness your carcasses will fall; and all of
you who were counted, for all your number, from twenty
years old and up, who complained against me,

verses.hebrew: אִם אַתֶּם תָּבֹאוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָשָׂאתִי אֶת יָדִי לְשַׁכֵּן אֶתְכֶם בָּהּ כִּי אִם כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן׃

hebrew.text: אִם אַתֶּם תָּבֹאוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָשָׂאתִי אֶת יָדִי לְשַׁכֵּן אֶתְכֶם בָּהּ כִּי אִם כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן׃

english.text:
I swear that you won’t come to the land that I raised my
hand to have you reside there—except Caleb son of
Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

translation.text: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.english:
I swear that you won’t come to the land that I raised my
hand to have you reside there—except Caleb son of
Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

verses.hebrew: וְטַפְּכֶם אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם לָבַז יִהְיֶה וְהֵבֵיאתִי אֹתָם וְיָדְעוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר מְאַסְתֶּם בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְטַפְּכֶם אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם לָבַז יִהְיֶה וְהֵבֵיאתִי אֹתָם וְיָדְעוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר מְאַסְתֶּם בָּהּ׃

english.text:
And your infants, whom you said would become a spoil: I’ll
bring them, and they will know the land that you rejected!

translation.text: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.

verses.english:
And your infants, whom you said would become a spoil: I’ll
bring them, and they will know the land that you rejected!

verses.hebrew: וּפִגְרֵיכֶם אַתֶּם יִפְּלוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וּפִגְרֵיכֶם אַתֶּם יִפְּלוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה׃

english.text: And you: your carcasses will fall in this wilderness.

translation.text: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.

verses.english: And you: your carcasses will fall in this wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵיכֶם יִהְיוּ רֹעִים בַּמִּדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וְנָשְׂאוּ אֶת זְנוּתֵיכֶם עַד תֹּם פִּגְרֵיכֶם בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵיכֶם יִהְיוּ רֹעִים בַּמִּדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וְנָשְׂאוּ אֶת זְנוּתֵיכֶם עַד תֹּם פִּגְרֵיכֶם בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
And your children will be roving in the wilderness forty
years, and they’ll bear your whoring until the end of your
carcasses in the wilderness.

translation.text: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.

verses.english:
And your children will be roving in the wilderness forty
years, and they’ll bear your whoring until the end of your
carcasses in the wilderness.

verses.hebrew: בְּמִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר תַּרְתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם יוֹם לַשָּׁנָה יוֹם לַשָּׁנָה תִּשְׂאוּ אֶת עֲוֺנֹתֵיכֶם אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וִידַעְתֶּם אֶת תְּנוּאָתִי׃

hebrew.text: בְּמִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר תַּרְתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם יוֹם לַשָּׁנָה יוֹם לַשָּׁנָה תִּשְׂאוּ אֶת עֲוֺנֹתֵיכֶם אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וִידַעְתֶּם אֶת תְּנוּאָתִי׃

english.text:
For the number of days that you scouted the land, forty
days, you shall bear your crimes a day for each year,
forty years, and you shall know my frustration!

translation.text: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.

verses.english:
For the number of days that you scouted the land, forty
days, you shall bear your crimes a day for each year,
forty years, and you shall know my frustration!

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה דִּבַּרְתִּי אִם לֹא זֹאת אֶעֱשֶׂה לְכל הָעֵדָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת הַנּוֹעָדִים עָלָי בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה יִתַּמּוּ וְשָׁם יָמֻתוּ׃

hebrew.text: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה דִּבַּרְתִּי אִם לֹא זֹאת אֶעֱשֶׂה לְכל הָעֵדָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת הַנּוֹעָדִים עָלָי בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה יִתַּמּוּ וְשָׁם יָמֻתוּ׃

english.text:
I, YHWH, have spoken: If I shall not do this to all this
bad congregation who are gathered against me: in this
wilderness they shall end, and they shall die there!”

translation.text: I the LORD have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

verses.english:
I, YHWH, have spoken: If I shall not do this to all this
bad congregation who are gathered against me: in this
wilderness they shall end, and they shall die there!”

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח מֹשֶׁה לָתוּר אֶת הָאָרֶץ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ (וילונו) [וַיַּלִּינוּ] עָלָיו אֶת כּל הָעֵדָה לְהוֹצִיא דִבָּה עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח מֹשֶׁה לָתוּר אֶת הָאָרֶץ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ (וילונו) [וַיַּלִּינוּ] עָלָיו אֶת כּל הָעֵדָה לְהוֹצִיא דִבָּה עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And the men whom Moses sent to scout the land and came
back and caused all the congregation to complain against
him, bringing out a report about the land:

translation.text: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,

verses.english:
And the men whom Moses sent to scout the land and came
back and caused all the congregation to complain against
him, bringing out a report about the land:

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמֻתוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים מוֹצִאֵי דִבַּת הָאָרֶץ רָעָה בַּמַּגֵּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמֻתוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים מוֹצִאֵי דִבַּת הָאָרֶץ רָעָה בַּמַּגֵּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
the men who brought out the bad report of the land died in
a plague in front of YHWH.

translation.text: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the LORD.

verses.english:
the men who brought out the bad report of the land died in
a plague in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן וְכָלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה חָיוּ מִן הָאֲנָשִׁים הָהֵם הַהֹלְכִים לָתוּר אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן וְכָלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה חָיוּ מִן הָאֲנָשִׁים הָהֵם הַהֹלְכִים לָתוּר אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
But, out of those men who went to scout the land, Joshua
son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh lived. And
Moses spoke these things to all the children of Israel,
and the people mourned very much.

translation.text: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.

verses.english:
But, out of those men who went to scout the land, Joshua
son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh lived. And
Moses spoke these things to all the children of Israel,
and the people mourned very much.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְאַבְּלוּ הָעָם מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל כּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְאַבְּלוּ הָעָם מְאֹד׃

english.text: When Moses told these words to all the Israelites, the people mourned greatly.

translation.text: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.

verses.english: When Moses told these words to all the Israelites, the people mourned greatly.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ בַבֹּקֶר וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶל רֹאשׁ הָהָר לֵאמֹר הִנֶּנּוּ וְעָלִינוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה כִּי חָטָאנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ בַבֹּקֶר וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶל רֹאשׁ הָהָר לֵאמֹר הִנֶּנּוּ וְעָלִינוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה כִּי חָטָאנוּ׃

english.text:
And they got up in the morning and went up to the top of
the mountain, saying, “Here we are, and we’ll go up to the
place that YHWH said, because we’ve sinned.”

translation.text: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised: for we have sinned.

verses.english:
And they got up in the morning and went up to the top of
the mountain, saying, “Here we are, and we’ll go up to the
place that YHWH said, because we’ve sinned.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לָמָּה זֶּה אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה וְהִוא לֹא תִצְלָח׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לָמָּה זֶּה אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה וְהִוא לֹא תִצְלָח׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “Why are you violating YHWH’s word? And it
won’t succeed.

translation.text: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD? but it shall not prosper.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “Why are you violating YHWH’s word? And it
won’t succeed.

verses.hebrew: אַל תַּעֲלוּ כִּי אֵין יְהֹוָה בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וְלֹא תִּנָּגְפוּ לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אַל תַּעֲלוּ כִּי אֵין יְהֹוָה בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וְלֹא תִּנָּגְפוּ לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
Don’t go up, so you won’t be stricken in front of your
enemies, because YHWH isn’t among you.

translation.text: Go not up, for the LORD is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.

verses.english:
Don’t go up, so you won’t be stricken in front of your
enemies, because YHWH isn’t among you.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הָעֲמָלֵקִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי שָׁם לִפְנֵיכֶם וּנְפַלְתֶּם בֶּחָרֶב כִּי עַל כֵּן שַׁבְתֶּם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא יִהְיֶה יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הָעֲמָלֵקִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי שָׁם לִפְנֵיכֶם וּנְפַלְתֶּם בֶּחָרֶב כִּי עַל כֵּן שַׁבְתֶּם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא יִהְיֶה יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם׃

english.text:
Because the Amalekite and the Canaanite are there in front
of you, and you’ll fall by the sword because of the fact
that you’ve gone back from following YHWH, and YHWH won’t
be with you.”

translation.text: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the LORD, therefore the LORD will not be with you.

verses.english:
Because the Amalekite and the Canaanite are there in front
of you, and you’ll fall by the sword because of the fact
that you’ve gone back from following YHWH, and YHWH won’t
be with you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעְפִּלוּ לַעֲלוֹת אֶל רֹאשׁ הָהָר וַאֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה וּמֹשֶׁה לֹא מָשׁוּ מִקֶּרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעְפִּלוּ לַעֲלוֹת אֶל רֹאשׁ הָהָר וַאֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה וּמֹשֶׁה לֹא מָשׁוּ מִקֶּרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And they acted heedlessly, going up to the top of the
mountain. And the ark of the covenant of YHWH and Moses
did not draw away from the camp.

translation.text: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

verses.english:
And they acted heedlessly, going up to the top of the
mountain. And the ark of the covenant of YHWH and Moses
did not draw away from the camp.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד הָעֲמָלֵקִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּהָר הַהוּא וַיַּכּוּם וַיַּכְּתוּם עַד הַחרְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד הָעֲמָלֵקִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּהָר הַהוּא וַיַּכּוּם וַיַּכְּתוּם עַד הַחרְמָה׃

english.text:
And the Amalekite and the Canaanite who lived in that
mountain came down, and they struck them and crushed them
as far as Hormah.

translation.text: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.

verses.english:
And the Amalekite and the Canaanite who lived in that
mountain came down, and they struck them and crushed them
as far as Hormah.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל אֶרֶץ מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל אֶרֶץ מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you will come to the land of your homes that I
am giving to you,

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you will come to the land of your homes that I
am giving to you,

verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה עֹלָה אוֹ זֶבַח לְפַלֵּא נֶדֶר אוֹ בִנְדָבָה אוֹ בְּמֹעֲדֵיכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה מִן הַבָּקָר אוֹ מִן הַצֹּאן׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה עֹלָה אוֹ זֶבַח לְפַלֵּא נֶדֶר אוֹ בִנְדָבָה אוֹ בְּמֹעֲדֵיכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה מִן הַבָּקָר אוֹ מִן הַצֹּאן׃

english.text:
and you will make a fire offering to YHWH, a burnt
offering or a sacrifice, to express a vow or as a
contribution or at your appointed times, to make a
pleasant smell to YHWH from the cattle or from the flock,

translation.text: And will make an offering by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD, of the herd or of the flock:

verses.english:
and you will make a fire offering to YHWH, a burnt
offering or a sacrifice, to express a vow or as a
contribution or at your appointed times, to make a
pleasant smell to YHWH from the cattle or from the flock,

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב הַמַּקְרִיב קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה מִנְחָה סֹלֶת עִשָּׂרוֹן בָּלוּל בִּרְבִעִית הַהִין שָׁמֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב הַמַּקְרִיב קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה מִנְחָה סֹלֶת עִשָּׂרוֹן בָּלוּל בִּרְבִעִית הַהִין שָׁמֶן׃

english.text:
then the one bringing his offering to YHWH shall bring
forward a grain offering, fine flour, one-tenth of a
measure, mixed with a fourth of a hin of oil.

translation.text: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.

verses.english:
then the one bringing his offering to YHWH shall bring
forward a grain offering, fine flour, one-tenth of a
measure, mixed with a fourth of a hin of oil.

verses.hebrew: וְיַיִן לַנֶּסֶךְ רְבִיעִית הַהִין תַּעֲשֶׂה עַל הָעֹלָה אוֹ לַזָּבַח לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וְיַיִן לַנֶּסֶךְ רְבִיעִית הַהִין תַּעֲשֶׂה עַל הָעֹלָה אוֹ לַזָּבַח לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד׃

english.text:
And you shall make wine for a libation with the burnt
offering or the sacrifice, a fourth of a hin for one lamb.

translation.text: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.

verses.english:
And you shall make wine for a libation with the burnt
offering or the sacrifice, a fourth of a hin for one lamb.

verses.hebrew: אוֹ לָאַיִל תַּעֲשֶׂה מִנְחָה סֹלֶת שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן שְׁלִשִׁית הַהִין׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ לָאַיִל תַּעֲשֶׂה מִנְחָה סֹלֶת שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן שְׁלִשִׁית הַהִין׃

english.text:
Or for a ram, you shall make a grain offering, fine flour,
two tenths, mixed with oil, a third of a hin,

translation.text: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.

verses.english:
Or for a ram, you shall make a grain offering, fine flour,
two tenths, mixed with oil, a third of a hin,

verses.hebrew: וְיַיִן לַנֶּסֶךְ שְׁלִשִׁית הַהִין תַּקְרִיב רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיַיִן לַנֶּסֶךְ שְׁלִשִׁית הַהִין תַּקְרִיב רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and you shall bring forward wine for a libation, a third
of a hin, a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.english:
and you shall bring forward wine for a libation, a third
of a hin, a pleasant smell to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי תַעֲשֶׂה בֶן בָּקָר עֹלָה אוֹ זָבַח לְפַלֵּא נֶדֶר אוֹ שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תַעֲשֶׂה בֶן בָּקָר עֹלָה אוֹ זָבַח לְפַלֵּא נֶדֶר אוֹ שְׁלָמִים לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And if you will make a bull a burnt offering or a
sacrifice, to express a vow, or a peace offering to YHWH,

translation.text: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD:

verses.english:
And if you will make a bull a burnt offering or a
sacrifice, to express a vow, or a peace offering to YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב עַל בֶּן הַבָּקָר מִנְחָה סֹלֶת שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים בָּלוּל בַּשֶּׁמֶן חֲצִי הַהִין׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיב עַל בֶּן הַבָּקָר מִנְחָה סֹלֶת שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים בָּלוּל בַּשֶּׁמֶן חֲצִי הַהִין׃

english.text:
then he shall bring forward with the bull a grain
offering, fine flour, three tenths, mixed with oil, half
of a hin,

translation.text: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.

verses.english:
then he shall bring forward with the bull a grain
offering, fine flour, three tenths, mixed with oil, half
of a hin,

verses.hebrew: וְיַיִן תַּקְרִיב לַנֶּסֶךְ חֲצִי הַהִין אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיַיִן תַּקְרִיב לַנֶּסֶךְ חֲצִי הַהִין אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and you shall bring forward wine for a libation, half of a
hin, an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.english:
and you shall bring forward wine for a libation, half of a
hin, an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: כָּכָה יֵעָשֶׂה לַשּׁוֹר הָאֶחָד אוֹ לָאַיִל הָאֶחָד אוֹ לַשֶּׂה בַכְּבָשִׂים אוֹ בָעִזִּים׃

hebrew.text: כָּכָה יֵעָשֶׂה לַשּׁוֹר הָאֶחָד אוֹ לָאַיִל הָאֶחָד אוֹ לַשֶּׂה בַכְּבָשִׂים אוֹ בָעִזִּים׃

english.text:
It shall be done this way for one ox or for one ram or for
a lamb of the sheep or of the goats.

translation.text: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.

verses.english:
It shall be done this way for one ox or for one ram or for
a lamb of the sheep or of the goats.

verses.hebrew: כַּמִּסְפָּר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּ כָּכָה תַּעֲשׂוּ לָאֶחָד כְּמִסְפָּרָם׃

hebrew.text: כַּמִּסְפָּר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּ כָּכָה תַּעֲשׂוּ לָאֶחָד כְּמִסְפָּרָם׃

english.text:
By the number that you will do, you shall do each one of
their number this way.

translation.text: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.

verses.english:
By the number that you will do, you shall do each one of
their number this way.

verses.hebrew: כּל הָאֶזְרָח יַעֲשֶׂה כָּכָה אֶת אֵלֶּה לְהַקְרִיב אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: כּל הָאֶזְרָח יַעֲשֶׂה כָּכָה אֶת אֵלֶּה לְהַקְרִיב אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Every citizen shall do these this way when bringing
forward an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.english:
Every citizen shall do these this way when bringing
forward an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יָגוּר אִתְּכֶם גֵּר אוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹכְכֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם וְעָשָׂה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יָגוּר אִתְּכֶם גֵּר אוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹכְכֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם וְעָשָׂה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
And when an alien will reside with you—or someone who is
among you—through your generations and will make an
offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH, as you will
do so he shall do.

translation.text: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; as ye do, so he shall do.

verses.english:
And when an alien will reside with you—or someone who is
among you—through your generations and will make an
offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH, as you will
do so he shall do.

verses.hebrew: הַקָּהָל חֻקָּה אַחַת לָכֶם וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם כָּכֶם כַּגֵּר יִהְיֶה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: הַקָּהָל חֻקָּה אַחַת לָכֶם וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם כָּכֶם כַּגֵּר יִהְיֶה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You, congregation, and the resident alien have one law, an
eternal law through your generations: it will be the same
for you and for the alien in front of YHWH.

translation.text: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the LORD.

verses.english:
You, congregation, and the resident alien have one law, an
eternal law through your generations: it will be the same
for you and for the alien in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹרָה אַחַת וּמִשְׁפָּט אֶחָד יִהְיֶה לָכֶם וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר אִתְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: תּוֹרָה אַחַת וּמִשְׁפָּט אֶחָד יִהְיֶה לָכֶם וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר אִתְּכֶם׃

english.text:
You and the alien who resides with you shall have one
instruction and one judgment.”

translation.text: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.

verses.english:
You and the alien who resides with you shall have one
instruction and one judgment.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם בְּבֹאֲכֶם אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם בְּבֹאֲכֶם אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you come to the land where I’m bringing you,

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you come to the land where I’m bringing you,

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַּאֲכלְכֶם מִלֶּחֶם הָאָרֶץ תָּרִימוּ תְרוּמָה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בַּאֲכלְכֶם מִלֶּחֶם הָאָרֶץ תָּרִימוּ תְרוּמָה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
then it will be that when you eat some of the land’s bread
you shall make a donation to YHWH.

translation.text: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the LORD.

verses.english:
then it will be that when you eat some of the land’s bread
you shall make a donation to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: רֵאשִׁית עֲרִסֹתֵכֶם חַלָּה תָּרִימוּ תְרוּמָה כִּתְרוּמַת גֹּרֶן כֵּן תָּרִימוּ אֹתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: רֵאשִׁית עֲרִסֹתֵכֶם חַלָּה תָּרִימוּ תְרוּמָה כִּתְרוּמַת גֹּרֶן כֵּן תָּרִימוּ אֹתָהּ׃

english.text:
The first of your dough: you shall make a loaf as a
donation. Like a donation from the threshing floor, so you
shall donate it.

translation.text: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.

verses.english:
The first of your dough: you shall make a loaf as a
donation. Like a donation from the threshing floor, so you
shall donate it.

verses.hebrew: מֵרֵאשִׁית עֲרִסֹתֵיכֶם תִּתְּנוּ לַיהֹוָה תְּרוּמָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: מֵרֵאשִׁית עֲרִסֹתֵיכֶם תִּתְּנוּ לַיהֹוָה תְּרוּמָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
From the first of your dough you shall give a donation to
YHWH through your generations.

translation.text: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.

verses.english:
From the first of your dough you shall give a donation to
YHWH through your generations.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי תִשְׁגּוּ וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֵת כּל הַמִּצְוֺת הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תִשְׁגּוּ וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֵת כּל הַמִּצְוֺת הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
“And when you will make a mistake and not do all of these
commandments that YHWH has spoken to Moses,

translation.text: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,

verses.english:
“And when you will make a mistake and not do all of these
commandments that YHWH has spoken to Moses,

verses.hebrew: אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה מִן הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה וָהָלְאָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה מִן הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה וָהָלְאָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
everything that YHWH has commanded you by Moses’ hand,
from the day that YHWH commanded and on through your
generations,

translation.text: Even all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;

verses.english:
everything that YHWH has commanded you by Moses’ hand,
from the day that YHWH commanded and on through your
generations,

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם מֵעֵינֵי הָעֵדָה נֶעֶשְׂתָה לִשְׁגָגָה וְעָשׂוּ כל הָעֵדָה פַּר בֶּן בָּקָר אֶחָד לְעֹלָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה וּמִנְחָתוֹ וְנִסְכּוֹ כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וּשְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּת׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם מֵעֵינֵי הָעֵדָה נֶעֶשְׂתָה לִשְׁגָגָה וְעָשׂוּ כל הָעֵדָה פַּר בֶּן בָּקָר אֶחָד לְעֹלָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה וּמִנְחָתוֹ וְנִסְכּוֹ כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וּשְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּת׃

english.text:
then it will be that, if it was done by mistake, out of
the congregation’s sight, then all the congregation shall
do one bull of the cattle as a burnt offering for a
pleasant smell to YHWH and its grain offering and its
libation according to the required manner and one goat for
a sin offering.

translation.text: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the LORD, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.

verses.english:
then it will be that, if it was done by mistake, out of
the congregation’s sight, then all the congregation shall
do one bull of the cattle as a burnt offering for a
pleasant smell to YHWH and its grain offering and its
libation according to the required manner and one goat for
a sin offering.

verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן עַל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִסְלַח לָהֶם כִּי שְׁגָגָה הִוא וְהֵם הֵבִיאוּ אֶת קרְבָּנָם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה וְחַטָּאתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל שִׁגְגָתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן עַל כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִסְלַח לָהֶם כִּי שְׁגָגָה הִוא וְהֵם הֵבִיאוּ אֶת קרְבָּנָם אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה וְחַטָּאתָם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל שִׁגְגָתָם׃

english.text:
And the priest shall make atonement for all the
congregation of the children of Israel, and it will be
forgiven for them, because it was a mistake, and they
brought their offering, an offering by fire to YHWH, and
their sin offering in front of YHWH for their mistake.

translation.text: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their ignorance:

verses.english:
And the priest shall make atonement for all the
congregation of the children of Israel, and it will be
forgiven for them, because it was a mistake, and they
brought their offering, an offering by fire to YHWH, and
their sin offering in front of YHWH for their mistake.

verses.hebrew: וְנִסְלַח לְכל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם כִּי לְכל הָעָם בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנִסְלַח לְכל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם כִּי לְכל הָעָם בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

english.text:
And it will be forgiven for all the congregation of the
children of Israel and the alien who resides among them,
because it was by mistake for all the people.

translation.text: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.

verses.english:
And it will be forgiven for all the congregation of the
children of Israel and the alien who resides among them,
because it was by mistake for all the people.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם נֶפֶשׁ אַחַת תֶּחֱטָא בִשְׁגָגָה וְהִקְרִיבָה עֵז בַּת שְׁנָתָהּ לְחַטָּאת׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם נֶפֶשׁ אַחַת תֶּחֱטָא בִשְׁגָגָה וְהִקְרִיבָה עֵז בַּת שְׁנָתָהּ לְחַטָּאת׃

english.text:
“And if one person will sin by mistake, then he shall
bring a she-goat in its first year for a sin offering.

translation.text: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.

verses.english:
“And if one person will sin by mistake, then he shall
bring a she-goat in its first year for a sin offering.

verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן עַל הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַשֹּׁגֶגֶת בְּחֶטְאָה בִשְׁגָגָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן עַל הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַשֹּׁגֶגֶת בְּחֶטְאָה בִשְׁגָגָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall make atonement for the person who
made the mistake, sinning by mistake, in front of YHWH to
make atonement for him, and it will be forgiven for him.

translation.text: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the LORD, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.

verses.english:
And the priest shall make atonement for the person who
made the mistake, sinning by mistake, in front of YHWH to
make atonement for him, and it will be forgiven for him.

verses.hebrew: הָאֶזְרָח בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם תּוֹרָה אַחַת יִהְיֶה לָכֶם לָעֹשֶׂה בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

hebrew.text: הָאֶזְרָח בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם תּוֹרָה אַחַת יִהְיֶה לָכֶם לָעֹשֶׂה בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

english.text:
The citizen among the children of Israel and for the alien
who resides among them: you shall have one instruction for
one who acts by mistake.

translation.text: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.

verses.english:
The citizen among the children of Israel and for the alien
who resides among them: you shall have one instruction for
one who acts by mistake.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה בְּיָד רָמָה מִן הָאֶזְרָח וּמִן הַגֵּר אֶת יְהֹוָה הוּא מְגַדֵּף וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה בְּיָד רָמָה מִן הָאֶזְרָח וּמִן הַגֵּר אֶת יְהֹוָה הוּא מְגַדֵּף וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּהּ׃

english.text:
“But the person who will act with a high hand, a citizen
or an alien, he is blaspheming YHWH, and that person will
be cut off from among his people,

translation.text: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.english:
“But the person who will act with a high hand, a citizen
or an alien, he is blaspheming YHWH, and that person will
be cut off from among his people,

verses.hebrew: כִּי דְבַר יְהֹוָה בָּזָה וְאֶת מִצְוָתוֹ הֵפַר הִכָּרֵת תִּכָּרֵת הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא עֲוֺנָה בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי דְבַר יְהֹוָה בָּזָה וְאֶת מִצְוָתוֹ הֵפַר הִכָּרֵת תִּכָּרֵת הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא עֲוֺנָה בָהּ׃

english.text:
because he disdained YHWH’s word and broke His
commandment. That person will be cut off. His crime is in
him.”

translation.text: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.

verses.english:
because he disdained YHWH’s word and broke His
commandment. That person will be cut off. His crime is in
him.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיִּמְצְאוּ אִישׁ מְקֹשֵׁשׁ עֵצִים בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיִּמְצְאוּ אִישׁ מְקֹשֵׁשׁ עֵצִים בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel were in the wilderness, and
they found a man collecting wood on the Sabbath day.

translation.text: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel were in the wilderness, and
they found a man collecting wood on the Sabbath day.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרִיבוּ אֹתוֹ הַמֹּצְאִים אֹתוֹ מְקֹשֵׁשׁ עֵצִים אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל כּל הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרִיבוּ אֹתוֹ הַמֹּצְאִים אֹתוֹ מְקֹשֵׁשׁ עֵצִים אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל כּל הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
And those who found him collecting wood brought him
forward to Moses and to Aaron and to all the congregation.

translation.text: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.

verses.english:
And those who found him collecting wood brought him
forward to Moses and to Aaron and to all the congregation.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּנִּיחוּ אֹתוֹ בַּמִּשְׁמָר כִּי לֹא פֹרַשׁ מַה יֵּעָשֶׂה לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּנִּיחוּ אֹתוֹ בַּמִּשְׁמָר כִּי לֹא פֹרַשׁ מַה יֵּעָשֶׂה לוֹ׃

english.text:
And they left him under watch because it had not been
determined what should be done to him.

translation.text: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.

verses.english:
And they left him under watch because it had not been
determined what should be done to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה מוֹת יוּמַת הָאִישׁ רָגוֹם אֹתוֹ בָאֲבָנִים כּל הָעֵדָה מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה מוֹת יוּמַת הָאִישׁ רָגוֹם אֹתוֹ בָאֲבָנִים כּל הָעֵדָה מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “The man shall be put to death!
All the congregation is to batter him with stones outside
the camp.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “The man shall be put to death!
All the congregation is to batter him with stones outside
the camp.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּצִיאוּ אֹתוֹ כּל הָעֵדָה אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וַיִּרְגְּמוּ אֹתוֹ בָּאֲבָנִים וַיָּמֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּצִיאוּ אֹתוֹ כּל הָעֵדָה אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וַיִּרְגְּמוּ אֹתוֹ בָּאֲבָנִים וַיָּמֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And all the congregation brought him outside the camp and
battered him with stones, and he died, as YHWH commanded
Moses.

translation.text: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And all the congregation brought him outside the camp and
battered him with stones, and he died, as YHWH commanded
Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH said to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH said to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם וְעָשׂוּ לָהֶם צִיצִת עַל כַּנְפֵי בִגְדֵיהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם וְנָתְנוּ עַל צִיצִת הַכָּנָף פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם וְעָשׂוּ לָהֶם צִיצִת עַל כַּנְפֵי בִגְדֵיהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם וְנָתְנוּ עַל צִיצִת הַכָּנָף פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them that they shall make fringe on the corners of their
clothes through their generations. And they shall put a
blue string on the fringe of the corner.

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them that they shall make fringe on the corners of their
clothes through their generations. And they shall put a
blue string on the fringe of the corner.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְצִיצִת וּרְאִיתֶם אֹתוֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם אֶת כּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וְלֹא תָתוּרוּ אַחֲרֵי לְבַבְכֶם וְאַחֲרֵי עֵינֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם זֹנִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְצִיצִת וּרְאִיתֶם אֹתוֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם אֶת כּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וְלֹא תָתוּרוּ אַחֲרֵי לְבַבְכֶם וְאַחֲרֵי עֵינֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם זֹנִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall have the fringe so you will see it and bring
to mind all of YHWH’s commandments and will do them, and
you will not go around after your heart and after your
eyes, because you whore after them.

translation.text: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:

verses.english:
And you shall have the fringe so you will see it and bring
to mind all of YHWH’s commandments and will do them, and
you will not go around after your heart and after your
eyes, because you whore after them.

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן תִּזְכְּרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָי וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים לֵאלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן תִּזְכְּרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָי וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים לֵאלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
So you will bring to mind and do all my commandments, and
you will be holy to your God.

translation.text: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.

verses.english:
So you will bring to mind and do all my commandments, and
you will be holy to your God.

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt to be God to you. I am YHWH, your God.”

translation.text: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt to be God to you. I am YHWH, your God.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח קֹרַח בֶּן יִצְהָר בֶּן קְהָת בֶּן לֵוִי וְדָתָן וַאֲבִירָם בְּנֵי אֱלִיאָב וְאוֹן בֶּן פֶּלֶת בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח קֹרַח בֶּן יִצְהָר בֶּן קְהָת בֶּן לֵוִי וְדָתָן וַאֲבִירָם בְּנֵי אֱלִיאָב וְאוֹן בֶּן פֶּלֶת בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן׃

english.text:
And Korah son of Izhar son of Kohath son of Levi, and
Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, and On, son of Peleth,
sons of Reuben, took

translation.text: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:

verses.english:
And Korah son of Izhar son of Kohath son of Levi, and
Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, and On, son of Peleth,
sons of Reuben, took

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וַאֲנָשִׁים מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתָיִם נְשִׂיאֵי עֵדָה קְרִאֵי מוֹעֵד אַנְשֵׁי שֵׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֻמוּ לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וַאֲנָשִׁים מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתָיִם נְשִׂיאֵי עֵדָה קְרִאֵי מוֹעֵד אַנְשֵׁי שֵׁם׃

english.text:
and got up in front of Moses—and two hundred fifty people
from the children of Israel, chieftains of the
congregation, prominent ones of the assembly, people of
repute.

translation.text: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:

verses.english:
and got up in front of Moses—and two hundred fifty people
from the children of Israel, chieftains of the
congregation, prominent ones of the assembly, people of
repute.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם רַב לָכֶם כִּי כל הָעֵדָה כֻּלָּם קְדֹשִׁים וּבְתוֹכָם יְהֹוָה וּמַדּוּעַ תִּתְנַשְּׂאוּ עַל קְהַל יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם רַב לָכֶם כִּי כל הָעֵדָה כֻּלָּם קְדֹשִׁים וּבְתוֹכָם יְהֹוָה וּמַדּוּעַ תִּתְנַשְּׂאוּ עַל קְהַל יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And they assembled against Moses and against Aaron and
said to them, “You have much! Because all of the
congregation, all of them, are holy, and YHWH is among
them. And why do you raise yourselves up over YHWH’s
community?”

translation.text: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the LORD is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the LORD?

verses.english:
And they assembled against Moses and against Aaron and
said to them, “You have much! Because all of the
congregation, all of them, are holy, and YHWH is among
them. And why do you raise yourselves up over YHWH’s
community?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע מֹשֶׁה וַיִּפֹּל עַל פָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע מֹשֶׁה וַיִּפֹּל עַל פָּנָיו׃

english.text: And Moses listened, and he fell on his face.

translation.text: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:

verses.english: And Moses listened, and he fell on his face.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל קֹרַח וְאֶל כּל עֲדָתוֹ לֵאמֹר בֹּקֶר וְיֹדַע יְהֹוָה אֶת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְאֶת הַקָּדוֹשׁ וְהִקְרִיב אֵלָיו וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר בּוֹ יַקְרִיב אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל קֹרַח וְאֶל כּל עֲדָתוֹ לֵאמֹר בֹּקֶר וְיֹדַע יְהֹוָה אֶת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְאֶת הַקָּדוֹשׁ וְהִקְרִיב אֵלָיו וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר בּוֹ יַקְרִיב אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
And he spoke to Korah and to all of his congregation,
saying, “In the morning YHWH will make known who is His
and who is holy, and He will bring him close to Him. And
He will bring the one He chooses close to Him.

translation.text: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the LORD will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.

verses.english:
And he spoke to Korah and to all of his congregation,
saying, “In the morning YHWH will make known who is His
and who is holy, and He will bring him close to Him. And
He will bring the one He chooses close to Him.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת עֲשׂוּ קְחוּ לָכֶם מַחְתּוֹת קֹרַח וְכל עֲדָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת עֲשׂוּ קְחוּ לָכֶם מַחְתּוֹת קֹרַח וְכל עֲדָתוֹ׃

english.text:
Do this: Take incense burners, Korah and all his
congregation,

translation.text: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;

verses.english:
Do this: Take incense burners, Korah and all his
congregation,

verses.hebrew: וּתְנוּ בָהֵן אֵשׁ וְשִׂימוּ עֲלֵיהֶן קְטֹרֶת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה מָחָר וְהָיָה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה הוּא הַקָּדוֹשׁ רַב לָכֶם בְּנֵי לֵוִי׃

hebrew.text: וּתְנוּ בָהֵן אֵשׁ וְשִׂימוּ עֲלֵיהֶן קְטֹרֶת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה מָחָר וְהָיָה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה הוּא הַקָּדוֹשׁ רַב לָכֶם בְּנֵי לֵוִי׃

english.text:
and put fire in them and set incense on them in front of
YHWH tomorrow. And it will be that the man whom YHWH will
choose, he will be the holy one. You have much, sons of
Levi!”

translation.text: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the LORD to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the LORD doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.

verses.english:
and put fire in them and set incense on them in front of
YHWH tomorrow. And it will be that the man whom YHWH will
choose, he will be the holy one. You have much, sons of
Levi!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל קֹרַח שִׁמְעוּ נָא בְּנֵי לֵוִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל קֹרַח שִׁמְעוּ נָא בְּנֵי לֵוִי׃

english.text: And Moses said to Korah, “Listen, sons of Levi,

translation.text: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:

verses.english: And Moses said to Korah, “Listen, sons of Levi,

verses.hebrew: הַמְעַט מִכֶּם כִּי הִבְדִּיל אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶתְכֶם מֵעֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַקְרִיב אֶתְכֶם אֵלָיו לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה וְלַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לְשָׁרְתָם׃

hebrew.text: הַמְעַט מִכֶּם כִּי הִבְדִּיל אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶתְכֶם מֵעֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַקְרִיב אֶתְכֶם אֵלָיו לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה וְלַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לְשָׁרְתָם׃

english.text:
is it too small a thing for you that Israel’s God has
distinguished you from the congregation of Israel to bring
you close to him, to do the work of YHWH’s Tabernacle and
to stand in front of the congregation to minister for
them,

translation.text: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the LORD, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?

verses.english:
is it too small a thing for you that Israel’s God has
distinguished you from the congregation of Israel to bring
you close to him, to do the work of YHWH’s Tabernacle and
to stand in front of the congregation to minister for
them,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֹתְךָ וְאֶת כּל אַחֶיךָ בְנֵי לֵוִי אִתָּךְ וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּם גַּם כְּהֻנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֹתְךָ וְאֶת כּל אַחֶיךָ בְנֵי לֵוִי אִתָּךְ וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּם גַּם כְּהֻנָּה׃

english.text:
and that He has brought you and all your brothers, the
sons of Levi, with you close to Him? And you seek
priesthood as well?!

translation.text: And he hath brought thee near to him, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?

verses.english:
and that He has brought you and all your brothers, the
sons of Levi, with you close to Him? And you seek
priesthood as well?!

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אַתָּה וְכל עֲדָתְךָ הַנֹּעָדִים עַל יְהֹוָה וְאַהֲרֹן מַה הוּא כִּי (תלונו) [תַלִּינוּ] עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: לָכֵן אַתָּה וְכל עֲדָתְךָ הַנֹּעָדִים עַל יְהֹוָה וְאַהֲרֹן מַה הוּא כִּי (תלונו) [תַלִּינוּ] עָלָיו׃

english.text:
Therefore you and all your congregation who are gathering
are against YHWH! And Aaron, what is he that you complain
against him?”

translation.text: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the LORD: and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?

verses.english:
Therefore you and all your congregation who are gathering
are against YHWH! And Aaron, what is he that you complain
against him?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֹשֶׁה לִקְרֹא לְדָתָן וְלַאֲבִירָם בְּנֵי אֱלִיאָב וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא נַעֲלֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֹשֶׁה לִקְרֹא לְדָתָן וְלַאֲבִירָם בְּנֵי אֱלִיאָב וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא נַעֲלֶה׃

english.text:
And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab,
and they said, “We won’t come up.

translation.text: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:

verses.english:
And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab,
and they said, “We won’t come up.

verses.hebrew: הַמְעַט כִּי הֶעֱלִיתָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ לַהֲמִיתֵנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּי תִשְׂתָּרֵר עָלֵינוּ גַּם הִשְׂתָּרֵר׃

hebrew.text: הַמְעַט כִּי הֶעֱלִיתָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ לַהֲמִיתֵנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּי תִשְׂתָּרֵר עָלֵינוּ גַּם הִשְׂתָּרֵר׃

english.text:
Is it a small thing that you brought us up from a land
flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness,
that you lord it over us as well?

translation.text: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?

verses.english:
Is it a small thing that you brought us up from a land
flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness,
that you lord it over us as well?

verses.hebrew: אַף לֹא אֶל אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ הֲבִיאֹתָנוּ וַתִּתֶּן לָנוּ נַחֲלַת שָׂדֶה וָכָרֶם הַעֵינֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָהֵם תְּנַקֵּר לֹא נַעֲלֶה׃

hebrew.text: אַף לֹא אֶל אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ הֲבִיאֹתָנוּ וַתִּתֶּן לָנוּ נַחֲלַת שָׂדֶה וָכָרֶם הַעֵינֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָהֵם תְּנַקֵּר לֹא נַעֲלֶה׃

english.text:
Besides, you haven’t brought us to a land flowing with
milk and honey or given us possession of field or
vineyard. Will you put out those people’s eyes? We won’t
come up.”

translation.text: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.

verses.english:
Besides, you haven’t brought us to a land flowing with
milk and honey or given us possession of field or
vineyard. Will you put out those people’s eyes? We won’t
come up.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר לְמֹשֶׁה מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל יְהֹוָה אַל תֵּפֶן אֶל מִנְחָתָם לֹא חֲמוֹר אֶחָד מֵהֶם נָשָׂאתִי וְלֹא הֲרֵעֹתִי אֶת אַחַד מֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר לְמֹשֶׁה מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל יְהֹוָה אַל תֵּפֶן אֶל מִנְחָתָם לֹא חֲמוֹר אֶחָד מֵהֶם נָשָׂאתִי וְלֹא הֲרֵעֹתִי אֶת אַחַד מֵהֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses was very angry, and he said to YHWH, “Don’t turn
to their offering. Not one ass of theirs have I taken
away, and I haven’t wronged one of them.”

translation.text: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the LORD, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.

verses.english:
And Moses was very angry, and he said to YHWH, “Don’t turn
to their offering. Not one ass of theirs have I taken
away, and I haven’t wronged one of them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל קֹרַח אַתָּה וְכל עֲדָתְךָ הֱיוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אַתָּה וָהֵם וְאַהֲרֹן מָחָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל קֹרַח אַתָּה וְכל עֲדָתְךָ הֱיוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אַתָּה וָהֵם וְאַהֲרֹן מָחָר׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Korah, “You and all your congregation,
be in front of YHWH—you and they and Aaron—tomorrow.

translation.text: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the LORD, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:

verses.english:
And Moses said to Korah, “You and all your congregation,
be in front of YHWH—you and they and Aaron—tomorrow.

verses.hebrew: וּקְחוּ אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ וּנְתַתֶּם עֲלֵיהֶם קְטֹרֶת וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתַיִם מַחְתֹּת וְאַתָּה וְאַהֲרֹן אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּקְחוּ אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ וּנְתַתֶּם עֲלֵיהֶם קְטֹרֶת וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתַיִם מַחְתֹּת וְאַתָּה וְאַהֲרֹן אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
And each man take his fire-holder, and put incense on
them, and each man bring his fire-holder forward in front
of YHWH, two hundred fifty fire-holders, and you and
Aaron, each man his fire-holder.”

translation.text: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the LORD every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.

verses.english:
And each man take his fire-holder, and put incense on
them, and each man bring his fire-holder forward in front
of YHWH, two hundred fifty fire-holders, and you and
Aaron, each man his fire-holder.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ וַיִּתְּנוּ עֲלֵיהֶם אֵשׁ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עֲלֵיהֶם קְטֹרֶת וַיַּעַמְדוּ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּמֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אִישׁ מַחְתָּתוֹ וַיִּתְּנוּ עֲלֵיהֶם אֵשׁ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עֲלֵיהֶם קְטֹרֶת וַיַּעַמְדוּ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּמֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן׃

english.text:
And each man took his fire-holder, and they put fire on
them and set incense on them, and they stood at the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting, and Moses and Aaron.

translation.text: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.

verses.english:
And each man took his fire-holder, and they put fire on
them and set incense on them, and they stood at the
entrance of the Tent of Meeting, and Moses and Aaron.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְהֵל עֲלֵיהֶם קֹרַח אֶת כּל הָעֵדָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיֵּרָא כְבוֹד יְהֹוָה אֶל כּל הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְהֵל עֲלֵיהֶם קֹרַח אֶת כּל הָעֵדָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיֵּרָא כְבוֹד יְהֹוָה אֶל כּל הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
And Korah assembled all the congregation against them, to
the entrance of the Tent of Meeting. And YHWH’s glory
appeared to all the congregation.

translation.text: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the congregation.

verses.english:
And Korah assembled all the congregation against them, to
the entrance of the Tent of Meeting. And YHWH’s glory
appeared to all the congregation.
