verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.hebrew: הִבָּדְלוּ מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה הַזֹּאת וַאֲכַלֶּה אֹתָם כְּרָגַע׃

hebrew.text: הִבָּדְלוּ מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה הַזֹּאת וַאֲכַלֶּה אֹתָם כְּרָגַע׃

english.text:
“Separate from among this congregation, and I’ll finish
them in an instant!”

translation.text: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.

verses.english:
“Separate from among this congregation, and I’ll finish
them in an instant!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל פְּנֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵל אֱלֹהֵי הָרוּחֹת לְכל בָּשָׂר הָאִישׁ אֶחָד יֶחֱטָא וְעַל כּל הָעֵדָה תִּקְצֹף׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל פְּנֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵל אֱלֹהֵי הָרוּחֹת לְכל בָּשָׂר הָאִישׁ אֶחָד יֶחֱטָא וְעַל כּל הָעֵדָה תִּקְצֹף׃

english.text:
And they fell on their faces and said, “God, the God of
the spirits of all flesh, will one man sin and you be
angry at all the congregation?”

translation.text: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?

verses.english:
And they fell on their faces and said, “God, the God of
the spirits of all flesh, will one man sin and you be
angry at all the congregation?”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל הָעֵדָה לֵאמֹר הֵעָלוּ מִסָּבִיב לְמִשְׁכַּן קֹרַח דָּתָן וַאֲבִירָם׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל הָעֵדָה לֵאמֹר הֵעָלוּ מִסָּבִיב לְמִשְׁכַּן קֹרַח דָּתָן וַאֲבִירָם׃

english.text:
“Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get up from around
the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan and Abiram.’”

translation.text: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

verses.english:
“Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get up from around
the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan and Abiram.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם מֹשֶׁה וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל דָּתָן וַאֲבִירָם וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרָיו זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם מֹשֶׁה וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל דָּתָן וַאֲבִירָם וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרָיו זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and
Israel’s elders went after him.

translation.text: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

verses.english:
And Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and
Israel’s elders went after him.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל הָעֵדָה לֵאמֹר סוּרוּ נָא מֵעַל אהֳלֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָרְשָׁעִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאַל תִּגְּעוּ בְּכל אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם פֶּן תִּסָּפוּ בְּכל חַטֹּאתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל הָעֵדָה לֵאמֹר סוּרוּ נָא מֵעַל אהֳלֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָרְשָׁעִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאַל תִּגְּעוּ בְּכל אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם פֶּן תִּסָּפוּ בְּכל חַטֹּאתָם׃

english.text:
And he spoke to the congregation, saying, “Turn away from
the tents of these wicked men and don’t touch anything
that is theirs, or else you’ll be annihilated through all
their sins.”

translation.text: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.

verses.english:
And he spoke to the congregation, saying, “Turn away from
the tents of these wicked men and don’t touch anything
that is theirs, or else you’ll be annihilated through all
their sins.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּעָלוּ מֵעַל מִשְׁכַּן קֹרַח דָּתָן וַאֲבִירָם מִסָּבִיב וְדָתָן וַאֲבִירָם יָצְאוּ נִצָּבִים פֶּתַח אהֳלֵיהֶם וּנְשֵׁיהֶם וּבְנֵיהֶם וְטַפָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּעָלוּ מֵעַל מִשְׁכַּן קֹרַח דָּתָן וַאֲבִירָם מִסָּבִיב וְדָתָן וַאֲבִירָם יָצְאוּ נִצָּבִים פֶּתַח אהֳלֵיהֶם וּנְשֵׁיהֶם וּבְנֵיהֶם וְטַפָּם׃

english.text:
And they got up from around the tabernacle of Korah,
Dathan and Abiram. And Dathan and Abiram came out,
standing at the entrance of their tents, and their wives
and their children and their infants.

translation.text: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.

verses.english:
And they got up from around the tabernacle of Korah,
Dathan and Abiram. And Dathan and Abiram came out,
standing at the entrance of their tents, and their wives
and their children and their infants.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה בְּזֹאת תֵּדְעוּן כִּי יְהֹוָה שְׁלָחַנִי לַעֲשׂוֹת אֵת כּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים הָאֵלֶּה כִּי לֹא מִלִּבִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה בְּזֹאת תֵּדְעוּן כִּי יְהֹוָה שְׁלָחַנִי לַעֲשׂוֹת אֵת כּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים הָאֵלֶּה כִּי לֹא מִלִּבִּי׃

english.text:
And Moses said, “By this you’ll know that YHWH sent me to
do all these things, because it’s not from my own heart.

translation.text: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.

verses.english:
And Moses said, “By this you’ll know that YHWH sent me to
do all these things, because it’s not from my own heart.

verses.hebrew: אִם כְּמוֹת כּל הָאָדָם יְמֻתוּן אֵלֶּה וּפְקֻדַּת כּל הָאָדָם יִפָּקֵד עֲלֵיהֶם לֹא יְהֹוָה שְׁלָחָנִי׃

hebrew.text: אִם כְּמוֹת כּל הָאָדָם יְמֻתוּן אֵלֶּה וּפְקֻדַּת כּל הָאָדָם יִפָּקֵד עֲלֵיהֶם לֹא יְהֹוָה שְׁלָחָנִי׃

english.text:
If these die like the death of every human, and the event
of every human happens to them, then YHWH hasn’t sent me.

translation.text: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the LORD hath not sent me.

verses.english:
If these die like the death of every human, and the event
of every human happens to them, then YHWH hasn’t sent me.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּרִיאָה יִבְרָא יְהֹוָה וּפָצְתָה הָאֲדָמָה אֶת פִּיהָ וּבָלְעָה אֹתָם וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם וְיָרְדוּ חַיִּים שְׁאֹלָה וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי נִאֲצוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה אֶת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּרִיאָה יִבְרָא יְהֹוָה וּפָצְתָה הָאֲדָמָה אֶת פִּיהָ וּבָלְעָה אֹתָם וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם וְיָרְדוּ חַיִּים שְׁאֹלָה וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי נִאֲצוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה אֶת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
But if YHWH will create something, and the ground will
open its mouth and swallow them and all that they have,
and they’ll go down alive to Sheol, then you’ll know that
these people have rejected YHWH.”

translation.text: But if the LORD make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD.

verses.english:
But if YHWH will create something, and the ground will
open its mouth and swallow them and all that they have,
and they’ll go down alive to Sheol, then you’ll know that
these people have rejected YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַתִּבָּקַע הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֵּיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַתִּבָּקַע הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֵּיהֶם׃

english.text:
And it was as he was finishing speaking all these things,
and the ground that was under them was broken up,

translation.text: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:

verses.english:
And it was as he was finishing speaking all these things,
and the ground that was under them was broken up,

verses.hebrew: וַתִּפְתַּח הָאָרֶץ אֶת פִּיהָ וַתִּבְלַע אֹתָם וְאֶת בָּתֵּיהֶם וְאֵת כּל הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר לְקֹרַח וְאֵת כּל הָרְכוּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּפְתַּח הָאָרֶץ אֶת פִּיהָ וַתִּבְלַע אֹתָם וְאֶת בָּתֵּיהֶם וְאֵת כּל הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר לְקֹרַח וְאֵת כּל הָרְכוּשׁ׃

english.text:
and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and
their households and all the people who were with Korah
and all the property,

translation.text: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.

verses.english:
and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and
their households and all the people who were with Korah
and all the property,

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרְדוּ הֵם וְכל אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם חַיִּים שְׁאֹלָה וַתְּכַס עֲלֵיהֶם הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאבְדוּ מִתּוֹךְ הַקָּהָל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרְדוּ הֵם וְכל אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם חַיִּים שְׁאֹלָה וַתְּכַס עֲלֵיהֶם הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאבְדוּ מִתּוֹךְ הַקָּהָל׃

english.text:
and they went down, they and all that they had, alive to
Sheol. And the earth covered them over, and they perished
from among the community.

translation.text: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.

verses.english:
and they went down, they and all that they had, alive to
Sheol. And the earth covered them over, and they perished
from among the community.

verses.hebrew: וְכל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶם נָסוּ לְקֹלָם כִּי אָמְרוּ פֶּן תִּבְלָעֵנוּ הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶם נָסוּ לְקֹלָם כִּי אָמְרוּ פֶּן תִּבְלָעֵנוּ הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And all Israel that was around them fled at the sound of
them, for they said, “Or else the earth will swallow us.”

translation.text: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.

verses.english:
And all Israel that was around them fled at the sound of
them, for they said, “Or else the earth will swallow us.”

verses.hebrew: וְאֵשׁ יָצְאָה מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל אֵת הַחֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתַיִם אִישׁ מַקְרִיבֵי הַקְּטֹרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵשׁ יָצְאָה מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל אֵת הַחֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתַיִם אִישׁ מַקְרִיבֵי הַקְּטֹרֶת׃

english.text:
And fire had gone out from YHWH and consumed the two
hundred fifty people offering the incense.

translation.text: And there came out a fire from the LORD, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.

verses.english:
And fire had gone out from YHWH and consumed the two
hundred fifty people offering the incense.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: אֱמֹר אֶל אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְיָרֵם אֶת הַמַּחְתֹּת מִבֵּין הַשְּׂרֵפָה וְאֶת הָאֵשׁ זְרֵה הָלְאָה כִּי קָדֵשׁוּ׃

hebrew.text: אֱמֹר אֶל אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְיָרֵם אֶת הַמַּחְתֹּת מִבֵּין הַשְּׂרֵפָה וְאֶת הָאֵשׁ זְרֵה הָלְאָה כִּי קָדֵשׁוּ׃

english.text:
“Say to Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, that he should
pick up the fire-holders from the burning and disperse the
fire, because they have become holy.

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man’s name upon his rod.

verses.english:
“Say to Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, that he should
pick up the fire-holders from the burning and disperse the
fire, because they have become holy.

verses.hebrew: אֵת מַחְתּוֹת הַחַטָּאִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּנַפְשֹׁתָם וְעָשׂוּ אֹתָם רִקֻּעֵי פַחִים צִפּוּי לַמִּזְבֵּחַ כִּי הִקְרִיבֻם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּקְדָּשׁוּ וְיִהְיוּ לְאוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: אֵת מַחְתּוֹת הַחַטָּאִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּנַפְשֹׁתָם וְעָשׂוּ אֹתָם רִקֻּעֵי פַחִים צִפּוּי לַמִּזְבֵּחַ כִּי הִקְרִיבֻם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּקְדָּשׁוּ וְיִהְיוּ לְאוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the fire-holders of these who sinned at the cost of
their lives: let them make them into hammered plates as
plating for the altar, because they brought them forward
in front of YHWH, and they became holy, and let them
become a sign to the children of Israel.”

translation.text: And thou shalt write Aaron’s name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.

verses.english:
And the fire-holders of these who sinned at the cost of
their lives: let them make them into hammered plates as
plating for the altar, because they brought them forward
in front of YHWH, and they became holy, and let them
become a sign to the children of Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֵת מַחְתּוֹת הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר הִקְרִיבוּ הַשְּׂרֻפִים וַיְרַקְּעוּם צִפּוּי לַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֵת מַחְתּוֹת הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר הִקְרִיבוּ הַשְּׂרֻפִים וַיְרַקְּעוּם צִפּוּי לַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And Eleazar, the priest, took the fire-holders of bronze
that those who were burned had brought forward, and they
hammered them into a plating for the altar,

translation.text: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.

verses.english:
And Eleazar, the priest, took the fire-holders of bronze
that those who were burned had brought forward, and they
hammered them into a plating for the altar,

verses.hebrew: זִכָּרוֹן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִקְרַב אִישׁ זָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא מִזֶּרַע אַהֲרֹן הוּא לְהַקְטִיר קְטֹרֶת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא יִהְיֶה כְקֹרַח וְכַעֲדָתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: זִכָּרוֹן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִקְרַב אִישׁ זָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא מִזֶּרַע אַהֲרֹן הוּא לְהַקְטִיר קְטֹרֶת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא יִהְיֶה כְקֹרַח וְכַעֲדָתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה לוֹ׃

english.text:
a commemoration for the children of Israel so that no
outsider, one who is not from Aaron’s seed, will come
forward to burn incense in front of YHWH, so he will not
be like Korah and like his congregation, as YHWH spoke to
him by Moses’ hand.

translation.text: And it shall come to pass, that the man’s rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.

verses.english:
a commemoration for the children of Israel so that no
outsider, one who is not from Aaron’s seed, will come
forward to burn incense in front of YHWH, so he will not
be like Korah and like his congregation, as YHWH spoke to
him by Moses’ hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלֹּנוּ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמּחֳרָת עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר אַתֶּם הֲמִתֶּם אֶת עַם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלֹּנוּ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמּחֳרָת עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר אַתֶּם הֲמִתֶּם אֶת עַם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And all the congregation of the children of Israel
complained the next day against Moses and against Aaron,
saying, “You killed YHWH’s people!”

translation.text: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.

verses.english:
And all the congregation of the children of Israel
complained the next day against Moses and against Aaron,
saying, “You killed YHWH’s people!”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּהִקָּהֵל הָעֵדָה עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן וַיִּפְנוּ אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהִנֵּה כִסָּהוּ הֶעָנָן וַיֵּרָא כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה׃

Meeting; and, here, the cloud had covered it, and YHWH’s
glory appeared.

And Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: הֵרֹמּוּ מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה הַזֹּאת וַאֲכַלֶּה אֹתָם כְּרָגַע וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל פְּנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
“Move away from among this congregation, and I’ll finish
them in an instant!” And they fell on their faces.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Bring Aaron’s rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.

“Move away from among this congregation, and I’ll finish

from the altar on it and set incense and carry it quickly
to the congregation and make atonement for them, because a
rage has come out from in front of YHWH! The plague has
begun!”

translation.text: And Moses did so: as the LORD commanded him, so did he.

the community. And, here, the plague had begun among the
people. And he put in incense and made atonement for the
people.

translation.text: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.

english.text:
And he stood between the dead and the living. And the
plague was halted.

translation.text: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the LORD shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?

verses.english:
And he stood between the dead and the living. And the

english.text:

hundred, apart from the dead over the matter of Korah.

verses.english:

english.text: And Moses did it. As YHWH had commanded him, he did so.

verses.english: And Moses did it. As YHWH had commanded him, he did so.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵאמֹר הֵן גָּוַעְנוּ אָבַדְנוּ כֻּלָּנוּ אָבָדְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵאמֹר הֵן גָּוַעְנוּ אָבַדְנוּ כֻּלָּנוּ אָבָדְנוּ׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel said to Moses, saying, “Here,
we’re expiring, we’re perishing, we’re all perishing!

verses.english:
And the children of Israel said to Moses, saying, “Here,
we’re expiring, we’re perishing, we’re all perishing!

verses.hebrew: כֹּל הַקָּרֵב הַקָּרֵב אֶל מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה יָמוּת הַאִם תַּמְנוּ לִגְוֺעַ׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל הַקָּרֵב הַקָּרֵב אֶל מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה יָמוּת הַאִם תַּמְנוּ לִגְוֺעַ׃

english.text:
Everyone who comes close—who comes close to YHWH’s
Tabernacle—will die. Have we come to the end of
expiring?!”

verses.english:
Everyone who comes close—who comes close to YHWH’s
Tabernacle—will die. Have we come to the end of
expiring?!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַהֲרֹן אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ וּבֵית אָבִיךָ אִתָּךְ תִּשְׂאוּ אֶת עֲוֺן הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וְאַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ אִתָּךְ תִּשְׂאוּ אֶת עֲוֺן כְּהֻנַּתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַהֲרֹן אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ וּבֵית אָבִיךָ אִתָּךְ תִּשְׂאוּ אֶת עֲוֺן הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וְאַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ אִתָּךְ תִּשְׂאוּ אֶת עֲוֺן כְּהֻנַּתְכֶם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your
father’s house with you shall bear any crime of the holy
place, and you and your sons with you shall bear any crime
of your priesthood.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father’s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your
father’s house with you shall bear any crime of the holy
place, and you and your sons with you shall bear any crime
of your priesthood.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֶת אַחֶיךָ מַטֵּה לֵוִי שֵׁבֶט אָבִיךָ הַקְרֵב אִתָּךְ וְיִלָּווּ עָלֶיךָ וִישָׁרְתוּךָ וְאַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ אִתָּךְ לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל הָעֵדֻת׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אֶת אַחֶיךָ מַטֵּה לֵוִי שֵׁבֶט אָבִיךָ הַקְרֵב אִתָּךְ וְיִלָּווּ עָלֶיךָ וִישָׁרְתוּךָ וְאַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ אִתָּךְ לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל הָעֵדֻת׃

english.text:
And bring forward your brothers, the tribe of Levi, your
father’s tribe, with you as well, and they shall be
connected to you and shall minister to you, and you and
your sons with you shall be in front of the Tent of the
Testimony.

translation.text: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.

verses.english:
And bring forward your brothers, the tribe of Levi, your
father’s tribe, with you as well, and they shall be
connected to you and shall minister to you, and you and
your sons with you shall be in front of the Tent of the
Testimony.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמְרוּ מִשְׁמַרְתְּךָ וּמִשְׁמֶרֶת כּל הָאֹהֶל אַךְ אֶל כְּלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יִקְרָבוּ וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ גַם הֵם גַּם אַתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמְרוּ מִשְׁמַרְתְּךָ וּמִשְׁמֶרֶת כּל הָאֹהֶל אַךְ אֶל כְּלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יִקְרָבוּ וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ גַם הֵם גַּם אַתֶּם׃

english.text:
And they shall keep your charge, the charge of all of the
tent, but they shall not come close to the equipment of
the holy and to the altar, so they will not die, both they
and you.

translation.text: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.

verses.english:
And they shall keep your charge, the charge of all of the
tent, but they shall not come close to the equipment of
the holy and to the altar, so they will not die, both they
and you.

verses.hebrew: וְנִלְווּ עָלֶיךָ וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לְכֹל עֲבֹדַת הָאֹהֶל וְזָר לֹא יִקְרַב אֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנִלְווּ עָלֶיךָ וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לְכֹל עֲבֹדַת הָאֹהֶל וְזָר לֹא יִקְרַב אֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And they shall be connected to you and shall keep the
charge of the Tent of Meeting, for all the work of the
tent, but an outsider shall not come close to you.

translation.text: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.

verses.english:
And they shall be connected to you and shall keep the
charge of the Tent of Meeting, for all the work of the
tent, but an outsider shall not come close to you.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֵת מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֵת מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְלֹא יִהְיֶה עוֹד קֶצֶף עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֵת מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֵת מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְלֹא יִהְיֶה עוֹד קֶצֶף עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And you shall keep the charge of the holy and the charge
of the altar, so there will not be any more rage at the
children of Israel.

translation.text: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And you shall keep the charge of the holy and the charge
of the altar, so there will not be any more rage at the
children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה לָקַחְתִּי אֶת אֲחֵיכֶם הַלְוִיִּם מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָכֶם מַתָּנָה נְתֻנִים לַיהֹוָה לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה לָקַחְתִּי אֶת אֲחֵיכֶם הַלְוִיִּם מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָכֶם מַתָּנָה נְתֻנִים לַיהֹוָה לַעֲבֹד אֶת עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And I, here, I have taken your brothers, the Levites from
among the children of Israel as a gift to you, given for
YHWH, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are given as a gift for the LORD, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.english:
And I, here, I have taken your brothers, the Levites from
among the children of Israel as a gift to you, given for
YHWH, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ אִתְּךָ תִּשְׁמְרוּ אֶת כְּהֻנַּתְכֶם לְכל דְּבַר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּלְמִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת וַעֲבַדְתֶּם עֲבֹדַת מַתָּנָה אֶתֵּן אֶת כְּהֻנַּתְכֶם וְהַזָּר הַקָּרֵב יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ אִתְּךָ תִּשְׁמְרוּ אֶת כְּהֻנַּתְכֶם לְכל דְּבַר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּלְמִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת וַעֲבַדְתֶּם עֲבֹדַת מַתָּנָה אֶתֵּן אֶת כְּהֻנַּתְכֶם וְהַזָּר הַקָּרֵב יוּמָת׃

english.text:
And you and your sons with you shall watch over your
priesthood for everything of the altar’s and for inside
the pavilion, and you shall serve. I give your priesthood
as a gift of service. And the outsider who comes close
shall be put to death.”

translation.text: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest’s office for everything of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest’s office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

verses.english:
And you and your sons with you shall watch over your
priesthood for everything of the altar’s and for inside
the pavilion, and you shall serve. I give your priesthood
as a gift of service. And the outsider who comes close
shall be put to death.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַהֲרֹן וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי לְךָ אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת תְּרוּמֹתָי לְכל קדְשֵׁי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ נְתַתִּים לְמשְׁחָה וּלְבָנֶיךָ לְחק עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַהֲרֹן וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי לְךָ אֶת מִשְׁמֶרֶת תְּרוּמֹתָי לְכל קדְשֵׁי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ נְתַתִּים לְמשְׁחָה וּלְבָנֶיךָ לְחק עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Aaron, “And I, here, I have given charge
of my donations to you for all the holy things of the
children of Israel. I have given them to you as an
anointing and to your sons as an eternal law.

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Aaron, “And I, here, I have given charge
of my donations to you for all the holy things of the
children of Israel. I have given them to you as an
anointing and to your sons as an eternal law.

verses.hebrew: זֶה יִהְיֶה לְךָ מִקֹּדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים מִן הָאֵשׁ כּל קרְבָּנָם לְכל מִנְחָתָם וּלְכל חַטָּאתָם וּלְכל אֲשָׁמָם אֲשֶׁר יָשִׁיבוּ לִי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים לְךָ הוּא וּלְבָנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: זֶה יִהְיֶה לְךָ מִקֹּדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים מִן הָאֵשׁ כּל קרְבָּנָם לְכל מִנְחָתָם וּלְכל חַטָּאתָם וּלְכל אֲשָׁמָם אֲשֶׁר יָשִׁיבוּ לִי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים לְךָ הוּא וּלְבָנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
This shall be yours from the holy of holies, from the
fire: every offering of theirs, every grain offering of
theirs and every sin offering of theirs and every guilt
offering of theirs that they will pay back to me. It is
holy of holies for you and for your sons.

translation.text: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.

verses.english:
This shall be yours from the holy of holies, from the
fire: every offering of theirs, every grain offering of
theirs and every sin offering of theirs and every guilt
offering of theirs that they will pay back to me. It is
holy of holies for you and for your sons.

verses.hebrew: בְּקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים תֹּאכְלֶנּוּ כּל זָכָר יֹאכַל אֹתוֹ קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: בְּקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים תֹּאכְלֶנּוּ כּל זָכָר יֹאכַל אֹתוֹ קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָּךְ׃

english.text:
You shall eat it in the holy of holies. Every male shall
eat it. It shall be holy to you.

translation.text: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.

verses.english:
You shall eat it in the holy of holies. Every male shall
eat it. It shall be holy to you.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה לְּךָ תְּרוּמַת מַתָּנָם לְכל תְּנוּפֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ נְתַתִּים וּלְבָנֶיךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶיךָ אִתְּךָ לְחק עוֹלָם כּל טָהוֹר בְּבֵיתְךָ יֹאכַל אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה לְּךָ תְּרוּמַת מַתָּנָם לְכל תְּנוּפֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ נְתַתִּים וּלְבָנֶיךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶיךָ אִתְּךָ לְחק עוֹלָם כּל טָהוֹר בְּבֵיתְךָ יֹאכַל אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
“And this is yours: their gift donation, all the elevation
offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to
you and to your sons and to your daughters with you as an
eternal law. Everyone who is pure in your house shall eat
it.

translation.text: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.

verses.english:
“And this is yours: their gift donation, all the elevation
offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to
you and to your sons and to your daughters with you as an
eternal law. Everyone who is pure in your house shall eat
it.

verses.hebrew: כֹּל חֵלֶב יִצְהָר וְכל חֵלֶב תִּירוֹשׁ וְדָגָן רֵאשִׁיתָם אֲשֶׁר יִתְּנוּ לַיהֹוָה לְךָ נְתַתִּים׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל חֵלֶב יִצְהָר וְכל חֵלֶב תִּירוֹשׁ וְדָגָן רֵאשִׁיתָם אֲשֶׁר יִתְּנוּ לַיהֹוָה לְךָ נְתַתִּים׃

english.text:
“All the best of the oil and all the best of the wine and
grain, the first of them that they will give to YHWH: I
have given them to you.

translation.text: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the LORD, them have I given thee.

verses.english:
“All the best of the oil and all the best of the wine and
grain, the first of them that they will give to YHWH: I
have given them to you.

verses.hebrew: בִּכּוּרֵי כּל אֲשֶׁר בְּאַרְצָם אֲשֶׁר יָבִיאוּ לַיהֹוָה לְךָ יִהְיֶה כּל טָהוֹר בְּבֵיתְךָ יֹאכְלֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: בִּכּוּרֵי כּל אֲשֶׁר בְּאַרְצָם אֲשֶׁר יָבִיאוּ לַיהֹוָה לְךָ יִהְיֶה כּל טָהוֹר בְּבֵיתְךָ יֹאכְלֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
The firstfruits of everything that is in their land that
they will bring to YHWH shall be yours. Everyone who is
pure in your house shall eat it.

translation.text: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the LORD, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.

verses.english:
The firstfruits of everything that is in their land that
they will bring to YHWH shall be yours. Everyone who is
pure in your house shall eat it.

verses.hebrew: כּל חֵרֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: כּל חֵרֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ יִהְיֶה׃

english.text: Every devoted thing in Israel shall be yours.

translation.text: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.

verses.english: Every devoted thing in Israel shall be yours.

verses.hebrew: כּל פֶּטֶר רֶחֶם לְכל בָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה יִהְיֶה לָּךְ אַךְ פָּדֹה תִפְדֶּה אֵת בְּכוֹר הָאָדָם וְאֵת בְּכוֹר הַבְּהֵמָה הַטְּמֵאָה תִּפְדֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כּל פֶּטֶר רֶחֶם לְכל בָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה יִהְיֶה לָּךְ אַךְ פָּדֹה תִפְדֶּה אֵת בְּכוֹר הָאָדָם וְאֵת בְּכוֹר הַבְּהֵמָה הַטְּמֵאָה תִּפְדֶּה׃

english.text:
Every first birth of a womb of all flesh that they will
bring forward to YHWH, human and animal, shall be yours.
Just: you shall redeem the human firstborn, and you shall
redeem the firstborn of an impure animal.

translation.text: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the LORD, whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.

verses.english:
Every first birth of a womb of all flesh that they will
bring forward to YHWH, human and animal, shall be yours.
Just: you shall redeem the human firstborn, and you shall
redeem the firstborn of an impure animal.

verses.hebrew: וּפְדוּיָו מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ תִּפְדֶּה בְּעֶרְכְּךָ כֶּסֶף חֲמֵשֶׁת שְׁקָלִים בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִים גֵּרָה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וּפְדוּיָו מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ תִּפְדֶּה בְּעֶרְכְּךָ כֶּסֶף חֲמֵשֶׁת שְׁקָלִים בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִים גֵּרָה הוּא׃

english.text:
And their redemption price: from one month old you shall
redeem it at your appraisal, five shekels of silver by the
shekel of the Holy. It is twenty gerah.

translation.text: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.

verses.english:
And their redemption price: from one month old you shall
redeem it at your appraisal, five shekels of silver by the
shekel of the Holy. It is twenty gerah.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ בְּכוֹר שׁוֹר אוֹ בְכוֹר כֶּשֶׂב אוֹ בְכוֹר עֵז לֹא תִפְדֶּה קֹדֶשׁ הֵם אֶת דָּמָם תִּזְרֹק עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת חֶלְבָּם תַּקְטִיר אִשֶּׁה לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ בְּכוֹר שׁוֹר אוֹ בְכוֹר כֶּשֶׂב אוֹ בְכוֹר עֵז לֹא תִפְדֶּה קֹדֶשׁ הֵם אֶת דָּמָם תִּזְרֹק עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת חֶלְבָּם תַּקְטִיר אִשֶּׁה לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Just: you shall not redeem a firstborn of an ox or
firstborn of a sheep or firstborn of a goat. They are
holy. You shall fling their blood on the altar and burn
their fat to smoke, a fire offering for a pleasant smell
to YHWH.

translation.text: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.english:
Just: you shall not redeem a firstborn of an ox or
firstborn of a sheep or firstborn of a goat. They are
holy. You shall fling their blood on the altar and burn
their fat to smoke, a fire offering for a pleasant smell
to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וּבְשָׂרָם יִהְיֶה לָּךְ כַּחֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וּכְשׁוֹק הַיָּמִין לְךָ יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וּבְשָׂרָם יִהְיֶה לָּךְ כַּחֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וּכְשׁוֹק הַיָּמִין לְךָ יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
And their meat shall be yours; like the breast of the
elevation offering and the right thigh it shall be yours.

translation.text: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.

verses.english:
And their meat shall be yours; like the breast of the
elevation offering and the right thigh it shall be yours.

verses.hebrew: כֹּל תְּרוּמֹת הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יָרִימוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַיהֹוָה נָתַתִּי לְךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶיךָ אִתְּךָ לְחק עוֹלָם בְּרִית מֶלַח עוֹלָם הִוא לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְךָ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אִתָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל תְּרוּמֹת הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יָרִימוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַיהֹוָה נָתַתִּי לְךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶיךָ אִתְּךָ לְחק עוֹלָם בְּרִית מֶלַח עוֹלָם הִוא לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְךָ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אִתָּךְ׃

english.text:
All the donations of the holy things that the children of
Israel will donate to YHWH I have given to you and to your
sons and to your daughters with you as an eternal law. It
is an eternal covenant of salt in front of YHWH for you
and for your seed with you.”

translation.text: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the LORD, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the LORD unto thee and to thy seed with thee.

verses.english:
All the donations of the holy things that the children of
Israel will donate to YHWH I have given to you and to your
sons and to your daughters with you as an eternal law. It
is an eternal covenant of salt in front of YHWH for you
and for your seed with you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַהֲרֹן בְּאַרְצָם לֹא תִנְחָל וְחֵלֶק לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ בְּתוֹכָם אֲנִי חֶלְקְךָ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל אַהֲרֹן בְּאַרְצָם לֹא תִנְחָל וְחֵלֶק לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ בְּתוֹכָם אֲנִי חֶלְקְךָ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Aaron, “You shall not have a legacy in
their land, and you shall not have a portion among them. I
am your portion and your legacy among the children of
Israel.

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Aaron, “You shall not have a legacy in
their land, and you shall not have a portion among them. I
am your portion and your legacy among the children of
Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי לֵוִי הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי כּל מַעֲשֵׂר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לְנַחֲלָה חֵלֶף עֲבֹדָתָם אֲשֶׁר הֵם עֹבְדִים אֶת עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְלִבְנֵי לֵוִי הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי כּל מַעֲשֵׂר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לְנַחֲלָה חֵלֶף עֲבֹדָתָם אֲשֶׁר הֵם עֹבְדִים אֶת עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And to the children of Levi, here, I’ve given every tithe
in Israel as a legacy in exchange for their work that
they’re doing, the service of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.english:
And to the children of Levi, here, I’ve given every tithe
in Israel as a legacy in exchange for their work that
they’re doing, the service of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יִקְרְבוּ עוֹד בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לָשֵׂאת חֵטְא לָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יִקְרְבוּ עוֹד בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לָשֵׂאת חֵטְא לָמוּת׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel shall not come near to the Tent
of Meeting anymore so as to bear sin and die.

translation.text: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel shall not come near to the Tent
of Meeting anymore so as to bear sin and die.

verses.hebrew: וְעָבַד הַלֵּוִי הוּא אֶת עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהֵם יִשְׂאוּ עֲוֺנָם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם וּבְתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יִנְחֲלוּ נַחֲלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעָבַד הַלֵּוִי הוּא אֶת עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהֵם יִשְׂאוּ עֲוֺנָם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם וּבְתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יִנְחֲלוּ נַחֲלָה׃

english.text:
But he, the Levite, shall do the service of the Tent of
Meeting, and they shall bear their crime. It is an eternal
law through your generations. And they shall not have a
legacy among the children of Israel,

translation.text: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.

verses.english:
But he, the Levite, shall do the service of the Tent of
Meeting, and they shall bear their crime. It is an eternal
law through your generations. And they shall not have a
legacy among the children of Israel,

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶת מַעְשַׂר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יָרִימוּ לַיהֹוָה תְּרוּמָה נָתַתִּי לַלְוִיִּם לְנַחֲלָה עַל כֵּן אָמַרְתִּי לָהֶם בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יִנְחֲלוּ נַחֲלָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֶת מַעְשַׂר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יָרִימוּ לַיהֹוָה תְּרוּמָה נָתַתִּי לַלְוִיִּם לְנַחֲלָה עַל כֵּן אָמַרְתִּי לָהֶם בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יִנְחֲלוּ נַחֲלָה׃

english.text:
because I’ve given to the Levites as a legacy the tithe of
the children of Israel that they will give to YHWH as a
donation. On account of this I’ve said to them: they shall
not have a legacy among the children of Israel.”

translation.text: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as an heave offering unto the LORD, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

verses.english:
because I’ve given to the Levites as a legacy the tithe of
the children of Israel that they will give to YHWH as a
donation. On account of this I’ve said to them: they shall
not have a legacy among the children of Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל הַלְוִיִּם תְּדַבֵּר וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי תִקְחוּ מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַמַּעֲשֵׂר אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָכֶם מֵאִתָּם בְּנַחֲלַתְכֶם וַהֲרֵמֹתֶם מִמֶּנּוּ תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה מַעֲשֵׂר מִן הַמַּעֲשֵׂר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל הַלְוִיִּם תְּדַבֵּר וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי תִקְחוּ מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַמַּעֲשֵׂר אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָכֶם מֵאִתָּם בְּנַחֲלַתְכֶם וַהֲרֵמֹתֶם מִמֶּנּוּ תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה מַעֲשֵׂר מִן הַמַּעֲשֵׂר׃

english.text:
“And you shall speak to the Levites and say to them: ‘When
you will take the tithe from the children of Israel that I
have given you from them as your legacy, then you shall
make a donation for YHWH from it, a tithe of the tithe.

translation.text: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD, even a tenth part of the tithe.

verses.english:
“And you shall speak to the Levites and say to them: ‘When
you will take the tithe from the children of Israel that I
have given you from them as your legacy, then you shall
make a donation for YHWH from it, a tithe of the tithe.

verses.hebrew: וְנֶחְשַׁב לָכֶם תְּרוּמַתְכֶם כַּדָּגָן מִן הַגֹּרֶן וְכַמְלֵאָה מִן הַיָּקֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְנֶחְשַׁב לָכֶם תְּרוּמַתְכֶם כַּדָּגָן מִן הַגֹּרֶן וְכַמְלֵאָה מִן הַיָּקֶב׃

english.text:
And it will be counted for you as your donation, like
grain from the threshing floor and like the fill of the
winepress.

translation.text: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.

verses.english:
And it will be counted for you as your donation, like
grain from the threshing floor and like the fill of the
winepress.

verses.hebrew: כֵּן תָּרִימוּ גַם אַתֶּם תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה מִכֹּל מַעְשְׂרֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר תִּקְחוּ מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּנְתַתֶּם מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: כֵּן תָּרִימוּ גַם אַתֶּם תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה מִכֹּל מַעְשְׂרֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר תִּקְחוּ מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּנְתַתֶּם מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
So you shall donate, you too, a donation for YHWH from all
your tithes that you will take from the children of
Israel, and you shall give a donation for YHWH to Aaron,
the priest, from them.

translation.text: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the LORD’s heave offering to Aaron the priest.

verses.english:
So you shall donate, you too, a donation for YHWH from all
your tithes that you will take from the children of
Israel, and you shall give a donation for YHWH to Aaron,
the priest, from them.

verses.hebrew: מִכֹּל מַתְּנֹתֵיכֶם תָּרִימוּ אֵת כּל תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה מִכּל חֶלְבּוֹ אֶת מִקְדְּשׁוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: מִכֹּל מַתְּנֹתֵיכֶם תָּרִימוּ אֵת כּל תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה מִכּל חֶלְבּוֹ אֶת מִקְדְּשׁוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
From all your gifts you shall make every donation for
YHWH, from all the best of it, its holy part from it.’

translation.text: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.

verses.english:
From all your gifts you shall make every donation for
YHWH, from all the best of it, its holy part from it.’

verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם בַּהֲרִימְכֶם אֶת חֶלְבּוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ וְנֶחְשַׁב לַלְוִיִּם כִּתְבוּאַת גֹּרֶן וְכִתְבוּאַת יָקֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם בַּהֲרִימְכֶם אֶת חֶלְבּוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ וְנֶחְשַׁב לַלְוִיִּם כִּתְבוּאַת גֹּרֶן וְכִתְבוּאַת יָקֶב׃

english.text:
And you shall say to them: ‘When you donate the best of it
from it, then it shall be counted to the Levites like the
produce of the threshing floor and like the produce of the
winepress.

translation.text: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.

verses.english:
And you shall say to them: ‘When you donate the best of it
from it, then it shall be counted to the Levites like the
produce of the threshing floor and like the produce of the
winepress.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם אֹתוֹ בְּכל מָקוֹם אַתֶּם וּבֵיתְכֶם כִּי שָׂכָר הוּא לָכֶם חֵלֶף עֲבֹדַתְכֶם בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם אֹתוֹ בְּכל מָקוֹם אַתֶּם וּבֵיתְכֶם כִּי שָׂכָר הוּא לָכֶם חֵלֶף עֲבֹדַתְכֶם בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And you shall eat it in every place, you and your house,
because it is compensation for you in exchange for your
work in the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.english:
And you shall eat it in every place, you and your house,
because it is compensation for you in exchange for your
work in the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תִשְׂאוּ עָלָיו חֵטְא בַּהֲרִימְכֶם אֶת חֶלְבּוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ וְאֶת קדְשֵׁי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא תְחַלְּלוּ וְלֹא תָמוּתוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תִשְׂאוּ עָלָיו חֵטְא בַּהֲרִימְכֶם אֶת חֶלְבּוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ וְאֶת קדְשֵׁי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא תְחַלְּלוּ וְלֹא תָמוּתוּ׃

english.text:
And you will not bear sin over it, when you have donated
its best from it, so you will not desecrate the holy
things of the children of Israel, and you will not die.’”

translation.text: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.

verses.english:
And you will not bear sin over it, when you have donated
its best from it, so you will not desecrate the holy
things of the children of Israel, and you will not die.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.hebrew: זֹאת חֻקַּת הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִקְחוּ אֵלֶיךָ פָרָה אֲדֻמָּה תְּמִימָה אֲשֶׁר אֵין בָּהּ מוּם אֲשֶׁר לֹא עָלָה עָלֶיהָ עֹל׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת חֻקַּת הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִקְחוּ אֵלֶיךָ פָרָה אֲדֻמָּה תְּמִימָה אֲשֶׁר אֵין בָּהּ מוּם אֲשֶׁר לֹא עָלָה עָלֶיהָ עֹל׃

english.text:
“This is the law of the instruction that YHWH commanded,
saying: Speak to the children of Israel that they should
take to you an unblemished red cow that has no injury, on
which a yoke has not gone.

translation.text: This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:

verses.english:
“This is the law of the instruction that YHWH commanded,
saying: Speak to the children of Israel that they should
take to you an unblemished red cow that has no injury, on
which a yoke has not gone.

verses.hebrew: וּנְתַתֶּם אֹתָהּ אֶל אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְהוֹצִיא אֹתָהּ אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְשָׁחַט אֹתָהּ לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וּנְתַתֶּם אֹתָהּ אֶל אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְהוֹצִיא אֹתָהּ אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְשָׁחַט אֹתָהּ לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
And you shall give it to Eleazar, the priest, and one
shall bring it outside the camp and slaughter it in front
of him.

translation.text: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:

verses.english:
And you shall give it to Eleazar, the priest, and one
shall bring it outside the camp and slaughter it in front
of him.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן מִדָּמָהּ בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ וְהִזָּה אֶל נֹכַח פְּנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד מִדָּמָהּ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן מִדָּמָהּ בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ וְהִזָּה אֶל נֹכַח פְּנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד מִדָּמָהּ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים׃

english.text:
And Eleazar, the priest, shall take some of its blood with
his finger and sprinkle some of its blood toward the front
of the Tent of Meeting seven times.

translation.text: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:

verses.english:
And Eleazar, the priest, shall take some of its blood with
his finger and sprinkle some of its blood toward the front
of the Tent of Meeting seven times.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׂרַף אֶת הַפָּרָה לְעֵינָיו אֶת עֹרָהּ וְאֶת בְּשָׂרָהּ וְאֶת דָּמָהּ עַל פִּרְשָׁהּ יִשְׂרֹף׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׂרַף אֶת הַפָּרָה לְעֵינָיו אֶת עֹרָהּ וְאֶת בְּשָׂרָהּ וְאֶת דָּמָהּ עַל פִּרְשָׁהּ יִשְׂרֹף׃

english.text:
And one shall burn the cow before his eyes. He shall burn
its skin and its meat and its blood and its dung.

translation.text: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:

verses.english:
And one shall burn the cow before his eyes. He shall burn
its skin and its meat and its blood and its dung.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן עֵץ אֶרֶז וְאֵזוֹב וּשְׁנִי תוֹלָעַת וְהִשְׁלִיךְ אֶל תּוֹךְ שְׂרֵפַת הַפָּרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן עֵץ אֶרֶז וְאֵזוֹב וּשְׁנִי תוֹלָעַת וְהִשְׁלִיךְ אֶל תּוֹךְ שְׂרֵפַת הַפָּרָה׃

english.text:
And the priest shall take cedarwood and hyssop and scarlet
and throw them into the fire of the cow.

translation.text: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

verses.english:
And the priest shall take cedarwood and hyssop and scarlet
and throw them into the fire of the cow.

verses.hebrew: וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו הַכֹּהֵן וְרָחַץ בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמַּיִם וְאַחַר יָבֹא אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה וְטָמֵא הַכֹּהֵן עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו הַכֹּהֵן וְרָחַץ בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמַּיִם וְאַחַר יָבֹא אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה וְטָמֵא הַכֹּהֵן עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And the priest shall wash his clothes and wash his flesh
with water, and after that he shall come to the camp, and
the priest shall be impure until evening.

translation.text: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
And the priest shall wash his clothes and wash his flesh
with water, and after that he shall come to the camp, and
the priest shall be impure until evening.

verses.hebrew: וְהַשֹּׂרֵף אֹתָהּ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו בַּמַּיִם וְרָחַץ בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשֹּׂרֵף אֹתָהּ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו בַּמַּיִם וְרָחַץ בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And the one who burns it shall wash his clothes with water
and wash his flesh with water and be impure until evening.

translation.text: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.

verses.english:
And the one who burns it shall wash his clothes with water
and wash his flesh with water and be impure until evening.

verses.hebrew: וְאָסַף אִישׁ טָהוֹר אֵת אֵפֶר הַפָּרָה וְהִנִּיחַ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה בְּמָקוֹם טָהוֹר וְהָיְתָה לַעֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמִשְׁמֶרֶת לְמֵי נִדָּה חַטָּאת הִוא׃

hebrew.text: וְאָסַף אִישׁ טָהוֹר אֵת אֵפֶר הַפָּרָה וְהִנִּיחַ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה בְּמָקוֹם טָהוֹר וְהָיְתָה לַעֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמִשְׁמֶרֶת לְמֵי נִדָּה חַטָּאת הִוא׃

english.text:
And a man who is pure shall gather the cow’s ashes and
leave them outside the camp in a pure place, and it shall
be for the congregation of the children of Israel to be
kept for water of impurity, for sin expiation.

translation.text: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.

verses.english:
And a man who is pure shall gather the cow’s ashes and
leave them outside the camp in a pure place, and it shall
be for the congregation of the children of Israel to be
kept for water of impurity, for sin expiation.

verses.hebrew: וְכִבֶּס הָאֹסֵף אֶת אֵפֶר הַפָּרָה אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב וְהָיְתָה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְכִבֶּס הָאֹסֵף אֶת אֵפֶר הַפָּרָה אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב וְהָיְתָה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
And the one who gathers the cow’s ashes shall wash his
clothes and be impure until evening. And it will be for
the children of Israel and for the alien who resides among
them as an eternal law.

translation.text: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.

verses.english:
And the one who gathers the cow’s ashes shall wash his
clothes and be impure until evening. And it will be for
the children of Israel and for the alien who resides among
them as an eternal law.

verses.hebrew: הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּמֵת לְכל נֶפֶשׁ אָדָם וְטָמֵא שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּמֵת לְכל נֶפֶשׁ אָדָם וְטָמֵא שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

english.text:
“One who touches a dead body of any human being will be
impure seven days.

translation.text: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

verses.english:
“One who touches a dead body of any human being will be
impure seven days.

verses.hebrew: הוּא יִתְחַטָּא בוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי יִטְהָר וְאִם לֹא יִתְחַטָּא בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי לֹא יִטְהָר׃

hebrew.text: הוּא יִתְחַטָּא בוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי יִטְהָר וְאִם לֹא יִתְחַטָּא בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי לֹא יִטְהָר׃

english.text:
He shall do sin expiation with it on the third day, and on
the seventh day he will be pure. And if he will not do sin
expiation on the third day, then on the seventh day he
will not be pure.

translation.text: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

verses.english:
He shall do sin expiation with it on the third day, and on
the seventh day he will be pure. And if he will not do sin
expiation on the third day, then on the seventh day he
will not be pure.

verses.hebrew: כּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּמֵת בְּנֶפֶשׁ הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת וְלֹא יִתְחַטָּא אֶת מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה טִמֵּא וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל כִּי מֵי נִדָּה לֹא זֹרַק עָלָיו טָמֵא יִהְיֶה עוֹד טֻמְאָתוֹ בוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּמֵת בְּנֶפֶשׁ הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת וְלֹא יִתְחַטָּא אֶת מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה טִמֵּא וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל כִּי מֵי נִדָּה לֹא זֹרַק עָלָיו טָמֵא יִהְיֶה עוֹד טֻמְאָתוֹ בוֹ׃

english.text:
Anyone who touches a dead body of a human being who has
died and does not do sin expiation has made YHWH’s
Tabernacle impure, and that person will be cut off from
Israel. Because the water of impurity was not flung on
him, he shall be impure. His impurity is still in him.

translation.text: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.

verses.english:
Anyone who touches a dead body of a human being who has
died and does not do sin expiation has made YHWH’s
Tabernacle impure, and that person will be cut off from
Israel. Because the water of impurity was not flung on
him, he shall be impure. His impurity is still in him.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת הַתּוֹרָה אָדָם כִּי יָמוּת בְּאֹהֶל כּל הַבָּא אֶל הָאֹהֶל וְכל אֲשֶׁר בָּאֹהֶל יִטְמָא שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת הַתּוֹרָה אָדָם כִּי יָמוּת בְּאֹהֶל כּל הַבָּא אֶל הָאֹהֶל וְכל אֲשֶׁר בָּאֹהֶל יִטְמָא שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

english.text:
“This is the instruction: When a human will die in a tent,
anyone who comes into the tent and everything that is in
the tent will be impure seven days.

translation.text: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

verses.english:
“This is the instruction: When a human will die in a tent,
anyone who comes into the tent and everything that is in
the tent will be impure seven days.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל כְּלִי פָתוּחַ אֲשֶׁר אֵין צָמִיד פָּתִיל עָלָיו טָמֵא הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל כְּלִי פָתוּחַ אֲשֶׁר אֵין צָמִיד פָּתִיל עָלָיו טָמֵא הוּא׃

english.text:
And any open container, on which there is not a fastened
cover: it is impure.

translation.text: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.

verses.english:
And any open container, on which there is not a fastened
cover: it is impure.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע עַל פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה בַּחֲלַל חֶרֶב אוֹ בְמֵת אוֹ בְעֶצֶם אָדָם אוֹ בְקָבֶר יִטְמָא שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע עַל פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה בַּחֲלַל חֶרֶב אוֹ בְמֵת אוֹ בְעֶצֶם אָדָם אוֹ בְקָבֶר יִטְמָא שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

english.text:
And anyone who, at an open field, will touch a corpse
slain by the sword or a dead body or a human bone or a
grave will be impure seven days.

translation.text: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

verses.english:
And anyone who, at an open field, will touch a corpse
slain by the sword or a dead body or a human bone or a
grave will be impure seven days.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקְחוּ לַטָּמֵא מֵעֲפַר שְׂרֵפַת הַחַטָּאת וְנָתַן עָלָיו מַיִם חַיִּים אֶל כֶּלִי׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקְחוּ לַטָּמֵא מֵעֲפַר שְׂרֵפַת הַחַטָּאת וְנָתַן עָלָיו מַיִם חַיִּים אֶל כֶּלִי׃

english.text:
And they shall take for the one who is impure some of the
ashes of the fire of sin expiation, and one shall put
living water on it in a container.

translation.text: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:

verses.english:
And they shall take for the one who is impure some of the
ashes of the fire of sin expiation, and one shall put
living water on it in a container.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח אֵזוֹב וְטָבַל בַּמַּיִם אִישׁ טָהוֹר וְהִזָּה עַל הָאֹהֶל וְעַל כּל הַכֵּלִים וְעַל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ שָׁם וְעַל הַנֹּגֵעַ בַּעֶצֶם אוֹ בֶחָלָל אוֹ בַמֵּת אוֹ בַקָּבֶר׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח אֵזוֹב וְטָבַל בַּמַּיִם אִישׁ טָהוֹר וְהִזָּה עַל הָאֹהֶל וְעַל כּל הַכֵּלִים וְעַל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ שָׁם וְעַל הַנֹּגֵעַ בַּעֶצֶם אוֹ בֶחָלָל אוֹ בַמֵּת אוֹ בַקָּבֶר׃

english.text:
And a man who is pure shall take hyssop and dip it in the
water and sprinkle it on the tent and on all the items and
on the persons who were there and on the one who touched
the bone or the slain corpse or the dead body or the
grave.

translation.text: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:

verses.english:
And a man who is pure shall take hyssop and dip it in the
water and sprinkle it on the tent and on all the items and
on the persons who were there and on the one who touched
the bone or the slain corpse or the dead body or the
grave.

verses.hebrew: וְהִזָּה הַטָּהֹר עַל הַטָּמֵא בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְחִטְּאוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָהֵר בָּעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְהִזָּה הַטָּהֹר עַל הַטָּמֵא בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְחִטְּאוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָהֵר בָּעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And the one who is pure shall sprinkle it on the impure on
the third day and on the seventh day, so he shall expiate
sin from him on the seventh day, and he shall wash his
clothes and wash in water and be pure in the evening.

translation.text: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.

verses.english:
And the one who is pure shall sprinkle it on the impure on
the third day and on the seventh day, so he shall expiate
sin from him on the seventh day, and he shall wash his
clothes and wash in water and be pure in the evening.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא וְלֹא יִתְחַטָּא וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִתּוֹךְ הַקָּהָל כִּי אֶת מִקְדַּשׁ יְהֹוָה טִמֵּא מֵי נִדָּה לֹא זֹרַק עָלָיו טָמֵא הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא וְלֹא יִתְחַטָּא וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִתּוֹךְ הַקָּהָל כִּי אֶת מִקְדַּשׁ יְהֹוָה טִמֵּא מֵי נִדָּה לֹא זֹרַק עָלָיו טָמֵא הוּא׃

english.text:
And if a man will be impure and will not do sin expiation,
then that person will be cut off from among the community,
because he has made YHWH’s holy place impure. The water of
impurity has not been flung on him: he is impure.

translation.text: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.

verses.english:
And if a man will be impure and will not do sin expiation,
then that person will be cut off from among the community,
because he has made YHWH’s holy place impure. The water of
impurity has not been flung on him: he is impure.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה לָהֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם וּמַזֵּה מֵי הַנִּדָּה יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְהַנֹּגֵעַ בְּמֵי הַנִּדָּה יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה לָהֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם וּמַזֵּה מֵי הַנִּדָּה יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְהַנֹּגֵעַ בְּמֵי הַנִּדָּה יִטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And it will become an eternal law for them. And one who
sprinkles the water of impurity shall wash his clothes,
and one who touches the water of impurity will be impure
until evening.

translation.text: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.

verses.english:
And it will become an eternal law for them. And one who
sprinkles the water of impurity shall wash his clothes,
and one who touches the water of impurity will be impure
until evening.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בּוֹ הַטָּמֵא יִטְמָא וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ הַנֹּגַעַת תִּטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בּוֹ הַטָּמֵא יִטְמָא וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ הַנֹּגַעַת תִּטְמָא עַד הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
And whatever the impure one will touch will be impure, and
the person who touches it will be impure until evening.”

translation.text: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.

verses.english:
And whatever the impure one will touch will be impure, and
the person who touches it will be impure until evening.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל הָעֵדָה מִדְבַּר צִן בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן וַיֵּשֶׁב הָעָם בְּקָדֵשׁ וַתָּמת שָׁם מִרְיָם וַתִּקָּבֵר שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל הָעֵדָה מִדְבַּר צִן בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן וַיֵּשֶׁב הָעָם בְּקָדֵשׁ וַתָּמת שָׁם מִרְיָם וַתִּקָּבֵר שָׁם׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel, all the congregation, came
to the wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the
people stayed in Kadesh. And Miriam died there and was
buried there.

translation.text: Then came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel, all the congregation, came
to the wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the
people stayed in Kadesh. And Miriam died there and was
buried there.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא הָיָה מַיִם לָעֵדָה וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא הָיָה מַיִם לָעֵדָה וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן׃

english.text:
And there was no water for the congregation, and they
assembled against Moses and against Aaron.

translation.text: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

verses.english:
And there was no water for the congregation, and they
assembled against Moses and against Aaron.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרֶב הָעָם עִם מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֵאמֹר וְלוּ גָוַעְנוּ בִּגְוַע אַחֵינוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּרֶב הָעָם עִם מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֵאמֹר וְלוּ גָוַעְנוּ בִּגְוַע אַחֵינוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the people quarreled with Moses, and they said,
saying, “If only we had expired when our brothers expired
in front of YHWH!

translation.text: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!

verses.english:
And the people quarreled with Moses, and they said,
saying, “If only we had expired when our brothers expired
in front of YHWH!

verses.hebrew: וְלָמָה הֲבֵאתֶם אֶת קְהַל יְהֹוָה אֶל הַמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה לָמוּת שָׁם אֲנַחְנוּ וּבְעִירֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָמָה הֲבֵאתֶם אֶת קְהַל יְהֹוָה אֶל הַמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה לָמוּת שָׁם אֲנַחְנוּ וּבְעִירֵנוּ׃

english.text:
And why have you brought YHWH’s community to this
wilderness to die there, we and our cattle?

translation.text: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?

verses.english:
And why have you brought YHWH’s community to this
wilderness to die there, we and our cattle?

verses.hebrew: וְלָמָה הֶעֱלִיתֻנוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם לְהָבִיא אֹתָנוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם הָרָע הַזֶּה לֹא מְקוֹם זֶרַע וּתְאֵנָה וְגֶפֶן וְרִמּוֹן וּמַיִם אַיִן לִשְׁתּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְלָמָה הֶעֱלִיתֻנוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם לְהָבִיא אֹתָנוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם הָרָע הַזֶּה לֹא מְקוֹם זֶרַע וּתְאֵנָה וְגֶפֶן וְרִמּוֹן וּמַיִם אַיִן לִשְׁתּוֹת׃

english.text:
And why did you bring us up from Egypt to bring us to this
bad place? It’s not a place of seed and fig and vine and
pomegranate, and there’s no water to drink!”

translation.text: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.

verses.english:
And why did you bring us up from Egypt to bring us to this
bad place? It’s not a place of seed and fig and vine and
pomegranate, and there’s no water to drink!”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן מִפְּנֵי הַקָּהָל אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל פְּנֵיהֶם וַיֵּרָא כְבוֹד יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן מִפְּנֵי הַקָּהָל אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל פְּנֵיהֶם וַיֵּרָא כְבוֹד יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron came from in front of the community to
the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, and they fell on
their faces. And YHWH’s glory appeared to them.

translation.text: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto them.

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron came from in front of the community to
the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, and they fell on
their faces. And YHWH’s glory appeared to them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: קַח אֶת הַמַּטֶּה וְהַקְהֵל אֶת הָעֵדָה אַתָּה וְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וְדִבַּרְתֶּם אֶל הַסֶּלַע לְעֵינֵיהֶם וְנָתַן מֵימָיו וְהוֹצֵאתָ לָהֶם מַיִם מִן הַסֶּלַע וְהִשְׁקִיתָ אֶת הָעֵדָה וְאֶת בְּעִירָם׃

hebrew.text: קַח אֶת הַמַּטֶּה וְהַקְהֵל אֶת הָעֵדָה אַתָּה וְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וְדִבַּרְתֶּם אֶל הַסֶּלַע לְעֵינֵיהֶם וְנָתַן מֵימָיו וְהוֹצֵאתָ לָהֶם מַיִם מִן הַסֶּלַע וְהִשְׁקִיתָ אֶת הָעֵדָה וְאֶת בְּעִירָם׃

english.text:
“Take the staff and assemble the congregation, you and
Aaron, your brother. And you shall speak to the rock
before their eyes, and it will give its water. So you
shall bring water out of the rock for them and give a
drink to the congregation and their cattle.”

translation.text: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.

verses.english:
“Take the staff and assemble the congregation, you and
Aaron, your brother. And you shall speak to the rock
before their eyes, and it will give its water. So you
shall bring water out of the rock for them and give a
drink to the congregation and their cattle.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמַּטֶּה מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמַּטֶּה מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ׃

english.text:
And Moses took the staff from in front of YHWH as He
commanded him.

translation.text: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.

verses.english:
And Moses took the staff from in front of YHWH as He
commanded him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְהִלוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶת הַקָּהָל אֶל פְּנֵי הַסָּלַע וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְעוּ נָא הַמֹּרִים הֲמִן הַסֶּלַע הַזֶּה נוֹצִיא לָכֶם מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְהִלוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶת הַקָּהָל אֶל פְּנֵי הַסָּלַע וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְעוּ נָא הַמֹּרִים הֲמִן הַסֶּלַע הַזֶּה נוֹצִיא לָכֶם מָיִם׃

english.text:
And Moses and Aaron assembled the community opposite the
rock. And he said to them, “Listen, rebels, shall we bring
water out of this rock for you?”

translation.text: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?

verses.english:
And Moses and Aaron assembled the community opposite the
rock. And he said to them, “Listen, rebels, shall we bring
water out of this rock for you?”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרֶם מֹשֶׁה אֶת יָדוֹ וַיַּךְ אֶת הַסֶּלַע בְּמַטֵּהוּ פַּעֲמָיִם וַיֵּצְאוּ מַיִם רַבִּים וַתֵּשְׁתְּ הָעֵדָה וּבְעִירָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּרֶם מֹשֶׁה אֶת יָדוֹ וַיַּךְ אֶת הַסֶּלַע בְּמַטֵּהוּ פַּעֲמָיִם וַיֵּצְאוּ מַיִם רַבִּים וַתֵּשְׁתְּ הָעֵדָה וּבְעִירָם׃

english.text:
And Moses lifted his hand and struck the rock with his
staff twice. And much water came out! And the congregation
and their cattle drank.

translation.text: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.

verses.english:
And Moses lifted his hand and struck the rock with his
staff twice. And much water came out! And the congregation
and their cattle drank.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן יַעַן לֹא הֶאֱמַנְתֶּם בִּי לְהַקְדִּישֵׁנִי לְעֵינֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָכֵן לֹא תָבִיאוּ אֶת הַקָּהָל הַזֶּה אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן יַעַן לֹא הֶאֱמַנְתֶּם בִּי לְהַקְדִּישֵׁנִי לְעֵינֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָכֵן לֹא תָבִיאוּ אֶת הַקָּהָל הַזֶּה אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָהֶם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses and to Aaron, “Because you did not
trust in me, to make me holy before the eyes of the
children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this
community to the land that I have given them!”

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses and to Aaron, “Because you did not
trust in me, to make me holy before the eyes of the
children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this
community to the land that I have given them!”

verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה מֵי מְרִיבָה אֲשֶׁר רָבוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת יְהֹוָה וַיִּקָּדֵשׁ בָּם׃

hebrew.text: הֵמָּה מֵי מְרִיבָה אֲשֶׁר רָבוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת יְהֹוָה וַיִּקָּדֵשׁ בָּם׃

english.text:
They are the waters of Meribah, over which the children of
Israel quarreled with YHWH, and He was made holy among
them.

translation.text: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.

verses.english:
They are the waters of Meribah, over which the children of
Israel quarreled with YHWH, and He was made holy among
them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֹשֶׁה מַלְאָכִים מִקָּדֵשׁ אֶל מֶלֶךְ אֱדוֹם כֹּה אָמַר אָחִיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֵת כּל הַתְּלָאָה אֲשֶׁר מְצָאָתְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֹשֶׁה מַלְאָכִים מִקָּדֵשׁ אֶל מֶלֶךְ אֱדוֹם כֹּה אָמַר אָחִיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֵת כּל הַתְּלָאָה אֲשֶׁר מְצָאָתְנוּ׃

english.text:
And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom.
“Your brother, Israel, says this: You know all the
hardship that has found us:

translation.text: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:

verses.english:
And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom.
“Your brother, Israel, says this: You know all the
hardship that has found us:

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרְדוּ אֲבֹתֵינוּ מִצְרַיְמָה וַנֵּשֶׁב בְּמִצְרַיִם יָמִים רַבִּים וַיָּרֵעוּ לָנוּ מִצְרַיִם וְלַאֲבֹתֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרְדוּ אֲבֹתֵינוּ מִצְרַיְמָה וַנֵּשֶׁב בְּמִצְרַיִם יָמִים רַבִּים וַיָּרֵעוּ לָנוּ מִצְרַיִם וְלַאֲבֹתֵינוּ׃

english.text:
And our fathers went down to Egypt, and we lived in Egypt
many days. And Egypt was bad to us and to our fathers,

translation.text: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:

verses.english:
And our fathers went down to Egypt, and we lived in Egypt
many days. And Egypt was bad to us and to our fathers,

verses.hebrew: וַנִּצְעַק אֶל יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁמַע קֹלֵנוּ וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָךְ וַיֹּצִאֵנוּ מִמִּצְרָיִם וְהִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ בְקָדֵשׁ עִיר קְצֵה גְבוּלֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַנִּצְעַק אֶל יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁמַע קֹלֵנוּ וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָךְ וַיֹּצִאֵנוּ מִמִּצְרָיִם וְהִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ בְקָדֵשׁ עִיר קְצֵה גְבוּלֶךָ׃

english.text:
and we cried to YHWH, and He heard our voice and sent an
angel and brought us from Egypt. And here we are in
Kadesh, a city at the edge of your border.

translation.text: And when we cried unto the LORD, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:

verses.english:
and we cried to YHWH, and He heard our voice and sent an
angel and brought us from Egypt. And here we are in
Kadesh, a city at the edge of your border.

verses.hebrew: נַעְבְּרָה נָּא בְאַרְצֶךָ לֹא נַעֲבֹר בְּשָׂדֶה וּבְכֶרֶם וְלֹא נִשְׁתֶּה מֵי בְאֵר דֶּרֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ נֵלֵךְ לֹא נִטֶּה יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול עַד אֲשֶׁר נַעֲבֹר גְּבֻלֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: נַעְבְּרָה נָּא בְאַרְצֶךָ לֹא נַעֲבֹר בְּשָׂדֶה וּבְכֶרֶם וְלֹא נִשְׁתֶּה מֵי בְאֵר דֶּרֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ נֵלֵךְ לֹא נִטֶּה יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול עַד אֲשֶׁר נַעֲבֹר גְּבֻלֶךָ׃

english.text:
Let us pass through your land. We won’t pass through a
field or through a vineyard, and we won’t drink the water
of a well. We’ll go by the king’s road, we won’t turn
right or left, until we pass your border.”

translation.text: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king’s high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.

verses.english:
Let us pass through your land. We won’t pass through a
field or through a vineyard, and we won’t drink the water
of a well. We’ll go by the king’s road, we won’t turn
right or left, until we pass your border.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֱדוֹם לֹא תַעֲבֹר בִּי פֶּן בַּחֶרֶב אֵצֵא לִקְרָאתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֱדוֹם לֹא תַעֲבֹר בִּי פֶּן בַּחֶרֶב אֵצֵא לִקְרָאתֶךָ׃

english.text:
And Edom said to him, “You won’t pass through me, or else
I’ll go out to you with the sword.”

translation.text: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.

verses.english:
And Edom said to him, “You won’t pass through me, or else
I’ll go out to you with the sword.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמְסִלָּה נַעֲלֶה וְאִם מֵימֶיךָ נִשְׁתֶּה אֲנִי וּמִקְנַי וְנָתַתִּי מִכְרָם רַק אֵין דָּבָר בְּרַגְלַי אֶעֱבֹרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמְסִלָּה נַעֲלֶה וְאִם מֵימֶיךָ נִשְׁתֶּה אֲנִי וּמִקְנַי וְנָתַתִּי מִכְרָם רַק אֵין דָּבָר בְּרַגְלַי אֶעֱבֹרָה׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel said to him, “We’ll go up by
the highway, and if we drink your water, I and my cattle,
then I’ll pay its price. Only, it’s nothing: let me pass
through by foot.”

translation.text: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing anything else, go through on my feet.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel said to him, “We’ll go up by
the highway, and if we drink your water, I and my cattle,
then I’ll pay its price. Only, it’s nothing: let me pass
through by foot.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תַעֲבֹר וַיֵּצֵא אֱדוֹם לִקְרָאתוֹ בְּעַם כָּבֵד וּבְיָד חֲזָקָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תַעֲבֹר וַיֵּצֵא אֱדוֹם לִקְרָאתוֹ בְּעַם כָּבֵד וּבְיָד חֲזָקָה׃

english.text:
And he said, “You won’t pass.” And Edom went out to him
with a heavy mass of people and a strong hand,

translation.text: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.

verses.english:
And he said, “You won’t pass.” And Edom went out to him
with a heavy mass of people and a strong hand,

verses.hebrew: וַיְמָאֵן אֱדוֹם נְתֹן אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבֹר בִּגְבֻלוֹ וַיֵּט יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמָאֵן אֱדוֹם נְתֹן אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבֹר בִּגְבֻלוֹ וַיֵּט יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעָלָיו׃

english.text:
and Edom refused to allow Israel to pass through his
border. And Israel turned away from him.

translation.text: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.

verses.english:
and Edom refused to allow Israel to pass through his
border. And Israel turned away from him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִקָּדֵשׁ וַיָּבֹאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל הָעֵדָה הֹר הָהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִקָּדֵשׁ וַיָּבֹאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל הָעֵדָה הֹר הָהָר׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel,
all the congregation, came to Mount Hor.

translation.text: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel,
all the congregation, came to Mount Hor.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן בְּהֹר הָהָר עַל גְּבוּל אֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם לֵאמֹר׃
