hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אַהֲרֹן בְּהֹר הָהָר עַל גְּבוּל אֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses and to Aaron at Mount Hor, on the
border of the land of Edom, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses and to Aaron at Mount Hor, on the
border of the land of Edom, saying,

verses.hebrew: יֵאָסֵף אַהֲרֹן אֶל עַמָּיו כִּי לֹא יָבֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל אֲשֶׁר מְרִיתֶם אֶת פִּי לְמֵי מְרִיבָה׃

hebrew.text: יֵאָסֵף אַהֲרֹן אֶל עַמָּיו כִּי לֹא יָבֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל אֲשֶׁר מְרִיתֶם אֶת פִּי לְמֵי מְרִיבָה׃

english.text:
“Let Aaron be gathered to his people, because he shall not
come to the land that I have given to the children of
Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters
of Meribah.

translation.text: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.

verses.english:
“Let Aaron be gathered to his people, because he shall not
come to the land that I have given to the children of
Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters
of Meribah.

verses.hebrew: קַח אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ וְהַעַל אֹתָם הֹר הָהָר׃

hebrew.text: קַח אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ וְהַעַל אֹתָם הֹר הָהָר׃

english.text:
Take Aaron and Eleazar, his son, and take them up Mount
Hor,

translation.text: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:

verses.english:
Take Aaron and Eleazar, his son, and take them up Mount
Hor,

verses.hebrew: וְהַפְשֵׁט אֶת אַהֲרֹן אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּם אֶת אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ וְאַהֲרֹן יֵאָסֵף וּמֵת שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַפְשֵׁט אֶת אַהֲרֹן אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּם אֶת אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ וְאַהֲרֹן יֵאָסֵף וּמֵת שָׁם׃

english.text:
and take off Aaron’s clothes, and you shall put them on
Eleazar, his son. And Aaron will be gathered and die
there.”

translation.text: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.

verses.english:
and take off Aaron’s clothes, and you shall put them on
Eleazar, his son. And Aaron will be gathered and die
there.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶל הֹר הָהָר לְעֵינֵי כּל הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶל הֹר הָהָר לְעֵינֵי כּל הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
And Moses did as YHWH commanded him. And they went up to
Mount Hor before the eyes of all the congregation.

translation.text: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

verses.english:
And Moses did as YHWH commanded him. And they went up to
Mount Hor before the eyes of all the congregation.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּפְשֵׁט מֹשֶׁה אֶת אַהֲרֹן אֶת בְּגָדָיו וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתָם אֶת אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ וַיָּמת אַהֲרֹן שָׁם בְּרֹאשׁ הָהָר וַיֵּרֶד מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר מִן הָהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּפְשֵׁט מֹשֶׁה אֶת אַהֲרֹן אֶת בְּגָדָיו וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתָם אֶת אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ וַיָּמת אַהֲרֹן שָׁם בְּרֹאשׁ הָהָר וַיֵּרֶד מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר מִן הָהָר׃

english.text:
And Moses took off Aaron’s clothes and put them on
Eleazar, his son. And Aaron died there on the top of the
mountain. And Moses and Eleazar came down from the
mountain.

translation.text: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.

verses.english:
And Moses took off Aaron’s clothes and put them on
Eleazar, his son. And Aaron died there on the top of the
mountain. And Moses and Eleazar came down from the
mountain.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ כּל הָעֵדָה כִּי גָוַע אַהֲרֹן וַיִּבְכּוּ אֶת אַהֲרֹן שְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם כֹּל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ כּל הָעֵדָה כִּי גָוַע אַהֲרֹן וַיִּבְכּוּ אֶת אַהֲרֹן שְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם כֹּל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And all the congregation saw that Aaron had expired, and
all the house of Israel mourned Aaron thirty days.

translation.text: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

verses.english:
And all the congregation saw that Aaron had expired, and
all the house of Israel mourned Aaron thirty days.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע הַכְּנַעֲנִי מֶלֶךְ עֲרָד יֹשֵׁב הַנֶּגֶב כִּי בָּא יִשְׂרָאֵל דֶּרֶךְ הָאֲתָרִים וַיִּלָּחֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׁבְּ מִמֶּנּוּ שֶׁבִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע הַכְּנַעֲנִי מֶלֶךְ עֲרָד יֹשֵׁב הַנֶּגֶב כִּי בָּא יִשְׂרָאֵל דֶּרֶךְ הָאֲתָרִים וַיִּלָּחֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׁבְּ מִמֶּנּוּ שֶׁבִי׃

english.text:
And the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the
Negeb, heard that Israel was coming by the way of Atharim,
and he fought against Israel and took some of them
prisoners.

translation.text: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.

verses.english:
And the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the
Negeb, heard that Israel was coming by the way of Atharim,
and he fought against Israel and took some of them
prisoners.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּדַּר יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶדֶר לַיהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר אִם נָתֹן תִּתֵּן אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה בְּיָדִי וְהַחֲרַמְתִּי אֶת עָרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּדַּר יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶדֶר לַיהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר אִם נָתֹן תִּתֵּן אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה בְּיָדִי וְהַחֲרַמְתִּי אֶת עָרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And Israel made a vow to YHWH and said, “If you will
deliver this people into my hand, then I shall completely
destroy their cities.”

translation.text: And Israel vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.

verses.english:
And Israel made a vow to YHWH and said, “If you will
deliver this people into my hand, then I shall completely
destroy their cities.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה בְּקוֹל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַכְּנַעֲנִי וַיַּחֲרֵם אֶתְהֶם וְאֶת עָרֵיהֶם וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם חרְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה בְּקוֹל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַכְּנַעֲנִי וַיַּחֲרֵם אֶתְהֶם וְאֶת עָרֵיהֶם וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם חרְמָה׃

english.text:
And YHWH listened to Israel’s voice and delivered the
Canaanite, and they completely destroyed them and their
cities. And the name of the place was called Hormah.

translation.text: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.

verses.english:
And YHWH listened to Israel’s voice and delivered the
Canaanite, and they completely destroyed them and their
cities. And the name of the place was called Hormah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהֹר הָהָר דֶּרֶךְ יַם סוּף לִסְבֹב אֶת אֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם וַתִּקְצַר נֶפֶשׁ הָעָם בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהֹר הָהָר דֶּרֶךְ יַם סוּף לִסְבֹב אֶת אֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם וַתִּקְצַר נֶפֶשׁ הָעָם בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Mount Hor by way of the Red Sea
road to go around the land of Edom. And the people’s soul
was getting short on the way.

translation.text: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Mount Hor by way of the Red Sea
road to go around the land of Edom. And the people’s soul
was getting short on the way.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר הָעָם בֵּאלֹהִים וּבְמֹשֶׁה לָמָה הֶעֱלִיתֻנוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם לָמוּת בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּי אֵין לֶחֶם וְאֵין מַיִם וְנַפְשֵׁנוּ קָצָה בַּלֶּחֶם הַקְּלֹקֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר הָעָם בֵּאלֹהִים וּבְמֹשֶׁה לָמָה הֶעֱלִיתֻנוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם לָמוּת בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּי אֵין לֶחֶם וְאֵין מַיִם וְנַפְשֵׁנוּ קָצָה בַּלֶּחֶם הַקְּלֹקֵל׃

english.text:
And the people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why
did you bring us up from Egypt to die in the wilderness?
Because there’s no bread, and there’s no water, and our
soul is disgusted with the cursed bread.”

translation.text: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.

verses.english:
And the people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why
did you bring us up from Egypt to die in the wilderness?
Because there’s no bread, and there’s no water, and our
soul is disgusted with the cursed bread.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהֹוָה בָּעָם אֵת הַנְּחָשִׁים הַשְּׂרָפִים וַיְנַשְּׁכוּ אֶת הָעָם וַיָּמת עַם רָב מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהֹוָה בָּעָם אֵת הַנְּחָשִׁים הַשְּׂרָפִים וַיְנַשְּׁכוּ אֶת הָעָם וַיָּמת עַם רָב מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And YHWH let fiery snakes go among the people, and they
bit the people, and a great many people from Israel died.

translation.text: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.

verses.english:
And YHWH let fiery snakes go among the people, and they
bit the people, and a great many people from Israel died.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הָעָם אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמְרוּ חָטָאנוּ כִּי דִבַּרְנוּ בַיהֹוָה וָבָךְ הִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל יְהֹוָה וְיָסֵר מֵעָלֵינוּ אֶת הַנָּחָשׁ וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַד הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא הָעָם אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמְרוּ חָטָאנוּ כִּי דִבַּרְנוּ בַיהֹוָה וָבָךְ הִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל יְהֹוָה וְיָסֵר מֵעָלֵינוּ אֶת הַנָּחָשׁ וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַד הָעָם׃

english.text:
And the people came to Moses, and they said, “We’ve
sinned, because we spoke against YHWH and against you.
Pray to YHWH, that He will turn the snake away from us.”
And Moses prayed on behalf of the people.

translation.text: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD, and against thee; pray unto the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.

verses.english:
And the people came to Moses, and they said, “We’ve
sinned, because we spoke against YHWH and against you.
Pray to YHWH, that He will turn the snake away from us.”
And Moses prayed on behalf of the people.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עֲשֵׂה לְךָ שָׂרָף וְשִׂים אֹתוֹ עַל נֵס וְהָיָה כּל הַנָּשׁוּךְ וְרָאָה אֹתוֹ וָחָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עֲשֵׂה לְךָ שָׂרָף וְשִׂים אֹתוֹ עַל נֵס וְהָיָה כּל הַנָּשׁוּךְ וְרָאָה אֹתוֹ וָחָי׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Make a fiery one and set it on a
pole, and it will be that everyone who is bitten and sees
it will live.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Make a fiery one and set it on a
pole, and it will be that everyone who is bitten and sees
it will live.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה נְחַשׁ נְחֹשֶׁת וַיְשִׂמֵהוּ עַל הַנֵּס וְהָיָה אִם נָשַׁךְ הַנָּחָשׁ אֶת אִישׁ וְהִבִּיט אֶל נְחַשׁ הַנְּחֹשֶׁת וָחָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה נְחַשׁ נְחֹשֶׁת וַיְשִׂמֵהוּ עַל הַנֵּס וְהָיָה אִם נָשַׁךְ הַנָּחָשׁ אֶת אִישׁ וְהִבִּיט אֶל נְחַשׁ הַנְּחֹשֶׁת וָחָי׃

english.text:
And Moses made a bronze snake and set it on a pole, and it
was, if a snake bit a man, then he would look at the
bronze snake and live.

translation.text: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.

verses.english:
And Moses made a bronze snake and set it on a pole, and it
was, if a snake bit a man, then he would look at the
bronze snake and live.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּאֹבֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּאֹבֹת׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel traveled, and they camped in
Oboth.

translation.text: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel traveled, and they camped in
Oboth.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֹבֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעִיֵּי הָעֲבָרִים בַּמִּדְבָּר אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי מוֹאָב מִמִּזְרַח הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֹבֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעִיֵּי הָעֲבָרִים בַּמִּדְבָּר אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי מוֹאָב מִמִּזְרַח הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Oboth, and they camped in
Iye-abarim, in the wilderness that is toward Moab, toward
the sun’s rising.

translation.text: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ijeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Oboth, and they camped in
Iye-abarim, in the wilderness that is toward Moab, toward
the sun’s rising.

verses.hebrew: מִשָּׁם נָסָעוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּנַחַל זָרֶד׃

hebrew.text: מִשָּׁם נָסָעוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּנַחַל זָרֶד׃

english.text:
From there they traveled, and they camped in the Wadi
Zered.

translation.text: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.

verses.english:
From there they traveled, and they camped in the Wadi
Zered.

verses.hebrew: מִשָּׁם נָסָעוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ מֵעֵבֶר אַרְנוֹן אֲשֶׁר בַּמִּדְבָּר הַיֹּצֵא מִגְּבֻל הָאֱמֹרִי כִּי אַרְנוֹן גְּבוּל מוֹאָב בֵּין מוֹאָב וּבֵין הָאֱמֹרִי׃

hebrew.text: מִשָּׁם נָסָעוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ מֵעֵבֶר אַרְנוֹן אֲשֶׁר בַּמִּדְבָּר הַיֹּצֵא מִגְּבֻל הָאֱמֹרִי כִּי אַרְנוֹן גְּבוּל מוֹאָב בֵּין מוֹאָב וּבֵין הָאֱמֹרִי׃

english.text:
From there they traveled, and they camped across the
Arnon, which is in the wilderness that extends from the
border of the Amorite, because Arnon is Moab’s border,
between Moab and the Amorite.

translation.text: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

verses.english:
From there they traveled, and they camped across the
Arnon, which is in the wilderness that extends from the
border of the Amorite, because Arnon is Moab’s border,
between Moab and the Amorite.

verses.hebrew: עַל כֵּן יֵאָמַר בְּסֵפֶר מִלְחֲמֹת יְהֹוָה אֶת וָהֵב בְּסוּפָה וְאֶת הַנְּחָלִים אַרְנוֹן׃

hebrew.text: עַל כֵּן יֵאָמַר בְּסֵפֶר מִלְחֲמֹת יְהֹוָה אֶת וָהֵב בְּסוּפָה וְאֶת הַנְּחָלִים אַרְנוֹן׃

english.text:
On account of this it is said in the Scroll of the Wars of
YHWH: Waheb in Suphah and the wadis of Arnon,

translation.text: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the LORD, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,

verses.english:
On account of this it is said in the Scroll of the Wars of
YHWH: Waheb in Suphah and the wadis of Arnon,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶשֶׁד הַנְּחָלִים אֲשֶׁר נָטָה לְשֶׁבֶת עָר וְנִשְׁעַן לִגְבוּל מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶשֶׁד הַנְּחָלִים אֲשֶׁר נָטָה לְשֶׁבֶת עָר וְנִשְׁעַן לִגְבוּל מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
and the slope of the wadis that reached to the settlement
of Ar, and pressed to Moab’s border.

translation.text: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.

verses.english:
and the slope of the wadis that reached to the settlement
of Ar, and pressed to Moab’s border.

verses.hebrew: וּמִשָּׁם בְּאֵרָה הִוא הַבְּאֵר אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה לְמֹשֶׁה אֱסֹף אֶת הָעָם וְאֶתְּנָה לָהֶם מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וּמִשָּׁם בְּאֵרָה הִוא הַבְּאֵר אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה לְמֹשֶׁה אֱסֹף אֶת הָעָם וְאֶתְּנָה לָהֶם מָיִם׃

english.text:
And from there to Beer: that is the well of which YHWH
said to Moses, “Gather the people, so I may give them
water.”

translation.text: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the LORD spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.

verses.english:
And from there to Beer: that is the well of which YHWH
said to Moses, “Gather the people, so I may give them
water.”

verses.hebrew: אָז יָשִׁיר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת עֲלִי בְאֵר עֱנוּ לָהּ׃

hebrew.text: אָז יָשִׁיר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת עֲלִי בְאֵר עֱנוּ לָהּ׃

english.text: Then Israel sang this song: Spring up, well. Sing to it.

translation.text: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:

verses.english: Then Israel sang this song: Spring up, well. Sing to it.

verses.hebrew: בְּאֵר חֲפָרוּהָ שָׂרִים כָּרוּהָ נְדִיבֵי הָעָם בִּמְחֹקֵק בְּמִשְׁעֲנֹתָם וּמִמִּדְבָּר מַתָּנָה׃

hebrew.text: בְּאֵר חֲפָרוּהָ שָׂרִים כָּרוּהָ נְדִיבֵי הָעָם בִּמְחֹקֵק בְּמִשְׁעֲנֹתָם וּמִמִּדְבָּר מַתָּנָה׃

english.text:
The commanders hewed the well, the people’s nobles dug it,
with a scepter, with their staffs. And from the wilderness
to Mattanah,

translation.text: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:

verses.english:
The commanders hewed the well, the people’s nobles dug it,
with a scepter, with their staffs. And from the wilderness
to Mattanah,

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּתָּנָה נַחֲלִיאֵל וּמִנַּחֲלִיאֵל בָּמוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּמִמַּתָּנָה נַחֲלִיאֵל וּמִנַּחֲלִיאֵל בָּמוֹת׃

english.text:
and from Mattanah to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to
Bamoth,

translation.text: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:

verses.english:
and from Mattanah to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to
Bamoth,

verses.hebrew: וּמִבָּמוֹת הַגַּיְא אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂדֵה מוֹאָב רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה וְנִשְׁקָפָה עַל פְּנֵי הַיְשִׁימֹן׃

hebrew.text: וּמִבָּמוֹת הַגַּיְא אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂדֵה מוֹאָב רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה וְנִשְׁקָפָה עַל פְּנֵי הַיְשִׁימֹן׃

english.text:
and from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the field of
Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks toward Jeshimon.

translation.text: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.

verses.english:
and from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the field of
Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks toward Jeshimon.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלְאָכִים אֶל סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלְאָכִים אֶל סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And Israel sent messengers to Sihon, king of the Amorites,
saying,

translation.text: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

verses.english:
And Israel sent messengers to Sihon, king of the Amorites,
saying,

verses.hebrew: אֶעְבְּרָה בְאַרְצֶךָ לֹא נִטֶּה בְּשָׂדֶה וּבְכֶרֶם לֹא נִשְׁתֶּה מֵי בְאֵר בְּדֶרֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ נֵלֵךְ עַד אֲשֶׁר נַעֲבֹר גְּבֻלֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אֶעְבְּרָה בְאַרְצֶךָ לֹא נִטֶּה בְּשָׂדֶה וּבְכֶרֶם לֹא נִשְׁתֶּה מֵי בְאֵר בְּדֶרֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ נֵלֵךְ עַד אֲשֶׁר נַעֲבֹר גְּבֻלֶךָ׃

english.text:
“Let me pass through your land. We won’t turn in at a
field and at a vineyard and won’t drink well waters. We’ll
go by the king’s road until we pass your border.”

translation.text: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king’s high way, until we be past thy borders.

verses.english:
“Let me pass through your land. We won’t turn in at a
field and at a vineyard and won’t drink well waters. We’ll
go by the king’s road until we pass your border.”

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא נָתַן סִיחֹן אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבֹר בִּגְבֻלוֹ וַיֶּאֱסֹף סִיחֹן אֶת כּל עַמּוֹ וַיֵּצֵא לִקְרַאת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּדְבָּרָה וַיָּבֹא יָהְצָה וַיִּלָּחֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא נָתַן סִיחֹן אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבֹר בִּגְבֻלוֹ וַיֶּאֱסֹף סִיחֹן אֶת כּל עַמּוֹ וַיֵּצֵא לִקְרַאת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּדְבָּרָה וַיָּבֹא יָהְצָה וַיִּלָּחֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Sihon did not allow Israel to pass within his border.
And Sihon gathered all his people and went out to Israel
at the wilderness and came to Jahaz and fought against
Israel.

translation.text: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

verses.english:
And Sihon did not allow Israel to pass within his border.
And Sihon gathered all his people and went out to Israel
at the wilderness and came to Jahaz and fought against
Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּהוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְפִי חָרֶב וַיִּירַשׁ אֶת אַרְצוֹ מֵאַרְנֹן עַד יַבֹּק עַד בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן כִּי עַז גְּבוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכֵּהוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְפִי חָרֶב וַיִּירַשׁ אֶת אַרְצוֹ מֵאַרְנֹן עַד יַבֹּק עַד בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן כִּי עַז גְּבוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
And Israel struck him by the sword and took possession of
his land from Arnon to Jabbok, to the children of Ammon,
because the border of the children of Ammon was strong.

translation.text: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.

verses.english:
And Israel struck him by the sword and took possession of
his land from Arnon to Jabbok, to the children of Ammon,
because the border of the children of Ammon was strong.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל עָרֵי הָאֱמֹרִי בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן וּבְכל בְּנֹתֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל עָרֵי הָאֱמֹרִי בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן וּבְכל בְּנֹתֶיהָ׃

english.text:
And Israel took all of these cities, and Israel lived in
all the Amorite cities in Heshbon and all of its environs,

translation.text: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.

verses.english:
And Israel took all of these cities, and Israel lived in
all the Amorite cities in Heshbon and all of its environs,

verses.hebrew: כִּי חֶשְׁבּוֹן עִיר סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי הִוא וְהוּא נִלְחַם בְּמֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב הָרִאשׁוֹן וַיִּקַּח אֶת כּל אַרְצוֹ מִיָּדוֹ עַד אַרְנֹן׃

hebrew.text: כִּי חֶשְׁבּוֹן עִיר סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי הִוא וְהוּא נִלְחַם בְּמֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב הָרִאשׁוֹן וַיִּקַּח אֶת כּל אַרְצוֹ מִיָּדוֹ עַד אַרְנֹן׃

english.text:
because Heshbon was the city of Sihon, the king of the
Amorite, and he fought against the former king of Moab and
took all of his land from his hand as far as Arnon.

translation.text: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.

verses.english:
because Heshbon was the city of Sihon, the king of the
Amorite, and he fought against the former king of Moab and
took all of his land from his hand as far as Arnon.

verses.hebrew: עַל כֵּן יֹאמְרוּ הַמֹּשְׁלִים בֹּאוּ חֶשְׁבּוֹן תִּבָּנֶה וְתִכּוֹנֵן עִיר סִיחוֹן׃

hebrew.text: עַל כֵּן יֹאמְרוּ הַמֹּשְׁלִים בֹּאוּ חֶשְׁבּוֹן תִּבָּנֶה וְתִכּוֹנֵן עִיר סִיחוֹן׃

english.text:
On account of this they say proverbially: Come to Heshbon.
Built and founded is Sihon’s city.

translation.text: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:

verses.english:
On account of this they say proverbially: Come to Heshbon.
Built and founded is Sihon’s city.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵשׁ יָצְאָה מֵחֶשְׁבּוֹן לֶהָבָה מִקִּרְיַת סִיחֹן אָכְלָה עָר מוֹאָב בַּעֲלֵי בָּמוֹת אַרְנֹן׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֵשׁ יָצְאָה מֵחֶשְׁבּוֹן לֶהָבָה מִקִּרְיַת סִיחֹן אָכְלָה עָר מוֹאָב בַּעֲלֵי בָּמוֹת אַרְנֹן׃

english.text:
For fire went out of Heshbon, flame from Sihon’s town; it
consumed Ar of Moab, the lords of the high places of
Arnon.

translation.text: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.

verses.english:
For fire went out of Heshbon, flame from Sihon’s town; it
consumed Ar of Moab, the lords of the high places of
Arnon.

verses.hebrew: אוֹי לְךָ מוֹאָב אָבַדְתָּ עַם כְּמוֹשׁ נָתַן בָּנָיו פְּלֵיטִם וּבְנֹתָיו בַּשְּׁבִית לְמֶלֶךְ אֱמֹרִי סִיחוֹן׃

hebrew.text: אוֹי לְךָ מוֹאָב אָבַדְתָּ עַם כְּמוֹשׁ נָתַן בָּנָיו פְּלֵיטִם וּבְנֹתָיו בַּשְּׁבִית לְמֶלֶךְ אֱמֹרִי סִיחוֹן׃

english.text:
Woe unto you, Moab: you’ve perished, Chemosh’s people.
He’s made his sons refugees and his daughters captive to
the king of the Amorite, Sihon.

translation.text: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.

verses.english:
Woe unto you, Moab: you’ve perished, Chemosh’s people.
He’s made his sons refugees and his daughters captive to
the king of the Amorite, Sihon.

verses.hebrew: וַנִּירָם אָבַד חֶשְׁבּוֹן עַד דִּיבֹן וַנַּשִּׁים עַד נֹפַח אֲשֶׁר עַד מֵידְבָא׃

hebrew.text: וַנִּירָם אָבַד חֶשְׁבּוֹן עַד דִּיבֹן וַנַּשִּׁים עַד נֹפַח אֲשֶׁר עַד מֵידְבָא׃

english.text:
And their fiefdom perished, Heshbon to Dibon, and we
devastated up to Nophah which reaches to Medeba.

translation.text: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.

verses.english:
And their fiefdom perished, Heshbon to Dibon, and we
devastated up to Nophah which reaches to Medeba.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ הָאֱמֹרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ הָאֱמֹרִי׃

english.text: And Israel lived in the Amorite’s land.

translation.text: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.

verses.english: And Israel lived in the Amorite’s land.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֹשֶׁה לְרַגֵּל אֶת יַעְזֵר וַיִּלְכְּדוּ בְּנֹתֶיהָ (ויירש) [וַיּוֹרֶשׁ] אֶת הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֹשֶׁה לְרַגֵּל אֶת יַעְזֵר וַיִּלְכְּדוּ בְּנֹתֶיהָ (ויירש) [וַיּוֹרֶשׁ] אֶת הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר שָׁם׃

english.text:
And Moses sent to spy on Jazer, and they captured its
environs and dispossessed the Amorite who was there.

translation.text: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.

verses.english:
And Moses sent to spy on Jazer, and they captured its
environs and dispossessed the Amorite who was there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ דֶּרֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וַיֵּצֵא עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן לִקְרָאתָם הוּא וְכל עַמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה אֶדְרֶעִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ דֶּרֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וַיֵּצֵא עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן לִקְרָאתָם הוּא וְכל עַמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה אֶדְרֶעִי׃

english.text:
And they turned and went up the road of Bashan, and Og,
the king of Bashan, went out to them, he and all his
people, to war at Edrei.

translation.text: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.

verses.english:
And they turned and went up the road of Bashan, and Og,
the king of Bashan, went out to them, he and all his
people, to war at Edrei.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אַל תִּירָא אֹתוֹ כִּי בְיָדְךָ נָתַתִּי אֹתוֹ וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ וְאֶת אַרְצוֹ וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לְסִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה אַל תִּירָא אֹתוֹ כִּי בְיָדְךָ נָתַתִּי אֹתוֹ וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ וְאֶת אַרְצוֹ וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לְסִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, because I’ve
delivered him and all his people and his land into your
hand, and you’ll do to him as you did to Sihon, king of
the Amorite, who lived in Heshbon.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, because I’ve
delivered him and all his people and his land into your
hand, and you’ll do to him as you did to Sihon, king of
the Amorite, who lived in Heshbon.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכּוּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ עַד בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר לוֹ שָׂרִיד וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֶת אַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכּוּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ עַד בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר לוֹ שָׂרִיד וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֶת אַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
And they struck him and his sons and all his people until
he did not have a remnant left, and they took possession
of his land.

translation.text: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.

verses.english:
And they struck him and his sons and all his people until
he did not have a remnant left, and they took possession
of his land.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַרְבוֹת מוֹאָב מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַרְבוֹת מוֹאָב מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel traveled, and they camped in
the plains of Moab, across the Jordan from Jericho.

translation.text: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel traveled, and they camped in
the plains of Moab, across the Jordan from Jericho.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא בָּלָק בֶּן צִפּוֹר אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יִשְׂרָאֵל לָאֱמֹרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא בָּלָק בֶּן צִפּוֹר אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יִשְׂרָאֵל לָאֱמֹרִי׃

english.text:
And Balak, son of Zippor, saw everything that Israel had
done to the Amorite.

translation.text: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

verses.english:
And Balak, son of Zippor, saw everything that Israel had
done to the Amorite.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּגר מוֹאָב מִפְּנֵי הָעָם מְאֹד כִּי רַב הוּא וַיָּקץ מוֹאָב מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּגר מוֹאָב מִפְּנֵי הָעָם מְאֹד כִּי רַב הוּא וַיָּקץ מוֹאָב מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moab was very fearful because of the people because it
was numerous, and Moab felt a disgust at the children of
Israel.

translation.text: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And Moab was very fearful because of the people because it
was numerous, and Moab felt a disgust at the children of
Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מוֹאָב אֶל זִקְנֵי מִדְיָן עַתָּה יְלַחֲכוּ הַקָּהָל אֶת כּל סְבִיבֹתֵינוּ כִּלְחֹךְ הַשּׁוֹר אֵת יֶרֶק הַשָּׂדֶה וּבָלָק בֶּן צִפּוֹר מֶלֶךְ לְמוֹאָב בָּעֵת הַהִוא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מוֹאָב אֶל זִקְנֵי מִדְיָן עַתָּה יְלַחֲכוּ הַקָּהָל אֶת כּל סְבִיבֹתֵינוּ כִּלְחֹךְ הַשּׁוֹר אֵת יֶרֶק הַשָּׂדֶה וּבָלָק בֶּן צִפּוֹר מֶלֶךְ לְמוֹאָב בָּעֵת הַהִוא׃

english.text:
And Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now the community
will lick up all of our surroundings the way an ox licks
up the plants of a field!” And Balak, son of Zippor, was
king of Moab at that time.

translation.text: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field.

verses.english:
And Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now the community
will lick up all of our surroundings the way an ox licks
up the plants of a field!” And Balak, son of Zippor, was
king of Moab at that time.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל בִּלְעָם בֶּן בְּעֹר פְּתוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר עַל הַנָּהָר אֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹ לִקְרֹא לוֹ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה עַם יָצָא מִמִּצְרַיִם הִנֵּה כִסָּה אֶת עֵין הָאָרֶץ וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב מִמֻּלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל בִּלְעָם בֶּן בְּעֹר פְּתוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר עַל הַנָּהָר אֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹ לִקְרֹא לוֹ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה עַם יָצָא מִמִּצְרַיִם הִנֵּה כִסָּה אֶת עֵין הָאָרֶץ וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב מִמֻּלִי׃

english.text:
And he sent messengers to Balaam, son of Beor, at Pethor,
which is on the river—the land of the children of his
people—to call him, saying, “Here, a people has come out
from Egypt. Here, it has covered the eye of the land. And
it’s sitting across from me!

translation.text: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:

verses.english:
And he sent messengers to Balaam, son of Beor, at Pethor,
which is on the river—the land of the children of his
people—to call him, saying, “Here, a people has come out
from Egypt. Here, it has covered the eye of the land. And
it’s sitting across from me!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לְכָה נָּא אָרָה לִּי אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי עָצוּם הוּא מִמֶּנִּי אוּלַי אוּכַל נַכֶּה בּוֹ וַאֲגָרְשֶׁנּוּ מִן הָאָרֶץ כִּי יָדַעְתִּי אֵת אֲשֶׁר תְּבָרֵךְ מְבֹרָךְ וַאֲשֶׁר תָּאֹר יוּאָר׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לְכָה נָּא אָרָה לִּי אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי עָצוּם הוּא מִמֶּנִּי אוּלַי אוּכַל נַכֶּה בּוֹ וַאֲגָרְשֶׁנּוּ מִן הָאָרֶץ כִּי יָדַעְתִּי אֵת אֲשֶׁר תְּבָרֵךְ מְבֹרָךְ וַאֲשֶׁר תָּאֹר יוּאָר׃

english.text:
And now, go, curse this people for me, because it’s more
powerful than I—maybe I’ll be able: we’ll strike it, and
I’ll drive it out from the land—because I know that
whoever you’ll bless will be blessed, and whoever you’ll
curse will be cursed.”

translation.text: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.

verses.english:
And now, go, curse this people for me, because it’s more
powerful than I—maybe I’ll be able: we’ll strike it, and
I’ll drive it out from the land—because I know that
whoever you’ll bless will be blessed, and whoever you’ll
curse will be cursed.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ זִקְנֵי מוֹאָב וְזִקְנֵי מִדְיָן וּקְסָמִים בְּיָדָם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו דִּבְרֵי בָלָק׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ זִקְנֵי מוֹאָב וְזִקְנֵי מִדְיָן וּקְסָמִים בְּיָדָם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו דִּבְרֵי בָלָק׃

english.text:
And Moab’s elders and Midian’s elders went, and divination
implements were in their hand, and they came to Balaam and
spoke Balak’s words to him.

translation.text: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.

verses.english:
And Moab’s elders and Midian’s elders went, and divination
implements were in their hand, and they came to Balaam and
spoke Balak’s words to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם לִינוּ פֹה הַלַּיְלָה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִי אֶתְכֶם דָּבָר כַּאֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֵלָי וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב עִם בִּלְעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם לִינוּ פֹה הַלַּיְלָה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִי אֶתְכֶם דָּבָר כַּאֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֵלָי וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב עִם בִּלְעָם׃

english.text:
And he said to them, “Spend the night here tonight, and
I’ll bring back word to you as YHWH will speak to me.” And
the chiefs of Moab stayed with Balaam.

translation.text: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.

verses.english:
And he said to them, “Spend the night here tonight, and
I’ll bring back word to you as YHWH will speak to me.” And
the chiefs of Moab stayed with Balaam.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר מִי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר מִי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
And God came to Balaam and said, “Who are these people
with you?”

translation.text: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?

verses.english:
And God came to Balaam and said, “Who are these people
with you?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים בָּלָק בֶּן צִפֹּר מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב שָׁלַח אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים בָּלָק בֶּן צִפֹּר מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב שָׁלַח אֵלָי׃

english.text:
And Balaam said to God, “Balak, son of Zippor, king of
Moab, sent to me:

translation.text: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying,

verses.english:
And Balaam said to God, “Balak, son of Zippor, king of
Moab, sent to me:

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה הָעָם הַיֹּצֵא מִמִּצְרַיִם וַיְכַס אֶת עֵין הָאָרֶץ עַתָּה לְכָה קָבָה לִּי אֹתוֹ אוּלַי אוּכַל לְהִלָּחֶם בּוֹ וְגֵרַשְׁתִּיו׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה הָעָם הַיֹּצֵא מִמִּצְרַיִם וַיְכַס אֶת עֵין הָאָרֶץ עַתָּה לְכָה קָבָה לִּי אֹתוֹ אוּלַי אוּכַל לְהִלָּחֶם בּוֹ וְגֵרַשְׁתִּיו׃

english.text:
‘Here is a people who came out from Egypt and has covered
the eye of the land. Now go, execrate it for me. Maybe
I’ll be able to fight against it, and I’ll drive it out.’”

translation.text: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.

verses.english:
‘Here is a people who came out from Egypt and has covered
the eye of the land. Now go, execrate it for me. Maybe
I’ll be able to fight against it, and I’ll drive it out.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל בִּלְעָם לֹא תֵלֵךְ עִמָּהֶם לֹא תָאֹר אֶת הָעָם כִּי בָרוּךְ הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל בִּלְעָם לֹא תֵלֵךְ עִמָּהֶם לֹא תָאֹר אֶת הָעָם כִּי בָרוּךְ הוּא׃

english.text:
And God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You
shall not curse the people, because it is blessed.”

translation.text: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.

verses.english:
And God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You
shall not curse the people, because it is blessed.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם בִּלְעָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל שָׂרֵי בָלָק לְכוּ אֶל אַרְצְכֶם כִּי מֵאֵן יְהֹוָה לְתִתִּי לַהֲלֹךְ עִמָּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם בִּלְעָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל שָׂרֵי בָלָק לְכוּ אֶל אַרְצְכֶם כִּי מֵאֵן יְהֹוָה לְתִתִּי לַהֲלֹךְ עִמָּכֶם׃

english.text:
And Balaam got up in the morning and said to Balak’s
chiefs, “Go to your land, because YHWH refused to allow me
to go with you.”

translation.text: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.

verses.english:
And Balaam got up in the morning and said to Balak’s
chiefs, “Go to your land, because YHWH refused to allow me
to go with you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקוּמוּ שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל בָּלָק וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵאֵן בִּלְעָם הֲלֹךְ עִמָּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקוּמוּ שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל בָּלָק וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵאֵן בִּלְעָם הֲלֹךְ עִמָּנוּ׃

english.text:
And the chiefs of Moab got up and came to Balak and said,
“Balaam refused to go with us.”

translation.text: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.

verses.english:
And the chiefs of Moab got up and came to Balak and said,
“Balaam refused to go with us.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד בָּלָק שְׁלֹחַ שָׂרִים רַבִּים וְנִכְבָּדִים מֵאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד בָּלָק שְׁלֹחַ שָׂרִים רַבִּים וְנִכְבָּדִים מֵאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
And Balak went on again to send more numerous and
prestigious chiefs than these.

translation.text: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.

verses.english:
And Balak went on again to send more numerous and
prestigious chiefs than these.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ כֹּה אָמַר בָּלָק בֶּן צִפּוֹר אַל נָא תִמָּנַע מֵהֲלֹךְ אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ כֹּה אָמַר בָּלָק בֶּן צִפּוֹר אַל נָא תִמָּנַע מֵהֲלֹךְ אֵלָי׃

english.text:
And they came to Balaam and said to him, “Balak, son of
Zippor, said this: ‘Don’t be held back from coming to me,

translation.text: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:

verses.english:
And they came to Balaam and said to him, “Balak, son of
Zippor, said this: ‘Don’t be held back from coming to me,

verses.hebrew: כִּי כַבֵּד אֲכַבֶּדְךָ מְאֹד וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַר אֵלַי אֶעֱשֶׂה וּלְכָה נָּא קָבָה לִּי אֵת הָעָם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי כַבֵּד אֲכַבֶּדְךָ מְאֹד וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַר אֵלַי אֶעֱשֶׂה וּלְכָה נָּא קָבָה לִּי אֵת הָעָם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
because I’ll honor you very much, and I’ll do everything
that you’ll say to me. And go, execrate this people for
me.’”

translation.text: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.

verses.english:
because I’ll honor you very much, and I’ll do everything
that you’ll say to me. And go, execrate this people for
me.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל עַבְדֵי בָלָק אִם יִתֶּן לִי בָלָק מְלֹא בֵיתוֹ כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲבֹר אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי לַעֲשׂוֹת קְטַנָּה אוֹ גְדוֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל עַבְדֵי בָלָק אִם יִתֶּן לִי בָלָק מְלֹא בֵיתוֹ כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲבֹר אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי לַעֲשׂוֹת קְטַנָּה אוֹ גְדוֹלָה׃

english.text:
And Balaam answered, and he said to Balak’s servants, “If
Balak would give me a houseful of silver and gold of his I
wouldn’t be able to go against the mouth of YHWH, my God,
to do something small or big.

translation.text: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.

verses.english:
And Balaam answered, and he said to Balak’s servants, “If
Balak would give me a houseful of silver and gold of his I
wouldn’t be able to go against the mouth of YHWH, my God,
to do something small or big.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שְׁבוּ נָא בָזֶה גַּם אַתֶּם הַלָּיְלָה וְאֵדְעָה מַה יֹּסֵף יְהֹוָה דַּבֵּר עִמִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שְׁבוּ נָא בָזֶה גַּם אַתֶּם הַלָּיְלָה וְאֵדְעָה מַה יֹּסֵף יְהֹוָה דַּבֵּר עִמִּי׃

english.text:
And now, stay here, you as well, tonight, so I may know
what YHWH will add to speak with me.”

translation.text: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the LORD will say unto me more.

verses.english:
And now, stay here, you as well, tonight, so I may know
what YHWH will add to speak with me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל בִּלְעָם לַיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִם לִקְרֹא לְךָ בָּאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים קוּם לֵךְ אִתָּם וְאַךְ אֶת הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אֲדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ אֹתוֹ תַעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל בִּלְעָם לַיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִם לִקְרֹא לְךָ בָּאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים קוּם לֵךְ אִתָּם וְאַךְ אֶת הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אֲדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ אֹתוֹ תַעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
And God came to Balaam at night and said to him, “If these
people have come to call you, get up, go with them. And
just the thing that I shall speak to you—you shall do
that.”

translation.text: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.

verses.english:
And God came to Balaam at night and said to him, “If these
people have come to call you, get up, go with them. And
just the thing that I shall speak to you—you shall do
that.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם בִּלְעָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת אֲתֹנוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ עִם שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם בִּלְעָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת אֲתֹנוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ עִם שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
And Balaam got up in the morning and harnessed his ass and
went with the chiefs of Moab.

translation.text: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.

verses.english:
And Balaam got up in the morning and harnessed his ass and
went with the chiefs of Moab.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר אַף אֱלֹהִים כִּי הוֹלֵךְ הוּא וַיִּתְיַצֵּב מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה בַּדֶּרֶךְ לְשָׂטָן לוֹ וְהוּא רֹכֵב עַל אֲתֹנוֹ וּשְׁנֵי נְעָרָיו עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר אַף אֱלֹהִים כִּי הוֹלֵךְ הוּא וַיִּתְיַצֵּב מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה בַּדֶּרֶךְ לְשָׂטָן לוֹ וְהוּא רֹכֵב עַל אֲתֹנוֹ וּשְׁנֵי נְעָרָיו עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And God’s anger flared because he was going. And an angel
of YHWH stood up in the road as an adversary to him. And
he was riding on his ass, and his two boys were with him.

translation.text: And God’s anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.

verses.english:
And God’s anger flared because he was going. And an angel
of YHWH stood up in the road as an adversary to him. And
he was riding on his ass, and his two boys were with him.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא הָאָתוֹן אֶת מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה נִצָּב בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְחַרְבּוֹ שְׁלוּפָה בְּיָדוֹ וַתֵּט הָאָתוֹן מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ וַתֵּלֶךְ בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיַּךְ בִּלְעָם אֶת הָאָתוֹן לְהַטֹּתָהּ הַדָּרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרֶא הָאָתוֹן אֶת מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה נִצָּב בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְחַרְבּוֹ שְׁלוּפָה בְּיָדוֹ וַתֵּט הָאָתוֹן מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ וַתֵּלֶךְ בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיַּךְ בִּלְעָם אֶת הָאָתוֹן לְהַטֹּתָהּ הַדָּרֶךְ׃

english.text:
And the ass saw the angel of YHWH standing up in the road
and his sword drawn in his hand, and the ass turned from
the road and went into the field. And Balaam hit the ass
to turn her back to the road.

translation.text: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.

verses.english:
And the ass saw the angel of YHWH standing up in the road
and his sword drawn in his hand, and the ass turned from
the road and went into the field. And Balaam hit the ass
to turn her back to the road.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה בְּמִשְׁעוֹל הַכְּרָמִים גָּדֵר מִזֶּה וְגָדֵר מִזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲמֹד מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה בְּמִשְׁעוֹל הַכְּרָמִים גָּדֵר מִזֶּה וְגָדֵר מִזֶּה׃

english.text:
And the angel of YHWH stood in the pathway of the
vineyards, a fence on this side and a fence on that side.

translation.text: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

verses.english:
And the angel of YHWH stood in the pathway of the
vineyards, a fence on this side and a fence on that side.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא הָאָתוֹן אֶת מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה וַתִּלָּחֵץ אֶל הַקִּיר וַתִּלְחַץ אֶת רֶגֶל בִּלְעָם אֶל הַקִּיר וַיֹּסֶף לְהַכֹּתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרֶא הָאָתוֹן אֶת מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה וַתִּלָּחֵץ אֶל הַקִּיר וַתִּלְחַץ אֶת רֶגֶל בִּלְעָם אֶל הַקִּיר וַיֹּסֶף לְהַכֹּתָהּ׃

english.text:
And the ass saw the angel of YHWH, and she was pressed
against the wall, and she pressed Balaam’s foot against
the wall, and he continued hitting her.

translation.text: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall: and he smote her again.

verses.english:
And the ass saw the angel of YHWH, and she was pressed
against the wall, and she pressed Balaam’s foot against
the wall, and he continued hitting her.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹסֶף מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה עֲבוֹר וַיַּעֲמֹד בְּמָקוֹם צָר אֲשֶׁר אֵין דֶּרֶךְ לִנְטוֹת יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹסֶף מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה עֲבוֹר וַיַּעֲמֹד בְּמָקוֹם צָר אֲשֶׁר אֵין דֶּרֶךְ לִנְטוֹת יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול׃

english.text:
And the angel continued passing on and stood in a narrow
place where there was no way to turn right or left.

translation.text: And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

verses.english:
And the angel continued passing on and stood in a narrow
place where there was no way to turn right or left.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא הָאָתוֹן אֶת מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה וַתִּרְבַּץ תַּחַת בִּלְעָם וַיִּחַר אַף בִּלְעָם וַיַּךְ אֶת הָאָתוֹן בַּמַּקֵּל׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרֶא הָאָתוֹן אֶת מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה וַתִּרְבַּץ תַּחַת בִּלְעָם וַיִּחַר אַף בִּלְעָם וַיַּךְ אֶת הָאָתוֹן בַּמַּקֵּל׃

english.text:
And the ass saw the angel of YHWH, and she lay down under
Balaam. And Balaam’s anger flared, and he struck the ass
with a stick.

translation.text: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam’s anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.

verses.english:
And the ass saw the angel of YHWH, and she lay down under
Balaam. And Balaam’s anger flared, and he struck the ass
with a stick.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְתַּח יְהֹוָה אֶת פִּי הָאָתוֹן וַתֹּאמֶר לְבִלְעָם מֶה עָשִׂיתִי לְךָ כִּי הִכִּיתַנִי זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ רְגָלִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְתַּח יְהֹוָה אֶת פִּי הָאָתוֹן וַתֹּאמֶר לְבִלְעָם מֶה עָשִׂיתִי לְךָ כִּי הִכִּיתַנִי זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ רְגָלִים׃

english.text:
And YHWH opened the ass’s mouth, and she said to Balaam,
“What have I done to you that you’ve struck me these three
times?!”

translation.text: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?

verses.english:
And YHWH opened the ass’s mouth, and she said to Balaam,
“What have I done to you that you’ve struck me these three
times?!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם לָאָתוֹן כִּי הִתְעַלַּלְתְּ בִּי לוּ יֶשׁ חֶרֶב בְּיָדִי כִּי עַתָּה הֲרַגְתִּיךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם לָאָתוֹן כִּי הִתְעַלַּלְתְּ בִּי לוּ יֶשׁ חֶרֶב בְּיָדִי כִּי עַתָּה הֲרַגְתִּיךְ׃

english.text:
And Balaam said to the ass, “Because you abused me! If
there had been a sword in my hand I would have killed you
by now!”

translation.text: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.

verses.english:
And Balaam said to the ass, “Because you abused me! If
there had been a sword in my hand I would have killed you
by now!”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאָתוֹן אֶל בִּלְעָם הֲלוֹא אָנֹכִי אֲתֹנְךָ אֲשֶׁר רָכַבְתָּ עָלַי מֵעוֹדְךָ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הַהַסְכֵּן הִסְכַּנְתִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת לְךָ כֹּה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאָתוֹן אֶל בִּלְעָם הֲלוֹא אָנֹכִי אֲתֹנְךָ אֲשֶׁר רָכַבְתָּ עָלַי מֵעוֹדְךָ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הַהַסְכֵּן הִסְכַּנְתִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת לְךָ כֹּה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא׃

english.text:
And the ass said to Balaam, “Aren’t I your ass, on whom
you’ve ridden? From your start until this day, have I been
accustomed to do like this to you?” And he said, “No.”

translation.text: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.

verses.english:
And the ass said to Balaam, “Aren’t I your ass, on whom
you’ve ridden? From your start until this day, have I been
accustomed to do like this to you?” And he said, “No.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְגַל יְהֹוָה אֶת עֵינֵי בִלְעָם וַיַּרְא אֶת מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה נִצָּב בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְחַרְבּוֹ שְׁלֻפָה בְּיָדוֹ וַיִּקֹּד וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לְאַפָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְגַל יְהֹוָה אֶת עֵינֵי בִלְעָם וַיַּרְא אֶת מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה נִצָּב בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְחַרְבּוֹ שְׁלֻפָה בְּיָדוֹ וַיִּקֹּד וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לְאַפָּיו׃

english.text:
And YHWH uncovered Balaam’s eyes, and he saw the angel of
YHWH standing up in the road, and his sword drawn in his
hand. And he knelt and bowed to his nose.

translation.text: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.

verses.english:
And YHWH uncovered Balaam’s eyes, and he saw the angel of
YHWH standing up in the road, and his sword drawn in his
hand. And he knelt and bowed to his nose.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה עַל מָה הִכִּיתָ אֶת אֲתֹנְךָ זֶה שָׁלוֹשׁ רְגָלִים הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי יָצָאתִי לְשָׂטָן כִּי יָרַט הַדֶּרֶךְ לְנֶגְדִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה עַל מָה הִכִּיתָ אֶת אֲתֹנְךָ זֶה שָׁלוֹשׁ רְגָלִים הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי יָצָאתִי לְשָׂטָן כִּי יָרַט הַדֶּרֶךְ לְנֶגְדִּי׃

english.text:
And the angel of YHWH said to him, “For what have you
struck your ass these three times? Here, I came out as an
adversary because the way was precipitous with regard to
me.

translation.text: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:

verses.english:
And the angel of YHWH said to him, “For what have you
struck your ass these three times? Here, I came out as an
adversary because the way was precipitous with regard to
me.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּרְאַנִי הָאָתוֹן וַתֵּט לְפָנַי זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ רְגָלִים אוּלַי נָטְתָה מִפָּנַי כִּי עַתָּה גַּם אֹתְכָה הָרַגְתִּי וְאוֹתָהּ הֶחֱיֵיתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּרְאַנִי הָאָתוֹן וַתֵּט לְפָנַי זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ רְגָלִים אוּלַי נָטְתָה מִפָּנַי כִּי עַתָּה גַּם אֹתְכָה הָרַגְתִּי וְאוֹתָהּ הֶחֱיֵיתִי׃

english.text:
And the ass saw me and turned in front of me these three
times. If she hadn’t turned from in front of me, I would
have killed you, too, by now and kept her alive!”

translation.text: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.

verses.english:
And the ass saw me and turned in front of me these three
times. If she hadn’t turned from in front of me, I would
have killed you, too, by now and kept her alive!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה חָטָאתִי כִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי כִּי אַתָּה נִצָּב לִקְרָאתִי בַּדָּרֶךְ וְעַתָּה אִם רַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ אָשׁוּבָה לִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה חָטָאתִי כִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי כִּי אַתָּה נִצָּב לִקְרָאתִי בַּדָּרֶךְ וְעַתָּה אִם רַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ אָשׁוּבָה לִּי׃

english.text:
And Balaam said to the angel of YHWH, “I’ve sinned,
because I didn’t know that you were standing up toward me
in the road. And now, if it’s bad in your eyes, let me go
back.”

translation.text: And Balaam said unto the angel of the LORD, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.

verses.english:
And Balaam said to the angel of YHWH, “I’ve sinned,
because I didn’t know that you were standing up toward me
in the road. And now, if it’s bad in your eyes, let me go
back.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶל בִּלְעָם לֵךְ עִם הָאֲנָשִׁים וְאֶפֶס אֶת הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אֲדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ אֹתוֹ תְדַבֵּר וַיֵּלֶךְ בִּלְעָם עִם שָׂרֵי בָלָק׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶל בִּלְעָם לֵךְ עִם הָאֲנָשִׁים וְאֶפֶס אֶת הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אֲדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ אֹתוֹ תְדַבֵּר וַיֵּלֶךְ בִּלְעָם עִם שָׂרֵי בָלָק׃

english.text:
And the angel of YHWH said to Balaam, “Go with the people.
And nothing but the thing that I shall speak to you: that
is what you shall speak.” And Balaam went with Balak’s
chiefs.

translation.text: And the angel of the LORD said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

verses.english:
And the angel of YHWH said to Balaam, “Go with the people.
And nothing but the thing that I shall speak to you: that
is what you shall speak.” And Balaam went with Balak’s
chiefs.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע בָּלָק כִּי בָא בִלְעָם וַיֵּצֵא לִקְרָאתוֹ אֶל עִיר מוֹאָב אֲשֶׁר עַל גְּבוּל אַרְנֹן אֲשֶׁר בִּקְצֵה הַגְּבוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע בָּלָק כִּי בָא בִלְעָם וַיֵּצֵא לִקְרָאתוֹ אֶל עִיר מוֹאָב אֲשֶׁר עַל גְּבוּל אַרְנֹן אֲשֶׁר בִּקְצֵה הַגְּבוּל׃

english.text:
And Balak heard that Balaam was coming, and he went out to
him, to a city of Moab that was on the Arnon border, that
was at the edge of the border.

translation.text: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.

verses.english:
And Balak heard that Balaam was coming, and he went out to
him, to a city of Moab that was on the Arnon border, that
was at the edge of the border.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם הֲלֹא שָׁלֹחַ שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לִקְרֹא לָךְ לָמָּה לֹא הָלַכְתָּ אֵלָי הַאֻמְנָם לֹא אוּכַל כַּבְּדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם הֲלֹא שָׁלֹחַ שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לִקְרֹא לָךְ לָמָּה לֹא הָלַכְתָּ אֵלָי הַאֻמְנָם לֹא אוּכַל כַּבְּדֶךָ׃

english.text:
And Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I send to you, to call
you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I indeed not able to
honor you?!”

translation.text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?

verses.english:
And Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I send to you, to call
you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I indeed not able to
honor you?!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל בָּלָק הִנֵּה בָאתִי אֵלֶיךָ עַתָּה הֲיָכֹל אוּכַל דַּבֵּר מְאוּמָה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יָשִׂים אֱלֹהִים בְּפִי אֹתוֹ אֲדַבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל בָּלָק הִנֵּה בָאתִי אֵלֶיךָ עַתָּה הֲיָכֹל אוּכַל דַּבֵּר מְאוּמָה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יָשִׂים אֱלֹהִים בְּפִי אֹתוֹ אֲדַבֵּר׃

english.text:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Here, I’ve come to you. Now:
will I be able to speak anything? The thing that God will
set in my mouth: that is what I’ll speak.”

translation.text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.

verses.english:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Here, I’ve come to you. Now:
will I be able to speak anything? The thing that God will
set in my mouth: that is what I’ll speak.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בִּלְעָם עִם בָּלָק וַיָּבֹאוּ קִרְיַת חֻצוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ בִּלְעָם עִם בָּלָק וַיָּבֹאוּ קִרְיַת חֻצוֹת׃

english.text:
And Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath
Huzoth.

translation.text: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjathhuzoth.

verses.english:
And Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath
Huzoth.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְבַּח בָּלָק בָּקָר וָצֹאן וַיְשַׁלַּח לְבִלְעָם וְלַשָּׂרִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזְבַּח בָּלָק בָּקָר וָצֹאן וַיְשַׁלַּח לְבִלְעָם וְלַשָּׂרִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Balak sacrificed oxen and sheep, and he let them go to
Balaam and to the chiefs who were with them.

translation.text: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.

verses.english:
And Balak sacrificed oxen and sheep, and he let them go to
Balaam and to the chiefs who were with them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַיִּקַּח בָּלָק אֶת בִּלְעָם וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ בָּמוֹת בָּעַל וַיַּרְא מִשָּׁם קְצֵה הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַיִּקַּח בָּלָק אֶת בִּלְעָם וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ בָּמוֹת בָּעַל וַיַּרְא מִשָּׁם קְצֵה הָעָם׃

english.text:
And it was in the morning, and Balak took Balaam and
brought him up to the High Places of Baal, and he saw the
outer edge of the people from there.

translation.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.

verses.english:
And it was in the morning, and Balak took Balaam and
brought him up to the High Places of Baal, and he saw the
outer edge of the people from there.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל בָּלָק בְּנֵה לִי בָזֶה שִׁבְעָה מִזְבְּחֹת וְהָכֵן לִי בָּזֶה שִׁבְעָה פָרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֵילִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל בָּלָק בְּנֵה לִי בָזֶה שִׁבְעָה מִזְבְּחֹת וְהָכֵן לִי בָּזֶה שִׁבְעָה פָרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֵילִים׃

english.text:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me
here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”

translation.text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.

verses.english:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me
here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ בָּלָק כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בִּלְעָם וַיַּעַל בָּלָק וּבִלְעָם פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ בָּלָק כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בִּלְעָם וַיַּעַל בָּלָק וּבִלְעָם פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And Balak did as Balaam spoke, and Balak and Balaam
offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

translation.text: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.

verses.english:
And Balak did as Balaam spoke, and Balak and Balaam
offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם לְבָלָק הִתְיַצֵּב עַל עֹלָתֶךָ וְאֵלְכָה אוּלַי יִקָּרֵה יְהֹוָה לִקְרָאתִי וּדְבַר מַה יַּרְאֵנִי וְהִגַּדְתִּי לָךְ וַיֵּלֶךְ שֶׁפִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם לְבָלָק הִתְיַצֵּב עַל עֹלָתֶךָ וְאֵלְכָה אוּלַי יִקָּרֵה יְהֹוָה לִקְרָאתִי וּדְבַר מַה יַּרְאֵנִי וְהִגַּדְתִּי לָךְ וַיֵּלֶךְ שֶׁפִי׃

english.text:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Stand up by your burnt
offering, and let me go. Maybe YHWH will communicate to
me. And whatever He’ll show me, I’ll tell you.” And he
went to a viewpoint.

translation.text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the LORD will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.

verses.english:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Stand up by your burnt
offering, and let me go. Maybe YHWH will communicate to
me. And whatever He’ll show me, I’ll tell you.” And he
went to a viewpoint.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּר אֱלֹהִים אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֶת שִׁבְעַת הַמִּזְבְּחֹת עָרַכְתִּי וָאַעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּר אֱלֹהִים אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֶת שִׁבְעַת הַמִּזְבְּחֹת עָרַכְתִּי וָאַעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And God communicated to Balaam. And he said to Him, “I’ve
arranged the seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on
each altar.”

translation.text: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.

verses.english:
And God communicated to Balaam. And he said to Him, “I’ve
arranged the seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on
each altar.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם יְהֹוָה דָּבָר בְּפִי בִלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר שׁוּב אֶל בָּלָק וְכֹה תְדַבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם יְהֹוָה דָּבָר בְּפִי בִלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר שׁוּב אֶל בָּלָק וְכֹה תְדַבֵּר׃

english.text:
And YHWH put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and He said, “Go
back to Balak, and speak like this.”

translation.text: And the LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.

verses.english:
And YHWH put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and He said, “Go
back to Balak, and speak like this.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב אֵלָיו וְהִנֵּה נִצָּב עַל עֹלָתוֹ הוּא וְכל שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב אֵלָיו וְהִנֵּה נִצָּב עַל עֹלָתוֹ הוּא וְכל שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
And he went back to him, and here he was, standing up by
his burnt offering, he and all the chiefs of Moab.

translation.text: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.

verses.english:
And he went back to him, and here he was, standing up by
his burnt offering, he and all the chiefs of Moab.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר מִן אֲרָם יַנְחֵנִי בָלָק מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב מֵהַרְרֵי קֶדֶם לְכָה אָרָה לִּי יַעֲקֹב וּלְכָה זֹעֲמָה יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר מִן אֲרָם יַנְחֵנִי בָלָק מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב מֵהַרְרֵי קֶדֶם לְכָה אָרָה לִּי יַעֲקֹב וּלְכָה זֹעֲמָה יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And he took up his pronouncement, and he said: Balak led
me from Aram, Moab’s king from mountains of the East.
“Come, curse Jacob for me! Come, denounce Israel!”

translation.text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.

verses.english:
And he took up his pronouncement, and he said: Balak led
me from Aram, Moab’s king from mountains of the East.
“Come, curse Jacob for me! Come, denounce Israel!”

verses.hebrew: מָה אֶקֹּב לֹא קַבֹּה אֵל וּמָה אֶזְעֹם לֹא זָעַם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: מָה אֶקֹּב לֹא קַבֹּה אֵל וּמָה אֶזְעֹם לֹא זָעַם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
How shall I execrate whom God hasn’t execrated? And how
shall I denounce whom YHWH hasn’t denounced?

translation.text: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the LORD hath not defied?

verses.english:
How shall I execrate whom God hasn’t execrated? And how
shall I denounce whom YHWH hasn’t denounced?

verses.hebrew: כִּי מֵרֹאשׁ צֻרִים אֶרְאֶנּוּ וּמִגְּבָעוֹת אֲשׁוּרֶנּוּ הֶן עָם לְבָדָד יִשְׁכֹּן וּבַגּוֹיִם לֹא יִתְחַשָּׁב׃

hebrew.text: כִּי מֵרֹאשׁ צֻרִים אֶרְאֶנּוּ וּמִגְּבָעוֹת אֲשׁוּרֶנּוּ הֶן עָם לְבָדָד יִשְׁכֹּן וּבַגּוֹיִם לֹא יִתְחַשָּׁב׃

english.text:
For from the top of rocks I see it, and from hills I view
it. Here: a people dwelling separate and not reckoned
among the nations.

translation.text: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.

verses.english:
For from the top of rocks I see it, and from hills I view
it. Here: a people dwelling separate and not reckoned
among the nations.

verses.hebrew: מִי מָנָה עֲפַר יַעֲקֹב וּמִסְפָּר אֶת רֹבַע יִשְׂרָאֵל תָּמֹת נַפְשִׁי מוֹת יְשָׁרִים וּתְהִי אַחֲרִיתִי כָּמֹהוּ׃

hebrew.text: מִי מָנָה עֲפַר יַעֲקֹב וּמִסְפָּר אֶת רֹבַע יִשְׂרָאֵל תָּמֹת נַפְשִׁי מוֹת יְשָׁרִים וּתְהִי אַחֲרִיתִי כָּמֹהוּ׃

english.text:
Who has counted the dust of Jacob and the number of a
fourth of Israel? May my soul die the death of the
righteous, and may my future be like his!

translation.text: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!

verses.english:
Who has counted the dust of Jacob and the number of a
fourth of Israel? May my soul die the death of the
righteous, and may my future be like his!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם מֶה עָשִׂיתָ לִי לָקֹב אֹיְבַי לְקַחְתִּיךָ וְהִנֵּה בֵּרַכְתָּ בָרֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם מֶה עָשִׂיתָ לִי לָקֹב אֹיְבַי לְקַחְתִּיךָ וְהִנֵּה בֵּרַכְתָּ בָרֵךְ׃

english.text:
And Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me?! I
took you to execrate my enemies. And, here, you’ve blessed
them!”

translation.text: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.

verses.english:
And Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me?! I
took you to execrate my enemies. And, here, you’ve blessed
them!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן וַיֹּאמַר הֲלֹא אֵת אֲשֶׁר יָשִׂים יְהֹוָה בְּפִי אֹתוֹ אֶשְׁמֹר לְדַבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן וַיֹּאמַר הֲלֹא אֵת אֲשֶׁר יָשִׂים יְהֹוָה בְּפִי אֹתוֹ אֶשְׁמֹר לְדַבֵּר׃

english.text:
And he answered and said, “Isn’t it that what ever YHWH
sets in my mouth, that is what I’ll watch out to say?!”

translation.text: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth?

verses.english:
And he answered and said, “Isn’t it that what ever YHWH
sets in my mouth, that is what I’ll watch out to say?!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בָּלָק (לך) [לְכָה] נָּא אִתִּי אֶל מָקוֹם אַחֵר אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶנּוּ מִשָּׁם אֶפֶס קָצֵהוּ תִרְאֶה וְכֻלּוֹ לֹא תִרְאֶה וְקבְנוֹ לִי מִשָּׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בָּלָק (לך) [לְכָה] נָּא אִתִּי אֶל מָקוֹם אַחֵר אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶנּוּ מִשָּׁם אֶפֶס קָצֵהוּ תִרְאֶה וְכֻלּוֹ לֹא תִרְאֶה וְקבְנוֹ לִי מִשָּׁם׃

english.text:
And Balak said to him, “Come on with me to another place
from which you’ll see it. You’ll see nothing but its edge,
and you won’t see all of it. And execrate it for me from
there.”

translation.text: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.

verses.english:
And Balak said to him, “Come on with me to another place
from which you’ll see it. You’ll see nothing but its edge,
and you won’t see all of it. And execrate it for me from
there.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ שְׂדֵה צֹפִים אֶל רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה וַיִּבֶן שִׁבְעָה מִזְבְּחֹת וַיַּעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ שְׂדֵה צֹפִים אֶל רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה וַיִּבֶן שִׁבְעָה מִזְבְּחֹת וַיַּעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And he took him to the field of Zophim, to the top of
Pisgah, and he built seven altars and offered a bull and a
ram on each altar.

translation.text: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.

verses.english:
And he took him to the field of Zophim, to the top of
Pisgah, and he built seven altars and offered a bull and a
ram on each altar.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל בָּלָק הִתְיַצֵּב כֹּה עַל עֹלָתֶךָ וְאָנֹכִי אִקָּרֶה כֹּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל בָּלָק הִתְיַצֵּב כֹּה עַל עֹלָתֶךָ וְאָנֹכִי אִקָּרֶה כֹּה׃

english.text:
And he said to Balak, “Stand up here by your burnt
offering, and I’ll be communicated with here.”

translation.text: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the LORD yonder.

verses.english:
And he said to Balak, “Stand up here by your burnt
offering, and I’ll be communicated with here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּר יְהֹוָה אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיָּשֶׂם דָּבָר בְּפִיו וַיֹּאמֶר שׁוּב אֶל בָּלָק וְכֹה תְדַבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּר יְהֹוָה אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיָּשֶׂם דָּבָר בְּפִיו וַיֹּאמֶר שׁוּב אֶל בָּלָק וְכֹה תְדַבֵּר׃

english.text:
And YHWH was communicated to Balaam, and He set a word in
his mouth and said, “Go back to Balak, and you shall speak
this.”

translation.text: And the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.

verses.english:
And YHWH was communicated to Balaam, and He set a word in
his mouth and said, “Go back to Balak, and you shall speak
this.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֵלָיו וְהִנּוֹ נִצָּב עַל עֹלָתוֹ וְשָׂרֵי מוֹאָב אִתּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בָּלָק מַה דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֵלָיו וְהִנּוֹ נִצָּב עַל עֹלָתוֹ וְשָׂרֵי מוֹאָב אִתּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בָּלָק מַה דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he came to him, and here he was, standing up by his
burnt offering, and the chiefs of Moab were with him. And
Balak said to him, “What did YHWH speak?”

translation.text: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?

verses.english:
And he came to him, and here he was, standing up by his
burnt offering, and the chiefs of Moab were with him. And
Balak said to him, “What did YHWH speak?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר קוּם בָּלָק וּשְׁמָע הַאֲזִינָה עָדַי בְּנוֹ צִפֹּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר קוּם בָּלָק וּשְׁמָע הַאֲזִינָה עָדַי בְּנוֹ צִפֹּר׃

english.text:
And he took up his pronouncement, and he said: Get up,
Balak, and listen. Hear me, son of Zippor.

translation.text: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:

verses.english:
And he took up his pronouncement, and he said: Get up,
Balak, and listen. Hear me, son of Zippor.

verses.hebrew: לֹא אִישׁ אֵל וִיכַזֵּב וּבֶן אָדָם וְיִתְנֶחָם הַהוּא אָמַר וְלֹא יַעֲשֶׂה וְדִבֶּר וְלֹא יְקִימֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא אִישׁ אֵל וִיכַזֵּב וּבֶן אָדָם וְיִתְנֶחָם הַהוּא אָמַר וְלֹא יַעֲשֶׂה וְדִבֶּר וְלֹא יְקִימֶנָּה׃

english.text:
is not a man, that He would lie, or a human being,
that He would regret. Has He said and will not do or
spoken and will not bring it about?

translation.text: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?

verses.english:
is not a man, that He would lie, or a human being,
that He would regret. Has He said and will not do or
spoken and will not bring it about?

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה בָרֵךְ לָקָחְתִּי וּבֵרֵךְ וְלֹא אֲשִׁיבֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה בָרֵךְ לָקָחְתִּי וּבֵרֵךְ וְלֹא אֲשִׁיבֶנָּה׃

english.text:
Here, I was taken to bless, and He blessed, and I won’t
take it back.

translation.text: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.

verses.english:
Here, I was taken to bless, and He blessed, and I won’t
take it back.

verses.hebrew: לֹא הִבִּיט אָוֶן בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא רָאָה עָמָל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וּתְרוּעַת מֶלֶךְ בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא הִבִּיט אָוֶן בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא רָאָה עָמָל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וּתְרוּעַת מֶלֶךְ בּוֹ׃

english.text:
He didn’t find harm in Jacob, and He didn’t see trouble in
Israel. YHWH, its God, is with it, and a shout for a king
is in it.

translation.text: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.

verses.english:
He didn’t find harm in Jacob, and He didn’t see trouble in
Israel. YHWH, its God, is with it, and a shout for a king
is in it.

verses.hebrew: אֵל מוֹצִיאָם מִמִּצְרָיִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹת רְאֵם לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אֵל מוֹצִיאָם מִמִּצְרָיִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹת רְאֵם לוֹ׃

english.text:
who brought them out from Egypt is like a wild ox’s
horns for it.

translation.text: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.

verses.english:
who brought them out from Egypt is like a wild ox’s
horns for it.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא נַחַשׁ בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא קֶסֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כָּעֵת יֵאָמֵר לְיַעֲקֹב וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל מַה פָּעַל אֵל׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא נַחַשׁ בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא קֶסֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כָּעֵת יֵאָמֵר לְיַעֲקֹב וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל מַה פָּעַל אֵל׃

english.text:
For there’s no divination against Jacob and no enchantment
against Israel. At this time it will be said to Jacob and
to Israel: “What has God done?”

translation.text: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!

verses.english:
For there’s no divination against Jacob and no enchantment
against Israel. At this time it will be said to Jacob and
to Israel: “What has God done?”

verses.hebrew: הֶן עָם כְּלָבִיא יָקוּם וְכַאֲרִי יִתְנַשָּׂא לֹא יִשְׁכַּב עַד יֹאכַל טֶרֶף וְדַם חֲלָלִים יִשְׁתֶּה׃

hebrew.text: הֶן עָם כְּלָבִיא יָקוּם וְכַאֲרִי יִתְנַשָּׂא לֹא יִשְׁכַּב עַד יֹאכַל טֶרֶף וְדַם חֲלָלִים יִשְׁתֶּה׃

english.text:
Here, a people will get up like a feline and like a lion
will raise itself. It won’t lie down until it has eaten
prey and until it has drunk blood of carcasses.

translation.text: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.

verses.english:
Here, a people will get up like a feline and like a lion
will raise itself. It won’t lie down until it has eaten
prey and until it has drunk blood of carcasses.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם גַּם קֹב לֹא תִקֳּבֶנּוּ גַּם בָּרֵךְ לֹא תְבָרְכֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם גַּם קֹב לֹא תִקֳּבֶנּוּ גַּם בָּרֵךְ לֹא תְבָרְכֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
And Balak said to Balaam, “Don’t do either: execrate them
or bless them!”

translation.text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.

verses.english:
And Balak said to Balaam, “Don’t do either: execrate them
or bless them!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל בָּלָק הֲלֹא דִּבַּרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ אֶעֱשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל בָּלָק הֲלֹא דִּבַּרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ אֶעֱשֶׂה׃

english.text:
And Balaam answered, and he said to Balak, “Didn’t I speak
to you, saying, ‘Everything that YHWH will speak, that is
what I’ll do’?”

translation.text: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?

verses.english:
And Balaam answered, and he said to Balak, “Didn’t I speak
to you, saying, ‘Everything that YHWH will speak, that is
what I’ll do’?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם לְכָה נָּא אֶקָּחֲךָ אֶל מָקוֹם אַחֵר אוּלַי יִישַׁר בְּעֵינֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וְקַבֹּתוֹ לִי מִשָּׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם לְכָה נָּא אֶקָּחֲךָ אֶל מָקוֹם אַחֵר אוּלַי יִישַׁר בְּעֵינֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וְקַבֹּתוֹ לִי מִשָּׁם׃

english.text:
And Balak said to Balaam, “Come on. I’ll take you to
another place. Maybe it will be right in God’s eyes, and
you’ll execrate it for me from there.”

translation.text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.

verses.english:
And Balak said to Balaam, “Come on. I’ll take you to
another place. Maybe it will be right in God’s eyes, and
you’ll execrate it for me from there.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח בָּלָק אֶת בִּלְעָם רֹאשׁ הַפְּעוֹר הַנִּשְׁקָף עַל פְּנֵי הַיְשִׁימֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח בָּלָק אֶת בִּלְעָם רֹאשׁ הַפְּעוֹר הַנִּשְׁקָף עַל פְּנֵי הַיְשִׁימֹן׃

english.text:
And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, which looks out
over Jeshimon.

translation.text: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.

verses.english:
And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, which looks out
over Jeshimon.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל בָּלָק בְּנֵה לִי בָזֶה שִׁבְעָה מִזְבְּחֹת וְהָכֵן לִי בָּזֶה שִׁבְעָה פָרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֵילִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל בָּלָק בְּנֵה לִי בָזֶה שִׁבְעָה מִזְבְּחֹת וְהָכֵן לִי בָּזֶה שִׁבְעָה פָרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֵילִם׃

english.text:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here
and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”

translation.text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.

verses.english:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here
and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ בָּלָק כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר בִּלְעָם וַיַּעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ בָּלָק כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר בִּלְעָם וַיַּעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
And Balak did as Balaam said, and he offered a bull and a
ram on each altar.

translation.text: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.

verses.english:
And Balak did as Balaam said, and he offered a bull and a
ram on each altar.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא בִּלְעָם כִּי טוֹב בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְבָרֵךְ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא הָלַךְ כְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם לִקְרַאת נְחָשִׁים וַיָּשֶׁת אֶל הַמִּדְבָּר פָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא בִּלְעָם כִּי טוֹב בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְבָרֵךְ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא הָלַךְ כְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם לִקְרַאת נְחָשִׁים וַיָּשֶׁת אֶל הַמִּדְבָּר פָּנָיו׃

english.text:
And Balaam saw that it was good in YHWH’s eyes to bless
Israel, and he did not go as in previous times to
divinations. And he turned his face to the wilderness,

translation.text: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

verses.english:
