And Balaam saw that it was good in YHWH’s eyes to bless
Israel, and he did not go as in previous times to
divinations. And he turned his face to the wilderness,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא בִלְעָם אֶת עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל שֹׁכֵן לִשְׁבָטָיו וַתְּהִי עָלָיו רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא בִלְעָם אֶת עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל שֹׁכֵן לִשְׁבָטָיו וַתְּהִי עָלָיו רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
and Balaam raised his eyes and saw Israel, tenting
according to its tribes, and God’s spirit came on him.

translation.text: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.

verses.english:
and Balaam raised his eyes and saw Israel, tenting
according to its tribes, and God’s spirit came on him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר נְאֻם בִּלְעָם בְּנוֹ בְעֹר וּנְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר שְׁתֻם הָעָיִן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר נְאֻם בִּלְעָם בְּנוֹ בְעֹר וּנְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר שְׁתֻם הָעָיִן׃

english.text:
And he took up his pronouncement, and he said: Word of
Balaam, son of Beor, and word of the man, opened of eye;

translation.text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:

verses.english:
And he took up his pronouncement, and he said: Word of
Balaam, son of Beor, and word of the man, opened of eye;

verses.hebrew: נְאֻם שֹׁמֵעַ אִמְרֵי אֵל אֲשֶׁר מַחֲזֵה שַׁדַּי יֶחֱזֶה נֹפֵל וּגְלוּי עֵינָיִם׃

hebrew.text: נְאֻם שֹׁמֵעַ אִמְרֵי אֵל אֲשֶׁר מַחֲזֵה שַׁדַּי יֶחֱזֶה נֹפֵל וּגְלוּי עֵינָיִם׃

english.text:
word of the one who hears God’s sayings, who sees
Shadday’s vision, falling, but with eyes uncovered.

translation.text: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:

verses.english:
word of the one who hears God’s sayings, who sees
Shadday’s vision, falling, but with eyes uncovered.

verses.hebrew: מַה טֹּבוּ אֹהָלֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: מַה טֹּבוּ אֹהָלֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text: How good your tents are, Jacob, your tabernacles, Israel.

translation.text: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!

verses.english: How good your tents are, Jacob, your tabernacles, Israel.

verses.hebrew: כִּנְחָלִים נִטָּיוּ כְּגַנֹּת עֲלֵי נָהָר כַּאֲהָלִים נָטַע יְהֹוָה כַּאֲרָזִים עֲלֵי מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: כִּנְחָלִים נִטָּיוּ כְּגַנֹּת עֲלֵי נָהָר כַּאֲהָלִים נָטַע יְהֹוָה כַּאֲרָזִים עֲלֵי מָיִם׃

english.text:
They spread like palms, like gardens by a river, like
aloes YHWH planted, like cedars by water.

translation.text: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river’s side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.

verses.english:
They spread like palms, like gardens by a river, like
aloes YHWH planted, like cedars by water.

verses.hebrew: יִזַּל מַיִם מִדָּלְיָו וְזַרְעוֹ בְּמַיִם רַבִּים וְיָרֹם מֵאֲגַג מַלְכּוֹ וְתִנַּשֵּׂא מַלְכֻתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: יִזַּל מַיִם מִדָּלְיָו וְזַרְעוֹ בְּמַיִם רַבִּים וְיָרֹם מֵאֲגַג מַלְכּוֹ וְתִנַּשֵּׂא מַלְכֻתוֹ׃

english.text:
It drips water from its branches and its seed in plentiful
water. And its king will be higher than Agag, and its
kingdom will be elevated.

translation.text: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.

verses.english:
It drips water from its branches and its seed in plentiful
water. And its king will be higher than Agag, and its
kingdom will be elevated.

verses.hebrew: אֵל מוֹצִיאוֹ מִמִּצְרַיִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹת רְאֵם לוֹ יֹאכַל גּוֹיִם צָרָיו וְעַצְמֹתֵיהֶם יְגָרֵם וְחִצָּיו יִמְחָץ׃

hebrew.text: אֵל מוֹצִיאוֹ מִמִּצְרַיִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹת רְאֵם לוֹ יֹאכַל גּוֹיִם צָרָיו וְעַצְמֹתֵיהֶם יְגָרֵם וְחִצָּיו יִמְחָץ׃

english.text:
who brought it out from Egypt is like a wild ox’s
horns for it. He shall eat up nations, its foes, and break
their bones and pierce with His arrows.

translation.text: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.

verses.english:
who brought it out from Egypt is like a wild ox’s
horns for it. He shall eat up nations, its foes, and break
their bones and pierce with His arrows.

verses.hebrew: כָּרַע שָׁכַב כַּאֲרִי וּכְלָבִיא מִי יְקִימֶנּוּ מְבָרְכֶיךָ בָרוּךְ וְאֹרְרֶיךָ אָרוּר׃

hebrew.text: כָּרַע שָׁכַב כַּאֲרִי וּכְלָבִיא מִי יְקִימֶנּוּ מְבָרְכֶיךָ בָרוּךְ וְאֹרְרֶיךָ אָרוּר׃

english.text:
It bent, lay down, like a lion; and, like a feline, who
will rouse it? Those who bless you: he’s blessed. And
those who curse you: he’s cursed.

translation.text: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.

verses.english:
It bent, lay down, like a lion; and, like a feline, who
will rouse it? Those who bless you: he’s blessed. And
those who curse you: he’s cursed.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר אַף בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיִּסְפֹּק אֶת כַּפָּיו וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם לָקֹב אֹיְבַי קְרָאתִיךָ וְהִנֵּה בֵּרַכְתָּ בָרֵךְ זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר אַף בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם וַיִּסְפֹּק אֶת כַּפָּיו וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם לָקֹב אֹיְבַי קְרָאתִיךָ וְהִנֵּה בֵּרַכְתָּ בָרֵךְ זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים׃

english.text:
And Balak’s anger flared at Balaam, and he wrung his
hands, and Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to execrate
my enemies; and, here, you’ve blessed these three times!

translation.text: And Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.

verses.english:
And Balak’s anger flared at Balaam, and he wrung his
hands, and Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to execrate
my enemies; and, here, you’ve blessed these three times!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה בְּרַח לְךָ אֶל מְקוֹמֶךָ אָמַרְתִּי כַּבֵּד אֲכַבֶּדְךָ וְהִנֵּה מְנָעֲךָ יְהֹוָה מִכָּבוֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה בְּרַח לְךָ אֶל מְקוֹמֶךָ אָמַרְתִּי כַּבֵּד אֲכַבֶּדְךָ וְהִנֵּה מְנָעֲךָ יְהֹוָה מִכָּבוֹד׃

english.text:
And now, flee to your place! I said I would honor you;
and, here, YHWH has held you back from honor!”

translation.text: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.

verses.english:
And now, flee to your place! I said I would honor you;
and, here, YHWH has held you back from honor!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל בָּלָק הֲלֹא גַּם אֶל מַלְאָכֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַחְתָּ אֵלַי דִּבַּרְתִּי לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל בָּלָק הֲלֹא גַּם אֶל מַלְאָכֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַחְתָּ אֵלַי דִּבַּרְתִּי לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I speak to your
messengers whom you sent to me as well, saying,

translation.text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,

verses.english:
And Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I speak to your
messengers whom you sent to me as well, saying,

verses.hebrew: אִם יִתֶּן לִי בָלָק מְלֹא בֵיתוֹ כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲבֹר אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת טוֹבָה אוֹ רָעָה מִלִּבִּי אֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ אֲדַבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: אִם יִתֶּן לִי בָלָק מְלֹא בֵיתוֹ כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲבֹר אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת טוֹבָה אוֹ רָעָה מִלִּבִּי אֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ אֲדַבֵּר׃

english.text:
‘If Balak would give me a houseful of silver and gold of
his I wouldn’t be able to go against the mouth of YHWH, to
do good or bad from my own heart. Whatever YHWH speaks,
that is what I’ll speak.’

translation.text: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the LORD, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the LORD saith, that will I speak?

verses.english:
‘If Balak would give me a houseful of silver and gold of
his I wouldn’t be able to go against the mouth of YHWH, to
do good or bad from my own heart. Whatever YHWH speaks,
that is what I’ll speak.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנְנִי הוֹלֵךְ לְעַמִּי לְכָה אִיעָצְךָ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה הָעָם הַזֶּה לְעַמְּךָ בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִנְנִי הוֹלֵךְ לְעַמִּי לְכָה אִיעָצְךָ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה הָעָם הַזֶּה לְעַמְּךָ בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
And now, here, I’m going to my people. Come. I’ll advise
you of what this people will do to your people in the
future days.”

translation.text: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.

verses.english:
And now, here, I’m going to my people. Come. I’ll advise
you of what this people will do to your people in the
future days.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר נְאֻם בִּלְעָם בְּנוֹ בְעֹר וּנְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר שְׁתֻם הָעָיִן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר נְאֻם בִּלְעָם בְּנוֹ בְעֹר וּנְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר שְׁתֻם הָעָיִן׃

translation.text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:

verses.hebrew: נְאֻם שֹׁמֵעַ אִמְרֵי אֵל וְיֹדֵעַ דַּעַת עֶלְיוֹן מַחֲזֵה שַׁדַּי יֶחֱזֶה נֹפֵל וּגְלוּי עֵינָיִם׃

hebrew.text: נְאֻם שֹׁמֵעַ אִמְרֵי אֵל וְיֹדֵעַ דַּעַת עֶלְיוֹן מַחֲזֵה שַׁדַּי יֶחֱזֶה נֹפֵל וּגְלוּי עֵינָיִם׃

english.text:
word of the one who hears God’s sayings and who knows the
Highest’s knowledge, who sees Shadday’s vision, falling,
but with eyes uncovered.

translation.text: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:

verses.english:
word of the one who hears God’s sayings and who knows the
Highest’s knowledge, who sees Shadday’s vision, falling,
but with eyes uncovered.

verses.hebrew: אֶרְאֶנּוּ וְלֹא עַתָּה אֲשׁוּרֶנּוּ וְלֹא קָרוֹב דָּרַךְ כּוֹכָב מִיַּעֲקֹב וְקָם שֵׁבֶט מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וּמָחַץ פַּאֲתֵי מוֹאָב וְקַרְקַר כּל בְּנֵי שֵׁת׃

hebrew.text: אֶרְאֶנּוּ וְלֹא עַתָּה אֲשׁוּרֶנּוּ וְלֹא קָרוֹב דָּרַךְ כּוֹכָב מִיַּעֲקֹב וְקָם שֵׁבֶט מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וּמָחַץ פַּאֲתֵי מוֹאָב וְקַרְקַר כּל בְּנֵי שֵׁת׃

english.text:
I see it—and not now; I view it—and not close: a star has
stepped from Jacob, and a scepter has come up from Israel
and pierced the temples of Moab and the crown of all the
children of Seth.

translation.text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

verses.english:
I see it—and not now; I view it—and not close: a star has
stepped from Jacob, and a scepter has come up from Israel
and pierced the temples of Moab and the crown of all the
children of Seth.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אֱדוֹם יְרֵשָׁה וְהָיָה יְרֵשָׁה שֵׂעִיר אֹיְבָיו וְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשֶׂה חָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אֱדוֹם יְרֵשָׁה וְהָיָה יְרֵשָׁה שֵׂעִיר אֹיְבָיו וְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשֶׂה חָיִל׃

english.text:
And Edom was a possession, and Seir was a possession of
its enemies, and Israel was making triumph.

translation.text: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.

verses.english:
And Edom was a possession, and Seir was a possession of
its enemies, and Israel was making triumph.

verses.hebrew: וְיֵרְדְּ מִיַּעֲקֹב וְהֶאֱבִיד שָׂרִיד מֵעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וְיֵרְדְּ מִיַּעֲקֹב וְהֶאֱבִיד שָׂרִיד מֵעִיר׃

english.text:
And one from Jacob dominated and destroyed a remnant from
a city.

translation.text: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.

verses.english:
And one from Jacob dominated and destroyed a remnant from
a city.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֶת עֲמָלֵק וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר רֵאשִׁית גּוֹיִם עֲמָלֵק וְאַחֲרִיתוֹ עֲדֵי אֹבֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אֶת עֲמָלֵק וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר רֵאשִׁית גּוֹיִם עֲמָלֵק וְאַחֲרִיתוֹ עֲדֵי אֹבֵד׃

english.text:
And he saw Amalek, and he took up his pronouncement, and
he said: Amalek was foremost of nations, and its future
arrives at destruction.

translation.text: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.

verses.english:
And he saw Amalek, and he took up his pronouncement, and
he said: Amalek was foremost of nations, and its future
arrives at destruction.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֶת הַקֵּינִי וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר אֵיתָן מוֹשָׁבֶךָ וְשִׂים בַּסֶּלַע קִנֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אֶת הַקֵּינִי וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר אֵיתָן מוֹשָׁבֶךָ וְשִׂים בַּסֶּלַע קִנֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And he saw the Kenites, and he took up his pronouncement
and said: Your residence is strong, and set your nest in a
cliff.

translation.text: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.

verses.english:
And he saw the Kenites, and he took up his pronouncement
and said: Your residence is strong, and set your nest in a
cliff.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם יִהְיֶה לְבָעֵר קָיִן עַד מָה אַשּׁוּר תִּשְׁבֶּךָּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם יִהְיֶה לְבָעֵר קָיִן עַד מָה אַשּׁוּר תִּשְׁבֶּךָּ׃

english.text:
But Cain will be for burning How long will Asshur hold you
prisoner?

translation.text: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.

verses.english:
But Cain will be for burning How long will Asshur hold you
prisoner?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר אוֹי מִי יִחְיֶה מִשֻּׂמוֹ אֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר אוֹי מִי יִחְיֶה מִשֻּׂמוֹ אֵל׃

english.text:
And he took up his pronouncement, and he said: Woe. Who
will live more than what God set him?

translation.text: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!

verses.english:
And he took up his pronouncement, and he said: Woe. Who
will live more than what God set him?

verses.hebrew: וְצִים מִיַּד כִּתִּים וְעִנּוּ אַשּׁוּר וְעִנּוּ עֵבֶר וְגַם הוּא עֲדֵי אֹבֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְצִים מִיַּד כִּתִּים וְעִנּוּ אַשּׁוּר וְעִנּוּ עֵבֶר וְגַם הוּא עֲדֵי אֹבֵד׃

english.text:
And ships from the hand of Kittim: And they degraded
Asshur, and they degraded Eber. And it, too, arrives at
destruction.

translation.text: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.

verses.english:
And ships from the hand of Kittim: And they degraded
Asshur, and they degraded Eber. And it, too, arrives at
destruction.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם בִּלְעָם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּשׁב לִמְקֹמוֹ וְגַם בָּלָק הָלַךְ לְדַרְכּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם בִּלְעָם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּשׁב לִמְקֹמוֹ וְגַם בָּלָק הָלַךְ לְדַרְכּוֹ׃

english.text:
And Balaam got up and went, and he went back to his place.
And Balak, too, went his way.

translation.text: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.

verses.english:
And Balaam got up and went, and he went back to his place.
And Balak, too, went his way.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשִּׁטִּים וַיָּחֶל הָעָם לִזְנוֹת אֶל בְּנוֹת מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשִּׁטִּים וַיָּחֶל הָעָם לִזְנוֹת אֶל בְּנוֹת מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
And Israel lived in Shittim, and the people began to
prostitute themselves to the daughters of Moab:

translation.text: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.

verses.english:
And Israel lived in Shittim, and the people began to
prostitute themselves to the daughters of Moab:

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרֶאןָ לָעָם לְזִבְחֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶן וַיֹּאכַל הָעָם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקְרֶאןָ לָעָם לְזִבְחֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶן וַיֹּאכַל הָעָם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
And they attracted the people to the sacrifices of their
gods, and the people ate and bowed to their gods,

translation.text: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.

verses.english:
And they attracted the people to the sacrifices of their
gods, and the people ate and bowed to their gods,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצָּמֶד יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצָּמֶד יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
and Israel was associated with Baal Peor. And YHWH’s anger
flared at Israel.

translation.text: And Israel joined himself unto Baalpeor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.

verses.english:
and Israel was associated with Baal Peor. And YHWH’s anger
flared at Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה קַח אֶת כּל רָאשֵׁי הָעָם וְהוֹקַע אוֹתָם לַיהֹוָה נֶגֶד הַשָּׁמֶשׁ וְיָשֹׁב חֲרוֹן אַף יְהֹוָה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה קַח אֶת כּל רָאשֵׁי הָעָם וְהוֹקַע אוֹתָם לַיהֹוָה נֶגֶד הַשָּׁמֶשׁ וְיָשֹׁב חֲרוֹן אַף יְהֹוָה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Take all of the leaders of the
people and hang them in front of the sun, and YHWH’s
flaring anger will go back from Israel.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the LORD against the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Take all of the leaders of the
people and hang them in front of the sun, and YHWH’s
flaring anger will go back from Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל שֹׁפְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִרְגוּ אִישׁ אֲנָשָׁיו הַנִּצְמָדִים לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל שֹׁפְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִרְגוּ אִישׁ אֲנָשָׁיו הַנִּצְמָדִים לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר׃

english.text:
And Moses said to Israel’s judges, “Each of you, kill
those of his people who are associated with Baal Peor.”

translation.text: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baalpeor.

verses.english:
And Moses said to Israel’s judges, “Each of you, kill
those of his people who are associated with Baal Peor.”

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּא וַיַּקְרֵב אֶל אֶחָיו אֶת הַמִּדְיָנִית לְעֵינֵי מֹשֶׁה וּלְעֵינֵי כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהֵמָּה בֹכִים פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּא וַיַּקְרֵב אֶל אֶחָיו אֶת הַמִּדְיָנִית לְעֵינֵי מֹשֶׁה וּלְעֵינֵי כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהֵמָּה בֹכִים פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And, here, a man from the children of Israel came and
brought forward a Midianite woman to his brothers before
the eyes of Moses and before the eyes of all the
congregation of the children of Israel while they were
mourning at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.english:
And, here, a man from the children of Israel came and
brought forward a Midianite woman to his brothers before
the eyes of Moses and before the eyes of all the
congregation of the children of Israel while they were
mourning at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא פִּינְחָס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וַיָּקם מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה וַיִּקַּח רֹמַח בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא פִּינְחָס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וַיָּקם מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה וַיִּקַּח רֹמַח בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
And Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, saw,
and he got up from among the congregation and took a spear
in his hand.

translation.text: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;

verses.english:
And Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, saw,
and he got up from among the congregation and took a spear
in his hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אַחַר אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל הַקֻּבָּה וַיִּדְקֹר אֶת שְׁנֵיהֶם אֵת אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת הָאִשָּׁה אֶל קֳבָתָהּ וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה מֵעַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אַחַר אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל הַקֻּבָּה וַיִּדְקֹר אֶת שְׁנֵיהֶם אֵת אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת הָאִשָּׁה אֶל קֳבָתָהּ וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה מֵעַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And he came after the Israelite man to the enclosure and
ran the two of them through, the Israelite man and the
woman, to her stomach, and the plague was halted from the
children of Israel.

translation.text: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And he came after the Israelite man to the enclosure and
ran the two of them through, the Israelite man and the
woman, to her stomach, and the plague was halted from the
children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ הַמֵּתִים בַּמַּגֵּפָה אַרְבָּעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ הַמֵּתִים בַּמַּגֵּפָה אַרְבָּעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף׃

english.text: And the dead in the plague were twenty-four thousand.

translation.text: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.

verses.english: And the dead in the plague were twenty-four thousand.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: פִּינְחָס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן הֵשִׁיב אֶת חֲמָתִי מֵעַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּקַנְאוֹ אֶת קִנְאָתִי בְּתוֹכָם וְלֹא כִלִּיתִי אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּקִנְאָתִי׃

hebrew.text: פִּינְחָס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן הֵשִׁיב אֶת חֲמָתִי מֵעַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּקַנְאוֹ אֶת קִנְאָתִי בְּתוֹכָם וְלֹא כִלִּיתִי אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּקִנְאָתִי׃

english.text:
“Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, has
turned back my fury from the children of Israel by his
carrying out my jealousy among them, so I didn’t finish
the children of Israel in my jealousy.

translation.text: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.

verses.english:
“Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, has
turned back my fury from the children of Israel by his
carrying out my jealousy among them, so I didn’t finish
the children of Israel in my jealousy.

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אֱמֹר הִנְנִי נֹתֵן לוֹ אֶת בְּרִיתִי שָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: לָכֵן אֱמֹר הִנְנִי נֹתֵן לוֹ אֶת בְּרִיתִי שָׁלוֹם׃

english.text: Therefore, say: Here, I’m giving him my covenant of peace,

translation.text: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:

verses.english: Therefore, say: Here, I’m giving him my covenant of peace,

verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה לּוֹ וּלְזַרְעוֹ אַחֲרָיו בְּרִית כְּהֻנַּת עוֹלָם תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר קִנֵּא לֵאלֹהָיו וַיְכַפֵּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה לּוֹ וּלְזַרְעוֹ אַחֲרָיו בְּרִית כְּהֻנַּת עוֹלָם תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר קִנֵּא לֵאלֹהָיו וַיְכַפֵּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
and it shall be his, and his seed’s after him, a covenant
of eternal priesthood, because he was jealous for his God,
and he made atonement for the children of Israel.”

translation.text: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.

verses.english:
and it shall be his, and his seed’s after him, a covenant
of eternal priesthood, because he was jealous for his God,
and he made atonement for the children of Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמֻּכֶּה אֲשֶׁר הֻכָּה אֶת הַמִּדְיָנִית זִמְרִי בֶּן סָלוּא נְשִׂיא בֵית אָב לַשִּׁמְעֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁם אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמֻּכֶּה אֲשֶׁר הֻכָּה אֶת הַמִּדְיָנִית זִמְרִי בֶּן סָלוּא נְשִׂיא בֵית אָב לַשִּׁמְעֹנִי׃

english.text:
And the name of the stricken Israelite man, who was struck
with the Midianite woman, was Zimri son of Salu, chieftain
of a father’s house of the Simeonites.

translation.text: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.

verses.english:
And the name of the stricken Israelite man, who was struck
with the Midianite woman, was Zimri son of Salu, chieftain
of a father’s house of the Simeonites.

verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם הָאִשָּׁה הַמֻּכָּה הַמִּדְיָנִית כּזְבִּי בַת צוּר רֹאשׁ אֻמּוֹת בֵּית אָב בְּמִדְיָן הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁם הָאִשָּׁה הַמֻּכָּה הַמִּדְיָנִית כּזְבִּי בַת צוּר רֹאשׁ אֻמּוֹת בֵּית אָב בְּמִדְיָן הוּא׃

english.text:
And the name of the stricken Midianite woman was Cozbi
daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a father’s
house in Midian.

translation.text: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.

verses.english:
And the name of the stricken Midianite woman was Cozbi
daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a father’s
house in Midian.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: צָרוֹר אֶת הַמִּדְיָנִים וְהִכִּיתֶם אוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: צָרוֹר אֶת הַמִּדְיָנִים וְהִכִּיתֶם אוֹתָם׃

english.text: “Afflict the Midianites—and you shall strike them—

translation.text: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:

verses.english: “Afflict the Midianites—and you shall strike them—

verses.hebrew: כִּי צֹרְרִים הֵם לָכֶם בְּנִכְלֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר נִכְּלוּ לָכֶם עַל דְּבַר פְּעוֹר וְעַל דְּבַר כּזְבִּי בַת נְשִׂיא מִדְיָן אֲחֹתָם הַמֻּכָּה בְיוֹם הַמַּגֵּפָה עַל דְּבַר פְּעוֹר׃

hebrew.text: כִּי צֹרְרִים הֵם לָכֶם בְּנִכְלֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר נִכְּלוּ לָכֶם עַל דְּבַר פְּעוֹר וְעַל דְּבַר כּזְבִּי בַת נְשִׂיא מִדְיָן אֲחֹתָם הַמֻּכָּה בְיוֹם הַמַּגֵּפָה עַל דְּבַר פְּעוֹר׃

english.text:
because they have been afflicting you with their
conspiracies that they made against you over the matter of
Peor and over the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a
chieftain of Midian, their sister who was struck on the
day of the plague over the matter of Peor.”

translation.text: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor’s sake.

verses.english:
because they have been afflicting you with their
conspiracies that they made against you over the matter of
Peor and over the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a
chieftain of Midian, their sister who was struck on the
day of the plague over the matter of Peor.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי הַמַּגֵּפָה פ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי הַמַּגֵּפָה פ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses and to Eleazar son of Aaron, the
priest, saying,

translation.text: And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses and to Eleazar son of Aaron, the
priest, saying,

verses.hebrew: שְׂאוּ אֶת רֹאשׁ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם כּל יֹצֵא צָבָא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: שְׂאוּ אֶת רֹאשׁ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם כּל יֹצֵא צָבָא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

translation.text: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers’ house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, spoke with them in the
plains of Moab by the Jordan toward Jericho, saying,

translation.text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

verses.english:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, spoke with them in the
plains of Moab by the Jordan toward Jericho, saying,

verses.hebrew: מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמָעְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיֹּצְאִים מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמָעְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיֹּצְאִים מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
“From twenty years old and up,” as YHWH commanded Moses
and the children of Israel who had gone out from the land
of Egypt.

translation.text: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
“From twenty years old and up,” as YHWH commanded Moses
and the children of Israel who had gone out from the land
of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: רְאוּבֵן בְּכוֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן חֲנוֹךְ מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֲנֹכִי לְפַלּוּא מִשְׁפַּחַת הַפַּלֻּאִי׃

hebrew.text: רְאוּבֵן בְּכוֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן חֲנוֹךְ מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֲנֹכִי לְפַלּוּא מִשְׁפַּחַת הַפַּלֻּאִי׃

english.text:
Reuben, Israel’s firstborn; the children of Reuben:
Hanoch: the family of the Hanochites. Of Pallu: the family
of the Palluites.

translation.text: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:

verses.english:
Reuben, Israel’s firstborn; the children of Reuben:
Hanoch: the family of the Hanochites. Of Pallu: the family
of the Palluites.

verses.hebrew: לְחֶצְרֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶצְרוֹנִי לְכַרְמִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַכַּרְמִי׃

hebrew.text: לְחֶצְרֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶצְרוֹנִי לְכַרְמִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַכַּרְמִי׃

english.text:
Of Hezron: the family of the Hezronites. Of Carmi: the
family of the Carmites.

translation.text: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

verses.english:
Of Hezron: the family of the Hezronites. Of Carmi: the
family of the Carmites.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הָראוּבֵנִי וַיִּהְיוּ פְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הָראוּבֵנִי וַיִּהְיוּ פְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁים׃

english.text:
These are the families of the Reubenites, and their counts
were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

translation.text: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.

verses.english:
These are the families of the Reubenites, and their counts
were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי פַלּוּא אֱלִיאָב׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי פַלּוּא אֱלִיאָב׃

english.text: And Pallu’s sons: Eliab.

translation.text: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.

verses.english: And Pallu’s sons: Eliab.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי אֱלִיאָב נְמוּאֵל וְדָתָן וַאֲבִירָם הוּא דָתָן וַאֲבִירָם (קרואי) [קְרִיאֵי] הָעֵדָה אֲשֶׁר הִצּוּ עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן בַּעֲדַת קֹרַח בְּהַצֹּתָם עַל יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי אֱלִיאָב נְמוּאֵל וְדָתָן וַאֲבִירָם הוּא דָתָן וַאֲבִירָם (קרואי) [קְרִיאֵי] הָעֵדָה אֲשֶׁר הִצּוּ עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַל אַהֲרֹן בַּעֲדַת קֹרַח בְּהַצֹּתָם עַל יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Eliab’s sons: Nemuel and Dathan and Abiram. That is
the Dathan and Abiram, prominent ones of the congregation,
who fought against Moses and against Aaron in Korah’s
congregation when they fought against YHWH,

translation.text: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the LORD:

verses.english:
And Eliab’s sons: Nemuel and Dathan and Abiram. That is
the Dathan and Abiram, prominent ones of the congregation,
who fought against Moses and against Aaron in Korah’s
congregation when they fought against YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וַתִּפְתַּח הָאָרֶץ אֶת פִּיהָ וַתִּבְלַע אֹתָם וְאֶת קֹרַח בְּמוֹת הָעֵדָה בַּאֲכֹל הָאֵשׁ אֵת חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתַיִם אִישׁ וַיִּהְיוּ לְנֵס׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּפְתַּח הָאָרֶץ אֶת פִּיהָ וַתִּבְלַע אֹתָם וְאֶת קֹרַח בְּמוֹת הָעֵדָה בַּאֲכֹל הָאֵשׁ אֵת חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתַיִם אִישׁ וַיִּהְיוּ לְנֵס׃

english.text:
and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and
Korah when the congregation died, when the fire consumed
the two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.

translation.text: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.

verses.english:
and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and
Korah when the congregation died, when the fire consumed
the two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי קֹרַח לֹא מֵתוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי קֹרַח לֹא מֵתוּ׃

english.text: But Korah’s sons did not die.

translation.text: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.

verses.english: But Korah’s sons did not die.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִנְמוּאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַנְּמוּאֵלִי לְיָמִין מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיָּמִינִי לְיָכִין מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיָּכִינִי׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִנְמוּאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַנְּמוּאֵלִי לְיָמִין מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיָּמִינִי לְיָכִין מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיָּכִינִי׃

english.text:
The children of Simeon by their families: Of Nemuel: the
family of the Nemuelites. Of Jamin: the family of the
Jaminites. Of Jachin: the family of the Jachinites.

be given his legacy according to his counts.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ בְּגוֹרָל יֵחָלֵק אֶת הָאָרֶץ לִשְׁמוֹת מַטּוֹת אֲבֹתָם יִנְחָלוּ׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ בְּגוֹרָל יֵחָלֵק אֶת הָאָרֶץ לִשְׁמוֹת מַטּוֹת אֲבֹתָם יִנְחָלוּ׃

english.text:
Just: the land shall be distributed by lot. They shall
have a legacy by the names of their fathers’ tribes.

translation.text: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

verses.english:
Just: the land shall be distributed by lot. They shall
have a legacy by the names of their fathers’ tribes.

verses.hebrew: עַל פִּי הַגּוֹרָל תֵּחָלֵק נַחֲלָתוֹ בֵּין רַב לִמְעָט׃

hebrew.text: עַל פִּי הַגּוֹרָל תֵּחָלֵק נַחֲלָתוֹ בֵּין רַב לִמְעָט׃

english.text:
Its legacy shall be distributed according to the lot,
whether large or small.”

translation.text: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.

verses.english:
Its legacy shall be distributed according to the lot,
whether large or small.”

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה פְקוּדֵי הַלֵּוִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְגֵרְשׁוֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לִקְהָת מִשְׁפַּחַת הַקְּהָתִי לִמְרָרִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמְּרָרִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה פְקוּדֵי הַלֵּוִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְגֵרְשׁוֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לִקְהָת מִשְׁפַּחַת הַקְּהָתִי לִמְרָרִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמְּרָרִי׃

english.text:
And these are the counts of the Levites by their families:
Of Gershon: the family of the Gershonites. Of Kohath: the
family of the Kohathites. Of Merari: the family of the
Merarites.

translation.text: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

verses.english:
And these are the counts of the Levites by their families:
Of Gershon: the family of the Gershonites. Of Kohath: the
family of the Kohathites. Of Merari: the family of the
Merarites.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת לֵוִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַלִּבְנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶבְרֹנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּחְלִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמּוּשִׁי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַקּרְחִי וּקְהָת הוֹלִד אֶת עַמְרָם׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת לֵוִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַלִּבְנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶבְרֹנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּחְלִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמּוּשִׁי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַקּרְחִי וּקְהָת הוֹלִד אֶת עַמְרָם׃

english.text:
These are the families of the Levites: the family of the
Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the
Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the
Korahites. And Kohath fathered Amram.

translation.text: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.

verses.english:
These are the families of the Levites: the family of the
Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the
Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the
Korahites. And Kohath fathered Amram.

verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם אֵשֶׁת עַמְרָם יוֹכֶבֶד בַּת לֵוִי אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה אֹתָהּ לְלֵוִי בְּמִצְרָיִם וַתֵּלֶד לְעַמְרָם אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת מֹשֶׁה וְאֵת מִרְיָם אֲחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁם אֵשֶׁת עַמְרָם יוֹכֶבֶד בַּת לֵוִי אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה אֹתָהּ לְלֵוִי בְּמִצְרָיִם וַתֵּלֶד לְעַמְרָם אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת מֹשֶׁה וְאֵת מִרְיָם אֲחֹתָם׃

english.text:
And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, a daughter of
Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. And she gave birth
for Amram to Aaron and Moses and Miriam, their sister.

translation.text: And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

verses.english:
And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, a daughter of
Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. And she gave birth
for Amram to Aaron and Moses and Miriam, their sister.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּלֵד לְאַהֲרֹן אֶת נָדָב וְאֶת אֲבִיהוּא אֶת אֶלְעָזָר וְאֶת אִיתָמָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּוָּלֵד לְאַהֲרֹן אֶת נָדָב וְאֶת אֲבִיהוּא אֶת אֶלְעָזָר וְאֶת אִיתָמָר׃

english.text:
And Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar were born to
Aaron.

translation.text: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.english:
And Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar were born to
Aaron.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא בְּהַקְרִיבָם אֵשׁ זָרָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא בְּהַקְרִיבָם אֵשׁ זָרָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Nadab and Abihu died when they brought forward
unfitting fire in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD.

verses.english:
And Nadab and Abihu died when they brought forward
unfitting fire in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ פְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף כּל זָכָר מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה כִּי לֹא התְפָּקְדוּ בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי לֹא נִתַּן לָהֶם נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ פְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף כּל זָכָר מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה כִּי לֹא התְפָּקְדוּ בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי לֹא נִתַּן לָהֶם נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And their counts were twenty-three thousand, every male
from a month old and up, because they were not counted
among the children of Israel because a legacy was not
given to them among the children of Israel.

translation.text: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And their counts were twenty-three thousand, every male
from a month old and up, because they were not counted
among the children of Israel because a legacy was not
given to them among the children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה פְּקוּדֵי מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר פָּקְדוּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה פְּקוּדֵי מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר פָּקְדוּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

translation.text: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

verses.hebrew: וּבְאֵלֶּה לֹא הָיָה אִישׁ מִפְּקוּדֵי מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר פָּקְדוּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי׃

hebrew.text: וּבְאֵלֶּה לֹא הָיָה אִישׁ מִפְּקוּדֵי מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר פָּקְדוּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי׃

english.text:
and there was not a man among these from the counts of
Moses and Aaron, the priest, who counted the children of
Israel in the wilderness of Sinai,

translation.text: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.english:
and there was not a man among these from the counts of
Moses and Aaron, the priest, who counted the children of
Israel in the wilderness of Sinai,

verses.hebrew: כִּי אָמַר יְהֹוָה לָהֶם מוֹת יָמֻתוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר וְלֹא נוֹתַר מֵהֶם אִישׁ כִּי אִם כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אָמַר יְהֹוָה לָהֶם מוֹת יָמֻתוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר וְלֹא נוֹתַר מֵהֶם אִישׁ כִּי אִם כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן׃

english.text:
because YHWH said of them, “They shall die in the
wilderness,” and not a man was left of them except Caleb
son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

translation.text: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.english:
because YHWH said of them, “They shall die in the
wilderness,” and not a man was left of them except Caleb
son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרַבְנָה בְּנוֹת צְלפְחָד בֶּן חֵפֶר בֶּן גִּלְעָד בֶּן מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹת מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן יוֹסֵף וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֹתָיו מַחְלָה נֹעָה וְחגְלָה וּמִלְכָּה וְתִרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקְרַבְנָה בְּנוֹת צְלפְחָד בֶּן חֵפֶר בֶּן גִּלְעָד בֶּן מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹת מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן יוֹסֵף וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֹתָיו מַחְלָה נֹעָה וְחגְלָה וּמִלְכָּה וְתִרְצָה׃

english.text:
And the daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher son of
Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, of the families of
Manasseh son of Joseph, came forward. And these are his
daughters’ names: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah and Milcah and
Tirzah.

translation.text: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.english:
And the daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher son of
Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, of the families of
Manasseh son of Joseph, came forward. And these are his
daughters’ names: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah and Milcah and
Tirzah.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲמֹדְנָה לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וְלִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי הַנְּשִׂיאִם וְכל הָעֵדָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעֲמֹדְנָה לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וְלִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי הַנְּשִׂיאִם וְכל הָעֵדָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And they stood in front of Moses and in front of Eleazar,
the priest, and in front of the chieftains and all the
congregation at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting,
saying,

translation.text: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

verses.english:
And they stood in front of Moses and in front of Eleazar,
the priest, and in front of the chieftains and all the
congregation at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting,
saying,

verses.hebrew: אָבִינוּ מֵת בַּמִּדְבָּר וְהוּא לֹא הָיָה בְּתוֹךְ הָעֵדָה הַנּוֹעָדִים עַל יְהֹוָה בַּעֲדַת קֹרַח כִּי בְחֶטְאוֹ מֵת וּבָנִים לֹא הָיוּ לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אָבִינוּ מֵת בַּמִּדְבָּר וְהוּא לֹא הָיָה בְּתוֹךְ הָעֵדָה הַנּוֹעָדִים עַל יְהֹוָה בַּעֲדַת קֹרַח כִּי בְחֶטְאוֹ מֵת וּבָנִים לֹא הָיוּ לוֹ׃

english.text:
“Our father died in the wilderness. And he wasn’t among
the congregation who were gathered against YHWH: in
Korah’s congregation. Rather, he died through his own sin.
And he had no sons.

translation.text: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.

verses.english:
“Our father died in the wilderness. And he wasn’t among
the congregation who were gathered against YHWH: in
Korah’s congregation. Rather, he died through his own sin.
And he had no sons.

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה יִגָּרַע שֵׁם אָבִינוּ מִתּוֹךְ מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ כִּי אֵין לוֹ בֵּן תְּנָה לָּנוּ אֲחֻזָּה בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵי אָבִינוּ׃

hebrew.text: לָמָּה יִגָּרַע שֵׁם אָבִינוּ מִתּוֹךְ מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ כִּי אֵין לוֹ בֵּן תְּנָה לָּנוּ אֲחֻזָּה בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵי אָבִינוּ׃

english.text:
Why should our father’s name be subtracted from among his
family because he didn’t have a son? Give us a possession
among our father’s brothers.”

translation.text: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.

verses.english:
Why should our father’s name be subtracted from among his
family because he didn’t have a son? Give us a possession
among our father’s brothers.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶת מִשְׁפָּטָן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶת מִשְׁפָּטָן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text: And Moses brought their case forward in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.

verses.english: And Moses brought their case forward in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH said to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH said to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: כֵּן בְּנוֹת צְלפְחָד דֹּבְרֹת נָתֹן תִּתֵּן לָהֶם אֲחֻזַּת נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵי אֲבִיהֶם וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ אֶת נַחֲלַת אֲבִיהֶן לָהֶן׃

hebrew.text: כֵּן בְּנוֹת צְלפְחָד דֹּבְרֹת נָתֹן תִּתֵּן לָהֶם אֲחֻזַּת נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵי אֲבִיהֶם וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ אֶת נַחֲלַת אֲבִיהֶן לָהֶן׃

english.text:
“Zelophehad’s daughters speak right. You shall give them a
possession for a legacy among their father’s brothers, and
you shall pass their father’s legacy to them.

translation.text: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.

verses.english:
“Zelophehad’s daughters speak right. You shall give them a
possession for a legacy among their father’s brothers, and
you shall pass their father’s legacy to them.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּדַבֵּר לֵאמֹר אִישׁ כִּי יָמוּת וּבֵן אֵין לוֹ וְהַעֲבַרְתֶּם אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ לְבִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּדַבֵּר לֵאמֹר אִישׁ כִּי יָמוּת וּבֵן אֵין לוֹ וְהַעֲבַרְתֶּם אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ לְבִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘A
man who will die and not have a son: you shall pass his
legacy to his daughter.

translation.text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.

verses.english:
And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘A
man who will die and not have a son: you shall pass his
legacy to his daughter.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם אֵין לוֹ בַּת וּנְתַתֶּם אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ לְאֶחָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם אֵין לוֹ בַּת וּנְתַתֶּם אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ לְאֶחָיו׃

english.text:
And if he does not have a daughter, then you shall give
his legacy to his brothers.

translation.text: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.

verses.english:
And if he does not have a daughter, then you shall give
his legacy to his brothers.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם אֵין לוֹ אַחִים וּנְתַתֶּם אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ לַאֲחֵי אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם אֵין לוֹ אַחִים וּנְתַתֶּם אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ לַאֲחֵי אָבִיו׃

english.text:
And if he does not have brothers, then you shall give his
legacy to his father’s brothers.

translation.text: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father’s brethren.

verses.english:
And if he does not have brothers, then you shall give his
legacy to his father’s brothers.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם אֵין אַחִים לְאָבִיו וּנְתַתֶּם אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ לִשְׁאֵרוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֵלָיו מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ וְיָרַשׁ אֹתָהּ וְהָיְתָה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְחֻקַּת מִשְׁפָּט כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם אֵין אַחִים לְאָבִיו וּנְתַתֶּם אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ לִשְׁאֵרוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֵלָיו מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ וְיָרַשׁ אֹתָהּ וְהָיְתָה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְחֻקַּת מִשְׁפָּט כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And if there are no brothers of his father, then you shall
give his legacy to his relative who is closest to him of
his family, and he shall possess it.’ And it shall become
a law of judgment for the children of Israel, as YHWH
commanded Moses.”

translation.text: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And if there are no brothers of his father, then you shall
give his legacy to his relative who is closest to him of
his family, and he shall possess it.’ And it shall become
a law of judgment for the children of Israel, as YHWH
commanded Moses.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עֲלֵה אֶל הַר הָעֲבָרִים הַזֶּה וּרְאֵה אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עֲלֵה אֶל הַר הָעֲבָרִים הַזֶּה וּרְאֵה אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Go up to this mountain of Abarim
and see the land that I’ve given to the children of
Israel.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Go up to this mountain of Abarim
and see the land that I’ve given to the children of
Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְרָאִיתָה אֹתָהּ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ אֶל עַמֶּיךָ גַּם אָתָּה כַּאֲשֶׁר נֶאֱסַף אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאִיתָה אֹתָהּ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ אֶל עַמֶּיךָ גַּם אָתָּה כַּאֲשֶׁר נֶאֱסַף אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ׃

english.text:
And you’ll see it, and then you’ll be gathered to your
people, you as well, as Aaron, your brother, was gathered,

translation.text: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.

verses.english:
And you’ll see it, and then you’ll be gathered to your
people, you as well, as Aaron, your brother, was gathered,

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר מְרִיתֶם פִּי בְּמִדְבַּר צִן בִּמְרִיבַת הָעֵדָה לְהַקְדִּישֵׁנִי בַמַּיִם לְעֵינֵיהֶם הֵם מֵי מְרִיבַת קָדֵשׁ מִדְבַּר צִן׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר מְרִיתֶם פִּי בְּמִדְבַּר צִן בִּמְרִיבַת הָעֵדָה לְהַקְדִּישֵׁנִי בַמַּיִם לְעֵינֵיהֶם הֵם מֵי מְרִיבַת קָדֵשׁ מִדְבַּר צִן׃

english.text:
because you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of
Zin in the congregation’s quarrel to make me holy with
water before their eyes. That is the water of Meribah of
Kadesh at the wilderness of Zin.”

translation.text: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

verses.english:
because you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of
Zin in the congregation’s quarrel to make me holy with
water before their eyes. That is the water of Meribah of
Kadesh at the wilderness of Zin.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And Moses spoke to YHWH, saying,

translation.text: And Moses spake unto the LORD, saying,

verses.english: And Moses spoke to YHWH, saying,

verses.hebrew: יִפְקֹד יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָרוּחֹת לְכל בָּשָׂר אִישׁ עַל הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: יִפְקֹד יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָרוּחֹת לְכל בָּשָׂר אִישׁ עַל הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
“Let YHWH, God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man
over the congregation

translation.text: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,

verses.english:
“Let YHWH, God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man
over the congregation

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא לִפְנֵיהֶם וַאֲשֶׁר יָבֹא לִפְנֵיהֶם וַאֲשֶׁר יוֹצִיאֵם וַאֲשֶׁר יְבִיאֵם וְלֹא תִהְיֶה עֲדַת יְהֹוָה כַּצֹּאן אֲשֶׁר אֵין לָהֶם רֹעֶה׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא לִפְנֵיהֶם וַאֲשֶׁר יָבֹא לִפְנֵיהֶם וַאֲשֶׁר יוֹצִיאֵם וַאֲשֶׁר יְבִיאֵם וְלֹא תִהְיֶה עֲדַת יְהֹוָה כַּצֹּאן אֲשֶׁר אֵין לָהֶם רֹעֶה׃

english.text:
who will go out in front of them and who will come in in
front of them and who will bring them out and who will
bring them in, so YHWH’s congregation won’t be like sheep
that don’t have a shepherd.”

translation.text: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.

verses.english:
who will go out in front of them and who will come in in
front of them and who will bring them out and who will
bring them in, so YHWH’s congregation won’t be like sheep
that don’t have a shepherd.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה קַח לְךָ אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר רוּחַ בּוֹ וְסָמַכְתָּ אֶת יָדְךָ עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה קַח לְךָ אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר רוּחַ בּוֹ וְסָמַכְתָּ אֶת יָדְךָ עָלָיו׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Take Joshua son of Nun, a man
with spirit in him, and lay your hand on him.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Take Joshua son of Nun, a man
with spirit in him, and lay your hand on him.

verses.hebrew: וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי כּל הָעֵדָה וְצִוִּיתָה אֹתוֹ לְעֵינֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי כּל הָעֵדָה וְצִוִּיתָה אֹתוֹ לְעֵינֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall stand him in front of Eleazar, the priest,
and in front of all the congregation, and you shall
command him before their eyes.

translation.text: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.

verses.english:
And you shall stand him in front of Eleazar, the priest,
and in front of all the congregation, and you shall
command him before their eyes.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה מֵהוֹדְךָ עָלָיו לְמַעַן יִשְׁמְעוּ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּה מֵהוֹדְךָ עָלָיו לְמַעַן יִשְׁמְעוּ כּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And you shall put some of your eminence on him so that all
the congregation of the children of Israel will hear.

translation.text: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.

verses.english:
And you shall put some of your eminence on him so that all
the congregation of the children of Israel will hear.

verses.hebrew: וְלִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן יַעֲמֹד וְשָׁאַל לוֹ בְּמִשְׁפַּט הָאוּרִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל פִּיו יֵצְאוּ וְעַל פִּיו יָבֹאוּ הוּא וְכל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִתּוֹ וְכל הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן יַעֲמֹד וְשָׁאַל לוֹ בְּמִשְׁפַּט הָאוּרִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַל פִּיו יֵצְאוּ וְעַל פִּיו יָבֹאוּ הוּא וְכל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִתּוֹ וְכל הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
And he shall stand in front of Eleazar, the priest; and he
shall ask him in judgment of the Urim in front of YHWH. By
his word they shall go out, and by his word they shall
come in, he and all the children of Israel with him and
all the congregation.”

translation.text: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.

verses.english:
And he shall stand in front of Eleazar, the priest; and he
shall ask him in judgment of the Urim in front of YHWH. By
his word they shall go out, and by his word they shall
come in, he and all the children of Israel with him and
all the congregation.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיַּעֲמִדֵהוּ לִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי כּל הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיַּעֲמִדֵהוּ לִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי כּל הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
And Moses did as YHWH commanded him, and he took Joshua
and stood him in front of Eleazar, the priest, and in
front of all the congregation.

translation.text: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:

verses.english:
And Moses did as YHWH commanded him, and he took Joshua
and stood him in front of Eleazar, the priest, and in
front of all the congregation.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְמֹךְ אֶת יָדָיו עָלָיו וַיְצַוֵּהוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְמֹךְ אֶת יָדָיו עָלָיו וַיְצַוֵּהוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And he laid his hands on him and commanded him, as YHWH
had spoken by Moses’ hand.

translation.text: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

verses.english:
And he laid his hands on him and commanded him, as YHWH
had spoken by Moses’ hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אֶת קרְבָּנִי לַחְמִי לְאִשַּׁי רֵיחַ נִיחֹחִי תִּשְׁמְרוּ לְהַקְרִיב לִי בְּמוֹעֲדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אֶת קרְבָּנִי לַחְמִי לְאִשַּׁי רֵיחַ נִיחֹחִי תִּשְׁמְרוּ לְהַקְרִיב לִי בְּמוֹעֲדוֹ׃

english.text:
“Command the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: You shall observe to bring forward my sacrifice to
me, my bread, for my offering by fire, my pleasant smell,
at its appointed time.

translation.text: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.

verses.english:
“Command the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: You shall observe to bring forward my sacrifice to
me, my bread, for my offering by fire, my pleasant smell,
at its appointed time.

verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ לָהֶם זֶה הָאִשֶּׁה אֲשֶׁר תַּקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְמִימִם שְׁנַיִם לַיּוֹם עֹלָה תָמִיד׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ לָהֶם זֶה הָאִשֶּׁה אֲשֶׁר תַּקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְמִימִם שְׁנַיִם לַיּוֹם עֹלָה תָמִיד׃

english.text:
“And you shall say to them: This is the offering by fire
that you shall bring forward to YHWH: two unblemished
one-year-old lambs per day as a continual burnt offering.

translation.text: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

verses.english:
“And you shall say to them: This is the offering by fire
that you shall bring forward to YHWH: two unblemished
one-year-old lambs per day as a continual burnt offering.

verses.hebrew: אֶת הַכֶּבֶשׂ אֶחָד תַּעֲשֶׂה בַבֹּקֶר וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: אֶת הַכֶּבֶשׂ אֶחָד תַּעֲשֶׂה בַבֹּקֶר וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם׃

english.text:
You shall do one lamb in the morning, and you shall do the
second lamb ‘between the two evenings.’

translation.text: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;

verses.english:
You shall do one lamb in the morning, and you shall do the
second lamb ‘between the two evenings.’

verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂירִית הָאֵיפָה סֹלֶת לְמִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בְּשֶׁמֶן כָּתִית רְבִיעִת הַהִין׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲשִׂירִית הָאֵיפָה סֹלֶת לְמִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בְּשֶׁמֶן כָּתִית רְבִיעִת הַהִין׃

english.text:
And a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a grain
offering, mixed with a fourth of a hin of pressed oil,

translation.text: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.

verses.english:
And a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a grain
offering, mixed with a fourth of a hin of pressed oil,

verses.hebrew: עֹלַת תָּמִיד הָעֲשֻׂיָה בְּהַר סִינַי לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: עֹלַת תָּמִיד הָעֲשֻׂיָה בְּהַר סִינַי לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
the continual burnt offering that was done at Mount Sinai
for a pleasant smell, an offering by fire to YHWH.

translation.text: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.english:
the continual burnt offering that was done at Mount Sinai
for a pleasant smell, an offering by fire to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְנִסְכּוֹ רְבִיעִת הַהִין לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד בַּקֹּדֶשׁ הַסֵּךְ נֶסֶךְ שֵׁכָר לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנִסְכּוֹ רְבִיעִת הַהִין לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד בַּקֹּדֶשׁ הַסֵּךְ נֶסֶךְ שֵׁכָר לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And its libation shall be a fourth of a hin for one lamb.
Pour a libation of beer in the holy place for YHWH.

translation.text: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD for a drink offering.

verses.english:
And its libation shall be a fourth of a hin for one lamb.
Pour a libation of beer in the holy place for YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם כְּמִנְחַת הַבֹּקֶר וּכְנִסְכּוֹ תַּעֲשֶׂה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם כְּמִנְחַת הַבֹּקֶר וּכְנִסְכּוֹ תַּעֲשֶׂה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And you shall do the second lamb ‘between the two
evenings,’ and you shall do it like the morning grain
offering and like its libation, an offering by fire of a
pleasant smell to YHWH.

translation.text: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And you shall do the second lamb ‘between the two
evenings,’ and you shall do it like the morning grain
offering and like its libation, an offering by fire of a
pleasant smell to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וּבְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת שְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וְנִסְכּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת שְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וְנִסְכּוֹ׃

english.text:
“And on the Sabbath day two unblemished one-year-old lambs
and two tenths of fine flour, a grain offering, mixed with
oil, and its libation:

translation.text: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:

verses.english:
“And on the Sabbath day two unblemished one-year-old lambs
and two tenths of fine flour, a grain offering, mixed with
oil, and its libation:

verses.hebrew: עֹלַת שַׁבַּת בְּשַׁבַּתּוֹ עַל עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וְנִסְכָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: עֹלַת שַׁבַּת בְּשַׁבַּתּוֹ עַל עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וְנִסְכָּהּ׃

english.text:
the burnt offering of each Sabbath in its week, beside the
continual burnt offering and its libation.

translation.text: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

verses.english:
the burnt offering of each Sabbath in its week, beside the
continual burnt offering and its libation.

verses.hebrew: וּבְרָאשֵׁי חדְשֵׁיכֶם תַּקְרִיבוּ עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה פָּרִים בְּנֵי בָקָר שְׁנַיִם וְאַיִל אֶחָד כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה שִׁבְעָה תְּמִימִם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְרָאשֵׁי חדְשֵׁיכֶם תַּקְרִיבוּ עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה פָּרִים בְּנֵי בָקָר שְׁנַיִם וְאַיִל אֶחָד כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה שִׁבְעָה תְּמִימִם׃

english.text:
“And at the beginning of your months you shall bring
forward a burnt offering to YHWH: two bulls of the cattle
and one ram, seven unblemished one-year-old lambs,

translation.text: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;

verses.english:
“And at the beginning of your months you shall bring
forward a burnt offering to YHWH: two bulls of the cattle
and one ram, seven unblemished one-year-old lambs,

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לַפָּר הָאֶחָד וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לָאַיִל הָאֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לַפָּר הָאֶחָד וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לָאַיִל הָאֶחָד׃

english.text:
with three tenths of fine flour, a grain offering, mixed
with oil for one bull and two tenths of fine flour mixed
with oil for the one ram,

translation.text: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;

verses.english:
with three tenths of fine flour, a grain offering, mixed
with oil for one bull and two tenths of fine flour mixed
with oil for the one ram,

verses.hebrew: וְעִשָּׂרֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד עֹלָה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעִשָּׂרֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד עֹלָה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and one tenth of fine flour, a grain offering, mixed with
oil for each lamb, a burnt offering as a pleasant smell,
an offering by fire to YHWH.

translation.text: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.english:
and one tenth of fine flour, a grain offering, mixed with
oil for each lamb, a burnt offering as a pleasant smell,
an offering by fire to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם חֲצִי הַהִין יִהְיֶה לַפָּר וּשְׁלִישִׁת הַהִין לָאַיִל וּרְבִיעִת הַהִין לַכֶּבֶשׂ יָיִן זֹאת עֹלַת חֹדֶשׁ בְּחדְשׁוֹ לְחדְשֵׁי הַשָּׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם חֲצִי הַהִין יִהְיֶה לַפָּר וּשְׁלִישִׁת הַהִין לָאַיִל וּרְבִיעִת הַהִין לַכֶּבֶשׂ יָיִן זֹאת עֹלַת חֹדֶשׁ בְּחדְשׁוֹ לְחדְשֵׁי הַשָּׁנָה׃

english.text:
And their libations: half a hin will be for a bull and a
third of a hin for a ram and a fourth of a hin for a
lamb—wine. This is the burnt offering of each new month in
its month for the months of the year.

translation.text: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

verses.english:
And their libations: half a hin will be for a bull and a
third of a hin for a ram and a fourth of a hin for a
lamb—wine. This is the burnt offering of each new month in
its month for the months of the year.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת לַיהֹוָה עַל עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד יֵעָשֶׂה וְנִסְכּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת לַיהֹוָה עַל עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד יֵעָשֶׂה וְנִסְכּוֹ׃

english.text:
And one goat for a sin offering to YHWH shall be done,
beside the continual burnt offering and its libation.

translation.text: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

verses.english:
And one goat for a sin offering to YHWH shall be done,
beside the continual burnt offering and its libation.

verses.hebrew: וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ פֶּסַח לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ פֶּסַח לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“And in the first month on the fourteenth day of the month
is a Passover to YHWH.

translation.text: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the LORD.

verses.english:
“And in the first month on the fourteenth day of the month
is a Passover to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה חָג שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מַצּוֹת יֵאָכֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה חָג שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מַצּוֹת יֵאָכֵל׃

english.text:
And on the fifteenth day of this month is a holiday. For
seven days unleavened bread shall be eaten.

translation.text: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

verses.english:
And on the fifteenth day of this month is a holiday. For
seven days unleavened bread shall be eaten.

verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ כּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
On the first day is a holy assembly. You shall not do any
act of work.

translation.text: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:

verses.english:
On the first day is a holy assembly. You shall not do any
act of work.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה פָּרִים בְּנֵי בָקָר שְׁנַיִם וְאַיִל אֶחָד וְשִׁבְעָה כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה פָּרִים בְּנֵי בָקָר שְׁנַיִם וְאַיִל אֶחָד וְשִׁבְעָה כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall bring forward an offering by fire, a burnt
offering to YHWH. You shall have two bulls of the cattle
and one ram and seven unblemished one-year-old lambs.

translation.text: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:

verses.english:
And you shall bring forward an offering by fire, a burnt
offering to YHWH. You shall have two bulls of the cattle
and one ram and seven unblemished one-year-old lambs.

verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָתָם סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאַיִל תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּמִנְחָתָם סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאַיִל תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
And their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with
oil. You shall do three tenths for a bull and two tenths
for a ram.

translation.text: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;

verses.english:
And their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with
oil. You shall do three tenths for a bull and two tenths
for a ram.

verses.hebrew: עִשָּׂרוֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן תַּעֲשֶׂה לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְשִׁבְעַת הַכְּבָשִׂים׃

hebrew.text: עִשָּׂרוֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן תַּעֲשֶׂה לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְשִׁבְעַת הַכְּבָשִׂים׃

english.text:
And you shall do one tenth for each lamb, for the seven
lambs.

translation.text: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

verses.english:
And you shall do one tenth for each lamb, for the seven
lambs.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׂעִיר חַטָּאת אֶחָד לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׂעִיר חַטָּאת אֶחָד לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
