verses.english:
“And if she vowed or made a restriction on herself by an
oath at her husband’s house,

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַע אִישָׁהּ וְהֶחֱרִשׁ לָהּ לֹא הֵנִיא אֹתָהּ וְקָמוּ כּל נְדָרֶיהָ וְכל אִסָּר אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל נַפְשָׁהּ יָקוּם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַע אִישָׁהּ וְהֶחֱרִשׁ לָהּ לֹא הֵנִיא אֹתָהּ וְקָמוּ כּל נְדָרֶיהָ וְכל אִסָּר אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל נַפְשָׁהּ יָקוּם׃

english.text:
and her husband heard it and kept quiet to her—he did not
hold her back—then all her vows shall stand, and every
restriction that she made on herself shall stand.

translation.text: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the LORD shall forgive her.

verses.english:
and her husband heard it and kept quiet to her—he did not
hold her back—then all her vows shall stand, and every
restriction that she made on herself shall stand.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם הָפֵר יָפֵר אֹתָם אִישָׁהּ בְּיוֹם שׁמְעוֹ כּל מוֹצָא שְׂפָתֶיהָ לִנְדָרֶיהָ וּלְאִסַּר נַפְשָׁהּ לֹא יָקוּם אִישָׁהּ הֲפֵרָם וַיהֹוָה יִסְלַח לָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם הָפֵר יָפֵר אֹתָם אִישָׁהּ בְּיוֹם שׁמְעוֹ כּל מוֹצָא שְׂפָתֶיהָ לִנְדָרֶיהָ וּלְאִסַּר נַפְשָׁהּ לֹא יָקוּם אִישָׁהּ הֲפֵרָם וַיהֹוָה יִסְלַח לָהּ׃

english.text:
But if her husband broke them on the day he heard all that
came out of her lips for her vows and for restricting
herself, it shall not stand. Her husband had broken them,
and YHWH will forgive her.

translation.text: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

verses.english:
But if her husband broke them on the day he heard all that
came out of her lips for her vows and for restricting
herself, it shall not stand. Her husband had broken them,
and YHWH will forgive her.

verses.hebrew: כּל נֵדֶר וְכל שְׁבֻעַת אִסָּר לְעַנֹּת נָפֶשׁ אִישָׁהּ יְקִימֶנּוּ וְאִישָׁהּ יְפֵרֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: כּל נֵדֶר וְכל שְׁבֻעַת אִסָּר לְעַנֹּת נָפֶשׁ אִישָׁהּ יְקִימֶנּוּ וְאִישָׁהּ יְפֵרֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
Every vow and every oath of restriction to degrade
oneself: her husband shall make it stand, and her husband
shall break it.

translation.text: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.

verses.english:
Every vow and every oath of restriction to degrade
oneself: her husband shall make it stand, and her husband
shall break it.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם הַחֲרֵשׁ יַחֲרִישׁ לָהּ אִישָׁהּ מִיּוֹם אֶל יוֹם וְהֵקִים אֶת כּל נְדָרֶיהָ אוֹ אֶת כּל אֱסָרֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר עָלֶיהָ הֵקִים אֹתָם כִּי הֶחֱרִשׁ לָהּ בְּיוֹם שׁמְעוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם הַחֲרֵשׁ יַחֲרִישׁ לָהּ אִישָׁהּ מִיּוֹם אֶל יוֹם וְהֵקִים אֶת כּל נְדָרֶיהָ אוֹ אֶת כּל אֱסָרֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר עָלֶיהָ הֵקִים אֹתָם כִּי הֶחֱרִשׁ לָהּ בְּיוֹם שׁמְעוֹ׃

english.text:
And if her husband will keep quiet in regard to her from
that day to the next, then he has made all her vows and
all her restrictions that are on her stand. He has made
them stand because he kept quiet to her on the day he
heard it.

translation.text: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.

verses.english:
And if her husband will keep quiet in regard to her from
that day to the next, then he has made all her vows and
all her restrictions that are on her stand. He has made
them stand because he kept quiet to her on the day he
heard it.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם הָפֵר יָפֵר אֹתָם אַחֲרֵי שׁמְעוֹ וְנָשָׂא אֶת עֲוֺנָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם הָפֵר יָפֵר אֹתָם אַחֲרֵי שׁמְעוֹ וְנָשָׂא אֶת עֲוֺנָהּ׃

english.text:
And if he will break them after he has heard them, then he
shall bear her crime.”

translation.text: These are the statutes, which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father’s house.

verses.english:
And if he will break them after he has heard them, then he
shall bear her crime.”

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַחֻקִּים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה בֵּין אִישׁ לְאִשְׁתּוֹ בֵּין אָב לְבִתּוֹ בִּנְעֻרֶיהָ בֵּית אָבִיהָ׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה הַחֻקִּים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה בֵּין אִישׁ לְאִשְׁתּוֹ בֵּין אָב לְבִתּוֹ בִּנְעֻרֶיהָ בֵּית אָבִיהָ׃

english.text:
These are the laws that YHWH commanded Moses between a man
and his wife, between a father and his daughter in her
youth at her father’s house.

verses.english:
These are the laws that YHWH commanded Moses between a man
and his wife, between a father and his daughter in her
youth at her father’s house.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: נְקֹם נִקְמַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֵת הַמִּדְיָנִים אַחַר תֵּאָסֵף אֶל עַמֶּיךָ׃

hebrew.text: נְקֹם נִקְמַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֵת הַמִּדְיָנִים אַחַר תֵּאָסֵף אֶל עַמֶּיךָ׃

english.text:
“Get revenge for the children of Israel from the
Midianites. After that you’ll be gathered to your people.”

translation.text: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.

verses.english:
“Get revenge for the children of Israel from the
Midianites. After that you’ll be gathered to your people.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעָם לֵאמֹר הֵחָלְצוּ מֵאִתְּכֶם אֲנָשִׁים לַצָּבָא וְיִהְיוּ עַל מִדְיָן לָתֵת נִקְמַת יְהֹוָה בְּמִדְיָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעָם לֵאמֹר הֵחָלְצוּ מֵאִתְּכֶם אֲנָשִׁים לַצָּבָא וְיִהְיוּ עַל מִדְיָן לָתֵת נִקְמַת יְהֹוָה בְּמִדְיָן׃

english.text:
And Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Let people from
you be equipped for the army, so they’ll be against Midian
to put YHWH’s revenge in Midian.

translation.text: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.

verses.english:
And Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Let people from
you be equipped for the army, so they’ll be against Midian
to put YHWH’s revenge in Midian.

verses.hebrew: אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה לְכֹל מַטּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל תִּשְׁלְחוּ לַצָּבָא׃

hebrew.text: אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה לְכֹל מַטּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל תִּשְׁלְחוּ לַצָּבָא׃

english.text:
You shall send a thousand per tribe, a thousand per tribe,
for all Israel’s tribes, to the army.”

translation.text: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.

verses.english:
You shall send a thousand per tribe, a thousand per tribe,
for all Israel’s tribes, to the army.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמָּסְרוּ מֵאַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֶלֶף חֲלוּצֵי צָבָא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמָּסְרוּ מֵאַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֶלֶף חֲלוּצֵי צָבָא׃

english.text:
And, from Israel’s thousands, a thousand per tribe were
delivered, twelve thousand equipped for the army.

translation.text: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

verses.english:
And, from Israel’s thousands, a thousand per tribe were
delivered, twelve thousand equipped for the army.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה לַצָּבָא אֹתָם וְאֶת פִּינְחָס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן לַצָּבָא וּכְלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וַחֲצֹצְרוֹת הַתְּרוּעָה בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה לַצָּבָא אֹתָם וְאֶת פִּינְחָס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן לַצָּבָא וּכְלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וַחֲצֹצְרוֹת הַתְּרוּעָה בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
And Moses sent them, a thousand per tribe, to the army;
them and Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, to the army,
with the equipment of the Holy and the trumpets for
blasting in his hand.

translation.text: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.

verses.english:
And Moses sent them, a thousand per tribe, to the army;
them and Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, to the army,
with the equipment of the Holy and the trumpets for
blasting in his hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְבְּאוּ עַל מִדְיָן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה וַיַּהַרְגוּ כּל זָכָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצְבְּאוּ עַל מִדְיָן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה וַיַּהַרְגוּ כּל זָכָר׃

english.text:
And they made war on Midian as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And they killed every male.

translation.text: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.

verses.english:
And they made war on Midian as YHWH had commanded Moses.
And they killed every male.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן הָרְגוּ עַל חַלְלֵיהֶם אֶת אֱוִי וְאֶת רֶקֶם וְאֶת צוּר וְאֶת חוּר וְאֶת רֶבַע חֲמֵשֶׁת מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן וְאֵת בִּלְעָם בֶּן בְּעוֹר הָרְגוּ בֶּחָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן הָרְגוּ עַל חַלְלֵיהֶם אֶת אֱוִי וְאֶת רֶקֶם וְאֶת צוּר וְאֶת חוּר וְאֶת רֶבַע חֲמֵשֶׁת מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן וְאֵת בִּלְעָם בֶּן בְּעוֹר הָרְגוּ בֶּחָרֶב׃

english.text:
And they killed the kings of Midian—Evi and Rekem and Zur
and Hur and Reba, the five kings of Midian—over their
corpses. And they killed Balaam son of Beor by the sword.

translation.text: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.

verses.english:
And they killed the kings of Midian—Evi and Rekem and Zur
and Hur and Reba, the five kings of Midian—over their
corpses. And they killed Balaam son of Beor by the sword.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁבּוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת נְשֵׁי מִדְיָן וְאֶת טַפָּם וְאֵת כּל בְּהֶמְתָּם וְאֶת כּל מִקְנֵהֶם וְאֶת כּל חֵילָם בָּזָזוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁבּוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת נְשֵׁי מִדְיָן וְאֶת טַפָּם וְאֵת כּל בְּהֶמְתָּם וְאֶת כּל מִקְנֵהֶם וְאֶת כּל חֵילָם בָּזָזוּ׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel took the women of Midian and
their infants prisoner, and they despoiled all their
animals and all their livestock and all their wealth.

translation.text: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel took the women of Midian and
their infants prisoner, and they despoiled all their
animals and all their livestock and all their wealth.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כּל עָרֵיהֶם בְּמוֹשְׁבֹתָם וְאֵת כּל טִירֹתָם שָׂרְפוּ בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת כּל עָרֵיהֶם בְּמוֹשְׁבֹתָם וְאֵת כּל טִירֹתָם שָׂרְפוּ בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
And they burned all their cities with their homes and all
their encampments in fire.

translation.text: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.

verses.english:
And they burned all their cities with their homes and all
their encampments in fire.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת כּל הַשָּׁלָל וְאֵת כּל הַמַּלְקוֹחַ בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת כּל הַשָּׁלָל וְאֵת כּל הַמַּלְקוֹחַ בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה׃

english.text:
And they took all the spoil and all the prey, human and
animal.

translation.text: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.

verses.english:
And they took all the spoil and all the prey, human and
animal.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבִאוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַשְּׁבִי וְאֶת הַמַּלְקוֹחַ וְאֶת הַשָּׁלָל אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה אֶל עַרְבֹת מוֹאָב אֲשֶׁר עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבִאוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַשְּׁבִי וְאֶת הַמַּלְקוֹחַ וְאֶת הַשָּׁלָל אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה אֶל עַרְבֹת מוֹאָב אֲשֶׁר עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

english.text:
And they brought the prisoners and the prey and the spoil
to Moses and to Eleazar, the priest, and to the
congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp, to
the plains of Moab, which is by the Jordan toward Jericho.

translation.text: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.

verses.english:
And they brought the prisoners and the prey and the spoil
to Moses and to Eleazar, the priest, and to the
congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp, to
the plains of Moab, which is by the Jordan toward Jericho.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְכל נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה לִקְרָאתָם אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְכל נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה לִקְרָאתָם אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, and all the
congregation’s chieftains went out to them, outside the
camp.

translation.text: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.

verses.english:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, and all the
congregation’s chieftains went out to them, outside the
camp.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְצֹף מֹשֶׁה עַל פְּקוּדֵי הֶחָיִל שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת הַבָּאִים מִצְּבָא הַמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְצֹף מֹשֶׁה עַל פְּקוּדֵי הֶחָיִל שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת הַבָּאִים מִצְּבָא הַמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
And Moses was angry at the officers of the army, the
chiefs of thousands and the chiefs of hundreds who were
coming from the army of the war.

translation.text: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.

verses.english:
And Moses was angry at the officers of the army, the
chiefs of thousands and the chiefs of hundreds who were
coming from the army of the war.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מֹשֶׁה הַחִיִּיתֶם כּל נְקֵבָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מֹשֶׁה הַחִיִּיתֶם כּל נְקֵבָה׃

english.text: And Moses said to them, “Did you keep every female alive?!

translation.text: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?

verses.english: And Moses said to them, “Did you keep every female alive?!

verses.hebrew: הֵן הֵנָּה הָיוּ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּדְבַר בִּלְעָם לִמְסר מַעַל בַּיהֹוָה עַל דְּבַר פְּעוֹר וַתְּהִי הַמַּגֵּפָה בַּעֲדַת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: הֵן הֵנָּה הָיוּ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּדְבַר בִּלְעָם לִמְסר מַעַל בַּיהֹוָה עַל דְּבַר פְּעוֹר וַתְּהִי הַמַּגֵּפָה בַּעֲדַת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Here, they came to bring about a breach against YHWH by
the children of Israel, at Balaam’s word, over the matter
of Peor, so there was the plague in YHWH’s congregation!

translation.text: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD.

verses.english:
Here, they came to bring about a breach against YHWH by
the children of Israel, at Balaam’s word, over the matter
of Peor, so there was the plague in YHWH’s congregation!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִרְגוּ כל זָכָר בַּטָּף וְכל אִשָּׁה יֹדַעַת אִישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּב זָכָר הֲרֹגוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִרְגוּ כל זָכָר בַּטָּף וְכל אִשָּׁה יֹדַעַת אִישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּב זָכָר הֲרֹגוּ׃

english.text:
So now, kill every male among the infants, and kill every
woman who has known a man for male intercourse.

translation.text: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.

verses.english:
So now, kill every male among the infants, and kill every
woman who has known a man for male intercourse.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל הַטַּף בַּנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ מִשְׁכַּב זָכָר הַחֲיוּ לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל הַטַּף בַּנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ מִשְׁכַּב זָכָר הַחֲיוּ לָכֶם׃

english.text:
But all infants among the women who have not known a
male’s inter-course: keep alive.

translation.text: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

verses.english:
But all infants among the women who have not known a
male’s inter-course: keep alive.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם חֲנוּ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים כֹּל הֹרֵג נֶפֶשׁ וְכֹל נֹגֵעַ בֶּחָלָל תִּתְחַטְּאוּ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי אַתֶּם וּשְׁבִיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם חֲנוּ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים כֹּל הֹרֵג נֶפֶשׁ וְכֹל נֹגֵעַ בֶּחָלָל תִּתְחַטְּאוּ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי אַתֶּם וּשְׁבִיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you, camp outside the camp for seven days: everyone
who killed a life and everyone who touched a corpse, do
sin expiation on the third day and on the seventh day, you
and your prisoners.

translation.text: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.

verses.english:
And you, camp outside the camp for seven days: everyone
who killed a life and everyone who touched a corpse, do
sin expiation on the third day and on the seventh day, you
and your prisoners.

verses.hebrew: וְכל בֶּגֶד וְכל כְּלִי עוֹר וְכל מַעֲשֵׂה עִזִּים וְכל כְּלִי עֵץ תִּתְחַטָּאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל בֶּגֶד וְכל כְּלִי עוֹר וְכל מַעֲשֵׂה עִזִּים וְכל כְּלִי עֵץ תִּתְחַטָּאוּ׃

english.text:
And for every piece of clothing and every leather item and
everything made from goats and every wood item you shall
do expiation.”

translation.text: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.

verses.english:
And for every piece of clothing and every leather item and
everything made from goats and every wood item you shall
do expiation.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶל אַנְשֵׁי הַצָּבָא הַבָּאִים לַמִּלְחָמָה זֹאת חֻקַּת הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶל אַנְשֵׁי הַצָּבָא הַבָּאִים לַמִּלְחָמָה זֹאת חֻקַּת הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Eleazar, the priest, said to the men of the army who
had come to the war, “This is the law of the instruction
that YHWH commanded Moses:

translation.text: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;

verses.english:
And Eleazar, the priest, said to the men of the army who
had come to the war, “This is the law of the instruction
that YHWH commanded Moses:

verses.hebrew: אַךְ אֶת הַזָּהָב וְאֶת הַכָּסֶף אֶת הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֶת הַבַּרְזֶל אֶת הַבְּדִיל וְאֶת הָעֹפָרֶת׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ אֶת הַזָּהָב וְאֶת הַכָּסֶף אֶת הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֶת הַבַּרְזֶל אֶת הַבְּדִיל וְאֶת הָעֹפָרֶת׃

english.text:
Just the gold and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the
tin, and the lead,

translation.text: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

verses.english:
Just the gold and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the
tin, and the lead,

verses.hebrew: כּל דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יָבֹא בָאֵשׁ תַּעֲבִירוּ בָאֵשׁ וְטָהֵר אַךְ בְּמֵי נִדָּה יִתְחַטָּא וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָבֹא בָּאֵשׁ תַּעֲבִירוּ בַמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: כּל דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יָבֹא בָאֵשׁ תַּעֲבִירוּ בָאֵשׁ וְטָהֵר אַךְ בְּמֵי נִדָּה יִתְחַטָּא וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָבֹא בָּאֵשׁ תַּעֲבִירוּ בַמָּיִם׃

english.text:
every thing that will go in fire, you shall pass through
fire and purify. It shall be expiated from sin just in
water of impurity. And everything that will not go in
fire, you shall pass through water.

translation.text: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.

verses.english:
every thing that will go in fire, you shall pass through
fire and purify. It shall be expiated from sin just in
water of impurity. And everything that will not go in
fire, you shall pass through water.

verses.hebrew: וְכִבַּסְתֶּם בִּגְדֵיכֶם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וּטְהַרְתֶּם וְאַחַר תָּבֹאוּ אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְכִבַּסְתֶּם בִּגְדֵיכֶם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וּטְהַרְתֶּם וְאַחַר תָּבֹאוּ אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And you shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and
you will be pure, and after that you shall come to the
camp.”

translation.text: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.

verses.english:
And you shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and
you will be pure, and after that you shall come to the
camp.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH said to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH said to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: שָׂא אֵת רֹאשׁ מַלְקוֹחַ הַשְּׁבִי בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה אַתָּה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְרָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: שָׂא אֵת רֹאשׁ מַלְקוֹחַ הַשְּׁבִי בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה אַתָּה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְרָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
“Add up the heads of the prey, the prisoners, human and
animal, you and Eleazar, the priest, and the heads of the
fathers of the congregation.

translation.text: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:

verses.english:
“Add up the heads of the prey, the prisoners, human and
animal, you and Eleazar, the priest, and the heads of the
fathers of the congregation.

verses.hebrew: וְחָצִיתָ אֶת הַמַּלְקוֹחַ בֵּין תֹּפְשֵׂי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַיֹּצְאִים לַצָּבָא וּבֵין כּל הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְחָצִיתָ אֶת הַמַּלְקוֹחַ בֵּין תֹּפְשֵׂי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַיֹּצְאִים לַצָּבָא וּבֵין כּל הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
And you shall split the prey between the warriors who went
out to the army and all the congregation.

translation.text: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:

verses.english:
And you shall split the prey between the warriors who went
out to the army and all the congregation.

verses.hebrew: וַהֲרֵמֹתָ מֶכֶס לַיהֹוָה מֵאֵת אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַיֹּצְאִים לַצָּבָא אֶחָד נֶפֶשׁ מֵחֲמֵשׁ הַמֵּאוֹת מִן הָאָדָם וּמִן הַבָּקָר וּמִן הַחֲמֹרִים וּמִן הַצֹּאן׃

hebrew.text: וַהֲרֵמֹתָ מֶכֶס לַיהֹוָה מֵאֵת אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַיֹּצְאִים לַצָּבָא אֶחָד נֶפֶשׁ מֵחֲמֵשׁ הַמֵּאוֹת מִן הָאָדָם וּמִן הַבָּקָר וּמִן הַחֲמֹרִים וּמִן הַצֹּאן׃

english.text:
And you shall levy a tax for YHWH from the men of war who
went out to the army, one individual out of five hundred,
from humans and from cattle and from asses and from sheep.

translation.text: And levy a tribute unto the Lord of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:

verses.english:
And you shall levy a tax for YHWH from the men of war who
went out to the army, one individual out of five hundred,
from humans and from cattle and from asses and from sheep.

verses.hebrew: מִמַּחֲצִיתָם תִּקָּחוּ וְנָתַתָּה לְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: מִמַּחֲצִיתָם תִּקָּחוּ וְנָתַתָּה לְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall take from their half and you shall give to
Eleazar, the priest, YHWH’s donation.

translation.text: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the LORD.

verses.english:
You shall take from their half and you shall give to
Eleazar, the priest, YHWH’s donation.

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּחֲצִת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תִּקַּח אֶחָד אָחֻז מִן הַחֲמִשִּׁים מִן הָאָדָם מִן הַבָּקָר מִן הַחֲמֹרִים וּמִן הַצֹּאן מִכּל הַבְּהֵמָה וְנָתַתָּה אֹתָם לַלְוִיִּם שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּמִמַּחֲצִת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תִּקַּח אֶחָד אָחֻז מִן הַחֲמִשִּׁים מִן הָאָדָם מִן הַבָּקָר מִן הַחֲמֹרִים וּמִן הַצֹּאן מִכּל הַבְּהֵמָה וְנָתַתָּה אֹתָם לַלְוִיִּם שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
From the half of the children of Israel you shall take one
share out of fifty, from humans, from cattle, from asses,
and from sheep, from all the animals, and you shall give
them to the Levites, who keep the watch of YHWH’s
Tabernacle.”

translation.text: And of the children of Israel’s half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.

verses.english:
From the half of the children of Israel you shall take one
share out of fifty, from humans, from cattle, from asses,
and from sheep, from all the animals, and you shall give
them to the Levites, who keep the watch of YHWH’s
Tabernacle.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, did as YHWH commanded
Moses.

translation.text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, did as YHWH commanded
Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַמַּלְקוֹחַ יֶתֶר הַבָּז אֲשֶׁר בָּזְזוּ עַם הַצָּבָא צֹאן שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וְשִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הַמַּלְקוֹחַ יֶתֶר הַבָּז אֲשֶׁר בָּזְזוּ עַם הַצָּבָא צֹאן שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וְשִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים׃

english.text:
And the prey, over and above the spoil that the people of
the army had taken, was: six hundred seventy-five thousand
sheep

verses.english:
And the prey, over and above the spoil that the people of
the army had taken, was: six hundred seventy-five thousand
sheep

english.text: and seventy-two thousand cattle

translation.text: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,

verses.english: and seventy-two thousand cattle

hebrew.text: וַחֲמֹרִים אֶחָד וְשִׁשִּׁים אָלֶף׃

english.text: and sixty-one thousand asses

translation.text: And threescore and one thousand asses,

verses.english: and sixty-one thousand asses

verses.hebrew: וְנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם מִן הַנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ מִשְׁכַּב זָכָר כּל נֶפֶשׁ שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף׃

hebrew.text: וְנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם מִן הַנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ מִשְׁכַּב זָכָר כּל נֶפֶשׁ שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף׃

english.text:
and human beings—from the women who had not known male
intercourse—all the persons were thirty-two thousand.

translation.text: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.

verses.english:
and human beings—from the women who had not known male
intercourse—all the persons were thirty-two thousand.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי הַמֶּחֱצָה חֵלֶק הַיֹּצְאִים בַּצָּבָא מִסְפַּר הַצֹּאן שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וְשִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי הַמֶּחֱצָה חֵלֶק הַיֹּצְאִים בַּצָּבָא מִסְפַּר הַצֹּאן שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וְשִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
So the half, the portion of those who went out in the army
was: the number of sheep was three hundred thirty-seven
thousand five hundred.

translation.text: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:

verses.english:
So the half, the portion of those who went out in the army
was: the number of sheep was three hundred thirty-seven
thousand five hundred.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַמֶּכֶס לַיהֹוָה מִן הַצֹּאן שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת חָמֵשׁ וְשִׁבְעִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הַמֶּכֶס לַיהֹוָה מִן הַצֹּאן שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת חָמֵשׁ וְשִׁבְעִים׃

english.text:
And the tax for YHWH from the sheep was six hundred
seventy-five.

translation.text: And the LORD’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.

verses.english:
And the tax for YHWH from the sheep was six hundred
seventy-five.

verses.hebrew: וְהַבָּקָר שִׁשָּׁה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף וּמִכְסָם לַיהֹוָה שְׁנַיִם וְשִׁבְעִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבָּקָר שִׁשָּׁה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף וּמִכְסָם לַיהֹוָה שְׁנַיִם וְשִׁבְעִים׃

english.text:
And the cattle were thirty-six thousand, and their tax for
YHWH was seventy-two.

translation.text: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD’s tribute was threescore and twelve.

verses.english:
And the cattle were thirty-six thousand, and their tax for
YHWH was seventy-two.

verses.hebrew: וַחֲמֹרִים שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וּמִכְסָם לַיהֹוָה אֶחָד וְשִׁשִּׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַחֲמֹרִים שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וּמִכְסָם לַיהֹוָה אֶחָד וְשִׁשִּׁים׃

english.text:
And asses were thirty thousand five hundred, and their tax
for YHWH was sixty-one.

translation.text: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD’s tribute was threescore and one.

verses.english:
And asses were thirty thousand five hundred, and their tax
for YHWH was sixty-one.

verses.hebrew: וְנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר אָלֶף וּמִכְסָם לַיהֹוָה שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים נָפֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר אָלֶף וּמִכְסָם לַיהֹוָה שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים נָפֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And human beings were sixteen thousand, and their tax for
YHWH was thirty-two persons.

translation.text: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the LORD’s tribute was thirty and two persons.

verses.english:
And human beings were sixteen thousand, and their tax for
YHWH was thirty-two persons.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה אֶת מֶכֶס תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה לְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה אֶת מֶכֶס תְּרוּמַת יְהֹוָה לְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Moses gave the tax, a donation for YHWH, to Eleazar,
the priest, as YHWH commanded Moses.

translation.text: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD’s heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And Moses gave the tax, a donation for YHWH, to Eleazar,
the priest, as YHWH commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּחֲצִית בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר חָצָה מֹשֶׁה מִן הָאֲנָשִׁים הַצֹּבְאִים׃

hebrew.text: וּמִמַּחֲצִית בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר חָצָה מֹשֶׁה מִן הָאֲנָשִׁים הַצֹּבְאִים׃

english.text:
And of the half for the children of Israel, which Moses
had split from the people who were serving in the army:

translation.text: And of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,

verses.english:
And of the half for the children of Israel, which Moses
had split from the people who were serving in the army:

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי מֶחֱצַת הָעֵדָה מִן הַצֹּאן שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי מֶחֱצַת הָעֵדָה מִן הַצֹּאן שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
and the congregation’s half of the sheep was three hundred
thirty-seven thousand five hundred.

translation.text: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,

verses.english:
and the congregation’s half of the sheep was three hundred
thirty-seven thousand five hundred.

verses.hebrew: וּבָקָר שִׁשָּׁה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף׃

hebrew.text: וּבָקָר שִׁשָּׁה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף׃

english.text: And the cattle were thirty-six thousand.

translation.text: And thirty and six thousand beeves,

verses.english: And the cattle were thirty-six thousand.

verses.hebrew: וַחֲמֹרִים שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַחֲמֹרִים שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

english.text: And asses were thirty thousand five hundred.

translation.text: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,

verses.english: And asses were thirty thousand five hundred.

verses.hebrew: וְנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר אָלֶף׃

hebrew.text: וְנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר אָלֶף׃

english.text: And human beings were sixteen thousand.

translation.text: And sixteen thousand persons;)

verses.english: And human beings were sixteen thousand.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה מִמַּחֲצִת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הָאָחֻז אֶחָד מִן הַחֲמִשִּׁים מִן הָאָדָם וּמִן הַבְּהֵמָה וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָם לַלְוִיִּם שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה מִמַּחֲצִת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הָאָחֻז אֶחָד מִן הַחֲמִשִּׁים מִן הָאָדָם וּמִן הַבְּהֵמָה וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָם לַלְוִיִּם שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Moses took from the half of the children of Israel one
share out of fifty, from humans and from animals, and gave
them to the Levites, who kept the watch of YHWH’s
Tabernacle, as YHWH commanded Moses.

translation.text: Even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And Moses took from the half of the children of Israel one
share out of fifty, from humans and from animals, and gave
them to the Levites, who kept the watch of YHWH’s
Tabernacle, as YHWH commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְבוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה הַפְּקֻדִים אֲשֶׁר לְאַלְפֵי הַצָּבָא שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְבוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה הַפְּקֻדִים אֲשֶׁר לְאַלְפֵי הַצָּבָא שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת׃

english.text:
And the officers who were over the thousands of the army
came forward to Moses, the chiefs of the thousands and the
chiefs of the hundreds.

translation.text: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:

verses.english:
And the officers who were over the thousands of the army
came forward to Moses, the chiefs of the thousands and the
chiefs of the hundreds.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה עֲבָדֶיךָ נָשְׂאוּ אֶת רֹאשׁ אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדֵנוּ וְלֹא נִפְקַד מִמֶּנּוּ אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה עֲבָדֶיךָ נָשְׂאוּ אֶת רֹאשׁ אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדֵנוּ וְלֹא נִפְקַד מִמֶּנּוּ אִישׁ׃

english.text:
And they said to Moses, “Your servants have added up the
heads of the men of war who are in our hands, and not a
man of them is lacking.

translation.text: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.

verses.english:
And they said to Moses, “Your servants have added up the
heads of the men of war who are in our hands, and not a
man of them is lacking.

verses.hebrew: וַנַּקְרֵב אֶת קרְבַּן יְהֹוָה אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר מָצָא כְלִי זָהָב אֶצְעָדָה וְצָמִיד טַבַּעַת עָגִיל וְכוּמָז לְכַפֵּר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵינוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַנַּקְרֵב אֶת קרְבַּן יְהֹוָה אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר מָצָא כְלִי זָהָב אֶצְעָדָה וְצָמִיד טַבַּעַת עָגִיל וְכוּמָז לְכַפֵּר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵינוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And we have made an offering for YHWH—whatever each man
found: an item of gold, an armlet or bracelet, a ring, an
earring, or an ornament—to make atonement for ourselves in
front of YHWH.”

translation.text: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.

verses.english:
And we have made an offering for YHWH—whatever each man
found: an item of gold, an armlet or bracelet, a ring, an
earring, or an ornament—to make atonement for ourselves in
front of YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַזָּהָב מֵאִתָּם כֹּל כְּלִי מַעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַזָּהָב מֵאִתָּם כֹּל כְּלִי מַעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, took the gold from
them, every item of handiwork.

translation.text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.

verses.english:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, took the gold from
them, every item of handiwork.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כּל זְהַב הַתְּרוּמָה אֲשֶׁר הֵרִימוּ לַיהֹוָה שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר אֶלֶף שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁקֶל מֵאֵת שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וּמֵאֵת שָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כּל זְהַב הַתְּרוּמָה אֲשֶׁר הֵרִימוּ לַיהֹוָה שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר אֶלֶף שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁקֶל מֵאֵת שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וּמֵאֵת שָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת׃

english.text:
And all the gold of the donation that they donated to YHWH
was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels, from the
chiefs of the thousands and from the chiefs of the
hundreds.

translation.text: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.

verses.english:
And all the gold of the donation that they donated to YHWH
was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels, from the
chiefs of the thousands and from the chiefs of the
hundreds.

verses.hebrew: אַנְשֵׁי הַצָּבָא בָּזְזוּ אִישׁ לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אַנְשֵׁי הַצָּבָא בָּזְזוּ אִישׁ לוֹ׃

english.text: The men of the army each had kept as spoil what was his.

translation.text: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)

verses.english: The men of the army each had kept as spoil what was his.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַזָּהָב מֵאֵת שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְהַמֵּאוֹת וַיָּבִאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד זִכָּרוֹן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַזָּהָב מֵאֵת שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְהַמֵּאוֹת וַיָּבִאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד זִכָּרוֹן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, took the gold from the
chiefs of the thousands and the hundreds and brought it to
the Tent of Meeting, a commemoration for the children of
Israel in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.

verses.english:
And Moses and Eleazar, the priest, took the gold from the
chiefs of the thousands and the hundreds and brought it to
the Tent of Meeting, a commemoration for the children of
Israel in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וּמִקְנֶה רַב הָיָה לִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן וְלִבְנֵי גָד עָצוּם מְאֹד וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת אֶרֶץ יַעְזֵר וְאֶת אֶרֶץ גִּלְעָד וְהִנֵּה הַמָּקוֹם מְקוֹם מִקְנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וּמִקְנֶה רַב הָיָה לִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן וְלִבְנֵי גָד עָצוּם מְאֹד וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת אֶרֶץ יַעְזֵר וְאֶת אֶרֶץ גִּלְעָד וְהִנֵּה הַמָּקוֹם מְקוֹם מִקְנֶה׃

english.text:
And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had
a great amount of livestock, very substantial. And they
saw the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead, and here:
the place was a place for livestock.

translation.text: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;

verses.english:
And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had
a great amount of livestock, very substantial. And they
saw the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead, and here:
the place was a place for livestock.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ בְנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶל נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ בְנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶל נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came
and said to Moses and to Eleazar, the priest, and to the
chieftains of the congregation, saying,

translation.text: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,

verses.english:
And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came
and said to Moses and to Eleazar, the priest, and to the
chieftains of the congregation, saying,

verses.hebrew: עֲטָרוֹת וְדִיבֹן וְיַעְזֵר וְנִמְרָה וְחֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶלְעָלֵה וּשְׂבָם וּנְבוֹ וּבְעֹן׃

hebrew.text: עֲטָרוֹת וְדִיבֹן וְיַעְזֵר וְנִמְרָה וְחֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶלְעָלֵה וּשְׂבָם וּנְבוֹ וּבְעֹן׃

english.text:
“Ataroth and Dibon and Jazer and Nimrah and Heshbon and
Elealeh and Sebam and Nebo and Beon,

translation.text: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

verses.english:
“Ataroth and Dibon and Jazer and Nimrah and Heshbon and
Elealeh and Sebam and Nebo and Beon,

verses.hebrew: הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵי עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶרֶץ מִקְנֶה הִוא וְלַעֲבָדֶיךָ מִקְנֶה׃

hebrew.text: הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵי עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶרֶץ מִקְנֶה הִוא וְלַעֲבָדֶיךָ מִקְנֶה׃

english.text:
the land that YHWH struck in front of the congregation of
Israel: it’s livestock land, and your servants have
livestock.”

translation.text: Even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:

verses.english:
the land that YHWH struck in front of the congregation of
Israel: it’s livestock land, and your servants have
livestock.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִם מָצָאנוּ חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ יֻתַּן אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לַעֲבָדֶיךָ לַאֲחֻזָּה אַל תַּעֲבִרֵנוּ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִם מָצָאנוּ חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ יֻתַּן אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לַעֲבָדֶיךָ לַאֲחֻזָּה אַל תַּעֲבִרֵנוּ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
And they said, “If we’ve found favor in your eyes, let
this land be given to your servants for a possession.
Don’t have us cross the Jordan.”

translation.text: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.

verses.english:
And they said, “If we’ve found favor in your eyes, let
this land be given to your servants for a possession.
Don’t have us cross the Jordan.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לִבְנֵי גָד וְלִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן הַאַחֵיכֶם יָבֹאוּ לַמִּלְחָמָה וְאַתֶּם תֵּשְׁבוּ פֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לִבְנֵי גָד וְלִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן הַאַחֵיכֶם יָבֹאוּ לַמִּלְחָמָה וְאַתֶּם תֵּשְׁבוּ פֹה׃

english.text:
And Moses said to the children of Gad and to the children
of Reuben, “Will your brothers go to war while you sit
here?!

translation.text: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?

verses.english:
And Moses said to the children of Gad and to the children
of Reuben, “Will your brothers go to war while you sit
here?!

verses.hebrew: וְלָמָּה (תנואון) [תְנִיאוּן] אֶת לֵב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעֲבֹר אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלָמָּה (תנואון) [תְנִיאוּן] אֶת לֵב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעֲבֹר אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And why do you hold back the heart of the children of
Israel from crossing to the land that YHWH has given them?

translation.text: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?

verses.english:
And why do you hold back the heart of the children of
Israel from crossing to the land that YHWH has given them?

verses.hebrew: כֹּה עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתֵיכֶם בְּשׁלְחִי אֹתָם מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ לִרְאוֹת אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: כֹּה עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתֵיכֶם בְּשׁלְחִי אֹתָם מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ לִרְאוֹת אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
That’s what your fathers did when I sent them from
Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

translation.text: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land.

verses.english:
That’s what your fathers did when I sent them from
Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ עַד נַחַל אֶשְׁכּוֹל וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ וַיָּנִיאוּ אֶת לֵב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבִלְתִּי בֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ עַד נַחַל אֶשְׁכּוֹל וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ וַיָּנִיאוּ אֶת לֵב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבִלְתִּי בֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And they went up to the Wadi Eshcol and saw the land, but
they held back the heart of the children of Israel so as
not to go to the land that YHWH had given them.

translation.text: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.

verses.english:
And they went up to the Wadi Eshcol and saw the land, but
they held back the heart of the children of Israel so as
not to go to the land that YHWH had given them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּשָּׁבַע לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּשָּׁבַע לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH’s anger flared on that day, and he swore saying,

translation.text: And the LORD’s anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH’s anger flared on that day, and he swore saying,

verses.hebrew: אִם יִרְאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים הָעֹלִים מִמִּצְרַיִם מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה אֵת הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב כִּי לֹא מִלְאוּ אַחֲרָי׃

hebrew.text: אִם יִרְאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים הָעֹלִים מִמִּצְרַיִם מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה אֵת הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב כִּי לֹא מִלְאוּ אַחֲרָי׃

english.text:
‘The people who came up from Egypt, from twenty years old
and up, won’t see the land that I swore to Abraham, to
Isaac, and to Jacob, because they didn’t go after me
completely,

translation.text: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:

verses.english:
‘The people who came up from Egypt, from twenty years old
and up, won’t see the land that I swore to Abraham, to
Isaac, and to Jacob, because they didn’t go after me
completely,

verses.hebrew: בִּלְתִּי כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה הַקְּנִזִּי וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן כִּי מִלְאוּ אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּלְתִּי כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה הַקְּנִזִּי וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן כִּי מִלְאוּ אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
except Caleb son of Jephunneh, the Kenizzite, and Joshua
son of Nun because they went after YHWH completely.’

translation.text: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.

verses.english:
except Caleb son of Jephunneh, the Kenizzite, and Joshua
son of Nun because they went after YHWH completely.’

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְנִעֵם בַּמִּדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה עַד תֹּם כּל הַדּוֹר הָעֹשֶׂה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְנִעֵם בַּמִּדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה עַד תֹּם כּל הַדּוֹר הָעֹשֶׂה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And YHWH’s anger flared at Israel, and he made them roam
in the wilderness forty years, until the end of all the
generation who were doing bad in YHWH’s eyes.

translation.text: And the LORD’s anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.

verses.english:
And YHWH’s anger flared at Israel, and he made them roam
in the wilderness forty years, until the end of all the
generation who were doing bad in YHWH’s eyes.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה קַמְתֶּם תַּחַת אֲבֹתֵיכֶם תַּרְבּוּת אֲנָשִׁים חַטָּאִים לִסְפּוֹת עוֹד עַל חֲרוֹן אַף יְהֹוָה אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה קַמְתֶּם תַּחַת אֲבֹתֵיכֶם תַּרְבּוּת אֲנָשִׁים חַטָּאִים לִסְפּוֹת עוֹד עַל חֲרוֹן אַף יְהֹוָה אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And, here, you’ve gotten up in your fathers’ place, a
group of sinning people, to add more onto YHWH’s flaring
anger at Israel.

translation.text: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers’ stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.

verses.english:
And, here, you’ve gotten up in your fathers’ place, a
group of sinning people, to add more onto YHWH’s flaring
anger at Israel.

verses.hebrew: כִּי תְשׁוּבֻן מֵאַחֲרָיו וְיָסַף עוֹד לְהַנִּיחוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר וְשִׁחַתֶּם לְכל הָעָם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תְשׁוּבֻן מֵאַחֲרָיו וְיָסַף עוֹד לְהַנִּיחוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר וְשִׁחַתֶּם לְכל הָעָם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
If you go back from behind Him, then He’ll add more to
leave them in the wilderness, and you’ll have destroyed
all of this people!”

translation.text: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.

verses.english:
If you go back from behind Him, then He’ll add more to
leave them in the wilderness, and you’ll have destroyed
all of this people!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ גִּדְרֹת צֹאן נִבְנֶה לְמִקְנֵנוּ פֹּה וְעָרִים לְטַפֵּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ גִּדְרֹת צֹאן נִבְנֶה לְמִקְנֵנוּ פֹּה וְעָרִים לְטַפֵּנוּ׃

english.text:
And they came over to him and said, “We’ll build walls for
our livestock here, and cities for our infants.

translation.text: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:

verses.english:
And they came over to him and said, “We’ll build walls for
our livestock here, and cities for our infants.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנַחְנוּ נֵחָלֵץ חֻשִׁים לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד אֲשֶׁר אִם הֲבִיאֹנֻם אֶל מְקוֹמָם וְיָשַׁב טַפֵּנוּ בְּעָרֵי הַמִּבְצָר מִפְּנֵי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנַחְנוּ נֵחָלֵץ חֻשִׁים לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד אֲשֶׁר אִם הֲבִיאֹנֻם אֶל מְקוֹמָם וְיָשַׁב טַפֵּנוּ בְּעָרֵי הַמִּבְצָר מִפְּנֵי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And we shall be equipped, ready in front of the children
of Israel until we’ve brought them to their place, and our
infants will live in fortified cities because of the
residents of the land.

translation.text: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

verses.english:
And we shall be equipped, ready in front of the children
of Israel until we’ve brought them to their place, and our
infants will live in fortified cities because of the
residents of the land.

verses.hebrew: לֹא נָשׁוּב אֶל בָּתֵּינוּ עַד הִתְנַחֵל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ נַחֲלָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא נָשׁוּב אֶל בָּתֵּינוּ עַד הִתְנַחֵל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ נַחֲלָתוֹ׃

english.text:
We won’t go back to our houses until the children of
Israel take possession, each of his legacy.

translation.text: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

verses.english:
We won’t go back to our houses until the children of
Israel take possession, each of his legacy.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא נִנְחַל אִתָּם מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וָהָלְאָה כִּי בָאָה נַחֲלָתֵנוּ אֵלֵינוּ מֵעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא נִנְחַל אִתָּם מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וָהָלְאָה כִּי בָאָה נַחֲלָתֵנוּ אֵלֵינוּ מֵעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה׃

english.text:
Because we won’t have a possession with them from the
farther side of the Jordan, because our possession has
come to us from the eastward side of the Jordan.”

translation.text: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.

verses.english:
Because we won’t have a possession with them from the
farther side of the Jordan, because our possession has
come to us from the eastward side of the Jordan.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מֹשֶׁה אִם תַּעֲשׂוּן אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אִם תֵּחָלְצוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לַמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מֹשֶׁה אִם תַּעֲשׂוּן אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אִם תֵּחָלְצוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לַמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
And Moses said to them, “If you’ll do this thing: if
you’ll get equipped for war in front of YHWH,

translation.text: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,

verses.english:
And Moses said to them, “If you’ll do this thing: if
you’ll get equipped for war in front of YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וְעָבַר לָכֶם כּל חָלוּץ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַד הוֹרִישׁוֹ אֶת אֹיְבָיו מִפָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְעָבַר לָכֶם כּל חָלוּץ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַד הוֹרִישׁוֹ אֶת אֹיְבָיו מִפָּנָיו׃

english.text:
and every one of you will cross the Jordan equipped in
front of YHWH until He dispossesses his enemies in front
of him,

translation.text: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,

verses.english:
and every one of you will cross the Jordan equipped in
front of YHWH until He dispossesses his enemies in front
of him,

verses.hebrew: וְנִכְבְּשָׁה הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְאַחַר תָּשֻׁבוּ וִהְיִיתֶם נְקִיִּם מֵיְהֹוָה וּמִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיְתָה הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לָכֶם לַאֲחֻזָּה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנִכְבְּשָׁה הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְאַחַר תָּשֻׁבוּ וִהְיִיתֶם נְקִיִּם מֵיְהֹוָה וּמִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיְתָה הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לָכֶם לַאֲחֻזָּה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and the land will be subdued in front of YHWH, then, after
that, you’ll go back, and, from YHWH and from Israel,
you’ll be free, and this land will become yours for a
possession in front of YHWH.

translation.text: And the land be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

verses.english:
and the land will be subdued in front of YHWH, then, after
that, you’ll go back, and, from YHWH and from Israel,
you’ll be free, and this land will become yours for a
possession in front of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא תַעֲשׂוּן כֵּן הִנֵּה חֲטָאתֶם לַיהֹוָה וּדְעוּ חַטַּאתְכֶם אֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא תַעֲשׂוּן כֵּן הִנֵּה חֲטָאתֶם לַיהֹוָה וּדְעוּ חַטַּאתְכֶם אֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
But if you won’t do this, here, you’ve sinned to YHWH, and
know that your sin will find you.

translation.text: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.

verses.english:
But if you won’t do this, here, you’ve sinned to YHWH, and
know that your sin will find you.

verses.hebrew: בְּנוּ לָכֶם עָרִים לְטַפְּכֶם וּגְדֵרֹת לְצֹנַאֲכֶם וְהַיֹּצֵא מִפִּיכֶם תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: בְּנוּ לָכֶם עָרִים לְטַפְּכֶם וּגְדֵרֹת לְצֹנַאֲכֶם וְהַיֹּצֵא מִפִּיכֶם תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
Build cities for your infants and fences for your flocks,
and do what has come out of your mouths.”

translation.text: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.

verses.english:
Build cities for your infants and fences for your flocks,
and do what has come out of your mouths.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בְּנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵאמֹר עֲבָדֶיךָ יַעֲשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲדֹנִי מְצַוֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בְּנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵאמֹר עֲבָדֶיךָ יַעֲשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲדֹנִי מְצַוֶּה׃

english.text:
And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben said to
Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.

translation.text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.

verses.english:
And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben said to
Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.

verses.hebrew: טַפֵּנוּ נָשֵׁינוּ מִקְנֵנוּ וְכל בְּהֶמְתֵּנוּ יִהְיוּ שָׁם בְּעָרֵי הַגִּלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: טַפֵּנוּ נָשֵׁינוּ מִקְנֵנוּ וְכל בְּהֶמְתֵּנוּ יִהְיוּ שָׁם בְּעָרֵי הַגִּלְעָד׃

english.text:
Our infants, our women, our livestock, and all our animals
will be there in the cities of Gilead.

translation.text: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:

verses.english:
Our infants, our women, our livestock, and all our animals
will be there in the cities of Gilead.

verses.hebrew: וַעֲבָדֶיךָ יַעַבְרוּ כּל חֲלוּץ צָבָא לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לַמִּלְחָמָה כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲדֹנִי דֹּבֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲבָדֶיךָ יַעַבְרוּ כּל חֲלוּץ צָבָא לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לַמִּלְחָמָה כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲדֹנִי דֹּבֵר׃

english.text:
And your servants will cross, everyone equipped for the
army, in front of YHWH for war as my lord speaks.”

translation.text: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.

verses.english:
And your servants will cross, everyone equipped for the
army, in front of YHWH for war as my lord speaks.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה אֵת אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֵת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן וְאֶת רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה אֵת אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֵת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן וְאֶת רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses commanded Eleazar, the priest, and Joshua son of
Nun and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the
children of Israel for them.

translation.text: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:

verses.english:
And Moses commanded Eleazar, the priest, and Joshua son of
Nun and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the
children of Israel for them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֲלֵהֶם אִם יַעַבְרוּ בְנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן אִתְּכֶם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן כּל חָלוּץ לַמִּלְחָמָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְנִכְבְּשָׁה הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵיכֶם וּנְתַתֶּם לָהֶם אֶת אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד לַאֲחֻזָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֲלֵהֶם אִם יַעַבְרוּ בְנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן אִתְּכֶם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן כּל חָלוּץ לַמִּלְחָמָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְנִכְבְּשָׁה הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵיכֶם וּנְתַתֶּם לָהֶם אֶת אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד לַאֲחֻזָּה׃

english.text:
And Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the
children of Reuben will cross the Jordan with you,
everyone equipped for war, in front of YHWH, and the land
will be subdued in front of you, then you shall give them
the land of Gilead for a possession.

translation.text: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

verses.english:
And Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the
children of Reuben will cross the Jordan with you,
everyone equipped for war, in front of YHWH, and the land
will be subdued in front of you, then you shall give them
the land of Gilead for a possession.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא יַעַבְרוּ חֲלוּצִים אִתְּכֶם וְנֹאחֲזוּ בְתֹכְכֶם בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא יַעַבְרוּ חֲלוּצִים אִתְּכֶם וְנֹאחֲזוּ בְתֹכְכֶם בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
But if they will not cross equipped with you, then they
will have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

translation.text: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

verses.english:
But if they will not cross equipped with you, then they
will have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן לֵאמֹר אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל עֲבָדֶיךָ כֵּן נַעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְנֵי גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן לֵאמֹר אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל עֲבָדֶיךָ כֵּן נַעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben
answered, saying, “What YHWH has spoken to your servants:
we shall do so.

translation.text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.

verses.english:
And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben
answered, saying, “What YHWH has spoken to your servants:
we shall do so.

verses.hebrew: נַחְנוּ נַעֲבֹר חֲלוּצִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְאִתָּנוּ אֲחֻזַּת נַחֲלָתֵנוּ מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: נַחְנוּ נַעֲבֹר חֲלוּצִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְאִתָּנוּ אֲחֻזַּת נַחֲלָתֵנוּ מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
We’ll cross equipped in front of YHWH to the land of
Canaan while we’ll have our legacy possession across the
Jordan.”

translation.text: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.

verses.english:
We’ll cross equipped in front of YHWH to the land of
Canaan while we’ll have our legacy possession across the
Jordan.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה לִבְנֵי גָד וְלִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן יוֹסֵף אֶת מַמְלֶכֶת סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי וְאֶת מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן הָאָרֶץ לְעָרֶיהָ בִּגְבֻלֹת עָרֵי הָאָרֶץ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה לִבְנֵי גָד וְלִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן יוֹסֵף אֶת מַמְלֶכֶת סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי וְאֶת מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן הָאָרֶץ לְעָרֶיהָ בִּגְבֻלֹת עָרֵי הָאָרֶץ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And Moses gave them, the children of Gad and the children
of Reuben and half of the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph,
the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites, and the
kingdom of Og, king of Bashan, the land with its cities,
with the borders of the land’s cities all around.

translation.text: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.

verses.english:
And Moses gave them, the children of Gad and the children
of Reuben and half of the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph,
the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites, and the
kingdom of Og, king of Bashan, the land with its cities,
with the borders of the land’s cities all around.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְנוּ בְנֵי גָד אֶת דִּיבֹן וְאֶת עֲטָרֹת וְאֵת עֲרֹעֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְנוּ בְנֵי גָד אֶת דִּיבֹן וְאֶת עֲטָרֹת וְאֵת עֲרֹעֵר׃

english.text: And the children of Gad built Dibon and Ataroth and Aroer

translation.text: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

verses.english: And the children of Gad built Dibon and Ataroth and Aroer

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת עַטְרֹת שׁוֹפָן וְאֶת יַעְזֵר וְיגְבְּהָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת עַטְרֹת שׁוֹפָן וְאֶת יַעְזֵר וְיגְבְּהָה׃

english.text: and Atroth-shophan and Jazer and Jogbehah

translation.text: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,

verses.english: and Atroth-shophan and Jazer and Jogbehah

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת בֵּית נִמְרָה וְאֶת בֵּית הָרָן עָרֵי מִבְצָר וְגִדְרֹת צֹאן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת בֵּית נִמְרָה וְאֶת בֵּית הָרָן עָרֵי מִבְצָר וְגִדְרֹת צֹאן׃

english.text:
and Beth-Nimrah and Beth-Haran, fortified cities and
fences for flocks.

translation.text: And Bethnimrah, and Bethharan, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.

verses.english:
and Beth-Nimrah and Beth-Haran, fortified cities and
fences for flocks.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן בָּנוּ אֶת חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶת אֶלְעָלֵא וְאֵת קִרְיָתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן בָּנוּ אֶת חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶת אֶלְעָלֵא וְאֵת קִרְיָתָיִם׃

english.text:
And the children of Reuben built Heshbon and Elealeh and
Kiriathaim

translation.text: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,

verses.english:
And the children of Reuben built Heshbon and Elealeh and
Kiriathaim

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת נְבוֹ וְאֶת בַּעַל מְעוֹן מוּסַבֹּת שֵׁם וְאֶת שִׂבְמָה וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְשֵׁמֹת אֶת שְׁמוֹת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר בָּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת נְבוֹ וְאֶת בַּעַל מְעוֹן מוּסַבֹּת שֵׁם וְאֶת שִׂבְמָה וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְשֵׁמֹת אֶת שְׁמוֹת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר בָּנוּ׃

english.text:
and Nebo and Baal-meon—with changes of name—and Sibmah,
and they called the names of the cities that they built by
new names.

translation.text: And Nebo, and Baalmeon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.

verses.english:
and Nebo and Baal-meon—with changes of name—and Sibmah,
and they called the names of the cities that they built by
new names.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה גִּלְעָדָה וַיִּלְכְּדֻהָ וַיּוֹרֶשׁ אֶת הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה גִּלְעָדָה וַיִּלְכְּדֻהָ וַיּוֹרֶשׁ אֶת הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בָּהּ׃

english.text:
And the children of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead
and captured it and dispossessed the Amorite who was in
it.

translation.text: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.

verses.english:
And the children of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead
and captured it and dispossessed the Amorite who was in
it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַגִּלְעָד לְמָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַגִּלְעָד לְמָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהּ׃

english.text:
And Moses gave Gilead to Machir son of Manasseh, and they
lived in it.

translation.text: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.

verses.english:
And Moses gave Gilead to Machir son of Manasseh, and they
lived in it.

verses.hebrew: וְיָאִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה הָלַךְ וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת חַוֺּתֵיהֶם וַיִּקְרָא אֶתְהֶן חַוֺּת יָאִיר׃

hebrew.text: וְיָאִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה הָלַךְ וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת חַוֺּתֵיהֶם וַיִּקְרָא אֶתְהֶן חַוֺּת יָאִיר׃

english.text:
And Jair son of Manasseh went and captured their villages,
and he called them Havvoth-Jair.

translation.text: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havothjair.

verses.english:
And Jair son of Manasseh went and captured their villages,
and he called them Havvoth-Jair.

verses.hebrew: וְנֹבַח הָלַךְ וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת קְנָת וְאֶת בְּנֹתֶיהָ וַיִּקְרָא לָה נֹבַח בִּשְׁמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְנֹבַח הָלַךְ וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת קְנָת וְאֶת בְּנֹתֶיהָ וַיִּקְרָא לָה נֹבַח בִּשְׁמוֹ׃

english.text:
And Nobah went and captured Kenath and its towns, and he
called it Nobah after his own name.

translation.text: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

verses.english:
And Nobah went and captured Kenath and its towns, and he
called it Nobah after his own name.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מַסְעֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְצִבְאֹתָם בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה מַסְעֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְצִבְאֹתָם בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן׃

english.text:
These are the travels of the children of Israel who went
out from the land of Egypt by their armies by the hand of
Moses and Aaron.

translation.text: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

verses.english:
These are the travels of the children of Israel who went
out from the land of Egypt by their armies by the hand of
Moses and Aaron.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֶת מוֹצָאֵיהֶם לְמַסְעֵיהֶם עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה וְאֵלֶּה מַסְעֵיהֶם לְמוֹצָאֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֶת מוֹצָאֵיהֶם לְמַסְעֵיהֶם עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה וְאֵלֶּה מַסְעֵיהֶם לְמוֹצָאֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And Moses wrote their stops for their travels by YHWH’s
word, and these are their travels and their stops.

translation.text: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

verses.english:
And Moses wrote their stops for their travels by YHWH’s
word, and these are their travels and their stops.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרַעְמְסֵס בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן מִמּחֳרַת הַפֶּסַח יָצְאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיָד רָמָה לְעֵינֵי כּל מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרַעְמְסֵס בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן מִמּחֳרַת הַפֶּסַח יָצְאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיָד רָמָה לְעֵינֵי כּל מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Rameses in the first month on the
fifteenth day of the first month. On the day after the
Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand
before the eyes of all Egypt.

translation.text: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Rameses in the first month on the
fifteenth day of the first month. On the day after the
Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand
before the eyes of all Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וּמִצְרַיִם מְקַבְּרִים אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יְהֹוָה בָּהֶם כּל בְּכוֹר וּבֵאלֹהֵיהֶם עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה שְׁפָטִים׃

hebrew.text: וּמִצְרַיִם מְקַבְּרִים אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יְהֹוָה בָּהֶם כּל בְּכוֹר וּבֵאלֹהֵיהֶם עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה שְׁפָטִים׃

english.text:
And the Egyptians were burying those whom YHWH had struck
among them: every firstborn. And YHWH had made judgments
on their gods.

translation.text: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.

verses.english:
And the Egyptians were burying those whom YHWH had struck
among them: every firstborn. And YHWH had made judgments
on their gods.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵרַעְמְסֵס וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּסֻכֹּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵרַעְמְסֵס וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּסֻכֹּת׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel traveled from Rameses and
camped in Succoth.

translation.text: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel traveled from Rameses and
camped in Succoth.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִסֻּכֹּת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְאֵתָם אֲשֶׁר בִּקְצֵה הַמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִסֻּכֹּת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְאֵתָם אֲשֶׁר בִּקְצֵה הַמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Succoth and camped in Etham, which
is at the edge of the wilderness.

translation.text: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Succoth and camped in Etham, which
is at the edge of the wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֵתָם וַיָּשׁב עַל פִּי הַחִירֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי בַּעַל צְפוֹן וַיַּחֲנוּ לִפְנֵי מִגְדֹּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֵתָם וַיָּשׁב עַל פִּי הַחִירֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי בַּעַל צְפוֹן וַיַּחֲנוּ לִפְנֵי מִגְדֹּל׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Etham and turned back toward
Pi-hahiroth, which is in front of Baal-Zephon: and they
camped in front of Migdol.

translation.text: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pihahiroth, which is before Baalzephon: and they pitched before Migdol.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Etham and turned back toward
Pi-hahiroth, which is in front of Baal-Zephon: and they
camped in front of Migdol.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִפְּנֵי הַחִירֹת וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְתוֹךְ הַיָּם הַמִּדְבָּרָה וַיֵּלְכוּ דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים בְּמִדְבַּר אֵתָם וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִפְּנֵי הַחִירֹת וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְתוֹךְ הַיָּם הַמִּדְבָּרָה וַיֵּלְכוּ דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים בְּמִדְבַּר אֵתָם וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמָרָה׃

english.text:
And they traveled from before Pi-hahiroth and passed
through the sea to the wilderness. And they went three
days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham and camped in
Marah.

translation.text: And they departed from before Pihahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.

verses.english:
And they traveled from before Pi-hahiroth and passed
through the sea to the wilderness. And they went three
days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham and camped in
Marah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמָּרָה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵילִמָה וּבְאֵילִם שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה עֵינֹת מַיִם וְשִׁבְעִים תְּמָרִים וַיַּחֲנוּ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמָּרָה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵילִמָה וּבְאֵילִם שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה עֵינֹת מַיִם וְשִׁבְעִים תְּמָרִים וַיַּחֲנוּ שָׁם׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Marah and came to Elim. And in Elim
were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. And
they camped there.

translation.text: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Marah and came to Elim. And in Elim
were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. And
they camped there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֵילִם וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל יַם סוּף׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֵילִם וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל יַם סוּף׃

english.text: And they traveled from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.

translation.text: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.

verses.english: And they traveled from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִיַּם סוּף וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִדְבַּר סִין׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִיַּם סוּף וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִדְבַּר סִין׃

english.text:
And they traveled from the Red Sea and camped in the
wilderness of Sin.

translation.text: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

verses.english:
And they traveled from the Red Sea and camped in the
wilderness of Sin.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמִּדְבַּר סִין וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּדפְקָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמִּדְבַּר סִין וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּדפְקָה׃

english.text:
And they traveled from the wilderness of Sin and camped in
Dophkah.

translation.text: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

verses.english:
And they traveled from the wilderness of Sin and camped in
Dophkah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִדּפְקָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּאָלוּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִדּפְקָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּאָלוּשׁ׃

english.text: And they traveled from Dophkah and camped in Alush.

translation.text: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

verses.english: And they traveled from Dophkah and camped in Alush.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאָלוּשׁ וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּרְפִידִם וְלֹא הָיָה שָׁם מַיִם לָעָם לִשְׁתּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאָלוּשׁ וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּרְפִידִם וְלֹא הָיָה שָׁם מַיִם לָעָם לִשְׁתּוֹת׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Alush and camped at Rephidim. And
there was no water there for the people to drink.

translation.text: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Alush and camped at Rephidim. And
there was no water there for the people to drink.

Almon-diblathaim.

translation.text: And they removed from Dibongad, and encamped in Almondiblathaim.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Dibon-gad and camped in
Almon-diblathaim.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעַלְמֹן דִּבְלָתָיְמָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּהָרֵי הָעֲבָרִים לִפְנֵי נְבוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעַלְמֹן דִּבְלָתָיְמָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּהָרֵי הָעֲבָרִים לִפְנֵי נְבוֹ׃

english.text:
And they traveled from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the
mountains of Abarim in front of Nebo.

translation.text: And they removed from Almondiblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

verses.english:
And they traveled from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the
mountains of Abarim in front of Nebo.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהָרֵי הָעֲבָרִים וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהָרֵי הָעֲבָרִים וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

english.text:
And they traveled from the mountains of Abarim and camped
in the plains of Moab by the Jordan toward Jericho.

translation.text: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

verses.english:
And they traveled from the mountains of Abarim and camped
in the plains of Moab by the Jordan toward Jericho.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל הַיַּרְדֵּן מִבֵּית הַיְשִׁמֹת עַד אָבֵל הַשִּׁטִּים בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל הַיַּרְדֵּן מִבֵּית הַיְשִׁמֹת עַד אָבֵל הַשִּׁטִּים בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
And they camped by the Jordan from Beth-jeshimoth to
Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.

translation.text: And they pitched by Jordan, from Bethjesimoth even unto Abelshittim in the plains of Moab.

verses.english:
And they camped by the Jordan from Beth-jeshimoth to
Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And YHWH spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the
Jordan toward Jericho, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

verses.english:
And YHWH spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the
Jordan toward Jericho, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶל אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶל אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you cross the Jordan to the land of Canaan,

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you cross the Jordan to the land of Canaan,

verses.hebrew: וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם אֶת כּל יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְאִבַּדְתֶּם אֵת כּל מַשְׂכִּיֹּתָם וְאֵת כּל צַלְמֵי מַסֵּכֹתָם תְּאַבֵּדוּ וְאֵת כּל בָּמוֹתָם תַּשְׁמִידוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם אֶת כּל יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְאִבַּדְתֶּם אֵת כּל מַשְׂכִּיֹּתָם וְאֵת כּל צַלְמֵי מַסֵּכֹתָם תְּאַבֵּדוּ וְאֵת כּל בָּמוֹתָם תַּשְׁמִידוּ׃

english.text:
you shall dispossess all the residents of the land in
front of you, and destroy all their carved figures, and
you shall destroy all their molten images and demolish all
their high places.

translation.text: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:

verses.english:
you shall dispossess all the residents of the land in
front of you, and destroy all their carved figures, and
you shall destroy all their molten images and demolish all
their high places.

verses.hebrew: וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ וִישַׁבְתֶּם בָּהּ כִּי לָכֶם נָתַתִּי אֶת הָאָרֶץ לָרֶשֶׁת אֹתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ וִישַׁבְתֶּם בָּהּ כִּי לָכֶם נָתַתִּי אֶת הָאָרֶץ לָרֶשֶׁת אֹתָהּ׃

english.text:
And you shall take possession of the land and live in it,
because I’ve given the land to you to possess it.

translation.text: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.

verses.english:
