And you shall take possession of the land and live in it,
because I’ve given the land to you to possess it.

verses.hebrew: וְהִתְנַחַלְתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ בְּגוֹרָל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתֵיכֶם לָרַב תַּרְבּוּ אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ וְלַמְעַט תַּמְעִיט אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ אֶל אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא לוֹ שָׁמָּה הַגּוֹרָל לוֹ יִהְיֶה לְמַטּוֹת אֲבֹתֵיכֶם תִּתְנֶחָלוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִתְנַחַלְתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ בְּגוֹרָל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתֵיכֶם לָרַב תַּרְבּוּ אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ וְלַמְעַט תַּמְעִיט אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ אֶל אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא לוֹ שָׁמָּה הַגּוֹרָל לוֹ יִהְיֶה לְמַטּוֹת אֲבֹתֵיכֶם תִּתְנֶחָלוּ׃

english.text:
And you shall give legacies of the land by lot, by your
families: for the large you shall make its legacy larger,
and for the small you shall make its legacy smaller.
Wherever the lot indicates for it shall belong to it. You
shall give legacies to the tribes of your fathers.

translation.text: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man’s inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.

verses.english:
And you shall give legacies of the land by lot, by your
families: for the large you shall make its legacy larger,
and for the small you shall make its legacy smaller.
Wherever the lot indicates for it shall belong to it. You
shall give legacies to the tribes of your fathers.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא תוֹרִישׁוּ אֶת יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְהָיָה אֲשֶׁר תּוֹתִירוּ מֵהֶם לְשִׂכִּים בְּעֵינֵיכֶם וְלִצְנִינִם בְּצִדֵּיכֶם וְצָרְרוּ אֶתְכֶם עַל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא תוֹרִישׁוּ אֶת יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְהָיָה אֲשֶׁר תּוֹתִירוּ מֵהֶם לְשִׂכִּים בְּעֵינֵיכֶם וְלִצְנִינִם בְּצִדֵּיכֶם וְצָרְרוּ אֶתְכֶם עַל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ׃

english.text:
And if you don’t dispossess the residents of the land in
front of you, then those whom you leave of them will
become sticks in your eyes and thorns in your sides, and
they’ll afflict you on the land in which you’re living.

translation.text: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.

verses.english:
And if you don’t dispossess the residents of the land in
front of you, then those whom you leave of them will
become sticks in your eyes and thorns in your sides, and
they’ll afflict you on the land in which you’re living.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּמִּיתִי לַעֲשׂוֹת לָהֶם אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּמִּיתִי לַעֲשׂוֹת לָהֶם אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And it will be that, as I meant to do to them, I’ll do to
you!”

translation.text: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.

verses.english:
And it will be that, as I meant to do to them, I’ll do to
you!”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי אַתֶּם בָּאִים אֶל הָאָרֶץ כְּנָעַן זֹאת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּפֹּל לָכֶם בְּנַחֲלָה אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לִגְבֻלֹתֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי אַתֶּם בָּאִים אֶל הָאָרֶץ כְּנָעַן זֹאת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּפֹּל לָכֶם בְּנַחֲלָה אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לִגְבֻלֹתֶיהָ׃

english.text:
“Command the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you come to the land of Canaan, this is the
land that will fall to you as a legacy, the land of Canaan
by its borders:

translation.text: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)

verses.english:
“Command the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you come to the land of Canaan, this is the
land that will fall to you as a legacy, the land of Canaan
by its borders:

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה לָכֶם פְּאַת נֶגֶב מִמִּדְבַּר צִן עַל יְדֵי אֱדוֹם וְהָיָה לָכֶם גְּבוּל נֶגֶב מִקְצֵה יָם הַמֶּלַח קֵדְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה לָכֶם פְּאַת נֶגֶב מִמִּדְבַּר צִן עַל יְדֵי אֱדוֹם וְהָיָה לָכֶם גְּבוּל נֶגֶב מִקְצֵה יָם הַמֶּלַח קֵדְמָה׃

english.text:
And the southern side for you shall be from the wilderness
of Zin next to Edom, and the southern border for you shall
be from the edge of the Dead Sea to the east.

translation.text: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:

verses.english:
And the southern side for you shall be from the wilderness
of Zin next to Edom, and the southern border for you shall
be from the edge of the Dead Sea to the east.

verses.hebrew: וְנָסַב לָכֶם הַגְּבוּל מִנֶּגֶב לְמַעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים וְעָבַר צִנָה (והיה) [וְהָיוּ] תּוֹצְאֹתָיו מִנֶּגֶב לְקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ וְיָצָא חֲצַר אַדָּר וְעָבַר עַצְמֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנָסַב לָכֶם הַגְּבוּל מִנֶּגֶב לְמַעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים וְעָבַר צִנָה (והיה) [וְהָיוּ] תּוֹצְאֹתָיו מִנֶּגֶב לְקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ וְיָצָא חֲצַר אַדָּר וְעָבַר עַצְמֹנָה׃

english.text:
And the border for you shall turn from the south to the
ascent of Akrabim and will pass to Zin, and its extent
shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and it shall go
out to Hazar-addar and pass to Azmon.

translation.text: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadeshbarnea, and shall go on to Hazaraddar, and pass on to Azmon:

verses.english:
And the border for you shall turn from the south to the
ascent of Akrabim and will pass to Zin, and its extent
shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and it shall go
out to Hazar-addar and pass to Azmon.

verses.hebrew: וְנָסַב הַגְּבוּל מֵעַצְמוֹן נַחְלָה מִצְרָיִם וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְנָסַב הַגְּבוּל מֵעַצְמוֹן נַחְלָה מִצְרָיִם וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה׃

english.text:
And the border shall turn from Azmon to the Wadi of Egypt,
and its extent shall be to the sea.

translation.text: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.

verses.english:
And the border shall turn from Azmon to the Wadi of Egypt,
and its extent shall be to the sea.

verses.hebrew: וּגְבוּל יָם וְהָיָה לָכֶם הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל וּגְבוּל זֶה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל יָם׃

hebrew.text: וּגְבוּל יָם וְהָיָה לָכֶם הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל וּגְבוּל זֶה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל יָם׃

english.text:
And the western border: and the big sea shall be a border
for you. This shall be the western border for you.

translation.text: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.

verses.english:
And the western border: and the big sea shall be a border
for you. This shall be the western border for you.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל צָפוֹן מִן הַיָּם הַגָּדֹל תְּתָאוּ לָכֶם הֹר הָהָר׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל צָפוֹן מִן הַיָּם הַגָּדֹל תְּתָאוּ לָכֶם הֹר הָהָר׃

english.text:
And this shall be the northern border for you: you shall
mark from the big sea to Mount Hor,

translation.text: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:

verses.english:
And this shall be the northern border for you: you shall
mark from the big sea to Mount Hor,

verses.hebrew: מֵהֹר הָהָר תְּתָאוּ לְבֹא חֲמָת וְהָיוּ תּוֹצְאֹת הַגְּבֻל צְדָדָה׃

hebrew.text: מֵהֹר הָהָר תְּתָאוּ לְבֹא חֲמָת וְהָיוּ תּוֹצְאֹת הַגְּבֻל צְדָדָה׃

english.text:
from Mount Hor you shall mark to the entrance of Hamath,
and the border’s extent shall be to Zedad,

translation.text: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:

verses.english:
from Mount Hor you shall mark to the entrance of Hamath,
and the border’s extent shall be to Zedad,

verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא הַגְּבֻל זִפְרֹנָה וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו חֲצַר עֵינָן זֶה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל צָפוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצָא הַגְּבֻל זִפְרֹנָה וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו חֲצַר עֵינָן זֶה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל צָפוֹן׃

english.text:
and the border shall go out to Ziphron, and its extent
shall be to Hazar-enan. This shall be the northern border
for you.

translation.text: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazarenan: this shall be your north border.

verses.english:
and the border shall go out to Ziphron, and its extent
shall be to Hazar-enan. This shall be the northern border
for you.

verses.hebrew: וְהִתְאַוִּיתֶם לָכֶם לִגְבוּל קֵדְמָה מֵחֲצַר עֵינָן שְׁפָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִתְאַוִּיתֶם לָכֶם לִגְבוּל קֵדְמָה מֵחֲצַר עֵינָן שְׁפָמָה׃

english.text:
And you shall mark for the border to the east from
Hazar-enan to Shepham,

translation.text: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazarenan to Shepham:

verses.english:
And you shall mark for the border to the east from
Hazar-enan to Shepham,

verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד הַגְּבֻל מִשְּׁפָם הָרִבְלָה מִקֶּדֶם לָעָיִן וְיָרַד הַגְּבֻל וּמָחָה עַל כֶּתֶף יָם כִּנֶּרֶת קֵדְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיָרַד הַגְּבֻל מִשְּׁפָם הָרִבְלָה מִקֶּדֶם לָעָיִן וְיָרַד הַגְּבֻל וּמָחָה עַל כֶּתֶף יָם כִּנֶּרֶת קֵדְמָה׃

english.text:
and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah at the
east of Ain, and the border shall go down and rub on the
shoulder of the Sea of Kinneret on the east,

translation.text: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:

verses.english:
and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah at the
east of Ain, and the border shall go down and rub on the
shoulder of the Sea of Kinneret on the east,

verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל הַיַּרְדֵּנָה וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו יָם הַמֶּלַח זֹאת תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם הָאָרֶץ לִגְבֻלֹתֶיהָ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל הַיַּרְדֵּנָה וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו יָם הַמֶּלַח זֹאת תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם הָאָרֶץ לִגְבֻלֹתֶיהָ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
and the border shall go down to the Jordan, and its extent
will be to the Dead Sea. This shall be the land for you by
its borders all around.”

translation.text: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.

verses.english:
and the border shall go down to the Jordan, and its extent
will be to the Dead Sea. This shall be the land for you by
its borders all around.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר זֹאת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּתְנַחֲלוּ אֹתָהּ בְּגוֹרָל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לָתֵת לְתִשְׁעַת הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר זֹאת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּתְנַחֲלוּ אֹתָהּ בְּגוֹרָל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לָתֵת לְתִשְׁעַת הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה׃

english.text:
And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This
is the land that you shall give as legacies by lot, which
YHWH commanded to give to the nine tribes and the half of
a tribe.”

translation.text: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:

verses.english:
And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This
is the land that you shall give as legacies by lot, which
YHWH commanded to give to the nine tribes and the half of
a tribe.”

verses.hebrew: כִּי לָקְחוּ מַטֵּה בְנֵי הָראוּבֵנִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם וּמַטֵּה בְנֵי הַגָּדִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם וַחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לָקְחוּ מַטֵּה בְנֵי הָראוּבֵנִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם וּמַטֵּה בְנֵי הַגָּדִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם וַחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם׃

english.text:
Because the tribe of the children of the Reubenites by
their fathers’ house and the tribe of the children of the
Gadites by their fathers’ house had taken and half of the
tribe of Manasseh had taken their legacy.

translation.text: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:

verses.english:
Because the tribe of the children of the Reubenites by
their fathers’ house and the tribe of the children of the
Gadites by their fathers’ house had taken and half of the
tribe of Manasseh had taken their legacy.

verses.hebrew: שְׁנֵי הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה׃

hebrew.text: שְׁנֵי הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה׃

english.text:
The two tribes and the half of a tribe had taken their
legacy from across the Jordan toward Jericho on the east
side—to the east.

translation.text: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.

verses.english:
The two tribes and the half of a tribe had taken their
legacy from across the Jordan toward Jericho on the east
side—to the east.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יִנְחֲלוּ לָכֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יִנְחֲלוּ לָכֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן׃

translation.text: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.hebrew: וְנָשִׂיא אֶחָד נָשִׂיא אֶחָד מִמַּטֶּה תִּקְחוּ לִנְחֹל אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָשִׂיא אֶחָד נָשִׂיא אֶחָד מִמַּטֶּה תִּקְחוּ לִנְחֹל אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
and you shall take one chieftain for each tribe to give
the land as legacies.

translation.text: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.

verses.english:
and you shall take one chieftain for each tribe to give
the land as legacies.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה׃

english.text:
And these are the people’s names: For the tribe of Judah,
Caleb son of Jephunneh.

translation.text: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

verses.english:
And these are the people’s names: For the tribe of Judah,
Caleb son of Jephunneh.

verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן שְׁמוּאֵל בֶּן עַמִּיהוּד׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן שְׁמוּאֵל בֶּן עַמִּיהוּד׃

english.text:
And for the tribe of the children of Simeon, Samuel son of
Ammihud.

translation.text: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

verses.english:
And for the tribe of the children of Simeon, Samuel son of
Ammihud.

verses.hebrew: לְמַטֵּה בִנְיָמִן אֱלִידָד בֶּן כִּסְלוֹן׃

hebrew.text: לְמַטֵּה בִנְיָמִן אֱלִידָד בֶּן כִּסְלוֹן׃

english.text: For the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad son of Chislon.

translation.text: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

verses.english: For the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad son of Chislon.

verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי דָן נָשִׂיא בֻּקִּי בֶּן יגְלִי׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי דָן נָשִׂיא בֻּקִּי בֶּן יגְלִי׃

english.text:
And for the tribe of the children of Dan, a chieftain,
Bukki son of Jogli.

translation.text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.

verses.english:
And for the tribe of the children of Dan, a chieftain,
Bukki son of Jogli.

verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי יוֹסֵף לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה נָשִׂיא חַנִּיאֵל בֶּן אֵפֹד׃

hebrew.text: לִבְנֵי יוֹסֵף לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה נָשִׂיא חַנִּיאֵל בֶּן אֵפֹד׃

english.text:
For the children of Joseph: for the tribe of the children
of Manasseh, a chieftain, Hanniel son of Ephod;

translation.text: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

verses.english:
For the children of Joseph: for the tribe of the children
of Manasseh, a chieftain, Hanniel son of Ephod;

verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם נָשִׂיא קְמוּאֵל בֶּן שִׁפְטָן׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם נָשִׂיא קְמוּאֵל בֶּן שִׁפְטָן׃

english.text:
and for the tribe of the children of Ephraim, a chieftain,
Kemuel son of Shiphtan.

translation.text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

verses.english:
and for the tribe of the children of Ephraim, a chieftain,
Kemuel son of Shiphtan.

verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי זְבוּלֻן נָשִׂיא אֱלִיצָפָן בֶּן פַּרְנָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי זְבוּלֻן נָשִׂיא אֱלִיצָפָן בֶּן פַּרְנָךְ׃

english.text:
And for the tribe of the children of Zebulun, a chieftain,
Elizaphan son of Parnach.

translation.text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

verses.english:
And for the tribe of the children of Zebulun, a chieftain,
Elizaphan son of Parnach.

verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר נָשִׂיא פַּלְטִיאֵל בֶּן עַזָּן׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר נָשִׂיא פַּלְטִיאֵל בֶּן עַזָּן׃

english.text:
And for the tribe of the children of Issachar, a
chieftain, Paltiel son of Azzan.

translation.text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

verses.english:
And for the tribe of the children of Issachar, a
chieftain, Paltiel son of Azzan.

verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי אָשֵׁר נָשִׂיא אֲחִיהוּד בֶּן שְׁלֹמִי׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי אָשֵׁר נָשִׂיא אֲחִיהוּד בֶּן שְׁלֹמִי׃

english.text:
And for the tribe of the children of Asher, a chieftain,
Ahihud son of Shelomi.

translation.text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

verses.english:
And for the tribe of the children of Asher, a chieftain,
Ahihud son of Shelomi.

verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי נָשִׂיא פְּדַהְאֵל בֶּן עַמִּיהוּד׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי נָשִׂיא פְּדַהְאֵל בֶּן עַמִּיהוּד׃

english.text:
And for the tribe of the children of Naphtali, a
chieftain, Pedahel son of Ammihud.”

translation.text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.

verses.english:
And for the tribe of the children of Naphtali, a
chieftain, Pedahel son of Ammihud.”

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לְנַחֵל אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לְנַחֵל אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
These are the ones whom YHWH commanded to give the
children of Israel legacies in the land of Canaan.

translation.text: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

verses.english:
These are the ones whom YHWH commanded to give the
children of Israel legacies in the land of Canaan.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And YHWH spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the
Jordan toward Jericho, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

verses.english:
And YHWH spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the
Jordan toward Jericho, saying,

verses.hebrew: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנָתְנוּ לַלְוִיִּם מִנַּחֲלַת אֲחֻזָּתָם עָרִים לָשָׁבֶת וּמִגְרָשׁ לֶעָרִים סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶם תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנָתְנוּ לַלְוִיִּם מִנַּחֲלַת אֲחֻזָּתָם עָרִים לָשָׁבֶת וּמִגְרָשׁ לֶעָרִים סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶם תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
“Command the children of Israel that, from the legacy of
their possession, they shall give the Levites cities in
which to live, and you shall give the Levites surrounding
land for the cities all around them.

translation.text: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.

verses.english:
“Command the children of Israel that, from the legacy of
their possession, they shall give the Levites cities in
which to live, and you shall give the Levites surrounding
land for the cities all around them.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ הֶעָרִים לָהֶם לָשָׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם יִהְיוּ לִבְהֶמְתָּם וְלִרְכֻשָׁם וּלְכֹל חַיָּתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ הֶעָרִים לָהֶם לָשָׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם יִהְיוּ לִבְהֶמְתָּם וְלִרְכֻשָׁם וּלְכֹל חַיָּתָם׃

english.text:
And the cities shall be theirs to live in, and their
surrounding lands shall be for their cattle and for their
property and for their animals.

translation.text: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.

verses.english:
And the cities shall be theirs to live in, and their
surrounding lands shall be for their cattle and for their
property and for their animals.

verses.hebrew: וּמִגְרְשֵׁי הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם מִקִּיר הָעִיר וָחוּצָה אֶלֶף אַמָּה סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וּמִגְרְשֵׁי הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם מִקִּיר הָעִיר וָחוּצָה אֶלֶף אַמָּה סָבִיב׃

english.text:
And the surrounding lands of the cities that you shall
give to the Levites: from the city wall outward, a
thousand cubits all around.

translation.text: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.

verses.english:
And the surrounding lands of the cities that you shall
give to the Levites: from the city wall outward, a
thousand cubits all around.

verses.hebrew: וּמַדֹּתֶם מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶת פְּאַת קֵדְמָה אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְאֶת פְּאַת נֶגֶב אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְאֶת פְּאַת יָם אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְאֵת פְּאַת צָפוֹן אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְהָעִיר בַּתָּוֶךְ זֶה יִהְיֶה לָהֶם מִגְרְשֵׁי הֶעָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וּמַדֹּתֶם מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶת פְּאַת קֵדְמָה אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְאֶת פְּאַת נֶגֶב אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְאֶת פְּאַת יָם אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְאֵת פְּאַת צָפוֹן אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְהָעִיר בַּתָּוֶךְ זֶה יִהְיֶה לָהֶם מִגְרְשֵׁי הֶעָרִים׃

english.text:
And you shall measure outside the city: on the eastern
side two thousand in cubits, and on the southern side two
thousand in cubits, and on the western side two thousand
in cubits, and on the northern side two thousand in
cubits, and the city in the middle. This shall be the
surrounding lands of the cities for them.

translation.text: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.

verses.english:
And you shall measure outside the city: on the eastern
side two thousand in cubits, and on the southern side two
thousand in cubits, and on the western side two thousand
in cubits, and on the northern side two thousand in
cubits, and the city in the middle. This shall be the
surrounding lands of the cities for them.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם אֵת שֵׁשׁ עָרֵי הַמִּקְלָט אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לָנֻס שָׁמָּה הָרֹצֵחַ וַעֲלֵיהֶם תִּתְּנוּ אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁתַּיִם עִיר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם אֵת שֵׁשׁ עָרֵי הַמִּקְלָט אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לָנֻס שָׁמָּה הָרֹצֵחַ וַעֲלֵיהֶם תִּתְּנוּ אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁתַּיִם עִיר׃

english.text:
And the cities that you shall give to the Levites: six
cities of refuge that you shall give for the manslayer to
flee there, and you shall give in addition to them
forty-two cities.

translation.text: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.

verses.english:
And the cities that you shall give to the Levites: six
cities of refuge that you shall give for the manslayer to
flee there, and you shall give in addition to them
forty-two cities.

verses.hebrew: כּל הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה עִיר אֶתְהֶן וְאֶת מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: כּל הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה עִיר אֶתְהֶן וְאֶת מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃

english.text:
All the cities that you shall give to the Levites:
forty-eight cities, them and their surrounding lands.

translation.text: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.

verses.english:
All the cities that you shall give to the Levites:
forty-eight cities, them and their surrounding lands.

verses.hebrew: וְהֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ מֵאֲחֻזַּת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֵת הָרַב תַּרְבּוּ וּמֵאֵת הַמְעַט תַּמְעִיטוּ אִישׁ כְּפִי נַחֲלָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִנְחָלוּ יִתֵּן מֵעָרָיו לַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ מֵאֲחֻזַּת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֵת הָרַב תַּרְבּוּ וּמֵאֵת הַמְעַט תַּמְעִיטוּ אִישׁ כְּפִי נַחֲלָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִנְחָלוּ יִתֵּן מֵעָרָיו לַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
And the cities that you shall give from the possession of
the children of Israel: from the larger you shall give
more, and from the smaller you shall give fewer. Each
shall give some of his cities to the Levites according to
his legacy that they will give.”

translation.text: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.

verses.english:
And the cities that you shall give from the possession of
the children of Israel: from the larger you shall give
more, and from the smaller you shall give fewer. Each
shall give some of his cities to the Levites according to
his legacy that they will give.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אַרְצָה כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אַרְצָה כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you cross the Jordan to the land of Canaan,

translation.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

verses.english:
“Speak to the children of Israel, and you shall say to
them: When you cross the Jordan to the land of Canaan,

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיתֶם לָכֶם עָרִים עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה לָכֶם וְנָס שָׁמָּה רֹצֵחַ מַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקְרִיתֶם לָכֶם עָרִים עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה לָכֶם וְנָס שָׁמָּה רֹצֵחַ מַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

english.text:
you shall establish cities; they shall be cities of refuge
for you, and a manslayer who strikes a life by mistake
shall flee there.

translation.text: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.

verses.english:
you shall establish cities; they shall be cities of refuge
for you, and a manslayer who strikes a life by mistake
shall flee there.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ לָכֶם הֶעָרִים לְמִקְלָט מִגֹּאֵל וְלֹא יָמוּת הָרֹצֵחַ עַד עמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לַמִּשְׁפָּט׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ לָכֶם הֶעָרִים לְמִקְלָט מִגֹּאֵל וְלֹא יָמוּת הָרֹצֵחַ עַד עמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לַמִּשְׁפָּט׃

english.text:
And you shall have the cities for refuge from an avenger
so the manslayer will not die until he stands in front of
the congregation for judgment.

translation.text: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.

verses.english:
And you shall have the cities for refuge from an avenger
so the manslayer will not die until he stands in front of
the congregation for judgment.

verses.hebrew: וְהֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתֵּנוּ שֵׁשׁ עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתֵּנוּ שֵׁשׁ עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And the cities that you shall give: You shall have six
cities of refuge.

translation.text: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.

verses.english:
And the cities that you shall give: You shall have six
cities of refuge.

verses.hebrew: אֵת שְׁלֹשׁ הֶעָרִים תִּתְּנוּ מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וְאֵת שְׁלֹשׁ הֶעָרִים תִּתְּנוּ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה׃

hebrew.text: אֵת שְׁלֹשׁ הֶעָרִים תִּתְּנוּ מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וְאֵת שְׁלֹשׁ הֶעָרִים תִּתְּנוּ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה׃

english.text:
You shall put three of the cities across the Jordan, and
you shall put three of the cities in the land of Canaan.
They shall be cities of refuge.

translation.text: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.

verses.english:
You shall put three of the cities across the Jordan, and
you shall put three of the cities in the land of Canaan.
They shall be cities of refuge.

verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר וְלַתּוֹשָׁב בְּתוֹכָם תִּהְיֶינָה שֵׁשׁ הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לְמִקְלָט לָנוּס שָׁמָּה כּל מַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

hebrew.text: לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר וְלַתּוֹשָׁב בְּתוֹכָם תִּהְיֶינָה שֵׁשׁ הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לְמִקְלָט לָנוּס שָׁמָּה כּל מַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

english.text:
“These six cities shall be for refuge for the children of
Israel and for the alien and for the visitor among them,
for anyone who strikes a life by mistake to flee there.

translation.text: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.

verses.english:
“These six cities shall be for refuge for the children of
Israel and for the alien and for the visitor among them,
for anyone who strikes a life by mistake to flee there.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם בִּכְלִי בַרְזֶל הִכָּהוּ וַיָּמֹת רֹצֵחַ הוּא מוֹת יוּמַת הָרֹצֵחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בִּכְלִי בַרְזֶל הִכָּהוּ וַיָּמֹת רֹצֵחַ הוּא מוֹת יוּמַת הָרֹצֵחַ׃

english.text:
But if he struck him with an iron item so that he died, he
is a murderer. The murderer shall be put to death.

translation.text: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

verses.english:
But if he struck him with an iron item so that he died, he
is a murderer. The murderer shall be put to death.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּאֶבֶן יָד אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בָּהּ הִכָּהוּ וַיָּמֹת רֹצֵחַ הוּא מוֹת יוּמַת הָרֹצֵחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּאֶבֶן יָד אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בָּהּ הִכָּהוּ וַיָּמֹת רֹצֵחַ הוּא מוֹת יוּמַת הָרֹצֵחַ׃

english.text:
And if he struck him with a stone in the hand by which one
could die, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer
shall be put to death.

translation.text: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

verses.english:
And if he struck him with a stone in the hand by which one
could die, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer
shall be put to death.

verses.hebrew: אוֹ בִּכְלִי עֵץ יָד אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בּוֹ הִכָּהוּ וַיָּמֹת רֹצֵחַ הוּא מוֹת יוּמַת הָרֹצֵחַ׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ בִּכְלִי עֵץ יָד אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בּוֹ הִכָּהוּ וַיָּמֹת רֹצֵחַ הוּא מוֹת יוּמַת הָרֹצֵחַ׃

english.text:
Or if he struck him with a wooden object in the hand by
which one could die, so that he died, he is a murderer.
The murderer shall be put to death.

translation.text: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

verses.english:
Or if he struck him with a wooden object in the hand by
which one could die, so that he died, he is a murderer.
The murderer shall be put to death.

verses.hebrew: גֹּאֵל הַדָּם הוּא יָמִית אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ בְּפִגְעוֹ בוֹ הוּא יְמִתֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: גֹּאֵל הַדָּם הוּא יָמִית אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ בְּפִגְעוֹ בוֹ הוּא יְמִתֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
The blood avenger, he shall kill the murderer. When he
comes upon him, he shall kill him.

translation.text: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.

verses.english:
The blood avenger, he shall kill the murderer. When he
comes upon him, he shall kill him.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּשִׂנְאָה יֶהְדֳּפֶנּוּ אוֹ הִשְׁלִיךְ עָלָיו בִּצְדִיָּה וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּשִׂנְאָה יֶהְדֳּפֶנּוּ אוֹ הִשְׁלִיךְ עָלָיו בִּצְדִיָּה וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
And if he pushed him in hatred or threw something on him
through scheming so that he died,

translation.text: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;

verses.english:
And if he pushed him in hatred or threw something on him
through scheming so that he died,

verses.hebrew: אוֹ בְאֵיבָה הִכָּהוּ בְיָדוֹ וַיָּמֹת מוֹת יוּמַת הַמַּכֶּה רֹצֵחַ הוּא גֹּאֵל הַדָּם יָמִית אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ בְּפִגְעוֹ בוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ בְאֵיבָה הִכָּהוּ בְיָדוֹ וַיָּמֹת מוֹת יוּמַת הַמַּכֶּה רֹצֵחַ הוּא גֹּאֵל הַדָּם יָמִית אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ בְּפִגְעוֹ בוֹ׃

english.text:
or if he struck him with his hand in enmity so that he
died, the one who struck shall be put to death. He is a
murderer. The blood avenger shall kill the murderer when
he comes upon him.

translation.text: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.

verses.english:
or if he struck him with his hand in enmity so that he
died, the one who struck shall be put to death. He is a
murderer. The blood avenger shall kill the murderer when
he comes upon him.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּפֶתַע בְּלֹא אֵיבָה הֲדָפוֹ אוֹ הִשְׁלִיךְ עָלָיו כּל כְּלִי בְּלֹא צְדִיָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם בְּפֶתַע בְּלֹא אֵיבָה הֲדָפוֹ אוֹ הִשְׁלִיךְ עָלָיו כּל כְּלִי בְּלֹא צְדִיָּה׃

english.text:
But if by chance, not in enmity, he pushed him or threw
any object on him not through scheming,

translation.text: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,

verses.english:
But if by chance, not in enmity, he pushed him or threw
any object on him not through scheming,

verses.hebrew: אוֹ בְכל אֶבֶן אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בָּהּ בְּלֹא רְאוֹת וַיַּפֵּל עָלָיו וַיָּמֹת וְהוּא לֹא אוֹיֵב לוֹ וְלֹא מְבַקֵּשׁ רָעָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ בְכל אֶבֶן אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בָּהּ בְּלֹא רְאוֹת וַיַּפֵּל עָלָיו וַיָּמֹת וְהוּא לֹא אוֹיֵב לוֹ וְלֹא מְבַקֵּשׁ רָעָתוֹ׃

english.text:
or with any stone by which one could die, without seeing,
so that he dropped it on him so that he died, and he was
not an enemy to him and was not seeking to harm him,

translation.text: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:

verses.english:
or with any stone by which one could die, without seeing,
so that he dropped it on him so that he died, and he was
not an enemy to him and was not seeking to harm him,

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁפְטוּ הָעֵדָה בֵּין הַמַּכֶּה וּבֵין גֹּאֵל הַדָּם עַל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁפְטוּ הָעֵדָה בֵּין הַמַּכֶּה וּבֵין גֹּאֵל הַדָּם עַל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
then the congregation shall judge between the one who
struck and the blood avenger on the basis of these
judgments.

translation.text: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:

verses.english:
then the congregation shall judge between the one who
struck and the blood avenger on the basis of these
judgments.

verses.hebrew: וְהִצִּילוּ הָעֵדָה אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ מִיַּד גֹּאֵל הַדָּם וְהֵשִׁיבוּ אֹתוֹ הָעֵדָה אֶל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָס שָׁמָּה וְיָשַׁב בָּהּ עַד מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדֹל אֲשֶׁר מָשַׁח אֹתוֹ בְּשֶׁמֶן הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִצִּילוּ הָעֵדָה אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ מִיַּד גֹּאֵל הַדָּם וְהֵשִׁיבוּ אֹתוֹ הָעֵדָה אֶל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָס שָׁמָּה וְיָשַׁב בָּהּ עַד מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדֹל אֲשֶׁר מָשַׁח אֹתוֹ בְּשֶׁמֶן הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And the congregation shall rescue the manslayer from the
blood avenger’s hand, and the congregation shall bring him
back to his city of refuge to which he fled, and he shall
live in it until the death of the high priest whom one
anointed with the holy oil.

translation.text: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.

verses.english:
And the congregation shall rescue the manslayer from the
blood avenger’s hand, and the congregation shall bring him
back to his city of refuge to which he fled, and he shall
live in it until the death of the high priest whom one
anointed with the holy oil.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם יָצֹא יֵצֵא הָרֹצֵחַ אֶת גְּבוּל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָנוּס שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם יָצֹא יֵצֵא הָרֹצֵחַ אֶת גְּבוּל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָנוּס שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
But if the murderer will go out of the border of his city
of refuge to which he will flee,

translation.text: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;

verses.english:
But if the murderer will go out of the border of his city
of refuge to which he will flee,

verses.hebrew: וּמָצָא אֹתוֹ גֹּאֵל הַדָּם מִחוּץ לִגְבוּל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ וְרָצַח גֹּאֵל הַדָּם אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ אֵין לוֹ דָּם׃

hebrew.text: וּמָצָא אֹתוֹ גֹּאֵל הַדָּם מִחוּץ לִגְבוּל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ וְרָצַח גֹּאֵל הַדָּם אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ אֵין לוֹ דָּם׃

english.text:
and the blood avenger will find him outside of the border
of his city of refuge, and the blood avenger will murder
the murderer, he does not have blood,

translation.text: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:

verses.english:
and the blood avenger will find him outside of the border
of his city of refuge, and the blood avenger will murder
the murderer, he does not have blood,

verses.hebrew: כִּי בְעִיר מִקְלָטוֹ יֵשֵׁב עַד מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדֹל וְאַחֲרֵי מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדֹל יָשׁוּב הָרֹצֵחַ אֶל אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי בְעִיר מִקְלָטוֹ יֵשֵׁב עַד מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדֹל וְאַחֲרֵי מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדֹל יָשׁוּב הָרֹצֵחַ אֶל אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
because he shall live in his city of refuge until the high
priest’s death, and after the high priest’s death the
murderer shall go back to the land of his possession.

translation.text: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

verses.english:
because he shall live in his city of refuge until the high
priest’s death, and after the high priest’s death the
murderer shall go back to the land of his possession.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ אֵלֶּה לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת מִשְׁפָּט לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ אֵלֶּה לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת מִשְׁפָּט לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“And these shall become a law of judgment for you through
your generations in all your homes.

translation.text: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

verses.english:
“And these shall become a law of judgment for you through
your generations in all your homes.

verses.hebrew: כּל מַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ לְפִי עֵדִים יִרְצַח אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ וְעֵד אֶחָד לֹא יַעֲנֶה בְנֶפֶשׁ לָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: כּל מַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ לְפִי עֵדִים יִרְצַח אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ וְעֵד אֶחָד לֹא יַעֲנֶה בְנֶפֶשׁ לָמוּת׃

english.text:
Anyone who strikes a life, the murderer shall be murdered
by the mouth of witnesses. And one witness shall not
testify against a person so as to die.

translation.text: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.

verses.english:
Anyone who strikes a life, the murderer shall be murdered
by the mouth of witnesses. And one witness shall not
testify against a person so as to die.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תִקְחוּ כֹפֶר לְנֶפֶשׁ רֹצֵחַ אֲשֶׁר הוּא רָשָׁע לָמוּת כִּי מוֹת יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תִקְחוּ כֹפֶר לְנֶפֶשׁ רֹצֵחַ אֲשֶׁר הוּא רָשָׁע לָמוּת כִּי מוֹת יוּמָת׃

english.text:
And you shall not take a ransom for a murderer’s life,
because he did wrong so as to die, but he shall be put to
death.

translation.text: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.

verses.english:
And you shall not take a ransom for a murderer’s life,
because he did wrong so as to die, but he shall be put to
death.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תִקְחוּ כֹפֶר לָנוּס אֶל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ לָשׁוּב לָשֶׁבֶת בָּאָרֶץ עַד מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תִקְחוּ כֹפֶר לָנוּס אֶל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ לָשׁוּב לָשֶׁבֶת בָּאָרֶץ עַד מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
And you shall not take a ransom to flee to his city of
refuge, to go back to live in the land until the priest’s
death.

translation.text: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

verses.english:
And you shall not take a ransom to flee to his city of
refuge, to go back to live in the land until the priest’s
death.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תַחֲנִיפוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם בָּהּ כִּי הַדָּם הוּא יַחֲנִיף אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְלָאָרֶץ לֹא יְכֻפַּר לַדָּם אֲשֶׁר שֻׁפַּךְ בָּהּ כִּי אִם בְּדַם שֹׁפְכוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תַחֲנִיפוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם בָּהּ כִּי הַדָּם הוּא יַחֲנִיף אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְלָאָרֶץ לֹא יְכֻפַּר לַדָּם אֲשֶׁר שֻׁפַּךְ בָּהּ כִּי אִם בְּדַם שֹׁפְכוֹ׃

english.text:
So you shall not pollute the land in which you are.
Because blood: it will pollute the land, and the land will
not have expiation for blood that is spilled in it except
by the blood of the one who spilled it!

translation.text: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.

verses.english:
So you shall not pollute the land in which you are.
Because blood: it will pollute the land, and the land will
not have expiation for blood that is spilled in it except
by the blood of the one who spilled it!

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תְטַמֵּא אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי שֹׁכֵן בְּתוֹכָהּ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה שֹׁכֵן בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תְטַמֵּא אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי שֹׁכֵן בְּתוֹכָהּ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה שֹׁכֵן בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And you shall not make the land impure in which you are
living, in which I tent, because I, YHWH, tent among the
children of Israel.”

translation.text: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And you shall not make the land impure in which you are
living, in which I tent, because I, YHWH, tent among the
children of Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְבוּ רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְמִשְׁפַּחַת בְּנֵי גִלְעָד בֶּן מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף וַיְדַבְּרוּ לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וְלִפְנֵי הַנְּשִׂאִים רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְבוּ רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְמִשְׁפַּחַת בְּנֵי גִלְעָד בֶּן מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף וַיְדַבְּרוּ לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וְלִפְנֵי הַנְּשִׂאִים רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the heads of the fathers of the family of the
children of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, from the
families of the children of Joseph, came forward and spoke
in front of Moses and in front of the chieftains, heads of
fathers of the children of Israel.

translation.text: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:

verses.english:
And the heads of the fathers of the family of the
children of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, from the
families of the children of Joseph, came forward and spoke
in front of Moses and in front of the chieftains, heads of
fathers of the children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶת אֲדֹנִי צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לָתֵת אֶת הָאָרֶץ בְּנַחֲלָה בְּגוֹרָל לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאדֹנִי צֻוָּה בַיהֹוָה לָתֵת אֶת נַחֲלַת צְלפְחָד אָחִינוּ לִבְנֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶת אֲדֹנִי צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לָתֵת אֶת הָאָרֶץ בְּנַחֲלָה בְּגוֹרָל לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאדֹנִי צֻוָּה בַיהֹוָה לָתֵת אֶת נַחֲלַת צְלפְחָד אָחִינוּ לִבְנֹתָיו׃

english.text:
And they said, “YHWH commanded my lord to give the land as
legacy by lot to the children of Israel, and my lord was
commanded by YHWH to give the legacy of Zelophehad, our
brother, to his daughters.

translation.text: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.

verses.english:
And they said, “YHWH commanded my lord to give the land as
legacy by lot to the children of Israel, and my lord was
commanded by YHWH to give the legacy of Zelophehad, our
brother, to his daughters.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ לְאֶחָד מִבְּנֵי שִׁבְטֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְנָשִׁים וְנִגְרְעָה נַחֲלָתָן מִנַּחֲלַת אֲבֹתֵינוּ וְנוֹסַף עַל נַחֲלַת הַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶינָה לָהֶם וּמִגֹּרַל נַחֲלָתֵנוּ יִגָּרֵעַ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ לְאֶחָד מִבְּנֵי שִׁבְטֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְנָשִׁים וְנִגְרְעָה נַחֲלָתָן מִנַּחֲלַת אֲבֹתֵינוּ וְנוֹסַף עַל נַחֲלַת הַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶינָה לָהֶם וּמִגֹּרַל נַחֲלָתֵנוּ יִגָּרֵעַ׃

english.text:
If they will become wives to one of the sons of the tribes
of the children of Israel, then their legacy will be
subtracted from our fathers’ legacy and added onto the
legacy of the tribe to whom they will belong, and it will
be subtracted from our legacy by the lot.

translation.text: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.

verses.english:
If they will become wives to one of the sons of the tribes
of the children of Israel, then their legacy will be
subtracted from our fathers’ legacy and added onto the
legacy of the tribe to whom they will belong, and it will
be subtracted from our legacy by the lot.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם יִהְיֶה הַיֹּבֵל לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנוֹסְפָה נַחֲלָתָן עַל נַחֲלַת הַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶינָה לָהֶם וּמִנַּחֲלַת מַטֵּה אֲבֹתֵינוּ יִגָּרַע נַחֲלָתָן׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם יִהְיֶה הַיֹּבֵל לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנוֹסְפָה נַחֲלָתָן עַל נַחֲלַת הַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶינָה לָהֶם וּמִנַּחֲלַת מַטֵּה אֲבֹתֵינוּ יִגָּרַע נַחֲלָתָן׃

english.text:
And if the children of Israel will have the jubilee, then
their legacy will be added onto the legacy of the tribe to
whom they will belong, and their legacy will be subtracted
from the legacy of our fathers’ tribe.”

translation.text: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.

verses.english:
And if the children of Israel will have the jubilee, then
their legacy will be added onto the legacy of the tribe to
whom they will belong, and their legacy will be subtracted
from the legacy of our fathers’ tribe.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר כֵּן מַטֵּה בְנֵי יוֹסֵף דֹּבְרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר כֵּן מַטֵּה בְנֵי יוֹסֵף דֹּבְרִים׃

english.text:
And Moses commanded the children of Israel by YHWH’s word,
saying, “The children of Joseph speak right.

translation.text: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.

verses.english:
And Moses commanded the children of Israel by YHWH’s word,
saying, “The children of Joseph speak right.

verses.hebrew: זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לִבְנוֹת צְלפְחָד לֵאמֹר לַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵיהֶם תִּהְיֶינָה לְנָשִׁים אַךְ לְמִשְׁפַּחַת מַטֵּה אֲבִיהֶם תִּהְיֶינָה לְנָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לִבְנוֹת צְלפְחָד לֵאמֹר לַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵיהֶם תִּהְיֶינָה לְנָשִׁים אַךְ לְמִשְׁפַּחַת מַטֵּה אֲבִיהֶם תִּהְיֶינָה לְנָשִׁים׃

english.text:
This is the thing that YHWH has commanded Zelophehad’s
daughters, saying: They shall become wives for any in
whose eyes it is good, except: they shall become wives to
the family of their father’s tribe.

translation.text: This is the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.

verses.english:
This is the thing that YHWH has commanded Zelophehad’s
daughters, saying: They shall become wives for any in
whose eyes it is good, except: they shall become wives to
the family of their father’s tribe.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תִסֹּב נַחֲלָה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמַּטֶּה אֶל מַטֶּה כִּי אִישׁ בְּנַחֲלַת מַטֵּה אֲבֹתָיו יִדְבְּקוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תִסֹּב נַחֲלָה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמַּטֶּה אֶל מַטֶּה כִּי אִישׁ בְּנַחֲלַת מַטֵּה אֲבֹתָיו יִדְבְּקוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
So a legacy of the children of Israel will not turn from
tribe to tribe, but the children of Israel shall each
cling to the legacy of his fathers’ tribe.

translation.text: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

verses.english:
So a legacy of the children of Israel will not turn from
tribe to tribe, but the children of Israel shall each
cling to the legacy of his fathers’ tribe.

verses.hebrew: וְכל בַּת יֹרֶשֶׁת נַחֲלָה מִמַּטּוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאֶחָד מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת מַטֵּה אָבִיהָ תִּהְיֶה לְאִשָּׁה לְמַעַן יִירְשׁוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ נַחֲלַת אֲבֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְכל בַּת יֹרֶשֶׁת נַחֲלָה מִמַּטּוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאֶחָד מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת מַטֵּה אָבִיהָ תִּהְיֶה לְאִשָּׁה לְמַעַן יִירְשׁוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ נַחֲלַת אֲבֹתָיו׃

english.text:
And any daughter who inherits a legacy from the tribes of
the children of Israel shall become a wife to someone from
a family of her father’s tribe, so that the children of
Israel will each inherit his fathers’ legacy,

translation.text: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.

verses.english:
And any daughter who inherits a legacy from the tribes of
the children of Israel shall become a wife to someone from
a family of her father’s tribe, so that the children of
Israel will each inherit his fathers’ legacy,

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תִסֹּב נַחֲלָה מִמַּטֶּה לְמַטֶּה אַחֵר כִּי אִישׁ בְּנַחֲלָתוֹ יִדְבְּקוּ מַטּוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תִסֹּב נַחֲלָה מִמַּטֶּה לְמַטֶּה אַחֵר כִּי אִישׁ בְּנַחֲלָתוֹ יִדְבְּקוּ מַטּוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
and a legacy will not turn from a tribe to another tribe,
but the tribes of the children of Israel shall each cling
to its legacy.”

translation.text: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.

verses.english:
and a legacy will not turn from a tribe to another tribe,
but the tribes of the children of Israel shall each cling
to its legacy.”

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנוֹת צְלפְחָד׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנוֹת צְלפְחָד׃

english.text: As YHWH commanded Moses, so Zelophehad’s daughters did.

translation.text: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:

verses.english: As YHWH commanded Moses, so Zelophehad’s daughters did.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּהְיֶינָה מַחְלָה תִרְצָה וְחגְלָה וּמִלְכָּה וְנֹעָה בְּנוֹת צְלפְחָד לִבְנֵי דֹדֵיהֶן לְנָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּהְיֶינָה מַחְלָה תִרְצָה וְחגְלָה וּמִלְכָּה וְנֹעָה בְּנוֹת צְלפְחָד לִבְנֵי דֹדֵיהֶן לְנָשִׁים׃

english.text:
And Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah and Milcah and Noah,
Zelophehad’s daughters, became wives to their uncles’
sons.

translation.text: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father’s brothers’ sons:

verses.english:
And Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah and Milcah and Noah,
Zelophehad’s daughters, became wives to their uncles’
sons.

verses.hebrew: מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן יוֹסֵף הָיוּ לְנָשִׁים וַתְּהִי נַחֲלָתָן עַל מַטֵּה מִשְׁפַּחַת אֲבִיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן יוֹסֵף הָיוּ לְנָשִׁים וַתְּהִי נַחֲלָתָן עַל מַטֵּה מִשְׁפַּחַת אֲבִיהֶן׃

english.text:
They became wives within the families of the children of
Manasseh son of Joseph, and their legacy was on the tribe
of their father’s family.

translation.text: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

verses.english:
They became wives within the families of the children of
Manasseh son of Joseph, and their legacy was on the tribe
of their father’s family.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַמִּצְוֺת וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה הַמִּצְוֺת וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

english.text:
These are the commandments and the judgments that YHWH
commanded by Moses’ hand to the children of Israel in the
plains of Moab by the Jordan toward Jericho.

translation.text: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

verses.english:
These are the commandments and the judgments that YHWH
commanded by Moses’ hand to the children of Israel in the
plains of Moab by the Jordan toward Jericho.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בַּמִּדְבָּר בָּעֲרָבָה מוֹל סוּף בֵּין פָּארָן וּבֵין תֹּפֶל וְלָבָן וַחֲצֵרֹת וְדִי זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בַּמִּדְבָּר בָּעֲרָבָה מוֹל סוּף בֵּין פָּארָן וּבֵין תֹּפֶל וְלָבָן וַחֲצֵרֹת וְדִי זָהָב׃

english.text:
These are the words that Moses spoke to all of Israel
across the Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain opposite
Suph between Paran and Tophel and Laban and Hazeroth and
Di-zahab,

translation.text: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

verses.english:
These are the words that Moses spoke to all of Israel
across the Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain opposite
Suph between Paran and Tophel and Laban and Hazeroth and
Di-zahab,

verses.hebrew: אַחַד עָשָׂר יוֹם מֵחֹרֵב דֶּרֶךְ הַר שֵׂעִיר עַד קָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ׃

hebrew.text: אַחַד עָשָׂר יוֹם מֵחֹרֵב דֶּרֶךְ הַר שֵׂעִיר עַד קָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ׃

english.text:
eleven days from Horeb by way of Mount Seir up to
Kadesh-barnea.

translation.text: (There are eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadeshbarnea.)

verses.english:
eleven days from Horeb by way of Mount Seir up to
Kadesh-barnea.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בְּעַשְׁתֵּי עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ אֲלֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בְּעַשְׁתֵּי עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ אֲלֵהֶם׃

english.text:
And it was in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on
the first of the month, Moses spoke to the children of
Israel of everything that YHWH commanded him to them.

translation.text: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the LORD had given him in commandment unto them;

verses.english:
And it was in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on
the first of the month, Moses spoke to the children of
Israel of everything that YHWH commanded him to them.

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרֵי הַכֹּתוֹ אֵת סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֵת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּעַשְׁתָּרֹת בְּאֶדְרֶעִי׃

hebrew.text: אַחֲרֵי הַכֹּתוֹ אֵת סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֵת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּעַשְׁתָּרֹת בְּאֶדְרֶעִי׃

english.text:
After he struck Sihon, king of the Amorites, who lived in
Heshbon, and Og, king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth at
Edrei,

translation.text: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:

verses.english:
After he struck Sihon, king of the Amorites, who lived in
Heshbon, and Og, king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth at
Edrei,

verses.hebrew: בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב הוֹאִיל מֹשֶׁה בֵּאֵר אֶת הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב הוֹאִיל מֹשֶׁה בֵּאֵר אֶת הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
across the Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses undertook to
make this instruction clear, saying,

translation.text: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,

verses.english:
across the Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses undertook to
make this instruction clear, saying,

verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ דִּבֶּר אֵלֵינוּ בְּחֹרֵב לֵאמֹר רַב לָכֶם שֶׁבֶת בָּהָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ דִּבֶּר אֵלֵינוּ בְּחֹרֵב לֵאמֹר רַב לָכֶם שֶׁבֶת בָּהָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
“YHWH our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You’ve had
enough of staying at this mountain.

translation.text: The LORD our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:

verses.english:
“YHWH our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You’ve had
enough of staying at this mountain.

verses.hebrew: פְּנוּ וּסְעוּ לָכֶם וּבֹאוּ הַר הָאֱמֹרִי וְאֶל כּל שְׁכֵנָיו בָּעֲרָבָה בָהָר וּבַשְּׁפֵלָה וּבַנֶּגֶב וּבְחוֹף הַיָּם אֶרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַלְּבָנוֹן עַד הַנָּהָר הַגָּדֹל נְהַר פְּרָת׃

hebrew.text: פְּנוּ וּסְעוּ לָכֶם וּבֹאוּ הַר הָאֱמֹרִי וְאֶל כּל שְׁכֵנָיו בָּעֲרָבָה בָהָר וּבַשְּׁפֵלָה וּבַנֶּגֶב וּבְחוֹף הַיָּם אֶרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַלְּבָנוֹן עַד הַנָּהָר הַגָּדֹל נְהַר פְּרָת׃

english.text:
Turn and travel and come to the Amorite hill country and
to all its neighboring places, in the plain, in the hill
country, and in the lowland and in the Negeb and by the
seashore, the land of the Canaanite and Lebanon as far as
the big river, the Euphrates River.

translation.text: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.

verses.english:
Turn and travel and come to the Amorite hill country and
to all its neighboring places, in the plain, in the hill
country, and in the lowland and in the Negeb and by the
seashore, the land of the Canaanite and Lebanon as far as
the big river, the Euphrates River.

verses.hebrew: רְאֵה נָתַתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ בֹּאוּ וּרְשׁוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לָתֵת לָהֶם וּלְזַרְעָם אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: רְאֵה נָתַתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ בֹּאוּ וּרְשׁוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לָתֵת לָהֶם וּלְזַרְעָם אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
See: I’ve put the land in front of you. Come and possess
the land that YHWH swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to
Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them and to their seed
after them.’

translation.text: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.

verses.english:
See: I’ve put the land in front of you. Come and possess
the land that YHWH swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to
Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them and to their seed
after them.’

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אֲלֵכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר לֹא אוּכַל לְבַדִּי שְׂאֵת אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר אֲלֵכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר לֹא אוּכַל לְבַדִּי שְׂאֵת אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
“And I said to you at that time, saying, ‘I’m not able to
carry you by myself.

translation.text: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:

verses.english:
“And I said to you at that time, saying, ‘I’m not able to
carry you by myself.

verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הִרְבָּה אֶתְכֶם וְהִנְּכֶם הַיּוֹם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם לָרֹב׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הִרְבָּה אֶתְכֶם וְהִנְּכֶם הַיּוֹם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם לָרֹב׃

english.text:
YHWH, your God, has made you multiply, and here today
you’re like the stars of the skies for multitude.

translation.text: The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.

verses.english:
YHWH, your God, has made you multiply, and here today
you’re like the stars of the skies for multitude.

verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵכֶם יֹסֵף עֲלֵיכֶם כָּכֶם אֶלֶף פְּעָמִים וִיבָרֵךְ אֶתְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵכֶם יֹסֵף עֲלֵיכֶם כָּכֶם אֶלֶף פְּעָמִים וִיבָרֵךְ אֶתְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָכֶם׃

english.text:
(May YHWH, your fathers’ God, add on to you a thousand
times more like you! And may He bless you as He spoke to
you.)

translation.text: (The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)

verses.english:
(May YHWH, your fathers’ God, add on to you a thousand
times more like you! And may He bless you as He spoke to
you.)

verses.hebrew: אֵיכָה אֶשָּׂא לְבַדִּי טרְחֲכֶם וּמַשַּׂאֲכֶם וְרִיבְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אֵיכָה אֶשָּׂא לְבַדִּי טרְחֲכֶם וּמַשַּׂאֲכֶם וְרִיבְכֶם׃

english.text:
How shall I carry your stress and your burden and your
quarrels by myself?

translation.text: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?

verses.english:
How shall I carry your stress and your burden and your
quarrels by myself?

verses.hebrew: הָבוּ לָכֶם אֲנָשִׁים חֲכָמִים וּנְבֹנִים וִידֻעִים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם וַאֲשִׂימֵם בְּרָאשֵׁיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: הָבוּ לָכֶם אֲנָשִׁים חֲכָמִים וּנְבֹנִים וִידֻעִים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם וַאֲשִׂימֵם בְּרָאשֵׁיכֶם׃

english.text:
Get wise and understanding and knowledgeable people for
your tribes, and I’ll set them among your heads.’

translation.text: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.

verses.english:
Get wise and understanding and knowledgeable people for
your tribes, and I’ll set them among your heads.’

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲנוּ אֹתִי וַתֹּאמְרוּ טוֹב הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעֲנוּ אֹתִי וַתֹּאמְרוּ טוֹב הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

english.text:
“And you answered me, and you said, ‘The thing that you’ve
spoken is good to do.’

translation.text: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.

verses.english:
“And you answered me, and you said, ‘The thing that you’ve
spoken is good to do.’

verses.hebrew: וָאֶקַּח אֶת רָאשֵׁי שִׁבְטֵיכֶם אֲנָשִׁים חֲכָמִים וִידֻעִים וָאֶתֵּן אוֹתָם רָאשִׁים עֲלֵיכֶם שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי מֵאוֹת וְשָׂרֵי חֲמִשִּׁים וְשָׂרֵי עֲשָׂרֹת וְשֹׁטְרִים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶקַּח אֶת רָאשֵׁי שִׁבְטֵיכֶם אֲנָשִׁים חֲכָמִים וִידֻעִים וָאֶתֵּן אוֹתָם רָאשִׁים עֲלֵיכֶם שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי מֵאוֹת וְשָׂרֵי חֲמִשִּׁים וְשָׂרֵי עֲשָׂרֹת וְשֹׁטְרִים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“And I took heads of your tribes, wise and knowledgeable
people, and I set them as heads over you, chiefs of
thousands and chiefs of hundreds and chiefs of fifties and
chiefs of tens and officers for your tribes.

translation.text: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.

verses.english:
“And I took heads of your tribes, wise and knowledgeable
people, and I set them as heads over you, chiefs of
thousands and chiefs of hundreds and chiefs of fifties and
chiefs of tens and officers for your tribes.

verses.hebrew: וָאֲצַוֶּה אֶת שֹׁפְטֵיכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר שָׁמֹעַ בֵּין אֲחֵיכֶם וּשְׁפַטְתֶּם צֶדֶק בֵּין אִישׁ וּבֵין אָחִיו וּבֵין גֵּרוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וָאֲצַוֶּה אֶת שֹׁפְטֵיכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר שָׁמֹעַ בֵּין אֲחֵיכֶם וּשְׁפַטְתֶּם צֶדֶק בֵּין אִישׁ וּבֵין אָחִיו וּבֵין גֵּרוֹ׃

english.text:
And I commanded your judges at that time, saying, ‘Hear
between your brothers, and you shall judge with justice
between a man and his brother or between him and his
alien.

translation.text: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.

verses.english:
And I commanded your judges at that time, saying, ‘Hear
between your brothers, and you shall judge with justice
between a man and his brother or between him and his
alien.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תַכִּירוּ פָנִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט כַּקָּטֹן כַּגָּדֹל תִּשְׁמָעוּן לֹא תָגוּרוּ מִפְּנֵי אִישׁ כִּי הַמִּשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהִים הוּא וְהַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יִקְשֶׁה מִכֶּם תַּקְרִבוּן אֵלַי וּשְׁמַעְתִּיו׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַכִּירוּ פָנִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט כַּקָּטֹן כַּגָּדֹל תִּשְׁמָעוּן לֹא תָגוּרוּ מִפְּנֵי אִישׁ כִּי הַמִּשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהִים הוּא וְהַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יִקְשֶׁה מִכֶּם תַּקְרִבוּן אֵלַי וּשְׁמַעְתִּיו׃

english.text:
You shall not recognize a face in judgment: you shall hear
the same for small and for big. Don’t be fearful in front
of a man—because justice is God’s. And a matter that will
be too hard for you, you shall bring forward to me, and
I’ll hear it.’

translation.text: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God’s: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.

verses.english:
You shall not recognize a face in judgment: you shall hear
the same for small and for big. Don’t be fearful in front
of a man—because justice is God’s. And a matter that will
be too hard for you, you shall bring forward to me, and
I’ll hear it.’

verses.hebrew: וָאֲצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּן׃

hebrew.text: וָאֲצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּן׃

english.text:
And I commanded you at that time all the things that you
should do.

translation.text: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.

verses.english:
And I commanded you at that time all the things that you
should do.

verses.hebrew: וַנִּסַּע מֵחֹרֵב וַנֵּלֶךְ אֵת כּל הַמִּדְבָּר הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא הַהוּא אֲשֶׁר רְאִיתֶם דֶּרֶךְ הַר הָאֱמֹרִי כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֹתָנוּ וַנָּבֹא עַד קָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ׃

hebrew.text: וַנִּסַּע מֵחֹרֵב וַנֵּלֶךְ אֵת כּל הַמִּדְבָּר הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא הַהוּא אֲשֶׁר רְאִיתֶם דֶּרֶךְ הַר הָאֱמֹרִי כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֹתָנוּ וַנָּבֹא עַד קָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ׃

english.text:
“And we traveled from Horeb and went through all that big
and fearful wilderness that you’ve seen by way of the
Amorite hill country as YHWH, our God, commanded us, and
we came to Kadesh-barnea.

translation.text: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadeshbarnea.

verses.english:
“And we traveled from Horeb and went through all that big
and fearful wilderness that you’ve seen by way of the
Amorite hill country as YHWH, our God, commanded us, and
we came to Kadesh-barnea.

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אֲלֵכֶם בָּאתֶם עַד הַר הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נֹתֵן לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר אֲלֵכֶם בָּאתֶם עַד הַר הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נֹתֵן לָנוּ׃

english.text:
And I said to you, ‘You’ve come to the Amorite hill
country that YHWH, our God, is giving us.

translation.text: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give unto us.

verses.english:
And I said to you, ‘You’ve come to the Amorite hill
country that YHWH, our God, is giving us.

verses.hebrew: רְאֵה נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת הָאָרֶץ עֲלֵה רֵשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֶיךָ לָךְ אַל תִּירָא וְאַל תֵּחָת׃

hebrew.text: רְאֵה נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת הָאָרֶץ עֲלֵה רֵשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֶיךָ לָךְ אַל תִּירָא וְאַל תֵּחָת׃

english.text:
See: YHWH, our God, has put the land in front of you. Go
up, possess it as YHWH, your fathers’ God, spoke to you.
Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.’

translation.text: Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.

verses.english:
See: YHWH, our God, has put the land in front of you. Go
up, possess it as YHWH, your fathers’ God, spoke to you.
Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.’

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרְבוּן אֵלַי כֻּלְּכֶם וַתֹּאמְרוּ נִשְׁלְחָה אֲנָשִׁים לְפָנֵינוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ לָנוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְיָשִׁבוּ אֹתָנוּ דָּבָר אֶת הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר נַעֲלֶה בָּהּ וְאֵת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר נָבֹא אֲלֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקְרְבוּן אֵלַי כֻּלְּכֶם וַתֹּאמְרוּ נִשְׁלְחָה אֲנָשִׁים לְפָנֵינוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ לָנוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְיָשִׁבוּ אֹתָנוּ דָּבָר אֶת הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר נַעֲלֶה בָּהּ וְאֵת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר נָבֹא אֲלֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
“And you came forward to me, all of you, and said, ‘Let’s
send men ahead of us, and let them explore the land for us
and bring us back word of the way by which we’ll go up and
of the cities to which we’ll come.’

translation.text: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.

verses.english:
“And you came forward to me, all of you, and said, ‘Let’s
send men ahead of us, and let them explore the land for us
and bring us back word of the way by which we’ll go up and
of the cities to which we’ll come.’

verses.hebrew: וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינַי הַדָּבָר וָאֶקַּח מִכֶּם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֲנָשִׁים אִישׁ אֶחָד לַשָּׁבֶט׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינַי הַדָּבָר וָאֶקַּח מִכֶּם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֲנָשִׁים אִישׁ אֶחָד לַשָּׁבֶט׃

english.text:
And the thing was good in my eyes, and I took twelve men
from you, one man per tribe.

translation.text: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:

verses.english:
And the thing was good in my eyes, and I took twelve men
from you, one man per tribe.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ הָהָרָה וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד נַחַל אֶשְׁכֹּל וַיְרַגְּלוּ אֹתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ הָהָרָה וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד נַחַל אֶשְׁכֹּל וַיְרַגְּלוּ אֹתָהּ׃

english.text:
And they turned and went up to the hill country and came
to the Wadi Eshcol and spied it out.

translation.text: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.

verses.english:
And they turned and went up to the hill country and came
to the Wadi Eshcol and spied it out.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ בְיָדָם מִפְּרִי הָאָרֶץ וַיּוֹרִדוּ אֵלֵינוּ וַיָּשִׁבוּ אֹתָנוּ דָבָר וַיֹּאמְרוּ טוֹבָה הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נֹתֵן לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ בְיָדָם מִפְּרִי הָאָרֶץ וַיּוֹרִדוּ אֵלֵינוּ וַיָּשִׁבוּ אֹתָנוּ דָבָר וַיֹּאמְרוּ טוֹבָה הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נֹתֵן לָנוּ׃

english.text:
And they took some of the land’s fruit in their hand and
brought it down to us, and they brought us back word and
said, the land that YHWH, our God, is giving us is good.

translation.text: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.

verses.english:
And they took some of the land’s fruit in their hand and
brought it down to us, and they brought us back word and
said, the land that YHWH, our God, is giving us is good.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא אֲבִיתֶם לַעֲלֹת וַתַּמְרוּ אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא אֲבִיתֶם לַעֲלֹת וַתַּמְרוּ אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
But you weren’t willing to go up, and you rebelled against
the word of YHWH, your God,

translation.text: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:

verses.english:
But you weren’t willing to go up, and you rebelled against
the word of YHWH, your God,

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרָגְנוּ בְאהֳלֵיכֶם וַתֹּאמְרוּ בְּשִׂנְאַת יְהֹוָה אֹתָנוּ הוֹצִיאָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לָתֵת אֹתָנוּ בְּיַד הָאֱמֹרִי לְהַשְׁמִידֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרָגְנוּ בְאהֳלֵיכֶם וַתֹּאמְרוּ בְּשִׂנְאַת יְהֹוָה אֹתָנוּ הוֹצִיאָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לָתֵת אֹתָנוּ בְּיַד הָאֱמֹרִי לְהַשְׁמִידֵנוּ׃

english.text:
and you grumbled in your tents and said, ‘Because of
YHWH’s hatred for us He brought us out from the land of
Egypt, to put us in the Amorite’s hand to destroy us!

translation.text: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.

verses.english:
and you grumbled in your tents and said, ‘Because of
YHWH’s hatred for us He brought us out from the land of
Egypt, to put us in the Amorite’s hand to destroy us!

verses.hebrew: אָנָה אֲנַחְנוּ עֹלִים אַחֵינוּ הֵמַסּוּ אֶת לְבָבֵנוּ לֵאמֹר עַם גָּדוֹל וָרָם מִמֶּנּוּ עָרִים גְּדֹלֹת וּבְצוּרֹת בַּשָּׁמָיִם וְגַם בְּנֵי עֲנָקִים רָאִינוּ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: אָנָה אֲנַחְנוּ עֹלִים אַחֵינוּ הֵמַסּוּ אֶת לְבָבֵנוּ לֵאמֹר עַם גָּדוֹל וָרָם מִמֶּנּוּ עָרִים גְּדֹלֹת וּבְצוּרֹת בַּשָּׁמָיִם וְגַם בְּנֵי עֲנָקִים רָאִינוּ שָׁם׃

english.text:
To where are we going up? Our brothers have melted our
heart, saying, “We saw a bigger and taller people than we
are, big cities and fortified to the skies, and also
giants!”’

translation.text: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.

verses.english:
To where are we going up? Our brothers have melted our
heart, saying, “We saw a bigger and taller people than we
are, big cities and fortified to the skies, and also
giants!”’

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אֲלֵכֶם לֹא תַעַרְצוּן וְלֹא תִירְאוּן מֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר אֲלֵכֶם לֹא תַעַרְצוּן וְלֹא תִירְאוּן מֵהֶם׃

english.text:
“And I said to you, ‘Don’t be scared and don’t be afraid
of them.

translation.text: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.

verses.english:
“And I said to you, ‘Don’t be scared and don’t be afraid
of them.

verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הַהֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם הוּא יִלָּחֵם לָכֶם כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אִתְּכֶם בְּמִצְרַיִם לְעֵינֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הַהֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם הוּא יִלָּחֵם לָכֶם כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אִתְּכֶם בְּמִצְרַיִם לְעֵינֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
YHWH, your God, who is going in front of you, He will
fight for you—like everything that He did with you in
Egypt before your eyes

translation.text: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;

verses.english:
YHWH, your God, who is going in front of you, He will
fight for you—like everything that He did with you in
Egypt before your eyes

verses.hebrew: וּבַמִּדְבָּר אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתָ אֲשֶׁר נְשָׂאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִשָּׂא אִישׁ אֶת בְּנוֹ בְּכל הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הֲלַכְתֶּם עַד בֹּאֲכֶם עַד הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וּבַמִּדְבָּר אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתָ אֲשֶׁר נְשָׂאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִשָּׂא אִישׁ אֶת בְּנוֹ בְּכל הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הֲלַכְתֶּם עַד בֹּאֲכֶם עַד הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
and in the wilderness, as you’ve seen that YHWH, your God,
carried you the way a man would carry his child through
all the way that you’ve gone until you came to this place.

translation.text: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.

verses.english:
and in the wilderness, as you’ve seen that YHWH, your God,
carried you the way a man would carry his child through
all the way that you’ve gone until you came to this place.

verses.hebrew: וּבַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֵינְכֶם מַאֲמִינִם בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּבַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֵינְכֶם מַאֲמִינִם בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text: And in this thing, don’t you trust in YHWH, your God,

translation.text: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God,

verses.english: And in this thing, don’t you trust in YHWH, your God,

verses.hebrew: הַהֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם בַּדֶּרֶךְ לָתוּר לָכֶם מָקוֹם לַחֲנֹתְכֶם בָּאֵשׁ לַיְלָה לַרְאֹתְכֶם בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר תֵּלְכוּ בָהּ וּבֶעָנָן יוֹמָם׃
