hebrew.text: הַהֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם בַּדֶּרֶךְ לָתוּר לָכֶם מָקוֹם לַחֲנֹתְכֶם בָּאֵשׁ לַיְלָה לַרְאֹתְכֶם בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר תֵּלְכוּ בָהּ וּבֶעָנָן יוֹמָם׃

english.text:
who was going in front of you on the way to scout a
camping place for you, in fire at night to let you see the
way in which you would go, and in a cloud by day?!’

translation.text: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.

verses.english:
who was going in front of you on the way to scout a
camping place for you, in fire at night to let you see the
way in which you would go, and in a cloud by day?!’

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֶת קוֹל דִּבְרֵיכֶם וַיִּקְצֹף וַיִּשָּׁבַע לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֶת קוֹל דִּבְרֵיכֶם וַיִּקְצֹף וַיִּשָּׁבַע לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
“And YHWH heard the sound of your words and was angry and
swore, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,

verses.english:
“And YHWH heard the sound of your words and was angry and
swore, saying,

verses.hebrew: אִם יִרְאֶה אִישׁ בָּאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה הַדּוֹר הָרָע הַזֶּה אֵת הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לָתֵת לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אִם יִרְאֶה אִישׁ בָּאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה הַדּוֹר הָרָע הַזֶּה אֵת הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לָתֵת לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
‘Not a man of these people, this bad generation, will see
the good land that I swore to give to your fathers;

translation.text: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers.

verses.english:
‘Not a man of these people, this bad generation, will see
the good land that I swore to give to your fathers;

verses.hebrew: זוּלָתִי כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה הוּא יִרְאֶנָּה וְלוֹ אֶתֵּן אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר דָּרַךְ בָּהּ וּלְבָנָיו יַעַן אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּא אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: זוּלָתִי כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה הוּא יִרְאֶנָּה וְלוֹ אֶתֵּן אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר דָּרַךְ בָּהּ וּלְבָנָיו יַעַן אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּא אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
just Caleb son of Jephunneh: he will see it, and I shall
give the land on which he went to him and to his children

translation.text: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.

verses.english:
just Caleb son of Jephunneh: he will see it, and I shall
give the land on which he went to him and to his children
because he went after YHWH fully.’

verses.hebrew: גַּם בִּי הִתְאַנַּף יְהֹוָה בִּגְלַלְכֶם לֵאמֹר גַּם אַתָּה לֹא תָבֹא שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: גַּם בִּי הִתְאַנַּף יְהֹוָה בִּגְלַלְכֶם לֵאמֹר גַּם אַתָּה לֹא תָבֹא שָׁם׃

english.text:
(YHWH was incensed at me, too, because of you, saying,

(YHWH was incensed at me, too, because of you, saying,

hebrew.text: יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן הָעֹמֵד לְפָנֶיךָ הוּא יָבֹא שָׁמָּה אֹתוֹ חַזֵּק כִּי הוּא יַנְחִלֶנָּה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Joshua son of Nun, who is standing in front of you: he
shall come there. Strengthen him, because he shall get
Israel its legacy.’)

verses.english:
Joshua son of Nun, who is standing in front of you: he
shall come there. Strengthen him, because he shall get
Israel its legacy.’)

verses.hebrew: וְטַפְּכֶם אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם לָבַז יִהְיֶה וּבְנֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ הַיּוֹם טוֹב וָרָע הֵמָּה יָבֹאוּ שָׁמָּה וְלָהֶם אֶתְּנֶנָּה וְהֵם יִירָשׁוּהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְטַפְּכֶם אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם לָבַז יִהְיֶה וּבְנֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ הַיּוֹם טוֹב וָרָע הֵמָּה יָבֹאוּ שָׁמָּה וְלָהֶם אֶתְּנֶנָּה וְהֵם יִירָשׁוּהָ׃

english.text:
‘And your infants whom you said would become a spoil, and
your children today who haven’t known good and bad, they
will come there, and I’ll give it to them, and they will
possess it.

translation.text: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.

verses.english:
‘And your infants whom you said would become a spoil, and
your children today who haven’t known good and bad, they
will come there, and I’ll give it to them, and they will
possess it.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם פְּנוּ לָכֶם וּסְעוּ הַמִּדְבָּרָה דֶּרֶךְ יַם סוּף׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם פְּנוּ לָכֶם וּסְעוּ הַמִּדְבָּרָה דֶּרֶךְ יַם סוּף׃

english.text:
But you: turn and travel to the wilderness by way of the
Red Sea.’

translation.text: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

verses.english:
But you: turn and travel to the wilderness by way of the
Red Sea.’

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲנוּ וַתֹּאמְרוּ אֵלַי חָטָאנוּ לַיהֹוָה אֲנַחְנוּ נַעֲלֶה וְנִלְחַמְנוּ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַתַּחְגְּרוּ אִישׁ אֶת כְּלֵי מִלְחַמְתּוֹ וַתָּהִינוּ לַעֲלֹת הָהָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעֲנוּ וַתֹּאמְרוּ אֵלַי חָטָאנוּ לַיהֹוָה אֲנַחְנוּ נַעֲלֶה וְנִלְחַמְנוּ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַתַּחְגְּרוּ אִישׁ אֶת כְּלֵי מִלְחַמְתּוֹ וַתָּהִינוּ לַעֲלֹת הָהָרָה׃

english.text:
“And you answered and said to me, ‘We’ve sinned against
YHWH. We’ll go up! And we’ll fight, according to
everything that YHWH, our God, commanded us.’ And you each
put on his weapons of war, and you were willing to go up
to the hill country.

translation.text: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us.

verses.english:
“And you answered and said to me, ‘We’ve sinned against
YHWH. We’ll go up! And we’ll fight, according to
everything that YHWH, our God, commanded us.’ And you each
put on his weapons of war, and you were willing to go up
to the hill country.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אֱמֹר לָהֶם לֹא תַעֲלוּ וְלֹא תִלָּחֲמוּ כִּי אֵינֶנִּי בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וְלֹא תִּנָּגְפוּ לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אֱמֹר לָהֶם לֹא תַעֲלוּ וְלֹא תִלָּחֲמוּ כִּי אֵינֶנִּי בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וְלֹא תִּנָּגְפוּ לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“And YHWH said to me, ‘Say to them: You shall not go up,
and you shall not fight, because I am not among you, so
you won’t be stricken before your enemies.’

translation.text: And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.

verses.english:
“And YHWH said to me, ‘Say to them: You shall not go up,
and you shall not fight, because I am not among you, so
you won’t be stricken before your enemies.’

verses.hebrew: וָאֲדַבֵּר אֲלֵיכֶם וְלֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּם וַתַּמְרוּ אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה וַתָּזִדוּ וַתַּעֲלוּ הָהָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וָאֲדַבֵּר אֲלֵיכֶם וְלֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּם וַתַּמְרוּ אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה וַתָּזִדוּ וַתַּעֲלוּ הָהָרָה׃

english.text:
And I spoke to you, but you didn’t listen, and you
rebelled against YHWH’s word and acted presumptuously and
went up to the hill country.

translation.text: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and went presumptuously up into the hill.

verses.english:
And I spoke to you, but you didn’t listen, and you
rebelled against YHWH’s word and acted presumptuously and
went up to the hill country.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הָאֱמֹרִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּהָר הַהוּא לִקְרַאתְכֶם וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אֶתְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂינָה הַדְּבֹרִים וַיַּכְּתוּ אֶתְכֶם בְּשֵׂעִיר עַד חרְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא הָאֱמֹרִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּהָר הַהוּא לִקְרַאתְכֶם וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אֶתְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂינָה הַדְּבֹרִים וַיַּכְּתוּ אֶתְכֶם בְּשֵׂעִיר עַד חרְמָה׃

english.text:
And the Amorite who lives in that hill country came out at
you and pursued you the way bees do, and they crushed you
in Seir as far as Hormah.

translation.text: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.

verses.english:
And the Amorite who lives in that hill country came out at
you and pursued you the way bees do, and they crushed you
in Seir as far as Hormah.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּשֻׁבוּ וַתִּבְכּוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה בְּקֹלְכֶם וְלֹא הֶאֱזִין אֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּשֻׁבוּ וַתִּבְכּוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה בְּקֹלְכֶם וְלֹא הֶאֱזִין אֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And you came back and wept in front of YHWH, but YHWH
didn’t listen to your voices and didn’t hear you!

translation.text: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.

verses.english:
And you came back and wept in front of YHWH, but YHWH
didn’t listen to your voices and didn’t hear you!

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בְקָדֵשׁ יָמִים רַבִּים כַּיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר יְשַׁבְתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בְקָדֵשׁ יָמִים רַבִּים כַּיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר יְשַׁבְתֶּם׃

english.text:
“So you lived in Kadesh many days—as many days as you
lived there—

translation.text: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.

verses.english:
“So you lived in Kadesh many days—as many days as you
lived there—

verses.hebrew: וַנֵּפֶן וַנִּסַּע הַמִּדְבָּרָה דֶּרֶךְ יַם סוּף כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֵלָי וַנָּסב אֶת הַר שֵׂעִיר יָמִים רַבִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַנֵּפֶן וַנִּסַּע הַמִּדְבָּרָה דֶּרֶךְ יַם סוּף כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֵלָי וַנָּסב אֶת הַר שֵׂעִיר יָמִים רַבִּים׃

english.text:
and we turned and traveled to the wilderness by way of
the Red Sea as YHWH spoke to me, and we stayed around
Mount Seir many days.

translation.text: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.

verses.english:
and we turned and traveled to the wilderness by way of
the Red Sea as YHWH spoke to me, and we stayed around
Mount Seir many days.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: “And YHWH said to me, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto me, saying,

verses.english: “And YHWH said to me, saying,

verses.hebrew: רַב לָכֶם סֹב אֶת הָהָר הַזֶּה פְּנוּ לָכֶם צָפֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: רַב לָכֶם סֹב אֶת הָהָר הַזֶּה פְּנוּ לָכֶם צָפֹנָה׃

english.text:
‘You’ve had enough of staying around this mountain. Turn
north.

translation.text: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.

verses.english:
‘You’ve had enough of staying around this mountain. Turn
north.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָעָם צַו לֵאמֹר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים בִּגְבוּל אֲחֵיכֶם בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּשֵׂעִיר וְיִירְאוּ מִכֶּם וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָעָם צַו לֵאמֹר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים בִּגְבוּל אֲחֵיכֶם בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּשֵׂעִיר וְיִירְאוּ מִכֶּם וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And command the people, saying: You’re crossing the border
of your brothers, the children of Esau, who live in Seir.
And they’ll be afraid of you, so be very watchful.

translation.text: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:

verses.english:
And command the people, saying: You’re crossing the border
of your brothers, the children of Esau, who live in Seir.
And they’ll be afraid of you, so be very watchful.

verses.hebrew: אַל תִּתְגָּרוּ בָם כִּי לֹא אֶתֵּן לָכֶם מֵאַרְצָם עַד מִדְרַךְ כַּף רָגֶל כִּי יְרֻשָּׁה לְעֵשָׂו נָתַתִּי אֶת הַר שֵׂעִיר׃

hebrew.text: אַל תִּתְגָּרוּ בָם כִּי לֹא אֶתֵּן לָכֶם מֵאַרְצָם עַד מִדְרַךְ כַּף רָגֶל כִּי יְרֻשָּׁה לְעֵשָׂו נָתַתִּי אֶת הַר שֵׂעִיר׃

english.text:
Don’t get agitated at them, because I won’t give you any
of their land, even as much as a footstep, because I’ve
given Mount Seir to Esau as a possession.

translation.text: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.

verses.english:
Don’t get agitated at them, because I won’t give you any
of their land, even as much as a footstep, because I’ve
given Mount Seir to Esau as a possession.

verses.hebrew: אֹכֶל תִּשְׁבְּרוּ מֵאִתָּם בַּכֶּסֶף וַאֲכַלְתֶּם וְגַם מַיִם תִּכְרוּ מֵאִתָּם בַּכֶּסֶף וּשְׁתִיתֶם׃

hebrew.text: אֹכֶל תִּשְׁבְּרוּ מֵאִתָּם בַּכֶּסֶף וַאֲכַלְתֶּם וְגַם מַיִם תִּכְרוּ מֵאִתָּם בַּכֶּסֶף וּשְׁתִיתֶם׃

english.text:
Food: you shall buy from them with money, and then you’ll
eat. And water, too: you shall purchase from them with
money, and then you’ll drink.

translation.text: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.

verses.english:
Food: you shall buy from them with money, and then you’ll
eat. And water, too: you shall purchase from them with
money, and then you’ll drink.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בֵּרַכְךָ בְּכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶךָ יָדַע לֶכְתְּךָ אֶת הַמִּדְבָּר הַגָּדֹל הַזֶּה זֶה אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עִמָּךְ לֹא חָסַרְתָּ דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בֵּרַכְךָ בְּכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶךָ יָדַע לֶכְתְּךָ אֶת הַמִּדְבָּר הַגָּדֹל הַזֶּה זֶה אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עִמָּךְ לֹא חָסַרְתָּ דָּבָר׃

english.text:
Because YHWH, your God, has blessed you in all your hand’s
work. He has known your walking in this big wilderness.
These forty years, YHWH, your God, has been with you. You
haven’t lacked a thing.’

translation.text: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.

verses.english:
Because YHWH, your God, has blessed you in all your hand’s
work. He has known your walking in this big wilderness.
These forty years, YHWH, your God, has been with you. You
haven’t lacked a thing.’

verses.hebrew: וַנַּעֲבֹר מֵאֵת אַחֵינוּ בְנֵי עֵשָׂו הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּשֵׂעִיר מִדֶּרֶךְ הָעֲרָבָה מֵאֵילַת וּמֵעֶצְיֹן גָּבֶר ס וַנֵּפֶן וַנַּעֲבֹר דֶּרֶךְ מִדְבַּר מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וַנַּעֲבֹר מֵאֵת אַחֵינוּ בְנֵי עֵשָׂו הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּשֵׂעִיר מִדֶּרֶךְ הָעֲרָבָה מֵאֵילַת וּמֵעֶצְיֹן גָּבֶר ס וַנֵּפֶן וַנַּעֲבֹר דֶּרֶךְ מִדְבַּר מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
So we passed by our brothers, the children of Esau, who
live in Seir, from the way of the plain, from Eilat, and
from Ezion-geber, and we turned and passed by way of the
wilderness of Moab.

translation.text: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Eziongaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

verses.english:
So we passed by our brothers, the children of Esau, who
live in Seir, from the way of the plain, from Eilat, and
from Ezion-geber, and we turned and passed by way of the
wilderness of Moab.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אַל תָּצַר אֶת מוֹאָב וְאַל תִּתְגָּר בָּם מִלְחָמָה כִּי לֹא אֶתֵּן לְךָ מֵאַרְצוֹ יְרֻשָּׁה כִּי לִבְנֵי לוֹט נָתַתִּי אֶת עָר יְרֻשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אַל תָּצַר אֶת מוֹאָב וְאַל תִּתְגָּר בָּם מִלְחָמָה כִּי לֹא אֶתֵּן לְךָ מֵאַרְצוֹ יְרֻשָּׁה כִּי לִבְנֵי לוֹט נָתַתִּי אֶת עָר יְרֻשָּׁה׃

english.text:
“And YHWH said to me, ‘Don’t oppose Moab and don’t agitate
them with war, because I won’t give you a possession from
its land, because I’ve given Ar as a possession to the
children of Lot.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.

verses.english:
“And YHWH said to me, ‘Don’t oppose Moab and don’t agitate
them with war, because I won’t give you a possession from
its land, because I’ve given Ar as a possession to the
children of Lot.

verses.hebrew: הָאֵמִים לְפָנִים יָשְׁבוּ בָהּ עַם גָּדוֹל וְרַב וָרָם כָּעֲנָקִים׃

hebrew.text: הָאֵמִים לְפָנִים יָשְׁבוּ בָהּ עַם גָּדוֹל וְרַב וָרָם כָּעֲנָקִים׃

english.text:
The Emim had lived there before, a people that was big and
numerous and tall as giants.

translation.text: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;

verses.english:
The Emim had lived there before, a people that was big and
numerous and tall as giants.

verses.hebrew: רְפָאִים יֵחָשְׁבוּ אַף הֵם כָּעֲנָקִים וְהַמֹּאָבִים יִקְרְאוּ לָהֶם אֵמִים׃

hebrew.text: רְפָאִים יֵחָשְׁבוּ אַף הֵם כָּעֲנָקִים וְהַמֹּאָבִים יִקְרְאוּ לָהֶם אֵמִים׃

english.text:
They were also thought to be Rephaim, like the giants, but
the Moabites call them Emim.

translation.text: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites called them Emims.

verses.english:
They were also thought to be Rephaim, like the giants, but
the Moabites call them Emim.

verses.hebrew: וּבְשֵׂעִיר יָשְׁבוּ הַחֹרִים לְפָנִים וּבְנֵי עֵשָׂו יִירָשׁוּם וַיַּשְׁמִידוּם מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַּחְתָּם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאֶרֶץ יְרֻשָּׁתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְשֵׂעִיר יָשְׁבוּ הַחֹרִים לְפָנִים וּבְנֵי עֵשָׂו יִירָשׁוּם וַיַּשְׁמִידוּם מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַּחְתָּם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאֶרֶץ יְרֻשָּׁתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה לָהֶם׃

english.text:
And the Horites lived in Seir before, but the children of
Esau dispossessed them and destroyed them in front of them
and lived in their place, as Israel did to the land of its
possession that YHWH gave them.

translation.text: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.

verses.english:
And the Horites lived in Seir before, but the children of
Esau dispossessed them and destroyed them in front of them
and lived in their place, as Israel did to the land of its
possession that YHWH gave them.

verses.hebrew: עַתָּה קֻמוּ וְעִבְרוּ לָכֶם אֶת נַחַל זָרֶד וַנַּעֲבֹר אֶת נַחַל זָרֶד׃

hebrew.text: עַתָּה קֻמוּ וְעִבְרוּ לָכֶם אֶת נַחַל זָרֶד וַנַּעֲבֹר אֶת נַחַל זָרֶד׃

english.text:
Now get up and cross the Wadi Zered.’ And we crossed the
Wadi Zered.

translation.text: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.

verses.english:
Now get up and cross the Wadi Zered.’ And we crossed the
Wadi Zered.

verses.hebrew: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְנוּ מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ עַד אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ אֶת נַחַל זֶרֶד שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה עַד תֹּם כּל הַדּוֹר אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה מִקֶּרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְנוּ מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ עַד אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ אֶת נַחַל זֶרֶד שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה עַד תֹּם כּל הַדּוֹר אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה מִקֶּרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לָהֶם׃

english.text:
And the days that we went from Kadesh-barnea until we
crossed the Wadi Zered were thirty-eight years, until the
end of all the generation, the men of war, from among the
camp, as YHWH swore to them.

translation.text: And the space in which we came from Kadeshbarnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the LORD sware unto them.

verses.english:
And the days that we went from Kadesh-barnea until we
crossed the Wadi Zered were thirty-eight years, until the
end of all the generation, the men of war, from among the
camp, as YHWH swore to them.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם יַד יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה בָּם לְהֻמָּם מִקֶּרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה עַד תֻּמָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם יַד יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה בָּם לְהֻמָּם מִקֶּרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה עַד תֻּמָּם׃

english.text:
And YHWH’s hand was against them, to eliminate them from
among the camp until their end.

translation.text: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.

verses.english:
And YHWH’s hand was against them, to eliminate them from
among the camp until their end.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַאֲשֶׁר תַּמּוּ כּל אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה לָמוּת מִקֶּרֶב הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַאֲשֶׁר תַּמּוּ כּל אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה לָמוּת מִקֶּרֶב הָעָם׃

english.text:
“And it was when all the men of war had ended, dying from
among the people,

translation.text: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

verses.english:
“And it was when all the men of war had ended, dying from
among the people,

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: and YHWH spoke to me, saying,

translation.text: That the LORD spake unto me, saying,

verses.english: and YHWH spoke to me, saying,

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה עֹבֵר הַיּוֹם אֶת גְּבוּל מוֹאָב אֶת עָר׃

hebrew.text: אַתָּה עֹבֵר הַיּוֹם אֶת גְּבוּל מוֹאָב אֶת עָר׃

english.text: ‘You’re crossing the border of Moab, Ar, today.

translation.text: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:

verses.english: ‘You’re crossing the border of Moab, Ar, today.

verses.hebrew: וְקָרַבְתָּ מוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן אַל תְּצֻרֵם וְאַל תִּתְגָּר בָּם כִּי לֹא אֶתֵּן מֵאֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן לְךָ יְרֻשָּׁה כִּי לִבְנֵי לוֹט נְתַתִּיהָ יְרֻשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְקָרַבְתָּ מוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן אַל תְּצֻרֵם וְאַל תִּתְגָּר בָּם כִּי לֹא אֶתֵּן מֵאֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן לְךָ יְרֻשָּׁה כִּי לִבְנֵי לוֹט נְתַתִּיהָ יְרֻשָּׁה׃

english.text:
And when you come close opposite the children of Ammon,
don’t oppose them and don’t get agitated at them, because
I won’t give you a possession from the land of the
children of Ammon, because I’ve given it as a possession
to the children of Lot.’

translation.text: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.

verses.english:
And when you come close opposite the children of Ammon,
don’t oppose them and don’t get agitated at them, because
I won’t give you a possession from the land of the
children of Ammon, because I’ve given it as a possession
to the children of Lot.’

verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ רְפָאִים תֵּחָשֵׁב אַף הִוא רְפָאִים יָשְׁבוּ בָהּ לְפָנִים וְהָעַמֹּנִים יִקְרְאוּ לָהֶם זַמְזֻמִּים׃

hebrew.text: אֶרֶץ רְפָאִים תֵּחָשֵׁב אַף הִוא רְפָאִים יָשְׁבוּ בָהּ לְפָנִים וְהָעַמֹּנִים יִקְרְאוּ לָהֶם זַמְזֻמִּים׃

english.text:
(It, too, was thought to be a land of Rephaim: Rephaim had
lived there before, and the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,

translation.text: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;

verses.english:
(It, too, was thought to be a land of Rephaim: Rephaim had
lived there before, and the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,

verses.hebrew: עַם גָּדוֹל וְרַב וָרָם כָּעֲנָקִים וַיַּשְׁמִידֵם יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיִּירָשֻׁם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּם׃

hebrew.text: עַם גָּדוֹל וְרַב וָרָם כָּעֲנָקִים וַיַּשְׁמִידֵם יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיִּירָשֻׁם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּם׃

english.text:
a people that was big and numerous and tall as giants, but
YHWH destroyed them in front of them, and they
dispossessed them and lived in their place,

translation.text: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:

verses.english:
a people that was big and numerous and tall as giants, but
YHWH destroyed them in front of them, and they
dispossessed them and lived in their place,

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִבְנֵי עֵשָׂו הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּשֵׂעִיר אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁמִיד אֶת הַחֹרִי מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיִּירָשֻׁם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִבְנֵי עֵשָׂו הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּשֵׂעִיר אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁמִיד אֶת הַחֹרִי מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיִּירָשֻׁם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
as He did for the children of Esau, who live in Seir, in
that He destroyed the Horite in front of them, and they
dispossessed them and have lived in their place to this
day.

translation.text: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:

verses.english:
as He did for the children of Esau, who live in Seir, in
that He destroyed the Horite in front of them, and they
dispossessed them and have lived in their place to this
day.

verses.hebrew: וְהָעַוִּים הַיֹּשְׁבִים בַּחֲצֵרִים עַד עַזָּה כַּפְתֹּרִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִכַּפְתֹּר הִשְׁמִידֻם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעַוִּים הַיֹּשְׁבִים בַּחֲצֵרִים עַד עַזָּה כַּפְתֹּרִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִכַּפְתֹּר הִשְׁמִידֻם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּם׃

english.text:
So the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the
Caphtorites who left Caphtor destroyed them, and they
dwelled in their place.)

translation.text: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)

verses.english:
So the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the
Caphtorites who left Caphtor destroyed them, and they
dwelled in their place.)

verses.hebrew: קוּמוּ סְּעוּ וְעִבְרוּ אֶת נַחַל אַרְנֹן רְאֵה נָתַתִּי בְיָדְךָ אֶת סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הָאֱמֹרִי וְאֶת אַרְצוֹ הָחֵל רָשׁ וְהִתְגָּר בּוֹ מִלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: קוּמוּ סְּעוּ וְעִבְרוּ אֶת נַחַל אַרְנֹן רְאֵה נָתַתִּי בְיָדְךָ אֶת סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הָאֱמֹרִי וְאֶת אַרְצוֹ הָחֵל רָשׁ וְהִתְגָּר בּוֹ מִלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
‘Get up, travel, and cross the Wadi Arnon. See: I’ve put
Sihon, king of Heshbon, the Amorite, and his land in your
hand. Begin. Dispossess! And you shall agitate him with
war.

translation.text: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.

verses.english:
‘Get up, travel, and cross the Wadi Arnon. See: I’ve put
Sihon, king of Heshbon, the Amorite, and his land in your
hand. Begin. Dispossess! And you shall agitate him with
war.

verses.hebrew: הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אָחֵל תֵּת פַּחְדְּךָ וְיִרְאָתְךָ עַל פְּנֵי הָעַמִּים תַּחַת כּל הַשָּׁמָיִם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁמְעוּן שִׁמְעֲךָ וְרָגְזוּ וְחָלוּ מִפָּנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אָחֵל תֵּת פַּחְדְּךָ וְיִרְאָתְךָ עַל פְּנֵי הָעַמִּים תַּחַת כּל הַשָּׁמָיִם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁמְעוּן שִׁמְעֲךָ וְרָגְזוּ וְחָלוּ מִפָּנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
This day I’ll begin to put an awe of you and a fear of you
on the faces of the peoples under all the skies so that
when they’ll hear the news of you they’ll tremble and
writhe in front of you.’

translation.text: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.

verses.english:
This day I’ll begin to put an awe of you and a fear of you
on the faces of the peoples under all the skies so that
when they’ll hear the news of you they’ll tremble and
writhe in front of you.’

verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים מִמִּדְבַּר קְדֵמוֹת אֶל סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן דִּבְרֵי שָׁלוֹם לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים מִמִּדְבַּר קְדֵמוֹת אֶל סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן דִּבְרֵי שָׁלוֹם לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
“And I sent messengers from the wilderness of Kedemoth to
Sihon, king of Heshbon, words of peace, saying,

translation.text: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

verses.english:
“And I sent messengers from the wilderness of Kedemoth to
Sihon, king of Heshbon, words of peace, saying,

verses.hebrew: אֶעְבְּרָה בְאַרְצֶךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֵלֵךְ לֹא אָסוּר יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול׃

hebrew.text: אֶעְבְּרָה בְאַרְצֶךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֵלֵךְ לֹא אָסוּר יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול׃

english.text:
‘Let me pass through your land. I’ll go on the road, on
the road! I won’t turn right or left.

translation.text: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.

verses.english:
‘Let me pass through your land. I’ll go on the road, on
the road! I won’t turn right or left.

verses.hebrew: אֹכֶל בַּכֶּסֶף תַּשְׁבִּרֵנִי וְאָכַלְתִּי וּמַיִם בַּכֶּסֶף תִּתֶּן לִי וְשָׁתִיתִי רַק אֶעְבְּרָה בְרַגְלָי׃

hebrew.text: אֹכֶל בַּכֶּסֶף תַּשְׁבִּרֵנִי וְאָכַלְתִּי וּמַיִם בַּכֶּסֶף תִּתֶּן לִי וְשָׁתִיתִי רַק אֶעְבְּרָה בְרַגְלָי׃

english.text:
Food: you’ll sell me for money, and I’ll eat. And water:
you’ll give me for money, and I’ll drink. Only let me pass
on my feet

translation.text: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;

verses.english:
Food: you’ll sell me for money, and I’ll eat. And water:
you’ll give me for money, and I’ll drink. Only let me pass
on my feet

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ לִי בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּשֵׂעִיר וְהַמּוֹאָבִים הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּעָר עַד אֲשֶׁר אֶעֱבֹר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נֹתֵן לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ לִי בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּשֵׂעִיר וְהַמּוֹאָבִים הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּעָר עַד אֲשֶׁר אֶעֱבֹר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נֹתֵן לָנוּ׃

english.text:
as the children of Esau, who live in Seir, and the
Moabites who live in Ar did for me, until I’ll cross the
Jordan to the land that YHWH, our God, is giving us.’

translation.text: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.

verses.english:
as the children of Esau, who live in Seir, and the
Moabites who live in Ar did for me, until I’ll cross the
Jordan to the land that YHWH, our God, is giving us.’

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא אָבָה סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הַעֲבִרֵנוּ בּוֹ כִּי הִקְשָׁה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת רוּחוֹ וְאִמֵּץ אֶת לְבָבוֹ לְמַעַן תִּתּוֹ בְיָדְךָ כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא אָבָה סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הַעֲבִרֵנוּ בּוֹ כִּי הִקְשָׁה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת רוּחוֹ וְאִמֵּץ אֶת לְבָבוֹ לְמַעַן תִּתּוֹ בְיָדְךָ כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
But Sihon, king of Heshbon, was not willing to let us pass
through it, because YHWH, your God, had hardened his
spirit and made his heart bold in order to put him in your
hand—as it is this day.

translation.text: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.

verses.english:
But Sihon, king of Heshbon, was not willing to let us pass
through it, because YHWH, your God, had hardened his
spirit and made his heart bold in order to put him in your
hand—as it is this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי רְאֵה הַחִלֹּתִי תֵּת לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת סִיחֹן וְאֶת אַרְצוֹ הָחֵל רָשׁ לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת אַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי רְאֵה הַחִלֹּתִי תֵּת לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת סִיחֹן וְאֶת אַרְצוֹ הָחֵל רָשׁ לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת אַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
“And YHWH said to me, ‘See: I’ve begun to put Sihon and
his land before you. Begin. Dispossess, so as to possess
his land.’

translation.text: And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.

verses.english:
“And YHWH said to me, ‘See: I’ve begun to put Sihon and
his land before you. Begin. Dispossess, so as to possess
his land.’

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא סִיחֹן לִקְרָאתֵנוּ הוּא וְכל עַמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה יָהְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא סִיחֹן לִקְרָאתֵנוּ הוּא וְכל עַמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה יָהְצָה׃

english.text:
“And Sihon came out at us, he and all his people, for war
at Jahaz.

translation.text: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

verses.english:
“And Sihon came out at us, he and all his people, for war
at Jahaz.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְפָנֵינוּ וַנַּךְ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת בָּנָו וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְפָנֵינוּ וַנַּךְ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת בָּנָו וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH, our God, put him before us, and we struck him
and his sons and all his people.

translation.text: And the LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.

verses.english:
And YHWH, our God, put him before us, and we struck him
and his sons and all his people.

verses.hebrew: וַנִּלְכֹּד אֶת כּל עָרָיו בָּעֵת הַהִוא וַנַּחֲרֵם אֶת כּל עִיר מְתִם וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַטָּף לֹא הִשְׁאַרְנוּ שָׂרִיד׃

hebrew.text: וַנִּלְכֹּד אֶת כּל עָרָיו בָּעֵת הַהִוא וַנַּחֲרֵם אֶת כּל עִיר מְתִם וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַטָּף לֹא הִשְׁאַרְנוּ שָׂרִיד׃

english.text:
And we captured all his cities at that time, and we put
every city to complete destruction: men and women and
infants. We didn’t leave a remnant.

translation.text: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:

verses.english:
And we captured all his cities at that time, and we put
every city to complete destruction: men and women and
infants. We didn’t leave a remnant.

verses.hebrew: רַק הַבְּהֵמָה בָּזַזְנוּ לָנוּ וּשְׁלַל הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר לָכָדְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: רַק הַבְּהֵמָה בָּזַזְנוּ לָנוּ וּשְׁלַל הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר לָכָדְנוּ׃

english.text:
Only the animals we despoiled for ourselves, and the spoil
of the cities that we captured.

translation.text: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.

verses.english:
Only the animals we despoiled for ourselves, and the spoil
of the cities that we captured.

verses.hebrew: מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל שְׂפַת נַחַל אַרְנֹן וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בַּנַּחַל וְעַד הַגִּלְעָד לֹא הָיְתָה קִרְיָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂגְבָה מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת הַכֹּל נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְפָנֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל שְׂפַת נַחַל אַרְנֹן וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בַּנַּחַל וְעַד הַגִּלְעָד לֹא הָיְתָה קִרְיָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂגְבָה מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת הַכֹּל נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְפָנֵינוּ׃

english.text:
From Aroer, which is on the edge of the Wadi Arnon and the
city that is in the wadi, to Gilead, there wasn’t a town
that was too high for us. YHWH, our God, put it all before
us.

translation.text: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto us:

verses.english:
From Aroer, which is on the edge of the Wadi Arnon and the
city that is in the wadi, to Gilead, there wasn’t a town
that was too high for us. YHWH, our God, put it all before
us.

verses.hebrew: רַק אֶל אֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן לֹא קָרָבְתָּ כּל יַד נַחַל יַבֹּק וְעָרֵי הָהָר וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: רַק אֶל אֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן לֹא קָרָבְתָּ כּל יַד נַחַל יַבֹּק וְעָרֵי הָהָר וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text:
Only to the land of the children of Ammon did you not come
close, all along the Wadi Jabbok, and the cities of the
hill country, and whatever YHWH, our God, commanded.

translation.text: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the LORD our God forbad us.

verses.english:
Only to the land of the children of Ammon did you not come
close, all along the Wadi Jabbok, and the cities of the
hill country, and whatever YHWH, our God, commanded.

verses.hebrew: וַנֵּפֶן וַנַּעַל דֶּרֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וַיֵּצֵא עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן לִקְרָאתֵנוּ הוּא וְכל עַמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה אֶדְרֶעִי׃

hebrew.text: וַנֵּפֶן וַנַּעַל דֶּרֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וַיֵּצֵא עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן לִקְרָאתֵנוּ הוּא וְכל עַמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה אֶדְרֶעִי׃

english.text:
“And we turned and went up the way to Bashan. And Og,
king of Bashan, came out at us, he and all his people, for
war at Edrei.

translation.text: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

verses.english:
“And we turned and went up the way to Bashan. And Og,
king of Bashan, came out at us, he and all his people, for
war at Edrei.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אַל תִּירָא אֹתוֹ כִּי בְיָדְךָ נָתַתִּי אֹתוֹ וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ וְאֶת אַרְצוֹ וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לְסִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אַל תִּירָא אֹתוֹ כִּי בְיָדְךָ נָתַתִּי אֹתוֹ וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ וְאֶת אַרְצוֹ וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לְסִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to me, ‘Don’t be afraid of him, because I’ve
put him and all his people and his land in your hand, and
you shall do to him as you did to Sihon, king of the
Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.’

translation.text: And the LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to me, ‘Don’t be afraid of him, because I’ve
put him and all his people and his land in your hand, and
you shall do to him as you did to Sihon, king of the
Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.’

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּיָדֵנוּ גַּם אֶת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ וַנַּכֵּהוּ עַד בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר לוֹ שָׂרִיד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּיָדֵנוּ גַּם אֶת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וְאֶת כּל עַמּוֹ וַנַּכֵּהוּ עַד בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר לוֹ שָׂרִיד׃

english.text:
And YHWH, our God, put Og, king of Bashan, and all his
people in our hand as well, and we struck him until he did
not have a remnant left.

translation.text: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.

verses.english:
And YHWH, our God, put Og, king of Bashan, and all his
people in our hand as well, and we struck him until he did
not have a remnant left.

verses.hebrew: וַנִּלְכֹּד אֶת כּל עָרָיו בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֹא הָיְתָה קִרְיָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא לָקַחְנוּ מֵאִתָּם שִׁשִּׁים עִיר כּל חֶבֶל אַרְגֹּב מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן׃

hebrew.text: וַנִּלְכֹּד אֶת כּל עָרָיו בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֹא הָיְתָה קִרְיָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא לָקַחְנוּ מֵאִתָּם שִׁשִּׁים עִיר כּל חֶבֶל אַרְגֹּב מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן׃

english.text:
And we captured all his cities at that time. There wasn’t
a town that we didn’t take from them: sixty cities—all the
region of Argob, Og’s kingdom in Bashan.

translation.text: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

verses.english:
And we captured all his cities at that time. There wasn’t
a town that we didn’t take from them: sixty cities—all the
region of Argob, Og’s kingdom in Bashan.

verses.hebrew: כּל אֵלֶּה עָרִים בְּצֻרֹת חוֹמָה גְבֹהָה דְּלָתַיִם וּבְרִיחַ לְבַד מֵעָרֵי הַפְּרָזִי הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: כּל אֵלֶּה עָרִים בְּצֻרֹת חוֹמָה גְבֹהָה דְּלָתַיִם וּבְרִיחַ לְבַד מֵעָרֵי הַפְּרָזִי הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

english.text:
All of these were ortified cities—a high wall, double
gates, and a bar—aside from a great many unwalled cities.

translation.text: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.

verses.english:
All of these were ortified cities—a high wall, double
gates, and a bar—aside from a great many unwalled cities.

verses.hebrew: וַנַּחֲרֵם אוֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂינוּ לְסִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הַחֲרֵם כּל עִיר מְתִם הַנָּשִׁים וְהַטָּף׃

hebrew.text: וַנַּחֲרֵם אוֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂינוּ לְסִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הַחֲרֵם כּל עִיר מְתִם הַנָּשִׁים וְהַטָּף׃

english.text:
And we completely destroyed them as we did to Sihon, king
of Heshbon, completely destroying every city: men, women,
and infants.

translation.text: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.

verses.english:
And we completely destroyed them as we did to Sihon, king
of Heshbon, completely destroying every city: men, women,
and infants.

verses.hebrew: וְכל הַבְּהֵמָה וּשְׁלַל הֶעָרִים בַּזּוֹנוּ לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הַבְּהֵמָה וּשְׁלַל הֶעָרִים בַּזּוֹנוּ לָנוּ׃

english.text:
And we despoiled all the animals and the spoil of the
cities for ourselves.

translation.text: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.

verses.english:
And we despoiled all the animals and the spoil of the
cities for ourselves.

verses.hebrew: וַנִּקַּח בָּעֵת הַהִוא אֶת הָאָרֶץ מִיַּד שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִנַּחַל אַרְנֹן עַד הַר חֶרְמוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַנִּקַּח בָּעֵת הַהִוא אֶת הָאָרֶץ מִיַּד שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִנַּחַל אַרְנֹן עַד הַר חֶרְמוֹן׃

english.text:
And at that time we took the land from the hand of the two
kings of the Amorites that was across the Jordan, from the
Wadi Arnon to Mount Hermon

translation.text: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;

verses.english:
And at that time we took the land from the hand of the two
kings of the Amorites that was across the Jordan, from the
Wadi Arnon to Mount Hermon

verses.hebrew: צִידֹנִים יִקְרְאוּ לְחֶרְמוֹן שִׂרְיֹן וְהָאֱמֹרִי יִקְרְאוּ לוֹ שְׂנִיר׃

hebrew.text: צִידֹנִים יִקְרְאוּ לְחֶרְמוֹן שִׂרְיֹן וְהָאֱמֹרִי יִקְרְאוּ לוֹ שְׂנִיר׃

english.text:
(Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it
Senir),

translation.text: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)

verses.english:
(Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it
Senir),

verses.hebrew: כֹּל עָרֵי הַמִּישֹׁר וְכל הַגִּלְעָד וְכל הַבָּשָׁן עַד סַלְכָה וְאֶדְרֶעִי עָרֵי מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל עָרֵי הַמִּישֹׁר וְכל הַגִּלְעָד וְכל הַבָּשָׁן עַד סַלְכָה וְאֶדְרֶעִי עָרֵי מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן׃

english.text:
all the cities of the plain and all of Gilead and all of
Bashan as far as Salcah and Edrei, cities of Og’s kingdom
in Bashan.

translation.text: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

verses.english:
all the cities of the plain and all of Gilead and all of
Bashan as far as Salcah and Edrei, cities of Og’s kingdom
in Bashan.

verses.hebrew: כִּי רַק עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן נִשְׁאַר מִיֶּתֶר הָרְפָאִים הִנֵּה עַרְשׂוֹ עֶרֶשׂ בַּרְזֶל הֲלֹה הִוא בְּרַבַּת בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן תֵּשַׁע אַמּוֹת ארְכָּהּ וְאַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת רחְבָּהּ בְּאַמַּת אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי רַק עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן נִשְׁאַר מִיֶּתֶר הָרְפָאִים הִנֵּה עַרְשׂוֹ עֶרֶשׂ בַּרְזֶל הֲלֹה הִוא בְּרַבַּת בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן תֵּשַׁע אַמּוֹת ארְכָּהּ וְאַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת רחְבָּהּ בְּאַמַּת אִישׁ׃

english.text:
Because only Og, king of Bashan, was left from the rest of
the Rephaim. Here, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron.
Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Its length is
nine cubits and its width is four cubits by a man’s cubit.

translation.text: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.

verses.english:
Because only Og, king of Bashan, was left from the rest of
the Rephaim. Here, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron.
Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Its length is
nine cubits and its width is four cubits by a man’s cubit.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת יָרַשְׁנוּ בָּעֵת הַהִוא מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל נַחַל אַרְנֹן וַחֲצִי הַר הַגִּלְעָד וְעָרָיו נָתַתִּי לָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת יָרַשְׁנוּ בָּעֵת הַהִוא מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל נַחַל אַרְנֹן וַחֲצִי הַר הַגִּלְעָד וְעָרָיו נָתַתִּי לָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי׃

english.text:
And we took possession of this land at that time. I gave
the Reubenites and the Gadites from Aroer, which is on the
Wadi Arnon, and half of the hill country of Gilead and its
cities.

translation.text: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.

verses.english:
And we took possession of this land at that time. I gave
the Reubenites and the Gadites from Aroer, which is on the
Wadi Arnon, and half of the hill country of Gilead and its
cities.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר הַגִּלְעָד וְכל הַבָּשָׁן מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג נָתַתִּי לַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה כֹּל חֶבֶל הָאַרְגֹּב לְכל הַבָּשָׁן הַהוּא יִקָּרֵא אֶרֶץ רְפָאִים׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר הַגִּלְעָד וְכל הַבָּשָׁן מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג נָתַתִּי לַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה כֹּל חֶבֶל הָאַרְגֹּב לְכל הַבָּשָׁן הַהוּא יִקָּרֵא אֶרֶץ רְפָאִים׃

english.text:
And I gave the rest of Gilead and all of Bashan, Og’s
kingdom, to half of the tribe of Manasseh. All the region
of Argob: all of that Bashan is called ‘the land of the
Rephaim.’

translation.text: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.

verses.english:
And I gave the rest of Gilead and all of Bashan, Og’s
kingdom, to half of the tribe of Manasseh. All the region
of Argob: all of that Bashan is called ‘the land of the
Rephaim.’

verses.hebrew: יָאִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה לָקַח אֶת כּל חֶבֶל אַרְגֹּב עַד גְּבוּל הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְהַמַּעֲכָתִי וַיִּקְרָא אֹתָם עַל שְׁמוֹ אֶת הַבָּשָׁן חַוֺּת יָאִיר עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: יָאִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה לָקַח אֶת כּל חֶבֶל אַרְגֹּב עַד גְּבוּל הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְהַמַּעֲכָתִי וַיִּקְרָא אֹתָם עַל שְׁמוֹ אֶת הַבָּשָׁן חַוֺּת יָאִיר עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Jair son of Manasseh had taken all the region of Argob as
far as the border of the Geshurites nd the Maachathites,
and he called them, the Bashan, by his name, Havvoth-Jair,
to this day.

translation.text: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashanhavothjair, unto this day.

verses.english:
Jair son of Manasseh had taken all the region of Argob as
far as the border of the Geshurites nd the Maachathites,
and he called them, the Bashan, by his name, Havvoth-Jair,
to this day.

verses.hebrew: וּלְמָכִיר נָתַתִּי אֶת הַגִּלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמָכִיר נָתַתִּי אֶת הַגִּלְעָד׃

english.text: And I gave Gilead to Machir.

translation.text: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.

verses.english: And I gave Gilead to Machir.

verses.hebrew: וְלָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי נָתַתִּי מִן הַגִּלְעָד וְעַד נַחַל אַרְנֹן תּוֹךְ הַנַּחַל וּגְבֻל וְעַד יַבֹּק הַנַּחַל גְּבוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְלָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי נָתַתִּי מִן הַגִּלְעָד וְעַד נַחַל אַרְנֹן תּוֹךְ הַנַּחַל וּגְבֻל וְעַד יַבֹּק הַנַּחַל גְּבוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
And I gave the Reubenites and the Gadites from Gilead to
the Wadi Arnon, the middle of the wadi being the border,
and to the Wadi Jabbok, the border of the children of
Ammon,

translation.text: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

verses.english:
And I gave the Reubenites and the Gadites from Gilead to
the Wadi Arnon, the middle of the wadi being the border,
and to the Wadi Jabbok, the border of the children of
Ammon,

verses.hebrew: וְהָעֲרָבָה וְהַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבֻל מִכִּנֶּרֶת וְעַד יָם הָעֲרָבָה יָם הַמֶּלַח תַּחַת אַשְׁדֹּת הַפִּסְגָּה מִזְרָחָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעֲרָבָה וְהַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבֻל מִכִּנֶּרֶת וְעַד יָם הָעֲרָבָה יָם הַמֶּלַח תַּחַת אַשְׁדֹּת הַפִּסְגָּה מִזְרָחָה׃

english.text:
and the plain, with the Jordan being the border, from the
Kinneret to the sea of the plain, the Dead Sea, below the
slopes of Pisgah eastward.

translation.text: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdothpisgah eastward.

verses.english:
and the plain, with the Jordan being the border, from the
Kinneret to the sea of the plain, the Dead Sea, below the
slopes of Pisgah eastward.

verses.hebrew: וָאֲצַו אֶתְכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נָתַן לָכֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לְרִשְׁתָּהּ חֲלוּצִים תַּעַבְרוּ לִפְנֵי אֲחֵיכֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל בְּנֵי חָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וָאֲצַו אֶתְכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נָתַן לָכֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לְרִשְׁתָּהּ חֲלוּצִים תַּעַבְרוּ לִפְנֵי אֲחֵיכֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל בְּנֵי חָיִל׃

english.text:
“And I commanded you at that time, saying, ‘YHWH, your
God, has given you this land to take possession of it. You
shall pass equipped, all the warriors, in front of your
brothers, the children of Israel.

translation.text: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are meet for the war.

verses.english:
“And I commanded you at that time, saying, ‘YHWH, your
God, has given you this land to take possession of it. You
shall pass equipped, all the warriors, in front of your
brothers, the children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: רַק נְשֵׁיכֶם וְטַפְּכֶם וּמִקְנֵכֶם יָדַעְתִּי כִּי מִקְנֶה רַב לָכֶם יֵשְׁבוּ בְּעָרֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: רַק נְשֵׁיכֶם וְטַפְּכֶם וּמִקְנֵכֶם יָדַעְתִּי כִּי מִקְנֶה רַב לָכֶם יֵשְׁבוּ בְּעָרֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָכֶם׃

english.text:
Only your wives and your infants and your livestock (I
knew that you have a great amount of livestock) shall stay
in your cities that I’ve given you

translation.text: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;

verses.english:
Only your wives and your infants and your livestock (I
knew that you have a great amount of livestock) shall stay
in your cities that I’ve given you

verses.hebrew: עַד אֲשֶׁר יָנִיחַ יְהֹוָה לַאֲחֵיכֶם כָּכֶם וְיָרְשׁוּ גַם הֵם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נֹתֵן לָהֶם בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן וְשַׁבְתֶּם אִישׁ לִירֻשָּׁתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: עַד אֲשֶׁר יָנִיחַ יְהֹוָה לַאֲחֵיכֶם כָּכֶם וְיָרְשׁוּ גַם הֵם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נֹתֵן לָהֶם בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן וְשַׁבְתֶּם אִישׁ לִירֻשָּׁתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָכֶם׃

english.text:
until YHWH will give your brothers rest like you, and
they, too, will get possession of the land that YHWH, your
God, is giving them across the Jordan. Then you shall go
back, each to his possession that I’ve given you.’

translation.text: Until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.

verses.english:
until YHWH will give your brothers rest like you, and
they, too, will get possession of the land that YHWH, your
God, is giving them across the Jordan. Then you shall go
back, each to his possession that I’ve given you.’

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת יְהוֹשׁוּעַ צִוֵּיתִי בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר עֵינֶיךָ הָרֹאֹת אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לִשְׁנֵי הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה לְכל הַמַּמְלָכוֹת אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹבֵר שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת יְהוֹשׁוּעַ צִוֵּיתִי בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר עֵינֶיךָ הָרֹאֹת אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לִשְׁנֵי הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה לְכל הַמַּמְלָכוֹת אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹבֵר שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, ‘Your eyes,
that have seen everything that YHWH, your God, has done to
these two kings: so may YHWH do to all the kingdoms to
which you’re crossing.

translation.text: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the LORD do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.

verses.english:
And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, ‘Your eyes,
that have seen everything that YHWH, your God, has done to
these two kings: so may YHWH do to all the kingdoms to
which you’re crossing.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִּירָאוּם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא הַנִּלְחָם לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִּירָאוּם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא הַנִּלְחָם לָכֶם׃

english.text:
You shall not fear them, because YHWH, your God: He is the
one fighting for you.’

translation.text: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.

verses.english:
You shall not fear them, because YHWH, your God: He is the
one fighting for you.’

verses.hebrew: וָאֶתְחַנַּן אֶל יְהֹוָה בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶתְחַנַּן אֶל יְהֹוָה בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: AND I IMPLORED “And I implored YHWH at that time, saying,

translation.text: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,

verses.english: AND I IMPLORED “And I implored YHWH at that time, saying,

verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה אַתָּה הַחִלּוֹתָ לְהַרְאוֹת אֶת עַבְדְּךָ אֶת גּדְלְךָ וְאֶת יָדְךָ הַחֲזָקָה אֲשֶׁר מִי אֵל בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה כְמַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְכִגְבוּרֹתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה אַתָּה הַחִלּוֹתָ לְהַרְאוֹת אֶת עַבְדְּךָ אֶת גּדְלְךָ וְאֶת יָדְךָ הַחֲזָקָה אֲשֶׁר מִי אֵל בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה כְמַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְכִגְבוּרֹתֶךָ׃

english.text:
‘My Lord, YHWH, you’ve begun to show your servant your
greatness and your strong hand, for who is a god in the
skies and in the earth who can do anything like your acts
and like your victories?!

translation.text: O Lord GOD, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?

verses.english:
‘My Lord, YHWH, you’ve begun to show your servant your
greatness and your strong hand, for who is a god in the
skies and in the earth who can do anything like your acts
and like your victories?!

verses.hebrew: אֶעְבְּרָה נָּא וְאֶרְאֶה אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן הָהָר הַטּוֹב הַזֶּה וְהַלְּבָנֹן׃

hebrew.text: אֶעְבְּרָה נָּא וְאֶרְאֶה אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן הָהָר הַטּוֹב הַזֶּה וְהַלְּבָנֹן׃

english.text:
Let me cross and see the good land that’s across the
Jordan, this good hill country and the Lebanon.’

translation.text: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.

verses.english:
Let me cross and see the good land that’s across the
Jordan, this good hill country and the Lebanon.’

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְעַבֵּר יְהֹוָה בִּי לְמַעַנְכֶם וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֵלָי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי רַב לָךְ אַל תּוֹסֶף דַּבֵּר אֵלַי עוֹד בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְעַבֵּר יְהֹוָה בִּי לְמַעַנְכֶם וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֵלָי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי רַב לָךְ אַל תּוֹסֶף דַּבֵּר אֵלַי עוֹד בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
“But YHWH was cross at me for your sakes, and He would not
listen to me. And YHWH said to me, ‘You have much. Don’t
go on speaking to me anymore of this thing.

translation.text: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.

verses.english:
“But YHWH was cross at me for your sakes, and He would not
listen to me. And YHWH said to me, ‘You have much. Don’t
go on speaking to me anymore of this thing.

verses.hebrew: עֲלֵה רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה וְשָׂא עֵינֶיךָ יָמָּה וְצָפֹנָה וְתֵימָנָה וּמִזְרָחָה וּרְאֵה בְעֵינֶיךָ כִּי לֹא תַעֲבֹר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: עֲלֵה רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה וְשָׂא עֵינֶיךָ יָמָּה וְצָפֹנָה וְתֵימָנָה וּמִזְרָחָה וּרְאֵה בְעֵינֶיךָ כִּי לֹא תַעֲבֹר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Go up to the top of Pisgah and raise your eyes west and
north and south and east and see it with your eyes,
because you won’t cross this Jordan.

translation.text: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

verses.english:
Go up to the top of Pisgah and raise your eyes west and
north and south and east and see it with your eyes,
because you won’t cross this Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וְצַו אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְחַזְּקֵהוּ וְאַמְּצֵהוּ כִּי הוּא יַעֲבֹר לִפְנֵי הָעָם הַזֶּה וְהוּא יַנְחִיל אוֹתָם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְצַו אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְחַזְּקֵהוּ וְאַמְּצֵהוּ כִּי הוּא יַעֲבֹר לִפְנֵי הָעָם הַזֶּה וְהוּא יַנְחִיל אוֹתָם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶה׃

english.text:
And command Joshua and strengthen him and make him bold,
because he will cross in front of this people, and he will
get them the land that you’ll see as a legacy.’

translation.text: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.

verses.english:
And command Joshua and strengthen him and make him bold,
because he will cross in front of this people, and he will
get them the land that you’ll see as a legacy.’

verses.hebrew: וַנֵּשֶׁב בַּגָּיְא מוּל בֵּית פְּעוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַנֵּשֶׁב בַּגָּיְא מוּל בֵּית פְּעוֹר׃

english.text: “And we stayed in the valley opposite Bethpeor.

translation.text: So we abode in the valley over against Bethpeor.

verses.english: “And we stayed in the valley opposite Bethpeor.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמַע אֶל הַחֻקִּים וְאֶל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְלַמֵּד אֶתְכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת לְמַעַן תִּחְיוּ וּבָאתֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם נֹתֵן לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמַע אֶל הַחֻקִּים וְאֶל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְלַמֵּד אֶתְכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת לְמַעַן תִּחְיוּ וּבָאתֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם נֹתֵן לָכֶם׃

english.text:
“And now, Israel, listen to the laws and to the
judgments that I’m teaching you to do, so that you’ll
live, and you’ll come and take possession of the land that
YHWH, your fathers’ God, is giving you

translation.text: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.

verses.english:
“And now, Israel, listen to the laws and to the
judgments that I’m teaching you to do, so that you’ll
live, and you’ll come and take possession of the land that
YHWH, your fathers’ God, is giving you

verses.hebrew: לֹא תֹסִפוּ עַל הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם וְלֹא תִגְרְעוּ מִמֶּנּוּ לִשְׁמֹר אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֹסִפוּ עַל הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם וְלֹא תִגְרְעוּ מִמֶּנּוּ לִשְׁמֹר אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
You shall not add onto the thing that I command you, and
you shall not subtract from it: observing the commandments
of YHWH, your God, that I command you.

translation.text: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.

verses.english:
You shall not add onto the thing that I command you, and
you shall not subtract from it: observing the commandments
of YHWH, your God, that I command you.

verses.hebrew: עֵינֵיכֶם הָרֹאוֹת אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה בְּבַעַל פְּעוֹר כִּי כל הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ אַחֲרֵי בַעַל פְּעוֹר הִשְׁמִידוֹ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִקִּרְבֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: עֵינֵיכֶם הָרֹאוֹת אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה בְּבַעַל פְּעוֹר כִּי כל הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ אַחֲרֵי בַעַל פְּעוֹר הִשְׁמִידוֹ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִקִּרְבֶּךָ׃

english.text:
It’s your eyes that saw what YHWH did at Baal Peor, that
every man who went after Baal Peor: YHWH, your God,
destroyed him from among you.

translation.text: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baalpeor: for all the men that followed Baalpeor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.

verses.english:
It’s your eyes that saw what YHWH did at Baal Peor, that
every man who went after Baal Peor: YHWH, your God,
destroyed him from among you.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם הַדְּבֵקִים בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם חַיִּים כֻּלְּכֶם הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם הַדְּבֵקִים בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם חַיִּים כֻּלְּכֶם הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
But you who were clinging to YHWH, your God: you’re all
alive today!

translation.text: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.

verses.english:
But you who were clinging to YHWH, your God: you’re all
alive today!

verses.hebrew: רְאֵה לִמַּדְתִּי אֶתְכֶם חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוַּנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי לַעֲשׂוֹת כֵּן בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם בָּאִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: רְאֵה לִמַּדְתִּי אֶתְכֶם חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוַּנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי לַעֲשׂוֹת כֵּן בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם בָּאִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
See: I’ve taught you laws and judgments as YHWH, my God,
commanded me, to do so within the land to which you’re
coming to take possession of it.

translation.text: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.

verses.english:
See: I’ve taught you laws and judgments as YHWH, my God,
commanded me, to do so within the land to which you’re
coming to take possession of it.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם כִּי הִוא חכְמַתְכֶם וּבִינַתְכֶם לְעֵינֵי הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁמְעוּן אֵת כּל הַחֻקִּים הָאֵלֶּה וְאָמְרוּ רַק עַם חָכָם וְנָבוֹן הַגּוֹי הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם כִּי הִוא חכְמַתְכֶם וּבִינַתְכֶם לְעֵינֵי הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁמְעוּן אֵת כּל הַחֻקִּים הָאֵלֶּה וְאָמְרוּ רַק עַם חָכָם וְנָבוֹן הַגּוֹי הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And you shall observe and do them because it’s your wisdom
and your understanding before the eyes of the peoples, in
that they will hear all these laws and will say, ‘Only a
wise and understanding people is this great nation.’

translation.text: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

verses.english:
And you shall observe and do them because it’s your wisdom
and your understanding before the eyes of the peoples, in
that they will hear all these laws and will say, ‘Only a
wise and understanding people is this great nation.’

verses.hebrew: כִּי מִי גוֹי גָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ אֱלֹהִים קְרֹבִים אֵלָיו כַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּכל קרְאֵנוּ אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: כִּי מִי גוֹי גָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ אֱלֹהִים קְרֹבִים אֵלָיו כַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּכל קרְאֵנוּ אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
Because who is a great nation that has gods close to it
like YHWH, our God, in all our calling to him?

translation.text: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for?

verses.english:
Because who is a great nation that has gods close to it
like YHWH, our God, in all our calling to him?

verses.hebrew: וּמִי גּוֹי גָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים צַדִּיקִם כְּכֹל הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן לִפְנֵיכֶם הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וּמִי גּוֹי גָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים צַדִּיקִם כְּכֹל הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן לִפְנֵיכֶם הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And who is a great nation that has just laws and judgments
like all this instruction that I’m putting in front of you
today?

translation.text: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?

verses.english:
And who is a great nation that has just laws and judgments
like all this instruction that I’m putting in front of you
today?

verses.hebrew: רַק הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ וּשְׁמֹר נַפְשְׁךָ מְאֹד פֶּן תִּשְׁכַּח אֶת הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ וּפֶן יָסוּרוּ מִלְּבָבְךָ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ וְהוֹדַעְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ וְלִבְנֵי בָנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: רַק הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ וּשְׁמֹר נַפְשְׁךָ מְאֹד פֶּן תִּשְׁכַּח אֶת הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ וּפֶן יָסוּרוּ מִלְּבָבְךָ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ וְהוֹדַעְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ וְלִבְנֵי בָנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
“Only be watchful, and watch yourself very much, in case
you’ll forget the things that your eyes have seen and in
case they’ll turn away from your heart, all the days of
your life. But you shall make them known to your children
and to your children’s children:

translation.text: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons’ sons;

verses.english:
“Only be watchful, and watch yourself very much, in case
you’ll forget the things that your eyes have seen and in
case they’ll turn away from your heart, all the days of
your life. But you shall make them known to your children
and to your children’s children:

verses.hebrew: יוֹם אֲשֶׁר עָמַדְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּחֹרֵב בֶּאֱמֹר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי הַקְהֶל לִי אֶת הָעָם וְאַשְׁמִעֵם אֶת דְּבָרָי אֲשֶׁר יִלְמְדוּן לְיִרְאָה אֹתִי כּל הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הֵם חַיִּים עַל הָאֲדָמָה וְאֶת בְּנֵיהֶם יְלַמֵּדוּן׃

hebrew.text: יוֹם אֲשֶׁר עָמַדְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּחֹרֵב בֶּאֱמֹר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי הַקְהֶל לִי אֶת הָעָם וְאַשְׁמִעֵם אֶת דְּבָרָי אֲשֶׁר יִלְמְדוּן לְיִרְאָה אֹתִי כּל הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הֵם חַיִּים עַל הָאֲדָמָה וְאֶת בְּנֵיהֶם יְלַמֵּדוּן׃

english.text:
the day that you stood in front of YHWH, your God, at
Horeb, when YHWH said to me, ‘Assemble the people to me,
and I’ll make them hear my words so that they’ll learn to
fear me all the days that they’re living on the land, and
they’ll teach their children.’

translation.text: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.

verses.english:
the day that you stood in front of YHWH, your God, at
Horeb, when YHWH said to me, ‘Assemble the people to me,
and I’ll make them hear my words so that they’ll learn to
fear me all the days that they’re living on the land, and
they’ll teach their children.’

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרְבוּן וַתַּעַמְדוּן תַּחַת הָהָר וְהָהָר בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ עַד לֵב הַשָּׁמַיִם חֹשֶׁךְ עָנָן וַעֲרָפֶל׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקְרְבוּן וַתַּעַמְדוּן תַּחַת הָהָר וְהָהָר בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ עַד לֵב הַשָּׁמַיִם חֹשֶׁךְ עָנָן וַעֲרָפֶל׃

english.text:
And you came forward and stood below the mountain, and the
mountain was burning in fire to the heart of the skies:
darkness, cloud, and nimbus.

translation.text: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.

verses.english:
And you came forward and stood below the mountain, and the
mountain was burning in fire to the heart of the skies:
darkness, cloud, and nimbus.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיכֶם מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ קוֹל דְּבָרִים אַתֶּם שֹׁמְעִים וּתְמוּנָה אֵינְכֶם רֹאִים זוּלָתִי קוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיכֶם מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ קוֹל דְּבָרִים אַתֶּם שֹׁמְעִים וּתְמוּנָה אֵינְכֶם רֹאִים זוּלָתִי קוֹל׃

english.text:
And YHWH spoke to you from inside the fire. You were
hearing the sound of words, but you weren’t seeing a form,
just sound.

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.

verses.english:
And YHWH spoke to you from inside the fire. You were
hearing the sound of words, but you weren’t seeing a form,
just sound.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד לָכֶם אֶת בְּרִיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת עֲשֶׂרֶת הַדְּבָרִים וַיִּכְתְּבֵם עַל שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת אֲבָנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֵּד לָכֶם אֶת בְּרִיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת עֲשֶׂרֶת הַדְּבָרִים וַיִּכְתְּבֵם עַל שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת אֲבָנִים׃

english.text:
And He told you His covenant that He commanded you to do,
the Ten commandments, and He wrote them on two tablets of
stones.

translation.text: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.

verses.english:
And He told you His covenant that He commanded you to do,
the Ten commandments, and He wrote them on two tablets of
stones.

verses.hebrew: וְאֹתִי צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בָּעֵת הַהִוא לְלַמֵּד אֶתְכֶם חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים לַעֲשֹׂתְכֶם אֹתָם בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֹתִי צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בָּעֵת הַהִוא לְלַמֵּד אֶתְכֶם חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים לַעֲשֹׂתְכֶם אֹתָם בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
And YHWH commanded me at that time to teach you laws and
judgments, for you to do them in the land to which you’re
crossing to take possession of it.

translation.text: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.

verses.english:
And YHWH commanded me at that time to teach you laws and
judgments, for you to do them in the land to which you’re
crossing to take possession of it.

verses.hebrew: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם מְאֹד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם כִּי לֹא רְאִיתֶם כּל תְּמוּנָה בְּיוֹם דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בְּחֹרֵב מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם מְאֹד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם כִּי לֹא רְאִיתֶם כּל תְּמוּנָה בְּיוֹם דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בְּחֹרֵב מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
And you shall be very watchful of yourselves—because you
didn’t see any form in the day that YHWH spoke to you at
Horeb from inside the fire—

translation.text: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:

verses.english:
And you shall be very watchful of yourselves—because you
didn’t see any form in the day that YHWH spoke to you at
Horeb from inside the fire—

verses.hebrew: פֶּן תַּשְׁחִתוּן וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָכֶם פֶּסֶל תְּמוּנַת כּל סָמֶל תַּבְנִית זָכָר אוֹ נְקֵבָה׃

hebrew.text: פֶּן תַּשְׁחִתוּן וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָכֶם פֶּסֶל תְּמוּנַת כּל סָמֶל תַּבְנִית זָכָר אוֹ נְקֵבָה׃

english.text:
in case you’ll be corrupted, and you’ll make a statue, a
form of any figure, a design of a male or a female,

translation.text: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

verses.english:
in case you’ll be corrupted, and you’ll make a statue, a
form of any figure, a design of a male or a female,

verses.hebrew: תַּבְנִית כּל בְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ תַּבְנִית כּל צִפּוֹר כָּנָף אֲשֶׁר תָּעוּף בַּשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: תַּבְנִית כּל בְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ תַּבְנִית כּל צִפּוֹר כָּנָף אֲשֶׁר תָּעוּף בַּשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
a design of any animal that’s in the earth, a design of
any winged bird that flies in the skies,

translation.text: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,

verses.english:
a design of any animal that’s in the earth, a design of
any winged bird that flies in the skies,

verses.hebrew: תַּבְנִית כּל רֹמֵשׂ בָּאֲדָמָה תַּבְנִית כּל דָּגָה אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּיִם מִתַּחַת לָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: תַּבְנִית כּל רֹמֵשׂ בָּאֲדָמָה תַּבְנִית כּל דָּגָה אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּיִם מִתַּחַת לָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
a design of anything that creeps on the ground, a design
of any fish that’s in the water under the earth,

translation.text: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:

verses.english:
a design of anything that creeps on the ground, a design
of any fish that’s in the water under the earth,

verses.hebrew: וּפֶן תִּשָּׂא עֵינֶיךָ הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וְרָאִיתָ אֶת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְאֶת הַיָּרֵחַ וְאֶת הַכּוֹכָבִים כֹּל צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וְנִדַּחְתָּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתָ לָהֶם וַעֲבַדְתָּם אֲשֶׁר חָלַק יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֹתָם לְכֹל הָעַמִּים תַּחַת כּל הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וּפֶן תִּשָּׂא עֵינֶיךָ הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וְרָאִיתָ אֶת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְאֶת הַיָּרֵחַ וְאֶת הַכּוֹכָבִים כֹּל צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וְנִדַּחְתָּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתָ לָהֶם וַעֲבַדְתָּם אֲשֶׁר חָלַק יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֹתָם לְכֹל הָעַמִּים תַּחַת כּל הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
and in case you’ll raise your eyes to the skies, and
you’ll see the sun and the moon and the stars, all the
array of the skies, and you’ll be moved so that you’ll bow
to them and serve them, when YHWH, your God, has allocated
them to all the peoples under all the skies.

translation.text: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.

verses.english:
and in case you’ll raise your eyes to the skies, and
you’ll see the sun and the moon and the stars, all the
array of the skies, and you’ll be moved so that you’ll bow
to them and serve them, when YHWH, your God, has allocated
them to all the peoples under all the skies.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶתְכֶם לָקַח יְהֹוָה וַיּוֹצִא אֶתְכֶם מִכּוּר הַבַּרְזֶל מִמִּצְרָיִם לִהְיוֹת לוֹ לְעַם נַחֲלָה כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶתְכֶם לָקַח יְהֹוָה וַיּוֹצִא אֶתְכֶם מִכּוּר הַבַּרְזֶל מִמִּצְרָיִם לִהְיוֹת לוֹ לְעַם נַחֲלָה כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
But YHWH has taken you, and He has brought you out from
the iron furnace, from Egypt, to become a legacy people
for him, as it is this day.

translation.text: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.

verses.english:
But YHWH has taken you, and He has brought you out from
the iron furnace, from Egypt, to become a legacy people
for him, as it is this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה הִתְאַנַּף בִּי עַל דִּבְרֵיכֶם וַיִּשָּׁבַע לְבִלְתִּי עבְרִי אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן וּלְבִלְתִּי בֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה הִתְאַנַּף בִּי עַל דִּבְרֵיכֶם וַיִּשָּׁבַע לְבִלְתִּי עבְרִי אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן וּלְבִלְתִּי בֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה׃

english.text:
“And YHWH had been incensed at me over your matters, and
He swore that I would not cross the Jordan and not come to
the good land that YHWH, your God, is giving you as a
legacy.

translation.text: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:

verses.english:
“And YHWH had been incensed at me over your matters, and
He swore that I would not cross the Jordan and not come to
the good land that YHWH, your God, is giving you as a
legacy.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אָנֹכִי מֵת בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֵינֶנִּי עֹבֵר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן וְאַתֶּם עֹבְרִים וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אָנֹכִי מֵת בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֵינֶנִּי עֹבֵר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן וְאַתֶּם עֹבְרִים וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
So I am dying in this land. I’m not crossing the Jordan.
But you are crossing, and you shall possess this good
land.

translation.text: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.

verses.english:
So I am dying in this land. I’m not crossing the Jordan.
But you are crossing, and you shall possess this good
land.

verses.hebrew: הִשָּׁמְרוּ לָכֶם פֶּן תִּשְׁכְּחוּ אֶת בְּרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת עִמָּכֶם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָכֶם פֶּסֶל תְּמוּנַת כֹּל אֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: הִשָּׁמְרוּ לָכֶם פֶּן תִּשְׁכְּחוּ אֶת בְּרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת עִמָּכֶם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָכֶם פֶּסֶל תְּמוּנַת כֹּל אֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Watch yourselves, in case you’ll forget the covenant of
YHWH, your God, that He made with you, and you’ll make a
statue of any form about which YHWH, your God, has
commanded you,

translation.text: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.

verses.english:
Watch yourselves, in case you’ll forget the covenant of
YHWH, your God, that He made with you, and you’ll make a
statue of any form about which YHWH, your God, has
commanded you,

verses.hebrew: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵשׁ אֹכְלָה הוּא אֵל קַנָּא׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵשׁ אֹכְלָה הוּא אֵל קַנָּא׃

english.text:
because YHWH, your God: He is a consuming fire, a jealous
God.

translation.text: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.

verses.english:
because YHWH, your God: He is a consuming fire, a jealous
God.

verses.hebrew: כִּי תוֹלִיד בָּנִים וּבְנֵי בָנִים וְנוֹשַׁנְתֶּם בָּאָרֶץ וְהִשְׁחַתֶּם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם פֶּסֶל תְּמוּנַת כֹּל וַעֲשִׂיתֶם הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְהַכְעִיסוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תוֹלִיד בָּנִים וּבְנֵי בָנִים וְנוֹשַׁנְתֶּם בָּאָרֶץ וְהִשְׁחַתֶּם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם פֶּסֶל תְּמוּנַת כֹּל וַעֲשִׂיתֶם הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְהַכְעִיסוֹ׃

english.text:
“When you’ll produce children and grand-children and will
have been in the land long, and you’ll be corrupt and make
a statue of any form and do what is bad in the eyes of
YHWH, your God, to provoke Him,

translation.text: When thou shalt beget children, and children’s children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:

verses.english:
“When you’ll produce children and grand-children and will
have been in the land long, and you’ll be corrupt and make
a statue of any form and do what is bad in the eyes of
YHWH, your God, to provoke Him,

verses.hebrew: הַעִידֹתִי בָכֶם הַיּוֹם אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ כִּי אָבֹד תֹּאבֵדוּן מַהֵר מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ לֹא תַאֲרִיכֻן יָמִים עָלֶיהָ כִּי הִשָּׁמֵד תִּשָּׁמֵדוּן׃

hebrew.text: הַעִידֹתִי בָכֶם הַיּוֹם אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ כִּי אָבֹד תֹּאבֵדוּן מַהֵר מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ לֹא תַאֲרִיכֻן יָמִים עָלֶיהָ כִּי הִשָּׁמֵד תִּשָּׁמֵדוּן׃

english.text:
I call the skies and the earth to witness regarding you
today that you’ll perish quickly from the land to which
you’re crossing the Jordan to take possession of it. You
won’t extend days on it, but you’ll be destroyed!

translation.text: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.

verses.english:
I call the skies and the earth to witness regarding you
today that you’ll perish quickly from the land to which
