you’re crossing the Jordan to take possession of it. You
won’t extend days on it, but you’ll be destroyed!

verses.hebrew: וְהֵפִיץ יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם בָּעַמִּים וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם מְתֵי מִסְפָּר בַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר יְנַהֵג יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵפִיץ יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם בָּעַמִּים וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם מְתֵי מִסְפָּר בַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר יְנַהֵג יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And YHWH will scatter you among the peoples, and you’ll be
left few in number among the nations where YHWH will drive
you.

translation.text: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.

verses.english:
And YHWH will scatter you among the peoples, and you’ll be
left few in number among the nations where YHWH will drive
you.

verses.hebrew: וַעֲבַדְתֶּם שָׁם אֱלֹהִים מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָם עֵץ וָאֶבֶן אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִרְאוּן וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּן וְלֹא יֹאכְלוּן וְלֹא יְרִיחֻן׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲבַדְתֶּם שָׁם אֱלֹהִים מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָם עֵץ וָאֶבֶן אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִרְאוּן וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּן וְלֹא יֹאכְלוּן וְלֹא יְרִיחֻן׃

english.text:
And you’ll serve gods, the work of human hands, wood and
stone, there, that don’t see and don’t hear and don’t eat
and don’t smell.

translation.text: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

verses.english:
And you’ll serve gods, the work of human hands, wood and
stone, there, that don’t see and don’t hear and don’t eat
and don’t smell.

verses.hebrew: וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּם מִשָּׁם אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּמָצָאתָ כִּי תִדְרְשֶׁנּוּ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּם מִשָּׁם אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּמָצָאתָ כִּי תִדְרְשֶׁנּוּ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
“But if you’ll seek YHWH, your God, from there, then
you’ll find Him, when you’ll inquire of Him with all your
heart and all your soul.

translation.text: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

verses.english:
“But if you’ll seek YHWH, your God, from there, then
you’ll find Him, when you’ll inquire of Him with all your
heart and all your soul.

verses.hebrew: בַּצַּר לְךָ וּמְצָאוּךָ כֹּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים וְשַׁבְתָּ עַד יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְשָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקֹלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בַּצַּר לְךָ וּמְצָאוּךָ כֹּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים וְשַׁבְתָּ עַד יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְשָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקֹלוֹ׃

english.text:
When you have trouble, and all these things have found
you, in the future days, if you’ll go back to YHWH, your
God, and listen to His voice,

translation.text: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;

verses.english:
When you have trouble, and all these things have found
you, in the future days, if you’ll go back to YHWH, your
God, and listen to His voice,

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵל רַחוּם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַשְׁחִיתֶךָ וְלֹא יִשְׁכַּח אֶת בְּרִית אֲבֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֵל רַחוּם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַשְׁחִיתֶךָ וְלֹא יִשְׁכַּח אֶת בְּרִית אֲבֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָהֶם׃

english.text:
He won’t let you down, and he won’t destroy you, because
YHWH, your God, is a merciful God, and He won’t forget
your fathers’ covenant that He swore to them.

translation.text: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.

verses.english:
He won’t let you down, and he won’t destroy you, because
YHWH, your God, is a merciful God, and He won’t forget
your fathers’ covenant that He swore to them.

verses.hebrew: כִּי שְׁאַל נָא לְיָמִים רִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנֶיךָ לְמִן הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים אָדָם עַל הָאָרֶץ וּלְמִקְצֵה הַשָּׁמַיִם וְעַד קְצֵה הַשָּׁמָיִם הֲנִהְיָה כַּדָּבָר הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה אוֹ הֲנִשְׁמַע כָּמֹהוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי שְׁאַל נָא לְיָמִים רִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנֶיךָ לְמִן הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים אָדָם עַל הָאָרֶץ וּלְמִקְצֵה הַשָּׁמַיִם וְעַד קְצֵה הַשָּׁמָיִם הֲנִהְיָה כַּדָּבָר הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה אוֹ הֲנִשְׁמַע כָּמֹהוּ׃

english.text:
Because ask of the earliest days that were before you,
from the day that God created a human on the earth, and
from one end of the skies to the other end of the skies:
has there been anything like this great thing? or has
any-thing like it been heard of?

translation.text: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?

verses.english:
Because ask of the earliest days that were before you,
from the day that God created a human on the earth, and
from one end of the skies to the other end of the skies:
has there been anything like this great thing? or has
any-thing like it been heard of?

verses.hebrew: הֲשָׁמַע עָם קוֹל אֱלֹהִים מְדַבֵּר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתָּ אַתָּה וַיֶּחִי׃

hebrew.text: הֲשָׁמַע עָם קוֹל אֱלֹהִים מְדַבֵּר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתָּ אַתָּה וַיֶּחִי׃

english.text:
Has a people heard God’s voice speaking from inside a fire
the way you heard—and lived?

translation.text: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?

verses.english:
Has a people heard God’s voice speaking from inside a fire
the way you heard—and lived?

verses.hebrew: אוֹ הֲנִסָּה אֱלֹהִים לָבוֹא לָקַחַת לוֹ גוֹי מִקֶּרֶב גּוֹי בְּמַסֹּת בְּאֹתֹת וּבְמוֹפְתִים וּבְמִלְחָמָה וּבְיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה וּבְמוֹרָאִים גְּדֹלִים כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לָכֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בְּמִצְרַיִם לְעֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ הֲנִסָּה אֱלֹהִים לָבוֹא לָקַחַת לוֹ גוֹי מִקֶּרֶב גּוֹי בְּמַסֹּת בְּאֹתֹת וּבְמוֹפְתִים וּבְמִלְחָמָה וּבְיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה וּבְמוֹרָאִים גְּדֹלִים כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לָכֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בְּמִצְרַיִם לְעֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Or has God put it to the test, to come to take for Himself
a people from among another people with tests, with signs,
and with wonders and with war and with a strong hand and
with an outstretched arm and with great fears like
everything that YHWH, your God, has done for you in Egypt
before your eyes?

translation.text: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

verses.english:
Or has God put it to the test, to come to take for Himself
a people from among another people with tests, with signs,
and with wonders and with war and with a strong hand and
with an outstretched arm and with great fears like
everything that YHWH, your God, has done for you in Egypt
before your eyes?

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה הרְאֵתָ לָדַעַת כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֵין עוֹד מִלְּבַדּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אַתָּה הרְאֵתָ לָדַעַת כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֵין עוֹד מִלְּבַדּוֹ׃

english.text:
You have been shown in order to know that YHWH: He is God.
There is no other outside of Him.

translation.text: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.

verses.english:
You have been shown in order to know that YHWH: He is God.
There is no other outside of Him.

verses.hebrew: מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמִיעֲךָ אֶת קֹלוֹ לְיַסְּרֶךָּ וְעַל הָאָרֶץ הֶרְאֲךָ אֶת אִשּׁוֹ הַגְּדוֹלָה וּדְבָרָיו שָׁמַעְתָּ מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמִיעֲךָ אֶת קֹלוֹ לְיַסְּרֶךָּ וְעַל הָאָרֶץ הֶרְאֲךָ אֶת אִשּׁוֹ הַגְּדוֹלָה וּדְבָרָיו שָׁמַעְתָּ מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
From the skies He had you hear His voice in order to
discipline you, and on the earth He showed you His great
fire, and you heard His words from inside the fire.

translation.text: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.

verses.english:
From the skies He had you hear His voice in order to
discipline you, and on the earth He showed you His great
fire, and you heard His words from inside the fire.

verses.hebrew: וְתַחַת כִּי אָהַב אֶת אֲבֹתֶיךָ וַיִּבְחַר בְּזַרְעוֹ אַחֲרָיו וַיּוֹצִאֲךָ בְּפָנָיו בְּכֹחוֹ הַגָּדֹל מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְתַחַת כִּי אָהַב אֶת אֲבֹתֶיךָ וַיִּבְחַר בְּזַרְעוֹ אַחֲרָיו וַיּוֹצִאֲךָ בְּפָנָיו בְּכֹחוֹ הַגָּדֹל מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And because He loved your fathers He chose their seed
after them, so He brought you out in front of Him from
Egypt by His great power,

translation.text: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;

verses.english:
And because He loved your fathers He chose their seed
after them, so He brought you out in front of Him from
Egypt by His great power,

verses.hebrew: לְהוֹרִישׁ גּוֹיִם גְּדֹלִים וַעֲצֻמִים מִמְּךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ לַהֲבִיאֲךָ לָתֶת לְךָ אֶת אַרְצָם נַחֲלָה כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: לְהוֹרִישׁ גּוֹיִם גְּדֹלִים וַעֲצֻמִים מִמְּךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ לַהֲבִיאֲךָ לָתֶת לְךָ אֶת אַרְצָם נַחֲלָה כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
to dispossess bigger and more powerful nations than you in
front of you, to bring you, to give you their land as a
legacy as it is today.

translation.text: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.

verses.english:
to dispossess bigger and more powerful nations than you in
front of you, to bring you, to give you their land as a
legacy as it is today.

verses.hebrew: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶךָ כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת אֵין עוֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶךָ כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת אֵין עוֹד׃

english.text:
And you shall know today and store it in your heart that
YHWH: He is God in the skies above and on the earth below.
There isn’t another.

translation.text: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the LORD he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.

verses.english:
And you shall know today and store it in your heart that
YHWH: He is God in the skies above and on the earth below.
There isn’t another.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת חֻקָּיו וְאֶת מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִיטַב לְךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ וּלְמַעַן תַּאֲרִיךְ יָמִים עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ כּל הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת חֻקָּיו וְאֶת מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִיטַב לְךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ וּלְמַעַן תַּאֲרִיךְ יָמִים עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ כּל הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
And you shall observe His laws and His commandments that I
command you today so it will be good for you and for your
children after you, and so that you’ll extend days on the
land that YHWH, your God, is giving you forever.”

translation.text: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.

verses.english:
And you shall observe His laws and His commandments that I
command you today so it will be good for you and for your
children after you, and so that you’ll extend days on the
land that YHWH, your God, is giving you forever.”

verses.hebrew: אָז יַבְדִּיל מֹשֶׁה שָׁלֹשׁ עָרִים בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרְחָה שָׁמֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: אָז יַבְדִּיל מֹשֶׁה שָׁלֹשׁ עָרִים בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרְחָה שָׁמֶשׁ׃

english.text:
Then Moses distinguished three cities across the Jordan
toward the sun’s rising,

translation.text: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

verses.english:
Then Moses distinguished three cities across the Jordan
toward the sun’s rising,

verses.hebrew: לָנֻס שָׁמָּה רוֹצֵחַ אֲשֶׁר יִרְצַח אֶת רֵעֵהוּ בִּבְלִי דַעַת וְהוּא לֹא שֹׂנֵא לוֹ מִתְּמֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וְנָס אֶל אַחַת מִן הֶעָרִים הָאֵל וָחָי׃

hebrew.text: לָנֻס שָׁמָּה רוֹצֵחַ אֲשֶׁר יִרְצַח אֶת רֵעֵהוּ בִּבְלִי דַעַת וְהוּא לֹא שֹׂנֵא לוֹ מִתְּמֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וְנָס אֶל אַחַת מִן הֶעָרִים הָאֵל וָחָי׃

english.text:
for the manslayer who would slay his neighbor without
knowing—and he had not hated him from the day before
yesterday—to flee there, so he would flee to one of these
the cities and would live:

translation.text: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:

verses.english:
for the manslayer who would slay his neighbor without
knowing—and he had not hated him from the day before
yesterday—to flee there, so he would flee to one of these
the cities and would live:

verses.hebrew: אֶת בֶּצֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר בְּאֶרֶץ הַמִּישֹׁר לָראוּבֵנִי וְאֶת רָאמֹת בַּגִּלְעָד לַגָּדִי וְאֶת גּוֹלָן בַּבָּשָׁן לַמְנַשִּׁי׃

hebrew.text: אֶת בֶּצֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר בְּאֶרֶץ הַמִּישֹׁר לָראוּבֵנִי וְאֶת רָאמֹת בַּגִּלְעָד לַגָּדִי וְאֶת גּוֹלָן בַּבָּשָׁן לַמְנַשִּׁי׃

english.text:
Bezer in the wilderness of the plain for the Reubenites,
and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites, and Golan in Bashan
for the Manassites.

translation.text: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.

verses.english:
Bezer in the wilderness of the plain for the Reubenites,
and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites, and Golan in Bashan
for the Manassites.

verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂם מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְזֹאת הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂם מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And this is the instruction that Moses set before the
children of Israel.

translation.text: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:

verses.english:
And this is the instruction that Moses set before the
children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הָעֵדֹת וְהַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵאתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה הָעֵדֹת וְהַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵאתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
These are the testimonies and the laws and the judgments
that Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they went
out from Egypt,

translation.text: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt.

verses.english:
These are the testimonies and the laws and the judgments
that Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they went
out from Egypt,

verses.hebrew: בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בַּגַּיְא מוּל בֵּית פְּעוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵאתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בַּגַּיְא מוּל בֵּית פְּעוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵאתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
across the Jordan in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the
land of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon,
whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they
came out from the land of Egypt.

translation.text: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Bethpeor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:

verses.english:
across the Jordan in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the
land of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon,
whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they
came out from the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֶת אַרְצוֹ וְאֶת אֶרֶץ עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרַח שָׁמֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֶת אַרְצוֹ וְאֶת אֶרֶץ עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרַח שָׁמֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And they took possession of his land, and of the land of
Og, king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites who were
across the Jordan at the sun’s rising,

translation.text: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

verses.english:
And they took possession of his land, and of the land of
Og, king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites who were
across the Jordan at the sun’s rising,

verses.hebrew: מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל שְׂפַת נַחַל אַרְנֹן וְעַד הַר שִׂיאֹן הוּא חֶרְמוֹן׃

hebrew.text: מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל שְׂפַת נַחַל אַרְנֹן וְעַד הַר שִׂיאֹן הוּא חֶרְמוֹן׃

english.text:
from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Wadi Arnon, to
Mount Sion—that is Hermon—

translation.text: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,

verses.english:
from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Wadi Arnon, to
Mount Sion—that is Hermon—

verses.hebrew: וְכל הָעֲרָבָה עֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה וְעַד יָם הָעֲרָבָה תַּחַת אַשְׁדֹּת הַפִּסְגָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְכל הָעֲרָבָה עֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה וְעַד יָם הָעֲרָבָה תַּחַת אַשְׁדֹּת הַפִּסְגָּה׃

english.text:
and all the plain across the Jordan eastward to the sea of
the plain below the slopes of Pisgah.

translation.text: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.

verses.english:
and all the plain across the Jordan eastward to the sea of
the plain below the slopes of Pisgah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַחֻקִּים וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי דֹּבֵר בְּאזְנֵיכֶם הַיּוֹם וּלְמַדְתֶּם אֹתָם וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם לַעֲשֹׂתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַחֻקִּים וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי דֹּבֵר בְּאזְנֵיכֶם הַיּוֹם וּלְמַדְתֶּם אֹתָם וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם לַעֲשֹׂתָם׃

english.text:
And Moses called all of Israel and said to them,
“Listen, Israel, to the laws and the judgments that I’m
speaking in your ears today. And you shall learn them and
be watchful to do them.

translation.text: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.

verses.english:
And Moses called all of Israel and said to them,
“Listen, Israel, to the laws and the judgments that I’m
speaking in your ears today. And you shall learn them and
be watchful to do them.

verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ כָּרַת עִמָּנוּ בְּרִית בְּחֹרֵב׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ כָּרַת עִמָּנוּ בְּרִית בְּחֹרֵב׃

english.text: YHWH, our God, had made a covenant with us at Horeb.

translation.text: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

verses.english: YHWH, our God, had made a covenant with us at Horeb.

verses.hebrew: לֹא אֶת אֲבֹתֵינוּ כָּרַת יְהֹוָה אֶת הַבְּרִית הַזֹּאת כִּי אִתָּנוּ אֲנַחְנוּ אֵלֶּה פֹה הַיּוֹם כֻּלָּנוּ חַיִּים׃

hebrew.text: לֹא אֶת אֲבֹתֵינוּ כָּרַת יְהֹוָה אֶת הַבְּרִית הַזֹּאת כִּי אִתָּנוּ אֲנַחְנוּ אֵלֶּה פֹה הַיּוֹם כֻּלָּנוּ חַיִּים׃

english.text:
YHWH did not make this covenant with our fathers, but with
us! We! These! Here! Today! All of us! Living!

translation.text: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.

verses.english:
YHWH did not make this covenant with our fathers, but with
us! We! These! Here! Today! All of us! Living!

verses.hebrew: פָּנִים בְּפָנִים דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם בָּהָר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: פָּנִים בְּפָנִים דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם בָּהָר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
Face-to-face, YHWH spoke with you at the mountain from
inside the fire

translation.text: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,

verses.english:
Face-to-face, YHWH spoke with you at the mountain from
inside the fire

verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי עֹמֵד בֵּין יְהֹוָה וּבֵינֵיכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לְהַגִּיד לָכֶם אֶת דְּבַר יְהֹוָה כִּי יְרֵאתֶם מִפְּנֵי הָאֵשׁ וְלֹא עֲלִיתֶם בָּהָר לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: אָנֹכִי עֹמֵד בֵּין יְהֹוָה וּבֵינֵיכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לְהַגִּיד לָכֶם אֶת דְּבַר יְהֹוָה כִּי יְרֵאתֶם מִפְּנֵי הָאֵשׁ וְלֹא עֲלִיתֶם בָּהָר לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
(I was standing between YHWH and you at that time to tell
you YHWH’s word because you were afraid on account of the
fire, and you didn’t go up in the mountain), saying:

translation.text: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,

verses.english:
(I was standing between YHWH and you at that time to tell
you YHWH’s word because you were afraid on account of the
fire, and you didn’t go up in the mountain), saying:

verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִ͏ים׃

hebrew.text: אָנֹכִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִ͏ים׃

english.text:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt, from a house of slaves.

translation.text: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

verses.english:
I am YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of
Egypt, from a house of slaves.

verses.hebrew: לֹא יִהְיֶ͏ה לְךָ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים עַל פָּנָ͏ַי׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יִהְיֶ͏ה לְךָ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים עַל פָּנָ͏ַי׃

english.text: You shall not have other gods before my face.

translation.text: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.

verses.english: You shall not have other gods before my face.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה לְךָ פֶסֶל כּל תְּמוּנָה אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וַאֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ מִתָּ͏ַחַת וַאֲשֶׁר בַּמַּיִם מִתַּחַת לָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה לְךָ פֶסֶל כּל תְּמוּנָה אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וַאֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ מִתָּ͏ַחַת וַאֲשֶׁר בַּמַּיִם מִתַּחַת לָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
You shall not make a statue, any form that is in the skies
above or that is in the earth below or that is in the
water below the earth.

translation.text: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:

verses.english:
You shall not make a statue, any form that is in the skies
above or that is in the earth below or that is in the
water below the earth.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לָהֶם וְלֹא תעבְדֵם כִּי אָנֹכִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵל קַנָּא פֹּקֵד עֲוֺן אָבוֹת עַל בָּנִים וְעַל שִׁלֵּשִׁים וְעַל רִבֵּעִים לְשֹׂנְאָי׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לָהֶם וְלֹא תעבְדֵם כִּי אָנֹכִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵל קַנָּא פֹּקֵד עֲוֺן אָבוֹת עַל בָּנִים וְעַל שִׁלֵּשִׁים וְעַל רִבֵּעִים לְשֹׂנְאָי׃

english.text:
You shall not bow to them, and you shall not serve them.
Because I, YHWH, your God, am a jealous God, counting
parents’ crime on children and on the third generation and
on the fourth generation of those who hate me,

translation.text: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,

verses.english:
You shall not bow to them, and you shall not serve them.
Because I, YHWH, your God, am a jealous God, counting
parents’ crime on children and on the third generation and
on the fourth generation of those who hate me,

verses.hebrew: וְעֹשֶׂה חֶסֶד לַאֲלָפִים לְאֹהֲבַי וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי (מצותו) [מִצְוֺתָי]׃

hebrew.text: וְעֹשֶׂה חֶסֶד לַאֲלָפִים לְאֹהֲבַי וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי (מצותו) [מִצְוֺתָי]׃

english.text:
but practicing kindness to thousands for those who love me
and for those who observe my commandments.

translation.text: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.

verses.english:
but practicing kindness to thousands for those who love me
and for those who observe my commandments.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִשָּׂא אֶת שֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַשָּׁוְא כִּי לֹא יְנַקֶּה יְהֹוָה אֵת אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׂא אֶת שְׁמוֹ לַשָּׁוְא׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִשָּׂא אֶת שֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַשָּׁוְא כִּי לֹא יְנַקֶּה יְהֹוָה אֵת אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׂא אֶת שְׁמוֹ לַשָּׁוְא׃

english.text:
You shall not bring up the name of YHWH, your God, for a
falsehood, because YHWH will not make one innocent who
will bring up His name for a falsehood.

translation.text: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

verses.english:
You shall not bring up the name of YHWH, your God, for a
falsehood, because YHWH will not make one innocent who
will bring up His name for a falsehood.

verses.hebrew: שָׁמוֹר אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת לְקַדְּשׁוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: שָׁמוֹר אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת לְקַדְּשׁוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Observe the Sabbath day, to make it holy, as YHWH, your
God, commanded you.

translation.text: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.

verses.english:
Observe the Sabbath day, to make it holy, as YHWH, your
God, commanded you.

verses.hebrew: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תַּעֲבֹד וְעָשִׂיתָ כּל מְלַאכְתֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תַּעֲבֹד וְעָשִׂיתָ כּל מְלַאכְתֶּךָ׃

english.text: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

translation.text: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:

verses.english: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבָּת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה כל מְלָאכָה אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבִתֶּךָ וְעַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתֶךָ וְשׁוֹרְךָ וַחֲמֹרְךָ וְכל בְּהֶמְתֶּךָ וְגֵרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ לְמַעַן יָנוּחַ עַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתְךָ כָּמוֹךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבָּת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה כל מְלָאכָה אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבִתֶּךָ וְעַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתֶךָ וְשׁוֹרְךָ וַחֲמֹרְךָ וְכל בְּהֶמְתֶּךָ וְגֵרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ לְמַעַן יָנוּחַ עַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתְךָ כָּמוֹךָ׃

english.text:
and the seventh day is a Sabbath to YHWH, your God. You
shall not do any work: you and your son and your daughter
and your servant and your maid and your ox and your ass or
any animal and your alien who is in your gates—in order
that your servant and your maid will rest like you,

translation.text: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.

verses.english:
and the seventh day is a Sabbath to YHWH, your God. You
shall not do any work: you and your son and your daughter
and your servant and your maid and your ox and your ass or
any animal and your alien who is in your gates—in order
that your servant and your maid will rest like you,

verses.hebrew: וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיֹּצִאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִשָּׁם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרֹעַ נְטוּיָה עַל כֵּן צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת׃

hebrew.text: וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיֹּצִאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִשָּׁם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרֹעַ נְטוּיָה עַל כֵּן צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת׃

english.text:
and you shall remember that you were a slave in the land
of Egypt and YHWH, your God, brought you out from there
with a strong hand and an outstretched arm. On account of
this, YHWH, your God, has commanded you to do the Sabbath
day.

translation.text: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.

verses.english:
and you shall remember that you were a slave in the land
of Egypt and YHWH, your God, brought you out from there
with a strong hand and an outstretched arm. On account of
this, YHWH, your God, has commanded you to do the Sabbath
day.

verses.hebrew: כַּבֵּד אֶת אָבִיךָ וְאֶת אִמֶּךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְמַעַן יַאֲרִיכֻן יָמֶיךָ וּלְמַעַן יִיטַב לָךְ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: כַּבֵּד אֶת אָבִיךָ וְאֶת אִמֶּךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְמַעַן יַאֲרִיכֻן יָמֶיךָ וּלְמַעַן יִיטַב לָךְ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

english.text:
Honor your father and your mother, as YHWH, your God,
commanded you, so that your days will be extended and so
that it will be good for you on the land that YHWH, your
God, is giving you.

translation.text: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

verses.english:
Honor your father and your mother, as YHWH, your God,
commanded you, so that your days will be extended and so
that it will be good for you on the land that YHWH, your
God, is giving you.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִּרְצָ͏ח׃ ס וְלֹא תִּנְאָ͏ף׃ ס וְלֹא תִּגְנֹב׃ ס וְלֹא תַעֲנֶה בְרֵעֲךָ עֵד שָׁוְא׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִּרְצָ͏ח׃ ס וְלֹא תִּנְאָ͏ף׃ ס וְלֹא תִּגְנֹב׃ ס וְלֹא תַעֲנֶה בְרֵעֲךָ עֵד שָׁוְא׃

english.text:
You shall not murder. And you shall not commit adultery.
And you shall not steal. And you shall not testify against
your neighbor as a false witness.

translation.text: Thou shalt not kill.

verses.english:
You shall not murder. And you shall not commit adultery.
And you shall not steal. And you shall not testify against
your neighbor as a false witness.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תַחְמֹד אֵשֶׁת רֵעֶךָ ס וְלֹא תִתְאַוֶּה בֵּית רֵעֶךָ שָׂדֵהוּ וְעַבְדּוֹ וַאֲמָתוֹ שׁוֹרוֹ וַחֲמֹרוֹ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לְרֵעֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תַחְמֹד אֵשֶׁת רֵעֶךָ ס וְלֹא תִתְאַוֶּה בֵּית רֵעֶךָ שָׂדֵהוּ וְעַבְדּוֹ וַאֲמָתוֹ שׁוֹרוֹ וַחֲמֹרוֹ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לְרֵעֶךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, and you
shall not long for your neighbor’s house, his field, or
his servant or his maid, his ox or his ass or anything
that your neighbor has.

translation.text: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.

verses.english:
And you shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, and you
shall not long for your neighbor’s house, his field, or
his servant or his maid, his ox or his ass or anything
that your neighbor has.

verses.hebrew: אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל כּל קְהַלְכֶם בָּהָר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ הֶעָנָן וְהָעֲרָפֶל קוֹל גָּדוֹל וְלֹא יָסָף וַיִּכְתְּבֵם עַל שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים וַיִּתְּנֵם אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל כּל קְהַלְכֶם בָּהָר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ הֶעָנָן וְהָעֲרָפֶל קוֹל גָּדוֹל וְלֹא יָסָף וַיִּכְתְּבֵם עַל שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים וַיִּתְּנֵם אֵלָי׃

english.text:
“YHWH spoke these words to your entire community at the
mountain from inside the fire, the cloud, and the nimbus,
a powerful voice. And He did not add. And He wrote them on
two tablets of stones and gave them to me.

translation.text: Neither shalt thou steal.

verses.english:
“YHWH spoke these words to your entire community at the
mountain from inside the fire, the cloud, and the nimbus,
a powerful voice. And He did not add. And He wrote them on
two tablets of stones and gave them to me.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּשׁמְעֲכֶם אֶת הַקּוֹל מִתּוֹךְ הַחֹשֶׁךְ וְהָהָר בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ וַתִּקְרְבוּן אֵלַי כּל רָאשֵׁי שִׁבְטֵיכֶם וְזִקְנֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּשׁמְעֲכֶם אֶת הַקּוֹל מִתּוֹךְ הַחֹשֶׁךְ וְהָהָר בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ וַתִּקְרְבוּן אֵלַי כּל רָאשֵׁי שִׁבְטֵיכֶם וְזִקְנֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“And it was when you heard the voice from inside the
darkness, as the mountain was burning in fire, that you
came forward to me, all the heads of your tribes and your
elders,

translation.text: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.

verses.english:
“And it was when you heard the voice from inside the
darkness, as the mountain was burning in fire, that you
came forward to me, all the heads of your tribes and your
elders,

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמְרוּ הֵן הֶרְאָנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת כְּבֹדוֹ וְאֶת גּדְלוֹ וְאֶת קֹלוֹ שָׁמַעְנוּ מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה רָאִינוּ כִּי יְדַבֵּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאָדָם וָחָי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמְרוּ הֵן הֶרְאָנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת כְּבֹדוֹ וְאֶת גּדְלוֹ וְאֶת קֹלוֹ שָׁמַעְנוּ מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה רָאִינוּ כִּי יְדַבֵּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאָדָם וָחָי׃

english.text:
and you said, ‘Here, YHWH, our God, has shown us His glory
and His greatness, and we’ve heard His voice from inside
the fire. This day we’ve seen that God may speak to a
human and he lives.

translation.text: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour’s wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour’s house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour’s.

verses.english:
and you said, ‘Here, YHWH, our God, has shown us His glory
and His greatness, and we’ve heard His voice from inside
the fire. This day we’ve seen that God may speak to a
human and he lives.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לָמָּה נָמוּת כִּי תֹאכְלֵנוּ הָאֵשׁ הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת אִם יֹסְפִים אֲנַחְנוּ לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶת קוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ עוֹד וָמָתְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לָמָּה נָמוּת כִּי תֹאכְלֵנוּ הָאֵשׁ הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת אִם יֹסְפִים אֲנַחְנוּ לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶת קוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ עוֹד וָמָתְנוּ׃

english.text:
So now why should we die? Because this big fire will
consume us. If we go on hearing the voice of YHWH, our
God, anymore, then we’ll die.

translation.text: These words the LORD spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.

verses.english:
So now why should we die? Because this big fire will
consume us. If we go on hearing the voice of YHWH, our
God, anymore, then we’ll die.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מִי כל בָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע קוֹל אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים מְדַבֵּר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ כָּמֹנוּ וַיֶּחִי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי מִי כל בָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע קוֹל אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים מְדַבֵּר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ כָּמֹנוּ וַיֶּחִי׃

english.text:
Because who, of all flesh, is there who has heard the
voice of the living God speaking from inside fire as we
have and lived?

translation.text: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

verses.english:
Because who, of all flesh, is there who has heard the
voice of the living God speaking from inside fire as we
have and lived?

verses.hebrew: קְרַב אַתָּה וּשְׁמָע אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְאַתְּ תְּדַבֵּר אֵלֵינוּ אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְשָׁמַעְנוּ וְעָשִׂינוּ׃

hebrew.text: קְרַב אַתָּה וּשְׁמָע אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְאַתְּ תְּדַבֵּר אֵלֵינוּ אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְשָׁמַעְנוּ וְעָשִׂינוּ׃

english.text:
You go forward and listen to everything that YHWH, our
God, will say, and you’ll speak to us everything that
YHWH, our God, will speak to you, and we’ll listen, and
we’ll do it.’

translation.text: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.

verses.english:
You go forward and listen to everything that YHWH, our
God, will say, and you’ll speak to us everything that
YHWH, our God, will speak to you, and we’ll listen, and
we’ll do it.’

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֶת קוֹל דִּבְרֵיכֶם בְּדַבֶּרְכֶם אֵלָי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת קוֹל דִּבְרֵי הָעָם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ אֵלֶיךָ הֵיטִיבוּ כּל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּרוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֶת קוֹל דִּבְרֵיכֶם בְּדַבֶּרְכֶם אֵלָי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת קוֹל דִּבְרֵי הָעָם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ אֵלֶיךָ הֵיטִיבוּ כּל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּרוּ׃

english.text:
“And YHWH listened to your words’ voice when you were
speaking to me, and YHWH said to me, ‘I’ve listened to the
voice of this people’s words that they spoke to you.
They’ve been good in everything that they’ve spoken.

translation.text: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.

verses.english:
“And YHWH listened to your words’ voice when you were
speaking to me, and YHWH said to me, ‘I’ve listened to the
voice of this people’s words that they spoke to you.
They’ve been good in everything that they’ve spoken.

verses.hebrew: מִי יִתֵּן וְהָיָה לְבָבָם זֶה לָהֶם לְיִרְאָה אֹתִי וְלִשְׁמֹר אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתַי כּל הַיָּמִים לְמַעַן יִיטַב לָהֶם וְלִבְנֵיהֶם לְעֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: מִי יִתֵּן וְהָיָה לְבָבָם זֶה לָהֶם לְיִרְאָה אֹתִי וְלִשְׁמֹר אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתַי כּל הַיָּמִים לְמַעַן יִיטַב לָהֶם וְלִבְנֵיהֶם לְעֹלָם׃

english.text:
Who would make it so, that they would have such a heart,
to fear me and observe all my commandments every day, so
it would be good for them and for their children forever!

translation.text: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?

verses.english:
Who would make it so, that they would have such a heart,
to fear me and observe all my commandments every day, so
it would be good for them and for their children forever!

verses.hebrew: לֵךְ אֱמֹר לָהֶם שׁוּבוּ לָכֶם לְאהֳלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֵךְ אֱמֹר לָהֶם שׁוּבוּ לָכֶם לְאהֳלֵיכֶם׃

english.text: Go say to them, “Go back to your tents.”

translation.text: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.

verses.english: Go say to them, “Go back to your tents.”

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה פֹּה עֲמֹד עִמָּדִי וַאֲדַבְּרָה אֵלֶיךָ אֵת כּל הַמִּצְוָה וְהַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר תְּלַמְּדֵם וְעָשׂוּ בָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן לָהֶם לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה פֹּה עֲמֹד עִמָּדִי וַאֲדַבְּרָה אֵלֶיךָ אֵת כּל הַמִּצְוָה וְהַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר תְּלַמְּדֵם וְעָשׂוּ בָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן לָהֶם לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
And you, stand here with me so I may speak to you all the
commandment and the laws and the judgments that you shall
teach them so they’ll do them in the land that I’m giving
them to take possession of it.

translation.text: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.

verses.english:
And you, stand here with me so I may speak to you all the
commandment and the laws and the judgments that you shall
teach them so they’ll do them in the land that I’m giving
them to take possession of it.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם לַעֲשׂוֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶתְכֶם לֹא תָסֻרוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאל׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם לַעֲשׂוֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶתְכֶם לֹא תָסֻרוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאל׃

english.text:
And you shall be watchful to do as YHWH, your God, has
commanded you. You shall not turn right or left.

translation.text: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!

verses.english:
And you shall be watchful to do as YHWH, your God, has
commanded you. You shall not turn right or left.

verses.hebrew: בְּכל הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶתְכֶם תֵּלֵכוּ לְמַעַן תִּחְיוּן וְטוֹב לָכֶם וְהַאֲרַכְתֶּם יָמִים בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּירָשׁוּן׃

hebrew.text: בְּכל הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶתְכֶם תֵּלֵכוּ לְמַעַן תִּחְיוּן וְטוֹב לָכֶם וְהַאֲרַכְתֶּם יָמִים בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּירָשׁוּן׃

english.text:
You shall go in all the way that YHWH, your God, has
commanded you, so that you’ll live, and it will be good
for you, and you’ll extend days in the land that you’ll
possess.’

translation.text: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.

verses.english:
You shall go in all the way that YHWH, your God, has
commanded you, so that you’ll live, and it will be good
for you, and you’ll extend days in the land that you’ll
possess.’

verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת הַמִּצְוָה הַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְלַמֵּד אֶתְכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְזֹאת הַמִּצְוָה הַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְלַמֵּד אֶתְכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
“And this is the commandment, the laws, and the
judgments that YHWH, your God, commanded to teach you to
do in the land to which you’re crossing to take possession
of it,

translation.text: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:

verses.english:
“And this is the commandment, the laws, and the
judgments that YHWH, your God, commanded to teach you to
do in the land to which you’re crossing to take possession
of it,

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן תִּירָא אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר אֶת כּל חֻקֹּתָיו וּמִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּךָ אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבֶן בִּנְךָ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ וּלְמַעַן יַאֲרִכֻן יָמֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן תִּירָא אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר אֶת כּל חֻקֹּתָיו וּמִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּךָ אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבֶן בִּנְךָ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ וּלְמַעַן יַאֲרִכֻן יָמֶיךָ׃

english.text:
so that you’ll fear YHWH, your God, to observe all His
laws and His commandments that I’m commanding you: you and
your child and your child’s child, all the days of your
life, and so that your days will be extended.

translation.text: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.

verses.english:
so that you’ll fear YHWH, your God, to observe all His
laws and His commandments that I’m commanding you: you and
your child and your child’s child, all the days of your
life, and so that your days will be extended.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשָׁמַרְתָּ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֲשֶׁר יִיטַב לְךָ וַאֲשֶׁר תִּרְבּוּן מְאֹד כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֶיךָ לָךְ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשָׁמַרְתָּ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֲשֶׁר יִיטַב לְךָ וַאֲשֶׁר תִּרְבּוּן מְאֹד כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֶיךָ לָךְ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

english.text:
And you shall listen, Israel, and be watchful to do it,
that it will be good for you and that you’ll multiply very
much, as YHWH, your fathers’ God, spoke to you: a land
flowing with milk and honey.

translation.text: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.

verses.english:
And you shall listen, Israel, and be watchful to do it,
that it will be good for you and that you’ll multiply very
much, as YHWH, your fathers’ God, spoke to you: a land
flowing with milk and honey.

verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְהֹוָה אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְהֹוָה אֶחָד׃

english.text: “Listen, Israel: YHWH is our God. YHWH is one.

translation.text: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:

verses.english: “Listen, Israel: YHWH is our God. YHWH is one.

verses.hebrew: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכל מְאֹדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכל מְאֹדֶךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall love YHWH, your God, with all your heart and
with all your soul and with all your might.

translation.text: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

verses.english:
And you shall love YHWH, your God, with all your heart and
with all your soul and with all your might.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם עַל לְבָבֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם עַל לְבָבֶךָ׃

english.text:
And these words that I command you today shall be on your
heart.

translation.text: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:

verses.english:
And these words that I command you today shall be on your
heart.

verses.hebrew: וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּרֶךְ וּבְשׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּרֶךְ וּבְשׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall impart them to your children, and you shall
speak about them when you sit in your house and when you
go in the road and when you lie down and when you get up.

translation.text: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

verses.english:
And you shall impart them to your children, and you shall
speak about them when you sit in your house and when you
go in the road and when you lie down and when you get up.

verses.hebrew: וּקְשַׁרְתָּם לְאוֹת עַל יָדֶךָ וְהָיוּ לְטֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּקְשַׁרְתָּם לְאוֹת עַל יָדֶךָ וְהָיוּ לְטֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they
shall become bands between your eyes.

translation.text: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.

verses.english:
And you shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they
shall become bands between your eyes.

verses.hebrew: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל מְזֻזוֹת בֵּיתֶךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל מְזֻזוֹת בֵּיתֶךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall write them on the doorposts of your house
and in your gates.

translation.text: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.

verses.english:
And you shall write them on the doorposts of your house
and in your gates.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי יְבִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לָתֶת לָךְ עָרִים גְּדֹלֹת וְטֹבֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא בָנִיתָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי יְבִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לָתֶת לָךְ עָרִים גְּדֹלֹת וְטֹבֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא בָנִיתָ׃

english.text:
“And it will be when YHWH, your God, will bring you to the
land that He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac,
and to Jacob, to give you big and good cities that you
didn’t build,

translation.text: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,

verses.english:
“And it will be when YHWH, your God, will bring you to the
land that He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac,
and to Jacob, to give you big and good cities that you
didn’t build,

verses.hebrew: וּבָתִּים מְלֵאִים כּל טוּב אֲשֶׁר לֹא מִלֵּאתָ וּבֹרֹת חֲצוּבִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא חָצַבְתָּ כְּרָמִים וְזֵיתִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא נָטָעְתָּ וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבָתִּים מְלֵאִים כּל טוּב אֲשֶׁר לֹא מִלֵּאתָ וּבֹרֹת חֲצוּבִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא חָצַבְתָּ כְּרָמִים וְזֵיתִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא נָטָעְתָּ וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ׃

english.text:
and houses filled with everything good that you didn’t
fill, and cisterns hewed that you didn’t hew, vineyards
and olives that you did’t plant, and you’ll eat and be
satisfied,

translation.text: And houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;

verses.english:
and houses filled with everything good that you didn’t
fill, and cisterns hewed that you didn’t hew, vineyards
and olives that you did’t plant, and you’ll eat and be
satisfied,

verses.hebrew: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תִּשְׁכַּח אֶת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיאֲךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים׃

hebrew.text: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תִּשְׁכַּח אֶת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיאֲךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים׃

english.text:
watch yourself in case you’ll forget YHWH, who brought you
out from the land of Egypt, from a house of slaves.

translation.text: Then beware lest thou forget the LORD, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

verses.english:
watch yourself in case you’ll forget YHWH, who brought you
out from the land of Egypt, from a house of slaves.

verses.hebrew: אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תִּירָא וְאֹתוֹ תַעֲבֹד וּבִשְׁמוֹ תִּשָּׁבֵעַ׃

hebrew.text: אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תִּירָא וְאֹתוֹ תַעֲבֹד וּבִשְׁמוֹ תִּשָּׁבֵעַ׃

english.text:
It’s YHWH, your God, whom you’ll fear, and it’s He whom
you’ll serve, and it’s in His name that you’ll swear.

translation.text: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.

verses.english:
It’s YHWH, your God, whom you’ll fear, and it’s He whom
you’ll serve, and it’s in His name that you’ll swear.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תֵלְכוּן אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים מֵאֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֵלְכוּן אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים מֵאֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
You shall not go after other gods, from the gods of the
peoples who are around you,

translation.text: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;

verses.english:
You shall not go after other gods, from the gods of the
peoples who are around you,

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵל קַנָּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּקִרְבֶּךָ פֶּן יֶחֱרֶה אַף יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּךְ וְהִשְׁמִידְךָ מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֵל קַנָּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּקִרְבֶּךָ פֶּן יֶחֱרֶה אַף יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּךְ וְהִשְׁמִידְךָ מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
because YHWH, your God, is a jealous God among you, in
case the anger of YHWH, your God, will flare at you, and
He’ll destroy you from the face of the earth.

translation.text: (For the LORD thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.

verses.english:
because YHWH, your God, is a jealous God among you, in
case the anger of YHWH, your God, will flare at you, and
He’ll destroy you from the face of the earth.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תְנַסּוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר נִסִּיתֶם בַּמַּסָּה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תְנַסּוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר נִסִּיתֶם בַּמַּסָּה׃

english.text:
You shall not test YHWH, your God, as you tested at
Massah.

translation.text: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.

verses.english:
You shall not test YHWH, your God, as you tested at
Massah.

verses.hebrew: שָׁמוֹר תִּשְׁמְרוּן אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְעֵדֹתָיו וְחֻקָּיו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: שָׁמוֹר תִּשְׁמְרוּן אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְעֵדֹתָיו וְחֻקָּיו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּךְ׃

english.text:
You shall observe the commandments of YHWH, your God, and
His testimonies and His laws that He commanded you.

translation.text: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.

verses.english:
You shall observe the commandments of YHWH, your God, and
His testimonies and His laws that He commanded you.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ הַיָּשָׁר וְהַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְמַעַן יִיטַב לָךְ וּבָאתָ וְיָרַשְׁתָּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַטֹּבָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ הַיָּשָׁר וְהַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְמַעַן יִיטַב לָךְ וּבָאתָ וְיָרַשְׁתָּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַטֹּבָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall do what is right and good in YHWH’s eyes so
it will be good for you, and you’ll come and take
possession of the good land that YHWH swore to your
fathers,

translation.text: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers.

verses.english:
And you shall do what is right and good in YHWH’s eyes so
it will be good for you, and you’ll come and take
possession of the good land that YHWH swore to your
fathers,

verses.hebrew: לַהֲדֹף אֶת כּל אֹיְבֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: לַהֲדֹף אֶת כּל אֹיְבֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
to push all your enemies from in front of you, as YHWH has
spoken.

translation.text: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.

verses.english:
to push all your enemies from in front of you, as YHWH has
spoken.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִשְׁאָלְךָ בִנְךָ מָחָר לֵאמֹר מָה הָעֵדֹת וְהַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִשְׁאָלְךָ בִנְךָ מָחָר לֵאמֹר מָה הָעֵדֹת וְהַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
“When your child will ask you tomorrow, saying, ‘What are
the testimonies and the laws and the judgments that YHWH,
our God, commanded you?’

translation.text: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?

verses.english:
“When your child will ask you tomorrow, saying, ‘What are
the testimonies and the laws and the judgments that YHWH,
our God, commanded you?’

verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ לְבִנְךָ עֲבָדִים הָיִינוּ לְפַרְעֹה בְּמִצְרָיִם וַיֹּצִיאֵנוּ יְהֹוָה מִמִּצְרַיִם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ לְבִנְךָ עֲבָדִים הָיִינוּ לְפַרְעֹה בְּמִצְרָיִם וַיֹּצִיאֵנוּ יְהֹוָה מִמִּצְרַיִם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה׃

english.text:
then you shall say to your child, ‘We were slaves to
Pharaoh in Egypt, and YHWH brought us out from Egypt with
a strong hand.

translation.text: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:

verses.english:
then you shall say to your child, ‘We were slaves to
Pharaoh in Egypt, and YHWH brought us out from Egypt with
a strong hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אוֹתֹת וּמֹפְתִים גְּדֹלִים וְרָעִים בְּמִצְרַיִם בְּפַרְעֹה וּבְכל בֵּיתוֹ לְעֵינֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אוֹתֹת וּמֹפְתִים גְּדֹלִים וְרָעִים בְּמִצְרַיִם בְּפַרְעֹה וּבְכל בֵּיתוֹ לְעֵינֵינוּ׃

english.text:
And YHWH put great and harsh signs and wonders in Egypt at
Pharaoh and at all of his household before our eyes.

translation.text: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:

verses.english:
And YHWH put great and harsh signs and wonders in Egypt at
Pharaoh and at all of his household before our eyes.

verses.hebrew: וְאוֹתָנוּ הוֹצִיא מִשָּׁם לְמַעַן הָבִיא אֹתָנוּ לָתֶת לָנוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאוֹתָנוּ הוֹצִיא מִשָּׁם לְמַעַן הָבִיא אֹתָנוּ לָתֶת לָנוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ׃

english.text:
And He brought us out from there in order to bring us to
give us the land that He swore to our fathers.

translation.text: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.

verses.english:
And He brought us out from there in order to bring us to
give us the land that He swore to our fathers.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַוֵּנוּ יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל הַחֻקִּים הָאֵלֶּה לְיִרְאָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְטוֹב לָנוּ כּל הַיָּמִים לְחַיֹּתֵנוּ כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַוֵּנוּ יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל הַחֻקִּים הָאֵלֶּה לְיִרְאָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְטוֹב לָנוּ כּל הַיָּמִים לְחַיֹּתֵנוּ כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And YHWH commanded us to do all these laws, to fear YHWH,
our God, for our good every day, to keep us alive as we
are this day.

translation.text: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.

verses.english:
And YHWH commanded us to do all these laws, to fear YHWH,
our God, for our good every day, to keep us alive as we
are this day.

verses.hebrew: וּצְדָקָה תִּהְיֶה לָּנוּ כִּי נִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל הַמִּצְוָה הַזֹּאת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּצְדָקָה תִּהְיֶה לָּנוּ כִּי נִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל הַמִּצְוָה הַזֹּאת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּנוּ׃

english.text:
And we’ll have virtue when we are watchful to do all of
this commandment in front of YHWH, our God, as He
commanded us.’

translation.text: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded us.

verses.english:
And we’ll have virtue when we are watchful to do all of
this commandment in front of YHWH, our God, as He
commanded us.’

verses.hebrew: כִּי יְבִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ וְנָשַׁל גּוֹיִם רַבִּים מִפָּנֶיךָ הַחִתִּי וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי שִׁבְעָה גוֹיִם רַבִּים וַעֲצוּמִים מִמֶּךָּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יְבִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ וְנָשַׁל גּוֹיִם רַבִּים מִפָּנֶיךָ הַחִתִּי וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי שִׁבְעָה גוֹיִם רַבִּים וַעֲצוּמִים מִמֶּךָּ׃

english.text:
“When YHWH, your God, will bring you to the land to
which you’re coming to take possession of it and will
eject numerous nations from in front of you—the Hittite
and the Girgashite and the Amorite and the Canaanite and
the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite—seven
nations more numerous and powerful than you,

translation.text: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;

verses.english:
“When YHWH, your God, will bring you to the land to
which you’re coming to take possession of it and will
eject numerous nations from in front of you—the Hittite
and the Girgashite and the Amorite and the Canaanite and
the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite—seven
nations more numerous and powerful than you,

verses.hebrew: וּנְתָנָם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְפָנֶיךָ וְהִכִּיתָם הַחֲרֵם תַּחֲרִים אֹתָם לֹא תִכְרֹת לָהֶם בְּרִית וְלֹא תְחנֵּם׃

hebrew.text: וּנְתָנָם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְפָנֶיךָ וְהִכִּיתָם הַחֲרֵם תַּחֲרִים אֹתָם לֹא תִכְרֹת לָהֶם בְּרִית וְלֹא תְחנֵּם׃

english.text:
and YHWH, your God, will put them in front of you, and
you’ll strike them: you shall completely destroy them! You
shall not make a covenant with them, and you shall not
show grace to them.

translation.text: And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:

verses.english:
and YHWH, your God, will put them in front of you, and
you’ll strike them: you shall completely destroy them! You
shall not make a covenant with them, and you shall not
show grace to them.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תִתְחַתֵּן בָּם בִּתְּךָ לֹא תִתֵּן לִבְנוֹ וּבִתּוֹ לֹא תִקַּח לִבְנֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תִתְחַתֵּן בָּם בִּתְּךָ לֹא תִתֵּן לִבְנוֹ וּבִתּוֹ לֹא תִקַּח לִבְנֶךָ׃

translation.text: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יָסִיר אֶת בִּנְךָ מֵאַחֲרַי וְעָבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְחָרָה אַף יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וְהִשְׁמִידְךָ מַהֵר׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יָסִיר אֶת בִּנְךָ מֵאַחֲרַי וְעָבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְחָרָה אַף יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וְהִשְׁמִידְךָ מַהֵר׃

english.text:
because he’ll turn your son from after me, and they’ll
serve other gods, and YHWH’s anger will flare at you, and
He’ll destroy you quickly.

translation.text: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.

verses.english:
because he’ll turn your son from after me, and they’ll
serve other gods, and YHWH’s anger will flare at you, and
He’ll destroy you quickly.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם כֹּה תַעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם מִזְבְּחֹתֵיהֶם תִּתֹּצוּ וּמַצֵּבֹתָם תְּשַׁבֵּרוּ וַאֲשֵׁירֵהֶם תְּגַדֵּעוּן וּפְסִילֵיהֶם תִּשְׂרְפוּן בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם כֹּה תַעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם מִזְבְּחֹתֵיהֶם תִּתֹּצוּ וּמַצֵּבֹתָם תְּשַׁבֵּרוּ וַאֲשֵׁירֵהֶם תְּגַדֵּעוּן וּפְסִילֵיהֶם תִּשְׂרְפוּן בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
But this is what you shall do to them: you shall demolish
their altars and shatter their pillars and cut down their
Asherahs and burn their statues in fire.

translation.text: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.

verses.english:
But this is what you shall do to them: you shall demolish
their altars and shatter their pillars and cut down their
Asherahs and burn their statues in fire.

verses.hebrew: כִּי עַם קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּךָ בָּחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִהְיוֹת לוֹ לְעַם סְגֻלָּה מִכֹּל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי עַם קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּךָ בָּחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִהְיוֹת לוֹ לְעַם סְגֻלָּה מִכֹּל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
Because you are a holy people to YHWH, your God. YHWH,
your God, chose you to become a treasured people to Him
out of all the peoples who are on the face of the earth.

translation.text: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.

verses.english:
Because you are a holy people to YHWH, your God. YHWH,
your God, chose you to become a treasured people to Him
out of all the peoples who are on the face of the earth.

verses.hebrew: לֹא מֵרֻבְּכֶם מִכּל הָעַמִּים חָשַׁק יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וַיִּבְחַר בָּכֶם כִּי אַתֶּם הַמְעַט מִכּל הָעַמִּים׃

hebrew.text: לֹא מֵרֻבְּכֶם מִכּל הָעַמִּים חָשַׁק יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וַיִּבְחַר בָּכֶם כִּי אַתֶּם הַמְעַט מִכּל הָעַמִּים׃

english.text:
It wasn’t because of your being more numerous than all the
peoples that YHWH was attracted to you so that He chose
you, because you’re the smallest of all the peoples.

translation.text: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:

verses.english:
It wasn’t because of your being more numerous than all the
peoples that YHWH was attracted to you so that He chose
you, because you’re the smallest of all the peoples.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מֵאַהֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם וּמִשּׁמְרוֹ אֶת הַשְּׁבֻעָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם הוֹצִיא יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וַיִּפְדְּךָ מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים מִיַּד פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי מֵאַהֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם וּמִשּׁמְרוֹ אֶת הַשְּׁבֻעָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם הוֹצִיא יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וַיִּפְדְּךָ מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים מִיַּד פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
But because of YHWH’s loving you and because of His
keeping the oath that He swore to your fathers, YHWH
brought you out with a strong hand and redeemed you from a
house of slaves, from the hand of Pharaoh, king of Egypt.

translation.text: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

verses.english:
But because of YHWH’s loving you and because of His
keeping the oath that He swore to your fathers, YHWH
brought you out with a strong hand and redeemed you from a
house of slaves, from the hand of Pharaoh, king of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וְיָדַעְתָּ כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים הָאֵל הַנֶּאֱמָן שֹׁמֵר הַבְּרִית וְהַחֶסֶד לְאֹהֲבָיו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי מִצְוֺתָו לְאֶלֶף דּוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְיָדַעְתָּ כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים הָאֵל הַנֶּאֱמָן שֹׁמֵר הַבְּרִית וְהַחֶסֶד לְאֹהֲבָיו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי מִצְוֺתָו לְאֶלֶף דּוֹר׃

english.text:
Therefore you shall know that YHWH, your God, He is God,
the faithful God, keeping the covenant and kindness for
those who love Him and who observe His commandments to the
thousandth generation

translation.text: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;

verses.english:
Therefore you shall know that YHWH, your God, He is God,
the faithful God, keeping the covenant and kindness for
those who love Him and who observe His commandments to the
thousandth generation

verses.hebrew: וּמְשַׁלֵּם לְשֹׂנְאָיו אֶל פָּנָיו לְהַאֲבִידוֹ לֹא יְאַחֵר לְשֹׂנְאוֹ אֶל פָּנָיו יְשַׁלֶּם לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּמְשַׁלֵּם לְשֹׂנְאָיו אֶל פָּנָיו לְהַאֲבִידוֹ לֹא יְאַחֵר לְשֹׂנְאוֹ אֶל פָּנָיו יְשַׁלֶּם לוֹ׃

english.text:
and paying back to those who hate Him to their faces to
destroy them. He won’t delay toward one who hates Him.
He’ll pay him back to his face.

translation.text: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.

verses.english:
and paying back to those who hate Him to their faces to
destroy them. He won’t delay toward one who hates Him.
He’ll pay him back to his face.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת הַמִּצְוָה וְאֶת הַחֻקִּים וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לַעֲשׂוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת הַמִּצְוָה וְאֶת הַחֻקִּים וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לַעֲשׂוֹתָם׃

english.text:
So you shall observe the commandment and the laws and the
judgments that I command you today, to do them.

translation.text: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.

verses.english:
So you shall observe the commandment and the laws and the
judgments that I command you today, to do them.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה עֵקֶב תִּשְׁמְעוּן אֵת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים הָאֵלֶּה וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וְשָׁמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְךָ אֶת הַבְּרִית וְאֶת הַחֶסֶד אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה עֵקֶב תִּשְׁמְעוּן אֵת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים הָאֵלֶּה וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וְשָׁמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְךָ אֶת הַבְּרִית וְאֶת הַחֶסֶד אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

english.text:
BECAUSE “And it will be because you’ll listen to these
judgments and observe and do them that YHWH, your God,
will keep the covenant and kindness for you that he swore
to your fathers.

translation.text: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:

verses.english:
BECAUSE “And it will be because you’ll listen to these
judgments and observe and do them that YHWH, your God,
will keep the covenant and kindness for you that he swore
to your fathers.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲהֵבְךָ וּבֵרַכְךָ וְהִרְבֶּךָ וּבֵרַךְ פְּרִי בִטְנְךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתֶךָ דְּגָנְךָ וְתִירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶךָ שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹת צֹאנֶךָ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לָתֶת לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲהֵבְךָ וּבֵרַכְךָ וְהִרְבֶּךָ וּבֵרַךְ פְּרִי בִטְנְךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתֶךָ דְּגָנְךָ וְתִירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶךָ שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹת צֹאנֶךָ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לָתֶת לָךְ׃

english.text:
And He’ll love you and bless you and multiply you and
bless the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your land:
your grain and your wine and your oil, your cattle’s
offspring and your flock’s young, on the land that He
swore to your fathers to give to you.

translation.text: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

verses.english:
And He’ll love you and bless you and multiply you and
bless the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your land:
your grain and your wine and your oil, your cattle’s
offspring and your flock’s young, on the land that He
swore to your fathers to give to you.

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ תִּהְיֶה מִכּל הָעַמִּים לֹא יִהְיֶה בְךָ עָקָר וַעֲקָרָה וּבִבְהֶמְתֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: בָּרוּךְ תִּהְיֶה מִכּל הָעַמִּים לֹא יִהְיֶה בְךָ עָקָר וַעֲקָרָה וּבִבְהֶמְתֶּךָ׃

english.text:
You’ll be more blessed than all the peoples. There won’t
be an infertile male or female among you or among your
animals.

translation.text: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.

verses.english:
You’ll be more blessed than all the peoples. There won’t
be an infertile male or female among you or among your
animals.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵסִיר יְהֹוָה מִמְּךָ כּל חֹלִי וְכל מַדְוֵי מִצְרַיִם הָרָעִים אֲשֶׁר יָדַעְתָּ לֹא יְשִׂימָם בָּךְ וּנְתָנָם בְּכל שֹׂנְאֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵסִיר יְהֹוָה מִמְּךָ כּל חֹלִי וְכל מַדְוֵי מִצְרַיִם הָרָעִים אֲשֶׁר יָדַעְתָּ לֹא יְשִׂימָם בָּךְ וּנְתָנָם בְּכל שֹׂנְאֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And YHWH will turn away from you every illness. And all
the bad diseases of Egypt that you knew: He won’t set them
among you but will put them among all who hate you.

translation.text: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.

verses.english:
And YHWH will turn away from you every illness. And all
the bad diseases of Egypt that you knew: He won’t set them
among you but will put them among all who hate you.

verses.hebrew: וְאָכַלְתָּ אֶת כּל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ לֹא תָחוֹס עֵינְךָ עֲלֵיהֶם וְלֹא תַעֲבֹד אֶת אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כִּי מוֹקֵשׁ הוּא לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָכַלְתָּ אֶת כּל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ לֹא תָחוֹס עֵינְךָ עֲלֵיהֶם וְלֹא תַעֲבֹד אֶת אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כִּי מוֹקֵשׁ הוּא לָךְ׃

english.text:
And you shall eat up all the peoples that YHWH, your God,
is giving you. Your eye shall not pity them. And you shall
not serve their gods, because that’s a trap for you.

translation.text: And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.

verses.english:
And you shall eat up all the peoples that YHWH, your God,
is giving you. Your eye shall not pity them. And you shall
not serve their gods, because that’s a trap for you.

verses.hebrew: כִּי תֹאמַר בִּלְבָבְךָ רַבִּים הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִמֶּנִּי אֵיכָה אוּכַל לְהוֹרִישָׁם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תֹאמַר בִּלְבָבְךָ רַבִּים הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִמֶּנִּי אֵיכָה אוּכַל לְהוֹרִישָׁם׃

english.text:
“If you say in your heart, ‘These nations are more
numerous than I; how shall I be able to dispossess them?’

translation.text: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?

verses.english:
“If you say in your heart, ‘These nations are more
numerous than I; how shall I be able to dispossess them?’

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִירָא מֵהֶם זָכֹר תִּזְכֹּר אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְפַרְעֹה וּלְכל מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִירָא מֵהֶם זָכֹר תִּזְכֹּר אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְפַרְעֹה וּלְכל מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
you shall not fear them. You shall remember what YHWH,
your God, did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:

translation.text: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;

verses.english:
you shall not fear them. You shall remember what YHWH,
your God, did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:

verses.hebrew: הַמַּסֹּת הַגְּדֹלֹת אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ וְהָאֹתֹת וְהַמֹּפְתִים וְהַיָּד הַחֲזָקָה וְהַזְּרֹעַ הַנְּטוּיָה אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְכל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה יָרֵא מִפְּנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: הַמַּסֹּת הַגְּדֹלֹת אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ וְהָאֹתֹת וְהַמֹּפְתִים וְהַיָּד הַחֲזָקָה וְהַזְּרֹעַ הַנְּטוּיָה אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְכל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה יָרֵא מִפְּנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
the big tests that your eyes saw and the signs and the
wonders and the strong hand and the outstretched arm by
which YHWH, your God, brought you out. So YHWH, your God,
will do to the peoples before whom you fear!

translation.text: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.

verses.english:
the big tests that your eyes saw and the signs and the
wonders and the strong hand and the outstretched arm by
which YHWH, your God, brought you out. So YHWH, your God,
will do to the peoples before whom you fear!

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֶת הַצִּרְעָה יְשַׁלַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּם עַד אֲבֹד הַנִּשְׁאָרִים וְהַנִּסְתָּרִים מִפָּנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אֶת הַצִּרְעָה יְשַׁלַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּם עַד אֲבֹד הַנִּשְׁאָרִים וְהַנִּסְתָּרִים מִפָּנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And YHWH, your God, will send the hornet against them as
well until those who remain and those who are hidden
perish from in front of you.

translation.text: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.

verses.english:
And YHWH, your God, will send the hornet against them as
well until those who remain and those who are hidden
perish from in front of you.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲרֹץ מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּקִרְבֶּךָ אֵל גָּדוֹל וְנוֹרָא׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲרֹץ מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּקִרְבֶּךָ אֵל גָּדוֹל וְנוֹרָא׃

english.text:
Don’t be scared in front of them, because YHWH, your God,
is among you, a great and fearful God.

translation.text: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.

verses.english:
Don’t be scared in front of them, because YHWH, your God,
is among you, a great and fearful God.

verses.hebrew: וְנָשַׁל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵל מִפָּנֶיךָ מְעַט מְעָט לֹא תוּכַל כַּלֹּתָם מַהֵר פֶּן תִּרְבֶּה עָלֶיךָ חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְנָשַׁל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵל מִפָּנֶיךָ מְעַט מְעָט לֹא תוּכַל כַּלֹּתָם מַהֵר פֶּן תִּרְבֶּה עָלֶיךָ חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
And YHWH, your God, will eject these nations from in front
of you little by little. You won’t be able to finish them
quickly, or else the animal of the field will become many
at you.

translation.text: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.

verses.english:
And YHWH, your God, will eject these nations from in front
of you little by little. You won’t be able to finish them
quickly, or else the animal of the field will become many
at you.

verses.hebrew: וּנְתָנָם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְפָנֶיךָ וְהָמָם מְהוּמָה גְדֹלָה עַד הִשָּׁמְדָם׃

hebrew.text: וּנְתָנָם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְפָנֶיךָ וְהָמָם מְהוּמָה גְדֹלָה עַד הִשָּׁמְדָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH, your God, will put them in front of you and put
them into a big tumult until they’re destroyed.

translation.text: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.

verses.english:
And YHWH, your God, will put them in front of you and put
them into a big tumult until they’re destroyed.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן מַלְכֵיהֶם בְּיָדֶךָ וְהַאֲבַדְתָּ אֶת שְׁמָם מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם לֹא יִתְיַצֵּב אִישׁ בְּפָנֶיךָ עַד הִשְׁמִדְךָ אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַן מַלְכֵיהֶם בְּיָדֶךָ וְהַאֲבַדְתָּ אֶת שְׁמָם מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם לֹא יִתְיַצֵּב אִישׁ בְּפָנֶיךָ עַד הִשְׁמִדְךָ אֹתָם׃

english.text:
And He’ll put their kings in your hand, and you’ll destroy
their name from under the skies. Not a man will stand in
front of you, until you’ve destroyed them.

translation.text: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.

verses.english:
And He’ll put their kings in your hand, and you’ll destroy
their name from under the skies. Not a man will stand in
front of you, until you’ve destroyed them.

verses.hebrew: פְּסִילֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶם תִּשְׂרְפוּן בָּאֵשׁ לֹא תַחְמֹד כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב עֲלֵיהֶם וְלָקַחְתָּ לָךְ פֶּן תִּוָּקֵשׁ בּוֹ כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא׃

hebrew.text: פְּסִילֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶם תִּשְׂרְפוּן בָּאֵשׁ לֹא תַחְמֹד כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב עֲלֵיהֶם וְלָקַחְתָּ לָךְ פֶּן תִּוָּקֵשׁ בּוֹ כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא׃

english.text:
You shall burn the statues of their gods in fire. You
shall not covet the silver and gold on them and take them
for yourself, in case you’ll be trapped through it,
because that is an offensive thing to YHWH, your God,

translation.text: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it is an abomination to the LORD thy God.

verses.english:
You shall burn the statues of their gods in fire. You
shall not covet the silver and gold on them and take them
for yourself, in case you’ll be trapped through it,
because that is an offensive thing to YHWH, your God,

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תָבִיא תוֹעֵבָה אֶל בֵּיתֶךָ וְהָיִיתָ חֵרֶם כָּמֹהוּ שַׁקֵּץ תְּשַׁקְּצֶנּוּ וְתַעֵב תְּתַעֲבֶנּוּ כִּי חֵרֶם הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תָבִיא תוֹעֵבָה אֶל בֵּיתֶךָ וְהָיִיתָ חֵרֶם כָּמֹהוּ שַׁקֵּץ תְּשַׁקְּצֶנּוּ וְתַעֵב תְּתַעֲבֶנּוּ כִּי חֵרֶם הוּא׃

english.text:
and you shall not bring an offensive thing to your house,
so that you’ll be a thing to be completely destroyed like
it. You shall detest it and find it abhorrent, because it
is a thing to be completely destroyed.
