translation.text: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.

verses.english:
and you shall not bring an offensive thing to your house,
so that you’ll be a thing to be completely destroyed like
it. You shall detest it and find it abhorrent, because it
is a thing to be completely destroyed.

verses.hebrew: כּל הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם תִּשְׁמְרוּן לַעֲשׂוֹת לְמַעַן תִּחְיוּן וּרְבִיתֶם וּבָאתֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם תִּשְׁמְרוּן לַעֲשׂוֹת לְמַעַן תִּחְיוּן וּרְבִיתֶם וּבָאתֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“All of the commandment that I command you today you
shall be watchful to do, so that you’ll live, and you’ll
multiply, and you’ll come and take possession of the land
that YHWH swore to your fathers.

translation.text: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.

verses.english:
“All of the commandment that I command you today you
shall be watchful to do, so that you’ll live, and you’ll
multiply, and you’ll come and take possession of the land
that YHWH swore to your fathers.

verses.hebrew: וְזָכַרְתָּ אֶת כּל הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הוֹלִיכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ זֶה אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בַּמִּדְבָּר לְמַעַן עַנֹּתְךָ לְנַסֹּתְךָ לָדַעַת אֶת אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבְךָ הֲתִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָו אִם לֹא׃

hebrew.text: וְזָכַרְתָּ אֶת כּל הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הוֹלִיכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ זֶה אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בַּמִּדְבָּר לְמַעַן עַנֹּתְךָ לְנַסֹּתְךָ לָדַעַת אֶת אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבְךָ הֲתִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָו אִם לֹא׃

english.text:
And you shall remember all the way that YHWH, your God,
had you go these forty years in the wilderness in order to
degrade you, to test you, to know what was in your heart:
would you observe His commandments or not.

translation.text: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.

verses.english:
And you shall remember all the way that YHWH, your God,
had you go these forty years in the wilderness in order to
degrade you, to test you, to know what was in your heart:
would you observe His commandments or not.

verses.hebrew: וַיְעַנְּךָ וַיַּרְעִבֶךָ וַיַּאֲכִלְךָ אֶת הַמָּן אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַעְתָּ וְלֹא יָדְעוּן אֲבֹתֶיךָ לְמַעַן הוֹדִיעֲךָ כִּי לֹא עַל הַלֶּחֶם לְבַדּוֹ יִחְיֶה הָאָדָם כִּי עַל כּל מוֹצָא פִי יְהֹוָה יִחְיֶה הָאָדָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְעַנְּךָ וַיַּרְעִבֶךָ וַיַּאֲכִלְךָ אֶת הַמָּן אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַעְתָּ וְלֹא יָדְעוּן אֲבֹתֶיךָ לְמַעַן הוֹדִיעֲךָ כִּי לֹא עַל הַלֶּחֶם לְבַדּוֹ יִחְיֶה הָאָדָם כִּי עַל כּל מוֹצָא פִי יְהֹוָה יִחְיֶה הָאָדָם׃

english.text:
So He degraded you and made you hunger and then fed you
the manna, which you had not known and your fathers had
not known, to let you know that a human doesn’t live by
bread alone, but a human lives by every product of YHWH’s
mouth.

translation.text: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.

verses.english:
So He degraded you and made you hunger and then fed you
the manna, which you had not known and your fathers had
not known, to let you know that a human doesn’t live by
bread alone, but a human lives by every product of YHWH’s
mouth.

verses.hebrew: שִׂמְלָתְךָ לֹא בָלְתָה מֵעָלֶיךָ וְרַגְלְךָ לֹא בָצֵקָה זֶה אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: שִׂמְלָתְךָ לֹא בָלְתָה מֵעָלֶיךָ וְרַגְלְךָ לֹא בָצֵקָה זֶה אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
Your garment didn’t wear out on you, and your foot didn’t
swell these forty years.

translation.text: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.

verses.english:
Your garment didn’t wear out on you, and your foot didn’t
swell these forty years.

verses.hebrew: וְיָדַעְתָּ עִם לְבָבֶךָ כִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר יְיַסֵּר אִישׁ אֶת בְּנוֹ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מְיַסְּרֶךָּ׃

hebrew.text: וְיָדַעְתָּ עִם לְבָבֶךָ כִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר יְיַסֵּר אִישׁ אֶת בְּנוֹ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מְיַסְּרֶךָּ׃

english.text:
So you shall know in your heart that, the way a man
disciplines his child, so YHWH, your God, disciplines you.

translation.text: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.

verses.english:
So you shall know in your heart that, the way a man
disciplines his child, so YHWH, your God, disciplines you.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָלֶכֶת בִּדְרָכָיו וּלְיִרְאָה אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָלֶכֶת בִּדְרָכָיו וּלְיִרְאָה אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And you shall observe the commandments of YHWH, your God,
to go in His ways and to fear Him.

translation.text: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

verses.english:
And you shall observe the commandments of YHWH, your God,
to go in His ways and to fear Him.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מְבִיאֲךָ אֶל אֶרֶץ טוֹבָה אֶרֶץ נַחֲלֵי מָיִם עֲיָנֹת וּתְהֹמֹת יֹצְאִים בַּבִּקְעָה וּבָהָר׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מְבִיאֲךָ אֶל אֶרֶץ טוֹבָה אֶרֶץ נַחֲלֵי מָיִם עֲיָנֹת וּתְהֹמֹת יֹצְאִים בַּבִּקְעָה וּבָהָר׃

english.text:
Because YHWH, your God, is bringing you to a good land, a
land of wadis of water, springs, and deeps coming out in
valleys and in hills,

translation.text: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;

verses.english:
Because YHWH, your God, is bringing you to a good land, a
land of wadis of water, springs, and deeps coming out in
valleys and in hills,

verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ חִטָּה וּשְׂעֹרָה וְגֶפֶן וּתְאֵנָה וְרִמּוֹן אֶרֶץ זֵית שֶׁמֶן וּדְבָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: אֶרֶץ חִטָּה וּשְׂעֹרָה וְגֶפֶן וּתְאֵנָה וְרִמּוֹן אֶרֶץ זֵית שֶׁמֶן וּדְבָשׁ׃

english.text:
a land of wheat and barley and vine and fig and
pomegranate, a land of olive, oil, and honey,

translation.text: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;

verses.english:
a land of wheat and barley and vine and fig and
pomegranate, a land of olive, oil, and honey,

verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לֹא בְמִסְכֵּנֻת תֹּאכַל בָּהּ לֶחֶם לֹא תֶחְסַר כֹּל בָּהּ אֶרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲבָנֶיהָ בַרְזֶל וּמֵהֲרָרֶיהָ תַּחְצֹב נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: אֶרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לֹא בְמִסְכֵּנֻת תֹּאכַל בָּהּ לֶחֶם לֹא תֶחְסַר כֹּל בָּהּ אֶרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲבָנֶיהָ בַרְזֶל וּמֵהֲרָרֶיהָ תַּחְצֹב נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
a land in which you won’t eat bread in scarcity, in which
you won’t lack anything, a land whose stones are iron and
from whose hills you’ll hew bronze.

translation.text: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.

verses.english:
a land in which you won’t eat bread in scarcity, in which
you won’t lack anything, a land whose stones are iron and
from whose hills you’ll hew bronze.

verses.hebrew: וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ וּבֵרַכְתָּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עַל הָאָרֶץ הַטֹּבָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ וּבֵרַכְתָּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עַל הָאָרֶץ הַטֹּבָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָךְ׃

english.text:
And you’ll eat and be full and bless YHWH, your God, for
the good land that He has given you.

translation.text: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.

verses.english:
And you’ll eat and be full and bless YHWH, your God, for
the good land that He has given you.

verses.hebrew: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תִּשְׁכַּח אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְבִלְתִּי שְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תִּשְׁכַּח אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְבִלְתִּי שְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
“Watch yourself in case you’ll forget YHWH, your God, so
as not to observe His commandments and His judgments and
His laws that I command you today,

translation.text: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:

verses.english:
“Watch yourself in case you’ll forget YHWH, your God, so
as not to observe His commandments and His judgments and
His laws that I command you today,

verses.hebrew: פֶּן תֹּאכַל וְשָׂבָעְתָּ וּבָתִּים טֹבִים תִּבְנֶה וְיָשָׁבְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: פֶּן תֹּאכַל וְשָׂבָעְתָּ וּבָתִּים טֹבִים תִּבְנֶה וְיָשָׁבְתָּ׃

english.text:
in case you’ll eat, and you’ll be full, and you’ll build
good houses, and you’ll live there,

translation.text: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;

verses.english:
in case you’ll eat, and you’ll be full, and you’ll build
good houses, and you’ll live there,

verses.hebrew: וּבְקָרְךָ וְצֹאנְךָ יִרְבְּיֻן וְכֶסֶף וְזָהָב יִרְבֶּה לָּךְ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לְךָ יִרְבֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וּבְקָרְךָ וְצֹאנְךָ יִרְבְּיֻן וְכֶסֶף וְזָהָב יִרְבֶּה לָּךְ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לְךָ יִרְבֶּה׃

english.text:
and your oxen and your flock will multiply, and silver and
gold will multiply for you, and everything that you’ll
have will multiply,

translation.text: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;

verses.english:
and your oxen and your flock will multiply, and silver and
gold will multiply for you, and everything that you’ll
have will multiply,

verses.hebrew: וְרָם לְבָבֶךָ וְשָׁכַחְתָּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הַמּוֹצִיאֲךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים׃

hebrew.text: וְרָם לְבָבֶךָ וְשָׁכַחְתָּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הַמּוֹצִיאֲךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים׃

english.text:
and your heart will be lifted, and you’ll forget YHWH,
your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from
a house of slaves,

translation.text: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;

verses.english:
and your heart will be lifted, and you’ll forget YHWH,
your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from
a house of slaves,

verses.hebrew: הַמּוֹלִיכְךָ בַּמִּדְבָּר הַגָּדֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא נָחָשׁ שָׂרָף וְעַקְרָב וְצִמָּאוֹן אֲשֶׁר אֵין מָיִם הַמּוֹצִיא לְךָ מַיִם מִצּוּר הַחַלָּמִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: הַמּוֹלִיכְךָ בַּמִּדְבָּר הַגָּדֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא נָחָשׁ שָׂרָף וְעַקְרָב וְצִמָּאוֹן אֲשֶׁר אֵין מָיִם הַמּוֹצִיא לְךָ מַיִם מִצּוּר הַחַלָּמִישׁ׃

english.text:
who led you in the big and fearful wilderness of fiery
snake and scorpion and thirst, where there isn’t water,
who brought out water for you from the flint rock,

translation.text: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;

verses.english:
who led you in the big and fearful wilderness of fiery
snake and scorpion and thirst, where there isn’t water,
who brought out water for you from the flint rock,

verses.hebrew: הַמַּאֲכִלְךָ מָן בַּמִּדְבָּר אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּן אֲבֹתֶיךָ לְמַעַן עַנֹּתְךָ וּלְמַעַן נַסֹּתֶךָ לְהֵיטִבְךָ בְּאַחֲרִיתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: הַמַּאֲכִלְךָ מָן בַּמִּדְבָּר אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּן אֲבֹתֶיךָ לְמַעַן עַנֹּתְךָ וּלְמַעַן נַסֹּתֶךָ לְהֵיטִבְךָ בְּאַחֲרִיתֶךָ׃

translation.text: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;

verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ בִּלְבָבֶךָ כֹּחִי וְעֹצֶם יָדִי עָשָׂה לִי אֶת הַחַיִל הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ בִּלְבָבֶךָ כֹּחִי וְעֹצֶם יָדִי עָשָׂה לִי אֶת הַחַיִל הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
and you’ll say in your heart: ‘My power and my hand’s
strength made this wealth for me.’

translation.text: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.

verses.english:
and you’ll say in your heart: ‘My power and my hand’s
strength made this wealth for me.’

verses.hebrew: וְזָכַרְתָּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי הוּא הַנֹּתֵן לְךָ כֹּחַ לַעֲשׂוֹת חָיִל לְמַעַן הָקִים אֶת בְּרִיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְזָכַרְתָּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי הוּא הַנֹּתֵן לְךָ כֹּחַ לַעֲשׂוֹת חָיִל לְמַעַן הָקִים אֶת בְּרִיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Then you shall remember YHWH, your God, because He is the
one who gave you power to make wealth so as to uphold His
covenant that He swore to your fathers—as it is this day.

translation.text: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.

verses.english:
Then you shall remember YHWH, your God, because He is the
one who gave you power to make wealth so as to uphold His
covenant that He swore to your fathers—as it is this day.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם שָׁכֹחַ תִּשְׁכַּח אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַעֲבַדְתָּם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתָ לָהֶם הַעִדֹתִי בָכֶם הַיּוֹם כִּי אָבֹד תֹּאבֵדוּן׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם שָׁכֹחַ תִּשְׁכַּח אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַעֲבַדְתָּם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתָ לָהֶם הַעִדֹתִי בָכֶם הַיּוֹם כִּי אָבֹד תֹּאבֵדוּן׃

english.text:
“And it will be, if you’ll forget YHWH, your God, and
you’ll go after other gods and serve them and bow to them,
I call witness regarding you today that you’ll perish!

translation.text: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.

verses.english:
“And it will be, if you’ll forget YHWH, your God, and
you’ll go after other gods and serve them and bow to them,
I call witness regarding you today that you’ll perish!

verses.hebrew: כַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה מַאֲבִיד מִפְּנֵיכֶם כֵּן תֹּאבֵדוּן עֵקֶב לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּן בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה מַאֲבִיד מִפְּנֵיכֶם כֵּן תֹּאבֵדוּן עֵקֶב לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּן בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
Like the nations that YHWH is making to perish in front of
you, so will you perish, because you wouldn’t listen to
the voice of YHWH, your God.

translation.text: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God.

verses.english:
Like the nations that YHWH is making to perish in front of
you, so will you perish, because you wouldn’t listen to
the voice of YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתָּה עֹבֵר הַיּוֹם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן לָבֹא לָרֶשֶׁת גּוֹיִם גְּדֹלִים וַעֲצֻמִים מִמֶּךָּ עָרִים גְּדֹלֹת וּבְצֻרֹת בַּשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתָּה עֹבֵר הַיּוֹם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן לָבֹא לָרֶשֶׁת גּוֹיִם גְּדֹלִים וַעֲצֻמִים מִמֶּךָּ עָרִים גְּדֹלֹת וּבְצֻרֹת בַּשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
“Listen, Israel: you’re crossing the Jordan today to
come to dispossess nations bigger and stronger than you,
big cities and fortified to the skies,

translation.text: Hear, O Israel: Thou art to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,

verses.english:
“Listen, Israel: you’re crossing the Jordan today to
come to dispossess nations bigger and stronger than you,
big cities and fortified to the skies,

verses.hebrew: עַם גָּדוֹל וָרָם בְּנֵי עֲנָקִים אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ וְאַתָּה שָׁמַעְתָּ מִי יִתְיַצֵּב לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי עֲנָק׃

hebrew.text: עַם גָּדוֹל וָרָם בְּנֵי עֲנָקִים אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ וְאַתָּה שָׁמַעְתָּ מִי יִתְיַצֵּב לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי עֲנָק׃

english.text:
a people big and tall, giants, of whom you have known, and
of whom you have heard it said: ‘Who can stand in front of
the giants?!’

translation.text: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say, Who can stand before the children of Anak!

verses.english:
a people big and tall, giants, of whom you have known, and
of whom you have heard it said: ‘Who can stand in front of
the giants?!’

verses.hebrew: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא הָעֹבֵר לְפָנֶיךָ אֵשׁ אֹכְלָה הוּא יַשְׁמִידֵם וְהוּא יַכְנִיעֵם לְפָנֶיךָ וְהוֹרַשְׁתָּם וְהַאֲבַדְתָּם מַהֵר כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא הָעֹבֵר לְפָנֶיךָ אֵשׁ אֹכְלָה הוּא יַשְׁמִידֵם וְהוּא יַכְנִיעֵם לְפָנֶיךָ וְהוֹרַשְׁתָּם וְהַאֲבַדְתָּם מַהֵר כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה לָךְ׃

english.text:
So you shall know today that YHWH, your God: He is the one
who is crossing in front of you, a consuming fire. He will
destroy them, and He will subdue them in front of you, so
you’ll dispossess them and destroy them quickly as YHWH
has spoken to you.

translation.text: Understand therefore this day, that the LORD thy God is he which goeth over before thee; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face: so shalt thou drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the LORD hath said unto thee.

verses.english:
So you shall know today that YHWH, your God: He is the one
who is crossing in front of you, a consuming fire. He will
destroy them, and He will subdue them in front of you, so
you’ll dispossess them and destroy them quickly as YHWH
has spoken to you.

verses.hebrew: אַל תֹּאמַר בִּלְבָבְךָ בַּהֲדֹף יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֹתָם מִלְּפָנֶיךָ לֵאמֹר בְּצִדְקָתִי הֱבִיאַנִי יְהֹוָה לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וּבְרִשְׁעַת הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה יְהֹוָה מוֹרִישָׁם מִפָּנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: אַל תֹּאמַר בִּלְבָבְךָ בַּהֲדֹף יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֹתָם מִלְּפָנֶיךָ לֵאמֹר בְּצִדְקָתִי הֱבִיאַנִי יְהֹוָה לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וּבְרִשְׁעַת הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה יְהֹוָה מוֹרִישָׁם מִפָּנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
“Don’t say in your heart when YHWH pushes them from in
front of you, saying, ‘Because of my virtue YHWH has
brought me to take possession of this land,’ when it is
because of these nations’ wickedness that YHWH
dispossesses them from before you.

translation.text: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the LORD thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the LORD hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD doth drive them out from before thee.

verses.english:
“Don’t say in your heart when YHWH pushes them from in
front of you, saying, ‘Because of my virtue YHWH has
brought me to take possession of this land,’ when it is
because of these nations’ wickedness that YHWH
dispossesses them from before you.

verses.hebrew: לֹא בְצִדְקָתְךָ וּבְיֹשֶׁר לְבָבְךָ אַתָּה בָא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת אַרְצָם כִּי בְּרִשְׁעַת הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מוֹרִישָׁם מִפָּנֶיךָ וּלְמַעַן הָקִים אֶת הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: לֹא בְצִדְקָתְךָ וּבְיֹשֶׁר לְבָבְךָ אַתָּה בָא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת אַרְצָם כִּי בְּרִשְׁעַת הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מוֹרִישָׁם מִפָּנֶיךָ וּלְמַעַן הָקִים אֶת הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
It’s not because of your virtue and your heart’s integrity
that you’re coming to take possession of their land, but
it is because of these nations’ wickedness that YHWH, your
God, dispossesses them from before you, and in order to
uphold the thing that YHWH swore to your fathers, to
Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

translation.text: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

verses.english:
It’s not because of your virtue and your heart’s integrity
that you’re coming to take possession of their land, but
it is because of these nations’ wickedness that YHWH, your
God, dispossesses them from before you, and in order to
uphold the thing that YHWH swore to your fathers, to
Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

verses.hebrew: וְיָדַעְתָּ כִּי לֹא בְצִדְקָתְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת לְרִשְׁתָּהּ כִּי עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף אָתָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְיָדַעְתָּ כִּי לֹא בְצִדְקָתְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת לְרִשְׁתָּהּ כִּי עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף אָתָּה׃

english.text:
So you shall know that it is not because of your virtue
that YHWH, your God, gives you this good land to take
possession of it, because you’re a hardnecked people.

translation.text: Understand therefore, that the LORD thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiffnecked people.

verses.english:
So you shall know that it is not because of your virtue
that YHWH, your God, gives you this good land to take
possession of it, because you’re a hardnecked people.

verses.hebrew: זְכֹר אַל תִּשְׁכַּח אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִקְצַפְתָּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּמִּדְבָּר לְמִן הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר יָצָאתָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם עַד בֹּאֲכֶם עַד הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה מַמְרִים הֱיִיתֶם עִם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: זְכֹר אַל תִּשְׁכַּח אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִקְצַפְתָּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּמִּדְבָּר לְמִן הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר יָצָאתָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם עַד בֹּאֲכֶם עַד הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה מַמְרִים הֱיִיתֶם עִם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Remember—don’t forget!—that you made YHWH, your God, angry
in the wilderness. From the day that you went out from the
land of Egypt until you came to this place, you’ve been
rebellious toward YHWH.

translation.text: Remember, and forget not, how thou provokedst the LORD thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the LORD.

verses.english:
Remember—don’t forget!—that you made YHWH, your God, angry
in the wilderness. From the day that you went out from the
land of Egypt until you came to this place, you’ve been
rebellious toward YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וּבְחֹרֵב הִקְצַפְתֶּם אֶת יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְאַנַּף יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם לְהַשְׁמִיד אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְחֹרֵב הִקְצַפְתֶּם אֶת יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְאַנַּף יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם לְהַשְׁמִיד אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
And you made YHWH angry at Horeb, and YHWH was so incensed
at you as to destroy you.

translation.text: Also in Horeb ye provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.

verses.english:
And you made YHWH angry at Horeb, and YHWH was so incensed
at you as to destroy you.

verses.hebrew: בַּעֲלֹתִי הָהָרָה לָקַחַת לוּחֹת הָאֲבָנִים לוּחֹת הַבְּרִית אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם וָאֵשֵׁב בָּהָר אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לַיְלָה לֶחֶם לֹא אָכַלְתִּי וּמַיִם לֹא שָׁתִיתִי׃

hebrew.text: בַּעֲלֹתִי הָהָרָה לָקַחַת לוּחֹת הָאֲבָנִים לוּחֹת הַבְּרִית אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם וָאֵשֵׁב בָּהָר אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לַיְלָה לֶחֶם לֹא אָכַלְתִּי וּמַיִם לֹא שָׁתִיתִי׃

english.text:
When I went up to the mountain to get the tablets of
stones, the tablets of the covenant that YHWH made with
you, and I stayed in the mountain forty days and forty
nights, I didn’t eat bread and didn’t drink water.

translation.text: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:

verses.english:
When I went up to the mountain to get the tablets of
stones, the tablets of the covenant that YHWH made with
you, and I stayed in the mountain forty days and forty
nights, I didn’t eat bread and didn’t drink water.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אֶת שְׁנֵי לוּחֹת הָאֲבָנִים כְּתֻבִים בְּאֶצְבַּע אֱלֹהִים וַעֲלֵיהֶם כְּכל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם בָּהָר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ בְּיוֹם הַקָּהָל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אֶת שְׁנֵי לוּחֹת הָאֲבָנִים כְּתֻבִים בְּאֶצְבַּע אֱלֹהִים וַעֲלֵיהֶם כְּכל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם בָּהָר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ בְּיוֹם הַקָּהָל׃

english.text:
And YHWH gave me the two tablets of stones, written with
God’s finger, and on them were all the words that YHWH had
spoken with you at the mountain from inside the fire in
the day of the assembly.

translation.text: And the LORD delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them was written according to all the words, which the LORD spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.

verses.english:
And YHWH gave me the two tablets of stones, written with
God’s finger, and on them were all the words that YHWH had
spoken with you at the mountain from inside the fire in
the day of the assembly.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לָיְלָה נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אֶת שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת הָאֲבָנִים לֻחוֹת הַבְּרִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לָיְלָה נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אֶת שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת הָאֲבָנִים לֻחוֹת הַבְּרִית׃

english.text:
And it was: at the end of forty days and forty nights YHWH
gave me the two tablets of stones, the tablets of the
covenant.

translation.text: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the LORD gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.

verses.english:
And it was: at the end of forty days and forty nights YHWH
gave me the two tablets of stones, the tablets of the
covenant.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי קוּם רֵד מַהֵר מִזֶּה כִּי שִׁחֵת עַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ מִמִּצְרָיִם סָרוּ מַהֵר מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִם עָשׂוּ לָהֶם מַסֵּכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי קוּם רֵד מַהֵר מִזֶּה כִּי שִׁחֵת עַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ מִמִּצְרָיִם סָרוּ מַהֵר מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִם עָשׂוּ לָהֶם מַסֵּכָה׃

english.text:
“And YHWH said to me, ‘Get up. Go down quickly from here,
because your people whom you brought out from Egypt has
become corrupt. They’ve turned quickly from the way that I
commanded them. They’ve made themselves a molten thing.’

translation.text: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.

verses.english:
“And YHWH said to me, ‘Get up. Go down quickly from here,
because your people whom you brought out from Egypt has
become corrupt. They’ve turned quickly from the way that I
commanded them. They’ve made themselves a molten thing.’

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר רָאִיתִי אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה וְהִנֵּה עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר רָאִיתִי אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה וְהִנֵּה עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף הוּא׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to me, saying, ‘I’ve seen this people; and,
here, it’s a hardnecked people.

translation.text: Furthermore the LORD spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:

verses.english:
And YHWH said to me, saying, ‘I’ve seen this people; and,
here, it’s a hardnecked people.

verses.hebrew: הֶרֶף מִמֶּנִּי וְאַשְׁמִידֵם וְאֶמְחֶה אֶת שְׁמָם מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם וְאֶעֱשֶׂה אוֹתְךָ לְגוֹי עָצוּם וָרָב מִמֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: הֶרֶף מִמֶּנִּי וְאַשְׁמִידֵם וְאֶמְחֶה אֶת שְׁמָם מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם וְאֶעֱשֶׂה אוֹתְךָ לְגוֹי עָצוּם וָרָב מִמֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
Hold back from me, and I’ll destroy them and wipe out
their name from under the skies, and I’ll make you into a
more powerful and numerous people than they.’

translation.text: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.

verses.english:
Hold back from me, and I’ll destroy them and wipe out
their name from under the skies, and I’ll make you into a
more powerful and numerous people than they.’

verses.hebrew: וָאֵפֶן וָאֵרֵד מִן הָהָר וְהָהָר בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ וּשְׁנֵי לוּחֹת הַבְּרִית עַל שְׁתֵּי יָדָי׃

hebrew.text: וָאֵפֶן וָאֵרֵד מִן הָהָר וְהָהָר בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ וּשְׁנֵי לוּחֹת הַבְּרִית עַל שְׁתֵּי יָדָי׃

english.text:
“And I turned and went down from the mountain—and the
mountain was burning in fire—and the two tablets of the
covenant were on my two hands.

translation.text: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.

verses.english:
“And I turned and went down from the mountain—and the
mountain was burning in fire—and the two tablets of the
covenant were on my two hands.

verses.hebrew: וָאֵרֶא וְהִנֵּה חֲטָאתֶם לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם עֲשִׂיתֶם לָכֶם עֵגֶל מַסֵּכָה סַרְתֶּם מַהֵר מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וָאֵרֶא וְהִנֵּה חֲטָאתֶם לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם עֲשִׂיתֶם לָכֶם עֵגֶל מַסֵּכָה סַרְתֶּם מַהֵר מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
And I saw! And, here, you’d sinned against YHWH, your God.
You’d made yourselves a molten calf. You’d turned quickly
from the way that YHWH had commanded you.

translation.text: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the LORD your God, and had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.

verses.english:
And I saw! And, here, you’d sinned against YHWH, your God.
You’d made yourselves a molten calf. You’d turned quickly
from the way that YHWH had commanded you.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶתְפֹּשׂ בִּשְׁנֵי הַלֻּחֹת וָאַשְׁלִכֵם מֵעַל שְׁתֵּי יָדָי וָאֲשַׁבְּרֵם לְעֵינֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶתְפֹּשׂ בִּשְׁנֵי הַלֻּחֹת וָאַשְׁלִכֵם מֵעַל שְׁתֵּי יָדָי וָאֲשַׁבְּרֵם לְעֵינֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
And I grasped the two tablets and threw them from on my
two hands and shattered them before your eyes.

translation.text: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.

verses.english:
And I grasped the two tablets and threw them from on my
two hands and shattered them before your eyes.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶתְנַפַּל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כָּרִאשֹׁנָה אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לַיְלָה לֶחֶם לֹא אָכַלְתִּי וּמַיִם לֹא שָׁתִיתִי עַל כּל חַטַּאתְכֶם אֲשֶׁר חֲטָאתֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶתְנַפַּל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כָּרִאשֹׁנָה אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לַיְלָה לֶחֶם לֹא אָכַלְתִּי וּמַיִם לֹא שָׁתִיתִי עַל כּל חַטַּאתְכֶם אֲשֶׁר חֲטָאתֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ׃

english.text:
“And I prostrated myself in front of YHWH like the first
time, forty days and forty nights—I didn’t eat bread and
didn’t drink water—over all your sin that you did, to do
what was bad in YHWH’s eyes, to provoke Him,

translation.text: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.

verses.english:
“And I prostrated myself in front of YHWH like the first
time, forty days and forty nights—I didn’t eat bread and
didn’t drink water—over all your sin that you did, to do
what was bad in YHWH’s eyes, to provoke Him,

verses.hebrew: כִּי יָגֹרְתִּי מִפְּנֵי הָאַף וְהַחֵמָה אֲשֶׁר קָצַף יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם לְהַשְׁמִיד אֶתְכֶם וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֵלַי גַּם בַּפַּעַם הַהִוא׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יָגֹרְתִּי מִפְּנֵי הָאַף וְהַחֵמָה אֲשֶׁר קָצַף יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם לְהַשְׁמִיד אֶתְכֶם וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֵלַי גַּם בַּפַּעַם הַהִוא׃

english.text:
because I was dreading on account of the anger and the
fury, that YHWH was so angry at you as to destroy you. But
YHWH listened to me that time as well.

translation.text: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you. But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.

verses.english:
because I was dreading on account of the anger and the
fury, that YHWH was so angry at you as to destroy you. But
YHWH listened to me that time as well.

verses.hebrew: וּבְאַהֲרֹן הִתְאַנַּף יְהֹוָה מְאֹד לְהַשְׁמִידוֹ וָאֶתְפַּלֵּל גַּם בְּעַד אַהֲרֹן בָּעֵת הַהִוא׃

hebrew.text: וּבְאַהֲרֹן הִתְאַנַּף יְהֹוָה מְאֹד לְהַשְׁמִידוֹ וָאֶתְפַּלֵּל גַּם בְּעַד אַהֲרֹן בָּעֵת הַהִוא׃

english.text:
And YHWH was very incensed at Aaron so as to destroy him,
and I prayed for Aaron at that time as well.

translation.text: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.

verses.english:
And YHWH was very incensed at Aaron so as to destroy him,
and I prayed for Aaron at that time as well.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת חַטַּאתְכֶם אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם אֶת הָעֵגֶל לָקַחְתִּי וָאֶשְׂרֹף אֹתוֹ בָּאֵשׁ וָאֶכֹּת אֹתוֹ טָחוֹן הֵיטֵב עַד אֲשֶׁר דַּק לְעָפָר וָאַשְׁלִךְ אֶת עֲפָרוֹ אֶל הַנַּחַל הַיֹּרֵד מִן הָהָר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת חַטַּאתְכֶם אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם אֶת הָעֵגֶל לָקַחְתִּי וָאֶשְׂרֹף אֹתוֹ בָּאֵשׁ וָאֶכֹּת אֹתוֹ טָחוֹן הֵיטֵב עַד אֲשֶׁר דַּק לְעָפָר וָאַשְׁלִךְ אֶת עֲפָרוֹ אֶל הַנַּחַל הַיֹּרֵד מִן הָהָר׃

english.text:
And your sin that you made, the calf: I took it and burned
it in fire and crushed it, grinding it well until it was
thin as dust, and I threw its dust into the wadi that
comes down from the mountain.

translation.text: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, and ground it very small, even until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.

verses.english:
And your sin that you made, the calf: I took it and burned
it in fire and crushed it, grinding it well until it was
thin as dust, and I threw its dust into the wadi that
comes down from the mountain.

verses.hebrew: וּבְתַבְעֵרָה וּבְמַסָּה וּבְקִבְרֹת הַתַּאֲוָה מַקְצִפִים הֱיִיתֶם אֶת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבְתַבְעֵרָה וּבְמַסָּה וּבְקִבְרֹת הַתַּאֲוָה מַקְצִפִים הֱיִיתֶם אֶת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“And at Taberah and at Massah and at Kibroth Hattaavah you
were making YHWH angry.

translation.text: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibrothhattaavah, ye provoked the LORD to wrath.

verses.english:
“And at Taberah and at Massah and at Kibroth Hattaavah you
were making YHWH angry.

verses.hebrew: וּבִשְׁלֹחַ יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ לֵאמֹר עֲלוּ וּרְשׁוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָכֶם וַתַּמְרוּ אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְלֹא הֶאֱמַנְתֶּם לוֹ וְלֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּם בְּקֹלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּבִשְׁלֹחַ יְהֹוָה אֶתְכֶם מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ לֵאמֹר עֲלוּ וּרְשׁוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָכֶם וַתַּמְרוּ אֶת פִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְלֹא הֶאֱמַנְתֶּם לוֹ וְלֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּם בְּקֹלוֹ׃

english.text:
And when YHWH sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, ‘Go up
and take possession of the land that I’ve given you,’ then
you rebelled at the word of YHWH, your God, and you didn’t
trust Him and didn’t listen to His voice.

translation.text: Likewise when the LORD sent you from Kadeshbarnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.

verses.english:
And when YHWH sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, ‘Go up
and take possession of the land that I’ve given you,’ then
you rebelled at the word of YHWH, your God, and you didn’t
trust Him and didn’t listen to His voice.

verses.hebrew: מַמְרִים הֱיִיתֶם עִם יְהֹוָה מִיּוֹם דַּעְתִּי אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: מַמְרִים הֱיִיתֶם עִם יְהֹוָה מִיּוֹם דַּעְתִּי אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text: You’ve been rebelling toward YHWH from the day I knew you.

translation.text: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.

verses.english: You’ve been rebelling toward YHWH from the day I knew you.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶתְנַפַּל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֵת אַרְבָּעִים הַיּוֹם וְאֶת אַרְבָּעִים הַלַּיְלָה אֲשֶׁר הִתְנַפָּלְתִּי כִּי אָמַר יְהֹוָה לְהַשְׁמִיד אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶתְנַפַּל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֵת אַרְבָּעִים הַיּוֹם וְאֶת אַרְבָּעִים הַלַּיְלָה אֲשֶׁר הִתְנַפָּלְתִּי כִּי אָמַר יְהֹוָה לְהַשְׁמִיד אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
“So I prostrated myself in front of YHWH for the forty
days and forty nights that I had fallen down because YHWH
had said He would destroy you,

translation.text: Thus I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights, as I fell down at the first; because the LORD had said he would destroy you.

verses.english:
“So I prostrated myself in front of YHWH for the forty
days and forty nights that I had fallen down because YHWH
had said He would destroy you,

verses.hebrew: וָאֶתְפַּלֵּל אֶל יְהֹוָה וָאֹמַר אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה אַל תַּשְׁחֵת עַמְּךָ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ בְּגדְלֶךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ מִמִּצְרַיִם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶתְפַּלֵּל אֶל יְהֹוָה וָאֹמַר אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה אַל תַּשְׁחֵת עַמְּךָ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ בְּגדְלֶךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ מִמִּצְרַיִם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה׃

english.text:
and I prayed to YHWH and said, ‘My Lord YHWH, don’t
destroy your people and your legacy whom you redeemed by
your greatness, whom you brought out from Egypt with a
strong hand.

translation.text: I prayed therefore unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

verses.english:
and I prayed to YHWH and said, ‘My Lord YHWH, don’t
destroy your people and your legacy whom you redeemed by
your greatness, whom you brought out from Egypt with a
strong hand.

verses.hebrew: זְכֹר לַעֲבָדֶיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב אַל תֵּפֶן אֶל קְשִׁי הָעָם הַזֶּה וְאֶל רִשְׁעוֹ וְאֶל חַטָּאתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: זְכֹר לַעֲבָדֶיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב אַל תֵּפֶן אֶל קְשִׁי הָעָם הַזֶּה וְאֶל רִשְׁעוֹ וְאֶל חַטָּאתוֹ׃

english.text:
Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Don’t
look to this people’s hardness and to its wickedness and
to its sin,

translation.text: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:

verses.english:
Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Don’t
look to this people’s hardness and to its wickedness and
to its sin,

verses.hebrew: פֶּן יֹאמְרוּ הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָנוּ מִשָּׁם מִבְּלִי יְכֹלֶת יְהֹוָה לַהֲבִיאָם אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם וּמִשִּׂנְאָתוֹ אוֹתָם הוֹצִיאָם לַהֲמִתָם בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: פֶּן יֹאמְרוּ הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָנוּ מִשָּׁם מִבְּלִי יְכֹלֶת יְהֹוָה לַהֲבִיאָם אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם וּמִשִּׂנְאָתוֹ אוֹתָם הוֹצִיאָם לַהֲמִתָם בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
or else the land from which you brought us out will say:
Because YHWH wasn’t able to bring them to the land of
which He spoke to them, and because He hated them, He
brought them out to kill them in the wilderness!

translation.text: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.

verses.english:
or else the land from which you brought us out will say:
Because YHWH wasn’t able to bring them to the land of
which He spoke to them, and because He hated them, He
brought them out to kill them in the wilderness!

verses.hebrew: וְהֵם עַמְּךָ וְנַחֲלָתֶךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ בְּכֹחֲךָ הַגָּדֹל וּבִזְרֹעֲךָ הַנְּטוּיָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵם עַמְּךָ וְנַחֲלָתֶךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ בְּכֹחֲךָ הַגָּדֹל וּבִזְרֹעֲךָ הַנְּטוּיָה׃

english.text:
And they’re your people and your legacy, whom you brought
out by your great power and by your outstretched arm.’

translation.text: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm.

verses.english:
And they’re your people and your legacy, whom you brought
out by your great power and by your outstretched arm.’

verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִוא אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי פְּסל לְךָ שְׁנֵי לוּחֹת אֲבָנִים כָּרִאשֹׁנִים וַעֲלֵה אֵלַי הָהָרָה וְעָשִׂיתָ לְּךָ אֲרוֹן עֵץ׃

hebrew.text: בָּעֵת הַהִוא אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי פְּסל לְךָ שְׁנֵי לוּחֹת אֲבָנִים כָּרִאשֹׁנִים וַעֲלֵה אֵלַי הָהָרָה וְעָשִׂיתָ לְּךָ אֲרוֹן עֵץ׃

english.text:
“At that time YHWH said to me, ‘Carve two tablets of
stones like the first ones, and come up to me at the
mountain. And you shall make an ark of wood.

translation.text: At that time the LORD said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.

verses.english:
“At that time YHWH said to me, ‘Carve two tablets of
stones like the first ones, and come up to me at the
mountain. And you shall make an ark of wood.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶכְתֹּב עַל הַלֻּחֹת אֶת הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ עַל הַלֻּחֹת הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר שִׁבַּרְתָּ וְשַׂמְתָּם בָּאָרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶכְתֹּב עַל הַלֻּחֹת אֶת הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ עַל הַלֻּחֹת הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר שִׁבַּרְתָּ וְשַׂמְתָּם בָּאָרוֹן׃

english.text:
And I’ll write on the tablets the words that were on the
first tablets, which you shattered, and you shall set them
in the ark.’

translation.text: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.

verses.english:
And I’ll write on the tablets the words that were on the
first tablets, which you shattered, and you shall set them
in the ark.’

verses.hebrew: וָאַעַשׂ אֲרוֹן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וָאֶפְסֹל שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים כָּרִאשֹׁנִים וָאַעַל הָהָרָה וּשְׁנֵי הַלֻּחֹת בְּיָדִי׃

hebrew.text: וָאַעַשׂ אֲרוֹן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וָאֶפְסֹל שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים כָּרִאשֹׁנִים וָאַעַל הָהָרָה וּשְׁנֵי הַלֻּחֹת בְּיָדִי׃

english.text:
“And I made an ark of acacia wood, and I carved two
tablets of stones like the first ones, and I went up the
mountain with the two tablets in my hands.

translation.text: And I made an ark of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.

verses.english:
“And I made an ark of acacia wood, and I carved two
tablets of stones like the first ones, and I went up the
mountain with the two tablets in my hands.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּב עַל הַלֻּחֹת כַּמִּכְתָּב הָרִאשׁוֹן אֵת עֲשֶׂרֶת הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בָּהָר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ בְּיוֹם הַקָּהָל וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְתֹּב עַל הַלֻּחֹת כַּמִּכְתָּב הָרִאשׁוֹן אֵת עֲשֶׂרֶת הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בָּהָר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ בְּיוֹם הַקָּהָל וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה אֵלָי׃

english.text:
And He wrote on the tablets like the first writing: the
Ten Commandments that YHWH spoke to you at the mountain
from inside the fire in the day of the assembly, and YHWH
gave them to me.

translation.text: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the LORD gave them unto me.

verses.english:
And He wrote on the tablets like the first writing: the
Ten Commandments that YHWH spoke to you at the mountain
from inside the fire in the day of the assembly, and YHWH
gave them to me.

verses.hebrew: וָאֵפֶן וָאֵרֵד מִן הָהָר וָאָשִׂם אֶת הַלֻּחֹת בָּאָרוֹן אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי וַיִּהְיוּ שָׁם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוַּנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וָאֵפֶן וָאֵרֵד מִן הָהָר וָאָשִׂם אֶת הַלֻּחֹת בָּאָרוֹן אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי וַיִּהְיוּ שָׁם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוַּנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And I turned and went down from the mountain, and I set
the tablets in the ark that I had made, and they have been
there, as YHWH commanded me.

translation.text: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the LORD commanded me.

verses.english:
And I turned and went down from the mountain, and I set
the tablets in the ark that I had made, and they have been
there, as YHWH commanded me.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נָסְעוּ מִבְּאֵרֹת בְּנֵי יַעֲקָן מוֹסֵרָה שָׁם מֵת אַהֲרֹן וַיִּקָּבֵר שָׁם וַיְכַהֵן אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נָסְעוּ מִבְּאֵרֹת בְּנֵי יַעֲקָן מוֹסֵרָה שָׁם מֵת אַהֲרֹן וַיִּקָּבֵר שָׁם וַיְכַהֵן אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
“And the children of Israel had traveled from
Beeroth-bene-Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and he
was buried there; and Eleazar, his son, functioned as
priest in his place.

translation.text: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his stead.

verses.english:
“And the children of Israel had traveled from
Beeroth-bene-Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and he
was buried there; and Eleazar, his son, functioned as
priest in his place.

verses.hebrew: מִשָּׁם נָסְעוּ הַגֻּדְגֹּדָה וּמִן הַגֻּדְגֹּדָה יטְבָתָה אֶרֶץ נַחֲלֵי מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: מִשָּׁם נָסְעוּ הַגֻּדְגֹּדָה וּמִן הַגֻּדְגֹּדָה יטְבָתָה אֶרֶץ נַחֲלֵי מָיִם׃

english.text:
From there they traveled to Gudgod, and from Gudgod to
Jotbah, a land of wadis of water.

translation.text: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.

verses.english:
From there they traveled to Gudgod, and from Gudgod to
Jotbah, a land of wadis of water.

verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִוא הִבְדִּיל יְהֹוָה אֶת שֵׁבֶט הַלֵּוִי לָשֵׂאת אֶת אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה לַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְשָׁרְתוֹ וּלְבָרֵךְ בִּשְׁמוֹ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: בָּעֵת הַהִוא הִבְדִּיל יְהֹוָה אֶת שֵׁבֶט הַלֵּוִי לָשֵׂאת אֶת אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה לַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְשָׁרְתוֹ וּלְבָרֵךְ בִּשְׁמוֹ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
At that time YHWH distinguished the tribe of Levi to carry
the ark of YHWH’s covenant, to stand in front of YHWH to
serve Him, and to bless in His name to this day.

translation.text: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.

verses.english:
At that time YHWH distinguished the tribe of Levi to carry
the ark of YHWH’s covenant, to stand in front of YHWH to
serve Him, and to bless in His name to this day.

verses.hebrew: עַל כֵּן לֹא הָיָה לְלֵוִי חֵלֶק וְנַחֲלָה עִם אֶחָיו יְהֹוָה הוּא נַחֲלָתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: עַל כֵּן לֹא הָיָה לְלֵוִי חֵלֶק וְנַחֲלָה עִם אֶחָיו יְהֹוָה הוּא נַחֲלָתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לוֹ׃

english.text:
Therefore Levi has not had a portion and a legacy with its
brothers. YHWH: He is its legacy, as YHWH, your God, spoke
to it.

translation.text: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God promised him.

verses.english:
Therefore Levi has not had a portion and a legacy with its
brothers. YHWH: He is its legacy, as YHWH, your God, spoke
to it.

verses.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִי עָמַדְתִּי בָהָר כַּיָּמִים הָרִאשֹׁנִים אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לָיְלָה וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֵלַי גַּם בַּפַּעַם הַהִוא לֹא אָבָה יְהֹוָה הַשְׁחִיתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָנֹכִי עָמַדְתִּי בָהָר כַּיָּמִים הָרִאשֹׁנִים אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לָיְלָה וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֵלַי גַּם בַּפַּעַם הַהִוא לֹא אָבָה יְהֹוָה הַשְׁחִיתֶךָ׃

english.text:
“And I: I stood in the mountain as in the first days:
forty days and forty nights. And YHWH listened to me that
time as well. YHWH was not willing to destroy you.

translation.text: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also, and the LORD would not destroy thee.

verses.english:
“And I: I stood in the mountain as in the first days:
forty days and forty nights. And YHWH listened to me that
time as well. YHWH was not willing to destroy you.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי קוּם לֵךְ לְמַסַּע לִפְנֵי הָעָם וְיָבֹאוּ וְיִירְשׁוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָם לָתֵת לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי קוּם לֵךְ לְמַסַּע לִפְנֵי הָעָם וְיָבֹאוּ וְיִירְשׁוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָם לָתֵת לָהֶם׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to me, ‘Get up. Set out on the journey in
front of the people, and they’ll come and take possession
of the land that I swore to their fathers to give to
them.’

translation.text: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, take thy journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to me, ‘Get up. Set out on the journey in
front of the people, and they’ll come and take possession
of the land that I swore to their fathers to give to
them.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל מָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ שֹׁאֵל מֵעִמָּךְ כִּי אִם לְיִרְאָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָלֶכֶת בְּכל דְּרָכָיו וּלְאַהֲבָה אֹתוֹ וְלַעֲבֹד אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל מָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ שֹׁאֵל מֵעִמָּךְ כִּי אִם לְיִרְאָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָלֶכֶת בְּכל דְּרָכָיו וּלְאַהֲבָה אֹתוֹ וְלַעֲבֹד אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
“And now, Israel, what is YHWH, your God, asking from you
except to fear YHWH, your God, to go in all His ways, and
to love Him and to serve YHWH, your God, with all your
heart and all your soul,

translation.text: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,

verses.english:
“And now, Israel, what is YHWH, your God, asking from you
except to fear YHWH, your God, to go in all His ways, and
to love Him and to serve YHWH, your God, with all your
heart and all your soul,

verses.hebrew: לִשְׁמֹר אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה וְאֶת חֻקֹּתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לְטוֹב לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: לִשְׁמֹר אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה וְאֶת חֻקֹּתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לְטוֹב לָךְ׃

english.text:
to observe YHWH’s commandments and His laws that I command
you today to be good for you.

translation.text: To keep the commandments of the LORD, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?

verses.english:
to observe YHWH’s commandments and His laws that I command
you today to be good for you.

verses.hebrew: הֵן לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הַשָּׁמַיִם וּשְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם הָאָרֶץ וְכל אֲשֶׁר בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: הֵן לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הַשָּׁמַיִם וּשְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם הָאָרֶץ וְכל אֲשֶׁר בָּהּ׃

english.text:
Here, YHWH, your God, has the skies—and the skies of the
skies!—the earth and everything that’s in it.

translation.text: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the LORD’s thy God, the earth also, with all that therein is.

verses.english:
Here, YHWH, your God, has the skies—and the skies of the
skies!—the earth and everything that’s in it.

verses.hebrew: רַק בַּאֲבֹתֶיךָ חָשַׁק יְהֹוָה לְאַהֲבָה אוֹתָם וַיִּבְחַר בְּזַרְעָם אַחֲרֵיהֶם בָּכֶם מִכּל הָעַמִּים כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: רַק בַּאֲבֹתֶיךָ חָשַׁק יְהֹוָה לְאַהֲבָה אוֹתָם וַיִּבְחַר בְּזַרְעָם אַחֲרֵיהֶם בָּכֶם מִכּל הָעַמִּים כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Only, YHWH was attracted to your fathers, to love them,
and He chose their seed after them: you, out of all the
peoples, as it is this day.

translation.text: Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all people, as it is this day.

verses.english:
Only, YHWH was attracted to your fathers, to love them,
and He chose their seed after them: you, out of all the
peoples, as it is this day.

verses.hebrew: וּמַלְתֶּם אֵת ערְלַת לְבַבְכֶם וְערְפְּכֶם לֹא תַקְשׁוּ עוֹד׃

hebrew.text: וּמַלְתֶּם אֵת ערְלַת לְבַבְכֶם וְערְפְּכֶם לֹא תַקְשׁוּ עוֹד׃

english.text:
So you shall circumcise the foreskin of your heart, and
you shall not harden your necks anymore.

translation.text: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.

verses.english:
So you shall circumcise the foreskin of your heart, and
you shall not harden your necks anymore.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא אֱלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וַאֲדֹנֵי הָאֲדֹנִים הָאֵל הַגָּדֹל הַגִּבֹּר וְהַנּוֹרָא אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִשָּׂא פָנִים וְלֹא יִקַּח שֹׁחַד׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא אֱלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וַאֲדֹנֵי הָאֲדֹנִים הָאֵל הַגָּדֹל הַגִּבֹּר וְהַנּוֹרָא אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִשָּׂא פָנִים וְלֹא יִקַּח שֹׁחַד׃

english.text:
Because YHWH, your God: He is the God of gods and the Lord
of lords, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who
won’t be partial and won’t take a bribe,

translation.text: For the LORD your God is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:

verses.english:
Because YHWH, your God: He is the God of gods and the Lord
of lords, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who
won’t be partial and won’t take a bribe,

verses.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפַּט יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה וְאֹהֵב גֵּר לָתֶת לוֹ לֶחֶם וְשִׂמְלָה׃

hebrew.text: עֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפַּט יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה וְאֹהֵב גֵּר לָתֶת לוֹ לֶחֶם וְשִׂמְלָה׃

english.text:
doing judgment for an orphan and a widow and loving an
alien, to give him bread and a garment.

translation.text: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.

verses.english:
doing judgment for an orphan and a widow and loving an
alien, to give him bread and a garment.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲהַבְתֶּם אֶת הַגֵּר כִּי גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲהַבְתֶּם אֶת הַגֵּר כִּי גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
So you shall love the alien, because you were aliens in
the land of Egypt.

translation.text: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
So you shall love the alien, because you were aliens in
the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תִּירָא אֹתוֹ תַעֲבֹד וּבוֹ תִדְבָּק וּבִשְׁמוֹ תִּשָּׁבֵעַ׃

hebrew.text: אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תִּירָא אֹתוֹ תַעֲבֹד וּבוֹ תִדְבָּק וּבִשְׁמוֹ תִּשָּׁבֵעַ׃

english.text:
You shall fear YHWH, your God, you shall serve Him, and
you shall cling to Him, and you shall swear by His name.

translation.text: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.

verses.english:
You shall fear YHWH, your God, you shall serve Him, and
you shall cling to Him, and you shall swear by His name.

verses.hebrew: הוּא תְהִלָּתְךָ וְהוּא אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אִתְּךָ אֶת הַגְּדֹלֹת וְאֶת הַנּוֹרָאֹת הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: הוּא תְהִלָּתְךָ וְהוּא אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אִתְּךָ אֶת הַגְּדֹלֹת וְאֶת הַנּוֹרָאֹת הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
He is your splendor, and He is your God, who did these
great and awesome things for you that your eyes have seen.
Your fathers went down to Egypt with seventy persons, and
now YHWH, your God, has made you like the stars of the
skies for multitude.

translation.text: He is thy praise, and he is thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.

verses.english:
He is your splendor, and He is your God, who did these
great and awesome things for you that your eyes have seen.
Your fathers went down to Egypt with seventy persons, and
now YHWH, your God, has made you like the stars of the
skies for multitude.

verses.hebrew: בְּשִׁבְעִים נֶפֶשׁ יָרְדוּ אֲבֹתֶיךָ מִצְרָיְמָה וְעַתָּה שָׂמְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם לָרֹב׃

hebrew.text: בְּשִׁבְעִים נֶפֶשׁ יָרְדוּ אֲבֹתֶיךָ מִצְרָיְמָה וְעַתָּה שָׂמְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם לָרֹב׃

translation.text: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.

verses.hebrew: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְשָׁמַרְתָּ מִשְׁמַרְתּוֹ וְחֻקֹּתָיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וּמִצְוֺתָיו כּל הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְשָׁמַרְתָּ מִשְׁמַרְתּוֹ וְחֻקֹּתָיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וּמִצְוֺתָיו כּל הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
“And you shall love YHWH, your God, and keep His charge
and His laws and His judgments and His commandments every
day.

translation.text: Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.

verses.english:
“And you shall love YHWH, your God, and keep His charge
and His laws and His judgments and His commandments every
day.

verses.hebrew: וִידַעְתֶּם הַיּוֹם כִּי לֹא אֶת בְּנֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ וַאֲשֶׁר לֹא רָאוּ אֶת מוּסַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶת גּדְלוֹ אֶת יָדוֹ הַחֲזָקָה וּזְרֹעוֹ הַנְּטוּיָה׃

hebrew.text: וִידַעְתֶּם הַיּוֹם כִּי לֹא אֶת בְּנֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ וַאֲשֶׁר לֹא רָאוּ אֶת מוּסַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶת גּדְלוֹ אֶת יָדוֹ הַחֲזָקָה וּזְרֹעוֹ הַנְּטוּיָה׃

english.text:
And you shall know today that it’s not with your children,
who didn’t know and who didn’t see the discipline of YHWH,
your God, His greatness and His strong hand and His
outstretched arm

translation.text: And know ye this day: for I speak not with your children which have not known, and which have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his stretched out arm,

verses.english:
And you shall know today that it’s not with your children,
who didn’t know and who didn’t see the discipline of YHWH,
your God, His greatness and His strong hand and His
outstretched arm

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת אֹתֹתָיו וְאֶת מַעֲשָׂיו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בְּתוֹךְ מִצְרָיִם לְפַרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם וּלְכל אַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת אֹתֹתָיו וְאֶת מַעֲשָׂיו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בְּתוֹךְ מִצְרָיִם לְפַרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם וּלְכל אַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
and His signs and His deeds that He did in Egypt to
Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and to all his land,

translation.text: And his miracles, and his acts, which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;

verses.english:
and His signs and His deeds that He did in Egypt to
Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and to all his land,

verses.hebrew: וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְחֵיל מִצְרַיִם לְסוּסָיו וּלְרִכְבּוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֵצִיף אֶת מֵי יַם סוּף עַל פְּנֵיהֶם בְּרדְפָם אַחֲרֵיכֶם וַיְאַבְּדֵם יְהֹוָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְחֵיל מִצְרַיִם לְסוּסָיו וּלְרִכְבּוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֵצִיף אֶת מֵי יַם סוּף עַל פְּנֵיהֶם בְּרדְפָם אַחֲרֵיכֶם וַיְאַבְּדֵם יְהֹוָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
and what He did to Egypt’s army and to his horses and his
chariots, that He flowed the waters of the Red Sea over
their faces when they pursued you so YHWH destroyed them
to this day,

translation.text: And what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and how the LORD hath destroyed them unto this day;

verses.english:
and what He did to Egypt’s army and to his horses and his
chariots, that He flowed the waters of the Red Sea over
their faces when they pursued you so YHWH destroyed them
to this day,

verses.hebrew: וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לָכֶם בַּמִּדְבָּר עַד בֹּאֲכֶם עַד הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לָכֶם בַּמִּדְבָּר עַד בֹּאֲכֶם עַד הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
and what He did for you in the wilderness until you came
to this place,

translation.text: And what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came into this place;

verses.english:
and what He did for you in the wilderness until you came
to this place,

verses.hebrew: וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְדָתָן וְלַאֲבִירָם בְּנֵי אֱלִיאָב בֶּן רְאוּבֵן אֲשֶׁר פָּצְתָה הָאָרֶץ אֶת פִּיהָ וַתִּבְלָעֵם וְאֶת בָּתֵּיהֶם וְאֶת אהֳלֵיהֶם וְאֵת כּל הַיְקוּם אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלֵיהֶם בְּקֶרֶב כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְדָתָן וְלַאֲבִירָם בְּנֵי אֱלִיאָב בֶּן רְאוּבֵן אֲשֶׁר פָּצְתָה הָאָרֶץ אֶת פִּיהָ וַתִּבְלָעֵם וְאֶת בָּתֵּיהֶם וְאֶת אהֳלֵיהֶם וְאֵת כּל הַיְקוּם אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלֵיהֶם בְּקֶרֶב כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
and what He did to Dathan and to Abiram, sons of Eliab son
of Reuben, that the earth opened its mouth and swallowed
them and their households and their tents and all the
substance that was at their feet among the children of
Israel—

translation.text: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that was in their possession, in the midst of all Israel:

verses.english:
and what He did to Dathan and to Abiram, sons of Eliab son
of Reuben, that the earth opened its mouth and swallowed
them and their households and their tents and all the
substance that was at their feet among the children of
Israel—

verses.hebrew: כִּי עֵינֵיכֶם הָרֹאֹת אֶת כּל מַעֲשֵׂה יְהֹוָה הַגָּדֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי עֵינֵיכֶם הָרֹאֹת אֶת כּל מַעֲשֵׂה יְהֹוָה הַגָּדֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

english.text:
but it’s your eyes, that saw every great deed of YHWH’s
that He did.

translation.text: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the LORD which he did.

verses.english:
but it’s your eyes, that saw every great deed of YHWH’s
that He did.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת כּל הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לְמַעַן תֶּחֶזְקוּ וּבָאתֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת כּל הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לְמַעַן תֶּחֶזְקוּ וּבָאתֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
And you shall observe all of the commandment that I
command you today so that you’ll be strong and you’ll come
and take possession of the land that you’re crossing there
to take possession of it,

translation.text: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither ye go to possess it;

verses.english:
And you shall observe all of the commandment that I
command you today so that you’ll be strong and you’ll come
and take possession of the land that you’re crossing there
to take possession of it,

verses.hebrew: וּלְמַעַן תַּאֲרִיכוּ יָמִים עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם לָתֵת לָהֶם וּלְזַרְעָם אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמַעַן תַּאֲרִיכוּ יָמִים עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם לָתֵת לָהֶם וּלְזַרְעָם אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

english.text:
and so that you’ll extend days on the land that YHWH swore
to your fathers to give to them and to their seed, a land
flowing with milk and honey.

translation.text: And that ye may prolong your days in the land, which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

verses.english:
and so that you’ll extend days on the land that YHWH swore
to your fathers to give to them and to their seed, a land
flowing with milk and honey.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ לֹא כְאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם הִוא אֲשֶׁר יְצָאתֶם מִשָּׁם אֲשֶׁר תִּזְרַע אֶת זַרְעֲךָ וְהִשְׁקִיתָ בְרַגְלְךָ כְּגַן הַיָּרָק׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ לֹא כְאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם הִוא אֲשֶׁר יְצָאתֶם מִשָּׁם אֲשֶׁר תִּזְרַע אֶת זַרְעֲךָ וְהִשְׁקִיתָ בְרַגְלְךָ כְּגַן הַיָּרָק׃

english.text:
“Because the land to which you’re coming to take
possession of it: it’s not like the land of Egypt from
which you’ve come out, where you plant your seed and water
it at your feet like a garden of plants.

translation.text: For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst it with thy foot, as a garden of herbs:

verses.english:
“Because the land to which you’re coming to take
possession of it: it’s not like the land of Egypt from
which you’ve come out, where you plant your seed and water
it at your feet like a garden of plants.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ אֶרֶץ הָרִים וּבְקָעֹת לִמְטַר הַשָּׁמַיִם תִּשְׁתֶּה מָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ אֶרֶץ הָרִים וּבְקָעֹת לִמְטַר הַשָּׁמַיִם תִּשְׁתֶּה מָּיִם׃

english.text:
But the land to which you’re crossing to take possession
of it is a land of hills and valleys. It drinks water by
the skies’ showers.

translation.text: But the land, whither ye go to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys, and drinketh water of the rain of heaven:

verses.english:
But the land to which you’re crossing to take possession
of it is a land of hills and valleys. It drinks water by
the skies’ showers.

verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ דֹּרֵשׁ אֹתָהּ תָּמִיד עֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּהּ מֵרֵשִׁית הַשָּׁנָה וְעַד אַחֲרִית שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: אֶרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ דֹּרֵשׁ אֹתָהּ תָּמִיד עֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּהּ מֵרֵשִׁית הַשָּׁנָה וְעַד אַחֲרִית שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
A land that YHWH, your God, cares about; YHWH’s eyes are
always on it, from the year’s beginning to year’s end.

translation.text: A land which the LORD thy God careth for: the eyes of the LORD thy God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.

verses.english:
A land that YHWH, your God, cares about; YHWH’s eyes are
always on it, from the year’s beginning to year’s end.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם שָׁמֹעַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶל מִצְוֺתַי אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וּלְעבְדוֹ בְּכל לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכל נַפְשְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם שָׁמֹעַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶל מִצְוֺתַי אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וּלְעבְדוֹ בְּכל לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכל נַפְשְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
So it will be, if you’ll listen to my commandments that I
command you today, to love YHWH, your God, and to serve
Him with all your heart and with all your soul,

translation.text: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

verses.english:
So it will be, if you’ll listen to my commandments that I
command you today, to love YHWH, your God, and to serve
Him with all your heart and with all your soul,

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי מְטַר אַרְצְכֶם בְּעִתּוֹ יוֹרֶה וּמַלְקוֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ דְגָנֶךָ וְתִירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי מְטַר אַרְצְכֶם בְּעִתּוֹ יוֹרֶה וּמַלְקוֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ דְגָנֶךָ וְתִירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶךָ׃

english.text:
then I’ll give your land’s showers at their time, early
rain and late rain, and you’ll gather your grain and your
wine and your oil.

translation.text: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.

verses.english:
then I’ll give your land’s showers at their time, early
rain and late rain, and you’ll gather your grain and your
wine and your oil.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי עֵשֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ לִבְהֶמְתֶּךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי עֵשֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ לִבְהֶמְתֶּךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ׃

english.text:
And I’ll give vegetation in your field for your animals,
and you’ll eat and be full.

translation.text: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle, that thou mayest eat and be full.

verses.english:
And I’ll give vegetation in your field for your animals,
and you’ll eat and be full.

verses.hebrew: הִשָּׁמְרוּ לָכֶם פֶּן יִפְתֶּה לְבַבְכֶם וְסַרְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: הִשָּׁמְרוּ לָכֶם פֶּן יִפְתֶּה לְבַבְכֶם וְסַרְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם לָהֶם׃

english.text:
“Watch yourselves in case your heart will be deceived so
you’ll turn and serve other gods and bow to them,

translation.text: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;

verses.english:
“Watch yourselves in case your heart will be deceived so
you’ll turn and serve other gods and bow to them,

verses.hebrew: וְחָרָה אַף יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וְעָצַר אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְלֹא יִהְיֶה מָטָר וְהָאֲדָמָה לֹא תִתֵּן אֶת יְבוּלָהּ וַאֲבַדְתֶּם מְהֵרָה מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ הַטֹּבָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה נֹתֵן לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְחָרָה אַף יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וְעָצַר אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְלֹא יִהְיֶה מָטָר וְהָאֲדָמָה לֹא תִתֵּן אֶת יְבוּלָהּ וַאֲבַדְתֶּם מְהֵרָה מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ הַטֹּבָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה נֹתֵן לָכֶם׃

english.text:
and YHWH’s anger will flare at you, and He’ll hold back
the skies, and there won’t be showers, and the earth won’t
give its crop, and you’ll perish quickly from the good
land that YHWH is giving you.

translation.text: And then the LORD’s wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD giveth you.

verses.english:
and YHWH’s anger will flare at you, and He’ll hold back
the skies, and there won’t be showers, and the earth won’t
give its crop, and you’ll perish quickly from the good
land that YHWH is giving you.

verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתֶּם אֶת דְּבָרַי אֵלֶּה עַל לְבַבְכֶם וְעַל נַפְשְׁכֶם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּם אֹתָם לְאוֹת עַל יֶדְכֶם וְהָיוּ לְטוֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתֶּם אֶת דְּבָרַי אֵלֶּה עַל לְבַבְכֶם וְעַל נַפְשְׁכֶם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּם אֹתָם לְאוֹת עַל יֶדְכֶם וְהָיוּ לְטוֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
So you shall set these words of mine on your heart and on
your soul, and you shall bind them for a sign on your
hand, and they shall become bands between your eyes,

translation.text: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.

verses.english:
So you shall set these words of mine on your heart and on
your soul, and you shall bind them for a sign on your
hand, and they shall become bands between your eyes,

verses.hebrew: וְלִמַּדְתֶּם אֹתָם אֶת בְּנֵיכֶם לְדַבֵּר בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּרֶךְ וּבְשׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְלִמַּדְתֶּם אֹתָם אֶת בְּנֵיכֶם לְדַבֵּר בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּרֶךְ וּבְשׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶךָ׃

english.text:
and you shall teach them to your children, to speak about
them when you sit in your house and when you go in the
road and when you lie down and when you get up,

translation.text: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

verses.english:
and you shall teach them to your children, to speak about
them when you sit in your house and when you go in the
road and when you lie down and when you get up,

verses.hebrew: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל מְזוּזוֹת בֵּיתֶךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל מְזוּזוֹת בֵּיתֶךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

english.text:
and you shall write them on the doorposts of your house
and in your gates,

translation.text: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house, and upon thy gates:

verses.english:
and you shall write them on the doorposts of your house
and in your gates,

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יִרְבּוּ יְמֵיכֶם וִימֵי בְנֵיכֶם עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם לָתֵת לָהֶם כִּימֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן יִרְבּוּ יְמֵיכֶם וִימֵי בְנֵיכֶם עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם לָתֵת לָהֶם כִּימֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם עַל הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
so that your days and your children’s days will be many on
the land that YHWH swore to your fathers to give them,
like the days of the skies over the earth.

translation.text: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.

verses.english:
so that your days and your children’s days will be many on
the land that YHWH swore to your fathers to give them,
like the days of the skies over the earth.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם שָׁמֹר תִּשְׁמְרוּן אֶת כּל הַמִּצְוָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם לַעֲשֹׂתָהּ לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לָלֶכֶת בְּכל דְּרָכָיו וּלְדבְקָה בוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם שָׁמֹר תִּשְׁמְרוּן אֶת כּל הַמִּצְוָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם לַעֲשֹׂתָהּ לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לָלֶכֶת בְּכל דְּרָכָיו וּלְדבְקָה בוֹ׃

english.text:
Because, if you will observe all of this commandment that
I command you, to do it, to love YHWH, your God, to go in
all His ways and to cling to Him,

translation.text: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him;

verses.english:
Because, if you will observe all of this commandment that
I command you, to do it, to love YHWH, your God, to go in
all His ways and to cling to Him,

verses.hebrew: וְהוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה אֶת כּל הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִלִּפְנֵיכֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם גּוֹיִם גְּדֹלִים וַעֲצֻמִים מִכֶּם׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה אֶת כּל הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִלִּפְנֵיכֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם גּוֹיִם גְּדֹלִים וַעֲצֻמִים מִכֶּם׃

english.text:
then YHWH will dispossess all these nations in front of
you, and you’ll dispossess bigger and more powerful
nations than you.

translation.text: Then will the LORD drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.

verses.english:
then YHWH will dispossess all these nations in front of
you, and you’ll dispossess bigger and more powerful
nations than you.

verses.hebrew: כּל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר תִּדְרֹךְ כַּף רַגְלְכֶם בּוֹ לָכֶם יִהְיֶה מִן הַמִּדְבָּר וְהַלְּבָנוֹן מִן הַנָּהָר נְהַר פְּרָת וְעַד הַיָּם הָאַחֲרוֹן יִהְיֶה גְּבֻלְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר תִּדְרֹךְ כַּף רַגְלְכֶם בּוֹ לָכֶם יִהְיֶה מִן הַמִּדְבָּר וְהַלְּבָנוֹן מִן הַנָּהָר נְהַר פְּרָת וְעַד הַיָּם הָאַחֲרוֹן יִהְיֶה גְּבֻלְכֶם׃

english.text:
Every place in which your foot will step shall be yours,
from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the
Euphrates River, to the far sea shall be your border.

translation.text: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.

verses.english:
Every place in which your foot will step shall be yours,
from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the
Euphrates River, to the far sea shall be your border.

verses.hebrew: לֹא יִתְיַצֵּב אִישׁ בִּפְנֵיכֶם פַּחְדְּכֶם וּמוֹרַאֲכֶם יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם עַל פְּנֵי כל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּדְרְכוּ בָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יִתְיַצֵּב אִישׁ בִּפְנֵיכֶם פַּחְדְּכֶם וּמוֹרַאֲכֶם יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם עַל פְּנֵי כל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּדְרְכוּ בָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָכֶם׃

english.text:
Not a man will stand up in front of you. YHWH, your God,
will put awe of you and fear of you on the face of all the
land on which you’ll step, as He spoke to you.

translation.text: There shall no man be able to stand before you: for the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.

verses.english:
Not a man will stand up in front of you. YHWH, your God,
will put awe of you and fear of you on the face of all the
land on which you’ll step, as He spoke to you.

verses.hebrew: רְאֵה אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן לִפְנֵיכֶם הַיּוֹם בְּרָכָה וּקְלָלָה׃

hebrew.text: רְאֵה אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן לִפְנֵיכֶם הַיּוֹם בְּרָכָה וּקְלָלָה׃

english.text:
SEE “See: I’m putting in front of you today a blessing and
a curse:

translation.text: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;

verses.english:
SEE “See: I’m putting in front of you today a blessing and
a curse:

verses.hebrew: אֶת הַבְּרָכָה אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: אֶת הַבְּרָכָה אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
the blessing when you’ll listen to the commandments of
YHWH, your God, that I command you today,

translation.text: A blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day:

verses.english:
the blessing when you’ll listen to the commandments of
YHWH, your God, that I command you today,

verses.hebrew: וְהַקְּלָלָה אִם לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ אֶל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְסַרְתֶּם מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יְדַעְתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַקְּלָלָה אִם לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ אֶל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְסַרְתֶּם מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יְדַעְתֶּם׃

english.text:
and the curse if you won’t listen to the commandments of
YHWH, your God, and you’ll turn from the way that I
command you today, to go after other gods, whom you
haven’t known.

translation.text: And a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.

verses.english:
and the curse if you won’t listen to the commandments of
YHWH, your God, and you’ll turn from the way that I
command you today, to go after other gods, whom you
haven’t known.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי יְבִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ וְנָתַתָּה אֶת הַבְּרָכָה עַל הַר גְּרִזִים וְאֶת הַקְּלָלָה עַל הַר עֵיבָל׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי יְבִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ וְנָתַתָּה אֶת הַבְּרָכָה עַל הַר גְּרִזִים וְאֶת הַקְּלָלָה עַל הַר עֵיבָל׃

english.text:
And it shall be, when YHWH, your God, will bring you to
the land to which you’re coming to take possession of it,
that you shall put the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the
curse on Mount Ebal.

translation.text: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.

verses.english:
And it shall be, when YHWH, your God, will bring you to
the land to which you’re coming to take possession of it,
that you shall put the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the
curse on Mount Ebal.

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא הֵמָּה בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן אַחֲרֵי דֶּרֶךְ מְבוֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בְּאֶרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּעֲרָבָה מוּל הַגִּלְגָּל אֵצֶל אֵלוֹנֵי מֹרֶה׃

hebrew.text: הֲלֹא הֵמָּה בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן אַחֲרֵי דֶּרֶךְ מְבוֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בְּאֶרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּעֲרָבָה מוּל הַגִּלְגָּל אֵצֶל אֵלוֹנֵי מֹרֶה׃

english.text:
Aren’t they across the Jordan, beyond the way of the sun’s
setting, in the land of the Canaanite who lives in the
plain, opposite Gilgal, near the oaks of Moreh?

translation.text: Are they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goeth down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?
