verses.english:
Aren’t they across the Jordan, beyond the way of the sun’s
setting, in the land of the Canaanite who lives in the
plain, opposite Gilgal, near the oaks of Moreh?

verses.hebrew: כִּי אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן לָבֹא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נֹתֵן לָכֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֹתָהּ וִישַׁבְתֶּם בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן לָבֹא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נֹתֵן לָכֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֹתָהּ וִישַׁבְתֶּם בָּהּ׃

translation.text: For ye shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם לַעֲשׂוֹת אֵת כּל הַחֻקִּים וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן לִפְנֵיכֶם הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם לַעֲשׂוֹת אֵת כּל הַחֻקִּים וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן לִפְנֵיכֶם הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
and be watchful to do all the laws and the judgments that
I’m putting in front of you today.

translation.text: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day.

verses.english:
and be watchful to do all the laws and the judgments that
I’m putting in front of you today.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמְרוּן לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֶיךָ לְךָ לְרִשְׁתָּהּ כּל הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם חַיִּים עַל הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה הַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמְרוּן לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֶיךָ לְךָ לְרִשְׁתָּהּ כּל הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם חַיִּים עַל הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
“These are the laws and the judgments that you shall be
watchful to do in the land that YHWH, your fathers’ God,
has given you to take possession of it, every day that
you’re living on the land:

translation.text: These are the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the LORD God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.

verses.english:
“These are the laws and the judgments that you shall be
watchful to do in the land that YHWH, your fathers’ God,
has given you to take possession of it, every day that
you’re living on the land:

verses.hebrew: אַבֵּד תְּאַבְּדוּן אֶת כּל הַמְּקֹמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָבְדוּ שָׁם הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹרְשִׁים אֹתָם אֶת אֱלֹהֵיהֶם עַל הֶהָרִים הָרָמִים וְעַל הַגְּבָעוֹת וְתַחַת כּל עֵץ רַעֲנָן׃

hebrew.text: אַבֵּד תְּאַבְּדוּן אֶת כּל הַמְּקֹמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָבְדוּ שָׁם הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹרְשִׁים אֹתָם אֶת אֱלֹהֵיהֶם עַל הֶהָרִים הָרָמִים וְעַל הַגְּבָעוֹת וְתַחַת כּל עֵץ רַעֲנָן׃

english.text:
“You shall destroy all the places where the nations that
you’re dispossessing worshiped their gods there: on the
high mountains and on the hills and under every lush tree.

translation.text: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:

verses.english:
“You shall destroy all the places where the nations that
you’re dispossessing worshiped their gods there: on the
high mountains and on the hills and under every lush tree.

verses.hebrew: וְנִתַּצְתֶּם אֶת מִזְבְּחֹתָם וְשִׁבַּרְתֶּם אֶת מַצֵּבֹתָם וַאֲשֵׁרֵיהֶם תִּשְׂרְפוּן בָּאֵשׁ וּפְסִילֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶם תְּגַדֵּעוּן וְאִבַּדְתֶּם אֶת שְׁמָם מִן הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְנִתַּצְתֶּם אֶת מִזְבְּחֹתָם וְשִׁבַּרְתֶּם אֶת מַצֵּבֹתָם וַאֲשֵׁרֵיהֶם תִּשְׂרְפוּן בָּאֵשׁ וּפְסִילֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶם תְּגַדֵּעוּן וְאִבַּדְתֶּם אֶת שְׁמָם מִן הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא׃

english.text:
And you shall demolish their altars and shatter their
pillars and burn their Asherahs in fire and cut down the
statues of their gods in fire and destroy their name from
that place.

translation.text: And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.

verses.english:
And you shall demolish their altars and shatter their
pillars and burn their Asherahs in fire and cut down the
statues of their gods in fire and destroy their name from
that place.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּן כֵּן לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּן כֵּן לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text: “You shall not do that for YHWH, your God.

translation.text: Ye shall not do so unto the LORD your God.

verses.english: “You shall not do that for YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מִכּל שִׁבְטֵיכֶם לָשׂוּם אֶת שְׁמוֹ שָׁם לְשִׁכְנוֹ תִדְרְשׁוּ וּבָאתָ שָּׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מִכּל שִׁבְטֵיכֶם לָשׂוּם אֶת שְׁמוֹ שָׁם לְשִׁכְנוֹ תִדְרְשׁוּ וּבָאתָ שָּׁמָּה׃

english.text:
But, rather, you shall inquire at the place that YHWH,
your God, will choose from all your tribes to set His name
there, to tent it. And you shall come there,

translation.text: But unto the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there, even unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come:

verses.english:
But, rather, you shall inquire at the place that YHWH,
your God, will choose from all your tribes to set His name
there, to tent it. And you shall come there,

verses.hebrew: וַהֲבֵאתֶם שָׁמָּה עֹלֹתֵיכֶם וְזִבְחֵיכֶם וְאֵת מַעְשְׂרֹתֵיכֶם וְאֵת תְּרוּמַת יֶדְכֶם וְנִדְרֵיכֶם וְנִדְבֹתֵיכֶם וּבְכֹרֹת בְּקַרְכֶם וְצֹאנְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַהֲבֵאתֶם שָׁמָּה עֹלֹתֵיכֶם וְזִבְחֵיכֶם וְאֵת מַעְשְׂרֹתֵיכֶם וְאֵת תְּרוּמַת יֶדְכֶם וְנִדְרֵיכֶם וְנִדְבֹתֵיכֶם וּבְכֹרֹת בְּקַרְכֶם וְצֹאנְכֶם׃

english.text:
and bring there your burnt offerings and your sacrifices
and your tithes and your hand’s donation and your vows and
your contributions and the firstborn of your herd and your
flock.

translation.text: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:

verses.english:
and bring there your burnt offerings and your sacrifices
and your tithes and your hand’s donation and your vows and
your contributions and the firstborn of your herd and your
flock.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם שָׁם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וּשְׂמַחְתֶּם בְּכֹל מִשְׁלַח יֶדְכֶם אַתֶּם וּבָתֵּיכֶם אֲשֶׁר בֵּרַכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם שָׁם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וּשְׂמַחְתֶּם בְּכֹל מִשְׁלַח יֶדְכֶם אַתֶּם וּבָתֵּיכֶם אֲשֶׁר בֵּרַכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall eat there in front of YHWH, your God. And
you shall rejoice about everything your hand has taken on,
you and your households, in that YHWH, your God, has
blessed you.

translation.text: And there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.

verses.english:
And you shall eat there in front of YHWH, your God. And
you shall rejoice about everything your hand has taken on,
you and your households, in that YHWH, your God, has
blessed you.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּן כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר אֲנַחְנוּ עֹשִׂים פֹּה הַיּוֹם אִישׁ כּל הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּן כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר אֲנַחְנוּ עֹשִׂים פֹּה הַיּוֹם אִישׁ כּל הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו׃

english.text:
You shall not do it like everything that we’re doing here
today, each one, everything that’s right in his own eyes,

translation.text: Ye shall not do after all the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes.

verses.english:
You shall not do it like everything that we’re doing here
today, each one, everything that’s right in his own eyes,

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא בָאתֶם עַד עָתָּה אֶל הַמְּנוּחָה וְאֶל הַנַּחֲלָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא בָאתֶם עַד עָתָּה אֶל הַמְּנוּחָה וְאֶל הַנַּחֲלָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

english.text:
because up to now you haven’t come to the resting place
and to the legacy that YHWH, your God, is giving you.

translation.text: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the LORD your God giveth you.

verses.english:
because up to now you haven’t come to the resting place
and to the legacy that YHWH, your God, is giving you.

verses.hebrew: וַעֲבַרְתֶּם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן וִישַׁבְתֶּם בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מַנְחִיל אֶתְכֶם וְהֵנִיחַ לָכֶם מִכּל אֹיְבֵיכֶם מִסָּבִיב וִישַׁבְתֶּם בֶּטַח׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲבַרְתֶּם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן וִישַׁבְתֶּם בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מַנְחִיל אֶתְכֶם וְהֵנִיחַ לָכֶם מִכּל אֹיְבֵיכֶם מִסָּבִיב וִישַׁבְתֶּם בֶּטַח׃

english.text:
But when you’ll cross the Jordan and live in the land that
YHWH, your God, is giving you as a legacy, and He’ll give
you rest from all your enemies all around, and you’ll live
securely,

translation.text: But when ye go over Jordan, and dwell in the land which the LORD your God giveth you to inherit, and when he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about, so that ye dwell in safety;

verses.english:
But when you’ll cross the Jordan and live in the land that
YHWH, your God, is giving you as a legacy, and He’ll give
you rest from all your enemies all around, and you’ll live
securely,

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בּוֹ לְשַׁכֵּן שְׁמוֹ שָׁם שָׁמָּה תָבִיאוּ אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם עוֹלֹתֵיכֶם וְזִבְחֵיכֶם מַעְשְׂרֹתֵיכֶם וּתְרֻמַת יֶדְכֶם וְכֹל מִבְחַר נִדְרֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר תִּדְּרוּ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בּוֹ לְשַׁכֵּן שְׁמוֹ שָׁם שָׁמָּה תָבִיאוּ אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם עוֹלֹתֵיכֶם וְזִבְחֵיכֶם מַעְשְׂרֹתֵיכֶם וּתְרֻמַת יֶדְכֶם וְכֹל מִבְחַר נִדְרֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר תִּדְּרוּ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
then it shall be, the place that YHWH, your God, will
choose to tent His name there: there you shall bring
everything that I command you, your burnt offerings and
your sacrifices, your tithes and your hand’s donation and
every choice one of your vows that you’ll make to YHWH.

translation.text: Then there shall be a place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the LORD:

verses.english:
then it shall be, the place that YHWH, your God, will
choose to tent His name there: there you shall bring
everything that I command you, your burnt offerings and
your sacrifices, your tithes and your hand’s donation and
every choice one of your vows that you’ll make to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׂמַחְתֶּם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אַתֶּם וּבְנֵיכֶם וּבְנֹתֵיכֶם וְעַבְדֵיכֶם וְאַמְהֹתֵיכֶם וְהַלֵּוִי אֲשֶׁר בְּשַׁעֲרֵיכֶם כִּי אֵין לוֹ חֵלֶק וְנַחֲלָה אִתְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׂמַחְתֶּם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אַתֶּם וּבְנֵיכֶם וּבְנֹתֵיכֶם וְעַבְדֵיכֶם וְאַמְהֹתֵיכֶם וְהַלֵּוִי אֲשֶׁר בְּשַׁעֲרֵיכֶם כִּי אֵין לוֹ חֵלֶק וְנַחֲלָה אִתְּכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall rejoice in front of YHWH, your God: you and
your sons and your daughters and your servants and your
maids and the Levite who is in your gates because he
doesn’t have a portion or a legacy with you.

translation.text: And ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that is within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.

verses.english:
And you shall rejoice in front of YHWH, your God: you and
your sons and your daughters and your servants and your
maids and the Levite who is in your gates because he
doesn’t have a portion or a legacy with you.

verses.hebrew: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תַּעֲלֶה עֹלֹתֶיךָ בְּכל מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶה׃

hebrew.text: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תַּעֲלֶה עֹלֹתֶיךָ בְּכל מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶה׃

english.text:
“Watch yourself in case you would make your burnt
offerings in any place that you’ll see.

translation.text: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest:

verses.english:
“Watch yourself in case you would make your burnt
offerings in any place that you’ll see.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה בְּאַחַד שְׁבָטֶיךָ שָׁם תַּעֲלֶה עֹלֹתֶיךָ וְשָׁם תַּעֲשֶׂה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּךָּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה בְּאַחַד שְׁבָטֶיךָ שָׁם תַּעֲלֶה עֹלֹתֶיךָ וְשָׁם תַּעֲשֶׂה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּךָּ׃

english.text:
But, rather, in the place that YHWH will choose in one of
your tribes: there you shall make your burnt offerings,
and there you shall do everything that I command you.

translation.text: But in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.

verses.english:
But, rather, in the place that YHWH will choose in one of
your tribes: there you shall make your burnt offerings,
and there you shall do everything that I command you.

verses.hebrew: רַק בְּכל אַוַּת נַפְשְׁךָ תִּזְבַּח וְאָכַלְתָּ בָשָׂר כְּבִרְכַּת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְךָ בְּכל שְׁעָרֶיךָ הַטָּמֵא וְהַטָּהוֹר יֹאכְלֶנּוּ כַּצְּבִי וְכָאַיָּל׃

hebrew.text: רַק בְּכל אַוַּת נַפְשְׁךָ תִּזְבַּח וְאָכַלְתָּ בָשָׂר כְּבִרְכַּת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְךָ בְּכל שְׁעָרֶיךָ הַטָּמֵא וְהַטָּהוֹר יֹאכְלֶנּוּ כַּצְּבִי וְכָאַיָּל׃

english.text:
Only, as much as your soul desires you may slaughter and
may eat meat according to the blessing of YHWH, your God,
that He has given you in all your gates. The impure and
the pure may eat it: like a gazelle, like a deer.

translation.text: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.

verses.english:
Only, as much as your soul desires you may slaughter and
may eat meat according to the blessing of YHWH, your God,
that He has given you in all your gates. The impure and
the pure may eat it: like a gazelle, like a deer.

verses.hebrew: רַק הַדָּם לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ עַל הָאָרֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶנּוּ כַּמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: רַק הַדָּם לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ עַל הָאָרֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶנּוּ כַּמָּיִם׃

english.text:
Only, you shall not eat the blood. You shall spill it like
water on the earth.

translation.text: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.

verses.english:
Only, you shall not eat the blood. You shall spill it like
water on the earth.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תוּכַל לֶאֱכֹל בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ מַעְשַׂר דְּגָנְךָ וְתִירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶךָ וּבְכֹרֹת בְּקָרְךָ וְצֹאנֶךָ וְכל נְדָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּדֹּר וְנִדְבֹתֶיךָ וּתְרוּמַת יָדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תוּכַל לֶאֱכֹל בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ מַעְשַׂר דְּגָנְךָ וְתִירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶךָ וּבְכֹרֹת בְּקָרְךָ וְצֹאנֶךָ וְכל נְדָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּדֹּר וְנִדְבֹתֶיךָ וּתְרוּמַת יָדֶךָ׃

english.text:
You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain
or your wine or your oil or the firstborn of your herd or
your flock or all your vows that you’ll make or your
contributions or your hand’s donation.

translation.text: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

verses.english:
You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain
or your wine or your oil or the firstborn of your herd or
your flock or all your vows that you’ll make or your
contributions or your hand’s donation.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תֹּאכְלֶנּוּ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בּוֹ אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבִתֶּךָ וְעַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתֶךָ וְהַלֵּוִי אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ וְשָׂמַחְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל מִשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תֹּאכְלֶנּוּ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בּוֹ אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבִתֶּךָ וְעַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתֶךָ וְהַלֵּוִי אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ וְשָׂמַחְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל מִשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ׃

english.text:
But, rather, you shall eat them in front of YHWH, your
God, in the place that YHWH, your God, will choose: you
and your son and your daughter and your servant and your
maid and the Levite who is in your gates. And you shall
rejoice in front of YHWH, your God, about everything your
hand has taken on.

translation.text: But thou must eat them before the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto.

verses.english:
But, rather, you shall eat them in front of YHWH, your
God, in the place that YHWH, your God, will choose: you
and your son and your daughter and your servant and your
maid and the Levite who is in your gates. And you shall
rejoice in front of YHWH, your God, about everything your
hand has taken on.

verses.hebrew: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תַּעֲזֹב אֶת הַלֵּוִי כּל יָמֶיךָ עַל אַדְמָתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תַּעֲזֹב אֶת הַלֵּוִי כּל יָמֶיךָ עַל אַדְמָתֶךָ׃

english.text:
Watch yourself in case you would leave the Levite, all
your days in your land.

translation.text: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.

verses.english:
Watch yourself in case you would leave the Levite, all
your days in your land.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יַרְחִיב יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת גְּבֻלְךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָךְ וְאָמַרְתָּ אֹכְלָה בָשָׂר כִּי תְאַוֶּה נַפְשְׁךָ לֶאֱכֹל בָּשָׂר בְּכל אַוַּת נַפְשְׁךָ תֹּאכַל בָּשָׂר׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יַרְחִיב יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת גְּבֻלְךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָךְ וְאָמַרְתָּ אֹכְלָה בָשָׂר כִּי תְאַוֶּה נַפְשְׁךָ לֶאֱכֹל בָּשָׂר בְּכל אַוַּת נַפְשְׁךָ תֹּאכַל בָּשָׂר׃

english.text:
“When YHWH, your God, will widen your border as He spoke
to you, and you’ll say, ‘Let me eat meat,’ because your
soul will desire to eat meat, you may eat meat as much as
your soul desires.

translation.text: When the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.

verses.english:
“When YHWH, your God, will widen your border as He spoke
to you, and you’ll say, ‘Let me eat meat,’ because your
soul will desire to eat meat, you may eat meat as much as
your soul desires.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִרְחַק מִמְּךָ הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָשׂוּם שְׁמוֹ שָׁם וְזָבַחְתָּ מִבְּקָרְךָ וּמִצֹּאנְךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה לְךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ בְּכֹל אַוַּת נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִרְחַק מִמְּךָ הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָשׂוּם שְׁמוֹ שָׁם וְזָבַחְתָּ מִבְּקָרְךָ וּמִצֹּאנְךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה לְךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ בְּכֹל אַוַּת נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
When the place that YHWH, your God, will choose to put His
name there will be far from you, then you shall slaughter
from your herd and from your flock that YHWH has given you
as I’ve commanded you, and you may eat within your gates
as much as your soul desires.

translation.text: If the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the LORD hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.

verses.english:
When the place that YHWH, your God, will choose to put His
name there will be far from you, then you shall slaughter
from your herd and from your flock that YHWH has given you
as I’ve commanded you, and you may eat within your gates
as much as your soul desires.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר יֵאָכֵל אֶת הַצְּבִי וְאֶת הָאַיָּל כֵּן תֹּאכְלֶנּוּ הַטָּמֵא וְהַטָּהוֹר יַחְדָּו יֹאכְלֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר יֵאָכֵל אֶת הַצְּבִי וְאֶת הָאַיָּל כֵּן תֹּאכְלֶנּוּ הַטָּמֵא וְהַטָּהוֹר יַחְדָּו יֹאכְלֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
Just: as a gazelle and a deer are eaten, so you shall eat
it. The impure and the pure may eat it together.

translation.text: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike.

verses.english:
Just: as a gazelle and a deer are eaten, so you shall eat
it. The impure and the pure may eat it together.

verses.hebrew: רַק חֲזַק לְבִלְתִּי אֲכֹל הַדָּם כִּי הַדָּם הוּא הַנָּפֶשׁ וְלֹא תֹאכַל הַנֶּפֶשׁ עִם הַבָּשָׂר׃

hebrew.text: רַק חֲזַק לְבִלְתִּי אֲכֹל הַדָּם כִּי הַדָּם הוּא הַנָּפֶשׁ וְלֹא תֹאכַל הַנֶּפֶשׁ עִם הַבָּשָׂר׃

english.text:
Only, be strong not to eat the blood, because the blood:
it’s the life; and you shall not eat the life with the
meat.

translation.text: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.

verses.english:
Only, be strong not to eat the blood, because the blood:
it’s the life; and you shall not eat the life with the
meat.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תֹּאכְלֶנּוּ עַל הָאָרֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶנּוּ כַּמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֹּאכְלֶנּוּ עַל הָאָרֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶנּוּ כַּמָּיִם׃

english.text:
You shall not eat it. You shall spill it like water on the
earth.

translation.text: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.

verses.english:
You shall not eat it. You shall spill it like water on the
earth.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תֹּאכְלֶנּוּ לְמַעַן יִיטַב לְךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ כִּי תַעֲשֶׂה הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֹּאכְלֶנּוּ לְמַעַן יִיטַב לְךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ כִּי תַעֲשֶׂה הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
You shall not eat it, so it will be good for you and for
your children after you when you do what is right in
YHWH’s eyes.

translation.text: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the LORD.

verses.english:
You shall not eat it, so it will be good for you and for
your children after you when you do what is right in
YHWH’s eyes.

verses.hebrew: רַק קדָשֶׁיךָ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיוּ לְךָ וּנְדָרֶיךָ תִּשָּׂא וּבָאתָ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: רַק קדָשֶׁיךָ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיוּ לְךָ וּנְדָרֶיךָ תִּשָּׂא וּבָאתָ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Only, you shall carry your holy things that you’ll have
and your vows and shall come to the place that YHWH will
choose.

translation.text: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which the LORD shall choose:

verses.english:
“Only, you shall carry your holy things that you’ll have
and your vows and shall come to the place that YHWH will
choose.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ עֹלֹתֶיךָ הַבָּשָׂר וְהַדָּם עַל מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְדַם זְבָחֶיךָ יִשָּׁפֵךְ עַל מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהַבָּשָׂר תֹּאכֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ עֹלֹתֶיךָ הַבָּשָׂר וְהַדָּם עַל מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְדַם זְבָחֶיךָ יִשָּׁפֵךְ עַל מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהַבָּשָׂר תֹּאכֵל׃

english.text:
And you shall do your burnt offerings, the meat and the
blood, on the altar of YHWH, your God. And the blood of
your sacrifices shall be spilled on the altar of YHWH,
your God, and you shall eat the meat.

translation.text: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.

verses.english:
And you shall do your burnt offerings, the meat and the
blood, on the altar of YHWH, your God. And the blood of
your sacrifices shall be spilled on the altar of YHWH,
your God, and you shall eat the meat.

verses.hebrew: שְׁמֹר וְשָׁמַעְתָּ אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּךָּ לְמַעַן יִיטַב לְךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ עַד עוֹלָם כִּי תַעֲשֶׂה הַטּוֹב וְהַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: שְׁמֹר וְשָׁמַעְתָּ אֵת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּךָּ לְמַעַן יִיטַב לְךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ עַד עוֹלָם כִּי תַעֲשֶׂה הַטּוֹב וְהַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Be watchful that you listen to all these things that I
command you so that it will be good for you and for your
children after you forever when you’ll do what is good and
right in the eyes of YHWH, your God.

translation.text: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest that which is good and right in the sight of the LORD thy God.

verses.english:
Be watchful that you listen to all these things that I
command you so that it will be good for you and for your
children after you forever when you’ll do what is good and
right in the eyes of YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יַכְרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לָרֶשֶׁת אוֹתָם מִפָּנֶיךָ וְיָרַשְׁתָּ אֹתָם וְיָשַׁבְתָּ בְּאַרְצָם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יַכְרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לָרֶשֶׁת אוֹתָם מִפָּנֶיךָ וְיָרַשְׁתָּ אֹתָם וְיָשַׁבְתָּ בְּאַרְצָם׃

english.text:
“When YHWH, your God, will cut off the nations that you’re
coming there to dispossess from in front of you, and
you’ll dispossess them and live in their land,

translation.text: When the LORD thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest to possess them, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their land;

verses.english:
“When YHWH, your God, will cut off the nations that you’re
coming there to dispossess from in front of you, and
you’ll dispossess them and live in their land,

verses.hebrew: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תִּנָּקֵשׁ אַחֲרֵיהֶם אַחֲרֵי הִשָּׁמְדָם מִפָּנֶיךָ וּפֶן תִּדְרֹשׁ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר אֵיכָה יַעַבְדוּ הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה אֶת אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וְאֶעֱשֶׂה כֵּן גַּם אָנִי׃

hebrew.text: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תִּנָּקֵשׁ אַחֲרֵיהֶם אַחֲרֵי הִשָּׁמְדָם מִפָּנֶיךָ וּפֶן תִּדְרֹשׁ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר אֵיכָה יַעַבְדוּ הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה אֶת אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וְאֶעֱשֶׂה כֵּן גַּם אָנִי׃

english.text:
watch yourself in case you’ll be trapped after them, after
their destruction from in front of you, and in case you’ll
inquire about their gods, saying, ‘How did these nations
serve their gods? And I’ll do that—I, too.’

translation.text: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before thee; and that thou enquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.

verses.english:
watch yourself in case you’ll be trapped after them, after
their destruction from in front of you, and in case you’ll
inquire about their gods, saying, ‘How did these nations
serve their gods? And I’ll do that—I, too.’

verses.hebrew: לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה כֵן לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי כל תּוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂנֵא עָשׂוּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם כִּי גַם אֶת בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת בְּנֹתֵיהֶם יִשְׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה כֵן לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי כל תּוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂנֵא עָשׂוּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם כִּי גַם אֶת בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת בְּנֹתֵיהֶם יִשְׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
You shall not do this for YHWH, your God, because they did
every offensive thing of YHWH that He hates for their
gods, because they would also burn their sons and their
daughters in fire to their gods!

translation.text: Thou shalt not do so unto the LORD thy God: for every abomination to the LORD, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.

verses.english:
You shall not do this for YHWH, your God, because they did
every offensive thing of YHWH that He hates for their
gods, because they would also burn their sons and their
daughters in fire to their gods!

verses.hebrew: אֵת כּל הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם אֹתוֹ תִשְׁמְרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת לֹא תֹסֵף עָלָיו וְלֹא תִגְרַע מִמֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: אֵת כּל הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם אֹתוֹ תִשְׁמְרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת לֹא תֹסֵף עָלָיו וְלֹא תִגְרַע מִמֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
“Everything that I command you: you shall be watchful
to do it. You shall not add onto it, and you shall not
subtract from it.

translation.text: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder,

verses.english:
“Everything that I command you: you shall be watchful
to do it. You shall not add onto it, and you shall not
subtract from it.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יָקוּם בְּקִרְבְּךָ נָבִיא אוֹ חֹלֵם חֲלוֹם וְנָתַן אֵלֶיךָ אוֹת אוֹ מוֹפֵת׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יָקוּם בְּקִרְבְּךָ נָבִיא אוֹ חֹלֵם חֲלוֹם וְנָתַן אֵלֶיךָ אוֹת אוֹ מוֹפֵת׃

english.text:
“When a prophet or one who has a dream will get up among
you and will give you a sign or a wonder,

translation.text: And the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them;

verses.english:
“When a prophet or one who has a dream will get up among
you and will give you a sign or a wonder,

verses.hebrew: וּבָא הָאוֹת וְהַמּוֹפֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר נֵלְכָה אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יְדַעְתָּם וְנעבְדֵם׃

hebrew.text: וּבָא הָאוֹת וְהַמּוֹפֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר נֵלְכָה אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יְדַעְתָּם וְנעבְדֵם׃

english.text:
and the sign or the wonder of which he spoke to
you—saying, ‘Let’s go after other gods,’ whom you haven’t
known, ‘and let’s serve them’—will come to pass,

translation.text: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for the LORD your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.english:
and the sign or the wonder of which he spoke to
you—saying, ‘Let’s go after other gods,’ whom you haven’t
known, ‘and let’s serve them’—will come to pass,

verses.hebrew: לֹא תִשְׁמַע אֶל דִּבְרֵי הַנָּבִיא הַהוּא אוֹ אֶל חוֹלֵם הַחֲלוֹם הַהוּא כִּי מְנַסֶּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶתְכֶם לָדַעַת הֲיִשְׁכֶם אֹהֲבִים אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בְּכל לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכל נַפְשְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תִשְׁמַע אֶל דִּבְרֵי הַנָּבִיא הַהוּא אוֹ אֶל חוֹלֵם הַחֲלוֹם הַהוּא כִּי מְנַסֶּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶתְכֶם לָדַעַת הֲיִשְׁכֶם אֹהֲבִים אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בְּכל לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכל נַפְשְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
you shall not listen to that prophet’s words or to that
one who has the dream, because YHWH, your God, is testing
you, to know whether you are loving YHWH, your God, with
all your heart and with all your soul.

translation.text: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.

verses.english:
you shall not listen to that prophet’s words or to that
one who has the dream, because YHWH, your God, is testing
you, to know whether you are loving YHWH, your God, with
all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם תֵּלֵכוּ וְאֹתוֹ תִירָאוּ וְאֶת מִצְוֺתָיו תִּשְׁמֹרוּ וּבְקֹלוֹ תִשְׁמָעוּ וְאֹתוֹ תַעֲבֹדוּ וּבוֹ תִדְבָּקוּן׃

hebrew.text: אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם תֵּלֵכוּ וְאֹתוֹ תִירָאוּ וְאֶת מִצְוֺתָיו תִּשְׁמֹרוּ וּבְקֹלוֹ תִשְׁמָעוּ וְאֹתוֹ תַעֲבֹדוּ וּבוֹ תִדְבָּקוּן׃

english.text:
You shall go after YHWH, your God, and you shall fear Him,
and you shall observe His commandments and listen to His
voice and serve Him and cling to Him.

translation.text: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken to turn you away from the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the LORD thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee.

verses.english:
You shall go after YHWH, your God, and you shall fear Him,
and you shall observe His commandments and listen to His
voice and serve Him and cling to Him.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנָּבִיא הַהוּא אוֹ חֹלֵם הַחֲלוֹם הַהוּא יוּמָת כִּי דִבֶּר סָרָה עַל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הַמּוֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וְהַפֹּדְךָ מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים לְהַדִּיחֲךָ מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָלֶכֶת בָּהּ וּבִעַרְתָּ הָרָע מִקִּרְבֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנָּבִיא הַהוּא אוֹ חֹלֵם הַחֲלוֹם הַהוּא יוּמָת כִּי דִבֶּר סָרָה עַל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הַמּוֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וְהַפֹּדְךָ מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים לְהַדִּיחֲךָ מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָלֶכֶת בָּהּ וּבִעַרְתָּ הָרָע מִקִּרְבֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And that prophet or that one who has the dream shall be
put to death, because he spoke a misrepresentation about
YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt
and who redeemed you from a house of slaves, to drive you
from the way in which YHWH, your God, commanded you to go.
So you shall burn away what is bad from among you.

translation.text: If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;

verses.english:
And that prophet or that one who has the dream shall be
put to death, because he spoke a misrepresentation about
YHWH, your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt
and who redeemed you from a house of slaves, to drive you
from the way in which YHWH, your God, commanded you to go.
So you shall burn away what is bad from among you.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יְסִיתְךָ אָחִיךָ בֶן אִמֶּךָ אוֹ בִנְךָ אוֹ בִתְּךָ אוֹ אֵשֶׁת חֵיקֶךָ אוֹ רֵעֲךָ אֲשֶׁר כְּנַפְשְׁךָ בַּסֵּתֶר לֵאמֹר נֵלְכָה וְנַעַבְדָה אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַעְתָּ אַתָּה וַאֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יְסִיתְךָ אָחִיךָ בֶן אִמֶּךָ אוֹ בִנְךָ אוֹ בִתְּךָ אוֹ אֵשֶׁת חֵיקֶךָ אוֹ רֵעֲךָ אֲשֶׁר כְּנַפְשְׁךָ בַּסֵּתֶר לֵאמֹר נֵלְכָה וְנַעַבְדָה אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַעְתָּ אַתָּה וַאֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

english.text:
“When your brother, your mother’s son or your father’s
son, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as
your own self will entice you in secret, saying, ‘Let’s go
and serve other gods,’ whom you haven’t known, you and
your fathers,

translation.text: Namely, of the gods of the people which are round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth;

verses.english:
“When your brother, your mother’s son or your father’s
son, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as
your own self will entice you in secret, saying, ‘Let’s go
and serve other gods,’ whom you haven’t known, you and
your fathers,

verses.hebrew: מֵאֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵיכֶם הַקְּרֹבִים אֵלֶיךָ אוֹ הָרְחֹקִים מִמֶּךָּ מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ וְעַד קְצֵה הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: מֵאֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵיכֶם הַקְּרֹבִים אֵלֶיךָ אוֹ הָרְחֹקִים מִמֶּךָּ מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ וְעַד קְצֵה הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
from the gods of the peoples who are all around you, those
close to you or those far from you, from one end of the
earth to the other end of the earth,

translation.text: Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him:

verses.english:
from the gods of the peoples who are all around you, those
close to you or those far from you, from one end of the
earth to the other end of the earth,

verses.hebrew: לֹא תֹאבֶה לוֹ וְלֹא תִשְׁמַע אֵלָיו וְלֹא תָחוֹס עֵינְךָ עָלָיו וְלֹא תַחְמֹל וְלֹא תְכַסֶּה עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֹאבֶה לוֹ וְלֹא תִשְׁמַע אֵלָיו וְלֹא תָחוֹס עֵינְךָ עָלָיו וְלֹא תַחְמֹל וְלֹא תְכַסֶּה עָלָיו׃

english.text:
you shall not consent to him, and you shall not listen to
him, and your eye shall not pity him, and you shall not
have compassion and shall not cover it up for him.

translation.text: But thou shalt surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.

verses.english:
you shall not consent to him, and you shall not listen to
him, and your eye shall not pity him, and you shall not
have compassion and shall not cover it up for him.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הָרֹג תַּהַרְגֶנּוּ יָדְךָ תִּהְיֶה בּוֹ בָרִאשׁוֹנָה לַהֲמִיתוֹ וְיַד כּל הָעָם בָּאַחֲרֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הָרֹג תַּהַרְגֶנּוּ יָדְךָ תִּהְיֶה בּוֹ בָרִאשׁוֹנָה לַהֲמִיתוֹ וְיַד כּל הָעָם בָּאַחֲרֹנָה׃

english.text:
But you shall kill him. Your hand shall be on him first to
put him to death, and all the people’s hand thereafter.

translation.text: And thou shalt stone him with stones, that he die; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

verses.english:
But you shall kill him. Your hand shall be on him first to
put him to death, and all the people’s hand thereafter.

verses.hebrew: וּסְקַלְתּוֹ בָאֲבָנִים וָמֵת כִּי בִקֵּשׁ לְהַדִּיחֲךָ מֵעַל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הַמּוֹצִיאֲךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים׃

hebrew.text: וּסְקַלְתּוֹ בָאֲבָנִים וָמֵת כִּי בִקֵּשׁ לְהַדִּיחֲךָ מֵעַל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הַמּוֹצִיאֲךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים׃

english.text:
And you shall stone him with stones so he dies because he
sought to drive you away from YHWH, your God, who brought
you out from the land of Egypt, from a house of slaves.

translation.text: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.

verses.english:
And you shall stone him with stones so he dies because he
sought to drive you away from YHWH, your God, who brought
you out from the land of Egypt, from a house of slaves.

verses.hebrew: וְכל יִשְׂרָאֵל יִשְׁמְעוּ וְיִרָאוּן וְלֹא יוֹסִפוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת כַּדָּבָר הָרָע הַזֶּה בְּקִרְבֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל יִשְׂרָאֵל יִשְׁמְעוּ וְיִרָאוּן וְלֹא יוֹסִפוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת כַּדָּבָר הָרָע הַזֶּה בְּקִרְבֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And all Israel will hear and fear and won’t continue to do
a bad thing like this among you.

translation.text: If thou shalt hear say in one of thy cities, which the LORD thy God hath given thee to dwell there, saying,

verses.english:
And all Israel will hear and fear and won’t continue to do
a bad thing like this among you.

verses.hebrew: כִּי תִשְׁמַע בְּאַחַת עָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ לָשֶׁבֶת שָׁם לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תִשְׁמַע בְּאַחַת עָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ לָשֶׁבֶת שָׁם לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
“When you’ll hear in one of your cities that YHWH, your
God, is giving you to live there, saying,

translation.text: Certain men, the children of Belial, are gone out from among you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known;

verses.english:
“When you’ll hear in one of your cities that YHWH, your
God, is giving you to live there, saying,

verses.hebrew: יָצְאוּ אֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי בְלִיַּעַל מִקִּרְבֶּךָ וַיַּדִּיחוּ אֶת יֹשְׁבֵי עִירָם לֵאמֹר נֵלְכָה וְנַעַבְדָה אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יְדַעְתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: יָצְאוּ אֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי בְלִיַּעַל מִקִּרְבֶּךָ וַיַּדִּיחוּ אֶת יֹשְׁבֵי עִירָם לֵאמֹר נֵלְכָה וְנַעַבְדָה אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יְדַעְתֶּם׃

english.text:
‘Good-for-nothing people have gone out from among you and
driven away their city’s residents, saying: “Let’s go and
serve other gods,” whom you haven’t known,’

translation.text: Then shalt thou enquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and, behold, if it be truth, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought among you;

verses.english:
‘Good-for-nothing people have gone out from among you and
driven away their city’s residents, saying: “Let’s go and
serve other gods,” whom you haven’t known,’

verses.hebrew: וְדָרַשְׁתָּ וְחָקַרְתָּ וְשָׁאַלְתָּ הֵיטֵב וְהִנֵּה אֱמֶת נָכוֹן הַדָּבָר נֶעֶשְׂתָה הַתּוֹעֵבָה הַזֹּאת בְּקִרְבֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְדָרַשְׁתָּ וְחָקַרְתָּ וְשָׁאַלְתָּ הֵיטֵב וְהִנֵּה אֱמֶת נָכוֹן הַדָּבָר נֶעֶשְׂתָה הַתּוֹעֵבָה הַזֹּאת בְּקִרְבֶּךָ׃

english.text:
and you’ll inquire and investigate and ask well, and,
here, the thing is true—this offensive thing was done
among you—

translation.text: Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that is therein, and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.

verses.english:
and you’ll inquire and investigate and ask well, and,
here, the thing is true—this offensive thing was done
among you—

verses.hebrew: הַכֵּה תַכֶּה אֶת יֹשְׁבֵי הָעִיר הַהִוא לְפִי חָרֶב הַחֲרֵם אֹתָהּ וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בָּהּ וְאֶת בְּהֶמְתָּהּ לְפִי חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: הַכֵּה תַכֶּה אֶת יֹשְׁבֵי הָעִיר הַהִוא לְפִי חָרֶב הַחֲרֵם אֹתָהּ וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בָּהּ וְאֶת בְּהֶמְתָּהּ לְפִי חָרֶב׃

english.text:
you shall strike that city’s residents by the sword,
completely destroying it and everything in it and its
animals with the sword.

translation.text: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof, and shalt burn with fire the city, and all the spoil thereof every whit, for the LORD thy God: and it shall be an heap for ever; it shall not be built again.

verses.english:
you shall strike that city’s residents by the sword,
completely destroying it and everything in it and its
animals with the sword.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת כּל שְׁלָלָהּ תִּקְבֹּץ אֶל תּוֹךְ רְחֹבָהּ וְשָׂרַפְתָּ בָאֵשׁ אֶת הָעִיר וְאֶת כּל שְׁלָלָהּ כָּלִיל לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהָיְתָה תֵּל עוֹלָם לֹא תִבָּנֶה עוֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת כּל שְׁלָלָהּ תִּקְבֹּץ אֶל תּוֹךְ רְחֹבָהּ וְשָׂרַפְתָּ בָאֵשׁ אֶת הָעִיר וְאֶת כּל שְׁלָלָהּ כָּלִיל לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהָיְתָה תֵּל עוֹלָם לֹא תִבָּנֶה עוֹד׃

english.text:
And you shall gather all its spoil into the middle of its
square, and you shall burn the city and all its spoil in
fire entirely to YHWH, your God, and it shall be a tell
eternally. It shall not be rebuilt again.

translation.text: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand: that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and shew thee mercy, and have compassion upon thee, and multiply thee, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers;

verses.english:
And you shall gather all its spoil into the middle of its
square, and you shall burn the city and all its spoil in
fire entirely to YHWH, your God, and it shall be a tell
eternally. It shall not be rebuilt again.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יִדְבַּק בְּיָדְךָ מְאוּמָה מִן הַחֵרֶם לְמַעַן יָשׁוּב יְהֹוָה מֵחֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ וְנָתַן לְךָ רַחֲמִים וְרִחַמְךָ וְהִרְבֶּךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יִדְבַּק בְּיָדְךָ מְאוּמָה מִן הַחֵרֶם לְמַעַן יָשׁוּב יְהֹוָה מֵחֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ וְנָתַן לְךָ רַחֲמִים וְרִחַמְךָ וְהִרְבֶּךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And let nothing from the complete destruction cling in
your hand, so that YHWH will turn back from His flaring
anger and will give you mercy. And He’ll be merciful to
you and multiply you as He swore to your fathers

translation.text: When thou shalt hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, to do that which is right in the eyes of the LORD thy God.

verses.english:
And let nothing from the complete destruction cling in
your hand, so that YHWH will turn back from His flaring
anger and will give you mercy. And He’ll be merciful to
you and multiply you as He swore to your fathers

verses.hebrew: כִּי תִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לַעֲשׂוֹת הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לַעֲשׂוֹת הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
when you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH, your God, to
observe all His commandments that I command you today, to
do what is right in the eyes of YHWH, your God.

verses.english:
when you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH, your God, to
observe all His commandments that I command you today, to
do what is right in the eyes of YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: בָּנִים אַתֶּם לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לֹא תִתְגֹּדְדוּ וְלֹא תָשִׂימוּ קרְחָה בֵּין עֵינֵיכֶם לָמֵת׃

hebrew.text: בָּנִים אַתֶּם לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לֹא תִתְגֹּדְדוּ וְלֹא תָשִׂימוּ קרְחָה בֵּין עֵינֵיכֶם לָמֵת׃

english.text:
“You are children of YHWH, your God. You shall not cut
yourselves and shall not make a bald place between your
eyes for the dead.

translation.text: Ye are the children of the LORD your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

verses.english:
“You are children of YHWH, your God. You shall not cut
yourselves and shall not make a bald place between your
eyes for the dead.

verses.hebrew: כִּי עַם קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּבְךָ בָּחַר יְהֹוָה לִהְיוֹת לוֹ לְעַם סְגֻלָּה מִכֹּל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי עַם קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּבְךָ בָּחַר יְהֹוָה לִהְיוֹת לוֹ לְעַם סְגֻלָּה מִכֹּל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
Because you are a holy people to YHWH, your God, and YHWH
has chosen you to become a treasured people to Him out of
all the peoples who are on the face of the earth.

translation.text: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God, and the LORD hath chosen thee to be a peculiar people unto himself, above all the nations that are upon the earth.

verses.english:
Because you are a holy people to YHWH, your God, and YHWH
has chosen you to become a treasured people to Him out of
all the peoples who are on the face of the earth.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תֹאכַל כּל תּוֹעֵבָה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֹאכַל כּל תּוֹעֵבָה׃

english.text: “You shall not eat any offensive thing.

translation.text: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.

verses.english: “You shall not eat any offensive thing.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכֵלוּ שׁוֹר שֵׂה כְשָׂבִים וְשֵׂה עִזִּים׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכֵלוּ שׁוֹר שֵׂה כְשָׂבִים וְשֵׂה עִזִּים׃

english.text:
This is the animal that you shall eat: ox, lamb of sheep,
and lamb of goats,

translation.text: These are the beasts which ye shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,

verses.english:
This is the animal that you shall eat: ox, lamb of sheep,
and lamb of goats,

verses.hebrew: אַיָּל וּצְבִי וְיַחְמוּר וְאַקּוֹ וְדִישֹׁן וּתְאוֹ וָזָמֶר׃

hebrew.text: אַיָּל וּצְבִי וְיַחְמוּר וְאַקּוֹ וְדִישֹׁן וּתְאוֹ וָזָמֶר׃

english.text:
deer and gazelle and roebuck and wild goat and bison and
antelope and mountain sheep

translation.text: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.

verses.english:
deer and gazelle and roebuck and wild goat and bison and
antelope and mountain sheep

verses.hebrew: וְכל בְּהֵמָה מַפְרֶסֶת פַּרְסָה וְשֹׁסַעַת שֶׁסַע שְׁתֵּי פְרָסוֹת מַעֲלַת גֵּרָה בַּבְּהֵמָה אֹתָהּ תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל בְּהֵמָה מַפְרֶסֶת פַּרְסָה וְשֹׁסַעַת שֶׁסַע שְׁתֵּי פְרָסוֹת מַעֲלַת גֵּרָה בַּבְּהֵמָה אֹתָהּ תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

english.text:
and every animal that has a hoof and that has a split of
hooves in two, that regurgitates cud, among animals, you
shall eat it.

translation.text: And every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaveth the cleft into two claws, and cheweth the cud among the beasts, that ye shall eat.

verses.english:
and every animal that has a hoof and that has a split of
hooves in two, that regurgitates cud, among animals, you
shall eat it.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ אֶת זֶה לֹא תֹאכְלוּ מִמַּעֲלֵי הַגֵּרָה וּמִמַּפְרִיסֵי הַפַּרְסָה הַשְּׁסוּעָה אֶת הַגָּמָל וְאֶת הָאַרְנֶבֶת וְאֶת הַשָּׁפָן כִּי מַעֲלֵה גֵרָה הֵמָּה וּפַרְסָה לֹא הִפְרִיסוּ טְמֵאִים הֵם לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ אֶת זֶה לֹא תֹאכְלוּ מִמַּעֲלֵי הַגֵּרָה וּמִמַּפְרִיסֵי הַפַּרְסָה הַשְּׁסוּעָה אֶת הַגָּמָל וְאֶת הָאַרְנֶבֶת וְאֶת הַשָּׁפָן כִּי מַעֲלֵה גֵרָה הֵמָּה וּפַרְסָה לֹא הִפְרִיסוּ טְמֵאִים הֵם לָכֶם׃

english.text:
Except you shall not eat this out of those that
regurgitate the cud and out of those that have a hoof: the
camel and the rock-badger and the hare, because they
regurgitate cud and do not have a hoof; they are impure to
you.

translation.text: Nevertheless these ye shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the cloven hoof; as the camel, and the hare, and the coney: for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; therefore they are unclean unto you.

verses.english:
Except you shall not eat this out of those that
regurgitate the cud and out of those that have a hoof: the
camel and the rock-badger and the hare, because they
regurgitate cud and do not have a hoof; they are impure to
you.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַחֲזִיר כִּי מַפְרִיס פַּרְסָה הוּא וְלֹא גֵרָה טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם מִבְּשָׂרָם לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ וּבְנִבְלָתָם לֹא תִגָּעוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַחֲזִיר כִּי מַפְרִיס פַּרְסָה הוּא וְלֹא גֵרָה טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם מִבְּשָׂרָם לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ וּבְנִבְלָתָם לֹא תִגָּעוּ׃

english.text:
And the pig, because it has a hoof but no cud; it is
impure to you. You shall not eat from their meat, and you
shall not touch their carcass.

translation.text: And the swine, because it divideth the hoof, yet cheweth not the cud, it is unclean unto you: ye shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.

verses.english:
And the pig, because it has a hoof but no cud; it is
impure to you. You shall not eat from their meat, and you
shall not touch their carcass.

verses.hebrew: אֶת זֶה תֹּאכְלוּ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר בַּמָּיִם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ סְנַפִּיר וְקַשְׂקֶשֶׂת תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

hebrew.text: אֶת זֶה תֹּאכְלוּ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר בַּמָּיִם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ סְנַפִּיר וְקַשְׂקֶשֶׂת תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

english.text:
“You shall eat this out of all that are in the water: you
shall eat every one that has fins and scales.

translation.text: These ye shall eat of all that are in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall ye eat:

verses.english:
“You shall eat this out of all that are in the water: you
shall eat every one that has fins and scales.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר אֵין לוֹ סְנַפִּיר וְקַשְׂקֶשֶׂת לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר אֵין לוֹ סְנַפִּיר וְקַשְׂקֶשֶׂת לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם׃

english.text:
And you shall not eat any one that does not have fins and
scales; it is impure to you.

translation.text: And whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye may not eat; it is unclean unto you.

verses.english:
And you shall not eat any one that does not have fins and
scales; it is impure to you.

verses.hebrew: כּל צִפּוֹר טְהֹרָה תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

hebrew.text: כּל צִפּוֹר טְהֹרָה תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

english.text: “And you shall eat any pure bird.

translation.text: Of all clean birds ye shall eat.

verses.english: “And you shall eat any pure bird.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֹאכְלוּ מֵהֶם הַנֶּשֶׁר וְהַפֶּרֶס וְהָעזְנִיָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֹאכְלוּ מֵהֶם הַנֶּשֶׁר וְהַפֶּרֶס וְהָעזְנִיָּה׃

english.text:
And this is what you shall not eat from them: the eagle
and the vulture and the black vulture

translation.text: But these are they of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

verses.english:
And this is what you shall not eat from them: the eagle
and the vulture and the black vulture

verses.hebrew: וְהָרָאָה וְאֶת הָאַיָּה וְהַדַּיָּה לְמִינָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָרָאָה וְאֶת הָאַיָּה וְהַדַּיָּה לְמִינָהּ׃

english.text: and the kite and the falcon by its kind

translation.text: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,

verses.english: and the kite and the falcon by its kind

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כּל עֹרֵב לְמִינוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת כּל עֹרֵב לְמִינוֹ׃

english.text: and every raven by its kind

translation.text: And every raven after his kind,

verses.english: and every raven by its kind

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת בַּת הַיַּעֲנָה וְאֶת הַתַּחְמָס וְאֶת הַשָּׁחַף וְאֶת הַנֵּץ לְמִינֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת בַּת הַיַּעֲנָה וְאֶת הַתַּחְמָס וְאֶת הַשָּׁחַף וְאֶת הַנֵּץ לְמִינֵהוּ׃

english.text:
and the eagle owl and the nighthawk and the seagull and
the hawk by its kind,

translation.text: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

verses.english:
and the eagle owl and the nighthawk and the seagull and
the hawk by its kind,

verses.hebrew: אֶת הַכּוֹס וְאֶת הַיַּנְשׁוּף וְהַתִּנְשָׁמֶת׃

hebrew.text: אֶת הַכּוֹס וְאֶת הַיַּנְשׁוּף וְהַתִּנְשָׁמֶת׃

english.text: the little owl and the great owl and the white owl

translation.text: The little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,

verses.english: the little owl and the great owl and the white owl

verses.hebrew: וְהַקָּאָת וְאֶת הָרָחָמָה וְאֶת הַשָּׁלָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַקָּאָת וְאֶת הָרָחָמָה וְאֶת הַשָּׁלָךְ׃

english.text: and the pelican and the fish hawk and the cormorant

translation.text: And the pelican, and the gier eagle, and the cormorant,

verses.english: and the pelican and the fish hawk and the cormorant

verses.hebrew: וְהַחֲסִידָה וְהָאֲנָפָה לְמִינָהּ וְהַדּוּכִיפַת וְהָעֲטַלֵּף׃

hebrew.text: וְהַחֲסִידָה וְהָאֲנָפָה לְמִינָהּ וְהַדּוּכִיפַת וְהָעֲטַלֵּף׃

english.text:
and the stork and the heron by its kind and the hoopoe and
the bat.

translation.text: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

verses.english:
and the stork and the heron by its kind and the hoopoe and
the bat.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל שֶׁרֶץ הָעוֹף טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם לֹא יֵאָכֵלוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל שֶׁרֶץ הָעוֹף טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם לֹא יֵאָכֵלוּ׃

english.text:
“And every swarming thing of flying creatures; it is
impure to you. It shall not be eaten.

translation.text: And every creeping thing that flieth is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.

verses.english:
“And every swarming thing of flying creatures; it is
impure to you. It shall not be eaten.

verses.hebrew: כּל עוֹף טָהוֹר תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

hebrew.text: כּל עוֹף טָהוֹר תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

english.text: You shall eat every pure bird.

translation.text: But of all clean fowls ye may eat.

verses.english: You shall eat every pure bird.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תֹאכְלוּ כל נְבֵלָה לַגֵּר אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ תִּתְּנֶנָּה וַאֲכָלָהּ אוֹ מָכֹר לְנכְרִי כִּי עַם קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תְבַשֵּׁל גְּדִי בַּחֲלֵב אִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תֹאכְלוּ כל נְבֵלָה לַגֵּר אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ תִּתְּנֶנָּה וַאֲכָלָהּ אוֹ מָכֹר לְנכְרִי כִּי עַם קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תְבַשֵּׁל גְּדִי בַּחֲלֵב אִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
“You shall not eat any carcass. You shall give it to the
alien who is in your gates, and he will eat it, or sell to
a foreigner. Because you are a holy people to YHWH, your
God. “You shall not cook a kid in its mother’s milk.

translation.text: Ye shall not eat of anything that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that is in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God.

verses.english:
“You shall not eat any carcass. You shall give it to the
alien who is in your gates, and he will eat it, or sell to
a foreigner. Because you are a holy people to YHWH, your
God. “You shall not cook a kid in its mother’s milk.

verses.hebrew: עַשֵּׂר תְּעַשֵּׂר אֵת כּל תְּבוּאַת זַרְעֶךָ הַיֹּצֵא הַשָּׂדֶה שָׁנָה שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: עַשֵּׂר תְּעַשֵּׂר אֵת כּל תְּבוּאַת זַרְעֶךָ הַיֹּצֵא הַשָּׂדֶה שָׁנָה שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
“You shall tithe all of your seed’s produce that comes out
of the field year by year.

translation.text: Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.

verses.english:
“You shall tithe all of your seed’s produce that comes out
of the field year by year.

verses.hebrew: וְאָכַלְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר לְשַׁכֵּן שְׁמוֹ שָׁם מַעְשַׂר דְּגָנְךָ תִּירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶךָ וּבְכֹרֹת בְּקָרְךָ וְצֹאנֶךָ לְמַעַן תִּלְמַד לְיִרְאָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כּל הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאָכַלְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר לְשַׁכֵּן שְׁמוֹ שָׁם מַעְשַׂר דְּגָנְךָ תִּירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶךָ וּבְכֹרֹת בְּקָרְךָ וְצֹאנֶךָ לְמַעַן תִּלְמַד לְיִרְאָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כּל הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
And you shall eat the tithe of your grain, your wine, and
your oil and the firstborn of your herd and your flock in
front of YHWH, your God, in the place that He will choose
to tent His name there, so that you’ll learn to fear YHWH,
your God, all the days.

translation.text: And thou shalt eat before the LORD thy God, in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear the LORD thy God always.

verses.english:
And you shall eat the tithe of your grain, your wine, and
your oil and the firstborn of your herd and your flock in
front of YHWH, your God, in the place that He will choose
to tent His name there, so that you’ll learn to fear YHWH,
your God, all the days.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִרְבֶּה מִמְּךָ הַדֶּרֶךְ כִּי לֹא תוּכַל שְׂאֵתוֹ כִּי יִרְחַק מִמְּךָ הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָשׂוּם שְׁמוֹ שָׁם כִּי יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִרְבֶּה מִמְּךָ הַדֶּרֶךְ כִּי לֹא תוּכַל שְׂאֵתוֹ כִּי יִרְחַק מִמְּךָ הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָשׂוּם שְׁמוֹ שָׁם כִּי יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And if the way will be too long for you because you won’t
be able to carry it because the place that YHWH, your God,
will choose to set His name there will be far from you,
because YHWH, your God, will bless you,

translation.text: And if the way be too long for thee, so that thou art not able to carry it; or if the place be too far from thee, which the LORD thy God shall choose to set his name there, when the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:

verses.english:
And if the way will be too long for you because you won’t
be able to carry it because the place that YHWH, your God,
will choose to set His name there will be far from you,
because YHWH, your God, will bless you,

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה בַּכָּסֶף וְצַרְתָּ הַכֶּסֶף בְּיָדְךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּה בַּכָּסֶף וְצַרְתָּ הַכֶּסֶף בְּיָדְךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בּוֹ׃

english.text:
then you shall give it by money. And you shall enclose the
money in your hand and go to the place that YHWH, your
God, will choose.

translation.text: Then shalt thou turn it into money, and bind up the money in thine hand, and shalt go unto the place which the LORD thy God shall choose:

verses.english:
then you shall give it by money. And you shall enclose the
money in your hand and go to the place that YHWH, your
God, will choose.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה הַכֶּסֶף בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תְּאַוֶּה נַפְשְׁךָ בַּבָּקָר וּבַצֹּאן וּבַיַּיִן וּבַשֵּׁכָר וּבְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁאָלְךָ נַפְשֶׁךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ שָּׁם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְשָׂמַחְתָּ אַתָּה וּבֵיתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּה הַכֶּסֶף בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תְּאַוֶּה נַפְשְׁךָ בַּבָּקָר וּבַצֹּאן וּבַיַּיִן וּבַשֵּׁכָר וּבְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁאָלְךָ נַפְשֶׁךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ שָּׁם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְשָׂמַחְתָּ אַתָּה וּבֵיתֶךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall spend the money for anything that your soul
will desire: for herd and for flock and for wine and for
beer and for anything that your soul will ask of you. And
you shall eat there in front of YHWH, your God, and you
shall rejoice, you and your household.

translation.text: And thou shalt bestow that money for whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever thy soul desireth: and thou shalt eat there before the LORD thy God, and thou shalt rejoice, thou, and thine household,

verses.english:
And you shall spend the money for anything that your soul
will desire: for herd and for flock and for wine and for
beer and for anything that your soul will ask of you. And
you shall eat there in front of YHWH, your God, and you
shall rejoice, you and your household.

verses.hebrew: וְהַלֵּוִי אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ לֹא תַעַזְבֶנּוּ כִּי אֵין לוֹ חֵלֶק וְנַחֲלָה עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַלֵּוִי אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ לֹא תַעַזְבֶנּוּ כִּי אֵין לוֹ חֵלֶק וְנַחֲלָה עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
And the Levite who is in your gates: you shall not leave
him, because he doesn’t have a portion and legacy with
you.

translation.text: And the Levite that is within thy gates; thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no part nor inheritance with thee.

verses.english:
And the Levite who is in your gates: you shall not leave
him, because he doesn’t have a portion and legacy with
you.

verses.hebrew: מִקְצֵה שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים תּוֹצִיא אֶת כּל מַעְשַׂר תְּבוּאָתְךָ בַּשָּׁנָה הַהִוא וְהִנַּחְתָּ בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: מִקְצֵה שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים תּוֹצִיא אֶת כּל מַעְשַׂר תְּבוּאָתְךָ בַּשָּׁנָה הַהִוא וְהִנַּחְתָּ בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

english.text:
“At the end of three years you shall bring out all the
tithe of your produce in that year and leave it within
your gates,

translation.text: At the end of three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thine increase the same year, and shalt lay it up within thy gates:

verses.english:
“At the end of three years you shall bring out all the
tithe of your produce in that year and leave it within
your gates,

verses.hebrew: וּבָא הַלֵּוִי כִּי אֵין לוֹ חֵלֶק וְנַחֲלָה עִמָּךְ וְהַגֵּר וְהַיָּתוֹם וְהָאַלְמָנָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ וְאָכְלוּ וְשָׂבֵעוּ לְמַעַן יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדְךָ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וּבָא הַלֵּוִי כִּי אֵין לוֹ חֵלֶק וְנַחֲלָה עִמָּךְ וְהַגֵּר וְהַיָּתוֹם וְהָאַלְמָנָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ וְאָכְלוּ וְשָׂבֵעוּ לְמַעַן יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדְךָ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
and the Levite will come, because he doesn’t have a
portion and legacy with you, and the alien and the orphan
and the widow who are in your gates, and they shall eat
and be full, so that YHWH, your God, will bless you in all
your hand’s work that you’ll do.

translation.text: And the Levite, (because he hath no part nor inheritance with thee,) and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, which are within thy gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hand which thou doest.

verses.english:
and the Levite will come, because he doesn’t have a
portion and legacy with you, and the alien and the orphan
and the widow who are in your gates, and they shall eat
and be full, so that YHWH, your God, will bless you in all
your hand’s work that you’ll do.

verses.hebrew: מִקֵּץ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים תַּעֲשֶׂה שְׁמִטָּה׃

hebrew.text: מִקֵּץ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים תַּעֲשֶׂה שְׁמִטָּה׃

english.text: “At the end of seven years you shall make a remission.

translation.text: At the end of every seven years thou shalt make a release.

verses.english: “At the end of seven years you shall make a remission.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה דְּבַר הַשְּׁמִטָּה שָׁמוֹט כּל בַּעַל מַשֵּׁה יָדוֹ אֲשֶׁר יַשֶּׁה בְּרֵעֵהוּ לֹא יִגֹּשׂ אֶת רֵעֵהוּ וְאֶת אָחִיו כִּי קָרָא שְׁמִטָּה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה דְּבַר הַשְּׁמִטָּה שָׁמוֹט כּל בַּעַל מַשֵּׁה יָדוֹ אֲשֶׁר יַשֶּׁה בְּרֵעֵהוּ לֹא יִגֹּשׂ אֶת רֵעֵהוּ וְאֶת אָחִיו כִּי קָרָא שְׁמִטָּה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And this is the matter of the remission: every holder of a
loan is to remit what he has lent his neighbor. He shall
not demand it of his neighbor and his brother, because a
remission for YHWH has been called.

translation.text: And this is the manner of the release: Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it; he shall not exact it of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called the LORD’s release.

verses.english:
And this is the matter of the remission: every holder of a
loan is to remit what he has lent his neighbor. He shall
not demand it of his neighbor and his brother, because a
remission for YHWH has been called.

verses.hebrew: אֶת הַנּכְרִי תִּגֹּשׂ וַאֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה לְךָ אֶת אָחִיךָ תַּשְׁמֵט יָדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אֶת הַנּכְרִי תִּגֹּשׂ וַאֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה לְךָ אֶת אָחִיךָ תַּשְׁמֵט יָדֶךָ׃

english.text:
You may demand it of a foreigner, but your hand shall
remit whatever of yours is with your brother.

translation.text: Of a foreigner thou mayest exact it again: but that which is thine with thy brother thine hand shall release;

verses.english:
You may demand it of a foreigner, but your hand shall
remit whatever of yours is with your brother.

verses.hebrew: אֶפֶס כִּי לֹא יִהְיֶה בְּךָ אֶבְיוֹן כִּי בָרֵךְ יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: אֶפֶס כִּי לֹא יִהְיֶה בְּךָ אֶבְיוֹן כִּי בָרֵךְ יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
Nonetheless, there won’t be an indigent one among you,
because YHWH will bless you in the land that YHWH, your
God, is giving you as a legacy, to take possession of it—

translation.text: Save when there shall be no poor among you; for the LORD shall greatly bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it:

verses.english:
Nonetheless, there won’t be an indigent one among you,
because YHWH will bless you in the land that YHWH, your
God, is giving you as a legacy, to take possession of it—

verses.hebrew: רַק אִם שָׁמוֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל הַמִּצְוָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: רַק אִם שָׁמוֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל הַמִּצְוָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
only if you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH, your God, to
be watchful to do all of this commandment that I command
you today.

translation.text: Only if thou carefully hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all these commandments which I command thee this day.

verses.english:
only if you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH, your God, to
be watchful to do all of this commandment that I command
you today.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בֵּרַכְךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָךְ וְהַעֲבַטְתָּ גּוֹיִם רַבִּים וְאַתָּה לֹא תַעֲבֹט וּמָשַׁלְתָּ בְּגוֹיִם רַבִּים וּבְךָ לֹא יִמְשֹׁלוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בֵּרַכְךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָךְ וְהַעֲבַטְתָּ גּוֹיִם רַבִּים וְאַתָּה לֹא תַעֲבֹט וּמָשַׁלְתָּ בְּגוֹיִם רַבִּים וּבְךָ לֹא יִמְשֹׁלוּ׃

english.text:
When YHWH, your God, will have blessed you as He spoke to
you, then you’ll lend to many nations, but you won’t
borrow; and you’ll dominate many nations, but they won’t
dominate you.

translation.text: For the LORD thy God blesseth thee, as he promised thee: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over thee.

verses.english:
When YHWH, your God, will have blessed you as He spoke to
you, then you’ll lend to many nations, but you won’t
borrow; and you’ll dominate many nations, but they won’t
dominate you.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִהְיֶה בְךָ אֶבְיוֹן מֵאַחַד אַחֶיךָ בְּאַחַד שְׁעָרֶיךָ בְּאַרְצְךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ לֹא תְאַמֵּץ אֶת לְבָבְךָ וְלֹא תִקְפֹּץ אֶת יָדְךָ מֵאָחִיךָ הָאֶבְיוֹן׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִהְיֶה בְךָ אֶבְיוֹן מֵאַחַד אַחֶיךָ בְּאַחַד שְׁעָרֶיךָ בְּאַרְצְךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ לֹא תְאַמֵּץ אֶת לְבָבְךָ וְלֹא תִקְפֹּץ אֶת יָדְךָ מֵאָחִיךָ הָאֶבְיוֹן׃

english.text:
“When there will be an indigent one among you from one of
your brothers within one of your gates in your land that
YHWH, your God, is giving you, you shall not fortify your
heart and shall not shut your hand from your brother who
is indigent.

translation.text: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not harden thine heart, nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother:

verses.english:
“When there will be an indigent one among you from one of
your brothers within one of your gates in your land that
YHWH, your God, is giving you, you shall not fortify your
heart and shall not shut your hand from your brother who
is indigent.

verses.hebrew: כִּי פָתֹחַ תִּפְתַּח אֶת יָדְךָ לוֹ וְהַעֲבֵט תַּעֲבִיטֶנּוּ דֵּי מַחְסֹרוֹ אֲשֶׁר יֶחְסַר לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי פָתֹחַ תִּפְתַּח אֶת יָדְךָ לוֹ וְהַעֲבֵט תַּעֲבִיטֶנּוּ דֵּי מַחְסֹרוֹ אֲשֶׁר יֶחְסַר לוֹ׃

english.text:
But you shall open your hand to him and shall lend to him,
enough for his shortage that he has.

translation.text: But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need, in that which he wanteth.

verses.english:
But you shall open your hand to him and shall lend to him,
enough for his shortage that he has.

verses.hebrew: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן יִהְיֶה דָבָר עִם לְבָבְךָ בְלִיַּעַל לֵאמֹר קָרְבָה שְׁנַת הַשֶּׁבַע שְׁנַת הַשְּׁמִטָּה וְרָעָה עֵינְךָ בְּאָחִיךָ הָאֶבְיוֹן וְלֹא תִתֵּן לוֹ וְקָרָא עָלֶיךָ אֶל יְהֹוָה וְהָיָה בְךָ חֵטְא׃

hebrew.text: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן יִהְיֶה דָבָר עִם לְבָבְךָ בְלִיַּעַל לֵאמֹר קָרְבָה שְׁנַת הַשֶּׁבַע שְׁנַת הַשְּׁמִטָּה וְרָעָה עֵינְךָ בְּאָחִיךָ הָאֶבְיוֹן וְלֹא תִתֵּן לוֹ וְקָרָא עָלֶיךָ אֶל יְהֹוָה וְהָיָה בְךָ חֵטְא׃

english.text:
Watch yourself in case there will be something
good-for-nothing in your heart, saying, ‘The seventh year,
the remission year, is getting close,’ and your eye will
be bad toward your brother who is indigent, and you won’t
give to him; and he’ll call to YHWH about you, and it will
be a sin in you.

translation.text: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother, and thou givest him nought; and he cry unto the LORD against thee, and it be sin unto thee.

verses.english:
Watch yourself in case there will be something
good-for-nothing in your heart, saying, ‘The seventh year,
the remission year, is getting close,’ and your eye will
be bad toward your brother who is indigent, and you won’t
give to him; and he’ll call to YHWH about you, and it will
be a sin in you.

verses.hebrew: נָתוֹן תִּתֵּן לוֹ וְלֹא יֵרַע לְבָבְךָ בְּתִתְּךָ לוֹ כִּי בִּגְלַל הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל מַעֲשֶׂךָ וּבְכֹל מִשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: נָתוֹן תִּתֵּן לוֹ וְלֹא יֵרַע לְבָבְךָ בְּתִתְּךָ לוֹ כִּי בִּגְלַל הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל מַעֲשֶׂךָ וּבְכֹל מִשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ׃

english.text:
You shall give to him, and your heart shall not be bad
when you’re giving to him, because on account of this
thing YHWH, your God, will bless you in everything you do
and in everything your hand has taken on.

translation.text: Thou shalt surely give him, and thine heart shall not be grieved when thou givest unto him: because that for this thing the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thy works, and in all that thou puttest thine hand unto.

verses.english:
You shall give to him, and your heart shall not be bad
when you’re giving to him, because on account of this
thing YHWH, your God, will bless you in everything you do
and in everything your hand has taken on.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יֶחְדַּל אֶבְיוֹן מִקֶּרֶב הָאָרֶץ עַל כֵּן אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ לֵאמֹר פָּתֹחַ תִּפְתַּח אֶת יָדְךָ לְאָחִיךָ לַעֲנִיֶּךָ וּלְאֶבְיֹנְךָ בְּאַרְצֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא יֶחְדַּל אֶבְיוֹן מִקֶּרֶב הָאָרֶץ עַל כֵּן אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ לֵאמֹר פָּתֹחַ תִּפְתַּח אֶת יָדְךָ לְאָחִיךָ לַעֲנִיֶּךָ וּלְאֶבְיֹנְךָ בְּאַרְצֶךָ׃

english.text:
Because there won’t stop being an indigent in the land. On
account of this I command you, saying: you shall open your
hand to your brother, to your poor, and to your indigent
in your land.

translation.text: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.

verses.english:
Because there won’t stop being an indigent in the land. On
account of this I command you, saying: you shall open your
hand to your brother, to your poor, and to your indigent
in your land.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִמָּכֵר לְךָ אָחִיךָ הָעִבְרִי אוֹ הָעִבְרִיָּה וַעֲבָדְךָ שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִת תְּשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ חפְשִׁי מֵעִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִמָּכֵר לְךָ אָחִיךָ הָעִבְרִי אוֹ הָעִבְרִיָּה וַעֲבָדְךָ שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִת תְּשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ חפְשִׁי מֵעִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
“When your Hebrew brother or sister will be sold to you,
then he shall work for you six years, and in the seventh
year you shall let him go liberated from you.

translation.text: And if thy brother, an Hebrew man, or an Hebrew woman, be sold unto thee, and serve thee six years; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee.

verses.english:
“When your Hebrew brother or sister will be sold to you,
then he shall work for you six years, and in the seventh
year you shall let him go liberated from you.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי תְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ חפְשִׁי מֵעִמָּךְ לֹא תְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ רֵיקָם׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי תְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ חפְשִׁי מֵעִמָּךְ לֹא תְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ רֵיקָם׃

english.text:
And when you let him go liberated from you, you shall not
let him go empty-handed.

translation.text: And when thou sendest him out free from thee, thou shalt not let him go away empty:

verses.english:
And when you let him go liberated from you, you shall not
let him go empty-handed.

verses.hebrew: הַעֲנֵיק תַּעֲנִיק לוֹ מִצֹּאנְךָ וּמִגּרְנְךָ וּמִיִּקְבֶךָ אֲשֶׁר בֵּרַכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תִּתֶּן לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: הַעֲנֵיק תַּעֲנִיק לוֹ מִצֹּאנְךָ וּמִגּרְנְךָ וּמִיִּקְבֶךָ אֲשֶׁר בֵּרַכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תִּתֶּן לוֹ׃

english.text:
You shall provide him from your flock and from your
threshing floor and from your winepress; as YHWH, your
God, has blessed you, you shall give to him.

translation.text: Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy floor, and out of thy winepress: of that wherewith the LORD thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him.

verses.english:
You shall provide him from your flock and from your
threshing floor and from your winepress; as YHWH, your
God, has blessed you, you shall give to him.

verses.hebrew: וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיִּפְדְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עַל כֵּן אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיִּפְדְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עַל כֵּן אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land
of Egypt, and YHWH, your God, redeemed you. On account of
this, I command you this thing today.

translation.text: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt, and the LORD thy God redeemed thee: therefore I command thee this thing to day.

verses.english:
And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land
of Egypt, and YHWH, your God, redeemed you. On account of
this, I command you this thing today.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי יֹאמַר אֵלֶיךָ לֹא אֵצֵא מֵעִמָּךְ כִּי אֲהֵבְךָ וְאֶת בֵּיתֶךָ כִּי טוֹב לוֹ עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי יֹאמַר אֵלֶיךָ לֹא אֵצֵא מֵעִמָּךְ כִּי אֲהֵבְךָ וְאֶת בֵּיתֶךָ כִּי טוֹב לוֹ עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
“And it will be, if he’ll say to you, ‘I won’t go out from
you’ because he loves you and your house, because it is
good for him with you,

translation.text: And it shall be, if he say unto thee, I will not go away from thee; because he loveth thee and thine house, because he is well with thee;

verses.english:
“And it will be, if he’ll say to you, ‘I won’t go out from
you’ because he loves you and your house, because it is
good for him with you,

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת הַמַּרְצֵעַ וְנָתַתָּה בְאזְנוֹ וּבַדֶּלֶת וְהָיָה לְךָ עֶבֶד עוֹלָם וְאַף לַאֲמָתְךָ תַּעֲשֶׂה כֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת הַמַּרְצֵעַ וְנָתַתָּה בְאזְנוֹ וּבַדֶּלֶת וְהָיָה לְךָ עֶבֶד עוֹלָם וְאַף לַאֲמָתְךָ תַּעֲשֶׂה כֵּן׃

english.text:
then you shall take an awl and put it in his ear and in
the door, and he shall be a slave forever to you. And you
shall also do this to your maid.

translation.text: Then thou shalt take an aul, and thrust it through his ear unto the door, and he shall be thy servant for ever. And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise.

verses.english:
then you shall take an awl and put it in his ear and in
the door, and he shall be a slave forever to you. And you
shall also do this to your maid.

verses.hebrew: לֹא יִקְשֶׁה בְעֵינֶךָ בְּשַׁלֵּחֲךָ אֹתוֹ חפְשִׁי מֵעִמָּךְ כִּי מִשְׁנֶה שְׂכַר שָׂכִיר עֲבָדְךָ שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וּבֵרַכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יִקְשֶׁה בְעֵינֶךָ בְּשַׁלֵּחֲךָ אֹתוֹ חפְשִׁי מֵעִמָּךְ כִּי מִשְׁנֶה שְׂכַר שָׂכִיר עֲבָדְךָ שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וּבֵרַכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
It shall not be hard in your eyes when you let him go
liberated from you, because he served you six years at
twice the value of an employee, and YHWH, your God, will
bless you in everything that you’ll do.

translation.text: It shall not seem hard unto thee, when thou sendest him away free from thee; for he hath been worth a double hired servant to thee, in serving thee six years: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all that thou doest.

verses.english:
It shall not be hard in your eyes when you let him go
liberated from you, because he served you six years at
twice the value of an employee, and YHWH, your God, will
bless you in everything that you’ll do.

verses.hebrew: כּל הַבְּכוֹר אֲשֶׁר יִוָּלֵד בִּבְקָרְךָ וּבְצֹאנְךָ הַזָּכָר תַּקְדִּישׁ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תַעֲבֹד בִּבְכֹר שׁוֹרֶךָ וְלֹא תָגֹז בְּכוֹר צֹאנֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: כּל הַבְּכוֹר אֲשֶׁר יִוָּלֵד בִּבְקָרְךָ וּבְצֹאנְךָ הַזָּכָר תַּקְדִּישׁ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תַעֲבֹד בִּבְכֹר שׁוֹרֶךָ וְלֹא תָגֹז בְּכוֹר צֹאנֶךָ׃

english.text:
“Every male firstborn that will be born in your herd and
in your flock you shall consecrate to YHWH, your God. You
shall not work with your ox’s firstborn, and you shall not
shear your sheep’s firstborn.

translation.text: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock, nor shear the firstling of thy sheep.

verses.english:
“Every male firstborn that will be born in your herd and
in your flock you shall consecrate to YHWH, your God. You
shall not work with your ox’s firstborn, and you shall not
shear your sheep’s firstborn.

verses.hebrew: לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תֹאכְלֶנּוּ שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אַתָּה וּבֵיתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תֹאכְלֶנּוּ שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אַתָּה וּבֵיתֶךָ׃

english.text:
You shall eat it in front of YHWH, your God, year by year
in the place that YHWH will choose—you and your household.

translation.text: Thou shalt eat it before the LORD thy God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, thou and thy household.

verses.english:
You shall eat it in front of YHWH, your God, year by year
in the place that YHWH will choose—you and your household.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִהְיֶה בוֹ מוּם פִּסֵּחַ אוֹ עִוֵּר כֹּל מוּם רָע לֹא תִזְבָּחֶנּוּ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִהְיֶה בוֹ מוּם פִּסֵּחַ אוֹ עִוֵּר כֹּל מוּם רָע לֹא תִזְבָּחֶנּוּ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And if there will be an injury in it—crippled or blind,
any bad injury—you shall not sacrifice it to YHWH, your
God.
