bough afterward. It shall be the alien’s and the orphan’s
and the widow’s.

verses.hebrew: כִּי תִבְצֹר כַּרְמְךָ לֹא תְעוֹלֵל אַחֲרֶיךָ לַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תִבְצֹר כַּרְמְךָ לֹא תְעוֹלֵל אַחֲרֶיךָ לַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
When you’ll cut off grapes of your vineyard, you shall not
glean afterward. It shall be the alien’s and the orphan’s
and the widow’s.

translation.text: When thou gatherest the grapes of thy vineyard, thou shalt not glean it afterward: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

verses.english:
When you’ll cut off grapes of your vineyard, you shall not
glean afterward. It shall be the alien’s and the orphan’s
and the widow’s.

verses.hebrew: וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם עַל כֵּן אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם עַל כֵּן אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land
of Egypt. On account of this I command you to do this
thing.

translation.text: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt: therefore I command thee to do this thing.

verses.english:
And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land
of Egypt. On account of this I command you to do this
thing.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִהְיֶה רִיב בֵּין אֲנָשִׁים וְנִגְּשׁוּ אֶל הַמִּשְׁפָּט וּשְׁפָטוּם וְהִצְדִּיקוּ אֶת הַצַּדִּיק וְהִרְשִׁיעוּ אֶת הָרָשָׁע׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִהְיֶה רִיב בֵּין אֲנָשִׁים וְנִגְּשׁוּ אֶל הַמִּשְׁפָּט וּשְׁפָטוּם וְהִצְדִּיקוּ אֶת הַצַּדִּיק וְהִרְשִׁיעוּ אֶת הָרָשָׁע׃

english.text:
“When there will be a dispute between people, and they
will go over to judgment, and they will judge them, then
they shall find in favor of the one who is in the right
and find against the one who is in the wrong.

translation.text: If there be a controversy between men, and they come unto judgment, that the judges may judge them; then they shall justify the righteous, and condemn the wicked.

verses.english:
“When there will be a dispute between people, and they
will go over to judgment, and they will judge them, then
they shall find in favor of the one who is in the right
and find against the one who is in the wrong.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם בִּן הַכּוֹת הָרָשָׁע וְהִפִּילוֹ הַשֹּׁפֵט וְהִכָּהוּ לְפָנָיו כְּדֵי רִשְׁעָתוֹ בְּמִסְפָּר׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם בִּן הַכּוֹת הָרָשָׁע וְהִפִּילוֹ הַשֹּׁפֵט וְהִכָּהוּ לְפָנָיו כְּדֵי רִשְׁעָתוֹ בְּמִסְפָּר׃

english.text:
And it will be, if the one who is in the wrong is to be
struck, that the judge shall have him laid down and have
him struck in front of him, according to his wrongdoing in
number.

translation.text: And it shall be, if the wicked man be worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down, and to be beaten before his face, according to his fault, by a certain number.

verses.english:
And it will be, if the one who is in the wrong is to be
struck, that the judge shall have him laid down and have
him struck in front of him, according to his wrongdoing in
number.

verses.hebrew: אַרְבָּעִים יַכֶּנּוּ לֹא יֹסִיף פֶּן יֹסִיף לְהַכֹּתוֹ עַל אֵלֶּה מַכָּה רַבָּה וְנִקְלָה אָחִיךָ לְעֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: אַרְבָּעִים יַכֶּנּוּ לֹא יֹסִיף פֶּן יֹסִיף לְהַכֹּתוֹ עַל אֵלֶּה מַכָּה רַבָּה וְנִקְלָה אָחִיךָ לְעֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
They shall strike him forty times. He shall not add, in
case he would add onto these to strike him a great amount,
and your brother would be treated as inconsequential
before your eyes.

translation.text: Forty stripes he may give him, and not exceed: lest, if he should exceed, and beat him above these with many stripes, then thy brother should seem vile unto thee.

verses.english:
They shall strike him forty times. He shall not add, in
case he would add onto these to strike him a great amount,
and your brother would be treated as inconsequential
before your eyes.

verses.hebrew: לֹא תַחְסֹם שׁוֹר בְּדִישׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא תַחְסֹם שׁוֹר בְּדִישׁוֹ׃

english.text: “You shall not muzzle an ox when it is threshing.

translation.text: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn.

verses.english: “You shall not muzzle an ox when it is threshing.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יֵשְׁבוּ אַחִים יַחְדָּו וּמֵת אַחַד מֵהֶם וּבֵן אֵין לוֹ לֹא תִהְיֶה אֵשֶׁת הַמֵּת הַחוּצָה לְאִישׁ זָר יְבָמָהּ יָבֹא עָלֶיהָ וּלְקָחָהּ לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וְיִבְּמָהּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יֵשְׁבוּ אַחִים יַחְדָּו וּמֵת אַחַד מֵהֶם וּבֵן אֵין לוֹ לֹא תִהְיֶה אֵשֶׁת הַמֵּת הַחוּצָה לְאִישׁ זָר יְבָמָהּ יָבֹא עָלֶיהָ וּלְקָחָהּ לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וְיִבְּמָהּ׃

english.text:
“When brothers will live together, and one of them will
die, and he had no son, the dead man’s wife shall not be
an unrelated man’s, outside. Her brother-in-law shall come
to her and take her to him for a wife and shall do the
brother-in-law’s duty for her.

translation.text: If brethren dwell together, and one of them die, and have no child, the wife of the dead shall not marry without unto a stranger: her husband’s brother shall go in unto her, and take her to him to wife, and perform the duty of an husband’s brother unto her.

verses.english:
“When brothers will live together, and one of them will
die, and he had no son, the dead man’s wife shall not be
an unrelated man’s, outside. Her brother-in-law shall come
to her and take her to him for a wife and shall do the
brother-in-law’s duty for her.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַבְּכוֹר אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵד יָקוּם עַל שֵׁם אָחִיו הַמֵּת וְלֹא יִמָּחֶה שְׁמוֹ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הַבְּכוֹר אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵד יָקוּם עַל שֵׁם אָחִיו הַמֵּת וְלֹא יִמָּחֶה שְׁמוֹ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the firstborn to whom she will give birth shall be
signified by the name of his brother who died, so his name
will not be wiped out from Israel.

translation.text: And it shall be, that the firstborn which she beareth shall succeed in the name of his brother which is dead, that his name be not put out of Israel.

verses.english:
And the firstborn to whom she will give birth shall be
signified by the name of his brother who died, so his name
will not be wiped out from Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא יַחְפֹּץ הָאִישׁ לָקַחַת אֶת יְבִמְתּוֹ וְעָלְתָה יְבִמְתּוֹ הַשַּׁעְרָה אֶל הַזְּקֵנִים וְאָמְרָה מֵאֵן יְבָמִי לְהָקִים לְאָחִיו שֵׁם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא אָבָה יַבְּמִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם לֹא יַחְפֹּץ הָאִישׁ לָקַחַת אֶת יְבִמְתּוֹ וְעָלְתָה יְבִמְתּוֹ הַשַּׁעְרָה אֶל הַזְּקֵנִים וְאָמְרָה מֵאֵן יְבָמִי לְהָקִים לְאָחִיו שֵׁם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא אָבָה יַבְּמִי׃

english.text:
And if the man won’t desire to take his sister-in-law,
then his sister-in-law shall go up at the gate to the
elders and say, ‘My brother-in-law refuses to preserve a
name for his brother in Israel. He was not willing to do
the brother-in-law’s duty for me.’

translation.text: And if the man like not to take his brother’s wife, then let his brother’s wife go up to the gate unto the elders, and say, My husband’s brother refuseth to raise up unto his brother a name in Israel, he will not perform the duty of my husband’s brother.

verses.english:
And if the man won’t desire to take his sister-in-law,
then his sister-in-law shall go up at the gate to the
elders and say, ‘My brother-in-law refuses to preserve a
name for his brother in Israel. He was not willing to do
the brother-in-law’s duty for me.’

verses.hebrew: וְקָרְאוּ לוֹ זִקְנֵי עִירוֹ וְדִבְּרוּ אֵלָיו וְעָמַד וְאָמַר לֹא חָפַצְתִּי לְקַחְתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְקָרְאוּ לוֹ זִקְנֵי עִירוֹ וְדִבְּרוּ אֵלָיו וְעָמַד וְאָמַר לֹא חָפַצְתִּי לְקַחְתָּהּ׃

english.text:
And his city’s elders shall call him and speak to him, and
if he’ll stand and say, ‘I don’t desire to take her,’

translation.text: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak unto him: and if he stand to it, and say, I like not to take her;

verses.english:
And his city’s elders shall call him and speak to him, and
if he’ll stand and say, ‘I don’t desire to take her,’

verses.hebrew: וְנִגְּשָׁה יְבִמְתּוֹ אֵלָיו לְעֵינֵי הַזְּקֵנִים וְחָלְצָה נַעֲלוֹ מֵעַל רַגְלוֹ וְיָרְקָה בְּפָנָיו וְעָנְתָה וְאָמְרָה כָּכָה יֵעָשֶׂה לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִבְנֶה אֶת בֵּית אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וְנִגְּשָׁה יְבִמְתּוֹ אֵלָיו לְעֵינֵי הַזְּקֵנִים וְחָלְצָה נַעֲלוֹ מֵעַל רַגְלוֹ וְיָרְקָה בְּפָנָיו וְעָנְתָה וְאָמְרָה כָּכָה יֵעָשֶׂה לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִבְנֶה אֶת בֵּית אָחִיו׃

english.text:
then his sister-in-law shall go over to him before the
elders’ eyes and take off his shoe from his foot and spit
in front of him. And she shall answer and say, ‘Thus shall
be done to the man who will not build up his brother’s
house.’

translation.text: Then shall his brother’s wife come unto him in the presence of the elders, and loose his shoe from off his foot, and spit in his face, and shall answer and say, So shall it be done unto that man that will not build up his brother’s house.

verses.english:
then his sister-in-law shall go over to him before the
elders’ eyes and take off his shoe from his foot and spit
in front of him. And she shall answer and say, ‘Thus shall
be done to the man who will not build up his brother’s
house.’

verses.hebrew: וְנִקְרָא שְׁמוֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל בֵּית חֲלוּץ הַנָּעַל׃

hebrew.text: וְנִקְרָא שְׁמוֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל בֵּית חֲלוּץ הַנָּעַל׃

english.text:
And his name shall be called in Israel ‘the house of the
one whose shoe was taken off.’

translation.text: And his name shall be called in Israel, The house of him that hath his shoe loosed.

verses.english:
And his name shall be called in Israel ‘the house of the
one whose shoe was taken off.’

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִנָּצוּ אֲנָשִׁים יַחְדָּו אִישׁ וְאָחִיו וְקָרְבָה אֵשֶׁת הָאֶחָד לְהַצִּיל אֶת אִישָׁהּ מִיַּד מַכֵּהוּ וְשָׁלְחָה יָדָהּ וְהֶחֱזִיקָה בִּמְבֻשָׁיו׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִנָּצוּ אֲנָשִׁים יַחְדָּו אִישׁ וְאָחִיו וְקָרְבָה אֵשֶׁת הָאֶחָד לְהַצִּיל אֶת אִישָׁהּ מִיַּד מַכֵּהוּ וְשָׁלְחָה יָדָהּ וְהֶחֱזִיקָה בִּמְבֻשָׁיו׃

english.text:
“If people will fight together, a man and his brother, and
the wife of one will come close to rescue her husband from
the hand of the one striking him, and she’ll put out her
hand and take hold of his private parts,

translation.text: When men strive together one with another, and the wife of the one draweth near for to deliver her husband out of the hand of him that smiteth him, and putteth forth her hand, and taketh him by the secrets:

verses.english:
“If people will fight together, a man and his brother, and
the wife of one will come close to rescue her husband from
the hand of the one striking him, and she’ll put out her
hand and take hold of his private parts,

verses.hebrew: וְקַצֹּתָה אֶת כַּפָּהּ לֹא תָחוֹס עֵינֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְקַצֹּתָה אֶת כַּפָּהּ לֹא תָחוֹס עֵינֶךָ׃

english.text: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall not pity.

translation.text: Then thou shalt cut off her hand, thine eye shall not pity her.

verses.english: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall not pity.

verses.hebrew: לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ בְּכִיסְךָ אֶבֶן וָאָבֶן גְּדוֹלָה וּקְטַנָּה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ בְּכִיסְךָ אֶבֶן וָאָבֶן גְּדוֹלָה וּקְטַנָּה׃

english.text:
“You shall not have in your bag multiple stones, a big and
a small.

translation.text: Thou shalt not have in thy bag divers weights, a great and a small.

verses.english:
“You shall not have in your bag multiple stones, a big and
a small.

verses.hebrew: לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ בְּבֵיתְךָ אֵיפָה וְאֵיפָה גְּדוֹלָה וּקְטַנָּה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ בְּבֵיתְךָ אֵיפָה וְאֵיפָה גְּדוֹלָה וּקְטַנָּה׃

english.text:
You shall not have in your house multiple ephah measures,
a big and a small.

translation.text: Thou shalt not have in thine house divers measures, a great and a small.

verses.english:
You shall not have in your house multiple ephah measures,
a big and a small.

verses.hebrew: אֶבֶן שְׁלֵמָה וָצֶדֶק יִהְיֶה לָּךְ אֵיפָה שְׁלֵמָה וָצֶדֶק יִהְיֶה לָּךְ לְמַעַן יַאֲרִיכוּ יָמֶיךָ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: אֶבֶן שְׁלֵמָה וָצֶדֶק יִהְיֶה לָּךְ אֵיפָה שְׁלֵמָה וָצֶדֶק יִהְיֶה לָּךְ לְמַעַן יַאֲרִיכוּ יָמֶיךָ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

english.text:
You shall have a whole and honest stone; you shall have a
whole and honest ephah measure, so your days will be
extended on the land that YHWH, your God, is giving you.

translation.text: But thou shalt have a perfect and just weight, a perfect and just measure shalt thou have: that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

verses.english:
You shall have a whole and honest stone; you shall have a
whole and honest ephah measure, so your days will be
extended on the land that YHWH, your God, is giving you.

verses.hebrew: כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כּל עֹשֵׂה אֵלֶּה כֹּל עֹשֵׂה עָוֶל׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כּל עֹשֵׂה אֵלֶּה כֹּל עֹשֵׂה עָוֶל׃

english.text:
Because everyone who does these is an offensive thing of
YHWH, everyone who does injustice.

translation.text: For all that do such things, and all that do unrighteously, are an abomination unto the LORD thy God.

verses.english:
Because everyone who does these is an offensive thing of
YHWH, everyone who does injustice.

verses.hebrew: זָכוֹר אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְךָ עֲמָלֵק בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּצֵאתְכֶם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: זָכוֹר אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְךָ עֲמָלֵק בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּצֵאתְכֶם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
“Remember what Amalek did to you on the way when you came
out from Egypt,

translation.text: Remember what Amalek did unto thee by the way, when ye were come forth out of Egypt;

verses.english:
“Remember what Amalek did to you on the way when you came
out from Egypt,

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר קָרְךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ וַיְזַנֵּב בְּךָ כּל הַנֶּחֱשָׁלִים אַחֲרֶיךָ וְאַתָּה עָיֵף וְיָגֵעַ וְלֹא יָרֵא אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר קָרְךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ וַיְזַנֵּב בְּךָ כּל הַנֶּחֱשָׁלִים אַחֲרֶיךָ וְאַתָּה עָיֵף וְיָגֵעַ וְלֹא יָרֵא אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
how he fell upon you on the way and cut off all the weak
ones at your rear, when you were exhausted and tired, and
he didn’t fear God.

translation.text: How he met thee by the way, and smote the hindmost of thee, even all that were feeble behind thee, when thou wast faint and weary; and he feared not God.

verses.english:
how he fell upon you on the way and cut off all the weak
ones at your rear, when you were exhausted and tired, and
he didn’t fear God.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בְּהָנִיחַ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְךָ מִכּל אֹיְבֶיךָ מִסָּבִיב בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ תִּמְחֶה אֶת זֵכֶר עֲמָלֵק מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם לֹא תִּשְׁכָּח׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בְּהָנִיחַ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְךָ מִכּל אֹיְבֶיךָ מִסָּבִיב בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ תִּמְחֶה אֶת זֵכֶר עֲמָלֵק מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם לֹא תִּשְׁכָּח׃

english.text:
So it shall be, when YHWH, your God, will give you rest
from all your enemies all around in the land that YHWH,
your God, is giving you as a legacy to take possession of
it, you shall wipe out the memory of Amalek from under the
skies. You shall not forget.

translation.text: Therefore it shall be, when the LORD thy God hath given thee rest from all thine enemies round about, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it, that thou shalt blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven; thou shalt not forget it.

verses.english:
So it shall be, when YHWH, your God, will give you rest
from all your enemies all around in the land that YHWH,
your God, is giving you as a legacy to take possession of
it, you shall wipe out the memory of Amalek from under the
skies. You shall not forget.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי תָבוֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה וִירִשְׁתָּהּ וְיָשַׁבְתָּ בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי תָבוֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ נַחֲלָה וִירִשְׁתָּהּ וְיָשַׁבְתָּ בָּהּ׃

english.text:
“And it shall be, when you’ll come to
the land that YHWH, your God, is giving you as a legacy,
and you’ll take possession of it and live in it,

translation.text: And it shall be, when thou art come in unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance, and possessest it, and dwellest therein;

verses.english:
“And it shall be, when you’ll come to
the land that YHWH, your God, is giving you as a legacy,
and you’ll take possession of it and live in it,

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ מֵרֵאשִׁית כּל פְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר תָּבִיא מֵאַרְצְךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ וְשַׂמְתָּ בַטֶּנֶא וְהָלַכְתָּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְשַׁכֵּן שְׁמוֹ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ מֵרֵאשִׁית כּל פְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר תָּבִיא מֵאַרְצְךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ וְשַׂמְתָּ בַטֶּנֶא וְהָלַכְתָּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְשַׁכֵּן שְׁמוֹ שָׁם׃

english.text:
that you shall take from the first of all the land’s fruit
that you’ll bring in from your land that YHWH, your God,
is giving you, and set it in a basket and go to the place
that YHWH, your God, will choose to tent His name there.

translation.text: That thou shalt take of the first of all the fruit of the earth, which thou shalt bring of thy land that the LORD thy God giveth thee, and shalt put it in a basket, and shalt go unto the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to place his name there.

verses.english:
that you shall take from the first of all the land’s fruit
that you’ll bring in from your land that YHWH, your God,
is giving you, and set it in a basket and go to the place
that YHWH, your God, will choose to tent His name there.

verses.hebrew: וּבָאתָ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו הִגַּדְתִּי הַיּוֹם לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי בָאתִי אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ לָתֶת לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבָאתָ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו הִגַּדְתִּי הַיּוֹם לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי בָאתִי אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ לָתֶת לָנוּ׃

english.text:
And you shall come to the priest who will be in those days
and say to him: I declare today to YHWH, your God, that
I’ve come to the land that YHWH swore to our fathers to
give to us.

translation.text: And thou shalt go unto the priest that shall be in those days, and say unto him, I profess this day unto the LORD thy God, that I am come unto the country which the LORD sware unto our fathers for to give us.

verses.english:
And you shall come to the priest who will be in those days
and say to him: I declare today to YHWH, your God, that
I’ve come to the land that YHWH swore to our fathers to
give to us.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן הַטֶּנֶא מִיָּדֶךָ וְהִנִּיחוֹ לִפְנֵי מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן הַטֶּנֶא מִיָּדֶךָ וְהִנִּיחוֹ לִפְנֵי מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And the priest shall take the basket from your hand and
set it down in front of the altar of YHWH, your God.

translation.text: And the priest shall take the basket out of thine hand, and set it down before the altar of the LORD thy God.

verses.english:
And the priest shall take the basket from your hand and
set it down in front of the altar of YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: וְעָנִיתָ וְאָמַרְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲרַמִּי אֹבֵד אָבִי וַיֵּרֶד מִצְרַיְמָה וַיָּגר שָׁם בִּמְתֵי מְעָט וַיְהִי שָׁם לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל עָצוּם וָרָב׃

hebrew.text: וְעָנִיתָ וְאָמַרְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲרַמִּי אֹבֵד אָבִי וַיֵּרֶד מִצְרַיְמָה וַיָּגר שָׁם בִּמְתֵי מְעָט וַיְהִי שָׁם לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל עָצוּם וָרָב׃

english.text:
And you shall answer and say in front of YHWH, your God:
My father was a perishing Aramean, so he went down to
Egypt and resided there with few persons and became a big,
powerful, and numerous nation there.

translation.text: And thou shalt speak and say before the LORD thy God, A Syrian ready to perish was my father, and he went down into Egypt, and sojourned there with a few, and became there a nation, great, mighty, and populous:

verses.english:
And you shall answer and say in front of YHWH, your God:
My father was a perishing Aramean, so he went down to
Egypt and resided there with few persons and became a big,
powerful, and numerous nation there.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרֵעוּ אֹתָנוּ הַמִּצְרִים וַיְעַנּוּנוּ וַיִּתְּנוּ עָלֵינוּ עֲבֹדָה קָשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּרֵעוּ אֹתָנוּ הַמִּצְרִים וַיְעַנּוּנוּ וַיִּתְּנוּ עָלֵינוּ עֲבֹדָה קָשָׁה׃

english.text:
And the Egyptians were bad to us and degraded us and
imposed hard work on us.

translation.text: And the Egyptians evil entreated us, and afflicted us, and laid upon us hard bondage:

verses.english:
And the Egyptians were bad to us and degraded us and
imposed hard work on us.

verses.hebrew: וַנִּצְעַק אֶל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵינוּ וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֶת קֹלֵנוּ וַיַּרְא אֶת ענְיֵנוּ וְאֶת עֲמָלֵנוּ וְאֶת לַחֲצֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַנִּצְעַק אֶל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵינוּ וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֶת קֹלֵנוּ וַיַּרְא אֶת ענְיֵנוּ וְאֶת עֲמָלֵנוּ וְאֶת לַחֲצֵנוּ׃

english.text:
And we cried out to YHWH, our fathers’ God, and YHWH
listened to our voice and saw our degradation and our
trouble and our oppression.

translation.text: And when we cried unto the LORD God of our fathers, the LORD heard our voice, and looked on our affliction, and our labour, and our oppression:

verses.english:
And we cried out to YHWH, our fathers’ God, and YHWH
listened to our voice and saw our degradation and our
trouble and our oppression.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִאֵנוּ יְהֹוָה מִמִּצְרַיִם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרֹעַ נְטוּיָה וּבְמֹרָא גָּדֹל וּבְאֹתוֹת וּבְמֹפְתִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹצִאֵנוּ יְהֹוָה מִמִּצְרַיִם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרֹעַ נְטוּיָה וּבְמֹרָא גָּדֹל וּבְאֹתוֹת וּבְמֹפְתִים׃

english.text:
And YHWH brought us out from Egypt with a strong hand and
an outstretched arm and with great fear and with signs and
with wonders.

translation.text: And the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with great terribleness, and with signs, and with wonders:

verses.english:
And YHWH brought us out from Egypt with a strong hand and
an outstretched arm and with great fear and with signs and
with wonders.

verses.hebrew: וַיְבִאֵנוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וַיִּתֶּן לָנוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבִאֵנוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וַיִּתֶּן לָנוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

english.text:
And He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a
land flowing with milk and honey.

translation.text: And he hath brought us into this place, and hath given us this land, even a land that floweth with milk and honey.

verses.english:
And He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a
land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הֵבֵאתִי אֶת רֵאשִׁית פְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה לִּי יְהֹוָה וְהִנַּחְתּוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתָ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הֵבֵאתִי אֶת רֵאשִׁית פְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה לִּי יְהֹוָה וְהִנַּחְתּוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתָ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And now, here, I’ve brought the first of the fruit of the
land that you’ve given me, YHWH. And you shall set it down
in front of YHWH, your God, and bow in front of YHWH, your
God.

translation.text: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land, which thou, O LORD, hast given me. And thou shalt set it before the LORD thy God, and worship before the LORD thy God:

verses.english:
And now, here, I’ve brought the first of the fruit of the
land that you’ve given me, YHWH. And you shall set it down
in front of YHWH, your God, and bow in front of YHWH, your
God.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ בְכל הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּלְבֵיתֶךָ אַתָּה וְהַלֵּוִי וְהַגֵּר אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ בְכל הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּלְבֵיתֶךָ אַתָּה וְהַלֵּוִי וְהַגֵּר אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall rejoice in all the good that YHWH, your God,
has given to you and to your house, you and the Levite and
the alien who is among you.

translation.text: And thou shalt rejoice in every good thing which the LORD thy God hath given unto thee, and unto thine house, thou, and the Levite, and the stranger that is among you.

verses.english:
And you shall rejoice in all the good that YHWH, your God,
has given to you and to your house, you and the Levite and
the alien who is among you.

verses.hebrew: כִּי תְכַלֶּה לַעְשֵׂר אֶת כּל מַעְשַׂר תְּבוּאָתְךָ בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁלִישִׁת שְׁנַת הַמַּעֲשֵׂר וְנָתַתָּה לַלֵּוִי לַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה וְאָכְלוּ בִשְׁעָרֶיךָ וְשָׂבֵעוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תְכַלֶּה לַעְשֵׂר אֶת כּל מַעְשַׂר תְּבוּאָתְךָ בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁלִישִׁת שְׁנַת הַמַּעֲשֵׂר וְנָתַתָּה לַלֵּוִי לַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה וְאָכְלוּ בִשְׁעָרֶיךָ וְשָׂבֵעוּ׃

english.text:
“When you’ll finish doing all the tithe of your produce in
the third year, the year of the tithe, and you’ll give it
to the Levite, to the alien, to the orphan, and to the
widow, and they’ll eat in your gates and be full,

translation.text: When thou hast made an end of tithing all the tithes of thine increase the third year, which is the year of tithing, and hast given it unto the Levite, the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, that they may eat within thy gates, and be filled;

verses.english:
“When you’ll finish doing all the tithe of your produce in
the third year, the year of the tithe, and you’ll give it
to the Levite, to the alien, to the orphan, and to the
widow, and they’ll eat in your gates and be full,

verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בִּעַרְתִּי הַקֹּדֶשׁ מִן הַבַּיִת וְגַם נְתַתִּיו לַלֵּוִי וְלַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה כְּכל מִצְוָתְךָ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָנִי לֹא עָבַרְתִּי מִמִּצְוֺתֶיךָ וְלֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בִּעַרְתִּי הַקֹּדֶשׁ מִן הַבַּיִת וְגַם נְתַתִּיו לַלֵּוִי וְלַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה כְּכל מִצְוָתְךָ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָנִי לֹא עָבַרְתִּי מִמִּצְוֺתֶיךָ וְלֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃

english.text:
then you shall say in front of YHWH, your God: I have
taken away what was holy from the house, and I have also
given it to the Levite and to the alien, to the orphan,
and to the widow according to all your commandment that
you’ve commanded me. I have not violated and have not
forgotten any of your commandments.

translation.text: Then thou shalt say before the LORD thy God, I have brought away the hallowed things out of mine house, and also have given them unto the Levite, and unto the stranger, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all thy commandments which thou hast commanded me: I have not transgressed thy commandments, neither have I forgotten them.

verses.english:
then you shall say in front of YHWH, your God: I have
taken away what was holy from the house, and I have also
given it to the Levite and to the alien, to the orphan,
and to the widow according to all your commandment that
you’ve commanded me. I have not violated and have not
forgotten any of your commandments.

verses.hebrew: לֹא אָכַלְתִּי בְאֹנִי מִמֶּנּוּ וְלֹא בִעַרְתִּי מִמֶּנּוּ בְּטָמֵא וְלֹא נָתַתִּי מִמֶּנּוּ לְמֵת שָׁמַעְתִּי בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי עָשִׂיתִי כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָנִי׃

hebrew.text: לֹא אָכַלְתִּי בְאֹנִי מִמֶּנּוּ וְלֹא בִעַרְתִּי מִמֶּנּוּ בְּטָמֵא וְלֹא נָתַתִּי מִמֶּנּוּ לְמֵת שָׁמַעְתִּי בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי עָשִׂיתִי כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָנִי׃

english.text:
I have not eaten any of it while I was mourning, and I
have not taken any of it away while impure, and I have not
given any of it to the dead. I have listened to the voice
of YHWH, my God. I have done according to everything that
you commanded me.

translation.text: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning, neither have I taken away ought thereof for any unclean use, nor given ought thereof for the dead: but I have hearkened to the voice of the LORD my God, and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me.

verses.english:
I have not eaten any of it while I was mourning, and I
have not taken any of it away while impure, and I have not
given any of it to the dead. I have listened to the voice
of YHWH, my God. I have done according to everything that
you commanded me.

verses.hebrew: הַשְׁקִיפָה מִמְּעוֹן קדְשְׁךָ מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם וּבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמְּךָ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֵת הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה לָנוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: הַשְׁקִיפָה מִמְּעוֹן קדְשְׁךָ מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם וּבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמְּךָ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֵת הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה לָנוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

english.text:
Gaze from your holy abode, from the skies, and bless your
people, Israel, and the land that you’ve given us as you
swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.

translation.text: Look down from thy holy habitation, from heaven, and bless thy people Israel, and the land which thou hast given us, as thou swarest unto our fathers, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

verses.english:
Gaze from your holy abode, from the skies, and bless your
people, Israel, and the land that you’ve given us as you
swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.hebrew: הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מְצַוְּךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת הַחֻקִּים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים וְשָׁמַרְתָּ וְעָשִׂיתָ אוֹתָם בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מְצַוְּךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת הַחֻקִּים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים וְשָׁמַרְתָּ וְעָשִׂיתָ אוֹתָם בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
“This day YHWH, your God, commands you to do these laws
and judgments. And you shall be watchful and do them with
all your heart and all your soul.

translation.text: This day the LORD thy God hath commanded thee to do these statutes and judgments: thou shalt therefore keep and do them with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.

verses.english:
“This day YHWH, your God, commands you to do these laws
and judgments. And you shall be watchful and do them with
all your heart and all your soul.

verses.hebrew: אֶת יְהֹוָה הֶאֱמַרְתָּ הַיּוֹם לִהְיוֹת לְךָ לֵאלֹהִים וְלָלֶכֶת בִּדְרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר חֻקָּיו וּמִצְוֺתָיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וְלִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקֹלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אֶת יְהֹוָה הֶאֱמַרְתָּ הַיּוֹם לִהְיוֹת לְךָ לֵאלֹהִים וְלָלֶכֶת בִּדְרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר חֻקָּיו וּמִצְוֺתָיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וְלִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקֹלוֹ׃

english.text:
You have proclaimed YHWH today to be God to you, and to go
in His ways and to observe His laws and His commandments
and His judgments and to listen to His voice.

translation.text: Thou hast avouched the LORD this day to be thy God, and to walk in his ways, and to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and to hearken unto his voice:

verses.english:
You have proclaimed YHWH today to be God to you, and to go
in His ways and to observe His laws and His commandments
and His judgments and to listen to His voice.

verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה הֶאֱמִירְךָ הַיּוֹם לִהְיוֹת לוֹ לְעַם סְגֻלָּה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָךְ וְלִשְׁמֹר כּל מִצְוֺתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה הֶאֱמִירְךָ הַיּוֹם לִהְיוֹת לוֹ לְעַם סְגֻלָּה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָךְ וְלִשְׁמֹר כּל מִצְוֺתָיו׃

english.text:
And YHWH proclaimed you today to be a treasured people to
Him as He spoke to you—and to observe all His
commandments—

translation.text: And the LORD hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people, as he hath promised thee, and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments;

verses.english:
And YHWH proclaimed you today to be a treasured people to
Him as He spoke to you—and to observe all His
commandments—

verses.hebrew: וּלְתִתְּךָ עֶלְיוֹן עַל כּל הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִתְהִלָּה וּלְשֵׁם וּלְתִפְאָרֶת וְלִהְיֹתְךָ עַם קָדֹשׁ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וּלְתִתְּךָ עֶלְיוֹן עַל כּל הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִתְהִלָּה וּלְשֵׁם וּלְתִפְאָרֶת וְלִהְיֹתְךָ עַם קָדֹשׁ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃

english.text:
and to set you high above all the nations that He has made
in praise and name and beauty, and for you to be a holy
people to YHWH, your God, as He spoke.”

translation.text: And to make thee high above all nations which he hath made, in praise, and in name, and in honour; and that thou mayest be an holy people unto the LORD thy God, as he hath spoken.

verses.english:
and to set you high above all the nations that He has made
in praise and name and beauty, and for you to be a holy
people to YHWH, your God, as He spoke.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הָעָם לֵאמֹר שָׁמֹר אֶת כּל הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הָעָם לֵאמֹר שָׁמֹר אֶת כּל הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And Moses and Israel’s elders commanded the people,
saying, “Observe all the commandment that I command you
today.

translation.text: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, Keep all the commandments which I command you this day.

verses.english:
And Moses and Israel’s elders commanded the people,
saying, “Observe all the commandment that I command you
today.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר תַּעַבְרוּ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ וַהֲקֵמֹתָ לְךָ אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת וְשַׂדְתָּ אֹתָם בַּשִּׂיד׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר תַּעַבְרוּ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ וַהֲקֵמֹתָ לְךָ אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת וְשַׂדְתָּ אֹתָם בַּשִּׂיד׃

english.text:
And it shall be, in the day that you’ll cross the Jordan
to the land that YHWH, your God, is giving you, that you
shall set up big stones and cover them with plaster.

translation.text: And it shall be on the day when ye shall pass over Jordan unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, that thou shalt set thee up great stones, and plaister them with plaister:

verses.english:
And it shall be, in the day that you’ll cross the Jordan
to the land that YHWH, your God, is giving you, that you
shall set up big stones and cover them with plaster.

verses.hebrew: וְכָתַבְתָּ עֲלֵיהֶן אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת בְּעבְרֶךָ לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר תָּבֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֶיךָ לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְכָתַבְתָּ עֲלֵיהֶן אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת בְּעבְרֶךָ לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר תָּבֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֶיךָ לָךְ׃

english.text:
And you shall write on them all the words of this
instruction when you cross so that you’ll come to the land
that YHWH, your God, is giving you, a land flowing with
milk and honey, as YHWH, your fathers’ God, spoke to you.

translation.text: And thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law, when thou art passed over, that thou mayest go in unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, a land that floweth with milk and honey; as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee.

verses.english:
And you shall write on them all the words of this
instruction when you cross so that you’ll come to the land
that YHWH, your God, is giving you, a land flowing with
milk and honey, as YHWH, your fathers’ God, spoke to you.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בְּעבְרְכֶם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן תָּקִימוּ אֶת הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם בְּהַר עֵיבָל וְשַׂדְתָּ אוֹתָם בַּשִּׂיד׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בְּעבְרְכֶם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן תָּקִימוּ אֶת הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם בְּהַר עֵיבָל וְשַׂדְתָּ אוֹתָם בַּשִּׂיד׃

english.text:
And it shall be, when you cross the Jordan, that you shall
set up these stones that I command you today in Mount Ebal
and cover them with plaster.

translation.text: Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan, that ye shall set up these stones, which I command you this day, in mount Ebal, and thou shalt plaister them with plaister.

verses.english:
And it shall be, when you cross the Jordan, that you shall
set up these stones that I command you today in Mount Ebal
and cover them with plaster.

verses.hebrew: וּבָנִיתָ שָּׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִזְבַּח אֲבָנִים לֹא תָנִיף עֲלֵיהֶם בַּרְזֶל׃

hebrew.text: וּבָנִיתָ שָּׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִזְבַּח אֲבָנִים לֹא תָנִיף עֲלֵיהֶם בַּרְזֶל׃

english.text:
And you shall build an altar to YHWH, your God, there, an
altar of stones. You shall not lift iron over them.

translation.text: And there shalt thou build an altar unto the LORD thy God, an altar of stones: thou shalt not lift up any iron tool upon them.

verses.english:
And you shall build an altar to YHWH, your God, there, an
altar of stones. You shall not lift iron over them.

verses.hebrew: אֲבָנִים שְׁלֵמוֹת תִּבְנֶה אֶת מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהַעֲלִיתָ עָלָיו עוֹלֹת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: אֲבָנִים שְׁלֵמוֹת תִּבְנֶה אֶת מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהַעֲלִיתָ עָלָיו עוֹלֹת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
You shall build the altar of YHWH, your God, of whole
stones, and you shall offer burnt offerings on it to YHWH,
your God.

translation.text: Thou shalt build the altar of the LORD thy God of whole stones: and thou shalt offer burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD thy God:

verses.english:
You shall build the altar of YHWH, your God, of whole
stones, and you shall offer burnt offerings on it to YHWH,
your God.

verses.hebrew: וְזָבַחְתָּ שְׁלָמִים וְאָכַלְתָּ שָּׁם וְשָׂמַחְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְזָבַחְתָּ שְׁלָמִים וְאָכַלְתָּ שָּׁם וְשָׂמַחְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you shall sacrifice peace offerings and eat there and
rejoice in front of YHWH, your God.

translation.text: And thou shalt offer peace offerings, and shalt eat there, and rejoice before the LORD thy God.

verses.english:
And you shall sacrifice peace offerings and eat there and
rejoice in front of YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: וְכָתַבְתָּ עַל הָאֲבָנִים אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת בַּאֵר הֵיטֵב׃

hebrew.text: וְכָתַבְתָּ עַל הָאֲבָנִים אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת בַּאֵר הֵיטֵב׃

english.text:
And you shall write on the stones all the words of this
instruction very clearly.”

translation.text: And thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly.

verses.english:
And you shall write on the stones all the words of this
instruction very clearly.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה וְהַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הַסְכֵּת וּשְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה נִהְיֵיתָ לְעָם לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה וְהַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הַסְכֵּת וּשְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה נִהְיֵיתָ לְעָם לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And Moses and the Levite priests spoke to all Israel,
saying, “Be silent, and listen, Israel: this day you have
become a people to YHWH, your God.

translation.text: And Moses and the priests the Levites spake unto all Israel, saying, Take heed, and hearken, O Israel; this day thou art become the people of the LORD thy God.

verses.english:
And Moses and the Levite priests spoke to all Israel,
saying, “Be silent, and listen, Israel: this day you have
become a people to YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת מִצְוֺתָו וְאֶת חֻקָּיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת מִצְוֺתָו וְאֶת חֻקָּיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And you shall listen to the voice of YHWH, your God, and
do His commandments and His laws that I command you
today.”

translation.text: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the LORD thy God, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command thee this day.

verses.english:
And you shall listen to the voice of YHWH, your God, and
do His commandments and His laws that I command you
today.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And Moses commanded the people on that day, saying,

translation.text: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,

verses.english: And Moses commanded the people on that day, saying,

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה יַעַמְדוּ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת הָעָם עַל הַר גְּרִזִים בְּעבְרְכֶם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי וִיהוּדָה וְיִשָּׂשכָר וְיוֹסֵף וּבִנְיָמִן׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה יַעַמְדוּ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת הָעָם עַל הַר גְּרִזִים בְּעבְרְכֶם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי וִיהוּדָה וְיִשָּׂשכָר וְיוֹסֵף וּבִנְיָמִן׃

english.text:
“These shall stand to bless the people on Mount Gerizim
when you cross the Jordan: Simeon and Levi and Judah and
Issachar and Joseph and Benjamin.

translation.text: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:

verses.english:
“These shall stand to bless the people on Mount Gerizim
when you cross the Jordan: Simeon and Levi and Judah and
Issachar and Joseph and Benjamin.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה יַעַמְדוּ עַל הַקְּלָלָה בְּהַר עֵיבָל רְאוּבֵן גָּד וְאָשֵׁר וּזְבוּלֻן דָּן וְנַפְתָּלִי׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה יַעַמְדוּ עַל הַקְּלָלָה בְּהַר עֵיבָל רְאוּבֵן גָּד וְאָשֵׁר וּזְבוּלֻן דָּן וְנַפְתָּלִי׃

english.text:
And these shall stand for the curse on Mount Ebal: Reuben,
Gad, and Asher and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

translation.text: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

verses.english:
And these shall stand for the curse on Mount Ebal: Reuben,
Gad, and Asher and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

verses.hebrew: וְעָנוּ הַלְוִיִּם וְאָמְרוּ אֶל כּל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל קוֹל רָם׃

hebrew.text: וְעָנוּ הַלְוִיִּם וְאָמְרוּ אֶל כּל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל קוֹל רָם׃

english.text:
And the Levites shall answer, and they shall say in a loud
voice to every man of Israel:

translation.text: And the Levites shall speak, and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice,

verses.english:
And the Levites shall answer, and they shall say in a loud
voice to every man of Israel:

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה פֶסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה תּוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי חָרָשׁ וְשָׂם בַּסָּתֶר וְעָנוּ כל הָעָם וְאָמְרוּ אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה פֶסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה תּוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי חָרָשׁ וְשָׂם בַּסָּתֶר וְעָנוּ כל הָעָם וְאָמְרוּ אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be the man who will make a statue or molten thing,
an offensive thing of YHWH, a stone engraver’s work, and
set it up in secret.’ And all the people shall answer, and
they shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: Cursed be the man that maketh any graven or molten image, an abomination unto the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and putteth it in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.

verses.english:
‘Cursed be the man who will make a statue or molten thing,
an offensive thing of YHWH, a stone engraver’s work, and
set it up in secret.’ And all the people shall answer, and
they shall say: ‘Amen.’

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר מַקְלֶה אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר מַקְלֶה אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who disrespects one’s father and his
mother.’ And all the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: Cursed be he that setteth light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who disrespects one’s father and his
mother.’ And all the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר מַסִּיג גְּבוּל רֵעֵהוּ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר מַסִּיג גְּבוּל רֵעֵהוּ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who moves his neighbor’s landmark.’ And all
the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour’s landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who moves his neighbor’s landmark.’ And all
the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר מַשְׁגֶּה עִוֵּר בַּדָּרֶךְ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר מַשְׁגֶּה עִוֵּר בַּדָּרֶךְ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who misleads a blind person on the way.’
And all the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who misleads a blind person on the way.’
And all the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר מַטֶּה מִשְׁפַּט גֵּר יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר מַטֶּה מִשְׁפַּט גֵּר יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who bends the judgment of an alien, an
orphan, or a widow.’ And all the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who bends the judgment of an alien, an
orphan, or a widow.’ And all the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם אֵשֶׁת אָבִיו כִּי גִלָּה כְּנַף אָבִיו וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם אֵשֶׁת אָבִיו כִּי גִלָּה כְּנַף אָבִיו וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who lies with his father’s wife, because he
has exposed his father’s hem.’ And all the people shall
say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: Cursed be he that lieth with his father’s wife; because he uncovereth his father’s skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who lies with his father’s wife, because he
has exposed his father’s hem.’ And all the people shall
say: ‘Amen.’

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם כּל בְּהֵמָה וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם כּל בְּהֵמָה וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who lies with any animal.’ And all the
people shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who lies with any animal.’ And all the
people shall say: ‘Amen.’

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם אֲחֹתוֹ בַּת אָבִיו אוֹ בַת אִמּוֹ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם אֲחֹתוֹ בַּת אָבִיו אוֹ בַת אִמּוֹ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who lies with his sister —his father’s
daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ And all the people
shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: Cursed be he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who lies with his sister —his father’s
daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ And all the people
shall say: ‘Amen.’

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם חֹתַנְתּוֹ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם חֹתַנְתּוֹ וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who lies with his mother-in-law.’ And all
the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who lies with his mother-in-law.’ And all
the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר מַכֵּה רֵעֵהוּ בַּסָּתֶר וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר מַכֵּה רֵעֵהוּ בַּסָּתֶר וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who strikes his neighbor in secret.’ And
all the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

translation.text: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who strikes his neighbor in secret.’ And
all the people shall say: ‘Amen.’

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר לֹקֵחַ שֹׁחַד לְהַכּוֹת נֶפֶשׁ דָּם נָקִי וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר לֹקֵחַ שֹׁחַד לְהַכּוֹת נֶפֶשׁ דָּם נָקִי וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who takes a bribe to strike a
person—innocent blood.’ And all the people shall say:
‘Amen.’

translation.text: Cursed be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who takes a bribe to strike a
person—innocent blood.’ And all the people shall say:
‘Amen.’

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָקִים אֶת דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת לַעֲשׂוֹת אוֹתָם וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָקִים אֶת דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת לַעֲשׂוֹת אוֹתָם וְאָמַר כּל הָעָם אָמֵן׃

english.text:
‘Cursed be one who will not uphold the words of this
instruction, to do them.’ And all the people shall say:
‘Amen.’

translation.text: Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.english:
‘Cursed be one who will not uphold the words of this
instruction, to do them.’ And all the people shall say:
‘Amen.’

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם שָׁמוֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם וּנְתָנְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עֶלְיוֹן עַל כּל גּוֹיֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם שָׁמוֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם וּנְתָנְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עֶלְיוֹן עַל כּל גּוֹיֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
“And it will be, if you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH,
your God, to be watchful to do all His commandments that I
command you today, that YHWH, your God, will set you high
above all the nations of the earth.

translation.text: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the LORD thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth:

verses.english:
“And it will be, if you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH,
your God, to be watchful to do all His commandments that I
command you today, that YHWH, your God, will set you high
above all the nations of the earth.

verses.hebrew: וּבָאוּ עָלֶיךָ כּל הַבְּרָכוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגֻךָ כִּי תִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּבָאוּ עָלֶיךָ כּל הַבְּרָכוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגֻךָ כִּי תִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And all these blessings will come on you and catch up with
you when you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH, your God:

translation.text: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.

verses.english:
And all these blessings will come on you and catch up with
you when you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH, your God:

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה בָּעִיר וּבָרוּךְ אַתָּה בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה בָּעִיר וּבָרוּךְ אַתָּה בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
You’ll be blessed in the city, and you’ll be blessed in
the field.

translation.text: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.

verses.english:
You’ll be blessed in the city, and you’ll be blessed in
the field.

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ פְּרִי בִטְנְךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתְךָ וּפְרִי בְהֶמְתֶּךָ שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרוֹת צֹאנֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: בָּרוּךְ פְּרִי בִטְנְךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתְךָ וּפְרִי בְהֶמְתֶּךָ שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרוֹת צֹאנֶךָ׃

english.text:
The fruit of your womb and the fruit of your land and the
fruit of your animals, your cattle’s offspring and your
flock’s young, will be blessed.

translation.text: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.

verses.english:
The fruit of your womb and the fruit of your land and the
fruit of your animals, your cattle’s offspring and your
flock’s young, will be blessed.

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ טַנְאֲךָ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: בָּרוּךְ טַנְאֲךָ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּךָ׃

english.text: Your basket and your bowl will be blessed.

translation.text: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store.

verses.english: Your basket and your bowl will be blessed.

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה בְּבֹאֶךָ וּבָרוּךְ אַתָּה בְּצֵאתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה בְּבֹאֶךָ וּבָרוּךְ אַתָּה בְּצֵאתֶךָ׃

english.text:
You’ll be blessed when you come in, and you’ll be blessed
when you go out.

translation.text: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.

verses.english:
You’ll be blessed when you come in, and you’ll be blessed
when you go out.

verses.hebrew: יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת אֹיְבֶיךָ הַקָּמִים עָלֶיךָ נִגָּפִים לְפָנֶיךָ בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶחָד יֵצְאוּ אֵלֶיךָ וּבְשִׁבְעָה דְרָכִים יָנוּסוּ לְפָנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת אֹיְבֶיךָ הַקָּמִים עָלֶיךָ נִגָּפִים לְפָנֶיךָ בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶחָד יֵצְאוּ אֵלֶיךָ וּבְשִׁבְעָה דְרָכִים יָנוּסוּ לְפָנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
YHWH will make your enemies who come up against you
stricken in front of you. By one road they’ll come out at
you, and by seven roads they’ll flee in front of you.

translation.text: The LORD shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.

verses.english:
YHWH will make your enemies who come up against you
stricken in front of you. By one road they’ll come out at
you, and by seven roads they’ll flee in front of you.

verses.hebrew: יְצַו יְהֹוָה אִתְּךָ אֶת הַבְּרָכָה בַּאֲסָמֶיךָ וּבְכֹל מִשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ וּבֵרַכְךָ בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: יְצַו יְהֹוָה אִתְּךָ אֶת הַבְּרָכָה בַּאֲסָמֶיךָ וּבְכֹל מִשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ וּבֵרַכְךָ בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃

english.text:
YHWH will command the blessing for you in your storehouses
and in everything your hand takes on and will bless you in
the land that YHWH, your God, is giving you.

translation.text: The LORD shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

verses.english:
YHWH will command the blessing for you in your storehouses
and in everything your hand takes on and will bless you in
the land that YHWH, your God, is giving you.

verses.hebrew: יְקִימְךָ יְהֹוָה לוֹ לְעַם קָדוֹשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָךְ כִּי תִשְׁמֹר אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ בִּדְרָכָיו׃

hebrew.text: יְקִימְךָ יְהֹוָה לוֹ לְעַם קָדוֹשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָךְ כִּי תִשְׁמֹר אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ בִּדְרָכָיו׃

english.text:
YHWH will establish you for him as a holy people as He
swore to you if you’ll keep the commandments of YHWH, your
God, and go in His ways.

translation.text: The LORD shall establish thee an holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, and walk in his ways.

verses.english:
YHWH will establish you for him as a holy people as He
swore to you if you’ll keep the commandments of YHWH, your
God, and go in His ways.

verses.hebrew: וְרָאוּ כּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי שֵׁם יְהֹוָה נִקְרָא עָלֶיךָ וְיָרְאוּ מִמֶּךָּ׃

hebrew.text: וְרָאוּ כּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי שֵׁם יְהֹוָה נִקְרָא עָלֶיךָ וְיָרְאוּ מִמֶּךָּ׃

english.text:
And all the peoples of the earth will see that YHWH’s name
is called on you, and they’ll be afraid of you.

translation.text: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD; and they shall be afraid of thee.

verses.english:
And all the peoples of the earth will see that YHWH’s name
is called on you, and they’ll be afraid of you.

verses.hebrew: וְהוֹתִרְךָ יְהֹוָה לְטוֹבָה בִּפְרִי בִטְנְךָ וּבִפְרִי בְהֶמְתְּךָ וּבִפְרִי אַדְמָתֶךָ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לָתֶת לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹתִרְךָ יְהֹוָה לְטוֹבָה בִּפְרִי בִטְנְךָ וּבִפְרִי בְהֶמְתְּךָ וּבִפְרִי אַדְמָתֶךָ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לָתֶת לָךְ׃

english.text:
And YHWH will give you a surplus of good in the fruit of
your womb and in the fruit of your animals and in the
fruit of your land, on the land that YHWH swore to your
fathers to give you.

translation.text: And the LORD shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

verses.english:
And YHWH will give you a surplus of good in the fruit of
your womb and in the fruit of your animals and in the
fruit of your land, on the land that YHWH swore to your
fathers to give you.

verses.hebrew: יִפְתַּח יְהֹוָה לְךָ אֶת אוֹצָרוֹ הַטּוֹב אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם לָתֵת מְטַר אַרְצְךָ בְּעִתּוֹ וּלְבָרֵךְ אֵת כּל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶךָ וְהִלְוִיתָ גּוֹיִם רַבִּים וְאַתָּה לֹא תִלְוֶה׃

hebrew.text: יִפְתַּח יְהֹוָה לְךָ אֶת אוֹצָרוֹ הַטּוֹב אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם לָתֵת מְטַר אַרְצְךָ בְּעִתּוֹ וּלְבָרֵךְ אֵת כּל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶךָ וְהִלְוִיתָ גּוֹיִם רַבִּים וְאַתָּה לֹא תִלְוֶה׃

english.text:
YHWH will open His good treasure, the skies, to you, to
give your lands showers at their time and to bless all
your hand’s work. And you’ll lend to many nations, and you
won’t borrow;

translation.text: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.

verses.english:
YHWH will open His good treasure, the skies, to you, to
give your lands showers at their time and to bless all
your hand’s work. And you’ll lend to many nations, and you
won’t borrow;

verses.hebrew: וּנְתָנְךָ יְהֹוָה לְרֹאשׁ וְלֹא לְזָנָב וְהָיִיתָ רַק לְמַעְלָה וְלֹא תִהְיֶה לְמָטָּה כִּי תִשְׁמַע אֶל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לִשְׁמֹר וְלַעֲשׂוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּנְתָנְךָ יְהֹוָה לְרֹאשׁ וְלֹא לְזָנָב וְהָיִיתָ רַק לְמַעְלָה וְלֹא תִהְיֶה לְמָטָּה כִּי תִשְׁמַע אֶל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לִשְׁמֹר וְלַעֲשׂוֹת׃

english.text:
and YHWH will put you at the head and not at the tail; and
you’ll only be above, and you won’t be below—if you’ll
listen to the commandments of YHWH, your God, that I
command you today, to observe and to do,

translation.text: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:

verses.english:
and YHWH will put you at the head and not at the tail; and
you’ll only be above, and you won’t be below—if you’ll
listen to the commandments of YHWH, your God, that I
command you today, to observe and to do,

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תָסוּר מִכּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לְעבְדָם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תָסוּר מִכּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לְעבְדָם׃

english.text:
and you won’t turn from all the things that I command you
today, right or left, to go after other gods, to serve
them.

translation.text: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

verses.english:
and you won’t turn from all the things that I command you
today, right or left, to go after other gods, to serve
them.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם לֹא תִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם וּבָאוּ עָלֶיךָ כּל הַקְּלָלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגוּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם לֹא תִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם וּבָאוּ עָלֶיךָ כּל הַקְּלָלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגוּךָ׃

english.text:
“And it will be, if you won’t listen to the voice of YHWH,
your God, to be watchful to do all His commandments and
His laws that I command you today, that all these curses
will come on you and catch up with you:

translation.text: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:

verses.english:
“And it will be, if you won’t listen to the voice of YHWH,
your God, to be watchful to do all His commandments and
His laws that I command you today, that all these curses
will come on you and catch up with you:

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר אַתָּה בָּעִיר וְאָרוּר אַתָּה בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר אַתָּה בָּעִיר וְאָרוּר אַתָּה בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
You’ll be cursed in the city, and you’ll be cursed in the
field.

translation.text: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.

verses.english:
You’ll be cursed in the city, and you’ll be cursed in the
field.

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר טַנְאֲךָ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר טַנְאֲךָ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּךָ׃

english.text: Your basket and your bowl will be cursed.

translation.text: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store.

verses.english: Your basket and your bowl will be cursed.

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר פְּרִי בִטְנְךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתֶךָ שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹת צֹאנֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר פְּרִי בִטְנְךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתֶךָ שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹת צֹאנֶךָ׃

english.text:
The fruit of your womb and the fruit of your land, your
cattle’s offspring and your flock’s young, will be cursed.

translation.text: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.

verses.english:
The fruit of your womb and the fruit of your land, your
cattle’s offspring and your flock’s young, will be cursed.

verses.hebrew: אָרוּר אַתָּה בְּבֹאֶךָ וְאָרוּר אַתָּה בְּצֵאתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אָרוּר אַתָּה בְּבֹאֶךָ וְאָרוּר אַתָּה בְּצֵאתֶךָ׃

english.text:
You’ll be cursed when you come in, and you’ll be cursed
when you go out.

translation.text: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out.

verses.english:
You’ll be cursed when you come in, and you’ll be cursed
when you go out.

verses.hebrew: יְשַׁלַּח יְהֹוָה בְּךָ אֶת הַמְּאֵרָה אֶת הַמְּהוּמָה וְאֶת הַמִּגְעֶרֶת בְּכל מִשְׁלַח יָדְךָ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה עַד הִשָּׁמֶדְךָ וְעַד אֲבדְךָ מַהֵר מִפְּנֵי רֹעַ מַעֲלָלֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר עֲזַבְתָּנִי׃

hebrew.text: יְשַׁלַּח יְהֹוָה בְּךָ אֶת הַמְּאֵרָה אֶת הַמְּהוּמָה וְאֶת הַמִּגְעֶרֶת בְּכל מִשְׁלַח יָדְךָ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה עַד הִשָּׁמֶדְךָ וְעַד אֲבדְךָ מַהֵר מִפְּנֵי רֹעַ מַעֲלָלֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר עֲזַבְתָּנִי׃

english.text:
YHWH will send curse and tumult and annoyance at you in
everything your hand takes on that you’ll do, until you’re
destroyed and until you perish quickly because of your bad
practices, in that you left me.

translation.text: The LORD shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.

verses.english:
YHWH will send curse and tumult and annoyance at you in
everything your hand takes on that you’ll do, until you’re
destroyed and until you perish quickly because of your bad
practices, in that you left me.

verses.hebrew: יַדְבֵּק יְהֹוָה בְּךָ אֶת הַדָּבֶר עַד כַּלֹּתוֹ אֹתְךָ מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: יַדְבֵּק יְהֹוָה בְּךָ אֶת הַדָּבֶר עַד כַּלֹּתוֹ אֹתְךָ מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
YHWH will make an epidemic cling to you until He finishes
you from the land to which you’re coming to take
possession of it.

translation.text: The LORD shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.

verses.english:
YHWH will make an epidemic cling to you until He finishes
you from the land to which you’re coming to take
possession of it.

verses.hebrew: יַכְּכָה יְהֹוָה בַּשַּׁחֶפֶת וּבַקַּדַּחַת וּבַדַּלֶּקֶת וּבַחַרְחֻר וּבַחֶרֶב וּבַשִּׁדָּפוֹן וּבַיֵּרָקוֹן וּרְדָפוּךָ עַד אבְדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: יַכְּכָה יְהֹוָה בַּשַּׁחֶפֶת וּבַקַּדַּחַת וּבַדַּלֶּקֶת וּבַחַרְחֻר וּבַחֶרֶב וּבַשִּׁדָּפוֹן וּבַיֵּרָקוֹן וּרְדָפוּךָ עַד אבְדֶךָ׃

english.text:
YHWH will strike you with consumption and with fever and
with inflammation and with burning and with the sword and
with blight and with mildew. And they’ll pursue you until
you perish.

translation.text: The LORD shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.

verses.english:
YHWH will strike you with consumption and with fever and
with inflammation and with burning and with the sword and
with blight and with mildew. And they’ll pursue you until
you perish.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ שָׁמֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹאשְׁךָ נְחֹשֶׁת וְהָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֶּיךָ בַּרְזֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ שָׁמֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹאשְׁךָ נְחֹשֶׁת וְהָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֶּיךָ בַּרְזֶל׃

english.text:
And your skies that are over your head will be bronze, and
the land that is under you iron.

translation.text: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.

verses.english:
And your skies that are over your head will be bronze, and
the land that is under you iron.

verses.hebrew: יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת מְטַר אַרְצְךָ אָבָק וְעָפָר מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם יֵרֵד עָלֶיךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ׃

hebrew.text: יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת מְטַר אַרְצְךָ אָבָק וְעָפָר מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם יֵרֵד עָלֶיךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ׃

english.text:
YHWH will make your land’s showers powder and dust; it
will fall on you from the skies until you’re destroyed.

translation.text: The LORD shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.

verses.english:
YHWH will make your land’s showers powder and dust; it
will fall on you from the skies until you’re destroyed.

verses.hebrew: יִתֶּנְךָ יְהֹוָה נִגָּף לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֶיךָ בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶחָד תֵּצֵא אֵלָיו וּבְשִׁבְעָה דְרָכִים תָּנוּס לְפָנָיו וְהָיִיתָ לְזַעֲוָה לְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: יִתֶּנְךָ יְהֹוָה נִגָּף לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֶיךָ בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶחָד תֵּצֵא אֵלָיו וּבְשִׁבְעָה דְרָכִים תָּנוּס לְפָנָיו וְהָיִיתָ לְזַעֲוָה לְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
YHWH will make you stricken in front of your enemies. By
one road you’ll go out at him, and by seven roads you’ll
flee in front of him. And you’ll be a horrifying thing to
all the earth’s kingdoms.

translation.text: The LORD shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.english:
YHWH will make you stricken in front of your enemies. By
one road you’ll go out at him, and by seven roads you’ll
flee in front of him. And you’ll be a horrifying thing to
all the earth’s kingdoms.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה נִבְלָתְךָ לְמַאֲכָל לְכל עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְבֶהֱמַת הָאָרֶץ וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה נִבְלָתְךָ לְמַאֲכָל לְכל עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְבֶהֱמַת הָאָרֶץ וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד׃

english.text:
And your carcass will become food for every bird of the
skies and for the animals of the earth, with no one making
them afraid.

translation.text: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.

verses.english:
And your carcass will become food for every bird of the
skies and for the animals of the earth, with no one making
them afraid.

verses.hebrew: יַכְּכָה יְהֹוָה בִּשְׁחִין מִצְרַיִם (ובעפלים) [וּבַטְּחֹרִים] וּבַגָּרָב וּבֶחָרֶס אֲשֶׁר לֹא תוּכַל לְהֵרָפֵא׃

hebrew.text: יַכְּכָה יְהֹוָה בִּשְׁחִין מִצְרַיִם (ובעפלים) [וּבַטְּחֹרִים] וּבַגָּרָב וּבֶחָרֶס אֲשֶׁר לֹא תוּכַל לְהֵרָפֵא׃

english.text:
YHWH will strike you with the boils of Egypt and with
hemorrhoids and with scabs and with itches, from which you
won’t be able to be healed.

translation.text: The LORD will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.

verses.english:
YHWH will strike you with the boils of Egypt and with
hemorrhoids and with scabs and with itches, from which you
won’t be able to be healed.

verses.hebrew: יַכְּכָה יְהֹוָה בְּשִׁגָּעוֹן וּבְעִוָּרוֹן וּבְתִמְהוֹן לֵבָב׃

hebrew.text: יַכְּכָה יְהֹוָה בְּשִׁגָּעוֹן וּבְעִוָּרוֹן וּבְתִמְהוֹן לֵבָב׃

english.text:
YHWH will strike you with madness and with blindness and
with amazement of heart.

translation.text: The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:

verses.english:
YHWH will strike you with madness and with blindness and
with amazement of heart.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיִיתָ מְמַשֵּׁשׁ בַּצּהֳרַיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר יְמַשֵּׁשׁ הַעִוֵּר בָּאֲפֵלָה וְלֹא תַצְלִיחַ אֶת דְּרָכֶיךָ וְהָיִיתָ אַךְ עָשׁוּק וְגָזוּל כּל הַיָּמִים וְאֵין מוֹשִׁיעַ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיִיתָ מְמַשֵּׁשׁ בַּצּהֳרַיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר יְמַשֵּׁשׁ הַעִוֵּר בָּאֲפֵלָה וְלֹא תַצְלִיחַ אֶת דְּרָכֶיךָ וְהָיִיתָ אַךְ עָשׁוּק וְגָזוּל כּל הַיָּמִים וְאֵין מוֹשִׁיעַ׃

english.text:
And you’ll be feeling around at noon the way the blind
would feel around, in the dark. And you won’t make your
ways successful, but you’ll just be exploited and robbed
every day, and there will be no one to save you.

translation.text: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.

verses.english:
And you’ll be feeling around at noon the way the blind
would feel around, in the dark. And you won’t make your
ways successful, but you’ll just be exploited and robbed
every day, and there will be no one to save you.

verses.hebrew: אִשָּׁה תְאָרֵשׂ וְאִישׁ אַחֵר (ישגלנה) [יִשְׁכָּבֶנָּה] בַּיִת תִּבְנֶה וְלֹא תֵשֵׁב בּוֹ כֶּרֶם תִּטַּע וְלֹא תְחַלְּלֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: אִשָּׁה תְאָרֵשׂ וְאִישׁ אַחֵר (ישגלנה) [יִשְׁכָּבֶנָּה] בַּיִת תִּבְנֶה וְלֹא תֵשֵׁב בּוֹ כֶּרֶם תִּטַּע וְלֹא תְחַלְּלֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
You’ll betroth a woman, and another man will ravish her.
You’ll build a house, and you won’t live in it. You’ll
plant a vineyard, and you won’t desanctify it.

translation.text: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.

verses.english:
You’ll betroth a woman, and another man will ravish her.
You’ll build a house, and you won’t live in it. You’ll
plant a vineyard, and you won’t desanctify it.

verses.hebrew: שׁוֹרְךָ טָבוּחַ לְעֵינֶיךָ וְלֹא תֹאכַל מִמֶּנּוּ חֲמֹרְךָ גָּזוּל מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וְלֹא יָשׁוּב לָךְ צֹאנְךָ נְתֻנוֹת לְאֹיְבֶיךָ וְאֵין לְךָ מוֹשִׁיעַ׃

hebrew.text: שׁוֹרְךָ טָבוּחַ לְעֵינֶיךָ וְלֹא תֹאכַל מִמֶּנּוּ חֲמֹרְךָ גָּזוּל מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וְלֹא יָשׁוּב לָךְ צֹאנְךָ נְתֻנוֹת לְאֹיְבֶיךָ וְאֵין לְךָ מוֹשִׁיעַ׃

english.text:
Your ox slaughtered before your eyes—and you won’t eat any
of it. Your ass stolen from in front of you—and it won’t
come back to you. Your sheep given to your enemies—and
you’ll have no one to save you.

translation.text: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to rescue them.

verses.english:
Your ox slaughtered before your eyes—and you won’t eat any
of it. Your ass stolen from in front of you—and it won’t
come back to you. Your sheep given to your enemies—and
you’ll have no one to save you.

verses.hebrew: בָּנֶיךָ וּבְנֹתֶיךָ נְתֻנִים לְעַם אַחֵר וְעֵינֶיךָ רֹאוֹת וְכָלוֹת אֲלֵיהֶם כּל הַיּוֹם וְאֵין לְאֵל יָדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: בָּנֶיךָ וּבְנֹתֶיךָ נְתֻנִים לְעַם אַחֵר וְעֵינֶיךָ רֹאוֹת וְכָלוֹת אֲלֵיהֶם כּל הַיּוֹם וְאֵין לְאֵל יָדֶךָ׃

english.text:
Your sons and your daughters given to another people—while
your eyes are looking for them all day and giving out, and
there’s no God at your hand.

translation.text: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long; and there shall be no might in thine hand.

verses.english:
Your sons and your daughters given to another people—while
your eyes are looking for them all day and giving out, and
there’s no God at your hand.

verses.hebrew: פְּרִי אַדְמָתְךָ וְכל יְגִיעֲךָ יֹאכַל עַם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדָעְתָּ וְהָיִיתָ רַק עָשׁוּק וְרָצוּץ כּל הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: פְּרִי אַדְמָתְךָ וְכל יְגִיעֲךָ יֹאכַל עַם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדָעְתָּ וְהָיִיתָ רַק עָשׁוּק וְרָצוּץ כּל הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
A people whom you haven’t known will eat your land’s fruit
and all the product of your exhaustion, and you’ll only be
exploited and crushed every day.

translation.text: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway:

verses.english:
A people whom you haven’t known will eat your land’s fruit
and all the product of your exhaustion, and you’ll only be
exploited and crushed every day.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיִיתָ מְשֻׁגָּע מִמַּרְאֵה עֵינֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיִיתָ מְשֻׁגָּע מִמַּרְאֵה עֵינֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶה׃

english.text:
And you’ll be driven mad from the sight before your eyes
that you’ll see.

translation.text: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

verses.english:
And you’ll be driven mad from the sight before your eyes
that you’ll see.

verses.hebrew: יַכְּכָה יְהֹוָה בִּשְׁחִין רָע עַל הַבִּרְכַּיִם וְעַל הַשֹּׁקַיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא תוּכַל לְהֵרָפֵא מִכַּף רַגְלְךָ וְעַד קדְקֳדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: יַכְּכָה יְהֹוָה בִּשְׁחִין רָע עַל הַבִּרְכַּיִם וְעַל הַשֹּׁקַיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא תוּכַל לְהֵרָפֵא מִכַּף רַגְלְךָ וְעַד קדְקֳדֶךָ׃

english.text:
YHWH will strike you with bad boils on the knees and on
the thighs from which you won’t be able to be healed, from
your foot to the top of your head.

translation.text: The LORD shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.

verses.english:
YHWH will strike you with bad boils on the knees and on
the thighs from which you won’t be able to be healed, from
your foot to the top of your head.

verses.hebrew: יוֹלֵךְ יְהֹוָה אֹתְךָ וְאֶת מַלְכְּךָ אֲשֶׁר תָּקִים עָלֶיךָ אֶל גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַעְתָּ אַתָּה וַאֲבֹתֶיךָ וְעָבַדְתָּ שָּׁם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים עֵץ וָאָבֶן׃

hebrew.text: יוֹלֵךְ יְהֹוָה אֹתְךָ וְאֶת מַלְכְּךָ אֲשֶׁר תָּקִים עָלֶיךָ אֶל גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַעְתָּ אַתָּה וַאֲבֹתֶיךָ וְעָבַדְתָּ שָּׁם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים עֵץ וָאָבֶן׃

english.text:
YHWH will drive you and your king whom you’ll set up over
you to a nation whom you haven’t known, you and your
fathers, and you’ll serve other gods, wood and stone,
there.

translation.text: The LORD shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.

verses.english:
YHWH will drive you and your king whom you’ll set up over
you to a nation whom you haven’t known, you and your
fathers, and you’ll serve other gods, wood and stone,
there.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיִיתָ לְשַׁמָּה לְמָשָׁל וְלִשְׁנִינָה בְּכֹל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר יְנַהֶגְךָ יְהֹוָה שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיִיתָ לְשַׁמָּה לְמָשָׁל וְלִשְׁנִינָה בְּכֹל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר יְנַהֶגְךָ יְהֹוָה שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And you’ll become an astonishment, a proverb, and an
expression among all the peoples to which YHWH will drive
you.

translation.text: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead thee.

verses.english:
And you’ll become an astonishment, a proverb, and an
expression among all the peoples to which YHWH will drive
you.

verses.hebrew: זֶרַע רַב תּוֹצִיא הַשָּׂדֶה וּמְעַט תֶּאֱסֹף כִּי יַחְסְלֶנּוּ הָאַרְבֶּה׃

hebrew.text: זֶרַע רַב תּוֹצִיא הַשָּׂדֶה וּמְעַט תֶּאֱסֹף כִּי יַחְסְלֶנּוּ הָאַרְבֶּה׃

english.text:
You’ll take out much seed to the field, but you’ll gather
little, because locusts will finish it off.

translation.text: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather but little in; for the locust shall consume it.

verses.english:
You’ll take out much seed to the field, but you’ll gather
little, because locusts will finish it off.

verses.hebrew: כְּרָמִים תִּטַּע וְעָבָדְתָּ וְיַיִן לֹא תִשְׁתֶּה וְלֹא תֶאֱגֹר כִּי תֹאכְלֶנּוּ הַתֹּלָעַת׃

hebrew.text: כְּרָמִים תִּטַּע וְעָבָדְתָּ וְיַיִן לֹא תִשְׁתֶּה וְלֹא תֶאֱגֹר כִּי תֹאכְלֶנּוּ הַתֹּלָעַת׃

english.text:
You’ll plant vineyards and work them, but you won’t drink
wine or gather grapes, because worms will eat it.

translation.text: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress them, but shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.

verses.english:
You’ll plant vineyards and work them, but you won’t drink
wine or gather grapes, because worms will eat it.

verses.hebrew: זֵיתִים יִהְיוּ לְךָ בְּכל גְּבוּלֶךָ וְשֶׁמֶן לֹא תָסוּךְ כִּי יִשַּׁל זֵיתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: זֵיתִים יִהְיוּ לְךָ בְּכל גְּבוּלֶךָ וְשֶׁמֶן לֹא תָסוּךְ כִּי יִשַּׁל זֵיתֶךָ׃

english.text:
You’ll have olives within all your border, but you won’t
anoint with oil, because your olive will drop off.

translation.text: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil; for thine olive shall cast his fruit.

verses.english:
You’ll have olives within all your border, but you won’t
anoint with oil, because your olive will drop off.

verses.hebrew: בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת תּוֹלִיד וְלֹא יִהְיוּ לָךְ כִּי יֵלְכוּ בַּשֶּׁבִי׃

hebrew.text: בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת תּוֹלִיד וְלֹא יִהְיוּ לָךְ כִּי יֵלְכוּ בַּשֶּׁבִי׃

english.text:
You’ll give birth to sons and daughters, but you won’t
have them, because they’ll go into captivity.

translation.text: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.

verses.english:
You’ll give birth to sons and daughters, but you won’t
have them, because they’ll go into captivity.

verses.hebrew: כּל עֵצְךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתֶךָ יְיָרֵשׁ הַצְּלָצַל׃

hebrew.text: כּל עֵצְךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתֶךָ יְיָרֵשׁ הַצְּלָצַל׃

english.text:
Crickets will take possession of all your trees and your
land’s fruit.

translation.text: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.

verses.english:
Crickets will take possession of all your trees and your
land’s fruit.

verses.hebrew: הַגֵּר אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבְּךָ יַעֲלֶה עָלֶיךָ מַעְלָה מָּעְלָה וְאַתָּה תֵרֵד מַטָּה מָּטָּה׃

hebrew.text: הַגֵּר אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבְּךָ יַעֲלֶה עָלֶיךָ מַעְלָה מָּעְלָה וְאַתָּה תֵרֵד מַטָּה מָּטָּה׃

english.text:
The alien who is among you will go up above you higher and
higher, and you will go down lower and lower.

translation.text: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.

verses.english:
The alien who is among you will go up above you higher and
higher, and you will go down lower and lower.

verses.hebrew: הוּא יַלְוְךָ וְאַתָּה לֹא תַלְוֶנּוּ הוּא יִהְיֶה לְרֹאשׁ וְאַתָּה תִּהְיֶה לְזָנָב׃

hebrew.text: הוּא יַלְוְךָ וְאַתָּה לֹא תַלְוֶנּוּ הוּא יִהְיֶה לְרֹאשׁ וְאַתָּה תִּהְיֶה לְזָנָב׃

english.text:
He will lend to you, but you won’t lend to him. He will
become a head, and you will become a tail.
