translation.text: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.

verses.english:
He will lend to you, but you won’t lend to him. He will
become a head, and you will become a tail.

verses.hebrew: וּבָאוּ עָלֶיךָ כּל הַקְּלָלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וּרְדָפוּךָ וְהִשִּׂיגוּךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ כִּי לֹא שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וּבָאוּ עָלֶיךָ כּל הַקְּלָלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וּרְדָפוּךָ וְהִשִּׂיגוּךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ כִּי לֹא שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּךְ׃

english.text:
“And all these curses will come over you and pursue you
and catch up with you until you’re destroyed because you
didn’t listen to the voice of YHWH, your God, to observe
His commandments and His laws that He commanded you.

translation.text: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:

verses.english:
“And all these curses will come over you and pursue you
and catch up with you until you’re destroyed because you
didn’t listen to the voice of YHWH, your God, to observe
His commandments and His laws that He commanded you.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ בְךָ לְאוֹת וּלְמוֹפֵת וּבְזַרְעֲךָ עַד עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ בְךָ לְאוֹת וּלְמוֹפֵת וּבְזַרְעֲךָ עַד עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
And they’ll be a sign and a wonder in you and in your seed
forever.

translation.text: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.

verses.english:
And they’ll be a sign and a wonder in you and in your seed
forever.

verses.hebrew: תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר לֹא עָבַדְתָּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְטוּב לֵבָב מֵרֹב כֹּל׃

hebrew.text: תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר לֹא עָבַדְתָּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְטוּב לֵבָב מֵרֹב כֹּל׃

english.text:
Because you didn’t serve YHWH, your God, with joy and with
good feeling from the abundance of everything,

translation.text: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;

verses.english:
Because you didn’t serve YHWH, your God, with joy and with
good feeling from the abundance of everything,

verses.hebrew: וְעָבַדְתָּ אֶת אֹיְבֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ יְהֹוָה בָּךְ בְּרָעָב וּבְצָמָא וּבְעֵירֹם וּבְחֹסֶר כֹּל וְנָתַן עֹל בַּרְזֶל עַל צַוָּארֶךָ עַד הִשְׁמִידוֹ אֹתָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָבַדְתָּ אֶת אֹיְבֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ יְהֹוָה בָּךְ בְּרָעָב וּבְצָמָא וּבְעֵירֹם וּבְחֹסֶר כֹּל וְנָתַן עֹל בַּרְזֶל עַל צַוָּארֶךָ עַד הִשְׁמִידוֹ אֹתָךְ׃

english.text:
so you’ll serve your enemies whom YHWH will send at you in
hunger and in thirst and in nakedness and in lack of
everything. And He’ll put an iron yoke on your neck until
He has destroyed you.

translation.text: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the LORD shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.

verses.english:
so you’ll serve your enemies whom YHWH will send at you in
hunger and in thirst and in nakedness and in lack of
everything. And He’ll put an iron yoke on your neck until
He has destroyed you.

verses.hebrew: יִשָּׂא יְהֹוָה עָלֶיךָ גּוֹי מֵרָחֹק מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִדְאֶה הַנָּשֶׁר גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר לֹא תִשְׁמַע לְשֹׁנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: יִשָּׂא יְהֹוָה עָלֶיךָ גּוֹי מֵרָחֹק מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִדְאֶה הַנָּשֶׁר גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר לֹא תִשְׁמַע לְשֹׁנוֹ׃

english.text:
YHWH will fetch a nation from far, from the end of the
earth, over you the way an eagle soars, a nation whose
language you won’t understand,

translation.text: The LORD shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;

verses.english:
YHWH will fetch a nation from far, from the end of the
earth, over you the way an eagle soars, a nation whose
language you won’t understand,

verses.hebrew: גּוֹי עַז פָּנִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִשָּׂא פָנִים לְזָקֵן וְנַעַר לֹא יָחֹן׃

hebrew.text: גּוֹי עַז פָּנִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִשָּׂא פָנִים לְזָקֵן וְנַעַר לֹא יָחֹן׃

english.text:
a fierce-faced nation who won’t be partial to the old and
won’t show grace to the young—

translation.text: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:

verses.english:
a fierce-faced nation who won’t be partial to the old and
won’t show grace to the young—

verses.hebrew: וְאָכַל פְּרִי בְהֶמְתְּךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתְךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ אֲשֶׁר לֹא יַשְׁאִיר לְךָ דָּגָן תִּירוֹשׁ וְיִצְהָר שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹת צֹאנֶךָ עַד הַאֲבִידוֹ אֹתָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָכַל פְּרִי בְהֶמְתְּךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתְךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ אֲשֶׁר לֹא יַשְׁאִיר לְךָ דָּגָן תִּירוֹשׁ וְיִצְהָר שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹת צֹאנֶךָ עַד הַאֲבִידוֹ אֹתָךְ׃

english.text:
and it will eat the fruit of your animals and the fruit of
your land until you are destroyed—who won’t leave you
grain, wine, and oil, your cattle’s offspring and your
flock’s young until it has made you perish.

translation.text: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which also shall not leave thee either corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.

verses.english:
and it will eat the fruit of your animals and the fruit of
your land until you are destroyed—who won’t leave you
grain, wine, and oil, your cattle’s offspring and your
flock’s young until it has made you perish.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵצַר לְךָ בְּכל שְׁעָרֶיךָ עַד רֶדֶת חֹמֹתֶיךָ הַגְּבֹהֹת וְהַבְּצֻרוֹת אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בֹּטֵחַ בָּהֵן בְּכל אַרְצֶךָ וְהֵצַר לְךָ בְּכל שְׁעָרֶיךָ בְּכל אַרְצְךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵצַר לְךָ בְּכל שְׁעָרֶיךָ עַד רֶדֶת חֹמֹתֶיךָ הַגְּבֹהֹת וְהַבְּצֻרוֹת אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בֹּטֵחַ בָּהֵן בְּכל אַרְצֶךָ וְהֵצַר לְךָ בְּכל שְׁעָרֶיךָ בְּכל אַרְצְךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָךְ׃

english.text:
And it will close you in, in all your gates, until your
high and fortified walls in which you trust come down in
all your land; and it will close you in, in all your
gates, in all your land that YHWH, your God, has given
you.

translation.text: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.

verses.english:
And it will close you in, in all your gates, until your
high and fortified walls in which you trust come down in
all your land; and it will close you in, in all your
gates, in all your land that YHWH, your God, has given
you.

verses.hebrew: וְאָכַלְתָּ פְרִי בִטְנְךָ בְּשַׂר בָּנֶיךָ וּבְנֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּמָצוֹר וּבְמָצוֹק אֲשֶׁר יָצִיק לְךָ אֹיְבֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָכַלְתָּ פְרִי בִטְנְךָ בְּשַׂר בָּנֶיךָ וּבְנֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּמָצוֹר וּבְמָצוֹק אֲשֶׁר יָצִיק לְךָ אֹיְבֶךָ׃

english.text:
And you’ll eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of your
sons and your daughters whom YHWH, your God, has given
you, in the siege and in the constraint that your enemy
will put on you.

translation.text: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the LORD thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:

verses.english:
And you’ll eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of your
sons and your daughters whom YHWH, your God, has given
you, in the siege and in the constraint that your enemy
will put on you.

verses.hebrew: הָאִישׁ הָרַךְ בְּךָ וְהֶעָנֹג מְאֹד תֵּרַע עֵינוֹ בְאָחִיו וּבְאֵשֶׁת חֵיקוֹ וּבְיֶתֶר בָּנָיו אֲשֶׁר יוֹתִיר׃

hebrew.text: הָאִישׁ הָרַךְ בְּךָ וְהֶעָנֹג מְאֹד תֵּרַע עֵינוֹ בְאָחִיו וּבְאֵשֶׁת חֵיקוֹ וּבְיֶתֶר בָּנָיו אֲשֶׁר יוֹתִיר׃

english.text:
The tenderest man among you and the very delicate: his eye
will look with evil intent at his brother and the wife of
his bosom and the rest of his children that he’ll have
left

translation.text: So that the man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:

verses.english:
The tenderest man among you and the very delicate: his eye
will look with evil intent at his brother and the wife of
his bosom and the rest of his children that he’ll have
left

verses.hebrew: מִתֵּת לְאַחַד מֵהֶם מִבְּשַׂר בָּנָיו אֲשֶׁר יֹאכֵל מִבְּלִי הִשְׁאִיר לוֹ כֹּל בְּמָצוֹר וּבְמָצוֹק אֲשֶׁר יָצִיק לְךָ אֹיִבְךָ בְּכל שְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: מִתֵּת לְאַחַד מֵהֶם מִבְּשַׂר בָּנָיו אֲשֶׁר יֹאכֵל מִבְּלִי הִשְׁאִיר לוֹ כֹּל בְּמָצוֹר וּבְמָצוֹק אֲשֶׁר יָצִיק לְךָ אֹיִבְךָ בְּכל שְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

english.text:
from giving to one of them any of the flesh of his
children that he’ll eat, because nothing will be left to
him in the siege and in the constraint that your enemy
will put on you in all your gates.

translation.text: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.

verses.english:
from giving to one of them any of the flesh of his
children that he’ll eat, because nothing will be left to
him in the siege and in the constraint that your enemy
will put on you in all your gates.

verses.hebrew: הָרַכָּה בְךָ וְהָעֲנֻגָּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא נִסְּתָה כַף רַגְלָהּ הַצֵּג עַל הָאָרֶץ מֵהִתְעַנֵּג וּמֵרֹךְ תֵּרַע עֵינָהּ בְּאִישׁ חֵיקָהּ וּבִבְנָהּ וּבְבִתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: הָרַכָּה בְךָ וְהָעֲנֻגָּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא נִסְּתָה כַף רַגְלָהּ הַצֵּג עַל הָאָרֶץ מֵהִתְעַנֵּג וּמֵרֹךְ תֵּרַע עֵינָהּ בְּאִישׁ חֵיקָהּ וּבִבְנָהּ וּבְבִתָּהּ׃

english.text:
The tenderest and the most delicate woman among you, who
wouldn’t risk setting her foot on the ground out of
delicacy and tenderness: her eye will look with evil
intent at the man of her bosom and her son and her
daughter

translation.text: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,

verses.english:
The tenderest and the most delicate woman among you, who
wouldn’t risk setting her foot on the ground out of
delicacy and tenderness: her eye will look with evil
intent at the man of her bosom and her son and her
daughter

verses.hebrew: וּבְשִׁלְיָתָהּ הַיּוֹצֵת מִבֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ וּבְבָנֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵד כִּי תֹאכְלֵם בְּחֹסֶר כֹּל בַּסָּתֶר בְּמָצוֹר וּבְמָצוֹק אֲשֶׁר יָצִיק לְךָ אֹיִבְךָ בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְשִׁלְיָתָהּ הַיּוֹצֵת מִבֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ וּבְבָנֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵד כִּי תֹאכְלֵם בְּחֹסֶר כֹּל בַּסָּתֶר בְּמָצוֹר וּבְמָצוֹק אֲשֶׁר יָצִיק לְךָ אֹיִבְךָ בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ׃

english.text:
and her afterbirth that comes out from between her legs
and her children to whom she’ll give birth, because she’ll
eat them in secret due to the lack of everything in the
siege and in the constraint that your enemy will put on
you in your gates.

translation.text: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.

verses.english:
and her afterbirth that comes out from between her legs
and her children to whom she’ll give birth, because she’ll
eat them in secret due to the lack of everything in the
siege and in the constraint that your enemy will put on
you in your gates.

verses.hebrew: אִם לֹא תִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת הַכְּתֻבִים בַּסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה לְיִרְאָה אֶת הַשֵּׁם הַנִּכְבָּד וְהַנּוֹרָא הַזֶּה אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: אִם לֹא תִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת הַכְּתֻבִים בַּסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה לְיִרְאָה אֶת הַשֵּׁם הַנִּכְבָּד וְהַנּוֹרָא הַזֶּה אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
If you won’t be watchful to do the words of this
instruction that are written in this scroll, to fear this
honored and awesome name: YHWH, your God,

translation.text: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD THY GOD;

verses.english:
If you won’t be watchful to do the words of this
instruction that are written in this scroll, to fear this
honored and awesome name: YHWH, your God,

verses.hebrew: וְהִפְלָא יְהֹוָה אֶת מַכֹּתְךָ וְאֵת מַכּוֹת זַרְעֶךָ מַכּוֹת גְּדֹלֹת וְנֶאֱמָנוֹת וחֳלָיִם רָעִים וְנֶאֱמָנִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהִפְלָא יְהֹוָה אֶת מַכֹּתְךָ וְאֵת מַכּוֹת זַרְעֶךָ מַכּוֹת גְּדֹלֹת וְנֶאֱמָנוֹת וחֳלָיִם רָעִים וְנֶאֱמָנִים׃

english.text:
then YHWH will make your plagues and your seed’s plagues
astonishing, great and enduring plagues, and great and
enduring illnesses.

translation.text: Then the LORD will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.

verses.english:
then YHWH will make your plagues and your seed’s plagues
astonishing, great and enduring plagues, and great and
enduring illnesses.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵשִׁיב בְּךָ אֵת כּל מַדְוֵה מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתָּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם וְדָבְקוּ בָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵשִׁיב בְּךָ אֵת כּל מַדְוֵה מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתָּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם וְדָבְקוּ בָּךְ׃

english.text:
And He’ll bring back among you every disease of Egypt,
which you were dreading, and they’ll cling to you.

translation.text: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.

verses.english:
And He’ll bring back among you every disease of Egypt,
which you were dreading, and they’ll cling to you.

verses.hebrew: גַּם כּל חֳלִי וְכל מַכָּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא כָתוּב בְּסֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת יַעְלֵם יְהֹוָה עָלֶיךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ׃

hebrew.text: גַּם כּל חֳלִי וְכל מַכָּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא כָתוּב בְּסֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת יַעְלֵם יְהֹוָה עָלֶיךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ׃

english.text:
YHWH will bring over you every illness and every plague
that is not written in this scroll of instruction, as
well, until you are destroyed.

translation.text: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.

verses.english:
YHWH will bring over you every illness and every plague
that is not written in this scroll of instruction, as
well, until you are destroyed.

verses.hebrew: וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם בִּמְתֵי מְעָט תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר הֱיִיתֶם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם לָרֹב כִּי לֹא שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם בִּמְתֵי מְעָט תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר הֱיִיתֶם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם לָרֹב כִּי לֹא שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And you’ll be left with few persons when you had been like
the stars of the skies for multitude, because you didn’t
listen to the voice of YHWH, your God.

translation.text: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the LORD thy God.

verses.english:
And you’ll be left with few persons when you had been like
the stars of the skies for multitude, because you didn’t
listen to the voice of YHWH, your God.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׂשׂ יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם לְהֵיטִיב אֶתְכֶם וּלְהַרְבּוֹת אֶתְכֶם כֵּן יָשִׂישׂ יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם לְהַאֲבִיד אֶתְכֶם וּלְהַשְׁמִיד אֶתְכֶם וְנִסַּחְתֶּם מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׂשׂ יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם לְהֵיטִיב אֶתְכֶם וּלְהַרְבּוֹת אֶתְכֶם כֵּן יָשִׂישׂ יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם לְהַאֲבִיד אֶתְכֶם וּלְהַשְׁמִיד אֶתְכֶם וְנִסַּחְתֶּם מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
And it will be: as YHWH had satisfaction over you to do
good to you and to multiply you, so YHWH will have
satisfaction over you to make you perish and to destroy
you, and you’ll be torn away from the land to which you’re
coming to take possession of it.

translation.text: And it shall come to pass, that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.

verses.english:
And it will be: as YHWH had satisfaction over you to do
good to you and to multiply you, so YHWH will have
satisfaction over you to make you perish and to destroy
you, and you’ll be torn away from the land to which you’re
coming to take possession of it.

verses.hebrew: וֶהֱפִיצְךָ יְהֹוָה בְּכל הָעַמִּים מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ וְעַד קְצֵה הָאָרֶץ וְעָבַדְתָּ שָּׁם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַעְתָּ אַתָּה וַאֲבֹתֶיךָ עֵץ וָאָבֶן׃

hebrew.text: וֶהֱפִיצְךָ יְהֹוָה בְּכל הָעַמִּים מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ וְעַד קְצֵה הָאָרֶץ וְעָבַדְתָּ שָּׁם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַעְתָּ אַתָּה וַאֲבֹתֶיךָ עֵץ וָאָבֶן׃

english.text:
And YHWH will scatter you among all the peoples from one
end of the earth to the other end of the earth. And you’ll
serve other gods, whom you haven’t known, you and your
fathers, there, wood and stone.

translation.text: And the LORD shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.

verses.english:
And YHWH will scatter you among all the peoples from one
end of the earth to the other end of the earth. And you’ll
serve other gods, whom you haven’t known, you and your
fathers, there, wood and stone.

verses.hebrew: וּבַגּוֹיִם הָהֵם לֹא תַרְגִּיעַ וְלֹא יִהְיֶה מָנוֹחַ לְכַף רַגְלֶךָ וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה לְךָ שָׁם לֵב רַגָּז וְכִלְיוֹן עֵינַיִם וְדַאֲבוֹן נָפֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וּבַגּוֹיִם הָהֵם לֹא תַרְגִּיעַ וְלֹא יִהְיֶה מָנוֹחַ לְכַף רַגְלֶךָ וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה לְךָ שָׁם לֵב רַגָּז וְכִלְיוֹן עֵינַיִם וְדַאֲבוֹן נָפֶשׁ׃

english.text:
And among those nations you won’t have a respite, and
there won’t be a resting place for your foot, and YHWH
will give you there a trembling heart and a failing of
eyes and a fainting of soul.

translation.text: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the LORD shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:

verses.english:
And among those nations you won’t have a respite, and
there won’t be a resting place for your foot, and YHWH
will give you there a trembling heart and a failing of
eyes and a fainting of soul.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ חַיֶּיךָ תְּלֻאִים לְךָ מִנֶּגֶד וּפָחַדְתָּ לַיְלָה וְיוֹמָם וְלֹא תַאֲמִין בְּחַיֶּיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיוּ חַיֶּיךָ תְּלֻאִים לְךָ מִנֶּגֶד וּפָחַדְתָּ לַיְלָה וְיוֹמָם וְלֹא תַאֲמִין בְּחַיֶּיךָ׃

english.text:
And your life will be hanging opposite you, and you’ll
fear night and day, and you won’t trust in your life.

translation.text: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:

verses.english:
And your life will be hanging opposite you, and you’ll
fear night and day, and you won’t trust in your life.

verses.hebrew: בַּבֹּקֶר תֹּאמַר מִי יִתֵּן עֶרֶב וּבָעֶרֶב תֹּאמַר מִי יִתֵּן בֹּקֶר מִפַּחַד לְבָבְךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּפְחָד וּמִמַּרְאֵה עֵינֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶה׃

hebrew.text: בַּבֹּקֶר תֹּאמַר מִי יִתֵּן עֶרֶב וּבָעֶרֶב תֹּאמַר מִי יִתֵּן בֹּקֶר מִפַּחַד לְבָבְךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּפְחָד וּמִמַּרְאֵה עֵינֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶה׃

english.text:
In the morning you’ll say, ‘Who would make it evening,’
and in the evening you’ll say, ‘Who would make it
morning,’ because of your heart’s fear that you’ll have
and because of the sight before your eyes that you’ll see.

translation.text: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

verses.english:
In the morning you’ll say, ‘Who would make it evening,’
and in the evening you’ll say, ‘Who would make it
morning,’ because of your heart’s fear that you’ll have
and because of the sight before your eyes that you’ll see.

verses.hebrew: וֶהֱשִׁיבְךָ יְהֹוָה מִצְרַיִם בּאֳנִיּוֹת בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי לְךָ לֹא תֹסִיף עוֹד לִרְאֹתָהּ וְהִתְמַכַּרְתֶּם שָׁם לְאֹיְבֶיךָ לַעֲבָדִים וְלִשְׁפָחוֹת וְאֵין קֹנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וֶהֱשִׁיבְךָ יְהֹוָה מִצְרַיִם בּאֳנִיּוֹת בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי לְךָ לֹא תֹסִיף עוֹד לִרְאֹתָהּ וְהִתְמַכַּרְתֶּם שָׁם לְאֹיְבֶיךָ לַעֲבָדִים וְלִשְׁפָחוֹת וְאֵין קֹנֶה׃

english.text:
And YHWH will bring you back to Egypt in boats, by the way
that I said to you: ‘You won’t go on to see it anymore.’
And you’ll sell yourselves there to your enemies as slaves
and as maids, and none will buy!”

translation.text: And the LORD shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.

verses.english:
And YHWH will bring you back to Egypt in boats, by the way
that I said to you: ‘You won’t go on to see it anymore.’
And you’ll sell yourselves there to your enemies as slaves
and as maids, and none will buy!”

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה דִבְרֵי הַבְּרִית אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה לִכְרֹת אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב מִלְּבַד הַבְּרִית אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אִתָּם בְּחֹרֵב׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה דִבְרֵי הַבְּרִית אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה לִכְרֹת אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב מִלְּבַד הַבְּרִית אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אִתָּם בְּחֹרֵב׃

english.text:
These are the words of the covenant that YHWH commanded
Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of
Moab, aside from the covenant that He made with them at
Horeb.

verses.english:
These are the words of the covenant that YHWH commanded
Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of
Moab, aside from the covenant that He made with them at
Horeb.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַתֶּם רְאִיתֶם אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לְעֵינֵיכֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְפַרְעֹה וּלְכל עֲבָדָיו וּלְכל אַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַתֶּם רְאִיתֶם אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לְעֵינֵיכֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְפַרְעֹה וּלְכל עֲבָדָיו וּלְכל אַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
And Moses called all of Israel and said to them,
“You’ve seen everything that YHWH did before your eyes in
the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and to all his servants and
to all his land,

translation.text: These are the words of the covenant, which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.

verses.english:
And Moses called all of Israel and said to them,
“You’ve seen everything that YHWH did before your eyes in
the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and to all his servants and
to all his land,

verses.hebrew: הַמַּסּוֹת הַגְּדֹלֹת אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ הָאֹתֹת וְהַמֹּפְתִים הַגְּדֹלִים הָהֵם׃

hebrew.text: הַמַּסּוֹת הַגְּדֹלֹת אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ הָאֹתֹת וְהַמֹּפְתִים הַגְּדֹלִים הָהֵם׃

english.text:
the great tests that your eyes saw, those great signs and
wonders.

translation.text: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;

verses.english:
the great tests that your eyes saw, those great signs and
wonders.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא נָתַן יְהֹוָה לָכֶם לֵב לָדַעַת וְעֵינַיִם לִרְאוֹת וְאזְנַיִם לִשְׁמֹעַ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא נָתַן יְהֹוָה לָכֶם לֵב לָדַעַת וְעֵינַיִם לִרְאוֹת וְאזְנַיִם לִשְׁמֹעַ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
But YHWH did not give you a heart to know and eyes to see
and ears to hear until this day.

translation.text: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:

verses.english:
But YHWH did not give you a heart to know and eyes to see
and ears to hear until this day.

verses.hebrew: וָאוֹלֵךְ אֶתְכֶם אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בַּמִּדְבָּר לֹא בָלוּ שַׂלְמֹתֵיכֶם מֵעֲלֵיכֶם וְנַעַלְךָ לֹא בָלְתָה מֵעַל רַגְלֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וָאוֹלֵךְ אֶתְכֶם אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בַּמִּדְבָּר לֹא בָלוּ שַׂלְמֹתֵיכֶם מֵעֲלֵיכֶם וְנַעַלְךָ לֹא בָלְתָה מֵעַל רַגְלֶךָ׃

english.text:
As I led you forty years in the wilderness, your clothing
did not become worn on you, and your shoe did not become
worn on your foot,

translation.text: Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.

verses.english:
As I led you forty years in the wilderness, your clothing
did not become worn on you, and your shoe did not become
worn on your foot,

verses.hebrew: לֶחֶם לֹא אֲכַלְתֶּם וְיַיִן וְשֵׁכָר לֹא שְׁתִיתֶם לְמַעַן תֵּדְעוּ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֶחֶם לֹא אֲכַלְתֶּם וְיַיִן וְשֵׁכָר לֹא שְׁתִיתֶם לְמַעַן תֵּדְעוּ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
you didn’t eat bread, and you didn’t drink wine and beer,
so you would know that ‘I am YHWH your God.’

translation.text: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.

verses.english:
you didn’t eat bread, and you didn’t drink wine and beer,
so you would know that ‘I am YHWH your God.’

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹאוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וַיֵּצֵא סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְעוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן לִקְרָאתֵנוּ לַמִּלְחָמָה וַנַּכֵּם׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּבֹאוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וַיֵּצֵא סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְעוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן לִקְרָאתֵנוּ לַמִּלְחָמָה וַנַּכֵּם׃

english.text:
And you came to this place. (And Sihon, king of Heshbon,
and Og, king of Bashan, came out at us for war, and we
struck them.

translation.text: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I am the LORD your God.

verses.english:
And you came to this place. (And Sihon, king of Heshbon,
and Og, king of Bashan, came out at us for war, and we
struck them.

verses.hebrew: וַנִּקַּח אֶת אַרְצָם וַנִּתְּנָהּ לְנַחֲלָה לָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשִּׁי׃

hebrew.text: וַנִּקַּח אֶת אַרְצָם וַנִּתְּנָהּ לְנַחֲלָה לָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשִּׁי׃

english.text:
And we took their land and gave it as a legacy to the
Reubenite and to the Gadite and to half of the Manassite
tribe.)

translation.text: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:

verses.english:
And we took their land and gave it as a legacy to the
Reubenite and to the Gadite and to half of the Manassite
tribe.)

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת דִּבְרֵי הַבְּרִית הַזֹּאת וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם לְמַעַן תַּשְׂכִּילוּ אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּן׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת דִּבְרֵי הַבְּרִית הַזֹּאת וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם לְמַעַן תַּשְׂכִּילוּ אֵת כּל אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּן׃

english.text:
And you shall observe the words of this covenant and do
them so that you’ll understand all that you’ll do.

translation.text: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.

verses.english:
And you shall observe the words of this covenant and do
them so that you’ll understand all that you’ll do.

verses.hebrew: אַתֶּם נִצָּבִים הַיּוֹם כֻּלְּכֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם רָאשֵׁיכֶם שִׁבְטֵיכֶם זִקְנֵיכֶם וְשֹׁטְרֵיכֶם כֹּל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: אַתֶּם נִצָּבִים הַיּוֹם כֻּלְּכֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם רָאשֵׁיכֶם שִׁבְטֵיכֶם זִקְנֵיכֶם וְשֹׁטְרֵיכֶם כֹּל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
“You’re standing today, all of you, in front of
YHWH, your God—your heads, your tribes, your elders, and
your officers, every man of Israel,

translation.text: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.

verses.english:
“You’re standing today, all of you, in front of
YHWH, your God—your heads, your tribes, your elders, and
your officers, every man of Israel,

verses.hebrew: טַפְּכֶם נְשֵׁיכֶם וְגֵרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בְּקֶרֶב מַחֲנֶיךָ מֵחֹטֵב עֵצֶיךָ עַד שֹׁאֵב מֵימֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: טַפְּכֶם נְשֵׁיכֶם וְגֵרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בְּקֶרֶב מַחֲנֶיךָ מֵחֹטֵב עֵצֶיךָ עַד שֹׁאֵב מֵימֶיךָ׃

english.text:
your infants, your women, and your alien who is in your
camps, from one who cuts your wood to one who draws your
water—

translation.text: Ye stand this day all of you before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Israel,

verses.english:
your infants, your women, and your alien who is in your
camps, from one who cuts your wood to one who draws your
water—

verses.hebrew: לְעבְרְךָ בִּבְרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּבְאָלָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כֹּרֵת עִמְּךָ הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: לְעבְרְךָ בִּבְרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּבְאָלָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כֹּרֵת עִמְּךָ הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
for you to enter into the covenant of YHWH, your God, and
into His oath, which YHWH, your God, is making with you
today,

translation.text: Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that is in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:

verses.english:
for you to enter into the covenant of YHWH, your God, and
into His oath, which YHWH, your God, is making with you
today,

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן הָקִים אֹתְךָ הַיּוֹם לוֹ לְעָם וְהוּא יִהְיֶה לְּךָ לֵאלֹהִים כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָךְ וְכַאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן הָקִים אֹתְךָ הַיּוֹם לוֹ לְעָם וְהוּא יִהְיֶה לְּךָ לֵאלֹהִים כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָךְ וְכַאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
in order to establish you today for Him as a people, and
He will be a God to you, as He spoke to you and as He
swore to your fathers: to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

translation.text: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the LORD thy God, and into his oath, which the LORD thy God maketh with thee this day:

verses.english:
in order to establish you today for Him as a people, and
He will be a God to you, as He spoke to you and as He
swore to your fathers: to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא אִתְּכֶם לְבַדְּכֶם אָנֹכִי כֹּרֵת אֶת הַבְּרִית הַזֹּאת וְאֶת הָאָלָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא אִתְּכֶם לְבַדְּכֶם אָנֹכִי כֹּרֵת אֶת הַבְּרִית הַזֹּאת וְאֶת הָאָלָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
And I am not making this covenant and this oath with you
alone,

translation.text: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and that he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

verses.english:
And I am not making this covenant and this oath with you
alone,

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶת אֲשֶׁר יֶשְׁנוֹ פֹּה עִמָּנוּ עֹמֵד הַיּוֹם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר אֵינֶנּוּ פֹּה עִמָּנוּ הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֶת אֲשֶׁר יֶשְׁנוֹ פֹּה עִמָּנוּ עֹמֵד הַיּוֹם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר אֵינֶנּוּ פֹּה עִמָּנוּ הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
but with the one who is here standing with us today in
front of YHWH, our God, and with the one who isn’t here
with us today.

translation.text: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;

verses.english:
but with the one who is here standing with us today in
front of YHWH, our God, and with the one who isn’t here
with us today.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אַתֶּם יְדַעְתֶּם אֵת אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁבְנוּ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ בְּקֶרֶב הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר עֲבַרְתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אַתֶּם יְדַעְתֶּם אֵת אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁבְנוּ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ בְּקֶרֶב הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר עֲבַרְתֶּם׃

english.text:
Because you know that we lived in the land of Egypt and
that we passed among the nations that you passed.

translation.text: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the LORD our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day:

verses.english:
Because you know that we lived in the land of Egypt and
that we passed among the nations that you passed.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּרְאוּ אֶת שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶם וְאֵת גִּלֻּלֵיהֶם עֵץ וָאֶבֶן כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב אֲשֶׁר עִמָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּרְאוּ אֶת שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶם וְאֵת גִּלֻּלֵיהֶם עֵץ וָאֶבֶן כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב אֲשֶׁר עִמָּהֶם׃

english.text:
And you’ve seen their disgraces and their idols, wood and
stone, silver and gold, that were with them.

translation.text: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;

verses.english:
And you’ve seen their disgraces and their idols, wood and
stone, silver and gold, that were with them.

verses.hebrew: פֶּן יֵשׁ בָּכֶם אִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה אוֹ מִשְׁפָּחָה אוֹ שֵׁבֶט אֲשֶׁר לְבָבוֹ פֹנֶה הַיּוֹם מֵעִם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לָלֶכֶת לַעֲבֹד אֶת אֱלֹהֵי הַגּוֹיִם הָהֵם פֶּן יֵשׁ בָּכֶם שֹׁרֶשׁ פֹּרֶה רֹאשׁ וְלַעֲנָה׃

hebrew.text: פֶּן יֵשׁ בָּכֶם אִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה אוֹ מִשְׁפָּחָה אוֹ שֵׁבֶט אֲשֶׁר לְבָבוֹ פֹנֶה הַיּוֹם מֵעִם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לָלֶכֶת לַעֲבֹד אֶת אֱלֹהֵי הַגּוֹיִם הָהֵם פֶּן יֵשׁ בָּכֶם שֹׁרֶשׁ פֹּרֶה רֹאשׁ וְלַעֲנָה׃

english.text:
In case there will be among you a man or woman or family
or tribe whose heart is turning today from YHWH, our God,
to go to serve those nations’ gods; in case there is among
you a root bearing poison and wormwood,

translation.text: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)

verses.english:
In case there will be among you a man or woman or family
or tribe whose heart is turning today from YHWH, our God,
to go to serve those nations’ gods; in case there is among
you a root bearing poison and wormwood,

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בְּשׁמְעוֹ אֶת דִּבְרֵי הָאָלָה הַזֹּאת וְהִתְבָּרֵךְ בִּלְבָבוֹ לֵאמֹר שָׁלוֹם יִהְיֶה לִּי כִּי בִּשְׁרִרוּת לִבִּי אֵלֵךְ לְמַעַן סְפוֹת הָרָוָה אֶת הַצְּמֵאָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בְּשׁמְעוֹ אֶת דִּבְרֵי הָאָלָה הַזֹּאת וְהִתְבָּרֵךְ בִּלְבָבוֹ לֵאמֹר שָׁלוֹם יִהְיֶה לִּי כִּי בִּשְׁרִרוּת לִבִּי אֵלֵךְ לְמַעַן סְפוֹת הָרָוָה אֶת הַצְּמֵאָה׃

english.text:
and it will be when he hears the words of this oath that
he’ll feel himself blessed in his heart, saying, ‘I’ll
have peace, though I’ll go on in my heart’s obstinacy,’ so
as to annihilate the wet with the dry:

translation.text: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the LORD our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;

verses.english:
and it will be when he hears the words of this oath that
he’ll feel himself blessed in his heart, saying, ‘I’ll
have peace, though I’ll go on in my heart’s obstinacy,’ so
as to annihilate the wet with the dry:

verses.hebrew: לֹא יֹאבֶה יְהֹוָה סְלֹחַ לוֹ כִּי אָז יֶעְשַׁן אַף יְהֹוָה וְקִנְאָתוֹ בָּאִישׁ הַהוּא וְרָבְצָה בּוֹ כּל הָאָלָה הַכְּתוּבָה בַּסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה וּמָחָה יְהֹוָה אֶת שְׁמוֹ מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא יֹאבֶה יְהֹוָה סְלֹחַ לוֹ כִּי אָז יֶעְשַׁן אַף יְהֹוָה וְקִנְאָתוֹ בָּאִישׁ הַהוּא וְרָבְצָה בּוֹ כּל הָאָלָה הַכְּתוּבָה בַּסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה וּמָחָה יְהֹוָה אֶת שְׁמוֹ מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
YHWH will not be willing to forgive him, because YHWH’s
anger and His jealousy will then smoke against that man,
and every curse that is written in this scroll will weigh
on him, and YHWH will wipe out his name from under the
skies.

translation.text: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:

verses.english:
YHWH will not be willing to forgive him, because YHWH’s
anger and His jealousy will then smoke against that man,
and every curse that is written in this scroll will weigh
on him, and YHWH will wipe out his name from under the
skies.

verses.hebrew: וְהִבְדִּילוֹ יְהֹוָה לְרָעָה מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אָלוֹת הַבְּרִית הַכְּתוּבָה בְּסֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִבְדִּילוֹ יְהֹוָה לְרָעָה מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אָלוֹת הַבְּרִית הַכְּתוּבָה בְּסֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And YHWH will separate him from all of Israel’s tribes for
bad, according to all the curses of the covenant that is
written in this scroll of instruction.

translation.text: The LORD will not spare him, but then the anger of the LORD and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heaven.

verses.english:
And YHWH will separate him from all of Israel’s tribes for
bad, according to all the curses of the covenant that is
written in this scroll of instruction.

verses.hebrew: וְאָמַר הַדּוֹר הָאַחֲרוֹן בְּנֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר יָקוּמוּ מֵאַחֲרֵיכֶם וְהַנּכְרִי אֲשֶׁר יָבֹא מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה וְרָאוּ אֶת מַכּוֹת הָאָרֶץ הַהִוא וְאֶת תַּחֲלֻאֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר חִלָּה יְהֹוָה בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַר הַדּוֹר הָאַחֲרוֹן בְּנֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר יָקוּמוּ מֵאַחֲרֵיכֶם וְהַנּכְרִי אֲשֶׁר יָבֹא מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה וְרָאוּ אֶת מַכּוֹת הָאָרֶץ הַהִוא וְאֶת תַּחֲלֻאֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר חִלָּה יְהֹוָה בָּהּ׃

english.text:
“And a later generation will say—your children who will
come up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a
far land, when they’ll see that land’s plagues and its
illnesses that YHWH put in it,

translation.text: And the LORD shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:

verses.english:
“And a later generation will say—your children who will
come up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a
far land, when they’ll see that land’s plagues and its
illnesses that YHWH put in it,

verses.hebrew: גּפְרִית וָמֶלַח שְׂרֵפָה כל אַרְצָהּ לֹא תִזָּרַע וְלֹא תַצְמִחַ וְלֹא יַעֲלֶה בָהּ כּל עֵשֶׂב כְּמַהְפֵּכַת סְדֹם וַעֲמֹרָה אַדְמָה (וצביים) [וּצְבוֹיִם] אֲשֶׁר הָפַךְ יְהֹוָה בְּאַפּוֹ וּבַחֲמָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: גּפְרִית וָמֶלַח שְׂרֵפָה כל אַרְצָהּ לֹא תִזָּרַע וְלֹא תַצְמִחַ וְלֹא יַעֲלֶה בָהּ כּל עֵשֶׂב כְּמַהְפֵּכַת סְדֹם וַעֲמֹרָה אַדְמָה (וצביים) [וּצְבוֹיִם] אֲשֶׁר הָפַךְ יְהֹוָה בְּאַפּוֹ וּבַחֲמָתוֹ׃

english.text:
brimstone and salt, all the land a burning, it won’t be
seeded and won’t grow, and not any vegetation will come up
in it, like the overturning of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah
and Zeboiim, which YHWH overturned in His anger and His
fury—

translation.text: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the LORD hath laid upon it;

verses.english:
brimstone and salt, all the land a burning, it won’t be
seeded and won’t grow, and not any vegetation will come up
in it, like the overturning of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah
and Zeboiim, which YHWH overturned in His anger and His
fury—

verses.hebrew: וְאָמְרוּ כּל הַגּוֹיִם עַל מֶה עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה כָּכָה לָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת מֶה חֳרִי הָאַף הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמְרוּ כּל הַגּוֹיִם עַל מֶה עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה כָּכָה לָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת מֶה חֳרִי הָאַף הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
and all the nations will say, ‘For what did YHWH do
something like this to this land? What is this big flaring
of anger?’

translation.text: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:

verses.english:
and all the nations will say, ‘For what did YHWH do
something like this to this land? What is this big flaring
of anger?’

verses.hebrew: וְאָמְרוּ עַל אֲשֶׁר עָזְבוּ אֶת בְּרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתָם אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת עִמָּם בְּהוֹצִיאוֹ אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמְרוּ עַל אֲשֶׁר עָזְבוּ אֶת בְּרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתָם אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת עִמָּם בְּהוֹצִיאוֹ אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
“And they’ll say, ‘For the fact that they left the
covenant of YHWH, their fathers’ God, which He made with
them when He brought them out from the land of Egypt.

translation.text: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?

verses.english:
“And they’ll say, ‘For the fact that they left the
covenant of YHWH, their fathers’ God, which He made with
them when He brought them out from the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יְדָעוּם וְלֹא חָלַק לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יְדָעוּם וְלֹא חָלַק לָהֶם׃

english.text:
And they went and served other gods and bowed to them,
gods whom they hadn’t known and He hadn’t allocated to
them.

translation.text: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:

verses.english:
And they went and served other gods and bowed to them,
gods whom they hadn’t known and He hadn’t allocated to
them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בָּאָרֶץ הַהִוא לְהָבִיא עָלֶיהָ אֶת כּל הַקְּלָלָה הַכְּתוּבָה בַּסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בָּאָרֶץ הַהִוא לְהָבִיא עָלֶיהָ אֶת כּל הַקְּלָלָה הַכְּתוּבָה בַּסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And YHWH’s anger flared at that land, to bring over it
every curse that was written in this scroll.

translation.text: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and whom he had not given unto them:

verses.english:
And YHWH’s anger flared at that land, to bring over it
every curse that was written in this scroll.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה מֵעַל אַדְמָתָם בְּאַף וּבְחֵמָה וּבְקֶצֶף גָּדוֹל וַיַּשְׁלִכֵם אֶל אֶרֶץ אַחֶרֶת כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה מֵעַל אַדְמָתָם בְּאַף וּבְחֵמָה וּבְקֶצֶף גָּדוֹל וַיַּשְׁלִכֵם אֶל אֶרֶץ אַחֶרֶת כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And YHWH plucked them from their land in anger and in fury
and in great rage, and He threw them into another land, as
it is this day.’

translation.text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:

verses.english:
And YHWH plucked them from their land in anger and in fury
and in great rage, and He threw them into another land, as
it is this day.’

verses.hebrew: הַנִּסְתָּרֹת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהַנִּגְלֹת לָנוּ וּלְבָנֵינוּ עַד עוֹלָם לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: הַנִּסְתָּרֹת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהַנִּגְלֹת לָנוּ וּלְבָנֵינוּ עַד עוֹלָם לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
“The hidden things belong to YHWH, our God, and the
revealed things belong to us and to our children forever,
to do all the words of this instruction.

translation.text: And the LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.

verses.english:
“The hidden things belong to YHWH, our God, and the
revealed things belong to us and to our children forever,
to do all the words of this instruction.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִי יָבֹאוּ עָלֶיךָ כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה הַבְּרָכָה וְהַקְּלָלָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶךָ בְּכל הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִדִּיחֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִי יָבֹאוּ עָלֶיךָ כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה הַבְּרָכָה וְהַקְּלָלָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶךָ בְּכל הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִדִּיחֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
And it will be, when all these things, the blessing and
the curse that I’ve put in front of you, will come upon
you, and you’ll store it in your heart among the nations
to which YHWH, your God, has driven you,

translation.text: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath driven thee,

verses.english:
And it will be, when all these things, the blessing and
the curse that I’ve put in front of you, will come upon
you, and you’ll store it in your heart among the nations
to which YHWH, your God, has driven you,

verses.hebrew: וְשַׁבְתָּ עַד יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְשָׁמַעְתָּ בְקֹלוֹ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׁבְתָּ עַד יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְשָׁמַעְתָּ בְקֹלוֹ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
and you’ll come back to YHWH, your God, and listen to His
voice, according to everything that I command you today,
you and your children, with all your heart and with all
your soul,

translation.text: And shalt return unto the LORD thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;

verses.english:
and you’ll come back to YHWH, your God, and listen to His
voice, according to everything that I command you today,
you and your children, with all your heart and with all
your soul,

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁב יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת שְׁבוּתְךָ וְרִחֲמֶךָ וְשָׁב וְקִבֶּצְךָ מִכּל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר הֱפִיצְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁב יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת שְׁבוּתְךָ וְרִחֲמֶךָ וְשָׁב וְקִבֶּצְךָ מִכּל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר הֱפִיצְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
that YHWH, your God, will bring back your captivity and be
merciful to you. And He’ll come back and gather you from
all the peoples to which YHWH, your God, has scattered
you.

translation.text: That then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.

verses.english:
that YHWH, your God, will bring back your captivity and be
merciful to you. And He’ll come back and gather you from
all the peoples to which YHWH, your God, has scattered
you.

verses.hebrew: אִם יִהְיֶה נִדַּחֲךָ בִּקְצֵה הַשָּׁמָיִם מִשָּׁם יְקַבֶּצְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּמִשָּׁם יִקָּחֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אִם יִהְיֶה נִדַּחֲךָ בִּקְצֵה הַשָּׁמָיִם מִשָּׁם יְקַבֶּצְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּמִשָּׁם יִקָּחֶךָ׃

english.text:
If you’ll be driven to the end of the skies, YHWH, your
God, will gather you from there, and He’ll take you from
there.

translation.text: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:

verses.english:
If you’ll be driven to the end of the skies, YHWH, your
God, will gather you from there, and He’ll take you from
there.

verses.hebrew: וֶהֱבִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יָרְשׁוּ אֲבֹתֶיךָ וִירִשְׁתָּהּ וְהֵיטִבְךָ וְהִרְבְּךָ מֵאֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וֶהֱבִיאֲךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יָרְשׁוּ אֲבֹתֶיךָ וִירִשְׁתָּהּ וְהֵיטִבְךָ וְהִרְבְּךָ מֵאֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And YHWH, your God, will bring you to the land that your
fathers possessed, and you’ll take possession of it, and
He’ll be good to you and multiply you more than your
fathers.

translation.text: And the LORD thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.

verses.english:
And YHWH, your God, will bring you to the land that your
fathers possessed, and you’ll take possession of it, and
He’ll be good to you and multiply you more than your
fathers.

verses.hebrew: וּמָל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת לְבָבְךָ וְאֶת לְבַב זַרְעֶךָ לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשְׁךָ לְמַעַן חַיֶּיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּמָל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת לְבָבְךָ וְאֶת לְבַב זַרְעֶךָ לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשְׁךָ לְמַעַן חַיֶּיךָ׃

english.text:
And YHWH, your God, will circumcise your heart and your
seed’s heart so as to love YHWH, your God, with all your
heart and with all your soul so that you’ll live.

translation.text: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.

verses.english:
And YHWH, your God, will circumcise your heart and your
seed’s heart so as to love YHWH, your God, with all your
heart and with all your soul so that you’ll live.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵת כּל הָאָלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה עַל אֹיְבֶיךָ וְעַל שֹׂנְאֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר רְדָפוּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵת כּל הָאָלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה עַל אֹיְבֶיךָ וְעַל שֹׂנְאֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר רְדָפוּךָ׃

english.text:
And YHWH, your God, will put all these curses on your
enemies and on those who hate you who have pursued you.

translation.text: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.

verses.english:
And YHWH, your God, will put all these curses on your
enemies and on those who hate you who have pursued you.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תָשׁוּב וְשָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה תָשׁוּב וְשָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת כּל מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
And you’ll come back and listen to YHWH’s voice and do all
His commandments that I command you today.

translation.text: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.

verses.english:
And you’ll come back and listen to YHWH’s voice and do all
His commandments that I command you today.

verses.hebrew: וְהוֹתִירְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶךָ בִּפְרִי בִטְנְךָ וּבִפְרִי בְהֶמְתְּךָ וּבִפְרִי אַדְמָתְךָ לְטֹבָה כִּי יָשׁוּב יְהֹוָה לָשׂוּשׂ עָלֶיךָ לְטוֹב כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׂשׂ עַל אֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹתִירְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶךָ בִּפְרִי בִטְנְךָ וּבִפְרִי בְהֶמְתְּךָ וּבִפְרִי אַדְמָתְךָ לְטֹבָה כִּי יָשׁוּב יְהֹוָה לָשׂוּשׂ עָלֶיךָ לְטוֹב כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׂשׂ עַל אֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And YHWH, your God, will give you extra of all your hand’s
work, of the fruit of your womb and of the fruit of your
animals and the fruit of your land for good. Because YHWH
will come back to have satisfaction over you for good as
He had satisfaction over your fathers,

translation.text: And the LORD thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the LORD will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:

verses.english:
And YHWH, your God, will give you extra of all your hand’s
work, of the fruit of your womb and of the fruit of your
animals and the fruit of your land for good. Because YHWH
will come back to have satisfaction over you for good as
He had satisfaction over your fathers,

verses.hebrew: כִּי תִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו הַכְּתוּבָה בְּסֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֶּה כִּי תָשׁוּב אֶל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו הַכְּתוּבָה בְּסֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֶּה כִּי תָשׁוּב אֶל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכל נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
when you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH, your God, to
observe His commandments and His laws, written in this
scroll of instruction, when you’ll come back to YHWH, your
God, with all your heart and with all your soul.

translation.text: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, and if thou turn unto the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.

verses.english:
when you’ll listen to the voice of YHWH, your God, to
observe His commandments and His laws, written in this
scroll of instruction, when you’ll come back to YHWH, your
God, with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הַמִּצְוָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לֹא נִפְלֵאת הִוא מִמְּךָ וְלֹא רְחֹקָה הִוא׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הַמִּצְוָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לֹא נִפְלֵאת הִוא מִמְּךָ וְלֹא רְחֹקָה הִוא׃

english.text:
“Because this commandment that I command you today: it’s
not too wondrous for you, and it’s not too far.

translation.text: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it is not hidden from thee, neither is it far off.

verses.english:
“Because this commandment that I command you today: it’s
not too wondrous for you, and it’s not too far.

verses.hebrew: לֹא בַשָּׁמַיִם הִוא לֵאמֹר מִי יַעֲלֶה לָּנוּ הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וְיִקָּחֶהָ לָּנוּ וְיַשְׁמִעֵנוּ אֹתָהּ וְנַעֲשֶׂנָּה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא בַשָּׁמַיִם הִוא לֵאמֹר מִי יַעֲלֶה לָּנוּ הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וְיִקָּחֶהָ לָּנוּ וְיַשְׁמִעֵנוּ אֹתָהּ וְנַעֲשֶׂנָּה׃

english.text:
It’s not in the skies, that one would say, ‘Who will go up
for us to the skies and get it for us and enable us to
hear it so we’ll do it?’

translation.text: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

verses.english:
It’s not in the skies, that one would say, ‘Who will go up
for us to the skies and get it for us and enable us to
hear it so we’ll do it?’

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא מֵעֵבֶר לַיָּם הִוא לֵאמֹר מִי יַעֲבר לָנוּ אֶל עֵבֶר הַיָּם וְיִקָּחֶהָ לָּנוּ וְיַשְׁמִעֵנוּ אֹתָהּ וְנַעֲשֶׂנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא מֵעֵבֶר לַיָּם הִוא לֵאמֹר מִי יַעֲבר לָנוּ אֶל עֵבֶר הַיָּם וְיִקָּחֶהָ לָּנוּ וְיַשְׁמִעֵנוּ אֹתָהּ וְנַעֲשֶׂנָּה׃

english.text:
And it’s not across the sea, that one would say, ‘Who will
cross for us, across the sea, and get it for us and enable
us to hear it so we’ll do it?’

translation.text: Neither is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

verses.english:
And it’s not across the sea, that one would say, ‘Who will
cross for us, across the sea, and get it for us and enable
us to hear it so we’ll do it?’

verses.hebrew: כִּי קָרוֹב אֵלֶיךָ הַדָּבָר מְאֹד בְּפִיךָ וּבִלְבָבְךָ לַעֲשֹׂתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי קָרוֹב אֵלֶיךָ הַדָּבָר מְאֹד בְּפִיךָ וּבִלְבָבְךָ לַעֲשֹׂתוֹ׃

english.text:
But the thing is very close to you, in your mouth, and in
your heart, to do it.

translation.text: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.

verses.english:
But the thing is very close to you, in your mouth, and in
your heart, to do it.

verses.hebrew: רְאֵה נָתַתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ הַיּוֹם אֶת הַחַיִּים וְאֶת הַטּוֹב וְאֶת הַמָּוֶת וְאֶת הָרָע׃

hebrew.text: רְאֵה נָתַתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ הַיּוֹם אֶת הַחַיִּים וְאֶת הַטּוֹב וְאֶת הַמָּוֶת וְאֶת הָרָע׃

english.text:
“See: I’ve put in front of you today life and good, and
death and bad,

translation.text: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;

verses.english:
“See: I’ve put in front of you today life and good, and
death and bad,

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָלֶכֶת בִּדְרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וְחָיִיתָ וְרָבִיתָ וּבֵרַכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָלֶכֶת בִּדְרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקֹּתָיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וְחָיִיתָ וְרָבִיתָ וּבֵרַכְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
in that I command you today to love YHWH, your God, to go
in His ways and to observe His commandments and His laws
and His judgments so you’ll live and multiply and bless
YHWH, your God, in the land to which you’re coming to take
possession of it.

translation.text: In that I command thee this day to love the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.

verses.english:
in that I command you today to love YHWH, your God, to go
in His ways and to observe His commandments and His laws
and His judgments so you’ll live and multiply and bless
YHWH, your God, in the land to which you’re coming to take
possession of it.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם יִפְנֶה לְבָבְךָ וְלֹא תִשְׁמָע וְנִדַּחְתָּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתָ לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַעֲבַדְתָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם יִפְנֶה לְבָבְךָ וְלֹא תִשְׁמָע וְנִדַּחְתָּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתָ לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַעֲבַדְתָּם׃

english.text:
But if your heart will turn away, and you won’t listen,
and you’ll be driven so that you’ll bow to other gods and
serve them,

translation.text: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;

verses.english:
But if your heart will turn away, and you won’t listen,
and you’ll be driven so that you’ll bow to other gods and
serve them,

verses.hebrew: הִגַּדְתִּי לָכֶם הַיּוֹם כִּי אָבֹד תֹּאבֵדוּן לֹא תַאֲרִיכֻן יָמִים עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹבֵר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן לָבוֹא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: הִגַּדְתִּי לָכֶם הַיּוֹם כִּי אָבֹד תֹּאבֵדוּן לֹא תַאֲרִיכֻן יָמִים עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹבֵר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן לָבוֹא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
I’ve told you today that you’ll perish. You won’t extend
days on the land to which you’re crossing the Jordan to
come to take possession of it.

translation.text: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.

verses.english:
I’ve told you today that you’ll perish. You won’t extend
days on the land to which you’re crossing the Jordan to
come to take possession of it.

verses.hebrew: הַעִדֹתִי בָכֶם הַיּוֹם אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ הַחַיִּים וְהַמָּוֶת נָתַתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ הַבְּרָכָה וְהַקְּלָלָה וּבָחַרְתָּ בַּחַיִּים לְמַעַן תִּחְיֶה אַתָּה וְזַרְעֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: הַעִדֹתִי בָכֶם הַיּוֹם אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ הַחַיִּים וְהַמָּוֶת נָתַתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ הַבְּרָכָה וְהַקְּלָלָה וּבָחַרְתָּ בַּחַיִּים לְמַעַן תִּחְיֶה אַתָּה וְזַרְעֶךָ׃

english.text:
I call the skies and the earth to witness regarding you
today: I’ve put life and death in front of you, blessing
and curse. And you shall choose life, so you’ll live, you
and your seed,

translation.text: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:

verses.english:
I call the skies and the earth to witness regarding you
today: I’ve put life and death in front of you, blessing
and curse. And you shall choose life, so you’ll live, you
and your seed,

verses.hebrew: לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקֹלוֹ וּלְדבְקָה בוֹ כִּי הוּא חַיֶּיךָ וְאֹרֶךְ יָמֶיךָ לָשֶׁבֶת עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לָתֵת לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקֹלוֹ וּלְדבְקָה בוֹ כִּי הוּא חַיֶּיךָ וְאֹרֶךְ יָמֶיךָ לָשֶׁבֶת עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתֶיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לָתֵת לָהֶם׃

english.text:
to love YHWH, your God, to listen to His voice and to
cling to Him, because He is your life and the extension of
your days to reside on the land that YHWH swore to your
fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to
them.”

translation.text: That thou mayest love the LORD thy God, and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

verses.english:
to love YHWH, your God, to listen to His voice and to
cling to Him, because He is your life and the extension of
your days to reside on the land that YHWH swore to your
fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to
them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה וַיְדַבֵּר אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה וַיְדַבֵּר אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses went and spoke these things to
all Israel.

translation.text: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.

verses.english:
And Moses went and spoke these things to
all Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם בֶּן מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה אָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם לֹא אוּכַל עוֹד לָצֵאת וְלָבוֹא וַיהֹוָה אָמַר אֵלַי לֹא תַעֲבֹר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם בֶּן מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה אָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם לֹא אוּכַל עוֹד לָצֵאת וְלָבוֹא וַיהֹוָה אָמַר אֵלַי לֹא תַעֲבֹר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And he said to them, “I’m a hundred twenty years old
today. I’m not able to go out and come in anymore. And
YHWH said to me, ‘You shall not cross this Jordan.’

translation.text: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the LORD hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

verses.english:
And he said to them, “I’m a hundred twenty years old
today. I’m not able to go out and come in anymore. And
YHWH said to me, ‘You shall not cross this Jordan.’

verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא עֹבֵר לְפָנֶיךָ הוּא יַשְׁמִיד אֶת הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וִירִשְׁתָּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ הוּא עֹבֵר לְפָנֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא עֹבֵר לְפָנֶיךָ הוּא יַשְׁמִיד אֶת הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וִירִשְׁתָּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ הוּא עֹבֵר לְפָנֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
YHWH, your God: He is crossing in front of you. He’ll
destroy these nations in front of you, and you’ll
dispossess them. Joshua: he is crossing in front of you,
as YHWH has spoken.

translation.text: The LORD thy God, he will go over before thee, and he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the LORD hath said.

verses.english:
YHWH, your God: He is crossing in front of you. He’ll
destroy these nations in front of you, and you’ll
dispossess them. Joshua: he is crossing in front of you,
as YHWH has spoken.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לָהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְסִיחוֹן וּלְעוֹג מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי וּלְאַרְצָם אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁמִיד אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לָהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְסִיחוֹן וּלְעוֹג מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי וּלְאַרְצָם אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁמִיד אֹתָם׃

english.text:
And YHWH will do to them as He did to Sihon and to Og, the
kings of the Amorites, and to their land, that He
destroyed them.

translation.text: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.

verses.english:
And YHWH will do to them as He did to Sihon and to Og, the
kings of the Amorites, and to their land, that He
destroyed them.

verses.hebrew: וּנְתָנָם יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵיכֶם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָהֶם כְּכל הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּנְתָנָם יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵיכֶם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָהֶם כְּכל הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
And YHWH will put them in front of you, and you shall do
to them according to all of the commandment that I’ve
commanded you.

translation.text: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.

verses.english:
And YHWH will put them in front of you, and you shall do
to them according to all of the commandment that I’ve
commanded you.

verses.hebrew: חִזְקוּ וְאִמְצוּ אַל תִּירְאוּ וְאַל תַּעַרְצוּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא הַהֹלֵךְ עִמָּךְ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַעַזְבֶךָּ׃

hebrew.text: חִזְקוּ וְאִמְצוּ אַל תִּירְאוּ וְאַל תַּעַרְצוּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא הַהֹלֵךְ עִמָּךְ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַעַזְבֶךָּ׃

english.text:
Be strong and be bold. Don’t be afraid and don’t be scared
in front of them, because YHWH, your God: He is the one
going with you. He won’t let you down and won’t leave
you.”

translation.text: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

verses.english:
Be strong and be bold. Don’t be afraid and don’t be scared
in front of them, because YHWH, your God: He is the one
going with you. He won’t let you down and won’t leave
you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לְעֵינֵי כל יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ כִּי אַתָּה תָּבוֹא אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתָם לָתֵת לָהֶם וְאַתָּה תַּנְחִילֶנָּה אוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לְעֵינֵי כל יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ כִּי אַתָּה תָּבוֹא אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבֹתָם לָתֵת לָהֶם וְאַתָּה תַּנְחִילֶנָּה אוֹתָם׃

english.text:
And Moses called Joshua and said to him before the eyes of
all Israel, “Be strong and be bold, because you will come
with this people to the land that YHWH swore to their
fathers to give to them, and you will get it for them as a
legacy.

translation.text: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the LORD hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.

verses.english:
And Moses called Joshua and said to him before the eyes of
all Israel, “Be strong and be bold, because you will come
with this people to the land that YHWH swore to their
fathers to give to them, and you will get it for them as a
legacy.

verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה הוּא הַהֹלֵךְ לְפָנֶיךָ הוּא יִהְיֶה עִמָּךְ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַעַזְבֶךָּ לֹא תִירָא וְלֹא תֵחָת׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה הוּא הַהֹלֵךְ לְפָנֶיךָ הוּא יִהְיֶה עִמָּךְ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַעַזְבֶךָּ לֹא תִירָא וְלֹא תֵחָת׃

english.text:
And YHWH: He is the one who is going in front of you. He
will be with you. He won’t let you down and won’t leave
you. You shall not fear, and you shall not be dismayed.”

translation.text: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

verses.english:
And YHWH: He is the one who is going in front of you. He
will be with you. He won’t let you down and won’t leave
you. You shall not fear, and you shall not be dismayed.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת וַיִּתְּנָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי לֵוִי הַנֹּשְׂאִים אֶת אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה וְאֶל כּל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת וַיִּתְּנָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי לֵוִי הַנֹּשְׂאִים אֶת אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה וְאֶל כּל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses wrote this instruction and gave it to the
priests, sons of Levi, who were carrying the ark of YHWH’s
covenant and to all of Israel’s elders.

translation.text: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and unto all the elders of Israel.

verses.english:
And Moses wrote this instruction and gave it to the
priests, sons of Levi, who were carrying the ark of YHWH’s
covenant and to all of Israel’s elders.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אוֹתָם לֵאמֹר מִקֵּץ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים בְּמֹעֵד שְׁנַת הַשְּׁמִטָּה בְּחַג הַסֻּכּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אוֹתָם לֵאמֹר מִקֵּץ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים בְּמֹעֵד שְׁנַת הַשְּׁמִטָּה בְּחַג הַסֻּכּוֹת׃

english.text:
And Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of seven
years, at the appointed time of the year of the remission,
on the Festival of Booths,

translation.text: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,

verses.english:
And Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of seven
years, at the appointed time of the year of the remission,
on the Festival of Booths,

verses.hebrew: בְּבוֹא כל יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵרָאוֹת אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחָר תִּקְרָא אֶת הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת נֶגֶד כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאזְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: בְּבוֹא כל יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵרָאוֹת אֶת פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחָר תִּקְרָא אֶת הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת נֶגֶד כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאזְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
when all Israel comes to appear before YHWH, your God, in
the place that He will choose, you shall read this
instruction in front of all Israel in their ears.

translation.text: When all Israel is come to appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

verses.english:
when all Israel comes to appear before YHWH, your God, in
the place that He will choose, you shall read this
instruction in front of all Israel in their ears.

verses.hebrew: הַקְהֵל אֶת הָעָם הָאֲנָשִׁים וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַטַּף וְגֵרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ לְמַעַן יִשְׁמְעוּ וּלְמַעַן יִלְמְדוּ וְיָרְאוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְשָׁמְרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: הַקְהֵל אֶת הָעָם הָאֲנָשִׁים וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַטַּף וְגֵרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ לְמַעַן יִשְׁמְעוּ וּלְמַעַן יִלְמְדוּ וְיָרְאוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְשָׁמְרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
Assemble the people—the men and the women and the infants
and your alien who is in your gates—so they will listen
and so they will learn and will fear YHWH, your God, and
they will be watchful to do all the words of this
instruction.

translation.text: Gather the people together, men and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:

verses.english:
Assemble the people—the men and the women and the infants
and your alien who is in your gates—so they will listen
and so they will learn and will fear YHWH, your God, and
they will be watchful to do all the words of this
instruction.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ יִשְׁמְעוּ וְלָמְדוּ לְיִרְאָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כּל הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם חַיִּים עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ יִשְׁמְעוּ וְלָמְדוּ לְיִרְאָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כּל הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם חַיִּים עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
And their children who have not known will listen and
learn to fear YHWH, your God, all the days that you’re
living on the land to which you’re crossing the Jordan to
take possession of it.”

translation.text: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

verses.english:
And their children who have not known will listen and
learn to fear YHWH, your God, all the days that you’re
living on the land to which you’re crossing the Jordan to
take possession of it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הֵן קָרְבוּ יָמֶיךָ לָמוּת קְרָא אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְהִתְיַצְּבוּ בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַאֲצַוֶּנּוּ וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּתְיַצְּבוּ בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הֵן קָרְבוּ יָמֶיךָ לָמוּת קְרָא אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְהִתְיַצְּבוּ בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַאֲצַוֶּנּוּ וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּתְיַצְּבוּ בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Here, your days to die have come
close. Call Joshua, and stand up in the Tent of Meeting,
and I’ll command him.” And Moses and Joshua went and stood
up in the Tent of Meeting.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Here, your days to die have come
close. Call Joshua, and stand up in the Tent of Meeting,
and I’ll command him.” And Moses and Joshua went and stood
up in the Tent of Meeting.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא יְהֹוָה בָּאֹהֶל בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן וַיַּעֲמֹד עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן עַל פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָא יְהֹוָה בָּאֹהֶל בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן וַיַּעֲמֹד עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן עַל פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל׃

english.text:
And YHWH appeared in the tent in a column of cloud, and
the column of cloud stood at the entrance of the tent.

translation.text: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.

verses.english:
And YHWH appeared in the tent in a column of cloud, and
the column of cloud stood at the entrance of the tent.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הִנְּךָ שֹׁכֵב עִם אֲבֹתֶיךָ וְקָם הָעָם הַזֶּה וְזָנָה אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵי נֵכַר הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הוּא בָא שָׁמָּה בְּקִרְבּוֹ וַעֲזָבַנִי וְהֵפֵר אֶת בְּרִיתִי אֲשֶׁר כָּרַתִּי אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הִנְּךָ שֹׁכֵב עִם אֲבֹתֶיךָ וְקָם הָעָם הַזֶּה וְזָנָה אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵי נֵכַר הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הוּא בָא שָׁמָּה בְּקִרְבּוֹ וַעֲזָבַנִי וְהֵפֵר אֶת בְּרִיתִי אֲשֶׁר כָּרַתִּי אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Here, when you’re lying with your
fathers, this people will get up and whore after foreign
gods of the land into which it is coming, and it will
leave me and break my covenant that I’ve made with it.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Moses, “Here, when you’re lying with your
fathers, this people will get up and whore after foreign
gods of the land into which it is coming, and it will
leave me and break my covenant that I’ve made with it.

verses.hebrew: וְחָרָה אַפִּי בוֹ בַיּוֹם הַהוּא וַעֲזַבְתִּים וְהִסְתַּרְתִּי פָנַי מֵהֶם וְהָיָה לֶאֱכֹל וּמְצָאֻהוּ רָעוֹת רַבּוֹת וְצָרוֹת וְאָמַר בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא הֲלֹא עַל כִּי אֵין אֱלֹהַי בְּקִרְבִּי מְצָאוּנִי הָרָעוֹת הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְחָרָה אַפִּי בוֹ בַיּוֹם הַהוּא וַעֲזַבְתִּים וְהִסְתַּרְתִּי פָנַי מֵהֶם וְהָיָה לֶאֱכֹל וּמְצָאֻהוּ רָעוֹת רַבּוֹת וְצָרוֹת וְאָמַר בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא הֲלֹא עַל כִּי אֵין אֱלֹהַי בְּקִרְבִּי מְצָאוּנִי הָרָעוֹת הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
And my anger will flare at it on that day, and I’ll leave
them, and I’ll hide my face from them, and it will become
prey, and many bad things and troubles will find it. And
it will say on that day, ‘Isn’t it because my God is not
present in me that these evils have found me?’

translation.text: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God is not among us?

verses.english:
And my anger will flare at it on that day, and I’ll leave
them, and I’ll hide my face from them, and it will become
prey, and many bad things and troubles will find it. And
it will say on that day, ‘Isn’t it because my God is not
present in me that these evils have found me?’

verses.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִי הַסְתֵּר אַסְתִּיר פָּנַי בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עַל כּל הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה כִּי פָנָה אֶל אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאָנֹכִי הַסְתֵּר אַסְתִּיר פָּנַי בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עַל כּל הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה כִּי פָנָה אֶל אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

english.text:
But I: I’ll hide my face on that day over all the bad that
it has done, because it turned to other gods.

translation.text: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.

verses.english:
But I: I’ll hide my face on that day over all the bad that
it has done, because it turned to other gods.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה כִּתְבוּ לָכֶם אֶת הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת וְלַמְּדָהּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׂימָהּ בְּפִיהֶם לְמַעַן תִּהְיֶה לִּי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת לְעֵד בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה כִּתְבוּ לָכֶם אֶת הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת וְלַמְּדָהּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׂימָהּ בְּפִיהֶם לְמַעַן תִּהְיֶה לִּי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת לְעֵד בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
So now write this song and teach it to the children of
Israel. Set it in their mouths, so this song will become a
witness for me among the children of Israel.

translation.text: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

verses.english:
So now write this song and teach it to the children of
Israel. Set it in their mouths, so this song will become a
witness for me among the children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֲבִיאֶנּוּ אֶל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָיו זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ וְאָכַל וְשָׂבַע וְדָשֵׁן וּפָנָה אֶל אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַעֲבָדוּם וְנִאֲצוּנִי וְהֵפֵר אֶת בְּרִיתִי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֲבִיאֶנּוּ אֶל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָיו זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ וְאָכַל וְשָׂבַע וְדָשֵׁן וּפָנָה אֶל אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַעֲבָדוּם וְנִאֲצוּנִי וְהֵפֵר אֶת בְּרִיתִי׃

english.text:
When I’ll bring it to the land that I swore to its
fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and it will eat and
be full and get fat and turn to other gods, and they will
serve them and reject me, and it will break my covenant,

translation.text: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.

verses.english:
When I’ll bring it to the land that I swore to its
fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and it will eat and
be full and get fat and turn to other gods, and they will
serve them and reject me, and it will break my covenant,

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי תִמְצֶאןָ אֹתוֹ רָעוֹת רַבּוֹת וְצָרוֹת וְעָנְתָה הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת לְפָנָיו לְעֵד כִּי לֹא תִשָּׁכַח מִפִּי זַרְעוֹ כִּי יָדַעְתִּי אֶת יִצְרוֹ אֲשֶׁר הוּא עֹשֶׂה הַיּוֹם בְּטֶרֶם אֲבִיאֶנּוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי תִמְצֶאןָ אֹתוֹ רָעוֹת רַבּוֹת וְצָרוֹת וְעָנְתָה הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת לְפָנָיו לְעֵד כִּי לֹא תִשָּׁכַח מִפִּי זַרְעוֹ כִּי יָדַעְתִּי אֶת יִצְרוֹ אֲשֶׁר הוּא עֹשֶׂה הַיּוֹם בְּטֶרֶם אֲבִיאֶנּוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי׃

english.text:
then it will be, when many bad things and troubles will
find it, that this song will testify as a witness in front
of it, because it won’t be forgotten from its seed’s
mouth. Because I know its inclination that it is doing
today even before I bring it to the land that I swore.”
