translation.text: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.

verses.english:
then it will be, when many bad things and troubles will
find it, that this song will testify as a witness in front
of it, because it won’t be forgotten from its seed’s
mouth. Because I know its inclination that it is doing
today even before I bring it to the land that I swore.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיְלַמְּדָהּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיְלַמְּדָהּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses wrote this song on that day, and he taught it to
the children of Israel.

translation.text: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And Moses wrote this song on that day, and he taught it to
the children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן וַיֹּאמֶר חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ כִּי אַתָּה תָּבִיא אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לָהֶם וְאָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן וַיֹּאמֶר חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ כִּי אַתָּה תָּבִיא אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לָהֶם וְאָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
And He commanded Joshua, son of Nun, and said, “Be strong
and bold, because you will bring the children of Israel to
the land that I swore to them, and I shall be with you.”

translation.text: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.

verses.english:
And He commanded Joshua, son of Nun, and said, “Be strong
and bold, because you will bring the children of Israel to
the land that I swore to them, and I shall be with you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת מֹשֶׁה לִכְתֹּב אֶת דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת עַל סֵפֶר עַד תֻּמָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת מֹשֶׁה לִכְתֹּב אֶת דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת עַל סֵפֶר עַד תֻּמָּם׃

english.text:
And it was when Moses finished writing the words of this
instruction on a scroll to their end,

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

verses.english:
And it was when Moses finished writing the words of this
instruction on a scroll to their end,

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַלְוִיִּם נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַלְוִיִּם נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
and Moses commanded the Levites, who carried the ark of
the covenant of YHWH, saying,

translation.text: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,

verses.english:
and Moses commanded the Levites, who carried the ark of
the covenant of YHWH, saying,

verses.hebrew: לָקֹחַ אֵת סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֶּה וְשַׂמְתֶּם אֹתוֹ מִצַּד אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְהָיָה שָׁם בְּךָ לְעֵד׃

hebrew.text: לָקֹחַ אֵת סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֶּה וְשַׂמְתֶּם אֹתוֹ מִצַּד אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְהָיָה שָׁם בְּךָ לְעֵד׃

english.text:
“Take this scroll of instruction and set it at the side of
the ark of the covenant of YHWH, your God, and it will be
there for you as a witness.

translation.text: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.

verses.english:
“Take this scroll of instruction and set it at the side of
the ark of the covenant of YHWH, your God, and it will be
there for you as a witness.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אָנֹכִי יָדַעְתִּי אֶת מֶרְיְךָ וְאֶת ערְפְּךָ הַקָּשֶׁה הֵן בְּעוֹדֶנִּי חַי עִמָּכֶם הַיּוֹם מַמְרִים הֱיִתֶם עִם יְהֹוָה וְאַף כִּי אַחֲרֵי מוֹתִי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אָנֹכִי יָדַעְתִּי אֶת מֶרְיְךָ וְאֶת ערְפְּךָ הַקָּשֶׁה הֵן בְּעוֹדֶנִּי חַי עִמָּכֶם הַיּוֹם מַמְרִים הֱיִתֶם עִם יְהֹוָה וְאַף כִּי אַחֲרֵי מוֹתִי׃

english.text:
Because I know your rebellion and your hard neck. Here,
while I’m still alive with you today, you’ve been
rebelling at YHWH, so how much more after my death!

translation.text: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the LORD; and how much more after my death?

verses.english:
Because I know your rebellion and your hard neck. Here,
while I’m still alive with you today, you’ve been
rebelling at YHWH, so how much more after my death!

verses.hebrew: הַקְהִילוּ אֵלַי אֶת כּל זִקְנֵי שִׁבְטֵיכֶם וְשֹׁטְרֵיכֶם וַאֲדַבְּרָה בְאזְנֵיהֶם אֵת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאָעִידָה בָּם אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: הַקְהִילוּ אֵלַי אֶת כּל זִקְנֵי שִׁבְטֵיכֶם וְשֹׁטְרֵיכֶם וַאֲדַבְּרָה בְאזְנֵיהֶם אֵת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאָעִידָה בָּם אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Assemble all the elders of your tribes and your officers
to me so I may speak these things in their ears and call
the skies and the earth to witness regarding them,

translation.text: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.

verses.english:
Assemble all the elders of your tribes and your officers
to me so I may speak these things in their ears and call
the skies and the earth to witness regarding them,

verses.hebrew: כִּי יָדַעְתִּי אַחֲרֵי מוֹתִי כִּי הַשְׁחֵת תַּשְׁחִתוּן וְסַרְתֶּם מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם וְקָרָאת אֶתְכֶם הָרָעָה בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים כִּי תַעֲשׂוּ אֶת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יָדַעְתִּי אַחֲרֵי מוֹתִי כִּי הַשְׁחֵת תַּשְׁחִתוּן וְסַרְתֶּם מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם וְקָרָאת אֶתְכֶם הָרָעָה בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים כִּי תַעֲשׂוּ אֶת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
because I know, after my death, that you’ll be corrupted,
and you’ll turn from the way that I’ve commanded you. And
the bad thing will happen to you in the future days when
you’ll do what is bad in YHWH’s eyes to provoke Him with
your hands’ work.”

translation.text: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.

verses.english:
because I know, after my death, that you’ll be corrupted,
and you’ll turn from the way that I’ve commanded you. And
the bad thing will happen to you in the future days when
you’ll do what is bad in YHWH’s eyes to provoke Him with
your hands’ work.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה בְּאזְנֵי כּל קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת דִּבְרֵי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת עַד תֻּמָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה בְּאזְנֵי כּל קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת דִּבְרֵי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת עַד תֻּמָּם׃

english.text:
And Moses spoke in the ears of all the community of Israel
the words of this song to their end:

translation.text: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.

verses.english:
And Moses spoke in the ears of all the community of Israel
the words of this song to their end:

verses.hebrew: הַאֲזִינוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וַאֲדַבֵּרָה וְתִשְׁמַע הָאָרֶץ אִמְרֵי פִי׃

hebrew.text: הַאֲזִינוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וַאֲדַבֵּרָה וְתִשְׁמַע הָאָרֶץ אִמְרֵי פִי׃

english.text:
Listen, skies, so I may speak and let the earth
hear what my mouth says.

translation.text: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

verses.english:
Listen, skies, so I may speak and let the earth
hear what my mouth says.

verses.hebrew: יַעֲרֹף כַּמָּטָר לִקְחִי תִּזַּל כַּטַּל אִמְרָתִי כִּשְׂעִירִם עֲלֵי דֶשֶׁא וְכִרְבִיבִים עֲלֵי עֵשֶׂב׃

hebrew.text: יַעֲרֹף כַּמָּטָר לִקְחִי תִּזַּל כַּטַּל אִמְרָתִי כִּשְׂעִירִם עֲלֵי דֶשֶׁא וְכִרְבִיבִים עֲלֵי עֵשֶׂב׃

english.text:
Let my teaching come down like showers; let my saying
emerge like dew, like raindrops on plants and like
rainfalls on herbs.

translation.text: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:

verses.english:
Let my teaching come down like showers; let my saying
emerge like dew, like raindrops on plants and like
rainfalls on herbs.

verses.hebrew: כִּי שֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֶקְרָא הָבוּ גֹדֶל לֵאלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי שֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֶקְרָא הָבוּ גֹדֶל לֵאלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text: When I call YHWH’s name, avow our God’s greatness.

translation.text: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.

verses.english: When I call YHWH’s name, avow our God’s greatness.

verses.hebrew: הַצּוּר תָּמִים פּעֳלוֹ כִּי כל דְּרָכָיו מִשְׁפָּט אֵל אֱמוּנָה וְאֵין עָוֶל צַדִּיק וְיָשָׁר הוּא׃

hebrew.text: הַצּוּר תָּמִים פּעֳלוֹ כִּי כל דְּרָכָיו מִשְׁפָּט אֵל אֱמוּנָה וְאֵין עָוֶל צַדִּיק וְיָשָׁר הוּא׃

english.text:
The Rock: His work is unblemished, for all His ways are
judgment. A God of trust, and without injustice, He’s
virtuous and right.

translation.text: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.

verses.english:
The Rock: His work is unblemished, for all His ways are
judgment. A God of trust, and without injustice, He’s
virtuous and right.

verses.hebrew: שִׁחֵת לוֹ לֹא בָּנָיו מוּמָם דּוֹר עִקֵּשׁ וּפְתַלְתֹּל׃

hebrew.text: שִׁחֵת לוֹ לֹא בָּנָיו מוּמָם דּוֹר עִקֵּשׁ וּפְתַלְתֹּל׃

english.text:
It corrupted at Him—not His children, their flaw— a
crooked and twisted generation.

translation.text: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.

verses.english:
It corrupted at Him—not His children, their flaw— a
crooked and twisted generation.

verses.hebrew: הַ לְיְהֹוָה תִּגְמְלוּ זֹאת עַם נָבָל וְלֹא חָכָם הֲלוֹא הוּא אָבִיךָ קָּנֶךָ הוּא עָשְׂךָ וַיְכֹנְנֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: הַ לְיְהֹוָה תִּגְמְלוּ זֹאת עַם נָבָל וְלֹא חָכָם הֲלוֹא הוּא אָבִיךָ קָּנֶךָ הוּא עָשְׂךָ וַיְכֹנְנֶךָ׃

english.text:
Is it to YHWH that you repay like this?! Foolish people
and unwise! Isn’t He your father, who created you, He who
made you and reared you?

translation.text: Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?

verses.english:
Is it to YHWH that you repay like this?! Foolish people
and unwise! Isn’t He your father, who created you, He who
made you and reared you?

verses.hebrew: זְכֹר יְמוֹת עוֹלָם בִּינוּ שְׁנוֹת דֹּר וָדֹר שְׁאַל אָבִיךָ וְיַגֵּדְךָ זְקֵנֶיךָ וְיֹאמְרוּ לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: זְכֹר יְמוֹת עוֹלָם בִּינוּ שְׁנוֹת דֹּר וָדֹר שְׁאַל אָבִיךָ וְיַגֵּדְךָ זְקֵנֶיךָ וְיֹאמְרוּ לָךְ׃

english.text:
Remember the days of old. Grasp the years through
generations. Ask your father, and he’ll tell you, your
elders, and they’ll say to you:

translation.text: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.

verses.english:
Remember the days of old. Grasp the years through
generations. Ask your father, and he’ll tell you, your
elders, and they’ll say to you:

verses.hebrew:
בְּהַנְחֵל
\hDtrBעֶלְיוֹן
גּוֹיִם בְּהַפְרִידוֹ בְּנֵי אָדָם יַצֵּב גְּבֻלֹת עַמִּים לְמִסְפַּר בְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: בְּהַנְחֵל עֶלְיוֹן גּוֹיִם בְּהַפְרִידוֹ בְּנֵי אָדָם יַצֵּב גְּבֻלֹת עַמִּים לְמִסְפַּר בְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
When the Highest gave nations legacies, when He dispersed
humankind, He set the peoples’ borders to the number of
the children of the gods.

translation.text: When the Most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.

verses.english:
When the Highest gave nations legacies, when He dispersed
humankind, He set the peoples’ borders to the number of
the children of the gods.

verses.hebrew: כִּי חֵלֶק יְהֹוָה עַמּוֹ יַעֲקֹב חֶבֶל נַחֲלָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי חֵלֶק יְהֹוָה עַמּוֹ יַעֲקֹב חֶבֶל נַחֲלָתוֹ׃

english.text:
For YHWH’s portion is His people. Jacob is the share of
His legacy.

translation.text: For the LORD’s portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

verses.english:
For YHWH’s portion is His people. Jacob is the share of
His legacy.

verses.hebrew: יִמְצָאֵהוּ בְּאֶרֶץ מִדְבָּר וּבְתֹהוּ יְלֵל יְשִׁמֹן יְסֹבְבֶנְהוּ יְבוֹנְנֵהוּ יִצְּרֶנְהוּ כְּאִישׁוֹן עֵינוֹ׃

hebrew.text: יִמְצָאֵהוּ בְּאֶרֶץ מִדְבָּר וּבְתֹהוּ יְלֵל יְשִׁמֹן יְסֹבְבֶנְהוּ יְבוֹנְנֵהוּ יִצְּרֶנְהוּ כְּאִישׁוֹן עֵינוֹ׃

english.text:
He found it in a wilderness land and in a formless place,
a howling desert. He surrounded it. He attended to it. He
guarded it, like the pupil of his eye.

translation.text: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.

verses.english:
He found it in a wilderness land and in a formless place,
a howling desert. He surrounded it. He attended to it. He
guarded it, like the pupil of his eye.

verses.hebrew: כְּנֶשֶׁר יָעִיר קִנּוֹ עַל גּוֹזָלָיו יְרַחֵף יִפְרֹשׂ כְּנָפָיו יִקָּחֵהוּ יִשָּׂאֵהוּ עַל אֶבְרָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כְּנֶשֶׁר יָעִיר קִנּוֹ עַל גּוֹזָלָיו יְרַחֵף יִפְרֹשׂ כְּנָפָיו יִקָּחֵהוּ יִשָּׂאֵהוּ עַל אֶבְרָתוֹ׃

english.text:
As an eagle stirs its nest, hovers over its young, spreads
its wings, takes it, lifts it on its pinion,

translation.text: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:

verses.english:
As an eagle stirs its nest, hovers over its young, spreads
its wings, takes it, lifts it on its pinion,

verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה בָּדָד יַנְחֶנּוּ וְאֵין עִמּוֹ אֵל נֵכָר׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה בָּדָד יַנְחֶנּוּ וְאֵין עִמּוֹ אֵל נֵכָר׃

english.text: YHWH, alone, led it, and no foreign god with Him.

translation.text: So the LORD alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.

verses.english: YHWH, alone, led it, and no foreign god with Him.

verses.hebrew: יַרְכִּבֵהוּ עַל [בָּמֳתֵי] (במותי) אָרֶץ וַיֹּאכַל תְּנוּבֹת שָׂדָי וַיֵּנִקֵהוּ דְבַשׁ מִסֶּלַע וְשֶׁמֶן מֵחַלְמִישׁ צוּר׃

hebrew.text: יַרְכִּבֵהוּ עַל [בָּמֳתֵי] (במותי) אָרֶץ וַיֹּאכַל תְּנוּבֹת שָׂדָי וַיֵּנִקֵהוּ דְבַשׁ מִסֶּלַע וְשֶׁמֶן מֵחַלְמִישׁ צוּר׃

english.text:
He had it ride over earth’s high places and fed it the
field’s bounties and had it suck honey from a rock and oil
from a flint rock

translation.text: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;

verses.english:
He had it ride over earth’s high places and fed it the
field’s bounties and had it suck honey from a rock and oil
from a flint rock

verses.hebrew: חֶמְאַת בָּקָר וַחֲלֵב צֹאן עִם חֵלֶב כָּרִים וְאֵילִים בְּנֵי בָשָׁן וְעַתּוּדִים עִם חֵלֶב כִּלְיוֹת חִטָּה וְדַם עֵנָב תִּשְׁתֶּה חָמֶר׃

hebrew.text: חֶמְאַת בָּקָר וַחֲלֵב צֹאן עִם חֵלֶב כָּרִים וְאֵילִים בְּנֵי בָשָׁן וְעַתּוּדִים עִם חֵלֶב כִּלְיוֹת חִטָּה וְדַם עֵנָב תִּשְׁתֶּה חָמֶר׃

english.text:
and curds of cattle and milk of the flock and fat of lambs
and Bashan rams and he-goats with fat of innards of wheat
—and from grape’s blood you drank wine.

translation.text: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.

verses.english:
and curds of cattle and milk of the flock and fat of lambs
and Bashan rams and he-goats with fat of innards of wheat
—and from grape’s blood you drank wine.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַן יְשֻׁרוּן וַיִּבְעָט שָׁמַנְתָּ עָבִיתָ כָּשִׂיתָ וַיִּטֹּשׁ אֱלוֹהַּ עָשָׂהוּ וַיְנַבֵּל צוּר יְשֻׁעָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַן יְשֻׁרוּן וַיִּבְעָט שָׁמַנְתָּ עָבִיתָ כָּשִׂיתָ וַיִּטֹּשׁ אֱלוֹהַּ עָשָׂהוּ וַיְנַבֵּל צוּר יְשֻׁעָתוֹ׃

english.text:
And Jeshurun got fat and kicked —you got fat, you got
wide, you got stuffed!— and it left God who made it and
took its saving rock for granted.

translation.text: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

verses.english:
And Jeshurun got fat and kicked —you got fat, you got
wide, you got stuffed!— and it left God who made it and
took its saving rock for granted.

verses.hebrew: יַקְנִאֻהוּ בְּזָרִים בְּתוֹעֵבֹת יַכְעִיסֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: יַקְנִאֻהוּ בְּזָרִים בְּתוֹעֵבֹת יַכְעִיסֻהוּ׃

english.text:
They made Him jealous with outsiders. With offensive
things they made him angry.

translation.text: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.

verses.english:
They made Him jealous with outsiders. With offensive
things they made him angry.

verses.hebrew: יִזְבְּחוּ לַשֵּׁדִים לֹא אֱלֹהַּ אֱלֹהִים לֹא יְדָעוּם חֲדָשִׁים מִקָּרֹב בָּאוּ לֹא שְׂעָרוּם אֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: יִזְבְּחוּ לַשֵּׁדִים לֹא אֱלֹהַּ אֱלֹהִים לֹא יְדָעוּם חֲדָשִׁים מִקָּרֹב בָּאוּ לֹא שְׂעָרוּם אֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
They sacrificed to demons, a non-god, gods they hadn’t
known; new ones, they came of late; your fathers hadn’t
been acquainted with them.

translation.text: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.

verses.english:
They sacrificed to demons, a non-god, gods they hadn’t
known; new ones, they came of late; your fathers hadn’t
been acquainted with them.

verses.hebrew: צוּר יְלָדְךָ תֶּשִׁי וַתִּשְׁכַּח אֵל מְחֹלְלֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: צוּר יְלָדְךָ תֶּשִׁי וַתִּשְׁכַּח אֵל מְחֹלְלֶךָ׃

english.text:
The rock that fathered you, you ignored, and you forgot
God who bore you.

translation.text: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.

verses.english:
The rock that fathered you, you ignored, and you forgot
God who bore you.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יְהֹוָה וַיִּנְאָץ מִכַּעַס בָּנָיו וּבְנֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יְהֹוָה וַיִּנְאָץ מִכַּעַס בָּנָיו וּבְנֹתָיו׃

english.text:
And YHWH saw and rejected from His sons’ and His
daughters’ angering.

translation.text: And when the LORD saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.

verses.english:
And YHWH saw and rejected from His sons’ and His
daughters’ angering.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַסְתִּירָה פָנַי מֵהֶם אֶרְאֶה מָה אַחֲרִיתָם כִּי דוֹר תַּהְפֻּכֹת הֵמָּה בָּנִים לֹא אֵמֻן בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַסְתִּירָה פָנַי מֵהֶם אֶרְאֶה מָה אַחֲרִיתָם כִּי דוֹר תַּהְפֻּכֹת הֵמָּה בָּנִים לֹא אֵמֻן בָּם׃

english.text:
And He said, “Let me hide my face from them; I’ll see what
their future will be. For they’re a generation of
overthrows, children with no trust in them.

translation.text: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.

verses.english:
And He said, “Let me hide my face from them; I’ll see what
their future will be. For they’re a generation of
overthrows, children with no trust in them.

verses.hebrew: הֵם קִנְאוּנִי בְלֹא אֵל כִּעֲסוּנִי בְּהַבְלֵיהֶם וַאֲנִי אַקְנִיאֵם בְּלֹא עָם בְּגוֹי נָבָל אַכְעִיסֵם׃

hebrew.text: הֵם קִנְאוּנִי בְלֹא אֵל כִּעֲסוּנִי בְּהַבְלֵיהֶם וַאֲנִי אַקְנִיאֵם בְּלֹא עָם בְּגוֹי נָבָל אַכְעִיסֵם׃

english.text:
They made me jealous with no-god. They made me angry with
their nothings. And I: I’ll make them jealous with
no-people. I’ll make them angry with a foolish nation.

translation.text: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

verses.english:
They made me jealous with no-god. They made me angry with
their nothings. And I: I’ll make them jealous with
no-people. I’ll make them angry with a foolish nation.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵשׁ קָדְחָה בְאַפִּי וַתִּיקַד עַד שְׁאוֹל תַּחְתִּית וַתֹּאכַל אֶרֶץ וִיבֻלָהּ וַתְּלַהֵט מוֹסְדֵי הָרִים׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֵשׁ קָדְחָה בְאַפִּי וַתִּיקַד עַד שְׁאוֹל תַּחְתִּית וַתֹּאכַל אֶרֶץ וִיבֻלָהּ וַתְּלַהֵט מוֹסְדֵי הָרִים׃

english.text:
For fire has ignited in my anger and burned to Sheol at
bottom and consumed land and its crop and set the
mountains’ foundations ablaze.

translation.text: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.

verses.english:
For fire has ignited in my anger and burned to Sheol at
bottom and consumed land and its crop and set the
mountains’ foundations ablaze.

verses.hebrew: אַסְפֶּה עָלֵימוֹ רָעוֹת חִצַּי אֲכַלֶּה בָּם׃

hebrew.text: אַסְפֶּה עָלֵימוֹ רָעוֹת חִצַּי אֲכַלֶּה בָּם׃

english.text:
I’ll mass bad things over them. I’ll exhaust my arrows on
them,

translation.text: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.

verses.english:
I’ll mass bad things over them. I’ll exhaust my arrows on
them,

verses.hebrew: מְזֵי רָעָב וּלְחֻמֵי רֶשֶׁף וְקֶטֶב מְרִירִי וְשֶׁן בְּהֵמֹת אֲשַׁלַּח בָּם עִם חֲמַת זֹחֲלֵי עָפָר׃

hebrew.text: מְזֵי רָעָב וּלְחֻמֵי רֶשֶׁף וְקֶטֶב מְרִירִי וְשֶׁן בְּהֵמֹת אֲשַׁלַּח בָּם עִם חֲמַת זֹחֲלֵי עָפָר׃

english.text:
sapped by hunger and devoured by flame. And bitter
destruction and animals’ teeth I’ll let loose at them with
venom of serpents of the dust.

translation.text: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.

verses.english:
sapped by hunger and devoured by flame. And bitter
destruction and animals’ teeth I’ll let loose at them with
venom of serpents of the dust.

verses.hebrew: מִחוּץ תְּשַׁכֶּל חֶרֶב וּמֵחֲדָרִים אֵימָה גַּם בָּחוּר גַּם בְּתוּלָה יוֹנֵק עִם אִישׁ שֵׂיבָה׃

hebrew.text: מִחוּץ תְּשַׁכֶּל חֶרֶב וּמֵחֲדָרִים אֵימָה גַּם בָּחוּר גַּם בְּתוּלָה יוֹנֵק עִם אִישׁ שֵׂיבָה׃

english.text:
Outside: a sword will bereave, and inside: terror, both
young man and virgin, suckling with aged man.

translation.text: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.

verses.english:
Outside: a sword will bereave, and inside: terror, both
young man and virgin, suckling with aged man.

verses.hebrew: אָמַרְתִּי אַפְאֵיהֶם אַשְׁבִּיתָה מֵאֱנוֹשׁ זִכְרָם׃

hebrew.text: אָמַרְתִּי אַפְאֵיהֶם אַשְׁבִּיתָה מֵאֱנוֹשׁ זִכְרָם׃

english.text:
I’d say, ‘I’ll erase them. I’ll make their memory cease
from mankind,’

translation.text: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:

verses.english:
I’d say, ‘I’ll erase them. I’ll make their memory cease
from mankind,’

verses.hebrew: לוּלֵי כַּעַס אוֹיֵב אָגוּר פֶּן יְנַכְּרוּ צָרֵימוֹ פֶּן יֹאמְרוּ יָדֵנוּ רָמָה וְלֹא יְהֹוָה פָּעַל כּל זֹאת׃

hebrew.text: לוּלֵי כַּעַס אוֹיֵב אָגוּר פֶּן יְנַכְּרוּ צָרֵימוֹ פֶּן יֹאמְרוּ יָדֵנוּ רָמָה וְלֹא יְהֹוָה פָּעַל כּל זֹאת׃

english.text:
if I didn’t fear the enemy’s anger, in case their foes
would misread, in case they’d say, ‘Our hand was high, and
it wasn’t YHWH who did all this!’

translation.text: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the LORD hath not done all this.

verses.english:
if I didn’t fear the enemy’s anger, in case their foes
would misread, in case they’d say, ‘Our hand was high, and
it wasn’t YHWH who did all this!’

verses.hebrew: כִּי גוֹי אֹבַד עֵצוֹת הֵמָּה וְאֵין בָּהֶם תְּבוּנָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי גוֹי אֹבַד עֵצוֹת הֵמָּה וְאֵין בָּהֶם תְּבוּנָה׃

english.text:
For they’re a nation void of counsel, and there’s no
understanding in them.

translation.text: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.

verses.english:
For they’re a nation void of counsel, and there’s no
understanding in them.

verses.hebrew: לוּ חָכְמוּ יַשְׂכִּילוּ זֹאת יָבִינוּ לְאַחֲרִיתָם׃

hebrew.text: לוּ חָכְמוּ יַשְׂכִּילוּ זֹאת יָבִינוּ לְאַחֲרִיתָם׃

english.text:
If they were wise they’d comprehend this; they’d grasp
their future.

translation.text: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

verses.english:
If they were wise they’d comprehend this; they’d grasp
their future.

verses.hebrew: אֵיכָה יִרְדֹּף אֶחָד אֶלֶף וּשְׁנַיִם יָנִיסוּ רְבָבָה אִם לֹא כִּי צוּרָם מְכָרָם וַיהֹוָה הִסְגִּירָם׃

hebrew.text: אֵיכָה יִרְדֹּף אֶחָד אֶלֶף וּשְׁנַיִם יָנִיסוּ רְבָבָה אִם לֹא כִּי צוּרָם מְכָרָם וַיהֹוָה הִסְגִּירָם׃

english.text:
How could one pursue a thousand and two chase ten thousand
if not that their rock had sold them, that YHWH had turned
them over?”

translation.text: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?

verses.english:
How could one pursue a thousand and two chase ten thousand
if not that their rock had sold them, that YHWH had turned
them over?”

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא כְצוּרֵנוּ צוּרָם וְאֹיְבֵינוּ פְּלִילִים׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא כְצוּרֵנוּ צוּרָם וְאֹיְבֵינוּ פְּלִילִים׃

english.text:
For their rock is not like our rock, though our enemies
are the judges.

translation.text: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.

verses.english:
For their rock is not like our rock, though our enemies
are the judges.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מִגֶּפֶן סְדֹם גַּפְנָם וּמִשַּׁדְמֹת עֲמֹרָה עֲנָבֵמוֹ עִנְּבֵי רוֹשׁ אַשְׁכְּלֹת מְרֹרֹת לָמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי מִגֶּפֶן סְדֹם גַּפְנָם וּמִשַּׁדְמֹת עֲמֹרָה עֲנָבֵמוֹ עִנְּבֵי רוֹשׁ אַשְׁכְּלֹת מְרֹרֹת לָמוֹ׃

english.text:
For their vine is from Sodom’s vine and from Gomorrah’s
fields. Their grapes are poison grapes. They have bitter
clusters.

translation.text: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:

verses.english:
For their vine is from Sodom’s vine and from Gomorrah’s
fields. Their grapes are poison grapes. They have bitter
clusters.

verses.hebrew: חֲמַת תַּנִּינִם יֵינָם וְרֹאשׁ פְּתָנִים אַכְזָר׃

hebrew.text: חֲמַת תַּנִּינִם יֵינָם וְרֹאשׁ פְּתָנִים אַכְזָר׃

english.text: Their wine is serpents’ venom and cruel poison of cobras.

translation.text: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.

verses.english: Their wine is serpents’ venom and cruel poison of cobras.

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא הוּא כָּמֻס עִמָּדִי חָתוּם בְּאוֹצְרֹתָי׃

hebrew.text: הֲלֹא הוּא כָּמֻס עִמָּדִי חָתוּם בְּאוֹצְרֹתָי׃

english.text: “Isn’t it stored with me, sealed in my treasuries?

translation.text: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?

verses.english: “Isn’t it stored with me, sealed in my treasuries?

verses.hebrew: לִי נָקָם וְשִׁלֵּם לְעֵת תָּמוּט רַגְלָם כִּי קָרוֹב יוֹם אֵידָם וְחָשׁ עֲתִדֹת לָמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לִי נָקָם וְשִׁלֵּם לְעֵת תָּמוּט רַגְלָם כִּי קָרוֹב יוֹם אֵידָם וְחָשׁ עֲתִדֹת לָמוֹ׃

english.text:
Vengeance and recompense are mine, for the time their foot
will slip; for the day of their ordeal is close and comes
fast: things prepared for them.”

translation.text: To me belongeth vengeance and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.

verses.english:
Vengeance and recompense are mine, for the time their foot
will slip; for the day of their ordeal is close and comes
fast: things prepared for them.”

verses.hebrew: כִּי יָדִין יְהֹוָה עַמּוֹ וְעַל עֲבָדָיו יִתְנֶחָם כִּי יִרְאֶה כִּי אָזְלַת יָד וְאֶפֶס עָצוּר וְעָזוּב׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יָדִין יְהֹוָה עַמּוֹ וְעַל עֲבָדָיו יִתְנֶחָם כִּי יִרְאֶה כִּי אָזְלַת יָד וְאֶפֶס עָצוּר וְעָזוּב׃

english.text:
For YHWH will judge His people and regret about His
servants when He’ll see that their strength is gone and
there’s none: held back or left alone.

translation.text: For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.

verses.english:
For YHWH will judge His people and regret about His
servants when He’ll see that their strength is gone and
there’s none: held back or left alone.

verses.hebrew: וְאָמַר אֵי אֱלֹהֵימוֹ צוּר חָסָיוּ בוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַר אֵי אֱלֹהֵימוֹ צוּר חָסָיוּ בוֹ׃

english.text:
And He’ll say, “Where are their gods, the rock in whom
they sought refuge,

translation.text: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,

verses.english:
And He’ll say, “Where are their gods, the rock in whom
they sought refuge,

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר חֵלֶב זְבָחֵימוֹ יֹאכֵלוּ יִשְׁתּוּ יֵין נְסִיכָם יָקוּמוּ וְיַעְזְרֻכֶם יְהִי עֲלֵיכֶם סִתְרָה׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר חֵלֶב זְבָחֵימוֹ יֹאכֵלוּ יִשְׁתּוּ יֵין נְסִיכָם יָקוּמוּ וְיַעְזְרֻכֶם יְהִי עֲלֵיכֶם סִתְרָה׃

english.text:
who would eat the fat of their sacrifices, would drink the
wine of their libations? Let them get up and help you! Let
that be a shelter over you.

translation.text: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.

verses.english:
who would eat the fat of their sacrifices, would drink the
wine of their libations? Let them get up and help you! Let
that be a shelter over you.

verses.hebrew: רְאוּ עַתָּה כִּי אֲנִי אֲנִי הוּא וְאֵין אֱלֹהִים עִמָּדִי אֲנִי אָמִית וַאֲחַיֶּה מָחַצְתִּי וַאֲנִי אֶרְפָּא וְאֵין מִיָּדִי מַצִּיל׃

hebrew.text: רְאוּ עַתָּה כִּי אֲנִי אֲנִי הוּא וְאֵין אֱלֹהִים עִמָּדִי אֲנִי אָמִית וַאֲחַיֶּה מָחַצְתִּי וַאֲנִי אֶרְפָּא וְאֵין מִיָּדִי מַצִּיל׃

english.text:
See now that I, I am He, and there is no god with me. I
cause death and give life. I’ve pierced, and I’ll heal.
And there’s no deliverer from my hand,

translation.text: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.

verses.english:
See now that I, I am He, and there is no god with me. I
cause death and give life. I’ve pierced, and I’ll heal.
And there’s no deliverer from my hand,

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶשָּׂא אֶל שָׁמַיִם יָדִי וְאָמַרְתִּי חַי אָנֹכִי לְעֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֶשָּׂא אֶל שָׁמַיִם יָדִי וְאָמַרְתִּי חַי אָנֹכִי לְעֹלָם׃

english.text:
when I raise my hand to the skies, and I say, ‘As I live
forever,

translation.text: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.

verses.english:
when I raise my hand to the skies, and I say, ‘As I live
forever,

verses.hebrew: אִם שַׁנּוֹתִי בְּרַק חַרְבִּי וְתֹאחֵז בְּמִשְׁפָּט יָדִי אָשִׁיב נָקָם לְצָרָי וְלִמְשַׂנְאַי אֲשַׁלֵּם׃

hebrew.text: אִם שַׁנּוֹתִי בְּרַק חַרְבִּי וְתֹאחֵז בְּמִשְׁפָּט יָדִי אָשִׁיב נָקָם לְצָרָי וְלִמְשַׂנְאַי אֲשַׁלֵּם׃

english.text:
if I whet the lightning of my sword, and my hand takes
hold of judgment, I’ll give back vengeance to my foes and
pay back those who hate me.

translation.text: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.

verses.english:
if I whet the lightning of my sword, and my hand takes
hold of judgment, I’ll give back vengeance to my foes and
pay back those who hate me.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁכִּיר חִצַּי מִדָּם וְחַרְבִּי תֹּאכַל בָּשָׂר מִדַּם חָלָל וְשִׁבְיָה מֵרֹאשׁ פַּרְעוֹת אוֹיֵב׃

hebrew.text: אַשְׁכִּיר חִצַּי מִדָּם וְחַרְבִּי תֹּאכַל בָּשָׂר מִדַּם חָלָל וְשִׁבְיָה מֵרֹאשׁ פַּרְעוֹת אוֹיֵב׃

english.text:
I’ll make my arrows drunk with blood, and my sword will
eat flesh from the blood of the slain and captured, from
the head of loose hair of the enemy.’”

translation.text: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.

verses.english:
I’ll make my arrows drunk with blood, and my sword will
eat flesh from the blood of the slain and captured, from
the head of loose hair of the enemy.’”

verses.hebrew: הַרְנִינוּ גוֹיִם עַמּוֹ כִּי דַם עֲבָדָיו יִקּוֹם וְנָקָם יָשִׁיב לְצָרָיו וְכִפֶּר אַדְמָתוֹ עַמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: הַרְנִינוּ גוֹיִם עַמּוֹ כִּי דַם עֲבָדָיו יִקּוֹם וְנָקָם יָשִׁיב לְצָרָיו וְכִפֶּר אַדְמָתוֹ עַמּוֹ׃

english.text:
Nations: cheer His people! For He’ll requite His servants’
blood and give back vengeance to His foes and make
atonement for His land, His people.

translation.text: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.

verses.english:
Nations: cheer His people! For He’ll requite His servants’
blood and give back vengeance to His foes and make
atonement for His land, His people.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וַיְדַבֵּר אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת בְּאזְנֵי הָעָם הוּא וְהוֹשֵׁעַ בִּן נוּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וַיְדַבֵּר אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת בְּאזְנֵי הָעָם הוּא וְהוֹשֵׁעַ בִּן נוּן׃

english.text:
And Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the
people’s ears, he and Hoshea son of Nun.

translation.text: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.

verses.english:
And Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the
people’s ears, he and Hoshea son of Nun.

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַל מֹשֶׁה לְדַבֵּר אֶת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְכַל מֹשֶׁה לְדַבֵּר אֶת כּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Moses finished speaking all these things to all of
Israel.

translation.text: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:

verses.english:
And Moses finished speaking all these things to all of
Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם שִׂימוּ לְבַבְכֶם לְכל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מֵעִיד בָּכֶם הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר תְּצַוֻּם אֶת בְּנֵיכֶם לִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם שִׂימוּ לְבַבְכֶם לְכל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מֵעִיד בָּכֶם הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר תְּצַוֻּם אֶת בְּנֵיכֶם לִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
And he said to them, “Pay attention to all the things that
I testify regarding you today, that you’ll command them to
your children, to observe and to do all the words of this
instruction.

translation.text: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

verses.english:
And he said to them, “Pay attention to all the things that
I testify regarding you today, that you’ll command them to
your children, to observe and to do all the words of this
instruction.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא דָבָר רֵק הוּא מִכֶּם כִּי הוּא חַיֵּיכֶם וּבַדָּבָר הַזֶּה תַּאֲרִיכוּ יָמִים עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא דָבָר רֵק הוּא מִכֶּם כִּי הוּא חַיֵּיכֶם וּבַדָּבָר הַזֶּה תַּאֲרִיכוּ יָמִים עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
Because it’s not an empty thing for you, because it’s your
life. And through this thing you’ll extend days on the
land to which you’re crossing the Jordan to take
possession of it.”

translation.text: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

verses.english:
Because it’s not an empty thing for you, because it’s your
life. And through this thing you’ll extend days on the
land to which you’re crossing the Jordan to take
possession of it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And YHWH spoke to Moses in this very day, saying,

translation.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,

verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses in this very day, saying,

verses.hebrew: עֲלֵה אֶל הַר הָעֲבָרִים הַזֶּה הַר נְבוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי יְרֵחוֹ וּרְאֵה אֶת אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַאֲחֻזָּה׃

hebrew.text: עֲלֵה אֶל הַר הָעֲבָרִים הַזֶּה הַר נְבוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי יְרֵחוֹ וּרְאֵה אֶת אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַאֲחֻזָּה׃

english.text:
“Go up to this mountain of Abarim, Mount Nebo, which is in
the land of Moab, which is facing Jericho, and see the
land of Canaan, which I’m giving to the children of Israel
for a possession.

translation.text: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:

verses.english:
“Go up to this mountain of Abarim, Mount Nebo, which is in
the land of Moab, which is facing Jericho, and see the
land of Canaan, which I’m giving to the children of Israel
for a possession.

verses.hebrew: וּמֻת בָּהָר אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹלֶה שָׁמָּה וְהֵאָסֵף אֶל עַמֶּיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר מֵת אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ בְּהֹר הָהָר וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וּמֻת בָּהָר אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹלֶה שָׁמָּה וְהֵאָסֵף אֶל עַמֶּיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר מֵת אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ בְּהֹר הָהָר וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו׃

english.text:
And die in the mountain to which you’re going up, and be
gathered to your people, as Aaron, your brother, died in
Mount Hor and was gathered to his people,

translation.text: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:

verses.english:
And die in the mountain to which you’re going up, and be
gathered to your people, as Aaron, your brother, died in
Mount Hor and was gathered to his people,

verses.hebrew: עַל אֲשֶׁר מְעַלְתֶּם בִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמֵי מְרִיבַת קָדֵשׁ מִדְבַּר צִן עַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא קִדַּשְׁתֶּם אוֹתִי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: עַל אֲשֶׁר מְעַלְתֶּם בִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמֵי מְרִיבַת קָדֵשׁ מִדְבַּר צִן עַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא קִדַּשְׁתֶּם אוֹתִי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
because you made a breach with me among the children of
Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh at the
wilderness of Zin, because you didn’t make me holy among
the children of Israel.

translation.text: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of MeribahKadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.

verses.english:
because you made a breach with me among the children of
Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh at the
wilderness of Zin, because you didn’t make me holy among
the children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מִנֶּגֶד תִּרְאֶה אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְשָׁמָּה לֹא תָבוֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: כִּי מִנֶּגֶד תִּרְאֶה אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְשָׁמָּה לֹא תָבוֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Because you’ll see the land from opposite, but you shall
not come there, to the land that I’m giving to the
children of Israel.

translation.text: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.

verses.english:
Because you’ll see the land from opposite, but you shall
not come there, to the land that I’m giving to the
children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת הַבְּרָכָה אֲשֶׁר בֵּרַךְ מֹשֶׁה אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי מוֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְזֹאת הַבְּרָכָה אֲשֶׁר בֵּרַךְ מֹשֶׁה אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי מוֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
And this is the blessing with which Moses, the man of God,
blessed the children of Israel before his death.

translation.text: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

verses.english:
And this is the blessing with which Moses, the man of God,
blessed the children of Israel before his death.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה מִסִּינַי בָּא וְזָרַח מִשֵּׂעִיר לָמוֹ הוֹפִיעַ מֵהַר פָּארָן וְאָתָה מֵרִבְבֹת קֹדֶשׁ מִימִינוֹ (אשדת) [אֵשׁ דָּת] לָמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה מִסִּינַי בָּא וְזָרַח מִשֵּׂעִיר לָמוֹ הוֹפִיעַ מֵהַר פָּארָן וְאָתָה מֵרִבְבֹת קֹדֶשׁ מִימִינוֹ (אשדת) [אֵשׁ דָּת] לָמוֹ׃

english.text:
And he said: YHWH came from Sinai and rose from Seir for
them. He shone from Mount Paran and came from ten
thousands of the holy, slopes at His right, for them.

translation.text: And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.

verses.english:
And he said: YHWH came from Sinai and rose from Seir for
them. He shone from Mount Paran and came from ten
thousands of the holy, slopes at His right, for them.

verses.hebrew: אַף חֹבֵב עַמִּים כּל קְדֹשָׁיו בְּיָדֶךָ וְהֵם תֻּכּוּ לְרַגְלֶךָ יִשָּׂא מִדַּבְּרֹתֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: אַף חֹבֵב עַמִּים כּל קְדֹשָׁיו בְּיָדֶךָ וְהֵם תֻּכּוּ לְרַגְלֶךָ יִשָּׂא מִדַּבְּרֹתֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Also loving peoples, all holy ones are in your hand. And
they knelt at your feet; they bore your words.

translation.text: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.

verses.english:
Also loving peoples, all holy ones are in your hand. And
they knelt at your feet; they bore your words.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹרָה צִוָּה לָנוּ מֹשֶׁה מוֹרָשָׁה קְהִלַּת יַעֲקֹב׃

hebrew.text: תּוֹרָה צִוָּה לָנוּ מֹשֶׁה מוֹרָשָׁה קְהִלַּת יַעֲקֹב׃

english.text:
Moses commanded us instruction, a possession, community of
Jacob.

translation.text: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.

verses.english:
Moses commanded us instruction, a possession, community of
Jacob.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִישֻׁרוּן מֶלֶךְ בְּהִתְאַסֵּף רָאשֵׁי עָם יַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִישֻׁרוּן מֶלֶךְ בְּהִתְאַסֵּף רָאשֵׁי עָם יַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And He was king in Jeshurun when the people’s heads were
gathered: Israel’s tribes together.

translation.text: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.

verses.english:
And He was king in Jeshurun when the people’s heads were
gathered: Israel’s tribes together.

verses.hebrew: יְחִי רְאוּבֵן וְאַל יָמֹת וִיהִי מְתָיו מִסְפָּר׃

hebrew.text: יְחִי רְאוּבֵן וְאַל יָמֹת וִיהִי מְתָיו מִסְפָּר׃

english.text:
Let Reuben live and not die, but his men will be few in
number.

translation.text: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.

verses.english:
Let Reuben live and not die, but his men will be few in
number.

verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת לִיהוּדָה וַיֹּאמַר שְׁמַע יְהֹוָה קוֹל יְהוּדָה וְאֶל עַמּוֹ תְּבִיאֶנּוּ יָדָיו רָב לוֹ וְעֵזֶר מִצָּרָיו תִּהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְזֹאת לִיהוּדָה וַיֹּאמַר שְׁמַע יְהֹוָה קוֹל יְהוּדָה וְאֶל עַמּוֹ תְּבִיאֶנּוּ יָדָיו רָב לוֹ וְעֵזֶר מִצָּרָיו תִּהְיֶה׃

english.text:
And this for Judah—and he said: Hear, YHWH, Judah’s voice,
and bring him to his people. With his hands he strove for
himself, and you’ll be a help from its foes.

translation.text: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.

verses.english:
And this for Judah—and he said: Hear, YHWH, Judah’s voice,
and bring him to his people. With his hands he strove for
himself, and you’ll be a help from its foes.

verses.hebrew: וּלְלֵוִי אָמַר תֻּמֶּיךָ וְאוּרֶיךָ לְאִישׁ חֲסִידֶךָ אֲשֶׁר נִסִּיתוֹ בְּמַסָּה תְּרִיבֵהוּ עַל מֵי מְרִיבָה׃

hebrew.text: וּלְלֵוִי אָמַר תֻּמֶּיךָ וְאוּרֶיךָ לְאִישׁ חֲסִידֶךָ אֲשֶׁר נִסִּיתוֹ בְּמַסָּה תְּרִיבֵהוּ עַל מֵי מְרִיבָה׃

english.text:
And for Levi he said: Your Tummim and your Urim are your
faithful man’s, whom you tested at Massah, disputed with
him over Meribah’s water.

translation.text: And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;

verses.english:
And for Levi he said: Your Tummim and your Urim are your
faithful man’s, whom you tested at Massah, disputed with
him over Meribah’s water.

verses.hebrew: הָאֹמֵר לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ לֹא רְאִיתִיו וְאֶת אֶחָיו לֹא הִכִּיר וְאֶת בָּנָו לֹא יָדָע כִּי שָׁמְרוּ אִמְרָתֶךָ וּבְרִיתְךָ יִנְצֹרוּ׃

hebrew.text: הָאֹמֵר לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ לֹא רְאִיתִיו וְאֶת אֶחָיו לֹא הִכִּיר וְאֶת בָּנָו לֹא יָדָע כִּי שָׁמְרוּ אִמְרָתֶךָ וּבְרִיתְךָ יִנְצֹרוּ׃

english.text:
Who said of his father and his mother: “I haven’t seen
him,” and didn’t recognize his brothers and didn’t know
his children, for they observed what you said and kept
your covenant.

translation.text: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.

verses.english:
Who said of his father and his mother: “I haven’t seen
him,” and didn’t recognize his brothers and didn’t know
his children, for they observed what you said and kept
your covenant.

verses.hebrew: יוֹרוּ מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְיַעֲקֹב וְתוֹרָתְךָ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל יָשִׂימוּ קְטוֹרָה בְּאַפֶּךָ וְכָלִיל עַל מִזְבְּחֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: יוֹרוּ מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְיַעֲקֹב וְתוֹרָתְךָ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל יָשִׂימוּ קְטוֹרָה בְּאַפֶּךָ וְכָלִיל עַל מִזְבְּחֶךָ׃

english.text:
They’ll teach your judgments to Jacob and your instruction
to Israel. They’ll set incense at your nose, entirely
burnt on your altar.

translation.text: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.

verses.english:
They’ll teach your judgments to Jacob and your instruction
to Israel. They’ll set incense at your nose, entirely
burnt on your altar.

verses.hebrew: בָּרֵךְ יְהֹוָה חֵילוֹ וּפֹעַל יָדָיו תִּרְצֶה מְחַץ מתְנַיִם קָמָיו וּמְשַׂנְאָיו מִן יְקוּמוּן׃

hebrew.text: בָּרֵךְ יְהֹוָה חֵילוֹ וּפֹעַל יָדָיו תִּרְצֶה מְחַץ מתְנַיִם קָמָיו וּמְשַׂנְאָיו מִן יְקוּמוּן׃

english.text:
Bless, YHWH, his wealth and accept his hands’ work. Pierce
his adversaries’ hips, and those who hate him, so they
won’t get up.

translation.text: Bless, LORD, his substance, and accept the work of his hands; smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.

verses.english:
Bless, YHWH, his wealth and accept his hands’ work. Pierce
his adversaries’ hips, and those who hate him, so they
won’t get up.

verses.hebrew: לְבִנְיָמִן אָמַר יְדִיד יְהֹוָה יִשְׁכֹּן לָבֶטַח עָלָיו חֹפֵף עָלָיו כּל הַיּוֹם וּבֵין כְּתֵפָיו שָׁכֵן׃

hebrew.text: לְבִנְיָמִן אָמַר יְדִיד יְהֹוָה יִשְׁכֹּן לָבֶטַח עָלָיו חֹפֵף עָלָיו כּל הַיּוֹם וּבֵין כְּתֵפָיו שָׁכֵן׃

english.text:
For Benjamin he said: Beloved of YHWH, he’ll dwell in
security by Him. He shelters over him all day as he dwells
between his shoulders.

translation.text: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; and the Lord shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.

verses.english:
For Benjamin he said: Beloved of YHWH, he’ll dwell in
security by Him. He shelters over him all day as he dwells
between his shoulders.

verses.hebrew: וּלְיוֹסֵף אָמַר מְבֹרֶכֶת יְהֹוָה אַרְצוֹ מִמֶּגֶד שָׁמַיִם מִטָּל וּמִתְּהוֹם רֹבֶצֶת תָּחַת׃

hebrew.text: וּלְיוֹסֵף אָמַר מְבֹרֶכֶת יְהֹוָה אַרְצוֹ מִמֶּגֶד שָׁמַיִם מִטָּל וּמִתְּהוֹם רֹבֶצֶת תָּחַת׃

english.text:
And for Joseph he said: Blessed of YHWH is his land, from
the skies’ abundance, from dew, and from the deep,
crouching below,

translation.text: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,

verses.english:
And for Joseph he said: Blessed of YHWH is his land, from
the skies’ abundance, from dew, and from the deep,
crouching below,

verses.hebrew: וּמִמֶּגֶד תְּבוּאֹת שָׁמֶשׁ וּמִמֶּגֶד גֶּרֶשׁ יְרָחִים׃

hebrew.text: וּמִמֶּגֶד תְּבוּאֹת שָׁמֶשׁ וּמִמֶּגֶד גֶּרֶשׁ יְרָחִים׃

english.text:
and from the abundance of the sun’s produce and from the
abundance of the moon’s output

translation.text: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,

verses.english:
and from the abundance of the sun’s produce and from the
abundance of the moon’s output

verses.hebrew: וּמֵרֹאשׁ הַרְרֵי קֶדֶם וּמִמֶּגֶד גִּבְעוֹת עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וּמֵרֹאשׁ הַרְרֵי קֶדֶם וּמִמֶּגֶד גִּבְעוֹת עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
and from the top of the ancient mountains and from the
abundance of the hills of antiquity

translation.text: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,

verses.english:
and from the top of the ancient mountains and from the
abundance of the hills of antiquity

verses.hebrew: וּמִמֶּגֶד אֶרֶץ וּמְלֹאָהּ וּרְצוֹן שֹׁכְנִי סְנֶה תָּבוֹאתָה לְרֹאשׁ יוֹסֵף וּלְקדְקֹד נְזִיר אֶחָיו׃

hebrew.text: וּמִמֶּגֶד אֶרֶץ וּמְלֹאָהּ וּרְצוֹן שֹׁכְנִי סְנֶה תָּבוֹאתָה לְרֹאשׁ יוֹסֵף וּלְקדְקֹד נְזִיר אֶחָיו׃

english.text:
and from the abundance of earth and what fills it and the
favor of the one who dwelt in the bush. May it be on
Joseph’s head, on the top of the head of the one separate
from his brothers.

translation.text: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.

verses.english:
and from the abundance of earth and what fills it and the
favor of the one who dwelt in the bush. May it be on
Joseph’s head, on the top of the head of the one separate
from his brothers.

verses.hebrew: בְּכוֹר שׁוֹרוֹ הָדָר לוֹ וְקַרְנֵי רְאֵם קַרְנָיו בָּהֶם עַמִּים יְנַגַּח יַחְדָּו אַפְסֵי אָרֶץ וְהֵם רִבְבוֹת אֶפְרַיִם וְהֵם אַלְפֵי מְנַשֶּׁה׃

hebrew.text: בְּכוֹר שׁוֹרוֹ הָדָר לוֹ וְקַרְנֵי רְאֵם קַרְנָיו בָּהֶם עַמִּים יְנַגַּח יַחְדָּו אַפְסֵי אָרֶץ וְהֵם רִבְבוֹת אֶפְרַיִם וְהֵם אַלְפֵי מְנַשֶּׁה׃

english.text:
His firstborn bull: it has majesty. And its horns are a
wild ox’s horns. It will gore peoples with them, together,
the ends of the earth. And they’re Ephraim’s ten
thousands, And they’re Manasseh’s thousands.

translation.text: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.

verses.english:
His firstborn bull: it has majesty. And its horns are a
wild ox’s horns. It will gore peoples with them, together,
the ends of the earth. And they’re Ephraim’s ten
thousands, And they’re Manasseh’s thousands.

verses.hebrew: וְלִזְבוּלֻן אָמַר שְׂמַח זְבוּלֻן בְּצֵאתֶךָ וְיִשָּׂשכָר בְּאֹהָלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְלִזְבוּלֻן אָמַר שְׂמַח זְבוּלֻן בְּצֵאתֶךָ וְיִשָּׂשכָר בְּאֹהָלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And for Zebulun he said: Rejoice, Zebulun, when you go
out, and Issachar in your tents.

translation.text: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.

verses.english:
And for Zebulun he said: Rejoice, Zebulun, when you go
out, and Issachar in your tents.

verses.hebrew: עַמִּים הַר יִקְרָאוּ שָׁם יִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵי צֶדֶק כִּי שֶׁפַע יַמִּים יִינָקוּ וּשְׂפֻנֵי טְמוּנֵי חוֹל׃

hebrew.text: עַמִּים הַר יִקְרָאוּ שָׁם יִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵי צֶדֶק כִּי שֶׁפַע יַמִּים יִינָקוּ וּשְׂפֻנֵי טְמוּנֵי חוֹל׃

english.text:
They’ll call peoples to the mountain. There they’ll offer
the sacrifices of virtue. For they’ll suck the seas’
bounty and the sand’s hidden treasures.

translation.text: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand.

verses.english:
They’ll call peoples to the mountain. There they’ll offer
the sacrifices of virtue. For they’ll suck the seas’
bounty and the sand’s hidden treasures.

verses.hebrew: וּלְגָד אָמַר בָּרוּךְ מַרְחִיב גָּד כְּלָבִיא שָׁכֵן וְטָרַף זְרוֹעַ אַף קדְקֹד׃

hebrew.text: וּלְגָד אָמַר בָּרוּךְ מַרְחִיב גָּד כְּלָבִיא שָׁכֵן וְטָרַף זְרוֹעַ אַף קדְקֹד׃

english.text:
And for Gad he said: Blessed is one who enlarges Gad. Like
a feline, abiding and tearing an arm and the top of a
head,

translation.text: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.

verses.english:
And for Gad he said: Blessed is one who enlarges Gad. Like
a feline, abiding and tearing an arm and the top of a
head,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא רֵאשִׁית לוֹ כִּי שָׁם חֶלְקַת מְחֹקֵק סָפוּן וַיֵּתֵא רָאשֵׁי עָם צִדְקַת יְהֹוָה עָשָׂה וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו עִם יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא רֵאשִׁית לוֹ כִּי שָׁם חֶלְקַת מְחֹקֵק סָפוּן וַיֵּתֵא רָאשֵׁי עָם צִדְקַת יְהֹוָה עָשָׂה וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו עִם יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
so he saw the foremost for himself, for a ruler’s share
was kept there. And the heads of the people came. And he
did YHWH’s justice and His laws with Israel.

translation.text: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, in a portion of the lawgiver, was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the LORD, and his judgments with Israel.

verses.english:
so he saw the foremost for himself, for a ruler’s share
was kept there. And the heads of the people came. And he
did YHWH’s justice and His laws with Israel.

verses.hebrew: וּלְדָן אָמַר דָּן גּוּר אַרְיֵה יְזַנֵּק מִן הַבָּשָׁן׃

hebrew.text: וּלְדָן אָמַר דָּן גּוּר אַרְיֵה יְזַנֵּק מִן הַבָּשָׁן׃

english.text:
And for Dan he said: Dan is a lion’s whelp that leapt from
Bashan.

translation.text: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion’s whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.

verses.english:
And for Dan he said: Dan is a lion’s whelp that leapt from
Bashan.

verses.hebrew: וּלְנַפְתָּלִי אָמַר נַפְתָּלִי שְׂבַע רָצוֹן וּמָלֵא בִּרְכַּת יְהֹוָה יָם וְדָרוֹם יְרָשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וּלְנַפְתָּלִי אָמַר נַפְתָּלִי שְׂבַע רָצוֹן וּמָלֵא בִּרְכַּת יְהֹוָה יָם וְדָרוֹם יְרָשָׁה׃

english.text:
And for Naphtali he said: Naphtali is full of favor and
filled with YHWH’s blessing. He’ll possess west and south.

translation.text: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the LORD: possess thou the west and the south.

verses.english:
And for Naphtali he said: Naphtali is full of favor and
filled with YHWH’s blessing. He’ll possess west and south.

verses.hebrew: וּלְאָשֵׁר אָמַר בָּרוּךְ מִבָּנִים אָשֵׁר יְהִי רְצוּי אֶחָיו וְטֹבֵל בַּשֶּׁמֶן רַגְלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּלְאָשֵׁר אָמַר בָּרוּךְ מִבָּנִים אָשֵׁר יְהִי רְצוּי אֶחָיו וְטֹבֵל בַּשֶּׁמֶן רַגְלוֹ׃

english.text:
And for Asher he said: Blessed out of the sons is Asher.
Let him be favored by his brothers and dipping his foot in
oil.

translation.text: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.

verses.english:
And for Asher he said: Blessed out of the sons is Asher.
Let him be favored by his brothers and dipping his foot in
oil.

verses.hebrew: בַּרְזֶל וּנְחֹשֶׁת מִנְעָלֶךָ וּכְיָמֶיךָ דּבְאֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: בַּרְזֶל וּנְחֹשֶׁת מִנְעָלֶךָ וּכְיָמֶיךָ דּבְאֶךָ׃

english.text:
Your lock is iron and bronze, and your strength is as much
as your days.

translation.text: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.

verses.english:
Your lock is iron and bronze, and your strength is as much
as your days.

verses.hebrew: אֵין כָּאֵל יְשֻׁרוּן רֹכֵב שָׁמַיִם בְּעֶזְרֶךָ וּבְגַאֲוָתוֹ שְׁחָקִים׃

hebrew.text: אֵין כָּאֵל יְשֻׁרוּן רֹכֵב שָׁמַיִם בְּעֶזְרֶךָ וּבְגַאֲוָתוֹ שְׁחָקִים׃

english.text:
There’s none like the God of Jeshurun, riding skies to
help you and clouds in His majesty.

translation.text: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun, who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.

verses.english:
There’s none like the God of Jeshurun, riding skies to
help you and clouds in His majesty.

verses.hebrew: מְעֹנָה אֱלֹהֵי קֶדֶם וּמִתַּחַת זְרֹעֹת עוֹלָם וַיְגָרֶשׁ מִפָּנֶיךָ אוֹיֵב וַיֹּאמֶר הַשְׁמֵד׃

hebrew.text: מְעֹנָה אֱלֹהֵי קֶדֶם וּמִתַּחַת זְרֹעֹת עוֹלָם וַיְגָרֶשׁ מִפָּנֶיךָ אוֹיֵב וַיֹּאמֶר הַשְׁמֵד׃

english.text:
The ancient God is a refuge; and below: the arms of the
eternal. And He drove out an enemy before you and said,
“Destroy!”

translation.text: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.

verses.english:
The ancient God is a refuge; and below: the arms of the
eternal. And He drove out an enemy before you and said,
“Destroy!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכֹּן יִשְׂרָאֵל בֶּטַח בָּדָד עֵין יַעֲקֹב אֶל אֶרֶץ דָּגָן וְתִירוֹשׁ אַף שָׁמָיו יַעַרְפוּ טָל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכֹּן יִשְׂרָאֵל בֶּטַח בָּדָד עֵין יַעֲקֹב אֶל אֶרֶץ דָּגָן וְתִירוֹשׁ אַף שָׁמָיו יַעַרְפוּ טָל׃

english.text:
And Israel will dwell secure, Jacob dwells alone. To a
land of grain and wine; and its skies drop dew.

translation.text: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.

verses.english:
And Israel will dwell secure, Jacob dwells alone. To a
land of grain and wine; and its skies drop dew.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל מִי כָמוֹךָ עַם נוֹשַׁע בַּיהֹוָה מָגֵן עֶזְרֶךָ וַאֲשֶׁר חֶרֶב גַּאֲוָתֶךָ וְיִכָּחֲשׁוּ אֹיְבֶיךָ לָךְ וְאַתָּה עַל בָּמוֹתֵימוֹ תִדְרֹךְ׃

hebrew.text: אַשְׁרֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל מִי כָמוֹךָ עַם נוֹשַׁע בַּיהֹוָה מָגֵן עֶזְרֶךָ וַאֲשֶׁר חֶרֶב גַּאֲוָתֶךָ וְיִכָּחֲשׁוּ אֹיְבֶיךָ לָךְ וְאַתָּה עַל בָּמוֹתֵימוֹ תִדְרֹךְ׃

english.text:
Happy are you, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by
YHWH, your strong shield who is your majestic sword?! And
your enemies will fawn to you. And you: you’ll step on
their high places.

translation.text: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.

verses.english:
Happy are you, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by
YHWH, your strong shield who is your majestic sword?! And
your enemies will fawn to you. And you: you’ll step on
their high places.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה מֵעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב אֶל הַר נְבוֹ רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי יְרֵחוֹ וַיַּרְאֵהוּ יְהֹוָה אֶת כּל הָאָרֶץ אֶת הַגִּלְעָד עַד דָּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה מֵעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב אֶל הַר נְבוֹ רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי יְרֵחוֹ וַיַּרְאֵהוּ יְהֹוָה אֶת כּל הָאָרֶץ אֶת הַגִּלְעָד עַד דָּן׃

english.text:
And Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount
Nebo, the top of Pisgah, which is facing Jericho. And YHWH
showed him all of the land, Gilead to Dan,

translation.text: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,

verses.english:
And Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount
Nebo, the top of Pisgah, which is facing Jericho. And YHWH
showed him all of the land, Gilead to Dan,

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כּל נַפְתָּלִי וְאֶת אֶרֶץ אֶפְרַיִם וּמְנַשֶּׁה וְאֵת כּל אֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה עַד הַיָּם הָאַחֲרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת כּל נַפְתָּלִי וְאֶת אֶרֶץ אֶפְרַיִם וּמְנַשֶּׁה וְאֵת כּל אֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה עַד הַיָּם הָאַחֲרוֹן׃

english.text:
and all of Naphtali and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh
and all the land of Judah to the far sea

translation.text: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,

verses.english:
and all of Naphtali and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh
and all the land of Judah to the far sea

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת הַנֶּגֶב וְאֶת הַכִּכָּר בִּקְעַת יְרֵחוֹ עִיר הַתְּמָרִים עַד צֹעַר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת הַנֶּגֶב וְאֶת הַכִּכָּר בִּקְעַת יְרֵחוֹ עִיר הַתְּמָרִים עַד צֹעַר׃

english.text:
and the Negeb and the plain, the valley of Jericho, city
of the palms, to Zoar.

translation.text: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.

verses.english:
and the Negeb and the plain, the valley of Jericho, city
of the palms, to Zoar.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו זֹאת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לֵאמֹר לְזַרְעֲךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה הֶרְאִיתִיךָ בְעֵינֶיךָ וְשָׁמָּה לֹא תַעֲבֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו זֹאת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב לֵאמֹר לְזַרְעֲךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה הֶרְאִיתִיךָ בְעֵינֶיךָ וְשָׁמָּה לֹא תַעֲבֹר׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to him, “This is the land that I swore to
Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I’ll give it to
your seed.’ I’ve caused you to see it with your eyes, but
you won’t pass there.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto him, This is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to him, “This is the land that I swore to
Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I’ll give it to
your seed.’ I’ve caused you to see it with your eyes, but
you won’t pass there.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת שָׁם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת שָׁם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב עַל פִּי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Moses, YHWH’s servant, died there in the land of Moab
by YHWH’s mouth,

translation.text: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.

verses.english:
And Moses, YHWH’s servant, died there in the land of Moab
by YHWH’s mouth,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבֹּר אֹתוֹ בַגַּי בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב מוּל בֵּית פְּעוֹר וְלֹא יָדַע אִישׁ אֶת קְבֻרָתוֹ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבֹּר אֹתוֹ בַגַּי בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב מוּל בֵּית פְּעוֹר וְלֹא יָדַע אִישׁ אֶת קְבֻרָתוֹ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
and He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab
opposite Beth Peor. And no man knows his burial place to
this day.

translation.text: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Bethpeor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.

verses.english:
and He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab
opposite Beth Peor. And no man knows his burial place to
this day.

verses.hebrew: וּמֹשֶׁה בֶּן מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה בְּמֹתוֹ לֹא כָהֲתָה עֵינוֹ וְלֹא נָס לֵחֹה׃

hebrew.text: וּמֹשֶׁה בֶּן מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה בְּמֹתוֹ לֹא כָהֲתָה עֵינוֹ וְלֹא נָס לֵחֹה׃

english.text:
And Moses was a hundred twenty years old at his death. His
eye was not dim, and his vitality had not fled.

translation.text: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.

verses.english:
And Moses was a hundred twenty years old at his death. His
eye was not dim, and his vitality had not fled.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְכּוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב שְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם וַיִּתְּמוּ יְמֵי בְכִי אֵבֶל מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְכּוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב שְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם וַיִּתְּמוּ יְמֵי בְכִי אֵבֶל מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And the children of Israel mourned Moses in the plains of
Moab thirty days. And the days of weeping, the mourning of
Moses, ended.

translation.text: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.

verses.english:
And the children of Israel mourned Moses in the plains of
Moab thirty days. And the days of weeping, the mourning of
Moses, ended.

verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן מָלֵא רוּחַ חכְמָה כִּי סָמַךְ מֹשֶׁה אֶת יָדָיו עָלָיו וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֵלָיו בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן מָלֵא רוּחַ חכְמָה כִּי סָמַךְ מֹשֶׁה אֶת יָדָיו עָלָיו וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֵלָיו בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And Joshua son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom
because Moses had laid his hands on him, and the children
of Israel listened to him. And they did as YHWH commanded
Moses.

translation.text: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
And Joshua son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom
because Moses had laid his hands on him, and the children
of Israel listened to him. And they did as YHWH commanded
Moses.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא קָם נָבִיא עוֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר יְדָעוֹ יְהֹוָה פָּנִים אֶל פָּנִים׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא קָם נָבִיא עוֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר יְדָעוֹ יְהֹוָה פָּנִים אֶל פָּנִים׃

english.text:
And a prophet did not rise again in Israel like Moses,
whom YHWH knew face-to-face,

translation.text: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,

verses.english:
And a prophet did not rise again in Israel like Moses,
whom YHWH knew face-to-face,

verses.hebrew: לְכל הָאֹתֹת וְהַמּוֹפְתִים אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לְפַרְעֹה וּלְכל עֲבָדָיו וּלְכל אַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: לְכל הָאֹתֹת וְהַמּוֹפְתִים אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לְפַרְעֹה וּלְכל עֲבָדָיו וּלְכל אַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
with all the signs and the wonders that YHWH sent him to
do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and to all his servants
and to all his land,

translation.text: In all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

verses.english:
with all the signs and the wonders that YHWH sent him to
do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and to all his servants
and to all his land,

verses.hebrew: וּלְכֹל הַיָּד הַחֲזָקָה וּלְכֹל הַמּוֹרָא הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מֹשֶׁה לְעֵינֵי כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּלְכֹל הַיָּד הַחֲזָקָה וּלְכֹל הַמּוֹרָא הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מֹשֶׁה לְעֵינֵי כּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
and with all the strong hand and with all the great fear
that Moses made before the eyes of all Israel.

translation.text: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.

verses.english:
and with all the strong hand and with all the great fear
that Moses made before the eyes of all Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי מוֹת מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן מְשָׁרֵת מֹשֶׁה לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי מוֹת מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן מְשָׁרֵת מֹשֶׁה לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
After the death of Moses the servant of YHWH, YHWH said to Joshua
son of Nun, Moses’ attendant:

translation.text: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD it came to pass, that the LORD spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,

verses.english:
After the death of Moses the servant of YHWH, YHWH said to Joshua
son of Nun, Moses’ attendant:

verses.hebrew: מֹשֶׁה עַבְדִּי מֵת וְעַתָּה קוּם עֲבֹר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה אַתָּה וְכל־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן לָהֶם לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: מֹשֶׁה עַבְדִּי מֵת וְעַתָּה קוּם עֲבֹר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה אַתָּה וְכל־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן לָהֶם לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
“My servant Moses is dead. Prepare to cross the Jordan, together
with all this people, into the land that I am giving to the
Israelites.

translation.text: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel.

verses.english:
“My servant Moses is dead. Prepare to cross the Jordan, together
with all this people, into the land that I am giving to the
Israelites.

verses.hebrew: כּל־מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר תִּדְרֹךְ כַּף־רַגְלְכֶם בּוֹ לָכֶם נְתַתִּיו כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶל־מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: כּל־מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר תִּדְרֹךְ כַּף־רַגְלְכֶם בּוֹ לָכֶם נְתַתִּיו כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶל־מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
Every spot on which your foot treads I give to you, as I promised
Moses.

translation.text: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.

verses.english:
Every spot on which your foot treads I give to you, as I promised
Moses.

verses.hebrew: מֵהַמִּדְבָּר וְהַלְּבָנוֹן הַזֶּה וְעַד־הַנָּהָר הַגָּדוֹל נְהַר־פְּרָת כֹּל אֶרֶץ הַחִתִּים וְעַד־הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל מְבוֹא הַשָּׁמֶשׁ יִהְיֶה גְּבוּלְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: מֵהַמִּדְבָּר וְהַלְּבָנוֹן הַזֶּה וְעַד־הַנָּהָר הַגָּדוֹל נְהַר־פְּרָת כֹּל אֶרֶץ הַחִתִּים וְעַד־הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל מְבוֹא הַשָּׁמֶשׁ יִהְיֶה גְּבוּלְכֶם׃

english.text:
Your territory shall extend from the wilderness and the Lebanon to
the Great River, the River Euphrates [on the east]—the whole
Hittite country—and up to the Mediterranean Sea on the west.

translation.text: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.

verses.english:
Your territory shall extend from the wilderness and the Lebanon to
the Great River, the River Euphrates [on the east]—the whole
Hittite country—and up to the Mediterranean Sea on the west.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יִתְיַצֵּב אִישׁ לְפָנֶיךָ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיִיתִי עִם־מֹשֶׁה אֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ לֹא אַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא אֶעֶזְבֶךָּ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא־יִתְיַצֵּב אִישׁ לְפָנֶיךָ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיִיתִי עִם־מֹשֶׁה אֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ לֹא אַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא אֶעֶזְבֶךָּ׃

english.text:
No one shall be able to resist you as long as you live. As I was
with Moses, so I will be with you; I will not fail you or forsake
you.

translation.text: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

verses.english:
No one shall be able to resist you as long as you live. As I was
with Moses, so I will be with you; I will not fail you or forsake
you.

verses.hebrew: חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ כִּי אַתָּה תַּנְחִיל אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבוֹתָם לָתֵת לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ כִּי אַתָּה תַּנְחִיל אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבוֹתָם לָתֵת לָהֶם׃

english.text:
“Be strong and resolute, for you shall apportion to this people
the land that I swore to their fathers to assign to them.

translation.text: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.

verses.english:
“Be strong and resolute, for you shall apportion to this people
the land that I swore to their fathers to assign to them.

verses.hebrew: רַק חֲזַק וֶאֱמַץ מְאֹד לִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכל־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ מֹשֶׁה עַבְדִּי אַל־תָּסוּר מִמֶּנּוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול לְמַעַן תַּשְׂכִּיל בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: רַק חֲזַק וֶאֱמַץ מְאֹד לִשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכל־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ מֹשֶׁה עַבְדִּי אַל־תָּסוּר מִמֶּנּוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול לְמַעַן תַּשְׂכִּיל בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵךְ׃

english.text:
But you must be very strong and resolute to observe faithfully all
the Teaching that My servant Moses enjoined upon you. Do not
deviate from it to the right or to the left, that you may be
successful wherever you go.

translation.text: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.

verses.english:
But you must be very strong and resolute to observe faithfully all
the Teaching that My servant Moses enjoined upon you. Do not
deviate from it to the right or to the left, that you may be
successful wherever you go.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יָמוּשׁ סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֶּה מִפִּיךָ וְהָגִיתָ בּוֹ יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה לְמַעַן תִּשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכל־הַכָּתוּב בּוֹ כִּי־אָז תַּצְלִיחַ אֶת־דְּרָכֶךָ וְאָז תַּשְׂכִּיל׃

hebrew.text: לֹא־יָמוּשׁ סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֶּה מִפִּיךָ וְהָגִיתָ בּוֹ יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה לְמַעַן תִּשְׁמֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכל־הַכָּתוּב בּוֹ כִּי־אָז תַּצְלִיחַ אֶת־דְּרָכֶךָ וְאָז תַּשְׂכִּיל׃

english.text:
Let not this Book of the Teaching cease from your lips, but recite
it day and night, so that you may observe faithfully all that is
written in it. Only then will you prosper in your undertakings and
only then will you be successful.

translation.text: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

verses.english:
Let not this Book of the Teaching cease from your lips, but recite
it day and night, so that you may observe faithfully all that is
written in it. Only then will you prosper in your undertakings and
only then will you be successful.

verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא צִוִּיתִיךָ חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ אַל־תַּעֲרֹץ וְאַל־תֵּחָת כִּי עִמְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: הֲלוֹא צִוִּיתִיךָ חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ אַל־תַּעֲרֹץ וְאַל־תֵּחָת כִּי עִמְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵךְ׃

english.text:
“I charge you: Be strong and resolute; do not be terrified or
dismayed, for YHWH your God is with you wherever you go.”

translation.text: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

verses.english:
“I charge you: Be strong and resolute; do not be terrified or
dismayed, for YHWH your God is with you wherever you go.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־שֹׁטְרֵי הָעָם לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־שֹׁטְרֵי הָעָם לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: Joshua thereupon gave orders to the officials of the people:

translation.text: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

verses.english: Joshua thereupon gave orders to the officials of the people:

verses.hebrew:
עִבְרוּ בְּקֶרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה וְצַוּוּ אֶת־הָעָם לֵאמֹר הָכִינוּ לָכֶם צֵידָה כִּי בְּעוֹד שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה לָבוֹא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר
יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נֹתֵן לָכֶם לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text:
עִבְרוּ בְּקֶרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה וְצַוּוּ אֶת־הָעָם לֵאמֹר הָכִינוּ לָכֶם צֵידָה כִּי בְּעוֹד שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה לָבוֹא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר
יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נֹתֵן לָכֶם לְרִשְׁתָּהּ׃

english.text:
“Go through the camp and charge the people thus: Get provisions
ready, for in three days’ time you are to cross the Jordan, in
order to enter and possess the land that YHWH your God is giving
you as a possession.”

translation.text: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the LORD your God giveth you to possess it.

verses.english:
“Go through the camp and charge the people thus: Get provisions
ready, for in three days’ time you are to cross the Jordan, in
order to enter and possess the land that YHWH your God is giving
you as a possession.”

verses.hebrew: וְלָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה אָמַר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְלָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה אָמַר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
Then Joshua said to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the
half-tribe of Manasseh,

translation.text: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,

verses.english:
Then Joshua said to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the
half-tribe of Manasseh,

verses.hebrew: זָכוֹר אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מֵנִיחַ לָכֶם וְנָתַן לָכֶם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: זָכוֹר אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מֵנִיחַ לָכֶם וְנָתַן לָכֶם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
“Remember what Moses the servant of YHWH enjoined upon you, when
he said, ‘YHWH your God is granting you a haven; He has assigned
this territory to you’:

translation.text: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, The LORD your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.

verses.english:
“Remember what Moses the servant of YHWH enjoined upon you, when
he said, ‘YHWH your God is granting you a haven; He has assigned
this territory to you’:

verses.hebrew:
נְשֵׁיכֶם טַפְּכֶם וּמִקְנֵיכֶם יֵשְׁבוּ בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם מֹשֶׁה בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן וְאַתֶּם תַּעַבְרוּ חֲמֻשִׁים לִפְנֵי אֲחֵיכֶם כֹּל גִּבּוֹרֵי הַחַיִל וַעֲזַרְתֶּם
אוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text:
נְשֵׁיכֶם טַפְּכֶם וּמִקְנֵיכֶם יֵשְׁבוּ בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם מֹשֶׁה בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן וְאַתֶּם תַּעַבְרוּ חֲמֻשִׁים לִפְנֵי אֲחֵיכֶם כֹּל גִּבּוֹרֵי הַחַיִל וַעֲזַרְתֶּם
אוֹתָם׃

english.text:
Let your wives, children, and livestock remain in the land that
Moses assigned to you on this side of the Jordan; but every one of
your fighting men shall go across armed in the van of your
kinsmen. And you shall assist them

translation.text: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;

verses.english:
Let your wives, children, and livestock remain in the land that
Moses assigned to you on this side of the Jordan; but every one of
your fighting men shall go across armed in the van of your
kinsmen. And you shall assist them

verses.hebrew:
עַד אֲשֶׁר־יָנִיחַ יְהֹוָה לַאֲחֵיכֶם כָּכֶם וְיָרְשׁוּ גַם־הֵמָּה אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נֹתֵן לָהֶם וְשַׁבְתֶּם לְאֶרֶץ יְרֻשַּׁתְכֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אוֹתָהּ אֲשֶׁר
נָתַן לָכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרַח הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text:
עַד אֲשֶׁר־יָנִיחַ יְהֹוָה לַאֲחֵיכֶם כָּכֶם וְיָרְשׁוּ גַם־הֵמָּה אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נֹתֵן לָהֶם וְשַׁבְתֶּם לְאֶרֶץ יְרֻשַּׁתְכֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אוֹתָהּ אֲשֶׁר
נָתַן לָכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרַח הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

english.text:
until YHWH has given your kinsmen a haven, such as you have, and
they too have gained possession of the land that YHWH your God has
assigned to them. Then you may return to the land on the east side
