of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of YHWH assigned to you as
your possession, and you may possess it.”

translation.text: Until the LORD have given your brethren rest, as he hath given you, and they also have possessed the land which the LORD your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD’s servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.

verses.english:
until YHWH has given your kinsmen a haven, such as you have, and
they too have gained possession of the land that YHWH your God has
assigned to them. Then you may return to the land on the east side
of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of YHWH assigned to you as
your possession, and you may possess it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנוּ אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתָנוּ נַעֲשֶׂה וְאֶל־כּל־אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁלָחֵנוּ נֵלֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲנוּ אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתָנוּ נַעֲשֶׂה וְאֶל־כּל־אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁלָחֵנוּ נֵלֵךְ׃

english.text:
They answered Joshua, “We will do everything you have commanded us
and we will go wherever you send us.

translation.text: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.

verses.english:
They answered Joshua, “We will do everything you have commanded us
and we will go wherever you send us.

verses.hebrew: כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמַעְנוּ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה כֵּן נִשְׁמַע אֵלֶיךָ רַק יִהְיֶה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עִמָּךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה עִם־מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמַעְנוּ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה כֵּן נִשְׁמַע אֵלֶיךָ רַק יִהְיֶה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עִמָּךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה עִם־מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
We will obey you just as we obeyed Moses; let but YHWH your God be
with you as He was with Moses!

translation.text: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the LORD thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.

verses.english:
We will obey you just as we obeyed Moses; let but YHWH your God be
with you as He was with Moses!

verses.hebrew: כּל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יַמְרֶה אֶת־פִּיךָ וְלֹא־יִשְׁמַע אֶת־דְּבָרֶיךָ לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תְּצַוֶּנּוּ יוּמָת רַק חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ׃

hebrew.text: כּל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יַמְרֶה אֶת־פִּיךָ וְלֹא־יִשְׁמַע אֶת־דְּבָרֶיךָ לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תְּצַוֶּנּוּ יוּמָת רַק חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ׃

english.text:
Any man who flouts your commands and does not obey every order you
give him shall be put to death. Only be strong and resolute!”

translation.text: Whosoever he be that doth rebel against thy commandment, and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.

verses.english:
Any man who flouts your commands and does not obey every order you
give him shall be put to death. Only be strong and resolute!”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ־בִּן־נוּן מִן־הַשִּׁטִּים שְׁנַיִם־אֲנָשִׁים מְרַגְּלִים חֶרֶשׁ לֵאמֹר לְכוּ רְאוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְאֶת־יְרִיחוֹ וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ בֵּית־אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה
וּשְׁמָהּ רָחָב וַיִּשְׁכְּבוּ־שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ־בִּן־נוּן מִן־הַשִּׁטִּים שְׁנַיִם־אֲנָשִׁים מְרַגְּלִים חֶרֶשׁ לֵאמֹר לְכוּ רְאוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְאֶת־יְרִיחוֹ וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ בֵּית־אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה
וּשְׁמָהּ רָחָב וַיִּשְׁכְּבוּ־שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim, saying,
“Go, reconnoiter the region of Jericho.” So they set out, and they
came to the house of a harlot named Rahab and lodged there.

translation.text: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there.

verses.english:
Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim, saying,
“Go, reconnoiter the region of Jericho.” So they set out, and they
came to the house of a harlot named Rahab and lodged there.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּאָמַר לְמֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה אֲנָשִׁים בָּאוּ הֵנָּה הַלַּיְלָה מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַחְפֹּר אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּאָמַר לְמֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה אֲנָשִׁים בָּאוּ הֵנָּה הַלַּיְלָה מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַחְפֹּר אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
The king of Jericho was told, “Some men have come here tonight,
Israelites, to spy out the country.”

translation.text: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.

verses.english:
The king of Jericho was told, “Some men have come here tonight,
Israelites, to spy out the country.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ אֶל־רָחָב לֵאמֹר הוֹצִיאִי הָאֲנָשִׁים הַבָּאִים אֵלַיִךְ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאוּ לְבֵיתֵךְ כִּי לַחְפֹּר אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ בָּאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ אֶל־רָחָב לֵאמֹר הוֹצִיאִי הָאֲנָשִׁים הַבָּאִים אֵלַיִךְ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאוּ לְבֵיתֵךְ כִּי לַחְפֹּר אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ בָּאוּ׃

english.text:
The king of Jericho thereupon sent orders to Rahab: “Produce the
men who came to you and entered your house, for they have come to
spy out the whole country.”

translation.text: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.

verses.english:
The king of Jericho thereupon sent orders to Rahab: “Produce the
men who came to you and entered your house, for they have come to
spy out the whole country.”

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח הָאִשָּׁה אֶת־שְׁנֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים וַתִּצְפְּנוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר כֵּן בָּאוּ אֵלַי הָאֲנָשִׁים וְלֹא יָדַעְתִּי מֵאַיִן הֵמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקַּח הָאִשָּׁה אֶת־שְׁנֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים וַתִּצְפְּנוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר כֵּן בָּאוּ אֵלַי הָאֲנָשִׁים וְלֹא יָדַעְתִּי מֵאַיִן הֵמָּה׃

english.text:
The woman, however, had taken the two men and hidden them. “It is
true,” she said, “the men did come to me, but I didn’t know where
they were from.

translation.text: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:

verses.english:
The woman, however, had taken the two men and hidden them. “It is
true,” she said, “the men did come to me, but I didn’t know where
they were from.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַשַּׁעַר לִסְגּוֹר בַּחֹשֶׁךְ וְהָאֲנָשִׁים יָצָאוּ לֹא יָדַעְתִּי אָנָה הָלְכוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים רִדְפוּ מַהֵר אַחֲרֵיהֶם כִּי תַשִּׂיגוּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הַשַּׁעַר לִסְגּוֹר בַּחֹשֶׁךְ וְהָאֲנָשִׁים יָצָאוּ לֹא יָדַעְתִּי אָנָה הָלְכוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים רִדְפוּ מַהֵר אַחֲרֵיהֶם כִּי תַשִּׂיגוּם׃

translation.text: And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.

verses.hebrew: וְהִיא הֶעֱלָתַם הַגָּגָה וַתִּטְמְנֵם בְּפִשְׁתֵּי הָעֵץ הָעֲרֻכוֹת לָהּ עַל־הַגָּג׃

hebrew.text: וְהִיא הֶעֱלָתַם הַגָּגָה וַתִּטְמְנֵם בְּפִשְׁתֵּי הָעֵץ הָעֲרֻכוֹת לָהּ עַל־הַגָּג׃

english.text:
Now she had taken them up to the roof and hidden them under some
stalks of flax which she had lying on the roof.—

translation.text: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.

verses.english:
Now she had taken them up to the roof and hidden them under some
stalks of flax which she had lying on the roof.—

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים רָדְפוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם דֶּרֶךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן עַל הַמַּעְבְּרוֹת וְהַשַּׁעַר סָגָרוּ אַחֲרֵי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ הָרֹדְפִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים רָדְפוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם דֶּרֶךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן עַל הַמַּעְבְּרוֹת וְהַשַּׁעַר סָגָרוּ אַחֲרֵי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ הָרֹדְפִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
So the men pursued them in the direction of the Jordan down to the
fords; and no sooner had the pursuers gone out than the gate was
shut behind them.

translation.text: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.

verses.english:
So the men pursued them in the direction of the Jordan down to the
fords; and no sooner had the pursuers gone out than the gate was
shut behind them.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵמָּה טֶרֶם יִשְׁכָּבוּן וְהִיא עָלְתָה עֲלֵיהֶם עַל־הַגָּג׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵמָּה טֶרֶם יִשְׁכָּבוּן וְהִיא עָלְתָה עֲלֵיהֶם עַל־הַגָּג׃

english.text:
The spies had not yet gone to sleep when she came up to them on
the roof.

translation.text: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;

verses.english:
The spies had not yet gone to sleep when she came up to them on
the roof.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־הָאֲנָשִׁים יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־נָתַן יְהֹוָה לָכֶם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְכִי־נָפְלָה אֵימַתְכֶם עָלֵינוּ וְכִי נָמֹגוּ כּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־הָאֲנָשִׁים יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־נָתַן יְהֹוָה לָכֶם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְכִי־נָפְלָה אֵימַתְכֶם עָלֵינוּ וְכִי נָמֹגוּ כּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
She said to the men, “I know that YHWH has given the country to
you, because dread of you has fallen upon us, and all the
inhabitants of the land are quaking before you.

translation.text: And she said unto the men, I know that the LORD hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.

verses.english:
She said to the men, “I know that YHWH has given the country to
you, because dread of you has fallen upon us, and all the
inhabitants of the land are quaking before you.

verses.hebrew:
כִּי שָׁמַעְנוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִישׁ יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֵי יַם־סוּף מִפְּנֵיכֶם בְּצֵאתְכֶם מִמִּצְרָיִם וַאֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם לִשְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן לְסִיחֹן
וּלְעוֹג אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱרַמְתֶּם אוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי שָׁמַעְנוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִישׁ יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֵי יַם־סוּף מִפְּנֵיכֶם בְּצֵאתְכֶם מִמִּצְרָיִם וַאֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם לִשְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן לְסִיחֹן
וּלְעוֹג אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱרַמְתֶּם אוֹתָם׃

english.text:
For we have heard how YHWH dried up the waters of the Sea of Reeds
for you when you left Egypt, and what you did to Sihon and Og, the
two Amorite kings across the Jordan, whom you doomed.

translation.text: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.

verses.english:
For we have heard how YHWH dried up the waters of the Sea of Reeds
for you when you left Egypt, and what you did to Sihon and Og, the
two Amorite kings across the Jordan, whom you doomed.

verses.hebrew: וַנִּשְׁמַע וַיִּמַּס לְבָבֵנוּ וְלֹא־קָמָה עוֹד רוּחַ בְּאִישׁ מִפְּנֵיכֶם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא אֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל־הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת׃

hebrew.text: וַנִּשְׁמַע וַיִּמַּס לְבָבֵנוּ וְלֹא־קָמָה עוֹד רוּחַ בְּאִישׁ מִפְּנֵיכֶם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא אֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל־הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת׃

english.text:
When we heard about it, we lost heart, and no man had any more
spirit left because of you; for YHWH your God is the only God in
heaven above and on earth below.

translation.text: And as soon as we had heard these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the LORD your God, he is God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.

verses.english:
When we heard about it, we lost heart, and no man had any more
spirit left because of you; for YHWH your God is the only God in
heaven above and on earth below.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִשָּׁבְעוּ־נָא לִי בַּיהֹוָה כִּי־עָשִׂיתִי עִמָּכֶם חָסֶד וַעֲשִׂיתֶם גַּם־אַתֶּם עִם־בֵּית אָבִי חֶסֶד וּנְתַתֶּם לִי אוֹת אֱמֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִשָּׁבְעוּ־נָא לִי בַּיהֹוָה כִּי־עָשִׂיתִי עִמָּכֶם חָסֶד וַעֲשִׂיתֶם גַּם־אַתֶּם עִם־בֵּית אָבִי חֶסֶד וּנְתַתֶּם לִי אוֹת אֱמֶת׃

english.text:
Now, since I have shown loyalty to you, swear to me by YHWH that
you in turn will show loyalty to my family. Provide me with a
reliable sign

translation.text: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the LORD, since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father’s house, and give me a true token:

verses.english:
Now, since I have shown loyalty to you, swear to me by YHWH that
you in turn will show loyalty to my family. Provide me with a
reliable sign

verses.hebrew: וְהַחֲיִתֶם אֶת־אָבִי וְאֶת־אִמִּי וְאֶת־אַחַי וְאֶת־[אַחְיוֹתַי] (אחותי) וְאֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם וְהִצַּלְתֶּם אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵינוּ מִמָּוֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְהַחֲיִתֶם אֶת־אָבִי וְאֶת־אִמִּי וְאֶת־אַחַי וְאֶת־[אַחְיוֹתַי] (אחותי) וְאֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר לָהֶם וְהִצַּלְתֶּם אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵינוּ מִמָּוֶת׃

english.text:
that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers
and sisters, and all who belong to them, and save us from death.”

translation.text: And that ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.

verses.english:
that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers
and sisters, and all who belong to them, and save us from death.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהּ הָאֲנָשִׁים נַפְשֵׁנוּ תַחְתֵּיכֶם לָמוּת אִם לֹא תַגִּידוּ אֶת־דְּבָרֵנוּ זֶה וְהָיָה בְּתֵת־יְהֹוָה לָנוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְעָשִׂינוּ עִמָּךְ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהּ הָאֲנָשִׁים נַפְשֵׁנוּ תַחְתֵּיכֶם לָמוּת אִם לֹא תַגִּידוּ אֶת־דְּבָרֵנוּ זֶה וְהָיָה בְּתֵת־יְהֹוָה לָנוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְעָשִׂינוּ עִמָּךְ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃

english.text:
The men answered her, “Our persons are pledged for yours, even to
death! If you do not disclose this mission of ours, we will show
you true loyalty when YHWH gives us the land.”

translation.text: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the LORD hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.

verses.english:
The men answered her, “Our persons are pledged for yours, even to
death! If you do not disclose this mission of ours, we will show
you true loyalty when YHWH gives us the land.”

verses.hebrew: וַתּוֹרִדֵם בַּחֶבֶל בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן כִּי בֵיתָהּ בְּקִיר הַחוֹמָה וּבַחוֹמָה הִיא יוֹשָׁבֶת׃

english.text:
She let them down by a rope through the window—for her dwelling
was at the outer side of the city wall and she lived in the actual
wall.

translation.text: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.

verses.english:
She let them down by a rope through the window—for her dwelling
was at the outer side of the city wall and she lived in the actual
wall.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הָהָרָה לֵּכוּ פֶּן־יִפְגְּעוּ בָכֶם הָרֹדְפִים וְנַחְבֵּתֶם שָׁמָּה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים עַד שׁוֹב הָרֹדְפִים וְאַחַר תֵּלְכוּ לְדַרְכְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הָהָרָה לֵּכוּ פֶּן־יִפְגְּעוּ בָכֶם הָרֹדְפִים וְנַחְבֵּתֶם שָׁמָּה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים עַד שׁוֹב הָרֹדְפִים וְאַחַר תֵּלְכוּ לְדַרְכְּכֶם׃

english.text:
She said to them, “Make for the hills, so that the pursuers may
not come upon you. Stay there in hiding three days, until the
pursuers return; then go your way.”

translation.text: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.

verses.english:
She said to them, “Make for the hills, so that the pursuers may
not come upon you. Stay there in hiding three days, until the
pursuers return; then go your way.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלֶיהָ הָאֲנָשִׁים נְקִיִּם אֲנַחְנוּ מִשְּׁבֻעָתֵךְ הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁבַּעְתָּנוּ׃

english.text:
But the men warned her, “We will be released from this oath which
you have made us take

translation.text: And the men said unto her, We will be blameless of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.

verses.english:
But the men warned her, “We will be released from this oath which
you have made us take

verses.hebrew:
הִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ בָאִים בָּאָרֶץ אֶת־תִּקְוַת חוּט הַשָּׁנִי הַזֶּה תִּקְשְׁרִי בַּחַלּוֹן אֲשֶׁר הוֹרַדְתֵּנוּ בוֹ וְאֶת־אָבִיךְ וְאֶת־אִמֵּךְ וְאֶת־אַחַיִךְ וְאֵת כּל־בֵּית
אָבִיךְ תַּאַסְפִי אֵלַיִךְ הַבָּיְתָה׃

hebrew.text:
הִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ בָאִים בָּאָרֶץ אֶת־תִּקְוַת חוּט הַשָּׁנִי הַזֶּה תִּקְשְׁרִי בַּחַלּוֹן אֲשֶׁר הוֹרַדְתֵּנוּ בוֹ וְאֶת־אָבִיךְ וְאֶת־אִמֵּךְ וְאֶת־אַחַיִךְ וְאֵת כּל־בֵּית

english.text:
[unless,] when we invade the country, you tie this length of
crimson cord to the window through which you let us down. Bring
your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your family
together in your house;

translation.text: Behold, when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father’s household, home unto thee.

verses.english:
[unless,] when we invade the country, you tie this length of
crimson cord to the window through which you let us down. Bring
your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your family
together in your house;

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא מִדַּלְתֵי בֵיתֵךְ הַחוּצָה דָּמוֹ בְרֹאשׁוֹ וַאֲנַחְנוּ נְקִיִּם וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה אִתָּךְ בַּבַּיִת דָּמוֹ בְרֹאשֵׁנוּ אִם־יָד תִּהְיֶה־בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא מִדַּלְתֵי בֵיתֵךְ הַחוּצָה דָּמוֹ בְרֹאשׁוֹ וַאֲנַחְנוּ נְקִיִּם וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה אִתָּךְ בַּבַּיִת דָּמוֹ בְרֹאשֵׁנוּ אִם־יָד תִּהְיֶה־בּוֹ׃

english.text:
and if anyone ventures outside the doors of your house, his blood
will be on his head, and we shall be clear. But if a hand is laid
on anyone who remains in the house with you, his blood shall be on
our heads.

translation.text: And it shall be, that whosoever shall go out of the doors of thy house into the street, his blood shall be upon his head, and we will be guiltless: and whosoever shall be with thee in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand be upon him.

verses.english:
and if anyone ventures outside the doors of your house, his blood
will be on his head, and we shall be clear. But if a hand is laid
on anyone who remains in the house with you, his blood shall be on
our heads.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־תַּגִּידִי אֶת־דְּבָרֵנוּ זֶה וְהָיִינוּ נְקִיִּם מִשְּׁבֻעָתֵךְ אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁבַּעְתָּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־תַּגִּידִי אֶת־דְּבָרֵנוּ זֶה וְהָיִינוּ נְקִיִּם מִשְּׁבֻעָתֵךְ אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁבַּעְתָּנוּ׃

english.text:
And if you disclose this mission of ours, we shall likewise be
released from the oath which you made us take.”

translation.text: And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.

verses.english:
And if you disclose this mission of ours, we shall likewise be
released from the oath which you made us take.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר כְּדִבְרֵיכֶם כֶּן־הוּא וַתְּשַׁלְּחֵם וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַתִּקְשֹׁר אֶת־תִּקְוַת הַשָּׁנִי בַּחַלּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר כְּדִבְרֵיכֶם כֶּן־הוּא וַתְּשַׁלְּחֵם וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַתִּקְשֹׁר אֶת־תִּקְוַת הַשָּׁנִי בַּחַלּוֹן׃

english.text:
She replied, “Let it be as you say.” She sent them on their way,
and they left; and she tied the crimson cord to the window.

translation.text: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.

verses.english:
She replied, “Let it be as you say.” She sent them on their way,
and they left; and she tied the crimson cord to the window.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ הָהָרָה וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים עַד־שָׁבוּ הָרֹדְפִים וַיְבַקְשׁוּ הָרֹדְפִים בְּכל־הַדֶּרֶךְ וְלֹא מָצָאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ הָהָרָה וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים עַד־שָׁבוּ הָרֹדְפִים וַיְבַקְשׁוּ הָרֹדְפִים בְּכל־הַדֶּרֶךְ וְלֹא מָצָאוּ׃

english.text:
They went straight to the hills and stayed there three days, until
the pursuers turned back. And so the pursuers, searching all along
the road, did not find them.

translation.text: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.

verses.english:
They went straight to the hills and stayed there three days, until
the pursuers turned back. And so the pursuers, searching all along
the road, did not find them.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ שְׁנֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיֵּרְדוּ מֵהָהָר וַיַּעַבְרוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וַיְסַפְּרוּ־לוֹ אֵת כּל־הַמֹּצְאוֹת אוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ שְׁנֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיֵּרְדוּ מֵהָהָר וַיַּעַבְרוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וַיְסַפְּרוּ־לוֹ אֵת כּל־הַמֹּצְאוֹת אוֹתָם׃

english.text:
Then the two men came down again from the hills and crossed over.
They came to Joshua son of Nun and reported to him all that had
happened to them.

translation.text: So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all things that befell them:

verses.english:
Then the two men came down again from the hills and crossed over.
They came to Joshua son of Nun and reported to him all that had
happened to them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כִּי־נָתַן יְהֹוָה בְּיָדֵנוּ אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ וְגַם־נָמֹגוּ כּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפָּנֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כִּי־נָתַן יְהֹוָה בְּיָדֵנוּ אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ וְגַם־נָמֹגוּ כּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפָּנֵינוּ׃

english.text:
They said to Joshua, “YHWH has delivered the whole land into our
power; in fact, all the inhabitants of the land are quaking before
us.”

translation.text: And they said unto Joshua, Truly the LORD hath delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.

verses.english:
They said to Joshua, “YHWH has delivered the whole land into our
power; in fact, all the inhabitants of the land are quaking before
us.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהַשִּׁטִּים וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּן הוּא וְכל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּלִנוּ שָׁם טֶרֶם יַעֲבֹרוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהַשִּׁטִּים וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּן הוּא וְכל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּלִנוּ שָׁם טֶרֶם יַעֲבֹרוּ׃

english.text:
Early next morning, Joshua and all the Israelites set out from
Shittim and marched to the Jordan. They did not cross immediately,
but spent the night there.

translation.text: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.

verses.english:
Early next morning, Joshua and all the Israelites set out from
Shittim and marched to the Jordan. They did not cross immediately,
but spent the night there.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקְצֵה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וַיַּעַבְרוּ הַשֹּׁטְרִים בְּקֶרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקְצֵה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וַיַּעַבְרוּ הַשֹּׁטְרִים בְּקֶרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text: Three days later, the officials went through the camp

translation.text: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;

verses.english: Three days later, the officials went through the camp

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַוּוּ אֶת־הָעָם לֵאמֹר כִּרְאֹתְכֶם אֵת אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְהַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם נֹשְׂאִים אֹתוֹ וְאַתֶּם תִּסְעוּ מִמְּקוֹמְכֶם וַהֲלַכְתֶּם אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַוּוּ אֶת־הָעָם לֵאמֹר כִּרְאֹתְכֶם אֵת אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְהַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם נֹשְׂאִים אֹתוֹ וְאַתֶּם תִּסְעוּ מִמְּקוֹמְכֶם וַהֲלַכְתֶּם אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
and charged the people as follows: “When you see the Ark of the
Covenant of YHWH your God being borne by the levitical priests,
you shall move forward. Follow it—

translation.text: And they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.

verses.english:
and charged the people as follows: “When you see the Ark of the
Covenant of YHWH your God being borne by the levitical priests,
you shall move forward. Follow it—

verses.hebrew:
אַךְ רָחוֹק יִהְיֶה בֵּינֵיכֶם וּבֵנָיו כְּאַלְפַּיִם אַמָּה בַּמִּדָּה אַל־תִּקְרְבוּ אֵלָיו לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר־תֵּדְעוּ אֶת־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר תֵּלְכוּ־בָהּ כִּי לֹא עֲבַרְתֶּם

english.text:
but keep a distance of some two thousand cubits from it, never
coming any closer to it—so that you may know by what route to
march, since it is a road you have not traveled before.”

translation.text: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this way heretofore.

verses.english:
but keep a distance of some two thousand cubits from it, never
coming any closer to it—so that you may know by what route to
march, since it is a road you have not traveled before.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם הִתְקַדָּשׁוּ כִּי מָחָר יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה בְּקִרְבְּכֶם נִפְלָאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם הִתְקַדָּשׁוּ כִּי מָחָר יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה בְּקִרְבְּכֶם נִפְלָאוֹת׃

english.text:
And Joshua said to the people, “Purify yourselves, for tomorrow
YHWH will perform wonders in your midst.”

translation.text: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.

verses.english:
And Joshua said to the people, “Purify yourselves, for tomorrow
YHWH will perform wonders in your midst.”

וְצַוּוּ אוֹתָם לֵאמֹר שְׂאוּ־לָכֶם מִזֶּה מִתּוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן מִמַּצַּב רַגְלֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים הָכִין שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה אֲבָנִים וְהַעֲבַרְתֶּם אוֹתָם עִמָּכֶם וְהִנַּחְתֶּם אוֹתָם

english.text:
and instruct them as follows: Pick up twelve stones from the spot
exactly in the middle of the Jordan, where the priests’ feet are
standing; take them along with you and deposit them in the place
where you will spend the night.”

translation.text: And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.

verses.english:
and instruct them as follows: Pick up twelve stones from the spot
exactly in the middle of the Jordan, where the priests’ feet are
standing; take them along with you and deposit them in the place
where you will spend the night.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־שְׁנֵים הֶעָשָׂר אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הֵכִין מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ־אֶחָד אִישׁ־אֶחָד מִשָּׁבֶט׃

english.text:
Joshua summoned the twelve men whom he had designated among the
Israelites, one from each tribe;

translation.text: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:

verses.english:
Joshua summoned the twelve men whom he had designated among the
Israelites, one from each tribe;

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ עִבְרוּ לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶל־תּוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן וְהָרִימוּ לָכֶם אִישׁ אֶבֶן אַחַת עַל־שִׁכְמוֹ לְמִסְפַּר שִׁבְטֵי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ עִבְרוּ לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶל־תּוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן וְהָרִימוּ לָכֶם אִישׁ אֶבֶן אַחַת עַל־שִׁכְמוֹ לְמִסְפַּר שִׁבְטֵי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:

the middle of the Jordan, and each of you lift a stone onto his
shoulder—corresponding to the number of the tribes of Israel.

translation.text: And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of the LORD your God into the midst of Jordan, and take you up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel:

verses.english:
and Joshua said to them, “Walk up to the Ark of YHWH your God, in
the middle of the Jordan, and each of you lift a stone onto his
shoulder—corresponding to the number of the tribes of Israel.

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן תִּהְיֶה זֹאת אוֹת בְּקִרְבְּכֶם כִּי־יִשְׁאָלוּן בְּנֵיכֶם מָחָר לֵאמֹר מָה הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן תִּהְיֶה זֹאת אוֹת בְּקִרְבְּכֶם כִּי־יִשְׁאָלוּן בְּנֵיכֶם מָחָר לֵאמֹר מָה הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה לָכֶם׃

english.text:
This shall serve as a symbol among you: in time to come, when your
children ask, ‘What is the meaning of these stones for you?’

translation.text: That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean ye by these stones?

verses.english:
This shall serve as a symbol among you: in time to come, when your
children ask, ‘What is the meaning of these stones for you?’

verses.hebrew:
וַאֲמַרְתֶּם לָהֶם אֲשֶׁר נִכְרְתוּ מֵימֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן מִפְּנֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה בְּעבְרוֹ בַּיַּרְדֵּן נִכְרְתוּ מֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן וְהָיוּ הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה לְזִכָּרוֹן
לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַאֲמַרְתֶּם לָהֶם אֲשֶׁר נִכְרְתוּ מֵימֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן מִפְּנֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה בְּעבְרוֹ בַּיַּרְדֵּן נִכְרְתוּ מֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן וְהָיוּ הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה לְזִכָּרוֹן

english.text:
you shall tell them, ‘The waters of the Jordan were cut off
because of the Ark of YHWH’s Covenant; when it passed through the
Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off.’ And so these
stones shall serve the people of Israel as a memorial for all
time.”

translation.text: Then ye shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD; when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.

verses.english:
you shall tell them, ‘The waters of the Jordan were cut off
because of the Ark of YHWH’s Covenant; when it passed through the
Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off.’ And so these
stones shall serve the people of Israel as a memorial for all
time.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־כֵן בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּשְׂאוּ שְׁתֵּי־עֶשְׂרֵה אֲבָנִים מִתּוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְמִסְפַּר

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־כֵן בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּשְׂאוּ שְׁתֵּי־עֶשְׂרֵה אֲבָנִים מִתּוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְמִסְפַּר

english.text:
The Israelites did as Joshua ordered. They picked up twelve
stones, corresponding to the number of the tribes of Israel, from
the middle of the Jordan—as YHWH had charged Joshua—and they took
them along with them to their night encampment and deposited them
there.

translation.text: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as the LORD spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.

verses.english:
The Israelites did as Joshua ordered. They picked up twelve
stones, corresponding to the number of the tribes of Israel, from
the middle of the Jordan—as YHWH had charged Joshua—and they took
them along with them to their night encampment and deposited them
there.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה אֲבָנִים הֵקִים יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בְּתוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן תַּחַת מַצַּב רַגְלֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן הַבְּרִית וַיִּהְיוּ שָׁם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה אֲבָנִים הֵקִים יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בְּתוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן תַּחַת מַצַּב רַגְלֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן הַבְּרִית וַיִּהְיוּ שָׁם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Joshua also set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, at
the spot where the feet of the priests bearing the Ark of the
Covenant had stood; and they have remained there to this day.

translation.text: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.

verses.english:
Joshua also set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, at
the spot where the feet of the priests bearing the Ark of the
Covenant had stood; and they have remained there to this day.

verses.hebrew:
וְהַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי הָאָרוֹן עֹמְדִים בְּתוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן עַד תֹּם כּל־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְדַבֵּר אֶל־הָעָם כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה
אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיְמַהֲרוּ הָעָם וַיַּעֲבֹרוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וְהַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי הָאָרוֹן עֹמְדִים בְּתוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן עַד תֹּם כּל־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְדַבֵּר אֶל־הָעָם כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה

english.text:
The priests who bore the Ark remained standing in the middle of
the Jordan until all the instructions that YHWH had ordered Joshua
to convey to the people had been carried out. And so the people
speedily crossed over, just as Moses had assured Joshua in his
charge to him.

translation.text: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until everything was finished that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.

verses.english:
The priests who bore the Ark remained standing in the middle of
the Jordan until all the instructions that YHWH had ordered Joshua
to convey to the people had been carried out. And so the people
speedily crossed over, just as Moses had assured Joshua in his
charge to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר־תַּם כּל־הָעָם לַעֲבוֹר וַיַּעֲבֹר אֲרוֹן־יְהֹוָה וְהַכֹּהֲנִים לִפְנֵי הָעָם׃

english.text:
And when all the people finished crossing, the Ark of YHWH and the
priests advanced to the head of the people.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the LORD passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.

verses.english:
And when all the people finished crossing, the Ark of YHWH and the
priests advanced to the head of the people.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה חֲמֻשִׁים לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲלֵיהֶם מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה חֲמֻשִׁים לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲלֵיהֶם מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh went
across armed in the van of the Israelites, as Moses had charged
them.

translation.text: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spake unto them:

verses.english:
The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh went
across armed in the van of the Israelites, as Moses had charged
them.

verses.hebrew: כְּאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף חֲלוּצֵי הַצָּבָא עָבְרוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לַמִּלְחָמָה אֶל עַרְבוֹת יְרִיחוֹ׃

english.text:
About forty thousand shock troops went across, at the instance of
YHWH, to the steppes of Jericho for battle.

translation.text: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the LORD unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.

verses.english:
About forty thousand shock troops went across, at the instance of
YHWH, to the steppes of Jericho for battle.

english.text:
On that day YHWH exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel, so
that they revered him all his days as they had revered Moses.

translation.text: On that day the LORD magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

verses.english:
On that day YHWH exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel, so
that they revered him all his days as they had revered Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: YHWH said to Joshua,
