verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי (בעלות) [כַּעֲלוֹת] הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה מִתּוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן נִתְּקוּ כַּפּוֹת רַגְלֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶל הֶחָרָבָה וַיָּשֻׁבוּ מֵי־הַיַּרְדֵּן
לִמְקוֹמָם וַיֵּלְכוּ כִתְמוֹל־שִׁלְשׁוֹם עַל־כּל־גְּדוֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי (בעלות) [כַּעֲלוֹת] הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה מִתּוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן נִתְּקוּ כַּפּוֹת רַגְלֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶל הֶחָרָבָה וַיָּשֻׁבוּ מֵי־הַיַּרְדֵּן
לִמְקוֹמָם וַיֵּלְכוּ כִתְמוֹל־שִׁלְשׁוֹם עַל־כּל־גְּדוֹתָיו׃

english.text:
As soon as the priests who bore the Ark of YHWH’s Covenant came up
out of the Jordan, and the feet of the priests stepped onto the
dry ground, the waters of the Jordan resumed their course, flowing
over its entire bed as before.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD were come up out of the midst of Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as they did before.

verses.english:
As soon as the priests who bore the Ark of YHWH’s Covenant came up
out of the Jordan, and the feet of the priests stepped onto the
dry ground, the waters of the Jordan resumed their course, flowing
over its entire bed as before.

verses.hebrew: וְהָעָם עָלוּ מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּגִּלְגָּל בִּקְצֵה מִזְרַח יְרִיחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעָם עָלוּ מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּגִּלְגָּל בִּקְצֵה מִזְרַח יְרִיחוֹ׃

english.text:
The people came up from the Jordan on the tenth day of the first
month, and encamped at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho.

translation.text: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.

verses.english:
The people came up from the Jordan on the tenth day of the first
month, and encamped at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן הֵקִים יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּגִּלְגָּל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן הֵקִים יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּגִּלְגָּל׃

english.text:
And Joshua set up in Gilgal the twelve stones they had taken from
the Jordan.

translation.text: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.

verses.english:
And Joshua set up in Gilgal the twelve stones they had taken from
the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁאָלוּן בְּנֵיכֶם מָחָר אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם לֵאמֹר מָה הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁאָלוּן בְּנֵיכֶם מָחָר אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם לֵאמֹר מָה הָאֲבָנִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
He charged the Israelites as follows: “In time to come, when your
children ask their fathers, ‘What is the meaning of those stones?’

translation.text: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?

verses.english:
He charged the Israelites as follows: “In time to come, when your
children ask their fathers, ‘What is the meaning of those stones?’

verses.hebrew: וְהוֹדַעְתֶּם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶם לֵאמֹר בַּיַּבָּשָׁה עָבַר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹדַעְתֶּם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶם לֵאמֹר בַּיַּבָּשָׁה עָבַר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
tell your children: ‘Here the Israelites crossed the Jordan on dry
land.’

translation.text: Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

verses.english:
tell your children: ‘Here the Israelites crossed the Jordan on dry
land.’

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִישׁ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶת־מֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן מִפְּנֵיכֶם עַד־עבְרְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְיַם־סוּף אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִישׁ מִפָּנֵינוּ עַד־עבְרֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִישׁ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶת־מֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן מִפְּנֵיכֶם עַד־עבְרְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְיַם־סוּף אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִישׁ מִפָּנֵינוּ עַד־עבְרֵנוּ׃

english.text:
For YHWH your God dried up the waters of the Jordan before you
until you crossed, just as YHWH your God did to the Sea of Reeds,
which He dried up before us until we crossed.

translation.text: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until ye were passed over, as the LORD your God did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:

verses.english:
For YHWH your God dried up the waters of the Jordan before you
until you crossed, just as YHWH your God did to the Sea of Reeds,
which He dried up before us until we crossed.

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן דַּעַת כּל־עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ אֶת־יַד יְהֹוָה כִּי חֲזָקָה הִיא לְמַעַן יְרָאתֶם אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן דַּעַת כּל־עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ אֶת־יַד יְהֹוָה כִּי חֲזָקָה הִיא לְמַעַן יְרָאתֶם אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
Thus all the peoples of the earth shall know how mighty is the
hand of YHWH, and you shall fear YHWH your God always.”

translation.text: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the LORD, that it is mighty: that ye might fear the LORD your God for ever.

verses.english:
Thus all the peoples of the earth shall know how mighty is the
hand of YHWH, and you shall fear YHWH your God always.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ כּל־מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן יָמָּה וְכל־מַלְכֵי הַכְּנַעֲנִי אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַיָּם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִישׁ יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן מִפְּנֵי
בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־[עבְרָם] (עברנו) וַיִּמַּס לְבָבָם וְלֹא־הָיָה בָם עוֹד רוּחַ מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ כּל־מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן יָמָּה וְכל־מַלְכֵי הַכְּנַעֲנִי אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַיָּם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִישׁ יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן מִפְּנֵי
בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־[עבְרָם] (עברנו) וַיִּמַּס לְבָבָם וְלֹא־הָיָה בָם עוֹד רוּחַ מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
When all the kings of the Amorites on the western side of the
Jordan, and all the kings of the Canaanites near the Sea, heard
how YHWH had dried up the waters of the Jordan for the sake of the
Israelites until they crossed over, they lost heart, and no spirit
was left in them because of the Israelites.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which were on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, which were by the sea, heard that the LORD had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children of Israel, until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Israel.

verses.english:
When all the kings of the Amorites on the western side of the
Jordan, and all the kings of the Canaanites near the Sea, heard
how YHWH had dried up the waters of the Jordan for the sake of the
Israelites until they crossed over, they lost heart, and no spirit
was left in them because of the Israelites.

verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ עֲשֵׂה לְךָ חַרְבוֹת צֻרִים וְשׁוּב מֹל אֶת־בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: בָּעֵת הַהִיא אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ עֲשֵׂה לְךָ חַרְבוֹת צֻרִים וְשׁוּב מֹל אֶת־בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁנִית׃

english.text:
At that time YHWH said to Joshua, “Make flint knives and proceed
with a second circumcision of the Israelites.”

translation.text: At that time the LORD said unto Joshua, Make thee sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.

verses.english:
At that time YHWH said to Joshua, “Make flint knives and proceed
with a second circumcision of the Israelites.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ־לוֹ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ חַרְבוֹת צֻרִים וַיָּמל אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־גִּבְעַת הָעֲרָלוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ־לוֹ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ חַרְבוֹת צֻרִים וַיָּמל אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־גִּבְעַת הָעֲרָלוֹת׃

english.text:
So Joshua had flint knives made, and the Israelites were
circumcised at Gibeath-haaraloth.

translation.text: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

verses.english:
So Joshua had flint knives made, and the Israelites were
circumcised at Gibeath-haaraloth.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־מָל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כּל־הָעָם הַיֹּצֵא מִמִּצְרַיִם הַזְּכָרִים כֹּל אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה מֵתוּ בַמִּדְבָּר בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּצֵאתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־מָל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כּל־הָעָם הַיֹּצֵא מִמִּצְרַיִם הַזְּכָרִים כֹּל אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה מֵתוּ בַמִּדְבָּר בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּצֵאתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
This is the reason why Joshua had the circumcision performed: All
the people who had come out of Egypt, all the males of military
age, had died during the desert wanderings after leaving Egypt.

translation.text: And this is the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the people that came out of Egypt, that were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came out of Egypt.

verses.english:
This is the reason why Joshua had the circumcision performed: All
the people who had come out of Egypt, all the males of military
age, had died during the desert wanderings after leaving Egypt.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־מֻלִים הָיוּ כּל־הָעָם הַיֹּצְאִים וְכל־הָעָם הַיִּלֹּדִים בַּמִּדְבָּר בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּצֵאתָם מִמִּצְרַיִם לֹא־מָלוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־מֻלִים הָיוּ כּל־הָעָם הַיֹּצְאִים וְכל־הָעָם הַיִּלֹּדִים בַּמִּדְבָּר בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּצֵאתָם מִמִּצְרַיִם לֹא־מָלוּ׃

english.text:
Now, whereas all the people who came out of Egypt had been
circumcised, none of the people born after the exodus, during the
desert wanderings, had been circumcised.

translation.text: Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the people that were born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt, them they had not circumcised.

verses.english:
Now, whereas all the people who came out of Egypt had been
circumcised, none of the people born after the exodus, during the
desert wanderings, had been circumcised.

verses.hebrew:
כִּי אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה הָלְכוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר עַד־תֹּם כּל־הַגּוֹי אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַיֹּצְאִים מִמִּצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר
נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לָהֶם לְבִלְתִּי הַרְאוֹתָם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבוֹתָם לָתֶת לָנוּ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה הָלְכוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר עַד־תֹּם כּל־הַגּוֹי אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַיֹּצְאִים מִמִּצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר
נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לָהֶם לְבִלְתִּי הַרְאוֹתָם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לַאֲבוֹתָם לָתֶת לָנוּ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ׃

english.text:
For the Israelites had traveled in the wilderness forty years,
until the entire nation—the men of military age who had left
Egypt—had perished; because they had not obeyed YHWH, and YHWH had
sworn never to let them see the land that YHWH had sworn to their
fathers to assign to us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

translation.text: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people that were men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD: unto whom the LORD sware that he would not shew them the land, which the LORD sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

verses.english:
For the Israelites had traveled in the wilderness forty years,
until the entire nation—the men of military age who had left
Egypt—had perished; because they had not obeyed YHWH, and YHWH had
sworn never to let them see the land that YHWH had sworn to their
fathers to assign to us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם הֵקִים תַּחְתָּם אֹתָם מָל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כִּי־עֲרֵלִים הָיוּ כִּי לֹא־מָלוּ אוֹתָם בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם הֵקִים תַּחְתָּם אֹתָם מָל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כִּי־עֲרֵלִים הָיוּ כִּי לֹא־מָלוּ אוֹתָם בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

english.text:
But He had raised up their sons in their stead; and it was these
that Joshua circumcised, for they were uncircumcised, not having
been circumcised on the way.

translation.text: And their children, whom he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.

verses.english:
But He had raised up their sons in their stead; and it was these
that Joshua circumcised, for they were uncircumcised, not having
been circumcised on the way.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר־תַּמּוּ כל־הַגּוֹי לְהִמּוֹל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּם בַּמַּחֲנֶה עַד חֲיוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר־תַּמּוּ כל־הַגּוֹי לְהִמּוֹל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּם בַּמַּחֲנֶה עַד חֲיוֹתָם׃

english.text:
After the circumcising of the whole nation was completed, they
remained where they were, in the camp, until they recovered.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.

verses.english:
After the circumcising of the whole nation was completed, they
remained where they were, in the camp, until they recovered.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ הַיּוֹם גַּלּוֹתִי אֶת־חֶרְפַּת מִצְרַיִם מֵעֲלֵיכֶם וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא גִּלְגָּל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ הַיּוֹם גַּלּוֹתִי אֶת־חֶרְפַּת מִצְרַיִם מֵעֲלֵיכֶם וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא גִּלְגָּל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away from you the
disgrace of Egypt.” So that place was called Gilgal, as it still
is.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away from you the
disgrace of Egypt.” So that place was called Gilgal, as it still
is.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּגִּלְגָּל וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת־הַפֶּסַח בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ בָּעֶרֶב בְּעַרְבוֹת יְרִיחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּגִּלְגָּל וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת־הַפֶּסַח בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ בָּעֶרֶב בְּעַרְבוֹת יְרִיחוֹ׃

english.text:
Encamped at Gilgal, in the steppes of Jericho, the Israelites
offered the passover sacrifice on the fourteenth day of the month,
toward evening.

translation.text: And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, and kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.

verses.english:
Encamped at Gilgal, in the steppes of Jericho, the Israelites
offered the passover sacrifice on the fourteenth day of the month,
toward evening.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאכְלוּ מֵעֲבוּר הָאָרֶץ מִמּחֳרַת הַפֶּסַח מַצּוֹת וְקָלוּי בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאכְלוּ מֵעֲבוּר הָאָרֶץ מִמּחֳרַת הַפֶּסַח מַצּוֹת וְקָלוּי בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
On the day after the passover offering, on that very day, they ate
of the produce of the country, unleavened bread and parched grain.

translation.text: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.

verses.english:
On the day after the passover offering, on that very day, they ate
of the produce of the country, unleavened bread and parched grain.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁבֹּת הַמָּן מִמּחֳרָת בְּאכְלָם מֵעֲבוּר הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא־הָיָה עוֹד לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מָן וַיֹּאכְלוּ מִתְּבוּאַת אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן בַּשָּׁנָה הַהִיא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁבֹּת הַמָּן מִמּחֳרָת בְּאכְלָם מֵעֲבוּר הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא־הָיָה עוֹד לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מָן וַיֹּאכְלוּ מִתְּבוּאַת אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן בַּשָּׁנָה הַהִיא׃

english.text:
On that same day, when they ate of the produce of the land, the
manna ceased. The Israelites got no more manna; that year they ate
of the yield of the land of Canaan.

translation.text: And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old corn of the land; neither had the children of Israel manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

verses.english:
On that same day, when they ate of the produce of the land, the
manna ceased. The Israelites got no more manna; that year they ate
of the yield of the land of Canaan.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּירִיחוֹ וַיִּשָּׂא עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ עֹמֵד לְנֶגְדּוֹ וְחַרְבּוֹ שְׁלוּפָה בְּיָדוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הֲלָנוּ
אַתָּה אִם־לְצָרֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּירִיחוֹ וַיִּשָּׂא עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ עֹמֵד לְנֶגְדּוֹ וְחַרְבּוֹ שְׁלוּפָה בְּיָדוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הֲלָנוּ
אַתָּה אִם־לְצָרֵינוּ׃

english.text:
Once, when Joshua was near Jericho, he looked up and saw a man
standing before him, drawn sword in hand. Joshua went up to him
and asked him, “Are you one of us or of our enemies?”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, Art thou for us, or for our adversaries?

verses.english:
Once, when Joshua was near Jericho, he looked up and saw a man
standing before him, drawn sword in hand. Joshua went up to him
and asked him, “Are you one of us or of our enemies?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא כִּי אֲנִי שַׂר־צְבָא־יְהֹוָה עַתָּה בָאתִי וַיִּפֹּל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־פָּנָיו אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מָה אֲדֹנִי מְדַבֵּר אֶל־עַבְדּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא כִּי אֲנִי שַׂר־צְבָא־יְהֹוָה עַתָּה בָאתִי וַיִּפֹּל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־פָּנָיו אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מָה אֲדֹנִי מְדַבֵּר אֶל־עַבְדּוֹ׃

english.text:
He replied, “No, I am captain of YHWH’s host. Now I have come!”
Joshua threw himself face down to the ground and, prostrating
himself, said to him, “What does my lord command his servant?”

translation.text: And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of the LORD am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What saith my Lord unto his servant?

verses.english:
He replied, “No, I am captain of YHWH’s host. Now I have come!”
Joshua threw himself face down to the ground and, prostrating
himself, said to him, “What does my lord command his servant?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שַׂר־צְבָא יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שַׁל־נַעַלְךָ מֵעַל רַגְלֶךָ כִּי הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹמֵד עָלָיו קֹדֶשׁ הוּא וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שַׂר־צְבָא יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שַׁל־נַעַלְךָ מֵעַל רַגְלֶךָ כִּי הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹמֵד עָלָיו קֹדֶשׁ הוּא וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כֵּן׃

english.text:
The captain of YHWH’s host answered Joshua, “Remove your sandals
from your feet, for the place where you stand is holy.” And Joshua
did so.

translation.text: And the captain of the LORD’s host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.

verses.english:
The captain of YHWH’s host answered Joshua, “Remove your sandals
from your feet, for the place where you stand is holy.” And Joshua
did so.

verses.hebrew: וִירִיחוֹ סֹגֶרֶת וּמְסֻגֶּרֶת מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵין יוֹצֵא וְאֵין בָּא׃

hebrew.text: וִירִיחוֹ סֹגֶרֶת וּמְסֻגֶּרֶת מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵין יוֹצֵא וְאֵין בָּא׃

english.text:
Now Jericho was shut up tight because of the Israelites; no one
could leave or enter.

translation.text: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in.

verses.english:
Now Jericho was shut up tight because of the Israelites; no one
could leave or enter.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ רְאֵה נָתַתִּי בְיָדְךָ אֶת־יְרִיחוֹ וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ גִּבּוֹרֵי הֶחָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ רְאֵה נָתַתִּי בְיָדְךָ אֶת־יְרִיחוֹ וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ גִּבּוֹרֵי הֶחָיִל׃

english.text:
YHWH said to Joshua, “See, I will deliver Jericho and her king
[and her] warriors into your hands.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.

verses.english:
YHWH said to Joshua, “See, I will deliver Jericho and her king
[and her] warriors into your hands.

verses.hebrew: וְסַבֹּתֶם אֶת־הָעִיר כֹּל אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַקֵּיף אֶת־הָעִיר פַּעַם אֶחָת כֹּה תַעֲשֶׂה שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְסַבֹּתֶם אֶת־הָעִיר כֹּל אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַקֵּיף אֶת־הָעִיר פַּעַם אֶחָת כֹּה תַעֲשֶׂה שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים׃

english.text:
Let all your troops march around the city and complete one circuit
of the city. Do this six days,

translation.text: And ye shall compass the city, all ye men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.

verses.english:
Let all your troops march around the city and complete one circuit
of the city. Do this six days,

verses.hebrew: וְשִׁבְעָה כֹהֲנִים יִשְׂאוּ שִׁבְעָה שׁוֹפְרוֹת הַיּוֹבְלִים לִפְנֵי הָאָרוֹן וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי תָּסֹבּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְהַכֹּהֲנִים יִתְקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְשִׁבְעָה כֹהֲנִים יִשְׂאוּ שִׁבְעָה שׁוֹפְרוֹת הַיּוֹבְלִים לִפְנֵי הָאָרוֹן וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי תָּסֹבּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְהַכֹּהֲנִים יִתְקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת׃

english.text:
with seven priests carrying seven ram’s horns preceding the Ark.
On the seventh day, march around the city seven times, with the
priests blowing the horns.

translation.text: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams’ horns: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.

verses.english:
with seven priests carrying seven ram’s horns preceding the Ark.
On the seventh day, march around the city seven times, with the
priests blowing the horns.

verses.hebrew:
וְהָיָה בִּמְשֹׁךְ בְּקֶרֶן הַיּוֹבֵל (בשמעכם) [כְּשׁמְעֲכֶם] אֶת־קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר יָרִיעוּ כל־הָעָם תְּרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וְנָפְלָה חוֹמַת הָעִיר תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְעָלוּ הָעָם אִישׁ
נֶגְדּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְהָיָה בִּמְשֹׁךְ בְּקֶרֶן הַיּוֹבֵל (בשמעכם) [כְּשׁמְעֲכֶם] אֶת־קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר יָרִיעוּ כל־הָעָם תְּרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וְנָפְלָה חוֹמַת הָעִיר תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְעָלוּ הָעָם אִישׁ
נֶגְדּוֹ׃

english.text:
And when a long blast is sounded on the horn—as soon as you hear
that sound of the horn—all the people shall give a mighty shout.
Thereupon the city wall will collapse, and the people shall
advance, every man straight ahead.”

translation.text: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.

verses.english:
And when a long blast is sounded on the horn—as soon as you hear
that sound of the horn—all the people shall give a mighty shout.
Thereupon the city wall will collapse, and the people shall
advance, every man straight ahead.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם שְׂאוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הַבְּרִית וְשִׁבְעָה כֹהֲנִים יִשְׂאוּ שִׁבְעָה שׁוֹפְרוֹת יוֹבְלִים לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם שְׂאוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הַבְּרִית וְשִׁבְעָה כֹהֲנִים יִשְׂאוּ שִׁבְעָה שׁוֹפְרוֹת יוֹבְלִים לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Joshua son of Nun summoned the priests and said to them, “Take up
the Ark of the Covenant, and let seven priests carrying seven
ram’s horns precede the Ark of YHWH.”

translation.text: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the LORD.

verses.english:
Joshua son of Nun summoned the priests and said to them, “Take up
the Ark of the Covenant, and let seven priests carrying seven
ram’s horns precede the Ark of YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: (ויאמרו) [וַיֹּאמֶר] אֶל־הָעָם עִבְרוּ וְסֹבּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר וְהֶחָלוּץ יַעֲבֹר לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: (ויאמרו) [וַיֹּאמֶר] אֶל־הָעָם עִבְרוּ וְסֹבּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר וְהֶחָלוּץ יַעֲבֹר לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And he instructed the people, “Go forward, march around the city,
with the vanguard marching in front of the Ark of YHWH.”

translation.text: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the LORD.

verses.english:
And he instructed the people, “Go forward, march around the city,
with the vanguard marching in front of the Ark of YHWH.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כֶּאֱמֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם וְשִׁבְעָה הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאִים שִׁבְעָה שׁוֹפְרוֹת הַיּוֹבְלִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עָבְרוּ וְתָקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וַאֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה
הֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כֶּאֱמֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם וְשִׁבְעָה הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאִים שִׁבְעָה שׁוֹפְרוֹת הַיּוֹבְלִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עָבְרוּ וְתָקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וַאֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה
הֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
When Joshua had instructed the people, the seven priests carrying
seven ram’s horns advanced before YHWH, blowing their horns; and
the Ark of YHWH’s Covenant followed them.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns passed on before the LORD, and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.

verses.english:
When Joshua had instructed the people, the seven priests carrying
seven ram’s horns advanced before YHWH, blowing their horns; and
the Ark of YHWH’s Covenant followed them.

verses.hebrew: וְהֶחָלוּץ הֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים (תקעו) [תֹּקְעֵי] הַשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וְהַמְאַסֵּף הֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֵי הָאָרוֹן הָלוֹךְ וְתָקוֹעַ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶחָלוּץ הֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים (תקעו) [תֹּקְעֵי] הַשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וְהַמְאַסֵּף הֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֵי הָאָרוֹן הָלוֹךְ וְתָקוֹעַ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת׃

english.text:
The vanguard marched in front of the priests who were blowing the
horns, and the rear guard marched behind the Ark, with the horns
sounding all the time.

translation.text: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

verses.english:
The vanguard marched in front of the priests who were blowing the
horns, and the rear guard marched behind the Ark, with the horns
sounding all the time.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הָעָם צִוָּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר לֹא תָרִיעוּ וְלֹא־תַשְׁמִיעוּ אֶת־קוֹלְכֶם וְלֹא־יֵצֵא מִפִּיכֶם דָּבָר עַד יוֹם אמְרִי אֲלֵיכֶם הָרִיעוּ וַהֲרִיעֹתֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הָעָם צִוָּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר לֹא תָרִיעוּ וְלֹא־תַשְׁמִיעוּ אֶת־קוֹלְכֶם וְלֹא־יֵצֵא מִפִּיכֶם דָּבָר עַד יוֹם אמְרִי אֲלֵיכֶם הָרִיעוּ וַהֲרִיעֹתֶם׃

english.text:
But Joshua’s orders to the rest of the people were, “Do not shout,
do not let your voices be heard, and do not let a sound issue from
your lips until the moment that I command you, ‘Shout!’ Then you
shall shout.”

translation.text: And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, Ye shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall ye shout.

verses.english:
But Joshua’s orders to the rest of the people were, “Do not shout,
do not let your voices be heard, and do not let a sound issue from
your lips until the moment that I command you, ‘Shout!’ Then you
shall shout.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּסֵּב אֲרוֹן־יְהֹוָה אֶת־הָעִיר הַקֵּף פַּעַם אֶחָת וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּלִינוּ בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּסֵּב אֲרוֹן־יְהֹוָה אֶת־הָעִיר הַקֵּף פַּעַם אֶחָת וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּלִינוּ בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
So he had the Ark of YHWH go around the city and complete one
circuit; then they returned to camp and spent the night in camp.

translation.text: So the ark of the LORD compassed the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.

verses.english:
So he had the Ark of YHWH go around the city and complete one
circuit; then they returned to camp and spent the night in camp.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּשְׂאוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּשְׂאוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Joshua rose early the next day; and the priests took up the Ark of
YHWH,

translation.text: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the LORD.

verses.english:
Joshua rose early the next day; and the priests took up the Ark of
YHWH,

verses.hebrew:
וְשִׁבְעָה הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאִים שִׁבְעָה שׁוֹפְרוֹת הַיֹּבְלִים לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה הֹלְכִים הָלוֹךְ וְתָקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וְהֶחָלוּץ הֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵיהֶם וְהַמְאַסֵּף הֹלֵךְ
אַחֲרֵי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה (הולך) [הָלוֹךְ] וְתָקוֹעַ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת׃

hebrew.text:
וְשִׁבְעָה הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאִים שִׁבְעָה שׁוֹפְרוֹת הַיֹּבְלִים לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה הֹלְכִים הָלוֹךְ וְתָקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וְהֶחָלוּץ הֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵיהֶם וְהַמְאַסֵּף הֹלֵךְ
אַחֲרֵי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה (הולך) [הָלוֹךְ] וְתָקוֹעַ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת׃

english.text:
while the seven priests bearing the seven ram’s horns marched in
front of the Ark of YHWH, blowing the horns as they marched. The
vanguard marched in front of them, and the rear guard marched
behind the Ark of YHWH, with the horns sounding all the time.

translation.text: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the LORD went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of the LORD, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

verses.english:
while the seven priests bearing the seven ram’s horns marched in
front of the Ark of YHWH, blowing the horns as they marched. The
vanguard marched in front of them, and the rear guard marched
behind the Ark of YHWH, with the horns sounding all the time.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּסֹבּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי פַּעַם אַחַת וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּחֲנֶה כֹּה עָשׂוּ שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּסֹבּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי פַּעַם אַחַת וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּחֲנֶה כֹּה עָשׂוּ שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים׃

english.text:
And so they marched around the city once on the second day and
returned to the camp. They did this six days.

translation.text: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.

verses.english:
And so they marched around the city once on the second day and
returned to the camp. They did this six days.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ כַּעֲלוֹת הַשַּׁחַר וַיָּסֹבּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר כַּמִּשְׁפָּט הַזֶּה שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים רַק בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא סָבְבוּ אֶת־הָעִיר שֶׁבַע
פְּעָמִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ כַּעֲלוֹת הַשַּׁחַר וַיָּסֹבּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר כַּמִּשְׁפָּט הַזֶּה שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים רַק בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא סָבְבוּ אֶת־הָעִיר שֶׁבַע
פְּעָמִים׃

english.text:
On the seventh day, they rose at daybreak and marched around the
city, in the same manner, seven times; that was the only day that
they marched around the city seven times.

translation.text: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.

verses.english:
On the seventh day, they rose at daybreak and marched around the
city, in the same manner, seven times; that was the only day that
they marched around the city seven times.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּפַּעַם הַשְּׁבִיעִית תָּקְעוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם הָרִיעוּ כִּי־נָתַן יְהֹוָה לָכֶם אֶת־הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּפַּעַם הַשְּׁבִיעִית תָּקְעוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם הָרִיעוּ כִּי־נָתַן יְהֹוָה לָכֶם אֶת־הָעִיר׃

english.text:
On the seventh round, as the priests blew the horns, Joshua
commanded the people, “Shout! For YHWH has given you the city.

translation.text: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the LORD hath given you the city.

verses.english:
On the seventh round, as the priests blew the horns, Joshua
commanded the people, “Shout! For YHWH has given you the city.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה הָעִיר חֵרֶם הִיא וְכל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לַיהֹוָה רַק רָחָב הַזּוֹנָה תִּחְיֶה הִיא וְכל־אֲשֶׁר אִתָּהּ בַּבַּיִת כִּי הֶחְבְּאַתָה אֶת־הַמַּלְאָכִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלָחְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה הָעִיר חֵרֶם הִיא וְכל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לַיהֹוָה רַק רָחָב הַזּוֹנָה תִּחְיֶה הִיא וְכל־אֲשֶׁר אִתָּהּ בַּבַּיִת כִּי הֶחְבְּאַתָה אֶת־הַמַּלְאָכִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלָחְנוּ׃

english.text:
The city and everything in it are to be proscribed for YHWH; only
Rahab the harlot is to be spared, and all who are with her in the
house, because she hid the messengers we sent.

translation.text: And the city shall be accursed, even it, and all that are therein, to the LORD: only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

verses.english:
The city and everything in it are to be proscribed for YHWH; only
Rahab the harlot is to be spared, and all who are with her in the
house, because she hid the messengers we sent.

verses.hebrew: וְרַק־אַתֶּם שִׁמְרוּ מִן־הַחֵרֶם פֶּן־תַּחֲרִימוּ וּלְקַחְתֶּם מִן־הַחֵרֶם וְשַׂמְתֶּם אֶת־מַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל לְחֵרֶם וַעֲכַרְתֶּם אוֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְרַק־אַתֶּם שִׁמְרוּ מִן־הַחֵרֶם פֶּן־תַּחֲרִימוּ וּלְקַחְתֶּם מִן־הַחֵרֶם וְשַׂמְתֶּם אֶת־מַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל לְחֵרֶם וַעֲכַרְתֶּם אוֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
But you must beware of that which is proscribed, or else you will
be proscribed: if you take anything from that which is proscribed,
you will cause the camp of Israel to be proscribed; you will bring
calamity upon it.

translation.text: And ye, in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest ye make yourselves accursed, when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.

verses.english:
But you must beware of that which is proscribed, or else you will
be proscribed: if you take anything from that which is proscribed,
you will cause the camp of Israel to be proscribed; you will bring
calamity upon it.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וּכְלֵי נְחֹשֶׁת וּבַרְזֶל קֹדֶשׁ הוּא לַיהֹוָה אוֹצַר יְהֹוָה יָבוֹא׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וּכְלֵי נְחֹשֶׁת וּבַרְזֶל קֹדֶשׁ הוּא לַיהֹוָה אוֹצַר יְהֹוָה יָבוֹא׃

english.text:
All the silver and gold and objects of copper and iron are
consecrated to YHWH; they must go into the treasury of YHWH.”

translation.text: But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, are consecrated unto the LORD: they shall come into the treasury of the LORD.

verses.english:
All the silver and gold and objects of copper and iron are
consecrated to YHWH; they must go into the treasury of YHWH.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּרַע הָעָם וַיִּתְקְעוּ בַּשֹּׁפָרוֹת וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ הָעָם אֶת־קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר וַיָּרִיעוּ הָעָם תְּרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וַתִּפֹּל הַחוֹמָה תַּחְתֶּיהָ וַיַּעַל הָעָם הָעִירָה
אִישׁ נֶגְדּוֹ וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אֶת־הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּרַע הָעָם וַיִּתְקְעוּ בַּשֹּׁפָרוֹת וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ הָעָם אֶת־קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר וַיָּרִיעוּ הָעָם תְּרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וַתִּפֹּל הַחוֹמָה תַּחְתֶּיהָ וַיַּעַל הָעָם הָעִירָה
אִישׁ נֶגְדּוֹ וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אֶת־הָעִיר׃

english.text:
So the people shouted when the horns were sounded. When the people
heard the sound of the horns, the people raised a mighty shout and
the wall collapsed. The people rushed into the city, every man
straight in front of him, and they captured the city.

translation.text: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.

verses.english:
So the people shouted when the horns were sounded. When the people
heard the sound of the horns, the people raised a mighty shout and
the wall collapsed. The people rushed into the city, every man
straight in front of him, and they captured the city.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲרִימוּ אֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר בָּעִיר מֵאִישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁה מִנַּעַר וְעַד־זָקֵן וְעַד שׁוֹר וָשֶׂה וַחֲמוֹר לְפִי־חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲרִימוּ אֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר בָּעִיר מֵאִישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁה מִנַּעַר וְעַד־זָקֵן וְעַד שׁוֹר וָשֶׂה וַחֲמוֹר לְפִי־חָרֶב׃

english.text:
They exterminated everything in the city with the sword: man and
woman, young and old, ox and sheep and ass.

translation.text: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.

verses.english:
They exterminated everything in the city with the sword: man and
woman, young and old, ox and sheep and ass.

verses.hebrew:
וְלִשְׁנַיִם הָאֲנָשִׁים הַמְרַגְּלִים אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אָמַר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בֹּאוּ בֵּית־הָאִשָּׁה הַזּוֹנָה וְהוֹצִיאוּ מִשָּׁם אֶת־הָאִשָּׁה וְאֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר
נִשְׁבַּעְתֶּם לָהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וְלִשְׁנַיִם הָאֲנָשִׁים הַמְרַגְּלִים אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אָמַר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בֹּאוּ בֵּית־הָאִשָּׁה הַזּוֹנָה וְהוֹצִיאוּ מִשָּׁם אֶת־הָאִשָּׁה וְאֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר
נִשְׁבַּעְתֶּם לָהּ׃

english.text:
But Joshua bade the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into
the harlot’s house and bring out the woman and all that belong to
her, as you swore to her.”

translation.text: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country, Go into the harlot’s house, and bring out thence the woman, and all that she hath, as ye sware unto her.

verses.english:
But Joshua bade the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into
the harlot’s house and bring out the woman and all that belong to
her, as you swore to her.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹאוּ הַנְּעָרִים הַמְרַגְּלִים וַיֹּצִיאוּ אֶת־רָחָב וְאֶת־אָבִיהָ וְאֶת־אִמָּהּ וְאֶת־אַחֶיהָ וְאֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לָהּ וְאֵת כּל־מִשְׁפְּחוֹתֶיהָ הוֹצִיאוּ וַיַּנִּיחוּם מִחוּץ
לְמַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹאוּ הַנְּעָרִים הַמְרַגְּלִים וַיֹּצִיאוּ אֶת־רָחָב וְאֶת־אָבִיהָ וְאֶת־אִמָּהּ וְאֶת־אַחֶיהָ וְאֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לָהּ וְאֵת כּל־מִשְׁפְּחוֹתֶיהָ הוֹצִיאוּ וַיַּנִּיחוּם מִחוּץ
לְמַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
So the young spies went in and brought out Rahab, her father and
her mother, her brothers and all that belonged to her—they brought
out her whole family and left them outside the camp of Israel.

translation.text: And the young men that were spies went in, and brought out Rahab, and her father, and her mother, and her brethren, and all that she had; and they brought out all her kindred, and left them without the camp of Israel.

verses.english:
So the young spies went in and brought out Rahab, her father and
her mother, her brothers and all that belonged to her—they brought
out her whole family and left them outside the camp of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְהָעִיר שָׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ רַק הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב וּכְלֵי הַנְּחֹשֶׁת וְהַבַּרְזֶל נָתְנוּ אוֹצַר בֵּית־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעִיר שָׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ רַק הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב וּכְלֵי הַנְּחֹשֶׁת וְהַבַּרְזֶל נָתְנוּ אוֹצַר בֵּית־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
They burned down the city and everything in it. But the silver and
gold and the objects of copper and iron were deposited in the
treasury of the House of YHWH.

translation.text: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
They burned down the city and everything in it. But the silver and
gold and the objects of copper and iron were deposited in the
treasury of the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew:
וְאֶת־רָחָב הַזּוֹנָה וְאֶת־בֵּית אָבִיהָ וְאֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לָהּ הֶחֱיָה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַתֵּשֶׁב בְּקֶרֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי הֶחְבִּיאָה אֶת־הַמַּלְאָכִים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח
יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְרַגֵּל אֶת־יְרִיחוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֶת־רָחָב הַזּוֹנָה וְאֶת־בֵּית אָבִיהָ וְאֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לָהּ הֶחֱיָה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַתֵּשֶׁב בְּקֶרֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי הֶחְבִּיאָה אֶת־הַמַּלְאָכִים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח
יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְרַגֵּל אֶת־יְרִיחוֹ׃

english.text:
Only Rahab the harlot and her father’s family were spared by
Joshua, along with all that belonged to her, and she dwelt among
the Israelites—as is still the case. For she had hidden the
messengers that Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

translation.text: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father’s household, and all that she had; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

verses.english:
Only Rahab the harlot and her father’s family were spared by
Joshua, along with all that belonged to her, and she dwelt among
the Israelites—as is still the case. For she had hidden the
messengers that Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּשְׁבַּע יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בָּעֵת הַהִיא לֵאמֹר אָרוּר הָאִישׁ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר יָקוּם וּבָנָה אֶת־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת אֶת־יְרִיחוֹ בִּבְכֹרוֹ יְיַסְּדֶנָּה וּבִצְעִירוֹ יַצִּיב
דְּלָתֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּשְׁבַּע יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בָּעֵת הַהִיא לֵאמֹר אָרוּר הָאִישׁ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר יָקוּם וּבָנָה אֶת־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת אֶת־יְרִיחוֹ בִּבְכֹרוֹ יְיַסְּדֶנָּה וּבִצְעִירוֹ יַצִּיב
דְּלָתֶיהָ׃

english.text:
At that time Joshua pronounced this oath: “Cursed of YHWH be the
man who shall undertake to fortify this city of Jericho: he shall
lay its foundations at the cost of his first-born, and set up its
gates at the cost of his youngest.”

translation.text: And Joshua adjured them at that time, saying, Cursed be the man before the LORD, that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.

verses.english:
At that time Joshua pronounced this oath: “Cursed of YHWH be the
man who shall undertake to fortify this city of Jericho: he shall
lay its foundations at the cost of his first-born, and set up its
gates at the cost of his youngest.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יְהֹוָה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיְהִי שׁמְעוֹ בְּכל־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי יְהֹוָה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיְהִי שׁמְעוֹ בְּכל־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text: YHWH was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land.

translation.text: So the LORD was with Joshua; and his fame was noised throughout all the country.

verses.english: YHWH was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְעֲלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מַעַל בַּחֵרֶם וַיִּקַּח עָכָן בֶּן־כַּרְמִי בֶן־זַבְדִּי בֶן־זֶרַח לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה מִן־הַחֵרֶם וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְעֲלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מַעַל בַּחֵרֶם וַיִּקַּח עָכָן בֶּן־כַּרְמִי בֶן־זַבְדִּי בֶן־זֶרַח לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה מִן־הַחֵרֶם וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The Israelites, however, violated the proscription: Achan son of
Carmi son of Zabdi son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of
that which was proscribed, and YHWH was incensed with the
Israelites.

translation.text: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed thing: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against the children of Israel.

verses.english:
The Israelites, however, violated the proscription: Achan son of
Carmi son of Zabdi son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of
that which was proscribed, and YHWH was incensed with the
Israelites.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֲנָשִׁים מִירִיחוֹ הָעַי אֲשֶׁר עִם־בֵּית אָוֶן מִקֶּדֶם לְבֵית־אֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר עֲלוּ וְרַגְּלוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וַיַּעֲלוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים
וַיְרַגְּלוּ אֶת־הָעָי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֲנָשִׁים מִירִיחוֹ הָעַי אֲשֶׁר עִם־בֵּית אָוֶן מִקֶּדֶם לְבֵית־אֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר עֲלוּ וְרַגְּלוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וַיַּעֲלוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים
וַיְרַגְּלוּ אֶת־הָעָי׃

english.text:
Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which lies close to
Beth-aven—east of Bethel—with orders to go up and spy out the
country. So the men went up and spied out Ai.

translation.text: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Bethaven, on the east of Bethel, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country.

verses.english:
Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which lies close to
Beth-aven—east of Bethel—with orders to go up and spy out the
country. So the men went up and spied out Ai.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשֻׁבוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אַל־יַעַל כּל־הָעָם כְּאַלְפַּיִם אִישׁ אוֹ כִּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ יַעֲלוּ וְיַכּוּ אֶת־הָעָי אַל־תְּיַגַּע־שָׁמָּה אֶת־כּל־הָעָם
כִּי מְעַט הֵמָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשֻׁבוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אַל־יַעַל כּל־הָעָם כְּאַלְפַּיִם אִישׁ אוֹ כִּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ יַעֲלוּ וְיַכּוּ אֶת־הָעָי אַל־תְּיַגַּע־שָׁמָּה אֶת־כּל־הָעָם
כִּי מְעַט הֵמָּה׃

english.text:
They returned to Joshua and reported to him, “Not all the troops
need go up. Let two or three thousand men go and attack Ai; do not
trouble all the troops to go up there, for [the people] there are
few.”

translation.text: And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai; and make not all the people to labour thither; for they are but few.

verses.english:
They returned to Joshua and reported to him, “Not all the troops
need go up. Let two or three thousand men go and attack Ai; do not
trouble all the troops to go up there, for [the people] there are
few.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ מִן־הָעָם שָׁמָּה כִּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ וַיָּנֻסוּ לִפְנֵי אַנְשֵׁי הָעָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ מִן־הָעָם שָׁמָּה כִּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ וַיָּנֻסוּ לִפְנֵי אַנְשֵׁי הָעָי׃

english.text:
So about three thousand of the troops marched up there; but they
were routed by the men of Ai.

translation.text: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.

verses.english:
So about three thousand of the troops marched up there; but they
were routed by the men of Ai.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכּוּ מֵהֶם אַנְשֵׁי הָעַי כִּשְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁשָּׁה אִישׁ וַיִּרְדְּפוּם לִפְנֵי הַשַּׁעַר עַד־הַשְּׁבָרִים וַיַּכּוּם בַּמּוֹרָד וַיִּמַּס לְבַב־הָעָם וַיְהִי לְמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכּוּ מֵהֶם אַנְשֵׁי הָעַי כִּשְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁשָּׁה אִישׁ וַיִּרְדְּפוּם לִפְנֵי הַשַּׁעַר עַד־הַשְּׁבָרִים וַיַּכּוּם בַּמּוֹרָד וַיִּמַּס לְבַב־הָעָם וַיְהִי לְמָיִם׃

english.text:
The men of Ai killed about thirty-six of them, pursuing them
outside the gate as far as Shebarim, and cutting them down along
the descent. And the heart of the troops sank in utter dismay.

translation.text: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.

verses.english:
The men of Ai killed about thirty-six of them, pursuing them
outside the gate as far as Shebarim, and cutting them down along
the descent. And the heart of the troops sank in utter dismay.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרַע יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שִׂמְלֹתָיו וַיִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנָיו אַרְצָה לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה עַד־הָעֶרֶב הוּא וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲלוּ עָפָר עַל־רֹאשָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרַע יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שִׂמְלֹתָיו וַיִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנָיו אַרְצָה לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה עַד־הָעֶרֶב הוּא וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲלוּ עָפָר עַל־רֹאשָׁם׃

english.text:
Joshua thereupon rent his clothes. He and the elders of Israel lay
until evening with their faces to the ground in front of the Ark
of YHWH; and they strewed earth on their heads.

translation.text: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the LORD until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust upon their heads.

verses.english:
Joshua thereupon rent his clothes. He and the elders of Israel lay
until evening with their faces to the ground in front of the Ark
of YHWH; and they strewed earth on their heads.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה לָמָה הֵעֲבַרְתָּ הַעֲבִיר אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן לָתֵת אֹתָנוּ בְּיַד הָאֱמֹרִי לְהַאֲבִידֵנוּ וְלוּ הוֹאַלְנוּ וַנֵּשֶׁב
בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה לָמָה הֵעֲבַרְתָּ הַעֲבִיר אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן לָתֵת אֹתָנוּ בְּיַד הָאֱמֹרִי לְהַאֲבִידֵנוּ וְלוּ הוֹאַלְנוּ וַנֵּשֶׁב
בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
“Ah, Lord GOD!” cried Joshua. “Why did You lead this people across
the Jordan only to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites, to
be destroyed by them? If only we had been content to remain on the
other side of the Jordan!

translation.text: And Joshua said, Alas, O LORD God, wherefore hast thou at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? would to God we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!

verses.english:
“Ah, Lord GOD!” cried Joshua. “Why did You lead this people across
the Jordan only to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites, to
be destroyed by them? If only we had been content to remain on the
other side of the Jordan!

verses.hebrew: בִּי אֲדֹנָי מָה אֹמַר אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר הָפַךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹרֶף לִפְנֵי אֹיְבָיו׃

hebrew.text: בִּי אֲדֹנָי מָה אֹמַר אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר הָפַךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹרֶף לִפְנֵי אֹיְבָיו׃

english.text:
O Lord, what can I say after Israel has turned tail before its
enemies?

translation.text: O LORD, what shall I say, when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies!

verses.english:
O Lord, what can I say after Israel has turned tail before its
enemies?

verses.hebrew: וְיִשְׁמְעוּ הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְכֹל יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ וְנָסַבּוּ עָלֵינוּ וְהִכְרִיתוּ אֶת־שְׁמֵנוּ מִן־הָאָרֶץ וּמַה־תַּעֲשֵׂה לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וְיִשְׁמְעוּ הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְכֹל יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ וְנָסַבּוּ עָלֵינוּ וְהִכְרִיתוּ אֶת־שְׁמֵנוּ מִן־הָאָרֶץ וּמַה־תַּעֲשֵׂה לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל׃

english.text:
When the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land hear of
this, they will turn upon us and wipe out our very name from the
earth. And what will You do about Your great name?”

translation.text: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it, and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth: and what wilt thou do unto thy great name?

verses.english:
When the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land hear of
this, they will turn upon us and wipe out our very name from the
earth. And what will You do about Your great name?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ קֻם לָךְ לָמָּה זֶּה אַתָּה נֹפֵל עַל־פָּנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ קֻם לָךְ לָמָּה זֶּה אַתָּה נֹפֵל עַל־פָּנֶיךָ׃

english.text: But YHWH answered Joshua: “Arise! Why do you lie prostrate?

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face?

verses.english: But YHWH answered Joshua: “Arise! Why do you lie prostrate?

verses.hebrew: חָטָא יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגַם עָבְרוּ אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אוֹתָם וְגַם לָקְחוּ מִן־הַחֵרֶם וְגַם גָּנְבוּ וְגַם כִּחֲשׁוּ וְגַם שָׂמוּ בִכְלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: חָטָא יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגַם עָבְרוּ אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אוֹתָם וְגַם לָקְחוּ מִן־הַחֵרֶם וְגַם גָּנְבוּ וְגַם כִּחֲשׁוּ וְגַם שָׂמוּ בִכְלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Israel has sinned! They have broken the covenant by which I bound
them. They have taken of the proscribed and put it in their
vessels; they have stolen; they have broken faith!

translation.text: Israel hath sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put it even among their own stuff.

verses.english:
Israel has sinned! They have broken the covenant by which I bound
them. They have taken of the proscribed and put it in their
vessels; they have stolen; they have broken faith!

verses.hebrew:
וְלֹא יֻכְלוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָקוּם לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיהֶם עֹרֶף יִפְנוּ לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיהֶם כִּי הָיוּ לְחֵרֶם לֹא אוֹסִיף לִהְיוֹת עִמָּכֶם אִם־לֹא תַשְׁמִידוּ הַחֵרֶם
מִקִּרְבְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וְלֹא יֻכְלוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָקוּם לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיהֶם עֹרֶף יִפְנוּ לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיהֶם כִּי הָיוּ לְחֵרֶם לֹא אוֹסִיף לִהְיוֹת עִמָּכֶם אִם־לֹא תַשְׁמִידוּ הַחֵרֶם
מִקִּרְבְּכֶם׃

english.text:
Therefore, the Israelites will not be able to hold their ground
against their enemies; they will have to turn tail before their
enemies, for they have become proscribed. I will not be with you
any more unless you root out from among you what is proscribed.

translation.text: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies, but turned their backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except ye destroy the accursed from among you.

verses.english:
Therefore, the Israelites will not be able to hold their ground
against their enemies; they will have to turn tail before their
enemies, for they have become proscribed. I will not be with you
any more unless you root out from among you what is proscribed.

verses.hebrew:
קֻם קַדֵּשׁ אֶת־הָעָם וְאָמַרְתָּ הִתְקַדְּשׁוּ לְמָחָר כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל חֵרֶם בְּקִרְבְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא תוּכַל לָקוּם לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֶיךָ עַד־הֲסִירְכֶם
הַחֵרֶם מִקִּרְבְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
קֻם קַדֵּשׁ אֶת־הָעָם וְאָמַרְתָּ הִתְקַדְּשׁוּ לְמָחָר כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל חֵרֶם בְּקִרְבְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא תוּכַל לָקוּם לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֶיךָ עַד־הֲסִירְכֶם
הַחֵרֶם מִקִּרְבְּכֶם׃

english.text:
Go and purify the people. Order them: Purify yourselves for
tomorrow. For thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: Something
proscribed is in your midst, O Israel, and you will not be able to
stand up to your enemies until you have purged the proscribed from
among you.

translation.text: Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus saith the LORD God of Israel, There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee, O Israel: thou canst not stand before thine enemies, until ye take away the accursed thing from among you.

verses.english:
Go and purify the people. Order them: Purify yourselves for
tomorrow. For thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: Something
proscribed is in your midst, O Israel, and you will not be able to
stand up to your enemies until you have purged the proscribed from
among you.

verses.hebrew:
וְנִקְרַבְתֶּם בַּבֹּקֶר לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם וְהָיָה הַשֵּׁבֶט אֲשֶׁר־יִלְכְּדֶנּוּ יְהֹוָה יִקְרַב לַמִּשְׁפָּחוֹת וְהַמִּשְׁפָּחָה אֲשֶׁר־יִלְכְּדֶנָּה יְהֹוָה תִּקְרַב לַבָּתִּים
וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר יִלְכְּדֶנּוּ יְהֹוָה יִקְרַב לַגְּבָרִים׃

hebrew.text:
וְנִקְרַבְתֶּם בַּבֹּקֶר לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם וְהָיָה הַשֵּׁבֶט אֲשֶׁר־יִלְכְּדֶנּוּ יְהֹוָה יִקְרַב לַמִּשְׁפָּחוֹת וְהַמִּשְׁפָּחָה אֲשֶׁר־יִלְכְּדֶנָּה יְהֹוָה תִּקְרַב לַבָּתִּים
וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר יִלְכְּדֶנּוּ יְהֹוָה יִקְרַב לַגְּבָרִים׃

english.text:
Tomorrow morning you shall present yourselves by tribes. Whichever
tribe YHWH indicates shall come forward by clans; the clan that
YHWH indicates shall come forward by ancestral houses, and the
ancestral house that YHWH indicates shall come forward man by man.

translation.text: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be, that the tribe which the LORD taketh shall come according to the families thereof; and the family which the LORD shall take shall come by households; and the household which the LORD shall take shall come man by man.

verses.english:
Tomorrow morning you shall present yourselves by tribes. Whichever
tribe YHWH indicates shall come forward by clans; the clan that
YHWH indicates shall come forward by ancestral houses, and the
ancestral house that YHWH indicates shall come forward man by man.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַנִּלְכָּד בַּחֵרֶם יִשָּׂרֵף בָּאֵשׁ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ כִּי עָבַר אֶת־בְּרִית יְהֹוָה וְכִי־עָשָׂה נְבָלָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הַנִּלְכָּד בַּחֵרֶם יִשָּׂרֵף בָּאֵשׁ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ כִּי עָבַר אֶת־בְּרִית יְהֹוָה וְכִי־עָשָׂה נְבָלָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Then he who is indicated for proscription, and all that is his,
shall be put to the fire, because he broke the Covenant of YHWH
and because he committed an outrage in Israel.”

translation.text: And it shall be, that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he hath: because he hath transgressed the covenant of the LORD, and because he hath wrought folly in Israel.

verses.english:
Then he who is indicated for proscription, and all that is his,
shall be put to the fire, because he broke the Covenant of YHWH
and because he committed an outrage in Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לִשְׁבָטָיו וַיִּלָּכֵד שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לִשְׁבָטָיו וַיִּלָּכֵד שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
Early next morning, Joshua had Israel come forward by tribes; and
the tribe of Judah was indicated.

translation.text: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken:

verses.english:
Early next morning, Joshua had Israel come forward by tribes; and
the tribe of Judah was indicated.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־מִשְׁפַּחַת יְהוּדָה וַיִּלְכֹּד אֵת מִשְׁפַּחַת הַזַּרְחִי וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־מִשְׁפַּחַת הַזַּרְחִי לַגְּבָרִים וַיִּלָּכֵד זַבְדִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־מִשְׁפַּחַת יְהוּדָה וַיִּלְכֹּד אֵת מִשְׁפַּחַת הַזַּרְחִי וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־מִשְׁפַּחַת הַזַּרְחִי לַגְּבָרִים וַיִּלָּכֵד זַבְדִּי׃

english.text:
He then had the clans of Judah come forward, and the clan of Zerah
was indicated. Then he had the clan of Zerah come forward by
ancestral houses, and Zabdi was indicated.

translation.text: And he brought the family of Judah; and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:

verses.english:
He then had the clans of Judah come forward, and the clan of Zerah
was indicated. Then he had the clan of Zerah come forward by
ancestral houses, and Zabdi was indicated.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ לַגְּבָרִים וַיִּלָּכֵד עָכָן בֶּן־כַּרְמִי בֶן־זַבְדִּי בֶּן־זֶרַח לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ לַגְּבָרִים וַיִּלָּכֵד עָכָן בֶּן־כַּרְמִי בֶן־זַבְדִּי בֶּן־זֶרַח לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
Finally he had his ancestral house come forward man by man, and
Achan son of Carmi, son of Zabdi, son of Zerah, of the tribe of
Judah, was indicated.

translation.text: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.

verses.english:
Finally he had his ancestral house come forward man by man, and
Achan son of Carmi, son of Zabdi, son of Zerah, of the tribe of
Judah, was indicated.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־עָכָן בְּנִי שִׂים־נָא כָבוֹד לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתֶן־לוֹ תוֹדָה וְהַגֶּד־נָא לִי מֶה עָשִׂיתָ אַל־תְּכַחֵד מִמֶּנִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־עָכָן בְּנִי שִׂים־נָא כָבוֹד לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתֶן־לוֹ תוֹדָה וְהַגֶּד־נָא לִי מֶה עָשִׂיתָ אַל־תְּכַחֵד מִמֶּנִּי׃

english.text:
Then Joshua said to Achan, “My son, pay honor to YHWH, the God of
Israel, and make confession to Him. Tell me what you have done; do
not hold anything back from me.”

translation.text: And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the LORD God of Israel, and make confession unto him; and tell me now what thou hast done; hide it not from me.

verses.english:
Then Joshua said to Achan, “My son, pay honor to YHWH, the God of
Israel, and make confession to Him. Tell me what you have done; do
not hold anything back from me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן עָכָן אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּאמַר אמְנָה אָנֹכִי חָטָאתִי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכָזֹאת וְכָזֹאת עָשִׂיתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן עָכָן אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּאמַר אמְנָה אָנֹכִי חָטָאתִי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכָזֹאת וְכָזֹאת עָשִׂיתִי׃

english.text:
Achan answered Joshua, “It is true, I have sinned against YHWH,
the God of Israel. This is what I did:

translation.text: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against the LORD God of Israel, and thus and thus have I done:

verses.english:
Achan answered Joshua, “It is true, I have sinned against YHWH,
the God of Israel. This is what I did:

verses.hebrew:

hebrew.text:
(ואראה) [וָאֵרֶא] בַשָּׁלָל אַדֶּרֶת שִׁנְעָר אַחַת טוֹבָה וּמָאתַיִם שְׁקָלִים כֶּסֶף וּלְשׁוֹן זָהָב אֶחָד חֲמִשִּׁים שְׁקָלִים מִשְׁקָלוֹ וָאֶחְמְדֵם וָאֶקָּחֵם וְהִנָּם

english.text:
I saw among the spoil a fine Shinar mantle, two hundred shekels of
silver, and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels, and I coveted
them and took them. They are buried in the ground in my tent, with
the silver under it.”

translation.text: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.

verses.english:
I saw among the spoil a fine Shinar mantle, two hundred shekels of
silver, and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels, and I coveted
them and took them. They are buried in the ground in my tent, with
the silver under it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מַלְאָכִים וַיָּרֻצוּ הָאֹהֱלָה וְהִנֵּה טְמוּנָה בְּאהֳלוֹ וְהַכֶּסֶף תַּחְתֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מַלְאָכִים וַיָּרֻצוּ הָאֹהֱלָה וְהִנֵּה טְמוּנָה בְּאהֳלוֹ וְהַכֶּסֶף תַּחְתֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
Joshua sent messengers, who hurried to the tent; and there it was,
buried in his tent, with the silver underneath.

translation.text: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold, it was hid in his tent, and the silver under it.

verses.english:
Joshua sent messengers, who hurried to the tent; and there it was,
buried in his tent, with the silver underneath.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּחוּם מִתּוֹךְ הָאֹהֶל וַיְבִאוּם אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְאֶל כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּצִּקֻם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּחוּם מִתּוֹךְ הָאֹהֶל וַיְבִאוּם אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְאֶל כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּצִּקֻם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
They took them from the tent and brought them to Joshua and all
the Israelites, and displayed them before YHWH.

translation.text: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the LORD.

verses.english:
They took them from the tent and brought them to Joshua and all
the Israelites, and displayed them before YHWH.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־עָכָן בֶּן־זֶרַח וְאֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הָאַדֶּרֶת וְאֶת־לְשׁוֹן הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וְאֶת־בְּנֹתָיו וְאֶת־שׁוֹרוֹ וְאֶת־חֲמֹרוֹ וְאֶת־צֹאנוֹ וְאֶת־אהֳלוֹ
וְאֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ וַיַּעֲלוּ אֹתָם עֵמֶק עָכוֹר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־עָכָן בֶּן־זֶרַח וְאֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הָאַדֶּרֶת וְאֶת־לְשׁוֹן הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וְאֶת־בְּנֹתָיו וְאֶת־שׁוֹרוֹ וְאֶת־חֲמֹרוֹ וְאֶת־צֹאנוֹ וְאֶת־אהֳלוֹ
וְאֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ וַיַּעֲלוּ אֹתָם עֵמֶק עָכוֹר׃

english.text:
Then Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan son of Zerah—and
the silver, the mantle, and the wedge of gold—his sons and
daughters, and his ox, his ass, and his flock, and his tent, and
all his belongings, and brought them up to the Valley of Achor.

translation.text: And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.

verses.english:
Then Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan son of Zerah—and
the silver, the mantle, and the wedge of gold—his sons and
daughters, and his ox, his ass, and his flock, and his tent, and
all his belongings, and brought them up to the Valley of Achor.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מֶה עֲכַרְתָּנוּ יַעְכּרְךָ יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיִּרְגְּמוּ אֹתוֹ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶבֶן וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אֹתָם בָּאֵשׁ וַיִּסְקְלוּ אֹתָם בָּאֲבָנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מֶה עֲכַרְתָּנוּ יַעְכּרְךָ יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיִּרְגְּמוּ אֹתוֹ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶבֶן וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אֹתָם בָּאֵשׁ וַיִּסְקְלוּ אֹתָם בָּאֲבָנִים׃

english.text:
And Joshua said, “What calamity you have brought upon us! YHWH
will bring calamity upon you this day.” And all Israel pelted him
with stones. They put them to the fire and stoned them.

translation.text: And Joshua said, Why hast thou troubled us? the LORD shall trouble thee this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.

verses.english:
And Joshua said, “What calamity you have brought upon us! YHWH
will bring calamity upon you this day.” And all Israel pelted him
with stones. They put them to the fire and stoned them.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקִימוּ עָלָיו גַּל־אֲבָנִים גָּדוֹל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיָּשׁב יְהֹוָה מֵחֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ עַל־כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא עֵמֶק עָכוֹר עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקִימוּ עָלָיו גַּל־אֲבָנִים גָּדוֹל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיָּשׁב יְהֹוָה מֵחֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ עַל־כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא עֵמֶק עָכוֹר עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
They raised a huge mound of stones over him, which is still there.
Then the anger of YHWH subsided. That is why that place was named
the Valley of Achor—as is still the case.

translation.text: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day. So the LORD turned from the fierceness of his anger. Wherefore the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, unto this day.

verses.english:
They raised a huge mound of stones over him, which is still there.
Then the anger of YHWH subsided. That is why that place was named
the Valley of Achor—as is still the case.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַל־תִּירָא וְאַל־תֵּחָת קַח עִמְּךָ אֵת כּל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה וְקוּם עֲלֵה הָעָי רְאֵה נָתַתִּי בְיָדְךָ אֶת־מֶלֶךְ הָעַי וְאֶת־עַמּוֹ וְאֶת־עִירוֹ
וְאֶת־אַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַל־תִּירָא וְאַל־תֵּחָת קַח עִמְּךָ אֵת כּל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה וְקוּם עֲלֵה הָעָי רְאֵה נָתַתִּי בְיָדְךָ אֶת־מֶלֶךְ הָעַי וְאֶת־עַמּוֹ וְאֶת־עִירוֹ
וְאֶת־אַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
YHWH said to Joshua, “Do not be frightened or dismayed. Take all
the fighting troops with you, go and march against Ai. See, I will
deliver the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land into
your hands.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:

verses.english:
YHWH said to Joshua, “Do not be frightened or dismayed. Take all
the fighting troops with you, go and march against Ai. See, I will
deliver the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land into
your hands.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ לָעַי וּלְמַלְכָּהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לִּירִיחוֹ וּלְמַלְכָּהּ רַק־שְׁלָלָהּ וּבְהֶמְתָּהּ תָּבֹזּוּ לָכֶם שִׂים־לְךָ אֹרֵב לָעִיר מֵאַחֲרֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ לָעַי וּלְמַלְכָּהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לִּירִיחוֹ וּלְמַלְכָּהּ רַק־שְׁלָלָהּ וּבְהֶמְתָּהּ תָּבֹזּוּ לָכֶם שִׂים־לְךָ אֹרֵב לָעִיר מֵאַחֲרֶיהָ׃

english.text:
You shall treat Ai and her king as you treated Jericho and her
king; however, you may take the spoil and the cattle as booty for
yourselves. Now set an ambush against the city behind it.”

translation.text: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king: only the spoil thereof, and the cattle thereof, shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves: lay thee an ambush for the city behind it.

verses.english:
You shall treat Ai and her king as you treated Jericho and her
king; however, you may take the spoil and the cattle as booty for
yourselves. Now set an ambush against the city behind it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה לַעֲלוֹת הָעָי וַיִּבְחַר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף אִישׁ גִּבּוֹרֵי הַחַיִל וַיִּשְׁלָחֵם לָיְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה לַעֲלוֹת הָעָי וַיִּבְחַר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף אִישׁ גִּבּוֹרֵי הַחַיִל וַיִּשְׁלָחֵם לָיְלָה׃

english.text:
So Joshua and all the fighting troops prepared for the march on
Ai. Joshua chose thirty thousand men, valiant warriors, and sent
them ahead by night.

translation.text: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.

verses.english:
So Joshua and all the fighting troops prepared for the march on
Ai. Joshua chose thirty thousand men, valiant warriors, and sent
them ahead by night.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו אֹתָם לֵאמֹר רְאוּ אַתֶּם אֹרְבִים לָעִיר מֵאַחֲרֵי הָעִיר אַל־תַּרְחִיקוּ מִן־הָעִיר מְאֹד וִהְיִיתֶם כֻּלְּכֶם נְכֹנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו אֹתָם לֵאמֹר רְאוּ אַתֶּם אֹרְבִים לָעִיר מֵאַחֲרֵי הָעִיר אַל־תַּרְחִיקוּ מִן־הָעִיר מְאֹד וִהְיִיתֶם כֻּלְּכֶם נְכֹנִים׃

english.text:
He instructed them as follows: “Mind, you are to lie in ambush
behind the city; don’t stay too far from the city, and all of you
be on the alert.

translation.text: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, ye shall lie in wait against the city, even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:

verses.english:
He instructed them as follows: “Mind, you are to lie in ambush
behind the city; don’t stay too far from the city, and all of you
be on the alert.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתִּי נִקְרַב אֶל־הָעִיר וְהָיָה כִּי־יֵצְאוּ לִקְרָאתֵנוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּרִאשֹׁנָה וְנַסְנוּ לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתִּי נִקְרַב אֶל־הָעִיר וְהָיָה כִּי־יֵצְאוּ לִקְרָאתֵנוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּרִאשֹׁנָה וְנַסְנוּ לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
I and all the troops with me will approach the city; and when they
come out against us, as they did the first time, we will flee from
them.

translation.text: And I, and all the people that are with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,

verses.english:
I and all the troops with me will approach the city; and when they
come out against us, as they did the first time, we will flee from
them.

verses.hebrew: וְיָצְאוּ אַחֲרֵינוּ עַד הַתִּיקֵנוּ אוֹתָם מִן־הָעִיר כִּי יֹאמְרוּ נָסִים לְפָנֵינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּרִאשֹׁנָה וְנַסְנוּ לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצְאוּ אַחֲרֵינוּ עַד הַתִּיקֵנוּ אוֹתָם מִן־הָעִיר כִּי יֹאמְרוּ נָסִים לְפָנֵינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּרִאשֹׁנָה וְנַסְנוּ לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
They will come rushing after us until we have drawn them away from
the city. They will think, ‘They are fleeing from us the same as
last time’; but while we are fleeing before them,

translation.text: (For they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.

verses.english:
They will come rushing after us until we have drawn them away from
the city. They will think, ‘They are fleeing from us the same as
last time’; but while we are fleeing before them,

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם תָּקֻמוּ מֵהָאוֹרֵב וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם אֶת־הָעִיר וּנְתָנָהּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בְּיֶדְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם תָּקֻמוּ מֵהָאוֹרֵב וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם אֶת־הָעִיר וּנְתָנָהּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בְּיֶדְכֶם׃

english.text:
you will dash out from your ambush and seize the city, and YHWH
your God will deliver it into your hands.

translation.text: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.

verses.english:
you will dash out from your ambush and seize the city, and YHWH
your God will deliver it into your hands.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כְּתפְשְׂכֶם אֶת־הָעִיר תַּצִּיתוּ אֶת־הָעִיר בָּאֵשׁ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה תַּעֲשׂוּ רְאוּ צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כְּתפְשְׂכֶם אֶת־הָעִיר תַּצִּיתוּ אֶת־הָעִיר בָּאֵשׁ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה תַּעֲשׂוּ רְאוּ צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
And when you take the city, set it on fire. Do as YHWH has
commanded. Mind, I have given you your orders.”

translation.text: And it shall be, when ye have taken the city, that ye shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of the LORD shall ye do. See, I have commanded you.

verses.english:
And when you take the city, set it on fire. Do as YHWH has
commanded. Mind, I have given you your orders.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלָחֵם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶל־הַמַּאְרָב וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בֵּין בֵּית־אֵל וּבֵין הָעַי מִיָּם לָעָי וַיָּלֶן יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא בְּתוֹךְ הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלָחֵם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶל־הַמַּאְרָב וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בֵּין בֵּית־אֵל וּבֵין הָעַי מִיָּם לָעָי וַיָּלֶן יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא בְּתוֹךְ הָעָם׃

english.text:
Joshua then sent them off, and they proceeded to the ambush; they
took up a position between Ai and Bethel—west of Ai—while Joshua
spent the night with the rest of the troops.

translation.text: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.

verses.english:
Joshua then sent them off, and they proceeded to the ambush; they
took up a position between Ai and Bethel—west of Ai—while Joshua
spent the night with the rest of the troops.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּפְקֹד אֶת־הָעָם וַיַּעַל הוּא וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי הָעָם הָעָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּפְקֹד אֶת־הָעָם וַיַּעַל הוּא וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי הָעָם הָעָי׃

english.text:
Early in the morning, Joshua mustered the troops; then he and the
elders of Israel marched upon Ai at the head of the troops.

translation.text: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.

verses.english:
Early in the morning, Joshua mustered the troops; then he and the
elders of Israel marched upon Ai at the head of the troops.

verses.hebrew: וְכל־הָעָם הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ עָלוּ וַיִּגְּשׁוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ נֶגֶד הָעִיר וַיַּחֲנוּ מִצְּפוֹן לָעַי וְהַגַּי בֵּינָו וּבֵין־הָעָי׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־הָעָם הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ עָלוּ וַיִּגְּשׁוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ נֶגֶד הָעִיר וַיַּחֲנוּ מִצְּפוֹן לָעַי וְהַגַּי בֵּינָו וּבֵין־הָעָי׃

english.text:
All the fighting force that was with him advanced near the city
and encamped to the north of Ai, with a hollow between them and
Ai.—

translation.text: And all the people, even the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.

verses.english:
All the fighting force that was with him advanced near the city
and encamped to the north of Ai, with a hollow between them and
Ai.—

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח כַּחֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ וַיָּשֶׂם אוֹתָם אֹרֵב בֵּין בֵּית־אֵל וּבֵין הָעַי מִיָּם לָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח כַּחֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ וַיָּשֶׂם אוֹתָם אֹרֵב בֵּין בֵּית־אֵל וּבֵין הָעַי מִיָּם לָעִיר׃

english.text:
He selected about five thousand men and stationed them as an
ambush between Bethel and Ai, west of the city.

translation.text: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.

verses.english:
He selected about five thousand men and stationed them as an
ambush between Bethel and Ai, west of the city.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ הָעָם אֶת־כּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה אֲשֶׁר מִצְּפוֹן לָעִיר וְאֶת־עֲקֵבוֹ מִיָּם לָעִיר וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא בְּתוֹךְ הָעֵמֶק׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ הָעָם אֶת־כּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה אֲשֶׁר מִצְּפוֹן לָעִיר וְאֶת־עֲקֵבוֹ מִיָּם לָעִיר וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא בְּתוֹךְ הָעֵמֶק׃

english.text:
Thus the main body of the army was disposed on the north of the
city, but the far end of it was on the west. (This was after
Joshua had spent the night in the valley.)—

translation.text: And when they had set the people, even all the host that was on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.

verses.english:
Thus the main body of the army was disposed on the north of the
city, but the far end of it was on the west. (This was after
Joshua had spent the night in the valley.)—

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת מֶלֶךְ־הָעַי וַיְמַהֲרוּ וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ וַיֵּצְאוּ אַנְשֵׁי־הָעִיר לִקְרַאת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַמִּלְחָמָה הוּא וְכל־עַמּוֹ לַמּוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי הָעֲרָבָה וְהוּא לֹא יָדַע
כִּי־אֹרֵב לוֹ מֵאַחֲרֵי הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת מֶלֶךְ־הָעַי וַיְמַהֲרוּ וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ וַיֵּצְאוּ אַנְשֵׁי־הָעִיר לִקְרַאת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַמִּלְחָמָה הוּא וְכל־עַמּוֹ לַמּוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי הָעֲרָבָה וְהוּא לֹא יָדַע
כִּי־אֹרֵב לוֹ מֵאַחֲרֵי הָעִיר׃

english.text:
When the king of Ai saw them, he and all his people, the
inhabitants of the city, rushed out in the early morning to the
meeting place, facing the Arabah, to engage the Israelites in
battle; for he was unaware that a force was lying in ambush behind
the city.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it, that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.

verses.english:
When the king of Ai saw them, he and all his people, the
inhabitants of the city, rushed out in the early morning to the
meeting place, facing the Arabah, to engage the Israelites in
battle; for he was unaware that a force was lying in ambush behind
the city.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּנָּגְעוּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיָּנֻסוּ דֶּרֶךְ הַמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּנָּגְעוּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיָּנֻסוּ דֶּרֶךְ הַמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
Joshua and all Israel fled in the direction of the wilderness, as
though routed by them.

translation.text: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

verses.english:
Joshua and all Israel fled in the direction of the wilderness, as
though routed by them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזָּעֲקוּ כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר (בעיר) [בָּעַי] לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵיהֶם וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אַחֲרֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּנָּתְקוּ מִן־הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזָּעֲקוּ כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר (בעיר) [בָּעַי] לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵיהֶם וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אַחֲרֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּנָּתְקוּ מִן־הָעִיר׃

english.text:
All the troops in the city gathered to pursue them; pursuing
Joshua, they were drawn out of the city.

translation.text: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

verses.english:
All the troops in the city gathered to pursue them; pursuing
Joshua, they were drawn out of the city.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־נִשְׁאַר אִישׁ בָּעַי וּבֵית אֵל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָצְאוּ אַחֲרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־הָעִיר פְּתוּחָה וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אַחֲרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־נִשְׁאַר אִישׁ בָּעַי וּבֵית אֵל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָצְאוּ אַחֲרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־הָעִיר פְּתוּחָה וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אַחֲרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
