Not a man was left in Ai or in Bethel who did not go out after
Israel; they left the city open while they pursued Israel.

translation.text: And there was not a man left in Ai or Bethel, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.

verses.english:
Not a man was left in Ai or in Bethel who did not go out after
Israel; they left the city open while they pursued Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ נְטֵה בַּכִּידוֹן אֲשֶׁר־בְּיָדְךָ אֶל־הָעַי כִּי בְיָדְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וַיֵּט יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּכִּידוֹן אֲשֶׁר־בְּיָדוֹ אֶל־הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ נְטֵה בַּכִּידוֹן אֲשֶׁר־בְּיָדְךָ אֶל־הָעַי כִּי בְיָדְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וַיֵּט יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּכִּידוֹן אֲשֶׁר־בְּיָדוֹ אֶל־הָעִיר׃

english.text:
YHWH then said to Joshua, “Hold out the javelin in your hand
toward Ai, for I will deliver it into your hands.” So Joshua held
out the javelin in his hand toward the city.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that is in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thine hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city.

verses.english:
YHWH then said to Joshua, “Hold out the javelin in your hand
toward Ai, for I will deliver it into your hands.” So Joshua held
out the javelin in his hand toward the city.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאוֹרֵב קָם מְהֵרָה מִמְּקוֹמוֹ וַיָּרוּצוּ כִּנְטוֹת יָדוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ הָעִיר וַיִּלְכְּדוּהָ וַיְמַהֲרוּ וַיַּצִּיתוּ אֶת־הָעִיר בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאוֹרֵב קָם מְהֵרָה מִמְּקוֹמוֹ וַיָּרוּצוּ כִּנְטוֹת יָדוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ הָעִיר וַיִּלְכְּדוּהָ וַיְמַהֲרוּ וַיַּצִּיתוּ אֶת־הָעִיר בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
As soon as he held out his hand, the ambush came rushing out of
their station. They entered the city and captured it; and they
swiftly set fire to the city.

translation.text: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.

verses.english:
As soon as he held out his hand, the ambush came rushing out of
their station. They entered the city and captured it; and they
swiftly set fire to the city.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּפְנוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעַי אַחֲרֵיהֶם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה עָלָה עֲשַׁן הָעִיר הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וְלֹא־הָיָה בָהֶם יָדַיִם לָנוּס הֵנָּה וָהֵנָּה וְהָעָם הַנָּס הַמִּדְבָּר נֶהְפַּךְ
אֶל־הָרוֹדֵף׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּפְנוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעַי אַחֲרֵיהֶם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה עָלָה עֲשַׁן הָעִיר הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וְלֹא־הָיָה בָהֶם יָדַיִם לָנוּס הֵנָּה וָהֵנָּה וְהָעָם הַנָּס הַמִּדְבָּר נֶהְפַּךְ
אֶל־הָרוֹדֵף׃

english.text:
The men of Ai looked back and saw the smoke of the city rising to
the sky; they had no room for flight in any direction. The people
who had been fleeing to the wilderness now became the pursuers.

translation.text: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.

verses.english:
The men of Ai looked back and saw the smoke of the city rising to
the sky; they had no room for flight in any direction. The people
who had been fleeing to the wilderness now became the pursuers.

verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאוּ כִּי־לָכַד הָאֹרֵב אֶת־הָעִיר וְכִי עָלָה עֲשַׁן הָעִיר וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־אַנְשֵׁי הָעָי׃

hebrew.text: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאוּ כִּי־לָכַד הָאֹרֵב אֶת־הָעִיר וְכִי עָלָה עֲשַׁן הָעִיר וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־אַנְשֵׁי הָעָי׃

english.text:
For when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had captured
the city, and that smoke was rising from the city, they turned
around and attacked the men of Ai.

translation.text: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.

verses.english:
For when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had captured
the city, and that smoke was rising from the city, they turned
around and attacked the men of Ai.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה יָצְאוּ מִן־הָעִיר לִקְרָאתָם וַיִּהְיוּ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בַּתָּוֶךְ אֵלֶּה מִזֶּה וְאֵלֶּה מִזֶּה וַיַּכּוּ אוֹתָם עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לוֹ שָׂרִיד וּפָלִיט׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה יָצְאוּ מִן־הָעִיר לִקְרָאתָם וַיִּהְיוּ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בַּתָּוֶךְ אֵלֶּה מִזֶּה וְאֵלֶּה מִזֶּה וַיַּכּוּ אוֹתָם עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לוֹ שָׂרִיד וּפָלִיט׃

english.text:
Now the other [Israelites] were coming out of the city against
them, so that they were between two bodies of Israelites, one on
each side of them. They were slaughtered, so that no one escaped
or got away.

translation.text: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

verses.english:
Now the other [Israelites] were coming out of the city against
them, so that they were between two bodies of Israelites, one on
each side of them. They were slaughtered, so that no one escaped
or got away.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־מֶלֶךְ הָעַי תָּפְשׂוּ חָי וַיַּקְרִבוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־מֶלֶךְ הָעַי תָּפְשׂוּ חָי וַיַּקְרִבוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃

english.text: The king of Ai was taken alive and brought to Joshua.

translation.text: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.

verses.english: The king of Ai was taken alive and brought to Joshua.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל לַהֲרֹג אֶת־כּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָעַי בַּשָּׂדֶה בַּמִּדְבָּר אֲשֶׁר רְדָפוּם בּוֹ וַיִּפְּלוּ כֻלָּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב עַד־תֻּמָּם וַיָּשֻׁבוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָעַי
וַיַּכּוּ אֹתָהּ לְפִי־חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל לַהֲרֹג אֶת־כּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָעַי בַּשָּׂדֶה בַּמִּדְבָּר אֲשֶׁר רְדָפוּם בּוֹ וַיִּפְּלוּ כֻלָּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב עַד־תֻּמָּם וַיָּשֻׁבוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָעַי
וַיַּכּוּ אֹתָהּ לְפִי־חָרֶב׃

english.text:
When Israel had killed all the inhabitants of Ai who had pursued
them into the open wilderness, and all of them, to the last man,
had fallen by the sword, all the Israelites turned back to Ai and
put it to the sword.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.

verses.english:
When Israel had killed all the inhabitants of Ai who had pursued
them into the open wilderness, and all of them, to the last man,
had fallen by the sword, all the Israelites turned back to Ai and
put it to the sword.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כל־הַנֹּפְלִים בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא מֵאִישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁה שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אָלֶף כֹּל אַנְשֵׁי הָעָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כל־הַנֹּפְלִים בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא מֵאִישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁה שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אָלֶף כֹּל אַנְשֵׁי הָעָי׃

english.text:
The total of those who fell that day, men and women, the entire
population of Ai, came to twelve thousand.

translation.text: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.

verses.english:
The total of those who fell that day, men and women, the entire
population of Ai, came to twelve thousand.

verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ לֹא־הֵשִׁיב יָדוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָטָה בַּכִּידוֹן עַד אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱרִים אֵת כּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָעָי׃

hebrew.text: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ לֹא־הֵשִׁיב יָדוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָטָה בַּכִּידוֹן עַד אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱרִים אֵת כּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָעָי׃

english.text:
Joshua did not draw back the hand with which he held out his
javelin until all the inhabitants of Ai had been exterminated.

translation.text: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.

verses.english:
Joshua did not draw back the hand with which he held out his
javelin until all the inhabitants of Ai had been exterminated.

verses.hebrew: רַק הַבְּהֵמָה וּשְׁלַל הָעִיר הַהִיא בָּזְזוּ לָהֶם יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃

hebrew.text: רַק הַבְּהֵמָה וּשְׁלַל הָעִיר הַהִיא בָּזְזוּ לָהֶם יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃

english.text:
However, the Israelites took the cattle and the spoil of the city
as their booty, in accordance with the instructions that YHWH had
given to Joshua.

translation.text: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of the LORD which he commanded Joshua.

verses.english:
However, the Israelites took the cattle and the spoil of the city
as their booty, in accordance with the instructions that YHWH had
given to Joshua.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂרֹף יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָעָי וַיְשִׂימֶהָ תֵּל־עוֹלָם שְׁמָמָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׂרֹף יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָעָי וַיְשִׂימֶהָ תֵּל־עוֹלָם שְׁמָמָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Then Joshua burned down Ai, and turned it into a mound of ruins
for all time, a desolation to this day.

translation.text: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, even a desolation unto this day.

verses.english:
Then Joshua burned down Ai, and turned it into a mound of ruins
for all time, a desolation to this day.

verses.hebrew:
וְאֶת־מֶלֶךְ הָעַי תָּלָה עַל־הָעֵץ עַד־עֵת הָעָרֶב וּכְבוֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ צִוָּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּרִידוּ אֶת־נִבְלָתוֹ מִן־הָעֵץ וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ אוֹתָהּ אֶל־פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הָעִיר
וַיָּקִימוּ עָלָיו גַּל־אֲבָנִים גָּדוֹל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֶת־מֶלֶךְ הָעַי תָּלָה עַל־הָעֵץ עַד־עֵת הָעָרֶב וּכְבוֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ צִוָּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּרִידוּ אֶת־נִבְלָתוֹ מִן־הָעֵץ וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ אוֹתָהּ אֶל־פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הָעִיר
וַיָּקִימוּ עָלָיו גַּל־אֲבָנִים גָּדוֹל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And the king of Ai was impaled on a stake until the evening. At
sunset, Joshua had the corpse taken down from the stake and it was
left lying at the entrance to the city gate. They raised a great
heap of stones over it, which is there to this day.

translation.text: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, that remaineth unto this day.

verses.english:
And the king of Ai was impaled on a stake until the evening. At
sunset, Joshua had the corpse taken down from the stake and it was
left lying at the entrance to the city gate. They raised a great
heap of stones over it, which is there to this day.

verses.hebrew: אָז יִבְנֶה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַר עֵיבָל׃

hebrew.text: אָז יִבְנֶה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַר עֵיבָל׃

english.text:
At that time Joshua built an altar to YHWH, the God of Israel, on
Mount Ebal,

translation.text: Then Joshua built an altar unto the LORD God of Israel in mount Ebal,

verses.english:
At that time Joshua built an altar to YHWH, the God of Israel, on
Mount Ebal,

verses.hebrew:
כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה מִזְבַּח אֲבָנִים שְׁלֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הֵנִיף עֲלֵיהֶן בַּרְזֶל וַיַּעֲלוּ עָלָיו
עֹלוֹת לַיהֹוָה וַיִּזְבְּחוּ שְׁלָמִים׃

hebrew.text:
כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה מִזְבַּח אֲבָנִים שְׁלֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הֵנִיף עֲלֵיהֶן בַּרְזֶל וַיַּעֲלוּ עָלָיו
עֹלוֹת לַיהֹוָה וַיִּזְבְּחוּ שְׁלָמִים׃

english.text:
as Moses, the servant of YHWH, had commanded the Israelites—as is
written in the Book of the Teaching of Moses—an altar of unhewn
stone upon which no iron had been wielded. They offered on it
burnt offerings to YHWH, and brought sacrifices of well-being.

translation.text: As Moses the servant of the LORD commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man hath lift up any iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the LORD, and sacrificed peace offerings.

verses.english:
as Moses, the servant of YHWH, had commanded the Israelites—as is
written in the Book of the Teaching of Moses—an altar of unhewn
stone upon which no iron had been wielded. They offered on it
burnt offerings to YHWH, and brought sacrifices of well-being.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתּב־שָׁם עַל־הָאֲבָנִים אֵת מִשְׁנֵה תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר כָּתַב לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְתּב־שָׁם עַל־הָאֲבָנִים אֵת מִשְׁנֵה תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר כָּתַב לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And there, on the stones, he inscribed a copy of the Teaching that
Moses had written for the Israelites.

translation.text: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.

verses.english:
And there, on the stones, he inscribed a copy of the Teaching that
Moses had written for the Israelites.

verses.hebrew:
וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּזְקֵנָיו וְשֹׁטְרִים וְשֹׁפְטָיו עֹמְדִים מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה לָאָרוֹן נֶגֶד הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה כַּגֵּר כָּאֶזְרָח חֶצְיוֹ
אֶל־מוּל הַר־גְּרִזִים וְהַחֶצְיוֹ אֶל־מוּל הַר־עֵיבָל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־הָעָם יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּרִאשֹׁנָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּזְקֵנָיו וְשֹׁטְרִים וְשֹׁפְטָיו עֹמְדִים מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה לָאָרוֹן נֶגֶד הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה כַּגֵּר כָּאֶזְרָח חֶצְיוֹ
אֶל־מוּל הַר־גְּרִזִים וְהַחֶצְיוֹ אֶל־מוּל הַר־עֵיבָל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־הָעָם יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּרִאשֹׁנָה׃

english.text:
All Israel—stranger and citizen alike—with their elders,
officials, and magistrates, stood on either side of the Ark,
facing the levitical priests who carried the Ark of YHWH’s
Covenant. Half of them faced Mount Gerizim and half of them faced
Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of YHWH had commanded them of
old, in order to bless the people of Israel.

translation.text: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.

verses.english:
All Israel—stranger and citizen alike—with their elders,
officials, and magistrates, stood on either side of the Ark,
facing the levitical priests who carried the Ark of YHWH’s
Covenant. Half of them faced Mount Gerizim and half of them faced
Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of YHWH had commanded them of
old, in order to bless the people of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן קָרָא אֶת־כּל־דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַבְּרָכָה וְהַקְּלָלָה כְּכל־הַכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן קָרָא אֶת־כּל־דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַבְּרָכָה וְהַקְּלָלָה כְּכל־הַכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה׃

english.text:
After that, he read all the words of the Teaching, the blessing
and the curse, just as is written in the Book of the Teaching.

translation.text: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

verses.english:
After that, he read all the words of the Teaching, the blessing
and the curse, just as is written in the Book of the Teaching.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־קָרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ נֶגֶד כּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַטַּף וְהַגֵּר הַהֹלֵךְ בְּקִרְבָּם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־קָרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ נֶגֶד כּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַטַּף וְהַגֵּר הַהֹלֵךְ בְּקִרְבָּם׃

english.text:
There was not a word of all that Moses had commanded that Joshua
failed to read in the presence of the entire assembly of Israel,
including the women and children and the strangers who accompanied
them.

translation.text: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.

verses.english:
There was not a word of all that Moses had commanded that Joshua
failed to read in the presence of the entire assembly of Israel,
including the women and children and the strangers who accompanied
them.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ כּל־הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בָּהָר וּבַשְּׁפֵלָה וּבְכֹל חוֹף הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל אֶל־מוּל הַלְּבָנוֹן הַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַפְּרִזִּי
הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ כּל־הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בָּהָר וּבַשְּׁפֵלָה וּבְכֹל חוֹף הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל אֶל־מוּל הַלְּבָנוֹן הַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַפְּרִזִּי
הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃

english.text:
When all the kings west of the Jordan—in the hill country, in the
Shephelah, and along the entire coast of the Mediterranean Sea up
to the vicinity of Lebanon, the [land of the] Hittites, Amorites,
Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—learned of this,

translation.text: And it came to pass, when all the kings which were on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard thereof;

verses.english:
When all the kings west of the Jordan—in the hill country, in the
Shephelah, and along the entire coast of the Mediterranean Sea up
to the vicinity of Lebanon, the [land of the] Hittites, Amorites,
Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—learned of this,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקַבְּצוּ יַחְדָּו לְהִלָּחֵם עִם־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְעִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל פֶּה אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְקַבְּצוּ יַחְדָּו לְהִלָּחֵם עִם־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְעִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל פֶּה אֶחָד׃

english.text: they gathered with one accord to fight against Joshua and Israel.

translation.text: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.

verses.english: they gathered with one accord to fight against Joshua and Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְיֹשְׁבֵי גִבְעוֹן שָׁמְעוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לִירִיחוֹ וְלָעָי׃

hebrew.text: וְיֹשְׁבֵי גִבְעוֹן שָׁמְעוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לִירִיחוֹ וְלָעָי׃

english.text:
But when the inhabitants of Gibeon learned how Joshua had treated
Jericho and Ai,

translation.text: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,

verses.english:
But when the inhabitants of Gibeon learned how Joshua had treated
Jericho and Ai,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ גַם־הֵמָּה בְּערְמָה וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיִּצְטַיָּרוּ וַיִּקְחוּ שַׂקִּים בָּלִים לַחֲמוֹרֵיהֶם וְנֹאדוֹת יַיִן בָּלִים וּמְבֻקָּעִים וּמְצֹרָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ גַם־הֵמָּה בְּערְמָה וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיִּצְטַיָּרוּ וַיִּקְחוּ שַׂקִּים בָּלִים לַחֲמוֹרֵיהֶם וְנֹאדוֹת יַיִן בָּלִים וּמְבֻקָּעִים וּמְצֹרָרִים׃

translation.text: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;

verses.hebrew: וּנְעָלוֹת בָּלוֹת וּמְטֻלָּאוֹת בְּרַגְלֵיהֶם וּשְׂלָמוֹת בָּלוֹת עֲלֵיהֶם וְכֹל לֶחֶם צֵידָם יָבֵשׁ הָיָה נִקֻּדִים׃

hebrew.text: וּנְעָלוֹת בָּלוֹת וּמְטֻלָּאוֹת בְּרַגְלֵיהֶם וּשְׂלָמוֹת בָּלוֹת עֲלֵיהֶם וְכֹל לֶחֶם צֵידָם יָבֵשׁ הָיָה נִקֻּדִים׃

english.text:
they had worn-out, patched sandals on their feet, and threadbare
clothes on their bodies; and all the bread they took as provision
was dry and crumbly.

translation.text: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.

verses.english:
they had worn-out, patched sandals on their feet, and threadbare
clothes on their bodies; and all the bread they took as provision
was dry and crumbly.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּל וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו וְאֶל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה בָּאנוּ וְעַתָּה כִּרְתוּ־לָנוּ בְרִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּל וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו וְאֶל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה בָּאנוּ וְעַתָּה כִּרְתוּ־לָנוּ בְרִית׃

english.text:
And so they went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal and said to him
and to the men of Israel, “We come from a distant land; we propose
that you make a pact with us.”

translation.text: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.

verses.english:
And so they went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal and said to him
and to the men of Israel, “We come from a distant land; we propose
that you make a pact with us.”

verses.hebrew: (ויאמרו) [וַיֹּאמֶר] אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַחִוִּי אוּלַי בְּקִרְבִּי אַתָּה יוֹשֵׁב וְאֵיךְ (אכרות) [אֶכְרת־]לְךָ בְרִית׃

hebrew.text: (ויאמרו) [וַיֹּאמֶר] אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַחִוִּי אוּלַי בְּקִרְבִּי אַתָּה יוֹשֵׁב וְאֵיךְ (אכרות) [אֶכְרת־]לְךָ בְרִית׃

english.text:
The men of Israel replied to the Hivites, “But perhaps you live
among us; how then can we make a pact with you?”

translation.text: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?

verses.english:
The men of Israel replied to the Hivites, “But perhaps you live
among us; how then can we make a pact with you?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲנָחְנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מִי אַתֶּם וּמֵאַיִן תָּבֹאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲנָחְנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מִי אַתֶּם וּמֵאַיִן תָּבֹאוּ׃

english.text:
They said to Joshua, “We will be your subjects.” But Joshua asked
them, “Who are you and where do you come from?”

translation.text: And they said unto Joshua, We are thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are ye? and from whence come ye?

verses.english:
They said to Joshua, “We will be your subjects.” But Joshua asked
them, “Who are you and where do you come from?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה מְאֹד בָּאוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי־שָׁמַעְנוּ שׁמְעוֹ וְאֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בְּמִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה מְאֹד בָּאוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי־שָׁמַעְנוּ שׁמְעוֹ וְאֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בְּמִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
They replied, “Your servants have come from a very distant
country, because of the fame of YHWH your God. For we heard the
report of Him: of all that He did in Egypt,

translation.text: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the LORD thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,

verses.english:
They replied, “Your servants have come from a very distant
country, because of the fame of YHWH your God. For we heard the
report of Him: of all that He did in Egypt,

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִשְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן לְסִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן וּלְעוֹג מֶלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר בְּעַשְׁתָּרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִשְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן לְסִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן וּלְעוֹג מֶלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר בְּעַשְׁתָּרוֹת׃

english.text:
and of all that He did to the two Amorite kings on the other side
of the Jordan, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan who
lived in Ashtaroth.

translation.text: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.

verses.english:
and of all that He did to the two Amorite kings on the other side
of the Jordan, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan who
lived in Ashtaroth.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלֵינוּ זְקֵינֵינוּ וְכל־יֹשְׁבֵי אַרְצֵנוּ לֵאמֹר קְחוּ בְיֶדְכֶם צֵידָה לַדֶּרֶךְ וּלְכוּ לִקְרָאתָם וַאֲמַרְתֶּם אֲלֵיהֶם עַבְדֵיכֶם אֲנַחְנוּ וְעַתָּה
כִּרְתוּ־לָנוּ בְרִית׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלֵינוּ זְקֵינֵינוּ וְכל־יֹשְׁבֵי אַרְצֵנוּ לֵאמֹר קְחוּ בְיֶדְכֶם צֵידָה לַדֶּרֶךְ וּלְכוּ לִקְרָאתָם וַאֲמַרְתֶּם אֲלֵיהֶם עַבְדֵיכֶם אֲנַחְנוּ וְעַתָּה
כִּרְתוּ־לָנוּ בְרִית׃

english.text:
So our elders and all the inhabitants of our country instructed us
as follows, ‘Take along provisions for a trip, and go to them and
say: We will be your subjects; come make a pact with us.’

translation.text: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We are your servants: therefore now make ye a league with us.

verses.english:
So our elders and all the inhabitants of our country instructed us
as follows, ‘Take along provisions for a trip, and go to them and
say: We will be your subjects; come make a pact with us.’

verses.hebrew: זֶה לַחְמֵנוּ חָם הִצְטַיַּדְנוּ אֹתוֹ מִבָּתֵּינוּ בְּיוֹם צֵאתֵנוּ לָלֶכֶת אֲלֵיכֶם וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה יָבֵשׁ וְהָיָה נִקֻּדִים׃

hebrew.text: זֶה לַחְמֵנוּ חָם הִצְטַיַּדְנוּ אֹתוֹ מִבָּתֵּינוּ בְּיוֹם צֵאתֵנוּ לָלֶכֶת אֲלֵיכֶם וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה יָבֵשׁ וְהָיָה נִקֻּדִים׃

english.text:
This bread of ours, which we took from our houses as provision,
was still hot when we set out to come to you; and see how dry and
crumbly it has become.

translation.text: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:

verses.english:
This bread of ours, which we took from our houses as provision,
was still hot when we set out to come to you; and see how dry and
crumbly it has become.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה נֹאדוֹת הַיַּיִן אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּאנוּ חֲדָשִׁים וְהִנֵּה הִתְבַּקָּעוּ וְאֵלֶּה שַׂלְמוֹתֵינוּ וּנְעָלֵינוּ בָּלוּ מֵרֹב הַדֶּרֶךְ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה נֹאדוֹת הַיַּיִן אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּאנוּ חֲדָשִׁים וְהִנֵּה הִתְבַּקָּעוּ וְאֵלֶּה שַׂלְמוֹתֵינוּ וּנְעָלֵינוּ בָּלוּ מֵרֹב הַדֶּרֶךְ מְאֹד׃

english.text:
These wineskins were new when we filled them, and see how they
have cracked. These clothes and sandals of ours are worn out from
the very long journey.”

translation.text: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.

verses.english:
These wineskins were new when we filled them, and see how they
have cracked. These clothes and sandals of ours are worn out from
the very long journey.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים מִצֵּידָם וְאֶת־פִּי יְהֹוָה לֹא שָׁאָלוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים מִצֵּידָם וְאֶת־פִּי יְהֹוָה לֹא שָׁאָלוּ׃

english.text:
The men took [their word] because of their provisions, and did not
inquire of YHWH.

translation.text: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not counsel at the mouth of the LORD.

verses.english:
The men took [their word] because of their provisions, and did not
inquire of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שָׁלוֹם וַיִּכְרֹת לָהֶם בְּרִית לְחַיּוֹתָם וַיִּשָּׁבְעוּ לָהֶם נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שָׁלוֹם וַיִּכְרֹת לָהֶם בְּרִית לְחַיּוֹתָם וַיִּשָּׁבְעוּ לָהֶם נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
Joshua established friendship with them; he made a pact with them
to spare their lives, and the chieftains of the community gave
them their oath.

translation.text: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.

verses.english:
Joshua established friendship with them; he made a pact with them
to spare their lives, and the chieftains of the community gave
them their oath.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקְצֵה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־כָּרְתוּ לָהֶם בְּרִית וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כִּי־קְרֹבִים הֵם אֵלָיו וּבְקִרְבּוֹ הֵם יֹשְׁבִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקְצֵה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־כָּרְתוּ לָהֶם בְּרִית וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כִּי־קְרֹבִים הֵם אֵלָיו וּבְקִרְבּוֹ הֵם יֹשְׁבִים׃

english.text:
But when three days had passed after they made this pact with
them, they learned that they were neighbors, living among them.

translation.text: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.

verses.english:
But when three days had passed after they made this pact with
them, they learned that they were neighbors, living among them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־עָרֵיהֶם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וְעָרֵיהֶם גִּבְעוֹן וְהַכְּפִירָה וּבְאֵרוֹת וְקִרְיַת יְעָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־עָרֵיהֶם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וְעָרֵיהֶם גִּבְעוֹן וְהַכְּפִירָה וּבְאֵרוֹת וְקִרְיַת יְעָרִים׃

english.text:
So the Israelites set out, and on the third day they came to their
towns; these towns were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and
Kiriath-jearim.

translation.text: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjathjearim.

verses.english:
So the Israelites set out, and on the third day they came to their
towns; these towns were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and
Kiriath-jearim.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא הִכּוּם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־נִשְׁבְּעוּ לָהֶם נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּלֹּנוּ כל־הָעֵדָה עַל־הַנְּשִׂיאִים׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא הִכּוּם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־נִשְׁבְּעוּ לָהֶם נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּלֹּנוּ כל־הָעֵדָה עַל־הַנְּשִׂיאִים׃

english.text:
But the Israelites did not attack them, since the chieftains of
the community had sworn to them by YHWH, the God of Israel. The
whole community muttered against the chieftains,

translation.text: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.

verses.english:
But the Israelites did not attack them, since the chieftains of
the community had sworn to them by YHWH, the God of Israel. The
whole community muttered against the chieftains,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ כל־הַנְּשִׂיאִים אֶל־כּל־הָעֵדָה אֲנַחְנוּ נִשְׁבַּעְנוּ לָהֶם בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַתָּה לֹא נוּכַל לִנְגֹּעַ בָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ כל־הַנְּשִׂיאִים אֶל־כּל־הָעֵדָה אֲנַחְנוּ נִשְׁבַּעְנוּ לָהֶם בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַתָּה לֹא נוּכַל לִנְגֹּעַ בָּהֶם׃

english.text:
but all the chieftains answered the whole community, “We swore to
them by YHWH, the God of Israel; therefore we cannot touch them.

translation.text: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.

verses.english:
but all the chieftains answered the whole community, “We swore to
them by YHWH, the God of Israel; therefore we cannot touch them.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת נַעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם וְהַחֲיֵה אוֹתָם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה עָלֵינוּ קֶצֶף עַל־הַשְּׁבוּעָה אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּעְנוּ לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת נַעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם וְהַחֲיֵה אוֹתָם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה עָלֵינוּ קֶצֶף עַל־הַשְּׁבוּעָה אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּעְנוּ לָהֶם׃

english.text:
This is what we will do to them: We will spare their lives, so
that there may be no wrath against us because of the oath that we
swore to them.”

translation.text: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.

verses.english:
This is what we will do to them: We will spare their lives, so
that there may be no wrath against us because of the oath that we
swore to them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵיהֶם הַנְּשִׂיאִים יִחְיוּ וַיִּהְיוּ חֹטְבֵי עֵצִים וְשֹׁאֲבֵי־מַיִם לְכל־הָעֵדָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ לָהֶם הַנְּשִׂיאִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵיהֶם הַנְּשִׂיאִים יִחְיוּ וַיִּהְיוּ חֹטְבֵי עֵצִים וְשֹׁאֲבֵי־מַיִם לְכל־הָעֵדָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ לָהֶם הַנְּשִׂיאִים׃

english.text:
And the chieftains declared concerning them, “They shall live!”
And they became hewers of wood and drawers of water for the whole
community, as the chieftains had decreed concerning them.

translation.text: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.

verses.english:
And the chieftains declared concerning them, “They shall live!”
And they became hewers of wood and drawers of water for the whole
community, as the chieftains had decreed concerning them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר לָמָּה רִמִּיתֶם אֹתָנוּ לֵאמֹר רְחוֹקִים אֲנַחְנוּ מִכֶּם מְאֹד וְאַתֶּם בְּקִרְבֵּנוּ יֹשְׁבִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר לָמָּה רִמִּיתֶם אֹתָנוּ לֵאמֹר רְחוֹקִים אֲנַחְנוּ מִכֶּם מְאֹד וְאַתֶּם בְּקִרְבֵּנוּ יֹשְׁבִים׃

english.text:
Joshua summoned them and spoke to them thus: “Why did you deceive
us and tell us you lived very far from us, when in fact you live
among us?

translation.text: And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We are very far from you; when ye dwell among us?

verses.english:
Joshua summoned them and spoke to them thus: “Why did you deceive
us and tell us you lived very far from us, when in fact you live
among us?

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֲרוּרִים אַתֶּם וְלֹא־יִכָּרֵת מִכֶּם עֶבֶד וְחֹטְבֵי עֵצִים וְשֹׁאֲבֵי מַיִם לְבֵית אֱלֹהָי׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אֲרוּרִים אַתֶּם וְלֹא־יִכָּרֵת מִכֶּם עֶבֶד וְחֹטְבֵי עֵצִים וְשֹׁאֲבֵי מַיִם לְבֵית אֱלֹהָי׃

english.text:
Therefore, be accursed! Never shall your descendants cease to be
slaves, hewers of wood and drawers of water for the House of my
God.”

translation.text: Now therefore ye are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.

verses.english:
Therefore, be accursed! Never shall your descendants cease to be
slaves, hewers of wood and drawers of water for the House of my
God.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲנוּ אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּאמְרוּ כִּי הֻגֵּד הֻגַּד לַעֲבָדֶיךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ לָתֵת לָכֶם אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ וּלְהַשְׁמִיד
אֶת־כּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וַנִּירָא מְאֹד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵינוּ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וַנַּעֲשֵׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲנוּ אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּאמְרוּ כִּי הֻגֵּד הֻגַּד לַעֲבָדֶיךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ לָתֵת לָכֶם אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ וּלְהַשְׁמִיד
אֶת־כּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וַנִּירָא מְאֹד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵינוּ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וַנַּעֲשֵׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
But they replied to Joshua, “You see, your servants had heard that
YHWH your God had promised His servant Moses to give you the whole
land and to wipe out all the inhabitants of the country on your
account; so we were in great fear for our lives on your account.
That is why we did this thing.

translation.text: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that the LORD thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

verses.english:
But they replied to Joshua, “You see, your servants had heard that
YHWH your God had promised His servant Moses to give you the whole
land and to wipe out all the inhabitants of the country on your
account; so we were in great fear for our lives on your account.
That is why we did this thing.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנְנוּ בְיָדֶךָ כַּטּוֹב וְכַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֶיךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת לָנוּ עֲשֵׂה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִנְנוּ בְיָדֶךָ כַּטּוֹב וְכַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֶיךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת לָנוּ עֲשֵׂה׃

english.text:
And now we are at your mercy; do with us what you consider right
and proper.”

translation.text: And now, behold, we are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.

verses.english:
And now we are at your mercy; do with us what you consider right
and proper.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם כֵּן וַיַּצֵּל אוֹתָם מִיַּד בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא הֲרָגוּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם כֵּן וַיַּצֵּל אוֹתָם מִיַּד בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא הֲרָגוּם׃

english.text: And he did so; he saved them from being killed by the Israelites.

translation.text: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew them not.

verses.english: And he did so; he saved them from being killed by the Israelites.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא חֹטְבֵי עֵצִים וְשֹׁאֲבֵי מַיִם לָעֵדָה וּלְמִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא חֹטְבֵי עֵצִים וְשֹׁאֲבֵי מַיִם לָעֵדָה וּלְמִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחָר׃

english.text:
That day Joshua made them hewers of wood and drawers of water—as
they still are—for the community and for the altar of YHWH, in the
place that He would choose.

translation.text: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the LORD, even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.

verses.english:
That day Joshua made them hewers of wood and drawers of water—as
they still are—for the community and for the altar of YHWH, in the
place that He would choose.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ אֲדֹנִי־צֶדֶק מֶלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם כִּי־לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָעַי וַיַּחֲרִימָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִירִיחוֹ וּלְמַלְכָּהּ כֵּן־עָשָׂה לָעַי וּלְמַלְכָּהּ וְכִי
הִשְׁלִימוּ יֹשְׁבֵי גִבְעוֹן אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּהְיוּ בְּקִרְבָּם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ אֲדֹנִי־צֶדֶק מֶלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם כִּי־לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָעַי וַיַּחֲרִימָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִירִיחוֹ וּלְמַלְכָּהּ כֵּן־עָשָׂה לָעַי וּלְמַלְכָּהּ וְכִי
הִשְׁלִימוּ יֹשְׁבֵי גִבְעוֹן אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּהְיוּ בְּקִרְבָּם׃

english.text:
When King Adoni-zedek of Jerusalem learned that Joshua had
captured Ai and proscribed it, treating Ai and its king as he had
treated Jericho and its king, and that, moreover, the people of
Gibeon had come to terms with Israel and remained among them,

translation.text: Now it came to pass, when Adonizedec king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;

verses.english:
When King Adoni-zedek of Jerusalem learned that Joshua had
captured Ai and proscribed it, treating Ai and its king as he had
treated Jericho and its king, and that, moreover, the people of
Gibeon had come to terms with Israel and remained among them,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּירְאוּ מְאֹד כִּי עִיר גְּדוֹלָה גִּבְעוֹן כְּאַחַת עָרֵי הַמַּמְלָכָה וְכִי הִיא גְדוֹלָה מִן־הָעַי וְכל־אֲנָשֶׁיהָ גִּבֹּרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּירְאוּ מְאֹד כִּי עִיר גְּדוֹלָה גִּבְעוֹן כְּאַחַת עָרֵי הַמַּמְלָכָה וְכִי הִיא גְדוֹלָה מִן־הָעַי וְכל־אֲנָשֶׁיהָ גִּבֹּרִים׃

english.text:
he was very frightened. For Gibeon was a large city, like one of
the royal cities—in fact, larger than Ai—and all its men were
warriors.

translation.text: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.

verses.english:
he was very frightened. For Gibeon was a large city, like one of
the royal cities—in fact, larger than Ai—and all its men were
warriors.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֲדֹנִי־צֶדֶק מֶלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֶל־הוֹהָם מֶלֶךְ־חֶבְרוֹן וְאֶל־פִּרְאָם מֶלֶךְ־יַרְמוּת וְאֶל־יָפִיעַ מֶלֶךְ־לָכִישׁ וְאֶל־דְּבִיר מֶלֶךְ־עֶגְלוֹן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֲדֹנִי־צֶדֶק מֶלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֶל־הוֹהָם מֶלֶךְ־חֶבְרוֹן וְאֶל־פִּרְאָם מֶלֶךְ־יַרְמוּת וְאֶל־יָפִיעַ מֶלֶךְ־לָכִישׁ וְאֶל־דְּבִיר מֶלֶךְ־עֶגְלוֹן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
So King Adoni-zedek of Jerusalem sent this message to King Hoham
of Hebron, King Piram of Jarmuth, King Japhia of Lachish, and King
Debir of Eglon:

translation.text: Wherefore Adonizedec king of Jerusalem, sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,

verses.english:
So King Adoni-zedek of Jerusalem sent this message to King Hoham
of Hebron, King Piram of Jarmuth, King Japhia of Lachish, and King
Debir of Eglon:

verses.hebrew: עֲלוּ־אֵלַי וְעִזְרֻנִי וְנַכֶּה אֶת־גִּבְעוֹן כִּי־הִשְׁלִימָה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְאֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: עֲלוּ־אֵלַי וְעִזְרֻנִי וְנַכֶּה אֶת־גִּבְעוֹן כִּי־הִשְׁלִימָה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְאֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
“Come up and help me defeat Gibeon; for it has come to terms with
Joshua and the Israelites.”

translation.text: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.

verses.english:
“Come up and help me defeat Gibeon; for it has come to terms with
Joshua and the Israelites.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּאָסְפוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי מֶלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם מֶלֶךְ־חֶבְרוֹן מֶלֶךְ־יַרְמוּת מֶלֶךְ־לָכִישׁ מֶלֶךְ־עֶגְלוֹן הֵם וְכל־מַחֲנֵיהֶם וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל־גִּבְעוֹן
וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּאָסְפוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי מֶלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם מֶלֶךְ־חֶבְרוֹן מֶלֶךְ־יַרְמוּת מֶלֶךְ־לָכִישׁ מֶלֶךְ־עֶגְלוֹן הֵם וְכל־מַחֲנֵיהֶם וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל־גִּבְעוֹן
וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
The five Amorite kings—the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron,
the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon,
with all their armies—joined forces and marched on Gibeon, and
encamped against it and attacked it.

translation.text: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.

verses.english:
The five Amorite kings—the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron,
the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon,
with all their armies—joined forces and marched on Gibeon, and
encamped against it and attacked it.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אַנְשֵׁי גִבְעוֹן אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּלָה לֵאמֹר אַל־תֶּרֶף יָדֶיךָ מֵעֲבָדֶיךָ עֲלֵה אֵלֵינוּ מְהֵרָה וְהוֹשִׁיעָה לָּנוּ וְעזְרֵנוּ כִּי
נִקְבְּצוּ אֵלֵינוּ כּל־מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָהָר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אַנְשֵׁי גִבְעוֹן אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּלָה לֵאמֹר אַל־תֶּרֶף יָדֶיךָ מֵעֲבָדֶיךָ עֲלֵה אֵלֵינוּ מְהֵרָה וְהוֹשִׁיעָה לָּנוּ וְעזְרֵנוּ כִּי
נִקְבְּצוּ אֵלֵינוּ כּל־מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָהָר׃

english.text:
The people of Gibeon thereupon sent this message to Joshua in the
camp at Gilgal: “Do not fail your servants; come up quickly and
aid us and deliver us, for all the Amorite kings of the hill
country have gathered against us.”

translation.text: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.

verses.english:
The people of Gibeon thereupon sent this message to Joshua in the
camp at Gilgal: “Do not fail your servants; come up quickly and
aid us and deliver us, for all the Amorite kings of the hill
country have gathered against us.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מִן־הַגִּלְגָּל הוּא וְכל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה עִמּוֹ וְכֹל גִּבּוֹרֵי הֶחָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מִן־הַגִּלְגָּל הוּא וְכל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה עִמּוֹ וְכֹל גִּבּוֹרֵי הֶחָיִל׃

english.text:
So Joshua marched up from Gilgal with his whole fighting force,
all the trained warriors.

translation.text: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.

verses.english:
So Joshua marched up from Gilgal with his whole fighting force,
all the trained warriors.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַל־תִּירָא מֵהֶם כִּי בְיָדְךָ נְתַתִּים לֹא־יַעֲמֹד אִישׁ מֵהֶם בְּפָנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַל־תִּירָא מֵהֶם כִּי בְיָדְךָ נְתַתִּים לֹא־יַעֲמֹד אִישׁ מֵהֶם בְּפָנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
YHWH said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them, for I will deliver
them into your hands; not one of them shall withstand you.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.

verses.english:
YHWH said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them, for I will deliver
them into your hands; not one of them shall withstand you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ פִּתְאֹם כּל־הַלַּיְלָה עָלָה מִן־הַגִּלְגָּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ פִּתְאֹם כּל־הַלַּיְלָה עָלָה מִן־הַגִּלְגָּל׃

english.text: Joshua took them by surprise, marching all night from Gilgal.

translation.text: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.

verses.english: Joshua took them by surprise, marching all night from Gilgal.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהֻמֵּם יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכֵּם מַכָּה־גְדוֹלָה בְּגִבְעוֹן וַיִּרְדְּפֵם דֶּרֶךְ מַעֲלֵה בֵית־חוֹרֹן וַיַּכֵּם עַד־עֲזֵקָה וְעַד־מַקֵּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהֻמֵּם יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכֵּם מַכָּה־גְדוֹלָה בְּגִבְעוֹן וַיִּרְדְּפֵם דֶּרֶךְ מַעֲלֵה בֵית־חוֹרֹן וַיַּכֵּם עַד־עֲזֵקָה וְעַד־מַקֵּדָה׃

english.text:
YHWH threw them into a panic before Israel: [Joshua] inflicted a
crushing defeat on them at Gibeon, pursued them in the direction
of the Beth-horon ascent, and harried them all the way to Azekah
and Makkedah.

translation.text: And the LORD discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Bethhoron, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.

verses.english:
YHWH threw them into a panic before Israel: [Joshua] inflicted a
crushing defeat on them at Gibeon, pursued them in the direction
of the Beth-horon ascent, and harried them all the way to Azekah
and Makkedah.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בְּנֻסָם מִפְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵם בְּמוֹרַד בֵּית־חוֹרֹן וַיהֹוָה הִשְׁלִיךְ עֲלֵיהֶם אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם עַד־עֲזֵקָה וַיָּמֻתוּ רַבִּים אֲשֶׁר־מֵתוּ
בְּאַבְנֵי הַבָּרָד מֵאֲשֶׁר הָרְגוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בֶּחָרֶב׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בְּנֻסָם מִפְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵם בְּמוֹרַד בֵּית־חוֹרֹן וַיהֹוָה הִשְׁלִיךְ עֲלֵיהֶם אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם עַד־עֲזֵקָה וַיָּמֻתוּ רַבִּים אֲשֶׁר־מֵתוּ
בְּאַבְנֵי הַבָּרָד מֵאֲשֶׁר הָרְגוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בֶּחָרֶב׃

english.text:
While they were fleeing before Israel down the descent from
Beth-horon, YHWH hurled huge stones on them from the sky, all the
way to Azekah, and they perished; more perished from the
hailstones than were killed by the Israelite weapons.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel, and were in the going down to Bethhoron, that the LORD cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.

verses.english:
While they were fleeing before Israel down the descent from
Beth-horon, YHWH hurled huge stones on them from the sky, all the
way to Azekah, and they perished; more perished from the
hailstones than were killed by the Israelite weapons.

verses.hebrew: אָז יְדַבֵּר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לַיהֹוָה בְּיוֹם תֵּת יְהֹוָה אֶת־הָאֱמֹרִי לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לְעֵינֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁמֶשׁ בְּגִבְעוֹן דּוֹם וְיָרֵחַ בְּעֵמֶק אַיָּלוֹן׃

hebrew.text: אָז יְדַבֵּר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לַיהֹוָה בְּיוֹם תֵּת יְהֹוָה אֶת־הָאֱמֹרִי לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לְעֵינֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁמֶשׁ בְּגִבְעוֹן דּוֹם וְיָרֵחַ בְּעֵמֶק אַיָּלוֹן׃

english.text:
On that occasion, when YHWH routed the Amorites before the
Israelites, Joshua addressed YHWH; he said in the presence of the
Israelites: “Stand still, O sun, at Gibeon, O moon, in the Valley
of Aijalon!”

translation.text: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.

verses.english:
On that occasion, when YHWH routed the Amorites before the
Israelites, Joshua addressed YHWH; he said in the presence of the
Israelites: “Stand still, O sun, at Gibeon, O moon, in the Valley
of Aijalon!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּדֹּם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְיָרֵחַ עָמָד עַד־יִקֹּם גּוֹי אֹיְבָיו הֲלֹא־הִיא כְתוּבָה עַל־סֵפֶר הַיָּשָׁר וַיַּעֲמֹד הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בַּחֲצִי הַשָּׁמַיִם וְלֹא־אָץ לָבוֹא כְּיוֹם תָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּדֹּם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְיָרֵחַ עָמָד עַד־יִקֹּם גּוֹי אֹיְבָיו הֲלֹא־הִיא כְתוּבָה עַל־סֵפֶר הַיָּשָׁר וַיַּעֲמֹד הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בַּחֲצִי הַשָּׁמַיִם וְלֹא־אָץ לָבוֹא כְּיוֹם תָּמִים׃

english.text:
And the sun stood still And the moon halted, While a nation
wreaked judgment on its foes —as is written in the Book of Jashar.
Thus the sun halted in midheaven, and did not press on to set, for
a whole day;

translation.text: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.

verses.english:
And the sun stood still And the moon halted, While a nation
wreaked judgment on its foes —as is written in the Book of Jashar.
Thus the sun halted in midheaven, and did not press on to set, for
a whole day;

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא הָיָה כַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לְפָנָיו וְאַחֲרָיו לִשְׁמֹעַ יְהֹוָה בְּקוֹל אִישׁ כִּי יְהֹוָה נִלְחָם לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא הָיָה כַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לְפָנָיו וְאַחֲרָיו לִשְׁמֹעַ יְהֹוָה בְּקוֹל אִישׁ כִּי יְהֹוָה נִלְחָם לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
for YHWH fought for Israel. Neither before nor since has there
ever been such a day, when YHWH acted on words spoken by a man.

translation.text: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the LORD fought for Israel.

verses.english:
for YHWH fought for Israel. Neither before nor since has there
ever been such a day, when YHWH acted on words spoken by a man.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּלָה׃

english.text:
Then Joshua together with all Israel returned to the camp at
Gilgal.

translation.text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

verses.english:
Then Joshua together with all Israel returned to the camp at
Gilgal.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּנֻסוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּחָבְאוּ בַמְּעָרָה בְּמַקֵּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּנֻסוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּחָבְאוּ בַמְּעָרָה בְּמַקֵּדָה׃

english.text: Meanwhile, those five kings fled and hid in a cave at Makkedah.

translation.text: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.

verses.english: Meanwhile, those five kings fled and hid in a cave at Makkedah.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר נִמְצְאוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים נֶחְבְּאִים בַּמְּעָרָה בְּמַקֵּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר נִמְצְאוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים נֶחְבְּאִים בַּמְּעָרָה בְּמַקֵּדָה׃

english.text:
When it was reported to Joshua that the five kings had been found
hiding in a cave at Makkedah,

translation.text: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.

verses.english:
When it was reported to Joshua that the five kings had been found
hiding in a cave at Makkedah,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ גֹּלּוּ אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת אֶל־פִּי הַמְּעָרָה וְהַפְקִידוּ עָלֶיהָ אֲנָשִׁים לְשׁמְרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ גֹּלּוּ אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת אֶל־פִּי הַמְּעָרָה וְהַפְקִידוּ עָלֶיהָ אֲנָשִׁים לְשׁמְרָם׃

english.text:
Joshua ordered, “Roll large stones up against the mouth of the
cave, and post men over it to keep guard over them.

translation.text: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:

verses.english:
Joshua ordered, “Roll large stones up against the mouth of the
cave, and post men over it to keep guard over them.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם אַל־תַּעֲמֹדוּ רִדְפוּ אַחֲרֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְזִנַּבְתֶּם אוֹתָם אַל־תִּתְּנוּם לָבוֹא אֶל־עָרֵיהֶם כִּי נְתָנָם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בְּיֶדְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם אַל־תַּעֲמֹדוּ רִדְפוּ אַחֲרֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְזִנַּבְתֶּם אוֹתָם אַל־תִּתְּנוּם לָבוֹא אֶל־עָרֵיהֶם כִּי נְתָנָם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בְּיֶדְכֶם׃

english.text:
But as for the rest of you, don’t stop, but press on the heels of
your enemies and harass them from the rear. Don’t let them reach
their towns, for YHWH your God has delivered them into your
hands.”

translation.text: And stay ye not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for the LORD your God hath delivered them into your hand.

verses.english:
But as for the rest of you, don’t stop, but press on the heels of
your enemies and harass them from the rear. Don’t let them reach
their towns, for YHWH your God has delivered them into your
hands.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכּוֹתָם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה־מְאֹד עַד־תֻּמָּם וְהַשְּׂרִידִים שָׂרְדוּ מֵהֶם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־עָרֵי הַמִּבְצָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכּוֹתָם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה־מְאֹד עַד־תֻּמָּם וְהַשְּׂרִידִים שָׂרְדוּ מֵהֶם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־עָרֵי הַמִּבְצָר׃

english.text:
When Joshua and the Israelites had finished dealing them a deadly
blow, they were wiped out, except for some fugitives who escaped
into the fortified towns.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.

verses.english:
When Joshua and the Israelites had finished dealing them a deadly
blow, they were wiped out, except for some fugitives who escaped
into the fortified towns.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ כל־הָעָם אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מַקֵּדָה בְּשָׁלוֹם לֹא־חָרַץ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאִישׁ אֶת־לְשֹׁנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ כל־הָעָם אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מַקֵּדָה בְּשָׁלוֹם לֹא־חָרַץ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאִישׁ אֶת־לְשֹׁנוֹ׃

english.text:
The whole army returned in safety to Joshua in the camp at
Makkedah; no one so much as snarled at the Israelites.

translation.text: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.

verses.english:
The whole army returned in safety to Joshua in the camp at
Makkedah; no one so much as snarled at the Israelites.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ פִּתְחוּ אֶת־פִּי הַמְּעָרָה וְהוֹצִיאוּ אֵלַי אֶת־חֲמֵשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה מִן־הַמְּעָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ פִּתְחוּ אֶת־פִּי הַמְּעָרָה וְהוֹצִיאוּ אֵלַי אֶת־חֲמֵשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה מִן־הַמְּעָרָה׃

english.text:
And now Joshua ordered, “Open the mouth of the cave, and bring
those five kings out of the cave to me.”

translation.text: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.

verses.english:
And now Joshua ordered, “Open the mouth of the cave, and bring
those five kings out of the cave to me.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן וַיֹּצִיאוּ אֵלָיו אֶת־חֲמֵשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה מִן־הַמְּעָרָה אֵת מֶלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֶת־מֶלֶךְ חֶבְרוֹן אֶת־מֶלֶךְ יַרְמוּת אֶת־מֶלֶךְ לָכִישׁ אֶת־מֶלֶךְ
עֶגְלוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן וַיֹּצִיאוּ אֵלָיו אֶת־חֲמֵשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה מִן־הַמְּעָרָה אֵת מֶלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֶת־מֶלֶךְ חֶבְרוֹן אֶת־מֶלֶךְ יַרְמוּת אֶת־מֶלֶךְ לָכִישׁ אֶת־מֶלֶךְ
עֶגְלוֹן׃

english.text:
This was done. Those five kings—the king of Jerusalem, the king of
Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of
Eglon—were brought out to him from the cave.

translation.text: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.

verses.english:
This was done. Those five kings—the king of Jerusalem, the king of
Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of
Eglon—were brought out to him from the cave.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כְּהוֹצִיאָם אֶת־הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־קְצִינֵי אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה הֶהָלְכוּא אִתּוֹ קִרְבוּ
שִׂימוּ אֶת־רַגְלֵיכֶם עַל־צַוְּארֵי הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּקְרְבוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶם עַל־צַוְּארֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כְּהוֹצִיאָם אֶת־הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־קְצִינֵי אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה הֶהָלְכוּא אִתּוֹ קִרְבוּ
שִׂימוּ אֶת־רַגְלֵיכֶם עַל־צַוְּארֵי הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּקְרְבוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶם עַל־צַוְּארֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And when the kings were brought out to Joshua, Joshua summoned all
the men of Israel and ordered the army officers who had
accompanied him, “Come forward and place your feet on the necks of
these kings.” They came forward and placed their feet on their
necks.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.

verses.english:
And when the kings were brought out to Joshua, Joshua summoned all
the men of Israel and ordered the army officers who had
accompanied him, “Come forward and place your feet on the necks of
these kings.” They came forward and placed their feet on their
necks.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַל־תִּירְאוּ וְאַל־תֵּחָתּוּ חִזְקוּ וְאִמְצוּ כִּי כָכָה יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה לְכל־אֹיְבֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם נִלְחָמִים אוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַל־תִּירְאוּ וְאַל־תֵּחָתּוּ חִזְקוּ וְאִמְצוּ כִּי כָכָה יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה לְכל־אֹיְבֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם נִלְחָמִים אוֹתָם׃

english.text:
Joshua said to them, “Do not be frightened or dismayed; be firm
and resolute. For this is what YHWH is going to do to all the
enemies with whom you are at war.”

translation.text: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the LORD do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.

verses.english:
Joshua said to them, “Do not be frightened or dismayed; be firm
and resolute. For this is what YHWH is going to do to all the
enemies with whom you are at war.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיְמִיתֵם וַיִּתְלֵם עַל חֲמִשָּׁה עֵצִים וַיִּהְיוּ תְּלוּיִם עַל־הָעֵצִים עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיְמִיתֵם וַיִּתְלֵם עַל חֲמִשָּׁה עֵצִים וַיִּהְיוּ תְּלוּיִם עַל־הָעֵצִים עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
After that, Joshua had them put to death and impaled on five
stakes, and they remained impaled on the stakes until evening.

translation.text: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.

verses.english:
After that, Joshua had them put to death and impaled on five
stakes, and they remained impaled on the stakes until evening.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי לְעֵת בּוֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ צִוָּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּרִידוּם מֵעַל הָעֵצִים וַיַּשְׁלִכֻם אֶל־הַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר נֶחְבְּאוּ־שָׁם וַיָּשִׂמוּ אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת עַל־פִּי הַמְּעָרָה
עַד־עֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי לְעֵת בּוֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ צִוָּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּרִידוּם מֵעַל הָעֵצִים וַיַּשְׁלִכֻם אֶל־הַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר נֶחְבְּאוּ־שָׁם וַיָּשִׂמוּ אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת עַל־פִּי הַמְּעָרָה
עַד־עֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
At sunset Joshua ordered them taken down from the poles and thrown
into the cave in which they had hidden. Large stones were placed
over the mouth of the cave, [and there they are] to this very day.

translation.text: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave’s mouth, which remain until this very day.

verses.english:
At sunset Joshua ordered them taken down from the poles and thrown
into the cave in which they had hidden. Large stones were placed
over the mouth of the cave, [and there they are] to this very day.

verses.hebrew:
וְאֶת־מַקֵּדָה לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיַּכֶּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ הֶחֱרִם אוֹתָם וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד וַיַּעַשׂ לְמֶלֶךְ
מַקֵּדָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְמֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֶת־מַקֵּדָה לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיַּכֶּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ הֶחֱרִם אוֹתָם וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד וַיַּעַשׂ לְמֶלֶךְ
מַקֵּדָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְמֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ׃

english.text:
At that time Joshua captured Makkedah and put it and its king to
the sword, proscribing it and every person in it and leaving none
that escaped. And he treated the king of Makkedah as he had
treated the king of Jericho.

translation.text: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.

verses.english:
At that time Joshua captured Makkedah and put it and its king to
the sword, proscribing it and every person in it and leaving none
that escaped. And he treated the king of Makkedah as he had
treated the king of Jericho.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִמַּקֵּדָה לִבְנָה וַיִּלָּחֶם עִם־לִבְנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִמַּקֵּדָה לִבְנָה וַיִּלָּחֶם עִם־לִבְנָה׃

english.text:
From Makkedah, Joshua proceeded with all Israel to Libnah, and he
attacked it.

translation.text: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:

verses.english:
From Makkedah, Joshua proceeded with all Israel to Libnah, and he
attacked it.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה גַּם־אוֹתָהּ בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ וַיַּכֶּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר בָּהּ שָׂרִיד וַיַּעַשׂ לְמַלְכָּהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר
עָשָׂה לְמֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה גַּם־אוֹתָהּ בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ וַיַּכֶּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר בָּהּ שָׂרִיד וַיַּעַשׂ לְמַלְכָּהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר
עָשָׂה לְמֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ׃

english.text:
YHWH delivered it and its king into the hands of Israel; they put
it and all the people in it to the sword, letting none escape. And
he treated its king as he had treated the king of Jericho.

translation.text: And the LORD delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.

verses.english:
YHWH delivered it and its king into the hands of Israel; they put
it and all the people in it to the sword, letting none escape. And
he treated its king as he had treated the king of Jericho.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִלִּבְנָה לָכִישָׁה וַיִּחַן עָלֶיהָ וַיִּלָּחֶם בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִלִּבְנָה לָכִישָׁה וַיִּחַן עָלֶיהָ וַיִּלָּחֶם בָּהּ׃

english.text:
From Libnah, Joshua proceeded with all Israel to Lachish; he
encamped against it and attacked it.

translation.text: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:

verses.english:
From Libnah, Joshua proceeded with all Israel to Lachish; he
encamped against it and attacked it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת־לָכִישׁ בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי וַיַּכֶּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְלִבְנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת־לָכִישׁ בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי וַיַּכֶּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְלִבְנָה׃

english.text:
YHWH delivered Lachish into the hands of Israel. They captured it
on the second day and put it and all the people in it to the
sword, just as they had done to Libnah.

translation.text: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

verses.english:
YHWH delivered Lachish into the hands of Israel. They captured it
on the second day and put it and all the people in it to the
sword, just as they had done to Libnah.

verses.hebrew: אָז עָלָה הֹרָם מֶלֶךְ גֶּזֶר לַעְזֹר אֶת־לָכִישׁ וַיַּכֵּהוּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְאֶת־עַמּוֹ עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לוֹ שָׂרִיד׃

hebrew.text: אָז עָלָה הֹרָם מֶלֶךְ גֶּזֶר לַעְזֹר אֶת־לָכִישׁ וַיַּכֵּהוּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְאֶת־עַמּוֹ עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לוֹ שָׂרִיד׃

english.text:
At that time King Horam of Gezer marched to the help of Lachish;
but Joshua defeated him and his army, letting none of them escape.

translation.text: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.

verses.english:
At that time King Horam of Gezer marched to the help of Lachish;
but Joshua defeated him and his army, letting none of them escape.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִלָּכִישׁ עֶגְלֹנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ עָלֶיהָ וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִלָּכִישׁ עֶגְלֹנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ עָלֶיהָ וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
From Lachish, Joshua proceeded with all Israel to Eglon; they
encamped against it and attacked it.

translation.text: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:

verses.english:
From Lachish, Joshua proceeded with all Israel to Eglon; they
encamped against it and attacked it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכְּדוּהָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיַּכּוּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֵת כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא הֶחֱרִים כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְלָכִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְכְּדוּהָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיַּכּוּהָ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֵת כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא הֶחֱרִים כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְלָכִישׁ׃

english.text:
They captured it on the same day and put it to the sword,
proscribing all the people that were in it, as they had done to
Lachish.

translation.text: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

verses.english:
They captured it on the same day and put it to the sword,
proscribing all the people that were in it, as they had done to
Lachish.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מֵעֶגְלוֹנָה חֶבְרוֹנָה וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מֵעֶגְלוֹנָה חֶבְרוֹנָה וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
From Eglon, Joshua marched with all Israel to Hebron and attacked
it.

translation.text: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:

verses.english:
From Eglon, Joshua marched with all Israel to Hebron and attacked
it.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּלְכְּדוּהָ וַיַּכּוּהָ־לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ וְאֶת־כּל־עָרֶיהָ וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְעֶגְלוֹן וַיַּחֲרֵם אוֹתָהּ
וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּלְכְּדוּהָ וַיַּכּוּהָ־לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ וְאֶת־כּל־עָרֶיהָ וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְעֶגְלוֹן וַיַּחֲרֵם אוֹתָהּ
וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ׃

english.text:
They captured it and put it, its king, and all its towns, and all
the people that were in it, to the sword. He let none escape,
proscribing it and all the people in it, just as he had done in
the case of Eglon.

translation.text: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein.

verses.english:
They captured it and put it, its king, and all its towns, and all
the people that were in it, to the sword. He let none escape,
proscribing it and all the people in it, just as he had done in
the case of Eglon.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ דְּבִרָה וַיִּלָּחֶם עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ דְּבִרָה וַיִּלָּחֶם עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
Joshua and all Israel with him then turned back to Debir and
attacked it.

translation.text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:

verses.english:
Joshua and all Israel with him then turned back to Debir and
attacked it.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ וְאֶת־כּל־עָרֶיהָ וַיַּכּוּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב וַיַּחֲרִימוּ אֶת־כּל־נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְחֶבְרוֹן כֵּן־עָשָׂה
לִדְבִרָה וּלְמַלְכָּהּ וְכַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְלִבְנָה וּלְמַלְכָּהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ וְאֶת־כּל־עָרֶיהָ וַיַּכּוּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב וַיַּחֲרִימוּ אֶת־כּל־נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לֹא הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְחֶבְרוֹן כֵּן־עָשָׂה
לִדְבִרָה וּלְמַלְכָּהּ וְכַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְלִבְנָה וּלְמַלְכָּהּ׃

english.text:
He captured it and its king and all its towns. They put them to
the sword and proscribed all the people in it. They let none
escape; just as they had done to Hebron, and as they had done to
Libnah and its king, so they did to Debir and its king.

translation.text: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.

verses.english:
He captured it and its king and all its towns. They put them to
the sword and proscribed all the people in it. They let none
escape; just as they had done to Hebron, and as they had done to
Libnah and its king, so they did to Debir and its king.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּכֶּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ הָהָר וְהַנֶּגֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָה וְהָאֲשֵׁדוֹת וְאֵת כּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם לֹא הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד וְאֵת כּל־הַנְּשָׁמָה הֶחֱרִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה
אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּכֶּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ הָהָר וְהַנֶּגֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָה וְהָאֲשֵׁדוֹת וְאֵת כּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם לֹא הִשְׁאִיר שָׂרִיד וְאֵת כּל־הַנְּשָׁמָה הֶחֱרִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה
אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Thus Joshua conquered the whole country: the hill country, the
Negeb, the Shephelah, and the slopes, with all their kings; he let
none escape, but proscribed everything that breathed—as YHWH, the
God of Israel, had commanded.

translation.text: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD God of Israel commanded.

verses.english:
Thus Joshua conquered the whole country: the hill country, the
Negeb, the Shephelah, and the slopes, with all their kings; he let
none escape, but proscribed everything that breathed—as YHWH, the
God of Israel, had commanded.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ וְעַד־עַזָּה וְאֵת כּל־אֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן וְעַד־גִּבְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ וְעַד־עַזָּה וְאֵת כּל־אֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן וְעַד־גִּבְעוֹן׃

english.text:
Joshua conquered them from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza, all the land of
Goshen, and up to Gibeon.

translation.text: And Joshua smote them from Kadeshbarnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.

verses.english:
Joshua conquered them from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza, all the land of
Goshen, and up to Gibeon.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כּל־הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־אַרְצָם לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ פַּעַם אֶחָת כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נִלְחָם לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת כּל־הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־אַרְצָם לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ פַּעַם אֶחָת כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נִלְחָם לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
All those kings and their lands were conquered by Joshua at a
single stroke, for YHWH, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

translation.text: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the LORD God of Israel fought for Israel.

verses.english:
All those kings and their lands were conquered by Joshua at a
single stroke, for YHWH, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּלָה׃

english.text: Then Joshua, with all Israel, returned to the camp at Gilgal.

translation.text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

verses.english: Then Joshua, with all Israel, returned to the camp at Gilgal.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־חָצוֹר וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶל־יוֹבָב מֶלֶךְ מָדוֹן וְאֶל־מֶלֶךְ שִׁמְרוֹן וְאֶל־מֶלֶךְ אַכְשָׁף׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־חָצוֹר וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶל־יוֹבָב מֶלֶךְ מָדוֹן וְאֶל־מֶלֶךְ שִׁמְרוֹן וְאֶל־מֶלֶךְ אַכְשָׁף׃

english.text:
When the news reached King Jabin of Hazor, he sent messages to
King Jobab of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of
Achshaph,

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,

verses.english:
When the news reached King Jabin of Hazor, he sent messages to
King Jobab of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of
Achshaph,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר מִצְּפוֹן בָּהָר וּבָעֲרָבָה נֶגֶב כִּנְרוֹת וּבַשְּׁפֵלָה וּבְנָפוֹת דּוֹר מִיָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל־הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר מִצְּפוֹן בָּהָר וּבָעֲרָבָה נֶגֶב כִּנְרוֹת וּבַשְּׁפֵלָה וּבְנָפוֹת דּוֹר מִיָּם׃

translation.text: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,

verses.hebrew: הַכְּנַעֲנִי מִמִּזְרָח וּמִיָּם וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי בָּהָר וְהַחִוִּי תַּחַת חֶרְמוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ הַמִּצְפָּה׃

hebrew.text: הַכְּנַעֲנִי מִמִּזְרָח וּמִיָּם וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי בָּהָר וְהַחִוִּי תַּחַת חֶרְמוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ הַמִּצְפָּה׃

english.text:
to the Canaanites in the east and in the west; to the Amorites,
Hittites, Perizzites, and Jebusites in the hill country; and to
the Hivites at the foot of Hermon, in the land of Mizpah.

translation.text: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.

verses.english:
to the Canaanites in the east and in the west; to the Amorites,
Hittites, Perizzites, and Jebusites in the hill country; and to
the Hivites at the foot of Hermon, in the land of Mizpah.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ הֵם וְכל־מַחֲנֵיהֶם עִמָּם עַם־רָב כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־הַיָּם לָרֹב וְסוּס וָרֶכֶב רַב־מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ הֵם וְכל־מַחֲנֵיהֶם עִמָּם עַם־רָב כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־הַיָּם לָרֹב וְסוּס וָרֶכֶב רַב־מְאֹד׃

english.text:
They took the field with all their armies—an enormous host, as
numerous as the sands on the seashore—and a vast multitude of
horses and chariots.

translation.text: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.

verses.english:
They took the field with all their armies—an enormous host, as
numerous as the sands on the seashore—and a vast multitude of
horses and chariots.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּעֲדוּ כֹּל הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ יַחְדָּו אֶל־מֵי מֵרוֹם לְהִלָּחֵם עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּוָּעֲדוּ כֹּל הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ יַחְדָּו אֶל־מֵי מֵרוֹם לְהִלָּחֵם עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
All these kings joined forces; they came and encamped together at
the Waters of Merom to give battle to Israel.

translation.text: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.

verses.english:
All these kings joined forces; they came and encamped together at
the Waters of Merom to give battle to Israel.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַל־תִּירָא מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּי־מָחָר כָּעֵת הַזֹּאת אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן אֶת־כֻּלָּם חֲלָלִים לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־סוּסֵיהֶם תְּעַקֵּר
וְאֶת־מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶם תִּשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אַל־תִּירָא מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּי־מָחָר כָּעֵת הַזֹּאת אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן אֶת־כֻּלָּם חֲלָלִים לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־סוּסֵיהֶם תְּעַקֵּר
וְאֶת־מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶם תִּשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
But YHWH said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them; tomorrow at
this time I will have them all lying slain before Israel. You
shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.

verses.english:
But YHWH said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them; tomorrow at
this time I will have them all lying slain before Israel. You
shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה עִמּוֹ עֲלֵיהֶם עַל־מֵי מֵרוֹם פִּתְאֹם וַיִּפְּלוּ בָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה עִמּוֹ עֲלֵיהֶם עַל־מֵי מֵרוֹם פִּתְאֹם וַיִּפְּלוּ בָּהֶם׃

english.text:
So Joshua, with all his fighting men, came upon them suddenly at
the Waters of Merom, and pounced upon them.

translation.text: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.

verses.english:
So Joshua, with all his fighting men, came upon them suddenly at
the Waters of Merom, and pounced upon them.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכּוּם וַיִּרְדְּפוּם עַד־צִידוֹן רַבָּה וְעַד מִשְׂרְפוֹת מַיִם וְעַד־בִּקְעַת מִצְפֶּה מִזְרָחָה וַיַּכֻּם עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לָהֶם
שָׂרִיד׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכּוּם וַיִּרְדְּפוּם עַד־צִידוֹן רַבָּה וְעַד מִשְׂרְפוֹת מַיִם וְעַד־בִּקְעַת מִצְפֶּה מִזְרָחָה וַיַּכֻּם עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לָהֶם
שָׂרִיד׃

english.text:
YHWH delivered them into the hands of Israel, and they defeated
them and pursued them all the way to Great Sidon and
Misrephothmaim, and all the way to the Valley of Mizpeh on the
east; they crushed them, letting none escape.
