translation.text: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephothmaim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.

verses.english:
YHWH delivered them into the hands of Israel, and they defeated
them and pursued them all the way to Great Sidon and
Misrephothmaim, and all the way to the Valley of Mizpeh on the
east; they crushed them, letting none escape.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר־לוֹ יְהֹוָה אֶת־סוּסֵיהֶם עִקֵּר וְאֶת־מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶם שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר־לוֹ יְהֹוָה אֶת־סוּסֵיהֶם עִקֵּר וְאֶת־מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶם שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
And Joshua dealt with them as YHWH had ordered him; he hamstrung
their horses and burned their chariots.

translation.text: And Joshua did unto them as the LORD bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.

verses.english:
And Joshua dealt with them as YHWH had ordered him; he hamstrung
their horses and burned their chariots.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בָּעֵת הַהִיא וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־חָצוֹר וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ הִכָּה בֶחָרֶב כִּי־חָצוֹר לְפָנִים הִיא רֹאשׁ כּל־הַמַּמְלָכוֹת הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בָּעֵת הַהִיא וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־חָצוֹר וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ הִכָּה בֶחָרֶב כִּי־חָצוֹר לְפָנִים הִיא רֹאשׁ כּל־הַמַּמְלָכוֹת הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
Joshua then turned back and captured Hazor and put her king to the
sword.—Hazor was formerly the head of all those kingdoms.—

translation.text: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.

verses.english:
Joshua then turned back and captured Hazor and put her king to the
sword.—Hazor was formerly the head of all those kingdoms.—

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לְפִי־חֶרֶב הַחֲרֵם לֹא נוֹתַר כּל־נְשָׁמָה וְאֶת־חָצוֹר שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־כּל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ לְפִי־חֶרֶב הַחֲרֵם לֹא נוֹתַר כּל־נְשָׁמָה וְאֶת־חָצוֹר שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
They proscribed and put to the sword every person in it. Not a
soul survived, and Hazor itself was burned down.

translation.text: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.

verses.english:
They proscribed and put to the sword every person in it. Not a
soul survived, and Hazor itself was burned down.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־כּל־עָרֵי הַמְּלָכִים־הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־כּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיַּכֵּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב הֶחֱרִים אוֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־כּל־עָרֵי הַמְּלָכִים־הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־כּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם לָכַד יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיַּכֵּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב הֶחֱרִים אוֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Joshua captured all those royal cities and their kings. He put
them to the sword; he proscribed them in accordance with the
charge of Moses, the servant of YHWH.

translation.text: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.

verses.english:
Joshua captured all those royal cities and their kings. He put
them to the sword; he proscribed them in accordance with the
charge of Moses, the servant of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: רַק כּל־הֶעָרִים הָעֹמְדוֹת עַל־תִּלָּם לֹא שְׂרָפָם יִשְׂרָאֵל זוּלָתִי אֶת־חָצוֹר לְבַדָּהּ שָׂרַף יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃

hebrew.text: רַק כּל־הֶעָרִים הָעֹמְדוֹת עַל־תִּלָּם לֹא שְׂרָפָם יִשְׂרָאֵל זוּלָתִי אֶת־חָצוֹר לְבַדָּהּ שָׂרַף יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃

english.text:
However, all those towns that are still standing on their mounds
were not burned down by Israel; it was Hazor alone that Joshua
burned down.

translation.text: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.

verses.english:
However, all those towns that are still standing on their mounds
were not burned down by Israel; it was Hazor alone that Joshua
burned down.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל שְׁלַל הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְהַבְּהֵמָה בָּזְזוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק אֶת־כּל־הָאָדָם הִכּוּ לְפִי־חֶרֶב עַד־הִשְׁמִדָם אוֹתָם לֹא הִשְׁאִירוּ כּל־נְשָׁמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל שְׁלַל הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְהַבְּהֵמָה בָּזְזוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק אֶת־כּל־הָאָדָם הִכּוּ לְפִי־חֶרֶב עַד־הִשְׁמִדָם אוֹתָם לֹא הִשְׁאִירוּ כּל־נְשָׁמָה׃

english.text:
The Israelites kept all the spoil and cattle of the rest of those
cities as booty. But they cut down their populations with the
sword until they exterminated them; they did not spare a soul.

translation.text: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.

verses.english:
The Israelites kept all the spoil and cattle of the rest of those
cities as booty. But they cut down their populations with the
sword until they exterminated them; they did not spare a soul.

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ כֵּן־צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכֵן עָשָׂה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֹא־הֵסִיר דָּבָר מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ כֵּן־צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכֵן עָשָׂה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֹא־הֵסִיר דָּבָר מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
Just as YHWH had commanded His servant Moses, so Moses had charged
Joshua, and so Joshua did; he left nothing undone of all that YHWH
had commanded Moses.

translation.text: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
Just as YHWH had commanded His servant Moses, so Moses had charged
Joshua, and so Joshua did; he left nothing undone of all that YHWH
had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת הָהָר וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּגֶב וְאֵת כּל־אֶרֶץ הַגֹּשֶׁן וְאֶת־הַשְּׁפֵלָה וְאֶת־הָעֲרָבָה וְאֶת־הַר יִשְׂרָאֵל וּשְׁפֵלָתֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת הָהָר וְאֶת־כּל־הַנֶּגֶב וְאֵת כּל־אֶרֶץ הַגֹּשֶׁן וְאֶת־הַשְּׁפֵלָה וְאֶת־הָעֲרָבָה וְאֶת־הַר יִשְׂרָאֵל וּשְׁפֵלָתֹה׃

english.text:
Joshua conquered the whole of this region: the hill country [of
Judah], the Negeb, the whole land of Goshen, the Shephelah, the
Arabah, and the hill country and coastal plain of Israel—

translation.text: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;

verses.english:
Joshua conquered the whole of this region: the hill country [of
Judah], the Negeb, the whole land of Goshen, the Shephelah, the
Arabah, and the hill country and coastal plain of Israel—

verses.hebrew: מִן־הָהָר הֶחָלָק הָעוֹלֶה שֵׂעִיר וְעַד־בַּעַל גָּד בְּבִקְעַת הַלְּבָנוֹן תַּחַת הַר־חֶרְמוֹן וְאֵת כּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם לָכַד וַיַּכֵּם וַיְמִיתֵם׃

hebrew.text: מִן־הָהָר הֶחָלָק הָעוֹלֶה שֵׂעִיר וְעַד־בַּעַל גָּד בְּבִקְעַת הַלְּבָנוֹן תַּחַת הַר־חֶרְמוֹן וְאֵת כּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם לָכַד וַיַּכֵּם וַיְמִיתֵם׃

english.text:
[everything] from Mount Halak, which ascends to Seir, all the way
to Baal-gad in the Valley of the Lebanon at the foot of Mount
Hermon; and he captured all the kings there and executed them.

translation.text: Even from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.

verses.english:
[everything] from Mount Halak, which ascends to Seir, all the way
to Baal-gad in the Valley of the Lebanon at the foot of Mount
Hermon; and he captured all the kings there and executed them.

verses.hebrew: יָמִים רַבִּים עָשָׂה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה מִלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: יָמִים רַבִּים עָשָׂה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה מִלְחָמָה׃

english.text: Joshua waged war with all those kings over a long period.

translation.text: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

verses.english: Joshua waged war with all those kings over a long period.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־הָיְתָה עִיר אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלִימָה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּלְתִּי הַחִוִּי יֹשְׁבֵי גִבְעוֹן אֶת־הַכֹּל לָקְחוּ בַמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: לֹא־הָיְתָה עִיר אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלִימָה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּלְתִּי הַחִוִּי יֹשְׁבֵי גִבְעוֹן אֶת־הַכֹּל לָקְחוּ בַמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
Apart from the Hivites who dwelt in Gibeon, not a single city made
terms with the Israelites; all were taken in battle.

translation.text: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.

verses.english:
Apart from the Hivites who dwelt in Gibeon, not a single city made
terms with the Israelites; all were taken in battle.

verses.hebrew:
כִּי מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה לְחַזֵּק אֶת־לִבָּם לִקְרַאת הַמִּלְחָמָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמַעַן הַחֲרִימָם לְבִלְתִּי הֱיוֹת־לָהֶם תְּחִנָּה כִּי לְמַעַן הַשְׁמִידָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה
יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה לְחַזֵּק אֶת־לִבָּם לִקְרַאת הַמִּלְחָמָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמַעַן הַחֲרִימָם לְבִלְתִּי הֱיוֹת־לָהֶם תְּחִנָּה כִּי לְמַעַן הַשְׁמִידָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה
יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
For it was YHWH’s doing to stiffen their hearts to give battle to
Israel, in order that they might be proscribed without quarter and
wiped out, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

translation.text: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
For it was YHWH’s doing to stiffen their hearts to give battle to
Israel, in order that they might be proscribed without quarter and
wiped out, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בָּעֵת הַהִיא וַיַּכְרֵת אֶת־הָעֲנָקִים מִן־הָהָר מִן־חֶבְרוֹן מִן־דְּבִר מִן־עֲנָב וּמִכֹּל הַר יְהוּדָה וּמִכֹּל הַר יִשְׂרָאֵל עִם־עָרֵיהֶם הֶחֱרִימָם
יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בָּעֵת הַהִיא וַיַּכְרֵת אֶת־הָעֲנָקִים מִן־הָהָר מִן־חֶבְרוֹן מִן־דְּבִר מִן־עֲנָב וּמִכֹּל הַר יְהוּדָה וּמִכֹּל הַר יִשְׂרָאֵל עִם־עָרֵיהֶם הֶחֱרִימָם
יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃

english.text:
At that time, Joshua went and wiped out the Anakites from the hill
country, from Hebron, Debir, and Anab, from the entire hill
country of Judah, and from the entire hill country of Israel;
Joshua proscribed them and their towns.

translation.text: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.

verses.english:
At that time, Joshua went and wiped out the Anakites from the hill
country, from Hebron, Debir, and Anab, from the entire hill
country of Judah, and from the entire hill country of Israel;
Joshua proscribed them and their towns.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־נוֹתַר עֲנָקִים בְּאֶרֶץ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק בְּעַזָּה בְּגַת וּבְאַשְׁדּוֹד נִשְׁאָרוּ׃

hebrew.text: לֹא־נוֹתַר עֲנָקִים בְּאֶרֶץ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק בְּעַזָּה בְּגַת וּבְאַשְׁדּוֹד נִשְׁאָרוּ׃

english.text:
No Anakites remained in the land of the Israelites; but some
remained in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.

translation.text: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.

verses.english:
No Anakites remained in the land of the Israelites; but some
remained in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וַיִּתְּנָהּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְנַחֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָם לְשִׁבְטֵיהֶם וְהָאָרֶץ שָׁקְטָה
מִמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וַיִּתְּנָהּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְנַחֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָם לְשִׁבְטֵיהֶם וְהָאָרֶץ שָׁקְטָה
מִמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
Thus Joshua conquered the whole country, just as YHWH had promised
Moses; and Joshua assigned it to Israel to share according to
their tribal divisions. And the land had rest from war.

translation.text: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.

verses.english:
Thus Joshua conquered the whole country, just as YHWH had promised
Moses; and Joshua assigned it to Israel to share according to
their tribal divisions. And the land had rest from war.

verses.hebrew:
וְאֵלֶּה מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִכּוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּרְשׁוּ אֶת־אַרְצָם בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרְחָה הַשָּׁמֶשׁ מִנַּחַל אַרְנוֹן עַד־הַר חֶרְמוֹן וְכל־הָעֲרָבָה
מִזְרָחָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֵלֶּה מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִכּוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּרְשׁוּ אֶת־אַרְצָם בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרְחָה הַשָּׁמֶשׁ מִנַּחַל אַרְנוֹן עַד־הַר חֶרְמוֹן וְכל־הָעֲרָבָה
מִזְרָחָה׃

english.text:
The following are the local kings whom the Israelites defeated and
whose territories they took possession of: East of the Jordan,
from the Wadi Arnon to Mount Hermon, including the eastern half of
the Arabah:

translation.text: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:

verses.english:
The following are the local kings whom the Israelites defeated and
whose territories they took possession of: East of the Jordan,
from the Wadi Arnon to Mount Hermon, including the eastern half of
the Arabah:

verses.hebrew:
סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן מֹשֵׁל מֵעֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־נַחַל אַרְנוֹן וְתוֹךְ הַנַּחַל וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד וְעַד יַבֹּק הַנַּחַל גְּבוּל בְּנֵי
עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן מֹשֵׁל מֵעֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־נַחַל אַרְנוֹן וְתוֹךְ הַנַּחַל וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד וְעַד יַבֹּק הַנַּחַל גְּבוּל בְּנֵי
עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
King Sihon of the Amorites, who resided in Heshbon and ruled over
part of Gilead—from Aroer on the bank of the Wadi Arnon and the
wadi proper up to the Wadi Jabbok [and] the border of the
Ammonites—

translation.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

verses.english:
King Sihon of the Amorites, who resided in Heshbon and ruled over
part of Gilead—from Aroer on the bank of the Wadi Arnon and the
wadi proper up to the Wadi Jabbok [and] the border of the
Ammonites—

verses.hebrew: וְהָעֲרָבָה עַד־יָם כִּנְרוֹת מִזְרָחָה וְעַד יָם הָעֲרָבָה יָם־הַמֶּלַח מִזְרָחָה דֶּרֶךְ בֵּית הַיְשִׁמוֹת וּמִתֵּימָן תַּחַת אַשְׁדּוֹת הַפִּסְגָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעֲרָבָה עַד־יָם כִּנְרוֹת מִזְרָחָה וְעַד יָם הָעֲרָבָה יָם־הַמֶּלַח מִזְרָחָה דֶּרֶךְ בֵּית הַיְשִׁמוֹת וּמִתֵּימָן תַּחַת אַשְׁדּוֹת הַפִּסְגָּה׃

english.text:
and over the eastern Arabah up to the Sea of Chinnereth and,
southward by way of Beth-jeshimoth at the foot of the slopes of
Pisgah on the east, down to the Sea of the Arabah, that is, the
Dead Sea.

translation.text: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Bethjeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdothpisgah:

verses.english:
and over the eastern Arabah up to the Sea of Chinnereth and,
southward by way of Beth-jeshimoth at the foot of the slopes of
Pisgah on the east, down to the Sea of the Arabah, that is, the
Dead Sea.

verses.hebrew: וּגְבוּל עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן מִיֶּתֶר הָרְפָאִים הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶעִי׃

hebrew.text: וּגְבוּל עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן מִיֶּתֶר הָרְפָאִים הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶעִי׃

english.text:
Also the territory of King Og of Bashan—one of the last of the
Rephaim—who resided in Ashtaroth and in Edrei

translation.text: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

verses.english:
Also the territory of King Og of Bashan—one of the last of the
Rephaim—who resided in Ashtaroth and in Edrei

verses.hebrew: וּמֹשֵׁל בְּהַר חֶרְמוֹן וּבְסַלְכָה וּבְכל־הַבָּשָׁן עַד־גְּבוּל הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְהַמַּעֲכָתִי וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד גְּבוּל סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ־חֶשְׁבּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וּמֹשֵׁל בְּהַר חֶרְמוֹן וּבְסַלְכָה וּבְכל־הַבָּשָׁן עַד־גְּבוּל הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְהַמַּעֲכָתִי וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד גְּבוּל סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ־חֶשְׁבּוֹן׃

english.text:
and ruled over Mount Hermon, Salcah, and all of Bashan up to the
border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, as also over part of
Gilead [down to] the border of King Sihon of Heshbon.

translation.text: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

verses.english:
and ruled over Mount Hermon, Salcah, and all of Bashan up to the
border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, as also over part of
Gilead [down to] the border of King Sihon of Heshbon.

verses.hebrew: מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִכּוּם וַיִּתְּנָהּ מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה יְרֻשָּׁה לָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה׃

hebrew.text: מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִכּוּם וַיִּתְּנָהּ מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה יְרֻשָּׁה לָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה׃

english.text:
These were vanquished by Moses, the servant of YHWH, and the
Israelites; and Moses, the servant of YHWH, assigned that
territory as a possession to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the
half-tribe of Manasseh.

translation.text: Them did Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.

verses.english:
These were vanquished by Moses, the servant of YHWH, and the
Israelites; and Moses, the servant of YHWH, assigned that
territory as a possession to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the
half-tribe of Manasseh.

וְאֵלֶּה מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן יָמָּה מִבַּעַל גָּד בְּבִקְעַת הַלְּבָנוֹן וְעַד־הָהָר הֶחָלָק הָעֹלֶה שֵׂעִירָה

And the following are the local kings whom Joshua and the
Israelites defeated on the west side of the Jordan—from Baal-gad
in the Valley of the Lebanon to Mount Halak, which ascends to
Seir—which Joshua assigned as a possession to the tribal divisions
of Israel:

translation.text: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

verses.english:

slopes, in the wilderness, and in the Negeb—[in the land of] the
Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the
Hivites, and the Jebusites.

translation.text: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:

hebrew.text: כּל־מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר־מָלַךְ בְּעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶעִי הוּא נִשְׁאַר מִיֶּתֶר הָרְפָאִים וַיַּכֵּם מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּרִשֵׁם׃

translation.text: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא הוֹרִישׁוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְאֶת־הַמַּעֲכָתִי וַיֵּשֶׁב גְּשׁוּר וּמַעֲכָת בְּקֶרֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא הוֹרִישׁוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְאֶת־הַמַּעֲכָתִי וַיֵּשֶׁב גְּשׁוּר וּמַעֲכָת בְּקֶרֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
but the Israelites failed to dispossess the Geshurites and the
Maacathites, and Geshur and Maacath remain among Israel to this
day.

translation.text: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.

verses.english:
but the Israelites failed to dispossess the Geshurites and the
Maacathites, and Geshur and Maacath remain among Israel to this
day.

verses.hebrew: רַק לְשֵׁבֶט הַלֵּוִי לֹא נָתַן נַחֲלָה אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא נַחֲלָתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר־לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: רַק לְשֵׁבֶט הַלֵּוִי לֹא נָתַן נַחֲלָה אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא נַחֲלָתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר־לוֹ׃

english.text:
No hereditary portion, however, was assigned to the tribe of Levi,
their portion being the fire offerings of YHWH, the God of Israel,
as He spoke concerning them.

translation.text: Only unto the tribes of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.

verses.english:
No hereditary portion, however, was assigned to the tribe of Levi,
their portion being the fire offerings of YHWH, the God of Israel,
as He spoke concerning them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

english.text:
And so Moses assigned [the following] to the tribe of the
Reubenites, for their various clans,

translation.text: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.

verses.english:
And so Moses assigned [the following] to the tribe of the
Reubenites, for their various clans,

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לָהֶם הַגְּבוּל מֵעֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־נַחַל אַרְנוֹן וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹךְ־הַנַּחַל וְכל־הַמִּישֹׁר עַל־מֵידְבָא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לָהֶם הַגְּבוּל מֵעֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־נַחַל אַרְנוֹן וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹךְ־הַנַּחַל וְכל־הַמִּישֹׁר עַל־מֵידְבָא׃

english.text:
and it became theirs: The territory from Aroer, on the edge of the
Wadi Arnon and the town in the middle of the wadi, up to Medeba—
the entire Tableland—

translation.text: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;

verses.english:
and it became theirs: The territory from Aroer, on the edge of the
Wadi Arnon and the town in the middle of the wadi, up to Medeba—
the entire Tableland—

verses.hebrew: חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְכל־עָרֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר בַּמִּישֹׁר דִּיבֹן וּבָמוֹת בַּעַל וּבֵית בַּעַל מְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְכל־עָרֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר בַּמִּישֹׁר דִּיבֹן וּבָמוֹת בַּעַל וּבֵית בַּעַל מְעוֹן׃

english.text:
Heshbon and all its towns in the Tableland: Dibon, Bamoth-baal,
Beth-baal-meon,

translation.text: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamothbaal, and Bethbaalmeon,

verses.english:
Heshbon and all its towns in the Tableland: Dibon, Bamoth-baal,
Beth-baal-meon,

verses.hebrew: וְיַהְצָה וּקְדֵמֹת וּמֵפָעַת׃

hebrew.text: וְיַהְצָה וּקְדֵמֹת וּמֵפָעַת׃

english.text: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

translation.text: And Jahaza, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,

verses.english: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

verses.hebrew: וְקִרְיָתַיִם וְשִׂבְמָה וְצֶרֶת הַשַּׁחַר בְּהַר הָעֵמֶק׃

hebrew.text: וְקִרְיָתַיִם וְשִׂבְמָה וְצֶרֶת הַשַּׁחַר בְּהַר הָעֵמֶק׃

english.text: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, and Zereth-shahar in the hill of the valley,

translation.text: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zarethshahar in the mount of the valley,

verses.english: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, and Zereth-shahar in the hill of the valley,

verses.hebrew: וּבֵית פְּעוֹר וְאַשְׁדּוֹת הַפִּסְגָּה וּבֵית הַיְשִׁמוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּבֵית פְּעוֹר וְאַשְׁדּוֹת הַפִּסְגָּה וּבֵית הַיְשִׁמוֹת׃

english.text: Beth-peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth—

translation.text: And Bethpeor, and Ashdothpisgah, and Bethjeshimoth,

verses.english: Beth-peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth—

verses.hebrew:
וְכֹל עָרֵי הַמִּישֹׁר וְכל־מַמְלְכוּת סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה מֹשֶׁה אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־נְשִׂיאֵי מִדְיָן אֶת־אֱוִי וְאֶת־רֶקֶם וְאֶת־צוּר
וְאֶת־חוּר וְאֶת־רֶבַע נְסִיכֵי סִיחוֹן יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text:
וְכֹל עָרֵי הַמִּישֹׁר וְכל־מַמְלְכוּת סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה מֹשֶׁה אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־נְשִׂיאֵי מִדְיָן אֶת־אֱוִי וְאֶת־רֶקֶם וְאֶת־צוּר
וְאֶת־חוּר וְאֶת־רֶבַע נְסִיכֵי סִיחוֹן יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
all the towns of the Tableland and the entire kingdom of Sihon,
the king of the Amorites, who had reigned in Heshbon. (For Moses
defeated him and the Midianite chiefs Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and
Reba, who had dwelt in the land as princes of Sihon.

translation.text: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.

verses.english:
all the towns of the Tableland and the entire kingdom of Sihon,
the king of the Amorites, who had reigned in Heshbon. (For Moses
defeated him and the Midianite chiefs Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and
Reba, who had dwelt in the land as princes of Sihon.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בִּלְעָם בֶּן־בְּעוֹר הַקּוֹסֵם הָרְגוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּחֶרֶב אֶל־חַלְלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־בִּלְעָם בֶּן־בְּעוֹר הַקּוֹסֵם הָרְגוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּחֶרֶב אֶל־חַלְלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Together with the others that they slew, the Israelites put Balaam
son of Beor, the augur, to the sword.)

translation.text: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.

verses.english:
Together with the others that they slew, the Israelites put Balaam
son of Beor, the augur, to the sword.)

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְּבוּל בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן הַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבוּל זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי גְּבוּל בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן הַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבוּל זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
The boundary of the Reubenites was the edge of the Jordan. That
was the portion of the Reubenites for their various clans—those
towns with their villages.

translation.text: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.

verses.english:
The boundary of the Reubenites was the edge of the Jordan. That
was the portion of the Reubenites for their various clans—those
towns with their villages.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה לְמַטֵּה־גָד לִבְנֵי־גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה לְמַטֵּה־גָד לִבְנֵי־גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

english.text:
To the tribe of Gad, for the various Gadite clans, Moses assigned
[the following],

translation.text: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.

verses.english:
To the tribe of Gad, for the various Gadite clans, Moses assigned
[the following],

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לָהֶם הַגְּבוּל יַעְזֵר וְכל־עָרֵי הַגִּלְעָד וַחֲצִי אֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן עַד־עֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי רַבָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לָהֶם הַגְּבוּל יַעְזֵר וְכל־עָרֵי הַגִּלְעָד וַחֲצִי אֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן עַד־עֲרוֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי רַבָּה׃

english.text:
and it became their territory: Jazer, all the towns of Gilead,
part of the country of the Ammonites up to Aroer, which is close
to Rabbah,

translation.text: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;

verses.english:
and it became their territory: Jazer, all the towns of Gilead,
part of the country of the Ammonites up to Aroer, which is close
to Rabbah,

verses.hebrew: וּמֵחֶשְׁבּוֹן עַד־רָמַת הַמִּצְפֶּה וּבְטֹנִים וּמִמַּחֲנַיִם עַד־גְּבוּל לִדְבִר׃

hebrew.text: וּמֵחֶשְׁבּוֹן עַד־רָמַת הַמִּצְפֶּה וּבְטֹנִים וּמִמַּחֲנַיִם עַד־גְּבוּל לִדְבִר׃

english.text:
and from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim
to the border of Lidbir;

translation.text: And from Heshbon unto Ramathmizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;

verses.english:
and from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim
to the border of Lidbir;

verses.hebrew: וּבָעֵמֶק בֵּית הָרָם וּבֵית נִמְרָה וְסֻכּוֹת וְצָפוֹן יֶתֶר מַמְלְכוּת סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבֻל עַד־קְצֵה יָם־כִּנֶּרֶת עֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבָעֵמֶק בֵּית הָרָם וּבֵית נִמְרָה וְסֻכּוֹת וְצָפוֹן יֶתֶר מַמְלְכוּת סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן הַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבֻל עַד־קְצֵה יָם־כִּנֶּרֶת עֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה׃

english.text:
and in the Valley, Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, and
Zaphon—the rest of the kingdom of Sihon, the king of Heshbon—down
to the edge of the Jordan and up to the tip of the Sea of
Chinnereth on the east side of the Jordan.

translation.text: And in the valley, Betharam, and Bethnimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.

verses.english:
and in the Valley, Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, and
Zaphon—the rest of the kingdom of Sihon, the king of Heshbon—down
to the edge of the Jordan and up to the tip of the Sea of
Chinnereth on the east side of the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
That was the portion of the Gadites, for their various clans—those
towns with their villages.

translation.text: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.

verses.english:
That was the portion of the Gadites, for their various clans—those
towns with their villages.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה לַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁה וַיְהִי לַחֲצִי מַטֵּה בְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה לַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁה וַיְהִי לַחֲצִי מַטֵּה בְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם׃

english.text:
And to the half-tribe of Manasseh Moses assigned [the following],
so that it went to the half-tribe of Manasseh, for its various
clans,

translation.text: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.

verses.english:
And to the half-tribe of Manasseh Moses assigned [the following],
so that it went to the half-tribe of Manasseh, for its various
clans,

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְבוּלָם מִמַּחֲנַיִם כּל־הַבָּשָׁן כּל־מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁן וְכל־חַוֺּת יָאִיר אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּשָׁן שִׁשִּׁים עִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי גְבוּלָם מִמַּחֲנַיִם כּל־הַבָּשָׁן כּל־מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁן וְכל־חַוֺּת יָאִיר אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּשָׁן שִׁשִּׁים עִיר׃

translation.text: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:

verses.hebrew: וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד וְעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶדְרֶעִי עָרֵי מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן לִבְנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה לַחֲצִי בְנֵי־מָכִיר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד וְעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶדְרֶעִי עָרֵי מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן לִבְנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה לַחֲצִי בְנֵי־מָכִיר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם׃

english.text:
and part of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei, the royal cities of
Og in Bashan, were assigned to the descendants of Machir son of
Manasseh—to a part of the descendants of Machir—for their various
clans.

translation.text: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.

verses.english:
and part of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei, the royal cities of
Og in Bashan, were assigned to the descendants of Machir son of
Manasseh—to a part of the descendants of Machir—for their various
clans.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נִחַל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבוֹת מוֹאָב מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרִיחוֹ מִזְרָחָה׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נִחַל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבוֹת מוֹאָב מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרִיחוֹ מִזְרָחָה׃

english.text:
Those, then, were the portions that Moses assigned in the steppes
of Moab, on the east side of the Jordan.

translation.text: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.

verses.english:
Those, then, were the portions that Moses assigned in the steppes
of Moab, on the east side of the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וּלְשֵׁבֶט הַלֵּוִי לֹא־נָתַן מֹשֶׁה נַחֲלָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא נַחֲלָתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּלְשֵׁבֶט הַלֵּוִי לֹא־נָתַן מֹשֶׁה נַחֲלָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא נַחֲלָתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם׃

english.text:
But no portion was assigned by Moses to the tribe of Levi; YHWH,
the God of Israel, is their portion, as He spoke concerning them.

translation.text: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the LORD God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.

verses.english:
But no portion was assigned by Moses to the tribe of Levi; YHWH,
the God of Israel, is their portion, as He spoke concerning them.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נָחֲלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן אֲשֶׁר נִחֲלוּ אוֹתָם אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְרָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נָחֲלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן אֲשֶׁר נִחֲלוּ אוֹתָם אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְרָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And these are the allotments of the Israelites in the land of
Canaan, that were apportioned to them by the priest Eleazar, by
Joshua son of Nun, and by the heads of the ancestral houses of the
Israelite tribes,

translation.text: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.

verses.english:
And these are the allotments of the Israelites in the land of
Canaan, that were apportioned to them by the priest Eleazar, by
Joshua son of Nun, and by the heads of the ancestral houses of the
Israelite tribes,

verses.hebrew: בְּגוֹרַל נַחֲלָתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה לְתִשְׁעַת הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה׃

hebrew.text: בְּגוֹרַל נַחֲלָתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה לְתִשְׁעַת הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה׃

english.text:
the portions that fell to them by lot, as YHWH had commanded
through Moses for the nine and a half tribes.

translation.text: By lot was their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.

verses.english:
the portions that fell to them by lot, as YHWH had commanded
through Moses for the nine and a half tribes.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־נָתַן מֹשֶׁה נַחֲלַת שְׁנֵי הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וְלַלְוִיִּם לֹא־נָתַן נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹכָם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־נָתַן מֹשֶׁה נַחֲלַת שְׁנֵי הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וְלַלְוִיִּם לֹא־נָתַן נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹכָם׃

translation.text: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הָיוּ בְנֵי־יוֹסֵף שְׁנֵי מַטּוֹת מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרָיִם וְלֹא־נָתְנוּ חֵלֶק לַלְוִיִּם בָּאָרֶץ כִּי אִם־עָרִים לָשֶׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם לְמִקְנֵיהֶם וּלְקִנְיָנָם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־הָיוּ בְנֵי־יוֹסֵף שְׁנֵי מַטּוֹת מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרָיִם וְלֹא־נָתְנוּ חֵלֶק לַלְוִיִּם בָּאָרֶץ כִּי אִם־עָרִים לָשֶׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם לְמִקְנֵיהֶם וּלְקִנְיָנָם׃

english.text:
for whereas the descendants of Joseph constituted two tribes,
Manasseh and Ephraim, the Levites were assigned no share in the
land, but only some towns to live in, with the pastures for their
livestock and cattle.

translation.text: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.

verses.english:
for whereas the descendants of Joseph constituted two tribes,
Manasseh and Ephraim, the Levites were assigned no share in the
land, but only some towns to live in, with the pastures for their
livestock and cattle.

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחְלְקוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחְלְקוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Just as YHWH had commanded Moses, so the Israelites did when they
apportioned the land.

translation.text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.

verses.english:
Just as YHWH had commanded Moses, so the Israelites did when they
apportioned the land.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּגְּשׁוּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּגִּלְגָּל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כָּלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה הַקְּנִזִּי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה
אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים עַל אֹדוֹתַי וְעַל אֹדוֹתֶיךָ בְּקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּגְּשׁוּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּגִּלְגָּל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כָּלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה הַקְּנִזִּי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה
אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים עַל אֹדוֹתַי וְעַל אֹדוֹתֶיךָ בְּקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ׃

english.text:
The Judites approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of
Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him: “You know what instructions
YHWH gave at Kadesh-barnea to Moses, the man of God, concerning
you and me.

translation.text: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadeshbarnea.

verses.english:
The Judites approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of
Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him: “You know what instructions
YHWH gave at Kadesh-barnea to Moses, the man of God, concerning
you and me.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אָנֹכִי בִּשְׁלֹחַ מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה אֹתִי מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ לְרַגֵּל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וָאָשֵׁב אֹתוֹ דָּבָר כַּאֲשֶׁר עִם־לְבָבִי׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אָנֹכִי בִּשְׁלֹחַ מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה אֹתִי מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ לְרַגֵּל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וָאָשֵׁב אֹתוֹ דָּבָר כַּאֲשֶׁר עִם־לְבָבִי׃

english.text:
I was forty years old when Moses the servant of YHWH sent me from
Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land, and I gave him a forthright
report.

translation.text: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadeshbarnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.

verses.english:
I was forty years old when Moses the servant of YHWH sent me from
Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land, and I gave him a forthright
report.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחַי אֲשֶׁר עָלוּ עִמִּי הִמְסִיו אֶת־לֵב הָעָם וְאָנֹכִי מִלֵּאתִי אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחַי אֲשֶׁר עָלוּ עִמִּי הִמְסִיו אֶת־לֵב הָעָם וְאָנֹכִי מִלֵּאתִי אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי׃

english.text:
While my companions who went up with me took the heart out of the
people, I was loyal to YHWH my God.

translation.text: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the LORD my God.

verses.english:
While my companions who went up with me took the heart out of the
people, I was loyal to YHWH my God.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׁבַע מֹשֶׁה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר אִם־לֹא הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר דָּרְכָה רַגְלְךָ בָּהּ לְךָ תִהְיֶה לְנַחֲלָה וּלְבָנֶיךָ עַד־עוֹלָם כִּי מִלֵּאתָ אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׁבַע מֹשֶׁה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר אִם־לֹא הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר דָּרְכָה רַגְלְךָ בָּהּ לְךָ תִהְיֶה לְנַחֲלָה וּלְבָנֶיךָ עַד־עוֹלָם כִּי מִלֵּאתָ אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי׃

english.text:
On that day, Moses promised on oath, ‘The land on which your foot
trod shall be a portion for you and your descendants forever,
because you were loyal to YHWH my God.’

translation.text: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children’s for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God.

verses.english:
On that day, Moses promised on oath, ‘The land on which your foot
trod shall be a portion for you and your descendants forever,
because you were loyal to YHWH my God.’

verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הֶחֱיָה יְהֹוָה אוֹתִי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר זֶה אַרְבָּעִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה מֵאָז דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר
וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם בֶּן־חָמֵשׁ וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הֶחֱיָה יְהֹוָה אוֹתִי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר זֶה אַרְבָּעִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה מֵאָז דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר
וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם בֶּן־חָמֵשׁ וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
Now YHWH has preserved me, as He promised. It is forty-five years
since YHWH made this promise to Moses, when Israel was journeying
through the wilderness; and here I am today, eighty-five years
old.

translation.text: And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.

verses.english:
Now YHWH has preserved me, as He promised. It is forty-five years
since YHWH made this promise to Moses, when Israel was journeying
through the wilderness; and here I am today, eighty-five years
old.

verses.hebrew: עוֹדֶנִּי הַיּוֹם חָזָק כַּאֲשֶׁר בְּיוֹם שְׁלֹחַ אוֹתִי מֹשֶׁה כְּכֹחִי אָז וּכְכֹחִי עָתָּה לַמִּלְחָמָה וְלָצֵאת וְלָבוֹא׃

hebrew.text: עוֹדֶנִּי הַיּוֹם חָזָק כַּאֲשֶׁר בְּיוֹם שְׁלֹחַ אוֹתִי מֹשֶׁה כְּכֹחִי אָז וּכְכֹחִי עָתָּה לַמִּלְחָמָה וְלָצֵאת וְלָבוֹא׃

english.text:
I am still as strong today as on the day that Moses sent me; my
strength is the same now as it was then, for battle and for
activity.

translation.text: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.

verses.english:
I am still as strong today as on the day that Moses sent me; my
strength is the same now as it was then, for battle and for
activity.

verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה תְּנָה־לִּי אֶת־הָהָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי אַתָּה־שָׁמַעְתָּ בַיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי־עֲנָקִים שָׁם וְעָרִים גְּדֹלוֹת בְּצֻרוֹת אוּלַי יְהֹוָה
אוֹתִי וְהוֹרַשְׁתִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה תְּנָה־לִּי אֶת־הָהָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי אַתָּה־שָׁמַעְתָּ בַיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי־עֲנָקִים שָׁם וְעָרִים גְּדֹלוֹת בְּצֻרוֹת אוּלַי יְהֹוָה
אוֹתִי וְהוֹרַשְׁתִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
So assign to me this hill country as YHWH promised on that day.
Though you too heard on that day that Anakites are there and great
fortified cities, if only YHWH is with me, I will dispossess them,
as YHWH promised.”

translation.text: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.

verses.english:
So assign to me this hill country as YHWH promised on that day.
Though you too heard on that day that Anakites are there and great
fortified cities, if only YHWH is with me, I will dispossess them,
as YHWH promised.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־חֶבְרוֹן לְכָלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה לְנַחֲלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־חֶבְרוֹן לְכָלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה לְנַחֲלָה׃

english.text:
So Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and assigned Hebron to
him as his portion.

translation.text: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.

verses.english:
So Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and assigned Hebron to
him as his portion.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן הָיְתָה־חֶבְרוֹן לְכָלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה הַקְּנִזִּי לְנַחֲלָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּא אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: עַל־כֵּן הָיְתָה־חֶבְרוֹן לְכָלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה הַקְּנִזִּי לְנַחֲלָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּא אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Thus Hebron became the portion of Caleb son of Jephunneh the
Kenizzite, as it still is, because he was loyal to YHWH, the God
of Israel.—

translation.text: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.

verses.english:
Thus Hebron became the portion of Caleb son of Jephunneh the
Kenizzite, as it still is, because he was loyal to YHWH, the God
of Israel.—

verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם חֶבְרוֹן לְפָנִים קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הָאָדָם הַגָּדוֹל בָּעֲנָקִים הוּא וְהָאָרֶץ שָׁקְטָה מִמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁם חֶבְרוֹן לְפָנִים קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הָאָדָם הַגָּדוֹל בָּעֲנָקִים הוּא וְהָאָרֶץ שָׁקְטָה מִמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
The name of Hebron was formerly Kiriath-arba: [Arba] was the great
man among the Anakites. And the land had rest from war.

translation.text: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.

verses.english:
The name of Hebron was formerly Kiriath-arba: [Arba] was the great
man among the Anakites. And the land had rest from war.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַגּוֹרָל לְמַטֵּה בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם אֶל־גְּבוּל אֱדוֹם מִדְבַּר־צִן נֶגְבָּה מִקְצֵה תֵימָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הַגּוֹרָל לְמַטֵּה בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם אֶל־גְּבוּל אֱדוֹם מִדְבַּר־צִן נֶגְבָּה מִקְצֵה תֵימָן׃

english.text:
The portion that fell by lot to the various clans of the tribe of
Judah lay farthest south, down to the border of Edom, which is the
Wilderness of Zin.

translation.text: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.

verses.english:
The portion that fell by lot to the various clans of the tribe of
Judah lay farthest south, down to the border of Edom, which is the
Wilderness of Zin.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לָהֶם גְּבוּל נֶגֶב מִקְצֵה יָם הַמֶּלַח מִן־הַלָּשֹׁן הַפֹּנֶה נֶגְבָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לָהֶם גְּבוּל נֶגֶב מִקְצֵה יָם הַמֶּלַח מִן־הַלָּשֹׁן הַפֹּנֶה נֶגְבָּה׃

english.text:
Their southern boundary began from the tip of the Dead Sea, from
the tongue that projects southward.

translation.text: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:

verses.english:
Their southern boundary began from the tip of the Dead Sea, from
the tongue that projects southward.

verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא אֶל־מִנֶּגֶב לְמַעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים וְעָבַר צִנָה וְעָלָה מִנֶּגֶב לְקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ וְעָבַר חֶצְרוֹן וְעָלָה אַדָּרָה וְנָסַב הַקַּרְקָעָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצָא אֶל־מִנֶּגֶב לְמַעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים וְעָבַר צִנָה וְעָלָה מִנֶּגֶב לְקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ וְעָבַר חֶצְרוֹן וְעָלָה אַדָּרָה וְנָסַב הַקַּרְקָעָה׃

english.text:
It proceeded to the south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, passed on to
Zin, ascended to the south of Kadesh-barnea, passed on to Hezron,
ascended to Addar, and made a turn to Karka.

translation.text: And it went out to the south side to Maalehacrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadeshbarnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:

verses.english:
It proceeded to the south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, passed on to
Zin, ascended to the south of Kadesh-barnea, passed on to Hezron,
ascended to Addar, and made a turn to Karka.

verses.hebrew: וְעָבַר עַצְמוֹנָה וְיָצָא נַחַל מִצְרַיִם (והיה) [וְהָיוּ] תֹּצְאוֹת הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה זֶה־יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל נֶגֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְעָבַר עַצְמוֹנָה וְיָצָא נַחַל מִצְרַיִם (והיה) [וְהָיוּ] תֹּצְאוֹת הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה זֶה־יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל נֶגֶב׃

english.text:
From there it passed on to Azmon and proceeded to the Wadi of
Egypt; and the boundary ran on to the Sea. That shall be your
southern boundary.

translation.text: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.

verses.english:
From there it passed on to Azmon and proceeded to the Wadi of
Egypt; and the boundary ran on to the Sea. That shall be your
southern boundary.

verses.hebrew: וּגְבוּל קֵדְמָה יָם הַמֶּלַח עַד־קְצֵה הַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבוּל לִפְאַת צָפוֹנָה מִלְּשׁוֹן הַיָּם מִקְצֵה הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וּגְבוּל קֵדְמָה יָם הַמֶּלַח עַד־קְצֵה הַיַּרְדֵּן וּגְבוּל לִפְאַת צָפוֹנָה מִלְּשׁוֹן הַיָּם מִקְצֵה הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
The boundary on the east was the Dead Sea up to the mouth of the
Jordan. On the northern side, the boundary began at the tongue of
the Sea at the mouth of the Jordan.

translation.text: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan.

verses.english:
The boundary on the east was the Dead Sea up to the mouth of the
Jordan. On the northern side, the boundary began at the tongue of
the Sea at the mouth of the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל בֵּית חגְלָה וְעָבַר מִצְּפוֹן לְבֵית הָעֲרָבָה וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל אֶבֶן בֹּהַן בֶּן־רְאוּבֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל בֵּית חגְלָה וְעָבַר מִצְּפוֹן לְבֵית הָעֲרָבָה וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל אֶבֶן בֹּהַן בֶּן־רְאוּבֵן׃

english.text:
The boundary ascended to Beth-hoglah and passed north of
Beth-arabah; then the boundary ascended to the Stone of Bohan son
of Reuben.

verses.english:
The boundary ascended to Beth-hoglah and passed north of
Beth-arabah; then the boundary ascended to the Stone of Bohan son
of Reuben.

verses.hebrew:
וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל דְּבִרָה מֵעֵמֶק עָכוֹר וְצָפוֹנָה פֹּנֶה אֶל־הַגִּלְגָּל אֲשֶׁר־נֹכַח לְמַעֲלֵה אֲדֻמִּים אֲשֶׁר מִנֶּגֶב לַנָּחַל וְעָבַר הַגְּבוּל אֶל־מֵי־עֵין שֶׁמֶשׁ וְהָיוּ
תֹצְאֹתָיו אֶל־עֵין רֹגֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל דְּבִרָה מֵעֵמֶק עָכוֹר וְצָפוֹנָה פֹּנֶה אֶל־הַגִּלְגָּל אֲשֶׁר־נֹכַח לְמַעֲלֵה אֲדֻמִּים אֲשֶׁר מִנֶּגֶב לַנָּחַל וְעָבַר הַגְּבוּל אֶל־מֵי־עֵין שֶׁמֶשׁ וְהָיוּ
תֹצְאֹתָיו אֶל־עֵין רֹגֵל׃

english.text:
The boundary ascended from the Valley of Achor to Debir and turned
north to Gilgal, facing the Ascent of Adummim which is south of
the wadi; from there the boundary continued to the waters of
En-shemesh and ran on to En-rogel.

verses.english:
The boundary ascended from the Valley of Achor to Debir and turned
north to Gilgal, facing the Ascent of Adummim which is south of
the wadi; from there the boundary continued to the waters of
En-shemesh and ran on to En-rogel.

verses.hebrew:
וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל גֵּי בֶן־הִנֹּם אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַיְבוּסִי מִנֶּגֶב הִיא יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל אֶל־רֹאשׁ הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי גֵי־הִנֹּם יָמָּה אֲשֶׁר בִּקְצֵה
עֵמֶק־רְפָאִים צָפוֹנָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל גֵּי בֶן־הִנֹּם אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַיְבוּסִי מִנֶּגֶב הִיא יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל אֶל־רֹאשׁ הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי גֵי־הִנֹּם יָמָּה אֲשֶׁר בִּקְצֵה
עֵמֶק־רְפָאִים צָפוֹנָה׃

english.text:
Then the boundary ascended into the Valley of Ben-hinnom, along
the southern flank of the Jebusites—that is, Jerusalem. The
boundary then ran up to the top of the hill which flanks the
Valley of Hinnom on the west, at the northern end of the Valley of
Rephaim.

verses.english:
Then the boundary ascended into the Valley of Ben-hinnom, along
the southern flank of the Jebusites—that is, Jerusalem. The
boundary then ran up to the top of the hill which flanks the
Valley of Hinnom on the west, at the northern end of the Valley of
Rephaim.

verses.hebrew: וְתָאַר הַגְּבוּל מֵרֹאשׁ הָהָר אֶל־מַעְיַן מֵי נֶפְתּוֹחַ וְיָצָא אֶל־עָרֵי הַר־עֶפְרוֹן וְתָאַר הַגְּבוּל בַּעֲלָה הִיא קִרְיַת יְעָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וְתָאַר הַגְּבוּל מֵרֹאשׁ הָהָר אֶל־מַעְיַן מֵי נֶפְתּוֹחַ וְיָצָא אֶל־עָרֵי הַר־עֶפְרוֹן וְתָאַר הַגְּבוּל בַּעֲלָה הִיא קִרְיַת יְעָרִים׃

english.text:
From that hilltop the boundary curved to the fountain of the
Waters of Nephtoah and ran on to the towns of Mount Ephron; then
the boundary curved to Baalah—that is, Kiriath-jearim.

translation.text: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjathjearim:

verses.english:
From that hilltop the boundary curved to the fountain of the
Waters of Nephtoah and ran on to the towns of Mount Ephron; then
the boundary curved to Baalah—that is, Kiriath-jearim.

verses.hebrew: וְנָסַב הַגְּבוּל מִבַּעֲלָה יָמָּה אֶל־הַר שֵׂעִיר וְעָבַר אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַר־יְעָרִים מִצָּפוֹנָה הִיא כְסָלוֹן וְיָרַד בֵּית־שֶׁמֶשׁ וְעָבַר תִּמְנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנָסַב הַגְּבוּל מִבַּעֲלָה יָמָּה אֶל־הַר שֵׂעִיר וְעָבַר אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַר־יְעָרִים מִצָּפוֹנָה הִיא כְסָלוֹן וְיָרַד בֵּית־שֶׁמֶשׁ וְעָבַר תִּמְנָה׃

english.text:
From Baalah the boundary turned westward to Mount Seir, passed
north of the slope of Mount Jearim—that is, Chesalon—descended to
Beth-shemesh, and passed on to Timnah.

translation.text: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Bethshemesh, and passed on to Timnah:

verses.english:
From Baalah the boundary turned westward to Mount Seir, passed
north of the slope of Mount Jearim—that is, Chesalon—descended to
Beth-shemesh, and passed on to Timnah.

verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא הַגְּבוּל אֶל־כֶּתֶף עֶקְרוֹן צָפוֹנָה וְתָאַר הַגְּבוּל שִׁכְּרוֹנָה וְעָבַר הַר־הַבַּעֲלָה וְיָצָא יַבְנְאֵל וְהָיוּ תֹּצְאוֹת הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצָא הַגְּבוּל אֶל־כֶּתֶף עֶקְרוֹן צָפוֹנָה וְתָאַר הַגְּבוּל שִׁכְּרוֹנָה וְעָבַר הַר־הַבַּעֲלָה וְיָצָא יַבְנְאֵל וְהָיוּ תֹּצְאוֹת הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה׃

english.text:
The boundary then proceeded to the northern flank of Ekron; the
boundary curved to Shikkeron, passed on to Mount Baalah, and
proceeded to Jabneel; and the boundary ran on to the Sea.

translation.text: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

verses.english:
The boundary then proceeded to the northern flank of Ekron; the
boundary curved to Shikkeron, passed on to Mount Baalah, and
proceeded to Jabneel; and the boundary ran on to the Sea.

and Lower Gulloth.
