The boundary of their portion ran from Atroth-addar on the east to
Upper Beth-horon,

verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא הַגְּבוּל הַיָּמָּה הַמִּכְמְתָת מִצָּפוֹן וְנָסַב הַגְּבוּל מִזְרָחָה תַּאֲנַת שִׁלֹה וְעָבַר אוֹתוֹ מִמִּזְרַח יָנוֹחָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצָא הַגְּבוּל הַיָּמָּה הַמִּכְמְתָת מִצָּפוֹן וְנָסַב הַגְּבוּל מִזְרָחָה תַּאֲנַת שִׁלֹה וְעָבַר אוֹתוֹ מִמִּזְרַח יָנוֹחָה׃

translation.text: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanathshiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;

verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד מִיָּנוֹחָה עֲטָרוֹת וְנַעֲרָתָה וּפָגַע בִּירִיחוֹ וְיָצָא הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וְיָרַד מִיָּנוֹחָה עֲטָרוֹת וְנַעֲרָתָה וּפָגַע בִּירִיחוֹ וְיָצָא הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
from Janoah it descended to Ataroth and Naarath, touched on
Jericho, and ran on to the Jordan.

translation.text: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.

verses.english:
from Janoah it descended to Ataroth and Naarath, touched on
Jericho, and ran on to the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: מִתַּפּוּחַ יֵלֵךְ הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה נַחַל קָנָה וְהָיוּ תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: מִתַּפּוּחַ יֵלֵךְ הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה נַחַל קָנָה וְהָיוּ תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

english.text:
Westward, the boundary proceeded from Tappuah to the Wadi Kanah
and ran on to the Sea. This was the portion of the tribe of the
Ephraimites, by their clans,

translation.text: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.

verses.english:
Westward, the boundary proceeded from Tappuah to the Wadi Kanah
and ran on to the Sea. This was the portion of the tribe of the
Ephraimites, by their clans,

verses.hebrew: וְהֶעָרִים הַמִּבְדָּלוֹת לִבְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם בְּתוֹךְ נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה כּל־הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶעָרִים הַמִּבְדָּלוֹת לִבְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם בְּתוֹךְ נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה כּל־הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
together with the towns marked off for the Ephraimites within the
territory of the Manassites—all those towns with their villages.

translation.text: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

verses.english:
together with the towns marked off for the Ephraimites within the
territory of the Manassites—all those towns with their villages.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא הוֹרִישׁוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּגָזֶר וַיֵּשֶׁב הַכְּנַעֲנִי בְּקֶרֶב אֶפְרַיִם עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיְהִי לְמַס־עֹבֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא הוֹרִישׁוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּגָזֶר וַיֵּשֶׁב הַכְּנַעֲנִי בְּקֶרֶב אֶפְרַיִם עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיְהִי לְמַס־עֹבֵד׃

english.text:
However, they failed to dispossess the Canaanites who dwelt in
Gezer; so the Canaanites remained in the midst of Ephraim, as is
still the case. But they had to perform forced labor.

translation.text: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.

verses.english:
However, they failed to dispossess the Canaanites who dwelt in
Gezer; so the Canaanites remained in the midst of Ephraim, as is
still the case. But they had to perform forced labor.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַגּוֹרָל לְמַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה כִּי־הוּא בְּכוֹר יוֹסֵף לְמָכִיר בְּכוֹר מְנַשֶּׁה אֲבִי הַגִּלְעָד כִּי הוּא הָיָה אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה וַיְהִי־לוֹ הַגִּלְעָד וְהַבָּשָׁן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הַגּוֹרָל לְמַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה כִּי־הוּא בְּכוֹר יוֹסֵף לְמָכִיר בְּכוֹר מְנַשֶּׁה אֲבִי הַגִּלְעָד כִּי הוּא הָיָה אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה וַיְהִי־לוֹ הַגִּלְעָד וְהַבָּשָׁן׃

english.text:
And this is the portion that fell by lot to the tribe of
Manasseh—for he was Joseph’s first-born. Since Machir, the
first-born of Manasseh and the father of Gilead, was a valiant
warrior, Gilead and Bashan were assigned to him.

translation.text: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

verses.english:
And this is the portion that fell by lot to the tribe of
Manasseh—for he was Joseph’s first-born. Since Machir, the
first-born of Manasseh and the father of Gilead, was a valiant
warrior, Gilead and Bashan were assigned to him.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי לִבְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה הַנּוֹתָרִים לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִבְנֵי אֲבִיעֶזֶר וְלִבְנֵי־חֵלֶק וְלִבְנֵי אַשְׂרִיאֵל וְלִבְנֵי־שֶׁכֶם וְלִבְנֵי־חֵפֶר וְלִבְנֵי שְׁמִידָע אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי
מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן־יוֹסֵף הַזְּכָרִים לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי לִבְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה הַנּוֹתָרִים לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִבְנֵי אֲבִיעֶזֶר וְלִבְנֵי־חֵלֶק וְלִבְנֵי אַשְׂרִיאֵל וְלִבְנֵי־שֶׁכֶם וְלִבְנֵי־חֵפֶר וְלִבְנֵי שְׁמִידָע אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי
מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן־יוֹסֵף הַזְּכָרִים לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

english.text:
And now assignments were made to the remaining Manassites, by
their clans: the descendants of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem,
Hepher, and Shemida. Those were the male descendants of Manasseh
son of Joseph, by their clans.

translation.text: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.

verses.english:
And now assignments were made to the remaining Manassites, by
their clans: the descendants of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem,
Hepher, and Shemida. Those were the male descendants of Manasseh
son of Joseph, by their clans.

verses.hebrew: וְלִצְלפְחָד בֶּן־חֵפֶר בֶּן־גִּלְעָד בֶּן־מָכִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה לֹא־הָיוּ לוֹ בָּנִים כִּי אִם־בָּנוֹת וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֹתָיו מַחְלָה וְנֹעָה חגְלָה מִלְכָּה וְתִרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלִצְלפְחָד בֶּן־חֵפֶר בֶּן־גִּלְעָד בֶּן־מָכִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה לֹא־הָיוּ לוֹ בָּנִים כִּי אִם־בָּנוֹת וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֹתָיו מַחְלָה וְנֹעָה חגְלָה מִלְכָּה וְתִרְצָה׃

english.text:
Now Zelophehad son of Hepher son of Gilead son of Machir son of
Manasseh had no sons, but only daughters. The names of his
daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

translation.text: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.english:
Now Zelophehad son of Hepher son of Gilead son of Machir son of
Manasseh had no sons, but only daughters. The names of his
daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.hebrew:
וַתִּקְרַבְנָה לִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְלִפְנֵי הַנְּשִׂיאִים לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה צִוָּה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה לָתֶת־לָנוּ נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אַחֵינוּ וַיִּתֵּן
לָהֶם אֶל־פִּי יְהֹוָה נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵי אֲבִיהֶן׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּקְרַבְנָה לִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְלִפְנֵי הַנְּשִׂיאִים לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה צִוָּה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה לָתֶת־לָנוּ נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אַחֵינוּ וַיִּתֵּן
לָהֶם אֶל־פִּי יְהֹוָה נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵי אֲבִיהֶן׃

english.text:
They appeared before the priest Eleazar, Joshua son of Nun, and
the chieftains, saying: “YHWH commanded Moses to grant us a
portion among our male kinsmen.” So, in accordance with YHWH’s
instructions, they were granted a portion among their father’s
kinsmen.

translation.text: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.

verses.english:
They appeared before the priest Eleazar, Joshua son of Nun, and
the chieftains, saying: “YHWH commanded Moses to grant us a
portion among our male kinsmen.” So, in accordance with YHWH’s
instructions, they were granted a portion among their father’s
kinsmen.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְּלוּ חַבְלֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה עֲשָׂרָה לְבַד מֵאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד וְהַבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְּלוּ חַבְלֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה עֲשָׂרָה לְבַד מֵאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד וְהַבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
Ten districts fell to Manasseh, apart from the lands of Gilead and
Bashan, which are across the Jordan.

translation.text: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;

verses.english:
Ten districts fell to Manasseh, apart from the lands of Gilead and
Bashan, which are across the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: כִּי בְּנוֹת מְנַשֶּׁה נָחֲלוּ נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ בָּנָיו וְאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד הָיְתָה לִבְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה הַנּוֹתָרִים׃

hebrew.text: כִּי בְּנוֹת מְנַשֶּׁה נָחֲלוּ נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ בָּנָיו וְאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד הָיְתָה לִבְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה הַנּוֹתָרִים׃

english.text:
Manasseh’s daughters inherited a portion in these together with
his sons, while the land of Gilead was assigned to the rest of
Manasseh’s descendants.

translation.text: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh’s sons had the land of Gilead.

verses.english:
Manasseh’s daughters inherited a portion in these together with
his sons, while the land of Gilead was assigned to the rest of
Manasseh’s descendants.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְבוּל־מְנַשֶּׁה מֵאָשֵׁר הַמִּכְמְתָת אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי שְׁכֶם וְהָלַךְ הַגְּבוּל אֶל־הַיָּמִין אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵי עֵין תַּפּוּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי גְבוּל־מְנַשֶּׁה מֵאָשֵׁר הַמִּכְמְתָת אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי שְׁכֶם וְהָלַךְ הַגְּבוּל אֶל־הַיָּמִין אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵי עֵין תַּפּוּחַ׃

english.text:
The boundary of Manasseh ran from Asher to Michmethath, which lies
near Shechem. The boundary continued to the right, toward the
inhabitants of En-tappuah.—

translation.text: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of Entappuah.

verses.english:
The boundary of Manasseh ran from Asher to Michmethath, which lies
near Shechem. The boundary continued to the right, toward the
inhabitants of En-tappuah.—

verses.hebrew: לִמְנַשֶּׁה הָיְתָה אֶרֶץ תַּפּוּחַ וְתַפּוּחַ אֶל־גְּבוּל מְנַשֶּׁה לִבְנֵי אֶפְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: לִמְנַשֶּׁה הָיְתָה אֶרֶץ תַּפּוּחַ וְתַפּוּחַ אֶל־גְּבוּל מְנַשֶּׁה לִבְנֵי אֶפְרָיִם׃

english.text:
The region of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah, on the
border of Manasseh, belonged to the Ephraimites.—

translation.text: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;

verses.english:
The region of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah, on the
border of Manasseh, belonged to the Ephraimites.—

verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל נַחַל קָנָה נֶגְבָּה לַנַּחַל עָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לְאֶפְרַיִם בְּתוֹךְ עָרֵי מְנַשֶּׁה וּגְבוּל מְנַשֶּׁה מִצְּפוֹן לַנַּחַל וַיְהִי תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל נַחַל קָנָה נֶגְבָּה לַנַּחַל עָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לְאֶפְרַיִם בְּתוֹךְ עָרֵי מְנַשֶּׁה וּגְבוּל מְנַשֶּׁה מִצְּפוֹן לַנַּחַל וַיְהִי תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה׃

english.text:
Then the boundary descended to the Wadi Kanah. Those towns to the
south of the wadi belonged to Ephraim as an enclave among the
towns of Manasseh. The boundary of Manasseh lay north of the wadi
and ran on to the Sea.

translation.text: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:

verses.english:
Then the boundary descended to the Wadi Kanah. Those towns to the
south of the wadi belonged to Ephraim as an enclave among the
towns of Manasseh. The boundary of Manasseh lay north of the wadi
and ran on to the Sea.

verses.hebrew: נֶגְבָּה לְאֶפְרַיִם וְצָפוֹנָה לִמְנַשֶּׁה וַיְהִי הַיָּם גְּבוּלוֹ וּבְאָשֵׁר יִפְגְּעוּן מִצָּפוֹן וּבְיִשָּׂשכָר מִמִּזְרָח׃

hebrew.text: נֶגְבָּה לְאֶפְרַיִם וְצָפוֹנָה לִמְנַשֶּׁה וַיְהִי הַיָּם גְּבוּלוֹ וּבְאָשֵׁר יִפְגְּעוּן מִצָּפוֹן וּבְיִשָּׂשכָר מִמִּזְרָח׃

english.text:
What lay to the south belonged to Ephraim, and what lay to the
north belonged to Manasseh, with the Sea as its boundary. [This
territory] was contiguous with Asher on the north and with
Issachar on the east.

translation.text: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.

verses.english:
What lay to the south belonged to Ephraim, and what lay to the
north belonged to Manasseh, with the Sea as its boundary. [This
territory] was contiguous with Asher on the north and with
Issachar on the east.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי לִמְנַשֶּׁה בְּיִשָּׂשכָר וּבְאָשֵׁר בֵּית־שְׁאָן וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיִבְלְעָם וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי דֹאר וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵי עֵין־דֹּר וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵי
תַעְנַךְ וּבְנֹתֶיהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵי מְגִדּוֹ וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַנָּפֶת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי לִמְנַשֶּׁה בְּיִשָּׂשכָר וּבְאָשֵׁר בֵּית־שְׁאָן וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיִבְלְעָם וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי דֹאר וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵי עֵין־דֹּר וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵי
תַעְנַךְ וּבְנֹתֶיהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵי מְגִדּוֹ וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַנָּפֶת׃

english.text:
Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh possessed Beth-shean and its
dependencies, Ibleam and its dependencies, the inhabitants of Dor
and its dependencies, the inhabitants of En-dor and its
dependencies, the inhabitants of Taanach and its dependencies, and
the inhabitants of Megiddo and its dependencies: these constituted
three regions.

translation.text: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Bethshean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.

verses.english:
Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh possessed Beth-shean and its
dependencies, Ibleam and its dependencies, the inhabitants of Dor
and its dependencies, the inhabitants of En-dor and its
dependencies, the inhabitants of Taanach and its dependencies, and
the inhabitants of Megiddo and its dependencies: these constituted
three regions.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יָכְלוּ בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה לְהוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיּוֹאֶל הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָשֶׁבֶת בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יָכְלוּ בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה לְהוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיּוֹאֶל הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָשֶׁבֶת בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
The Manassites could not dispossess [the inhabitants of] these
towns, and the Canaanites stubbornly remained in this region.

translation.text: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

verses.english:
The Manassites could not dispossess [the inhabitants of] these
towns, and the Canaanites stubbornly remained in this region.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי חָזְקוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָמַס וְהוֹרֵשׁ לֹא הוֹרִישׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי חָזְקוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָמַס וְהוֹרֵשׁ לֹא הוֹרִישׁוֹ׃

english.text:
When the Israelites became stronger, they imposed tribute on the
Canaanites; but they did not dispossess them.

translation.text: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, but did not utterly drive them out.

verses.english:
When the Israelites became stronger, they imposed tribute on the
Canaanites; but they did not dispossess them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבְּרוּ בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר מַדּוּעַ נָתַתָּה לִּי נַחֲלָה גּוֹרָל אֶחָד וְחֶבֶל אֶחָד וַאֲנִי עַם־רָב עַד אֲשֶׁר־עַד־כֹּה בֵּרְכַנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבְּרוּ בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר מַדּוּעַ נָתַתָּה לִּי נַחֲלָה גּוֹרָל אֶחָד וְחֶבֶל אֶחָד וַאֲנִי עַם־רָב עַד אֲשֶׁר־עַד־כֹּה בֵּרְכַנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The Josephites complained to Joshua, saying, “Why have you
assigned as our portion a single allotment and a single district,
seeing that we are a numerous people whom YHWH has blessed so
greatly?”

translation.text: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the LORD hath blessed me hitherto?

verses.english:
The Josephites complained to Joshua, saying, “Why have you
assigned as our portion a single allotment and a single district,
seeing that we are a numerous people whom YHWH has blessed so
greatly?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אִם־עַם־רַב אַתָּה עֲלֵה לְךָ הַיַּעְרָה וּבֵרֵאתָ לְךָ שָׁם בְּאֶרֶץ הַפְּרִזִּי וְהָרְפָאִים כִּי־אָץ לְךָ הַר־אֶפְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אִם־עַם־רַב אַתָּה עֲלֵה לְךָ הַיַּעְרָה וּבֵרֵאתָ לְךָ שָׁם בְּאֶרֶץ הַפְּרִזִּי וְהָרְפָאִים כִּי־אָץ לְךָ הַר־אֶפְרָיִם׃

english.text:
“If you are a numerous people,” Joshua answered them, “go up to
the forest country and clear an area for yourselves there, in the
territory of the Perizzites and the Rephaim, seeing that you are
cramped in the hill country of Ephraim.”

translation.text: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.

verses.english:
“If you are a numerous people,” Joshua answered them, “go up to
the forest country and clear an area for yourselves there, in the
territory of the Perizzites and the Rephaim, seeing that you are
cramped in the hill country of Ephraim.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף לֹא־יִמָּצֵא לָנוּ הָהָר וְרֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל בְּכל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בְּאֶרֶץ־הָעֵמֶק לַאֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־שְׁאָן וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּעֵמֶק
יִזְרְעֶאל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף לֹא־יִמָּצֵא לָנוּ הָהָר וְרֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל בְּכל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בְּאֶרֶץ־הָעֵמֶק לַאֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־שְׁאָן וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּעֵמֶק
יִזְרְעֶאל׃

english.text:
“The hill country is not enough for us,” the Josephites replied,
“and all the Canaanites who live in the valley area have iron
chariots, both those in Beth-shean and its dependencies and those
in the Valley of Jezreel.”

translation.text: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Bethshean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.

verses.english:
“The hill country is not enough for us,” the Josephites replied,
“and all the Canaanites who live in the valley area have iron
chariots, both those in Beth-shean and its dependencies and those
in the Valley of Jezreel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־בֵּית יוֹסֵף לְאֶפְרַיִם וְלִמְנַשֶּׁה לֵאמֹר עַם־רַב אַתָּה וְכֹחַ גָּדוֹל לָךְ לֹא־יִהְיֶה לְךָ גּוֹרָל אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־בֵּית יוֹסֵף לְאֶפְרַיִם וְלִמְנַשֶּׁה לֵאמֹר עַם־רַב אַתָּה וְכֹחַ גָּדוֹל לָךְ לֹא־יִהְיֶה לְךָ גּוֹרָל אֶחָד׃

english.text:
But Joshua declared to the House of Joseph, to Ephraim and
Manasseh, “You are indeed a numerous people, possessed of great
strength; you shall not have one allotment only.

translation.text: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:

verses.english:
But Joshua declared to the House of Joseph, to Ephraim and
Manasseh, “You are indeed a numerous people, possessed of great
strength; you shall not have one allotment only.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הַר יִהְיֶה־לָּךְ כִּי־יַעַר הוּא וּבֵרֵאתוֹ וְהָיָה לְךָ תֹּצְאֹתָיו כִּי־תוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי כִּי רֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל לוֹ כִּי חָזָק הוּא׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הַר יִהְיֶה־לָּךְ כִּי־יַעַר הוּא וּבֵרֵאתוֹ וְהָיָה לְךָ תֹּצְאֹתָיו כִּי־תוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי כִּי רֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל לוֹ כִּי חָזָק הוּא׃

english.text:
The hill country shall be yours as well; true, it is forest land,
but you will clear it and possess it to its farthest limits. And
you shall also dispossess the Canaanites, even though they have
iron chariots and even though they are strong.”

translation.text: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.

verses.english:
The hill country shall be yours as well; true, it is forest land,
but you will clear it and possess it to its farthest limits. And
you shall also dispossess the Canaanites, even though they have
iron chariots and even though they are strong.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ כּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁלֹה וַיַּשְׁכִּינוּ שָׁם אֶת־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהָאָרֶץ נִכְבְּשָׁה לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ כּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁלֹה וַיַּשְׁכִּינוּ שָׁם אֶת־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהָאָרֶץ נִכְבְּשָׁה לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

translation.text: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּתְרוּ בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חָלְקוּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתָם שִׁבְעָה שְׁבָטִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּוָּתְרוּ בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חָלְקוּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתָם שִׁבְעָה שְׁבָטִים׃

english.text:
but there remained seven tribes of the Israelites which had not
yet received their portions.

translation.text: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.

verses.english:
but there remained seven tribes of the Israelites which had not
yet received their portions.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־אָנָה אַתֶּם מִתְרַפִּים לָבוֹא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־אָנָה אַתֶּם מִתְרַפִּים לָבוֹא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
So Joshua said to the Israelites, “How long will you be slack
about going and taking possession of the land which YHWH, the God
of your fathers, has assigned to you?

translation.text: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?

verses.english:
So Joshua said to the Israelites, “How long will you be slack
about going and taking possession of the land which YHWH, the God
of your fathers, has assigned to you?

verses.hebrew: הָבוּ לָכֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה אֲנָשִׁים לַשָּׁבֶט וְאֶשְׁלָחֵם וְיָקֻמוּ וְיִתְהַלְּכוּ בָאָרֶץ וְיִכְתְּבוּ אוֹתָהּ לְפִי נַחֲלָתָם וְיָבֹאוּ אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: הָבוּ לָכֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה אֲנָשִׁים לַשָּׁבֶט וְאֶשְׁלָחֵם וְיָקֻמוּ וְיִתְהַלְּכוּ בָאָרֶץ וְיִכְתְּבוּ אוֹתָהּ לְפִי נַחֲלָתָם וְיָבֹאוּ אֵלָי׃

english.text:
Appoint three men of each tribe; I will send them out to go
through the country and write down a description of it for
purposes of apportionment, and then come back to me.

translation.text: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.

verses.english:
Appoint three men of each tribe; I will send them out to go
through the country and write down a description of it for
purposes of apportionment, and then come back to me.

verses.hebrew: וְהִתְחַלְּקוּ אֹתָהּ לְשִׁבְעָה חֲלָקִים יְהוּדָה יַעֲמֹד עַל־גְּבוּלוֹ מִנֶּגֶב וּבֵית יוֹסֵף יַעַמְדוּ עַל־גְּבוּלָם מִצָּפוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְהִתְחַלְּקוּ אֹתָהּ לְשִׁבְעָה חֲלָקִים יְהוּדָה יַעֲמֹד עַל־גְּבוּלוֹ מִנֶּגֶב וּבֵית יוֹסֵף יַעַמְדוּ עַל־גְּבוּלָם מִצָּפוֹן׃

english.text:
They shall divide it into seven parts—Judah shall remain by its
territory in the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain by
its territory in the north.—

translation.text: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.

verses.english:
They shall divide it into seven parts—Judah shall remain by its
territory in the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain by
its territory in the north.—

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם תִּכְתְּבוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ שִׁבְעָה חֲלָקִים וַהֲבֵאתֶם אֵלַי הֵנָּה וְיָרִיתִי לָכֶם גּוֹרָל פֹּה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם תִּכְתְּבוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ שִׁבְעָה חֲלָקִים וַהֲבֵאתֶם אֵלַי הֵנָּה וְיָרִיתִי לָכֶם גּוֹרָל פֹּה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text:
When you have written down the description of the land in seven
parts, bring it here to me. Then I will cast lots for you here
before YHWH our God.

translation.text: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.

verses.english:
When you have written down the description of the land in seven
parts, bring it here to me. Then I will cast lots for you here
before YHWH our God.

verses.hebrew:
כִּי אֵין־חֵלֶק לַלְוִיִּם בְּקִרְבְּכֶם כִּי־כְהֻנַּת יְהֹוָה נַחֲלָתוֹ וְגָד וּרְאוּבֵן וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן
לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי אֵין־חֵלֶק לַלְוִיִּם בְּקִרְבְּכֶם כִּי־כְהֻנַּת יְהֹוָה נַחֲלָתוֹ וְגָד וּרְאוּבֵן וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן
לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
For the Levites have no share among you, since the priesthood of
YHWH is their portion; and Gad and Reuben and the half-tribe of
Manasseh have received the portions which were assigned to them by
Moses the servant of YHWH, on the eastern side of the Jordan.”

translation.text: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.

verses.english:
For the Levites have no share among you, since the priesthood of
YHWH is their portion; and Gad and Reuben and the half-tribe of
Manasseh have received the portions which were assigned to them by
Moses the servant of YHWH, on the eastern side of the Jordan.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקֻמוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַיְצַו יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הַהֹלְכִים לִכְתֹּב אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לֵאמֹר לְכוּ וְהִתְהַלְּכוּ בָאָרֶץ וְכִתְבוּ אוֹתָהּ וְשׁוּבוּ אֵלַי וּפֹה אַשְׁלִיךְ
לָכֶם גּוֹרָל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּשִׁלֹה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקֻמוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַיְצַו יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הַהֹלְכִים לִכְתֹּב אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לֵאמֹר לְכוּ וְהִתְהַלְּכוּ בָאָרֶץ וְכִתְבוּ אוֹתָהּ וְשׁוּבוּ אֵלַי וּפֹה אַשְׁלִיךְ
לָכֶם גּוֹרָל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּשִׁלֹה׃

english.text:
The men set out on their journeys. Joshua ordered the men who were
leaving to write down a description of the land—“Go, traverse the
country and write down a description of it. Then return to me, and
I will cast lots for you here at Shiloh before YHWH.”

translation.text: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.

verses.english:
The men set out on their journeys. Joshua ordered the men who were
leaving to write down a description of the land—“Go, traverse the
country and write down a description of it. Then return to me, and
I will cast lots for you here at Shiloh before YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיַּעַבְרוּ בָאָרֶץ וַיִּכְתְּבוּהָ לֶעָרִים לְשִׁבְעָה חֲלָקִים עַל־סֵפֶר וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁלֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיַּעַבְרוּ בָאָרֶץ וַיִּכְתְּבוּהָ לֶעָרִים לְשִׁבְעָה חֲלָקִים עַל־סֵפֶר וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁלֹה׃

english.text:
So the men went and traversed the land; they described it in a
document, town by town, in seven parts, and they returned to
Joshua in the camp at Shiloh.

translation.text: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.

verses.english:
So the men went and traversed the land; they described it in a
document, town by town, in seven parts, and they returned to
Joshua in the camp at Shiloh.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ גּוֹרָל בְּשִׁלֹה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְחַלֶּק־שָׁם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ גּוֹרָל בְּשִׁלֹה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְחַלֶּק־שָׁם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָם׃

english.text:
Joshua cast lots for them at Shiloh before YHWH, and there Joshua
apportioned the land among the Israelites according to their
divisions.

translation.text: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.

verses.english:
Joshua cast lots for them at Shiloh before YHWH, and there Joshua
apportioned the land among the Israelites according to their
divisions.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל גּוֹרַל מַטֵּה בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וַיֵּצֵא גְּבוּל גּוֹרָלָם בֵּין בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה וּבֵין בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל גּוֹרַל מַטֵּה בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וַיֵּצֵא גְּבוּל גּוֹרָלָם בֵּין בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה וּבֵין בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף׃

english.text:
The lot of the tribe of the Benjaminites, by their clans, came out
first. The territory which fell to their lot lay between the
Judites and the Josephites.

translation.text: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

verses.english:
The lot of the tribe of the Benjaminites, by their clans, came out
first. The territory which fell to their lot lay between the
Judites and the Josephites.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לָהֶם הַגְּבוּל לִפְאַת צָפוֹנָה מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל אֶל־כֶּתֶף יְרִיחוֹ מִצָּפוֹן וְעָלָה בָהָר יָמָּה (והיה) [וְהָיוּ] תֹּצְאֹתָיו מִדְבַּרָה בֵּית אָוֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לָהֶם הַגְּבוּל לִפְאַת צָפוֹנָה מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל אֶל־כֶּתֶף יְרִיחוֹ מִצָּפוֹן וְעָלָה בָהָר יָמָּה (והיה) [וְהָיוּ] תֹּצְאֹתָיו מִדְבַּרָה בֵּית אָוֶן׃

english.text:
The boundary on their northern rim began at the Jordan; the
boundary ascended to the northern flank of Jericho, ascended
westward into the hill country and ran on to the Wilderness of
Beth-aven.

translation.text: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Bethaven.

verses.english:
The boundary on their northern rim began at the Jordan; the
boundary ascended to the northern flank of Jericho, ascended
westward into the hill country and ran on to the Wilderness of
Beth-aven.

verses.hebrew: וְעָבַר מִשָּׁם הַגְּבוּל לוּזָה אֶל־כֶּתֶף לוּזָה נֶגְבָּה הִיא בֵּית־אֵל וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל עַטְרוֹת אַדָּר עַל־הָהָר אֲשֶׁר מִנֶּגֶב לְבֵית־חֹרוֹן תַּחְתּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְעָבַר מִשָּׁם הַגְּבוּל לוּזָה אֶל־כֶּתֶף לוּזָה נֶגְבָּה הִיא בֵּית־אֵל וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל עַטְרוֹת אַדָּר עַל־הָהָר אֲשֶׁר מִנֶּגֶב לְבֵית־חֹרוֹן תַּחְתּוֹן׃

english.text:
From there the boundary passed on southward to Luz, to the flank
of Luz—that is, Bethel; then the boundary descended to
Atroth-addar [and] to the hill south of Lower Beth-horon.

translation.text: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Atarothadar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Bethhoron.

verses.english:
From there the boundary passed on southward to Luz, to the flank
of Luz—that is, Bethel; then the boundary descended to
Atroth-addar [and] to the hill south of Lower Beth-horon.

verses.hebrew:
וְתָאַר הַגְּבוּל וְנָסַב לִפְאַת־יָם נֶגְבָּה מִן־הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי בֵית־חֹרוֹן נֶגְבָּה (והיה) [וְהָיוּ] תֹצְאֹתָיו אֶל־קִרְיַת־בַּעַל הִיא קִרְיַת יְעָרִים עִיר בְּנֵי
יְהוּדָה זֹאת פְּאַת־יָם׃

hebrew.text:
וְתָאַר הַגְּבוּל וְנָסַב לִפְאַת־יָם נֶגְבָּה מִן־הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי בֵית־חֹרוֹן נֶגְבָּה (והיה) [וְהָיוּ] תֹצְאֹתָיו אֶל־קִרְיַת־בַּעַל הִיא קִרְיַת יְעָרִים עִיר בְּנֵי
יְהוּדָה זֹאת פְּאַת־יָם׃

english.text:
The boundary now turned and curved onto the western rim; and the
boundary ran southward from the hill on the south side of
Beth-horon till it ended at Kiriath-baal—that is, Kiriath-jearim—a
town of the Judites. That was the western rim.

translation.text: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Bethhoron southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.

verses.english:
The boundary now turned and curved onto the western rim; and the
boundary ran southward from the hill on the south side of
Beth-horon till it ended at Kiriath-baal—that is, Kiriath-jearim—a
town of the Judites. That was the western rim.

verses.hebrew: וּפְאַת־נֶגְבָּה מִקְצֵה קִרְיַת יְעָרִים וְיָצָא הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה וְיָצָא אֶל־מַעְיַן מֵי נֶפְתּוֹחַ׃

hebrew.text: וּפְאַת־נֶגְבָּה מִקְצֵה קִרְיַת יְעָרִים וְיָצָא הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה וְיָצָא אֶל־מַעְיַן מֵי נֶפְתּוֹחַ׃

english.text:
The southern rim: From the outskirts of Kiriath-jearim, the
boundary passed westward and ran on to the fountain of the Waters
of Nephtoah.

translation.text: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjathjearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:

verses.english:
The southern rim: From the outskirts of Kiriath-jearim, the
boundary passed westward and ran on to the fountain of the Waters
of Nephtoah.

verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל אֶל־קְצֵה הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי גֵּי בֶן־הִנֹּם אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים צָפוֹנָה וְיָרַד גֵּי הִנֹּם אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַיְבוּסִי נֶגְבָּה וְיָרַד עֵין רֹגֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל אֶל־קְצֵה הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי גֵּי בֶן־הִנֹּם אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים צָפוֹנָה וְיָרַד גֵּי הִנֹּם אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַיְבוּסִי נֶגְבָּה וְיָרַד עֵין רֹגֵל׃

english.text:
Then the boundary descended to the foot of the hill by the Valley
of Ben-hinnom at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim; then
it ran down the Valley of Hinnom along the southern flank of the
Jebusites to En-rogel.

translation.text: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to Enrogel,

verses.english:
Then the boundary descended to the foot of the hill by the Valley
of Ben-hinnom at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim; then
it ran down the Valley of Hinnom along the southern flank of the
Jebusites to En-rogel.

verses.hebrew: וְתָאַר מִצָּפוֹן וְיָצָא עֵין שֶׁמֶשׁ וְיָצָא אֶל־גְּלִילוֹת אֲשֶׁר־נֹכַח מַעֲלֵה אֲדֻמִּים וְיָרַד אֶבֶן בֹּהַן בֶּן־רְאוּבֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְתָאַר מִצָּפוֹן וְיָצָא עֵין שֶׁמֶשׁ וְיָצָא אֶל־גְּלִילוֹת אֲשֶׁר־נֹכַח מַעֲלֵה אֲדֻמִּים וְיָרַד אֶבֶן בֹּהַן בֶּן־רְאוּבֵן׃

english.text:
Curving northward, it ran on to En-shemesh and ran on to Geliloth,
facing the Ascent of Adummim, and descended to the Stone of Bohan
son of Reuben.

translation.text: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to Enshemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,

verses.english:
Curving northward, it ran on to En-shemesh and ran on to Geliloth,
facing the Ascent of Adummim, and descended to the Stone of Bohan
son of Reuben.

verses.hebrew: וְעָבַר אֶל־כֶּתֶף מוּל־הָעֲרָבָה צָפוֹנָה וְיָרַד הָעֲרָבָתָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעָבַר אֶל־כֶּתֶף מוּל־הָעֲרָבָה צָפוֹנָה וְיָרַד הָעֲרָבָתָה׃

english.text:
It continued northward to the edge of the Arabah and descended
into the Arabah.

translation.text: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:

verses.english:
It continued northward to the edge of the Arabah and descended
into the Arabah.

verses.hebrew:
וְעָבַר הַגְּבוּל אֶל־כֶּתֶף בֵּית־חגְלָה צָפוֹנָה (והיה) [וְהָיוּ ] (תצאותיו) [תֹּצְאוֹת] הַגְּבוּל אֶל־לְשׁוֹן יָם־הַמֶּלַח צָפוֹנָה אֶל־קְצֵה הַיַּרְדֵּן נֶגְבָּה זֶה גְּבוּל
נֶגֶב׃

hebrew.text:
וְעָבַר הַגְּבוּל אֶל־כֶּתֶף בֵּית־חגְלָה צָפוֹנָה (והיה) [וְהָיוּ ] (תצאותיו) [תֹּצְאוֹת] הַגְּבוּל אֶל־לְשׁוֹן יָם־הַמֶּלַח צָפוֹנָה אֶל־קְצֵה הַיַּרְדֵּן נֶגְבָּה זֶה גְּבוּל
נֶגֶב׃

english.text:
The boundary passed on to the northern flank of Beth-hoglah, and
the boundary ended at the northern tongue of the Dead Sea, at the
southern end of the Jordan. That was the southern boundary.

translation.text: And the border passed along to the side of Bethhoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.

verses.english:
The boundary passed on to the northern flank of Beth-hoglah, and
the boundary ended at the northern tongue of the Dead Sea, at the
southern end of the Jordan. That was the southern boundary.

verses.hebrew: וְהַיַּרְדֵּן יִגְבֹּל־אֹתוֹ לִפְאַת־קֵדְמָה זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן לִגְבוּלֹתֶיהָ סָבִיב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַיַּרְדֵּן יִגְבֹּל־אֹתוֹ לִפְאַת־קֵדְמָה זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן לִגְבוּלֹתֶיהָ סָבִיב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

english.text:
On their eastern rim, finally, the Jordan was their boundary. That
was the portion of the Benjaminites, by their clans, according to
its boundaries on all sides.

translation.text: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.

verses.english:
On their eastern rim, finally, the Jordan was their boundary. That
was the portion of the Benjaminites, by their clans, according to
its boundaries on all sides.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ הֶעָרִים לְמַטֵּה בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתֵיהֶם יְרִיחוֹ וּבֵית־חגְלָה וְעֵמֶק קְצִיץ׃

And the towns of the tribe of the Benjaminites, by its clans,
were: Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,

translation.text: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Bethhoglah, and the valley of Keziz,

verses.english:
And the towns of the tribe of the Benjaminites, by its clans,
were: Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,

english.text:
Zela, Eleph, and Jebus—that is, Jerusalem—Gibeath [and] Kiriath:
14 towns, with their villages. That was the portion of the
Benjaminites, by their clans.

translation.text: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

verses.english:
Zela, Eleph, and Jebus—that is, Jerusalem—Gibeath [and] Kiriath:
14 towns, with their villages. That was the portion of the
Benjaminites, by their clans.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל הַשֵּׁנִי לְשִׁמְעוֹן לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־שִׁמְעוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם וַיְהִי נַחֲלָתָם בְּתוֹךְ נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל הַשֵּׁנִי לְשִׁמְעוֹן לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־שִׁמְעוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם וַיְהִי נַחֲלָתָם בְּתוֹךְ נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The second lot fell to Simeon. The portion of the tribe of the
Simeonites, by their clans, lay inside the portion of the Judites.

translation.text: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.

verses.english:
The second lot fell to Simeon. The portion of the tribe of the
Simeonites, by their clans, lay inside the portion of the Judites.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לָהֶם בְּנַחֲלָתָם בְּאֵר־שֶׁבַע וְשֶׁבַע וּמוֹלָדָה׃

english.text: Their portion comprised: Beer-sheba—or Sheba—Moladah,

translation.text: And they had in their inheritance Beersheba, and Sheba, and Moladah,

verses.english: Their portion comprised: Beer-sheba—or Sheba—Moladah,

verses.hebrew: וַחֲצַר שׁוּעָל וּבָלָה וָעָצֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַחֲצַר שׁוּעָל וּבָלָה וָעָצֶם׃

english.text: Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem,

translation.text: And Hazarshual, and Balah, and Azem,

verses.english: Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem,

hebrew.text: וְאֶלְתּוֹלַד וּבְתוּל וְחרְמָה׃

english.text: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

translation.text: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,

english.text: Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen —13 towns, with their villages.

translation.text: And Bethlebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:

verses.english: Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen —13 towns, with their villages.

verses.hebrew: עַיִן רִמּוֹן וָעֶתֶר וְעָשָׁן עָרִים אַרְבַּע וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: עַיִן רִמּוֹן וָעֶתֶר וְעָשָׁן עָרִים אַרְבַּע וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

english.text: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan: 4 towns, with their villages—

translation.text: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:

verses.english: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan: 4 towns, with their villages—

verses.hebrew: וְכל־הַחֲצֵרִים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹת הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה עַד־בַּעֲלַת בְּאֵר רָאמַת נֶגֶב זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־שִׁמְעוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־הַחֲצֵרִים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹת הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה עַד־בַּעֲלַת בְּאֵר רָאמַת נֶגֶב זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־שִׁמְעוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

english.text:
together with all the villages in the vicinity of those towns,
down to Baalath-beer [and] Ramath-negeb. That was the portion of
the tribe of the Simeonites, by their clans.

translation.text: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalathbeer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

verses.english:
together with all the villages in the vicinity of those towns,
down to Baalath-beer [and] Ramath-negeb. That was the portion of
the tribe of the Simeonites, by their clans.

verses.hebrew: מֵחֶבֶל בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן כִּי־הָיָה חֵלֶק בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה רַב מֵהֶם וַיִּנְחֲלוּ בְנֵי־שִׁמְעוֹן בְּתוֹךְ נַחֲלָתָם׃

hebrew.text: מֵחֶבֶל בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן כִּי־הָיָה חֵלֶק בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה רַב מֵהֶם וַיִּנְחֲלוּ בְנֵי־שִׁמְעוֹן בְּתוֹךְ נַחֲלָתָם׃

english.text:
The portion of the Simeonites was part of the territory of the
Judites; since the share of the Judites was larger than they
needed, the Simeonites received a portion inside their portion.

translation.text: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.

verses.english:
The portion of the Simeonites was part of the territory of the
Judites; since the share of the Judites was larger than they
needed, the Simeonites received a portion inside their portion.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל הַגּוֹרָל הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לִבְנֵי זְבוּלֻן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וַיְהִי גְּבוּל נַחֲלָתָם עַד־שָׂרִיד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל הַגּוֹרָל הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לִבְנֵי זְבוּלֻן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וַיְהִי גְּבוּל נַחֲלָתָם עַד־שָׂרִיד׃

english.text:
The third lot emerged for the Zebulunites, by their clans. The
boundary of their portion: Starting at Sarid,

translation.text: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:

verses.english:
The third lot emerged for the Zebulunites, by their clans. The
boundary of their portion: Starting at Sarid,

verses.hebrew: וְעָלָה גְבוּלָם לַיָּמָּה וּמַרְעֲלָה וּפָגַע בְּדַבָּשֶׁת וּפָגַע אֶל־הַנַּחַל אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי יקְנְעָם׃

hebrew.text: וְעָלָה גְבוּלָם לַיָּמָּה וּמַרְעֲלָה וּפָגַע בְּדַבָּשֶׁת וּפָגַע אֶל־הַנַּחַל אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי יקְנְעָם׃

english.text:
their boundary ascended westward to Maralah, touching Dabbesheth
and touching the wadi alongside Jokneam.

translation.text: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;

verses.english:
their boundary ascended westward to Maralah, touching Dabbesheth
and touching the wadi alongside Jokneam.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁב מִשָּׂרִיד קֵדְמָה מִזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ עַל־גְּבוּל כִּסְלֹת תָּבֹר וְיָצָא אֶל־הַדָּבְרַת וְעָלָה יָפִיעַ׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁב מִשָּׂרִיד קֵדְמָה מִזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ עַל־גְּבוּל כִּסְלֹת תָּבֹר וְיָצָא אֶל־הַדָּבְרַת וְעָלָה יָפִיעַ׃

english.text:
And it also ran from Sarid along the eastern side, where the sun
rises, past the territory of Chisloth-tabor and on to Daberath and
ascended to Japhia.

translation.text: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chislothtabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,

verses.english:
And it also ran from Sarid along the eastern side, where the sun
rises, past the territory of Chisloth-tabor and on to Daberath and
ascended to Japhia.

verses.hebrew: וּמִשָּׁם עָבַר קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה גִּתָּה חֵפֶר עִתָּה קָצִין וְיָצָא רִמּוֹן הַמְּתֹאָר הַנֵּעָה׃

hebrew.text: וּמִשָּׁם עָבַר קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה גִּתָּה חֵפֶר עִתָּה קָצִין וְיָצָא רִמּוֹן הַמְּתֹאָר הַנֵּעָה׃

english.text:
From there it ran [back] to the east, toward the sunrise, to
Gath-hepher, to Eth-kazin, and on to Rimmon, where it curved to
Neah.

translation.text: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittahhepher, to Ittahkazin, and goeth out to Remmonmethoar to Neah;

verses.english:
From there it ran [back] to the east, toward the sunrise, to
Gath-hepher, to Eth-kazin, and on to Rimmon, where it curved to
Neah.

verses.hebrew: וְנָסַב אֹתוֹ הַגְּבוּל מִצְּפוֹן חַנָּתֹן וְהָיוּ תֹּצְאֹתָיו גֵּי יִפְתַּח־אֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְנָסַב אֹתוֹ הַגְּבוּל מִצְּפוֹן חַנָּתֹן וְהָיוּ תֹּצְאֹתָיו גֵּי יִפְתַּח־אֵל׃

english.text:
Then it turned—that is, the boundary on the north—to Hannathon.
Its extreme limits were the Valley of Iphtah-el,

translation.text: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthahel:

verses.english:
Then it turned—that is, the boundary on the north—to Hannathon.
Its extreme limits were the Valley of Iphtah-el,

verses.hebrew: וְקַטָּת וְנַהֲלָל וְשִׁמְרוֹן וְיִדְאֲלָה וּבֵית לָחֶם עָרִים שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְקַטָּת וְנַהֲלָל וְשִׁמְרוֹן וְיִדְאֲלָה וּבֵית לָחֶם עָרִים שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: 12 towns, with
their villages.

translation.text: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.

verses.english:
Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: 12 towns, with
their villages.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־זְבוּלֻן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־זְבוּלֻן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
That was the portion of the Zebulunites by their clans—those
towns, with their villages.

translation.text: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

verses.english:
That was the portion of the Zebulunites by their clans—those
towns, with their villages.

verses.hebrew: לְיִשָּׂשכָר יָצָא הַגּוֹרָל הָרְבִיעִי לִבְנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: לְיִשָּׂשכָר יָצָא הַגּוֹרָל הָרְבִיעִי לִבְנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם׃

english.text: The fourth lot fell to Issachar, the Issacharites by their clans.

translation.text: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.

verses.english: The fourth lot fell to Issachar, the Issacharites by their clans.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְּבוּלָם יִזְרְעֶאלָה וְהַכְּסוּלֹת וְשׁוּנֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי גְּבוּלָם יִזְרְעֶאלָה וְהַכְּסוּלֹת וְשׁוּנֵם׃

english.text: Their territory comprised: Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,

translation.text: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,

verses.english: Their territory comprised: Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,

verses.hebrew: וַחֲפָרַיִם וְשִׁיאֹן וַאֲנָחֲרַת׃

hebrew.text: וַחֲפָרַיִם וְשִׁיאֹן וַאֲנָחֲרַת׃

english.text: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

translation.text: And Haphraim, and Shihon, and Anaharath,

verses.english: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

verses.hebrew: וְהָרַבִּית וְקִשְׁיוֹן וָאָבֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָרַבִּית וְקִשְׁיוֹן וָאָבֶץ׃

english.text: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

translation.text: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,

verses.english: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

verses.hebrew: וְרֶמֶת וְעֵין־גַּנִּים וְעֵין חַדָּה וּבֵית פַּצֵּץ׃

hebrew.text: וְרֶמֶת וְעֵין־גַּנִּים וְעֵין חַדָּה וּבֵית פַּצֵּץ׃

english.text: Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez.

translation.text: And Remeth, and Engannim, and Enhaddah, and Bethpazzez;

verses.english: Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez.

verses.hebrew: וּפָגַע הַגְּבוּל בְּתָבוֹר (ושחצומה) [וְשַׁחֲצִימָה] וּבֵית שֶׁמֶשׁ וְהָיוּ תֹּצְאוֹת גְּבוּלָם הַיַּרְדֵּן עָרִים שֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וּפָגַע הַגְּבוּל בְּתָבוֹר (ושחצומה) [וְשַׁחֲצִימָה] וּבֵית שֶׁמֶשׁ וְהָיוּ תֹּצְאוֹת גְּבוּלָם הַיַּרְדֵּן עָרִים שֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
The boundary touched Tabor, Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh; and
their boundary ran to the Jordan: 16 towns, with their villages.

translation.text: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Bethshemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

verses.english:
The boundary touched Tabor, Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh; and
their boundary ran to the Jordan: 16 towns, with their villages.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־יִשָּׂשכָר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־יִשָּׂשכָר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
That was the portion of the tribe of the Issacharites, by their
clans—the towns with their villages.

translation.text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.

verses.english:
That was the portion of the tribe of the Issacharites, by their
clans—the towns with their villages.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל הַחֲמִישִׁי לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־אָשֵׁר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל הַחֲמִישִׁי לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־אָשֵׁר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם׃

english.text: The fifth lot fell to the tribe of the Asherites, by their clans.

translation.text: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

verses.english: The fifth lot fell to the tribe of the Asherites, by their clans.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְּבוּלָם חֶלְקַת וַחֲלִי וָבֶטֶן וְאַכְשָׁף׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי גְּבוּלָם חֶלְקַת וַחֲלִי וָבֶטֶן וְאַכְשָׁף׃

english.text: Their boundary ran along Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,

translation.text: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,

verses.english: Their boundary ran along Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,

verses.hebrew: וְאַלַמֶּלֶךְ וְעַמְעָד וּמִשְׁאָל וּפָגַע בְּכַרְמֶל הַיָּמָּה וּבְשִׁיחוֹר לִבְנָת׃

hebrew.text: וְאַלַמֶּלֶךְ וְעַמְעָד וּמִשְׁאָל וּפָגַע בְּכַרְמֶל הַיָּמָּה וּבְשִׁיחוֹר לִבְנָת׃

english.text:
Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal; and it touched Carmel on the west,
and Shihor-libnath.

translation.text: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath;

verses.english:
Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal; and it touched Carmel on the west,
and Shihor-libnath.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁב מִזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בֵּית דָּגֹן וּפָגַע בִּזְבֻלוּן וּבְגֵי יִפְתַּח־אֵל צָפוֹנָה בֵּית הָעֵמֶק וּנְעִיאֵל וְיָצָא אֶל־כָּבוּל מִשְּׂמֹאל׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁב מִזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בֵּית דָּגֹן וּפָגַע בִּזְבֻלוּן וּבְגֵי יִפְתַּח־אֵל צָפוֹנָה בֵּית הָעֵמֶק וּנְעִיאֵל וְיָצָא אֶל־כָּבוּל מִשְּׂמֹאל׃

english.text:
It also ran along the east side to Beth-dagon, and touched Zebulun
and the Valley of Iphtah-el to the north, [as also] Beth-emek and
Neiel; then it ran to Cabul on the north,

translation.text: And turneth toward the sunrising to Bethdagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthahel toward the north side of Bethemek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,

verses.english:
It also ran along the east side to Beth-dagon, and touched Zebulun
and the Valley of Iphtah-el to the north, [as also] Beth-emek and
Neiel; then it ran to Cabul on the north,

verses.hebrew: וְעֶבְרֹן וּרְחֹב וְחַמּוֹן וְקָנָה עַד צִידוֹן רַבָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְעֶבְרֹן וּרְחֹב וְחַמּוֹן וְקָנָה עַד צִידוֹן רַבָּה׃

english.text: Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, up to Great Sidon.

translation.text: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;

verses.english: Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, up to Great Sidon.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁב הַגְּבוּל הָרָמָה וְעַד־עִיר מִבְצַר־צֹר וְשָׁב הַגְּבוּל חֹסָה (ויהיו) [וְהָיוּ] תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה מֵחֶבֶל אַכְזִיבָה׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁב הַגְּבוּל הָרָמָה וְעַד־עִיר מִבְצַר־צֹר וְשָׁב הַגְּבוּל חֹסָה (ויהיו) [וְהָיוּ] תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה מֵחֶבֶל אַכְזִיבָה׃

translation.text: And then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:

verses.hebrew: וְעֻמָה וַאֲפֵק וּרְחֹב עָרִים עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְעֻמָה וַאֲפֵק וּרְחֹב עָרִים עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

english.text: Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob: 22 towns, with their villages.

translation.text: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.

verses.english: Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob: 22 towns, with their villages.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־אָשֵׁר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־אָשֵׁר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
That was the portion of the tribe of the Asherites, by their
clans—those towns, with their villages.

translation.text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

verses.english:
That was the portion of the tribe of the Asherites, by their
clans—those towns, with their villages.

verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי יָצָא הַגּוֹרָל הַשִּׁשִּׁי לִבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: לִבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי יָצָא הַגּוֹרָל הַשִּׁשִּׁי לִבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

english.text:
The sixth lot fell to the Naphtalites, the Naphtalites by their
clans.

translation.text: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

verses.english:
The sixth lot fell to the Naphtalites, the Naphtalites by their
clans.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי גְבוּלָם מֵחֵלֶף מֵאֵלוֹן בְּצַעֲנַנִּים וַאֲדָמִי הַנֶּקֶב וְיַבְנְאֵל עַד־לַקּוּם וַיְהִי תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי גְבוּלָם מֵחֵלֶף מֵאֵלוֹן בְּצַעֲנַנִּים וַאֲדָמִי הַנֶּקֶב וְיַבְנְאֵל עַד־לַקּוּם וַיְהִי תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
Their boundary ran from Heleph, Elon-bezaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and
Jabneel to Lakkum, and it ended at the Jordan.

translation.text: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:

verses.english:
Their boundary ran from Heleph, Elon-bezaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and
Jabneel to Lakkum, and it ended at the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁב הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה אַזְנוֹת תָּבוֹר וְיָצָא מִשָּׁם חוּקֹקָה וּפָגַע בִּזְבֻלוּן מִנֶּגֶב וּבְאָשֵׁר פָּגַע מִיָּם וּבִיהוּדָה הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרַח הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁב הַגְּבוּל יָמָּה אַזְנוֹת תָּבוֹר וְיָצָא מִשָּׁם חוּקֹקָה וּפָגַע בִּזְבֻלוּן מִנֶּגֶב וּבְאָשֵׁר פָּגַע מִיָּם וּבִיהוּדָה הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרַח הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

english.text:
The boundary then turned westward to Aznoth-tabor and ran from
there to Hukok. It touched Zebulun on the south, and it touched
Asher on the west, and Judah at the Jordan on the east.

translation.text: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznothtabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.

verses.english:
The boundary then turned westward to Aznoth-tabor and ran from
there to Hukok. It touched Zebulun on the south, and it touched
Asher on the west, and Judah at the Jordan on the east.

verses.hebrew: וְעָרֵי מִבְצָר הַצִּדִּים צֵר וְחַמַּת רַקַּת וְכִנָּרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְעָרֵי מִבְצָר הַצִּדִּים צֵר וְחַמַּת רַקַּת וְכִנָּרֶת׃

english.text:
Its fortified towns were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath,
Chinnereth,

translation.text: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,

verses.english:
Its fortified towns were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath,
Chinnereth,

verses.hebrew: וַאֲדָמָה וְהָרָמָה וְחָצוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲדָמָה וְהָרָמָה וְחָצוֹר׃

english.text: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

translation.text: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,

verses.english: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

verses.hebrew: וְקֶדֶשׁ וְאֶדְרֶעִי וְעֵין חָצוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְקֶדֶשׁ וְאֶדְרֶעִי וְעֵין חָצוֹר׃

english.text: Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor,

translation.text: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and Enhazor,

verses.english: Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor,

verses.hebrew: וְיִרְאוֹן וּמִגְדַּל־אֵל חֳרֵם וּבֵית־עֲנָת וּבֵית שָׁמֶשׁ עָרִים תְּשַׁע־עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh: 19 towns,
with their villages.

That was the portion of the tribe of the Naphtalites, by their
clans—the towns, with their villages.

verses.english: The seventh lot fell to the tribe of the Danites, by their clans.

verses.english: Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, at the border near Joppa.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּצֵא גְבוּל־בְּנֵי־דָן מֵהֶם וַיַּעֲלוּ בְנֵי־דָן וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עִם־לֶשֶׁם וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיַּכּוּ אוֹתָהּ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וַיִּרְשׁוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ
לְלֶשֶׁם דָּן כְּשֵׁם דָּן אֲבִיהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּצֵא גְבוּל־בְּנֵי־דָן מֵהֶם וַיַּעֲלוּ בְנֵי־דָן וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עִם־לֶשֶׁם וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיַּכּוּ אוֹתָהּ לְפִי־חֶרֶב וַיִּרְשׁוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ
לְלֶשֶׁם דָּן כְּשֵׁם דָּן אֲבִיהֶם׃

english.text:
But the territory of the Danites slipped from their grasp. So the
Danites migrated and made war on Leshem. They captured it and put
it to the sword; they took possession of it and settled in it. And
they changed the name of Leshem to Dan, after their ancestor Dan.

translation.text: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.

verses.english:
But the territory of the Danites slipped from their grasp. So the
Danites migrated and made war on Leshem. They captured it and put
it to the sword; they took possession of it and settled in it. And
they changed the name of Leshem to Dan, after their ancestor Dan.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־דָן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי־דָן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
That was the portion of the tribe of the Danites, by their
clans—those towns, with their villages.

translation.text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

verses.english:
That was the portion of the tribe of the Danites, by their
clans—those towns, with their villages.

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַלּוּ לִנְחֹל־אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לִגְבוּלֹתֶיהָ וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל נַחֲלָה לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן בְּתוֹכָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְכַלּוּ לִנְחֹל־אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לִגְבוּלֹתֶיהָ וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל נַחֲלָה לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן בְּתוֹכָם׃

english.text:
When they had finished allotting the land by its boundaries, the
Israelites gave a portion in their midst to Joshua son of Nun.

translation.text: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:

verses.english:
When they had finished allotting the land by its boundaries, the
Israelites gave a portion in their midst to Joshua son of Nun.

verses.hebrew: עַל־פִּי יְהֹוָה נָתְנוּ לוֹ אֶת־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר שָׁאָל אֶת־תִּמְנַת־סֶרַח בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיִּבְנֶה אֶת־הָעִיר וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: עַל־פִּי יְהֹוָה נָתְנוּ לוֹ אֶת־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר שָׁאָל אֶת־תִּמְנַת־סֶרַח בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיִּבְנֶה אֶת־הָעִיר וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהּ׃

english.text:
At the command of YHWH they gave him the town that he asked for,
Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim; he fortified the
town and settled in it.

translation.text: According to the word of the LORD they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.

verses.english:
At the command of YHWH they gave him the town that he asked for,
Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim; he fortified the
town and settled in it.

verses.hebrew:
אֵלֶּה הַנְּחָלֹת אֲשֶׁר נִחֲלוּ אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְמַטּוֹת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּגוֹרָל בְּשִׁלֹה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד
וַיְכַלּוּ מֵחַלֵּק אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text:
אֵלֶּה הַנְּחָלֹת אֲשֶׁר נִחֲלוּ אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְמַטּוֹת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּגוֹרָל בְּשִׁלֹה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד
וַיְכַלּוּ מֵחַלֵּק אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
These are the portions assigned by lot to the tribes of Israel by
the priest Eleazar, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the
ancestral houses, before YHWH at Shiloh, at the entrance of the
Tent of Meeting. When they had finished dividing the land,

translation.text: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.

verses.english:
These are the portions assigned by lot to the tribes of Israel by
the priest Eleazar, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the
ancestral houses, before YHWH at Shiloh, at the entrance of the
Tent of Meeting. When they had finished dividing the land,

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: YHWH said to Joshua:

translation.text: The LORD also spake unto Joshua, saying,

verses.english: YHWH said to Joshua:

verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר תְּנוּ לָכֶם אֶת־עָרֵי הַמִּקְלָט אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּרְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר תְּנוּ לָכֶם אֶת־עָרֵי הַמִּקְלָט אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּרְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
“Speak to the Israelites: Designate the cities of refuge—about
which I commanded you through Moses—

translation.text: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:

verses.english:
“Speak to the Israelites: Designate the cities of refuge—about
which I commanded you through Moses—

verses.hebrew: לָנוּס שָׁמָּה רוֹצֵחַ מַכֵּה־נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה בִּבְלִי־דָעַת וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְמִקְלָט מִגֹּאֵל הַדָּם׃

hebrew.text: לָנוּס שָׁמָּה רוֹצֵחַ מַכֵּה־נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה בִּבְלִי־דָעַת וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְמִקְלָט מִגֹּאֵל הַדָּם׃

english.text:
to which a manslayer who kills a person by mistake,
unintentionally, may flee. They shall serve you as a refuge from
the blood avenger.

translation.text: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

verses.english:
to which a manslayer who kills a person by mistake,
unintentionally, may flee. They shall serve you as a refuge from
the blood avenger.

verses.hebrew:
וְנָס אֶל־אַחַת מֵהֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְעָמַד פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הָעִיר וְדִבֶּר בְּאזְנֵי זִקְנֵי־הָעִיר הַהִיא אֶת־דְּבָרָיו וְאָסְפוּ אֹתוֹ הָעִירָה אֲלֵיהֶם וְנָתְנוּ־לוֹ מָקוֹם
וְיָשַׁב עִמָּם׃

hebrew.text:
וְנָס אֶל־אַחַת מֵהֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְעָמַד פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הָעִיר וְדִבֶּר בְּאזְנֵי זִקְנֵי־הָעִיר הַהִיא אֶת־דְּבָרָיו וְאָסְפוּ אֹתוֹ הָעִירָה אֲלֵיהֶם וְנָתְנוּ־לוֹ מָקוֹם
וְיָשַׁב עִמָּם׃

english.text:
He shall flee to one of those cities, present himself at the
entrance to the city gate, and plead his case before the elders of
that city; and they shall admit him into the city and give him a
place in which to live among them.

translation.text: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.

verses.english:
He shall flee to one of those cities, present himself at the
entrance to the city gate, and plead his case before the elders of
that city; and they shall admit him into the city and give him a
place in which to live among them.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִרְדֹּף גֹּאֵל הַדָּם אַחֲרָיו וְלֹא־יַסְגִּרוּ אֶת־הָרֹצֵחַ בְּיָדוֹ כִּי בִבְלִי־דַעַת הִכָּה אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ וְלֹא־שֹׂנֵא הוּא לוֹ מִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי יִרְדֹּף גֹּאֵל הַדָּם אַחֲרָיו וְלֹא־יַסְגִּרוּ אֶת־הָרֹצֵחַ בְּיָדוֹ כִּי בִבְלִי־דַעַת הִכָּה אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ וְלֹא־שֹׂנֵא הוּא לוֹ מִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃

english.text:
Should the blood avenger pursue him, they shall not hand the
manslayer over to him, since he killed the other person without
intent and had not been his enemy in the past.

translation.text: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.

verses.english:
Should the blood avenger pursue him, they shall not hand the
manslayer over to him, since he killed the other person without
intent and had not been his enemy in the past.

verses.hebrew:
וְיָשַׁב בָּעִיר הַהִיא עַד־עמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לַמִּשְׁפָּט עַד־מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אָז יָשׁוּב הָרוֹצֵחַ וּבָא אֶל־עִירוֹ וְאֶל־בֵּיתוֹ
אֶל־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־נָס מִשָּׁם׃

hebrew.text:
וְיָשַׁב בָּעִיר הַהִיא עַד־עמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לַמִּשְׁפָּט עַד־מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אָז יָשׁוּב הָרוֹצֵחַ וּבָא אֶל־עִירוֹ וְאֶל־בֵּיתוֹ
אֶל־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־נָס מִשָּׁם׃

english.text:
He shall live in that city until he can stand trial before the
assembly, [and remain there] until the death of the high priest
who is in office at that time. Thereafter, the manslayer may go
back to his home in his own town, to the town from which he fled.”

translation.text: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.

verses.english:
He shall live in that city until he can stand trial before the
assembly, [and remain there] until the death of the high priest
who is in office at that time. Thereafter, the manslayer may go
back to his home in his own town, to the town from which he fled.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְדִּשׁוּ אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל בְּהַר נַפְתָּלִי וְאֶת־שְׁכֶם בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וְאֶת־קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הִיא חֶבְרוֹן בְּהַר יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְדִּשׁוּ אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל בְּהַר נַפְתָּלִי וְאֶת־שְׁכֶם בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וְאֶת־קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הִיא חֶבְרוֹן בְּהַר יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
So they set aside Kedesh in the hill country of Naphtali in
Galilee, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and
Kiriath-arba—that is, Hebron—in the hill country of Judah.

translation.text: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjatharba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.

verses.english:
So they set aside Kedesh in the hill country of Naphtali in
Galilee, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and
Kiriath-arba—that is, Hebron—in the hill country of Judah.

verses.hebrew:
וּמֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרִיחוֹ מִזְרָחָה נָתְנוּ אֶת־בֶּצֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר בַּמִּישֹׁר מִמַּטֵּה רְאוּבֵן וְאֶת־רָאמֹת בַּגִּלְעָד מִמַּטֵּה־גָד וְאֶת־[גּוֹלָן] (גלון) בַּבָּשָׁן
מִמַּטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה׃

hebrew.text:
וּמֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרִיחוֹ מִזְרָחָה נָתְנוּ אֶת־בֶּצֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר בַּמִּישֹׁר מִמַּטֵּה רְאוּבֵן וְאֶת־רָאמֹת בַּגִּלְעָד מִמַּטֵּה־גָד וְאֶת־[גּוֹלָן] (גלון) בַּבָּשָׁן
מִמַּטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה׃

english.text:
And across the Jordan, east of Jericho, they assigned Bezer in the
wilderness, in the Tableland, from the tribe of Reuben; Ramoth in
Gilead from the tribe of Gad; and Golan in Bashan from the tribe
of Manasseh.

translation.text: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

verses.english:
And across the Jordan, east of Jericho, they assigned Bezer in the
wilderness, in the Tableland, from the tribe of Reuben; Ramoth in
Gilead from the tribe of Gad; and Golan in Bashan from the tribe
of Manasseh.

verses.hebrew:
אֵלֶּה הָיוּ עָרֵי הַמּוּעָדָה לְכֹל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם לָנוּס שָׁמָּה כּל־מַכֵּה־נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה וְלֹא יָמוּת בְּיַד גֹּאֵל הַדָּם עַד־עמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי
הָעֵדָה׃

hebrew.text:
אֵלֶּה הָיוּ עָרֵי הַמּוּעָדָה לְכֹל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם לָנוּס שָׁמָּה כּל־מַכֵּה־נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה וְלֹא יָמוּת בְּיַד גֹּאֵל הַדָּם עַד־עמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי
הָעֵדָה׃

english.text:
Those were the towns designated for all the Israelites and for
aliens residing among them, to which anyone who killed a person
unintentionally might flee, and not die by the hand of the blood
avenger before standing trial by the assembly.

translation.text: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.

verses.english:
Those were the towns designated for all the Israelites and for
aliens residing among them, to which anyone who killed a person
unintentionally might flee, and not die by the hand of the blood
avenger before standing trial by the assembly.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַלְוִיִּם אֶל־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְאֶל־רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַלְוִיִּם אֶל־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְאֶל־רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The heads of the ancestral houses of the Levites approached the
priest Eleazar, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the ancestral
houses of the Israelite tribes,

translation.text: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;

verses.english:
The heads of the ancestral houses of the Levites approached the
priest Eleazar, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the ancestral
houses of the Israelite tribes,

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֲלֵיהֶם בְּשִׁלֹה בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה צִוָּה בְיַד־מֹשֶׁה לָתֶת־לָנוּ עָרִים לָשָׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן לִבְהֶמְתֵּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֲלֵיהֶם בְּשִׁלֹה בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה צִוָּה בְיַד־מֹשֶׁה לָתֶת־לָנוּ עָרִים לָשָׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן לִבְהֶמְתֵּנוּ׃

english.text:
and spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, as follows:
“YHWH commanded through Moses that we be given towns to live in,
along with their pastures for our livestock.”

translation.text: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.

verses.english:
and spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, as follows:
“YHWH commanded through Moses that we be given towns to live in,
along with their pastures for our livestock.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְוִיִּם מִנַּחֲלָתָם אֶל־פִּי יְהֹוָה אֶת־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְוִיִּם מִנַּחֲלָתָם אֶל־פִּי יְהֹוָה אֶת־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃

english.text:
So the Israelites, in accordance with YHWH’s command, assigned to
the Levites, out of their own portions, the following towns with
their pastures:

translation.text: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the LORD, these cities and their suburbs.

verses.english:
So the Israelites, in accordance with YHWH’s command, assigned to
the Levites, out of their own portions, the following towns with
their pastures:

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי וַיְהִי לִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן מִן־הַלְוִיִּם מִמַּטֵּה יְהוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּה הַשִּׁמְעֹנִי וּמִמַּטֵּה בִנְיָמִן בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים
שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי וַיְהִי לִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן מִן־הַלְוִיִּם מִמַּטֵּה יְהוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּה הַשִּׁמְעֹנִי וּמִמַּטֵּה בִנְיָמִן בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים
שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה׃

english.text:
The [first] lot among the Levites fell to the Kohathite clans. To
the descendants of the priest Aaron, there fell by lot 13 towns
from the tribe of Judah, the tribe of Simeon, and the tribe of
Benjamin;

translation.text: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.

verses.english:
The [first] lot among the Levites fell to the Kohathite clans. To
the descendants of the priest Aaron, there fell by lot 13 towns
from the tribe of Judah, the tribe of Simeon, and the tribe of
Benjamin;

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי קְהָת הַנּוֹתָרִים מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת מַטֵּה־אֶפְרַיִם וּמִמַּטֵּה־דָן וּמֵחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים עָשֶׂר׃

hebrew.text: וְלִבְנֵי קְהָת הַנּוֹתָרִים מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת מַטֵּה־אֶפְרַיִם וּמִמַּטֵּה־דָן וּמֵחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים עָשֶׂר׃

english.text:
and to the remaining Kohathites [there fell] by lot 10 towns from
the clans of the tribe of Ephraim, the tribe of Dan, and the
half-tribe of Manasseh.

translation.text: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

verses.english:
and to the remaining Kohathites [there fell] by lot 10 towns from
the clans of the tribe of Ephraim, the tribe of Dan, and the
half-tribe of Manasseh.

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת מַטֵּה־יִשָּׂשכָר וּמִמַּטֵּה־אָשֵׁר וּמִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וּמֵחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה בַבָּשָׁן בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה׃

hebrew.text: וְלִבְנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת מַטֵּה־יִשָּׂשכָר וּמִמַּטֵּה־אָשֵׁר וּמִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וּמֵחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה בַבָּשָׁן בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה׃

english.text:
To the Gershonites [there fell] by lot 13 towns from the clans of
the tribe of Issachar, the tribe of Asher, the tribe of Naphtali,
and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

translation.text: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

verses.english:
To the Gershonites [there fell] by lot 13 towns from the clans of
the tribe of Issachar, the tribe of Asher, the tribe of Naphtali,
and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם מִמַּטֵּה רְאוּבֵן וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָד וּמִמַּטֵּה זְבוּלֻן עָרִים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה׃

hebrew.text: לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם מִמַּטֵּה רְאוּבֵן וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָד וּמִמַּטֵּה זְבוּלֻן עָרִים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה׃

english.text:
[And] to the Merarites, by their clans—12 towns from the tribe of
Reuben, the tribe of Gad, and the tribe of Zebulun.

translation.text: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

verses.english:
[And] to the Merarites, by their clans—12 towns from the tribe of
Reuben, the tribe of Gad, and the tribe of Zebulun.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְוִיִּם אֶת־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה בַּגּוֹרָל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְוִיִּם אֶת־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה בַּגּוֹרָל׃

english.text:
The Israelites assigned those towns with their pastures by lot to
the Levites—as YHWH had commanded through Moses.

translation.text: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

verses.english:
The Israelites assigned those towns with their pastures by lot to
the Levites—as YHWH had commanded through Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ מִמַּטֵּה בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּה בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן אֵת הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָא אֶתְהֶן בְּשֵׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ מִמַּטֵּה בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּה בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן אֵת הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָא אֶתְהֶן בְּשֵׁם׃

english.text:
From the tribe of the Judites and the tribe of the Simeonites were
assigned the following towns, which will be listed by name;

translation.text: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name.

verses.english:
From the tribe of the Judites and the tribe of the Simeonites were
assigned the following towns, which will be listed by name;

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת הַקְּהָתִי מִבְּנֵי לֵוִי כִּי לָהֶם הָיָה הַגּוֹרָל רִאישֹׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת הַקְּהָתִי מִבְּנֵי לֵוִי כִּי לָהֶם הָיָה הַגּוֹרָל רִאישֹׁנָה׃

english.text:
they went to the descendants of Aaron among the Kohathite clans of
the Levites, for the first lot had fallen to them.

translation.text: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.

verses.english:
they went to the descendants of Aaron among the Kohathite clans of
the Levites, for the first lot had fallen to them.

verses.hebrew: אֶת־חֶלְקָת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־רְחֹב וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים אַרְבַּע׃

hebrew.text: אֶת־חֶלְקָת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־רְחֹב וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים אַרְבַּע׃

english.text: Helkath with its pastures, and Rehob with its pastures—4 towns.
