translation.text: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.english: Helkath with its pastures, and Rehob with its pastures—4 towns.

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי אֶת־עִיר מִקְלַט הָרֹצֵחַ אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־חַמֹּת דֹּאר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־קַרְתָּן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים שָׁלֹשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וּמִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי אֶת־עִיר מִקְלַט הָרֹצֵחַ אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־חַמֹּת דֹּאר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־קַרְתָּן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים שָׁלֹשׁ׃

translation.text: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammothdor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.

verses.hebrew: כּל־עָרֵי הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם שְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה עִיר וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: כּל־עָרֵי הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם שְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה עִיר וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃

english.text:
All the towns of the Gershonites, by their clans, came to 13
towns, with their pastures.

translation.text: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

verses.english:
All the towns of the Gershonites, by their clans, came to 13
towns, with their pastures.

verses.hebrew: וּלְמִשְׁפְּחוֹת בְּנֵי־מְרָרִי הַלְוִיִּם הַנּוֹתָרִים מֵאֵת מַטֵּה זְבוּלֻן אֶת־יקְנְעָם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ אֶת־קַרְתָּה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמִשְׁפְּחוֹת בְּנֵי־מְרָרִי הַלְוִיִּם הַנּוֹתָרִים מֵאֵת מַטֵּה זְבוּלֻן אֶת־יקְנְעָם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ אֶת־קַרְתָּה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ׃

english.text:
To the remaining Levites, the clans of the Merarites: From the
tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pastures, Kartah with its
pastures,

translation.text: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,

verses.english:
To the remaining Levites, the clans of the Merarites: From the
tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pastures, Kartah with its
pastures,

verses.hebrew: אֶת־דִּמְנָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ אֶת־נַהֲלָל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים אַרְבַּע׃

hebrew.text: אֶת־דִּמְנָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ אֶת־נַהֲלָל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים אַרְבַּע׃

english.text: Dimnah with its pastures, and Nahalal with its pastures—4 towns.

translation.text: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.english: Dimnah with its pastures, and Nahalal with its pastures—4 towns.

english.text:
And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her pasture lands,
and Jahazah with her pasture lands,

translation.text: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,

verses.english:
And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her pasture lands,
and Jahazah with her pasture lands,

english.text:
Kedemoth with her pasture lands, and Mephaath with her pasture
lands; four cities.

translation.text: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.english:
Kedemoth with her pasture lands, and Mephaath with her pasture
lands; four cities.

verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָד אֶת־עִיר מִקְלַט הָרֹצֵחַ אֶת־רָמֹת בַּגִּלְעָד וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־מַחֲנַיִם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ׃

hebrew.text: וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָד אֶת־עִיר מִקְלַט הָרֹצֵחַ אֶת־רָמֹת בַּגִּלְעָד וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת־מַחֲנַיִם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ׃

english.text:
From the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead—the city of refuge for
manslayers—with its pastures, Mahanaim with its pastures,

translation.text: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,

verses.english:
From the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead—the city of refuge for
manslayers—with its pastures, Mahanaim with its pastures,

verses.hebrew: אֶת־חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ אֶת־יַעְזֵר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ כּל־עָרִים אַרְבַּע׃

hebrew.text: אֶת־חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ אֶת־יַעְזֵר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁהָ כּל־עָרִים אַרְבַּע׃

english.text:
Heshbon with its pastures, and Jazer with its pastures—4 towns in
all.

translation.text: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.

verses.english:
Heshbon with its pastures, and Jazer with its pastures—4 towns in
all.

verses.hebrew: כּל־הֶעָרִים לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הַנּוֹתָרִים מִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת הַלְוִיִּם וַיְהִי גּוֹרָלָם עָרִים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה׃

hebrew.text: כּל־הֶעָרִים לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הַנּוֹתָרִים מִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת הַלְוִיִּם וַיְהִי גּוֹרָלָם עָרִים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה׃

english.text:
All the towns which went by lot to the Merarites, by their
clans—the rest of the levitical clans—came to 12 towns.

translation.text: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.

verses.english:
All the towns which went by lot to the Merarites, by their
clans—the rest of the levitical clans—came to 12 towns.

verses.hebrew: כֹּל עָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֻזַּת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עָרִים אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: כֹּל עָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֻזַּת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עָרִים אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃

english.text:
All the towns of the Levites within the holdings of the Israelites
came to 48 towns, with their pastures.

translation.text: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.

verses.english:
All the towns of the Levites within the holdings of the Israelites
came to 48 towns, with their pastures.

verses.hebrew: תִּהְיֶינָה הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה עִיר עִיר וּמִגְרָשֶׁיהָ סְבִיבֹתֶיהָ כֵּן לְכל־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: תִּהְיֶינָה הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה עִיר עִיר וּמִגְרָשֶׁיהָ סְבִיבֹתֶיהָ כֵּן לְכל־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
Thus those towns were assigned, every town with its surrounding
pasture; and so it was with all those towns.

translation.text: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.

verses.english:
Thus those towns were assigned, every town with its surrounding
pasture; and so it was with all those towns.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָתֵת לַאֲבוֹתָם וַיִּרָשׁוּהָ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־כּל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָתֵת לַאֲבוֹתָם וַיִּרָשׁוּהָ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ׃

english.text:
YHWH gave to Israel the whole country which He had sworn to their
fathers that He would assign to them; they took possession of it
and settled in it.

translation.text: And the LORD gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.

verses.english:
YHWH gave to Israel the whole country which He had sworn to their
fathers that He would assign to them; they took possession of it
and settled in it.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּנַח יְהֹוָה לָהֶם מִסָּבִיב כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבוֹתָם וְלֹא־עָמַד אִישׁ בִּפְנֵיהֶם מִכּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם אֵת כּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם נָתַן יְהֹוָה בְּיָדָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּנַח יְהֹוָה לָהֶם מִסָּבִיב כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבוֹתָם וְלֹא־עָמַד אִישׁ בִּפְנֵיהֶם מִכּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם אֵת כּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם נָתַן יְהֹוָה בְּיָדָם׃

translation.text: And the LORD gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־נָפַל דָּבָר מִכֹּל הַדָּבָר הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל הַכֹּל בָּא׃

hebrew.text: לֹא־נָפַל דָּבָר מִכֹּל הַדָּבָר הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל הַכֹּל בָּא׃

english.text:
Not one of the good things which YHWH had promised to the House of
Israel was lacking. Everything was fulfilled.

translation.text: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.

verses.english:
Not one of the good things which YHWH had promised to the House of
Israel was lacking. Everything was fulfilled.

verses.hebrew: אָז יִקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה׃

hebrew.text: אָז יִקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה׃

english.text:
Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the
half-tribe of Manasseh,

translation.text: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

verses.english:
Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the
half-tribe of Manasseh,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם אַתֶּם שְׁמַרְתֶּם אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה וַתִּשְׁמְעוּ בְקוֹלִי לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם אַתֶּם שְׁמַרְתֶּם אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה וַתִּשְׁמְעוּ בְקוֹלִי לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
and said to them, “You have observed all that Moses the servant of
YHWH commanded you, and have obeyed me in everything that I
commanded you.

translation.text: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:

verses.english:
and said to them, “You have observed all that Moses the servant of
YHWH commanded you, and have obeyed me in everything that I
commanded you.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־עֲזַבְתֶּם אֶת־אֲחֵיכֶם זֶה יָמִים רַבִּים עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִצְוַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לֹא־עֲזַבְתֶּם אֶת־אֲחֵיכֶם זֶה יָמִים רַבִּים עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִצְוַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
You have not forsaken your kinsmen through the long years down to
this day, but have faithfully observed the Instruction of YHWH
your God.

translation.text: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the LORD your God.

verses.english:
You have not forsaken your kinsmen through the long years down to
this day, but have faithfully observed the Instruction of YHWH
your God.

verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה הֵנִיחַ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לַאֲחֵיכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם וְעַתָּה פְּנוּ וּלְכוּ לָכֶם לְאהֳלֵיכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה
בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה הֵנִיחַ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לַאֲחֵיכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם וְעַתָּה פְּנוּ וּלְכוּ לָכֶם לְאהֳלֵיכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה
בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
Now YHWH your God has given your kinsmen rest, as He promised
them. Therefore turn and go to your homes, to the land of your
holdings beyond the Jordan that Moses the servant of YHWH assigned
to you.

translation.text: And now the LORD your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side Jordan.

verses.english:
Now YHWH your God has given your kinsmen rest, as He promised
them. Therefore turn and go to your homes, to the land of your
holdings beyond the Jordan that Moses the servant of YHWH assigned
to you.

verses.hebrew:
רַק שִׁמְרוּ מְאֹד לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־הַמִּצְוָה וְאֶת־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְלָלֶכֶת בְּכל־דְּרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר
מִצְוֺתָיו וּלְדבְקָה־בוֹ וּלְעבְדוֹ בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכל־נַפְשְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
רַק שִׁמְרוּ מְאֹד לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־הַמִּצְוָה וְאֶת־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָה לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְלָלֶכֶת בְּכל־דְּרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר
מִצְוֺתָיו וּלְדבְקָה־בוֹ וּלְעבְדוֹ בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכל־נַפְשְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
But be very careful to fulfill the Instruction and the Teaching
that Moses the servant of YHWH enjoined upon you, to love YHWH
your God and to walk in all His ways, and to keep His commandments
and hold fast to Him, and to serve Him with all your heart and
soul.”

translation.text: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the LORD charged you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.english:
But be very careful to fulfill the Instruction and the Teaching
that Moses the servant of YHWH enjoined upon you, to love YHWH
your God and to walk in all His ways, and to keep His commandments
and hold fast to Him, and to serve Him with all your heart and
soul.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְבָרְכֵם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶל־אהֳלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבָרְכֵם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶל־אהֳלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Then Joshua blessed them and dismissed them, and they went to
their homes.

translation.text: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.

verses.english:
Then Joshua blessed them and dismissed them, and they went to
their homes.

verses.hebrew:
וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה נָתַן מֹשֶׁה בַּבָּשָׁן וּלְחֶצְיוֹ נָתַן יְהוֹשֻׁעַ עִם־אֲחֵיהֶם (מעבר) [בְּעֵבֶר] הַיַּרְדֵּן יָמָּה וְגַם כִּי־שִׁלְּחָם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־אהֳלֵיהֶם
וַיְבָרְכֵם׃

hebrew.text:
וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה נָתַן מֹשֶׁה בַּבָּשָׁן וּלְחֶצְיוֹ נָתַן יְהוֹשֻׁעַ עִם־אֲחֵיהֶם (מעבר) [בְּעֵבֶר] הַיַּרְדֵּן יָמָּה וְגַם כִּי־שִׁלְּחָם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־אהֳלֵיהֶם
וַיְבָרְכֵם׃

english.text:
To the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had assigned territory in
Bashan, and to the other Joshua assigned [territory] on the west
side of the Jordan, with their kinsmen. Furthermore, when Joshua
sent them off to their homes, he blessed them

translation.text: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,

verses.english:
To the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had assigned territory in
Bashan, and to the other Joshua assigned [territory] on the west
side of the Jordan, with their kinsmen. Furthermore, when Joshua
sent them off to their homes, he blessed them

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר בִּנְכָסִים רַבִּים שׁוּבוּ אֶל־אהֳלֵיכֶם וּבְמִקְנֶה רַב־מְאֹד בְּכֶסֶף וּבְזָהָב וּבִנְחֹשֶׁת וּבְבַרְזֶל וּבִשְׂלָמוֹת הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד חִלְקוּ
שְׁלַל־אֹיְבֵיכֶם עִם־אֲחֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר בִּנְכָסִים רַבִּים שׁוּבוּ אֶל־אהֳלֵיכֶם וּבְמִקְנֶה רַב־מְאֹד בְּכֶסֶף וּבְזָהָב וּבִנְחֹשֶׁת וּבְבַרְזֶל וּבִשְׂלָמוֹת הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד חִלְקוּ
שְׁלַל־אֹיְבֵיכֶם עִם־אֲחֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
and said to them, “Return to your homes with great wealth—with
very much livestock, with silver and gold, with copper and iron,
and with a great quantity of clothing. Share the spoil of your
enemies with your kinsmen.”

translation.text: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.

verses.english:
and said to them, “Return to your homes with great wealth—with
very much livestock, with silver and gold, with copper and iron,
and with a great quantity of clothing. Share the spoil of your
enemies with your kinsmen.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִשִּׁלֹה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ־כְּנָעַן לָלֶכֶת אֶל־אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד אֶל־אֶרֶץ
אֲחֻזָּתָם אֲשֶׁר נֹאחֲזוּ־בָהּ עַל־פִּי יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִשִּׁלֹה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ־כְּנָעַן לָלֶכֶת אֶל־אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד אֶל־אֶרֶץ
אֲחֻזָּתָם אֲשֶׁר נֹאחֲזוּ־בָהּ עַל־פִּי יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
So the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh
left the Israelites at Shiloh, in the land of Canaan, and made
their way back to the land of Gilead, the land of their own
holding, which they had acquired by the command of YHWH through
Moses.

translation.text: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

verses.english:
So the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh
left the Israelites at Shiloh, in the land of Canaan, and made
their way back to the land of Gilead, the land of their own
holding, which they had acquired by the command of YHWH through
Moses.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־גְּלִילוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיִּבְנוּ בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ עַל־הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְבֵּחַ גָּדוֹל
לְמַרְאֶה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־גְּלִילוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיִּבְנוּ בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ עַל־הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְבֵּחַ גָּדוֹל
לְמַרְאֶה׃

english.text:
When they came to the region of the Jordan in the land of Canaan,
the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh
built an altar there by the Jordan, a great conspicuous altar.

translation.text: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.

verses.english:
When they came to the region of the Jordan in the land of Canaan,
the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh
built an altar there by the Jordan, a great conspicuous altar.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה בָנוּ בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֶל־מוּל אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֶל־גְּלִילוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן
אֶל־עֵבֶר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה בָנוּ בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֶל־מוּל אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֶל־גְּלִילוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן
אֶל־עֵבֶר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
A report reached the Israelites: “The Reubenites, the Gadites, and
the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar opposite the land
of Canaan, in the region of the Jordan, across from the
Israelites.”

translation.text: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.

verses.english:
A report reached the Israelites: “The Reubenites, the Gadites, and
the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar opposite the land
of Canaan, in the region of the Jordan, across from the
Israelites.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ כּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁלֹה לַעֲלוֹת עֲלֵיהֶם לַצָּבָא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ כּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁלֹה לַעֲלוֹת עֲלֵיהֶם לַצָּבָא׃

english.text:
When the Israelites heard this, the whole community of the
Israelites assembled at Shiloh to make war on them.

translation.text: And when the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.

verses.english:
When the Israelites heard this, the whole community of the
Israelites assembled at Shiloh to make war on them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וְאֶל־בְּנֵי־גָד וְאֶל־חֲצִי שֵׁבֶט־מְנַשֶּׁה אֶל־אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד אֶת־פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וְאֶל־בְּנֵי־גָד וְאֶל־חֲצִי שֵׁבֶט־מְנַשֶּׁה אֶל־אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד אֶת־פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
But [first] the Israelites sent the priest Phinehas son of Eleazar
to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh in
the land of Gilead,

translation.text: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,

verses.english:
But [first] the Israelites sent the priest Phinehas son of Eleazar
to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh in
the land of Gilead,

verses.hebrew: וַעֲשָׂרָה נְשִׂאִים עִמּוֹ נָשִׂיא אֶחָד נָשִׂיא אֶחָד לְבֵית אָב לְכֹל מַטּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִישׁ רֹאשׁ בֵּית־אֲבוֹתָם הֵמָּה לְאַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲשָׂרָה נְשִׂאִים עִמּוֹ נָשִׂיא אֶחָד נָשִׂיא אֶחָד לְבֵית אָב לְכֹל מַטּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִישׁ רֹאשׁ בֵּית־אֲבוֹתָם הֵמָּה לְאַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
accompanied by ten chieftains, one chieftain from each ancestral
house of each of the tribes of Israel; they were every one of them
heads of ancestral houses of the contingents of Israel.

translation.text: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.

verses.english:
accompanied by ten chieftains, one chieftain from each ancestral
house of each of the tribes of Israel; they were every one of them
heads of ancestral houses of the contingents of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וְאֶל־בְּנֵי־גָד וְאֶל־חֲצִי שֵׁבֶט־מְנַשֶּׁה אֶל־אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד וַיְדַבְּרוּ אִתָּם לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וְאֶל־בְּנֵי־גָד וְאֶל־חֲצִי שֵׁבֶט־מְנַשֶּׁה אֶל־אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד וַיְדַבְּרוּ אִתָּם לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
When they came to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe
of Manasseh in the land of Gilead, they spoke to them as follows:

translation.text: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,

verses.english:
When they came to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe
of Manasseh in the land of Gilead, they spoke to them as follows:

verses.hebrew:
כֹּה אָמְרוּ כֹּל עֲדַת יְהֹוָה מָה־הַמַּעַל הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר מְעַלְתֶּם בֵּאלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָשׁוּב הַיּוֹם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה בִּבְנוֹתְכֶם לָכֶם מִזְבֵּחַ לִמְרדְכֶם הַיּוֹם
בַּיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
כֹּה אָמְרוּ כֹּל עֲדַת יְהֹוָה מָה־הַמַּעַל הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר מְעַלְתֶּם בֵּאלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָשׁוּב הַיּוֹם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה בִּבְנוֹתְכֶם לָכֶם מִזְבֵּחַ לִמְרדְכֶם הַיּוֹם
בַּיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Thus said the whole community of YHWH: What is this treachery
that you have committed this day against the God of Israel,
turning away from YHWH, building yourselves an altar and rebelling
this day against YHWH!

translation.text: Thus saith the whole congregation of the LORD, What trespass is this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the LORD, in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the LORD?

verses.english:
“Thus said the whole community of YHWH: What is this treachery
that you have committed this day against the God of Israel,
turning away from YHWH, building yourselves an altar and rebelling
this day against YHWH!

verses.hebrew: הַמְעַט־לָנוּ אֶת־עֲוֺן פְּעוֹר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הִטַּהַרְנוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיְהִי הַנֶּגֶף בַּעֲדַת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: הַמְעַט־לָנוּ אֶת־עֲוֺן פְּעוֹר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הִטַּהַרְנוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיְהִי הַנֶּגֶף בַּעֲדַת יְהֹוָה׃

translation.text: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the LORD,

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם תָּשֻׁבוּ הַיּוֹם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וְהָיָה אַתֶּם תִּמְרְדוּ הַיּוֹם בַּיהֹוָה וּמָחָר אֶל־כּל־עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל יִקְצֹף׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם תָּשֻׁבוּ הַיּוֹם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וְהָיָה אַתֶּם תִּמְרְדוּ הַיּוֹם בַּיהֹוָה וּמָחָר אֶל־כּל־עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל יִקְצֹף׃

english.text:
and now you would turn away from YHWH! If you rebel against YHWH
today, tomorrow He will be angry with the whole community of
Israel.

translation.text: But that ye must turn away this day from following the LORD? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to day against the LORD, that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.

verses.english:
and now you would turn away from YHWH! If you rebel against YHWH
today, tomorrow He will be angry with the whole community of
Israel.

verses.hebrew:
וְאַךְ אִם־טְמֵאָה אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם עִבְרוּ לָכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁכַן־שָׁם מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה וְהֵאָחֲזוּ בְּתוֹכֵנוּ וּבַיהֹוָה אַל־תִּמְרֹדוּ וְאֹתָנוּ
אַל־תִּמְרֹדוּ בִּבְנֹתְכֶם לָכֶם מִזְבֵּחַ מִבַּלְעֲדֵי מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וְאַךְ אִם־טְמֵאָה אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם עִבְרוּ לָכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁכַן־שָׁם מִשְׁכַּן יְהֹוָה וְהֵאָחֲזוּ בְּתוֹכֵנוּ וּבַיהֹוָה אַל־תִּמְרֹדוּ וְאֹתָנוּ
אַל־תִּמְרֹדוּ בִּבְנֹתְכֶם לָכֶם מִזְבֵּחַ מִבַּלְעֲדֵי מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text:
If it is because the land of your holding is unclean, cross over
into the land of YHWH’s own holding, where the Tabernacle of YHWH
abides, and acquire holdings among us. But do not rebel against
YHWH, and do not rebel against us by building for yourselves an
altar other than the altar of YHWH our God.

translation.text: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the LORD, wherein the LORD’s tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the LORD, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the LORD our God.

verses.english:
If it is because the land of your holding is unclean, cross over
into the land of YHWH’s own holding, where the Tabernacle of YHWH
abides, and acquire holdings among us. But do not rebel against
YHWH, and do not rebel against us by building for yourselves an
altar other than the altar of YHWH our God.

verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא עָכָן בֶּן־זֶרַח מָעַל מַעַל בַּחֵרֶם וְעַל־כּל־עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיָה קָצֶף וְהוּא אִישׁ אֶחָד לֹא גָוַע בַּעֲוֺנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: הֲלוֹא עָכָן בֶּן־זֶרַח מָעַל מַעַל בַּחֵרֶם וְעַל־כּל־עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיָה קָצֶף וְהוּא אִישׁ אֶחָד לֹא גָוַע בַּעֲוֺנוֹ׃

english.text:
When Achan son of Zerah violated the proscription, anger struck
the whole community of Israel; he was not the only one who
perished for that sin.”

translation.text: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.

verses.english:
When Achan son of Zerah violated the proscription, anger struck
the whole community of Israel; he was not the only one who
perished for that sin.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֶת־רָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשֶּׁה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֶת־רָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh
replied to the heads of the contingents of Israel: They said,

translation.text: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,

verses.english:
The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh
replied to the heads of the contingents of Israel: They said,

verses.hebrew: אֵל אֱלֹהִים יְהֹוָה אֵל אֱלֹהִים יְהֹוָה הוּא יֹדֵעַ וְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא יֵדָע אִם־בְּמֶרֶד וְאִם־בְּמַעַל בַּיהֹוָה אַל־תּוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: אֵל אֱלֹהִים יְהֹוָה אֵל אֱלֹהִים יְהֹוָה הוּא יֹדֵעַ וְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא יֵדָע אִם־בְּמֶרֶד וְאִם־בְּמַעַל בַּיהֹוָה אַל־תּוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
“God, YHWH God! God, YHWH God! He knows, and Israel too shall
know! If we acted in rebellion or in treachery against YHWH, do
not vindicate us this day!

translation.text: The LORD God of gods, the LORD God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the LORD, (save us not this day,)

verses.english:
“God, YHWH God! God, YHWH God! He knows, and Israel too shall
know! If we acted in rebellion or in treachery against YHWH, do
not vindicate us this day!

verses.hebrew: לִבְנוֹת לָנוּ מִזְבֵּחַ לָשׁוּב מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וְאִם־לְהַעֲלוֹת עָלָיו עוֹלָה וּמִנְחָה וְאִם־לַעֲשׂוֹת עָלָיו זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים יְהֹוָה הוּא יְבַקֵּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: לִבְנוֹת לָנוּ מִזְבֵּחַ לָשׁוּב מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וְאִם־לְהַעֲלוֹת עָלָיו עוֹלָה וּמִנְחָה וְאִם־לַעֲשׂוֹת עָלָיו זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים יְהֹוָה הוּא יְבַקֵּשׁ׃

english.text:
If we built an altar to turn away from YHWH, if it was to offer
burnt offerings or meal offerings upon it, or to present
sacrifices of well-being upon it, may YHWH Himself demand [a
reckoning].

translation.text: That we have built us an altar to turn from following the LORD, or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let the LORD himself require it;

verses.english:
If we built an altar to turn away from YHWH, if it was to offer
burnt offerings or meal offerings upon it, or to present
sacrifices of well-being upon it, may YHWH Himself demand [a
reckoning].

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא מִדְּאָגָה מִדָּבָר עָשִׂינוּ אֶת־זֹאת לֵאמֹר מָחָר יֹאמְרוּ בְנֵיכֶם לְבָנֵינוּ לֵאמֹר מַה־לָּכֶם וְלַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־לֹא מִדְּאָגָה מִדָּבָר עָשִׂינוּ אֶת־זֹאת לֵאמֹר מָחָר יֹאמְרוּ בְנֵיכֶם לְבָנֵינוּ לֵאמֹר מַה־לָּכֶם וְלַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
We did this thing only out of our concern that, in time to come,
your children might say to our children, ‘What have you to do with
YHWH, the God of Israel?

translation.text: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with the LORD God of Israel?

verses.english:
We did this thing only out of our concern that, in time to come,
your children might say to our children, ‘What have you to do with
YHWH, the God of Israel?

verses.hebrew:
וּגְבוּל נָתַן־יְהֹוָה בֵּינֵנוּ וּבֵינֵיכֶם בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן אֵין־לָכֶם חֵלֶק בַּיהֹוָה וְהִשְׁבִּיתוּ בְנֵיכֶם אֶת־בָּנֵינוּ לְבִלְתִּי יְרֹא
אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וּגְבוּל נָתַן־יְהֹוָה בֵּינֵנוּ וּבֵינֵיכֶם בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן אֵין־לָכֶם חֵלֶק בַּיהֹוָה וְהִשְׁבִּיתוּ בְנֵיכֶם אֶת־בָּנֵינוּ לְבִלְתִּי יְרֹא
אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
YHWH has made the Jordan a boundary between you and us, O
Reubenites and Gadites; you have no share in YHWH!’ Thus your
children might prevent our children from worshiping YHWH.

translation.text: For the LORD hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the LORD: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the LORD.

verses.english:
YHWH has made the Jordan a boundary between you and us, O
Reubenites and Gadites; you have no share in YHWH!’ Thus your
children might prevent our children from worshiping YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַנֹּאמֶר נַעֲשֶׂה־נָּא לָנוּ לִבְנוֹת אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא לְעוֹלָה וְלֹא לְזָבַח׃

hebrew.text: וַנֹּאמֶר נַעֲשֶׂה־נָּא לָנוּ לִבְנוֹת אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא לְעוֹלָה וְלֹא לְזָבַח׃

english.text:
So we decided to provide [a witness] for ourselves by building an
altar—not for burnt offerings or [other] sacrifices,

translation.text: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:

verses.english:
So we decided to provide [a witness] for ourselves by building an
altar—not for burnt offerings or [other] sacrifices,

verses.hebrew:
כִּי עֵד הוּא בֵּינֵינוּ וּבֵינֵיכֶם וּבֵין דֹּרוֹתֵינוּ אַחֲרֵינוּ לַעֲבֹד אֶת־עֲבֹדַת יְהֹוָה לְפָנָיו בְּעֹלוֹתֵינוּ וּבִזְבָחֵינוּ וּבִשְׁלָמֵינוּ וְלֹא־יֹאמְרוּ בְנֵיכֶם מָחָר
לְבָנֵינוּ אֵין־לָכֶם חֵלֶק בַּיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי עֵד הוּא בֵּינֵינוּ וּבֵינֵיכֶם וּבֵין דֹּרוֹתֵינוּ אַחֲרֵינוּ לַעֲבֹד אֶת־עֲבֹדַת יְהֹוָה לְפָנָיו בְּעֹלוֹתֵינוּ וּבִזְבָחֵינוּ וּבִשְׁלָמֵינוּ וְלֹא־יֹאמְרוּ בְנֵיכֶם מָחָר
לְבָנֵינוּ אֵין־לָכֶם חֵלֶק בַּיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
but as a witness between you and us, and between the generations
to come—that we may perform the service of YHWH before Him with
our burnt offerings, our sacrifices, and our offerings of
well-being; and that your children should not say to our children
in time to come, ‘You have no share in YHWH.’

translation.text: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the LORD.

verses.english:
but as a witness between you and us, and between the generations
to come—that we may perform the service of YHWH before Him with
our burnt offerings, our sacrifices, and our offerings of
well-being; and that your children should not say to our children
in time to come, ‘You have no share in YHWH.’

verses.hebrew:
וַנֹּאמֶר וְהָיָה כִּי־יֹאמְרוּ אֵלֵינוּ וְאֶל־דֹּרֹתֵינוּ מָחָר וְאָמַרְנוּ רְאוּ אֶת־תַּבְנִית מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לֹא לְעוֹלָה וְלֹא לְזֶבַח כִּי־עֵד הוּא
בֵּינֵינוּ וּבֵינֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַנֹּאמֶר וְהָיָה כִּי־יֹאמְרוּ אֵלֵינוּ וְאֶל־דֹּרֹתֵינוּ מָחָר וְאָמַרְנוּ רְאוּ אֶת־תַּבְנִית מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לֹא לְעוֹלָה וְלֹא לְזֶבַח כִּי־עֵד הוּא
בֵּינֵינוּ וּבֵינֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
We reasoned: should they speak thus to us and to our children in
time to come, we would reply, ‘See the replica of YHWH’s altar,
which our fathers made—not for burnt offerings or sacrifices, but
as a witness between you and us.’

translation.text: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again, Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.

verses.english:
We reasoned: should they speak thus to us and to our children in
time to come, we would reply, ‘See the replica of YHWH’s altar,
which our fathers made—not for burnt offerings or sacrifices, but
as a witness between you and us.’

verses.hebrew:
חָלִילָה לָּנוּ מִמֶּנּוּ לִמְרֹד בַּיהֹוָה וְלָשׁוּב הַיּוֹם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה לִבְנוֹת מִזְבֵּחַ לְעֹלָה לְמִנְחָה וּלְזָבַח מִלְּבַד מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי
מִשְׁכָּנוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
חָלִילָה לָּנוּ מִמֶּנּוּ לִמְרֹד בַּיהֹוָה וְלָשׁוּב הַיּוֹם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה לִבְנוֹת מִזְבֵּחַ לְעֹלָה לְמִנְחָה וּלְזָבַח מִלְּבַד מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי
מִשְׁכָּנוֹ׃

english.text:
Far be it from us to rebel against YHWH, or to turn away this day
from YHWH and build an altar for burnt offerings, meal offerings,
and sacrifices other than the altar of YHWH our God which stands
before His Tabernacle.”

translation.text: God forbid that we should rebel against the LORD, and turn this day from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of the LORD our God that is before his tabernacle.

verses.english:
Far be it from us to rebel against YHWH, or to turn away this day
from YHWH and build an altar for burnt offerings, meal offerings,
and sacrifices other than the altar of YHWH our God which stands
before His Tabernacle.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁמַע פִּינְחָס הַכֹּהֵן וּנְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה וְרָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וּבְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה
וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁמַע פִּינְחָס הַכֹּהֵן וּנְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה וְרָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד וּבְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה
וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
When the priest Phinehas and the chieftains of the community—the
heads of the contingents of Israel—who were with him heard the
explanation given by the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the
Manassites, they approved.

translation.text: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.

verses.english:
When the priest Phinehas and the chieftains of the community—the
heads of the contingents of Israel—who were with him heard the
explanation given by the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the
Manassites, they approved.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶל־בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וְאֶל־בְּנֵי־גָד וְאֶל־בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה הַיּוֹם יָדַעְנוּ כִּי־בְתוֹכֵנוּ יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מְעַלְתֶּם בַּיהֹוָה
הַמַּעַל הַזֶּה אָז הִצַּלְתֶּם אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶל־בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וְאֶל־בְּנֵי־גָד וְאֶל־בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה הַיּוֹם יָדַעְנוּ כִּי־בְתוֹכֵנוּ יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מְעַלְתֶּם בַּיהֹוָה
הַמַּעַל הַזֶּה אָז הִצַּלְתֶּם אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The priest Phinehas son of Eleazar said to the Reubenites, the
Gadites, and the Manassites, “Now we know that YHWH is in our
midst, since you have not committed such treachery against YHWH.
You have indeed saved the Israelites from punishment by YHWH.”

translation.text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the LORD is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD.

verses.english:
The priest Phinehas son of Eleazar said to the Reubenites, the
Gadites, and the Manassites, “Now we know that YHWH is in our
midst, since you have not committed such treachery against YHWH.
You have indeed saved the Israelites from punishment by YHWH.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשׁב פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְהַנְּשִׂיאִים מֵאֵת בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּמֵאֵת בְּנֵי־גָד מֵאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד אֶל־אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּשִׁבוּ אוֹתָם
דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשׁב פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְהַנְּשִׂיאִים מֵאֵת בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּמֵאֵת בְּנֵי־גָד מֵאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד אֶל־אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּשִׁבוּ אוֹתָם
דָּבָר׃

english.text:
Then the priest Phinehas son of Eleazar and the chieftains
returned from the Reubenites and the Gadites in the land of Gilead
to the Israelites in the land of Canaan, and gave them their
report.

translation.text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

verses.english:
Then the priest Phinehas son of Eleazar and the chieftains
returned from the Reubenites and the Gadites in the land of Gilead
to the Israelites in the land of Canaan, and gave them their
report.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְבָרְכוּ אֱלֹהִים בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא אָמְרוּ לַעֲלוֹת עֲלֵיהֶם לַצָּבָא לְשַׁחֵת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן
וּבְנֵי־גָד יֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְבָרְכוּ אֱלֹהִים בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא אָמְרוּ לַעֲלוֹת עֲלֵיהֶם לַצָּבָא לְשַׁחֵת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן
וּבְנֵי־גָד יֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ׃

english.text:
The Israelites were pleased, and the Israelites praised God; and
they spoke no more of going to war against them, to ravage the
land in which the Reubenites and Gadites dwelt.

translation.text: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.

verses.english:
The Israelites were pleased, and the Israelites praised God; and
they spoke no more of going to war against them, to ravage the
land in which the Reubenites and Gadites dwelt.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד לַמִּזְבֵּחַ כִּי עֵד הוּא בֵּינֹתֵינוּ כִּי יְהֹוָה הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וּבְנֵי־גָד לַמִּזְבֵּחַ כִּי עֵד הוּא בֵּינֹתֵינוּ כִּי יְהֹוָה הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
The Reubenites and the Gadites named the altar [“Witness”],
meaning, “It is a witness between us and them that YHWH is [our]
God.”

translation.text: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the LORD is God.

verses.english:
The Reubenites and the Gadites named the altar [“Witness”],
meaning, “It is a witness between us and them that YHWH is [our]
God.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִיָּמִים רַבִּים אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־הֵנִיחַ יְהֹוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מִכּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם מִסָּבִיב וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִיָּמִים רַבִּים אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־הֵנִיחַ יְהֹוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מִכּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם מִסָּבִיב וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים׃

english.text:
Much later, after YHWH had given Israel rest from all the enemies
around them, and when Joshua was old and well advanced in years,

translation.text: And it came to pass a long time after that the LORD had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age.

verses.english:
Much later, after YHWH had given Israel rest from all the enemies
around them, and when Joshua was old and well advanced in years,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לִזְקֵנָיו וּלְרָאשָׁיו וּלְשֹׁפְטָיו וּלְשֹׁטְרָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אֲנִי זָקַנְתִּי בָּאתִי בַּיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לִזְקֵנָיו וּלְרָאשָׁיו וּלְשֹׁפְטָיו וּלְשֹׁטְרָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אֲנִי זָקַנְתִּי בָּאתִי בַּיָּמִים׃

english.text:
Joshua summoned all Israel, their elders and commanders, their
magistrates and officials, and said to them: “I have grown old and
am advanced in years.

translation.text: And Joshua called for all Israel, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:

verses.english:
Joshua summoned all Israel, their elders and commanders, their
magistrates and officials, and said to them: “I have grown old and
am advanced in years.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם רְאִיתֶם אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְכל־הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִפְּנֵיכֶם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא הַנִּלְחָם לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם רְאִיתֶם אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְכל־הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִפְּנֵיכֶם כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא הַנִּלְחָם לָכֶם׃

english.text:
You have seen all that YHWH your God has done to all those nations
on your account, for it was YHWH your God who fought for you.

translation.text: And ye have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for the LORD your God is he that hath fought for you.

verses.english:
You have seen all that YHWH your God has done to all those nations
on your account, for it was YHWH your God who fought for you.

verses.hebrew: רְאוּ הִפַּלְתִּי לָכֶם אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם הַנִּשְׁאָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּנַחֲלָה לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְכל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִכְרַתִּי וְהַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל מְבוֹא הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: רְאוּ הִפַּלְתִּי לָכֶם אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם הַנִּשְׁאָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּנַחֲלָה לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְכל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִכְרַתִּי וְהַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל מְבוֹא הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

english.text:
See, I have allotted to you, by your tribes, [the territory of]
these nations that still remain, and that of all the nations that
I have destroyed, from the Jordan to the Mediterranean Sea in the
west.

translation.text: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.

verses.english:
See, I have allotted to you, by your tribes, [the territory of]
these nations that still remain, and that of all the nations that
I have destroyed, from the Jordan to the Mediterranean Sea in the
west.

verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא יֶהְדֳּפֵם מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְהוֹרִישׁ אֹתָם מִלִּפְנֵיכֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת־אַרְצָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא יֶהְדֳּפֵם מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְהוֹרִישׁ אֹתָם מִלִּפְנֵיכֶם וִירִשְׁתֶּם אֶת־אַרְצָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לָכֶם׃

english.text:
YHWH your God Himself will thrust them out on your account and
drive them out to make way for you, and you shall possess their
land as YHWH your God promised you.

translation.text: And the LORD your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the LORD your God hath promised unto you.

verses.english:
YHWH your God Himself will thrust them out on your account and
drive them out to make way for you, and you shall possess their
land as YHWH your God promised you.

verses.hebrew: וַחֲזַקְתֶּם מְאֹד לִשְׁמֹר וְלַעֲשׂוֹת אֵת כּל־הַכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה לְבִלְתִּי סוּר־מִמֶּנּוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול׃

hebrew.text: וַחֲזַקְתֶּם מְאֹד לִשְׁמֹר וְלַעֲשׂוֹת אֵת כּל־הַכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה לְבִלְתִּי סוּר־מִמֶּנּוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול׃

english.text:
“But be most resolute to observe faithfully all that is written in
the Book of the Teaching of Moses, without ever deviating from it
to the right or to the left,

translation.text: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;

verses.english:
“But be most resolute to observe faithfully all that is written in
the Book of the Teaching of Moses, without ever deviating from it
to the right or to the left,

verses.hebrew: לְבִלְתִּי־בֹא בַּגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה הַנִּשְׁאָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אִתְּכֶם וּבְשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיהֶם לֹא־תַזְכִּירוּ וְלֹא תַשְׁבִּיעוּ וְלֹא תַעַבְדוּם וְלֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: לְבִלְתִּי־בֹא בַּגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה הַנִּשְׁאָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אִתְּכֶם וּבְשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיהֶם לֹא־תַזְכִּירוּ וְלֹא תַשְׁבִּיעוּ וְלֹא תַעַבְדוּם וְלֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם׃

english.text:
and without intermingling with these nations that are left among
you. Do not utter the names of their gods or swear by them; do not
serve them or bow down to them.

translation.text: That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:

verses.english:
and without intermingling with these nations that are left among
you. Do not utter the names of their gods or swear by them; do not
serve them or bow down to them.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם תִּדְבָּקוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם־בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם תִּדְבָּקוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text: But hold fast to YHWH your God as you have done to this day.

translation.text: But cleave unto the LORD your God, as ye have done unto this day.

verses.english: But hold fast to YHWH your God as you have done to this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹרֶשׁ יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵיכֶם גּוֹיִם גְּדֹלִים וַעֲצוּמִים וְאַתֶּם לֹא־עָמַד אִישׁ בִּפְנֵיכֶם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹרֶשׁ יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵיכֶם גּוֹיִם גְּדֹלִים וַעֲצוּמִים וְאַתֶּם לֹא־עָמַד אִישׁ בִּפְנֵיכֶם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
“YHWH has driven out great, powerful nations on your account, and
not a man has withstood you to this day.

translation.text: For the LORD hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day.

verses.english:
“YHWH has driven out great, powerful nations on your account, and
not a man has withstood you to this day.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ־אֶחָד מִכֶּם יִרְדּף־אָלֶף כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא הַנִּלְחָם לָכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אִישׁ־אֶחָד מִכֶּם יִרְדּף־אָלֶף כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא הַנִּלְחָם לָכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָכֶם׃

english.text:
A single man of you would put a thousand to flight, for YHWH your
God Himself has been fighting for you, as He promised you.

translation.text: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the LORD your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.

verses.english:
A single man of you would put a thousand to flight, for YHWH your
God Himself has been fighting for you, as He promised you.

verses.hebrew: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם מְאֹד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם מְאֹד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
For your own sakes, therefore, be most mindful to love YHWH your
God.

translation.text: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the LORD your God.

verses.english:
For your own sakes, therefore, be most mindful to love YHWH your
God.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־שׁוֹב תָּשׁוּבוּ וּדְבַקְתֶּם בְּיֶתֶר הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה הַנִּשְׁאָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אִתְּכֶם וְהִתְחַתַּנְתֶּם בָּהֶם וּבָאתֶם בָּהֶם וְהֵם בָּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם־שׁוֹב תָּשׁוּבוּ וּדְבַקְתֶּם בְּיֶתֶר הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה הַנִּשְׁאָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אִתְּכֶם וְהִתְחַתַּנְתֶּם בָּהֶם וּבָאתֶם בָּהֶם וְהֵם בָּכֶם׃

english.text:
For should you turn away and attach yourselves to the remnant of
those nations—to those that are left among you—and intermarry with
them, you joining them and they joining you,

translation.text: Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:

verses.english:
For should you turn away and attach yourselves to the remnant of
those nations—to those that are left among you—and intermarry with
them, you joining them and they joining you,

verses.hebrew:
יָדוֹעַ תֵּדְעוּ כִּי לֹא יוֹסִיף יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְהוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִלִּפְנֵיכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְפַח וּלְמוֹקֵשׁ וּלְשֹׁטֵט בְּצִדֵּיכֶם וְלִצְנִנִים
בְּעֵינֵיכֶם עַד־אֲבדְכֶם מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
יָדוֹעַ תֵּדְעוּ כִּי לֹא יוֹסִיף יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְהוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִלִּפְנֵיכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְפַח וּלְמוֹקֵשׁ וּלְשֹׁטֵט בְּצִדֵּיכֶם וְלִצְנִנִים
בְּעֵינֵיכֶם עַד־אֲבדְכֶם מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
know for certain that YHWH your God will not continue to drive
these nations out before you; they shall become a snare and a trap
for you, a scourge to your sides and thorns in your eyes, until
you perish from this good land that YHWH your God has given you.

translation.text: Know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

verses.english:
know for certain that YHWH your God will not continue to drive
these nations out before you; they shall become a snare and a trap
for you, a scourge to your sides and thorns in your eyes, until
you perish from this good land that YHWH your God has given you.

verses.hebrew:
וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הוֹלֵךְ הַיּוֹם בְּדֶרֶךְ כּל־הָאָרֶץ וִידַעְתֶּם בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכל־נַפְשְׁכֶם כִּי לֹא־נָפַל דָּבָר אֶחָד מִכֹּל הַדְּבָרִים הַטּוֹבִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר
יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם עֲלֵיכֶם הַכֹּל בָּאוּ לָכֶם לֹא־נָפַל מִמֶּנּוּ דָּבָר אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הוֹלֵךְ הַיּוֹם בְּדֶרֶךְ כּל־הָאָרֶץ וִידַעְתֶּם בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכל־נַפְשְׁכֶם כִּי לֹא־נָפַל דָּבָר אֶחָד מִכֹּל הַדְּבָרִים הַטּוֹבִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר
יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם עֲלֵיכֶם הַכֹּל בָּאוּ לָכֶם לֹא־נָפַל מִמֶּנּוּ דָּבָר אֶחָד׃

english.text:
“I am now going the way of all the earth. Acknowledge with all
your heart and soul that not one of the good things that YHWH your
God promised you has failed to happen; they have all come true for
you, not a single one has failed.

translation.text: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing hath failed thereof.

verses.english:
“I am now going the way of all the earth. Acknowledge with all
your heart and soul that not one of the good things that YHWH your
God promised you has failed to happen; they have all come true for
you, not a single one has failed.

verses.hebrew:
וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּא עֲלֵיכֶם כּל־הַדָּבָר הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲלֵיכֶם כֵּן יָבִיא יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם אֵת כּל־הַדָּבָר הָרָע עַד־הַשְׁמִידוֹ אוֹתְכֶם מֵעַל
הָאֲדָמָה הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּא עֲלֵיכֶם כּל־הַדָּבָר הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲלֵיכֶם כֵּן יָבִיא יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם אֵת כּל־הַדָּבָר הָרָע עַד־הַשְׁמִידוֹ אוֹתְכֶם מֵעַל
הָאֲדָמָה הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
But just as every good thing that YHWH your God promised you has
been fulfilled for you, so YHWH can bring upon you every evil
thing until He has wiped you off this good land that YHWH your God
has given you.

translation.text: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which the LORD your God promised you; so shall the LORD bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

verses.english:
But just as every good thing that YHWH your God promised you has
been fulfilled for you, so YHWH can bring upon you every evil
thing until He has wiped you off this good land that YHWH your God
has given you.

verses.hebrew:
בְּעבְרְכֶם אֶת־בְּרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם וַהֲלַכְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם לָהֶם וְחָרָה אַף־יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וַאֲבַדְתֶּם
מְהֵרָה מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
בְּעבְרְכֶם אֶת־בְּרִית יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶתְכֶם וַהֲלַכְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם לָהֶם וְחָרָה אַף־יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וַאֲבַדְתֶּם
מְהֵרָה מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָכֶם׃

english.text:
If you break the covenant that YHWH your God enjoined upon you,
and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, then YHWH’s
anger will burn against you, and you shall quickly perish from the
good land that He has given you.”

translation.text: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.

verses.english:
If you break the covenant that YHWH your God enjoined upon you,
and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, then YHWH’s
anger will burn against you, and you shall quickly perish from the
good land that He has given you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱסֹף יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁכֶמָה וַיִּקְרָא לְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּלְרָאשָׁיו וּלְשֹׁפְטָיו וּלְשֹׁטְרָיו וַיִּתְיַצְּבוּ לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־כּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁכֶמָה וַיִּקְרָא לְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּלְרָאשָׁיו וּלְשֹׁפְטָיו וּלְשֹׁטְרָיו וַיִּתְיַצְּבוּ לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem. He summoned
Israel’s elders and commanders, magistrates and officers; and they
presented themselves before God.

translation.text: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

verses.english:
Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem. He summoned
Israel’s elders and commanders, magistrates and officers; and they
presented themselves before God.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־כּל־הָעָם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר יָשְׁבוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם מֵעוֹלָם תֶּרַח אֲבִי אַבְרָהָם וַאֲבִי נָחוֹר וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים
אֲחֵרִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־כּל־הָעָם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר יָשְׁבוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם מֵעוֹלָם תֶּרַח אֲבִי אַבְרָהָם וַאֲבִי נָחוֹר וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים
אֲחֵרִים׃

english.text:
Then Joshua said to all the people, “Thus said YHWH, the God of
Israel: In olden times, your forefathers—Terah, father of Abraham
and father of Nahor—lived beyond the Euphrates and worshiped other
gods.

translation.text: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.

verses.english:
Then Joshua said to all the people, “Thus said YHWH, the God of
Israel: In olden times, your forefathers—Terah, father of Abraham
and father of Nahor—lived beyond the Euphrates and worshiped other
gods.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶקַּח אֶת־אֲבִיכֶם אֶת־אַבְרָהָם מֵעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וָאוֹלֵךְ אֹתוֹ בְּכל־אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן (וארב) [וָאַרְבֶּה] אֶת־זַרְעוֹ וָאֶתֶּן־לוֹ אֶת־יִצְחָק׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶקַּח אֶת־אֲבִיכֶם אֶת־אַבְרָהָם מֵעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וָאוֹלֵךְ אֹתוֹ בְּכל־אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן (וארב) [וָאַרְבֶּה] אֶת־זַרְעוֹ וָאֶתֶּן־לוֹ אֶת־יִצְחָק׃

english.text:
But I took your father Abraham from beyond the Euphrates and led
him through the whole land of Canaan and multiplied his offspring.
I gave him Isaac,

translation.text: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.

verses.english:
But I took your father Abraham from beyond the Euphrates and led
him through the whole land of Canaan and multiplied his offspring.
I gave him Isaac,

verses.hebrew: וָאֶתֵּן לְיִצְחָק אֶת־יַעֲקֹב וְאֶת־עֵשָׂו וָאֶתֵּן לְעֵשָׂו אֶת־הַר שֵׂעִיר לָרֶשֶׁת אוֹתוֹ וְיַעֲקֹב וּבָנָיו יָרְדוּ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶתֵּן לְיִצְחָק אֶת־יַעֲקֹב וְאֶת־עֵשָׂו וָאֶתֵּן לְעֵשָׂו אֶת־הַר שֵׂעִיר לָרֶשֶׁת אוֹתוֹ וְיַעֲקֹב וּבָנָיו יָרְדוּ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau the hill country
of Seir as his possession, while Jacob and his children went down
to Egypt.

translation.text: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

verses.english:
and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau the hill country
of Seir as his possession, while Jacob and his children went down
to Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁלַח אֶת־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹן וָאֶגֹּף אֶת־מִצְרַיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְאַחַר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶשְׁלַח אֶת־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹן וָאֶגֹּף אֶת־מִצְרַיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְאַחַר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
“Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt with [the
wonders] that I wrought in their midst, after which I freed you—

translation.text: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

verses.english:
“Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt with [the
wonders] that I wrought in their midst, after which I freed you—

verses.hebrew: וָאוֹצִיא אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וַתָּבֹאוּ הַיָּמָּה וַיִּרְדְּפוּ מִצְרַיִם אַחֲרֵי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּרֶכֶב וּבְפָרָשִׁים יַם־סוּף׃

hebrew.text: וָאוֹצִיא אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וַתָּבֹאוּ הַיָּמָּה וַיִּרְדְּפוּ מִצְרַיִם אַחֲרֵי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּרֶכֶב וּבְפָרָשִׁים יַם־סוּף׃

english.text:
I freed your fathers—from Egypt, and you came to the Sea. But the
Egyptians pursued your fathers to the Sea of Reeds with chariots
and horsemen.

translation.text: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.

verses.english:
I freed your fathers—from Egypt, and you came to the Sea. But the
Egyptians pursued your fathers to the Sea of Reeds with chariots
and horsemen.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיָּשֶׂם מַאֲפֵל בֵּינֵיכֶם וּבֵין הַמִּצְרִים וַיָּבֵא עָלָיו אֶת־הַיָּם וַיְכַסֵּהוּ וַתִּרְאֶינָה עֵינֵיכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי בְּמִצְרָיִם
וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בַמִּדְבָּר יָמִים רַבִּים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיָּשֶׂם מַאֲפֵל בֵּינֵיכֶם וּבֵין הַמִּצְרִים וַיָּבֵא עָלָיו אֶת־הַיָּם וַיְכַסֵּהוּ וַתִּרְאֶינָה עֵינֵיכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי בְּמִצְרָיִם
וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בַמִּדְבָּר יָמִים רַבִּים׃

english.text:
They cried out to YHWH, and He put darkness between you and the
Egyptians; then He brought the Sea upon them, and it covered them.
Your own eyes saw what I did to the Egyptians. “After you had
lived a long time in the wilderness,

translation.text: And when they cried unto the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.

verses.english:
They cried out to YHWH, and He put darkness between you and the
Egyptians; then He brought the Sea upon them, and it covered them.
Your own eyes saw what I did to the Egyptians. “After you had
lived a long time in the wilderness,

verses.hebrew: (ואבאה) [וָאָבִיא] אֶתְכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ הָאֱמֹרִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ אִתְּכֶם וָאֶתֵּן אוֹתָם בְּיֶדְכֶם וַתִּירְשׁוּ אֶת־אַרְצָם וָאַשְׁמִידֵם מִפְּנֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: (ואבאה) [וָאָבִיא] אֶתְכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ הָאֱמֹרִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ אִתְּכֶם וָאֶתֵּן אוֹתָם בְּיֶדְכֶם וַתִּירְשׁוּ אֶת־אַרְצָם וָאַשְׁמִידֵם מִפְּנֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived beyond the
Jordan. They gave battle to you, but I delivered them into your
hands; I annihilated them for you, and you took possession of
their land.

translation.text: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.

verses.english:
I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived beyond the
Jordan. They gave battle to you, but I delivered them into your
hands; I annihilated them for you, and you took possession of
their land.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם בָּלָק בֶּן־צִפּוֹר מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וַיִּלָּחֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיִּקְרָא לְבִלְעָם בֶּן־בְּעוֹר לְקַלֵּל אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם בָּלָק בֶּן־צִפּוֹר מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וַיִּלָּחֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיִּקְרָא לְבִלְעָם בֶּן־בְּעוֹר לְקַלֵּל אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
Thereupon Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, made ready to
attack Israel. He sent for Balaam son of Beor to curse you,

translation.text: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:

verses.english:
Thereupon Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, made ready to
attack Israel. He sent for Balaam son of Beor to curse you,

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא אָבִיתִי לִשְׁמֹעַ לְבִלְעָם וַיְבָרֶךְ בָּרוֹךְ אֶתְכֶם וָאַצִּל אֶתְכֶם מִיָּדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא אָבִיתִי לִשְׁמֹעַ לְבִלְעָם וַיְבָרֶךְ בָּרוֹךְ אֶתְכֶם וָאַצִּל אֶתְכֶם מִיָּדוֹ׃

english.text:
but I refused to listen to Balaam; he had to bless you, and thus I
saved you from him.

translation.text: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.

verses.english:
but I refused to listen to Balaam; he had to bless you, and thus I
saved you from him.

verses.hebrew:
וַתַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַתָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְרִיחוֹ וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בָכֶם בַּעֲלֵי־יְרִיחוֹ הָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי
וָאֶתֵּן אוֹתָם בְּיֶדְכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַתַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַתָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְרִיחוֹ וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בָכֶם בַּעֲלֵי־יְרִיחוֹ הָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי
וָאֶתֵּן אוֹתָם בְּיֶדְכֶם׃

english.text:
“Then you crossed the Jordan and you came to Jericho. The citizens
of Jericho and the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites,
Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites fought you, but I delivered
them into your hands.

translation.text: And you went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.

verses.english:
“Then you crossed the Jordan and you came to Jericho. The citizens
of Jericho and the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites,
Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites fought you, but I delivered
them into your hands.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁלַח לִפְנֵיכֶם אֶת־הַצִּרְעָה וַתְּגָרֶשׁ אוֹתָם מִפְּנֵיכֶם שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי לֹא בְחַרְבְּךָ וְלֹא בְקַשְׁתֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶשְׁלַח לִפְנֵיכֶם אֶת־הַצִּרְעָה וַתְּגָרֶשׁ אוֹתָם מִפְּנֵיכֶם שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי הָאֱמֹרִי לֹא בְחַרְבְּךָ וְלֹא בְקַשְׁתֶּךָ׃

english.text:
I sent a plague ahead of you, and it drove them out before
you—[just like] the two Amorite kings—not by your sword or by your
bow.

translation.text: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.

verses.english:
I sent a plague ahead of you, and it drove them out before
you—[just like] the two Amorite kings—not by your sword or by your
bow.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶתֵּן לָכֶם אֶרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָגַעְתָּ בָּהּ וְעָרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־בְנִיתֶם וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בָּהֶם כְּרָמִים וְזֵיתִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נְטַעְתֶּם אַתֶּם אֹכְלִים׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶתֵּן לָכֶם אֶרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָגַעְתָּ בָּהּ וְעָרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־בְנִיתֶם וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בָּהֶם כְּרָמִים וְזֵיתִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נְטַעְתֶּם אַתֶּם אֹכְלִים׃

english.text:
I have given you a land for which you did not labor and towns
which you did not build, and you have settled in them; you are
enjoying vineyards and olive groves which you did not plant.

translation.text: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.

verses.english:
I have given you a land for which you did not labor and towns
which you did not build, and you have settled in them; you are
enjoying vineyards and olive groves which you did not plant.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יְראוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְעִבְדוּ אֹתוֹ בְּתָמִים וּבֶאֱמֶת וְהָסִירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר עָבְדוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וּבְמִצְרַיִם וְעִבְדוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה יְראוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְעִבְדוּ אֹתוֹ בְּתָמִים וּבֶאֱמֶת וְהָסִירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר עָבְדוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וּבְמִצְרַיִם וְעִבְדוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

translation.text: Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the LORD.

verses.hebrew:
וְאִם רַע בְּעֵינֵיכֶם לַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה בַּחֲרוּ לָכֶם הַיּוֹם אֶת־מִי תַעֲבֹדוּן אִם אֶת־אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־עָבְדוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר (בעבר) [מֵעֵבֶר] הַנָּהָר וְאִם אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי
הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹשְׁבִים בְּאַרְצָם וְאָנֹכִי וּבֵיתִי נַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְאִם רַע בְּעֵינֵיכֶם לַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה בַּחֲרוּ לָכֶם הַיּוֹם אֶת־מִי תַעֲבֹדוּן אִם אֶת־אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־עָבְדוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר (בעבר) [מֵעֵבֶר] הַנָּהָר וְאִם אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי
הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹשְׁבִים בְּאַרְצָם וְאָנֹכִי וּבֵיתִי נַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Or, if you are loath to serve YHWH, choose this day which ones you
are going to serve—the gods that your forefathers served beyond
the Euphrates, or those of the Amorites in whose land you are
settled; but I and my household will serve YHWH.”

translation.text: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

verses.english:
Or, if you are loath to serve YHWH, choose this day which ones you
are going to serve—the gods that your forefathers served beyond
the Euphrates, or those of the Amorites in whose land you are
settled; but I and my household will serve YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר חָלִילָה לָּנוּ מֵעֲזֹב אֶת־יְהֹוָה לַעֲבֹד אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר חָלִילָה לָּנוּ מֵעֲזֹב אֶת־יְהֹוָה לַעֲבֹד אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

english.text:
In reply, the people declared, “Far be it from us to forsake YHWH
and serve other gods!

translation.text: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;

verses.english:
In reply, the people declared, “Far be it from us to forsake YHWH
and serve other gods!

verses.hebrew:
כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הוּא הַמַּעֲלֶה אֹתָנוּ וְאֶת־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְעֵינֵינוּ אֶת־הָאֹתוֹת הַגְּדֹלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּשְׁמְרֵנוּ
בְּכל־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְנוּ בָהּ וּבְכֹל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ בְּקִרְבָּם׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הוּא הַמַּעֲלֶה אֹתָנוּ וְאֶת־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְעֵינֵינוּ אֶת־הָאֹתוֹת הַגְּדֹלוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּשְׁמְרֵנוּ
בְּכל־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְנוּ בָהּ וּבְכֹל הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ בְּקִרְבָּם׃

english.text:
For it was YHWH our God who brought us and our fathers up from the
land of Egypt, the house of bondage, and who wrought those
wondrous signs before our very eyes, and guarded us all along the
way that we traveled and among all the peoples through whose midst
we passed.

translation.text: For the LORD our God, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:

verses.english:
For it was YHWH our God who brought us and our fathers up from the
land of Egypt, the house of bondage, and who wrought those
wondrous signs before our very eyes, and guarded us all along the
way that we traveled and among all the peoples through whose midst
we passed.

verses.hebrew: וַיְגָרֶשׁ יְהֹוָה אֶת־כּל־הָעַמִּים וְאֶת־הָאֱמֹרִי יֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ מִפָּנֵינוּ גַּם־אֲנַחְנוּ נַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה כִּי־הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְגָרֶשׁ יְהֹוָה אֶת־כּל־הָעַמִּים וְאֶת־הָאֱמֹרִי יֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ מִפָּנֵינוּ גַּם־אֲנַחְנוּ נַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה כִּי־הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text:
And then YHWH drove out before us all the peoples—the
Amorites—that inhabited the country. We too will serve YHWH, for
He is our God.”

translation.text: And the LORD drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve the LORD; for he is our God.

verses.english:
And then YHWH drove out before us all the peoples—the
Amorites—that inhabited the country. We too will serve YHWH, for
He is our God.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם לֹא תוּכְלוּ לַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה כִּי־אֱלֹהִים קְדֹשִׁים הוּא אֵל־קַנּוֹא הוּא לֹא־יִשָּׂא לְפִשְׁעֲכֶם וּלְחַטֹּאותֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם לֹא תוּכְלוּ לַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה כִּי־אֱלֹהִים קְדֹשִׁים הוּא אֵל־קַנּוֹא הוּא לֹא־יִשָּׂא לְפִשְׁעֲכֶם וּלְחַטֹּאותֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
Joshua, however, said to the people, “You will not be able to
serve YHWH, for He is a holy God. He is a jealous God; He will not
forgive your transgressions and your sins.

translation.text: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the LORD: for he is an holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.

verses.english:
Joshua, however, said to the people, “You will not be able to
serve YHWH, for He is a holy God. He is a jealous God; He will not
forgive your transgressions and your sins.

verses.hebrew: כִּי תַעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהֵי נֵכָר וְשָׁב וְהֵרַע לָכֶם וְכִלָּה אֶתְכֶם אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־הֵיטִיב לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי תַעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהֵי נֵכָר וְשָׁב וְהֵרַע לָכֶם וְכִלָּה אֶתְכֶם אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־הֵיטִיב לָכֶם׃

english.text:
If you forsake YHWH and serve alien gods, He will turn and deal
harshly with you and make an end of you, after having been
gracious to you.”

translation.text: If ye forsake the LORD, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.

verses.english:
If you forsake YHWH and serve alien gods, He will turn and deal
harshly with you and make an end of you, after having been
gracious to you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֹא כִּי אֶת־יְהֹוָה נַעֲבֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֹא כִּי אֶת־יְהֹוָה נַעֲבֹד׃

english.text: But the people replied to Joshua, “No, we will serve YHWH!”

translation.text: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the LORD.

verses.english: But the people replied to Joshua, “No, we will serve YHWH!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם עֵדִים אַתֶּם בָּכֶם כִּי־אַתֶּם בְּחַרְתֶּם לָכֶם אֶת־יְהֹוָה לַעֲבֹד אוֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֵדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־הָעָם עֵדִים אַתֶּם בָּכֶם כִּי־אַתֶּם בְּחַרְתֶּם לָכֶם אֶת־יְהֹוָה לַעֲבֹד אוֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֵדִים׃

english.text:
Thereupon Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against
yourselves that you have by your own act chosen to serve YHWH.”
“Yes, we are!” they responded.

translation.text: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the LORD, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.

verses.english:
Thereupon Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against
yourselves that you have by your own act chosen to serve YHWH.”
“Yes, we are!” they responded.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הָסִירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וְהַטּוּ אֶת־לְבַבְכֶם אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הָסִירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וְהַטּוּ אֶת־לְבַבְכֶם אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
“Then put away the alien gods that you have among you and direct
your hearts to YHWH, the God of Israel.”

translation.text: Now therefore put away, said he, the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto the LORD God of Israel.

verses.english:
“Then put away the alien gods that you have among you and direct
your hearts to YHWH, the God of Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעָם אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נַעֲבֹד וּבְקוֹלוֹ נִשְׁמָע׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעָם אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נַעֲבֹד וּבְקוֹלוֹ נִשְׁמָע׃

english.text:
And the people declared to Joshua, “We will serve none but YHWH
our God, and we will obey none but Him.”

translation.text: And the people said unto Joshua, The LORD our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.

verses.english:
And the people declared to Joshua, “We will serve none but YHWH
our God, and we will obey none but Him.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בְּרִית לָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיָּשֶׂם לוֹ חֹק וּמִשְׁפָּט בִּשְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בְּרִית לָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיָּשֶׂם לוֹ חֹק וּמִשְׁפָּט בִּשְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
On that day at Shechem, Joshua made a covenant for the people and
he made a fixed rule for them.

translation.text: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

verses.english:
On that day at Shechem, Joshua made a covenant for the people and
he made a fixed rule for them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרַת אֱלֹהִים וַיִּקַּח אֶבֶן גְּדוֹלָה וַיְקִימֶהָ שָּׁם תַּחַת הָאַלָּה אֲשֶׁר בְּמִקְדַּשׁ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְתֹּב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרַת אֱלֹהִים וַיִּקַּח אֶבֶן גְּדוֹלָה וַיְקִימֶהָ שָּׁם תַּחַת הָאַלָּה אֲשֶׁר בְּמִקְדַּשׁ יְהֹוָה׃

translation.text: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of the LORD.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־כּל־הָעָם הִנֵּה הָאֶבֶן הַזֹּאת תִּהְיֶה־בָּנוּ לְעֵדָה כִּי־הִיא שָׁמְעָה אֵת כּל־אִמְרֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר עִמָּנוּ וְהָיְתָה בָכֶם לְעֵדָה
פֶּן־תְּכַחֲשׁוּן בֵּאלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶל־כּל־הָעָם הִנֵּה הָאֶבֶן הַזֹּאת תִּהְיֶה־בָּנוּ לְעֵדָה כִּי־הִיא שָׁמְעָה אֵת כּל־אִמְרֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר עִמָּנוּ וְהָיְתָה בָכֶם לְעֵדָה
פֶּן־תְּכַחֲשׁוּן בֵּאלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
and Joshua said to all the people, “See, this very stone shall be
a witness against us, for it heard all the words that YHWH spoke
to us; it shall be a witness against you, lest you break faith
with your God.”

translation.text: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.

verses.english:
and Joshua said to all the people, “See, this very stone shall be
a witness against us, for it heard all the words that YHWH spoke
to us; it shall be a witness against you, lest you break faith
with your God.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָעָם אִישׁ לְנַחֲלָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָעָם אִישׁ לְנַחֲלָתוֹ׃

english.text: Joshua then dismissed the people to their allotted portions.

translation.text: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.

verses.english: Joshua then dismissed the people to their allotted portions.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיָּמת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּן־מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיָּמת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּן־מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
After these events, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of YHWH, died
at the age of one hundred and ten years.

translation.text: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.

verses.english:
After these events, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of YHWH, died
at the age of one hundred and ten years.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בִּגְבוּל נַחֲלָתוֹ בְּתִמְנַת־סֶרַח אֲשֶׁר בְּהַר־אֶפְרָיִם מִצְּפוֹן לְהַר־גָּעַשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בִּגְבוּל נַחֲלָתוֹ בְּתִמְנַת־סֶרַח אֲשֶׁר בְּהַר־אֶפְרָיִם מִצְּפוֹן לְהַר־גָּעַשׁ׃

english.text:
They buried him on his own property, at Timnath-serah in the hill
country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

translation.text: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

verses.english:
They buried him on his own property, at Timnath-serah in the hill
country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲבֹד יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־יְהֹוָה כֹּל יְמֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכֹל יְמֵי הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר הֶאֱרִיכוּ יָמִים אַחֲרֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַאֲשֶׁר יָדְעוּ אֵת כּל־מַעֲשֵׂה יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
