וַיַּעֲבֹד יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־יְהֹוָה כֹּל יְמֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכֹל יְמֵי הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר הֶאֱרִיכוּ יָמִים אַחֲרֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַאֲשֶׁר יָדְעוּ אֵת כּל־מַעֲשֵׂה יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Israel served YHWH during the lifetime of Joshua and the lifetime
of the elders who lived on after Joshua, and who had experienced
all the deeds that YHWH had wrought for Israel.

translation.text: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD, that he had done for Israel.

verses.english:
Israel served YHWH during the lifetime of Joshua and the lifetime
of the elders who lived on after Joshua, and who had experienced
all the deeds that YHWH had wrought for Israel.

verses.hebrew:
וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר־הֶעֱלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם קָבְרוּ בִשְׁכֶם בְּחֶלְקַת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה יַעֲקֹב מֵאֵת בְּנֵי־חֲמוֹר אֲבִי־שְׁכֶם בְּמֵאָה קְשִׂיטָה
וַיִּהְיוּ לִבְנֵי־יוֹסֵף לְנַחֲלָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר־הֶעֱלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם קָבְרוּ בִשְׁכֶם בְּחֶלְקַת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה יַעֲקֹב מֵאֵת בְּנֵי־חֲמוֹר אֲבִי־שְׁכֶם בְּמֵאָה קְשִׂיטָה
וַיִּהְיוּ לִבְנֵי־יוֹסֵף לְנַחֲלָה׃

english.text:
The bones of Joseph, which the Israelites had brought up from
Egypt, were buried at Shechem, in the piece of ground which Jacob
had bought for a hundred kesitahs from the children of Hamor,
Shechem’s father, and which had become a heritage of the
Josephites.

translation.text: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

verses.english:
The bones of Joseph, which the Israelites had brought up from
Egypt, were buried at Shechem, in the piece of ground which Jacob
had bought for a hundred kesitahs from the children of Hamor,
Shechem’s father, and which had become a heritage of the
Josephites.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹן מֵת וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בְּגִבְעַת פִּינְחָס בְּנוֹ אֲשֶׁר נִתַּן־לוֹ בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹן מֵת וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בְּגִבְעַת פִּינְחָס בְּנוֹ אֲשֶׁר נִתַּן־לוֹ בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם׃

english.text:
Eleazar son of Aaron also died, and they buried him on the hill of
his son Phinehas, which had been assigned to him in the hill
country of Ephraim.

translation.text: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.

verses.english:
Eleazar son of Aaron also died, and they buried him on the hill of
his son Phinehas, which had been assigned to him in the hill
country of Ephraim.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי מוֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר מִי יַעֲלֶה־לָּנוּ אֶל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי בַּתְּחִלָּה לְהִלָּחֶם בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי מוֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר מִי יַעֲלֶה־לָּנוּ אֶל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי בַּתְּחִלָּה לְהִלָּחֶם בּוֹ׃

english.text:
After the death of Joshua, the Israelites inquired of YHWH, “Which
of us shall be the first to go up against the Canaanites and
attack them?”

translation.text: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?

verses.english:
After the death of Joshua, the Israelites inquired of YHWH, “Which
of us shall be the first to go up against the Canaanites and
attack them?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה יְהוּדָה יַעֲלֶה הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי אֶת־הָאָרֶץ בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה יְהוּדָה יַעֲלֶה הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי אֶת־הָאָרֶץ בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
YHWH replied, “Let [the tribe of] Judah go up. I now deliver the
land into their hands.”

translation.text: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.

verses.english:
YHWH replied, “Let [the tribe of] Judah go up. I now deliver the
land into their hands.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה לְשִׁמְעוֹן אָחִיו עֲלֵה אִתִּי בְגֹרָלִי וְנִלָּחֲמָה בַּכְּנַעֲנִי וְהָלַכְתִּי גַם־אֲנִי אִתְּךָ בְּגוֹרָלֶךָ וַיֵּלֶךְ אִתּוֹ שִׁמְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה לְשִׁמְעוֹן אָחִיו עֲלֵה אִתִּי בְגֹרָלִי וְנִלָּחֲמָה בַּכְּנַעֲנִי וְהָלַכְתִּי גַם־אֲנִי אִתְּךָ בְּגוֹרָלֶךָ וַיֵּלֶךְ אִתּוֹ שִׁמְעוֹן׃

english.text:
Judah then said to their brother-tribe Simeon, “Come up with us to
our allotted territory and let us attack the Canaanites, and then
we will go with you to your allotted territory.” So Simeon joined
them.

translation.text: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.

verses.english:
Judah then said to their brother-tribe Simeon, “Come up with us to
our allotted territory and let us attack the Canaanites, and then
we will go with you to your allotted territory.” So Simeon joined
them.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל יְהוּדָה וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי בְּיָדָם וַיַּכּוּם בְּבֶזֶק עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל יְהוּדָה וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי בְּיָדָם וַיַּכּוּם בְּבֶזֶק עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ׃

english.text:
When Judah advanced, YHWH delivered the Canaanites and the
Perizzites into their hands, and they defeated ten thousand of
them at Bezek.

translation.text: And Judah went up; and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.

verses.english:
When Judah advanced, YHWH delivered the Canaanites and the
Perizzites into their hands, and they defeated ten thousand of
them at Bezek.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצְאוּ אֶת־אֲדֹנִי בֶזֶק בְּבֶזֶק וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בּוֹ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְאֶת־הַפְּרִזִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְצְאוּ אֶת־אֲדֹנִי בֶזֶק בְּבֶזֶק וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בּוֹ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְאֶת־הַפְּרִזִּי׃

english.text:
At Bezek, they encountered Adoni-bezek, engaged him in battle, and
defeated the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

translation.text: And they found Adonibezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

verses.english:
At Bezek, they encountered Adoni-bezek, engaged him in battle, and
defeated the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּנס אֲדֹנִי בֶזֶק וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אַחֲרָיו וַיֹּאחֲזוּ אוֹתוֹ וַיְקַצְּצוּ אֶת־בְּהֹנוֹת יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּנס אֲדֹנִי בֶזֶק וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אַחֲרָיו וַיֹּאחֲזוּ אוֹתוֹ וַיְקַצְּצוּ אֶת־בְּהֹנוֹת יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו׃

english.text:
Adoni-bezek fled, but they pursued him and captured him; and they
cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

translation.text: But Adonibezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.

verses.english:
Adoni-bezek fled, but they pursued him and captured him; and they
cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֲדֹנִי־בֶזֶק שִׁבְעִים מְלָכִים בְּהֹנוֹת יְדֵיהֶם וְרַגְלֵיהֶם מְקֻצָּצִים הָיוּ מְלַקְּטִים תַּחַת שֻׁלְחָנִי כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי כֵּן שִׁלַּם־לִי אֱלֹהִים
וַיְבִיאֻהוּ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיָּמת שָׁם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֲדֹנִי־בֶזֶק שִׁבְעִים מְלָכִים בְּהֹנוֹת יְדֵיהֶם וְרַגְלֵיהֶם מְקֻצָּצִים הָיוּ מְלַקְּטִים תַּחַת שֻׁלְחָנִי כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי כֵּן שִׁלַּם־לִי אֱלֹהִים
וַיְבִיאֻהוּ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיָּמת שָׁם׃

english.text:
And Adoni-bezek said, “Seventy kings, with thumbs and big toes cut
off, used to pick up scraps under my table; as I have done, so God
has requited me.” They brought him to Jerusalem and he died there.

translation.text: And Adonibezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.

verses.english:
And Adoni-bezek said, “Seventy kings, with thumbs and big toes cut
off, used to pick up scraps under my table; as I have done, so God
has requited me.” They brought him to Jerusalem and he died there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיַּכּוּהָ לְפִי־חָרֶב וְאֶת־הָעִיר שִׁלְּחוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיַּכּוּהָ לְפִי־חָרֶב וְאֶת־הָעִיר שִׁלְּחוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
The Judites attacked Jerusalem and captured it; they put it to the
sword and set the city on fire.

translation.text: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

verses.english:
The Judites attacked Jerusalem and captured it; they put it to the
sword and set the city on fire.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר יָרְדוּ בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה לְהִלָּחֵם בַּכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב הָהָר וְהַנֶּגֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחַר יָרְדוּ בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה לְהִלָּחֵם בַּכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב הָהָר וְהַנֶּגֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָה׃

english.text:
After that the Judites went down to attack the Canaanites who
inhabited the hill country, the Negeb, and the Shephelah.

translation.text: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.

verses.english:
After that the Judites went down to attack the Canaanites who
inhabited the hill country, the Negeb, and the Shephelah.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוּדָה אֶל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶבְרוֹן וְשֵׁם־חֶבְרוֹן לְפָנִים קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־שֵׁשַׁי וְאֶת־אֲחִימַן וְאֶת־תַּלְמָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוּדָה אֶל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶבְרוֹן וְשֵׁם־חֶבְרוֹן לְפָנִים קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־שֵׁשַׁי וְאֶת־אֲחִימַן וְאֶת־תַּלְמָי׃

english.text:
The Judites marched against the Canaanites who dwelt in Hebron,
and they defeated Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai. (The name of Hebron
was formerly Kiriath-arba.)

translation.text: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.

verses.english:
The Judites marched against the Canaanites who dwelt in Hebron,
and they defeated Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai. (The name of Hebron
was formerly Kiriath-arba.)

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם אֶל־יוֹשְׁבֵי דְּבִיר וְשֵׁם־דְּבִיר לְפָנִים קִרְיַת־סֵפֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם אֶל־יוֹשְׁבֵי דְּבִיר וְשֵׁם־דְּבִיר לְפָנִים קִרְיַת־סֵפֶר׃

english.text:
From there they marched against the inhabitants of Debir (the name
of Debir was formerly Kiriath-sepher).

translation.text: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher:

verses.english:
From there they marched against the inhabitants of Debir (the name
of Debir was formerly Kiriath-sepher).

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר כָּלֵב אֲשֶׁר־יַכֶּה אֶת־קִרְיַת־סֵפֶר וּלְכָדָהּ וְנָתַתִּי לוֹ אֶת־עַכְסָה בִתִּי לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר כָּלֵב אֲשֶׁר־יַכֶּה אֶת־קִרְיַת־סֵפֶר וּלְכָדָהּ וְנָתַתִּי לוֹ אֶת־עַכְסָה בִתִּי לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
And Caleb announced, “I will give my daughter Achsah in marriage
to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath-sepher.”

translation.text: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

verses.english:
And Caleb announced, “I will give my daughter Achsah in marriage
to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath-sepher.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ עתְנִיאֵל בֶּן־קְנַז אֲחִי כָלֵב הַקָּטֹן מִמֶּנּוּ וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ אֶת־עַכְסָה בִתּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ עתְנִיאֵל בֶּן־קְנַז אֲחִי כָלֵב הַקָּטֹן מִמֶּנּוּ וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ אֶת־עַכְסָה בִתּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
His younger kinsman, Othniel the Kenizzite, captured it; and Caleb
gave him his daughter Achsah in marriage.

translation.text: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

verses.english:
His younger kinsman, Othniel the Kenizzite, captured it; and Caleb
gave him his daughter Achsah in marriage.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאָהּ וַתְּסִיתֵהוּ לִשְׁאֹל מֵאֵת־אָבִיהָ הַשָּׂדֶה וַתִּצְנַח מֵעַל הַחֲמוֹר וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ כָּלֵב מַה־לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאָהּ וַתְּסִיתֵהוּ לִשְׁאֹל מֵאֵת־אָבִיהָ הַשָּׂדֶה וַתִּצְנַח מֵעַל הַחֲמוֹר וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ כָּלֵב מַה־לָּךְ׃

english.text:
When she came [to him], she induced him to ask her father for some
property. She dismounted from her donkey, and Caleb asked her,
“What is the matter?”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when she came to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?

verses.english:
When she came [to him], she induced him to ask her father for some
property. She dismounted from her donkey, and Caleb asked her,
“What is the matter?”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ הָבָה־לִּי בְרָכָה כִּי אֶרֶץ הַנֶּגֶב נְתַתָּנִי וְנָתַתָּה לִי גֻּלֹּת מָיִם וַיִּתֶּן־לָהּ כָּלֵב אֵת גֻּלֹּת עִלִּית וְאֵת גֻּלֹּת תַּחְתִּית׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ הָבָה־לִּי בְרָכָה כִּי אֶרֶץ הַנֶּגֶב נְתַתָּנִי וְנָתַתָּה לִי גֻּלֹּת מָיִם וַיִּתֶּן־לָהּ כָּלֵב אֵת גֻּלֹּת עִלִּית וְאֵת גֻּלֹּת תַּחְתִּית׃

english.text:
She replied, “Give me a present, for you have given me away as
Negeb-land; give me springs of water.” And Caleb gave her Upper
and Lower Gulloth.

translation.text: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.

verses.english:
She replied, “Give me a present, for you have given me away as
Negeb-land; give me springs of water.” And Caleb gave her Upper
and Lower Gulloth.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי קֵינִי חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה עָלוּ מֵעִיר הַתְּמָרִים אֶת־בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה מִדְבַּר יְהוּדָה אֲשֶׁר בְּנֶגֶב עֲרָד וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיֵּשֶׁב אֶת־הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי קֵינִי חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה עָלוּ מֵעִיר הַתְּמָרִים אֶת־בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה מִדְבַּר יְהוּדָה אֲשֶׁר בְּנֶגֶב עֲרָד וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיֵּשֶׁב אֶת־הָעָם׃

english.text:
The descendants of the Kenite, the father-in-law of Moses, went up
with the Judites from the City of Palms to the wilderness of
Judah; and they went and settled among the people in the Negeb of
Arad.

translation.text: And the children of the Kenite, Moses’ father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which lieth in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.

verses.english:
The descendants of the Kenite, the father-in-law of Moses, went up
with the Judites from the City of Palms to the wilderness of
Judah; and they went and settled among the people in the Negeb of
Arad.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוּדָה אֶת־שִׁמְעוֹן אָחִיו וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב צְפַת וַיַּחֲרִימוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שֵׁם־הָעִיר חרְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוּדָה אֶת־שִׁמְעוֹן אָחִיו וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב צְפַת וַיַּחֲרִימוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שֵׁם־הָעִיר חרְמָה׃

english.text:
And Judah with its brother-tribe Simeon went on and defeated the
Canaanites who dwelt in Zephath. They proscribed it, and so the
town was named Hormah.

translation.text: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.

verses.english:
And Judah with its brother-tribe Simeon went on and defeated the
Canaanites who dwelt in Zephath. They proscribed it, and so the
town was named Hormah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכֹּד יְהוּדָה אֶת־עַזָּה וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָהּ וְאֶת־אַשְׁקְלוֹן וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָהּ וְאֶת־עֶקְרוֹן וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְכֹּד יְהוּדָה אֶת־עַזָּה וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָהּ וְאֶת־אַשְׁקְלוֹן וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָהּ וְאֶת־עֶקְרוֹן וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָהּ׃

english.text:
And Judah captured Gaza and its territory, Ashkelon and its
territory, and Ekron and its territory.

translation.text: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.

verses.english:
And Judah captured Gaza and its territory, Ashkelon and its
territory, and Ekron and its territory.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יְהֹוָה אֶת־יְהוּדָה וַיֹּרֶשׁ אֶת־הָהָר כִּי לֹא לְהוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי הָעֵמֶק כִּי־רֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי יְהֹוָה אֶת־יְהוּדָה וַיֹּרֶשׁ אֶת־הָהָר כִּי לֹא לְהוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי הָעֵמֶק כִּי־רֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל לָהֶם׃

english.text:
YHWH was with Judah, so that they took possession of the hill
country; but they were not able to dispossess the inhabitants of
the plain, for they had iron chariots.

translation.text: And the LORD was with Judah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

verses.english:
YHWH was with Judah, so that they took possession of the hill
country; but they were not able to dispossess the inhabitants of
the plain, for they had iron chariots.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ לְכָלֵב אֶת־חֶבְרוֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה וַיּוֹרֶשׁ מִשָּׁם אֶת־שְׁלֹשָׁה בְּנֵי הָעֲנָק׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ לְכָלֵב אֶת־חֶבְרוֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה וַיּוֹרֶשׁ מִשָּׁם אֶת־שְׁלֹשָׁה בְּנֵי הָעֲנָק׃

english.text:
They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had promised; and he drove the
three Anakites out of there.

translation.text: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.

verses.english:
They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had promised; and he drove the
three Anakites out of there.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַיְבוּסִי יֹשֵׁב יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לֹא הוֹרִישׁוּ בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וַיֵּשֶׁב הַיְבוּסִי אֶת־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַיְבוּסִי יֹשֵׁב יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לֹא הוֹרִישׁוּ בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וַיֵּשֶׁב הַיְבוּסִי אֶת־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The Benjaminites did not dispossess the Jebusite inhabitants of
Jerusalem; so the Jebusites have dwelt with the Benjaminites in
Jerusalem to this day.

translation.text: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.

verses.english:
The Benjaminites did not dispossess the Jebusite inhabitants of
Jerusalem; so the Jebusites have dwelt with the Benjaminites in
Jerusalem to this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ בֵית־יוֹסֵף גַּם־הֵם בֵּית־אֵל וַיהֹוָה עִמָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ בֵית־יוֹסֵף גַּם־הֵם בֵּית־אֵל וַיהֹוָה עִמָּם׃

english.text:
The House of Joseph, for their part, advanced against Bethel, and
YHWH was with them.

translation.text: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the LORD was with them.

verses.english:
The House of Joseph, for their part, advanced against Bethel, and
YHWH was with them.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּתִירוּ בֵית־יוֹסֵף בְּבֵית־אֵל וְשֵׁם־הָעִיר לְפָנִים לוּז׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּתִירוּ בֵית־יוֹסֵף בְּבֵית־אֵל וְשֵׁם־הָעִיר לְפָנִים לוּז׃

english.text:
While the House of Joseph were scouting at Bethel (the name of the
town was formerly Luz),

translation.text: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)

verses.english:
While the House of Joseph were scouting at Bethel (the name of the
town was formerly Luz),

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ הַשֹּׁמְרִים אִישׁ יוֹצֵא מִן־הָעִיר וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ הַרְאֵנוּ נָא אֶת־מְבוֹא הָעִיר וְעָשִׂינוּ עִמְּךָ חָסֶד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ הַשֹּׁמְרִים אִישׁ יוֹצֵא מִן־הָעִיר וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ הַרְאֵנוּ נָא אֶת־מְבוֹא הָעִיר וְעָשִׂינוּ עִמְּךָ חָסֶד׃

english.text:
their patrols saw a man leaving the town. They said to him, “Just
show us how to get into the town, and we will treat you kindly.”

translation.text: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.

verses.english:
their patrols saw a man leaving the town. They said to him, “Just
show us how to get into the town, and we will treat you kindly.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְאֵם אֶת־מְבוֹא הָעִיר וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר לְפִי־חָרֶב וְאֶת־הָאִישׁ וְאֶת־כּל־מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ שִׁלֵּחוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְאֵם אֶת־מְבוֹא הָעִיר וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר לְפִי־חָרֶב וְאֶת־הָאִישׁ וְאֶת־כּל־מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ שִׁלֵּחוּ׃

english.text:
He showed them how to get into the town; they put the town to the
sword, but they let the man and all his relatives go free.

translation.text: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.

verses.english:
He showed them how to get into the town; they put the town to the
sword, but they let the man and all his relatives go free.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הָאִישׁ אֶרֶץ הַחִתִּים וַיִּבֶן עִיר וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמָהּ לוּז הוּא שְׁמָהּ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ הָאִישׁ אֶרֶץ הַחִתִּים וַיִּבֶן עִיר וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמָהּ לוּז הוּא שְׁמָהּ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The man went to the Hittite country. He founded a city and named
it Luz, and that has been its name to this day.

translation.text: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.

verses.english:
The man went to the Hittite country. He founded a city and named
it Luz, and that has been its name to this day.

verses.hebrew:
וְלֹא־הוֹרִישׁ מְנַשֶּׁה אֶת־בֵּית־שְׁאָן וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־תַּעְנַךְ וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־[יוֹשְׁבֵי] (יושב) דוֹר וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי יִבְלְעָם
וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי מְגִדּוֹ וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וַיּוֹאֶל הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָשֶׁבֶת בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text:
וְלֹא־הוֹרִישׁ מְנַשֶּׁה אֶת־בֵּית־שְׁאָן וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־תַּעְנַךְ וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־[יוֹשְׁבֵי] (יושב) דוֹר וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי יִבְלְעָם
וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי מְגִדּוֹ וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וַיּוֹאֶל הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָשֶׁבֶת בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
Manasseh did not dispossess [the inhabitants of] Beth-shean and
its dependencies, or [of] Taanach and its dependencies, or the
inhabitants of Dor and its dependencies, or the inhabitants of
Ibleam and its dependencies, or the inhabitants of Megiddo and its
dependencies. The Canaanites persisted in dwelling in this region.

translation.text: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Bethshean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

verses.english:
Manasseh did not dispossess [the inhabitants of] Beth-shean and
its dependencies, or [of] Taanach and its dependencies, or the
inhabitants of Dor and its dependencies, or the inhabitants of
Ibleam and its dependencies, or the inhabitants of Megiddo and its
dependencies. The Canaanites persisted in dwelling in this region.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי־חָזַק יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָמַס וְהוֹרֵישׁ לֹא הוֹרִישׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי־חָזַק יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָמַס וְהוֹרֵישׁ לֹא הוֹרִישׁוֹ׃

english.text:
And when Israel gained the upper hand, they subjected the
Canaanites to forced labor; but they did not dispossess them.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.

verses.english:
And when Israel gained the upper hand, they subjected the
Canaanites to forced labor; but they did not dispossess them.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶפְרַיִם לֹא הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּגָזֶר וַיֵּשֶׁב הַכְּנַעֲנִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ בְּגָזֶר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶפְרַיִם לֹא הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּגָזֶר וַיֵּשֶׁב הַכְּנַעֲנִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ בְּגָזֶר׃

english.text:
Nor did Ephraim dispossess the Canaanites who inhabited Gezer; so
the Canaanites dwelt in their midst at Gezer.

translation.text: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.

verses.english:
Nor did Ephraim dispossess the Canaanites who inhabited Gezer; so
the Canaanites dwelt in their midst at Gezer.

verses.hebrew: זְבוּלֻן לֹא הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי קִטְרוֹן וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי נַהֲלֹל וַיֵּשֶׁב הַכְּנַעֲנִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ וַיִּהְיוּ לָמַס׃

hebrew.text: זְבוּלֻן לֹא הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי קִטְרוֹן וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי נַהֲלֹל וַיֵּשֶׁב הַכְּנַעֲנִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ וַיִּהְיוּ לָמַס׃

english.text:
Zebulun did not dispossess the inhabitants of Kitron or the
inhabitants of Nahalol; so the Canaanites dwelt in their midst,
but they were subjected to forced labor.

translation.text: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.

verses.english:
Zebulun did not dispossess the inhabitants of Kitron or the
inhabitants of Nahalol; so the Canaanites dwelt in their midst,
but they were subjected to forced labor.

verses.hebrew: אָשֵׁר לֹא הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי עַכּוֹ וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי צִידוֹן וְאֶת־אַחְלָב וְאֶת־אַכְזִיב וְאֶת־חֶלְבָּה וְאֶת־אֲפִיק וְאֶת־רְחֹב׃

hebrew.text: אָשֵׁר לֹא הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי עַכּוֹ וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי צִידוֹן וְאֶת־אַחְלָב וְאֶת־אַכְזִיב וְאֶת־חֶלְבָּה וְאֶת־אֲפִיק וְאֶת־רְחֹב׃

english.text:
Asher did not dispossess the inhabitants of Acco or the
inhabitants of Sidon, Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, and Rehob.

translation.text: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:

verses.english:
Asher did not dispossess the inhabitants of Acco or the
inhabitants of Sidon, Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, and Rehob.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב הָאָשֵׁרִי בְּקֶרֶב הַכְּנַעֲנִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ כִּי לֹא הוֹרִישׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב הָאָשֵׁרִי בְּקֶרֶב הַכְּנַעֲנִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ כִּי לֹא הוֹרִישׁוֹ׃

english.text:
So the Asherites dwelt in the midst of the Canaanites, the
inhabitants of the land, for they did not dispossess them.

translation.text: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.

verses.english:
So the Asherites dwelt in the midst of the Canaanites, the
inhabitants of the land, for they did not dispossess them.

verses.hebrew: נַפְתָּלִי לֹא־הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ וְאֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי בֵית־עֲנָת וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּקֶרֶב הַכְּנַעֲנִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ וְיֹשְׁבֵי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ וּבֵית עֲנָת הָיוּ לָהֶם לָמַס׃

hebrew.text: נַפְתָּלִי לֹא־הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ וְאֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי בֵית־עֲנָת וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּקֶרֶב הַכְּנַעֲנִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ וְיֹשְׁבֵי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ וּבֵית עֲנָת הָיוּ לָהֶם לָמַס׃

english.text:
Naphtali did not dispossess the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh or the
inhabitants of Beth-anath. But they settled in the midst of the
Canaanite inhabitants of the land, and the inhabitants of
Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath had to perform forced labor for them.

translation.text: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Bethshemesh, nor the inhabitants of Bethanath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Bethshemesh and of Bethanath became tributaries unto them.

verses.english:
Naphtali did not dispossess the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh or the
inhabitants of Beth-anath. But they settled in the midst of the
Canaanite inhabitants of the land, and the inhabitants of
Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath had to perform forced labor for them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְחֲצוּ הָאֱמֹרִי אֶת־בְּנֵי־דָן הָהָרָה כִּי־לֹא נְתָנוֹ לָרֶדֶת לָעֵמֶק׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְחֲצוּ הָאֱמֹרִי אֶת־בְּנֵי־דָן הָהָרָה כִּי־לֹא נְתָנוֹ לָרֶדֶת לָעֵמֶק׃

english.text:
The Amorites pressed the Danites into the hill country; they would
not let them come down to the plain.

translation.text: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:

verses.english:
The Amorites pressed the Danites into the hill country; they would
not let them come down to the plain.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹאֶל הָאֱמֹרִי לָשֶׁבֶת בְּהַר־חֶרֶס בְּאַיָּלוֹן וּבְשַׁעַלְבִים וַתִּכְבַּד יַד בֵּית־יוֹסֵף וַיִּהְיוּ לָמַס׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹאֶל הָאֱמֹרִי לָשֶׁבֶת בְּהַר־חֶרֶס בְּאַיָּלוֹן וּבְשַׁעַלְבִים וַתִּכְבַּד יַד בֵּית־יוֹסֵף וַיִּהְיוּ לָמַס׃

english.text:
The Amorites also persisted in dwelling in Har-heres, in Aijalon,
and in Shaalbim. But the hand of the House of Joseph bore heavily
on them and they had to perform forced labor.

translation.text: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.

verses.english:
The Amorites also persisted in dwelling in Har-heres, in Aijalon,
and in Shaalbim. But the hand of the House of Joseph bore heavily
on them and they had to perform forced labor.

verses.hebrew: וּגְבוּל הָאֱמֹרִי מִמַּעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים מֵהַסֶּלַע וָמָעְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וּגְבוּל הָאֱמֹרִי מִמַּעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים מֵהַסֶּלַע וָמָעְלָה׃

english.text:
The territory of the Amorites extended from the Ascent of
Akrabbim—from Sela—onward.

translation.text: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

verses.english:
The territory of the Amorites extended from the Ascent of
Akrabbim—from Sela—onward.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַל מַלְאַךְ־יְהֹוָה מִן־הַגִּלְגָּל אֶל־הַבֹּכִיםוַיֹּאמֶר אַעֲלֶה אֶתְכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וָאָבִיא אֶתְכֶם אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם וָאֹמַר לֹא־אָפֵר
בְּרִיתִי אִתְּכֶם לְעוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַל מַלְאַךְ־יְהֹוָה מִן־הַגִּלְגָּל אֶל־הַבֹּכִיםוַיֹּאמֶר אַעֲלֶה אֶתְכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וָאָבִיא אֶתְכֶם אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם וָאֹמַר לֹא־אָפֵר
בְּרִיתִי אִתְּכֶם לְעוֹלָם׃

english.text:
An angel of YHWH came up from Gilgal to Bochim and said, “I
brought you up from Egypt and I took you into the land which I had
promised on oath to your fathers. And I said, ‘I will never break
My covenant with you.

translation.text: And an angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.

verses.english:
An angel of YHWH came up from Gilgal to Bochim and said, “I
brought you up from Egypt and I took you into the land which I had
promised on oath to your fathers. And I said, ‘I will never break
My covenant with you.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם לֹא־תִכְרְתוּ בְרִית לְיוֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיהֶם תִּתֹּצוּן וְלֹא־שְׁמַעְתֶּם בְּקוֹלִי מַה־זֹּאת עֲשִׂיתֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם לֹא־תִכְרְתוּ בְרִית לְיוֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיהֶם תִּתֹּצוּן וְלֹא־שְׁמַעְתֶּם בְּקוֹלִי מַה־זֹּאת עֲשִׂיתֶם׃

english.text:
And you, for your part, must make no covenant with the inhabitants
of this land; you must tear down their altars.’ But you have not
obeyed Me—look what you have done!

translation.text: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not obeyed my voice: why have ye done this?

verses.english:
And you, for your part, must make no covenant with the inhabitants
of this land; you must tear down their altars.’ But you have not
obeyed Me—look what you have done!

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אָמַרְתִּי לֹא־אֲגָרֵשׁ אוֹתָם מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְצִדִּים וֵאלֹהֵיהֶם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אָמַרְתִּי לֹא־אֲגָרֵשׁ אוֹתָם מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְצִדִּים וֵאלֹהֵיהֶם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃

english.text:
Therefore, I have resolved not to drive them out before you; they
shall become your oppressors, and their gods shall be a snare to
you.”

translation.text: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.

verses.english:
Therefore, I have resolved not to drive them out before you; they
shall become your oppressors, and their gods shall be a snare to
you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּדַבֵּר מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל־כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׂאוּ הָעָם אֶת־קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּדַבֵּר מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל־כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׂאוּ הָעָם אֶת־קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ׃

english.text:
As the angel of YHWH spoke these words to all the Israelites, the
people broke into weeping.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the angel of the LORD spake these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.

verses.english:
As the angel of YHWH spoke these words to all the Israelites, the
people broke into weeping.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ שֵׁם־הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בֹּכִים וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־שָׁם לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ שֵׁם־הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בֹּכִים וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־שָׁם לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
So they named that place Bochim, and they offered sacrifices there
to YHWH.

translation.text: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto the LORD.

verses.english:
So they named that place Bochim, and they offered sacrifices there
to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָעָם וַיֵּלְכוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ לְנַחֲלָתוֹ לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָעָם וַיֵּלְכוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ לְנַחֲלָתוֹ לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
When Joshua dismissed the people, the Israelites went to their
allotted territories and took possession of the land.

translation.text: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.

verses.english:
When Joshua dismissed the people, the Israelites went to their
allotted territories and took possession of the land.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַבְדוּ הָעָם אֶת־יְהֹוָה כֹּל יְמֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכֹל יְמֵי הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר הֶאֱרִיכוּ יָמִים אַחֲרֵי יְהוֹשׁוּעַ אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ אֵת כּל־מַעֲשֵׂה יְהֹוָה הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר
עָשָׂה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַבְדוּ הָעָם אֶת־יְהֹוָה כֹּל יְמֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכֹל יְמֵי הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר הֶאֱרִיכוּ יָמִים אַחֲרֵי יְהוֹשׁוּעַ אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ אֵת כּל־מַעֲשֵׂה יְהֹוָה הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר
עָשָׂה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The people served YHWH during the lifetime of Joshua and the
lifetime of the older people who lived on after Joshua and who had
witnessed all the marvelous deeds that YHWH had wrought for
Israel.

translation.text: And the people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the LORD, that he did for Israel.

verses.english:
The people served YHWH during the lifetime of Joshua and the
lifetime of the older people who lived on after Joshua and who had
witnessed all the marvelous deeds that YHWH had wrought for
Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּן־מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה בֶּן־מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
Joshua son of Nun, the servant of YHWH, died at the age of one
hundred and ten years,

translation.text: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.

verses.english:
Joshua son of Nun, the servant of YHWH, died at the age of one
hundred and ten years,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אוֹתוֹ בִּגְבוּל נַחֲלָתוֹ בְּתִמְנַת־חֶרֶס בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם מִצְּפוֹן לְהַר־גָּעַשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אוֹתוֹ בִּגְבוּל נַחֲלָתוֹ בְּתִמְנַת־חֶרֶס בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם מִצְּפוֹן לְהַר־גָּעַשׁ׃

english.text:
and was buried on his own property, at Timnath-heres in the hill
country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

translation.text: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathheres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.

verses.english:
and was buried on his own property, at Timnath-heres in the hill
country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם כּל־הַדּוֹר הַהוּא נֶאֶסְפוּ אֶל־אֲבוֹתָיו וַיָּקם דּוֹר אַחֵר אַחֲרֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְגַם אֶת־הַמַּעֲשֶׂה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם כּל־הַדּוֹר הַהוּא נֶאֶסְפוּ אֶל־אֲבוֹתָיו וַיָּקם דּוֹר אַחֵר אַחֲרֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְגַם אֶת־הַמַּעֲשֶׂה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And all that generation were likewise gathered to their fathers.
Another generation arose after them, which had not experienced
[the deliverance of] YHWH or the deeds that He had wrought for
Israel.

translation.text: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the LORD, nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.

verses.english:
And all that generation were likewise gathered to their fathers.
Another generation arose after them, which had not experienced
[the deliverance of] YHWH or the deeds that He had wrought for
Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים׃

english.text:
And the Israelites did what was offensive to YHWH. They worshiped
the Baalim

translation.text: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim:

verses.english:
And the Israelites did what was offensive to YHWH. They worshiped
the Baalim

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתָם הַמּוֹצִיא אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים מֵאֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיהֶם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם
וַיַּכְעִסוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתָם הַמּוֹצִיא אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים מֵאֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיהֶם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם
וַיַּכְעִסוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and forsook YHWH, the God of their fathers, who had brought them
out of the land of Egypt. They followed other gods, from among the
gods of the peoples around them, and bowed down to them; they
provoked YHWH.

translation.text: And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the LORD to anger.

verses.english:
and forsook YHWH, the God of their fathers, who had brought them
out of the land of Egypt. They followed other gods, from among the
gods of the peoples around them, and bowed down to them; they
provoked YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַיַּעַבְדוּ לַבַּעַל וְלָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַיַּעַבְדוּ לַבַּעַל וְלָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת׃

english.text: They forsook YHWH and worshiped Baal and the Ashtaroth.

translation.text: And they forsook the LORD, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.

verses.english: They forsook YHWH and worshiped Baal and the Ashtaroth.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־שֹׁסִים וַיָּשֹׁסּוּ אוֹתָם וַיִּמְכְּרֵם בְּיַד אוֹיְבֵיהֶם מִסָּבִיב וְלֹא־יָכְלוּ עוֹד לַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי אוֹיְבֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־שֹׁסִים וַיָּשֹׁסּוּ אוֹתָם וַיִּמְכְּרֵם בְּיַד אוֹיְבֵיהֶם מִסָּבִיב וְלֹא־יָכְלוּ עוֹד לַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי אוֹיְבֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Then YHWH was incensed at Israel, and He handed them over to foes
who plundered them. He surrendered them to their enemies on all
sides, and they could no longer hold their own against their
enemies.

translation.text: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.

verses.english:
Then YHWH was incensed at Israel, and He handed them over to foes
who plundered them. He surrendered them to their enemies on all
sides, and they could no longer hold their own against their
enemies.

verses.hebrew: בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ יַד־יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה־בָּם לְרָעָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה וְכַאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לָהֶם וַיֵּצֶר לָהֶם מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ יַד־יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה־בָּם לְרָעָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה וְכַאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לָהֶם וַיֵּצֶר לָהֶם מְאֹד׃

english.text:
In all their campaigns, the hand of YHWH was against them to their
undoing, as YHWH had declared and as YHWH had sworn to them; and
they were in great distress.

translation.text: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the LORD was against them for evil, as the LORD had said, and as the LORD had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.

verses.english:
In all their campaigns, the hand of YHWH was against them to their
undoing, as YHWH had declared and as YHWH had sworn to them; and
they were in great distress.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה שֹׁפְטִים וַיּוֹשִׁיעוּם מִיַּד שֹׁסֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה שֹׁפְטִים וַיּוֹשִׁיעוּם מִיַּד שֹׁסֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Then YHWH raised up chieftains who delivered them from those who
plundered them.

translation.text: Nevertheless the LORD raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.

verses.english:
Then YHWH raised up chieftains who delivered them from those who
plundered them.

verses.hebrew:
וְגַם אֶל־שֹׁפְטֵיהֶם לֹא שָׁמֵעוּ כִּי זָנוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם סָרוּ מַהֵר מִן־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ אֲבוֹתָם לִשְׁמֹעַ מִצְוֺת־יְהֹוָה
לֹא־עָשׂוּ כֵן׃

hebrew.text:
וְגַם אֶל־שֹׁפְטֵיהֶם לֹא שָׁמֵעוּ כִּי זָנוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם סָרוּ מַהֵר מִן־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ אֲבוֹתָם לִשְׁמֹעַ מִצְוֺת־יְהֹוָה
לֹא־עָשׂוּ כֵן׃

english.text:
But they did not heed their chieftains either; they went astray
after other gods and bowed down to them. They were quick to turn
aside from the way their fathers had followed in obedience to the
commandments of YHWH; they did not do right.

translation.text: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the LORD; but they did not so.

verses.english:
But they did not heed their chieftains either; they went astray
after other gods and bowed down to them. They were quick to turn
aside from the way their fathers had followed in obedience to the
commandments of YHWH; they did not do right.

verses.hebrew:
וְכִי־הֵקִים יְהֹוָה לָהֶם שֹׁפְטִים וְהָיָה יְהֹוָה עִם־הַשֹּׁפֵט וְהוֹשִׁיעָם מִיַּד אֹיְבֵיהֶם כֹּל יְמֵי הַשּׁוֹפֵט כִּי־יִנָּחֵם יְהֹוָה מִנַּאֲקָתָם מִפְּנֵי לֹחֲצֵיהֶם
וְדֹחֲקֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וְכִי־הֵקִים יְהֹוָה לָהֶם שֹׁפְטִים וְהָיָה יְהֹוָה עִם־הַשֹּׁפֵט וְהוֹשִׁיעָם מִיַּד אֹיְבֵיהֶם כֹּל יְמֵי הַשּׁוֹפֵט כִּי־יִנָּחֵם יְהֹוָה מִנַּאֲקָתָם מִפְּנֵי לֹחֲצֵיהֶם
וְדֹחֲקֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
When YHWH raised up chieftains for them, YHWH would be with the
chieftain and would save them from their enemies during the
chieftain’s lifetime; for YHWH would be moved to pity by their
moanings because of those who oppressed and crushed them.

translation.text: And when the LORD raised them up judges, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the LORD because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.

verses.english:
When YHWH raised up chieftains for them, YHWH would be with the
chieftain and would save them from their enemies during the
chieftain’s lifetime; for YHWH would be moved to pity by their
moanings because of those who oppressed and crushed them.

verses.hebrew:
וְהָיָה בְּמוֹת הַשּׁוֹפֵט יָשֻׁבוּ וְהִשְׁחִיתוּ מֵאֲבוֹתָם לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לְעבְדָם וּלְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לָהֶם לֹא הִפִּילוּ מִמַּעַלְלֵיהֶם וּמִדַּרְכָּם
הַקָּשָׁה׃

hebrew.text:
וְהָיָה בְּמוֹת הַשּׁוֹפֵט יָשֻׁבוּ וְהִשְׁחִיתוּ מֵאֲבוֹתָם לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לְעבְדָם וּלְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לָהֶם לֹא הִפִּילוּ מִמַּעַלְלֵיהֶם וּמִדַּרְכָּם
הַקָּשָׁה׃

english.text:
But when the chieftain died, they would again act basely, even
more than the preceding generation —following other gods,
worshiping them, and bowing down to them; they omitted none of
their practices and stubborn ways.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.

verses.english:
But when the chieftain died, they would again act basely, even
more than the preceding generation —following other gods,
worshiping them, and bowing down to them; they omitted none of
their practices and stubborn ways.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָבְרוּ הַגּוֹי הַזֶּה אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ לְקוֹלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָבְרוּ הַגּוֹי הַזֶּה אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ לְקוֹלִי׃

english.text:
Then YHWH became incensed against Israel, and He said, “Since that
nation has transgressed the covenant that I enjoined upon their
fathers and has not obeyed Me,

translation.text: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;

verses.english:
Then YHWH became incensed against Israel, and He said, “Since that
nation has transgressed the covenant that I enjoined upon their
fathers and has not obeyed Me,

verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֲנִי לֹא אוֹסִיף לְהוֹרִישׁ אִישׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶם מִן־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר־עָזַב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: גַּם־אֲנִי לֹא אוֹסִיף לְהוֹרִישׁ אִישׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶם מִן־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר־עָזַב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
I for My part will no longer drive out before them any of the
nations that Joshua left when he died.”

translation.text: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:

verses.english:
I for My part will no longer drive out before them any of the
nations that Joshua left when he died.”

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן נַסּוֹת בָּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲשֹׁמְרִים הֵם אֶת־דֶּרֶךְ יְהֹוָה לָלֶכֶת בָּם כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמְרוּ אֲבוֹתָם אִם־לֹא׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן נַסּוֹת בָּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲשֹׁמְרִים הֵם אֶת־דֶּרֶךְ יְהֹוָה לָלֶכֶת בָּם כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמְרוּ אֲבוֹתָם אִם־לֹא׃

english.text:
For it was in order to test Israel by them—[to see] whether or not
they would faithfully walk in the ways of YHWH, as their fathers
had done—

translation.text: That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the LORD to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it, or not.

verses.english:
For it was in order to test Israel by them—[to see] whether or not
they would faithfully walk in the ways of YHWH, as their fathers
had done—

verses.hebrew: וַיַּנַּח יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה לְבִלְתִּי הוֹרִישָׁם מַהֵר וְלֹא נְתָנָם בְּיַד־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּנַּח יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה לְבִלְתִּי הוֹרִישָׁם מַהֵר וְלֹא נְתָנָם בְּיַד־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃

english.text:
that YHWH had left those nations, instead of driving them out at
once, and had not delivered them into the hands of Joshua.

translation.text: Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.

verses.english:
that YHWH had left those nations, instead of driving them out at
once, and had not delivered them into the hands of Joshua.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִנִּיחַ יְהֹוָה לְנַסּוֹת בָּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעוּ אֵת כּל־מִלְחֲמוֹת כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִנִּיחַ יְהֹוָה לְנַסּוֹת בָּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעוּ אֵת כּל־מִלְחֲמוֹת כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
These are the nations that YHWH left so that He might test by them
all the Israelites who had not known any of the wars of Canaan,

translation.text: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

verses.english:
These are the nations that YHWH left so that He might test by them
all the Israelites who had not known any of the wars of Canaan,

verses.hebrew: רַק לְמַעַן דַּעַת דֹּרוֹת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְלַמְּדָם מִלְחָמָה רַק אֲשֶׁר־לְפָנִים לֹא יְדָעוּם׃

hebrew.text: רַק לְמַעַן דַּעַת דֹּרוֹת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְלַמְּדָם מִלְחָמָה רַק אֲשֶׁר־לְפָנִים לֹא יְדָעוּם׃

english.text:
so that succeeding generations of Israelites might be made to
experience war—but only those who had not known the former wars:

translation.text: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;

verses.english:
so that succeeding generations of Israelites might be made to
experience war—but only those who had not known the former wars:

verses.hebrew: חֲמֵשֶׁת סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וְכל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַצִּידֹנִי וְהַחִוִּי יֹשֵׁב הַר הַלְּבָנוֹן מֵהַר בַּעַל חֶרְמוֹן עַד לְבוֹא חֲמָת׃

hebrew.text: חֲמֵשֶׁת סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וְכל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַצִּידֹנִי וְהַחִוִּי יֹשֵׁב הַר הַלְּבָנוֹן מֵהַר בַּעַל חֶרְמוֹן עַד לְבוֹא חֲמָת׃

english.text:
the five principalities of the Philistines and all the Canaanites,
Sidonians, and Hivites who inhabited the hill country of the
Lebanon from Mount Baal-hermon to Lebo-hamath.

translation.text: Namely, five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baalhermon unto the entering in of Hamath.

verses.english:
the five principalities of the Philistines and all the Canaanites,
Sidonians, and Hivites who inhabited the hill country of the
Lebanon from Mount Baal-hermon to Lebo-hamath.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ לְנַסּוֹת בָּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לָדַעַת הֲיִשְׁמְעוּ אֶת־מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ לְנַסּוֹת בָּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לָדַעַת הֲיִשְׁמְעוּ אֶת־מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
These served as a means of testing Israel, to learn whether they
would obey the commandments which YHWH had enjoined upon their
fathers through Moses.

translation.text: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the LORD, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.

verses.english:
These served as a means of testing Israel, to learn whether they
would obey the commandments which YHWH had enjoined upon their
fathers through Moses.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יָשְׁבוּ בְּקֶרֶב הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יָשְׁבוּ בְּקֶרֶב הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃

english.text:
The Israelites settled among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites,
Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites;

translation.text: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:

verses.english:
The Israelites settled among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites,
Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם לָהֶם לְנָשִׁים וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם נָתְנוּ לִבְנֵיהֶם וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם לָהֶם לְנָשִׁים וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם נָתְנוּ לִבְנֵיהֶם וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
they took their daughters to wife and gave their own daughters to
their sons, and they worshiped their gods.

translation.text: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

verses.english:
they took their daughters to wife and gave their own daughters to
their sons, and they worshiped their gods.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁכְּחוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים וְאֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁכְּחוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים וְאֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרוֹת׃

english.text:
The Israelites did what was offensive to YHWH; they ignored YHWH
their God and worshiped the Baalim and the Asheroth.

translation.text: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and forgat the LORD their God, and served Baalim and the groves.

verses.english:
The Israelites did what was offensive to YHWH; they ignored YHWH
their God and worshiped the Baalim and the Asheroth.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְכְּרֵם בְּיַד כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם מֶלֶךְ אֲרַם נַהֲרָיִם וַיַּעַבְדוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם שְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְכְּרֵם בְּיַד כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם מֶלֶךְ אֲרַם נַהֲרָיִם וַיַּעַבְדוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם שְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
YHWH became incensed at Israel and surrendered them to King
Cushan-rishathaim of Aram-naharaim; and the Israelites were
subject to Cushan-rishathaim for eight years.

translation.text: Therefore the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Chushanrishathaim eight years.

verses.english:
YHWH became incensed at Israel and surrendered them to King
Cushan-rishathaim of Aram-naharaim; and the Israelites were
subject to Cushan-rishathaim for eight years.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה מוֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּשִׁיעֵם אֵת עתְנִיאֵל בֶּן־קְנַז אֲחִי כָלֵב הַקָּטֹן מִמֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה מוֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּשִׁיעֵם אֵת עתְנִיאֵל בֶּן־קְנַז אֲחִי כָלֵב הַקָּטֹן מִמֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
The Israelites cried out to YHWH, and YHWH raised a champion for
the Israelites to deliver them: Othniel the Kenizzite, a younger
kinsman of Caleb.

translation.text: And when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

verses.english:
The Israelites cried out to YHWH, and YHWH raised a champion for
the Israelites to deliver them: Othniel the Kenizzite, a younger
kinsman of Caleb.

verses.hebrew:
וַתְּהִי עָלָיו רוּחַ־יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּצֵא לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה בְּיָדוֹ אֶת־כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַתָּעז יָדוֹ עַל כּוּשַׁן
רִשְׁעָתָיִם׃

hebrew.text:
וַתְּהִי עָלָיו רוּחַ־יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּצֵא לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה בְּיָדוֹ אֶת־כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַתָּעז יָדוֹ עַל כּוּשַׁן
רִשְׁעָתָיִם׃

english.text:
The spirit of YHWH descended upon him and he became Israel’s
chieftain. He went out to war, and YHWH delivered King
Cushan-rishathaim of Aram into his hands. He prevailed over
Cushan-rishathaim,

translation.text: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the LORD delivered Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushanrishathaim.

verses.english:
The spirit of YHWH descended upon him and he became Israel’s
chieftain. He went out to war, and YHWH delivered King
Cushan-rishathaim of Aram into his hands. He prevailed over
Cushan-rishathaim,

verses.hebrew: וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַיָּמת עתְנִיאֵל בֶּן־קְנַז׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַיָּמת עתְנִיאֵל בֶּן־קְנַז׃

english.text:
and the land had peace for forty years. When Othniel the Kenizzite
died,

translation.text: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

verses.english:
and the land had peace for forty years. When Othniel the Kenizzite
died,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסִפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְחַזֵּק יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל כִּי־עָשׂוּ אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסִפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְחַזֵּק יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל כִּי־עָשׂוּ אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
the Israelites again did what was offensive to YHWH. And because
they did what was offensive to YHWH, YHWH let King Eglon of Moab
prevail over Israel.

translation.text: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD.

verses.english:
the Israelites again did what was offensive to YHWH. And because
they did what was offensive to YHWH, YHWH let King Eglon of Moab
prevail over Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֵלָיו אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵק וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּךְ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֶת־עִיר הַתְּמָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֵלָיו אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵק וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּךְ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֶת־עִיר הַתְּמָרִים׃

english.text:
[Eglon] brought the Ammonites and the Amalekites together under
his command, and went and defeated Israel and occupied the City of
Palms.

translation.text: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.

verses.english:
[Eglon] brought the Ammonites and the Amalekites together under
his command, and went and defeated Israel and occupied the City of
Palms.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְדוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־עֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב שְׁמוֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַבְדוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־עֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב שְׁמוֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
The Israelites were subject to King Eglon of Moab for eighteen
years.

translation.text: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

verses.english:
The Israelites were subject to King Eglon of Moab for eighteen
years.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה לָהֶם מוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־אֵהוּד בֶּן־גֵּרָא בֶּן־הַיְמִינִי אִישׁ אִטֵּר יַד־יְמִינוֹ וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיָדוֹ
מִנְחָה לְעֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה לָהֶם מוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־אֵהוּד בֶּן־גֵּרָא בֶּן־הַיְמִינִי אִישׁ אִטֵּר יַד־יְמִינוֹ וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיָדוֹ
מִנְחָה לְעֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
Then the Israelites cried out to YHWH, and YHWH raised up a
champion for them: the Benjaminite Ehud son of Gera, a left-handed
man. It happened that the Israelites sent tribute to King Eglon of
Moab through him.

translation.text: But when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.

verses.english:
Then the Israelites cried out to YHWH, and YHWH raised up a
champion for them: the Benjaminite Ehud son of Gera, a left-handed
man. It happened that the Israelites sent tribute to King Eglon of
Moab through him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ אֵהוּד חֶרֶב וְלָהּ שְׁנֵי פֵיוֹת גֹּמֶד ארְכָּהּ וַיַּחְגֹּר אוֹתָהּ מִתַּחַת לְמַדָּיו עַל יֶרֶךְ יְמִינוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ אֵהוּד חֶרֶב וְלָהּ שְׁנֵי פֵיוֹת גֹּמֶד ארְכָּהּ וַיַּחְגֹּר אוֹתָהּ מִתַּחַת לְמַדָּיו עַל יֶרֶךְ יְמִינוֹ׃

english.text:
So Ehud made for himself a two-edged dagger, a gomed in length,
which he girded on his right side under his cloak.

translation.text: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.

verses.english:
So Ehud made for himself a two-edged dagger, a gomed in length,
which he girded on his right side under his cloak.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־הַמִּנְחָה לְעֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וְעֶגְלוֹן אִישׁ בָּרִיא מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־הַמִּנְחָה לְעֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וְעֶגְלוֹן אִישׁ בָּרִיא מְאֹד׃

english.text:
He presented the tribute to King Eglon of Moab. Now Eglon was a
very stout man.

translation.text: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.

verses.english:
He presented the tribute to King Eglon of Moab. Now Eglon was a
very stout man.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלָּה לְהַקְרִיב אֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת־הָעָם נֹשְׂאֵי הַמִּנְחָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלָּה לְהַקְרִיב אֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת־הָעָם נֹשְׂאֵי הַמִּנְחָה׃

english.text:
When [Ehud] had finished presenting the tribute, he dismissed the
people who had conveyed the tribute.

translation.text: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.

verses.english:
When [Ehud] had finished presenting the tribute, he dismissed the
people who had conveyed the tribute.

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא שָׁב מִן־הַפְּסִילִים אֲשֶׁר אֶת־הַגִּלְגָּל וַיֹּאמֶר דְּבַר־סֵתֶר לִי אֵלֶיךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הָס וַיֵּצְאוּ מֵעָלָיו כּל־הָעֹמְדִים עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְהוּא שָׁב מִן־הַפְּסִילִים אֲשֶׁר אֶת־הַגִּלְגָּל וַיֹּאמֶר דְּבַר־סֵתֶר לִי אֵלֶיךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הָס וַיֵּצְאוּ מֵעָלָיו כּל־הָעֹמְדִים עָלָיו׃

english.text:
But he himself returned from Pesilim, near Gilgal, and said, “Your
Majesty, I have a secret message for you.” [Eglon] thereupon
commanded, “Silence!” So all those in attendance left his
presence;

translation.text: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.

verses.english:
But he himself returned from Pesilim, near Gilgal, and said, “Your
Majesty, I have a secret message for you.” [Eglon] thereupon
commanded, “Silence!” So all those in attendance left his
presence;

verses.hebrew: וְאֵהוּד בָּא אֵלָיו וְהוּא־יֹשֵׁב בַּעֲלִיַּת הַמְּקֵרָה אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ לְבַדּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵהוּד דְּבַר־אֱלֹהִים לִי אֵלֶיךָ וַיָּקם מֵעַל הַכִּסֵּא׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵהוּד בָּא אֵלָיו וְהוּא־יֹשֵׁב בַּעֲלִיַּת הַמְּקֵרָה אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ לְבַדּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵהוּד דְּבַר־אֱלֹהִים לִי אֵלֶיךָ וַיָּקם מֵעַל הַכִּסֵּא׃

translation.text: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵהוּד אֶת־יַד שְׂמֹאלוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הַחֶרֶב מֵעַל יֶרֶךְ יְמִינוֹ וַיִּתְקָעֶהָ בְּבִטְנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵהוּד אֶת־יַד שְׂמֹאלוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הַחֶרֶב מֵעַל יֶרֶךְ יְמִינוֹ וַיִּתְקָעֶהָ בְּבִטְנוֹ׃

english.text:
Reaching with his left hand, Ehud drew the dagger from his right
side and drove it into [Eglon’s] belly.

translation.text: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:

verses.english:
Reaching with his left hand, Ehud drew the dagger from his right
side and drove it into [Eglon’s] belly.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא גַם־הַנִּצָּב אַחַר הַלַּהַב וַיִּסְגֹּר הַחֵלֶב בְּעַד הַלַּהַב כִּי לֹא שָׁלַף הַחֶרֶב מִבִּטְנוֹ וַיֵּצֵא הַפַּרְשְׁדֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא גַם־הַנִּצָּב אַחַר הַלַּהַב וַיִּסְגֹּר הַחֵלֶב בְּעַד הַלַּהַב כִּי לֹא שָׁלַף הַחֶרֶב מִבִּטְנוֹ וַיֵּצֵא הַפַּרְשְׁדֹנָה׃

english.text:
The fat closed over the blade and the hilt went in after the
blade—for he did not pull the dagger out of his belly—and the
filth came out.

translation.text: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.

verses.english:
The fat closed over the blade and the hilt went in after the
blade—for he did not pull the dagger out of his belly—and the
filth came out.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא אֵהוּד הַמִּסְדְּרוֹנָה וַיִּסְגֹּר דַּלְתוֹת הָעֲלִיָּה בַּעֲדוֹ וְנָעָל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא אֵהוּד הַמִּסְדְּרוֹנָה וַיִּסְגֹּר דַּלְתוֹת הָעֲלִיָּה בַּעֲדוֹ וְנָעָל׃

english.text:
Stepping out into the vestibule, Ehud shut the doors of the upper
chamber on him and locked them.

translation.text: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.

verses.english:
Stepping out into the vestibule, Ehud shut the doors of the upper
chamber on him and locked them.

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא יָצָא וַעֲבָדָיו בָּאוּ וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה דַּלְתוֹת הָעֲלִיָּה נְעֻלוֹת וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַךְ מֵסִיךְ הוּא אֶת־רַגְלָיו בַּחֲדַר הַמְּקֵרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהוּא יָצָא וַעֲבָדָיו בָּאוּ וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה דַּלְתוֹת הָעֲלִיָּה נְעֻלוֹת וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַךְ מֵסִיךְ הוּא אֶת־רַגְלָיו בַּחֲדַר הַמְּקֵרָה׃

english.text:
After he left, the courtiers returned. When they saw that the
doors of the upper chamber were locked, they thought, “He must be
relieving himself in the cool chamber.”

translation.text: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.

verses.english:
After he left, the courtiers returned. When they saw that the
doors of the upper chamber were locked, they thought, “He must be
relieving himself in the cool chamber.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּחִילוּ עַד־בּוֹשׁ וְהִנֵּה אֵינֶנּוּ פֹתֵחַ דַּלְתוֹת הָעֲלִיָּה וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־הַמַּפְתֵּחַ וַיִּפְתָּחוּ וְהִנֵּה אֲדֹנֵיהֶם נֹפֵל אַרְצָה מֵת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּחִילוּ עַד־בּוֹשׁ וְהִנֵּה אֵינֶנּוּ פֹתֵחַ דַּלְתוֹת הָעֲלִיָּה וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־הַמַּפְתֵּחַ וַיִּפְתָּחוּ וְהִנֵּה אֲדֹנֵיהֶם נֹפֵל אַרְצָה מֵת׃

english.text:
They waited a long time; and when he did not open the doors of the
chamber, they took the key and opened them—and there their master
was lying dead on the floor!

translation.text: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.

verses.english:
They waited a long time; and when he did not open the doors of the
chamber, they took the key and opened them—and there their master
was lying dead on the floor!

verses.hebrew: וְאֵהוּד נִמְלַט עַד הִתְמַהְמְהָם וְהוּא עָבַר אֶת־הַפְּסִילִים וַיִּמָּלֵט הַשְּׂעִירָתָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵהוּד נִמְלַט עַד הִתְמַהְמְהָם וְהוּא עָבַר אֶת־הַפְּסִילִים וַיִּמָּלֵט הַשְּׂעִירָתָה׃

english.text:
But Ehud had made good his escape while they delayed; he had
passed Pesilim and escaped to Seirah.

translation.text: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.

verses.english:
But Ehud had made good his escape while they delayed; he had
passed Pesilim and escaped to Seirah.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאוֹ וַיִּתְקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיֵּרְדוּ עִמּוֹ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָהָר וְהוּא לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאוֹ וַיִּתְקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיֵּרְדוּ עִמּוֹ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָהָר וְהוּא לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
When he got there, he had the ram’s horn sounded through the hill
country of Ephraim, and all the Israelites descended with him from
the hill country; and he took the lead.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount, and he before them.

verses.english:
When he got there, he had the ram’s horn sounded through the hill
country of Ephraim, and all the Israelites descended with him from
the hill country; and he took the lead.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם רִדְפוּ אַחֲרַי כִּי־נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֶת־אֹיְבֵיכֶם אֶת־מוֹאָב בְּיֶדְכֶם וַיֵּרְדוּ אַחֲרָיו וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אֶת־מַעְבְּרוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן לְמוֹאָב וְלֹא־נָתְנוּ אִישׁ
לַעֲבֹר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם רִדְפוּ אַחֲרַי כִּי־נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֶת־אֹיְבֵיכֶם אֶת־מוֹאָב בְּיֶדְכֶם וַיֵּרְדוּ אַחֲרָיו וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אֶת־מַעְבְּרוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן לְמוֹאָב וְלֹא־נָתְנוּ אִישׁ
לַעֲבֹר׃

english.text:
“Follow me closely,” he said, “for YHWH has delivered your
enemies, the Moabites, into your hands.” They followed him down
and seized the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites; they let
no one cross.

translation.text: And he said unto them, Follow after me: for the LORD hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered not a man to pass over.

verses.english:
“Follow me closely,” he said, “for YHWH has delivered your
enemies, the Moabites, into your hands.” They followed him down
and seized the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites; they let
no one cross.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־מוֹאָב בָּעֵת הַהִיא כַּעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ כּל־שָׁמֵן וְכל־אִישׁ חָיִל וְלֹא נִמְלַט אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־מוֹאָב בָּעֵת הַהִיא כַּעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ כּל־שָׁמֵן וְכל־אִישׁ חָיִל וְלֹא נִמְלַט אִישׁ׃

english.text:
On that occasion they slew about 10,000 Moabites; they were all
robust and brave men, yet not one of them escaped.

translation.text: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.

verses.english:
On that occasion they slew about 10,000 Moabites; they were all
robust and brave men, yet not one of them escaped.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּכָּנַע מוֹאָב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא תַּחַת יַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ שְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּכָּנַע מוֹאָב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא תַּחַת יַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ שְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
On that day, Moab submitted to Israel; and the land was tranquil
for eighty years.

translation.text: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.

verses.english:
On that day, Moab submitted to Israel; and the land was tranquil
for eighty years.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרָיו הָיָה שַׁמְגַּר בֶּן־עֲנָת וַיַּךְ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ בְּמַלְמַד הַבָּקָר וַיּוֹשַׁע גַּם־הוּא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחֲרָיו הָיָה שַׁמְגַּר בֶּן־עֲנָת וַיַּךְ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ בְּמַלְמַד הַבָּקָר וַיּוֹשַׁע גַּם־הוּא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
After him came Shamgar son of Anath, who slew six hundred
Philistines with an oxgoad. He too was a champion of Israel.

translation.text: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.

verses.english:
After him came Shamgar son of Anath, who slew six hundred
Philistines with an oxgoad. He too was a champion of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסִפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וְאֵהוּד מֵת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסִפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וְאֵהוּד מֵת׃

english.text:
The Israelites again did what was offensive to YHWH—Ehud now being
dead.

translation.text: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD, when Ehud was dead.

verses.english:
The Israelites again did what was offensive to YHWH—Ehud now being
dead.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְכְּרֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ בְּחָצוֹר וְשַׂר־צְבָאוֹ סִיסְרָא וְהוּא יוֹשֵׁב בַּחֲרֹשֶׁת הַגּוֹיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְכְּרֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ בְּחָצוֹר וְשַׂר־צְבָאוֹ סִיסְרָא וְהוּא יוֹשֵׁב בַּחֲרֹשֶׁת הַגּוֹיִם׃

english.text:
And YHWH surrendered them to King Jabin of Canaan, who reigned in
Hazor. His army commander was Sisera, whose base was
Harosheth-goiim.

translation.text: And the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

verses.english:
And YHWH surrendered them to King Jabin of Canaan, who reigned in
Hazor. His army commander was Sisera, whose base was
Harosheth-goiim.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה כִּי תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב־בַּרְזֶל לוֹ וְהוּא לָחַץ אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּחזְקָה עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה כִּי תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב־בַּרְזֶל לוֹ וְהוּא לָחַץ אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּחזְקָה עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
The Israelites cried out to YHWH; for he had nine hundred iron
chariots, and he had oppressed Israel ruthlessly for twenty years.

translation.text: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.

verses.english:
The Israelites cried out to YHWH; for he had nine hundred iron
chariots, and he had oppressed Israel ruthlessly for twenty years.

verses.hebrew: וּדְבוֹרָה אִשָּׁה נְבִיאָה אֵשֶׁת לַפִּידוֹת הִיא שֹׁפְטָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּעֵת הַהִיא׃

hebrew.text: וּדְבוֹרָה אִשָּׁה נְבִיאָה אֵשֶׁת לַפִּידוֹת הִיא שֹׁפְטָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּעֵת הַהִיא׃

english.text:
Deborah, wife of Lappidoth, was a prophetess; she led Israel at
that time.

translation.text: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.

verses.english:
Deborah, wife of Lappidoth, was a prophetess; she led Israel at
that time.

verses.hebrew: וְהִיא יוֹשֶׁבֶת תַּחַת־תֹּמֶר דְּבוֹרָה בֵּין הָרָמָה וּבֵין בֵּית־אֵל בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיַּעֲלוּ אֵלֶיהָ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַמִּשְׁפָּט׃

hebrew.text: וְהִיא יוֹשֶׁבֶת תַּחַת־תֹּמֶר דְּבוֹרָה בֵּין הָרָמָה וּבֵין בֵּית־אֵל בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיַּעֲלוּ אֵלֶיהָ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַמִּשְׁפָּט׃

english.text:
She used to sit under the Palm of Deborah, between Ramah and
Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites would
come to her for decisions.

translation.text: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

verses.english:
She used to sit under the Palm of Deborah, between Ramah and
Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites would
come to her for decisions.

verses.hebrew:
וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתִּקְרָא לְבָרָק בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם מִקֶּדֶשׁ נַפְתָּלִי וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֲלֹא צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵךְ וּמָשַׁכְתָּ בְּהַר תָּבוֹר וְלָקַחְתָּ עִמְּךָ
עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי נַפְתָּלִי וּמִבְּנֵי זְבֻלוּן׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתִּקְרָא לְבָרָק בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם מִקֶּדֶשׁ נַפְתָּלִי וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֲלֹא צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵךְ וּמָשַׁכְתָּ בְּהַר תָּבוֹר וְלָקַחְתָּ עִמְּךָ
עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי נַפְתָּלִי וּמִבְּנֵי זְבֻלוּן׃

english.text:
She summoned Barak son of Abinoam, of Kedesh in Naphtali, and said
to him, “YHWH, the God of Israel, has commanded: Go, march up to
Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of Naphtali and
Zebulun.

translation.text: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedeshnaphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the LORD God of Israel commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

verses.english:
She summoned Barak son of Abinoam, of Kedesh in Naphtali, and said
to him, “YHWH, the God of Israel, has commanded: Go, march up to
Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of Naphtali and
Zebulun.

verses.hebrew: וּמָשַׁכְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֶל־נַחַל קִישׁוֹן אֶת־סִיסְרָא שַׂר־צְבָא יָבִין וְאֶת־רִכְבּוֹ וְאֶת־הֲמוֹנוֹ וּנְתַתִּיהוּ בְּיָדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּמָשַׁכְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֶל־נַחַל קִישׁוֹן אֶת־סִיסְרָא שַׂר־צְבָא יָבִין וְאֶת־רִכְבּוֹ וְאֶת־הֲמוֹנוֹ וּנְתַתִּיהוּ בְּיָדֶךָ׃

english.text:
And I will draw Sisera, Jabin’s army commander, with his chariots
and his troops, toward you up to the Wadi Kishon; and I will
deliver him into your hands.”

translation.text: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thine hand.

verses.english:
And I will draw Sisera, Jabin’s army commander, with his chariots
and his troops, toward you up to the Wadi Kishon; and I will
deliver him into your hands.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ בָּרָק אִם־תֵּלְכִי עִמִּי וְהָלָכְתִּי וְאִם־לֹא תֵלְכִי עִמִּי לֹא אֵלֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ בָּרָק אִם־תֵּלְכִי עִמִּי וְהָלָכְתִּי וְאִם־לֹא תֵלְכִי עִמִּי לֹא אֵלֵךְ׃

english.text:
But Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, I will go; if not,
I will not go.”

translation.text: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go: but if thou wilt not go with me, then I will not go.

verses.english:
But Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, I will go; if not,
I will not go.”

verses.hebrew:
וַתֹּאמֶר הָלֹךְ אֵלֵךְ עִמָּךְ אֶפֶס כִּי לֹא תִהְיֶה תִּפְאַרְתְּךָ עַל־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה הוֹלֵךְ כִּי בְיַד־אִשָּׁה יִמְכֹּר יְהֹוָה אֶת־סִיסְרָא וַתָּקם דְּבוֹרָה
וַתֵּלֶךְ עִם־בָּרָק קֶדְשָׁה׃

hebrew.text:
וַתֹּאמֶר הָלֹךְ אֵלֵךְ עִמָּךְ אֶפֶס כִּי לֹא תִהְיֶה תִּפְאַרְתְּךָ עַל־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה הוֹלֵךְ כִּי בְיַד־אִשָּׁה יִמְכֹּר יְהֹוָה אֶת־סִיסְרָא וַתָּקם דְּבוֹרָה
וַתֵּלֶךְ עִם־בָּרָק קֶדְשָׁה׃

english.text:
“Very well, I will go with you,” she answered. “However, there
will be no glory for you in the course you are taking, for then
YHWH will deliver Sisera into the hands of a woman.” So Deborah
went with Barak to Kedesh.

translation.text: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour; for the LORD shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

verses.english:
“Very well, I will go with you,” she answered. “However, there
will be no glory for you in the course you are taking, for then
YHWH will deliver Sisera into the hands of a woman.” So Deborah
went with Barak to Kedesh.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּזְעֵק בָּרָק אֶת־זְבוּלֻן וְאֶת־נַפְתָּלִי קֶדְשָׁה וַיַּעַל בְּרַגְלָיו עֲשֶׂרֶת אַלְפֵי אִישׁ וַתַּעַל עִמּוֹ דְּבוֹרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּזְעֵק בָּרָק אֶת־זְבוּלֻן וְאֶת־נַפְתָּלִי קֶדְשָׁה וַיַּעַל בְּרַגְלָיו עֲשֶׂרֶת אַלְפֵי אִישׁ וַתַּעַל עִמּוֹ דְּבוֹרָה׃

english.text:
Barak then mustered Zebulun and Naphtali at Kedesh; ten thousand
men marched up after him; and Deborah also went up with him.

translation.text: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.

verses.english:
Barak then mustered Zebulun and Naphtali at Kedesh; ten thousand
men marched up after him; and Deborah also went up with him.

verses.hebrew: וְחֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי נִפְרָד מִקַּיִן מִבְּנֵי חֹבָב חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה וַיֵּט אהֳלוֹ עַד־אֵילוֹן (בצענים) [בְּצַעֲנַנִּים] אֲשֶׁר אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְחֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי נִפְרָד מִקַּיִן מִבְּנֵי חֹבָב חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה וַיֵּט אהֳלוֹ עַד־אֵילוֹן (בצענים) [בְּצַעֲנַנִּים] אֲשֶׁר אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ׃

english.text:
Now Heber the Kenite had separated from the other Kenites,
descendants of Hobab, father-in-law of Moses, and had pitched his
tent at Elon-bezaanannim, which is near Kedesh.

translation.text: Now Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which is by Kedesh.

verses.english:
Now Heber the Kenite had separated from the other Kenites,
descendants of Hobab, father-in-law of Moses, and had pitched his
tent at Elon-bezaanannim, which is near Kedesh.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְסִיסְרָא כִּי עָלָה בָּרָק בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם הַר־תָּבוֹר׃
