hebrew.text: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְסִיסְרָא כִּי עָלָה בָּרָק בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם הַר־תָּבוֹר׃

english.text:
Sisera was informed that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount
Tabor.

translation.text: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.

verses.english:
Sisera was informed that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount
Tabor.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּזְעֵק סִיסְרָא אֶת־כּל־רִכְבּוֹ תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל וְאֶת־כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ מֵחֲרֹשֶׁת הַגּוֹיִם אֶל־נַחַל קִישׁוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּזְעֵק סִיסְרָא אֶת־כּל־רִכְבּוֹ תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל וְאֶת־כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ מֵחֲרֹשֶׁת הַגּוֹיִם אֶל־נַחַל קִישׁוֹן׃

english.text:
So Sisera ordered all his chariots—nine hundred iron chariots—and
all the troops he had to move from Harosheth-goiim to the Wadi
Kishon.

translation.text: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon.

verses.english:
So Sisera ordered all his chariots—nine hundred iron chariots—and
all the troops he had to move from Harosheth-goiim to the Wadi
Kishon.

verses.hebrew:
וַתֹּאמֶר דְּבֹרָה אֶל־בָּרָק קוּם כִּי זֶה הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֶת־סִיסְרָא בְּיָדֶךָ הֲלֹא יְהֹוָה יָצָא לְפָנֶיךָ וַיֵּרֶד בָּרָק מֵהַר תָּבוֹר וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים
אִישׁ אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַתֹּאמֶר דְּבֹרָה אֶל־בָּרָק קוּם כִּי זֶה הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֶת־סִיסְרָא בְּיָדֶךָ הֲלֹא יְהֹוָה יָצָא לְפָנֶיךָ וַיֵּרֶד בָּרָק מֵהַר תָּבוֹר וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים
אִישׁ אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
Then Deborah said to Barak, “Up! This is the day on which YHWH
will deliver Sisera into your hands: YHWH is marching before you.”
Barak charged down Mount Tabor, followed by the ten thousand men,

translation.text: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which the LORD hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the LORD gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

verses.english:
Then Deborah said to Barak, “Up! This is the day on which YHWH
will deliver Sisera into your hands: YHWH is marching before you.”
Barak charged down Mount Tabor, followed by the ten thousand men,

verses.hebrew: וַיָּהם יְהֹוָה אֶת־סִיסְרָא וְאֶת־כּל־הָרֶכֶב וְאֶת־כּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה לְפִי־חֶרֶב לִפְנֵי בָרָק וַיֵּרֶד סִיסְרָא מֵעַל הַמֶּרְכָּבָה וַיָּנס בְּרַגְלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּהם יְהֹוָה אֶת־סִיסְרָא וְאֶת־כּל־הָרֶכֶב וְאֶת־כּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה לְפִי־חֶרֶב לִפְנֵי בָרָק וַיֵּרֶד סִיסְרָא מֵעַל הַמֶּרְכָּבָה וַיָּנס בְּרַגְלָיו׃

english.text:
and YHWH threw Sisera and all his chariots and army into a panic
before the onslaught of Barak. Sisera leaped from his chariot and
fled on foot

translation.text: And the LORD discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot, and fled away on his feet.

verses.english:
and YHWH threw Sisera and all his chariots and army into a panic
before the onslaught of Barak. Sisera leaped from his chariot and
fled on foot

verses.hebrew: וּבָרָק רָדַף אַחֲרֵי הָרֶכֶב וְאַחֲרֵי הַמַּחֲנֶה עַד חֲרֹשֶׁת הַגּוֹיִם וַיִּפֹּל כּל־מַחֲנֵה סִיסְרָא לְפִי־חֶרֶב לֹא נִשְׁאַר עַד־אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וּבָרָק רָדַף אַחֲרֵי הָרֶכֶב וְאַחֲרֵי הַמַּחֲנֶה עַד חֲרֹשֶׁת הַגּוֹיִם וַיִּפֹּל כּל־מַחֲנֵה סִיסְרָא לְפִי־חֶרֶב לֹא נִשְׁאַר עַד־אֶחָד׃

english.text:
as Barak pursued the chariots and the soldiers as far as
Harosheth-goiim. All of Sisera’s soldiers fell by the sword; not a
man was left.

translation.text: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.

verses.english:
as Barak pursued the chariots and the soldiers as far as
Harosheth-goiim. All of Sisera’s soldiers fell by the sword; not a
man was left.

verses.hebrew: וְסִיסְרָא נָס בְּרַגְלָיו אֶל־אֹהֶל יָעֵל אֵשֶׁת חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי כִּי שָׁלוֹם בֵּין יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־חָצוֹר וּבֵין בֵּית חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי׃

hebrew.text: וְסִיסְרָא נָס בְּרַגְלָיו אֶל־אֹהֶל יָעֵל אֵשֶׁת חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי כִּי שָׁלוֹם בֵּין יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־חָצוֹר וּבֵין בֵּית חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי׃

english.text:
Sisera, meanwhile, had fled on foot to the tent of Jael, wife of
Heber the Kenite; for there was friendship between King Jabin of
Hazor and the family of Heber the Kenite.

translation.text: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

verses.english:
Sisera, meanwhile, had fled on foot to the tent of Jael, wife of
Heber the Kenite; for there was friendship between King Jabin of
Hazor and the family of Heber the Kenite.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּצֵא יָעֵל לִקְרַאת סִיסְרָא וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו סוּרָה אֲדֹנִי סוּרָה אֵלַי אַל־תִּירָא וַיָּסַר אֵלֶיהָ הָאֹהֱלָה וַתְּכַסֵּהוּ בַּשְּׂמִיכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּצֵא יָעֵל לִקְרַאת סִיסְרָא וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו סוּרָה אֲדֹנִי סוּרָה אֵלַי אַל־תִּירָא וַיָּסַר אֵלֶיהָ הָאֹהֱלָה וַתְּכַסֵּהוּ בַּשְּׂמִיכָה׃

english.text:
Jael came out to greet Sisera and said to him, “Come in, my lord,
come in here, do not be afraid.” So he entered her tent, and she
covered him with a blanket.

translation.text: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.

verses.english:
Jael came out to greet Sisera and said to him, “Come in, my lord,
come in here, do not be afraid.” So he entered her tent, and she
covered him with a blanket.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ הַשְׁקִינִי־נָא מְעַט־מַיִם כִּי צָמֵאתִי וַתִּפְתַּח אֶת־נֹאוד הֶחָלָב וַתַּשְׁקֵהוּ וַתְּכַסֵּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ הַשְׁקִינִי־נָא מְעַט־מַיִם כִּי צָמֵאתִי וַתִּפְתַּח אֶת־נֹאוד הֶחָלָב וַתַּשְׁקֵהוּ וַתְּכַסֵּהוּ׃

english.text:
He said to her, “Please let me have some water; I am thirsty.” She
opened a skin of milk and gave him some to drink; and she covered
him again.

translation.text: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.

verses.english:
He said to her, “Please let me have some water; I am thirsty.” She
opened a skin of milk and gave him some to drink; and she covered
him again.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ עֲמֹד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וְהָיָה אִם־אִישׁ יָבֹא וּשְׁאֵלֵךְ וְאָמַר הֲיֵשׁ־פֹּה אִישׁ וְאָמַרְתְּ אָיִן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ עֲמֹד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וְהָיָה אִם־אִישׁ יָבֹא וּשְׁאֵלֵךְ וְאָמַר הֲיֵשׁ־פֹּה אִישׁ וְאָמַרְתְּ אָיִן׃

english.text:
He said to her, “Stand at the entrance of the tent. If anybody
comes and asks you if there is anybody here, say ‘No.’”

translation.text: Again he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and enquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.

verses.english:
He said to her, “Stand at the entrance of the tent. If anybody
comes and asks you if there is anybody here, say ‘No.’”

verses.hebrew:
וַתִּקַּח יָעֵל אֵשֶׁת־חֶבֶר אֶת־יְתַד הָאֹהֶל וַתָּשֶׂם אֶת־הַמַּקֶּבֶת בְּיָדָהּ וַתָּבוֹא אֵלָיו בַּלָּאט וַתִּתְקַע אֶת־הַיָּתֵד בְּרַקָּתוֹ וַתִּצְנַח בָּאָרֶץ וְהוּא־נִרְדָּם
וַיָּעַף וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּקַּח יָעֵל אֵשֶׁת־חֶבֶר אֶת־יְתַד הָאֹהֶל וַתָּשֶׂם אֶת־הַמַּקֶּבֶת בְּיָדָהּ וַתָּבוֹא אֵלָיו בַּלָּאט וַתִּתְקַע אֶת־הַיָּתֵד בְּרַקָּתוֹ וַתִּצְנַח בָּאָרֶץ וְהוּא־נִרְדָּם
וַיָּעַף וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
Then Jael wife of Heber took a tent pin and grasped the mallet.
When he was fast asleep from exhaustion, she approached him
stealthily and drove the pin through his temple till it went down
to the ground. Thus he died.

translation.text: Then Jael Heber’s wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.

verses.english:
Then Jael wife of Heber took a tent pin and grasped the mallet.
When he was fast asleep from exhaustion, she approached him
stealthily and drove the pin through his temple till it went down
to the ground. Thus he died.

verses.hebrew:
וְהִנֵּה בָרָק רֹדֵף אֶת־סִיסְרָא וַתֵּצֵא יָעֵל לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ וְאַרְאֶךָּ אֶת־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּה מְבַקֵּשׁ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וְהִנֵּה סִיסְרָא נֹפֵל מֵת
וְהַיָּתֵד בְּרַקָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִנֵּה בָרָק רֹדֵף אֶת־סִיסְרָא וַתֵּצֵא יָעֵל לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ וְאַרְאֶךָּ אֶת־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּה מְבַקֵּשׁ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וְהִנֵּה סִיסְרָא נֹפֵל מֵת
וְהַיָּתֵד בְּרַקָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
Now Barak appeared in pursuit of Sisera. Jael went out to greet
him and said, “Come, I will show you the man you are looking for.”
He went inside with her, and there Sisera was lying dead, with the
pin in his temple.

translation.text: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest. And when he came into her tent, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail was in his temples.

verses.english:
Now Barak appeared in pursuit of Sisera. Jael went out to greet
him and said, “Come, I will show you the man you are looking for.”
He went inside with her, and there Sisera was lying dead, with the
pin in his temple.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכְנַע אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֵת יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנָעַן לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכְנַע אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֵת יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנָעַן לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
On that day God subdued King Jabin of Canaan before the
Israelites.

translation.text: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.

verses.english:
On that day God subdued King Jabin of Canaan before the
Israelites.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ יַד בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָלוֹךְ וְקָשָׁה עַל יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנָעַן עַד אֲשֶׁר הִכְרִיתוּ אֵת יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶךְ יַד בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָלוֹךְ וְקָשָׁה עַל יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנָעַן עַד אֲשֶׁר הִכְרִיתוּ אֵת יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
The hand of the Israelites bore harder and harder on King Jabin of
Canaan, until they destroyed King Jabin of Canaan.

translation.text: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

verses.english:
The hand of the Israelites bore harder and harder on King Jabin of
Canaan, until they destroyed King Jabin of Canaan.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּשַׁר דְּבוֹרָה וּבָרָק בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּשַׁר דְּבוֹרָה וּבָרָק בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: On that day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang:

translation.text: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,

verses.english: On that day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang:

verses.hebrew: בִּפְרֹעַ פְּרָעוֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהִתְנַדֵּב עָם בָּרְכוּ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּפְרֹעַ פְּרָעוֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהִתְנַדֵּב עָם בָּרְכוּ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
When locks go untrimmed in Israel, When people dedicate
themselves— Bless YHWH!

translation.text: Praise ye the LORD for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.

verses.english:
When locks go untrimmed in Israel, When people dedicate
themselves— Bless YHWH!

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ מְלָכִים הַאֲזִינוּ רֹזְנִים אָנֹכִי לַיהֹוָה אָנֹכִי אָשִׁירָה אֲזַמֵּר לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: שִׁמְעוּ מְלָכִים הַאֲזִינוּ רֹזְנִים אָנֹכִי לַיהֹוָה אָנֹכִי אָשִׁירָה אֲזַמֵּר לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Hear, O kings! Give ear, O potentates! I will sing, will sing to
YHWH, Will hymn YHWH, the God of Israel.

translation.text: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the LORD; I will sing praise to the LORD God of Israel.

verses.english:
Hear, O kings! Give ear, O potentates! I will sing, will sing to
YHWH, Will hymn YHWH, the God of Israel.

verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה בְּצֵאתְךָ מִשֵּׂעִיר בְּצַעְדְּךָ מִשְּׂדֵה אֱדוֹם אֶרֶץ רָעָשָׁה גַּם־שָׁמַיִם נָטָפוּ גַּם־עָבִים נָטְפוּ מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה בְּצֵאתְךָ מִשֵּׂעִיר בְּצַעְדְּךָ מִשְּׂדֵה אֱדוֹם אֶרֶץ רָעָשָׁה גַּם־שָׁמַיִם נָטָפוּ גַּם־עָבִים נָטְפוּ מָיִם׃

english.text:
O LORD, when You came forth from Seir, Advanced from the country
of Edom, The earth trembled; The heavens dripped, Yea, the clouds
dripped water,

translation.text: LORD, when thou wentest out of Seir, when thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.

verses.english:
O LORD, when You came forth from Seir, Advanced from the country
of Edom, The earth trembled; The heavens dripped, Yea, the clouds
dripped water,

verses.hebrew: הָרִים נָזְלוּ מִפְּנֵי יְהֹוָה זֶה סִינַי מִפְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: הָרִים נָזְלוּ מִפְּנֵי יְהֹוָה זֶה סִינַי מִפְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The mountains quaked— Before YHWH, Him of Sinai, Before YHWH, God
of Israel.

translation.text: The mountains melted from before the LORD, even that Sinai from before the LORD God of Israel.

verses.english:
The mountains quaked— Before YHWH, Him of Sinai, Before YHWH, God
of Israel.

verses.hebrew: בִּימֵי שַׁמְגַּר בֶּן־עֲנָת בִּימֵי יָעֵל חָדְלוּ אֳרָחוֹת וְהֹלְכֵי נְתִיבוֹת יֵלְכוּ אֳרָחוֹת עֲקַלְקַלּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: בִּימֵי שַׁמְגַּר בֶּן־עֲנָת בִּימֵי יָעֵל חָדְלוּ אֳרָחוֹת וְהֹלְכֵי נְתִיבוֹת יֵלְכוּ אֳרָחוֹת עֲקַלְקַלּוֹת׃

english.text:
In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, In the days of Jael, caravans
ceased, And wayfarers went By roundabout paths.

translation.text: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travellers walked through byways.

verses.english:
In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, In the days of Jael, caravans
ceased, And wayfarers went By roundabout paths.

verses.hebrew: חָדְלוּ פְרָזוֹן בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל חָדֵלּוּ עַד שַׁקַּמְתִּי דְּבוֹרָה שַׁקַּמְתִּי אֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: חָדְלוּ פְרָזוֹן בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל חָדֵלּוּ עַד שַׁקַּמְתִּי דְּבוֹרָה שַׁקַּמְתִּי אֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Deliverance ceased, Ceased in Israel, Till you arose, O Deborah,
Arose, O mother, in Israel!

translation.text: The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel.

verses.english:
Deliverance ceased, Ceased in Israel, Till you arose, O Deborah,
Arose, O mother, in Israel!

verses.hebrew: יִבְחַר אֱלֹהִים חֲדָשִׁים אָז לָחֶם שְׁעָרִים מָגֵן אִם־יֵרָאֶה וָרֹמַח בְּאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: יִבְחַר אֱלֹהִים חֲדָשִׁים אָז לָחֶם שְׁעָרִים מָגֵן אִם־יֵרָאֶה וָרֹמַח בְּאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
When they chose new gods, Was there a fighter then in the gates?
No shield or spear was seen Among forty thousand in Israel!

translation.text: They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?

verses.english:
When they chose new gods, Was there a fighter then in the gates?
No shield or spear was seen Among forty thousand in Israel!

verses.hebrew: לִבִּי לְחוֹקְקֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּתְנַדְּבִים בָּעָם בָּרְכוּ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: לִבִּי לְחוֹקְקֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּתְנַדְּבִים בָּעָם בָּרְכוּ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
My heart is with Israel’s leaders, With the dedicated of the
people— Bless YHWH!

translation.text: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, that offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless ye the LORD.

verses.english:
My heart is with Israel’s leaders, With the dedicated of the
people— Bless YHWH!

verses.hebrew: רֹכְבֵי אֲתֹנוֹת צְחֹרוֹת יֹשְׁבֵי עַל־מִדִּין וְהֹלְכֵי עַל־דֶּרֶךְ שִׂיחוּ׃

hebrew.text: רֹכְבֵי אֲתֹנוֹת צְחֹרוֹת יֹשְׁבֵי עַל־מִדִּין וְהֹלְכֵי עַל־דֶּרֶךְ שִׂיחוּ׃

english.text:
You riders on tawny she-asses, You who sit on saddle rugs, And you
wayfarers, declare it!

translation.text: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.

verses.english:
You riders on tawny she-asses, You who sit on saddle rugs, And you
wayfarers, declare it!

verses.hebrew: מִקּוֹל מְחַצְצִים בֵּין מַשְׁאַבִּים שָׁם יְתַנּוּ צִדְקוֹת יְהֹוָה צִדְקֹת פִּרְזוֹנוֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אָז יָרְדוּ לַשְּׁעָרִים עַם־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: מִקּוֹל מְחַצְצִים בֵּין מַשְׁאַבִּים שָׁם יְתַנּוּ צִדְקוֹת יְהֹוָה צִדְקֹת פִּרְזוֹנוֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אָז יָרְדוּ לַשְּׁעָרִים עַם־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Louder than the sound of archers, There among the watering places
Let them chant the gracious acts of YHWH, His gracious deliverance
of Israel. Then did the people of YHWH March down to the gates!

translation.text: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the LORD, even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the LORD go down to the gates.

verses.english:
Louder than the sound of archers, There among the watering places
Let them chant the gracious acts of YHWH, His gracious deliverance
of Israel. Then did the people of YHWH March down to the gates!

verses.hebrew: עוּרִי עוּרִי דְּבוֹרָה עוּרִי עוּרִי דַּבְּרִי־שִׁיר קוּם בָּרָק וּשְׁבֵה שֶׁבְיְךָ בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם׃

hebrew.text: עוּרִי עוּרִי דְּבוֹרָה עוּרִי עוּרִי דַּבְּרִי־שִׁיר קוּם בָּרָק וּשְׁבֵה שֶׁבְיְךָ בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם׃

english.text:
Awake, awake, O Deborah! Awake, awake, strike up the chant! Arise,
O Barak; Take your captives, O son of Abinoam!

translation.text: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead thy captivity captive, thou son of Abinoam.

verses.english:
Awake, awake, O Deborah! Awake, awake, strike up the chant! Arise,
O Barak; Take your captives, O son of Abinoam!

verses.hebrew: אָז יְרַד שָׂרִיד לְאַדִּירִים עָם יְהֹוָה יְרַד־לִי בַּגִּבּוֹרִים׃

hebrew.text: אָז יְרַד שָׂרִיד לְאַדִּירִים עָם יְהֹוָה יְרַד־לִי בַּגִּבּוֹרִים׃

english.text:
Then was the remnant made victor over the mighty, YHWH’s people
won my victory over the warriors.

translation.text: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the LORD made me have dominion over the mighty.

verses.english:
Then was the remnant made victor over the mighty, YHWH’s people
won my victory over the warriors.

verses.hebrew: מִנִּי אֶפְרַיִם שׁרְשָׁם בַּעֲמָלֵק אַחֲרֶיךָ בִנְיָמִין בַּעֲמָמֶיךָ מִנִּי מָכִיר יָרְדוּ מְחֹקְקִים וּמִזְּבוּלֻן מֹשְׁכִים בְּשֵׁבֶט סֹפֵר׃

hebrew.text: מִנִּי אֶפְרַיִם שׁרְשָׁם בַּעֲמָלֵק אַחֲרֶיךָ בִנְיָמִין בַּעֲמָמֶיךָ מִנִּי מָכִיר יָרְדוּ מְחֹקְקִים וּמִזְּבוּלֻן מֹשְׁכִים בְּשֵׁבֶט סֹפֵר׃

english.text:
From Ephraim came they whose roots are in Amalek; After you, your
kin Benjamin; From Machir came down leaders, From Zebulun such as
hold the marshal’s staff.

translation.text: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; after thee, Benjamin, among thy people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.

verses.english:
From Ephraim came they whose roots are in Amalek; After you, your
kin Benjamin; From Machir came down leaders, From Zebulun such as
hold the marshal’s staff.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׂרַי בְּיִשָּׂשכָר עִם־דְּבֹרָה וְיִשָּׂשכָר כֵּן בָּרָק בָּעֵמֶק שֻׁלַּח בְּרַגְלָיו בִּפְלַגּוֹת רְאוּבֵן גְּדֹלִים חִקְקֵי־לֵב׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׂרַי בְּיִשָּׂשכָר עִם־דְּבֹרָה וְיִשָּׂשכָר כֵּן בָּרָק בָּעֵמֶק שֻׁלַּח בְּרַגְלָיו בִּפְלַגּוֹת רְאוּבֵן גְּדֹלִים חִקְקֵי־לֵב׃

english.text:
And Issachar’s chiefs were with Deborah; As Barak, so was
Issachar— Rushing after him into the valley. Among the clans of
Reuben Were great decisions of heart.

translation.text: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart.

verses.english:
And Issachar’s chiefs were with Deborah; As Barak, so was
Issachar— Rushing after him into the valley. Among the clans of
Reuben Were great decisions of heart.

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה יָשַׁבְתָּ בֵּין הַמִּשְׁפְּתַיִם לִשְׁמֹעַ שְׁרִקוֹת עֲדָרִים לִפְלַגּוֹת רְאוּבֵן גְּדוֹלִים חִקְרֵי־לֵב׃

hebrew.text: לָמָּה יָשַׁבְתָּ בֵּין הַמִּשְׁפְּתַיִם לִשְׁמֹעַ שְׁרִקוֹת עֲדָרִים לִפְלַגּוֹת רְאוּבֵן גְּדוֹלִים חִקְרֵי־לֵב׃

english.text:
Why then did you stay among the sheepfolds And listen as they pipe
for the flocks? Among the clans of Reuben Were great searchings of
heart!

translation.text: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.

verses.english:
Why then did you stay among the sheepfolds And listen as they pipe
for the flocks? Among the clans of Reuben Were great searchings of
heart!

verses.hebrew: גִּלְעָד בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁכֵן וְדָן לָמָּה יָגוּר אֳנִיּוֹת אָשֵׁר יָשַׁב לְחוֹף יַמִּים וְעַל מִפְרָצָיו יִשְׁכּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: גִּלְעָד בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁכֵן וְדָן לָמָּה יָגוּר אֳנִיּוֹת אָשֵׁר יָשַׁב לְחוֹף יַמִּים וְעַל מִפְרָצָיו יִשְׁכּוֹן׃

english.text:
Gilead tarried beyond the Jordan; And Dan—why did he linger by the
ships? Asher remained at the seacoast And tarried at his landings.

translation.text: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.

verses.english:
Gilead tarried beyond the Jordan; And Dan—why did he linger by the
ships? Asher remained at the seacoast And tarried at his landings.

verses.hebrew: זְבֻלוּן עַם חֵרֵף נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת וְנַפְתָּלִי עַל מְרוֹמֵי שָׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: זְבֻלוּן עַם חֵרֵף נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת וְנַפְתָּלִי עַל מְרוֹמֵי שָׂדֶה׃

english.text:
Zebulun is a people that mocked at death, Naphtali—on the open
heights.

translation.text: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.

verses.english:
Zebulun is a people that mocked at death, Naphtali—on the open
heights.

verses.hebrew: בָּאוּ מְלָכִים נִלְחָמוּ אָז נִלְחֲמוּ מַלְכֵי כְנַעַן בְּתַעְנַךְ עַל־מֵי מְגִדּוֹ בֶּצַע כֶּסֶף לֹא לָקָחוּ׃

hebrew.text: בָּאוּ מְלָכִים נִלְחָמוּ אָז נִלְחֲמוּ מַלְכֵי כְנַעַן בְּתַעְנַךְ עַל־מֵי מְגִדּוֹ בֶּצַע כֶּסֶף לֹא לָקָחוּ׃

english.text:
Then the kings came, they fought: The kings of Canaan fought At
Taanach, by Megiddo’s waters— They got no spoil of silver.

translation.text: The kings came and fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.

verses.english:
Then the kings came, they fought: The kings of Canaan fought At
Taanach, by Megiddo’s waters— They got no spoil of silver.

verses.hebrew: מִן־שָׁמַיִם נִלְחָמוּ הַכּוֹכָבִים מִמְּסִלּוֹתָם נִלְחֲמוּ עִם־סִיסְרָא׃

hebrew.text: מִן־שָׁמַיִם נִלְחָמוּ הַכּוֹכָבִים מִמְּסִלּוֹתָם נִלְחֲמוּ עִם־סִיסְרָא׃

english.text:
The stars fought from heaven, From their courses they fought
against Sisera.

translation.text: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.

verses.english:
The stars fought from heaven, From their courses they fought
against Sisera.

verses.hebrew: נַחַל קִישׁוֹן גְּרָפָם נַחַל קְדוּמִים נַחַל קִישׁוֹן תִּדְרְכִי נַפְשִׁי עֹז׃

hebrew.text: נַחַל קִישׁוֹן גְּרָפָם נַחַל קְדוּמִים נַחַל קִישׁוֹן תִּדְרְכִי נַפְשִׁי עֹז׃

english.text:
The torrent Kishon swept them away, The raging torrent, the
torrent Kishon. March on, my soul, with courage!

translation.text: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.

verses.english:
The torrent Kishon swept them away, The raging torrent, the
torrent Kishon. March on, my soul, with courage!

verses.hebrew: אָז הָלְמוּ עִקְּבֵי־סוּס מִדַּהֲרוֹת דַּהֲרוֹת אַבִּירָיו׃

hebrew.text: אָז הָלְמוּ עִקְּבֵי־סוּס מִדַּהֲרוֹת דַּהֲרוֹת אַבִּירָיו׃

english.text: Then the horses’ hoofs pounded As headlong galloped the steeds.

translation.text: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.

verses.english: Then the horses’ hoofs pounded As headlong galloped the steeds.

verses.hebrew: אוֹרוּ מֵרוֹז אָמַר מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֹרוּ אָרוֹר יֹשְׁבֶיהָ כִּי לֹא־בָאוּ לְעֶזְרַת יְהֹוָה לְעֶזְרַת יְהֹוָה בַּגִּבּוֹרִים׃

hebrew.text: אוֹרוּ מֵרוֹז אָמַר מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֹרוּ אָרוֹר יֹשְׁבֶיהָ כִּי לֹא־בָאוּ לְעֶזְרַת יְהֹוָה לְעֶזְרַת יְהֹוָה בַּגִּבּוֹרִים׃

english.text:
“Curse Meroz!” said the angel of YHWH. “Bitterly curse its
inhabitants, Because they came not to the aid of YHWH, To the aid
of YHWH among the warriors.”

translation.text: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of the LORD, curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof; because they came not to the help of the LORD, to the help of the LORD against the mighty.

verses.english:
“Curse Meroz!” said the angel of YHWH. “Bitterly curse its
inhabitants, Because they came not to the aid of YHWH, To the aid
of YHWH among the warriors.”

verses.hebrew: תְּבֹרַךְ מִנָּשִׁים יָעֵל אֵשֶׁת חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי מִנָּשִׁים בָּאֹהֶל תְּבֹרָךְ׃

hebrew.text: תְּבֹרַךְ מִנָּשִׁים יָעֵל אֵשֶׁת חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי מִנָּשִׁים בָּאֹהֶל תְּבֹרָךְ׃

english.text:
Most blessed of women be Jael, Wife of Heber the Kenite, Most
blessed of women in tents.

translation.text: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.

verses.english:
Most blessed of women be Jael, Wife of Heber the Kenite, Most
blessed of women in tents.

verses.hebrew: מַיִם שָׁאַל חָלָב נָתָנָה בְּסֵפֶל אַדִּירִים הִקְרִיבָה חֶמְאָה׃

hebrew.text: מַיִם שָׁאַל חָלָב נָתָנָה בְּסֵפֶל אַדִּירִים הִקְרִיבָה חֶמְאָה׃

english.text:
He asked for water, she offered milk; In a princely bowl she
brought him curds.

translation.text: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.

verses.english:
He asked for water, she offered milk; In a princely bowl she
brought him curds.

verses.hebrew: יָדָהּ לַיָּתֵד תִּשְׁלַחְנָה וִימִינָהּ לְהַלְמוּת עֲמֵלִים וְהָלְמָה סִיסְרָא מָחֲקָה רֹאשׁוֹ וּמָחֲצָה וְחָלְפָה רַקָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: יָדָהּ לַיָּתֵד תִּשְׁלַחְנָה וִימִינָהּ לְהַלְמוּת עֲמֵלִים וְהָלְמָה סִיסְרָא מָחֲקָה רֹאשׁוֹ וּמָחֲצָה וְחָלְפָה רַקָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
Her [left] hand reached for the tent pin, Her right for the
workmen’s hammer. She struck Sisera, crushed his head, Smashed and
pierced his temple.

translation.text: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen’s hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and stricken through his temples.

verses.english:
Her [left] hand reached for the tent pin, Her right for the
workmen’s hammer. She struck Sisera, crushed his head, Smashed and
pierced his temple.

verses.hebrew: בֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ כָּרַע נָפַל שָׁכָב בֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ כָּרַע נָפָל בַּאֲשֶׁר כָּרַע שָׁם נָפַל שָׁדוּד׃

hebrew.text: בֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ כָּרַע נָפַל שָׁכָב בֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ כָּרַע נָפָל בַּאֲשֶׁר כָּרַע שָׁם נָפַל שָׁדוּד׃

english.text:
At her feet he sank, lay outstretched, At her feet he sank, lay
still; Where he sank, there he lay—destroyed.

translation.text: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

verses.english:
At her feet he sank, lay outstretched, At her feet he sank, lay
still; Where he sank, there he lay—destroyed.

verses.hebrew: בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן נִשְׁקְפָה וַתְּיַבֵּב אֵם סִיסְרָא בְּעַד הָאֶשְׁנָב מַדּוּעַ בֹּשֵׁשׁ רִכְבּוֹ לָבוֹא מַדּוּעַ אֶחֱרוּ פַּעֲמֵי מַרְכְּבוֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן נִשְׁקְפָה וַתְּיַבֵּב אֵם סִיסְרָא בְּעַד הָאֶשְׁנָב מַדּוּעַ בֹּשֵׁשׁ רִכְבּוֹ לָבוֹא מַדּוּעַ אֶחֱרוּ פַּעֲמֵי מַרְכְּבוֹתָיו׃

english.text:
Through the window peered Sisera’s mother, Behind the lattice she
whined: “Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why so late the
clatter of his wheels?”

translation.text: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?

verses.english:
Through the window peered Sisera’s mother, Behind the lattice she
whined: “Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why so late the
clatter of his wheels?”

verses.hebrew: חַכְמוֹת שָׂרוֹתֶיהָ תַּעֲנֶינָּה אַף־הִיא תָּשִׁיב אֲמָרֶיהָ לָהּ׃

hebrew.text: חַכְמוֹת שָׂרוֹתֶיהָ תַּעֲנֶינָּה אַף־הִיא תָּשִׁיב אֲמָרֶיהָ לָהּ׃

english.text:
The wisest of her ladies give answer; She, too, replies to
herself:

translation.text: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,

verses.english:
The wisest of her ladies give answer; She, too, replies to
herself:

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא יִמְצְאוּ יְחַלְּקוּ שָׁלָל רַחַם רַחֲמָתַיִם לְרֹאשׁ גֶּבֶר שְׁלַל צְבָעִים לְסִיסְרָא שְׁלַל צְבָעִים רִקְמָה צֶבַע רִקְמָתַיִם לְצַוְּארֵי שָׁלָל׃

hebrew.text: הֲלֹא יִמְצְאוּ יְחַלְּקוּ שָׁלָל רַחַם רַחֲמָתַיִם לְרֹאשׁ גֶּבֶר שְׁלַל צְבָעִים לְסִיסְרָא שְׁלַל צְבָעִים רִקְמָה צֶבַע רִקְמָתַיִם לְצַוְּארֵי שָׁלָל׃

english.text:
“They must be dividing the spoil they have found: A damsel or two
for each man, Spoil of dyed cloths for Sisera, Spoil of
embroidered cloths, A couple of embroidered cloths Round every
neck as spoil.”

translation.text: Have they not sped? have they not divided the prey; to every man a damsel or two; to Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet for the necks of them that take the spoil?

verses.english:
“They must be dividing the spoil they have found: A damsel or two
for each man, Spoil of dyed cloths for Sisera, Spoil of
embroidered cloths, A couple of embroidered cloths Round every
neck as spoil.”

verses.hebrew: כֵּן יֹאבְדוּ כל־אוֹיְבֶיךָ יְהֹוָה וְאֹהֲבָיו כְּצֵאת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בִּגְבֻרָתוֹ וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: כֵּן יֹאבְדוּ כל־אוֹיְבֶיךָ יְהֹוָה וְאֹהֲבָיו כְּצֵאת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בִּגְבֻרָתוֹ וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
So may all Your enemies perish, O LORD! But may His friends be as
the sun rising in might! And the land was tranquil forty years.

translation.text: So let all thine enemies perish, O LORD: but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.

verses.english:
So may all Your enemies perish, O LORD! But may His friends be as
the sun rising in might! And the land was tranquil forty years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־מִדְיָן שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־מִדְיָן שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
Then the Israelites did what was offensive to YHWH, and YHWH
delivered them into the hands of the Midianites for seven years.

translation.text: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

verses.english:
Then the Israelites did what was offensive to YHWH, and YHWH
delivered them into the hands of the Midianites for seven years.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּעז יַד־מִדְיָן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִפְּנֵי מִדְיָן עָשׂוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַמִּנְהָרוֹת אֲשֶׁר בֶּהָרִים וְאֶת־הַמְּעָרוֹת וְאֶת־הַמְּצָדוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּעז יַד־מִדְיָן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִפְּנֵי מִדְיָן עָשׂוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַמִּנְהָרוֹת אֲשֶׁר בֶּהָרִים וְאֶת־הַמְּעָרוֹת וְאֶת־הַמְּצָדוֹת׃

english.text:
The hand of the Midianites prevailed over Israel; and because of
Midian, the Israelites provided themselves with refuges in the
caves and strongholds of the mountains.

translation.text: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.

verses.english:
The hand of the Midianites prevailed over Israel; and because of
Midian, the Israelites provided themselves with refuges in the
caves and strongholds of the mountains.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם־זָרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעָלָה מִדְיָן וַעֲמָלֵק וּבְנֵי־קֶדֶם וְעָלוּ עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אִם־זָרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעָלָה מִדְיָן וַעֲמָלֵק וּבְנֵי־קֶדֶם וְעָלוּ עָלָיו׃

english.text:
After the Israelites had done their sowing, Midian, Amalek, and
the Kedemites would come up and raid them;

translation.text: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;

verses.english:
After the Israelites had done their sowing, Midian, Amalek, and
the Kedemites would come up and raid them;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲנוּ עֲלֵיהֶם וַיַּשְׁחִיתוּ אֶת־יְבוּל הָאָרֶץ עַד־בּוֹאֲךָ עַזָּה וְלֹא־יַשְׁאִירוּ מִחְיָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְשֶׂה וָשׁוֹר וַחֲמוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲנוּ עֲלֵיהֶם וַיַּשְׁחִיתוּ אֶת־יְבוּל הָאָרֶץ עַד־בּוֹאֲךָ עַזָּה וְלֹא־יַשְׁאִירוּ מִחְיָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְשֶׂה וָשׁוֹר וַחֲמוֹר׃

english.text:
they would attack them, destroy the produce of the land all the
way to Gaza, and leave no means of sustenance in Israel, not a
sheep or an ox or an ass.

translation.text: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.

verses.english:
they would attack them, destroy the produce of the land all the
way to Gaza, and leave no means of sustenance in Israel, not a
sheep or an ox or an ass.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הֵם וּמִקְנֵיהֶם יַעֲלוּ וְאהֳלֵיהֶם (יבאו) [וּבָאוּ] כְדֵי־אַרְבֶּה לָרֹב וְלָהֶם וְלִגְמַלֵּיהֶם אֵין מִסְפָּר וַיָּבֹאוּ בָאָרֶץ לְשַׁחֲתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הֵם וּמִקְנֵיהֶם יַעֲלוּ וְאהֳלֵיהֶם (יבאו) [וּבָאוּ] כְדֵי־אַרְבֶּה לָרֹב וְלָהֶם וְלִגְמַלֵּיהֶם אֵין מִסְפָּר וַיָּבֹאוּ בָאָרֶץ לְשַׁחֲתָהּ׃

english.text:
For they would come up with their livestock and their tents,
swarming as thick as locusts; they and their camels were
innumerable. Thus they would invade the land and ravage it.

translation.text: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; for both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.

verses.english:
For they would come up with their livestock and their tents,
swarming as thick as locusts; they and their camels were
innumerable. Thus they would invade the land and ravage it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּדַּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מְאֹד מִפְּנֵי מִדְיָן וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּדַּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מְאֹד מִפְּנֵי מִדְיָן וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Israel was reduced to utter misery by the Midianites, and the
Israelites cried out to YHWH.

translation.text: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the LORD.

verses.english:
Israel was reduced to utter misery by the Midianites, and the
Israelites cried out to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי־זָעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה עַל אֹדוֹת מִדְיָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי־זָעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה עַל אֹדוֹת מִדְיָן׃

english.text: When the Israelites cried to YHWH on account of Midian,

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD because of the Midianites,

verses.english: When the Israelites cried to YHWH on account of Midian,

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהֹוָה אִישׁ נָבִיא אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָנֹכִי הֶעֱלֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וָאֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מִבֵּית
עֲבָדִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהֹוָה אִישׁ נָבִיא אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָנֹכִי הֶעֱלֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וָאֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מִבֵּית
עֲבָדִים׃

english.text:
YHWH sent a prophet to the Israelites who said to them, “Thus said
YHWH, the God of Israel: I brought you up out of Egypt and freed
you from the house of bondage.

translation.text: That the LORD sent a prophet unto the children of Israel, which said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;

verses.english:
YHWH sent a prophet to the Israelites who said to them, “Thus said
YHWH, the God of Israel: I brought you up out of Egypt and freed
you from the house of bondage.

verses.hebrew: וָאַצִּל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם וּמִיַּד כּל־לֹחֲצֵיכֶם וָאֲגָרֵשׁ אוֹתָם מִפְּנֵיכֶם וָאֶתְּנָה לָכֶם אֶת־אַרְצָם׃

hebrew.text: וָאַצִּל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם וּמִיַּד כּל־לֹחֲצֵיכֶם וָאֲגָרֵשׁ אוֹתָם מִפְּנֵיכֶם וָאֶתְּנָה לָכֶם אֶת־אַרְצָם׃

english.text:
I rescued you from the Egyptians and from all your oppressors; I
drove them out before you, and gave you their land.

translation.text: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;

verses.english:
I rescued you from the Egyptians and from all your oppressors; I
drove them out before you, and gave you their land.

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמְרָה לָכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לֹא תִירְאוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יוֹשְׁבִים בְּאַרְצָם וְלֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּם בְּקוֹלִי׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמְרָה לָכֶם אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לֹא תִירְאוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יוֹשְׁבִים בְּאַרְצָם וְלֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּם בְּקוֹלִי׃

english.text:
And I said to you, ‘I YHWH am your God. You must not worship the
gods of the Amorites in whose land you dwell.’ But you did not
obey Me.”

translation.text: And I said unto you, I am the LORD your God; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but ye have not obeyed my voice.

verses.english:
And I said to you, ‘I YHWH am your God. You must not worship the
gods of the Amorites in whose land you dwell.’ But you did not
obey Me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה וַיֵּשֶׁב תַּחַת הָאֵלָה אֲשֶׁר בְּעפְרָה אֲשֶׁר לְיוֹאָשׁ אֲבִי הָעֶזְרִי וְגִדְעוֹן בְּנוֹ חֹבֵט חִטִּים בַּגַּת לְהָנִיס מִפְּנֵי מִדְיָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה וַיֵּשֶׁב תַּחַת הָאֵלָה אֲשֶׁר בְּעפְרָה אֲשֶׁר לְיוֹאָשׁ אֲבִי הָעֶזְרִי וְגִדְעוֹן בְּנוֹ חֹבֵט חִטִּים בַּגַּת לְהָנִיס מִפְּנֵי מִדְיָן׃

english.text:
An angel of YHWH came and sat under the terebinth at Ophrah, which
belonged to Joash the Abiezrite. His son Gideon was then beating
out wheat inside a winepress in order to keep it safe from the
Midianites.

translation.text: And there came an angel of the LORD, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abiezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.

verses.english:
An angel of YHWH came and sat under the terebinth at Ophrah, which
belonged to Joash the Abiezrite. His son Gideon was then beating
out wheat inside a winepress in order to keep it safe from the
Midianites.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה עִמְּךָ גִּבּוֹר הֶחָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה עִמְּךָ גִּבּוֹר הֶחָיִל׃

english.text:
The angel of YHWH appeared to him and said to him, “YHWH is with
you, valiant warrior!”

translation.text: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.

verses.english:
The angel of YHWH appeared to him and said to him, “YHWH is with
you, valiant warrior!”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו גִּדְעוֹן בִּי אֲדֹנִי וְיֵשׁ יְהֹוָה עִמָּנוּ וְלָמָּה מְצָאַתְנוּ כּל־זֹאת וְאַיֵּה כל־נִפְלְאֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר סִפְּרוּ־לָנוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לֵאמֹר הֲלֹא מִמִּצְרַיִם
הֶעֱלָנוּ יְהֹוָה וְעַתָּה נְטָשָׁנוּ יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְּנֵנוּ בְּכַף־מִדְיָן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו גִּדְעוֹן בִּי אֲדֹנִי וְיֵשׁ יְהֹוָה עִמָּנוּ וְלָמָּה מְצָאַתְנוּ כּל־זֹאת וְאַיֵּה כל־נִפְלְאֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר סִפְּרוּ־לָנוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לֵאמֹר הֲלֹא מִמִּצְרַיִם
הֶעֱלָנוּ יְהֹוָה וְעַתָּה נְטָשָׁנוּ יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְּנֵנוּ בְּכַף־מִדְיָן׃

english.text:
Gideon said to him, “Please, my lord, if YHWH is with us, why has
all this befallen us? Where are all His wondrous deeds about which
our fathers told us, saying, ‘Truly YHWH brought us up from
Egypt’? Now YHWH has abandoned us and delivered us into the hands
of Midian!”

translation.text: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if the LORD be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the LORD bring us up from Egypt? but now the LORD hath forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.

verses.english:
Gideon said to him, “Please, my lord, if YHWH is with us, why has
all this befallen us? Where are all His wondrous deeds about which
our fathers told us, saying, ‘Truly YHWH brought us up from
Egypt’? Now YHWH has abandoned us and delivered us into the hands
of Midian!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֵךְ בְּכֹחֲךָ זֶה וְהוֹשַׁעְתָּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכַּף מִדְיָן הֲלֹא שְׁלַחְתִּיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֶן אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֵךְ בְּכֹחֲךָ זֶה וְהוֹשַׁעְתָּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכַּף מִדְיָן הֲלֹא שְׁלַחְתִּיךָ׃

english.text:
YHWH turned to him and said, “Go in this strength of yours and
deliver Israel from the Midianites. I herewith make you My
messenger.”

translation.text: And the LORD looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?

verses.english:
YHWH turned to him and said, “Go in this strength of yours and
deliver Israel from the Midianites. I herewith make you My
messenger.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בִּי אֲדֹנָי בַּמָּה אוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנֵּה אַלְפִּי הַדַּל בִּמְנַשֶּׁה וְאָנֹכִי הַצָּעִיר בְּבֵית אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בִּי אֲדֹנָי בַּמָּה אוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנֵּה אַלְפִּי הַדַּל בִּמְנַשֶּׁה וְאָנֹכִי הַצָּעִיר בְּבֵית אָבִי׃

english.text:
He said to Him, “Please, my lord, how can I deliver Israel? Why,
my clan is the humblest in Manasseh, and I am the youngest in my
father’s household.”

translation.text: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.

verses.english:
He said to Him, “Please, my lord, how can I deliver Israel? Why,
my clan is the humblest in Manasseh, and I am the youngest in my
father’s household.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה כִּי אֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ וְהִכִּיתָ אֶת־מִדְיָן כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה כִּי אֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ וְהִכִּיתָ אֶת־מִדְיָן כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד׃

english.text:
YHWH replied, “I will be with you, and you shall defeat Midian to
a man.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.

verses.english:
YHWH replied, “I will be with you, and you shall defeat Midian to
a man.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אִם־נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ לִּי אוֹת שָׁאַתָּה מְדַבֵּר עִמִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אִם־נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ לִּי אוֹת שָׁאַתָּה מְדַבֵּר עִמִּי׃

english.text:
And he said to Him, “If I have gained Your favor, give me a sign
that it is You who are speaking to me:

translation.text: And he said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me.

verses.english:
And he said to Him, “If I have gained Your favor, give me a sign
that it is You who are speaking to me:

verses.hebrew: אַל־נָא תָמֻשׁ מִזֶּה עַד־בֹּאִי אֵלֶיךָ וְהֹצֵאתִי אֶת־מִנְחָתִי וְהִנַּחְתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ וַיֹּאמַר אָנֹכִי אֵשֵׁב עַד שׁוּבֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אַל־נָא תָמֻשׁ מִזֶּה עַד־בֹּאִי אֵלֶיךָ וְהֹצֵאתִי אֶת־מִנְחָתִי וְהִנַּחְתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ וַיֹּאמַר אָנֹכִי אֵשֵׁב עַד שׁוּבֶךָ׃

english.text:
do not leave this place until I come back to You and bring out my
offering and place it before You.” And He answered, “I will stay
until you return.”

translation.text: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and set it before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.

verses.english:
do not leave this place until I come back to You and bring out my
offering and place it before You.” And He answered, “I will stay
until you return.”

verses.hebrew: וְגִדְעוֹן בָּא וַיַּעַשׂ גְּדִי־עִזִּים וְאֵיפַת־קֶמַח מַצּוֹת הַבָּשָׂר שָׂם בַּסַּל וְהַמָּרַק שָׂם בַּפָּרוּר וַיּוֹצֵא אֵלָיו אֶל־תַּחַת הָאֵלָה וַיַּגַּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְגִדְעוֹן בָּא וַיַּעַשׂ גְּדִי־עִזִּים וְאֵיפַת־קֶמַח מַצּוֹת הַבָּשָׂר שָׂם בַּסַּל וְהַמָּרַק שָׂם בַּפָּרוּר וַיּוֹצֵא אֵלָיו אֶל־תַּחַת הָאֵלָה וַיַּגַּשׁ׃

english.text:
So Gideon went in and prepared a kid, and [baked] unleavened bread
from an ephah of flour. He put the meat in a basket and poured the
broth into a pot, and he brought them out to Him under the
terebinth. As he presented them,

translation.text: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it.

verses.english:
So Gideon went in and prepared a kid, and [baked] unleavened bread
from an ephah of flour. He put the meat in a basket and poured the
broth into a pot, and he brought them out to Him under the
terebinth. As he presented them,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים קַח אֶת־הַבָּשָׂר וְאֶת־הַמַּצּוֹת וְהַנַּח אֶל־הַסֶּלַע הַלָּז וְאֶת־הַמָּרַק שְׁפוֹךְ וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים קַח אֶת־הַבָּשָׂר וְאֶת־הַמַּצּוֹת וְהַנַּח אֶל־הַסֶּלַע הַלָּז וְאֶת־הַמָּרַק שְׁפוֹךְ וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן׃

english.text:
the angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened
bread, put them on yonder rock, and spill out the broth.” He did
so.

translation.text: And the angel of God said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.

verses.english:
the angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened
bread, put them on yonder rock, and spill out the broth.” He did
so.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת־קְצֵה הַמִּשְׁעֶנֶת אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ וַיִּגַּע בַּבָּשָׂר וּבַמַּצּוֹת וַתַּעַל הָאֵשׁ מִן־הַצּוּר וַתֹּאכַל אֶת־הַבָּשָׂר וְאֶת־הַמַּצּוֹת
וּמַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הָלַךְ מֵעֵינָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת־קְצֵה הַמִּשְׁעֶנֶת אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ וַיִּגַּע בַּבָּשָׂר וּבַמַּצּוֹת וַתַּעַל הָאֵשׁ מִן־הַצּוּר וַתֹּאכַל אֶת־הַבָּשָׂר וְאֶת־הַמַּצּוֹת
וּמַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הָלַךְ מֵעֵינָיו׃

english.text:
The angel of YHWH held out the staff that he carried, and touched
the meat and the unleavened bread with its tip. A fire sprang up
from the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened bread. And
the angel of YHWH vanished from his sight.

translation.text: Then the angel of the LORD put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the LORD departed out of his sight.

verses.english:
The angel of YHWH held out the staff that he carried, and touched
the meat and the unleavened bread with its tip. A fire sprang up
from the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened bread. And
the angel of YHWH vanished from his sight.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא גִּדְעוֹן כִּי־מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הוּא וַיֹּאמֶר גִּדְעוֹן אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה כִּי־עַל־כֵּן רָאִיתִי מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה פָּנִים אֶל־פָּנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא גִּדְעוֹן כִּי־מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הוּא וַיֹּאמֶר גִּדְעוֹן אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה כִּי־עַל־כֵּן רָאִיתִי מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה פָּנִים אֶל־פָּנִים׃

english.text:
Then Gideon realized that it was an angel of YHWH; and Gideon
said, “Alas, O Lord GOD! For I have seen an angel of YHWH face to
face.”

translation.text: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the LORD, Gideon said, Alas, O LORD God! for because I have seen an angel of the LORD face to face.

verses.english:
Then Gideon realized that it was an angel of YHWH; and Gideon
said, “Alas, O Lord GOD! For I have seen an angel of YHWH face to
face.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהֹוָה שָׁלוֹם לְךָ אַל־תִּירָא לֹא תָּמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהֹוָה שָׁלוֹם לְךָ אַל־תִּירָא לֹא תָּמוּת׃

english.text:
But YHWH said to him, “All is well; have no fear, you shall not
die.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.

verses.english:
But YHWH said to him, “All is well; have no fear, you shall not
die.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן שָׁם גִּדְעוֹן מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה וַיִּקְרָא־לוֹ יְהֹוָה שָׁלוֹם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה עוֹדֶנּוּ בְּעפְרָת אֲבִי הָעֶזְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן שָׁם גִּדְעוֹן מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה וַיִּקְרָא־לוֹ יְהֹוָה שָׁלוֹם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה עוֹדֶנּוּ בְּעפְרָת אֲבִי הָעֶזְרִי׃

english.text:
So Gideon built there an altar to YHWH and called it
Adonai-shalom. To this day it stands in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

translation.text: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovahshalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

verses.english:
So Gideon built there an altar to YHWH and called it
Adonai-shalom. To this day it stands in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהֹוָה קַח אֶת־פַּר־הַשּׁוֹר אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִיךָ וּפַר הַשֵּׁנִי שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְהָרַסְתָּ אֶת־מִזְבַּח הַבַּעַל אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִיךָ
וְאֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו תִּכְרֹת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהֹוָה קַח אֶת־פַּר־הַשּׁוֹר אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִיךָ וּפַר הַשֵּׁנִי שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְהָרַסְתָּ אֶת־מִזְבַּח הַבַּעַל אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִיךָ
וְאֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו תִּכְרֹת׃

english.text:
That night YHWH said to him: “Take the young bull belonging to
your father and another bull seven years old; pull down the altar
of Baal which belongs to your father, and cut down the sacred post
which is beside it.

translation.text: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Take thy father’s young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the grove that is by it:

verses.english:
That night YHWH said to him: “Take the young bull belonging to
your father and another bull seven years old; pull down the altar
of Baal which belongs to your father, and cut down the sacred post
which is beside it.

verses.hebrew: וּבָנִיתָ מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עַל רֹאשׁ הַמָּעוֹז הַזֶּה בַּמַּעֲרָכָה וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת־הַפָּר הַשֵּׁנִי וְהַעֲלִיתָ עוֹלָה בַּעֲצֵי הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר תִּכְרֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּבָנִיתָ מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עַל רֹאשׁ הַמָּעוֹז הַזֶּה בַּמַּעֲרָכָה וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת־הַפָּר הַשֵּׁנִי וְהַעֲלִיתָ עוֹלָה בַּעֲצֵי הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר תִּכְרֹת׃

english.text:
Then build an altar to YHWH your God, on the level ground on top
of this stronghold. Take the other bull and offer it as a burnt
offering, using the wood of the sacred post that you have cut
down.”

translation.text: And build an altar unto the LORD thy God upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down.

verses.english:
Then build an altar to YHWH your God, on the level ground on top
of this stronghold. Take the other bull and offer it as a burnt
offering, using the wood of the sacred post that you have cut
down.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח גִּדְעוֹן עֲשָׂרָה אֲנָשִׁים מֵעֲבָדָיו וַיַּעַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָרֵא אֶת־בֵּית אָבִיו וְאֶת־אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר מֵעֲשׂוֹת יוֹמָם
וַיַּעַשׂ לָיְלָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח גִּדְעוֹן עֲשָׂרָה אֲנָשִׁים מֵעֲבָדָיו וַיַּעַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָרֵא אֶת־בֵּית אָבִיו וְאֶת־אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר מֵעֲשׂוֹת יוֹמָם
וַיַּעַשׂ לָיְלָה׃

translation.text: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father’s household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר בַּבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה נֻתַּץ מִזְבַּח הַבַּעַל וְהָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו כֹּרָתָה וְאֵת הַפָּר הַשֵּׁנִי הֹעֲלָה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַבָּנוּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר בַּבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה נֻתַּץ מִזְבַּח הַבַּעַל וְהָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו כֹּרָתָה וְאֵת הַפָּר הַשֵּׁנִי הֹעֲלָה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַבָּנוּי׃

english.text:
Early the next morning, the townspeople found that the altar of
Baal had been torn down and the sacred post beside it had been cut
down, and that the second bull had been offered on the newly built
altar.

translation.text: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.

verses.english:
Early the next morning, the townspeople found that the altar of
Baal had been torn down and the sacred post beside it had been cut
down, and that the second bull had been offered on the newly built
altar.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ מִי עָשָׂה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיִּדְרְשׁוּ וַיְבַקְשׁוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ גִּדְעוֹן בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ עָשָׂה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ מִי עָשָׂה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיִּדְרְשׁוּ וַיְבַקְשׁוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ גִּדְעוֹן בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ עָשָׂה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
They said to one another, “Who did this thing?” Upon inquiry and
investigation, they were told, “Gideon son of Joash did this
thing!”

translation.text: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.

verses.english:
They said to one another, “Who did this thing?” Upon inquiry and
investigation, they were told, “Gideon son of Joash did this
thing!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר אֶל־יוֹאָשׁ הוֹצֵא אֶת־בִּנְךָ וְיָמֹת כִּי נָתַץ אֶת־מִזְבַּח הַבַּעַל וְכִי כָרַת הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר אֶל־יוֹאָשׁ הוֹצֵא אֶת־בִּנְךָ וְיָמֹת כִּי נָתַץ אֶת־מִזְבַּח הַבַּעַל וְכִי כָרַת הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו׃

english.text:
The townspeople said to Joash, “Bring out your son, for he must
die: he has torn down the altar of Baal and cut down the sacred
post beside it!”

translation.text: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die: because he hath cast down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it.

verses.english:
The townspeople said to Joash, “Bring out your son, for he must
die: he has torn down the altar of Baal and cut down the sacred
post beside it!”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָשׁ לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָמְדוּ עָלָיו הַאַתֶּם תְּרִיבוּן לַבַּעַל אִם־אַתֶּם תּוֹשִׁיעוּן אוֹתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָרִיב לוֹ יוּמַת עַד־הַבֹּקֶר אִם־אֱלֹהִים הוּא יָרֶב לוֹ כִּי
נָתַץ אֶת־מִזְבְּחוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָשׁ לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָמְדוּ עָלָיו הַאַתֶּם תְּרִיבוּן לַבַּעַל אִם־אַתֶּם תּוֹשִׁיעוּן אוֹתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָרִיב לוֹ יוּמַת עַד־הַבֹּקֶר אִם־אֱלֹהִים הוּא יָרֶב לוֹ כִּי
נָתַץ אֶת־מִזְבְּחוֹ׃

english.text:
But Joash said to all who had risen against him, “Do you have to
contend for Baal? Do you have to vindicate him? Whoever fights his
battles shall be dead by morning! If he is a god, let him fight
his own battles, since it is his altar that has been torn down!”

translation.text: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning: if he be a god, let him plead for himself, because one hath cast down his altar.

verses.english:
But Joash said to all who had risen against him, “Do you have to
contend for Baal? Do you have to vindicate him? Whoever fights his
battles shall be dead by morning! If he is a god, let him fight
his own battles, since it is his altar that has been torn down!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא־לוֹ בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא יְרֻבַּעַל לֵאמֹר יָרֶב בּוֹ הַבַּעַל כִּי נָתַץ אֶת־מִזְבְּחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא־לוֹ בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא יְרֻבַּעַל לֵאמֹר יָרֶב בּוֹ הַבַּעַל כִּי נָתַץ אֶת־מִזְבְּחוֹ׃

english.text:
That day they named him Jerubbaal, meaning “Let Baal contend with
him, since he tore down his altar.”

translation.text: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.

verses.english:
That day they named him Jerubbaal, meaning “Let Baal contend with
him, since he tore down his altar.”

verses.hebrew: וְכל־מִדְיָן וַעֲמָלֵק וּבְנֵי־קֶדֶם נֶאֶסְפוּ יַחְדָּו וַיַּעַבְרוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעֵמֶק יִזְרְעֶאל׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־מִדְיָן וַעֲמָלֵק וּבְנֵי־קֶדֶם נֶאֶסְפוּ יַחְדָּו וַיַּעַבְרוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעֵמֶק יִזְרְעֶאל׃

english.text:
All Midian, Amalek, and the Kedemites joined forces; they crossed
over and encamped in the Valley of Jezreel.

translation.text: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.

verses.english:
All Midian, Amalek, and the Kedemites joined forces; they crossed
over and encamped in the Valley of Jezreel.

verses.hebrew: וְרוּחַ יְהֹוָה לָבְשָׁה אֶת־גִּדְעוֹן וַיִּתְקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיִּזָּעֵק אֲבִיעֶזֶר אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְרוּחַ יְהֹוָה לָבְשָׁה אֶת־גִּדְעוֹן וַיִּתְקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיִּזָּעֵק אֲבִיעֶזֶר אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
The spirit of YHWH enveloped Gideon; he sounded the horn, and the
Abiezrites rallied behind him.

translation.text: But the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered after him.

verses.english:
The spirit of YHWH enveloped Gideon; he sounded the horn, and the
Abiezrites rallied behind him.

verses.hebrew: וּמַלְאָכִים שָׁלַח בְּכל־מְנַשֶּׁה וַיִּזָּעֵק גַּם־הוּא אַחֲרָיו וּמַלְאָכִים שָׁלַח בְּאָשֵׁר וּבִזְבֻלוּן וּבְנַפְתָּלִי וַיַּעֲלוּ לִקְרָאתָם׃

hebrew.text: וּמַלְאָכִים שָׁלַח בְּכל־מְנַשֶּׁה וַיִּזָּעֵק גַּם־הוּא אַחֲרָיו וּמַלְאָכִים שָׁלַח בְּאָשֵׁר וּבִזְבֻלוּן וּבְנַפְתָּלִי וַיַּעֲלוּ לִקְרָאתָם׃

english.text:
And he sent messengers throughout Manasseh, and they too rallied
behind him. He then sent messengers through Asher, Zebulun, and
Naphtali, and they came up to meet the Manassites.

translation.text: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.

verses.english:
And he sent messengers throughout Manasseh, and they too rallied
behind him. He then sent messengers through Asher, Zebulun, and
Naphtali, and they came up to meet the Manassites.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר גִּדְעוֹן אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים אִם־יֶשְׁךָ מוֹשִׁיעַ בְּיָדִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר גִּדְעוֹן אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים אִם־יֶשְׁךָ מוֹשִׁיעַ בְּיָדִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ׃

english.text:
And Gideon said to God, “If You really intend to deliver Israel
through me as You have said—

translation.text: And Gideon said unto God, If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said,

verses.english:
And Gideon said to God, “If You really intend to deliver Israel
through me as You have said—

verses.hebrew:
הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מַצִּיג אֶת־גִּזַּת הַצֶּמֶר בַּגֹּרֶן אִם טַל יִהְיֶה עַל־הַגִּזָּה לְבַדָּהּ וְעַל־כּל־הָאָרֶץ חֹרֶב וְיָדַעְתִּי כִּי־תוֹשִׁיעַ בְּיָדִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר
דִּבַּרְתָּ׃

hebrew.text:
הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מַצִּיג אֶת־גִּזַּת הַצֶּמֶר בַּגֹּרֶן אִם טַל יִהְיֶה עַל־הַגִּזָּה לְבַדָּהּ וְעַל־כּל־הָאָרֶץ חֹרֶב וְיָדַעְתִּי כִּי־תוֹשִׁיעַ בְּיָדִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר
דִּבַּרְתָּ׃

english.text:
here I place a fleece of wool on the threshing floor. If dew falls
only on the fleece and all the ground remains dry, I shall know
that You will deliver Israel through me, as You have said.”

translation.text: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.

verses.english:
here I place a fleece of wool on the threshing floor. If dew falls
only on the fleece and all the ground remains dry, I shall know
that You will deliver Israel through me, as You have said.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־כֵן וַיַּשְׁכֵּם מִמּחֳרָת וַיָּזַר אֶת־הַגִּזָּה וַיִּמֶץ טַל מִן־הַגִּזָּה מְלוֹא הַסֵּפֶל מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי־כֵן וַיַּשְׁכֵּם מִמּחֳרָת וַיָּזַר אֶת־הַגִּזָּה וַיִּמֶץ טַל מִן־הַגִּזָּה מְלוֹא הַסֵּפֶל מָיִם׃

english.text:
And that is what happened. Early the next day, he squeezed the
fleece and wrung out the dew from the fleece, a bowlful of water.

translation.text: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.

verses.english:
And that is what happened. Early the next day, he squeezed the
fleece and wrung out the dew from the fleece, a bowlful of water.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר גִּדְעוֹן אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים אַל־יִחַר אַפְּךָ בִּי וַאֲדַבְּרָה אַךְ הַפָּעַם אֲנַסֶּה נָּא־רַק־הַפַּעַם בַּגִּזָּה יְהִי־נָא חֹרֶב אֶל־הַגִּזָּה לְבַדָּהּ וְעַל־כּל־הָאָרֶץ
יִהְיֶה־טָּל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר גִּדְעוֹן אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים אַל־יִחַר אַפְּךָ בִּי וַאֲדַבְּרָה אַךְ הַפָּעַם אֲנַסֶּה נָּא־רַק־הַפַּעַם בַּגִּזָּה יְהִי־נָא חֹרֶב אֶל־הַגִּזָּה לְבַדָּהּ וְעַל־כּל־הָאָרֶץ
יִהְיֶה־טָּל׃

english.text:
Then Gideon said to God, “Do not be angry with me if I speak just
once more. Let me make just one more test with the fleece: let the
fleece alone be dry, while there is dew all over the ground.”

translation.text: And Gideon said unto God, Let not thine anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.

verses.english:
Then Gideon said to God, “Do not be angry with me if I speak just
once more. Let me make just one more test with the fleece: let the
fleece alone be dry, while there is dew all over the ground.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֱלֹהִים כֵּן בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיְהִי־חֹרֶב אֶל־הַגִּזָּה לְבַדָּהּ וְעַל־כּל־הָאָרֶץ הָיָה טָל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֱלֹהִים כֵּן בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיְהִי־חֹרֶב אֶל־הַגִּזָּה לְבַדָּהּ וְעַל־כּל־הָאָרֶץ הָיָה טָל׃

english.text:
God did so that night: only the fleece was dry, while there was
dew all over the ground.

translation.text: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.

verses.english:
God did so that night: only the fleece was dry, while there was
dew all over the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְרֻבַּעַל הוּא גִדְעוֹן וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל־עֵין חֲרֹד וּמַחֲנֵה מִדְיָן הָיָה־לוֹ מִצָּפוֹן מִגִּבְעַת הַמּוֹרֶה בָּעֵמֶק׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְרֻבַּעַל הוּא גִדְעוֹן וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל־עֵין חֲרֹד וּמַחֲנֵה מִדְיָן הָיָה־לוֹ מִצָּפוֹן מִגִּבְעַת הַמּוֹרֶה בָּעֵמֶק׃

english.text:
Early next day, Jerubbaal—that is, Gideon—and all the troops with
him encamped above En-harod, while the camp of Midian was in the
plain to the north of him, at Gibeath-moreh.

translation.text: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people that were with him, rose up early, and pitched beside the well of Harod: so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

verses.english:
Early next day, Jerubbaal—that is, Gideon—and all the troops with
him encamped above En-harod, while the camp of Midian was in the
plain to the north of him, at Gibeath-moreh.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן רַב הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתָּךְ מִתִּתִּי אֶת־מִדְיָן בְּיָדָם פֶּן־יִתְפָּאֵר עָלַי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר יָדִי הוֹשִׁיעָה לִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן רַב הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתָּךְ מִתִּתִּי אֶת־מִדְיָן בְּיָדָם פֶּן־יִתְפָּאֵר עָלַי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר יָדִי הוֹשִׁיעָה לִּי׃

english.text:
YHWH said to Gideon, “You have too many troops with you for Me to
deliver Midian into their hands; Israel might claim for themselves
the glory due to Me, thinking, ‘Our own hand has brought us
victory.’

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.

verses.english:
YHWH said to Gideon, “You have too many troops with you for Me to
deliver Midian into their hands; Israel might claim for themselves
the glory due to Me, thinking, ‘Our own hand has brought us
victory.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה קְרָא נָא בְּאזְנֵי הָעָם לֵאמֹר מִי־יָרֵא וְחָרֵד יָשֹׁב וְיִצְפֹּר מֵהַר הַגִּלְעָד וַיָּשׁב מִן־הָעָם עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים נִשְׁאָרוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה קְרָא נָא בְּאזְנֵי הָעָם לֵאמֹר מִי־יָרֵא וְחָרֵד יָשֹׁב וְיִצְפֹּר מֵהַר הַגִּלְעָד וַיָּשׁב מִן־הָעָם עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים נִשְׁאָרוּ׃

english.text:
Therefore, announce to the men, ‘Let anybody who is timid and
fearful turn back, as a bird flies from Mount Gilead.’” Thereupon,
22,000 of the troops turned back and 10,000 remained.

translation.text: Now therefore go to, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whosoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and depart early from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.

verses.english:
Therefore, announce to the men, ‘Let anybody who is timid and
fearful turn back, as a bird flies from Mount Gilead.’” Thereupon,
22,000 of the troops turned back and 10,000 remained.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן עוֹד הָעָם רָב הוֹרֵד אוֹתָם אֶל־הַמַּיִם וְאֶצְרְפֶנּוּ לְךָ שָׁם וְהָיָה אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ זֶה יֵלֵךְ אִתָּךְ הוּא יֵלֵךְ אִתָּךְ וְכֹל
אֲשֶׁר־אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ זֶה לֹא־יֵלֵךְ עִמָּךְ הוּא לֹא יֵלֵךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן עוֹד הָעָם רָב הוֹרֵד אוֹתָם אֶל־הַמַּיִם וְאֶצְרְפֶנּוּ לְךָ שָׁם וְהָיָה אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ זֶה יֵלֵךְ אִתָּךְ הוּא יֵלֵךְ אִתָּךְ וְכֹל
אֲשֶׁר־אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ זֶה לֹא־יֵלֵךְ עִמָּךְ הוּא לֹא יֵלֵךְ׃

english.text:
“There are still too many troops,” YHWH said to Gideon. “Take them
down to the water and I will sift them for you there. Anyone of
whom I tell you, ‘This one is to go with you,’ that one shall go
with you; and anyone of whom I tell you, ‘This one is not to go
with you,’ that one shall not go.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for thee there: and it shall be, that of whom I say unto thee, This shall go with thee, the same shall go with thee; and of whomsoever I say unto thee, This shall not go with thee, the same shall not go.

verses.english:
“There are still too many troops,” YHWH said to Gideon. “Take them
down to the water and I will sift them for you there. Anyone of
whom I tell you, ‘This one is to go with you,’ that one shall go
with you; and anyone of whom I tell you, ‘This one is not to go
with you,’ that one shall not go.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיּוֹרֶד אֶת־הָעָם אֶל־הַמָּיִם וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יָלֹק בִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ מִן־הַמַּיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר יָלֹק הַכֶּלֶב תַּצִּיג אוֹתוֹ לְבָד וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִכְרַע
עַל־בִּרְכָּיו לִשְׁתּוֹת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיּוֹרֶד אֶת־הָעָם אֶל־הַמָּיִם וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יָלֹק בִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ מִן־הַמַּיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר יָלֹק הַכֶּלֶב תַּצִּיג אוֹתוֹ לְבָד וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִכְרַע
עַל־בִּרְכָּיו לִשְׁתּוֹת׃

english.text:
So he took the troops down to the water. Then YHWH said to Gideon,
“Set apart all those who lap up the water with their tongues like
dogs from all those who get down on their knees to drink.”

translation.text: So he brought down the people unto the water: and the LORD said unto Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shalt thou set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.

verses.english:
So he took the troops down to the water. Then YHWH said to Gideon,
“Set apart all those who lap up the water with their tongues like
dogs from all those who get down on their knees to drink.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִסְפַּר הַמְלַקְקִים בְּיָדָם אֶל־פִּיהֶם שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וְכֹל יֶתֶר הָעָם כָּרְעוּ עַל־בִּרְכֵיהֶם לִשְׁתּוֹת מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִסְפַּר הַמְלַקְקִים בְּיָדָם אֶל־פִּיהֶם שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וְכֹל יֶתֶר הָעָם כָּרְעוּ עַל־בִּרְכֵיהֶם לִשְׁתּוֹת מָיִם׃

english.text:
Now those who “lapped” the water into their mouths by hand
numbered three hundred; all the rest of the troops got down on
their knees to drink.

translation.text: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.

verses.english:
Now those who “lapped” the water into their mouths by hand
numbered three hundred; all the rest of the troops got down on
their knees to drink.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן בִּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ הַמְלַקְקִים אוֹשִׁיעַ אֶתְכֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־מִדְיָן בְּיָדֶךָ וְכל־הָעָם יֵלְכוּ אִישׁ לִמְקֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן בִּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ הַמְלַקְקִים אוֹשִׁיעַ אֶתְכֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־מִדְיָן בְּיָדֶךָ וְכל־הָעָם יֵלְכוּ אִישׁ לִמְקֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
Then YHWH said to Gideon, “I will deliver you and I will put
Midian into your hands through the three hundred ‘lappers’; let
the rest of the troops go home.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.

verses.english:
Then YHWH said to Gideon, “I will deliver you and I will put
Midian into your hands through the three hundred ‘lappers’; let
the rest of the troops go home.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־צֵדָה הָעָם בְּיָדָם וְאֵת שׁוֹפְרֹתֵיהֶם וְאֵת כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁלַּח אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו וּבִשְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ הֶחֱזִיק וּמַחֲנֵה מִדְיָן הָיָה לוֹ
מִתַּחַת בָּעֵמֶק׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־צֵדָה הָעָם בְּיָדָם וְאֵת שׁוֹפְרֹתֵיהֶם וְאֵת כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁלַּח אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו וּבִשְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ הֶחֱזִיק וּמַחֲנֵה מִדְיָן הָיָה לוֹ
מִתַּחַת בָּעֵמֶק׃

english.text:
So [the lappers] took the provisions and horns that the other men
had with them, and he sent the rest of the men of Israel back to
their homes, retaining only the three hundred men. The Midianite
camp was below him, in the plain.

translation.text: So the people took victuals in their hand, and their trumpets: and he sent all the rest of Israel every man unto his tent, and retained those three hundred men: and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley.

verses.english:
So [the lappers] took the provisions and horns that the other men
had with them, and he sent the rest of the men of Israel back to
their homes, retaining only the three hundred men. The Midianite
camp was below him, in the plain.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה קוּם רֵד בַּמַּחֲנֶה כִּי נְתַתִּיו בְּיָדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה קוּם רֵד בַּמַּחֲנֶה כִּי נְתַתִּיו בְּיָדֶךָ׃

english.text:
That night YHWH said to him, “Come, attack the camp, for I have
delivered it into your hands.

translation.text: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Arise, get thee down unto the host; for I have delivered it into thine hand.

verses.english:
That night YHWH said to him, “Come, attack the camp, for I have
delivered it into your hands.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־יָרֵא אַתָּה לָרֶדֶת רֵד אַתָּה וּפֻרָה נַעַרְךָ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־יָרֵא אַתָּה לָרֶדֶת רֵד אַתָּה וּפֻרָה נַעַרְךָ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
And if you are afraid to attack, first go down to the camp with
your attendant Purah

translation.text: But if thou fear to go down, go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host:

verses.english:
And if you are afraid to attack, first go down to the camp with
your attendant Purah

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ מַה־יְדַבֵּרוּ וְאַחַר תֶּחֱזַקְנָה יָדֶיךָ וְיָרַדְתָּ בַּמַּחֲנֶה וַיֵּרֶד הוּא וּפֻרָה נַעֲרוֹ אֶל־קְצֵה הַחֲמֻשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ מַה־יְדַבֵּרוּ וְאַחַר תֶּחֱזַקְנָה יָדֶיךָ וְיָרַדְתָּ בַּמַּחֲנֶה וַיֵּרֶד הוּא וּפֻרָה נַעֲרוֹ אֶל־קְצֵה הַחֲמֻשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
and listen to what they say; after that you will have the courage
to attack the camp.” So he went down with his attendant Purah to
the outposts of the warriors who were in the camp.—

translation.text: And thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host. Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host.

verses.english:
and listen to what they say; after that you will have the courage
to attack the camp.” So he went down with his attendant Purah to
the outposts of the warriors who were in the camp.—

verses.hebrew: וּמִדְיָן וַעֲמָלֵק וְכל־בְּנֵי־קֶדֶם נֹפְלִים בָּעֵמֶק כָּאַרְבֶּה לָרֹב וְלִגְמַלֵּיהֶם אֵין מִסְפָּר כַּחוֹל שֶׁעַל־שְׂפַת הַיָּם לָרֹב׃

hebrew.text: וּמִדְיָן וַעֲמָלֵק וְכל־בְּנֵי־קֶדֶם נֹפְלִים בָּעֵמֶק כָּאַרְבֶּה לָרֹב וְלִגְמַלֵּיהֶם אֵין מִסְפָּר כַּחוֹל שֶׁעַל־שְׂפַת הַיָּם לָרֹב׃

english.text:
Now Midian, Amalek, and all the Kedemites were spread over the
plain, as thick as locusts; and their camels were countless, as
numerous as the sands on the seashore.—

translation.text: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand by the sea side for multitude.

verses.english:
Now Midian, Amalek, and all the Kedemites were spread over the
plain, as thick as locusts; and their camels were countless, as
numerous as the sands on the seashore.—

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא גִדְעוֹן וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ מְסַפֵּר לְרֵעֵהוּ חֲלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה חֲלוֹם חָלַמְתִּי וְהִנֵּה צְלִיל לֶחֶם שְׂעֹרִים מִתְהַפֵּךְ בְּמַחֲנֵה מִדְיָן וַיָּבֹא עַד־הָאֹהֶל
וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיִּפֹּל וַיַּהַפְכֵהוּ לְמַעְלָה וְנָפַל הָאֹהֶל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא גִדְעוֹן וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ מְסַפֵּר לְרֵעֵהוּ חֲלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה חֲלוֹם חָלַמְתִּי וְהִנֵּה צְלִיל לֶחֶם שְׂעֹרִים מִתְהַפֵּךְ בְּמַחֲנֵה מִדְיָן וַיָּבֹא עַד־הָאֹהֶל
וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיִּפֹּל וַיַּהַפְכֵהוּ לְמַעְלָה וְנָפַל הָאֹהֶל׃

english.text:
Gideon came there just as one man was narrating a dream to
another. “Listen,” he was saying, “I had this dream: There was a
commotion—a loaf of barley bread was whirling through the
Midianite camp. It came to a tent and struck it, and it fell; it
turned it upside down, and the tent collapsed.”

translation.text: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.

verses.english:
Gideon came there just as one man was narrating a dream to
another. “Listen,” he was saying, “I had this dream: There was a
commotion—a loaf of barley bread was whirling through the
Midianite camp. It came to a tent and struck it, and it fell; it
turned it upside down, and the tent collapsed.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן רֵעֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין זֹאת בִּלְתִּי אִם־חֶרֶב גִּדְעוֹן בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל נָתַן הָאֱלֹהִים בְּיָדוֹ אֶת־מִדְיָן וְאֶת־כּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן רֵעֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין זֹאת בִּלְתִּי אִם־חֶרֶב גִּדְעוֹן בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל נָתַן הָאֱלֹהִים בְּיָדוֹ אֶת־מִדְיָן וְאֶת־כּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
To this the other responded, “That can only mean the sword of the
Israelite Gideon son of Joash. God is delivering Midian and the
entire camp into his hands.”

translation.text: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel: for into his hand hath God delivered Midian, and all the host.

verses.english:
To this the other responded, “That can only mean the sword of the
Israelite Gideon son of Joash. God is delivering Midian and the
entire camp into his hands.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ גִּדְעוֹן אֶת־מִסְפַּר הַחֲלוֹם וְאֶת־שִׁבְרוֹ וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיָּשׁב אֶל־מַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר קוּמוּ כִּי־נָתַן יְהֹוָה בְּיֶדְכֶם אֶת־מַחֲנֵה מִדְיָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ גִּדְעוֹן אֶת־מִסְפַּר הַחֲלוֹם וְאֶת־שִׁבְרוֹ וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיָּשׁב אֶל־מַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר קוּמוּ כִּי־נָתַן יְהֹוָה בְּיֶדְכֶם אֶת־מַחֲנֵה מִדְיָן׃

english.text:
When Gideon heard the dream told and interpreted, he bowed low.
Returning to the camp of Israel, he shouted, “Come on! YHWH has
delivered the Midianite camp into your hands!”

translation.text: And it was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Israel, and said, Arise; for the LORD hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.

verses.english:
When Gideon heard the dream told and interpreted, he bowed low.
Returning to the camp of Israel, he shouted, “Come on! YHWH has
delivered the Midianite camp into your hands!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחַץ אֶת־שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ שְׁלֹשָׁה רָאשִׁים וַיִּתֵּן שׁוֹפָרוֹת בְּיַד־כֻּלָּם וְכַדִּים רֵיקִים וְלַפִּדִים בְּתוֹךְ הַכַּדִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחַץ אֶת־שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ שְׁלֹשָׁה רָאשִׁים וַיִּתֵּן שׁוֹפָרוֹת בְּיַד־כֻּלָּם וְכַדִּים רֵיקִים וְלַפִּדִים בְּתוֹךְ הַכַּדִּים׃

english.text:
He divided the three hundred men into three columns and equipped
every man with a ram’s horn and an empty jar, with a torch in each
jar.

translation.text: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man’s hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.

verses.english:
He divided the three hundred men into three columns and equipped
every man with a ram’s horn and an empty jar, with a torch in each
jar.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מִמֶּנִּי תִרְאוּ וְכֵן תַּעֲשׂוּ וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי בָא בִּקְצֵה הַמַּחֲנֶה וְהָיָה כַאֲשֶׁר־אֶעֱשֶׂה כֵּן תַּעֲשׂוּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מִמֶּנִּי תִרְאוּ וְכֵן תַּעֲשׂוּ וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי בָא בִּקְצֵה הַמַּחֲנֶה וְהָיָה כַאֲשֶׁר־אֶעֱשֶׂה כֵּן תַּעֲשׂוּן׃

english.text:
“Watch me,” he said, “and do the same. When I get to the outposts
of the camp, do exactly as I do.

translation.text: And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so shall ye do.

verses.english:
“Watch me,” he said, “and do the same. When I get to the outposts
of the camp, do exactly as I do.

verses.hebrew: וְתָקַעְתִּי בַּשּׁוֹפָר אָנֹכִי וְכל־אֲשֶׁר אִתִּי וּתְקַעְתֶּם בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת גַּם־אַתֶּם סְבִיבוֹת כּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַאֲמַרְתֶּם לַיהֹוָה וּלְגִדְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְתָקַעְתִּי בַּשּׁוֹפָר אָנֹכִי וְכל־אֲשֶׁר אִתִּי וּתְקַעְתֶּם בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת גַּם־אַתֶּם סְבִיבוֹת כּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַאֲמַרְתֶּם לַיהֹוָה וּלְגִדְעוֹן׃

english.text:
When I and all those with me blow our horns, you too, all around
the camp, will blow your horns and shout, ‘For YHWH and for
Gideon!’”

translation.text: When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that are with me, then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.

verses.english:
When I and all those with me blow our horns, you too, all around
the camp, will blow your horns and shout, ‘For YHWH and for
Gideon!’”

verses.hebrew:
