וַיָּבֹא גִדְעוֹן וּמֵאָה־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ בִּקְצֵה הַמַּחֲנֶה רֹאשׁ הָאַשְׁמֹרֶת הַתִּיכוֹנָה אַךְ הָקֵם הֵקִימוּ אֶת־הַשֹּׁמְרִים וַיִּתְקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וְנָפוֹץ
הַכַּדִּים אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא גִדְעוֹן וּמֵאָה־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ בִּקְצֵה הַמַּחֲנֶה רֹאשׁ הָאַשְׁמֹרֶת הַתִּיכוֹנָה אַךְ הָקֵם הֵקִימוּ אֶת־הַשֹּׁמְרִים וַיִּתְקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וְנָפוֹץ
הַכַּדִּים אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדָם׃

english.text:
Gideon and the hundred men with him arrived at the outposts of the
camp, at the beginning of the middle watch, just after the
sentries were posted. They sounded the horns and smashed the jars
that they had with them,

translation.text: So Gideon, and the hundred men that were with him, came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers that were in their hands.

verses.english:
Gideon and the hundred men with him arrived at the outposts of the
camp, at the beginning of the middle watch, just after the
sentries were posted. They sounded the horns and smashed the jars
that they had with them,

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתְקְעוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הָרָאשִׁים בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וַיִּשְׁבְּרוּ הַכַּדִּים וַיַּחֲזִיקוּ בְיַד־שְׂמֹאולָם בַּלַּפִּדִים וּבְיַד־יְמִינָם הַשּׁוֹפָרוֹת לִתְקוֹעַ וַיִּקְרְאוּ חֶרֶב
לַיהֹוָה וּלְגִדְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתְקְעוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הָרָאשִׁים בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וַיִּשְׁבְּרוּ הַכַּדִּים וַיַּחֲזִיקוּ בְיַד־שְׂמֹאולָם בַּלַּפִּדִים וּבְיַד־יְמִינָם הַשּׁוֹפָרוֹת לִתְקוֹעַ וַיִּקְרְאוּ חֶרֶב
לַיהֹוָה וּלְגִדְעוֹן׃

english.text:
and the three columns blew their horns and broke their jars.
Holding the torches in their left hands and the horns for blowing
in their right hands, they shouted, “A sword for YHWH and for
Gideon!”

translation.text: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.

verses.english:
and the three columns blew their horns and broke their jars.
Holding the torches in their left hands and the horns for blowing
in their right hands, they shouted, “A sword for YHWH and for
Gideon!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַמְדוּ אִישׁ תַּחְתָּיו סָבִיב לַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּרץ כּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּרִיעוּ (ויניסו) [וַיָּנוּסוּ]׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַמְדוּ אִישׁ תַּחְתָּיו סָבִיב לַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּרץ כּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּרִיעוּ (ויניסו) [וַיָּנוּסוּ]׃

english.text:
They remained standing where they were, surrounding the camp; but
the entire camp ran about yelling, and took to flight.

translation.text: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp; and all the host ran, and cried, and fled.

verses.english:
They remained standing where they were, surrounding the camp; but
the entire camp ran about yelling, and took to flight.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתְקְעוּ שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת הַשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וַיָּשֶׂם יְהֹוָה אֵת חֶרֶב אִישׁ בְּרֵעֵהוּ וּבְכל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּנס הַמַּחֲנֶה עַד־בֵּית הַשִּׁטָּה צְרֵרָתָה עַד שְׂפַת־אָבֵל מְחוֹלָה
עַל־טַבָּת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתְקְעוּ שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת הַשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וַיָּשֶׂם יְהֹוָה אֵת חֶרֶב אִישׁ בְּרֵעֵהוּ וּבְכל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּנס הַמַּחֲנֶה עַד־בֵּית הַשִּׁטָּה צְרֵרָתָה עַד שְׂפַת־אָבֵל מְחוֹלָה
עַל־טַבָּת׃

english.text:
For when the three hundred horns were sounded, YHWH turned every
man’s sword against his fellow, throughout the camp, and the
entire host fled as far as Beth-shittah and on to Zererah—as far
as the outskirts of Abel-meholah near Tabbath.

translation.text: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the LORD set every man’s sword against his fellow, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Bethshittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abelmeholah, unto Tabbath.

verses.english:
For when the three hundred horns were sounded, YHWH turned every
man’s sword against his fellow, throughout the camp, and the
entire host fled as far as Beth-shittah and on to Zererah—as far
as the outskirts of Abel-meholah near Tabbath.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצָּעֵק אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִנַּפְתָּלִי וּמִן־אָשֵׁר וּמִן־כּל־מְנַשֶּׁה וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אַחֲרֵי מִדְיָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצָּעֵק אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִנַּפְתָּלִי וּמִן־אָשֵׁר וּמִן־כּל־מְנַשֶּׁה וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אַחֲרֵי מִדְיָן׃

english.text:
And now the men of Israel from Naphtali and Asher and from all of
Manasseh rallied for the pursuit of the Midianites.

translation.text: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.

verses.english:
And now the men of Israel from Naphtali and Asher and from all of
Manasseh rallied for the pursuit of the Midianites.

verses.hebrew:
וּמַלְאָכִים שָׁלַח גִּדְעוֹן בְּכל־הַר אֶפְרַיִם לֵאמֹר רְדוּ לִקְרַאת מִדְיָן וְלִכְדוּ לָהֶם אֶת־הַמַּיִם עַד בֵּית בָּרָה וְאֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּצָּעֵק כּל־אִישׁ אֶפְרַיִם
וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אֶת־הַמַּיִם עַד בֵּית בָּרָה וְאֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text:
וּמַלְאָכִים שָׁלַח גִּדְעוֹן בְּכל־הַר אֶפְרַיִם לֵאמֹר רְדוּ לִקְרַאת מִדְיָן וְלִכְדוּ לָהֶם אֶת־הַמַּיִם עַד בֵּית בָּרָה וְאֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּצָּעֵק כּל־אִישׁ אֶפְרַיִם
וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אֶת־הַמַּיִם עַד בֵּית בָּרָה וְאֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
Gideon also sent messengers all through the hill country of
Ephraim with this order: “Go down ahead of the Midianites and
seize their access to the water all along the Jordan down to
Beth-barah.” So all the men of Ephraim rallied and seized the
waterside down to Beth-barah by the Jordan.

translation.text: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan.

verses.english:
Gideon also sent messengers all through the hill country of
Ephraim with this order: “Go down ahead of the Midianites and
seize their access to the water all along the Jordan down to
Beth-barah.” So all the men of Ephraim rallied and seized the
waterside down to Beth-barah by the Jordan.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּלְכְּדוּ שְׁנֵי־שָׂרֵי מִדְיָן אֶת־עֹרֵב וְאֶת־זְאֵב וַיַּהַרְגוּ אֶת־עוֹרֵב בְּצוּר־עוֹרֵב וְאֶת־זְאֵב הָרְגוּ בְיֶקֶב־זְאֵב וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אֶל־מִדְיָן וְרֹאשׁ־עֹרֵב וּזְאֵב
הֵבִיאוּ אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּלְכְּדוּ שְׁנֵי־שָׂרֵי מִדְיָן אֶת־עֹרֵב וְאֶת־זְאֵב וַיַּהַרְגוּ אֶת־עוֹרֵב בְּצוּר־עוֹרֵב וְאֶת־זְאֵב הָרְגוּ בְיֶקֶב־זְאֵב וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אֶל־מִדְיָן וְרֹאשׁ־עֹרֵב וּזְאֵב
הֵבִיאוּ אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
They pursued the Midianites and captured Midian’s two generals,
Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at the Rock of Oreb and they
killed Zeeb at the Winepress of Zeeb; and they brought the heads
of Oreb and Zeeb from the other side of the Jordan to Gideon.

translation.text: And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.

verses.english:
They pursued the Midianites and captured Midian’s two generals,
Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at the Rock of Oreb and they
killed Zeeb at the Winepress of Zeeb; and they brought the heads
of Oreb and Zeeb from the other side of the Jordan to Gideon.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אִישׁ אֶפְרַיִם מָה־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ לְבִלְתִּי קְרֹאות לָנוּ כִּי הָלַכְתָּ לְהִלָּחֵם בְּמִדְיָן וַיְרִיבוּן אִתּוֹ בְּחזְקָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אִישׁ אֶפְרַיִם מָה־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ לְבִלְתִּי קְרֹאות לָנוּ כִּי הָלַכְתָּ לְהִלָּחֵם בְּמִדְיָן וַיְרִיבוּן אִתּוֹ בְּחזְקָה׃

english.text:
And the men of Ephraim said to him, “Why did you do that to us—not
calling us when you went to fight the Midianites?” And they
rebuked him severely.

translation.text: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.

verses.english:
And the men of Ephraim said to him, “Why did you do that to us—not
calling us when you went to fight the Midianites?” And they
rebuked him severely.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מֶה־עָשִׂיתִי עַתָּה כָּכֶם הֲלֹא טוֹב עֹלְלוֹת אֶפְרַיִם מִבְצִיר אֲבִיעֶזֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מֶה־עָשִׂיתִי עַתָּה כָּכֶם הֲלֹא טוֹב עֹלְלוֹת אֶפְרַיִם מִבְצִיר אֲבִיעֶזֶר׃

english.text:
But he answered them, “After all, what have I accomplished
compared to you? Why, Ephraim’s gleanings are better than
Abiezer’s vintage!

translation.text: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?

verses.english:
But he answered them, “After all, what have I accomplished
compared to you? Why, Ephraim’s gleanings are better than
Abiezer’s vintage!

verses.hebrew: בְּיֶדְכֶם נָתַן אֱלֹהִים אֶת־שָׂרֵי מִדְיָן אֶת־עֹרֵב וְאֶת־זְאֵב וּמַה־יָּכֹלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת כָּכֶם אָז רָפְתָה רוּחָם מֵעָלָיו בְּדַבְּרוֹ הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: בְּיֶדְכֶם נָתַן אֱלֹהִים אֶת־שָׂרֵי מִדְיָן אֶת־עֹרֵב וְאֶת־זְאֵב וּמַה־יָּכֹלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת כָּכֶם אָז רָפְתָה רוּחָם מֵעָלָיו בְּדַבְּרוֹ הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
God has delivered the Midianite generals Oreb and Zeeb into your
hands, and what was I able to do compared to you?” And when he
spoke in this fashion, their anger against him abated.

translation.text: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.

verses.english:
God has delivered the Midianite generals Oreb and Zeeb into your
hands, and what was I able to do compared to you?” And when he
spoke in this fashion, their anger against him abated.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא גִדְעוֹן הַיַּרְדֵּנָה עֹבֵר הוּא וּשְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ עֲיֵפִים וְרֹדְפִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא גִדְעוֹן הַיַּרְדֵּנָה עֹבֵר הוּא וּשְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ עֲיֵפִים וְרֹדְפִים׃

english.text:
Gideon came to the Jordan and crossed it. The three hundred men
with him were famished, but still in pursuit.

translation.text: And Gideon came to Jordan, and passed over, he, and the three hundred men that were with him, faint, yet pursuing them.

verses.english:
Gideon came to the Jordan and crossed it. The three hundred men
with him were famished, but still in pursuit.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְאַנְשֵׁי סֻכּוֹת תְּנוּ־נָא כִּכְּרוֹת לֶחֶם לָעָם אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלָי כִּי־עֲיֵפִים הֵם וְאָנֹכִי רֹדֵף אַחֲרֵי זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְאַנְשֵׁי סֻכּוֹת תְּנוּ־נָא כִּכְּרוֹת לֶחֶם לָעָם אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלָי כִּי־עֲיֵפִים הֵם וְאָנֹכִי רֹדֵף אַחֲרֵי זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן׃

english.text:
He said to the people of Succoth, “Please give some loaves of
bread to the men who are following me, for they are famished, and
I am pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”

translation.text: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.

verses.english:
He said to the people of Succoth, “Please give some loaves of
bread to the men who are following me, for they are famished, and
I am pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׂרֵי סֻכּוֹת הֲכַף זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע עַתָּה בְּיָדֶךָ כִּי־נִתֵּן לִצְבָאֲךָ לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׂרֵי סֻכּוֹת הֲכַף זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע עַתָּה בְּיָדֶךָ כִּי־נִתֵּן לִצְבָאֲךָ לָחֶם׃

english.text:
But the officials of Succoth replied, “Are Zebah and Zalmunna
already in your hands, that we should give bread to your troops?”

translation.text: And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?

verses.english:
But the officials of Succoth replied, “Are Zebah and Zalmunna
already in your hands, that we should give bread to your troops?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר גִּדְעוֹן לָכֵן בְּתֵת יְהֹוָה אֶת־זֶבַח וְאֶת־צַלְמֻנָּע בְּיָדִי וְדַשְׁתִּי אֶת־בְּשַׂרְכֶם אֶת־קוֹצֵי הַמִּדְבָּר וְאֶת־הַבַּרְקֳנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר גִּדְעוֹן לָכֵן בְּתֵת יְהֹוָה אֶת־זֶבַח וְאֶת־צַלְמֻנָּע בְּיָדִי וְדַשְׁתִּי אֶת־בְּשַׂרְכֶם אֶת־קוֹצֵי הַמִּדְבָּר וְאֶת־הַבַּרְקֳנִים׃

english.text:
“I swear,” declared Gideon, “when YHWH delivers Zebah and Zalmunna
into my hands, I’ll thresh your bodies upon desert thorns and
briers!”

translation.text: And Gideon said, Therefore when the LORD hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.

verses.english:
“I swear,” declared Gideon, “when YHWH delivers Zebah and Zalmunna
into my hands, I’ll thresh your bodies upon desert thorns and
briers!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מִשָּׁם פְּנוּאֵל וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם כָּזֹאת וַיַּעֲנוּ אוֹתוֹ אַנְשֵׁי פְנוּאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר עָנוּ אַנְשֵׁי סֻכּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל מִשָּׁם פְּנוּאֵל וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם כָּזֹאת וַיַּעֲנוּ אוֹתוֹ אַנְשֵׁי פְנוּאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר עָנוּ אַנְשֵׁי סֻכּוֹת׃

translation.text: And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־לְאַנְשֵׁי פְנוּאֵל לֵאמֹר בְּשׁוּבִי בְשָׁלוֹם אֶתֹּץ אֶת־הַמִּגְדָּל הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־לְאַנְשֵׁי פְנוּאֵל לֵאמֹר בְּשׁוּבִי בְשָׁלוֹם אֶתֹּץ אֶת־הַמִּגְדָּל הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
So he also threatened the people of Penuel: “When I come back
safe, I’ll tear down this tower!”

translation.text: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.

verses.english:
So he also threatened the people of Penuel: “When I come back
safe, I’ll tear down this tower!”

verses.hebrew: וְזֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע בַּקַּרְקֹר וּמַחֲנֵיהֶם עִמָּם כַּחֲמֵשֶׁת עָשָׂר אֶלֶף כֹּל הַנּוֹתָרִים מִכֹּל מַחֲנֵה בְנֵי־קֶדֶם וְהַנֹּפְלִים מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ שֹׁלֵף־חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע בַּקַּרְקֹר וּמַחֲנֵיהֶם עִמָּם כַּחֲמֵשֶׁת עָשָׂר אֶלֶף כֹּל הַנּוֹתָרִים מִכֹּל מַחֲנֵה בְנֵי־קֶדֶם וְהַנֹּפְלִים מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ שֹׁלֵף־חָרֶב׃

english.text:
Now Zebah and Zalmunna were at Karkor with their army of about
15,000; these were all that remained of the entire host of the
Kedemites, for the slain numbered 120,000 fighting men.

translation.text: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.

verses.english:
Now Zebah and Zalmunna were at Karkor with their army of about
15,000; these were all that remained of the entire host of the
Kedemites, for the slain numbered 120,000 fighting men.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל גִּדְעוֹן דֶּרֶךְ הַשְּׁכוּנֵי באֳהָלִים מִקֶּדֶם לְנֹבַח וְיגְבְּהָה וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַמַּחֲנֶה וְהַמַּחֲנֶה הָיָה בֶטַח׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל גִּדְעוֹן דֶּרֶךְ הַשְּׁכוּנֵי באֳהָלִים מִקֶּדֶם לְנֹבַח וְיגְבְּהָה וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַמַּחֲנֶה וְהַמַּחֲנֶה הָיָה בֶטַח׃

english.text:
Gideon marched up the road of the tent dwellers, up to east of
Nobah and Jogbehah, and routed the camp, which was off guard.

translation.text: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host; for the host was secure.

verses.english:
Gideon marched up the road of the tent dwellers, up to east of
Nobah and Jogbehah, and routed the camp, which was off guard.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּנֻסוּ זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע וַיִּרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵיהֶם וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן אֶת־זֶבַח וְאֶת־צַלְמֻנָּע וְכל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הֶחֱרִיד׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּנֻסוּ זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע וַיִּרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵיהֶם וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן אֶת־זֶבַח וְאֶת־צַלְמֻנָּע וְכל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הֶחֱרִיד׃

english.text:
Zebah and Zalmunna took to flight, with Gideon in pursuit. He
captured Zebah and Zalmunna, the two kings of Midian, and threw
the whole army into panic.

translation.text: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.

verses.english:
Zebah and Zalmunna took to flight, with Gideon in pursuit. He
captured Zebah and Zalmunna, the two kings of Midian, and threw
the whole army into panic.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב גִּדְעוֹן בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ מִן־הַמִּלְחָמָה מִלְמַעֲלֵה הֶחָרֶס׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב גִּדְעוֹן בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ מִן־הַמִּלְחָמָה מִלְמַעֲלֵה הֶחָרֶס׃

english.text:
On his way back from the battle at the Ascent of Heres, Gideon son
of Joash

translation.text: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun was up,

verses.english:
On his way back from the battle at the Ascent of Heres, Gideon son
of Joash

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכּד־נַעַר מֵאַנְשֵׁי סֻכּוֹת וַיִּשְׁאָלֵהוּ וַיִּכְתֹּב אֵלָיו אֶת־שָׂרֵי סֻכּוֹת וְאֶת־זְקֵנֶיהָ שִׁבְעִים וְשִׁבְעָה אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְכּד־נַעַר מֵאַנְשֵׁי סֻכּוֹת וַיִּשְׁאָלֵהוּ וַיִּכְתֹּב אֵלָיו אֶת־שָׂרֵי סֻכּוֹת וְאֶת־זְקֵנֶיהָ שִׁבְעִים וְשִׁבְעָה אִישׁ׃

english.text:
captured a boy from among the people of Succoth and interrogated
him. The latter drew up for him a list of the officials and elders
of Succoth, seventy-seven in number.

translation.text: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, even threescore and seventeen men.

verses.english:
captured a boy from among the people of Succoth and interrogated
him. The latter drew up for him a list of the officials and elders
of Succoth, seventy-seven in number.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אַנְשֵׁי סֻכּוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע אֲשֶׁר חֵרַפְתֶּם אוֹתִי לֵאמֹר הֲכַף זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע עַתָּה בְּיָדֶךָ כִּי נִתֵּן לַאֲנָשֶׁיךָ הַיְּעֵפִים
לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אַנְשֵׁי סֻכּוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע אֲשֶׁר חֵרַפְתֶּם אוֹתִי לֵאמֹר הֲכַף זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע עַתָּה בְּיָדֶךָ כִּי נִתֵּן לַאֲנָשֶׁיךָ הַיְּעֵפִים
לָחֶם׃

english.text:
Then he came to the people of Succoth and said, “Here are Zebah
and Zalmunna, about whom you mocked me, saying, ‘Are Zebah and
Zalmunna already in your hands, that we should give your famished
men bread?’”

translation.text: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary?

verses.english:
Then he came to the people of Succoth and said, “Here are Zebah
and Zalmunna, about whom you mocked me, saying, ‘Are Zebah and
Zalmunna already in your hands, that we should give your famished
men bread?’”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־זִקְנֵי הָעִיר וְאֶת־קוֹצֵי הַמִּדְבָּר וְאֶת־הַבַּרְקֳנִים וַיֹּדַע בָּהֶם אֵת אַנְשֵׁי סֻכּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־זִקְנֵי הָעִיר וְאֶת־קוֹצֵי הַמִּדְבָּר וְאֶת־הַבַּרְקֳנִים וַיֹּדַע בָּהֶם אֵת אַנְשֵׁי סֻכּוֹת׃

english.text:
And he took the elders of the city and, [bringing] desert thorns
and briers, he punished the people of Succoth with them.

translation.text: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.

verses.english:
And he took the elders of the city and, [bringing] desert thorns
and briers, he punished the people of Succoth with them.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־מִגְדַּל פְּנוּאֵל נָתָץ וַיַּהֲרֹג אֶת־אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־מִגְדַּל פְּנוּאֵל נָתָץ וַיַּהֲרֹג אֶת־אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר׃

english.text: As for Penuel, he tore down its tower and killed the townspeople.

translation.text: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.

verses.english: As for Penuel, he tore down its tower and killed the townspeople.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־זֶבַח וְאֶל־צַלְמֻנָּע אֵיפֹה הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הֲרַגְתֶּם בְּתָבוֹר וַיֹּאמְרוּ כָּמוֹךָ כְמוֹהֶם אֶחָד כְּתֹאַר בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־זֶבַח וְאֶל־צַלְמֻנָּע אֵיפֹה הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הֲרַגְתֶּם בְּתָבוֹר וַיֹּאמְרוּ כָּמוֹךָ כְמוֹהֶם אֶחָד כְּתֹאַר בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Then he asked Zebah and Zalmunna, “Those men you killed at Tabor,
what were they like?” “They looked just like you,” they replied,
“like sons of a king.”

translation.text: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou art, so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.

verses.english:
Then he asked Zebah and Zalmunna, “Those men you killed at Tabor,
what were they like?” “They looked just like you,” they replied,
“like sons of a king.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר אַחַי בְּנֵי־אִמִּי הֵם חַי־יְהֹוָה לוּ הַחֲיִתֶם אוֹתָם לֹא הָרַגְתִּי אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר אַחַי בְּנֵי־אִמִּי הֵם חַי־יְהֹוָה לוּ הַחֲיִתֶם אוֹתָם לֹא הָרַגְתִּי אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
“They were my brothers,” he declared, “the sons of my mother. As
YHWH lives, if you had spared them, I would not kill you.”

translation.text: And he said, They were my brethren, even the sons of my mother: as the LORD liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.

verses.english:
“They were my brothers,” he declared, “the sons of my mother. As
YHWH lives, if you had spared them, I would not kill you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְיֶתֶר בְּכוֹרוֹ קוּם הֲרֹג אוֹתָם וְלֹא־שָׁלַף הַנַּעַר חַרְבּוֹ כִּי יָרֵא כִּי עוֹדֶנּוּ נָעַר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְיֶתֶר בְּכוֹרוֹ קוּם הֲרֹג אוֹתָם וְלֹא־שָׁלַף הַנַּעַר חַרְבּוֹ כִּי יָרֵא כִּי עוֹדֶנּוּ נָעַר׃

english.text:
And he commanded his oldest son Jether, “Go kill them!” But the
boy did not draw his sword, for he was timid, being still a boy.

translation.text: And he said unto Jether his firstborn, Up, and slay them. But the youth drew not his sword: for he feared, because he was yet a youth.

verses.english:
And he commanded his oldest son Jether, “Go kill them!” But the
boy did not draw his sword, for he was timid, being still a boy.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע קוּם אַתָּה וּפְגַע־בָּנוּ כִּי כָאִישׁ גְּבוּרָתוֹ וַיָּקם גִּדְעוֹן וַיַּהֲרֹג אֶת־זֶבַח וְאֶת־צַלְמֻנָּע וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הַשַּׂהֲרֹנִים אֲשֶׁר
בְּצַוְּארֵי גְמַלֵּיהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע קוּם אַתָּה וּפְגַע־בָּנוּ כִּי כָאִישׁ גְּבוּרָתוֹ וַיָּקם גִּדְעוֹן וַיַּהֲרֹג אֶת־זֶבַח וְאֶת־צַלְמֻנָּע וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הַשַּׂהֲרֹנִים אֲשֶׁר
בְּצַוְּארֵי גְמַלֵּיהֶם׃

english.text:
Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, “Come, you slay us; for strength
comes with manhood.” So Gideon went over and killed Zebah and
Zalmunna, and he took the crescents that were on the necks of
their camels.

translation.text: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that were on their camels’ necks.

verses.english:
Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, “Come, you slay us; for strength
comes with manhood.” So Gideon went over and killed Zebah and
Zalmunna, and he took the crescents that were on the necks of
their camels.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן מְשָׁל־בָּנוּ גַּם־אַתָּה גַּם־בִּנְךָ גַּם בֶּן־בְּנֶךָ כִּי הוֹשַׁעְתָּנוּ מִיַּד מִדְיָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן מְשָׁל־בָּנוּ גַּם־אַתָּה גַּם־בִּנְךָ גַּם בֶּן־בְּנֶךָ כִּי הוֹשַׁעְתָּנוּ מִיַּד מִדְיָן׃

english.text:
Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, “Rule over us—you, your
son, and your grandson as well; for you have saved us from the
Midianites.”

translation.text: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.

verses.english:
Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, “Rule over us—you, your
son, and your grandson as well; for you have saved us from the
Midianites.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם גִּדְעוֹן לֹא־אֶמְשֹׁל אֲנִי בָּכֶם וְלֹא־יִמְשֹׁל בְּנִי בָּכֶם יְהֹוָה יִמְשֹׁל בָּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם גִּדְעוֹן לֹא־אֶמְשֹׁל אֲנִי בָּכֶם וְלֹא־יִמְשֹׁל בְּנִי בָּכֶם יְהֹוָה יִמְשֹׁל בָּכֶם׃

english.text:
But Gideon replied, “I will not rule over you myself, nor shall my
son rule over you; YHWH alone shall rule over you.”

translation.text: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the LORD shall rule over you.

verses.english:
But Gideon replied, “I will not rule over you myself, nor shall my
son rule over you; YHWH alone shall rule over you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם גִּדְעוֹן אֶשְׁאֲלָה מִכֶּם שְׁאֵלָה וּתְנוּ־לִי אִישׁ נֶזֶם שְׁלָלוֹ כִּי־נִזְמֵי זָהָב לָהֶם כִּי יִשְׁמְעֵאלִים הֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם גִּדְעוֹן אֶשְׁאֲלָה מִכֶּם שְׁאֵלָה וּתְנוּ־לִי אִישׁ נֶזֶם שְׁלָלוֹ כִּי־נִזְמֵי זָהָב לָהֶם כִּי יִשְׁמְעֵאלִים הֵם׃

english.text:
And Gideon said to them, “I have a request to make of you: Each of
you give me the earring he received as booty.” (They had golden
earrings, for they were Ishmaelites.)

translation.text: And Gideon said unto them, I would desire a request of you, that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey. (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)

verses.english:
And Gideon said to them, “I have a request to make of you: Each of
you give me the earring he received as booty.” (They had golden
earrings, for they were Ishmaelites.)

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָתוֹן נִתֵּן וַיִּפְרְשׂוּ אֶת־הַשִּׂמְלָה וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ שָׁמָּה אִישׁ נֶזֶם שְׁלָלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָתוֹן נִתֵּן וַיִּפְרְשׂוּ אֶת־הַשִּׂמְלָה וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ שָׁמָּה אִישׁ נֶזֶם שְׁלָלוֹ׃

english.text:
“Certainly!” they replied. And they spread out a cloth, and
everyone threw onto it the earring he had received as booty.

translation.text: And they answered, We will willingly give them. And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey.

verses.english:
“Certainly!” they replied. And they spread out a cloth, and
everyone threw onto it the earring he had received as booty.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי מִשְׁקַל נִזְמֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר שָׁאָל אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע־מֵאוֹת זָהָב לְבַד מִן־הַשַּׂהֲרֹנִים וְהַנְּטִיפוֹת וּבִגְדֵי הָאַרְגָּמָן שֶׁעַל מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן וּלְבַד
מִן־הָעֲנָקוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּצַוְּארֵי גְמַלֵּיהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי מִשְׁקַל נִזְמֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר שָׁאָל אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע־מֵאוֹת זָהָב לְבַד מִן־הַשַּׂהֲרֹנִים וְהַנְּטִיפוֹת וּבִגְדֵי הָאַרְגָּמָן שֶׁעַל מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן וּלְבַד
מִן־הָעֲנָקוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּצַוְּארֵי גְמַלֵּיהֶם׃

english.text:
The weight of the golden earrings that he had requested came to
1,700 shekels of gold; this was in addition to the crescents and
the pendants and the purple robes worn by the kings of Midian and
in addition to the collars on the necks of their camels.

translation.text: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold; beside ornaments, and collars, and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian, and beside the chains that were about their camels’ necks.

verses.english:
The weight of the golden earrings that he had requested came to
1,700 shekels of gold; this was in addition to the crescents and
the pendants and the purple robes worn by the kings of Midian and
in addition to the collars on the necks of their camels.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אוֹתוֹ גִדְעוֹן לְאֵפוֹד וַיַּצֵּג אוֹתוֹ בְעִירוֹ בְּעפְרָה וַיִּזְנוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרָיו שָׁם וַיְהִי לְגִדְעוֹן וּלְבֵיתוֹ לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אוֹתוֹ גִדְעוֹן לְאֵפוֹד וַיַּצֵּג אוֹתוֹ בְעִירוֹ בְּעפְרָה וַיִּזְנוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרָיו שָׁם וַיְהִי לְגִדְעוֹן וּלְבֵיתוֹ לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃

english.text:
Gideon made an ephod of this gold and set it up in his own town of
Ophrah. There all Israel went astray after it, and it became a
snare to Gideon and his household.

translation.text: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah: and all Israel went thither a whoring after it: which thing became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.

verses.english:
Gideon made an ephod of this gold and set it up in his own town of
Ophrah. There all Israel went astray after it, and it became a
snare to Gideon and his household.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכָּנַע מִדְיָן לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא יָסְפוּ לָשֵׂאת רֹאשָׁם וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בִּימֵי גִדְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכָּנַע מִדְיָן לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא יָסְפוּ לָשֵׂאת רֹאשָׁם וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בִּימֵי גִדְעוֹן׃

english.text:
Thus Midian submitted to the Israelites and did not raise its head
again; and the land was tranquil for forty years in Gideon’s time.

translation.text: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.

verses.english:
Thus Midian submitted to the Israelites and did not raise its head
again; and the land was tranquil for forty years in Gideon’s time.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ יְרֻבַּעַל בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּבֵיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ יְרֻבַּעַל בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּבֵיתוֹ׃

english.text: So Jerubbaal son of Joash retired to his own house.

translation.text: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.

verses.english: So Jerubbaal son of Joash retired to his own house.

verses.hebrew: וּלְגִדְעוֹן הָיוּ שִׁבְעִים בָּנִים יֹצְאֵי יְרֵכוֹ כִּי־נָשִׁים רַבּוֹת הָיוּ לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּלְגִדְעוֹן הָיוּ שִׁבְעִים בָּנִים יֹצְאֵי יְרֵכוֹ כִּי־נָשִׁים רַבּוֹת הָיוּ לוֹ׃

english.text: Gideon had seventy sons of his own issue, for he had many wives.

translation.text: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten: for he had many wives.

verses.english: Gideon had seventy sons of his own issue, for he had many wives.

verses.hebrew: וּפִילַגְשׁוֹ אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁכֶם יָלְדָה־לּוֹ גַם־הִיא בֵּן וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־שְׁמוֹ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וּפִילַגְשׁוֹ אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁכֶם יָלְדָה־לּוֹ גַם־הִיא בֵּן וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־שְׁמוֹ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
A son was also born to him by his concubine in Shechem, and he
named him Abimelech.

translation.text: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.

verses.english:
A son was also born to him by his concubine in Shechem, and he
named him Abimelech.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת גִּדְעוֹן בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ בְּשֵׂיבָה טוֹבָה וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּקֶבֶר יוֹאָשׁ אָבִיו בְּעפְרָה אֲבִי הָעֶזְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת גִּדְעוֹן בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ בְּשֵׂיבָה טוֹבָה וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּקֶבֶר יוֹאָשׁ אָבִיו בְּעפְרָה אֲבִי הָעֶזְרִי׃

english.text:
Gideon son of Joash died at a ripe old age, and was buried in the
tomb of his father Joash at Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

translation.text: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

verses.english:
Gideon son of Joash died at a ripe old age, and was buried in the
tomb of his father Joash at Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר מֵת גִּדְעוֹן וַיָּשׁוּבוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּזְנוּ אַחֲרֵי הַבְּעָלִים וַיָּשִׂימוּ לָהֶם בַּעַל בְּרִית לֵאלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר מֵת גִּדְעוֹן וַיָּשׁוּבוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּזְנוּ אַחֲרֵי הַבְּעָלִים וַיָּשִׂימוּ לָהֶם בַּעַל בְּרִית לֵאלֹהִים׃

english.text:
After Gideon died, the Israelites again went astray after the
Baalim, and they adopted Baal-berith as a god.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel turned again, and went a whoring after Baalim, and made Baalberith their god.

verses.english:
After Gideon died, the Israelites again went astray after the
Baalim, and they adopted Baal-berith as a god.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא זָכְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הַמַּצִּיל אוֹתָם מִיַּד כּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם מִסָּבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא זָכְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הַמַּצִּיל אוֹתָם מִיַּד כּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם מִסָּבִיב׃

english.text:
The Israelites gave no thought to YHWH their God, who saved them
from all the enemies around them.

translation.text: And the children of Israel remembered not the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side:

verses.english:
The Israelites gave no thought to YHWH their God, who saved them
from all the enemies around them.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־עָשׂוּ חֶסֶד עִם־בֵּית יְרֻבַּעַל גִּדְעוֹן כְּכל־הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־עָשׂוּ חֶסֶד עִם־בֵּית יְרֻבַּעַל גִּדְעוֹן כְּכל־הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Nor did they show loyalty to the house of Jerubbaal-Gideon in
return for all the good that he had done for Israel.

translation.text: Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, namely, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shewed unto Israel.

verses.english:
Nor did they show loyalty to the house of Jerubbaal-Gideon in
return for all the good that he had done for Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־יְרֻבַּעַל שְׁכֶמָה אֶל־אֲחֵי אִמּוֹ וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם וְאֶל־כּל־מִשְׁפַּחַת בֵּית־אֲבִי אִמּוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־יְרֻבַּעַל שְׁכֶמָה אֶל־אֲחֵי אִמּוֹ וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם וְאֶל־כּל־מִשְׁפַּחַת בֵּית־אֲבִי אִמּוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
Abimelech son of Jerubbaal went to his mother’s brothers in
Shechem and spoke to them and to the whole clan of his mother’s
family. He said,

translation.text: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother’s brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,

verses.english:
Abimelech son of Jerubbaal went to his mother’s brothers in
Shechem and spoke to them and to the whole clan of his mother’s
family. He said,

verses.hebrew:
דַּבְּרוּ־נָא בְּאזְנֵי כל־בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם מַה־טּוֹב לָכֶם הַמְשֹׁל בָּכֶם שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ כֹּל בְּנֵי יְרֻבַּעַל אִם־מְשֹׁל בָּכֶם אִישׁ אֶחָד וּזְכַרְתֶּם כִּי־עַצְמְכֶם
וּבְשַׂרְכֶם אָנִי׃

hebrew.text:
דַּבְּרוּ־נָא בְּאזְנֵי כל־בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם מַה־טּוֹב לָכֶם הַמְשֹׁל בָּכֶם שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ כֹּל בְּנֵי יְרֻבַּעַל אִם־מְשֹׁל בָּכֶם אִישׁ אֶחָד וּזְכַרְתֶּם כִּי־עַצְמְכֶם
וּבְשַׂרְכֶם אָנִי׃

english.text:
“Put this question to all the citizens of Shechem: Which is better
for you, to be ruled by seventy men—by all the sons of
Jerubbaal—or to be ruled by one man? And remember, I am your own
flesh and blood.”

translation.text: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.

verses.english:
“Put this question to all the citizens of Shechem: Which is better
for you, to be ruled by seventy men—by all the sons of
Jerubbaal—or to be ruled by one man? And remember, I am your own
flesh and blood.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֲחֵי־אִמּוֹ עָלָיו בְּאזְנֵי כּל־בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם אֵת כּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּט לִבָּם אַחֲרֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ כִּי אָמְרוּ אָחִינוּ הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֲחֵי־אִמּוֹ עָלָיו בְּאזְנֵי כּל־בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם אֵת כּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּט לִבָּם אַחֲרֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ כִּי אָמְרוּ אָחִינוּ הוּא׃

english.text:
His mother’s brothers said all this in his behalf to all the
citizens of Shechem, and they were won over to Abimelech; for they
thought, “He is our kinsman.”

translation.text: And his mother’s brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.

verses.english:
His mother’s brothers said all this in his behalf to all the
citizens of Shechem, and they were won over to Abimelech; for they
thought, “He is our kinsman.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ שִׁבְעִים כֶּסֶף מִבֵּית בַּעַל בְּרִית וַיִּשְׂכֹּר בָּהֶם אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֲנָשִׁים רֵיקִים וּפֹחֲזִים וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ שִׁבְעִים כֶּסֶף מִבֵּית בַּעַל בְּרִית וַיִּשְׂכֹּר בָּהֶם אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֲנָשִׁים רֵיקִים וּפֹחֲזִים וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
They gave him seventy shekels from the temple of Baal-berith; and
with this Abimelech hired some worthless and reckless fellows, and
they followed him.

translation.text: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baalberith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.

verses.english:
They gave him seventy shekels from the temple of Baal-berith; and
with this Abimelech hired some worthless and reckless fellows, and
they followed him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא בֵית־אָבִיו עפְרָתָה וַיַּהֲרֹג אֶת־אֶחָיו בְּנֵי־יְרֻבַּעַל שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ עַל־אֶבֶן אֶחָת וַיִּוָּתֵר יוֹתָם בֶּן־יְרֻבַּעַל הַקָּטֹן כִּי נֶחְבָּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא בֵית־אָבִיו עפְרָתָה וַיַּהֲרֹג אֶת־אֶחָיו בְּנֵי־יְרֻבַּעַל שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ עַל־אֶבֶן אֶחָת וַיִּוָּתֵר יוֹתָם בֶּן־יְרֻבַּעַל הַקָּטֹן כִּי נֶחְבָּא׃

english.text:
Then he went to his father’s house in Ophrah and killed his
brothers, the sons of Jerubbaal, seventy men on one stone. Only
Jotham, the youngest son of Jerubbaal, survived, because he went
into hiding.

translation.text: And he went unto his father’s house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.

verses.english:
Then he went to his father’s house in Ophrah and killed his
brothers, the sons of Jerubbaal, seventy men on one stone. Only
Jotham, the youngest son of Jerubbaal, survived, because he went
into hiding.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּאָסְפוּ כּל־בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וְכל־בֵּית מִלּוֹא וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּמְלִיכוּ אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ לְמֶלֶךְ עִם־אֵלוֹן מֻצָּב אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּאָסְפוּ כּל־בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וְכל־בֵּית מִלּוֹא וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּמְלִיכוּ אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ לְמֶלֶךְ עִם־אֵלוֹן מֻצָּב אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
All the citizens of Shechem and all Beth-millo convened, and they
proclaimed Abimelech king at the terebinth of the pillar at
Shechem.

translation.text: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem.

verses.english:
All the citizens of Shechem and all Beth-millo convened, and they
proclaimed Abimelech king at the terebinth of the pillar at
Shechem.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְיוֹתָם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּעֲמֹד בְּרֹאשׁ הַר־גְּרִזִים וַיִּשָּׂא קוֹלוֹ וַיִּקְרָא וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְעוּ אֵלַי בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וְיִשְׁמַע אֲלֵיכֶם אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְיוֹתָם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּעֲמֹד בְּרֹאשׁ הַר־גְּרִזִים וַיִּשָּׂא קוֹלוֹ וַיִּקְרָא וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְעוּ אֵלַי בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וְיִשְׁמַע אֲלֵיכֶם אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
When Jotham was informed, he went and stood on top of Mount
Gerizim and called out to them in a loud voice. “Citizens of
Shechem!” he cried, “Listen to me, that God may listen to you.

translation.text: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.

verses.english:
When Jotham was informed, he went and stood on top of Mount
Gerizim and called out to them in a loud voice. “Citizens of
Shechem!” he cried, “Listen to me, that God may listen to you.

verses.hebrew: הָלוֹךְ הָלְכוּ הָעֵצִים לִמְשֹׁחַ עֲלֵיהֶם מֶלֶךְ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לַזַּיִת (מלוכה) [מלְכָה] עָלֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: הָלוֹךְ הָלְכוּ הָעֵצִים לִמְשֹׁחַ עֲלֵיהֶם מֶלֶךְ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לַזַּיִת (מלוכה) [מלְכָה] עָלֵינוּ׃

english.text:
“Once the trees went to anoint a king over themselves. They said
to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’

translation.text: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign thou over us.

verses.english:
“Once the trees went to anoint a king over themselves. They said
to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַזַּיִת הֶחֳדַלְתִּי אֶת־דִּשְׁנִי אֲשֶׁר־בִּי יְכַבְּדוּ אֱלֹהִים וַאֲנָשִׁים וְהָלַכְתִּי לָנוּעַ עַל־הָעֵצִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַזַּיִת הֶחֳדַלְתִּי אֶת־דִּשְׁנִי אֲשֶׁר־בִּי יְכַבְּדוּ אֱלֹהִים וַאֲנָשִׁים וְהָלַכְתִּי לָנוּעַ עַל־הָעֵצִים׃

english.text:
But the olive tree replied, ‘Have I, through whom God and men are
honored, stopped yielding my rich oil, that I should go and wave
above the trees?’

translation.text: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

verses.english:
But the olive tree replied, ‘Have I, through whom God and men are
honored, stopped yielding my rich oil, that I should go and wave
above the trees?’

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעֵצִים לַתְּאֵנָה לְכִי־אַתְּ מלְכִי עָלֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעֵצִים לַתְּאֵנָה לְכִי־אַתְּ מלְכִי עָלֵינוּ׃

english.text: So the trees said to the fig tree, ‘You come and reign over us.’

translation.text: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come thou, and reign over us.

verses.english: So the trees said to the fig tree, ‘You come and reign over us.’

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַתְּאֵנָה הֶחֳדַלְתִּי אֶת־מתְקִי וְאֶת־תְּנוּבָתִי הַטּוֹבָה וְהָלַכְתִּי לָנוּעַ עַל־הָעֵצִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַתְּאֵנָה הֶחֳדַלְתִּי אֶת־מתְקִי וְאֶת־תְּנוּבָתִי הַטּוֹבָה וְהָלַכְתִּי לָנוּעַ עַל־הָעֵצִים׃

english.text:
But the fig tree replied, ‘Have I stopped yielding my sweetness,
my delicious fruit, that I should go and wave above the trees?’

translation.text: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?

verses.english:
But the fig tree replied, ‘Have I stopped yielding my sweetness,
my delicious fruit, that I should go and wave above the trees?’

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעֵצִים לַגָּפֶן לְכִי־אַתְּ (מלוכי) [מלְכִי] עָלֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעֵצִים לַגָּפֶן לְכִי־אַתְּ (מלוכי) [מלְכִי] עָלֵינוּ׃

english.text: So the trees said to the vine, ‘You come and reign over us.’

translation.text: Then said the trees unto the vine, Come thou, and reign over us.

verses.english: So the trees said to the vine, ‘You come and reign over us.’

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַגֶּפֶן הֶחֳדַלְתִּי אֶת־תִּירוֹשִׁי הַמְשַׂמֵּחַ אֱלֹהִים וַאֲנָשִׁים וְהָלַכְתִּי לָנוּעַ עַל־הָעֵצִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַגֶּפֶן הֶחֳדַלְתִּי אֶת־תִּירוֹשִׁי הַמְשַׂמֵּחַ אֱלֹהִים וַאֲנָשִׁים וְהָלַכְתִּי לָנוּעַ עַל־הָעֵצִים׃

english.text:
But the vine replied, ‘Have I stopped yielding my new wine, which
gladdens God and men, that I should go and wave above the trees?’

translation.text: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

verses.english:
But the vine replied, ‘Have I stopped yielding my new wine, which
gladdens God and men, that I should go and wave above the trees?’

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ כל־הָעֵצִים אֶל־הָאָטָד לֵךְ אַתָּה מְלךְ־עָלֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ כל־הָעֵצִים אֶל־הָאָטָד לֵךְ אַתָּה מְלךְ־עָלֵינוּ׃

english.text:
Then all the trees said to the thornbush, ‘You come and reign over
us.’

translation.text: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.

verses.english:
Then all the trees said to the thornbush, ‘You come and reign over
us.’

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאָטָד אֶל־הָעֵצִים אִם בֶּאֱמֶת אַתֶּם מֹשְׁחִים אֹתִי לְמֶלֶךְ עֲלֵיכֶם בֹּאוּ חֲסוּ בְצִלִּי וְאִם־אַיִן תֵּצֵא אֵשׁ מִן־הָאָטָד וְתֹאכַל אֶת־אַרְזֵי הַלְּבָנוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאָטָד אֶל־הָעֵצִים אִם בֶּאֱמֶת אַתֶּם מֹשְׁחִים אֹתִי לְמֶלֶךְ עֲלֵיכֶם בֹּאוּ חֲסוּ בְצִלִּי וְאִם־אַיִן תֵּצֵא אֵשׁ מִן־הָאָטָד וְתֹאכַל אֶת־אַרְזֵי הַלְּבָנוֹן׃

english.text:
And the thornbush said to the trees, ‘If you are acting honorably
in anointing me king over you, come and take shelter in my shade;
but if not, may fire issue from the thornbush and consume the
cedars of Lebanon!’

translation.text: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.english:
And the thornbush said to the trees, ‘If you are acting honorably
in anointing me king over you, come and take shelter in my shade;
but if not, may fire issue from the thornbush and consume the
cedars of Lebanon!’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אִם־בֶּאֱמֶת וּבְתָמִים עֲשִׂיתֶם וַתַּמְלִיכוּ אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְאִם־טוֹבָה עֲשִׂיתֶם עִם־יְרֻבַּעַל וְעִם־בֵּיתוֹ וְאִם־כִּגְמוּל יָדָיו עֲשִׂיתֶם לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אִם־בֶּאֱמֶת וּבְתָמִים עֲשִׂיתֶם וַתַּמְלִיכוּ אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְאִם־טוֹבָה עֲשִׂיתֶם עִם־יְרֻבַּעַל וְעִם־בֵּיתוֹ וְאִם־כִּגְמוּל יָדָיו עֲשִׂיתֶם לוֹ׃

english.text:
“Now then, if you acted honorably and loyally in making Abimelech
king, if you have done right by Jerubbaal and his house and have
requited him according to his deserts—

translation.text: Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;

verses.english:
“Now then, if you acted honorably and loyally in making Abimelech
king, if you have done right by Jerubbaal and his house and have
requited him according to his deserts—

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־נִלְחַם אָבִי עֲלֵיכֶם וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ מִנֶּגֶד וַיַּצֵּל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד מִדְיָן׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר־נִלְחַם אָבִי עֲלֵיכֶם וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ מִנֶּגֶד וַיַּצֵּל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד מִדְיָן׃

english.text:
considering that my father fought for you and saved you from the
Midianites at the risk of his life,

translation.text: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:

verses.english:
considering that my father fought for you and saved you from the
Midianites at the risk of his life,

verses.hebrew:
וְאַתֶּם קַמְתֶּם עַל־בֵּית אָבִי הַיּוֹם וַתַּהַרְגוּ אֶת־בָּנָיו שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ עַל־אֶבֶן אֶחָת וַתַּמְלִיכוּ אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֲמָתוֹ עַל־בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם כִּי אֲחִיכֶם
הוּא׃

hebrew.text:
וְאַתֶּם קַמְתֶּם עַל־בֵּית אָבִי הַיּוֹם וַתַּהַרְגוּ אֶת־בָּנָיו שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ עַל־אֶבֶן אֶחָת וַתַּמְלִיכוּ אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֲמָתוֹ עַל־בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם כִּי אֲחִיכֶם
הוּא׃

english.text:
and now you have turned on my father’s household, killed his sons,
seventy men on one stone, and set up Abimelech, the son of his
handmaid, as king over the citizens of Shechem just because he is
your kinsman—

translation.text: And ye are risen up against my father’s house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)

verses.english:
and now you have turned on my father’s household, killed his sons,
seventy men on one stone, and set up Abimelech, the son of his
handmaid, as king over the citizens of Shechem just because he is
your kinsman—

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בֶּאֱמֶת וּבְתָמִים עֲשִׂיתֶם עִם־יְרֻבַּעַל וְעִם־בֵּיתוֹ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה שִׂמְחוּ בַּאֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְיִשְׂמַח גַּם־הוּא בָּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־בֶּאֱמֶת וּבְתָמִים עֲשִׂיתֶם עִם־יְרֻבַּעַל וְעִם־בֵּיתוֹ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה שִׂמְחוּ בַּאֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְיִשְׂמַח גַּם־הוּא בָּכֶם׃

english.text:
if, I say, you have this day acted honorably and loyally toward
Jerubbaal and his house, have joy in Abimelech and may he likewise
have joy in you.

translation.text: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:

verses.english:
if, I say, you have this day acted honorably and loyally toward
Jerubbaal and his house, have joy in Abimelech and may he likewise
have joy in you.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־אַיִן תֵּצֵא אֵשׁ מֵאֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְתֹאכַל אֶת־בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וְאֶת־בֵּית מִלּוֹא וְתֵצֵא אֵשׁ מִבַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וּמִבֵּית מִלּוֹא וְתֹאכַל אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־אַיִן תֵּצֵא אֵשׁ מֵאֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְתֹאכַל אֶת־בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וְאֶת־בֵּית מִלּוֹא וְתֵצֵא אֵשׁ מִבַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וּמִבֵּית מִלּוֹא וְתֹאכַל אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
But if not, may fire issue from Abimelech and consume the citizens
of Shechem and Beth-millo, and may fire issue from the citizens of
Shechem and Beth-millo and consume Abimelech!”

translation.text: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.

verses.english:
But if not, may fire issue from Abimelech and consume the citizens
of Shechem and Beth-millo, and may fire issue from the citizens of
Shechem and Beth-millo and consume Abimelech!”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּנס יוֹתָם וַיִּבְרַח וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּאֵרָה וַיֵּשֶׁב שָׁם מִפְּנֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּנס יוֹתָם וַיִּבְרַח וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּאֵרָה וַיֵּשֶׁב שָׁם מִפְּנֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אָחִיו׃

english.text:
With that, Jotham fled. He ran to Beer and stayed there, because
of his brother Abimelech.

translation.text: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.

verses.english:
With that, Jotham fled. He ran to Beer and stayed there, because
of his brother Abimelech.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשַׂר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשַׂר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים׃

english.text: Abimelech held sway over Israel for three years.

translation.text: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,

verses.english: Abimelech held sway over Israel for three years.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֱלֹהִים רוּחַ רָעָה בֵּין אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וּבֵין בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וַיִּבְגְּדוּ בַעֲלֵי־שְׁכֶם בַּאֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֱלֹהִים רוּחַ רָעָה בֵּין אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וּבֵין בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וַיִּבְגְּדוּ בַעֲלֵי־שְׁכֶם בַּאֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Then God sent a spirit of discord between Abimelech and the
citizens of Shechem, and the citizens of Shechem broke faith with
Abimelech—

translation.text: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:

verses.english:
Then God sent a spirit of discord between Abimelech and the
citizens of Shechem, and the citizens of Shechem broke faith with
Abimelech—

verses.hebrew: לָבוֹא חֲמַס שִׁבְעִים בְּנֵי־יְרֻבָּעַל וְדָמָם לָשׂוּם עַל־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֲחִיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הָרַג אוֹתָם וְעַל בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם אֲשֶׁר־חִזְּקוּ אֶת־יָדָיו לַהֲרֹג אֶת־אֶחָיו׃

hebrew.text: לָבוֹא חֲמַס שִׁבְעִים בְּנֵי־יְרֻבָּעַל וְדָמָם לָשׂוּם עַל־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֲחִיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הָרַג אוֹתָם וְעַל בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם אֲשֶׁר־חִזְּקוּ אֶת־יָדָיו לַהֲרֹג אֶת־אֶחָיו׃

english.text:
to the end that the crime committed against the seventy sons of
Jerubbaal might be avenged, and their blood recoil upon their
brother Abimelech, who had slain them, and upon the citizens of
Shechem, who had abetted him in the slaying of his brothers.

translation.text: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.

verses.english:
to the end that the crime committed against the seventy sons of
Jerubbaal might be avenged, and their blood recoil upon their
brother Abimelech, who had slain them, and upon the citizens of
Shechem, who had abetted him in the slaying of his brothers.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ לוֹ בַעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם מְאָרְבִים עַל רָאשֵׁי הֶהָרִים וַיִּגְזְלוּ אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲבֹר עֲלֵיהֶם בַּדָּרֶךְ וַיֻּגַּד לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ לוֹ בַעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם מְאָרְבִים עַל רָאשֵׁי הֶהָרִים וַיִּגְזְלוּ אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲבֹר עֲלֵיהֶם בַּדָּרֶךְ וַיֻּגַּד לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The citizens of Shechem planted ambuscades against him on the
hilltops; and they robbed whoever passed by them on the road. Word
of this reached Abimelech.

translation.text: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.

verses.english:
The citizens of Shechem planted ambuscades against him on the
hilltops; and they robbed whoever passed by them on the road. Word
of this reached Abimelech.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא גַּעַל בֶּן־עֶבֶד וְאֶחָיו וַיַּעַבְרוּ בִּשְׁכֶם וַיִּבְטְחוּ־בוֹ בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא גַּעַל בֶּן־עֶבֶד וְאֶחָיו וַיַּעַבְרוּ בִּשְׁכֶם וַיִּבְטְחוּ־בוֹ בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
Then Gaal son of Ebed and his companions came passing through
Shechem, and the citizens of Shechem gave him their confidence.

translation.text: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.

verses.english:
Then Gaal son of Ebed and his companions came passing through
Shechem, and the citizens of Shechem gave him their confidence.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ הַשָּׂדֶה וַיִּבְצְרוּ אֶת־כַּרְמֵיהֶם וַיִּדְרְכוּ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ הִלּוּלִים וַיָּבֹאוּ בֵּית אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ וַיְקַלְלוּ אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ הַשָּׂדֶה וַיִּבְצְרוּ אֶת־כַּרְמֵיהֶם וַיִּדְרְכוּ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ הִלּוּלִים וַיָּבֹאוּ בֵּית אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ וַיְקַלְלוּ אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
They went out into the fields, gathered and trod out the vintage
of their vineyards, and made a festival. They entered the temple
of their god, and as they ate and drank they reviled Abimelech.

translation.text: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.

verses.english:
They went out into the fields, gathered and trod out the vintage
of their vineyards, and made a festival. They entered the temple
of their god, and as they ate and drank they reviled Abimelech.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר גַּעַל בֶּן־עֶבֶד מִי־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וּמִי־שְׁכֶם כִּי נַעַבְדֶנּוּ הֲלֹא בֶן־יְרֻבַּעַל וּזְבֻל פְּקִידוֹ עִבְדוּ אֶת־אַנְשֵׁי חֲמוֹר אֲבִי שְׁכֶם וּמַדּוּעַ נַעַבְדֶנּוּ
אֲנָחְנוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר גַּעַל בֶּן־עֶבֶד מִי־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וּמִי־שְׁכֶם כִּי נַעַבְדֶנּוּ הֲלֹא בֶן־יְרֻבַּעַל וּזְבֻל פְּקִידוֹ עִבְדוּ אֶת־אַנְשֵׁי חֲמוֹר אֲבִי שְׁכֶם וּמַדּוּעַ נַעַבְדֶנּוּ
אֲנָחְנוּ׃

english.text:
Gaal son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelech and who are [we]
Shechemites, that we should serve him? This same son of Jerubbaal
and his lieutenant Zebul once served the men of Hamor, the father
of Shechem; so why should we serve him?

translation.text: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?

verses.english:
Gaal son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelech and who are [we]
Shechemites, that we should serve him? This same son of Jerubbaal
and his lieutenant Zebul once served the men of Hamor, the father
of Shechem; so why should we serve him?

verses.hebrew: וּמִי יִתֵּן אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה בְּיָדִי וְאָסִירָה אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ רַבֶּה צְבָאֲךָ וָצֵאָה׃

hebrew.text: וּמִי יִתֵּן אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה בְּיָדִי וְאָסִירָה אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ רַבֶּה צְבָאֲךָ וָצֵאָה׃

english.text:
Oh, if only this people were under my command, I would get rid of
Abimelech! One would challenge Abimelech, ‘Fill up your ranks and
come out here!’”

translation.text: And would to God this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase thine army, and come out.

verses.english:
Oh, if only this people were under my command, I would get rid of
Abimelech! One would challenge Abimelech, ‘Fill up your ranks and
come out here!’”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע זְבֻל שַׂר־הָעִיר אֶת־דִּבְרֵי גַּעַל בֶּן־עָבֶד וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע זְבֻל שַׂר־הָעִיר אֶת־דִּבְרֵי גַּעַל בֶּן־עָבֶד וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ׃

english.text:
When Zebul, the governor of the city, heard the words of Gaal son
of Ebed, he was furious.

translation.text: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.

verses.english:
When Zebul, the governor of the city, heard the words of Gaal son
of Ebed, he was furious.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בְּתרְמָה לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה גַעַל בֶּן־עֶבֶד וְאֶחָיו בָּאִים שְׁכֶמָה וְהִנָּם צָרִים אֶת־הָעִיר עָלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בְּתרְמָה לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה גַעַל בֶּן־עֶבֶד וְאֶחָיו בָּאִים שְׁכֶמָה וְהִנָּם צָרִים אֶת־הָעִיר עָלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
He sent messages to Abimelech at Tormah to say, “Gaal son of Ebed
and his companions have come to Shechem and they are inciting the
city against you.

translation.text: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.

verses.english:
He sent messages to Abimelech at Tormah to say, “Gaal son of Ebed
and his companions have come to Shechem and they are inciting the
city against you.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה קוּם לַיְלָה אַתָּה וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתָּךְ וֶאֱרֹב בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה קוּם לַיְלָה אַתָּה וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתָּךְ וֶאֱרֹב בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
Therefore, set out at night with the forces you have with you and
conceal yourself in the fields.

translation.text: Now therefore up by night, thou and the people that is with thee, and lie in wait in the field:

verses.english:
Therefore, set out at night with the forces you have with you and
conceal yourself in the fields.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַבֹּקֶר כִּזְרֹחַ הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ תַּשְׁכִּים וּפָשַׁטְתָּ עַל־הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה־הוּא וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ יֹצְאִים אֵלֶיךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא יָדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בַבֹּקֶר כִּזְרֹחַ הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ תַּשְׁכִּים וּפָשַׁטְתָּ עַל־הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה־הוּא וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ יֹצְאִים אֵלֶיךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא יָדֶךָ׃

english.text:
Early next morning, as the sun rises, advance on the city. He and
his men will thereupon come out against you, and you will do to
him whatever you find possible.”

translation.text: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when he and the people that is with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.

verses.english:
Early next morning, as the sun rises, advance on the city. He and
his men will thereupon come out against you, and you will do to
him whatever you find possible.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־עִמּוֹ לָיְלָה וַיֶּאֶרְבוּ עַל־שְׁכֶם אַרְבָּעָה רָאשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־עִמּוֹ לָיְלָה וַיֶּאֶרְבוּ עַל־שְׁכֶם אַרְבָּעָה רָאשִׁים׃

english.text:
Abimelech and all the men with him set out at night and disposed
themselves against Shechem in four hiding places.

translation.text: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.

verses.english:
Abimelech and all the men with him set out at night and disposed
themselves against Shechem in four hiding places.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא גַּעַל בֶּן־עֶבֶד וַיַּעֲמֹד פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הָעִיר וַיָּקם אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ מִן־הַמַּאְרָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא גַּעַל בֶּן־עֶבֶד וַיַּעֲמֹד פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הָעִיר וַיָּקם אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ מִן־הַמַּאְרָב׃

english.text:
When Gaal son of Ebed came out and stood at the entrance to the
city gate, Abimelech and the army with him emerged from
concealment.

translation.text: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from lying in wait.

verses.english:
When Gaal son of Ebed came out and stood at the entrance to the
city gate, Abimelech and the army with him emerged from
concealment.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא־גַּעַל אֶת־הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־זְבֻל הִנֵּה־עָם יוֹרֵד מֵרָאשֵׁי הֶהָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו זְבֻל אֵת צֵל הֶהָרִים אַתָּה רֹאֶה כָּאֲנָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא־גַּעַל אֶת־הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־זְבֻל הִנֵּה־עָם יוֹרֵד מֵרָאשֵׁי הֶהָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו זְבֻל אֵת צֵל הֶהָרִים אַתָּה רֹאֶה כָּאֲנָשִׁים׃

english.text:
Gaal saw the army and said to Zebul, “That’s an army marching down
from the hilltops!” But Zebul said to him, “The shadows of the
hills look to you like men.”

translation.text: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.

verses.english:
Gaal saw the army and said to Zebul, “That’s an army marching down
from the hilltops!” But Zebul said to him, “The shadows of the
hills look to you like men.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד גַּעַל לְדַבֵּר וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־עָם יוֹרְדִים מֵעִם טַבּוּר הָאָרֶץ וְרֹאשׁ־אֶחָד בָּא מִדֶּרֶךְ אֵלוֹן מְעוֹנְנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד גַּעַל לְדַבֵּר וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־עָם יוֹרְדִים מֵעִם טַבּוּר הָאָרֶץ וְרֹאשׁ־אֶחָד בָּא מִדֶּרֶךְ אֵלוֹן מְעוֹנְנִים׃

english.text:
Gaal spoke up again, “Look, an army is marching down from
Tabbur-erez, and another column is coming from the direction of
Elon-meonenim.”

translation.text: And Gaal spake again, and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.

verses.english:
Gaal spoke up again, “Look, an army is marching down from
Tabbur-erez, and another column is coming from the direction of
Elon-meonenim.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו זְבֻל אַיֵּה אֵפוֹא פִיךָ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַר מִי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ כִּי נַעַבְדֶנּוּ הֲלֹא זֶה הָעָם אֲשֶׁר מָאַסְתָּה בּוֹ צֵא־נָא עַתָּה וְהִלָּחֶם בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו זְבֻל אַיֵּה אֵפוֹא פִיךָ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַר מִי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ כִּי נַעַבְדֶנּוּ הֲלֹא זֶה הָעָם אֲשֶׁר מָאַסְתָּה בּוֹ צֵא־נָא עַתָּה וְהִלָּחֶם בּוֹ׃

english.text:
“Well,” replied Zebul, “where is your boast, ‘Who is Abimelech
that we should serve him’? There is the army you sneered at; now
go out and fight it!”

translation.text: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now thy mouth, wherewith thou saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.

verses.english:
“Well,” replied Zebul, “where is your boast, ‘Who is Abimelech
that we should serve him’? There is the army you sneered at; now
go out and fight it!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא גַעַל לִפְנֵי בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וַיִּלָּחֶם בַּאֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא גַעַל לִפְנֵי בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וַיִּלָּחֶם בַּאֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
So Gaal went out at the head of the citizens of Shechem and gave
battle to Abimelech.

translation.text: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

verses.english:
So Gaal went out at the head of the citizens of Shechem and gave
battle to Abimelech.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדְּפֵהוּ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיָּנס מִפָּנָיו וַיִּפְּלוּ חֲלָלִים רַבִּים עַד־פֶּתַח הַשָּׁעַר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְדְּפֵהוּ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיָּנס מִפָּנָיו וַיִּפְּלוּ חֲלָלִים רַבִּים עַד־פֶּתַח הַשָּׁעַר׃

english.text:
But he had to flee before him, and Abimelech pursued him, and many
fell slain, all the way to the entrance of the gate.

translation.text: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.

verses.english:
But he had to flee before him, and Abimelech pursued him, and many
fell slain, all the way to the entrance of the gate.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בָּארוּמָה וַיְגָרֶשׁ זְבֻל אֶת־גַּעַל וְאֶת־אֶחָיו מִשֶּׁבֶת בִּשְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בָּארוּמָה וַיְגָרֶשׁ זְבֻל אֶת־גַּעַל וְאֶת־אֶחָיו מִשֶּׁבֶת בִּשְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
Then Abimelech stayed in Arumah, while Zebul expelled Gaal and his
companions and kept them out of Shechem.

translation.text: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.

verses.english:
Then Abimelech stayed in Arumah, while Zebul expelled Gaal and his
companions and kept them out of Shechem.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיֵּצֵא הָעָם הַשָּׂדֶה וַיַּגִּדוּ לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיֵּצֵא הָעָם הַשָּׂדֶה וַיַּגִּדוּ לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The next day, when people went out into the fields, Abimelech was
informed.

translation.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.

verses.english:
The next day, when people went out into the fields, Abimelech was
informed.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הָעָם וַיֶּחֱצֵם לִשְׁלֹשָׁה רָאשִׁים וַיֶּאֱרֹב בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה הָעָם יֹצֵא מִן־הָעִיר וַיָּקם עֲלֵיהֶם וַיַּכֵּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הָעָם וַיֶּחֱצֵם לִשְׁלֹשָׁה רָאשִׁים וַיֶּאֱרֹב בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה הָעָם יֹצֵא מִן־הָעִיר וַיָּקם עֲלֵיהֶם וַיַּכֵּם׃

english.text:
Taking the army, he divided it into three columns and lay in
ambush in the fields; and when he saw the people coming out of the
city, he pounced upon them and struck them down.

translation.text: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.

verses.english:
Taking the army, he divided it into three columns and lay in
ambush in the fields; and when he saw the people coming out of the
city, he pounced upon them and struck them down.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְהָרָאשִׁים אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ פָּשְׁטוּ וַיַּעַמְדוּ פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הָעִיר וּשְׁנֵי הָרָאשִׁים פָּשְׁטוּ עַל־כּל־אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיַּכּוּם׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְהָרָאשִׁים אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ פָּשְׁטוּ וַיַּעַמְדוּ פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הָעִיר וּשְׁנֵי הָרָאשִׁים פָּשְׁטוּ עַל־כּל־אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיַּכּוּם׃

english.text:
While Abimelech and the column that followed him dashed ahead and
took up a position at the entrance of the city gate, the other two
columns rushed upon all that were in the open and struck them
down.

translation.text: And Abimelech, and the company that was with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew them.

verses.english:
While Abimelech and the column that followed him dashed ahead and
took up a position at the entrance of the city gate, the other two
columns rushed upon all that were in the open and struck them
down.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ נִלְחָם בָּעִיר כֹּל הַיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־הָעִיר וְאֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ הָרָג וַיִּתֹּץ אֶת־הָעִיר וַיִּזְרָעֶהָ מֶלַח׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ נִלְחָם בָּעִיר כֹּל הַיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־הָעִיר וְאֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ הָרָג וַיִּתֹּץ אֶת־הָעִיר וַיִּזְרָעֶהָ מֶלַח׃

english.text:
Abimelech fought against the city all that day. He captured the
city and massacred the people in it; he razed the town and sowed
it with salt.

translation.text: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.

verses.english:
Abimelech fought against the city all that day. He captured the
city and massacred the people in it; he razed the town and sowed
it with salt.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כּל־בַּעֲלֵי מִגְדַּל־שְׁכֶם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־צְרִיחַ בֵּית אֵל בְּרִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כּל־בַּעֲלֵי מִגְדַּל־שְׁכֶם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־צְרִיחַ בֵּית אֵל בְּרִית׃

english.text:
When all the citizens of the Tower of Shechem learned of this,
they went into the tunnel of the temple of El-berith.

translation.text: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.

verses.english:
When all the citizens of the Tower of Shechem learned of this,
they went into the tunnel of the temple of El-berith.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ כִּי הִתְקַבְּצוּ כּל־בַּעֲלֵי מִגְדַּל־שְׁכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ כִּי הִתְקַבְּצוּ כּל־בַּעֲלֵי מִגְדַּל־שְׁכֶם׃

english.text:
When Abimelech was informed that all the citizens of the Tower of
Shechem had gathered [there],

translation.text: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

verses.english:
When Abimelech was informed that all the citizens of the Tower of
Shechem had gathered [there],

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַל אֲבִימֶלֶךְ הַר־צַלְמוֹן הוּא וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶת־הַקַּרְדֻּמּוֹת בְּיָדוֹ וַיִּכְרֹת שׂוֹכַת עֵצִים וַיִּשָּׂאֶהָ וַיָּשֶׂם עַל־שִׁכְמוֹ
וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־עִמּוֹ מָה רְאִיתֶם עָשִׂיתִי מַהֲרוּ עֲשׂוּ כָמוֹנִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַל אֲבִימֶלֶךְ הַר־צַלְמוֹן הוּא וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶת־הַקַּרְדֻּמּוֹת בְּיָדוֹ וַיִּכְרֹת שׂוֹכַת עֵצִים וַיִּשָּׂאֶהָ וַיָּשֶׂם עַל־שִׁכְמוֹ
וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־עִמּוֹ מָה רְאִיתֶם עָשִׂיתִי מַהֲרוּ עֲשׂוּ כָמוֹנִי׃

english.text:
Abimelech and all the troops he had with him went up on Mount
Zalmon. Taking an ax in his hand, Abimelech lopped off a tree limb
and lifted it onto his shoulder. Then he said to the troops that
accompanied him, “What you saw me do—quick, do the same!”

translation.text: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on his shoulder, and said unto the people that were with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done.

verses.english:
Abimelech and all the troops he had with him went up on Mount
Zalmon. Taking an ax in his hand, Abimelech lopped off a tree limb
and lifted it onto his shoulder. Then he said to the troops that
accompanied him, “What you saw me do—quick, do the same!”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּכְרְתוּ גַם־כּל־הָעָם אִישׁ שׂוֹכֹה וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל־הַצְּרִיחַ וַיַּצִּיתוּ עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת־הַצְּרִיחַ בָּאֵשׁ וַיָּמֻתוּ גַּם כּל־אַנְשֵׁי
מִגְדַּל־שְׁכֶם כְּאֶלֶף אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּכְרְתוּ גַם־כּל־הָעָם אִישׁ שׂוֹכֹה וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל־הַצְּרִיחַ וַיַּצִּיתוּ עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת־הַצְּרִיחַ בָּאֵשׁ וַיָּמֻתוּ גַּם כּל־אַנְשֵׁי
מִגְדַּל־שְׁכֶם כְּאֶלֶף אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
So each of the troops also lopped off a bough; then they marched
behind Abimelech and laid them against the tunnel, and set fire to
the tunnel over their heads. Thus all the people of the Tower of
Shechem also perished, about a thousand men and women.

translation.text: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.

verses.english:
So each of the troops also lopped off a bough; then they marched
behind Abimelech and laid them against the tunnel, and set fire to
the tunnel over their heads. Thus all the people of the Tower of
Shechem also perished, about a thousand men and women.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶל־תֵּבֵץ וַיִּחַן בְּתֵבֵץ וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶל־תֵּבֵץ וַיִּחַן בְּתֵבֵץ וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ׃

english.text:
Abimelech proceeded to Thebez; he encamped at Thebez and occupied
it.

translation.text: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.

verses.english:
Abimelech proceeded to Thebez; he encamped at Thebez and occupied
it.

verses.hebrew: וּמִגְדַּל־עֹז הָיָה בְתוֹךְ־הָעִיר וַיָּנֻסוּ שָׁמָּה כּל־הָאֲנָשִׁים וְהַנָּשִׁים וְכֹל בַּעֲלֵי הָעִיר וַיִּסְגְּרוּ בַּעֲדָם וַיַּעֲלוּ עַל־גַּג הַמִּגְדָּל׃

hebrew.text: וּמִגְדַּל־עֹז הָיָה בְתוֹךְ־הָעִיר וַיָּנֻסוּ שָׁמָּה כּל־הָאֲנָשִׁים וְהַנָּשִׁים וְכֹל בַּעֲלֵי הָעִיר וַיִּסְגְּרוּ בַּעֲדָם וַיַּעֲלוּ עַל־גַּג הַמִּגְדָּל׃

english.text:
Within the town was a fortified tower; and all the citizens of the
town, men and women, took refuge there. They shut themselves in,
and went up on the roof of the tower.

translation.text: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.

verses.english:
Within the town was a fortified tower; and all the citizens of the
town, men and women, took refuge there. They shut themselves in,
and went up on the roof of the tower.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֲבִימֶלֶךְ עַד־הַמִּגְדָּל וַיִּלָּחֶם בּוֹ וַיִּגַּשׁ עַד־פֶּתַח הַמִּגְדָּל לְשׂרְפוֹ בָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֲבִימֶלֶךְ עַד־הַמִּגְדָּל וַיִּלָּחֶם בּוֹ וַיִּגַּשׁ עַד־פֶּתַח הַמִּגְדָּל לְשׂרְפוֹ בָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
Abimelech pressed forward to the tower and attacked it. He
approached the door of the tower to set it on fire.

translation.text: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

verses.english:
Abimelech pressed forward to the tower and attacked it. He
approached the door of the tower to set it on fire.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ אִשָּׁה אַחַת פֶּלַח רֶכֶב עַל־רֹאשׁ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַתָּרִץ אֶת־גֻּלְגּלְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ אִשָּׁה אַחַת פֶּלַח רֶכֶב עַל־רֹאשׁ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַתָּרִץ אֶת־גֻּלְגּלְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
But a woman dropped an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head and
cracked his skull.

translation.text: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech’s head, and all to brake his skull.

verses.english:
But a woman dropped an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head and
cracked his skull.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מְהֵרָה אֶל־הַנַּעַר נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ שְׁלֹף חַרְבְּךָ וּמוֹתְתֵנִי פֶּן־יֹאמְרוּ לִי אִשָּׁה הֲרָגָתְהוּ וַיִּדְקְרֵהוּ נַעֲרוֹ וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא מְהֵרָה אֶל־הַנַּעַר נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ שְׁלֹף חַרְבְּךָ וּמוֹתְתֵנִי פֶּן־יֹאמְרוּ לִי אִשָּׁה הֲרָגָתְהוּ וַיִּדְקְרֵהוּ נַעֲרוֹ וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
He immediately cried out to his attendant, his arms-bearer, “Draw
your dagger and finish me off, that they may not say of me, ‘A
woman killed him!’” So his attendant stabbed him, and he died.

translation.text: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A women slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.

verses.english:
He immediately cried out to his attendant, his arms-bearer, “Draw
your dagger and finish me off, that they may not say of me, ‘A
woman killed him!’” So his attendant stabbed him, and he died.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי מֵת אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיֵּלְכוּ אִישׁ לִמְקֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי מֵת אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיֵּלְכוּ אִישׁ לִמְקֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
When the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, everyone went
home.

translation.text: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.

verses.english:
When the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, everyone went
home.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב אֱלֹהִים אֵת רָעַת אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְאָבִיו לַהֲרֹג אֶת־שִׁבְעִים אֶחָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׁב אֱלֹהִים אֵת רָעַת אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְאָבִיו לַהֲרֹג אֶת־שִׁבְעִים אֶחָיו׃

english.text:
Thus God repaid Abimelech for the evil he had done to his father
by slaying his seventy brothers;

translation.text: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:

verses.english:
Thus God repaid Abimelech for the evil he had done to his father
by slaying his seventy brothers;

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כּל־רָעַת אַנְשֵׁי שְׁכֶם הֵשִׁיב אֱלֹהִים בְּרֹאשָׁם וַתָּבֹא אֲלֵיהֶם קִלְלַת יוֹתָם בֶּן־יְרֻבָּעַל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת כּל־רָעַת אַנְשֵׁי שְׁכֶם הֵשִׁיב אֱלֹהִים בְּרֹאשָׁם וַתָּבֹא אֲלֵיהֶם קִלְלַת יוֹתָם בֶּן־יְרֻבָּעַל׃

english.text:
and God likewise repaid the men of Shechem for all their
wickedness. And so the curse of Jotham son of Jerubbaal was
fulfilled upon them.

translation.text: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.

verses.english:
and God likewise repaid the men of Shechem for all their
wickedness. And so the curse of Jotham son of Jerubbaal was
fulfilled upon them.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם אַחֲרֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ לְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל תּוֹלָע בֶּן־פּוּאָה בֶּן־דּוֹדוֹ אִישׁ יִשָּׂשכָר וְהוּא־יֹשֵׁב בְּשָׁמִיר בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם אַחֲרֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ לְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל תּוֹלָע בֶּן־פּוּאָה בֶּן־דּוֹדוֹ אִישׁ יִשָּׂשכָר וְהוּא־יֹשֵׁב בְּשָׁמִיר בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם׃

english.text:
After Abimelech, Tola son of Puah son of Dodo, a man of Issachar,
arose to deliver Israel. He lived at Shamir in the hill country of
Ephraim.

translation.text: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.

verses.english:
After Abimelech, Tola son of Puah son of Dodo, a man of Issachar,
arose to deliver Israel. He lived at Shamir in the hill country of
Ephraim.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה וַיָּמת וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּשָׁמִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה וַיָּמת וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּשָׁמִיר׃

english.text:
He led Israel for twenty-three years; then he died and was buried
at Shamir.

translation.text: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

verses.english:
He led Israel for twenty-three years; then he died and was buried
at Shamir.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם אַחֲרָיו יָאִיר הַגִּלְעָדִי וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם אַחֲרָיו יָאִיר הַגִּלְעָדִי וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
After him arose Jair the Gileadite, and he led Israel for
twenty-two years.

translation.text: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.

verses.english:
After him arose Jair the Gileadite, and he led Israel for
twenty-two years.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־לוֹ שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנִים רֹכְבִים עַל־שְׁלֹשִׁים עֲיָרִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים עֲיָרִים לָהֶם לָהֶם יִקְרְאוּ חַוֺּת יָאִיר עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי־לוֹ שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנִים רֹכְבִים עַל־שְׁלֹשִׁים עֲיָרִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים עֲיָרִים לָהֶם לָהֶם יִקְרְאוּ חַוֺּת יָאִיר עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד׃

english.text:
He had thirty sons, who rode on thirty burros and owned thirty
boroughs in the region of Gilead; these are called Havvoth-jair to
this day.)

translation.text: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havothjair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.

verses.english:
He had thirty sons, who rode on thirty burros and owned thirty
boroughs in the region of Gilead; these are called Havvoth-jair to
this day.)

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת יָאִיר וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּקָמוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת יָאִיר וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּקָמוֹן׃

english.text: Then Jair died and was buried at Kamon.

translation.text: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.

verses.english: Then Jair died and was buried at Kamon.
