verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּסִיפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים וְאֶת־הָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶת־אֱלֹהֵי אֲרָם וְאֶת־אֱלֹהֵי צִידוֹן וְאֵת אֱלֹהֵי מוֹאָב
וְאֵת אֱלֹהֵי בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וְאֵת אֱלֹהֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְלֹא עֲבָדוּהוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּסִיפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים וְאֶת־הָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶת־אֱלֹהֵי אֲרָם וְאֶת־אֱלֹהֵי צִידוֹן וְאֵת אֱלֹהֵי מוֹאָב
וְאֵת אֱלֹהֵי בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וְאֵת אֱלֹהֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְלֹא עֲבָדוּהוּ׃

english.text:
The Israelites again did what was offensive to YHWH. They served
the Baalim and the Ashtaroth, and the gods of Aram, the gods of
Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the Ammonites, and the gods
of the Philistines; they forsook YHWH and did not serve Him.

translation.text: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD, and served not him.

verses.english:
The Israelites again did what was offensive to YHWH. They served
the Baalim and the Ashtaroth, and the gods of Aram, the gods of
Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the Ammonites, and the gods
of the Philistines; they forsook YHWH and did not serve Him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְכְּרֵם בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּבְיַד בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְכְּרֵם בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּבְיַד בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
And YHWH, incensed with Israel, surrendered them to the
Philistines and to the Ammonites.

translation.text: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.

verses.english:
And YHWH, incensed with Israel, surrendered them to the
Philistines and to the Ammonites.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּרְעֲצוּ וַיְרֹצְצוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁנָה הַהִיא שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה אֶת־כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בְּאֶרֶץ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר
בַּגִּלְעָד׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּרְעֲצוּ וַיְרֹצְצוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁנָה הַהִיא שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה אֶת־כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בְּאֶרֶץ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר
בַּגִּלְעָד׃

english.text:
That year they battered and shattered the Israelites—for eighteen
years—all the Israelites beyond the Jordan, in [what had been] the
land of the Amorites in Gilead.

translation.text: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.

verses.english:
That year they battered and shattered the Israelites—for eighteen
years—all the Israelites beyond the Jordan, in [what had been] the
land of the Amorites in Gilead.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן לְהִלָּחֵם גַּם־בִּיהוּדָה וּבְבִנְיָמִין וּבְבֵית אֶפְרָיִם וַתֵּצֶר לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן לְהִלָּחֵם גַּם־בִּיהוּדָה וּבְבִנְיָמִין וּבְבֵית אֶפְרָיִם וַתֵּצֶר לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מְאֹד׃

english.text:
The Ammonites also crossed the Jordan to make war on Judah,
Benjamin, and the House of Ephraim. Israel was in great distress.

translation.text: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.

verses.english:
The Ammonites also crossed the Jordan to make war on Judah,
Benjamin, and the House of Ephraim. Israel was in great distress.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר חָטָאנוּ לָךְ וְכִי עָזַבְנוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַנַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר חָטָאנוּ לָךְ וְכִי עָזַבְנוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַנַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים׃

english.text:
Then the Israelites cried out to YHWH, “We stand guilty before
You, for we have forsaken our God and served the Baalim.”

translation.text: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.

verses.english:
Then the Israelites cried out to YHWH, “We stand guilty before
You, for we have forsaken our God and served the Baalim.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלֹא מִמִּצְרַיִם וּמִן־הָאֱמֹרִי וּמִן־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וּמִן־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלֹא מִמִּצְרַיִם וּמִן־הָאֱמֹרִי וּמִן־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וּמִן־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
But YHWH said to the Israelites, “[I have rescued you] from the
Egyptians, from the Amorites, from the Ammonites, and from the
Philistines.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

verses.english:
But YHWH said to the Israelites, “[I have rescued you] from the
Egyptians, from the Amorites, from the Ammonites, and from the
Philistines.

verses.hebrew: וְצִידוֹנִים וַעֲמָלֵק וּמָעוֹן לָחֲצוּ אֶתְכֶם וַתִּצְעֲקוּ אֵלַי וָאוֹשִׁיעָה אֶתְכֶם מִיָּדָם׃

hebrew.text: וְצִידוֹנִים וַעֲמָלֵק וּמָעוֹן לָחֲצוּ אֶתְכֶם וַתִּצְעֲקוּ אֵלַי וָאוֹשִׁיעָה אֶתְכֶם מִיָּדָם׃

english.text:
The Sidonians, Amalek, and Maon also oppressed you; and when you
cried out to Me, I saved you from them.

translation.text: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.

verses.english:
The Sidonians, Amalek, and Maon also oppressed you; and when you
cried out to Me, I saved you from them.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם עֲזַבְתֶּם אוֹתִי וַתַּעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לָכֵן לֹא־אוֹסִיף לְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתֶּם עֲזַבְתֶּם אוֹתִי וַתַּעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לָכֵן לֹא־אוֹסִיף לְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
Yet you have forsaken Me and have served other gods. No, I will
not deliver you again.

translation.text: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.

verses.english:
Yet you have forsaken Me and have served other gods. No, I will
not deliver you again.

verses.hebrew: לְכוּ וְזַעֲקוּ אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר בְּחַרְתֶּם בָּם הֵמָּה יוֹשִׁיעוּ לָכֶם בְּעֵת צָרַתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: לְכוּ וְזַעֲקוּ אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר בְּחַרְתֶּם בָּם הֵמָּה יוֹשִׁיעוּ לָכֶם בְּעֵת צָרַתְכֶם׃

english.text:
Go cry to the gods you have chosen; let them deliver you in your
time of distress!”

translation.text: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.

verses.english:
Go cry to the gods you have chosen; let them deliver you in your
time of distress!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה חָטָאנוּ עֲשֵׂה־אַתָּה לָנוּ כְּכל־הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ אַךְ הַצִּילֵנוּ נָא הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה חָטָאנוּ עֲשֵׂה־אַתָּה לָנוּ כְּכל־הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ אַךְ הַצִּילֵנוּ נָא הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
But the Israelites implored YHWH: “We stand guilty. Do to us as
You see fit; only save us this day!”

translation.text: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.

verses.english:
But the Israelites implored YHWH: “We stand guilty. Do to us as
You see fit; only save us this day!”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּסִירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר מִקִּרְבָּם וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַתִּקְצַר נַפְשׁוֹ בַּעֲמַל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּסִירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר מִקִּרְבָּם וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַתִּקְצַר נַפְשׁוֹ בַּעֲמַל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
They removed the alien gods from among them and served YHWH; and
He could not bear the miseries of Israel.

translation.text: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

verses.english:
They removed the alien gods from among them and served YHWH; and
He could not bear the miseries of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצָּעֲקוּ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּגִּלְעָד וַיֵּאָסְפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּמִּצְפָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצָּעֲקוּ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּגִּלְעָד וַיֵּאָסְפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּמִּצְפָּה׃

english.text:
The Ammonites mustered and they encamped in Gilead; and the
Israelites massed and they encamped at Mizpah.

translation.text: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.

verses.english:
The Ammonites mustered and they encamped in Gilead; and the
Israelites massed and they encamped at Mizpah.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעָם שָׂרֵי גִלְעָד אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ מִי הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יָחֵל לְהִלָּחֵם בִּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן יִהְיֶה לְרֹאשׁ לְכֹל יֹשְׁבֵי גִלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעָם שָׂרֵי גִלְעָד אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ מִי הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יָחֵל לְהִלָּחֵם בִּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן יִהְיֶה לְרֹאשׁ לְכֹל יֹשְׁבֵי גִלְעָד׃

english.text:
The troops—the officers of Gilead—said to one another, “Let the
man who is the first to fight the Ammonites be chieftain over all
the inhabitants of Gilead.”

translation.text: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

verses.english:
The troops—the officers of Gilead—said to one another, “Let the
man who is the first to fight the Ammonites be chieftain over all
the inhabitants of Gilead.”

verses.hebrew: וְיִפְתָּח הַגִּלְעָדִי הָיָה גִּבּוֹר חַיִל וְהוּא בֶּן־אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה וַיּוֹלֶד גִּלְעָד אֶת־יִפְתָּח׃

hebrew.text: וְיִפְתָּח הַגִּלְעָדִי הָיָה גִּבּוֹר חַיִל וְהוּא בֶּן־אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה וַיּוֹלֶד גִּלְעָד אֶת־יִפְתָּח׃

english.text:
Jephthah the Gileadite was an able warrior, who was the son of a
prostitute. Jephthah’s father was Gilead;

translation.text: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.

verses.english:
Jephthah the Gileadite was an able warrior, who was the son of a
prostitute. Jephthah’s father was Gilead;

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד אֵשֶׁת־גִּלְעָד לוֹ בָּנִים וַיִּגְדְּלוּ בְנֵי־הָאִשָּׁה וַיְגָרְשׁוּ אֶת־יִפְתָּח וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ לֹא־תִנְחַל בְּבֵית־אָבִינוּ כִּי בֶּן־אִשָּׁה אַחֶרֶת אָתָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד אֵשֶׁת־גִּלְעָד לוֹ בָּנִים וַיִּגְדְּלוּ בְנֵי־הָאִשָּׁה וַיְגָרְשׁוּ אֶת־יִפְתָּח וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ לֹא־תִנְחַל בְּבֵית־אָבִינוּ כִּי בֶּן־אִשָּׁה אַחֶרֶת אָתָּה׃

english.text:
but Gilead also had sons by his wife, and when the wife’s sons
grew up, they drove Jephthah out. They said to him, “You shall
have no share in our father’s property, for you are the son of an
outsider.”

translation.text: And Gilead’s wife bare him sons; and his wife’s sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father’s house; for thou art the son of a strange woman.

verses.english:
but Gilead also had sons by his wife, and when the wife’s sons
grew up, they drove Jephthah out. They said to him, “You shall
have no share in our father’s property, for you are the son of an
outsider.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְרַח יִפְתָּח מִפְּנֵי אֶחָיו וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּאֶרֶץ טוֹב וַיִּתְלַקְּטוּ אֶל־יִפְתָּח אֲנָשִׁים רֵיקִים וַיֵּצְאוּ עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְרַח יִפְתָּח מִפְּנֵי אֶחָיו וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּאֶרֶץ טוֹב וַיִּתְלַקְּטוּ אֶל־יִפְתָּח אֲנָשִׁים רֵיקִים וַיֵּצְאוּ עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
So Jephthah fled from his brothers and settled in the Tob country.
Men of low character gathered about Jephthah and went out raiding
with him.

translation.text: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.

verses.english:
So Jephthah fled from his brothers and settled in the Tob country.
Men of low character gathered about Jephthah and went out raiding
with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִיָּמִים וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִיָּמִים וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text: Some time later, the Ammonites went to war against Israel.

translation.text: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.

verses.english: Some time later, the Ammonites went to war against Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר־נִלְחֲמוּ בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּלְכוּ זִקְנֵי גִלְעָד לָקַחַת אֶת־יִפְתָּח מֵאֶרֶץ טוֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר־נִלְחֲמוּ בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּלְכוּ זִקְנֵי גִלְעָד לָקַחַת אֶת־יִפְתָּח מֵאֶרֶץ טוֹב׃

english.text:
And when the Ammonites attacked Israel, the elders of Gilead went
to bring Jephthah back from the Tob country.

translation.text: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:

verses.english:
And when the Ammonites attacked Israel, the elders of Gilead went
to bring Jephthah back from the Tob country.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְיִפְתָּח לְכָה וְהָיִיתָה לָּנוּ לְקָצִין וְנִלָּחֲמָה בִּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְיִפְתָּח לְכָה וְהָיִיתָה לָּנוּ לְקָצִין וְנִלָּחֲמָה בִּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
They said to Jephthah, “Come be our chief, so that we can fight
the Ammonites.”

translation.text: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.

verses.english:
They said to Jephthah, “Come be our chief, so that we can fight
the Ammonites.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִפְתָּח לְזִקְנֵי גִלְעָד הֲלֹא אַתֶּם שְׂנֵאתֶם אוֹתִי וַתְּגָרְשׁוּנִי מִבֵּית אָבִי וּמַדּוּעַ בָּאתֶם אֵלַי עַתָּה כַּאֲשֶׁר צַר לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִפְתָּח לְזִקְנֵי גִלְעָד הֲלֹא אַתֶּם שְׂנֵאתֶם אוֹתִי וַתְּגָרְשׁוּנִי מִבֵּית אָבִי וּמַדּוּעַ בָּאתֶם אֵלַי עַתָּה כַּאֲשֶׁר צַר לָכֶם׃

english.text:
Jephthah replied to the elders of Gilead, “You are the very people
who rejected me and drove me out of my father’s house. How can you
come to me now when you are in trouble?”

translation.text: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father’s house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?

verses.english:
Jephthah replied to the elders of Gilead, “You are the very people
who rejected me and drove me out of my father’s house. How can you
come to me now when you are in trouble?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ זִקְנֵי גִלְעָד אֶל־יִפְתָּח לָכֵן עַתָּה שַׁבְנוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ עִמָּנוּ וְנִלְחַמְתָּ בִּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן וְהָיִיתָ לָּנוּ לְרֹאשׁ לְכֹל יֹשְׁבֵי גִלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ זִקְנֵי גִלְעָד אֶל־יִפְתָּח לָכֵן עַתָּה שַׁבְנוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ עִמָּנוּ וְנִלְחַמְתָּ בִּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן וְהָיִיתָ לָּנוּ לְרֹאשׁ לְכֹל יֹשְׁבֵי גִלְעָד׃

english.text:
The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “Honestly, we have now
turned back to you. If you come with us and fight the Ammonites,
you shall be our commander over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”

translation.text: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

verses.english:
The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “Honestly, we have now
turned back to you. If you come with us and fight the Ammonites,
you shall be our commander over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִפְתָּח אֶל־זִקְנֵי גִלְעָד אִם־מְשִׁיבִים אַתֶּם אוֹתִי לְהִלָּחֵם בִּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה אוֹתָם לְפָנָי אָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה לָכֶם לְרֹאשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִפְתָּח אֶל־זִקְנֵי גִלְעָד אִם־מְשִׁיבִים אַתֶּם אוֹתִי לְהִלָּחֵם בִּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה אוֹתָם לְפָנָי אָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה לָכֶם לְרֹאשׁ׃

english.text:
Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, “[Very well,] if you bring
me back to fight the Ammonites and YHWH delivers them to me, I am
to be your commander.”

translation.text: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, shall I be your head?

verses.english:
Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, “[Very well,] if you bring
me back to fight the Ammonites and YHWH delivers them to me, I am
to be your commander.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ זִקְנֵי־גִלְעָד אֶל־יִפְתָּח יְהֹוָה יִהְיֶה שֹׁמֵעַ בֵּינוֹתֵינוּ אִם־לֹא כִדְבָרְךָ כֵּן נַעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ זִקְנֵי־גִלְעָד אֶל־יִפְתָּח יְהֹוָה יִהְיֶה שֹׁמֵעַ בֵּינוֹתֵינוּ אִם־לֹא כִדְבָרְךָ כֵּן נַעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
And the elders of Gilead answered Jephthah, “YHWH Himself shall be
witness between us: we will do just as you have said.”

translation.text: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The LORD be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.

verses.english:
And the elders of Gilead answered Jephthah, “YHWH Himself shall be
witness between us: we will do just as you have said.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ יִפְתָּח עִם־זִקְנֵי גִלְעָד וַיָּשִׂימוּ הָעָם אוֹתוֹ עֲלֵיהֶם לְרֹאשׁ וּלְקָצִין וַיְדַבֵּר יִפְתָּח אֶת־כּל־דְּבָרָיו לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בַּמִּצְפָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ יִפְתָּח עִם־זִקְנֵי גִלְעָד וַיָּשִׂימוּ הָעָם אוֹתוֹ עֲלֵיהֶם לְרֹאשׁ וּלְקָצִין וַיְדַבֵּר יִפְתָּח אֶת־כּל־דְּבָרָיו לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בַּמִּצְפָּה׃

english.text:
Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him
their commander and chief. And Jephthah repeated all these terms
before YHWH at Mizpah.

translation.text: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.

verses.english:
Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him
their commander and chief. And Jephthah repeated all these terms
before YHWH at Mizpah.

for three hundred years, why have you not tried to recover them
all this time?

translation.text: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover them within that time?

verses.english:
“While Israel has been inhabiting Heshbon and its dependencies,
and Aroer and its dependencies, and all the towns along the Arnon
for three hundred years, why have you not tried to recover them
all this time?

verses.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִי לֹא־חָטָאתִי לָךְ וְאַתָּה עֹשֶׂה אִתִּי רָעָה לְהִלָּחֶם בִּי יִשְׁפֹּט יְהֹוָה הַשֹּׁפֵט הַיּוֹם בֵּין בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵין בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְאָנֹכִי לֹא־חָטָאתִי לָךְ וְאַתָּה עֹשֶׂה אִתִּי רָעָה לְהִלָּחֶם בִּי יִשְׁפֹּט יְהֹוָה הַשֹּׁפֵט הַיּוֹם בֵּין בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵין בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
I have done you no wrong; yet you are doing me harm and making war
on me. May YHWH, who judges, decide today between the Israelites
and the Ammonites!”

translation.text: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the LORD the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.

verses.english:
I have done you no wrong; yet you are doing me harm and making war
on me. May YHWH, who judges, decide today between the Israelites
and the Ammonites!”

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא שָׁמַע מֶלֶךְ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן אֶל־דִּבְרֵי יִפְתָּח אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא שָׁמַע מֶלֶךְ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן אֶל־דִּבְרֵי יִפְתָּח אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
But the king of the Ammonites paid no heed to the message that
Jephthah sent him.

translation.text: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

verses.english:
But the king of the Ammonites paid no heed to the message that
Jephthah sent him.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי עַל־יִפְתָּח רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־הַגִּלְעָד וְאֶת־מְנַשֶּׁה וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־מִצְפֵּה גִלְעָד וּמִמִּצְפֵּה גִלְעָד עָבַר בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי עַל־יִפְתָּח רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־הַגִּלְעָד וְאֶת־מְנַשֶּׁה וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־מִצְפֵּה גִלְעָד וּמִמִּצְפֵּה גִלְעָד עָבַר בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
Then the spirit of YHWH came upon Jephthah. He marched through
Gilead and Manasseh, passing Mizpeh of Gilead; and from Mizpeh of
Gilead he crossed over [to] the Ammonites.

translation.text: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.

verses.english:
Then the spirit of YHWH came upon Jephthah. He marched through
Gilead and Manasseh, passing Mizpeh of Gilead; and from Mizpeh of
Gilead he crossed over [to] the Ammonites.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּדַּר יִפְתָּח נֶדֶר לַיהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר אִם־נָתוֹן תִּתֵּן אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן בְּיָדִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּדַּר יִפְתָּח נֶדֶר לַיהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר אִם־נָתוֹן תִּתֵּן אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן בְּיָדִי׃

english.text:
And Jephthah made the following vow to YHWH: “If you deliver the
Ammonites into my hands,

translation.text: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,

verses.english:
And Jephthah made the following vow to YHWH: “If you deliver the
Ammonites into my hands,

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַיּוֹצֵא אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מִדַּלְתֵי בֵיתִי לִקְרָאתִי בְּשׁוּבִי בְשָׁלוֹם מִבְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וְהָיָה לַיהֹוָה וְהַעֲלִיתִיהוּ עֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הַיּוֹצֵא אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מִדַּלְתֵי בֵיתִי לִקְרָאתִי בְּשׁוּבִי בְשָׁלוֹם מִבְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וְהָיָה לַיהֹוָה וְהַעֲלִיתִיהוּ עֹלָה׃

english.text:
then whatever comes out of the door of my house to meet me on my
safe return from the Ammonites shall be YHWH’s and shall be
offered by me as a burnt offering.”

translation.text: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD’s, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.

verses.english:
then whatever comes out of the door of my house to meet me on my
safe return from the Ammonites shall be YHWH’s and shall be
offered by me as a burnt offering.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר יִפְתָּח אֶל־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן לְהִלָּחֶם בָּם וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר יִפְתָּח אֶל־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן לְהִלָּחֶם בָּם וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
Jephthah crossed over to the Ammonites and attacked them, and YHWH
delivered them into his hands.

translation.text: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hands.

verses.english:
Jephthah crossed over to the Ammonites and attacked them, and YHWH
delivered them into his hands.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּם מֵעֲרוֹעֵר וְעַד־בֹּאֲךָ מִנִּית עֶשְׂרִים עִיר וְעַד אָבֵל כְּרָמִים מַכָּה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד וַיִּכָּנְעוּ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכֵּם מֵעֲרוֹעֵר וְעַד־בֹּאֲךָ מִנִּית עֶשְׂרִים עִיר וְעַד אָבֵל כְּרָמִים מַכָּה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד וַיִּכָּנְעוּ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
He utterly routed them—from Aroer as far as Minnith, twenty
towns—all the way to Abel-cheramim. So the Ammonites submitted to
the Israelites.

translation.text: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

verses.english:
He utterly routed them—from Aroer as far as Minnith, twenty
towns—all the way to Abel-cheramim. So the Ammonites submitted to
the Israelites.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יִפְתָּח הַמִּצְפָּה אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וְהִנֵּה בִתּוֹ יֹצֵאת לִקְרָאתוֹ בְּתֻפִּים וּבִמְחֹלוֹת וְרַק הִיא יְחִידָה אֵין־לוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ בֵּן אוֹ־בַת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יִפְתָּח הַמִּצְפָּה אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וְהִנֵּה בִתּוֹ יֹצֵאת לִקְרָאתוֹ בְּתֻפִּים וּבִמְחֹלוֹת וְרַק הִיא יְחִידָה אֵין־לוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ בֵּן אוֹ־בַת׃

english.text:
When Jephthah arrived at his home in Mizpah, there was his
daughter coming out to meet him, with timbrel and dance! She was
an only child; he had no other son or daughter.

translation.text: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.

verses.english:
When Jephthah arrived at his home in Mizpah, there was his
daughter coming out to meet him, with timbrel and dance! She was
an only child; he had no other son or daughter.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כִרְאוֹתוֹ אוֹתָהּ וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲהָהּ בִּתִּי הַכְרֵעַ הִכְרַעְתִּנִי וְאַתְּ הָיִית בְּעֹכְרָי וְאָנֹכִי פָּצִיתִי פִי אֶל־יְהֹוָה וְלֹא אוּכַל
לָשׁוּב׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כִרְאוֹתוֹ אוֹתָהּ וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲהָהּ בִּתִּי הַכְרֵעַ הִכְרַעְתִּנִי וְאַתְּ הָיִית בְּעֹכְרָי וְאָנֹכִי פָּצִיתִי פִי אֶל־יְהֹוָה וְלֹא אוּכַל
לָשׁוּב׃

english.text:
On seeing her, he rent his clothes and said, “Alas, daughter! You
have brought me low; you have become my troubler! For I have
uttered a vow to YHWH and I cannot retract.”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD, and I cannot go back.

verses.english:
On seeing her, he rent his clothes and said, “Alas, daughter! You
have brought me low; you have become my troubler! For I have
uttered a vow to YHWH and I cannot retract.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אָבִי פָּצִיתָה אֶת־פִּיךָ אֶל־יְהֹוָה עֲשֵׂה לִי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָצָא מִפִּיךָ אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְךָ יְהֹוָה נְקָמוֹת מֵאֹיְבֶיךָ מִבְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אָבִי פָּצִיתָה אֶת־פִּיךָ אֶל־יְהֹוָה עֲשֵׂה לִי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָצָא מִפִּיךָ אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְךָ יְהֹוָה נְקָמוֹת מֵאֹיְבֶיךָ מִבְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
“Father,” she said, “you have uttered a vow to YHWH; do to me as
you have vowed, seeing that YHWH has vindicated you against your
enemies, the Ammonites.”

translation.text: And she said unto him, My father, if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the LORD, do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the LORD hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, even of the children of Ammon.

verses.english:
“Father,” she said, “you have uttered a vow to YHWH; do to me as
you have vowed, seeing that YHWH has vindicated you against your
enemies, the Ammonites.”

verses.hebrew:
וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־אָבִיהָ יֵעָשֶׂה לִּי הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה הַרְפֵּה מִמֶּנִּי שְׁנַיִם חֳדָשִׁים וְאֵלְכָה וְיָרַדְתִּי עַל־הֶהָרִים וְאֶבְכֶּה עַל־בְּתוּלַי אָנֹכִי (ורעיתי)
[וְרֵעוֹתָי]׃

hebrew.text:
וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־אָבִיהָ יֵעָשֶׂה לִּי הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה הַרְפֵּה מִמֶּנִּי שְׁנַיִם חֳדָשִׁים וְאֵלְכָה וְיָרַדְתִּי עַל־הֶהָרִים וְאֶבְכֶּה עַל־בְּתוּלַי אָנֹכִי (ורעיתי)
[וְרֵעוֹתָי]׃

english.text:
She further said to her father, “Let this be done for me: let me
be for two months, and I will go with my companions and lament
upon the hills and there bewail my maidenhood.”

translation.text: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.

verses.english:
She further said to her father, “Let this be done for me: let me
be for two months, and I will go with my companions and lament
upon the hills and there bewail my maidenhood.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֵכִי וַיִּשְׁלַח אוֹתָהּ שְׁנֵי חֳדָשִׁים וַתֵּלֶךְ הִיא וְרֵעוֹתֶיהָ וַתֵּבְךְּ עַל־בְּתוּלֶיהָ עַל־הֶהָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לֵכִי וַיִּשְׁלַח אוֹתָהּ שְׁנֵי חֳדָשִׁים וַתֵּלֶךְ הִיא וְרֵעוֹתֶיהָ וַתֵּבְךְּ עַל־בְּתוּלֶיהָ עַל־הֶהָרִים׃

english.text:
“Go,” he replied. He let her go for two months, and she and her
companions went and bewailed her maidenhood upon the hills.

translation.text: And he said, Go. And he sent her away for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.

verses.english:
“Go,” he replied. He let her go for two months, and she and her
companions went and bewailed her maidenhood upon the hills.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ שְׁנַיִם חֳדָשִׁים וַתָּשׁב אֶל־אָבִיהָ וַיַּעַשׂ לָהּ אֶת־נִדְרוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָדָר וְהִיא לֹא־יָדְעָה אִישׁ וַתְּהִי־חֹק בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ שְׁנַיִם חֳדָשִׁים וַתָּשׁב אֶל־אָבִיהָ וַיַּעַשׂ לָהּ אֶת־נִדְרוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָדָר וְהִיא לֹא־יָדְעָה אִישׁ וַתְּהִי־חֹק בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
After two months’ time, she returned to her father, and he did to
her as he had vowed. She had never known a man. So it became a
custom in Israel

translation.text: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,

verses.english:
After two months’ time, she returned to her father, and he did to
her as he had vowed. She had never known a man. So it became a
custom in Israel

verses.hebrew: מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה תֵּלַכְנָה בְּנוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְתַנּוֹת לְבַת־יִפְתָּח הַגִּלְעָדִי אַרְבַּעַת יָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה תֵּלַכְנָה בְּנוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְתַנּוֹת לְבַת־יִפְתָּח הַגִּלְעָדִי אַרְבַּעַת יָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה׃

english.text:
for the maidens of Israel to go every year, for four days in the
year, and chant dirges for the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite.

translation.text: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.

verses.english:
for the maidens of Israel to go every year, for four days in the
year, and chant dirges for the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּצָּעֵק אִישׁ אֶפְרַיִם וַיַּעֲבֹר צָפוֹנָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְיִפְתָּח מַדּוּעַ עָבַרְתָּ לְהִלָּחֵם בִּבְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וְלָנוּ לֹא קָרָאתָ לָלֶכֶת עִמָּךְ בֵּיתְךָ נִשְׂרֹף עָלֶיךָ
בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּצָּעֵק אִישׁ אֶפְרַיִם וַיַּעֲבֹר צָפוֹנָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְיִפְתָּח מַדּוּעַ עָבַרְתָּ לְהִלָּחֵם בִּבְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וְלָנוּ לֹא קָרָאתָ לָלֶכֶת עִמָּךְ בֵּיתְךָ נִשְׂרֹף עָלֶיךָ
בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
The men of Ephraim mustered and crossed [the Jordan] to Zaphon.
They said to Jephthah, “Why did you march to fight the Ammonites
without calling us to go with you? We’ll burn your house down over
you!”

translation.text: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire.

verses.english:
The men of Ephraim mustered and crossed [the Jordan] to Zaphon.
They said to Jephthah, “Why did you march to fight the Ammonites
without calling us to go with you? We’ll burn your house down over
you!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִפְתָּח אֲלֵיהֶם אִישׁ רִיב הָיִיתִי אֲנִי וְעַמִּי וּבְנֵי־עַמּוֹן מְאֹד וָאֶזְעַק אֶתְכֶם וְלֹא־הוֹשַׁעְתֶּם אוֹתִי מִיָּדָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִפְתָּח אֲלֵיהֶם אִישׁ רִיב הָיִיתִי אֲנִי וְעַמִּי וּבְנֵי־עַמּוֹן מְאֹד וָאֶזְעַק אֶתְכֶם וְלֹא־הוֹשַׁעְתֶּם אוֹתִי מִיָּדָם׃

english.text:
Jephthah answered them, “I and my people were in a bitter conflict
with the Ammonites; and I summoned you, but you did not save me
from them.

translation.text: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.

verses.english:
Jephthah answered them, “I and my people were in a bitter conflict
with the Ammonites; and I summoned you, but you did not save me
from them.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶרְאֶה כִּי־אֵינְךָ מוֹשִׁיעַ וָאָשִׂימָה נַפְשִׁי בְכַפִּי וָאֶעְבְּרָה אֶל־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיָדִי וְלָמָה עֲלִיתֶם אֵלַי הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְהִלָּחֶם בִּי׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶרְאֶה כִּי־אֵינְךָ מוֹשִׁיעַ וָאָשִׂימָה נַפְשִׁי בְכַפִּי וָאֶעְבְּרָה אֶל־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיָדִי וְלָמָה עֲלִיתֶם אֵלַי הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְהִלָּחֶם בִּי׃

english.text:
When I saw that you were no saviors, I risked my life and advanced
against the Ammonites; and YHWH delivered them into my hands. Why
have you come here now to fight against me?”

translation.text: And when I saw that ye delivered me not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day, to fight against me?

verses.english:
When I saw that you were no saviors, I risked my life and advanced
against the Ammonites; and YHWH delivered them into my hands. Why
have you come here now to fight against me?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְבֹּץ יִפְתָּח אֶת־כּל־אַנְשֵׁי גִלְעָד וַיִּלָּחֶם אֶת־אֶפְרָיִם וַיַּכּוּ אַנְשֵׁי גִלְעָד אֶת־אֶפְרַיִם כִּי אָמְרוּ פְּלִיטֵי אֶפְרַיִם אַתֶּם גִּלְעָד בְּתוֹךְ אֶפְרַיִם
בְּתוֹךְ מְנַשֶּׁה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְבֹּץ יִפְתָּח אֶת־כּל־אַנְשֵׁי גִלְעָד וַיִּלָּחֶם אֶת־אֶפְרָיִם וַיַּכּוּ אַנְשֵׁי גִלְעָד אֶת־אֶפְרַיִם כִּי אָמְרוּ פְּלִיטֵי אֶפְרַיִם אַתֶּם גִּלְעָד בְּתוֹךְ אֶפְרַיִם
בְּתוֹךְ מְנַשֶּׁה׃

english.text:
And Jephthah gathered all the men of Gilead and fought the
Ephraimites. The men of Gilead defeated the Ephraimites; for they
had said, “You Gileadites are nothing but fugitives from
Ephraim—being in Manasseh is like being in Ephraim.”

translation.text: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the Manassites.

verses.english:
And Jephthah gathered all the men of Gilead and fought the
Ephraimites. The men of Gilead defeated the Ephraimites; for they
had said, “You Gileadites are nothing but fugitives from
Ephraim—being in Manasseh is like being in Ephraim.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכֹּד גִּלְעָד אֶת־מַעְבְּרוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן לְאֶפְרָיִם וְהָיָה כִּי יֹאמְרוּ פְּלִיטֵי אֶפְרַיִם אֶעֱבֹרָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אַנְשֵׁי־גִלְעָד הַאֶפְרָתִי אַתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְכֹּד גִּלְעָד אֶת־מַעְבְּרוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן לְאֶפְרָיִם וְהָיָה כִּי יֹאמְרוּ פְּלִיטֵי אֶפְרַיִם אֶעֱבֹרָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אַנְשֵׁי־גִלְעָד הַאֶפְרָתִי אַתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא׃

english.text:
The Gileadites held the fords of the Jordan against the
Ephraimites. And when any fugitive from Ephraim said, “Let me
cross,” the men of Gilead would ask him, “Are you an Ephraimite?”;
if he said “No,”

translation.text: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was so, that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, Art thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;

verses.english:
The Gileadites held the fords of the Jordan against the
Ephraimites. And when any fugitive from Ephraim said, “Let me
cross,” the men of Gilead would ask him, “Are you an Ephraimite?”;
if he said “No,”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אֱמר־נָא שִׁבֹּלֶת וַיֹּאמֶר סִבֹּלֶת וְלֹא יָכִין לְדַבֵּר כֵּן וַיֹּאחֲזוּ אוֹתוֹ וַיִּשְׁחָטוּהוּ אֶל־מַעְבְּרוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּפֹּל בָּעֵת הַהִיא מֵאֶפְרַיִם
אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנַיִם אָלֶף׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אֱמר־נָא שִׁבֹּלֶת וַיֹּאמֶר סִבֹּלֶת וְלֹא יָכִין לְדַבֵּר כֵּן וַיֹּאחֲזוּ אוֹתוֹ וַיִּשְׁחָטוּהוּ אֶל־מַעְבְּרוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּפֹּל בָּעֵת הַהִיא מֵאֶפְרַיִם
אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנַיִם אָלֶף׃

english.text:
they would say to him, “Then say shibboleth”; but he would say
“sibboleth,” not being able to pronounce it correctly. Thereupon
they would seize him and slay him by the fords of the Jordan.
Forty-two thousand Ephraimites fell at that time.

translation.text: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.

verses.english:
they would say to him, “Then say shibboleth”; but he would say
“sibboleth,” not being able to pronounce it correctly. Thereupon
they would seize him and slay him by the fords of the Jordan.
Forty-two thousand Ephraimites fell at that time.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט יִפְתָּח אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וַיָּמת יִפְתָּח הַגִּלְעָדִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּעָרֵי גִלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט יִפְתָּח אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וַיָּמת יִפְתָּח הַגִּלְעָדִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּעָרֵי גִלְעָד׃

english.text:
Jephthah led Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died
and he was buried in one of the towns of Gilead.

translation.text: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.

verses.english:
Jephthah led Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died
and he was buried in one of the towns of Gilead.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַחֲרָיו אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אִבְצָן מִבֵּית לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַחֲרָיו אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אִבְצָן מִבֵּית לָחֶם׃

english.text: After him, Ibzan of Bethlehem led Israel.

translation.text: And after him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.

verses.english: After him, Ibzan of Bethlehem led Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־לוֹ שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנוֹת שִׁלַּח הַחוּצָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנוֹת הֵבִיא לְבָנָיו מִן־הַחוּץ וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי־לוֹ שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנוֹת שִׁלַּח הַחוּצָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנוֹת הֵבִיא לְבָנָיו מִן־הַחוּץ וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
He had thirty sons, and he married off thirty daughters outside
the clan and brought in thirty girls from outside the clan for his
sons. He led Israel seven years.

translation.text: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.

verses.english:
He had thirty sons, and he married off thirty daughters outside
the clan and brought in thirty girls from outside the clan for his
sons. He led Israel seven years.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת אִבְצָן וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּבֵית לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת אִבְצָן וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּבֵית לָחֶם׃

english.text: Then Ibzan died and was buried in Bethlehem.

translation.text: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Bethlehem.

verses.english: Then Ibzan died and was buried in Bethlehem.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַחֲרָיו אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵילוֹן הַזְּבוּלֹנִי וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַחֲרָיו אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵילוֹן הַזְּבוּלֹנִי וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
After him, Elon the Zebulunite led Israel; he led Israel for ten
years.

translation.text: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.

verses.english:
After him, Elon the Zebulunite led Israel; he led Israel for ten
years.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת אֵילוֹן הַזְּבוּלֹנִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּאַיָּלוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ זְבוּלֻן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת אֵילוֹן הַזְּבוּלֹנִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּאַיָּלוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ זְבוּלֻן׃

english.text:
Then Elon the Zebulunite died and was buried in Aijalon, in the
territory of Zebulun.

translation.text: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.

verses.english:
Then Elon the Zebulunite died and was buried in Aijalon, in the
territory of Zebulun.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַחֲרָיו אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדּוֹן בֶּן־הִלֵּל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַחֲרָיו אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדּוֹן בֶּן־הִלֵּל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִי׃

english.text: After him, Abdon son of Hillel the Pirathonite led Israel.

translation.text: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.

verses.english: After him, Abdon son of Hillel the Pirathonite led Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־לוֹ אַרְבָּעִים בָּנִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים בְּנֵי בָנִים רֹכְבִים עַל־שִׁבְעִים עֲיָרִם וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי־לוֹ אַרְבָּעִים בָּנִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים בְּנֵי בָנִים רֹכְבִים עַל־שִׁבְעִים עֲיָרִם וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy
jackasses. He led Israel for eight years.

translation.text: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.

verses.english:
He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy
jackasses. He led Israel for eight years.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת עַבְדּוֹן בֶּן־הִלֵּל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּפִרְעָתוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ אֶפְרַיִם בְּהַר הָעֲמָלֵקִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת עַבְדּוֹן בֶּן־הִלֵּל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּפִרְעָתוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ אֶפְרַיִם בְּהַר הָעֲמָלֵקִי׃

english.text:
Then Abdon son of Hillel the Pirathonite died. He was buried in
Pirathon, in the territory of Ephraim, on the hill of the
Amalekites.

translation.text: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.

verses.english:
Then Abdon son of Hillel the Pirathonite died. He was buried in
Pirathon, in the territory of Ephraim, on the hill of the
Amalekites.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסִיפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסִיפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
The Israelites again did what was offensive to YHWH, and YHWH
delivered them into the hands of the Philistines for forty years.

translation.text: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.

verses.english:
The Israelites again did what was offensive to YHWH, and YHWH
delivered them into the hands of the Philistines for forty years.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אִישׁ אֶחָד מִצּרְעָה מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת הַדָּנִי וּשְׁמוֹ מָנוֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ עֲקָרָה וְלֹא יָלָדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אִישׁ אֶחָד מִצּרְעָה מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת הַדָּנִי וּשְׁמוֹ מָנוֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ עֲקָרָה וְלֹא יָלָדָה׃

english.text:
There was a certain man from Zorah, of the stock of Dan, whose
name was Manoah. His wife was barren and had borne no children.

translation.text: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.

verses.english:
There was a certain man from Zorah, of the stock of Dan, whose
name was Manoah. His wife was barren and had borne no children.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא מַלְאַךְ־יְהֹוָה אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ הִנֵּה־נָא אַתְּ־עֲקָרָה וְלֹא יָלַדְתְּ וְהָרִית וְיָלַדְתְּ בֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָא מַלְאַךְ־יְהֹוָה אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ הִנֵּה־נָא אַתְּ־עֲקָרָה וְלֹא יָלַדְתְּ וְהָרִית וְיָלַדְתְּ בֵּן׃

english.text:
An angel of YHWH appeared to the woman and said to her, “You are
barren and have borne no children; but you shall conceive and bear
a son.

translation.text: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, thou art barren, and bearest not: but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.

verses.english:
An angel of YHWH appeared to the woman and said to her, “You are
barren and have borne no children; but you shall conceive and bear
a son.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִשָּׁמְרִי נָא וְאַל־תִּשְׁתִּי יַיִן וְשֵׁכָר וְאַל־תֹּאכְלִי כּל־טָמֵא׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִשָּׁמְרִי נָא וְאַל־תִּשְׁתִּי יַיִן וְשֵׁכָר וְאַל־תֹּאכְלִי כּל־טָמֵא׃

english.text:
Now be careful not to drink wine or other intoxicant, or to eat
anything unclean.

translation.text: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing:

verses.english:
Now be careful not to drink wine or other intoxicant, or to eat
anything unclean.

verses.hebrew:
כִּי הִנָּךְ הָרָה וְיֹלַדְתְּ בֵּן וּמוֹרָה לֹא־יַעֲלֶה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ כִּי־נְזִיר אֱלֹהִים יִהְיֶה הַנַּעַר מִן־הַבָּטֶן וְהוּא יָחֵל לְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד
פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי הִנָּךְ הָרָה וְיֹלַדְתְּ בֵּן וּמוֹרָה לֹא־יַעֲלֶה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ כִּי־נְזִיר אֱלֹהִים יִהְיֶה הַנַּעַר מִן־הַבָּטֶן וְהוּא יָחֵל לְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד
פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
For you are going to conceive and bear a son; let no razor touch
his head, for the boy is to be a nazirite to God from the womb on.
He shall be the first to deliver Israel from the Philistines.”

translation.text: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.

verses.english:
For you are going to conceive and bear a son; let no razor touch
his head, for the boy is to be a nazirite to God from the womb on.
He shall be the first to deliver Israel from the Philistines.”

verses.hebrew:
וַתָּבֹא הָאִשָּׁה וַתֹּאמֶר לְאִישָׁהּ לֵאמֹר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בָּא אֵלַי וּמַרְאֵהוּ כְּמַרְאֵה מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים נוֹרָא מְאֹד וְלֹא שְׁאִלְתִּיהוּ אֵי־מִזֶּה הוּא וְאֶת־שְׁמוֹ
לֹא־הִגִּיד לִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַתָּבֹא הָאִשָּׁה וַתֹּאמֶר לְאִישָׁהּ לֵאמֹר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בָּא אֵלַי וּמַרְאֵהוּ כְּמַרְאֵה מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים נוֹרָא מְאֹד וְלֹא שְׁאִלְתִּיהוּ אֵי־מִזֶּה הוּא וְאֶת־שְׁמוֹ
לֹא־הִגִּיד לִי׃

english.text:
The woman went and told her husband, “A man of God came to me; he
looked like an angel of God, very frightening. I did not ask him
where he was from, nor did he tell me his name.

translation.text: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came unto me, and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of God, very terrible: but I asked him not whence he was, neither told he me his name:

verses.english:
The woman went and told her husband, “A man of God came to me; he
looked like an angel of God, very frightening. I did not ask him
where he was from, nor did he tell me his name.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי הִנָּךְ הָרָה וְיֹלַדְתְּ בֵּן וְעַתָּה אַל־תִּשְׁתִּי יַיִן וְשֵׁכָר וְאַל־תֹּאכְלִי כּל־טֻמְאָה כִּי־נְזִיר אֱלֹהִים יִהְיֶה הַנַּעַר מִן־הַבֶּטֶן עַד־יוֹם מוֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי הִנָּךְ הָרָה וְיֹלַדְתְּ בֵּן וְעַתָּה אַל־תִּשְׁתִּי יַיִן וְשֵׁכָר וְאַל־תֹּאכְלִי כּל־טֻמְאָה כִּי־נְזִיר אֱלֹהִים יִהְיֶה הַנַּעַר מִן־הַבֶּטֶן עַד־יוֹם מוֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
He said to me, ‘You are going to conceive and bear a son. Drink no
wine or other intoxicant, and eat nothing unclean, for the boy is
to be a nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death!’”

translation.text: But he said unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.

verses.english:
He said to me, ‘You are going to conceive and bear a son. Drink no
wine or other intoxicant, and eat nothing unclean, for the boy is
to be a nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death!’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּעְתַּר מָנוֹחַ אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר בִּי אֲדוֹנָי אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַחְתָּ יָבוֹא־נָא עוֹד אֵלֵינוּ וְיוֹרֵנוּ מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂה לַנַּעַר הַיּוּלָּד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּעְתַּר מָנוֹחַ אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר בִּי אֲדוֹנָי אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַחְתָּ יָבוֹא־נָא עוֹד אֵלֵינוּ וְיוֹרֵנוּ מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂה לַנַּעַר הַיּוּלָּד׃

english.text:
Manoah pleaded with YHWH. “Oh, my Lord!” he said, “please let the
man of God that You sent come to us again, and let him instruct us
how to act with the child that is to be born.”

translation.text: Then Manoah intreated the LORD, and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.

verses.english:
Manoah pleaded with YHWH. “Oh, my Lord!” he said, “please let the
man of God that You sent come to us again, and let him instruct us
how to act with the child that is to be born.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע הָאֱלֹהִים בְּקוֹל מָנוֹחַ וַיָּבֹא מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים עוֹד אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה וְהִיא יוֹשֶׁבֶת בַּשָּׂדֶה וּמָנוֹחַ אִישָׁהּ אֵין עִמָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע הָאֱלֹהִים בְּקוֹל מָנוֹחַ וַיָּבֹא מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים עוֹד אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה וְהִיא יוֹשֶׁבֶת בַּשָּׂדֶה וּמָנוֹחַ אִישָׁהּ אֵין עִמָּהּ׃

english.text:
God heeded Manoah’s plea, and the angel of God came to the woman
again. She was sitting in the field and her husband Manoah was not
with her.

translation.text: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband was not with her.

verses.english:
God heeded Manoah’s plea, and the angel of God came to the woman
again. She was sitting in the field and her husband Manoah was not
with her.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּמַהֵר הָאִשָּׁה וַתָּרץ וַתַּגֵּד לְאִישָׁהּ וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה נִרְאָה אֵלַי הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּא בַיּוֹם אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּמַהֵר הָאִשָּׁה וַתָּרץ וַתַּגֵּד לְאִישָׁהּ וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה נִרְאָה אֵלַי הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּא בַיּוֹם אֵלָי׃

english.text:
The woman ran in haste to tell her husband. She said to him, “The
man who came to me before has just appeared to me.”

translation.text: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me the other day.

verses.english:
The woman ran in haste to tell her husband. She said to him, “The
man who came to me before has just appeared to me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ מָנוֹחַ אַחֲרֵי אִשְׁתּוֹ וַיָּבֹא אֶל־הָאִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַאַתָּה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּרְתָּ אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה וַיֹּאמֶר אָנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ מָנוֹחַ אַחֲרֵי אִשְׁתּוֹ וַיָּבֹא אֶל־הָאִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַאַתָּה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּרְתָּ אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה וַיֹּאמֶר אָנִי׃

english.text:
Manoah promptly followed his wife. He came to the man and asked
him: “Are you the man who spoke to my wife?” “Yes,” he answered.

translation.text: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman? And he said, I am.

verses.english:
Manoah promptly followed his wife. He came to the man and asked
him: “Are you the man who spoke to my wife?” “Yes,” he answered.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ עַתָּה יָבֹא דְבָרֶיךָ מַה־יִּהְיֶה מִשְׁפַּט־הַנַּעַר וּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ עַתָּה יָבֹא דְבָרֶיךָ מַה־יִּהְיֶה מִשְׁפַּט־הַנַּעַר וּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ׃

english.text:
Then Manoah said, “May your words soon come true! What rules shall
be observed for the boy?”

translation.text: And Manoah said, Now let thy words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and how shall we do unto him?

verses.english:
Then Manoah said, “May your words soon come true! What rules shall
be observed for the boy?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶל־מָנוֹחַ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־אָמַרְתִּי אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה תִּשָּׁמֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶל־מָנוֹחַ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־אָמַרְתִּי אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה תִּשָּׁמֵר׃

english.text:
The angel of YHWH said to Manoah, “The woman must abstain from all
the things against which I warned her.

translation.text: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.

verses.english:
The angel of YHWH said to Manoah, “The woman must abstain from all
the things against which I warned her.

verses.hebrew: מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא מִגֶּפֶן הַיַּיִן לֹא תֹאכַל וְיַיִן וְשֵׁכָר אַל־תֵּשְׁתְּ וְכל־טֻמְאָה אַל־תֹּאכַל כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתִיהָ תִּשְׁמֹר׃

hebrew.text: מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא מִגֶּפֶן הַיַּיִן לֹא תֹאכַל וְיַיִן וְשֵׁכָר אַל־תֵּשְׁתְּ וְכל־טֻמְאָה אַל־תֹּאכַל כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתִיהָ תִּשְׁמֹר׃

english.text:
She must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, or drink
wine or other intoxicant, or eat anything unclean. She must
observe all that I commanded her.”

translation.text: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.

verses.english:
She must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, or drink
wine or other intoxicant, or eat anything unclean. She must
observe all that I commanded her.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ אֶל־מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה נַעְצְרָה־נָּא אוֹתָךְ וְנַעֲשֶׂה לְפָנֶיךָ גְּדִי עִזִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ אֶל־מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה נַעְצְרָה־נָּא אוֹתָךְ וְנַעֲשֶׂה לְפָנֶיךָ גְּדִי עִזִּים׃

english.text:
Manoah said to the angel of YHWH, “Let us detain you and prepare a
kid for you.”

translation.text: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.

verses.english:
Manoah said to the angel of YHWH, “Let us detain you and prepare a
kid for you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶל־מָנוֹחַ אִם־תַּעְצְרֵנִי לֹא־אֹכַל בְּלַחְמֶךָ וְאִם־תַּעֲשֶׂה עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה תַּעֲלֶנָּה כִּי לֹא־יָדַע מָנוֹחַ כִּי־מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶל־מָנוֹחַ אִם־תַּעְצְרֵנִי לֹא־אֹכַל בְּלַחְמֶךָ וְאִם־תַּעֲשֶׂה עֹלָה לַיהֹוָה תַּעֲלֶנָּה כִּי לֹא־יָדַע מָנוֹחַ כִּי־מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הוּא׃

english.text:
But the angel of YHWH said to Manoah, “If you detain me, I shall
not eat your food; and if you present a burnt offering, offer it
to YHWH.”—For Manoah did not know that he was an angel of YHWH.

translation.text: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Though thou detain me, I will not eat of thy bread: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering, thou must offer it unto the LORD. For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the LORD.

verses.english:
But the angel of YHWH said to Manoah, “If you detain me, I shall
not eat your food; and if you present a burnt offering, offer it
to YHWH.”—For Manoah did not know that he was an angel of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ אֶל־מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה מִי שְׁמֶךָ כִּי־יָבֹא (דבריך) [דְבָרְךָ] וְכִבַּדְנוּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ אֶל־מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה מִי שְׁמֶךָ כִּי־יָבֹא (דבריך) [דְבָרְךָ] וְכִבַּדְנוּךָ׃

english.text:
So Manoah said to the angel of YHWH, “What is your name? We should
like to honor you when your words come true.”

translation.text: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, What is thy name, that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour?

verses.english:
So Manoah said to the angel of YHWH, “What is your name? We should
like to honor you when your words come true.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה לָמָּה זֶּה תִּשְׁאַל לִשְׁמִי וְהוּא־פֶלִאי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה לָמָּה זֶּה תִּשְׁאַל לִשְׁמִי וְהוּא־פֶלִאי׃

english.text:
The angel said to him, “You must not ask for my name; it is
unknowable!”

translation.text: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?

verses.english:
The angel said to him, “You must not ask for my name; it is
unknowable!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מָנוֹחַ אֶת־גְּדִי הָעִזִּים וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וַיַּעַל עַל־הַצּוּר לַיהֹוָה וּמַפְלִא לַעֲשׂוֹת וּמָנוֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ רֹאִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח מָנוֹחַ אֶת־גְּדִי הָעִזִּים וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וַיַּעַל עַל־הַצּוּר לַיהֹוָה וּמַפְלִא לַעֲשׂוֹת וּמָנוֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ רֹאִים׃

english.text:
Manoah took the kid and the meal offering and offered them up on
the rock to YHWH; and a marvelous thing happened while Manoah and
his wife looked on.

translation.text: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered it upon a rock unto the LORD: and the angel did wonderously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.

verses.english:
Manoah took the kid and the meal offering and offered them up on
the rock to YHWH; and a marvelous thing happened while Manoah and
his wife looked on.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַעֲלוֹת הַלַּהַב מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וַיַּעַל מַלְאַךְ־יְהֹוָה בְּלַהַב הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמָנוֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ רֹאִים וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַעֲלוֹת הַלַּהַב מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וַיַּעַל מַלְאַךְ־יְהֹוָה בְּלַהַב הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמָנוֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ רֹאִים וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
As the flames leaped up from the altar toward the sky, the angel
of YHWH ascended in the flames of the altar, while Manoah and his
wife looked on; and they flung themselves on their faces to the
ground.—

translation.text: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on it, and fell on their faces to the ground.

verses.english:
As the flames leaped up from the altar toward the sky, the angel
of YHWH ascended in the flames of the altar, while Manoah and his
wife looked on; and they flung themselves on their faces to the
ground.—

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יָסַף עוֹד מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה לְהֵרָאֹה אֶל־מָנוֹחַ וְאֶל־אִשְׁתּוֹ אָז יָדַע מָנוֹחַ כִּי־מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־יָסַף עוֹד מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה לְהֵרָאֹה אֶל־מָנוֹחַ וְאֶל־אִשְׁתּוֹ אָז יָדַע מָנוֹחַ כִּי־מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הוּא׃

english.text:
The angel of YHWH never appeared again to Manoah and his
wife.—Manoah then realized that it had been an angel of YHWH.

translation.text: But the angel of the LORD did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the LORD.

verses.english:
The angel of YHWH never appeared again to Manoah and his
wife.—Manoah then realized that it had been an angel of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ אֶל־אִשְׁתּוֹ מוֹת נָמוּת כִּי אֱלֹהִים רָאִינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ אֶל־אִשְׁתּוֹ מוֹת נָמוּת כִּי אֱלֹהִים רָאִינוּ׃

english.text:
And Manoah said to his wife, “We shall surely die, for we have
seen a divine being.”

translation.text: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.

verses.english:
And Manoah said to his wife, “We shall surely die, for we have
seen a divine being.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִשְׁתּוֹ לוּ חָפֵץ יְהֹוָה לַהֲמִיתֵנוּ לֹא־לָקַח מִיָּדֵנוּ עֹלָה וּמִנְחָה וְלֹא הֶרְאָנוּ אֶת־כּל־אֵלֶּה וְכָעֵת לֹא הִשְׁמִיעָנוּ כָּזֹאת׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִשְׁתּוֹ לוּ חָפֵץ יְהֹוָה לַהֲמִיתֵנוּ לֹא־לָקַח מִיָּדֵנוּ עֹלָה וּמִנְחָה וְלֹא הֶרְאָנוּ אֶת־כּל־אֵלֶּה וְכָעֵת לֹא הִשְׁמִיעָנוּ כָּזֹאת׃

english.text:
But his wife said to him, “Had YHWH meant to take our lives, He
would not have accepted a burnt offering and meal offering from
us, nor let us see all these things; and He would not have made
such an announcement to us.”

translation.text: But his wife said unto him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these things, nor would as at this time have told us such things as these.

verses.english:
But his wife said to him, “Had YHWH meant to take our lives, He
would not have accepted a burnt offering and meal offering from
us, nor let us see all these things; and He would not have made
such an announcement to us.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד הָאִשָּׁה בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּגְדַּל הַנַּעַר וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד הָאִשָּׁה בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּגְדַּל הַנַּעַר וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The woman bore a son, and she named him Samson. The boy grew up,
and YHWH blessed him.

translation.text: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.

verses.english:
The woman bore a son, and she named him Samson. The boy grew up,
and YHWH blessed him.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּחֶל רוּחַ יְהֹוָה לְפַעֲמוֹ בְּמַחֲנֵה־דָן בֵּין צרְעָה וּבֵין אֶשְׁתָּאֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּחֶל רוּחַ יְהֹוָה לְפַעֲמוֹ בְּמַחֲנֵה־דָן בֵּין צרְעָה וּבֵין אֶשְׁתָּאֹל׃

english.text:
The spirit of YHWH first moved him in the encampment of Dan,
between Zorah and Eshtaol.

translation.text: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.

verses.english:
The spirit of YHWH first moved him in the encampment of Dan,
between Zorah and Eshtaol.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד שִׁמְשׁוֹן תִּמְנָתָה וַיַּרְא אִשָּׁה בְּתִמְנָתָה מִבְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד שִׁמְשׁוֹן תִּמְנָתָה וַיַּרְא אִשָּׁה בְּתִמְנָתָה מִבְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
Once Samson went down to Timnah; and while in Timnah, he noticed a
girl among the Philistine women.

translation.text: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.

verses.english:
Once Samson went down to Timnah; and while in Timnah, he noticed a
girl among the Philistine women.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל וַיַּגֵּד לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אִשָּׁה רָאִיתִי בְתִמְנָתָה מִבְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְעַתָּה קְחוּ־אוֹתָהּ לִי לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל וַיַּגֵּד לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אִשָּׁה רָאִיתִי בְתִמְנָתָה מִבְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְעַתָּה קְחוּ־אוֹתָהּ לִי לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
On his return, he told his father and mother, “I noticed one of
the Philistine women in Timnah; please get her for me as a wife.”

translation.text: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.

verses.english:
On his return, he told his father and mother, “I noticed one of
the Philistine women in Timnah; please get her for me as a wife.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ הַאֵין בִּבְנוֹת אַחֶיךָ וּבְכל־עַמִּי אִשָּׁה כִּי־אַתָּה הוֹלֵךְ לָקַחַת אִשָּׁה מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים הָעֲרֵלִים וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶל־אָבִיו אוֹתָהּ
קַח־לִי כִּי־הִיא יָשְׁרָה בְעֵינָי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ הַאֵין בִּבְנוֹת אַחֶיךָ וּבְכל־עַמִּי אִשָּׁה כִּי־אַתָּה הוֹלֵךְ לָקַחַת אִשָּׁה מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים הָעֲרֵלִים וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶל־אָבִיו אוֹתָהּ
קַח־לִי כִּי־הִיא יָשְׁרָה בְעֵינָי׃

english.text:
His father and mother said to him, “Is there no one among the
daughters of your own kinsmen and among all our people, that you
must go and take a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines?” But
Samson answered his father, “Get me that one, for she is the one
that pleases me.”

translation.text: Then his father and his mother said unto him, Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.

verses.english:
His father and mother said to him, “Is there no one among the
daughters of your own kinsmen and among all our people, that you
must go and take a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines?” But
Samson answered his father, “Get me that one, for she is the one
that pleases me.”

verses.hebrew: וְאָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ לֹא יָדְעוּ כִּי מֵיְהֹוָה הִיא כִּי־תֹאֲנָה הוּא־מְבַקֵּשׁ מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים וּבָעֵת הַהִיא פְּלִשְׁתִּים מֹשְׁלִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ לֹא יָדְעוּ כִּי מֵיְהֹוָה הִיא כִּי־תֹאֲנָה הוּא־מְבַקֵּשׁ מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים וּבָעֵת הַהִיא פְּלִשְׁתִּים מֹשְׁלִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
His father and mother did not realize that this was YHWH’s doing:
He was seeking a pretext against the Philistines, for the
Philistines were ruling over Israel at that time.

translation.text: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the LORD, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.

verses.english:
His father and mother did not realize that this was YHWH’s doing:
He was seeking a pretext against the Philistines, for the
Philistines were ruling over Israel at that time.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד שִׁמְשׁוֹן וְאָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ תִּמְנָתָה וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־כַּרְמֵי תִמְנָתָה וְהִנֵּה כְּפִיר אֲרָיוֹת שֹׁאֵג לִקְרָאתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד שִׁמְשׁוֹן וְאָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ תִּמְנָתָה וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־כַּרְמֵי תִמְנָתָה וְהִנֵּה כְּפִיר אֲרָיוֹת שֹׁאֵג לִקְרָאתוֹ׃

english.text:
So Samson and his father and mother went down to Timnah. When he
came to the vineyards of Timnah [for the first time], a full-grown
lion came roaring at him.

translation.text: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.

verses.english:
So Samson and his father and mother went down to Timnah. When he
came to the vineyards of Timnah [for the first time], a full-grown
lion came roaring at him.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וַיְשַׁסְּעֵהוּ כְּשַׁסַּע הַגְּדִי וּמְאוּמָה אֵין בְּיָדוֹ וְלֹא הִגִּיד לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וַיְשַׁסְּעֵהוּ כְּשַׁסַּע הַגְּדִי וּמְאוּמָה אֵין בְּיָדוֹ וְלֹא הִגִּיד לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

english.text:
The spirit of YHWH gripped him, and he tore him asunder with his
bare hands as one might tear a kid asunder; but he did not tell
his father and mother what he had done.

translation.text: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.

verses.english:
The spirit of YHWH gripped him, and he tore him asunder with his
bare hands as one might tear a kid asunder; but he did not tell
his father and mother what he had done.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד וַיְדַבֵּר לָאִשָּׁה וַתִּישַׁר בְּעֵינֵי שִׁמְשׁוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד וַיְדַבֵּר לָאִשָּׁה וַתִּישַׁר בְּעֵינֵי שִׁמְשׁוֹן׃

english.text: Then he went down and spoke to the woman, and she pleased Samson.

translation.text: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.

verses.english: Then he went down and spoke to the woman, and she pleased Samson.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב מִיָּמִים לְקַחְתָּהּ וַיָּסַר לִרְאוֹת אֵת מַפֶּלֶת הָאַרְיֵה וְהִנֵּה עֲדַת דְּבוֹרִים בִּגְוִיַּת הָאַרְיֵה וּדְבָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב מִיָּמִים לְקַחְתָּהּ וַיָּסַר לִרְאוֹת אֵת מַפֶּלֶת הָאַרְיֵה וְהִנֵּה עֲדַת דְּבוֹרִים בִּגְוִיַּת הָאַרְיֵה וּדְבָשׁ׃

english.text:
Returning the following year to marry her, he turned aside to look
at the remains of the lion; and in the lion’s skeleton he found a
swarm of bees, and honey.

translation.text: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.

verses.english:
Returning the following year to marry her, he turned aside to look
at the remains of the lion; and in the lion’s skeleton he found a
swarm of bees, and honey.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדֵּהוּ אֶל־כַּפָּיו וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וְאָכֹל וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־אָבִיו וְאֶל־אִמּוֹ וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם וַיֹּאכֵלוּ וְלֹא־הִגִּיד לָהֶם כִּי מִגְּוִיַּת הָאַרְיֵה רָדָה הַדְּבָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְדֵּהוּ אֶל־כַּפָּיו וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וְאָכֹל וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־אָבִיו וְאֶל־אִמּוֹ וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם וַיֹּאכֵלוּ וְלֹא־הִגִּיד לָהֶם כִּי מִגְּוִיַּת הָאַרְיֵה רָדָה הַדְּבָשׁ׃

english.text:
He scooped it into his palms and ate it as he went along. When he
rejoined his father and mother, he gave them some and they ate it;
but he did not tell them that he had scooped the honey out of a
lion’s skeleton.

translation.text: And he took thereof in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they did eat: but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.

verses.english:
He scooped it into his palms and ate it as he went along. When he
rejoined his father and mother, he gave them some and they ate it;
but he did not tell them that he had scooped the honey out of a
lion’s skeleton.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד אָבִיהוּ אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה וַיַּעַשׂ שָׁם שִׁמְשׁוֹן מִשְׁתֶּה כִּי כֵּן יַעֲשׂוּ הַבַּחוּרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד אָבִיהוּ אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה וַיַּעַשׂ שָׁם שִׁמְשׁוֹן מִשְׁתֶּה כִּי כֵּן יַעֲשׂוּ הַבַּחוּרִים׃

english.text:
So his father came down to the woman, and Samson made a feast
there, as young men used to do.

translation.text: So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.

verses.english:
So his father came down to the woman, and Samson made a feast
there, as young men used to do.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹתָם אוֹתוֹ וַיִּקְחוּ שְׁלֹשִׁים מֵרֵעִים וַיִּהְיוּ אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹתָם אוֹתוֹ וַיִּקְחוּ שְׁלֹשִׁים מֵרֵעִים וַיִּהְיוּ אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
When they saw him, they designated thirty companions to be with
him.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.

verses.english:
When they saw him, they designated thirty companions to be with
him.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן אָחוּדָה־נָּא לָכֶם חִידָה אִם־הַגֵּד תַּגִּידוּ אוֹתָהּ לִי שִׁבְעַת יְמֵי הַמִּשְׁתֶּה וּמְצָאתֶם וְנָתַתִּי לָכֶם שְׁלֹשִׁים סְדִינִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים
חֲלִפֹת בְּגָדִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן אָחוּדָה־נָּא לָכֶם חִידָה אִם־הַגֵּד תַּגִּידוּ אוֹתָהּ לִי שִׁבְעַת יְמֵי הַמִּשְׁתֶּה וּמְצָאתֶם וְנָתַתִּי לָכֶם שְׁלֹשִׁים סְדִינִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים
חֲלִפֹת בְּגָדִים׃

translation.text: And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if ye can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא תוּכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד לִי וּנְתַתֶּם אַתֶּם לִי שְׁלֹשִׁים סְדִינִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים חֲלִיפוֹת בְּגָדִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ חוּדָה חִידָתְךָ וְנִשְׁמָעֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־לֹא תוּכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד לִי וּנְתַתֶּם אַתֶּם לִי שְׁלֹשִׁים סְדִינִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים חֲלִיפוֹת בְּגָדִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ חוּדָה חִידָתְךָ וְנִשְׁמָעֶנָּה׃

english.text:
but if you are not able to tell it to me, you must give me thirty
linen tunics and thirty sets of clothing.” And they said to him,
“Ask your riddle and we will listen.”

translation.text: But if ye cannot declare it me, then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments. And they said unto him, Put forth thy riddle, that we may hear it.

verses.english:
but if you are not able to tell it to me, you must give me thirty
linen tunics and thirty sets of clothing.” And they said to him,
“Ask your riddle and we will listen.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם מֵהָאֹכֵל יָצָא מַאֲכָל וּמֵעַז יָצָא מָתוֹק וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד הַחִידָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם מֵהָאֹכֵל יָצָא מַאֲכָל וּמֵעַז יָצָא מָתוֹק וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד הַחִידָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים׃

english.text:
So he said to them: “Out of the eater came something to eat, Out
of the strong came something sweet.” For three days they could not
answer the riddle.

translation.text: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.

verses.english:
So he said to them: “Out of the eater came something to eat, Out
of the strong came something sweet.” For three days they could not
answer the riddle.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְאֵשֶׁת־שִׁמְשׁוֹן פַּתִּי אֶת־אִישֵׁךְ וְיַגֶּד־לָנוּ אֶת־הַחִידָה פֶּן־נִשְׂרֹף אוֹתָךְ וְאֶת־בֵּית אָבִיךְ בָּאֵשׁ הַלְירְשֵׁנוּ
קְרָאתֶם לָנוּ הֲלֹא׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְאֵשֶׁת־שִׁמְשׁוֹן פַּתִּי אֶת־אִישֵׁךְ וְיַגֶּד־לָנוּ אֶת־הַחִידָה פֶּן־נִשְׂרֹף אוֹתָךְ וְאֶת־בֵּית אָבִיךְ בָּאֵשׁ הַלְירְשֵׁנוּ
קְרָאתֶם לָנוּ הֲלֹא׃

english.text:
On the seventh day, they said to Samson’s wife, “Coax your husband
to provide us with the answer to the riddle; else we shall put you
and your father’s household to the fire; have you invited us here
in order to impoverish us?”

translation.text: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said unto Samson’s wife, Entice thy husband, that he may declare unto us the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father’s house with fire: have ye called us to take that we have? is it not so?

verses.english:
On the seventh day, they said to Samson’s wife, “Coax your husband
to provide us with the answer to the riddle; else we shall put you
and your father’s household to the fire; have you invited us here
in order to impoverish us?”

verses.hebrew:
וַתֵּבְךְּ אֵשֶׁת שִׁמְשׁוֹן עָלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר רַק־שְׂנֵאתַנִי וְלֹא אֲהַבְתָּנִי הַחִידָה חַדְתָּ לִבְנֵי עַמִּי וְלִי לֹא הִגַּדְתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ הִנֵּה לְאָבִי וּלְאִמִּי לֹא
הִגַּדְתִּי וְלָךְ אַגִּיד׃

hebrew.text:
וַתֵּבְךְּ אֵשֶׁת שִׁמְשׁוֹן עָלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר רַק־שְׂנֵאתַנִי וְלֹא אֲהַבְתָּנִי הַחִידָה חַדְתָּ לִבְנֵי עַמִּי וְלִי לֹא הִגַּדְתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ הִנֵּה לְאָבִי וּלְאִמִּי לֹא
הִגַּדְתִּי וְלָךְ אַגִּיד׃

english.text:
Then Samson’s wife harassed him with tears, and she said, “You
really hate me, you don’t love me. You asked my countrymen a
riddle, and you didn’t tell me the answer.” He replied, “I haven’t
even told my father and mother; shall I tell you?”

translation.text: And Samson’s wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not: thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people, and hast not told it me. And he said unto her, Behold, I have not told it my father nor my mother, and shall I tell it thee?

verses.english:
Then Samson’s wife harassed him with tears, and she said, “You
really hate me, you don’t love me. You asked my countrymen a
riddle, and you didn’t tell me the answer.” He replied, “I haven’t
even told my father and mother; shall I tell you?”

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּבְךְּ עָלָיו שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר־הָיָה לָהֶם הַמִּשְׁתֶּה וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיַּגֶּד־לָהּ כִּי הֱצִיקַתְהוּ וַתַּגֵּד הַחִידָה לִבְנֵי עַמָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּבְךְּ עָלָיו שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר־הָיָה לָהֶם הַמִּשְׁתֶּה וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיַּגֶּד־לָהּ כִּי הֱצִיקַתְהוּ וַתַּגֵּד הַחִידָה לִבְנֵי עַמָּהּ׃

english.text:
During the rest of the seven days of the feast she continued to
harass him with her tears, and on the seventh day he told her,
because she nagged him so. And she explained the riddle to her
countrymen.

translation.text: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she lay sore upon him: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.

verses.english:
During the rest of the seven days of the feast she continued to
harass him with her tears, and on the seventh day he told her,
because she nagged him so. And she explained the riddle to her
countrymen.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּטֶרֶם יָבֹא הַחַרְסָה מַה־מָּתוֹק מִדְּבַשׁ וּמֶה עַז מֵאֲרִי וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לוּלֵא חֲרַשְׁתֶּם בְּעֶגְלָתִי לֹא מְצָאתֶם
חִידָתִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּטֶרֶם יָבֹא הַחַרְסָה מַה־מָּתוֹק מִדְּבַשׁ וּמֶה עַז מֵאֲרִי וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לוּלֵא חֲרַשְׁתֶּם בְּעֶגְלָתִי לֹא מְצָאתֶם
חִידָתִי׃

english.text:
On the seventh day, before the sunset, the townsmen said to him:
“What is sweeter than honey, And what is stronger than a lion?” He
responded: “Had you not plowed with my heifer, You would not have
guessed my riddle!”

translation.text: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What is sweeter than honey? And what is stronger than a lion? and he said unto them, If ye had not plowed with my heifer, ye had not found out my riddle.

verses.english:
On the seventh day, before the sunset, the townsmen said to him:
“What is sweeter than honey, And what is stronger than a lion?” He
responded: “Had you not plowed with my heifer, You would not have
guessed my riddle!”

verses.hebrew:
וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וַיֵּרֶד אַשְׁקְלוֹן וַיַּךְ מֵהֶם שְׁלֹשִׁים אִישׁ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־חֲלִיצוֹתָם וַיִּתֵּן הַחֲלִיפוֹת לְמַגִּידֵי הַחִידָה וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ וַיַּעַל
בֵּית אָבִיהוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וַיֵּרֶד אַשְׁקְלוֹן וַיַּךְ מֵהֶם שְׁלֹשִׁים אִישׁ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־חֲלִיצוֹתָם וַיִּתֵּן הַחֲלִיפוֹת לְמַגִּידֵי הַחִידָה וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ וַיַּעַל
בֵּית אָבִיהוּ׃

english.text:
The spirit of YHWH gripped him. He went down to Ashkelon and
killed thirty of its men. He stripped them and gave the sets of
clothing to those who had answered the riddle. And he left in a
rage for his father’s house.

translation.text: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father’s house.

verses.english:
The spirit of YHWH gripped him. He went down to Ashkelon and
killed thirty of its men. He stripped them and gave the sets of
clothing to those who had answered the riddle. And he left in a
rage for his father’s house.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי אֵשֶׁת שִׁמְשׁוֹן לְמֵרֵעֵהוּ אֲשֶׁר רֵעָה לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי אֵשֶׁת שִׁמְשׁוֹן לְמֵרֵעֵהוּ אֲשֶׁר רֵעָה לוֹ׃

english.text:
Samson’s wife then married one of those who had been his wedding
companions.

translation.text: But Samson’s wife was given to his companion, whom he had used as his friend.

verses.english:
Samson’s wife then married one of those who had been his wedding
companions.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִיָּמִים בִּימֵי קְצִיר־חִטִּים וַיִּפְקֹד שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ בִּגְדִי עִזִּים וַיֹּאמֶר אָבֹאָה אֶל־אִשְׁתִּי הֶחָדְרָה וְלֹא־נְתָנוֹ אָבִיהָ לָבוֹא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִיָּמִים בִּימֵי קְצִיר־חִטִּים וַיִּפְקֹד שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ בִּגְדִי עִזִּים וַיֹּאמֶר אָבֹאָה אֶל־אִשְׁתִּי הֶחָדְרָה וְלֹא־נְתָנוֹ אָבִיהָ לָבוֹא׃

english.text:
Some time later, in the season of the wheat harvest, Samson came
to visit his wife, bringing a kid as a gift. He said, “Let me go
into the chamber to my wife.” But her father would not let him go
in.

translation.text: But it came to pass within a while after, in the time of wheat harvest, that Samson visited his wife with a kid; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber. But her father would not suffer him to go in.

verses.english:
Some time later, in the season of the wheat harvest, Samson came
to visit his wife, bringing a kid as a gift. He said, “Let me go
into the chamber to my wife.” But her father would not let him go
in.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִיהָ אָמֹר אָמַרְתִּי כִּי־שָׂנֹא שְׂנֵאתָהּ וָאֶתְּנֶנָּה לְמֵרֵעֶךָ הֲלֹא אֲחוֹתָהּ הַקְּטַנָּה טוֹבָה מִמֶּנָּה תְּהִי־נָא לְךָ תַּחְתֶּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִיהָ אָמֹר אָמַרְתִּי כִּי־שָׂנֹא שְׂנֵאתָהּ וָאֶתְּנֶנָּה לְמֵרֵעֶךָ הֲלֹא אֲחוֹתָהּ הַקְּטַנָּה טוֹבָה מִמֶּנָּה תְּהִי־נָא לְךָ תַּחְתֶּיהָ׃

english.text:
“I was sure,” said her father, “that you had taken a dislike to
her, so I gave her to your wedding companion. But her younger
sister is more beautiful than she; let her become your wife
instead.”

translation.text: And her father said, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to thy companion: is not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.

verses.english:
“I was sure,” said her father, “that you had taken a dislike to
her, so I gave her to your wedding companion. But her younger
sister is more beautiful than she; let her become your wife
instead.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן נִקֵּיתִי הַפַּעַם מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי־עֹשֶׂה אֲנִי עִמָּם רָעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן נִקֵּיתִי הַפַּעַם מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי־עֹשֶׂה אֲנִי עִמָּם רָעָה׃

english.text:
Thereupon Samson declared, “Now the Philistines can have no claim
against me for the harm I shall do them.”
