translation.text: And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.

verses.english:
Thereupon Samson declared, “Now the Philistines can have no claim
against me for the harm I shall do them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּלְכֹּד שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת שׁוּעָלִים וַיִּקַּח לַפִּדִים וַיֶּפֶן זָנָב אֶל־זָנָב וַיָּשֶׂם לַפִּיד אֶחָד בֵּין־שְׁנֵי הַזְּנָבוֹת בַּתָּוֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּלְכֹּד שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת שׁוּעָלִים וַיִּקַּח לַפִּדִים וַיֶּפֶן זָנָב אֶל־זָנָב וַיָּשֶׂם לַפִּיד אֶחָד בֵּין־שְׁנֵי הַזְּנָבוֹת בַּתָּוֶךְ׃

english.text:
Samson went and caught three hundred foxes. He took torches and,
turning [the foxes] tail to tail, he placed a torch between each
pair of tails.

translation.text: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.

verses.english:
Samson went and caught three hundred foxes. He took torches and,
turning [the foxes] tail to tail, he placed a torch between each
pair of tails.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּבְעֶר־אֵשׁ בַּלַּפִּידִים וַיְשַׁלַּח בְּקָמוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּבְעֵר מִגָּדִישׁ וְעַד־קָמָה וְעַד־כֶּרֶם זָיִת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּבְעֶר־אֵשׁ בַּלַּפִּידִים וַיְשַׁלַּח בְּקָמוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּבְעֵר מִגָּדִישׁ וְעַד־קָמָה וְעַד־כֶּרֶם זָיִת׃

english.text:
He lit the torches and turned [the foxes] loose among the standing
grain of the Philistines, setting fire to stacked grain, standing
grain, vineyards, [and] olive trees.

translation.text: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives.

verses.english:
He lit the torches and turned [the foxes] loose among the standing
grain of the Philistines, setting fire to stacked grain, standing
grain, vineyards, [and] olive trees.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים מִי עָשָׂה זֹאת וַיֹּאמְרוּ שִׁמְשׁוֹן חֲתַן הַתִּמְנִי כִּי לָקַח אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וַיִּתְּנָהּ לְמֵרֵעֵהוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אוֹתָהּ
וְאֶת־אָבִיהָ בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים מִי עָשָׂה זֹאת וַיֹּאמְרוּ שִׁמְשׁוֹן חֲתַן הַתִּמְנִי כִּי לָקַח אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וַיִּתְּנָהּ לְמֵרֵעֵהוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אוֹתָהּ
וְאֶת־אָבִיהָ בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
The Philistines asked, “Who did this?” And they were told, “It was
Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, who took Samson’s wife and
gave her to his wedding companion.” Thereupon the Philistines came
up and put her and her father to the fire.

translation.text: Then the Philistines said, Who hath done this? And they answered, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife, and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up, and burnt her and her father with fire.

verses.english:
The Philistines asked, “Who did this?” And they were told, “It was
Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, who took Samson’s wife and
gave her to his wedding companion.” Thereupon the Philistines came
up and put her and her father to the fire.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן אִם־תַּעֲשׂוּן כָּזֹאת כִּי אִם־נִקַּמְתִּי בָכֶם וְאַחַר אֶחְדָּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן אִם־תַּעֲשׂוּן כָּזֹאת כִּי אִם־נִקַּמְתִּי בָכֶם וְאַחַר אֶחְדָּל׃

english.text:
Samson said to them, “If that is how you act, I will not rest
until I have taken revenge on you.”

translation.text: And Samson said unto them, Though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.

verses.english:
Samson said to them, “If that is how you act, I will not rest
until I have taken revenge on you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ אוֹתָם שׁוֹק עַל־יָרֵךְ מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה וַיֵּרֶד וַיֵּשֶׁב בִּסְעִיף סֶלַע עֵיטָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּךְ אוֹתָם שׁוֹק עַל־יָרֵךְ מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה וַיֵּרֶד וַיֵּשֶׁב בִּסְעִיף סֶלַע עֵיטָם׃

english.text:
He gave them a sound and thorough thrashing. Then he went down and
stayed in the cave of the rock of Etam.

translation.text: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.

verses.english:
He gave them a sound and thorough thrashing. Then he went down and
stayed in the cave of the rock of Etam.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּיהוּדָה וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בַּלֶּחִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּיהוּדָה וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בַּלֶּחִי׃

english.text:
The Philistines came up, pitched camp in Judah and spread out over
Lehi.

translation.text: Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.

verses.english:
The Philistines came up, pitched camp in Judah and spread out over
Lehi.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ יְהוּדָה לָמָה עֲלִיתֶם עָלֵינוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֶאֱסוֹר אֶת־שִׁמְשׁוֹן עָלִינוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת לוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ יְהוּדָה לָמָה עֲלִיתֶם עָלֵינוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֶאֱסוֹר אֶת־שִׁמְשׁוֹן עָלִינוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת לוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לָנוּ׃

english.text:
The men of Judah asked, “Why have you come up against us?” They
answered, “We have come to take Samson prisoner, and to do to him
as he did to us.”

translation.text: And the men of Judah said, Why are ye come up against us? And they answered, To bind Samson are we come up, to do to him as he hath done to us.

verses.english:
The men of Judah asked, “Why have you come up against us?” They
answered, “We have come to take Samson prisoner, and to do to him
as he did to us.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּרְדוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ מִיהוּדָה אֶל־סְעִיף סֶלַע עֵיטָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְשִׁמְשׁוֹן הֲלֹא יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־מֹשְׁלִים בָּנוּ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמַה־זֹּאת עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ
וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ לִי כֵּן עָשִׂיתִי לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּרְדוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ מִיהוּדָה אֶל־סְעִיף סֶלַע עֵיטָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְשִׁמְשׁוֹן הֲלֹא יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־מֹשְׁלִים בָּנוּ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמַה־זֹּאת עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ
וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ לִי כֵּן עָשִׂיתִי לָהֶם׃

english.text:
Thereupon three thousand men of Judah went down to the cave of the
rock of Etam, and they said to Samson, “You knew that the
Philistines rule over us; why have you done this to us?” He
replied, “As they did to me, so I did to them.”

translation.text: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines are rulers over us? what is this that thou hast done unto us? And he said unto them, As they did unto me, so have I done unto them.

verses.english:
Thereupon three thousand men of Judah went down to the cave of the
rock of Etam, and they said to Samson, “You knew that the
Philistines rule over us; why have you done this to us?” He
replied, “As they did to me, so I did to them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ לֶאֱסרְךָ יָרַדְנוּ לְתִתְּךָ בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן הִשָּׁבְעוּ לִי פֶּן־תִּפְגְּעוּן בִּי אַתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ לֶאֱסרְךָ יָרַדְנוּ לְתִתְּךָ בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן הִשָּׁבְעוּ לִי פֶּן־תִּפְגְּעוּן בִּי אַתֶּם׃

english.text:
“We have come down,” they told him, “to take you prisoner and to
hand you over to the Philistines.” “But swear to me,” said Samson
to them, “that you yourselves will not attack me.”

translation.text: And they said unto him, We are come down to bind thee, that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines. And Samson said unto them, Swear unto me, that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.

verses.english:
“We have come down,” they told him, “to take you prisoner and to
hand you over to the Philistines.” “But swear to me,” said Samson
to them, “that you yourselves will not attack me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא כִּי־אָסֹר נֶאֱסרְךָ וּנְתַנּוּךָ בְיָדָם וְהָמֵת לֹא נְמִיתֶךָ וַיַּאַסְרֻהוּ בִּשְׁנַיִם עֲבֹתִים חֲדָשִׁים וַיַּעֲלוּהוּ מִן־הַסָּלַע׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא כִּי־אָסֹר נֶאֱסרְךָ וּנְתַנּוּךָ בְיָדָם וְהָמֵת לֹא נְמִיתֶךָ וַיַּאַסְרֻהוּ בִּשְׁנַיִם עֲבֹתִים חֲדָשִׁים וַיַּעֲלוּהוּ מִן־הַסָּלַע׃

english.text:
“We won’t,” they replied. “We will only take you prisoner and hand
you over to them; we will not slay you.” So they bound him with
two new ropes and brought him up from the rock.

translation.text: And they spake unto him, saying, No; but we will bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand: but surely we will not kill thee. And they bound him with two new cords, and brought him up from the rock.

verses.english:
“We won’t,” they replied. “We will only take you prisoner and hand
you over to them; we will not slay you.” So they bound him with
two new ropes and brought him up from the rock.

verses.hebrew:
הוּא־בָא עַד־לֶחִי וּפְלִשְׁתִּים הֵרִיעוּ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וַתִּהְיֶינָה הָעֲבֹתִים אֲשֶׁר עַל־זְרוֹעוֹתָיו כַּפִּשְׁתִּים אֲשֶׁר בָּעֲרוּ בָאֵשׁ
וַיִּמַּסּוּ אֱסוּרָיו מֵעַל יָדָיו׃

hebrew.text:
הוּא־בָא עַד־לֶחִי וּפְלִשְׁתִּים הֵרִיעוּ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וַתִּהְיֶינָה הָעֲבֹתִים אֲשֶׁר עַל־זְרוֹעוֹתָיו כַּפִּשְׁתִּים אֲשֶׁר בָּעֲרוּ בָאֵשׁ
וַיִּמַּסּוּ אֱסוּרָיו מֵעַל יָדָיו׃

english.text:
When he reached Lehi, the Philistines came shouting to meet him.
Thereupon the spirit of YHWH gripped him, and the ropes on his
arms became like flax that catches fire; the bonds melted off his
hands.

translation.text: And when he came unto Lehi, the Philistines shouted against him: and the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and the cords that were upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.

verses.english:
When he reached Lehi, the Philistines came shouting to meet him.
Thereupon the spirit of YHWH gripped him, and the ropes on his
arms became like flax that catches fire; the bonds melted off his
hands.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצָא לְחִי־חֲמוֹר טְרִיָּה וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַיַּךְ־בָּהּ אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְצָא לְחִי־חֲמוֹר טְרִיָּה וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַיַּךְ־בָּהּ אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

english.text:
He came upon a fresh jawbone of an ass and he picked it up; and
with it he killed a thousand men.

translation.text: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.

verses.english:
He came upon a fresh jawbone of an ass and he picked it up; and
with it he killed a thousand men.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן בִּלְחִי הַחֲמוֹר חֲמוֹר חֲמֹרָתָיִם בִּלְחִי הַחֲמוֹר הִכֵּיתִי אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן בִּלְחִי הַחֲמוֹר חֲמוֹר חֲמֹרָתָיִם בִּלְחִי הַחֲמוֹר הִכֵּיתִי אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

english.text:
Then Samson said: “With the jaw of an ass, Mass upon mass! With
the jaw of an ass I have slain a thousand men.”

translation.text: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.

verses.english:
Then Samson said: “With the jaw of an ass, Mass upon mass! With
the jaw of an ass I have slain a thousand men.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ הַלְּחִי מִיָּדוֹ וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא רָמַת לֶחִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ הַלְּחִי מִיָּדוֹ וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא רָמַת לֶחִי׃

english.text:
As he finished speaking, he threw the jawbone away; hence that
place was called Ramath-lehi.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramathlehi.

verses.english:
As he finished speaking, he threw the jawbone away; hence that
place was called Ramath-lehi.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְמָא מְאֹד וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר אַתָּה נָתַתָּ בְיַד־עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־הַתְּשׁוּעָה הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת וְעַתָּה אָמוּת בַּצָּמָא וְנָפַלְתִּי בְּיַד הָעֲרֵלִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצְמָא מְאֹד וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר אַתָּה נָתַתָּ בְיַד־עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־הַתְּשׁוּעָה הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת וְעַתָּה אָמוּת בַּצָּמָא וְנָפַלְתִּי בְּיַד הָעֲרֵלִים׃

english.text:
He was very thirsty and he called to YHWH, “You Yourself have
granted this great victory through Your servant; and must I now
die of thirst and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?”

translation.text: And he was sore athirst, and called on the LORD, and said, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant: and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?

verses.english:
He was very thirsty and he called to YHWH, “You Yourself have
granted this great victory through Your servant; and must I now
die of thirst and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּבְקַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת־הַמַּכְתֵּשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בַּלֶּחִי וַיֵּצְאוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מַיִם וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַתָּשׁב רוּחוֹ וַיֶּחִי עַל־כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמָהּ עֵין הַקּוֹרֵא אֲשֶׁר בַּלֶּחִי עַד
הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּבְקַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת־הַמַּכְתֵּשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בַּלֶּחִי וַיֵּצְאוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מַיִם וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַתָּשׁב רוּחוֹ וַיֶּחִי עַל־כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמָהּ עֵין הַקּוֹרֵא אֲשֶׁר בַּלֶּחִי עַד
הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
So God split open the hollow which is at Lehi, and the water
gushed out of it; he drank, regained his strength, and revived.
That is why it is called to this day “En-hakkore of Lehi.”

translation.text: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof Enhakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.

verses.english:
So God split open the hollow which is at Lehi, and the water
gushed out of it; he drank, regained his strength, and revived.
That is why it is called to this day “En-hakkore of Lehi.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּימֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּימֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text: He led Israel in the days of the Philistines for twenty years.

translation.text: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.

verses.english: He led Israel in the days of the Philistines for twenty years.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ שִׁמְשׁוֹן עַזָּתָה וַיַּרְא־שָׁם אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ שִׁמְשׁוֹן עַזָּתָה וַיַּרְא־שָׁם אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ׃

english.text: Once Samson went to Gaza; there he met a whore and slept with her.

translation.text: Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto her.

verses.english: Once Samson went to Gaza; there he met a whore and slept with her.

verses.hebrew: לַעַזָּתִים לֵאמֹר בָּא שִׁמְשׁוֹן הֵנָּה וַיָּסֹבּוּ וַיֶּאֶרְבוּ־לוֹ כל־הַלַּיְלָה בְּשַׁעַר הָעִיר וַיִּתְחָרְשׁוּ כל־הַלַּיְלָה לֵאמֹר עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר וַהֲרַגְנֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: לַעַזָּתִים לֵאמֹר בָּא שִׁמְשׁוֹן הֵנָּה וַיָּסֹבּוּ וַיֶּאֶרְבוּ־לוֹ כל־הַלַּיְלָה בְּשַׁעַר הָעִיר וַיִּתְחָרְשׁוּ כל־הַלַּיְלָה לֵאמֹר עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר וַהֲרַגְנֻהוּ׃

english.text:
The Gazites [learned] that Samson had come there, so they gathered
and lay in ambush for him in the town gate the whole night; and
all night long they kept whispering to each other, “When daylight
comes, we’ll kill him.”

translation.text: And it was told the Gazites, saying, Samson is come hither. And they compassed him in, and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, In the morning, when it is day, we shall kill him.

verses.english:
The Gazites [learned] that Samson had come there, so they gathered
and lay in ambush for him in the town gate the whole night; and
all night long they kept whispering to each other, “When daylight
comes, we’ll kill him.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁכַּב שִׁמְשׁוֹן עַד־חֲצִי הַלַּיְלָה וַיָּקם בַּחֲצִי הַלַּיְלָה וַיֶּאֱחֹז בְּדַלְתוֹת שַׁעַר־הָעִיר וּבִשְׁתֵּי הַמְּזֻזוֹת וַיִּסָּעֵם עִם־הַבְּרִיחַ וַיָּשֶׂם
עַל־כְּתֵפָיו וַיַּעֲלֵם אֶל־רֹאשׁ הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי חֶבְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁכַּב שִׁמְשׁוֹן עַד־חֲצִי הַלַּיְלָה וַיָּקם בַּחֲצִי הַלַּיְלָה וַיֶּאֱחֹז בְּדַלְתוֹת שַׁעַר־הָעִיר וּבִשְׁתֵּי הַמְּזֻזוֹת וַיִּסָּעֵם עִם־הַבְּרִיחַ וַיָּשֶׂם
עַל־כְּתֵפָיו וַיַּעֲלֵם אֶל־רֹאשׁ הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי חֶבְרוֹן׃

english.text:
But Samson lay in bed only till midnight. At midnight he got up,
grasped the doors of the town gate together with the two
gateposts, and pulled them out along with the bar. He placed them
on his shoulders and carried them off to the top of the hill that
is near Hebron.

translation.text: And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took the doors of the gate of the city, and the two posts, and went away with them, bar and all, and put them upon his shoulders, and carried them up to the top of an hill that is before Hebron.

verses.english:
But Samson lay in bed only till midnight. At midnight he got up,
grasped the doors of the town gate together with the two
gateposts, and pulled them out along with the bar. He placed them
on his shoulders and carried them off to the top of the hill that
is near Hebron.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיֶּאֱהַב אִשָּׁה בְּנַחַל שֹׂרֵק וּשְׁמָהּ דְּלִילָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיֶּאֱהַב אִשָּׁה בְּנַחַל שֹׂרֵק וּשְׁמָהּ דְּלִילָה׃

english.text:
After that, he fell in love with a woman in the Wadi Sorek, named
Delilah.

translation.text: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

verses.english:
After that, he fell in love with a woman in the Wadi Sorek, named
Delilah.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲלוּ אֵלֶיהָ סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהּ פַּתִּי אוֹתוֹ וּרְאִי בַּמֶּה כֹּחוֹ גָדוֹל וּבַמֶּה נוּכַל לוֹ וַאֲסַרְנוּהוּ לְעַנּוֹתוֹ וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִתַּן־לָךְ אִישׁ
אֶלֶף וּמֵאָה כָּסֶף׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲלוּ אֵלֶיהָ סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהּ פַּתִּי אוֹתוֹ וּרְאִי בַּמֶּה כֹּחוֹ גָדוֹל וּבַמֶּה נוּכַל לוֹ וַאֲסַרְנוּהוּ לְעַנּוֹתוֹ וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִתַּן־לָךְ אִישׁ
אֶלֶף וּמֵאָה כָּסֶף׃

english.text:
The lords of the Philistines went up to her and said, “Coax him
and find out what makes him so strong, and how we can overpower
him, tie him up, and make him helpless; and we’ll each give you
eleven hundred shekels of silver.”

translation.text: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and said unto her, Entice him, and see wherein his great strength lieth, and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him; and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver.

verses.english:
The lords of the Philistines went up to her and said, “Coax him
and find out what makes him so strong, and how we can overpower
him, tie him up, and make him helpless; and we’ll each give you
eleven hundred shekels of silver.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר דְּלִילָה אֶל־שִׁמְשׁוֹן הַגִּידָה־נָּא לִי בַּמֶּה כֹּחֲךָ גָדוֹל וּבַמֶּה תֵאָסֵר לְעַנּוֹתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר דְּלִילָה אֶל־שִׁמְשׁוֹן הַגִּידָה־נָּא לִי בַּמֶּה כֹּחֲךָ גָדוֹל וּבַמֶּה תֵאָסֵר לְעַנּוֹתֶךָ׃

english.text:
So Delilah said to Samson, “Tell me, what makes you so strong? And
how could you be tied up and made helpless?”

translation.text: And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth, and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.

verses.english:
So Delilah said to Samson, “Tell me, what makes you so strong? And
how could you be tied up and made helpless?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן אִם־יַאַסְרֻנִי בְּשִׁבְעָה יְתָרִים לַחִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חֹרָבוּ וְחָלִיתִי וְהָיִיתִי כְּאַחַד הָאָדָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן אִם־יַאַסְרֻנִי בְּשִׁבְעָה יְתָרִים לַחִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חֹרָבוּ וְחָלִיתִי וְהָיִיתִי כְּאַחַד הָאָדָם׃

english.text:
Samson replied, “If I were to be tied with seven fresh tendons
that had not been dried, I should become as weak as an ordinary
man.”

translation.text: And Samson said unto her, If they bind me with seven green withs that were never dried, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

verses.english:
Samson replied, “If I were to be tied with seven fresh tendons
that had not been dried, I should become as weak as an ordinary
man.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ־לָהּ סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים שִׁבְעָה יְתָרִים לַחִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חֹרָבוּ וַתַּאַסְרֵהוּ בָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ־לָהּ סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים שִׁבְעָה יְתָרִים לַחִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חֹרָבוּ וַתַּאַסְרֵהוּ בָּהֶם׃

english.text:
So the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven fresh
tendons that had not been dried. She bound him with them,

translation.text: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

verses.english:
So the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven fresh
tendons that had not been dried. She bound him with them,

verses.hebrew:
וְהָאֹרֵב יֹשֵׁב לָהּ בַּחֶדֶר וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיְנַתֵּק אֶת־הַיְתָרִים כַּאֲשֶׁר יִנָּתֵק פְּתִיל־הַנְּעֹרֶת בַּהֲרִיחוֹ אֵשׁ וְלֹא נוֹדַע
כֹּחוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְהָאֹרֵב יֹשֵׁב לָהּ בַּחֶדֶר וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיְנַתֵּק אֶת־הַיְתָרִים כַּאֲשֶׁר יִנָּתֵק פְּתִיל־הַנְּעֹרֶת בַּהֲרִיחוֹ אֵשׁ וְלֹא נוֹדַע
כֹּחוֹ׃

english.text:
while an ambush was waiting in her room. Then she called out to
him, “Samson, the Philistines are upon you!” Whereat he pulled the
tendons apart, as a strand of tow comes apart at the touch of
fire. So the secret of his strength remained unknown.

translation.text: Now there were men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber.

verses.english:
while an ambush was waiting in her room. Then she called out to
him, “Samson, the Philistines are upon you!” Whereat he pulled the
tendons apart, as a strand of tow comes apart at the touch of
fire. So the secret of his strength remained unknown.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר דְּלִילָה אֶל־שִׁמְשׁוֹן הִנֵּה הֵתַלְתָּ בִּי וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלַי כְּזָבִים עַתָּה הַגִּידָה־נָּא לִי בַּמֶּה תֵּאָסֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר דְּלִילָה אֶל־שִׁמְשׁוֹן הִנֵּה הֵתַלְתָּ בִּי וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלַי כְּזָבִים עַתָּה הַגִּידָה־נָּא לִי בַּמֶּה תֵּאָסֵר׃

english.text:
Then Delilah said to Samson, “Oh, you deceived me; you lied to me!
Do tell me now how you could be tied up.”

translation.text: And Delilah said unto Samson, Behold, thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: now tell me, I pray thee, wherewith thou mightest be bound.

verses.english:
Then Delilah said to Samson, “Oh, you deceived me; you lied to me!
Do tell me now how you could be tied up.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אִם־אָסוֹר יַאַסְרוּנִי בַּעֲבֹתִים חֲדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נַעֲשָׂה בָהֶם מְלָאכָה וְחָלִיתִי וְהָיִיתִי כְּאַחַד הָאָדָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אִם־אָסוֹר יַאַסְרוּנִי בַּעֲבֹתִים חֲדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נַעֲשָׂה בָהֶם מְלָאכָה וְחָלִיתִי וְהָיִיתִי כְּאַחַד הָאָדָם׃

english.text:
He said, “If I were to be bound with new ropes that had never been
used, I would become as weak as an ordinary man.”

translation.text: And he said unto her, If they bind me fast with new ropes that never were occupied, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

verses.english:
He said, “If I were to be bound with new ropes that had never been
used, I would become as weak as an ordinary man.”

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח דְּלִילָה עֲבֹתִים חֲדָשִׁים וַתַּאַסְרֵהוּ בָהֶם וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וְהָאֹרֵב יֹשֵׁב בֶּחָדֶר וַיְנַתְּקֵם מֵעַל זְרֹעֹתָיו כַּחוּט׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקַּח דְּלִילָה עֲבֹתִים חֲדָשִׁים וַתַּאַסְרֵהוּ בָהֶם וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וְהָאֹרֵב יֹשֵׁב בֶּחָדֶר וַיְנַתְּקֵם מֵעַל זְרֹעֹתָיו כַּחוּט׃

english.text:
So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, while an ambush
was waiting in a room. And she cried, “Samson, the Philistines are
upon you!” But he tore them off his arms like a thread.

translation.text: Delilah therefore took new ropes, and bound him therewith, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And there were liers in wait abiding in the chamber. And he brake them from off his arms like a thread.

verses.english:
So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, while an ambush
was waiting in a room. And she cried, “Samson, the Philistines are
upon you!” But he tore them off his arms like a thread.

verses.hebrew:
וַתֹּאמֶר דְּלִילָה אֶל־שִׁמְשׁוֹן עַד־הֵנָּה הֵתַלְתָּ בִּי וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלַי כְּזָבִים הַגִּידָה לִּי בַּמֶּה תֵּאָסֵר וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אִם־תַּאַרְגִי אֶת־שֶׁבַע מַחְלְפוֹת
רֹאשִׁי עִם־הַמַּסָּכֶת׃

hebrew.text:
וַתֹּאמֶר דְּלִילָה אֶל־שִׁמְשׁוֹן עַד־הֵנָּה הֵתַלְתָּ בִּי וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלַי כְּזָבִים הַגִּידָה לִּי בַּמֶּה תֵּאָסֵר וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אִם־תַּאַרְגִי אֶת־שֶׁבַע מַחְלְפוֹת
רֹאשִׁי עִם־הַמַּסָּכֶת׃

english.text:
Then Delilah said to Samson, “You have been deceiving me all
along; you have been lying to me! Tell me, how could you be tied
up?” He answered her, “If you weave seven locks of my head into
the web.”

translation.text: And Delilah said unto Samson, Hitherto thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound. And he said unto her, If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web.

verses.english:
Then Delilah said to Samson, “You have been deceiving me all
along; you have been lying to me! Tell me, how could you be tied
up?” He answered her, “If you weave seven locks of my head into
the web.”

verses.hebrew: וַתִּתְקַע בַּיָּתֵד וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּיקַץ מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיִּסַּע אֶת־הַיְתַד הָאֶרֶג וְאֶת־הַמַּסָּכֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּתְקַע בַּיָּתֵד וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּיקַץ מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיִּסַּע אֶת־הַיְתַד הָאֶרֶג וְאֶת־הַמַּסָּכֶת׃

english.text:
And she pinned it with a peg and cried to him, “Samson, the
Philistines are upon you!” Awaking from his sleep, he pulled out
the peg, the loom, and the web.

translation.text: And she fastened it with the pin, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awaked out of his sleep, and went away with the pin of the beam, and with the web.

verses.english:
And she pinned it with a peg and cried to him, “Samson, the
Philistines are upon you!” Awaking from his sleep, he pulled out
the peg, the loom, and the web.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֵיךְ תֹּאמַר אֲהַבְתִּיךְ וְלִבְּךָ אֵין אִתִּי זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים הֵתַלְתָּ בִּי וְלֹא־הִגַּדְתָּ לִּי בַּמֶּה כֹּחֲךָ גָדוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֵיךְ תֹּאמַר אֲהַבְתִּיךְ וְלִבְּךָ אֵין אִתִּי זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים הֵתַלְתָּ בִּי וְלֹא־הִגַּדְתָּ לִּי בַּמֶּה כֹּחֲךָ גָדוֹל׃

english.text:
Then she said to him, “How can you say you love me, when you don’t
confide in me? This makes three times that you’ve deceived me and
haven’t told me what makes you so strong.”

translation.text: And she said unto him, How canst thou say, I love thee, when thine heart is not with me? thou hast mocked me these three times, and hast not told me wherein thy great strength lieth.

verses.english:
Then she said to him, “How can you say you love me, when you don’t
confide in me? This makes three times that you’ve deceived me and
haven’t told me what makes you so strong.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי־הֵצִיקָה לּוֹ בִדְבָרֶיהָ כּל־הַיָּמִים וַתְּאַלְצֵהוּ וַתִּקְצַר נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי־הֵצִיקָה לּוֹ בִדְבָרֶיהָ כּל־הַיָּמִים וַתְּאַלְצֵהוּ וַתִּקְצַר נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת׃

english.text:
Finally, after she had nagged him and pressed him constantly, he
was wearied to death

translation.text: And it came to pass, when she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, so that his soul was vexed unto death;

verses.english:
Finally, after she had nagged him and pressed him constantly, he
was wearied to death

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּגֶּד־לָהּ אֶת־כּל־לִבּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מוֹרָה לֹא־עָלָה עַל־רֹאשִׁי כִּי־נְזִיר אֱלֹהִים אֲנִי מִבֶּטֶן אִמִּי אִם־גֻּלַּחְתִּי וְסָר מִמֶּנִּי כֹחִי וְחָלִיתִי וְהָיִיתִי
כְּכל־הָאָדָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּגֶּד־לָהּ אֶת־כּל־לִבּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מוֹרָה לֹא־עָלָה עַל־רֹאשִׁי כִּי־נְזִיר אֱלֹהִים אֲנִי מִבֶּטֶן אִמִּי אִם־גֻּלַּחְתִּי וְסָר מִמֶּנִּי כֹחִי וְחָלִיתִי וְהָיִיתִי
כְּכל־הָאָדָם׃

english.text:
and he confided everything to her. He said to her, “No razor has
ever touched my head, for I have been a nazirite to God since I
was in my mother’s womb. If my hair were cut, my strength would
leave me and I should become as weak as an ordinary man.”

translation.text: That he told her all his heart, and said unto her, There hath not come a razor upon mine head; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother’s womb: if I be shaven, then my strength will go from me, and I shall become weak, and be like any other man.

verses.english:
and he confided everything to her. He said to her, “No razor has
ever touched my head, for I have been a nazirite to God since I
was in my mother’s womb. If my hair were cut, my strength would
leave me and I should become as weak as an ordinary man.”

verses.hebrew:
וַתֵּרֶא דְלִילָה כִּי־הִגִּיד לָהּ אֶת־כּל־לִבּוֹ וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתִּקְרָא לְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים לֵאמֹר עֲלוּ הַפַּעַם כִּי־הִגִּיד (לה) [לִי] אֶת־כּל־לִבּוֹ וְעָלוּ אֵלֶיהָ
סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּעֲלוּ הַכֶּסֶף בְּיָדָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַתֵּרֶא דְלִילָה כִּי־הִגִּיד לָהּ אֶת־כּל־לִבּוֹ וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתִּקְרָא לְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים לֵאמֹר עֲלוּ הַפַּעַם כִּי־הִגִּיד (לה) [לִי] אֶת־כּל־לִבּוֹ וְעָלוּ אֵלֶיהָ
סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּעֲלוּ הַכֶּסֶף בְּיָדָם׃

english.text:
Sensing that he had confided everything to her, Delilah sent for
the lords of the Philistines, with this message: “Come up once
more, for he has confided everything to me.” And the lords of the
Philistines came up and brought the money with them.

translation.text: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come up this once, for he hath shewed me all his heart. Then the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and brought money in their hand.

verses.english:
Sensing that he had confided everything to her, Delilah sent for
the lords of the Philistines, with this message: “Come up once
more, for he has confided everything to me.” And the lords of the
Philistines came up and brought the money with them.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּיַשְּׁנֵהוּ עַל־בִּרְכֶּיהָ וַתִּקְרָא לָאִישׁ וַתְּגַלַּח אֶת־שֶׁבַע מַחְלְפוֹת רֹאשׁוֹ וַתָּחֶל לְעַנּוֹתוֹ וַיָּסַר כֹּחוֹ מֵעָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּיַשְּׁנֵהוּ עַל־בִּרְכֶּיהָ וַתִּקְרָא לָאִישׁ וַתְּגַלַּח אֶת־שֶׁבַע מַחְלְפוֹת רֹאשׁוֹ וַתָּחֶל לְעַנּוֹתוֹ וַיָּסַר כֹּחוֹ מֵעָלָיו׃

english.text:
She lulled him to sleep on her lap. Then she called in a man, and
she had him cut off the seven locks of his head; thus she weakened
him and made him helpless: his strength slipped away from him.

translation.text: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.

verses.english:
She lulled him to sleep on her lap. Then she called in a man, and
she had him cut off the seven locks of his head; thus she weakened
him and made him helpless: his strength slipped away from him.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּקַץ מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵצֵא כְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם וְאִנָּעֵר וְהוּא לֹא יָדַע כִּי יְהֹוָה סָר מֵעָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּקַץ מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵצֵא כְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם וְאִנָּעֵר וְהוּא לֹא יָדַע כִּי יְהֹוָה סָר מֵעָלָיו׃

english.text:
She cried, “Samson, the Philistines are upon you!” And he awoke
from his sleep, thinking he would break loose and shake himself
free as he had the other times. For he did not know that YHWH had
departed from him.

translation.text: And she said, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awoke out of his sleep, and said, I will go out as at other times before, and shake myself. And he wist not that the LORD was departed from him.

verses.english:
She cried, “Samson, the Philistines are upon you!” And he awoke
from his sleep, thinking he would break loose and shake himself
free as he had the other times. For he did not know that YHWH had
departed from him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאחֲזוּהוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיְנַקְּרוּ אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיּוֹרִידוּ אוֹתוֹ עַזָּתָה וַיַּאַסְרוּהוּ בַּנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם וַיְהִי טוֹחֵן בְּבֵית (האסירים) [הָאֲסוּרִים]׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאחֲזוּהוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיְנַקְּרוּ אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיּוֹרִידוּ אוֹתוֹ עַזָּתָה וַיַּאַסְרוּהוּ בַּנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם וַיְהִי טוֹחֵן בְּבֵית (האסירים) [הָאֲסוּרִים]׃

english.text:
The Philistines seized him and gouged out his eyes. They brought
him down to Gaza and shackled him in bronze fetters, and he became
a mill slave in the prison.

translation.text: But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.

verses.english:
The Philistines seized him and gouged out his eyes. They brought
him down to Gaza and shackled him in bronze fetters, and he became
a mill slave in the prison.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּחֶל שְׂעַר־רֹאשׁוֹ לְצַמֵּחַ כַּאֲשֶׁר גֻּלָּח׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּחֶל שְׂעַר־רֹאשׁוֹ לְצַמֵּחַ כַּאֲשֶׁר גֻּלָּח׃

english.text: After his hair was cut off, it began to grow back.

translation.text: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven.

verses.english: After his hair was cut off, it began to grow back.

verses.hebrew: וְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֶסְפוּ לִזְבֹּחַ זֶבַח־גָּדוֹל לְדָגוֹן אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וּלְשִׂמְחָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָתַן אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּיָדֵנוּ אֵת שִׁמְשׁוֹן אוֹיְבֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֶסְפוּ לִזְבֹּחַ זֶבַח־גָּדוֹל לְדָגוֹן אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וּלְשִׂמְחָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָתַן אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּיָדֵנוּ אֵת שִׁמְשׁוֹן אוֹיְבֵנוּ׃

english.text:
Now the lords of the Philistines gathered to offer a great
sacrifice to their god Dagon and to make merry. They chanted, “Our
god has delivered into our hands Our enemy Samson.”

translation.text: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god, and to rejoice: for they said, Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.

verses.english:
Now the lords of the Philistines gathered to offer a great
sacrifice to their god Dagon and to make merry. They chanted, “Our
god has delivered into our hands Our enemy Samson.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ אֹתוֹ הָעָם וַיְהַלְלוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כִּי אָמְרוּ נָתַן אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְיָדֵנוּ אֶת־אוֹיְבֵנוּ וְאֵת מַחֲרִיב אַרְצֵנוּ וַאֲשֶׁר הִרְבָּה אֶת־חֲלָלֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ אֹתוֹ הָעָם וַיְהַלְלוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כִּי אָמְרוּ נָתַן אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְיָדֵנוּ אֶת־אוֹיְבֵנוּ וְאֵת מַחֲרִיב אַרְצֵנוּ וַאֲשֶׁר הִרְבָּה אֶת־חֲלָלֵינוּ׃

english.text:
When the people saw him, they sang praises to their god, chanting,
“Our god has delivered into our hands The enemy who devastated our
land, And who slew so many of us.”

translation.text: And when the people saw him, they praised their god: for they said, Our god hath delivered into our hands our enemy, and the destroyer of our country, which slew many of us.

verses.english:
When the people saw him, they sang praises to their god, chanting,
“Our god has delivered into our hands The enemy who devastated our
land, And who slew so many of us.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי (כי טוב) [כְּטוֹב] לִבָּם וַיֹּאמְרוּ קִרְאוּ לְשִׁמְשׁוֹן וִישַׂחֶק־לָנוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ לְשִׁמְשׁוֹן מִבֵּית (האסירים) [הָאֲסוּרִים] וַיְצַחֵק לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲמִידוּ
אוֹתוֹ בֵּין הָעַמּוּדִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי (כי טוב) [כְּטוֹב] לִבָּם וַיֹּאמְרוּ קִרְאוּ לְשִׁמְשׁוֹן וִישַׂחֶק־לָנוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ לְשִׁמְשׁוֹן מִבֵּית (האסירים) [הָאֲסוּרִים] וַיְצַחֵק לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲמִידוּ
אוֹתוֹ בֵּין הָעַמּוּדִים׃

english.text:
As their spirits rose, they said, “Call Samson here and let him
dance for us.” Samson was fetched from the prison, and he danced
for them. Then they put him between the pillars.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when their hearts were merry, that they said, Call for Samson, that he may make us sport. And they called for Samson out of the prison house; and he made them sport: and they set him between the pillars.

verses.english:
As their spirits rose, they said, “Call Samson here and let him
dance for us.” Samson was fetched from the prison, and he danced
for them. Then they put him between the pillars.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַמַּחֲזִיק בְּיָדוֹ הַנִּיחָה אוֹתִי (והימשני) [וַהֲמִישֵׁנִי] אֶת־הָעַמֻּדִים אֲשֶׁר הַבַּיִת נָכוֹן עֲלֵיהֶם וְאֶשָּׁעֵן עֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַמַּחֲזִיק בְּיָדוֹ הַנִּיחָה אוֹתִי (והימשני) [וַהֲמִישֵׁנִי] אֶת־הָעַמֻּדִים אֲשֶׁר הַבַּיִת נָכוֹן עֲלֵיהֶם וְאֶשָּׁעֵן עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And Samson said to the boy who was leading him by the hand, “Let
go of me and let me feel the pillars that the temple rests upon,
that I may lean on them.”

translation.text: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand, Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth, that I may lean upon them.

verses.english:
And Samson said to the boy who was leading him by the hand, “Let
go of me and let me feel the pillars that the temple rests upon,
that I may lean on them.”

verses.hebrew: וְהַבַּיִת מָלֵא הָאֲנָשִׁים וְהַנָּשִׁים וְשָׁמָּה כֹּל סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וְעַל־הַגָּג כִּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה הָרֹאִים בִּשְׂחוֹק שִׁמְשׁוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבַּיִת מָלֵא הָאֲנָשִׁים וְהַנָּשִׁים וְשָׁמָּה כֹּל סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וְעַל־הַגָּג כִּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה הָרֹאִים בִּשְׂחוֹק שִׁמְשׁוֹן׃

english.text:
Now the temple was full of men and women; all the lords of the
Philistines were there, and there were some three thousand men and
women on the roof watching Samson dance.

translation.text: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women, that beheld while Samson made sport.

verses.english:
Now the temple was full of men and women; all the lords of the
Philistines were there, and there were some three thousand men and
women on the roof watching Samson dance.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה זכְרֵנִי נָא וְחַזְּקֵנִי נָא אַךְ הַפַּעַם הַזֶּה הָאֱלֹהִים וְאִנָּקְמָה נְקַם־אַחַת מִשְּׁתֵי עֵינַי מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה זכְרֵנִי נָא וְחַזְּקֵנִי נָא אַךְ הַפַּעַם הַזֶּה הָאֱלֹהִים וְאִנָּקְמָה נְקַם־אַחַת מִשְּׁתֵי עֵינַי מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
Then Samson called to YHWH, “O Lord GOD! Please remember me, and
give me strength just this once, O God, to take revenge of the
Philistines, if only for one of my two eyes.”

translation.text: And Samson called unto the LORD, and said, O Lord God, remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.

verses.english:
Then Samson called to YHWH, “O Lord GOD! Please remember me, and
give me strength just this once, O God, to take revenge of the
Philistines, if only for one of my two eyes.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְפֹּת שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶת־שְׁנֵי עַמּוּדֵי הַתָּוֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הַבַּיִת נָכוֹן עֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּסָּמֵךְ עֲלֵיהֶם אֶחָד בִּימִינוֹ וְאֶחָד בִּשְׂמֹאלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְפֹּת שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶת־שְׁנֵי עַמּוּדֵי הַתָּוֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הַבַּיִת נָכוֹן עֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּסָּמֵךְ עֲלֵיהֶם אֶחָד בִּימִינוֹ וְאֶחָד בִּשְׂמֹאלוֹ׃

translation.text: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן תָּמוֹת נַפְשִׁי עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיֵּט בְּכֹחַ וַיִּפֹּל הַבַּיִת עַל־הַסְּרָנִים וְעַל־כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ וַיִּהְיוּ הַמֵּתִים אֲשֶׁר הֵמִית בְּמוֹתוֹ
רַבִּים מֵאֲשֶׁר הֵמִית בְּחַיָּיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן תָּמוֹת נַפְשִׁי עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיֵּט בְּכֹחַ וַיִּפֹּל הַבַּיִת עַל־הַסְּרָנִים וְעַל־כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ וַיִּהְיוּ הַמֵּתִים אֲשֶׁר הֵמִית בְּמוֹתוֹ
רַבִּים מֵאֲשֶׁר הֵמִית בְּחַיָּיו׃

english.text:
Samson cried, “Let me die with the Philistines!” and he pulled
with all his might. The temple came crashing down on the lords and
on all the people in it. Those who were slain by him as he died
outnumbered those who had been slain by him when he lived.

translation.text: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And he bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell upon the lords, and upon all the people that were therein. So the dead which he slew at his death were more than they which he slew in his life.

verses.english:
Samson cried, “Let me die with the Philistines!” and he pulled
with all his might. The temple came crashing down on the lords and
on all the people in it. Those who were slain by him as he died
outnumbered those who had been slain by him when he lived.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּרְדוּ אֶחָיו וְכל־בֵּית אָבִיהוּ וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֹתוֹ וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אוֹתוֹ בֵּין צרְעָה וּבֵין אֶשְׁתָּאֹל בְּקֶבֶר מָנוֹחַ אָבִיו וְהוּא שָׁפַט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל
עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּרְדוּ אֶחָיו וְכל־בֵּית אָבִיהוּ וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֹתוֹ וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אוֹתוֹ בֵּין צרְעָה וּבֵין אֶשְׁתָּאֹל בְּקֶבֶר מָנוֹחַ אָבִיו וְהוּא שָׁפַט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל
עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
His brothers and all his father’s household came down and carried
him up and buried him in the tomb of his father Manoah, between
Zorah and Eshtaol. He had led Israel for twenty years.

translation.text: Then his brethren and all the house of his father came down, and took him, and brought him up, and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father. And he judged Israel twenty years.

verses.english:
His brothers and all his father’s household came down and carried
him up and buried him in the tomb of his father Manoah, between
Zorah and Eshtaol. He had led Israel for twenty years.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־אִישׁ מֵהַר־אֶפְרָיִם וּשְׁמוֹ מִיכָיְהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי־אִישׁ מֵהַר־אֶפְרָיִם וּשְׁמוֹ מִיכָיְהוּ׃

english.text:
There was a man in the hill country of Ephraim whose name was
Micah.

translation.text: And there was a man of mount Ephraim, whose name was Micah.

verses.english:
There was a man in the hill country of Ephraim whose name was
Micah.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לְאִמּוֹ אֶלֶף וּמֵאָה הַכֶּסֶף אֲשֶׁר לֻקַּח־לָךְ (ואתי) [וְאַתְּ] אָלִית וְגַם אָמַרְתְּ בְּאזְנַי הִנֵּה־הַכֶּסֶף אִתִּי אֲנִי לְקַחְתִּיו וַתֹּאמֶר אִמּוֹ בָּרוּךְ
בְּנִי לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לְאִמּוֹ אֶלֶף וּמֵאָה הַכֶּסֶף אֲשֶׁר לֻקַּח־לָךְ (ואתי) [וְאַתְּ] אָלִית וְגַם אָמַרְתְּ בְּאזְנַי הִנֵּה־הַכֶּסֶף אִתִּי אֲנִי לְקַחְתִּיו וַתֹּאמֶר אִמּוֹ בָּרוּךְ
בְּנִי לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred shekels of silver that
were taken from you, so that you uttered an imprecation which you
repeated in my hearing—I have that silver; I took it.” “Blessed of
YHWH be my son,” said his mother.

translation.text: And he said unto his mother, The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from thee, about which thou cursedst, and spakest of also in mine ears, behold, the silver is with me; I took it. And his mother said, Blessed be thou of the LORD, my son.

verses.english:
He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred shekels of silver that
were taken from you, so that you uttered an imprecation which you
repeated in my hearing—I have that silver; I took it.” “Blessed of
YHWH be my son,” said his mother.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־אֶלֶף־וּמֵאָה הַכֶּסֶף לְאִמּוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר אִמּוֹ הַקְדֵּשׁ הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף לַיהֹוָה מִיָּדִי לִבְנִי לַעֲשׂוֹת פֶּסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה וְעַתָּה אֲשִׁיבֶנּוּ
לָךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־אֶלֶף־וּמֵאָה הַכֶּסֶף לְאִמּוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר אִמּוֹ הַקְדֵּשׁ הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף לַיהֹוָה מִיָּדִי לִבְנִי לַעֲשׂוֹת פֶּסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה וְעַתָּה אֲשִׁיבֶנּוּ
לָךְ׃

english.text:
He returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother;
but his mother said, “I herewith consecrate the silver to YHWH,
transferring it to my son to make a sculptured image and a molten
image. I now return it to you.”

translation.text: And when he had restored the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, his mother said, I had wholly dedicated the silver unto the LORD from my hand for my son, to make a graven image and a molten image: now therefore I will restore it unto thee.

verses.english:
He returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother;
but his mother said, “I herewith consecrate the silver to YHWH,
transferring it to my son to make a sculptured image and a molten
image. I now return it to you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף לְאִמּוֹ וַתִּקַּח אִמּוֹ מָאתַיִם כֶּסֶף וַתִּתְּנֵהוּ לַצּוֹרֵף וַיַּעֲשֵׂהוּ פֶּסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה וַיְהִי בְּבֵית מִיכָיְהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף לְאִמּוֹ וַתִּקַּח אִמּוֹ מָאתַיִם כֶּסֶף וַתִּתְּנֵהוּ לַצּוֹרֵף וַיַּעֲשֵׂהוּ פֶּסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה וַיְהִי בְּבֵית מִיכָיְהוּ׃

english.text:
So when he gave the silver back to his mother, his mother took two
hundred shekels of silver and gave it to a smith. He made of it a
sculptured image and a molten image, which were kept in the house
of Micah.

translation.text: Yet he restored the money unto his mother; and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver, and gave them to the founder, who made thereof a graven image and a molten image: and they were in the house of Micah.

verses.english:
So when he gave the silver back to his mother, his mother took two
hundred shekels of silver and gave it to a smith. He made of it a
sculptured image and a molten image, which were kept in the house
of Micah.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאִישׁ מִיכָה לוֹ בֵּית אֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַשׂ אֵפוֹד וּתְרָפִים וַיְמַלֵּא אֶת־יַד אַחַד מִבָּנָיו וַיְהִי־לוֹ לְכֹהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאִישׁ מִיכָה לוֹ בֵּית אֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַשׂ אֵפוֹד וּתְרָפִים וַיְמַלֵּא אֶת־יַד אַחַד מִבָּנָיו וַיְהִי־לוֹ לְכֹהֵן׃

english.text:
Now the man Micah had a house of God; he had made an ephod and
teraphim and he had inducted one of his sons to be his priest.

translation.text: And the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.

verses.english:
Now the man Micah had a house of God; he had made an ephod and
teraphim and he had inducted one of his sons to be his priest.

verses.hebrew: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין מֶלֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו יַעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין מֶלֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו יַעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
In those days there was no king in Israel; every man did as he
pleased.

translation.text: In those days there was no king in Israel, but every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

verses.english:
In those days there was no king in Israel; every man did as he
pleased.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־נַעַר מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת יְהוּדָה וְהוּא לֵוִי וְהוּא גָר־שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי־נַעַר מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת יְהוּדָה וְהוּא לֵוִי וְהוּא גָר־שָׁם׃

english.text:
There was a young man from Bethlehem of Judah, from the clan seat
of Judah; he was a Levite and had resided there as a sojourner.

translation.text: And there was a young man out of Bethlehemjudah of the family of Judah, who was a Levite, and he sojourned there.

verses.english:
There was a young man from Bethlehem of Judah, from the clan seat
of Judah; he was a Levite and had resided there as a sojourner.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הָאִישׁ מֵהָעִיר מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה לָגוּר בַּאֲשֶׁר יִמְצָא וַיָּבֹא הַר־אֶפְרַיִם עַד־בֵּית מִיכָה לַעֲשׂוֹת דַּרְכּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ הָאִישׁ מֵהָעִיר מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה לָגוּר בַּאֲשֶׁר יִמְצָא וַיָּבֹא הַר־אֶפְרַיִם עַד־בֵּית מִיכָה לַעֲשׂוֹת דַּרְכּוֹ׃

english.text:
This man had left the town of Bethlehem of Judah to take up
residence wherever he could find a place. On his way, he came to
the house of Micah in the hill country of Ephraim.

translation.text: And the man departed out of the city from Bethlehemjudah to sojourn where he could find a place: and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.

verses.english:
This man had left the town of Bethlehem of Judah to take up
residence wherever he could find a place. On his way, he came to
the house of Micah in the hill country of Ephraim.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ מִיכָה מֵאַיִן תָּבוֹא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לֵוִי אָנֹכִי מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה וְאָנֹכִי הֹלֵךְ לָגוּר בַּאֲשֶׁר אֶמְצָא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ מִיכָה מֵאַיִן תָּבוֹא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לֵוִי אָנֹכִי מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה וְאָנֹכִי הֹלֵךְ לָגוּר בַּאֲשֶׁר אֶמְצָא׃

english.text:
“Where do you come from?” Micah asked him. He replied, “I am a
Levite from Bethlehem of Judah, and I am traveling to take up
residence wherever I can find a place.”

translation.text: And Micah said unto him, Whence comest thou? And he said unto him, I am a Levite of Bethlehemjudah, and I go to sojourn where I may find a place.

verses.english:
“Where do you come from?” Micah asked him. He replied, “I am a
Levite from Bethlehem of Judah, and I am traveling to take up
residence wherever I can find a place.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מִיכָה שְׁבָה עִמָּדִי וֶהְיֵה־לִי לְאָב וּלְכֹהֵן וְאָנֹכִי אֶתֶּן־לְךָ עֲשֶׂרֶת כֶּסֶף לַיָּמִים וְעֵרֶךְ בְּגָדִים וּמִחְיָתֶךָ וַיֵּלֶךְ הַלֵּוִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מִיכָה שְׁבָה עִמָּדִי וֶהְיֵה־לִי לְאָב וּלְכֹהֵן וְאָנֹכִי אֶתֶּן־לְךָ עֲשֶׂרֶת כֶּסֶף לַיָּמִים וְעֵרֶךְ בְּגָדִים וּמִחְיָתֶךָ וַיֵּלֶךְ הַלֵּוִי׃

english.text:
“Stay with me,” Micah said to him, “and be a father and a priest
to me, and I will pay you ten shekels of silver a year, an
allowance of clothing, and your food.” The Levite went.

translation.text: And Micah said unto him, Dwell with me, and be unto me a father and a priest, and I will give thee ten shekels of silver by the year, and a suit of apparel, and thy victuals. So the Levite went in.

verses.english:
“Stay with me,” Micah said to him, “and be a father and a priest
to me, and I will pay you ten shekels of silver a year, an
allowance of clothing, and your food.” The Levite went.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹאֶל הַלֵּוִי לָשֶׁבֶת אֶת־הָאִישׁ וַיְהִי הַנַּעַר לוֹ כְּאַחַד מִבָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹאֶל הַלֵּוִי לָשֶׁבֶת אֶת־הָאִישׁ וַיְהִי הַנַּעַר לוֹ כְּאַחַד מִבָּנָיו׃

english.text:
The Levite agreed to stay with the man, and the youth became like
one of his own sons.

translation.text: And the Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was unto him as one of his sons.

verses.english:
The Levite agreed to stay with the man, and the youth became like
one of his own sons.

verses.hebrew: וַיְמַלֵּא מִיכָה אֶת־יַד הַלֵּוִי וַיְהִי־לוֹ הַנַּעַר לְכֹהֵן וַיְהִי בְּבֵית מִיכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַלֵּא מִיכָה אֶת־יַד הַלֵּוִי וַיְהִי־לוֹ הַנַּעַר לְכֹהֵן וַיְהִי בְּבֵית מִיכָה׃

english.text:
Micah inducted the Levite, and the young man became his priest and
remained in Micah’s shrine.

translation.text: And Micah consecrated the Levite; and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.

verses.english:
Micah inducted the Levite, and the young man became his priest and
remained in Micah’s shrine.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָה עַתָּה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־יֵיטִיב יְהֹוָה לִי כִּי הָיָה־לִי הַלֵּוִי לְכֹהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָה עַתָּה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־יֵיטִיב יְהֹוָה לִי כִּי הָיָה־לִי הַלֵּוִי לְכֹהֵן׃

english.text:
“Now I know,” Micah told himself, “that YHWH will prosper me,
since the Levite has become my priest.”

translation.text: Then said Micah, Now know I that the LORD will do me good, seeing I have a Levite to my priest.

verses.english:
“Now I know,” Micah told himself, “that YHWH will prosper me,
since the Levite has become my priest.”

verses.hebrew:
בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין מֶלֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וּבַיָּמִים הָהֵם שֵׁבֶט הַדָּנִי מְבַקֶּשׁ־לוֹ נַחֲלָה לָשֶׁבֶת כִּי לֹא־נָפְלָה לּוֹ עַד־הַיּוֹם הַהוּא בְּתוֹךְ־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
בְּנַחֲלָה׃

hebrew.text:
בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין מֶלֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וּבַיָּמִים הָהֵם שֵׁבֶט הַדָּנִי מְבַקֶּשׁ־לוֹ נַחֲלָה לָשֶׁבֶת כִּי לֹא־נָפְלָה לּוֹ עַד־הַיּוֹם הַהוּא בְּתוֹךְ־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
בְּנַחֲלָה׃

english.text:
In those days there was no king in Israel, and in those days the
tribe of Dan was seeking a territory in which to settle; for to
that day no territory had fallen to their lot among the tribes of
Israel.

translation.text: In those days there was no king in Israel: and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in; for unto that day all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel.

verses.english:
In those days there was no king in Israel, and in those days the
tribe of Dan was seeking a territory in which to settle; for to
that day no territory had fallen to their lot among the tribes of
Israel.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ בְנֵי־דָן מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתָּם חֲמִשָּׁה אֲנָשִׁים מִקְצוֹתָם אֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־חַיִל מִצּרְעָה וּמֵאֶשְׁתָּאֹל לְרַגֵּל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וּלְחקְרָהּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם לְכוּ
חִקְרוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּבֹאוּ הַר־אֶפְרַיִם עַד־בֵּית מִיכָה וַיָּלִינוּ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ בְנֵי־דָן מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתָּם חֲמִשָּׁה אֲנָשִׁים מִקְצוֹתָם אֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־חַיִל מִצּרְעָה וּמֵאֶשְׁתָּאֹל לְרַגֵּל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וּלְחקְרָהּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם לְכוּ
חִקְרוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּבֹאוּ הַר־אֶפְרַיִם עַד־בֵּית מִיכָה וַיָּלִינוּ שָׁם׃

english.text:
The Danites sent out five of their number, from their clan seat at
Zorah and Eshtaol—valiant men—to spy out the land and explore it.
“Go,” they told them, “and explore the land.” When they had
advanced into the hill country of Ephraim as far as the house of
Micah, they stopped there for the night.

translation.text: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts, men of valour, from Zorah, and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land, and to search it; and they said unto them, Go, search the land: who when they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged there.

verses.english:
The Danites sent out five of their number, from their clan seat at
Zorah and Eshtaol—valiant men—to spy out the land and explore it.
“Go,” they told them, “and explore the land.” When they had
advanced into the hill country of Ephraim as far as the house of
Micah, they stopped there for the night.

verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה עִם־בֵּית מִיכָה וְהֵמָּה הִכִּירוּ אֶת־קוֹל הַנַּעַר הַלֵּוִי וַיָּסוּרוּ שָׁם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ מִי־הֱבִיאֲךָ הֲלֹם וּמָה־אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה בָּזֶה וּמַה־לְּךָ פֹה׃

hebrew.text: הֵמָּה עִם־בֵּית מִיכָה וְהֵמָּה הִכִּירוּ אֶת־קוֹל הַנַּעַר הַלֵּוִי וַיָּסוּרוּ שָׁם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ מִי־הֱבִיאֲךָ הֲלֹם וּמָה־אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה בָּזֶה וּמַה־לְּךָ פֹה׃

english.text:
While in the vicinity of Micah’s house, they recognized the speech
of the young Levite, so they went over and asked him, “Who brought
you to these parts? What are you doing in this place? What is your
business here?”

translation.text: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite: and they turned in thither, and said unto him, Who brought thee hither? and what makest thou in this place? and what hast thou here?

verses.english:
While in the vicinity of Micah’s house, they recognized the speech
of the young Levite, so they went over and asked him, “Who brought
you to these parts? What are you doing in this place? What is your
business here?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם כָּזֹה וְכָזֶה עָשָׂה לִי מִיכָה וַיִּשְׂכְּרֵנִי וָאֱהִי־לוֹ לְכֹהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם כָּזֹה וְכָזֶה עָשָׂה לִי מִיכָה וַיִּשְׂכְּרֵנִי וָאֱהִי־לוֹ לְכֹהֵן׃

english.text:
He replied, “Thus and thus Micah did for me—he hired me and I
became his priest.”

translation.text: And he said unto them, Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me, and hath hired me, and I am his priest.

verses.english:
He replied, “Thus and thus Micah did for me—he hired me and I
became his priest.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ שְׁאַל־נָא בֵאלֹהִים וְנֵדְעָה הֲתַצְלִחַ דַּרְכֵּנוּ אֲשֶׁר אֲנַחְנוּ הֹלְכִים עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ שְׁאַל־נָא בֵאלֹהִים וְנֵדְעָה הֲתַצְלִחַ דַּרְכֵּנוּ אֲשֶׁר אֲנַחְנוּ הֹלְכִים עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
They said to him, “Please, inquire of God; we would like to know
if the mission on which we are going will be successful.”

translation.text: And they said unto him, Ask counsel, we pray thee, of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.

verses.english:
They said to him, “Please, inquire of God; we would like to know
if the mission on which we are going will be successful.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַכֹּהֵן לְכוּ לְשָׁלוֹם נֹכַח יְהֹוָה דַּרְכְּכֶם אֲשֶׁר תֵּלְכוּ־בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַכֹּהֵן לְכוּ לְשָׁלוֹם נֹכַח יְהֹוָה דַּרְכְּכֶם אֲשֶׁר תֵּלְכוּ־בָהּ׃

english.text:
“Go in peace,” the priest said to them, “YHWH views with favor the
mission you are going on.”

translation.text: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.

verses.english:
“Go in peace,” the priest said to them, “YHWH views with favor the
mission you are going on.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלְכוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיָּבֹאוּ לָיְשָׁה וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בְּקִרְבָּהּ יוֹשֶׁבֶת־לָבֶטַח כְּמִשְׁפַּט צִדֹנִים שֹׁקֵט וּבֹטֵחַ וְאֵין־מַכְלִים דָּבָר בָּאָרֶץ
יוֹרֵשׁ עֶצֶר וּרְחוֹקִים הֵמָּה מִצִּידֹנִים וְדָבָר אֵין־לָהֶם עִם־אָדָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלְכוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיָּבֹאוּ לָיְשָׁה וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בְּקִרְבָּהּ יוֹשֶׁבֶת־לָבֶטַח כְּמִשְׁפַּט צִדֹנִים שֹׁקֵט וּבֹטֵחַ וְאֵין־מַכְלִים דָּבָר בָּאָרֶץ
יוֹרֵשׁ עֶצֶר וּרְחוֹקִים הֵמָּה מִצִּידֹנִים וְדָבָר אֵין־לָהֶם עִם־אָדָם׃

english.text:
The five men went on and came to Laish. They observed the people
in it dwelling carefree, after the manner of the Sidonians, a
tranquil and unsuspecting people, with no one in the land to
molest them and with no hereditary ruler. Moreover, they were
distant from the Sidonians and had no dealings with anybody.

translation.text: Then the five men departed, and came to Laish, and saw the people that were therein, how they dwelt careless, after the manner of the Zidonians, quiet and secure; and there was no magistrate in the land, that might put them to shame in any thing; and they were far from the Zidonians, and had no business with any man.

verses.english:
The five men went on and came to Laish. They observed the people
in it dwelling carefree, after the manner of the Sidonians, a
tranquil and unsuspecting people, with no one in the land to
molest them and with no hereditary ruler. Moreover, they were
distant from the Sidonians and had no dealings with anybody.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־אֲחֵיהֶם צרְעָה וְאֶשְׁתָּאֹל וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהֶם אֲחֵיהֶם מָה אַתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־אֲחֵיהֶם צרְעָה וְאֶשְׁתָּאֹל וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהֶם אֲחֵיהֶם מָה אַתֶּם׃

english.text:
When [the men] came back to their kinsmen at Zorah and Eshtaol,
their kinsmen asked them, “How did you fare?”

translation.text: And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol: and their brethren said unto them, What say ye?

verses.english:
When [the men] came back to their kinsmen at Zorah and Eshtaol,
their kinsmen asked them, “How did you fare?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ קוּמָה וְנַעֲלֶה עֲלֵיהֶם כִּי רָאִינוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְהִנֵּה טוֹבָה מְאֹד וְאַתֶּם מַחְשִׁים אַל־תֵּעָצְלוּ לָלֶכֶת לָבֹא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ קוּמָה וְנַעֲלֶה עֲלֵיהֶם כִּי רָאִינוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְהִנֵּה טוֹבָה מְאֹד וְאַתֶּם מַחְשִׁים אַל־תֵּעָצְלוּ לָלֶכֶת לָבֹא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
They replied, “Let us go at once and attack them! For we found
that the land was very good, and you are sitting idle! Don’t
delay; go and invade the land and take possession of it,

translation.text: And they said, Arise, that we may go up against them: for we have seen the land, and, behold, it is very good: and are ye still? be not slothful to go, and to enter to possess the land.

verses.english:
They replied, “Let us go at once and attack them! For we found
that the land was very good, and you are sitting idle! Don’t
delay; go and invade the land and take possession of it,

verses.hebrew: כְּבֹאֲכֶם תָּבֹאוּ אֶל־עַם בֹּטֵחַ וְהָאָרֶץ רַחֲבַת יָדַיִם כִּי־נְתָנָהּ אֱלֹהִים בְּיֶדְכֶם מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אֵין־שָׁם מַחְסוֹר כּל־דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: כְּבֹאֲכֶם תָּבֹאוּ אֶל־עַם בֹּטֵחַ וְהָאָרֶץ רַחֲבַת יָדַיִם כִּי־נְתָנָהּ אֱלֹהִים בְּיֶדְכֶם מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אֵין־שָׁם מַחְסוֹר כּל־דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
for God has delivered it into your hand. When you come, you will
come to an unsuspecting people; and the land is spacious and
nothing on earth is lacking there.”

translation.text: When ye go, ye shall come unto a people secure, and to a large land: for God hath given it into your hands; a place where there is no want of any thing that is in the earth.

verses.english:
for God has delivered it into your hand. When you come, you will
come to an unsuspecting people; and the land is spacious and
nothing on earth is lacking there.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִשָּׁם מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת הַדָּנִי מִצּרְעָה וּמֵאֶשְׁתָּאֹל שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ חָגוּר כְּלֵי מִלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִשָּׁם מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת הַדָּנִי מִצּרְעָה וּמֵאֶשְׁתָּאֹל שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ חָגוּר כְּלֵי מִלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
They departed from there, from the clan seat of the Danites, from
Zorah and Eshtaol, six hundred strong, girt with weapons of war.

translation.text: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.

verses.english:
They departed from there, from the clan seat of the Danites, from
Zorah and Eshtaol, six hundred strong, girt with weapons of war.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּקִרְיַת יְעָרִים בִּיהוּדָה עַל־כֵּן קָרְאוּ לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא מַחֲנֵה־דָן עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הִנֵּה אַחֲרֵי קִרְיַת יְעָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּקִרְיַת יְעָרִים בִּיהוּדָה עַל־כֵּן קָרְאוּ לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא מַחֲנֵה־דָן עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הִנֵּה אַחֲרֵי קִרְיַת יְעָרִים׃

english.text:
They went up and encamped at Kiriath-jearim in Judah. That is why
that place is called “the Camp of Dan” to this day; it lies west
of Kiriath-jearim.

translation.text: And they went up, and pitched in Kirjathjearim, in Judah: wherefore they called that place Mahanehdan unto this day: behold, it is behind Kirjathjearim.

verses.english:
They went up and encamped at Kiriath-jearim in Judah. That is why
that place is called “the Camp of Dan” to this day; it lies west
of Kiriath-jearim.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְרוּ מִשָּׁם הַר־אֶפְרָיִם וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־בֵּית מִיכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַבְרוּ מִשָּׁם הַר־אֶפְרָיִם וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־בֵּית מִיכָה׃

english.text:
From there they passed on to the hill country of Ephraim and
arrived at the house of Micah.

translation.text: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.

verses.english:
From there they passed on to the hill country of Ephraim and
arrived at the house of Micah.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲנוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים הַהֹלְכִים לְרַגֵּל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לַיִשׁ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־אֲחֵיהֶם הַיְדַעְתֶּם כִּי יֵשׁ בַּבָּתִּים הָאֵלֶּה אֵפוֹד וּתְרָפִים וּפֶסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה
וְעַתָּה דְּעוּ מַה־תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲנוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים הַהֹלְכִים לְרַגֵּל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לַיִשׁ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־אֲחֵיהֶם הַיְדַעְתֶּם כִּי יֵשׁ בַּבָּתִּים הָאֵלֶּה אֵפוֹד וּתְרָפִים וּפֶסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה
וְעַתָּה דְּעוּ מַה־תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

english.text:
Here the five men who had gone to spy out the Laish region
remarked to their kinsmen, “Do you know, there is an ephod in
these houses, and teraphim, and a sculptured image and a molten
image? Now you know what you have to do.”

translation.text: Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of Laish, and said unto their brethren, Do ye know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a graven image, and a molten image? now therefore consider what ye have to do.

verses.english:
Here the five men who had gone to spy out the Laish region
remarked to their kinsmen, “Do you know, there is an ephod in
these houses, and teraphim, and a sculptured image and a molten
image? Now you know what you have to do.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּסוּרוּ שָׁמָּה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בֵּית־הַנַּעַר הַלֵּוִי בֵּית מִיכָה וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ־לוֹ לְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּסוּרוּ שָׁמָּה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בֵּית־הַנַּעַר הַלֵּוִי בֵּית מִיכָה וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ־לוֹ לְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
So they turned off there and entered the home of the young Levite
at Micah’s house and greeted him.

translation.text: And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, even unto the house of Micah, and saluted him.

verses.english:
So they turned off there and entered the home of the young Levite
at Micah’s house and greeted him.

verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ חֲגוּרִים כְּלֵי מִלְחַמְתָּם נִצָּבִים פֶּתַח הַשָּׁעַר אֲשֶׁר מִבְּנֵי־דָן׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ חֲגוּרִים כְּלֵי מִלְחַמְתָּם נִצָּבִים פֶּתַח הַשָּׁעַר אֲשֶׁר מִבְּנֵי־דָן׃

english.text:
The six hundred Danite men, girt with their weapons of war, stood
at the entrance of the gate,

translation.text: And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, which were of the children of Dan, stood by the entering of the gate.

verses.english:
The six hundred Danite men, girt with their weapons of war, stood
at the entrance of the gate,

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲלוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים הַהֹלְכִים לְרַגֵּל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ בָּאוּ שָׁמָּה לָקְחוּ אֶת־הַפֶּסֶל וְאֶת־הָאֵפוֹד וְאֶת־הַתְּרָפִים וְאֶת־הַמַּסֵּכָה וְהַכֹּהֵן נִצָּב פֶּתַח
הַשַּׁעַר וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ הֶחָגוּר כְּלֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲלוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים הַהֹלְכִים לְרַגֵּל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ בָּאוּ שָׁמָּה לָקְחוּ אֶת־הַפֶּסֶל וְאֶת־הָאֵפוֹד וְאֶת־הַתְּרָפִים וְאֶת־הַמַּסֵּכָה וְהַכֹּהֵן נִצָּב פֶּתַח
הַשַּׁעַר וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ הֶחָגוּר כְּלֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
while the five men who had gone to spy out the land went inside
and took the sculptured image, the ephod, the teraphim, and the
molten image. The priest was standing at the entrance of the gate,
and the six hundred men girt with their weapons of war,

translation.text: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up, and came in thither, and took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war.

verses.english:
while the five men who had gone to spy out the land went inside
and took the sculptured image, the ephod, the teraphim, and the
molten image. The priest was standing at the entrance of the gate,
and the six hundred men girt with their weapons of war,

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בָּאוּ בֵּית מִיכָה וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־פֶּסֶל הָאֵפוֹד וְאֶת־הַתְּרָפִים וְאֶת־הַמַּסֵּכָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם הַכֹּהֵן מָה אַתֶּם עֹשִׂים׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה בָּאוּ בֵּית מִיכָה וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־פֶּסֶל הָאֵפוֹד וְאֶת־הַתְּרָפִים וְאֶת־הַמַּסֵּכָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם הַכֹּהֵן מָה אַתֶּם עֹשִׂים׃

english.text:
while those men entered Micah’s house and took the sculptured
image, the molten image, the ephod, and the household gods. The
priest said to them, “What are you doing?”

translation.text: And these went into Micah’s house, and fetched the carved image, the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image. Then said the priest unto them, What do ye?

verses.english:
while those men entered Micah’s house and took the sculptured
image, the molten image, the ephod, and the household gods. The
priest said to them, “What are you doing?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ הַחֲרֵשׁ שִׂים־יָדְךָ עַל־פִּיךָ וְלֵךְ עִמָּנוּ וֶהְיֵה־לָנוּ לְאָב וּלְכֹהֵן הֲטוֹב הֱיוֹתְךָ כֹהֵן לְבֵית אִישׁ אֶחָד אוֹ הֱיוֹתְךָ כֹהֵן לְשֵׁבֶט
וּלְמִשְׁפָּחָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ הַחֲרֵשׁ שִׂים־יָדְךָ עַל־פִּיךָ וְלֵךְ עִמָּנוּ וֶהְיֵה־לָנוּ לְאָב וּלְכֹהֵן הֲטוֹב הֱיוֹתְךָ כֹהֵן לְבֵית אִישׁ אֶחָד אוֹ הֱיוֹתְךָ כֹהֵן לְשֵׁבֶט
וּלְמִשְׁפָּחָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But they said to him, “Be quiet; put your hand on your mouth! Come
with us and be our father and priest. Would you rather be priest
to one man’s household or be priest to a tribe and clan in
Israel?”

translation.text: And they said unto him, Hold thy peace, lay thine hand upon thy mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest: is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel?

verses.english:
But they said to him, “Be quiet; put your hand on your mouth! Come
with us and be our father and priest. Would you rather be priest
to one man’s household or be priest to a tribe and clan in
Israel?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּיטַב לֵב הַכֹּהֵן וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הָאֵפוֹד וְאֶת־הַתְּרָפִים וְאֶת־הַפָּסֶל וַיָּבֹא בְּקֶרֶב הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּיטַב לֵב הַכֹּהֵן וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הָאֵפוֹד וְאֶת־הַתְּרָפִים וְאֶת־הַפָּסֶל וַיָּבֹא בְּקֶרֶב הָעָם׃

english.text:
The priest was delighted. He took the ephod, the household gods,
and the sculptured image, and he joined the people.

translation.text: And the priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.

verses.english:
The priest was delighted. He took the ephod, the household gods,
and the sculptured image, and he joined the people.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת־הַטַּף וְאֶת־הַמִּקְנֶה וְאֶת־הַכְּבוּדָּה לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת־הַטַּף וְאֶת־הַמִּקְנֶה וְאֶת־הַכְּבוּדָּה לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
They set out again, placing the children, the cattle, and their
household goods in front.

translation.text: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them.

verses.english:
They set out again, placing the children, the cattle, and their
household goods in front.

verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה הִרְחִיקוּ מִבֵּית מִיכָה וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּתִּים אֲשֶׁר עִם־בֵּית מִיכָה נִזְעֲקוּ וַיַּדְבִּיקוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי־דָן׃

hebrew.text: הֵמָּה הִרְחִיקוּ מִבֵּית מִיכָה וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּתִּים אֲשֶׁר עִם־בֵּית מִיכָה נִזְעֲקוּ וַיַּדְבִּיקוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי־דָן׃

english.text:
They had already gone some distance from Micah’s house, when the
men in the houses near Micah’s mustered and caught up with the
Danites.

translation.text: And when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that were in the houses near to Micah’s house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.

verses.english:
They had already gone some distance from Micah’s house, when the
men in the houses near Micah’s mustered and caught up with the
Danites.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי־דָן וַיַּסֵּבּוּ פְּנֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְמִיכָה מַה־לְּךָ כִּי נִזְעָקְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי־דָן וַיַּסֵּבּוּ פְּנֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְמִיכָה מַה־לְּךָ כִּי נִזְעָקְתָּ׃

english.text:
They called out to the Danites, who turned around and said to
Micah, “What’s the matter? Why have you mustered?”

translation.text: And they cried unto the children of Dan. And they turned their faces, and said unto Micah, What aileth thee, that thou comest with such a company?

verses.english:
They called out to the Danites, who turned around and said to
Micah, “What’s the matter? Why have you mustered?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶת־אֱלֹהַי אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי לְקַחְתֶּם וְאֶת־הַכֹּהֵן וַתֵּלְכוּ וּמַה־לִּי עוֹד וּמַה־זֶּה תֹּאמְרוּ אֵלַי מַה־לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶת־אֱלֹהַי אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי לְקַחְתֶּם וְאֶת־הַכֹּהֵן וַתֵּלְכוּ וּמַה־לִּי עוֹד וּמַה־זֶּה תֹּאמְרוּ אֵלַי מַה־לָּךְ׃

english.text:
He said, “You have taken my priest and the gods that I made, and
walked off! What do I have left? How can you ask, ‘What’s the
matter’?”

translation.text: And he said, Ye have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and ye are gone away: and what have I more? and what is this that ye say unto me, What aileth thee?

verses.english:
He said, “You have taken my priest and the gods that I made, and
walked off! What do I have left? How can you ask, ‘What’s the
matter’?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו בְּנֵי־דָן אַל־תַּשְׁמַע קוֹלְךָ עִמָּנוּ פֶּן־יִפְגְּעוּ בָכֶם אֲנָשִׁים מָרֵי נֶפֶשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּה נַפְשְׁךָ וְנֶפֶשׁ בֵּיתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו בְּנֵי־דָן אַל־תַּשְׁמַע קוֹלְךָ עִמָּנוּ פֶּן־יִפְגְּעוּ בָכֶם אֲנָשִׁים מָרֵי נֶפֶשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּה נַפְשְׁךָ וְנֶפֶשׁ בֵּיתֶךָ׃

english.text:
But the Danites replied, “Don’t do any shouting at us, or some
desperate men might attack you, and you and your family would lose
your lives.”

translation.text: And the children of Dan said unto him, Let not thy voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows run upon thee, and thou lose thy life, with the lives of thy household.

verses.english:
But the Danites replied, “Don’t do any shouting at us, or some
desperate men might attack you, and you and your family would lose
your lives.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְנֵי־דָן לְדַרְכָּם וַיַּרְא מִיכָה כִּי־חֲזָקִים הֵמָּה מִמֶּנּוּ וַיִּפֶן וַיָּשׁב אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְנֵי־דָן לְדַרְכָּם וַיַּרְא מִיכָה כִּי־חֲזָקִים הֵמָּה מִמֶּנּוּ וַיִּפֶן וַיָּשׁב אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
So Micah, realizing that they were stronger than he, turned back
and went home; and the Danites went on their way,

translation.text: And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house.

verses.english:
So Micah, realizing that they were stronger than he, turned back
and went home; and the Danites went on their way,

verses.hebrew: וְהֵמָּה לָקְחוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה מִיכָה וְאֶת־הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר הָיָה־לוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַל־לַיִשׁ עַל־עַם שֹׁקֵט וּבֹטֵחַ וַיַּכּוּ אוֹתָם לְפִי־חָרֶב וְאֶת־הָעִיר שָׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵמָּה לָקְחוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה מִיכָה וְאֶת־הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר הָיָה־לוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַל־לַיִשׁ עַל־עַם שֹׁקֵט וּבֹטֵחַ וַיַּכּוּ אוֹתָם לְפִי־חָרֶב וְאֶת־הָעִיר שָׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
taking the things Micah had made and the priest he had acquired.
They proceeded to Laish, a people tranquil and unsuspecting, and
they put them to the sword and burned down the town.

translation.text: And they took the things which Micah had made, and the priest which he had, and came unto Laish, unto a people that were at quiet and secure: and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire.

verses.english:
taking the things Micah had made and the priest he had acquired.
They proceeded to Laish, a people tranquil and unsuspecting, and
they put them to the sword and burned down the town.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵין מַצִּיל כִּי רְחוֹקָה־הִיא מִצִּידוֹן וְדָבָר אֵין־לָהֶם עִם־אָדָם וְהִיא בָּעֵמֶק אֲשֶׁר לְבֵית־רְחוֹב וַיִּבְנוּ אֶת־הָעִיר וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵין מַצִּיל כִּי רְחוֹקָה־הִיא מִצִּידוֹן וְדָבָר אֵין־לָהֶם עִם־אָדָם וְהִיא בָּעֵמֶק אֲשֶׁר לְבֵית־רְחוֹב וַיִּבְנוּ אֶת־הָעִיר וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ׃

english.text:
There was none to come to the rescue, for it was distant from
Sidon and they had no dealings with anyone; it lay in the valley
of Beth-rehob. They rebuilt the town and settled there,

translation.text: And there was no deliverer, because it was far from Zidon, and they had no business with any man; and it was in the valley that lieth by Bethrehob. And they built a city, and dwelt therein.

verses.english:
There was none to come to the rescue, for it was distant from
Sidon and they had no dealings with anyone; it lay in the valley
of Beth-rehob. They rebuilt the town and settled there,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ שֵׁם־הָעִיר דָּן בְּשֵׁם דָּן אֲבִיהֶם אֲשֶׁר יוּלַּד לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְאוּלָם לַיִשׁ שֵׁם־הָעִיר לָרִאשֹׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ שֵׁם־הָעִיר דָּן בְּשֵׁם דָּן אֲבִיהֶם אֲשֶׁר יוּלַּד לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְאוּלָם לַיִשׁ שֵׁם־הָעִיר לָרִאשֹׁנָה׃

english.text:
and they named the town Dan, after their ancestor Dan who was
Israel’s son. Originally, however, the name of the town was Laish.

translation.text: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born unto Israel: howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first.

verses.english:
and they named the town Dan, after their ancestor Dan who was
Israel’s son. Originally, however, the name of the town was Laish.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקִימוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי־דָן אֶת־הַפָּסֶל וִיהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־גֵּרְשֹׁם בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה הוּא וּבָנָיו הָיוּ כֹהֲנִים לְשֵׁבֶט הַדָּנִי עַד־יוֹם גְּלוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקִימוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי־דָן אֶת־הַפָּסֶל וִיהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־גֵּרְשֹׁם בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה הוּא וּבָנָיו הָיוּ כֹהֲנִים לְשֵׁבֶט הַדָּנִי עַד־יוֹם גְּלוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
The Danites set up the sculptured image for themselves; and
Jonathan son of Gershom son of Manasseh, and his descendants,
served as priests to the Danite tribe until the land went into
exile.

translation.text: And the children of Dan set up the graven image: and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.

verses.english:
The Danites set up the sculptured image for themselves; and
Jonathan son of Gershom son of Manasseh, and his descendants,
served as priests to the Danite tribe until the land went into
exile.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ לָהֶם אֶת־פֶּסֶל מִיכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה כּל־יְמֵי הֱיוֹת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִים בְּשִׁלֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ לָהֶם אֶת־פֶּסֶל מִיכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה כּל־יְמֵי הֱיוֹת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִים בְּשִׁלֹה׃

english.text:
They maintained the sculptured image that Micah had made
throughout the time that the House of God stood at Shiloh.

translation.text: And they set them up Micah’s graven image, which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.

verses.english:
They maintained the sculptured image that Micah had made
throughout the time that the House of God stood at Shiloh.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וּמֶלֶךְ אֵין בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְהִי אִישׁ לֵוִי גָּר בְּיַרְכְּתֵי הַר־אֶפְרַיִם וַיִּקַּח־לוֹ אִשָּׁה פִילֶגֶשׁ מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וּמֶלֶךְ אֵין בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְהִי אִישׁ לֵוִי גָּר בְּיַרְכְּתֵי הַר־אֶפְרַיִם וַיִּקַּח־לוֹ אִשָּׁה פִילֶגֶשׁ מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
In those days, when there was no king in Israel, a Levite residing
at the other end of the hill country of Ephraim took to himself a
concubine from Bethlehem in Judah.

translation.text: And it came to pass in those days, when there was no king in Israel, that there was a certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount Ephraim, who took to him a concubine out of Bethlehemjudah.

verses.english:
In those days, when there was no king in Israel, a Levite residing
at the other end of the hill country of Ephraim took to himself a
concubine from Bethlehem in Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּזְנֶה עָלָיו פִּילַגְשׁוֹ וַתֵּלֶךְ מֵאִתּוֹ אֶל־בֵּית אָבִיהָ אֶל־בֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה וַתְּהִי־שָׁם יָמִים אַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּזְנֶה עָלָיו פִּילַגְשׁוֹ וַתֵּלֶךְ מֵאִתּוֹ אֶל־בֵּית אָבִיהָ אֶל־בֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה וַתְּהִי־שָׁם יָמִים אַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים׃

english.text:
Once his concubine deserted him, leaving him for her father’s
house in Bethlehem in Judah; and she stayed there a full four
months.

translation.text: And his concubine played the whore against him, and went away from him unto her father’s house to Bethlehemjudah, and was there four whole months.

verses.english:
Once his concubine deserted him, leaving him for her father’s
house in Bethlehem in Judah; and she stayed there a full four
months.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקם אִישָׁהּ וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֶיהָ לְדַבֵּר עַל־לִבָּהּ (להשיבו) [לַהֲשִׁיבָהּ] וְנַעֲרוֹ עִמּוֹ וְצֶמֶד חֲמֹרִים וַתְּבִיאֵהוּ בֵּית אָבִיהָ וַיִּרְאֵהוּ אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָה
וַיִּשְׂמַח לִקְרָאתוֹ׃
