hebrew.text:
וַיָּקם אִישָׁהּ וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֶיהָ לְדַבֵּר עַל־לִבָּהּ (להשיבו) [לַהֲשִׁיבָהּ] וְנַעֲרוֹ עִמּוֹ וְצֶמֶד חֲמֹרִים וַתְּבִיאֵהוּ בֵּית אָבִיהָ וַיִּרְאֵהוּ אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָה
וַיִּשְׂמַח לִקְרָאתוֹ׃

english.text:
Then her husband set out, with an attendant and a pair of donkeys,
and went after her to woo her and to win her back. She admitted
him into her father’s house; and when the girl’s father saw him,
he received him warmly.

translation.text: And her husband arose, and went after her, to speak friendly unto her, and to bring her again, having his servant with him, and a couple of asses: and she brought him into her father’s house: and when the father of the damsel saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

verses.english:
Then her husband set out, with an attendant and a pair of donkeys,
and went after her to woo her and to win her back. She admitted
him into her father’s house; and when the girl’s father saw him,
he received him warmly.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲזֶק־בּוֹ חֹתְנוֹ אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָה וַיֵּשֶׁב אִתּוֹ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ וַיָּלִינוּ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲזֶק־בּוֹ חֹתְנוֹ אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָה וַיֵּשֶׁב אִתּוֹ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ וַיָּלִינוּ שָׁם׃

english.text:
His father-in-law, the girl’s father, pressed him, and he stayed
with him three days; they ate and drank and lodged there.

translation.text: And his father in law, the damsel’s father, retained him; and he abode with him three days: so they did eat and drink, and lodged there.

verses.english:
His father-in-law, the girl’s father, pressed him, and he stayed
with him three days; they ate and drank and lodged there.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הָרְבִיעִי וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ בַבֹּקֶר וַיָּקם לָלֶכֶת וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָה אֶל־חֲתָנוֹ סְעָד לִבְּךָ פַּת־לֶחֶם וְאַחַר תֵּלֵכוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הָרְבִיעִי וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ בַבֹּקֶר וַיָּקם לָלֶכֶת וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָה אֶל־חֲתָנוֹ סְעָד לִבְּךָ פַּת־לֶחֶם וְאַחַר תֵּלֵכוּ׃

english.text:
Early in the morning of the fourth day, he started to leave; but
the girl’s father said to his son-in-law, “Eat something to give
you strength, then you can leave.”

translation.text: And it came to pass on the fourth day, when they arose early in the morning, that he rose up to depart: and the damsel’s father said unto his son in law, Comfort thine heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward go your way.

verses.english:
Early in the morning of the fourth day, he started to leave; but
the girl’s father said to his son-in-law, “Eat something to give
you strength, then you can leave.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ וַיֹּאכְלוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם יַחְדָּו וַיִּשְׁתּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָה אֶל־הָאִישׁ הוֹאֶל־נָא וְלִין וְיִיטַב לִבֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ וַיֹּאכְלוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם יַחְדָּו וַיִּשְׁתּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָה אֶל־הָאִישׁ הוֹאֶל־נָא וְלִין וְיִיטַב לִבֶּךָ׃

english.text:
So the two of them sat down and they feasted together. Then the
girl’s father said to the man, “Won’t you stay overnight and enjoy
yourself?”

translation.text: And they sat down, and did eat and drink both of them together: for the damsel’s father had said unto the man, Be content, I pray thee, and tarry all night, and let thine heart be merry.

verses.english:
So the two of them sat down and they feasted together. Then the
girl’s father said to the man, “Won’t you stay overnight and enjoy
yourself?”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם הָאִישׁ לָלֶכֶת וַיִּפְצַר־בּוֹ חֹתְנוֹ וַיָּשׁב וַיָּלֶן שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם הָאִישׁ לָלֶכֶת וַיִּפְצַר־בּוֹ חֹתְנוֹ וַיָּשׁב וַיָּלֶן שָׁם׃

english.text:
The man started to leave, but his father-in-law kept urging him
until he turned back and spent the night there.

translation.text: And when the man rose up to depart, his father in law urged him: therefore he lodged there again.

verses.english:
The man started to leave, but his father-in-law kept urging him
until he turned back and spent the night there.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם בַּבֹּקֶר בַּיּוֹם הַחֲמִישִׁי לָלֶכֶת וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָה סְעד־נָא לְבָבְךָ וְהִתְמַהְמְהוּ עַד־נְטוֹת הַיּוֹם וַיֹּאכְלוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם בַּבֹּקֶר בַּיּוֹם הַחֲמִישִׁי לָלֶכֶת וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָה סְעד־נָא לְבָבְךָ וְהִתְמַהְמְהוּ עַד־נְטוֹת הַיּוֹם וַיֹּאכְלוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Early in the morning of the fifth day, he was about to leave, when
the girl’s father said, “Come, have a bite.” The two of them ate,
dawdling until past noon.

translation.text: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart; and the damsel’s father said, Comfort thine heart, I pray thee. And they tarried until afternoon, and they did eat both of them.

verses.english:
Early in the morning of the fifth day, he was about to leave, when
the girl’s father said, “Come, have a bite.” The two of them ate,
dawdling until past noon.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקם הָאִישׁ לָלֶכֶת הוּא וּפִילַגְשׁוֹ וְנַעֲרוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ חֹתְנוֹ אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָה הִנֵּה נָא רָפָה הַיּוֹם לַעֲרוֹב לִינוּ־נָא הִנֵּה חֲנוֹת הַיּוֹם לִין פֹּה וְיִיטַב
לְבָבֶךָ וְהִשְׁכַּמְתֶּם מָחָר לְדַרְכְּכֶם וְהָלַכְתָּ לְאֹהָלֶךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקם הָאִישׁ לָלֶכֶת הוּא וּפִילַגְשׁוֹ וְנַעֲרוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ חֹתְנוֹ אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָה הִנֵּה נָא רָפָה הַיּוֹם לַעֲרוֹב לִינוּ־נָא הִנֵּה חֲנוֹת הַיּוֹם לִין פֹּה וְיִיטַב
לְבָבֶךָ וְהִשְׁכַּמְתֶּם מָחָר לְדַרְכְּכֶם וְהָלַכְתָּ לְאֹהָלֶךָ׃

english.text:
Then the man, his concubine, and his attendant started to leave.
His father-in-law, the girl’s father, said to him, “Look, the day
is waning toward evening; do stop for the night. See, the day is
declining; spend the night here and enjoy yourself. You can start
early tomorrow on your journey and head for home.”

translation.text: And when the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father in law, the damsel’s father, said unto him, Behold, now the day draweth toward evening, I pray you tarry all night: behold, the day groweth to an end, lodge here, that thine heart may be merry; and to morrow get you early on your way, that thou mayest go home.

verses.english:
Then the man, his concubine, and his attendant started to leave.
His father-in-law, the girl’s father, said to him, “Look, the day
is waning toward evening; do stop for the night. See, the day is
declining; spend the night here and enjoy yourself. You can start
early tomorrow on your journey and head for home.”

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־אָבָה הָאִישׁ לָלוּן וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּבֹא עַד־נֹכַח יְבוּס הִיא יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְעִמּוֹ צֶמֶד חֲמוֹרִים חֲבוּשִׁים וּפִילַגְשׁוֹ עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־אָבָה הָאִישׁ לָלוּן וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּבֹא עַד־נֹכַח יְבוּס הִיא יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְעִמּוֹ צֶמֶד חֲמוֹרִים חֲבוּשִׁים וּפִילַגְשׁוֹ עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
But the man refused to stay for the night. He set out and traveled
as far as the vicinity of Jebus—that is, Jerusalem; he had with
him a pair of laden donkeys, and his concubine was with him.

translation.text: But the man would not tarry that night, but he rose up and departed, and came over against Jebus, which is Jerusalem; and there were with him two asses saddled, his concubine also was with him.

verses.english:
But the man refused to stay for the night. He set out and traveled
as far as the vicinity of Jebus—that is, Jerusalem; he had with
him a pair of laden donkeys, and his concubine was with him.

verses.hebrew: הֵם עִם־יְבוּס וְהַיּוֹם רַד מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר הַנַּעַר אֶל־אֲדֹנָיו לְכָה־נָּא וְנָסוּרָה אֶל־עִיר־הַיְבוּסִי הַזֹּאת וְנָלִין בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: הֵם עִם־יְבוּס וְהַיּוֹם רַד מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר הַנַּעַר אֶל־אֲדֹנָיו לְכָה־נָּא וְנָסוּרָה אֶל־עִיר־הַיְבוּסִי הַזֹּאת וְנָלִין בָּהּ׃

english.text:
Since they were close to Jebus, and the day was very far spent,
the attendant said to his master, “Let us turn aside to this town
of the Jebusites and spend the night in it.”

translation.text: And when they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said unto his master, Come, I pray thee, and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites, and lodge in it.

verses.english:
Since they were close to Jebus, and the day was very far spent,
the attendant said to his master, “Let us turn aside to this town
of the Jebusites and spend the night in it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֲדֹנָיו לֹא נָסוּר אֶל־עִיר נכְרִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵנָּה וְעָבַרְנוּ עַד־גִּבְעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֲדֹנָיו לֹא נָסוּר אֶל־עִיר נכְרִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵנָּה וְעָבַרְנוּ עַד־גִּבְעָה׃

english.text:
But his master said to him, “We will not turn aside to a town of
aliens who are not of Israel, but will continue to Gibeah.

translation.text: And his master said unto him, We will not turn aside hither into the city of a stranger, that is not of the children of Israel; we will pass over to Gibeah.

verses.english:
But his master said to him, “We will not turn aside to a town of
aliens who are not of Israel, but will continue to Gibeah.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְנַעֲרוֹ לְךָ וְנִקְרְבָה בְּאַחַד הַמְּקֹמוֹת וְלַנּוּ בַגִּבְעָה אוֹ בָרָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְנַעֲרוֹ לְךָ וְנִקְרְבָה בְּאַחַד הַמְּקֹמוֹת וְלַנּוּ בַגִּבְעָה אוֹ בָרָמָה׃

english.text:
Come,” he said to his attendant, “let us approach one of those
places and spend the night either in Gibeah or in Ramah.”

translation.text: And he said unto his servant, Come, and let us draw near to one of these places to lodge all night, in Gibeah, or in Ramah.

verses.english:
Come,” he said to his attendant, “let us approach one of those
places and spend the night either in Gibeah or in Ramah.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְרוּ וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַתָּבֹא לָהֶם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אֵצֶל הַגִּבְעָה אֲשֶׁר לְבִנְיָמִן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַבְרוּ וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַתָּבֹא לָהֶם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אֵצֶל הַגִּבְעָה אֲשֶׁר לְבִנְיָמִן׃

english.text:
So they traveled on, and the sun set when they were near Gibeah of
Benjamin.

translation.text: And they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down upon them when they were by Gibeah, which belongeth to Benjamin.

verses.english:
So they traveled on, and the sun set when they were near Gibeah of
Benjamin.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּסֻרוּ שָׁם לָבוֹא לָלוּן בַּגִּבְעָה וַיָּבֹא וַיֵּשֶׁב בִּרְחוֹב הָעִיר וְאֵין אִישׁ מְאַסֵּף־אוֹתָם הַבַּיְתָה לָלוּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּסֻרוּ שָׁם לָבוֹא לָלוּן בַּגִּבְעָה וַיָּבֹא וַיֵּשֶׁב בִּרְחוֹב הָעִיר וְאֵין אִישׁ מְאַסֵּף־אוֹתָם הַבַּיְתָה לָלוּן׃

english.text:
They turned off there and went in to spend the night in Gibeah. He
went and sat down in the town square, but nobody took them indoors
to spend the night.

translation.text: And they turned aside thither, to go in and to lodge in Gibeah: and when he went in, he sat him down in a street of the city: for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging.

verses.english:
They turned off there and went in to spend the night in Gibeah. He
went and sat down in the town square, but nobody took them indoors
to spend the night.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ זָקֵן בָּא מִן־מַעֲשֵׂהוּ מִן־הַשָּׂדֶה בָּעֶרֶב וְהָאִישׁ מֵהַר אֶפְרַיִם וְהוּא־גָר בַּגִּבְעָה וְאַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם בְּנֵי יְמִינִי׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ זָקֵן בָּא מִן־מַעֲשֵׂהוּ מִן־הַשָּׂדֶה בָּעֶרֶב וְהָאִישׁ מֵהַר אֶפְרַיִם וְהוּא־גָר בַּגִּבְעָה וְאַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם בְּנֵי יְמִינִי׃

english.text:
In the evening, an old man came along from his property outside
the town. (This man hailed from the hill country of Ephraim and
resided at Gibeah, where the townspeople were Benjaminites.)

translation.text: And, behold, there came an old man from his work out of the field at even, which was also of mount Ephraim; and he sojourned in Gibeah: but the men of the place were Benjamites.

verses.english:
In the evening, an old man came along from his property outside
the town. (This man hailed from the hill country of Ephraim and
resided at Gibeah, where the townspeople were Benjaminites.)

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת־הָאִישׁ הָאֹרֵחַ בִּרְחֹב הָעִיר וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ הַזָּקֵן אָנָה תֵלֵךְ וּמֵאַיִן תָּבוֹא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת־הָאִישׁ הָאֹרֵחַ בִּרְחֹב הָעִיר וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ הַזָּקֵן אָנָה תֵלֵךְ וּמֵאַיִן תָּבוֹא׃

english.text:
He happened to see the wayfarer in the town square. “Where,” the
old man inquired, “are you going to, and where do you come from?”

translation.text: And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city: and the old man said, Whither goest thou? and whence comest thou?

verses.english:
He happened to see the wayfarer in the town square. “Where,” the
old man inquired, “are you going to, and where do you come from?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו עֹבְרִים אֲנַחְנוּ מִבֵּית־לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה עַד־יַרְכְּתֵי הַר־אֶפְרַיִם מִשָּׁם אָנֹכִי וָאֵלֵךְ עַד־בֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֲנִי הֹלֵךְ וְאֵין
אִישׁ מְאַסֵּף אוֹתִי הַבָּיְתָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו עֹבְרִים אֲנַחְנוּ מִבֵּית־לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה עַד־יַרְכְּתֵי הַר־אֶפְרַיִם מִשָּׁם אָנֹכִי וָאֵלֵךְ עַד־בֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֲנִי הֹלֵךְ וְאֵין
אִישׁ מְאַסֵּף אוֹתִי הַבָּיְתָה׃

english.text:
He replied, “We are traveling from Bethlehem in Judah to the other
end of the hill country of Ephraim. That is where I live. I made a
journey to Bethlehem of Judah, and now I am on my way to the House
of YHWH, and nobody has taken me indoors.

translation.text: And he said unto him, We are passing from Bethlehemjudah toward the side of mount Ephraim; from thence am I: and I went to Bethlehemjudah, but I am now going to the house of the LORD; and there is no man that receiveth me to house.

verses.english:
He replied, “We are traveling from Bethlehem in Judah to the other
end of the hill country of Ephraim. That is where I live. I made a
journey to Bethlehem of Judah, and now I am on my way to the House
of YHWH, and nobody has taken me indoors.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם־תֶּבֶן גַּם־מִסְפּוֹא יֵשׁ לַחֲמוֹרֵינוּ וְגַם לֶחֶם וָיַיִן יֶשׁ־לִי וְלַאֲמָתֶךָ וְלַנַּעַר עִם־עֲבָדֶיךָ אֵין מַחְסוֹר כּל־דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם־תֶּבֶן גַּם־מִסְפּוֹא יֵשׁ לַחֲמוֹרֵינוּ וְגַם לֶחֶם וָיַיִן יֶשׁ־לִי וְלַאֲמָתֶךָ וְלַנַּעַר עִם־עֲבָדֶיךָ אֵין מַחְסוֹר כּל־דָּבָר׃

english.text:
We have both bruised straw and feed for our donkeys, and bread and
wine for me and your handmaid, and for the attendant with your
servants. We lack nothing.”

translation.text: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for thy handmaid, and for the young man which is with thy servants: there is no want of any thing.

verses.english:
We have both bruised straw and feed for our donkeys, and bread and
wine for me and your handmaid, and for the attendant with your
servants. We lack nothing.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ הַזָּקֵן שָׁלוֹם לָךְ רַק כּל־מַחְסוֹרְךָ עָלָי רַק בָּרְחוֹב אַל־תָּלַן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ הַזָּקֵן שָׁלוֹם לָךְ רַק כּל־מַחְסוֹרְךָ עָלָי רַק בָּרְחוֹב אַל־תָּלַן׃

english.text:
“Rest easy,” said the old man. “Let me take care of all your
needs. Do not on any account spend the night in the square.”

translation.text: And the old man said, Peace be with thee; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.

verses.english:
“Rest easy,” said the old man. “Let me take care of all your
needs. Do not on any account spend the night in the square.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְבִיאֵהוּ לְבֵיתוֹ (ויבול) [וַיָּבל] לַחֲמוֹרִים וַיִּרְחֲצוּ רַגְלֵיהֶם וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבִיאֵהוּ לְבֵיתוֹ (ויבול) [וַיָּבל] לַחֲמוֹרִים וַיִּרְחֲצוּ רַגְלֵיהֶם וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ׃

english.text:
And he took him into his house. He mixed fodder for the donkeys;
then they bathed their feet and ate and drank.

translation.text: So he brought him into his house, and gave provender unto the asses: and they washed their feet, and did eat and drink.

verses.english:
And he took him into his house. He mixed fodder for the donkeys;
then they bathed their feet and ate and drank.

verses.hebrew:
הֵמָּה מֵיטִיבִים אֶת־לִבָּם וְהִנֵּה אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר אַנְשֵׁי בְנֵי־בְלִיַּעַל נָסַבּוּ אֶת־הַבַּיִת מִתְדַּפְּקִים עַל־הַדָּלֶת וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הָאִישׁ בַּעַל הַבַּיִת הַזָּקֵן
לֵאמֹר הוֹצֵא אֶת־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּא אֶל־בֵּיתְךָ וְנֵדָעֶנּוּ׃

hebrew.text:
הֵמָּה מֵיטִיבִים אֶת־לִבָּם וְהִנֵּה אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר אַנְשֵׁי בְנֵי־בְלִיַּעַל נָסַבּוּ אֶת־הַבַּיִת מִתְדַּפְּקִים עַל־הַדָּלֶת וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הָאִישׁ בַּעַל הַבַּיִת הַזָּקֵן
לֵאמֹר הוֹצֵא אֶת־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּא אֶל־בֵּיתְךָ וְנֵדָעֶנּוּ׃

english.text:
While they were enjoying themselves, the men of the town, a
depraved lot, had gathered about the house and were pounding on
the door. They called to the aged owner of the house, “Bring out
the man who has come into your house, so that we can be intimate
with him.”

translation.text: Now as they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain sons of Belial, beset the house round about, and beat at the door, and spake to the master of the house, the old man, saying, Bring forth the man that came into thine house, that we may know him.

verses.english:
While they were enjoying themselves, the men of the town, a
depraved lot, had gathered about the house and were pounding on
the door. They called to the aged owner of the house, “Bring out
the man who has come into your house, so that we can be intimate
with him.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא אֲלֵיהֶם הָאִישׁ בַּעַל הַבַּיִת וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַל־אַחַי אַל־תָּרֵעוּ נָא אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־בָּא הָאִישׁ הַזֶּה אֶל־בֵּיתִי אַל־תַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת־הַנְּבָלָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא אֲלֵיהֶם הָאִישׁ בַּעַל הַבַּיִת וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַל־אַחַי אַל־תָּרֵעוּ נָא אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־בָּא הָאִישׁ הַזֶּה אֶל־בֵּיתִי אַל־תַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת־הַנְּבָלָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
The owner of the house went out and said to them, “Please, my
friends, do not commit such a wrong. Since this man has entered my
house, do not perpetrate this outrage.

translation.text: And the man, the master of the house, went out unto them, and said unto them, Nay, my brethren, nay, I pray you, do not so wickedly; seeing that this man is come into mine house, do not this folly.

verses.english:
The owner of the house went out and said to them, “Please, my
friends, do not commit such a wrong. Since this man has entered my
house, do not perpetrate this outrage.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה בִתִּי הַבְּתוּלָה וּפִילַגְשֵׁהוּ אוֹצִיאָה־נָּא אוֹתָם וְעַנּוּ אוֹתָם וַעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶם וְלָאִישׁ הַזֶּה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ דְּבַר הַנְּבָלָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה בִתִּי הַבְּתוּלָה וּפִילַגְשֵׁהוּ אוֹצִיאָה־נָּא אוֹתָם וְעַנּוּ אוֹתָם וַעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶם וְלָאִישׁ הַזֶּה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ דְּבַר הַנְּבָלָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
Look, here is my virgin daughter, and his concubine. Let me bring
them out to you. Have your pleasure of them, do what you like with
them; but don’t do that outrageous thing to this man.”

translation.text: Behold, here is my daughter a maiden, and his concubine; them I will bring out now, and humble ye them, and do with them what seemeth good unto you: but unto this man do not so vile a thing.

verses.english:
Look, here is my virgin daughter, and his concubine. Let me bring
them out to you. Have your pleasure of them, do what you like with
them; but don’t do that outrageous thing to this man.”

verses.hebrew:
וְלֹא־אָבוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים לִשְׁמֹעַ לוֹ וַיַּחֲזֵק הָאִישׁ בְּפִילַגְשׁוֹ וַיֹּצֵא אֲלֵיהֶם הַחוּץ וַיֵּדְעוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיִּתְעַלְּלוּ־בָהּ כּל־הַלַּיְלָה עַד־הַבֹּקֶר וַיְשַׁלְּחוּהָ
(בעלות) [כַּעֲלוֹת] הַשָּׁחַר׃

hebrew.text:
וְלֹא־אָבוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים לִשְׁמֹעַ לוֹ וַיַּחֲזֵק הָאִישׁ בְּפִילַגְשׁוֹ וַיֹּצֵא אֲלֵיהֶם הַחוּץ וַיֵּדְעוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיִּתְעַלְּלוּ־בָהּ כּל־הַלַּיְלָה עַד־הַבֹּקֶר וַיְשַׁלְּחוּהָ
(בעלות) [כַּעֲלוֹת] הַשָּׁחַר׃

english.text:
But the men would not listen to him, so the man seized his
concubine and pushed her out to them. They raped her and abused
her all night long until morning; and they let her go when dawn
broke.

translation.text: But the men would not hearken to him: so the man took his concubine, and brought her forth unto them; and they knew her, and abused her all the night until the morning: and when the day began to spring, they let her go.

verses.english:
But the men would not listen to him, so the man seized his
concubine and pushed her out to them. They raped her and abused
her all night long until morning; and they let her go when dawn
broke.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא הָאִשָּׁה לִפְנוֹת הַבֹּקֶר וַתִּפֹּל פֶּתַח בֵּית־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־אֲדוֹנֶיהָ שָּׁם עַד־הָאוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּבֹא הָאִשָּׁה לִפְנוֹת הַבֹּקֶר וַתִּפֹּל פֶּתַח בֵּית־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־אֲדוֹנֶיהָ שָּׁם עַד־הָאוֹר׃

english.text:
Toward morning the woman came back; and as it was growing light,
she collapsed at the entrance of the man’s house where her husband
was.

translation.text: Then came the woman in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her lord was, till it was light.

verses.english:
Toward morning the woman came back; and as it was growing light,
she collapsed at the entrance of the man’s house where her husband
was.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם אֲדֹנֶיהָ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּפְתַּח דַּלְתוֹת הַבַּיִת וַיֵּצֵא לָלֶכֶת לְדַרְכּוֹ וְהִנֵּה הָאִשָּׁה פִילַגְשׁוֹ נֹפֶלֶת פֶּתַח הַבַּיִת וְיָדֶיהָ עַל־הַסַּף׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם אֲדֹנֶיהָ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּפְתַּח דַּלְתוֹת הַבַּיִת וַיֵּצֵא לָלֶכֶת לְדַרְכּוֹ וְהִנֵּה הָאִשָּׁה פִילַגְשׁוֹ נֹפֶלֶת פֶּתַח הַבַּיִת וְיָדֶיהָ עַל־הַסַּף׃

english.text:
When her husband arose in the morning, he opened the doors of the
house and went out to continue his journey; and there was the
woman, his concubine, lying at the entrance of the house, with her
hands on the threshold.

translation.text: And her lord rose up in the morning, and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way: and, behold, the woman his concubine was fallen down at the door of the house, and her hands were upon the threshold.

verses.english:
When her husband arose in the morning, he opened the doors of the
house and went out to continue his journey; and there was the
woman, his concubine, lying at the entrance of the house, with her
hands on the threshold.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ קוּמִי וְנֵלֵכָה וְאֵין עֹנֶה וַיִּקָּחֶהָ עַל־הַחֲמוֹר וַיָּקם הָאִישׁ וַיֵּלֶךְ לִמְקֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ קוּמִי וְנֵלֵכָה וְאֵין עֹנֶה וַיִּקָּחֶהָ עַל־הַחֲמוֹר וַיָּקם הָאִישׁ וַיֵּלֶךְ לִמְקֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
“Get up,” he said to her, “let us go.” But there was no reply. So
the man placed her on the donkey and set out for home.

translation.text: And he said unto her, Up, and let us be going. But none answered.

verses.english:
“Get up,” he said to her, “let us go.” But there was no reply. So
the man placed her on the donkey and set out for home.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הַמַּאֲכֶלֶת וַיַּחֲזֵק בְּפִילַגְשׁוֹ וַיְנַתְּחֶהָ לַעֲצָמֶיהָ לִשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר נְתָחִים וַיְשַׁלְּחֶהָ בְּכֹל גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הַמַּאֲכֶלֶת וַיַּחֲזֵק בְּפִילַגְשׁוֹ וַיְנַתְּחֶהָ לַעֲצָמֶיהָ לִשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר נְתָחִים וַיְשַׁלְּחֶהָ בְּכֹל גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
When he came home, he picked up a knife, and took hold of his
concubine and cut her up limb by limb into twelve parts. He sent
them throughout the territory of Israel.

translation.text: And when he was come into his house, he took a knife, and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, together with her bones, into twelve pieces, and sent her into all the coasts of Israel.

verses.english:
When he came home, he picked up a knife, and took hold of his
concubine and cut her up limb by limb into twelve parts. He sent
them throughout the territory of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כל־הָרֹאֶה וְאָמַר לֹא־נִהְיְתָה וְלֹא־נִרְאֲתָה כָּזֹאת לְמִיּוֹם עֲלוֹת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה שִׂימוּ־לָכֶם עָלֶיהָ עֻצוּ וְדַבֵּרוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כל־הָרֹאֶה וְאָמַר לֹא־נִהְיְתָה וְלֹא־נִרְאֲתָה כָּזֹאת לְמִיּוֹם עֲלוֹת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה שִׂימוּ־לָכֶם עָלֶיהָ עֻצוּ וְדַבֵּרוּ׃

english.text:
And everyone who saw it cried out, “Never has such a thing
happened or been seen from the day the Israelites came out of the
land of Egypt to this day! Put your mind to this; take counsel and
decide.”

translation.text: And it was so, that all that saw it said, There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day: consider of it, take advice, and speak your minds.

verses.english:
And everyone who saw it cried out, “Never has such a thing
happened or been seen from the day the Israelites came out of the
land of Egypt to this day! Put your mind to this; take counsel and
decide.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתִּקָּהֵל הָעֵדָה כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד לְמִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע וְאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד אֶל־יְהֹוָה הַמִּצְפָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתִּקָּהֵל הָעֵדָה כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד לְמִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע וְאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד אֶל־יְהֹוָה הַמִּצְפָּה׃

english.text:
Thereupon all the Israelites—from Dan to Beer-sheba and [from] the
land of Gilead—marched forth, and the community assembled to a man
before YHWH at Mizpah.

translation.text: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land of Gilead, unto the LORD in Mizpeh.

verses.english:
Thereupon all the Israelites—from Dan to Beer-sheba and [from] the
land of Gilead—marched forth, and the community assembled to a man
before YHWH at Mizpah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְיַצְּבוּ פִּנּוֹת כּל־הָעָם כֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְהַל עַם הָאֱלֹהִים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף אִישׁ רַגְלִי שֹׁלֵף־חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְיַצְּבוּ פִּנּוֹת כּל־הָעָם כֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְהַל עַם הָאֱלֹהִים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף אִישׁ רַגְלִי שֹׁלֵף־חָרֶב׃

english.text:
All the leaders of the people [and] all the tribes of Israel
presented themselves in the assembly of God’s people, 400,000
fighting men on foot.—

translation.text: And the chief of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.

verses.english:
All the leaders of the people [and] all the tribes of Israel
presented themselves in the assembly of God’s people, 400,000
fighting men on foot.—

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן כִּי־עָלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּצְפָּה וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דַּבְּרוּ אֵיכָה נִהְיְתָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן כִּי־עָלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּצְפָּה וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דַּבְּרוּ אֵיכָה נִהְיְתָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
The Benjaminites heard that the Israelites had come up to
Mizpah.—The Israelites said, “Tell us, how did this evil thing
happen?”

translation.text: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpeh.) Then said the children of Israel, Tell us, how was this wickedness?

verses.english:
The Benjaminites heard that the Israelites had come up to
Mizpah.—The Israelites said, “Tell us, how did this evil thing
happen?”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הָאִישׁ הַלֵּוִי אִישׁ הָאִשָּׁה הַנִּרְצָחָה וַיֹּאמַר הַגִּבְעָתָה אֲשֶׁר לְבִנְיָמִן בָּאתִי אֲנִי וּפִילַגְשִׁי לָלוּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן הָאִישׁ הַלֵּוִי אִישׁ הָאִשָּׁה הַנִּרְצָחָה וַיֹּאמַר הַגִּבְעָתָה אֲשֶׁר לְבִנְיָמִן בָּאתִי אֲנִי וּפִילַגְשִׁי לָלוּן׃

english.text:
And the Levite, the husband of the murdered woman, replied, “My
concubine and I came to Gibeah of Benjamin to spend the night.

translation.text: And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah that belongeth to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.

verses.english:
And the Levite, the husband of the murdered woman, replied, “My
concubine and I came to Gibeah of Benjamin to spend the night.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ עָלַי בַּעֲלֵי הַגִּבְעָה וַיָּסֹבּוּ עָלַי אֶת־הַבַּיִת לָיְלָה אוֹתִי דִּמּוּ לַהֲרֹג וְאֶת־פִּילַגְשִׁי עִנּוּ וַתָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֻמוּ עָלַי בַּעֲלֵי הַגִּבְעָה וַיָּסֹבּוּ עָלַי אֶת־הַבַּיִת לָיְלָה אוֹתִי דִּמּוּ לַהֲרֹג וְאֶת־פִּילַגְשִׁי עִנּוּ וַתָּמֹת׃

english.text:
The citizens of Gibeah set out to harm me. They gathered against
me around the house in the night; they meant to kill me, and they
ravished my concubine until she died.

translation.text: And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round about upon me by night, and thought to have slain me: and my concubine have they forced, that she is dead.

verses.english:
The citizens of Gibeah set out to harm me. They gathered against
me around the house in the night; they meant to kill me, and they
ravished my concubine until she died.

verses.hebrew: וָאֹחֵז בְּפִילַגְשִׁי וָאֲנַתְּחֶהָ וָאֲשַׁלְּחֶהָ בְּכל־שְׂדֵה נַחֲלַת יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי עָשׂוּ זִמָּה וּנְבָלָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹחֵז בְּפִילַגְשִׁי וָאֲנַתְּחֶהָ וָאֲשַׁלְּחֶהָ בְּכל־שְׂדֵה נַחֲלַת יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי עָשׂוּ זִמָּה וּנְבָלָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
So I took hold of my concubine and I cut her in pieces and sent
them through every part of Israel’s territory. For an outrageous
act of depravity had been committed in Israel.

translation.text: And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel: for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.

verses.english:
So I took hold of my concubine and I cut her in pieces and sent
them through every part of Israel’s territory. For an outrageous
act of depravity had been committed in Israel.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה כֻלְּכֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָבוּ לָכֶם דָּבָר וְעֵצָה הֲלֹם׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה כֻלְּכֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָבוּ לָכֶם דָּבָר וְעֵצָה הֲלֹם׃

english.text:
Now you are all Israelites; produce a plan of action here and
now!”

translation.text: Behold, ye are all children of Israel; give here your advice and counsel.

verses.english:
Now you are all Israelites; produce a plan of action here and
now!”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם כּל־הָעָם כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד לֵאמֹר לֹא נֵלֵךְ אִישׁ לְאהֳלוֹ וְלֹא נָסוּר אִישׁ לְבֵיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם כּל־הָעָם כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד לֵאמֹר לֹא נֵלֵךְ אִישׁ לְאהֳלוֹ וְלֹא נָסוּר אִישׁ לְבֵיתוֹ׃

english.text:
Then all the people rose, as one man, and declared, “We will not
go back to our homes, we will not enter our houses!

translation.text: And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any of us go to his tent, neither will we any of us turn into his house.

verses.english:
Then all the people rose, as one man, and declared, “We will not
go back to our homes, we will not enter our houses!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר נַעֲשֶׂה לַגִּבְעָה עָלֶיהָ בְּגוֹרָל׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר נַעֲשֶׂה לַגִּבְעָה עָלֶיהָ בְּגוֹרָל׃

english.text:
But this is what we will do to Gibeah: [we will wage war] against
it according to lot.

translation.text: But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah; we will go up by lot against it;

verses.english:
But this is what we will do to Gibeah: [we will wage war] against
it according to lot.

verses.hebrew:
וְלָקַחְנוּ עֲשָׂרָה אֲנָשִׁים לַמֵּאָה לְכֹל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמֵאָה לָאֶלֶף וְאֶלֶף לָרְבָבָה לָקַחַת צֵדָה לָעָם לַעֲשׂוֹת לְבוֹאָם לְגֶבַע בִּנְיָמִן כְּכל־הַנְּבָלָה
אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וְלָקַחְנוּ עֲשָׂרָה אֲנָשִׁים לַמֵּאָה לְכֹל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמֵאָה לָאֶלֶף וְאֶלֶף לָרְבָבָה לָקַחַת צֵדָה לָעָם לַעֲשׂוֹת לְבוֹאָם לְגֶבַע בִּנְיָמִן כְּכל־הַנְּבָלָה
אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
We will take from all the tribes of Israel ten men to the hundred,
a hundred to the thousand, and a thousand to the ten thousand to
supply provisions for the troops—to prepare for their going to
Geba in Benjamin for all the outrage it has committed in Israel.”

translation.text: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch victual for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel.

verses.english:
We will take from all the tribes of Israel ten men to the hundred,
a hundred to the thousand, and a thousand to the ten thousand to
supply provisions for the troops—to prepare for their going to
Geba in Benjamin for all the outrage it has committed in Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּאָסֵף כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הָעִיר כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד חֲבֵרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּאָסֵף כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הָעִיר כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד חֲבֵרִים׃

english.text:
So all the men of Israel, united as one man, massed against the
town.

translation.text: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.

verses.english:
So all the men of Israel, united as one man, massed against the
town.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנָשִׁים בְּכל־שִׁבְטֵי בִנְיָמִן לֵאמֹר מָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נִהְיְתָה בָּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנָשִׁים בְּכל־שִׁבְטֵי בִנְיָמִן לֵאמֹר מָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נִהְיְתָה בָּכֶם׃

english.text:
And the tribes of Israel sent men through the whole tribe of
Benjamin, saying, “What is this evil thing that has happened among
you?

translation.text: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, What wickedness is this that is done among you?

verses.english:
And the tribes of Israel sent men through the whole tribe of
Benjamin, saying, “What is this evil thing that has happened among
you?

verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה תְּנוּ אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־בְלִיַּעַל אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּבְעָה וּנְמִיתֵם וּנְבַעֲרָה רָעָה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא אָבוּ [בְּנֵי] בִנְיָמִן לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל אֲחֵיהֶם
בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה תְּנוּ אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־בְלִיַּעַל אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּבְעָה וּנְמִיתֵם וּנְבַעֲרָה רָעָה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא אָבוּ [בְּנֵי] בִנְיָמִן לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל אֲחֵיהֶם
בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Come, hand over those scoundrels in Gibeah so that we may put them
to death and stamp out the evil from Israel.” But the Benjaminites
would not yield to the demand of their fellow Israelites.

translation.text: Now therefore deliver us the men, the children of Belial, which are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from Israel. But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel.

verses.english:
Come, hand over those scoundrels in Gibeah so that we may put them
to death and stamp out the evil from Israel.” But the Benjaminites
would not yield to the demand of their fellow Israelites.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּאָסְפוּ בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן מִן־הֶעָרִים הַגִּבְעָתָה לָצֵאת לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּאָסְפוּ בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן מִן־הֶעָרִים הַגִּבְעָתָה לָצֵאת לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
So the Benjaminites gathered from their towns to Gibeah in order
to take the field against the Israelites.

translation.text: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.

verses.english:
So the Benjaminites gathered from their towns to Gibeah in order
to take the field against the Israelites.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְפָּקְדוּ בְנֵי בִנְיָמִן בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא מֵהֶעָרִים עֶשְׂרִים וְשִׁשָּׁה אֶלֶף אִישׁ שֹׁלֵף חָרֶב לְבַד מִיֹּשְׁבֵי הַגִּבְעָה הִתְפָּקְדוּ שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ בָּחוּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְפָּקְדוּ בְנֵי בִנְיָמִן בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא מֵהֶעָרִים עֶשְׂרִים וְשִׁשָּׁה אֶלֶף אִישׁ שֹׁלֵף חָרֶב לְבַד מִיֹּשְׁבֵי הַגִּבְעָה הִתְפָּקְדוּ שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ בָּחוּר׃

english.text:
On that day the Benjaminites mustered from the towns 26,000
fighting men, mustered apart from the inhabitants of Gibeah; 700
picked men

translation.text: And the children of Benjamin were numbered at that time out of the cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, beside the inhabitants of Gibeah, which were numbered seven hundred chosen men.

verses.english:
On that day the Benjaminites mustered from the towns 26,000
fighting men, mustered apart from the inhabitants of Gibeah; 700
picked men

verses.hebrew: מִכֹּל הָעָם הַזֶּה שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ בָּחוּר אִטֵּר יַד־יְמִינוֹ כּל־זֶה קֹלֵעַ בָּאֶבֶן אֶל־הַשַּׂעֲרָה וְלֹא יַחֲטִא׃

hebrew.text: מִכֹּל הָעָם הַזֶּה שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ בָּחוּר אִטֵּר יַד־יְמִינוֹ כּל־זֶה קֹלֵעַ בָּאֶבֶן אֶל־הַשַּׂעֲרָה וְלֹא יַחֲטִא׃

english.text:
of all this force—700 picked men—were left-handed. Every one of
them could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.

translation.text: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth, and not miss.

verses.english:
of all this force—700 picked men—were left-handed. Every one of
them could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הִתְפָּקְדוּ לְבַד מִבִּנְיָמִן אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף אִישׁ שֹׁלֵף חָרֶב כּל־זֶה אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הִתְפָּקְדוּ לְבַד מִבִּנְיָמִן אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף אִישׁ שֹׁלֵף חָרֶב כּל־זֶה אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
The men of Israel other than Benjamin mustered 400,000 fighting
men, warriors to a man.

translation.text: And the men of Israel, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these were men of war.

verses.english:
The men of Israel other than Benjamin mustered 400,000 fighting
men, warriors to a man.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ בֵית־אֵל וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ בֵאלֹהִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִי יַעֲלֶה־לָּנוּ בַתְּחִלָּה לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה יְהוּדָה
בַתְּחִלָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ בֵית־אֵל וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ בֵאלֹהִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִי יַעֲלֶה־לָּנוּ בַתְּחִלָּה לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה יְהוּדָה
בַתְּחִלָּה׃

english.text:
They proceeded to Bethel and inquired of God; the Israelites
asked, “Who of us shall advance first to fight the Benjaminites?”
And YHWH replied, “Judah first.”

translation.text: And the children of Israel arose, and went up to the house of God, and asked counsel of God, and said, Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin? And the LORD said, Judah shall go up first.

verses.english:
They proceeded to Bethel and inquired of God; the Israelites
asked, “Who of us shall advance first to fight the Benjaminites?”
And YHWH replied, “Judah first.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקוּמוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל־הַגִּבְעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקוּמוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל־הַגִּבְעָה׃

english.text:
So the Israelites arose in the morning and encamped against
Gibeah.

translation.text: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.

verses.english:
So the Israelites arose in the morning and encamped against
Gibeah.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־בִּנְיָמִן וַיַּעַרְכוּ אִתָּם אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִלְחָמָה אֶל־הַגִּבְעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־בִּנְיָמִן וַיַּעַרְכוּ אִתָּם אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִלְחָמָה אֶל־הַגִּבְעָה׃

english.text:
The men of Israel took the field against the Benjaminites; the men
of Israel drew up in battle order against them at Gibeah.

translation.text: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.

verses.english:
The men of Israel took the field against the Benjaminites; the men
of Israel drew up in battle order against them at Gibeah.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן מִן־הַגִּבְעָה וַיַּשְׁחִיתוּ בְיִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא שְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן מִן־הַגִּבְעָה וַיַּשְׁחִיתוּ בְיִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא שְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
But the Benjaminites issued from Gibeah, and that day they struck
down 22,000 men of Israel.

translation.text: And the children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah, and destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites that day twenty and two thousand men.

verses.english:
But the Benjaminites issued from Gibeah, and that day they struck
down 22,000 men of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְחַזֵּק הָעָם אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּסִפוּ לַעֲרֹךְ מִלְחָמָה בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־עָרְכוּ שָׁם בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְחַזֵּק הָעָם אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּסִפוּ לַעֲרֹךְ מִלְחָמָה בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־עָרְכוּ שָׁם בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן׃

english.text:
Now the army—the men of Israel—rallied and again drew up in battle
order at the same place as they had on the first day.

translation.text: And the people the men of Israel encouraged themselves, and set their battle again in array in the place where they put themselves in array the first day.

verses.english:
Now the army—the men of Israel—rallied and again drew up in battle
order at the same place as they had on the first day.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּבְכּוּ לִפְנֵי־יְהֹוָה עַד־הָעֶרֶב וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ בַיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַאוֹסִיף לָגֶשֶׁת לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן אָחִי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה עֲלוּ
אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּבְכּוּ לִפְנֵי־יְהֹוָה עַד־הָעֶרֶב וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ בַיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַאוֹסִיף לָגֶשֶׁת לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן אָחִי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה עֲלוּ
אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
For the Israelites had gone up and wept before YHWH until evening.
They had inquired of YHWH, “Shall we again join battle with our
kinsmen the Benjaminites?” And YHWH had replied, “March against
them.”

translation.text: (And the children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until even, and asked counsel of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the LORD said, Go up against him.)

verses.english:
For the Israelites had gone up and wept before YHWH until evening.
They had inquired of YHWH, “Shall we again join battle with our
kinsmen the Benjaminites?” And YHWH had replied, “March against
them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְבוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְבוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי׃

english.text:
The Israelites advanced against the Benjaminites on the second
day.

translation.text: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.

verses.english:
The Israelites advanced against the Benjaminites on the second
day.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא בִנְיָמִן לִקְרָאתָם מִן־הַגִּבְעָה בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי וַיַּשְׁחִיתוּ בִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עוֹד שְׁמֹנַת עָשָׂר אֶלֶף אִישׁ אָרְצָה כּל־אֵלֶּה שֹׁלְפֵי חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא בִנְיָמִן לִקְרָאתָם מִן־הַגִּבְעָה בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי וַיַּשְׁחִיתוּ בִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עוֹד שְׁמֹנַת עָשָׂר אֶלֶף אִישׁ אָרְצָה כּל־אֵלֶּה שֹׁלְפֵי חָרֶב׃

english.text:
But the Benjaminites came out from Gibeah against them on the
second day and struck down 18,000 more of the Israelites, all of
them fighting men.

translation.text: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.

verses.english:
But the Benjaminites came out from Gibeah against them on the
second day and struck down 18,000 more of the Israelites, all of
them fighting men.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲלוּ כל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכל־הָעָם וַיָּבֹאוּ בֵית־אֵל וַיִּבְכּוּ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיָּצוּמוּ בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא עַד־הָעָרֶב וַיַּעֲלוּ עֹלוֹת וּשְׁלָמִים
לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲלוּ כל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכל־הָעָם וַיָּבֹאוּ בֵית־אֵל וַיִּבְכּוּ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיָּצוּמוּ בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא עַד־הָעָרֶב וַיַּעֲלוּ עֹלוֹת וּשְׁלָמִים
לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Then all the Israelites, all the army, went up and came to Bethel
and they sat there, weeping before YHWH. They fasted that day
until evening, and presented burnt offerings and offerings of
well-being to YHWH.

translation.text: Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and came unto the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the LORD, and fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

verses.english:
Then all the Israelites, all the army, went up and came to Bethel
and they sat there, weeping before YHWH. They fasted that day
until evening, and presented burnt offerings and offerings of
well-being to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיהֹוָה וְשָׁם אֲרוֹן בְּרִית הָאֱלֹהִים בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיהֹוָה וְשָׁם אֲרוֹן בְּרִית הָאֱלֹהִים בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם׃

english.text:

there in those days,

translation.text: And the children of Israel enquired of the LORD, (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,

verses.english:
The Israelites inquired of YHWH (for the Ark of God’s Covenant was
there in those days,

verses.hebrew:

and Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron the priest ministered
before Him in those days), “Shall we again take the field against
our kinsmen the Benjaminites, or shall we not?” YHWH answered, “Go
up, for tomorrow I will deliver them into your hands.”

translation.text: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And the LORD said, Go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand.

verses.english:
and Phinehas son of Eleazar son of Aaron the priest ministered
before Him in those days), “Shall we again take the field against
our kinsmen the Benjaminites, or shall we not?” YHWH answered, “Go
up, for tomorrow I will deliver them into your hands.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם יִשְׂרָאֵל אֹרְבִים אֶל־הַגִּבְעָה סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם יִשְׂרָאֵל אֹרְבִים אֶל־הַגִּבְעָה סָבִיב׃

english.text: Israel put men in ambush against Gibeah on all sides.

translation.text: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.

verses.english: Israel put men in ambush against Gibeah on all sides.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וַיַּעַרְכוּ אֶל־הַגִּבְעָה כְּפַעַם בְּפָעַם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וַיַּעַרְכוּ אֶל־הַגִּבְעָה כְּפַעַם בְּפָעַם׃

english.text:
And on the third day, the Israelites went up against the
Benjaminites, as before, and engaged them in battle at Gibeah.

translation.text: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

verses.english:
And on the third day, the Israelites went up against the
Benjaminites, as before, and engaged them in battle at Gibeah.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּצְאוּ בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן לִקְרַאת הָעָם הנְתְּקוּ מִן־הָעִיר וַיָּחֵלּוּ לְהַכּוֹת מֵהָעָם חֲלָלִים כְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם בַּמְסִלּוֹת אֲשֶׁר אַחַת עֹלָה בֵית־אֵל וְאַחַת גִּבְעָתָה
בַּשָּׂדֶה כִּשְׁלֹשִׁים אִישׁ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּצְאוּ בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן לִקְרַאת הָעָם הנְתְּקוּ מִן־הָעִיר וַיָּחֵלּוּ לְהַכּוֹת מֵהָעָם חֲלָלִים כְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם בַּמְסִלּוֹת אֲשֶׁר אַחַת עֹלָה בֵית־אֵל וְאַחַת גִּבְעָתָה
בַּשָּׂדֶה כִּשְׁלֹשִׁים אִישׁ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The Benjaminites dashed out to meet the army and were drawn away
from the town onto the roads, of which one runs to Bethel and the
other to Gibeah. As before, they started out by striking some of
the men dead in the open field, about 30 men of Israel.

translation.text: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people, and kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goeth up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Israel.

verses.english:
The Benjaminites dashed out to meet the army and were drawn away
from the town onto the roads, of which one runs to Bethel and the
other to Gibeah. As before, they started out by striking some of
the men dead in the open field, about 30 men of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן נִגָּפִים הֵם לְפָנֵינוּ כְּבָרִאשֹׁנָה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָמְרוּ נָנוּסָה וּנְתַקְּנוּהוּ מִן־הָעִיר אֶל־הַמְסִלּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן נִגָּפִים הֵם לְפָנֵינוּ כְּבָרִאשֹׁנָה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָמְרוּ נָנוּסָה וּנְתַקְּנוּהוּ מִן־הָעִיר אֶל־הַמְסִלּוֹת׃

english.text:
The Benjaminites thought, “They are being routed before us as
previously.” But the Israelites had planned: “We will take to
flight and draw them away from the town to the roads.”

translation.text: And the children of Benjamin said, They are smitten down before us, as at the first. But the children of Israel said, Let us flee, and draw them from the city unto the highways.

verses.english:
The Benjaminites thought, “They are being routed before us as
previously.” But the Israelites had planned: “We will take to
flight and draw them away from the town to the roads.”

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל קָמוּ מִמְּקוֹמוֹ וַיַּעַרְכוּ בְּבַעַל תָּמָר וְאֹרֵב יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵגִיחַ מִמְּקֹמוֹ מִמַּעֲרֵה גָבַע׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל קָמוּ מִמְּקוֹמוֹ וַיַּעַרְכוּ בְּבַעַל תָּמָר וְאֹרֵב יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵגִיחַ מִמְּקֹמוֹ מִמַּעֲרֵה גָבַע׃

english.text:
And while the main body of the Israelites had moved away from
their positions and had drawn up in battle order at Baal-tamar,
the Israelite ambush was rushing out from its position at
Maareh-geba.

translation.text: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baaltamar: and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places, even out of the meadows of Gibeah.

verses.english:
And while the main body of the Israelites had moved away from
their positions and had drawn up in battle order at Baal-tamar,
the Israelite ambush was rushing out from its position at
Maareh-geba.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ מִנֶּגֶד לַגִּבְעָה עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ בָּחוּר מִכּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַמִּלְחָמָה כָּבֵדָה וְהֵם לֹא יָדְעוּ כִּי־נֹגַעַת עֲלֵיהֶם הָרָעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ מִנֶּגֶד לַגִּבְעָה עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ בָּחוּר מִכּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַמִּלְחָמָה כָּבֵדָה וְהֵם לֹא יָדְעוּ כִּי־נֹגַעַת עֲלֵיהֶם הָרָעָה׃

english.text:
Thus 10,000 picked men of all Israel came to a point south of
Gibeah, and the battle was furious. Before they realized that
disaster was approaching,

translation.text: And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil was near them.

verses.english:
Thus 10,000 picked men of all Israel came to a point south of
Gibeah, and the battle was furious. Before they realized that
disaster was approaching,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגֹּף יְהֹוָה אֶת־בִּנְיָמִן לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּשְׁחִיתוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּבִנְיָמִן בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עֶשְׂרִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה אֶלֶף וּמֵאָה אִישׁ כּל־אֵלֶּה שֹׁלֵף־חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגֹּף יְהֹוָה אֶת־בִּנְיָמִן לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּשְׁחִיתוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּבִנְיָמִן בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עֶשְׂרִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה אֶלֶף וּמֵאָה אִישׁ כּל־אֵלֶּה שֹׁלֵף־חָרֶב׃

english.text:
YHWH routed the Benjaminites before Israel. That day the
Israelites slew 25,100 men of Benjamin, all of them fighting men.

translation.text: And the LORD smote Benjamin before Israel: and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men: all these drew the sword.

verses.english:
YHWH routed the Benjaminites before Israel. That day the
Israelites slew 25,100 men of Benjamin, all of them fighting men.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן כִּי נִגָּפוּ וַיִּתְּנוּ אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל מָקוֹם לְבִנְיָמִן כִּי בָטְחוּ אֶל־הָאֹרֵב אֲשֶׁר־שָׂמוּ אֶל־הַגִּבְעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן כִּי נִגָּפוּ וַיִּתְּנוּ אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל מָקוֹם לְבִנְיָמִן כִּי בָטְחוּ אֶל־הָאֹרֵב אֲשֶׁר־שָׂמוּ אֶל־הַגִּבְעָה׃

english.text:
Then the Benjaminites realized that they were routed. Now the
Israelites had yielded ground to the Benjaminites, for they relied
on the ambush which they had laid against Gibeah.

translation.text: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten: for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites, because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah.

verses.english:
Then the Benjaminites realized that they were routed. Now the
Israelites had yielded ground to the Benjaminites, for they relied
on the ambush which they had laid against Gibeah.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֹרֵב הֵחִישׁוּ וַיִּפְשְׁטוּ אֶל־הַגִּבְעָה וַיִּמְשֹׁךְ הָאֹרֵב וַיַּךְ אֶת־כּל־הָעִיר לְפִי־חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֹרֵב הֵחִישׁוּ וַיִּפְשְׁטוּ אֶל־הַגִּבְעָה וַיִּמְשֹׁךְ הָאֹרֵב וַיַּךְ אֶת־כּל־הָעִיר לְפִי־חָרֶב׃

english.text:
One ambush quickly deployed against Gibeah, and the other ambush
advanced and put the whole town to the sword.

translation.text: And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.

verses.english:
One ambush quickly deployed against Gibeah, and the other ambush
advanced and put the whole town to the sword.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמּוֹעֵד הָיָה לְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל עִם־הָאֹרֵב הֶרֶב לְהַעֲלוֹתָם מַשְׂאַת הֶעָשָׁן מִן־הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמּוֹעֵד הָיָה לְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל עִם־הָאֹרֵב הֶרֶב לְהַעֲלוֹתָם מַשְׂאַת הֶעָשָׁן מִן־הָעִיר׃

english.text:
A time had been agreed upon by the Israelite men with those in
ambush: When a huge column of smoke was sent up from the town,

translation.text: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait, that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city.

verses.english:
A time had been agreed upon by the Israelite men with those in
ambush: When a huge column of smoke was sent up from the town,

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּהֲפֹךְ אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּלְחָמָה וּבִנְיָמִן הֵחֵל לְהַכּוֹת חֲלָלִים בְּאִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּשְׁלֹשִׁים אִישׁ כִּי אָמְרוּ אַךְ נִגּוֹף נִגָּף הוּא לְפָנֵינוּ
כַּמִּלְחָמָה הָרִאשֹׁנָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּהֲפֹךְ אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּלְחָמָה וּבִנְיָמִן הֵחֵל לְהַכּוֹת חֲלָלִים בְּאִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּשְׁלֹשִׁים אִישׁ כִּי אָמְרוּ אַךְ נִגּוֹף נִגָּף הוּא לְפָנֵינוּ
כַּמִּלְחָמָה הָרִאשֹׁנָה׃

english.text:
the Israelite men were to turn about in battle. Benjamin had begun
by striking dead about 30 Israelite men, and they thought, “They
are being routed before us as in the previous fighting.”

translation.text: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle, Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons: for they said, Surely they are smitten down before us, as in the first battle.

verses.english:
the Israelite men were to turn about in battle. Benjamin had begun
by striking dead about 30 Israelite men, and they thought, “They
are being routed before us as in the previous fighting.”

verses.hebrew: וְהַמַּשְׂאֵת הֵחֵלָּה לַעֲלוֹת מִן־הָעִיר עַמּוּד עָשָׁן וַיִּפֶן בִּנְיָמִן אַחֲרָיו וְהִנֵּה עָלָה כְלִיל־הָעִיר הַשָּׁמָיְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמַּשְׂאֵת הֵחֵלָּה לַעֲלוֹת מִן־הָעִיר עַמּוּד עָשָׁן וַיִּפֶן בִּנְיָמִן אַחֲרָיו וְהִנֵּה עָלָה כְלִיל־הָעִיר הַשָּׁמָיְמָה׃

english.text:
But when the column, the pillar of smoke, began to rise from the
city, the Benjaminites looked behind them, and there was the whole
town going up in smoke to the sky!

translation.text: But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the flame of the city ascended up to heaven.

verses.english:
But when the column, the pillar of smoke, began to rise from the
city, the Benjaminites looked behind them, and there was the whole
town going up in smoke to the sky!

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הָפַךְ וַיִּבָּהֵל אִישׁ בִּנְיָמִן כִּי רָאָה כִּי־נָגְעָה עָלָיו הָרָעָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הָפַךְ וַיִּבָּהֵל אִישׁ בִּנְיָמִן כִּי רָאָה כִּי־נָגְעָה עָלָיו הָרָעָה׃

english.text:
And now the Israelites turned about, and the men of Benjamin were
thrown into panic, for they realized that disaster had overtaken
them.

translation.text: And when the men of Israel turned again, the men of Benjamin were amazed: for they saw that evil was come upon them.

verses.english:
And now the Israelites turned about, and the men of Benjamin were
thrown into panic, for they realized that disaster had overtaken
them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְנוּ לִפְנֵי אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־דֶּרֶךְ הַמִּדְבָּר וְהַמִּלְחָמָה הִדְבִּיקָתְהוּ וַאֲשֶׁר מֵהֶעָרִים מַשְׁחִיתִים אוֹתוֹ בְּתוֹכוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְנוּ לִפְנֵי אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־דֶּרֶךְ הַמִּדְבָּר וְהַמִּלְחָמָה הִדְבִּיקָתְהוּ וַאֲשֶׁר מֵהֶעָרִים מַשְׁחִיתִים אוֹתוֹ בְּתוֹכוֹ׃

english.text:
They retreated before the men of Israel along the road to the
wilderness, where the fighting caught up with them; meanwhile
those from the towns were massacring them in it.

translation.text: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel unto the way of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them; and them which came out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.

verses.english:
They retreated before the men of Israel along the road to the
wilderness, where the fighting caught up with them; meanwhile
those from the towns were massacring them in it.

verses.hebrew: כִּתְּרוּ אֶת־בִּנְיָמִן הִרְדִיפֻהוּ מְנוּחָה הִדְרִיכֻהוּ עַד נֹכַח הַגִּבְעָה מִמִּזְרַח־שָׁמֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: כִּתְּרוּ אֶת־בִּנְיָמִן הִרְדִיפֻהוּ מְנוּחָה הִדְרִיכֻהוּ עַד נֹכַח הַגִּבְעָה מִמִּזְרַח־שָׁמֶשׁ׃

english.text:
They encircled the Benjaminites, pursued them, and trod them down
[from] Menuhah to a point opposite Gibeah on the east.

translation.text: Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about, and chased them, and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.

verses.english:
They encircled the Benjaminites, pursued them, and trod them down
[from] Menuhah to a point opposite Gibeah on the east.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְּלוּ מִבִּנְיָמִן שְׁמֹנָה־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף אִישׁ אֶת־כּל־אֵלֶּה אַנְשֵׁי־חָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְּלוּ מִבִּנְיָמִן שְׁמֹנָה־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף אִישׁ אֶת־כּל־אֵלֶּה אַנְשֵׁי־חָיִל׃

english.text: That day 18,000 men of Benjamin fell, all of them brave men.

translation.text: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these were men of valour.

verses.english: That day 18,000 men of Benjamin fell, all of them brave men.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּפְנוּ וַיָּנֻסוּ הַמִּדְבָּרָה אֶל־סֶלַע הָרִמּוֹן וַיְעֹלְלֻהוּ בַּמְסִלּוֹת חֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ וַיַּדְבִּיקוּ אַחֲרָיו עַד־גִּדְעֹם וַיַּכּוּ מִמֶּנּוּ אַלְפַּיִם
אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּפְנוּ וַיָּנֻסוּ הַמִּדְבָּרָה אֶל־סֶלַע הָרִמּוֹן וַיְעֹלְלֻהוּ בַּמְסִלּוֹת חֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ וַיַּדְבִּיקוּ אַחֲרָיו עַד־גִּדְעֹם וַיַּכּוּ מִמֶּנּוּ אַלְפַּיִם
אִישׁ׃

english.text:
They turned and fled to the wilderness, to the Rock of Rimmon; but
[the Israelites] picked off another 5,000 on the roads and,
continuing in hot pursuit of them up to Gidom, they slew 2,000
more.

translation.text: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon: and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom, and slew two thousand men of them.

verses.english:
They turned and fled to the wilderness, to the Rock of Rimmon; but
[the Israelites] picked off another 5,000 on the roads and,
continuing in hot pursuit of them up to Gidom, they slew 2,000
more.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כל־הַנֹּפְלִים מִבִּנְיָמִן עֶשְׂרִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה אֶלֶף אִישׁ שֹׁלֵף חֶרֶב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת־כּל־אֵלֶּה אַנְשֵׁי־חָיִל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כל־הַנֹּפְלִים מִבִּנְיָמִן עֶשְׂרִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה אֶלֶף אִישׁ שֹׁלֵף חֶרֶב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת־כּל־אֵלֶּה אַנְשֵׁי־חָיִל׃

english.text:
Thus the total number of Benjaminites who fell that day came to
25,000 fighting men, all of them brave.

translation.text: So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these were men of valour.

verses.english:
Thus the total number of Benjaminites who fell that day came to
25,000 fighting men, all of them brave.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיָּנֻסוּ הַמִּדְבָּרָה אֶל־סֶלַע הָרִמּוֹן שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְּסֶלַע רִמּוֹן אַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיָּנֻסוּ הַמִּדְבָּרָה אֶל־סֶלַע הָרִמּוֹן שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְּסֶלַע רִמּוֹן אַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים׃

english.text:
But 600 men turned and fled to the wilderness, to the Rock of
Rimmon; they remained at the Rock of Rimmon four months.

translation.text: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon, and abode in the rock Rimmon four months.

verses.english:
But 600 men turned and fled to the wilderness, to the Rock of
Rimmon; they remained at the Rock of Rimmon four months.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁבוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וַיַּכּוּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב מֵעִיר מְתֹם עַד־בְּהֵמָה עַד כּל־הַנִּמְצָא גַּם כּל־הֶעָרִים הַנִּמְצָאוֹת שִׁלְּחוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁבוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וַיַּכּוּם לְפִי־חֶרֶב מֵעִיר מְתֹם עַד־בְּהֵמָה עַד כּל־הַנִּמְצָא גַּם כּל־הֶעָרִים הַנִּמְצָאוֹת שִׁלְּחוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
The men of Israel, meanwhile, turned back to the rest of the
Benjaminites and put them to the sword—towns, people,
cattle—everything that remained. Finally, they set fire to all the
towns that were left.

translation.text: And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword, as well the men of every city, as the beast, and all that came to hand: also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.

verses.english:
The men of Israel, meanwhile, turned back to the rest of the
Benjaminites and put them to the sword—towns, people,
cattle—everything that remained. Finally, they set fire to all the
towns that were left.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל נִשְׁבַּע בַּמִּצְפָּה לֵאמֹר אִישׁ מִמֶּנּוּ לֹא־יִתֵּן בִּתּוֹ לְבִנְיָמִן לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל נִשְׁבַּע בַּמִּצְפָּה לֵאמֹר אִישׁ מִמֶּנּוּ לֹא־יִתֵּן בִּתּוֹ לְבִנְיָמִן לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
Now the men of Israel had taken an oath at Mizpah: “None of us
will give his daughter in marriage to a Benjaminite.”

translation.text: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.

verses.english:
Now the men of Israel had taken an oath at Mizpah: “None of us
will give his daughter in marriage to a Benjaminite.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הָעָם בֵּית־אֵל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם עַד־הָעֶרֶב לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּשְׂאוּ קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ בְּכִי גָדוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא הָעָם בֵּית־אֵל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם עַד־הָעֶרֶב לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּשְׂאוּ קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ בְּכִי גָדוֹל׃

english.text:
The people came to Bethel and sat there before God until evening.
They wailed and wept bitterly,

translation.text: And the people came to the house of God, and abode there till even before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept sore;

verses.english:
The people came to Bethel and sat there before God until evening.
They wailed and wept bitterly,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָמָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיְתָה זֹּאת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לְהִפָּקֵד הַיּוֹם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁבֶט אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָמָה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיְתָה זֹּאת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לְהִפָּקֵד הַיּוֹם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁבֶט אֶחָד׃

english.text:
and they said, “O LORD God of Israel, why has this happened in
Israel, that one tribe must now be missing from Israel?”

translation.text: And said, O LORD God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel?

verses.english:
and they said, “O LORD God of Israel, why has this happened in
Israel, that one tribe must now be missing from Israel?”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ הָעָם וַיִּבְנוּ־שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ וַיַּעֲלוּ עֹלוֹת וּשְׁלָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ הָעָם וַיִּבְנוּ־שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ וַיַּעֲלוּ עֹלוֹת וּשְׁלָמִים׃

english.text:
Early the next day, the people built an altar there, and they
brought burnt offerings and offerings of well-being.

translation.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

verses.english:
Early the next day, the people built an altar there, and they
brought burnt offerings and offerings of well-being.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָלָה בַקָּהָל מִכּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה כִּי הַשְּׁבוּעָה הַגְּדוֹלָה הָיְתָה לַאֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָלָה אֶל־יְהֹוָה הַמִּצְפָּה
לֵאמֹר מוֹת יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָלָה בַקָּהָל מִכּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה כִּי הַשְּׁבוּעָה הַגְּדוֹלָה הָיְתָה לַאֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָלָה אֶל־יְהֹוָה הַמִּצְפָּה
לֵאמֹר מוֹת יוּמָת׃

english.text:
The Israelites asked, “Is there anyone from all the tribes of
Israel who failed to come up to the assembly before YHWH?” For a
solemn oath had been taken concerning anyone who did not go up to
YHWH at Mizpah: “He shall be put to death.”

translation.text: And the children of Israel said, Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the LORD? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the LORD to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.

verses.english:
The Israelites asked, “Is there anyone from all the tribes of
Israel who failed to come up to the assembly before YHWH?” For a
solemn oath had been taken concerning anyone who did not go up to
YHWH at Mizpah: “He shall be put to death.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּנָּחֲמוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־בִּנְיָמִן אָחִיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ נִגְדַּע הַיּוֹם שֵׁבֶט אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּנָּחֲמוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־בִּנְיָמִן אָחִיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ נִגְדַּע הַיּוֹם שֵׁבֶט אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The Israelites now relented toward their kinsmen the Benjaminites,
and they said, “This day one tribe has been cut off from Israel!

translation.text: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.

verses.english:
The Israelites now relented toward their kinsmen the Benjaminites,
and they said, “This day one tribe has been cut off from Israel!

verses.hebrew: מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם לַנּוֹתָרִים לְנָשִׁים וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִשְׁבַּעְנוּ בַיהֹוָה לְבִלְתִּי תֵּת־לָהֶם מִבְּנוֹתֵינוּ לְנָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם לַנּוֹתָרִים לְנָשִׁים וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִשְׁבַּעְנוּ בַיהֹוָה לְבִלְתִּי תֵּת־לָהֶם מִבְּנוֹתֵינוּ לְנָשִׁים׃

english.text:
What can we do to provide wives for those who are left, seeing
that we have sworn by YHWH not to give any of our daughters to
them in marriage?”

translation.text: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?

verses.english:
What can we do to provide wives for those who are left, seeing
that we have sworn by YHWH not to give any of our daughters to
them in marriage?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ מִי אֶחָד מִשִּׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָלָה אֶל־יְהֹוָה הַמִּצְפָּה וְהִנֵּה לֹא בָא־אִישׁ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה מִיָּבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֶל־הַקָּהָל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ מִי אֶחָד מִשִּׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָלָה אֶל־יְהֹוָה הַמִּצְפָּה וְהִנֵּה לֹא בָא־אִישׁ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה מִיָּבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֶל־הַקָּהָל׃

english.text:
They inquired, “Is there anyone from the tribes of Israel who did
not go up to YHWH at Mizpah?” Now no one from Jabesh-gilead had
come to the camp, to the assembly.

translation.text: And they said, What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpeh to the LORD? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabeshgilead to the assembly.

verses.english:
They inquired, “Is there anyone from the tribes of Israel who did
not go up to YHWH at Mizpah?” Now no one from Jabesh-gilead had
come to the camp, to the assembly.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְפָּקֵד הָעָם וְהִנֵּה אֵין־שָׁם אִישׁ מִיּוֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵשׁ גִּלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְפָּקֵד הָעָם וְהִנֵּה אֵין־שָׁם אִישׁ מִיּוֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵשׁ גִּלְעָד׃

english.text:
For, when the roll of the troops was taken, not one of the
inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead was present.

translation.text: For the people were numbered, and, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead there.

verses.english:
For, when the roll of the troops was taken, not one of the
inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead was present.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ־שָׁם הָעֵדָה שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי הֶחָיִל וַיְצַוּוּ אוֹתָם לֵאמֹר לְכוּ וְהִכִּיתֶם אֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵשׁ גִּלְעָד לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַטָּף׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ־שָׁם הָעֵדָה שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי הֶחָיִל וַיְצַוּוּ אוֹתָם לֵאמֹר לְכוּ וְהִכִּיתֶם אֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵשׁ גִּלְעָד לְפִי־חֶרֶב וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַטָּף׃

english.text:
So the assemblage dispatched 12,000 of the warriors, instructing
them as follows: “Go and put the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead to
the sword, women and children included.

translation.text: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the children.

verses.english:
So the assemblage dispatched 12,000 of the warriors, instructing
them as follows: “Go and put the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead to
the sword, women and children included.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּ כּל־זָכָר וְכל־אִשָּׁה יֹדַעַת מִשְׁכַּב־זָכָר תַּחֲרִימוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּ כּל־זָכָר וְכל־אִשָּׁה יֹדַעַת מִשְׁכַּב־זָכָר תַּחֲרִימוּ׃

english.text:
This is what you are to do: Proscribe every man, and every woman
who has known a man carnally.”

translation.text: And this is the thing that ye shall do, Ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.

verses.english:
This is what you are to do: Proscribe every man, and every woman
who has known a man carnally.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּמְצְאוּ מִיּוֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת נַעֲרָה בְתוּלָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעָה אִישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּב זָכָר וַיָּבִאוּ אוֹתָם אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁלֹה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ
כְּנָעַן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּמְצְאוּ מִיּוֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת נַעֲרָה בְתוּלָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעָה אִישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּב זָכָר וַיָּבִאוּ אוֹתָם אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁלֹה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ
כְּנָעַן׃

english.text:
They found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead 400 maidens who
had not known a man carnally; and they brought them to the camp at
Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

translation.text: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

verses.english:
They found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead 400 maidens who
had not known a man carnally; and they brought them to the camp at
Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ כּל־הָעֵדָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן אֲשֶׁר בְּסֶלַע רִמּוֹן וַיִּקְרְאוּ לָהֶם שָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ כּל־הָעֵדָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן אֲשֶׁר בְּסֶלַע רִמּוֹן וַיִּקְרְאוּ לָהֶם שָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
Then the whole community sent word to the Benjaminites who were at
the Rock of Rimmon, and offered them terms of peace.

translation.text: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably unto them.

verses.english:
Then the whole community sent word to the Benjaminites who were at
the Rock of Rimmon, and offered them terms of peace.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב בִּנְיָמִן בָּעֵת הַהִיא וַיִּתְּנוּ לָהֶם הַנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר חִיּוּ מִנְּשֵׁי יָבֵשׁ גִּלְעָד וְלֹא־מָצְאוּ לָהֶם כֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב בִּנְיָמִן בָּעֵת הַהִיא וַיִּתְּנוּ לָהֶם הַנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר חִיּוּ מִנְּשֵׁי יָבֵשׁ גִּלְעָד וְלֹא־מָצְאוּ לָהֶם כֵּן׃

english.text:
Thereupon the Benjaminites returned, and they gave them the girls
who had been spared from the women of Jabesh-gilead. But there
were not enough of them.

translation.text: And Benjamin came again at that time; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabeshgilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.

verses.english:
Thereupon the Benjaminites returned, and they gave them the girls
who had been spared from the women of Jabesh-gilead. But there
were not enough of them.

verses.hebrew: וְהָעָם נִחָם לְבִנְיָמִן כִּי־עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה פֶּרֶץ בְּשִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעָם נִחָם לְבִנְיָמִן כִּי־עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה פֶּרֶץ בְּשִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Now the people had relented toward Benjamin, for YHWH had made a
breach in the tribes of Israel.

translation.text: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.

verses.english:
Now the people had relented toward Benjamin, for YHWH had made a
breach in the tribes of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ זִקְנֵי הָעֵדָה מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂה לַנּוֹתָרִים לְנָשִׁים כִּי־נִשְׁמְדָה מִבִּנְיָמִן אִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ זִקְנֵי הָעֵדָה מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂה לַנּוֹתָרִים לְנָשִׁים כִּי־נִשְׁמְדָה מִבִּנְיָמִן אִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
So the elders of the community asked, “What can we do about wives
for those who are left, since the women of Benjamin have been
killed off?”

translation.text: Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?

verses.english:
So the elders of the community asked, “What can we do about wives
for those who are left, since the women of Benjamin have been
killed off?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְרֻשַּׁת פְּלֵיטָה לְבִנְיָמִן וְלֹא־יִמָּחֶה שֵׁבֶט מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְרֻשַּׁת פְּלֵיטָה לְבִנְיָמִן וְלֹא־יִמָּחֶה שֵׁבֶט מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
For they said, “There must be a saving remnant for Benjamin, that
a tribe may not be blotted out of Israel;

translation.text: And they said, There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel.

verses.english:
For they said, “There must be a saving remnant for Benjamin, that
a tribe may not be blotted out of Israel;

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנַחְנוּ לֹא נוּכַל לָתֵת־לָהֶם נָשִׁים מִבְּנוֹתֵינוּ כִּי־נִשְׁבְּעוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אָרוּר נֹתֵן אִשָּׁה לְבִנְיָמִן׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנַחְנוּ לֹא נוּכַל לָתֵת־לָהֶם נָשִׁים מִבְּנוֹתֵינוּ כִּי־נִשְׁבְּעוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אָרוּר נֹתֵן אִשָּׁה לְבִנְיָמִן׃

english.text:
yet we cannot give them any of our daughters as wives,” since the
Israelites had taken an oath: “Cursed be anyone who gives a wife
to Benjamin!”

translation.text: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters: for the children of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin.

verses.english:
yet we cannot give them any of our daughters as wives,” since the
Israelites had taken an oath: “Cursed be anyone who gives a wife
to Benjamin!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הִנֵּה חַג־יְהֹוָה בְּשִׁלוֹ מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה אֲשֶׁר מִצְּפוֹנָה לְבֵית־אֵל מִזְרְחָה הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לִמְסִלָּה הָעֹלָה מִבֵּית־אֵל שְׁכֶמָה וּמִנֶּגֶב לִלְבוֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הִנֵּה חַג־יְהֹוָה בְּשִׁלוֹ מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה אֲשֶׁר מִצְּפוֹנָה לְבֵית־אֵל מִזְרְחָה הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לִמְסִלָּה הָעֹלָה מִבֵּית־אֵל שְׁכֶמָה וּמִנֶּגֶב לִלְבוֹנָה׃

english.text:
They said, “The annual feast of YHWH is now being held at Shiloh.”
(It lies north of Bethel, east of the highway that runs from
Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah.)

translation.text: Then they said, Behold, there is a feast of the LORD in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.

verses.english:
They said, “The annual feast of YHWH is now being held at Shiloh.”
(It lies north of Bethel, east of the highway that runs from
Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah.)

verses.hebrew: (ויצו) [וַיְצַוּוּ] אֶת־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן לֵאמֹר לְכוּ וַאֲרַבְתֶּם בַּכְּרָמִים׃

hebrew.text: (ויצו) [וַיְצַוּוּ] אֶת־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן לֵאמֹר לְכוּ וַאֲרַבְתֶּם בַּכְּרָמִים׃

english.text:
So they instructed the Benjaminites as follows: “Go and lie in
wait in the vineyards.

translation.text: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;

verses.english:
So they instructed the Benjaminites as follows: “Go and lie in
wait in the vineyards.

verses.hebrew: וּרְאִיתֶם וְהִנֵּה אִם־יֵצְאוּ בְנוֹת־שִׁילוֹ לָחוּל בַּמְּחֹלוֹת וִיצָאתֶם מִן־הַכְּרָמִים וַחֲטַפְתֶּם לָכֶם אִישׁ אִשְׁתּוֹ מִבְּנוֹת שִׁילוֹ וַהֲלַכְתֶּם אֶרֶץ בִּנְיָמִן׃

hebrew.text: וּרְאִיתֶם וְהִנֵּה אִם־יֵצְאוּ בְנוֹת־שִׁילוֹ לָחוּל בַּמְּחֹלוֹת וִיצָאתֶם מִן־הַכְּרָמִים וַחֲטַפְתֶּם לָכֶם אִישׁ אִשְׁתּוֹ מִבְּנוֹת שִׁילוֹ וַהֲלַכְתֶּם אֶרֶץ בִּנְיָמִן׃

english.text:
As soon as you see the girls of Shiloh coming out to join in the
dances, come out from the vineyards; let each of you seize a wife
from among the girls of Shiloh, and be off for the land of
Benjamin.

translation.text: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

verses.english:
As soon as you see the girls of Shiloh coming out to join in the
dances, come out from the vineyards; let each of you seize a wife
from among the girls of Shiloh, and be off for the land of
Benjamin.

verses.hebrew:
וְהָיָה כִּי־יָבֹאוּ אֲבוֹתָם אוֹ אֲחֵיהֶם (לרוב) [לָרִיב ] אֵלֵינוּ וְאָמַרְנוּ אֲלֵיהֶם חנּוּנוּ אוֹתָם כִּי לֹא לָקַחְנוּ אִישׁ אִשְׁתּוֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָה כִּי לֹא אַתֶּם נְתַתֶּם
לָהֶם כָּעֵת תֶּאְשָׁמוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וְהָיָה כִּי־יָבֹאוּ אֲבוֹתָם אוֹ אֲחֵיהֶם (לרוב) [לָרִיב ] אֵלֵינוּ וְאָמַרְנוּ אֲלֵיהֶם חנּוּנוּ אוֹתָם כִּי לֹא לָקַחְנוּ אִישׁ אִשְׁתּוֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָה כִּי לֹא אַתֶּם נְתַתֶּם
לָהֶם כָּעֵת תֶּאְשָׁמוּ׃

english.text:
And if their fathers or brothers come to us to complain, we shall
say to them, ‘Be generous to them for our sake! We could not
provide any of them with a wife on account of the war, and you
would have incurred guilt if you yourselves had given them
[wives].’”

translation.text: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain, that we will say unto them, Be favourable unto them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for ye did not give unto them at this time, that ye should be guilty.

verses.english:
And if their fathers or brothers come to us to complain, we shall
say to them, ‘Be generous to them for our sake! We could not
provide any of them with a wife on account of the war, and you
would have incurred guilt if you yourselves had given them
[wives].’”

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־כֵן בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וַיִּשְׂאוּ נָשִׁים לְמִסְפָּרָם מִן־הַמְּחֹלְלוֹת אֲשֶׁר גָּזָלוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיָּשׁוּבוּ אֶל־נַחֲלָתָם וַיִּבְנוּ אֶת־הֶעָרִים וַיֵּשְׁבוּ
בָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־כֵן בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וַיִּשְׂאוּ נָשִׁים לְמִסְפָּרָם מִן־הַמְּחֹלְלוֹת אֲשֶׁר גָּזָלוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיָּשׁוּבוּ אֶל־נַחֲלָתָם וַיִּבְנוּ אֶת־הֶעָרִים וַיֵּשְׁבוּ
בָּהֶם׃

english.text:
The Benjaminites did so. They took to wife, from the dancers whom
they carried off, as many as they themselves numbered. Then they
