went back to their own territory, and rebuilt their towns and
settled in them.

translation.text: And the children of Benjamin did so, and took them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.

verses.english:
The Benjaminites did so. They took to wife, from the dancers whom
they carried off, as many as they themselves numbered. Then they
went back to their own territory, and rebuilt their towns and
settled in them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִשָּׁם בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּעֵת הַהִיא אִישׁ לְשִׁבְטוֹ וּלְמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ וַיֵּצְאוּ מִשָּׁם אִישׁ לְנַחֲלָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִשָּׁם בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּעֵת הַהִיא אִישׁ לְשִׁבְטוֹ וּלְמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ וַיֵּצְאוּ מִשָּׁם אִישׁ לְנַחֲלָתוֹ׃

english.text:
Thereupon the Israelites dispersed, each to his own tribe and
clan; everyone departed for his own territory.

translation.text: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.

verses.english:
Thereupon the Israelites dispersed, each to his own tribe and
clan; everyone departed for his own territory.

verses.hebrew: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין מֶלֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו יַעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין מֶלֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו יַעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
In those days there was no king in Israel; everyone did as he
pleased.

translation.text: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

verses.english:
In those days there was no king in Israel; everyone did as he
pleased.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אִישׁ אֶחָד מִן־הָרָמָתַיִם צוֹפִים מֵהַר אֶפְרָיִם וּשְׁמוֹ אֶלְקָנָה בֶּן־יְרֹחָם בֶּן־אֱלִיהוּא בֶּן־תֹּחוּ בֶן־צוּף אֶפְרָתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אִישׁ אֶחָד מִן־הָרָמָתַיִם צוֹפִים מֵהַר אֶפְרָיִם וּשְׁמוֹ אֶלְקָנָה בֶּן־יְרֹחָם בֶּן־אֱלִיהוּא בֶּן־תֹּחוּ בֶן־צוּף אֶפְרָתִי׃

english.text:
There was a man from Ramathaim of the Zuphites, in the hill
country of Ephraim, whose name was Elkanah son of Jeroham son of
Elihu son of Tohu son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.

translation.text: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaimzophim, of mount Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite:

verses.english:
There was a man from Ramathaim of the Zuphites, in the hill
country of Ephraim, whose name was Elkanah son of Jeroham son of
Elihu son of Tohu son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.

verses.hebrew: וְלוֹ שְׁתֵּי נָשִׁים שֵׁם אַחַת חַנָּה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית פְּנִנָּה וַיְהִי לִפְנִנָּה יְלָדִים וּלְחַנָּה אֵין יְלָדִים׃

hebrew.text: וְלוֹ שְׁתֵּי נָשִׁים שֵׁם אַחַת חַנָּה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית פְּנִנָּה וַיְהִי לִפְנִנָּה יְלָדִים וּלְחַנָּה אֵין יְלָדִים׃

english.text:
He had two wives, one named Hannah and the other Peninnah;
Peninnah had children, but Hannah was childless.

translation.text: And he had two wives; the name of the one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

verses.english:
He had two wives, one named Hannah and the other Peninnah;
Peninnah had children, but Hannah was childless.

verses.hebrew: וְעָלָה הָאִישׁ הַהוּא מֵעִירוֹ מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת וְלִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת בְּשִׁלֹה וְשָׁם שְׁנֵי בְנֵי־עֵלִי חפְנִי וּפִנְחָס כֹּהֲנִים לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעָלָה הָאִישׁ הַהוּא מֵעִירוֹ מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת וְלִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת בְּשִׁלֹה וְשָׁם שְׁנֵי בְנֵי־עֵלִי חפְנִי וּפִנְחָס כֹּהֲנִים לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
This man used to go up from his town every year to worship and to
offer sacrifice to YHWH of Hosts at Shiloh.—Hophni and Phinehas,
the two sons of Eli, were priests of YHWH there.

translation.text: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the LORD of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the LORD, were there.

verses.english:
This man used to go up from his town every year to worship and to
offer sacrifice to YHWH of Hosts at Shiloh.—Hophni and Phinehas,
the two sons of Eli, were priests of YHWH there.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיִּזְבַּח אֶלְקָנָה וְנָתַן לִפְנִנָּה אִשְׁתּוֹ וּלְכל־בָּנֶיהָ וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ מָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיִּזְבַּח אֶלְקָנָה וְנָתַן לִפְנִנָּה אִשְׁתּוֹ וּלְכל־בָּנֶיהָ וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ מָנוֹת׃

english.text:
One such day, Elkanah offered a sacrifice. He used to give
portions to his wife Peninnah and to all her sons and daughters;

translation.text: And when the time was that Elkanah offered, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions:

verses.english:
One such day, Elkanah offered a sacrifice. He used to give
portions to his wife Peninnah and to all her sons and daughters;

verses.hebrew: וּלְחַנָּה יִתֵּן מָנָה אַחַת אַפָּיִם כִּי אֶת־חַנָּה אָהֵב וַיהֹוָה סָגַר רַחְמָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וּלְחַנָּה יִתֵּן מָנָה אַחַת אַפָּיִם כִּי אֶת־חַנָּה אָהֵב וַיהֹוָה סָגַר רַחְמָהּ׃

english.text:
but to Hannah he would give one portion only—though Hannah was his
favorite—for YHWH had closed her womb.

translation.text: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion; for he loved Hannah: but the LORD had shut up her womb.

verses.english:
but to Hannah he would give one portion only—though Hannah was his
favorite—for YHWH had closed her womb.

verses.hebrew: וְכִעֲסַתָּה צָרָתָהּ גַּם־כַּעַס בַּעֲבוּר הַרְּעִמָהּ כִּי־סָגַר יְהֹוָה בְּעַד רַחְמָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְכִעֲסַתָּה צָרָתָהּ גַּם־כַּעַס בַּעֲבוּר הַרְּעִמָהּ כִּי־סָגַר יְהֹוָה בְּעַד רַחְמָהּ׃

english.text:
Moreover, her rival, to make her miserable, would taunt her that
YHWH had closed her womb.

translation.text: And her adversary also provoked her sore, for to make her fret, because the LORD had shut up her womb.

verses.english:
Moreover, her rival, to make her miserable, would taunt her that
YHWH had closed her womb.

verses.hebrew: וְכֵן יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה מִדֵּי עֲלֹתָהּ בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה כֵּן תַּכְעִסֶנָּה וַתִּבְכֶּה וְלֹא תֹאכַל׃

hebrew.text: וְכֵן יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה מִדֵּי עֲלֹתָהּ בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה כֵּן תַּכְעִסֶנָּה וַתִּבְכֶּה וְלֹא תֹאכַל׃

english.text:
This happened year after year: Every time she went up to the House
of YHWH, the other would taunt her, so that she wept and would not
eat.

translation.text: And as he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of the LORD, so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.

verses.english:
This happened year after year: Every time she went up to the House
of YHWH, the other would taunt her, so that she wept and would not
eat.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ אֶלְקָנָה אִישָׁהּ חַנָּה לָמֶה תִבְכִּי וְלָמֶה לֹא תֹאכְלִי וְלָמֶה יֵרַע לְבָבֵךְ הֲלוֹא אָנֹכִי טוֹב לָךְ מֵעֲשָׂרָה בָּנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ אֶלְקָנָה אִישָׁהּ חַנָּה לָמֶה תִבְכִּי וְלָמֶה לֹא תֹאכְלִי וְלָמֶה יֵרַע לְבָבֵךְ הֲלוֹא אָנֹכִי טוֹב לָךְ מֵעֲשָׂרָה בָּנִים׃

english.text:
Her husband Elkanah said to her, “Hannah, why are you crying and
why aren’t you eating? Why are you so sad? Am I not more devoted
to you than ten sons?”

translation.text: Then said Elkanah her husband to her, Hannah, why weepest thou? and why eatest thou not? and why is thy heart grieved? am not I better to thee than ten sons?

verses.english:
Her husband Elkanah said to her, “Hannah, why are you crying and
why aren’t you eating? Why are you so sad? Am I not more devoted
to you than ten sons?”

verses.hebrew: וַתָּקם חַנָּה אַחֲרֵי אכְלָה בְשִׁלֹה וְאַחֲרֵי שָׁתֹה וְעֵלִי הַכֹּהֵן יֹשֵׁב עַל־הַכִּסֵּא עַל־מְזוּזַת הֵיכַל יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּקם חַנָּה אַחֲרֵי אכְלָה בְשִׁלֹה וְאַחֲרֵי שָׁתֹה וְעֵלִי הַכֹּהֵן יֹשֵׁב עַל־הַכִּסֵּא עַל־מְזוּזַת הֵיכַל יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
After they had eaten and drunk at Shiloh, Hannah rose.—The priest
Eli was sitting on the seat near the doorpost of the temple of
YHWH.—

translation.text: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk. Now Eli the priest sat upon a seat by a post of the temple of the LORD.

verses.english:
After they had eaten and drunk at Shiloh, Hannah rose.—The priest
Eli was sitting on the seat near the doorpost of the temple of
YHWH.—

verses.hebrew: וְהִיא מָרַת נָפֶשׁ וַתִּתְפַּלֵּל עַל־יְהֹוָה וּבָכֹה תִבְכֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִיא מָרַת נָפֶשׁ וַתִּתְפַּלֵּל עַל־יְהֹוָה וּבָכֹה תִבְכֶּה׃

english.text: In her wretchedness, she prayed to YHWH, weeping all the while.

translation.text: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto the LORD, and wept sore.

verses.english: In her wretchedness, she prayed to YHWH, weeping all the while.

verses.hebrew:
וַתִּדֹּר נֶדֶר וַתֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אִם־רָאֹה תִרְאֶה בּעֳנִי אֲמָתֶךָ וּזְכַרְתַּנִי וְלֹא־תִשְׁכַּח אֶת־אֲמָתֶךָ וְנָתַתָּה לַאֲמָתְךָ זֶרַע אֲנָשִׁים וּנְתַתִּיו לַיהֹוָה
כּל־יְמֵי חַיָּיו וּמוֹרָה לֹא־יַעֲלֶה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּדֹּר נֶדֶר וַתֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אִם־רָאֹה תִרְאֶה בּעֳנִי אֲמָתֶךָ וּזְכַרְתַּנִי וְלֹא־תִשְׁכַּח אֶת־אֲמָתֶךָ וְנָתַתָּה לַאֲמָתְךָ זֶרַע אֲנָשִׁים וּנְתַתִּיו לַיהֹוָה
כּל־יְמֵי חַיָּיו וּמוֹרָה לֹא־יַעֲלֶה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
And she made this vow: “O LORD of Hosts, if You will look upon the
suffering of Your maidservant and will remember me and not forget
Your maidservant, and if You will grant Your maidservant a male
child, I will dedicate him to YHWH for all the days of his life;
and no razor shall ever touch his head.”

translation.text: And she vowed a vow, and said, O LORD of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid, but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto the LORD all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.

verses.english:
And she made this vow: “O LORD of Hosts, if You will look upon the
suffering of Your maidservant and will remember me and not forget
Your maidservant, and if You will grant Your maidservant a male
child, I will dedicate him to YHWH for all the days of his life;
and no razor shall ever touch his head.”

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי הִרְבְּתָה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְעֵלִי שֹׁמֵר אֶת־פִּיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי הִרְבְּתָה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְעֵלִי שֹׁמֵר אֶת־פִּיהָ׃

english.text: As she kept on praying before YHWH, Eli watched her mouth.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as she continued praying before the LORD, that Eli marked her mouth.

verses.english: As she kept on praying before YHWH, Eli watched her mouth.

verses.hebrew: וְחַנָּה הִיא מְדַבֶּרֶת עַל־לִבָּהּ רַק שְׂפָתֶיהָ נָּעוֹת וְקוֹלָהּ לֹא יִשָּׁמֵעַ וַיַּחְשְׁבֶהָ עֵלִי לְשִׁכֹּרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְחַנָּה הִיא מְדַבֶּרֶת עַל־לִבָּהּ רַק שְׂפָתֶיהָ נָּעוֹת וְקוֹלָהּ לֹא יִשָּׁמֵעַ וַיַּחְשְׁבֶהָ עֵלִי לְשִׁכֹּרָה׃

english.text:
Now Hannah was praying in her heart; only her lips moved, but her
voice could not be heard. So Eli thought she was drunk.

translation.text: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.

verses.english:
Now Hannah was praying in her heart; only her lips moved, but her
voice could not be heard. So Eli thought she was drunk.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ עֵלִי עַד־מָתַי תִּשְׁתַּכָּרִין הָסִירִי אֶת־יֵינֵךְ מֵעָלָיִךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ עֵלִי עַד־מָתַי תִּשְׁתַּכָּרִין הָסִירִי אֶת־יֵינֵךְ מֵעָלָיִךְ׃

english.text:
Eli said to her, “How long will you make a drunken spectacle of
yourself? Sober up!”

translation.text: And Eli said unto her, How long wilt thou be drunken? put away thy wine from thee.

verses.english:
Eli said to her, “How long will you make a drunken spectacle of
yourself? Sober up!”

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעַן חַנָּה וַתֹּאמֶר לֹא אֲדֹנִי אִשָּׁה קְשַׁת־רוּחַ אָנֹכִי וְיַיִן וְשֵׁכָר לֹא שָׁתִיתִי וָאֶשְׁפֹּךְ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעַן חַנָּה וַתֹּאמֶר לֹא אֲדֹנִי אִשָּׁה קְשַׁת־רוּחַ אָנֹכִי וְיַיִן וְשֵׁכָר לֹא שָׁתִיתִי וָאֶשְׁפֹּךְ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Hannah replied, “Oh no, my lord! I am a very unhappy woman. I
have drunk no wine or other strong drink, but I have been pouring
out my heart to YHWH.

translation.text: And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the LORD.

verses.english:
And Hannah replied, “Oh no, my lord! I am a very unhappy woman. I
have drunk no wine or other strong drink, but I have been pouring
out my heart to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתֵּן אֶת־אֲמָתְךָ לִפְנֵי בַּת־בְּלִיָּעַל כִּי־מֵרֹב שִׂיחִי וְכַעְסִי דִּבַּרְתִּי עַד־הֵנָּה׃

hebrew.text: אַל־תִּתֵּן אֶת־אֲמָתְךָ לִפְנֵי בַּת־בְּלִיָּעַל כִּי־מֵרֹב שִׂיחִי וְכַעְסִי דִּבַּרְתִּי עַד־הֵנָּה׃

english.text:
Do not take your maidservant for a worthless woman; I have only
been speaking all this time out of my great anguish and distress.”

translation.text: Count not thine handmaid for a daughter of Belial: for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto.

verses.english:
Do not take your maidservant for a worthless woman; I have only
been speaking all this time out of my great anguish and distress.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן עֵלִי וַיֹּאמֶר לְכִי לְשָׁלוֹם וֵאלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יִתֵּן אֶת־שֵׁלָתֵךְ אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתְּ מֵעִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן עֵלִי וַיֹּאמֶר לְכִי לְשָׁלוֹם וֵאלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יִתֵּן אֶת־שֵׁלָתֵךְ אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתְּ מֵעִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
“Then go in peace,” said Eli, “and may the God of Israel grant you
what you have asked of Him.”

translation.text: Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace: and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him.

verses.english:
“Then go in peace,” said Eli, “and may the God of Israel grant you
what you have asked of Him.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר תִּמְצָא שִׁפְחָתְךָ חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וַתֵּלֶךְ הָאִשָּׁה לְדַרְכָּהּ וַתֹּאכַל וּפָנֶיהָ לֹא־הָיוּ־לָהּ עוֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר תִּמְצָא שִׁפְחָתְךָ חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וַתֵּלֶךְ הָאִשָּׁה לְדַרְכָּהּ וַתֹּאכַל וּפָנֶיהָ לֹא־הָיוּ־לָהּ עוֹד׃

english.text:
She answered, “You are most kind to your handmaid.” So the woman
left, and she ate, and was no longer downcast.

translation.text: And she said, Let thine handmaid find grace in thy sight. So the woman went her way, and did eat, and her countenance was no more sad.

verses.english:
She answered, “You are most kind to your handmaid.” So the woman
left, and she ate, and was no longer downcast.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ בַבֹּקֶר וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בֵּיתָם הָרָמָתָה וַיֵּדַע אֶלְקָנָה אֶת־חַנָּה אִשְׁתּוֹ וַיִּזְכְּרֶהָ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ בַבֹּקֶר וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בֵּיתָם הָרָמָתָה וַיֵּדַע אֶלְקָנָה אֶת־חַנָּה אִשְׁתּוֹ וַיִּזְכְּרֶהָ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Early next morning they bowed low before YHWH, and they went back
home to Ramah. Elkanah knew his wife Hannah and YHWH remembered
her.

translation.text: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshipped before the LORD, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah: and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the LORD remembered her.

verses.english:
Early next morning they bowed low before YHWH, and they went back
home to Ramah. Elkanah knew his wife Hannah and YHWH remembered
her.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִתְקֻפוֹת הַיָּמִים וַתַּהַר חַנָּה וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שְׁמוּאֵל כִּי מֵיְהֹוָה שְׁאִלְתִּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לִתְקֻפוֹת הַיָּמִים וַתַּהַר חַנָּה וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שְׁמוּאֵל כִּי מֵיְהֹוָה שְׁאִלְתִּיו׃

english.text:
Hannah conceived, and at the turn of the year bore a son. She
named him Samuel, meaning, “I asked YHWH for him.”

translation.text: Wherefore it came to pass, when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived, that she bare a son, and called his name Samuel, saying, Because I have asked him of the LORD.

verses.english:
Hannah conceived, and at the turn of the year bore a son. She
named him Samuel, meaning, “I asked YHWH for him.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל הָאִישׁ אֶלְקָנָה וְכל־בֵּיתוֹ לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֶת־זֶבַח הַיָּמִים וְאֶת־נִדְרוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל הָאִישׁ אֶלְקָנָה וְכל־בֵּיתוֹ לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֶת־זֶבַח הַיָּמִים וְאֶת־נִדְרוֹ׃

english.text:
And when the man Elkanah and all his household were going up to
offer to YHWH the annual sacrifice and his votive sacrifice,

translation.text: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto the LORD the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.

verses.english:
And when the man Elkanah and all his household were going up to
offer to YHWH the annual sacrifice and his votive sacrifice,

verses.hebrew: וְחַנָּה לֹא עָלָתָה כִּי־אָמְרָה לְאִישָׁהּ עַד יִגָּמֵל הַנַּעַר וַהֲבִאֹתִיו וְנִרְאָה אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה וְיָשַׁב שָׁם עַד־עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְחַנָּה לֹא עָלָתָה כִּי־אָמְרָה לְאִישָׁהּ עַד יִגָּמֵל הַנַּעַר וַהֲבִאֹתִיו וְנִרְאָה אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה וְיָשַׁב שָׁם עַד־עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
Hannah did not go up. She said to her husband, “When the child is
weaned, I will bring him. For when he has appeared before YHWH, he
must remain there for good.”

translation.text: But Hannah went not up; for she said unto her husband, I will not go up until the child be weaned, and then I will bring him, that he may appear before the LORD, and there abide for ever.

verses.english:
Hannah did not go up. She said to her husband, “When the child is
weaned, I will bring him. For when he has appeared before YHWH, he
must remain there for good.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ אֶלְקָנָה אִישָׁהּ עֲשִׂי הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינַיִךְ שְׁבִי עַד־גּמְלֵךְ אֹתוֹ אַךְ יָקֵם יְהֹוָה אֶת־דְּבָרוֹ וַתֵּשֶׁב הָאִשָּׁה וַתֵּינֶק אֶת־בְּנָהּ עַד־גּמְלָהּ
אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ אֶלְקָנָה אִישָׁהּ עֲשִׂי הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינַיִךְ שְׁבִי עַד־גּמְלֵךְ אֹתוֹ אַךְ יָקֵם יְהֹוָה אֶת־דְּבָרוֹ וַתֵּשֶׁב הָאִשָּׁה וַתֵּינֶק אֶת־בְּנָהּ עַד־גּמְלָהּ
אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
Her husband Elkanah said to her, “Do as you think best. Stay home
until you have weaned him. May YHWH fulfill His word.” So the
woman stayed home and nursed her son until she weaned him.

translation.text: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Do what seemeth thee good; tarry until thou have weaned him; only the LORD establish his word. So the woman abode, and gave her son suck until she weaned him.

verses.english:
Her husband Elkanah said to her, “Do as you think best. Stay home
until you have weaned him. May YHWH fulfill His word.” So the
woman stayed home and nursed her son until she weaned him.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲלֵהוּ עִמָּהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר גְּמָלַתּוּ בְּפָרִים שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאֵיפָה אַחַת קֶמַח וְנֵבֶל יַיִן וַתְּבִאֵהוּ בֵית־יְהֹוָה שִׁלוֹ וְהַנַּעַר נָעַר׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעֲלֵהוּ עִמָּהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר גְּמָלַתּוּ בְּפָרִים שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאֵיפָה אַחַת קֶמַח וְנֵבֶל יַיִן וַתְּבִאֵהוּ בֵית־יְהֹוָה שִׁלוֹ וְהַנַּעַר נָעַר׃

english.text:
When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, along with
three bulls, one ephah of flour, and a jar of wine. And though the
boy was still very young, she brought him to the House of YHWH at
Shiloh.

translation.text: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bullocks, and one ephah of flour, and a bottle of wine, and brought him unto the house of the LORD in Shiloh: and the child was young.

verses.english:
When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, along with
three bulls, one ephah of flour, and a jar of wine. And though the
boy was still very young, she brought him to the House of YHWH at
Shiloh.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת־הַפָּר וַיָּבִאוּ אֶת־הַנַּעַר אֶל־עֵלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת־הַפָּר וַיָּבִאוּ אֶת־הַנַּעַר אֶל־עֵלִי׃

english.text: After slaughtering the bull, they brought the boy to Eli.

translation.text: And they slew a bullock, and brought the child to Eli.

verses.english: After slaughtering the bull, they brought the boy to Eli.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר בִּי אֲדֹנִי חֵי נַפְשְׁךָ אֲדֹנִי אֲנִי הָאִשָּׁה הַנִּצֶּבֶת עִמְּכָה בָּזֶה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר בִּי אֲדֹנִי חֵי נַפְשְׁךָ אֲדֹנִי אֲנִי הָאִשָּׁה הַנִּצֶּבֶת עִמְּכָה בָּזֶה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
She said, “Please, my lord! As you live, my lord, I am the woman
who stood here beside you and prayed to YHWH.

translation.text: And she said, Oh my lord, as thy soul liveth, my lord, I am the woman that stood by thee here, praying unto the LORD.

verses.english:
She said, “Please, my lord! As you live, my lord, I am the woman
who stood here beside you and prayed to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַזֶּה הִתְפַּלָּלְתִּי וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה לִי אֶת־שְׁאֵלָתִי אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵעִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַזֶּה הִתְפַּלָּלְתִּי וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה לִי אֶת־שְׁאֵלָתִי אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵעִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
It was this boy I prayed for; and YHWH has granted me what I asked
of Him.

translation.text: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:

verses.english:
It was this boy I prayed for; and YHWH has granted me what I asked
of Him.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אָנֹכִי הִשְׁאִלְתִּהוּ לַיהֹוָה כּל־הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הָיָה הוּא שָׁאוּל לַיהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ שָׁם לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אָנֹכִי הִשְׁאִלְתִּהוּ לַיהֹוָה כּל־הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הָיָה הוּא שָׁאוּל לַיהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ שָׁם לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
I, in turn, hereby lend him to YHWH. For as long as he lives he is
lent to YHWH.” And they bowed low there before YHWH.

translation.text: Therefore also I have lent him to the LORD; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the LORD. And he worshipped the LORD there.

verses.english:
I, in turn, hereby lend him to YHWH. For as long as he lives he is
lent to YHWH.” And they bowed low there before YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּתְפַּלֵּל חַנָּה וַתֹּאמַר עָלַץ לִבִּי בַּיהֹוָה רָמָה קַרְנִי בַּיהֹוָה רָחַב פִּי עַל־אוֹיְבַי כִּי שָׂמַחְתִּי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּתְפַּלֵּל חַנָּה וַתֹּאמַר עָלַץ לִבִּי בַּיהֹוָה רָמָה קַרְנִי בַּיהֹוָה רָחַב פִּי עַל־אוֹיְבַי כִּי שָׂמַחְתִּי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ׃

english.text:
And Hannah prayed: My heart exults in YHWH; I have triumphed
through YHWH. I gloat over my enemies; I rejoice in Your
deliverance.

translation.text: And Hannah prayed, and said, My heart rejoiceth in the LORD, mine horn is exalted in the LORD: my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies; because I rejoice in thy salvation.

verses.english:
And Hannah prayed: My heart exults in YHWH; I have triumphed
through YHWH. I gloat over my enemies; I rejoice in Your
deliverance.

verses.hebrew: אֵין־קָדוֹשׁ כַּיהֹוָה כִּי אֵין בִּלְתֶּךָ וְאֵין צוּר כֵּאלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: אֵין־קָדוֹשׁ כַּיהֹוָה כִּי אֵין בִּלְתֶּךָ וְאֵין צוּר כֵּאלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text:
There is no holy one like YHWH, Truly, there is none beside You;
There is no rock like our God.

translation.text: There is none holy as the LORD: for there is none beside thee: neither is there any rock like our God.

verses.english:
There is no holy one like YHWH, Truly, there is none beside You;
There is no rock like our God.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּרְבּוּ תְדַבְּרוּ גְּבֹהָה גְבֹהָה יֵצֵא עָתָק מִפִּיכֶם כִּי אֵל דֵּעוֹת יְהֹוָה (ולא) [וְלוֹ] נִתְכְּנוּ עֲלִלוֹת׃

hebrew.text: אַל־תַּרְבּוּ תְדַבְּרוּ גְּבֹהָה גְבֹהָה יֵצֵא עָתָק מִפִּיכֶם כִּי אֵל דֵּעוֹת יְהֹוָה (ולא) [וְלוֹ] נִתְכְּנוּ עֲלִלוֹת׃

english.text:
Talk no more with lofty pride, Let no arrogance cross your lips!
For YHWH is an all-knowing God; By Him actions are measured.

translation.text: Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth: for the LORD is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.

verses.english:
Talk no more with lofty pride, Let no arrogance cross your lips!
For YHWH is an all-knowing God; By Him actions are measured.

verses.hebrew: קֶשֶׁת גִּבֹּרִים חַתִּים וְנִכְשָׁלִים אָזְרוּ חָיִל׃

hebrew.text: קֶשֶׁת גִּבֹּרִים חַתִּים וְנִכְשָׁלִים אָזְרוּ חָיִל׃

english.text:
The bows of the mighty are broken, And the faltering are girded
with strength.

translation.text: The bows of the mighty men are broken, and they that stumbled are girded with strength.

verses.english:
The bows of the mighty are broken, And the faltering are girded
with strength.

verses.hebrew: שְׂבֵעִים בַּלֶּחֶם נִשְׂכָּרוּ וּרְעֵבִים חָדֵלּוּ עַד־עֲקָרָה יָלְדָה שִׁבְעָה וְרַבַּת בָּנִים אֻמְלָלָה׃

hebrew.text: שְׂבֵעִים בַּלֶּחֶם נִשְׂכָּרוּ וּרְעֵבִים חָדֵלּוּ עַד־עֲקָרָה יָלְדָה שִׁבְעָה וְרַבַּת בָּנִים אֻמְלָלָה׃

english.text:
Men once sated must hire out for bread; Men once hungry hunger no
more. While the barren woman bears seven, The mother of many is
forlorn.

translation.text: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread; and they that were hungry ceased: so that the barren hath born seven; and she that hath many children is waxed feeble.

verses.english:
Men once sated must hire out for bread; Men once hungry hunger no
more. While the barren woman bears seven, The mother of many is
forlorn.

verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה מוֹרִיד שְׁאוֹל וַיָּעַל׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה מוֹרִיד שְׁאוֹל וַיָּעַל׃

english.text:
YHWH deals death and gives life, Casts down into Sheol and raises
up.

translation.text: The LORD killeth, and maketh alive: he bringeth down to the grave, and bringeth up.

verses.english:
YHWH deals death and gives life, Casts down into Sheol and raises
up.

verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה מוֹרִישׁ וּמַעֲשִׁיר מַשְׁפִּיל אַף־מְרוֹמֵם׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה מוֹרִישׁ וּמַעֲשִׁיר מַשְׁפִּיל אַף־מְרוֹמֵם׃

english.text: YHWH makes poor and makes rich; He casts down, He also lifts high.

translation.text: The LORD maketh poor, and maketh rich: he bringeth low, and lifteth up.

verses.english: YHWH makes poor and makes rich; He casts down, He also lifts high.

verses.hebrew: מֵקִים מֵעָפָר דָּל מֵאַשְׁפֹּת יָרִים אֶבְיוֹן לְהוֹשִׁיב עִם־נְדִיבִים וְכִסֵּא כָבוֹד יַנְחִלֵם כִּי לַיהֹוָה מְצֻקֵי אֶרֶץ וַיָּשֶׁת עֲלֵיהֶם תֵּבֵל׃

hebrew.text: מֵקִים מֵעָפָר דָּל מֵאַשְׁפֹּת יָרִים אֶבְיוֹן לְהוֹשִׁיב עִם־נְדִיבִים וְכִסֵּא כָבוֹד יַנְחִלֵם כִּי לַיהֹוָה מְצֻקֵי אֶרֶץ וַיָּשֶׁת עֲלֵיהֶם תֵּבֵל׃

english.text:
He raises the poor from the dust, Lifts up the needy from the
dunghill, Setting them with nobles, Granting them seats of honor.
For the pillars of the earth are YHWH’s; He has set the world upon
them.

translation.text: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the LORD’s, and he hath set the world upon them.

verses.english:
He raises the poor from the dust, Lifts up the needy from the
dunghill, Setting them with nobles, Granting them seats of honor.
For the pillars of the earth are YHWH’s; He has set the world upon
them.

verses.hebrew: רַגְלֵי חֲסִידָו יִשְׁמֹר וּרְשָׁעִים בַּחֹשֶׁךְ יִדָּמּוּ כִּי־לֹא בְכֹחַ יִגְבַּר־אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: רַגְלֵי חֲסִידָו יִשְׁמֹר וּרְשָׁעִים בַּחֹשֶׁךְ יִדָּמּוּ כִּי־לֹא בְכֹחַ יִגְבַּר־אִישׁ׃

english.text:
He guards the steps of His faithful, But the wicked perish in
darkness— For not by strength shall man prevail.

translation.text: He will keep the feet of his saints, and the wicked shall be silent in darkness; for by strength shall no man prevail.

verses.english:
He guards the steps of His faithful, But the wicked perish in
darkness— For not by strength shall man prevail.

verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה יֵחַתּוּ מְרִיבָו עָלָו בַּשָּׁמַיִם יַרְעֵם יְהֹוָה יָדִין אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ וְיִתֶּן־עֹז לְמַלְכּוֹ וְיָרֵם קֶרֶן מְשִׁיחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: יְהֹוָה יֵחַתּוּ מְרִיבָו עָלָו בַּשָּׁמַיִם יַרְעֵם יְהֹוָה יָדִין אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ וְיִתֶּן־עֹז לְמַלְכּוֹ וְיָרֵם קֶרֶן מְשִׁיחוֹ׃

english.text:
The foes of YHWH shall be shattered; He will thunder against them
in the heavens. YHWH will judge the ends of the earth. He will
give power to His king, And triumph to His anointed one.

translation.text: The adversaries of the LORD shall be broken to pieces; out of heaven shall he thunder upon them: the LORD shall judge the ends of the earth; and he shall give strength unto his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.

verses.english:
The foes of YHWH shall be shattered; He will thunder against them
in the heavens. YHWH will judge the ends of the earth. He will
give power to His king, And triumph to His anointed one.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶלְקָנָה הָרָמָתָה עַל־בֵּיתוֹ וְהַנַּעַר הָיָה מְשָׁרֵת אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֶת־פְּנֵי עֵלִי הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶלְקָנָה הָרָמָתָה עַל־בֵּיתוֹ וְהַנַּעַר הָיָה מְשָׁרֵת אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֶת־פְּנֵי עֵלִי הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
Then Elkanah [and Hannah] went home to Ramah; and the boy entered
the service of YHWH under the priest Eli.

translation.text: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child did minister unto the LORD before Eli the priest.

verses.english:
Then Elkanah [and Hannah] went home to Ramah; and the boy entered
the service of YHWH under the priest Eli.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי עֵלִי בְּנֵי בְלִיָּעַל לֹא יָדְעוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי עֵלִי בְּנֵי בְלִיָּעַל לֹא יָדְעוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text: Now Eli’s sons were scoundrels; they paid no heed to YHWH.

translation.text: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial; they knew not the LORD.

verses.english: Now Eli’s sons were scoundrels; they paid no heed to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וּמִשְׁפַּט הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־הָעָם כּל־אִישׁ זֹבֵחַ זֶבַח וּבָא נַעַר הַכֹּהֵן כְּבַשֵּׁל הַבָּשָׂר וְהַמַּזְלֵג שְׁלֹשׁ הַשִּׁנַּיִם בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּמִשְׁפַּט הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־הָעָם כּל־אִישׁ זֹבֵחַ זֶבַח וּבָא נַעַר הַכֹּהֵן כְּבַשֵּׁל הַבָּשָׂר וְהַמַּזְלֵג שְׁלֹשׁ הַשִּׁנַּיִם בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
This is how the priests used to deal with the people: When anyone
brought a sacrifice, the priest’s boy would come along with a
three-pronged fork while the meat was boiling,

translation.text: And the priest’s custom with the people was, that, when any man offered sacrifice, the priest’s servant came, while the flesh was in seething, with a fleshhook of three teeth in his hand;

verses.english:
This is how the priests used to deal with the people: When anyone
brought a sacrifice, the priest’s boy would come along with a
three-pronged fork while the meat was boiling,

verses.hebrew: וְהִכָּה בַכִּיּוֹר אוֹ בַדּוּד אוֹ בַקַּלַּחַת אוֹ בַפָּרוּר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲלֶה הַמַּזְלֵג יִקַּח הַכֹּהֵן בּוֹ כָּכָה יַעֲשׂוּ לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַבָּאִים שָׁם בְּשִׁלֹה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִכָּה בַכִּיּוֹר אוֹ בַדּוּד אוֹ בַקַּלַּחַת אוֹ בַפָּרוּר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲלֶה הַמַּזְלֵג יִקַּח הַכֹּהֵן בּוֹ כָּכָה יַעֲשׂוּ לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַבָּאִים שָׁם בְּשִׁלֹה׃

english.text:
and he would thrust it into the cauldron, or the kettle, or the
great pot, or the small cooking-pot; and whatever the fork brought
up, the priest would take away on it. This was the practice at
Shiloh with all the Israelites who came there.

translation.text: And he struck it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; all that the fleshhook brought up the priest took for himself. So they did in Shiloh unto all the Israelites that came thither.

verses.english:
and he would thrust it into the cauldron, or the kettle, or the
great pot, or the small cooking-pot; and whatever the fork brought
up, the priest would take away on it. This was the practice at
Shiloh with all the Israelites who came there.

verses.hebrew: גַּם בְּטֶרֶם יַקְטִרוּן אֶת־הַחֵלֶב וּבָא נַעַר הַכֹּהֵן וְאָמַר לָאִישׁ הַזֹּבֵחַ תְּנָה בָשָׂר לִצְלוֹת לַכֹּהֵן וְלֹא־יִקַּח מִמְּךָ בָּשָׂר מְבֻשָּׁל כִּי אִם־חָי׃

hebrew.text: גַּם בְּטֶרֶם יַקְטִרוּן אֶת־הַחֵלֶב וּבָא נַעַר הַכֹּהֵן וְאָמַר לָאִישׁ הַזֹּבֵחַ תְּנָה בָשָׂר לִצְלוֹת לַכֹּהֵן וְלֹא־יִקַּח מִמְּךָ בָּשָׂר מְבֻשָּׁל כִּי אִם־חָי׃

english.text:
[But now] even before the suet was turned into smoke, the priest’s
boy would come and say to the man who was sacrificing, “Hand over
some meat to roast for the priest; for he won’t accept boiled meat
from you, only raw.”

translation.text: Also before they burnt the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have sodden flesh of thee, but raw.

verses.english:
[But now] even before the suet was turned into smoke, the priest’s
boy would come and say to the man who was sacrificing, “Hand over
some meat to roast for the priest; for he won’t accept boiled meat
from you, only raw.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הָאִישׁ קַטֵּר יַקְטִירוּן כַּיּוֹם הַחֵלֶב וְקַח־לְךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר תְּאַוֶּה נַפְשֶׁךָ וְאָמַר [לֹא] (לו) כִּי עַתָּה תִתֵּן וְאִם־לֹא לָקַחְתִּי בְחזְקָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הָאִישׁ קַטֵּר יַקְטִירוּן כַּיּוֹם הַחֵלֶב וְקַח־לְךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר תְּאַוֶּה נַפְשֶׁךָ וְאָמַר [לֹא] (לו) כִּי עַתָּה תִתֵּן וְאִם־לֹא לָקַחְתִּי בְחזְקָה׃

english.text:
And if the man said to him, “Let them first turn the suet into
smoke, and then take as much as you want,” he would reply, “No,
hand it over at once or I’ll take it by force.”

translation.text: And if any man said unto him, Let them not fail to burn the fat presently, and then take as much as thy soul desireth; then he would answer him, Nay; but thou shalt give it me now: and if not, I will take it by force.

verses.english:
And if the man said to him, “Let them first turn the suet into
smoke, and then take as much as you want,” he would reply, “No,
hand it over at once or I’ll take it by force.”

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי חַטַּאת הַנְּעָרִים גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי נִאֲצוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים אֵת מִנְחַת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי חַטַּאת הַנְּעָרִים גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי נִאֲצוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים אֵת מִנְחַת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The sin of the young men against YHWH was very great, for the men
treated YHWH’s offerings impiously.

translation.text: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the LORD: for men abhorred the offering of the LORD.

verses.english:
The sin of the young men against YHWH was very great, for the men
treated YHWH’s offerings impiously.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמוּאֵל מְשָׁרֵת אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה נַעַר חָגוּר אֵפוֹד בָּד׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמוּאֵל מְשָׁרֵת אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה נַעַר חָגוּר אֵפוֹד בָּד׃

english.text:
Samuel was engaged in the service of YHWH as an attendant, girded
with a linen ephod.

translation.text: But Samuel ministered before the LORD, being a child, girded with a linen ephod.

verses.english:
Samuel was engaged in the service of YHWH as an attendant, girded
with a linen ephod.

verses.hebrew: וּמְעִיל קָטֹן תַּעֲשֶׂה־לּוֹ אִמּוֹ וְהַעַלְתָה לוֹ מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה בַּעֲלוֹתָהּ אֶת־אִישָׁהּ לִזְבֹּחַ אֶת־זֶבַח הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וּמְעִיל קָטֹן תַּעֲשֶׂה־לּוֹ אִמּוֹ וְהַעַלְתָה לוֹ מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה בַּעֲלוֹתָהּ אֶת־אִישָׁהּ לִזְבֹּחַ אֶת־זֶבַח הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
His mother would also make a little robe for him and bring it up
to him every year, when she made the pilgrimage with her husband
to offer the annual sacrifice.

translation.text: Moreover his mother made him a little coat, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

verses.english:
His mother would also make a little robe for him and bring it up
to him every year, when she made the pilgrimage with her husband
to offer the annual sacrifice.

verses.hebrew: וּבֵרַךְ עֵלִי אֶת־אֶלְקָנָה וְאֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאָמַר יָשֵׂם יְהֹוָה לְךָ זֶרַע מִן־הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת תַּחַת הַשְּׁאֵלָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַל לַיהֹוָה וְהָלְכוּ לִמְקוֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּבֵרַךְ עֵלִי אֶת־אֶלְקָנָה וְאֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאָמַר יָשֵׂם יְהֹוָה לְךָ זֶרַע מִן־הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת תַּחַת הַשְּׁאֵלָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַל לַיהֹוָה וְהָלְכוּ לִמְקוֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, and say, “May YHWH grant you
offspring by this woman in place of the loan she made to YHWH.”
Then they would return home.

translation.text: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, The LORD give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the LORD. And they went unto their own home.

verses.english:
Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, and say, “May YHWH grant you
offspring by this woman in place of the loan she made to YHWH.”
Then they would return home.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־פָקַד יְהֹוָה אֶת־חַנָּה וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד שְׁלֹשָׁה־בָנִים וּשְׁתֵּי בָנוֹת וַיִּגְדַּל הַנַּעַר שְׁמוּאֵל עִם־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־פָקַד יְהֹוָה אֶת־חַנָּה וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד שְׁלֹשָׁה־בָנִים וּשְׁתֵּי בָנוֹת וַיִּגְדַּל הַנַּעַר שְׁמוּאֵל עִם־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
For YHWH took note of Hannah; she conceived and bore three sons
and two daughters. Young Samuel meanwhile grew up in the service
of YHWH.

translation.text: And the LORD visited Hannah, so that she conceived, and bare three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the LORD.

verses.english:
For YHWH took note of Hannah; she conceived and bore three sons
and two daughters. Young Samuel meanwhile grew up in the service
of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְעֵלִי זָקֵן מְאֹד וְשָׁמַע אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּן בָּנָיו לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁכְּבוּן אֶת־הַנָּשִׁים הַצֹּבְאוֹת פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

hebrew.text: וְעֵלִי זָקֵן מְאֹד וְשָׁמַע אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּן בָּנָיו לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁכְּבוּן אֶת־הַנָּשִׁים הַצֹּבְאוֹת פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

english.text:
Now Eli was very old. When he heard all that his sons were doing
to all Israel, and how they lay with the women who performed tasks
at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting,

translation.text: Now Eli was very old, and heard all that his sons did unto all Israel; and how they lay with the women that assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.english:
Now Eli was very old. When he heard all that his sons were doing
to all Israel, and how they lay with the women who performed tasks
at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לָמָּה תַעֲשׂוּן כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי שֹׁמֵעַ אֶת־דִּבְרֵיכֶם רָעִים מֵאֵת כּל־הָעָם אֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לָמָּה תַעֲשׂוּן כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי שֹׁמֵעַ אֶת־דִּבְרֵיכֶם רָעִים מֵאֵת כּל־הָעָם אֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
he said to them, “Why do you do such things? I get evil reports
about you from the people on all hands.

translation.text: And he said unto them, Why do ye such things? for I hear of your evil dealings by all this people.

verses.english:
he said to them, “Why do you do such things? I get evil reports
about you from the people on all hands.

verses.hebrew: אַל בָּנָי כִּי לוֹא־טוֹבָה הַשְּׁמֻעָה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי שֹׁמֵעַ מַעֲבִרִים עַם־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אַל בָּנָי כִּי לוֹא־טוֹבָה הַשְּׁמֻעָה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי שֹׁמֵעַ מַעֲבִרִים עַם־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Don’t, my sons! It is no favorable report I hear the people of
YHWH spreading about.

translation.text: Nay, my sons; for it is no good report that I hear: ye make the LORD’s people to transgress.

verses.english:
Don’t, my sons! It is no favorable report I hear the people of
YHWH spreading about.

verses.hebrew: אִם־יֶחֱטָא אִישׁ לְאִישׁ וּפִלְלוֹ אֱלֹהִים וְאִם לַיהֹוָה יֶחֱטָא־אִישׁ מִי יִתְפַּלֶּל־לוֹ וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ לְקוֹל אֲבִיהֶם כִּי־חָפֵץ יְהֹוָה לַהֲמִיתָם׃

hebrew.text: אִם־יֶחֱטָא אִישׁ לְאִישׁ וּפִלְלוֹ אֱלֹהִים וְאִם לַיהֹוָה יֶחֱטָא־אִישׁ מִי יִתְפַּלֶּל־לוֹ וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ לְקוֹל אֲבִיהֶם כִּי־חָפֵץ יְהֹוָה לַהֲמִיתָם׃

english.text:
If a man sins against a man, God may pardon him; but if a man
offends against YHWH, who can obtain pardon for him?” But they
ignored their father’s plea; for YHWH was resolved that they
should die.

translation.text: If one man sin against another, the judge shall judge him: but if a man sin against the LORD, who shall intreat for him? Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father, because the LORD would slay them.

verses.english:
If a man sins against a man, God may pardon him; but if a man
offends against YHWH, who can obtain pardon for him?” But they
ignored their father’s plea; for YHWH was resolved that they
should die.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנַּעַר שְׁמוּאֵל הֹלֵךְ וְגָדֵל וָטוֹב גַּם עִם־יְהֹוָה וְגַם עִם־אֲנָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנַּעַר שְׁמוּאֵל הֹלֵךְ וְגָדֵל וָטוֹב גַּם עִם־יְהֹוָה וְגַם עִם־אֲנָשִׁים׃

english.text:
Young Samuel, meanwhile, grew in esteem and favor both with God
and with men.

translation.text: And the child Samuel grew on, and was in favour both with the LORD, and also with men.

verses.english:
Young Samuel, meanwhile, grew in esteem and favor both with God
and with men.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אִישׁ־אֱלֹהִים אֶל־עֵלִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הֲנִגְלֹה נִגְלֵיתִי אֶל־בֵּית אָבִיךָ בִּהְיוֹתָם בְּמִצְרַיִם לְבֵית פַּרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אִישׁ־אֱלֹהִים אֶל־עֵלִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הֲנִגְלֹה נִגְלֵיתִי אֶל־בֵּית אָבִיךָ בִּהְיוֹתָם בְּמִצְרַיִם לְבֵית פַּרְעֹה׃

english.text:
A man of God came to Eli and said to him, “Thus said YHWH: Lo, I
revealed Myself to your father’s house in Egypt when they were
subject to the House of Pharaoh,

translation.text: And there came a man of God unto Eli, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Did I plainly appear unto the house of thy father, when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh’s house?

verses.english:
A man of God came to Eli and said to him, “Thus said YHWH: Lo, I
revealed Myself to your father’s house in Egypt when they were
subject to the House of Pharaoh,

verses.hebrew: וּבָחֹר אֹתוֹ מִכּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִי לְכֹהֵן לַעֲלוֹת עַל־מִזְבְּחִי לְהַקְטִיר קְטֹרֶת לָשֵׂאת אֵפוֹד לְפָנָי וָאֶתְּנָה לְבֵית אָבִיךָ אֶת־כּל־אִשֵּׁי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וּבָחֹר אֹתוֹ מִכּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִי לְכֹהֵן לַעֲלוֹת עַל־מִזְבְּחִי לְהַקְטִיר קְטֹרֶת לָשֵׂאת אֵפוֹד לְפָנָי וָאֶתְּנָה לְבֵית אָבִיךָ אֶת־כּל־אִשֵּׁי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
and I chose them from among all the tribes of Israel to be My
priests—to ascend My altar, to burn incense, [and] to carry an
ephod before Me—and I assigned to your father’s house all
offerings by fire of the Israelites.

translation.text: And did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to offer upon mine altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? and did I give unto the house of thy father all the offerings made by fire of the children of Israel?

verses.english:
and I chose them from among all the tribes of Israel to be My
priests—to ascend My altar, to burn incense, [and] to carry an
ephod before Me—and I assigned to your father’s house all
offerings by fire of the Israelites.

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה תִבְעֲטוּ בְּזִבְחִי וּבְמִנְחָתִי אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי מָעוֹן וַתְּכַבֵּד אֶת־בָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי לְהַבְרִיאֲכֶם מֵרֵאשִׁית כּל־מִנְחַת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעַמִּי׃

hebrew.text: לָמָּה תִבְעֲטוּ בְּזִבְחִי וּבְמִנְחָתִי אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי מָעוֹן וַתְּכַבֵּד אֶת־בָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי לְהַבְרִיאֲכֶם מֵרֵאשִׁית כּל־מִנְחַת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעַמִּי׃

english.text:
Why, then, do you maliciously trample upon the sacrifices and
offerings that I have commanded? You have honored your sons more
than Me, feeding on the first portions of every offering of My
people Israel.

translation.text: Wherefore kick ye at my sacrifice and at mine offering, which I have commanded in my habitation; and honourest thy sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people?

verses.english:
Why, then, do you maliciously trample upon the sacrifices and
offerings that I have commanded? You have honored your sons more
than Me, feeding on the first portions of every offering of My
people Israel.

verses.hebrew:
לָכֵן נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָמוֹר אָמַרְתִּי בֵּיתְךָ וּבֵית אָבִיךָ יִתְהַלְּכוּ לְפָנַי עַד־עוֹלָם וְעַתָּה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה חָלִילָה לִּי כִּי־מְכַבְּדַי אֲכַבֵּד
וּבֹזַי יֵקָלּוּ׃

hebrew.text:
לָכֵן נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָמוֹר אָמַרְתִּי בֵּיתְךָ וּבֵית אָבִיךָ יִתְהַלְּכוּ לְפָנַי עַד־עוֹלָם וְעַתָּה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה חָלִילָה לִּי כִּי־מְכַבְּדַי אֲכַבֵּד
וּבֹזַי יֵקָלּוּ׃

english.text:
Assuredly—declares YHWH, the God of Israel—I intended for you and
your father’s house to remain in My service forever. But
now—declares YHWH—far be it from Me! For I honor those who honor
Me, but those who spurn Me shall be dishonored.

translation.text: Wherefore the LORD God of Israel saith, I said indeed that thy house, and the house of thy father, should walk before me for ever: but now the LORD saith, Be it far from me; for them that honour me I will honour, and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed.

verses.english:
Assuredly—declares YHWH, the God of Israel—I intended for you and
your father’s house to remain in My service forever. But
now—declares YHWH—far be it from Me! For I honor those who honor
Me, but those who spurn Me shall be dishonored.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה יָמִים בָּאִים וְגָדַעְתִּי אֶת־זְרֹעֲךָ וְאֶת־זְרֹעַ בֵּית אָבִיךָ מִהְיוֹת זָקֵן בְּבֵיתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה יָמִים בָּאִים וְגָדַעְתִּי אֶת־זְרֹעֲךָ וְאֶת־זְרֹעַ בֵּית אָבִיךָ מִהְיוֹת זָקֵן בְּבֵיתֶךָ׃

english.text:
A time is coming when I will break your power and that of your
father’s house, and there shall be no elder in your house.

translation.text: Behold, the days come, that I will cut off thine arm, and the arm of thy father’s house, that there shall not be an old man in thine house.

verses.english:
A time is coming when I will break your power and that of your
father’s house, and there shall be no elder in your house.

verses.hebrew: וְהִבַּטְתָּ צַר מָעוֹן בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יֵיטִיב אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה זָקֵן בְּבֵיתְךָ כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהִבַּטְתָּ צַר מָעוֹן בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יֵיטִיב אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה זָקֵן בְּבֵיתְךָ כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
You will gaze grudgingly at all the bounty that will be bestowed
on Israel, but there shall never be an elder in your house.

translation.text: And thou shalt see an enemy in my habitation, in all the wealth which God shall give Israel: and there shall not be an old man in thine house for ever.

verses.english:
You will gaze grudgingly at all the bounty that will be bestowed
on Israel, but there shall never be an elder in your house.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ לֹא־אַכְרִית לְךָ מֵעִם מִזְבְּחִי לְכַלּוֹת אֶת־עֵינֶיךָ וְלַאֲדִיב אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ וְכל־מַרְבִּית בֵּיתְךָ יָמוּתוּ אֲנָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ לֹא־אַכְרִית לְךָ מֵעִם מִזְבְּחִי לְכַלּוֹת אֶת־עֵינֶיךָ וְלַאֲדִיב אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ וְכל־מַרְבִּית בֵּיתְךָ יָמוּתוּ אֲנָשִׁים׃

english.text:
I shall not cut off all your offspring from My altar; [but,] to
make your eyes pine and your spirit languish, all the increase in
your house shall die as [ordinary] men.

translation.text: And the man of thine, whom I shall not cut off from mine altar, shall be to consume thine eyes, and to grieve thine heart: and all the increase of thine house shall die in the flower of their age.

verses.english:
I shall not cut off all your offspring from My altar; [but,] to
make your eyes pine and your spirit languish, all the increase in
your house shall die as [ordinary] men.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה־לְּךָ הָאוֹת אֲשֶׁר יָבֹא אֶל־שְׁנֵי בָנֶיךָ אֶל־חפְנִי וּפִינְחָס בְּיוֹם אֶחָד יָמוּתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה־לְּךָ הָאוֹת אֲשֶׁר יָבֹא אֶל־שְׁנֵי בָנֶיךָ אֶל־חפְנִי וּפִינְחָס בְּיוֹם אֶחָד יָמוּתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And this shall be a sign for you: The fate of your two sons Hophni
and Phinehas—they shall both die on the same day.

translation.text: And this shall be a sign unto thee, that shall come upon thy two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas; in one day they shall die both of them.

verses.english:
And this shall be a sign for you: The fate of your two sons Hophni
and Phinehas—they shall both die on the same day.

verses.hebrew: וַהֲקִימֹתִי לִי כֹּהֵן נֶאֱמָן כַּאֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבִי וּבְנַפְשִׁי יַעֲשֶׂה וּבָנִיתִי לוֹ בַּיִת נֶאֱמָן וְהִתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵי־מְשִׁיחִי כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַהֲקִימֹתִי לִי כֹּהֵן נֶאֱמָן כַּאֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבִי וּבְנַפְשִׁי יַעֲשֶׂה וּבָנִיתִי לוֹ בַּיִת נֶאֱמָן וְהִתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵי־מְשִׁיחִי כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
And I will raise up for Myself a faithful priest, who will act in
accordance with My wishes and My purposes. I will build for him an
enduring house, and he shall walk before My anointed evermore.

translation.text: And I will raise me up a faithful priest, that shall do according to that which is in mine heart and in my mind: and I will build him a sure house; and he shall walk before mine anointed for ever.

verses.english:
And I will raise up for Myself a faithful priest, who will act in
accordance with My wishes and My purposes. I will build for him an
enduring house, and he shall walk before My anointed evermore.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כּל־הַנּוֹתָר בְּבֵיתְךָ יָבוֹא לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לוֹ לַאֲגוֹרַת כֶּסֶף וְכִכַּר־לָחֶם וְאָמַר סְפָחֵנִי נָא אֶל־אַחַת הַכְּהֻנּוֹת לֶאֱכֹל פַּת־לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כּל־הַנּוֹתָר בְּבֵיתְךָ יָבוֹא לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לוֹ לַאֲגוֹרַת כֶּסֶף וְכִכַּר־לָחֶם וְאָמַר סְפָחֵנִי נָא אֶל־אַחַת הַכְּהֻנּוֹת לֶאֱכֹל פַּת־לָחֶם׃

english.text:
And all the survivors of your house shall come and bow low to him
for the sake of a money fee and a loaf of bread, and shall say,
‘Please, assign me to one of the priestly duties, that I may have
a morsel of bread to eat.’”

translation.text: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left in thine house shall come and crouch to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread, and shall say, Put me, I pray thee, into one of the priests’ offices, that I may eat a piece of bread.

verses.english:
And all the survivors of your house shall come and bow low to him
for the sake of a money fee and a loaf of bread, and shall say,
‘Please, assign me to one of the priestly duties, that I may have
a morsel of bread to eat.’”

verses.hebrew: וְהַנַּעַר שְׁמוּאֵל מְשָׁרֵת אֶת־יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵי עֵלִי וּדְבַר־יְהֹוָה הָיָה יָקָר בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין חָזוֹן נִפְרָץ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנַּעַר שְׁמוּאֵל מְשָׁרֵת אֶת־יְהֹוָה לִפְנֵי עֵלִי וּדְבַר־יְהֹוָה הָיָה יָקָר בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין חָזוֹן נִפְרָץ׃

english.text:
Young Samuel was in the service of YHWH under Eli. In those days
the word of YHWH was rare; prophecy was not widespread.

translation.text: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days; there was no open vision.

verses.english:
Young Samuel was in the service of YHWH under Eli. In those days
the word of YHWH was rare; prophecy was not widespread.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְעֵלִי שֹׁכֵב בִּמְקוֹמוֹ וְעֵינָו הֵחֵלּוּ כֵהוֹת לֹא יוּכַל לִרְאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְעֵלִי שֹׁכֵב בִּמְקוֹמוֹ וְעֵינָו הֵחֵלּוּ כֵהוֹת לֹא יוּכַל לִרְאוֹת׃

english.text:
One day, Eli was asleep in his usual place; his eyes had begun to
fail and he could barely see.

translation.text: And it came to pass at that time, when Eli was laid down in his place, and his eyes began to wax dim, that he could not see;

verses.english:
One day, Eli was asleep in his usual place; his eyes had begun to
fail and he could barely see.

verses.hebrew: וְנֵר אֱלֹהִים טֶרֶם יִכְבֶּה וּשְׁמוּאֵל שֹׁכֵב בְּהֵיכַל יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם אֲרוֹן אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וְנֵר אֱלֹהִים טֶרֶם יִכְבֶּה וּשְׁמוּאֵל שֹׁכֵב בְּהֵיכַל יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם אֲרוֹן אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
The lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel was sleeping in
the temple of YHWH where the Ark of God was.

translation.text: And ere the lamp of God went out in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was, and Samuel was laid down to sleep;

verses.english:
The lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel was sleeping in
the temple of YHWH where the Ark of God was.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי׃

english.text: YHWH called out to Samuel, and he answered, “I’m coming.”

translation.text: That the LORD called Samuel: and he answered, Here am I.

verses.english: YHWH called out to Samuel, and he answered, “I’m coming.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרץ אֶל־עֵלִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְנִי כִּי־קָרָאתָ לִּי וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־קָרָאתִי שׁוּב שְׁכָב וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁכָּב׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּרץ אֶל־עֵלִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְנִי כִּי־קָרָאתָ לִּי וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־קָרָאתִי שׁוּב שְׁכָב וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁכָּב׃

english.text:
He ran to Eli and said, “Here I am; you called me.” But he
replied, “I didn’t call you; go back to sleep.” So he went back
and lay down.

translation.text: And he ran unto Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou calledst me. And he said, I called not; lie down again. And he went and lay down.

verses.english:
He ran to Eli and said, “Here I am; you called me.” But he
replied, “I didn’t call you; go back to sleep.” So he went back
and lay down.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף יְהֹוָה קְרֹא עוֹד שְׁמוּאֵל וַיָּקם שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־עֵלִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְנִי כִּי קָרָאתָ לִי וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־קָרָאתִי בְנִי שׁוּב שְׁכָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסֶף יְהֹוָה קְרֹא עוֹד שְׁמוּאֵל וַיָּקם שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־עֵלִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְנִי כִּי קָרָאתָ לִי וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־קָרָאתִי בְנִי שׁוּב שְׁכָב׃

english.text:
Again YHWH called, “Samuel!” Samuel rose and went to Eli and said,
“Here I am; you called me.” But he replied, “I didn’t call, my
son; go back to sleep.”—

translation.text: And the LORD called yet again, Samuel. And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou didst call me. And he answered, I called not, my son; lie down again.

verses.english:
Again YHWH called, “Samuel!” Samuel rose and went to Eli and said,
“Here I am; you called me.” But he replied, “I didn’t call, my
son; go back to sleep.”—

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמוּאֵל טֶרֶם יָדַע אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְטֶרֶם יִגָּלֶה אֵלָיו דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמוּאֵל טֶרֶם יָדַע אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְטֶרֶם יִגָּלֶה אֵלָיו דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Now Samuel had not yet experienced YHWH; the word of YHWH had not
yet been revealed to him.—

translation.text: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, neither was the word of the LORD yet revealed unto him.

verses.english:
Now Samuel had not yet experienced YHWH; the word of YHWH had not
yet been revealed to him.—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף יְהֹוָה קְרֹא־שְׁמוּאֵל בַּשְּׁלִישִׁת וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־עֵלִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְנִי כִּי קָרָאתָ לִי וַיָּבֶן עֵלִי כִּי יְהֹוָה קֹרֵא לַנָּעַר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסֶף יְהֹוָה קְרֹא־שְׁמוּאֵל בַּשְּׁלִישִׁת וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־עֵלִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְנִי כִּי קָרָאתָ לִי וַיָּבֶן עֵלִי כִּי יְהֹוָה קֹרֵא לַנָּעַר׃

english.text:
YHWH called Samuel again, a third time, and he rose and went to
Eli and said, “Here I am; you called me.” Then Eli understood that
YHWH was calling the boy.

translation.text: And the LORD called Samuel again the third time. And he arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou didst call me. And Eli perceived that the LORD had called the child.

verses.english:
YHWH called Samuel again, a third time, and he rose and went to
Eli and said, “Here I am; you called me.” Then Eli understood that
YHWH was calling the boy.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר עֵלִי לִשְׁמוּאֵל לֵךְ שְׁכָב וְהָיָה אִם־יִקְרָא אֵלֶיךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ דַּבֵּר יְהֹוָה כִּי שֹׁמֵעַ עַבְדֶּךָ וַיֵּלֶךְ שְׁמוּאֵל וַיִּשְׁכַּב בִּמְקוֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר עֵלִי לִשְׁמוּאֵל לֵךְ שְׁכָב וְהָיָה אִם־יִקְרָא אֵלֶיךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ דַּבֵּר יְהֹוָה כִּי שֹׁמֵעַ עַבְדֶּךָ וַיֵּלֶךְ שְׁמוּאֵל וַיִּשְׁכַּב בִּמְקוֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
And Eli said to Samuel, “Go lie down. If you are called again,
say, ‘Speak, LORD, for Your servant is listening.’” And Samuel
went to his place and lay down.

translation.text: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel, Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, LORD; for thy servant heareth. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

verses.english:
And Eli said to Samuel, “Go lie down. If you are called again,
say, ‘Speak, LORD, for Your servant is listening.’” And Samuel
went to his place and lay down.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְיַצַּב וַיִּקְרָא כְפַעַם־בְּפַעַם שְׁמוּאֵל שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל דַּבֵּר כִּי שֹׁמֵעַ עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְיַצַּב וַיִּקְרָא כְפַעַם־בְּפַעַם שְׁמוּאֵל שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל דַּבֵּר כִּי שֹׁמֵעַ עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
YHWH came, and stood there, and He called as before: “Samuel!
Samuel!” And Samuel answered, “Speak, for Your servant is
listening.”

translation.text: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.

verses.english:
YHWH came, and stood there, and He called as before: “Samuel!
Samuel!” And Samuel answered, “Speak, for Your servant is
listening.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי עֹשֶׂה דָבָר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר כּל־שֹׁמְעוֹ תְּצִלֶּינָה שְׁתֵּי אזְנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי עֹשֶׂה דָבָר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר כּל־שֹׁמְעוֹ תְּצִלֶּינָה שְׁתֵּי אזְנָיו׃

english.text:
YHWH said to Samuel: “I am going to do in Israel such a thing that
both ears of anyone who hears about it will tingle.

translation.text: And the LORD said to Samuel, Behold, I will do a thing in Israel, at which both the ears of every one that heareth it shall tingle.

verses.english:
YHWH said to Samuel: “I am going to do in Israel such a thing that
both ears of anyone who hears about it will tingle.

verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אָקִים אֶל־עֵלִי אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ הָחֵל וְכַלֵּה׃

hebrew.text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אָקִים אֶל־עֵלִי אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ הָחֵל וְכַלֵּה׃

english.text:
In that day I will fulfill against Eli all that I spoke concerning
his house, from beginning to end.

translation.text: In that day I will perform against Eli all things which I have spoken concerning his house: when I begin, I will also make an end.

verses.english:
In that day I will fulfill against Eli all that I spoke concerning
his house, from beginning to end.

verses.hebrew: וְהִגַּדְתִּי לוֹ כִּי־שֹׁפֵט אֲנִי אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ עַד־עוֹלָם בַּעֲוֺן אֲשֶׁר־יָדַע כִּי־מְקַלְלִים לָהֶם בָּנָיו וְלֹא כִהָה בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִגַּדְתִּי לוֹ כִּי־שֹׁפֵט אֲנִי אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ עַד־עוֹלָם בַּעֲוֺן אֲשֶׁר־יָדַע כִּי־מְקַלְלִים לָהֶם בָּנָיו וְלֹא כִהָה בָּם׃

english.text:
And I declare to him that I sentence his house to endless
punishment for the iniquity he knew about—how his sons committed
sacrilege at will —and he did not rebuke them.

translation.text: For I have told him that I will judge his house for ever for the iniquity which he knoweth; because his sons made themselves vile, and he restrained them not.

verses.english:
And I declare to him that I sentence his house to endless
punishment for the iniquity he knew about—how his sons committed
sacrilege at will —and he did not rebuke them.

verses.hebrew: וְלָכֵן נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְבֵית עֵלִי אִם־יִתְכַּפֵּר עֲוֺן בֵּית־עֵלִי בְּזֶבַח וּבְמִנְחָה עַד־עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְלָכֵן נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְבֵית עֵלִי אִם־יִתְכַּפֵּר עֲוֺן בֵּית־עֵלִי בְּזֶבַח וּבְמִנְחָה עַד־עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
Assuredly, I swear concerning the house of Eli that the iniquity
of the house of Eli will never be expiated by sacrifice or
offering.”

translation.text: And therefore I have sworn unto the house of Eli, that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering for ever.

verses.english:
Assuredly, I swear concerning the house of Eli that the iniquity
of the house of Eli will never be expiated by sacrifice or
offering.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב שְׁמוּאֵל עַד־הַבֹּקֶר וַיִּפְתַּח אֶת־דַּלְתוֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וּשְׁמוּאֵל יָרֵא מֵהַגִּיד אֶת־הַמַּרְאָה אֶל־עֵלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב שְׁמוּאֵל עַד־הַבֹּקֶר וַיִּפְתַּח אֶת־דַּלְתוֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וּשְׁמוּאֵל יָרֵא מֵהַגִּיד אֶת־הַמַּרְאָה אֶל־עֵלִי׃

english.text:
Samuel lay there until morning; and then he opened the doors of
the House of YHWH. Samuel was afraid to report the vision to Eli,

translation.text: And Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the house of the LORD. And Samuel feared to shew Eli the vision.

verses.english:
Samuel lay there until morning; and then he opened the doors of
the House of YHWH. Samuel was afraid to report the vision to Eli,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא עֵלִי אֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל בְּנִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא עֵלִי אֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל בְּנִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי׃

english.text:
but Eli summoned Samuel and said, “Samuel, my son”; and he
answered, “Here.”

translation.text: Then Eli called Samuel, and said, Samuel, my son. And he answered, Here am I.

verses.english:
but Eli summoned Samuel and said, “Samuel, my son”; and he
answered, “Here.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֵלֶיךָ אַל־נָא תְכַחֵד מִמֶּנִּי כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִיף אִם־תְּכַחֵד מִמֶּנִּי דָּבָר מִכּל־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר
אֵלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֵלֶיךָ אַל־נָא תְכַחֵד מִמֶּנִּי כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִיף אִם־תְּכַחֵד מִמֶּנִּי דָּבָר מִכּל־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר
אֵלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And [Eli] asked, “What did He say to you? Keep nothing from me.
Thus and more may God do to you if you keep from me a single word
of all that He said to you!”

translation.text: And he said, What is the thing that the LORD hath said unto thee? I pray thee hide it not from me: God do so to thee, and more also, if thou hide any thing from me of all the things that he said unto thee.

verses.english:
And [Eli] asked, “What did He say to you? Keep nothing from me.
Thus and more may God do to you if you keep from me a single word
of all that He said to you!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־כּל־הַדְּבָרִים וְלֹא כִחֵד מִמֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה הוּא הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינָו יַעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־כּל־הַדְּבָרִים וְלֹא כִחֵד מִמֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה הוּא הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינָו יַעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
Samuel then told him everything, withholding nothing from him. And
[Eli] said, “He is YHWH; He will do what He deems right.”

translation.text: And Samuel told him every whit, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It is the LORD: let him do what seemeth him good.

verses.english:
Samuel then told him everything, withholding nothing from him. And
[Eli] said, “He is YHWH; He will do what He deems right.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְדַּל שְׁמוּאֵל וַיהֹוָה הָיָה עִמּוֹ וְלֹא־הִפִּיל מִכּל־דְּבָרָיו אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְדַּל שְׁמוּאֵל וַיהֹוָה הָיָה עִמּוֹ וְלֹא־הִפִּיל מִכּל־דְּבָרָיו אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
Samuel grew up and YHWH was with him: He did not leave any of
Samuel’s predictions unfulfilled.

translation.text: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the ground.

verses.english:
Samuel grew up and YHWH was with him: He did not leave any of
Samuel’s predictions unfulfilled.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּדַע כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שָׁבַע כִּי נֶאֱמָן שְׁמוּאֵל לְנָבִיא לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּדַע כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שָׁבַע כִּי נֶאֱמָן שְׁמוּאֵל לְנָבִיא לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
All Israel, from Dan to Beer-sheba, knew that Samuel was
trustworthy as a prophet of YHWH.

translation.text: And all Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the LORD.

verses.english:
All Israel, from Dan to Beer-sheba, knew that Samuel was
trustworthy as a prophet of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף יְהֹוָה לְהֵרָאֹה בְשִׁלֹה כִּי־נִגְלָה יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל בְּשִׁלוֹ בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסֶף יְהֹוָה לְהֵרָאֹה בְשִׁלֹה כִּי־נִגְלָה יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל בְּשִׁלוֹ בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And YHWH continued to appear at Shiloh: YHWH revealed Himself to
Samuel at Shiloh with the word of YHWH;

translation.text: And the LORD appeared again in Shiloh: for the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the LORD.

verses.english:
And YHWH continued to appear at Shiloh: YHWH revealed Himself to
Samuel at Shiloh with the word of YHWH;

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־שְׁמוּאֵל לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּצֵא יִשְׂרָאֵל לִקְרַאת פְּלִשְׁתִּים לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל־הָאֶבֶן הָעֵזֶר וּפְלִשְׁתִּים חָנוּ בַאֲפֵק׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דְבַר־שְׁמוּאֵל לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּצֵא יִשְׂרָאֵל לִקְרַאת פְּלִשְׁתִּים לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל־הָאֶבֶן הָעֵזֶר וּפְלִשְׁתִּים חָנוּ בַאֲפֵק׃

english.text:
and Samuel’s word went forth to all Israel. Israel marched out to
engage the Philistines in battle; they encamped near Eben-ezer,
while the Philistines encamped at Aphek.

translation.text: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and pitched beside Ebenezer: and the Philistines pitched in Aphek.

verses.english:
and Samuel’s word went forth to all Israel. Israel marched out to
engage the Philistines in battle; they encamped near Eben-ezer,
while the Philistines encamped at Aphek.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַרְכוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לִקְרַאת יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתִּטֹּשׁ הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּנָּגֶף יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּכּוּ בַמַּעֲרָכָה בַּשָּׂדֶה כְּאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַרְכוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לִקְרַאת יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתִּטֹּשׁ הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּנָּגֶף יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּכּוּ בַמַּעֲרָכָה בַּשָּׂדֶה כְּאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ׃

english.text:
The Philistines arrayed themselves against Israel; and when the
battle was fought, Israel was routed by the Philistines, who slew
about four thousand men on the field of battle.

translation.text: And the Philistines put themselves in array against Israel: and when they joined battle, Israel was smitten before the Philistines: and they slew of the army in the field about four thousand men.

verses.english:
The Philistines arrayed themselves against Israel; and when the
battle was fought, Israel was routed by the Philistines, who slew
about four thousand men on the field of battle.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא הָעָם אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיֹּאמְרוּ זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָמָּה נְגָפָנוּ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם לִפְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים נִקְחָה אֵלֵינוּ מִשִּׁלֹה אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה וְיָבֹא
בְקִרְבֵּנוּ וְיֹשִׁעֵנוּ מִכַּף אֹיְבֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא הָעָם אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיֹּאמְרוּ זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָמָּה נְגָפָנוּ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם לִפְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים נִקְחָה אֵלֵינוּ מִשִּׁלֹה אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה וְיָבֹא
בְקִרְבֵּנוּ וְיֹשִׁעֵנוּ מִכַּף אֹיְבֵינוּ׃

english.text:
When the [Israelite] troops returned to the camp, the elders of
Israel asked, “Why did YHWH put us to rout today before the
Philistines? Let us fetch the Ark of the Covenant of YHWH from
Shiloh; thus He will be present among us and will deliver us from
the hands of our enemies.”

translation.text: And when the people were come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, Wherefore hath the LORD smitten us to day before the Philistines? Let us fetch the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of Shiloh unto us, that, when it cometh among us, it may save us out of the hand of our enemies.

verses.english:
When the [Israelite] troops returned to the camp, the elders of
Israel asked, “Why did YHWH put us to rout today before the
Philistines? Let us fetch the Ark of the Covenant of YHWH from
Shiloh; thus He will be present among us and will deliver us from
the hands of our enemies.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הָעָם שִׁלֹה וַיִּשְׂאוּ מִשָּׁם אֵת אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרֻבִים וְשָׁם שְׁנֵי בְנֵי־עֵלִי עִם־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית הָאֱלֹהִים חפְנִי וּפִינְחָס׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הָעָם שִׁלֹה וַיִּשְׂאוּ מִשָּׁם אֵת אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרֻבִים וְשָׁם שְׁנֵי בְנֵי־עֵלִי עִם־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית הָאֱלֹהִים חפְנִי וּפִינְחָס׃

english.text:
So the troops sent men to Shiloh; there Eli’s two sons, Hophni and
Phinehas, were in charge of the Ark of the Covenant of God, and
they brought down from there the Ark of the Covenant of YHWH of
Hosts Enthroned on the Cherubim.

translation.text: So the people sent to Shiloh, that they might bring from thence the ark of the covenant of the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth between the cherubims: and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.

verses.english:
So the troops sent men to Shiloh; there Eli’s two sons, Hophni and
Phinehas, were in charge of the Ark of the Covenant of God, and
they brought down from there the Ark of the Covenant of YHWH of
Hosts Enthroned on the Cherubim.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּבוֹא אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּרִעוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וַתֵּהֹם הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּבוֹא אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּרִעוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וַתֵּהֹם הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
When the Ark of the Covenant of YHWH entered the camp, all Israel
burst into a great shout, so that the earth resounded.

translation.text: And when the ark of the covenant of the LORD came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth rang again.

verses.english:
When the Ark of the Covenant of YHWH entered the camp, all Israel
burst into a great shout, so that the earth resounded.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־קוֹל הַתְּרוּעָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֶה קוֹל הַתְּרוּעָה הַגְּדוֹלָה הַזֹּאת בְּמַחֲנֵה הָעִבְרִים וַיֵּדְעוּ כִּי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה בָּא אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־קוֹל הַתְּרוּעָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֶה קוֹל הַתְּרוּעָה הַגְּדוֹלָה הַזֹּאת בְּמַחֲנֵה הָעִבְרִים וַיֵּדְעוּ כִּי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה בָּא אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
The Philistines heard the noise of the shouting and they wondered,
“Why is there such a loud shouting in the camp of the Hebrews?”
And when they learned that the Ark of YHWH had come to the camp,

translation.text: And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, What meaneth the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews? And they understood that the ark of the LORD was come into the camp.

verses.english:
The Philistines heard the noise of the shouting and they wondered,
“Why is there such a loud shouting in the camp of the Hebrews?”
And when they learned that the Ark of YHWH had come to the camp,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי אָמְרוּ בָּא אֱלֹהִים אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אוֹי לָנוּ כִּי לֹא הָיְתָה כָּזֹאת אֶתְמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי אָמְרוּ בָּא אֱלֹהִים אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אוֹי לָנוּ כִּי לֹא הָיְתָה כָּזֹאת אֶתְמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם׃

english.text:
the Philistines were frightened; for they said, “God has come to
the camp.” And they cried, “Woe to us! Nothing like this has ever
happened before.

translation.text: And the Philistines were afraid, for they said, God is come into the camp. And they said, Woe unto us! for there hath not been such a thing heretofore.

verses.english:
the Philistines were frightened; for they said, “God has come to
the camp.” And they cried, “Woe to us! Nothing like this has ever
happened before.

verses.hebrew: אוֹי לָנוּ מִי יַצִּילֵנוּ מִיַּד הָאֱלֹהִים הָאַדִּירִים הָאֵלֶּה אֵלֶּה הֵם הָאֱלֹהִים הַמַּכִּים אֶת־מִצְרַיִם בְּכל־מַכָּה בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: אוֹי לָנוּ מִי יַצִּילֵנוּ מִיַּד הָאֱלֹהִים הָאַדִּירִים הָאֵלֶּה אֵלֶּה הֵם הָאֱלֹהִים הַמַּכִּים אֶת־מִצְרַיִם בְּכל־מַכָּה בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
Woe to us! Who will save us from the power of this mighty God? He
is the same God who struck the Egyptians with every kind of plague
in the wilderness!

translation.text: Woe unto us! who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods? these are the Gods that smote the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness.

verses.english:
Woe to us! Who will save us from the power of this mighty God? He
is the same God who struck the Egyptians with every kind of plague
in the wilderness!

verses.hebrew: הִתְחַזְּקוּ וִהְיוּ לַאֲנָשִׁים פְּלִשְׁתִּים פֶּן תַּעַבְדוּ לָעִבְרִים כַּאֲשֶׁר עָבְדוּ לָכֶם וִהְיִיתֶם לַאֲנָשִׁים וְנִלְחַמְתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: הִתְחַזְּקוּ וִהְיוּ לַאֲנָשִׁים פְּלִשְׁתִּים פֶּן תַּעַבְדוּ לָעִבְרִים כַּאֲשֶׁר עָבְדוּ לָכֶם וִהְיִיתֶם לַאֲנָשִׁים וְנִלְחַמְתֶּם׃

english.text:
Brace yourselves and be men, O Philistines! Or you will become
slaves to the Hebrews as they were slaves to you. Be men and
fight!”

translation.text: Be strong and quit yourselves like men, O ye Philistines, that ye be not servants unto the Hebrews, as they have been to you: quit yourselves like men, and fight.

verses.english:
Brace yourselves and be men, O Philistines! Or you will become
slaves to the Hebrews as they were slaves to you. Be men and
fight!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּנָּגֶף יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּנֻסוּ אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו וַתְּהִי הַמַּכָּה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד וַיִּפֹּל מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף רַגְלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּנָּגֶף יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּנֻסוּ אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו וַתְּהִי הַמַּכָּה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד וַיִּפֹּל מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף רַגְלִי׃

english.text:
The Philistines fought; Israel was routed, and they all fled to
their homes. The defeat was very great, thirty thousand foot
soldiers of Israel fell there.

translation.text: And the Philistines fought, and Israel was smitten, and they fled every man into his tent: and there was a very great slaughter; for there fell of Israel thirty thousand footmen.

verses.english:
The Philistines fought; Israel was routed, and they all fled to
their homes. The defeat was very great, thirty thousand foot
soldiers of Israel fell there.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲרוֹן אֱלֹהִים נִלְקָח וּשְׁנֵי בְנֵי־עֵלִי מֵתוּ חפְנִי וּפִינְחָס׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲרוֹן אֱלֹהִים נִלְקָח וּשְׁנֵי בְנֵי־עֵלִי מֵתוּ חפְנִי וּפִינְחָס׃

english.text:
The Ark of God was captured, and Eli’s two sons, Hophni and
Phinehas, were slain.

translation.text: And the ark of God was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.

verses.english:
The Ark of God was captured, and Eli’s two sons, Hophni and
Phinehas, were slain.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרץ אִישׁ־בִּנְיָמִן מֵהַמַּעֲרָכָה וַיָּבֹא שִׁלֹה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וּמַדָּיו קְרֻעִים וַאֲדָמָה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּרץ אִישׁ־בִּנְיָמִן מֵהַמַּעֲרָכָה וַיָּבֹא שִׁלֹה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וּמַדָּיו קְרֻעִים וַאֲדָמָה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
A Benjaminite ran from the battlefield and reached Shiloh the same
day; his clothes were rent and there was earth on his head.

translation.text: And there ran a man of Benjamin out of the army, and came to Shiloh the same day with his clothes rent, and with earth upon his head.

verses.english:
A Benjaminite ran from the battlefield and reached Shiloh the same
day; his clothes were rent and there was earth on his head.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבוֹא וְהִנֵּה עֵלִי יֹשֵׁב עַל־הַכִּסֵּא (יך) [יַד] דֶּרֶךְ מְצַפֶּה כִּי־הָיָה לִבּוֹ חָרֵד עַל אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וְהָאִישׁ בָּא לְהַגִּיד בָּעִיר וַתִּזְעַק כּל־הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבוֹא וְהִנֵּה עֵלִי יֹשֵׁב עַל־הַכִּסֵּא (יך) [יַד] דֶּרֶךְ מְצַפֶּה כִּי־הָיָה לִבּוֹ חָרֵד עַל אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וְהָאִישׁ בָּא לְהַגִּיד בָּעִיר וַתִּזְעַק כּל־הָעִיר׃

english.text:
When he arrived, he found Eli sitting on a seat, waiting beside
the road—his heart trembling for the Ark of God. The man entered
the city to spread the news, and the whole city broke out in a
cry.

translation.text: And when he came, lo, Eli sat upon a seat by the wayside watching: for his heart trembled for the ark of God. And when the man came into the city, and told it, all the city cried out.

verses.english:
When he arrived, he found Eli sitting on a seat, waiting beside
the road—his heart trembling for the Ark of God. The man entered
the city to spread the news, and the whole city broke out in a
cry.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע עֵלִי אֶת־קוֹל הַצְּעָקָה וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה קוֹל הֶהָמוֹן הַזֶּה וְהָאִישׁ מִהַר וַיָּבֹא וַיַּגֵּד לְעֵלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע עֵלִי אֶת־קוֹל הַצְּעָקָה וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה קוֹל הֶהָמוֹן הַזֶּה וְהָאִישׁ מִהַר וַיָּבֹא וַיַּגֵּד לְעֵלִי׃

english.text:
And when Eli heard the sound of the outcry and asked, “What is the
meaning of this uproar?” the man rushed over to tell Eli.

translation.text: And when Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, What meaneth the noise of this tumult? And the man came in hastily, and told Eli.

verses.english:
And when Eli heard the sound of the outcry and asked, “What is the
meaning of this uproar?” the man rushed over to tell Eli.

verses.hebrew: וְעֵלִי בֶּן־תִּשְׁעִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה וְעֵינָיו קָמָה וְלֹא יָכוֹל לִרְאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְעֵלִי בֶּן־תִּשְׁעִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה וְעֵינָיו קָמָה וְלֹא יָכוֹל לִרְאוֹת׃

english.text:
Now Eli was ninety-eight years old; his eyes were fixed in a blind
stare.

translation.text: Now Eli was ninety and eight years old; and his eyes were dim, that he could not see.

verses.english:
Now Eli was ninety-eight years old; his eyes were fixed in a blind
stare.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ אֶל־עֵלִי אָנֹכִי הַבָּא מִן־הַמַּעֲרָכָה וַאֲנִי מִן־הַמַּעֲרָכָה נַסְתִּי הַיּוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה־הָיָה הַדָּבָר בְּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ אֶל־עֵלִי אָנֹכִי הַבָּא מִן־הַמַּעֲרָכָה וַאֲנִי מִן־הַמַּעֲרָכָה נַסְתִּי הַיּוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה־הָיָה הַדָּבָר בְּנִי׃

translation.text: And the man said unto Eli, I am he that came out of the army, and I fled to day out of the army. And he said, What is there done, my son?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַמְבַשֵּׂר וַיֹּאמֶר נָס יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וְגַם מַגֵּפָה גְדוֹלָה הָיְתָה בָעָם וְגַם־שְׁנֵי בָנֶיךָ מֵתוּ חפְנִי וּפִינְחָס וַאֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים נִלְקָחָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן הַמְבַשֵּׂר וַיֹּאמֶר נָס יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וְגַם מַגֵּפָה גְדוֹלָה הָיְתָה בָעָם וְגַם־שְׁנֵי בָנֶיךָ מֵתוּ חפְנִי וּפִינְחָס וַאֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים נִלְקָחָה׃

english.text:
The bearer of the news replied, “Israel fled before the
Philistines and the troops also suffered a great slaughter. Your
two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the Ark of God has
been captured.”

translation.text: And the messenger answered and said, Israel is fled before the Philistines, and there hath been also a great slaughter among the people, and thy two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God is taken.

verses.english:
The bearer of the news replied, “Israel fled before the
Philistines and the troops also suffered a great slaughter. Your
two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the Ark of God has
been captured.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כְּהַזְכִּירוֹ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּפֹּל מֵעַל־הַכִּסֵּא אֲחֹרַנִּית בְּעַד יַד הַשַּׁעַר וַתִּשָּׁבֵר מַפְרַקְתּוֹ וַיָּמֹת כִּי־זָקֵן הָאִישׁ וְכָבֵד וְהוּא שָׁפַט
אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כְּהַזְכִּירוֹ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּפֹּל מֵעַל־הַכִּסֵּא אֲחֹרַנִּית בְּעַד יַד הַשַּׁעַר וַתִּשָּׁבֵר מַפְרַקְתּוֹ וַיָּמֹת כִּי־זָקֵן הָאִישׁ וְכָבֵד וְהוּא שָׁפַט
אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
When he mentioned the Ark of God, [Eli] fell backward off the seat
beside the gate, broke his neck and died; for he was an old man
and heavy. He had been a chieftain of Israel for forty years.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when he made mention of the ark of God, that he fell from off the seat backward by the side of the gate, and his neck brake, and he died: for he was an old man, and heavy. And he had judged Israel forty years.

verses.english:
When he mentioned the Ark of God, [Eli] fell backward off the seat
beside the gate, broke his neck and died; for he was an old man
and heavy. He had been a chieftain of Israel for forty years.

verses.hebrew: וְכַלָּתוֹ אֵשֶׁת־פִּינְחָס הָרָה לָלַת וַתִּשְׁמַע אֶת־הַשְּׁמוּעָה אֶל־הִלָּקַח אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וּמֵת חָמִיהָ וְאִישָׁהּ וַתִּכְרַע וַתֵּלֶד כִּי־נֶהֶפְכוּ עָלֶיהָ צִרֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְכַלָּתוֹ אֵשֶׁת־פִּינְחָס הָרָה לָלַת וַתִּשְׁמַע אֶת־הַשְּׁמוּעָה אֶל־הִלָּקַח אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וּמֵת חָמִיהָ וְאִישָׁהּ וַתִּכְרַע וַתֵּלֶד כִּי־נֶהֶפְכוּ עָלֶיהָ צִרֶיהָ׃
