translation.text: And Saul answered and said, Am not I a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? and my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? wherefore then speakest thou so to me?

verses.english:
Saul replied, “But I am only a Benjaminite, from the smallest of
the tribes of Israel, and my clan is the least of all the clans of
the tribe of Benjamin! Why do you say such things to me?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־נַעֲרוֹ וַיְבִיאֵם לִשְׁכָּתָה וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם מָקוֹם בְּרֹאשׁ הַקְּרוּאִים וְהֵמָּה כִּשְׁלֹשִׁם אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־נַעֲרוֹ וַיְבִיאֵם לִשְׁכָּתָה וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם מָקוֹם בְּרֹאשׁ הַקְּרוּאִים וְהֵמָּה כִּשְׁלֹשִׁם אִישׁ׃

english.text:
Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the hall,
and gave them a place at the head of the guests, who numbered
about thirty.

translation.text: And Samuel took Saul and his servant, and brought them into the parlour, and made them sit in the chiefest place among them that were bidden, which were about thirty persons.

verses.english:
Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the hall,
and gave them a place at the head of the guests, who numbered
about thirty.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל לַטַּבָּח תְּנָה אֶת־הַמָּנָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָךְ אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ שִׂים אֹתָהּ עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל לַטַּבָּח תְּנָה אֶת־הַמָּנָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָךְ אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ שִׂים אֹתָהּ עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
And Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion which I gave you
and told you to set aside.”

translation.text: And Samuel said unto the cook, Bring the portion which I gave thee, of which I said unto thee, Set it by thee.

verses.english:
And Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion which I gave you
and told you to set aside.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּרֶם הַטַּבָּח אֶת־הַשּׁוֹק וְהֶעָלֶיהָ וַיָּשֶׂם לִפְנֵי שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה הַנִּשְׁאָר שִׂים־לְפָנֶיךָ אֱכֹל כִּי לַמּוֹעֵד שָׁמוּר־לְךָ לֵאמֹר הָעָם קָרָאתִי וַיֹּאכַל
שָׁאוּל עִם־שְׁמוּאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּרֶם הַטַּבָּח אֶת־הַשּׁוֹק וְהֶעָלֶיהָ וַיָּשֶׂם לִפְנֵי שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה הַנִּשְׁאָר שִׂים־לְפָנֶיךָ אֱכֹל כִּי לַמּוֹעֵד שָׁמוּר־לְךָ לֵאמֹר הָעָם קָרָאתִי וַיֹּאכַל
שָׁאוּל עִם־שְׁמוּאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

english.text:
The cook lifted up the thigh and what was on it, and set it before
Saul. And [Samuel] said, “What has been reserved is set before
you. Eat; it has been kept for you for this occasion, when I said
I was inviting the people.” So Saul ate with Samuel that day.

translation.text: And the cook took up the shoulder, and that which was upon it, and set it before Saul. And Samuel said, Behold that which is left! set it before thee, and eat: for unto this time hath it been kept for thee since I said, I have invited the people. So Saul did eat with Samuel that day.

verses.english:
The cook lifted up the thigh and what was on it, and set it before
Saul. And [Samuel] said, “What has been reserved is set before
you. Eat; it has been kept for you for this occasion, when I said
I was inviting the people.” So Saul ate with Samuel that day.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרְדוּ מֵהַבָּמָה הָעִיר וַיְדַבֵּר עִם־שָׁאוּל עַל־הַגָּג׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרְדוּ מֵהַבָּמָה הָעִיר וַיְדַבֵּר עִם־שָׁאוּל עַל־הַגָּג׃

english.text:
They then descended from the shrine to the town, and [Samuel]
talked with Saul on the roof.

translation.text: And when they were come down from the high place into the city, Samuel communed with Saul upon the top of the house.

verses.english:
They then descended from the shrine to the town, and [Samuel]
talked with Saul on the roof.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ וַיְהִי כַּעֲלוֹת הַשַּׁחַר וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל (הגג) [הַגָּגָה] לֵאמֹר קוּמָה וַאֲשַׁלְּחֶךָּ וַיָּקם שָׁאוּל וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם הוּא וּשְׁמוּאֵל
הַחוּצָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ וַיְהִי כַּעֲלוֹת הַשַּׁחַר וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל (הגג) [הַגָּגָה] לֵאמֹר קוּמָה וַאֲשַׁלְּחֶךָּ וַיָּקם שָׁאוּל וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם הוּא וּשְׁמוּאֵל
הַחוּצָה׃

english.text:
Early, at the break of day, Samuel called to Saul on the roof. He
said, “Get up, and I will send you off.” Saul arose, and the two
of them, Samuel and he, went outside.

translation.text: And they arose early: and it came to pass about the spring of the day, that Samuel called Saul to the top of the house, saying, Up, that I may send thee away. And Saul arose, and they went out both of them, he and Samuel, abroad.

verses.english:
Early, at the break of day, Samuel called to Saul on the roof. He
said, “Get up, and I will send you off.” Saul arose, and the two
of them, Samuel and he, went outside.

verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה יוֹרְדִים בִּקְצֵה הָעִיר וּשְׁמוּאֵל אָמַר אֶל־שָׁאוּל אֱמֹר לַנַּעַר וְיַעֲבֹר לְפָנֵינוּ וַיַּעֲבֹר וְאַתָּה עֲמֹד כַּיּוֹם וְאַשְׁמִיעֲךָ אֶת־דְּבַר אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: הֵמָּה יוֹרְדִים בִּקְצֵה הָעִיר וּשְׁמוּאֵל אָמַר אֶל־שָׁאוּל אֱמֹר לַנַּעַר וְיַעֲבֹר לְפָנֵינוּ וַיַּעֲבֹר וְאַתָּה עֲמֹד כַּיּוֹם וְאַשְׁמִיעֲךָ אֶת־דְּבַר אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
As they were walking toward the end of the town, Samuel said to
Saul, “Tell the servant to walk ahead of us”—and he walked
ahead—“but you stop here a moment and I will make known to you the
word of God.”

translation.text: And as they were going down to the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, Bid the servant pass on before us, (and he passed on), but stand thou still a while, that I may shew thee the word of God.

verses.english:
As they were walking toward the end of the town, Samuel said to
Saul, “Tell the servant to walk ahead of us”—and he walked
ahead—“but you stop here a moment and I will make known to you the
word of God.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־פַּךְ הַשֶּׁמֶן וַיִּצֹק עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּשָּׁקֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא כִּי־מְשָׁחֲךָ יְהֹוָה עַל־נַחֲלָתוֹ לְנָגִיד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־פַּךְ הַשֶּׁמֶן וַיִּצֹק עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּשָּׁקֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא כִּי־מְשָׁחֲךָ יְהֹוָה עַל־נַחֲלָתוֹ לְנָגִיד׃

english.text:
Samuel took a flask of oil and poured some on Saul’s head and
kissed him, and said, “YHWH herewith anoints you ruler over His
own people.

translation.text: Then Samuel took a vial of oil, and poured it upon his head, and kissed him, and said, Is it not because the LORD hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance?

verses.english:
Samuel took a flask of oil and poured some on Saul’s head and
kissed him, and said, “YHWH herewith anoints you ruler over His
own people.

verses.hebrew:
בְּלֶכְתְּךָ הַיּוֹם מֵעִמָּדִי וּמָצָאתָ שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים עִם־קְבֻרַת רָחֵל בִּגְבוּל בִּנְיָמִן בְּצֶלְצַח וְאָמְרוּ אֵלֶיךָ נִמְצְאוּ הָאֲתֹנוֹת אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְתָּ לְבַקֵּשׁ
וְהִנֵּה נָטַשׁ אָבִיךָ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הָאֲתֹנוֹת וְדָאַג לָכֶם לֵאמֹר מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לִבְנִי׃

hebrew.text:
בְּלֶכְתְּךָ הַיּוֹם מֵעִמָּדִי וּמָצָאתָ שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים עִם־קְבֻרַת רָחֵל בִּגְבוּל בִּנְיָמִן בְּצֶלְצַח וְאָמְרוּ אֵלֶיךָ נִמְצְאוּ הָאֲתֹנוֹת אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְתָּ לְבַקֵּשׁ
וְהִנֵּה נָטַשׁ אָבִיךָ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הָאֲתֹנוֹת וְדָאַג לָכֶם לֵאמֹר מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לִבְנִי׃

english.text:
When you leave me today, you will meet two men near the tomb of
Rachel in the territory of Benjamin, at Zelzah, and they will tell
you that the asses you set out to look for have been found, and
that your father has stopped being concerned about the asses and
is worrying about you, saying: ‘What shall I do about my son?’

translation.text: When thou art departed from me to day, then thou shalt find two men by Rachel’s sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah; and they will say unto thee, The asses which thou wentest to seek are found: and, lo, thy father hath left the care of the asses, and sorroweth for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?

verses.english:
When you leave me today, you will meet two men near the tomb of
Rachel in the territory of Benjamin, at Zelzah, and they will tell
you that the asses you set out to look for have been found, and
that your father has stopped being concerned about the asses and
is worrying about you, saying: ‘What shall I do about my son?’

verses.hebrew:
וְחָלַפְתָּ מִשָּׁם וָהָלְאָה וּבָאתָ עַד־אֵלוֹן תָּבוֹר וּמְצָאוּךָ שָּׁם שְׁלֹשָׁה אֲנָשִׁים עֹלִים אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים בֵּית־אֵל אֶחָד נֹשֵׂא שְׁלֹשָׁה גְדָיִים וְאֶחָד נֹשֵׂא
שְׁלֹשֶׁת כִּכְּרוֹת לֶחֶם וְאֶחָד נֹשֵׂא נֵבֶל־יָיִן׃

hebrew.text:
וְחָלַפְתָּ מִשָּׁם וָהָלְאָה וּבָאתָ עַד־אֵלוֹן תָּבוֹר וּמְצָאוּךָ שָּׁם שְׁלֹשָׁה אֲנָשִׁים עֹלִים אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים בֵּית־אֵל אֶחָד נֹשֵׂא שְׁלֹשָׁה גְדָיִים וְאֶחָד נֹשֵׂא
שְׁלֹשֶׁת כִּכְּרוֹת לֶחֶם וְאֶחָד נֹשֵׂא נֵבֶל־יָיִן׃

english.text:
You shall pass on from there until you come to the terebinth of
Tabor. There you will be met by three men making a pilgrimage to
God at Bethel. One will be carrying three kids, another will be
carrying three loaves of bread, and the third will be carrying a
jar of wine.

translation.text: Then shalt thou go on forward from thence, and thou shalt come to the plain of Tabor, and there shall meet thee three men going up to God to Bethel, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a bottle of wine:

verses.english:
You shall pass on from there until you come to the terebinth of
Tabor. There you will be met by three men making a pilgrimage to
God at Bethel. One will be carrying three kids, another will be
carrying three loaves of bread, and the third will be carrying a
jar of wine.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁאֲלוּ לְךָ לְשָׁלוֹם וְנָתְנוּ לְךָ שְׁתֵּי־לֶחֶם וְלָקַחְתָּ מִיָּדָם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁאֲלוּ לְךָ לְשָׁלוֹם וְנָתְנוּ לְךָ שְׁתֵּי־לֶחֶם וְלָקַחְתָּ מִיָּדָם׃

english.text:
They will greet you and offer you two loaves of bread, which you
shall accept.

translation.text: And they will salute thee, and give thee two loaves of bread; which thou shalt receive of their hands.

verses.english:
They will greet you and offer you two loaves of bread, which you
shall accept.

verses.hebrew:
אַחַר כֵּן תָּבוֹא גִּבְעַת הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם נְצִבֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וִיהִי כְבֹאֲךָ שָׁם הָעִיר וּפָגַעְתָּ חֶבֶל נְבִאִים יֹרְדִים מֵהַבָּמָה וְלִפְנֵיהֶם נֵבֶל וְתֹף וְחָלִיל
וְכִנּוֹר וְהֵמָּה מִתְנַבְּאִים׃

hebrew.text:
אַחַר כֵּן תָּבוֹא גִּבְעַת הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם נְצִבֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וִיהִי כְבֹאֲךָ שָׁם הָעִיר וּפָגַעְתָּ חֶבֶל נְבִאִים יֹרְדִים מֵהַבָּמָה וְלִפְנֵיהֶם נֵבֶל וְתֹף וְחָלִיל
וְכִנּוֹר וְהֵמָּה מִתְנַבְּאִים׃

english.text:
After that, you are to go on to the Hill of God, where the
Philistine prefects reside. There, as you enter the town, you will
encounter a band of prophets coming down from the shrine, preceded
by lyres, timbrels, flutes, and harps, and they will be speaking
in ecstasy.

translation.text: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God, where is the garrison of the Philistines: and it shall come to pass, when thou art come thither to the city, that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery, and a tabret, and a pipe, and a harp, before them; and they shall prophesy:

verses.english:
After that, you are to go on to the Hill of God, where the
Philistine prefects reside. There, as you enter the town, you will
encounter a band of prophets coming down from the shrine, preceded
by lyres, timbrels, flutes, and harps, and they will be speaking
in ecstasy.

verses.hebrew: וְצָלְחָה עָלֶיךָ רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וְהִתְנַבִּיתָ עִמָּם וְנֶהְפַּכְתָּ לְאִישׁ אַחֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְצָלְחָה עָלֶיךָ רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וְהִתְנַבִּיתָ עִמָּם וְנֶהְפַּכְתָּ לְאִישׁ אַחֵר׃

english.text:
The spirit of YHWH will grip you, and you will speak in ecstasy
along with them; you will become another man.

translation.text: And the Spirit of the LORD will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.

verses.english:
The spirit of YHWH will grip you, and you will speak in ecstasy
along with them; you will become another man.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי (תבאינה) [תָבֹאנָה] הָאֹתוֹת הָאֵלֶּה לָךְ עֲשֵׂה לְךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא יָדֶךָ כִּי הָאֱלֹהִים עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי (תבאינה) [תָבֹאנָה] הָאֹתוֹת הָאֵלֶּה לָךְ עֲשֵׂה לְךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא יָדֶךָ כִּי הָאֱלֹהִים עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
And once these signs have happened to you, act when the occasion
arises, for God is with you.

translation.text: And let it be, when these signs are come unto thee, that thou do as occasion serve thee; for God is with thee.

verses.english:
And once these signs have happened to you, act when the occasion
arises, for God is with you.

verses.hebrew:
וְיָרַדְתָּ לְפָנַי הַגִּלְגָּל וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי יֹרֵד אֵלֶיךָ לְהַעֲלוֹת עֹלוֹת לִזְבֹּחַ זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תּוֹחֵל עַד־בּוֹאִי אֵלֶיךָ וְהוֹדַעְתִּי לְךָ אֵת
אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text:
וְיָרַדְתָּ לְפָנַי הַגִּלְגָּל וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי יֹרֵד אֵלֶיךָ לְהַעֲלוֹת עֹלוֹת לִזְבֹּחַ זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תּוֹחֵל עַד־בּוֹאִי אֵלֶיךָ וְהוֹדַעְתִּי לְךָ אֵת
אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
After that, you are to go down to Gilgal ahead of me, and I will
come down to you to present burnt offerings and offer sacrifices
of well-being. Wait seven days until I come to you and instruct
you what you are to do next.”

translation.text: And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal; and, behold, I will come down unto thee, to offer burnt offerings, and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings: seven days shalt thou tarry, till I come to thee, and shew thee what thou shalt do.

verses.english:
After that, you are to go down to Gilgal ahead of me, and I will
come down to you to present burnt offerings and offer sacrifices
of well-being. Wait seven days until I come to you and instruct
you what you are to do next.”

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כְּהַפְנֹתוֹ שִׁכְמוֹ לָלֶכֶת מֵעִם שְׁמוּאֵל וַיַּהֲפךְ־לוֹ אֱלֹהִים לֵב אַחֵר וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל־הָאֹתוֹת הָאֵלֶּה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כְּהַפְנֹתוֹ שִׁכְמוֹ לָלֶכֶת מֵעִם שְׁמוּאֵל וַיַּהֲפךְ־לוֹ אֱלֹהִים לֵב אַחֵר וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל־הָאֹתוֹת הָאֵלֶּה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

english.text:
As [Saul] turned around to leave Samuel, God gave him another
heart; and all those signs were fulfilled that same day.

translation.text: And it was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart: and all those signs came to pass that day.

verses.english:
As [Saul] turned around to leave Samuel, God gave him another
heart; and all those signs were fulfilled that same day.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ שָׁם הַגִּבְעָתָה וְהִנֵּה חֶבֶל־נְבִאִים לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים וַיִּתְנַבֵּא בְּתוֹכָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ שָׁם הַגִּבְעָתָה וְהִנֵּה חֶבֶל־נְבִאִים לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים וַיִּתְנַבֵּא בְּתוֹכָם׃

english.text:
And when they came there, to the Hill, he saw a band of prophets
coming toward him. Thereupon the spirit of God gripped him, and he
spoke in ecstasy among them.

translation.text: And when they came thither to the hill, behold, a company of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came upon him, and he prophesied among them.

verses.english:
And when they came there, to the Hill, he saw a band of prophets
coming toward him. Thereupon the spirit of God gripped him, and he
spoke in ecstasy among them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כּל־יוֹדְעוֹ מֵאִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה עִם־נְבִאִים נִבָּאוַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ מַה־זֶּה הָיָה לְבֶן־קִישׁ הֲגַם שָׁאוּל בַּנְּבִיאִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כּל־יוֹדְעוֹ מֵאִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה עִם־נְבִאִים נִבָּאוַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ מַה־זֶּה הָיָה לְבֶן־קִישׁ הֲגַם שָׁאוּל בַּנְּבִיאִים׃

english.text:
When all who knew him previously saw him speaking in ecstasy
together with the prophets, the people said to one another,
“What’s happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul too among the
prophets?”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when all that knew him beforetime saw that, behold, he prophesied among the prophets, then the people said one to another, What is this that is come unto the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?

verses.english:
When all who knew him previously saw him speaking in ecstasy
together with the prophets, the people said to one another,
“What’s happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul too among the
prophets?”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִישׁ מִשָּׁם וַיֹּאמֶר וּמִי אֲבִיהֶם עַל־כֵּן הָיְתָה לְמָשָׁל הֲגַם שָׁאוּל בַּנְּבִאִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן אִישׁ מִשָּׁם וַיֹּאמֶר וּמִי אֲבִיהֶם עַל־כֵּן הָיְתָה לְמָשָׁל הֲגַם שָׁאוּל בַּנְּבִאִים׃

english.text:
But another person there spoke up and said, “And who are their
fathers?” Thus the proverb arose: “Is Saul too among the
prophets?”

translation.text: And one of the same place answered and said, But who is their father? Therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among the prophets?

verses.english:
But another person there spoke up and said, “And who are their
fathers?” Thus the proverb arose: “Is Saul too among the
prophets?”

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַל מֵהִתְנַבּוֹת וַיָּבֹא הַבָּמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְכַל מֵהִתְנַבּוֹת וַיָּבֹא הַבָּמָה׃

english.text: And when he stopped speaking in ecstasy, he entered the shrine.

translation.text: And when he had made an end of prophesying, he came to the high place.

verses.english: And when he stopped speaking in ecstasy, he entered the shrine.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דּוֹד שָׁאוּל אֵלָיו וְאֶל־נַעֲרוֹ אָן הֲלַכְתֶּם וַיֹּאמֶר לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־הָאֲתֹנוֹת וַנִּרְאֶה כִי־אַיִן וַנָּבוֹא אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דּוֹד שָׁאוּל אֵלָיו וְאֶל־נַעֲרוֹ אָן הֲלַכְתֶּם וַיֹּאמֶר לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־הָאֲתֹנוֹת וַנִּרְאֶה כִי־אַיִן וַנָּבוֹא אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל׃

english.text:
Saul’s uncle asked him and his servant, “Where did you go?” “To
look for the asses,” he replied. “And when we saw that they were
not to be found, we went to Samuel.”

translation.text: And Saul’s uncle said unto him and to his servant, Whither went ye? And he said, To seek the asses: and when we saw that they were no where, we came to Samuel.

verses.english:
Saul’s uncle asked him and his servant, “Where did you go?” “To
look for the asses,” he replied. “And when we saw that they were
not to be found, we went to Samuel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דּוֹד שָׁאוּל הַגִּידָה־נָּא לִי מָה־אָמַר לָכֶם שְׁמוּאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דּוֹד שָׁאוּל הַגִּידָה־נָּא לִי מָה־אָמַר לָכֶם שְׁמוּאֵל׃

english.text: “Tell me,” said Saul’s uncle, “what did Samuel say to you?”

translation.text: And Saul’s uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said unto you.

verses.english: “Tell me,” said Saul’s uncle, “what did Samuel say to you?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דּוֹדוֹ הַגֵּד הִגִּיד לָנוּ כִּי נִמְצְאוּ הָאֲתֹנוֹת וְאֶת־דְּבַר הַמְּלוּכָה לֹא־הִגִּיד לוֹ אֲשֶׁר אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דּוֹדוֹ הַגֵּד הִגִּיד לָנוּ כִּי נִמְצְאוּ הָאֲתֹנוֹת וְאֶת־דְּבַר הַמְּלוּכָה לֹא־הִגִּיד לוֹ אֲשֶׁר אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל׃

english.text:
Saul answered his uncle, “He just told us that the asses had been
found.” But he did not tell him anything of what Samuel had said
about the kingship.

translation.text: And Saul said unto his uncle, He told us plainly that the asses were found. But of the matter of the kingdom, whereof Samuel spake, he told him not.

verses.english:
Saul answered his uncle, “He just told us that the asses had been
found.” But he did not tell him anything of what Samuel had said
about the kingship.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּצְעֵק שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־הָעָם אֶל־יְהֹוָה הַמִּצְפָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּצְעֵק שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־הָעָם אֶל־יְהֹוָה הַמִּצְפָּה׃

english.text: Samuel summoned the people to YHWH at Mizpah

translation.text: And Samuel called the people together unto the LORD to Mizpeh;

verses.english: Samuel summoned the people to YHWH at Mizpah

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵלכֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָנֹכִי הֶעֱלֵיתִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם וָאַצִּיל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם וּמִיַּד כּל־הַמַּמְלָכוֹת
הַלֹּחֲצִים אֶתְכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵלכֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָנֹכִי הֶעֱלֵיתִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם וָאַצִּיל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם וּמִיַּד כּל־הַמַּמְלָכוֹת
הַלֹּחֲצִים אֶתְכֶם׃

english.text:
and said to them, “Thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: ‘I brought
Israel out of Egypt, and I delivered you from the hands of the
Egyptians and of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’

translation.text: And said unto the children of Israel, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought up Israel out of Egypt, and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all kingdoms, and of them that oppressed you:

verses.english:
and said to them, “Thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: ‘I brought
Israel out of Egypt, and I delivered you from the hands of the
Egyptians and of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’

verses.hebrew:
וְאַתֶּם הַיּוֹם מְאַסְתֶּם אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר־הוּא מוֹשִׁיעַ לָכֶם מִכּל־רָעוֹתֵיכֶם וְצָרֹתֵיכֶם וַתֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ כִּי־מֶלֶךְ תָּשִׂים עָלֵינוּ וְעַתָּה הִתְיַצְּבוּ לִפְנֵי
יְהֹוָה לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם וּלְאַלְפֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וְאַתֶּם הַיּוֹם מְאַסְתֶּם אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר־הוּא מוֹשִׁיעַ לָכֶם מִכּל־רָעוֹתֵיכֶם וְצָרֹתֵיכֶם וַתֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ כִּי־מֶלֶךְ תָּשִׂים עָלֵינוּ וְעַתָּה הִתְיַצְּבוּ לִפְנֵי
יְהֹוָה לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם וּלְאַלְפֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
But today you have rejected your God who delivered you from all
your troubles and calamities. For you said, ‘No, set up a king
over us!’ Now station yourselves before YHWH, by your tribes and
clans.”

translation.text: And ye have this day rejected your God, who himself saved you out of all your adversities and your tribulations; and ye have said unto him, Nay, but set a king over us. Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes, and by your thousands.

verses.english:
But today you have rejected your God who delivered you from all
your troubles and calamities. For you said, ‘No, set up a king
over us!’ Now station yourselves before YHWH, by your tribes and
clans.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב שְׁמוּאֵל אֵת כּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּלָּכֵד שֵׁבֶט בִּנְיָמִן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב שְׁמוּאֵל אֵת כּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּלָּכֵד שֵׁבֶט בִּנְיָמִן׃

english.text:
Samuel brought forward each of the tribes of Israel, and the lot
indicated the tribe of Benjamin.

translation.text: And when Samuel had caused all the tribes of Israel to come near, the tribe of Benjamin was taken.

verses.english:
Samuel brought forward each of the tribes of Israel, and the lot
indicated the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־שֵׁבֶט בִּנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָו וַתִּלָּכֵד מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּטְרִי וַיִּלָּכֵד שָׁאוּל בֶּן־קִישׁ וַיְבַקְשֻׁהוּ וְלֹא נִמְצָא׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־שֵׁבֶט בִּנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָו וַתִּלָּכֵד מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּטְרִי וַיִּלָּכֵד שָׁאוּל בֶּן־קִישׁ וַיְבַקְשֻׁהוּ וְלֹא נִמְצָא׃

english.text:
Then Samuel brought forward the tribe of Benjamin by its clans,
and the clan of the Matrites was indicated; and then Saul son of
Kish was indicated. But when they looked for him, he was not to be
found.

translation.text: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families, the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken: and when they sought him, he could not be found.

verses.english:
Then Samuel brought forward the tribe of Benjamin by its clans,
and the clan of the Matrites was indicated; and then Saul son of
Kish was indicated. But when they looked for him, he was not to be
found.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ־עוֹד בַּיהֹוָה הֲבָא עוֹד הֲלֹם אִישׁוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה הִנֵּה־הוּא נֶחְבָּא אֶל־הַכֵּלִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ־עוֹד בַּיהֹוָה הֲבָא עוֹד הֲלֹם אִישׁוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה הִנֵּה־הוּא נֶחְבָּא אֶל־הַכֵּלִים׃

english.text:
They inquired of YHWH again, “Has anyone else come here?” And YHWH
replied, “Yes; he is hiding among the baggage.”

translation.text: Therefore they enquired of the LORD further, if the man should yet come thither. And the LORD answered, Behold he hath hid himself among the stuff.

verses.english:
They inquired of YHWH again, “Has anyone else come here?” And YHWH
replied, “Yes; he is hiding among the baggage.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרֻצוּ וַיִּקָּחֻהוּ מִשָּׁם וַיִּתְיַצֵּב בְּתוֹךְ הָעָם וַיִּגְבַּהּ מִכּל־הָעָם מִשִּׁכְמוֹ וָמָעְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּרֻצוּ וַיִּקָּחֻהוּ מִשָּׁם וַיִּתְיַצֵּב בְּתוֹךְ הָעָם וַיִּגְבַּהּ מִכּל־הָעָם מִשִּׁכְמוֹ וָמָעְלָה׃

english.text:
So they ran over and brought him from there; and when he took his
place among the people, he stood a head taller than all the
people.

translation.text: And they ran and fetched him thence: and when he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.

verses.english:
So they ran over and brought him from there; and when he took his
place among the people, he stood a head taller than all the
people.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־כּל־הָעָם הַרְּאִיתֶם אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר־בּוֹ יְהֹוָה כִּי אֵין כָּמֹהוּ בְּכל־הָעָם וַיָּרִעוּ כל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־כּל־הָעָם הַרְּאִיתֶם אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר־בּוֹ יְהֹוָה כִּי אֵין כָּמֹהוּ בְּכל־הָעָם וַיָּרִעוּ כל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
And Samuel said to the people, “Do you see the one whom YHWH has
chosen? There is none like him among all the people.” And all the
people acclaimed him, shouting, “Long live the king!”

translation.text: And Samuel said to all the people, See ye him whom the LORD hath chosen, that there is none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, God save the king.

verses.english:
And Samuel said to the people, “Do you see the one whom YHWH has
chosen? There is none like him among all the people.” And all the
people acclaimed him, shouting, “Long live the king!”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־הָעָם אֵת מִשְׁפַּט הַמְּלֻכָה וַיִּכְתֹּב בַּסֵּפֶר וַיַּנַּח לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְשַׁלַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־כּל־הָעָם אִישׁ לְבֵיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־הָעָם אֵת מִשְׁפַּט הַמְּלֻכָה וַיִּכְתֹּב בַּסֵּפֶר וַיַּנַּח לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְשַׁלַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־כּל־הָעָם אִישׁ לְבֵיתוֹ׃

english.text:
Samuel expounded to the people the rules of the monarchy, and
recorded them in a document which he deposited before YHWH. Samuel
then sent the people back to their homes.

translation.text: Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book, and laid it up before the LORD. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.

verses.english:
Samuel expounded to the people the rules of the monarchy, and
recorded them in a document which he deposited before YHWH. Samuel
then sent the people back to their homes.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם־שָׁאוּל הָלַךְ לְבֵיתוֹ גִּבְעָתָה וַיֵּלְכוּ עִמּוֹ הַחַיִל אֲשֶׁר־נָגַע אֱלֹהִים בְּלִבָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם־שָׁאוּל הָלַךְ לְבֵיתוֹ גִּבְעָתָה וַיֵּלְכוּ עִמּוֹ הַחַיִל אֲשֶׁר־נָגַע אֱלֹהִים בְּלִבָּם׃

english.text:
Saul also went home to Gibeah, accompanied by upstanding men whose
hearts God had touched.

translation.text: And Saul also went home to Gibeah; and there went with him a band of men, whose hearts God had touched.

verses.english:
Saul also went home to Gibeah, accompanied by upstanding men whose
hearts God had touched.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי בְלִיַּעַל אָמְרוּ מַה־יֹּשִׁעֵנוּ זֶה וַיִּבְזֻהוּ וְלֹא־הֵבִיאוּ לוֹ מִנְחָה וַיְהִי כְּמַחֲרִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי בְלִיַּעַל אָמְרוּ מַה־יֹּשִׁעֵנוּ זֶה וַיִּבְזֻהוּ וְלֹא־הֵבִיאוּ לוֹ מִנְחָה וַיְהִי כְּמַחֲרִישׁ׃

english.text:
But some scoundrels said, “How can this fellow save us?” So they
scorned him and brought him no gift. But he pretended not to mind.

translation.text: But the children of Belial said, How shall this man save us? And they despised him, and brought no presents. But he held his peace.

verses.english:
But some scoundrels said, “How can this fellow save us?” So they
scorned him and brought him no gift. But he pretended not to mind.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל נָחָשׁ הָעַמּוֹנִי וַיִּחַן עַל־יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמְרוּ כּל־אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ אֶל־נָחָשׁ כְּרת־לָנוּ בְרִית וְנַעַבְדֶךָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל נָחָשׁ הָעַמּוֹנִי וַיִּחַן עַל־יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמְרוּ כּל־אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ אֶל־נָחָשׁ כְּרת־לָנוּ בְרִית וְנַעַבְדֶךָּ׃

english.text:
Nahash the Ammonite marched up and besieged Jabesh-gilead. All the
men of Jabesh-gilead said to Nahash, “Make a pact with us, and we
will serve you.”

translation.text: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabeshgilead: and all the men of Jabesh said unto Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.

verses.english:
Nahash the Ammonite marched up and besieged Jabesh-gilead. All the
men of Jabesh-gilead said to Nahash, “Make a pact with us, and we
will serve you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם נָחָשׁ הָעַמּוֹנִי בְּזֹאת אֶכְרֹת לָכֶם בִּנְקוֹר לָכֶם כּל־עֵין יָמִין וְשַׂמְתִּיהָ חֶרְפָּה עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם נָחָשׁ הָעַמּוֹנִי בְּזֹאת אֶכְרֹת לָכֶם בִּנְקוֹר לָכֶם כּל־עֵין יָמִין וְשַׂמְתִּיהָ חֶרְפָּה עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But Nahash the Ammonite answered them, “I will make a pact with
you on this condition, that everyone’s right eye be gouged out; I
will make this a humiliation for all Israel.”

translation.text: And Nahash the Ammonite answered them, On this condition will I make a covenant with you, that I may thrust out all your right eyes, and lay it for a reproach upon all Israel.

verses.english:
But Nahash the Ammonite answered them, “I will make a pact with
you on this condition, that everyone’s right eye be gouged out; I
will make this a humiliation for all Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו זִקְנֵי יָבֵישׁ הֶרֶף לָנוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְנִשְׁלְחָה מַלְאָכִים בְּכֹל גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִם־אֵין מוֹשִׁיעַ אֹתָנוּ וְיָצָאנוּ אֵלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו זִקְנֵי יָבֵישׁ הֶרֶף לָנוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְנִשְׁלְחָה מַלְאָכִים בְּכֹל גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִם־אֵין מוֹשִׁיעַ אֹתָנוּ וְיָצָאנוּ אֵלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
The elders of Jabesh said to him, “Give us seven days’ respite, so
that we may send messengers throughout the territory of Israel; if
no one comes to our aid, we will surrender to you.”

translation.text: And the elders of Jabesh said unto him, Give us seven days’ respite, that we may send messengers unto all the coasts of Israel: and then, if there be no man to save us, we will come out to thee.

verses.english:
The elders of Jabesh said to him, “Give us seven days’ respite, so
that we may send messengers throughout the territory of Israel; if
no one comes to our aid, we will surrender to you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים גִּבְעַת שָׁאוּל וַיְדַבְּרוּ הַדְּבָרִים בְּאזְנֵי הָעָם וַיִּשְׂאוּ כל־הָעָם אֶת־קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים גִּבְעַת שָׁאוּל וַיְדַבְּרוּ הַדְּבָרִים בְּאזְנֵי הָעָם וַיִּשְׂאוּ כל־הָעָם אֶת־קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ׃

english.text:
When the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and gave this report in
the hearing of the people, all the people broke into weeping.

translation.text: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul, and told the tidings in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voices, and wept.

verses.english:
When the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and gave this report in
the hearing of the people, all the people broke into weeping.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה שָׁאוּל בָּא אַחֲרֵי הַבָּקָר מִן־הַשָּׂדֶה וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל מַה־לָּעָם כִּי יִבְכּוּ וַיְסַפְּרוּ־לוֹ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה שָׁאוּל בָּא אַחֲרֵי הַבָּקָר מִן־הַשָּׂדֶה וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל מַה־לָּעָם כִּי יִבְכּוּ וַיְסַפְּרוּ־לוֹ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ׃

english.text:
Saul was just coming from the field driving the cattle; and Saul
asked, “Why are the people crying?” And they told him about the
situation of the men of Jabesh.

translation.text: And, behold, Saul came after the herd out of the field; and Saul said, What aileth the people that they weep? And they told him the tidings of the men of Jabesh.

verses.english:
Saul was just coming from the field driving the cattle; and Saul
asked, “Why are the people crying?” And they told him about the
situation of the men of Jabesh.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּצְלַח רוּחַ־אֱלֹהִים עַל־שָׁאוּל (בשמעו) [כְּשׁמְעוֹ] אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּצְלַח רוּחַ־אֱלֹהִים עַל־שָׁאוּל (בשמעו) [כְּשׁמְעוֹ] אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ מְאֹד׃

english.text:
When he heard these things, the spirit of God gripped Saul and his
anger blazed up.

translation.text: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those tidings, and his anger was kindled greatly.

verses.english:
When he heard these things, the spirit of God gripped Saul and his
anger blazed up.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח צֶמֶד בָּקָר וַיְנַתְּחֵהוּ וַיְשַׁלַּח בְּכל־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיַד הַמַּלְאָכִים לֵאמֹר אֲשֶׁר אֵינֶנּוּ יֹצֵא אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל וְאַחַר שְׁמוּאֵל כֹּה יֵעָשֶׂה
לִבְקָרוֹ וַיִּפֹּל פַּחַד־יְהֹוָה עַל־הָעָם וַיֵּצְאוּ כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח צֶמֶד בָּקָר וַיְנַתְּחֵהוּ וַיְשַׁלַּח בְּכל־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיַד הַמַּלְאָכִים לֵאמֹר אֲשֶׁר אֵינֶנּוּ יֹצֵא אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל וְאַחַר שְׁמוּאֵל כֹּה יֵעָשֶׂה
לִבְקָרוֹ וַיִּפֹּל פַּחַד־יְהֹוָה עַל־הָעָם וַיֵּצְאוּ כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד׃

english.text:
He took a yoke of oxen and cut them into pieces, which he sent by
messengers throughout the territory of Israel, with the warning,
“Thus shall be done to the cattle of anyone who does not follow
Saul and Samuel into battle!” Terror from YHWH fell upon the
people, and they came out as one man.

translation.text: And he took a yoke of oxen, and hewed them in pieces, and sent them throughout all the coasts of Israel by the hands of messengers, saying, Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done unto his oxen. And the fear of the LORD fell on the people, and they came out with one consent.

verses.english:
He took a yoke of oxen and cut them into pieces, which he sent by
messengers throughout the territory of Israel, with the warning,
“Thus shall be done to the cattle of anyone who does not follow
Saul and Samuel into battle!” Terror from YHWH fell upon the
people, and they came out as one man.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקְדֵם בְּבָזֶק וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה שְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְקְדֵם בְּבָזֶק וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה שְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף׃

english.text:
[Saul] mustered them in Bezek, and the Israelites numbered
300,000, the men of Judah 30,000.

translation.text: And when he numbered them in Bezek, the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

verses.english:
[Saul] mustered them in Bezek, and the Israelites numbered
300,000, the men of Judah 30,000.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לַמַּלְאָכִים הַבָּאִים כֹּה תֹאמְרוּן לְאִישׁ יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד מָחָר תִּהְיֶה־לָכֶם תְּשׁוּעָה (בחם) [כְּחֹם] הַשָּׁמֶשׁ וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיַּגִּידוּ
לְאַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ וַיִּשְׂמָחוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לַמַּלְאָכִים הַבָּאִים כֹּה תֹאמְרוּן לְאִישׁ יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד מָחָר תִּהְיֶה־לָכֶם תְּשׁוּעָה (בחם) [כְּחֹם] הַשָּׁמֶשׁ וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיַּגִּידוּ
לְאַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ וַיִּשְׂמָחוּ׃

english.text:
The messengers who had come were told, “Thus shall you speak to
the men of Jabesh-gilead: Tomorrow, when the sun grows hot, you
shall be saved.” When the messengers came and told this to the men
of Jabesh-gilead, they rejoiced.

translation.text: And they said unto the messengers that came, Thus shall ye say unto the men of Jabeshgilead, To morrow, by that time the sun be hot, ye shall have help. And the messengers came and shewed it to the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.

verses.english:
The messengers who had come were told, “Thus shall you speak to
the men of Jabesh-gilead: Tomorrow, when the sun grows hot, you
shall be saved.” When the messengers came and told this to the men
of Jabesh-gilead, they rejoiced.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ מָחָר נֵצֵא אֲלֵיכֶם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָנוּ כְּכל־הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ מָחָר נֵצֵא אֲלֵיכֶם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָנוּ כְּכל־הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
The men of Jabesh then told [the Ammonites], “Tomorrow we will
surrender to you, and you can do to us whatever you please.”

translation.text: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, To morrow we will come out unto you, and ye shall do with us all that seemeth good unto you.

verses.english:
The men of Jabesh then told [the Ammonites], “Tomorrow we will
surrender to you, and you can do to us whatever you please.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיָּשֶׂם שָׁאוּל אֶת־הָעָם שְׁלֹשָׁה רָאשִׁים וַיָּבֹאוּ בְתוֹךְ־הַמַּחֲנֶה בְּאַשְׁמֹרֶת הַבֹּקֶר וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־עַמּוֹן עַד־חֹם הַיּוֹם וַיְהִי הַנִּשְׁאָרִים
וַיָּפֻצוּ וְלֹא נִשְׁאֲרוּ־בָם שְׁנַיִם יָחַד׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיָּשֶׂם שָׁאוּל אֶת־הָעָם שְׁלֹשָׁה רָאשִׁים וַיָּבֹאוּ בְתוֹךְ־הַמַּחֲנֶה בְּאַשְׁמֹרֶת הַבֹּקֶר וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־עַמּוֹן עַד־חֹם הַיּוֹם וַיְהִי הַנִּשְׁאָרִים
וַיָּפֻצוּ וְלֹא נִשְׁאֲרוּ־בָם שְׁנַיִם יָחַד׃

english.text:
The next day, Saul divided the troops into three columns; at the
morning watch they entered the camp and struck down the Ammonites
until the day grew hot. The survivors scattered; no two were left
together.

translation.text: And it was so on the morrow, that Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the midst of the host in the morning watch, and slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day: and it came to pass, that they which remained were scattered, so that two of them were not left together.

verses.english:
The next day, Saul divided the troops into three columns; at the
morning watch they entered the camp and struck down the Ammonites
until the day grew hot. The survivors scattered; no two were left
together.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל מִי הָאֹמֵר שָׁאוּל יִמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ תְּנוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וּנְמִיתֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל מִי הָאֹמֵר שָׁאוּל יִמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ תְּנוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וּנְמִיתֵם׃

english.text:
The people then said to Samuel, “Who was it said, ‘Shall Saul be
king over us?’ Hand the men over and we will put them to death!”

translation.text: And the people said unto Samuel, Who is he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? bring the men, that we may put them to death.

verses.english:
The people then said to Samuel, “Who was it said, ‘Shall Saul be
king over us?’ Hand the men over and we will put them to death!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לֹא־יוּמַת אִישׁ בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה־יְהֹוָה תְּשׁוּעָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לֹא־יוּמַת אִישׁ בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה־יְהֹוָה תְּשׁוּעָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But Saul replied, “No man shall be put to death this day! For this
day YHWH has brought victory to Israel.”

translation.text: And Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day: for to day the LORD hath wrought salvation in Israel.

verses.english:
But Saul replied, “No man shall be put to death this day! For this
day YHWH has brought victory to Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־הָעָם לְכוּ וְנֵלְכָה הַגִּלְגָּל וּנְחַדֵּשׁ שָׁם הַמְּלוּכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־הָעָם לְכוּ וְנֵלְכָה הַגִּלְגָּל וּנְחַדֵּשׁ שָׁם הַמְּלוּכָה׃

english.text:
Samuel said to the people, “Come, let us go to Gilgal and there
inaugurate the monarchy.”

translation.text: Then said Samuel to the people, Come, and let us go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.

verses.english:
Samuel said to the people, “Come, let us go to Gilgal and there
inaugurate the monarchy.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלְכוּ כל־הָעָם הַגִּלְגָּל וַיַּמְלִכוּ שָׁם אֶת־שָׁאוּל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בַּגִּלְגָּל וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־שָׁם זְבָחִים שְׁלָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׂמַח שָׁם שָׁאוּל
וְכל־אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלְכוּ כל־הָעָם הַגִּלְגָּל וַיַּמְלִכוּ שָׁם אֶת־שָׁאוּל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בַּגִּלְגָּל וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־שָׁם זְבָחִים שְׁלָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׂמַח שָׁם שָׁאוּל
וְכל־אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־מְאֹד׃

english.text:
So all the people went to Gilgal, and there at Gilgal they
declared Saul king before YHWH. They offered sacrifices of
well-being there before YHWH; and Saul and all the men of Israel
held a great celebration there.

translation.text: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.

verses.english:
So all the people went to Gilgal, and there at Gilgal they
declared Saul king before YHWH. They offered sacrifices of
well-being there before YHWH; and Saul and all the men of Israel
held a great celebration there.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנֵּה שָׁמַעְתִּי בְקֹלְכֶם לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־אֲמַרְתֶּם לִי וָאַמְלִיךְ עֲלֵיכֶם מֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנֵּה שָׁמַעְתִּי בְקֹלְכֶם לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־אֲמַרְתֶּם לִי וָאַמְלִיךְ עֲלֵיכֶם מֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Then Samuel said to all Israel, “I have yielded to you in all you
have asked of me and have set a king over you.

translation.text: And Samuel said unto all Israel, Behold, I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me, and have made a king over you.

verses.english:
Then Samuel said to all Israel, “I have yielded to you in all you
have asked of me and have set a king over you.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ מִתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם וַאֲנִי זָקַנְתִּי וָשַׂבְתִּי וּבָנַי הִנָּם אִתְּכֶם וַאֲנִי הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶם מִנְּעֻרַי עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ מִתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם וַאֲנִי זָקַנְתִּי וָשַׂבְתִּי וּבָנַי הִנָּם אִתְּכֶם וַאֲנִי הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶם מִנְּעֻרַי עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Henceforth the king will be your leader. “As for me, I have grown
old and gray—but my sons are still with you—and I have been your
leader from my youth to this day.

translation.text: And now, behold, the king walketh before you: and I am old and grayheaded; and, behold, my sons are with you: and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day.

verses.english:
Henceforth the king will be your leader. “As for me, I have grown
old and gray—but my sons are still with you—and I have been your
leader from my youth to this day.

verses.hebrew:
הִנְנִי עֲנוּ בִי נֶגֶד יְהֹוָה וְנֶגֶד מְשִׁיחוֹ אֶת־שׁוֹר מִי לָקַחְתִּי וַחֲמוֹר מִי לָקַחְתִּי וְאֶת־מִי עָשַׁקְתִּי אֶת־מִי רַצּוֹתִי וּמִיַּד־מִי לָקַחְתִּי כֹפֶר וְאַעְלִים
עֵינַי בּוֹ וְאָשִׁיב לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
הִנְנִי עֲנוּ בִי נֶגֶד יְהֹוָה וְנֶגֶד מְשִׁיחוֹ אֶת־שׁוֹר מִי לָקַחְתִּי וַחֲמוֹר מִי לָקַחְתִּי וְאֶת־מִי עָשַׁקְתִּי אֶת־מִי רַצּוֹתִי וּמִיַּד־מִי לָקַחְתִּי כֹפֶר וְאַעְלִים
עֵינַי בּוֹ וְאָשִׁיב לָכֶם׃

english.text:
Here I am! Testify against me, in the presence of YHWH and in the
presence of His anointed one: Whose ox have I taken, or whose ass
have I taken? Whom have I defrauded or whom have I robbed? From
whom have I taken a bribe to look the other way? I will return it
to you.”

translation.text: Behold, here I am: witness against me before the LORD, and before his anointed: whose ox have I taken? or whose ass have I taken? or whom have I defrauded? whom have I oppressed? or of whose hand have I received any bribe to blind mine eyes therewith? and I will restore it you.

verses.english:
Here I am! Testify against me, in the presence of YHWH and in the
presence of His anointed one: Whose ox have I taken, or whose ass
have I taken? Whom have I defrauded or whom have I robbed? From
whom have I taken a bribe to look the other way? I will return it
to you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא עֲשַׁקְתָּנוּ וְלֹא רַצּוֹתָנוּ וְלֹא־לָקַחְתָּ מִיַּד־אִישׁ מְאוּמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא עֲשַׁקְתָּנוּ וְלֹא רַצּוֹתָנוּ וְלֹא־לָקַחְתָּ מִיַּד־אִישׁ מְאוּמָה׃

english.text:
They responded, “You have not defrauded us, and you have not
robbed us, and you have taken nothing from anyone.”

translation.text: And they said, Thou hast not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither hast thou taken ought of any man’s hand.

verses.english:
They responded, “You have not defrauded us, and you have not
robbed us, and you have taken nothing from anyone.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם עֵד יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וְעֵד מְשִׁיחוֹ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי לֹא מְצָאתֶם בְּיָדִי מְאוּמָה וַיֹּאמֶר עֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם עֵד יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וְעֵד מְשִׁיחוֹ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי לֹא מְצָאתֶם בְּיָדִי מְאוּמָה וַיֹּאמֶר עֵד׃

english.text:
He said to them, “YHWH then is witness, and His anointed is
witness, to your admission this day that you have found nothing in
my possession.” They responded, “He is!”

translation.text: And he said unto them, The LORD is witness against you, and his anointed is witness this day, that ye have not found ought in my hand. And they answered, He is witness.

verses.english:
He said to them, “YHWH then is witness, and His anointed is
witness, to your admission this day that you have found nothing in
my possession.” They responded, “He is!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־הָעָם יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹן וַאֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָה אֶת־אֲבֹתֵיכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־הָעָם יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹן וַאֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָה אֶת־אֲבֹתֵיכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
Samuel said to the people, “YHWH [is witness], He who appointed
Moses and Aaron and who brought your fathers out of the land of
Egypt.

translation.text: And Samuel said unto the people, It is the LORD that advanced Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
Samuel said to the people, “YHWH [is witness], He who appointed
Moses and Aaron and who brought your fathers out of the land of
Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִתְיַצְּבוּ וְאִשָּׁפְטָה אִתְּכֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֵת כּל־צִדְקוֹת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אִתְּכֶם וְאֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִתְיַצְּבוּ וְאִשָּׁפְטָה אִתְּכֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֵת כּל־צִדְקוֹת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אִתְּכֶם וְאֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
Come, stand before YHWH while I cite against you all the
kindnesses that YHWH has done to you and your fathers.

translation.text: Now therefore stand still, that I may reason with you before the LORD of all the righteous acts of the LORD, which he did to you and to your fathers.

verses.english:
Come, stand before YHWH while I cite against you all the
kindnesses that YHWH has done to you and your fathers.

verses.hebrew:
כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּא יַעֲקֹב מִצְרָיִם וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹן וַיּוֹצִיאוּ אֶת־אֲבֹתֵיכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וַיֹּשִׁבוּם בַּמָּקוֹם
הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּא יַעֲקֹב מִצְרָיִם וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹן וַיּוֹצִיאוּ אֶת־אֲבֹתֵיכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וַיֹּשִׁבוּם בַּמָּקוֹם
הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
“When Jacob came to Egypt,…your fathers cried out to YHWH, and
YHWH sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt
and settled them in this place.

translation.text: When Jacob was come into Egypt, and your fathers cried unto the LORD, then the LORD sent Moses and Aaron, which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt, and made them dwell in this place.

verses.english:
“When Jacob came to Egypt,…your fathers cried out to YHWH, and
YHWH sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt
and settled them in this place.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכְּחוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיִּמְכֹּר אֹתָם בְּיַד סִיסְרָא שַׂר־צְבָא חָצוֹר וּבְיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּבְיַד מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכְּחוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיִּמְכֹּר אֹתָם בְּיַד סִיסְרָא שַׂר־צְבָא חָצוֹר וּבְיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּבְיַד מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בָּם׃

english.text:
But they forgot YHWH their God; so He delivered them into the
hands of Sisera the military commander of Hazor, into the hands of
the Philistines, and into the hands of the king of Moab; and these
made war upon them.

translation.text: And when they forgat the LORD their God, he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the host of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.

verses.english:
But they forgot YHWH their God; so He delivered them into the
hands of Sisera the military commander of Hazor, into the hands of
the Philistines, and into the hands of the king of Moab; and these
made war upon them.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה (ויאמר) [וַיֹּאמְרוּ] חָטָאנוּ כִּי עָזַבְנוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַנַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים וְאֶת־הָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְעַתָּה הַצִּילֵנוּ מִיַּד אֹיְבֵינוּ
וְנַעַבְדֶךָּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה (ויאמר) [וַיֹּאמְרוּ] חָטָאנוּ כִּי עָזַבְנוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַנַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים וְאֶת־הָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְעַתָּה הַצִּילֵנוּ מִיַּד אֹיְבֵינוּ
וְנַעַבְדֶךָּ׃

english.text:
They cried to YHWH, ‘We are guilty, for we have forsaken YHWH and
worshiped the Baalim and Ashtaroth. Oh, deliver us from our
enemies and we will serve You.’

translation.text: And they cried unto the LORD, and said, We have sinned, because we have forsaken the LORD, and have served Baalim and Ashtaroth: but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve thee.

verses.english:
They cried to YHWH, ‘We are guilty, for we have forsaken YHWH and
worshiped the Baalim and Ashtaroth. Oh, deliver us from our
enemies and we will serve You.’

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהֹוָה אֶת־יְרֻבַּעַל וְאֶת־בְּדָן וְאֶת־יִפְתָּח וְאֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל וַיַּצֵּל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד אֹיְבֵיכֶם מִסָּבִיב וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בֶּטַח׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהֹוָה אֶת־יְרֻבַּעַל וְאֶת־בְּדָן וְאֶת־יִפְתָּח וְאֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל וַיַּצֵּל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד אֹיְבֵיכֶם מִסָּבִיב וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בֶּטַח׃

english.text:
And YHWH sent Jerubbaal and Bedan and Jephthah and Samuel, and
delivered you from the enemies around you; and you dwelt in
security.

translation.text: And the LORD sent Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side, and ye dwelled safe.

verses.english:
And YHWH sent Jerubbaal and Bedan and Jephthah and Samuel, and
delivered you from the enemies around you; and you dwelt in
security.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּרְאוּ כִּי־נָחָשׁ מֶלֶךְ בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן בָּא עֲלֵיכֶם וַתֹּאמְרוּ לִי לֹא כִּי־מֶלֶךְ יִמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ וַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מַלְכְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּרְאוּ כִּי־נָחָשׁ מֶלֶךְ בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן בָּא עֲלֵיכֶם וַתֹּאמְרוּ לִי לֹא כִּי־מֶלֶךְ יִמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ וַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מַלְכְּכֶם׃

english.text:
But when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites was advancing
against you, you said to me, ‘No, we must have a king reigning
over us’—though YHWH your God is your King.

translation.text: And when ye saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, ye said unto me, Nay; but a king shall reign over us: when the LORD your God was your king.

verses.english:
But when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites was advancing
against you, you said to me, ‘No, we must have a king reigning
over us’—though YHWH your God is your King.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר בְּחַרְתֶּם אֲשֶׁר שְׁאֶלְתֶּם וְהִנֵּה נָתַן יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם מֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר בְּחַרְתֶּם אֲשֶׁר שְׁאֶלְתֶּם וְהִנֵּה נָתַן יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיכֶם מֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
“Well, YHWH has set a king over you! Here is the king that you
have chosen, that you have asked for.

translation.text: Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen, and whom ye have desired! and, behold, the LORD hath set a king over you.

verses.english:
“Well, YHWH has set a king over you! Here is the king that you
have chosen, that you have asked for.

verses.hebrew:
אִם־תִּירְאוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֹתוֹ וּשְׁמַעְתֶּם בְּקוֹלוֹ וְלֹא תַמְרוּ אֶת־פִּי יְהֹוָה וִהְיִתֶם גַּם־אַתֶּם וְגַם־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ עֲלֵיכֶם אַחַר יְהֹוָה
אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
אִם־תִּירְאוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֹתוֹ וּשְׁמַעְתֶּם בְּקוֹלוֹ וְלֹא תַמְרוּ אֶת־פִּי יְהֹוָה וִהְיִתֶם גַּם־אַתֶּם וְגַם־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ עֲלֵיכֶם אַחַר יְהֹוָה
אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“If you will revere YHWH, worship Him, and obey Him, and will not
flout YHWH’s command, if both you and the king who reigns over you
will follow YHWH your God, [well and good].

translation.text: If ye will fear the LORD, and serve him, and obey his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then shall both ye and also the king that reigneth over you continue following the LORD your God:

verses.english:
“If you will revere YHWH, worship Him, and obey Him, and will not
flout YHWH’s command, if both you and the king who reigns over you
will follow YHWH your God, [well and good].

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וּמְרִיתֶם אֶת־פִּי יְהֹוָה וְהָיְתָה יַד־יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וּבַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וּמְרִיתֶם אֶת־פִּי יְהֹוָה וְהָיְתָה יַד־יְהֹוָה בָּכֶם וּבַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
But if you do not obey YHWH and you flout YHWH’s command, the hand
of YHWH will strike you as it did your fathers.

translation.text: But if ye will not obey the voice of the LORD, but rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then shall the hand of the LORD be against you, as it was against your fathers.

verses.english:
But if you do not obey YHWH and you flout YHWH’s command, the hand
of YHWH will strike you as it did your fathers.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־עַתָּה הִתְיַצְּבוּ וּרְאוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה עֹשֶׂה לְעֵינֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: גַּם־עַתָּה הִתְיַצְּבוּ וּרְאוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר יְהֹוָה עֹשֶׂה לְעֵינֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
“Now stand by and see the marvelous thing that YHWH will do before
your eyes.

translation.text: Now therefore stand and see this great thing, which the LORD will do before your eyes.

verses.english:
“Now stand by and see the marvelous thing that YHWH will do before
your eyes.

verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא קְצִיר־חִטִּים הַיּוֹם אֶקְרָא אֶל־יְהֹוָה וְיִתֵּן קֹלוֹת וּמָטָר וּדְעוּ וּרְאוּ כִּי־רָעַתְכֶם רַבָּה אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לִשְׁאוֹל לָכֶם מֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: הֲלוֹא קְצִיר־חִטִּים הַיּוֹם אֶקְרָא אֶל־יְהֹוָה וְיִתֵּן קֹלוֹת וּמָטָר וּדְעוּ וּרְאוּ כִּי־רָעַתְכֶם רַבָּה אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לִשְׁאוֹל לָכֶם מֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
It is the season of the wheat harvest. I will pray to YHWH and He
will send thunder and rain; then you will take thought and realize
what a wicked thing you did in the sight of YHWH when you asked
for a king.”

translation.text: Is it not wheat harvest to day? I will call unto the LORD, and he shall send thunder and rain; that ye may perceive and see that your wickedness is great, which ye have done in the sight of the LORD, in asking you a king.

verses.english:
It is the season of the wheat harvest. I will pray to YHWH and He
will send thunder and rain; then you will take thought and realize
what a wicked thing you did in the sight of YHWH when you asked
for a king.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה קֹלֹת וּמָטָר בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּירָא כל־הָעָם מְאֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה קֹלֹת וּמָטָר בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּירָא כל־הָעָם מְאֹד אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל׃

english.text:
Samuel prayed to YHWH, and YHWH sent thunder and rain that day,
and the people stood in awe of YHWH and of Samuel.

translation.text: So Samuel called unto the LORD; and the LORD sent thunder and rain that day: and all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.

verses.english:
Samuel prayed to YHWH, and YHWH sent thunder and rain that day,
and the people stood in awe of YHWH and of Samuel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ כל־הָעָם אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל הִתְפַּלֵּל בְּעַד־עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְאַל־נָמוּת כִּי־יָסַפְנוּ עַל־כּל־חַטֹּאתֵינוּ רָעָה לִשְׁאֹל לָנוּ מֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ כל־הָעָם אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל הִתְפַּלֵּל בְּעַד־עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְאַל־נָמוּת כִּי־יָסַפְנוּ עַל־כּל־חַטֹּאתֵינוּ רָעָה לִשְׁאֹל לָנוּ מֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The people all said to Samuel, “Intercede for your servants with
YHWH your God that we may not die, for we have added to all our
sins the wickedness of asking for a king.”

translation.text: And all the people said unto Samuel, Pray for thy servants unto the LORD thy God, that we die not: for we have added unto all our sins this evil, to ask us a king.

verses.english:
The people all said to Samuel, “Intercede for your servants with
YHWH your God that we may not die, for we have added to all our
sins the wickedness of asking for a king.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־הָעָם אַל־תִּירָאוּ אַתֶּם עֲשִׂיתֶם אֵת כּל־הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת אַךְ אַל־תָּסוּרוּ מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֶת־יְהֹוָה בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־הָעָם אַל־תִּירָאוּ אַתֶּם עֲשִׂיתֶם אֵת כּל־הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת אַךְ אַל־תָּסוּרוּ מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֶת־יְהֹוָה בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם׃

english.text:
But Samuel said to the people, “Have no fear. You have, indeed,
done all those wicked things. Do not, however, turn away from
YHWH, but serve YHWH with all your heart.

translation.text: And Samuel said unto the people, Fear not: ye have done all this wickedness: yet turn not aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart;

verses.english:
But Samuel said to the people, “Have no fear. You have, indeed,
done all those wicked things. Do not, however, turn away from
YHWH, but serve YHWH with all your heart.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תָּסוּרוּ כִּי אַחֲרֵי הַתֹּהוּ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יוֹעִילוּ וְלֹא יַצִּילוּ כִּי־תֹהוּ הֵמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תָּסוּרוּ כִּי אַחֲרֵי הַתֹּהוּ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יוֹעִילוּ וְלֹא יַצִּילוּ כִּי־תֹהוּ הֵמָּה׃

english.text:
Do not turn away to follow worthless things, which can neither
profit nor save but are worthless.

translation.text: And turn ye not aside: for then should ye go after vain things, which cannot profit nor deliver; for they are vain.

verses.english:
Do not turn away to follow worthless things, which can neither
profit nor save but are worthless.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־יִטֹּשׁ יְהֹוָה אֶת־עַמּוֹ בַּעֲבוּר שְׁמוֹ הַגָּדוֹל כִּי הוֹאִיל יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶתְכֶם לוֹ לְעָם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא־יִטֹּשׁ יְהֹוָה אֶת־עַמּוֹ בַּעֲבוּר שְׁמוֹ הַגָּדוֹל כִּי הוֹאִיל יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶתְכֶם לוֹ לְעָם׃

english.text:
For the sake of His great name, YHWH will never abandon His
people, seeing that YHWH undertook to make you His people.

translation.text: For the LORD will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake: because it hath pleased the LORD to make you his people.

verses.english:
For the sake of His great name, YHWH will never abandon His
people, seeing that YHWH undertook to make you His people.

verses.hebrew: גַּם אָנֹכִי חָלִילָה לִּי מֵחֲטֹא לַיהֹוָה מֵחֲדֹל לְהִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעַדְכֶם וְהוֹרֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם בְּדֶרֶךְ הַטּוֹבָה וְהַיְשָׁרָה׃

hebrew.text: גַּם אָנֹכִי חָלִילָה לִּי מֵחֲטֹא לַיהֹוָה מֵחֲדֹל לְהִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעַדְכֶם וְהוֹרֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם בְּדֶרֶךְ הַטּוֹבָה וְהַיְשָׁרָה׃

english.text:
“As for me, far be it from me to sin against YHWH and refrain from
praying for you; and I will continue to instruct you in the
practice of what is good and right.

translation.text: Moreover as for me, God forbid that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way:

verses.english:
“As for me, far be it from me to sin against YHWH and refrain from
praying for you; and I will continue to instruct you in the
practice of what is good and right.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ יְראוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֹתוֹ בֶּאֱמֶת בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם כִּי רְאוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הִגְדִּל עִמָּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ יְראוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֹתוֹ בֶּאֱמֶת בְּכל־לְבַבְכֶם כִּי רְאוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הִגְדִּל עִמָּכֶם׃

english.text:
Above all, you must revere YHWH and serve Him faithfully with all
your heart; and consider how grandly He has dealt with you.

translation.text: Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great things he hath done for you.

verses.english:
Above all, you must revere YHWH and serve Him faithfully with all
your heart; and consider how grandly He has dealt with you.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־הָרֵעַ תָּרֵעוּ גַּם־אַתֶּם גַּם־מַלְכְּכֶם תִּסָּפוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־הָרֵעַ תָּרֵעוּ גַּם־אַתֶּם גַּם־מַלְכְּכֶם תִּסָּפוּ׃

english.text:
For if you persist in your wrongdoing, both you and your king
shall be swept away.”

translation.text: But if ye shall still do wickedly, ye shall be consumed, both ye and your king.

verses.english:
For if you persist in your wrongdoing, both you and your king
shall be swept away.”

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שָׁנָה שָׁאוּל בְּמלְכוֹ וּשְׁתֵּי שָׁנִים מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־שָׁנָה שָׁאוּל בְּמלְכוֹ וּשְׁתֵּי שָׁנִים מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Saul was… years old when he became king, and he reigned over
Israel two years.

translation.text: Saul reigned one year; and when he had reigned two years over Israel,

verses.english:
Saul was… years old when he became king, and he reigned over
Israel two years.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּבְחַר־לוֹ שָׁאוּל שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּהְיוּ עִם־שָׁאוּל אַלְפַּיִם בְּמִכְמָשׂ וּבְהַר בֵּית־אֵל וְאֶלֶף הָיוּ עִם־יוֹנָתָן בְּגִבְעַת בִּנְיָמִין וְיֶתֶר
הָעָם שִׁלַּח אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּבְחַר־לוֹ שָׁאוּל שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּהְיוּ עִם־שָׁאוּל אַלְפַּיִם בְּמִכְמָשׂ וּבְהַר בֵּית־אֵל וְאֶלֶף הָיוּ עִם־יוֹנָתָן בְּגִבְעַת בִּנְיָמִין וְיֶתֶר
הָעָם שִׁלַּח אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו׃

english.text:
Saul picked 3,000 Israelites, of whom 2,000 were with Saul in
Michmas and in the hill country of Bethel, and 1,000 with Jonathan
in Gibeah of Benjamin; the rest of the troops he sent back to
their homes.

translation.text: Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel; whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.

verses.english:
Saul picked 3,000 Israelites, of whom 2,000 were with Saul in
Michmas and in the hill country of Bethel, and 1,000 with Jonathan
in Gibeah of Benjamin; the rest of the troops he sent back to
their homes.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ יוֹנָתָן אֵת נְצִיב פְּלִשְׁתִּים אֲשֶׁר בְּגֶבַע וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְשָׁאוּל תָּקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר בְּכל־הָאָרֶץ לֵאמֹר יִשְׁמְעוּ הָעִבְרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּךְ יוֹנָתָן אֵת נְצִיב פְּלִשְׁתִּים אֲשֶׁר בְּגֶבַע וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְשָׁאוּל תָּקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר בְּכל־הָאָרֶץ לֵאמֹר יִשְׁמְעוּ הָעִבְרִים׃

english.text:
Jonathan struck down the Philistine prefect in Geba; and the
Philistines heard about it. Saul had the ram’s horn sounded
throughout the land, saying, “Let the Hebrews hear.”

translation.text: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.

verses.english:
Jonathan struck down the Philistine prefect in Geba; and the
Philistines heard about it. Saul had the ram’s horn sounded
throughout the land, saying, “Let the Hebrews hear.”

verses.hebrew: וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁמְעוּ לֵאמֹר הִכָּה שָׁאוּל אֶת־נְצִיב פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְגַם־נִבְאַשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּצָּעֲקוּ הָעָם אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל הַגִּלְגָּל׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁמְעוּ לֵאמֹר הִכָּה שָׁאוּל אֶת־נְצִיב פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְגַם־נִבְאַשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּצָּעֲקוּ הָעָם אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל הַגִּלְגָּל׃

english.text:
When all Israel heard that Saul had struck down the Philistine
prefect, and that Israel had incurred the wrath of the
Philistines, all the people rallied to Saul at Gilgal.

translation.text: And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines, and that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines. And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal.

verses.english:
When all Israel heard that Saul had struck down the Philistine
prefect, and that Israel had incurred the wrath of the
Philistines, all the people rallied to Saul at Gilgal.

verses.hebrew:
וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֶסְפוּ לְהִלָּחֵם עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף רֶכֶב וְשֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים פָּרָשִׁים וְעָם כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־הַיָּם לָרֹב וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ
בְמִכְמָשׂ קִדְמַת בֵּית אָוֶן׃

hebrew.text:
וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֶסְפוּ לְהִלָּחֵם עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף רֶכֶב וְשֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים פָּרָשִׁים וְעָם כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת־הַיָּם לָרֹב וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ
בְמִכְמָשׂ קִדְמַת בֵּית אָוֶן׃

english.text:
The Philistines, in turn, gathered to attack Israel: 30,000
chariots and 6,000 horsemen, and troops as numerous as the sands
of the seashore. They marched up and encamped at Michmas, east of
Beth-aven.

translation.text: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the sea shore in multitude: and they came up, and pitched in Michmash, eastward from Bethaven.

verses.english:
The Philistines, in turn, gathered to attack Israel: 30,000
chariots and 6,000 horsemen, and troops as numerous as the sands
of the seashore. They marched up and encamped at Michmas, east of
Beth-aven.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאוּ כִּי צַר־לוֹ כִּי נִגַּשׂ הָעָם וַיִּתְחַבְּאוּ הָעָם בַּמְּעָרוֹת וּבַחֲוָחִים וּבַסְּלָעִים וּבַצְּרִחִים וּבַבֹּרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאוּ כִּי צַר־לוֹ כִּי נִגַּשׂ הָעָם וַיִּתְחַבְּאוּ הָעָם בַּמְּעָרוֹת וּבַחֲוָחִים וּבַסְּלָעִים וּבַצְּרִחִים וּבַבֹּרוֹת׃

english.text:
When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble—for the
troops were hard pressed—the people hid in caves, among thorns,
among rocks, in tunnels, and in cisterns.

translation.text: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait, (for the people were distressed,) then the people did hide themselves in caves, and in thickets, and in rocks, and in high places, and in pits.

verses.english:
When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble—for the
troops were hard pressed—the people hid in caves, among thorns,
among rocks, in tunnels, and in cisterns.

verses.hebrew: וְעִבְרִים עָבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶרֶץ גָּד וְגִלְעָד וְשָׁאוּל עוֹדֶנּוּ בַגִּלְגָּל וְכל־הָעָם חָרְדוּ אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְעִבְרִים עָבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶרֶץ גָּד וְגִלְעָד וְשָׁאוּל עוֹדֶנּוּ בַגִּלְגָּל וְכל־הָעָם חָרְדוּ אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
Some Hebrews crossed the Jordan, [to] the territory of Gad and
Gilead. Saul was still at Gilgal, and the rest of the people
rallied to him in alarm.d

translation.text: And some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. As for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

verses.english:
Some Hebrews crossed the Jordan, [to] the territory of Gad and
Gilead. Saul was still at Gilgal, and the rest of the people
rallied to him in alarm.d

verses.hebrew: (וייחל) [וַיּוֹחֶל ] שִׁבְעַת יָמִים לַמּוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר שְׁמוּאֵל וְלֹא־בָא שְׁמוּאֵל הַגִּלְגָּל וַיָּפֶץ הָעָם מֵעָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: (וייחל) [וַיּוֹחֶל ] שִׁבְעַת יָמִים לַמּוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר שְׁמוּאֵל וְלֹא־בָא שְׁמוּאֵל הַגִּלְגָּל וַיָּפֶץ הָעָם מֵעָלָיו׃

english.text:
He waited seven days, the time that Samuel [had set]. But when
Samuel failed to come to Gilgal, and the people began to scatter,

translation.text: And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel had appointed: but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.

verses.english:
He waited seven days, the time that Samuel [had set]. But when
Samuel failed to come to Gilgal, and the people began to scatter,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל הַגִּשׁוּ אֵלַי הָעֹלָה וְהַשְּׁלָמִים וַיַּעַל הָעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל הַגִּשׁוּ אֵלַי הָעֹלָה וְהַשְּׁלָמִים וַיַּעַל הָעֹלָה׃

english.text:
Saul said, “Bring me the burnt offering and the sacrifice of
well-being”; and he presented the burnt offering.

translation.text: And Saul said, Bring hither a burnt offering to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.

verses.english:
Saul said, “Bring me the burnt offering and the sacrifice of
well-being”; and he presented the burnt offering.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְהַעֲלוֹת הָעֹלָה וְהִנֵּה שְׁמוּאֵל בָּא וַיֵּצֵא שָׁאוּל לִקְרָאתוֹ לְבָרְכוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְהַעֲלוֹת הָעֹלָה וְהִנֵּה שְׁמוּאֵל בָּא וַיֵּצֵא שָׁאוּל לִקְרָאתוֹ לְבָרְכוֹ׃

english.text:
He had just finished presenting the burnt offering when Samuel
arrived; and Saul went out to meet him and welcome him.

translation.text: And it came to pass, that as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might salute him.

verses.english:
He had just finished presenting the burnt offering when Samuel
arrived; and Saul went out to meet him and welcome him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל מֶה עָשִׂיתָ וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל כִּי־רָאִיתִי כִי־נָפַץ הָעָם מֵעָלַי וְאַתָּה לֹא־בָאתָ לְמוֹעֵד הַיָּמִים וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֱסָפִים מִכְמָשׂ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל מֶה עָשִׂיתָ וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל כִּי־רָאִיתִי כִי־נָפַץ הָעָם מֵעָלַי וְאַתָּה לֹא־בָאתָ לְמוֹעֵד הַיָּמִים וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֱסָפִים מִכְמָשׂ׃

english.text:
But Samuel said, “What have you done?” Saul replied, “I saw the
people leaving me and scattering; you had not come at the
appointed time, and the Philistines had gathered at Michmas.

translation.text: And Samuel said, What hast thou done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that thou camest not within the days appointed, and that the Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash;

verses.english:
But Samuel said, “What have you done?” Saul replied, “I saw the
people leaving me and scattering; you had not come at the
appointed time, and the Philistines had gathered at Michmas.

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר עַתָּה יֵרְדוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֵלַי הַגִּלְגָּל וּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא חִלִּיתִי וָאֶתְאַפַּק וָאַעֲלֶה הָעֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמַר עַתָּה יֵרְדוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֵלַי הַגִּלְגָּל וּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא חִלִּיתִי וָאֶתְאַפַּק וָאַעֲלֶה הָעֹלָה׃

english.text:
I thought the Philistines would march down against me at Gilgal
before I had entreated YHWH, so I forced myself to present the
burnt offering.”

translation.text: Therefore said I, The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal, and I have not made supplication unto the LORD: I forced myself therefore, and offered a burnt offering.

verses.english:
I thought the Philistines would march down against me at Gilgal
before I had entreated YHWH, so I forced myself to present the
burnt offering.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל נִסְכָּלְתָּ לֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־מִצְוַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר צִוָּךְ כִּי עַתָּה הֵכִין יְהֹוָה אֶת־מַמְלַכְתְּךָ אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל נִסְכָּלְתָּ לֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־מִצְוַת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר צִוָּךְ כִּי עַתָּה הֵכִין יְהֹוָה אֶת־מַמְלַכְתְּךָ אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
Samuel answered Saul, “You acted foolishly in not keeping the
commandments that YHWH your God laid upon you! Otherwise YHWH
would have established your dynasty over Israel forever.

translation.text: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly: thou hast not kept the commandment of the LORD thy God, which he commanded thee: for now would the LORD have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever.

verses.english:
Samuel answered Saul, “You acted foolishly in not keeping the
commandments that YHWH your God laid upon you! Otherwise YHWH
would have established your dynasty over Israel forever.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה מַמְלַכְתְּךָ לֹא־תָקוּם בִּקֵּשׁ יְהֹוָה לוֹ אִישׁ כִּלְבָבוֹ וַיְצַוֵּהוּ יְהֹוָה לְנָגִיד עַל־עַמּוֹ כִּי לֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה מַמְלַכְתְּךָ לֹא־תָקוּם בִּקֵּשׁ יְהֹוָה לוֹ אִישׁ כִּלְבָבוֹ וַיְצַוֵּהוּ יְהֹוָה לְנָגִיד עַל־עַמּוֹ כִּי לֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
But now your dynasty will not endure. YHWH will seek out a man
after His own heart, and YHWH will appoint him ruler over His
people, because you did not abide by what YHWH had commanded you.”

translation.text: But now thy kingdom shall not continue: the LORD hath sought him a man after his own heart, and the LORD hath commanded him to be captain over his people, because thou hast not kept that which the LORD commanded thee.

verses.english:
But now your dynasty will not endure. YHWH will seek out a man
after His own heart, and YHWH will appoint him ruler over His
people, because you did not abide by what YHWH had commanded you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם שְׁמוּאֵל וַיַּעַל מִן־הַגִּלְגָּל גִּבְעַת בִּנְיָמִן וַיִּפְקֹד שָׁאוּל אֶת־הָעָם הַנִּמְצְאִים עִמּוֹ כְּשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם שְׁמוּאֵל וַיַּעַל מִן־הַגִּלְגָּל גִּבְעַת בִּנְיָמִן וַיִּפְקֹד שָׁאוּל אֶת־הָעָם הַנִּמְצְאִים עִמּוֹ כְּשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אִישׁ׃

english.text:
Samuel arose and went up from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. Saul
numbered the troops who remained with him—about 600 strong.

translation.text: And Samuel arose, and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people that were present with him, about six hundred men.

verses.english:
Samuel arose and went up from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. Saul
numbered the troops who remained with him—about 600 strong.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁאוּל וְיוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ וְהָעָם הַנִּמְצָא עִמָּם יֹשְׁבִים בְּגֶבַע בִּנְיָמִן וּפְלִשְׁתִּים חָנוּ בְמִכְמָשׂ׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁאוּל וְיוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ וְהָעָם הַנִּמְצָא עִמָּם יֹשְׁבִים בְּגֶבַע בִּנְיָמִן וּפְלִשְׁתִּים חָנוּ בְמִכְמָשׂ׃

english.text:
Saul and his son Jonathan, and the troops who remained with them,
stayed in Geba of Benjamin, while the Philistines were encamped at
Michmas.

translation.text: And Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people that were present with them, abode in Gibeah of Benjamin: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.

verses.english:
Saul and his son Jonathan, and the troops who remained with them,
stayed in Geba of Benjamin, while the Philistines were encamped at
Michmas.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַמַּשְׁחִית מִמַּחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים שְׁלֹשָׁה רָאשִׁים הָרֹאשׁ אֶחָד יִפְנֶה אֶל־דֶּרֶךְ עפְרָה אֶל־אֶרֶץ שׁוּעָל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא הַמַּשְׁחִית מִמַּחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים שְׁלֹשָׁה רָאשִׁים הָרֹאשׁ אֶחָד יִפְנֶה אֶל־דֶּרֶךְ עפְרָה אֶל־אֶרֶץ שׁוּעָל׃

english.text:
The raiders came out of the Philistine camp in three columns: One
column headed for the Ophrah road that leads to the district of
Shual,

translation.text: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah, unto the land of Shual:

verses.english:
The raiders came out of the Philistine camp in three columns: One
column headed for the Ophrah road that leads to the district of
Shual,

verses.hebrew: וְהָרֹאשׁ אֶחָד יִפְנֶה דֶּרֶךְ בֵּית חֹרוֹן וְהָרֹאשׁ אֶחָד יִפְנֶה דֶּרֶךְ הַגְּבוּל הַנִּשְׁקָף עַל־גֵּי הַצְּבֹעִים הַמִּדְבָּרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָרֹאשׁ אֶחָד יִפְנֶה דֶּרֶךְ בֵּית חֹרוֹן וְהָרֹאשׁ אֶחָד יִפְנֶה דֶּרֶךְ הַגְּבוּל הַנִּשְׁקָף עַל־גֵּי הַצְּבֹעִים הַמִּדְבָּרָה׃

english.text:
another column headed for the Beth-horon road, and the third
column headed for the border road that overlooks the valley of
Zeboim toward the desert.

translation.text: And another company turned the way to Bethhoron: and another company turned to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

verses.english:
another column headed for the Beth-horon road, and the third
column headed for the border road that overlooks the valley of
Zeboim toward the desert.

verses.hebrew: וְחָרָשׁ לֹא יִמָּצֵא בְּכֹל אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־[אָמְרוּ] (אמר) פְלִשְׁתִּים פֶּן יַעֲשׂוּ הָעִבְרִים חֶרֶב אוֹ חֲנִית׃

hebrew.text: וְחָרָשׁ לֹא יִמָּצֵא בְּכֹל אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־[אָמְרוּ] (אמר) פְלִשְׁתִּים פֶּן יַעֲשׂוּ הָעִבְרִים חֶרֶב אוֹ חֲנִית׃

english.text:
No smith was to be found in all the land of Israel, for the
Philistines were afraid that the Hebrews would make swords or
spears.

translation.text: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel: for the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make them swords or spears:

verses.english:
No smith was to be found in all the land of Israel, for the
Philistines were afraid that the Hebrews would make swords or
spears.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרְדוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים לִלְטוֹשׁ אִישׁ אֶת־מַחֲרַשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת־אֵתוֹ וְאֶת־קַרְדֻּמּוֹ וְאֵת מַחֲרֵשָׁתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרְדוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים לִלְטוֹשׁ אִישׁ אֶת־מַחֲרַשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת־אֵתוֹ וְאֶת־קַרְדֻּמּוֹ וְאֵת מַחֲרֵשָׁתוֹ׃

english.text:
So all the Israelites had to go down to the Philistines to have
their plowshares, their mattocks, axes, and colters sharpened.

translation.text: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, to sharpen every man his share, and his coulter, and his axe, and his mattock.

verses.english:
So all the Israelites had to go down to the Philistines to have
their plowshares, their mattocks, axes, and colters sharpened.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה הַפְּצִירָה פִים לַמַּחֲרֵשֹׁת וְלָאֵתִים וְלִשְׁלֹשׁ קִלְּשׁוֹן וּלְהַקַּרְדֻּמִּים וּלְהַצִּיב הַדָּרְבָן׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיְתָה הַפְּצִירָה פִים לַמַּחֲרֵשֹׁת וְלָאֵתִים וְלִשְׁלֹשׁ קִלְּשׁוֹן וּלְהַקַּרְדֻּמִּים וּלְהַצִּיב הַדָּרְבָן׃

english.text:
The charge for sharpening was a pim for plowshares, mattocks,
three-pronged forks, and axes, and for setting the goads.

translation.text: Yet they had a file for the mattocks, and for the coulters, and for the forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the goads.

verses.english:
The charge for sharpening was a pim for plowshares, mattocks,
three-pronged forks, and axes, and for setting the goads.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בְּיוֹם מִלְחֶמֶת וְלֹא נִמְצָא חֶרֶב וַחֲנִית בְּיַד כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־יוֹנָתָן וַתִּמָּצֵא לְשָׁאוּל וּלְיוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בְּיוֹם מִלְחֶמֶת וְלֹא נִמְצָא חֶרֶב וַחֲנִית בְּיַד כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־יוֹנָתָן וַתִּמָּצֵא לְשָׁאוּל וּלְיוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ׃

translation.text: So it came to pass in the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that were with Saul and Jonathan: but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא מַצַּב פְּלִשְׁתִּים אֶל־מַעֲבַר מִכְמָשׂ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא מַצַּב פְּלִשְׁתִּים אֶל־מַעֲבַר מִכְמָשׂ׃

english.text:
Now the Philistine garrison had marched out to the pass of
Michmas.

translation.text: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash.

verses.english:
Now the Philistine garrison had marched out to the pass of
Michmas.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל אֶל־הַנַּעַר נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו לְכָה וְנַעְבְּרָה אֶל־מַצַּב פְּלִשְׁתִּים אֲשֶׁר מֵעֵבֶר הַלָּז וּלְאָבִיו לֹא הִגִּיד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל אֶל־הַנַּעַר נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו לְכָה וְנַעְבְּרָה אֶל־מַצַּב פְּלִשְׁתִּים אֲשֶׁר מֵעֵבֶר הַלָּז וּלְאָבִיו לֹא הִגִּיד׃

english.text:
One day, Jonathan son of Saul said to the attendant who carried
his arms, “Come, let us cross over to the Philistine garrison on
the other side”; but he did not tell his father.

translation.text: Now it came to pass upon a day, that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over to the Philistines’ garrison, that is on the other side. But he told not his father.

verses.english:
