One day, Jonathan son of Saul said to the attendant who carried
his arms, “Come, let us cross over to the Philistine garrison on
the other side”; but he did not tell his father.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁאוּל יוֹשֵׁב בִּקְצֵה הַגִּבְעָה תַּחַת הָרִמּוֹן אֲשֶׁר בְּמִגְרוֹן וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ כְּשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁאוּל יוֹשֵׁב בִּקְצֵה הַגִּבְעָה תַּחַת הָרִמּוֹן אֲשֶׁר בְּמִגְרוֹן וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ כְּשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אִישׁ׃

english.text:
Now Saul was staying on the outskirts of Gibeah, under the
pomegranate tree at Migron, and the troops with him numbered about
600.

translation.text: And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people that were with him were about six hundred men;

verses.english:
Now Saul was staying on the outskirts of Gibeah, under the
pomegranate tree at Migron, and the troops with him numbered about
600.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחִיָּה בֶן־אֲחִטוּב אֲחִי אִיכָבוֹד בֶּן־פִּינְחָס בֶּן־עֵלִי כֹּהֵן יְהֹוָה בְּשִׁלוֹ נֹשֵׂא אֵפוֹד וְהָעָם לֹא יָדַע כִּי הָלַךְ יוֹנָתָן׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲחִיָּה בֶן־אֲחִטוּב אֲחִי אִיכָבוֹד בֶּן־פִּינְחָס בֶּן־עֵלִי כֹּהֵן יְהֹוָה בְּשִׁלוֹ נֹשֵׂא אֵפוֹד וְהָעָם לֹא יָדַע כִּי הָלַךְ יוֹנָתָן׃

english.text:
Ahijah son of Ahitub brother of Ichabod son of Phinehas son of
Eli, the priest of YHWH at Shiloh, was there bearing an ephod.—The
troops did not know that Jonathan had gone.

translation.text: And Ahiah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the LORD’s priest in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. And the people knew not that Jonathan was gone.

verses.english:
Ahijah son of Ahitub brother of Ichabod son of Phinehas son of
Eli, the priest of YHWH at Shiloh, was there bearing an ephod.—The
troops did not know that Jonathan had gone.

verses.hebrew:
וּבֵין הַמַּעְבְּרוֹת אֲשֶׁר בִּקֵּשׁ יוֹנָתָן לַעֲבֹר עַל־מַצַּב פְּלִשְׁתִּים שֵׁן־הַסֶּלַע מֵהָעֵבֶר מִזֶּה וְשֵׁן־הַסֶּלַע מֵהָעֵבֶר מִזֶּה וְשֵׁם הָאֶחָד בּוֹצֵץ וְשֵׁם
הָאֶחָד סֶנֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וּבֵין הַמַּעְבְּרוֹת אֲשֶׁר בִּקֵּשׁ יוֹנָתָן לַעֲבֹר עַל־מַצַּב פְּלִשְׁתִּים שֵׁן־הַסֶּלַע מֵהָעֵבֶר מִזֶּה וְשֵׁן־הַסֶּלַע מֵהָעֵבֶר מִזֶּה וְשֵׁם הָאֶחָד בּוֹצֵץ וְשֵׁם
הָאֶחָד סֶנֶּה׃

english.text:
At the crossing by which Jonathan sought to reach the Philistine
garrison, there was a rocky crag on one side, and another rocky
crag on the other, the one called Bozez and the other Seneh.

translation.text: And between the passages, by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines’ garrison, there was a sharp rock on the one side, and a sharp rock on the other side: and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

verses.english:
At the crossing by which Jonathan sought to reach the Philistine
garrison, there was a rocky crag on one side, and another rocky
crag on the other, the one called Bozez and the other Seneh.

verses.hebrew: הַשֵּׁן הָאֶחָד מָצוּק מִצָּפוֹן מוּל מִכְמָשׂ וְהָאֶחָד מִנֶּגֶב מוּל גָּבַע׃

hebrew.text: הַשֵּׁן הָאֶחָד מָצוּק מִצָּפוֹן מוּל מִכְמָשׂ וְהָאֶחָד מִנֶּגֶב מוּל גָּבַע׃

english.text:
One crag was located on the north, near Michmas, and the other on
the south, near Geba.

translation.text: The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash, and the other southward over against Gibeah.

verses.english:
One crag was located on the north, near Michmas, and the other on
the south, near Geba.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן אֶל־הַנַּעַר נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו לְכָה וְנַעְבְּרָה אֶל־מַצַּב הָעֲרֵלִים הָאֵלֶּה אוּלַי יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה לָנוּ כִּי אֵין לַיהֹוָה מַעְצוֹר לְהוֹשִׁיעַ בְּרַב אוֹ
בִמְעָט׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן אֶל־הַנַּעַר נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו לְכָה וְנַעְבְּרָה אֶל־מַצַּב הָעֲרֵלִים הָאֵלֶּה אוּלַי יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה לָנוּ כִּי אֵין לַיהֹוָה מַעְצוֹר לְהוֹשִׁיעַ בְּרַב אוֹ
בִמְעָט׃

english.text:
Jonathan said to the attendant who carried his arms, “Come, let us
cross over to the outpost of those uncircumcised fellows. Perhaps
YHWH will act in our behalf, for nothing prevents YHWH from
winning a victory by many or by few.”

translation.text: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the LORD will work for us: for there is no restraint to the LORD to save by many or by few.

verses.english:
Jonathan said to the attendant who carried his arms, “Come, let us
cross over to the outpost of those uncircumcised fellows. Perhaps
YHWH will act in our behalf, for nothing prevents YHWH from
winning a victory by many or by few.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו עֲשֵׂה כּל־אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבֶךָ נְטֵה לָךְ הִנְנִי עִמְּךָ כִּלְבָבֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו עֲשֵׂה כּל־אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבֶךָ נְטֵה לָךְ הִנְנִי עִמְּךָ כִּלְבָבֶךָ׃

english.text:
His arms-bearer answered him, “Do whatever you like. You go first,
I am with you, whatever you decide.”

translation.text: And his armourbearer said unto him, Do all that is in thine heart: turn thee; behold, I am with thee according to thy heart.

verses.english:
His arms-bearer answered him, “Do whatever you like. You go first,
I am with you, whatever you decide.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן הִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ עֹבְרִים אֶל־הָאֲנָשִׁים וְנִגְלִינוּ אֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן הִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ עֹבְרִים אֶל־הָאֲנָשִׁים וְנִגְלִינוּ אֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text: Jonathan said, “We’ll cross over to those men and let them see us.

translation.text: Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over unto these men, and we will discover ourselves unto them.

verses.english: Jonathan said, “We’ll cross over to those men and let them see us.

verses.hebrew: אִם־כֹּה יֹאמְרוּ אֵלֵינוּ דֹּמּוּ עַד־הַגִּיעֵנוּ אֲלֵיכֶם וְעָמַדְנוּ תַחְתֵּינוּ וְלֹא נַעֲלֶה אֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: אִם־כֹּה יֹאמְרוּ אֵלֵינוּ דֹּמּוּ עַד־הַגִּיעֵנוּ אֲלֵיכֶם וְעָמַדְנוּ תַחְתֵּינוּ וְלֹא נַעֲלֶה אֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
If they say to us, ‘Wait until we get to you,’ then we’ll stay
where we are, and not go up to them.

translation.text: If they say thus unto us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up unto them.

verses.english:
If they say to us, ‘Wait until we get to you,’ then we’ll stay
where we are, and not go up to them.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־כֹּה יֹאמְרוּ עֲלוּ עָלֵינוּ וְעָלִינוּ כִּי־נְתָנָם יְהֹוָה בְּיָדֵנוּ וְזֶה־לָּנוּ הָאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־כֹּה יֹאמְרוּ עֲלוּ עָלֵינוּ וְעָלִינוּ כִּי־נְתָנָם יְהֹוָה בְּיָדֵנוּ וְזֶה־לָּנוּ הָאוֹת׃

english.text:
But if they say, ‘Come up to us,’ then we will go up, for YHWH is
delivering them into our hands. That shall be our sign.”

translation.text: But if they say thus, Come up unto us; then we will go up: for the LORD hath delivered them into our hand: and this shall be a sign unto us.

verses.english:
But if they say, ‘Come up to us,’ then we will go up, for YHWH is
delivering them into our hands. That shall be our sign.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגָּלוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם אֶל־מַצַּב פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמְרוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים הִנֵּה עִבְרִים יֹצְאִים מִן־הַחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַבְּאוּ־שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגָּלוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם אֶל־מַצַּב פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמְרוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים הִנֵּה עִבְרִים יֹצְאִים מִן־הַחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַבְּאוּ־שָׁם׃

english.text:
They both showed themselves to the Philistine outpost and the
Philistines said, “Look, some Hebrews are coming out of the holes
where they have been hiding.”

translation.text: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves.

verses.english:
They both showed themselves to the Philistine outpost and the
Philistines said, “Look, some Hebrews are coming out of the holes
where they have been hiding.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲנוּ אַנְשֵׁי הַמַּצָּבָה אֶת־יוֹנָתָן וְאֶת־נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲלוּ אֵלֵינוּ וְנוֹדִיעָה אֶתְכֶם דָּבָרוַיֹּאמֶר יוֹנָתָן אֶל־נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו עֲלֵה אַחֲרַי
כִּי־נְתָנָם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲנוּ אַנְשֵׁי הַמַּצָּבָה אֶת־יוֹנָתָן וְאֶת־נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲלוּ אֵלֵינוּ וְנוֹדִיעָה אֶתְכֶם דָּבָרוַיֹּאמֶר יוֹנָתָן אֶל־נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו עֲלֵה אַחֲרַי
כִּי־נְתָנָם יְהֹוָה בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The men of the outpost shouted to Jonathan and his arms-bearer,
“Come up to us, and we’ll teach you a lesson.” Then Jonathan said
to his arms-bearer, “Follow me, for YHWH will deliver them into
the hands of Israel.”

translation.text: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer, and said, Come up to us, and we will shew you a thing. And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer, Come up after me: for the LORD hath delivered them into the hand of Israel.

verses.english:
The men of the outpost shouted to Jonathan and his arms-bearer,
“Come up to us, and we’ll teach you a lesson.” Then Jonathan said
to his arms-bearer, “Follow me, for YHWH will deliver them into
the hands of Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל יוֹנָתָן עַל־יָדָיו וְעַל־רַגְלָיו וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו אַחֲרָיו וַיִּפְּלוּ לִפְנֵי יוֹנָתָן וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו מְמוֹתֵת אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל יוֹנָתָן עַל־יָדָיו וְעַל־רַגְלָיו וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו אַחֲרָיו וַיִּפְּלוּ לִפְנֵי יוֹנָתָן וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו מְמוֹתֵת אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
And Jonathan clambered up on his hands and feet, his arms-bearer
behind him; [the Philistines] fell before Jonathan, and his
arms-bearer finished them off behind him.

translation.text: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armourbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armourbearer slew after him.

verses.english:
And Jonathan clambered up on his hands and feet, his arms-bearer
behind him; [the Philistines] fell before Jonathan, and his
arms-bearer finished them off behind him.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי הַמַּכָּה הָרִאשֹׁנָה אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יוֹנָתָן וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו כְּעֶשְׂרִים אִישׁ כְּבַחֲצִי מַעֲנָה צֶמֶד שָׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי הַמַּכָּה הָרִאשֹׁנָה אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יוֹנָתָן וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו כְּעֶשְׂרִים אִישׁ כְּבַחֲצִי מַעֲנָה צֶמֶד שָׂדֶה׃

english.text:
The initial attack that Jonathan and his arms-bearer made
accounted for some twenty men, within a space about half a furrow
long [in] an acre of land.

translation.text: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land, which a yoke of oxen might plow.

verses.english:
The initial attack that Jonathan and his arms-bearer made
accounted for some twenty men, within a space about half a furrow
long [in] an acre of land.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי חֲרָדָה בַמַּחֲנֶה בַשָּׂדֶה וּבְכל־הָעָם הַמַּצָּב וְהַמַּשְׁחִית חָרְדוּ גַּם־הֵמָּה וַתִּרְגַּז הָאָרֶץ וַתְּהִי לְחֶרְדַּת אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי חֲרָדָה בַמַּחֲנֶה בַשָּׂדֶה וּבְכל־הָעָם הַמַּצָּב וְהַמַּשְׁחִית חָרְדוּ גַּם־הֵמָּה וַתִּרְגַּז הָאָרֶץ וַתְּהִי לְחֶרְדַּת אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
Terror broke out among all the troops both in the camp [and] in
the field; the outposts and the raiders were also terrified. The
very earth quaked, and a terror from God ensued.

translation.text: And there was trembling in the host, in the field, and among all the people: the garrison, and the spoilers, they also trembled, and the earth quaked: so it was a very great trembling.

verses.english:
Terror broke out among all the troops both in the camp [and] in
the field; the outposts and the raiders were also terrified. The
very earth quaked, and a terror from God ensued.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ הַצֹּפִים לְשָׁאוּל בְּגִבְעַת בִּנְיָמִן וְהִנֵּה הֶהָמוֹן נָמוֹג וַיֵּלֶךְ וַהֲלֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ הַצֹּפִים לְשָׁאוּל בְּגִבְעַת בִּנְיָמִן וְהִנֵּה הֶהָמוֹן נָמוֹג וַיֵּלֶךְ וַהֲלֹם׃

english.text:
Saul’s scouts in Gibeah of Benjamin saw that the multitude was
scattering in all directions.

translation.text: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and, behold, the multitude melted away, and they went on beating down one another.

verses.english:
Saul’s scouts in Gibeah of Benjamin saw that the multitude was
scattering in all directions.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ פִּקְדוּ־נָא וּרְאוּ מִי הָלַךְ מֵעִמָּנוּ וַיִּפְקְדוּ וְהִנֵּה אֵין יוֹנָתָן וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ פִּקְדוּ־נָא וּרְאוּ מִי הָלַךְ מֵעִמָּנוּ וַיִּפְקְדוּ וְהִנֵּה אֵין יוֹנָתָן וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו׃

english.text:
And Saul said to the troops with him, “Take a count and see who
has left us.” They took a count and found that Jonathan and his
arms-bearer were missing.

translation.text: Then said Saul unto the people that were with him, Number now, and see who is gone from us. And when they had numbered, behold, Jonathan and his armourbearer were not there.

verses.english:
And Saul said to the troops with him, “Take a count and see who
has left us.” They took a count and found that Jonathan and his
arms-bearer were missing.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לַאֲחִיָּה הַגִּישָׁה אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי־הָיָה אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לַאֲחִיָּה הַגִּישָׁה אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי־הָיָה אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Thereupon Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring the Ark of God here”; for
the Ark of God was at the time among the Israelites.

translation.text: And Saul said unto Ahiah, Bring hither the ark of God. For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel.

verses.english:
Thereupon Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring the Ark of God here”; for
the Ark of God was at the time among the Israelites.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עַד דִּבֶּר שָׁאוּל אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן וְהֶהָמוֹן אֲשֶׁר בְּמַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וָרָבוַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן אֱסֹף יָדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי עַד דִּבֶּר שָׁאוּל אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן וְהֶהָמוֹן אֲשֶׁר בְּמַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וָרָבוַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן אֱסֹף יָדֶךָ׃

english.text:
But while Saul was speaking to the priest, the confusion in the
Philistine camp kept increasing; and Saul said to the priest,
“Withdraw your hand.”

translation.text: And it came to pass, while Saul talked unto the priest, that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased: and Saul said unto the priest, Withdraw thine hand.

verses.english:
But while Saul was speaking to the priest, the confusion in the
Philistine camp kept increasing; and Saul said to the priest,
“Withdraw your hand.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזָּעֵק שָׁאוּל וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־הַמִּלְחָמָה וְהִנֵּה הָיְתָה חֶרֶב אִישׁ בְּרֵעֵהוּ מְהוּמָה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזָּעֵק שָׁאוּל וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־הַמִּלְחָמָה וְהִנֵּה הָיְתָה חֶרֶב אִישׁ בְּרֵעֵהוּ מְהוּמָה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד׃

translation.text: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man’s sword was against his fellow, and there was a very great discomfiture.

verses.hebrew: וְהָעִבְרִים הָיוּ לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים כְּאֶתְמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם אֲשֶׁר עָלוּ עִמָּם בַּמַּחֲנֶה סָבִיב וְגַם־הֵמָּה לִהְיוֹת עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עִם־שָׁאוּל וְיוֹנָתָן׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעִבְרִים הָיוּ לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים כְּאֶתְמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם אֲשֶׁר עָלוּ עִמָּם בַּמַּחֲנֶה סָבִיב וְגַם־הֵמָּה לִהְיוֹת עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עִם־שָׁאוּל וְיוֹנָתָן׃

english.text:
And the Hebrews who had previously sided with the Philistines, who
had come up with them in the army [from] round about—they too
joined the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

translation.text: Moreover the Hebrews that were with the Philistines before that time, which went up with them into the camp from the country round about, even they also turned to be with the Israelites that were with Saul and Jonathan.

verses.english:
And the Hebrews who had previously sided with the Philistines, who
had come up with them in the army [from] round about—they too
joined the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּתְחַבְּאִים בְּהַר־אֶפְרַיִם שָׁמְעוּ כִּי־נָסוּ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּדְבְּקוּ גַם־הֵמָּה אַחֲרֵיהֶם בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּתְחַבְּאִים בְּהַר־אֶפְרַיִם שָׁמְעוּ כִּי־נָסוּ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּדְבְּקוּ גַם־הֵמָּה אַחֲרֵיהֶם בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
When all the men of Israel who were hiding in the hill country of
Ephraim heard that the Philistines were fleeing, they too pursued
them in battle.

translation.text: Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.

verses.english:
When all the men of Israel who were hiding in the hill country of
Ephraim heard that the Philistines were fleeing, they too pursued
them in battle.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹשַׁע יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַמִּלְחָמָה עָבְרָה אֶת־בֵּית אָוֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹשַׁע יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַמִּלְחָמָה עָבְרָה אֶת־בֵּית אָוֶן׃

english.text:
Thus YHWH brought victory to Israel that day. The fighting passed
beyond Beth-aven.

translation.text: So the LORD saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over unto Bethaven.

verses.english:
Thus YHWH brought victory to Israel that day. The fighting passed
beyond Beth-aven.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל נִגַּשׂ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיֹּאֶל שָׁאוּל אֶת־הָעָם לֵאמֹר אָרוּר הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יֹאכַל לֶחֶם עַד־הָעֶרֶב וְנִקַּמְתִּי מֵאֹיְבַי וְלֹא־טָעַם כּל־הָעָם לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל נִגַּשׂ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיֹּאֶל שָׁאוּל אֶת־הָעָם לֵאמֹר אָרוּר הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יֹאכַל לֶחֶם עַד־הָעֶרֶב וְנִקַּמְתִּי מֵאֹיְבַי וְלֹא־טָעַם כּל־הָעָם לָחֶם׃

english.text:
The men of Israel were distressed that day. For Saul had laid an
oath upon the troops: “Cursed be the man who eats any food before
night falls and I take revenge on my enemies.” So none of the
troops ate anything.

translation.text: And the men of Israel were distressed that day: for Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening, that I may be avenged on mine enemies. So none of the people tasted any food.

verses.english:
The men of Israel were distressed that day. For Saul had laid an
oath upon the troops: “Cursed be the man who eats any food before
night falls and I take revenge on my enemies.” So none of the
troops ate anything.

verses.hebrew: וְכל־הָאָרֶץ בָּאוּ בַיָּעַר וַיְהִי דְבַשׁ עַל־פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־הָאָרֶץ בָּאוּ בַיָּעַר וַיְהִי דְבַשׁ עַל־פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
Everybody came to a stack of beehives where some honey had spilled
on the ground.

translation.text: And all they of the land came to a wood; and there was honey upon the ground.

verses.english:
Everybody came to a stack of beehives where some honey had spilled
on the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הָעָם אֶל־הַיַּעַר וְהִנֵּה הֵלֶךְ דְּבָשׁ וְאֵין־מַשִּׂיג יָדוֹ אֶל־פִּיו כִּי־יָרֵא הָעָם אֶת־הַשְּׁבֻעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא הָעָם אֶל־הַיַּעַר וְהִנֵּה הֵלֶךְ דְּבָשׁ וְאֵין־מַשִּׂיג יָדוֹ אֶל־פִּיו כִּי־יָרֵא הָעָם אֶת־הַשְּׁבֻעָה׃

english.text:
When the troops came to the beehives and found the flow of honey
there, no one put his hand to his mouth, for the troops feared the
oath.

translation.text: And when the people were come into the wood, behold, the honey dropped; but no man put his hand to his mouth: for the people feared the oath.

verses.english:
When the troops came to the beehives and found the flow of honey
there, no one put his hand to his mouth, for the troops feared the
oath.

verses.hebrew:
וְיוֹנָתָן לֹא־שָׁמַע בְּהַשְׁבִּיעַ אָבִיו אֶת־הָעָם וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת־קְצֵה הַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ וַיִּטְבֹּל אוֹתָהּ בְּיַעְרַת הַדְּבָשׁ וַיָּשֶׁב יָדוֹ אֶל־פִּיו (ותראנה)
[וַתָּאֹרְנָה] עֵינָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וְיוֹנָתָן לֹא־שָׁמַע בְּהַשְׁבִּיעַ אָבִיו אֶת־הָעָם וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת־קְצֵה הַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ וַיִּטְבֹּל אוֹתָהּ בְּיַעְרַת הַדְּבָשׁ וַיָּשֶׁב יָדוֹ אֶל־פִּיו (ותראנה)
[וַתָּאֹרְנָה] עֵינָיו׃

english.text:
Jonathan, however, had not heard his father adjure the troops. So
he put out the stick he had with him, dipped it into the beehive
of honey, and brought his hand back to his mouth; and his eyes lit
up.

translation.text: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath: wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand, and dipped it in an honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.

verses.english:
Jonathan, however, had not heard his father adjure the troops. So
he put out the stick he had with him, dipped it into the beehive
of honey, and brought his hand back to his mouth; and his eyes lit
up.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִישׁ מֵהָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר הַשְׁבֵּעַ הִשְׁבִּיעַ אָבִיךָ אֶת־הָעָם לֵאמֹר אָרוּר הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יֹאכַל לֶחֶם הַיּוֹם וַיָּעַף הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן אִישׁ מֵהָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר הַשְׁבֵּעַ הִשְׁבִּיעַ אָבִיךָ אֶת־הָעָם לֵאמֹר אָרוּר הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יֹאכַל לֶחֶם הַיּוֹם וַיָּעַף הָעָם׃

english.text:
At this one of the soldiers spoke up, “Your father adjured the
troops: ‘Cursed be the man who eats anything this day.’ And so the
troops are faint.”

translation.text: Then answered one of the people, and said, Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food this day. And the people were faint.

verses.english:
At this one of the soldiers spoke up, “Your father adjured the
troops: ‘Cursed be the man who eats anything this day.’ And so the
troops are faint.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹנָתָן עָכַר אָבִי אֶת־הָאָרֶץ רְאוּ־נָא כִּי־אֹרוּ עֵינַי כִּי טָעַמְתִּי מְעַט דְּבַשׁ הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹנָתָן עָכַר אָבִי אֶת־הָאָרֶץ רְאוּ־נָא כִּי־אֹרוּ עֵינַי כִּי טָעַמְתִּי מְעַט דְּבַשׁ הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Jonathan answered, “My father has brought trouble on the people.
See for yourselves how my eyes lit up when I tasted that bit of
honey.

translation.text: Then said Jonathan, My father hath troubled the land: see, I pray you, how mine eyes have been enlightened, because I tasted a little of this honey.

verses.english:
Jonathan answered, “My father has brought trouble on the people.
See for yourselves how my eyes lit up when I tasted that bit of
honey.

verses.hebrew: אַף כִּי לוּא אָכֹל אָכַל הַיּוֹם הָעָם מִשְּׁלַל אֹיְבָיו אֲשֶׁר מָצָא כִּי עַתָּה לֹא־רָבְתָה מַכָּה בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: אַף כִּי לוּא אָכֹל אָכַל הַיּוֹם הָעָם מִשְּׁלַל אֹיְבָיו אֲשֶׁר מָצָא כִּי עַתָּה לֹא־רָבְתָה מַכָּה בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
If only the troops had eaten today of spoil captured from the
enemy, the defeat of the Philistines would have been greater
still!”

translation.text: How much more, if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?

verses.english:
If only the troops had eaten today of spoil captured from the
enemy, the defeat of the Philistines would have been greater
still!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכּוּ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים מִמִּכְמָשׂ אַיָּלֹנָה וַיָּעַף הָעָם מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכּוּ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים מִמִּכְמָשׂ אַיָּלֹנָה וַיָּעַף הָעָם מְאֹד׃

english.text:
They struck down the Philistines that day from Michmas to Aijalon,
and the troops were famished.

translation.text: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon: and the people were very faint.

verses.english:
They struck down the Philistines that day from Michmas to Aijalon,
and the troops were famished.

verses.hebrew: (ויעש) [וַיַּעַט] הָעָם אֶל־[הַשָּׁלָל] (שלל) וַיִּקְחוּ צֹאן וּבָקָר וּבְנֵי בָקָר וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ־אָרְצָה וַיֹּאכַל הָעָם עַל־הַדָּם׃

hebrew.text: (ויעש) [וַיַּעַט] הָעָם אֶל־[הַשָּׁלָל] (שלל) וַיִּקְחוּ צֹאן וּבָקָר וּבְנֵי בָקָר וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ־אָרְצָה וַיֹּאכַל הָעָם עַל־הַדָּם׃

english.text:
The troops pounced on the spoil; they took the sheep and cows and
calves and slaughtered them on the ground, and the troops ate with
the blood.

translation.text: And the people flew upon the spoil, and took sheep, and oxen, and calves, and slew them on the ground: and the people did eat them with the blood.

verses.english:
The troops pounced on the spoil; they took the sheep and cows and
calves and slaughtered them on the ground, and the troops ate with
the blood.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּידוּ לְשָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה הָעָם חֹטִאים לַיהֹוָה לֶאֱכֹל עַל־הַדָּם וַיֹּאמֶר בְּגַדְתֶּם גֹּלּוּ־אֵלַי הַיּוֹם אֶבֶן גְּדוֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגִּידוּ לְשָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה הָעָם חֹטִאים לַיהֹוָה לֶאֱכֹל עַל־הַדָּם וַיֹּאמֶר בְּגַדְתֶּם גֹּלּוּ־אֵלַי הַיּוֹם אֶבֶן גְּדוֹלָה׃

english.text:
When it was reported to Saul that the troops were sinning against
YHWH, eating with the blood, he said, “You have acted faithlessly.
Roll a large stone over to me today.”

translation.text: Then they told Saul, saying, Behold, the people sin against the LORD, in that they eat with the blood. And he said, Ye have transgressed: roll a great stone unto me this day.

verses.english:
When it was reported to Saul that the troops were sinning against
YHWH, eating with the blood, he said, “You have acted faithlessly.
Roll a large stone over to me today.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל פֻּצוּ בָעָם וַאֲמַרְתֶּם לָהֶם הַגִּישׁוּ אֵלַי אִישׁ שׁוֹרוֹ וְאִישׁ שְׂיֵהוּ וּשְׁחַטְתֶּם בָּזֶה וַאֲכַלְתֶּם וְלֹא־תֶחֶטְאוּ לַיהֹוָה לֶאֱכֹל אֶל־הַדָּם
וַיַּגִּשׁוּ כל־הָעָם אִישׁ שׁוֹרוֹ בְיָדוֹ הַלַּיְלָה וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ־שָׁם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל פֻּצוּ בָעָם וַאֲמַרְתֶּם לָהֶם הַגִּישׁוּ אֵלַי אִישׁ שׁוֹרוֹ וְאִישׁ שְׂיֵהוּ וּשְׁחַטְתֶּם בָּזֶה וַאֲכַלְתֶּם וְלֹא־תֶחֶטְאוּ לַיהֹוָה לֶאֱכֹל אֶל־הַדָּם
וַיַּגִּשׁוּ כל־הָעָם אִישׁ שׁוֹרוֹ בְיָדוֹ הַלַּיְלָה וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ־שָׁם׃

english.text:
And Saul ordered, “Spread out among the troops and tell them that
everyone must bring me his ox or his sheep and slaughter it here,
and then eat. You must not sin against YHWH and eat with the
blood.” Every one of the troops brought his own ox with him that
night and slaughtered it there.

translation.text: And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people, and say unto them, Bring me hither every man his ox, and every man his sheep, and slay them here, and eat; and sin not against the LORD in eating with the blood.

verses.english:
And Saul ordered, “Spread out among the troops and tell them that
everyone must bring me his ox or his sheep and slaughter it here,
and then eat. You must not sin against YHWH and eat with the
blood.” Every one of the troops brought his own ox with him that
night and slaughtered it there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן שָׁאוּל מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֹתוֹ הֵחֵל לִבְנוֹת מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן שָׁאוּל מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֹתוֹ הֵחֵל לִבְנוֹת מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Thus Saul set up an altar to YHWH; it was the first altar he
erected to YHWH.

translation.text: And Saul built an altar unto the LORD: the same was the first altar that he built unto the LORD.

verses.english:
Thus Saul set up an altar to YHWH; it was the first altar he
erected to YHWH.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל נֵרְדָה אַחֲרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים לַיְלָה וְנָבֹזָה בָהֶם עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר וְלֹא־נַשְׁאֵר בָּהֶם אִישׁ וַיֹּאמְרוּ כּל־הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ עֲשֵׂהוַיֹּאמֶר הַכֹּהֵן
נִקְרְבָה הֲלֹם אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל נֵרְדָה אַחֲרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים לַיְלָה וְנָבֹזָה בָהֶם עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר וְלֹא־נַשְׁאֵר בָּהֶם אִישׁ וַיֹּאמְרוּ כּל־הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ עֲשֵׂהוַיֹּאמֶר הַכֹּהֵן
נִקְרְבָה הֲלֹם אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
Saul said, “Let us go down after the Philistines by night and
plunder among them until the light of morning; and let us not
leave a single survivor among them.” “Do whatever you please,”
they replied. But the priest said, “Let us approach God here.”

translation.text: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and spoil them until the morning light, and let us not leave a man of them. And they said, Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee. Then said the priest, Let us draw near hither unto God.

verses.english:
Saul said, “Let us go down after the Philistines by night and
plunder among them until the light of morning; and let us not
leave a single survivor among them.” “Do whatever you please,”
they replied. But the priest said, “Let us approach God here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל שָׁאוּל בֵּאלֹהִים הַאֵרֵד אַחֲרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים הֲתִתְּנֵם בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא עָנָהוּ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל שָׁאוּל בֵּאלֹהִים הַאֵרֵד אַחֲרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים הֲתִתְּנֵם בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא עָנָהוּ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

english.text:
So Saul inquired of God, “Shall I go down after the Philistines?
Will You deliver them into the hands of Israel?” But this time He
did not respond to him.

translation.text: And Saul asked counsel of God, Shall I go down after the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel? But he answered him not that day.

verses.english:
So Saul inquired of God, “Shall I go down after the Philistines?
Will You deliver them into the hands of Israel?” But this time He
did not respond to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל גֹּשׁוּ הֲלֹם כֹּל פִּנּוֹת הָעָם וּדְעוּ וּרְאוּ בַּמָּה הָיְתָה הַחַטָּאת הַזֹּאת הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל גֹּשׁוּ הֲלֹם כֹּל פִּנּוֹת הָעָם וּדְעוּ וּרְאוּ בַּמָּה הָיְתָה הַחַטָּאת הַזֹּאת הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
Then Saul said, “Come forward, all chief officers of the troops,
and find out how this guilt was incurred today.

translation.text: And Saul said, Draw ye near hither, all the chief of the people: and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day.

verses.english:
Then Saul said, “Come forward, all chief officers of the troops,
and find out how this guilt was incurred today.

verses.hebrew: כִּי חַי־יְהֹוָה הַמּוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי אִם־יֶשְׁנוֹ בְּיוֹנָתָן בְּנִי כִּי מוֹת יָמוּת וְאֵין עֹנֵהוּ מִכּל־הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי חַי־יְהֹוָה הַמּוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי אִם־יֶשְׁנוֹ בְּיוֹנָתָן בְּנִי כִּי מוֹת יָמוּת וְאֵין עֹנֵהוּ מִכּל־הָעָם׃

english.text:
For as YHWH lives who brings victory to Israel, even if it was
through my son Jonathan, he shall be put to death!” Not one
soldier answered him.

translation.text: For, as the LORD liveth, which saveth Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die. But there was not a man among all the people that answered him.

verses.english:
For as YHWH lives who brings victory to Israel, even if it was
through my son Jonathan, he shall be put to death!” Not one
soldier answered him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ לְעֵבֶר אֶחָד וַאֲנִי וְיוֹנָתָן בְּנִי נִהְיֶה לְעֵבֶר אֶחָד וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעָם אֶל־שָׁאוּל הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ עֲשֵׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ לְעֵבֶר אֶחָד וַאֲנִי וְיוֹנָתָן בְּנִי נִהְיֶה לְעֵבֶר אֶחָד וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעָם אֶל־שָׁאוּל הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ עֲשֵׂה׃

english.text:
And he said to all the Israelites, “You stand on one side, and my
son Jonathan and I shall stand on the other.” The troops said to
Saul, “Do as you please.”

translation.text: Then said he unto all Israel, Be ye on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said unto Saul, Do what seemeth good unto thee.

verses.english:
And he said to all the Israelites, “You stand on one side, and my
son Jonathan and I shall stand on the other.” The troops said to
Saul, “Do as you please.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָבָה תָמִים וַיִּלָּכֵד יוֹנָתָן וְשָׁאוּל וְהָעָם יָצָאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָבָה תָמִים וַיִּלָּכֵד יוֹנָתָן וְשָׁאוּל וְהָעָם יָצָאוּ׃

english.text:
Saul then said to YHWH, the God of Israel, “Show Thammim.”
Jonathan and Saul were indicated by lot, and the troops were
cleared.

translation.text: Therefore Saul said unto the LORD God of Israel, Give a perfect lot.

verses.english:
Saul then said to YHWH, the God of Israel, “Show Thammim.”
Jonathan and Saul were indicated by lot, and the troops were
cleared.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל הַפִּילוּ בֵּינִי וּבֵין יוֹנָתָן בְּנִי וַיִּלָּכֵד יוֹנָתָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל הַפִּילוּ בֵּינִי וּבֵין יוֹנָתָן בְּנִי וַיִּלָּכֵד יוֹנָתָן׃

english.text:
And Saul said, “Cast the lots between my son and me”; and Jonathan
was indicated.

translation.text: And Saul said, Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son. And Jonathan was taken.

verses.english:
And Saul said, “Cast the lots between my son and me”; and Jonathan
was indicated.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־יוֹנָתָן הַגִּידָה לִּי מֶה עָשִׂיתָה וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ יוֹנָתָן וַיֹּאמֶר טָעֹם טָעַמְתִּי בִּקְצֵה הַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר־בְּיָדִי מְעַט דְּבַשׁ הִנְנִי אָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־יוֹנָתָן הַגִּידָה לִּי מֶה עָשִׂיתָה וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ יוֹנָתָן וַיֹּאמֶר טָעֹם טָעַמְתִּי בִּקְצֵה הַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר־בְּיָדִי מְעַט דְּבַשׁ הִנְנִי אָמוּת׃

english.text:
Saul said to Jonathan, “Tell me, what have you done?” And Jonathan
told him, “I only tasted a bit of honey with the tip of the stick
in my hand. I am ready to die.”

translation.text: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done. And Jonathan told him, and said, I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in mine hand, and, lo, I must die.

verses.english:
Saul said to Jonathan, “Tell me, what have you done?” And Jonathan
told him, “I only tasted a bit of honey with the tip of the stick
in my hand. I am ready to die.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל כֹּה־יַעֲשֶׂה אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִף כִּי־מוֹת תָּמוּת יוֹנָתָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל כֹּה־יַעֲשֶׂה אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִף כִּי־מוֹת תָּמוּת יוֹנָתָן׃

english.text:
Saul said, “Thus and more may God do: You shall be put to death,
Jonathan!”

translation.text: And Saul answered, God do so and more also: for thou shalt surely die, Jonathan.

verses.english:
Saul said, “Thus and more may God do: You shall be put to death,
Jonathan!”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם אֶל־שָׁאוּל הֲיוֹנָתָן יָמוּת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הַיְשׁוּעָה הַגְּדוֹלָה הַזֹּאת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל חָלִילָה חַי־יְהֹוָה אִם־יִפֹּל מִשַּׂעֲרַת רֹאשׁוֹ אַרְצָה
כִּי־עִם־אֱלֹהִים עָשָׂה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיִּפְדּוּ הָעָם אֶת־יוֹנָתָן וְלֹא־מֵת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם אֶל־שָׁאוּל הֲיוֹנָתָן יָמוּת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הַיְשׁוּעָה הַגְּדוֹלָה הַזֹּאת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל חָלִילָה חַי־יְהֹוָה אִם־יִפֹּל מִשַּׂעֲרַת רֹאשׁוֹ אַרְצָה
כִּי־עִם־אֱלֹהִים עָשָׂה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיִּפְדּוּ הָעָם אֶת־יוֹנָתָן וְלֹא־מֵת׃

english.text:
But the troops said to Saul, “Shall Jonathan die, after bringing
this great victory to Israel? Never! As YHWH lives, not a hair of
his head shall fall to the ground! For he brought this day to pass
with the help of God.” Thus the troops saved Jonathan and he did
not die.

translation.text: And the people said unto Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel? God forbid: as the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground; for he hath wrought with God this day. So the people rescued Jonathan, that he died not.

verses.english:
But the troops said to Saul, “Shall Jonathan die, after bringing
this great victory to Israel? Never! As YHWH lives, not a hair of
his head shall fall to the ground! For he brought this day to pass
with the help of God.” Thus the troops saved Jonathan and he did
not die.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל שָׁאוּל מֵאַחֲרֵי פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּפְלִשְׁתִּים הָלְכוּ לִמְקוֹמָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל שָׁאוּל מֵאַחֲרֵי פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּפְלִשְׁתִּים הָלְכוּ לִמְקוֹמָם׃

english.text:
Saul broke off his pursuit of the Philistines, and the Philistines
returned to their homes.

translation.text: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines: and the Philistines went to their own place.

verses.english:
Saul broke off his pursuit of the Philistines, and the Philistines
returned to their homes.

verses.hebrew:
וְשָׁאוּל לָכַד הַמְּלוּכָה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּלָּחֶם סָבִיב בְּכל־אֹיְבָיו בְּמוֹאָב וּבִבְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וּבֶאֱדוֹם וּבְמַלְכֵי צוֹבָה וּבַפְּלִשְׁתִּים וּבְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִפְנֶה
יַרְשִׁיעַ׃

hebrew.text:
וְשָׁאוּל לָכַד הַמְּלוּכָה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּלָּחֶם סָבִיב בְּכל־אֹיְבָיו בְּמוֹאָב וּבִבְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וּבֶאֱדוֹם וּבְמַלְכֵי צוֹבָה וּבַפְּלִשְׁתִּים וּבְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִפְנֶה
יַרְשִׁיעַ׃

english.text:
After Saul had secured his kingship over Israel, he waged war on
every side against all his enemies: against the Moabites,
Ammonites, Edomites, the Philistines, and the kings of Zobah; and
wherever he turned he worsted [them].

translation.text: So Saul took the kingdom over Israel, and fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines: and whithersoever he turned himself, he vexed them.

verses.english:
After Saul had secured his kingship over Israel, he waged war on
every side against all his enemies: against the Moabites,
Ammonites, Edomites, the Philistines, and the kings of Zobah; and
wherever he turned he worsted [them].

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ חַיִל וַיַּךְ אֶת־עֲמָלֵק וַיַּצֵּל אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד שֹׁסֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ חַיִל וַיַּךְ אֶת־עֲמָלֵק וַיַּצֵּל אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד שֹׁסֵהוּ׃

english.text:
He was triumphant, defeating the Amalekites and saving Israel from
those who plundered it.

translation.text: And he gathered an host, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them.

verses.english:
He was triumphant, defeating the Amalekites and saving Israel from
those who plundered it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְּנֵי שָׁאוּל יוֹנָתָן וְיִשְׁוִי וּמַלְכִּישׁוּעַ וְשֵׁם שְׁתֵּי בְנֹתָיו שֵׁם הַבְּכִירָה מֵרַב וְשֵׁם הַקְּטַנָּה מִיכַל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ בְּנֵי שָׁאוּל יוֹנָתָן וְיִשְׁוִי וּמַלְכִּישׁוּעַ וְשֵׁם שְׁתֵּי בְנֹתָיו שֵׁם הַבְּכִירָה מֵרַב וְשֵׁם הַקְּטַנָּה מִיכַל׃

english.text:
Saul’s sons were: Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua; and the names
of his two daughters were Merab, the older, and Michal, the
younger.

translation.text: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Ishui, and Melchishua: and the names of his two daughters were these; the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal:

verses.english:
Saul’s sons were: Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua; and the names
of his two daughters were Merab, the older, and Michal, the
younger.

verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם אֵשֶׁת שָׁאוּל אֲחִינֹעַם בַּת־אֲחִימָעַץ וְשֵׁם שַׂר־צְבָאוֹ אֲבִינֵר בֶּן־נֵר דּוֹד שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁם אֵשֶׁת שָׁאוּל אֲחִינֹעַם בַּת־אֲחִימָעַץ וְשֵׁם שַׂר־צְבָאוֹ אֲבִינֵר בֶּן־נֵר דּוֹד שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam daughter of Ahimaaz; and the
name of his army commander was Abiner son of Saul’s uncle Ner.

translation.text: And the name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz: and the name of the captain of his host was Abner, the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.

verses.english:
The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam daughter of Ahimaaz; and the
name of his army commander was Abiner son of Saul’s uncle Ner.

verses.hebrew: וְקִישׁ אֲבִי־שָׁאוּל וְנֵר אֲבִי־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־אֲבִיאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְקִישׁ אֲבִי־שָׁאוּל וְנֵר אֲבִי־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־אֲבִיאֵל׃

english.text: Kish, Saul’s father, and Ner, Abner’s father, were sons of Abiel.

translation.text: And Kish was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.

verses.english: Kish, Saul’s father, and Ner, Abner’s father, were sons of Abiel.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי הַמִּלְחָמָה חֲזָקָה עַל־פְּלִשְׁתִּים כֹּל יְמֵי שָׁאוּל וְרָאָה שָׁאוּל כּל־אִישׁ גִּבּוֹר וְכל־בֶּן־חַיִל וַיַּאַסְפֵהוּ אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי הַמִּלְחָמָה חֲזָקָה עַל־פְּלִשְׁתִּים כֹּל יְמֵי שָׁאוּל וְרָאָה שָׁאוּל כּל־אִישׁ גִּבּוֹר וְכל־בֶּן־חַיִל וַיַּאַסְפֵהוּ אֵלָיו׃

translation.text: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he took him unto him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל אֹתִי שָׁלַח יְהֹוָה לִמְשׁחֳךָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־עַמּוֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַתָּה שְׁמַע לְקוֹל דִּבְרֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל אֹתִי שָׁלַח יְהֹוָה לִמְשׁחֳךָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־עַמּוֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַתָּה שְׁמַע לְקוֹל דִּבְרֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Samuel said to Saul, “I am the one YHWH sent to anoint you king
over His people Israel. Therefore, listen to YHWH’s command!

translation.text: Samuel also said unto Saul, The LORD sent me to anoint thee to be king over his people, over Israel: now therefore hearken thou unto the voice of the words of the LORD.

verses.english:
Samuel said to Saul, “I am the one YHWH sent to anoint you king
over His people Israel. Therefore, listen to YHWH’s command!

verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת פָּקַדְתִּי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה עֲמָלֵק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם לוֹ בַּדֶּרֶךְ בַּעֲלֹתוֹ מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת פָּקַדְתִּי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה עֲמָלֵק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם לוֹ בַּדֶּרֶךְ בַּעֲלֹתוֹ מִמִּצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
“Thus said YHWH of Hosts: I am exacting the penalty for what
Amalek did to Israel, for the assault he made upon them on the
road, on their way up from Egypt.

translation.text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I remember that which Amalek did to Israel, how he laid wait for him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.

verses.english:
“Thus said YHWH of Hosts: I am exacting the penalty for what
Amalek did to Israel, for the assault he made upon them on the
road, on their way up from Egypt.

verses.hebrew:
עַתָּה לֵךְ וְהִכִּיתָה אֶת־עֲמָלֵק וְהַחֲרַמְתֶּם אֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וְלֹא תַחְמֹל עָלָיו וְהֵמַתָּה מֵאִישׁ עַד־אִשָּׁה מֵעֹלֵל וְעַד־יוֹנֵק מִשּׁוֹר וְעַד־שֶׂה מִגָּמָל
וְעַד־חֲמוֹר׃

hebrew.text:
עַתָּה לֵךְ וְהִכִּיתָה אֶת־עֲמָלֵק וְהַחֲרַמְתֶּם אֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וְלֹא תַחְמֹל עָלָיו וְהֵמַתָּה מֵאִישׁ עַד־אִשָּׁה מֵעֹלֵל וְעַד־יוֹנֵק מִשּׁוֹר וְעַד־שֶׂה מִגָּמָל
וְעַד־חֲמוֹר׃

english.text:
Now go, attack Amalek, and proscribe all that belongs to him.
Spare no one, but kill alike men and women, infants and sucklings,
oxen and sheep, camels and asses!”

translation.text: Now go and smite Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and spare them not; but slay both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and ass.

verses.english:
Now go, attack Amalek, and proscribe all that belongs to him.
Spare no one, but kill alike men and women, infants and sucklings,
oxen and sheep, camels and asses!”

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁמַּע שָׁאוּל אֶת־הָעָם וַיִּפְקְדֵם בַּטְּלָאִים מָאתַיִם אֶלֶף רַגְלִי וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אֶת־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁמַּע שָׁאוּל אֶת־הָעָם וַיִּפְקְדֵם בַּטְּלָאִים מָאתַיִם אֶלֶף רַגְלִי וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אֶת־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
Saul mustered the troops and enrolled them at Telaim: 200,000 men
on foot, and 10,000 men of Judah.

translation.text: And Saul gathered the people together, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.

verses.english:
Saul mustered the troops and enrolled them at Telaim: 200,000 men
on foot, and 10,000 men of Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא שָׁאוּל עַד־עִיר עֲמָלֵק וַיָּרֶב בַּנָּחַל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא שָׁאוּל עַד־עִיר עֲמָלֵק וַיָּרֶב בַּנָּחַל׃

english.text:
Then Saul advanced as far as the city of Amalek and lay in wait in
the wadi.

translation.text: And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and laid wait in the valley.

verses.english:
Then Saul advanced as far as the city of Amalek and lay in wait in
the wadi.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־הַקֵּינִי לְכוּ סֻּרוּ רְדוּ מִתּוֹךְ עֲמָלֵקִי פֶּן־אֹסִפְךָ עִמּוֹ וְאַתָּה עָשִׂיתָה חֶסֶד עִם־כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲלוֹתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם וַיָּסַר
קֵינִי מִתּוֹךְ עֲמָלֵק׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־הַקֵּינִי לְכוּ סֻּרוּ רְדוּ מִתּוֹךְ עֲמָלֵקִי פֶּן־אֹסִפְךָ עִמּוֹ וְאַתָּה עָשִׂיתָה חֶסֶד עִם־כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲלוֹתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם וַיָּסַר
קֵינִי מִתּוֹךְ עֲמָלֵק׃

english.text:
Saul said to the Kenites, “Come, withdraw at once from among the
Amalekites, that I may not destroy you along with them; for you
showed kindness to all the Israelites when they left Egypt.” So
the Kenites withdrew from among the Amalekites.

translation.text: And Saul said unto the Kenites, Go, depart, get you down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them: for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel, when they came up out of Egypt. So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

verses.english:
Saul said to the Kenites, “Come, withdraw at once from among the
Amalekites, that I may not destroy you along with them; for you
showed kindness to all the Israelites when they left Egypt.” So
the Kenites withdrew from among the Amalekites.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ שָׁאוּל אֶת־עֲמָלֵק מֵחֲוִילָה בּוֹאֲךָ שׁוּר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּךְ שָׁאוּל אֶת־עֲמָלֵק מֵחֲוִילָה בּוֹאֲךָ שׁוּר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
Saul destroyed Amalek from Havilah all the way to Shur, which is
close to Egypt,

translation.text: And Saul smote the Amalekites from Havilah until thou comest to Shur, that is over against Egypt.

verses.english:
Saul destroyed Amalek from Havilah all the way to Shur, which is
close to Egypt,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְפֹּשׂ אֶת־אֲגַג מֶלֶךְ־עֲמָלֵק חָי וְאֶת־כּל־הָעָם הֶחֱרִים לְפִי־חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְפֹּשׂ אֶת־אֲגַג מֶלֶךְ־עֲמָלֵק חָי וְאֶת־כּל־הָעָם הֶחֱרִים לְפִי־חָרֶב׃

english.text:
and he captured King Agag of Amalek alive. He proscribed all the
people, putting them to the sword;

translation.text: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

verses.english:
and he captured King Agag of Amalek alive. He proscribed all the
people, putting them to the sword;

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּחְמֹל שָׁאוּל וְהָעָם עַל־אֲגָג וְעַל־מֵיטַב הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר וְהַמִּשְׁנִים וְעַל־הַכָּרִים וְעַל־כּל־הַטּוֹב וְלֹא אָבוּ הַחֲרִימָם וְכל־הַמְּלָאכָה נְמִבְזָה וְנָמֵס
אֹתָהּ הֶחֱרִימוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּחְמֹל שָׁאוּל וְהָעָם עַל־אֲגָג וְעַל־מֵיטַב הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר וְהַמִּשְׁנִים וְעַל־הַכָּרִים וְעַל־כּל־הַטּוֹב וְלֹא אָבוּ הַחֲרִימָם וְכל־הַמְּלָאכָה נְמִבְזָה וְנָמֵס
אֹתָהּ הֶחֱרִימוּ׃

english.text:
but Saul and the troops spared Agag and the best of the sheep, the
oxen, the second-born, the lambs, and all else that was of value.
They would not proscribe them; they proscribed only what was cheap
and worthless.

translation.text: But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, and of the oxen, and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all that was good, and would not utterly destroy them: but every thing that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.

verses.english:
but Saul and the troops spared Agag and the best of the sheep, the
oxen, the second-born, the lambs, and all else that was of value.
They would not proscribe them; they proscribed only what was cheap
and worthless.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: The word of YHWH then came to Samuel:

translation.text: Then came the word of the LORD unto Samuel, saying,

verses.english: The word of YHWH then came to Samuel:

verses.hebrew: נִחַמְתִּי כִּי־הִמְלַכְתִּי אֶת־שָׁאוּל לְמֶלֶךְ כִּי־שָׁב מֵאַחֲרַי וְאֶת־דְּבָרַי לֹא הֵקִים וַיִּחַר לִשְׁמוּאֵל וַיִּזְעַק אֶל־יְהֹוָה כּל־הַלָּיְלָה׃

hebrew.text: נִחַמְתִּי כִּי־הִמְלַכְתִּי אֶת־שָׁאוּל לְמֶלֶךְ כִּי־שָׁב מֵאַחֲרַי וְאֶת־דְּבָרַי לֹא הֵקִים וַיִּחַר לִשְׁמוּאֵל וַיִּזְעַק אֶל־יְהֹוָה כּל־הַלָּיְלָה׃

english.text:
“I regret that I made Saul king, for he has turned away from Me
and has not carried out My commands.” Samuel was distressed and he
entreated YHWH all night long.

translation.text: It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be king: for he is turned back from following me, and hath not performed my commandments. And it grieved Samuel; and he cried unto the LORD all night.

verses.english:
“I regret that I made Saul king, for he has turned away from Me
and has not carried out My commands.” Samuel was distressed and he
entreated YHWH all night long.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם שְׁמוּאֵל לִקְרַאת שָׁאוּל בַּבֹּקֶר וַיֻּגַּד לִשְׁמוּאֵל לֵאמֹר בָּא־שָׁאוּל הַכַּרְמֶלָה וְהִנֵּה מַצִּיב לוֹ יָד וַיִּסֹּב וַיַּעֲבֹר וַיֵּרֶד הַגִּלְגָּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם שְׁמוּאֵל לִקְרַאת שָׁאוּל בַּבֹּקֶר וַיֻּגַּד לִשְׁמוּאֵל לֵאמֹר בָּא־שָׁאוּל הַכַּרְמֶלָה וְהִנֵּה מַצִּיב לוֹ יָד וַיִּסֹּב וַיַּעֲבֹר וַיֵּרֶד הַגִּלְגָּל׃

translation.text: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, he set him up a place, and is gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ שָׁאוּל בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה לַיהֹוָה הֲקִימֹתִי אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ שָׁאוּל בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה לַיהֹוָה הֲקִימֹתִי אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
When Samuel came to Saul, Saul said to him, “Blessed are you of
YHWH! I have fulfilled YHWH’s command.”

translation.text: And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said unto him, Blessed be thou of the LORD: I have performed the commandment of the LORD.

verses.english:
When Samuel came to Saul, Saul said to him, “Blessed are you of
YHWH! I have fulfilled YHWH’s command.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל וּמֶה קוֹל־הַצֹּאן הַזֶּה בְּאזְנָי וְקוֹל הַבָּקָר אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי שֹׁמֵעַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל וּמֶה קוֹל־הַצֹּאן הַזֶּה בְּאזְנָי וְקוֹל הַבָּקָר אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי שֹׁמֵעַ׃

english.text:
“Then what,” demanded Samuel, “is this bleating of sheep in my
ears, and the lowing of oxen that I hear?”

translation.text: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?

verses.english:
“Then what,” demanded Samuel, “is this bleating of sheep in my
ears, and the lowing of oxen that I hear?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל מֵעֲמָלֵקִי הֱבִיאוּם אֲשֶׁר חָמַל הָעָם עַל־מֵיטַב הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר לְמַעַן זְבֹחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְאֶת־הַיּוֹתֵר הֶחֱרַמְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל מֵעֲמָלֵקִי הֱבִיאוּם אֲשֶׁר חָמַל הָעָם עַל־מֵיטַב הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר לְמַעַן זְבֹחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְאֶת־הַיּוֹתֵר הֶחֱרַמְנוּ׃

english.text:
Saul answered, “They were brought from the Amalekites, for the
troops spared the choicest of the sheep and oxen for sacrificing
to YHWH your God. And we proscribed the rest.”

translation.text: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.

verses.english:
Saul answered, “They were brought from the Amalekites, for the
troops spared the choicest of the sheep and oxen for sacrificing
to YHWH your God. And we proscribed the rest.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל הֶרֶף וְאַגִּידָה לְּךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי הַלָּיְלָה (ויאמרו) [וַיֹּאמֶר] לוֹ דַּבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל הֶרֶף וְאַגִּידָה לְּךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי הַלָּיְלָה (ויאמרו) [וַיֹּאמֶר] לוֹ דַּבֵּר׃

english.text:
Samuel said to Saul, “Stop! Let me tell you what YHWH said to me
last night!” “Speak,” he replied.

translation.text: Then Samuel said unto Saul, Stay, and I will tell thee what the LORD hath said to me this night. And he said unto him, Say on.

verses.english:
Samuel said to Saul, “Stop! Let me tell you what YHWH said to me
last night!” “Speak,” he replied.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל הֲלוֹא אִם־קָטֹן אַתָּה בְּעֵינֶיךָ רֹאשׁ שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָתָּה וַיִּמְשָׁחֲךָ יְהֹוָה לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל הֲלוֹא אִם־קָטֹן אַתָּה בְּעֵינֶיךָ רֹאשׁ שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָתָּה וַיִּמְשָׁחֲךָ יְהֹוָה לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And Samuel said, “You may look small to yourself, but you are the
head of the tribes of Israel. YHWH anointed you king over Israel,

translation.text: And Samuel said, When thou wast little in thine own sight, wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel, and the LORD anointed thee king over Israel?

verses.english:
And Samuel said, “You may look small to yourself, but you are the
head of the tribes of Israel. YHWH anointed you king over Israel,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלָחֲךָ יְהֹוָה בְּדָרֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר לֵךְ וְהַחֲרַמְתָּה אֶת־הַחַטָּאִים אֶת־עֲמָלֵק וְנִלְחַמְתָּ בוֹ עַד כַּלּוֹתָם אֹתָם׃

and YHWH sent you on a mission, saying, ‘Go and proscribe the
sinful Amalekites; make war on them until you have exterminated
them.’

translation.text: And the LORD sent thee on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.

verses.english:
and YHWH sent you on a mission, saying, ‘Go and proscribe the
sinful Amalekites; make war on them until you have exterminated
them.’

verses.hebrew: וְלָמָּה לֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וַתַּעַט אֶל־הַשָּׁלָל וַתַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Why did you disobey YHWH and swoop down on the spoil in defiance
of YHWH’s will?”

translation.text: Wherefore then didst thou not obey the voice of the LORD, but didst fly upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of the LORD?

verses.english:
Why did you disobey YHWH and swoop down on the spoil in defiance
of YHWH’s will?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתִּי בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וָאֵלֵךְ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־שְׁלָחַנִי יְהֹוָה וָאָבִיא אֶת־אֲגַג מֶלֶךְ עֲמָלֵק וְאֶת־עֲמָלֵק הֶחֱרַמְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתִּי בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וָאֵלֵךְ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־שְׁלָחַנִי יְהֹוָה וָאָבִיא אֶת־אֲגַג מֶלֶךְ עֲמָלֵק וְאֶת־עֲמָלֵק הֶחֱרַמְתִּי׃

english.text:
Saul said to Samuel, “But I did obey YHWH! I performed the mission
on which YHWH sent me: I captured King Agag of Amalek, and I
proscribed Amalek,

translation.text: And Saul said unto Samuel, Yea, I have obeyed the voice of the LORD, and have gone the way which the LORD sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

verses.english:
Saul said to Samuel, “But I did obey YHWH! I performed the mission
on which YHWH sent me: I captured King Agag of Amalek, and I
proscribed Amalek,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח הָעָם מֵהַשָּׁלָל צֹאן וּבָקָר רֵאשִׁית הַחֵרֶם לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּגִּלְגָּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח הָעָם מֵהַשָּׁלָל צֹאן וּבָקָר רֵאשִׁית הַחֵרֶם לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּגִּלְגָּל׃

english.text:
and the troops took from the spoil some sheep and oxen—the best of
what had been proscribed—to sacrifice to YHWH your God at Gilgal.”

translation.text: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God in Gilgal.

verses.english:
and the troops took from the spoil some sheep and oxen—the best of
what had been proscribed—to sacrifice to YHWH your God at Gilgal.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל הַחֵפֶץ לַיהֹוָה בְּעֹלוֹת וּזְבָחִים כִּשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה הִנֵּה שְׁמֹעַ מִזֶּבַח טוֹב לְהַקְשִׁיב מֵחֵלֶב אֵילִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל הַחֵפֶץ לַיהֹוָה בְּעֹלוֹת וּזְבָחִים כִּשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה הִנֵּה שְׁמֹעַ מִזֶּבַח טוֹב לְהַקְשִׁיב מֵחֵלֶב אֵילִים׃

english.text:
But Samuel said: “Does YHWH delight in burnt offerings and
sacrifices As much as in obedience to YHWH’s command? Surely,
obedience is better than sacrifice, Compliance than the fat of
rams.

translation.text: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.

verses.english:
But Samuel said: “Does YHWH delight in burnt offerings and
sacrifices As much as in obedience to YHWH’s command? Surely,
obedience is better than sacrifice, Compliance than the fat of
rams.

verses.hebrew: כִּי חַטַּאת־קֶסֶם מֶרִי וְאָוֶן וּתְרָפִים הַפְצַר יַעַן מָאַסְתָּ אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה וַיִּמְאָסְךָ מִמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי חַטַּאת־קֶסֶם מֶרִי וְאָוֶן וּתְרָפִים הַפְצַר יַעַן מָאַסְתָּ אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה וַיִּמְאָסְךָ מִמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
For rebellion is like the sin of divination, Defiance, like the
iniquity of teraphim. Because you rejected YHWH’s command, He has
rejected you as king.”

translation.text: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, he hath also rejected thee from being king.

verses.english:
For rebellion is like the sin of divination, Defiance, like the
iniquity of teraphim. Because you rejected YHWH’s command, He has
rejected you as king.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל חָטָאתִי כִּי־עָבַרְתִּי אֶת־פִּי־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־דְּבָרֶיךָ כִּי יָרֵאתִי אֶת־הָעָם וָאֶשְׁמַע בְּקוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל חָטָאתִי כִּי־עָבַרְתִּי אֶת־פִּי־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־דְּבָרֶיךָ כִּי יָרֵאתִי אֶת־הָעָם וָאֶשְׁמַע בְּקוֹלָם׃

english.text:
Saul said to Samuel, “I did wrong to transgress YHWH’s command and
your instructions; but I was afraid of the troops and I yielded to
them.

translation.text: And Saul said unto Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD, and thy words: because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.

verses.english:
Saul said to Samuel, “I did wrong to transgress YHWH’s command and
your instructions; but I was afraid of the troops and I yielded to
them.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שָׂא נָא אֶת־חַטָּאתִי וְשׁוּב עִמִּי וְאֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שָׂא נָא אֶת־חַטָּאתִי וְשׁוּב עִמִּי וְאֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Please, forgive my offense and come back with me, and I will bow
low to YHWH.”

translation.text: Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD.

verses.english:
Please, forgive my offense and come back with me, and I will bow
low to YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל לֹא אָשׁוּב עִמָּךְ כִּי מָאַסְתָּה אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה וַיִּמְאָסְךָ יְהֹוָה מִהְיוֹת מֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל לֹא אָשׁוּב עִמָּךְ כִּי מָאַסְתָּה אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה וַיִּמְאָסְךָ יְהֹוָה מִהְיוֹת מֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But Samuel said to Saul, “I will not go back with you; for you
have rejected YHWH’s command, and YHWH has rejected you as king
over Israel.”

translation.text: And Samuel said unto Saul, I will not return with thee: for thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, and the LORD hath rejected thee from being king over Israel.

verses.english:
But Samuel said to Saul, “I will not go back with you; for you
have rejected YHWH’s command, and YHWH has rejected you as king
over Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסֹּב שְׁמוּאֵל לָלֶכֶת וַיַּחֲזֵק בִּכְנַף־מְעִילוֹ וַיִּקָּרַע׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסֹּב שְׁמוּאֵל לָלֶכֶת וַיַּחֲזֵק בִּכְנַף־מְעִילוֹ וַיִּקָּרַע׃

english.text:
As Samuel turned to leave, Saul seized the corner of his robe, and
it tore.

translation.text: And as Samuel turned about to go away, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.

verses.english:
As Samuel turned to leave, Saul seized the corner of his robe, and
it tore.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו שְׁמוּאֵל קָרַע יְהֹוָה אֶת־מַמְלְכוּת יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעָלֶיךָ הַיּוֹם וּנְתָנָהּ לְרֵעֲךָ הַטּוֹב מִמֶּךָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו שְׁמוּאֵל קָרַע יְהֹוָה אֶת־מַמְלְכוּת יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעָלֶיךָ הַיּוֹם וּנְתָנָהּ לְרֵעֲךָ הַטּוֹב מִמֶּךָּ׃

english.text:
And Samuel said to him, “YHWH has this day torn the kingship over
Israel away from you and has given it to another who is worthier
than you.

translation.text: And Samuel said unto him, The LORD hath rent the kingdom of Israel from thee this day, and hath given it to a neighbour of thine, that is better than thou.

verses.english:
And Samuel said to him, “YHWH has this day torn the kingship over
Israel away from you and has given it to another who is worthier
than you.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם נֵצַח יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יְשַׁקֵּר וְלֹא יִנָּחֵם כִּי לֹא אָדָם הוּא לְהִנָּחֵם׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם נֵצַח יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יְשַׁקֵּר וְלֹא יִנָּחֵם כִּי לֹא אָדָם הוּא לְהִנָּחֵם׃

english.text:
Moreover, the Glory of Israel does not deceive or change His mind,
for He is not human that He should change His mind.”

translation.text: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent: for he is not a man, that he should repent.

verses.english:
Moreover, the Glory of Israel does not deceive or change His mind,
for He is not human that He should change His mind.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חָטָאתִי עַתָּה כַּבְּדֵנִי נָא נֶגֶד זִקְנֵי־עַמִּי וְנֶגֶד יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשׁוּב עִמִּי וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֵיתִי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
But [Saul] pleaded, “I did wrong. Please, honor me in the presence
of the elders of my people and in the presence of Israel, and come
back with me until I have bowed low to YHWH your God.”

translation.text: Then he said, I have sinned: yet honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD thy God.

verses.english:
But [Saul] pleaded, “I did wrong. Please, honor me in the presence
of the elders of my people and in the presence of Israel, and come
back with me until I have bowed low to YHWH your God.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב שְׁמוּאֵל אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ שָׁאוּל לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב שְׁמוּאֵל אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ שָׁאוּל לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text: So Samuel followed Saul back, and Saul bowed low to YHWH.

translation.text: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped the LORD.

verses.english: So Samuel followed Saul back, and Saul bowed low to YHWH.

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל הַגִּישׁוּ אֵלַי אֶת־אֲגַג מֶלֶךְ עֲמָלֵק וַיֵּלֶךְ אֵלָיו אֲגַג מַעֲדַנֹּת וַיֹּאמֶר אֲגָג אָכֵן סָר מַר־הַמָּוֶת׃

english.text:
