approached him with faltering steps; and Agag said, “Ah, bitter
death is at hand!”

translation.text: Then said Samuel, Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him delicately. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.

verses.english:
Samuel said, “Bring forward to me King Agag of Amalek.” Agag
approached him with faltering steps; and Agag said, “Ah, bitter
death is at hand!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר שִׁכְּלָה נָשִׁים חַרְבֶּךָ כֵּן־תִּשְׁכַּל מִנָּשִׁים אִמֶּךָ וַיְשַׁסֵּף שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־אֲגָג לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בַּגִּלְגָּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר שִׁכְּלָה נָשִׁים חַרְבֶּךָ כֵּן־תִּשְׁכַּל מִנָּשִׁים אִמֶּךָ וַיְשַׁסֵּף שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־אֲגָג לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בַּגִּלְגָּל׃

english.text:
Samuel said: “As your sword has bereaved women, So shall your
mother be bereaved among women.” And Samuel cut Agag down before
YHWH at Gilgal.

translation.text: And Samuel said, As the sword hath made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.

verses.english:
Samuel said: “As your sword has bereaved women, So shall your
mother be bereaved among women.” And Samuel cut Agag down before
YHWH at Gilgal.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ שְׁמוּאֵל הָרָמָתָה וְשָׁאוּל עָלָה אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ גִּבְעַת שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ שְׁמוּאֵל הָרָמָתָה וְשָׁאוּל עָלָה אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ גִּבְעַת שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
Samuel then departed for Ramah, and Saul went up to his home at
Gibeah of Saul.

translation.text: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

verses.english:
Samuel then departed for Ramah, and Saul went up to his home at
Gibeah of Saul.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יָסַף שְׁמוּאֵל לִרְאוֹת אֶת־שָׁאוּל עַד־יוֹם מוֹתוֹ כִּי־הִתְאַבֵּל שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיהֹוָה נִחָם כִּי־הִמְלִיךְ אֶת־שָׁאוּל עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־יָסַף שְׁמוּאֵל לִרְאוֹת אֶת־שָׁאוּל עַד־יוֹם מוֹתוֹ כִּי־הִתְאַבֵּל שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיהֹוָה נִחָם כִּי־הִמְלִיךְ אֶת־שָׁאוּל עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Samuel never saw Saul again to the day of his death. But Samuel
grieved over Saul, because YHWH regretted that He had made Saul
king over Israel.

translation.text: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death: nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul: and the LORD repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.

verses.english:
Samuel never saw Saul again to the day of his death. But Samuel
grieved over Saul, because YHWH regretted that He had made Saul
king over Israel.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל עַד־מָתַי אַתָּה מִתְאַבֵּל אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַאֲנִי מְאַסְתִּיו מִמְּלֹךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלֵּא קַרְנְךָ שֶׁמֶן וְלֵךְ אֶשְׁלָחֲךָ אֶל־יִשַׁי
בֵּית־הַלַּחְמִי כִּי־רָאִיתִי בְּבָנָיו לִי מֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל עַד־מָתַי אַתָּה מִתְאַבֵּל אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַאֲנִי מְאַסְתִּיו מִמְּלֹךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלֵּא קַרְנְךָ שֶׁמֶן וְלֵךְ אֶשְׁלָחֲךָ אֶל־יִשַׁי
בֵּית־הַלַּחְמִי כִּי־רָאִיתִי בְּבָנָיו לִי מֶלֶךְ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Samuel, “How long will you grieve over Saul,
since I have rejected him as king over Israel? Fill your horn with
oil and set out; I am sending you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I
have decided on one of his sons to be king.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Samuel, How long wilt thou mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? fill thine horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Bethlehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Samuel, “How long will you grieve over Saul,
since I have rejected him as king over Israel? Fill your horn with
oil and set out; I am sending you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I
have decided on one of his sons to be king.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֵיךְ אֵלֵךְ וְשָׁמַע שָׁאוּל וַהֲרָגָנִי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה עֶגְלַת בָּקָר תִּקַּח בְּיָדֶךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה בָּאתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֵיךְ אֵלֵךְ וְשָׁמַע שָׁאוּל וַהֲרָגָנִי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה עֶגְלַת בָּקָר תִּקַּח בְּיָדֶךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה בָּאתִי׃

english.text:
Samuel replied, “How can I go? If Saul hears of it, he will kill
me.” YHWH answered, “Take a heifer with you, and say, ‘I have come
to sacrifice to YHWH.’

translation.text: And Samuel said, How can I go? if Saul hear it, he will kill me. And the LORD said, Take an heifer with thee, and say, I am come to sacrifice to the LORD.

verses.english:
Samuel replied, “How can I go? If Saul hears of it, he will kill
me.” YHWH answered, “Take a heifer with you, and say, ‘I have come
to sacrifice to YHWH.’

verses.hebrew: וְקָרָאתָ לְיִשַׁי בַּזָּבַח וְאָנֹכִי אוֹדִיעֲךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ לִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְקָרָאתָ לְיִשַׁי בַּזָּבַח וְאָנֹכִי אוֹדִיעֲךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ לִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Invite Jesse to the sacrificial feast, and then I will make known
to you what you shall do; you shall anoint for Me the one I point
out to you.”

translation.text: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will shew thee what thou shalt do: and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee.

verses.english:
Invite Jesse to the sacrificial feast, and then I will make known
to you what you shall do; you shall anoint for Me the one I point
out to you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁמוּאֵל אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה וַיָּבֹא בֵּית לָחֶם וַיֶּחֶרְדוּ זִקְנֵי הָעִיר לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלֹם בּוֹאֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁמוּאֵל אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה וַיָּבֹא בֵּית לָחֶם וַיֶּחֶרְדוּ זִקְנֵי הָעִיר לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלֹם בּוֹאֶךָ׃

english.text:
Samuel did what YHWH commanded. When he came to Bethlehem, the
elders of the city went out in alarm to meet him and said, “Do you
come on a peaceful errand?”

translation.text: And Samuel did that which the LORD spake, and came to Bethlehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, Comest thou peaceably?

verses.english:
Samuel did what YHWH commanded. When he came to Bethlehem, the
elders of the city went out in alarm to meet him and said, “Do you
come on a peaceful errand?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה בָּאתִי הִתְקַדְּשׁוּ וּבָאתֶם אִתִּי בַּזָּבַח וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת־יִשַׁי וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא לָהֶם לַזָּבַח׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהֹוָה בָּאתִי הִתְקַדְּשׁוּ וּבָאתֶם אִתִּי בַּזָּבַח וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת־יִשַׁי וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא לָהֶם לַזָּבַח׃

english.text:
“Yes,” he replied, “I have come to sacrifice to YHWH. Purify
yourselves and join me in the sacrificial feast.” He also
instructed Jesse and his sons to purify themselves and invited
them to the sacrificial feast.

translation.text: And he said, Peaceably: I am come to sacrifice unto the LORD: sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice. And he sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

verses.english:
“Yes,” he replied, “I have come to sacrifice to YHWH. Purify
yourselves and join me in the sacrificial feast.” He also
instructed Jesse and his sons to purify themselves and invited
them to the sacrificial feast.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאָם וַיַּרְא אֶת־אֱלִיאָב וַיֹּאמֶר אַךְ נֶגֶד יְהֹוָה מְשִׁיחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאָם וַיַּרְא אֶת־אֱלִיאָב וַיֹּאמֶר אַךְ נֶגֶד יְהֹוָה מְשִׁיחוֹ׃

english.text:
When they arrived and he saw Eliab, he thought: “Surely YHWH’s
anointed stands before Him.”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when they were come, that he looked on Eliab, and said, Surely the LORD’s anointed is before him.

verses.english:
When they arrived and he saw Eliab, he thought: “Surely YHWH’s
anointed stands before Him.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל אַל־תַּבֵּט אֶל־מַרְאֵהוּ וְאֶל־גְּבֹהַּ קוֹמָתוֹ כִּי מְאַסְתִּיהוּ כִּי לֹא אֲשֶׁר יִרְאֶה הָאָדָם כִּי הָאָדָם יִרְאֶה לַעֵינַיִם וַיהֹוָה
יִרְאֶה לַלֵּבָב׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל אַל־תַּבֵּט אֶל־מַרְאֵהוּ וְאֶל־גְּבֹהַּ קוֹמָתוֹ כִּי מְאַסְתִּיהוּ כִּי לֹא אֲשֶׁר יִרְאֶה הָאָדָם כִּי הָאָדָם יִרְאֶה לַעֵינַיִם וַיהֹוָה
יִרְאֶה לַלֵּבָב׃

english.text:
But YHWH said to Samuel, “Pay no attention to his appearance or
his stature, for I have rejected him. For not as man sees [does
YHWH see]; man sees only what is visible, but YHWH sees into the
heart.”

translation.text: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the LORD seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.

verses.english:
But YHWH said to Samuel, “Pay no attention to his appearance or
his stature, for I have rejected him. For not as man sees [does
YHWH see]; man sees only what is visible, but YHWH sees into the
heart.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יִשַׁי אֶל־אֲבִינָדָב וַיַּעֲבִרֵהוּ לִפְנֵי שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־בָּזֶה לֹא־בָחַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יִשַׁי אֶל־אֲבִינָדָב וַיַּעֲבִרֵהוּ לִפְנֵי שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־בָּזֶה לֹא־בָחַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Then Jesse called Abinadab and had him pass before Samuel; but he
said, “YHWH has not chosen this one either.”

translation.text: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.

verses.english:
Then Jesse called Abinadab and had him pass before Samuel; but he
said, “YHWH has not chosen this one either.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֵר יִשַׁי שַׁמָּה וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־בָּזֶה לֹא־בָחַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֵר יִשַׁי שַׁמָּה וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־בָּזֶה לֹא־בָחַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Next Jesse presented Shammah; and again he said, “YHWH has not
chosen this one either.”

translation.text: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.

verses.english:
Next Jesse presented Shammah; and again he said, “YHWH has not
chosen this one either.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֵר יִשַׁי שִׁבְעַת בָּנָיו לִפְנֵי שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יִשַׁי לֹא־בָחַר יְהֹוָה בָּאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֵר יִשַׁי שִׁבְעַת בָּנָיו לִפְנֵי שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יִשַׁי לֹא־בָחַר יְהֹוָה בָּאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
Thus Jesse presented seven of his sons before Samuel, and Samuel
said to Jesse, “YHWH has not chosen any of these.”

translation.text: Again, Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. And Samuel said unto Jesse, The LORD hath not chosen these.

verses.english:
Thus Jesse presented seven of his sons before Samuel, and Samuel
said to Jesse, “YHWH has not chosen any of these.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יִשַׁי הֲתַמּוּ הַנְּעָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר עוֹד שָׁאַר הַקָּטָן וְהִנֵּה רֹעֶה בַּצֹּאן וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יִשַׁי שִׁלְחָה וְקָחֶנּוּ כִּי לֹא־נָסֹב
עַד־בֹּאוֹ פֹה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יִשַׁי הֲתַמּוּ הַנְּעָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר עוֹד שָׁאַר הַקָּטָן וְהִנֵּה רֹעֶה בַּצֹּאן וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יִשַׁי שִׁלְחָה וְקָחֶנּוּ כִּי לֹא־נָסֹב
עַד־בֹּאוֹ פֹה׃

english.text:
Then Samuel asked Jesse, “Are these all the boys you have?” He
replied, “There is still the youngest; he is tending the flock.”
And Samuel said to Jesse, “Send someone to bring him, for we will
not sit down to eat until he gets here.”

translation.text: And Samuel said unto Jesse, Are here all thy children? And he said, There remaineth yet the youngest, and, behold, he keepeth the sheep. And Samuel said unto Jesse, Send and fetch him: for we will not sit down till he come hither.

verses.english:
Then Samuel asked Jesse, “Are these all the boys you have?” He
replied, “There is still the youngest; he is tending the flock.”
And Samuel said to Jesse, “Send someone to bring him, for we will
not sit down to eat until he gets here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיְבִיאֵהוּ וְהוּא אַדְמוֹנִי עִם־יְפֵה עֵינַיִם וְטוֹב רֹאִיוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה קוּם מְשָׁחֵהוּ כִּי־זֶה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיְבִיאֵהוּ וְהוּא אַדְמוֹנִי עִם־יְפֵה עֵינַיִם וְטוֹב רֹאִיוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה קוּם מְשָׁחֵהוּ כִּי־זֶה הוּא׃

english.text:
So they sent and brought him. He was ruddy-cheeked, bright-eyed,
and handsome. And YHWH said, “Rise and anoint him, for this is the
one.”

translation.text: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And the LORD said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.

verses.english:
So they sent and brought him. He was ruddy-cheeked, bright-eyed,
and handsome. And YHWH said, “Rise and anoint him, for this is the
one.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־קֶרֶן הַשֶּׁמֶן וַיִּמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ בְּקֶרֶב אֶחָיו וַתִּצְלַח רוּחַ־יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד מֵהַיּוֹם הַהוּא וָמָעְלָה וַיָּקם שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֵּלֶךְ הָרָמָתָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־קֶרֶן הַשֶּׁמֶן וַיִּמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ בְּקֶרֶב אֶחָיו וַתִּצְלַח רוּחַ־יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד מֵהַיּוֹם הַהוּא וָמָעְלָה וַיָּקם שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֵּלֶךְ הָרָמָתָה׃

english.text:
Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of
his brothers; and the spirit of YHWH gripped David from that day
on. Samuel then set out for Ramah.

translation.text: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the LORD came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.

verses.english:
Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of
his brothers; and the spirit of YHWH gripped David from that day
on. Samuel then set out for Ramah.

verses.hebrew: וְרוּחַ יְהֹוָה סָרָה מֵעִם שָׁאוּל וּבִעֲתַתּוּ רוּחַ־רָעָה מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְרוּחַ יְהֹוָה סָרָה מֵעִם שָׁאוּל וּבִעֲתַתּוּ רוּחַ־רָעָה מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Now the spirit of YHWH had departed from Saul, and an evil spirit
from YHWH began to terrify him.

translation.text: But the Spirit of the LORD departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD troubled him.

verses.english:
Now the spirit of YHWH had departed from Saul, and an evil spirit
from YHWH began to terrify him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי־שָׁאוּל אֵלָיו הִנֵּה־נָא רוּחַ־אֱלֹהִים רָעָה מְבַעִתֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי־שָׁאוּל אֵלָיו הִנֵּה־נָא רוּחַ־אֱלֹהִים רָעָה מְבַעִתֶּךָ׃

english.text:
Saul’s courtiers said to him, “An evil spirit of God is terrifying
you.

translation.text: And Saul’s servants said unto him, Behold now, an evil spirit from God troubleth thee.

verses.english:
Saul’s courtiers said to him, “An evil spirit of God is terrifying
you.

verses.hebrew: יֹאמַר־נָא אֲדֹנֵנוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ לְפָנֶיךָ יְבַקְשׁוּ אִישׁ יֹדֵעַ מְנַגֵּן בַּכִּנּוֹר וְהָיָה בִּהְיוֹת עָלֶיךָ רוּחַ־אֱלֹהִים רָעָה וְנִגֵּן בְּיָדוֹ וְטוֹב לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: יֹאמַר־נָא אֲדֹנֵנוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ לְפָנֶיךָ יְבַקְשׁוּ אִישׁ יֹדֵעַ מְנַגֵּן בַּכִּנּוֹר וְהָיָה בִּהְיוֹת עָלֶיךָ רוּחַ־אֱלֹהִים רָעָה וְנִגֵּן בְּיָדוֹ וְטוֹב לָךְ׃

english.text:
Let our lord give the order [and] the courtiers in attendance on
you will look for someone who is skilled at playing the lyre;
whenever the evil spirit of God comes over you, he will play it
and you will feel better.”

translation.text: Let our lord now command thy servants, which are before thee, to seek out a man, who is a cunning player on an harp: and it shall come to pass, when the evil spirit from God is upon thee, that he shall play with his hand, and thou shalt be well.

verses.english:
Let our lord give the order [and] the courtiers in attendance on
you will look for someone who is skilled at playing the lyre;
whenever the evil spirit of God comes over you, he will play it
and you will feel better.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־עֲבָדָיו רְאוּ־נָא לִי אִישׁ מֵיטִיב לְנַגֵּן וַהֲבִיאוֹתֶם אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־עֲבָדָיו רְאוּ־נָא לִי אִישׁ מֵיטִיב לְנַגֵּן וַהֲבִיאוֹתֶם אֵלָי׃

english.text:
So Saul said to his courtiers, “Find me someone who can play well
and bring him to me.”

translation.text: And Saul said unto his servants, Provide me now a man that can play well, and bring him to me.

verses.english:
So Saul said to his courtiers, “Find me someone who can play well
and bring him to me.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן אֶחָד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה רָאִיתִי בֵּן לְיִשַׁי בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי יֹדֵעַ נַגֵּן וְגִבּוֹר חַיִל וְאִישׁ מִלְחָמָה וּנְבוֹן דָּבָר וְאִישׁ תֹּאַר וַיהֹוָה
עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן אֶחָד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה רָאִיתִי בֵּן לְיִשַׁי בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי יֹדֵעַ נַגֵּן וְגִבּוֹר חַיִל וְאִישׁ מִלְחָמָה וּנְבוֹן דָּבָר וְאִישׁ תֹּאַר וַיהֹוָה
עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
One of the attendants spoke up, “I have observed a son of Jesse
the Bethlehemite who is skilled in music; he is a stalwart fellow
and a warrior, sensible in speech, and handsome in appearance, and
YHWH is with him.”

translation.text: Then answered one of the servants, and said, Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite, that is cunning in playing, and a mighty valiant man, and a man of war, and prudent in matters, and a comely person, and the LORD is with him.

verses.english:
One of the attendants spoke up, “I have observed a son of Jesse
the Bethlehemite who is skilled in music; he is a stalwart fellow
and a warrior, sensible in speech, and handsome in appearance, and
YHWH is with him.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים אֶל־יִשָׁי וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁלְחָה אֵלַי אֶת־דָּוִד בִּנְךָ אֲשֶׁר בַּצֹּאן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים אֶל־יִשָׁי וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁלְחָה אֵלַי אֶת־דָּוִד בִּנְךָ אֲשֶׁר בַּצֹּאן׃

english.text:
Whereupon Saul sent messengers to Jesse to say, “Send me your son
David, who is with the flock.”

translation.text: Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse, and said, Send me David thy son, which is with the sheep.

verses.english:
Whereupon Saul sent messengers to Jesse to say, “Send me your son
David, who is with the flock.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יִשַׁי חֲמוֹר לֶחֶם וְנֹאד יַיִן וּגְדִי עִזִּים אֶחָד וַיִּשְׁלַח בְּיַד־דָּוִד בְּנוֹ אֶל־שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח יִשַׁי חֲמוֹר לֶחֶם וְנֹאד יַיִן וּגְדִי עִזִּים אֶחָד וַיִּשְׁלַח בְּיַד־דָּוִד בְּנוֹ אֶל־שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
Jesse took an ass [laden with] bread, a skin of wine, and a kid,
and sent them to Saul by his son David.

translation.text: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread, and a bottle of wine, and a kid, and sent them by David his son unto Saul.

verses.english:
Jesse took an ass [laden with] bread, a skin of wine, and a kid,
and sent them to Saul by his son David.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיַּעֲמֹד לְפָנָיו וַיֶּאֱהָבֵהוּ מְאֹד וַיְהִי־לוֹ נֹשֵׂא כֵלִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיַּעֲמֹד לְפָנָיו וַיֶּאֱהָבֵהוּ מְאֹד וַיְהִי־לוֹ נֹשֵׂא כֵלִים׃

english.text:
So David came to Saul and entered his service; [Saul] took a
strong liking to him and made him one of his arms-bearers.

translation.text: And David came to Saul, and stood before him: and he loved him greatly; and he became his armourbearer.

verses.english:
So David came to Saul and entered his service; [Saul] took a
strong liking to him and made him one of his arms-bearers.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל אֶל־יִשַׁי לֵאמֹר יַעֲמד־נָא דָוִד לְפָנַי כִּי־מָצָא חֵן בְּעֵינָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל אֶל־יִשַׁי לֵאמֹר יַעֲמד־נָא דָוִד לְפָנַי כִּי־מָצָא חֵן בְּעֵינָי׃

english.text:
Saul sent word to Jesse, “Let David remain in my service, for I am
pleased with him.”

translation.text: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray thee, stand before me; for he hath found favour in my sight.

verses.english:
Saul sent word to Jesse, “Let David remain in my service, for I am
pleased with him.”

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בִּהְיוֹת רוּחַ־אֱלֹהִים אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְלָקַח דָּוִד אֶת־הַכִּנּוֹר וְנִגֵּן בְּיָדוֹ וְרָוַח לְשָׁאוּל וְטוֹב לוֹ וְסָרָה מֵעָלָיו רוּחַ הָרָעָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בִּהְיוֹת רוּחַ־אֱלֹהִים אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְלָקַח דָּוִד אֶת־הַכִּנּוֹר וְנִגֵּן בְּיָדוֹ וְרָוַח לְשָׁאוּל וְטוֹב לוֹ וְסָרָה מֵעָלָיו רוּחַ הָרָעָה׃

english.text:
Whenever the [evil] spirit of God came upon Saul, David would take
the lyre and play it; Saul would find relief and feel better, and
the evil spirit would leave him.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

verses.english:
Whenever the [evil] spirit of God came upon Saul, David would take
the lyre and play it; Saul would find relief and feel better, and
the evil spirit would leave him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּאַסְפוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־מַחֲנֵיהֶם לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיֵּאָסְפוּ שֹׂכֹה אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בֵּין־שׂוֹכֹה וּבֵין־עֲזֵקָה בְּאֶפֶס דַּמִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּאַסְפוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־מַחֲנֵיהֶם לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיֵּאָסְפוּ שֹׂכֹה אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בֵּין־שׂוֹכֹה וּבֵין־עֲזֵקָה בְּאֶפֶס דַּמִּים׃

english.text:
The Philistines assembled their forces for battle; they massed at
Socoh of Judah, and encamped at Ephes-dammim, between Socoh and
Azekah.

translation.text: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle, and were gathered together at Shochoh, which belongeth to Judah, and pitched between Shochoh and Azekah, in Ephesdammim.

verses.english:
The Philistines assembled their forces for battle; they massed at
Socoh of Judah, and encamped at Ephes-dammim, between Socoh and
Azekah.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁאוּל וְאִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶאֶסְפוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעֵמֶק הָאֵלָה וַיַּעַרְכוּ מִלְחָמָה לִקְרַאת פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁאוּל וְאִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶאֶסְפוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעֵמֶק הָאֵלָה וַיַּעַרְכוּ מִלְחָמָה לִקְרַאת פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
Saul and the men of Israel massed and encamped in the valley of
Elah. They drew up their line of battle against the Philistines,

translation.text: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and pitched by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.

verses.english:
Saul and the men of Israel massed and encamped in the valley of
Elah. They drew up their line of battle against the Philistines,

verses.hebrew: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים עֹמְדִים אֶל־הָהָר מִזֶּה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֹמְדִים אֶל־הָהָר מִזֶּה וְהַגַּיְא בֵּינֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים עֹמְדִים אֶל־הָהָר מִזֶּה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֹמְדִים אֶל־הָהָר מִזֶּה וְהַגַּיְא בֵּינֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
with the Philistines stationed on one hill and Israel stationed on
the opposite hill; the ravine was between them.

translation.text: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.

verses.english:
with the Philistines stationed on one hill and Israel stationed on
the opposite hill; the ravine was between them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא אִישׁ־הַבֵּנַיִם מִמַּחֲנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים גּלְיָת שְׁמוֹ מִגַּת גּבְהוֹ שֵׁשׁ אַמּוֹת וָזָרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא אִישׁ־הַבֵּנַיִם מִמַּחֲנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים גּלְיָת שְׁמוֹ מִגַּת גּבְהוֹ שֵׁשׁ אַמּוֹת וָזָרֶת׃

english.text:
A champion of the Philistine forces stepped forward; his name was
Goliath of Gath, and he was six cubits and a span tall.

translation.text: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.

verses.english:
A champion of the Philistine forces stepped forward; his name was
Goliath of Gath, and he was six cubits and a span tall.

verses.hebrew: וְכוֹבַע נְחֹשֶׁת עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וְשִׁרְיוֹן קַשְׂקַשִּׂים הוּא לָבוּשׁ וּמִשְׁקַל הַשִּׁרְיוֹן חֲמֵשֶׁת־אֲלָפִים שְׁקָלִים נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וְכוֹבַע נְחֹשֶׁת עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וְשִׁרְיוֹן קַשְׂקַשִּׂים הוּא לָבוּשׁ וּמִשְׁקַל הַשִּׁרְיוֹן חֲמֵשֶׁת־אֲלָפִים שְׁקָלִים נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
He had a bronze helmet on his head, and wore a breastplate of
scale armor, a bronze breastplate weighing five thousand shekels.

translation.text: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.

verses.english:
He had a bronze helmet on his head, and wore a breastplate of
scale armor, a bronze breastplate weighing five thousand shekels.

verses.hebrew: וּמִצְחַת נְחֹשֶׁת עַל־רַגְלָיו וְכִידוֹן נְחֹשֶׁת בֵּין כְּתֵפָיו׃

hebrew.text: וּמִצְחַת נְחֹשֶׁת עַל־רַגְלָיו וְכִידוֹן נְחֹשֶׁת בֵּין כְּתֵפָיו׃

english.text:
He had bronze greaves on his legs, and a bronze javelin [slung]
from his shoulders.

translation.text: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a target of brass between his shoulders.

verses.english:
He had bronze greaves on his legs, and a bronze javelin [slung]
from his shoulders.

verses.hebrew: (וחץ) [וְעֵץ] חֲנִיתוֹ כִּמְנוֹר אֹרְגִים וְלַהֶבֶת חֲנִיתוֹ שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת שְׁקָלִים בַּרְזֶל וְנֹשֵׂא הַצִּנָּה הֹלֵךְ לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: (וחץ) [וְעֵץ] חֲנִיתוֹ כִּמְנוֹר אֹרְגִים וְלַהֶבֶת חֲנִיתוֹ שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת שְׁקָלִים בַּרְזֶל וְנֹשֵׂא הַצִּנָּה הֹלֵךְ לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
The shaft of his spear was like a weaver’s bar, and the iron head
of his spear weighed six hundred shekels; and the shield-bearer
marched in front of him.

translation.text: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam; and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.

verses.english:
The shaft of his spear was like a weaver’s bar, and the iron head
of his spear weighed six hundred shekels; and the shield-bearer
marched in front of him.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲמֹד וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־מַעַרְכֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לָמָּה תֵצְאוּ לַעֲרֹךְ מִלְחָמָה הֲלוֹא אָנֹכִי הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וְאַתֶּם עֲבָדִים לְשָׁאוּל בְּרוּ־לָכֶם אִישׁ
וְיֵרֵד אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲמֹד וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־מַעַרְכֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לָמָּה תֵצְאוּ לַעֲרֹךְ מִלְחָמָה הֲלוֹא אָנֹכִי הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וְאַתֶּם עֲבָדִים לְשָׁאוּל בְּרוּ־לָכֶם אִישׁ
וְיֵרֵד אֵלָי׃

english.text:
He stopped and called out to the ranks of Israel and he said to
them, “Why should you come out to engage in battle? I am the
Philistine [champion], and you are Saul’s servants. Choose one of
your men and let him come down against me.

translation.text: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel, and said unto them, Why are ye come out to set your battle in array? am not I a Philistine, and ye servants to Saul? choose you a man for you, and let him come down to me.

verses.english:
He stopped and called out to the ranks of Israel and he said to
them, “Why should you come out to engage in battle? I am the
Philistine [champion], and you are Saul’s servants. Choose one of
your men and let him come down against me.

verses.hebrew: אִם־יוּכַל לְהִלָּחֵם אִתִּי וְהִכָּנִי וְהָיִינוּ לָכֶם לַעֲבָדִים וְאִם־אֲנִי אוּכַל־לוֹ וְהִכִּיתִיו וִהְיִיתֶם לָנוּ לַעֲבָדִים וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֹתָנוּ׃

hebrew.text: אִם־יוּכַל לְהִלָּחֵם אִתִּי וְהִכָּנִי וְהָיִינוּ לָכֶם לַעֲבָדִים וְאִם־אֲנִי אוּכַל־לוֹ וְהִכִּיתִיו וִהְיִיתֶם לָנוּ לַעֲבָדִים וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֹתָנוּ׃

translation.text: If he be able to fight with me, and to kill me, then will we be your servants: but if I prevail against him, and kill him, then shall ye be our servants, and serve us.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֲנִי חֵרַפְתִּי אֶת־מַעַרְכוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה תְּנוּ־לִי אִישׁ וְנִלָּחֲמָה יָחַד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֲנִי חֵרַפְתִּי אֶת־מַעַרְכוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה תְּנוּ־לִי אִישׁ וְנִלָּחֲמָה יָחַד׃

english.text:
And the Philistine ended, “I herewith defy the ranks of Israel.
Get me a man and let’s fight it out!”

translation.text: And the Philistine said, I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.

verses.english:
And the Philistine ended, “I herewith defy the ranks of Israel.
Get me a man and let’s fight it out!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע שָׁאוּל וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּחַתּוּ וַיִּרְאוּ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע שָׁאוּל וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּחַתּוּ וַיִּרְאוּ מְאֹד׃

english.text:
When Saul and all Israel heard these words of the Philistine, they
were dismayed and terror-stricken.

translation.text: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.

verses.english:
When Saul and all Israel heard these words of the Philistine, they
were dismayed and terror-stricken.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד בֶּן־אִישׁ אֶפְרָתִי הַזֶּה מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה וּשְׁמוֹ יִשַׁי וְלוֹ שְׁמֹנָה בָנִים וְהָאִישׁ בִּימֵי שָׁאוּל זָקֵן בָּא בַאֲנָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד בֶּן־אִישׁ אֶפְרָתִי הַזֶּה מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה וּשְׁמוֹ יִשַׁי וְלוֹ שְׁמֹנָה בָנִים וְהָאִישׁ בִּימֵי שָׁאוּל זָקֵן בָּא בַאֲנָשִׁים׃

english.text:
David was the son of a certain Ephrathite of Bethlehem in Judah
whose name was Jesse. He had eight sons, and in the days of Saul
the man was already old, advanced in years.

translation.text: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehemjudah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons: and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul.

verses.english:
David was the son of a certain Ephrathite of Bethlehem in Judah
whose name was Jesse. He had eight sons, and in the days of Saul
the man was already old, advanced in years.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת בְּנֵי־יִשַׁי הַגְּדֹלִים הָלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי־שָׁאוּל לַמִּלְחָמָה וְשֵׁם שְׁלֹשֶׁת בָּנָיו אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָה אֱלִיאָב הַבְּכוֹר וּמִשְׁנֵהוּ אֲבִינָדָב
וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁי שַׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת בְּנֵי־יִשַׁי הַגְּדֹלִים הָלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי־שָׁאוּל לַמִּלְחָמָה וְשֵׁם שְׁלֹשֶׁת בָּנָיו אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָה אֱלִיאָב הַבְּכוֹר וּמִשְׁנֵהוּ אֲבִינָדָב
וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁי שַׁמָּה׃

translation.text: And the three eldest sons of Jesse went and followed Saul to the battle: and the names of his three sons that went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next unto him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד הוּא הַקָּטָן וּשְׁלֹשָׁה הַגְּדֹלִים הָלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד הוּא הַקָּטָן וּשְׁלֹשָׁה הַגְּדֹלִים הָלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל׃

english.text: and David was the youngest. The three oldest had followed Saul,

translation.text: And David was the youngest: and the three eldest followed Saul.

verses.english: and David was the youngest. The three oldest had followed Saul,

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד הֹלֵךְ וָשָׁב מֵעַל שָׁאוּל לִרְעוֹת אֶת־צֹאן אָבִיו בֵּית לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד הֹלֵךְ וָשָׁב מֵעַל שָׁאוּל לִרְעוֹת אֶת־צֹאן אָבִיו בֵּית לָחֶם׃

english.text:
and David would go back and forth from attending on Saul to
shepherd his father’s flock at Bethlehem.

translation.text: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.

verses.english:
and David would go back and forth from attending on Saul to
shepherd his father’s flock at Bethlehem.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הַשְׁכֵּם וְהַעֲרֵב וַיִּתְיַצֵּב אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגַּשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הַשְׁכֵּם וְהַעֲרֵב וַיִּתְיַצֵּב אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם׃

english.text:
The Philistine stepped forward morning and evening and took his
stand for forty days.

translation.text: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.

verses.english:
The Philistine stepped forward morning and evening and took his
stand for forty days.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשַׁי לְדָוִד בְּנוֹ קַח־נָא לְאַחֶיךָ אֵיפַת הַקָּלִיא הַזֶּה וַעֲשָׂרָה לֶחֶם הַזֶּה וְהָרֵץ הַמַּחֲנֶה לְאַחֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשַׁי לְדָוִד בְּנוֹ קַח־נָא לְאַחֶיךָ אֵיפַת הַקָּלִיא הַזֶּה וַעֲשָׂרָה לֶחֶם הַזֶּה וְהָרֵץ הַמַּחֲנֶה לְאַחֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Jesse said to his son David, “Take an ephah of this parched corn
and these ten loaves of bread for your brothers, and carry them
quickly to your brothers in camp.

translation.text: And Jesse said unto David his son, Take now for thy brethren an ephah of this parched corn, and these ten loaves, and run to the camp of thy brethren;

verses.english:
Jesse said to his son David, “Take an ephah of this parched corn
and these ten loaves of bread for your brothers, and carry them
quickly to your brothers in camp.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת עֲשֶׂרֶת חֲרִצֵי הֶחָלָב הָאֵלֶּה תָּבִיא לְשַׂר־הָאָלֶף וְאֶת־אַחֶיךָ תִּפְקֹד לְשָׁלוֹם וְאֶת־עֲרֻבָּתָם תִּקָּח׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת עֲשֶׂרֶת חֲרִצֵי הֶחָלָב הָאֵלֶּה תָּבִיא לְשַׂר־הָאָלֶף וְאֶת־אַחֶיךָ תִּפְקֹד לְשָׁלוֹם וְאֶת־עֲרֻבָּתָם תִּקָּח׃

english.text:
Take these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand. Find out
how your brothers are and bring some token from them.”

translation.text: And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand, and look how thy brethren fare, and take their pledge.

verses.english:
Take these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand. Find out
how your brothers are and bring some token from them.”

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁאוּל וְהֵמָּה וְכל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵמֶק הָאֵלָה נִלְחָמִים עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁאוּל וְהֵמָּה וְכל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵמֶק הָאֵלָה נִלְחָמִים עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
Saul and the brothers and all the men of Israel were in the valley
of Elah, in the war against the Philistines.

translation.text: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.

verses.english:
Saul and the brothers and all the men of Israel were in the valley
of Elah, in the war against the Philistines.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּשְׁכֵּם דָּוִד בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּטֹּשׁ אֶת־הַצֹּאן עַל־שֹׁמֵר וַיִּשָּׂא וַיֵּלֶךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ יִשָׁי וַיָּבֹא הַמַּעְגָּלָה וְהַחַיִל הַיֹּצֵא אֶל־הַמַּעֲרָכָה וְהֵרֵעוּ
בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּשְׁכֵּם דָּוִד בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּטֹּשׁ אֶת־הַצֹּאן עַל־שֹׁמֵר וַיִּשָּׂא וַיֵּלֶךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ יִשָׁי וַיָּבֹא הַמַּעְגָּלָה וְהַחַיִל הַיֹּצֵא אֶל־הַמַּעֲרָכָה וְהֵרֵעוּ
בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
Early next morning, David left someone in charge of the flock,
took [the provisions], and set out, as his father Jesse had
instructed him. He reached the barricade as the army was going out
to the battle lines shouting the war cry.

translation.text: And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took, and went, as Jesse had commanded him; and he came to the trench, as the host was going forth to the fight, and shouted for the battle.

verses.english:
Early next morning, David left someone in charge of the flock,
took [the provisions], and set out, as his father Jesse had
instructed him. He reached the barricade as the army was going out
to the battle lines shouting the war cry.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲרֹךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפְלִשְׁתִּים מַעֲרָכָה לִקְרַאת מַעֲרָכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעֲרֹךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפְלִשְׁתִּים מַעֲרָכָה לִקְרַאת מַעֲרָכָה׃

english.text:
Israel and the Philistines drew up their battle lines opposite
each other.

translation.text: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army against army.

verses.english:
Israel and the Philistines drew up their battle lines opposite
each other.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּטֹּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־הַכֵּלִים מֵעָלָיו עַל־יַד שׁוֹמֵר הַכֵּלִים וַיָּרץ הַמַּעֲרָכָה וַיָּבֹא וַיִּשְׁאַל לְאֶחָיו לְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּטֹּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־הַכֵּלִים מֵעָלָיו עַל־יַד שׁוֹמֵר הַכֵּלִים וַיָּרץ הַמַּעֲרָכָה וַיָּבֹא וַיִּשְׁאַל לְאֶחָיו לְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
David left his baggage with the man in charge of the baggage and
ran toward the battle line and went to greet his brothers.

translation.text: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage, and ran into the army, and came and saluted his brethren.

verses.english:
David left his baggage with the man in charge of the baggage and
ran toward the battle line and went to greet his brothers.

verses.hebrew:
וְהוּא מְדַבֵּר עִמָּם וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ הַבֵּנַיִם עוֹלֶה גּלְיָת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי שְׁמוֹ מִגַּת (ממערות) [מִמַּעַרְכוֹת] פְּלִשְׁתִּים

hebrew.text: וְהוּא מְדַבֵּר עִמָּם וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ הַבֵּנַיִם עוֹלֶה גּלְיָת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי שְׁמוֹ מִגַּת (ממערות) [מִמַּעַרְכוֹת] פְּלִשְׁתִּים
וַיְדַבֵּר כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה
וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד׃

english.text:
While he was talking to them, the champion, whose name was
Goliath, the Philistine of Gath, stepped forward from the
Philistine ranks
and spoke the same words as before
and David heard him.

translation.text: And as he talked with them, behold, there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the armies of the Philistines,
and spake according to the same words:
and David heard them.

verses.english:
While he was talking to them, the champion, whose name was
Goliath, the Philistine of Gath, stepped forward from the
Philistine ranks

and spoke the same words as before
and David heard him.
verses.translation: And as he talked with them, behold, there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the armies of the Philistines, and spake according to the same words: and David heard them.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּרְאוֹתָם אֶת־הָאִישׁ וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפָּנָיו וַיִּירְאוּ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּרְאוֹתָם אֶת־הָאִישׁ וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפָּנָיו וַיִּירְאוּ מְאֹד׃

english.text: When the men of Israel saw the man, they fled in terror.

translation.text: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were sore afraid.

verses.english: When the men of Israel saw the man, they fled in terror.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַרְּאִיתֶם הָאִישׁ הָעֹלֶה הַזֶּה כִּי לְחָרֵף אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹלֶה וְהָיָה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יַכֶּנּוּ יַעְשְׁרֶנּוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ עֹשֶׁר גָּדוֹל
וְאֶת־בִּתּוֹ יִתֶּן־לוֹ וְאֵת בֵּית אָבִיו יַעֲשֶׂה חפְשִׁי בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַרְּאִיתֶם הָאִישׁ הָעֹלֶה הַזֶּה כִּי לְחָרֵף אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹלֶה וְהָיָה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יַכֶּנּוּ יַעְשְׁרֶנּוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ עֹשֶׁר גָּדוֹל
וְאֶת־בִּתּוֹ יִתֶּן־לוֹ וְאֵת בֵּית אָבִיו יַעֲשֶׂה חפְשִׁי בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the men of Israel were saying [among themselves], “Do you see
that man coming out? He comes out to defy Israel! The man who
kills him will be rewarded by the king with great riches; he will
also give him his daughter in marriage and grant exemption to his
father’s house in Israel.”

translation.text: And the men of Israel said, Have ye seen this man that is come up? surely to defy Israel is he come up: and it shall be, that the man who killeth him, the king will enrich him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father’s house free in Israel.

verses.english:
And the men of Israel were saying [among themselves], “Do you see
that man coming out? He comes out to defy Israel! The man who
kills him will be rewarded by the king with great riches; he will
also give him his daughter in marriage and grant exemption to his
father’s house in Israel.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הָאֲנָשִׁים הָעֹמְדִים עִמּוֹ לֵאמֹר מַה־יֵּעָשֶׂה לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַכֶּה אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הַלָּז וְהֵסִיר חֶרְפָּה מֵעַל יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי מִי הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי
הֶעָרֵל הַזֶּה כִּי חֵרֵף מַעַרְכוֹת אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הָאֲנָשִׁים הָעֹמְדִים עִמּוֹ לֵאמֹר מַה־יֵּעָשֶׂה לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַכֶּה אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הַלָּז וְהֵסִיר חֶרְפָּה מֵעַל יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי מִי הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי

english.text:
David asked the men standing near him, “What will be done for the
man who kills that Philistine and removes the disgrace from
Israel? Who is that uncircumcised Philistine that he dares defy
the ranks of the living God?”

translation.text: And David spake to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that killeth this Philistine, and taketh away the reproach from Israel? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?

verses.english:
David asked the men standing near him, “What will be done for the
man who kills that Philistine and removes the disgrace from
Israel? Who is that uncircumcised Philistine that he dares defy
the ranks of the living God?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הָעָם כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה לֵאמֹר כֹּה יֵעָשֶׂה לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַכֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הָעָם כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה לֵאמֹר כֹּה יֵעָשֶׂה לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַכֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
The troops told him in the same words what would be done for the
man who killed him.

translation.text: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that killeth him.

verses.english:
The troops told him in the same words what would be done for the
man who killed him.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלִיאָב אָחִיו הַגָּדוֹל בְּדַבְּרוֹ אֶל־הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיִּחַר־אַף אֱלִיאָב בְּדָוִד וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָּה־זֶּה יָרַדְתָּ וְעַל־מִי נָטַשְׁתָּ מְעַט הַצֹּאן הָהֵנָּה
בַּמִּדְבָּר אֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי אֶת־זְדֹנְךָ וְאֵת רֹעַ לְבָבֶךָ כִּי לְמַעַן רְאוֹת הַמִּלְחָמָה יָרָדְתָּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלִיאָב אָחִיו הַגָּדוֹל בְּדַבְּרוֹ אֶל־הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיִּחַר־אַף אֱלִיאָב בְּדָוִד וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָּה־זֶּה יָרַדְתָּ וְעַל־מִי נָטַשְׁתָּ מְעַט הַצֹּאן הָהֵנָּה
בַּמִּדְבָּר אֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי אֶת־זְדֹנְךָ וְאֵת רֹעַ לְבָבֶךָ כִּי לְמַעַן רְאוֹת הַמִּלְחָמָה יָרָדְתָּ׃

english.text:
When Eliab, his oldest brother, heard him speaking to the men,
Eliab became angry with David and said, “Why did you come down
here, and with whom did you leave those few sheep in the
wilderness? I know your impudence and your impertinence: you came
down to watch the fighting!”

translation.text: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men; and Eliab’s anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why camest thou down hither? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know thy pride, and the naughtiness of thine heart; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle.

verses.english:
When Eliab, his oldest brother, heard him speaking to the men,
Eliab became angry with David and said, “Why did you come down
here, and with whom did you leave those few sheep in the
wilderness? I know your impudence and your impertinence: you came
down to watch the fighting!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד מֶה עָשִׂיתִי עָתָּה הֲלוֹא דָּבָר הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד מֶה עָשִׂיתִי עָתָּה הֲלוֹא דָּבָר הוּא׃

english.text: But David replied, “What have I done now? I was only asking!”

translation.text: And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a cause?

verses.english: But David replied, “What have I done now? I was only asking!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסֹּב מֵאֶצְלוֹ אֶל־מוּל אַחֵר וַיֹּאמֶר כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיְשִׁבֻהוּ הָעָם דָּבָר כַּדָּבָר הָרִאשׁוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסֹּב מֵאֶצְלוֹ אֶל־מוּל אַחֵר וַיֹּאמֶר כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיְשִׁבֻהוּ הָעָם דָּבָר כַּדָּבָר הָרִאשׁוֹן׃

english.text:
And he turned away from him toward someone else; he asked the same
question, and the troops gave him the same answer as before.

translation.text: And he turned from him toward another, and spake after the same manner: and the people answered him again after the former manner.

verses.english:
And he turned away from him toward someone else; he asked the same
question, and the troops gave him the same answer as before.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׁמְעוּ הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר דָּוִד וַיַּגִּדוּ לִפְנֵי־שָׁאוּל וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׁמְעוּ הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר דָּוִד וַיַּגִּדוּ לִפְנֵי־שָׁאוּל וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ׃

english.text:
The things David said were overheard and were reported to Saul,
who had him brought over.

translation.text: And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed them before Saul: and he sent for him.

verses.english:
The things David said were overheard and were reported to Saul,
who had him brought over.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל אַל־יִפֹּל לֵב־אָדָם עָלָיו עַבְדְּךָ יֵלֵךְ וְנִלְחַם עִם־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל אַל־יִפֹּל לֵב־אָדָם עָלָיו עַבְדְּךָ יֵלֵךְ וְנִלְחַם עִם־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
David said to Saul, “Let no man’s courage fail him. Your servant
will go and fight that Philistine!”

translation.text: And David said to Saul, Let no man’s heart fail because of him; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine.

verses.english:
David said to Saul, “Let no man’s courage fail him. Your servant
will go and fight that Philistine!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד לֹא תוּכַל לָלֶכֶת אֶל־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הַזֶּה לְהִלָּחֵם עִמּוֹ כִּי־נַעַר אַתָּה וְהוּא אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה מִנְּעֻרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד לֹא תוּכַל לָלֶכֶת אֶל־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הַזֶּה לְהִלָּחֵם עִמּוֹ כִּי־נַעַר אַתָּה וְהוּא אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה מִנְּעֻרָיו׃

english.text:
But Saul said to David, “You cannot go to that Philistine and
fight him; you are only a boy, and he has been a warrior from his
youth!”

translation.text: And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.

verses.english:
But Saul said to David, “You cannot go to that Philistine and
fight him; you are only a boy, and he has been a warrior from his
youth!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל רֹעֶה הָיָה עַבְדְּךָ לְאָבִיו בַּצֹּאן וּבָא הָאֲרִי וְאֶת־הַדּוֹב וְנָשָׂא שֶׂה מֵהָעֵדֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל רֹעֶה הָיָה עַבְדְּךָ לְאָבִיו בַּצֹּאן וּבָא הָאֲרִי וְאֶת־הַדּוֹב וְנָשָׂא שֶׂה מֵהָעֵדֶר׃

english.text:
David replied to Saul, “Your servant has been tending his father’s
sheep, and if a lion or a bear came and carried off an animal from
the flock,

translation.text: And David said unto Saul, Thy servant kept his father’s sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:

verses.english:
David replied to Saul, “Your servant has been tending his father’s
sheep, and if a lion or a bear came and carried off an animal from
the flock,

verses.hebrew: וְיָצָאתִי אַחֲרָיו וְהִכִּתִיו וְהִצַּלְתִּי מִפִּיו וַיָּקם עָלַי וְהֶחֱזַקְתִּי בִּזְקָנוֹ וְהִכִּתִיו וַהֲמִיתִּיו׃

hebrew.text: וְיָצָאתִי אַחֲרָיו וְהִכִּתִיו וְהִצַּלְתִּי מִפִּיו וַיָּקם עָלַי וְהֶחֱזַקְתִּי בִּזְקָנוֹ וְהִכִּתִיו וַהֲמִיתִּיו׃

english.text:
I would go after it and fight it and rescue it from its mouth. And
if it attacked me, I would seize it by the beard and strike it
down and kill it.

translation.text: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.

verses.english:
I would go after it and fight it and rescue it from its mouth. And
if it attacked me, I would seize it by the beard and strike it
down and kill it.

verses.hebrew: גַּם אֶת־הָאֲרִי גַּם־הַדֹּב הִכָּה עַבְדֶּךָ וְהָיָה הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הֶעָרֵל הַזֶּה כְּאַחַד מֵהֶם כִּי חֵרֵף מַעַרְכֹת אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים׃

hebrew.text: גַּם אֶת־הָאֲרִי גַּם־הַדֹּב הִכָּה עַבְדֶּךָ וְהָיָה הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הֶעָרֵל הַזֶּה כְּאַחַד מֵהֶם כִּי חֵרֵף מַעַרְכֹת אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים׃

english.text:
Your servant has killed both lion and bear; and that uncircumcised
Philistine shall end up like one of them, for he has defied the
ranks of the living God.

translation.text: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God.

verses.english:
Your servant has killed both lion and bear; and that uncircumcised
Philistine shall end up like one of them, for he has defied the
ranks of the living God.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הִצִּלַנִי מִיַּד הָאֲרִי וּמִיַּד הַדֹּב הוּא יַצִּילֵנִי מִיַּד הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הַזֶּהוַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד לֵךְ וַיהֹוָה יִהְיֶה עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הִצִּלַנִי מִיַּד הָאֲרִי וּמִיַּד הַדֹּב הוּא יַצִּילֵנִי מִיַּד הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הַזֶּהוַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד לֵךְ וַיהֹוָה יִהְיֶה עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
And David said “YHWH, who saved me from lion and bear will also
save me from that Philistine.” “Then go,” Saul said to David, “and
may YHWH be with you!”

translation.text: David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the LORD be with thee.

verses.english:
And David said “YHWH, who saved me from lion and bear will also
save me from that Philistine.” “Then go,” Saul said to David, “and
may YHWH be with you!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ שָׁאוּל אֶת־דָּוִד מַדָּיו וְנָתַן קוֹבַע נְחֹשֶׁת עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ שִׁרְיוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ שָׁאוּל אֶת־דָּוִד מַדָּיו וְנָתַן קוֹבַע נְחֹשֶׁת עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ שִׁרְיוֹן׃

english.text:
Saul clothed David in his own garment; he placed a bronze helmet
on his head and fastened a breastplate on him.

translation.text: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.

verses.english:
Saul clothed David in his own garment; he placed a bronze helmet
on his head and fastened a breastplate on him.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּחְגֹּר דָּוִד אֶת־חַרְבּוֹ מֵעַל לְמַדָּיו וַיֹּאֶל לָלֶכֶת כִּי לֹא־נִסָּה וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל לֹא אוּכַל לָלֶכֶת בָּאֵלֶּה כִּי לֹא נִסִּיתִי וַיְסִרֵם דָּוִד
מֵעָלָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּחְגֹּר דָּוִד אֶת־חַרְבּוֹ מֵעַל לְמַדָּיו וַיֹּאֶל לָלֶכֶת כִּי לֹא־נִסָּה וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל לֹא אוּכַל לָלֶכֶת בָּאֵלֶּה כִּי לֹא נִסִּיתִי וַיְסִרֵם דָּוִד
מֵעָלָיו׃

translation.text: And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off him.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח מַקְלוֹ בְּיָדוֹ וַיִּבְחַר־לוֹ חֲמִשָּׁה חַלֻּקֵי־אֲבָנִים מִן־הַנַּחַל וַיָּשֶׂם אֹתָם בִּכְלִי הָרֹעִים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וּבַיַּלְקוּט וְקַלְעוֹ בְיָדוֹ וַיִּגַּשׁ

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח מַקְלוֹ בְּיָדוֹ וַיִּבְחַר־לוֹ חֲמִשָּׁה חַלֻּקֵי־אֲבָנִים מִן־הַנַּחַל וַיָּשֶׂם אֹתָם בִּכְלִי הָרֹעִים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וּבַיַּלְקוּט וְקַלְעוֹ בְיָדוֹ וַיִּגַּשׁ
אֶל־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי׃

english.text:
He took his stick, picked a few smooth stones from the wadi, put
them in the pocket of his shepherd’s bag and, sling in hand, he
went toward the Philistine.

translation.text: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd’s bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.

verses.english:
He took his stick, picked a few smooth stones from the wadi, put
them in the pocket of his shepherd’s bag and, sling in hand, he
went toward the Philistine.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הֹלֵךְ וְקָרֵב אֶל־דָּוִד וְהָאִישׁ נֹשֵׂא הַצִּנָּה לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הֹלֵךְ וְקָרֵב אֶל־דָּוִד וְהָאִישׁ נֹשֵׂא הַצִּנָּה לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
The Philistine, meanwhile, was coming closer to David, preceded by
his shield-bearer.

translation.text: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield went before him.

verses.english:
The Philistine, meanwhile, was coming closer to David, preceded by
his shield-bearer.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּבֵּט הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיִּרְאֶה אֶת־דָּוִד וַיִּבְזֵהוּ כִּי־הָיָה נַעַר וְאַדְמֹנִי עִם־יְפֵה מַרְאֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּבֵּט הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיִּרְאֶה אֶת־דָּוִד וַיִּבְזֵהוּ כִּי־הָיָה נַעַר וְאַדְמֹנִי עִם־יְפֵה מַרְאֶה׃

english.text:
When the Philistine caught sight of David, he scorned him, for he
was but a boy, ruddy and handsome.

translation.text: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.

verses.english:
When the Philistine caught sight of David, he scorned him, for he
was but a boy, ruddy and handsome.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֶל־דָּוִד הֲכֶלֶב אָנֹכִי כִּי־אַתָּה בָא־אֵלַי בַּמַּקְלוֹת וַיְקַלֵּל הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֶת־דָּוִד בֵּאלֹהָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֶל־דָּוִד הֲכֶלֶב אָנֹכִי כִּי־אַתָּה בָא־אֵלַי בַּמַּקְלוֹת וַיְקַלֵּל הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֶת־דָּוִד בֵּאלֹהָיו׃

english.text:
And the Philistine called out to David, “Am I a dog that you come
against me with sticks?” The Philistine cursed David by his gods;

translation.text: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.

verses.english:
And the Philistine called out to David, “Am I a dog that you come
against me with sticks?” The Philistine cursed David by his gods;

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֶל־דָּוִד לְכָה אֵלַי וְאֶתְּנָה אֶת־בְּשָׂרְךָ לְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְבֶהֱמַת הַשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֶל־דָּוִד לְכָה אֵלַי וְאֶתְּנָה אֶת־בְּשָׂרְךָ לְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְבֶהֱמַת הַשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
and the Philistine said to David, “Come here, and I will give your
flesh to the birds of the sky and the beasts of the field.”

translation.text: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field.

verses.english:
and the Philistine said to David, “Come here, and I will give your
flesh to the birds of the sky and the beasts of the field.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אַתָּה בָּא אֵלַי בְּחֶרֶב וּבַחֲנִית וּבְכִידוֹן וְאָנֹכִי בָא־אֵלֶיךָ בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי מַעַרְכוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר חֵרַפְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אַתָּה בָּא אֵלַי בְּחֶרֶב וּבַחֲנִית וּבְכִידוֹן וְאָנֹכִי בָא־אֵלֶיךָ בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי מַעַרְכוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר חֵרַפְתָּ׃

english.text:
David replied to the Philistine, “You come against me with sword
and spear and javelin; but I come against you in the name of YHWH
of Hosts, the God of the ranks of Israel, whom you have defied.

translation.text: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.

verses.english:
David replied to the Philistine, “You come against me with sword
and spear and javelin; but I come against you in the name of YHWH
of Hosts, the God of the ranks of Israel, whom you have defied.

verses.hebrew:
הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְסַגֶּרְךָ יְהֹוָה בְּיָדִי וְהִכִּיתִךָ וַהֲסִרֹתִי אֶת־רֹאשְׁךָ מֵעָלֶיךָ וְנָתַתִּי פֶּגֶר מַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְחַיַּת
הָאָרֶץ וְיֵדְעוּ כּל־הָאָרֶץ כִּי יֵשׁ אֱלֹהִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְסַגֶּרְךָ יְהֹוָה בְּיָדִי וְהִכִּיתִךָ וַהֲסִרֹתִי אֶת־רֹאשְׁךָ מֵעָלֶיךָ וְנָתַתִּי פֶּגֶר מַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְחַיַּת
הָאָרֶץ וְיֵדְעוּ כּל־הָאָרֶץ כִּי יֵשׁ אֱלֹהִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
This very day YHWH will deliver you into my hands. I will kill you
and cut off your head; and I will give the carcasses of the
Philistine camp to the birds of the sky and the beasts of the
earth. All the earth shall know that there is a God in Israel.

translation.text: This day will the LORD deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee, and take thine head from thee; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.

verses.english:
This very day YHWH will deliver you into my hands. I will kill you
and cut off your head; and I will give the carcasses of the
Philistine camp to the birds of the sky and the beasts of the
earth. All the earth shall know that there is a God in Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְיֵדְעוּ כּל־הַקָּהָל הַזֶּה כִּי־לֹא בְּחֶרֶב וּבַחֲנִית יְהוֹשִׁיעַ יְהֹוָה כִּי לַיהֹוָה הַמִּלְחָמָה וְנָתַן אֶתְכֶם בְּיָדֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְיֵדְעוּ כּל־הַקָּהָל הַזֶּה כִּי־לֹא בְּחֶרֶב וּבַחֲנִית יְהוֹשִׁיעַ יְהֹוָה כִּי לַיהֹוָה הַמִּלְחָמָה וְנָתַן אֶתְכֶם בְּיָדֵנוּ׃

english.text:
And this whole assembly shall know that YHWH can give victory
without sword or spear. For the battle is YHWH’s, and He will
deliver you into our hands.”

translation.text: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD’s, and he will give you into our hands.

verses.english:
And this whole assembly shall know that YHWH can give victory
without sword or spear. For the battle is YHWH’s, and He will
deliver you into our hands.”

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי־קָם הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרַב לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וַיְמַהֵר דָּוִד וַיָּרץ הַמַּעֲרָכָה לִקְרַאת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי־קָם הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרַב לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וַיְמַהֵר דָּוִד וַיָּרץ הַמַּעֲרָכָה לִקְרַאת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי׃

english.text:
When the Philistine began to advance toward him again, David
quickly ran up to the battle line to face the Philistine.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came, and drew nigh to meet David, that David hastened, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.

verses.english:
When the Philistine began to advance toward him again, David
quickly ran up to the battle line to face the Philistine.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶת־יָדוֹ אֶל־הַכֶּלִי וַיִּקַּח מִשָּׁם אֶבֶן וַיְקַלַּע וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֶל־מִצְחוֹ וַתִּטְבַּע הָאֶבֶן בְּמִצְחוֹ וַיִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנָיו אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶת־יָדוֹ אֶל־הַכֶּלִי וַיִּקַּח מִשָּׁם אֶבֶן וַיְקַלַּע וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֶל־מִצְחוֹ וַתִּטְבַּע הָאֶבֶן בְּמִצְחוֹ וַיִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנָיו אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
David put his hand into the bag; he took out a stone and slung it.
It struck the Philistine in the forehead; the stone sank into his
forehead, and he fell face down on the ground.

translation.text: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.

verses.english:
David put his hand into the bag; he took out a stone and slung it.
It struck the Philistine in the forehead; the stone sank into his
forehead, and he fell face down on the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחֱזַק דָּוִד מִן־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי בַּקֶּלַע וּבָאֶבֶן וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיְמִתֵהוּ וְחֶרֶב אֵין בְּיַד־דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּחֱזַק דָּוִד מִן־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי בַּקֶּלַע וּבָאֶבֶן וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיְמִתֵהוּ וְחֶרֶב אֵין בְּיַד־דָּוִד׃

english.text:
Thus David bested the Philistine with sling and stone; he struck
him down and killed him. David had no sword;

translation.text: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.

verses.english:
Thus David bested the Philistine with sling and stone; he struck
him down and killed him. David had no sword;

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּרץ דָּוִד וַיַּעֲמֹד אֶל־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיִּקַּח אֶת־חַרְבּוֹ וַיִּשְׁלְפָהּ מִתַּעְרָהּ וַיְמֹתְתֵהוּ וַיִּכְרת־בָּהּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּרְאוּ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי־מֵת
גִּבּוֹרָם וַיָּנֻסוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּרץ דָּוִד וַיַּעֲמֹד אֶל־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיִּקַּח אֶת־חַרְבּוֹ וַיִּשְׁלְפָהּ מִתַּעְרָהּ וַיְמֹתְתֵהוּ וַיִּכְרת־בָּהּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּרְאוּ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי־מֵת
גִּבּוֹרָם וַיָּנֻסוּ׃

english.text:
so David ran up and stood over the Philistine, grasped his sword
and pulled it from its sheath; and with it he dispatched him and
cut off his head. When the Philistines saw that their warrior was
dead, they ran.

translation.text: Therefore David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of the sheath thereof, and slew him, and cut off his head therewith. And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead, they fled.

verses.english:
so David ran up and stood over the Philistine, grasped his sword
and pulled it from its sheath; and with it he dispatched him and
cut off his head. When the Philistines saw that their warrior was
dead, they ran.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקֻמוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה וַיָּרִעוּ וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים עַד־בּוֹאֲךָ גַיְא וְעַד שַׁעֲרֵי עֶקְרוֹן וַיִּפְּלוּ חַלְלֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים בְּדֶרֶךְ
שַׁעֲרַיִם וְעַד־גַּת וְעַד־עֶקְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקֻמוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה וַיָּרִעוּ וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים עַד־בּוֹאֲךָ גַיְא וְעַד שַׁעֲרֵי עֶקְרוֹן וַיִּפְּלוּ חַלְלֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים בְּדֶרֶךְ
שַׁעֲרַיִם וְעַד־גַּת וְעַד־עֶקְרוֹן׃

english.text:
The men of Israel and Judah rose up with a war cry and they
pursued the Philistines all the way to Gai and up to the gates of
Ekron; the Philistines fell mortally wounded along the road to
Shaarim up to Gath and Ekron.

translation.text: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, until thou come to the valley, and to the gates of Ekron.

verses.english:
The men of Israel and Judah rose up with a war cry and they
pursued the Philistines all the way to Gai and up to the gates of
Ekron; the Philistines fell mortally wounded along the road to
Shaarim up to Gath and Ekron.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִדְּלֹק אַחֲרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיָּשֹׁסּוּ אֶת־מַחֲנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִדְּלֹק אַחֲרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיָּשֹׁסּוּ אֶת־מַחֲנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Then the Israelites returned from chasing the Philistines and
looted their camp.

translation.text: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they spoiled their tents.

verses.english:
Then the Israelites returned from chasing the Philistines and
looted their camp.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־רֹאשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיְבִאֵהוּ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְאֶת־כֵּלָיו שָׂם בְּאהֳלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־רֹאשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיְבִאֵהוּ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְאֶת־כֵּלָיו שָׂם בְּאהֳלוֹ׃

english.text:
David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem;
and he put his weapons in his own tent.

translation.text: And David took the head of the Philistine, and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armour in his tent.

verses.english:
David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem;
and he put his weapons in his own tent.

verses.hebrew: וְכִרְאוֹת שָׁאוּל אֶת־דָּוִד יֹצֵא לִקְרַאת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אָמַר אֶל־אַבְנֵר שַׂר הַצָּבָא בֶּן־מִי־זֶה הַנַּעַר אַבְנֵר וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְנֵר חֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־יָדָעְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְכִרְאוֹת שָׁאוּל אֶת־דָּוִד יֹצֵא לִקְרַאת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אָמַר אֶל־אַבְנֵר שַׂר הַצָּבָא בֶּן־מִי־זֶה הַנַּעַר אַבְנֵר וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְנֵר חֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־יָדָעְתִּי׃

english.text:
When Saul saw David going out to assault the Philistine, he asked
his army commander Abner, “Whose son is that boy, Abner?” And
Abner replied, “By your life, Your Majesty, I do not know.”

translation.text: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said unto Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose son is this youth? And Abner said, As thy soul liveth, O king, I cannot tell.

verses.english:
When Saul saw David going out to assault the Philistine, he asked
his army commander Abner, “Whose son is that boy, Abner?” And
Abner replied, “By your life, Your Majesty, I do not know.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁאַל אַתָּה בֶּן־מִי־זֶה הָעָלֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁאַל אַתָּה בֶּן־מִי־זֶה הָעָלֶם׃

english.text: “Then find out whose son that young fellow is,” the king ordered.

translation.text: And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the stripling is.

verses.english: “Then find out whose son that young fellow is,” the king ordered.

verses.hebrew: וּכְשׁוּב דָּוִד מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיִּקַּח אֹתוֹ אַבְנֵר וַיְבִאֵהוּ לִפְנֵי שָׁאוּל וְרֹאשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּכְשׁוּב דָּוִד מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיִּקַּח אֹתוֹ אַבְנֵר וַיְבִאֵהוּ לִפְנֵי שָׁאוּל וְרֹאשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
So when David returned after killing the Philistine, Abner took
him and brought him to Saul, with the head of the Philistine still
in his hand.

translation.text: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him, and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

verses.english:
So when David returned after killing the Philistine, Abner took
him and brought him to Saul, with the head of the Philistine still
in his hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו שָׁאוּל בֶּן־מִי אַתָּה הַנָּעַר וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד בֶּן־עַבְדְּךָ יִשַׁי בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו שָׁאוּל בֶּן־מִי אַתָּה הַנָּעַר וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד בֶּן־עַבְדְּךָ יִשַׁי בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי׃

english.text:
Saul said to him, “Whose son are you, my boy?” And David answered,
“The son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.”

translation.text: And Saul said to him, Whose son art thou, thou young man? And David answered, I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.

verses.english:
Saul said to him, “Whose son are you, my boy?” And David answered,
“The son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְנֶפֶשׁ יְהוֹנָתָן נִקְשְׁרָה בְּנֶפֶשׁ דָּוִד (ויאהבו) [וַיֶּאֱהָבֵהוּ] יְהוֹנָתָן כְּנַפְשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְנֶפֶשׁ יְהוֹנָתָן נִקְשְׁרָה בְּנֶפֶשׁ דָּוִד (ויאהבו) [וַיֶּאֱהָבֵהוּ] יְהוֹנָתָן כְּנַפְשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
When [David] finished speaking with Saul, Jonathan’s soul became
bound up with the soul of David; Jonathan loved David as himself.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

verses.english:
When [David] finished speaking with Saul, Jonathan’s soul became
bound up with the soul of David; Jonathan loved David as himself.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ שָׁאוּל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְלֹא נְתָנוֹ לָשׁוּב בֵּית אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ שָׁאוּל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְלֹא נְתָנוֹ לָשׁוּב בֵּית אָבִיו׃

english.text:
Saul took him [into his service] that day and would not let him
return to his father’s house.—

translation.text: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father’s house.

verses.english:
Saul took him [into his service] that day and would not let him
return to his father’s house.—

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹנָתָן וְדָוִד בְּרִית בְּאַהֲבָתוֹ אֹתוֹ כְּנַפְשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹנָתָן וְדָוִד בְּרִית בְּאַהֲבָתוֹ אֹתוֹ כְּנַפְשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
Jonathan and David made a pact, because [Jonathan] loved him as
himself.

translation.text: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

verses.english:
Jonathan and David made a pact, because [Jonathan] loved him as
himself.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְפַּשֵּׁט יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־הַמְּעִיל אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ לְדָוִד וּמַדָּיו וְעַד־חַרְבּוֹ וְעַד־קַשְׁתּוֹ וְעַד־חֲגֹרוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְפַּשֵּׁט יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־הַמְּעִיל אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ לְדָוִד וּמַדָּיו וְעַד־חַרְבּוֹ וְעַד־קַשְׁתּוֹ וְעַד־חֲגֹרוֹ׃

english.text:
Jonathan took off the cloak and tunic he was wearing and gave them
to David, together with his sword, bow, and belt.

translation.text: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.

verses.english:
Jonathan took off the cloak and tunic he was wearing and gave them
to David, together with his sword, bow, and belt.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא דָוִד בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁלָחֶנּוּ שָׁאוּל יַשְׂכִּיל וַיְשִׂמֵהוּ שָׁאוּל עַל אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵי כל־הָעָם וְגַם בְּעֵינֵי עַבְדֵי שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא דָוִד בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁלָחֶנּוּ שָׁאוּל יַשְׂכִּיל וַיְשִׂמֵהוּ שָׁאוּל עַל אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵי כל־הָעָם וְגַם בְּעֵינֵי עַבְדֵי שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
David went out [with the troops], and he was successful in every
mission on which Saul sent him, and Saul put him in command of all
the soldiers; this pleased all the troops and Saul’s courtiers as
well.

translation.text: And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.

verses.english:
David went out [with the troops], and he was successful in every
mission on which Saul sent him, and Saul put him in command of all
the soldiers; this pleased all the troops and Saul’s courtiers as
well.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאָם בְּשׁוּב דָּוִד מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַתֵּצֶאנָה הַנָּשִׁים מִכּל־עָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל (לשור) [לָשִׁיר] וְהַמְּחֹלוֹת לִקְרַאת שָׁאוּל הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּתֻפִּים
בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְשָׁלִשִׁים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאָם בְּשׁוּב דָּוִד מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַתֵּצֶאנָה הַנָּשִׁים מִכּל־עָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל (לשור) [לָשִׁיר] וְהַמְּחֹלוֹת לִקְרַאת שָׁאוּל הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּתֻפִּים
בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְשָׁלִשִׁים׃

english.text:
When the [troops] came home [and] David returned from killing the
Philistine, the women of all the towns of Israel came out singing
and dancing to greet King Saul with timbrels, shouting, and
sistrums.

translation.text: And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick.

verses.english:
When the [troops] came home [and] David returned from killing the
Philistine, the women of all the towns of Israel came out singing
and dancing to greet King Saul with timbrels, shouting, and
sistrums.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲנֶינָה הַנָּשִׁים הַמְשַׂחֲקוֹת וַתֹּאמַרְןָ הִכָּה שָׁאוּל בַּאֲלָפָו וְדָוִד בְּרִבְבֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעֲנֶינָה הַנָּשִׁים הַמְשַׂחֲקוֹת וַתֹּאמַרְןָ הִכָּה שָׁאוּל בַּאֲלָפָו וְדָוִד בְּרִבְבֹתָיו׃

english.text:
The women sang as they danced, and they chanted: Saul has slain
his thousands; David, his tens of thousands!

translation.text: And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.

verses.english:
The women sang as they danced, and they chanted: Saul has slain
his thousands; David, his tens of thousands!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר לְשָׁאוּל מְאֹד וַיֵּרַע בְּעֵינָיו הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר נָתְנוּ לְדָוִד רְבָבוֹת וְלִי נָתְנוּ הָאֲלָפִים וְעוֹד לוֹ אַךְ הַמְּלוּכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר לְשָׁאוּל מְאֹד וַיֵּרַע בְּעֵינָיו הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר נָתְנוּ לְדָוִד רְבָבוֹת וְלִי נָתְנוּ הָאֲלָפִים וְעוֹד לוֹ אַךְ הַמְּלוּכָה׃

english.text:
Saul was much distressed and greatly vexed about the matter. For
he said, “To David they have given tens of thousands, and to me
they have given thousands. All that he lacks is the kingship!”

translation.text: And Saul was very wroth, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom?

verses.english:
Saul was much distressed and greatly vexed about the matter. For
he said, “To David they have given tens of thousands, and to me
they have given thousands. All that he lacks is the kingship!”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי שָׁאוּל (עון) [עוֹיֵן] אֶת־דָּוִד מֵהַיּוֹם הַהוּא וָהָלְאָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי שָׁאוּל (עון) [עוֹיֵן] אֶת־דָּוִד מֵהַיּוֹם הַהוּא וָהָלְאָה׃

english.text: From that day on Saul kept a jealous eye on David.

translation.text: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.

verses.english: From that day on Saul kept a jealous eye on David.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַתִּצְלַח רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים רָעָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיִּתְנַבֵּא בְתוֹךְ־הַבַּיִת וְדָוִד מְנַגֵּן בְּיָדוֹ כְּיוֹם בְּיוֹם וְהַחֲנִית בְּיַד־שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַתִּצְלַח רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים רָעָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיִּתְנַבֵּא בְתוֹךְ־הַבַּיִת וְדָוִד מְנַגֵּן בְּיָדוֹ כְּיוֹם בְּיוֹם וְהַחֲנִית בְּיַד־שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
The next day an evil spirit of God gripped Saul and he began to
rave in the house, while David was playing [the lyre], as he did
daily. Saul had a spear in his hand,

translation.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house: and David played with his hand, as at other times: and there was a javelin in Saul’s hand.

verses.english:
The next day an evil spirit of God gripped Saul and he began to
rave in the house, while David was playing [the lyre], as he did
daily. Saul had a spear in his hand,

verses.hebrew: וַיָּטֶל שָׁאוּל אֶת־הַחֲנִית וַיֹּאמֶר אַכֶּה בְדָוִד וּבַקִּיר וַיִּסֹּב דָּוִד מִפָּנָיו פַּעֲמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּטֶל שָׁאוּל אֶת־הַחֲנִית וַיֹּאמֶר אַכֶּה בְדָוִד וּבַקִּיר וַיִּסֹּב דָּוִד מִפָּנָיו פַּעֲמָיִם׃

english.text:
and Saul threw the spear, thinking to pin David to the wall. But
David eluded him twice.

translation.text: And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it. And David avoided out of his presence twice.

verses.english:
and Saul threw the spear, thinking to pin David to the wall. But
David eluded him twice.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרָא שָׁאוּל מִלִּפְנֵי דָוִד כִּי־הָיָה יְהֹוָה עִמּוֹ וּמֵעִם שָׁאוּל סָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרָא שָׁאוּל מִלִּפְנֵי דָוִד כִּי־הָיָה יְהֹוָה עִמּוֹ וּמֵעִם שָׁאוּל סָר׃

english.text:
Saul was afraid of David, for YHWH was with him and had turned
away from Saul.

translation.text: And Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him, and was departed from Saul.

verses.english:
Saul was afraid of David, for YHWH was with him and had turned
away from Saul.

verses.hebrew: וַיְסִרֵהוּ שָׁאוּל מֵעִמּוֹ וַיְשִׂמֵהוּ לוֹ שַׂר־אָלֶף וַיֵּצֵא וַיָּבֹא לִפְנֵי הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְסִרֵהוּ שָׁאוּל מֵעִמּוֹ וַיְשִׂמֵהוּ לוֹ שַׂר־אָלֶף וַיֵּצֵא וַיָּבֹא לִפְנֵי הָעָם׃

english.text:
So Saul removed him from his presence and appointed him chief of a
thousand, to march at the head of the troops.

translation.text: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.

verses.english:
So Saul removed him from his presence and appointed him chief of a
thousand, to march at the head of the troops.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דָוִד לְכל־דְּרָכָו מַשְׂכִּיל וַיהֹוָה עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דָוִד לְכל־דְּרָכָו מַשְׂכִּיל וַיהֹוָה עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
David was successful in all his undertakings, for YHWH was with
him;

translation.text: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the LORD was with him.

verses.english:
David was successful in all his undertakings, for YHWH was with
him;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר־הוּא מַשְׂכִּיל מְאֹד וַיָּגר מִפָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר־הוּא מַשְׂכִּיל מְאֹד וַיָּגר מִפָּנָיו׃

english.text: and when Saul saw that he was successful, he dreaded him.

translation.text: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.

verses.english: and when Saul saw that he was successful, he dreaded him.

verses.hebrew: וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה אֹהֵב אֶת־דָּוִד כִּי־הוּא יוֹצֵא וָבָא לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה אֹהֵב אֶת־דָּוִד כִּי־הוּא יוֹצֵא וָבָא לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text: All Israel and Judah loved David, for he marched at their head.

translation.text: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.

verses.english: All Israel and Judah loved David, for he marched at their head.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד הִנֵּה בִתִּי הַגְּדוֹלָה מֵרַב אֹתָהּ אֶתֶּן־לְךָ לְאִשָּׁה אַךְ הֱיֵה־לִי לְבֶן־חַיִל וְהִלָּחֵם מִלְחֲמוֹת יְהֹוָה וְשָׁאוּל אָמַר אַל־תְּהִי יָדִי
בּוֹ וּתְהִי־בוֹ יַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד הִנֵּה בִתִּי הַגְּדוֹלָה מֵרַב אֹתָהּ אֶתֶּן־לְךָ לְאִשָּׁה אַךְ הֱיֵה־לִי לְבֶן־חַיִל וְהִלָּחֵם מִלְחֲמוֹת יְהֹוָה וְשָׁאוּל אָמַר אַל־תְּהִי יָדִי
בּוֹ וּתְהִי־בוֹ יַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
Saul said to David, “Here is my older daughter, Merab; I will give
her to you in marriage; in return, you be my warrior and fight the
battles of YHWH.” Saul thought: “Let not my hand strike him; let
the hand of the Philistines strike him.”

translation.text: And Saul said to David, Behold my elder daughter Merab, her will I give thee to wife: only be thou valiant for me, and fight the LORD’s battles.

verses.english:
Saul said to David, “Here is my older daughter, Merab; I will give
her to you in marriage; in return, you be my warrior and fight the
battles of YHWH.” Saul thought: “Let not my hand strike him; let
the hand of the Philistines strike him.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל מִי אָנֹכִי וּמִי חַיַּי מִשְׁפַּחַת אָבִי בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־אֶהְיֶה חָתָן לַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל מִי אָנֹכִי וּמִי חַיַּי מִשְׁפַּחַת אָבִי בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־אֶהְיֶה חָתָן לַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
David replied to Saul, “Who am I and what is my life —my father’s
family in Israel—that I should become Your Majesty’s son-in-law?”

translation.text: And David said unto Saul, Who am I? and what is my life, or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son in law to the king?

verses.english:
David replied to Saul, “Who am I and what is my life —my father’s
family in Israel—that I should become Your Majesty’s son-in-law?”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּעֵת תֵּת אֶת־מֵרַב בַּת־שָׁאוּל לְדָוִד וְהִיא נִתְּנָה לְעַדְרִיאֵל הַמְּחֹלָתִי לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּעֵת תֵּת אֶת־מֵרַב בַּת־שָׁאוּל לְדָוִד וְהִיא נִתְּנָה לְעַדְרִיאֵל הַמְּחֹלָתִי לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
But at the time that Merab, daughter of Saul, should have been
given to David, she was given in marriage to Adriel the
Meholathite.

translation.text: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul’s daughter should have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife.

verses.english:
But at the time that Merab, daughter of Saul, should have been
given to David, she was given in marriage to Adriel the
Meholathite.

verses.hebrew: וַתֶּאֱהַב מִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל אֶת־דָּוִד וַיַּגִּדוּ לְשָׁאוּל וַיִּשַׁר הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתֶּאֱהַב מִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל אֶת־דָּוִד וַיַּגִּדוּ לְשָׁאוּל וַיִּשַׁר הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינָיו׃

english.text:
Now Michal daughter of Saul had fallen in love with David; and
when this was reported to Saul, he was pleased.

translation.text: And Michal Saul’s daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

verses.english:
Now Michal daughter of Saul had fallen in love with David; and
when this was reported to Saul, he was pleased.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶתְּנֶנָּה לּוֹ וּתְהִי־לוֹ לְמוֹקֵשׁ וּתְהִי־בוֹ יַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד בִּשְׁתַּיִם תִּתְחַתֵּן בִּי הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶתְּנֶנָּה לּוֹ וּתְהִי־לוֹ לְמוֹקֵשׁ וּתְהִי־בוֹ יַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד בִּשְׁתַּיִם תִּתְחַתֵּן בִּי הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
Saul thought: “I will give her to him, and she can serve as a
snare for him, so that the Philistines may kill him.” So Saul said
to David, “You can become my son-in-law even now through the
second one.”

translation.text: And Saul said, I will give him her, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Wherefore Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain.

verses.english:
Saul thought: “I will give her to him, and she can serve as a
snare for him, so that the Philistines may kill him.” So Saul said
to David, “You can become my son-in-law even now through the
second one.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו שָׁאוּל אֶת־עֲבָדָו דַּבְּרוּ אֶל־דָּוִד בַּלָּט לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה חָפֵץ בְּךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־עֲבָדָיו אֲהֵבוּךָ וְעַתָּה הִתְחַתֵּן בַּמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו שָׁאוּל אֶת־עֲבָדָו דַּבְּרוּ אֶל־דָּוִד בַּלָּט לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה חָפֵץ בְּךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־עֲבָדָיו אֲהֵבוּךָ וְעַתָּה הִתְחַתֵּן בַּמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
