And Saul instructed his courtiers to say to David privately, “The
king is fond of you and all his courtiers like you. So why not
become the king’s son-in-law?”

translation.text: And Saul commanded his servants, saying, Commune with David secretly, and say, Behold, the king hath delight in thee, and all his servants love thee: now therefore be the king’s son in law.

verses.english:
And Saul instructed his courtiers to say to David privately, “The
king is fond of you and all his courtiers like you. So why not
become the king’s son-in-law?”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבְּרוּ עַבְדֵי שָׁאוּל בְּאזְנֵי דָוִד אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד הַנְקַלָּה בְעֵינֵיכֶם הִתְחַתֵּן בַּמֶּלֶךְ וְאָנֹכִי אִישׁ־רָשׁ וְנִקְלֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבְּרוּ עַבְדֵי שָׁאוּל בְּאזְנֵי דָוִד אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד הַנְקַלָּה בְעֵינֵיכֶם הִתְחַתֵּן בַּמֶּלֶךְ וְאָנֹכִי אִישׁ־רָשׁ וְנִקְלֶה׃

english.text:
When the king’s courtiers repeated these words to David, David
replied, “Do you think that becoming the son-in-law of a king is a
small matter, when I am but a poor man of no consequence?”

translation.text: And Saul’s servants spake those words in the ears of David. And David said, Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king’s son in law, seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?

verses.english:
When the king’s courtiers repeated these words to David, David
replied, “Do you think that becoming the son-in-law of a king is a
small matter, when I am but a poor man of no consequence?”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּדוּ עַבְדֵי שָׁאוּל לוֹ לֵאמֹר כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה דִּבֶּר דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגִּדוּ עַבְדֵי שָׁאוּל לוֹ לֵאמֹר כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה דִּבֶּר דָּוִד׃

english.text: Saul’s courtiers reported to him, “This is what David answered.”

translation.text: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner spake David.

verses.english: Saul’s courtiers reported to him, “This is what David answered.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל כֹּה־תֹאמְרוּ לְדָוִד אֵין־חֵפֶץ לַמֶּלֶךְ בְּמֹהַר כִּי בְּמֵאָה ערְלוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים לְהִנָּקֵם בְּאֹיְבֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְשָׁאוּל חָשַׁב לְהַפִּיל אֶת־דָּוִד
בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל כֹּה־תֹאמְרוּ לְדָוִד אֵין־חֵפֶץ לַמֶּלֶךְ בְּמֹהַר כִּי בְּמֵאָה ערְלוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים לְהִנָּקֵם בְּאֹיְבֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְשָׁאוּל חָשַׁב לְהַפִּיל אֶת־דָּוִד
בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
And Saul said, “Say this to David: ‘The king desires no other
bride-price than the foreskins of a hundred Philistines, as
vengeance on the king’s enemies.’”—Saul intended to bring about
David’s death at the hands of the Philistines.—

translation.text: And Saul said, Thus shall ye say to David, The king desireth not any dowry, but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king’s enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

verses.english:
And Saul said, “Say this to David: ‘The king desires no other
bride-price than the foreskins of a hundred Philistines, as
vengeance on the king’s enemies.’”—Saul intended to bring about
David’s death at the hands of the Philistines.—

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּדוּ עֲבָדָיו לְדָוִד אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּשַׁר הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי דָוִד לְהִתְחַתֵּן בַּמֶּלֶךְ וְלֹא מָלְאוּ הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגִּדוּ עֲבָדָיו לְדָוִד אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּשַׁר הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי דָוִד לְהִתְחַתֵּן בַּמֶּלֶךְ וְלֹא מָלְאוּ הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
When his courtiers told this to David, David was pleased with the
idea of becoming the king’s son-in-law. Before the time had
expired,

translation.text: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king’s son in law: and the days were not expired.

verses.english:
When his courtiers told this to David, David was pleased with the
idea of becoming the king’s son-in-law. Before the time had
expired,

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַיֵּלֶךְ הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו וַיַּךְ בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים מָאתַיִם אִישׁ וַיָּבֵא דָוִד אֶת־ערְלֹתֵיהֶם וַיְמַלְאוּם לַמֶּלֶךְ לְהִתְחַתֵּן בַּמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ
שָׁאוּל אֶת־מִיכַל בִּתּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַיֵּלֶךְ הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו וַיַּךְ בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים מָאתַיִם אִישׁ וַיָּבֵא דָוִד אֶת־ערְלֹתֵיהֶם וַיְמַלְאוּם לַמֶּלֶךְ לְהִתְחַתֵּן בַּמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ
שָׁאוּל אֶת־מִיכַל בִּתּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
David went out with his men and killed two hundred Philistines;
David brought their foreskins and they were counted out for the
king, that he might become the king’s son-in-law. Saul then gave
him his daughter Michal in marriage.

translation.text: Wherefore David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full tale to the king, that he might be the king’s son in law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife.

verses.english:
David went out with his men and killed two hundred Philistines;
David brought their foreskins and they were counted out for the
king, that he might become the king’s son-in-law. Saul then gave
him his daughter Michal in marriage.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא שָׁאוּל וַיֵּדַע כִּי יְהֹוָה עִם־דָּוִד וּמִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל אֲהֵבַתְהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא שָׁאוּל וַיֵּדַע כִּי יְהֹוָה עִם־דָּוִד וּמִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל אֲהֵבַתְהוּ׃

english.text:
When Saul realized that YHWH was with David and that Michal
daughter of Saul loved him,

translation.text: And Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David, and that Michal Saul’s daughter loved him.

verses.english:
When Saul realized that YHWH was with David and that Michal
daughter of Saul loved him,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאסֶף שָׁאוּל לֵרֹא מִפְּנֵי דָוִד עוֹד וַיְהִי שָׁאוּל אֹיֵב אֶת־דָּוִד כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאסֶף שָׁאוּל לֵרֹא מִפְּנֵי דָוִד עוֹד וַיְהִי שָׁאוּל אֹיֵב אֶת־דָּוִד כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
Saul grew still more afraid of David; and Saul was David’s enemy
ever after.

translation.text: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul became David’s enemy continually.

verses.english:
Saul grew still more afraid of David; and Saul was David’s enemy
ever after.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיְהִי מִדֵּי צֵאתָם שָׂכַל דָּוִד מִכֹּל עַבְדֵי שָׁאוּל וַיִּיקַר שְׁמוֹ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיְהִי מִדֵּי צֵאתָם שָׂכַל דָּוִד מִכֹּל עַבְדֵי שָׁאוּל וַיִּיקַר שְׁמוֹ מְאֹד׃

english.text:
The Philistine chiefs marched out [to battle]; and every time they
marched out, David was more successful than all the other officers
of Saul. His reputation soared.

translation.text: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth: and it came to pass, after they went forth, that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul; so that his name was much set by.

verses.english:
The Philistine chiefs marched out [to battle]; and every time they
marched out, David was more successful than all the other officers
of Saul. His reputation soared.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר שָׁאוּל אֶל־יוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ וְאֶל־כּל־עֲבָדָיו לְהָמִית אֶת־דָּוִד וִיהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל חָפֵץ בְּדָוִד מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר שָׁאוּל אֶל־יוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ וְאֶל־כּל־עֲבָדָיו לְהָמִית אֶת־דָּוִד וִיהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל חָפֵץ בְּדָוִד מְאֹד׃

english.text:
Saul urged his son Jonathan and all his courtiers to kill David.
But Saul’s son Jonathan was very fond of David,

translation.text: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David.

verses.english:
Saul urged his son Jonathan and all his courtiers to kill David.
But Saul’s son Jonathan was very fond of David,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד יְהוֹנָתָן לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר מְבַקֵּשׁ שָׁאוּל אָבִי לַהֲמִיתֶךָ וְעַתָּה הִשָּׁמֶר־נָא בַבֹּקֶר וְיָשַׁבְתָּ בַסֵּתֶר וְנַחְבֵּאתָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֵּד יְהוֹנָתָן לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר מְבַקֵּשׁ שָׁאוּל אָבִי לַהֲמִיתֶךָ וְעַתָּה הִשָּׁמֶר־נָא בַבֹּקֶר וְיָשַׁבְתָּ בַסֵּתֶר וְנַחְבֵּאתָ׃

english.text:
and Jonathan told David, “My father Saul is bent on killing you.
Be on your guard tomorrow morning; get to a secret place and
remain in hiding.

translation.text: But Jonathan Saul’s son delighted much in David: and Jonathan told David, saying, Saul my father seeketh to kill thee: now therefore, I pray thee, take heed to thyself until the morning, and abide in a secret place, and hide thyself:

verses.english:
and Jonathan told David, “My father Saul is bent on killing you.
Be on your guard tomorrow morning; get to a secret place and
remain in hiding.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אֵצֵא וְעָמַדְתִּי לְיַד־אָבִי בַּשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה שָׁם וַאֲנִי אֲדַבֵּר בְּךָ אֶל־אָבִי וְרָאִיתִי מָה וְהִגַּדְתִּי לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי אֵצֵא וְעָמַדְתִּי לְיַד־אָבִי בַּשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה שָׁם וַאֲנִי אֲדַבֵּר בְּךָ אֶל־אָבִי וְרָאִיתִי מָה וְהִגַּדְתִּי לָךְ׃

english.text:
I will go out and stand next to my father in the field where you
will be, and I will speak to my father about you. If I learn
anything, I will tell you.”

translation.text: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art, and I will commune with my father of thee; and what I see, that I will tell thee.

verses.english:
I will go out and stand next to my father in the field where you
will be, and I will speak to my father about you. If I learn
anything, I will tell you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוֹנָתָן בְּדָוִד טוֹב אֶל־שָׁאוּל אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַל־יֶחֱטָא הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּעַבְדּוֹ בְדָוִד כִּי לוֹא חָטָא לָךְ וְכִי מַעֲשָׂיו טוֹב־לְךָ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוֹנָתָן בְּדָוִד טוֹב אֶל־שָׁאוּל אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַל־יֶחֱטָא הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּעַבְדּוֹ בְדָוִד כִּי לוֹא חָטָא לָךְ וְכִי מַעֲשָׂיו טוֹב־לְךָ מְאֹד׃

english.text:
So Jonathan spoke well of David to his father Saul. He said to
him, “Let not Your Majesty wrong his servant David, for he has not
wronged you; indeed, all his actions have been very much to your
advantage.

translation.text: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father, and said unto him, Let not the king sin against his servant, against David; because he hath not sinned against thee, and because his works have been to thee-ward very good:

verses.english:
So Jonathan spoke well of David to his father Saul. He said to
him, “Let not Your Majesty wrong his servant David, for he has not
wronged you; indeed, all his actions have been very much to your
advantage.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ בְכַפּוֹ וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה תְּשׁוּעָה גְדוֹלָה לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאִיתָ וַתִּשְׂמָח וְלָמָּה תֶחֱטָא בְּדָם נָקִי לְהָמִית
אֶת־דָּוִד חִנָּם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ בְכַפּוֹ וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה תְּשׁוּעָה גְדוֹלָה לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאִיתָ וַתִּשְׂמָח וְלָמָּה תֶחֱטָא בְּדָם נָקִי לְהָמִית
אֶת־דָּוִד חִנָּם׃

english.text:
He took his life in his hands and killed the Philistine, and YHWH
wrought a great victory for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced.
Why then should you incur the guilt of shedding the blood of an
innocent man, killing David without cause?”

translation.text: For he did put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine, and the LORD wrought a great salvation for all Israel: thou sawest it, and didst rejoice: wherefore then wilt thou sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?

verses.english:
He took his life in his hands and killed the Philistine, and YHWH
wrought a great victory for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced.
Why then should you incur the guilt of shedding the blood of an
innocent man, killing David without cause?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע שָׁאוּל בְּקוֹל יְהוֹנָתָן וַיִּשָּׁבַע שָׁאוּל חַי־יְהֹוָה אִם־יוּמָת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע שָׁאוּל בְּקוֹל יְהוֹנָתָן וַיִּשָּׁבַע שָׁאוּל חַי־יְהֹוָה אִם־יוּמָת׃

english.text:
Saul heeded Jonathan’s plea, and Saul swore, “As YHWH lives, he
shall not be put to death!”

translation.text: And Saul hearkened unto the voice of Jonathan: and Saul sware, As the LORD liveth, he shall not be slain.

verses.english:
Saul heeded Jonathan’s plea, and Saul swore, “As YHWH lives, he
shall not be put to death!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹנָתָן לְדָוִד וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ יְהוֹנָתָן אֵת כּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיָּבֵא יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־דָּוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיְהִי לְפָנָיו כְּאֶתְמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹנָתָן לְדָוִד וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ יְהוֹנָתָן אֵת כּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיָּבֵא יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־דָּוִד אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיְהִי לְפָנָיו כְּאֶתְמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃

english.text:
Jonathan called David, and Jonathan told him all this. Then
Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he served him as before.

translation.text: And Jonathan called David, and Jonathan shewed him all those things.

verses.english:
Jonathan called David, and Jonathan told him all this. Then
Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he served him as before.

verses.hebrew: וַתּוֹסֶף הַמִּלְחָמָה לִהְיוֹת וַיֵּצֵא דָוִד וַיִּלָּחֶם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּךְ בָּהֶם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתּוֹסֶף הַמִּלְחָמָה לִהְיוֹת וַיֵּצֵא דָוִד וַיִּלָּחֶם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּךְ בָּהֶם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפָּנָיו׃

english.text:
Fighting broke out again. David went out and fought the
Philistines. He inflicted a great defeat upon them and they fled
before him.

translation.text: And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled from him.

verses.english:
Fighting broke out again. David went out and fought the
Philistines. He inflicted a great defeat upon them and they fled
before him.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי רוּחַ יְהֹוָה רָעָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְהוּא בְּבֵיתוֹ יֹשֵׁב וַחֲנִיתוֹ בְּיָדוֹ וְדָוִד מְנַגֵּן בְּיָד׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי רוּחַ יְהֹוָה רָעָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְהוּא בְּבֵיתוֹ יֹשֵׁב וַחֲנִיתוֹ בְּיָדוֹ וְדָוִד מְנַגֵּן בְּיָד׃

english.text:
Then an evil spirit of YHWH came upon Saul while he was sitting in
his house with his spear in his hand, and David was playing [the
lyre].

translation.text: And the evil spirit from the LORD was upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand: and David played with his hand.

verses.english:
Then an evil spirit of YHWH came upon Saul while he was sitting in
his house with his spear in his hand, and David was playing [the
lyre].

verses.hebrew: וַיְבַקֵּשׁ שָׁאוּל לְהַכּוֹת בַּחֲנִית בְּדָוִד וּבַקִּיר וַיִּפְטַר מִפְּנֵי שָׁאוּל וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַחֲנִית בַּקִּיר וְדָוִד נָס וַיִּמָּלֵט בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבַקֵּשׁ שָׁאוּל לְהַכּוֹת בַּחֲנִית בְּדָוִד וּבַקִּיר וַיִּפְטַר מִפְּנֵי שָׁאוּל וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַחֲנִית בַּקִּיר וְדָוִד נָס וַיִּמָּלֵט בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא׃

english.text:
Saul tried to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he eluded
Saul, so that he drove the spear into the wall. David fled and got
away. That night

translation.text: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin: but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence, and he smote the javelin into the wall: and David fled, and escaped that night.

verses.english:
Saul tried to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he eluded
Saul, so that he drove the spear into the wall. David fled and got
away. That night

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים אֶל־בֵּית דָּוִד לְשׁמְרוֹ וְלַהֲמִיתוֹ בַּבֹּקֶר וַתַּגֵּד לְדָוִד מִיכַל אִשְׁתּוֹ לֵאמֹר אִם־אֵינְךָ מְמַלֵּט אֶת־נַפְשְׁךָ הַלַּיְלָה מָחָר
אַתָּה מוּמָת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים אֶל־בֵּית דָּוִד לְשׁמְרוֹ וְלַהֲמִיתוֹ בַּבֹּקֶר וַתַּגֵּד לְדָוִד מִיכַל אִשְׁתּוֹ לֵאמֹר אִם־אֵינְךָ מְמַלֵּט אֶת־נַפְשְׁךָ הַלַּיְלָה מָחָר
אַתָּה מוּמָת׃

english.text:
Saul sent messengers to David’s home to keep watch on him and to
kill him in the morning. But David’s wife Michal told him, “Unless
you run for your life tonight, you will be killed tomorrow.”

translation.text: Saul also sent messengers unto David’s house, to watch him, and to slay him in the morning: and Michal David’s wife told him, saying, If thou save not thy life to night, to morrow thou shalt be slain.

verses.english:
Saul sent messengers to David’s home to keep watch on him and to
kill him in the morning. But David’s wife Michal told him, “Unless
you run for your life tonight, you will be killed tomorrow.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּרֶד מִיכַל אֶת־דָּוִד בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּבְרַח וַיִּמָּלֵט׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּרֶד מִיכַל אֶת־דָּוִד בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּבְרַח וַיִּמָּלֵט׃

english.text: Michal let David down from the window and he escaped and fled.

translation.text: So Michal let David down through a window: and he went, and fled, and escaped.

verses.english: Michal let David down from the window and he escaped and fled.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח מִיכַל אֶת־הַתְּרָפִים וַתָּשֶׂם אֶל־הַמִּטָּה וְאֵת כְּבִיר הָעִזִּים שָׂמָה מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו וַתְּכַס בַּבָּגֶד׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקַּח מִיכַל אֶת־הַתְּרָפִים וַתָּשֶׂם אֶל־הַמִּטָּה וְאֵת כְּבִיר הָעִזִּים שָׂמָה מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו וַתְּכַס בַּבָּגֶד׃

english.text:
Michal then took the household idol, laid it on the bed, and
covered it with a cloth; and at its head she put a net of goat’s
hair.

translation.text: And Michal took an image, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair for his bolster, and covered it with a cloth.

verses.english:
Michal then took the household idol, laid it on the bed, and
covered it with a cloth; and at its head she put a net of goat’s
hair.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים לָקַחַת אֶת־דָּוִד וַתֹּאמֶר חֹלֶה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים לָקַחַת אֶת־דָּוִד וַתֹּאמֶר חֹלֶה הוּא׃

english.text: Saul sent messengers to seize David; but she said, “He is sick.”

translation.text: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, He is sick.

verses.english: Saul sent messengers to seize David; but she said, “He is sick.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל אֶת־הַמַּלְאָכִים לִרְאוֹת אֶת־דָּוִד לֵאמֹר הַעֲלוּ אֹתוֹ בַמִּטָּה אֵלַי לַהֲמִתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל אֶת־הַמַּלְאָכִים לִרְאוֹת אֶת־דָּוִד לֵאמֹר הַעֲלוּ אֹתוֹ בַמִּטָּה אֵלַי לַהֲמִתוֹ׃

english.text:
Saul, however, sent back the messengers to see David for
themselves. “Bring him up to me in the bed,” he ordered, “that he
may be put to death.”

translation.text: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David, saying, Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may slay him.

verses.english:
Saul, however, sent back the messengers to see David for
themselves. “Bring him up to me in the bed,” he ordered, “that he
may be put to death.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וְהִנֵּה הַתְּרָפִים אֶל־הַמִּטָּה וּכְבִיר הָעִזִּים מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וְהִנֵּה הַתְּרָפִים אֶל־הַמִּטָּה וּכְבִיר הָעִזִּים מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו׃

english.text:
When the messengers came, they found the household idol in the
bed, with the net of goat’s hair at its head.

translation.text: And when the messengers were come in, behold, there was an image in the bed, with a pillow of goats’ hair for his bolster.

verses.english:
When the messengers came, they found the household idol in the
bed, with the net of goat’s hair at its head.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־מִיכַל לָמָּה כָּכָה רִמִּיתִנִי וַתְּשַׁלְּחִי אֶת־אֹיְבִי וַיִּמָּלֵט וַתֹּאמֶר מִיכַל אֶל־שָׁאוּל הוּא־אָמַר אֵלַי שַׁלְּחִנִי לָמָה אֲמִיתֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־מִיכַל לָמָּה כָּכָה רִמִּיתִנִי וַתְּשַׁלְּחִי אֶת־אֹיְבִי וַיִּמָּלֵט וַתֹּאמֶר מִיכַל אֶל־שָׁאוּל הוּא־אָמַר אֵלַי שַׁלְּחִנִי לָמָה אֲמִיתֵךְ׃

english.text:
Saul said to Michal, “Why did you play that trick on me and let my
enemy get away safely?” “Because,” Michal answered Saul, “he said
to me: ‘Help me get away or I’ll kill you.’”

translation.text: And Saul said unto Michal, Why hast thou deceived me so, and sent away mine enemy, that he is escaped? And Michal answered Saul, He said unto me, Let me go; why should I kill thee?

verses.english:
Saul said to Michal, “Why did you play that trick on me and let my
enemy get away safely?” “Because,” Michal answered Saul, “he said
to me: ‘Help me get away or I’ll kill you.’”

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד בָּרַח וַיִּמָּלֵט וַיָּבֹא אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל הָרָמָתָה וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה־לוֹ שָׁאוּל וַיֵּלֶךְ הוּא וּשְׁמוּאֵל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ (בנוית) [בְּנָיוֹת]׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד בָּרַח וַיִּמָּלֵט וַיָּבֹא אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל הָרָמָתָה וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה־לוֹ שָׁאוּל וַיֵּלֶךְ הוּא וּשְׁמוּאֵל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ (בנוית) [בְּנָיוֹת]׃

english.text:
David made good his escape, and he came to Samuel at Ramah and
told him all that Saul had done to him. He and Samuel went and
stayed at Naioth.

translation.text: So David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.

verses.english:
David made good his escape, and he came to Samuel at Ramah and
told him all that Saul had done to him. He and Samuel went and
stayed at Naioth.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְשָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה דָוִד (בנוית) [בְּנָיוֹת] בָּרָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לְשָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה דָוִד (בנוית) [בְּנָיוֹת] בָּרָמָה׃

english.text: Saul was told that David was at Naioth in Ramah,

translation.text: And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.

verses.english: Saul was told that David was at Naioth in Ramah,

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים לָקַחַת אֶת־דָּוִד וַיַּרְא אֶת־לַהֲקַת הַנְּבִיאִים נִבְּאִים וּשְׁמוּאֵל עֹמֵד נִצָּב עֲלֵיהֶם וַתְּהִי עַל־מַלְאֲכֵי שָׁאוּל רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים
וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ גַּם־הֵמָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים לָקַחַת אֶת־דָּוִד וַיַּרְא אֶת־לַהֲקַת הַנְּבִיאִים נִבְּאִים וּשְׁמוּאֵל עֹמֵד נִצָּב עֲלֵיהֶם וַתְּהִי עַל־מַלְאֲכֵי שָׁאוּל רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים
וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ גַּם־הֵמָּה׃

english.text:
and Saul sent messengers to seize David. They saw a band of
prophets speaking in ecstasy, with Samuel standing by as their
leader; and the spirit of God came upon Saul’s messengers and they
too began to speak in ecstasy.

translation.text: And Saul sent messengers to take David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as appointed over them, the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.

verses.english:
and Saul sent messengers to seize David. They saw a band of
prophets speaking in ecstasy, with Samuel standing by as their
leader; and the spirit of God came upon Saul’s messengers and they
too began to speak in ecstasy.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְשָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֲחֵרִים וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ גַּם־הֵמָּהוַיֹּסֶף שָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים שְׁלִשִׁים וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ גַּם־הֵמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְשָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֲחֵרִים וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ גַּם־הֵמָּהוַיֹּסֶף שָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים שְׁלִשִׁים וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ גַּם־הֵמָּה׃

english.text:
When Saul was told about this, he sent other messengers; but they
too spoke in ecstasy. Saul sent a third group of messengers; and
they also spoke in ecstasy.

translation.text: And when it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they prophesied likewise. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they prophesied also.

verses.english:
When Saul was told about this, he sent other messengers; but they
too spoke in ecstasy. Saul sent a third group of messengers; and
they also spoke in ecstasy.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ גַּם־הוּא הָרָמָתָה וַיָּבֹא עַד־בּוֹר הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר בַּשֶּׂכוּ וַיִּשְׁאַל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵיפֹה שְׁמוּאֵל וְדָוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה (בנוית) [בְּנָיוֹת] בָּרָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ גַּם־הוּא הָרָמָתָה וַיָּבֹא עַד־בּוֹר הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר בַּשֶּׂכוּ וַיִּשְׁאַל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵיפֹה שְׁמוּאֵל וְדָוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה (בנוית) [בְּנָיוֹת] בָּרָמָה׃

english.text:
So he himself went to Ramah. When he came to the great cistern at
Secu, he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” and was told that
they were at Naioth in Ramah.

translation.text: Then went he also to Ramah, and came to a great well that is in Sechu: and he asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, Behold, they be at Naioth in Ramah.

verses.english:
So he himself went to Ramah. When he came to the great cistern at
Secu, he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” and was told that
they were at Naioth in Ramah.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ שָׁם אֶל־[נָיוֹת] (נוית) בָּרָמָה וַתְּהִי עָלָיו גַּם־הוּא רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וַיִּתְנַבֵּא עַד־בֹּאוֹ (בנוית) [בְּנָיוֹת] בָּרָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ שָׁם אֶל־[נָיוֹת] (נוית) בָּרָמָה וַתְּהִי עָלָיו גַּם־הוּא רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וַיִּתְנַבֵּא עַד־בֹּאוֹ (בנוית) [בְּנָיוֹת] בָּרָמָה׃

english.text:
He was on his way there, to Naioth in Ramah, when the spirit of
God came upon him too; and he walked on, speaking in ecstasy,
until he reached Naioth in Ramah.

translation.text: And he went thither to Naioth in Ramah: and the Spirit of God was upon him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.

verses.english:
He was on his way there, to Naioth in Ramah, when the spirit of
God came upon him too; and he walked on, speaking in ecstasy,
until he reached Naioth in Ramah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְשַׁט גַּם־הוּא בְּגָדָיו וַיִּתְנַבֵּא גַם־הוּא לִפְנֵי שְׁמוּאֵל וַיִּפֹּל עָרֹם כּל־הַיּוֹם הַהוּא וְכל־הַלָּיְלָה עַל־כֵּן יֹאמְרוּ הֲגַם שָׁאוּל בַּנְּבִיאִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְשַׁט גַּם־הוּא בְּגָדָיו וַיִּתְנַבֵּא גַם־הוּא לִפְנֵי שְׁמוּאֵל וַיִּפֹּל עָרֹם כּל־הַיּוֹם הַהוּא וְכל־הַלָּיְלָה עַל־כֵּן יֹאמְרוּ הֲגַם שָׁאוּל בַּנְּבִיאִם׃

english.text:
Then he too stripped off his clothes and he too spoke in ecstasy
before Samuel; and he lay naked all that day and all night. That
is why people say, “Is Saul too among the prophets?”

translation.text: And he stripped off his clothes also, and prophesied before Samuel in like manner, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Wherefore they say, Is Saul also among the prophets?

verses.english:
Then he too stripped off his clothes and he too spoke in ecstasy
before Samuel; and he lay naked all that day and all night. That
is why people say, “Is Saul too among the prophets?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְרַח דָּוִד (מנוות) [מִנָּיוֹת] בָּרָמָה וַיָּבֹא וַיֹּאמֶר לִפְנֵי יְהוֹנָתָן מֶה עָשִׂיתִי מֶה־עֲוֺנִי וּמֶה־חַטָּאתִי לִפְנֵי אָבִיךָ כִּי מְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְרַח דָּוִד (מנוות) [מִנָּיוֹת] בָּרָמָה וַיָּבֹא וַיֹּאמֶר לִפְנֵי יְהוֹנָתָן מֶה עָשִׂיתִי מֶה־עֲוֺנִי וּמֶה־חַטָּאתִי לִפְנֵי אָבִיךָ כִּי מְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי׃

english.text:
David fled from Naioth in Ramah; he came to Jonathan and said,
“What have I done, what is my crime and my guilt against your
father, that he seeks my life?”

translation.text: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?

verses.english:
David fled from Naioth in Ramah; he came to Jonathan and said,
“What have I done, what is my crime and my guilt against your
father, that he seeks my life?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ חָלִילָה לֹא תָמוּת הִנֵּה (לו עשה) [לֹא־יַעֲשֶׂה] אָבִי דָּבָר גָּדוֹל אוֹ דָּבָר קָטֹן וְלֹא יִגְלֶה אֶת־אזְנִי וּמַדּוּעַ יַסְתִּיר אָבִי מִמֶּנִּי אֶת־הַדָּבָר
הַזֶּה אֵין זֹאת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ חָלִילָה לֹא תָמוּת הִנֵּה (לו עשה) [לֹא־יַעֲשֶׂה] אָבִי דָּבָר גָּדוֹל אוֹ דָּבָר קָטֹן וְלֹא יִגְלֶה אֶת־אזְנִי וּמַדּוּעַ יַסְתִּיר אָבִי מִמֶּנִּי אֶת־הַדָּבָר
הַזֶּה אֵין זֹאת׃

english.text:
He replied, “Heaven forbid! You shall not die. My father does not
do anything, great or small, without disclosing it to me; why
should my father conceal this matter from me? It cannot be!”

translation.text: And he said unto him, God forbid; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, but that he will shew it me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so.

verses.english:
He replied, “Heaven forbid! You shall not die. My father does not
do anything, great or small, without disclosing it to me; why
should my father conceal this matter from me? It cannot be!”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשָּׁבַע עוֹד דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר יָדֹעַ יָדַע אָבִיךָ כִּי־מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־יֵדַע־זֹאת יְהוֹנָתָן פֶּן־יֵעָצֵב וְאוּלָם חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי נַפְשֶׁךָ כִּי
כְפֶשַׂע בֵּינִי וּבֵין הַמָּוֶת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשָּׁבַע עוֹד דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר יָדֹעַ יָדַע אָבִיךָ כִּי־מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־יֵדַע־זֹאת יְהוֹנָתָן פֶּן־יֵעָצֵב וְאוּלָם חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי נַפְשֶׁךָ כִּי
כְפֶשַׂע בֵּינִי וּבֵין הַמָּוֶת׃

english.text:
David swore further, “Your father knows well that you are fond of
me and has decided: Jonathan must not learn of this or he will be
grieved. But, as YHWH lives and as you live, there is only a step
between me and death.”

translation.text: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.

verses.english:
David swore further, “Your father knows well that you are fond of
me and has decided: Jonathan must not learn of this or he will be
grieved. But, as YHWH lives and as you live, there is only a step
between me and death.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד מַה־תֹּאמַר נַפְשְׁךָ וְאֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד מַה־תֹּאמַר נַפְשְׁךָ וְאֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ׃

english.text: Jonathan said to David, “Whatever you want, I will do it for you.”

translation.text: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.

verses.english: Jonathan said to David, “Whatever you want, I will do it for you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יְהוֹנָתָן הִנֵּה־חֹדֶשׁ מָחָר וְאָנֹכִי יָשֹׁב־אֵשֵׁב עִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֶאֱכוֹל וְשִׁלַּחְתַּנִי וְנִסְתַּרְתִּי בַשָּׂדֶה עַד הָעֶרֶב הַשְּׁלִשִׁית׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יְהוֹנָתָן הִנֵּה־חֹדֶשׁ מָחָר וְאָנֹכִי יָשֹׁב־אֵשֵׁב עִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֶאֱכוֹל וְשִׁלַּחְתַּנִי וְנִסְתַּרְתִּי בַשָּׂדֶה עַד הָעֶרֶב הַשְּׁלִשִׁית׃

english.text:
David said to Jonathan, “Tomorrow is the new moon, and I am to sit
with the king at the meal. Instead, let me go and I will hide in
the countryside until the third evening.

translation.text: And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to morrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even.

verses.english:
David said to Jonathan, “Tomorrow is the new moon, and I am to sit
with the king at the meal. Instead, let me go and I will hide in
the countryside until the third evening.

verses.hebrew: אִם־פָּקֹד יִפְקְדֵנִי אָבִיךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ נִשְׁאֹל נִשְׁאַל מִמֶּנִּי דָוִד לָרוּץ בֵּית־לֶחֶם עִירוֹ כִּי זֶבַח הַיָּמִים שָׁם לְכל־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה׃

hebrew.text: אִם־פָּקֹד יִפְקְדֵנִי אָבִיךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ נִשְׁאֹל נִשְׁאַל מִמֶּנִּי דָוִד לָרוּץ בֵּית־לֶחֶם עִירוֹ כִּי זֶבַח הַיָּמִים שָׁם לְכל־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה׃

english.text:
If your father notes my absence, you say, ‘David asked my
permission to run down to his home town, Bethlehem, for the whole
family has its annual sacrifice there.’

translation.text: If thy father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem his city: for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.

verses.english:
If your father notes my absence, you say, ‘David asked my
permission to run down to his home town, Bethlehem, for the whole
family has its annual sacrifice there.’

verses.hebrew: אִם־כֹּה יֹאמַר טוֹב שָׁלוֹם לְעַבְדֶּךָ וְאִם־חָרֹה יֶחֱרֶה לוֹ דַּע כִּי־כָלְתָה הָרָעָה מֵעִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אִם־כֹּה יֹאמַר טוֹב שָׁלוֹם לְעַבְדֶּךָ וְאִם־חָרֹה יֶחֱרֶה לוֹ דַּע כִּי־כָלְתָה הָרָעָה מֵעִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
If he says ‘Good,’ your servant is safe; but if his anger flares
up, know that he is resolved to do [me] harm.

translation.text: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth, then be sure that evil is determined by him.

verses.english:
If he says ‘Good,’ your servant is safe; but if his anger flares
up, know that he is resolved to do [me] harm.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ חֶסֶד עַל־עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי בִּבְרִית יְהֹוָה הֵבֵאתָ אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ עִמָּךְ וְאִם־יֶשׁ־בִּי עָוֺן הֲמִיתֵנִי אַתָּה וְעַד־אָבִיךָ לָמָּה־זֶּה תְבִיאֵנִי׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ חֶסֶד עַל־עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי בִּבְרִית יְהֹוָה הֵבֵאתָ אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ עִמָּךְ וְאִם־יֶשׁ־בִּי עָוֺן הֲמִיתֵנִי אַתָּה וְעַד־אָבִיךָ לָמָּה־זֶּה תְבִיאֵנִי׃

english.text:
Deal faithfully with your servant, since you have taken your
servant into a covenant of YHWH with you. And if I am guilty, kill
me yourself, but don’t make me go back to your father.”

translation.text: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the LORD with thee: notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?

verses.english:
Deal faithfully with your servant, since you have taken your
servant into a covenant of YHWH with you. And if I am guilty, kill
me yourself, but don’t make me go back to your father.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן חָלִילָה לָּךְ כִּי אִם־יָדֹעַ אֵדַע כִּי־כָלְתָה הָרָעָה מֵעִם אָבִי לָבוֹא עָלֶיךָ וְלֹא אֹתָהּ אַגִּיד לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן חָלִילָה לָּךְ כִּי אִם־יָדֹעַ אֵדַע כִּי־כָלְתָה הָרָעָה מֵעִם אָבִי לָבוֹא עָלֶיךָ וְלֹא אֹתָהּ אַגִּיד לָךְ׃

english.text:
Jonathan replied, “Don’t talk like that! If I learn that my father
has resolved to kill you, I will surely tell you about it.”

translation.text: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee: for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?

verses.english:
Jonathan replied, “Don’t talk like that! If I learn that my father
has resolved to kill you, I will surely tell you about it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יְהוֹנָתָן מִי יַגִּיד לִי אוֹ מַה־יַּעַנְךָ אָבִיךָ קָשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יְהוֹנָתָן מִי יַגִּיד לִי אוֹ מַה־יַּעַנְךָ אָבִיךָ קָשָׁה׃

english.text:
David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers
you harshly?”

translation.text: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if thy father answer thee roughly?

verses.english:
David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers
you harshly?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד לְכָה וְנֵצֵא הַשָּׂדֶה וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם הַשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד לְכָה וְנֵצֵא הַשָּׂדֶה וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם הַשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
Jonathan said to David, “Let us go into the open”; and they both
went out into the open.

translation.text: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.

verses.english:
Jonathan said to David, “Let us go into the open”; and they both
went out into the open.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־אֶחְקֹר אֶת־אָבִי כָּעֵת מָחָר הַשְּׁלִשִׁית וְהִנֵּה־טוֹב אֶל־דָּוִד וְלֹא־אָז אֶשְׁלַח אֵלֶיךָ וְגָלִיתִי
אֶת־אזְנֶךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־אֶחְקֹר אֶת־אָבִי כָּעֵת מָחָר הַשְּׁלִשִׁית וְהִנֵּה־טוֹב אֶל־דָּוִד וְלֹא־אָז אֶשְׁלַח אֵלֶיךָ וְגָלִיתִי
אֶת־אזְנֶךָ׃

english.text:
Then Jonathan said to David, “By YHWH, the God of Israel! I will
sound out my father at this time tomorrow, [or] on the third day;
and if [his response] is favorable for David, I will send a
message to you at once and disclose it to you.

translation.text: And Jonathan said unto David, O LORD God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time, or the third day, and, behold, if there be good toward David, and I then send not unto thee, and shew it thee;

verses.english:
Then Jonathan said to David, “By YHWH, the God of Israel! I will
sound out my father at this time tomorrow, [or] on the third day;
and if [his response] is favorable for David, I will send a
message to you at once and disclose it to you.

verses.hebrew:
כֹּה־יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה לִיהוֹנָתָן וְכֹה יֹסִיף כִּי־יֵיטִב אֶל־אָבִי אֶת־הָרָעָה עָלֶיךָ וְגָלִיתִי אֶת־אזְנֶךָ וְשִׁלַּחְתִּיךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ לְשָׁלוֹם וִיהִי יְהֹוָה עִמָּךְ
כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה עִם־אָבִי׃

hebrew.text:
כֹּה־יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה לִיהוֹנָתָן וְכֹה יֹסִיף כִּי־יֵיטִב אֶל־אָבִי אֶת־הָרָעָה עָלֶיךָ וְגָלִיתִי אֶת־אזְנֶךָ וְשִׁלַּחְתִּיךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ לְשָׁלוֹם וִיהִי יְהֹוָה עִמָּךְ
כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה עִם־אָבִי׃

english.text:
But if my father intends to do you harm, may YHWH do thus to
Jonathan and more if I do [not] disclose it to you and send you
off to escape unharmed. May YHWH be with you, as He used to be
with my father.

translation.text: The LORD do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my father to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the LORD be with thee, as he hath been with my father.

verses.english:
But if my father intends to do you harm, may YHWH do thus to
Jonathan and more if I do [not] disclose it to you and send you
off to escape unharmed. May YHWH be with you, as He used to be
with my father.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא אִם־עוֹדֶנִּי חָי וְלֹא־תַעֲשֶׂה עִמָּדִי חֶסֶד יְהֹוָה וְלֹא אָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא אִם־עוֹדֶנִּי חָי וְלֹא־תַעֲשֶׂה עִמָּדִי חֶסֶד יְהֹוָה וְלֹא אָמוּת׃

english.text:
Nor shall you fail to show me YHWH’s faithfulness, while I am
alive; nor, when I am dead,

translation.text: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the LORD, that I die not:

verses.english:
Nor shall you fail to show me YHWH’s faithfulness, while I am
alive; nor, when I am dead,

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־תַכְרִית אֶת־חַסְדְּךָ מֵעִם בֵּיתִי עַד־עוֹלָם וְלֹא בְּהַכְרִת יְהֹוָה אֶת־אֹיְבֵי דָוִד אִישׁ מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־תַכְרִית אֶת־חַסְדְּךָ מֵעִם בֵּיתִי עַד־עוֹלָם וְלֹא בְּהַכְרִת יְהֹוָה אֶת־אֹיְבֵי דָוִד אִישׁ מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
shall you ever discontinue your faithfulness to my house—not even
after YHWH has wiped out every one of David’s enemies from the
face of the earth.

translation.text: But also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever: no, not when the LORD hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.

verses.english:
shall you ever discontinue your faithfulness to my house—not even
after YHWH has wiped out every one of David’s enemies from the
face of the earth.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹנָתָן עִם־בֵּית דָּוִד וּבִקֵּשׁ יְהֹוָה מִיַּד אֹיְבֵי דָוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹנָתָן עִם־בֵּית דָּוִד וּבִקֵּשׁ יְהֹוָה מִיַּד אֹיְבֵי דָוִד׃

english.text:
Thus has Jonathan covenanted with the house of David; and may YHWH
requite the enemies of David!”

translation.text: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, Let the LORD even require it at the hand of David’s enemies.

verses.english:
Thus has Jonathan covenanted with the house of David; and may YHWH
requite the enemies of David!”

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹסֶף יְהוֹנָתָן לְהַשְׁבִּיעַ אֶת־דָּוִד בְּאַהֲבָתוֹ אֹתוֹ כִּי־אַהֲבַת נַפְשׁוֹ אֲהֵבוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹסֶף יְהוֹנָתָן לְהַשְׁבִּיעַ אֶת־דָּוִד בְּאַהֲבָתוֹ אֹתוֹ כִּי־אַהֲבַת נַפְשׁוֹ אֲהֵבוֹ׃

english.text:
Jonathan, out of his love for David, adjured him again, for he
loved him as himself.

translation.text: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

verses.english:
Jonathan, out of his love for David, adjured him again, for he
loved him as himself.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ יְהוֹנָתָן מָחָר חֹדֶשׁ וְנִפְקַדְתָּ כִּי יִפָּקֵד מוֹשָׁבֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ יְהוֹנָתָן מָחָר חֹדֶשׁ וְנִפְקַדְתָּ כִּי יִפָּקֵד מוֹשָׁבֶךָ׃

english.text:
Jonathan said to him, “Tomorrow will be the new moon; and you will
be missed when your seat remains vacant.

translation.text: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.

verses.english:
Jonathan said to him, “Tomorrow will be the new moon; and you will
be missed when your seat remains vacant.

verses.hebrew: וְשִׁלַּשְׁתָּ תֵּרֵד מְאֹד וּבָאתָ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־נִסְתַּרְתָּ שָּׁם בְּיוֹם הַמַּעֲשֶׂה וְיָשַׁבְתָּ אֵצֶל הָאֶבֶן הָאָזֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְשִׁלַּשְׁתָּ תֵּרֵד מְאֹד וּבָאתָ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־נִסְתַּרְתָּ שָּׁם בְּיוֹם הַמַּעֲשֶׂה וְיָשַׁבְתָּ אֵצֶל הָאֶבֶן הָאָזֶל׃

english.text:
So the day after tomorrow, go down all the way to the place where
you hid the other time, and stay close to the Ezel stone.

translation.text: And when thou hast stayed three days, then thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.

verses.english:
So the day after tomorrow, go down all the way to the place where
you hid the other time, and stay close to the Ezel stone.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַחִצִּים צִדָּה אוֹרֶה לְשַׁלַּח־לִי לְמַטָּרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַחִצִּים צִדָּה אוֹרֶה לְשַׁלַּח־לִי לְמַטָּרָה׃

english.text:
Now I will shoot three arrows to one side of it, as though I were
shooting at a mark,

translation.text: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.

verses.english:
Now I will shoot three arrows to one side of it, as though I were
shooting at a mark,

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה אֶשְׁלַח אֶת־הַנַּעַר לֵךְ מְצָא אֶת־הַחִצִּים אִם־אָמֹר אֹמַר לַנַּעַר הִנֵּה הַחִצִּים מִמְּךָ וָהֵנָּה קָחֶנּוּ וָבֹאָה כִּי־שָׁלוֹם לְךָ וְאֵין דָּבָר חַי־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה אֶשְׁלַח אֶת־הַנַּעַר לֵךְ מְצָא אֶת־הַחִצִּים אִם־אָמֹר אֹמַר לַנַּעַר הִנֵּה הַחִצִּים מִמְּךָ וָהֵנָּה קָחֶנּוּ וָבֹאָה כִּי־שָׁלוֹם לְךָ וְאֵין דָּבָר חַי־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and I will order the boy to go and find the arrows. If I call to
the boy, ‘Hey! the arrows are on this side of you,’ be reassured
and come, for you are safe and there is no danger—as YHWH lives!

translation.text: And, behold, I will send a lad, saying, Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for there is peace to thee, and no hurt; as the LORD liveth.

verses.english:
and I will order the boy to go and find the arrows. If I call to
the boy, ‘Hey! the arrows are on this side of you,’ be reassured
and come, for you are safe and there is no danger—as YHWH lives!

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־כֹּה אֹמַר לָעֶלֶם הִנֵּה הַחִצִּים מִמְּךָ וָהָלְאָה לֵךְ כִּי שִׁלַּחֲךָ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־כֹּה אֹמַר לָעֶלֶם הִנֵּה הַחִצִּים מִמְּךָ וָהָלְאָה לֵךְ כִּי שִׁלַּחֲךָ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
But if, instead, I call to the lad, ‘Hey! the arrows are beyond
you,’ then leave, for YHWH has sent you away.

translation.text: But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way: for the LORD hath sent thee away.

verses.english:
But if, instead, I call to the lad, ‘Hey! the arrows are beyond
you,’ then leave, for YHWH has sent you away.

verses.hebrew: וְהַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְנוּ אֲנִי וָאָתָּה הִנֵּה יְהֹוָה בֵּינִי וּבֵינְךָ עַד־עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְנוּ אֲנִי וָאָתָּה הִנֵּה יְהֹוָה בֵּינִי וּבֵינְךָ עַד־עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
As for the promise we made to each other, may YHWH be [witness]
between you and me forever.”

translation.text: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, the LORD be between thee and me for ever.

verses.english:
As for the promise we made to each other, may YHWH be [witness]
between you and me forever.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסָּתֵר דָּוִד בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיְהִי הַחֹדֶשׁ וַיֵּשֶׁב הַמֶּלֶךְ (על) [אֶל־]הַלֶּחֶם לֶאֱכוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסָּתֵר דָּוִד בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיְהִי הַחֹדֶשׁ וַיֵּשֶׁב הַמֶּלֶךְ (על) [אֶל־]הַלֶּחֶם לֶאֱכוֹל׃

english.text:
David hid in the field. The new moon came, and the king sat down
to partake of the meal.

translation.text: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.

verses.english:
David hid in the field. The new moon came, and the king sat down
to partake of the meal.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־מוֹשָׁבוֹ כְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם אֶל־מוֹשַׁב הַקִּיר וַיָּקם יְהוֹנָתָן וַיֵּשֶׁב אַבְנֵר מִצַּד שָׁאוּל וַיִּפָּקֵד מְקוֹם דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־מוֹשָׁבוֹ כְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם אֶל־מוֹשַׁב הַקִּיר וַיָּקם יְהוֹנָתָן וַיֵּשֶׁב אַבְנֵר מִצַּד שָׁאוּל וַיִּפָּקֵד מְקוֹם דָּוִד׃

english.text:
When the king took his usual place on the seat by the wall,
Jonathan rose and Abner sat down at Saul’s side; but David’s place
remained vacant.

translation.text: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, and David’s place was empty.

verses.english:
When the king took his usual place on the seat by the wall,
Jonathan rose and Abner sat down at Saul’s side; but David’s place
remained vacant.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־דִבֶּר שָׁאוּל מְאוּמָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי אָמַר מִקְרֶה הוּא בִּלְתִּי טָהוֹר הוּא כִּי־לֹא טָהוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־דִבֶּר שָׁאוּל מְאוּמָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי אָמַר מִקְרֶה הוּא בִּלְתִּי טָהוֹר הוּא כִּי־לֹא טָהוֹר׃

english.text:
That day, however, Saul said nothing. “It’s accidental,” he
thought. “He must be unclean and not yet cleansed.”

translation.text: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.

verses.english:
That day, however, Saul said nothing. “It’s accidental,” he
thought. “He must be unclean and not yet cleansed.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרַת הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי וַיִּפָּקֵד מְקוֹם דָּוִדוַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ מַדּוּעַ לֹא־בָא בֶן־יִשַׁי גַּם־תְּמוֹל גַּם־הַיּוֹם אֶל־הַלָּחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרַת הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי וַיִּפָּקֵד מְקוֹם דָּוִדוַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ מַדּוּעַ לֹא־בָא בֶן־יִשַׁי גַּם־תְּמוֹל גַּם־הַיּוֹם אֶל־הַלָּחֶם׃

english.text:
But on the day after the new moon, the second day, David’s place
was vacant again. So Saul said to his son Jonathan, “Why didn’t
the son of Jesse come to the meal yesterday or today?”

translation.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month, that David’s place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?

verses.english:
But on the day after the new moon, the second day, David’s place
was vacant again. So Saul said to his son Jonathan, “Why didn’t
the son of Jesse come to the meal yesterday or today?”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־שָׁאוּל נִשְׁאֹל נִשְׁאַל דָּוִד מֵעִמָּדִי עַד־בֵּית לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־שָׁאוּל נִשְׁאֹל נִשְׁאַל דָּוִד מֵעִמָּדִי עַד־בֵּית לָחֶם׃

english.text:
Jonathan answered Saul, “David begged leave of me to go to
Bethlehem.

translation.text: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Bethlehem:

verses.english:
Jonathan answered Saul, “David begged leave of me to go to
Bethlehem.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שַׁלְּחֵנִי נָא כִּי זֶבַח מִשְׁפָּחָה לָנוּ בָּעִיר וְהוּא צִוָּה־לִי אָחִי וְעַתָּה אִם־מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אִמָּלְטָה נָּא וְאֶרְאֶה אֶת־אֶחָי עַל־כֵּן לֹא־בָא
אֶל־שֻׁלְחַן הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שַׁלְּחֵנִי נָא כִּי זֶבַח מִשְׁפָּחָה לָנוּ בָּעִיר וְהוּא צִוָּה־לִי אָחִי וְעַתָּה אִם־מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אִמָּלְטָה נָּא וְאֶרְאֶה אֶת־אֶחָי עַל־כֵּן לֹא־בָא
אֶל־שֻׁלְחַן הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
He said, ‘Please let me go, for we are going to have a family
feast in our town and my brother has summoned me to it. Do me a
favor, let me slip away to see my kinsmen.’ That is why he has not
come to the king’s table.”

translation.text: And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favour in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not unto the king’s table.

verses.english:
He said, ‘Please let me go, for we are going to have a family
feast in our town and my brother has summoned me to it. Do me a
favor, let me slip away to see my kinsmen.’ That is why he has not
come to the king’s table.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף שָׁאוּל בִּיהוֹנָתָן וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בֶּן־נַעֲוַת הַמַּרְדּוּת הֲלוֹא יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־בֹחֵר אַתָּה לְבֶן־יִשַׁי לְבשְׁתְּךָ וּלְבֹשֶׁת עֶרְוַת אִמֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר־אַף שָׁאוּל בִּיהוֹנָתָן וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בֶּן־נַעֲוַת הַמַּרְדּוּת הֲלוֹא יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־בֹחֵר אַתָּה לְבֶן־יִשַׁי לְבשְׁתְּךָ וּלְבֹשֶׁת עֶרְוַת אִמֶּךָ׃

english.text:
Saul flew into a rage against Jonathan. “You son of a perverse,
rebellious woman!” he shouted. “I know that you side with the son
of Jesse—to your shame, and to the shame of your mother’s
nakedness!

translation.text: Then Saul’s anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother’s nakedness?

verses.english:
Saul flew into a rage against Jonathan. “You son of a perverse,
rebellious woman!” he shouted. “I know that you side with the son
of Jesse—to your shame, and to the shame of your mother’s
nakedness!

verses.hebrew: כִּי כל־הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר בֶּן־יִשַׁי חַי עַל־הָאֲדָמָה לֹא תִכּוֹן אַתָּה וּמַלְכוּתֶךָ וְעַתָּה שְׁלַח וְקַח אֹתוֹ אֵלַי כִּי בֶן־מָוֶת הוּא׃

hebrew.text: כִּי כל־הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר בֶּן־יִשַׁי חַי עַל־הָאֲדָמָה לֹא תִכּוֹן אַתָּה וּמַלְכוּתֶךָ וְעַתָּה שְׁלַח וְקַח אֹתוֹ אֵלַי כִּי בֶן־מָוֶת הוּא׃

english.text:
For as long as the son of Jesse lives on earth, neither you nor
your kingship will be secure. Now then, have him brought to me,
for he is marked for death.”

translation.text: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.

verses.english:
For as long as the son of Jesse lives on earth, neither you nor
your kingship will be secure. Now then, have him brought to me,
for he is marked for death.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־שָׁאוּל אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לָמָּה יוּמַת מֶה עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־שָׁאוּל אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לָמָּה יוּמַת מֶה עָשָׂה׃

english.text:
But Jonathan spoke up and said to his father, “Why should he be
put to death? What has he done?”

translation.text: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?

verses.english:
But Jonathan spoke up and said to his father, “Why should he be
put to death? What has he done?”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּטֶל שָׁאוּל אֶת־הַחֲנִית עָלָיו לְהַכֹּתוֹ וַיֵּדַע יְהוֹנָתָן כִּי־כָלָה הִיא מֵעִם אָבִיו לְהָמִית אֶת־דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּטֶל שָׁאוּל אֶת־הַחֲנִית עָלָיו לְהַכֹּתוֹ וַיֵּדַע יְהוֹנָתָן כִּי־כָלָה הִיא מֵעִם אָבִיו לְהָמִית אֶת־דָּוִד׃

english.text:
At that, Saul threw his spear at him to strike him down; and
Jonathan realized that his father was determined to do away with
David.

translation.text: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.

verses.english:
At that, Saul threw his spear at him to strike him down; and
Jonathan realized that his father was determined to do away with
David.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם יְהוֹנָתָן מֵעִם הַשֻּׁלְחָן בּחֳרִי־אָף וְלֹא־אָכַל בְּיוֹם־הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי לֶחֶם כִּי נֶעְצַב אֶל־דָּוִד כִּי הִכְלִמוֹ אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם יְהוֹנָתָן מֵעִם הַשֻּׁלְחָן בּחֳרִי־אָף וְלֹא־אָכַל בְּיוֹם־הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי לֶחֶם כִּי נֶעְצַב אֶל־דָּוִד כִּי הִכְלִמוֹ אָבִיו׃

english.text:
Jonathan rose from the table in a rage. He ate no food on the
second day of the new moon, because he was grieved about David,
and because his father had humiliated him.

translation.text: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.

verses.english:
Jonathan rose from the table in a rage. He ate no food on the
second day of the new moon, because he was grieved about David,
and because his father had humiliated him.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַיֵּצֵא יְהוֹנָתָן הַשָּׂדֶה לְמוֹעֵד דָּוִד וְנַעַר קָטֹן עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַיֵּצֵא יְהוֹנָתָן הַשָּׂדֶה לְמוֹעֵד דָּוִד וְנַעַר קָטֹן עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
In the morning, Jonathan went out into the open for the meeting
with David, accompanied by a young boy.

translation.text: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.

verses.english:
In the morning, Jonathan went out into the open for the meeting
with David, accompanied by a young boy.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְנַעֲרוֹ רֻץ מְצָא נָא אֶת־הַחִצִּים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מוֹרֶה הַנַּעַר רָץ וְהוּא־יָרָה הַחֵצִי לְהַעֲבִרוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְנַעֲרוֹ רֻץ מְצָא נָא אֶת־הַחִצִּים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מוֹרֶה הַנַּעַר רָץ וְהוּא־יָרָה הַחֵצִי לְהַעֲבִרוֹ׃

english.text:
He said to the boy, “Run ahead and find the arrows that I shoot.”
And as the boy ran, he shot the arrows past him.

translation.text: And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

verses.english:
He said to the boy, “Run ahead and find the arrows that I shoot.”
And as the boy ran, he shot the arrows past him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַנַּעַר עַד־מְקוֹם הַחֵצִי אֲשֶׁר יָרָה יְהוֹנָתָן וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹנָתָן אַחֲרֵי הַנַּעַר וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא הַחֵצִי מִמְּךָ וָהָלְאָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא הַנַּעַר עַד־מְקוֹם הַחֵצִי אֲשֶׁר יָרָה יְהוֹנָתָן וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹנָתָן אַחֲרֵי הַנַּעַר וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא הַחֵצִי מִמְּךָ וָהָלְאָה׃

english.text:
When the boy came to the place where the arrows shot by Jonathan
had fallen, Jonathan called out to the boy, “Hey, the arrows are
beyond you!”

translation.text: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow beyond thee?

verses.english:
When the boy came to the place where the arrows shot by Jonathan
had fallen, Jonathan called out to the boy, “Hey, the arrows are
beyond you!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹנָתָן אַחֲרֵי הַנַּעַר מְהֵרָה חוּשָׁה אַל־תַּעֲמֹד וַיְלַקֵּט נַעַר יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־[הַחִצִּים] (החצי) וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אֲדֹנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוֹנָתָן אַחֲרֵי הַנַּעַר מְהֵרָה חוּשָׁה אַל־תַּעֲמֹד וַיְלַקֵּט נַעַר יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־[הַחִצִּים] (החצי) וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אֲדֹנָיו׃

english.text:
And Jonathan called after the boy, “Quick, hurry up. Don’t stop!”
So Jonathan’s boy gathered the arrows and came back to his
master.—

translation.text: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan’s lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.

verses.english:
And Jonathan called after the boy, “Quick, hurry up. Don’t stop!”
So Jonathan’s boy gathered the arrows and came back to his
master.—

verses.hebrew: וְהַנַּעַר לֹא־יָדַע מְאוּמָה אַךְ יְהוֹנָתָן וְדָוִד יָדְעוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנַּעַר לֹא־יָדַע מְאוּמָה אַךְ יְהוֹנָתָן וְדָוִד יָדְעוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר׃

english.text:
The boy suspected nothing; only Jonathan and David knew the
arrangement.—

translation.text: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

verses.english:
The boy suspected nothing; only Jonathan and David knew the
arrangement.—

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־כֵּלָיו אֶל־הַנַּעַר אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ הָבֵיא הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־כֵּלָיו אֶל־הַנַּעַר אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ הָבֵיא הָעִיר׃

english.text:
Jonathan handed the gear to his boy and told him, “Take these back
to the town.”

translation.text: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.

verses.english:
Jonathan handed the gear to his boy and told him, “Take these back
to the town.”

verses.hebrew:
הַנַּעַר בָּא וְדָוִד קָם מֵאֵצֶל הַנֶּגֶב וַיִּפֹּל לְאַפָּיו אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים וַיִּשְּׁקוּ אִישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ וַיִּבְכּוּ אִישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ עַד־דָּוִד
הִגְדִּיל׃

hebrew.text:
הַנַּעַר בָּא וְדָוִד קָם מֵאֵצֶל הַנֶּגֶב וַיִּפֹּל לְאַפָּיו אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים וַיִּשְּׁקוּ אִישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ וַיִּבְכּוּ אִישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ עַד־דָּוִד
הִגְדִּיל׃

english.text:
When the boy got there, David emerged from his concealment at the
Negeb. He flung himself face down on the ground and bowed low
three times. They kissed each other and wept together; David wept
the longer.

translation.text: And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.

verses.english:
When the boy got there, David emerged from his concealment at the
Negeb. He flung himself face down on the ground and bowed low
three times. They kissed each other and wept together; David wept
the longer.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן לְדָוִד לֵךְ לְשָׁלוֹם אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְנוּ שְׁנֵינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה יִהְיֶה בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ וּבֵין זַרְעִי וּבֵין זַרְעֲךָ
עַד־עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן לְדָוִד לֵךְ לְשָׁלוֹם אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְנוּ שְׁנֵינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה יִהְיֶה בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ וּבֵין זַרְעִי וּבֵין זַרְעֲךָ
עַד־עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace! For we two have sworn to
each other in the name of YHWH: ‘May YHWH be [witness] between you
and me, and between your offspring and mine, forever!’”

translation.text: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.

verses.english:
Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace! For we two have sworn to
each other in the name of YHWH: ‘May YHWH be [witness] between you
and me, and between your offspring and mine, forever!’”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם וַיֵּלַךְ וִיהוֹנָתָן בָּא הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם וַיֵּלַךְ וִיהוֹנָתָן בָּא הָעִיר׃

english.text: David then went his way, and Jonathan returned to the town.

translation.text: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said unto him, Why art thou alone, and no man with thee?

verses.english: David then went his way, and Jonathan returned to the town.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד נֹבֶה אֶל־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ הַכֹּהֵן וַיֶּחֱרַד אֲחִימֶלֶךְ לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מַדּוּעַ אַתָּה לְבַדֶּךָ וְאִישׁ אֵין אִתָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד נֹבֶה אֶל־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ הַכֹּהֵן וַיֶּחֱרַד אֲחִימֶלֶךְ לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מַדּוּעַ אַתָּה לְבַדֶּךָ וְאִישׁ אֵין אִתָּךְ׃

english.text:
David went to the priest Ahimelech at Nob. Ahimelech came out in
alarm to meet David, and he said to him, “Why are you alone, and
no one with you?”

translation.text: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest, The king hath commanded me a business, and hath said unto me, Let no man know any thing of the business whereabout I send thee, and what I have commanded thee: and I have appointed my servants to such and such a place.

verses.english:
David went to the priest Ahimelech at Nob. Ahimelech came out in
alarm to meet David, and he said to him, “Why are you alone, and
no one with you?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ הַכֹּהֵן הַמֶּלֶךְ צִוַּנִי דָבָר וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי אִישׁ אַל־יֵדַע מְאוּמָה אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־אָנֹכִי שֹׁלֵחֲךָ וַאֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִךָ
וְאֶת־הַנְּעָרִים יוֹדַעְתִּי אֶל־מְקוֹם פְּלֹנִי אַלְמוֹנִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ הַכֹּהֵן הַמֶּלֶךְ צִוַּנִי דָבָר וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי אִישׁ אַל־יֵדַע מְאוּמָה אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־אָנֹכִי שֹׁלֵחֲךָ וַאֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִךָ
וְאֶת־הַנְּעָרִים יוֹדַעְתִּי אֶל־מְקוֹם פְּלֹנִי אַלְמוֹנִי׃

english.text:
David answered the priest Ahimelech, “The king has ordered me on a
mission, and he said to me, ‘No one must know anything about the
mission on which I am sending you and for which I have given you
orders.’ So I have directed [my] young men to such and such a
place.

translation.text: Now therefore what is under thine hand? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand, or what there is present.

verses.english:
David answered the priest Ahimelech, “The king has ordered me on a
mission, and he said to me, ‘No one must know anything about the
mission on which I am sending you and for which I have given you
orders.’ So I have directed [my] young men to such and such a
place.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה מַה־יֵּשׁ תַּחַת־יָדְךָ חֲמִשָּׁה־לֶחֶם תְּנָה בְיָדִי אוֹ הַנִּמְצָא׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה מַה־יֵּשׁ תַּחַת־יָדְךָ חֲמִשָּׁה־לֶחֶם תְּנָה בְיָדִי אוֹ הַנִּמְצָא׃

english.text:
Now then, what have you got on hand? Any loaves of bread? Let me
have them—or whatever is available.”

translation.text: And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread under mine hand, but there is hallowed bread; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.

verses.english:
Now then, what have you got on hand? Any loaves of bread? Let me
have them—or whatever is available.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין־לֶחֶם חֹל אֶל־תַּחַת יָדִי כִּי־אִם־לֶחֶם קֹדֶשׁ יֵשׁ אִם־נִשְׁמְרוּ הַנְּעָרִים אַךְ מֵאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין־לֶחֶם חֹל אֶל־תַּחַת יָדִי כִּי־אִם־לֶחֶם קֹדֶשׁ יֵשׁ אִם־נִשְׁמְרוּ הַנְּעָרִים אַךְ מֵאִשָּׁה׃

translation.text: And David answered the priest, and said unto him, Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days, since I came out, and the vessels of the young men are holy, and the bread is in a manner common, yea, though it were sanctified this day in the vessel.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן דָּוִד אֶת־הַכֹּהֵן וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כִּי אִם־אִשָּׁה עֲצֻרָה־לָנוּ כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם בְּצֵאתִי וַיִּהְיוּ כְלֵי־הַנְּעָרִים קֹדֶשׁ וְהוּא דֶּרֶךְ חֹל וְאַף כִּי הַיּוֹם
יִקְדַּשׁ בַּכֶּלִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן דָּוִד אֶת־הַכֹּהֵן וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כִּי אִם־אִשָּׁה עֲצֻרָה־לָנוּ כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם בְּצֵאתִי וַיִּהְיוּ כְלֵי־הַנְּעָרִים קֹדֶשׁ וְהוּא דֶּרֶךְ חֹל וְאַף כִּי הַיּוֹם
יִקְדַּשׁ בַּכֶּלִי׃

english.text:
In reply to the priest, David said, “I assure you that women have
been kept from us, as always. Whenever I went on a mission, even
if the journey was a common one, the vessels of the young men were
consecrated; all the more then may consecrated food be put into
their vessels today.”

translation.text: So the priest gave him hallowed bread: for there was no bread there but the shewbread, that was taken from before the LORD, to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away.

verses.english:
In reply to the priest, David said, “I assure you that women have
been kept from us, as always. Whenever I went on a mission, even
if the journey was a common one, the vessels of the young men were
consecrated; all the more then may consecrated food be put into
their vessels today.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ הַכֹּהֵן קֹדֶשׁ כִּי לֹא־הָיָה שָׁם לֶחֶם כִּי־אִם־לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים הַמּוּסָרִים מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לָשׂוּם לֶחֶם חֹם בְּיוֹם הִלָּקְחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ הַכֹּהֵן קֹדֶשׁ כִּי לֹא־הָיָה שָׁם לֶחֶם כִּי־אִם־לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים הַמּוּסָרִים מִלִּפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לָשׂוּם לֶחֶם חֹם בְּיוֹם הִלָּקְחוֹ׃

english.text:
So the priest gave him consecrated bread, because there was none
there except the bread of display, which had been removed from the
presence of YHWH, to be replaced by warm bread as soon as it was
taken away.—

translation.text: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the LORD; and his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul.

verses.english:
So the priest gave him consecrated bread, because there was none
there except the bread of display, which had been removed from the
presence of YHWH, to be replaced by warm bread as soon as it was
taken away.—

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁם אִישׁ מֵעַבְדֵי שָׁאוּל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא נֶעְצָר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּשְׁמוֹ דֹּאֵג הָאֲדֹמִי אַבִּיר הָרֹעִים אֲשֶׁר לְשָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁם אִישׁ מֵעַבְדֵי שָׁאוּל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא נֶעְצָר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּשְׁמוֹ דֹּאֵג הָאֲדֹמִי אַבִּיר הָרֹעִים אֲשֶׁר לְשָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
Now one of Saul’s officials was there that day, detained before
YHWH; his name was Doeg the Edomite, Saul’s chief herdsman.

translation.text: And David said unto Ahimelech, And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste.

verses.english:
Now one of Saul’s officials was there that day, detained before
YHWH; his name was Doeg the Edomite, Saul’s chief herdsman.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ וְאִין יֶשׁ־פֹּה תַחַת־יָדְךָ חֲנִית אוֹ־חָרֶב כִּי גַם־חַרְבִּי וְגַם־כֵּלַי לֹא־לָקַחְתִּי בְיָדִי כִּי־הָיָה דְבַר־הַמֶּלֶךְ נָחוּץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ וְאִין יֶשׁ־פֹּה תַחַת־יָדְךָ חֲנִית אוֹ־חָרֶב כִּי גַם־חַרְבִּי וְגַם־כֵּלַי לֹא־לָקַחְתִּי בְיָדִי כִּי־הָיָה דְבַר־הַמֶּלֶךְ נָחוּץ׃

english.text:
David said to Ahimelech, “Haven’t you got a spear or sword on
hand? I didn’t take my sword or any of my weapons with me, because
the king’s mission was urgent.”

translation.text: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom thou slewest in the valley of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod: if thou wilt take that, take it: for there is no other save that here. And David said, There is none like that; give it me.

verses.english:
David said to Ahimelech, “Haven’t you got a spear or sword on
hand? I didn’t take my sword or any of my weapons with me, because
the king’s mission was urgent.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר הַכֹּהֵן חֶרֶב גּלְיָת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֲשֶׁר־הִכִּיתָ בְּעֵמֶק הָאֵלָה הִנֵּה־הִיא לוּטָה בַשִּׂמְלָה אַחֲרֵי הָאֵפוֹד אִם־אֹתָהּ תִּקַּח־לְךָ קָח כִּי אֵין אַחֶרֶת
זוּלָתָהּ בָּזֶהוַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֵין כָּמוֹהָ תְּנֶנָּה לִּי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר הַכֹּהֵן חֶרֶב גּלְיָת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֲשֶׁר־הִכִּיתָ בְּעֵמֶק הָאֵלָה הִנֵּה־הִיא לוּטָה בַשִּׂמְלָה אַחֲרֵי הָאֵפוֹד אִם־אֹתָהּ תִּקַּח־לְךָ קָח כִּי אֵין אַחֶרֶת
זוּלָתָהּ בָּזֶהוַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֵין כָּמוֹהָ תְּנֶנָּה לִּי׃

english.text:
The priest said, “There is the sword of Goliath the Philistine
whom you slew in the valley of Elah; it is over there, wrapped in
a cloth, behind the ephod. If you want to take that one, take it,
for there is none here but that one.” David replied, “There is
none like it; give it to me.”

translation.text: And David arose and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.

verses.english:
The priest said, “There is the sword of Goliath the Philistine
whom you slew in the valley of Elah; it is over there, wrapped in
a cloth, behind the ephod. If you want to take that one, take it,
for there is none here but that one.” David replied, “There is
none like it; give it to me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַיִּבְרַח בַּיּוֹם־הַהוּא מִפְּנֵי שָׁאוּל וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אָכִישׁ מֶלֶךְ גַּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַיִּבְרַח בַּיּוֹם־הַהוּא מִפְּנֵי שָׁאוּל וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אָכִישׁ מֶלֶךְ גַּת׃

english.text:
That day David continued on his flight from Saul and he came to
King Achish of Gath.

translation.text: And the servants of Achish said unto him, Is not this David the king of the land? did they not sing one to another of him in dances, saying, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

verses.english:
That day David continued on his flight from Saul and he came to
King Achish of Gath.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי אָכִישׁ אֵלָיו הֲלוֹא־זֶה דָוִד מֶלֶךְ הָאָרֶץ הֲלוֹא לָזֶה יַעֲנוּ בַמְּחֹלוֹת לֵאמֹר הִכָּה שָׁאוּל בַּאֲלָפָו וְדָוִד בְּרִבְבֹתָו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי אָכִישׁ אֵלָיו הֲלוֹא־זֶה דָוִד מֶלֶךְ הָאָרֶץ הֲלוֹא לָזֶה יַעֲנוּ בַמְּחֹלוֹת לֵאמֹר הִכָּה שָׁאוּל בַּאֲלָפָו וְדָוִד בְּרִבְבֹתָו׃

english.text:
The courtiers of Achish said to him, “Why, that’s David, king of
the land! That’s the one of whom they sing as they dance: Saul has
slain his thousands; David, his tens of thousands.”

translation.text: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath.

verses.english:
The courtiers of Achish said to him, “Why, that’s David, king of
the land! That’s the one of whom they sing as they dance: Saul has
slain his thousands; David, his tens of thousands.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם דָּוִד אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בִּלְבָבוֹ וַיִּרָא מְאֹד מִפְּנֵי אָכִישׁ מֶלֶךְ־גַּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם דָּוִד אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בִּלְבָבוֹ וַיִּרָא מְאֹד מִפְּנֵי אָכִישׁ מֶלֶךְ־גַּת׃

english.text:
These words worried David and he became very much afraid of King
Achish of Gath.

translation.text: And he changed his behaviour before them, and feigned himself mad in their hands, and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down upon his beard.

verses.english:
These words worried David and he became very much afraid of King
Achish of Gath.

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁנּוֹ אֶת־טַעְמוֹ בְּעֵינֵיהֶם וַיִּתְהֹלֵל בְּיָדָם וַיְתָו עַל־דַּלְתוֹת הַשַּׁעַר וַיּוֹרֶד רִירוֹ אֶל־זְקָנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁנּוֹ אֶת־טַעְמוֹ בְּעֵינֵיהֶם וַיִּתְהֹלֵל בְּיָדָם וַיְתָו עַל־דַּלְתוֹת הַשַּׁעַר וַיּוֹרֶד רִירוֹ אֶל־זְקָנוֹ׃

english.text:
So he concealed his good sense from them; he feigned madness for
their benefit. He scratched marks on the doors of the gate and let
his saliva run down his beard.

translation.text: Then said Achish unto his servants, Lo, ye see the man is mad: wherefore then have ye brought him to me?

verses.english:
So he concealed his good sense from them; he feigned madness for
their benefit. He scratched marks on the doors of the gate and let
his saliva run down his beard.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הִנֵּה תִרְאוּ אִישׁ מִשְׁתַּגֵּעַ לָמָּה תָּבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הִנֵּה תִרְאוּ אִישׁ מִשְׁתַּגֵּעַ לָמָּה תָּבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ אֵלָי׃

english.text:
And Achish said to his courtiers, “You see the man is raving; why
bring him to me?

translation.text: Have I need of mad men, that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?

verses.english:
And Achish said to his courtiers, “You see the man is raving; why
bring him to me?

verses.hebrew: חֲסַר מְשֻׁגָּעִים אָנִי כִּי־הֲבֵאתֶם אֶת־זֶה לְהִשְׁתַּגֵּעַ עָלָי הֲזֶה יָבוֹא אֶל־בֵּיתִי׃

hebrew.text: חֲסַר מְשֻׁגָּעִים אָנִי כִּי־הֲבֵאתֶם אֶת־זֶה לְהִשְׁתַּגֵּעַ עָלָי הֲזֶה יָבוֹא אֶל־בֵּיתִי׃

english.text:
Do I lack madmen that you have brought this fellow to rave for me?
Should this fellow enter my house?”

verses.english:
Do I lack madmen that you have brought this fellow to rave for me?
Should this fellow enter my house?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד מִשָּׁם וַיִּמָּלֵט אֶל־מְעָרַת עֲדֻלָּם וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶחָיו וְכל־בֵּית אָבִיו וַיֵּרְדוּ אֵלָיו שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד מִשָּׁם וַיִּמָּלֵט אֶל־מְעָרַת עֲדֻלָּם וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶחָיו וְכל־בֵּית אָבִיו וַיֵּרְדוּ אֵלָיו שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
David departed from there and escaped to the cave of Adullam; and
when his brothers and all his father’s house heard, they joined
him down there.

translation.text: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father’s house heard it, they went down thither to him.

verses.english:
David departed from there and escaped to the cave of Adullam; and
when his brothers and all his father’s house heard, they joined
him down there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקַבְּצוּ אֵלָיו כּל־אִישׁ מָצוֹק וְכל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ נֹשֶׁא וְכל־אִישׁ מַר־נֶפֶשׁ וַיְהִי עֲלֵיהֶם לְשָׂר וַיִּהְיוּ עִמּוֹ כְּאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְקַבְּצוּ אֵלָיו כּל־אִישׁ מָצוֹק וְכל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ נֹשֶׁא וְכל־אִישׁ מַר־נֶפֶשׁ וַיְהִי עֲלֵיהֶם לְשָׂר וַיִּהְיוּ עִמּוֹ כְּאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ׃

translation.text: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד מִשָּׁם מִצְפֵּה מוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב יֵצֵא־נָא אָבִי וְאִמִּי אִתְּכֶם עַד אֲשֶׁר אֵדַע מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד מִשָּׁם מִצְפֵּה מוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב יֵצֵא־נָא אָבִי וְאִמִּי אִתְּכֶם עַד אֲשֶׁר אֵדַע מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab, and he said to the king
of Moab, “Let my father and mother come [and stay] with you, until
I know what God will do for me.”

translation.text: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth, and be with you, till I know what God will do for me.

verses.english:
David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab, and he said to the king
of Moab, “Let my father and mother come [and stay] with you, until
I know what God will do for me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּנְחֵם אֶת־פְּנֵי מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וַיֵּשְׁבוּ עִמּוֹ כּל־יְמֵי הֱיוֹת־דָּוִד בַּמְּצוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּנְחֵם אֶת־פְּנֵי מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וַיֵּשְׁבוּ עִמּוֹ כּל־יְמֵי הֱיוֹת־דָּוִד בַּמְּצוּדָה׃

english.text:
So he led them to the king of Moab, and they stayed with him as
long as David remained in the stronghold.

translation.text: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold.

verses.english:
So he led them to the king of Moab, and they stayed with him as
long as David remained in the stronghold.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר גָּד הַנָּבִיא אֶל־דָּוִד לֹא תֵשֵׁב בַּמְּצוּדָה לֵךְ וּבָאתָ־לְּךָ אֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיָּבֹא יַעַר חָרֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר גָּד הַנָּבִיא אֶל־דָּוִד לֹא תֵשֵׁב בַּמְּצוּדָה לֵךְ וּבָאתָ־לְּךָ אֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיָּבֹא יַעַר חָרֶת׃

translation.text: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע שָׁאוּל כִּי נוֹדַע דָּוִד וַאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וְשָׁאוּל יוֹשֵׁב בַּגִּבְעָה תַּחַת־הָאֶשֶׁל בָּרָמָה וַחֲנִיתוֹ בְיָדוֹ וְכל־עֲבָדָיו נִצָּבִים עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע שָׁאוּל כִּי נוֹדַע דָּוִד וַאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וְשָׁאוּל יוֹשֵׁב בַּגִּבְעָה תַּחַת־הָאֶשֶׁל בָּרָמָה וַחֲנִיתוֹ בְיָדוֹ וְכל־עֲבָדָיו נִצָּבִים עָלָיו׃

english.text:
When Saul heard that David and the men with him had been
located—Saul was then in Gibeah, sitting under the tamarisk tree
on the height, spear in hand, with all his courtiers in attendance
upon him—

translation.text: When Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were with him, (now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, having his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him;)

verses.english:
When Saul heard that David and the men with him had been
located—Saul was then in Gibeah, sitting under the tamarisk tree
on the height, spear in hand, with all his courtiers in attendance
upon him—

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לַעֲבָדָיו הַנִּצָּבִים עָלָיו שִׁמְעוּ־נָא בְּנֵי יְמִינִי גַּם־לְכֻלְּכֶם יִתֵּן בֶּן־יִשַׁי שָׂדוֹת וּכְרָמִים לְכֻלְּכֶם יָשִׂים שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי
מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לַעֲבָדָיו הַנִּצָּבִים עָלָיו שִׁמְעוּ־נָא בְּנֵי יְמִינִי גַּם־לְכֻלְּכֶם יִתֵּן בֶּן־יִשַׁי שָׂדוֹת וּכְרָמִים לְכֻלְּכֶם יָשִׂים שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי
מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
Saul said to the courtiers standing about him, “Listen, men of
Benjamin! Will the son of Jesse give fields and vineyards to every
one of you? And will he make all of you captains of thousands or
captains of hundreds?

translation.text: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him, Hear now, ye Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, and make you all captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds;

verses.english:
Saul said to the courtiers standing about him, “Listen, men of
Benjamin! Will the son of Jesse give fields and vineyards to every
one of you? And will he make all of you captains of thousands or
captains of hundreds?

verses.hebrew:
כִּי קְשַׁרְתֶּם כֻּלְּכֶם עָלַי וְאֵין־גֹּלֶה אֶת־אזְנִי בִּכְרת־בְּנִי עִם־בֶּן־יִשַׁי וְאֵין־חֹלֶה מִכֶּם עָלַי וְגֹלֶה אֶת־אזְנִי כִּי הֵקִים בְּנִי אֶת־עַבְדִּי עָלַי לְאֹרֵב
כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי קְשַׁרְתֶּם כֻּלְּכֶם עָלַי וְאֵין־גֹּלֶה אֶת־אזְנִי בִּכְרת־בְּנִי עִם־בֶּן־יִשַׁי וְאֵין־חֹלֶה מִכֶּם עָלַי וְגֹלֶה אֶת־אזְנִי כִּי הֵקִים בְּנִי אֶת־עַבְדִּי עָלַי לְאֹרֵב
כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Is that why all of you have conspired against me? For no one
informs me when my own son makes a pact with the son of Jesse; no
one is concerned for me and no one informs me when my own son has
set my servant in ambush against me, as is now the case.”

translation.text: That all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you that is sorry for me, or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?

verses.english:
Is that why all of you have conspired against me? For no one
informs me when my own son makes a pact with the son of Jesse; no
one is concerned for me and no one informs me when my own son has
set my servant in ambush against me, as is now the case.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן דֹּאֵג הָאֲדֹמִי וְהוּא נִצָּב עַל־עַבְדֵי־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמַר רָאִיתִי אֶת־בֶּן־יִשַׁי בָּא נֹבֶה אֶל־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֲחִטוּב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן דֹּאֵג הָאֲדֹמִי וְהוּא נִצָּב עַל־עַבְדֵי־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמַר רָאִיתִי אֶת־בֶּן־יִשַׁי בָּא נֹבֶה אֶל־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֲחִטוּב׃

english.text:
Doeg the Edomite, who was standing among the courtiers of Saul,
spoke up: “I saw the son of Jesse come to Ahimelech son of Ahitub
at Nob.

translation.text: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, which was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

verses.english:
Doeg the Edomite, who was standing among the courtiers of Saul,
spoke up: “I saw the son of Jesse come to Ahimelech son of Ahitub
at Nob.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל־לוֹ בַּיהֹוָה וְצֵידָה נָתַן לוֹ וְאֵת חֶרֶב גּלְיָת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי נָתַן לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל־לוֹ בַּיהֹוָה וְצֵידָה נָתַן לוֹ וְאֵת חֶרֶב גּלְיָת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי נָתַן לוֹ׃

english.text:
He inquired of YHWH on his behalf and gave him provisions; he also
gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.”

translation.text: And he enquired of the LORD for him, and gave him victuals, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

verses.english:
He inquired of YHWH on his behalf and gave him provisions; he also
gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ לִקְרֹא אֶת־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֲחִיטוּב הַכֹּהֵן וְאֵת כּל־בֵּית אָבִיו הַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר בְּנֹב וַיָּבֹאוּ כֻלָּם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ לִקְרֹא אֶת־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֲחִיטוּב הַכֹּהֵן וְאֵת כּל־בֵּית אָבִיו הַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר בְּנֹב וַיָּבֹאוּ כֻלָּם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Thereupon the king sent for the priest Ahimelech son of Ahitub and
for all the priests belonging to his father’s house at Nob. They
all came to the king,
