translation.text: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests that were in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.

verses.english:
Thereupon the king sent for the priest Ahimelech son of Ahitub and
for all the priests belonging to his father’s house at Nob. They
all came to the king,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל שְׁמַע־נָא בֶּן־אֲחִיטוּב וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְנִי אֲדֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל שְׁמַע־נָא בֶּן־אֲחִיטוּב וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְנִי אֲדֹנִי׃

english.text:
and Saul said, “Listen to me, son of Ahitub.” “Yes, my lord,” he
replied.

translation.text: And Saul said, Hear now, thou son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am, my lord.

verses.english:
and Saul said, “Listen to me, son of Ahitub.” “Yes, my lord,” he
replied.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָו שָׁאוּל לָמָּה קְשַׁרְתֶּם עָלַי אַתָּה וּבֶן־יִשָׁי בְּתִתְּךָ לוֹ לֶחֶם וְחֶרֶב וְשָׁאוֹל לוֹ בֵּאלֹהִים לָקוּם אֵלַי לְאֹרֵב כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָו שָׁאוּל לָמָּה קְשַׁרְתֶּם עָלַי אַתָּה וּבֶן־יִשָׁי בְּתִתְּךָ לוֹ לֶחֶם וְחֶרֶב וְשָׁאוֹל לוֹ בֵּאלֹהִים לָקוּם אֵלַי לְאֹרֵב כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And Saul said to him, “Why have you and the son of Jesse conspired
against me? You gave him food and a sword, and inquired of God for
him—that he may rise in ambush against me, as is now the case.”

translation.text: And Saul said unto him, Why have ye conspired against me, thou and the son of Jesse, in that thou hast given him bread, and a sword, and hast enquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?

verses.english:
And Saul said to him, “Why have you and the son of Jesse conspired
against me? You gave him food and a sword, and inquired of God for
him—that he may rise in ambush against me, as is now the case.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֲחִימֶלֶךְ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמַר וּמִי בְכל־עֲבָדֶיךָ כְּדָוִד נֶאֱמָן וַחֲתַן הַמֶּלֶךְ וְסָר אֶל־מִשְׁמַעְתֶּךָ וְנִכְבָּד בְּבֵיתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן אֲחִימֶלֶךְ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמַר וּמִי בְכל־עֲבָדֶיךָ כְּדָוִד נֶאֱמָן וַחֲתַן הַמֶּלֶךְ וְסָר אֶל־מִשְׁמַעְתֶּךָ וְנִכְבָּד בְּבֵיתֶךָ׃

english.text:
Ahimelech replied to the king, “But who is there among all your
courtiers as trusted as David, son-in-law of Your Majesty and
obedient to your bidding, and esteemed in your household?

translation.text: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David, which is the king’s son in law, and goeth at thy bidding, and is honourable in thine house?

verses.english:
Ahimelech replied to the king, “But who is there among all your
courtiers as trusted as David, son-in-law of Your Majesty and
obedient to your bidding, and esteemed in your household?

verses.hebrew:
הַיּוֹם הַחִלֹּתִי (לשאול) [לִשְׁאל־]לוֹ בֵאלֹהִים חָלִילָה לִּי אַל־יָשֵׂם הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּעַבְדּוֹ דָבָר בְּכל־בֵּית אָבִי כִּי לֹא־יָדַע עַבְדְּךָ בְּכל־זֹאת דָּבָר קָטֹן אוֹ
גָדוֹל׃

hebrew.text:
הַיּוֹם הַחִלֹּתִי (לשאול) [לִשְׁאל־]לוֹ בֵאלֹהִים חָלִילָה לִּי אַל־יָשֵׂם הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּעַבְדּוֹ דָבָר בְּכל־בֵּית אָבִי כִּי לֹא־יָדַע עַבְדְּךָ בְּכל־זֹאת דָּבָר קָטֹן אוֹ
גָדוֹל׃

english.text:
This is the first time that I inquired of God for him; I have done
no wrong. Let not Your Majesty find fault with his servant [or]
with any of my father’s house; for your servant knew nothing
whatever about all this.”

translation.text: Did I then begin to enquire of God for him? be it far from me: let not the king impute any thing unto his servant, nor to all the house of my father: for thy servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.

verses.english:
This is the first time that I inquired of God for him; I have done
no wrong. Let not Your Majesty find fault with his servant [or]
with any of my father’s house; for your servant knew nothing
whatever about all this.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ מוֹת תָּמוּת אֲחִימֶלֶךְ אַתָּה וְכל־בֵּית אָבִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ מוֹת תָּמוּת אֲחִימֶלֶךְ אַתָּה וְכל־בֵּית אָבִיךָ׃

english.text:
But the king said, “You shall die, Ahimelech, you and all your
father’s house.”

translation.text: And the king said, Thou shalt surely die, Ahimelech, thou, and all thy father’s house.

verses.english:
But the king said, “You shall die, Ahimelech, you and all your
father’s house.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לָרָצִים הַנִּצָּבִים עָלָיו סֹבּוּ וְהָמִיתוּ כֹּהֲנֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי גַם־יָדָם עִם־דָּוִד וְכִי יָדְעוּ כִּי־בֹרֵחַ הוּא וְלֹא גָלוּ אֶת־[אזְנִי] (אזנו)
וְלֹא־אָבוּ עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לִשְׁלֹחַ אֶת־יָדָם לִפְגֹעַ בְּכֹהֲנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לָרָצִים הַנִּצָּבִים עָלָיו סֹבּוּ וְהָמִיתוּ כֹּהֲנֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי גַם־יָדָם עִם־דָּוִד וְכִי יָדְעוּ כִּי־בֹרֵחַ הוּא וְלֹא גָלוּ אֶת־[אזְנִי] (אזנו)
וְלֹא־אָבוּ עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לִשְׁלֹחַ אֶת־יָדָם לִפְגֹעַ בְּכֹהֲנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the king commanded the guards standing by, “Turn about and
kill the priests of YHWH, for they are in league with David; they
knew he was running away and they did not inform me.” But the
king’s servants would not raise a hand to strike down the priests
of YHWH.

translation.text: And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him, Turn, and slay the priests of the LORD: because their hand also is with David, and because they knew when he fled, and did not shew it to me. But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of the LORD.

verses.english:
And the king commanded the guards standing by, “Turn about and
kill the priests of YHWH, for they are in league with David; they
knew he was running away and they did not inform me.” But the
king’s servants would not raise a hand to strike down the priests
of YHWH.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ (לדויג) [לְדוֹאֵג] סֹב אַתָּה וּפְגַע בַּכֹּהֲנִים וַיִּסֹּב (דויג) [דּוֹאֵג] הָאֲדֹמִי וַיִּפְגַּע־הוּא בַּכֹּהֲנִים וַיָּמֶת בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא שְׁמֹנִים
וַחֲמִשָּׁה אִישׁ נֹשֵׂא אֵפוֹד בָּד׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ (לדויג) [לְדוֹאֵג] סֹב אַתָּה וּפְגַע בַּכֹּהֲנִים וַיִּסֹּב (דויג) [דּוֹאֵג] הָאֲדֹמִי וַיִּפְגַּע־הוּא בַּכֹּהֲנִים וַיָּמֶת בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא שְׁמֹנִים
וַחֲמִשָּׁה אִישׁ נֹשֵׂא אֵפוֹד בָּד׃

english.text:
Thereupon the king said to Doeg, “You, Doeg, go and strike down
the priests.” And Doeg the Edomite went and struck down the
priests himself; that day, he killed eighty-five men who wore the
linen ephod.

translation.text: And the king said to Doeg, Turn thou, and fall upon the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod.

verses.english:
Thereupon the king said to Doeg, “You, Doeg, go and strike down
the priests.” And Doeg the Edomite went and struck down the
priests himself; that day, he killed eighty-five men who wore the
linen ephod.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת נֹב עִיר־הַכֹּהֲנִים הִכָּה לְפִי־חֶרֶב מֵאִישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁה מֵעוֹלֵל וְעַד־יוֹנֵק וְשׁוֹר וַחֲמוֹר וָשֶׂה לְפִי־חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת נֹב עִיר־הַכֹּהֲנִים הִכָּה לְפִי־חֶרֶב מֵאִישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁה מֵעוֹלֵל וְעַד־יוֹנֵק וְשׁוֹר וַחֲמוֹר וָשֶׂה לְפִי־חָרֶב׃

english.text:
He put Nob, the town of the priests, to the sword: men and women,
children and infants, oxen, asses, and sheep—[all] to the sword.

translation.text: And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

verses.english:
He put Nob, the town of the priests, to the sword: men and women,
children and infants, oxen, asses, and sheep—[all] to the sword.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמָּלֵט בֵּן־אֶחָד לַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֲחִטוּב וּשְׁמוֹ אֶבְיָתָר וַיִּבְרַח אַחֲרֵי דָוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמָּלֵט בֵּן־אֶחָד לַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֲחִטוּב וּשְׁמוֹ אֶבְיָתָר וַיִּבְרַח אַחֲרֵי דָוִד׃

english.text:
But one son of Ahimelech son of Ahitub escaped—his name was
Abiathar—and he fled to David.

translation.text: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.

verses.english:
But one son of Ahimelech son of Ahitub escaped—his name was
Abiathar—and he fled to David.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד אֶבְיָתָר לְדָוִד כִּי הָרַג שָׁאוּל אֵת כֹּהֲנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֵּד אֶבְיָתָר לְדָוִד כִּי הָרַג שָׁאוּל אֵת כֹּהֲנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text: When Abiathar told David that Saul had killed the priests of YHWH,

translation.text: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the LORD’s priests.

verses.english: When Abiathar told David that Saul had killed the priests of YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לְאֶבְיָתָר יָדַעְתִּי בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי־שָׁם (דויג) [דּוֹאֵג] הָאֲדֹמִי כִּי־הַגֵּד יַגִּיד לְשָׁאוּל אָנֹכִי סַבֹּתִי בְּכל־נֶפֶשׁ בֵּית אָבִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לְאֶבְיָתָר יָדַעְתִּי בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי־שָׁם (דויג) [דּוֹאֵג] הָאֲדֹמִי כִּי־הַגֵּד יַגִּיד לְשָׁאוּל אָנֹכִי סַבֹּתִי בְּכל־נֶפֶשׁ בֵּית אָבִיךָ׃

english.text:
David said to Abiathar, “I knew that day, when Doeg the Edomite
was there, that he would tell Saul. I am to blame for all the
deaths in your father’s house.

translation.text: And David said unto Abiathar, I knew it that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father’s house.

verses.english:
David said to Abiathar, “I knew that day, when Doeg the Edomite
was there, that he would tell Saul. I am to blame for all the
deaths in your father’s house.

verses.hebrew: שְׁבָה אִתִּי אַל־תִּירָא כִּי אֲשֶׁר־יְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי יְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ כִּי־מִשְׁמֶרֶת אַתָּה עִמָּדִי׃

hebrew.text: שְׁבָה אִתִּי אַל־תִּירָא כִּי אֲשֶׁר־יְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי יְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ כִּי־מִשְׁמֶרֶת אַתָּה עִמָּדִי׃

english.text:
Stay with me; do not be afraid; for whoever seeks your life must
seek my life also. It will be my care to guard you.”

translation.text: Abide thou with me, fear not: for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: but with me thou shalt be in safeguard.

verses.english:
Stay with me; do not be afraid; for whoever seeks your life must
seek my life also. It will be my care to guard you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה פְלִשְׁתִּים נִלְחָמִים בִּקְעִילָה וְהֵמָּה שֹׁסִים אֶת־הַגֳּרָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה פְלִשְׁתִּים נִלְחָמִים בִּקְעִילָה וְהֵמָּה שֹׁסִים אֶת־הַגֳּרָנוֹת׃

english.text:
David was told: “The Philistines are raiding Keilah and plundering
the threshing floors.”

translation.text: Then they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshingfloors.

verses.english:
David was told: “The Philistines are raiding Keilah and plundering
the threshing floors.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַאֵלֵךְ וְהִכֵּיתִי בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים הָאֵלֶּהוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד לֵךְ וְהִכִּיתָ בַפְּלִשְׁתִּים וְהוֹשַׁעְתָּ אֶת־קְעִילָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַאֵלֵךְ וְהִכֵּיתִי בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים הָאֵלֶּהוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד לֵךְ וְהִכִּיתָ בַפְּלִשְׁתִּים וְהוֹשַׁעְתָּ אֶת־קְעִילָה׃

english.text:
David consulted YHWH, “Shall I go and attack those Philistines?”
And YHWH said to David, “Go; attack the Philistines and you will
save Keilah.”

translation.text: Therefore David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And the LORD said unto David, Go, and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah.

verses.english:
David consulted YHWH, “Shall I go and attack those Philistines?”
And YHWH said to David, “Go; attack the Philistines and you will
save Keilah.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי דָוִד אֵלָיו הִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ פֹה בִּיהוּדָה יְרֵאִים וְאַף כִּי־נֵלֵךְ קְעִלָה אֶל־מַעַרְכוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי דָוִד אֵלָיו הִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ פֹה בִּיהוּדָה יְרֵאִים וְאַף כִּי־נֵלֵךְ קְעִלָה אֶל־מַעַרְכוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
But David’s men said to him, “Look, we are afraid here in Judah,
how much more if we go to Keilah against the forces of the
Philistines!”

translation.text: And David’s men said unto him, Behold, we be afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?

verses.english:
But David’s men said to him, “Look, we are afraid here in Judah,
how much more if we go to Keilah against the forces of the
Philistines!”

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹסֶף עוֹד דָּוִד לִשְׁאוֹל בַּיהֹוָה וַיַּעֲנֵהוּ יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר קוּם רֵד קְעִילָה כִּי־אֲנִי נֹתֵן אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים בְּיָדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹסֶף עוֹד דָּוִד לִשְׁאוֹל בַּיהֹוָה וַיַּעֲנֵהוּ יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר קוּם רֵד קְעִילָה כִּי־אֲנִי נֹתֵן אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים בְּיָדֶךָ׃

english.text:
So David consulted YHWH again, and YHWH answered him, “March down
at once to Keilah, for I am going to deliver the Philistines into
your hands.”

translation.text: Then David enquired of the LORD yet again. And the LORD answered him and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into thine hand.

verses.english:
So David consulted YHWH again, and YHWH answered him, “March down
at once to Keilah, for I am going to deliver the Philistines into
your hands.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁו קְעִילָה וַיִּלָּחֶם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּנְהַג אֶת־מִקְנֵיהֶם וַיַּךְ בָּהֶם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה וַיֹּשַׁע דָּוִד אֵת יֹשְׁבֵי קְעִילָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁו קְעִילָה וַיִּלָּחֶם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּנְהַג אֶת־מִקְנֵיהֶם וַיַּךְ בָּהֶם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה וַיֹּשַׁע דָּוִד אֵת יֹשְׁבֵי קְעִילָה׃

english.text:
David and his men went to Keilah and fought against the
Philistines; he drove off their cattle and inflicted a severe
defeat on them. Thus David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

translation.text: So David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

verses.english:
David and his men went to Keilah and fought against the
Philistines; he drove off their cattle and inflicted a severe
defeat on them. Thus David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּבְרֹחַ אֶבְיָתָר בֶּן־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ אֶל־דָּוִד קְעִילָה אֵפוֹד יָרַד בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּבְרֹחַ אֶבְיָתָר בֶּן־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ אֶל־דָּוִד קְעִילָה אֵפוֹד יָרַד בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
When Abiathar son of Ahimelech fled to David at Keilah, he brought
down an ephod with him.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.

verses.english:
When Abiathar son of Ahimelech fled to David at Keilah, he brought
down an ephod with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְשָׁאוּל כִּי־בָא דָוִד קְעִילָה וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל נִכַּר אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים בְּיָדִי כִּי נִסְגַּר לָבוֹא בְּעִיר דְּלָתַיִם וּבְרִיחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לְשָׁאוּל כִּי־בָא דָוִד קְעִילָה וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל נִכַּר אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים בְּיָדִי כִּי נִסְגַּר לָבוֹא בְּעִיר דְּלָתַיִם וּבְרִיחַ׃

english.text:
Saul was told that David had come to Keilah, and Saul thought,
“God has delivered him into my hands, for he has shut himself in
by entering a town with gates and bars.”

translation.text: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah. And Saul said, God hath delivered him into mine hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that hath gates and bars.

verses.english:
Saul was told that David had come to Keilah, and Saul thought,
“God has delivered him into my hands, for he has shut himself in
by entering a town with gates and bars.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁמַּע שָׁאוּל אֶת־כּל־הָעָם לַמִּלְחָמָה לָרֶדֶת קְעִילָה לָצוּר אֶל־דָּוִד וְאֶל־אֲנָשָׁיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁמַּע שָׁאוּל אֶת־כּל־הָעָם לַמִּלְחָמָה לָרֶדֶת קְעִילָה לָצוּר אֶל־דָּוִד וְאֶל־אֲנָשָׁיו׃

english.text:
Saul summoned all the troops for war, to go down to Keilah and
besiege David and his men.

translation.text: And Saul called all the people together to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.

verses.english:
Saul summoned all the troops for war, to go down to Keilah and
besiege David and his men.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּדַע דָּוִד כִּי עָלָיו שָׁאוּל מַחֲרִישׁ הָרָעָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן הַגִּישָׁה הָאֵפוֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּדַע דָּוִד כִּי עָלָיו שָׁאוּל מַחֲרִישׁ הָרָעָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן הַגִּישָׁה הָאֵפוֹד׃

english.text:
When David learned that Saul was planning to harm him, he told the
priest Abiathar to bring the ephod forward.

translation.text: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.

verses.english:
When David learned that Saul was planning to harm him, he told the
priest Abiathar to bring the ephod forward.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁמֹעַ שָׁמַע עַבְדְּךָ כִּי־מְבַקֵּשׁ שָׁאוּל לָבוֹא אֶל־קְעִילָה לְשַׁחֵת לָעִיר בַּעֲבוּרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁמֹעַ שָׁמַע עַבְדְּךָ כִּי־מְבַקֵּשׁ שָׁאוּל לָבוֹא אֶל־קְעִילָה לְשַׁחֵת לָעִיר בַּעֲבוּרִי׃

english.text:
And David said, “O LORD, God of Israel, Your servant has heard
that Saul intends to come to Keilah and destroy the town because
of me.

translation.text: Then said David, O LORD God of Israel, thy servant hath certainly heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.

verses.english:
And David said, “O LORD, God of Israel, Your servant has heard
that Saul intends to come to Keilah and destroy the town because
of me.

verses.hebrew: הֲיַסְגִּרֻנִי בַעֲלֵי קְעִילָה בְיָדוֹ הֲיֵרֵד שָׁאוּל כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע עַבְדֶּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַגֶּד־נָא לְעַבְדֶּךָוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה יֵרֵד׃

hebrew.text: הֲיַסְגִּרֻנִי בַעֲלֵי קְעִילָה בְיָדוֹ הֲיֵרֵד שָׁאוּל כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע עַבְדֶּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַגֶּד־נָא לְעַבְדֶּךָוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה יֵרֵד׃

english.text:
Will the citizens of Keilah deliver me into his hands? Will Saul
come down, as Your servant has heard? O LORD, God of Israel, tell
Your servant!” And YHWH said, “He will.”

translation.text: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as thy servant hath heard? O LORD God of Israel, I beseech thee, tell thy servant. And the LORD said, He will come down.

verses.english:
Will the citizens of Keilah deliver me into his hands? Will Saul
come down, as Your servant has heard? O LORD, God of Israel, tell
Your servant!” And YHWH said, “He will.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד הֲיַסְגִּרוּ בַּעֲלֵי קְעִילָה אֹתִי וְאֶת־אֲנָשַׁי בְּיַד־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה יַסְגִּירוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד הֲיַסְגִּרוּ בַּעֲלֵי קְעִילָה אֹתִי וְאֶת־אֲנָשַׁי בְּיַד־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה יַסְגִּירוּ׃

english.text:
David continued, “Will the citizens of Keilah deliver me and my
men into Saul’s hands?” And YHWH answered, “They will.”

translation.text: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul? And the LORD said, They will deliver thee up.

verses.english:
David continued, “Will the citizens of Keilah deliver me and my
men into Saul’s hands?” And YHWH answered, “They will.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו כְּשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיֵּצְאוּ מִקְּעִלָה וַיִּתְהַלְּכוּ בַּאֲשֶׁר יִתְהַלָּכוּ וּלְשָׁאוּל הֻגַּד כִּי־נִמְלַט דָּוִד מִקְּעִילָה וַיֶּחְדַּל לָצֵאת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו כְּשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיֵּצְאוּ מִקְּעִלָה וַיִּתְהַלְּכוּ בַּאֲשֶׁר יִתְהַלָּכוּ וּלְשָׁאוּל הֻגַּד כִּי־נִמְלַט דָּוִד מִקְּעִילָה וַיֶּחְדַּל לָצֵאת׃

english.text:
So David and his men, about six hundred in number, left Keilah at
once and moved about wherever they could. And when Saul was told
that David had got away from Keilah, he did not set out.

translation.text: Then David and his men, which were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah, and went whithersoever they could go. And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah; and he forbare to go forth.

verses.english:
So David and his men, about six hundred in number, left Keilah at
once and moved about wherever they could. And when Saul was told
that David had got away from Keilah, he did not set out.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד בַּמִּדְבָּר בַּמְּצָדוֹת וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהָר בְּמִדְבַּר־זִיף וַיְבַקְשֵׁהוּ שָׁאוּל כּל־הַיָּמִים וְלֹא־נְתָנוֹ אֱלֹהִים בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד בַּמִּדְבָּר בַּמְּצָדוֹת וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהָר בְּמִדְבַּר־זִיף וַיְבַקְשֵׁהוּ שָׁאוּל כּל־הַיָּמִים וְלֹא־נְתָנוֹ אֱלֹהִים בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
David was staying in the strongholds of the wilderness [of Judah];
he stayed in the hill country, in the wilderness of Ziph. Saul
searched for him constantly, but God did not deliver him into his
hands.

translation.text: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not into his hand.

verses.english:
David was staying in the strongholds of the wilderness [of Judah];
he stayed in the hill country, in the wilderness of Ziph. Saul
searched for him constantly, but God did not deliver him into his
hands.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא דָּוִד כִּי־יָצָא שָׁאוּל לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ וְדָוִד בְּמִדְבַּר־זִיף בַּחֹרְשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא דָּוִד כִּי־יָצָא שָׁאוּל לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ וְדָוִד בְּמִדְבַּר־זִיף בַּחֹרְשָׁה׃

english.text:
David was once at Horesh in the wilderness of Ziph, when David
learned that Saul had come out to seek his life.

translation.text: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life: and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.

verses.english:
David was once at Horesh in the wilderness of Ziph, when David
learned that Saul had come out to seek his life.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־דָּוִד חֹרְשָׁה וַיְחַזֵּק אֶת־יָדוֹ בֵּאלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־דָּוִד חֹרְשָׁה וַיְחַזֵּק אֶת־יָדוֹ בֵּאלֹהִים׃

english.text:
And Saul’s son Jonathan came to David at Horesh and encouraged him
in [the name of] God.

translation.text: And Jonathan Saul’s son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.

verses.english:
And Saul’s son Jonathan came to David at Horesh and encouraged him
in [the name of] God.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַל־תִּירָא כִּי לֹא תִמְצָאֲךָ יַד שָׁאוּל אָבִי וְאַתָּה תִּמְלֹךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה־לְּךָ לְמִשְׁנֶה וְגַם־שָׁאוּל אָבִי יֹדֵעַ כֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַל־תִּירָא כִּי לֹא תִמְצָאֲךָ יַד שָׁאוּל אָבִי וְאַתָּה תִּמְלֹךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה־לְּךָ לְמִשְׁנֶה וְגַם־שָׁאוּל אָבִי יֹדֵעַ כֵּן׃

english.text:
He said to him, “Do not be afraid: the hand of my father Saul will
never touch you. You are going to be king over Israel and I shall
be second to you; and even my father Saul knows this is so.”

translation.text: And he said unto him, Fear not: for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee; and thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next unto thee; and that also Saul my father knoweth.

verses.english:
He said to him, “Do not be afraid: the hand of my father Saul will
never touch you. You are going to be king over Israel and I shall
be second to you; and even my father Saul knows this is so.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם בְּרִית לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד בַּחֹרְשָׁה וִיהוֹנָתָן הָלַךְ לְבֵיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְרְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם בְּרִית לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד בַּחֹרְשָׁה וִיהוֹנָתָן הָלַךְ לְבֵיתוֹ׃

english.text:
And the two of them entered into a pact before YHWH. David
remained in Horesh, and Jonathan went home.

translation.text: And they two made a covenant before the LORD: and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.

verses.english:
And the two of them entered into a pact before YHWH. David
remained in Horesh, and Jonathan went home.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ זִפִים אֶל־שָׁאוּל הַגִּבְעָתָה לֵאמֹר הֲלוֹא דָוִד מִסְתַּתֵּר עִמָּנוּ בַמְּצָדוֹת בַּחֹרְשָׁה בְּגִבְעַת הַחֲכִילָה אֲשֶׁר מִימִין הַיְשִׁימוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ זִפִים אֶל־שָׁאוּל הַגִּבְעָתָה לֵאמֹר הֲלוֹא דָוִד מִסְתַּתֵּר עִמָּנוּ בַמְּצָדוֹת בַּחֹרְשָׁה בְּגִבְעַת הַחֲכִילָה אֲשֶׁר מִימִין הַיְשִׁימוֹן׃

english.text:
Some Ziphites went up to Saul in Gibeah and said, “David is hiding
among us in the strongholds of Horesh, at the hill of Hachilah
south of Jeshimon.

translation.text: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?

verses.english:
Some Ziphites went up to Saul in Gibeah and said, “David is hiding
among us in the strongholds of Horesh, at the hill of Hachilah
south of Jeshimon.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לְכל־אַוַּת נַפְשְׁךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ לָרֶדֶת רֵד וְלָנוּ הַסְגִּירוֹ בְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לְכל־אַוַּת נַפְשְׁךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ לָרֶדֶת רֵד וְלָנוּ הַסְגִּירוֹ בְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
So if Your Majesty has the desire to come down, come down, and it
will be our task to deliver him into Your Majesty’s hands.”

translation.text: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king’s hand.

verses.english:
So if Your Majesty has the desire to come down, come down, and it
will be our task to deliver him into Your Majesty’s hands.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל בְּרוּכִים אַתֶּם לַיהֹוָה כִּי חֲמַלְתֶּם עָלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל בְּרוּכִים אַתֶּם לַיהֹוָה כִּי חֲמַלְתֶּם עָלָי׃

english.text:
And Saul replied, “May you be blessed of YHWH for the compassion
you have shown me!

translation.text: And Saul said, Blessed be ye of the LORD; for ye have compassion on me.

verses.english:
And Saul replied, “May you be blessed of YHWH for the compassion
you have shown me!

verses.hebrew: לְכוּ־נָא הָכִינוּ עוֹד וּדְעוּ וּרְאוּ אֶת־מְקוֹמוֹ אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶה רַגְלוֹ מִי רָאָהוּ שָׁם כִּי אָמַר אֵלַי עָרוֹם יַעְרִם הוּא׃

hebrew.text: לְכוּ־נָא הָכִינוּ עוֹד וּדְעוּ וּרְאוּ אֶת־מְקוֹמוֹ אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶה רַגְלוֹ מִי רָאָהוּ שָׁם כִּי אָמַר אֵלַי עָרוֹם יַעְרִם הוּא׃

english.text:
Go now and prepare further. Look around and learn what places he
sets foot on [and] who has seen him there, for I have been told he
is a very cunning fellow.

translation.text: Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who hath seen him there: for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly.

verses.english:
Go now and prepare further. Look around and learn what places he
sets foot on [and] who has seen him there, for I have been told he
is a very cunning fellow.

verses.hebrew:
וּרְאוּ וּדְעוּ מִכֹּל הַמַּחֲבֹאִים אֲשֶׁר יִתְחַבֵּא שָׁם וְשַׁבְתֶּם אֵלַי אֶל־נָכוֹן וְהָלַכְתִּי אִתְּכֶם וְהָיָה אִם־יֶשְׁנוֹ בָאָרֶץ וְחִפַּשְׂתִּי אֹתוֹ בְּכֹל אַלְפֵי
יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text:
וּרְאוּ וּדְעוּ מִכֹּל הַמַּחֲבֹאִים אֲשֶׁר יִתְחַבֵּא שָׁם וְשַׁבְתֶּם אֵלַי אֶל־נָכוֹן וְהָלַכְתִּי אִתְּכֶם וְהָיָה אִם־יֶשְׁנוֹ בָאָרֶץ וְחִפַּשְׂתִּי אֹתוֹ בְּכֹל אַלְפֵי
יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
Look around and learn in which of all his hiding places he has
been hiding, and return to me when you are certain. I will then go
with you, and if he is in the region, I will search him out among
all the clans of Judah.”

translation.text: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hideth himself, and come ye again to me with the certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Judah.

verses.english:
Look around and learn in which of all his hiding places he has
been hiding, and return to me when you are certain. I will then go
with you, and if he is in the region, I will search him out among
all the clans of Judah.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקוּמוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ זִיפָה לִפְנֵי שָׁאוּל וְדָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו בְּמִדְבַּר מָעוֹן בָּעֲרָבָה אֶל יְמִין הַיְשִׁימוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקוּמוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ זִיפָה לִפְנֵי שָׁאוּל וְדָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו בְּמִדְבַּר מָעוֹן בָּעֲרָבָה אֶל יְמִין הַיְשִׁימוֹן׃

english.text:
They left at once for Ziph, ahead of Saul; David and his men were
then in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah, to the south of
Jeshimon.

translation.text: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.

verses.english:
They left at once for Ziph, ahead of Saul; David and his men were
then in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah, to the south of
Jeshimon.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ שָׁאוּל וַאֲנָשָׁיו לְבַקֵּשׁ וַיַּגִּדוּ לְדָוִד וַיֵּרֶד הַסֶּלַע וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּמִדְבַּר מָעוֹן וַיִּשְׁמַע שָׁאוּל וַיִּרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי־דָוִד מִדְבַּר מָעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ שָׁאוּל וַאֲנָשָׁיו לְבַקֵּשׁ וַיַּגִּדוּ לְדָוִד וַיֵּרֶד הַסֶּלַע וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּמִדְבַּר מָעוֹן וַיִּשְׁמַע שָׁאוּל וַיִּרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי־דָוִד מִדְבַּר מָעוֹן׃

english.text:
When Saul and his men came to search, David was told about it; and
he went down to the rocky region and stayed in the wilderness of
Maon. On hearing this, Saul pursued David in the wilderness of
Maon.

translation.text: Saul also and his men went to seek him. And they told David; wherefore he came down into a rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that, he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.

verses.english:
When Saul and his men came to search, David was told about it; and
he went down to the rocky region and stayed in the wilderness of
Maon. On hearing this, Saul pursued David in the wilderness of
Maon.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלֶךְ שָׁאוּל מִצַּד הָהָר מִזֶּה וְדָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו מִצַּד הָהָר מִזֶּה וַיְהִי דָוִד נֶחְפָּז לָלֶכֶת מִפְּנֵי שָׁאוּל וְשָׁאוּל וַאֲנָשָׁיו עֹטְרִים אֶל־דָּוִד
וְאֶל־אֲנָשָׁיו לְתפְשָׂם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלֶךְ שָׁאוּל מִצַּד הָהָר מִזֶּה וְדָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו מִצַּד הָהָר מִזֶּה וַיְהִי דָוִד נֶחְפָּז לָלֶכֶת מִפְּנֵי שָׁאוּל וְשָׁאוּל וַאֲנָשָׁיו עֹטְרִים אֶל־דָּוִד
וְאֶל־אֲנָשָׁיו לְתפְשָׂם׃

english.text:
Saul was making his way along one side of a hill, and David and
his men were on the other side of the hill. David was trying hard
to elude Saul, and Saul and his men were trying to encircle David
and his men and capture them,

translation.text: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them.

verses.english:
Saul was making his way along one side of a hill, and David and
his men were on the other side of the hill. David was trying hard
to elude Saul, and Saul and his men were trying to encircle David
and his men and capture them,

verses.hebrew: וּמַלְאָךְ בָּא אֶל־שָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר מַהֲרָה וְלֵכָה כִּי־פָשְׁטוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים עַל־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וּמַלְאָךְ בָּא אֶל־שָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר מַהֲרָה וְלֵכָה כִּי־פָשְׁטוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים עַל־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
when a messenger came and told Saul, “Come quickly, for the
Philistines have invaded the land.”

translation.text: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.

verses.english:
when a messenger came and told Saul, “Come quickly, for the
Philistines have invaded the land.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב שָׁאוּל מִרְדֹף אַחֲרֵי דָוִד וַיֵּלֶךְ לִקְרַאת פְּלִשְׁתִּים עַל־כֵּן קָרְאוּ לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא סֶלַע הַמַּחְלְקוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב שָׁאוּל מִרְדֹף אַחֲרֵי דָוִד וַיֵּלֶךְ לִקְרַאת פְּלִשְׁתִּים עַל־כֵּן קָרְאוּ לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא סֶלַע הַמַּחְלְקוֹת׃

english.text:
Saul gave up his pursuit of David and went to meet the
Philistines. That is why that place came to be called the Rock of
Separation.

translation.text: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Selahammahlekoth.

verses.english:
Saul gave up his pursuit of David and went to meet the
Philistines. That is why that place came to be called the Rock of
Separation.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל דָּוִד מִשָּׁם וַיֵּשֶׁב בִּמְצָדוֹת עֵין־גֶּדִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל דָּוִד מִשָּׁם וַיֵּשֶׁב בִּמְצָדוֹת עֵין־גֶּדִי׃

english.text: David went from there and stayed in the wildernesses of En-gedi.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of Engedi.

verses.english: David went from there and stayed in the wildernesses of En-gedi.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁב שָׁאוּל מֵאַחֲרֵי פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּגִּדוּ לוֹ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה דָוִד בְּמִדְבַּר עֵין גֶּדִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁב שָׁאוּל מֵאַחֲרֵי פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּגִּדוּ לוֹ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה דָוִד בְּמִדְבַּר עֵין גֶּדִי׃

english.text:
When Saul returned from pursuing the Philistines, he was told that
David was in the wilderness of En-gedi.

translation.text: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.

verses.english:
When Saul returned from pursuing the Philistines, he was told that
David was in the wilderness of En-gedi.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח שָׁאוּל שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ בָּחוּר מִכּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּלֶךְ לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו עַל־פְּנֵי צוּרֵי הַיְּעֵלִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח שָׁאוּל שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ בָּחוּר מִכּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּלֶךְ לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו עַל־פְּנֵי צוּרֵי הַיְּעֵלִים׃

translation.text: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet: and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֶל־גִּדְרוֹת הַצֹּאן עַל־הַדֶּרֶךְ וְשָׁם מְעָרָה וַיָּבֹא שָׁאוּל לְהָסֵךְ אֶת־רַגְלָיו וְדָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו בְּיַרְכְּתֵי הַמְּעָרָה יֹשְׁבִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֶל־גִּדְרוֹת הַצֹּאן עַל־הַדֶּרֶךְ וְשָׁם מְעָרָה וַיָּבֹא שָׁאוּל לְהָסֵךְ אֶת־רַגְלָיו וְדָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו בְּיַרְכְּתֵי הַמְּעָרָה יֹשְׁבִים׃

english.text:
and he came to the sheepfolds along the way. There was a cave
there, and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men
were sitting in the back of the cave.

translation.text: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the LORD said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe privily.

verses.english:
and he came to the sheepfolds along the way. There was a cave
there, and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men
were sitting in the back of the cave.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי דָוִד אֵלָיו הִנֵּה הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֵלֶיךָ הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן אֶת־[אֹיִבְךָ] (איביך) בְּיָדֶךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִטַב בְּעֵינֶיךָ
וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַיִּכְרֹת אֶת־כְּנַף־הַמְּעִיל אֲשֶׁר־לְשָׁאוּל בַּלָּט׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי דָוִד אֵלָיו הִנֵּה הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֵלֶיךָ הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן אֶת־[אֹיִבְךָ] (איביך) בְּיָדֶךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִטַב בְּעֵינֶיךָ
וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַיִּכְרֹת אֶת־כְּנַף־הַמְּעִיל אֲשֶׁר־לְשָׁאוּל בַּלָּט׃

english.text:
David’s men said to him, “This is the day of which YHWH said to
you, ‘I will deliver your enemy into your hands; you can do with
him as you please.’” David went and stealthily cut off the corner
of Saul’s cloak.

translation.text: And it came to pass afterward, that David’s heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.

verses.english:
David’s men said to him, “This is the day of which YHWH said to
you, ‘I will deliver your enemy into your hands; you can do with
him as you please.’” David went and stealthily cut off the corner
of Saul’s cloak.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיַּךְ לֵב־דָּוִד אֹתוֹ עַל אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אֶת־כָּנָף אֲשֶׁר לְשָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיַּךְ לֵב־דָּוִד אֹתוֹ עַל אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אֶת־כָּנָף אֲשֶׁר לְשָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
But afterward David reproached himself for cutting off the corner
of Saul’s cloak.

translation.text: And he said unto his men, The LORD forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the LORD’s anointed, to stretch forth mine hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the LORD.

verses.english:
But afterward David reproached himself for cutting off the corner
of Saul’s cloak.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲנָשָׁיו חָלִילָה לִּי מֵיְהֹוָה אִם־אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לַאדֹנִי לִמְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה לִשְׁלֹחַ יָדִי בּוֹ כִּי־מְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲנָשָׁיו חָלִילָה לִּי מֵיְהֹוָה אִם־אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לַאדֹנִי לִמְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה לִשְׁלֹחַ יָדִי בּוֹ כִּי־מְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה הוּא׃

translation.text: So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁסַּע דָּוִד אֶת־אֲנָשָׁיו בַּדְּבָרִים וְלֹא נְתָנָם לָקוּם אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְשָׁאוּל קָם מֵהַמְּעָרָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְשַׁסַּע דָּוִד אֶת־אֲנָשָׁיו בַּדְּבָרִים וְלֹא נְתָנָם לָקוּם אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְשָׁאוּל קָם מֵהַמְּעָרָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

english.text:
David rebuked his men and did not permit them to attack Saul. Saul
left the cave and started on his way.

translation.text: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed himself.

verses.english:
David rebuked his men and did not permit them to attack Saul. Saul
left the cave and started on his way.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקם דָּוִד אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיֵּצֵא (מן המערה) [מֵהַמְּעָרָה] וַיִּקְרָא אַחֲרֵי־שָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּבֵּט שָׁאוּל אַחֲרָיו וַיִּקֹּד דָּוִד אַפַּיִם אַרְצָה
וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקם דָּוִד אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיֵּצֵא (מן המערה) [מֵהַמְּעָרָה] וַיִּקְרָא אַחֲרֵי־שָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּבֵּט שָׁאוּל אַחֲרָיו וַיִּקֹּד דָּוִד אַפַּיִם אַרְצָה
וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ׃

english.text:
Then David also went out of the cave and called after Saul, “My
lord king!” Saul looked around and David bowed low in homage, with
his face to the ground.

translation.text: And David said to Saul, Wherefore hearest thou men’s words, saying, Behold, David seeketh thy hurt?

verses.english:
Then David also went out of the cave and called after Saul, “My
lord king!” Saul looked around and David bowed low in homage, with
his face to the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לְשָׁאוּל לָמָּה תִשְׁמַע אֶת־דִּבְרֵי אָדָם לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה דָוִד מְבַקֵּשׁ רָעָתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לְשָׁאוּל לָמָּה תִשְׁמַע אֶת־דִּבְרֵי אָדָם לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה דָוִד מְבַקֵּשׁ רָעָתֶךָ׃

english.text:
And David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to the people who say,
‘David is out to do you harm?’

translation.text: Behold, this day thine eyes have seen how that the LORD had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave: and some bade me kill thee: but mine eye spared thee; and I said, I will not put forth mine hand against my lord; for he is the LORD’s anointed.

verses.english:
And David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to the people who say,
‘David is out to do you harm?’

verses.hebrew:
הִנֵּה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־נְתָנְךָ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם בְּיָדִי בַּמְּעָרָה וְאָמַר לַהֲרָגְךָ וַתָּחס עָלֶיךָ וָאֹמַר לֹא־אֶשְׁלַח יָדִי בַּאדֹנִי כִּי־מְשִׁיחַ
יְהֹוָה הוּא׃

hebrew.text:
הִנֵּה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־נְתָנְךָ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם בְּיָדִי בַּמְּעָרָה וְאָמַר לַהֲרָגְךָ וַתָּחס עָלֶיךָ וָאֹמַר לֹא־אֶשְׁלַח יָדִי בַּאדֹנִי כִּי־מְשִׁיחַ
יְהֹוָה הוּא׃

english.text:
You can see for yourself now that YHWH delivered you into my hands
in the cave today. And though I was urged to kill you, I showed
you pity; for I said, ‘I will not raise a hand against my lord,
since he is YHWH’s anointed.’

translation.text: Moreover, my father, see, yea, see the skirt of thy robe in my hand: for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe, and killed thee not, know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand, and I have not sinned against thee; yet thou huntest my soul to take it.

verses.english:
You can see for yourself now that YHWH delivered you into my hands
in the cave today. And though I was urged to kill you, I showed
you pity; for I said, ‘I will not raise a hand against my lord,
since he is YHWH’s anointed.’

verses.hebrew:
וְאָבִי רְאֵה גַּם רְאֵה אֶת־כְּנַף מְעִילְךָ בְּיָדִי כִּי בְּכרְתִי אֶת־כְּנַף מְעִילְךָ וְלֹא הֲרַגְתִּיךָ דַּע וּרְאֵה כִּי אֵין בְּיָדִי רָעָה וָפֶשַׁע וְלֹא־חָטָאתִי לָךְ
וְאַתָּה צֹדֶה אֶת־נַפְשִׁי לְקַחְתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וְאָבִי רְאֵה גַּם רְאֵה אֶת־כְּנַף מְעִילְךָ בְּיָדִי כִּי בְּכרְתִי אֶת־כְּנַף מְעִילְךָ וְלֹא הֲרַגְתִּיךָ דַּע וּרְאֵה כִּי אֵין בְּיָדִי רָעָה וָפֶשַׁע וְלֹא־חָטָאתִי לָךְ
וְאַתָּה צֹדֶה אֶת־נַפְשִׁי לְקַחְתָּהּ׃

english.text:
Please, sir, take a close look at the corner of your cloak in my
hand; for when I cut off the corner of your cloak, I did not kill
you. You must see plainly that I have done nothing evil or
rebellious, and I have never wronged you. Yet you are bent on
taking my life.

translation.text: The LORD judge between me and thee, and the LORD avenge me of thee: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.

verses.english:
Please, sir, take a close look at the corner of your cloak in my
hand; for when I cut off the corner of your cloak, I did not kill
you. You must see plainly that I have done nothing evil or
rebellious, and I have never wronged you. Yet you are bent on
taking my life.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁפֹּט יְהֹוָה בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ וּנְקָמַנִי יְהֹוָה מִמֶּךָּ וְיָדִי לֹא תִהְיֶה־בָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: יִשְׁפֹּט יְהֹוָה בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ וּנְקָמַנִי יְהֹוָה מִמֶּךָּ וְיָדִי לֹא תִהְיֶה־בָּךְ׃

english.text:
May YHWH judge between you and me! And may He take vengeance upon
you for me, but my hand will never touch you.

translation.text: As saith the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.

verses.english:
May YHWH judge between you and me! And may He take vengeance upon
you for me, but my hand will never touch you.

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר מְשַׁל הַקַּדְמֹנִי מֵרְשָׁעִים יֵצֵא רֶשַׁע וְיָדִי לֹא תִהְיֶה־בָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר מְשַׁל הַקַּדְמֹנִי מֵרְשָׁעִים יֵצֵא רֶשַׁע וְיָדִי לֹא תִהְיֶה־בָּךְ׃

english.text:
As the ancient proverb has it: ‘Wicked deeds come from wicked
men!’ My hand will never touch you.

translation.text: After whom is the king of Israel come out? after whom dost thou pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.

verses.english:
As the ancient proverb has it: ‘Wicked deeds come from wicked
men!’ My hand will never touch you.

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרֵי מִי יָצָא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרֵי מִי אַתָּה רֹדֵף אַחֲרֵי כֶּלֶב מֵת אַחֲרֵי פַּרְעֹשׁ אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: אַחֲרֵי מִי יָצָא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרֵי מִי אַתָּה רֹדֵף אַחֲרֵי כֶּלֶב מֵת אַחֲרֵי פַּרְעֹשׁ אֶחָד׃

english.text:
Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom are you
pursuing? A dead dog? A single flea?

translation.text: The LORD therefore be judge, and judge between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of thine hand.

verses.english:
Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom are you
pursuing? A dead dog? A single flea?

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה יְהֹוָה לְדַיָּן וְשָׁפַט בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ וְיֵרֶא וְיָרֵב אֶת־רִיבִי וְיִשְׁפְּטֵנִי מִיָּדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה יְהֹוָה לְדַיָּן וְשָׁפַט בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ וְיֵרֶא וְיָרֵב אֶת־רִיבִי וְיִשְׁפְּטֵנִי מִיָּדֶךָ׃

english.text:
May YHWH be arbiter and may He judge between you and me! May He
take note and uphold my cause, and vindicate me against you.”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.

verses.english:
May YHWH be arbiter and may He judge between you and me! May He
take note and uphold my cause, and vindicate me against you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת דָּוִד לְדַבֵּר אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל הֲקֹלְךָ זֶה בְּנִי דָוִד וַיִּשָּׂא שָׁאוּל קֹלוֹ וַיֵּבְךְּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת דָּוִד לְדַבֵּר אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל הֲקֹלְךָ זֶה בְּנִי דָוִד וַיִּשָּׂא שָׁאוּל קֹלוֹ וַיֵּבְךְּ׃

english.text:
When David finished saying these things to Saul, Saul said, “Is
that your voice, my son David?” And Saul broke down and wept.

translation.text: And he said to David, Thou art more righteous than I: for thou hast rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded thee evil.

verses.english:
When David finished saying these things to Saul, Saul said, “Is
that your voice, my son David?” And Saul broke down and wept.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־דָּוִד צַדִּיק אַתָּה מִמֶּנִּי כִּי אַתָּה גְּמַלְתַּנִי הַטּוֹבָה וַאֲנִי גְּמַלְתִּיךָ הָרָעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־דָּוִד צַדִּיק אַתָּה מִמֶּנִּי כִּי אַתָּה גְּמַלְתַּנִי הַטּוֹבָה וַאֲנִי גְּמַלְתִּיךָ הָרָעָה׃

english.text:
He said to David, “You are right, not I; for you have treated me
generously, but I have treated you badly.

translation.text: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me: forasmuch as when the LORD had delivered me into thine hand, thou killedst me not.

verses.english:
He said to David, “You are right, not I; for you have treated me
generously, but I have treated you badly.

verses.hebrew: (ואת) [וְאַתָּה] הִגַּדְתָּ הַיּוֹם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתָה אִתִּי טוֹבָה אֵת אֲשֶׁר סִגְּרַנִי יְהֹוָה בְּיָדְךָ וְלֹא הֲרַגְתָּנִי׃

hebrew.text: (ואת) [וְאַתָּה] הִגַּדְתָּ הַיּוֹם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתָה אִתִּי טוֹבָה אֵת אֲשֶׁר סִגְּרַנִי יְהֹוָה בְּיָדְךָ וְלֹא הֲרַגְתָּנִי׃

english.text:
Yes, you have just revealed how generously you treated me, for
YHWH delivered me into your hands and you did not kill me.

translation.text: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore the LORD reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day.

verses.english:
Yes, you have just revealed how generously you treated me, for
YHWH delivered me into your hands and you did not kill me.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי־יִמְצָא אִישׁ אֶת־אֹיְבוֹ וְשִׁלְּחוֹ בְּדֶרֶךְ טוֹבָה וַיהֹוָה יְשַׁלֶּמְךָ טוֹבָה תַּחַת הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָה לִי׃

hebrew.text: וְכִי־יִמְצָא אִישׁ אֶת־אֹיְבוֹ וְשִׁלְּחוֹ בְּדֶרֶךְ טוֹבָה וַיהֹוָה יְשַׁלֶּמְךָ טוֹבָה תַּחַת הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָה לִי׃

english.text:
If a man meets his enemy, does he let him go his way unharmed?
Surely, YHWH will reward you generously for what you have done for
me this day.

translation.text: And now, behold, I know well that thou shalt surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand.

verses.english:
If a man meets his enemy, does he let him go his way unharmed?
Surely, YHWH will reward you generously for what you have done for
me this day.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי מָלֹךְ תִּמְלוֹךְ וְקָמָה בְּיָדְךָ מַמְלֶכֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי מָלֹךְ תִּמְלוֹךְ וְקָמָה בְּיָדְךָ מַמְלֶכֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
I know now that you will become king, and that the kingship over
Israel will remain in your hands.

translation.text: Swear now therefore unto me by the LORD, that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me, and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father’s house.

verses.english:
I know now that you will become king, and that the kingship over
Israel will remain in your hands.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִשָּׁבְעָה לִּי בַּיהֹוָה אִם־תַּכְרִית אֶת־זַרְעִי אַחֲרָי וְאִם־תַּשְׁמִיד אֶת־שְׁמִי מִבֵּית אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִשָּׁבְעָה לִּי בַּיהֹוָה אִם־תַּכְרִית אֶת־זַרְעִי אַחֲרָי וְאִם־תַּשְׁמִיד אֶת־שְׁמִי מִבֵּית אָבִי׃

english.text:
So swear to me by YHWH that you will not destroy my descendants or
wipe out my name from my father’s house.”

translation.text: And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold.

verses.english:
So swear to me by YHWH that you will not destroy my descendants or
wipe out my name from my father’s house.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׁבַע דָּוִד לְשָׁאוּל וַיֵּלֶךְ שָׁאוּל אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וְדָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו עָלוּ עַל־הַמְּצוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׁבַע דָּוִד לְשָׁאוּל וַיֵּלֶךְ שָׁאוּל אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וְדָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו עָלוּ עַל־הַמְּצוּדָה׃

english.text:
David swore to Saul, Saul went home, and David and his men went up
to the strongholds.

verses.english:
David swore to Saul, Saul went home, and David and his men went up
to the strongholds.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת שְׁמוּאֵל וַיִּקָּבְצוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּסְפְּדוּ־לוֹ וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בְּבֵיתוֹ בָּרָמָה וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַיֵּרֶד אֶל־מִדְבַּר פָּארָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת שְׁמוּאֵל וַיִּקָּבְצוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּסְפְּדוּ־לוֹ וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בְּבֵיתוֹ בָּרָמָה וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַיֵּרֶד אֶל־מִדְבַּר פָּארָן׃

english.text:
Samuel died, and all Israel gathered and made lament for him; and
they buried him in Ramah, his home. David went down to the
wilderness of Paran.

translation.text: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

verses.english:
Samuel died, and all Israel gathered and made lament for him; and
they buried him in Ramah, his home. David went down to the
wilderness of Paran.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ בְּמָעוֹן וּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ בַכַּרְמֶל וְהָאִישׁ גָּדוֹל מְאֹד וְלוֹ צֹאן שְׁלֹשֶׁת־אֲלָפִים וְאֶלֶף עִזִּים וַיְהִי בִּגְזֹז אֶת־צֹאנוֹ בַּכַּרְמֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ בְּמָעוֹן וּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ בַכַּרְמֶל וְהָאִישׁ גָּדוֹל מְאֹד וְלוֹ צֹאן שְׁלֹשֶׁת־אֲלָפִים וְאֶלֶף עִזִּים וַיְהִי בִּגְזֹז אֶת־צֹאנוֹ בַּכַּרְמֶל׃

english.text:
There was a man in Maon whose possessions were in Carmel. The man
was very wealthy; he owned three thousand sheep and a thousand
goats. At the time, he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

translation.text: And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

verses.english:
There was a man in Maon whose possessions were in Carmel. The man
was very wealthy; he owned three thousand sheep and a thousand
goats. At the time, he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם הָאִישׁ נָבָל וְשֵׁם אִשְׁתּוֹ אֲבִגָיִל וְהָאִשָּׁה טוֹבַת־שֶׂכֶל וִיפַת תֹּאַר וְהָאִישׁ קָשֶׁה וְרַע מַעֲלָלִים וְהוּא (כלבו) [כָלִבִּי]׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁם הָאִישׁ נָבָל וְשֵׁם אִשְׁתּוֹ אֲבִגָיִל וְהָאִשָּׁה טוֹבַת־שֶׂכֶל וִיפַת תֹּאַר וְהָאִישׁ קָשֶׁה וְרַע מַעֲלָלִים וְהוּא (כלבו) [כָלִבִּי]׃

english.text:
The man’s name was Nabal, and his wife’s name was Abigail. The
woman was intelligent and beautiful, but the man, a Calebite, was
a hard man and an evildoer.

translation.text: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.

verses.english:
The man’s name was Nabal, and his wife’s name was Abigail. The
woman was intelligent and beautiful, but the man, a Calebite, was
a hard man and an evildoer.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּי־גֹזֵז נָבָל אֶת־צֹאנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּי־גֹזֵז נָבָל אֶת־צֹאנוֹ׃

english.text:
David was in the wilderness when he heard that Nabal was shearing
his sheep.

translation.text: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.

verses.english:
David was in the wilderness when he heard that Nabal was shearing
his sheep.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד עֲשָׂרָה נְעָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לַנְּעָרִים עֲלוּ כַרְמֶלָה וּבָאתֶם אֶל־נָבָל וּשְׁאֶלְתֶּם־לוֹ בִשְׁמִי לְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד עֲשָׂרָה נְעָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לַנְּעָרִים עֲלוּ כַרְמֶלָה וּבָאתֶם אֶל־נָבָל וּשְׁאֶלְתֶּם־לוֹ בִשְׁמִי לְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
David dispatched ten young men, and David instructed the young
men, “Go up to Carmel. When you come to Nabal, greet him in my
name.

translation.text: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:

verses.english:
David dispatched ten young men, and David instructed the young
men, “Go up to Carmel. When you come to Nabal, greet him in my
name.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲמַרְתֶּם כֹּה לֶחָי וְאַתָּה שָׁלוֹם וּבֵיתְךָ שָׁלוֹם וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־לְךָ שָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲמַרְתֶּם כֹּה לֶחָי וְאַתָּה שָׁלוֹם וּבֵיתְךָ שָׁלוֹם וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־לְךָ שָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
Say as follows: ‘To life! Greetings to you and to your household
and to all that is yours!

translation.text: And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity, Peace be both to thee, and peace be to thine house, and peace be unto all that thou hast.

verses.english:
Say as follows: ‘To life! Greetings to you and to your household
and to all that is yours!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שָׁמַעְתִּי כִּי גֹזְזִים לָךְ עַתָּה הָרֹעִים אֲשֶׁר־לְךָ הָיוּ עִמָּנוּ לֹא הֶכְלַמְנוּם וְלֹא־נִפְקַד לָהֶם מְאוּמָה כּל־יְמֵי הֱיוֹתָם בַּכַּרְמֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שָׁמַעְתִּי כִּי גֹזְזִים לָךְ עַתָּה הָרֹעִים אֲשֶׁר־לְךָ הָיוּ עִמָּנוּ לֹא הֶכְלַמְנוּם וְלֹא־נִפְקַד לָהֶם מְאוּמָה כּל־יְמֵי הֱיוֹתָם בַּכַּרְמֶל׃

english.text:
I hear that you are now doing your shearing. As you know, your
shepherds have been with us; we did not harm them, and nothing of
theirs was missing all the time they were in Carmel.

translation.text: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers: now thy shepherds which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.

verses.english:
I hear that you are now doing your shearing. As you know, your
shepherds have been with us; we did not harm them, and nothing of
theirs was missing all the time they were in Carmel.

verses.hebrew: שְׁאַל אֶת־נְעָרֶיךָ וְיַגִּידוּ לָךְ וְיִמְצְאוּ הַנְּעָרִים חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ כִּי־עַל־יוֹם טוֹב בָּנוּ תְּנָה־נָּא אֵת אֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא יָדְךָ לַעֲבָדֶיךָ וּלְבִנְךָ לְדָוִד׃

hebrew.text: שְׁאַל אֶת־נְעָרֶיךָ וְיַגִּידוּ לָךְ וְיִמְצְאוּ הַנְּעָרִים חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ כִּי־עַל־יוֹם טוֹב בָּנוּ תְּנָה־נָּא אֵת אֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא יָדְךָ לַעֲבָדֶיךָ וּלְבִנְךָ לְדָוִד׃

english.text:
Ask your young men and they will tell you. So receive these young
men graciously, for we have come on a festive occasion. Please
give your servants and your son David whatever you can.’”

translation.text: Ask thy young men, and they will shew thee. Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray thee, whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants, and to thy son David.

verses.english:
Ask your young men and they will tell you. So receive these young
men graciously, for we have come on a festive occasion. Please
give your servants and your son David whatever you can.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ נַעֲרֵי דָוִד וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֶל־נָבָל כְּכל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּשֵׁם דָּוִד וַיָּנוּחוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ נַעֲרֵי דָוִד וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֶל־נָבָל כְּכל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּשֵׁם דָּוִד וַיָּנוּחוּ׃

english.text:
David’s young men went and delivered this message to Nabal in the
name of David. When they stopped speaking,

translation.text: And when David’s young men came, they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.

verses.english:
David’s young men went and delivered this message to Nabal in the
name of David. When they stopped speaking,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן נָבָל אֶת־עַבְדֵי דָוִד וַיֹּאמֶר מִי דָוִד וּמִי בֶן־יִשָׁי הַיּוֹם רַבּוּ עֲבָדִים הַמִּתְפָּרְצִים אִישׁ מִפְּנֵי אֲדֹנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן נָבָל אֶת־עַבְדֵי דָוִד וַיֹּאמֶר מִי דָוִד וּמִי בֶן־יִשָׁי הַיּוֹם רַבּוּ עֲבָדִים הַמִּתְפָּרְצִים אִישׁ מִפְּנֵי אֲדֹנָיו׃

english.text:
Nabal answered David’s servants, “Who is David? Who is the son of
Jesse? There are many slaves nowadays who run away from their
masters.

translation.text: And Nabal answered David’s servants, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.

verses.english:
Nabal answered David’s servants, “Who is David? Who is the son of
Jesse? There are many slaves nowadays who run away from their
masters.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶת־לַחְמִי וְאֶת־מֵימַי וְאֵת טִבְחָתִי אֲשֶׁר טָבַחְתִּי לְגֹזְזָי וְנָתַתִּי לַאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַעְתִּי אֵי מִזֶּה הֵמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶת־לַחְמִי וְאֶת־מֵימַי וְאֵת טִבְחָתִי אֲשֶׁר טָבַחְתִּי לְגֹזְזָי וְנָתַתִּי לַאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַעְתִּי אֵי מִזֶּה הֵמָּה׃

english.text:
Should I then take my bread and my water, and the meat that I
slaughtered for my own shearers, and give them to men who come
from I don’t know where?”

translation.text: Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give it unto men, whom I know not whence they be?

verses.english:
Should I then take my bread and my water, and the meat that I
slaughtered for my own shearers, and give them to men who come
from I don’t know where?”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּהַפְכוּ נַעֲרֵי־דָוִד לְדַרְכָּם וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיַּגִּדוּ לוֹ כְּכֹל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּהַפְכוּ נַעֲרֵי־דָוִד לְדַרְכָּם וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיַּגִּדוּ לוֹ כְּכֹל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
Thereupon David’s young men retraced their steps; and when they
got back, they told him all this.

translation.text: So David’s young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.

verses.english:
Thereupon David’s young men retraced their steps; and when they
got back, they told him all this.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לַאֲנָשָׁיו חִגְרוּ אִישׁ אֶת־חַרְבּוֹ וַיַּחְגְּרוּ אִישׁ אֶת־חַרְבּוֹ וַיַּחְגֹּר גַּם־דָּוִד אֶת־חַרְבּוֹ וַיַּעֲלוּ אַחֲרֵי דָוִד כְּאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ
וּמָאתַיִם יָשְׁבוּ עַל־הַכֵּלִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לַאֲנָשָׁיו חִגְרוּ אִישׁ אֶת־חַרְבּוֹ וַיַּחְגְּרוּ אִישׁ אֶת־חַרְבּוֹ וַיַּחְגֹּר גַּם־דָּוִד אֶת־חַרְבּוֹ וַיַּעֲלוּ אַחֲרֵי דָוִד כְּאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ
וּמָאתַיִם יָשְׁבוּ עַל־הַכֵּלִים׃

english.text:
And David said to his men, “Gird on your swords.” Each girded on
his sword; David too girded on his sword. About four hundred men
went up after David, while two hundred remained with the baggage.

translation.text: And David said unto his men, Gird ye on every man his sword. And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the stuff.

verses.english:
And David said to his men, “Gird on your swords.” Each girded on
his sword; David too girded on his sword. About four hundred men
went up after David, while two hundred remained with the baggage.

verses.hebrew: וְלַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הִגִּיד נַעַר־אֶחָד מֵהַנְּעָרִים לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה שָׁלַח דָּוִד מַלְאָכִים מֵהַמִּדְבָּר לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־אֲדֹנֵינוּ וַיָּעַט בָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְלַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הִגִּיד נַעַר־אֶחָד מֵהַנְּעָרִים לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה שָׁלַח דָּוִד מַלְאָכִים מֵהַמִּדְבָּר לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־אֲדֹנֵינוּ וַיָּעַט בָּהֶם׃

english.text:
One of [Nabal’s] young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, that David
had sent messengers from the wilderness to greet their master, and
that he had spurned them.

translation.text: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master; and he railed on them.

verses.english:
One of [Nabal’s] young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, that David
had sent messengers from the wilderness to greet their master, and
that he had spurned them.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים טֹבִים לָנוּ מְאֹד וְלֹא הכְלַמְנוּ וְלֹא־פָקַדְנוּ מְאוּמָה כּל־יְמֵי הִתְהַלַּכְנוּ אִתָּם בִּהְיוֹתֵנוּ בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים טֹבִים לָנוּ מְאֹד וְלֹא הכְלַמְנוּ וְלֹא־פָקַדְנוּ מְאוּמָה כּל־יְמֵי הִתְהַלַּכְנוּ אִתָּם בִּהְיוֹתֵנוּ בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
“But the men had been very friendly to us; we were not harmed, nor
did we miss anything all the time that we went about with them
while we were in the open.

translation.text: But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:

verses.english:
“But the men had been very friendly to us; we were not harmed, nor
did we miss anything all the time that we went about with them
while we were in the open.

verses.hebrew: חוֹמָה הָיוּ עָלֵינוּ גַּם־לַיְלָה גַּם־יוֹמָם כּל־יְמֵי הֱיוֹתֵנוּ עִמָּם רֹעִים הַצֹּאן׃

hebrew.text: חוֹמָה הָיוּ עָלֵינוּ גַּם־לַיְלָה גַּם־יוֹמָם כּל־יְמֵי הֱיוֹתֵנוּ עִמָּם רֹעִים הַצֹּאן׃

english.text:
They were a wall about us both by night and by day all the time
that we were with them tending the flocks.

translation.text: They were a wall unto us both by night and day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

verses.english:
They were a wall about us both by night and by day all the time
that we were with them tending the flocks.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה דְּעִי וּרְאִי מַה־תַּעֲשִׂי כִּי־כָלְתָה הָרָעָה אֶל־אֲדֹנֵינוּ וְעַל כּל־בֵּיתוֹ וְהוּא בֶּן־בְּלִיַּעַל מִדַּבֵּר אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה דְּעִי וּרְאִי מַה־תַּעֲשִׂי כִּי־כָלְתָה הָרָעָה אֶל־אֲדֹנֵינוּ וְעַל כּל־בֵּיתוֹ וְהוּא בֶּן־בְּלִיַּעַל מִדַּבֵּר אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
So consider carefully what you should do, for harm threatens our
master and all his household; he is such a nasty fellow that no
one can speak to him.”

translation.text: Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he is such a son of Belial, that a man cannot speak to him.

verses.english:
So consider carefully what you should do, for harm threatens our
master and all his household; he is such a nasty fellow that no
one can speak to him.”

verses.hebrew:
וַתְּמַהֵר (אבוגיל) [אֲבִיגַיִל] וַתִּקַּח מָאתַיִם לֶחֶם וּשְׁנַיִם נִבְלֵי־יַיִן וְחָמֵשׁ צֹאן (עשוות) [עֲשׂוּיוֹת] וְחָמֵשׁ סְאִים קָלִי וּמֵאָה צִמֻּקִים וּמָאתַיִם דְּבֵלִים
וַתָּשֶׂם עַל־הַחֲמֹרִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַתְּמַהֵר (אבוגיל) [אֲבִיגַיִל] וַתִּקַּח מָאתַיִם לֶחֶם וּשְׁנַיִם נִבְלֵי־יַיִן וְחָמֵשׁ צֹאן (עשוות) [עֲשׂוּיוֹת] וְחָמֵשׁ סְאִים קָלִי וּמֵאָה צִמֻּקִים וּמָאתַיִם דְּבֵלִים
וַתָּשֶׂם עַל־הַחֲמֹרִים׃

english.text:
Abigail quickly got together two hundred loaves of bread, two jars
of wine, five dressed sheep, five seahs of parched corn, one
hundred cakes of raisin, and two hundred cakes of pressed figs.
She loaded them on asses,

translation.text: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn, and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.

verses.english:
Abigail quickly got together two hundred loaves of bread, two jars
of wine, five dressed sheep, five seahs of parched corn, one
hundred cakes of raisin, and two hundred cakes of pressed figs.
She loaded them on asses,

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לִנְעָרֶיהָ עִבְרוּ לְפָנַי הִנְנִי אַחֲרֵיכֶם בָּאָה וּלְאִישָׁהּ נָבָל לֹא הִגִּידָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לִנְעָרֶיהָ עִבְרוּ לְפָנַי הִנְנִי אַחֲרֵיכֶם בָּאָה וּלְאִישָׁהּ נָבָל לֹא הִגִּידָה׃

english.text:
and she told her young men, “Go on ahead of me, and I’ll follow
you”; but she did not tell her husband Nabal.

translation.text: And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.

verses.english:
and she told her young men, “Go on ahead of me, and I’ll follow
you”; but she did not tell her husband Nabal.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הִיא רֹכֶבֶת עַל־הַחֲמוֹר וְיֹרֶדֶת בְּסֵתֶר הָהָר וְהִנֵּה דָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו יֹרְדִים לִקְרָאתָהּ וַתִּפְגֹשׁ אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הִיא רֹכֶבֶת עַל־הַחֲמוֹר וְיֹרֶדֶת בְּסֵתֶר הָהָר וְהִנֵּה דָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו יֹרְדִים לִקְרָאתָהּ וַתִּפְגֹשׁ אֹתָם׃

english.text:
She was riding on the ass and going down a trail on the hill, when
David and his men appeared, coming down toward her; and she met
them.—

translation.text: And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert on the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.

verses.english:
She was riding on the ass and going down a trail on the hill, when
David and his men appeared, coming down toward her; and she met
them.—

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד אָמַר אַךְ לַשֶּׁקֶר שָׁמַרְתִּי אֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר לָזֶה בַּמִּדְבָּר וְלֹא־נִפְקַד מִכּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ מְאוּמָה וַיָּשֶׁב־לִי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד אָמַר אַךְ לַשֶּׁקֶר שָׁמַרְתִּי אֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר לָזֶה בַּמִּדְבָּר וְלֹא־נִפְקַד מִכּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ מְאוּמָה וַיָּשֶׁב־לִי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה׃

english.text:
Now David had been saying, “It was all for nothing that I
protected that fellow’s possessions in the wilderness, and that
nothing he owned is missing. He has paid me back evil for good.

translation.text: Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow hath in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained unto him: and he hath requited me evil for good.

verses.english:
Now David had been saying, “It was all for nothing that I
protected that fellow’s possessions in the wilderness, and that
nothing he owned is missing. He has paid me back evil for good.

verses.hebrew: כֹּה־יַעֲשֶׂה אֱלֹהִים לְאֹיְבֵי דָוִד וְכֹה יֹסִיף אִם־אַשְׁאִיר מִכּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ עַד־הַבֹּקֶר מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר׃

hebrew.text: כֹּה־יַעֲשֶׂה אֱלֹהִים לְאֹיְבֵי דָוִד וְכֹה יֹסִיף אִם־אַשְׁאִיר מִכּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ עַד־הַבֹּקֶר מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר׃

english.text:
May God do thus and more to the enemies of David if, by the light
of morning, I leave a single male of his”—

translation.text: So and more also do God unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.

verses.english:
May God do thus and more to the enemies of David if, by the light
of morning, I leave a single male of his”—

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא אֲבִיגַיִל אֶת־דָּוִד וַתְּמַהֵר וַתֵּרֶד מֵעַל הַחֲמוֹר וַתִּפֹּל לְאַפֵּי דָוִד עַל־פָּנֶיהָ וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ אָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרֶא אֲבִיגַיִל אֶת־דָּוִד וַתְּמַהֵר וַתֵּרֶד מֵעַל הַחֲמוֹר וַתִּפֹּל לְאַפֵּי דָוִד עַל־פָּנֶיהָ וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ אָרֶץ׃

english.text:
When Abigail saw David, she quickly dismounted from the ass and
threw herself face down before David, bowing to the ground.

translation.text: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,

verses.english:
When Abigail saw David, she quickly dismounted from the ass and
threw herself face down before David, bowing to the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּפֹּל עַל־רַגְלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר בִּי־אֲנִי אֲדֹנִי הֶעָוֺן וּתְדַבֶּר־נָא אֲמָתְךָ בְּאזְנֶיךָ וּשְׁמַע אֵת דִּבְרֵי אֲמָתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּפֹּל עַל־רַגְלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר בִּי־אֲנִי אֲדֹנִי הֶעָוֺן וּתְדַבֶּר־נָא אֲמָתְךָ בְּאזְנֶיךָ וּשְׁמַע אֵת דִּבְרֵי אֲמָתֶךָ׃

english.text:
Prostrate at his feet, she pleaded, “Let the blame be mine, my
lord, but let your handmaid speak to you; hear your maid’s plea.

translation.text: And fell at his feet, and said, Upon me, my lord, upon me let this iniquity be: and let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak in thine audience, and hear the words of thine handmaid.

verses.english:
Prostrate at his feet, she pleaded, “Let the blame be mine, my
lord, but let your handmaid speak to you; hear your maid’s plea.

verses.hebrew:
אַל־נָא יָשִׂים אֲדֹנִי אֶת־לִבּוֹ אֶל־אִישׁ הַבְּלִיַּעַל הַזֶּה עַל־נָבָל כִּי כִשְׁמוֹ כֶּן־הוּא נָבָל שְׁמוֹ וּנְבָלָה עִמּוֹ וַאֲנִי אֲמָתְךָ לֹא רָאִיתִי אֶת־נַעֲרֵי אֲדֹנִי
אֲשֶׁר שָׁלָחְתָּ׃

hebrew.text:
אַל־נָא יָשִׂים אֲדֹנִי אֶת־לִבּוֹ אֶל־אִישׁ הַבְּלִיַּעַל הַזֶּה עַל־נָבָל כִּי כִשְׁמוֹ כֶּן־הוּא נָבָל שְׁמוֹ וּנְבָלָה עִמּוֹ וַאֲנִי אֲמָתְךָ לֹא רָאִיתִי אֶת־נַעֲרֵי אֲדֹנִי
אֲשֶׁר שָׁלָחְתָּ׃

english.text:
Please, my lord, pay no attention to that wretched fellow Nabal.
For he is just what his name says: His name means ‘boor’ and he is
a boor. “Your handmaid did not see the young men whom my lord
sent.

translation.text: Let not my lord, I pray thee, regard this man of Belial, even Nabal: for as his name is, so is he; Nabal is his name, and folly is with him: but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord, whom thou didst send.

verses.english:
Please, my lord, pay no attention to that wretched fellow Nabal.
For he is just what his name says: His name means ‘boor’ and he is
a boor. “Your handmaid did not see the young men whom my lord
sent.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֲדֹנִי חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אֲשֶׁר מְנָעֲךָ יְהֹוָה מִבּוֹא בְדָמִים וְהוֹשֵׁעַ יָדְךָ לָךְ וְעַתָּה יִהְיוּ כְנָבָל אֹיְבֶיךָ וְהַמְבַקְשִׁים אֶל־אֲדֹנִי רָעָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אֲדֹנִי חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אֲשֶׁר מְנָעֲךָ יְהֹוָה מִבּוֹא בְדָמִים וְהוֹשֵׁעַ יָדְךָ לָךְ וְעַתָּה יִהְיוּ כְנָבָל אֹיְבֶיךָ וְהַמְבַקְשִׁים אֶל־אֲדֹנִי רָעָה׃

english.text:
I swear, my lord, as YHWH lives and as you live—YHWH who has kept
you from seeking redress by blood with your own hands—let your
enemies and all who would harm my lord fare like Nabal!

translation.text: Now therefore, my lord, as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, seeing the LORD hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood, and from avenging thyself with thine own hand, now let thine enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.

verses.english:
I swear, my lord, as YHWH lives and as you live—YHWH who has kept
you from seeking redress by blood with your own hands—let your
enemies and all who would harm my lord fare like Nabal!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הַבְּרָכָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִיא שִׁפְחָתְךָ לַאדֹנִי וְנִתְּנָה לַנְּעָרִים הַמִּתְהַלְּכִים בְּרַגְלֵי אֲדֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הַבְּרָכָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִיא שִׁפְחָתְךָ לַאדֹנִי וְנִתְּנָה לַנְּעָרִים הַמִּתְהַלְּכִים בְּרַגְלֵי אֲדֹנִי׃

english.text:
Here is the present which your maidservant has brought to my lord;
let it be given to the young men who are the followers of my lord.

translation.text: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord, let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord.

verses.english:
Here is the present which your maidservant has brought to my lord;
let it be given to the young men who are the followers of my lord.

verses.hebrew: שָׂא נָא לְפֶשַׁע אֲמָתֶךָ כִּי עָשֹׂה־יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה לַאדֹנִי בַּיִת נֶאֱמָן כִּי־מִלְחֲמוֹת יְהֹוָה אֲדֹנִי נִלְחָם וְרָעָה לֹא־תִמָּצֵא בְךָ מִיָּמֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: שָׂא נָא לְפֶשַׁע אֲמָתֶךָ כִּי עָשֹׂה־יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה לַאדֹנִי בַּיִת נֶאֱמָן כִּי־מִלְחֲמוֹת יְהֹוָה אֲדֹנִי נִלְחָם וְרָעָה לֹא־תִמָּצֵא בְךָ מִיָּמֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Please pardon your maid’s boldness. For YHWH will grant my lord an
enduring house, because my lord is fighting the battles of YHWH,
and no wrong is ever to be found in you.

translation.text: I pray thee, forgive the trespass of thine handmaid: for the LORD will certainly make my lord a sure house; because my lord fighteth the battles of the LORD, and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days.

verses.english:
Please pardon your maid’s boldness. For YHWH will grant my lord an
enduring house, because my lord is fighting the battles of YHWH,
and no wrong is ever to be found in you.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקם אָדָם לִרְדפְךָ וּלְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ וְהָיְתָה נֶפֶשׁ אֲדֹנִי צְרוּרָה בִּצְרוֹר הַחַיִּים אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְאֵת נֶפֶשׁ אֹיְבֶיךָ יְקַלְּעֶנָּה בְּתוֹךְ כַּף
הַקָּלַע׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקם אָדָם לִרְדפְךָ וּלְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ וְהָיְתָה נֶפֶשׁ אֲדֹנִי צְרוּרָה בִּצְרוֹר הַחַיִּים אֵת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְאֵת נֶפֶשׁ אֹיְבֶיךָ יְקַלְּעֶנָּה בְּתוֹךְ כַּף
הַקָּלַע׃

english.text:
And if anyone sets out to pursue you and seek your life, the life
of my lord will be bound up in the bundle of life in the care of
YHWH; but He will fling away the lives of your enemies as from the
hollow of a sling.

translation.text: Yet a man is risen to pursue thee, and to seek thy soul: but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the LORD thy God; and the souls of thine enemies, them shall he sling out, as out of the middle of a sling.

verses.english:
And if anyone sets out to pursue you and seek your life, the life
of my lord will be bound up in the bundle of life in the care of
YHWH; but He will fling away the lives of your enemies as from the
hollow of a sling.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי־יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה לַאדֹנִי כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֶת־הַטּוֹבָה עָלֶיךָ וְצִוְּךָ לְנָגִיד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּי־יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה לַאדֹנִי כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֶת־הַטּוֹבָה עָלֶיךָ וְצִוְּךָ לְנָגִיד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And when YHWH has accomplished for my lord all the good He has
promised you, and has appointed you ruler of Israel,

translation.text: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee, and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel;

verses.english:
And when YHWH has accomplished for my lord all the good He has
promised you, and has appointed you ruler of Israel,

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תִהְיֶה זֹאת לְךָ לְפוּקָה וּלְמִכְשׁוֹל לֵב לַאדֹנִי וְלִשְׁפּךְ־דָּם חִנָּם וּלְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֲדֹנִי לוֹ וְהֵיטִב יְהֹוָה לַאדֹנִי וְזָכַרְתָּ אֶת־אֲמָתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא תִהְיֶה זֹאת לְךָ לְפוּקָה וּלְמִכְשׁוֹל לֵב לַאדֹנִי וְלִשְׁפּךְ־דָּם חִנָּם וּלְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֲדֹנִי לוֹ וְהֵיטִב יְהֹוָה לַאדֹנִי וְזָכַרְתָּ אֶת־אֲמָתֶךָ׃

english.text:
do not let this be a cause of stumbling and of faltering courage
to my lord that you have shed blood needlessly and that my lord
sought redress with his own hands. And when YHWH has prospered my
lord, remember your maid.”

translation.text: That this shall be no grief unto thee, nor offence of heart unto my lord, either that thou hast shed blood causeless, or that my lord hath avenged himself: but when the LORD shall have dealt well with my lord, then remember thine handmaid.

verses.english:
do not let this be a cause of stumbling and of faltering courage
to my lord that you have shed blood needlessly and that my lord
sought redress with his own hands. And when YHWH has prospered my
lord, remember your maid.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לַאֲבִיגַל בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחֵךְ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לִקְרָאתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לַאֲבִיגַל בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחֵךְ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לִקְרָאתִי׃

english.text:
David said to Abigail, “Praised be YHWH, the God of Israel, who
sent you this day to meet me!

translation.text: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which sent thee this day to meet me:

verses.english:
David said to Abigail, “Praised be YHWH, the God of Israel, who
sent you this day to meet me!

verses.hebrew: וּבָרוּךְ טַעְמֵךְ וּבְרוּכָה אָתְּ אֲשֶׁר כְּלִתִנִי הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה מִבּוֹא בְדָמִים וְהֹשֵׁעַ יָדִי לִי׃

hebrew.text: וּבָרוּךְ טַעְמֵךְ וּבְרוּכָה אָתְּ אֲשֶׁר כְּלִתִנִי הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה מִבּוֹא בְדָמִים וְהֹשֵׁעַ יָדִי לִי׃

english.text:
And blessed be your prudence, and blessed be you yourself for
restraining me from seeking redress in blood by my own hands.

translation.text: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.

verses.english:
And blessed be your prudence, and blessed be you yourself for
restraining me from seeking redress in blood by my own hands.

verses.hebrew:
וְאוּלָם חַי־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר מְנָעַנִי מֵהָרַע אֹתָךְ כִּי לוּלֵי מִהַרְתְּ (ותבאתי) [וַתָּבֹאת] לִקְרָאתִי כִּי אִם־נוֹתַר לְנָבָל עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר מַשְׁתִּין
בְּקִיר׃

hebrew.text:
וְאוּלָם חַי־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר מְנָעַנִי מֵהָרַע אֹתָךְ כִּי לוּלֵי מִהַרְתְּ (ותבאתי) [וַתָּבֹאת] לִקְרָאתִי כִּי אִם־נוֹתַר לְנָבָל עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר מַשְׁתִּין
בְּקִיר׃

english.text:
For as sure as YHWH, the God of Israel, lives—who has kept me from
harming you—had you not come quickly to meet me, not a single male
of Nabal’s line would have been left by daybreak.”

translation.text: For in very deed, as the LORD God of Israel liveth, which hath kept me back from hurting thee, except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.

verses.english:
For as sure as YHWH, the God of Israel, lives—who has kept me from
harming you—had you not come quickly to meet me, not a single male
of Nabal’s line would have been left by daybreak.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד מִיָּדָהּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִיאָה לוֹ וְלָהּ אָמַר עֲלִי לְשָׁלוֹם לְבֵיתֵךְ רְאִי שָׁמַעְתִּי בְקוֹלֵךְ וָאֶשָּׂא פָּנָיִךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד מִיָּדָהּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִיאָה לוֹ וְלָהּ אָמַר עֲלִי לְשָׁלוֹם לְבֵיתֵךְ רְאִי שָׁמַעְתִּי בְקוֹלֵךְ וָאֶשָּׂא פָּנָיִךְ׃

english.text:
David then accepted from her what she had brought him, and he said
to her, “Go up to your home safely. See, I have heeded your plea
and respected your wish.”

translation.text: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him, and said unto her, Go up in peace to thine house; see, I have hearkened to thy voice, and have accepted thy person.

verses.english:
David then accepted from her what she had brought him, and he said
to her, “Go up to your home safely. See, I have heeded your plea
and respected your wish.”

verses.hebrew:
וַתָּבֹא אֲבִיגַיִל אֶל־נָבָל וְהִנֵּה־לוֹ מִשְׁתֶּה בְּבֵיתוֹ כְּמִשְׁתֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלֵב נָבָל טוֹב עָלָיו וְהוּא שִׁכֹּר עַד־מְאֹד וְלֹא־הִגִּידָה לּוֹ דָּבָר קָטֹן וְגָדוֹל
עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר׃

hebrew.text:
וַתָּבֹא אֲבִיגַיִל אֶל־נָבָל וְהִנֵּה־לוֹ מִשְׁתֶּה בְּבֵיתוֹ כְּמִשְׁתֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלֵב נָבָל טוֹב עָלָיו וְהוּא שִׁכֹּר עַד־מְאֹד וְלֹא־הִגִּידָה לּוֹ דָּבָר קָטֹן וְגָדוֹל
עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר׃

english.text:
When Abigail came home to Nabal, he was having a feast in his
house, a feast fit for a king; Nabal was in a merry mood and very
drunk, so she did not tell him anything at all until daybreak.

translation.text: And Abigail came to Nabal; and, behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king; and Nabal’s heart was merry within him, for he was very drunken: wherefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.

verses.english:
When Abigail came home to Nabal, he was having a feast in his
house, a feast fit for a king; Nabal was in a merry mood and very
drunk, so she did not tell him anything at all until daybreak.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר בְּצֵאת הַיַּיִן מִנָּבָל וַתַּגֶּד־לוֹ אִשְׁתּוֹ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיָּמת לִבּוֹ בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְהוּא הָיָה לְאָבֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר בְּצֵאת הַיַּיִן מִנָּבָל וַתַּגֶּד־לוֹ אִשְׁתּוֹ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיָּמת לִבּוֹ בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְהוּא הָיָה לְאָבֶן׃

english.text:
The next morning, when Nabal had slept off the wine, his wife told
him everything that had happened; and his heart died within him,
and he became like a stone.

translation.text: But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.

verses.english:
The next morning, when Nabal had slept off the wine, his wife told
him everything that had happened; and his heart died within him,
and he became like a stone.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּעֲשֶׂרֶת הַיָּמִים וַיִּגֹּף יְהֹוָה אֶת־נָבָל וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּעֲשֶׂרֶת הַיָּמִים וַיִּגֹּף יְהֹוָה אֶת־נָבָל וַיָּמֹת׃
