english.text: About ten days later YHWH struck Nabal and he died.

translation.text: And it came to pass about ten days after, that the LORD smote Nabal, that he died.

verses.english: About ten days later YHWH struck Nabal and he died.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד כִּי מֵת נָבָל וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר רָב אֶת־רִיב חֶרְפָּתִי מִיַּד נָבָל וְאֶת־עַבְדּוֹ חָשַׂךְ מֵרָעָה וְאֵת רָעַת נָבָל הֵשִׁיב יְהֹוָה בְּרֹאשׁוֹ
וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד וַיְדַבֵּר בַּאֲבִיגַיִל לְקַחְתָּהּ לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד כִּי מֵת נָבָל וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר רָב אֶת־רִיב חֶרְפָּתִי מִיַּד נָבָל וְאֶת־עַבְדּוֹ חָשַׂךְ מֵרָעָה וְאֵת רָעַת נָבָל הֵשִׁיב יְהֹוָה בְּרֹאשׁוֹ
וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד וַיְדַבֵּר בַּאֲבִיגַיִל לְקַחְתָּהּ לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, “Praised be YHWH
who championed my cause against the insults of Nabal and held back
His servant from wrongdoing; YHWH has brought Nabal’s wrongdoing
down on his own head.” David sent messengers to propose marriage
to Abigail, to take her as his wife.

translation.text: And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be the LORD, that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his servant from evil: for the LORD hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.

verses.english:
When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, “Praised be YHWH
who championed my cause against the insults of Nabal and held back
His servant from wrongdoing; YHWH has brought Nabal’s wrongdoing
down on his own head.” David sent messengers to propose marriage
to Abigail, to take her as his wife.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי דָוִד אֶל־אֲבִיגַיִל הַכַּרְמֶלָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלֶיהָ לֵאמֹר דָּוִד שְׁלָחָנוּ אֵלַיִךְ לְקַחְתֵּךְ לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי דָוִד אֶל־אֲבִיגַיִל הַכַּרְמֶלָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלֶיהָ לֵאמֹר דָּוִד שְׁלָחָנוּ אֵלַיִךְ לְקַחְתֵּךְ לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
When David’s servants came to Abigail at Carmel and told her that
David had sent them to her to make her his wife,

translation.text: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto thee, to take thee to him to wife.

verses.english:
When David’s servants came to Abigail at Carmel and told her that
David had sent them to her to make her his wife,

verses.hebrew: וַתָּקם וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ אַפַּיִם אָרְצָה וַתֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה אֲמָתְךָ לְשִׁפְחָה לִרְחֹץ רַגְלֵי עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּקם וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ אַפַּיִם אָרְצָה וַתֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה אֲמָתְךָ לְשִׁפְחָה לִרְחֹץ רַגְלֵי עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנִי׃

english.text:
she immediately bowed low with her face to the ground and said,
“Your handmaid is ready to be your maidservant, to wash the feet
of my lord’s servants.”

translation.text: And she arose, and bowed herself on her face to the earth, and said, Behold, let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.

verses.english:
she immediately bowed low with her face to the ground and said,
“Your handmaid is ready to be your maidservant, to wash the feet
of my lord’s servants.”

verses.hebrew: וַתְּמַהֵר וַתָּקם אֲבִיגַיִל וַתִּרְכַּב עַל־הַחֲמוֹר וְחָמֵשׁ נַעֲרֹתֶיהָ הַהֹלְכוֹת לְרַגְלָהּ וַתֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי מַלְאֲכֵי דָוִד וַתְּהִי־לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּמַהֵר וַתָּקם אֲבִיגַיִל וַתִּרְכַּב עַל־הַחֲמוֹר וְחָמֵשׁ נַעֲרֹתֶיהָ הַהֹלְכוֹת לְרַגְלָהּ וַתֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי מַלְאֲכֵי דָוִד וַתְּהִי־לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
Then Abigail rose quickly and mounted an ass, and with five of her
maids in attendance she followed David’s messengers; and she
became his wife.

translation.text: And Abigail hasted, and arose and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

verses.english:
Then Abigail rose quickly and mounted an ass, and with five of her
maids in attendance she followed David’s messengers; and she
became his wife.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־אֲחִינֹעַם לָקַח דָּוִד מִיִּזְרְעֶאל וַתִּהְיֶיןָ גַּם־שְׁתֵּיהֶן לוֹ לְנָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־אֲחִינֹעַם לָקַח דָּוִד מִיִּזְרְעֶאל וַתִּהְיֶיןָ גַּם־שְׁתֵּיהֶן לוֹ לְנָשִׁים׃

english.text:
Now David had taken Ahinoam of Jezreel; so both of them became his
wives.

translation.text: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of them his wives.

verses.english:
Now David had taken Ahinoam of Jezreel; so both of them became his
wives.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁאוּל נָתַן אֶת־מִיכַל בִּתּוֹ אֵשֶׁת דָּוִד לְפַלְטִי בֶן־לַיִשׁ אֲשֶׁר מִגַּלִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁאוּל נָתַן אֶת־מִיכַל בִּתּוֹ אֵשֶׁת דָּוִד לְפַלְטִי בֶן־לַיִשׁ אֲשֶׁר מִגַּלִּים׃

english.text:
Saul had given his daughter Michal, David’s wife, to Palti son of
Laish from Gallim.

translation.text: But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Phalti the son of Laish, which was of Gallim.

verses.english:
Saul had given his daughter Michal, David’s wife, to Palti son of
Laish from Gallim.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַזִּפִים אֶל־שָׁאוּל הַגִּבְעָתָה לֵאמֹר הֲלוֹא דָוִד מִסְתַּתֵּר בְּגִבְעַת הַחֲכִילָה עַל פְּנֵי הַיְשִׁימֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַזִּפִים אֶל־שָׁאוּל הַגִּבְעָתָה לֵאמֹר הֲלוֹא דָוִד מִסְתַּתֵּר בְּגִבְעַת הַחֲכִילָה עַל פְּנֵי הַיְשִׁימֹן׃

english.text:
The Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah and said, “David is hiding in
the hill of Hachilah facing Jeshimon.”

translation.text: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?

verses.english:
The Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah and said, “David is hiding in
the hill of Hachilah facing Jeshimon.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם שָׁאוּל וַיֵּרֶד אֶל־מִדְבַּר־זִיף וְאִתּוֹ שְׁלֹשֶׁת־אֲלָפִים אִישׁ בְּחוּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־דָּוִד בְּמִדְבַּר־זִיף׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם שָׁאוּל וַיֵּרֶד אֶל־מִדְבַּר־זִיף וְאִתּוֹ שְׁלֹשֶׁת־אֲלָפִים אִישׁ בְּחוּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־דָּוִד בְּמִדְבַּר־זִיף׃

english.text:
Saul went down at once to the wilderness of Ziph, together with
three thousand picked men of Israel, to search for David in the
wilderness of Ziph,

translation.text: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.

verses.english:
Saul went down at once to the wilderness of Ziph, together with
three thousand picked men of Israel, to search for David in the
wilderness of Ziph,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַן שָׁאוּל בְּגִבְעַת הַחֲכִילָה אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הַיְשִׁימֹן עַל־הַדָּרֶךְ וְדָוִד יֹשֵׁב בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיַּרְא כִּי בָא שָׁאוּל אַחֲרָיו הַמִּדְבָּרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַן שָׁאוּל בְּגִבְעַת הַחֲכִילָה אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הַיְשִׁימֹן עַל־הַדָּרֶךְ וְדָוִד יֹשֵׁב בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיַּרְא כִּי בָא שָׁאוּל אַחֲרָיו הַמִּדְבָּרָה׃

english.text:
and Saul encamped on the hill of Hachilah which faces Jeshimon, by
the road. When David, who was then living in the wilderness,
learned that Saul had come after him into the wilderness,

translation.text: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

verses.english:
and Saul encamped on the hill of Hachilah which faces Jeshimon, by
the road. When David, who was then living in the wilderness,
learned that Saul had come after him into the wilderness,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד מְרַגְּלִים וַיֵּדַע כִּי־בָא שָׁאוּל אֶל־נָכוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד מְרַגְּלִים וַיֵּדַע כִּי־בָא שָׁאוּל אֶל־נָכוֹן׃

english.text: David sent out scouts and made sure that Saul had come.

translation.text: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come in very deed.

verses.english: David sent out scouts and made sure that Saul had come.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַיָּבֹא אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר חָנָה־שָׁם שָׁאוּל וַיַּרְא דָּוִד אֶת־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר שָׁכַב־שָׁם שָׁאוּל וְאַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר שַׂר־צְבָאוֹ וְשָׁאוּל שֹׁכֵב
בַּמַּעְגָּל וְהָעָם חֹנִים סְבִיבֹתָו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַיָּבֹא אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר חָנָה־שָׁם שָׁאוּל וַיַּרְא דָּוִד אֶת־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר שָׁכַב־שָׁם שָׁאוּל וְאַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר שַׂר־צְבָאוֹ וְשָׁאוּל שֹׁכֵב
בַּמַּעְגָּל וְהָעָם חֹנִים סְבִיבֹתָו׃

english.text:
David went at once to the place where Saul had encamped, and David
saw the spot where Saul and his army commander, Abner son of Ner,
lay asleep. Saul lay asleep inside the barricade and the troops
were posted around him.

translation.text: And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had pitched: and David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people pitched round about him.

verses.english:
David went at once to the place where Saul had encamped, and David
saw the spot where Saul and his army commander, Abner son of Ner,
lay asleep. Saul lay asleep inside the barricade and the troops
were posted around him.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ הַחִתִּי וְאֶל־אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן־צְרוּיָה אֲחִי יוֹאָב לֵאמֹר מִי־יֵרֵד אִתִּי אֶל־שָׁאוּל אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִישַׁי אֲנִי אֵרֵד
עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ הַחִתִּי וְאֶל־אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן־צְרוּיָה אֲחִי יוֹאָב לֵאמֹר מִי־יֵרֵד אִתִּי אֶל־שָׁאוּל אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִישַׁי אֲנִי אֵרֵד
עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
David spoke up and asked Ahimelech the Hittite and Abishai son of
Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, “Who will go down with me into the camp
to Saul?” And Abishai answered, “I will go down with you.”

translation.text: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, saying, Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp? And Abishai said, I will go down with thee.

verses.english:
David spoke up and asked Ahimelech the Hittite and Abishai son of
Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, “Who will go down with me into the camp
to Saul?” And Abishai answered, “I will go down with you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד וַאֲבִישַׁי אֶל־הָעָם לַיְלָה וְהִנֵּה שָׁאוּל שֹׁכֵב יָשֵׁן בַּמַּעְגָּל וַחֲנִיתוֹ מְעוּכָה־בָאָרֶץ מְרַאֲשֹׁתָו וְאַבְנֵר וְהָעָם שֹׁכְבִים סְבִיבֹתָו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד וַאֲבִישַׁי אֶל־הָעָם לַיְלָה וְהִנֵּה שָׁאוּל שֹׁכֵב יָשֵׁן בַּמַּעְגָּל וַחֲנִיתוֹ מְעוּכָה־בָאָרֶץ מְרַאֲשֹׁתָו וְאַבְנֵר וְהָעָם שֹׁכְבִים סְבִיבֹתָו׃

english.text:
So David and Abishai approached the troops by night, and found
Saul fast asleep inside the barricade, his spear stuck in the
ground at his head, and Abner and the troops sleeping around him.

translation.text: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the trench, and his spear stuck in the ground at his bolster: but Abner and the people lay round about him.

verses.english:
So David and Abishai approached the troops by night, and found
Saul fast asleep inside the barricade, his spear stuck in the
ground at his head, and Abner and the troops sleeping around him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִישַׁי אֶל־דָּוִד סִגַּר אֱלֹהִים הַיּוֹם אֶת־אוֹיִבְךָ בְּיָדֶךָ וְעַתָּה אַכֶּנּוּ נָא בַּחֲנִית וּבָאָרֶץ פַּעַם אַחַת וְלֹא אֶשְׁנֶה לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִישַׁי אֶל־דָּוִד סִגַּר אֱלֹהִים הַיּוֹם אֶת־אוֹיִבְךָ בְּיָדֶךָ וְעַתָּה אַכֶּנּוּ נָא בַּחֲנִית וּבָאָרֶץ פַּעַם אַחַת וְלֹא אֶשְׁנֶה לוֹ׃

english.text:
And Abishai said to David, “God has delivered your enemy into your
hands today. Let me pin him to the ground with a single thrust of
the spear. I will not have to strike him twice.”

translation.text: Then said Abishai to David, God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day: now therefore let me smite him, I pray thee, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not smite him the second time.

verses.english:
And Abishai said to David, “God has delivered your enemy into your
hands today. Let me pin him to the ground with a single thrust of
the spear. I will not have to strike him twice.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אֲבִישַׁי אַל־תַּשְׁחִיתֵהוּ כִּי מִי שָׁלַח יָדוֹ בִּמְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה וְנִקָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אֲבִישַׁי אַל־תַּשְׁחִיתֵהוּ כִּי מִי שָׁלַח יָדוֹ בִּמְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה וְנִקָּה׃

english.text:
But David said to Abishai, “Don’t do him violence! No one can lay
hands on YHWH’s anointed with impunity.”

translation.text: And David said to Abishai, Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the LORD’s anointed, and be guiltless?

verses.english:
But David said to Abishai, “Don’t do him violence! No one can lay
hands on YHWH’s anointed with impunity.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי אִם־יְהֹוָה יִגֳּפֶנּוּ אוֹ־יוֹמוֹ יָבוֹא וָמֵת אוֹ בַמִּלְחָמָה יֵרֵד וְנִסְפָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי אִם־יְהֹוָה יִגֳּפֶנּוּ אוֹ־יוֹמוֹ יָבוֹא וָמֵת אוֹ בַמִּלְחָמָה יֵרֵד וְנִסְפָּה׃

english.text:
And David went on, “As YHWH lives, YHWH Himself will strike him
down, or his time will come and he will die, or he will go down to
battle and perish.

translation.text: David said furthermore, As the LORD liveth, the LORD shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall descend into battle, and perish.

verses.english:
And David went on, “As YHWH lives, YHWH Himself will strike him
down, or his time will come and he will die, or he will go down to
battle and perish.

verses.hebrew: חָלִילָה לִּי מֵיְהֹוָה מִשְּׁלֹחַ יָדִי בִּמְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה וְעַתָּה קַח־נָא אֶת־הַחֲנִית אֲשֶׁר מְרַאֲשֹׁתָו וְאֶת־צַפַּחַת הַמַּיִם וְנֵלְכָה־לָּנוּ׃

hebrew.text: חָלִילָה לִּי מֵיְהֹוָה מִשְּׁלֹחַ יָדִי בִּמְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה וְעַתָּה קַח־נָא אֶת־הַחֲנִית אֲשֶׁר מְרַאֲשֹׁתָו וְאֶת־צַפַּחַת הַמַּיִם וְנֵלְכָה־לָּנוּ׃

english.text:
But YHWH forbid that I should lay a hand on YHWH’s anointed! Just
take the spear and the water jar at his head and let’s be off.”

translation.text: The LORD forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the LORD’s anointed: but, I pray thee, take thou now the spear that is at his bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.

verses.english:
But YHWH forbid that I should lay a hand on YHWH’s anointed! Just
take the spear and the water jar at his head and let’s be off.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־הַחֲנִית וְאֶת־צַפַּחַת הַמַּיִם מֵרַאֲשֹׁתֵי שָׁאוּל וַיֵּלְכוּ לָהֶם וְאֵין רֹאֶה וְאֵין יוֹדֵעַ וְאֵין מֵקִיץ כִּי כֻלָּם יְשֵׁנִים כִּי תַּרְדֵּמַת יְהֹוָה
נָפְלָה עֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־הַחֲנִית וְאֶת־צַפַּחַת הַמַּיִם מֵרַאֲשֹׁתֵי שָׁאוּל וַיֵּלְכוּ לָהֶם וְאֵין רֹאֶה וְאֵין יוֹדֵעַ וְאֵין מֵקִיץ כִּי כֻלָּם יְשֵׁנִים כִּי תַּרְדֵּמַת יְהֹוָה
נָפְלָה עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
So David took away the spear and the water jar at Saul’s head, and
they left. No one saw or knew or woke up; all remained asleep; a
deep sleep from YHWH had fallen upon them.

translation.text: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul’s bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw it, nor knew it, neither awaked: for they were all asleep; because a deep sleep from the LORD was fallen upon them.

verses.english:
So David took away the spear and the water jar at Saul’s head, and
they left. No one saw or knew or woke up; all remained asleep; a
deep sleep from YHWH had fallen upon them.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר דָּוִד הָעֵבֶר וַיַּעֲמֹד עַל־רֹאשׁ־הָהָר מֵרָחֹק רַב הַמָּקוֹם בֵּינֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר דָּוִד הָעֵבֶר וַיַּעֲמֹד עַל־רֹאשׁ־הָהָר מֵרָחֹק רַב הַמָּקוֹם בֵּינֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
David crossed over to the other side and stood afar on top of a
hill; there was considerable distance between them.

translation.text: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of an hill afar off; a great space being between them:

verses.english:
David crossed over to the other side and stood afar on top of a
hill; there was considerable distance between them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא דָוִד אֶל־הָעָם וְאֶל־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר לֵאמֹר הֲלוֹא תַעֲנֶה אַבְנֵר וַיַּעַן אַבְנֵר וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אַתָּה קָרָאתָ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא דָוִד אֶל־הָעָם וְאֶל־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר לֵאמֹר הֲלוֹא תַעֲנֶה אַבְנֵר וַיַּעַן אַבְנֵר וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אַתָּה קָרָאתָ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
And David shouted to the troops and to Abner son of Ner, “Abner,
aren’t you going to answer?” And Abner shouted back, “Who are you
to shout at the king?”

translation.text: And David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, Answerest thou not, Abner? Then Abner answered and said, Who art thou that criest to the king?

verses.english:
And David shouted to the troops and to Abner son of Ner, “Abner,
aren’t you going to answer?” And Abner shouted back, “Who are you
to shout at the king?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אַבְנֵר הֲלוֹא־אִישׁ אַתָּה וּמִי כָמוֹךָ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְלָמָּה לֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ אֶל־אֲדֹנֶיךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־בָא אַחַד הָעָם לְהַשְׁחִית אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ
אֲדֹנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אַבְנֵר הֲלוֹא־אִישׁ אַתָּה וּמִי כָמוֹךָ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְלָמָּה לֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ אֶל־אֲדֹנֶיךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־בָא אַחַד הָעָם לְהַשְׁחִית אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ
אֲדֹנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And David answered Abner, “You are a man, aren’t you? And there is
no one like you in Israel! So why didn’t you keep watch over your
lord the king? For one of [our] troops came to do violence to your
lord the king.

translation.text: And David said to Abner, Art not thou a valiant man? and who is like to thee in Israel? wherefore then hast thou not kept thy lord the king? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king thy lord.

verses.english:
And David answered Abner, “You are a man, aren’t you? And there is
no one like you in Israel! So why didn’t you keep watch over your
lord the king? For one of [our] troops came to do violence to your
lord the king.

verses.hebrew:
לֹא־טוֹב הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי בְנֵי־מָוֶת אַתֶּם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שְׁמַרְתֶּם עַל־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם עַל־מְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה וְעַתָּה רְאֵה אֵי־חֲנִית הַמֶּלֶךְ
וְאֶת־צַפַּחַת הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר מְרַאֲשֹׁתָו׃

hebrew.text:
לֹא־טוֹב הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי בְנֵי־מָוֶת אַתֶּם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שְׁמַרְתֶּם עַל־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם עַל־מְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה וְעַתָּה רְאֵה אֵי־חֲנִית הַמֶּלֶךְ
וְאֶת־צַפַּחַת הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר מְרַאֲשֹׁתָו׃

english.text:
You have not given a good account of yourself! As YHWH lives, [all
of] you deserve to die, because you did not keep watch over your
lord, YHWH’s anointed. Look around, where are the king’s spear and
the water jar that were at his head?”

translation.text: This thing is not good that thou hast done. As the LORD liveth, ye are worthy to die, because ye have not kept your master, the LORD’s anointed.

verses.english:
You have not given a good account of yourself! As YHWH lives, [all
of] you deserve to die, because you did not keep watch over your
lord, YHWH’s anointed. Look around, where are the king’s spear and
the water jar that were at his head?”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּר שָׁאוּל אֶת־קוֹל דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הֲקוֹלְךָ זֶה בְּנִי דָוִד וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד קוֹלִי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכֵּר שָׁאוּל אֶת־קוֹל דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הֲקוֹלְךָ זֶה בְּנִי דָוִד וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד קוֹלִי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Saul recognized David’s voice, and he asked, “Is that your voice,
my son David?” And David replied, “It is, my lord king.”

translation.text: And Saul knew David’s voice, and said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And David said, It is my voice, my lord, O king.

verses.english:
Saul recognized David’s voice, and he asked, “Is that your voice,
my son David?” And David replied, “It is, my lord king.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָּה זֶּה אֲדֹנִי רֹדֵף אַחֲרֵי עַבְדּוֹ כִּי מֶה עָשִׂיתִי וּמַה־בְּיָדִי רָעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָּה זֶּה אֲדֹנִי רֹדֵף אַחֲרֵי עַבְדּוֹ כִּי מֶה עָשִׂיתִי וּמַה־בְּיָדִי רָעָה׃

english.text:
And he went on, “But why does my lord continue to pursue his
servant? What have I done, and what wrong am I guilty of?

translation.text: And he said, Wherefore doth my lord thus pursue after his servant? for what have I done? or what evil is in mine hand?

verses.english:
And he went on, “But why does my lord continue to pursue his
servant? What have I done, and what wrong am I guilty of?

verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה יִשְׁמַע־נָא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת דִּבְרֵי עַבְדּוֹ אִם־יְהֹוָה הֱסִיתְךָ בִי יָרַח מִנְחָה וְאִם בְּנֵי הָאָדָם אֲרוּרִים הֵם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי־גֵרְשׁוּנִי הַיּוֹם
מֵהִסְתַּפֵּחַ בְּנַחֲלַת יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר לֵךְ עֲבֹד אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה יִשְׁמַע־נָא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת דִּבְרֵי עַבְדּוֹ אִם־יְהֹוָה הֱסִיתְךָ בִי יָרַח מִנְחָה וְאִם בְּנֵי הָאָדָם אֲרוּרִים הֵם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי־גֵרְשׁוּנִי הַיּוֹם
מֵהִסְתַּפֵּחַ בְּנַחֲלַת יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר לֵךְ עֲבֹד אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

english.text:
Now let my lord the king hear his servant out. If YHWH has incited
you against me, let Him be appeased by an offering; but if it is
men, may they be accursed of YHWH! For they have driven me out
today, so that I cannot have a share in YHWH’s possession, but am
told, ‘Go and worship other gods.’

translation.text: Now therefore, I pray thee, let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If the LORD have stirred thee up against me, let him accept an offering: but if they be the children of men, cursed be they before the LORD; for they have driven me out this day from abiding in the inheritance of the LORD, saying, Go, serve other gods.

verses.english:
Now let my lord the king hear his servant out. If YHWH has incited
you against me, let Him be appeased by an offering; but if it is
men, may they be accursed of YHWH! For they have driven me out
today, so that I cannot have a share in YHWH’s possession, but am
told, ‘Go and worship other gods.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אַל־יִפֹּל דָּמִי אַרְצָה מִנֶּגֶד פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי־יָצָא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־פַּרְעֹשׁ אֶחָד כַּאֲשֶׁר יִרְדֹּף הַקֹּרֵא בֶּהָרִים׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אַל־יִפֹּל דָּמִי אַרְצָה מִנֶּגֶד פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי־יָצָא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־פַּרְעֹשׁ אֶחָד כַּאֲשֶׁר יִרְדֹּף הַקֹּרֵא בֶּהָרִים׃

english.text:
Oh, let my blood not fall to the ground, away from the presence of
YHWH! For the king of Israel has come out to seek a single flea—as
if he were hunting a partridge in the hills.”

translation.text: Now therefore, let not my blood fall to the earth before the face of the LORD: for the king of Israel is come out to seek a flea, as when one doth hunt a partridge in the mountains.

verses.english:
Oh, let my blood not fall to the ground, away from the presence of
YHWH! For the king of Israel has come out to seek a single flea—as
if he were hunting a partridge in the hills.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל חָטָאתִי שׁוּב בְּנִי־דָוִד כִּי לֹא־אָרַע לְךָ עוֹד תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר יָקְרָה נַפְשִׁי בְּעֵינֶיךָ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הִנֵּה הִסְכַּלְתִּי וָאֶשְׁגֶּה הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל חָטָאתִי שׁוּב בְּנִי־דָוִד כִּי לֹא־אָרַע לְךָ עוֹד תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר יָקְרָה נַפְשִׁי בְּעֵינֶיךָ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הִנֵּה הִסְכַּלְתִּי וָאֶשְׁגֶּה הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And Saul answered, “I am in the wrong. Come back, my son David,
for I will never harm you again, seeing how you have held my life
precious this day. Yes, I have been a fool, and I have erred so
very much.”

translation.text: Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David: for I will no more do thee harm, because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day: behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.

verses.english:
And Saul answered, “I am in the wrong. Come back, my son David,
for I will never harm you again, seeing how you have held my life
precious this day. Yes, I have been a fool, and I have erred so
very much.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה (החנית) [חֲנִית] הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיַעֲבֹר אֶחָד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וְיִקָּחֶהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה (החנית) [חֲנִית] הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיַעֲבֹר אֶחָד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וְיִקָּחֶהָ׃

english.text:
David replied, “Here is Your Majesty’s spear. Let one of the young
men come over and get it.

translation.text: And David answered and said, Behold the king’s spear! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it.

verses.english:
David replied, “Here is Your Majesty’s spear. Let one of the young
men come over and get it.

verses.hebrew: וַיהֹוָה יָשִׁיב לָאִישׁ אֶת־צִדְקָתוֹ וְאֶת־אֱמֻנָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נְתָנְךָ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם בְּיָד וְלֹא אָבִיתִי לִשְׁלֹחַ יָדִי בִּמְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיהֹוָה יָשִׁיב לָאִישׁ אֶת־צִדְקָתוֹ וְאֶת־אֱמֻנָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נְתָנְךָ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם בְּיָד וְלֹא אָבִיתִי לִשְׁלֹחַ יָדִי בִּמְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And YHWH will requite every man for his right conduct and
loyalty—for this day YHWH delivered you into my hands and I would
not raise a hand against YHWH’s anointed.

translation.text: The LORD render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; for the LORD delivered thee into my hand to day, but I would not stretch forth mine hand against the LORD’s anointed.

verses.english:
And YHWH will requite every man for his right conduct and
loyalty—for this day YHWH delivered you into my hands and I would
not raise a hand against YHWH’s anointed.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה כַּאֲשֶׁר גָּדְלָה נַפְשְׁךָ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בְּעֵינָי כֵּן תִּגְדַּל נַפְשִׁי בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וְיַצִּלֵנִי מִכּל־צָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה כַּאֲשֶׁר גָּדְלָה נַפְשְׁךָ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בְּעֵינָי כֵּן תִּגְדַּל נַפְשִׁי בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וְיַצִּלֵנִי מִכּל־צָרָה׃

english.text:
And just as I valued your life highly this day, so may YHWH value
my life and may He rescue me from all trouble.”

translation.text: And, behold, as thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes, so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the LORD, and let him deliver me out of all tribulation.

verses.english:
And just as I valued your life highly this day, so may YHWH value
my life and may He rescue me from all trouble.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה בְּנִי דָוִד גַּם עָשֹׂה תַעֲשֶׂה וְגַם יָכֹל תּוּכָל וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד לְדַרְכּוֹ וְשָׁאוּל שָׁב לִמְקוֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה בְּנִי דָוִד גַּם עָשֹׂה תַעֲשֶׂה וְגַם יָכֹל תּוּכָל וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד לְדַרְכּוֹ וְשָׁאוּל שָׁב לִמְקוֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
Saul answered David, “May you be blessed, my son David. You shall
achieve, and you shall prevail.” David then went his way, and Saul
returned home.

translation.text: Then Saul said to David, Blessed be thou, my son David: thou shalt both do great things, and also shalt still prevail. So David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.

verses.english:
Saul answered David, “May you be blessed, my son David. You shall
achieve, and you shall prevail.” David then went his way, and Saul
returned home.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־לִבּוֹ עַתָּה אֶסָּפֶה יוֹם־אֶחָד בְּיַד־שָׁאוּל אֵין־לִי טוֹב כִּי הִמָּלֵט אִמָּלֵט אֶל־אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְנוֹאַשׁ מִמֶּנִּי שָׁאוּל לְבַקְשֵׁנִי עוֹד
בְּכל־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִמְלַטְתִּי מִיָּדוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־לִבּוֹ עַתָּה אֶסָּפֶה יוֹם־אֶחָד בְּיַד־שָׁאוּל אֵין־לִי טוֹב כִּי הִמָּלֵט אִמָּלֵט אֶל־אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְנוֹאַשׁ מִמֶּנִּי שָׁאוּל לְבַקְשֵׁנִי עוֹד
בְּכל־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִמְלַטְתִּי מִיָּדוֹ׃

english.text:
David said to himself, “Some day I shall certainly perish at the
hands of Saul. The best thing for me is to flee to the land of the
Philistines; Saul will then give up hunting me throughout the
territory of Israel, and I will escape him.”

translation.text: And David said in his heart, I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul: there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul shall despair of me, to seek me any more in any coast of Israel: so shall I escape out of his hand.

verses.english:
David said to himself, “Some day I shall certainly perish at the
hands of Saul. The best thing for me is to flee to the land of the
Philistines; Saul will then give up hunting me throughout the
territory of Israel, and I will escape him.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַיַּעֲבֹר הוּא וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ אֶל־אָכִישׁ בֶּן־מָעוֹךְ מֶלֶךְ גַּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם דָּוִד וַיַּעֲבֹר הוּא וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ אֶל־אָכִישׁ בֶּן־מָעוֹךְ מֶלֶךְ גַּת׃

english.text:
So David and the six hundred men with him went and crossed over to
King Achish son of Maoch of Gath.

translation.text: And David arose, and he passed over with the six hundred men that were with him unto Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

verses.english:
So David and the six hundred men with him went and crossed over to
King Achish son of Maoch of Gath.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד עִם־אָכִישׁ בְּגַת הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו אִישׁ וּבֵיתוֹ דָּוִד וּשְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו אֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִת וַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת־נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד עִם־אָכִישׁ בְּגַת הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו אִישׁ וּבֵיתוֹ דָּוִד וּשְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו אֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִת וַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת־נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִית׃

english.text:
David and his men stayed with Achish in Gath, each man with his
family, and David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelite and
Abigail wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

translation.text: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.

verses.english:
David and his men stayed with Achish in Gath, each man with his
family, and David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelite and
Abigail wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְשָׁאוּל כִּי־בָרַח דָּוִד גַּת וְלֹא־[יָסַף] (יוסף) עוֹד לְבַקְשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לְשָׁאוּל כִּי־בָרַח דָּוִד גַּת וְלֹא־[יָסַף] (יוסף) עוֹד לְבַקְשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
And when Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, he did not
pursue him anymore.

translation.text: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.

verses.english:
And when Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, he did not
pursue him anymore.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אָכִישׁ אִם־נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ יִתְּנוּ־לִי מָקוֹם בְּאַחַת עָרֵי הַשָּׂדֶה וְאֵשְׁבָה שָּׁם וְלָמָּה יֵשֵׁב עַבְדְּךָ בְּעִיר הַמַּמְלָכָה עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אָכִישׁ אִם־נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ יִתְּנוּ־לִי מָקוֹם בְּאַחַת עָרֵי הַשָּׂדֶה וְאֵשְׁבָה שָּׁם וְלָמָּה יֵשֵׁב עַבְדְּךָ בְּעִיר הַמַּמְלָכָה עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
David said to Achish, “If you please, let a place be granted me in
one of the country towns where I can live; why should your servant
remain with you in the royal city?”

translation.text: And David said unto Achish, If I have now found grace in thine eyes, let them give me a place in some town in the country, that I may dwell there: for why should thy servant dwell in the royal city with thee?

verses.english:
David said to Achish, “If you please, let a place be granted me in
one of the country towns where I can live; why should your servant
remain with you in the royal city?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ אָכִישׁ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת־צִקְלָג לָכֵן הָיְתָה צִקְלַג לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ אָכִישׁ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת־צִקְלָג לָכֵן הָיְתָה צִקְלַג לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
At that time Achish granted him Ziklag; that is how Ziklag came to
belong to the kings of Judah, as is still the case.

translation.text: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day.

verses.english:
At that time Achish granted him Ziklag; that is how Ziklag came to
belong to the kings of Judah, as is still the case.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר־יָשַׁב דָּוִד בִּשְׂדֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים יָמִים וְאַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר־יָשַׁב דָּוִד בִּשְׂדֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים יָמִים וְאַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים׃

english.text:
The length of time that David lived in Philistine territory was a
year and four months.

translation.text: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.

verses.english:
The length of time that David lived in Philistine territory was a
year and four months.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַל דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו וַיִּפְשְׁטוּ אֶל־הַגְּשׁוּרִי (והגרזי) [וְהַגִּזְרִי] וְהָעֲמָלֵקִי כִּי הֵנָּה יֹשְׁבוֹת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר מֵעוֹלָם בּוֹאֲךָ שׁוּרָה וְעַד־אֶרֶץ
מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַל דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו וַיִּפְשְׁטוּ אֶל־הַגְּשׁוּרִי (והגרזי) [וְהַגִּזְרִי] וְהָעֲמָלֵקִי כִּי הֵנָּה יֹשְׁבוֹת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר מֵעוֹלָם בּוֹאֲךָ שׁוּרָה וְעַד־אֶרֶץ
מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Gizrites,
and the Amalekites—who were the inhabitants of the region of Olam,
all the way to Shur and to the land of Egypt.—

translation.text: And David and his men went up, and invaded the Geshurites, and the Gezrites, and the Amalekites: for those nations were of old the inhabitants of the land, as thou goest to Shur, even unto the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Gizrites,
and the Amalekites—who were the inhabitants of the region of Olam,
all the way to Shur and to the land of Egypt.—

verses.hebrew: וְהִכָּה דָוִד אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא יְחַיֶּה אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה וְלָקַח צֹאן וּבָקָר וַחֲמֹרִים וּגְמַלִּים וּבְגָדִים וַיָּשׁב וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אָכִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִכָּה דָוִד אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא יְחַיֶּה אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה וְלָקַח צֹאן וּבָקָר וַחֲמֹרִים וּגְמַלִּים וּבְגָדִים וַיָּשׁב וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אָכִישׁ׃

english.text:
When David attacked a region, he would leave no man or woman
alive; he would take flocks, herds, asses, camels, and clothing.
When he returned and came to Achish,

translation.text: And David smote the land, and left neither man nor woman alive, and took away the sheep, and the oxen, and the asses, and the camels, and the apparel, and returned, and came to Achish.

verses.english:
When David attacked a region, he would leave no man or woman
alive; he would take flocks, herds, asses, camels, and clothing.
When he returned and came to Achish,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אַל־פְּשַׁטְתֶּם הַיּוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד עַל־נֶגֶב יְהוּדָה וְעַל־נֶגֶב הַיְּרַחְמְאֵלִי וְאֶל־נֶגֶב הַקֵּינִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אַל־פְּשַׁטְתֶּם הַיּוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד עַל־נֶגֶב יְהוּדָה וְעַל־נֶגֶב הַיְּרַחְמְאֵלִי וְאֶל־נֶגֶב הַקֵּינִי׃

english.text:
Achish would ask, “Where did you raid today?” and David would
reply, “The Negeb of Judah,” or “the Negeb of the Jerahmeelites,”
or “the Negeb of the Kenites.”

translation.text: And Achish said, Whither have ye made a road to day? And David said, Against the south of Judah, and against the south of the Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.

verses.english:
Achish would ask, “Where did you raid today?” and David would
reply, “The Negeb of Judah,” or “the Negeb of the Jerahmeelites,”
or “the Negeb of the Kenites.”

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה לֹא־יְחַיֶּה דָוִד לְהָבִיא גַת לֵאמֹר פֶּן־יַגִּדוּ עָלֵינוּ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־עָשָׂה דָוִד וְכֹה מִשְׁפָּטוֹ כּל־הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁב בִּשְׂדֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה לֹא־יְחַיֶּה דָוִד לְהָבִיא גַת לֵאמֹר פֶּן־יַגִּדוּ עָלֵינוּ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־עָשָׂה דָוִד וְכֹה מִשְׁפָּטוֹ כּל־הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁב בִּשְׂדֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
David would leave no man or woman alive to be brought to Gath; for
he thought, “They might tell about us: David did this.” Such was
his practice as long as he stayed in the territory of the
Philistines.

translation.text: And David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring tidings to Gath, saying, Lest they should tell on us, saying, So did David, and so will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines.

verses.english:
David would leave no man or woman alive to be brought to Gath; for
he thought, “They might tell about us: David did this.” Such was
his practice as long as he stayed in the territory of the
Philistines.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּאֲמֵן אָכִישׁ בְּדָוִד לֵאמֹר הַבְאֵשׁ הִבְאִישׁ בְּעַמּוֹ בְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיָה לִי לְעֶבֶד עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּאֲמֵן אָכִישׁ בְּדָוִד לֵאמֹר הַבְאֵשׁ הִבְאִישׁ בְּעַמּוֹ בְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיָה לִי לְעֶבֶד עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
Achish trusted David. He thought: “He has aroused the wrath of his
own people Israel, and so he will be my vassal forever.”

translation.text: And Achish believed David, saying, He hath made his people Israel utterly to abhor him; therefore he shall be my servant for ever.

verses.english:
Achish trusted David. He thought: “He has aroused the wrath of his
own people Israel, and so he will be my vassal forever.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וַיִּקְבְּצוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־מַחֲנֵיהֶם לַצָּבָא לְהִלָּחֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־דָּוִד יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי אִתִּי תֵּצֵא בַמַּחֲנֶה אַתָּה
וַאֲנָשֶׁיךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וַיִּקְבְּצוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־מַחֲנֵיהֶם לַצָּבָא לְהִלָּחֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־דָּוִד יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי אִתִּי תֵּצֵא בַמַּחֲנֶה אַתָּה
וַאֲנָשֶׁיךָ׃

english.text:
At that time the Philistines mustered their forces for war, to
take the field against Israel. Achish said to David, “You know, of
course, that you and your men must march out with my forces.”

translation.text: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. And Achish said unto David, Know thou assuredly, that thou shalt go out with me to battle, thou and thy men.

verses.english:
At that time the Philistines mustered their forces for war, to
take the field against Israel. Achish said to David, “You know, of
course, that you and your men must march out with my forces.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אָכִישׁ לָכֵן אַתָּה תֵדַע אֵת אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂה עַבְדֶּךָ וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־דָּוִד לָכֵן שֹׁמֵר לְרֹאשִׁי אֲשִׂימְךָ כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אָכִישׁ לָכֵן אַתָּה תֵדַע אֵת אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂה עַבְדֶּךָ וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־דָּוִד לָכֵן שֹׁמֵר לְרֹאשִׁי אֲשִׂימְךָ כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
David answered Achish, “You surely know what your servant will
do.” “In that case,” Achish replied to David, “I will appoint you
my bodyguard for life.”

translation.text: And David said to Achish, Surely thou shalt know what thy servant can do. And Achish said to David, Therefore will I make thee keeper of mine head for ever.

verses.english:
David answered Achish, “You surely know what your servant will
do.” “In that case,” Achish replied to David, “I will appoint you
my bodyguard for life.”

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמוּאֵל מֵת וַיִּסְפְּדוּ־לוֹ כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בָרָמָה וּבְעִירוֹ וְשָׁאוּל הֵסִיר הָאֹבוֹת וְאֶת־הַיִּדְּעֹנִים מֵהָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁמוּאֵל מֵת וַיִּסְפְּדוּ־לוֹ כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בָרָמָה וּבְעִירוֹ וְשָׁאוּל הֵסִיר הָאֹבוֹת וְאֶת־הַיִּדְּעֹנִים מֵהָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Now Samuel had died and all Israel made lament for him; and he was
buried in his own town of Ramah. And Saul had forbidden [recourse
to] ghosts and familiar spirits in the land.

translation.text: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had lamented him, and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.

verses.english:
Now Samuel had died and all Israel made lament for him; and he was
buried in his own town of Ramah. And Saul had forbidden [recourse
to] ghosts and familiar spirits in the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּבְצוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְשׁוּנֵם וַיִּקְבֹּץ שָׁאוּל אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּגִּלְבֹּעַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּבְצוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְשׁוּנֵם וַיִּקְבֹּץ שָׁאוּל אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּגִּלְבֹּעַ׃

english.text:
The Philistines mustered and they marched to Shunem and encamped;
and Saul gathered all Israel, and they encamped at Gilboa.

translation.text: And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and pitched in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they pitched in Gilboa.

verses.english:
The Philistines mustered and they marched to Shunem and encamped;
and Saul gathered all Israel, and they encamped at Gilboa.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא שָׁאוּל אֶת־מַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּרָא וַיֶּחֱרַד לִבּוֹ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא שָׁאוּל אֶת־מַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּרָא וַיֶּחֱרַד לִבּוֹ מְאֹד׃

english.text: When Saul saw the Philistine force, his heart trembled with fear.

translation.text: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart greatly trembled.

verses.english: When Saul saw the Philistine force, his heart trembled with fear.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל שָׁאוּל בַּיהֹוָה וְלֹא עָנָהוּ יְהֹוָה גַּם בַּחֲלֹמוֹת גַּם בָּאוּרִים גַּם בַּנְּבִיאִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל שָׁאוּל בַּיהֹוָה וְלֹא עָנָהוּ יְהֹוָה גַּם בַּחֲלֹמוֹת גַּם בָּאוּרִים גַּם בַּנְּבִיאִם׃

english.text:
And Saul inquired of YHWH, but YHWH did not answer him, either by
dreams or by Urim or by prophets.

translation.text: And when Saul enquired of the LORD, the LORD answered him not, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.

verses.english:
And Saul inquired of YHWH, but YHWH did not answer him, either by
dreams or by Urim or by prophets.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לַעֲבָדָיו בַּקְּשׁוּ־לִי אֵשֶׁת בַּעֲלַת־אוֹב וְאֵלְכָה אֵלֶיהָ וְאֶדְרְשָׁה־בָּהּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲבָדָיו אֵלָיו הִנֵּה אֵשֶׁת בַּעֲלַת־אוֹב בְּעֵין דּוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לַעֲבָדָיו בַּקְּשׁוּ־לִי אֵשֶׁת בַּעֲלַת־אוֹב וְאֵלְכָה אֵלֶיהָ וְאֶדְרְשָׁה־בָּהּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲבָדָיו אֵלָיו הִנֵּה אֵשֶׁת בַּעֲלַת־אוֹב בְּעֵין דּוֹר׃

english.text:
Then Saul said to his courtiers, “Find me a woman who consults
ghosts, so that I can go to her and inquire through her.” And his
courtiers told him that there was a woman in En-dor who consulted
ghosts.

translation.text: Then said Saul unto his servants, Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and enquire of her. And his servants said to him, Behold, there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at Endor.

verses.english:
Then Saul said to his courtiers, “Find me a woman who consults
ghosts, so that I can go to her and inquire through her.” And his
courtiers told him that there was a woman in En-dor who consulted
ghosts.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתְחַפֵּשׂ שָׁאוּל וַיִּלְבַּשׁ בְּגָדִים אֲחֵרִים וַיֵּלֶךְ הוּא וּשְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים עִמּוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה לָיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר (קסומי) [קסֳמִי־]נָא לִי בָּאוֹב
וְהַעֲלִי לִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־אֹמַר אֵלָיִךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתְחַפֵּשׂ שָׁאוּל וַיִּלְבַּשׁ בְּגָדִים אֲחֵרִים וַיֵּלֶךְ הוּא וּשְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים עִמּוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה לָיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר (קסומי) [קסֳמִי־]נָא לִי בָּאוֹב
וְהַעֲלִי לִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־אֹמַר אֵלָיִךְ׃

english.text:
Saul disguised himself; he put on different clothes and set out
with two men. They came to the woman by night, and he said,
“Please divine for me by a ghost. Bring up for me the one I shall
name to you.”

translation.text: And Saul disguised himself, and put on other raiment, and he went, and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night: and he said, I pray thee, divine unto me by the familiar spirit, and bring me him up, whom I shall name unto thee.

verses.english:
Saul disguised himself; he put on different clothes and set out
with two men. They came to the woman by night, and he said,
“Please divine for me by a ghost. Bring up for me the one I shall
name to you.”

verses.hebrew:
וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֵלָיו הִנֵּה אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר הִכְרִית אֶת־הָאֹבוֹת וְאֶת־הַיִּדְּעֹנִי מִן־הָאָרֶץ וְלָמָה אַתָּה מִתְנַקֵּשׁ בְּנַפְשִׁי
לַהֲמִיתֵנִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֵלָיו הִנֵּה אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר הִכְרִית אֶת־הָאֹבוֹת וְאֶת־הַיִּדְּעֹנִי מִן־הָאָרֶץ וְלָמָה אַתָּה מִתְנַקֵּשׁ בְּנַפְשִׁי
לַהֲמִיתֵנִי׃

english.text:
But the woman answered him, “You know what Saul has done, how he
has banned [the use of] ghosts and familiar spirits in the land.
So why are you laying a trap for me, to get me killed?”

translation.text: And the woman said unto him, Behold, thou knowest what Saul hath done, how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land: wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life, to cause me to die?

verses.english:
But the woman answered him, “You know what Saul has done, how he
has banned [the use of] ghosts and familiar spirits in the land.
So why are you laying a trap for me, to get me killed?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׁבַע לָהּ שָׁאוּל בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר חַי־יְהֹוָה אִם־יִקְּרֵךְ עָוֺן בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׁבַע לָהּ שָׁאוּל בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר חַי־יְהֹוָה אִם־יִקְּרֵךְ עָוֺן בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Saul swore to her by YHWH: “As YHWH lives, you won’t get into
trouble over this.”

translation.text: And Saul sware to her by the LORD, saying, As the LORD liveth, there shall no punishment happen to thee for this thing.

verses.english:
Saul swore to her by YHWH: “As YHWH lives, you won’t get into
trouble over this.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶת־מִי אַעֲלֶה־לָּךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל הַעֲלִי־לִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶת־מִי אַעֲלֶה־לָּךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל הַעֲלִי־לִי׃

english.text:
At that, the woman asked, “Whom shall I bring up for you?” He
answered, “Bring up Samuel for me.”

translation.text: Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto thee? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.

verses.english:
At that, the woman asked, “Whom shall I bring up for you?” He
answered, “Bring up Samuel for me.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא הָאִשָּׁה אֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל וַתִּזְעַק בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־שָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר לָמָּה רִמִּיתָנִי וְאַתָּה שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרֶא הָאִשָּׁה אֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל וַתִּזְעַק בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־שָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר לָמָּה רִמִּיתָנִי וְאַתָּה שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
Then the woman recognized Samuel, and she shrieked loudly, and
said to Saul, “Why have you deceived me? You are Saul!”

translation.text: And when the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice: and the woman spake to Saul, saying, Why hast thou deceived me? for thou art Saul.

verses.english:
Then the woman recognized Samuel, and she shrieked loudly, and
said to Saul, “Why have you deceived me? You are Saul!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ אַל־תִּירְאִי כִּי מָה רָאִית וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־שָׁאוּל אֱלֹהִים רָאִיתִי עֹלִים מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ אַל־תִּירְאִי כִּי מָה רָאִית וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־שָׁאוּל אֱלֹהִים רָאִיתִי עֹלִים מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
The king answered her, “Don’t be afraid. What do you see?” And the
woman said to Saul, “I see a divine being coming up from the
earth.”

translation.text: And the king said unto her, Be not afraid: for what sawest thou? And the woman said unto Saul, I saw gods ascending out of the earth.

verses.english:
The king answered her, “Don’t be afraid. What do you see?” And the
woman said to Saul, “I see a divine being coming up from the
earth.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מַה־תּאֳרוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר אִישׁ זָקֵן עֹלֶה וְהוּא עֹטֶה מְעִיל וַיֵּדַע שָׁאוּל כִּי־שְׁמוּאֵל הוּא וַיִּקֹּד אַפַּיִם אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מַה־תּאֳרוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר אִישׁ זָקֵן עֹלֶה וְהוּא עֹטֶה מְעִיל וַיֵּדַע שָׁאוּל כִּי־שְׁמוּאֵל הוּא וַיִּקֹּד אַפַּיִם אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ׃

english.text:
“What does he look like?” he asked her. “It is an old man coming
up,” she said, “and he is wrapped in a robe.” Then Saul knew that
it was Samuel; and he bowed low in homage with his face to the
ground.

translation.text: And he said unto her, What form is he of? And she said, An old man cometh up; and he is covered with a mantle. And Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he stooped with his face to the ground, and bowed himself.

verses.english:
“What does he look like?” he asked her. “It is an old man coming
up,” she said, “and he is wrapped in a robe.” Then Saul knew that
it was Samuel; and he bowed low in homage with his face to the
ground.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל לָמָּה הִרְגַּזְתַּנִי לְהַעֲלוֹת אֹתִי וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל צַר־לִי מְאֹד וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נִלְחָמִים בִּי וֵאלֹהִים סָר מֵעָלַי וְלֹא־עָנָנִי עוֹד גַּם
בְּיַד־הַנְּבִיאִים גַּם־בַּחֲלֹמוֹת וָאֶקְרָאֶה לְךָ לְהוֹדִיעֵנִי מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל לָמָּה הִרְגַּזְתַּנִי לְהַעֲלוֹת אֹתִי וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל צַר־לִי מְאֹד וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נִלְחָמִים בִּי וֵאלֹהִים סָר מֵעָלַי וְלֹא־עָנָנִי עוֹד גַּם
בְּיַד־הַנְּבִיאִים גַּם־בַּחֲלֹמוֹת וָאֶקְרָאֶה לְךָ לְהוֹדִיעֵנִי מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה׃

english.text:
Samuel said to Saul, “Why have you disturbed me and brought me
up?” And Saul answered, “I am in great trouble. The Philistines
are attacking me and God has turned away from me; He no longer
answers me, either by prophets or in dreams. So I have called you
to tell me what I am to do.”

translation.text: And Samuel said to Saul, Why hast thou disquieted me, to bring me up? And Saul answered, I am sore distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God is departed from me, and answereth me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called thee, that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do.

verses.english:
Samuel said to Saul, “Why have you disturbed me and brought me
up?” And Saul answered, “I am in great trouble. The Philistines
are attacking me and God has turned away from me; He no longer
answers me, either by prophets or in dreams. So I have called you
to tell me what I am to do.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל וְלָמָּה תִּשְׁאָלֵנִי וַיהֹוָה סָר מֵעָלֶיךָ וַיְהִי עָרֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל וְלָמָּה תִּשְׁאָלֵנִי וַיהֹוָה סָר מֵעָלֶיךָ וַיְהִי עָרֶךָ׃

english.text:
Samuel said, “Why do you ask me, seeing that YHWH has turned away
from you and has become your adversary?

translation.text: Then said Samuel, Wherefore then dost thou ask of me, seeing the LORD is departed from thee, and is become thine enemy?

verses.english:
Samuel said, “Why do you ask me, seeing that YHWH has turned away
from you and has become your adversary?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה לוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיָדִי וַיִּקְרַע יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה מִיָּדֶךָ וַיִּתְּנָהּ לְרֵעֲךָ לְדָוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה לוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיָדִי וַיִּקְרַע יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה מִיָּדֶךָ וַיִּתְּנָהּ לְרֵעֲךָ לְדָוִד׃

english.text:
YHWH has done for Himself as He foretold through me: YHWH has torn
the kingship out of your hands and has given it to your fellow, to
David,

translation.text: And the LORD hath done to him, as he spake by me: for the LORD hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand, and given it to thy neighbour, even to David:

verses.english:
YHWH has done for Himself as He foretold through me: YHWH has torn
the kingship out of your hands and has given it to your fellow, to
David,

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וְלֹא־עָשִׂיתָ חֲרוֹן־אַפּוֹ בַּעֲמָלֵק עַל־כֵּן הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עָשָׂה־לְךָ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה וְלֹא־עָשִׂיתָ חֲרוֹן־אַפּוֹ בַּעֲמָלֵק עַל־כֵּן הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עָשָׂה־לְךָ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
because you did not obey YHWH and did not execute His wrath upon
the Amalekites. That is why YHWH has done this to you today.

translation.text: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the LORD, nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore hath the LORD done this thing unto thee this day.

verses.english:
because you did not obey YHWH and did not execute His wrath upon
the Amalekites. That is why YHWH has done this to you today.

verses.hebrew: וְיִתֵּן יְהֹוָה גַּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמְּךָ בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמָחָר אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ עִמִּי גַּם אֶת־מַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְיִתֵּן יְהֹוָה גַּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמְּךָ בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמָחָר אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ עִמִּי גַּם אֶת־מַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל יִתֵּן יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
Further, YHWH will deliver the Israelites who are with you into
the hands of the Philistines. Tomorrow your sons and you will be
with me; and YHWH will also deliver the Israelite forces into the
hands of the Philistines.”

translation.text: Moreover the LORD will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines: and to morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me: the LORD also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines.

verses.english:
Further, YHWH will deliver the Israelites who are with you into
the hands of the Philistines. Tomorrow your sons and you will be
with me; and YHWH will also deliver the Israelite forces into the
hands of the Philistines.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֵר שָׁאוּל וַיִּפֹּל מְלֹא־קוֹמָתוֹ אַרְצָה וַיִּרָא מְאֹד מִדִּבְרֵי שְׁמוּאֵל גַּם־כֹּחַ לֹא־הָיָה בוֹ כִּי לֹא אָכַל לֶחֶם כּל־הַיּוֹם וְכל־הַלָּיְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַהֵר שָׁאוּל וַיִּפֹּל מְלֹא־קוֹמָתוֹ אַרְצָה וַיִּרָא מְאֹד מִדִּבְרֵי שְׁמוּאֵל גַּם־כֹּחַ לֹא־הָיָה בוֹ כִּי לֹא אָכַל לֶחֶם כּל־הַיּוֹם וְכל־הַלָּיְלָה׃

english.text:
At once Saul flung himself prone on the ground, terrified by
Samuel’s words. Besides, there was no strength in him, for he had
not eaten anything all day and all night.

translation.text: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.

verses.english:
At once Saul flung himself prone on the ground, terrified by
Samuel’s words. Besides, there was no strength in him, for he had
not eaten anything all day and all night.

verses.hebrew:
וַתָּבוֹא הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַתֵּרֶא כִּי־נִבְהַל מְאֹד וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה שָׁמְעָה שִׁפְחָתְךָ בְּקוֹלֶךָ וָאָשִׂים נַפְשִׁי בְּכַפִּי וָאֶשְׁמַע אֶת־דְּבָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר
דִּבַּרְתָּ אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text:
וַתָּבוֹא הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַתֵּרֶא כִּי־נִבְהַל מְאֹד וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה שָׁמְעָה שִׁפְחָתְךָ בְּקוֹלֶךָ וָאָשִׂים נַפְשִׁי בְּכַפִּי וָאֶשְׁמַע אֶת־דְּבָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר
דִּבַּרְתָּ אֵלָי׃

english.text:
The woman went up to Saul and, seeing how greatly disturbed he
was, she said to him, “Your handmaid listened to you; I took my
life in my hands and heeded the request you made of me.

translation.text: And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that he was sore troubled, and said unto him, Behold, thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me.

verses.english:
The woman went up to Saul and, seeing how greatly disturbed he
was, she said to him, “Your handmaid listened to you; I took my
life in my hands and heeded the request you made of me.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שְׁמַע־נָא גַם־אַתָּה בְּקוֹל שִׁפְחָתֶךָ וְאָשִׂמָה לְפָנֶיךָ פַּת־לֶחֶם וֶאֱכוֹל וִיהִי בְךָ כֹּחַ כִּי תֵלֵךְ בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שְׁמַע־נָא גַם־אַתָּה בְּקוֹל שִׁפְחָתֶךָ וְאָשִׂמָה לְפָנֶיךָ פַּת־לֶחֶם וֶאֱכוֹל וִיהִי בְךָ כֹּחַ כִּי תֵלֵךְ בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

english.text:
So now you listen to me: Let me set before you a bit of food. Eat,
and then you will have the strength to go on your way.”

translation.text: Now therefore, I pray thee, hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before thee; and eat, that thou mayest have strength, when thou goest on thy way.

verses.english:
So now you listen to me: Let me set before you a bit of food. Eat,
and then you will have the strength to go on your way.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְמָאֵן וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֹכַל וַיִּפְרְצוּ־בוֹ עֲבָדָיו וְגַם־הָאִשָּׁה וַיִּשְׁמַע לְקֹלָם וַיָּקם מֵהָאָרֶץ וַיֵּשֶׁב אֶל־הַמִּטָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמָאֵן וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֹכַל וַיִּפְרְצוּ־בוֹ עֲבָדָיו וְגַם־הָאִשָּׁה וַיִּשְׁמַע לְקֹלָם וַיָּקם מֵהָאָרֶץ וַיֵּשֶׁב אֶל־הַמִּטָּה׃

english.text:
He refused, saying, “I will not eat.” But when his courtiers as
well as the woman urged him, he listened to them; he got up from
the ground and sat on the bed.

translation.text: But he refused, and said, I will not eat. But his servants, together with the woman, compelled him; and he hearkened unto their voice. So he arose from the earth, and sat upon the bed.

verses.english:
He refused, saying, “I will not eat.” But when his courtiers as
well as the woman urged him, he listened to them; he got up from
the ground and sat on the bed.

verses.hebrew: וְלָאִשָּׁה עֵגֶל־מַרְבֵּק בַּבַּיִת וַתְּמַהֵר וַתִּזְבָּחֵהוּ וַתִּקַּח־קֶמַח וַתָּלָשׁ וַתֹּפֵהוּ מַצּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְלָאִשָּׁה עֵגֶל־מַרְבֵּק בַּבַּיִת וַתְּמַהֵר וַתִּזְבָּחֵהוּ וַתִּקַּח־קֶמַח וַתָּלָשׁ וַתֹּפֵהוּ מַצּוֹת׃

english.text:
The woman had a stall-fed calf in the house; she hastily
slaughtered it, and took flour and kneaded it, and baked some
unleavened cakes.

translation.text: And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she hasted, and killed it, and took flour, and kneaded it, and did bake unleavened bread thereof:

verses.english:
The woman had a stall-fed calf in the house; she hastily
slaughtered it, and took flour and kneaded it, and baked some
unleavened cakes.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּגֵּשׁ לִפְנֵי־שָׁאוּל וְלִפְנֵי עֲבָדָיו וַיֹּאכֵלוּ וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּגֵּשׁ לִפְנֵי־שָׁאוּל וְלִפְנֵי עֲבָדָיו וַיֹּאכֵלוּ וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא׃

english.text:
She set this before Saul and his courtiers, and they ate. Then
they rose and left the same night.

translation.text: And she brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.

verses.english:
She set this before Saul and his courtiers, and they ate. Then
they rose and left the same night.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבְּצוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־כּל־מַחֲנֵיהֶם אֲפֵקָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל חֹנִים בַּעַיִן אֲשֶׁר בְּיִזְרְעֶאל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבְּצוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־כּל־מַחֲנֵיהֶם אֲפֵקָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל חֹנִים בַּעַיִן אֲשֶׁר בְּיִזְרְעֶאל׃

english.text:
The Philistines mustered all their forces at Aphek, while Israel
was encamping at the spring in Jezreel.

translation.text: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek: and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel.

verses.english:
The Philistines mustered all their forces at Aphek, while Israel
was encamping at the spring in Jezreel.

verses.hebrew: וְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים עֹבְרִים לְמֵאוֹת וְלַאֲלָפִים וְדָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו עֹבְרִים בָּאַחֲרֹנָה עִם־אָכִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים עֹבְרִים לְמֵאוֹת וְלַאֲלָפִים וְדָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו עֹבְרִים בָּאַחֲרֹנָה עִם־אָכִישׁ׃

english.text:
The Philistine lords came marching, each with his units of
hundreds and of thousands; and David and his men came marching
last, with Achish.

translation.text: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by thousands: but David and his men passed on in the rereward with Achish.

verses.english:
The Philistine lords came marching, each with his units of
hundreds and of thousands; and David and his men came marching
last, with Achish.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים מָה הָעִבְרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים הֲלוֹא־זֶה דָוִד עֶבֶד שָׁאוּל מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הָיָה אִתִּי זֶה יָמִים
אוֹ־זֶה שָׁנִים וְלֹא־מָצָאתִי בוֹ מְאוּמָה מִיּוֹם נפְלוֹ עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים מָה הָעִבְרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים הֲלוֹא־זֶה דָוִד עֶבֶד שָׁאוּל מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הָיָה אִתִּי זֶה יָמִים
אוֹ־זֶה שָׁנִים וְלֹא־מָצָאתִי בוֹ מְאוּמָה מִיּוֹם נפְלוֹ עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The Philistine officers asked, “Who are those Hebrews?” “Why,
that’s David, the servant of King Saul of Israel,” Achish answered
the Philistine officers. “He has been with me for a year or more,
and I have found no fault in him from the day he defected until
now.”

translation.text: Then said the princes of the Philistines, What do these Hebrews here? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines, Is not this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, which hath been with me these days, or these years, and I have found no fault in him since he fell unto me unto this day?

verses.english:
The Philistine officers asked, “Who are those Hebrews?” “Why,
that’s David, the servant of King Saul of Israel,” Achish answered
the Philistine officers. “He has been with me for a year or more,
and I have found no fault in him from the day he defected until
now.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְצְפוּ עָלָיו שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים הָשֵׁב אֶת־הָאִישׁ וְיָשֹׁב אֶל־מְקוֹמוֹ אֲשֶׁר הִפְקַדְתּוֹ שָׁם וְלֹא־יֵרֵד עִמָּנוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָה
וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה־לָּנוּ לְשָׂטָן בַּמִּלְחָמָה וּבַמֶּה יִתְרַצֶּה זֶה אֶל־אֲדֹנָיו הֲלוֹא בְּרָאשֵׁי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָהֵם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְצְפוּ עָלָיו שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים הָשֵׁב אֶת־הָאִישׁ וְיָשֹׁב אֶל־מְקוֹמוֹ אֲשֶׁר הִפְקַדְתּוֹ שָׁם וְלֹא־יֵרֵד עִמָּנוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָה
וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה־לָּנוּ לְשָׂטָן בַּמִּלְחָמָה וּבַמֶּה יִתְרַצֶּה זֶה אֶל־אֲדֹנָיו הֲלוֹא בְּרָאשֵׁי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָהֵם׃

english.text:
But the Philistine officers were angry with him; and the
Philistine officers said to him, “Send the man back; let him go
back to the place you assigned him. He shall not march down with
us to the battle, or else he may become our adversary in battle.
For with what could that fellow appease his master if not with the
heads of these men?

translation.text: And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him, Make this fellow return, that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he be an adversary to us: for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master? should it not be with the heads of these men?

verses.english:
But the Philistine officers were angry with him; and the
Philistine officers said to him, “Send the man back; let him go
back to the place you assigned him. He shall not march down with
us to the battle, or else he may become our adversary in battle.
For with what could that fellow appease his master if not with the
heads of these men?

verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא־זֶה דָוִד אֲשֶׁר יַעֲנוּ־לוֹ בַּמְּחֹלוֹת לֵאמֹר הִכָּה שָׁאוּל בַּאֲלָפָיו וְדָוִד בְּרִבְבֹתָו׃

hebrew.text: הֲלוֹא־זֶה דָוִד אֲשֶׁר יַעֲנוּ־לוֹ בַּמְּחֹלוֹת לֵאמֹר הִכָּה שָׁאוּל בַּאֲלָפָיו וְדָוִד בְּרִבְבֹתָו׃

english.text:
Remember, he is the David of whom they sang as they danced: Saul
has slain his thousands; David, his tens of thousands.”

translation.text: Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, Saul slew his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

verses.english:
Remember, he is the David of whom they sang as they danced: Saul
has slain his thousands; David, his tens of thousands.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְרָא אָכִישׁ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי־יָשָׁר אַתָּה וְטוֹב בְּעֵינַי צֵאתְךָ וּבֹאֲךָ אִתִּי בַּמַּחֲנֶה כִּי לֹא־מָצָאתִי בְךָ רָעָה מִיּוֹם בֹּאֲךָ
אֵלַי עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וּבְעֵינֵי הַסְּרָנִים לֹא־טוֹב אָתָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְרָא אָכִישׁ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי־יָשָׁר אַתָּה וְטוֹב בְּעֵינַי צֵאתְךָ וּבֹאֲךָ אִתִּי בַּמַּחֲנֶה כִּי לֹא־מָצָאתִי בְךָ רָעָה מִיּוֹם בֹּאֲךָ
אֵלַי עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וּבְעֵינֵי הַסְּרָנִים לֹא־טוֹב אָתָּה׃

english.text:
Achish summoned David and said to him, “As YHWH lives, you are an
honest man, and I would like to have you serve in my forces; for I
have found no fault with you from the day you joined me until now.
But you are not acceptable to the other lords.

translation.text: Then Achish called David, and said unto him, Surely, as the LORD liveth, thou hast been upright, and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight: for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the lords favour thee not.

verses.english:
Achish summoned David and said to him, “As YHWH lives, you are an
honest man, and I would like to have you serve in my forces; for I
have found no fault with you from the day you joined me until now.
But you are not acceptable to the other lords.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שׁוּב וְלֵךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם וְלֹא־תַעֲשֶׂה רָע בְּעֵינֵי סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שׁוּב וְלֵךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם וְלֹא־תַעֲשֶׂה רָע בְּעֵינֵי סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
So go back in peace, and do nothing to displease the Philistine
lords.”

translation.text: Wherefore now return, and go in peace, that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines.

verses.english:
So go back in peace, and do nothing to displease the Philistine
lords.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אָכִישׁ כִּי מֶה עָשִׂיתִי וּמַה־מָּצָאתָ בְעַבְדְּךָ מִיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר הָיִיתִי לְפָנֶיךָ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי לֹא אָבוֹא וְנִלְחַמְתִּי בְּאֹיְבֵי אֲדֹנִי
הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אָכִישׁ כִּי מֶה עָשִׂיתִי וּמַה־מָּצָאתָ בְעַבְדְּךָ מִיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר הָיִיתִי לְפָנֶיךָ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי לֹא אָבוֹא וְנִלְחַמְתִּי בְּאֹיְבֵי אֲדֹנִי
הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
David, however, said to Achish, “But what have I done, what fault
have you found in your servant from the day I appeared before you
to this day, that I should not go and fight against the enemies of
my lord the king?”

translation.text: And David said unto Achish, But what have I done? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day, that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?

verses.english:
David, however, said to Achish, “But what have I done, what fault
have you found in your servant from the day I appeared before you
to this day, that I should not go and fight against the enemies of
my lord the king?”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אָכִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־דָּוִד יָדַעְתִּי כִּי טוֹב אַתָּה בְּעֵינַי כְּמַלְאַךְ אֱלֹהִים אַךְ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים אָמְרוּ לֹא־יַעֲלֶה עִמָּנוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן אָכִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־דָּוִד יָדַעְתִּי כִּי טוֹב אַתָּה בְּעֵינַי כְּמַלְאַךְ אֱלֹהִים אַךְ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים אָמְרוּ לֹא־יַעֲלֶה עִמָּנוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
Achish replied to David, “I know; you are as acceptable to me as
an angel of God. But the Philistine officers have decided that you
must not march out with us to the battle.

translation.text: And Achish answered and said to David, I know that thou art good in my sight, as an angel of God: notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, He shall not go up with us to the battle.

verses.english:
Achish replied to David, “I know; you are as acceptable to me as
an angel of God. But the Philistine officers have decided that you
must not march out with us to the battle.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הַשְׁכֵּם בַּבֹּקֶר וְעַבְדֵי אֲדֹנֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאוּ אִתָּךְ וְהִשְׁכַּמְתֶּם בַּבֹּקֶר וְאוֹר לָכֶם וָלֵכוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הַשְׁכֵּם בַּבֹּקֶר וְעַבְדֵי אֲדֹנֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאוּ אִתָּךְ וְהִשְׁכַּמְתֶּם בַּבֹּקֶר וְאוֹר לָכֶם וָלֵכוּ׃

english.text:
So rise early in the morning, you and your lord’s servants who
came with you—rise early in the morning, and leave as soon as it
is light.”

translation.text: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master’s servants that are come with thee: and as soon as ye be up early in the morning, and have light, depart.

verses.english:
So rise early in the morning, you and your lord’s servants who
came with you—rise early in the morning, and leave as soon as it
is light.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם דָּוִד הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו לָלֶכֶת בַּבֹּקֶר לָשׁוּב אֶל־אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּפְלִשְׁתִּים עָלוּ יִזְרְעֶאל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם דָּוִד הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו לָלֶכֶת בַּבֹּקֶר לָשׁוּב אֶל־אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּפְלִשְׁתִּים עָלוּ יִזְרְעֶאל׃

english.text:
Accordingly, David and his men rose early in the morning to leave,
to return to the land of the Philistines, while the Philistines
marched up to Jezreel.

translation.text: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

verses.english:
Accordingly, David and his men rose early in the morning to leave,
to return to the land of the Philistines, while the Philistines
marched up to Jezreel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּבֹא דָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו צִקְלַג בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וַעֲמָלֵקִי פָשְׁטוּ אֶל־נֶגֶב וְאֶל־צִקְלַג וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־צִקְלַג וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אֹתָהּ בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּבֹא דָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו צִקְלַג בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וַעֲמָלֵקִי פָשְׁטוּ אֶל־נֶגֶב וְאֶל־צִקְלַג וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־צִקְלַג וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אֹתָהּ בָּאֵשׁ׃

translation.text: And it came to pass, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the south, and Ziklag, and smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁבּוּ אֶת־הַנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ מִקָּטֹן וְעַד־גָּדוֹל לֹא הֵמִיתוּ אִישׁ וַיִּנְהֲגוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ לְדַרְכָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁבּוּ אֶת־הַנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ מִקָּטֹן וְעַד־גָּדוֹל לֹא הֵמִיתוּ אִישׁ וַיִּנְהֲגוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ לְדַרְכָּם׃

english.text:
They had taken the women in it captive, low-born and high-born
alike; they did not kill any, but carried them off and went their
way.

translation.text: And had taken the women captives, that were therein: they slew not any, either great or small, but carried them away, and went on their way.

verses.english:
They had taken the women in it captive, low-born and high-born
alike; they did not kill any, but carried them off and went their
way.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו אֶל־הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה שְׂרוּפָה בָּאֵשׁ וּנְשֵׁיהֶם וּבְנֵיהֶם וּבְנֹתֵיהֶם נִשְׁבּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו אֶל־הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה שְׂרוּפָה בָּאֵשׁ וּנְשֵׁיהֶם וּבְנֵיהֶם וּבְנֹתֵיהֶם נִשְׁבּוּ׃

english.text:
When David and his men came to the town and found it burned down,
and their wives and sons and daughters taken captive,

translation.text: So David and his men came to the city, and, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were taken captives.

verses.english:
When David and his men came to the town and found it burned down,
and their wives and sons and daughters taken captive,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא דָוִד וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ אֶת־קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ עַד אֲשֶׁר אֵין־בָּהֶם כֹּחַ לִבְכּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא דָוִד וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ אֶת־קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ עַד אֲשֶׁר אֵין־בָּהֶם כֹּחַ לִבְכּוֹת׃

english.text:
David and the troops with him broke into tears, until they had no
strength left for weeping.

translation.text: Then David and the people that were with him lifted up their voice and wept, until they had no more power to weep.

verses.english:
David and the troops with him broke into tears, until they had no
strength left for weeping.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי נְשֵׁי־דָוִד נִשְׁבּוּ אֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵלִית וַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִי׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁתֵּי נְשֵׁי־דָוִד נִשְׁבּוּ אֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵלִית וַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִי׃

english.text:
David’s two wives had been taken captive, Ahinoam of Jezreel and
Abigail wife of Nabal from Carmel.

translation.text: And David’s two wives were taken captives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

verses.english:
David’s two wives had been taken captive, Ahinoam of Jezreel and
Abigail wife of Nabal from Carmel.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּצֶר לְדָוִד מְאֹד כִּי־אָמְרוּ הָעָם לְסקְלוֹ כִּי־מָרָה נֶפֶשׁ כּל־הָעָם אִישׁ עַל־בָּנָו וְעַל־בְּנֹתָיו וַיִּתְחַזֵּק דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּצֶר לְדָוִד מְאֹד כִּי־אָמְרוּ הָעָם לְסקְלוֹ כִּי־מָרָה נֶפֶשׁ כּל־הָעָם אִישׁ עַל־בָּנָו וְעַל־בְּנֹתָיו וַיִּתְחַזֵּק דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו׃

translation.text: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the LORD his God.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן בֶּן־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ הַגִּישָׁה־נָּא לִי הָאֵפוֹד וַיַּגֵּשׁ אֶבְיָתָר אֶת־הָאֵפוֹד אֶל־דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן בֶּן־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ הַגִּישָׁה־נָּא לִי הָאֵפוֹד וַיַּגֵּשׁ אֶבְיָתָר אֶת־הָאֵפוֹד אֶל־דָּוִד׃

english.text:
David said to the priest Abiathar son of Ahimelech, “Bring the
ephod up to me.” When Abiathar brought up the ephod to David,

translation.text: And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech’s son, I pray thee, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David.

verses.english:
David said to the priest Abiathar son of Ahimelech, “Bring the
ephod up to me.” When Abiathar brought up the ephod to David,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר אֶרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי הַגְּדוּד־הַזֶּה הַאַשִּׂגֶנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ רְדֹף כִּי־הַשֵּׂג תַּשִּׂיג וְהַצֵּל תַּצִּיל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר אֶרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי הַגְּדוּד־הַזֶּה הַאַשִּׂגֶנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ רְדֹף כִּי־הַשֵּׂג תַּשִּׂיג וְהַצֵּל תַּצִּיל׃

english.text:
David inquired of YHWH, “Shall I pursue those raiders? Will I
overtake them?” And He answered him, “Pursue, for you shall
overtake and you shall rescue.”

translation.text: And David enquired at the LORD, saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them, and without fail recover all.

verses.english:
David inquired of YHWH, “Shall I pursue those raiders? Will I
overtake them?” And He answered him, “Pursue, for you shall
overtake and you shall rescue.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד הוּא וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־נַחַל הַבְּשׂוֹר וְהַנּוֹתָרִים עָמָדוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד הוּא וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־נַחַל הַבְּשׂוֹר וְהַנּוֹתָרִים עָמָדוּ׃

english.text:
So David and the six hundred men with him set out, and they came
to the Wadi Besor, where a halt was made by those who were to be
left behind.

translation.text: So David went, he and the six hundred men that were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those that were left behind stayed.

verses.english:
So David and the six hundred men with him set out, and they came
to the Wadi Besor, where a halt was made by those who were to be
left behind.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדֹּף דָּוִד הוּא וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיַּעַמְדוּ מָאתַיִם אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר פִּגְּרוּ מֵעֲבֹר אֶת־נַחַל הַבְּשׂוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְדֹּף דָּוִד הוּא וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיַּעַמְדוּ מָאתַיִם אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר פִּגְּרוּ מֵעֲבֹר אֶת־נַחַל הַבְּשׂוֹר׃

english.text:
David continued the pursuit with four hundred men; two hundred men
had halted, too faint to cross the Wadi Besor.

translation.text: But David pursued, he and four hundred men: for two hundred abode behind, which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor.

verses.english:
David continued the pursuit with four hundred men; two hundred men
had halted, too faint to cross the Wadi Besor.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצְאוּ אִישׁ־מִצְרִי בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיִּקְחוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ לֶחֶם וַיֹּאכַל וַיַּשְׁקֻהוּ מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְצְאוּ אִישׁ־מִצְרִי בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיִּקְחוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ לֶחֶם וַיֹּאכַל וַיַּשְׁקֻהוּ מָיִם׃

english.text:
They came upon an Egyptian in the open country and brought him to
David. They gave him food to eat and water to drink;

translation.text: And they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he did eat; and they made him drink water;

verses.english:
They came upon an Egyptian in the open country and brought him to
David. They gave him food to eat and water to drink;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ פֶלַח דְּבֵלָה וּשְׁנֵי צִמֻּקִים וַיֹּאכַל וַתָּשׁב רוּחוֹ אֵלָיו כִּי לֹא־אָכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא־שָׁתָה מַיִם שְׁלֹשָׁה יָמִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה לֵילוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ פֶלַח דְּבֵלָה וּשְׁנֵי צִמֻּקִים וַיֹּאכַל וַתָּשׁב רוּחוֹ אֵלָיו כִּי לֹא־אָכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא־שָׁתָה מַיִם שְׁלֹשָׁה יָמִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה לֵילוֹת׃

english.text:
he was also given a piece of pressed fig cake and two cakes of
raisins. He ate and regained his strength, for he had eaten no
food and drunk no water for three days and three nights.

translation.text: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.

verses.english:
he was also given a piece of pressed fig cake and two cakes of
raisins. He ate and regained his strength, for he had eaten no
food and drunk no water for three days and three nights.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָוִד לְמִי־אַתָּה וְאֵי מִזֶּה אָתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר נַעַר מִצְרִי אָנֹכִי עֶבֶד לְאִישׁ עֲמָלֵקִי וַיַּעַזְבֵנִי אֲדֹנִי כִּי חָלִיתִי הַיּוֹם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָוִד לְמִי־אַתָּה וְאֵי מִזֶּה אָתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר נַעַר מִצְרִי אָנֹכִי עֶבֶד לְאִישׁ עֲמָלֵקִי וַיַּעַזְבֵנִי אֲדֹנִי כִּי חָלִיתִי הַיּוֹם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

english.text:
Then David asked him, “To whom do you belong and where are you
from?” “I am an Egyptian boy,” he answered, “the slave of an
Amalekite. My master abandoned me when I fell ill three days ago.

translation.text: And David said unto him, To whom belongest thou? and whence art thou? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days agone I fell sick.

verses.english:
Then David asked him, “To whom do you belong and where are you
from?” “I am an Egyptian boy,” he answered, “the slave of an
Amalekite. My master abandoned me when I fell ill three days ago.

verses.hebrew: אֲנַחְנוּ פָּשַׁטְנוּ נֶגֶב הַכְּרֵתִי וְעַל־אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה וְעַל־נֶגֶב כָּלֵב וְאֶת־צִקְלַג שָׂרַפְנוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: אֲנַחְנוּ פָּשַׁטְנוּ נֶגֶב הַכְּרֵתִי וְעַל־אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה וְעַל־נֶגֶב כָּלֵב וְאֶת־צִקְלַג שָׂרַפְנוּ בָאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
We had raided the Negeb of the Cherethites, and [the Negeb] of
Judah, and the Negeb of Caleb; we also burned down Ziklag.”

translation.text: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites, and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah, and upon the south of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.

verses.english:
We had raided the Negeb of the Cherethites, and [the Negeb] of
Judah, and the Negeb of Caleb; we also burned down Ziklag.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד הֲתוֹרִדֵנִי אֶל־הַגְּדוּד הַזֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר הִשָּׁבְעָה לִּי בֵאלֹהִים אִם־תְּמִיתֵנִי וְאִם־תַּסְגִּרֵנִי בְּיַד־אֲדֹנִי וְאוֹרִדְךָ אֶל־הַגְּדוּד הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד הֲתוֹרִדֵנִי אֶל־הַגְּדוּד הַזֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר הִשָּׁבְעָה לִּי בֵאלֹהִים אִם־תְּמִיתֵנִי וְאִם־תַּסְגִּרֵנִי בְּיַד־אֲדֹנִי וְאוֹרִדְךָ אֶל־הַגְּדוּד הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And David said to him, “Can you lead me down to that band?” He
replied, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me or deliver
me into my master’s hands, and I will lead you down to that band.”

translation.text: And David said to him, Canst thou bring me down to this company? And he said, Swear unto me by God, that thou wilt neither kill me, nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring thee down to this company.

verses.english:
And David said to him, “Can you lead me down to that band?” He
replied, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me or deliver
me into my master’s hands, and I will lead you down to that band.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּרִדֵהוּ וְהִנֵּה נְטֻשִׁים עַל־פְּנֵי כל־הָאָרֶץ אֹכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים וְחֹגְגִים בְּכֹל הַשָּׁלָל הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ מֵאֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמֵאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה׃
