hebrew.text: וַיֹּרִדֵהוּ וְהִנֵּה נְטֻשִׁים עַל־פְּנֵי כל־הָאָרֶץ אֹכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים וְחֹגְגִים בְּכֹל הַשָּׁלָל הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ מֵאֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמֵאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
So he led him down, and there they were, scattered all over the
ground, eating and drinking and making merry because of all the
vast spoil they had taken from the land of the Philistines and
from the land of Judah.

translation.text: And when he had brought him down, behold, they were spread abroad upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.

verses.english:
So he led him down, and there they were, scattered all over the
ground, eating and drinking and making merry because of all the
vast spoil they had taken from the land of the Philistines and
from the land of Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּם דָּוִד מֵהַנֶּשֶׁף וְעַד־הָעֶרֶב לְמחֳרָתָם וְלֹא־נִמְלַט מֵהֶם אִישׁ כִּי אִם־אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ־נַעַר אֲשֶׁר־רָכְבוּ עַל־הַגְּמַלִּים וַיָּנֻסוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכֵּם דָּוִד מֵהַנֶּשֶׁף וְעַד־הָעֶרֶב לְמחֳרָתָם וְלֹא־נִמְלַט מֵהֶם אִישׁ כִּי אִם־אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ־נַעַר אֲשֶׁר־רָכְבוּ עַל־הַגְּמַלִּים וַיָּנֻסוּ׃

english.text:
David attacked them from before dawn until the evening of the next
day; none of them escaped, except four hundred young men who
mounted camels and got away.

translation.text: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day: and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred young men, which rode upon camels, and fled.

verses.english:
David attacked them from before dawn until the evening of the next
day; none of them escaped, except four hundred young men who
mounted camels and got away.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּצֵּל דָּוִד אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ עֲמָלֵק וְאֶת־שְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו הִצִּיל דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּצֵּל דָּוִד אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ עֲמָלֵק וְאֶת־שְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו הִצִּיל דָּוִד׃

english.text:
David rescued everything the Amalekites had taken; David also
rescued his two wives.

translation.text: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.

verses.english:
David rescued everything the Amalekites had taken; David also
rescued his two wives.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא נֶעְדַּר־לָהֶם מִן־הַקָּטֹן וְעַד־הַגָּדוֹל וְעַד־בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת וּמִשָּׁלָל וְעַד כּל־אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ לָהֶם הַכֹּל הֵשִׁיב דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא נֶעְדַּר־לָהֶם מִן־הַקָּטֹן וְעַד־הַגָּדוֹל וְעַד־בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת וּמִשָּׁלָל וְעַד כּל־אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ לָהֶם הַכֹּל הֵשִׁיב דָּוִד׃

english.text:
Nothing of theirs was missing—young or old, sons or daughters,
spoil or anything else that had been carried off—David recovered
everything.

translation.text: And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any thing that they had taken to them: David recovered all.

verses.english:
Nothing of theirs was missing—young or old, sons or daughters,
spoil or anything else that had been carried off—David recovered
everything.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־כּל־הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר נָהֲגוּ לִפְנֵי הַמִּקְנֶה הַהוּא וַיֹּאמְרוּ זֶה שְׁלַל דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־כּל־הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר נָהֲגוּ לִפְנֵי הַמִּקְנֶה הַהוּא וַיֹּאמְרוּ זֶה שְׁלַל דָּוִד׃

english.text:
David took all the flocks and herds, which [the troops] drove
ahead of the other livestock; and they declared, “This is David’s
spoil.”

translation.text: And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, This is David’s spoil.

verses.english:
David took all the flocks and herds, which [the troops] drove
ahead of the other livestock; and they declared, “This is David’s
spoil.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־מָאתַיִם הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־פִּגְּרוּ מִלֶּכֶת אַחֲרֵי דָוִד וַיֹּשִׁיבֻם בְּנַחַל הַבְּשׂוֹר וַיֵּצְאוּ לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וְלִקְרַאת הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ
וַיִּגַּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־הָעָם וַיִּשְׁאַל לָהֶם לְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־מָאתַיִם הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־פִּגְּרוּ מִלֶּכֶת אַחֲרֵי דָוִד וַיֹּשִׁיבֻם בְּנַחַל הַבְּשׂוֹר וַיֵּצְאוּ לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וְלִקְרַאת הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ
וַיִּגַּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־הָעָם וַיִּשְׁאַל לָהֶם לְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
When David reached the two hundred men who were too faint to
follow David and who had been left at the Wadi Besor, they came
out to welcome David and the troops with him; David came forward
with the troops and greeted them.

translation.text: And David came to the two hundred men, which were so faint that they could not follow David, whom they had made also to abide at the brook Besor: and they went forth to meet David, and to meet the people that were with him: and when David came near to the people, he saluted them.

verses.english:
When David reached the two hundred men who were too faint to
follow David and who had been left at the Wadi Besor, they came
out to welcome David and the troops with him; David came forward
with the troops and greeted them.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן כּל־אִישׁ־רָע וּבְלִיַּעַל מֵהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ עִם־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמְרוּ יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָלְכוּ עִמִּי לֹא־נִתֵּן לָהֶם מֵהַשָּׁלָל אֲשֶׁר הִצַּלְנוּ
כִּי־אִם־אִישׁ אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וְיִנְהֲגוּ וְיֵלֵכוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן כּל־אִישׁ־רָע וּבְלִיַּעַל מֵהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ עִם־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמְרוּ יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָלְכוּ עִמִּי לֹא־נִתֵּן לָהֶם מֵהַשָּׁלָל אֲשֶׁר הִצַּלְנוּ
כִּי־אִם־אִישׁ אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וְיִנְהֲגוּ וְיֵלֵכוּ׃

english.text:
But all the mean and churlish fellows among the men who had
accompanied David spoke up, “Since they did not accompany us, we
will not give them any of the spoil that we seized—except that
each may take his wife and children and go.”

translation.text: Then answered all the wicked men and men of Belial, of those that went with David, and said, Because they went not with us, we will not give them ought of the spoil that we have recovered, save to every man his wife and his children, that they may lead them away, and depart.

verses.english:
But all the mean and churlish fellows among the men who had
accompanied David spoke up, “Since they did not accompany us, we
will not give them any of the spoil that we seized—except that
each may take his wife and children and go.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לֹא־תַעֲשׂוּ כֵן אֶחָי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן יְהֹוָה לָנוּ וַיִּשְׁמֹר אֹתָנוּ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַגְּדוּד הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ בְּיָדֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לֹא־תַעֲשׂוּ כֵן אֶחָי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן יְהֹוָה לָנוּ וַיִּשְׁמֹר אֹתָנוּ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַגְּדוּד הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ בְּיָדֵנוּ׃

english.text:
David, however, spoke up, “You must not do that, my brothers, in
view of what YHWH has granted us, guarding us and delivering into
our hands the band that attacked us.

translation.text: Then said David, Ye shall not do so, my brethren, with that which the LORD hath given us, who hath preserved us, and delivered the company that came against us into our hand.

verses.english:
David, however, spoke up, “You must not do that, my brothers, in
view of what YHWH has granted us, guarding us and delivering into
our hands the band that attacked us.

verses.hebrew: וּמִי יִשְׁמַע לָכֶם לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה כִּי כְּחֵלֶק הַיֹּרֵד בַּמִּלְחָמָה וּכְחֵלֶק הַיֹּשֵׁב עַל־הַכֵּלִים יַחְדָּו יַחֲלֹקוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּמִי יִשְׁמַע לָכֶם לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה כִּי כְּחֵלֶק הַיֹּרֵד בַּמִּלְחָמָה וּכְחֵלֶק הַיֹּשֵׁב עַל־הַכֵּלִים יַחְדָּו יַחֲלֹקוּ׃

english.text:
How could anyone agree with you in this matter? The share of those
who remain with the baggage shall be the same as the share of
those who go down to battle; they shall share alike.”

translation.text: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle, so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.

verses.english:
How could anyone agree with you in this matter? The share of those
who remain with the baggage shall be the same as the share of
those who go down to battle; they shall share alike.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מֵהַיּוֹם הַהוּא וָמָעְלָה וַיְשִׂמֶהָ לְחֹק וּלְמִשְׁפָּט לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מֵהַיּוֹם הַהוּא וָמָעְלָה וַיְשִׂמֶהָ לְחֹק וּלְמִשְׁפָּט לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
So from that day on it was made a fixed rule for Israel,
continuing to the present day.

translation.text: And it was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day.

verses.english:
So from that day on it was made a fixed rule for Israel,
continuing to the present day.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־צִקְלַג וַיְשַׁלַּח מֵהַשָּׁלָל לְזִקְנֵי יְהוּדָה לְרֵעֵהוּ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה לָכֶם בְּרָכָה מִשְּׁלַל אֹיְבֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־צִקְלַג וַיְשַׁלַּח מֵהַשָּׁלָל לְזִקְנֵי יְהוּדָה לְרֵעֵהוּ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה לָכֶם בְּרָכָה מִשְּׁלַל אֹיְבֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
When David reached Ziklag, he sent some of the spoil to the elders
of Judah [and] to his friends, saying, “This is a present for you
from our spoil of the enemies of YHWH.”

translation.text: And when David came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the LORD;

verses.english:
When David reached Ziklag, he sent some of the spoil to the elders
of Judah [and] to his friends, saying, “This is a present for you
from our spoil of the enemies of YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: לַאֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־אֵלוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּרָמוֹת־נֶגֶבוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּיַתִּר׃

hebrew.text: לַאֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־אֵלוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּרָמוֹת־נֶגֶבוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּיַתִּר׃

english.text:
[He sent the spoil to the elders] in Bethel, Ramoth-negeb, and
Jattir;

translation.text: To them which were in Bethel, and to them which were in south Ramoth, and to them which were in Jattir,

verses.english:
[He sent the spoil to the elders] in Bethel, Ramoth-negeb, and
Jattir;

verses.hebrew: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בַּעֲרֹעֵרוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּשִׂפְמוֹתוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּאֶשְׁתְּמֹעַ׃

hebrew.text: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בַּעֲרֹעֵרוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּשִׂפְמוֹתוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּאֶשְׁתְּמֹעַ׃

english.text: in Aroer, Siphmoth, and Eshtemoa;

translation.text: And to them which were in Aroer, and to them which were in Siphmoth, and to them which were in Eshtemoa,

verses.english: in Aroer, Siphmoth, and Eshtemoa;

verses.hebrew: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּרָכָלוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי הַיְּרַחְמְאֵלִיוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי הַקֵּינִי׃

hebrew.text: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּרָכָלוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי הַיְּרַחְמְאֵלִיוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי הַקֵּינִי׃

english.text:
in Racal, in the towns of the Jerahmeelites, and in the towns of
the Kenites;

translation.text: And to them which were in Rachal, and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites,

verses.english:
in Racal, in the towns of the Jerahmeelites, and in the towns of
the Kenites;

verses.hebrew: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּחרְמָהוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּבוֹר־עָשָׁןוְלַאֲשֶׁר בַּעֲתָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּחרְמָהוְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּבוֹר־עָשָׁןוְלַאֲשֶׁר בַּעֲתָךְ׃

english.text: in Hormah, Bor-ashan, and Athach;

translation.text: And to them which were in Hormah, and to them which were in Chorashan, and to them which were in Athach,

verses.english: in Hormah, Bor-ashan, and Athach;

verses.hebrew: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וּלְכל־הַמְּקֹמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־הִתְהַלֶּךְ־שָׁם דָּוִד הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו׃

hebrew.text: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וּלְכל־הַמְּקֹמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־הִתְהַלֶּךְ־שָׁם דָּוִד הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו׃

english.text:
and to those in Hebron—all the places where David and his men had
roamed.

translation.text: And to them which were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men were wont to haunt.

verses.english:
and to those in Hebron—all the places where David and his men had
roamed.

verses.hebrew: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נִלְחָמִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּנֻסוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִפְּנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּפְּלוּ חֲלָלִים בְּהַר הַגִּלְבֹּעַ׃

hebrew.text: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נִלְחָמִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּנֻסוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִפְּנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּפְּלוּ חֲלָלִים בְּהַר הַגִּלְבֹּעַ׃

english.text:
The Philistines attacked Israel, and the men of Israel fled before
the Philistines and [many] fell on Mount Gilboa.

translation.text: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

verses.english:
The Philistines attacked Israel, and the men of Israel fled before
the Philistines and [many] fell on Mount Gilboa.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּדְבְּקוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וַיַּכּוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־יְהוֹנָתָן וְאֶת־אֲבִינָדָב וְאֶת־מַלְכִּישׁוּעַ בְּנֵי שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּדְבְּקוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וַיַּכּוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־יְהוֹנָתָן וְאֶת־אֲבִינָדָב וְאֶת־מַלְכִּישׁוּעַ בְּנֵי שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
The Philistines pursued Saul and his sons, and the Philistines
struck down Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, sons of Saul.

translation.text: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Melchishua, Saul’s sons.

verses.english:
The Philistines pursued Saul and his sons, and the Philistines
struck down Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, sons of Saul.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּכְבַּד הַמִּלְחָמָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיִּמְצָאֻהוּ הַמּוֹרִים אֲנָשִׁים בַּקָּשֶׁת וַיָּחֶל מְאֹד מֵהַמּוֹרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּכְבַּד הַמִּלְחָמָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיִּמְצָאֻהוּ הַמּוֹרִים אֲנָשִׁים בַּקָּשֶׁת וַיָּחֶל מְאֹד מֵהַמּוֹרִים׃

english.text:
The battle raged around Saul, and some of the archers hit him, and
he was severely wounded by the archers.

translation.text: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him; and he was sore wounded of the archers.

verses.english:
The battle raged around Saul, and some of the archers hit him, and
he was severely wounded by the archers.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו שְׁלֹף חַרְבְּךָ וְדקְרֵנִי בָהּ פֶּן־יָבוֹאוּ הָעֲרֵלִים הָאֵלֶּה וּדְקָרֻנִי וְהִתְעַלְּלוּ־בִי וְלֹא אָבָה נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו כִּי יָרֵא מְאֹד
וַיִּקַּח שָׁאוּל אֶת־הַחֶרֶב וַיִּפֹּל עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו שְׁלֹף חַרְבְּךָ וְדקְרֵנִי בָהּ פֶּן־יָבוֹאוּ הָעֲרֵלִים הָאֵלֶּה וּדְקָרֻנִי וְהִתְעַלְּלוּ־בִי וְלֹא אָבָה נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו כִּי יָרֵא מְאֹד
וַיִּקַּח שָׁאוּל אֶת־הַחֶרֶב וַיִּפֹּל עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
Saul said to his arms-bearer, “Draw your sword and run me through,
so that the uncircumcised may not run me through and make sport of
me.” But his arms-bearer, in his great awe, refused; whereupon
Saul grasped the sword and fell upon it.

translation.text: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

verses.english:
Saul said to his arms-bearer, “Draw your sword and run me through,
so that the uncircumcised may not run me through and make sport of
me.” But his arms-bearer, in his great awe, refused; whereupon
Saul grasped the sword and fell upon it.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא נֹשֵׂא־כֵלָיו כִּי מֵת שָׁאוּל וַיִּפֹּל גַּם־הוּא עַל־חַרְבּוֹ וַיָּמת עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא נֹשֵׂא־כֵלָיו כִּי מֵת שָׁאוּל וַיִּפֹּל גַּם־הוּא עַל־חַרְבּוֹ וַיָּמת עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
When his arms-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his
sword and died with him.

translation.text: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise upon his sword, and died with him.

verses.english:
When his arms-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his
sword and died with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת שָׁאוּל וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת בָּנָיו וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו גַּם כּל־אֲנָשָׁיו בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יַחְדָּו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת שָׁאוּל וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת בָּנָיו וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו גַּם כּל־אֲנָשָׁיו בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יַחְדָּו׃

english.text:
Thus Saul and his three sons and his arms-bearer, as well as all
his men, died together on that day.

translation.text: So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armourbearer, and all his men, that same day together.

verses.english:
Thus Saul and his three sons and his arms-bearer, as well as all
his men, died together on that day.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּרְאוּ אַנְשֵׁי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־בְּעֵבֶר הָעֵמֶק וַאֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן כִּי־נָסוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִי־מֵתוּ שָׁאוּל וּבָנָיו וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־הֶעָרִים
וַיָּנֻסוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָּהֶן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּרְאוּ אַנְשֵׁי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־בְּעֵבֶר הָעֵמֶק וַאֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן כִּי־נָסוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִי־מֵתוּ שָׁאוּל וּבָנָיו וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־הֶעָרִים
וַיָּנֻסוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָּהֶן׃

english.text:
And when the men of Israel on the other side of the valley and on
the other side of the Jordan saw that the men of Israel had fled
and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the towns and
fled; the Philistines then came and occupied them.

translation.text: And when the men of Israel that were on the other side of the valley, and they that were on the other side Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

verses.english:
And when the men of Israel on the other side of the valley and on
the other side of the Jordan saw that the men of Israel had fled
and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the towns and
fled; the Philistines then came and occupied them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיָּבֹאוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לְפַשֵּׁט אֶת־הַחֲלָלִים וַיִּמְצְאוּ אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־שְׁלֹשֶׁת בָּנָיו נֹפְלִים בְּהַר הַגִּלְבֹּעַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִמּחֳרָת וַיָּבֹאוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לְפַשֵּׁט אֶת־הַחֲלָלִים וַיִּמְצְאוּ אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־שְׁלֹשֶׁת בָּנָיו נֹפְלִים בְּהַר הַגִּלְבֹּעַ׃

english.text:
The next day the Philistines came to strip the slain, and they
found Saul and his three sons lying on Mount Gilboa.

translation.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

verses.english:
The next day the Philistines came to strip the slain, and they
found Saul and his three sons lying on Mount Gilboa.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרְתוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיַּפְשִׁטוּ אֶת־כֵּלָיו וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ בְאֶרֶץ־פְּלִשְׁתִּים סָבִיב לְבַשֵּׂר בֵּית עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וְאֶת־הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְרְתוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיַּפְשִׁטוּ אֶת־כֵּלָיו וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ בְאֶרֶץ־פְּלִשְׁתִּים סָבִיב לְבַשֵּׂר בֵּית עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וְאֶת־הָעָם׃

english.text:
They cut off his head and stripped him of his armor, and they sent
them throughout the land of the Philistines, to spread the news in
the temples of their idols and among the people.

translation.text: And they cut off his head, and stripped off his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to publish it in the house of their idols, and among the people.

verses.english:
They cut off his head and stripped him of his armor, and they sent
them throughout the land of the Philistines, to spread the news in
the temples of their idols and among the people.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת־כֵּלָיו בֵּית עַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶת־גְּוִיָּתוֹ תָּקְעוּ בְּחוֹמַת בֵּית שָׁן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת־כֵּלָיו בֵּית עַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶת־גְּוִיָּתוֹ תָּקְעוּ בְּחוֹמַת בֵּית שָׁן׃

english.text:
They placed his armor in the temple of Ashtaroth, and they impaled
his body on the wall of Beth-shan.

translation.text: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtaroth: and they fastened his body to the wall of Bethshan.

verses.english:
They placed his armor in the temple of Ashtaroth, and they impaled
his body on the wall of Beth-shan.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֵלָיו יֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לְשָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֵלָיו יֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לְשָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
When the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard about it—what the
Philistines had done to Saul—

translation.text: And when the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul;

verses.english:
When the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard about it—what the
Philistines had done to Saul—

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקוּמוּ כּל־אִישׁ חַיִל וַיֵּלְכוּ כל־הַלַּיְלָה וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־גְּוִיַּת שָׁאוּל וְאֵת גְּוִיֹּת בָּנָיו מֵחוֹמַת בֵּית שָׁן וַיָּבֹאוּ יָבֵשָׁה וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אֹתָם שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקוּמוּ כּל־אִישׁ חַיִל וַיֵּלְכוּ כל־הַלַּיְלָה וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־גְּוִיַּת שָׁאוּל וְאֵת גְּוִיֹּת בָּנָיו מֵחוֹמַת בֵּית שָׁן וַיָּבֹאוּ יָבֵשָׁה וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אֹתָם שָׁם׃

english.text:
all their stalwart men set out and marched all night; they removed
the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall of Beth-shan and
came to Jabesh and burned them there.

translation.text: All the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Bethshan, and came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.

verses.english:
all their stalwart men set out and marched all night; they removed
the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall of Beth-shan and
came to Jabesh and burned them there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־עַצְמֹתֵיהֶם וַיִּקְבְּרוּ תַחַת־הָאֶשֶׁל בְּיָבֵשָׁה וַיָּצֻמוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־עַצְמֹתֵיהֶם וַיִּקְבְּרוּ תַחַת־הָאֶשֶׁל בְּיָבֵשָׁה וַיָּצֻמוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

english.text:
Then they took the bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree
in Jabesh, and they fasted for seven days.

translation.text: And they took their bones, and buried them under a tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

verses.english:
Then they took the bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree
in Jabesh, and they fasted for seven days.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי מוֹת שָׁאוּל וְדָוִד שָׁב מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת־הָעֲמָלֵק וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד בְּצִקְלָג יָמִים שְׁנָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי מוֹת שָׁאוּל וְדָוִד שָׁב מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת־הָעֲמָלֵק וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד בְּצִקְלָג יָמִים שְׁנָיִם׃

english.text:
And it was after Saul’s death, when David had come back from
striking the Amalekites, and David stayed in Ziklag two days.

translation.text: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;

verses.english:
And it was after Saul’s death, when David had come back from
striking the Amalekites, and David stayed in Ziklag two days.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ בָּא מִן־הַמַּחֲנֶה מֵעִם שָׁאוּל וּבְגָדָיו קְרֻעִים וַאֲדָמָה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיְהִי בְּבֹאוֹ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיִּפֹּל אַרְצָה
וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ בָּא מִן־הַמַּחֲנֶה מֵעִם שָׁאוּל וּבְגָדָיו קְרֻעִים וַאֲדָמָה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיְהִי בְּבֹאוֹ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיִּפֹּל אַרְצָה
וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ׃

english.text:
On the third day, a man came from Saul’s camp, with his clothes
rent and earth on his head; and as he approached David, he flung
himself to the ground and bowed low.

translation.text: It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.

verses.english:
On the third day, a man came from Saul’s camp, with his clothes
rent and earth on his head; and as he approached David, he flung
himself to the ground and bowed low.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָּוִד אֵי מִזֶּה תָּבוֹא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מִמַּחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל נִמְלָטְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָּוִד אֵי מִזֶּה תָּבוֹא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מִמַּחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל נִמְלָטְתִּי׃

english.text:
David said to him, “Where are you coming from?” He answered, “I
have just escaped from the camp of Israel.”

translation.text: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.

verses.english:
David said to him, “Where are you coming from?” He answered, “I
have just escaped from the camp of Israel.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד מֶה־הָיָה הַדָּבָר הַגֶּד־נָא לִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֲשֶׁר־נָס הָעָם מִן־הַמִּלְחָמָה וְגַם־הַרְבֵּה נָפַל מִן־הָעָם וַיָּמֻתוּ וְגַם שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ
מֵתוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד מֶה־הָיָה הַדָּבָר הַגֶּד־נָא לִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֲשֶׁר־נָס הָעָם מִן־הַמִּלְחָמָה וְגַם־הַרְבֵּה נָפַל מִן־הָעָם וַיָּמֻתוּ וְגַם שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ
מֵתוּ׃

english.text:
“What happened?” asked David. “Tell me!” And he told him how the
troops had fled the battlefield, and that, moreover, many of the
troops had fallen and died; also that Saul and his son Jonathan
were dead.

translation.text: And David said unto him, How went the matter? I pray thee, tell me.

verses.english:
“What happened?” asked David. “Tell me!” And he told him how the
troops had fled the battlefield, and that, moreover, many of the
troops had fallen and died; also that Saul and his son Jonathan
were dead.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ אֵיךְ יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־מֵת שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ אֵיךְ יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־מֵת שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ׃

english.text:
“How do you know,” David asked the young man who brought him the
news, “that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?”

translation.text: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?

verses.english:
“How do you know,” David asked the young man who brought him the
news, “that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַנַּעַר הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ נִקְרֹא נִקְרֵיתִי בְּהַר הַגִּלְבֹּעַ וְהִנֵּה שָׁאוּל נִשְׁעָן עַל־חֲנִיתוֹ וְהִנֵּה הָרֶכֶב וּבַעֲלֵי הַפָּרָשִׁים הִדְבִּקֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַנַּעַר הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ נִקְרֹא נִקְרֵיתִי בְּהַר הַגִּלְבֹּעַ וְהִנֵּה שָׁאוּל נִשְׁעָן עַל־חֲנִיתוֹ וְהִנֵּה הָרֶכֶב וּבַעֲלֵי הַפָּרָשִׁים הִדְבִּקֻהוּ׃

english.text:
The young man who brought him the news answered, “I happened to be
at Mount Gilboa, and I saw Saul leaning on his spear, and the
chariots and horsemen closing in on him.

translation.text: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.

verses.english:
The young man who brought him the news answered, “I happened to be
at Mount Gilboa, and I saw Saul leaning on his spear, and the
chariots and horsemen closing in on him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן אַחֲרָיו וַיִּרְאֵנִי וַיִּקְרָא אֵלַי וָאֹמַר הִנֵּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֶן אַחֲרָיו וַיִּרְאֵנִי וַיִּקְרָא אֵלַי וָאֹמַר הִנֵּנִי׃

english.text:
He looked around and saw me, and he called to me. When I
responded, ‘At your service,’

translation.text: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here am I.

verses.english:
He looked around and saw me, and he called to me. When I
responded, ‘At your service,’

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי מִי־אָתָּה (ויאמר) [וָאֹמַר] אֵלָיו עֲמָלֵקִי אָנֹכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי מִי־אָתָּה (ויאמר) [וָאֹמַר] אֵלָיו עֲמָלֵקִי אָנֹכִי׃

english.text:
he asked me, ‘Who are you?’ And I told him that I was an
Amalekite.

translation.text: And he said unto me, Who art thou? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.

verses.english:
he asked me, ‘Who are you?’ And I told him that I was an
Amalekite.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי עֲמד־נָא עָלַי וּמֹתְתֵנִי כִּי אֲחָזַנִי הַשָּׁבָץ כִּי־כל־עוֹד נַפְשִׁי בִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי עֲמד־נָא עָלַי וּמֹתְתֵנִי כִּי אֲחָזַנִי הַשָּׁבָץ כִּי־כל־עוֹד נַפְשִׁי בִּי׃

english.text:
Then he said to me, ‘Stand over me, and finish me off, for I am in
agony and am barely alive.’

translation.text: He said unto me again, Stand, I pray thee, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life is yet whole in me.

verses.english:
Then he said to me, ‘Stand over me, and finish me off, for I am in
agony and am barely alive.’

verses.hebrew: וָאֶעֱמֹד עָלָיו וַאֲמֹתְתֵהוּ כִּי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי לֹא יִחְיֶה אַחֲרֵי נִפְלוֹ וָאֶקַּח הַנֵּזֶר אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וְאֶצְעָדָה אֲשֶׁר עַל־זְרֹעוֹ וָאֲבִיאֵם אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הֵנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶעֱמֹד עָלָיו וַאֲמֹתְתֵהוּ כִּי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי לֹא יִחְיֶה אַחֲרֵי נִפְלוֹ וָאֶקַּח הַנֵּזֶר אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וְאֶצְעָדָה אֲשֶׁר עַל־זְרֹעוֹ וָאֲבִיאֵם אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הֵנָּה׃

english.text:
So I stood over him and finished him off, for I knew that he would
never rise from where he was lying. Then I took the crown from his
head and the armlet from his arm, and I have brought them here to
my lord.”

translation.text: So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that was upon his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.

verses.english:
So I stood over him and finished him off, for I knew that he would
never rise from where he was lying. Then I took the crown from his
head and the armlet from his arm, and I have brought them here to
my lord.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲזֵק דָּוִד בִּבְגָדָו וַיִּקְרָעֵם וְגַם כּל־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲזֵק דָּוִד בִּבְגָדָו וַיִּקְרָעֵם וְגַם כּל־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
David took hold of his clothes and rent them, and so did all the
men with him.

translation.text: Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that were with him:

verses.english:
David took hold of his clothes and rent them, and so did all the
men with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְפְּדוּ וַיִּבְכּוּ וַיָּצֻמוּ עַד־הָעָרֶב עַל־שָׁאוּל וְעַל־יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ וְעַל־עַם יְהֹוָה וְעַל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי נָפְלוּ בֶּחָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסְפְּדוּ וַיִּבְכּוּ וַיָּצֻמוּ עַד־הָעָרֶב עַל־שָׁאוּל וְעַל־יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ וְעַל־עַם יְהֹוָה וְעַל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי נָפְלוּ בֶּחָרֶב׃

english.text:
They lamented and wept, and they fasted until evening for Saul and
his son Jonathan, and for the soldiers of YHWH and the House of
Israel who had fallen by the sword.

translation.text: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.

verses.english:
They lamented and wept, and they fasted until evening for Saul and
his son Jonathan, and for the soldiers of YHWH and the House of
Israel who had fallen by the sword.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ אֵי מִזֶּה אָתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר בֶּן־אִישׁ גֵּר עֲמָלֵקִי אָנֹכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ אֵי מִזֶּה אָתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר בֶּן־אִישׁ גֵּר עֲמָלֵקִי אָנֹכִי׃

english.text:
David said to the young man who had brought him the news, “Where
are you from?” He replied, “I am the son of a resident alien, an
Amalekite.”

translation.text: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence art thou? And he answered, I am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.

verses.english:
David said to the young man who had brought him the news, “Where
are you from?” He replied, “I am the son of a resident alien, an
Amalekite.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד אֵיךְ לֹא יָרֵאתָ לִשְׁלֹחַ יָדְךָ לְשַׁחֵת אֶת־מְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד אֵיךְ לֹא יָרֵאתָ לִשְׁלֹחַ יָדְךָ לְשַׁחֵת אֶת־מְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“How did you dare,” David said to him, “to lift your hand and kill
YHWH’s anointed?”

translation.text: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the LORD’s anointed?

verses.english:
“How did you dare,” David said to him, “to lift your hand and kill
YHWH’s anointed?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא דָוִד לְאַחַד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר גַּשׁ פְּגַע־בּוֹ וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא דָוִד לְאַחַד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר גַּשׁ פְּגַע־בּוֹ וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
Thereupon David called one of the attendants and said to him,
“Come over and strike him!” He struck him down and he died.

translation.text: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.

verses.english:
Thereupon David called one of the attendants and said to him,
“Come over and strike him!” He struck him down and he died.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד (דמיך) [דָּמְךָ] עַל־רֹאשֶׁךָ כִּי פִיךָ עָנָה בְךָ לֵאמֹר אָנֹכִי מֹתַתִּי אֶת־מְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד (דמיך) [דָּמְךָ] עַל־רֹאשֶׁךָ כִּי פִיךָ עָנָה בְךָ לֵאמֹר אָנֹכִי מֹתַתִּי אֶת־מְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And David said to him, “Your blood be on your own head! Your own
mouth testified against you when you said, ‘I put YHWH’s anointed
to death.’”

translation.text: And David said unto him, Thy blood be upon thy head; for thy mouth hath testified against thee, saying, I have slain the LORD’s anointed.

verses.english:
And David said to him, “Your blood be on your own head! Your own
mouth testified against you when you said, ‘I put YHWH’s anointed
to death.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיְקֹנֵן דָּוִד אֶת־הַקִּינָה הַזֹּאת עַל־שָׁאוּל וְעַל־יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְקֹנֵן דָּוִד אֶת־הַקִּינָה הַזֹּאת עַל־שָׁאוּל וְעַל־יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ׃

english.text: And David intoned this dirge over Saul and his son Jonathan—

translation.text: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:

verses.english: And David intoned this dirge over Saul and his son Jonathan—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְלַמֵּד בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה קָשֶׁת הִנֵּה כְתוּבָה עַל־סֵפֶר הַיָּשָׁר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְלַמֵּד בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה קָשֶׁת הִנֵּה כְתוּבָה עַל־סֵפֶר הַיָּשָׁר׃

english.text:
He ordered the Judites to be taught [The Song of the] Bow. It is
recorded in the Book of Jashar.

translation.text: (Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)

verses.english:
He ordered the Judites to be taught [The Song of the] Bow. It is
recorded in the Book of Jashar.

verses.hebrew: הַצְּבִי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־בָּמוֹתֶיךָ חָלָל אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבּוֹרִים׃

hebrew.text: הַצְּבִי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־בָּמוֹתֶיךָ חָלָל אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבּוֹרִים׃

english.text:
Your glory, O Israel, Lies slain on your heights; How have the
mighty fallen!

translation.text: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!

verses.english:
Your glory, O Israel, Lies slain on your heights; How have the
mighty fallen!

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּגִּידוּ בְגַת אַל־תְּבַשְּׂרוּ בְּחוּצֹת אַשְׁקְלוֹן פֶּן־תִּשְׂמַחְנָה בְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים פֶּן־תַּעֲלֹזְנָה בְּנוֹת הָעֲרֵלִים׃

hebrew.text: אַל־תַּגִּידוּ בְגַת אַל־תְּבַשְּׂרוּ בְּחוּצֹת אַשְׁקְלוֹן פֶּן־תִּשְׂמַחְנָה בְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים פֶּן־תַּעֲלֹזְנָה בְּנוֹת הָעֲרֵלִים׃

english.text:
Tell it not in Gath, Do not proclaim it in the streets of
Ashkelon, Lest the daughters of the Philistine rejoice, Lest the
daughters of the uncircumcised exult.

translation.text: Tell it not in Gath, publish it not in the streets of Askelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

verses.english:
Tell it not in Gath, Do not proclaim it in the streets of
Ashkelon, Lest the daughters of the Philistine rejoice, Lest the
daughters of the uncircumcised exult.

verses.hebrew: הָרֵי בַגִּלְבֹּעַ אַל־טַל וְאַל־מָטָר עֲלֵיכֶם וּשְׂדֵי תְרוּמֹת כִּי שָׁם נִגְעַל מָגֵן גִּבּוֹרִים מָגֵן שָׁאוּל בְּלִי מָשִׁיחַ בַּשָּׁמֶן׃

hebrew.text: הָרֵי בַגִּלְבֹּעַ אַל־טַל וְאַל־מָטָר עֲלֵיכֶם וּשְׂדֵי תְרוּמֹת כִּי שָׁם נִגְעַל מָגֵן גִּבּוֹרִים מָגֵן שָׁאוּל בְּלִי מָשִׁיחַ בַּשָּׁמֶן׃

english.text:
O hills of Gilboa— Let there be no dew or rain on you, Or
bountiful fields, For there the shield of warriors lay rejected,
The shield of Saul, Polished with oil no more.

translation.text: Ye mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew, neither let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, as though he had not been anointed with oil.

verses.english:
O hills of Gilboa— Let there be no dew or rain on you, Or
bountiful fields, For there the shield of warriors lay rejected,
The shield of Saul, Polished with oil no more.

verses.hebrew: מִדַּם חֲלָלִים מֵחֵלֶב גִּבּוֹרִים קֶשֶׁת יְהוֹנָתָן לֹא נָשׂוֹג אָחוֹר וְחֶרֶב שָׁאוּל לֹא תָשׁוּב רֵיקָם׃

hebrew.text: מִדַּם חֲלָלִים מֵחֵלֶב גִּבּוֹרִים קֶשֶׁת יְהוֹנָתָן לֹא נָשׂוֹג אָחוֹר וְחֶרֶב שָׁאוּל לֹא תָשׁוּב רֵיקָם׃

english.text:
From the blood of slain, From the fat of warriors— The bow of
Jonathan Never turned back; The sword of Saul Never withdrew
empty.

translation.text: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.

verses.english:
From the blood of slain, From the fat of warriors— The bow of
Jonathan Never turned back; The sword of Saul Never withdrew
empty.

verses.hebrew: שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן הַנֶּאֱהָבִים וְהַנְּעִימִם בְּחַיֵּיהֶם וּבְמוֹתָם לֹא נִפְרָדוּ מִנְּשָׁרִים קַלּוּ מֵאֲרָיוֹת גָּבֵרוּ׃

hebrew.text: שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן הַנֶּאֱהָבִים וְהַנְּעִימִם בְּחַיֵּיהֶם וּבְמוֹתָם לֹא נִפְרָדוּ מִנְּשָׁרִים קַלּוּ מֵאֲרָיוֹת גָּבֵרוּ׃

english.text:
Saul and Jonathan, Beloved and cherished, Never parted In life or
in death! They were swifter than eagles, They were stronger than
lions!

translation.text: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.

verses.english:
Saul and Jonathan, Beloved and cherished, Never parted In life or
in death! They were swifter than eagles, They were stronger than
lions!

verses.hebrew: בְּנוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל בְּכֶינָה הַמַּלְבִּשְׁכֶם שָׁנִי עִם־עֲדָנִים הַמַּעֲלֶה עֲדִי זָהָב עַל לְבוּשְׁכֶן׃

hebrew.text: בְּנוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל בְּכֶינָה הַמַּלְבִּשְׁכֶם שָׁנִי עִם־עֲדָנִים הַמַּעֲלֶה עֲדִי זָהָב עַל לְבוּשְׁכֶן׃

english.text:
Daughters of Israel, Weep over Saul, Who clothed you in crimson
and finery, Who decked your robes with jewels of gold.

translation.text: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.

verses.english:
Daughters of Israel, Weep over Saul, Who clothed you in crimson
and finery, Who decked your robes with jewels of gold.

verses.hebrew: אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבֹּרִים בְּתוֹךְ הַמִּלְחָמָה יְהוֹנָתָן עַל־בָּמוֹתֶיךָ חָלָל׃

hebrew.text: אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבֹּרִים בְּתוֹךְ הַמִּלְחָמָה יְהוֹנָתָן עַל־בָּמוֹתֶיךָ חָלָל׃

english.text:
How have the mighty fallen In the thick of battle— Jonathan, slain
on your heights!

translation.text: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, thou wast slain in thine high places.

verses.english:
How have the mighty fallen In the thick of battle— Jonathan, slain
on your heights!

verses.hebrew: צַר־לִי עָלֶיךָ אָחִי יְהוֹנָתָן נָעַמְתָּ לִּי מְאֹד נִפְלְאַתָה אַהֲבָתְךָ לִי מֵאַהֲבַת נָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: צַר־לִי עָלֶיךָ אָחִי יְהוֹנָתָן נָעַמְתָּ לִּי מְאֹד נִפְלְאַתָה אַהֲבָתְךָ לִי מֵאַהֲבַת נָשִׁים׃

english.text:
I grieve for you, My brother Jonathan, You were most dear to me.
Your love was wonderful to me More than the love of women.

translation.text: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.

verses.english:
I grieve for you, My brother Jonathan, You were most dear to me.
Your love was wonderful to me More than the love of women.

verses.hebrew: אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבּוֹרִים וַיֹּאבְדוּ כְּלֵי מִלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבּוֹרִים וַיֹּאבְדוּ כְּלֵי מִלְחָמָה׃

english.text: How have the mighty fallen, The weapons of war perished!

translation.text: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!

verses.english: How have the mighty fallen, The weapons of war perished!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַאֶעֱלֶה בְּאַחַת עָרֵי יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו עֲלֵה וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אָנָה אֶעֱלֶה וַיֹּאמֶר חֶבְרֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַאֶעֱלֶה בְּאַחַת עָרֵי יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו עֲלֵה וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אָנָה אֶעֱלֶה וַיֹּאמֶר חֶבְרֹנָה׃

english.text:
Sometime afterward, David inquired of YHWH, “Shall I go up to one
of the towns of Judah?” YHWH answered, “Yes.” David further asked,
“Which one shall I go up to?” And YHWH replied, “To Hebron.”

translation.text: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the LORD said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.

verses.english:
Sometime afterward, David inquired of YHWH, “Shall I go up to one
of the towns of Judah?” YHWH answered, “Yes.” David further asked,
“Which one shall I go up to?” And YHWH replied, “To Hebron.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל שָׁם דָּוִד וְגַם שְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו אֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵלִית וַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל שָׁם דָּוִד וְגַם שְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו אֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵלִית וַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִי׃

english.text:
So David went up there, along with his two wives, Ahinoam of
Jezreel and Abigail wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

translation.text: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal’s wife the Carmelite.

verses.english:
So David went up there, along with his two wives, Ahinoam of
Jezreel and Abigail wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנָשָׁיו אֲשֶׁר־עִמּוֹ הֶעֱלָה דָוִד אִישׁ וּבֵיתוֹ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְּעָרֵי חֶבְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנָשָׁיו אֲשֶׁר־עִמּוֹ הֶעֱלָה דָוִד אִישׁ וּבֵיתוֹ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְּעָרֵי חֶבְרוֹן׃

english.text:
David also took the men who were with him, each with his family,
and they settled in the towns about Hebron.

translation.text: And his men that were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.

verses.english:
David also took the men who were with him, each with his family,
and they settled in the towns about Hebron.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אַנְשֵׁי יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ־שָׁם אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה וַיַּגִּדוּ לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֲשֶׁר קָבְרוּ אֶת־שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אַנְשֵׁי יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ־שָׁם אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה וַיַּגִּדוּ לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֲשֶׁר קָבְרוּ אֶת־שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
The men of Judah came and there they anointed David king over the
House of Judah. David was told about the men of Jabesh-gilead who
buried Saul.

translation.text: And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, That the men of Jabeshgilead were they that buried Saul.

verses.english:
The men of Judah came and there they anointed David king over the
House of Judah. David was told about the men of Jabesh-gilead who
buried Saul.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד מַלְאָכִים אֶל־אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם בְּרֻכִים אַתֶּם לַיהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם הַחֶסֶד הַזֶּה עִם־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם עִם־שָׁאוּל וַתִּקְבְּרוּ
אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד מַלְאָכִים אֶל־אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם בְּרֻכִים אַתֶּם לַיהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם הַחֶסֶד הַזֶּה עִם־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם עִם־שָׁאוּל וַתִּקְבְּרוּ
אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
So David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh-gilead and said to
them, “May you be blessed of YHWH because you performed this act
of faithfulness to your lord Saul and buried him.

translation.text: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabeshgilead, and said unto them, Blessed be ye of the LORD, that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord, even unto Saul, and have buried him.

verses.english:
So David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh-gilead and said to
them, “May you be blessed of YHWH because you performed this act
of faithfulness to your lord Saul and buried him.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יַעַשׂ־יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת וְגַם אָנֹכִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אִתְּכֶם הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה יַעַשׂ־יְהֹוָה עִמָּכֶם חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת וְגַם אָנֹכִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אִתְּכֶם הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
May YHWH in turn show you true faithfulness; and I too will reward
you generously because you performed this act.

translation.text: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.

verses.english:
May YHWH in turn show you true faithfulness; and I too will reward
you generously because you performed this act.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה תֶּחֱזַקְנָה יְדֵיכֶם וִהְיוּ לִבְנֵי־חַיִל כִּי־מֵת אֲדֹנֵיכֶם שָׁאוּל וְגַם־אֹתִי מָשְׁחוּ בֵית־יְהוּדָה לְמֶלֶךְ עֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה תֶּחֱזַקְנָה יְדֵיכֶם וִהְיוּ לִבְנֵי־חַיִל כִּי־מֵת אֲדֹנֵיכֶם שָׁאוּל וְגַם־אֹתִי מָשְׁחוּ בֵית־יְהוּדָה לְמֶלֶךְ עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Now take courage and be brave men; for your lord Saul is dead and
the House of Judah have already anointed me king over them.”

translation.text: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.

verses.english:
Now take courage and be brave men; for your lord Saul is dead and
the House of Judah have already anointed me king over them.”

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר שַׂר־צָבָא אֲשֶׁר לְשָׁאוּל לָקַח אֶת־אִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל וַיַּעֲבִרֵהוּ מַחֲנָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר שַׂר־צָבָא אֲשֶׁר לְשָׁאוּל לָקַח אֶת־אִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל וַיַּעֲבִרֵהוּ מַחֲנָיִם׃

english.text:
But Abner son of Ner, Saul’s army commander, had taken Ish-bosheth
son of Saul and brought him across to Mahanaim

translation.text: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s host, took Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;

verses.english:
But Abner son of Ner, Saul’s army commander, had taken Ish-bosheth
son of Saul and brought him across to Mahanaim

verses.hebrew: וַיַּמְלִכֵהוּ אֶל־הַגִּלְעָד וְאֶל־הָאֲשׁוּרִי וְאֶל־יִזְרְעֶאל וְעַל־אֶפְרַיִם וְעַל־בִּנְיָמִן וְעַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֻּלֹּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּמְלִכֵהוּ אֶל־הַגִּלְעָד וְאֶל־הָאֲשׁוּרִי וְאֶל־יִזְרְעֶאל וְעַל־אֶפְרַיִם וְעַל־בִּנְיָמִן וְעַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֻּלֹּה׃

english.text:
and made him king over Gilead, the Ashurites, Jezreel, Ephraim,
and Benjamin—over all Israel.

translation.text: And made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

verses.english:
and made him king over Gilead, the Ashurites, Jezreel, Ephraim,
and Benjamin—over all Israel.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל בְּמלְכוֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנִים מָלָךְ אַךְ בֵּית יְהוּדָה הָיוּ אַחֲרֵי דָוִד׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל בְּמלְכוֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנִים מָלָךְ אַךְ בֵּית יְהוּדָה הָיוּ אַחֲרֵי דָוִד׃

english.text:
Ish-bosheth son of Saul was forty years old when he became king of
Israel, and he reigned two years. But the House of Judah supported
David.

translation.text: Ishbosheth Saul’s son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

verses.english:
Ish-bosheth son of Saul was forty years old when he became king of
Israel, and he reigned two years. But the House of Judah supported
David.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הָיָה דָוִד מֶלֶךְ בְּחֶבְרוֹן עַל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הָיָה דָוִד מֶלֶךְ בְּחֶבְרוֹן עַל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים׃

english.text:
The length of time that David reigned in Hebron over the House of
Judah was seven years and six months.

translation.text: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

verses.english:
The length of time that David reigned in Hebron over the House of
Judah was seven years and six months.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר וְעַבְדֵי אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל מִמַּחֲנַיִם גִּבְעוֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר וְעַבְדֵי אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל מִמַּחֲנַיִם גִּבְעוֹנָה׃

english.text:
Once Abner son of Ner and the soldiers of Ish-bosheth son of Saul
marched out from Mahanaim to Gibeon,

translation.text: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

verses.english:
Once Abner son of Ner and the soldiers of Ish-bosheth son of Saul
marched out from Mahanaim to Gibeon,

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה וְעַבְדֵי דָוִד יָצְאוּ וַיִּפְגְּשׁוּם עַל־בְּרֵכַת גִּבְעוֹן יַחְדָּו וַיֵּשְׁבוּ אֵלֶּה עַל־הַבְּרֵכָה מִזֶּה וְאֵלֶּה עַל־הַבְּרֵכָה מִזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה וְעַבְדֵי דָוִד יָצְאוּ וַיִּפְגְּשׁוּם עַל־בְּרֵכַת גִּבְעוֹן יַחְדָּו וַיֵּשְׁבוּ אֵלֶּה עַל־הַבְּרֵכָה מִזֶּה וְאֵלֶּה עַל־הַבְּרֵכָה מִזֶּה׃

english.text:
and Joab son of Zeruiah and the soldiers of David [also] came out.
They confronted one another at the pool of Gibeon: one group sat
on one side of the pool, and the other group on the other side of
the pool.

translation.text: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.

verses.english:
and Joab son of Zeruiah and the soldiers of David [also] came out.
They confronted one another at the pool of Gibeon: one group sat
on one side of the pool, and the other group on the other side of
the pool.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְנֵר אֶל־יוֹאָב יָקוּמוּ נָא הַנְּעָרִים וִישַׂחֲקוּ לְפָנֵינוּ וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב יָקֻמוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְנֵר אֶל־יוֹאָב יָקוּמוּ נָא הַנְּעָרִים וִישַׂחֲקוּ לְפָנֵינוּ וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב יָקֻמוּ׃

english.text:
Abner said to Joab, “Let the young men come forward and sport
before us.” “Yes, let them,” Joab answered.

translation.text: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.

verses.english:
Abner said to Joab, “Let the young men come forward and sport
before us.” “Yes, let them,” Joab answered.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְמִסְפָּר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר לְבִנְיָמִן וּלְאִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל וּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר מֵעַבְדֵי דָוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְמִסְפָּר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר לְבִנְיָמִן וּלְאִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל וּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר מֵעַבְדֵי דָוִד׃

english.text:
They came forward and were counted off, twelve for Benjamin and
Ish-bosheth son of Saul, and twelve of David’s soldiers.

translation.text: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which pertained to Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.

verses.english:
They came forward and were counted off, twelve for Benjamin and
Ish-bosheth son of Saul, and twelve of David’s soldiers.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲזִקוּ אִישׁ בְּרֹאשׁ רֵעֵהוּ וְחַרְבּוֹ בְּצַד רֵעֵהוּ וַיִּפְּלוּ יַחְדָּו וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא חֶלְקַת הַצֻּרִים אֲשֶׁר בְּגִבְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲזִקוּ אִישׁ בְּרֹאשׁ רֵעֵהוּ וְחַרְבּוֹ בְּצַד רֵעֵהוּ וַיִּפְּלוּ יַחְדָּו וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא חֶלְקַת הַצֻּרִים אֲשֶׁר בְּגִבְעוֹן׃

english.text:
Each one grasped his opponent’s head [and thrust] his dagger into
his opponent’s side; thus they fell together. That place, which is
in Gibeon, was called Helkath-hazzurim.

translation.text: And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkathhazzurim, which is in Gibeon.

verses.english:
Each one grasped his opponent’s head [and thrust] his dagger into
his opponent’s side; thus they fell together. That place, which is
in Gibeon, was called Helkath-hazzurim.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי הַמִּלְחָמָה קָשָׁה עַד־מְאֹד בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּנָּגֶף אַבְנֵר וְאַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי עַבְדֵי דָוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי הַמִּלְחָמָה קָשָׁה עַד־מְאֹד בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּנָּגֶף אַבְנֵר וְאַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי עַבְדֵי דָוִד׃

english.text:
A fierce battle ensued that day, and Abner and the men of Israel
were routed by David’s soldiers.

translation.text: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.

verses.english:
A fierce battle ensued that day, and Abner and the men of Israel
were routed by David’s soldiers.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ־שָׁם שְׁלֹשָׁה בְּנֵי צְרוּיָה יוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי וַעֲשָׂהאֵל וַעֲשָׂהאֵל קַל בְּרַגְלָיו כְּאַחַד הַצְּבָיִם אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ־שָׁם שְׁלֹשָׁה בְּנֵי צְרוּיָה יוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי וַעֲשָׂהאֵל וַעֲשָׂהאֵל קַל בְּרַגְלָיו כְּאַחַד הַצְּבָיִם אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
The three sons of Zeruiah were there—Joab, Abishai, and Asahel.
Asahel was swift of foot, like a gazelle in the open field.

translation.text: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe.

verses.english:
The three sons of Zeruiah were there—Joab, Abishai, and Asahel.
Asahel was swift of foot, like a gazelle in the open field.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדֹּף עֲשָׂהאֵל אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וְלֹא־נָטָה לָלֶכֶת עַל־הַיָּמִין וְעַל־הַשְּׂמֹאול מֵאַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְדֹּף עֲשָׂהאֵל אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וְלֹא־נָטָה לָלֶכֶת עַל־הַיָּמִין וְעַל־הַשְּׂמֹאול מֵאַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר׃

english.text:
And Asahel ran after Abner, swerving neither right nor left in his
pursuit of Abner.

translation.text: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.

verses.english:
And Asahel ran after Abner, swerving neither right nor left in his
pursuit of Abner.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן אַבְנֵר אַחֲרָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הַאַתָּה זֶה עֲשָׂהאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֶן אַבְנֵר אַחֲרָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הַאַתָּה זֶה עֲשָׂהאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי׃

english.text:
Abner looked back and shouted, “Is that you, Asahel?” “Yes, it
is,” he called back.

translation.text: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Art thou Asahel? And he answered, I am.

verses.english:
Abner looked back and shouted, “Is that you, Asahel?” “Yes, it
is,” he called back.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַבְנֵר נְטֵה לְךָ עַל־יְמִינְךָ אוֹ עַל־שְׂמֹאלֶךָ וֶאֱחֹז לְךָ אֶחָד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וְקַח־לְךָ אֶת־חֲלִצָתוֹ וְלֹא־אָבָה עֲשָׂהאֵל לָסוּר מֵאַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַבְנֵר נְטֵה לְךָ עַל־יְמִינְךָ אוֹ עַל־שְׂמֹאלֶךָ וֶאֱחֹז לְךָ אֶחָד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וְקַח־לְךָ אֶת־חֲלִצָתוֹ וְלֹא־אָבָה עֲשָׂהאֵל לָסוּר מֵאַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
Abner said to him, “Turn to the right or to the left, and seize
one of our boys and strip off his tunic.” But Asahel would not
leave off.

translation.text: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour.

verses.english:
Abner said to him, “Turn to the right or to the left, and seize
one of our boys and strip off his tunic.” But Asahel would not
leave off.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד אַבְנֵר לֵאמֹר אֶל־עֲשָׂהאֵל סוּר לְךָ מֵאַחֲרָי לָמָּה אַכֶּכָּה אַרְצָה וְאֵיךְ אֶשָּׂא פָנַי אֶל־יוֹאָב אָחִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד אַבְנֵר לֵאמֹר אֶל־עֲשָׂהאֵל סוּר לְךָ מֵאַחֲרָי לָמָּה אַכֶּכָּה אַרְצָה וְאֵיךְ אֶשָּׂא פָנַי אֶל־יוֹאָב אָחִיךָ׃

english.text:
Abner again begged Asahel, “Stop pursuing me, or I’ll have to
strike you down. How will I look your brother Joab in the face?”

translation.text: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?

verses.english:
Abner again begged Asahel, “Stop pursuing me, or I’ll have to
strike you down. How will I look your brother Joab in the face?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְמָאֵן לָסוּר וַיַּכֵּהוּ אַבְנֵר בְּאַחֲרֵי הַחֲנִית אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ וַתֵּצֵא הַחֲנִית מֵאַחֲרָיו וַיִּפּל־שָׁם וַיָּמת תַּחְתָּו וַיְהִי כּל־הַבָּא אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־נָפַל
שָׁם עֲשָׂהאֵל וַיָּמֹת וַיַּעֲמֹדוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְמָאֵן לָסוּר וַיַּכֵּהוּ אַבְנֵר בְּאַחֲרֵי הַחֲנִית אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ וַתֵּצֵא הַחֲנִית מֵאַחֲרָיו וַיִּפּל־שָׁם וַיָּמת תַּחְתָּו וַיְהִי כּל־הַבָּא אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־נָפַל
שָׁם עֲשָׂהאֵל וַיָּמֹת וַיַּעֲמֹדוּ׃

english.text:
When he refused to desist, Abner struck him in the belly with a
backward thrust of his spear and the spear protruded from his
back. He fell there and died on the spot. And all who came to the
place where Asahel fell and died halted;

translation.text: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib, that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

verses.english:
When he refused to desist, Abner struck him in the belly with a
backward thrust of his spear and the spear protruded from his
back. He fell there and died on the spot. And all who came to the
place where Asahel fell and died halted;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדְּפוּ יוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וְהַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בָּאָה וְהֵמָּה בָּאוּ עַד־גִּבְעַת אַמָּה אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי־גִיחַ דֶּרֶךְ מִדְבַּר גִּבְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְדְּפוּ יוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וְהַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בָּאָה וְהֵמָּה בָּאוּ עַד־גִּבְעַת אַמָּה אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי־גִיחַ דֶּרֶךְ מִדְבַּר גִּבְעוֹן׃

english.text:
but Joab and Abishai continued to pursue Abner. And the sun was
setting as they reached the hill of Ammah, which faces Giah on the
road to the wilderness of Gibeon.

translation.text: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

verses.english:
but Joab and Abishai continued to pursue Abner. And the sun was
setting as they reached the hill of Ammah, which faces Giah on the
road to the wilderness of Gibeon.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקַבְּצוּ בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וַיִּהְיוּ לַאֲגֻדָּה אֶחָת וַיַּעַמְדוּ עַל רֹאשׁ־גִּבְעָה אֶחָת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְקַבְּצוּ בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וַיִּהְיוּ לַאֲגֻדָּה אֶחָת וַיַּעַמְדוּ עַל רֹאשׁ־גִּבְעָה אֶחָת׃

english.text:
The Benjaminites rallied behind Abner, forming a single company;
and they took up a position on the top of a hill.

translation.text: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.

verses.english:
The Benjaminites rallied behind Abner, forming a single company;
and they took up a position on the top of a hill.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אַבְנֵר אֶל־יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלָנֶצַח תֹּאכַל חֶרֶב הֲלוֹא יָדַעְתָּה כִּי־מָרָה תִהְיֶה בָּאַחֲרוֹנָה וְעַד־מָתַי לֹא־תֹאמַר לָעָם לָשׁוּב מֵאַחֲרֵי אֲחֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אַבְנֵר אֶל־יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלָנֶצַח תֹּאכַל חֶרֶב הֲלוֹא יָדַעְתָּה כִּי־מָרָה תִהְיֶה בָּאַחֲרוֹנָה וְעַד־מָתַי לֹא־תֹאמַר לָעָם לָשׁוּב מֵאַחֲרֵי אֲחֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Abner then called out to Joab, “Must the sword devour forever? You
know how bitterly it’s going to end! How long will you delay
ordering your troops to stop the pursuit of their kinsmen?”

translation.text: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?

verses.english:
Abner then called out to Joab, “Must the sword devour forever? You
know how bitterly it’s going to end! How long will you delay
ordering your troops to stop the pursuit of their kinsmen?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב חַי הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי לוּלֵא דִּבַּרְתָּ כִּי אָז מֵהַבֹּקֶר נַעֲלָה הָעָם אִישׁ מֵאַחֲרֵי אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב חַי הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי לוּלֵא דִּבַּרְתָּ כִּי אָז מֵהַבֹּקֶר נַעֲלָה הָעָם אִישׁ מֵאַחֲרֵי אָחִיו׃

english.text:
And Joab replied, “As God lives, if you hadn’t spoken up, the
troops would have given up the pursuit of their kinsmen only the
next morning.”

translation.text: And Joab said, As God liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.

verses.english:
And Joab replied, “As God lives, if you hadn’t spoken up, the
troops would have given up the pursuit of their kinsmen only the
next morning.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקַע יוֹאָב בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיַּעַמְדוּ כּל־הָעָם וְלֹא־יִרְדְּפוּ עוֹד אַחֲרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא־יָסְפוּ עוֹד לְהִלָּחֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְקַע יוֹאָב בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיַּעַמְדוּ כּל־הָעָם וְלֹא־יִרְדְּפוּ עוֹד אַחֲרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא־יָסְפוּ עוֹד לְהִלָּחֵם׃

english.text:
Joab then sounded the horn, and all the troops halted; they ceased
their pursuit of Israel and stopped the fighting.

translation.text: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.

verses.english:
Joab then sounded the horn, and all the troops halted; they ceased
their pursuit of Israel and stopped the fighting.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְנֵר וַאֲנָשָׁיו הָלְכוּ בָּעֲרָבָה כֹּל הַלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיֵּלְכוּ כּל־הַבִּתְרוֹן וַיָּבֹאוּ מַחֲנָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַבְנֵר וַאֲנָשָׁיו הָלְכוּ בָּעֲרָבָה כֹּל הַלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיֵּלְכוּ כּל־הַבִּתְרוֹן וַיָּבֹאוּ מַחֲנָיִם׃

english.text:
Abner and his men marched through the Arabah all that night and,
after crossing the Jordan, they marched through all of Bithron
until they came to Mahanaim.

translation.text: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.

verses.english:
Abner and his men marched through the Arabah all that night and,
after crossing the Jordan, they marched through all of Bithron
until they came to Mahanaim.

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב שָׁב מֵאַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וַיִּקְבֹּץ אֶת־כּל־הָעָם וַיִּפָּקְדוּ מֵעַבְדֵי דָוִד תִּשְׁעָה־עָשָׂר אִישׁ וַעֲשָׂהאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹאָב שָׁב מֵאַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וַיִּקְבֹּץ אֶת־כּל־הָעָם וַיִּפָּקְדוּ מֵעַבְדֵי דָוִד תִּשְׁעָה־עָשָׂר אִישׁ וַעֲשָׂהאֵל׃

english.text:
After Joab gave up the pursuit of Abner, he assembled all the
troops and found nineteen of David’s soldiers missing, besides
Asahel.

translation.text: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David’s servants nineteen men and Asahel.

verses.english:
After Joab gave up the pursuit of Abner, he assembled all the
troops and found nineteen of David’s soldiers missing, besides
Asahel.

verses.hebrew: וְעַבְדֵי דָוִד הִכּוּ מִבִּנְיָמִן וּבְאַנְשֵׁי אַבְנֵר שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת וְשִׁשִּׁים אִישׁ מֵתוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַבְדֵי דָוִד הִכּוּ מִבִּנְיָמִן וּבְאַנְשֵׁי אַבְנֵר שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת וְשִׁשִּׁים אִישׁ מֵתוּ׃

english.text:
David’s soldiers, on the other hand, defeated the Benjaminites and
the men under Abner and killed three hundred and sixty men.

translation.text: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner’s men, so that three hundred and threescore men died.

verses.english:
David’s soldiers, on the other hand, defeated the Benjaminites and
the men under Abner and killed three hundred and sixty men.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־עֲשָׂהאֵל וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בְּקֶבֶר אָבִיו אֲשֶׁר בֵּית לָחֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ כל־הַלַּיְלָה יוֹאָב וַאֲנָשָׁיו וַיֵּאֹר לָהֶם בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־עֲשָׂהאֵל וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בְּקֶבֶר אָבִיו אֲשֶׁר בֵּית לָחֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ כל־הַלַּיְלָה יוֹאָב וַאֲנָשָׁיו וַיֵּאֹר לָהֶם בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

english.text:
They bore Asahel away and buried him in his father’s tomb in
Bethlehem. Then Joab and his men marched all night; day broke upon
them in Hebron.

translation.text: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Bethlehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.

verses.english:
They bore Asahel away and buried him in his father’s tomb in
Bethlehem. Then Joab and his men marched all night; day broke upon
them in Hebron.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲרֻכָּה בֵּין בֵּית שָׁאוּל וּבֵין בֵּית דָּוִד וְדָוִד הֹלֵךְ וְחָזֵק וּבֵית שָׁאוּל הֹלְכִים וְדַלִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲרֻכָּה בֵּין בֵּית שָׁאוּל וּבֵין בֵּית דָּוִד וְדָוִד הֹלֵךְ וְחָזֵק וּבֵית שָׁאוּל הֹלְכִים וְדַלִּים׃

english.text:
The war between the House of Saul and the House of David was
long-drawn-out; but David kept growing stronger, while the House
of Saul grew weaker.

translation.text: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.

verses.english:
The war between the House of Saul and the House of David was
long-drawn-out; but David kept growing stronger, while the House
of Saul grew weaker.

verses.hebrew: (וילדו) [וַיִּוָּלְדוּ] לְדָוִד בָּנִים בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיְהִי בְכוֹרוֹ אַמְנוֹן לַאֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִת׃

hebrew.text: (וילדו) [וַיִּוָּלְדוּ] לְדָוִד בָּנִים בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיְהִי בְכוֹרוֹ אַמְנוֹן לַאֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִת׃

english.text:
Sons were born to David in Hebron: His first-born was Amnon, by
Ahinoam of Jezreel;

translation.text: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

verses.english:
Sons were born to David in Hebron: His first-born was Amnon, by
Ahinoam of Jezreel;

verses.hebrew: וּמִשְׁנֵהוּ כִלְאָב (לאביגל) [לַאֲבִיגַיִל] אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִי וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁי אַבְשָׁלוֹם בֶּן־מַעֲכָה בַּת־תַּלְמַי מֶלֶךְ גְּשׁוּר׃

hebrew.text: וּמִשְׁנֵהוּ כִלְאָב (לאביגל) [לַאֲבִיגַיִל] אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִי וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁי אַבְשָׁלוֹם בֶּן־מַעֲכָה בַּת־תַּלְמַי מֶלֶךְ גְּשׁוּר׃

translation.text: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

verses.hebrew: וְהָרְבִיעִי אֲדֹנִיָּה בֶן־חַגִּית וְהַחֲמִישִׁי שְׁפַטְיָה בֶן־אֲבִיטָל׃

hebrew.text: וְהָרְבִיעִי אֲדֹנִיָּה בֶן־חַגִּית וְהַחֲמִישִׁי שְׁפַטְיָה בֶן־אֲבִיטָל׃

english.text:
the fourth was Adonijah son of Haggith; the fifth was Shephatiah
son of Abital;

translation.text: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

verses.english:
the fourth was Adonijah son of Haggith; the fifth was Shephatiah
son of Abital;

verses.hebrew: וְהַשִּׁשִּׁי יִתְרְעָם לְעֶגְלָה אֵשֶׁת דָּוִד אֵלֶּה יֻלְּדוּ לְדָוִד בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשִּׁשִּׁי יִתְרְעָם לְעֶגְלָה אֵשֶׁת דָּוִד אֵלֶּה יֻלְּדוּ לְדָוִד בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

english.text:
and the sixth was Ithream, by David’s wife Eglah. These were born
to David in Hebron.

translation.text: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

verses.english:
and the sixth was Ithream, by David’s wife Eglah. These were born
to David in Hebron.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹת הַמִּלְחָמָה בֵּין בֵּית שָׁאוּל וּבֵין בֵּית דָּוִד וְאַבְנֵר הָיָה מִתְחַזֵּק בְּבֵית שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹת הַמִּלְחָמָה בֵּין בֵּית שָׁאוּל וּבֵין בֵּית דָּוִד וְאַבְנֵר הָיָה מִתְחַזֵּק בְּבֵית שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
During the war between the House of Saul and the House of David,
Abner supported the House of Saul.

translation.text: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.

verses.english:
During the war between the House of Saul and the House of David,
Abner supported the House of Saul.

verses.hebrew: וּלְשָׁאוּל פִּלֶגֶשׁ וּשְׁמָהּ רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אַבְנֵר מַדּוּעַ בָּאתָה אֶל־פִּילֶגֶשׁ אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: וּלְשָׁאוּל פִּלֶגֶשׁ וּשְׁמָהּ רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אַבְנֵר מַדּוּעַ בָּאתָה אֶל־פִּילֶגֶשׁ אָבִי׃

english.text:
Now Saul had a concubine named Rizpah, daughter of Aiah; and
[Ish-bosheth] said to Abner, “Why have you lain with my father’s
concubine?”

translation.text: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ishbosheth said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father’s concubine?

verses.english:
Now Saul had a concubine named Rizpah, daughter of Aiah; and
[Ish-bosheth] said to Abner, “Why have you lain with my father’s
concubine?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּחַר לְאַבְנֵר מְאֹד עַל־דִּבְרֵי אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת וַיֹּאמֶר הֲרֹאשׁ כֶּלֶב אָנֹכִי אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה הַיּוֹם אֶעֱשֶׂה־חֶסֶד עִם־בֵּית שָׁאוּל אָבִיךָ אֶל־אֶחָיו וְאֶל־מֵרֵעֵהוּ
וְלֹא הִמְצִיתִךָ בְּיַד־דָּוִד וַתִּפְקֹד עָלַי עֲוֺן הָאִשָּׁה הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּחַר לְאַבְנֵר מְאֹד עַל־דִּבְרֵי אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת וַיֹּאמֶר הֲרֹאשׁ כֶּלֶב אָנֹכִי אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה הַיּוֹם אֶעֱשֶׂה־חֶסֶד עִם־בֵּית שָׁאוּל אָבִיךָ אֶל־אֶחָיו וְאֶל־מֵרֵעֵהוּ
וְלֹא הִמְצִיתִךָ בְּיַד־דָּוִד וַתִּפְקֹד עָלַי עֲוֺן הָאִשָּׁה הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
Abner was very upset by what Ish-bosheth said, and he replied, “Am
I a dog’s head from Judah? Here I have been loyally serving the
House of your father Saul and his kinsfolk and friends, and I have
not betrayed you into the hands of David; yet this day you
reproach me over a woman!

translation.text: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ishbosheth, and said, Am I a dog’s head, which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered thee into the hand of David, that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?

verses.english:
Abner was very upset by what Ish-bosheth said, and he replied, “Am
I a dog’s head from Judah? Here I have been loyally serving the
House of your father Saul and his kinsfolk and friends, and I have
not betrayed you into the hands of David; yet this day you
reproach me over a woman!

verses.hebrew: כֹּה־יַעֲשֶׂה אֱלֹהִים לְאַבְנֵר וְכֹה יֹסִיף לוֹ כִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לְדָוִד כִּי־כֵן אֶעֱשֶׂה־לּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כֹּה־יַעֲשֶׂה אֱלֹהִים לְאַבְנֵר וְכֹה יֹסִיף לוֹ כִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהֹוָה לְדָוִד כִּי־כֵן אֶעֱשֶׂה־לּוֹ׃

english.text:
May God do thus and more to Abner if I do not do for David as YHWH
swore to him—

translation.text: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the LORD hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;

verses.english:
May God do thus and more to Abner if I do not do for David as YHWH
swore to him—

verses.hebrew: לְהַעֲבִיר הַמַּמְלָכָה מִבֵּית שָׁאוּל וּלְהָקִים אֶת־כִּסֵּא דָוִד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל־יְהוּדָה מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃

hebrew.text: לְהַעֲבִיר הַמַּמְלָכָה מִבֵּית שָׁאוּל וּלְהָקִים אֶת־כִּסֵּא דָוִד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל־יְהוּדָה מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃

english.text:
to transfer the kingship from the House of Saul, and to establish
the throne of David over Israel and Judah from Dan to Beer-sheba.”

translation.text: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.

verses.english:
to transfer the kingship from the House of Saul, and to establish
the throne of David over Israel and Judah from Dan to Beer-sheba.”

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יָכֹל עוֹד לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־אַבְנֵר דָּבָר מִיִּרְאָתוֹ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־יָכֹל עוֹד לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־אַבְנֵר דָּבָר מִיִּרְאָתוֹ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
[Ish-bosheth] could say nothing more in reply to Abner, because he
was afraid of him.

translation.text: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.

verses.english:
[Ish-bosheth] could say nothing more in reply to Abner, because he
was afraid of him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְנֵר מַלְאָכִים אֶל־דָּוִד תַּחְתָּו לֵאמֹר לְמִי־אָרֶץ לֵאמֹר כּרְתָה בְרִיתְךָ אִתִּי וְהִנֵּה יָדִי עִמָּךְ לְהָסֵב אֵלֶיךָ אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְנֵר מַלְאָכִים אֶל־דָּוִד תַּחְתָּו לֵאמֹר לְמִי־אָרֶץ לֵאמֹר כּרְתָה בְרִיתְךָ אִתִּי וְהִנֵּה יָדִי עִמָּךְ לְהָסֵב אֵלֶיךָ אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Abner immediately sent messengers to David, saying, “To whom shall
the land belong?” and to say [further], “Make a pact with me, and
I will help you and bring all Israel over to your side.”

translation.text: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose is the land? saying also, Make thy league with me, and, behold, my hand shall be with thee, to bring about all Israel unto thee.

verses.english:
Abner immediately sent messengers to David, saying, “To whom shall
the land belong?” and to say [further], “Make a pact with me, and
I will help you and bring all Israel over to your side.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר טוֹב אֲנִי אֶכְרֹת אִתְּךָ בְּרִית אַךְ דָּבָר אֶחָד אָנֹכִי שֹׁאֵל מֵאִתְּךָ לֵאמֹר לֹא־תִרְאֶה אֶת־פָּנַי כִּי אִם־לִפְנֵי הֱבִיאֲךָ אֵת מִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל בְּבֹאֲךָ
לִרְאוֹת אֶת־פָּנָי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר טוֹב אֲנִי אֶכְרֹת אִתְּךָ בְּרִית אַךְ דָּבָר אֶחָד אָנֹכִי שֹׁאֵל מֵאִתְּךָ לֵאמֹר לֹא־תִרְאֶה אֶת־פָּנַי כִּי אִם־לִפְנֵי הֱבִיאֲךָ אֵת מִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל בְּבֹאֲךָ
לִרְאוֹת אֶת־פָּנָי׃

english.text:
He replied, “Good; I will make a pact with you. But I make one
demand upon you: Do not appear before me unless you bring Michal
daughter of Saul when you come before me.”

translation.text: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Saul’s daughter, when thou comest to see my face.

verses.english:
He replied, “Good; I will make a pact with you. But I make one
demand upon you: Do not appear before me unless you bring Michal
daughter of Saul when you come before me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד מַלְאָכִים אֶל־אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר תְּנָה אֶת־אִשְׁתִּי אֶת־מִיכַל אֲשֶׁר אֵרַשְׂתִּי לִי בְּמֵאָה ערְלוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד מַלְאָכִים אֶל־אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר תְּנָה אֶת־אִשְׁתִּי אֶת־מִיכַל אֲשֶׁר אֵרַשְׂתִּי לִי בְּמֵאָה ערְלוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
David also sent messengers to Ish-bosheth son of Saul, to say,
“Give me my wife Michal, for whom I paid the bride-price of one
hundred Philistine foreskins.”

translation.text: And David sent messengers to Ishbosheth Saul’s son, saying, Deliver me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.

verses.english:
David also sent messengers to Ish-bosheth son of Saul, to say,
“Give me my wife Michal, for whom I paid the bride-price of one
hundred Philistine foreskins.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת וַיִּקָּחֶהָ מֵעִם אִישׁ מֵעִם פַּלְטִיאֵל בֶּן־[לָיִשׁ] (לוש)׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת וַיִּקָּחֶהָ מֵעִם אִישׁ מֵעִם פַּלְטִיאֵל בֶּן־[לָיִשׁ] (לוש)׃

english.text:
So Ish-bosheth sent and had her taken away from [her] husband,
Paltiel son of Laish.

translation.text: And Ishbosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.

verses.english:
So Ish-bosheth sent and had her taken away from [her] husband,
Paltiel son of Laish.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אִתָּהּ אִישָׁהּ הָלוֹךְ וּבָכֹה אַחֲרֶיהָ עַד־בַּחֻרִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְנֵר לֵךְ שׁוּב וַיָּשֹׁב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ אִתָּהּ אִישָׁהּ הָלוֹךְ וּבָכֹה אַחֲרֶיהָ עַד־בַּחֻרִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְנֵר לֵךְ שׁוּב וַיָּשֹׁב׃

english.text:
Her husband walked with her as far as Bahurim, weeping as he
followed her; then Abner ordered him to turn back, and he went
back.

translation.text: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim.

verses.english:
Her husband walked with her as far as Bahurim, weeping as he
followed her; then Abner ordered him to turn back, and he went
back.

verses.hebrew: וּדְבַר־אַבְנֵר הָיָה עִם־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר גַּם־תְּמוֹל גַּם־שִׁלְשֹׁם הֱיִיתֶם מְבַקְשִׁים אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּדְבַר־אַבְנֵר הָיָה עִם־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר גַּם־תְּמוֹל גַּם־שִׁלְשֹׁם הֱיִיתֶם מְבַקְשִׁים אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
Abner had conferred with the elders of Israel, saying, “You have
wanted David to be king over you all along.

translation.text: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you:

verses.english:
Abner had conferred with the elders of Israel, saying, “You have
wanted David to be king over you all along.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה עֲשׂוּ כִּי יְהֹוָה אָמַר אֶל־דָּוִד לֵאמֹר בְּיַד דָּוִד עַבְדִּי הוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמִיַּד כּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה עֲשׂוּ כִּי יְהֹוָה אָמַר אֶל־דָּוִד לֵאמֹר בְּיַד דָּוִד עַבְדִּי הוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמִיַּד כּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Now act! For YHWH has said concerning David: I will deliver My
people Israel from the hands of the Philistines and all its other
enemies through My servant David.”

translation.text: Now then do it: for the LORD hath spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.

verses.english:
Now act! For YHWH has said concerning David: I will deliver My
people Israel from the hands of the Philistines and all its other
enemies through My servant David.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר גַּם־אַבְנֵר בְּאזְנֵי בִנְיָמִין וַיֵּלֶךְ גַּם־אַבְנֵר לְדַבֵּר בְּאזְנֵי דָוִד בְּחֶבְרוֹן אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר־טוֹב בְּעֵינֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבְעֵינֵי כּל־בֵּית בִּנְיָמִן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר גַּם־אַבְנֵר בְּאזְנֵי בִנְיָמִין וַיֵּלֶךְ גַּם־אַבְנֵר לְדַבֵּר בְּאזְנֵי דָוִד בְּחֶבְרוֹן אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר־טוֹב בְּעֵינֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבְעֵינֵי כּל־בֵּית בִּנְיָמִן׃

english.text:
Abner also talked with the Benjaminites; then Abner went and
informed David in Hebron of all the wishes of Israel and of the
whole House of Benjamin.

translation.text: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.

verses.english:
Abner also talked with the Benjaminites; then Abner went and
informed David in Hebron of all the wishes of Israel and of the
whole House of Benjamin.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אַבְנֵר אֶל־דָּוִד חֶבְרוֹן וְאִתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים אֲנָשִׁים וַיַּעַשׂ דָּוִד לְאַבְנֵר וְלַאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ מִשְׁתֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אַבְנֵר אֶל־דָּוִד חֶבְרוֹן וְאִתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים אֲנָשִׁים וַיַּעַשׂ דָּוִד לְאַבְנֵר וְלַאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ מִשְׁתֶּה׃

english.text:
When Abner came to David in Hebron, accompanied by twenty men,
David made a feast for Abner and the men with him.

translation.text: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.

verses.english:
When Abner came to David in Hebron, accompanied by twenty men,
David made a feast for Abner and the men with him.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְנֵר אֶל־דָּוִד אָקוּמָה וְאֵלֵכָה וְאֶקְבְּצָה אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִכְרְתוּ אִתְּךָ בְּרִית וּמָלַכְתָּ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תְּאַוֶּה נַפְשֶׁךָ
וַיְשַׁלַּח דָּוִד אֶת־אַבְנֵר וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְנֵר אֶל־דָּוִד אָקוּמָה וְאֵלֵכָה וְאֶקְבְּצָה אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִכְרְתוּ אִתְּךָ בְּרִית וּמָלַכְתָּ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תְּאַוֶּה נַפְשֶׁךָ
וַיְשַׁלַּח דָּוִד אֶת־אַבְנֵר וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
Abner said to David, “Now I will go and rally all Israel to Your
