Majesty. They will make a pact with you, and you can reign over
all that your heart desires.” And David dismissed Abner, who went
away unharmed.

translation.text: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

verses.english:
Abner said to David, “Now I will go and rally all Israel to Your
Majesty. They will make a pact with you, and you can reign over
all that your heart desires.” And David dismissed Abner, who went
away unharmed.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה עַבְדֵי דָוִד וְיוֹאָב בָּא מֵהַגְּדוּד וְשָׁלָל רָב עִמָּם הֵבִיאוּ וְאַבְנֵר אֵינֶנּוּ עִם־דָּוִד בְּחֶבְרוֹן כִּי שִׁלְּחוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה עַבְדֵי דָוִד וְיוֹאָב בָּא מֵהַגְּדוּד וְשָׁלָל רָב עִמָּם הֵבִיאוּ וְאַבְנֵר אֵינֶנּוּ עִם־דָּוִד בְּחֶבְרוֹן כִּי שִׁלְּחוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
Just then David’s soldiers and Joab returned from a raid, bringing
much plunder with them; Abner was no longer with David in Hebron,
for he had been dismissed and had gone away unharmed.

translation.text: And, behold, the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.

verses.english:
Just then David’s soldiers and Joab returned from a raid, bringing
much plunder with them; Abner was no longer with David in Hebron,
for he had been dismissed and had gone away unharmed.

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב וְכל־הַצָּבָא אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ בָּאוּ וַיַּגִּדוּ לְיוֹאָב לֵאמֹר בָּא־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְשַׁלְּחֵהוּ וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹאָב וְכל־הַצָּבָא אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ בָּאוּ וַיַּגִּדוּ לְיוֹאָב לֵאמֹר בָּא־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְשַׁלְּחֵהוּ וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
When Joab and the whole force with him arrived, Joab was told that
Abner son of Ner had come to the king, had been dismissed by him,
and had gone away unharmed.

translation.text: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.

verses.english:
When Joab and the whole force with him arrived, Joab was told that
Abner son of Ner had come to the king, had been dismissed by him,
and had gone away unharmed.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יוֹאָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה עָשִׂיתָה הִנֵּה־בָא אַבְנֵר אֵלֶיךָ לָמָּה־זֶּה שִׁלַּחְתּוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יוֹאָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה עָשִׂיתָה הִנֵּה־בָא אַבְנֵר אֵלֶיךָ לָמָּה־זֶּה שִׁלַּחְתּוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ׃

english.text:
Joab went to the king and said, “What have you done? Here Abner
came to you; why did you let him go? Now he has gotten away!

translation.text: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What hast thou done? behold, Abner came unto thee; why is it that thou hast sent him away, and he is quite gone?

verses.english:
Joab went to the king and said, “What have you done? Here Abner
came to you; why did you let him go? Now he has gotten away!

verses.hebrew: יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר כִּי לְפַתֹּתְךָ בָּא וְלָדַעַת אֶת־מוֹצָאֲךָ וְאֶת־[מוֹבָאֶךָ] (מבואך) וְלָדַעַת אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר כִּי לְפַתֹּתְךָ בָּא וְלָדַעַת אֶת־מוֹצָאֲךָ וְאֶת־[מוֹבָאֶךָ] (מבואך) וְלָדַעַת אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה׃

english.text:
Don’t you know that Abner son of Ner came only to deceive you, to
learn your comings and goings and to find out all that you are
planning?”

translation.text: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all that thou doest.

verses.english:
Don’t you know that Abner son of Ner came only to deceive you, to
learn your comings and goings and to find out all that you are
planning?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא יוֹאָב מֵעִם דָּוִד וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וַיָּשִׁבוּ אֹתוֹ מִבּוֹר הַסִּרָה וְדָוִד לֹא יָדָע׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא יוֹאָב מֵעִם דָּוִד וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וַיָּשִׁבוּ אֹתוֹ מִבּוֹר הַסִּרָה וְדָוִד לֹא יָדָע׃

english.text:
Joab left David and sent messengers after Abner, and they brought
him back from the cistern of Sirah; but David knew nothing about
it.

translation.text: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew it not.

verses.english:
Joab left David and sent messengers after Abner, and they brought
him back from the cistern of Sirah; but David knew nothing about
it.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב אַבְנֵר חֶבְרוֹן וַיַּטֵּהוּ יוֹאָב אֶל־תּוֹךְ הַשַּׁעַר לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ בַּשֶּׁלִי וַיַּכֵּהוּ שָׁם הַחֹמֶשׁ וַיָּמת בְּדַם עֲשָׂהאֵל אָחִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב אַבְנֵר חֶבְרוֹן וַיַּטֵּהוּ יוֹאָב אֶל־תּוֹךְ הַשַּׁעַר לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ בַּשֶּׁלִי וַיַּכֵּהוּ שָׁם הַחֹמֶשׁ וַיָּמת בְּדַם עֲשָׂהאֵל אָחִיו׃

english.text:
When Abner returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside within the gate
to talk to him privately; there he struck him in the belly. Thus
[Abner] died for shedding the blood of Asahel, Joab’s brother.

translation.text: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth rib, that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.

verses.english:
When Abner returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside within the gate
to talk to him privately; there he struck him in the belly. Thus
[Abner] died for shedding the blood of Asahel, Joab’s brother.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד מֵאַחֲרֵי כֵן וַיֹּאמֶר נָקִי אָנֹכִי וּמַמְלַכְתִּי מֵעִם יְהֹוָה עַד־עוֹלָם מִדְּמֵי אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד מֵאַחֲרֵי כֵן וַיֹּאמֶר נָקִי אָנֹכִי וּמַמְלַכְתִּי מֵעִם יְהֹוָה עַד־עוֹלָם מִדְּמֵי אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר׃

english.text:
Afterward, when David heard of it, he said, “Both I and my kingdom
are forever innocent before YHWH of shedding the blood of Abner
son of Ner.

translation.text: And afterward when David heard it, he said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before the LORD for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:

verses.english:
Afterward, when David heard of it, he said, “Both I and my kingdom
are forever innocent before YHWH of shedding the blood of Abner
son of Ner.

verses.hebrew: יָחֻלוּ עַל־רֹאשׁ יוֹאָב וְאֶל כּל־בֵּית אָבִיו וְאַל־יִכָּרֵת מִבֵּית יוֹאָב זָב וּמְצֹרָע וּמַחֲזִיק בַּפֶּלֶךְ וְנֹפֵל בַּחֶרֶב וַחֲסַר־לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: יָחֻלוּ עַל־רֹאשׁ יוֹאָב וְאֶל כּל־בֵּית אָבִיו וְאַל־יִכָּרֵת מִבֵּית יוֹאָב זָב וּמְצֹרָע וּמַחֲזִיק בַּפֶּלֶךְ וְנֹפֵל בַּחֶרֶב וַחֲסַר־לָחֶם׃

english.text:
May [the guilt] fall upon the head of Joab and all his father’s
house. May the house of Joab never be without someone suffering
from a discharge or an eruption, or a male who handles the
spindle, or one slain by the sword, or one lacking bread.”—

translation.text: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father’s house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falleth on the sword, or that lacketh bread.

verses.english:
May [the guilt] fall upon the head of Joab and all his father’s
house. May the house of Joab never be without someone suffering
from a discharge or an eruption, or a male who handles the
spindle, or one slain by the sword, or one lacking bread.”—

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי אָחִיו הָרְגוּ לְאַבְנֵר עַל אֲשֶׁר הֵמִית אֶת־עֲשָׂהאֵל אֲחִיהֶם בְּגִבְעוֹן בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי אָחִיו הָרְגוּ לְאַבְנֵר עַל אֲשֶׁר הֵמִית אֶת־עֲשָׂהאֵל אֲחִיהֶם בְּגִבְעוֹן בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
Now Joab and his brother Abishai had killed Abner because he had
killed their brother Asahel during the battle at Gibeon.—

translation.text: So Joab, and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

verses.english:
Now Joab and his brother Abishai had killed Abner because he had
killed their brother Asahel during the battle at Gibeon.—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יוֹאָב וְאֶל־כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ קִרְעוּ בִגְדֵיכֶם וְחִגְרוּ שַׂקִּים וְסִפְדוּ לִפְנֵי אַבְנֵר וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד הֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֵי הַמִּטָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יוֹאָב וְאֶל־כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ קִרְעוּ בִגְדֵיכֶם וְחִגְרוּ שַׂקִּים וְסִפְדוּ לִפְנֵי אַבְנֵר וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד הֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֵי הַמִּטָּה׃

english.text:
David then ordered Joab and all the troops with him to rend their
clothes, gird on sackcloth, and make lament before Abner; and King
David himself walked behind the bier.

translation.text: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David himself followed the bier.

verses.english:
David then ordered Joab and all the troops with him to rend their
clothes, gird on sackcloth, and make lament before Abner; and King
David himself walked behind the bier.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֶת־אַבְנֵר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּשָּׂא הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־קוֹלוֹ וַיֵּבְךְּ אֶל־קֶבֶר אַבְנֵר וַיִּבְכּוּ כּל־הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֶת־אַבְנֵר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּשָּׂא הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־קוֹלוֹ וַיֵּבְךְּ אֶל־קֶבֶר אַבְנֵר וַיִּבְכּוּ כּל־הָעָם׃

english.text:
And so they buried Abner at Hebron; the king wept aloud by Abner’s
grave, and all the troops wept.

translation.text: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.

verses.english:
And so they buried Abner at Hebron; the king wept aloud by Abner’s
grave, and all the troops wept.

verses.hebrew: וַיְקֹנֵן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אַבְנֵר וַיֹּאמַר הַכְּמוֹת נָבָל יָמוּת אַבְנֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְקֹנֵן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אַבְנֵר וַיֹּאמַר הַכְּמוֹת נָבָל יָמוּת אַבְנֵר׃

english.text:
And the king intoned this dirge over Abner, “Should Abner have
died the death of a churl?

translation.text: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?

verses.english:
And the king intoned this dirge over Abner, “Should Abner have
died the death of a churl?

verses.hebrew: יָדֶךָ לֹא־אֲסֻרוֹת וְרַגְלֶיךָ לֹא־לִנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם הֻגָּשׁוּ כִּנְפוֹל לִפְנֵי בְנֵי־עַוְלָה נָפָלְתָּ וַיֹּסִפוּ כל־הָעָם לִבְכּוֹת עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: יָדֶךָ לֹא־אֲסֻרוֹת וְרַגְלֶיךָ לֹא־לִנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם הֻגָּשׁוּ כִּנְפוֹל לִפְנֵי בְנֵי־עַוְלָה נָפָלְתָּ וַיֹּסִפוּ כל־הָעָם לִבְכּוֹת עָלָיו׃

english.text:
Your hands were not bound, Your feet were not put in fetters; But
you fell as one falls Before treacherous men!” And all the troops
continued to weep over him.

translation.text: Thy hands were not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men, so fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him.

verses.english:
Your hands were not bound, Your feet were not put in fetters; But
you fell as one falls Before treacherous men!” And all the troops
continued to weep over him.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא כל־הָעָם לְהַבְרוֹת אֶת־דָּוִד לֶחֶם בְּעוֹד הַיּוֹם וַיִּשָּׁבַע דָּוִד לֵאמֹר כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יֹסִיף כִּי אִם־לִפְנֵי בוֹא־הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אֶטְעַם־לֶחֶם אוֹ
כל־מְאוּמָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא כל־הָעָם לְהַבְרוֹת אֶת־דָּוִד לֶחֶם בְּעוֹד הַיּוֹם וַיִּשָּׁבַע דָּוִד לֵאמֹר כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יֹסִיף כִּי אִם־לִפְנֵי בוֹא־הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אֶטְעַם־לֶחֶם אוֹ
כל־מְאוּמָה׃

english.text:
All the troops came to urge David to eat something while it was
still day; but David swore, “May God do thus to me and more if I
eat bread or anything else before sundown.”

translation.text: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.

verses.english:
All the troops came to urge David to eat something while it was
still day; but David swore, “May God do thus to me and more if I
eat bread or anything else before sundown.”

verses.hebrew: וְכל־הָעָם הִכִּירוּ וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵיהֶם כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּעֵינֵי כל־הָעָם טוֹב׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־הָעָם הִכִּירוּ וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵיהֶם כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּעֵינֵי כל־הָעָם טוֹב׃

english.text:
All the troops took note of it and approved, just as all the
troops approved everything else the king did.

translation.text: And all the people took notice of it, and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.

verses.english:
All the troops took note of it and approved, just as all the
troops approved everything else the king did.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּדְעוּ כל־הָעָם וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי לֹא הָיְתָה מֵהַמֶּלֶךְ לְהָמִית אֶת־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּדְעוּ כל־הָעָם וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי לֹא הָיְתָה מֵהַמֶּלֶךְ לְהָמִית אֶת־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר׃

english.text:
That day all the troops and all Israel knew that it was not by the
king’s will that Abner son of Ner was killed.

translation.text: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.

verses.english:
That day all the troops and all Israel knew that it was not by the
king’s will that Abner son of Ner was killed.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הֲלוֹא תֵדְעוּ כִּי־שַׂר וְגָדוֹל נָפַל הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הֲלוֹא תֵדְעוּ כִּי־שַׂר וְגָדוֹל נָפַל הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And the king said to his soldiers, “You well know that a prince, a
great man in Israel, has fallen this day.

translation.text: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?

verses.english:
And the king said to his soldiers, “You well know that a prince, a
great man in Israel, has fallen this day.

verses.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם רַךְ וּמָשׁוּחַ מֶלֶךְ וְהָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי צְרוּיָה קָשִׁים מִמֶּנִּי יְשַׁלֵּם יְהֹוָה לְעֹשֵׂה הָרָעָה כְּרָעָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם רַךְ וּמָשׁוּחַ מֶלֶךְ וְהָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי צְרוּיָה קָשִׁים מִמֶּנִּי יְשַׁלֵּם יְהֹוָה לְעֹשֵׂה הָרָעָה כְּרָעָתוֹ׃

english.text:
And today I am weak, even though anointed king; those men, the
sons of Zeruiah, are too savage for me. May YHWH requite the
wicked for their wickedness!”

translation.text: And I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me: the LORD shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness.

verses.english:
And today I am weak, even though anointed king; those men, the
sons of Zeruiah, are too savage for me. May YHWH requite the
wicked for their wickedness!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע בֶּן־שָׁאוּל כִּי מֵת אַבְנֵר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּרְפּוּ יָדָיו וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל נִבְהָלוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע בֶּן־שָׁאוּל כִּי מֵת אַבְנֵר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּרְפּוּ יָדָיו וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל נִבְהָלוּ׃

english.text:
When [Ish-bosheth] son of Saul heard that Abner had died in
Hebron, he lost heart and all Israel was alarmed.

translation.text: And when Saul’s son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

verses.english:
When [Ish-bosheth] son of Saul heard that Abner had died in
Hebron, he lost heart and all Israel was alarmed.

verses.hebrew:
וּשְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים שָׂרֵי־גְדוּדִים הָיוּ בֶן־שָׁאוּל שֵׁם הָאֶחָד בַּעֲנָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִי רֵכָב בְּנֵי רִמּוֹן הַבְּאֵרֹתִי מִבְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן כִּי גַּם־בְּאֵרוֹת תֵּחָשֵׁב
עַל־בִּנְיָמִן׃

hebrew.text:
וּשְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים שָׂרֵי־גְדוּדִים הָיוּ בֶן־שָׁאוּל שֵׁם הָאֶחָד בַּעֲנָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִי רֵכָב בְּנֵי רִמּוֹן הַבְּאֵרֹתִי מִבְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן כִּי גַּם־בְּאֵרוֹת תֵּחָשֵׁב
עַל־בִּנְיָמִן׃

english.text:
The son of Saul [had] two company commanders, one named Baanah and
the other Rechab, sons of Rimmon the Beerothite—Benjaminites,
since Beeroth too was considered part of Benjamin.

translation.text: And Saul’s son had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin.

verses.english:
The son of Saul [had] two company commanders, one named Baanah and
the other Rechab, sons of Rimmon the Beerothite—Benjaminites,
since Beeroth too was considered part of Benjamin.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְרְחוּ הַבְּאֵרֹתִים גִּתָּיְמָה וַיִּהְיוּ־שָׁם גָּרִים עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְרְחוּ הַבְּאֵרֹתִים גִּתָּיְמָה וַיִּהְיוּ־שָׁם גָּרִים עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The Beerothites had fled to Gittaim, where they have sojourned to
this day.

translation.text: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until this day.)

verses.english:
The Beerothites had fled to Gittaim, where they have sojourned to
this day.

verses.hebrew:
וְלִיהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל בֵּן נְכֵה רַגְלָיִם בֶּן־חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים הָיָה בְּבֹא שְׁמֻעַת שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן מִיִּזְרְעֶאל וַתִּשָּׂאֵהוּ אֹמַנְתּוֹ וַתָּנֹס וַיְהִי בְּחפְזָהּ
לָנוּס וַיִּפֹּל וַיִּפָּסֵחַ וּשְׁמוֹ מְפִיבֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text:
וְלִיהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל בֵּן נְכֵה רַגְלָיִם בֶּן־חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים הָיָה בְּבֹא שְׁמֻעַת שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן מִיִּזְרְעֶאל וַתִּשָּׂאֵהוּ אֹמַנְתּוֹ וַתָּנֹס וַיְהִי בְּחפְזָהּ
לָנוּס וַיִּפֹּל וַיִּפָּסֵחַ וּשְׁמוֹ מְפִיבֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
(Jonathan son of Saul had a son whose feet were crippled. He was
five years old when the news about Saul and Jonathan came from
Jezreel, and his nurse picked him up and fled; but as she was
fleeing in haste, he fell and was lamed. His name was
Mephibosheth.)

translation.text: And Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son that was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel, and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name was Mephibosheth.

verses.english:
(Jonathan son of Saul had a son whose feet were crippled. He was
five years old when the news about Saul and Jonathan came from
Jezreel, and his nurse picked him up and fled; but as she was
fleeing in haste, he fell and was lamed. His name was
Mephibosheth.)

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי־רִמּוֹן הַבְּאֵרֹתִי רֵכָב וּבַעֲנָה וַיָּבֹאוּ כְּחֹם הַיּוֹם אֶל־בֵּית אִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת וְהוּא שֹׁכֵב אֵת מִשְׁכַּב הַצּהֳרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי־רִמּוֹן הַבְּאֵרֹתִי רֵכָב וּבַעֲנָה וַיָּבֹאוּ כְּחֹם הַיּוֹם אֶל־בֵּית אִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת וְהוּא שֹׁכֵב אֵת מִשְׁכַּב הַצּהֳרָיִם׃

english.text:
Rechab and Baanah, sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, started out, and
they reached the home of Ish-bosheth at the heat of the day, when
he was taking his midday rest.

translation.text: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.

verses.english:
Rechab and Baanah, sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, started out, and
they reached the home of Ish-bosheth at the heat of the day, when
he was taking his midday rest.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵנָּה בָּאוּ עַד־תּוֹךְ הַבַּיִת לֹקְחֵי חִטִּים וַיַּכֻּהוּ אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ וְרֵכָב וּבַעֲנָה אָחִיו נִמְלָטוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵנָּה בָּאוּ עַד־תּוֹךְ הַבַּיִת לֹקְחֵי חִטִּים וַיַּכֻּהוּ אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ וְרֵכָב וּבַעֲנָה אָחִיו נִמְלָטוּ׃

english.text:
So they went inside the house, as though fetching wheat, and
struck him in the belly. Rechab and his brother Baanah slipped by,

translation.text: And they came thither into the midst of the house, as though they would have fetched wheat; and they smote him under the fifth rib: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

verses.english:
So they went inside the house, as though fetching wheat, and
struck him in the belly. Rechab and his brother Baanah slipped by,

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹאוּ הַבַּיִת וְהוּא־שֹׁכֵב עַל־מִטָּתוֹ בַּחֲדַר מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וַיַּכֻּהוּ וַיְמִתֻהוּ וַיָּסִירוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיֵּלְכוּ דֶּרֶךְ הָעֲרָבָה
כּל־הַלָּיְלָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹאוּ הַבַּיִת וְהוּא־שֹׁכֵב עַל־מִטָּתוֹ בַּחֲדַר מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וַיַּכֻּהוּ וַיְמִתֻהוּ וַיָּסִירוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיֵּלְכוּ דֶּרֶךְ הָעֲרָבָה
כּל־הַלָּיְלָה׃

english.text:
and entered the house while he was asleep on his bed in his
bedchamber; and they stabbed him to death. They cut off his head
and took his head and made their way all night through the Arabah.

translation.text: For when they came into the house, he lay on his bed in his bedchamber, and they smote him, and slew him, and beheaded him, and took his head, and gat them away through the plain all night.

verses.english:
and entered the house while he was asleep on his bed in his
bedchamber; and they stabbed him to death. They cut off his head
and took his head and made their way all night through the Arabah.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבִאוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת אֶל־דָּוִד חֶבְרוֹן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה־רֹאשׁ אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל אֹיִבְךָ אֲשֶׁר בִּקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה
לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ נְקָמוֹת הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה מִשָּׁאוּל וּמִזַּרְעוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבִאוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת אֶל־דָּוִד חֶבְרוֹן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה־רֹאשׁ אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל אֹיִבְךָ אֲשֶׁר בִּקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה
לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ נְקָמוֹת הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה מִשָּׁאוּל וּמִזַּרְעוֹ׃

english.text:
They brought the head of Ish-bosheth to David in Hebron. “Here,”
they said to the king, “is the head of your enemy, Ish-bosheth son
of Saul, who sought your life. This day YHWH has avenged my lord
the king upon Saul and his offspring.”

translation.text: And they brought the head of Ishbosheth unto David to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold the head of Ishbosheth the son of Saul thine enemy, which sought thy life; and the LORD hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed.

verses.english:
They brought the head of Ish-bosheth to David in Hebron. “Here,”
they said to the king, “is the head of your enemy, Ish-bosheth son
of Saul, who sought your life. This day YHWH has avenged my lord
the king upon Saul and his offspring.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן דָּוִד אֶת־רֵכָב וְאֶת־בַּעֲנָה אָחִיו בְּנֵי רִמּוֹן הַבְּאֵרֹתִי וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם חַי־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־פָּדָה אֶת־נַפְשִׁי מִכּל־צָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן דָּוִד אֶת־רֵכָב וְאֶת־בַּעֲנָה אָחִיו בְּנֵי רִמּוֹן הַבְּאֵרֹתִי וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם חַי־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־פָּדָה אֶת־נַפְשִׁי מִכּל־צָרָה׃

english.text:
But David answered Rechab and his brother Baanah, the sons of
Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, “As YHWH lives, who has
rescued me from every trouble:

translation.text: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, As the LORD liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

verses.english:
But David answered Rechab and his brother Baanah, the sons of
Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, “As YHWH lives, who has
rescued me from every trouble:

verses.hebrew: כִּי הַמַּגִּיד לִי לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה־מֵת שָׁאוּל וְהוּא־הָיָה כִמְבַשֵּׂר בְּעֵינָיו וָאֹחֲזָה בוֹ וָאֶהְרְגֵהוּ בְּצִקְלָג אֲשֶׁר לְתִתִּי־לוֹ בְּשֹׂרָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הַמַּגִּיד לִי לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה־מֵת שָׁאוּל וְהוּא־הָיָה כִמְבַשֵּׂר בְּעֵינָיו וָאֹחֲזָה בוֹ וָאֶהְרְגֵהוּ בְּצִקְלָג אֲשֶׁר לְתִתִּי־לוֹ בְּשֹׂרָה׃

english.text:
The man who told me in Ziklag that Saul was dead thought he was
bringing good news. But instead of rewarding him for the news, I
seized and killed him.

translation.text: When one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings:

verses.english:
The man who told me in Ziklag that Saul was dead thought he was
bringing good news. But instead of rewarding him for the news, I
seized and killed him.

verses.hebrew: אַף כִּי־אֲנָשִׁים רְשָׁעִים הָרְגוּ אֶת־אִישׁ־צַדִּיק בְּבֵיתוֹ עַל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וְעַתָּה הֲלוֹא אֲבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־דָּמוֹ מִיֶּדְכֶם וּבִעַרְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: אַף כִּי־אֲנָשִׁים רְשָׁעִים הָרְגוּ אֶת־אִישׁ־צַדִּיק בְּבֵיתוֹ עַל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וְעַתָּה הֲלוֹא אֲבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־דָּמוֹ מִיֶּדְכֶם וּבִעַרְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
How much more, then, when wicked men have killed a blameless man
in bed in his own house! I will certainly avenge his blood on you,
and I will rid the earth of you.”

translation.text: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?

verses.english:
How much more, then, when wicked men have killed a blameless man
in bed in his own house! I will certainly avenge his blood on you,
and I will rid the earth of you.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְצַו דָּוִד אֶת־הַנְּעָרִים וַיַּהַרְגוּם וַיְקַצְּצוּ אֶת־יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶם וַיִּתְלוּ עַל־הַבְּרֵכָה בְּחֶבְרוֹן וְאֵת רֹאשׁ אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת לָקָחוּ וַיִּקְבְּרוּ
בְקֶבֶר־אַבְנֵר בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְצַו דָּוִד אֶת־הַנְּעָרִים וַיַּהַרְגוּם וַיְקַצְּצוּ אֶת־יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶם וַיִּתְלוּ עַל־הַבְּרֵכָה בְּחֶבְרוֹן וְאֵת רֹאשׁ אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת לָקָחוּ וַיִּקְבְּרוּ
בְקֶבֶר־אַבְנֵר בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

english.text:
David gave orders to the young men, who killed them; they cut off
their hands and feet and hung them up by the pool in Hebron. And
they took the head of Ish-bosheth and buried it in the grave of
Abner at Hebron.

translation.text: And David commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth, and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron.

verses.english:
David gave orders to the young men, who killed them; they cut off
their hands and feet and hung them up by the pool in Hebron. And
they took the head of Ish-bosheth and buried it in the grave of
Abner at Hebron.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־דָּוִד חֶבְרוֹנָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֵאמֹר הִנְנוּ עַצְמְךָ וּבְשָׂרְךָ אֲנָחְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־דָּוִד חֶבְרוֹנָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֵאמֹר הִנְנוּ עַצְמְךָ וּבְשָׂרְךָ אֲנָחְנוּ׃

english.text:
All the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said, “We are
your own flesh and blood.

translation.text: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.

verses.english:
All the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said, “We are
your own flesh and blood.

verses.hebrew:
גַּם־אֶתְמוֹל גַּם־שִׁלְשׁוֹם בִּהְיוֹת שָׁאוּל מֶלֶךְ עָלֵינוּ אַתָּה (הייתה מוציא) [הָיִיתָ הַמּוֹצִיא] וְהַמֵּבִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לְךָ אַתָּה תִרְעֶה אֶת־עַמִּי
אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאַתָּה תִּהְיֶה לְנָגִיד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
גַּם־אֶתְמוֹל גַּם־שִׁלְשׁוֹם בִּהְיוֹת שָׁאוּל מֶלֶךְ עָלֵינוּ אַתָּה (הייתה מוציא) [הָיִיתָ הַמּוֹצִיא] וְהַמֵּבִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לְךָ אַתָּה תִרְעֶה אֶת־עַמִּי
אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאַתָּה תִּהְיֶה לְנָגִיד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Long before now, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led
Israel in war; and YHWH said to you: You shall shepherd My people
Israel; you shall be ruler of Israel.”

translation.text: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.

verses.english:
Long before now, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led
Israel in war; and YHWH said to you: You shall shepherd My people
Israel; you shall be ruler of Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ חֶבְרוֹנָה וַיִּכְרֹת לָהֶם הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד בְּרִית בְּחֶבְרוֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ חֶבְרוֹנָה וַיִּכְרֹת לָהֶם הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד בְּרִית בְּחֶבְרוֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
All the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and King
David made a pact with them in Hebron before YHWH. And they
anointed David king over Israel.

translation.text: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD: and they anointed David king over Israel.

verses.english:
All the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and King
David made a pact with them in Hebron before YHWH. And they
anointed David king over Israel.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה דָּוִד בְּמלְכוֹ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה מָלָךְ׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה דָּוִד בְּמלְכוֹ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה מָלָךְ׃

english.text:
David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned
forty years.

translation.text: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

verses.english:
David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned
forty years.

verses.hebrew: בְּחֶבְרוֹן מָלַךְ עַל־יְהוּדָה שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים וּבִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם מָלַךְ שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה עַל כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: בְּחֶבְרוֹן מָלַךְ עַל־יְהוּדָה שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים וּבִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם מָלַךְ שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה עַל כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה׃

english.text:
In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in
Jerusalem he reigned over all Israel and Judah thirty-three years.

translation.text: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.

verses.english:
In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in
Jerusalem he reigned over all Israel and Judah thirty-three years.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאֲנָשָׁיו יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֶל־הַיְבֻסִי יוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאמֶר לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר לֹא־תָבוֹא הֵנָּה כִּי אִם־הֱסִירְךָ הַעִוְרִים וְהַפִּסְחִים לֵאמֹר לֹא־יָבוֹא
דָוִד הֵנָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאֲנָשָׁיו יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֶל־הַיְבֻסִי יוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאמֶר לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר לֹא־תָבוֹא הֵנָּה כִּי אִם־הֱסִירְךָ הַעִוְרִים וְהַפִּסְחִים לֵאמֹר לֹא־יָבוֹא
דָוִד הֵנָּה׃

english.text:
The king and his men set out for Jerusalem against the Jebusites
who inhabited the region. David was told, “You will never get in
here! Even the blind and the lame will turn you back.” (They
meant: David will never enter here.)

translation.text: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.

verses.english:
The king and his men set out for Jerusalem against the Jebusites
who inhabited the region. David was told, “You will never get in
here! Even the blind and the lame will turn you back.” (They
meant: David will never enter here.)

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכֹּד דָּוִד אֵת מְצֻדַת צִיּוֹן הִיא עִיר דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְכֹּד דָּוִד אֵת מְצֻדַת צִיּוֹן הִיא עִיר דָּוִד׃

english.text:
But David captured the stronghold of Zion; it is now the City of
David.

translation.text: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.

verses.english:
But David captured the stronghold of Zion; it is now the City of
David.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כּל־מַכֵּה יְבֻסִי וְיִגַּע בַּצִּנּוֹר וְאֶת־הַפִּסְחִים וְאֶת־הַעִוְרִים (שנאו) [שְׂנוּאֵי] נֶפֶשׁ דָּוִד עַל־כֵּן יֹאמְרוּ עִוֵּר וּפִסֵּחַ לֹא
יָבוֹא אֶל־הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כּל־מַכֵּה יְבֻסִי וְיִגַּע בַּצִּנּוֹר וְאֶת־הַפִּסְחִים וְאֶת־הַעִוְרִים (שנאו) [שְׂנוּאֵי] נֶפֶשׁ דָּוִד עַל־כֵּן יֹאמְרוּ עִוֵּר וּפִסֵּחַ לֹא
יָבוֹא אֶל־הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
On that occasion David said, “Those who attack the Jebusites shall
reach the water channel and [strike down] the lame and the blind,
who are hateful to David.” That is why they say: “No one who is
blind or lame may enter the House.”

translation.text: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind that are hated of David’s soul, he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.

verses.english:
On that occasion David said, “Those who attack the Jebusites shall
reach the water channel and [strike down] the lame and the blind,
who are hateful to David.” That is why they say: “No one who is
blind or lame may enter the House.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד בַּמְּצֻדָה וַיִּקְרָא־לָהּ עִיר דָּוִד וַיִּבֶן דָּוִד סָבִיב מִן־הַמִּלּוֹא וָבָיְתָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד בַּמְּצֻדָה וַיִּקְרָא־לָהּ עִיר דָּוִד וַיִּבֶן דָּוִד סָבִיב מִן־הַמִּלּוֹא וָבָיְתָה׃

english.text:
David occupied the stronghold and renamed it the City of David;
David also fortified the surrounding area, from the Millo inward.

translation.text: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.

verses.english:
David occupied the stronghold and renamed it the City of David;
David also fortified the surrounding area, from the Millo inward.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד הָלוֹךְ וְגָדוֹל וַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד הָלוֹךְ וְגָדוֹל וַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
David kept growing stronger, for YHWH, the God of Hosts, was with
him.

translation.text: And David went on, and grew great, and the LORD God of hosts was with him.

verses.english:
David kept growing stronger, for YHWH, the God of Hosts, was with
him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם מֶלֶךְ־צֹר מַלְאָכִים אֶל־דָּוִד וַעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וְחָרָשֵׁי עֵץ וְחָרָשֵׁי אֶבֶן קִיר וַיִּבְנוּ־בַיִת לְדָוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם מֶלֶךְ־צֹר מַלְאָכִים אֶל־דָּוִד וַעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וְחָרָשֵׁי עֵץ וְחָרָשֵׁי אֶבֶן קִיר וַיִּבְנוּ־בַיִת לְדָוִד׃

english.text:
King Hiram of Tyre sent envoys to David with cedar logs,
carpenters, and stonemasons; and they built a palace for David.

translation.text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.

verses.english:
King Hiram of Tyre sent envoys to David with cedar logs,
carpenters, and stonemasons; and they built a palace for David.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּדַע דָּוִד כִּי־הֱכִינוֹ יְהֹוָה לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִי נִשֵּׂא מַמְלַכְתּוֹ בַּעֲבוּר עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּדַע דָּוִד כִּי־הֱכִינוֹ יְהֹוָה לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִי נִשֵּׂא מַמְלַכְתּוֹ בַּעֲבוּר עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Thus David knew that YHWH had established him as king over Israel
and had exalted his kingship for the sake of His people Israel.

translation.text: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.

verses.english:
Thus David knew that YHWH had established him as king over Israel
and had exalted his kingship for the sake of His people Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד עוֹד פִּלַגְשִׁים וְנָשִׁים מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אַחֲרֵי בֹּאוֹ מֵחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּוָּלְדוּ עוֹד לְדָוִד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד עוֹד פִּלַגְשִׁים וְנָשִׁים מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אַחֲרֵי בֹּאוֹ מֵחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּוָּלְדוּ עוֹד לְדָוִד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃

english.text:
After he left Hebron, David took more concubines and wives in
Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to David.

translation.text: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.

verses.english:
After he left Hebron, David took more concubines and wives in
Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to David.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הַיִּלֹּדִים לוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם שַׁמּוּעַ וְשׁוֹבָב וְנָתָן וּשְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הַיִּלֹּדִים לוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם שַׁמּוּעַ וְשׁוֹבָב וְנָתָן וּשְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem:
Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon;

translation.text: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammuah, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,

verses.english:
These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem:
Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon;

verses.hebrew: וְיִבְחָר וֶאֱלִישׁוּעַ וְנֶפֶג וְיָפִיעַ׃

hebrew.text: וְיִבְחָר וֶאֱלִישׁוּעַ וְנֶפֶג וְיָפִיעַ׃

english.text: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, and Japhia;

translation.text: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

verses.english: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, and Japhia;

verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִישָׁמָע וְאֶלְיָדָע וֶאֱלִיפָלֶט׃

hebrew.text: וֶאֱלִישָׁמָע וְאֶלְיָדָע וֶאֱלִיפָלֶט׃

english.text: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

translation.text: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.

verses.english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים כִּי־מָשְׁחוּ אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲלוּ כל־פְּלִשְׁתִּים לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־דָּוִד וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד וַיֵּרֶד אֶל־הַמְּצוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים כִּי־מָשְׁחוּ אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲלוּ כל־פְּלִשְׁתִּים לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־דָּוִד וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד וַיֵּרֶד אֶל־הַמְּצוּדָה׃

english.text:
When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over
Israel, the Philistines marched up in search of David; but David
heard of it, and he went down to the fastness.

translation.text: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went down to the hold.

verses.english:
When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over
Israel, the Philistines marched up in search of David; but David
heard of it, and he went down to the fastness.

verses.hebrew: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים בָּאוּ וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים׃

hebrew.text: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים בָּאוּ וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים׃

english.text: The Philistines came and spread out over the Valley of Rephaim.

translation.text: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.english: The Philistines came and spread out over the Valley of Rephaim.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַאֶעֱלֶה אֶל־פְּלִשְׁתִּים הֲתִתְּנֵם בְּיָדִיוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד עֲלֵה כִּי־נָתֹן אֶתֵּן אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים בְּיָדֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַאֶעֱלֶה אֶל־פְּלִשְׁתִּים הֲתִתְּנֵם בְּיָדִיוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד עֲלֵה כִּי־נָתֹן אֶתֵּן אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים בְּיָדֶךָ׃

english.text:
David inquired of YHWH, “Shall I go up against the Philistines?
Will You deliver them into my hands?” And YHWH answered David, “Go
up, and I will deliver the Philistines into your hands.”

translation.text: And David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.

verses.english:
David inquired of YHWH, “Shall I go up against the Philistines?
Will You deliver them into my hands?” And YHWH answered David, “Go
up, and I will deliver the Philistines into your hands.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד בְּבַעַל־פְּרָצִים וַיַּכֵּם שָׁם דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר פָּרַץ יְהֹוָה אֶת־אֹיְבַי לְפָנַי כְּפֶרֶץ מָיִם עַל־כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם־הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בַּעַל פְּרָצִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד בְּבַעַל־פְּרָצִים וַיַּכֵּם שָׁם דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר פָּרַץ יְהֹוָה אֶת־אֹיְבַי לְפָנַי כְּפֶרֶץ מָיִם עַל־כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם־הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בַּעַל פְּרָצִים׃

english.text:
Thereupon David marched to Baal-perazim, and David defeated them
there. And he said, “YHWH has broken through my enemies before me
as waters break through [a dam].” That is why that place was named
Baal-perazim.

translation.text: And David came to Baalperazim, and David smote them there, and said, The LORD hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baalperazim.

verses.english:
Thereupon David marched to Baal-perazim, and David defeated them
there. And he said, “YHWH has broken through my enemies before me
as waters break through [a dam].” That is why that place was named
Baal-perazim.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַזְבוּ שָׁם אֶת־עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וַיִּשָּׂאֵם דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַזְבוּ שָׁם אֶת־עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וַיִּשָּׂאֵם דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו׃

english.text:
The Philistines abandoned their idols there, and David and his men
carried them off.

translation.text: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.

verses.english:
The Philistines abandoned their idols there, and David and his men
carried them off.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסִפוּ עוֹד פְּלִשְׁתִּים לַעֲלוֹת וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסִפוּ עוֹד פְּלִשְׁתִּים לַעֲלוֹת וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים׃

english.text:
Once again the Philistines marched up and spread out over the
Valley of Rephaim.

translation.text: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.english:
Once again the Philistines marched up and spread out over the
Valley of Rephaim.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תַעֲלֶה הָסֵב אֶל־אַחֲרֵיהֶם וּבָאתָ לָהֶם מִמּוּל בְּכָאִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תַעֲלֶה הָסֵב אֶל־אַחֲרֵיהֶם וּבָאתָ לָהֶם מִמּוּל בְּכָאִים׃

english.text:
David inquired of YHWH, and He answered, “Do not go up, but circle
around behind them and confront them at the baca trees.

translation.text: And when David enquired of the LORD, he said, Thou shalt not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

verses.english:
David inquired of YHWH, and He answered, “Do not go up, but circle
around behind them and confront them at the baca trees.

verses.hebrew: וִיהִי (בשמעך) [כְּשׁמְעֲךָ] אֶת־קוֹל צְעָדָה בְּרָאשֵׁי הַבְּכָאִים אָז תֶּחֱרָץ כִּי אָז יָצָא יְהֹוָה לְפָנֶיךָ לְהַכּוֹת בְּמַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וִיהִי (בשמעך) [כְּשׁמְעֲךָ] אֶת־קוֹל צְעָדָה בְּרָאשֵׁי הַבְּכָאִים אָז תֶּחֱרָץ כִּי אָז יָצָא יְהֹוָה לְפָנֶיךָ לְהַכּוֹת בְּמַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
And when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the baca
trees, then go into action, for YHWH will be going in front of you
to attack the Philistine forces.”

translation.text: And let it be, when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall the LORD go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines.

verses.english:
And when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the baca
trees, then go into action, for YHWH will be going in front of you
to attack the Philistine forces.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ דָּוִד כֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ יְהֹוָה וַיַּךְ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים מִגֶּבַע עַד־בֹּאֲךָ גָזֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ דָּוִד כֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ יְהֹוָה וַיַּךְ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים מִגֶּבַע עַד־בֹּאֲךָ גָזֶר׃

english.text:
David did as YHWH had commanded him; and he routed the Philistines
from Geba all the way to Gezer.

translation.text: And David did so, as the LORD had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer.

verses.english:
David did as YHWH had commanded him; and he routed the Philistines
from Geba all the way to Gezer.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד דָּוִד אֶת־כּל־בָּחוּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד דָּוִד אֶת־כּל־בָּחוּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף׃

english.text:
David again assembled all the picked men of Israel, thirty
thousand strong.

translation.text: Again, David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

verses.english:
David again assembled all the picked men of Israel, thirty
thousand strong.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ מִבַּעֲלֵי יְהוּדָה לְהַעֲלוֹת מִשָּׁם אֵת אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָא שֵׁם שֵׁם יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרֻבִים עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ מִבַּעֲלֵי יְהוּדָה לְהַעֲלוֹת מִשָּׁם אֵת אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָא שֵׁם שֵׁם יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרֻבִים עָלָיו׃

english.text:
Then David and all the troops that were with him set out from
Baalim of Judah to bring up from there the Ark of God to which the
Name was attached, the name LORD of Hosts Enthroned on the
Cherubim.

translation.text: And David arose, and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, whose name is called by the name of the LORD of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims.

verses.english:
Then David and all the troops that were with him set out from
Baalim of Judah to bring up from there the Ark of God to which the
Name was attached, the name LORD of Hosts Enthroned on the
Cherubim.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־עֲגָלָה חֲדָשָׁה וַיִּשָּׂאֻהוּ מִבֵּית אֲבִינָדָב אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּבְעָה וְעֻזָּא וְאַחְיוֹ בְּנֵי אֲבִינָדָב נֹהֲגִים אֶת־הָעֲגָלָה חֲדָשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־עֲגָלָה חֲדָשָׁה וַיִּשָּׂאֻהוּ מִבֵּית אֲבִינָדָב אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּבְעָה וְעֻזָּא וְאַחְיוֹ בְּנֵי אֲבִינָדָב נֹהֲגִים אֶת־הָעֲגָלָה חֲדָשָׁה׃

english.text:
They loaded the Ark of God onto a new cart and conveyed it from
the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill; and Abinadab’s sons,
Uzza and Ahio, guided the new cart.

translation.text: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.

verses.english:
They loaded the Ark of God onto a new cart and conveyed it from
the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill; and Abinadab’s sons,
Uzza and Ahio, guided the new cart.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂאֻהוּ מִבֵּית אֲבִינָדָב אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּבְעָה עִם אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וְאַחְיוֹ הֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵי הָאָרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂאֻהוּ מִבֵּית אֲבִינָדָב אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּבְעָה עִם אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וְאַחְיוֹ הֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵי הָאָרוֹן׃

english.text:
They conveyed it from Abinadab’s house on the hill, [Uzza walking]
alongside the Ark of God and Ahio walking in front of the Ark.

translation.text: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark.

verses.english:
They conveyed it from Abinadab’s house on the hill, [Uzza walking]
alongside the Ark of God and Ahio walking in front of the Ark.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד וְכל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל מְשַׂחֲקִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּכֹל עֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים וּבְכִנֹּרוֹת וּבִנְבָלִים וּבְתֻפִּים וּבִמְנַעַנְעִים וּבְצֶלְצֱלִים׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד וְכל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל מְשַׂחֲקִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּכֹל עֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים וּבְכִנֹּרוֹת וּבִנְבָלִים וּבְתֻפִּים וּבִמְנַעַנְעִים וּבְצֶלְצֱלִים׃

english.text:
Meanwhile, David and all the House of Israel danced before YHWH to
[the sound of] all kinds of cypress wood [instruments], with
lyres, harps, timbrels, sistrums, and cymbals.

translation.text: And David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD on all manner of instruments made of fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.

verses.english:
Meanwhile, David and all the House of Israel danced before YHWH to
[the sound of] all kinds of cypress wood [instruments], with
lyres, harps, timbrels, sistrums, and cymbals.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־גֹּרֶן נָכוֹן וַיִּשְׁלַח עֻזָּה אֶל־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאחֶז בּוֹ כִּי שָׁמְטוּ הַבָּקָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־גֹּרֶן נָכוֹן וַיִּשְׁלַח עֻזָּה אֶל־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאחֶז בּוֹ כִּי שָׁמְטוּ הַבָּקָר׃

english.text:
But when they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached
out for the Ark of God and grasped it, for the oxen had stumbled.

translation.text: And when they came to Nachon’s threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth his hand to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it.

verses.english:
But when they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached
out for the Ark of God and grasped it, for the oxen had stumbled.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּעֻזָּה וַיַּכֵּהוּ שָׁם הָאֱלֹהִים עַל־הַשַּׁל וַיָּמת שָׁם עִם אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּעֻזָּה וַיַּכֵּהוּ שָׁם הָאֱלֹהִים עַל־הַשַּׁל וַיָּמת שָׁם עִם אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
YHWH was incensed at Uzzah. And God struck him down on the spot
for his indiscretion, and he died there beside the Ark of God.

translation.text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.

verses.english:
YHWH was incensed at Uzzah. And God struck him down on the spot
for his indiscretion, and he died there beside the Ark of God.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר לְדָוִד עַל אֲשֶׁר פָּרַץ יְהֹוָה פֶּרֶץ בְּעֻזָּה וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא פֶּרֶץ עֻזָּה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר לְדָוִד עַל אֲשֶׁר פָּרַץ יְהֹוָה פֶּרֶץ בְּעֻזָּה וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא פֶּרֶץ עֻזָּה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
David was distressed because YHWH had inflicted a breach upon
Uzzah; and that place was named Perez-uzzah, as it is still
called.

translation.text: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perezuzzah to this day.

verses.english:
David was distressed because YHWH had inflicted a breach upon
Uzzah; and that place was named Perez-uzzah, as it is still
called.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרָא דָוִד אֶת־יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵיךְ יָבוֹא אֵלַי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרָא דָוִד אֶת־יְהֹוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵיךְ יָבוֹא אֵלַי אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
David was afraid of YHWH that day; he said, “How can I let the Ark
of YHWH come to me?”

translation.text: And David was afraid of the LORD that day, and said, How shall the ark of the LORD come to me?

verses.english:
David was afraid of YHWH that day; he said, “How can I let the Ark
of YHWH come to me?”

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־אָבָה דָוִד לְהָסִיר אֵלָיו אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה עַל־עִיר דָּוִד וַיַּטֵּהוּ דָוִד בֵּית עֹבֵד־אֱדֹם הַגִּתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־אָבָה דָוִד לְהָסִיר אֵלָיו אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה עַל־עִיר דָּוִד וַיַּטֵּהוּ דָוִד בֵּית עֹבֵד־אֱדֹם הַגִּתִּי׃

english.text:
So David would not bring the Ark of YHWH to his place in the City
of David; instead, David diverted it to the house of Obed-edom the
Gittite.

translation.text: So David would not remove the ark of the LORD unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.

verses.english:
So David would not bring the Ark of YHWH to his place in the City
of David; instead, David diverted it to the house of Obed-edom the
Gittite.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה בֵּית עֹבֵד אֱדֹם הַגִּתִּי שְׁלֹשָׁה חֳדָשִׁים וַיְבָרֶךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֹבֵד אֱדֹם וְאֶת־כּל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה בֵּית עֹבֵד אֱדֹם הַגִּתִּי שְׁלֹשָׁה חֳדָשִׁים וַיְבָרֶךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֹבֵד אֱדֹם וְאֶת־כּל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
The Ark of YHWH remained in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite
three months, and YHWH blessed Obed-edom and his whole household.

translation.text: And the ark of the LORD continued in the house of Obededom the Gittite three months: and the LORD blessed Obededom, and all his household.

verses.english:
The Ark of YHWH remained in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite
three months, and YHWH blessed Obed-edom and his whole household.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֻּגַּד לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד לֵאמֹר בֵּרַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת־בֵּית עֹבֵד אֱדֹם וְאֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ בַּעֲבוּר אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיַּעַל אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים מִבֵּית
עֹבֵד אֱדֹם עִיר דָּוִד בְּשִׂמְחָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֻּגַּד לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד לֵאמֹר בֵּרַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶת־בֵּית עֹבֵד אֱדֹם וְאֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ בַּעֲבוּר אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיַּעַל אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים מִבֵּית
עֹבֵד אֱדֹם עִיר דָּוִד בְּשִׂמְחָה׃

english.text:
It was reported to King David: “YHWH has blessed Obed-edom’s house
and all that belongs to him because of the Ark of God.” Thereupon
David went and brought up the Ark of God from the house of
Obed-edom to the City of David, amid rejoicing.

translation.text: And it was told king David, saying, The LORD hath blessed the house of Obededom, and all that pertaineth unto him, because of the ark of God. So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obededom into the city of David with gladness.

verses.english:
It was reported to King David: “YHWH has blessed Obed-edom’s house
and all that belongs to him because of the Ark of God.” Thereupon
David went and brought up the Ark of God from the house of
Obed-edom to the City of David, amid rejoicing.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי צָעֲדוּ נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן־יְהֹוָה שִׁשָּׁה צְעָדִים וַיִּזְבַּח שׁוֹר וּמְרִיא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי צָעֲדוּ נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן־יְהֹוָה שִׁשָּׁה צְעָדִים וַיִּזְבַּח שׁוֹר וּמְרִיא׃

english.text:
When the bearers of the Ark of YHWH had moved forward six paces,
he sacrificed an ox and a fatling.

translation.text: And it was so, that when they that bare the ark of the LORD had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.

verses.english:
When the bearers of the Ark of YHWH had moved forward six paces,
he sacrificed an ox and a fatling.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד מְכַרְכֵּר בְּכל־עֹז לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְדָוִד חָגוּר אֵפוֹד בָּד׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד מְכַרְכֵּר בְּכל־עֹז לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְדָוִד חָגוּר אֵפוֹד בָּד׃

english.text:
David whirled with all his might before YHWH; David was girt with
a linen ephod.

translation.text: And David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.

verses.english:
David whirled with all his might before YHWH; David was girt with
a linen ephod.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד וְכל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל מַעֲלִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה בִּתְרוּעָה וּבְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד וְכל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל מַעֲלִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה בִּתְרוּעָה וּבְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר׃

english.text:
Thus David and all the House of Israel brought up the Ark of YHWH
with shouts and with blasts of the horn.

translation.text: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the LORD with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.

verses.english:
Thus David and all the House of Israel brought up the Ark of YHWH
with shouts and with blasts of the horn.

verses.hebrew:
וְהָיָה אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה בָּא עִיר דָּוִד וּמִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל נִשְׁקְפָה בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן וַתֵּרֶא אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד מְפַזֵּז וּמְכַרְכֵּר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַתִּבֶז לוֹ
בְּלִבָּהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וְהָיָה אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה בָּא עִיר דָּוִד וּמִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל נִשְׁקְפָה בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן וַתֵּרֶא אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד מְפַזֵּז וּמְכַרְכֵּר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַתִּבֶז לוֹ
בְּלִבָּהּ׃

english.text:
As the Ark of YHWH entered the City of David, Michal daughter of
Saul looked out of the window and saw King David leaping and
whirling before YHWH; and she despised him for it.

translation.text: And as the ark of the LORD came into the city of David, Michal Saul’s daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.

verses.english:
As the Ark of YHWH entered the City of David, Michal daughter of
Saul looked out of the window and saw King David leaping and
whirling before YHWH; and she despised him for it.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבִאוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה וַיַּצִּגוּ אֹתוֹ בִּמְקוֹמוֹ בְּתוֹךְ הָאֹהֶל אֲשֶׁר נָטָה־לוֹ דָּוִד וַיַּעַל דָּוִד עֹלוֹת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּשְׁלָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבִאוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה וַיַּצִּגוּ אֹתוֹ בִּמְקוֹמוֹ בְּתוֹךְ הָאֹהֶל אֲשֶׁר נָטָה־לוֹ דָּוִד וַיַּעַל דָּוִד עֹלוֹת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וּשְׁלָמִים׃

english.text:
They brought in the Ark of YHWH and set it up in its place inside
the tent which David had pitched for it, and David sacrificed
burnt offerings and offerings of well-being before YHWH.

translation.text: And they brought in the ark of the LORD, and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

verses.english:
They brought in the Ark of YHWH and set it up in its place inside
the tent which David had pitched for it, and David sacrificed
burnt offerings and offerings of well-being before YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַל דָּוִד מֵהַעֲלוֹת הָעוֹלָה וְהַשְּׁלָמִים וַיְבָרֶךְ אֶת־הָעָם בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְכַל דָּוִד מֵהַעֲלוֹת הָעוֹלָה וְהַשְּׁלָמִים וַיְבָרֶךְ אֶת־הָעָם בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת׃

english.text:
When David finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and the
offerings of well-being, he blessed the people in the name of YHWH
of Hosts.

translation.text: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of hosts.

verses.english:
When David finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and the
offerings of well-being, he blessed the people in the name of YHWH
of Hosts.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַלֵּק לְכל־הָעָם לְכל־הֲמוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמֵאִישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁה לְאִישׁ חַלַּת לֶחֶם אַחַת וְאֶשְׁפָּר אֶחָד וַאֲשִׁישָׁה אֶחָת וַיֵּלֶךְ כּל־הָעָם אִישׁ לְבֵיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחַלֵּק לְכל־הָעָם לְכל־הֲמוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמֵאִישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁה לְאִישׁ חַלַּת לֶחֶם אַחַת וְאֶשְׁפָּר אֶחָד וַאֲשִׁישָׁה אֶחָת וַיֵּלֶךְ כּל־הָעָם אִישׁ לְבֵיתוֹ׃

english.text:
And he distributed among all the people—the entire multitude of
Israel, man and woman alike—to each a loaf of bread, a cake made
in a pan, and a raisin cake. Then all the people left for their
homes.

translation.text: And he dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine. So all the people departed every one to his house.

verses.english:
And he distributed among all the people—the entire multitude of
Israel, man and woman alike—to each a loaf of bread, a cake made
in a pan, and a raisin cake. Then all the people left for their
homes.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשׁב דָּוִד לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּיתוֹוַתֵּצֵא מִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וַתֹּאמֶר מַה־נִּכְבַּד הַיּוֹם מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר נִגְלָה הַיּוֹם לְעֵינֵי אַמְהוֹת עֲבָדָיו
כְּהִגָּלוֹת נִגְלוֹת אַחַד הָרֵקִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשׁב דָּוִד לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּיתוֹוַתֵּצֵא מִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וַתֹּאמֶר מַה־נִּכְבַּד הַיּוֹם מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר נִגְלָה הַיּוֹם לְעֵינֵי אַמְהוֹת עֲבָדָיו
כְּהִגָּלוֹת נִגְלוֹת אַחַד הָרֵקִים׃

english.text:
David went home to greet his household. And Michal daughter of
Saul came out to meet David and said, “Didn’t the king of Israel
do himself honor today—exposing himself today in the sight of the
slavegirls of his subjects, as one of the riffraff might expose
himself!”

translation.text: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!

verses.english:
David went home to greet his household. And Michal daughter of
Saul came out to meet David and said, “Didn’t the king of Israel
do himself honor today—exposing himself today in the sight of the
slavegirls of his subjects, as one of the riffraff might expose
himself!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־מִיכַל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר־בִּי מֵאָבִיךְ וּמִכּל־בֵּיתוֹ לְצַוֺּת אֹתִי נָגִיד עַל־עַם יְהֹוָה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשִׂחַקְתִּי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־מִיכַל לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר־בִּי מֵאָבִיךְ וּמִכּל־בֵּיתוֹ לְצַוֺּת אֹתִי נָגִיד עַל־עַם יְהֹוָה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשִׂחַקְתִּי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
David answered Michal, “It was before YHWH who chose me instead of
your father and all his family and appointed me ruler over YHWH’s
people Israel! I will dance before YHWH

translation.text: And David said unto Michal, It was before the LORD, which chose me before thy father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of the LORD, over Israel: therefore will I play before the LORD.

verses.english:
David answered Michal, “It was before YHWH who chose me instead of
your father and all his family and appointed me ruler over YHWH’s
people Israel! I will dance before YHWH

verses.hebrew: וּנְקַלֹּתִי עוֹד מִזֹּאת וְהָיִיתִי שָׁפָל בְּעֵינָי וְעִם־הָאֲמָהוֹת אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתְּ עִמָּם אִכָּבֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: וּנְקַלֹּתִי עוֹד מִזֹּאת וְהָיִיתִי שָׁפָל בְּעֵינָי וְעִם־הָאֲמָהוֹת אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתְּ עִמָּם אִכָּבֵדָה׃

english.text:
and dishonor myself even more, and be low in my own esteem; but
among the slavegirls that you speak of I will be honored.”

translation.text: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own sight: and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.

verses.english:
and dishonor myself even more, and be low in my own esteem; but
among the slavegirls that you speak of I will be honored.”

verses.hebrew: וּלְמִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל לֹא־הָיָה לָהּ יָלֶד עַד יוֹם מוֹתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל לֹא־הָיָה לָהּ יָלֶד עַד יוֹם מוֹתָהּ׃

english.text: So to her dying day Michal daughter of Saul had no children.

translation.text: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.

verses.english: So to her dying day Michal daughter of Saul had no children.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי־יָשַׁב הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּבֵיתוֹ וַיהֹוָה הֵנִיחַ־לוֹ מִסָּבִיב מִכּל־אֹיְבָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי־יָשַׁב הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּבֵיתוֹ וַיהֹוָה הֵנִיחַ־לוֹ מִסָּבִיב מִכּל־אֹיְבָיו׃

english.text:
When the king was settled in his palace and YHWH had granted him
safety from all the enemies around him,

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house, and the LORD had given him rest round about from all his enemies;

verses.english:
When the king was settled in his palace and YHWH had granted him
safety from all the enemies around him,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־נָתָן הַנָּבִיא רְאֵה נָא אָנֹכִי יוֹשֵׁב בְּבֵית אֲרָזִים וַאֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים יֹשֵׁב בְּתוֹךְ הַיְרִיעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־נָתָן הַנָּבִיא רְאֵה נָא אָנֹכִי יוֹשֵׁב בְּבֵית אֲרָזִים וַאֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים יֹשֵׁב בְּתוֹךְ הַיְרִיעָה׃

english.text:
the king said to the prophet Nathan: “Here I am dwelling in a
house of cedar, while the Ark of YHWH abides in a tent!”

translation.text: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.

verses.english:
the king said to the prophet Nathan: “Here I am dwelling in a
house of cedar, while the Ark of YHWH abides in a tent!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבְךָ לֵךְ עֲשֵׂה כִּי יְהֹוָה עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבְךָ לֵךְ עֲשֵׂה כִּי יְהֹוָה עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
Nathan said to the king, “Go and do whatever you have in mind, for
YHWH is with you.”

translation.text: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thine heart; for the LORD is with thee.

verses.english:
Nathan said to the king, “Go and do whatever you have in mind, for
YHWH is with you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּאוַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־נָתָן לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּאוַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־נָתָן לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: But that same night the word of YHWH came to Nathan:

translation.text: And it came to pass that night, that the word of the LORD came unto Nathan, saying,

verses.english: But that same night the word of YHWH came to Nathan:

verses.hebrew: לֵךְ וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל־עַבְדִּי אֶל־דָּוִדכֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הַאַתָּה תִּבְנֶה־לִּי בַיִת לְשִׁבְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: לֵךְ וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל־עַבְדִּי אֶל־דָּוִדכֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הַאַתָּה תִּבְנֶה־לִּי בַיִת לְשִׁבְתִּי׃

english.text:
“Go and say to My servant David: Thus said YHWH: Are you the one
to build a house for Me to dwell in?

translation.text: Go and tell my servant David, Thus saith the LORD, Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in?

verses.english:
“Go and say to My servant David: Thus said YHWH: Are you the one
to build a house for Me to dwell in?

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יָשַׁבְתִּי בְּבַיִת לְמִיּוֹם הַעֲלֹתִי אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם וְעַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וָאֶהְיֶה מִתְהַלֵּךְ בְּאֹהֶל וּבְמִשְׁכָּן׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא יָשַׁבְתִּי בְּבַיִת לְמִיּוֹם הַעֲלֹתִי אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם וְעַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וָאֶהְיֶה מִתְהַלֵּךְ בְּאֹהֶל וּבְמִשְׁכָּן׃

english.text:
From the day that I brought the people of Israel out of Egypt to
this day I have not dwelt in a house, but have moved about in Tent
and Tabernacle.

translation.text: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.

verses.english:
From the day that I brought the people of Israel out of Egypt to
this day I have not dwelt in a house, but have moved about in Tent
and Tabernacle.

verses.hebrew:
בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי בְּכל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲדָבָר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶת־אַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי לִרְעוֹת אֶת־עַמִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר לָמָּה
לֹא־בְנִיתֶם לִי בֵּית אֲרָזִים׃

hebrew.text:
בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי בְּכל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲדָבָר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶת־אַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי לִרְעוֹת אֶת־עַמִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר לָמָּה
לֹא־בְנִיתֶם לִי בֵּית אֲרָזִים׃

english.text:
As I moved about wherever the Israelites went, did I ever reproach
any of the tribal leaders whom I appointed to care for My people
Israel: Why have you not built Me a house of cedar?

translation.text: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people Israel, saying, Why build ye not me an house of cedar?

verses.english:
As I moved about wherever the Israelites went, did I ever reproach
any of the tribal leaders whom I appointed to care for My people
Israel: Why have you not built Me a house of cedar?

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה כֹּה־תֹאמַר לְעַבְדִּי לְדָוִד כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֲנִי לְקַחְתִּיךָ מִן־הַנָּוֶה מֵאַחַר הַצֹּאן לִהְיוֹת נָגִיד עַל־עַמִּי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה כֹּה־תֹאמַר לְעַבְדִּי לְדָוִד כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֲנִי לְקַחְתִּיךָ מִן־הַנָּוֶה מֵאַחַר הַצֹּאן לִהְיוֹת נָגִיד עַל־עַמִּי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
“Further, say thus to My servant David: Thus said YHWH of Hosts: I
took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be ruler
of My people Israel,

translation.text: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:

verses.english:
“Further, say thus to My servant David: Thus said YHWH of Hosts: I
took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be ruler
of My people Israel,

verses.hebrew: וָאֶהְיֶה עִמְּךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְתָּ וָאַכְרִתָה אֶת־כּל־אֹיְבֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ וְעָשִׂתִי־לְךָ שֵׁם גָּדוֹל כְּשֵׁם הַגְּדֹלִים אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶהְיֶה עִמְּךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְתָּ וָאַכְרִתָה אֶת־כּל־אֹיְבֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ וְעָשִׂתִי־לְךָ שֵׁם גָּדוֹל כְּשֵׁם הַגְּדֹלִים אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
and I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut down all
your enemies before you. Moreover, I will give you great renown
like that of the greatest men on earth.

translation.text: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight, and have made thee a great name, like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth.

verses.english:
and I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut down all
your enemies before you. Moreover, I will give you great renown
like that of the greatest men on earth.

verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתִּי מָקוֹם לְעַמִּי לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וּנְטַעְתִּיו וְשָׁכַן תַּחְתָּיו וְלֹא יִרְגַּז עוֹד וְלֹא־יֹסִיפוּ בְנֵי־עַוְלָה לְעַנּוֹתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְשַׂמְתִּי מָקוֹם לְעַמִּי לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וּנְטַעְתִּיו וְשָׁכַן תַּחְתָּיו וְלֹא יִרְגַּז עוֹד וְלֹא־יֹסִיפוּ בְנֵי־עַוְלָה לְעַנּוֹתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה׃

english.text:
I will establish a home for My people Israel and will plant them
firm, so that they shall dwell secure and shall tremble no more.
Evil men shall not oppress them any more as in the past,

translation.text: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as beforetime,

verses.english:
I will establish a home for My people Israel and will plant them
firm, so that they shall dwell secure and shall tremble no more.
Evil men shall not oppress them any more as in the past,

verses.hebrew: וּלְמִן־הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי שֹׁפְטִים עַל־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַהֲנִיחֹתִי לְךָ מִכּל־אֹיְבֶיךָ וְהִגִּיד לְךָ יְהֹוָה כִּי־בַיִת יַעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּלְמִן־הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי שֹׁפְטִים עַל־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַהֲנִיחֹתִי לְךָ מִכּל־אֹיְבֶיךָ וְהִגִּיד לְךָ יְהֹוָה כִּי־בַיִת יַעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
ever since I appointed chieftains over My people Israel. I will
give you safety from all your enemies. “YHWH declares to you that
He, YHWH, will establish a house for you.

translation.text: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel, and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies. Also the LORD telleth thee that he will make thee an house.

verses.english:
ever since I appointed chieftains over My people Israel. I will
give you safety from all your enemies. “YHWH declares to you that
He, YHWH, will establish a house for you.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִמְלְאוּ יָמֶיךָ וְשָׁכַבְתָּ אֶת־אֲבֹתֶיךָ וַהֲקִימֹתִי אֶת־זַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מִמֵּעֶיךָ וַהֲכִינֹתִי אֶת־מַמְלַכְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִמְלְאוּ יָמֶיךָ וְשָׁכַבְתָּ אֶת־אֲבֹתֶיךָ וַהֲקִימֹתִי אֶת־זַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מִמֵּעֶיךָ וַהֲכִינֹתִי אֶת־מַמְלַכְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
When your days are done and you lie with your fathers, I will
raise up your offspring after you, one of your own issue, and I
will establish his kingship.

translation.text: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.

verses.english:
When your days are done and you lie with your fathers, I will
raise up your offspring after you, one of your own issue, and I
will establish his kingship.

verses.hebrew: הוּא יִבְנֶה־בַּיִת לִשְׁמִי וְכֹנַנְתִּי אֶת־כִּסֵּא מַמְלַכְתּוֹ עַד־עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: הוּא יִבְנֶה־בַּיִת לִשְׁמִי וְכֹנַנְתִּי אֶת־כִּסֵּא מַמְלַכְתּוֹ עַד־עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
He shall build a house for My name, and I will establish his royal
throne forever.

translation.text: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.

verses.english:
He shall build a house for My name, and I will establish his royal
throne forever.

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי אֶהְיֶה־לּוֹ לְאָב וְהוּא יִהְיֶה־לִּי לְבֵן אֲשֶׁר בְּהַעֲוֺתוֹ וְהֹכַחְתִּיו בְּשֵׁבֶט אֲנָשִׁים וּבְנִגְעֵי בְּנֵי אָדָם׃

hebrew.text: אֲנִי אֶהְיֶה־לּוֹ לְאָב וְהוּא יִהְיֶה־לִּי לְבֵן אֲשֶׁר בְּהַעֲוֺתוֹ וְהֹכַחְתִּיו בְּשֵׁבֶט אֲנָשִׁים וּבְנִגְעֵי בְּנֵי אָדָם׃

translation.text: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:

verses.hebrew: וְחַסְדִּי לֹא־יָסוּר מִמֶּנּוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר הֲסִרֹתִי מֵעִם שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר הֲסִרֹתִי מִלְּפָנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְחַסְדִּי לֹא־יָסוּר מִמֶּנּוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר הֲסִרֹתִי מֵעִם שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר הֲסִרֹתִי מִלְּפָנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
but I will never withdraw My favor from him as I withdrew it from
Saul, whom I removed to make room for you.

translation.text: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before thee.

verses.english:
but I will never withdraw My favor from him as I withdrew it from
Saul, whom I removed to make room for you.

verses.hebrew: וְנֶאְמַן בֵּיתְךָ וּמַמְלַכְתְּךָ עַד־עוֹלָם לְפָנֶיךָ כִּסְאֲךָ יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן עַד־עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְנֶאְמַן בֵּיתְךָ וּמַמְלַכְתְּךָ עַד־עוֹלָם לְפָנֶיךָ כִּסְאֲךָ יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן עַד־עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
Your house and your kingship shall ever be secure before you; your
throne shall be established forever.”

translation.text: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.

verses.english:
Your house and your kingship shall ever be secure before you; your
throne shall be established forever.”

verses.hebrew: כְּכֹל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וּכְכֹל הַחִזָּיוֹן הַזֶּה כֵּן דִּבֶּר נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: כְּכֹל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וּכְכֹל הַחִזָּיוֹן הַזֶּה כֵּן דִּבֶּר נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד׃

english.text:
Nathan spoke to David in accordance with all these words and all
this prophecy.

translation.text: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

verses.english:
Nathan spoke to David in accordance with all these words and all
this prophecy.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֵּשֶׁב לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אָנֹכִי אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה וּמִי בֵיתִי כִּי הֲבִאֹתַנִי עַד־הֲלֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֵּשֶׁב לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אָנֹכִי אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה וּמִי בֵיתִי כִּי הֲבִאֹתַנִי עַד־הֲלֹם׃

english.text:
Then King David came and sat before YHWH, and he said, “What am I,
O Lord GOD, and what is my family, that You have brought me thus
far?

translation.text: Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD, and he said, Who am I, O Lord GOD? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

verses.english:
Then King David came and sat before YHWH, and he said, “What am I,
O Lord GOD, and what is my family, that You have brought me thus
far?

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְטַן עוֹד זֹאת בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה וַתְּדַבֵּר גַּם אֶל־בֵּית־עַבְדְּךָ לְמֵרָחוֹק וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הָאָדָם אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקְטַן עוֹד זֹאת בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה וַתְּדַבֵּר גַּם אֶל־בֵּית־עַבְדְּךָ לְמֵרָחוֹק וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הָאָדָם אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה׃

english.text:
Yet even this, O Lord GOD, has seemed too little to You; for You
have spoken of Your servant’s house also for the future. May that
be the law for the people, O Lord GOD.

translation.text: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight, O Lord GOD; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant’s house for a great while to come. And is this the manner of man, O Lord GOD?

verses.english:
Yet even this, O Lord GOD, has seemed too little to You; for You
have spoken of Your servant’s house also for the future. May that
be the law for the people, O Lord GOD.

verses.hebrew: וּמַה־יּוֹסִיף דָּוִד עוֹד לְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ וְאַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה׃

hebrew.text: וּמַה־יּוֹסִיף דָּוִד עוֹד לְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ וְאַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה׃

english.text: What more can David say to You? You know Your servant, O Lord GOD.

translation.text: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord GOD, knowest thy servant.

verses.english: What more can David say to You? You know Your servant, O Lord GOD.

verses.hebrew: בַּעֲבוּר דְּבָרְךָ וּכְלִבְּךָ עָשִׂיתָ אֵת כּל־הַגְּדוּלָּה הַזֹּאת לְהוֹדִיעַ אֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: בַּעֲבוּר דְּבָרְךָ וּכְלִבְּךָ עָשִׂיתָ אֵת כּל־הַגְּדוּלָּה הַזֹּאת לְהוֹדִיעַ אֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
For Your word’s sake and of Your own accord You have wrought this
great thing, and made it known to Your servant.

translation.text: For thy word’s sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know them.

verses.english:
For Your word’s sake and of Your own accord You have wrought this
great thing, and made it known to Your servant.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן גָּדַלְתָּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהִים כִּי־אֵין כָּמוֹךָ וְאֵין אֱלֹהִים זוּלָתֶךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמַעְנוּ בְּאזְנֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: עַל־כֵּן גָּדַלְתָּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהִים כִּי־אֵין כָּמוֹךָ וְאֵין אֱלֹהִים זוּלָתֶךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמַעְנוּ בְּאזְנֵינוּ׃

english.text:
You are great indeed, O Lord GOD! There is none like You and there
is no other God but You, as we have always heard.

translation.text: Wherefore thou art great, O LORD God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

verses.english:
You are great indeed, O Lord GOD! There is none like You and there
is no other God but You, as we have always heard.

verses.hebrew:
וּמִי כְעַמְּךָ כְּיִשְׂרָאֵל גּוֹי אֶחָד בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ־אֱלֹהִים לִפְדּוֹת־לוֹ לְעָם וְלָשׂוּם לוֹ שֵׁם וְלַעֲשׂוֹת לָכֶם הַגְּדוּלָּה וְנֹרָאוֹת לְאַרְצֶךָ מִפְּנֵי
עַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ לְּךָ מִמִּצְרַיִם גּוֹיִם וֵאלֹהָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וּמִי כְעַמְּךָ כְּיִשְׂרָאֵל גּוֹי אֶחָד בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ־אֱלֹהִים לִפְדּוֹת־לוֹ לְעָם וְלָשׂוּם לוֹ שֵׁם וְלַעֲשׂוֹת לָכֶם הַגְּדוּלָּה וְנֹרָאוֹת לְאַרְצֶךָ מִפְּנֵי
עַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ לְּךָ מִמִּצְרַיִם גּוֹיִם וֵאלֹהָיו׃

english.text:
And who is like Your people Israel, a unique nation on earth, whom
God went and redeemed as His people, winning renown for Himself
and doing great and marvelous deeds for them [and] for Your
land—[driving out] nations and their gods before Your people, whom
You redeemed for Yourself from Egypt.

translation.text: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

verses.english:
And who is like Your people Israel, a unique nation on earth, whom
God went and redeemed as His people, winning renown for Himself
and doing great and marvelous deeds for them [and] for Your
land—[driving out] nations and their gods before Your people, whom
You redeemed for Yourself from Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּכוֹנֵן לְךָ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ לְעָם עַד־עוֹלָם וְאַתָּה יְהֹוָה הָיִיתָ לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּכוֹנֵן לְךָ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ לְעָם עַד־עוֹלָם וְאַתָּה יְהֹוָה הָיִיתָ לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃

english.text:
You have established Your people Israel as Your very own people
forever; and You, O LORD, have become their God.

translation.text: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever: and thou, LORD, art become their God.

verses.english:
You have established Your people Israel as Your very own people
forever; and You, O LORD, have become their God.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהִים הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ עַל־עַבְדְּךָ וְעַל־בֵּיתוֹ הָקֵם עַד־עוֹלָם וַעֲשֵׂה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהִים הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ עַל־עַבְדְּךָ וְעַל־בֵּיתוֹ הָקֵם עַד־עוֹלָם וַעֲשֵׂה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ׃

english.text:
“And now, O LORD God, fulfill Your promise to Your servant and his
house forever; and do as You have promised.

translation.text: And now, O LORD God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as thou hast said.

verses.english:
“And now, O LORD God, fulfill Your promise to Your servant and his
