house forever; and do as You have promised.

verses.hebrew: וְיִגְדַּל שִׁמְךָ עַד־עוֹלָם לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהִים עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵית עַבְדְּךָ דָוִד יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן לְפָנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְיִגְדַּל שִׁמְךָ עַד־עוֹלָם לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהִים עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵית עַבְדְּךָ דָוִד יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן לְפָנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And may Your name be glorified forever, in that men will say,
‘YHWH of Hosts is God over Israel’; and may the house of Your
servant David be established before You.

translation.text: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.

verses.english:
And may Your name be glorified forever, in that men will say,
‘YHWH of Hosts is God over Israel’; and may the house of Your
servant David be established before You.

verses.hebrew:
כִּי־אַתָּה יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל גָּלִיתָה אֶת־אֹזֶן עַבְדְּךָ לֵאמֹר בַּיִת אֶבְנֶה־לָּךְ עַל־כֵּן מָצָא עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־לִבּוֹ לְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֵלֶיךָ אֶת־הַתְּפִלָּה
הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי־אַתָּה יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל גָּלִיתָה אֶת־אֹזֶן עַבְדְּךָ לֵאמֹר בַּיִת אֶבְנֶה־לָּךְ עַל־כֵּן מָצָא עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־לִבּוֹ לְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֵלֶיךָ אֶת־הַתְּפִלָּה
הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
Because You, O LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, have revealed to
Your servant that You will build a house for him, Your servant has
ventured to offer this prayer to You.

translation.text: For thou, O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee an house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.

verses.english:
Because You, O LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, have revealed to
Your servant that You will build a house for him, Your servant has
ventured to offer this prayer to You.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה אַתָּה־הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים וּדְבָרֶיךָ יִהְיוּ אֱמֶת וַתְּדַבֵּר אֶל־עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה אַתָּה־הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים וּדְבָרֶיךָ יִהְיוּ אֱמֶת וַתְּדַבֵּר אֶל־עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
And now, O Lord GOD, You are God and Your words will surely come
true, and You have made this gracious promise to Your servant.

translation.text: And now, O Lord GOD, thou art that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

verses.english:
And now, O Lord GOD, You are God and Your words will surely come
true, and You have made this gracious promise to Your servant.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הוֹאֵל וּבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית עַבְדְּךָ לִהְיוֹת לְעוֹלָם לְפָנֶיךָ כִּי־אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה דִּבַּרְתָּ וּמִבִּרְכָתְךָ יְבֹרַךְ בֵּית־עַבְדְּךָ לְעוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הוֹאֵל וּבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית עַבְדְּךָ לִהְיוֹת לְעוֹלָם לְפָנֶיךָ כִּי־אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה דִּבַּרְתָּ וּמִבִּרְכָתְךָ יְבֹרַךְ בֵּית־עַבְדְּךָ לְעוֹלָם׃

english.text:
Be pleased, therefore, to bless Your servant’s house, that it
abide before You forever; for You, O Lord GOD, have spoken. May
Your servant’s house be blessed forever by Your blessing.”

translation.text: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O Lord GOD, hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.

verses.english:
Be pleased, therefore, to bless Your servant’s house, that it
abide before You forever; for You, O Lord GOD, have spoken. May
Your servant’s house be blessed forever by Your blessing.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיַּךְ דָּוִד אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּכְנִיעֵם וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־מֶתֶג הָאַמָּה מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיַּךְ דָּוִד אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּכְנִיעֵם וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־מֶתֶג הָאַמָּה מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
Some time afterward, David attacked the Philistines and subdued
them; and David took Metheg-ammah from the Philistines.

translation.text: And after this it came to pass that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Methegammah out of the hand of the Philistines.

verses.english:
Some time afterward, David attacked the Philistines and subdued
them; and David took Metheg-ammah from the Philistines.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּךְ אֶת־מוֹאָב וַיְמַדְּדֵם בַּחֶבֶל הַשְׁכֵּב אוֹתָם אַרְצָה וַיְמַדֵּד שְׁנֵי־חֲבָלִים לְהָמִית וּמְלֹא הַחֶבֶל לְהַחֲיוֹת וַתְּהִי מוֹאָב לְדָוִד לַעֲבָדִים נֹשְׂאֵי
מִנְחָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּךְ אֶת־מוֹאָב וַיְמַדְּדֵם בַּחֶבֶל הַשְׁכֵּב אוֹתָם אַרְצָה וַיְמַדֵּד שְׁנֵי־חֲבָלִים לְהָמִית וּמְלֹא הַחֶבֶל לְהַחֲיוֹת וַתְּהִי מוֹאָב לְדָוִד לַעֲבָדִים נֹשְׂאֵי
מִנְחָה׃

english.text:
He also defeated the Moabites. He made them lie down on the ground
and he measured them off with a cord; he measured out two lengths
of cord for those who were to be put to death, and one length for
those to be spared. And the Moabites became tributary vassals of
David.

translation.text: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.

verses.english:
He also defeated the Moabites. He made them lie down on the ground
and he measured them off with a cord; he measured out two lengths
of cord for those who were to be put to death, and one length for
those to be spared. And the Moabites became tributary vassals of
David.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ דָּוִד אֶת־הֲדַדְעֶזֶר בֶּן־רְחֹב מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָה בְּלֶכְתּוֹ לְהָשִׁיב יָדוֹ (בנהר) [בִּנְהַר־פְּרָת]׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּךְ דָּוִד אֶת־הֲדַדְעֶזֶר בֶּן־רְחֹב מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָה בְּלֶכְתּוֹ לְהָשִׁיב יָדוֹ (בנהר) [בִּנְהַר־פְּרָת]׃

english.text:
David defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, who was then
on his way to restore his monument at the Euphrates River.

translation.text: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.

verses.english:
David defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, who was then
on his way to restore his monument at the Euphrates River.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכֹּד דָּוִד מִמֶּנּוּ אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע־מֵאוֹת פָּרָשִׁים וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ רַגְלִי וַיְעַקֵּר דָּוִד אֶת־כּל־הָרֶכֶב וַיּוֹתֵר מִמֶּנּוּ מֵאָה רָכֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְכֹּד דָּוִד מִמֶּנּוּ אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע־מֵאוֹת פָּרָשִׁים וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ רַגְלִי וַיְעַקֵּר דָּוִד אֶת־כּל־הָרֶכֶב וַיּוֹתֵר מִמֶּנּוּ מֵאָה רָכֶב׃

english.text:
David captured 1,700 horsemen and 20,000 foot soldiers of his
force; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, except for 100
which he retained.

translation.text: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.

verses.english:
David captured 1,700 horsemen and 20,000 foot soldiers of his
force; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, except for 100
which he retained.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא אֲרַם דַּמֶּשֶׂק לַעְזֹר לַהֲדַדְעֶזֶר מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָה וַיַּךְ דָּוִד בַּאֲרָם עֶשְׂרִים־וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּבֹא אֲרַם דַּמֶּשֶׂק לַעְזֹר לַהֲדַדְעֶזֶר מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָה וַיַּךְ דָּוִד בַּאֲרָם עֶשְׂרִים־וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

english.text:
And when the Arameans of Damascus came to the aid of King
Hadadezer of Zobah, David struck down 22,000 of the Arameans.

translation.text: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

verses.english:
And when the Arameans of Damascus came to the aid of King
Hadadezer of Zobah, David struck down 22,000 of the Arameans.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם דָּוִד נְצִבִים בַּאֲרַם דַּמֶּשֶׂק וַתְּהִי אֲרָם לְדָוִד לַעֲבָדִים נוֹשְׂאֵי מִנְחָה וַיֹּשַׁע יְהֹוָה אֶת־דָּוִד בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָלָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם דָּוִד נְצִבִים בַּאֲרַם דַּמֶּשֶׂק וַתְּהִי אֲרָם לְדָוִד לַעֲבָדִים נוֹשְׂאֵי מִנְחָה וַיֹּשַׁע יְהֹוָה אֶת־דָּוִד בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָלָךְ׃

english.text:
David stationed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans
became tributary vassals of David. YHWH gave David victory
wherever he went.

translation.text: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought gifts. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

verses.english:
David stationed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans
became tributary vassals of David. YHWH gave David victory
wherever he went.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֵת שִׁלְטֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ אֶל עַבְדֵי הֲדַדְעָזֶר וַיְבִיאֵם יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֵת שִׁלְטֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ אֶל עַבְדֵי הֲדַדְעָזֶר וַיְבִיאֵם יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
David took the gold shields carried by Hadadezer’s retinue and
brought them to Jerusalem;

translation.text: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

verses.english:
David took the gold shields carried by Hadadezer’s retinue and
brought them to Jerusalem;

verses.hebrew: וּמִבֶּטַח וּמִבֵּרֹתַי עָרֵי הֲדַדְעָזֶר לָקַח הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד נְחֹשֶׁת הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וּמִבֶּטַח וּמִבֵּרֹתַי עָרֵי הֲדַדְעָזֶר לָקַח הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד נְחֹשֶׁת הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

english.text:
and from Betah and Berothai, towns of Hadadezer, King David took a
vast amount of copper.

translation.text: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.

verses.english:
and from Betah and Berothai, towns of Hadadezer, King David took a
vast amount of copper.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע תֹּעִי מֶלֶךְ חֲמָת כִּי הִכָּה דָוִד אֵת כּל־חֵיל הֲדַדְעָזֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע תֹּעִי מֶלֶךְ חֲמָת כִּי הִכָּה דָוִד אֵת כּל־חֵיל הֲדַדְעָזֶר׃

english.text:
When King Toi of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire
army of Hadadezer,

translation.text: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,

verses.english:
When King Toi of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire
army of Hadadezer,

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח תֹּעִי אֶת־יוֹרָם־בְּנוֹ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ־דָּוִד לִשְׁאל־לוֹ לְשָׁלוֹם וּלְבָרְכוֹ עַל אֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם בַּהֲדַדְעֶזֶר וַיַּכֵּהוּ כִּי־אִישׁ מִלְחֲמוֹת תֹּעִי הָיָה
הֲדַדְעָזֶר וּבְיָדוֹ הָיוּ כְּלֵי־כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי־זָהָב וּכְלֵי נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח תֹּעִי אֶת־יוֹרָם־בְּנוֹ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ־דָּוִד לִשְׁאל־לוֹ לְשָׁלוֹם וּלְבָרְכוֹ עַל אֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם בַּהֲדַדְעֶזֶר וַיַּכֵּהוּ כִּי־אִישׁ מִלְחֲמוֹת תֹּעִי הָיָה
הֲדַדְעָזֶר וּבְיָדוֹ הָיוּ כְּלֵי־כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי־זָהָב וּכְלֵי נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
Toi sent his son Joram to King David to greet him and to
congratulate him on his military victory over Hadadezer—for
Hadadezer had been at war with Toi. [Joram] brought with him
objects of silver, gold, and copper.

translation.text: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:

verses.english:
Toi sent his son Joram to King David to greet him and to
congratulate him on his military victory over Hadadezer—for
Hadadezer had been at war with Toi. [Joram] brought with him
objects of silver, gold, and copper.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֹתָם הִקְדִּישׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד לַיהֹוָה עִם־הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הִקְדִּישׁ מִכּל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר כִּבֵּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: גַּם־אֹתָם הִקְדִּישׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד לַיהֹוָה עִם־הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הִקְדִּישׁ מִכּל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר כִּבֵּשׁ׃

english.text:
King David dedicated these to YHWH, along with the other silver
and gold that he dedicated, [taken] from all the nations he had
conquered:

translation.text: Which also king David did dedicate unto the LORD, with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;

verses.english:
King David dedicated these to YHWH, along with the other silver
and gold that he dedicated, [taken] from all the nations he had
conquered:

verses.hebrew: מֵאֲרָם וּמִמּוֹאָב וּמִבְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וּמִפְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמֵעֲמָלֵק וּמִשְּׁלַל הֲדַדְעֶזֶר בֶּן־רְחֹב מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָה׃

hebrew.text: מֵאֲרָם וּמִמּוֹאָב וּמִבְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וּמִפְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמֵעֲמָלֵק וּמִשְּׁלַל הֲדַדְעֶזֶר בֶּן־רְחֹב מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָה׃

english.text:
from Edom, Moab, and Ammon; from the Philistines and the
Amalekites, and from the plunder of Hadadezer son of Rehob, king
of Zobah.

translation.text: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

verses.english:
from Edom, Moab, and Ammon; from the Philistines and the
Amalekites, and from the plunder of Hadadezer son of Rehob, king
of Zobah.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ דָּוִד שֵׁם בְּשֻׁבוֹ מֵהַכּוֹתוֹ אֶת־אֲרָם בְּגֵיא־מֶלַח שְׁמוֹנָה עָשָׂר אָלֶף׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ דָּוִד שֵׁם בְּשֻׁבוֹ מֵהַכּוֹתוֹ אֶת־אֲרָם בְּגֵיא־מֶלַח שְׁמוֹנָה עָשָׂר אָלֶף׃

english.text:
David gained fame when he returned from defeating Edom in the
Valley of Salt, 18,000 in all.

translation.text: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men.

verses.english:
David gained fame when he returned from defeating Edom in the
Valley of Salt, 18,000 in all.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם בֶּאֱדוֹם נְצִבִים בְּכל־אֱדוֹם שָׂם נְצִבִים וַיְהִי כל־אֱדוֹם עֲבָדִים לְדָוִד וַיּוֹשַׁע יְהֹוָה אֶת־דָּוִד בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָלָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם בֶּאֱדוֹם נְצִבִים בְּכל־אֱדוֹם שָׂם נְצִבִים וַיְהִי כל־אֱדוֹם עֲבָדִים לְדָוִד וַיּוֹשַׁע יְהֹוָה אֶת־דָּוִד בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָלָךְ׃

english.text:
He stationed garrisons in Edom—he stationed garrisons in all of
Edom —and all the Edomites became vassals of David. YHWH gave
David victory wherever he went.

translation.text: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David’s servants. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

verses.english:
He stationed garrisons in Edom—he stationed garrisons in all of
Edom —and all the Edomites became vassals of David. YHWH gave
David victory wherever he went.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְלֹךְ דָּוִד עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְהִי דָוִד עֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה לְכל־עַמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְלֹךְ דָּוִד עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְהִי דָוִד עֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה לְכל־עַמּוֹ׃

english.text:
David reigned over all Israel, and David executed true justice
among all his people.

translation.text: And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people.

verses.english:
David reigned over all Israel, and David executed true justice
among all his people.

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה עַל־הַצָּבָא וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־אֲחִילוּד מַזְכִּיר׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה עַל־הַצָּבָא וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־אֲחִילוּד מַזְכִּיר׃

english.text:
Joab son of Zeruiah was commander of the army; Jehoshaphat son of
Ahilud was recorder;

translation.text: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

verses.english:
Joab son of Zeruiah was commander of the army; Jehoshaphat son of
Ahilud was recorder;

verses.hebrew: וְצָדוֹק בֶּן־אֲחִיטוּב וַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִים וּשְׂרָיָה סוֹפֵר׃

hebrew.text: וְצָדוֹק בֶּן־אֲחִיטוּב וַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִים וּשְׂרָיָה סוֹפֵר׃

english.text:
Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests;
Seraiah was scribe;

translation.text: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;

verses.english:
Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests;
Seraiah was scribe;

verses.hebrew: וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וּבְנֵי דָוִד כֹּהֲנִים הָיוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וּבְנֵי דָוִד כֹּהֲנִים הָיוּ׃

english.text:
Benaiah son of Jehoiada was commander of the Cherethites and the
Pelethites; and David’s sons were priests.

translation.text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief rulers.

verses.english:
Benaiah son of Jehoiada was commander of the Cherethites and the
Pelethites; and David’s sons were priests.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד הֲכִי יֶשׁ־עוֹד אֲשֶׁר נוֹתַר לְבֵית שָׁאוּל וְאֶעֱשֶׂה עִמּוֹ חֶסֶד בַּעֲבוּר יְהוֹנָתָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד הֲכִי יֶשׁ־עוֹד אֲשֶׁר נוֹתַר לְבֵית שָׁאוּל וְאֶעֱשֶׂה עִמּוֹ חֶסֶד בַּעֲבוּר יְהוֹנָתָן׃

english.text:
David inquired, “Is there anyone still left of the House of Saul
with whom I can keep faith for the sake of Jonathan?”

translation.text: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?

verses.english:
David inquired, “Is there anyone still left of the House of Saul
with whom I can keep faith for the sake of Jonathan?”

verses.hebrew: וּלְבֵית שָׁאוּל עֶבֶד וּשְׁמוֹ צִיבָא וַיִּקְרְאוּ־לוֹ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו הַאַתָּה צִיבָא וַיֹּאמֶר עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּלְבֵית שָׁאוּל עֶבֶד וּשְׁמוֹ צִיבָא וַיִּקְרְאוּ־לוֹ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו הַאַתָּה צִיבָא וַיֹּאמֶר עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
There was a servant of the House of Saul named Ziba, and they
summoned him to David. “Are you Ziba?” the king asked him. “Yes,
sir,” he replied.

translation.text: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant is he.

verses.english:
There was a servant of the House of Saul named Ziba, and they
summoned him to David. “Are you Ziba?” the king asked him. “Yes,
sir,” he replied.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַאֶפֶס עוֹד אִישׁ לְבֵית שָׁאוּל וְאֶעֱשֶׂה עִמּוֹ חֶסֶד אֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ עוֹד בֵּן לִיהוֹנָתָן נְכֵה רַגְלָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַאֶפֶס עוֹד אִישׁ לְבֵית שָׁאוּל וְאֶעֱשֶׂה עִמּוֹ חֶסֶד אֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ עוֹד בֵּן לִיהוֹנָתָן נְכֵה רַגְלָיִם׃

english.text:
The king continued, “Is there anyone at all left of the House of
Saul with whom I can keep faith as pledged before God?” Ziba
answered the king, “Yes, there is still a son of Jonathan whose
feet are crippled.”

translation.text: And the king said, Is there not yet any of the house of Saul, that I may shew the kindness of God unto him? And Ziba said unto the king, Jonathan hath yet a son, which is lame on his feet.

verses.english:
The king continued, “Is there anyone at all left of the House of
Saul with whom I can keep faith as pledged before God?” Ziba
answered the king, “Yes, there is still a son of Jonathan whose
feet are crippled.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵיפֹה הוּא וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה־הוּא בֵּית מָכִיר בֶּן־עַמִּיאֵל בְּלוֹ דְבָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵיפֹה הוּא וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה־הוּא בֵּית מָכִיר בֶּן־עַמִּיאֵל בְּלוֹ דְבָר׃

english.text:
“Where is he?” the king asked, and Ziba said to the king, “He is
in the house of Machir son of Ammiel, in Lo-debar.”

translation.text: And the king said unto him, Where is he? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lodebar.

verses.english:
“Where is he?” the king asked, and Ziba said to the king, “He is
in the house of Machir son of Ammiel, in Lo-debar.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ מִבֵּית מָכִיר בֶּן־עַמִּיאֵל מִלּוֹ דְבָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ מִבֵּית מָכִיר בֶּן־עַמִּיאֵל מִלּוֹ דְבָר׃

english.text:
King David had him brought from the house of Machir son of Ammiel,
at Lo-debar;

translation.text: Then king David sent, and fetched him out of the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, from Lodebar.

verses.english:
King David had him brought from the house of Machir son of Ammiel,
at Lo-debar;

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מְפִיבֹשֶׁת בֶּן־יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד וַיִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנָיו וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד מְפִיבֹשֶׁת וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא מְפִיבֹשֶׁת בֶּן־יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד וַיִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנָיו וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד מְפִיבֹשֶׁת וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
and when Mephibosheth son of Jonathan son of Saul came to David,
he flung himself on his face and prostrated himself. David said,
“Mephibosheth!” and he replied, “At your service, sir.”

translation.text: Now when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, was come unto David, he fell on his face, and did reverence. And David said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold thy servant!

verses.english:
and when Mephibosheth son of Jonathan son of Saul came to David,
he flung himself on his face and prostrated himself. David said,
“Mephibosheth!” and he replied, “At your service, sir.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָוִד אַל־תִּירָא כִּי עָשֹׂה אֶעֱשֶׂה עִמְּךָ חֶסֶד בַּעֲבוּר יְהוֹנָתָן אָבִיךָ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִי לְךָ אֶת־כּל־שְׂדֵה שָׁאוּל אָבִיךָ וְאַתָּה תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם
עַל־שֻׁלְחָנִי תָּמִיד׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָוִד אַל־תִּירָא כִּי עָשֹׂה אֶעֱשֶׂה עִמְּךָ חֶסֶד בַּעֲבוּר יְהוֹנָתָן אָבִיךָ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִי לְךָ אֶת־כּל־שְׂדֵה שָׁאוּל אָבִיךָ וְאַתָּה תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם
עַל־שֻׁלְחָנִי תָּמִיד׃

english.text:
David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will keep faith with
you for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will give you back all
the land of your grandfather Saul; moreover, you shall always eat
at my table.”

translation.text: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father’s sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.

verses.english:
David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will keep faith with
you for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will give you back all
the land of your grandfather Saul; moreover, you shall always eat
at my table.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי פָנִיתָ אֶל־הַכֶּלֶב הַמֵּת אֲשֶׁר כָּמוֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי פָנִיתָ אֶל־הַכֶּלֶב הַמֵּת אֲשֶׁר כָּמוֹנִי׃

english.text:
[Mephibosheth] prostrated himself again, and said, “What is your
servant, that you should show regard for a dead dog like me?”

translation.text: And he bowed himself, and said, What is thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am?

verses.english:
[Mephibosheth] prostrated himself again, and said, “What is your
servant, that you should show regard for a dead dog like me?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־צִיבָא נַעַר שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּל אֲשֶׁר הָיָה לְשָׁאוּל וּלְכל־בֵּיתוֹ נָתַתִּי לְבֶן־אֲדֹנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־צִיבָא נַעַר שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּל אֲשֶׁר הָיָה לְשָׁאוּל וּלְכל־בֵּיתוֹ נָתַתִּי לְבֶן־אֲדֹנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
The king summoned Ziba, Saul’s steward, and said to him, “I give
to your master’s grandson everything that belonged to Saul and to
his entire family.

translation.text: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said unto him, I have given unto thy master’s son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.

verses.english:
The king summoned Ziba, Saul’s steward, and said to him, “I give
to your master’s grandson everything that belonged to Saul and to
his entire family.

verses.hebrew:
וְעָבַדְתָּ לּוֹ אֶת־הָאֲדָמָה אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ וַעֲבָדֶיךָ וְהֵבֵאתָ וְהָיָה לְבֶן־אֲדֹנֶיךָ לֶּחֶם וַאֲכָלוֹ וּמְפִיבֹשֶׁת בֶּן־אֲדֹנֶיךָ יֹאכַל תָּמִיד לֶחֶם עַל־שֻׁלְחָנִי
וּלְצִיבָא חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר בָּנִים וְעֶשְׂרִים עֲבָדִים׃

hebrew.text:
וְעָבַדְתָּ לּוֹ אֶת־הָאֲדָמָה אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ וַעֲבָדֶיךָ וְהֵבֵאתָ וְהָיָה לְבֶן־אֲדֹנֶיךָ לֶּחֶם וַאֲכָלוֹ וּמְפִיבֹשֶׁת בֶּן־אֲדֹנֶיךָ יֹאכַל תָּמִיד לֶחֶם עַל־שֻׁלְחָנִי
וּלְצִיבָא חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר בָּנִים וְעֶשְׂרִים עֲבָדִים׃

english.text:
You and your sons and your slaves shall farm the land for him and
shall bring in [its yield] to provide food for your master’s
grandson to live on; but Mephibosheth, your master’s grandson,
shall always eat at my table.”—Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty
slaves.—

translation.text: Thou therefore, and thy sons, and thy servants, shall till the land for him, and thou shalt bring in the fruits, that thy master’s son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth thy master’s son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

verses.english:
You and your sons and your slaves shall farm the land for him and
shall bring in [its yield] to provide food for your master’s
grandson to live on; but Mephibosheth, your master’s grandson,
shall always eat at my table.”—Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty
slaves.—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יְצַוֶּה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־עַבְדּוֹ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה עַבְדֶּךָ וּמְפִיבֹשֶׁת אֹכֵל עַל־שֻׁלְחָנִי כְּאַחַד מִבְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יְצַוֶּה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־עַבְדּוֹ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה עַבְדֶּךָ וּמְפִיבֹשֶׁת אֹכֵל עַל־שֻׁלְחָנִי כְּאַחַד מִבְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Ziba said to the king, “Your servant will do just as my lord the
king has commanded him.” “Mephibosheth shall eat at my table like
one of the king’s sons.”

translation.text: Then said Ziba unto the king, According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant, so shall thy servant do. As for Mephibosheth, said the king, he shall eat at my table, as one of the king’s sons.

verses.english:
Ziba said to the king, “Your servant will do just as my lord the
king has commanded him.” “Mephibosheth shall eat at my table like
one of the king’s sons.”

verses.hebrew: וְלִמְפִיבֹשֶׁת בֵּן־קָטָן וּשְׁמוֹ מִיכָא וְכֹל מוֹשַׁב בֵּית־צִיבָא עֲבָדִים לִמְפִיבֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וְלִמְפִיבֹשֶׁת בֵּן־קָטָן וּשְׁמוֹ מִיכָא וְכֹל מוֹשַׁב בֵּית־צִיבָא עֲבָדִים לִמְפִיבֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica; and all the members of
Ziba’s household worked for Mephibosheth.

translation.text: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.

verses.english:
Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica; and all the members of
Ziba’s household worked for Mephibosheth.

verses.hebrew: וּמְפִיבֹשֶׁת יֹשֵׁב בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם כִּי עַל־שֻׁלְחַן הַמֶּלֶךְ תָּמִיד הוּא אֹכֵל וְהוּא פִסֵּחַ שְׁתֵּי רַגְלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וּמְפִיבֹשֶׁת יֹשֵׁב בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם כִּי עַל־שֻׁלְחַן הַמֶּלֶךְ תָּמִיד הוּא אֹכֵל וְהוּא פִסֵּחַ שְׁתֵּי רַגְלָיו׃

english.text:
Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he ate regularly at the
king’s table. He was lame in both feet.

translation.text: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king’s table; and was lame on both his feet.

verses.english:
Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he ate regularly at the
king’s table. He was lame in both feet.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיָּמת מֶלֶךְ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ חָנוּן בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיָּמת מֶלֶךְ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ חָנוּן בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Some time afterward, the king of Ammon died, and his son Hanun
succeeded him as king.

translation.text: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Some time afterward, the king of Ammon died, and his son Hanun
succeeded him as king.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶעֱשֶׂה־חֶסֶד עִם־חָנוּן בֶּן־נָחָשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אָבִיו עִמָּדִי חֶסֶד וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד לְנַחֲמוֹ בְּיַד־עֲבָדָיו אֶל־אָבִיו וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי דָוִד אֶרֶץ
בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶעֱשֶׂה־חֶסֶד עִם־חָנוּן בֶּן־נָחָשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אָבִיו עִמָּדִי חֶסֶד וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד לְנַחֲמוֹ בְּיַד־עֲבָדָיו אֶל־אָבִיו וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי דָוִד אֶרֶץ
בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
David said, “I will keep faith with Hanun son of Nahash, just as
his father kept faith with me.” He sent his courtiers with a
message of condolence to him over his father. But when David’s
courtiers came to the land of Ammon,

translation.text: Then said David, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father shewed kindness unto me. And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father. And David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

verses.english:
David said, “I will keep faith with Hanun son of Nahash, just as
his father kept faith with me.” He sent his courtiers with a
message of condolence to him over his father. But when David’s
courtiers came to the land of Ammon,

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׂרֵי בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן אֶל־חָנוּן אֲדֹנֵיהֶם הַמְכַבֵּד דָּוִד אֶת־אָבִיךָ בְּעֵינֶיךָ כִּי־שָׁלַח לְךָ מְנַחֲמִים הֲלוֹא בַּעֲבוּר חֲקֹר אֶת־הָעִיר וּלְרַגְּלָהּ
וּלְהפְכָהּ שָׁלַח דָּוִד אֶת־עֲבָדָיו אֵלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׂרֵי בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן אֶל־חָנוּן אֲדֹנֵיהֶם הַמְכַבֵּד דָּוִד אֶת־אָבִיךָ בְּעֵינֶיךָ כִּי־שָׁלַח לְךָ מְנַחֲמִים הֲלוֹא בַּעֲבוּר חֲקֹר אֶת־הָעִיר וּלְרַגְּלָהּ
וּלְהפְכָהּ שָׁלַח דָּוִד אֶת־עֲבָדָיו אֵלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
the Ammonite officials said to their lord Hanun, “Do you think
David is really honoring your father just because he sent you men
with condolences? Why, David has sent his courtiers to you to
explore and spy out the city, and to overthrow it.”

translation.text: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? hath not David rather sent his servants unto thee, to search the city, and to spy it out, and to overthrow it?

verses.english:
the Ammonite officials said to their lord Hanun, “Do you think
David is really honoring your father just because he sent you men
with condolences? Why, David has sent his courtiers to you to
explore and spy out the city, and to overthrow it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח חָנוּן אֶת־עַבְדֵי דָוִד וַיְגַלַּח אֶת־חֲצִי זְקָנָם וַיִּכְרֹת אֶת־מַדְוֵיהֶם בַּחֵצִי עַד שְׁתוֹתֵיהֶם וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח חָנוּן אֶת־עַבְדֵי דָוִד וַיְגַלַּח אֶת־חֲצִי זְקָנָם וַיִּכְרֹת אֶת־מַדְוֵיהֶם בַּחֵצִי עַד שְׁתוֹתֵיהֶם וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם׃

english.text:
So Hanun seized David’s courtiers, clipped off one side of their
beards and cut away half of their garments at the buttocks, and
sent them off.

translation.text: Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

verses.english:
So Hanun seized David’s courtiers, clipped off one side of their
beards and cut away half of their garments at the buttocks, and
sent them off.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְדָוִד וַיִּשְׁלַח לִקְרָאתָם כִּי־הָיוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים נִכְלָמִים מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁבוּ בִירֵחוֹ עַד־יְצַמַּח זְקַנְכֶם וְשַׁבְתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְדָוִד וַיִּשְׁלַח לִקְרָאתָם כִּי־הָיוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים נִכְלָמִים מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁבוּ בִירֵחוֹ עַד־יְצַמַּח זְקַנְכֶם וְשַׁבְתֶּם׃

english.text:
When David was told of it, he dispatched men to meet them, for the
men were greatly embarrassed. And the king gave orders: “Stop in
Jericho until your beards grow back; then you can return.”

translation.text: When they told it unto David, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed: and the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

verses.english:
When David was told of it, he dispatched men to meet them, for the
men were greatly embarrassed. And the king gave orders: “Stop in
Jericho until your beards grow back; then you can return.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּרְאוּ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן כִּי נִבְאֲשׁוּ בְּדָוִד וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וַיִּשְׂכְּרוּ אֶת־אֲרַם בֵּית־רְחוֹב וְאֶת־אֲרַם צוֹבָא עֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף רַגְלִי וְאֶת־מֶלֶךְ מַעֲכָה
אֶלֶף אִישׁ וְאִישׁ טוֹב שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּרְאוּ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן כִּי נִבְאֲשׁוּ בְּדָוִד וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וַיִּשְׂכְּרוּ אֶת־אֲרַם בֵּית־רְחוֹב וְאֶת־אֲרַם צוֹבָא עֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף רַגְלִי וְאֶת־מֶלֶךְ מַעֲכָה
אֶלֶף אִישׁ וְאִישׁ טוֹב שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

english.text:
The Ammonites realized that they had incurred the wrath of David;
so the Ammonites sent agents and hired Arameans of Beth-rehob and
Arameans of Zobah—20,000 foot soldiers—the king of Maacah [with]
1,000 men, and 12,000 men from Tob.

translation.text: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Bethrehob and the Syrians of Zoba, twenty thousand footmen, and of king Maacah a thousand men, and of Ishtob twelve thousand men.

verses.english:
The Ammonites realized that they had incurred the wrath of David;
so the Ammonites sent agents and hired Arameans of Beth-rehob and
Arameans of Zobah—20,000 foot soldiers—the king of Maacah [with]
1,000 men, and 12,000 men from Tob.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת־יוֹאָב וְאֵת כּל־הַצָּבָא הַגִּבֹּרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת־יוֹאָב וְאֵת כּל־הַצָּבָא הַגִּבֹּרִים׃

english.text:
On learning this, David sent out Joab and the whole
army—[including] the professional fighters.

translation.text: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

verses.english:
On learning this, David sent out Joab and the whole
army—[including] the professional fighters.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיַּעַרְכוּ מִלְחָמָה פֶּתַח הַשָּׁעַר וַאֲרַם צוֹבָא וּרְחוֹב וְאִישׁ־טוֹב וּמַעֲכָה לְבַדָּם בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיַּעַרְכוּ מִלְחָמָה פֶּתַח הַשָּׁעַר וַאֲרַם צוֹבָא וּרְחוֹב וְאִישׁ־טוֹב וּמַעֲכָה לְבַדָּם בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
The Ammonites marched out and took up their battle position at the
entrance of the gate, while the Arameans of Zobah and Rehob and
the men of Tob and Maacah took their stand separately in the open.

translation.text: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate: and the Syrians of Zoba, and of Rehob, and Ishtob, and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.

verses.english:
The Ammonites marched out and took up their battle position at the
entrance of the gate, while the Arameans of Zobah and Rehob and
the men of Tob and Maacah took their stand separately in the open.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יוֹאָב כִּי־הָיְתָה אֵלָיו פְּנֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה מִפָּנִים וּמֵאָחוֹר וַיִּבְחַר מִכֹּל בְּחוּרֵי (בישראל) [יִשְׂרָאֵל] וַיַּעֲרֹךְ לִקְרַאת אֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא יוֹאָב כִּי־הָיְתָה אֵלָיו פְּנֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה מִפָּנִים וּמֵאָחוֹר וַיִּבְחַר מִכֹּל בְּחוּרֵי (בישראל) [יִשְׂרָאֵל] וַיַּעֲרֹךְ לִקְרַאת אֲרָם׃

english.text:
Joab saw that there was a battle line against him both front and
rear. So he made a selection from all the picked men of Israel and
arrayed them against the Arameans,

translation.text: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians:

verses.english:
Joab saw that there was a battle line against him both front and
rear. So he made a selection from all the picked men of Israel and
arrayed them against the Arameans,

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת יֶתֶר הָעָם נָתַן בְּיַד אַבְשַׁי אָחִיו וַיַּעֲרֹךְ לִקְרַאת בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת יֶתֶר הָעָם נָתַן בְּיַד אַבְשַׁי אָחִיו וַיַּעֲרֹךְ לִקְרַאת בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
and the rest of the troops he put under the command of his brother
Abishai and arrayed them against the Ammonites.

translation.text: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother, that he might put them in array against the children of Ammon.

verses.english:
and the rest of the troops he put under the command of his brother
Abishai and arrayed them against the Ammonites.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם־תֶּחֱזַק אֲרָם מִמֶּנִּי וְהָיִתָה לִּי לִישׁוּעָה וְאִם־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן יֶחֶזְקוּ מִמְּךָ וְהָלַכְתִּי לְהוֹשִׁיעַ לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם־תֶּחֱזַק אֲרָם מִמֶּנִּי וְהָיִתָה לִּי לִישׁוּעָה וְאִם־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן יֶחֶזְקוּ מִמְּךָ וְהָלַכְתִּי לְהוֹשִׁיעַ לָךְ׃

english.text:
[Joab] said, “If the Arameans prove too strong for me, you come to
my aid; and if the Ammonites prove too strong for you, I will come
to your aid.

translation.text: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will come and help thee.

verses.english:
[Joab] said, “If the Arameans prove too strong for me, you come to
my aid; and if the Ammonites prove too strong for you, I will come
to your aid.

verses.hebrew: חֲזַק וְנִתְחַזַּק בְּעַד־עַמֵּנוּ וּבְעַד עָרֵי אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַיהֹוָה יַעֲשֶׂה הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינָיו׃

hebrew.text: חֲזַק וְנִתְחַזַּק בְּעַד־עַמֵּנוּ וּבְעַד עָרֵי אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַיהֹוָה יַעֲשֶׂה הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינָיו׃

english.text:
Let us be strong and resolute for the sake of our people and the
land of our God; and YHWH will do what He deems right.”

translation.text: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the LORD do that which seemeth him good.

verses.english:
Let us be strong and resolute for the sake of our people and the
land of our God; and YHWH will do what He deems right.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ יוֹאָב וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה בַּאֲרָם וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגַּשׁ יוֹאָב וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה בַּאֲרָם וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפָּנָיו׃

english.text:
Joab and the troops with him marched into battle against the
Arameans, who fled before him.

translation.text: And Joab drew nigh, and the people that were with him, unto the battle against the Syrians: and they fled before him.

verses.english:
Joab and the troops with him marched into battle against the
Arameans, who fled before him.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן רָאוּ כִּי־נָס אֲרָם וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפְּנֵי אֲבִישַׁי וַיָּבֹאוּ הָעִיר וַיָּשׁב יוֹאָב מֵעַל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיָּבֹא יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן רָאוּ כִּי־נָס אֲרָם וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפְּנֵי אֲבִישַׁי וַיָּבֹאוּ הָעִיר וַיָּשׁב יוֹאָב מֵעַל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיָּבֹא יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
And when the Ammonites saw that the Arameans had fled, they fled
before Abishai and withdrew into the city. So Joab broke off the
attack against the Ammonites, and went to Jerusalem.

translation.text: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city. So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.

verses.english:
And when the Ammonites saw that the Arameans had fled, they fled
before Abishai and withdrew into the city. So Joab broke off the
attack against the Ammonites, and went to Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֲרָם כִּי נִגַּף לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּאָסְפוּ יָחַד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אֲרָם כִּי נִגַּף לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּאָסְפוּ יָחַד׃

english.text:
When the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they
regrouped their forces.

translation.text: And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Israel, they gathered themselves together.

verses.english:
When the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they
regrouped their forces.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הֲדַדְעֶזֶר וַיֹּצֵא אֶת־אֲרָם אֲשֶׁר מֵעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וַיָּבֹאוּ חֵילָם וְשׁוֹבַךְ שַׂר־צְבָא הֲדַדְעֶזֶר לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הֲדַדְעֶזֶר וַיֹּצֵא אֶת־אֲרָם אֲשֶׁר מֵעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וַיָּבֹאוּ חֵילָם וְשׁוֹבַךְ שַׂר־צְבָא הֲדַדְעֶזֶר לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Hadadezer sent for and brought out the Arameans from across the
Euphrates; they came to Helam, led by Shobach, Hadadezer’s army
commander.

translation.text: And Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that were beyond the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.

verses.english:
Hadadezer sent for and brought out the Arameans from across the
Euphrates; they came to Helam, led by Shobach, Hadadezer’s army
commander.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְדָוִד וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיָּבֹא חֵלָאמָה וַיַּעַרְכוּ אֲרָם לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לְדָוִד וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיָּבֹא חֵלָאמָה וַיַּעַרְכוּ אֲרָם לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עִמּוֹ׃

translation.text: And when it was told David, he gathered all Israel together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּנס אֲרָם מִפְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּהֲרֹג דָּוִד מֵאֲרָם שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף פָּרָשִׁים וְאֵת שׁוֹבַךְ שַׂר־צְבָאוֹ הִכָּה וַיָּמת שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּנס אֲרָם מִפְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּהֲרֹג דָּוִד מֵאֲרָם שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף פָּרָשִׁים וְאֵת שׁוֹבַךְ שַׂר־צְבָאוֹ הִכָּה וַיָּמת שָׁם׃

english.text:
but the Arameans were put to flight by Israel. David killed 700
Aramean charioteers and 40,000 horsemen; he also struck down
Shobach, Hadadezer’s army commander, who died there.

translation.text: And the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen, and smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there.

verses.english:
but the Arameans were put to flight by Israel. David killed 700
Aramean charioteers and 40,000 horsemen; he also struck down
Shobach, Hadadezer’s army commander, who died there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ כל־הַמְּלָכִים עַבְדֵי הֲדַדְעֶזֶר כִּי נִגְּפוּ לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּשְׁלִמוּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעַבְדוּם וַיִּרְאוּ אֲרָם לְהוֹשִׁיעַ עוֹד אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ כל־הַמְּלָכִים עַבְדֵי הֲדַדְעֶזֶר כִּי נִגְּפוּ לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּשְׁלִמוּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעַבְדוּם וַיִּרְאוּ אֲרָם לְהוֹשִׁיעַ עוֹד אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
And when all the vassal kings of Hadadezer saw that they had been
routed by Israel, they submitted to Israel and became their
vassals. And the Arameans were afraid to help the Ammonites any
more.

translation.text: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadarezer saw that they were smitten before Israel, they made peace with Israel, and served them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.

verses.english:
And when all the vassal kings of Hadadezer saw that they had been
routed by Israel, they submitted to Israel and became their
vassals. And the Arameans were afraid to help the Ammonites any
more.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי לִתְשׁוּבַת הַשָּׁנָה לְעֵת צֵאת הַמְּלָאכִים וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶת־יוֹאָב וְאֶת־עֲבָדָיו עִמּוֹ וְאֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּשְׁחִתוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיָּצֻרוּ
עַל־רַבָּה וְדָוִד יוֹשֵׁב בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי לִתְשׁוּבַת הַשָּׁנָה לְעֵת צֵאת הַמְּלָאכִים וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶת־יוֹאָב וְאֶת־עֲבָדָיו עִמּוֹ וְאֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּשְׁחִתוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיָּצֻרוּ
עַל־רַבָּה וְדָוִד יוֹשֵׁב בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם

english.text:
At the turn of the year, the season when kings go out [to battle],
David sent Joab with his officers and all Israel with him, and
they devastated Ammon and besieged Rabbah; David remained in
Jerusalem.

translation.text: And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth to battle, that David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem.

verses.english:
At the turn of the year, the season when kings go out [to battle],
David sent Joab with his officers and all Israel with him, and
they devastated Ammon and besieged Rabbah; David remained in
Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לְעֵת הָעֶרֶב וַיָּקם דָּוִד מֵעַל מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וַיִּתְהַלֵּךְ עַל־גַּג בֵּית־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּרְא אִשָּׁה רֹחֶצֶת מֵעַל הַגָּג וְהָאִשָּׁה טוֹבַת מַרְאֶה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לְעֵת הָעֶרֶב וַיָּקם דָּוִד מֵעַל מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וַיִּתְהַלֵּךְ עַל־גַּג בֵּית־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּרְא אִשָּׁה רֹחֶצֶת מֵעַל הַגָּג וְהָאִשָּׁה טוֹבַת מַרְאֶה מְאֹד׃

english.text:
Late one afternoon, David rose from his couch and strolled on the
roof of the royal palace; and from the roof he saw a woman
bathing. The woman was very beautiful,

translation.text: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king’s house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.

verses.english:
Late one afternoon, David rose from his couch and strolled on the
roof of the royal palace; and from the roof he saw a woman
bathing. The woman was very beautiful,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד וַיִּדְרֹשׁ לָאִשָּׁה וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא־זֹאת בַּת־שֶׁבַע בַּת־אֱלִיעָם אֵשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד וַיִּדְרֹשׁ לָאִשָּׁה וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא־זֹאת בַּת־שֶׁבַע בַּת־אֱלִיעָם אֵשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי׃

english.text:
and the king sent someone to make inquiries about the woman. He
reported, “She is Bathsheba daughter of Eliam [and] wife of Uriah
the Hittite.”

translation.text: And David sent and enquired after the woman. And one said, Is not this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?

verses.english:
and the king sent someone to make inquiries about the woman. He
reported, “She is Bathsheba daughter of Eliam [and] wife of Uriah
the Hittite.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד מַלְאָכִים וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַתָּבוֹא אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִמָּהּ וְהִיא מִתְקַדֶּשֶׁת מִטֻּמְאָתָהּ וַתָּשׁב אֶל־בֵּיתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד מַלְאָכִים וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַתָּבוֹא אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִמָּהּ וְהִיא מִתְקַדֶּשֶׁת מִטֻּמְאָתָהּ וַתָּשׁב אֶל־בֵּיתָהּ׃

english.text:
David sent messengers to fetch her; she came to him and he lay
with her—she had just purified herself after her period—and she
went back home.

translation.text: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house.

verses.english:
David sent messengers to fetch her; she came to him and he lay
with her—she had just purified herself after her period—and she
went back home.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר הָאִשָּׁה וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתַּגֵּד לְדָוִד וַתֹּאמֶר הָרָה אָנֹכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר הָאִשָּׁה וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתַּגֵּד לְדָוִד וַתֹּאמֶר הָרָה אָנֹכִי׃

english.text: The woman conceived, and she sent word to David, “I am pregnant.”

translation.text: And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I am with child.

verses.english: The woman conceived, and she sent word to David, “I am pregnant.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶל־יוֹאָב שְׁלַח אֵלַי אֶת־אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי וַיִּשְׁלַח יוֹאָב אֶת־אוּרִיָּה אֶל־דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶל־יוֹאָב שְׁלַח אֵלַי אֶת־אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי וַיִּשְׁלַח יוֹאָב אֶת־אוּרִיָּה אֶל־דָּוִד׃

english.text:
Thereupon David sent a message to Joab, “Send Uriah the Hittite to
me”; and Joab sent Uriah to David.

translation.text: And David sent to Joab, saying, Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab sent Uriah to David.

verses.english:
Thereupon David sent a message to Joab, “Send Uriah the Hittite to
me”; and Joab sent Uriah to David.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אוּרִיָּה אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד לִשְׁלוֹם יוֹאָב וְלִשְׁלוֹם הָעָם וְלִשְׁלוֹם הַמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אוּרִיָּה אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד לִשְׁלוֹם יוֹאָב וְלִשְׁלוֹם הָעָם וְלִשְׁלוֹם הַמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
When Uriah came to him, David asked him how Joab and the troops
were faring and how the war was going.

translation.text: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded of him how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.

verses.english:
When Uriah came to him, David asked him how Joab and the troops
were faring and how the war was going.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לְאוּרִיָּה רֵד לְבֵיתְךָ וּרְחַץ רַגְלֶיךָ וַיֵּצֵא אוּרִיָּה מִבֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתֵּצֵא אַחֲרָיו מַשְׂאַת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לְאוּרִיָּה רֵד לְבֵיתְךָ וּרְחַץ רַגְלֶיךָ וַיֵּצֵא אוּרִיָּה מִבֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתֵּצֵא אַחֲרָיו מַשְׂאַת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Then David said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and bathe your
feet.” When Uriah left the royal palace, a present from the king
followed him.

translation.text: And David said to Uriah, Go down to thy house, and wash thy feet. And Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and there followed him a mess of meat from the king.

verses.english:
Then David said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and bathe your
feet.” When Uriah left the royal palace, a present from the king
followed him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אוּרִיָּה פֶּתַח בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת כּל־עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנָיו וְלֹא יָרַד אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אוּרִיָּה פֶּתַח בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת כּל־עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנָיו וְלֹא יָרַד אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
But Uriah slept at the entrance of the royal palace, along with
the other officers of his lord, and did not go down to his house.

translation.text: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.

verses.english:
But Uriah slept at the entrance of the royal palace, along with
the other officers of his lord, and did not go down to his house.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר לֹא־יָרַד אוּרִיָּה אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אוּרִיָּה הֲלוֹא מִדֶּרֶךְ אַתָּה בָא מַדּוּעַ לֹא־יָרַדְתָּ אֶל־בֵּיתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר לֹא־יָרַד אוּרִיָּה אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אוּרִיָּה הֲלוֹא מִדֶּרֶךְ אַתָּה בָא מַדּוּעַ לֹא־יָרַדְתָּ אֶל־בֵּיתֶךָ׃

english.text:
When David was told that Uriah had not gone down to his house, he
said to Uriah, “You just came from a journey; why didn’t you go
down to your house?”

translation.text: And when they had told David, saying, Uriah went not down unto his house, David said unto Uriah, Camest thou not from thy journey? why then didst thou not go down unto thine house?

verses.english:
When David was told that Uriah had not gone down to his house, he
said to Uriah, “You just came from a journey; why didn’t you go
down to your house?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אוּרִיָּה אֶל־דָּוִד הָאָרוֹן וְיִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה יֹשְׁבִים בַּסֻּכּוֹת וַאדֹנִי יוֹאָב וְעַבְדֵי אֲדֹנִי עַל־פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה חֹנִים וַאֲנִי אָבוֹא אֶל־בֵּיתִי
לֶאֱכֹל וְלִשְׁתּוֹת וְלִשְׁכַּב עִם־אִשְׁתִּי חַיֶּךָ וְחֵי נַפְשֶׁךָ אִם־אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אוּרִיָּה אֶל־דָּוִד הָאָרוֹן וְיִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה יֹשְׁבִים בַּסֻּכּוֹת וַאדֹנִי יוֹאָב וְעַבְדֵי אֲדֹנִי עַל־פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה חֹנִים וַאֲנִי אָבוֹא אֶל־בֵּיתִי
לֶאֱכֹל וְלִשְׁתּוֹת וְלִשְׁכַּב עִם־אִשְׁתִּי חַיֶּךָ וְחֵי נַפְשֶׁךָ אִם־אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Uriah answered David, “The Ark and Israel and Judah are located at
Succoth, and my master Joab and Your Majesty’s men are camped in
the open; how can I go home and eat and drink and sleep with my
wife? As you live, by your very life, I will not do this!”

translation.text: And Uriah said unto David, The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? as thou livest, and as thy soul liveth, I will not do this thing.

verses.english:
Uriah answered David, “The Ark and Israel and Judah are located at
Succoth, and my master Joab and Your Majesty’s men are camped in
the open; how can I go home and eat and drink and sleep with my
wife? As you live, by your very life, I will not do this!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אוּרִיָּה שֵׁב בָּזֶה גַּם־הַיּוֹם וּמָחָר אֲשַׁלְּחֶךָּ וַיֵּשֶׁב אוּרִיָּה בִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וּמִמּחֳרָת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אוּרִיָּה שֵׁב בָּזֶה גַּם־הַיּוֹם וּמָחָר אֲשַׁלְּחֶךָּ וַיֵּשֶׁב אוּרִיָּה בִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וּמִמּחֳרָת׃

english.text:
David said to Uriah, “Stay here today also, and tomorrow I will
send you off.” So Uriah remained in Jerusalem that day. The next
day,

translation.text: And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let thee depart. So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the morrow.

verses.english:
David said to Uriah, “Stay here today also, and tomorrow I will
send you off.” So Uriah remained in Jerusalem that day. The next
day,

english.text:
David summoned him, and he ate and drank with him until he got him
drunk; but in the evening, [Uriah] went out to sleep in the same
place, with his lord’s officers; he did not go down to his home.

translation.text: And when David had called him, he did eat and drink before him; and he made him drunk: and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.

verses.english:
David summoned him, and he ate and drank with him until he got him

english.text:
In the morning, David wrote a letter to Joab, which he sent with
Uriah.

translation.text: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.

verses.english:
In the morning, David wrote a letter to Joab, which he sent with

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּב בַּסֵּפֶר לֵאמֹר הָבוּ אֶת־אוּרִיָּה אֶל־מוּל פְּנֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַחֲזָקָה וְשַׁבְתֶּם מֵאַחֲרָיו וְנִכָּה וָמֵת׃

english.text:
He wrote in the letter as follows: “Place Uriah in the front line
where the fighting is fiercest; then fall back so that he may be
killed.”

translation.text: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die.

verses.english:
He wrote in the letter as follows: “Place Uriah in the front line
where the fighting is fiercest; then fall back so that he may be
killed.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁמוֹר יוֹאָב אֶל־הָעִיר וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־אוּרִיָּה אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יָדַע כִּי אַנְשֵׁי־חַיִל שָׁם׃

So when Joab was besieging the city, he stationed Uriah at the
point where he knew that there were able warriors.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were.

verses.english:
So when Joab was besieging the city, he stationed Uriah at the
point where he knew that there were able warriors.

english.text:
The men of the city sallied out and attacked Joab, and some of
David’s officers among the troops fell; Uriah the Hittite was
among those who died.

translation.text: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell some of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.

verses.english:
The men of the city sallied out and attacked Joab, and some of
David’s officers among the troops fell; Uriah the Hittite was
among those who died.

to the king all about the battle,

the king may get angry and say to you, ‘Why did you come so close

the king may get angry and say to you, ‘Why did you come so close

english.text:
Who struck down Abimelech son of Jerubbesheth? Was it not a woman
who dropped an upper millstone on him from the wall at Thebez,
from which he died? Why did you come so close to the wall?’ Then
say: ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite was among those killed.’”

translation.text: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went ye nigh the wall? then say thou, Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.

verses.english:
Who struck down Abimelech son of Jerubbesheth? Was it not a woman
who dropped an upper millstone on him from the wall at Thebez,
from which he died? Why did you come so close to the wall?’ Then

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמַּלְאָךְ וַיָּבֹא וַיַּגֵּד לְדָוִד אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ יוֹאָב׃

sent him to say.

translation.text: So the messenger went, and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for.

verses.english:
The messenger set out; he came and told David all that Joab had
sent him to say.

up to the entrance to the gate.

verses.english:

and sallied out against us into the open; then we drove them back
up to the entrance to the gate.

toll. Press your attack on the city and destroy it!’ Encourage
him!”

translation.text: Then David said unto the messenger, Thus shalt thou say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease thee, for the sword devoureth one as well as another: make thy battle more strong against the city, and overthrow it: and encourage thou him.

verses.english: The rich man had very large flocks and herds,

verses.hebrew:
וְלָרָשׁ אֵין־כֹּל כִּי אִם־כִּבְשָׂה אַחַת קְטַנָּה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה וַיְחַיֶּהָ וַתִּגְדַּל עִמּוֹ וְעִם־בָּנָיו יַחְדָּו מִפִּתּוֹ תֹאכַל וּמִכֹּסוֹ תִשְׁתֶּה וּבְחֵיקוֹ תִשְׁכָּב
וַתְּהִי־לוֹ כְּבַת׃

hebrew.text:
וְלָרָשׁ אֵין־כֹּל כִּי אִם־כִּבְשָׂה אַחַת קְטַנָּה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה וַיְחַיֶּהָ וַתִּגְדַּל עִמּוֹ וְעִם־בָּנָיו יַחְדָּו מִפִּתּוֹ תֹאכַל וּמִכֹּסוֹ תִשְׁתֶּה וּבְחֵיקוֹ תִשְׁכָּב
וַתְּהִי־לוֹ כְּבַת׃

english.text:
but the poor man had only one little ewe lamb that he had bought.
He tended it and it grew up together with him and his children: it
used to share his morsel of bread, drink from his cup, and nestle
in his bosom; it was like a daughter to him.

translation.text: But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.

verses.english:
but the poor man had only one little ewe lamb that he had bought.
He tended it and it grew up together with him and his children: it
used to share his morsel of bread, drink from his cup, and nestle
in his bosom; it was like a daughter to him.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא הֵלֶךְ לְאִישׁ הֶעָשִׁיר וַיַּחְמֹל לָקַחַת מִצֹּאנוֹ וּמִבְּקָרוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת לָאֹרֵחַ הַבָּא־לוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־כִּבְשַׂת הָאִישׁ הָרָאשׁ וַיַּעֲשֶׂהָ לָאִישׁ הַבָּא
אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא הֵלֶךְ לְאִישׁ הֶעָשִׁיר וַיַּחְמֹל לָקַחַת מִצֹּאנוֹ וּמִבְּקָרוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת לָאֹרֵחַ הַבָּא־לוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־כִּבְשַׂת הָאִישׁ הָרָאשׁ וַיַּעֲשֶׂהָ לָאִישׁ הַבָּא
אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
One day, a traveler came to the rich man, but he was loath to take
anything from his own flocks or herds to prepare a meal for the
guest who had come to him; so he took the poor man’s lamb and
prepared it for the man who had come to him.”

translation.text: And there came a traveller unto the rich man, and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd, to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him; but took the poor man’s lamb, and dressed it for the man that was come to him.

verses.english:
One day, a traveler came to the rich man, but he was loath to take
anything from his own flocks or herds to prepare a meal for the
guest who had come to him; so he took the poor man’s lamb and
prepared it for the man who had come to him.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף דָּוִד בָּאִישׁ מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־נָתָן חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי בֶן־מָוֶת הָאִישׁ הָעֹשֶׂה זֹאת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר־אַף דָּוִד בָּאִישׁ מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־נָתָן חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי בֶן־מָוֶת הָאִישׁ הָעֹשֶׂה זֹאת׃

english.text:
David flew into a rage against the man, and said to Nathan, “As
YHWH lives, the man who did this deserves to die!

translation.text: And David’s anger was greatly kindled against the man; and he said to Nathan, As the LORD liveth, the man that hath done this thing shall surely die:

verses.english:
David flew into a rage against the man, and said to Nathan, “As
YHWH lives, the man who did this deserves to die!

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַכִּבְשָׂה יְשַׁלֵּם אַרְבַּעְתָּיִם עֵקֶב אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְעַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חָמָל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַכִּבְשָׂה יְשַׁלֵּם אַרְבַּעְתָּיִם עֵקֶב אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְעַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חָמָל׃

english.text:
He shall pay for the lamb four times over, because he did such a
thing and showed no pity.”

translation.text: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.

verses.english:
He shall pay for the lamb four times over, because he did such a
thing and showed no pity.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד אַתָּה הָאִישׁכֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָנֹכִי מְשַׁחְתִּיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָנֹכִי הִצַּלְתִּיךָ מִיַּד שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד אַתָּה הָאִישׁכֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָנֹכִי מְשַׁחְתִּיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָנֹכִי הִצַּלְתִּיךָ מִיַּד שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
And Nathan said to David, “That man is you! Thus said YHWH, the
God of Israel: ‘It was I who anointed you king over Israel and it
was I who rescued you from the hand of Saul.

translation.text: And Nathan said to David, Thou art the man. Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I anointed thee king over Israel, and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul;

verses.english:
And Nathan said to David, “That man is you! Thus said YHWH, the
God of Israel: ‘It was I who anointed you king over Israel and it
was I who rescued you from the hand of Saul.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אֶת־בֵּית אֲדֹנֶיךָ וְאֶת־נְשֵׁי אֲדֹנֶיךָ בְּחֵיקֶךָ וָאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה וְאִם־מְעָט וְאֹסִפָה לְּךָ כָּהֵנָּה וְכָהֵנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אֶת־בֵּית אֲדֹנֶיךָ וְאֶת־נְשֵׁי אֲדֹנֶיךָ בְּחֵיקֶךָ וָאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה וְאִם־מְעָט וְאֹסִפָה לְּךָ כָּהֵנָּה וְכָהֵנָּה׃

english.text:
I gave you your master’s house and possession of your master’s
wives; and I gave you the House of Israel and Judah; and if that
were not enough, I would give you twice as much more.

translation.text: And I gave thee thy master’s house, and thy master’s wives into thy bosom, and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that had been too little, I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things.

verses.english:
I gave you your master’s house and possession of your master’s
wives; and I gave you the House of Israel and Judah; and if that
were not enough, I would give you twice as much more.

verses.hebrew:
מַדּוּעַ בָּזִיתָ אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע (בעינו) [בְּעֵינַי] אֵת אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי הִכִּיתָ בַחֶרֶב וְאֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ לָקַחְתָּ לְּךָ לְאִשָּׁה וְאֹתוֹ הָרַגְתָּ
בְּחֶרֶב בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
מַדּוּעַ בָּזִיתָ אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע (בעינו) [בְּעֵינַי] אֵת אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי הִכִּיתָ בַחֶרֶב וְאֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ לָקַחְתָּ לְּךָ לְאִשָּׁה וְאֹתוֹ הָרַגְתָּ
בְּחֶרֶב בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
Why then have you flouted the command of YHWH and done what
displeases Him? You have put Uriah the Hittite to the sword; you
took his wife and made her your wife and had him killed by the
sword of the Ammonites.

translation.text: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the LORD, to do evil in his sight? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword, and hast taken his wife to be thy wife, and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

verses.english:
Why then have you flouted the command of YHWH and done what
displeases Him? You have put Uriah the Hittite to the sword; you
took his wife and made her your wife and had him killed by the
sword of the Ammonites.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לֹא־תָסוּר חֶרֶב מִבֵּיתְךָ עַד־עוֹלָם עֵקֶב כִּי בְזִתָנִי וַתִּקַּח אֶת־אֵשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי לִהְיוֹת לְךָ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לֹא־תָסוּר חֶרֶב מִבֵּיתְךָ עַד־עוֹלָם עֵקֶב כִּי בְזִתָנִי וַתִּקַּח אֶת־אֵשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי לִהְיוֹת לְךָ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
Therefore the sword shall never depart from your House—because you
spurned Me by taking the wife of Uriah the Hittite and making her
your wife.’

translation.text: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thine house; because thou hast despised me, and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife.

verses.english:
Therefore the sword shall never depart from your House—because you
spurned Me by taking the wife of Uriah the Hittite and making her
your wife.’

verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הִנְנִי מֵקִים עָלֶיךָ רָעָה מִבֵּיתֶךָ וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶת־נָשֶׁיךָ לְעֵינֶיךָ וְנָתַתִּי לְרֵעֶיךָ וְשָׁכַב עִם־נָשֶׁיךָ לְעֵינֵי הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הִנְנִי מֵקִים עָלֶיךָ רָעָה מִבֵּיתֶךָ וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶת־נָשֶׁיךָ לְעֵינֶיךָ וְנָתַתִּי לְרֵעֶיךָ וְשָׁכַב עִם־נָשֶׁיךָ לְעֵינֵי הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
Thus said YHWH: ‘I will make a calamity rise against you from
within your own house; I will take your wives and give them to
another man before your very eyes and he shall sleep with your
wives under this very sun.

translation.text: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will raise up evil against thee out of thine own house, and I will take thy wives before thine eyes, and give them unto thy neighbour, and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun.

verses.english:
Thus said YHWH: ‘I will make a calamity rise against you from
within your own house; I will take your wives and give them to
another man before your very eyes and he shall sleep with your
wives under this very sun.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ בַסָּתֶר וַאֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה נֶגֶד כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנֶגֶד הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ בַסָּתֶר וַאֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה נֶגֶד כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנֶגֶד הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

english.text:
You acted in secret, but I will make this happen in the sight of
all Israel and in broad daylight.’”

translation.text: For thou didst it secretly: but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.

verses.english:
You acted in secret, but I will make this happen in the sight of
all Israel and in broad daylight.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־נָתָן חָטָאתִי לַיהֹוָהוַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד גַּם־יְהֹוָה הֶעֱבִיר חַטָּאתְךָ לֹא תָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־נָתָן חָטָאתִי לַיהֹוָהוַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד גַּם־יְהֹוָה הֶעֱבִיר חַטָּאתְךָ לֹא תָמוּת׃

english.text:
David said to Nathan, “I stand guilty before YHWH!” And Nathan
replied to David, “YHWH has remitted your sin; you shall not die.

translation.text: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the LORD. And Nathan said unto David, The LORD also hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.

verses.english:
David said to Nathan, “I stand guilty before YHWH!” And Nathan
replied to David, “YHWH has remitted your sin; you shall not die.

verses.hebrew: אֶפֶס כִּי־נִאֵץ נִאַצְתָּ אֶת־אֹיְבֵי יְהֹוָה בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה גַּם הַבֵּן הַיִּלּוֹד לְךָ מוֹת יָמוּת׃

hebrew.text: אֶפֶס כִּי־נִאֵץ נִאַצְתָּ אֶת־אֹיְבֵי יְהֹוָה בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה גַּם הַבֵּן הַיִּלּוֹד לְךָ מוֹת יָמוּת׃

english.text:
However, since you have spurned the enemies of YHWH by this deed,
even the child about to be born to you shall die.”

translation.text: Howbeit, because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the LORD to blaspheme, the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die.

verses.english:
However, since you have spurned the enemies of YHWH by this deed,
even the child about to be born to you shall die.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ נָתָן אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּגֹּף יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַיֶּלֶד אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה אֵשֶׁת־אוּרִיָּה לְדָוִד וַיֵּאָנַשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ נָתָן אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּגֹּף יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַיֶּלֶד אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה אֵשֶׁת־אוּרִיָּה לְדָוִד וַיֵּאָנַשׁ׃

english.text:
Nathan went home, and YHWH afflicted the child that Uriah’s wife
had borne to David, and it became critically ill.

translation.text: And Nathan departed unto his house. And the LORD struck the child that Uriah’s wife bare unto David, and it was very sick.

verses.english:
Nathan went home, and YHWH afflicted the child that Uriah’s wife
had borne to David, and it became critically ill.

verses.hebrew: וַיְבַקֵּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִים בְּעַד הַנָּעַר וַיָּצם דָּוִד צוֹם וּבָא וְלָן וְשָׁכַב אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבַקֵּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִים בְּעַד הַנָּעַר וַיָּצם דָּוִד צוֹם וּבָא וְלָן וְשָׁכַב אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
David entreated God for the boy; David fasted, and he went in and
spent the night lying on the ground.

translation.text: David therefore besought God for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night upon the earth.

verses.english:
David entreated God for the boy; David fasted, and he went in and
spent the night lying on the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ זִקְנֵי בֵיתוֹ עָלָיו לַהֲקִימוֹ מִן־הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא אָבָה וְלֹא־בָרָא אִתָּם לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֻמוּ זִקְנֵי בֵיתוֹ עָלָיו לַהֲקִימוֹ מִן־הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא אָבָה וְלֹא־בָרָא אִתָּם לָחֶם׃

english.text:
The senior servants of his household tried to induce him to get up
from the ground; but he refused, nor would he partake of food with
them.

translation.text: And the elders of his house arose, and went to him, to raise him up from the earth: but he would not, neither did he eat bread with them.

verses.english:
The senior servants of his household tried to induce him to get up
from the ground; but he refused, nor would he partake of food with
them.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיָּמת הַיָּלֶד וַיִּרְאוּ עַבְדֵי דָוִד לְהַגִּיד לוֹ כִּי־מֵת הַיֶּלֶד כִּי אָמְרוּ הִנֵּה בִהְיוֹת הַיֶּלֶד חַי דִּבַּרְנוּ אֵלָיו וְלֹא־שָׁמַע
בְּקוֹלֵנוּ וְאֵיךְ נֹאמַר אֵלָיו מֵת הַיֶּלֶד וְעָשָׂה רָעָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיָּמת הַיָּלֶד וַיִּרְאוּ עַבְדֵי דָוִד לְהַגִּיד לוֹ כִּי־מֵת הַיֶּלֶד כִּי אָמְרוּ הִנֵּה בִהְיוֹת הַיֶּלֶד חַי דִּבַּרְנוּ אֵלָיו וְלֹא־שָׁמַע
בְּקוֹלֵנוּ וְאֵיךְ נֹאמַר אֵלָיו מֵת הַיֶּלֶד וְעָשָׂה רָעָה׃

english.text:
On the seventh day the child died. David’s servants were afraid to
tell David that the child was dead; for they said, “We spoke to
him when the child was alive and he wouldn’t listen to us; how can
we tell him that the child is dead? He might do something
terrible.”

translation.text: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that the child died. And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead: for they said, Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spake unto him, and he would not hearken unto our voice: how will he then vex himself, if we tell him that the child is dead?

verses.english:
On the seventh day the child died. David’s servants were afraid to
tell David that the child was dead; for they said, “We spoke to
him when the child was alive and he wouldn’t listen to us; how can
we tell him that the child is dead? He might do something
terrible.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא דָּוִד כִּי עֲבָדָיו מִתְלַחֲשִׁים וַיָּבֶן דָּוִד כִּי מֵת הַיָּלֶד וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הֲמֵת הַיֶּלֶד וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא דָּוִד כִּי עֲבָדָיו מִתְלַחֲשִׁים וַיָּבֶן דָּוִד כִּי מֵת הַיָּלֶד וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הֲמֵת הַיֶּלֶד וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵת׃

english.text:
When David saw his servants talking in whispers, David understood
that the child was dead; David asked his servants, “Is the child
dead?” “Yes,” they replied.

translation.text: But when David saw that his servants whispered, David perceived that the child was dead: therefore David said unto his servants, Is the child dead? And they said, He is dead.

verses.english:
When David saw his servants talking in whispers, David understood
that the child was dead; David asked his servants, “Is the child
dead?” “Yes,” they replied.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם דָּוִד מֵהָאָרֶץ וַיִּרְחַץ וַיָּסֶךְ וַיְחַלֵּף שִׂמְלֹתָו וַיָּבֹא בֵית־יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיָּבֹא אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּשְׁאַל וַיָּשִׂימוּ לוֹ לֶחֶם וַיֹּאכַל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם דָּוִד מֵהָאָרֶץ וַיִּרְחַץ וַיָּסֶךְ וַיְחַלֵּף שִׂמְלֹתָו וַיָּבֹא בֵית־יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיָּבֹא אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּשְׁאַל וַיָּשִׂימוּ לוֹ לֶחֶם וַיֹּאכַל׃

english.text:
Thereupon David rose from the ground; he bathed and anointed
himself, and he changed his clothes. He went into the House of
YHWH and prostrated himself. Then he went home and asked for food,
which they set before him, and he ate.

translation.text: Then David arose from the earth, and washed, and anointed himself, and changed his apparel, and came into the house of the LORD, and worshipped: then he came to his own house; and when he required, they set bread before him, and he did eat.

verses.english:
Thereupon David rose from the ground; he bathed and anointed
himself, and he changed his clothes. He went into the House of
YHWH and prostrated himself. Then he went home and asked for food,
which they set before him, and he ate.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲבָדָיו אֵלָיו מָה־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָה בַּעֲבוּר הַיֶּלֶד חַי צַמְתָּ וַתֵּבְךְּ וְכַאֲשֶׁר מֵת הַיֶּלֶד קַמְתָּ וַתֹּאכַל לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲבָדָיו אֵלָיו מָה־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָה בַּעֲבוּר הַיֶּלֶד חַי צַמְתָּ וַתֵּבְךְּ וְכַאֲשֶׁר מֵת הַיֶּלֶד קַמְתָּ וַתֹּאכַל לָחֶם׃

english.text:
His courtiers asked him, “Why have you acted in this manner? While
the child was alive, you fasted and wept; but now that the child
is dead, you rise and take food!”

translation.text: Then said his servants unto him, What thing is this that thou hast done? thou didst fast and weep for the child, while it was alive; but when the child was dead, thou didst rise and eat bread.

verses.english:
His courtiers asked him, “Why have you acted in this manner? While
the child was alive, you fasted and wept; but now that the child
is dead, you rise and take food!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בְּעוֹד הַיֶּלֶד חַי צַמְתִּי וָאֶבְכֶּה כִּי אָמַרְתִּי מִי יוֹדֵעַ (יחנני) [וְחַנַּנִי] יְהֹוָה וְחַי הַיָּלֶד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בְּעוֹד הַיֶּלֶד חַי צַמְתִּי וָאֶבְכֶּה כִּי אָמַרְתִּי מִי יוֹדֵעַ (יחנני) [וְחַנַּנִי] יְהֹוָה וְחַי הַיָּלֶד׃

english.text:
He replied, “While the child was still alive, I fasted and wept
because I thought: ‘Who knows? YHWH may have pity on me, and the
child may live.’

translation.text: And he said, While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept: for I said, Who can tell whether GOD will be gracious to me, that the child may live?

verses.english:
He replied, “While the child was still alive, I fasted and wept
because I thought: ‘Who knows? YHWH may have pity on me, and the
child may live.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה מֵת לָמָּה זֶּה אֲנִי צָם הַאוּכַל לַהֲשִׁיבוֹ עוֹד אֲנִי הֹלֵךְ אֵלָיו וְהוּא לֹא־יָשׁוּב אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה מֵת לָמָּה זֶּה אֲנִי צָם הַאוּכַל לַהֲשִׁיבוֹ עוֹד אֲנִי הֹלֵךְ אֵלָיו וְהוּא לֹא־יָשׁוּב אֵלָי׃

english.text:
But now that he is dead, why should I fast? Can I bring him back
again? I shall go to him, but he will never come back to me.”

translation.text: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.

verses.english:
But now that he is dead, why should I fast? Can I bring him back
again? I shall go to him, but he will never come back to me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְנַחֵם דָּוִד אֵת בַּת־שֶׁבַע אִשְׁתּוֹ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִמָּהּ וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן (ויקרא) [וַתִּקְרָא] אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיהֹוָה אֲהֵבוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְנַחֵם דָּוִד אֵת בַּת־שֶׁבַע אִשְׁתּוֹ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִמָּהּ וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן (ויקרא) [וַתִּקְרָא] אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיהֹוָה אֲהֵבוֹ׃

english.text:
David consoled his wife Bathsheba; he went to her and lay with
her. She bore a son and she named him Solomon. YHWH favored him,

translation.text: And David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in unto her, and lay with her: and she bare a son, and he called his name Solomon: and the LORD loved him.

verses.english:
David consoled his wife Bathsheba; he went to her and lay with
her. She bore a son and she named him Solomon. YHWH favored him,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח בְּיַד נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ יְדִידְיָהּ בַּעֲבוּר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח בְּיַד נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ יְדִידְיָהּ בַּעֲבוּר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and He sent a message through the prophet Nathan; and he was named
Jedidiah at the instance of YHWH.

translation.text: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet; and he called his name Jedidiah, because of the LORD.

verses.english:
and He sent a message through the prophet Nathan; and he was named
Jedidiah at the instance of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלָּחֶם יוֹאָב בְּרַבַּת בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־עִיר הַמְּלוּכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלָּחֶם יוֹאָב בְּרַבַּת בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־עִיר הַמְּלוּכָה׃

english.text: Joab attacked Rabbah of Ammon and captured the royal city.

translation.text: And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

verses.english: Joab attacked Rabbah of Ammon and captured the royal city.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יוֹאָב מַלְאָכִים אֶל־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר נִלְחַמְתִּי בְרַבָּה גַּם־לָכַדְתִּי אֶת־עִיר הַמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יוֹאָב מַלְאָכִים אֶל־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר נִלְחַמְתִּי בְרַבָּה גַּם־לָכַדְתִּי אֶת־עִיר הַמָּיִם׃

english.text:
Joab sent messengers to David and said, “I have attacked Rabbah
and I have already captured the water city.

translation.text: And Joab sent messengers to David, and said, I have fought against Rabbah, and have taken the city of waters.

verses.english:
Joab sent messengers to David and said, “I have attacked Rabbah
and I have already captured the water city.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֱסֹף אֶת־יֶתֶר הָעָם וַחֲנֵה עַל־הָעִיר וְלכְדָהּ פֶּן־אֶלְכֹּד אֲנִי אֶת־הָעִיר וְנִקְרָא שְׁמִי עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אֱסֹף אֶת־יֶתֶר הָעָם וַחֲנֵה עַל־הָעִיר וְלכְדָהּ פֶּן־אֶלְכֹּד אֲנִי אֶת־הָעִיר וְנִקְרָא שְׁמִי עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
Now muster the rest of the troops and besiege the city and capture
it; otherwise I will capture the city myself, and my name will be
connected with it.”

translation.text: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city, and take it: lest I take the city, and it be called after my name.

verses.english:
Now muster the rest of the troops and besiege the city and capture
it; otherwise I will capture the city myself, and my name will be
connected with it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱסֹף דָּוִד אֶת־כּל־הָעָם וַיֵּלֶךְ רַבָּתָה וַיִּלָּחֶם בָּהּ וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף דָּוִד אֶת־כּל־הָעָם וַיֵּלֶךְ רַבָּתָה וַיִּלָּחֶם בָּהּ וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ׃

english.text:
David mustered all the troops and marched on Rabbah, and he
attacked it and captured it.

translation.text: And David gathered all the people together, and went to Rabbah, and fought against it, and took it.

verses.english:
David mustered all the troops and marched on Rabbah, and he
attacked it and captured it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־עֲטֶרֶת־מַלְכָּם מֵעַל רֹאשׁוֹ וּמִשְׁקָלָהּ כִּכַּר זָהָב וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה וַתְּהִי עַל־רֹאשׁ דָּוִד וּשְׁלַל הָעִיר הוֹצִיא הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־עֲטֶרֶת־מַלְכָּם מֵעַל רֹאשׁוֹ וּמִשְׁקָלָהּ כִּכַּר זָהָב וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה וַתְּהִי עַל־רֹאשׁ דָּוִד וּשְׁלַל הָעִיר הוֹצִיא הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃

english.text:
The crown was taken from the head of their king and it was placed
on David’s head—it weighed a talent of gold, and [on it] were
precious stones. He also carried off a vast amount of booty from
the city.

translation.text: And he took their king’s crown from off his head, the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones: and it was set on David’s head. And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance.

verses.english:
The crown was taken from the head of their king and it was placed
on David’s head—it weighed a talent of gold, and [on it] were
precious stones. He also carried off a vast amount of booty from
the city.

verses.hebrew:
וְאֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ הוֹצִיא וַיָּשֶׂם בַּמְּגֵרָה וּבַחֲרִצֵי הַבַּרְזֶל וּבְמַגְזְרֹת הַבַּרְזֶל וְהֶעֱבִיר אוֹתָם (במלכן) [בַּמַּלְבֵּן] וְכֵן יַעֲשֶׂה לְכֹל עָרֵי
