בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וַיָּשׁב דָּוִד וְכל־הָעָם יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ הוֹצִיא וַיָּשֶׂם בַּמְּגֵרָה וּבַחֲרִצֵי הַבַּרְזֶל וּבְמַגְזְרֹת הַבַּרְזֶל וְהֶעֱבִיר אוֹתָם (במלכן) [בַּמַּלְבֵּן] וְכֵן יַעֲשֶׂה לְכֹל עָרֵי
בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וַיָּשׁב דָּוִד וְכל־הָעָם יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
He led out the people who lived there and set them to work with
saws, iron threshing boards, and iron axes, or assigned them to
brickmaking; David did this to all the towns of Ammon. Then David
and all the troops returned to Jerusalem.

translation.text: And he brought forth the people that were therein, and put them under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron, and made them pass through the brick-kiln: and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem.

verses.english:
He led out the people who lived there and set them to work with
saws, iron threshing boards, and iron axes, or assigned them to
brickmaking; David did this to all the towns of Ammon. Then David
and all the troops returned to Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וּלְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בֶּן־דָּוִד אָחוֹת יָפָה וּשְׁמָהּ תָּמָר וַיֶּאֱהָבֶהָ אַמְנוֹן בֶּן־דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וּלְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בֶּן־דָּוִד אָחוֹת יָפָה וּשְׁמָהּ תָּמָר וַיֶּאֱהָבֶהָ אַמְנוֹן בֶּן־דָּוִד׃

english.text:
This happened sometime afterward: Absalom son of David had a
beautiful sister named Tamar, and Amnon son of David became
infatuated with her.

translation.text: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom the son of David had a fair sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.

verses.english:
This happened sometime afterward: Absalom son of David had a
beautiful sister named Tamar, and Amnon son of David became
infatuated with her.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֶר לְאַמְנוֹן לְהִתְחַלּוֹת בַּעֲבוּר תָּמָר אֲחֹתוֹ כִּי בְתוּלָה הִיא וַיִּפָּלֵא בְּעֵינֵי אַמְנוֹן לַעֲשׂוֹת לָהּ מְאוּמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֶר לְאַמְנוֹן לְהִתְחַלּוֹת בַּעֲבוּר תָּמָר אֲחֹתוֹ כִּי בְתוּלָה הִיא וַיִּפָּלֵא בְּעֵינֵי אַמְנוֹן לַעֲשׂוֹת לָהּ מְאוּמָה׃

english.text:
Amnon was so distraught because of his [half-]sister Tamar that he
became sick; for she was a virgin, and it seemed impossible to
Amnon to do anything to her.

translation.text: And Amnon was so vexed, that he fell sick for his sister Tamar; for she was a virgin; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do anything to her.

verses.english:
Amnon was so distraught because of his [half-]sister Tamar that he
became sick; for she was a virgin, and it seemed impossible to
Amnon to do anything to her.

verses.hebrew: וּלְאַמְנוֹן רֵעַ וּשְׁמוֹ יוֹנָדָב בֶּן־שִׁמְעָה אֲחִי דָוִד וְיוֹנָדָב אִישׁ חָכָם מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וּלְאַמְנוֹן רֵעַ וּשְׁמוֹ יוֹנָדָב בֶּן־שִׁמְעָה אֲחִי דָוִד וְיוֹנָדָב אִישׁ חָכָם מְאֹד׃

english.text:
Amnon had a friend named Jonadab, the son of David’s brother
Shimah; Jonadab was a very clever man.

translation.text: But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David’s brother: and Jonadab was a very subtil man.

verses.english:
Amnon had a friend named Jonadab, the son of David’s brother
Shimah; Jonadab was a very clever man.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מַדּוּעַ אַתָּה כָּכָה דַּל בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר הֲלוֹא תַּגִּיד לִי וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַמְנוֹן אֶת־תָּמָר אֲחוֹת אַבְשָׁלֹם אָחִי אֲנִי אֹהֵב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מַדּוּעַ אַתָּה כָּכָה דַּל בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר הֲלוֹא תַּגִּיד לִי וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַמְנוֹן אֶת־תָּמָר אֲחוֹת אַבְשָׁלֹם אָחִי אֲנִי אֹהֵב׃

english.text:
He asked him, “Why are you so dejected, O prince, morning after
morning? Tell me!” Amnon replied, “I am in love with Tamar, the
sister of my brother Absalom!”

translation.text: And he said unto him, Why art thou, being the king’s son, lean from day to day? wilt thou not tell me? And Amnon said unto him, I love Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister.

verses.english:
He asked him, “Why are you so dejected, O prince, morning after
morning? Tell me!” Amnon replied, “I am in love with Tamar, the
sister of my brother Absalom!”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהוֹנָדָב שְׁכַב עַל־מִשְׁכָּבְךָ וְהִתְחָל וּבָא אָבִיךָ לִרְאוֹתֶךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו תָּבֹא נָא תָמָר אֲחוֹתִי וְתַבְרֵנִי לֶחֶם וְעָשְׂתָה לְעֵינַי
אֶת־הַבִּרְיָה לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֶרְאֶה וְאָכַלְתִּי מִיָּדָהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהוֹנָדָב שְׁכַב עַל־מִשְׁכָּבְךָ וְהִתְחָל וּבָא אָבִיךָ לִרְאוֹתֶךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו תָּבֹא נָא תָמָר אֲחוֹתִי וְתַבְרֵנִי לֶחֶם וְעָשְׂתָה לְעֵינַי
אֶת־הַבִּרְיָה לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֶרְאֶה וְאָכַלְתִּי מִיָּדָהּ׃

english.text:
Jonadab said to him, “Lie down in your bed and pretend you are
sick. When your father comes to see you, say to him, ‘Let my
sister Tamar come and give me something to eat. Let her prepare
the food in front of me, so that I may look on, and let her serve
it to me.’”

translation.text: And Jonadab said unto him, Lay thee down on thy bed, and make thyself sick: and when thy father cometh to see thee, say unto him, I pray thee, let my sister Tamar come, and give me meat, and dress the meat in my sight, that I may see it, and eat it at her hand.

verses.english:
Jonadab said to him, “Lie down in your bed and pretend you are
sick. When your father comes to see you, say to him, ‘Let my
sister Tamar come and give me something to eat. Let her prepare
the food in front of me, so that I may look on, and let her serve
it to me.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אַמְנוֹן וַיִּתְחָל וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ לִרְאוֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אַמְנוֹן אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ תָּבוֹא־נָא תָּמָר אֲחֹתִי וּתְלַבֵּב לְעֵינַי שְׁתֵּי לְבִבוֹת וְאֶבְרֶה מִיָּדָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אַמְנוֹן וַיִּתְחָל וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ לִרְאוֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אַמְנוֹן אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ תָּבוֹא־נָא תָּמָר אֲחֹתִי וּתְלַבֵּב לְעֵינַי שְׁתֵּי לְבִבוֹת וְאֶבְרֶה מִיָּדָהּ׃

english.text:
Amnon lay down and pretended to be sick. The king came to see him,
and Amnon said to the king, “Let my sister Tamar come and prepare
a couple of cakes in front of me, and let her bring them to me.”

translation.text: So Amnon lay down, and made himself sick: and when the king was come to see him, Amnon said unto the king, I pray thee, let Tamar my sister come, and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat at her hand.

verses.english:
Amnon lay down and pretended to be sick. The king came to see him,
and Amnon said to the king, “Let my sister Tamar come and prepare
a couple of cakes in front of me, and let her bring them to me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶל־תָּמָר הַבַּיְתָה לֵאמֹר לְכִי נָא בֵּית אַמְנוֹן אָחִיךְ וַעֲשִׂי־לוֹ הַבִּרְיָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶל־תָּמָר הַבַּיְתָה לֵאמֹר לְכִי נָא בֵּית אַמְנוֹן אָחִיךְ וַעֲשִׂי־לוֹ הַבִּרְיָה׃

english.text:
David sent a message to Tamar in the palace, “Please go to the
house of your brother Amnon and prepare some food for him.”

translation.text: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, Go now to thy brother Amnon’s house, and dress him meat.

verses.english:
David sent a message to Tamar in the palace, “Please go to the
house of your brother Amnon and prepare some food for him.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ תָּמָר בֵּית אַמְנוֹן אָחִיהָ וְהוּא שֹׁכֵב וַתִּקַּח אֶת־הַבָּצֵק (ותלוש) [וַתָּלשׁ] וַתְּלַבֵּב לְעֵינָיו וַתְּבַשֵּׁל אֶת־הַלְּבִבוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶךְ תָּמָר בֵּית אַמְנוֹן אָחִיהָ וְהוּא שֹׁכֵב וַתִּקַּח אֶת־הַבָּצֵק (ותלוש) [וַתָּלשׁ] וַתְּלַבֵּב לְעֵינָיו וַתְּבַשֵּׁל אֶת־הַלְּבִבוֹת׃

english.text:
Tamar went to the house of her brother Amnon, who was in bed. She
took dough and kneaded it into cakes in front of him, and cooked
the cakes.

translation.text: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house; and he was laid down. And she took flour, and kneaded it, and made cakes in his sight, and did bake the cakes.

verses.english:
Tamar went to the house of her brother Amnon, who was in bed. She
took dough and kneaded it into cakes in front of him, and cooked
the cakes.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח אֶת־הַמַּשְׂרֵת וַתִּצֹק לְפָנָיו וַיְמָאֵן לֶאֱכוֹל וַיֹּאמֶר אַמְנוֹן הוֹצִיאוּ כל־אִישׁ מֵעָלַי וַיֵּצְאוּ כל־אִישׁ מֵעָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקַּח אֶת־הַמַּשְׂרֵת וַתִּצֹק לְפָנָיו וַיְמָאֵן לֶאֱכוֹל וַיֹּאמֶר אַמְנוֹן הוֹצִיאוּ כל־אִישׁ מֵעָלַי וַיֵּצְאוּ כל־אִישׁ מֵעָלָיו׃

english.text:
She took the pan and set out [the cakes], but Amnon refused to eat
and ordered everyone to withdraw. After everyone had withdrawn,

translation.text: And she took a pan, and poured them out before him; but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, Have out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.

verses.english:
She took the pan and set out [the cakes], but Amnon refused to eat
and ordered everyone to withdraw. After everyone had withdrawn,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַמְנוֹן אֶל־תָּמָר הָבִיאִי הַבִּרְיָה הַחֶדֶר וְאֶבְרֶה מִיָּדֵךְ וַתִּקַּח תָּמָר אֶת־הַלְּבִבוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂתָה וַתָּבֵא לְאַמְנוֹן אָחִיהָ הֶחָדְרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַמְנוֹן אֶל־תָּמָר הָבִיאִי הַבִּרְיָה הַחֶדֶר וְאֶבְרֶה מִיָּדֵךְ וַתִּקַּח תָּמָר אֶת־הַלְּבִבוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂתָה וַתָּבֵא לְאַמְנוֹן אָחִיהָ הֶחָדְרָה׃

english.text:
Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food inside and feed me.” Tamar
took the cakes she had made and brought them to her brother
inside.

translation.text: And Amnon said unto Tamar, Bring the meat into the chamber, that I may eat of thine hand. And Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother.

verses.english:
Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food inside and feed me.” Tamar
took the cakes she had made and brought them to her brother
inside.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּגֵּשׁ אֵלָיו לֶאֱכֹל וַיַּחֲזֶק־בָּהּ וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ בּוֹאִי שִׁכְבִי עִמִּי אֲחוֹתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּגֵּשׁ אֵלָיו לֶאֱכֹל וַיַּחֲזֶק־בָּהּ וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ בּוֹאִי שִׁכְבִי עִמִּי אֲחוֹתִי׃

english.text:
But when she served them to him, he caught hold of her and said to
her, “Come lie with me, sister.”

translation.text: And when she had brought them unto him to eat, he took hold of her, and said unto her, Come lie with me, my sister.

verses.english:
But when she served them to him, he caught hold of her and said to
her, “Come lie with me, sister.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַל־אָחִי אַל־תְּעַנֵּנִי כִּי לֹא־יֵעָשֶׂה כֵן בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אַל־תַּעֲשֵׂה אֶת־הַנְּבָלָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַל־אָחִי אַל־תְּעַנֵּנִי כִּי לֹא־יֵעָשֶׂה כֵן בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אַל־תַּעֲשֵׂה אֶת־הַנְּבָלָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
But she said to him, “Don’t, brother. Don’t force me. Such things
are not done in Israel! Don’t do such a vile thing!

translation.text: And she answered him, Nay, my brother, do not force me; for no such thing ought to be done in Israel: do not thou this folly.

verses.english:
But she said to him, “Don’t, brother. Don’t force me. Such things
are not done in Israel! Don’t do such a vile thing!

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אָנָה אוֹלִיךְ אֶת־חֶרְפָּתִי וְאַתָּה תִּהְיֶה כְּאַחַד הַנְּבָלִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַתָּה דַּבֶּר־נָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי לֹא יִמְנָעֵנִי מִמֶּךָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲנִי אָנָה אוֹלִיךְ אֶת־חֶרְפָּתִי וְאַתָּה תִּהְיֶה כְּאַחַד הַנְּבָלִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַתָּה דַּבֶּר־נָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי לֹא יִמְנָעֵנִי מִמֶּךָּ׃

english.text:
Where will I carry my shame? And you, you will be like any of the
scoundrels in Israel! Please, speak to the king; he will not
refuse me to you.”

translation.text: And I, whither shall I cause my shame to go? and as for thee, thou shalt be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, I pray thee, speak unto the king; for he will not withhold me from thee.

verses.english:
Where will I carry my shame? And you, you will be like any of the
scoundrels in Israel! Please, speak to the king; he will not
refuse me to you.”

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא אָבָה לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹלָהּ וַיֶּחֱזַק מִמֶּנָּה וַיְעַנֶּהָ וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֹתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא אָבָה לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹלָהּ וַיֶּחֱזַק מִמֶּנָּה וַיְעַנֶּהָ וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֹתָהּ׃

english.text:
But he would not listen to her; he overpowered her and lay with
her by force.

translation.text: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.

verses.english:
But he would not listen to her; he overpowered her and lay with
her by force.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂנָאֶהָ אַמְנוֹן שִׂנְאָה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד כִּי גְדוֹלָה הַשִּׂנְאָה אֲשֶׁר שְׂנֵאָהּ מֵאַהֲבָה אֲשֶׁר אֲהֵבָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ אַמְנוֹן קוּמִי לֵכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׂנָאֶהָ אַמְנוֹן שִׂנְאָה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד כִּי גְדוֹלָה הַשִּׂנְאָה אֲשֶׁר שְׂנֵאָהּ מֵאַהֲבָה אֲשֶׁר אֲהֵבָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ אַמְנוֹן קוּמִי לֵכִי׃

english.text:
Then Amnon felt a very great loathing for her; indeed, his
loathing for her was greater than the passion he had felt for her.
And Amnon said to her, “Get out!”

translation.text: Then Amnon hated her exceedingly; so that the hatred wherewith he hated her was greater than the love wherewith he had loved her. And Amnon said unto her, Arise, be gone.

verses.english:
Then Amnon felt a very great loathing for her; indeed, his
loathing for her was greater than the passion he had felt for her.
And Amnon said to her, “Get out!”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַל־אוֹדֹת הָרָעָה הַגְּדוֹלָה הַזֹּאת מֵאַחֶרֶת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתָ עִמִּי לְשַׁלְּחֵנִי וְלֹא אָבָה לִשְׁמֹעַ לָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַל־אוֹדֹת הָרָעָה הַגְּדוֹלָה הַזֹּאת מֵאַחֶרֶת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתָ עִמִּי לְשַׁלְּחֵנִי וְלֹא אָבָה לִשְׁמֹעַ לָהּ׃

english.text:
She pleaded with him, “Please don’t commit this wrong; to send me
away would be even worse than the first wrong you committed
against me.” But he would not listen to her.

translation.text: And she said unto him, There is no cause: this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.

verses.english:
She pleaded with him, “Please don’t commit this wrong; to send me
away would be even worse than the first wrong you committed
against me.” But he would not listen to her.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־נַעֲרוֹ מְשָׁרְתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁלְחוּ־נָא אֶת־זֹאת מֵעָלַי הַחוּצָה וּנְעֹל הַדֶּלֶת אַחֲרֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־נַעֲרוֹ מְשָׁרְתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁלְחוּ־נָא אֶת־זֹאת מֵעָלַי הַחוּצָה וּנְעֹל הַדֶּלֶת אַחֲרֶיהָ׃

english.text:
He summoned his young attendant and said, “Get that woman out of
my presence, and bar the door behind her.”—

translation.text: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him, and said, Put now this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.

verses.english:
He summoned his young attendant and said, “Get that woman out of
my presence, and bar the door behind her.”—

verses.hebrew: וְעָלֶיהָ כְּתֹנֶת פַּסִּים כִּי כֵן תִּלְבַּשְׁןָ בְנוֹת־הַמֶּלֶךְ הַבְּתוּלֹת מְעִילִים וַיֹּצֵא אוֹתָהּ מְשָׁרְתוֹ הַחוּץ וְנָעַל הַדֶּלֶת אַחֲרֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְעָלֶיהָ כְּתֹנֶת פַּסִּים כִּי כֵן תִּלְבַּשְׁןָ בְנוֹת־הַמֶּלֶךְ הַבְּתוּלֹת מְעִילִים וַיֹּצֵא אוֹתָהּ מְשָׁרְתוֹ הַחוּץ וְנָעַל הַדֶּלֶת אַחֲרֶיהָ׃

english.text:
She was wearing an ornamented tunic, for maiden princesses were
customarily dressed in such garments. —His attendant took her
outside and barred the door after her.

translation.text: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her: for with such robes were the king’s daughters that were virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.

verses.english:
She was wearing an ornamented tunic, for maiden princesses were
customarily dressed in such garments. —His attendant took her
outside and barred the door after her.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח תָּמָר אֵפֶר עַל־רֹאשָׁהּ וּכְתֹנֶת הַפַּסִּים אֲשֶׁר עָלֶיהָ קָרָעָה וַתָּשֶׂם יָדָהּ עַל־רֹאשָׁהּ וַתֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וְזָעָקָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקַּח תָּמָר אֵפֶר עַל־רֹאשָׁהּ וּכְתֹנֶת הַפַּסִּים אֲשֶׁר עָלֶיהָ קָרָעָה וַתָּשֶׂם יָדָהּ עַל־רֹאשָׁהּ וַתֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וְזָעָקָה׃

english.text:
Tamar put dust on her head and rent the ornamented tunic she was
wearing; she put her hands on her head, and walked away, screaming
loudly as she went.

translation.text: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.

verses.english:
Tamar put dust on her head and rent the ornamented tunic she was
wearing; she put her hands on her head, and walked away, screaming
loudly as she went.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אַבְשָׁלוֹם אָחִיהָ הַאֲמִינוֹן אָחִיךְ הָיָה עִמָּךְ וְעַתָּה אֲחוֹתִי הַחֲרִישִׁי אָחִיךְ הוּא אַל־תָּשִׁיתִי אֶת־לִבֵּךְ לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַתֵּשֶׁב תָּמָר
וְשֹׁמֵמָה בֵּית אַבְשָׁלוֹם אָחִיהָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אַבְשָׁלוֹם אָחִיהָ הַאֲמִינוֹן אָחִיךְ הָיָה עִמָּךְ וְעַתָּה אֲחוֹתִי הַחֲרִישִׁי אָחִיךְ הוּא אַל־תָּשִׁיתִי אֶת־לִבֵּךְ לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַתֵּשֶׁב תָּמָר
וְשֹׁמֵמָה בֵּית אַבְשָׁלוֹם אָחִיהָ׃

english.text:
Her brother Absalom said to her, “Was it your brother Amnon who
did this to you? For the present, sister, keep quiet about it; he
is your brother. Don’t brood over the matter.” And Tamar remained
in her brother Absalom’s house, forlorn.

translation.text: And Absalom her brother said unto her, Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee? but hold now thy peace, my sister: he is thy brother; regard not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom’s house.

verses.english:
Her brother Absalom said to her, “Was it your brother Amnon who
did this to you? For the present, sister, keep quiet about it; he
is your brother. Don’t brood over the matter.” And Tamar remained
in her brother Absalom’s house, forlorn.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד שָׁמַע אֵת כּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּחַר לוֹ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד שָׁמַע אֵת כּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּחַר לוֹ מְאֹד׃

english.text: When King David heard about all this, he was greatly upset.

translation.text: But when king David heard of all these things, he was very wroth.

verses.english: When King David heard about all this, he was greatly upset.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־דִבֶּר אַבְשָׁלוֹם עִם־אַמְנוֹן לְמֵרָע וְעַד־טוֹב כִּי־שָׂנֵא אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־אַמְנוֹן עַל־דְּבַר אֲשֶׁר עִנָּה אֵת תָּמָר אֲחֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־דִבֶּר אַבְשָׁלוֹם עִם־אַמְנוֹן לְמֵרָע וְעַד־טוֹב כִּי־שָׂנֵא אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־אַמְנוֹן עַל־דְּבַר אֲשֶׁר עִנָּה אֵת תָּמָר אֲחֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
Absalom didn’t utter a word to Amnon, good or bad; but Absalom
hated Amnon because he had violated his sister Tamar.

translation.text: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.

verses.english:
Absalom didn’t utter a word to Amnon, good or bad; but Absalom
hated Amnon because he had violated his sister Tamar.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִשְׁנָתַיִם יָמִים וַיִּהְיוּ גֹזְזִים לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּבַעַל חָצוֹר אֲשֶׁר עִם־אֶפְרָיִם וַיִּקְרָא אַבְשָׁלוֹם לְכל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לִשְׁנָתַיִם יָמִים וַיִּהְיוּ גֹזְזִים לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּבַעַל חָצוֹר אֲשֶׁר עִם־אֶפְרָיִם וַיִּקְרָא אַבְשָׁלוֹם לְכל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Two years later, when Absalom was having his flocks sheared at
Baal-hazor near Ephraim, Absalom invited all the king’s sons.

translation.text: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baalhazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.

verses.english:
Two years later, when Absalom was having his flocks sheared at
Baal-hazor near Ephraim, Absalom invited all the king’s sons.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־נָא גֹזְזִים לְעַבְדֶּךָ יֵלֶךְ־נָא הַמֶּלֶךְ וַעֲבָדָיו עִם־עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־נָא גֹזְזִים לְעַבְדֶּךָ יֵלֶךְ־נָא הַמֶּלֶךְ וַעֲבָדָיו עִם־עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And Absalom came to the king and said, “Your servant is having his
flocks sheared. Would Your Majesty and your retinue accompany your
servant?”

translation.text: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheepshearers; let the king, I beseech thee, and his servants go with thy servant.

verses.english:
And Absalom came to the king and said, “Your servant is having his
flocks sheared. Would Your Majesty and your retinue accompany your
servant?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם אַל־בְּנִי אַל־נָא נֵלֵךְ כֻּלָּנוּ וְלֹא נִכְבַּד עָלֶיךָ וַיִּפְרץ־בּוֹ וְלֹא־אָבָה לָלֶכֶת וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם אַל־בְּנִי אַל־נָא נֵלֵךְ כֻּלָּנוּ וְלֹא נִכְבַּד עָלֶיךָ וַיִּפְרץ־בּוֹ וְלֹא־אָבָה לָלֶכֶת וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ׃

english.text:
But the king answered Absalom, “No, my son. We must not all come,
or we’ll be a burden to you.” He urged him, but he would not go,
and he said good-bye to him.

translation.text: And the king said to Absalom, Nay, my son, let us not all now go, lest we be chargeable unto thee. And he pressed him: howbeit he would not go, but blessed him.

verses.english:
But the king answered Absalom, “No, my son. We must not all come,
or we’ll be a burden to you.” He urged him, but he would not go,
and he said good-bye to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם וָלֹא יֵלֶךְ־נָא אִתָּנוּ אַמְנוֹן אָחִי וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה יֵלֵךְ עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם וָלֹא יֵלֶךְ־נָא אִתָּנוּ אַמְנוֹן אָחִי וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה יֵלֵךְ עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
Thereupon Absalom said, “In that case, let my brother Amnon come
with us,” to which the king replied, “He shall not go with you.”

translation.text: Then said Absalom, If not, I pray thee, let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said unto him, Why should he go with thee?

verses.english:
Thereupon Absalom said, “In that case, let my brother Amnon come
with us,” to which the king replied, “He shall not go with you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְרץ־בּוֹ אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיִּשְׁלַח אִתּוֹ אֶת־אַמְנוֹן וְאֵת כּל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְרץ־בּוֹ אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיִּשְׁלַח אִתּוֹ אֶת־אַמְנוֹן וְאֵת כּל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
But Absalom urged him, and he sent with him Amnon and all the
other princes.

translation.text: But Absalom pressed him, that he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.

verses.english:
But Absalom urged him, and he sent with him Amnon and all the
other princes.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְצַו אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־נְעָרָיו לֵאמֹר רְאוּ נָא כְּטוֹב לֵב־אַמְנוֹן בַּיַּיִן וְאָמַרְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם הַכּוּ אֶת־אַמְנוֹן וַהֲמִתֶּם אֹתוֹ אַל־תִּירָאוּ הֲלוֹא כִּי אָנֹכִי
צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם חִזְקוּ וִהְיוּ לִבְנֵי־חָיִל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְצַו אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־נְעָרָיו לֵאמֹר רְאוּ נָא כְּטוֹב לֵב־אַמְנוֹן בַּיַּיִן וְאָמַרְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם הַכּוּ אֶת־אַמְנוֹן וַהֲמִתֶּם אֹתוֹ אַל־תִּירָאוּ הֲלוֹא כִּי אָנֹכִי
צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם חִזְקוּ וִהְיוּ לִבְנֵי־חָיִל׃

english.text:
Now Absalom gave his attendants these orders: “Watch, and when
Amnon is merry with wine and I tell you to strike down Amnon, kill
him! Don’t be afraid, for it is I who give you the order. Act with
determination, like brave men!”

translation.text: Now Absalom had commanded his servants, saying, Mark ye now when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine, and when I say unto you, Smite Amnon; then kill him, fear not: have not I commanded you? be courageous, and be valiant.

verses.english:
Now Absalom gave his attendants these orders: “Watch, and when
Amnon is merry with wine and I tell you to strike down Amnon, kill
him! Don’t be afraid, for it is I who give you the order. Act with
determination, like brave men!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ נַעֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם לְאַמְנוֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיָּקֻמוּ כּל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּרְכְּבוּ אִישׁ עַל־פִּרְדּוֹ וַיָּנֻסוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ נַעֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם לְאַמְנוֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיָּקֻמוּ כּל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּרְכְּבוּ אִישׁ עַל־פִּרְדּוֹ וַיָּנֻסוּ׃

english.text:
Absalom’s attendants did to Amnon as Absalom had ordered;
whereupon all the other princes mounted their mules and fled.

translation.text: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded.

verses.english:
Absalom’s attendants did to Amnon as Absalom had ordered;
whereupon all the other princes mounted their mules and fled.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הֵמָּה בַדֶּרֶךְ וְהַשְּׁמֻעָה בָאָה אֶל־דָּוִד לֵאמֹר הִכָּה אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־כּל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלֹא־נוֹתַר מֵהֶם אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הֵמָּה בַדֶּרֶךְ וְהַשְּׁמֻעָה בָאָה אֶל־דָּוִד לֵאמֹר הִכָּה אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־כּל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלֹא־נוֹתַר מֵהֶם אֶחָד׃

english.text:
They were still on the road when a rumor reached David that
Absalom had killed all the princes, and that not one of them had
survived.

translation.text: And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that tidings came to David, saying, Absalom hath slain all the king’s sons, and there is not one of them left.

verses.english:
They were still on the road when a rumor reached David that
Absalom had killed all the princes, and that not one of them had
survived.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיִּשְׁכַּב אָרְצָה וְכל־עֲבָדָיו נִצָּבִים קְרֻעֵי בְגָדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיִּשְׁכַּב אָרְצָה וְכל־עֲבָדָיו נִצָּבִים קְרֻעֵי בְגָדִים׃

english.text:
At this, David rent his garment and lay down on the ground, and
all his courtiers stood by with their clothes rent.

translation.text: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.

verses.english:
At this, David rent his garment and lay down on the ground, and
all his courtiers stood by with their clothes rent.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן יוֹנָדָב בֶּן־שִׁמְעָה אֲחִי־דָוִד וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־יֹאמַר אֲדֹנִי אֵת כּל־הַנְּעָרִים בְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ הֵמִיתוּ כִּי־אַמְנוֹן לְבַדּוֹ מֵת כִּי־עַל־פִּי אַבְשָׁלוֹם הָיְתָה
שׂוּמָה מִיּוֹם עַנֹּתוֹ אֵת תָּמָר אֲחֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן יוֹנָדָב בֶּן־שִׁמְעָה אֲחִי־דָוִד וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־יֹאמַר אֲדֹנִי אֵת כּל־הַנְּעָרִים בְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ הֵמִיתוּ כִּי־אַמְנוֹן לְבַדּוֹ מֵת כִּי־עַל־פִּי אַבְשָׁלוֹם הָיְתָה
שׂוּמָה מִיּוֹם עַנֹּתוֹ אֵת תָּמָר אֲחֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
But Jonadab, the son of David’s brother Shimah, said, “My lord
must not think that all the young princes have been killed. Only
Amnon is dead; for this has been decided by Absalom ever since his
sister Tamar was violated.

translation.text: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David’s brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king’s sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.

verses.english:
But Jonadab, the son of David’s brother Shimah, said, “My lord
must not think that all the young princes have been killed. Only
Amnon is dead; for this has been decided by Absalom ever since his
sister Tamar was violated.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אַל־יָשֵׂם אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־לִבּוֹ דָּבָר לֵאמֹר כּל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ מֵתוּ כִּי־(אם)־אַמְנוֹן לְבַדּוֹ מֵת׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אַל־יָשֵׂם אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־לִבּוֹ דָּבָר לֵאמֹר כּל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ מֵתוּ כִּי־(אם)־אַמְנוֹן לְבַדּוֹ מֵת׃

english.text:
So my lord the king must not think for a moment that all the
princes are dead; Amnon alone is dead.”

translation.text: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.

verses.english:
So my lord the king must not think for a moment that all the
princes are dead; Amnon alone is dead.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְרַח אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיִּשָּׂא הַנַּעַר הַצֹּפֶה אֶת־עֵינָו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה עַם־רַב הֹלְכִים מִדֶּרֶךְ אַחֲרָיו מִצַּד הָהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְרַח אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיִּשָּׂא הַנַּעַר הַצֹּפֶה אֶת־עֵינָו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה עַם־רַב הֹלְכִים מִדֶּרֶךְ אַחֲרָיו מִצַּד הָהָר׃

english.text:
Meanwhile Absalom had fled. The watchman on duty looked up and saw
a large crowd coming from the road to his rear, from the side of
the hill.

translation.text: But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him.

verses.english:
Meanwhile Absalom had fled. The watchman on duty looked up and saw
a large crowd coming from the road to his rear, from the side of
the hill.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹנָדָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה בְנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ בָּאוּ כִּדְבַר עַבְדְּךָ כֵּן הָיָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹנָדָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה בְנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ בָּאוּ כִּדְבַר עַבְדְּךָ כֵּן הָיָה׃

english.text:
Jonadab said to the king, “See, the princes have come! It is just
as your servant said.”

translation.text: And Jonadab said unto the king, Behold, the king’s sons come: as thy servant said, so it is.

verses.english:
Jonadab said to the king, “See, the princes have come! It is just
as your servant said.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר וְהִנֵּה בְנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ בָּאוּ וַיִּשְׂאוּ קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ וְגַם־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־עֲבָדָיו בָּכוּ בְּכִי גָּדוֹל מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר וְהִנֵּה בְנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ בָּאוּ וַיִּשְׂאוּ קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ וְגַם־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־עֲבָדָיו בָּכוּ בְּכִי גָּדוֹל מְאֹד׃

english.text:
As he finished speaking, the princes came in and broke into
weeping; and David and all his courtiers wept bitterly, too.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of speaking, that, behold, the king’s sons came, and lifted up their voice and wept: and the king also and all his servants wept very sore.

verses.english:
As he finished speaking, the princes came in and broke into
weeping; and David and all his courtiers wept bitterly, too.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בָּרַח וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־תַּלְמַי בֶּן־[עַמִּיהוּד] (עמיחור) מֶלֶךְ גְּשׁוּר וַיִּתְאַבֵּל עַל־בְּנוֹ כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בָּרַח וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־תַּלְמַי בֶּן־[עַמִּיהוּד] (עמיחור) מֶלֶךְ גְּשׁוּר וַיִּתְאַבֵּל עַל־בְּנוֹ כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
Absalom had fled, and he came to Talmai son of Ammihud, king of
Geshur. And [King David] mourned over his son a long time.

translation.text: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And David mourned for his son every day.

verses.english:
Absalom had fled, and he came to Talmai son of Ammihud, king of
Geshur. And [King David] mourned over his son a long time.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בָּרַח וַיֵּלֶךְ גְּשׁוּר וַיְהִי־שָׁם שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בָּרַח וַיֵּלֶךְ גְּשׁוּר וַיְהִי־שָׁם שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים׃

english.text: Absalom, who had fled to Geshur, remained there three years.

translation.text: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

verses.english: Absalom, who had fled to Geshur, remained there three years.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּכַל דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ לָצֵאת אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם כִּי־נִחַם עַל־אַמְנוֹן כִּי־מֵת׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּכַל דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ לָצֵאת אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם כִּי־נִחַם עַל־אַמְנוֹן כִּי־מֵת׃

english.text:
And King David was pining away for Absalom, for [the king] had
gotten over Amnon’s death.

translation.text: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.

verses.english:
And King David was pining away for Absalom, for [the king] had
gotten over Amnon’s death.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּדַע יוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרֻיָה כִּי־לֵב הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּדַע יוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרֻיָה כִּי־לֵב הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text: Joab son of Zeruiah could see that the king’s mind was on Absalom;

translation.text: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was toward Absalom.

verses.english: Joab son of Zeruiah could see that the king’s mind was on Absalom;

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח יוֹאָב תְּקוֹעָה וַיִּקַּח מִשָּׁם אִשָּׁה חֲכָמָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ הִתְאַבְּלִי־נָא וְלִבְשִׁי־נָא בִגְדֵי־אֵבֶל וְאַל־תָּסוּכִי שֶׁמֶן וְהָיִית כְּאִשָּׁה זֶה יָמִים
רַבִּים מִתְאַבֶּלֶת עַל־מֵת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח יוֹאָב תְּקוֹעָה וַיִּקַּח מִשָּׁם אִשָּׁה חֲכָמָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ הִתְאַבְּלִי־נָא וְלִבְשִׁי־נָא בִגְדֵי־אֵבֶל וְאַל־תָּסוּכִי שֶׁמֶן וְהָיִית כְּאִשָּׁה זֶה יָמִים
רַבִּים מִתְאַבֶּלֶת עַל־מֵת׃

english.text:
so Joab sent to Tekoa and brought a clever woman from there. He
said to her, “Pretend you are in mourning; put on mourning clothes
and don’t anoint yourself with oil; and act like a woman who has
grieved a long time over a departed one.

translation.text: And Joab sent to Tekoah, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said unto her, I pray thee, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on now mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead:

verses.english:
so Joab sent to Tekoa and brought a clever woman from there. He
said to her, “Pretend you are in mourning; put on mourning clothes
and don’t anoint yourself with oil; and act like a woman who has
grieved a long time over a departed one.

verses.hebrew: וּבָאת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְדִבַּרְתְּ אֵלָיו כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיָּשֶׂם יוֹאָב אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים בְּפִיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וּבָאת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְדִבַּרְתְּ אֵלָיו כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיָּשֶׂם יוֹאָב אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים בְּפִיהָ׃

english.text:
Go to the king and say to him thus and thus.” And Joab told her
what to say.

translation.text: And come to the king, and speak on this manner unto him. So Joab put the words in her mouth.

verses.english:
Go to the king and say to him thus and thus.” And Joab told her
what to say.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַתְּקֹעִית אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתִּפֹּל עַל־אַפֶּיהָ אַרְצָה וַתִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַתֹּאמֶר הוֹשִׁעָה הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַתְּקֹעִית אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתִּפֹּל עַל־אַפֶּיהָ אַרְצָה וַתִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַתֹּאמֶר הוֹשִׁעָה הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The woman of Tekoa came to the king, flung herself face down to
the ground, and prostrated herself. She cried out, “Help, O king!”

translation.text: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.

verses.english:
The woman of Tekoa came to the king, flung herself face down to
the ground, and prostrated herself. She cried out, “Help, O king!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ מַה־לָּךְ וַתֹּאמֶר אֲבָל אִשָּׁה־אַלְמָנָה אָנִי וַיָּמת אִישִׁי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ מַה־לָּךְ וַתֹּאמֶר אֲבָל אִשָּׁה־אַלְמָנָה אָנִי וַיָּמת אִישִׁי׃

english.text:
The king asked her, “What troubles you?” And she answered, “Alas,
I am a widow, my husband is dead.

translation.text: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, I am indeed a widow woman, and mine husband is dead.

verses.english:
The king asked her, “What troubles you?” And she answered, “Alas,
I am a widow, my husband is dead.

verses.hebrew: וּלְשִׁפְחָתְךָ שְׁנֵי בָנִים וַיִּנָּצוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם בַּשָּׂדֶה וְאֵין מַצִּיל בֵּינֵיהֶם וַיַּכּוֹ הָאֶחָד אֶת־הָאֶחָד וַיָּמֶת אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּלְשִׁפְחָתְךָ שְׁנֵי בָנִים וַיִּנָּצוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם בַּשָּׂדֶה וְאֵין מַצִּיל בֵּינֵיהֶם וַיַּכּוֹ הָאֶחָד אֶת־הָאֶחָד וַיָּמֶת אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
Your maidservant had two sons. The two of them came to blows out
in the fields where there was no one to stop them, and one of them
struck the other and killed him.

translation.text: And thy handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, and slew him.

verses.english:
Your maidservant had two sons. The two of them came to blows out
in the fields where there was no one to stop them, and one of them
struck the other and killed him.

verses.hebrew:
וְהִנֵּה קָמָה כל־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה עַל־שִׁפְחָתֶךָ וַיֹּאמְרוּ תְּנִי אֶת־מַכֵּה אָחִיו וּנְמִתֵהוּ בְּנֶפֶשׁ אָחִיו אֲשֶׁר הָרָג וְנַשְׁמִידָה גַּם אֶת־הַיּוֹרֵשׁ וְכִבּוּ
אֶת־גַּחַלְתִּי אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁאָרָה לְבִלְתִּי (שום) [שִׂים־]לְאִישִׁי שֵׁם וּשְׁאֵרִית עַל־פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִנֵּה קָמָה כל־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה עַל־שִׁפְחָתֶךָ וַיֹּאמְרוּ תְּנִי אֶת־מַכֵּה אָחִיו וּנְמִתֵהוּ בְּנֶפֶשׁ אָחִיו אֲשֶׁר הָרָג וְנַשְׁמִידָה גַּם אֶת־הַיּוֹרֵשׁ וְכִבּוּ
אֶת־גַּחַלְתִּי אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁאָרָה לְבִלְתִּי (שום) [שִׂים־]לְאִישִׁי שֵׁם וּשְׁאֵרִית עַל־פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
Then the whole clan confronted your maidservant and said, ‘Hand
over the one who killed his brother, that we may put him to death
for the slaying of his brother, even though we wipe out the heir.’
Thus they would quench the last ember remaining to me, and leave
my husband without name or remnant upon the earth.”

translation.text: And, behold, the whole family is risen against thine handmaid, and they said, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the life of his brother whom he slew; and we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to my husband neither name nor remainder upon the earth.

verses.english:
Then the whole clan confronted your maidservant and said, ‘Hand
over the one who killed his brother, that we may put him to death
for the slaying of his brother, even though we wipe out the heir.’
Thus they would quench the last ember remaining to me, and leave
my husband without name or remnant upon the earth.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה לְכִי לְבֵיתֵךְ וַאֲנִי אֲצַוֶּה עָלָיִךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה לְכִי לְבֵיתֵךְ וַאֲנִי אֲצַוֶּה עָלָיִךְ׃

english.text:
The king said to the woman, “Go home. I will issue an order in
your behalf.”

translation.text: And the king said unto the woman, Go to thine house, and I will give charge concerning thee.

verses.english:
The king said to the woman, “Go home. I will issue an order in
your behalf.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַתְּקוֹעִית אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלַי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הֶעָוֺן וְעַל־בֵּית אָבִי וְהַמֶּלֶךְ וְכִסְאוֹ נָקִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַתְּקוֹעִית אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלַי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הֶעָוֺן וְעַל־בֵּית אָבִי וְהַמֶּלֶךְ וְכִסְאוֹ נָקִי׃

english.text:
And the woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord king, may the
guilt be on me and on my ancestral house; Your Majesty and his
throne are guiltless.”

translation.text: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house: and the king and his throne be guiltless.

verses.english:
And the woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord king, may the
guilt be on me and on my ancestral house; Your Majesty and his
throne are guiltless.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַמְדַבֵּר אֵלַיִךְ וַהֲבֵאתוֹ אֵלַי וְלֹא־יֹסִיף עוֹד לָגַעַת בָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַמְדַבֵּר אֵלַיִךְ וַהֲבֵאתוֹ אֵלַי וְלֹא־יֹסִיף עוֹד לָגַעַת בָּךְ׃

english.text:
The king said, “If anyone says anything more to you, have him
brought to me, and he will never trouble you again.”

translation.text: And the king said, Whoever saith ought unto thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.

verses.english:
The king said, “If anyone says anything more to you, have him
brought to me, and he will never trouble you again.”

verses.hebrew:
וַתֹּאמֶר יִזְכּר־נָא הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ (מהרבית) [מֵהַרְבַּת] גֹּאֵל הַדָּם לְשַׁחֵת וְלֹא יַשְׁמִידוּ אֶת־בְּנִי וַיֹּאמֶר חַי־יְהֹוָה אִם־יִפֹּל מִשַּׂעֲרַת בְּנֵךְ
אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַתֹּאמֶר יִזְכּר־נָא הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ (מהרבית) [מֵהַרְבַּת] גֹּאֵל הַדָּם לְשַׁחֵת וְלֹא יַשְׁמִידוּ אֶת־בְּנִי וַיֹּאמֶר חַי־יְהֹוָה אִם־יִפֹּל מִשַּׂעֲרַת בְּנֵךְ
אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
She replied, “Let Your Majesty be mindful of YHWH your God and
restrain the blood avenger bent on destruction, so that my son may
not be killed.” And he said, “As YHWH lives, not a hair of your
son shall fall to the ground.”

translation.text: Then said she, I pray thee, let the king remember the LORD thy God, that thou wouldest not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, As the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of thy son fall to the earth.

verses.english:
She replied, “Let Your Majesty be mindful of YHWH your God and
restrain the blood avenger bent on destruction, so that my son may
not be killed.” And he said, “As YHWH lives, not a hair of your
son shall fall to the ground.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה תְּדַבֶּר־נָא שִׁפְחָתְךָ אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר וַיֹּאמֶר דַּבֵּרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה תְּדַבֶּר־נָא שִׁפְחָתְךָ אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר וַיֹּאמֶר דַּבֵּרִי׃

english.text:
Then the woman said, “Please let your maidservant say another word
to my lord the king.” “Speak on,” said the king.

translation.text: Then the woman said, Let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak one word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.

verses.english:
Then the woman said, “Please let your maidservant say another word
to my lord the king.” “Speak on,” said the king.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה וְלָמָּה חָשַׁבְתָּה כָּזֹאת עַל־עַם אֱלֹהִים וּמִדַּבֵּר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה כְּאָשֵׁם לְבִלְתִּי הָשִׁיב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־נִדְּחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה וְלָמָּה חָשַׁבְתָּה כָּזֹאת עַל־עַם אֱלֹהִים וּמִדַּבֵּר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה כְּאָשֵׁם לְבִלְתִּי הָשִׁיב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־נִדְּחוֹ׃

english.text:
And the woman said, “Why then have you planned the like against
God’s people? In making this pronouncement, Your Majesty condemns
himself in that Your Majesty does not bring back his own banished
one.

translation.text: And the woman said, Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty, in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished.

verses.english:
And the woman said, “Why then have you planned the like against
God’s people? In making this pronouncement, Your Majesty condemns
himself in that Your Majesty does not bring back his own banished
one.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־מוֹת נָמוּת וְכַמַּיִם הַנִּגָּרִים אַרְצָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא יֵאָסֵפוּ וְלֹא־יִשָּׂא אֱלֹהִים נֶפֶשׁ וְחָשַׁב מַחֲשָׁבוֹת לְבִלְתִּי יִדַּח מִמֶּנּוּ נִדָּח׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־מוֹת נָמוּת וְכַמַּיִם הַנִּגָּרִים אַרְצָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא יֵאָסֵפוּ וְלֹא־יִשָּׂא אֱלֹהִים נֶפֶשׁ וְחָשַׁב מַחֲשָׁבוֹת לְבִלְתִּי יִדַּח מִמֶּנּוּ נִדָּח׃

english.text:
We must all die; we are like water that is poured out on the
ground and cannot be gathered up. God will not take away the life
of one who makes plans so that no one may be kept banished.

translation.text: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect any person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.

verses.english:
We must all die; we are like water that is poured out on the
ground and cannot be gathered up. God will not take away the life
of one who makes plans so that no one may be kept banished.

verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה אֲשֶׁר־בָּאתִי לְדַבֵּר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲדֹנִי אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה כִּי יֵרְאֻנִי הָעָם וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁפְחָתְךָ אֲדַבְּרָה־נָּא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אוּלַי יַעֲשֶׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ
אֶת־דְּבַר אֲמָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה אֲשֶׁר־בָּאתִי לְדַבֵּר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲדֹנִי אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה כִּי יֵרְאֻנִי הָעָם וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁפְחָתְךָ אֲדַבְּרָה־נָּא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אוּלַי יַעֲשֶׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ
אֶת־דְּבַר אֲמָתוֹ׃

english.text:
And the reason I have come to say these things to the king, my
lord, is that the people have frightened me. Your maidservant
thought I would speak to Your Majesty; perhaps Your Majesty would
act on his handmaid’s plea.

translation.text: Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid: and thy handmaid said, I will now speak unto the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid.

verses.english:
And the reason I have come to say these things to the king, my
lord, is that the people have frightened me. Your maidservant
thought I would speak to Your Majesty; perhaps Your Majesty would
act on his handmaid’s plea.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִשְׁמַע הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהַצִּיל אֶת־אֲמָתוֹ מִכַּף הָאִישׁ לְהַשְׁמִיד אֹתִי וְאֶת־בְּנִי יַחַד מִנַּחֲלַת אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִשְׁמַע הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהַצִּיל אֶת־אֲמָתוֹ מִכַּף הָאִישׁ לְהַשְׁמִיד אֹתִי וְאֶת־בְּנִי יַחַד מִנַּחֲלַת אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
For Your Majesty would surely agree to deliver his handmaid from
the hands of anyone [who would seek to] cut off both me and my son
from the heritage of God.

translation.text: For the king will hear, to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.

verses.english:
For Your Majesty would surely agree to deliver his handmaid from
the hands of anyone [who would seek to] cut off both me and my son
from the heritage of God.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁפְחָתְךָ יִהְיֶה־נָּא דְּבַר־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לִמְנֻחָה כִּי כְּמַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים כֵּן אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לִשְׁמֹעַ הַטּוֹב וְהָרָע וַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ יְהִי עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁפְחָתְךָ יִהְיֶה־נָּא דְּבַר־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לִמְנֻחָה כִּי כְּמַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים כֵּן אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לִשְׁמֹעַ הַטּוֹב וְהָרָע וַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ יְהִי עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
Your maidservant thought, ‘Let the word of my lord the king
provide comfort; for my lord the king is like an angel of God,
understanding everything, good and bad.’ May YHWH your God be with
you.”

translation.text: Then thine handmaid said, The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable: for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad: therefore the LORD thy God will be with thee.

verses.english:
Your maidservant thought, ‘Let the word of my lord the king
provide comfort; for my lord the king is like an angel of God,
understanding everything, good and bad.’ May YHWH your God be with
you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה אַל־נָא תְכַחֲדִי מִמֶּנִּי דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי שֹׁאֵל אֹתָךְ וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה יְדַבֶּר־נָא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה אַל־נָא תְכַחֲדִי מִמֶּנִּי דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי שֹׁאֵל אֹתָךְ וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה יְדַבֶּר־נָא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
In reply, the king said to the woman, “Do not withhold from me
anything I ask you!” The woman answered, “Let my lord the king
speak.”

translation.text: Then the king answered and said unto the woman, Hide not from me, I pray thee, the thing that I shall ask thee. And the woman said, Let my lord the king now speak.

verses.english:
In reply, the king said to the woman, “Do not withhold from me
anything I ask you!” The woman answered, “Let my lord the king
speak.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ הֲיַד יוֹאָב אִתָּךְ בְּכל־זֹאת וַתַּעַן הָאִשָּׁה וַתֹּאמֶר חֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־אִשׁ לְהֵמִין וּלְהַשְׂמִיל מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֲדֹנִי
הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־עַבְדְּךָ יוֹאָב הוּא צִוָּנִי וְהוּא שָׂם בְּפִי שִׁפְחָתְךָ אֵת כּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ הֲיַד יוֹאָב אִתָּךְ בְּכל־זֹאת וַתַּעַן הָאִשָּׁה וַתֹּאמֶר חֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־אִשׁ לְהֵמִין וּלְהַשְׂמִיל מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֲדֹנִי
הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־עַבְדְּךָ יוֹאָב הוּא צִוָּנִי וְהוּא שָׂם בְּפִי שִׁפְחָתְךָ אֵת כּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
The king asked, “Is Joab in league with you in all this?” The
woman replied, “As you live, my lord the king, it is just as my
lord the king says. Yes, your servant Joab was the one who
instructed me, and it was he who told your maidservant everything
she was to say.

translation.text: And the king said, Is not the hand of Joab with thee in all this? And the woman answered and said, As thy soul liveth, my lord the king, none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken: for thy servant Joab, he bade me, and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid:

verses.english:
The king asked, “Is Joab in league with you in all this?” The
woman replied, “As you live, my lord the king, it is just as my
lord the king says. Yes, your servant Joab was the one who
instructed me, and it was he who told your maidservant everything
she was to say.

verses.hebrew: לְבַעֲבוּר סַבֵּב אֶת־פְּנֵי הַדָּבָר עָשָׂה עַבְדְּךָ יוֹאָב אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַאדֹנִי חָכָם כְּחכְמַת מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים לָדַעַת אֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: לְבַעֲבוּר סַבֵּב אֶת־פְּנֵי הַדָּבָר עָשָׂה עַבְדְּךָ יוֹאָב אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַאדֹנִי חָכָם כְּחכְמַת מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים לָדַעַת אֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
It was to conceal the real purpose of the matter that your servant
Joab did this thing. My lord is as wise as an angel of God, and he
knows all that goes on in the land.”

translation.text: To fetch about this form of speech hath thy servant Joab done this thing: and my lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.

verses.english:
It was to conceal the real purpose of the matter that your servant
Joab did this thing. My lord is as wise as an angel of God, and he
knows all that goes on in the land.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־יוֹאָב הִנֵּה־נָא עָשִׂיתִי אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְלֵךְ הָשֵׁב אֶת־הַנַּעַר אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־יוֹאָב הִנֵּה־נָא עָשִׂיתִי אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְלֵךְ הָשֵׁב אֶת־הַנַּעַר אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
Then the king said to Joab, “I will do this thing. Go and bring
back my boy Absalom.”

translation.text: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.

verses.english:
Then the king said to Joab, “I will do this thing. Go and bring
back my boy Absalom.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּפֹּל יוֹאָב אֶל־פָּנָיו אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ וַיְבָרֶךְ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב הַיּוֹם יָדַע עַבְדְּךָ כִּי־מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה
הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־דְּבַר (עבדו) [עַבְדֶּךָ]׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּפֹּל יוֹאָב אֶל־פָּנָיו אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ וַיְבָרֶךְ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב הַיּוֹם יָדַע עַבְדְּךָ כִּי־מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה
הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־דְּבַר (עבדו) [עַבְדֶּךָ]׃

english.text:
Joab flung himself face down on the ground and prostrated himself.
Joab blessed the king and said, “Today your servant knows that he
has found favor with you, my lord king, for Your Majesty has
granted his servant’s request.”

translation.text: And Joab fell to the ground on his face, and bowed himself, and thanked the king: and Joab said, To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight, my lord, O king, in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant.

verses.english:
Joab flung himself face down on the ground and prostrated himself.
Joab blessed the king and said, “Today your servant knows that he
has found favor with you, my lord king, for Your Majesty has
granted his servant’s request.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם יוֹאָב וַיֵּלֶךְ גְּשׁוּרָה וַיָּבֵא אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם יוֹאָב וַיֵּלֶךְ גְּשׁוּרָה וַיָּבֵא אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text: And Joab went at once to Geshur and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

translation.text: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

verses.english: And Joab went at once to Geshur and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ יִסֹּב אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וּפָנַי לֹא יִרְאֶה וַיִּסֹּב אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וּפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא רָאָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ יִסֹּב אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וּפָנַי לֹא יִרְאֶה וַיִּסֹּב אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וּפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא רָאָה׃

english.text:
But the king said, “Let him go directly to his house and not
present himself to me.” So Absalom went directly to his house and
did not present himself to the king.

translation.text: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, and saw not the king’s face.

verses.english:
But the king said, “Let him go directly to his house and not
present himself to me.” So Absalom went directly to his house and
did not present himself to the king.

verses.hebrew: וּכְאַבְשָׁלוֹם לֹא־הָיָה אִישׁ־יָפֶה בְּכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַלֵּל מְאֹד מִכַּף רַגְלוֹ וְעַד קדְקֳדוֹ לֹא־הָיָה בוֹ מוּם׃

hebrew.text: וּכְאַבְשָׁלוֹם לֹא־הָיָה אִישׁ־יָפֶה בְּכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַלֵּל מְאֹד מִכַּף רַגְלוֹ וְעַד קדְקֳדוֹ לֹא־הָיָה בוֹ מוּם׃

translation.text: But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.

verses.hebrew: וּבְגַלְּחוֹ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וְהָיָה מִקֵּץ יָמִים לַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר יְגַלֵּחַ כִּי־כָבֵד עָלָיו וְגִלְּחוֹ וְשָׁקַל אֶת־שְׂעַר רֹאשׁוֹ מָאתַיִם שְׁקָלִים בְּאֶבֶן הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְגַלְּחוֹ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וְהָיָה מִקֵּץ יָמִים לַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר יְגַלֵּחַ כִּי־כָבֵד עָלָיו וְגִלְּחוֹ וְשָׁקַל אֶת־שְׂעַר רֹאשׁוֹ מָאתַיִם שְׁקָלִים בְּאֶבֶן הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
When he cut his hair—he had to have it cut every year, for it grew
too heavy for him—the hair of his head weighed two hundred shekels
by the royal weight.

translation.text: And when he polled his head, (for it was at every year’s end that he polled it: because the hair was heavy on him, therefore he polled it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king’s weight.

verses.english:
When he cut his hair—he had to have it cut every year, for it grew
too heavy for him—the hair of his head weighed two hundred shekels
by the royal weight.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּלְדוּ לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם שְׁלוֹשָׁה בָנִים וּבַת אַחַת וּשְׁמָהּ תָּמָר הִיא הָיְתָה אִשָּׁה יְפַת מַרְאֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּוָּלְדוּ לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם שְׁלוֹשָׁה בָנִים וּבַת אַחַת וּשְׁמָהּ תָּמָר הִיא הָיְתָה אִשָּׁה יְפַת מַרְאֶה׃

english.text:
Absalom had three sons and a daughter whose name was Tamar; she
was a beautiful woman.

translation.text: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.

verses.english:
Absalom had three sons and a daughter whose name was Tamar; she
was a beautiful woman.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב אַבְשָׁלוֹם בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם שְׁנָתַיִם יָמִים וּפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא רָאָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב אַבְשָׁלוֹם בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם שְׁנָתַיִם יָמִים וּפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא רָאָה׃

english.text:
Absalom lived in Jerusalem two years without appearing before the
king.

translation.text: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem, and saw not the king’s face.

verses.english:
Absalom lived in Jerusalem two years without appearing before the
king.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־יוֹאָב לִשְׁלֹחַ אֹתוֹ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלֹא אָבָה לָבוֹא אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁלַח עוֹד שֵׁנִית וְלֹא אָבָה לָבוֹא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־יוֹאָב לִשְׁלֹחַ אֹתוֹ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלֹא אָבָה לָבוֹא אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁלַח עוֹד שֵׁנִית וְלֹא אָבָה לָבוֹא׃

english.text:
Then Absalom sent for Joab, in order to send him to the king; but
Joab would not come to him. He sent for him a second time, but he
would not come.

translation.text: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab, to have sent him to the king; but he would not come to him: and when he sent again the second time, he would not come.

verses.english:
Then Absalom sent for Joab, in order to send him to the king; but
Joab would not come to him. He sent for him a second time, but he
would not come.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־עֲבָדָיו רְאוּ חֶלְקַת יוֹאָב אֶל־יָדִי וְלוֹ־שָׁם שְׂעֹרִים לְכוּ (והוצתיה) [וְהַצִּיתוּהָ] בָאֵשׁ וַיַּצִּתוּ עַבְדֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־הַחֶלְקָה בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־עֲבָדָיו רְאוּ חֶלְקַת יוֹאָב אֶל־יָדִי וְלוֹ־שָׁם שְׂעֹרִים לְכוּ (והוצתיה) [וְהַצִּיתוּהָ] בָאֵשׁ וַיַּצִּתוּ עַבְדֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־הַחֶלְקָה בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
So [Absalom] said to his servants, “Look, Joab’s field is next to
mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire.” And
Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.

translation.text: Therefore he said unto his servants, See, Joab’s field is near mine, and he hath barley there; go and set it on fire. And Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.

verses.english:
So [Absalom] said to his servants, “Look, Joab’s field is next to
mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire.” And
Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם יוֹאָב וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם הַבָּיְתָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לָמָּה הִצִּיתוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶת־הַחֶלְקָה אֲשֶׁר־לִי בָּאֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם יוֹאָב וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם הַבָּיְתָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לָמָּה הִצִּיתוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶת־הַחֶלְקָה אֲשֶׁר־לִי בָּאֵשׁ׃

english.text:
Joab came at once to Absalom’s house and said to him, “Why did
your servants set fire to my field?”

translation.text: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto his house, and said unto him, Wherefore have thy servants set my field on fire?

verses.english:
Joab came at once to Absalom’s house and said to him, “Why did
your servants set fire to my field?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־יוֹאָב הִנֵּה שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר בֹּא הֵנָּה וְאֶשְׁלְחָה אֹתְךָ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר לָמָּה בָּאתִי מִגְּשׁוּר טוֹב לִי עֹד אֲנִי־שָׁם וְעַתָּה
אֶרְאֶה פְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאִם־יֶשׁ־בִּי עָוֺן וֶהֱמִתָנִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־יוֹאָב הִנֵּה שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר בֹּא הֵנָּה וְאֶשְׁלְחָה אֹתְךָ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר לָמָּה בָּאתִי מִגְּשׁוּר טוֹב לִי עֹד אֲנִי־שָׁם וְעַתָּה
אֶרְאֶה פְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאִם־יֶשׁ־בִּי עָוֺן וֶהֱמִתָנִי׃

english.text:
Absalom replied to Joab, “I sent for you to come here; I wanted to
send you to the king to say [on my behalf]: ‘Why did I leave
Geshur? I would be better off if I were still there. Now let me
appear before the king; and if I am guilty of anything, let him
put me to death!’”

translation.text: And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent unto thee, saying, Come hither, that I may send thee to the king, to say, Wherefore am I come from Geshur? it had been good for me to have been there still: now therefore let me see the king’s face; and if there be any iniquity in me, let him kill me.

verses.english:
Absalom replied to Joab, “I sent for you to come here; I wanted to
send you to the king to say [on my behalf]: ‘Why did I leave
Geshur? I would be better off if I were still there. Now let me
appear before the king; and if I am guilty of anything, let him
put me to death!’”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא יוֹאָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיָּבֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לוֹ עַל־אַפָּיו אַרְצָה לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשַּׁק הַמֶּלֶךְ
לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא יוֹאָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיָּבֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לוֹ עַל־אַפָּיו אַרְצָה לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשַּׁק הַמֶּלֶךְ
לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
Joab went to the king and reported to him; whereupon he summoned
Absalom. He came to the king and flung himself face down to the
ground before the king. And the king kissed Absalom.

translation.text: So Joab came to the king, and told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.

verses.english:
Joab went to the king and reported to him; whereupon he summoned
Absalom. He came to the king and flung himself face down to the
ground before the king. And the king kissed Absalom.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מֵאַחֲרֵי כֵן וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ אַבְשָׁלוֹם מֶרְכָּבָה וְסֻסִים וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ רָצִים לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מֵאַחֲרֵי כֵן וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ אַבְשָׁלוֹם מֶרְכָּבָה וְסֻסִים וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ רָצִים לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
Sometime afterward, Absalom provided himself with a chariot,
horses, and fifty outrunners.

translation.text: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.

verses.english:
Sometime afterward, Absalom provided himself with a chariot,
horses, and fifty outrunners.

verses.hebrew:
וְהִשְׁכִּים אַבְשָׁלוֹם וְעָמַד עַל־יַד דֶּרֶךְ הַשָּׁעַר וַיְהִי כּל־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶה־לּוֹ־רִיב לָבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לַמִּשְׁפָּט וַיִּקְרָא אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר
אֵי־מִזֶּה עִיר אַתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר מֵאַחַד שִׁבְטֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִשְׁכִּים אַבְשָׁלוֹם וְעָמַד עַל־יַד דֶּרֶךְ הַשָּׁעַר וַיְהִי כּל־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶה־לּוֹ־רִיב לָבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לַמִּשְׁפָּט וַיִּקְרָא אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר
אֵי־מִזֶּה עִיר אַתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר מֵאַחַד שִׁבְטֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
Absalom used to rise early and stand by the road to the city
gates; and whenever a man had a case that was to come before the
king for judgment, Absalom would call out to him, “What town are
you from?” And when he answered, “Your servant is from such and
such a tribe in Israel,”

translation.text: And Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate: and it was so, that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment, then Absalom called unto him, and said, Of what city art thou? And he said, Thy servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.

verses.english:
Absalom used to rise early and stand by the road to the city
gates; and whenever a man had a case that was to come before the
king for judgment, Absalom would call out to him, “What town are
you from?” And when he answered, “Your servant is from such and
such a tribe in Israel,”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְשָׁלוֹם רְאֵה דְבָרֶיךָ טוֹבִים וּנְכֹחִים וְשֹׁמֵעַ אֵין־לְךָ מֵאֵת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְשָׁלוֹם רְאֵה דְבָרֶיךָ טוֹבִים וּנְכֹחִים וְשֹׁמֵעַ אֵין־לְךָ מֵאֵת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Absalom would say to him, “It is clear that your claim is right
and just, but there is no one assigned to you by the king to hear
it.”

translation.text: And Absalom said unto him, See, thy matters are good and right; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee.

verses.english:
Absalom would say to him, “It is clear that your claim is right
and just, but there is no one assigned to you by the king to hear
it.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם מִי־יְשִׂמֵנִי שֹׁפֵט בָּאָרֶץ וְעָלַי יָבוֹא כּל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶה־לּוֹ־רִיב וּמִשְׁפָּט וְהִצְדַּקְתִּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם מִי־יְשִׂמֵנִי שֹׁפֵט בָּאָרֶץ וְעָלַי יָבוֹא כּל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶה־לּוֹ־רִיב וּמִשְׁפָּט וְהִצְדַּקְתִּיו׃

english.text:
And Absalom went on, “If only I were appointed judge in the land
and everyone with a legal dispute came before me, I would see that
he got his rights.”

translation.text: Absalom said moreover, Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would do him justice!

verses.english:
And Absalom went on, “If only I were appointed judge in the land
and everyone with a legal dispute came before me, I would see that
he got his rights.”

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בִּקְרב־אִישׁ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לוֹ וְשָׁלַח אֶת־יָדוֹ וְהֶחֱזִיק לוֹ וְנָשַׁק לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בִּקְרב־אִישׁ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לוֹ וְשָׁלַח אֶת־יָדוֹ וְהֶחֱזִיק לוֹ וְנָשַׁק לוֹ׃

english.text:
And if a man approached to bow to him, [Absalom] would extend his
hand and take hold of him and kiss him.

translation.text: And it was so, that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took him, and kissed him.

verses.english:
And if a man approached to bow to him, [Absalom] would extend his
hand and take hold of him and kiss him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אַבְשָׁלוֹם כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־יָבֹאוּ לַמִּשְׁפָּט אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְגַנֵּב אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־לֵב אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אַבְשָׁלוֹם כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־יָבֹאוּ לַמִּשְׁפָּט אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְגַנֵּב אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־לֵב אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Absalom did this to every Israelite who came to the king for
judgment. Thus Absalom won away the hearts of the men of Israel.

translation.text: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

verses.english:
Absalom did this to every Israelite who came to the king for
judgment. Thus Absalom won away the hearts of the men of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלְכָה נָּא וַאֲשַׁלֵּם אֶת־נִדְרִי אֲשֶׁר־נָדַרְתִּי לַיהֹוָה בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלְכָה נָּא וַאֲשַׁלֵּם אֶת־נִדְרִי אֲשֶׁר־נָדַרְתִּי לַיהֹוָה בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

english.text:
After a period of forty years had gone by, Absalom said to the
king, “Let me go to Hebron and fulfill a vow that I made to YHWH.

translation.text: And it came to pass after forty years, that Absalom said unto the king, I pray thee, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto the LORD, in Hebron.

verses.english:
After a period of forty years had gone by, Absalom said to the
king, “Let me go to Hebron and fulfill a vow that I made to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־נֵדֶר נָדַר עַבְדְּךָ בְּשִׁבְתִּי בִגְשׁוּר בַּאֲרָם לֵאמֹר אִם־[יָשׁוֹב] (ישיב) יְשִׁיבֵנִי יְהֹוָה יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְעָבַדְתִּי אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־נֵדֶר נָדַר עַבְדְּךָ בְּשִׁבְתִּי בִגְשׁוּר בַּאֲרָם לֵאמֹר אִם־[יָשׁוֹב] (ישיב) יְשִׁיבֵנִי יְהֹוָה יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְעָבַדְתִּי אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
For your servant made a vow when I lived in Geshur of Aram: If
YHWH ever brings me back to Jerusalem, I will worship YHWH.”

translation.text: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If the LORD shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem, then I will serve the LORD.

verses.english:
For your servant made a vow when I lived in Geshur of Aram: If
YHWH ever brings me back to Jerusalem, I will worship YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ חֶבְרוֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ חֶבְרוֹנָה׃

english.text: The king said to him, “Go in peace”; and so he set out for Hebron.

translation.text: And the king said unto him, Go in peace. So he arose, and went to Hebron.

verses.english: The king said to him, “Go in peace”; and so he set out for Hebron.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְשָׁלוֹם מְרַגְּלִים בְּכל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר כְּשׁמְעֲכֶם אֶת־קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר וַאֲמַרְתֶּם מָלַךְ אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְשָׁלוֹם מְרַגְּלִים בְּכל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר כְּשׁמְעֲכֶם אֶת־קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר וַאֲמַרְתֶּם מָלַךְ אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃

english.text:
But Absalom sent agents to all the tribes of Israel to say, “When
you hear the blast of the horn, announce that Absalom has become
king in Hebron.”

translation.text: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom reigneth in Hebron.

verses.english:
But Absalom sent agents to all the tribes of Israel to say, “When
you hear the blast of the horn, announce that Absalom has become
king in Hebron.”

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם הָלְכוּ מָאתַיִם אִישׁ מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם קְרֻאִים וְהֹלְכִים לְתֻמָּם וְלֹא יָדְעוּ כּל־דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם הָלְכוּ מָאתַיִם אִישׁ מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם קְרֻאִים וְהֹלְכִים לְתֻמָּם וְלֹא יָדְעוּ כּל־דָּבָר׃

english.text:
Two hundred men of Jerusalem accompanied Absalom; they were
invited and went in good faith, suspecting nothing.

translation.text: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, that were called; and they went in their simplicity, and they knew not any thing.

verses.english:
Two hundred men of Jerusalem accompanied Absalom; they were
invited and went in good faith, suspecting nothing.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־אֲחִיתֹפֶל הַגִּילֹנִי יוֹעֵץ דָּוִד מֵעִירוֹ מִגִּלֹה בְּזבְחוֹ אֶת־הַזְּבָחִים וַיְהִי הַקֶּשֶׁר אַמִּץ וְהָעָם הוֹלֵךְ וָרָב אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־אֲחִיתֹפֶל הַגִּילֹנִי יוֹעֵץ דָּוִד מֵעִירוֹ מִגִּלֹה בְּזבְחוֹ אֶת־הַזְּבָחִים וַיְהִי הַקֶּשֶׁר אַמִּץ וְהָעָם הוֹלֵךְ וָרָב אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
Absalom also sent [to fetch] Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s
counselor, from his town, Giloh, when the sacrifices were to be
offered. The conspiracy gained strength, and the people supported
Absalom in increasing numbers.

translation.text: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counsellor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he offered sacrifices. And the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.

verses.english:
Absalom also sent [to fetch] Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s
counselor, from his town, Giloh, when the sacrifices were to be
offered. The conspiracy gained strength, and the people supported
Absalom in increasing numbers.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַמַּגִּיד אֶל־דָּוִד לֵאמֹר הָיָה לֶב־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא הַמַּגִּיד אֶל־דָּוִד לֵאמֹר הָיָה לֶב־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
Someone came and told David, “The loyalty of the men of Israel has
veered toward Absalom.”

translation.text: And there came a messenger to David, saying, The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.

verses.english:
Someone came and told David, “The loyalty of the men of Israel has
veered toward Absalom.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לְכל־עֲבָדָיו אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ בִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם קוּמוּ וְנִבְרָחָה כִּי לֹא־תִהְיֶה־לָּנוּ פְלֵיטָה מִפְּנֵי אַבְשָׁלֹם מַהֲרוּ לָלֶכֶת פֶּן־יְמַהֵר וְהִשִּׂגָנוּ
וְהִדִּיחַ עָלֵינוּ אֶת־הָרָעָה וְהִכָּה הָעִיר לְפִי־חָרֶב׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לְכל־עֲבָדָיו אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ בִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם קוּמוּ וְנִבְרָחָה כִּי לֹא־תִהְיֶה־לָּנוּ פְלֵיטָה מִפְּנֵי אַבְשָׁלֹם מַהֲרוּ לָלֶכֶת פֶּן־יְמַהֵר וְהִשִּׂגָנוּ
וְהִדִּיחַ עָלֵינוּ אֶת־הָרָעָה וְהִכָּה הָעִיר לְפִי־חָרֶב׃

english.text:
Whereupon David said to all the courtiers who were with him in
Jerusalem, “Let us flee at once, or none of us will escape from
Absalom. We must get away quickly, or he will soon overtake us and
bring down disaster upon us and put the city to the sword.”

translation.text: And David said unto all his servants that were with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not else escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us suddenly, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.

verses.english:
Whereupon David said to all the courtiers who were with him in
Jerusalem, “Let us flee at once, or none of us will escape from
Absalom. We must get away quickly, or he will soon overtake us and
bring down disaster upon us and put the city to the sword.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה עֲבָדֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה עֲבָדֶיךָ׃

english.text:
The king’s courtiers said to the king, “Whatever our lord the king
decides, your servants are ready.”

translation.text: And the king’s servants said unto the king, Behold, thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint.

verses.english:
The king’s courtiers said to the king, “Whatever our lord the king
decides, your servants are ready.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־בֵּיתוֹ בְּרַגְלָיו וַיַּעֲזֹב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת עֶשֶׂר נָשִׁים פִּלַגְשִׁים לִשְׁמֹר הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־בֵּיתוֹ בְּרַגְלָיו וַיַּעֲזֹב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת עֶשֶׂר נָשִׁים פִּלַגְשִׁים לִשְׁמֹר הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
So the king left, followed by his entire household, except for ten
concubines whom the king left to mind the palace.

translation.text: And the king went forth, and all his household after him. And the king left ten women, which were concubines, to keep the house.

verses.english:
So the king left, followed by his entire household, except for ten
concubines whom the king left to mind the palace.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־הָעָם בְּרַגְלָיו וַיַּעַמְדוּ בֵּית הַמֶּרְחָק׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־הָעָם בְּרַגְלָיו וַיַּעַמְדוּ בֵּית הַמֶּרְחָק׃

english.text:
The king left, followed by all the people, and they stopped at the
last house.

translation.text: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.

verses.english:
The king left, followed by all the people, and they stopped at the
last house.

verses.hebrew: וְכל־עֲבָדָיו עֹבְרִים עַל־יָדוֹ וְכל־הַכְּרֵתִי וְכל־הַפְּלֵתִי וְכל־הַגִּתִּים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאוּ בְרַגְלוֹ מִגַּת עֹבְרִים עַל־פְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־עֲבָדָיו עֹבְרִים עַל־יָדוֹ וְכל־הַכְּרֵתִי וְכל־הַפְּלֵתִי וְכל־הַגִּתִּים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאוּ בְרַגְלוֹ מִגַּת עֹבְרִים עַל־פְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
All his followers marched past him, including all the Cherethites
and all the Pelethites; and all the Gittites, six hundred men who
had accompanied him from Gath, also marched by the king.

translation.text: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men which came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

verses.english:
All his followers marched past him, including all the Cherethites
and all the Pelethites; and all the Gittites, six hundred men who
had accompanied him from Gath, also marched by the king.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אִתַּי הַגִּתִּי לָמָּה תֵלֵךְ גַּם־אַתָּה אִתָּנוּ שׁוּב וְשֵׁב עִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־נכְרִי אַתָּה וְגַם־גֹּלֶה אַתָּה לִמְקוֹמֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אִתַּי הַגִּתִּי לָמָּה תֵלֵךְ גַּם־אַתָּה אִתָּנוּ שׁוּב וְשֵׁב עִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־נכְרִי אַתָּה וְגַם־גֹּלֶה אַתָּה לִמְקוֹמֶךָ׃

english.text:
And the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why should you too go
with us? Go back and stay with the [new] king, for you are a
foreigner and you are also an exile from your country.

translation.text: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore goest thou also with us? return to thy place, and abide with the king: for thou art a stranger, and also an exile.

verses.english:
And the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why should you too go
with us? Go back and stay with the [new] king, for you are a
foreigner and you are also an exile from your country.

verses.hebrew: תְּמוֹל בּוֹאֶךָ וְהַיּוֹם (אנועך) [אֲנִיעֲךָ] עִמָּנוּ לָלֶכֶת וַאֲנִי הוֹלֵךְ עַל אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי הוֹלֵךְ שׁוּב וְהָשֵׁב אֶת־אַחֶיךָ עִמָּךְ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃

hebrew.text: תְּמוֹל בּוֹאֶךָ וְהַיּוֹם (אנועך) [אֲנִיעֲךָ] עִמָּנוּ לָלֶכֶת וַאֲנִי הוֹלֵךְ עַל אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי הוֹלֵךְ שׁוּב וְהָשֵׁב אֶת־אַחֶיךָ עִמָּךְ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃

english.text:
You came only yesterday; should I make you wander about with us
today, when I myself must go wherever I can? Go back, and take
your kinsmen with you, [in] true faithfulness.”

translation.text: Whereas thou camest but yesterday, should I this day make thee go up and down with us? seeing I go whither I may, return thou, and take back thy brethren: mercy and truth be with thee.

verses.english:
You came only yesterday; should I make you wander about with us
today, when I myself must go wherever I can? Go back, and take
your kinsmen with you, [in] true faithfulness.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן אִתַּי אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמַר חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי (אם) בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה־שָּׁם אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־לְמָוֶת אִם־לְחַיִּים כִּי־שָׁם יִהְיֶה
עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן אִתַּי אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמַר חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי (אם) בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה־שָּׁם אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־לְמָוֶת אִם־לְחַיִּים כִּי־שָׁם יִהְיֶה
עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
Ittai replied to the king, “As YHWH lives and as my lord the king
lives, wherever my lord the king may be, there your servant will
be, whether for death or for life!”

translation.text: And Ittai answered the king, and said, As the LORD liveth, and as my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be.

verses.english:
Ittai replied to the king, “As YHWH lives and as my lord the king
lives, wherever my lord the king may be, there your servant will
be, whether for death or for life!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אִתַּי לֵךְ וַעֲבֹר וַיַּעֲבֹר אִתַּי הַגִּתִּי וְכל־אֲנָשָׁיו וְכל־הַטַּף אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אִתַּי לֵךְ וַעֲבֹר וַיַּעֲבֹר אִתַּי הַגִּתִּי וְכל־אֲנָשָׁיו וְכל־הַטַּף אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
And David said to Ittai, “Then march by.” And Ittai the Gittite
and all his men and all the children who were with him marched by.

translation.text: And David said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones that were with him.

verses.english:
And David said to Ittai, “Then march by.” And Ittai the Gittite
and all his men and all the children who were with him marched by.

verses.hebrew: וְכל־הָאָרֶץ בּוֹכִים קוֹל גָּדוֹל וְכל־הָעָם עֹבְרִים וְהַמֶּלֶךְ עֹבֵר בְּנַחַל קִדְרוֹן וְכל־הָעָם עֹבְרִים עַל־פְּנֵי־דֶרֶךְ אֶת־הַמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־הָאָרֶץ בּוֹכִים קוֹל גָּדוֹל וְכל־הָעָם עֹבְרִים וְהַמֶּלֶךְ עֹבֵר בְּנַחַל קִדְרוֹן וְכל־הָעָם עֹבְרִים עַל־פְּנֵי־דֶרֶךְ אֶת־הַמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
The whole countryside wept aloud as the troops marched by. The
king crossed the Kidron Valley, and all the troops crossed by the
road to the wilderness.

translation.text: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.

verses.english:
The whole countryside wept aloud as the troops marched by. The
king crossed the Kidron Valley, and all the troops crossed by the
road to the wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה גַם־צָדוֹק וְכל־הַלְוִיִּם אִתּוֹ נֹשְׂאִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּצִּקוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַל אֶבְיָתָר עַד־תֹּם כּל־הָעָם לַעֲבוֹר מִן־הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה גַם־צָדוֹק וְכל־הַלְוִיִּם אִתּוֹ נֹשְׂאִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּצִּקוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַל אֶבְיָתָר עַד־תֹּם כּל־הָעָם לַעֲבוֹר מִן־הָעִיר׃

english.text:
Then Zadok appeared, with all the Levites carrying the Ark of the
Covenant of God; and they set down the Ark of God until all the
people had finished marching out of the city. Abiathar also came
up.

translation.text: And lo Zadok also, and all the Levites were with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God: and they set down the ark of God; and Abiathar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.

verses.english:
Then Zadok appeared, with all the Levites carrying the Ark of the
Covenant of God; and they set down the Ark of God until all the
people had finished marching out of the city. Abiathar also came
up.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְצָדוֹק הָשֵׁב אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים הָעִיר אִם־אֶמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וֶהֱשִׁבַנִי וְהִרְאַנִי אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־נָוֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְצָדוֹק הָשֵׁב אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים הָעִיר אִם־אֶמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וֶהֱשִׁבַנִי וְהִרְאַנִי אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־נָוֵהוּ׃

english.text:
But the king said to Zadok, “Take the Ark of God back to the city.
If I find favor with YHWH, He will bring me back and let me see it
and its abode.

translation.text: And the king said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of God into the city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of the LORD, he will bring me again, and shew me both it, and his habitation:

verses.english:
But the king said to Zadok, “Take the Ark of God back to the city.
If I find favor with YHWH, He will bring me back and let me see it
and its abode.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם כֹּה יֹאמַר לֹא חָפַצְתִּי בָּךְ הִנְנִי יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר טוֹב בְּעֵינָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם כֹּה יֹאמַר לֹא חָפַצְתִּי בָּךְ הִנְנִי יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר טוֹב בְּעֵינָיו׃

english.text:
And if He should say, ‘I do not want you,’ I am ready; let Him do
with me as He pleases.”
