translation.text: But if he thus say, I have no delight in thee; behold, here am I, let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.

verses.english:
And if He should say, ‘I do not want you,’ I am ready; let Him do
with me as He pleases.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן הֲרוֹאֶה אַתָּה שֻׁבָה הָעִיר בְּשָׁלוֹם וַאֲחִימַעַץ בִּנְךָ וִיהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָר שְׁנֵי בְנֵיכֶם אִתְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן הֲרוֹאֶה אַתָּה שֻׁבָה הָעִיר בְּשָׁלוֹם וַאֲחִימַעַץ בִּנְךָ וִיהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָר שְׁנֵי בְנֵיכֶם אִתְּכֶם׃

english.text:
And the king said to the priest Zadok, “Do you understand? You
return to the safety of the city with your two sons, your own son
Ahimaaz and Abiathar’s son Jonathan.

translation.text: The king said also unto Zadok the priest, Art not thou a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz thy son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.

verses.english:
And the king said to the priest Zadok, “Do you understand? You
return to the safety of the city with your two sons, your own son
Ahimaaz and Abiathar’s son Jonathan.

verses.hebrew: רְאוּ אָנֹכִי מִתְמַהְמֵהַּ (בעברות) [בְּעַרְבוֹת] הַמִּדְבָּר עַד בּוֹא דָבָר מֵעִמָּכֶם לְהַגִּיד לִי׃

hebrew.text: רְאוּ אָנֹכִי מִתְמַהְמֵהַּ (בעברות) [בְּעַרְבוֹת] הַמִּדְבָּר עַד בּוֹא דָבָר מֵעִמָּכֶם לְהַגִּיד לִי׃

english.text:
Look, I shall linger in the steppes of the wilderness until word
comes from you to inform me.”

translation.text: See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.

verses.english:
Look, I shall linger in the steppes of the wilderness until word
comes from you to inform me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב צָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׁב צָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם׃

english.text:
Zadok and Abiathar brought the Ark of God back to Jerusalem, and
they stayed there.

translation.text: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem: and they tarried there.

verses.english:
Zadok and Abiathar brought the Ark of God back to Jerusalem, and
they stayed there.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד עֹלֶה בְמַעֲלֵה הַזֵּיתִים עֹלֶה וּבוֹכֶה וְרֹאשׁ לוֹ חָפוּי וְהוּא הֹלֵךְ יָחֵף וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ חָפוּ אִישׁ רֹאשׁוֹ וְעָלוּ עָלֹה וּבָכֹה׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד עֹלֶה בְמַעֲלֵה הַזֵּיתִים עֹלֶה וּבוֹכֶה וְרֹאשׁ לוֹ חָפוּי וְהוּא הֹלֵךְ יָחֵף וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ חָפוּ אִישׁ רֹאשׁוֹ וְעָלוּ עָלֹה וּבָכֹה׃

english.text:
David meanwhile went up the slope of the [Mount of] Olives,
weeping as he went; his head was covered and he walked barefoot.
And all the people who were with him covered their heads and wept
as they went up.

translation.text: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet, and wept as he went up, and had his head covered, and he went barefoot: and all the people that was with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

verses.english:
David meanwhile went up the slope of the [Mount of] Olives,
weeping as he went; his head was covered and he walked barefoot.
And all the people who were with him covered their heads and wept
as they went up.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד הִגִּיד לֵאמֹר אֲחִיתֹפֶל בַּקֹּשְׁרִים עִם־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד סַכֶּל־נָא אֶת־עֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד הִגִּיד לֵאמֹר אֲחִיתֹפֶל בַּקֹּשְׁרִים עִם־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד סַכֶּל־נָא אֶת־עֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
David [was] told that Ahithophel was among the conspirators with
Absalom, and he prayed, “Please, O LORD, frustrate Ahithophel’s
counsel!”

translation.text: And one told David, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O LORD, I pray thee, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.

verses.english:
David [was] told that Ahithophel was among the conspirators with
Absalom, and he prayed, “Please, O LORD, frustrate Ahithophel’s
counsel!”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דָוִד בָּא עַד־הָרֹאשׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה שָׁם לֵאלֹהִים וְהִנֵּה לִקְרָאתוֹ חוּשַׁי הָאַרְכִּי קָרוּעַ כֻּתּנְתּוֹ וַאֲדָמָה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דָוִד בָּא עַד־הָרֹאשׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה שָׁם לֵאלֹהִים וְהִנֵּה לִקְרָאתוֹ חוּשַׁי הָאַרְכִּי קָרוּעַ כֻּתּנְתּוֹ וַאֲדָמָה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
When David reached the top, where people would prostrate
themselves to God, Hushai the Archite was there to meet him, with
his robe torn and with earth on his head.

translation.text: And it came to pass, that when David was come to the top of the mount, where he worshipped God, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head:

verses.english:
When David reached the top, where people would prostrate
themselves to God, Hushai the Archite was there to meet him, with
his robe torn and with earth on his head.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָּוִד אִם עָבַרְתָּ אִתִּי וְהָיִתָ עָלַי לְמַשָּׂא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָּוִד אִם עָבַרְתָּ אִתִּי וְהָיִתָ עָלַי לְמַשָּׂא׃

english.text:
David said to him, “If you march on with me, you will be a burden
to me.

translation.text: Unto whom David said, If thou passest on with me, then thou shalt be a burden unto me:

verses.english:
David said to him, “If you march on with me, you will be a burden
to me.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־הָעִיר תָּשׁוּב וְאָמַרְתָּ לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם עַבְדְּךָ אֲנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶהְיֶה עֶבֶד אָבִיךָ וַאֲנִי מֵאָז וְעַתָּה וַאֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ וְהֵפַרְתָּה לִי אֵת עֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־הָעִיר תָּשׁוּב וְאָמַרְתָּ לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם עַבְדְּךָ אֲנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶהְיֶה עֶבֶד אָבִיךָ וַאֲנִי מֵאָז וְעַתָּה וַאֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ וְהֵפַרְתָּה לִי אֵת עֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל׃

english.text:
But if you go back to the city and say to Absalom, ‘I will be your
servant, O king; I was your father’s servant formerly, and now I
will be yours,’ then you can nullify Ahithophel’s counsel for me.

translation.text: But if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father’s servant hitherto, so will I now also be thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.

verses.english:
But if you go back to the city and say to Absalom, ‘I will be your
servant, O king; I was your father’s servant formerly, and now I
will be yours,’ then you can nullify Ahithophel’s counsel for me.

verses.hebrew: וַהֲלוֹא עִמְּךָ שָׁם צָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהָיָה כּל־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמַע מִבֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ תַּגִּיד לְצָדוֹק וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֲנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַהֲלוֹא עִמְּךָ שָׁם צָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהָיָה כּל־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמַע מִבֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ תַּגִּיד לְצָדוֹק וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֲנִים׃

english.text:
You will have the priests Zadok and Abiathar there, and you can
report everything that you hear in the king’s palace to the
priests Zadok and Abiathar.

translation.text: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king’s house, thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

verses.english:
You will have the priests Zadok and Abiathar there, and you can
report everything that you hear in the king’s palace to the
priests Zadok and Abiathar.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־שָׁם עִמָּם שְׁנֵי בְנֵיהֶם אֲחִימַעַץ לְצָדוֹק וִיהוֹנָתָן לְאֶבְיָתָר וּשְׁלַחְתֶּם בְּיָדָם אֵלַי כּל־דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמָעוּ׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה־שָׁם עִמָּם שְׁנֵי בְנֵיהֶם אֲחִימַעַץ לְצָדוֹק וִיהוֹנָתָן לְאֶבְיָתָר וּשְׁלַחְתֶּם בְּיָדָם אֵלַי כּל־דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמָעוּ׃

english.text:
Also, their two sons are there with them, Zadok’s son Ahimaaz and
Abiathar’s son Jonathan; and through them you can report to me
everything you hear.”

translation.text: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok’s son, and Jonathan Abiathar’s son; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear.

verses.english:
Also, their two sons are there with them, Zadok’s son Ahimaaz and
Abiathar’s son Jonathan; and through them you can report to me
everything you hear.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא חוּשַׁי רֵעֶה דָוִד הָעִיר וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם יָבוֹא יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא חוּשַׁי רֵעֶה דָוִד הָעִיר וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם יָבוֹא יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
And so Hushai, the friend of David, reached the city as Absalom
was entering Jerusalem.

translation.text: So Hushai David’s friend came into the city, and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

verses.english:
And so Hushai, the friend of David, reached the city as Absalom
was entering Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד עָבַר מְעַט מֵהָרֹאשׁ וְהִנֵּה צִיבָא נַעַר מְפִיבֹשֶׁת לִקְרָאתוֹ וְצֶמֶד חֲמֹרִים חֲבֻשִׁים וַעֲלֵיהֶם מָאתַיִם לֶחֶם וּמֵאָה צִמּוּקִים וּמֵאָה קַיִץ וְנֵבֶל יָיִן׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד עָבַר מְעַט מֵהָרֹאשׁ וְהִנֵּה צִיבָא נַעַר מְפִיבֹשֶׁת לִקְרָאתוֹ וְצֶמֶד חֲמֹרִים חֲבֻשִׁים וַעֲלֵיהֶם מָאתַיִם לֶחֶם וּמֵאָה צִמּוּקִים וּמֵאָה קַיִץ וְנֵבֶל יָיִן׃

english.text:
David had passed a little beyond the summit when Ziba the servant
of Mephibosheth came toward him with a pair of saddled asses
carrying two hundred loaves of bread, one hundred cakes of raisin,
one hundred cakes of figs, and a jar of wine.

translation.text: And when David was a little past the top of the hill, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, and upon them two hundred loaves of bread, and an hundred bunches of raisins, and an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.

verses.english:
David had passed a little beyond the summit when Ziba the servant
of Mephibosheth came toward him with a pair of saddled asses
carrying two hundred loaves of bread, one hundred cakes of raisin,
one hundred cakes of figs, and a jar of wine.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־צִיבָא מָה־אֵלֶּה לָּךְ וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא הַחֲמוֹרִים לְבֵית־הַמֶּלֶךְ לִרְכֹּב (ולהלחם) [וְהַלֶּחֶם] וְהַקַּיִץ לֶאֱכוֹל הַנְּעָרִים וְהַיַּיִן לִשְׁתּוֹת
הַיָּעֵף בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־צִיבָא מָה־אֵלֶּה לָּךְ וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא הַחֲמוֹרִים לְבֵית־הַמֶּלֶךְ לִרְכֹּב (ולהלחם) [וְהַלֶּחֶם] וְהַקַּיִץ לֶאֱכוֹל הַנְּעָרִים וְהַיַּיִן לִשְׁתּוֹת
הַיָּעֵף בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
The king asked Ziba, “What are you doing with these?” Ziba
answered, “The asses are for Your Majesty’s family to ride on, the
bread and figs are for the attendants to eat, and the wine is to
be drunk by any who are exhausted in the wilderness.”

translation.text: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest thou by these? And Ziba said, The asses be for the king’s household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink.

verses.english:
The king asked Ziba, “What are you doing with these?” Ziba
answered, “The asses are for Your Majesty’s family to ride on, the
bread and figs are for the attendants to eat, and the wine is to
be drunk by any who are exhausted in the wilderness.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאַיֵּה בֶּן־אֲדֹנֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה יוֹשֵׁב בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם כִּי אָמַר הַיּוֹם יָשִׁיבוּ לִי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת מַמְלְכוּת אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאַיֵּה בֶּן־אֲדֹנֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה יוֹשֵׁב בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם כִּי אָמַר הַיּוֹם יָשִׁיבוּ לִי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת מַמְלְכוּת אָבִי׃

english.text:
“And where is your master’s son?” the king asked. “He is staying
in Jerusalem,” Ziba replied to the king, “for he thinks that the
House of Israel will now give him back the throne of his
grandfather.”

translation.text: And the king said, And where is thy master’s son? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he abideth at Jerusalem: for he said, To day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father.

verses.english:
“And where is your master’s son?” the king asked. “He is staying
in Jerusalem,” Ziba replied to the king, “for he thinks that the
House of Israel will now give him back the throne of his
grandfather.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְצִבָא הִנֵּה לְךָ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר לִמְפִיבֹשֶׁת וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא הִשְׁתַּחֲוֵיתִי אֶמְצָא־חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְצִבָא הִנֵּה לְךָ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר לִמְפִיבֹשֶׁת וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא הִשְׁתַּחֲוֵיתִי אֶמְצָא־חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The king said to Ziba, “Then all that belongs to Mephibosheth is
now yours!” And Ziba replied, “I bow low. Your Majesty is most
gracious to me.”

translation.text: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech thee that I may find grace in thy sight, my lord, O king.

verses.english:
The king said to Ziba, “Then all that belongs to Mephibosheth is
now yours!” And Ziba replied, “I bow low. Your Majesty is most
gracious to me.”

verses.hebrew: וּבָא הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד עַד־בַּחוּרִים וְהִנֵּה מִשָּׁם אִישׁ יוֹצֵא מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת בֵּית־שָׁאוּל וּשְׁמוֹ שִׁמְעִי בֶן־גֵּרָא יֹצֵא יָצוֹא וּמְקַלֵּל׃

hebrew.text: וּבָא הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד עַד־בַּחוּרִים וְהִנֵּה מִשָּׁם אִישׁ יוֹצֵא מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת בֵּית־שָׁאוּל וּשְׁמוֹ שִׁמְעִי בֶן־גֵּרָא יֹצֵא יָצוֹא וּמְקַלֵּל׃

english.text:
As King David was approaching Bahurim, a member of Saul’s clan—a
man named Shimei son of Gera—came out from there, hurling insults
as he came.

translation.text: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came.

verses.english:
As King David was approaching Bahurim, a member of Saul’s clan—a
man named Shimei son of Gera—came out from there, hurling insults
as he came.

verses.hebrew: וַיְסַקֵּל בָּאֲבָנִים אֶת־דָּוִד וְאֶת־כּל־עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וְכל־הָעָם וְכל־הַגִּבֹּרִים מִימִינוֹ וּמִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְסַקֵּל בָּאֲבָנִים אֶת־דָּוִד וְאֶת־כּל־עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וְכל־הָעָם וְכל־הַגִּבֹּרִים מִימִינוֹ וּמִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ׃

english.text:
He threw stones at David and all King David’s courtiers, while all
the troops and all the warriors were at his right and his left.

translation.text: And he cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David: and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.

verses.english:
He threw stones at David and all King David’s courtiers, while all
the troops and all the warriors were at his right and his left.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹה־אָמַר שִׁמְעִי בְּקַלְלוֹ צֵא צֵא אִישׁ הַדָּמִים וְאִישׁ הַבְּלִיָּעַל׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹה־אָמַר שִׁמְעִי בְּקַלְלוֹ צֵא צֵא אִישׁ הַדָּמִים וְאִישׁ הַבְּלִיָּעַל׃

english.text:
And these are the insults that Shimei hurled: “Get out, get out,
you criminal, you villain!

translation.text: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial:

verses.english:
And these are the insults that Shimei hurled: “Get out, get out,
you criminal, you villain!

verses.hebrew:
הֵשִׁיב עָלֶיךָ יְהֹוָה כֹּל דְּמֵי בֵית־שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר מָלַכְתָּ תַּחְתָּו וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַמְּלוּכָה בְּיַד אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּנֶךָ וְהִנְּךָ בְּרָעָתֶךָ כִּי אִישׁ דָּמִים
אָתָּה׃

hebrew.text:
הֵשִׁיב עָלֶיךָ יְהֹוָה כֹּל דְּמֵי בֵית־שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר מָלַכְתָּ תַּחְתָּו וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַמְּלוּכָה בְּיַד אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּנֶךָ וְהִנְּךָ בְּרָעָתֶךָ כִּי אִישׁ דָּמִים
אָתָּה׃

english.text:
YHWH is paying you back for all your crimes against the family of
Saul, whose throne you seized. YHWH is handing over the throne to
your son Absalom; you are in trouble because you are a criminal!”

translation.text: The LORD hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose stead thou hast reigned; and the LORD hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son: and, behold, thou art taken in thy mischief, because thou art a bloody man.

verses.english:
YHWH is paying you back for all your crimes against the family of
Saul, whose throne you seized. YHWH is handing over the throne to
your son Absalom; you are in trouble because you are a criminal!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן־צְרוּיָה אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה יְקַלֵּל הַכֶּלֶב הַמֵּת הַזֶּה אֶת־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶעְבְּרָה־נָּא וְאָסִירָה אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן־צְרוּיָה אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה יְקַלֵּל הַכֶּלֶב הַמֵּת הַזֶּה אֶת־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶעְבְּרָה־נָּא וְאָסִירָה אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
Abishai son of Zeruiah said to the king, “Why let that dead dog
abuse my lord the king? Let me go over and cut off his head!”

translation.text: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray thee, and take off his head.

verses.english:
Abishai son of Zeruiah said to the king, “Why let that dead dog
abuse my lord the king? Let me go over and cut off his head!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ מַה־לִּי וְלָכֶם בְּנֵי צְרֻיָה (כי) [כֹּה] יְקַלֵּל (וכי) [כִּי] יְהֹוָה אָמַר לוֹ קַלֵּל אֶת־דָּוִד וּמִי יֹאמַר מַדּוּעַ עָשִׂיתָה כֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ מַה־לִּי וְלָכֶם בְּנֵי צְרֻיָה (כי) [כֹּה] יְקַלֵּל (וכי) [כִּי] יְהֹוָה אָמַר לוֹ קַלֵּל אֶת־דָּוִד וּמִי יֹאמַר מַדּוּעַ עָשִׂיתָה כֵּן׃

english.text:
But the king said, “What has this to do with you, you sons of
Zeruiah? He is abusing [me] only because YHWH told him to abuse
David; and who is to say, ‘Why did You do that?’”

translation.text: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because the LORD hath said unto him, Curse David. Who shall then say, Wherefore hast thou done so?

verses.english:
But the king said, “What has this to do with you, you sons of
Zeruiah? He is abusing [me] only because YHWH told him to abuse
David; and who is to say, ‘Why did You do that?’”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אֲבִישַׁי וְאֶל־כּל־עֲבָדָיו הִנֵּה בְנִי אֲשֶׁר־יָצָא מִמֵּעַי מְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי וְאַף כִּי־עַתָּה בֶּן־הַיְמִינִי הַנִּחוּ לוֹ וִיקַלֵּל כִּי אָמַר־לוֹ
יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אֲבִישַׁי וְאֶל־כּל־עֲבָדָיו הִנֵּה בְנִי אֲשֶׁר־יָצָא מִמֵּעַי מְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי וְאַף כִּי־עַתָּה בֶּן־הַיְמִינִי הַנִּחוּ לוֹ וִיקַלֵּל כִּי אָמַר־לוֹ
יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
David said further to Abishai and all the courtiers, “If my son,
my own issue, seeks to kill me, how much more the Benjaminite! Let
him go on hurling abuse, for YHWH has told him to.

translation.text: And David said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, which came forth of my bowels, seeketh my life: how much more now may this Benjamite do it? let him alone, and let him curse; for the LORD hath bidden him.

verses.english:
David said further to Abishai and all the courtiers, “If my son,
my own issue, seeks to kill me, how much more the Benjaminite! Let
him go on hurling abuse, for YHWH has told him to.

verses.hebrew: אוּלַי יִרְאֶה יְהֹוָה (בעוני) [בְּעֵינִי] וְהֵשִׁיב יְהֹוָה לִי טוֹבָה תַּחַת קִלְלָתוֹ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: אוּלַי יִרְאֶה יְהֹוָה (בעוני) [בְּעֵינִי] וְהֵשִׁיב יְהֹוָה לִי טוֹבָה תַּחַת קִלְלָתוֹ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Perhaps YHWH will look upon my punishment and recompense me for
the abuse [Shimei] has uttered today.”

translation.text: It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction, and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing this day.

verses.english:
Perhaps YHWH will look upon my punishment and recompense me for
the abuse [Shimei] has uttered today.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו בַּדָּרֶךְוְשִׁמְעִי הֹלֵךְ בְּצֵלַע הָהָר לְעֻמָּתוֹ הָלוֹךְ וַיְקַלֵּל וַיְסַקֵּל בָּאֲבָנִים לְעֻמָּתוֹ וְעִפַּר בֶּעָפָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו בַּדָּרֶךְוְשִׁמְעִי הֹלֵךְ בְּצֵלַע הָהָר לְעֻמָּתוֹ הָלוֹךְ וַיְקַלֵּל וַיְסַקֵּל בָּאֲבָנִים לְעֻמָּתוֹ וְעִפַּר בֶּעָפָר׃

english.text:
David and his men continued on their way, while Shimei walked
alongside on the slope of the hill, insulting him as he walked,
and throwing stones at him and flinging dirt.

translation.text: And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill’s side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.

verses.english:
David and his men continued on their way, while Shimei walked
alongside on the slope of the hill, insulting him as he walked,
and throwing stones at him and flinging dirt.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ עֲיֵפִים וַיִּנָּפֵשׁ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ עֲיֵפִים וַיִּנָּפֵשׁ שָׁם׃

english.text:
The king and all who accompanied him arrived exhausted, and he
rested there.

translation.text: And the king, and all the people that were with him, came weary, and refreshed themselves there.

verses.english:
The king and all who accompanied him arrived exhausted, and he
rested there.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם וְכל־הָעָם אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאוּ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וַאֲחִיתֹפֶל אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם וְכל־הָעָם אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאוּ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וַאֲחִיתֹפֶל אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
Meanwhile Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, arrived
in Jerusalem, together with Ahithophel.

translation.text: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

verses.english:
Meanwhile Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, arrived
in Jerusalem, together with Ahithophel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּא חוּשַׁי הָאַרְכִּי רֵעֶה דָוִד אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר חוּשַׁי אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּא חוּשַׁי הָאַרְכִּי רֵעֶה דָוִד אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר חוּשַׁי אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, came before Absalom,
Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live the king!”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, God save the king, God save the king.

verses.english:
When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, came before Absalom,
Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live the king!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־חוּשַׁי זֶה חַסְדְּךָ אֶת־רֵעֶךָ לָמָּה לֹא־הָלַכְתָּ אֶת־רֵעֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־חוּשַׁי זֶה חַסְדְּךָ אֶת־רֵעֶךָ לָמָּה לֹא־הָלַכְתָּ אֶת־רֵעֶךָ׃

english.text:
But Absalom said to Hushai, “Is this your loyalty to your friend?
Why didn’t you go with your friend?”

translation.text: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not with thy friend?

verses.english:
But Absalom said to Hushai, “Is this your loyalty to your friend?
Why didn’t you go with your friend?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חוּשַׁי אֶל־אַבְשָׁלֹם לֹא כִּי אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר יְהֹוָה וְהָעָם הַזֶּה וְכל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל (לא) [לוֹ] אֶהְיֶה וְאִתּוֹ אֵשֵׁב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר חוּשַׁי אֶל־אַבְשָׁלֹם לֹא כִּי אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר יְהֹוָה וְהָעָם הַזֶּה וְכל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל (לא) [לוֹ] אֶהְיֶה וְאִתּוֹ אֵשֵׁב׃

english.text:
“Not at all!” Hushai replied. “I am for the one whom YHWH and this
people and all the men of Israel have chosen, and I will stay with
him.

translation.text: And Hushai said unto Absalom, Nay; but whom the LORD, and this people, and all the men of Israel, choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.

verses.english:
“Not at all!” Hushai replied. “I am for the one whom YHWH and this
people and all the men of Israel have chosen, and I will stay with
him.

verses.hebrew: וְהַשֵּׁנִית לְמִי אֲנִי אֶעֱבֹד הֲלוֹא לִפְנֵי בְנוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָבַדְתִּי לִפְנֵי אָבִיךָ כֵּן אֶהְיֶה לְפָנֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשֵּׁנִית לְמִי אֲנִי אֶעֱבֹד הֲלוֹא לִפְנֵי בְנוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָבַדְתִּי לִפְנֵי אָבִיךָ כֵּן אֶהְיֶה לְפָנֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Furthermore, whom should I serve, if not David’s son? As I was in
your father’s service, so I will be in yours.”

translation.text: And again, whom should I serve? should I not serve in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father’s presence, so will I be in thy presence.

verses.english:
Furthermore, whom should I serve, if not David’s son? As I was in
your father’s service, so I will be in yours.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־אֲחִיתֹפֶל הָבוּ לָכֶם עֵצָה מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־אֲחִיתֹפֶל הָבוּ לָכֶם עֵצָה מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text: Absalom then said to Ahithophel, “What do you advise us to do?”

translation.text: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.

verses.english: Absalom then said to Ahithophel, “What do you advise us to do?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֲחִיתֹפֶל אֶל־אַבְשָׁלֹם בּוֹא אֶל־פִּלַגְשֵׁי אָבִיךָ אֲשֶׁר הִנִּיחַ לִשְׁמוֹר הַבָּיִת וְשָׁמַע כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־נִבְאַשְׁתָּ אֶת־אָבִיךָ וְחָזְקוּ יְדֵי
כּל־אֲשֶׁר אִתָּךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֲחִיתֹפֶל אֶל־אַבְשָׁלֹם בּוֹא אֶל־פִּלַגְשֵׁי אָבִיךָ אֲשֶׁר הִנִּיחַ לִשְׁמוֹר הַבָּיִת וְשָׁמַע כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־נִבְאַשְׁתָּ אֶת־אָבִיךָ וְחָזְקוּ יְדֵי
כּל־אֲשֶׁר אִתָּךְ׃

english.text:
And Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Have intercourse with your
father’s concubines, whom he left to mind the palace; and when all
Israel hears that you have dared the wrath of your father, all who
support you will be encouraged.”

translation.text: And Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Go in unto thy father’s concubines, which he hath left to keep the house; and all Israel shall hear that thou art abhorred of thy father: then shall the hands of all that are with thee be strong.

verses.english:
And Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Have intercourse with your
father’s concubines, whom he left to mind the palace; and when all
Israel hears that you have dared the wrath of your father, all who
support you will be encouraged.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּטּוּ לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם הָאֹהֶל עַל־הַגָּג וַיָּבֹא אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־פִּלַגְשֵׁי אָבִיו לְעֵינֵי כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּטּוּ לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם הָאֹהֶל עַל־הַגָּג וַיָּבֹא אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־פִּלַגְשֵׁי אָבִיו לְעֵינֵי כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
So they pitched a tent for Absalom on the roof, and Absalom lay
with his father’s concubines with the full knowledge of all
Israel.—

translation.text: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and Absalom went in unto his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.

verses.english:
So they pitched a tent for Absalom on the roof, and Absalom lay
with his father’s concubines with the full knowledge of all
Israel.—

verses.hebrew: וַעֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל אֲשֶׁר יָעַץ בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם כַּאֲשֶׁר יִשְׁאַל־[אִישׁ] בִּדְבַר הָאֱלֹהִים כֵּן כּל־עֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל גַּם־לְדָוִד גַּם לְאַבְשָׁלֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל אֲשֶׁר יָעַץ בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם כַּאֲשֶׁר יִשְׁאַל־[אִישׁ] בִּדְבַר הָאֱלֹהִים כֵּן כּל־עֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל גַּם־לְדָוִד גַּם לְאַבְשָׁלֹם׃

english.text:
In those days, the advice which Ahithophel gave was accepted like
an oracle sought from God; that is how all the advice of
Ahithophel was esteemed both by David and by Absalom.

translation.text: And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God: so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.

verses.english:
In those days, the advice which Ahithophel gave was accepted like
an oracle sought from God; that is how all the advice of
Ahithophel was esteemed both by David and by Absalom.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲחִיתֹפֶל אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶבְחֲרָה נָּא שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף אִישׁ וְאָקוּמָה וְאֶרְדְּפָה אַחֲרֵי־דָוִד הַלָּיְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲחִיתֹפֶל אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶבְחֲרָה נָּא שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף אִישׁ וְאָקוּמָה וְאֶרְדְּפָה אַחֲרֵי־דָוִד הַלָּיְלָה׃

english.text:
And Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me pick twelve thousand men
and set out tonight in pursuit of David.

translation.text: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:

verses.english:
And Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me pick twelve thousand men
and set out tonight in pursuit of David.

verses.hebrew: וְאָבוֹא עָלָיו וְהוּא יָגֵעַ וּרְפֵה יָדַיִם וְהַחֲרַדְתִּי אֹתוֹ וְנָס כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ וְהִכֵּיתִי אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ לְבַדּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאָבוֹא עָלָיו וְהוּא יָגֵעַ וּרְפֵה יָדַיִם וְהַחֲרַדְתִּי אֹתוֹ וְנָס כּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ וְהִכֵּיתִי אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ לְבַדּוֹ׃

english.text:
I will come upon him when he is weary and disheartened, and I will
throw him into a panic; and when all the troops with him flee, I
will kill the king alone.

translation.text: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that are with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:

verses.english:
I will come upon him when he is weary and disheartened, and I will
throw him into a panic; and when all the troops with him flee, I
will kill the king alone.

verses.hebrew: וְאָשִׁיבָה כל־הָעָם אֵלֶיךָ כְּשׁוּב הַכֹּל הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה מְבַקֵּשׁ כּל־הָעָם יִהְיֶה שָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְאָשִׁיבָה כל־הָעָם אֵלֶיךָ כְּשׁוּב הַכֹּל הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה מְבַקֵּשׁ כּל־הָעָם יִהְיֶה שָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
And I will bring back all the people to you; when all have come
back [except] the man you are after, all the people will be at
peace.”

translation.text: And I will bring back all the people unto thee: the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned: so all the people shall be in peace.

verses.english:
And I will bring back all the people to you; when all have come
back [except] the man you are after, all the people will be at
peace.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּישַׁר הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי אַבְשָׁלֹם וּבְעֵינֵי כּל־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּישַׁר הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי אַבְשָׁלֹם וּבְעֵינֵי כּל־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text: The advice pleased Absalom and all the elders of Israel.

translation.text: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

verses.english: The advice pleased Absalom and all the elders of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם קְרָא נָא גַּם לְחוּשַׁי הָאַרְכִּי וְנִשְׁמְעָה מַה־בְּפִיו גַּם־הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם קְרָא נָא גַּם לְחוּשַׁי הָאַרְכִּי וְנִשְׁמְעָה מַה־בְּפִיו גַּם־הוּא׃

english.text:
But Absalom said, “Summon Hushai the Archite as well, so we can
hear what he too has to say.”

translation.text: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he saith.

verses.english:
But Absalom said, “Summon Hushai the Archite as well, so we can
hear what he too has to say.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא חוּשַׁי אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה דִּבֶּר אֲחִיתֹפֶל הֲנַעֲשֶׂה אֶת־דְּבָרוֹ אִם־אַיִן אַתָּה דַבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא חוּשַׁי אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה דִּבֶּר אֲחִיתֹפֶל הֲנַעֲשֶׂה אֶת־דְּבָרוֹ אִם־אַיִן אַתָּה דַבֵּר׃

english.text:
Hushai came to Absalom, and Absalom said to him, “This is what
Ahithophel has advised. Shall we follow his advice? If not, what
do you say?”

translation.text: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do after his saying? if not; speak thou.

verses.english:
Hushai came to Absalom, and Absalom said to him, “This is what
Ahithophel has advised. Shall we follow his advice? If not, what
do you say?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חוּשַׁי אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם לֹא־טוֹבָה הָעֵצָה אֲשֶׁר־יָעַץ אֲחִיתֹפֶל בַּפַּעַם הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר חוּשַׁי אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם לֹא־טוֹבָה הָעֵצָה אֲשֶׁר־יָעַץ אֲחִיתֹפֶל בַּפַּעַם הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
Hushai said to Absalom, “This time the advice that Ahithophel has
given is not good.

translation.text: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time.

verses.english:
Hushai said to Absalom, “This time the advice that Ahithophel has
given is not good.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר חוּשַׁי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־אָבִיךָ וְאֶת־אֲנָשָׁיו כִּי גִבֹּרִים הֵמָּה וּמָרֵי נֶפֶשׁ הֵמָּה כְּדֹב שַׁכּוּל בַּשָּׂדֶה וְאָבִיךָ אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה וְלֹא יָלִין
אֶת־הָעָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר חוּשַׁי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־אָבִיךָ וְאֶת־אֲנָשָׁיו כִּי גִבֹּרִים הֵמָּה וּמָרֵי נֶפֶשׁ הֵמָּה כְּדֹב שַׁכּוּל בַּשָּׂדֶה וְאָבִיךָ אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה וְלֹא יָלִין
אֶת־הָעָם׃

english.text:
You know,” Hushai continued, “that your father and his men are
courageous fighters, and they are as desperate as a bear in the
wild robbed of her whelps. Your father is an experienced soldier,
and he will not spend the night with the troops;

translation.text: For, said Hushai, thou knowest thy father and his men, that they be mighty men, and they be chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field: and thy father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

verses.english:
You know,” Hushai continued, “that your father and his men are
courageous fighters, and they are as desperate as a bear in the
wild robbed of her whelps. Your father is an experienced soldier,
and he will not spend the night with the troops;

verses.hebrew:
הִנֵּה עַתָּה הוּא־נֶחְבָּא בְּאַחַת הַפְּחָתִים אוֹ בְּאַחַד הַמְּקוֹמֹת וְהָיָה כִּנְפֹל בָּהֶם בַּתְּחִלָּה וְשָׁמַע הַשֹּׁמֵעַ וְאָמַר הָיְתָה מַגֵּפָה בָּעָם אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵי
אַבְשָׁלֹם׃

hebrew.text:
הִנֵּה עַתָּה הוּא־נֶחְבָּא בְּאַחַת הַפְּחָתִים אוֹ בְּאַחַד הַמְּקוֹמֹת וְהָיָה כִּנְפֹל בָּהֶם בַּתְּחִלָּה וְשָׁמַע הַשֹּׁמֵעַ וְאָמַר הָיְתָה מַגֵּפָה בָּעָם אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵי
אַבְשָׁלֹם׃

english.text:
even now he must be hiding in one of the pits or in some other
place. And if any of them fall at the first attack, whoever hears
of it will say, ‘A disaster has struck the troops that follow
Absalom’;

translation.text: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some other place: and it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that whosoever heareth it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom.

verses.english:
even now he must be hiding in one of the pits or in some other
place. And if any of them fall at the first attack, whoever hears
of it will say, ‘A disaster has struck the troops that follow
Absalom’;

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא גַם־בֶּן־חַיִל אֲשֶׁר לִבּוֹ כְּלֵב הָאַרְיֵה הִמֵּס יִמָּס כִּי־יֹדֵעַ כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־גִבּוֹר אָבִיךָ וּבְנֵי־חַיִל אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהוּא גַם־בֶּן־חַיִל אֲשֶׁר לִבּוֹ כְּלֵב הָאַרְיֵה הִמֵּס יִמָּס כִּי־יֹדֵעַ כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־גִבּוֹר אָבִיךָ וּבְנֵי־חַיִל אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
and even if he is a brave man with the heart of a lion, he will be
shaken—for all Israel knows that your father and the soldiers with
him are courageous fighters.

translation.text: And he also that is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, shall utterly melt: for all Israel knoweth that thy father is a mighty man, and they which be with him are valiant men.

verses.english:
and even if he is a brave man with the heart of a lion, he will be
shaken—for all Israel knows that your father and the soldiers with
him are courageous fighters.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יָעַצְתִּי הֵאָסֹף יֵאָסֵף עָלֶיךָ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַיָּם לָרֹב וּפָנֶיךָ הֹלְכִים בַּקְרָב׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יָעַצְתִּי הֵאָסֹף יֵאָסֵף עָלֶיךָ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַיָּם לָרֹב וּפָנֶיךָ הֹלְכִים בַּקְרָב׃

english.text:
So I advise that all Israel from Dan to Beer-sheba—as numerous as
the sands of the sea—be called up to join you, and that you
yourself march into battle.

translation.text: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that thou go to battle in thine own person.

verses.english:
So I advise that all Israel from Dan to Beer-sheba—as numerous as
the sands of the sea—be called up to join you, and that you
yourself march into battle.

verses.hebrew:
וּבָאנוּ אֵלָיו (באחת) [בְּאַחַד] הַמְּקוֹמֹת אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא שָׁם וְנַחְנוּ עָלָיו כַּאֲשֶׁר יִפֹּל הַטַּל עַל־הָאֲדָמָה וְלֹא־נוֹתַר בּוֹ וּבְכל־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ
גַּם־אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text:
וּבָאנוּ אֵלָיו (באחת) [בְּאַחַד] הַמְּקוֹמֹת אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא שָׁם וְנַחְנוּ עָלָיו כַּאֲשֶׁר יִפֹּל הַטַּל עַל־הָאֲדָמָה וְלֹא־נוֹתַר בּוֹ וּבְכל־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ
גַּם־אֶחָד׃

english.text:
When we come upon him in whatever place he may be, we’ll descend
on him [as thick] as dew falling on the ground; and no one will
survive, neither he nor any of the men with him.

translation.text: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground: and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one.

verses.english:
When we come upon him in whatever place he may be, we’ll descend
on him [as thick] as dew falling on the ground; and no one will
survive, neither he nor any of the men with him.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־אֶל־עִיר יֵאָסֵף וְהִשִּׂיאוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הָעִיר הַהִיא חֲבָלִים וְסָחַבְנוּ אֹתוֹ עַד־הַנַּחַל עַד אֲשֶׁר־לֹא־נִמְצָא שָׁם גַּם־צְרוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם־אֶל־עִיר יֵאָסֵף וְהִשִּׂיאוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הָעִיר הַהִיא חֲבָלִים וְסָחַבְנוּ אֹתוֹ עַד־הַנַּחַל עַד אֲשֶׁר־לֹא־נִמְצָא שָׁם גַּם־צְרוֹר׃

english.text:
And if he withdraws into a city, all Israel will bring ropes to
that city and drag its stones as far as the riverbed, until not
even a pebble of it is left.”

translation.text: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.

verses.english:
And if he withdraws into a city, all Israel will bring ropes to
that city and drag its stones as far as the riverbed, until not
even a pebble of it is left.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם וְכל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל טוֹבָה עֲצַת חוּשַׁי הָאַרְכִּי מֵעֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶלוַיהֹוָה צִוָּה לְהָפֵר אֶת־עֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל הַטּוֹבָה לְבַעֲבוּר הָבִיא יְהֹוָה
אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־הָרָעָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם וְכל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל טוֹבָה עֲצַת חוּשַׁי הָאַרְכִּי מֵעֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶלוַיהֹוָה צִוָּה לְהָפֵר אֶת־עֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל הַטּוֹבָה לְבַעֲבוּר הָבִיא יְהֹוָה
אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־הָרָעָה׃

english.text:
Absalom and all Israel agreed that the advice of Hushai the
Archite was better than that of Ahithophel.—YHWH had decreed that
Ahithophel’s sound advice be nullified, in order that YHWH might
bring ruin upon Absalom.

translation.text: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For the LORD had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the LORD might bring evil upon Absalom.

verses.english:
Absalom and all Israel agreed that the advice of Hushai the
Archite was better than that of Ahithophel.—YHWH had decreed that
Ahithophel’s sound advice be nullified, in order that YHWH might
bring ruin upon Absalom.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חוּשַׁי אֶל־צָדוֹק וְאֶל־אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֲנִים כָּזֹאת וְכָזֹאת יָעַץ אֲחִיתֹפֶל אֶת־אַבְשָׁלֹם וְאֵת זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכָזֹאת וְכָזֹאת יָעַצְתִּי אָנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר חוּשַׁי אֶל־צָדוֹק וְאֶל־אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֲנִים כָּזֹאת וְכָזֹאת יָעַץ אֲחִיתֹפֶל אֶת־אַבְשָׁלֹם וְאֵת זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכָזֹאת וְכָזֹאת יָעַצְתִּי אָנִי׃

english.text:
Then Hushai told the priests Zadok and Abiathar, “This is what
Ahithophel advised Absalom and the elders of Israel; this is what
I advised.

translation.text: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel; and thus and thus have I counselled.

verses.english:
Then Hushai told the priests Zadok and Abiathar, “This is what
Ahithophel advised Absalom and the elders of Israel; this is what
I advised.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שִׁלְחוּ מְהֵרָה וְהַגִּידוּ לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר אַל־תָּלֶן הַלַּיְלָה בְּעַרְבוֹת הַמִּדְבָּר וְגַם עָבוֹר תַּעֲבוֹר פֶּן יְבֻלַּע לַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שִׁלְחוּ מְהֵרָה וְהַגִּידוּ לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר אַל־תָּלֶן הַלַּיְלָה בְּעַרְבוֹת הַמִּדְבָּר וְגַם עָבוֹר תַּעֲבוֹר פֶּן יְבֻלַּע לַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
Now send at once and tell David, ‘Do not spend the night at the
fords of the wilderness, but cross over at once; otherwise the
king and all the troops with him will be annihilated.’”

translation.text: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that are with him.

verses.english:
Now send at once and tell David, ‘Do not spend the night at the
fords of the wilderness, but cross over at once; otherwise the
king and all the troops with him will be annihilated.’”

verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹנָתָן וַאֲחִימַעַץ עֹמְדִים בְּעֵין־רֹגֵל וְהָלְכָה הַשִּׁפְחָה וְהִגִּידָה לָהֶם וְהֵם יֵלְכוּ וְהִגִּידוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד כִּי לֹא יוּכְלוּ לְהֵרָאוֹת לָבוֹא הָעִירָה׃

hebrew.text: וִיהוֹנָתָן וַאֲחִימַעַץ עֹמְדִים בְּעֵין־רֹגֵל וְהָלְכָה הַשִּׁפְחָה וְהִגִּידָה לָהֶם וְהֵם יֵלְכוּ וְהִגִּידוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד כִּי לֹא יוּכְלוּ לְהֵרָאוֹת לָבוֹא הָעִירָה׃

english.text:
Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying at En-rogel, and a slave girl
would go and bring them word and they in turn would go and inform
King David. For they themselves dared not be seen entering the
city.

translation.text: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by Enrogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king David.

verses.english:
Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying at En-rogel, and a slave girl
would go and bring them word and they in turn would go and inform
King David. For they themselves dared not be seen entering the
city.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֹתָם נַעַר וַיַּגֵּד לְאַבְשָׁלֹם וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בֵּית־אִישׁ בְּבַחוּרִים וְלוֹ בְאֵר בַּחֲצֵרוֹ וַיֵּרְדוּ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אֹתָם נַעַר וַיַּגֵּד לְאַבְשָׁלֹם וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בֵּית־אִישׁ בְּבַחוּרִים וְלוֹ בְאֵר בַּחֲצֵרוֹ וַיֵּרְדוּ שָׁם׃

english.text:
But a boy saw them and informed Absalom. They left at once and
came to the house of a man in Bahurim who had a well in his
courtyard. They got down into it,

translation.text: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, and came to a man’s house in Bahurim, which had a well in his court; whither they went down.

verses.english:
But a boy saw them and informed Absalom. They left at once and
came to the house of a man in Bahurim who had a well in his
courtyard. They got down into it,

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח הָאִשָּׁה וַתִּפְרֹשׂ אֶת־הַמָּסָךְ עַל־פְּנֵי הַבְּאֵר וַתִּשְׁטַח עָלָיו הָרִפוֹת וְלֹא נוֹדַע דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקַּח הָאִשָּׁה וַתִּפְרֹשׂ אֶת־הַמָּסָךְ עַל־פְּנֵי הַבְּאֵר וַתִּשְׁטַח עָלָיו הָרִפוֹת וְלֹא נוֹדַע דָּבָר׃

english.text:
and the wife took a cloth, spread it over the mouth of the well,
and scattered groats on top of it, so that nothing would be
noticed.

translation.text: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well’s mouth, and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.

verses.english:
and the wife took a cloth, spread it over the mouth of the well,
and scattered groats on top of it, so that nothing would be
noticed.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה הַבַּיְתָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַיֵּה אֲחִימַעַץ וִיהוֹנָתָן וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הָאִשָּׁה עָבְרוּ מִיכַל הַמָּיִם וַיְבַקְשׁוּ וְלֹא מָצָאוּ
וַיָּשֻׁבוּ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה הַבַּיְתָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַיֵּה אֲחִימַעַץ וִיהוֹנָתָן וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הָאִשָּׁה עָבְרוּ מִיכַל הַמָּיִם וַיְבַקְשׁוּ וְלֹא מָצָאוּ
וַיָּשֻׁבוּ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
When Absalom’s servants came to the woman at the house and asked
where Ahimaaz and Jonathan were, the woman told them that they had
crossed a bit beyond the water. They searched, but found nothing;
and they returned to Jerusalem.

translation.text: And when Absalom’s servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where is Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They be gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.english:
When Absalom’s servants came to the woman at the house and asked
where Ahimaaz and Jonathan were, the woman told them that they had
crossed a bit beyond the water. They searched, but found nothing;
and they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי לֶכְתָּם וַיַּעֲלוּ מֵהַבְּאֵר וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּגִּדוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־דָּוִד קוּמוּ וְעִבְרוּ מְהֵרָה אֶת־הַמַּיִם כִּי־כָכָה יָעַץ עֲלֵיכֶם
אֲחִיתֹפֶל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי לֶכְתָּם וַיַּעֲלוּ מֵהַבְּאֵר וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּגִּדוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־דָּוִד קוּמוּ וְעִבְרוּ מְהֵרָה אֶת־הַמַּיִם כִּי־כָכָה יָעַץ עֲלֵיכֶם
אֲחִיתֹפֶל׃

english.text:
After they were gone, [Ahimaaz and Jonathan] came up from the well
and went and informed King David. They said to David, “Go and
cross the water quickly, for Ahithophel has advised thus and thus
concerning you.”

translation.text: And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, and went and told king David, and said unto David, Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you.

verses.english:
After they were gone, [Ahimaaz and Jonathan] came up from the well
and went and informed King David. They said to David, “Go and
cross the water quickly, for Ahithophel has advised thus and thus
concerning you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם דָּוִד וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר עַד־אַחַד לֹא נֶעְדָּר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָבַר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם דָּוִד וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר עַד־אַחַד לֹא נֶעְדָּר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָבַר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
David and all the troops with him promptly crossed the Jordan, and
by daybreak not one was left who had not crossed the Jordan.

translation.text: Then David arose, and all the people that were with him, and they passed over Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan.

verses.english:
David and all the troops with him promptly crossed the Jordan, and
by daybreak not one was left who had not crossed the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחִיתֹפֶל רָאָה כִּי לֹא נֶעֶשְׂתָה עֲצָתוֹ וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת־הַחֲמוֹר וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ אֶל־עִירוֹ וַיְצַו אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיֵּחָנַק וַיָּמת וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּקֶבֶר אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲחִיתֹפֶל רָאָה כִּי לֹא נֶעֶשְׂתָה עֲצָתוֹ וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת־הַחֲמוֹר וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ אֶל־עִירוֹ וַיְצַו אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיֵּחָנַק וַיָּמת וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּקֶבֶר אָבִיו׃

english.text:
When Ahithophel saw that his advice had not been followed, he
saddled his ass and went home to his native town. He set his
affairs in order, and then he hanged himself. He was buried in his
ancestral tomb.

translation.text: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his ass, and arose, and gat him home to his house, to his city, and put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father.

verses.english:
When Ahithophel saw that his advice had not been followed, he
saddled his ass and went home to his native town. He set his
affairs in order, and then he hanged himself. He was buried in his
ancestral tomb.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד בָּא מַחֲנָיְמָה וְאַבְשָׁלֹם עָבַר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן הוּא וְכל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד בָּא מַחֲנָיְמָה וְאַבְשָׁלֹם עָבַר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן הוּא וְכל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
David had reached Mahanaim when Absalom and all the men of Israel
with him crossed the Jordan.

translation.text: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

verses.english:
David had reached Mahanaim when Absalom and all the men of Israel
with him crossed the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־עֲמָשָׂא שָׂם אַבְשָׁלֹם תַּחַת יוֹאָב עַל־הַצָּבָא וַעֲמָשָׂא בֶן־אִישׁ וּשְׁמוֹ יִתְרָא הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי אֲשֶׁר־בָּא אֶל־אֲבִיגַל בַּת־נָחָשׁ אֲחוֹת צְרוּיָה אֵם יוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־עֲמָשָׂא שָׂם אַבְשָׁלֹם תַּחַת יוֹאָב עַל־הַצָּבָא וַעֲמָשָׂא בֶן־אִישׁ וּשְׁמוֹ יִתְרָא הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי אֲשֶׁר־בָּא אֶל־אֲבִיגַל בַּת־נָחָשׁ אֲחוֹת צְרוּיָה אֵם יוֹאָב׃

english.text:
Absalom had appointed Amasa army commander in place of Joab; Amasa
was the son of a man named Ithra the Israelite, who had married
Abigal, daughter of Nahash and sister of Joab’s mother Zeruiah.

translation.text: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man’s son, whose name was Ithra an Israelite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab’s mother.

verses.english:
Absalom had appointed Amasa army commander in place of Joab; Amasa
was the son of a man named Ithra the Israelite, who had married
Abigal, daughter of Nahash and sister of Joab’s mother Zeruiah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַן יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאַבְשָׁלֹם אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַן יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאַבְשָׁלֹם אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד׃

english.text: The Israelites and Absalom encamped in the district of Gilead.

translation.text: So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.

verses.english: The Israelites and Absalom encamped in the district of Gilead.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּבוֹא דָוִד מַחֲנָיְמָה וְשֹׁבִי בֶן־נָחָשׁ מֵרַבַּת בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן וּמָכִיר בֶּן־עַמִּיאֵל מִלֹּא דְבָר וּבַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי מֵרֹגְלִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּבוֹא דָוִד מַחֲנָיְמָה וְשֹׁבִי בֶן־נָחָשׁ מֵרַבַּת בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן וּמָכִיר בֶּן־עַמִּיאֵל מִלֹּא דְבָר וּבַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי מֵרֹגְלִים׃

english.text:
When David reached Mahanaim, Shobi son of Nahash from
Rabbath-ammon, Machir son of Ammiel from Lo-debar, and Barzillai
the Gileadite from Rogelim

translation.text: And it came to pass, when David was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

verses.english:
When David reached Mahanaim, Shobi son of Nahash from
Rabbath-ammon, Machir son of Ammiel from Lo-debar, and Barzillai
the Gileadite from Rogelim

verses.hebrew: מִשְׁכָּב וְסַפּוֹת וּכְלִי יוֹצֵר וְחִטִּים וּשְׂעֹרִים וְקֶמַח וְקָלִי וּפוֹל וַעֲדָשִׁים וְקָלִי׃

hebrew.text: מִשְׁכָּב וְסַפּוֹת וּכְלִי יוֹצֵר וְחִטִּים וּשְׂעֹרִים וְקֶמַח וְקָלִי וּפוֹל וַעֲדָשִׁים וְקָלִי׃

english.text:
presented couches, basins, and earthenware; also wheat, barley,
flour, parched grain, beans, lentils, parched grain,

translation.text: Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched corn, and beans, and lentiles, and parched pulse,

verses.english:
presented couches, basins, and earthenware; also wheat, barley,
flour, parched grain, beans, lentils, parched grain,

verses.hebrew: וּדְבַשׁ וְחֶמְאָה וְצֹאן וּשְׁפוֹת בָּקָר הִגִּישׁוּ לְדָוִד וְלָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ לֶאֱכוֹל כִּי אָמְרוּ הָעָם רָעֵב וְעָיֵף וְצָמֵא בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וּדְבַשׁ וְחֶמְאָה וְצֹאן וּשְׁפוֹת בָּקָר הִגִּישׁוּ לְדָוִד וְלָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ לֶאֱכוֹל כִּי אָמְרוּ הָעָם רָעֵב וְעָיֵף וְצָמֵא בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
honey, curds, a flock, and cheese from the herd for David and the
troops with him to eat. For they knew that the troops must have
grown hungry, faint, and thirsty in the wilderness.

translation.text: And honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of kine, for David, and for the people that were with him, to eat: for they said, The people is hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.

verses.english:
honey, curds, a flock, and cheese from the herd for David and the
troops with him to eat. For they knew that the troops must have
grown hungry, faint, and thirsty in the wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקֹד דָּוִד אֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם עֲלֵיהֶם שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי מֵאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְקֹד דָּוִד אֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם עֲלֵיהֶם שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי מֵאוֹת׃

english.text:
David mustered the troops who were with him and set over them
captains of thousands and captains of hundreds.

translation.text: And David numbered the people that were with him, and set captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds over them.

verses.english:
David mustered the troops who were with him and set over them
captains of thousands and captains of hundreds.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְשַׁלַּח דָּוִד אֶת־הָעָם הַשְּׁלִשִׁית בְּיַד־יוֹאָב וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית בְּיַד אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן־צְרוּיָה אֲחִי יוֹאָב וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁת בְּיַד אִתַּי הַגִּתִּיוַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ
אֶל־הָעָם יָצֹא אֵצֵא גַּם־אֲנִי עִמָּכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְשַׁלַּח דָּוִד אֶת־הָעָם הַשְּׁלִשִׁית בְּיַד־יוֹאָב וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית בְּיַד אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן־צְרוּיָה אֲחִי יוֹאָב וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁת בְּיַד אִתַּי הַגִּתִּיוַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ
אֶל־הָעָם יָצֹא אֵצֵא גַּם־אֲנִי עִמָּכֶם׃

english.text:
David sent out the troops, one-third under the command of Joab,
one-third under the command of Joab’s brother Abishai son of
Zeruiah, and one-third under the command of Ittai the Gittite. And
David said to the troops, “I myself will march out with you.”

translation.text: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said unto the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.

verses.english:
David sent out the troops, one-third under the command of Joab,
one-third under the command of Joab’s brother Abishai son of
Zeruiah, and one-third under the command of Ittai the Gittite. And
David said to the troops, “I myself will march out with you.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם לֹא תֵצֵא כִּי אִם־נֹס נָנוּס לֹא־יָשִׂימוּ אֵלֵינוּ לֵב וְאִם־יָמֻתוּ חֶצְיֵנוּ לֹא־יָשִׂימוּ אֵלֵינוּ לֵב כִּי־עַתָּה כָמֹנוּ עֲשָׂרָה אֲלָפִים וְעַתָּה טוֹב
כִּי־תִהְיֶה־לָּנוּ מֵעִיר (לעזיר) [לַעְזוֹר]׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם לֹא תֵצֵא כִּי אִם־נֹס נָנוּס לֹא־יָשִׂימוּ אֵלֵינוּ לֵב וְאִם־יָמֻתוּ חֶצְיֵנוּ לֹא־יָשִׂימוּ אֵלֵינוּ לֵב כִּי־עַתָּה כָמֹנוּ עֲשָׂרָה אֲלָפִים וְעַתָּה טוֹב
כִּי־תִהְיֶה־לָּנוּ מֵעִיר (לעזיר) [לַעְזוֹר]׃

english.text:
But the troops replied, “No! For if some of us flee, the rest will
not be concerned about us; even if half of us should die, the
others will not be concerned about us. But you are worth ten
thousand of us. Therefore, it is better for you to support us from
the town.”

translation.text: But the people answered, Thou shalt not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but now thou art worth ten thousand of us: therefore now it is better that thou succour us out of the city.

verses.english:
But the troops replied, “No! For if some of us flee, the rest will
not be concerned about us; even if half of us should die, the
others will not be concerned about us. But you are worth ten
thousand of us. Therefore, it is better for you to support us from
the town.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־יִיטַב בְּעֵינֵיכֶם אֶעֱשֶׂה וַיַּעֲמֹד הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־יַד הַשַּׁעַר וְכל־הָעָם יָצְאוּ לְמֵאוֹת וְלַאֲלָפִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־יִיטַב בְּעֵינֵיכֶם אֶעֱשֶׂה וַיַּעֲמֹד הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־יַד הַשַּׁעַר וְכל־הָעָם יָצְאוּ לְמֵאוֹת וְלַאֲלָפִים׃

english.text:
And the king said to them, “I will do whatever you think best.” So
the king stood beside the gate as all the troops marched out by
their hundreds and thousands.

translation.text: And the king said unto them, What seemeth you best I will do. And the king stood by the gate side, and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands.

verses.english:
And the king said to them, “I will do whatever you think best.” So
the king stood beside the gate as all the troops marched out by
their hundreds and thousands.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־יוֹאָב וְאֶת־אֲבִישַׁי וְאֶת־אִתַּי לֵאמֹר לְאַט־לִי לַנַּעַר לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם וְכל־הָעָם שָׁמְעוּ בְּצַוֺּת הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־כּל־הַשָּׂרִים עַל־דְּבַר אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־יוֹאָב וְאֶת־אֲבִישַׁי וְאֶת־אִתַּי לֵאמֹר לְאַט־לִי לַנַּעַר לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם וְכל־הָעָם שָׁמְעוּ בְּצַוֺּת הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־כּל־הַשָּׂרִים עַל־דְּבַר אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
The king gave orders to Joab, Abishai, and Ittai: “Deal gently
with my boy Absalom, for my sake.” All the troops heard the king
give the order about Absalom to all the officers.

translation.text: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.

verses.english:
The king gave orders to Joab, Abishai, and Ittai: “Deal gently
with my boy Absalom, for my sake.” All the troops heard the king
give the order about Absalom to all the officers.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הָעָם הַשָּׂדֶה לִקְרַאת יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתְּהִי הַמִּלְחָמָה בְּיַעַר אֶפְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא הָעָם הַשָּׂדֶה לִקְרַאת יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתְּהִי הַמִּלְחָמָה בְּיַעַר אֶפְרָיִם׃

english.text:
The troops marched out into the open to confront the Israelites,
and the battle was fought in the forest of Ephraim.

translation.text: So the people went out into the field against Israel: and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim;

verses.english:
The troops marched out into the open to confront the Israelites,
and the battle was fought in the forest of Ephraim.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּנָּגְפוּ שָׁם עַם יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי עַבְדֵי דָוִד וַתְּהִי־שָׁם הַמַּגֵּפָה גְדוֹלָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּנָּגְפוּ שָׁם עַם יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי עַבְדֵי דָוִד וַתְּהִי־שָׁם הַמַּגֵּפָה גְדוֹלָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף׃

english.text:
The Israelite troops were routed by David’s followers, and a great
slaughter took place there that day—twenty thousand men.

translation.text: Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David, and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men.

verses.english:
The Israelite troops were routed by David’s followers, and a great
slaughter took place there that day—twenty thousand men.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי־שָׁם הַמִּלְחָמָה (נפצות) [נָפוֹצֶת] עַל־פְּנֵי כל־הָאָרֶץ וַיֶּרֶב הַיַּעַר לֶאֱכֹל בָּעָם מֵאֲשֶׁר אָכְלָה הַחֶרֶב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי־שָׁם הַמִּלְחָמָה (נפצות) [נָפוֹצֶת] עַל־פְּנֵי כל־הָאָרֶץ וַיֶּרֶב הַיַּעַר לֶאֱכֹל בָּעָם מֵאֲשֶׁר אָכְלָה הַחֶרֶב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

english.text:
The battle spread out over that whole region, and the forest
devoured more troops that day than the sword.

translation.text: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country: and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.

verses.english:
The battle spread out over that whole region, and the forest
devoured more troops that day than the sword.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקָּרֵא אַבְשָׁלוֹם לִפְנֵי עַבְדֵי דָוִד וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם רֹכֵב עַל־הַפֶּרֶד וַיָּבֹא הַפֶּרֶד תַּחַת שׂוֹבֶךְ הָאֵלָה הַגְּדוֹלָה וַיֶּחֱזַק רֹאשׁוֹ בָאֵלָה וַיֻּתַּן בֵּין
הַשָּׁמַיִם וּבֵין הָאָרֶץ וְהַפֶּרֶד אֲשֶׁר־תַּחְתָּיו עָבָר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקָּרֵא אַבְשָׁלוֹם לִפְנֵי עַבְדֵי דָוִד וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם רֹכֵב עַל־הַפֶּרֶד וַיָּבֹא הַפֶּרֶד תַּחַת שׂוֹבֶךְ הָאֵלָה הַגְּדוֹלָה וַיֶּחֱזַק רֹאשׁוֹ בָאֵלָה וַיֻּתַּן בֵּין
הַשָּׁמַיִם וּבֵין הָאָרֶץ וְהַפֶּרֶד אֲשֶׁר־תַּחְתָּיו עָבָר׃

english.text:
Absalom encountered some of David’s followers. Absalom was riding
on a mule, and as the mule passed under the tangled branches of a
great terebinth, his hair got caught in the terebinth; he was held
between heaven and earth as the mule under him kept going.

translation.text: And Absalom met the servants of David. And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that was under him went away.

verses.english:
Absalom encountered some of David’s followers. Absalom was riding
on a mule, and as the mule passed under the tangled branches of a
great terebinth, his hair got caught in the terebinth; he was held
between heaven and earth as the mule under him kept going.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אִישׁ אֶחָד וַיַּגֵּד לְיוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה רָאִיתִי אֶת־אַבְשָׁלֹם תָּלוּי בָּאֵלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא אִישׁ אֶחָד וַיַּגֵּד לְיוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה רָאִיתִי אֶת־אַבְשָׁלֹם תָּלוּי בָּאֵלָה׃

english.text:
One of the men saw it and told Joab, “I have just seen Absalom
hanging from a terebinth.”

translation.text: And a certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanged in an oak.

verses.english:
One of the men saw it and told Joab, “I have just seen Absalom
hanging from a terebinth.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לָאִישׁ הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ וְהִנֵּה רָאִיתָ וּמַדּוּעַ לֹא־הִכִּיתוֹ שָׁם אָרְצָה וְעָלַי לָתֶת לְךָ עֲשָׂרָה כֶסֶף וַחֲגֹרָה אֶחָת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לָאִישׁ הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ וְהִנֵּה רָאִיתָ וּמַדּוּעַ לֹא־הִכִּיתוֹ שָׁם אָרְצָה וְעָלַי לָתֶת לְךָ עֲשָׂרָה כֶסֶף וַחֲגֹרָה אֶחָת׃

english.text:
Joab said to the man who told him, “You saw it! Why didn’t you
kill him then and there? I would have owed you ten shekels of
silver and a belt.”

translation.text: And Joab said unto the man that told him, And, behold, thou sawest him, and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground? and I would have given thee ten shekels of silver, and a girdle.

verses.english:
Joab said to the man who told him, “You saw it! Why didn’t you
kill him then and there? I would have owed you ten shekels of
silver and a belt.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ אֶל־יוֹאָב (ולא) [וְלוּ] אָנֹכִי שֹׁקֵל עַל־כַּפַּי אֶלֶף כֶּסֶף לֹא־אֶשְׁלַח יָדִי אֶל־בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי בְאזְנֵינוּ צִוָּה הַמֶּלֶךְ אֹתְךָ וְאֶת־אֲבִישַׁי
וְאֶת־אִתַּי לֵאמֹר שִׁמְרוּ־מִי בַּנַּעַר בְּאַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ אֶל־יוֹאָב (ולא) [וְלוּ] אָנֹכִי שֹׁקֵל עַל־כַּפַּי אֶלֶף כֶּסֶף לֹא־אֶשְׁלַח יָדִי אֶל־בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי בְאזְנֵינוּ צִוָּה הַמֶּלֶךְ אֹתְךָ וְאֶת־אֲבִישַׁי
וְאֶת־אִתַּי לֵאמֹר שִׁמְרוּ־מִי בַּנַּעַר בְּאַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
But the man answered Joab, “Even if I had a thousand shekels of
silver in my hands, I would not raise a hand against the king’s
son. For the king charged you and Abishai and Ittai in our
hearing, ‘Watch over my boy Absalom, for my sake.’

translation.text: And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in mine hand, yet would I not put forth mine hand against the king’s son: for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none touch the young man Absalom.

verses.english:
But the man answered Joab, “Even if I had a thousand shekels of
silver in my hands, I would not raise a hand against the king’s
son. For the king charged you and Abishai and Ittai in our
hearing, ‘Watch over my boy Absalom, for my sake.’

verses.hebrew: אוֹ־עָשִׂיתִי (בנפשו) [בְנַפְשִׁי] שֶׁקֶר וְכל־דָּבָר לֹא־יִכָּחֵד מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאַתָּה תִּתְיַצֵּב מִנֶּגֶד׃

hebrew.text: אוֹ־עָשִׂיתִי (בנפשו) [בְנַפְשִׁי] שֶׁקֶר וְכל־דָּבָר לֹא־יִכָּחֵד מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאַתָּה תִּתְיַצֵּב מִנֶּגֶד׃

english.text:
If I betrayed myself—and nothing is hidden from the king—you would
have stood aloof.”

translation.text: Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against mine own life: for there is no matter hid from the king, and thou thyself wouldest have set thyself against me.

verses.english:
If I betrayed myself—and nothing is hidden from the king—you would
have stood aloof.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לֹא־כֵן אֹחִילָה לְפָנֶיךָ וַיִּקַּח שְׁלֹשָׁה שְׁבָטִים בְּכַפּוֹ וַיִּתְקָעֵם בְּלֵב אַבְשָׁלוֹם עוֹדֶנּוּ חַי בְּלֵב הָאֵלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לֹא־כֵן אֹחִילָה לְפָנֶיךָ וַיִּקַּח שְׁלֹשָׁה שְׁבָטִים בְּכַפּוֹ וַיִּתְקָעֵם בְּלֵב אַבְשָׁלוֹם עוֹדֶנּוּ חַי בְּלֵב הָאֵלָה׃

english.text:
Joab replied, “Then I will not wait for you.” He took three darts
in his hand and drove them into Absalom’s chest. [Absalom] was
still alive in the thick growth of the terebinth,

translation.text: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with thee. And he took three darts in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak.

verses.english:
Joab replied, “Then I will not wait for you.” He took three darts
in his hand and drove them into Absalom’s chest. [Absalom] was
still alive in the thick growth of the terebinth,

verses.hebrew: וַיָּסֹבּוּ עֲשָׂרָה נְעָרִים נֹשְׂאֵי כְּלֵי יוֹאָב וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיְמִתֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּסֹבּוּ עֲשָׂרָה נְעָרִים נֹשְׂאֵי כְּלֵי יוֹאָב וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיְמִתֻהוּ׃

english.text:
when ten of Joab’s young arms-bearers closed in and struck at
Absalom until he died.

translation.text: And ten young men that bare Joab’s armour compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.

verses.english:
when ten of Joab’s young arms-bearers closed in and struck at
Absalom until he died.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקַע יוֹאָב בַּשֹּׁפָר וַיָּשׁב הָעָם מִרְדֹף אַחֲרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־חָשַׂךְ יוֹאָב אֶת־הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְקַע יוֹאָב בַּשֹּׁפָר וַיָּשׁב הָעָם מִרְדֹף אַחֲרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־חָשַׂךְ יוֹאָב אֶת־הָעָם׃

english.text:
Then Joab sounded the horn, and the troops gave up their pursuit
of the Israelites; for Joab held the troops in check.

translation.text: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel: for Joab held back the people.

verses.english:
Then Joab sounded the horn, and the troops gave up their pursuit
of the Israelites; for Joab held the troops in check.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ אֹתוֹ בַיַּעַר אֶל־הַפַּחַת הַגָּדוֹל וַיַּצִּבוּ עָלָיו גַּל־אֲבָנִים גָּדוֹל מְאֹד וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל נָסוּ אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ אֹתוֹ בַיַּעַר אֶל־הַפַּחַת הַגָּדוֹל וַיַּצִּבוּ עָלָיו גַּל־אֲבָנִים גָּדוֹל מְאֹד וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל נָסוּ אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָו׃

english.text:
They took Absalom and flung him into a large pit in the forest,
and they piled up a very great heap of stones over it. Then all
the Israelites fled to their homes.—

translation.text: And they took Absalom, and cast him into a great pit in the wood, and laid a very great heap of stones upon him: and all Israel fled every one to his tent.

verses.english:
They took Absalom and flung him into a large pit in the forest,
and they piled up a very great heap of stones over it. Then all
the Israelites fled to their homes.—

verses.hebrew:
וְאַבְשָׁלֹם לָקַח וַיַּצֶּב־לוֹ בְחַיָּו אֶת־מַצֶּבֶת אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵמֶק־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי אָמַר אֵין־לִי בֵן בַּעֲבוּר הַזְכִּיר שְׁמִי וַיִּקְרָא לַמַּצֶּבֶת עַל־שְׁמוֹ וַיִּקָּרֵא
לָהּ יַד אַבְשָׁלוֹם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וְאַבְשָׁלֹם לָקַח וַיַּצֶּב־לוֹ בְחַיָּו אֶת־מַצֶּבֶת אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵמֶק־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי אָמַר אֵין־לִי בֵן בַּעֲבוּר הַזְכִּיר שְׁמִי וַיִּקְרָא לַמַּצֶּבֶת עַל־שְׁמוֹ וַיִּקָּרֵא
לָהּ יַד אַבְשָׁלוֹם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Now Absalom, in his lifetime, had taken the pillar which is in the
Valley of the King and set it up for himself; for he said, “I have
no son to keep my name alive.” He had named the pillar after
himself, and it has been called Absalom’s Monument to this day.

translation.text: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar, which is in the king’s dale: for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name: and it is called unto this day, Absalom’s place.

verses.english:
Now Absalom, in his lifetime, had taken the pillar which is in the
Valley of the King and set it up for himself; for he said, “I have
no son to keep my name alive.” He had named the pillar after
himself, and it has been called Absalom’s Monument to this day.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחִימַעַץ בֶּן־צָדוֹק אָמַר אָרוּצָה נָּא וַאֲבַשְּׂרָה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־שְׁפָטוֹ יְהֹוָה מִיַּד אֹיְבָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲחִימַעַץ בֶּן־צָדוֹק אָמַר אָרוּצָה נָּא וַאֲבַשְּׂרָה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־שְׁפָטוֹ יְהֹוָה מִיַּד אֹיְבָיו׃

english.text:
Ahimaaz son of Zadok said, “Let me run and report to the king that
YHWH has vindicated him against his enemies.”

translation.text: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok, Let me now run, and bear the king tidings, how that the LORD hath avenged him of his enemies.

verses.english:
Ahimaaz son of Zadok said, “Let me run and report to the king that
YHWH has vindicated him against his enemies.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יוֹאָב לֹא אִישׁ בְּשֹׂרָה אַתָּה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וּבִשַּׂרְתָּ בְּיוֹם אַחֵר וְהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לֹא תְבַשֵּׂר כִּי־עַל־[כֵּן] בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ מֵת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יוֹאָב לֹא אִישׁ בְּשֹׂרָה אַתָּה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וּבִשַּׂרְתָּ בְּיוֹם אַחֵר וְהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לֹא תְבַשֵּׂר כִּי־עַל־[כֵּן] בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ מֵת׃

english.text:
But Joab said to him, “You shall not be the one to bring tidings
today. You may bring tidings some other day, but you’ll not bring
any today; for the king’s son is dead!”

translation.text: And Joab said unto him, Thou shalt not bear tidings this day, but thou shalt bear tidings another day: but this day thou shalt bear no tidings, because the king’s son is dead.

verses.english:
But Joab said to him, “You shall not be the one to bring tidings
today. You may bring tidings some other day, but you’ll not bring
any today; for the king’s son is dead!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לַכּוּשִׁי לֵךְ הַגֵּד לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ כוּשִׁי לְיוֹאָב וַיָּרֹץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לַכּוּשִׁי לֵךְ הַגֵּד לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ כוּשִׁי לְיוֹאָב וַיָּרֹץ׃

english.text:
And Joab said to a Cushite, “Go tell the king what you have seen.”
The Cushite bowed to Joab and ran off.

translation.text: Then said Joab to Cushi, Go tell the king what thou hast seen. And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab, and ran.

verses.english:
And Joab said to a Cushite, “Go tell the king what you have seen.”
The Cushite bowed to Joab and ran off.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד אֲחִימַעַץ בֶּן־צָדוֹק וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־יוֹאָב וִיהִי מָה אָרֻצָה־נָּא גַם־אָנִי אַחֲרֵי הַכּוּשִׁי וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לָמָּה־זֶּה אַתָּה רָץ בְּנִי וּלְכָה
אֵין־בְּשׂוֹרָה מֹצֵאת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד אֲחִימַעַץ בֶּן־צָדוֹק וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־יוֹאָב וִיהִי מָה אָרֻצָה־נָּא גַם־אָנִי אַחֲרֵי הַכּוּשִׁי וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לָמָּה־זֶּה אַתָּה רָץ בְּנִי וּלְכָה
אֵין־בְּשׂוֹרָה מֹצֵאת׃

english.text:
But Ahimaaz son of Zadok again said to Joab, “No matter what, let
me run, too, behind the Cushite.” Joab asked, “Why should you run,
my boy, when you have no news worth telling?”

translation.text: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab, But howsoever, let me, I pray thee, also run after Cushi. And Joab said, Wherefore wilt thou run, my son, seeing that thou hast no tidings ready?

verses.english:
But Ahimaaz son of Zadok again said to Joab, “No matter what, let
me run, too, behind the Cushite.” Joab asked, “Why should you run,
my boy, when you have no news worth telling?”

verses.hebrew: וִיהִי־מָה אָרוּץ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ רוּץ וַיָּרץ אֲחִימַעַץ דֶּרֶךְ הַכִּכָּר וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־הַכּוּשִׁי׃

hebrew.text: וִיהִי־מָה אָרוּץ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ רוּץ וַיָּרץ אֲחִימַעַץ דֶּרֶךְ הַכִּכָּר וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־הַכּוּשִׁי׃

english.text:
“I am going to run anyway.” “Then run,” he said. So Ahimaaz ran by
way of the Plain, and he passed the Cushite.

translation.text: But howsoever, said he, let me run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.

verses.english:
“I am going to run anyway.” “Then run,” he said. So Ahimaaz ran by
way of the Plain, and he passed the Cushite.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד יוֹשֵׁב בֵּין־שְׁנֵי הַשְּׁעָרִים וַיֵּלֶךְ הַצֹּפֶה אֶל־גַּג הַשַּׁעַר אֶל־הַחוֹמָה וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ רָץ לְבַדּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד יוֹשֵׁב בֵּין־שְׁנֵי הַשְּׁעָרִים וַיֵּלֶךְ הַצֹּפֶה אֶל־גַּג הַשַּׁעַר אֶל־הַחוֹמָה וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ רָץ לְבַדּוֹ׃

english.text:
David was sitting between the two gates. The watchman on the roof
of the gate walked over to the city wall. He looked up and saw a
man running alone.

translation.text: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.

verses.english:
David was sitting between the two gates. The watchman on the roof
of the gate walked over to the city wall. He looked up and saw a
man running alone.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא הַצֹּפֶה וַיַּגֵּד לַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־לְבַדּוֹ בְּשׂוֹרָה בְּפִיו וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וְקָרֵב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא הַצֹּפֶה וַיַּגֵּד לַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־לְבַדּוֹ בְּשׂוֹרָה בְּפִיו וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וְקָרֵב׃

english.text:
The watchman called down and told the king; and the king said, “If
he is alone, he has news to report.” As he was coming nearer,

translation.text: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.

verses.english:
The watchman called down and told the king; and the king said, “If
he is alone, he has news to report.” As he was coming nearer,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא הַצֹּפֶה אִישׁ־אַחֵר רָץ וַיִּקְרָא הַצֹּפֶה אֶל־הַשֹּׁעֵר וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־אִישׁ רָץ לְבַדּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ גַּם־זֶה מְבַשֵּׂר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא הַצֹּפֶה אִישׁ־אַחֵר רָץ וַיִּקְרָא הַצֹּפֶה אֶל־הַשֹּׁעֵר וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־אִישׁ רָץ לְבַדּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ גַּם־זֶה מְבַשֵּׂר׃

english.text:
the watchman saw another man running; and he called out to the
gatekeeper, “There is another man running alone.” And the king
said, “That one, too, brings news.”

translation.text: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called unto the porter, and said, Behold another man running alone. And the king said, He also bringeth tidings.

verses.english:
the watchman saw another man running; and he called out to the
gatekeeper, “There is another man running alone.” And the king
said, “That one, too, brings news.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַצֹּפֶה אֲנִי רֹאֶה אֶת־מְרוּצַת הָרִאשׁוֹן כִּמְרֻצַת אֲחִימַעַץ בֶּן־צָדוֹק וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אִישׁ־טוֹב זֶה וְאֶל־בְּשׂוֹרָה טוֹבָה יָבוֹא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַצֹּפֶה אֲנִי רֹאֶה אֶת־מְרוּצַת הָרִאשׁוֹן כִּמְרֻצַת אֲחִימַעַץ בֶּן־צָדוֹק וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אִישׁ־טוֹב זֶה וְאֶל־בְּשׂוֹרָה טוֹבָה יָבוֹא׃

english.text:
The watchman said, “I can see that the first one runs like Ahimaaz
son of Zadok”; to which the king replied, “He is a good man, and
he comes with good news.”

translation.text: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and cometh with good tidings.

verses.english:
The watchman said, “I can see that the first one runs like Ahimaaz
son of Zadok”; to which the king replied, “He is a good man, and
he comes with good news.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְרָא אֲחִימַעַץ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׁלוֹם וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ לְאַפָּיו אָרְצָהוַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר סִגַּר אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־נָשְׂאוּ
אֶת־יָדָם בַּאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְרָא אֲחִימַעַץ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׁלוֹם וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ לְאַפָּיו אָרְצָהוַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר סִגַּר אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־נָשְׂאוּ
אֶת־יָדָם בַּאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Ahimaaz called out and said to the king, “All is well!” He bowed
low with his face to the ground and said, “Praised be YHWH your
God, who has delivered up the men who raised their hand against my
lord the king.”

translation.text: And Ahimaaz called, and said unto the king, All is well. And he fell down to the earth upon his face before the king, and said, Blessed be the LORD thy God, which hath delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord the king.

verses.english:
Ahimaaz called out and said to the king, “All is well!” He bowed
low with his face to the ground and said, “Praised be YHWH your
God, who has delivered up the men who raised their hand against my
lord the king.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׁלוֹם לַנַּעַר לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲחִימַעַץ רָאִיתִי הֶהָמוֹן הַגָּדוֹל לִשְׁלֹחַ אֶת־עֶבֶד הַמֶּלֶךְ יוֹאָב וְאֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ וְלֹא יָדַעְתִּי מָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׁלוֹם לַנַּעַר לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲחִימַעַץ רָאִיתִי הֶהָמוֹן הַגָּדוֹל לִשְׁלֹחַ אֶת־עֶבֶד הַמֶּלֶךְ יוֹאָב וְאֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ וְלֹא יָדַעְתִּי מָה׃

english.text:
The king asked, “Is my boy Absalom safe?” And Ahimaaz answered, “I
saw a large crowd when Your Majesty’s servant Joab was sending
your servant off, but I don’t know what it was about.”

translation.text: And the king said, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king’s servant, and me thy servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what it was.

verses.english:
The king asked, “Is my boy Absalom safe?” And Ahimaaz answered, “I
saw a large crowd when Your Majesty’s servant Joab was sending
your servant off, but I don’t know what it was about.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ סֹב הִתְיַצֵּב כֹּה וַיִּסֹּב וַיַּעֲמֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ סֹב הִתְיַצֵּב כֹּה וַיִּסֹּב וַיַּעֲמֹד׃

english.text:
The king said, “Step aside and stand over there”; he stepped aside
and waited.

translation.text: And the king said unto him, Turn aside, and stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.

verses.english:
The king said, “Step aside and stand over there”; he stepped aside
and waited.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה הַכּוּשִׁי בָּא וַיֹּאמֶר הַכּוּשִׁי יִתְבַּשֵּׂר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־שְׁפָטְךָ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם מִיַּד כּל־הַקָּמִים עָלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה הַכּוּשִׁי בָּא וַיֹּאמֶר הַכּוּשִׁי יִתְבַּשֵּׂר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־שְׁפָטְךָ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם מִיַּד כּל־הַקָּמִים עָלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Just then the Cushite came up; and the Cushite said, “Let my lord
the king be informed that YHWH has vindicated you today against
all who rebelled against you!”

translation.text: And, behold, Cushi came; and Cushi said, Tidings, my lord the king: for the LORD hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee.

verses.english:
Just then the Cushite came up; and the Cushite said, “Let my lord
the king be informed that YHWH has vindicated you today against
all who rebelled against you!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הַכּוּשִׁי הֲשָׁלוֹם לַנַּעַר לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר הַכּוּשִׁי יִהְיוּ כַנַּעַר אֹיְבֵי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־קָמוּ עָלֶיךָ לְרָעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הַכּוּשִׁי הֲשָׁלוֹם לַנַּעַר לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר הַכּוּשִׁי יִהְיוּ כַנַּעַר אֹיְבֵי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־קָמוּ עָלֶיךָ לְרָעָה׃

english.text:
The king asked the Cushite, “Is my boy Absalom safe?” And the
Cushite replied, “May the enemies of my lord the king and all who
rose against you to do you harm fare like that young man!”

translation.text: And the king said unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Cushi answered, The enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise against thee to do thee hurt, be as that young man is.

verses.english:
The king asked the Cushite, “Is my boy Absalom safe?” And the
Cushite replied, “May the enemies of my lord the king and all who
rose against you to do you harm fare like that young man!”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּרְגַּז הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּעַל עַל־עֲלִיַּת הַשַּׁעַר וַיֵּבְךְּ וְכֹה אָמַר בְּלֶכְתּוֹ בְּנִי אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּנִי בְנִי אַבְשָׁלוֹם מִי־יִתֵּן מוּתִי אֲנִי תַחְתֶּיךָ אַבְשָׁלוֹם
בְּנִי בְנִי׃

hebrew.text:
