וַיִּרְגַּז הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּעַל עַל־עֲלִיַּת הַשַּׁעַר וַיֵּבְךְּ וְכֹה אָמַר בְּלֶכְתּוֹ בְּנִי אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּנִי בְנִי אַבְשָׁלוֹם מִי־יִתֵּן מוּתִי אֲנִי תַחְתֶּיךָ אַבְשָׁלוֹם
בְּנִי בְנִי׃

english.text:
The king was shaken. He went up to the upper chamber of the
gateway and wept, moaning these words as he went, “My son Absalom!
O my son, my son Absalom! If only I had died instead of you! O
Absalom, my son, my son!”

translation.text: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!

verses.english:
The king was shaken. He went up to the upper chamber of the
gateway and wept, moaning these words as he went, “My son Absalom!
O my son, my son Absalom! If only I had died instead of you! O
Absalom, my son, my son!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְיוֹאָב הִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ בֹּכֶה וַיִּתְאַבֵּל עַל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לְיוֹאָב הִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ בֹּכֶה וַיִּתְאַבֵּל עַל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text: Joab was told that the king was weeping and mourning over Absalom.

translation.text: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.

verses.english: Joab was told that the king was weeping and mourning over Absalom.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי הַתְּשֻׁעָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לְאֵבֶל לְכל־הָעָם כִּי־שָׁמַע הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר נֶעֱצַב הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־בְּנוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי הַתְּשֻׁעָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לְאֵבֶל לְכל־הָעָם כִּי־שָׁמַע הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר נֶעֱצַב הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־בְּנוֹ׃

english.text:
And the victory that day was turned into mourning for all the
troops, for that day the troops heard that the king was grieving
over his son.

translation.text: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people: for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son.

verses.english:
And the victory that day was turned into mourning for all the
troops, for that day the troops heard that the king was grieving
over his son.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְגַּנֵּב הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לָבוֹא הָעִיר כַּאֲשֶׁר יִתְגַּנֵּב הָעָם הַנִּכְלָמִים בְּנוּסָם בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְגַּנֵּב הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לָבוֹא הָעִיר כַּאֲשֶׁר יִתְגַּנֵּב הָעָם הַנִּכְלָמִים בְּנוּסָם בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
The troops stole into town that day like troops ashamed after
running away in battle.

translation.text: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

verses.english:
The troops stole into town that day like troops ashamed after
running away in battle.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ לָאַט אֶת־פָּנָיו וַיִּזְעַק הַמֶּלֶךְ קוֹל גָּדוֹל בְּנִי אַבְשָׁלוֹם אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּנִי בְנִי׃

english.text:
The king covered his face and the king kept crying aloud, “O my
son Absalom! O Absalom, my son, my son!”

translation.text: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!

verses.english:
The king covered his face and the king kept crying aloud, “O my
son Absalom! O Absalom, my son, my son!”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא יוֹאָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הַבָּיִת וַיֹּאמֶר הֹבַשְׁתָּ הַיּוֹם אֶת־פְּנֵי כל־עֲבָדֶיךָ הַמְמַלְּטִים אֶת־נַפְשְׁךָ הַיּוֹם וְאֵת נֶפֶשׁ בָּנֶיךָ וּבְנֹתֶיךָ וְנֶפֶשׁ נָשֶׁיךָ
וְנֶפֶשׁ פִּלַגְשֶׁיךָ׃

Joab came to the king in his quarters and said, “Today you have
humiliated all your followers, who this day saved your life, and
the lives of your sons and daughters, and the lives of your wives
and concubines,

translation.text: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, which this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;

verses.english:
Joab came to the king in his quarters and said, “Today you have
humiliated all your followers, who this day saved your life, and
the lives of your sons and daughters, and the lives of your wives
and concubines,

verses.hebrew:

הַיּוֹם מֵתִים כִּי־אָז יָשָׁר בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

by showing love for those who hate you and hate for those who love
you. For you have made clear today that the officers and men mean
nothing to you. I am sure that if Absalom were alive today and the
rest of us dead, you would have preferred it.

translation.text: In that thou lovest thine enemies, and hatest thy friends. For thou hast declared this day, that thou regardest neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased thee well.

verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה קוּם צֵא וְדַבֵּר עַל־לֵב עֲבָדֶיךָכִּי בַיהֹוָה נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי כִּי־אֵינְךָ יוֹצֵא אִם־יָלִין אִישׁ אִתְּךָ הַלַּיְלָה וְרָעָה לְךָ זֹאת מִכּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר־בָּאָה
עָלֶיךָ מִנְּעֻרֶיךָ עַד־עָתָּה׃

hebrew.text:

english.text:
Now arise, come out and placate your followers! For I swear by
YHWH that if you do not come out, not a single man will remain
with you overnight; and that would be a greater disaster for you
than any disaster that has befallen you from your youth until
now.”

translation.text: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto thy servants: for I swear by the LORD, if thou go not forth, there will not tarry one with thee this night: and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now.

verses.english:
Now arise, come out and placate your followers! For I swear by
YHWH that if you do not come out, not a single man will remain
with you overnight; and that would be a greater disaster for you
than any disaster that has befallen you from your youth until
now.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּשֶׁב בַּשָּׁעַר וּלְכל־הָעָם הִגִּידוּ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב בַּשַּׁעַר וַיָּבֹא כל־הָעָם לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיִשְׂרָאֵל נָס אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּשֶׁב בַּשָּׁעַר וּלְכל־הָעָם הִגִּידוּ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב בַּשַּׁעַר וַיָּבֹא כל־הָעָם לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיִשְׂרָאֵל נָס אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו׃

english.text:
So the king arose and sat down in the gateway; and when all the
troops were told that the king was sitting in the gateway, all the
troops presented themselves to the king. Now the Israelites had
fled to their homes.

translation.text: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate. And they told unto all the people, saying, Behold, the king doth sit in the gate. And all the people came before the king: for Israel had fled every man to his tent.

verses.english:
So the king arose and sat down in the gateway; and when all the
troops were told that the king was sitting in the gateway, all the
troops presented themselves to the king. Now the Israelites had
fled to their homes.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כל־הָעָם נָדוֹן בְּכל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הַמֶּלֶךְ הִצִּילָנוּ מִכַּף אֹיְבֵינוּ וְהוּא מִלְּטָנוּ מִכַּף פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְעַתָּה בָּרַח מִן־הָאָרֶץ מֵעַל
אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
All the people throughout the tribes of Israel were arguing: Some
said, “The king saved us from the hands of our enemies, and he
delivered us from the hands of the Philistines; and just now he
had to flee the country because of Absalom.

translation.text: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.

verses.english:
All the people throughout the tribes of Israel were arguing: Some
said, “The king saved us from the hands of our enemies, and he
delivered us from the hands of the Philistines; and just now he
had to flee the country because of Absalom.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם אֲשֶׁר מָשַׁחְנוּ עָלֵינוּ מֵת בַּמִּלְחָמָה וְעַתָּה לָמָה אַתֶּם מַחֲרִשִׁים לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם אֲשֶׁר מָשַׁחְנוּ עָלֵינוּ מֵת בַּמִּלְחָמָה וְעַתָּה לָמָה אַתֶּם מַחֲרִשִׁים לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
But Absalom, whom we anointed over us, has died in battle; why
then do you sit idle instead of escorting the king back?”

translation.text: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back?

verses.english:
But Absalom, whom we anointed over us, has died in battle; why
then do you sit idle instead of escorting the king back?”

verses.hebrew:
וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד שָׁלַח אֶל־צָדוֹק וְאֶל־אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֲנִים לֵאמֹר דַּבְּרוּ אֶל־זִקְנֵי יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר לָמָּה תִהְיוּ אַחֲרֹנִים לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וּדְבַר
כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד שָׁלַח אֶל־צָדוֹק וְאֶל־אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֲנִים לֵאמֹר דַּבְּרוּ אֶל־זִקְנֵי יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר לָמָּה תִהְיוּ אַחֲרֹנִים לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וּדְבַר
כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
The talk of all Israel reached the king in his quarters. So King
David sent this message to the priests Zadok and Abiathar: “Speak
to the elders of Judah and say, ‘Why should you be the last to
bring the king back to his palace?

translation.text: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, even to his house.

verses.english:
The talk of all Israel reached the king in his quarters. So King
David sent this message to the priests Zadok and Abiathar: “Speak
to the elders of Judah and say, ‘Why should you be the last to
bring the king back to his palace?

verses.hebrew: אַחַי אַתֶּם עַצְמִי וּבְשָׂרִי אַתֶּם וְלָמָּה תִהְיוּ אַחֲרֹנִים לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: אַחַי אַתֶּם עַצְמִי וּבְשָׂרִי אַתֶּם וְלָמָּה תִהְיוּ אַחֲרֹנִים לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
You are my kinsmen, my own flesh and blood! Why should you be the
last to escort the king back?’

translation.text: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?

verses.english:
You are my kinsmen, my own flesh and blood! Why should you be the
last to escort the king back?’

verses.hebrew: וְלַעֲמָשָׂא תֹּמְרוּ הֲלוֹא עַצְמִי וּבְשָׂרִי אָתָּה כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִיף אִם־לֹא שַׂר־צָבָא תִּהְיֶה לְפָנַי כּל־הַיָּמִים תַּחַת יוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וְלַעֲמָשָׂא תֹּמְרוּ הֲלוֹא עַצְמִי וּבְשָׂרִי אָתָּה כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִיף אִם־לֹא שַׂר־צָבָא תִּהְיֶה לְפָנַי כּל־הַיָּמִים תַּחַת יוֹאָב׃

english.text:
And to Amasa say this, ‘You are my own flesh and blood. May God do
thus and more to me if you do not become my army commander
permanently in place of Joab!’”

translation.text: And say ye to Amasa, Art thou not of my bone, and of my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.

verses.english:
And to Amasa say this, ‘You are my own flesh and blood. May God do
thus and more to me if you do not become my army commander
permanently in place of Joab!’”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּט אֶת־לְבַב כּל־אִישׁ־יְהוּדָה כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שׁוּב אַתָּה וְכל־עֲבָדֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּט אֶת־לְבַב כּל־אִישׁ־יְהוּדָה כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שׁוּב אַתָּה וְכל־עֲבָדֶיךָ׃

english.text:
So [Amasa] swayed the hearts of all the Judites as one man; and
they sent a message to the king: “Come back with all your
followers.”

translation.text: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as the heart of one man; so that they sent this word unto the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.

verses.english:
So [Amasa] swayed the hearts of all the Judites as one man; and
they sent a message to the king: “Come back with all your
followers.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיָּבֹא עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּן וִיהוּדָה בָּא הַגִּלְגָּלָה לָלֶכֶת לִקְרַאת הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהַעֲבִיר אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיָּבֹא עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּן וִיהוּדָה בָּא הַגִּלְגָּלָה לָלֶכֶת לִקְרַאת הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהַעֲבִיר אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
The king started back and arrived at the Jordan; and the Judites
went to Gilgal to meet the king and to conduct the king across the
Jordan.

translation.text: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.

verses.english:
The king started back and arrived at the Jordan; and the Judites
went to Gilgal to meet the king and to conduct the king across the
Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֵר שִׁמְעִי בֶן־גֵּרָא בֶּן־הַיְמִינִי אֲשֶׁר מִבַּחוּרִים וַיֵּרֶד עִם־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה לִקְרַאת הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַהֵר שִׁמְעִי בֶן־גֵּרָא בֶּן־הַיְמִינִי אֲשֶׁר מִבַּחוּרִים וַיֵּרֶד עִם־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה לִקְרַאת הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד׃

english.text:
Shimei son of Gera, the Benjaminite from Bahurim, hurried down
with the Judites to meet King David,

translation.text: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.

verses.english:
Shimei son of Gera, the Benjaminite from Bahurim, hurried down
with the Judites to meet King David,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶלֶף אִישׁ עִמּוֹ מִבִּנְיָמִן וְצִיבָא נַעַר בֵּית שָׁאוּל וַחֲמֵשֶׁת עָשָׂר בָּנָיו וְעֶשְׂרִים עֲבָדָיו אִתּוֹ וְצָלְחוּ הַיַּרְדֵּן לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶלֶף אִישׁ עִמּוֹ מִבִּנְיָמִן וְצִיבָא נַעַר בֵּית שָׁאוּל וַחֲמֵשֶׁת עָשָׂר בָּנָיו וְעֶשְׂרִים עֲבָדָיו אִתּוֹ וְצָלְחוּ הַיַּרְדֵּן לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
accompanied by a thousand Benjaminites. And Ziba, the servant of
the House of Saul, together with his fifteen sons and twenty
slaves, rushed down to the Jordan ahead of the king

translation.text: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.

verses.english:
accompanied by a thousand Benjaminites. And Ziba, the servant of
the House of Saul, together with his fifteen sons and twenty
slaves, rushed down to the Jordan ahead of the king

verses.hebrew: וְעָבְרָה הָעֲבָרָה לַעֲבִיר אֶת־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינָו וְשִׁמְעִי בֶן־גֵּרָא נָפַל לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּעבְרוֹ בַּיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וְעָבְרָה הָעֲבָרָה לַעֲבִיר אֶת־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינָו וְשִׁמְעִי בֶן־גֵּרָא נָפַל לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּעבְרוֹ בַּיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
while the crossing was being made, to escort the king’s family
over, and to do whatever he wished. Shimei son of Gera flung
himself before the king as he was about to cross the Jordan.

translation.text: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;

verses.english:
while the crossing was being made, to escort the king’s family
over, and to do whatever he wished. Shimei son of Gera flung
himself before the king as he was about to cross the Jordan.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אַל־יַחֲשָׁב־לִי אֲדֹנִי עָוֺן וְאַל־תִּזְכֹּר אֵת אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱוָה עַבְדְּךָ בַּיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר־יָצָא אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ מִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם לָשׂוּם הַמֶּלֶךְ
אֶל־לִבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אַל־יַחֲשָׁב־לִי אֲדֹנִי עָוֺן וְאַל־תִּזְכֹּר אֵת אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱוָה עַבְדְּךָ בַּיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר־יָצָא אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ מִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם לָשׂוּם הַמֶּלֶךְ
אֶל־לִבּוֹ׃

english.text:
He said to the king, “Let not my lord hold me guilty, and do not
remember the wrong your servant committed on the day my lord the
king left Jerusalem; let Your Majesty give it no thought.

translation.text: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

verses.english:
He said to the king, “Let not my lord hold me guilty, and do not
remember the wrong your servant committed on the day my lord the
king left Jerusalem; let Your Majesty give it no thought.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יָדַע עַבְדְּךָ כִּי אֲנִי חָטָאתִי וְהִנֵּה־בָאתִי הַיּוֹם רִאשׁוֹן לְכל־בֵּית יוֹסֵף לָרֶדֶת לִקְרַאת אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יָדַע עַבְדְּךָ כִּי אֲנִי חָטָאתִי וְהִנֵּה־בָאתִי הַיּוֹם רִאשׁוֹן לְכל־בֵּית יוֹסֵף לָרֶדֶת לִקְרַאת אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
For your servant knows that he has sinned; so here I have come
down today, the first of all the House of Joseph, to meet my lord
the king.”

translation.text: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.

verses.english:
For your servant knows that he has sinned; so here I have come
down today, the first of all the House of Joseph, to meet my lord
the king.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן־צְרוּיָה וַיֹּאמֶר הֲתַחַת זֹאת לֹא יוּמַת שִׁמְעִי כִּי קִלֵּל אֶת־מְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן־צְרוּיָה וַיֹּאמֶר הֲתַחַת זֹאת לֹא יוּמַת שִׁמְעִי כִּי קִלֵּל אֶת־מְשִׁיחַ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Thereupon Abishai son of Zeruiah spoke up, “Shouldn’t Shimei be
put to death for that—insulting YHWH’s anointed?”

translation.text: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’s anointed?

verses.english:
Thereupon Abishai son of Zeruiah spoke up, “Shouldn’t Shimei be
put to death for that—insulting YHWH’s anointed?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד מַה־לִּי וְלָכֶם בְּנֵי צְרוּיָה כִּי־תִהְיוּ־לִי הַיּוֹם לְשָׂטָן הַיּוֹם יוּמַת אִישׁ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי הֲלוֹא יָדַעְתִּי כִּי הַיּוֹם אֲנִי־מֶלֶךְ
עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד מַה־לִּי וְלָכֶם בְּנֵי צְרוּיָה כִּי־תִהְיוּ־לִי הַיּוֹם לְשָׂטָן הַיּוֹם יוּמַת אִישׁ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי הֲלוֹא יָדַעְתִּי כִּי הַיּוֹם אֲנִי־מֶלֶךְ
עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But David said, “What has this to do with you, you sons of
Zeruiah, that you should cross me today? Should a single Israelite
be put to death today? Don’t I know that today I am again king
over Israel?”

translation.text: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel?

verses.english:
But David said, “What has this to do with you, you sons of
Zeruiah, that you should cross me today? Should a single Israelite
be put to death today? Don’t I know that today I am again king
over Israel?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־שִׁמְעִי לֹא תָמוּת וַיִּשָּׁבַע לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־שִׁמְעִי לֹא תָמוּת וַיִּשָּׁבַע לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Then the king said to Shimei, “You shall not die”; and the king
gave him his oath.

translation.text: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.

verses.english:
Then the king said to Shimei, “You shall not die”; and the king
gave him his oath.

verses.hebrew:
וּמְפִבֹשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל יָרַד לִקְרַאת הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלֹא־עָשָׂה רַגְלָיו וְלֹא־עָשָׂה שְׂפָמוֹ וְאֶת־בְּגָדָיו לֹא כִבֵּס לְמִן־הַיּוֹם לֶכֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ עַד־הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר־בָּא
בְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text:
וּמְפִבֹשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל יָרַד לִקְרַאת הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלֹא־עָשָׂה רַגְלָיו וְלֹא־עָשָׂה שְׂפָמוֹ וְאֶת־בְּגָדָיו לֹא כִבֵּס לְמִן־הַיּוֹם לֶכֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ עַד־הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר־בָּא
בְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
Mephibosheth, the grandson of Saul, also came down to meet the
king. He had not pared his toenails, or trimmed his mustache, or
washed his clothes from the day that the king left until the day
he returned safe.

translation.text: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.

verses.english:
Mephibosheth, the grandson of Saul, also came down to meet the
king. He had not pared his toenails, or trimmed his mustache, or
washed his clothes from the day that the king left until the day
he returned safe.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי־בָא יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לִקְרַאת הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה לֹא־הָלַכְתָּ עִמִּי מְפִיבֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי־בָא יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לִקְרַאת הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה לֹא־הָלַכְתָּ עִמִּי מְפִיבֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
When he came [from] Jerusalem to meet the king, the king asked
him, “Why didn’t you come with me, Mephibosheth?”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?

verses.english:
When he came [from] Jerusalem to meet the king, the king asked
him, “Why didn’t you come with me, Mephibosheth?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ עַבְדִּי רִמָּנִי כִּי־אָמַר עַבְדְּךָ אֶחְבְּשָׁה־לִּי הַחֲמוֹר וְאֶרְכַּב עָלֶיהָ וְאֵלֵךְ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי פִסֵּחַ עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ עַבְדִּי רִמָּנִי כִּי־אָמַר עַבְדְּךָ אֶחְבְּשָׁה־לִּי הַחֲמוֹר וְאֶרְכַּב עָלֶיהָ וְאֵלֵךְ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי פִסֵּחַ עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
He replied, “My lord the king, my own servant deceived me. Your
servant planned to saddle his ass and ride on it and go with Your
Majesty—for your servant is lame.

translation.text: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant is lame.

verses.english:
He replied, “My lord the king, my own servant deceived me. Your
servant planned to saddle his ass and ride on it and go with Your
Majesty—for your servant is lame.

verses.hebrew: וַיְרַגֵּל בְּעַבְדְּךָ אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּמַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים וַעֲשֵׂה הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְרַגֵּל בְּעַבְדְּךָ אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּמַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים וַעֲשֵׂה הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
[Ziba] has slandered your servant to my lord the king. But my lord
the king is like an angel of YHWH; do as you see fit.

translation.text: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of God: do therefore what is good in thine eyes.

verses.english:
[Ziba] has slandered your servant to my lord the king. But my lord
the king is like an angel of YHWH; do as you see fit.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא הָיָה כּל־בֵּית אָבִי כִּי אִם־אַנְשֵׁי־מָוֶת לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתָּשֶׁת אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ בְּאֹכְלֵי שֻׁלְחָנֶךָ וּמַה־יֶּשׁ־לִי עוֹד צְדָקָה וְלִזְעֹק עוֹד אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא הָיָה כּל־בֵּית אָבִי כִּי אִם־אַנְשֵׁי־מָוֶת לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתָּשֶׁת אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ בְּאֹכְלֵי שֻׁלְחָנֶךָ וּמַה־יֶּשׁ־לִי עוֹד צְדָקָה וְלִזְעֹק עוֹד אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
For all the members of my father’s family deserved only death from
my lord the king; yet you set your servant among those who ate at
your table. What right have I to appeal further to Your Majesty?”

translation.text: For all of my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?

verses.english:
For all the members of my father’s family deserved only death from
my lord the king; yet you set your servant among those who ate at
your table. What right have I to appeal further to Your Majesty?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה תְּדַבֵּר עוֹד דְּבָרֶיךָ אָמַרְתִּי אַתָּה וְצִיבָא תַּחְלְקוּ אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה תְּדַבֵּר עוֹד דְּבָרֶיךָ אָמַרְתִּי אַתָּה וְצִיבָא תַּחְלְקוּ אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
The king said to him, “You need not speak further. I decree that
you and Ziba shall divide the property.”

translation.text: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.

verses.english:
The king said to him, “You need not speak further. I decree that
you and Ziba shall divide the property.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מְפִיבֹשֶׁת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ גַּם אֶת־הַכֹּל יִקָּח אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־בָּא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מְפִיבֹשֶׁת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ גַּם אֶת־הַכֹּל יִקָּח אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־בָּא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
And Mephibosheth said to the king, “Let him take it all, as long
as my lord the king has come home safe.”

translation.text: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.

verses.english:
And Mephibosheth said to the king, “Let him take it all, as long
as my lord the king has come home safe.”

verses.hebrew: וּבַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי יָרַד מֵרֹגְלִים וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן לְשַׁלְּחוֹ אֶת־[הַיַּרְדֵּן] (בירדן)׃

hebrew.text: וּבַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי יָרַד מֵרֹגְלִים וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן לְשַׁלְּחוֹ אֶת־[הַיַּרְדֵּן] (בירדן)׃

english.text:
Barzillai the Gileadite had come down from Rogelin and passed on
to the Jordan with the king, to see him off at the Jordan.

translation.text: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.

verses.english:
Barzillai the Gileadite had come down from Rogelin and passed on
to the Jordan with the king, to see him off at the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וּבַרְזִלַּי זָקֵן מְאֹד בֶּן־שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וְהוּא־כִלְכַּל אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשִׁיבָתוֹ בְמַחֲנַיִם כִּי־אִישׁ גָּדוֹל הוּא מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וּבַרְזִלַּי זָקֵן מְאֹד בֶּן־שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וְהוּא־כִלְכַּל אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשִׁיבָתוֹ בְמַחֲנַיִם כִּי־אִישׁ גָּדוֹל הוּא מְאֹד׃

english.text:
Barzillai was very old, eighty years of age; and he had provided
the king with food during his stay at Mahanaim, for he was a very
wealthy man.

translation.text: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.

verses.english:
Barzillai was very old, eighty years of age; and he had provided
the king with food during his stay at Mahanaim, for he was a very
wealthy man.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־בַּרְזִלָּי אַתָּה עֲבֹר אִתִּי וְכִלְכַּלְתִּי אֹתְךָ עִמָּדִי בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־בַּרְזִלָּי אַתָּה עֲבֹר אִתִּי וְכִלְכַּלְתִּי אֹתְךָ עִמָּדִי בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
The king said to Barzillai, “Cross over with me, and I will
provide for you in Jerusalem at my side.”

translation.text: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.

verses.english:
The king said to Barzillai, “Cross over with me, and I will
provide for you in Jerusalem at my side.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בַּרְזִלַּי אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כַּמָּה יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיַּי כִּי־אֶעֱלֶה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בַּרְזִלַּי אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כַּמָּה יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיַּי כִּי־אֶעֱלֶה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
But Barzillai said to the king, “How many years are left to me
that I should go up with Your Majesty to Jerusalem?

translation.text: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?

verses.english:
But Barzillai said to the king, “How many years are left to me
that I should go up with Your Majesty to Jerusalem?

verses.hebrew:
בֶּן־שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה אָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם הַאֵדַע בֵּין־טוֹב לְרָע אִם־יִטְעַם עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־אֲשֶׁר אֹכַל וְאֶת־אֲשֶׁר אֶשְׁתֶּה אִם־אֶשְׁמַע עוֹד בְּקוֹל שָׁרִים וְשָׁרוֹת וְלָמָּה
יִהְיֶה עַבְדְּךָ עוֹד לְמַשָּׂא אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
בֶּן־שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה אָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם הַאֵדַע בֵּין־טוֹב לְרָע אִם־יִטְעַם עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־אֲשֶׁר אֹכַל וְאֶת־אֲשֶׁר אֶשְׁתֶּה אִם־אֶשְׁמַע עוֹד בְּקוֹל שָׁרִים וְשָׁרוֹת וְלָמָּה
יִהְיֶה עַבְדְּךָ עוֹד לְמַשָּׂא אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
I am now eighty years old. Can I tell the difference between good
and bad? Can your servant taste what he eats and drinks? Can I
still listen to the singing of men and women? Why then should your
servant continue to be a burden to my lord the king?

translation.text: I am this day fourscore years old: and can I discern between good and evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?

verses.english:
I am now eighty years old. Can I tell the difference between good
and bad? Can your servant taste what he eats and drinks? Can I
still listen to the singing of men and women? Why then should your
servant continue to be a burden to my lord the king?

verses.hebrew: כִּמְעַט יַעֲבֹר עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלָמָּה יִגְמְלֵנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגְּמוּלָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: כִּמְעַט יַעֲבֹר עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלָמָּה יִגְמְלֵנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגְּמוּלָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
Your servant could barely cross the Jordan with your Majesty! Why
should Your Majesty reward me so generously?

translation.text: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?

verses.english:
Your servant could barely cross the Jordan with your Majesty! Why
should Your Majesty reward me so generously?

verses.hebrew: יָשׁב־נָא עַבְדְּךָ וְאָמֻת בְּעִירִי עִם קֶבֶר אָבִי וְאִמִּי וְהִנֵּה עַבְדְּךָ כִמְהָם יַעֲבֹר עִם־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַעֲשֵׂה־לוֹ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־טוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: יָשׁב־נָא עַבְדְּךָ וְאָמֻת בְּעִירִי עִם קֶבֶר אָבִי וְאִמִּי וְהִנֵּה עַבְדְּךָ כִמְהָם יַעֲבֹר עִם־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַעֲשֵׂה־לוֹ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־טוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Let your servant go back, and let me die in my own town, near the
graves of my father and mother. But here is your servant Chimham;
let him cross with my lord the king, and do for him as you see
fit.”

translation.text: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.

verses.english:
Let your servant go back, and let me die in my own town, near the
graves of my father and mother. But here is your servant Chimham;
let him cross with my lord the king, and do for him as you see
fit.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אִתִּי יַעֲבֹר כִּמְהָם וַאֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה־לּוֹ אֶת־הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תִּבְחַר עָלַי אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אִתִּי יַעֲבֹר כִּמְהָם וַאֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה־לּוֹ אֶת־הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תִּבְחַר עָלַי אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ׃

english.text:
And the king said, “Chimham shall cross with me, and I will do for
him as you see fit; and anything you want me to do, I will do for
you.”

translation.text: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, that will I do for thee.

verses.english:
And the king said, “Chimham shall cross with me, and I will do for
him as you see fit; and anything you want me to do, I will do for
you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר כּל־הָעָם אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְהַמֶּלֶךְ עָבָר וַיִּשַּׁק הַמֶּלֶךְ לְבַרְזִלַּי וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיָּשׁב לִמְקֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר כּל־הָעָם אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְהַמֶּלֶךְ עָבָר וַיִּשַּׁק הַמֶּלֶךְ לְבַרְזִלַּי וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיָּשׁב לִמְקֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
All the troops crossed the Jordan; and when the king was ready to
cross, the king kissed Barzillai and bade him farewell; and
[Barzillai] returned to his home.

translation.text: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.

verses.english:
All the troops crossed the Jordan; and when the king was ready to
cross, the king kissed Barzillai and bade him farewell; and
[Barzillai] returned to his home.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגִּלְגָּלָה וְכִמְהָן עָבַר עִמּוֹ וְכל־עַם יְהוּדָה (ויעברו) [הֶעֱבִירוּ] אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְגַם חֲצִי עַם יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגִּלְגָּלָה וְכִמְהָן עָבַר עִמּוֹ וְכל־עַם יְהוּדָה (ויעברו) [הֶעֱבִירוּ] אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְגַם חֲצִי עַם יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The king passed on to Gilgal, with Chimham accompanying him; and
all the Judite soldiers and part of the Israelite army escorted
the king across.

translation.text: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel.

verses.english:
The king passed on to Gilgal, with Chimham accompanying him; and
all the Judite soldiers and part of the Israelite army escorted
the king across.

verses.hebrew:
וְהִנֵּה כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאִים אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ מַדּוּעַ גְּנָבוּךָ אַחֵינוּ אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וַיַּעֲבִרוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן
וְכל־אַנְשֵׁי דָוִד עִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִנֵּה כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאִים אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ מַדּוּעַ גְּנָבוּךָ אַחֵינוּ אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וַיַּעֲבִרוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן
וְכל־אַנְשֵׁי דָוִד עִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
Then all the men of Israel came to the king and said to the king,
“Why did our kinsmen, the men of Judah, steal you away and escort
the king and his family across the Jordan, along with all David’s
men?”

translation.text: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David’s men with him, over Jordan?

verses.english:
Then all the men of Israel came to the king and said to the king,
“Why did our kinsmen, the men of Judah, steal you away and escort
the king and his family across the Jordan, along with all David’s
men?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן כּל־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה עַל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־קָרוֹב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלַי וְלָמָּה זֶּה חָרָה לְךָ עַל־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה הֶאָכוֹל אָכַלְנוּ מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־נִשֵּׂאת נִשָּׂא
לָנוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן כּל־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה עַל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־קָרוֹב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלַי וְלָמָּה זֶּה חָרָה לְךָ עַל־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה הֶאָכוֹל אָכַלְנוּ מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־נִשֵּׂאת נִשָּׂא
לָנוּ׃

english.text:
All the men of Judah replied to the men of Israel, “Because the
king is our relative! Why should this upset you? Have we consumed
anything that belongs to the king? Has he given us any gifts?”

translation.text: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then be ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king’s cost? or hath he given us any gift?

verses.english:
All the men of Judah replied to the men of Israel, “Because the
king is our relative! Why should this upset you? Have we consumed
anything that belongs to the king? Has he given us any gifts?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר עֶשֶׂר־יָדוֹת לִי בַמֶּלֶךְ וְגַם־בְּדָוִד אֲנִי מִמְּךָ וּמַדּוּעַ הֱקִלֹּתַנִי וְלֹא־הָיָה דְבָרִי רִאשׁוֹן לִי לְהָשִׁיב
אֶת־מַלְכִּי וַיִּקֶשׁ דְּבַר־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה מִדְּבַר אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר עֶשֶׂר־יָדוֹת לִי בַמֶּלֶךְ וְגַם־בְּדָוִד אֲנִי מִמְּךָ וּמַדּוּעַ הֱקִלֹּתַנִי וְלֹא־הָיָה דְבָרִי רִאשׁוֹן לִי לְהָשִׁיב
אֶת־מַלְכִּי וַיִּקֶשׁ דְּבַר־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה מִדְּבַר אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, “We have ten
shares in the king, and in David, too, we have more than you. Why
then have you slighted us? Were we not the first to propose that
our king be brought back?” However, the men of Judah prevailed
over the men of Israel.

translation.text: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.

verses.english:
But the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, “We have ten
shares in the king, and in David, too, we have more than you. Why
then have you slighted us? Were we not the first to propose that
our king be brought back?” However, the men of Judah prevailed
over the men of Israel.

verses.hebrew:
וְשָׁם נִקְרָא אִישׁ בְּלִיַּעַל וּשְׁמוֹ שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי אִישׁ יְמִינִי וַיִּתְקַע בַּשֹּׁפָר וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין־לָנוּ חֵלֶק בְּדָוִד וְלֹא נַחֲלָה־לָנוּ בְּבֶן־יִשַׁי אִישׁ
לְאֹהָלָיו יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וְשָׁם נִקְרָא אִישׁ בְּלִיַּעַל וּשְׁמוֹ שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי אִישׁ יְמִינִי וַיִּתְקַע בַּשֹּׁפָר וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין־לָנוּ חֵלֶק בְּדָוִד וְלֹא נַחֲלָה־לָנוּ בְּבֶן־יִשַׁי אִישׁ
לְאֹהָלָיו יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
A scoundrel named Sheba son of Bichri, a Benjaminite, happened to
be there. He sounded the horn and proclaimed: “We have no portion
in David, No share in Jesse’s son! Every man to his tent, O
Israel!”

translation.text: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.

verses.english:
A scoundrel named Sheba son of Bichri, a Benjaminite, happened to
be there. He sounded the horn and proclaimed: “We have no portion
in David, No share in Jesse’s son! Every man to his tent, O
Israel!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַחֲרֵי דָוִד אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי וְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה דָּבְקוּ בְמַלְכָּם מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְעַד־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַחֲרֵי דָוִד אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי וְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה דָּבְקוּ בְמַלְכָּם מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְעַד־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

translation.text: So every man of Israel went up from after David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּקַּח הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת עֶשֶׂר־נָשִׁים פִּלַגְשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הִנִּיחַ לִשְׁמֹר הַבַּיִת וַיִּתְּנֵם בֵּית־מִשְׁמֶרֶת וַיְכַלְכְּלֵם
וַאֲלֵיהֶם לֹא־בָא וַתִּהְיֶינָה צְרֻרוֹת עַד־יוֹם מֻתָן אַלְמְנוּת חַיּוּת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּקַּח הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת עֶשֶׂר־נָשִׁים פִּלַגְשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הִנִּיחַ לִשְׁמֹר הַבַּיִת וַיִּתְּנֵם בֵּית־מִשְׁמֶרֶת וַיְכַלְכְּלֵם
וַאֲלֵיהֶם לֹא־בָא וַתִּהְיֶינָה צְרֻרוֹת עַד־יוֹם מֻתָן אַלְמְנוּת חַיּוּת׃

english.text:
David went to his palace in Jerusalem, and the king took the ten
concubines he had left to mind the palace and put them in a
guarded place; he provided for them, but he did not cohabit with
them. They remained in seclusion until the day they died, in
living widowhood.

translation.text: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.

verses.english:
David went to his palace in Jerusalem, and the king took the ten
concubines he had left to mind the palace and put them in a
guarded place; he provided for them, but he did not cohabit with
them. They remained in seclusion until the day they died, in
living widowhood.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־עֲמָשָׂא הַזְעֶק־לִי אֶת־אִישׁ־יְהוּדָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וְאַתָּה פֹּה עֲמֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־עֲמָשָׂא הַזְעֶק־לִי אֶת־אִישׁ־יְהוּדָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וְאַתָּה פֹּה עֲמֹד׃

english.text:
The king said to Amasa, “Call up the men of Judah to my standard,
and report here three days from now.”

translation.text: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.

verses.english:
The king said to Amasa, “Call up the men of Judah to my standard,
and report here three days from now.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ עֲמָשָׂא לְהַזְעִיק אֶת־יְהוּדָה (וייחר) [וַיּוֹחֶר] מִן־הַמּוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר יְעָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ עֲמָשָׂא לְהַזְעִיק אֶת־יְהוּדָה (וייחר) [וַיּוֹחֶר] מִן־הַמּוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר יְעָדוֹ׃

english.text:
Amasa went to call up Judah, but he took longer than the time set
for him.

translation.text: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.

verses.english:
Amasa went to call up Judah, but he took longer than the time set
for him.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אֲבִישַׁי עַתָּה יֵרַע לָנוּ שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי מִן־אַבְשָׁלוֹם אַתָּה קַח אֶת־עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנֶיךָ וּרְדֹף אַחֲרָיו פֶּן־מָצָא לוֹ עָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת וְהִצִּיל
עֵינֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אֲבִישַׁי עַתָּה יֵרַע לָנוּ שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי מִן־אַבְשָׁלוֹם אַתָּה קַח אֶת־עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנֶיךָ וּרְדֹף אַחֲרָיו פֶּן־מָצָא לוֹ עָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת וְהִצִּיל
עֵינֵנוּ׃

english.text:
And David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba son of Bichri will cause us
more trouble than Absalom. So take your lord’s servants and pursue
him, before he finds fortified towns and eludes us.”

translation.text: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord’s servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.

verses.english:
And David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba son of Bichri will cause us
more trouble than Absalom. So take your lord’s servants and pursue
him, before he finds fortified towns and eludes us.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ אַחֲרָיו אַנְשֵׁי יוֹאָב וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וְכל־הַגִּבֹּרִים וַיֵּצְאוּ מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ אַחֲרָיו אַנְשֵׁי יוֹאָב וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וְכל־הַגִּבֹּרִים וַיֵּצְאוּ מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי׃

english.text:
Joab’s men, the Cherethites and Pelethites, and all the warriors,
marched out behind him. They left Jerusalem in pursuit of Sheba
son of Bichri.

translation.text: And there went out after him Joab’s men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

verses.english:
Joab’s men, the Cherethites and Pelethites, and all the warriors,
marched out behind him. They left Jerusalem in pursuit of Sheba
son of Bichri.

verses.hebrew:
הֵם עִם־הָאֶבֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה אֲשֶׁר בְּגִבְעוֹן וַעֲמָשָׂא בָּא לִפְנֵיהֶם וְיוֹאָב חָגוּר מִדּוֹ לְבֻשׁוֹ וְעָלָו חֲגוֹר חֶרֶב מְצֻמֶּדֶת עַל־מתְנָיו בְּתַעְרָהּ וְהוּא יָצָא
וַתִּפֹּל׃

hebrew.text:
הֵם עִם־הָאֶבֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה אֲשֶׁר בְּגִבְעוֹן וַעֲמָשָׂא בָּא לִפְנֵיהֶם וְיוֹאָב חָגוּר מִדּוֹ לְבֻשׁוֹ וְעָלָו חֲגוֹר חֶרֶב מְצֻמֶּדֶת עַל־מתְנָיו בְּתַעְרָהּ וְהוּא יָצָא
וַתִּפֹּל׃

english.text:
They were near the great stone in Gibeon when Amasa appeared
before them. Joab was wearing his military dress, with his sword
girded over it and fastened around his waist in its sheath; and,
as he stepped forward, it fell out.

translation.text: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab’s garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.

verses.english:
They were near the great stone in Gibeon when Amasa appeared
before them. Joab was wearing his military dress, with his sword
girded over it and fastened around his waist in its sheath; and,
as he stepped forward, it fell out.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לַעֲמָשָׂא הֲשָׁלוֹם אַתָּה אָחִי וַתֹּחֶז יַד־יְמִין יוֹאָב בִּזְקַן עֲמָשָׂא לִנְשׁק־לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לַעֲמָשָׂא הֲשָׁלוֹם אַתָּה אָחִי וַתֹּחֶז יַד־יְמִין יוֹאָב בִּזְקַן עֲמָשָׂא לִנְשׁק־לוֹ׃

english.text:
Joab said to Amasa, “How are you, brother?” and with his right
hand Joab took hold of Amasa’s beard as if to kiss him.

translation.text: And Joab said to Amasa, Art thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.

verses.english:
Joab said to Amasa, “How are you, brother?” and with his right
hand Joab took hold of Amasa’s beard as if to kiss him.

verses.hebrew:
וַעֲמָשָׂא לֹא־נִשְׁמַר בַּחֶרֶב אֲשֶׁר בְּיַד־יוֹאָב וַיַּכֵּהוּ בָהּ אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ וַיִּשְׁפֹּךְ מֵעָיו אַרְצָה וְלֹא־שָׁנָה לוֹ וַיָּמֹת וְיוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי אָחִיו רָדַף אַחֲרֵי
שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַעֲמָשָׂא לֹא־נִשְׁמַר בַּחֶרֶב אֲשֶׁר בְּיַד־יוֹאָב וַיַּכֵּהוּ בָהּ אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ וַיִּשְׁפֹּךְ מֵעָיו אַרְצָה וְלֹא־שָׁנָה לוֹ וַיָּמֹת וְיוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי אָחִיו רָדַף אַחֲרֵי
שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי׃

english.text:
Amasa was not on his guard against the sword in Joab’s [left]
hand, and [Joab] drove it into his belly so that his entrails
poured out on the ground and he died; he did not need to strike
him a second time. Joab and his brother Abishai then set off in
pursuit of Sheba son of Bichri,

translation.text: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.

verses.english:
Amasa was not on his guard against the sword in Joab’s [left]
hand, and [Joab] drove it into his belly so that his entrails
poured out on the ground and he died; he did not need to strike
him a second time. Joab and his brother Abishai then set off in
pursuit of Sheba son of Bichri,

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ עָמַד עָלָיו מִנַּעֲרֵי יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ בְּיוֹאָב וּמִי אֲשֶׁר־לְדָוִד אַחֲרֵי יוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ עָמַד עָלָיו מִנַּעֲרֵי יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ בְּיוֹאָב וּמִי אֲשֶׁר־לְדָוִד אַחֲרֵי יוֹאָב׃

translation.text: And one of Joab’s men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for David, let him go after Joab.

verses.hebrew:
וַעֲמָשָׂא מִתְגֹּלֵל בַּדָּם בְּתוֹךְ הַמְסִלָּה וַיַּרְא הָאִישׁ כִּי־עָמַד כּל־הָעָם וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־עֲמָשָׂא מִן־הַמְסִלָּה הַשָּׂדֶה וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ עָלָיו בֶּגֶד כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאָה
כּל־הַבָּא עָלָיו וְעָמָד׃

hebrew.text:
וַעֲמָשָׂא מִתְגֹּלֵל בַּדָּם בְּתוֹךְ הַמְסִלָּה וַיַּרְא הָאִישׁ כִּי־עָמַד כּל־הָעָם וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־עֲמָשָׂא מִן־הַמְסִלָּה הַשָּׂדֶה וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ עָלָיו בֶּגֶד כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאָה
כּל־הַבָּא עָלָיו וְעָמָד׃

english.text:
Amasa lay in the middle of the road, drenched in his blood; and
the man saw that everyone stopped. And when he saw that all the
people were stopping, he dragged Amasa from the road into the
field and covered him with a garment.

translation.text: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.

verses.english:
Amasa lay in the middle of the road, drenched in his blood; and
the man saw that everyone stopped. And when he saw that all the
people were stopping, he dragged Amasa from the road into the
field and covered him with a garment.

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר הֹגָה מִן־הַמְסִלָּה עָבַר כּל־אִישׁ אַחֲרֵי יוֹאָב לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר הֹגָה מִן־הַמְסִלָּה עָבַר כּל־אִישׁ אַחֲרֵי יוֹאָב לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי׃

english.text:
Once he was removed from the road, everybody continued to follow
Joab in pursuit of Sheba son of Bichri.

translation.text: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

verses.english:
Once he was removed from the road, everybody continued to follow
Joab in pursuit of Sheba son of Bichri.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּכל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבֵלָה וּבֵית מַעֲכָה וְכל־הַבֵּרִים(ויקלהו) [וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ] וַיָּבֹאוּ אַף־אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּכל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבֵלָה וּבֵית מַעֲכָה וְכל־הַבֵּרִים(ויקלהו) [וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ] וַיָּבֹאוּ אַף־אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
[Sheba] had passed through all the tribes of Israel up to Abel of
Beth-maacah; and all the Beerites assembled and followed him
inside.

translation.text: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Bethmaachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.

verses.english:
[Sheba] had passed through all the tribes of Israel up to Abel of
Beth-maacah; and all the Beerites assembled and followed him
inside.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיָּצֻרוּ עָלָיו בְּאָבֵלָה בֵּית הַמַּעֲכָה וַיִּשְׁפְּכוּ סֹלְלָה אֶל־הָעִיר וַתַּעֲמֹד בַּחֵל וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אֶת־יוֹאָב מַשְׁחִיתִם לְהַפִּיל הַחוֹמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיָּצֻרוּ עָלָיו בְּאָבֵלָה בֵּית הַמַּעֲכָה וַיִּשְׁפְּכוּ סֹלְלָה אֶל־הָעִיר וַתַּעֲמֹד בַּחֵל וְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אֶת־יוֹאָב מַשְׁחִיתִם לְהַפִּיל הַחוֹמָה׃

english.text:
[Joab’s men] came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maacah; they
threw up a siegemound against the city and it stood against the
rampart. All the troops with Joab were engaged in battering the
wall,

translation.text: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Bethmaachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.

verses.english:
[Joab’s men] came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maacah; they
threw up a siegemound against the city and it stood against the
rampart. All the troops with Joab were engaged in battering the
wall,

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרָא אִשָּׁה חֲכָמָה מִן־הָעִיר שִׁמְעוּ שִׁמְעוּ אִמְרוּ־נָא אֶל־יוֹאָב קְרַב עַד־הֵנָּה וַאֲדַבְּרָה אֵלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקְרָא אִשָּׁה חֲכָמָה מִן־הָעִיר שִׁמְעוּ שִׁמְעוּ אִמְרוּ־נָא אֶל־יוֹאָב קְרַב עַד־הֵנָּה וַאֲדַבְּרָה אֵלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
when a clever woman shouted from the city, “Listen! Listen! Tell
Joab to come over here so I can talk to him.”

translation.text: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.

verses.english:
when a clever woman shouted from the city, “Listen! Listen! Tell
Joab to come over here so I can talk to him.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרַב אֵלֶיהָ וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַאַתָּה יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר אָנִי וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ שְׁמַע דִּבְרֵי אֲמָתֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר שֹׁמֵעַ אָנֹכִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרַב אֵלֶיהָ וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַאַתָּה יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר אָנִי וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ שְׁמַע דִּבְרֵי אֲמָתֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר שֹׁמֵעַ אָנֹכִי׃

english.text:
He approached her, and the woman asked, “Are you Joab?” “Yes,” he
answered; and she said to him, “Listen to what your handmaid has
to say.” “I’m listening,” he replied.

translation.text: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, Art thou Joab? And he answered, I am he. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.

verses.english:
He approached her, and the woman asked, “Are you Joab?” “Yes,” he
answered; and she said to him, “Listen to what your handmaid has
to say.” “I’m listening,” he replied.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאמֹר דַּבֵּר יְדַבְּרוּ בָרִאשֹׁנָה לֵאמֹר שָׁאוֹל יְשָׁאֲלוּ בְּאָבֵל וְכֵן הֵתַמּוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאמֹר דַּבֵּר יְדַבְּרוּ בָרִאשֹׁנָה לֵאמֹר שָׁאוֹל יְשָׁאֲלוּ בְּאָבֵל וְכֵן הֵתַמּוּ׃

english.text:
And she continued, “In olden times people used to say, ‘Let them
inquire of Abel,’ and that was the end of the matter.

translation.text: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: and so they ended the matter.

verses.english:
And she continued, “In olden times people used to say, ‘Let them
inquire of Abel,’ and that was the end of the matter.

verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי שְׁלֻמֵי אֱמוּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתָּה מְבַקֵּשׁ לְהָמִית עִיר וְאֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לָמָּה תְבַלַּע נַחֲלַת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אָנֹכִי שְׁלֻמֵי אֱמוּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתָּה מְבַקֵּשׁ לְהָמִית עִיר וְאֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לָמָּה תְבַלַּע נַחֲלַת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
I am one of those who seek the welfare of the faithful in Israel.
But you seek to bring death upon a mother city in Israel! Why
should you destroy YHWH’s possession?”

translation.text: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the LORD?

verses.english:
I am one of those who seek the welfare of the faithful in Israel.
But you seek to bring death upon a mother city in Israel! Why
should you destroy YHWH’s possession?”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמַר חָלִילָה חָלִילָה לִי אִם־אֲבַלַּע וְאִם־אַשְׁחִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמַר חָלִילָה חָלִילָה לִי אִם־אֲבַלַּע וְאִם־אַשְׁחִית׃

english.text: Joab replied, “Far be it, far be it from me to destroy or to ruin!

translation.text: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

verses.english: Joab replied, “Far be it, far be it from me to destroy or to ruin!

verses.hebrew:
לֹא־כֵן הַדָּבָר כִּי אִישׁ מֵהַר אֶפְרַיִם שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי שְׁמוֹ נָשָׂא יָדוֹ בַּמֶּלֶךְ בְּדָוִד תְּנוּ־אֹתוֹ לְבַדּוֹ וְאֵלְכָה מֵעַל הָעִיר וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־יוֹאָב
הִנֵּה רֹאשׁוֹ מֻשְׁלָךְ אֵלֶיךָ בְּעַד הַחוֹמָה׃

hebrew.text:
לֹא־כֵן הַדָּבָר כִּי אִישׁ מֵהַר אֶפְרַיִם שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי שְׁמוֹ נָשָׂא יָדוֹ בַּמֶּלֶךְ בְּדָוִד תְּנוּ־אֹתוֹ לְבַדּוֹ וְאֵלְכָה מֵעַל הָעִיר וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־יוֹאָב
הִנֵּה רֹאשׁוֹ מֻשְׁלָךְ אֵלֶיךָ בְּעַד הַחוֹמָה׃

english.text:
Not at all! But a certain man from the hill country of Ephraim,
named Sheba son of Bichri, has rebelled against King David. Just
hand him alone over to us, and I will withdraw from the city.” The
woman assured Joab, “His head shall be thrown over the wall to
you.”

translation.text: The matter is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, even against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.

verses.english:
Not at all! But a certain man from the hill country of Ephraim,
named Sheba son of Bichri, has rebelled against King David. Just
hand him alone over to us, and I will withdraw from the city.” The
woman assured Joab, “His head shall be thrown over the wall to
you.”

verses.hebrew:
וַתָּבוֹא הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־כּל־הָעָם בְּחכְמָתָהּ וַיִּכְרְתוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ אֶל־יוֹאָב וַיִּתְקַע בַּשֹּׁפָר וַיָּפֻצוּ מֵעַל־הָעִיר אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו
וְיוֹאָב שָׁב יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַתָּבוֹא הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־כּל־הָעָם בְּחכְמָתָהּ וַיִּכְרְתוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ אֶל־יוֹאָב וַיִּתְקַע בַּשֹּׁפָר וַיָּפֻצוּ מֵעַל־הָעִיר אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו
וְיוֹאָב שָׁב יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The woman came to all the people with her clever plan; and they
cut off the head of Sheba son of Bichri and threw it down to Joab.
He then sounded the horn; all the men dispersed to their homes,
and Joab returned to the king in Jerusalem.

translation.text: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.

verses.english:
The woman came to all the people with her clever plan; and they
cut off the head of Sheba son of Bichri and threw it down to Joab.
He then sounded the horn; all the men dispersed to their homes,
and Joab returned to the king in Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב אֶל כּל־הַצָּבָא יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבְנָיָה בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע עַל־(הכרי) [הַכְּרֵתִי] וְעַל־הַפְּלֵתִי׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹאָב אֶל כּל־הַצָּבָא יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבְנָיָה בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע עַל־(הכרי) [הַכְּרֵתִי] וְעַל־הַפְּלֵתִי׃

english.text:
Joab was commander of the whole army [of] Israel; Benaiah son of
Jehoiada was commander of the Cherethites and the Pelethites;

translation.text: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:

verses.english:
Joab was commander of the whole army [of] Israel; Benaiah son of
Jehoiada was commander of the Cherethites and the Pelethites;

verses.hebrew: וַאֲדֹרָם עַל־הַמַּס וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־אֲחִילוּד הַמַּזְכִּיר׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲדֹרָם עַל־הַמַּס וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־אֲחִילוּד הַמַּזְכִּיר׃

english.text:
Adoram was in charge of forced labor; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud
was recorder;

translation.text: And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:

verses.english:
Adoram was in charge of forced labor; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud
was recorder;

verses.hebrew: (ושיא) [וּשְׁוָא] סֹפֵר וְצָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִים׃

hebrew.text: (ושיא) [וּשְׁוָא] סֹפֵר וְצָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִים׃

english.text: Sheva was scribe; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests.

translation.text: And Sheva was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:

verses.english: Sheva was scribe; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם עִירָא הַיָּאִרִי הָיָה כֹהֵן לְדָוִד׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם עִירָא הַיָּאִרִי הָיָה כֹהֵן לְדָוִד׃

english.text: Ira the Jairite also served David as priest.

translation.text: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.

verses.english: Ira the Jairite also served David as priest.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי רָעָב בִּימֵי דָוִד שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים שָׁנָה אַחֲרֵי שָׁנָה וַיְבַקֵּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָהוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְאֶל־בֵּית הַדָּמִים עַל אֲשֶׁר־הֵמִית
אֶת־הַגִּבְעֹנִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי רָעָב בִּימֵי דָוִד שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים שָׁנָה אַחֲרֵי שָׁנָה וַיְבַקֵּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָהוַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְאֶל־בֵּית הַדָּמִים עַל אֲשֶׁר־הֵמִית
אֶת־הַגִּבְעֹנִים׃

english.text:
There was a famine during the reign of David, year after year for
three years. David inquired of YHWH, and YHWH replied, “It is
because of the bloodguilt of Saul and [his] house, for he put some
Gibeonites to death.”

translation.text: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of the LORD. And the LORD answered, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.

verses.english:
There was a famine during the reign of David, year after year for
three years. David inquired of YHWH, and YHWH replied, “It is
because of the bloodguilt of Saul and [his] house, for he put some
Gibeonites to death.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְרָא הַמֶּלֶךְ לַגִּבְעֹנִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם וְהַגִּבְעֹנִים לֹא מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵמָּה כִּי אִם־מִיֶּתֶר הָאֱמֹרִי וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נִשְׁבְּעוּ לָהֶם וַיְבַקֵּשׁ
שָׁאוּל לְהַכֹּתָם בְּקַנֹּאתוֹ לִבְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְרָא הַמֶּלֶךְ לַגִּבְעֹנִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם וְהַגִּבְעֹנִים לֹא מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵמָּה כִּי אִם־מִיֶּתֶר הָאֱמֹרִי וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נִשְׁבְּעוּ לָהֶם וַיְבַקֵּשׁ
שָׁאוּל לְהַכֹּתָם בְּקַנֹּאתוֹ לִבְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The king summoned the Gibeonites and spoke to them.—Now the
Gibeonites were not of Israelite stock, but a remnant of the
Amorites, to whom the Israelites had given an oath; and Saul had
tried to wipe them out in his zeal for the people of Israel and
Judah.—

translation.text: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)

verses.english:
The king summoned the Gibeonites and spoke to them.—Now the
Gibeonites were not of Israelite stock, but a remnant of the
Amorites, to whom the Israelites had given an oath; and Saul had
tried to wipe them out in his zeal for the people of Israel and
Judah.—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַגִּבְעֹנִים מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם וּבַמָּה אֲכַפֵּר וּבָרְכוּ אֶת־נַחֲלַת יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַגִּבְעֹנִים מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם וּבַמָּה אֲכַפֵּר וּבָרְכוּ אֶת־נַחֲלַת יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
David asked the Gibeonites, “What shall I do for you? How shall I
make expiation, so that you may bless YHWH’s own people?”

translation.text: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the LORD?

verses.english:
David asked the Gibeonites, “What shall I do for you? How shall I
make expiation, so that you may bless YHWH’s own people?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ הַגִּבְעֹנִים אֵין־[לָנוּ] (לי) כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב עִם־שָׁאוּל וְעִם־בֵּיתוֹ וְאֵין־לָנוּ אִישׁ לְהָמִית בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר מָה־אַתֶּם אֹמְרִים אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ הַגִּבְעֹנִים אֵין־[לָנוּ] (לי) כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב עִם־שָׁאוּל וְעִם־בֵּיתוֹ וְאֵין־לָנוּ אִישׁ לְהָמִית בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר מָה־אַתֶּם אֹמְרִים אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם׃

english.text:
The Gibeonites answered him, “We have no claim for silver or gold
against Saul and his household; and we have no claim on the life
of any other man in Israel.” And [David] responded, “Whatever you
say I will do for you.”

translation.text: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.

verses.english:
The Gibeonites answered him, “We have no claim for silver or gold
against Saul and his household; and we have no claim on the life
of any other man in Israel.” And [David] responded, “Whatever you
say I will do for you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר כִּלָּנוּ וַאֲשֶׁר דִּמָּה־לָנוּ נִשְׁמַדְנוּ מֵהִתְיַצֵּב בְּכל־גְּבֻל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר כִּלָּנוּ וַאֲשֶׁר דִּמָּה־לָנוּ נִשְׁמַדְנוּ מֵהִתְיַצֵּב בְּכל־גְּבֻל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Thereupon they said to the king, “The man who massacred us and
planned to exterminate us, so that we should not survive in all
the territory of Israel—

translation.text: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel,

verses.english:
Thereupon they said to the king, “The man who massacred us and
planned to exterminate us, so that we should not survive in all
the territory of Israel—

verses.hebrew: (ינתן) [יֻתַּן־]לָנוּ שִׁבְעָה אֲנָשִׁים מִבָּנָיו וְהוֹקַעֲנוּם לַיהֹוָה בְּגִבְעַת שָׁאוּל בְּחִיר יְהֹוָהוַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲנִי אֶתֵּן׃

hebrew.text: (ינתן) [יֻתַּן־]לָנוּ שִׁבְעָה אֲנָשִׁים מִבָּנָיו וְהוֹקַעֲנוּם לַיהֹוָה בְּגִבְעַת שָׁאוּל בְּחִיר יְהֹוָהוַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲנִי אֶתֵּן׃

english.text:
let seven of his male issue be handed over to us, and we will
impale them before YHWH in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of YHWH.”
And the king replied, “I will do so.”

translation.text: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, whom the LORD did choose. And the king said, I will give them.

verses.english:
let seven of his male issue be handed over to us, and we will
impale them before YHWH in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of YHWH.”
And the king replied, “I will do so.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחְמֹל הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־מְפִיבֹשֶׁת בֶּן־יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל עַל־שְׁבֻעַת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בֵּינֹתָם בֵּין דָּוִד וּבֵין יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחְמֹל הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־מְפִיבֹשֶׁת בֶּן־יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל עַל־שְׁבֻעַת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר בֵּינֹתָם בֵּין דָּוִד וּבֵין יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
The king spared Mephibosheth son of Jonathan son of Saul, because
of the oath before YHWH between the two, between David and
Jonathan son of Saul.

translation.text: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

verses.english:
The king spared Mephibosheth son of Jonathan son of Saul, because
of the oath before YHWH between the two, between David and
Jonathan son of Saul.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְשָׁאוּל אֶת־אַרְמֹנִי וְאֶת־מְפִבֹשֶׁת וְאֶת־חֲמֵשֶׁת בְּנֵי מִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה
לְעַדְרִיאֵל בֶּן־בַּרְזִלַּי הַמְּחֹלָתִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְשָׁאוּל אֶת־אַרְמֹנִי וְאֶת־מְפִבֹשֶׁת וְאֶת־חֲמֵשֶׁת בְּנֵי מִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה
לְעַדְרִיאֵל בֶּן־בַּרְזִלַּי הַמְּחֹלָתִי׃

english.text:
Instead, the king took Armoni and Mephibosheth, the two sons that
Rizpah daughter of Aiah bore to Saul, and the five sons that Merab
daughter of Saul bore to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite,

translation.text: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:

verses.english:
Instead, the king took Armoni and Mephibosheth, the two sons that
Rizpah daughter of Aiah bore to Saul, and the five sons that Merab
daughter of Saul bore to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite,

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד הַגִּבְעֹנִים וַיֹּקִיעֻם בָּהָר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּפְּלוּ (שבעתים) [שְׁבַעְתָּם] יָחַד (והם) [וְהֵמָּה] הֻמְתוּ בִּימֵי קָצִיר בָּרִאשֹׁנִים (תחלת)
[בִּתְחִלַּת] קְצִיר שְׂעֹרִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד הַגִּבְעֹנִים וַיֹּקִיעֻם בָּהָר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּפְּלוּ (שבעתים) [שְׁבַעְתָּם] יָחַד (והם) [וְהֵמָּה] הֻמְתוּ בִּימֵי קָצִיר בָּרִאשֹׁנִים (תחלת)
[בִּתְחִלַּת] קְצִיר שְׂעֹרִים׃

english.text:
and he handed them over to the Gibeonites. They impaled them on
the mountain before YHWH; all seven of them perished at the same
time. They were put to death in the first days of the harvest, the
beginning of the barley harvest.

translation.text: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the LORD: and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, in the beginning of barley harvest.

verses.english:
and he handed them over to the Gibeonites. They impaled them on
the mountain before YHWH; all seven of them perished at the same
time. They were put to death in the first days of the harvest, the
beginning of the barley harvest.

verses.hebrew:
וַתִּקַּח רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה אֶת־הַשַּׂק וַתַּטֵּהוּ לָהּ אֶל־הַצּוּר מִתְּחִלַּת קָצִיר עַד נִתַּךְ־מַיִם עֲלֵיהֶם מִן־הַשָּׁמָיִם וְלֹא־נָתְנָה עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם לָנוּחַ עֲלֵיהֶם
יוֹמָם וְאֶת־חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה לָיְלָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּקַּח רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה אֶת־הַשַּׂק וַתַּטֵּהוּ לָהּ אֶל־הַצּוּר מִתְּחִלַּת קָצִיר עַד נִתַּךְ־מַיִם עֲלֵיהֶם מִן־הַשָּׁמָיִם וְלֹא־נָתְנָה עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם לָנוּחַ עֲלֵיהֶם
יוֹמָם וְאֶת־חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה לָיְלָה׃

english.text:
Then Rizpah daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it on a
rock for herself, and she stayed there from the beginning of the
harvest until rain from the sky fell on the bodies; she did not
let the birds of the sky settle on them by day or the wild beasts
[approach] by night.

translation.text: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.

verses.english:
Then Rizpah daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it on a
rock for herself, and she stayed there from the beginning of the
harvest until rain from the sky fell on the bodies; she did not
let the birds of the sky settle on them by day or the wild beasts
[approach] by night.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְדָוִד אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשְׂתָה רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה פִּלֶגֶשׁ שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לְדָוִד אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשְׂתָה רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה פִּלֶגֶשׁ שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
David was told what Saul’s concubine Rizpah daughter of Aiah had
done.

translation.text: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

verses.english:
David was told what Saul’s concubine Rizpah daughter of Aiah had
done.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיִּקַּח אֶת־עַצְמוֹת שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ מֵאֵת בַּעֲלֵי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֲשֶׁר גָּנְבוּ אֹתָם מֵרְחֹב בֵּית־שַׁן אֲשֶׁר (תלום שם הפלשתים)
[תְּלָאוּם שָׁמָּה פְּלִשְׁתִּים] בְּיוֹם הַכּוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־שָׁאוּל בַּגִּלְבֹּעַ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיִּקַּח אֶת־עַצְמוֹת שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ מֵאֵת בַּעֲלֵי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֲשֶׁר גָּנְבוּ אֹתָם מֵרְחֹב בֵּית־שַׁן אֲשֶׁר (תלום שם הפלשתים)
[תְּלָאוּם שָׁמָּה פְּלִשְׁתִּים] בְּיוֹם הַכּוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־שָׁאוּל בַּגִּלְבֹּעַ׃

english.text:
And David went and took the bones of Saul and of his son Jonathan
from the citizens of Jabesh-gilead, who had made off with them
from the public square of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had
hung them up on the day the Philistines killed Saul at Gilboa.

translation.text: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabeshgilead, which had stolen them from the street of Bethshan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:

verses.english:
And David went and took the bones of Saul and of his son Jonathan
from the citizens of Jabesh-gilead, who had made off with them
from the public square of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had
hung them up on the day the Philistines killed Saul at Gilboa.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מִשָּׁם אֶת־עַצְמוֹת שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֶת־עַצְמוֹת הַמּוּקָעִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל מִשָּׁם אֶת־עַצְמוֹת שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֶת־עַצְמוֹת הַמּוּקָעִים׃

english.text:
He brought up the bones of Saul and of his son Jonathan from
there; and he gathered the bones of those who had been impaled.

translation.text: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.

verses.english:
He brought up the bones of Saul and of his son Jonathan from
there; and he gathered the bones of those who had been impaled.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֶת־עַצְמוֹת־שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן־בְּנוֹ בְּאֶרֶץ בִּנְיָמִן בְּצֵלָע בְּקֶבֶר קִישׁ אָבִיו וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּעָתֵר אֱלֹהִים לָאָרֶץ
אַחֲרֵי־כֵן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֶת־עַצְמוֹת־שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן־בְּנוֹ בְּאֶרֶץ בִּנְיָמִן בְּצֵלָע בְּקֶבֶר קִישׁ אָבִיו וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּעָתֵר אֱלֹהִים לָאָרֶץ
אַחֲרֵי־כֵן׃

english.text:
And they buried the bones of Saul and of his son Jonathan in Zela,
in the territory of Benjamin, in the tomb of his father Kish. And
when all that the king had commanded was done, God responded to
the plea of the land thereafter.

translation.text: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.

verses.english:
And they buried the bones of Saul and of his son Jonathan in Zela,
in the territory of Benjamin, in the tomb of his father Kish. And
when all that the king had commanded was done, God responded to
the plea of the land thereafter.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי־עוֹד מִלְחָמָה לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּרֶד דָּוִד וַעֲבָדָיו עִמּוֹ וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיָּעַף דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי־עוֹד מִלְחָמָה לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּרֶד דָּוִד וַעֲבָדָיו עִמּוֹ וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיָּעַף דָּוִד׃

english.text:
Again war broke out between the Philistines and Israel, and David
and the men with him went down and fought the Philistines; David
grew weary,

translation.text: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.

verses.english:
Again war broke out between the Philistines and Israel, and David
and the men with him went down and fought the Philistines; David
grew weary,

verses.hebrew: (וישבו) [וְיִשְׁבִּי] בְנֹב אֲשֶׁר בִּילִידֵי הָרָפָה וּמִשְׁקַל קֵינוֹ שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת מִשְׁקַל נְחֹשֶׁת וְהוּא חָגוּר חֲדָשָׁה וַיֹּאמֶר לְהַכּוֹת אֶת־דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: (וישבו) [וְיִשְׁבִּי] בְנֹב אֲשֶׁר בִּילִידֵי הָרָפָה וּמִשְׁקַל קֵינוֹ שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת מִשְׁקַל נְחֹשֶׁת וְהוּא חָגוּר חֲדָשָׁה וַיֹּאמֶר לְהַכּוֹת אֶת־דָּוִד׃

english.text:
and Ishbi-benob tried to kill David.—He was a descendant of the
Raphah; his bronze spear weighed three hundred shekels and he wore
new armor.—

translation.text: And Ishbibenob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword, thought to have slain David.

verses.english:
and Ishbi-benob tried to kill David.—He was a descendant of the
Raphah; his bronze spear weighed three hundred shekels and he wore
new armor.—

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲזר־לוֹ אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן־צְרוּיָה וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיְמִתֵהוּ אָז נִשְׁבְּעוּ אַנְשֵׁי־דָוִד לוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא־תֵצֵא עוֹד אִתָּנוּ לַמִּלְחָמָה וְלֹא תְכַבֶּה אֶת־נֵר
יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲזר־לוֹ אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן־צְרוּיָה וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיְמִתֵהוּ אָז נִשְׁבְּעוּ אַנְשֵׁי־דָוִד לוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא־תֵצֵא עוֹד אִתָּנוּ לַמִּלְחָמָה וְלֹא תְכַבֶּה אֶת־נֵר
יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to his aid; he attacked the
Philistine and killed him. It was then that David’s men declared
to him on oath, “You shall not go with us into battle any more,
lest you extinguish the lamp of Israel!”

translation.text: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel.

verses.english:
But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to his aid; he attacked the
Philistine and killed him. It was then that David’s men declared
to him on oath, “You shall not go with us into battle any more,
lest you extinguish the lamp of Israel!”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַתְּהִי־עוֹד הַמִּלְחָמָה בְּגוֹב עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים אָז הִכָּה סִבְּכַי הַחֻשָׁתִי אֶת־סַף אֲשֶׁר בִּילִדֵי הָרָפָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַתְּהִי־עוֹד הַמִּלְחָמָה בְּגוֹב עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים אָז הִכָּה סִבְּכַי הַחֻשָׁתִי אֶת־סַף אֲשֶׁר בִּילִדֵי הָרָפָה׃

translation.text: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי־עוֹד הַמִּלְחָמָה בְּגוֹב עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּךְ אֶלְחָנָן בֶּן־יַעְרֵי אֹרְגִים בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי אֵת גּלְיָת הַגִּתִּי וְעֵץ חֲנִיתוֹ כִּמְנוֹר אֹרְגִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי־עוֹד הַמִּלְחָמָה בְּגוֹב עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּךְ אֶלְחָנָן בֶּן־יַעְרֵי אֹרְגִים בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי אֵת גּלְיָת הַגִּתִּי וְעֵץ חֲנִיתוֹ כִּמְנוֹר אֹרְגִים׃

english.text:
Again there was fighting with the Philistines at Gob; and Elhanan
son of Jaare-oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite,
whose spear had a shaft like a weaver’s bar.

translation.text: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaareoregim, a Bethlehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

verses.english:
Again there was fighting with the Philistines at Gob; and Elhanan
son of Jaare-oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite,
whose spear had a shaft like a weaver’s bar.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי־עוֹד מִלְחָמָה בְּגַת וַיְהִי אִישׁ (מדין) [מָדוֹן] וְאֶצְבְּעֹת יָדָיו וְאֶצְבְּעֹת רַגְלָיו שֵׁשׁ וָשֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע מִסְפָּר וְגַם־הוּא יֻלַּד לְהָרָפָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי־עוֹד מִלְחָמָה בְּגַת וַיְהִי אִישׁ (מדין) [מָדוֹן] וְאֶצְבְּעֹת יָדָיו וְאֶצְבְּעֹת רַגְלָיו שֵׁשׁ וָשֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע מִסְפָּר וְגַם־הוּא יֻלַּד לְהָרָפָה׃

english.text:
Once again there was fighting, at Gath. There was a giant of a
man, who had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot,
twenty-four in all; he too was descended from the Raphah.

translation.text: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.

verses.english:
Once again there was fighting, at Gath. There was a giant of a
man, who had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot,
twenty-four in all; he too was descended from the Raphah.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחָרֵף אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכֵּהוּ יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־[שִׁמְעָה] (שמעי) אֲחִי דָוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחָרֵף אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכֵּהוּ יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־[שִׁמְעָה] (שמעי) אֲחִי דָוִד׃

english.text:
When he taunted Israel, Jonathan, the son of David’s brother
Shimei, killed him.

translation.text: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David slew him.

verses.english:
When he taunted Israel, Jonathan, the son of David’s brother
Shimei, killed him.

verses.hebrew: אֶת־אַרְבַּעַת אֵלֶּה יֻלְּדוּ לְהָרָפָה בְּגַת וַיִּפְּלוּ בְיַד־דָּוִד וּבְיַד עֲבָדָיו׃

hebrew.text: אֶת־אַרְבַּעַת אֵלֶּה יֻלְּדוּ לְהָרָפָה בְּגַת וַיִּפְּלוּ בְיַד־דָּוִד וּבְיַד עֲבָדָיו׃

english.text:
Those four were descended from the Raphah in Gath, and they fell
by the hands of David and his men.

translation.text: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

verses.english:
Those four were descended from the Raphah in Gath, and they fell
by the hands of David and his men.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר דָּוִד לַיהֹוָה אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת בְּיוֹם הִצִּיל יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ מִכַּף כּל־אֹיְבָיו וּמִכַּף שָׁאוּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר דָּוִד לַיהֹוָה אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת בְּיוֹם הִצִּיל יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ מִכַּף כּל־אֹיְבָיו וּמִכַּף שָׁאוּל׃

english.text:
David addressed the words of this song to YHWH, after YHWH had
saved him from the hands of all his enemies and from the hands of
Saul.

translation.text: And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:

verses.english:
David addressed the words of this song to YHWH, after YHWH had
saved him from the hands of all his enemies and from the hands of
Saul.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה סַלְעִי וּמְצֻדָתִי וּמְפַלְטִי־לִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה סַלְעִי וּמְצֻדָתִי וּמְפַלְטִי־לִי׃

english.text: He said: O LORD, my crag, my fastness, my deliverer!

translation.text: And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

verses.english: He said: O LORD, my crag, my fastness, my deliverer!

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵי צוּרִי אֶחֱסֶה־בּוֹ מָגִנִּי וְקֶרֶן יִשְׁעִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי וּמְנוּסִי מֹשִׁעִי מֵחָמָס תֹּשִׁעֵנִי׃

hebrew.text: אֱלֹהֵי צוּרִי אֶחֱסֶה־בּוֹ מָגִנִּי וְקֶרֶן יִשְׁעִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי וּמְנוּסִי מֹשִׁעִי מֵחָמָס תֹּשִׁעֵנִי׃

english.text:
O God, the rock wherein I take shelter: My shield, my mighty
champion, my fortress and refuge! My savior, You who rescue me
from violence!

translation.text: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.

verses.english:
O God, the rock wherein I take shelter: My shield, my mighty
champion, my fortress and refuge! My savior, You who rescue me
from violence!
