verses.hebrew: מְהֻלָּל אֶקְרָא יְהֹוָה וּמֵאֹיְבַי אִוָּשֵׁעַ׃

hebrew.text: מְהֻלָּל אֶקְרָא יְהֹוָה וּמֵאֹיְבַי אִוָּשֵׁעַ׃

english.text: All praise! I called on YHWH, And I was delivered from my enemies.

translation.text: I will call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

verses.english: All praise! I called on YHWH, And I was delivered from my enemies.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֲפָפֻנִי מִשְׁבְּרֵי־מָוֶת נַחֲלֵי בְלִיַּעַל יְבַעֲתֻנִי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֲפָפֻנִי מִשְׁבְּרֵי־מָוֶת נַחֲלֵי בְלִיַּעַל יְבַעֲתֻנִי׃

english.text:
For the breakers of Death encompassed me, The torrents of Belial
terrified me;

translation.text: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;

verses.english:
For the breakers of Death encompassed me, The torrents of Belial
terrified me;

verses.hebrew: חֶבְלֵי שְׁאוֹל סַבֻּנִי קִדְּמֻנִי מֹקְשֵׁי מָוֶת׃

hebrew.text: חֶבְלֵי שְׁאוֹל סַבֻּנִי קִדְּמֻנִי מֹקְשֵׁי מָוֶת׃

english.text: The snares of Sheol encircled me, The coils of Death engulfed me.

translation.text: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;

verses.english: The snares of Sheol encircled me, The coils of Death engulfed me.

verses.hebrew: בַּצַּר־לִי אֶקְרָא יְהֹוָה וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַי אֶקְרָא וַיִּשְׁמַע מֵהֵיכָלוֹ קוֹלִי וְשַׁוְעָתִי בְּאזְנָיו׃

hebrew.text: בַּצַּר־לִי אֶקְרָא יְהֹוָה וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַי אֶקְרָא וַיִּשְׁמַע מֵהֵיכָלוֹ קוֹלִי וְשַׁוְעָתִי בְּאזְנָיו׃

english.text:
In my anguish I called on YHWH, Cried out to my God; In His Abode
He heard my voice, My cry entered His ears.

translation.text: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.

verses.english:
In my anguish I called on YHWH, Cried out to my God; In His Abode
He heard my voice, My cry entered His ears.

verses.hebrew: (ותגעש) [וַיִּתְגָּעַשׁ] וַתִּרְעַשׁ הָאָרֶץ מוֹסְדוֹת הַשָּׁמַיִם יִרְגָּזוּ וַיִּתְגָּעֲשׁוּ כִּי־חָרָה לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: (ותגעש) [וַיִּתְגָּעַשׁ] וַתִּרְעַשׁ הָאָרֶץ מוֹסְדוֹת הַשָּׁמַיִם יִרְגָּזוּ וַיִּתְגָּעֲשׁוּ כִּי־חָרָה לוֹ׃

english.text:
Then the earth rocked and quaked, The foundations of heaven shook—
Rocked by His indignation.

translation.text: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.

verses.english:
Then the earth rocked and quaked, The foundations of heaven shook—
Rocked by His indignation.

verses.hebrew: עָלָה עָשָׁן בְּאַפּוֹ וְאֵשׁ מִפִּיו תֹּאכֵל גֶּחָלִים בָּעֲרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text: עָלָה עָשָׁן בְּאַפּוֹ וְאֵשׁ מִפִּיו תֹּאכֵל גֶּחָלִים בָּעֲרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
Smoke went up from His nostrils, From His mouth came devouring
fire; Live coals blazed forth from Him.

translation.text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

verses.english:
Smoke went up from His nostrils, From His mouth came devouring
fire; Live coals blazed forth from Him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּט שָׁמַיִם וַיֵּרַד וַעֲרָפֶל תַּחַת רַגְלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּט שָׁמַיִם וַיֵּרַד וַעֲרָפֶל תַּחַת רַגְלָיו׃

english.text: He bent the sky and came down, Thick cloud beneath His feet.

translation.text: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.

verses.english: He bent the sky and came down, Thick cloud beneath His feet.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְכַּב עַל־כְּרוּב וַיָּעֹף וַיֵּרָא עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רוּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְכַּב עַל־כְּרוּב וַיָּעֹף וַיֵּרָא עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רוּחַ׃

english.text:
He mounted a cherub and flew; He was seen on the wings of the
wind.

translation.text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.

verses.english:
He mounted a cherub and flew; He was seen on the wings of the
wind.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁת חֹשֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָיו סֻכּוֹת חַשְׁרַת־מַיִם עָבֵי שְׁחָקִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׁת חֹשֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָיו סֻכּוֹת חַשְׁרַת־מַיִם עָבֵי שְׁחָקִים׃

english.text:
He made pavilions of darkness about Him, Dripping clouds, huge
thunderheads;

translation.text: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.

verses.english:
He made pavilions of darkness about Him, Dripping clouds, huge
thunderheads;

verses.hebrew: מִנֹּגַהּ נֶגְדּוֹ בָּעֲרוּ גַּחֲלֵי־אֵשׁ׃

hebrew.text: מִנֹּגַהּ נֶגְדּוֹ בָּעֲרוּ גַּחֲלֵי־אֵשׁ׃

english.text: In the brilliance before Him Blazed fiery coals.

translation.text: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.

verses.english: In the brilliance before Him Blazed fiery coals.

verses.hebrew: יַרְעֵם מִן־שָׁמַיִם יְהֹוָה וְעֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּן קוֹלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: יַרְעֵם מִן־שָׁמַיִם יְהֹוָה וְעֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּן קוֹלוֹ׃

english.text:
YHWH thundered forth from heaven, The Most High sent forth His
voice;

translation.text: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.

verses.english:
YHWH thundered forth from heaven, The Most High sent forth His
voice;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִצִּים וַיְפִיצֵם בָּרָק (ויהמם) [וַיָּהֹם]׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִצִּים וַיְפִיצֵם בָּרָק (ויהמם) [וַיָּהֹם]׃

english.text:
He let loose bolts, and scattered them; Lightning, and put them to
rout.

translation.text: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.

verses.english:
He let loose bolts, and scattered them; Lightning, and put them to
rout.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָאוּ אֲפִקֵי יָם יִגָּלוּ מֹסְדוֹת תֵּבֵל בְּגַעֲרַת יְהֹוָה מִנִּשְׁמַת רוּחַ אַפּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָאוּ אֲפִקֵי יָם יִגָּלוּ מֹסְדוֹת תֵּבֵל בְּגַעֲרַת יְהֹוָה מִנִּשְׁמַת רוּחַ אַפּוֹ׃

english.text:
The bed of the sea was exposed, The foundations of the world were
laid bare By the mighty roaring of YHWH, At the blast of the
breath of His nostrils.

translation.text: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

verses.english:
The bed of the sea was exposed, The foundations of the world were
laid bare By the mighty roaring of YHWH, At the blast of the
breath of His nostrils.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח מִמָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵנִי יַמְשֵׁנִי מִמַּיִם רַבִּים׃

hebrew.text: יִשְׁלַח מִמָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵנִי יַמְשֵׁנִי מִמַּיִם רַבִּים׃

english.text:
He reached down from on high, He took me, Drew me out of the
mighty waters;

translation.text: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;

verses.english:
He reached down from on high, He took me, Drew me out of the
mighty waters;

verses.hebrew: יַצִּילֵנִי מֵאֹיְבִי עָז מִשֹּׂנְאַי כִּי אָמְצוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃

hebrew.text: יַצִּילֵנִי מֵאֹיְבִי עָז מִשֹּׂנְאַי כִּי אָמְצוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃

english.text:
He rescued me from my enemy so strong, From foes too mighty for
me.

translation.text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.

verses.english:
He rescued me from my enemy so strong, From foes too mighty for
me.

verses.hebrew: יְקַדְּמֻנִי בְּיוֹם אֵידִי וַיְהִי יְהֹוָה מִשְׁעָן לִי׃

hebrew.text: יְקַדְּמֻנִי בְּיוֹם אֵידִי וַיְהִי יְהֹוָה מִשְׁעָן לִי׃

english.text: They attacked me on my day of calamity, But YHWH was my stay.

translation.text: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

verses.english: They attacked me on my day of calamity, But YHWH was my stay.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּצֵא לַמֶּרְחָב אֹתִי יְחַלְּצֵנִי כִּי־חָפֵץ בִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּצֵא לַמֶּרְחָב אֹתִי יְחַלְּצֵנִי כִּי־חָפֵץ בִּי׃

english.text:
He brought me out to freedom, He rescued me because He was pleased
with me.

translation.text: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

verses.english:
He brought me out to freedom, He rescued me because He was pleased
with me.

verses.hebrew: יִגְמְלֵנִי יְהֹוָה כְּצִדְקָתִי כְּבֹר יָדַי יָשִׁיב לִי׃

hebrew.text: יִגְמְלֵנִי יְהֹוָה כְּצִדְקָתִי כְּבֹר יָדַי יָשִׁיב לִי׃

english.text:
YHWH rewarded me according to my merit, He requited the cleanness
of my hands.

translation.text: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

verses.english:
YHWH rewarded me according to my merit, He requited the cleanness
of my hands.

verses.hebrew: כִּי שָׁמַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא רָשַׁעְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי שָׁמַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא רָשַׁעְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָי׃

english.text:
For I have kept the ways of YHWH And have not been guilty before
my God;

translation.text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

verses.english:
For I have kept the ways of YHWH And have not been guilty before
my God;

verses.hebrew: כִּי כל־מִשְׁפָּטָו לְנֶגְדִּי וְחֻקֹּתָיו לֹא־אָסוּר מִמֶּנָּה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי כל־מִשְׁפָּטָו לְנֶגְדִּי וְחֻקֹּתָיו לֹא־אָסוּר מִמֶּנָּה׃

english.text: I am mindful of all His rules And have not departed from His laws.

translation.text: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.

verses.english: I am mindful of all His rules And have not departed from His laws.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶהְיֶה תָמִים לוֹ וָאֶשְׁתַּמְּרָה מֵעֲוֺנִי׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶהְיֶה תָמִים לוֹ וָאֶשְׁתַּמְּרָה מֵעֲוֺנִי׃

english.text:
I have been blameless before Him, And have guarded myself against
sinning—

translation.text: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.

verses.english:
I have been blameless before Him, And have guarded myself against
sinning—

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב יְהֹוָה לִי כְּצִדְקָתִי כְּבֹרִי לְנֶגֶד עֵינָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׁב יְהֹוָה לִי כְּצִדְקָתִי כְּבֹרִי לְנֶגֶד עֵינָיו׃

english.text:
And YHWH has requited my merit, According to my purity in His
sight.

translation.text: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.

verses.english:
And YHWH has requited my merit, According to my purity in His
sight.

verses.hebrew: עִם־חָסִיד תִּתְחַסָּד עִם־גִּבּוֹר תָּמִים תִּתַּמָּם׃

hebrew.text: עִם־חָסִיד תִּתְחַסָּד עִם־גִּבּוֹר תָּמִים תִּתַּמָּם׃

english.text:
With the loyal You deal loyally; With the blameless hero,
blamelessly.

translation.text: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.

verses.english:
With the loyal You deal loyally; With the blameless hero,
blamelessly.

verses.hebrew: עִם־נָבָר תִּתָּבָר וְעִם־עִקֵּשׁ תִּתַּפָּל׃

hebrew.text: עִם־נָבָר תִּתָּבָר וְעִם־עִקֵּשׁ תִּתַּפָּל׃

english.text:
With the pure You act in purity, And with the perverse You are
wily.

translation.text: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.

verses.english:
With the pure You act in purity, And with the perverse You are
wily.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־עַם עָנִי תּוֹשִׁיעַ וְעֵינֶיךָ עַל־רָמִים תַּשְׁפִּיל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־עַם עָנִי תּוֹשִׁיעַ וְעֵינֶיךָ עַל־רָמִים תַּשְׁפִּיל׃

english.text:
To humble folk You give victory, And You look with scorn on the
haughty.

translation.text: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.

verses.english:
To humble folk You give victory, And You look with scorn on the
haughty.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה נֵירִי יְהֹוָה וַיהֹוָה יַגִּיהַּ חשְׁכִּי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־אַתָּה נֵירִי יְהֹוָה וַיהֹוָה יַגִּיהַּ חשְׁכִּי׃

english.text: You, O LORD, are my lamp; YHWH lights up my darkness.

translation.text: For thou art my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.

verses.english: You, O LORD, are my lamp; YHWH lights up my darkness.

verses.hebrew: כִּי בְכָה אָרוּץ גְּדוּד בֵּאלֹהַי אֲדַלֶּג־שׁוּר׃

hebrew.text: כִּי בְכָה אָרוּץ גְּדוּד בֵּאלֹהַי אֲדַלֶּג־שׁוּר׃

english.text: With You, I can rush a barrier, With my God, I can scale a wall.

translation.text: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.

verses.english: With You, I can rush a barrier, With my God, I can scale a wall.

verses.hebrew: הָאֵל תָּמִים דַּרְכּוֹ אִמְרַת יְהֹוָה צְרוּפָה מָגֵן הוּא לְכֹל הַחֹסִים בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: הָאֵל תָּמִים דַּרְכּוֹ אִמְרַת יְהֹוָה צְרוּפָה מָגֵן הוּא לְכֹל הַחֹסִים בּוֹ׃

english.text:
The way of God is perfect, The word of YHWH is pure. He is a
shield to all who take refuge in Him.

translation.text: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.

verses.english:
The way of God is perfect, The word of YHWH is pure. He is a
shield to all who take refuge in Him.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מִי־אֵל מִבַּלְעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה וּמִי צוּר מִבַּלְעֲדֵי אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי מִי־אֵל מִבַּלְעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה וּמִי צוּר מִבַּלְעֲדֵי אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text: Yea, who is a god except YHWH, Who is a rock except God?—

translation.text: For who is God, save the LORD? and who is a rock, save our God?

verses.english: Yea, who is a god except YHWH, Who is a rock except God?—

verses.hebrew: הָאֵל מָעוּזִּי חָיִל וַיַּתֵּר תָּמִים (דרכו) [דַּרְכִּי]׃

hebrew.text: הָאֵל מָעוּזִּי חָיִל וַיַּתֵּר תָּמִים (דרכו) [דַּרְכִּי]׃

english.text: The God, my mighty stronghold, Who kept my path secure;

translation.text: God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.

verses.english: The God, my mighty stronghold, Who kept my path secure;

verses.hebrew: מְשַׁוֶּה (רגליו) [רַגְלַי] כָּאַיָּלוֹת וְעַל בָּמֹתַי יַעֲמִדֵנִי׃

hebrew.text: מְשַׁוֶּה (רגליו) [רַגְלַי] כָּאַיָּלוֹת וְעַל בָּמֹתַי יַעֲמִדֵנִי׃

english.text: Who made my legs like a deer’s, And set me firm on the heights;

translation.text: He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet: and setteth me upon my high places.

verses.english: Who made my legs like a deer’s, And set me firm on the heights;

verses.hebrew: מְלַמֵּד יָדַי לַמִּלְחָמָה וְנִחַת קֶשֶׁת־נְחוּשָׁה זְרֹעֹתָי׃

hebrew.text: מְלַמֵּד יָדַי לַמִּלְחָמָה וְנִחַת קֶשֶׁת־נְחוּשָׁה זְרֹעֹתָי׃

english.text:
Who trained my hands for battle, So that my arms can bend a bow of
bronze!

translation.text: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

verses.english:
Who trained my hands for battle, So that my arms can bend a bow of
bronze!

verses.hebrew: וַתִּתֶּן־לִי מָגֵן יִשְׁעֶךָ וַעֲנֹתְךָ תַּרְבֵּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּתֶּן־לִי מָגֵן יִשְׁעֶךָ וַעֲנֹתְךָ תַּרְבֵּנִי׃

english.text:
You have granted me the shield of Your protection And Your
providence has made me great.

translation.text: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.

verses.english:
You have granted me the shield of Your protection And Your
providence has made me great.

verses.hebrew: תַּרְחִיב צַעֲדִי תַּחְתֵּנִי וְלֹא מָעֲדוּ קַרְסֻלָּי׃

hebrew.text: תַּרְחִיב צַעֲדִי תַּחְתֵּנִי וְלֹא מָעֲדוּ קַרְסֻלָּי׃

english.text: You have let me stride on freely, And my feet have not slipped.

translation.text: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.

verses.english: You have let me stride on freely, And my feet have not slipped.

verses.hebrew: אֶרְדְּפָה אֹיְבַי וָאַשְׁמִידֵם וְלֹא אָשׁוּב עַד־כַּלּוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: אֶרְדְּפָה אֹיְבַי וָאַשְׁמִידֵם וְלֹא אָשׁוּב עַד־כַּלּוֹתָם׃

english.text:
I pursued my enemies and wiped them out, I did not turn back till
I destroyed them.

translation.text: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.

verses.english:
I pursued my enemies and wiped them out, I did not turn back till
I destroyed them.

verses.hebrew: וָאֲכַלֵּם וָאֶמְחָצֵם וְלֹא יְקוּמוּן וַיִּפְּלוּ תַּחַת רַגְלָי׃

hebrew.text: וָאֲכַלֵּם וָאֶמְחָצֵם וְלֹא יְקוּמוּן וַיִּפְּלוּ תַּחַת רַגְלָי׃

english.text:
I destroyed them, I struck them down; They rose no more, they lay
at my feet.

translation.text: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.

verses.english:
I destroyed them, I struck them down; They rose no more, they lay
at my feet.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּזְרֵנִי חַיִל לַמִּלְחָמָה תַּכְרִיעַ קָמַי תַּחְתֵּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּזְרֵנִי חַיִל לַמִּלְחָמָה תַּכְרִיעַ קָמַי תַּחְתֵּנִי׃

english.text:
You have girt me with strength for battle, Brought low my foes
before me,

translation.text: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.

verses.english:
You have girt me with strength for battle, Brought low my foes
before me,

verses.hebrew: וְאֹיְבַי תַּתָּה לִּי עֹרֶף מְשַׂנְאַי וָאַצְמִיתֵם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֹיְבַי תַּתָּה לִּי עֹרֶף מְשַׂנְאַי וָאַצְמִיתֵם׃

english.text: Made my enemies turn tail before me, My foes—and I wiped them out.

translation.text: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.

verses.english: Made my enemies turn tail before me, My foes—and I wiped them out.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁעוּ וְאֵין מֹשִׁיעַ אֶל־יְהֹוָה וְלֹא עָנָם׃

hebrew.text: יִשְׁעוּ וְאֵין מֹשִׁיעַ אֶל־יְהֹוָה וְלֹא עָנָם׃

english.text:
They looked, but there was none to deliver; To YHWH, but He
answered them not.

translation.text: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.

verses.english:
They looked, but there was none to deliver; To YHWH, but He
answered them not.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶשְׁחָקֵם כַּעֲפַר־אָרֶץ כְּטִיט־חוּצוֹת אֲדִקֵּם אֶרְקָעֵם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶשְׁחָקֵם כַּעֲפַר־אָרֶץ כְּטִיט־חוּצוֹת אֲדִקֵּם אֶרְקָעֵם׃

english.text:
I pounded them like dust of the earth, Stamped, crushed them like
dirt of the streets.

translation.text: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.

verses.english:
I pounded them like dust of the earth, Stamped, crushed them like
dirt of the streets.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּפַלְּטֵנִי מֵרִיבֵי עַמִּי תִּשְׁמְרֵנִי לְרֹאשׁ גּוֹיִם עַם לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי יַעַבְדֻנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּפַלְּטֵנִי מֵרִיבֵי עַמִּי תִּשְׁמְרֵנִי לְרֹאשׁ גּוֹיִם עַם לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי יַעַבְדֻנִי׃

english.text:
You have rescued me from the strife of peoples, Kept me to be a
ruler of nations; Peoples I knew not must serve me.

translation.text: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.

verses.english:
You have rescued me from the strife of peoples, Kept me to be a
ruler of nations; Peoples I knew not must serve me.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי נֵכָר יִתְכַּחֲשׁוּ־לִי לִשְׁמוֹעַ אֹזֶן יִשָּׁמְעוּ לִי׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי נֵכָר יִתְכַּחֲשׁוּ־לִי לִשְׁמוֹעַ אֹזֶן יִשָּׁמְעוּ לִי׃

english.text:
Aliens have cringed before me, Paid me homage at the mere report
of me.

translation.text: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.

verses.english:
Aliens have cringed before me, Paid me homage at the mere report
of me.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי נֵכָר יִבֹּלוּ וְיַחְגְּרוּ מִמִּסְגְּרוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵי נֵכָר יִבֹּלוּ וְיַחְגְּרוּ מִמִּסְגְּרוֹתָם׃

english.text:
Aliens have lost courage And come trembling out of their
fastnesses.

translation.text: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.

verses.english:
Aliens have lost courage And come trembling out of their
fastnesses.

verses.hebrew: חַי־יְהֹוָה וּבָרוּךְ צוּרִי וְיָרֻם אֱלֹהֵי צוּר יִשְׁעִי׃

hebrew.text: חַי־יְהֹוָה וּבָרוּךְ צוּרִי וְיָרֻם אֱלֹהֵי צוּר יִשְׁעִי׃

english.text:
YHWH lives! Blessed is my rock! Exalted be God, the rock Who gives
me victory;

translation.text: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.

verses.english:
YHWH lives! Blessed is my rock! Exalted be God, the rock Who gives
me victory;

verses.hebrew: הָאֵל הַנֹּתֵן נְקָמֹת לִי וּמֹרִיד עַמִּים תַּחְתֵּנִי׃

hebrew.text: הָאֵל הַנֹּתֵן נְקָמֹת לִי וּמֹרִיד עַמִּים תַּחְתֵּנִי׃

english.text: The God who has vindicated me And made peoples subject to me,

translation.text: It is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me.

verses.english: The God who has vindicated me And made peoples subject to me,

verses.hebrew: וּמוֹצִיאִי מֵאֹיְבָי וּמִקָּמַי תְּרוֹמְמֵנִי מֵאִישׁ חֲמָסִים תַּצִּילֵנִי׃

hebrew.text: וּמוֹצִיאִי מֵאֹיְבָי וּמִקָּמַי תְּרוֹמְמֵנִי מֵאִישׁ חֲמָסִים תַּצִּילֵנִי׃

english.text:
Rescued me from my enemies, Raised me clear of my foes, Saved me
from lawless men!

translation.text: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

verses.english:
Rescued me from my enemies, Raised me clear of my foes, Saved me
from lawless men!

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן אוֹדְךָ יְהֹוָה בַּגּוֹיִם וּלְשִׁמְךָ אֲזַמֵּר׃

hebrew.text: עַל־כֵּן אוֹדְךָ יְהֹוָה בַּגּוֹיִם וּלְשִׁמְךָ אֲזַמֵּר׃

english.text: For this I sing Your praise among the nations And hymn Your name:

translation.text: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.

verses.english: For this I sing Your praise among the nations And hymn Your name:

verses.hebrew: (מגדיל) [מִגְדּוֹל] יְשׁוּעוֹת מַלְכּוֹ וְעֹשֶׂה־חֶסֶד לִמְשִׁיחוֹ לְדָוִד וּלְזַרְעוֹ עַד־עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: (מגדיל) [מִגְדּוֹל] יְשׁוּעוֹת מַלְכּוֹ וְעֹשֶׂה־חֶסֶד לִמְשִׁיחוֹ לְדָוִד וּלְזַרְעוֹ עַד־עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
Tower of victory to His king, Who deals graciously with His
anointed, With David and his offspring evermore.

translation.text: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.

verses.english:
Tower of victory to His king, Who deals graciously with His
anointed, With David and his offspring evermore.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה דִּבְרֵי דָוִד הָאַחֲרֹנִים נְאֻם דָּוִד בֶּן־יִשַׁי וּנְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר הֻקַם עָל מְשִׁיחַ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב וּנְעִים זְמִרוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה דִּבְרֵי דָוִד הָאַחֲרֹנִים נְאֻם דָּוִד בֶּן־יִשַׁי וּנְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר הֻקַם עָל מְשִׁיחַ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב וּנְעִים זְמִרוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
These are the last words of David: The utterance of David son of
Jesse, The utterance of the man set on high, The anointed of the
God of Jacob, The favorite of the songs of Israel:

translation.text: Now these be the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,

verses.english:
These are the last words of David: The utterance of David son of
Jesse, The utterance of the man set on high, The anointed of the
God of Jacob, The favorite of the songs of Israel:

verses.hebrew: רוּחַ יְהֹוָה דִּבֶּר־בִּי וּמִלָּתוֹ עַל־לְשׁוֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: רוּחַ יְהֹוָה דִּבֶּר־בִּי וּמִלָּתוֹ עַל־לְשׁוֹנִי׃

english.text:
The spirit of YHWH has spoken through me, His message is on my
tongue;

translation.text: The Spirit of the LORD spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.

verses.english:
The spirit of YHWH has spoken through me, His message is on my
tongue;

verses.hebrew: אָמַר אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִי דִבֶּר צוּר יִשְׂרָאֵל מוֹשֵׁל בָּאָדָם צַדִּיק מוֹשֵׁל יִרְאַת אֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: אָמַר אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִי דִבֶּר צוּר יִשְׂרָאֵל מוֹשֵׁל בָּאָדָם צַדִּיק מוֹשֵׁל יִרְאַת אֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
The God of Israel has spoken, The Rock of Israel said concerning
me: “He who rules men justly, He who rules in awe of God

translation.text: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear of God.

verses.english:
The God of Israel has spoken, The Rock of Israel said concerning
me: “He who rules men justly, He who rules in awe of God

verses.hebrew: וּכְאוֹר בֹּקֶר יִזְרַח־שָׁמֶשׁ בֹּקֶר לֹא עָבוֹת מִנֹּגַהּ מִמָּטָר דֶּשֶׁא מֵאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וּכְאוֹר בֹּקֶר יִזְרַח־שָׁמֶשׁ בֹּקֶר לֹא עָבוֹת מִנֹּגַהּ מִמָּטָר דֶּשֶׁא מֵאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Is like the light of morning at sunrise, A morning without clouds—
Through sunshine and rain [Bringing] vegetation out of the earth.”

translation.text: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.

verses.english:
Is like the light of morning at sunrise, A morning without clouds—
Through sunshine and rain [Bringing] vegetation out of the earth.”

verses.hebrew: כִּי־לֹא־כֵן בֵּיתִי עִם־אֵל כִּי בְרִית עוֹלָם שָׂם לִי עֲרוּכָה בַכֹּל וּשְׁמֻרָה כִּי־כל־יִשְׁעִי וְכל־חֵפֶץ כִּי־לֹא יַצְמִיחַ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־לֹא־כֵן בֵּיתִי עִם־אֵל כִּי בְרִית עוֹלָם שָׂם לִי עֲרוּכָה בַכֹּל וּשְׁמֻרָה כִּי־כל־יִשְׁעִי וְכל־חֵפֶץ כִּי־לֹא יַצְמִיחַ׃

english.text:
Is not my House established before God? For He has granted me an
eternal pact, Drawn up in full and secured. Will He not cause all
my success And [my] every desire to blossom?

translation.text: Although my house be not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.

verses.english:
Is not my House established before God? For He has granted me an
eternal pact, Drawn up in full and secured. Will He not cause all
my success And [my] every desire to blossom?

verses.hebrew: וּבְלִיַּעַל כְּקוֹץ מֻנָד כֻּלָּהַם כִּי־לֹא בְיָד יִקָּחוּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְלִיַּעַל כְּקוֹץ מֻנָד כֻּלָּהַם כִּי־לֹא בְיָד יִקָּחוּ׃

english.text:
But the wicked shall all Be raked aside like thorns; For no one
will take them in his hand.

translation.text: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:

verses.english:
But the wicked shall all Be raked aside like thorns; For no one
will take them in his hand.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ יִגַּע בָּהֶם יִמָּלֵא בַרְזֶל וְעֵץ חֲנִית וּבָאֵשׁ שָׂרוֹף יִשָּׂרְפוּ בַּשָּׁבֶת׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ יִגַּע בָּהֶם יִמָּלֵא בַרְזֶל וְעֵץ חֲנִית וּבָאֵשׁ שָׂרוֹף יִשָּׂרְפוּ בַּשָּׁבֶת׃

english.text:
Whoever touches them Must arm himself with iron And the shaft of a
spear; And they must be burned up on the spot.

translation.text: But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.

verses.english:
Whoever touches them Must arm himself with iron And the shaft of a
spear; And they must be burned up on the spot.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הַגִּבֹּרִים אֲשֶׁר לְדָוִד יֹשֵׁב בַּשֶּׁבֶת תַּחְכְּמֹנִי רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁלִשִׁי הוּא עֲדִינוֹ (העצנו) [הָעֶצְנִי] עַל־שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת חָלָל בְּפַעַם (אחד) [אֶחָת]׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הַגִּבֹּרִים אֲשֶׁר לְדָוִד יֹשֵׁב בַּשֶּׁבֶת תַּחְכְּמֹנִי רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁלִשִׁי הוּא עֲדִינוֹ (העצנו) [הָעֶצְנִי] עַל־שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת חָלָל בְּפַעַם (אחד) [אֶחָת]׃

english.text:
These are the names of David’s warriors: Josheb-basshebeth, a
Tahchemonite, the chief officer—he is Adino the Eznite; [he
wielded his spear] against eight hundred and slew them on one
occasion.

translation.text: These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.

verses.english:
These are the names of David’s warriors: Josheb-basshebeth, a
Tahchemonite, the chief officer—he is Adino the Eznite; [he
wielded his spear] against eight hundred and slew them on one
occasion.

verses.hebrew:
וְאַחֲרָו אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־[דֹּדוֹ] (דדי) בֶּן־אֲחֹחִי בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה (גברים) [הַגִּבֹּרִים] עִם־דָּוִד בְּחָרְפָם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֶסְפוּ־שָׁם לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיַּעֲלוּ אִישׁ
יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וְאַחֲרָו אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־[דֹּדוֹ] (דדי) בֶּן־אֲחֹחִי בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה (גברים) [הַגִּבֹּרִים] עִם־דָּוִד בְּחָרְפָם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֶסְפוּ־שָׁם לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיַּעֲלוּ אִישׁ
יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Next to him was Eleazar son of Dodo son of Ahohi. He was one of
the three warriors with David when they defied the Philistines
gathered there for battle. The Israelite soldiers retreated,

translation.text: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:

verses.english:
Next to him was Eleazar son of Dodo son of Ahohi. He was one of
the three warriors with David when they defied the Philistines
gathered there for battle. The Israelite soldiers retreated,

verses.hebrew:
הוּא קָם וַיַּךְ בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים עַד כִּי־יָגְעָה יָדוֹ וַתִּדְבַּק יָדוֹ אֶל־הַחֶרֶב וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה תְּשׁוּעָה גְדוֹלָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְהָעָם יָשֻׁבוּ אַחֲרָיו
אַךְ־לְפַשֵּׁט׃

hebrew.text:
הוּא קָם וַיַּךְ בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים עַד כִּי־יָגְעָה יָדוֹ וַתִּדְבַּק יָדוֹ אֶל־הַחֶרֶב וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה תְּשׁוּעָה גְדוֹלָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְהָעָם יָשֻׁבוּ אַחֲרָיו
אַךְ־לְפַשֵּׁט׃

english.text:
but he held his ground. He struck down Philistines until his arm
grew tired and his hand stuck to his sword; and YHWH wrought a
great victory that day. Then the troops came back to him—but only
to strip [the slain].

translation.text: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.

verses.english:
but he held his ground. He struck down Philistines until his arm
grew tired and his hand stuck to his sword; and YHWH wrought a
great victory that day. Then the troops came back to him—but only
to strip [the slain].

verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרָיו שַׁמָּה בֶן־אָגֵא הָרָרִי וַיֵּאָסְפוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לַחַיָּה וַתְּהִי־שָׁם חֶלְקַת הַשָּׂדֶה מְלֵאָה עֲדָשִׁים וְהָעָם נָס מִפְּנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחֲרָיו שַׁמָּה בֶן־אָגֵא הָרָרִי וַיֵּאָסְפוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לַחַיָּה וַתְּהִי־שָׁם חֶלְקַת הַשָּׂדֶה מְלֵאָה עֲדָשִׁים וְהָעָם נָס מִפְּנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
Next to him was Shammah son of Age the Ararite. The Philistines
had gathered in force where there was a plot of ground full of
lentils; and the troops fled from the Philistines.

translation.text: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.

verses.english:
Next to him was Shammah son of Age the Ararite. The Philistines
had gathered in force where there was a plot of ground full of
lentils; and the troops fled from the Philistines.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְיַצֵּב בְּתוֹךְ־הַחֶלְקָה וַיַּצִּילֶהָ וַיַּךְ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה תְּשׁוּעָה גְדוֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְיַצֵּב בְּתוֹךְ־הַחֶלְקָה וַיַּצִּילֶהָ וַיַּךְ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה תְּשׁוּעָה גְדוֹלָה׃

english.text:
But [Shammah] took his stand in the middle of the plot and
defended it, and he routed the Philistines. Thus YHWH wrought a
great victory.

translation.text: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the LORD wrought a great victory.

verses.english:
But [Shammah] took his stand in the middle of the plot and
defended it, and he routed the Philistines. Thus YHWH wrought a
great victory.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרְדוּ (שלשים) [שְׁלֹשָׁה] מֵהַשְּׁלֹשִׁים רֹאשׁ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־קָצִיר אֶל־דָּוִד אֶל־מְעָרַת עֲדֻלָּם וְחַיַּת פְּלִשְׁתִּים חֹנָה בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרְדוּ (שלשים) [שְׁלֹשָׁה] מֵהַשְּׁלֹשִׁים רֹאשׁ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־קָצִיר אֶל־דָּוִד אֶל־מְעָרַת עֲדֻלָּם וְחַיַּת פְּלִשְׁתִּים חֹנָה בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים׃

english.text:
Once, during the harvest, three of the thirty chiefs went down to
David at the cave of Adullam, while a force of Philistines was
encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.

translation.text: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.english:
Once, during the harvest, three of the thirty chiefs went down to
David at the cave of Adullam, while a force of Philistines was
encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד אָז בַּמְּצוּדָה וּמַצַּב פְּלִשְׁתִּים אָז בֵּית לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְדָוִד אָז בַּמְּצוּדָה וּמַצַּב פְּלִשְׁתִּים אָז בֵּית לָחֶם׃

english.text:
David was then in the stronghold, and a Philistine garrison was
then at Bethlehem.

translation.text: And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.

verses.english:
David was then in the stronghold, and a Philistine garrison was
then at Bethlehem.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְאַוֶּה דָוִד וַיֹּאמַר מִי יַשְׁקֵנִי מַיִם מִבֹּאר בֵּית־לֶחֶם אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׁעַר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְאַוֶּה דָוִד וַיֹּאמַר מִי יַשְׁקֵנִי מַיִם מִבֹּאר בֵּית־לֶחֶם אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׁעַר׃

english.text:
David felt a craving and said, “If only I could get a drink of
water from the cistern which is by the gate of Bethlehem!”

translation.text: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!

verses.english:
David felt a craving and said, “If only I could get a drink of
water from the cistern which is by the gate of Bethlehem!”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּבְקְעוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַגִּבֹּרִים בְּמַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּשְׁאֲבוּ־מַיִם מִבֹּאר בֵּית־לֶחֶם אֲשֶׁר בַּשַּׁעַר וַיִּשְׂאוּ וַיָּבִאוּ אֶל־דָּוִד וְלֹא אָבָה לִשְׁתּוֹתָם
וַיַּסֵּךְ אֹתָם לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּבְקְעוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַגִּבֹּרִים בְּמַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּשְׁאֲבוּ־מַיִם מִבֹּאר בֵּית־לֶחֶם אֲשֶׁר בַּשַּׁעַר וַיִּשְׂאוּ וַיָּבִאוּ אֶל־דָּוִד וְלֹא אָבָה לִשְׁתּוֹתָם
וַיַּסֵּךְ אֹתָם לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
So the three warriors got through the Philistine camp and drew
water from the cistern which is by the gate of Bethlehem, and they
carried it back. But when they brought it to David he would not
drink it, and he poured it out as a libation to YHWH.

translation.text: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD.

verses.english:
So the three warriors got through the Philistine camp and drew
water from the cistern which is by the gate of Bethlehem, and they
carried it back. But when they brought it to David he would not
drink it, and he poured it out as a libation to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חָלִילָה לִּי יְהֹוָה מֵעֲשֹׂתִי זֹאת הֲדַם הָאֲנָשִׁים הַהֹלְכִים בְּנַפְשׁוֹתָם וְלֹא אָבָה לִשְׁתּוֹתָם אֵלֶּה עָשׂוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַגִּבֹּרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר חָלִילָה לִּי יְהֹוָה מֵעֲשֹׂתִי זֹאת הֲדַם הָאֲנָשִׁים הַהֹלְכִים בְּנַפְשׁוֹתָם וְלֹא אָבָה לִשְׁתּוֹתָם אֵלֶּה עָשׂוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַגִּבֹּרִים׃

english.text:
For he said, “YHWH forbid that I should do this! Can [I drink] the
blood of the men who went at the risk of their lives?” So he would
not drink it. Such were the exploits of the three warriors.

translation.text: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.

verses.english:
For he said, “YHWH forbid that I should do this! Can [I drink] the
blood of the men who went at the risk of their lives?” So he would
not drink it. Such were the exploits of the three warriors.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲבִישַׁי אֲחִי יוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה הוּא רֹאשׁ (השלשי) [הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה] וְהוּא עוֹרֵר אֶת־חֲנִיתוֹ עַל־שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת חָלָל וְלוֹ־שֵׁם בַּשְּׁלֹשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲבִישַׁי אֲחִי יוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה הוּא רֹאשׁ (השלשי) [הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה] וְהוּא עוֹרֵר אֶת־חֲנִיתוֹ עַל־שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת חָלָל וְלוֹ־שֵׁם בַּשְּׁלֹשָׁה׃

english.text:
Abishai, the brother of Joab son of Zeruiah, was head of another
three. He once wielded his spear against three hundred and slew
them.

translation.text: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them, and had the name among three.

verses.english:
Abishai, the brother of Joab son of Zeruiah, was head of another
three. He once wielded his spear against three hundred and slew
them.

verses.hebrew: מִן־הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה הֲכִי נִכְבָּד וַיְהִי לָהֶם לְשָׂר וְעַד־הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה לֹא־בָא׃

hebrew.text: מִן־הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה הֲכִי נִכְבָּד וַיְהִי לָהֶם לְשָׂר וְעַד־הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה לֹא־בָא׃

english.text:
He won a name among the three; since he was the most highly
regarded among the three, he became their leader. However, he did
not attain to the three.

translation.text: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.

verses.english:
He won a name among the three; since he was the most highly
regarded among the three, he became their leader. However, he did
not attain to the three.

verses.hebrew:
וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע בֶּן־אִישׁ־[חַיִל] (חי) רַב־פְּעָלִים מִקַּבְצְאֵל הוּא הִכָּה אֵת שְׁנֵי אֲרִאֵל מוֹאָב וְהוּא יָרַד וְהִכָּה אֶת־[הָאֲרִי] (האריה) בְּתוֹךְ הַבֹּאר
בְּיוֹם הַשָּׁלֶג׃

hebrew.text:
וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע בֶּן־אִישׁ־[חַיִל] (חי) רַב־פְּעָלִים מִקַּבְצְאֵל הוּא הִכָּה אֵת שְׁנֵי אֲרִאֵל מוֹאָב וְהוּא יָרַד וְהִכָּה אֶת־[הָאֲרִי] (האריה) בְּתוֹךְ הַבֹּאר
בְּיוֹם הַשָּׁלֶג׃

english.text:
Benaiah son of Jehoiada, from Kabzeel, was a brave soldier who
performed great deeds. He killed the two [sons] of Ariel of Moab.
Once, on a snowy day, he went down into a pit and killed a lion.

translation.text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:

verses.english:
Benaiah son of Jehoiada, from Kabzeel, was a brave soldier who
performed great deeds. He killed the two [sons] of Ariel of Moab.
Once, on a snowy day, he went down into a pit and killed a lion.

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא־הִכָּה אֶת־אִישׁ מִצְרִי (אשר) [אִישׁ] מַרְאֶה וּבְיַד הַמִּצְרִי חֲנִית וַיֵּרֶד אֵלָיו בַּשָּׁבֶט וַיִּגְזֹל אֶת־הַחֲנִית מִיַּד הַמִּצְרִי וַיַּהַרְגֵהוּ בַּחֲנִיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהוּא־הִכָּה אֶת־אִישׁ מִצְרִי (אשר) [אִישׁ] מַרְאֶה וּבְיַד הַמִּצְרִי חֲנִית וַיֵּרֶד אֵלָיו בַּשָּׁבֶט וַיִּגְזֹל אֶת־הַחֲנִית מִיַּד הַמִּצְרִי וַיַּהַרְגֵהוּ בַּחֲנִיתוֹ׃

english.text:
He also killed an Egyptian, a huge man. The Egyptian had a spear
in his hand, yet [Benaiah] went down against him with a club,
wrenched the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with
his own spear.

translation.text: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.

verses.english:
He also killed an Egyptian, a huge man. The Egyptian had a spear
in his hand, yet [Benaiah] went down against him with a club,
wrenched the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with
his own spear.

hebrew.text: וַיֹּסֶף אַף־יְהֹוָה לַחֲרוֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּסֶת אֶת־דָּוִד בָּהֶם לֵאמֹר לֵךְ מְנֵה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The anger of YHWH again flared up against Israel; and He incited
David against them, saying, “Go and number Israel and Judah.”

translation.text: And again the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.

verses.english:
The anger of YHWH again flared up against Israel; and He incited
David against them, saying, “Go and number Israel and Judah.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־יוֹאָב שַׂר־הַחַיִל אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ שׁוּט־נָא בְּכל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע וּפִקְדוּ אֶת־הָעָם וְיָדַעְתִּי אֵת מִסְפַּר הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־יוֹאָב שַׂר־הַחַיִל אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ שׁוּט־נָא בְּכל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע וּפִקְדוּ אֶת־הָעָם וְיָדַעְתִּי אֵת מִסְפַּר הָעָם׃

english.text:
The king said to Joab, his army commander, “Make the rounds of all
the tribes of Israel, from Dan to Beer-sheba, and take a census of
the people, so that I may know the size of the population.”

translation.text: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which was with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people.

verses.english:
The king said to Joab, his army commander, “Make the rounds of all
the tribes of Israel, from Dan to Beer-sheba, and take a census of
the people, so that I may know the size of the population.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיוֹסֵף יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶל־הָעָם כָּהֵם וְכָהֵם מֵאָה פְעָמִים וְעֵינֵי אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ רֹאוֹת וַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה חָפֵץ בַּדָּבָר
הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיוֹסֵף יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶל־הָעָם כָּהֵם וְכָהֵם מֵאָה פְעָמִים וְעֵינֵי אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ רֹאוֹת וַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה חָפֵץ בַּדָּבָר
הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Joab answered the king, “May YHWH your God increase the number of
the people a hundredfold, while your own eyes see it! But why
should my lord king want this?”

translation.text: And Joab said unto the king, Now the LORD thy God add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?

verses.english:
Joab answered the king, “May YHWH your God increase the number of
the people a hundredfold, while your own eyes see it! But why
should my lord king want this?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחֱזַק דְּבַר־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־יוֹאָב וְעַל שָׂרֵי הֶחָיִל וַיֵּצֵא יוֹאָב וְשָׂרֵי הַחַיִל לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לִפְקֹד אֶת־הָעָם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּחֱזַק דְּבַר־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־יוֹאָב וְעַל שָׂרֵי הֶחָיִל וַיֵּצֵא יוֹאָב וְשָׂרֵי הַחַיִל לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לִפְקֹד אֶת־הָעָם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
However, the king’s command to Joab and to the officers of the
army remained firm; and Joab and the officers of the army set out,
at the instance of the king, to take a census of the people of
Israel.

translation.text: Notwithstanding the king’s word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.

verses.english:
However, the king’s command to Joab and to the officers of the
army remained firm; and Joab and the officers of the army set out,
at the instance of the king, to take a census of the people of
Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיַּחֲנוּ בַעֲרוֹעֵר יְמִין הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹךְ־הַנַּחַל הַגָּד וְאֶל־יַעְזֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיַּחֲנוּ בַעֲרוֹעֵר יְמִין הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹךְ־הַנַּחַל הַגָּד וְאֶל־יַעְזֵר׃

english.text:
They crossed the Jordan and encamped at Aroer, on the right side
of the town, which is in the middle of the wadi of Gad, and [went
on] to Jazer.

translation.text: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:

verses.english:
They crossed the Jordan and encamped at Aroer, on the right side
of the town, which is in the middle of the wadi of Gad, and [went
on] to Jazer.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַגִּלְעָדָה וְאֶל־אֶרֶץ תַּחְתִּים חדְשִׁי וַיָּבֹאוּ דָּנָה יַּעַן וְסָבִיב אֶל־צִידוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַגִּלְעָדָה וְאֶל־אֶרֶץ תַּחְתִּים חדְשִׁי וַיָּבֹאוּ דָּנָה יַּעַן וְסָבִיב אֶל־צִידוֹן׃

english.text:
They continued to Gilead and to the region of Tahtim-hodshi, and
they came to Dan-jaan and around to Sidon.

translation.text: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtimhodshi; and they came to Danjaan, and about to Zidon,

verses.english:
They continued to Gilead and to the region of Tahtim-hodshi, and
they came to Dan-jaan and around to Sidon.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ מִבְצַר־צֹר וְכל־עָרֵי הַחִוִּי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי וַיֵּצְאוּ אֶל־נֶגֶב יְהוּדָה בְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ מִבְצַר־צֹר וְכל־עָרֵי הַחִוִּי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי וַיֵּצְאוּ אֶל־נֶגֶב יְהוּדָה בְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃

english.text:
They went onto the fortress of Tyre and all the towns of the
Hivites and Canaanites, and finished at Beer-sheba in southern
Judah.

translation.text: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Judah, even to Beersheba.

verses.english:
They went onto the fortress of Tyre and all the towns of the
Hivites and Canaanites, and finished at Beer-sheba in southern
Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁטוּ בְּכל־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּבֹאוּ מִקְצֵה תִשְׁעָה חֳדָשִׁים וְעֶשְׂרִים יוֹם יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֻׁטוּ בְּכל־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּבֹאוּ מִקְצֵה תִשְׁעָה חֳדָשִׁים וְעֶשְׂרִים יוֹם יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
They traversed the whole country, and then they came back to
Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

translation.text: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

verses.english:
They traversed the whole country, and then they came back to
Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יוֹאָב אֶת־מִסְפַּר מִפְקַד־הָעָם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתְּהִי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף אִישׁ־חַיִל שֹׁלֵף חֶרֶב וְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה חֲמֵשׁ־מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן יוֹאָב אֶת־מִסְפַּר מִפְקַד־הָעָם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתְּהִי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף אִישׁ־חַיִל שֹׁלֵף חֶרֶב וְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה חֲמֵשׁ־מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

english.text:
Joab reported to the king the number of the people that had been
recorded: in Israel there were 800,000 soldiers ready to draw the
sword, and the men of Judah numbered 500,000.

translation.text: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

verses.english:
Joab reported to the king the number of the people that had been
recorded: in Israel there were 800,000 soldiers ready to draw the
sword, and the men of Judah numbered 500,000.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּךְ לֵב־דָּוִד אֹתוֹ אַחֲרֵי־כֵן סָפַר אֶת־הָעָםוַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יְהֹוָה חָטָאתִי מְאֹד אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַעֲבֶר־נָא אֶת־עֲוֺן עַבְדְּךָ כִּי נִסְכַּלְתִּי
מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּךְ לֵב־דָּוִד אֹתוֹ אַחֲרֵי־כֵן סָפַר אֶת־הָעָםוַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יְהֹוָה חָטָאתִי מְאֹד אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַעֲבֶר־נָא אֶת־עֲוֺן עַבְדְּךָ כִּי נִסְכַּלְתִּי
מְאֹד׃

english.text:
But afterward David reproached himself for having numbered the
people. And David said to YHWH, “I have sinned grievously in what
I have done. Please, O LORD, remit the guilt of Your servant, for
I have acted foolishly.”

translation.text: And David’s heart smote him after that he had numbered the people.

verses.english:
But afterward David reproached himself for having numbered the
people. And David said to YHWH, “I have sinned grievously in what
I have done. Please, O LORD, remit the guilt of Your servant, for
I have acted foolishly.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם דָּוִד בַּבֹּקֶרוּדְבַר־יְהֹוָה הָיָה אֶל־גָּד הַנָּבִיא חֹזֵה דָוִד לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם דָּוִד בַּבֹּקֶרוּדְבַר־יְהֹוָה הָיָה אֶל־גָּד הַנָּבִיא חֹזֵה דָוִד לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
When David rose in the morning, the word of YHWH had come to the
prophet Gad, David’s seer:

translation.text: For when David was up in the morning, the word of the LORD came unto the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,

verses.english:
When David rose in the morning, the word of YHWH had come to the
prophet Gad, David’s seer:

verses.hebrew: הָלוֹךְ וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֶל־דָּוִד כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה שָׁלֹשׁ אָנֹכִי נוֹטֵל עָלֶיךָ בְּחַר־לְךָ אַחַת־מֵהֶם וְאֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: הָלוֹךְ וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֶל־דָּוִד כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה שָׁלֹשׁ אָנֹכִי נוֹטֵל עָלֶיךָ בְּחַר־לְךָ אַחַת־מֵהֶם וְאֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ׃

english.text:
“Go and tell David, ‘Thus said YHWH: I hold three things over you;
choose one of them, and I will bring it upon you.’”

translation.text: Go and say unto David, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three things; choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

verses.english:
“Go and tell David, ‘Thus said YHWH: I hold three things over you;
choose one of them, and I will bring it upon you.’”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא־גָד אֶל־דָּוִד וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הֲתָבוֹא לְךָ שֶׁבַע־שָׁנִים רָעָב בְּאַרְצֶךָ אִם־שְׁלֹשָׁה חֳדָשִׁים נֻסְךָ לִפְנֵי־צָרֶיךָ וְהוּא רֹדְפֶךָ וְאִם־הֱיוֹת
שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים דֶּבֶר בְּאַרְצֶךָ עַתָּה דַּע וּרְאֵה מָה־אָשִׁיב שֹׁלְחִי דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא־גָד אֶל־דָּוִד וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הֲתָבוֹא לְךָ שֶׁבַע־שָׁנִים רָעָב בְּאַרְצֶךָ אִם־שְׁלֹשָׁה חֳדָשִׁים נֻסְךָ לִפְנֵי־צָרֶיךָ וְהוּא רֹדְפֶךָ וְאִם־הֱיוֹת
שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים דֶּבֶר בְּאַרְצֶךָ עַתָּה דַּע וּרְאֵה מָה־אָשִׁיב שֹׁלְחִי דָּבָר׃

english.text:
Gad came to David and told him; he asked, “Shall a seven-year
famine come upon you in the land, or shall you be in flight from
your adversaries for three months while they pursue you, or shall
there be three days of pestilence in your land? Now consider
carefully what reply I shall take back to Him who sent me.”

translation.text: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days’ pestilence in thy land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.

verses.english:
Gad came to David and told him; he asked, “Shall a seven-year
famine come upon you in the land, or shall you be in flight from
your adversaries for three months while they pursue you, or shall
there be three days of pestilence in your land? Now consider
carefully what reply I shall take back to Him who sent me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־גָּד צַר־לִי מְאֹד נִפְּלָה־נָּא בְיַד־יְהֹוָה כִּי־רַבִּים רַחֲמָו וּבְיַד־אָדָם אַל־אֶפֹּלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־גָּד צַר־לִי מְאֹד נִפְּלָה־נָּא בְיַד־יְהֹוָה כִּי־רַבִּים רַחֲמָו וּבְיַד־אָדָם אַל־אֶפֹּלָה׃

english.text:
David said to Gad, “I am in great distress. Let us fall into the
hands of YHWH, for His compassion is great; and let me not fall
into the hands of men.”

translation.text: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of the LORD; for his mercies are great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.

verses.english:
David said to Gad, “I am in great distress. Let us fall into the
hands of YHWH, for His compassion is great; and let me not fall
into the hands of men.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה דֶּבֶר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל מֵהַבֹּקֶר וְעַד־עֵת מוֹעֵד וַיָּמת מִן־הָעָם מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע שִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה דֶּבֶר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל מֵהַבֹּקֶר וְעַד־עֵת מוֹעֵד וַיָּמת מִן־הָעָם מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע שִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃

english.text:
YHWH sent a pestilence upon Israel from morning until the set
time; and 70,000 of the people died, from Dan to Beer-sheba.

translation.text: So the LORD sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba seventy thousand men.

verses.english:
YHWH sent a pestilence upon Israel from morning until the set
time; and 70,000 of the people died, from Dan to Beer-sheba.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ הַמַּלְאָךְ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לְשַׁחֲתָהּ וַיִּנָּחֶם יְהֹוָה אֶל־הָרָעָה וַיֹּאמֶר לַמַּלְאָךְ הַמַּשְׁחִית בָּעָם רַב עַתָּה הֶרֶף יָדֶךָ וּמַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הָיָה
עִם־גֹּרֶן (האורנה) [הָאֲרַוְנָה] הַיְבֻסִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ הַמַּלְאָךְ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לְשַׁחֲתָהּ וַיִּנָּחֶם יְהֹוָה אֶל־הָרָעָה וַיֹּאמֶר לַמַּלְאָךְ הַמַּשְׁחִית בָּעָם רַב עַתָּה הֶרֶף יָדֶךָ וּמַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה הָיָה
עִם־גֹּרֶן (האורנה) [הָאֲרַוְנָה] הַיְבֻסִי׃

english.text:
But when the angel extended his hand against Jerusalem to destroy
it, YHWH renounced further punishment and said to the angel who
was destroying the people, “Enough! Stay your hand!” The angel of
YHWH was then by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

translation.text: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.

verses.english:
But when the angel extended his hand against Jerusalem to destroy
it, YHWH renounced further punishment and said to the angel who
was destroying the people, “Enough! Stay your hand!” The angel of
YHWH was then by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יְהֹוָה בִּרְאֹתוֹ אֶת־הַמַּלְאָךְ הַמַּכֶּה בָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי חָטָאתִי וְאָנֹכִי הֶעֱוֵיתִי וְאֵלֶּה הַצֹּאן מֶה עָשׂוּ תְּהִי נָא יָדְךָ בִּי
וּבְבֵית אָבִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יְהֹוָה בִּרְאֹתוֹ אֶת־הַמַּלְאָךְ הַמַּכֶּה בָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי חָטָאתִי וְאָנֹכִי הֶעֱוֵיתִי וְאֵלֶּה הַצֹּאן מֶה עָשׂוּ תְּהִי נָא יָדְךָ בִּי
וּבְבֵית אָבִי׃

english.text:
When David saw the angel who was striking down the people, he said
to YHWH, “I alone am guilty, I alone have done wrong; but these
poor sheep, what have they done? Let Your hand fall upon me and my
father’s house!”

translation.text: And David spake unto the LORD when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father’s house.

verses.english:
When David saw the angel who was striking down the people, he said
to YHWH, “I alone am guilty, I alone have done wrong; but these
poor sheep, what have they done? Let Your hand fall upon me and my
father’s house!”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא־גָד אֶל־דָּוִד בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ עֲלֵה הָקֵם לַיהֹוָה מִזְבֵּחַ בְּגֹרֶן (ארניה) [אֲרַוְנָה] הַיְבֻסִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא־גָד אֶל־דָּוִד בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ עֲלֵה הָקֵם לַיהֹוָה מִזְבֵּחַ בְּגֹרֶן (ארניה) [אֲרַוְנָה] הַיְבֻסִי׃

english.text:
Gad came to David the same day and said to him, “Go and set up an
altar to YHWH on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.”

translation.text: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.

verses.english:
Gad came to David the same day and said to him, “Go and set up an
altar to YHWH on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל דָּוִד כִּדְבַר־גָּד כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל דָּוִד כִּדְבַר־גָּד כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
David went up, following Gad’s instructions, as YHWH had
commanded.

translation.text: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the LORD commanded.

verses.english:
David went up, following Gad’s instructions, as YHWH had
commanded.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁקֵף אֲרַוְנָה וַיַּרְא אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־עֲבָדָיו עֹבְרִים עָלָיו וַיֵּצֵא אֲרַוְנָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ אַפָּיו אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁקֵף אֲרַוְנָה וַיַּרְא אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־עֲבָדָיו עֹבְרִים עָלָיו וַיֵּצֵא אֲרַוְנָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ אַפָּיו אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
Araunah looked out and saw the king and his courtiers approaching
him. So Araunah went out and bowed low to the king, with his face
to the ground.

translation.text: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.

verses.english:
Araunah looked out and saw the king and his courtiers approaching
him. So Araunah went out and bowed low to the king, with his face
to the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲרַוְנָה מַדּוּעַ בָּא אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־עַבְדּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לִקְנוֹת מֵעִמְּךָ אֶת־הַגֹּרֶן לִבְנוֹת מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה וְתֵעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה מֵעַל הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲרַוְנָה מַדּוּעַ בָּא אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־עַבְדּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לִקְנוֹת מֵעִמְּךָ אֶת־הַגֹּרֶן לִבְנוֹת מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה וְתֵעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה מֵעַל הָעָם׃

english.text:
And Araunah asked, “Why has my lord the king come to his servant?”
David replied, “To buy the threshing floor from you, that I may
build an altar to YHWH and that the plague against the people may
be checked.”

translation.text: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar unto the LORD, that the plague may be stayed from the people.

verses.english:
And Araunah asked, “Why has my lord the king come to his servant?”
David replied, “To buy the threshing floor from you, that I may
build an altar to YHWH and that the plague against the people may
be checked.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲרַוְנָה אֶל־דָּוִד יִקַּח וְיַעַל אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינָו רְאֵה הַבָּקָר לָעֹלָה וְהַמֹּרִגִּים וּכְלֵי הַבָּקָר לָעֵצִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲרַוְנָה אֶל־דָּוִד יִקַּח וְיַעַל אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינָו רְאֵה הַבָּקָר לָעֹלָה וְהַמֹּרִגִּים וּכְלֵי הַבָּקָר לָעֵצִים׃

english.text:
And Araunah said to David, “Let my lord the king take it and offer
up whatever he sees fit. Here are oxen for a burnt offering, and
the threshing boards and the gear of the oxen for wood.

translation.text: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him: behold, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.

verses.english:
And Araunah said to David, “Let my lord the king take it and offer
up whatever he sees fit. Here are oxen for a burnt offering, and
the threshing boards and the gear of the oxen for wood.

verses.hebrew: הַכֹּל נָתַן אֲרַוְנָה הַמֶּלֶךְ לַמֶּלֶךְוַיֹּאמֶר אֲרַוְנָה אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ יִרְצֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: הַכֹּל נָתַן אֲרַוְנָה הַמֶּלֶךְ לַמֶּלֶךְוַיֹּאמֶר אֲרַוְנָה אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ יִרְצֶךָ׃

english.text:
All this, O king, Araunah gives to Your Majesty. And may YHWH your
God,” Araunah added, “respond to you with favor!”

translation.text: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, The LORD thy God accept thee.

verses.english:
All this, O king, Araunah gives to Your Majesty. And may YHWH your
God,” Araunah added, “respond to you with favor!”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אֲרַוְנָה לֹא כִּי־קָנוֹ אֶקְנֶה מֵאוֹתְךָ בִּמְחִיר וְלֹא אַעֲלֶה לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהַי עֹלוֹת חִנָּם וַיִּקֶן דָּוִד אֶת־הַגֹּרֶן וְאֶת־הַבָּקָר בְּכֶסֶף
שְׁקָלִים חֲמִשִּׁים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אֲרַוְנָה לֹא כִּי־קָנוֹ אֶקְנֶה מֵאוֹתְךָ בִּמְחִיר וְלֹא אַעֲלֶה לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהַי עֹלוֹת חִנָּם וַיִּקֶן דָּוִד אֶת־הַגֹּרֶן וְאֶת־הַבָּקָר בְּכֶסֶף
שְׁקָלִים חֲמִשִּׁים׃

english.text:
But the king replied to Araunah, “No, I will buy them from you at
a price. I cannot sacrifice to YHWH my God burnt offerings that
have cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the
oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

translation.text: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

verses.english:
But the king replied to Araunah, “No, I will buy them from you at
a price. I cannot sacrifice to YHWH my God burnt offerings that
have cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the
oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן שָׁם דָּוִד מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה וַיַּעַל עֹלוֹת וּשְׁלָמִים וַיֵּעָתֵר יְהֹוָה לָאָרֶץ וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה מֵעַל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן שָׁם דָּוִד מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהֹוָה וַיַּעַל עֹלוֹת וּשְׁלָמִים וַיֵּעָתֵר יְהֹוָה לָאָרֶץ וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה מֵעַל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And David built there an altar to YHWH and sacrificed burnt
offerings and offerings of well-being. YHWH responded to the plea
for the land, and the plague against Israel was checked.

translation.text: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.

verses.english:
And David built there an altar to YHWH and sacrificed burnt
offerings and offerings of well-being. YHWH responded to the plea
for the land, and the plague against Israel was checked.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים וַיְכַסֻּהוּ בַּבְּגָדִים וְלֹא יִחַם לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים וַיְכַסֻּהוּ בַּבְּגָדִים וְלֹא יִחַם לוֹ׃

english.text:
King David was now old, advanced in years; and though they covered
him with bedclothes, he never felt warm.

translation.text: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.

verses.english:
King David was now old, advanced in years; and though they covered
him with bedclothes, he never felt warm.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ עֲבָדָיו יְבַקְשׁוּ לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ נַעֲרָה בְתוּלָה וְעָמְדָה לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּתְהִי־לוֹ סֹכֶנֶת וְשָׁכְבָה בְחֵיקֶךָ וְחַם לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ עֲבָדָיו יְבַקְשׁוּ לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ נַעֲרָה בְתוּלָה וְעָמְדָה לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּתְהִי־לוֹ סֹכֶנֶת וְשָׁכְבָה בְחֵיקֶךָ וְחַם לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
His courtiers said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my
lord the king, to wait upon Your Majesty and be his attendant; and
let her lie in your bosom, and my lord the king will be warm.”

translation.text: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.

verses.english:
His courtiers said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my
lord the king, to wait upon Your Majesty and be his attendant; and
let her lie in your bosom, and my lord the king will be warm.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְבַקְשׁוּ נַעֲרָה יָפָה בְּכֹל גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְצְאוּ אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשּׁוּנַמִּית וַיָּבִאוּ אֹתָהּ לַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבַקְשׁוּ נַעֲרָה יָפָה בְּכֹל גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְצְאוּ אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשּׁוּנַמִּית וַיָּבִאוּ אֹתָהּ לַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
So they looked for a beautiful girl throughout the territory of
Israel. They found Abishag the Shunammite and brought her to the
king.

translation.text: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

verses.english:
So they looked for a beautiful girl throughout the territory of
Israel. They found Abishag the Shunammite and brought her to the
king.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנַּעֲרָה יָפָה עַד־מְאֹד וַתְּהִי לַמֶּלֶךְ סֹכֶנֶת וַתְּשָׁרְתֵהוּ וְהַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא יְדָעָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנַּעֲרָה יָפָה עַד־מְאֹד וַתְּהִי לַמֶּלֶךְ סֹכֶנֶת וַתְּשָׁרְתֵהוּ וְהַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא יְדָעָהּ׃

english.text:
The girl was exceedingly beautiful. She became the king’s
attendant and waited upon him; but the king was not intimate with
her.

translation.text: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.

verses.english:
The girl was exceedingly beautiful. She became the king’s
attendant and waited upon him; but the king was not intimate with
her.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲדֹנִיָּה בֶן־חַגִּית מִתְנַשֵּׂא לֵאמֹר אֲנִי אֶמְלֹךְ וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ רֶכֶב וּפָרָשִׁים וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ רָצִים לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲדֹנִיָּה בֶן־חַגִּית מִתְנַשֵּׂא לֵאמֹר אֲנִי אֶמְלֹךְ וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ רֶכֶב וּפָרָשִׁים וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ רָצִים לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
Now Adonijah son of Haggith went about boasting, “I will be king!”
He provided himself with chariots and horses, and an escort of
fifty outrunners.

translation.text: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

verses.english:
Now Adonijah son of Haggith went about boasting, “I will be king!”
He provided himself with chariots and horses, and an escort of
fifty outrunners.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־עֲצָבוֹ אָבִיו מִיָּמָיו לֵאמֹר מַדּוּעַ כָּכָה עָשִׂיתָ וְגַם־הוּא טוֹב־תֹּאַר מְאֹד וְאֹתוֹ יָלְדָה אַחֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־עֲצָבוֹ אָבִיו מִיָּמָיו לֵאמֹר מַדּוּעַ כָּכָה עָשִׂיתָ וְגַם־הוּא טוֹב־תֹּאַר מְאֹד וְאֹתוֹ יָלְדָה אַחֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
His father had never scolded him: “Why did you do that?” He was
the one born after Absalom and, like him, was very handsome.

translation.text: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.

verses.english:
His father had never scolded him: “Why did you do that?” He was
the one born after Absalom and, like him, was very handsome.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ דְבָרָיו עִם יוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה וְעִם אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן וַיַּעְזְרוּ אַחֲרֵי אֲדֹנִיָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ דְבָרָיו עִם יוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה וְעִם אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן וַיַּעְזְרוּ אַחֲרֵי אֲדֹנִיָּה׃

english.text:
He conferred with Joab son of Zeruiah and with the priest
Abiathar, and they supported Adonijah;

translation.text: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.

verses.english:
He conferred with Joab son of Zeruiah and with the priest
Abiathar, and they supported Adonijah;

verses.hebrew: וְצָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא וְשִׁמְעִי וְרֵעִי וְהַגִּבּוֹרִים אֲשֶׁר לְדָוִד לֹא הָיוּ עִם־אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְצָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא וְשִׁמְעִי וְרֵעִי וְהַגִּבּוֹרִים אֲשֶׁר לְדָוִד לֹא הָיוּ עִם־אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
but the priest Zadok, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the prophet Nathan,
Shimei and Rei, and David’s own fighting men did not side with
Adonijah.

translation.text: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

verses.english:
but the priest Zadok, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the prophet Nathan,
Shimei and Rei, and David’s own fighting men did not side with
Adonijah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְבַּח אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ צֹאן וּבָקָר וּמְרִיא עִם אֶבֶן הַזֹּחֶלֶת אֲשֶׁר־אֵצֶל עֵין רֹגֵל וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־כּל־אֶחָיו בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְכל־אַנְשֵׁי יְהוּדָה עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזְבַּח אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ צֹאן וּבָקָר וּמְרִיא עִם אֶבֶן הַזֹּחֶלֶת אֲשֶׁר־אֵצֶל עֵין רֹגֵל וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־כּל־אֶחָיו בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְכל־אַנְשֵׁי יְהוּדָה עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Adonijah made a sacrificial feast of sheep, oxen, and fatlings at
the Zoheleth stone which is near En-rogel; he invited all his
brother princes and all the king’s courtiers of the tribe of
Judah;

translation.text: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by Enrogel, and called all his brethren the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah the king’s servants:

verses.english:
Adonijah made a sacrificial feast of sheep, oxen, and fatlings at
the Zoheleth stone which is near En-rogel; he invited all his
brother princes and all the king’s courtiers of the tribe of
Judah;

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וּבְנָיָהוּ וְאֶת־הַגִּבּוֹרִים וְאֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה אָחִיו לֹא קָרָא׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וּבְנָיָהוּ וְאֶת־הַגִּבּוֹרִים וְאֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה אָחִיו לֹא קָרָא׃

english.text:
but he did not invite the prophet Nathan, or Benaiah, or the
fighting men, or his brother Solomon.

translation.text: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.

verses.english:
but he did not invite the prophet Nathan, or Benaiah, or the
fighting men, or his brother Solomon.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֶל־בַּת־שֶׁבַע אֵם־שְׁלֹמֹה לֵאמֹר הֲלוֹא שָׁמַעַתְּ כִּי מָלַךְ אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ בֶן־חַגִּית וַאֲדֹנֵינוּ דָוִד לֹא יָדָע׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֶל־בַּת־שֶׁבַע אֵם־שְׁלֹמֹה לֵאמֹר הֲלוֹא שָׁמַעַתְּ כִּי מָלַךְ אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ בֶן־חַגִּית וַאֲדֹנֵינוּ דָוִד לֹא יָדָע׃

english.text:
Then Nathan said to Bathsheba, Solomon’s mother, “You must have
heard that Adonijah son of Haggith has assumed the kingship
without the knowledge of our lord David.

translation.text: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?

verses.english:
Then Nathan said to Bathsheba, Solomon’s mother, “You must have
heard that Adonijah son of Haggith has assumed the kingship
without the knowledge of our lord David.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לְכִי אִיעָצֵךְ נָא עֵצָה וּמַלְּטִי אֶת־נַפְשֵׁךְ וְאֶת־נֶפֶשׁ בְּנֵךְ שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה לְכִי אִיעָצֵךְ נָא עֵצָה וּמַלְּטִי אֶת־נַפְשֵׁךְ וְאֶת־נֶפֶשׁ בְּנֵךְ שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
Now take my advice, so that you may save your life and the life of
your son Solomon.

translation.text: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.

verses.english:
Now take my advice, so that you may save your life and the life of
your son Solomon.

verses.hebrew:
לְכִי וּבֹאִי אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וְאָמַרְתְּ אֵלָיו הֲלֹא־אַתָּה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לַאֲמָתְךָ לֵאמֹר כִּי־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנֵךְ יִמְלֹךְ אַחֲרַי וְהוּא יֵשֵׁב
עַל־כִּסְאִי וּמַדּוּעַ מָלַךְ אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text:
לְכִי וּבֹאִי אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וְאָמַרְתְּ אֵלָיו הֲלֹא־אַתָּה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לַאֲמָתְךָ לֵאמֹר כִּי־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנֵךְ יִמְלֹךְ אַחֲרַי וְהוּא יֵשֵׁב
עַל־כִּסְאִי וּמַדּוּעַ מָלַךְ אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
Go immediately to King David and say to him, ‘Did not you, O lord
king, swear to your maidservant: “Your son Solomon shall succeed
me as king, and he shall sit upon my throne”? Then why has
Adonijah become king?’

translation.text: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?

verses.english:
Go immediately to King David and say to him, ‘Did not you, O lord
king, swear to your maidservant: “Your son Solomon shall succeed
me as king, and he shall sit upon my throne”? Then why has
Adonijah become king?’

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה עוֹדָךְ מְדַבֶּרֶת שָׁם עִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאֲנִי אָבוֹא אַחֲרַיִךְ וּמִלֵּאתִי אֶת־דְּבָרָיִךְ׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה עוֹדָךְ מְדַבֶּרֶת שָׁם עִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאֲנִי אָבוֹא אַחֲרַיִךְ וּמִלֵּאתִי אֶת־דְּבָרָיִךְ׃

english.text:
While you are still there talking with the king, I will come in
after you and confirm your words.”

translation.text: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.

verses.english:
While you are still there talking with the king, I will come in
after you and confirm your words.”

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא בַת־שֶׁבַע אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הַחַדְרָה וְהַמֶּלֶךְ זָקֵן מְאֹד וַאֲבִישַׁג הַשּׁוּנַמִּית מְשָׁרַת אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּבֹא בַת־שֶׁבַע אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הַחַדְרָה וְהַמֶּלֶךְ זָקֵן מְאֹד וַאֲבִישַׁג הַשּׁוּנַמִּית מְשָׁרַת אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
So Bathsheba went to the king in his chamber.—The king was very
old, and Abishag the Shunammite was waiting on the king.—

translation.text: And Bathsheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.

verses.english:
So Bathsheba went to the king in his chamber.—The king was very
old, and Abishag the Shunammite was waiting on the king.—

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקֹּד בַּת־שֶׁבַע וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ מַה־לָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקֹּד בַּת־שֶׁבַע וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ מַה־לָּךְ׃

english.text:
Bathsheba bowed low in homage to the king; and the king asked,
“What troubles you?”

translation.text: And Bathsheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?

verses.english:
Bathsheba bowed low in homage to the king; and the king asked,
“What troubles you?”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֲדֹנִי אַתָּה נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַאֲמָתֶךָ כִּי־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנֵךְ יִמְלֹךְ אַחֲרָי וְהוּא יֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֲדֹנִי אַתָּה נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַאֲמָתֶךָ כִּי־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנֵךְ יִמְלֹךְ אַחֲרָי וְהוּא יֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאִי׃

english.text:
She answered him, “My lord, you yourself swore to your maidservant
by YHWH your God: ‘Your son Solomon shall succeed me as king, and
he shall sit upon my throne.’

translation.text: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the LORD thy God unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.

verses.english:
She answered him, “My lord, you yourself swore to your maidservant
by YHWH your God: ‘Your son Solomon shall succeed me as king, and
he shall sit upon my throne.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה אֲדֹנִיָּה מָלָךְ וְעַתָּה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא יָדָעְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה אֲדֹנִיָּה מָלָךְ וְעַתָּה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא יָדָעְתָּ׃

english.text:
Yet now Adonijah has become king, and you, my lord the king, know
nothing about it.

translation.text: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest it not:

verses.english:
Yet now Adonijah has become king, and you, my lord the king, know
nothing about it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְבַּח שׁוֹר וּמְרִיא־וְצֹאן לָרֹבוַיִּקְרָא לְכל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן וּלְיֹאָב שַׂר הַצָּבָא וְלִשְׁלֹמֹה עַבְדְּךָ לֹא קָרָא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּזְבַּח שׁוֹר וּמְרִיא־וְצֹאן לָרֹבוַיִּקְרָא לְכל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן וּלְיֹאָב שַׂר הַצָּבָא וְלִשְׁלֹמֹה עַבְדְּךָ לֹא קָרָא׃

english.text:
He has prepared a sacrificial feast of a great many oxen,
fatlings, and sheep, and he has invited all the king’s sons and
Abiathar the priest and Joab commander of the army; but he has not
invited your servant Solomon.

translation.text: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.

verses.english:
He has prepared a sacrificial feast of a great many oxen,
fatlings, and sheep, and he has invited all the king’s sons and
Abiathar the priest and Joab commander of the army; but he has not
invited your servant Solomon.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ עֵינֵי כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עָלֶיךָ לְהַגִּיד לָהֶם מִי יֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ עֵינֵי כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עָלֶיךָ לְהַגִּיד לָהֶם מִי יֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
And so the eyes of all Israel are upon you, O lord king, to tell
them who shall succeed my lord the king on the throne.

translation.text: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

verses.english:
And so the eyes of all Israel are upon you, O lord king, to tell
them who shall succeed my lord the king on the throne.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּשְׁכַב אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וְהָיִיתִי אֲנִי וּבְנִי שְׁלֹמֹה חַטָּאִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה כִּשְׁכַב אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וְהָיִיתִי אֲנִי וּבְנִי שְׁלֹמֹה חַטָּאִים׃

english.text:
Otherwise, when my lord the king lies down with his fathers, my
son Solomon and I will be regarded as traitors.”

translation.text: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.

verses.english:
Otherwise, when my lord the king lies down with his fathers, my
son Solomon and I will be regarded as traitors.”

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה עוֹדֶנָּה מְדַבֶּרֶת עִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא בָּא׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה עוֹדֶנָּה מְדַבֶּרֶת עִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא בָּא׃

english.text: She was still talking to the king when the prophet Nathan arrived.

translation.text: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.

verses.english: She was still talking to the king when the prophet Nathan arrived.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּידוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וַיָּבֹא לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־אַפָּיו אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגִּידוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וַיָּבֹא לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־אַפָּיו אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
They announced to the king, “The prophet Nathan is here,” and he
entered the king’s presence. Bowing low to the king with his face
to the ground,

translation.text: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

verses.english:
They announced to the king, “The prophet Nathan is here,” and he
entered the king’s presence. Bowing low to the king with his face
to the ground,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אַתָּה אָמַרְתָּ אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ יִמְלֹךְ אַחֲרָי וְהוּא יֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אַתָּה אָמַרְתָּ אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ יִמְלֹךְ אַחֲרָי וְהוּא יֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאִי׃

english.text:
Nathan said, “O lord king, you must have said, ‘Adonijah shall
succeed me as king and he shall sit upon my throne.’

translation.text: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?

verses.english:
Nathan said, “O lord king, you must have said, ‘Adonijah shall
succeed me as king and he shall sit upon my throne.’

verses.hebrew:
כִּי יָרַד הַיּוֹם וַיִּזְבַּח שׁוֹר וּמְרִיא־וְצֹאן לָרֹב וַיִּקְרָא לְכל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְשָׂרֵי הַצָּבָא וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנָּם אֹכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים לְפָנָיו
וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text:
כִּי יָרַד הַיּוֹם וַיִּזְבַּח שׁוֹר וּמְרִיא־וְצֹאן לָרֹב וַיִּקְרָא לְכל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְשָׂרֵי הַצָּבָא וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנָּם אֹכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים לְפָנָיו
וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
For he has gone down today and prepared a sacrificial feast of a
great many oxen, fatlings, and sheep. He invited all the king’s
sons and the army officers and Abiathar the priest. At this very
moment they are eating and drinking with him, and they are
shouting, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’

translation.text: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king’s sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.

verses.english:
For he has gone down today and prepared a sacrificial feast of a
great many oxen, fatlings, and sheep. He invited all the king’s
sons and the army officers and Abiathar the priest. At this very
moment they are eating and drinking with him, and they are
shouting, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’

verses.hebrew: וְלִי אֲנִי־עַבְדֶּךָ וּלְצָדֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְלִבְנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְלִשְׁלֹמֹה עַבְדְּךָ לֹא קָרָא׃

hebrew.text: וְלִי אֲנִי־עַבְדֶּךָ וּלְצָדֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְלִבְנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְלִשְׁלֹמֹה עַבְדְּךָ לֹא קָרָא׃

english.text:
But he did not invite me your servant, or the priest Zadok, or
Benaiah son of Jehoiada, or your servant Solomon.
