translation.text: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.

verses.english:
But he did not invite me your servant, or the priest Zadok, or
Benaiah son of Jehoiada, or your servant Solomon.

verses.hebrew: אִם מֵאֵת אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ נִהְיָה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְלֹא הוֹדַעְתָּ אֶת־[עַבְדְּךָ] (עבדיך) מִי יֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: אִם מֵאֵת אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ נִהְיָה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְלֹא הוֹדַעְתָּ אֶת־[עַבְדְּךָ] (עבדיך) מִי יֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
Can this decision have come from my lord the king, without your
telling your servant who is to succeed to the throne of my lord
the king?”

translation.text: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?

verses.english:
Can this decision have come from my lord the king, without your
telling your servant who is to succeed to the throne of my lord
the king?”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר קִרְאוּ־לִי לְבַת־שָׁבַע וַתָּבֹא לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתַּעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר קִרְאוּ־לִי לְבַת־שָׁבַע וַתָּבֹא לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתַּעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
King David’s response was: “Summon Bathsheba!” She entered the
king’s presence and stood before the king.

translation.text: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bathsheba. And she came into the king’s presence, and stood before the king.

verses.english:
King David’s response was: “Summon Bathsheba!” She entered the
king’s presence and stood before the king.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׁבַע הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמַר חַי־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־פָּדָה אֶת־נַפְשִׁי מִכּל־צָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׁבַע הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמַר חַי־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־פָּדָה אֶת־נַפְשִׁי מִכּל־צָרָה׃

english.text:
And the king took an oath, saying, “As YHWH lives, who has rescued
me from every trouble:

translation.text: And the king sware, and said, As the LORD liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,

verses.english:
And the king took an oath, saying, “As YHWH lives, who has rescued
me from every trouble:

verses.hebrew: כִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לָךְ בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר כִּי־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנֵךְ יִמְלֹךְ אַחֲרַי וְהוּא יֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאִי תַּחְתָּי כִּי כֵּן אֶעֱשֶׂה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לָךְ בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר כִּי־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנֵךְ יִמְלֹךְ אַחֲרַי וְהוּא יֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאִי תַּחְתָּי כִּי כֵּן אֶעֱשֶׂה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The oath I swore to you by YHWH, the God of Israel, that your son
Solomon should succeed me as king and that he should sit upon my
throne in my stead, I will fulfill this very day!”

translation.text: Even as I sware unto thee by the LORD God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.

verses.english:
The oath I swore to you by YHWH, the God of Israel, that your son
Solomon should succeed me as king and that he should sit upon my
throne in my stead, I will fulfill this very day!”

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקֹּד בַּת־שֶׁבַע אַפַּיִם אֶרֶץ וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ וַתֹּאמֶר יְחִי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד לְעֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקֹּד בַּת־שֶׁבַע אַפַּיִם אֶרֶץ וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ וַתֹּאמֶר יְחִי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד לְעֹלָם׃

english.text:
Bathsheba bowed low in homage to the king with her face to the
ground, and she said, “May my lord King David live forever!”

translation.text: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.

verses.english:
Bathsheba bowed low in homage to the king with her face to the
ground, and she said, “May my lord King David live forever!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד קִרְאוּ־לִי לְצָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וּלְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא וְלִבְנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיָּבֹאוּ לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד קִרְאוּ־לִי לְצָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וּלְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא וְלִבְנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיָּבֹאוּ לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Then King David said, “Summon to me the priest Zadok, the prophet
Nathan, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada.” When they came before the
king,

translation.text: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.

verses.english:
Then King David said, “Summon to me the priest Zadok, the prophet
Nathan, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada.” When they came before the
king,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לָהֶם קְחוּ עִמָּכֶם אֶת־עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנֵיכֶם וְהִרְכַּבְתֶּם אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנִי עַל־הַפִּרְדָּה אֲשֶׁר־לִי וְהוֹרַדְתֶּם אֹתוֹ אֶל־גִּחוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לָהֶם קְחוּ עִמָּכֶם אֶת־עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנֵיכֶם וְהִרְכַּבְתֶּם אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנִי עַל־הַפִּרְדָּה אֲשֶׁר־לִי וְהוֹרַדְתֶּם אֹתוֹ אֶל־גִּחוֹן׃

english.text:
the king said to them, “Take my loyal soldiers, and have my son
Solomon ride on my mule and bring him down to Gihon.

translation.text: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:

verses.english:
the king said to them, “Take my loyal soldiers, and have my son
Solomon ride on my mule and bring him down to Gihon.

verses.hebrew: וּמָשַׁח אֹתוֹ שָׁם צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְקַעְתֶּם בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַאֲמַרְתֶּם יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: וּמָשַׁח אֹתוֹ שָׁם צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְקַעְתֶּם בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַאֲמַרְתֶּם יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
Let the priest Zadok and the prophet Nathan anoint him there king
over Israel, whereupon you shall sound the horn and shout, ‘Long
live King Solomon!’

translation.text: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.

verses.english:
Let the priest Zadok and the prophet Nathan anoint him there king
over Israel, whereupon you shall sound the horn and shout, ‘Long
live King Solomon!’

verses.hebrew: וַעֲלִיתֶם אַחֲרָיו וּבָא וְיָשַׁב עַל־כִּסְאִי וְהוּא יִמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּי וְאֹתוֹ צִוִּיתִי לִהְיוֹת נָגִיד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל־יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲלִיתֶם אַחֲרָיו וּבָא וְיָשַׁב עַל־כִּסְאִי וְהוּא יִמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּי וְאֹתוֹ צִוִּיתִי לִהְיוֹת נָגִיד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל־יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
Then march up after him, and let him come in and sit on my throne.
For he shall succeed me as king; him I designate to be ruler of
Israel and Judah.”

translation.text: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.

verses.english:
Then march up after him, and let him come in and sit on my throne.
For he shall succeed me as king; him I designate to be ruler of
Israel and Judah.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אָמֵן כֵּן יֹאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אָמֵן כֵּן יֹאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Benaiah son of Jehoiada spoke up and said to the king, “Amen! And
may YHWH, the God of my lord the king, so ordain.

translation.text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so too.

verses.english:
Benaiah son of Jehoiada spoke up and said to the king, “Amen! And
may YHWH, the God of my lord the king, so ordain.

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה יְהֹוָה עִם־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כֵּן (יהי) [יִהְיֶה] עִם־שְׁלֹמֹה וִיגַדֵּל אֶת־כִּסְאוֹ מִכִּסֵּא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה יְהֹוָה עִם־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כֵּן (יהי) [יִהְיֶה] עִם־שְׁלֹמֹה וִיגַדֵּל אֶת־כִּסְאוֹ מִכִּסֵּא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד׃

english.text:
As YHWH was with my lord the king, so may He be with Solomon; and
may He exalt his throne even higher than the throne of my lord
King David.”

translation.text: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.

verses.english:
As YHWH was with my lord the king, so may He be with Solomon; and
may He exalt his throne even higher than the throne of my lord
King David.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּרֶד צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה עַל־פִּרְדַּת הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֹּלִכוּ אֹתוֹ
עַל־גִּחוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּרֶד צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה עַל־פִּרְדַּת הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֹּלִכוּ אֹתוֹ
עַל־גִּחוֹן׃

english.text:
Then the priest Zadok, and the prophet Nathan, and Benaiah son of
Jehoiada went down with the Cherethites and the Pelethites. They
had Solomon ride on King David’s mule and they led him to Gihon.

translation.text: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.

verses.english:
Then the priest Zadok, and the prophet Nathan, and Benaiah son of
Jehoiada went down with the Cherethites and the Pelethites. They
had Solomon ride on King David’s mule and they led him to Gihon.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־קֶרֶן הַשֶּׁמֶן מִן־הָאֹהֶל וַיִּמְשַׁח אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּתְקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיֹּאמְרוּ כּל־הָעָם יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־קֶרֶן הַשֶּׁמֶן מִן־הָאֹהֶל וַיִּמְשַׁח אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּתְקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיֹּאמְרוּ כּל־הָעָם יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
The priest Zadok took the horn of oil from the Tent and anointed
Solomon. They sounded the horn and all the people shouted, “Long
live King Solomon!”

translation.text: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.

verses.english:
The priest Zadok took the horn of oil from the Tent and anointed
Solomon. They sounded the horn and all the people shouted, “Long
live King Solomon!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ כל־הָעָם אַחֲרָיו וְהָעָם מְחַלְּלִים בַּחֲלִלִים וּשְׂמֵחִים שִׂמְחָה גְדוֹלָה וַתִּבָּקַע הָאָרֶץ בְּקוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ כל־הָעָם אַחֲרָיו וְהָעָם מְחַלְּלִים בַּחֲלִלִים וּשְׂמֵחִים שִׂמְחָה גְדוֹלָה וַתִּבָּקַע הָאָרֶץ בְּקוֹלָם׃

english.text:
All the people then marched up behind him, playing on flutes and
making merry till the earth was split open by the uproar.

translation.text: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.

verses.english:
All the people then marched up behind him, playing on flutes and
making merry till the earth was split open by the uproar.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וְכל־הַקְּרֻאִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וְהֵם כִּלּוּ לֶאֱכֹל וַיִּשְׁמַע יוֹאָב אֶת־קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר וַיֹּאמֶר מַדּוּעַ קוֹל־הַקִּרְיָה הוֹמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וְכל־הַקְּרֻאִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וְהֵם כִּלּוּ לֶאֱכֹל וַיִּשְׁמַע יוֹאָב אֶת־קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר וַיֹּאמֶר מַדּוּעַ קוֹל־הַקִּרְיָה הוֹמָה׃

english.text:
Adonijah and all the guests who were with him, who had just
finished eating, heard it. When Joab heard the sound of the horn,
he said, “Why is the city in such an uproar?”

translation.text: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?

verses.english:
Adonijah and all the guests who were with him, who had just
finished eating, heard it. When Joab heard the sound of the horn,
he said, “Why is the city in such an uproar?”

verses.hebrew: עוֹדֶנּוּ מְדַבֵּר וְהִנֵּה יוֹנָתָן בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן בָּא וַיֹּאמֶר אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ בֹּא כִּי אִישׁ חַיִל אַתָּה וְטוֹב תְּבַשֵּׂר׃

hebrew.text: עוֹדֶנּוּ מְדַבֵּר וְהִנֵּה יוֹנָתָן בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן בָּא וַיֹּאמֶר אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ בֹּא כִּי אִישׁ חַיִל אַתָּה וְטוֹב תְּבַשֵּׂר׃

english.text:
He was still speaking when the priest Jonathan son of Abiathar
arrived. “Come in,” said Adonijah. “You are a worthy man, and you
surely bring good news.”

translation.text: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.

verses.english:
He was still speaking when the priest Jonathan son of Abiathar
arrived. “Come in,” said Adonijah. “You are a worthy man, and you
surely bring good news.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יוֹנָתָן וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ אֲבָל אֲדֹנֵינוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ־דָּוִד הִמְלִיךְ אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן יוֹנָתָן וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ אֲבָל אֲדֹנֵינוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ־דָּוִד הִמְלִיךְ אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
But Jonathan replied to Adonijah, “Alas, our lord King David has
made Solomon king!

translation.text: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.

verses.english:
But Jonathan replied to Adonijah, “Alas, our lord King David has
made Solomon king!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אִתּוֹ־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת־נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֹתוֹ עַל פִּרְדַּת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אִתּוֹ־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת־נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֹתוֹ עַל פִּרְדַּת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The king sent with him the priest Zadok and the prophet Nathan and
Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and Pelethites. They
had him ride on the king’s mule,

translation.text: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king’s mule:

verses.english:
The king sent with him the priest Zadok and the prophet Nathan and
Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and Pelethites. They
had him ride on the king’s mule,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ אֹתוֹ צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא לְמֶלֶךְ בְּגִחוֹן וַיַּעֲלוּ מִשָּׁם שְׂמֵחִים וַתֵּהֹם הַקִּרְיָה הוּא הַקּוֹל אֲשֶׁר שְׁמַעְתֶּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ אֹתוֹ צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא לְמֶלֶךְ בְּגִחוֹן וַיַּעֲלוּ מִשָּׁם שְׂמֵחִים וַתֵּהֹם הַקִּרְיָה הוּא הַקּוֹל אֲשֶׁר שְׁמַעְתֶּם׃

english.text:
and the priest Zadok and the prophet Nathan anointed him king at
Gihon. Then they came up from there making merry, and the city
went into an uproar. That’s the noise you heard.

translation.text: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.

verses.english:
and the priest Zadok and the prophet Nathan anointed him king at
Gihon. Then they came up from there making merry, and the city
went into an uproar. That’s the noise you heard.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם יָשַׁב שְׁלֹמֹה עַל כִּסֵּא הַמְּלוּכָה׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם יָשַׁב שְׁלֹמֹה עַל כִּסֵּא הַמְּלוּכָה׃

english.text: Further, Solomon seated himself on the royal throne;

translation.text: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.

verses.english: Further, Solomon seated himself on the royal throne;

verses.hebrew:
וְגַם־בָּאוּ עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־אֲדֹנֵינוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד לֵאמֹר יֵיטֵב (אלהיך) [אֱלֹהִים] אֶת־שֵׁם שְׁלֹמֹה מִשְּׁמֶךָ וִיגַדֵּל אֶת־כִּסְאוֹ מִכִּסְאֶךָ
וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּב׃

hebrew.text:
וְגַם־בָּאוּ עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־אֲדֹנֵינוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד לֵאמֹר יֵיטֵב (אלהיך) [אֱלֹהִים] אֶת־שֵׁם שְׁלֹמֹה מִשְּׁמֶךָ וִיגַדֵּל אֶת־כִּסְאוֹ מִכִּסְאֶךָ
וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּב׃

english.text:
further, the king’s courtiers came to congratulate our lord King
David, saying, ‘May God make the renown of Solomon even greater
than yours, and may He exalt his throne even higher than yours!’
And the king bowed low on his couch.

translation.text: And moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.

verses.english:
further, the king’s courtiers came to congratulate our lord King
David, saying, ‘May God make the renown of Solomon even greater
than yours, and may He exalt his throne even higher than yours!’
And the king bowed low on his couch.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם־כָּכָה אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר נָתַן הַיּוֹם יֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאִי וְעֵינַי רֹאוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם־כָּכָה אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר נָתַן הַיּוֹם יֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאִי וְעֵינַי רֹאוֹת׃

english.text:
And further, this is what the king said, ‘Praised be YHWH, the God
of Israel who has this day provided a successor to my throne,
while my own eyes can see it.’”

translation.text: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.

verses.english:
And further, this is what the king said, ‘Praised be YHWH, the God
of Israel who has this day provided a successor to my throne,
while my own eyes can see it.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחֶרְדוּ וַיָּקֻמוּ כּל־הַקְּרֻאִים אֲשֶׁר לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ אִישׁ לְדַרְכּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּחֶרְדוּ וַיָּקֻמוּ כּל־הַקְּרֻאִים אֲשֶׁר לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ אִישׁ לְדַרְכּוֹ׃

english.text:
Thereupon, all of Adonijah’s guests rose in alarm and each went
his own way.

translation.text: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.

verses.english:
Thereupon, all of Adonijah’s guests rose in alarm and each went
his own way.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ יָרֵא מִפְּנֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּחֲזֵק בְּקַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ יָרֵא מִפְּנֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּחֲזֵק בְּקַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
Adonijah, in fear of Solomon, went at once [to the Tent] and
grasped the horns of the altar.

translation.text: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

verses.english:
Adonijah, in fear of Solomon, went at once [to the Tent] and
grasped the horns of the altar.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֻּגַּד לִשְׁלֹמֹה לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ יָרֵא אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וְהִנֵּה אָחַז בְּקַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֵאמֹר יִשָּׁבַע־לִי כַיּוֹם הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה אִם־יָמִית
אֶת־עַבְדּוֹ בֶּחָרֶב׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֻּגַּד לִשְׁלֹמֹה לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ יָרֵא אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וְהִנֵּה אָחַז בְּקַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֵאמֹר יִשָּׁבַע־לִי כַיּוֹם הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה אִם־יָמִית
אֶת־עַבְדּוֹ בֶּחָרֶב׃

english.text:
It was reported to Solomon: “Adonijah is in fear of King Solomon
and has grasped the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon
first swear to me that he will not put his servant to the sword.’”

translation.text: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me today that he will not slay his servant with the sword.

verses.english:
It was reported to Solomon: “Adonijah is in fear of King Solomon
and has grasped the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon
first swear to me that he will not put his servant to the sword.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁלֹמֹה אִם יִהְיֶה לְבֶן־חַיִל לֹא־יִפֹּל מִשַּׂעֲרָתוֹ אָרְצָה וְאִם־רָעָה תִמָּצֵא־בוֹ וָמֵת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁלֹמֹה אִם יִהְיֶה לְבֶן־חַיִל לֹא־יִפֹּל מִשַּׂעֲרָתוֹ אָרְצָה וְאִם־רָעָה תִמָּצֵא־בוֹ וָמֵת׃

english.text:
Solomon said, “If he behaves worthily, not a hair of his head
shall fall to the ground; but if he is caught in any offense, he
shall die.”

translation.text: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.

verses.english:
Solomon said, “If he behaves worthily, not a hair of his head
shall fall to the ground; but if he is caught in any offense, he
shall die.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיּוֹרִדֻהוּ מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיָּבֹא וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ שְׁלֹמֹה לֵךְ לְבֵיתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיּוֹרִדֻהוּ מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיָּבֹא וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ שְׁלֹמֹה לֵךְ לְבֵיתֶךָ׃

english.text:
So King Solomon sent and had him taken down from the altar. He
came and bowed before King Solomon, and Solomon said to him, “Go
home.”

translation.text: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.

verses.english:
So King Solomon sent and had him taken down from the altar. He
came and bowed before King Solomon, and Solomon said to him, “Go
home.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְבוּ יְמֵי־דָוִד לָמוּת וַיְצַו אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְבוּ יְמֵי־דָוִד לָמוּת וַיְצַו אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
When David’s life was drawing to a close, he instructed his son
Solomon as follows:

translation.text: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,

verses.english:
When David’s life was drawing to a close, he instructed his son
Solomon as follows:

verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי הֹלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ כּל־הָאָרֶץ וְחָזַקְתָּ וְהָיִיתָ לְאִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: אָנֹכִי הֹלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ כּל־הָאָרֶץ וְחָזַקְתָּ וְהָיִיתָ לְאִישׁ׃

english.text:
“I am going the way of all the earth; be strong and show yourself
a man.

translation.text: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;

verses.english:
“I am going the way of all the earth; be strong and show yourself
a man.

verses.hebrew:
וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָלֶכֶת בִּדְרָכָיו לִשְׁמֹר חֻקֹּתָיו מִצְוֺתָיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וְעֵדְוֺתָיו כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה לְמַעַן תַּשְׂכִּיל אֵת
כּל־אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה וְאֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר תִּפְנֶה שָׁם׃

hebrew.text:
וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָלֶכֶת בִּדְרָכָיו לִשְׁמֹר חֻקֹּתָיו מִצְוֺתָיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וְעֵדְוֺתָיו כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה לְמַעַן תַּשְׂכִּיל אֵת
כּל־אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה וְאֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר תִּפְנֶה שָׁם׃

english.text:
Keep the charge of YHWH your God, walking in His ways and
following His laws, His commandments, His rules, and His
admonitions as recorded in the Teaching of Moses, in order that
you may succeed in whatever you undertake and wherever you turn.

translation.text: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:

verses.english:
Keep the charge of YHWH your God, walking in His ways and
following His laws, His commandments, His rules, and His
admonitions as recorded in the Teaching of Moses, in order that
you may succeed in whatever you undertake and wherever you turn.

verses.hebrew:
לְמַעַן יָקִים יְהֹוָה אֶת־דְּבָרוֹ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר עָלַי לֵאמֹר אִם־יִשְׁמְרוּ בָנֶיךָ אֶת־דַּרְכָּם לָלֶכֶת לְפָנַי בֶּאֱמֶת בְּכל־לְבָבָם וּבְכל־נַפְשָׁם לֵאמֹר לֹא־יִכָּרֵת לְךָ
אִישׁ מֵעַל כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
לְמַעַן יָקִים יְהֹוָה אֶת־דְּבָרוֹ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר עָלַי לֵאמֹר אִם־יִשְׁמְרוּ בָנֶיךָ אֶת־דַּרְכָּם לָלֶכֶת לְפָנַי בֶּאֱמֶת בְּכל־לְבָבָם וּבְכל־נַפְשָׁם לֵאמֹר לֹא־יִכָּרֵת לְךָ
אִישׁ מֵעַל כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Then YHWH will fulfill the promise that He made concerning me: ‘If
your descendants are scrupulous in their conduct, and walk before
Me faithfully, with all their heart and soul, your line on the
throne of Israel shall never end!’

translation.text: That the LORD may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.

verses.english:
Then YHWH will fulfill the promise that He made concerning me: ‘If
your descendants are scrupulous in their conduct, and walk before
Me faithfully, with all their heart and soul, your line on the
throne of Israel shall never end!’

verses.hebrew:
וְגַם אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לִי יוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִשְׁנֵי־שָׂרֵי צִבְאוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר וְלַעֲמָשָׂא בֶן־יֶתֶר וַיַּהַרְגֵם וַיָּשֶׂם
דְּמֵי־מִלְחָמָה בְּשָׁלֹם וַיִּתֵּן דְּמֵי מִלְחָמָה בַּחֲגֹרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּמתְנָיו וּבְנַעֲלוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וְגַם אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לִי יוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לִשְׁנֵי־שָׂרֵי צִבְאוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר וְלַעֲמָשָׂא בֶן־יֶתֶר וַיַּהַרְגֵם וַיָּשֶׂם
דְּמֵי־מִלְחָמָה בְּשָׁלֹם וַיִּתֵּן דְּמֵי מִלְחָמָה בַּחֲגֹרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּמתְנָיו וּבְנַעֲלוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלָיו׃

english.text:
“Further, you know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me, what he did
to the two commanders of Israel’s forces, Abner son of Ner and
Amasa son of Jether: he killed them, shedding blood of war in
peacetime, staining the girdle of his loins and the sandals on his
feet with blood of war.

translation.text: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.

verses.english:
“Further, you know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me, what he did
to the two commanders of Israel’s forces, Abner son of Ner and
Amasa son of Jether: he killed them, shedding blood of war in
peacetime, staining the girdle of his loins and the sandals on his
feet with blood of war.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתָ כְּחכְמָתֶךָ וְלֹא־תוֹרֵד שֵׂיבָתוֹ בְּשָׁלֹם שְׁאֹל׃

hebrew.text: וְעָשִׂיתָ כְּחכְמָתֶךָ וְלֹא־תוֹרֵד שֵׂיבָתוֹ בְּשָׁלֹם שְׁאֹל׃

english.text:
So act in accordance with your wisdom, and see that his white hair
does not go down to Sheol in peace.

translation.text: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.

verses.english:
So act in accordance with your wisdom, and see that his white hair
does not go down to Sheol in peace.

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי בַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי תַּעֲשֶׂה־חֶסֶד וְהָיוּ בְּאֹכְלֵי שֻׁלְחָנֶךָ כִּי־כֵן קָרְבוּ אֵלַי בְּברְחִי מִפְּנֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם אָחִיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְלִבְנֵי בַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי תַּעֲשֶׂה־חֶסֶד וְהָיוּ בְּאֹכְלֵי שֻׁלְחָנֶךָ כִּי־כֵן קָרְבוּ אֵלַי בְּברְחִי מִפְּנֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם אָחִיךָ׃

english.text:
“But deal graciously with the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, for
they befriended me when I fled from your brother Absalom; let them
be among those that eat at your table.

translation.text: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.

verses.english:
“But deal graciously with the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, for
they befriended me when I fled from your brother Absalom; let them
be among those that eat at your table.

verses.hebrew:
וְהִנֵּה עִמְּךָ שִׁמְעִי בֶן־גֵּרָא בֶן־הַיְמִינִי מִבַּחֻרִים וְהוּא קִלְלַנִי קְלָלָה נִמְרֶצֶת בְּיוֹם לֶכְתִּי מַחֲנָיִם וְהוּא־יָרַד לִקְרָאתִי הַיַּרְדֵּן וָאֶשָּׁבַע לוֹ
בַיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר אִם־אֲמִיתְךָ בֶּחָרֶב׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִנֵּה עִמְּךָ שִׁמְעִי בֶן־גֵּרָא בֶן־הַיְמִינִי מִבַּחֻרִים וְהוּא קִלְלַנִי קְלָלָה נִמְרֶצֶת בְּיוֹם לֶכְתִּי מַחֲנָיִם וְהוּא־יָרַד לִקְרָאתִי הַיַּרְדֵּן וָאֶשָּׁבַע לוֹ
בַיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר אִם־אֲמִיתְךָ בֶּחָרֶב׃

english.text:
“You must also deal with Shimei son of Gera, the Benjaminite from
Bahurim. He insulted me outrageously when I was on my way to
Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore
to him by YHWH: ‘I will not put you to the sword.’

translation.text: And, behold, thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the LORD, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.

verses.english:
“You must also deal with Shimei son of Gera, the Benjaminite from
Bahurim. He insulted me outrageously when I was on my way to
Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore
to him by YHWH: ‘I will not put you to the sword.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אַל־תְּנַקֵּהוּ כִּי אִישׁ חָכָם אָתָּה וְיָדַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה־לּוֹ וְהוֹרַדְתָּ אֶת־שֵׂיבָתוֹ בְּדָם שְׁאוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אַל־תְּנַקֵּהוּ כִּי אִישׁ חָכָם אָתָּה וְיָדַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה־לּוֹ וְהוֹרַדְתָּ אֶת־שֵׂיבָתוֹ בְּדָם שְׁאוֹל׃

english.text:
So do not let him go unpunished; for you are a wise man and you
will know how to deal with him and send his gray hair down to
Sheol in blood.”

translation.text: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou art a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.

verses.english:
So do not let him go unpunished; for you are a wise man and you
will know how to deal with him and send his gray hair down to
Sheol in blood.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב דָּוִד עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּעִיר דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב דָּוִד עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּעִיר דָּוִד׃

english.text:
So David slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the City of
David.

translation.text: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.

verses.english:
So David slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the City of
David.

verses.hebrew: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ דָּוִד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בְּחֶבְרוֹן מָלַךְ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וּבִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם מָלַךְ שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ דָּוִד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בְּחֶבְרוֹן מָלַךְ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וּבִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם מָלַךְ שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
The length of David’s reign over Israel was forty years: he
reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years
in Jerusalem.

translation.text: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

verses.english:
The length of David’s reign over Israel was forty years: he
reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years
in Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁלֹמֹה יָשַׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא דָּוִד אָבִיו וַתִּכֹּן מַלְכֻתוֹ מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁלֹמֹה יָשַׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא דָּוִד אָבִיו וַתִּכֹּן מַלְכֻתוֹ מְאֹד׃

english.text:
And Solomon sat upon the throne of his father David, and his rule
was firmly established.

translation.text: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.

verses.english:
And Solomon sat upon the throne of his father David, and his rule
was firmly established.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ בֶן־חַגִּית אֶל־בַּת־שֶׁבַע אֵם־שְׁלֹמֹה וַתֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם בֹּאֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ בֶן־חַגִּית אֶל־בַּת־שֶׁבַע אֵם־שְׁלֹמֹה וַתֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם בֹּאֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
Adonijah son of Haggith came to see Bathsheba, Solomon’s mother.
She said, “Do you come with friendly intent?” “Yes,” he replied;

translation.text: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.

verses.english:
Adonijah son of Haggith came to see Bathsheba, Solomon’s mother.
She said, “Do you come with friendly intent?” “Yes,” he replied;

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּבָר לִי אֵלָיִךְ וַתֹּאמֶר דַּבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּבָר לִי אֵלָיִךְ וַתֹּאמֶר דַּבֵּר׃

english.text:
and he continued, “I would like to have a word with you.” “Speak
up,” she said.

translation.text: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.

verses.english:
and he continued, “I would like to have a word with you.” “Speak
up,” she said.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַתְּ יָדַעַתְּ כִּי־לִי הָיְתָה הַמְּלוּכָה וְעָלַי שָׂמוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל פְּנֵיהֶם לִמְלֹךְ וַתִּסֹּב הַמְּלוּכָה וַתְּהִי לְאָחִי כִּי מֵיְהֹוָה הָיְתָה לּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַתְּ יָדַעַתְּ כִּי־לִי הָיְתָה הַמְּלוּכָה וְעָלַי שָׂמוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל פְּנֵיהֶם לִמְלֹךְ וַתִּסֹּב הַמְּלוּכָה וַתְּהִי לְאָחִי כִּי מֵיְהֹוָה הָיְתָה לּוֹ׃

english.text:
Then he said, “You know that the kingship was rightly mine and
that all Israel wanted me to reign. But the kingship passed on to
my brother; it came to him by the will of YHWH.

translation.text: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother’s: for it was his from the LORD.

verses.english:
Then he said, “You know that the kingship was rightly mine and
that all Israel wanted me to reign. But the kingship passed on to
my brother; it came to him by the will of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שְׁאֵלָה אַחַת אָנֹכִי שֹׁאֵל מֵאִתָּךְ אַל־תָּשִׁבִי אֶת־פָּנָי וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דַּבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה שְׁאֵלָה אַחַת אָנֹכִי שֹׁאֵל מֵאִתָּךְ אַל־תָּשִׁבִי אֶת־פָּנָי וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דַּבֵּר׃

english.text:
And now I have one request to make of you; do not refuse me.” She
said, “Speak up.”

translation.text: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.

verses.english:
And now I have one request to make of you; do not refuse me.” She
said, “Speak up.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִמְרִי־נָא לִשְׁלֹמֹה הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי לֹא־יָשִׁיב אֶת־פָּנָיִךְ וְיִתֶּן־לִי אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשּׁוּנַמִּית לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אִמְרִי־נָא לִשְׁלֹמֹה הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי לֹא־יָשִׁיב אֶת־פָּנָיִךְ וְיִתֶּן־לִי אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשּׁוּנַמִּית לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
He replied, “Please ask King Solomon—for he won’t refuse you—to
give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife.”

translation.text: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.

verses.english:
He replied, “Please ask King Solomon—for he won’t refuse you—to
give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר בַּת־שֶׁבַע טוֹב אָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר עָלֶיךָ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר בַּת־שֶׁבַע טוֹב אָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר עָלֶיךָ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
“Very well,” said Bathsheba, “I will speak to the king in your
behalf.”

translation.text: And Bathsheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.

verses.english:
“Very well,” said Bathsheba, “I will speak to the king in your
behalf.”

verses.hebrew:
וַתָּבֹא בַת־שֶׁבַע אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לְדַבֶּר־לוֹ עַל־אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וַיָּקם הַמֶּלֶךְ לִקְרָאתָהּ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לָהּ וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם כִּסֵּא לְאֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ
וַתֵּשֶׁב לִימִינוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַתָּבֹא בַת־שֶׁבַע אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לְדַבֶּר־לוֹ עַל־אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וַיָּקם הַמֶּלֶךְ לִקְרָאתָהּ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לָהּ וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם כִּסֵּא לְאֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ
וַתֵּשֶׁב לִימִינוֹ׃

english.text:
So Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak to him about Adonijah.
The king rose to greet her and bowed down to her. He sat on his
throne; and he had a throne placed for the queen mother, and she
sat on his right.

translation.text: Bathsheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.

verses.english:
So Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak to him about Adonijah.
The king rose to greet her and bowed down to her. He sat on his
throne; and he had a throne placed for the queen mother, and she
sat on his right.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר שְׁאֵלָה אַחַת קְטַנָּה אָנֹכִי שֹׁאֶלֶת מֵאִתָּךְ אַל־תָּשֶׁב אֶת־פָּנָי וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ שַׁאֲלִי אִמִּי כִּי לֹא־אָשִׁיב אֶת־פָּנָיִךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר שְׁאֵלָה אַחַת קְטַנָּה אָנֹכִי שֹׁאֶלֶת מֵאִתָּךְ אַל־תָּשֶׁב אֶת־פָּנָי וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ שַׁאֲלִי אִמִּי כִּי לֹא־אָשִׁיב אֶת־פָּנָיִךְ׃

english.text:
She said, “I have one small request to make of you, do not refuse
me.” He responded, “Ask, Mother; I shall not refuse you.”

translation.text: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; I pray thee, say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.

verses.english:
She said, “I have one small request to make of you, do not refuse
me.” He responded, “Ask, Mother; I shall not refuse you.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר יֻתַּן אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשֻּׁנַמִּית לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ אָחִיךָ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר יֻתַּן אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשֻּׁנַמִּית לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ אָחִיךָ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
Then she said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to your
brother Adonijah as wife.”

translation.text: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.

verses.english:
Then she said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to your
brother Adonijah as wife.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיֹּאמֶר לְאִמּוֹ וְלָמָה אַתְּ שֹׁאֶלֶת אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשֻּׁנַמִּית לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וְשַׁאֲלִי־לוֹ אֶת־הַמְּלוּכָה כִּי הוּא אָחִי הַגָּדוֹל מִמֶּנִּי
וְלוֹ וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן וּלְיוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיֹּאמֶר לְאִמּוֹ וְלָמָה אַתְּ שֹׁאֶלֶת אֶת־אֲבִישַׁג הַשֻּׁנַמִּית לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וְשַׁאֲלִי־לוֹ אֶת־הַמְּלוּכָה כִּי הוּא אָחִי הַגָּדוֹל מִמֶּנִּי
וְלוֹ וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן וּלְיוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה׃

english.text:
The king replied to his mother, “Why request Abishag the
Shunammite for Adonijah? Request the kingship for him! For he is
my older brother, and the priest Abiathar and Joab son of Zeruiah
are on his side.”

translation.text: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.

verses.english:
The king replied to his mother, “Why request Abishag the
Shunammite for Adonijah? Request the kingship for him! For he is
my older brother, and the priest Abiathar and Joab son of Zeruiah
are on his side.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׁבַע הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִיף כִּי בְנַפְשׁוֹ דִּבֶּר אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׁבַע הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בַּיהֹוָה לֵאמֹר כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִיף כִּי בְנַפְשׁוֹ דִּבֶּר אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Thereupon, King Solomon swore by YHWH, saying, “So may God do to
me and even more, if broaching this matter does not cost Adonijah
his life!

translation.text: Then king Solomon sware by the LORD, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.

verses.english:
Thereupon, King Solomon swore by YHWH, saying, “So may God do to
me and even more, if broaching this matter does not cost Adonijah
his life!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה חַי־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הֱכִינַנִי (ויושיביני) [וַיּוֹשִׁיבַנִי] עַל־כִּסֵּא דָּוִד אָבִי וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה־לִי בַּיִת כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר כִּי הַיּוֹם יוּמַת אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה חַי־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הֱכִינַנִי (ויושיביני) [וַיּוֹשִׁיבַנִי] עַל־כִּסֵּא דָּוִד אָבִי וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה־לִי בַּיִת כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר כִּי הַיּוֹם יוּמַת אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
Now, as YHWH lives, who has established me and set me on the
throne of my father David and who has provided him with a house,
as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this very day!”

translation.text: Now therefore, as the LORD liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.

verses.english:
Now, as YHWH lives, who has established me and set me on the
throne of my father David and who has provided him with a house,
as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this very day!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בְּיַד בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּפְגַּע־בּוֹ וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בְּיַד בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּפְגַּע־בּוֹ וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
And Solomon instructed Benaiah son of Jehoiada, who struck
Adonijah down; and so he died.

translation.text: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.

verses.english:
And Solomon instructed Benaiah son of Jehoiada, who struck
Adonijah down; and so he died.

verses.hebrew:
וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ עֲנָתֹת לֵךְ עַל־שָׂדֶיךָ כִּי אִישׁ מָוֶת אָתָּה וּבַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לֹא אֲמִיתֶךָ כִּי־נָשָׂאתָ אֶת־אֲרוֹן אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה לִפְנֵי דָּוִד
אָבִי וְכִי הִתְעַנִּיתָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־הִתְעַנָּה אָבִי׃

hebrew.text:
וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ עֲנָתֹת לֵךְ עַל־שָׂדֶיךָ כִּי אִישׁ מָוֶת אָתָּה וּבַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לֹא אֲמִיתֶךָ כִּי־נָשָׂאתָ אֶת־אֲרוֹן אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה לִפְנֵי דָּוִד
אָבִי וְכִי הִתְעַנִּיתָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־הִתְעַנָּה אָבִי׃

english.text:
To the priest Abiathar, the king said, “Go to your estate at
Anathoth! You deserve to die, but I shall not put you to death at
this time, because you carried the Ark of my Lord GOD before my
father David and because you shared all the hardships that my
father endured.”

translation.text: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the LORD God before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.

verses.english:
To the priest Abiathar, the king said, “Go to your estate at
Anathoth! You deserve to die, but I shall not put you to death at
this time, because you carried the Ark of my Lord GOD before my
father David and because you shared all the hardships that my
father endured.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְגָרֶשׁ שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־אֶבְיָתָר מִהְיוֹת כֹּהֵן לַיהֹוָה לְמַלֵּא אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר עַל־בֵּית עֵלִי בְּשִׁלֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְגָרֶשׁ שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־אֶבְיָתָר מִהְיוֹת כֹּהֵן לַיהֹוָה לְמַלֵּא אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר עַל־בֵּית עֵלִי בְּשִׁלֹה׃

english.text:
So Solomon dismissed Abiathar from his office of priest of
YHWH—thus fulfilling what YHWH had spoken at Shiloh regarding the
house of Eli.

translation.text: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the LORD; that he might fulfil the word of the LORD, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

verses.english:
So Solomon dismissed Abiathar from his office of priest of
YHWH—thus fulfilling what YHWH had spoken at Shiloh regarding the
house of Eli.

verses.hebrew: וְהַשְּׁמֻעָה בָּאָה עַד־יוֹאָב כִּי יוֹאָב נָטָה אַחֲרֵי אֲדֹנִיָּה וְאַחֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם לֹא נָטָה וַיָּנס יוֹאָב אֶל־אֹהֶל יְהֹוָה וַיַּחֲזֵק בְּקַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשְּׁמֻעָה בָּאָה עַד־יוֹאָב כִּי יוֹאָב נָטָה אַחֲרֵי אֲדֹנִיָּה וְאַחֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם לֹא נָטָה וַיָּנס יוֹאָב אֶל־אֹהֶל יְהֹוָה וַיַּחֲזֵק בְּקַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
When the news reached Joab, he fled to the Tent of YHWH and
grasped the horns of the altar—for Joab had sided with Adonijah,
though he had not sided with Absalom.

translation.text: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

verses.english:
When the news reached Joab, he fled to the Tent of YHWH and
grasped the horns of the altar—for Joab had sided with Adonijah,
though he had not sided with Absalom.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה כִּי נָס יוֹאָב אֶל־אֹהֶל יְהֹוָה וְהִנֵּה אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּשְׁלַח שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע לֵאמֹר לֵךְ פְּגַע־בּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה כִּי נָס יוֹאָב אֶל־אֹהֶל יְהֹוָה וְהִנֵּה אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּשְׁלַח שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע לֵאמֹר לֵךְ פְּגַע־בּוֹ׃

english.text:
King Solomon was told that Joab had fled to the Tent of YHWH and
that he was there by the altar; so Solomon sent Benaiah son of
Jehoiada, saying, “Go and strike him down.”

translation.text: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD; and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.

verses.english:
King Solomon was told that Joab had fled to the Tent of YHWH and
that he was there by the altar; so Solomon sent Benaiah son of
Jehoiada, saying, “Go and strike him down.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא בְנָיָהוּ אֶל־אֹהֶל יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ צֵא וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא כִּי פֹה אָמוּת וַיָּשֶׁב בְּנָיָהוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר לֵאמֹר כֹּה־דִבֶּר יוֹאָב
וְכֹה עָנָנִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא בְנָיָהוּ אֶל־אֹהֶל יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ צֵא וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא כִּי פֹה אָמוּת וַיָּשֶׁב בְּנָיָהוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר לֵאמֹר כֹּה־דִבֶּר יוֹאָב
וְכֹה עָנָנִי׃

english.text:
Benaiah went to the Tent of YHWH and said to him, “Thus said the
king: Come out!” “No!” he replied; “I will die here.” Benaiah
reported back to the king that Joab had answered thus and thus,

translation.text: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.

verses.english:
Benaiah went to the Tent of YHWH and said to him, “Thus said the
king: Come out!” “No!” he replied; “I will die here.” Benaiah
reported back to the king that Joab had answered thus and thus,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ עֲשֵׂה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר וּפְגַע־בּוֹ וּקְבַרְתּוֹ וַהֲסִירֹתָ דְּמֵי חִנָּם אֲשֶׁר שָׁפַךְ יוֹאָב מֵעָלַי וּמֵעַל בֵּית אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ עֲשֵׂה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר וּפְגַע־בּוֹ וּקְבַרְתּוֹ וַהֲסִירֹתָ דְּמֵי חִנָּם אֲשֶׁר שָׁפַךְ יוֹאָב מֵעָלַי וּמֵעַל בֵּית אָבִי׃

english.text:
and the king said, “Do just as he said; strike him down and bury
him, and remove guilt from me and my father’s house for the blood
of the innocent that Joab has shed.

translation.text: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.

verses.english:
and the king said, “Do just as he said; strike him down and bury
him, and remove guilt from me and my father’s house for the blood
of the innocent that Joab has shed.

verses.hebrew:
וְהֵשִׁיב יְהֹוָה אֶת־דָּמוֹ עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ אֲשֶׁר פָּגַע בִּשְׁנֵי־אֲנָשִׁים צַדִּקִים וְטֹבִים מִמֶּנּוּ וַיַּהַרְגֵם בַּחֶרֶב וְאָבִי דָוִד לֹא יָדָע אֶת־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר
שַׂר־צְבָא יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־עֲמָשָׂא בֶן־יֶתֶר שַׂר־צְבָא יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְהֵשִׁיב יְהֹוָה אֶת־דָּמוֹ עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ אֲשֶׁר פָּגַע בִּשְׁנֵי־אֲנָשִׁים צַדִּקִים וְטֹבִים מִמֶּנּוּ וַיַּהַרְגֵם בַּחֶרֶב וְאָבִי דָוִד לֹא יָדָע אֶת־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר
שַׂר־צְבָא יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־עֲמָשָׂא בֶן־יֶתֶר שַׂר־צְבָא יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
Thus YHWH will bring his blood guilt down upon his own head,
because, unbeknown to my father, he struck down with the sword two
men more righteous and honorable than he—Abner son of Ner, the
army commander of Israel, and Amasa son of Jether, the army
commander of Judah.

translation.text: And the LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.

verses.english:
Thus YHWH will bring his blood guilt down upon his own head,
because, unbeknown to my father, he struck down with the sword two
men more righteous and honorable than he—Abner son of Ner, the
army commander of Israel, and Amasa son of Jether, the army
commander of Judah.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁבוּ דְמֵיהֶם בְּרֹאשׁ יוֹאָב וּבְרֹאשׁ זַרְעוֹ לְעֹלָם וּלְדָוִד וּלְזַרְעוֹ וּלְבֵיתוֹ וּלְכִסְאוֹ יִהְיֶה שָׁלוֹם עַד־עוֹלָם מֵעִם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁבוּ דְמֵיהֶם בְּרֹאשׁ יוֹאָב וּבְרֹאשׁ זַרְעוֹ לְעֹלָם וּלְדָוִד וּלְזַרְעוֹ וּלְבֵיתוֹ וּלְכִסְאוֹ יִהְיֶה שָׁלוֹם עַד־עוֹלָם מֵעִם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
May the guilt for their blood come down upon the head of Joab and
his descendants forever, and may good fortune from YHWH be granted
forever to David and his descendants, his house and his throne.”

translation.text: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the LORD.

verses.english:
May the guilt for their blood come down upon the head of Joab and
his descendants forever, and may good fortune from YHWH be granted
forever to David and his descendants, his house and his throne.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל בְּנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּפְגַּע־בּוֹ וַיְמִתֵהוּ וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּבֵיתוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל בְּנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּפְגַּע־בּוֹ וַיְמִתֵהוּ וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּבֵיתוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

english.text:
So Benaiah son of Jehoiada went up and struck him down. And he was
buried at his home in the wilderness.

translation.text: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

verses.english:
So Benaiah son of Jehoiada went up and struck him down. And he was
buried at his home in the wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע תַּחְתָּיו עַל־הַצָּבָא וְאֶת־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן נָתַן הַמֶּלֶךְ תַּחַת אֶבְיָתָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע תַּחְתָּיו עַל־הַצָּבָא וְאֶת־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן נָתַן הַמֶּלֶךְ תַּחַת אֶבְיָתָר׃

english.text:
In his place, the king appointed Benaiah son of Jehoiada over the
army, and in place of Abiathar, the king appointed the priest
Zadok.

translation.text: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.

verses.english:
In his place, the king appointed Benaiah son of Jehoiada over the
army, and in place of Abiathar, the king appointed the priest
Zadok.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרָא לְשִׁמְעִי וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בְּנֵה־לְךָ בַיִת בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְיָשַׁבְתָּ שָׁם וְלֹא־תֵצֵא מִשָּׁם אָנֶה וָאָנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרָא לְשִׁמְעִי וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בְּנֵה־לְךָ בַיִת בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְיָשַׁבְתָּ שָׁם וְלֹא־תֵצֵא מִשָּׁם אָנֶה וָאָנָה׃

english.text:
Then the king summoned Shimei and said to him, “Build yourself a
house in Jerusalem and stay there—do not ever go out from there
anywhere else.

translation.text: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.

verses.english:
Then the king summoned Shimei and said to him, “Build yourself a
house in Jerusalem and stay there—do not ever go out from there
anywhere else.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בְּיוֹם צֵאתְךָ וְעָבַרְתָּ אֶת־נַחַל קִדְרוֹן יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי מוֹת תָּמוּת דָּמְךָ יִהְיֶה בְרֹאשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה בְּיוֹם צֵאתְךָ וְעָבַרְתָּ אֶת־נַחַל קִדְרוֹן יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי מוֹת תָּמוּת דָּמְךָ יִהְיֶה בְרֹאשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
On the very day that you go out and cross the Wadi Kidron, you can
be sure that you will die; your blood shall be on your own head.”

translation.text: For it shall be, that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.

verses.english:
On the very day that you go out and cross the Wadi Kidron, you can
be sure that you will die; your blood shall be on your own head.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְעִי לַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב הַדָּבָר כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה עַבְדֶּךָ וַיֵּשֶׁב שִׁמְעִי בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם יָמִים רַבִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְעִי לַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב הַדָּבָר כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה עַבְדֶּךָ וַיֵּשֶׁב שִׁמְעִי בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם יָמִים רַבִּים׃

english.text:
“That is fair,” said Shimei to the king, “your servant will do
just as my lord the king has spoken.” And for a long time, Shimei
remained in Jerusalem.

translation.text: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.

verses.english:
“That is fair,” said Shimei to the king, “your servant will do
just as my lord the king has spoken.” And for a long time, Shimei
remained in Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים וַיִּבְרְחוּ שְׁנֵי־עֲבָדִים לְשִׁמְעִי אֶל־אָכִישׁ בֶּן־מַעֲכָה מֶלֶךְ גַּת וַיַּגִּידוּ לְשִׁמְעִי לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה עֲבָדֶיךָ בְּגַת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים וַיִּבְרְחוּ שְׁנֵי־עֲבָדִים לְשִׁמְעִי אֶל־אָכִישׁ בֶּן־מַעֲכָה מֶלֶךְ גַּת וַיַּגִּידוּ לְשִׁמְעִי לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה עֲבָדֶיךָ בְּגַת׃

english.text:
Three years later, two slaves of Shimei ran away to King Achish
son of Maacah of Gath. Shimei was told, “Your slaves are in Gath.”

translation.text: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants be in Gath.

verses.english:
Three years later, two slaves of Shimei ran away to King Achish
son of Maacah of Gath. Shimei was told, “Your slaves are in Gath.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם שִׁמְעִי וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת־חֲמֹרוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ גַּתָה אֶל־אָכִישׁ לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־עֲבָדָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ שִׁמְעִי וַיָּבֵא אֶת־עֲבָדָיו מִגַּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם שִׁמְעִי וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת־חֲמֹרוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ גַּתָה אֶל־אָכִישׁ לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־עֲבָדָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ שִׁמְעִי וַיָּבֵא אֶת־עֲבָדָיו מִגַּת׃

english.text:
Shimei thereupon saddled his ass and went to Achish in Gath to
claim his slaves; and Shimei returned from Gath with his slaves.

translation.text: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.

verses.english:
Shimei thereupon saddled his ass and went to Achish in Gath to
claim his slaves; and Shimei returned from Gath with his slaves.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לִשְׁלֹמֹה כִּי־הָלַךְ שִׁמְעִי מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם גַּת וַיָּשֹׁב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֻּגַּד לִשְׁלֹמֹה כִּי־הָלַךְ שִׁמְעִי מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם גַּת וַיָּשֹׁב׃

english.text:
Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and
back,

translation.text: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.

verses.english:
Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and
back,

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרָא לְשִׁמְעִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֲלוֹא הִשְׁבַּעְתִּיךָ בַיהֹוָה וָאָעִד בְּךָ לֵאמֹר בְּיוֹם צֵאתְךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ אָנֶה וָאָנָה יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי מוֹת
תָּמוּת וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלַי טוֹב הַדָּבָר שָׁמָעְתִּי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרָא לְשִׁמְעִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֲלוֹא הִשְׁבַּעְתִּיךָ בַיהֹוָה וָאָעִד בְּךָ לֵאמֹר בְּיוֹם צֵאתְךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ אָנֶה וָאָנָה יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי מוֹת
תָּמוּת וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלַי טוֹב הַדָּבָר שָׁמָעְתִּי׃

english.text:
and the king summoned Shimei and said to him, “Did I not adjure
you by YHWH and warn you, ‘On the very day that you leave and go
anywhere else, you can be sure that you will die,’ and did you not
say to me, ‘It is fair; I accept’?

translation.text: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the LORD, and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.

verses.english:
and the king summoned Shimei and said to him, “Did I not adjure
you by YHWH and warn you, ‘On the very day that you leave and go
anywhere else, you can be sure that you will die,’ and did you not
say to me, ‘It is fair; I accept’?

verses.hebrew: וּמַדּוּעַ לֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ אֵת שְׁבֻעַת יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתִי עָלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וּמַדּוּעַ לֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ אֵת שְׁבֻעַת יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתִי עָלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Why did you not abide by the oath before YHWH and by the orders
which I gave you?”

translation.text: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the LORD, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?

verses.english:
Why did you not abide by the oath before YHWH and by the orders
which I gave you?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־שִׁמְעִי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֵת כּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר יָדַע לְבָבְךָ אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לְדָוִד אָבִי וְהֵשִׁיב יְהֹוָה אֶת־רָעָתְךָ בְּרֹאשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־שִׁמְעִי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֵת כּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר יָדַע לְבָבְךָ אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לְדָוִד אָבִי וְהֵשִׁיב יְהֹוָה אֶת־רָעָתְךָ בְּרֹאשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
The king said further to Shimei, “You know all the wrong, which
you remember very well, that you did to my father David. Now YHWH
brings down your wrongdoing upon your own head.

translation.text: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the LORD shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;

verses.english:
The king said further to Shimei, “You know all the wrong, which
you remember very well, that you did to my father David. Now YHWH
brings down your wrongdoing upon your own head.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בָּרוּךְ וְכִסֵּא דָוִד יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַד־עוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בָּרוּךְ וְכִסֵּא דָוִד יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עַד־עוֹלָם׃

english.text:
But King Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall
be established before YHWH forever.”

translation.text: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.

verses.english:
But King Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall
be established before YHWH forever.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־בְּנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיֵּצֵא וַיִּפְגַּע־בּוֹ וַיָּמֹת וְהַמַּמְלָכָה נָכוֹנָה בְּיַד־שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־בְּנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וַיֵּצֵא וַיִּפְגַּע־בּוֹ וַיָּמֹת וְהַמַּמְלָכָה נָכוֹנָה בְּיַד־שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
The king gave orders to Benaiah son of Jehoiada and he went out
and struck Shimei down; and so he died. Thus the kingdom was
secured in Solomon’s hands.

translation.text: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

verses.english:
The king gave orders to Benaiah son of Jehoiada and he went out
and struck Shimei down; and so he died. Thus the kingdom was
secured in Solomon’s hands.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתְחַתֵּן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם וַיִּקַּח אֶת־בַּת־פַּרְעֹה וַיְבִיאֶהָ אֶל־עִיר דָּוִד עַד כַּלֹּתוֹ לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־חוֹמַת
יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתְחַתֵּן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם וַיִּקַּח אֶת־בַּת־פַּרְעֹה וַיְבִיאֶהָ אֶל־עִיר דָּוִד עַד כַּלֹּתוֹ לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־חוֹמַת
יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם סָבִיב׃

english.text:
Solomon allied himself by marriage with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He
married Pharaoh’s daughter and brought her to the City of David
[to live there] until he had finished building his palace, and the
House of YHWH, and the walls around Jerusalem.

translation.text: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the LORD, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.

verses.english:
Solomon allied himself by marriage with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He
married Pharaoh’s daughter and brought her to the City of David
[to live there] until he had finished building his palace, and the
House of YHWH, and the walls around Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: רַק הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים בַּבָּמוֹת כִּי לֹא־נִבְנָה בַיִת לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה עַד הַיָּמִים הָהֵם׃

hebrew.text: רַק הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים בַּבָּמוֹת כִּי לֹא־נִבְנָה בַיִת לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה עַד הַיָּמִים הָהֵם׃

english.text:
The people, however, continued to offer sacrifices at the open
shrines, because up to that time no house had been built for the
name of YHWH.

translation.text: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the LORD, until those days.

verses.english:
The people, however, continued to offer sacrifices at the open
shrines, because up to that time no house had been built for the
name of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱהַב שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־יְהֹוָה לָלֶכֶת בְּחֻקּוֹת דָּוִד אָבִיו רַק בַּבָּמוֹת הוּא מְזַבֵּחַ וּמַקְטִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאֱהַב שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־יְהֹוָה לָלֶכֶת בְּחֻקּוֹת דָּוִד אָבִיו רַק בַּבָּמוֹת הוּא מְזַבֵּחַ וּמַקְטִיר׃

english.text:
And Solomon, though he loved YHWH and followed the practices of
his father David, also sacrificed and offered at the shrines.

translation.text: And Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.

verses.english:
And Solomon, though he loved YHWH and followed the practices of
his father David, also sacrificed and offered at the shrines.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ גִּבְעֹנָה לִזְבֹּחַ שָׁם כִּי־הִיא הַבָּמָה הַגְּדוֹלָה אֶלֶף עֹלוֹת יַעֲלֶה שְׁלֹמֹה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַהוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ גִּבְעֹנָה לִזְבֹּחַ שָׁם כִּי־הִיא הַבָּמָה הַגְּדוֹלָה אֶלֶף עֹלוֹת יַעֲלֶה שְׁלֹמֹה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַהוּא׃

english.text:
The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the
largest shrine; on that altar Solomon presented a thousand burnt
offerings.

translation.text: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.

verses.english:
The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the
largest shrine; on that altar Solomon presented a thousand burnt
offerings.

verses.hebrew: בְּגִבְעוֹן נִרְאָה יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה בַּחֲלוֹם הַלָּיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים שְׁאַל מָה אֶתֶּן־לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: בְּגִבְעוֹן נִרְאָה יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה בַּחֲלוֹם הַלָּיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים שְׁאַל מָה אֶתֶּן־לָךְ׃

english.text:
At Gibeon YHWH appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God
said, “Ask, what shall I grant you?”

translation.text: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.

verses.english:
At Gibeon YHWH appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God
said, “Ask, what shall I grant you?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁלֹמֹה אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ עִם־עַבְדְּךָ דָוִד אָבִי חֶסֶד גָּדוֹל כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ לְפָנֶיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת וּבִצְדָקָה וּבְיִשְׁרַת לֵבָב עִמָּךְ וַתִּשְׁמר־לוֹ אֶת־הַחֶסֶד
הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה וַתִּתֶּן־לוֹ בֵן יֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁלֹמֹה אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ עִם־עַבְדְּךָ דָוִד אָבִי חֶסֶד גָּדוֹל כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ לְפָנֶיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת וּבִצְדָקָה וּבְיִשְׁרַת לֵבָב עִמָּךְ וַתִּשְׁמר־לוֹ אֶת־הַחֶסֶד
הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה וַתִּתֶּן־לוֹ בֵן יֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Solomon said, “You dealt most graciously with Your servant my
father David, because he walked before You in faithfulness and
righteousness and in integrity of heart. You have continued this
great kindness to him by giving him a son to occupy his throne, as
is now the case.

translation.text: And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.

verses.english:
Solomon said, “You dealt most graciously with Your servant my
father David, because he walked before You in faithfulness and
righteousness and in integrity of heart. You have continued this
great kindness to him by giving him a son to occupy his throne, as
is now the case.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי אַתָּה הִמְלַכְתָּ אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ תַּחַת דָּוִד אָבִי וְאָנֹכִי נַעַר קָטֹן לֹא אֵדַע צֵאת וָבֹא׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי אַתָּה הִמְלַכְתָּ אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ תַּחַת דָּוִד אָבִי וְאָנֹכִי נַעַר קָטֹן לֹא אֵדַע צֵאת וָבֹא׃

english.text:
And now, O LORD my God, You have made Your servant king in place
of my father David; but I am a young lad, with no experience in
leadership.

translation.text: And now, O LORD my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.

verses.english:
And now, O LORD my God, You have made Your servant king in place
of my father David; but I am a young lad, with no experience in
leadership.

verses.hebrew: וְעַבְדְּךָ בְּתוֹךְ עַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרְתָּ עַם־רָב אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִמָּנֶה וְלֹא יִסָּפֵר מֵרֹב׃

hebrew.text: וְעַבְדְּךָ בְּתוֹךְ עַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרְתָּ עַם־רָב אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִמָּנֶה וְלֹא יִסָּפֵר מֵרֹב׃

english.text:
Your servant finds himself in the midst of the people You have
chosen, a people too numerous to be numbered or counted.

translation.text: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.

verses.english:
Your servant finds himself in the midst of the people You have
chosen, a people too numerous to be numbered or counted.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ לֵב שֹׁמֵעַ לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת־עַמְּךָ לְהָבִין בֵּין־טוֹב לְרָע כִּי מִי יוּכַל לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת־עַמְּךָ הַכָּבֵד הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ לֵב שֹׁמֵעַ לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת־עַמְּךָ לְהָבִין בֵּין־טוֹב לְרָע כִּי מִי יוּכַל לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת־עַמְּךָ הַכָּבֵד הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Grant, then, Your servant an understanding mind to judge Your
people, to distinguish between good and bad; for who can judge
this vast people of Yours?”

translation.text: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?

verses.english:
Grant, then, Your servant an understanding mind to judge Your
people, to distinguish between good and bad; for who can judge
this vast people of Yours?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנָי כִּי שָׁאַל שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנָי כִּי שָׁאַל שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text: YHWH was pleased that Solomon had asked for this.

translation.text: And the speech pleased the LORD, that Solomon had asked this thing.

verses.english: YHWH was pleased that Solomon had asked for this.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֵלָיו יַעַן אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתָּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְלֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ יָמִים רַבִּים וְלֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ עֹשֶׁר וְלֹא שָׁאַלְתָּ נֶפֶשׁ אֹיְבֶיךָ
וְשָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ הָבִין לִשְׁמֹעַ מִשְׁפָּט׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֵלָיו יַעַן אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתָּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְלֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ יָמִים רַבִּים וְלֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ עֹשֶׁר וְלֹא שָׁאַלְתָּ נֶפֶשׁ אֹיְבֶיךָ
וְשָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ הָבִין לִשְׁמֹעַ מִשְׁפָּט׃

english.text:
And God said to him, “Because you asked for this—you did not ask
for long life, you did not ask for riches, you did not ask for the
life of your enemies, but you asked for discernment in dispensing
justice—

translation.text: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;

verses.english:
And God said to him, “Because you asked for this—you did not ask
for long life, you did not ask for riches, you did not ask for the
life of your enemies, but you asked for discernment in dispensing
justice—

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה עָשִׂיתִי כִּדְבָרֶיךָ הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי לְךָ לֵב חָכָם וְנָבוֹן אֲשֶׁר כָּמוֹךָ לֹא־הָיָה לְפָנֶיךָ וְאַחֲרֶיךָ לֹא־יָקוּם כָּמוֹךָ׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה עָשִׂיתִי כִּדְבָרֶיךָ הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי לְךָ לֵב חָכָם וְנָבוֹן אֲשֶׁר כָּמוֹךָ לֹא־הָיָה לְפָנֶיךָ וְאַחֲרֶיךָ לֹא־יָקוּם כָּמוֹךָ׃

english.text:
I now do as you have spoken. I grant you a wise and discerning
mind; there has never been anyone like you before, nor will anyone
like you arise again.

translation.text: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.

verses.english:
I now do as you have spoken. I grant you a wise and discerning
mind; there has never been anyone like you before, nor will anyone
like you arise again.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ נָתַתִּי לָךְ גַּם־עֹשֶׁר גַּם־כָּבוֹד אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָיָה כָמוֹךָ אִישׁ בַּמְּלָכִים כּל־יָמֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ נָתַתִּי לָךְ גַּם־עֹשֶׁר גַּם־כָּבוֹד אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָיָה כָמוֹךָ אִישׁ בַּמְּלָכִים כּל־יָמֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And I also grant you what you did not ask for—both riches and
glory all your life—the like of which no king has ever had.

translation.text: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.

verses.english:
And I also grant you what you did not ask for—both riches and
glory all your life—the like of which no king has ever had.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם תֵּלֵךְ בִּדְרָכַי לִשְׁמֹר חֻקַּי וּמִצְוֺתַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ דָּוִיד אָבִיךָ וְהַאֲרַכְתִּי אֶת־יָמֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִם תֵּלֵךְ בִּדְרָכַי לִשְׁמֹר חֻקַּי וּמִצְוֺתַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ דָּוִיד אָבִיךָ וְהַאֲרַכְתִּי אֶת־יָמֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And I will further grant you long life, if you will walk in My
ways and observe My laws and commandments, as did your father
David.”

translation.text: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.

verses.english:
And I will further grant you long life, if you will walk in My
ways and observe My laws and commandments, as did your father
David.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַץ שְׁלֹמֹה וְהִנֵּה חֲלוֹם וַיָּבוֹא יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיַּעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־אֲדֹנָי וַיַּעַל עֹלוֹת וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלָמִים וַיַּעַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּה לְכל־עֲבָדָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַץ שְׁלֹמֹה וְהִנֵּה חֲלוֹם וַיָּבוֹא יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיַּעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־אֲדֹנָי וַיַּעַל עֹלוֹת וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלָמִים וַיַּעַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּה לְכל־עֲבָדָיו׃

english.text:
Then Solomon awoke: it was a dream! He went to Jerusalem, stood
before the Ark of the Covenant of YHWH, and sacrificed burnt
offerings and presented offerings of well-being; and he made a
banquet for all his courtiers.

translation.text: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.

verses.english:
Then Solomon awoke: it was a dream! He went to Jerusalem, stood
before the Ark of the Covenant of YHWH, and sacrificed burnt
offerings and presented offerings of well-being; and he made a
banquet for all his courtiers.

verses.hebrew: אָז תָּבֹאנָה שְׁתַּיִם נָשִׁים זֹנוֹת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתַּעֲמֹדְנָה לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: אָז תָּבֹאנָה שְׁתַּיִם נָשִׁים זֹנוֹת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתַּעֲמֹדְנָה לְפָנָיו׃

english.text: Later two prostitutes came to the king and stood before him.

translation.text: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.

verses.english: Later two prostitutes came to the king and stood before him.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הָאַחַת בִּי אֲדֹנִי אֲנִי וְהָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת יֹשְׁבֹת בְּבַיִת אֶחָד וָאֵלֵד עִמָּהּ בַּבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הָאַחַת בִּי אֲדֹנִי אֲנִי וְהָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת יֹשְׁבֹת בְּבַיִת אֶחָד וָאֵלֵד עִמָּהּ בַּבָּיִת׃

english.text:
The first woman said, “Please, my lord! This woman and I live in
the same house; and I gave birth to a child while she was in the
house.

translation.text: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.

verses.english:
The first woman said, “Please, my lord! This woman and I live in
the same house; and I gave birth to a child while she was in the
house.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לְלִדְתִּי וַתֵּלֶד גַּם־הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת וַאֲנַחְנוּ יַחְדָּו אֵין־זָר אִתָּנוּ בַּבַּיִת זוּלָתִי שְׁתַּיִם־אֲנַחְנוּ בַּבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לְלִדְתִּי וַתֵּלֶד גַּם־הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת וַאֲנַחְנוּ יַחְדָּו אֵין־זָר אִתָּנוּ בַּבַּיִת זוּלָתִי שְׁתַּיִם־אֲנַחְנוּ בַּבָּיִת׃

english.text:
On the third day after I was delivered, this woman also gave birth
to a child. We were alone; there was no one else with us in the
house, just the two of us in the house.

translation.text: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.

verses.english:
On the third day after I was delivered, this woman also gave birth
to a child. We were alone; there was no one else with us in the
house, just the two of us in the house.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת בֶּן־הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת לָיְלָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁכְבָה עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת בֶּן־הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת לָיְלָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁכְבָה עָלָיו׃

english.text: During the night this woman’s child died, because she lay on it.

translation.text: And this woman’s child died in the night; because she overlaid it.

verses.english: During the night this woman’s child died, because she lay on it.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּקם בְּתוֹךְ הַלַּיְלָה וַתִּקַּח אֶת־בְּנִי מֵאֶצְלִי וַאֲמָתְךָ יְשֵׁנָה וַתַּשְׁכִּיבֵהוּ בְּחֵיקָהּ וְאֶת־בְּנָהּ הַמֵּת הִשְׁכִּיבָה בְחֵיקִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּקם בְּתוֹךְ הַלַּיְלָה וַתִּקַּח אֶת־בְּנִי מֵאֶצְלִי וַאֲמָתְךָ יְשֵׁנָה וַתַּשְׁכִּיבֵהוּ בְּחֵיקָהּ וְאֶת־בְּנָהּ הַמֵּת הִשְׁכִּיבָה בְחֵיקִי׃

english.text:
She arose in the night and took my son from my side while your
maidservant was asleep, and laid him in her bosom; and she laid
her dead son in my bosom.

translation.text: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

verses.english:
She arose in the night and took my son from my side while your
maidservant was asleep, and laid him in her bosom; and she laid
her dead son in my bosom.

verses.hebrew: וָאָקֻם בַּבֹּקֶר לְהֵינִיק אֶת־בְּנִי וְהִנֵּה־מֵת וָאֶתְבּוֹנֵן אֵלָיו בַּבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה לֹא־הָיָה בְנִי אֲשֶׁר יָלָדְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וָאָקֻם בַּבֹּקֶר לְהֵינִיק אֶת־בְּנִי וְהִנֵּה־מֵת וָאֶתְבּוֹנֵן אֵלָיו בַּבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה לֹא־הָיָה בְנִי אֲשֶׁר יָלָדְתִּי׃

translation.text: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הָאַחֶרֶת לֹא כִי בְּנִי הַחַי וּבְנֵךְ הַמֵּת וְזֹאת אֹמֶרֶת לֹא כִי בְּנֵךְ הַמֵּת וּבְנִי הֶחָי וַתְּדַבֵּרְנָה לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הָאַחֶרֶת לֹא כִי בְּנִי הַחַי וּבְנֵךְ הַמֵּת וְזֹאת אֹמֶרֶת לֹא כִי בְּנֵךְ הַמֵּת וּבְנִי הֶחָי וַתְּדַבֵּרְנָה לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The other woman spoke up, “No, the live one is my son, and the
dead one is yours!” But the first insisted, “No, the dead boy is
yours; mine is the live one!” And they went on arguing before the
king.

translation.text: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.

verses.english:
The other woman spoke up, “No, the live one is my son, and the
dead one is yours!” But the first insisted, “No, the dead boy is
yours; mine is the live one!” And they went on arguing before the
king.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ זֹאת אֹמֶרֶת זֶה־בְּנִי הַחַי וּבְנֵךְ הַמֵּת וְזֹאת אֹמֶרֶת לֹא כִי בְּנֵךְ הַמֵּת וּבְנִי הֶחָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ זֹאת אֹמֶרֶת זֶה־בְּנִי הַחַי וּבְנֵךְ הַמֵּת וְזֹאת אֹמֶרֶת לֹא כִי בְּנֵךְ הַמֵּת וּבְנִי הֶחָי׃

english.text:
The king said, “One says, ‘This is my son, the live one, and the
dead one is yours’; and the other says, ‘No, the dead boy is
yours, mine is the live one.’

translation.text: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.

verses.english:
The king said, “One says, ‘This is my son, the live one, and the
dead one is yours’; and the other says, ‘No, the dead boy is
yours, mine is the live one.’

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ קְחוּ לִי־חָרֶב וַיָּבִאוּ הַחֶרֶב לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ קְחוּ לִי־חָרֶב וַיָּבִאוּ הַחֶרֶב לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
So the king gave the order, “Fetch me a sword.” A sword was
brought before the king,

translation.text: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.

verses.english:
So the king gave the order, “Fetch me a sword.” A sword was
brought before the king,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ גִּזְרוּ אֶת־הַיֶּלֶד הַחַי לִשְׁנָיִם וּתְנוּ אֶת־הַחֲצִי לְאַחַת וְאֶת־הַחֲצִי לְאֶחָת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ גִּזְרוּ אֶת־הַיֶּלֶד הַחַי לִשְׁנָיִם וּתְנוּ אֶת־הַחֲצִי לְאַחַת וְאֶת־הַחֲצִי לְאֶחָת׃

english.text:
and the king said, “Cut the live child in two, and give half to
one and half to the other.”

translation.text: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.

verses.english:
and the king said, “Cut the live child in two, and give half to
one and half to the other.”

verses.hebrew:
וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר־בְּנָהּ הַחַי אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־נִכְמְרוּ רַחֲמֶיהָ עַל־בְּנָהּ וַתֹּאמֶר בִּי אֲדֹנִי תְּנוּ־לָהּ אֶת־הַיָּלוּד הַחַי וְהָמֵת אַל־תְּמִיתֻהוּ וְזֹאת
אֹמֶרֶת גַּם־לִי גַם־לָךְ לֹא יִהְיֶה גְּזֹרוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר־בְּנָהּ הַחַי אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־נִכְמְרוּ רַחֲמֶיהָ עַל־בְּנָהּ וַתֹּאמֶר בִּי אֲדֹנִי תְּנוּ־לָהּ אֶת־הַיָּלוּד הַחַי וְהָמֵת אַל־תְּמִיתֻהוּ וְזֹאת
אֹמֶרֶת גַּם־לִי גַם־לָךְ לֹא יִהְיֶה גְּזֹרוּ׃

english.text:
But the woman whose son was the live one pleaded with the king,
for she was overcome with compassion for her son. “Please, my
lord,” she cried, “give her the live child; only don’t kill it!”
The other insisted, “It shall be neither yours nor mine; cut it in
two!”
