translation.text: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it.

verses.english:
But the woman whose son was the live one pleaded with the king,
for she was overcome with compassion for her son. “Please, my
lord,” she cried, “give her the live child; only don’t kill it!”
The other insisted, “It shall be neither yours nor mine; cut it in
two!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר תְּנוּ־לָהּ אֶת־הַיָּלוּד הַחַי וְהָמֵת לֹא תְמִיתֻהוּ הִיא אִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר תְּנוּ־לָהּ אֶת־הַיָּלוּד הַחַי וְהָמֵת לֹא תְמִיתֻהוּ הִיא אִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
Then the king spoke up. “Give the live child to her,” he said,
“and do not put it to death; she is its mother.”

translation.text: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.

verses.english:
Then the king spoke up. “Give the live child to her,” he said,
“and do not put it to death; she is its mother.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּט אֲשֶׁר שָׁפַט הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּרְאוּ מִפְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי רָאוּ כִּי־חכְמַת אֱלֹהִים בְּקִרְבּוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּט אֲשֶׁר שָׁפַט הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּרְאוּ מִפְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי רָאוּ כִּי־חכְמַת אֱלֹהִים בְּקִרְבּוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט׃

english.text:
When all Israel heard the decision that the king had rendered,
they stood in awe of the king; for they saw that he possessed
divine wisdom to execute justice.

translation.text: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do judgment.

verses.english:
When all Israel heard the decision that the king had rendered,
they stood in awe of the king; for they saw that he possessed
divine wisdom to execute justice.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מֶלֶךְ עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מֶלֶךְ עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text: King Solomon was now king over all Israel.

translation.text: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.

verses.english: King Solomon was now king over all Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הַשָּׂרִים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ עֲזַרְיָהוּ בֶן־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה הַשָּׂרִים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ עֲזַרְיָהוּ בֶן־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: These were his officials: Azariah son of Zadok—the priest;

Elihoreph and Ahijah sons of Shisha—scribes; Jehoshaphat son of

Elihoreph and Ahijah sons of Shisha—scribes; Jehoshaphat son of
Ahilud—recorder;

hebrew.text: וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע עַל־הַצָּבָאוְצָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִים׃

english.text: Benaiah son of Jehoiada—over the army; Zadok and Abiathar—priests;

translation.text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:

verses.english: Benaiah son of Jehoiada—over the army; Zadok and Abiathar—priests;

verses.hebrew: וַעֲזַרְיָהוּ בֶן־נָתָן עַל־הַנִּצָּבִיםוְזָבוּד בֶּן־נָתָן כֹּהֵן רֵעֶה הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲזַרְיָהוּ בֶן־נָתָן עַל־הַנִּצָּבִיםוְזָבוּד בֶּן־נָתָן כֹּהֵן רֵעֶה הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Azariah son of Nathan—in charge of the prefects; Zabud son of
Nathan the priest—companion of the king;

translation.text: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king’s friend:

verses.english:
Azariah son of Nathan—in charge of the prefects; Zabud son of
Nathan the priest—companion of the king;

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחִישָׁר עַל־הַבָּיִתוַאֲדֹנִירָם בֶּן־עַבְדָּא עַל־הַמַּס׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲחִישָׁר עַל־הַבָּיִתוַאֲדֹנִירָם בֶּן־עַבְדָּא עַל־הַמַּס׃

english.text:
Ahishar—in charge of the palace; and Adoniram son of Abda—in
charge of the forced labor.

translation.text: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.

verses.english:
Ahishar—in charge of the palace; and Adoniram son of Abda—in
charge of the forced labor.

verses.hebrew: וְלִשְׁלֹמֹה שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר נִצָּבִים עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִלְכְּלוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ חֹדֶשׁ בַּשָּׁנָה יִהְיֶה עַל־[הָאֶחָד] (אחד) לְכַלְכֵּל׃

hebrew.text: וְלִשְׁלֹמֹה שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר נִצָּבִים עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִלְכְּלוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ חֹדֶשׁ בַּשָּׁנָה יִהְיֶה עַל־[הָאֶחָד] (אחד) לְכַלְכֵּל׃

english.text:
Solomon had twelve prefects governing all Israel, who provided
food for the king and his household; each had to provide food for
one month in the year.

translation.text: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.

verses.english:
Solomon had twelve prefects governing all Israel, who provided
food for the king and his household; each had to provide food for
one month in the year.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹתָם בֶּן־חוּר בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹתָם בֶּן־חוּר בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם׃

english.text:
And these were their names: Ben-hur, in the hill country of
Ephraim;

translation.text: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:

verses.english:
And these were their names: Ben-hur, in the hill country of
Ephraim;

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־דֶּקֶר בְּמָקַץ וּבְשַׁעַלְבִים וּבֵית שָׁמֶשׁ וְאֵילוֹן בֵּית חָנָן׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־דֶּקֶר בְּמָקַץ וּבְשַׁעַלְבִים וּבֵית שָׁמֶשׁ וְאֵילוֹן בֵּית חָנָן׃

english.text: Ben-deker, in Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-shemesh, and Elon-beth-hanan;

translation.text: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Bethshemesh, and Elonbethhanan:

verses.english: Ben-deker, in Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-shemesh, and Elon-beth-hanan;

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־חֶסֶד בָּאֲרֻבּוֹת לוֹ שֹׂכֹה וְכל־אֶרֶץ חֵפֶר׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־חֶסֶד בָּאֲרֻבּוֹת לוֹ שֹׂכֹה וְכל־אֶרֶץ חֵפֶר׃

english.text: Ben-hesed in Arubboth—he governed Socho and all the Hepher area;

translation.text: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:

verses.english: Ben-hesed in Arubboth—he governed Socho and all the Hepher area;

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אֲבִינָדָב כּל־נָפַת דֹּאר טָפַת בַּת־שְׁלֹמֹה הָיְתָה לּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־אֲבִינָדָב כּל־נָפַת דֹּאר טָפַת בַּת־שְׁלֹמֹה הָיְתָה לּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
Ben-abinadab, [in] all of Naphath-dor (Solomon’s daughter Taphath
was his wife);

translation.text: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

verses.english:
Ben-abinadab, [in] all of Naphath-dor (Solomon’s daughter Taphath
was his wife);

verses.hebrew: בַּעֲנָא בֶּן־אֲחִילוּד תַּעְנַךְ וּמְגִדּוֹ וְכל־בֵּית שְׁאָן אֲשֶׁר אֵצֶל צָרְתַנָה מִתַּחַת לְיִזְרְעֶאל מִבֵּית שְׁאָן עַד אָבֵל מְחוֹלָה עַד מֵעֵבֶר לְיקְמְעָם׃

hebrew.text: בַּעֲנָא בֶּן־אֲחִילוּד תַּעְנַךְ וּמְגִדּוֹ וְכל־בֵּית שְׁאָן אֲשֶׁר אֵצֶל צָרְתַנָה מִתַּחַת לְיִזְרְעֶאל מִבֵּית שְׁאָן עַד אָבֵל מְחוֹלָה עַד מֵעֵבֶר לְיקְמְעָם׃

translation.text: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Bethshean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Bethshean to Abelmeholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokneam:

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־גֶּבֶר בְּרָמֹת גִּלְעָד לוֹ חַוֺּת יָאִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּלְעָד לוֹ חֶבֶל אַרְגֹּב אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּשָׁן שִׁשִּׁים עָרִים גְּדֹלוֹת חוֹמָה וּבְרִיחַ נְחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־גֶּבֶר בְּרָמֹת גִּלְעָד לוֹ חַוֺּת יָאִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּלְעָד לוֹ חֶבֶל אַרְגֹּב אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּשָׁן שִׁשִּׁים עָרִים גְּדֹלוֹת חוֹמָה וּבְרִיחַ נְחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
Ben-geber, in Ramoth-gilead—he governed the villages of Jair son
of Manasseh which are in Gilead, and he also governed the district
of Argob which is in Bashan, sixty large towns with walls and
bronze bars;

translation.text: The son of Geber, in Ramothgilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:

verses.english:
Ben-geber, in Ramoth-gilead—he governed the villages of Jair son
of Manasseh which are in Gilead, and he also governed the district
of Argob which is in Bashan, sixty large towns with walls and
bronze bars;

verses.hebrew: אֲחִינָדָב בֶּן־עִדֹּא מַחֲנָיְמָה׃

hebrew.text: אֲחִינָדָב בֶּן־עִדֹּא מַחֲנָיְמָה׃

english.text: Ahinadab son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;

translation.text: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:

verses.english: Ahinadab son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;

verses.hebrew: אֲחִימַעַץ בְּנַפְתָּלִי גַּם־הוּא לָקַח אֶת־בָּשְׂמַת בַּת־שְׁלֹמֹה לְאִשָּׁה׃

hebrew.text: אֲחִימַעַץ בְּנַפְתָּלִי גַּם־הוּא לָקַח אֶת־בָּשְׂמַת בַּת־שְׁלֹמֹה לְאִשָּׁה׃

english.text:
Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he too took a daughter of
Solomon—Basemath—to wife);

translation.text: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

verses.english:
Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he too took a daughter of
Solomon—Basemath—to wife);

verses.hebrew: בַּעֲנָא בֶּן־חוּשָׁי בְּאָשֵׁר וּבְעָלוֹת׃

hebrew.text: בַּעֲנָא בֶּן־חוּשָׁי בְּאָשֵׁר וּבְעָלוֹת׃

english.text: Baanah son of Hushi, in Asher and Bealoth;

translation.text: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:

verses.english: Baanah son of Hushi, in Asher and Bealoth;

verses.hebrew: יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־פָּרוּחַ בְּיִשָּׂשכָר׃

hebrew.text: יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־פָּרוּחַ בְּיִשָּׂשכָר׃

english.text: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah, in Issachar;

translation.text: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:

verses.english: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah, in Issachar;

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעִי בֶן־אֵלָא בְּבִנְיָמִן׃

hebrew.text: שִׁמְעִי בֶן־אֵלָא בְּבִנְיָמִן׃

english.text: Shimei son of Ela, in Benjamin;

translation.text: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:

verses.english: Shimei son of Ela, in Benjamin;

verses.hebrew: גֶּבֶר בֶּן־אֻרִי בְּאֶרֶץ גִּלְעָד אֶרֶץ סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי וְעֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וּנְצִיב אֶחָד אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: גֶּבֶר בֶּן־אֻרִי בְּאֶרֶץ גִּלְעָד אֶרֶץ סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי וְעֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וּנְצִיב אֶחָד אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Geber son of Uri, in the region of Gilead, the country of Sihon,
king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan; and one prefect who
was in the land.

translation.text: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.

verses.english:
Geber son of Uri, in the region of Gilead, the country of Sihon,
king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan; and one prefect who
was in the land.

verses.hebrew: יְהוּדָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל רַבִּים כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַיָּם לָרֹב אֹכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים וּשְׂמֵחִים׃

hebrew.text: יְהוּדָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל רַבִּים כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַיָּם לָרֹב אֹכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים וּשְׂמֵחִים׃

english.text:
Judah and Israel were as numerous as the sands of the sea; they
ate and drank and were content.

translation.text: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.

verses.english:
Judah and Israel were as numerous as the sands of the sea; they
ate and drank and were content.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁלֹמֹה הָיָה מוֹשֵׁל בְּכל־הַמַּמְלָכוֹת מִן־הַנָּהָר אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְעַד גְּבוּל מִצְרָיִם מַגִּשִׁים מִנְחָה וְעֹבְדִים אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה כּל־יְמֵי חַיָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁלֹמֹה הָיָה מוֹשֵׁל בְּכל־הַמַּמְלָכוֹת מִן־הַנָּהָר אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְעַד גְּבוּל מִצְרָיִם מַגִּשִׁים מִנְחָה וְעֹבְדִים אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה כּל־יְמֵי חַיָּיו׃

english.text:
Solomon’s rule extended over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates
to the land of the Philistines and the boundary of Egypt. They
brought Solomon tribute and were subject to him all his life.

translation.text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.

verses.english:
Solomon’s rule extended over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates
to the land of the Philistines and the boundary of Egypt. They
brought Solomon tribute and were subject to him all his life.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לֶחֶם־שְׁלֹמֹה לְיוֹם אֶחָד שְׁלֹשִׁים כֹּר סֹלֶת וְשִׁשִּׁים כֹּר קָמַח׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לֶחֶם־שְׁלֹמֹה לְיוֹם אֶחָד שְׁלֹשִׁים כֹּר סֹלֶת וְשִׁשִּׁים כֹּר קָמַח׃

english.text:
Solomon’s daily provisions consisted of 30 kors of semolina, and
60 kors of [ordinary] flour,

translation.text: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

verses.english:
Solomon’s daily provisions consisted of 30 kors of semolina, and
60 kors of [ordinary] flour,

verses.hebrew: עֲשָׂרָה בָקָר בְּרִאִים וְעֶשְׂרִים בָּקָר רְעִי וּמֵאָה צֹאן לְבַד מֵאַיָּל וּצְבִי וְיַחְמוּר וּבַרְבֻּרִים אֲבוּסִים׃

hebrew.text: עֲשָׂרָה בָקָר בְּרִאִים וְעֶשְׂרִים בָּקָר רְעִי וּמֵאָה צֹאן לְבַד מֵאַיָּל וּצְבִי וְיַחְמוּר וּבַרְבֻּרִים אֲבוּסִים׃

english.text:
10 fattened oxen, 20 pasture-fed oxen, and 100 sheep and goats,
besides deer and gazelles, roebucks and fatted geese.

translation.text: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.

verses.english:
10 fattened oxen, 20 pasture-fed oxen, and 100 sheep and goats,
besides deer and gazelles, roebucks and fatted geese.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הוּא רֹדֶה בְּכל־עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר מִתִּפְסַח וְעַד־עַזָּה בְּכל־מַלְכֵי עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וְשָׁלוֹם הָיָה לוֹ מִכּל־עֲבָרָיו מִסָּבִיב׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־הוּא רֹדֶה בְּכל־עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר מִתִּפְסַח וְעַד־עַזָּה בְּכל־מַלְכֵי עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וְשָׁלוֹם הָיָה לוֹ מִכּל־עֲבָרָיו מִסָּבִיב׃

english.text:
For he controlled the whole region west of the Euphrates—all the
kings west of the Euphrates, from Tiphsah to Gaza—and he had peace
on all his borders round about.

translation.text: But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.

verses.english:
For he controlled the whole region west of the Euphrates—all the
kings west of the Euphrates, from Tiphsah to Gaza—and he had peace
on all his borders round about.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב יְהוּדָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לָבֶטַח אִישׁ תַּחַת גַּפְנוֹ וְתַחַת תְּאֵנָתוֹ מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שָׁבַע כֹּל יְמֵי שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב יְהוּדָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לָבֶטַח אִישׁ תַּחַת גַּפְנוֹ וְתַחַת תְּאֵנָתוֹ מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שָׁבַע כֹּל יְמֵי שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
All the days of Solomon, Judah and Israel from Dan to Beer-sheba
dwelt in safety, everyone under his own vine and under his own fig
tree.

translation.text: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.

verses.english:
All the days of Solomon, Judah and Israel from Dan to Beer-sheba
dwelt in safety, everyone under his own vine and under his own fig
tree.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִשְׁלֹמֹה אַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף אֻרְוֺת סוּסִים לְמֶרְכָּבוֹ וּשְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף פָּרָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לִשְׁלֹמֹה אַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף אֻרְוֺת סוּסִים לְמֶרְכָּבוֹ וּשְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף פָּרָשִׁים׃

english.text:
Solomon had 40,000 stalls of horses for his chariotry and 12,000
horsemen.

translation.text: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.

verses.english:
Solomon had 40,000 stalls of horses for his chariotry and 12,000
horsemen.

verses.hebrew: וְכִלְכְּלוּ הַנִּצָּבִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וְאֵת כּל־הַקָּרֵב אֶל־שֻׁלְחַן הַמֶּלֶךְ־שְׁלֹמֹה אִישׁ חדְשׁוֹ לֹא יְעַדְּרוּ דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: וְכִלְכְּלוּ הַנִּצָּבִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וְאֵת כּל־הַקָּרֵב אֶל־שֻׁלְחַן הַמֶּלֶךְ־שְׁלֹמֹה אִישׁ חדְשׁוֹ לֹא יְעַדְּרוּ דָּבָר׃

english.text:
All those prefects, each during his month, would furnish
provisions for King Solomon and for all who were admitted to King
Solomon’s table; they did not fall short in anything.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the LORD this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.

verses.english:
All those prefects, each during his month, would furnish
provisions for King Solomon and for all who were admitted to King
Solomon’s table; they did not fall short in anything.

verses.hebrew: וְהַשְּׂעֹרִים וְהַתֶּבֶן לַסּוּסִים וְלָרָכֶשׁ יָבִאוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה־שָּׁם אִישׁ כְּמִשְׁפָּטוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשְּׂעֹרִים וְהַתֶּבֶן לַסּוּסִים וְלָרָכֶשׁ יָבִאוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה־שָּׁם אִישׁ כְּמִשְׁפָּטוֹ׃

english.text:
They would also, each in his turn, deliver barley and straw for
the horses and the swift steeds to the places where they were
stationed.

translation.text: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.

verses.english:
They would also, each in his turn, deliver barley and straw for
the horses and the swift steeds to the places where they were
stationed.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אֱלֹהִים חכְמָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה וּתְבוּנָה הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד וְרֹחַב לֵב כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת הַיָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן אֱלֹהִים חכְמָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה וּתְבוּנָה הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד וְרֹחַב לֵב כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת הַיָּם׃

english.text:
God endowed Solomon with wisdom and discernment in great measure,
with understanding as vast as the sands on the seashore.

translation.text: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.

verses.english:
God endowed Solomon with wisdom and discernment in great measure,
with understanding as vast as the sands on the seashore.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶב חכְמַת שְׁלֹמֹה מֵחכְמַת כּל־בְּנֵי־קֶדֶם וּמִכֹּל חכְמַת מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרֶב חכְמַת שְׁלֹמֹה מֵחכְמַת כּל־בְּנֵי־קֶדֶם וּמִכֹּל חכְמַת מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
Solomon’s wisdom was greater than the wisdom of all the Kedemites
and than all the wis dom of the Egyptians.

translation.text: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.

verses.english:
Solomon’s wisdom was greater than the wisdom of all the Kedemites
and than all the wis dom of the Egyptians.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחְכַּם מִכּל־הָאָדָם מֵאֵיתָן הָאֶזְרָחִי וְהֵימָן וְכַלְכֹּל וְדַרְדַּע בְּנֵי מָחוֹל וַיְהִי־שְׁמוֹ בְכל־הַגּוֹיִם סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּחְכַּם מִכּל־הָאָדָם מֵאֵיתָן הָאֶזְרָחִי וְהֵימָן וְכַלְכֹּל וְדַרְדַּע בְּנֵי מָחוֹל וַיְהִי־שְׁמוֹ בְכל־הַגּוֹיִם סָבִיב׃

english.text:
He was the wisest of all men: [wiser] than Ethan the Ezrahite, and
Heman, Chalkol, and Darda the sons of Mahol. His fame spread among
all the surrounding nations.

translation.text: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.

verses.english:
He was the wisest of all men: [wiser] than Ethan the Ezrahite, and
Heman, Chalkol, and Darda the sons of Mahol. His fame spread among
all the surrounding nations.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים מָשָׁל וַיְהִי שִׁירוֹ חֲמִשָּׁה וָאָלֶף׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים מָשָׁל וַיְהִי שִׁירוֹ חֲמִשָּׁה וָאָלֶף׃

english.text:
He composed three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered one
thousand and five.

translation.text: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.

verses.english:
He composed three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered one
thousand and five.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר עַל־הָעֵצִים מִן־הָאֶרֶז אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן וְעַד הָאֵזוֹב אֲשֶׁר יֹצֵא בַּקִּיר וַיְדַבֵּר עַל־הַבְּהֵמָה וְעַל־הָעוֹף וְעַל־הָרֶמֶשׂ וְעַל־הַדָּגִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר עַל־הָעֵצִים מִן־הָאֶרֶז אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן וְעַד הָאֵזוֹב אֲשֶׁר יֹצֵא בַּקִּיר וַיְדַבֵּר עַל־הַבְּהֵמָה וְעַל־הָעוֹף וְעַל־הָרֶמֶשׂ וְעַל־הַדָּגִים׃

english.text:
He discoursed about trees, from the cedar in Lebanon to the hyssop
that grows out of the wall; and he discoursed about beasts, birds,
creeping things, and fishes.

translation.text: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

verses.english:
He discoursed about trees, from the cedar in Lebanon to the hyssop
that grows out of the wall; and he discoursed about beasts, birds,
creeping things, and fishes.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ מִכּל־הָעַמִּים לִשְׁמֹעַ אֵת חכְמַת שְׁלֹמֹה מֵאֵת כּל־מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר שָׁמְעוּ אֶת־חכְמָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ מִכּל־הָעַמִּים לִשְׁמֹעַ אֵת חכְמַת שְׁלֹמֹה מֵאֵת כּל־מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר שָׁמְעוּ אֶת־חכְמָתוֹ׃

english.text:
Men of all peoples came to hear Solomon’s wisdom, [sent] by all
the kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom.

translation.text: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.

verses.english:
Men of all peoples came to hear Solomon’s wisdom, [sent] by all
the kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם מֶלֶךְ־צוֹר אֶת־עֲבָדָיו אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה כִּי שָׁמַע כִּי אֹתוֹ מָשְׁחוּ לְמֶלֶךְ תַּחַת אָבִיהוּ כִּי אֹהֵב הָיָה חִירָם לְדָוִד כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם מֶלֶךְ־צוֹר אֶת־עֲבָדָיו אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה כִּי שָׁמַע כִּי אֹתוֹ מָשְׁחוּ לְמֶלֶךְ תַּחַת אָבִיהוּ כִּי אֹהֵב הָיָה חִירָם לְדָוִד כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
King Hiram of Tyre sent his officials to Solomon when he heard
that he had been anointed king in place of his father; for Hiram
had always been a friend of David.

translation.text: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;

verses.english:
King Hiram of Tyre sent his officials to Solomon when he heard
that he had been anointed king in place of his father; for Hiram
had always been a friend of David.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח שְׁלֹמֹה אֶל־חִירָם לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח שְׁלֹמֹה אֶל־חִירָם לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: Solomon sent this message to Hiram:

translation.text: Beside the chief of Solomon’s officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.

verses.english: Solomon sent this message to Hiram:

verses.hebrew:
אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־דָּוִד אָבִי כִּי לֹא יָכֹל לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו מִפְּנֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲשֶׁר סְבָבֻהוּ עַד תֵּת־יְהֹוָה אֹתָם תַּחַת כַּפּוֹת (רגלו)
[רַגְלָי]׃

hebrew.text:
אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־דָּוִד אָבִי כִּי לֹא יָכֹל לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו מִפְּנֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲשֶׁר סְבָבֻהוּ עַד תֵּת־יְהֹוָה אֹתָם תַּחַת כַּפּוֹת (רגלו)
[רַגְלָי]׃

english.text:
“You know that my father David could not build a house for the
name of YHWH his God because of the enemies that encompassed him,
until YHWH had placed them under the soles of his feet.

translation.text: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.

verses.english:
“You know that my father David could not build a house for the
name of YHWH his God because of the enemies that encompassed him,
until YHWH had placed them under the soles of his feet.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הֵנִיחַ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהַי לִי מִסָּבִיב אֵין שָׂטָן וְאֵין פֶּגַע רָע׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הֵנִיחַ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהַי לִי מִסָּבִיב אֵין שָׂטָן וְאֵין פֶּגַע רָע׃

english.text:
But now YHWH my God has given me respite all around; there is no
adversary and no mischance.

translation.text: And Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.

verses.english:
But now YHWH my God has given me respite all around; there is no
adversary and no mischance.

verses.hebrew:
וְהִנְנִי אֹמֵר לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד אָבִי לֵאמֹר בִּנְךָ אֲשֶׁר אֶתֵּן תַּחְתֶּיךָ עַל־כִּסְאֶךָ הוּא־יִבְנֶה הַבַּיִת
לִשְׁמִי׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִנְנִי אֹמֵר לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד אָבִי לֵאמֹר בִּנְךָ אֲשֶׁר אֶתֵּן תַּחְתֶּיךָ עַל־כִּסְאֶךָ הוּא־יִבְנֶה הַבַּיִת
לִשְׁמִי׃

english.text:
And so I propose to build a house for the name of YHWH my God, as
YHWH promised my father David, saying, ‘Your son, whom I will set
on your throne in your place, shall build the house for My name.’

verses.english:
And so I propose to build a house for the name of YHWH my God, as
YHWH promised my father David, saying, ‘Your son, whom I will set
on your throne in your place, shall build the house for My name.’

verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה צַוֵּה וְיִכְרְתוּ־לִי אֲרָזִים מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן וַעֲבָדַי יִהְיוּ עִם־עֲבָדֶיךָ וּשְׂכַר עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶתֵּן לְךָ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמֵר כִּי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ כִּי אֵין בָּנוּ
אִישׁ יֹדֵעַ לִכְרת־עֵצִים כַּצִּדֹנִים׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה צַוֵּה וְיִכְרְתוּ־לִי אֲרָזִים מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן וַעֲבָדַי יִהְיוּ עִם־עֲבָדֶיךָ וּשְׂכַר עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶתֵּן לְךָ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמֵר כִּי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ כִּי אֵין בָּנוּ
אִישׁ יֹדֵעַ לִכְרת־עֵצִים כַּצִּדֹנִים׃

english.text:
Please, then, give orders for cedars to be cut for me in the
Lebanon. My servants will work with yours, and I will pay you any
wages you may ask for your servants; for as you know, there is
none among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.”

verses.english:
Please, then, give orders for cedars to be cut for me in the
Lebanon. My servants will work with yours, and I will pay you any
wages you may ask for your servants; for as you know, there is
none among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ חִירָם אֶת־דִּבְרֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּשְׂמַח מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְדָוִד בֵּן חָכָם עַל־הָעָם הָרָב הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ חִירָם אֶת־דִּבְרֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּשְׂמַח מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְדָוִד בֵּן חָכָם עַל־הָעָם הָרָב הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
When Hiram heard Solomon’s message, he was overjoyed. “Praised be
YHWH this day,” he said, “for granting David a wise son to govern
this great people.”

verses.english:
When Hiram heard Solomon’s message, he was overjoyed. “Praised be
YHWH this day,” he said, “for granting David a wise son to govern
this great people.”

english.text:
YHWH had given Solomon wisdom, as He had promised him. There was
friendship between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a
treaty.

King Solomon imposed forced labor on all Israel; the levy came to
30,000 men.

english.text:
He sent them to the Lebanon in shifts of 10,000 a month: they
would spend one month in the Lebanon and two months at home.
Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor.

made ready.

english.text:
In the four hundred and eightieth year after the Israelites left
the land of Egypt, in the month of Ziv—that is, the second
month—in the fourth year of his reign over Israel, Solomon began
to build the House of YHWH.

translation.text: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
In the four hundred and eightieth year after the Israelites left
the land of Egypt, in the month of Ziv—that is, the second

english.text:
The House which King Solomon built for YHWH was 60 cubits long, 20
cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.

translation.text: And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.

verses.english:
The House which King Solomon built for YHWH was 60 cubits long, 20

verses.english:
The portico in front of the Great Hall of the House was 20 cubits

english.text: He made windows for the House, recessed and latticed.

translation.text: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.

verses.english: He made windows for the House, recessed and latticed.

structure; and he made side chambers all around.

Against the outside wall of the House—the outside walls of the
House enclosing the Great Hall and the Shrine—he built a storied
structure; and he made side chambers all around.

translation.text: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.

verses.english:
The lowest story was 5 cubits wide, the middle one 6 cubits wide,
and the third 7 cubits wide; for he had provided recesses around
the outside of the House so as not to penetrate the walls of the
House.

verses.hebrew: וְהַבַּיִת בְּהִבָּנֹתוֹ אֶבֶן־שְׁלֵמָה מַסָּע נִבְנָה וּמַקָּבוֹת וְהַגַּרְזֶן כּל־כְּלִי בַרְזֶל לֹא־נִשְׁמַע בַּבַּיִת בְּהִבָּנֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבַּיִת בְּהִבָּנֹתוֹ אֶבֶן־שְׁלֵמָה מַסָּע נִבְנָה וּמַקָּבוֹת וְהַגַּרְזֶן כּל־כְּלִי בַרְזֶל לֹא־נִשְׁמַע בַּבַּיִת בְּהִבָּנֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
When the House was built, only finished stones cut at the quarry
were used, so that no hammer or ax or any iron tool was heard in
the House while it was being built.

translation.text: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.

verses.english:
When the House was built, only finished stones cut at the quarry
were used, so that no hammer or ax or any iron tool was heard in
the House while it was being built.

verses.hebrew: פֶּתַח הַצֵּלָע הַתִּיכֹנָה אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית וּבְלוּלִּים יַעֲלוּ עַל־הַתִּיכֹנָה וּמִן־הַתִּיכֹנָה אֶל־הַשְּׁלִשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: פֶּתַח הַצֵּלָע הַתִּיכֹנָה אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית וּבְלוּלִּים יַעֲלוּ עַל־הַתִּיכֹנָה וּמִן־הַתִּיכֹנָה אֶל־הַשְּׁלִשִׁים׃

english.text:
The entrance to the middle [story of] the side chambers was on the
right side of the House; and winding stairs led up to the middle
chambers, and from the middle chambers to the third story.

translation.text: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.

verses.english:
The entrance to the middle [story of] the side chambers was on the
right side of the House; and winding stairs led up to the middle
chambers, and from the middle chambers to the third story.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הַבַּיִת וַיְכַלֵּהוּ וַיִּסְפֹּן אֶת־הַבַּיִת גֵּבִים וּשְׂדֵרֹת בָּאֲרָזִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הַבַּיִת וַיְכַלֵּהוּ וַיִּסְפֹּן אֶת־הַבַּיִת גֵּבִים וּשְׂדֵרֹת בָּאֲרָזִים׃

english.text:
When he finished building the House, he paneled the House with
beams and planks of cedar.

translation.text: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.

verses.english:
When he finished building the House, he paneled the House with
beams and planks of cedar.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־[הַיָּצִיעַ] (היצוע) עַל־כּל־הַבַּיִת חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמָתוֹ וַיֶּאֱחֹז אֶת־הַבַּיִת בַּעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־[הַיָּצִיעַ] (היצוע) עַל־כּל־הַבַּיִת חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמָתוֹ וַיֶּאֱחֹז אֶת־הַבַּיִת בַּעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים׃

english.text:
He built the storied structure against the entire House—each story
5 cubits high, so that it encased the House with timbers of cedar.

translation.text: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.

verses.english:
He built the storied structure against the entire House—each story
5 cubits high, so that it encased the House with timbers of cedar.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: Then the word of YHWH came to Solomon,

translation.text: And the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying,

verses.english: Then the word of YHWH came to Solomon,

verses.hebrew:
הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּה בֹנֶה אִם־תֵּלֵךְ בְּחֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַי תַּעֲשֶׂה וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־כּל־מִצְוֺתַי לָלֶכֶת בָּהֶם וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת־דְּבָרִי אִתָּךְ אֲשֶׁר
דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶל־דָּוִד אָבִיךָ׃

hebrew.text:
הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּה בֹנֶה אִם־תֵּלֵךְ בְּחֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַי תַּעֲשֶׂה וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־כּל־מִצְוֺתַי לָלֶכֶת בָּהֶם וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת־דְּבָרִי אִתָּךְ אֲשֶׁר
דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶל־דָּוִד אָבִיךָ׃

english.text:
“With regard to this House you are building—if you follow My laws
and observe My rules and faithfully keep My commandments, I will
fulfill for you the promise that I gave to your father David:

translation.text: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:

verses.english:
“With regard to this House you are building—if you follow My laws
and observe My rules and faithfully keep My commandments, I will
fulfill for you the promise that I gave to your father David:

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא אֶעֱזֹב אֶת־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא אֶעֱזֹב אֶת־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
I will abide among the children of Israel, and I will never
forsake My people Israel.”

translation.text: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.

verses.english:
I will abide among the children of Israel, and I will never
forsake My people Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַבַּיִת וַיְכַלֵּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַבַּיִת וַיְכַלֵּהוּ׃

english.text: When Solomon had completed the construction of the House,

translation.text: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

verses.english: When Solomon had completed the construction of the House,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת מִבַּיְתָה בְּצַלְעוֹת אֲרָזִים מִקַּרְקַע הַבַּיִת עַד־קִירוֹת הַסִּפֻּן צִפָּה עֵץ מִבָּיִת וַיְצַף אֶת־קַרְקַע הַבַּיִת בְּצַלְעוֹת בְּרוֹשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת מִבַּיְתָה בְּצַלְעוֹת אֲרָזִים מִקַּרְקַע הַבַּיִת עַד־קִירוֹת הַסִּפֻּן צִפָּה עֵץ מִבָּיִת וַיְצַף אֶת־קַרְקַע הַבַּיִת בְּצַלְעוֹת בְּרוֹשִׁים׃

english.text:
he paneled the walls of the House on the inside with planks of
cedar. He also overlaid the walls on the inside with wood, from
the floor of the House to the ceiling. And he overlaid the floor
of the House with planks of cypress.

translation.text: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the ceiling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.

verses.english:
he paneled the walls of the House on the inside with planks of
cedar. He also overlaid the walls on the inside with wood, from
the floor of the House to the ceiling. And he overlaid the floor
of the House with planks of cypress.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה (מירכותי) [מִיַּרְכְּתֵי] הַבַּיִת בְּצַלְעוֹת אֲרָזִים מִן־הַקַּרְקַע עַד־הַקִּירוֹת וַיִּבֶן לוֹ מִבַּיִת לִדְבִיר לְקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה (מירכותי) [מִיַּרְכְּתֵי] הַבַּיִת בְּצַלְעוֹת אֲרָזִים מִן־הַקַּרְקַע עַד־הַקִּירוֹת וַיִּבֶן לוֹ מִבַּיִת לִדְבִיר לְקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים׃

english.text:
Twenty cubits from the rear of the House, he built [a partition]
of cedar planks from the floor to the walls; he furnished its
interior to serve as a shrine, as the Holy of Holies.

translation.text: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.

verses.english:
Twenty cubits from the rear of the House, he built [a partition]
of cedar planks from the floor to the walls; he furnished its
interior to serve as a shrine, as the Holy of Holies.

verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעִים בָּאַמָּה הָיָה הַבָּיִת הוּא הַהֵיכָל לִפְנָי׃

hebrew.text: וְאַרְבָּעִים בָּאַמָּה הָיָה הַבָּיִת הוּא הַהֵיכָל לִפְנָי׃

english.text:
The front part of the House, that is, the Great Hall, measured 40
cubits.

translation.text: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.

verses.english:
The front part of the House, that is, the Great Hall, measured 40
cubits.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶרֶז אֶל־הַבַּיִת פְּנִימָה מִקְלַעַת פְּקָעִים וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים הַכֹּל אֶרֶז אֵין אֶבֶן נִרְאָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶרֶז אֶל־הַבַּיִת פְּנִימָה מִקְלַעַת פְּקָעִים וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים הַכֹּל אֶרֶז אֵין אֶבֶן נִרְאָה׃

english.text:
The cedar of the interior of the House had carvings of gourds and
calyxes; it was all cedar, no stone was exposed.

translation.text: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.

verses.english:
The cedar of the interior of the House had carvings of gourds and
calyxes; it was all cedar, no stone was exposed.

verses.hebrew: וּדְבִיר בְּתוֹךְ־הַבַּיִת מִפְּנִימָה הֵכִין לְתִתֵּן שָׁם אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וּדְבִיר בְּתוֹךְ־הַבַּיִת מִפְּנִימָה הֵכִין לְתִתֵּן שָׁם אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
In the innermost part of the House, he fixed a Shrine in which to
place the Ark of YHWH’s Covenant.

translation.text: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

verses.english:
In the innermost part of the House, he fixed a Shrine in which to
place the Ark of YHWH’s Covenant.

verses.hebrew: וְלִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה אֹרֶךְ וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה רֹחַב וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב סָגוּר וַיְצַף מִזְבֵּחַ אָרֶז׃

hebrew.text: וְלִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה אֹרֶךְ וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה רֹחַב וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב סָגוּר וַיְצַף מִזְבֵּחַ אָרֶז׃

english.text:
The interior of the Shrine was 20 cubits long, 20 cubits wide, and
20 cubits high. He overlaid it with solid gold; he similarly
overlaid [its] cedar altar.

translation.text: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.

verses.english:
The interior of the Shrine was 20 cubits long, 20 cubits wide, and
20 cubits high. He overlaid it with solid gold; he similarly
overlaid [its] cedar altar.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַף שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַבַּיִת מִפְּנִימָה זָהָב סָגוּר וַיְעַבֵּר (ברתיקות) [בְּרַתּוּקוֹת] זָהָב לִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַף שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַבַּיִת מִפְּנִימָה זָהָב סָגוּר וַיְעַבֵּר (ברתיקות) [בְּרַתּוּקוֹת] זָהָב לִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב׃

english.text:
Solomon overlaid the interior of the House with solid gold; and he
inserted golden chains into the door of the Shrine. He overlaid
[the Shrine] with gold,

translation.text: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.

verses.english:
Solomon overlaid the interior of the House with solid gold; and he
inserted golden chains into the door of the Shrine. He overlaid
[the Shrine] with gold,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־כּל־הַבַּיִת צִפָּה זָהָב עַד־תֹּם כּל־הַבָּיִת וְכל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר־לַדְּבִיר צִפָּה זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־כּל־הַבַּיִת צִפָּה זָהָב עַד־תֹּם כּל־הַבָּיִת וְכל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר־לַדְּבִיר צִפָּה זָהָב׃

english.text:
so that the entire House was overlaid with gold; he even overlaid
with gold the entire altar of the Shrine. And so the entire House
was completed.

translation.text: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.

verses.english:
so that the entire House was overlaid with gold; he even overlaid
with gold the entire altar of the Shrine. And so the entire House
was completed.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ בַּדְּבִיר שְׁנֵי כְרוּבִים עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת קוֹמָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ בַּדְּבִיר שְׁנֵי כְרוּבִים עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת קוֹמָתוֹ׃

english.text:
In the Shrine he made two cherubim of olive wood, each 10 cubits
high.

translation.text: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.

verses.english:
In the Shrine he made two cherubim of olive wood, each 10 cubits
high.

verses.hebrew: וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת כְּנַף הַכְּרוּב הָאֶחָת וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת כְּנַף הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִית עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת מִקְצוֹת כְּנָפָיו וְעַד־קְצוֹת כְּנָפָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת כְּנַף הַכְּרוּב הָאֶחָת וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת כְּנַף הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִית עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת מִקְצוֹת כְּנָפָיו וְעַד־קְצוֹת כְּנָפָיו׃

english.text:
[One] had a wing measuring 5 cubits and another wing measuring 5
cubits, so that the spread from wingtip to wingtip was 10 cubits;

translation.text: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.

verses.english:
[One] had a wing measuring 5 cubits and another wing measuring 5
cubits, so that the spread from wingtip to wingtip was 10 cubits;

verses.hebrew: וְעֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי מִדָּה אַחַת וְקֶצֶב אֶחָד לִשְׁנֵי הַכְּרֻבִים׃

hebrew.text: וְעֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי מִדָּה אַחַת וְקֶצֶב אֶחָד לִשְׁנֵי הַכְּרֻבִים׃

english.text:
and the wingspread of the other cherub was also 10 cubits. The two
cherubim had the same measurements and proportions:

translation.text: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.

verses.english:
and the wingspread of the other cherub was also 10 cubits. The two
cherubim had the same measurements and proportions:

verses.hebrew: קוֹמַת הַכְּרוּב הָאֶחָד עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה וְכֵן הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי׃

hebrew.text: קוֹמַת הַכְּרוּב הָאֶחָד עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה וְכֵן הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי׃

english.text:
the height of the one cherub was 10 cubits, and so was that of the
other cherub.

translation.text: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.

verses.english:
the height of the one cherub was 10 cubits, and so was that of the
other cherub.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַכְּרוּבִים בְּתוֹךְ הַבַּיִת הַפְּנִימִי וַיִּפְרְשׂוּ אֶת־כַּנְפֵי הַכְּרֻבִים וַתִּגַּע כְּנַף־הָאֶחָד בַּקִּיר וּכְנַף הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי נֹגַעַת בַּקִּיר
הַשֵּׁנִי וְכַנְפֵיהֶם אֶל־תּוֹךְ הַבַּיִת נֹגְעֹת כָּנָף אֶל־כָּנָף׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַכְּרוּבִים בְּתוֹךְ הַבַּיִת הַפְּנִימִי וַיִּפְרְשׂוּ אֶת־כַּנְפֵי הַכְּרֻבִים וַתִּגַּע כְּנַף־הָאֶחָד בַּקִּיר וּכְנַף הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי נֹגַעַת בַּקִּיר
הַשֵּׁנִי וְכַנְפֵיהֶם אֶל־תּוֹךְ הַבַּיִת נֹגְעֹת כָּנָף אֶל־כָּנָף׃

english.text:
He placed the cherubim inside the inner chamber. Since the wings
of the cherubim were extended, a wing of the one touched one wall
and a wing of the other touched the other wall, while their wings
in the center of the chamber touched each other.

translation.text: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.

verses.english:
He placed the cherubim inside the inner chamber. Since the wings
of the cherubim were extended, a wing of the one touched one wall
and a wing of the other touched the other wall, while their wings
in the center of the chamber touched each other.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַף אֶת־הַכְּרוּבִים זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַף אֶת־הַכְּרוּבִים זָהָב׃

english.text: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

translation.text: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.

verses.english: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כּל־קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת מֵסַב קָלַע פִּתּוּחֵי מִקְלְעוֹת כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרֹת וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים מִלִּפְנִים וְלַחִיצוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת כּל־קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת מֵסַב קָלַע פִּתּוּחֵי מִקְלְעוֹת כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרֹת וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים מִלִּפְנִים וְלַחִיצוֹן׃

english.text:
All over the walls of the House, of both the inner area and the
outer area, he carved reliefs of cherubim, palms, and calyxes,

translation.text: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.

verses.english:
All over the walls of the House, of both the inner area and the
outer area, he carved reliefs of cherubim, palms, and calyxes,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־קַרְקַע הַבַּיִת צִפָּה זָהָב לִפְנִימָה וְלַחִיצוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־קַרְקַע הַבַּיִת צִפָּה זָהָב לִפְנִימָה וְלַחִיצוֹן׃

english.text:
and he overlaid the floor of the House with gold, both the inner
and the outer areas.

translation.text: And the floors of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.

verses.english:
and he overlaid the floor of the House with gold, both the inner
and the outer areas.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת פֶּתַח הַדְּבִיר עָשָׂה דַּלְתוֹת עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן הָאַיִל מְזוּזוֹת חֲמִשִׁית׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת פֶּתַח הַדְּבִיר עָשָׂה דַּלְתוֹת עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן הָאַיִל מְזוּזוֹת חֲמִשִׁית׃

english.text:
For the entrance of the Shrine he made doors of olive wood, the
pilasters and the doorposts having five sides.

translation.text: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.

verses.english:
For the entrance of the Shrine he made doors of olive wood, the
pilasters and the doorposts having five sides.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי דַּלְתוֹת עֲצֵי־שֶׁמֶן וְקָלַע עֲלֵיהֶם מִקְלְעוֹת כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרֹת וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים וְצִפָּה זָהָב וַיָּרֶד עַל־הַכְּרוּבִים וְעַל־הַתִּמֹרוֹת אֶת־הַזָּהָב׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁתֵּי דַּלְתוֹת עֲצֵי־שֶׁמֶן וְקָלַע עֲלֵיהֶם מִקְלְעוֹת כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרֹת וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים וְצִפָּה זָהָב וַיָּרֶד עַל־הַכְּרוּבִים וְעַל־הַתִּמֹרוֹת אֶת־הַזָּהָב׃

english.text:
The double doors were of olive wood, and on them he carved reliefs
of cherubim, palms, and calyxes. He overlaid them with gold,
hammering the gold onto the cherubim and the palms.

translation.text: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.

verses.english:
The double doors were of olive wood, and on them he carved reliefs
of cherubim, palms, and calyxes. He overlaid them with gold,
hammering the gold onto the cherubim and the palms.

verses.hebrew: וְכֵן עָשָׂה לְפֶתַח הַהֵיכָל מְזוּזוֹת עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן מֵאֵת רְבִעִית׃

hebrew.text: וְכֵן עָשָׂה לְפֶתַח הַהֵיכָל מְזוּזוֹת עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן מֵאֵת רְבִעִית׃

english.text:
For the entrance of the Great Hall, too, he made doorposts of
oleaster wood, having four sides,

translation.text: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.

verses.english:
For the entrance of the Great Hall, too, he made doorposts of
oleaster wood, having four sides,

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי דַלְתוֹת עֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים שְׁנֵי צְלָעִים הַדֶּלֶת הָאַחַת גְּלִילִים וּשְׁנֵי קְלָעִים הַדֶּלֶת הַשֵּׁנִית גְּלִילִים׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁתֵּי דַלְתוֹת עֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים שְׁנֵי צְלָעִים הַדֶּלֶת הָאַחַת גְּלִילִים וּשְׁנֵי קְלָעִים הַדֶּלֶת הַשֵּׁנִית גְּלִילִים׃

english.text:
and the double doors of cypress wood, each door consisting of two
rounded planks.

translation.text: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

verses.english:
and the double doors of cypress wood, each door consisting of two
rounded planks.

verses.hebrew: וְקָלַע כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרוֹת וּפְטֻרֵי צִצִּים וְצִפָּה זָהָב מְיֻשָּׁר עַל־הַמְּחֻקֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְקָלַע כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרוֹת וּפְטֻרֵי צִצִּים וְצִפָּה זָהָב מְיֻשָּׁר עַל־הַמְּחֻקֶּה׃

english.text:
On them he carved cherubim, palms, and calyxes, overlaying them
with gold applied evenly over the carvings.

translation.text: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.

verses.english:
On them he carved cherubim, palms, and calyxes, overlaying them
with gold applied evenly over the carvings.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִית שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרֵי גָזִית וְטוּר כְּרֻתֹת אֲרָזִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִית שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרֵי גָזִית וְטוּר כְּרֻתֹת אֲרָזִים׃

english.text:
He built the inner enclosure of three courses of hewn stones and
one course of cedar beams.

translation.text: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.

verses.english:
He built the inner enclosure of three courses of hewn stones and
one course of cedar beams.

verses.hebrew: בַּשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִית יֻסַּד בֵּית יְהֹוָה בְּיֶרַח זִו׃

hebrew.text: בַּשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִית יֻסַּד בֵּית יְהֹוָה בְּיֶרַח זִו׃

english.text:
In the fourth year, in the month of Ziv, the foundations of the
House of YHWH were laid;

translation.text: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:

verses.english:
In the fourth year, in the month of Ziv, the foundations of the
House of YHWH were laid;

verses.hebrew: וּבַשָּׁנָה הָאַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה בְּיֶרַח בּוּל הוּא הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִי כָּלָה הַבַּיִת לְכל־דְּבָרָיו וּלְכל־מִשְׁפָּטָו וַיִּבְנֵהוּ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וּבַשָּׁנָה הָאַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה בְּיֶרַח בּוּל הוּא הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִי כָּלָה הַבַּיִת לְכל־דְּבָרָיו וּלְכל־מִשְׁפָּטָו וַיִּבְנֵהוּ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
and in the eleventh year, in the month of Bul—that is, the eighth
month—the House was completed according to all its details and all
its specifications. It took him seven years to build it.

translation.text: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.

verses.english:
and in the eleventh year, in the month of Bul—that is, the eighth
month—the House was completed according to all its details and all
its specifications. It took him seven years to build it.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וַיְכַל אֶת־כּל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וַיְכַל אֶת־כּל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
And it took Solomon thirteen years to build his palace, until his
whole palace was completed.

translation.text: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

verses.english:
And it took Solomon thirteen years to build his palace, until his
whole palace was completed.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּבֶן אֶת־בֵּית יַעַר הַלְּבָנוֹן מֵאָה אַמָּה ארְכּוֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה רחְבּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ עַל אַרְבָּעָה טוּרֵי עַמּוּדֵי אֲרָזִים וּכְרֻתוֹת אֲרָזִים
עַל־הָעַמּוּדִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּבֶן אֶת־בֵּית יַעַר הַלְּבָנוֹן מֵאָה אַמָּה ארְכּוֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה רחְבּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ עַל אַרְבָּעָה טוּרֵי עַמּוּדֵי אֲרָזִים וּכְרֻתוֹת אֲרָזִים
עַל־הָעַמּוּדִים׃

english.text:
He built the Lebanon Forest House with four rows of cedar columns,
and with hewn cedar beams above the columns. Its length was 100
cubits, its breadth 50 cubits, and its height 30 cubits.

translation.text: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.

verses.english:
He built the Lebanon Forest House with four rows of cedar columns,
and with hewn cedar beams above the columns. Its length was 100
cubits, its breadth 50 cubits, and its height 30 cubits.

verses.hebrew: וְסָפֻן בָּאֶרֶז מִמַּעַל עַל־הַצְּלָעוֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־הָעַמּוּדִים אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר הַטּוּר׃

hebrew.text: וְסָפֻן בָּאֶרֶז מִמַּעַל עַל־הַצְּלָעוֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־הָעַמּוּדִים אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר הַטּוּר׃

english.text:
It was paneled above with cedar, with the planks that were above
on the 45 columns—15 in each row.

translation.text: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.

verses.english:
It was paneled above with cedar, with the planks that were above
on the 45 columns—15 in each row.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁקֻפִים שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרִים וּמֶחֱזָה אֶל־מֶחֱזָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁקֻפִים שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרִים וּמֶחֱזָה אֶל־מֶחֱזָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים׃

english.text:
And there were three rows of window frames, with three tiers of
windows facing each other.

translation.text: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.

verses.english:
And there were three rows of window frames, with three tiers of
windows facing each other.

verses.hebrew: וְכל־הַפְּתָחִים וְהַמְּזוּזוֹת רְבֻעִים שָׁקֶף וּמוּל מֶחֱזָה אֶל־מֶחֱזָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־הַפְּתָחִים וְהַמְּזוּזוֹת רְבֻעִים שָׁקֶף וּמוּל מֶחֱזָה אֶל־מֶחֱזָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים׃

english.text:
All the doorways and doorposts had square frames—with three tiers
of windows facing each other.

translation.text: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.

verses.english:
All the doorways and doorposts had square frames—with three tiers
of windows facing each other.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת אוּלָם הָעַמּוּדִים עָשָׂה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה ארְכּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה רחְבּוֹ וְאוּלָם עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם וְעַמֻּדִים וְעָב עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת אוּלָם הָעַמּוּדִים עָשָׂה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה ארְכּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה רחְבּוֹ וְאוּלָם עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם וְעַמֻּדִים וְעָב עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם׃

translation.text: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.

verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם הַכִּסֵּא אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁפּט־שָׁם אֻלָם הַמִּשְׁפָּט עָשָׂה וְסָפוּן בָּאֶרֶז מֵהַקַּרְקַע עַד־הַקַּרְקָע׃

hebrew.text: וְאוּלָם הַכִּסֵּא אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁפּט־שָׁם אֻלָם הַמִּשְׁפָּט עָשָׂה וְסָפוּן בָּאֶרֶז מֵהַקַּרְקַע עַד־הַקַּרְקָע׃

english.text:
He made the throne portico, where he was to pronounce judgment—the
Hall of Judgment. It was paneled with cedar from floor to floor.

translation.text: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.

verses.english:
He made the throne portico, where he was to pronounce judgment—the
Hall of Judgment. It was paneled with cedar from floor to floor.

verses.hebrew: וּבֵיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־יֵשֶׁב שָׁם חָצֵר הָאַחֶרֶת מִבֵּית לָאוּלָם כַּמַּעֲשֶׂה הַזֶּה הָיָה וּבַיִת יַעֲשֶׂה לְבַת־פַּרְעֹה אֲשֶׁר לָקַח שְׁלֹמֹה כָּאוּלָם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וּבֵיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־יֵשֶׁב שָׁם חָצֵר הָאַחֶרֶת מִבֵּית לָאוּלָם כַּמַּעֲשֶׂה הַזֶּה הָיָה וּבַיִת יַעֲשֶׂה לְבַת־פַּרְעֹה אֲשֶׁר לָקַח שְׁלֹמֹה כָּאוּלָם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The house that he used as a residence, in the rear courtyard, back
of the portico, was of the same construction. Solomon also
constructed a palace like that portico for the daughter of
Pharaoh, whom he had married.

translation.text: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.

verses.english:
The house that he used as a residence, in the rear courtyard, back
of the portico, was of the same construction. Solomon also
constructed a palace like that portico for the daughter of
Pharaoh, whom he had married.

verses.hebrew: כּל־אֵלֶּה אֲבָנִים יְקָרֹת כְּמִדּוֹת גָּזִית מְגֹרָרוֹת בַּמְּגֵרָה מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ וּמִמַּסָּד עַד־הַטְּפָחוֹת וּמִחוּץ עַד־הֶחָצֵר הַגְּדוֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: כּל־אֵלֶּה אֲבָנִים יְקָרֹת כְּמִדּוֹת גָּזִית מְגֹרָרוֹת בַּמְּגֵרָה מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ וּמִמַּסָּד עַד־הַטְּפָחוֹת וּמִחוּץ עַד־הֶחָצֵר הַגְּדוֹלָה׃

english.text:
All these buildings, from foundation to coping and all the way out
to the great courtyard, were of choice stones, hewn according to
measure, smooth on all sides.

translation.text: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.

verses.english:
All these buildings, from foundation to coping and all the way out
to the great courtyard, were of choice stones, hewn according to
measure, smooth on all sides.

verses.hebrew: וּמְיֻסָּד אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת אַבְנֵי עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת וְאַבְנֵי שְׁמֹנֶה אַמּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּמְיֻסָּד אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת אַבְנֵי עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת וְאַבְנֵי שְׁמֹנֶה אַמּוֹת׃

english.text:
The foundations were huge blocks of choice stone, stones of 10
cubits and stones of 8 cubits;

translation.text: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.

verses.english:
The foundations were huge blocks of choice stone, stones of 10
cubits and stones of 8 cubits;

verses.hebrew: וּמִלְמַעְלָה אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת כְּמִדּוֹת גָּזִית וָאָרֶז׃

hebrew.text: וּמִלְמַעְלָה אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת כְּמִדּוֹת גָּזִית וָאָרֶז׃

english.text:
and above were choice stones, hewn according to measure, and cedar
wood.

translation.text: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.

verses.english:
and above were choice stones, hewn according to measure, and cedar
wood.

verses.hebrew: וְחָצֵר הַגְּדוֹלָה סָבִיב שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרִים גָּזִית וְטוּר כְּרֻתֹת אֲרָזִים וְלַחֲצַר בֵּית־יְהֹוָה הַפְּנִימִית וּלְאֻלָם הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וְחָצֵר הַגְּדוֹלָה סָבִיב שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרִים גָּזִית וְטוּר כְּרֻתֹת אֲרָזִים וְלַחֲצַר בֵּית־יְהֹוָה הַפְּנִימִית וּלְאֻלָם הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
The large surrounding courtyard had three tiers of hewn stone and
a row of cedar beams, the same as for the inner court of the House
of YHWH, and for the portico of the House.

translation.text: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house.

verses.english:
The large surrounding courtyard had three tiers of hewn stone and
a row of cedar beams, the same as for the inner court of the House
of YHWH, and for the portico of the House.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּקַּח אֶת־חִירָם מִצֹּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּקַּח אֶת־חִירָם מִצֹּר׃

english.text: King Solomon sent for Hiram and brought him down from Tyre.

translation.text: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.

verses.english: King Solomon sent for Hiram and brought him down from Tyre.

verses.hebrew:
בֶּן־אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה הוּא מִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וְאָבִיו אִישׁ־צֹרִי חֹרֵשׁ נְחֹשֶׁת וַיִּמָּלֵא אֶת־הַחכְמָה וְאֶת־הַתְּבוּנָה וְאֶת־הַדַּעַת לַעֲשׂוֹת כּל־מְלָאכָה בַּנְּחֹשֶׁת
וַיָּבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־כּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
בֶּן־אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה הוּא מִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וְאָבִיו אִישׁ־צֹרִי חֹרֵשׁ נְחֹשֶׁת וַיִּמָּלֵא אֶת־הַחכְמָה וְאֶת־הַתְּבוּנָה וְאֶת־הַדַּעַת לַעֲשׂוֹת כּל־מְלָאכָה בַּנְּחֹשֶׁת
וַיָּבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־כּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father
had been a Tyrian, a coppersmith. He was endowed with skill,
ability, and talent for executing all work in bronze. He came to
King Solomon and executed all his work.

translation.text: He was a widow’s son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.

verses.english:
He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father
had been a Tyrian, a coppersmith. He was endowed with skill,
ability, and talent for executing all work in bronze. He came to
King Solomon and executed all his work.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּצַר אֶת־שְׁנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים נְחֹשֶׁת שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קוֹמַת הָעַמּוּד הָאֶחָד וְחוּט שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה יָסֹב אֶת־הָעַמּוּד הַשֵּׁנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּצַר אֶת־שְׁנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים נְחֹשֶׁת שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קוֹמַת הָעַמּוּד הָאֶחָד וְחוּט שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה יָסֹב אֶת־הָעַמּוּד הַשֵּׁנִי׃

english.text:
He cast two columns of bronze; one column was 18 cubits high and
measured 12 cubits in circumference, [and similarly] the other
column.

translation.text: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.

verses.english:
He cast two columns of bronze; one column was 18 cubits high and
measured 12 cubits in circumference, [and similarly] the other
column.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי כֹתָרֹת עָשָׂה לָתֵת עַל־רָאשֵׁי הָעַמּוּדִים מֻצַק נְחֹשֶׁת חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת הָאֶחָת וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁתֵּי כֹתָרֹת עָשָׂה לָתֵת עַל־רָאשֵׁי הָעַמּוּדִים מֻצַק נְחֹשֶׁת חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת הָאֶחָת וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

english.text:
He made two capitals, cast in bronze, to be set upon the two
columns, the height of each of the two capitals being 5 cubits;

translation.text: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:

verses.english:
He made two capitals, cast in bronze, to be set upon the two
columns, the height of each of the two capitals being 5 cubits;

verses.hebrew: שְׂבָכִים מַעֲשֵׂה שְׂבָכָה גְּדִלִים מַעֲשֵׂה שַׁרְשְׁרוֹת לַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים שִׁבְעָה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הָאֶחָת וְשִׁבְעָה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: שְׂבָכִים מַעֲשֵׂה שְׂבָכָה גְּדִלִים מַעֲשֵׂה שַׁרְשְׁרוֹת לַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים שִׁבְעָה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הָאֶחָת וְשִׁבְעָה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

english.text:
also nets of meshwork with festoons of chainwork for the capitals
that were on the top of the columns, seven for each of the two
capitals.

translation.text: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.

verses.english:
also nets of meshwork with festoons of chainwork for the capitals
that were on the top of the columns, seven for each of the two
capitals.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־הָעַמּוּדִים וּשְׁנֵי טוּרִים סָבִיב עַל־הַשְּׂבָכָה הָאֶחָת לְכַסּוֹת אֶת־הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָרִמֹּנִים וְכֵן עָשָׂה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־הָעַמּוּדִים וּשְׁנֵי טוּרִים סָבִיב עַל־הַשְּׂבָכָה הָאֶחָת לְכַסּוֹת אֶת־הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָרִמֹּנִים וְכֵן עָשָׂה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

english.text:
He made the columns so that there were two rows [of pomegranates]
encircling the top of the one network, to cover the capitals that
were on the top of the pomegranates; and he did the same for [the
network on] the second capital.

translation.text: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.

verses.english:
He made the columns so that there were two rows [of pomegranates]
encircling the top of the one network, to cover the capitals that
were on the top of the pomegranates; and he did the same for [the
network on] the second capital.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים מַעֲשֵׂה שׁוּשַׁן בָּאוּלָם אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים מַעֲשֵׂה שׁוּשַׁן בָּאוּלָם אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת׃

english.text:
The capitals upon the columns of the portico were of lily design,
4 cubits high;

translation.text: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.

verses.english:
The capitals upon the columns of the portico were of lily design,
4 cubits high;

verses.hebrew: וְכֹתָרֹת עַל־שְׁנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים גַּם־מִמַּעַל מִלְּעֻמַּת הַבֶּטֶן אֲשֶׁר לְעֵבֶר (שבכה) [הַשְּׂבָכָה] וְהָרִמּוֹנִים מָאתַיִם טֻרִים סָבִיב עַל הַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹתָרֹת עַל־שְׁנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים גַּם־מִמַּעַל מִלְּעֻמַּת הַבֶּטֶן אֲשֶׁר לְעֵבֶר (שבכה) [הַשְּׂבָכָה] וְהָרִמּוֹנִים מָאתַיִם טֻרִים סָבִיב עַל הַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית׃

english.text:
so also the capitals upon the two columns extended above and next
to the bulge that was beside the network. There were 200
pomegranates in rows around the top of the second capital.

translation.text: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.

verses.english:
so also the capitals upon the two columns extended above and next
to the bulge that was beside the network. There were 200
pomegranates in rows around the top of the second capital.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם אֶת־הָעַמֻּדִים לְאֻלָם הַהֵיכָל וַיָּקֶם אֶת־הָעַמּוּד הַיְמָנִי וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ יָכִין וַיָּקֶם אֶת־הָעַמּוּד הַשְּׂמָאלִי וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ בֹּעַז׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֶם אֶת־הָעַמֻּדִים לְאֻלָם הַהֵיכָל וַיָּקֶם אֶת־הָעַמּוּד הַיְמָנִי וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ יָכִין וַיָּקֶם אֶת־הָעַמּוּד הַשְּׂמָאלִי וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ בֹּעַז׃

english.text:
He set up the columns at the portico of the Great Hall; he set up
one column on the right and named it Jachin, and he set up the
other column on the left and named it Boaz.

translation.text: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.

verses.english:
He set up the columns at the portico of the Great Hall; he set up
one column on the right and named it Jachin, and he set up the
other column on the left and named it Boaz.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים מַעֲשֵׂה שׁוֹשָׁן וַתִּתֹּם מְלֶאכֶת הָעַמּוּדִים׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים מַעֲשֵׂה שׁוֹשָׁן וַתִּתֹּם מְלֶאכֶת הָעַמּוּדִים׃

english.text:
Upon the top of the columns there was a lily design. Thus the work
of the columns was completed.

translation.text: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.

verses.english:
Upon the top of the columns there was a lily design. Thus the work
of the columns was completed.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־הַיָּם מוּצָק עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה מִשְּׂפָתוֹ עַד־שְׂפָתוֹ עָגֹל סָבִיב וְחָמֵשׁ בָּאַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ (וקוה) [וְקָו] שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּאַמָּה יָסֹב אֹתוֹ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־הַיָּם מוּצָק עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה מִשְּׂפָתוֹ עַד־שְׂפָתוֹ עָגֹל סָבִיב וְחָמֵשׁ בָּאַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ (וקוה) [וְקָו] שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּאַמָּה יָסֹב אֹתוֹ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
Then he made the tank of cast metal, 10 cubits across from brim to
brim, completely round; it was 5 cubits high, and it measured 30
cubits in circumference.

translation.text: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

verses.english:
Then he made the tank of cast metal, 10 cubits across from brim to
brim, completely round; it was 5 cubits high, and it measured 30
cubits in circumference.

verses.hebrew: וּפְקָעִים מִתַּחַת לִשְׂפָתוֹ סָבִיב סֹבְבִים אֹתוֹ עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה מַקִּפִים אֶת־הַיָּם סָבִיב שְׁנֵי טוּרִים הַפְּקָעִים יְצֻקִים בִּיצֻקָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּפְקָעִים מִתַּחַת לִשְׂפָתוֹ סָבִיב סֹבְבִים אֹתוֹ עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה מַקִּפִים אֶת־הַיָּם סָבִיב שְׁנֵי טוּרִים הַפְּקָעִים יְצֻקִים בִּיצֻקָתוֹ׃

english.text:
There were gourds below the brim completely encircling it—ten to a
cubit, encircling the tank; the gourds were in two rows, cast in
one piece with it.

translation.text: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.

verses.english:
There were gourds below the brim completely encircling it—ten to a
cubit, encircling the tank; the gourds were in two rows, cast in
one piece with it.

verses.hebrew:
עֹמֵד עַל־שְׁנֵי עָשָׂר בָּקָר שְׁלֹשָׁה פֹנִים צָפוֹנָה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה פֹנִים יָמָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה פֹּנִים נֶגְבָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה פֹּנִים מִזְרָחָה וְהַיָּם עֲלֵיהֶם מִלְמָעְלָה
וְכל־אֲחֹרֵיהֶם בָּיְתָה׃

hebrew.text:
עֹמֵד עַל־שְׁנֵי עָשָׂר בָּקָר שְׁלֹשָׁה פֹנִים צָפוֹנָה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה פֹנִים יָמָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה פֹּנִים נֶגְבָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה פֹּנִים מִזְרָחָה וְהַיָּם עֲלֵיהֶם מִלְמָעְלָה
וְכל־אֲחֹרֵיהֶם בָּיְתָה׃

english.text:
It stood upon twelve oxen: three facing north, three facing west,
three facing south, and three facing east, with the tank resting
upon them; their haunches were all turned inward.

translation.text: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.

verses.english:
It stood upon twelve oxen: three facing north, three facing west,
three facing south, and three facing east, with the tank resting
upon them; their haunches were all turned inward.

verses.hebrew: וְעבְיוֹ טֶפַח וּשְׂפָתוֹ כְּמַעֲשֵׂה שְׂפַת־כּוֹס פֶּרַח שׁוֹשָׁן אַלְפַּיִם בַּת יָכִיל׃

hebrew.text: וְעבְיוֹ טֶפַח וּשְׂפָתוֹ כְּמַעֲשֵׂה שְׂפַת־כּוֹס פֶּרַח שׁוֹשָׁן אַלְפַּיִם בַּת יָכִיל׃

english.text:
It was a handbreadth thick, and its brim was made like that of a
cup, like the petals of a lily. Its capacity was 2,000 baths.

translation.text: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.

verses.english:
It was a handbreadth thick, and its brim was made like that of a
cup, like the petals of a lily. Its capacity was 2,000 baths.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת עֶשֶׂר נְחֹשֶׁת אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה אֹרֶךְ הַמְּכוֹנָה הָאֶחָת וְאַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה רחְבָּהּ וְשָׁלֹשׁ בָּאַמָּה קוֹמָתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת עֶשֶׂר נְחֹשֶׁת אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה אֹרֶךְ הַמְּכוֹנָה הָאֶחָת וְאַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה רחְבָּהּ וְשָׁלֹשׁ בָּאַמָּה קוֹמָתָהּ׃

english.text:
He made the ten laver stands of bronze. The length of each laver
stand was 4 cubits and the width 4 cubits, and the height was 3
cubits.

translation.text: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.

verses.english:
He made the ten laver stands of bronze. The length of each laver
stand was 4 cubits and the width 4 cubits, and the height was 3
cubits.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה מַעֲשֵׂה הַמְּכוֹנָה מִסְגְּרֹת לָהֶם וּמִסְגְּרֹת בֵּין הַשְׁלַבִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה מַעֲשֵׂה הַמְּכוֹנָה מִסְגְּרֹת לָהֶם וּמִסְגְּרֹת בֵּין הַשְׁלַבִּים׃

english.text:
The structure of the laver stands was as follows: They had insets,
and there were insets within the frames;

translation.text: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:

verses.english:
The structure of the laver stands was as follows: They had insets,
and there were insets within the frames;

verses.hebrew: וְעַל־הַמִּסְגְּרוֹת אֲשֶׁר בֵּין הַשְׁלַבִּים אֲרָיוֹת בָּקָר וּכְרוּבִים וְעַל־הַשְׁלַבִּים כֵּן מִמָּעַל וּמִתַּחַת לַאֲרָיוֹת וְלַבָּקָר לֹיוֹת מַעֲשֵׂה מוֹרָד׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל־הַמִּסְגְּרוֹת אֲשֶׁר בֵּין הַשְׁלַבִּים אֲרָיוֹת בָּקָר וּכְרוּבִים וְעַל־הַשְׁלַבִּים כֵּן מִמָּעַל וּמִתַּחַת לַאֲרָיוֹת וְלַבָּקָר לֹיוֹת מַעֲשֵׂה מוֹרָד׃

english.text:
and on the insets within the frames were lions, oxen, and
cherubim. Above the frames was a stand; and both above and below
the lions and the oxen were spirals of hammered metal.

translation.text: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.

verses.english:
and on the insets within the frames were lions, oxen, and
cherubim. Above the frames was a stand; and both above and below
the lions and the oxen were spirals of hammered metal.

verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעָה אוֹפַנֵּי נְחֹשֶׁת לַמְּכוֹנָה הָאַחַת וְסַרְנֵי נְחֹשֶׁת וְאַרְבָּעָה פַעֲמֹתָיו כְּתֵפֹת לָהֶם מִתַּחַת לַכִּיֹּר הַכְּתֵפוֹת יְצֻקוֹת מֵעֵבֶר אִישׁ לֹיוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאַרְבָּעָה אוֹפַנֵּי נְחֹשֶׁת לַמְּכוֹנָה הָאַחַת וְסַרְנֵי נְחֹשֶׁת וְאַרְבָּעָה פַעֲמֹתָיו כְּתֵפֹת לָהֶם מִתַּחַת לַכִּיֹּר הַכְּתֵפוֹת יְצֻקוֹת מֵעֵבֶר אִישׁ לֹיוֹת׃

english.text:
Each laver stand had four bronze wheels and [two] bronze
axletrees. Its four legs had brackets; the brackets were under the
laver, cast with spirals beyond each.

translation.text: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.

verses.english:
Each laver stand had four bronze wheels and [two] bronze
axletrees. Its four legs had brackets; the brackets were under the
laver, cast with spirals beyond each.

verses.hebrew: וּפִיהוּ מִבֵּית לַכֹּתֶרֶת וָמַעְלָה בָּאַמָּה וּפִיהָ עָגֹל מַעֲשֵׂה־כֵן אַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָאַמָּה וְגַם־עַל־פִּיהָ מִקְלָעוֹת וּמִסְגְּרֹתֵיהֶם מְרֻבָּעוֹת לֹא עֲגֻלּוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּפִיהוּ מִבֵּית לַכֹּתֶרֶת וָמַעְלָה בָּאַמָּה וּפִיהָ עָגֹל מַעֲשֵׂה־כֵן אַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָאַמָּה וְגַם־עַל־פִּיהָ מִקְלָעוֹת וּמִסְגְּרֹתֵיהֶם מְרֻבָּעוֹת לֹא עֲגֻלּוֹת׃

english.text:
Its funnel, within the crown, rose a cubit above it; this funnel
was round, in the fashion of a stand, a cubit and a half in
diameter. On the funnel too there were carvings. But the insets
were square, not round.

translation.text: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.

verses.english:
Its funnel, within the crown, rose a cubit above it; this funnel
was round, in the fashion of a stand, a cubit and a half in
diameter. On the funnel too there were carvings. But the insets
were square, not round.

verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבַּעַת הָאוֹפַנִּים לְמִתַּחַת לַמִּסְגְּרוֹת וִידוֹת הָאוֹפַנִּים בַּמְּכוֹנָה וְקוֹמַת הָאוֹפַן הָאֶחָד אַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָאַמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאַרְבַּעַת הָאוֹפַנִּים לְמִתַּחַת לַמִּסְגְּרוֹת וִידוֹת הָאוֹפַנִּים בַּמְּכוֹנָה וְקוֹמַת הָאוֹפַן הָאֶחָד אַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָאַמָּה׃

english.text:
And below the insets were the four wheels. The axletrees of the
wheels were [fixed] in the laver stand, and the height of each
wheel was a cubit and a half.

translation.text: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.

verses.english:
And below the insets were the four wheels. The axletrees of the
wheels were [fixed] in the laver stand, and the height of each
wheel was a cubit and a half.

verses.hebrew: וּמַעֲשֵׂה הָאוֹפַנִּים כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אוֹפַן הַמֶּרְכָּבָה יְדוֹתָם וְגַבֵּיהֶם וְחִשֻּׁקֵיהֶם וְחִשֻּׁרֵיהֶם הַכֹּל מוּצָק׃

hebrew.text: וּמַעֲשֵׂה הָאוֹפַנִּים כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אוֹפַן הַמֶּרְכָּבָה יְדוֹתָם וְגַבֵּיהֶם וְחִשֻּׁקֵיהֶם וְחִשֻּׁרֵיהֶם הַכֹּל מוּצָק׃

english.text:
The structure of the wheels was like the structure of chariot
wheels; and their axletrees, their rims, their spokes, and their
hubs were all of cast metal.

translation.text: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.

verses.english:
The structure of the wheels was like the structure of chariot
wheels; and their axletrees, their rims, their spokes, and their
hubs were all of cast metal.

verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבַּע כְּתֵפוֹת אֶל אַרְבַּע פִּנּוֹת הַמְּכֹנָה הָאֶחָת מִן־הַמְּכֹנָה כְּתֵפֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַרְבַּע כְּתֵפוֹת אֶל אַרְבַּע פִּנּוֹת הַמְּכֹנָה הָאֶחָת מִן־הַמְּכֹנָה כְּתֵפֶיהָ׃

english.text:
Four brackets ran to the four corners of each laver stand; the
brackets were of a piece with the laver stand.

translation.text: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.

verses.english:
Four brackets ran to the four corners of each laver stand; the
brackets were of a piece with the laver stand.

verses.hebrew: וּבְרֹאשׁ הַמְּכוֹנָה חֲצִי הָאַמָּה קוֹמָה עָגֹל סָבִיב וְעַל רֹאשׁ הַמְּכֹנָה יְדֹתֶיהָ וּמִסְגְּרֹתֶיהָ מִמֶּנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וּבְרֹאשׁ הַמְּכוֹנָה חֲצִי הָאַמָּה קוֹמָה עָגֹל סָבִיב וְעַל רֹאשׁ הַמְּכֹנָה יְדֹתֶיהָ וּמִסְגְּרֹתֶיהָ מִמֶּנָּה׃

english.text:
At the top of the laver stand was a round band half a cubit high,
and together with the top of the laver stand; its sides and its
insets were of one piece with it.

translation.text: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.

verses.english:
At the top of the laver stand was a round band half a cubit high,
and together with the top of the laver stand; its sides and its
insets were of one piece with it.

verses.hebrew: וַיְפַתַּח עַל־הַלֻּחֹת יְדֹתֶיהָ וְעַל (ומסגרתיה) [מִסְגְּרֹתֶיהָ] כְּרוּבִים אֲרָיוֹת וְתִמֹרֹת כְּמַעַר־אִישׁ וְלֹיוֹת סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיְפַתַּח עַל־הַלֻּחֹת יְדֹתֶיהָ וְעַל (ומסגרתיה) [מִסְגְּרֹתֶיהָ] כְּרוּבִים אֲרָיוֹת וְתִמֹרֹת כְּמַעַר־אִישׁ וְלֹיוֹת סָבִיב׃

english.text:
On its surface—on its sides—and on its insets [Hiram] engraved
cherubim, lions, and palms, as the clear space on each allowed,
with spirals round about.

translation.text: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.

verses.english:
On its surface—on its sides—and on its insets [Hiram] engraved
cherubim, lions, and palms, as the clear space on each allowed,
with spirals round about.

verses.hebrew: כָּזֹאת עָשָׂה אֵת עֶשֶׂר הַמְּכֹנוֹת מוּצָק אֶחָד מִדָּה אַחַת קֶצֶב אֶחָד לְכֻלָּהְנָה׃

hebrew.text: כָּזֹאת עָשָׂה אֵת עֶשֶׂר הַמְּכֹנוֹת מוּצָק אֶחָד מִדָּה אַחַת קֶצֶב אֶחָד לְכֻלָּהְנָה׃

english.text:
It was after this manner that he made the ten laver stands, all of
them cast alike, of the same measure and the same form.

translation.text: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.

verses.english:
It was after this manner that he made the ten laver stands, all of
