them cast alike, of the same measure and the same form.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ עֲשָׂרָה כִיֹּרוֹת נְחֹשֶׁת אַרְבָּעִים בַּת יָכִיל הַכִּיּוֹר הָאֶחָד אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה הַכִּיּוֹר הָאֶחָד כִּיּוֹר אֶחָד עַל־הַמְּכוֹנָה הָאַחַת לְעֶשֶׂר הַמְּכֹנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ עֲשָׂרָה כִיֹּרוֹת נְחֹשֶׁת אַרְבָּעִים בַּת יָכִיל הַכִּיּוֹר הָאֶחָד אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה הַכִּיּוֹר הָאֶחָד כִּיּוֹר אֶחָד עַל־הַמְּכוֹנָה הָאַחַת לְעֶשֶׂר הַמְּכֹנוֹת׃

english.text:
Then he made ten bronze lavers, one laver on each of the ten laver
stands, each laver measuring 4 cubits and each laver containing
forty baths.

translation.text: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.

verses.english:
Then he made ten bronze lavers, one laver on each of the ten laver
stands, each laver measuring 4 cubits and each laver containing
forty baths.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת חָמֵשׁ עַל־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת מִיָּמִין וְחָמֵשׁ עַל־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת מִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ וְאֶת־הַיָּם נָתַן מִכֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית קֵדְמָה מִמּוּל נֶגֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת חָמֵשׁ עַל־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת מִיָּמִין וְחָמֵשׁ עַל־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת מִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ וְאֶת־הַיָּם נָתַן מִכֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית קֵדְמָה מִמּוּל נֶגֶב׃

english.text:
He disposed the laver stands, five at the right side of the House
and five at its left side; and the tank he placed on the right
side of the House, at the southeast [corner].

translation.text: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.

verses.english:
He disposed the laver stands, five at the right side of the House
and five at its left side; and the tank he placed on the right
side of the House, at the southeast [corner].

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ חִירוֹם אֶת־הַכִּיֹּרוֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקוֹת וַיְכַל חִירָם לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־כּל־הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ חִירוֹם אֶת־הַכִּיֹּרוֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקוֹת וַיְכַל חִירָם לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־כּל־הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Hiram also made the lavers, the scrapers, and the sprinkling
bowls. So Hiram finished all the work that he had been doing for
King Solomon on the House of YHWH:

translation.text: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD:

verses.english:
Hiram also made the lavers, the scrapers, and the sprinkling
bowls. So Hiram finished all the work that he had been doing for
King Solomon on the House of YHWH:

verses.hebrew: עַמֻּדִים שְׁנַיִם וְגֻלֹּת הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר־עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים שְׁתָּיִם וְהַשְּׂבָכוֹת שְׁתַּיִם לְכַסּוֹת אֶת־שְׁתֵּי גֻּלּוֹת הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים׃

hebrew.text: עַמֻּדִים שְׁנַיִם וְגֻלֹּת הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר־עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים שְׁתָּיִם וְהַשְּׂבָכוֹת שְׁתַּיִם לְכַסּוֹת אֶת־שְׁתֵּי גֻּלּוֹת הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים׃

translation.text: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars;

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הָרִמֹּנִים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת לִשְׁתֵּי הַשְּׂבָכוֹת שְׁנֵי־טוּרִים רִמֹּנִים לַשְּׂבָכָה הָאֶחָת לְכַסּוֹת אֶת־שְׁתֵּי גֻּלּוֹת הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הָרִמֹּנִים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת לִשְׁתֵּי הַשְּׂבָכוֹת שְׁנֵי־טוּרִים רִמֹּנִים לַשְּׂבָכָה הָאֶחָת לְכַסּוֹת אֶת־שְׁתֵּי גֻּלּוֹת הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים׃

translation.text: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת עָשֶׂר וְאֶת־הַכִּיֹּרֹת עֲשָׂרָה עַל־הַמְּכֹנוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת עָשֶׂר וְאֶת־הַכִּיֹּרֹת עֲשָׂרָה עַל־הַמְּכֹנוֹת׃

english.text: the ten stands and the ten lavers upon the stands;

translation.text: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;

verses.english: the ten stands and the ten lavers upon the stands;

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַיָּם הָאֶחָד וְאֶת־הַבָּקָר שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר תַּחַת הַיָּם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַיָּם הָאֶחָד וְאֶת־הַבָּקָר שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר תַּחַת הַיָּם׃

english.text: the one tank with the twelve oxen underneath the tank;

translation.text: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;

verses.english: the one tank with the twelve oxen underneath the tank;

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַסִּירוֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקוֹת וְאֵת כּל־הַכֵּלִים (האהל) [הָאֵלֶּה] אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה חִירָם לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהֹוָה נְחֹשֶׁת מְמֹרָט׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַסִּירוֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקוֹת וְאֵת כּל־הַכֵּלִים (האהל) [הָאֵלֶּה] אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה חִירָם לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהֹוָה נְחֹשֶׁת מְמֹרָט׃

english.text:
the pails, the scrapers, and the sprinkling bowls. All those
vessels in the House of YHWH that Hiram made for King Solomon were
of burnished bronze.

translation.text: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD, were of bright brass.

verses.english:
the pails, the scrapers, and the sprinkling bowls. All those
vessels in the House of YHWH that Hiram made for King Solomon were
of burnished bronze.

verses.hebrew: בְּכִכַּר הַיַּרְדֵּן יְצָקָם הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּמַעֲבֵה הָאֲדָמָה בֵּין סֻכּוֹת וּבֵין צָרְתָן׃

hebrew.text: בְּכִכַּר הַיַּרְדֵּן יְצָקָם הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּמַעֲבֵה הָאֲדָמָה בֵּין סֻכּוֹת וּבֵין צָרְתָן׃

english.text:
The king had them cast in earthen molds, in the plain of the
Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan.

translation.text: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.

verses.english:
The king had them cast in earthen molds, in the plain of the
Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּנַּח שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־כּל־הַכֵּלִים מֵרֹב מְאֹד מְאֹד לֹא נֶחְקַר מִשְׁקַל הַנְּחֹשֶׁת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּנַּח שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־כּל־הַכֵּלִים מֵרֹב מְאֹד מְאֹד לֹא נֶחְקַר מִשְׁקַל הַנְּחֹשֶׁת׃

english.text:
Solomon left all the vessels [unweighed] because of their very
great quantity; the weight of the bronze was not reckoned.

translation.text: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.

verses.english:
Solomon left all the vessels [unweighed] because of their very
great quantity; the weight of the bronze was not reckoned.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹה אֵת כּל־הַכֵּלִים אֲשֶׁר בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֵת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹה אֵת כּל־הַכֵּלִים אֲשֶׁר בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֵת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים זָהָב׃

translation.text: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of the LORD: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹרוֹת חָמֵשׁ מִיָּמִין וְחָמֵשׁ מִשְּׂמֹאול לִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר זָהָב סָגוּר וְהַפֶּרַח וְהַנֵּרֹת וְהַמֶּלְקַחַיִם זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹרוֹת חָמֵשׁ מִיָּמִין וְחָמֵשׁ מִשְּׂמֹאול לִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר זָהָב סָגוּר וְהַפֶּרַח וְהַנֵּרֹת וְהַמֶּלְקַחַיִם זָהָב׃

translation.text: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,

verses.hebrew:
וְהַסִּפּוֹת וְהַמְזַמְּרוֹת וְהַמִּזְרָקוֹת וְהַכַּפּוֹת וְהַמַּחְתּוֹת זָהָב סָגוּר וְהַפֹּתוֹת לְדַלְתוֹת הַבַּיִת הַפְּנִימִי לְקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים לְדַלְתֵי הַבַּיִת לַהֵיכָל
זָהָב׃

hebrew.text:
וְהַסִּפּוֹת וְהַמְזַמְּרוֹת וְהַמִּזְרָקוֹת וְהַכַּפּוֹת וְהַמַּחְתּוֹת זָהָב סָגוּר וְהַפֹּתוֹת לְדַלְתוֹת הַבַּיִת הַפְּנִימִי לְקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים לְדַלְתֵי הַבַּיִת לַהֵיכָל
זָהָב׃

english.text:
the basins, snuffers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and fire pans, of
solid gold; and the hinge sockets for the doors of the innermost
part of the House, the Holy of Holies, and for the doors of the
Great Hall of the House, of gold.

translation.text: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.

verses.english:
the basins, snuffers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and fire pans, of
solid gold; and the hinge sockets for the doors of the innermost
part of the House, the Holy of Holies, and for the doors of the
Great Hall of the House, of gold.

verses.hebrew:
וַתִּשְׁלַם כּל־הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיָּבֵא שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־קדְשֵׁי דָּוִד אָבִיו אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַכֵּלִים נָתַן בְּאֹצְרוֹת
בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּשְׁלַם כּל־הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיָּבֵא שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־קדְשֵׁי דָּוִד אָבִיו אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַכֵּלִים נָתַן בְּאֹצְרוֹת
בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
When all the work that King Solomon had done in the House of YHWH
was completed, Solomon brought in the sacred donations of his
father David—the silver, the gold, and the vessels—and deposited
them in the treasury of the House of YHWH.

translation.text: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
When all the work that King Solomon had done in the House of YHWH
was completed, Solomon brought in the sacred donations of his
father David—the silver, the gold, and the vessels—and deposited
them in the treasury of the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew:
אָז יַקְהֵל שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־כּל־רָאשֵׁי הַמַּטּוֹת נְשִׂיאֵי הָאָבוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם לְהַעֲלוֹת אֶת־אֲרוֹן
בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה מֵעִיר דָּוִד הִיא צִיּוֹן׃

hebrew.text:
אָז יַקְהֵל שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־כּל־רָאשֵׁי הַמַּטּוֹת נְשִׂיאֵי הָאָבוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם לְהַעֲלוֹת אֶת־אֲרוֹן
בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה מֵעִיר דָּוִד הִיא צִיּוֹן׃

english.text:
Then Solomon convoked the elders of Israel—all the heads of the
tribes and the ancestral chieftains of the Israelites—before King
Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the Ark of the Covenant of YHWH
from the City of David, that is, Zion.

translation.text: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.

verses.english:
Then Solomon convoked the elders of Israel—all the heads of the
tribes and the ancestral chieftains of the Israelites—before King
Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the Ark of the Covenant of YHWH
from the City of David, that is, Zion.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיֶרַח הָאֵתָנִים בֶּחָג הוּא הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה כּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיֶרַח הָאֵתָנִים בֶּחָג הוּא הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי׃

english.text:
All the men of Israel gathered before King Solomon at the Feast,
in the month of Ethanim—that is, the seventh month.

translation.text: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

verses.english:
All the men of Israel gathered before King Solomon at the Feast,
in the month of Ethanim—that is, the seventh month.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ כֹּל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׂאוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־הָאָרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ כֹּל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׂאוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־הָאָרוֹן׃

english.text: When all the elders of Israel had come, the priests lifted the Ark

translation.text: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.

verses.english: When all the elders of Israel had come, the priests lifted the Ark

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת־כּל־כְּלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּאֹהֶל וַיַּעֲלוּ אֹתָם הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת־כּל־כְּלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּאֹהֶל וַיַּעֲלוּ אֹתָם הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
and carried up the Ark of YHWH. Then the priests and the Levites
brought the Tent of Meeting and all the holy vessels that were in
the Tent.

translation.text: And they brought up the ark of the LORD, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.

verses.english:
and carried up the Ark of YHWH. Then the priests and the Levites
brought the Tent of Meeting and all the holy vessels that were in
the Tent.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וְכל־עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנּוֹעָדִים עָלָיו אִתּוֹ לִפְנֵי הָאָרוֹן מְזַבְּחִים צֹאן וּבָקָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִסָּפְרוּ וְלֹא יִמָּנוּ מֵרֹב׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וְכל־עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנּוֹעָדִים עָלָיו אִתּוֹ לִפְנֵי הָאָרוֹן מְזַבְּחִים צֹאן וּבָקָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִסָּפְרוּ וְלֹא יִמָּנוּ מֵרֹב׃

english.text:
Meanwhile, King Solomon and the whole community of Israel, who
were assembled with him before the Ark, were sacrificing sheep and
oxen in such abundance that they could not be numbered or counted.

translation.text: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

verses.english:
Meanwhile, King Solomon and the whole community of Israel, who
were assembled with him before the Ark, were sacrificing sheep and
oxen in such abundance that they could not be numbered or counted.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבִאוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה אֶל־מְקוֹמוֹ אֶל־דְּבִיר הַבַּיִת אֶל־קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֶל־תַּחַת כַּנְפֵי הַכְּרוּבִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבִאוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה אֶל־מְקוֹמוֹ אֶל־דְּבִיר הַבַּיִת אֶל־קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֶל־תַּחַת כַּנְפֵי הַכְּרוּבִים׃

translation.text: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הַכְּרוּבִים פֹּרְשִׂים כְּנָפַיִם אֶל־מְקוֹם הָאָרוֹן וַיָּסֹכּוּ הַכְּרֻבִים עַל־הָאָרוֹן וְעַל־בַּדָּיו מִלְמָעְלָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הַכְּרוּבִים פֹּרְשִׂים כְּנָפַיִם אֶל־מְקוֹם הָאָרוֹן וַיָּסֹכּוּ הַכְּרֻבִים עַל־הָאָרוֹן וְעַל־בַּדָּיו מִלְמָעְלָה׃

english.text:
for the cherubim had their wings spread out over the place of the
Ark, so that the cherubim shielded the Ark and its poles from
above.

translation.text: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

verses.english:
for the cherubim had their wings spread out over the place of the
Ark, so that the cherubim shielded the Ark and its poles from
above.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּאֲרִכוּ הַבַּדִּים וַיֵּרָאוּ רָאשֵׁי הַבַּדִּים מִן־הַקֹּדֶשׁ עַל־פְּנֵי הַדְּבִיר וְלֹא יֵרָאוּ הַחוּצָה וַיִּהְיוּ שָׁם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּאֲרִכוּ הַבַּדִּים וַיֵּרָאוּ רָאשֵׁי הַבַּדִּים מִן־הַקֹּדֶשׁ עַל־פְּנֵי הַדְּבִיר וְלֹא יֵרָאוּ הַחוּצָה וַיִּהְיוּ שָׁם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The poles projected so that the ends of the poles were visible in
the sanctuary in front of the Shrine, but they could not be seen
outside; and there they remain to this day.

translation.text: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.

verses.english:
The poles projected so that the ends of the poles were visible in
the sanctuary in front of the Shrine, but they could not be seen
outside; and there they remain to this day.

verses.hebrew: אֵין בָּאָרוֹן רַק שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת הָאֲבָנִים אֲשֶׁר הִנִּחַ שָׁם מֹשֶׁה בְּחֹרֵב אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת יְהֹוָה עִם־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵאתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: אֵין בָּאָרוֹן רַק שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת הָאֲבָנִים אֲשֶׁר הִנִּחַ שָׁם מֹשֶׁה בְּחֹרֵב אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת יְהֹוָה עִם־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵאתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
There was nothing inside the Ark but the two tablets of stone
which Moses placed there at Horeb, when YHWH made [a covenant]
with the Israelites after their departure from the land of Egypt.

translation.text: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
There was nothing inside the Ark but the two tablets of stone
which Moses placed there at Horeb, when YHWH made [a covenant]
with the Israelites after their departure from the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּצֵאת הַכֹּהֲנִים מִן־הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְהֶעָנָן מָלֵא אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּצֵאת הַכֹּהֲנִים מִן־הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְהֶעָנָן מָלֵא אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
When the priests came out of the sanctuary—for the cloud had
filled the House of YHWH

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,

verses.english:
When the priests came out of the sanctuary—for the cloud had
filled the House of YHWH

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יָכְלוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים לַעֲמֹד לְשָׁרֵת מִפְּנֵי הֶעָנָן כִּי־מָלֵא כְבוֹד־יְהֹוָה אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־יָכְלוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים לַעֲמֹד לְשָׁרֵת מִפְּנֵי הֶעָנָן כִּי־מָלֵא כְבוֹד־יְהֹוָה אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and the priests were not able to remain and perform the service
because of the cloud, for the Presence of YHWH filled the House of
YHWH—

translation.text: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
and the priests were not able to remain and perform the service
because of the cloud, for the Presence of YHWH filled the House of
YHWH—

verses.hebrew: אָז אָמַר שְׁלֹמֹה יְהֹוָה אָמַר לִשְׁכֹּן בָּעֲרָפֶל׃

hebrew.text: אָז אָמַר שְׁלֹמֹה יְהֹוָה אָמַר לִשְׁכֹּן בָּעֲרָפֶל׃

english.text: then Solomon declared: “YHWH has chosen To abide in a thick cloud:

translation.text: Then spake Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

verses.english: then Solomon declared: “YHWH has chosen To abide in a thick cloud:

verses.hebrew: בָּנֹה בָנִיתִי בֵּית זְבֻל לָךְ מָכוֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ עוֹלָמִים׃

hebrew.text: בָּנֹה בָנִיתִי בֵּית זְבֻל לָךְ מָכוֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ עוֹלָמִים׃

english.text:
I have now built for You A stately House, A place where You May
dwell forever.”

translation.text: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.

verses.english:
I have now built for You A stately House, A place where You May
dwell forever.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּסֵּב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־פָּנָיו וַיְבָרֶךְ אֵת כּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹמֵד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּסֵּב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־פָּנָיו וַיְבָרֶךְ אֵת כּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹמֵד׃

english.text:
Then, with the whole congregation of Israel standing, the king
faced about and blessed the whole congregation of Israel.

translation.text: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)

verses.english:
Then, with the whole congregation of Israel standing, the king
faced about and blessed the whole congregation of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּפִיו אֵת דָּוִד אָבִי וּבְיָדוֹ מִלֵּא לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּפִיו אֵת דָּוִד אָבִי וּבְיָדוֹ מִלֵּא לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
He said: “Praised be YHWH, the God of Israel, who has fulfilled
with deeds the promise He made to my father David. For He said,

translation.text: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled it, saying,

verses.english:
He said: “Praised be YHWH, the God of Israel, who has fulfilled
with deeds the promise He made to my father David. For He said,

verses.hebrew:
מִן־הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶת־עַמִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם לֹא־בָחַרְתִּי בְעִיר מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לִהְיוֹת שְׁמִי שָׁם וָאֶבְחַר בְּדָוִד
לִהְיוֹת עַל־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
מִן־הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶת־עַמִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם לֹא־בָחַרְתִּי בְעִיר מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לִהְיוֹת שְׁמִי שָׁם וָאֶבְחַר בְּדָוִד
לִהְיוֹת עַל־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
‘Ever since I brought My people Israel out of Egypt, I have not
chosen a city among all the tribes of Israel for building a House
where My name might abide; but I have chosen David to rule My
people Israel.’

translation.text: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.

verses.english:
‘Ever since I brought My people Israel out of Egypt, I have not
chosen a city among all the tribes of Israel for building a House
where My name might abide; but I have chosen David to rule My
people Israel.’

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עִם־לְבַב דָּוִד אָבִי לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי עִם־לְבַב דָּוִד אָבִי לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
“Now my father David had intended to build a House for the name of
YHWH, the God of Israel.

translation.text: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.english:
“Now my father David had intended to build a House for the name of
YHWH, the God of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד אָבִי יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הָיָה עִם־לְבָבְךָ לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לִשְׁמִי הֱטִיבֹתָ כִּי הָיָה עִם־לְבָבֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד אָבִי יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הָיָה עִם־לְבָבְךָ לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לִשְׁמִי הֱטִיבֹתָ כִּי הָיָה עִם־לְבָבֶךָ׃

english.text:
But YHWH said to my father David, ‘As regards your intention to
build a House for My name, you did right to have that intention.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.

verses.english:
But YHWH said to my father David, ‘As regards your intention to
build a House for My name, you did right to have that intention.

verses.hebrew: רַק אַתָּה לֹא תִבְנֶה הַבָּיִת כִּי אִם־בִּנְךָ הַיֹּצֵא מֵחֲלָצֶיךָ הוּא־יִבְנֶה הַבַּיִת לִשְׁמִי׃

hebrew.text: רַק אַתָּה לֹא תִבְנֶה הַבָּיִת כִּי אִם־בִּנְךָ הַיֹּצֵא מֵחֲלָצֶיךָ הוּא־יִבְנֶה הַבַּיִת לִשְׁמִי׃

english.text:
However, you shall not build the House yourself; instead, your
son, the issue of your loins, shall build the House for My name.’

translation.text: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.

verses.english:
However, you shall not build the House yourself; instead, your
son, the issue of your loins, shall build the House for My name.’

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה אֶת־דְּבָרוֹ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר וָאָקֻם תַּחַת דָּוִד אָבִי וָאֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה וָאֶבְנֶה הַבַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי
יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה אֶת־דְּבָרוֹ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר וָאָקֻם תַּחַת דָּוִד אָבִי וָאֵשֵׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה וָאֶבְנֶה הַבַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי
יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
“And YHWH has fulfilled the promise that He made: I have succeeded
my father David and have ascended the throne of Israel, as YHWH
promised. I have built the House for the name of YHWH, the God of
Israel;

translation.text: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.english:
“And YHWH has fulfilled the promise that He made: I have succeeded
my father David and have ascended the throne of Israel, as YHWH
promised. I have built the House for the name of YHWH, the God of
Israel;

verses.hebrew: וָאָשִׂם שָׁם מָקוֹם לָאָרוֹן אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם בְּרִית יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת עִם־אֲבֹתֵינוּ בְּהוֹצִיאוֹ אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וָאָשִׂם שָׁם מָקוֹם לָאָרוֹן אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם בְּרִית יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת עִם־אֲבֹתֵינוּ בְּהוֹצִיאוֹ אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
and I have set a place there for the Ark, containing the covenant
which YHWH made with our fathers when He brought them out from the
land of Egypt.”

translation.text: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
and I have set a place there for the Ark, containing the covenant
which YHWH made with our fathers when He brought them out from the
land of Egypt.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד שְׁלֹמֹה לִפְנֵי מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה נֶגֶד כּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּפְרֹשׂ כַּפָּיו הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲמֹד שְׁלֹמֹה לִפְנֵי מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה נֶגֶד כּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּפְרֹשׂ כַּפָּיו הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
Then Solomon stood before the altar of YHWH in the presence of the
whole community of Israel; he spread the palms of his hands toward
heaven

translation.text: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:

verses.english:
Then Solomon stood before the altar of YHWH in the presence of the
whole community of Israel; he spread the palms of his hands toward
heaven

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵין־כָּמוֹךָ אֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל־הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת שֹׁמֵר הַבְּרִית וְהַחֶסֶד לַעֲבָדֶיךָ הַהֹלְכִים לְפָנֶיךָ בְּכל־לִבָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵין־כָּמוֹךָ אֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל־הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת שֹׁמֵר הַבְּרִית וְהַחֶסֶד לַעֲבָדֶיךָ הַהֹלְכִים לְפָנֶיךָ בְּכל־לִבָּם׃

english.text:
and said, “O LORD God of Israel, in the heavens above and on the
earth below there is no god like You, who keep Your gracious
covenant with Your servants when they walk before You in
wholehearted devotion;

translation.text: And he said, LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:

verses.english:
and said, “O LORD God of Israel, in the heavens above and on the
earth below there is no god like You, who keep Your gracious
covenant with Your servants when they walk before You in
wholehearted devotion;

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַרְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ דָּוִד אָבִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּרְתָּ לוֹ וַתְּדַבֵּר בְּפִיךָ וּבְיָדְךָ מִלֵּאתָ כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַרְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ דָּוִד אָבִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּרְתָּ לוֹ וַתְּדַבֵּר בְּפִיךָ וּבְיָדְךָ מִלֵּאתָ כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
You who have kept the promises You made to Your servant, my father
David, fulfilling with deeds the promise You made—as is now the
case.

translation.text: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.

verses.english:
You who have kept the promises You made to Your servant, my father
David, fulfilling with deeds the promise You made—as is now the
case.

verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמֹר לְעַבְדְּךָ דָוִד אָבִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לּוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא־יִכָּרֵת לְךָ אִישׁ מִלְּפָנַי יֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק
אִם־יִשְׁמְרוּ בָנֶיךָ אֶת־דַּרְכָּם לָלֶכֶת לְפָנַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַכְתָּ לְפָנָי׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמֹר לְעַבְדְּךָ דָוִד אָבִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לּוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא־יִכָּרֵת לְךָ אִישׁ מִלְּפָנַי יֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק
אִם־יִשְׁמְרוּ בָנֶיךָ אֶת־דַּרְכָּם לָלֶכֶת לְפָנַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַכְתָּ לְפָנָי׃

english.text:
And now, O LORD God of Israel, keep the further promise that You
made to Your servant, my father David: ‘Your line on the throne of
Israel shall never end, if only your descendants will look to
their way and walk before Me as you have walked before Me.’

translation.text: Therefore now, LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.

verses.english:
And now, O LORD God of Israel, keep the further promise that You
made to Your servant, my father David: ‘Your line on the throne of
Israel shall never end, if only your descendants will look to
their way and walk before Me as you have walked before Me.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יֵאָמֶן נָא (דבריך) [דְּבָרְךָ] אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ דָּוִד אָבִי׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יֵאָמֶן נָא (דבריך) [דְּבָרְךָ] אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ דָּוִד אָבִי׃

english.text:
Now, therefore, O God of Israel, let the promise that You made to
Your servant my father David be fulfilled.

translation.text: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.

verses.english:
Now, therefore, O God of Israel, let the promise that You made to
Your servant my father David be fulfilled.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הַאֻמְנָם יֵשֵׁב אֱלֹהִים עַל־הָאָרֶץ הִנֵּה הַשָּׁמַיִם וּשְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם לֹא יְכַלְכְּלוּךָ אַף כִּי־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בָּנִיתִי׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הַאֻמְנָם יֵשֵׁב אֱלֹהִים עַל־הָאָרֶץ הִנֵּה הַשָּׁמַיִם וּשְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם לֹא יְכַלְכְּלוּךָ אַף כִּי־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בָּנִיתִי׃

english.text:
“But will God really dwell on earth? Even the heavens to their
uttermost reaches cannot contain You, how much less this House
that I have built!

translation.text: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?

verses.english:
“But will God really dwell on earth? Even the heavens to their
uttermost reaches cannot contain You, how much less this House
that I have built!

verses.hebrew: וּפָנִיתָ אֶל־תְּפִלַּת עַבְדְּךָ וְאֶל־תְּחִנָּתוֹ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶל־הָרִנָּה וְאֶל־הַתְּפִלָּה אֲשֶׁר עַבְדְּךָ מִתְפַּלֵּל לְפָנֶיךָ הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וּפָנִיתָ אֶל־תְּפִלַּת עַבְדְּךָ וְאֶל־תְּחִנָּתוֹ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶל־הָרִנָּה וְאֶל־הַתְּפִלָּה אֲשֶׁר עַבְדְּךָ מִתְפַּלֵּל לְפָנֶיךָ הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
Yet turn, O LORD my God, to the prayer and supplication of Your
servant, and hear the cry and prayer which Your servant offers
before You this day.

translation.text: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:

verses.english:
Yet turn, O LORD my God, to the prayer and supplication of Your
servant, and hear the cry and prayer which Your servant offers
before You this day.

verses.hebrew:
לִהְיוֹת עֵינֶךָ פְתֻחֹת אֶל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה לַיְלָה וָיוֹם אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתָּ יִהְיֶה שְׁמִי שָׁם לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶל־הַתְּפִלָּה אֲשֶׁר יִתְפַּלֵּל עַבְדְּךָ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם
הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
לִהְיוֹת עֵינֶךָ פְתֻחֹת אֶל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה לַיְלָה וָיוֹם אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתָּ יִהְיֶה שְׁמִי שָׁם לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶל־הַתְּפִלָּה אֲשֶׁר יִתְפַּלֵּל עַבְדְּךָ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם
הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
May Your eyes be open day and night toward this House, toward the
place of which You have said, ‘My name shall abide there’; may You
heed the prayers which Your servant will offer toward this place.

translation.text: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.

verses.english:
May Your eyes be open day and night toward this House, toward the
place of which You have said, ‘My name shall abide there’; may You
heed the prayers which Your servant will offer toward this place.

verses.hebrew:
וְשָׁמַעְתָּ אֶל־תְּחִנַּת עַבְדְּךָ וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יִתְפַּלְלוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע אֶל־מְקוֹם שִׁבְתְּךָ אֶל־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְשָׁמַעְתָּ
וְסָלָחְתָּ׃

hebrew.text:
וְשָׁמַעְתָּ אֶל־תְּחִנַּת עַבְדְּךָ וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יִתְפַּלְלוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע אֶל־מְקוֹם שִׁבְתְּךָ אֶל־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְשָׁמַעְתָּ
וְסָלָחְתָּ׃

english.text:
And when You hear the supplications which Your servant and Your
people Israel offer toward this place, give heed in Your heavenly
abode—give heed and pardon.

translation.text: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.

verses.english:
And when You hear the supplications which Your servant and Your
people Israel offer toward this place, give heed in Your heavenly
abode—give heed and pardon.

verses.hebrew: אֵת אֲשֶׁר יֶחֱטָא אִישׁ לְרֵעֵהוּ וְנָשָׁא־בוֹ אָלָה לְהַאֲלֹתוֹ וּבָא אָלָה לִפְנֵי מִזְבַּחֲךָ בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: אֵת אֲשֶׁר יֶחֱטָא אִישׁ לְרֵעֵהוּ וְנָשָׁא־בוֹ אָלָה לְהַאֲלֹתוֹ וּבָא אָלָה לִפְנֵי מִזְבַּחֲךָ בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
“Whenever one man commits an offense against another, and the
latter utters an imprecation to bring a curse upon him, and comes
with his imprecation before Your altar in this House,

translation.text: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:

verses.english:
“Whenever one man commits an offense against another, and the
latter utters an imprecation to bring a curse upon him, and comes
with his imprecation before Your altar in this House,

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם וְעָשִׂיתָ וְשָׁפַטְתָּ אֶת־עֲבָדֶיךָ לְהַרְשִׁיעַ רָשָׁע לָתֵת דַּרְכּוֹ בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וּלְהַצְדִּיק צַדִּיק לָתֶת לוֹ כְּצִדְקָתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם וְעָשִׂיתָ וְשָׁפַטְתָּ אֶת־עֲבָדֶיךָ לְהַרְשִׁיעַ רָשָׁע לָתֵת דַּרְכּוֹ בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וּלְהַצְדִּיק צַדִּיק לָתֶת לוֹ כְּצִדְקָתוֹ׃

english.text:
oh, hear in heaven and take action to judge Your servants,
condemning him who is in the wrong and bringing down the
punishment of his conduct on his head, vindicating him who is in
the right by rewarding him according to his righteousness.

translation.text: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

verses.english:
oh, hear in heaven and take action to judge Your servants,
condemning him who is in the wrong and bringing down the
punishment of his conduct on his head, vindicating him who is in
the right by rewarding him according to his righteousness.

verses.hebrew: בְּהִנָּגֵף עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי אוֹיֵב אֲשֶׁר יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָךְ וְשָׁבוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְהוֹדוּ אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ וְהִתְחַנְּנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: בְּהִנָּגֵף עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי אוֹיֵב אֲשֶׁר יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָךְ וְשָׁבוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְהוֹדוּ אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ וְהִתְחַנְּנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
“Should Your people Israel be routed by an enemy because they have
sinned against You, and then turn back to You and acknowledge Your
name, and they offer prayer and supplication to You in this House,

translation.text: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house:

verses.english:
“Should Your people Israel be routed by an enemy because they have
sinned against You, and then turn back to You and acknowledge Your
name, and they offer prayer and supplication to You in this House,

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם וְסָלַחְתָּ לְחַטַּאת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָם אֶל־הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּ לַאֲבוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם וְסָלַחְתָּ לְחַטַּאת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָם אֶל־הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּ לַאֲבוֹתָם׃

english.text:
oh, hear in heaven and pardon the sin of Your people Israel, and
restore them to the land that You gave to their fathers.

translation.text: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.

verses.english:
oh, hear in heaven and pardon the sin of Your people Israel, and
restore them to the land that You gave to their fathers.

verses.hebrew: בְּהֵעָצֵר שָׁמַיִם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה מָטָר כִּי יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָךְ וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְהוֹדוּ אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ וּמֵחַטָּאתָם יְשׁוּבוּן כִּי תַעֲנֵם׃

hebrew.text: בְּהֵעָצֵר שָׁמַיִם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה מָטָר כִּי יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָךְ וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְהוֹדוּ אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ וּמֵחַטָּאתָם יְשׁוּבוּן כִּי תַעֲנֵם׃

english.text:
“Should the heavens be shut up and there be no rain, because they
have sinned against You, and then they pray toward this place and
acknowledge Your name and repent of their sins, when You answer
them,

translation.text: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:

verses.english:
“Should the heavens be shut up and there be no rain, because they
have sinned against You, and then they pray toward this place and
acknowledge Your name and repent of their sins, when You answer
them,

verses.hebrew:
וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם וְסָלַחְתָּ לְחַטַּאת עֲבָדֶיךָ וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי תוֹרֵם אֶת־הַדֶּרֶךְ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר יֵלְכוּ־בָהּ וְנָתַתָּה מָטָר עַל־אַרְצְךָ
אֲשֶׁר־נָתַתָּה לְעַמְּךָ לְנַחֲלָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם וְסָלַחְתָּ לְחַטַּאת עֲבָדֶיךָ וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי תוֹרֵם אֶת־הַדֶּרֶךְ הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר יֵלְכוּ־בָהּ וְנָתַתָּה מָטָר עַל־אַרְצְךָ
אֲשֶׁר־נָתַתָּה לְעַמְּךָ לְנַחֲלָה׃

english.text:
oh, hear in heaven and pardon the sin of Your servants, Your
people Israel, after You have shown them the proper way in which
they are to walk; and send down rain upon the land which You gave
to Your people as their heritage.

translation.text: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.

verses.english:
oh, hear in heaven and pardon the sin of Your servants, Your
people Israel, after You have shown them the proper way in which
they are to walk; and send down rain upon the land which You gave
to Your people as their heritage.

verses.hebrew: רָעָב כִּי־יִהְיֶה בָאָרֶץ דֶּבֶר כִּי־יִהְיֶה שִׁדָּפוֹן יֵרָקוֹן אַרְבֶּה חָסִיל כִּי יִהְיֶה כִּי יָצַר־לוֹ אֹיְבוֹ בְּאֶרֶץ שְׁעָרָיו כּל־נֶגַע כּל־מַחֲלָה׃

hebrew.text: רָעָב כִּי־יִהְיֶה בָאָרֶץ דֶּבֶר כִּי־יִהְיֶה שִׁדָּפוֹן יֵרָקוֹן אַרְבֶּה חָסִיל כִּי יִהְיֶה כִּי יָצַר־לוֹ אֹיְבוֹ בְּאֶרֶץ שְׁעָרָיו כּל־נֶגַע כּל־מַחֲלָה׃

english.text:
So, too, if there is a famine in the land, if there is pestilence,
blight, mildew, locusts or caterpillars, or if an enemy oppresses
them in any of the settlements of the land. “In any plague and in
any disease,

translation.text: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, or if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;

verses.english:
So, too, if there is a famine in the land, if there is pestilence,
blight, mildew, locusts or caterpillars, or if an enemy oppresses
them in any of the settlements of the land. “In any plague and in
any disease,

verses.hebrew: כּל־תְּפִלָּה כל־תְּחִנָּה אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶה לְכל־הָאָדָם לְכֹל עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יֵדְעוּן אִישׁ נֶגַע לְבָבוֹ וּפָרַשׂ כַּפָּיו אֶל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כּל־תְּפִלָּה כל־תְּחִנָּה אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶה לְכל־הָאָדָם לְכֹל עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יֵדְעוּן אִישׁ נֶגַע לְבָבוֹ וּפָרַשׂ כַּפָּיו אֶל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
in any prayer or supplication offered by any person among all Your
people Israel—each of whom knows his own affliction—when he
spreads his palms toward this House,

translation.text: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, or by all thy people Israel, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:

verses.english:
in any prayer or supplication offered by any person among all Your
people Israel—each of whom knows his own affliction—when he
spreads his palms toward this House,

verses.hebrew:
וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם מְכוֹן שִׁבְתֶּךָ וְסָלַחְתָּ וְעָשִׂיתָ וְנָתַתָּ לָאִישׁ כְּכל־דְּרָכָיו אֲשֶׁר תֵּדַע אֶת־לְבָבוֹ כִּי־אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ לְבַדְּךָ אֶת־לְבַב
כּל־בְּנֵי הָאָדָם׃

hebrew.text:
וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם מְכוֹן שִׁבְתֶּךָ וְסָלַחְתָּ וְעָשִׂיתָ וְנָתַתָּ לָאִישׁ כְּכל־דְּרָכָיו אֲשֶׁר תֵּדַע אֶת־לְבָבוֹ כִּי־אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ לְבַדְּךָ אֶת־לְבַב
כּל־בְּנֵי הָאָדָם׃

english.text:
oh, hear in Your heavenly abode, and pardon and take action!
Render to each man according to his ways as You know his heart to
be—for You alone know the hearts of all men—

translation.text: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)

verses.english:
oh, hear in Your heavenly abode, and pardon and take action!
Render to each man according to his ways as You know his heart to
be—for You alone know the hearts of all men—

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יִרָאוּךָ כּל־הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר־הֵם חַיִּים עַל־פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן יִרָאוּךָ כּל־הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר־הֵם חַיִּים עַל־פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ׃

english.text:
so that they may revere You all the days that they live on the
land that You gave to our fathers.

translation.text: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.

verses.english:
so that they may revere You all the days that they live on the
land that You gave to our fathers.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֶל־הַנּכְרִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מֵעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא וּבָא מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אֶל־הַנּכְרִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מֵעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא וּבָא מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ׃

english.text:
“Or if a foreigner who is not of Your people Israel comes from a
distant land for the sake of Your name—

translation.text: Moreover concerning a stranger, that is not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name’s sake;

verses.english:
“Or if a foreigner who is not of Your people Israel comes from a
distant land for the sake of Your name—

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִשְׁמְעוּן אֶת־שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְאֶת־יָדְךָ הַחֲזָקָה וּזְרֹעֲךָ הַנְּטוּיָה וּבָא וְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יִשְׁמְעוּן אֶת־שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְאֶת־יָדְךָ הַחֲזָקָה וּזְרֹעֲךָ הַנְּטוּיָה וּבָא וְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
for they shall hear about Your great name and Your mighty hand and
Your outstretched arm—when he comes to pray toward this House,

translation.text: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;

verses.english:
for they shall hear about Your great name and Your mighty hand and
Your outstretched arm—when he comes to pray toward this House,

verses.hebrew:
אַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם מְכוֹן שִׁבְתֶּךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָא אֵלֶיךָ הַנּכְרִי לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּן כּל־עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ לְיִרְאָה אֹתְךָ כְּעַמְּךָ
יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלָדַעַת כִּי־שִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא עַל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בָּנִיתִי׃

hebrew.text:
אַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע הַשָּׁמַיִם מְכוֹן שִׁבְתֶּךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָא אֵלֶיךָ הַנּכְרִי לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּן כּל־עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ לְיִרְאָה אֹתְךָ כְּעַמְּךָ
יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלָדַעַת כִּי־שִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא עַל־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בָּנִיתִי׃

english.text:
oh, hear in Your heavenly abode and grant all that the foreigner
asks You for. Thus all the peoples of the earth will know Your
name and revere You, as does Your people Israel; and they will
recognize that Your name is attached to this House that I have
built.

translation.text: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as do thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name.

verses.english:
oh, hear in Your heavenly abode and grant all that the foreigner
asks You for. Thus all the peoples of the earth will know Your
name and revere You, as does Your people Israel; and they will
recognize that Your name is attached to this House that I have
built.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יֵצֵא עַמְּךָ לַמִּלְחָמָה עַל־אֹיְבוֹ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁלָחֵם וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה דֶּרֶךְ הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתָּ בָּהּ וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנִתִי לִשְׁמֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־יֵצֵא עַמְּךָ לַמִּלְחָמָה עַל־אֹיְבוֹ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁלָחֵם וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה דֶּרֶךְ הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתָּ בָּהּ וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנִתִי לִשְׁמֶךָ׃

english.text:
“When Your people take the field against their enemy by whatever
way You send them, and they pray to YHWH in the direction of the
city which You have chosen, and of the House which I have built to
Your name,

translation.text: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the LORD toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house that I have built for thy name:

verses.english:
“When Your people take the field against their enemy by whatever
way You send them, and they pray to YHWH in the direction of the
city which You have chosen, and of the House which I have built to
Your name,

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ הַשָּׁמַיִם אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָם וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתָם וְעָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטָם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ הַשָּׁמַיִם אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָם וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתָם וְעָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטָם׃

english.text:
oh, hear in heaven their prayer and supplication and uphold their
cause.

translation.text: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

verses.english:
oh, hear in heaven their prayer and supplication and uphold their
cause.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָךְ כִּי אֵין אָדָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יֶחֱטָא וְאָנַפְתָּ בָם וּנְתַתָּם לִפְנֵי אוֹיֵב וְשָׁבוּם שֹׁבֵיהֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ הָאוֹיֵב רְחוֹקָה אוֹ קְרוֹבָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָךְ כִּי אֵין אָדָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יֶחֱטָא וְאָנַפְתָּ בָם וּנְתַתָּם לִפְנֵי אוֹיֵב וְשָׁבוּם שֹׁבֵיהֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ הָאוֹיֵב רְחוֹקָה אוֹ קְרוֹבָה׃

translation.text: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;

verses.hebrew: וְהֵשִׁיבוּ אֶל־לִבָּם בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבּוּ־שָׁם וְשָׁבוּ וְהִתְחַנְּנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְּאֶרֶץ שֹׁבֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר חָטָאנוּ וְהֶעֱוִינוּ רָשָׁעְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵשִׁיבוּ אֶל־לִבָּם בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבּוּ־שָׁם וְשָׁבוּ וְהִתְחַנְּנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְּאֶרֶץ שֹׁבֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר חָטָאנוּ וְהֶעֱוִינוּ רָשָׁעְנוּ׃

english.text:
and then they take it to heart in the land to which they have been
carried off, and they repent and make supplication to You in the
land of their captors, saying: ‘We have sinned, we have acted
perversely, we have acted wickedly,’

translation.text: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;

verses.english:
and then they take it to heart in the land to which they have been
carried off, and they repent and make supplication to You in the
land of their captors, saying: ‘We have sinned, we have acted
perversely, we have acted wickedly,’

verses.hebrew:
וְשָׁבוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְּכל־לְבָבָם וּבְכל־נַפְשָׁם בְּאֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר־שָׁבוּ אֹתָם וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ אֵלֶיךָ דֶּרֶךְ אַרְצָם אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה לַאֲבוֹתָם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתָּ
וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר־[בָּנִיתִי] (בנית) לִשְׁמֶךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וְשָׁבוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְּכל־לְבָבָם וּבְכל־נַפְשָׁם בְּאֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר־שָׁבוּ אֹתָם וְהִתְפַּלְלוּ אֵלֶיךָ דֶּרֶךְ אַרְצָם אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה לַאֲבוֹתָם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתָּ
וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר־[בָּנִיתִי] (בנית) לִשְׁמֶךָ׃

english.text:
and they turn back to You with all their heart and soul, in the
land of the enemies who have carried them off, and they pray to
You in the direction of their land which You gave to their
fathers, of the city which You have chosen, and of the House which
I have built to Your name—

translation.text: And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:

verses.english:
and they turn back to You with all their heart and soul, in the
land of the enemies who have carried them off, and they pray to
You in the direction of their land which You gave to their
fathers, of the city which You have chosen, and of the House which
I have built to Your name—

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ הַשָּׁמַיִם מְכוֹן שִׁבְתְּךָ אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָם וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתָם וְעָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטָם׃

hebrew.text: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ הַשָּׁמַיִם מְכוֹן שִׁבְתְּךָ אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָם וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתָם וְעָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטָם׃

english.text:
oh, give heed in Your heavenly abode to their prayer and
supplication, uphold their cause,

translation.text: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,

verses.english:
oh, give heed in Your heavenly abode to their prayer and
supplication, uphold their cause,

verses.hebrew: וְסָלַחְתָּ לְעַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר חָטְאוּ־לָךְ וּלְכל־פִּשְׁעֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר פָּשְׁעוּ־בָךְ וּנְתַתָּם לְרַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי שֹׁבֵיהֶם וְרִחֲמוּם׃

hebrew.text: וְסָלַחְתָּ לְעַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר חָטְאוּ־לָךְ וּלְכל־פִּשְׁעֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר פָּשְׁעוּ־בָךְ וּנְתַתָּם לְרַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי שֹׁבֵיהֶם וְרִחֲמוּם׃

english.text:
and pardon Your people who have sinned against You for all the
transgressions that they have committed against You. Grant them
mercy in the sight of their captors that they may be merciful to
them.

translation.text: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:

verses.english:
and pardon Your people who have sinned against You for all the
transgressions that they have committed against You. Grant them
mercy in the sight of their captors that they may be merciful to
them.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עַמְּךָ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ הֵם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ מִמִּצְרַיִם מִתּוֹךְ כּוּר הַבַּרְזֶל׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־עַמְּךָ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ הֵם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ מִמִּצְרַיִם מִתּוֹךְ כּוּר הַבַּרְזֶל׃

english.text:
For they are Your very own people that You freed from Egypt, from
the midst of the iron furnace.

translation.text: For they be thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:

verses.english:
For they are Your very own people that You freed from Egypt, from
the midst of the iron furnace.

verses.hebrew: לִהְיוֹת עֵינֶיךָ פְתֻחֹת אֶל־תְּחִנַּת עַבְדְּךָ וְאֶל־תְּחִנַּת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִשְׁמֹעַ אֲלֵיהֶם בְּכֹל קרְאָם אֵלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: לִהְיוֹת עֵינֶיךָ פְתֻחֹת אֶל־תְּחִנַּת עַבְדְּךָ וְאֶל־תְּחִנַּת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִשְׁמֹעַ אֲלֵיהֶם בְּכֹל קרְאָם אֵלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
May Your eyes be open to the supplication of Your servant and the
supplication of Your people Israel, and may You heed them whenever
they call upon You.

translation.text: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.

verses.english:
May Your eyes be open to the supplication of Your servant and the
supplication of Your people Israel, and may You heed them whenever
they call upon You.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה הִבְדַּלְתָּם לְךָ לְנַחֲלָה מִכֹּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ בְּהוֹצִיאֲךָ אֶת־אֲבֹתֵינוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־אַתָּה הִבְדַּלְתָּם לְךָ לְנַחֲלָה מִכֹּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ בְּהוֹצִיאֲךָ אֶת־אֲבֹתֵינוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם אֲדֹנָי יֱהֹוִה׃

english.text:
For You, O Lord GOD, have set them apart for Yourself from all the
peoples of the earth as Your very own, as You promised through
Moses Your servant when You freed our fathers from Egypt.”

translation.text: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth, to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O LORD God.

verses.english:
For You, O Lord GOD, have set them apart for Yourself from all the
peoples of the earth as Your very own, as You promised through
Moses Your servant when You freed our fathers from Egypt.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת שְׁלֹמֹה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֵת כּל־הַתְּפִלָּה וְהַתְּחִנָּה הַזֹּאת קָם מִלִּפְנֵי מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה מִכְּרֹעַ עַל־בִּרְכָּיו וְכַפָּיו פְּרֻשׂוֹת
הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת שְׁלֹמֹה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֵת כּל־הַתְּפִלָּה וְהַתְּחִנָּה הַזֹּאת קָם מִלִּפְנֵי מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה מִכְּרֹעַ עַל־בִּרְכָּיו וְכַפָּיו פְּרֻשׂוֹת
הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
When Solomon finished offering to YHWH all this prayer and
supplication, he rose from where he had been kneeling, in front of
the altar of YHWH, his hands spread out toward heaven.

translation.text: And it was so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the LORD, he arose from before the altar of the LORD, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.

verses.english:
When Solomon finished offering to YHWH all this prayer and
supplication, he rose from where he had been kneeling, in front of
the altar of YHWH, his hands spread out toward heaven.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד וַיְבָרֶךְ אֵת כּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל קוֹל גָּדוֹל לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲמֹד וַיְבָרֶךְ אֵת כּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל קוֹל גָּדוֹל לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
He stood, and in a loud voice blessed the whole congregation of
Israel:

translation.text: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

verses.english:
He stood, and in a loud voice blessed the whole congregation of
Israel:

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן מְנוּחָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר לֹא־נָפַל דָּבָר אֶחָד מִכֹּל דְּבָרוֹ הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן מְנוּחָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר לֹא־נָפַל דָּבָר אֶחָד מִכֹּל דְּבָרוֹ הַטּוֹב אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ׃

english.text:
“Praised be YHWH who has granted a haven to His people Israel,
just as He promised; not a single word has failed of all the
gracious promises that He made through His servant Moses.

translation.text: Blessed be the LORD, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.

verses.english:
“Praised be YHWH who has granted a haven to His people Israel,
just as He promised; not a single word has failed of all the
gracious promises that He made through His servant Moses.

verses.hebrew: יְהִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ עִמָּנוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה עִם־אֲבֹתֵינוּ אַל־יַעַזְבֵנוּ וְאַל־יִטְּשֵׁנוּ׃

hebrew.text: יְהִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ עִמָּנוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיָה עִם־אֲבֹתֵינוּ אַל־יַעַזְבֵנוּ וְאַל־יִטְּשֵׁנוּ׃

english.text:
May YHWH our God be with us, as He was with our fathers. May He
never abandon or forsake us.

translation.text: The LORD our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:

verses.english:
May YHWH our God be with us, as He was with our fathers. May He
never abandon or forsake us.

verses.hebrew: לְהַטּוֹת לְבָבֵנוּ אֵלָיו לָלֶכֶת בְּכל־דְּרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקָּיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶת־אֲבֹתֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: לְהַטּוֹת לְבָבֵנוּ אֵלָיו לָלֶכֶת בְּכל־דְּרָכָיו וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְחֻקָּיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶת־אֲבֹתֵינוּ׃

english.text:
May He incline our hearts to Him, that we may walk in all His ways
and keep the commandments, the laws, and the rules, which He
enjoined upon our fathers.

translation.text: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.

verses.english:
May He incline our hearts to Him, that we may walk in all His ways
and keep the commandments, the laws, and the rules, which He
enjoined upon our fathers.

verses.hebrew:
וְיִהְיוּ דְבָרַי אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַנַּנְתִּי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קְרֹבִים אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפַּט עַבְדּוֹ וּמִשְׁפַּט עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל
דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְיִהְיוּ דְבָרַי אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַנַּנְתִּי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קְרֹבִים אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפַּט עַבְדּוֹ וּמִשְׁפַּט עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל
דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
And may these words of mine, which I have offered in supplication
before YHWH, be close to YHWH our God day and night, that He may
provide for His servant and for His people Israel, according to
each day’s needs—

translation.text: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the LORD, be nigh unto the LORD our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:

verses.english:
And may these words of mine, which I have offered in supplication
before YHWH, be close to YHWH our God day and night, that He may
provide for His servant and for His people Israel, according to
each day’s needs—

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן דַּעַת כּל־עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֵין עוֹד׃

hebrew.text: לְמַעַן דַּעַת כּל־עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֵין עוֹד׃

english.text:
to the end that all the peoples of the earth may know that YHWH
alone is God, there is no other.

translation.text: That all the people of the earth may know that the LORD is God, and that there is none else.

verses.english:
to the end that all the peoples of the earth may know that YHWH
alone is God, there is no other.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה לְבַבְכֶם שָׁלֵם עִם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לָלֶכֶת בְּחֻקָּיו וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה לְבַבְכֶם שָׁלֵם עִם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לָלֶכֶת בְּחֻקָּיו וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And may you be wholehearted with YHWH our God, to walk in His ways
and keep His commandments, even as now.”

translation.text: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.

verses.english:
And may you be wholehearted with YHWH our God, to walk in His ways
and keep His commandments, even as now.”

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ זֹבְחִים זֶבַח לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ זֹבְחִים זֶבַח לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text: The king and all Israel with him offered sacrifices before YHWH.

translation.text: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.

verses.english: The king and all Israel with him offered sacrifices before YHWH.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּזְבַּח שְׁלֹמֹה אֵת זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר זָבַח לַיהֹוָה בָּקָר עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף וְצֹאן מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף וַיַּחְנְכוּ אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה הַמֶּלֶךְ
וְכל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּזְבַּח שְׁלֹמֹה אֵת זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר זָבַח לַיהֹוָה בָּקָר עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף וְצֹאן מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף וַיַּחְנְכוּ אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה הַמֶּלֶךְ
וְכל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Solomon offered 22,000 oxen and 120,000 sheep as sacrifices of
well-being to YHWH. Thus the king and all the Israelites dedicated
the House of YHWH.

translation.text: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the LORD, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
Solomon offered 22,000 oxen and 120,000 sheep as sacrifices of
well-being to YHWH. Thus the king and all the Israelites dedicated
the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew:
בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא קִדַּשׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־תּוֹךְ הֶחָצֵר אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי בֵית־יְהֹוָה כִּי־עָשָׂה שָׁם אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וְאֵת חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁלָמִים כִּי־מִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת
אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קָטֹן מֵהָכִיל אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וְאֵת חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁלָמִים׃

hebrew.text:
בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא קִדַּשׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־תּוֹךְ הֶחָצֵר אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי בֵית־יְהֹוָה כִּי־עָשָׂה שָׁם אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וְאֵת חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁלָמִים כִּי־מִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת
אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קָטֹן מֵהָכִיל אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וְאֵת חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁלָמִים׃

english.text:
That day the king consecrated the center of the court that was in
front of the House of YHWH. For it was there that he presented the
burnt offerings, the meal offerings, and the fat parts of the
offerings of well-being, because the bronze altar that was before
YHWH was too small to hold the burnt offerings, the meal
offerings, and the fat parts of the offerings of well-being.

translation.text: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.

verses.english:
That day the king consecrated the center of the court that was in
front of the House of YHWH. For it was there that he presented the
burnt offerings, the meal offerings, and the fat parts of the
offerings of well-being, because the bronze altar that was before
YHWH was too small to hold the burnt offerings, the meal
offerings, and the fat parts of the offerings of well-being.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹה בָעֵת־הַהִיא אֶת־הֶחָג וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ קָהָל גָּדוֹל מִלְּבוֹא חֲמָת עַד־נַחַל מִצְרַיִם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְשִׁבְעַת יָמִים
אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹה בָעֵת־הַהִיא אֶת־הֶחָג וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ קָהָל גָּדוֹל מִלְּבוֹא חֲמָת עַד־נַחַל מִצְרַיִם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְשִׁבְעַת יָמִים
אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם׃

english.text:
So Solomon and all Israel with him—a great assemblage, [coming]
from Lebo-hamath to the Wadi of Egypt—observed the Feast at that
time before YHWH our God, seven days and again seven days,
fourteen days in all.

translation.text: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.

verses.english:
So Solomon and all Israel with him—a great assemblage, [coming]
from Lebo-hamath to the Wadi of Egypt—observed the Feast at that
time before YHWH our God, seven days and again seven days,
fourteen days in all.

verses.hebrew:
בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי שִׁלַּח אֶת־הָעָם וַיְבָרְכוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּלְכוּ לְאהֳלֵיהֶם שְׂמֵחִים וְטוֹבֵי לֵב עַל כּל־הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לְדָוִד עַבְדּוֹ
וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי שִׁלַּח אֶת־הָעָם וַיְבָרְכוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּלְכוּ לְאהֳלֵיהֶם שְׂמֵחִים וְטוֹבֵי לֵב עַל כּל־הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה לְדָוִד עַבְדּוֹ
וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ׃

english.text:
On the eighth day he let the people go. They bade the king
good-bye and went to their homes, joyful and glad of heart over
all the goodness that YHWH had shown to His servant David and His
people Israel.

translation.text: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.

verses.english:
On the eighth day he let the people go. They bade the king
good-bye and went to their homes, joyful and glad of heart over
all the goodness that YHWH had shown to His servant David and His
people Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת שְׁלֹמֹה לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֵת כּל־חֵשֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת שְׁלֹמֹה לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֵת כּל־חֵשֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

english.text:
When Solomon had finished building the House of YHWH and the royal
palace and everything that Solomon had set his heart on
constructing,

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD, and the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,

verses.english:
When Solomon had finished building the House of YHWH and the royal
palace and everything that Solomon had set his heart on
constructing,

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה שֵׁנִית כַּאֲשֶׁר נִרְאָה אֵלָיו בְּגִבְעוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָא יְהֹוָה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה שֵׁנִית כַּאֲשֶׁר נִרְאָה אֵלָיו בְּגִבְעוֹן׃

english.text:
YHWH appeared to Solomon a second time, as He had appeared to him
at Gibeon.

translation.text: That the LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.

verses.english:
YHWH appeared to Solomon a second time, as He had appeared to him
at Gibeon.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת־תְּפִלָּתְךָ וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתְךָ אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַנַּנְתָּה לְפָנַי הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי אֶת־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בָּנִתָה לָשׂוּם־שְׁמִי שָׁם
עַד־עוֹלָם וְהָיוּ עֵינַי וְלִבִּי שָׁם כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת־תְּפִלָּתְךָ וְאֶת־תְּחִנָּתְךָ אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַנַּנְתָּה לְפָנַי הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי אֶת־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בָּנִתָה לָשׂוּם־שְׁמִי שָׁם
עַד־עוֹלָם וְהָיוּ עֵינַי וְלִבִּי שָׁם כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
YHWH said to him, “I have heard the prayer and the supplication
which you have offered to Me. I consecrate this House which you
have built and I set My name there forever. My eyes and My heart
shall ever be there.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

verses.english:
YHWH said to him, “I have heard the prayer and the supplication
which you have offered to Me. I consecrate this House which you
have built and I set My name there forever. My eyes and My heart
shall ever be there.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה אִם־תֵּלֵךְ לְפָנַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ דָּוִד אָבִיךָ בְּתם־לֵבָב וּבְיֹשֶׁר לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִיךָ חֻקַּי וּמִשְׁפָּטַי תִּשְׁמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה אִם־תֵּלֵךְ לְפָנַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ דָּוִד אָבִיךָ בְּתם־לֵבָב וּבְיֹשֶׁר לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִיךָ חֻקַּי וּמִשְׁפָּטַי תִּשְׁמֹר׃

english.text:
As for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked
before Me, wholeheartedly and with uprightness, doing all that I
have commanded you [and] keeping My laws and My rules,

translation.text: And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, and wilt keep my statutes and my judgments:

verses.english:
As for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked
before Me, wholeheartedly and with uprightness, doing all that I
have commanded you [and] keeping My laws and My rules,

verses.hebrew: וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת־כִּסֵּא מַמְלַכְתְּךָ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעֹלָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי עַל־דָּוִד אָבִיךָ לֵאמֹר לֹא־יִכָּרֵת לְךָ אִישׁ מֵעַל כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת־כִּסֵּא מַמְלַכְתְּךָ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעֹלָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי עַל־דָּוִד אָבִיךָ לֵאמֹר לֹא־יִכָּרֵת לְךָ אִישׁ מֵעַל כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
then I will establish your throne of kingship over Israel forever,
as I promised your father David, saying, ‘Your line on the throne
of Israel shall never end.’

translation.text: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.

verses.english:
then I will establish your throne of kingship over Israel forever,
as I promised your father David, saying, ‘Your line on the throne
of Israel shall never end.’

verses.hebrew:
אִם־שׁוֹב תְּשֻׁבוּן אַתֶּם וּבְנֵיכֶם מֵאַחֲרַי וְלֹא תִשְׁמְרוּ מִצְוֺתַי חֻקֹּתַי אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶם וַהֲלַכְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם
לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
אִם־שׁוֹב תְּשֻׁבוּן אַתֶּם וּבְנֵיכֶם מֵאַחֲרַי וְלֹא תִשְׁמְרוּ מִצְוֺתַי חֻקֹּתַי אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶם וַהֲלַכְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם
לָהֶם׃

english.text:
[But] if you and your descendants turn away from Me and do not
keep the commandments [and] the laws which I have set before you,
and go and serve other gods and worship them,

translation.text: But if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:

verses.english:
[But] if you and your descendants turn away from Me and do not
keep the commandments [and] the laws which I have set before you,
and go and serve other gods and worship them,

verses.hebrew:
וְהִכְרַתִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָהֶם וְאֶת־הַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי לִשְׁמִי אֲשַׁלַּח מֵעַל פָּנָי וְהָיָה יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמָשָׁל
וְלִשְׁנִינָה בְּכל־הָעַמִּים׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִכְרַתִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָהֶם וְאֶת־הַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי לִשְׁמִי אֲשַׁלַּח מֵעַל פָּנָי וְהָיָה יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמָשָׁל
וְלִשְׁנִינָה בְּכל־הָעַמִּים׃

english.text:
then I will sweep Israel off the land which I gave them; I will
reject the House which I have consecrated to My name; and Israel
shall become a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

translation.text: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:

verses.english:
then I will sweep Israel off the land which I gave them; I will
reject the House which I have consecrated to My name; and Israel
shall become a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

verses.hebrew: וְהַבַּיִת הַזֶּה יִהְיֶה עֶלְיוֹן כּל־עֹבֵר עָלָיו יִשֹּׁם וְשָׁרָק וְאָמְרוּ עַל־מֶה עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה כָּכָה לָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וְלַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבַּיִת הַזֶּה יִהְיֶה עֶלְיוֹן כּל־עֹבֵר עָלָיו יִשֹּׁם וְשָׁרָק וְאָמְרוּ עַל־מֶה עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה כָּכָה לָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וְלַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
And as for this House, once so exalted, everyone passing by it
shall be appalled and shall hiss. And when they ask, ‘Why did YHWH
do thus to the land and to this House?’

translation.text: And at this house, which is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and to this house?

verses.english:
And as for this House, once so exalted, everyone passing by it
shall be appalled and shall hiss. And when they ask, ‘Why did YHWH
do thus to the land and to this House?’

verses.hebrew:
וְאָמְרוּ עַל אֲשֶׁר עָזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיא אֶת־אֲבֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיַּחֲזִקוּ בֵּאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים (וישתחו) [וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ] לָהֶם וַיַּעַבְדֻם
עַל־כֵּן הֵבִיא יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיהֶם אֵת כּל־הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת׃

hebrew.text:
וְאָמְרוּ עַל אֲשֶׁר עָזְבוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיא אֶת־אֲבֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיַּחֲזִקוּ בֵּאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים (וישתחו) [וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ] לָהֶם וַיַּעַבְדֻם
עַל־כֵּן הֵבִיא יְהֹוָה עֲלֵיהֶם אֵת כּל־הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת׃

english.text:
they shall be told, ‘It is because they forsook YHWH their God who
freed them from the land of Egypt, and they embraced other gods
and worshiped them and served them; therefore YHWH has brought all
this calamity upon them.’”

translation.text: And they shall answer, Because they forsook the LORD their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the LORD brought upon them all this evil.

verses.english:
they shall be told, ‘It is because they forsook YHWH their God who
freed them from the land of Egypt, and they embraced other gods
and worshiped them and served them; therefore YHWH has brought all
this calamity upon them.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקְצֵה עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה אֲשֶׁר־בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־שְׁנֵי הַבָּתִּים אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקְצֵה עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה אֲשֶׁר־בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־שְׁנֵי הַבָּתִּים אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
At the end of the twenty years during which Solomon constructed
the two buildings, YHWH’s House and the royal palace—

translation.text: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the LORD, and the king’s house,

verses.english:
At the end of the twenty years during which Solomon constructed
the two buildings, YHWH’s House and the royal palace—

verses.hebrew: חִירָם מֶלֶךְ־צֹר נִשָּׂא אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה בַּעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וּבַעֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים וּבַזָּהָב לְכל־חֶפְצוֹ אָז יִתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לְחִירָם עֶשְׂרִים עִיר בְּאֶרֶץ הַגָּלִיל׃

hebrew.text: חִירָם מֶלֶךְ־צֹר נִשָּׂא אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה בַּעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וּבַעֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים וּבַזָּהָב לְכל־חֶפְצוֹ אָז יִתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לְחִירָם עֶשְׂרִים עִיר בְּאֶרֶץ הַגָּלִיל׃

english.text:
since King Hiram of Tyre had supplied Solomon with all the cedar
and cypress timber and gold that he required—King Solomon in turn
gave Hiram twenty towns in the region of Galilee.

translation.text: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

verses.english:
since King Hiram of Tyre had supplied Solomon with all the cedar
and cypress timber and gold that he required—King Solomon in turn
gave Hiram twenty towns in the region of Galilee.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא חִירָם מִצֹּר לִרְאוֹת אֶת־הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר נָתַן־לוֹ שְׁלֹמֹה וְלֹא יָשְׁרוּ בְּעֵינָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא חִירָם מִצֹּר לִרְאוֹת אֶת־הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר נָתַן־לוֹ שְׁלֹמֹה וְלֹא יָשְׁרוּ בְּעֵינָיו׃

english.text:
But when Hiram came from Tyre to inspect the towns that Solomon
had given him, he was not pleased with them.

translation.text: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.

verses.english:
But when Hiram came from Tyre to inspect the towns that Solomon
had given him, he was not pleased with them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נָתַתָּה לִּי אָחִי וַיִּקְרָא לָהֶם אֶרֶץ כָּבוּל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נָתַתָּה לִּי אָחִי וַיִּקְרָא לָהֶם אֶרֶץ כָּבוּל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
“My brother,” he said, “what sort of towns are these you have
given me?” So they were named the land of Cabul, as is still the
case.

translation.text: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.

verses.english:
“My brother,” he said, “what sort of towns are these you have
given me?” So they were named the land of Cabul, as is still the
case.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם לַמֶּלֶךְ מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכַּר זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם לַמֶּלֶךְ מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכַּר זָהָב׃

english.text:
However, Hiram sent the king one hundred and twenty talents of
gold.

translation.text: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.

verses.english:
However, Hiram sent the king one hundred and twenty talents of
gold.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה דְבַר־הַמַּס אֲשֶׁר־הֶעֱלָה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶת־הַמִּלּוֹא וְאֵת חוֹמַת יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְאֶת־חָצֹר וְאֶת־מְגִדּוֹ וְאֶת־גָּזֶר׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה דְבַר־הַמַּס אֲשֶׁר־הֶעֱלָה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶת־הַמִּלּוֹא וְאֵת חוֹמַת יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְאֶת־חָצֹר וְאֶת־מְגִדּוֹ וְאֶת־גָּזֶר׃

english.text:
This was the purpose of the forced labor which Solomon imposed: It
was to build the House of YHWH, his own palace, the Millo, and the
wall of Jerusalem, and [to fortify] Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.

translation.text: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the LORD, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.

verses.english:
This was the purpose of the forced labor which Solomon imposed: It
was to build the House of YHWH, his own palace, the Millo, and the
wall of Jerusalem, and [to fortify] Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.

verses.hebrew: פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם עָלָה וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־גֶּזֶר וַיִּשְׂרְפָהּ בָּאֵשׁ וְאֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּעִיר הָרָג וַיִּתְּנָהּ שִׁלֻּחִים לְבִתּוֹ אֵשֶׁת שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם עָלָה וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־גֶּזֶר וַיִּשְׂרְפָהּ בָּאֵשׁ וְאֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּעִיר הָרָג וַיִּתְּנָהּ שִׁלֻּחִים לְבִתּוֹ אֵשֶׁת שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
(Pharaoh king of Egypt had come up and captured Gezer; he
destroyed it by fire, killed the Canaanites who dwelt in the town,
and gave it as dowry to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.)

translation.text: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a present unto his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

verses.english:
(Pharaoh king of Egypt had come up and captured Gezer; he
destroyed it by fire, killed the Canaanites who dwelt in the town,
and gave it as dowry to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.)

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־גָּזֶר וְאֶת־בֵּית חֹרֹן תַּחְתּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־גָּזֶר וְאֶת־בֵּית חֹרֹן תַּחְתּוֹן׃
