english.text: So Solomon fortified Gezer, lower Beth-horon,

translation.text: And Solomon built Gezer, and Bethhoron the nether,

verses.english: So Solomon fortified Gezer, lower Beth-horon,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בַּעֲלָת וְאֶת־[תַּדְמֹר] (תמר) בַּמִּדְבָּר בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־בַּעֲלָת וְאֶת־[תַּדְמֹר] (תמר) בַּמִּדְבָּר בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text: Baalith, and Tamar in the wilderness, in the land [of Judah],

translation.text: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,

verses.english: Baalith, and Tamar in the wilderness, in the land [of Judah],

verses.hebrew:
וְאֵת כּל־עָרֵי הַמִּסְכְּנוֹת אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לִשְׁלֹמֹה וְאֵת עָרֵי הָרֶכֶב וְאֵת עָרֵי הַפָּרָשִׁים וְאֵת חֵשֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר חָשַׁק לִבְנוֹת בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וּבַלְּבָנוֹן
וּבְכֹל אֶרֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֵת כּל־עָרֵי הַמִּסְכְּנוֹת אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לִשְׁלֹמֹה וְאֵת עָרֵי הָרֶכֶב וְאֵת עָרֵי הַפָּרָשִׁים וְאֵת חֵשֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר חָשַׁק לִבְנוֹת בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וּבַלְּבָנוֹן
וּבְכֹל אֶרֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
and all of Solomon’s garrison towns, chariot towns, and cavalry
towns—everything that Solomon set his heart on building in
Jerusalem and in the Lebanon, and throughout the territory that he
ruled.

translation.text: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

verses.english:
and all of Solomon’s garrison towns, chariot towns, and cavalry
towns—everything that Solomon set his heart on building in
Jerusalem and in the Lebanon, and throughout the territory that he
ruled.

verses.hebrew: כּל־הָעָם הַנּוֹתָר מִן־הָאֱמֹרִי הַחִתִּי הַפְּרִזִּי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵמָּה׃

hebrew.text: כּל־הָעָם הַנּוֹתָר מִן־הָאֱמֹרִי הַחִתִּי הַפְּרִזִּי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵמָּה׃

english.text:
All the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites,
Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites who were not of the Israelite
stock—

translation.text: And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Israel,

verses.english:
All the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites,
Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites who were not of the Israelite
stock—

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר נֹתְרוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָכְלוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַחֲרִימָם וַיַּעֲלֵם שְׁלֹמֹה לְמַס־עֹבֵד עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: בְּנֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר נֹתְרוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָכְלוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַחֲרִימָם וַיַּעֲלֵם שְׁלֹמֹה לְמַס־עֹבֵד עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
those of their descendants who remained in the land and whom the
Israelites were not able to annihilate—of these Solomon made a
slave force, as is still the case.

translation.text: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.

verses.english:
those of their descendants who remained in the land and whom the
Israelites were not able to annihilate—of these Solomon made a
slave force, as is still the case.

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־נָתַן שְׁלֹמֹה עָבֶד כִּי־הֵם אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה וַעֲבָדָיו וְשָׂרָיו וְשָׁלִישָׁיו וְשָׂרֵי רִכְבּוֹ וּפָרָשָׁיו׃

hebrew.text: וּמִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־נָתַן שְׁלֹמֹה עָבֶד כִּי־הֵם אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה וַעֲבָדָיו וְשָׂרָיו וְשָׁלִישָׁיו וְשָׂרֵי רִכְבּוֹ וּפָרָשָׁיו׃

english.text:
But he did not reduce any Israelites to slavery; they served,
rather, as warriors and as his attendants, officials, and
officers, and as commanders of his chariotry and cavalry.

translation.text: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.

verses.english:
But he did not reduce any Israelites to slavery; they served,
rather, as warriors and as his attendants, officials, and
officers, and as commanders of his chariotry and cavalry.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה שָׂרֵי הַנִּצָּבִים אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמְּלָאכָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה חֲמִשִּׁים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת הָרֹדִים בָּעָם הָעֹשִׂים בַּמְּלָאכָה׃

hebrew.text: אֵלֶּה שָׂרֵי הַנִּצָּבִים אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמְּלָאכָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה חֲמִשִּׁים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת הָרֹדִים בָּעָם הָעֹשִׂים בַּמְּלָאכָה׃

english.text:
These were the prefects that were in charge of Solomon’s works and
were foremen over the people engaged in the work, who numbered
550.

translation.text: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon’s work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.

verses.english:
These were the prefects that were in charge of Solomon’s works and
were foremen over the people engaged in the work, who numbered
550.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ בַּת־פַּרְעֹה עָלְתָה מֵעִיר דָּוִד אֶל־בֵּיתָהּ אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה־לָהּ אָז בָּנָה אֶת־הַמִּלּוֹא׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ בַּת־פַּרְעֹה עָלְתָה מֵעִיר דָּוִד אֶל־בֵּיתָהּ אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה־לָהּ אָז בָּנָה אֶת־הַמִּלּוֹא׃

english.text:
As soon as Pharaoh’s daughter went up from the City of David to
the palace that he had built for her, he built the Millo.

translation.text: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.

verses.english:
As soon as Pharaoh’s daughter went up from the City of David to
the palace that he had built for her, he built the Millo.

verses.hebrew: וְהֶעֱלָה שְׁלֹמֹה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה עֹלוֹת וּשְׁלָמִים עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה לַיהֹוָה וְהַקְטֵיר אִתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְשִׁלַּם אֶת־הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶעֱלָה שְׁלֹמֹה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה עֹלוֹת וּשְׁלָמִים עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה לַיהֹוָה וְהַקְטֵיר אִתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְשִׁלַּם אֶת־הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
Solomon used to offer burnt offerings and sacrifices of well-being
three times a year on the altar that he had built for YHWH, and he
used to offer incense on the one that was before YHWH. And he kept
the House in repair.

translation.text: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the LORD, and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the LORD. So he finished the house.

verses.english:
Solomon used to offer burnt offerings and sacrifices of well-being
three times a year on the altar that he had built for YHWH, and he
used to offer incense on the one that was before YHWH. And he kept
the House in repair.

verses.hebrew: ואֳנִי עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בְּעֶצְיוֹן־גֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר אֶת־אֵלוֹת עַל־שְׂפַת יַם־סוּף בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: ואֳנִי עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בְּעֶצְיוֹן־גֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר אֶת־אֵלוֹת עַל־שְׂפַת יַם־סוּף בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם׃

english.text:
King Solomon also built a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber, which is
near Eloth on the shore of the Sea of Reeds in the land of Edom.

translation.text: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Eziongeber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.

verses.english:
King Solomon also built a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber, which is
near Eloth on the shore of the Sea of Reeds in the land of Edom.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם בּאֳנִי אֶת־עֲבָדָיו אַנְשֵׁי אֳנִיּוֹת יֹדְעֵי הַיָּם עִם עַבְדֵי שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם בּאֳנִי אֶת־עֲבָדָיו אַנְשֵׁי אֳנִיּוֹת יֹדְעֵי הַיָּם עִם עַבְדֵי שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
Hiram sent servants of his with the fleet, mariners who were
experienced on the sea, to serve with Solomon’s men.

translation.text: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

verses.english:
Hiram sent servants of his with the fleet, mariners who were
experienced on the sea, to serve with Solomon’s men.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אוֹפִירָה וַיִּקְחוּ מִשָּׁם זָהָב אַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכָּר וַיָּבִאוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אוֹפִירָה וַיִּקְחוּ מִשָּׁם זָהָב אַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכָּר וַיָּבִאוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
They came to Ophir; there they obtained gold in the amount of four
hundred and twenty talents, which they delivered to King Solomon.

translation.text: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.

verses.english:
They came to Ophir; there they obtained gold in the amount of four
hundred and twenty talents, which they delivered to King Solomon.

verses.hebrew: וּמַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא שֹׁמַעַת אֶת־שֵׁמַע שְׁלֹמֹה לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה וַתָּבֹא לְנַסֹּתוֹ בְּחִידוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּמַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא שֹׁמַעַת אֶת־שֵׁמַע שְׁלֹמֹה לְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה וַתָּבֹא לְנַסֹּתוֹ בְּחִידוֹת׃

english.text:
The queen of Sheba heard of Solomon’s fame, through the name of
YHWH, and she came to test him with hard questions.

translation.text: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard questions.

verses.english:
The queen of Sheba heard of Solomon’s fame, through the name of
YHWH, and she came to test him with hard questions.

verses.hebrew:
וַתָּבֹא יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ְמָה בְּחַיִל כָּבֵד מְאֹד גְּמַלִּים נֹשְׂאִים בְּשָׂמִים וְזָהָב רַב־מְאֹד וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה וַתָּבֹא אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלָיו אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר הָיָה
עִם־לְבָבָהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַתָּבֹא יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ְמָה בְּחַיִל כָּבֵד מְאֹד גְּמַלִּים נֹשְׂאִים בְּשָׂמִים וְזָהָב רַב־מְאֹד וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה וַתָּבֹא אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלָיו אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר הָיָה
עִם־לְבָבָהּ׃

english.text:
She arrived in Jerusalem with a very large retinue, with camels
bearing spices, a great quantity of gold, and precious stones.
When she came to Solomon, she asked him all that she had in mind.

translation.text: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

verses.english:
She arrived in Jerusalem with a very large retinue, with camels
bearing spices, a great quantity of gold, and precious stones.
When she came to Solomon, she asked him all that she had in mind.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֶּד־לָהּ שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־כּל־דְּבָרֶיהָ לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר נֶעְלָם מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר לֹא הִגִּיד לָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֶּד־לָהּ שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־כּל־דְּבָרֶיהָ לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר נֶעְלָם מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר לֹא הִגִּיד לָהּ׃

english.text:
Solomon had answers for all her questions; there was nothing that
the king did not know, [nothing] to which he could not give her an
answer.

translation.text: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not any thing hid from the king, which he told her not.

verses.english:
Solomon had answers for all her questions; there was nothing that
the king did not know, [nothing] to which he could not give her an
answer.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא מַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא אֵת כּל־חכְמַת שְׁלֹמֹה וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּרֶא מַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא אֵת כּל־חכְמַת שְׁלֹמֹה וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה׃

english.text:
When the queen of Sheba observed all of Solomon’s wisdom, and the
palace he had built,

translation.text: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon’s wisdom, and the house that he had built,

verses.english:
When the queen of Sheba observed all of Solomon’s wisdom, and the
palace he had built,

verses.hebrew: וּמַאֲכַל שֻׁלְחָנוֹ וּמוֹשַׁב עֲבָדָיו וּמַעֲמַד מְשָׁרְתָו וּמַלְבֻּשֵׁיהֶם וּמַשְׁקָיו וְעֹלָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲלֶה בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְלֹא־הָיָה בָהּ עוֹד רוּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וּמַאֲכַל שֻׁלְחָנוֹ וּמוֹשַׁב עֲבָדָיו וּמַעֲמַד מְשָׁרְתָו וּמַלְבֻּשֵׁיהֶם וּמַשְׁקָיו וְעֹלָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲלֶה בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְלֹא־הָיָה בָהּ עוֹד רוּחַ׃

english.text:
the fare of his table, the seating of his courtiers, the service
and attire of his attendants, and his wine service, and the burnt
offerings that he offered at the House of YHWH, she was left
breathless.

translation.text: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.

verses.english:
the fare of his table, the seating of his courtiers, the service
and attire of his attendants, and his wine service, and the burnt
offerings that he offered at the House of YHWH, she was left
breathless.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֱמֶת הָיָה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתִּי בְּאַרְצִי עַל־דְּבָרֶיךָ וְעַל־חכְמָתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֱמֶת הָיָה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתִּי בְּאַרְצִי עַל־דְּבָרֶיךָ וְעַל־חכְמָתֶךָ׃

english.text:
She said to the king, “The report I heard in my own land about you
and your wisdom was true.

translation.text: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom.

verses.english:
She said to the king, “The report I heard in my own land about you
and your wisdom was true.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־הֶאֱמַנְתִּי לַדְּבָרִים עַד אֲשֶׁר־בָּאתִי וַתִּרְאֶינָה עֵינַי וְהִנֵּה לֹא־הֻגַּד־לִי הַחֵצִי הוֹסַפְתָּ חכְמָה וָטוֹב אֶל־הַשְּׁמוּעָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁמָעְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־הֶאֱמַנְתִּי לַדְּבָרִים עַד אֲשֶׁר־בָּאתִי וַתִּרְאֶינָה עֵינַי וְהִנֵּה לֹא־הֻגַּד־לִי הַחֵצִי הוֹסַפְתָּ חכְמָה וָטוֹב אֶל־הַשְּׁמוּעָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁמָעְתִּי׃

english.text:
But I did not believe the reports until I came and saw with my own
eyes that not even the half had been told me; your wisdom and
wealth surpass the reports that I heard.

translation.text: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.

verses.english:
But I did not believe the reports until I came and saw with my own
eyes that not even the half had been told me; your wisdom and
wealth surpass the reports that I heard.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי אֲנָשֶׁיךָ אַשְׁרֵי עֲבָדֶיךָ אֵלֶּה הָעֹמְדִים לְפָנֶיךָ תָּמִיד הַשֹּׁמְעִים אֶת־חכְמָתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: אַשְׁרֵי אֲנָשֶׁיךָ אַשְׁרֵי עֲבָדֶיךָ אֵלֶּה הָעֹמְדִים לְפָנֶיךָ תָּמִיד הַשֹּׁמְעִים אֶת־חכְמָתֶךָ׃

english.text:
How fortunate are your men and how fortunate are these your
courtiers, who are always in attendance on you and can hear your
wisdom!

translation.text: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and that hear thy wisdom.

verses.english:
How fortunate are your men and how fortunate are these your
courtiers, who are always in attendance on you and can hear your
wisdom!

verses.hebrew: יְהִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּרוּךְ אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ בְּךָ לְתִתְּךָ עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאַהֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעֹלָם וַיְשִׂימְךָ לְמֶלֶךְ לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה׃

hebrew.text: יְהִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בָּרוּךְ אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ בְּךָ לְתִתְּךָ עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאַהֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעֹלָם וַיְשִׂימְךָ לְמֶלֶךְ לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה׃

english.text:
Praised be YHWH your God, who delighted in you and set you on the
throne of Israel. It is because of YHWH’s everlasting love for
Israel that He made you king to administer justice and
righteousness.”

translation.text: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the LORD loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.

verses.english:
Praised be YHWH your God, who delighted in you and set you on the
throne of Israel. It is because of YHWH’s everlasting love for
Israel that He made you king to administer justice and
righteousness.”

verses.hebrew:
וַתִּתֵּן לַמֶּלֶךְ מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכַּר זָהָב וּבְשָׂמִים הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה לֹא בָא כַבֹּשֶׂם הַהוּא עוֹד לָרֹב אֲשֶׁר־נָתְנָה מַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא לַמֶּלֶךְ
שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּתֵּן לַמֶּלֶךְ מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכַּר זָהָב וּבְשָׂמִים הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה לֹא בָא כַבֹּשֶׂם הַהוּא עוֹד לָרֹב אֲשֶׁר־נָתְנָה מַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא לַמֶּלֶךְ
שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
She presented the king with one hundred and twenty talents of
gold, and a large quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never
again did such a vast quantity of spices arrive as that which the
queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.—

translation.text: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.

verses.english:
She presented the king with one hundred and twenty talents of
gold, and a large quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never
again did such a vast quantity of spices arrive as that which the
queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.—

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֳנִי חִירָם אֲשֶׁר־נָשָׂא זָהָב מֵאוֹפִיר הֵבִיא מֵאֹפִיר עֲצֵי אַלְמֻגִּים הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אֳנִי חִירָם אֲשֶׁר־נָשָׂא זָהָב מֵאוֹפִיר הֵבִיא מֵאֹפִיר עֲצֵי אַלְמֻגִּים הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה׃

english.text:
Moreover, Hiram’s fleet, which carried gold from Ophir, brought in
from Ophir a huge quantity of almug wood and precious stones.

translation.text: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.

verses.english:
Moreover, Hiram’s fleet, which carried gold from Ophir, brought in
from Ophir a huge quantity of almug wood and precious stones.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־עֲצֵי הָאַלְמֻגִּים מִסְעָד לְבֵית־יְהֹוָה וּלְבֵית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכִנֹּרוֹת וּנְבָלִים לַשָּׁרִים לֹא בָא־כֵן עֲצֵי אַלְמֻגִּים וְלֹא נִרְאָה עַד הַיּוֹם
הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־עֲצֵי הָאַלְמֻגִּים מִסְעָד לְבֵית־יְהֹוָה וּלְבֵית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכִנֹּרוֹת וּנְבָלִים לַשָּׁרִים לֹא בָא־כֵן עֲצֵי אַלְמֻגִּים וְלֹא נִרְאָה עַד הַיּוֹם
הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The king used the almug wood for decorations in the House of YHWH
and in the royal palace, and for harps and lyres for the
musicians. Such a quantity of almug wood has never arrived or been
seen to this day.—

translation.text: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD, and for the king’s house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.

verses.english:
The king used the almug wood for decorations in the House of YHWH
and in the royal palace, and for harps and lyres for the
musicians. Such a quantity of almug wood has never arrived or been
seen to this day.—

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה נָתַן לְמַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא אֶת־כּל־חֶפְצָהּ אֲשֶׁר שָׁאָלָה מִלְּבַד אֲשֶׁר נָתַן־לָהּ כְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַתֵּפֶן וַתֵּלֶךְ לְאַרְצָהּ הִיא וַעֲבָדֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה נָתַן לְמַלְכַּת־שְׁבָא אֶת־כּל־חֶפְצָהּ אֲשֶׁר שָׁאָלָה מִלְּבַד אֲשֶׁר נָתַן־לָהּ כְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַתֵּפֶן וַתֵּלֶךְ לְאַרְצָהּ הִיא וַעֲבָדֶיהָ׃

english.text:
King Solomon, in turn, gave the queen of Sheba everything she
wanted and asked for, in addition to what King Solomon gave her
out of his royal bounty. Then she and her attendants left and
returned to her own land.

translation.text: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty.

verses.english:
King Solomon, in turn, gave the queen of Sheba everything she
wanted and asked for, in addition to what King Solomon gave her
out of his royal bounty. Then she and her attendants left and
returned to her own land.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִשְׁקַל הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר־בָּא לִשְׁלֹמֹה בְּשָׁנָה אֶחָת שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שִׁשִּׁים וָשֵׁשׁ כִּכַּר זָהָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִשְׁקַל הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר־בָּא לִשְׁלֹמֹה בְּשָׁנָה אֶחָת שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שִׁשִּׁים וָשֵׁשׁ כִּכַּר זָהָב׃

english.text:
The weight of the gold which Solomon received every year was 666
talents of gold,

translation.text: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,

verses.english:
The weight of the gold which Solomon received every year was 666
talents of gold,

verses.hebrew: לְבַד מֵאַנְשֵׁי הַתָּרִים וּמִסְחַר הָרֹכְלִים וְכל־מַלְכֵי הָעֶרֶב וּפַחוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: לְבַד מֵאַנְשֵׁי הַתָּרִים וּמִסְחַר הָרֹכְלִים וְכל־מַלְכֵי הָעֶרֶב וּפַחוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
besides what came from tradesmen, from the traffic of the
merchants, and from all the kings of Arabia and the governors of
the regions.

translation.text: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.

verses.english:
besides what came from tradesmen, from the traffic of the
merchants, and from all the kings of Arabia and the governors of
the regions.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מָאתַיִם צִנָּה זָהָב שָׁחוּט שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת זָהָב יַעֲלֶה עַל־הַצִּנָּה הָאֶחָת׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מָאתַיִם צִנָּה זָהָב שָׁחוּט שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת זָהָב יַעֲלֶה עַל־הַצִּנָּה הָאֶחָת׃

english.text:
King Solomon made 200 shields of beaten gold—600 shekels of gold
to each shield—

translation.text: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.

verses.english:
King Solomon made 200 shields of beaten gold—600 shekels of gold
to each shield—

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת מָגִנִּים זָהָב שָׁחוּט שְׁלֹשֶׁת מָנִים זָהָב יַעֲלֶה עַל־הַמָּגֵן הָאֶחָת וַיִּתְּנֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ בֵּית יַעַר הַלְּבָנוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת מָגִנִּים זָהָב שָׁחוּט שְׁלֹשֶׁת מָנִים זָהָב יַעֲלֶה עַל־הַמָּגֵן הָאֶחָת וַיִּתְּנֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ בֵּית יַעַר הַלְּבָנוֹן׃

english.text:
and 300 bucklers of beaten gold—three minas of gold to each
buckler. The king placed them in the Lebanon Forest House.

translation.text: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

verses.english:
and 300 bucklers of beaten gold—three minas of gold to each
buckler. The king placed them in the Lebanon Forest House.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּסֵּא־שֵׁן גָּדוֹל וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב מוּפָז׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּסֵּא־שֵׁן גָּדוֹל וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב מוּפָז׃

english.text:
The king also made a large throne of ivory, and he overlaid it
with refined gold.

translation.text: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.

verses.english:
The king also made a large throne of ivory, and he overlaid it
with refined gold.

verses.hebrew: שֵׁשׁ מַעֲלוֹת לַכִּסֵּה וְרֹאשׁ־עָגֹל לַכִּסֵּה מֵאַחֲרָיו וְיָדֹת מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה אֶל־מְקוֹם הַשָּׁבֶת וּשְׁנַיִם אֲרָיוֹת עֹמְדִים אֵצֶל הַיָּדוֹת׃

hebrew.text: שֵׁשׁ מַעֲלוֹת לַכִּסֵּה וְרֹאשׁ־עָגֹל לַכִּסֵּה מֵאַחֲרָיו וְיָדֹת מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה אֶל־מְקוֹם הַשָּׁבֶת וּשְׁנַיִם אֲרָיוֹת עֹמְדִים אֵצֶל הַיָּדוֹת׃

english.text:
Six steps led up to the throne, and the throne had a back with a
rounded top, and arms on either side of the seat. Two lions stood
beside the arms,

translation.text: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.

verses.english:
Six steps led up to the throne, and the throne had a back with a
rounded top, and arms on either side of the seat. Two lions stood
beside the arms,

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֲרָיִים עֹמְדִים שָׁם עַל־שֵׁשׁ הַמַּעֲלוֹת מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה לֹא־נַעֲשָׂה כֵן לְכל־מַמְלָכוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֲרָיִים עֹמְדִים שָׁם עַל־שֵׁשׁ הַמַּעֲלוֹת מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה לֹא־נַעֲשָׂה כֵן לְכל־מַמְלָכוֹת׃

english.text:
and twelve lions stood on the six steps, six on either side. No
such throne was ever made for any other kingdom.

translation.text: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.

verses.english:
and twelve lions stood on the six steps, six on either side. No
such throne was ever made for any other kingdom.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל כְּלֵי מַשְׁקֵה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה זָהָב וְכֹל כְּלֵי בֵּית־יַעַר הַלְּבָנוֹן זָהָב סָגוּר אֵין כֶּסֶף לֹא נֶחְשָׁב בִּימֵי שְׁלֹמֹה לִמְאוּמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְכֹל כְּלֵי מַשְׁקֵה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה זָהָב וְכֹל כְּלֵי בֵּית־יַעַר הַלְּבָנוֹן זָהָב סָגוּר אֵין כֶּסֶף לֹא נֶחְשָׁב בִּימֵי שְׁלֹמֹה לִמְאוּמָה׃

english.text:
All King Solomon’s drinking cups were of gold, and all the
utensils of the Lebanon Forest House were of pure gold: silver did
not count for anything in Solomon’s days.

translation.text: And all king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

verses.english:
All King Solomon’s drinking cups were of gold, and all the
utensils of the Lebanon Forest House were of pure gold: silver did
not count for anything in Solomon’s days.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֳנִי תַרְשִׁישׁ לַמֶּלֶךְ בַּיָּם עִם אֳנִי חִירָם אַחַת לְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים תָּבוֹא אֳנִי תַרְשִׁישׁ נֹשְׂאֵת זָהָב וָכֶסֶף שֶׁנְהַבִּים וְקֹפִים וְתֻכִּיִּים׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אֳנִי תַרְשִׁישׁ לַמֶּלֶךְ בַּיָּם עִם אֳנִי חִירָם אַחַת לְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים תָּבוֹא אֳנִי תַרְשִׁישׁ נֹשְׂאֵת זָהָב וָכֶסֶף שֶׁנְהַבִּים וְקֹפִים וְתֻכִּיִּים׃

english.text:
For the king had a Tarshish fleet on the sea, along with Hiram’s
fleet. Once every three years, the Tarshish fleet came in, bearing
gold and silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

translation.text: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

verses.english:
For the king had a Tarshish fleet on the sea, along with Hiram’s
fleet. Once every three years, the Tarshish fleet came in, bearing
gold and silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְדַּל הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מִכֹּל מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ לְעֹשֶׁר וּלְחכְמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְדַּל הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מִכֹּל מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ לְעֹשֶׁר וּלְחכְמָה׃

english.text:
King Solomon excelled all the kings on earth in wealth and in
wisdom.

translation.text: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.

verses.english:
King Solomon excelled all the kings on earth in wealth and in
wisdom.

verses.hebrew: וְכל־הָאָרֶץ מְבַקְשִׁים אֶת־פְּנֵי שְׁלֹמֹה לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶת־חכְמָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן אֱלֹהִים בְּלִבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־הָאָרֶץ מְבַקְשִׁים אֶת־פְּנֵי שְׁלֹמֹה לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶת־חכְמָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן אֱלֹהִים בְּלִבּוֹ׃

english.text:
All the world came to pay homage to Solomon and to listen to the
wisdom with which God had endowed him;

translation.text: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

verses.english:
All the world came to pay homage to Solomon and to listen to the
wisdom with which God had endowed him;

verses.hebrew: וְהֵמָּה מְבִאִים אִישׁ מִנְחָתוֹ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב וּשְׂלָמוֹת וְנֵשֶׁק וּבְשָׂמִים סוּסִים וּפְרָדִים דְּבַר־שָׁנָה בְּשָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵמָּה מְבִאִים אִישׁ מִנְחָתוֹ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב וּשְׂלָמוֹת וְנֵשֶׁק וּבְשָׂמִים סוּסִים וּפְרָדִים דְּבַר־שָׁנָה בְּשָׁנָה׃

english.text:
and each one would bring his tribute—silver and gold objects,
robes, weapons and spices, horses and mules—in the amount due each
year.

translation.text: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

verses.english:
and each one would bring his tribute—silver and gold objects,
robes, weapons and spices, horses and mules—in the amount due each
year.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱסֹף שְׁלֹמֹה רֶכֶב וּפָרָשִׁים וַיְהִי־לוֹ אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב וּשְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף פָּרָשִׁים וַיַּנְחֵם בְּעָרֵי הָרֶכֶב וְעִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף שְׁלֹמֹה רֶכֶב וּפָרָשִׁים וַיְהִי־לוֹ אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב וּשְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף פָּרָשִׁים וַיַּנְחֵם בְּעָרֵי הָרֶכֶב וְעִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
Solomon assembled chariots and horses. He had 1,400 chariots and
12,000 horses, which he stationed in the chariot towns and with
the king in Jerusalem.

translation.text: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.

verses.english:
Solomon assembled chariots and horses. He had 1,400 chariots and
12,000 horses, which he stationed in the chariot towns and with
the king in Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם כָּאֲבָנִים וְאֵת הָאֲרָזִים נָתַן כַּשִּׁקְמִים אֲשֶׁר־בַּשְּׁפֵלָה לָרֹב׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם כָּאֲבָנִים וְאֵת הָאֲרָזִים נָתַן כַּשִּׁקְמִים אֲשֶׁר־בַּשְּׁפֵלָה לָרֹב׃

english.text:
The king made silver as plentiful in Jerusalem as stones, and
cedars as plentiful as sycamores in the Shephelah.

translation.text: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.

verses.english:
The king made silver as plentiful in Jerusalem as stones, and
cedars as plentiful as sycamores in the Shephelah.

verses.hebrew: וּמוֹצָא הַסּוּסִים אֲשֶׁר לִשְׁלֹמֹה מִמִּצְרָיִם וּמִקְוֵה סֹחֲרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יִקְחוּ מִקְוֵה בִּמְחִיר׃

hebrew.text: וּמוֹצָא הַסּוּסִים אֲשֶׁר לִשְׁלֹמֹה מִמִּצְרָיִם וּמִקְוֵה סֹחֲרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יִקְחוּ מִקְוֵה בִּמְחִיר׃

english.text:
Solomon’s horses were procured from Mizraim and Kue. The king’s
dealers would buy them from Kue at a fixed price.

translation.text: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

verses.english:
Solomon’s horses were procured from Mizraim and Kue. The king’s
dealers would buy them from Kue at a fixed price.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲלֶה וַתֵּצֵא מֶרְכָּבָה מִמִּצְרַיִם בְּשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת כֶּסֶף וְסוּס בַּחֲמִשִּׁים וּמֵאָה וְכֵן לְכל־מַלְכֵי הַחִתִּים וּלְמַלְכֵי אֲרָם בְּיָדָם יֹצִאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעֲלֶה וַתֵּצֵא מֶרְכָּבָה מִמִּצְרַיִם בְּשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת כֶּסֶף וְסוּס בַּחֲמִשִּׁים וּמֵאָה וְכֵן לְכל־מַלְכֵי הַחִתִּים וּלְמַלְכֵי אֲרָם בְּיָדָם יֹצִאוּ׃

english.text:
A chariot imported from Mizraim cost 600 shekels of silver, and a
horse 150; these in turn were exported by them to all the kings of
the Hittites and the kings of the Arameans.

translation.text: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.

verses.english:
A chariot imported from Mizraim cost 600 shekels of silver, and a
horse 150; these in turn were exported by them to all the kings of
the Hittites and the kings of the Arameans.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה אָהַב נָשִׁים נכְרִיּוֹת רַבּוֹת וְאֶת־בַּת־פַּרְעֹה מוֹאֲבִיּוֹת עַמֳּנִיּוֹת אֲדֹמִיֹּת צֵדְנִיֹּת חִתִּיֹּת׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה אָהַב נָשִׁים נכְרִיּוֹת רַבּוֹת וְאֶת־בַּת־פַּרְעֹה מוֹאֲבִיּוֹת עַמֳּנִיּוֹת אֲדֹמִיֹּת צֵדְנִיֹּת חִתִּיֹּת׃

english.text:
King Solomon loved many foreign women in addition to Pharaoh’s
daughter—Moabite, Ammonite, Edomite, Phoenician, and Hittite
women,

translation.text: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites:

verses.english:
King Solomon loved many foreign women in addition to Pharaoh’s
daughter—Moabite, Ammonite, Edomite, Phoenician, and Hittite
women,

verses.hebrew: מִן־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־תָבֹאוּ בָהֶם וְהֵם לֹא־יָבֹאוּ בָכֶם אָכֵן יַטּוּ אֶת־לְבַבְכֶם אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶם בָּהֶם דָּבַק שְׁלֹמֹה לְאַהֲבָה׃

hebrew.text: מִן־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־תָבֹאוּ בָהֶם וְהֵם לֹא־יָבֹאוּ בָכֶם אָכֵן יַטּוּ אֶת־לְבַבְכֶם אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶם בָּהֶם דָּבַק שְׁלֹמֹה לְאַהֲבָה׃

english.text:
from the nations of which YHWH had said to the Israelites, “None
of you shall join them and none of them shall join you, lest they
turn your heart away to follow their gods.” Such Solomon clung to
and loved.

translation.text: Of the nations concerning which the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.

verses.english:
from the nations of which YHWH had said to the Israelites, “None
of you shall join them and none of them shall join you, lest they
turn your heart away to follow their gods.” Such Solomon clung to
and loved.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־לוֹ נָשִׁים שָׂרוֹת שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וּפִלַגְשִׁים שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וַיַּטּוּ נָשָׁיו אֶת־לִבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי־לוֹ נָשִׁים שָׂרוֹת שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וּפִלַגְשִׁים שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וַיַּטּוּ נָשָׁיו אֶת־לִבּוֹ׃

english.text:
He had seven hundred royal wives and three hundred concubines; and
his wives turned his heart away.

translation.text: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.

verses.english:
He had seven hundred royal wives and three hundred concubines; and
his wives turned his heart away.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לְעֵת זִקְנַת שְׁלֹמֹה נָשָׁיו הִטּוּ אֶת־לְבָבוֹ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְלֹא־הָיָה לְבָבוֹ שָׁלֵם עִם־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו כִּלְבַב דָּוִיד אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לְעֵת זִקְנַת שְׁלֹמֹה נָשָׁיו הִטּוּ אֶת־לְבָבוֹ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְלֹא־הָיָה לְבָבוֹ שָׁלֵם עִם־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו כִּלְבַב דָּוִיד אָבִיו׃

english.text:
In his old age, his wives turned away Solomon’s heart after other
gods, and he was not as wholeheartedly devoted to YHWH his God as
his father David had been.

translation.text: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as was the heart of David his father.

verses.english:
In his old age, his wives turned away Solomon’s heart after other
gods, and he was not as wholeheartedly devoted to YHWH his God as
his father David had been.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה אַחֲרֵי עַשְׁתֹּרֶת אֱלֹהֵי צִדֹנִים וְאַחֲרֵי מִלְכֹּם שִׁקֻּץ עַמֹּנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה אַחֲרֵי עַשְׁתֹּרֶת אֱלֹהֵי צִדֹנִים וְאַחֲרֵי מִלְכֹּם שִׁקֻּץ עַמֹּנִים׃

english.text:
Solomon followed Ashtoreth the goddess of the Phoenicians, and
Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

translation.text: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

verses.english:
Solomon followed Ashtoreth the goddess of the Phoenicians, and
Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא מִלֵּא אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה כְּדָוִד אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא מִלֵּא אַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה כְּדָוִד אָבִיו׃

english.text:
Solomon did what was displeasing to YHWH and did not remain loyal
to YHWH like his father David.

translation.text: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD, and went not fully after the LORD, as did David his father.

verses.english:
Solomon did what was displeasing to YHWH and did not remain loyal
to YHWH like his father David.

verses.hebrew: אָז יִבְנֶה שְׁלֹמֹה בָּמָה לִכְמוֹשׁ שִׁקֻּץ מוֹאָב בָּהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וּלְמֹלֶךְ שִׁקֻּץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: אָז יִבְנֶה שְׁלֹמֹה בָּמָה לִכְמוֹשׁ שִׁקֻּץ מוֹאָב בָּהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וּלְמֹלֶךְ שִׁקֻּץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

english.text:
At that time, Solomon built a shrine for Chemosh the abomination
of Moab on the hill near Jerusalem, and one for Molech the
abomination of the Ammonites.

translation.text: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.

verses.english:
At that time, Solomon built a shrine for Chemosh the abomination
of Moab on the hill near Jerusalem, and one for Molech the
abomination of the Ammonites.

verses.hebrew: וְכֵן עָשָׂה לְכל־נָשָׁיו הַנּכְרִיּוֹת מַקְטִירוֹת וּמְזַבְּחוֹת לֵאלֹהֵיהֶן׃

hebrew.text: וְכֵן עָשָׂה לְכל־נָשָׁיו הַנּכְרִיּוֹת מַקְטִירוֹת וּמְזַבְּחוֹת לֵאלֹהֵיהֶן׃

english.text:
And he did the same for all his foreign wives who offered and
sacrificed to their gods.

translation.text: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.

verses.english:
And he did the same for all his foreign wives who offered and
sacrificed to their gods.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְאַנַּף יְהֹוָה בִּשְׁלֹמֹה כִּי־נָטָה לְבָבוֹ מֵעִם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנִּרְאָה אֵלָיו פַּעֲמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְאַנַּף יְהֹוָה בִּשְׁלֹמֹה כִּי־נָטָה לְבָבוֹ מֵעִם יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנִּרְאָה אֵלָיו פַּעֲמָיִם׃

english.text:
YHWH was angry with Solomon, because his heart turned away from
YHWH, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice

translation.text: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,

verses.english:
YHWH was angry with Solomon, because his heart turned away from
YHWH, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice

verses.hebrew: וְצִוָּה אֵלָיו עַל־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְבִלְתִּי־לֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְלֹא שָׁמַר אֵת אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְצִוָּה אֵלָיו עַל־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְבִלְתִּי־לֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְלֹא שָׁמַר אֵת אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and had commanded him about this matter, not to follow other gods;
he did not obey what YHWH had commanded.

translation.text: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.

verses.english:
and had commanded him about this matter, not to follow other gods;
he did not obey what YHWH had commanded.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הָיְתָה־זֹּאת עִמָּךְ וְלֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ בְּרִיתִי וְחֻקֹּתַי אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי עָלֶיךָ קָרֹעַ אֶקְרַע אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה מֵעָלֶיךָ
וּנְתַתִּיהָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הָיְתָה־זֹּאת עִמָּךְ וְלֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ בְּרִיתִי וְחֻקֹּתַי אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי עָלֶיךָ קָרֹעַ אֶקְרַע אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה מֵעָלֶיךָ
וּנְתַתִּיהָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
And YHWH said to Solomon, “Because you are guilty of this —you
have not kept My covenant and the laws which I enjoined upon you—I
will tear the kingdom away from you and give it to one of your
servants.

translation.text: Wherefore the LORD said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.

verses.english:
And YHWH said to Solomon, “Because you are guilty of this —you
have not kept My covenant and the laws which I enjoined upon you—I
will tear the kingdom away from you and give it to one of your
servants.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ־בְּיָמֶיךָ לֹא אֶעֱשֶׂנָּה לְמַעַן דָּוִד אָבִיךָ מִיַּד בִּנְךָ אֶקְרָעֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ־בְּיָמֶיךָ לֹא אֶעֱשֶׂנָּה לְמַעַן דָּוִד אָבִיךָ מִיַּד בִּנְךָ אֶקְרָעֶנָּה׃

english.text:
But, for the sake of your father David, I will not do it in your
lifetime; I will tear it away from your son.

translation.text: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father’s sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.

verses.english:
But, for the sake of your father David, I will not do it in your
lifetime; I will tear it away from your son.

verses.hebrew: רַק אֶת־כּל־הַמַּמְלָכָה לֹא אֶקְרָע שֵׁבֶט אֶחָד אֶתֵּן לִבְנֶךָ לְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי וּלְמַעַן יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: רַק אֶת־כּל־הַמַּמְלָכָה לֹא אֶקְרָע שֵׁבֶט אֶחָד אֶתֵּן לִבְנֶךָ לְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי וּלְמַעַן יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרְתִּי׃

english.text:
However, I will not tear away the whole kingdom; I will give your
son one tribe, for the sake of My servant David and for the sake
of Jerusalem which I have chosen.”

translation.text: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.

verses.english:
However, I will not tear away the whole kingdom; I will give your
son one tribe, for the sake of My servant David and for the sake
of Jerusalem which I have chosen.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה שָׂטָן לִשְׁלֹמֹה אֵת הֲדַד הָאֲדֹמִי מִזֶּרַע הַמֶּלֶךְ הוּא בֶּאֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֶם יְהֹוָה שָׂטָן לִשְׁלֹמֹה אֵת הֲדַד הָאֲדֹמִי מִזֶּרַע הַמֶּלֶךְ הוּא בֶּאֱדוֹם׃

english.text:
So YHWH raised up an adversary against Solomon, the Edomite Hadad,
who was of the royal family of Edom.

translation.text: And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king’s seed in Edom.

verses.english:
So YHWH raised up an adversary against Solomon, the Edomite Hadad,
who was of the royal family of Edom.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹת דָּוִד אֶת־אֱדוֹם בַּעֲלוֹת יוֹאָב שַׂר הַצָּבָא לְקַבֵּר אֶת־הַחֲלָלִים וַיַּךְ כּל־זָכָר בֶּאֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹת דָּוִד אֶת־אֱדוֹם בַּעֲלוֹת יוֹאָב שַׂר הַצָּבָא לְקַבֵּר אֶת־הַחֲלָלִים וַיַּךְ כּל־זָכָר בֶּאֱדוֹם׃

english.text:
When David was in Edom, Joab the army commander went up to bury
the slain, and he killed every male in Edom;

translation.text: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;

verses.english:
When David was in Edom, Joab the army commander went up to bury
the slain, and he killed every male in Edom;

verses.hebrew: כִּי שֵׁשֶׁת חֳדָשִׁים יָשַׁב־שָׁם יוֹאָב וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־הִכְרִית כּל־זָכָר בֶּאֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי שֵׁשֶׁת חֳדָשִׁים יָשַׁב־שָׁם יוֹאָב וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־הִכְרִית כּל־זָכָר בֶּאֱדוֹם׃

english.text:
for Joab and all Israel stayed there for six months until he had
killed off every male in Edom.

translation.text: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)

verses.english:
for Joab and all Israel stayed there for six months until he had
killed off every male in Edom.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְרַח אֲדַד הוּא וַאֲנָשִׁים אֲדֹמִיִּים מֵעַבְדֵי אָבִיו אִתּוֹ לָבוֹא מִצְרָיִם וַהֲדַד נַעַר קָטָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְרַח אֲדַד הוּא וַאֲנָשִׁים אֲדֹמִיִּים מֵעַבְדֵי אָבִיו אִתּוֹ לָבוֹא מִצְרָיִם וַהֲדַד נַעַר קָטָן׃

english.text:
But Hadad, together with some Edomite men, servants of his father,
escaped and headed for Egypt; Hadad was then a young boy.

translation.text: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.

verses.english:
But Hadad, together with some Edomite men, servants of his father,
escaped and headed for Egypt; Hadad was then a young boy.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקֻמוּ מִמִּדְיָן וַיָּבֹאוּ פָּארָן וַיִּקְחוּ אֲנָשִׁים עִמָּם מִפָּארָן וַיָּבֹאוּ מִצְרַיִם אֶל־פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ בַיִת וְלֶחֶם אָמַר לוֹ וְאֶרֶץ
נָתַן לוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקֻמוּ מִמִּדְיָן וַיָּבֹאוּ פָּארָן וַיִּקְחוּ אֲנָשִׁים עִמָּם מִפָּארָן וַיָּבֹאוּ מִצְרַיִם אֶל־פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ בַיִת וְלֶחֶם אָמַר לוֹ וְאֶרֶץ
נָתַן לוֹ׃

english.text:
Setting out from Midian, they came to Paran and took along with
them men from Paran. Thus they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of
Egypt, who gave him a house, assigned a food allowance to him, and
granted him an estate.

translation.text: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.

verses.english:
Setting out from Midian, they came to Paran and took along with
them men from Paran. Thus they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of
Egypt, who gave him a house, assigned a food allowance to him, and
granted him an estate.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצָא הֲדַד חֵן בְּעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה מְאֹד וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ אִשָּׁה אֶת־אֲחוֹת אִשְׁתּוֹ אֲחוֹת תַּחְפְּנֵיס הַגְּבִירָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְצָא הֲדַד חֵן בְּעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה מְאֹד וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ אִשָּׁה אֶת־אֲחוֹת אִשְׁתּוֹ אֲחוֹת תַּחְפְּנֵיס הַגְּבִירָה׃

english.text:
Pharaoh took a great liking to Hadad and gave him his
sister-in-law, the sister of Queen Tahpenes, as wife.

translation.text: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

verses.english:
Pharaoh took a great liking to Hadad and gave him his
sister-in-law, the sister of Queen Tahpenes, as wife.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֲחוֹת תַּחְפְּנֵיס אֵת גְּנֻבַת בְּנוֹ וַתִּגְמְלֵהוּ תַחְפְּנֵס בְּתוֹךְ בֵּית פַּרְעֹה וַיְהִי גְנֻבַת בֵּית פַּרְעֹה בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי פַרְעֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֲחוֹת תַּחְפְּנֵיס אֵת גְּנֻבַת בְּנוֹ וַתִּגְמְלֵהוּ תַחְפְּנֵס בְּתוֹךְ בֵּית פַּרְעֹה וַיְהִי גְנֻבַת בֵּית פַּרְעֹה בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי פַרְעֹה׃

english.text:
The sister of Tahpenes bore him a son, Genubath. Tahpenes weaned
him in Pharaoh’s palace, and Genubath remained in Pharaoh’s palace
among the sons of Pharaoh.

translation.text: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s household among the sons of Pharaoh.

verses.english:
The sister of Tahpenes bore him a son, Genubath. Tahpenes weaned
him in Pharaoh’s palace, and Genubath remained in Pharaoh’s palace
among the sons of Pharaoh.

verses.hebrew: וַהֲדַד שָׁמַע בְּמִצְרַיִם כִּי־שָׁכַב דָּוִד עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וְכִי־מֵת יוֹאָב שַׂר־הַצָּבָא וַיֹּאמֶר הֲדַד אֶל־פַּרְעֹה שַׁלְּחֵנִי וְאֵלֵךְ אֶל־אַרְצִי׃

hebrew.text: וַהֲדַד שָׁמַע בְּמִצְרַיִם כִּי־שָׁכַב דָּוִד עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וְכִי־מֵת יוֹאָב שַׂר־הַצָּבָא וַיֹּאמֶר הֲדַד אֶל־פַּרְעֹה שַׁלְּחֵנִי וְאֵלֵךְ אֶל־אַרְצִי׃

english.text:
When Hadad heard in Egypt that David had been laid to rest with
his fathers and that Joab the army commander was dead, Hadad said
to Pharaoh, “Give me leave to go to my own country.”

translation.text: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.

verses.english:
When Hadad heard in Egypt that David had been laid to rest with
his fathers and that Joab the army commander was dead, Hadad said
to Pharaoh, “Give me leave to go to my own country.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ פַרְעֹה כִּי מָה־אַתָּה חָסֵר עִמִּי וְהִנְּךָ מְבַקֵּשׁ לָלֶכֶת אֶל־אַרְצֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא כִּי שַׁלֵּחַ תְּשַׁלְּחֵנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ פַרְעֹה כִּי מָה־אַתָּה חָסֵר עִמִּי וְהִנְּךָ מְבַקֵּשׁ לָלֶכֶת אֶל־אַרְצֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא כִּי שַׁלֵּחַ תְּשַׁלְּחֵנִי׃

english.text:
Pharaoh replied, “What do you lack with me, that you want to go to
your own country?” But he said, “Nevertheless, give me leave to
go.”

translation.text: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.

verses.english:
Pharaoh replied, “What do you lack with me, that you want to go to
your own country?” But he said, “Nevertheless, give me leave to
go.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם אֱלֹהִים לוֹ שָׂטָן אֶת־רְזוֹן בֶּן־אֶלְיָדָע אֲשֶׁר בָּרַח מֵאֵת הֲדַדְעֶזֶר מֶלֶךְ־צוֹבָה אֲדֹנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֶם אֱלֹהִים לוֹ שָׂטָן אֶת־רְזוֹן בֶּן־אֶלְיָדָע אֲשֶׁר בָּרַח מֵאֵת הֲדַדְעֶזֶר מֶלֶךְ־צוֹבָה אֲדֹנָיו׃

english.text:
Another adversary that God raised up against Solomon was Rezon son
of Eliada, who had fled from his lord, King Hadadezer of Zobah,

translation.text: And God stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:

verses.english:
Another adversary that God raised up against Solomon was Rezon son
of Eliada, who had fled from his lord, King Hadadezer of Zobah,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבֹּץ עָלָיו אֲנָשִׁים וַיְהִי שַׂר־גְּדוּד בַּהֲרֹג דָּוִד אֹתָם וַיֵּלְכוּ דַמֶּשֶׂק וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ וַיִּמְלְכוּ בְּדַמָּשֶׂק׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבֹּץ עָלָיו אֲנָשִׁים וַיְהִי שַׂר־גְּדוּד בַּהֲרֹג דָּוִד אֹתָם וַיֵּלְכוּ דַמֶּשֶׂק וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ וַיִּמְלְכוּ בְּדַמָּשֶׂק׃

english.text:
when David was slaughtering them. He gathered men about him and
became captain over a troop; they went to Damascus and settled
there, and they established a kingdom in Damascus.

translation.text: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.

verses.english:
when David was slaughtering them. He gathered men about him and
became captain over a troop; they went to Damascus and settled
there, and they established a kingdom in Damascus.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי שָׂטָן לְיִשְׂרָאֵל כּל־יְמֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וְאֶת־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר הֲדָד וַיָּקָץ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְלֹךְ עַל־אֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי שָׂטָן לְיִשְׂרָאֵל כּל־יְמֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וְאֶת־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר הֲדָד וַיָּקָץ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְלֹךְ עַל־אֲרָם׃

english.text:
He was an adversary of Israel all the days of Solomon, adding to
the trouble [caused by] Hadad; he repudiated [the authority of]
Israel and reigned over Aram.

translation.text: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

verses.english:
He was an adversary of Israel all the days of Solomon, adding to
the trouble [caused by] Hadad; he repudiated [the authority of]
Israel and reigned over Aram.

verses.hebrew: וְיָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֶפְרָתִי מִן־הַצְּרֵדָה וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ צְרוּעָה אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה עֶבֶד לִשְׁלֹמֹה וַיָּרֶם יָד בַּמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְיָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֶפְרָתִי מִן־הַצְּרֵדָה וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ צְרוּעָה אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה עֶבֶד לִשְׁלֹמֹה וַיָּרֶם יָד בַּמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Jeroboam son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, the son of a
widow whose name was Zeruah, was in Solomon’s service; he raised
his hand against the king.

translation.text: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon’s servant, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.

verses.english:
Jeroboam son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, the son of a
widow whose name was Zeruah, was in Solomon’s service; he raised
his hand against the king.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־הֵרִים יָד בַּמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בָּנָה אֶת־הַמִּלּוֹא סָגַר אֶת־פֶּרֶץ עִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־הֵרִים יָד בַּמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בָּנָה אֶת־הַמִּלּוֹא סָגַר אֶת־פֶּרֶץ עִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו׃

english.text:
The circumstances under which he raised his hand against the king
were as follows: Solomon built the Millo and repaired the breach
of the city of his father, David.

translation.text: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.

verses.english:
The circumstances under which he raised his hand against the king
were as follows: Solomon built the Millo and repaired the breach
of the city of his father, David.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאִישׁ יָרבְעָם גִּבּוֹר חָיִל וַיַּרְא שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַנַּעַר כִּי־עֹשֵׂה מְלָאכָה הוּא וַיַּפְקֵד אֹתוֹ לְכל־סֵבֶל בֵּית יוֹסֵף׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאִישׁ יָרבְעָם גִּבּוֹר חָיִל וַיַּרְא שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַנַּעַר כִּי־עֹשֵׂה מְלָאכָה הוּא וַיַּפְקֵד אֹתוֹ לְכל־סֵבֶל בֵּית יוֹסֵף׃

english.text:
This Jeroboam was an able man, and when Solomon saw that the young
man was a capable worker, he appointed him over all the forced
labor of the House of Joseph.

translation.text: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.

verses.english:
This Jeroboam was an able man, and when Solomon saw that the young
man was a capable worker, he appointed him over all the forced
labor of the House of Joseph.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בָּעֵת הַהִיא וְיָרבְעָם יָצָא מִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וַיִּמְצָא אֹתוֹ אֲחִיָּה הַשִּׁילֹנִי הַנָּבִיא בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְהוּא מִתְכַּסֶּה בְּשַׂלְמָה חֲדָשָׁה וּשְׁנֵיהֶם לְבַדָּם
בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בָּעֵת הַהִיא וְיָרבְעָם יָצָא מִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וַיִּמְצָא אֹתוֹ אֲחִיָּה הַשִּׁילֹנִי הַנָּבִיא בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְהוּא מִתְכַּסֶּה בְּשַׂלְמָה חֲדָשָׁה וּשְׁנֵיהֶם לְבַדָּם
בַּשָּׂדֶה׃

english.text:
During that time Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem and the prophet
Ahijah of Shiloh met him on the way. He had put on a new robe; and
when the two were alone in the open country,

translation.text: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:

verses.english:
During that time Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem and the prophet
Ahijah of Shiloh met him on the way. He had put on a new robe; and
when the two were alone in the open country,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְפֹּשׂ אֲחִיָּה בַּשַּׂלְמָה הַחֲדָשָׁה אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו וַיִּקְרָעֶהָ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר קְרָעִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְפֹּשׂ אֲחִיָּה בַּשַּׂלְמָה הַחֲדָשָׁה אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו וַיִּקְרָעֶהָ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר קְרָעִים׃

english.text:
Ahijah took hold of the new robe he was wearing and tore it into
twelve pieces.

translation.text: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:

verses.english:
Ahijah took hold of the new robe he was wearing and tore it into
twelve pieces.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְיָרבְעָם קַח־לְךָ עֲשָׂרָה קְרָעִים כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנְנִי קֹרֵעַ אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה מִיַּד שְׁלֹמֹה וְנָתַתִּי לְךָ אֵת עֲשָׂרָה הַשְּׁבָטִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְיָרבְעָם קַח־לְךָ עֲשָׂרָה קְרָעִים כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנְנִי קֹרֵעַ אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה מִיַּד שְׁלֹמֹה וְנָתַתִּי לְךָ אֵת עֲשָׂרָה הַשְּׁבָטִים׃

english.text:
“Take ten pieces,” he said to Jeroboam. “For thus said YHWH, the
God of Israel: I am about to tear the kingdom out of Solomon’s
hands, and I will give you ten tribes.

translation.text: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:

verses.english:
“Take ten pieces,” he said to Jeroboam. “For thus said YHWH, the
God of Israel: I am about to tear the kingdom out of Solomon’s
hands, and I will give you ten tribes.

verses.hebrew: וְהַשֵּׁבֶט הָאֶחָד יִהְיֶה־לּוֹ לְמַעַן עַבְדִּי דָוִד וּלְמַעַן יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתִּי בָהּ מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשֵּׁבֶט הָאֶחָד יִהְיֶה־לּוֹ לְמַעַן עַבְדִּי דָוִד וּלְמַעַן יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתִּי בָהּ מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But one tribe shall remain his—for the sake of My servant David
and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city that I have chosen out of
all the tribes of Israel.

translation.text: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)

verses.english:
But one tribe shall remain his—for the sake of My servant David
and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city that I have chosen out of
all the tribes of Israel.

verses.hebrew:
יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עֲזָבוּנִי וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְעַשְׁתֹּרֶת אֱלֹהֵי צִדֹנִין לִכְמוֹשׁ אֱלֹהֵי מוֹאָב וּלְמִלְכֹּם אֱלֹהֵי בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וְלֹא־הָלְכוּ בִדְרָכַי לַעֲשׂוֹת הַיָּשָׁר
בְּעֵינַי וְחֻקֹּתַי וּמִשְׁפָּטַי כְּדָוִד אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text:
יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עֲזָבוּנִי וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְעַשְׁתֹּרֶת אֱלֹהֵי צִדֹנִין לִכְמוֹשׁ אֱלֹהֵי מוֹאָב וּלְמִלְכֹּם אֱלֹהֵי בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וְלֹא־הָלְכוּ בִדְרָכַי לַעֲשׂוֹת הַיָּשָׁר
בְּעֵינַי וְחֻקֹּתַי וּמִשְׁפָּטַי כְּדָוִד אָבִיו׃

english.text:
For they have forsaken Me; they have worshiped Ashtoreth the
goddess of the Phoenicians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom
the god of the Ammonites; they have not walked in My ways, or done
what is pleasing to Me, or [kept] My laws and rules, as his father
David did.

translation.text: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in mine eyes, and to keep my statutes and my judgments, as did David his father.

verses.english:
For they have forsaken Me; they have worshiped Ashtoreth the
goddess of the Phoenicians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom
the god of the Ammonites; they have not walked in My ways, or done
what is pleasing to Me, or [kept] My laws and rules, as his father
David did.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־אֶקַּח אֶת־כּל־הַמַּמְלָכָה מִיָּדוֹ כִּי נָשִׂיא אֲשִׁתֶנּוּ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיָּיו לְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתִּי אֹתוֹ אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַר מִצְוֺתַי וְחֻקֹּתָי׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־אֶקַּח אֶת־כּל־הַמַּמְלָכָה מִיָּדוֹ כִּי נָשִׂיא אֲשִׁתֶנּוּ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיָּיו לְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתִּי אֹתוֹ אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַר מִצְוֺתַי וְחֻקֹּתָי׃

english.text:
However, I will not take the entire kingdom away from him, but
will keep him as ruler as long as he lives for the sake of My
servant David whom I chose, and who kept My commandments and My
laws.

translation.text: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:

verses.english:
However, I will not take the entire kingdom away from him, but
will keep him as ruler as long as he lives for the sake of My
servant David whom I chose, and who kept My commandments and My
laws.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתִּי הַמְּלוּכָה מִיַּד בְּנוֹ וּנְתַתִּיהָ לְּךָ אֵת עֲשֶׂרֶת הַשְּׁבָטִים׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחְתִּי הַמְּלוּכָה מִיַּד בְּנוֹ וּנְתַתִּיהָ לְּךָ אֵת עֲשֶׂרֶת הַשְּׁבָטִים׃

english.text:
But I will take the kingship out of the hands of his son and give
it to you—the ten tribes.

translation.text: But I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand, and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes.

verses.english:
But I will take the kingship out of the hands of his son and give
it to you—the ten tribes.

verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנוֹ אֶתֵּן שֵׁבֶט־אֶחָד לְמַעַן הֱיוֹת־נִיר לְדָוִיד־עַבְדִּי כּל־הַיָּמִים לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתִּי לִי לָשׂוּם שְׁמִי שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְלִבְנוֹ אֶתֵּן שֵׁבֶט־אֶחָד לְמַעַן הֱיוֹת־נִיר לְדָוִיד־עַבְדִּי כּל־הַיָּמִים לְפָנַי בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתִּי לִי לָשׂוּם שְׁמִי שָׁם׃

english.text:
To his son I will give one tribe, so that there may be a lamp for
My servant David forever before Me in Jerusalem—the city where I
have chosen to establish My name.

translation.text: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.

verses.english:
To his son I will give one tribe, so that there may be a lamp for
My servant David forever before Me in Jerusalem—the city where I
have chosen to establish My name.

verses.hebrew: וְאֹתְךָ אֶקַּח וּמָלַכְתָּ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תְּאַוֶּה נַפְשֶׁךָ וְהָיִיתָ מֶּלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְאֹתְךָ אֶקַּח וּמָלַכְתָּ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תְּאַוֶּה נַפְשֶׁךָ וְהָיִיתָ מֶּלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But you have been chosen by Me; reign wherever you wish, and you
shall be king over Israel.

translation.text: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.

verses.english:
But you have been chosen by Me; reign wherever you wish, and you
shall be king over Israel.

verses.hebrew:
וְהָיָה אִם־תִּשְׁמַע אֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר אֲצַוֶּךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ בִדְרָכַי וְעָשִׂיתָ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינַי לִשְׁמוֹר חֻקּוֹתַי וּמִצְוֺתַי כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה דָּוִד עַבְדִּי וְהָיִיתִי
עִמָּךְ וּבָנִיתִי לְךָ בַיִת־נֶאֱמָן כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּנִיתִי לְדָוִד וְנָתַתִּי לְךָ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וְהָיָה אִם־תִּשְׁמַע אֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר אֲצַוֶּךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ בִדְרָכַי וְעָשִׂיתָ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינַי לִשְׁמוֹר חֻקּוֹתַי וּמִצְוֺתַי כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה דָּוִד עַבְדִּי וְהָיִיתִי
עִמָּךְ וּבָנִיתִי לְךָ בַיִת־נֶאֱמָן כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּנִיתִי לְדָוִד וְנָתַתִּי לְךָ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
If you heed all that I command you, and walk in My ways, and do
what is right in My sight, keeping My laws and commandments as My
servant David did, then I will be with you and I will build for
you a lasting dynasty as I did for David. I hereby give Israel to
you;

translation.text: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.

verses.english:
If you heed all that I command you, and walk in My ways, and do
what is right in My sight, keeping My laws and commandments as My
servant David did, then I will be with you and I will build for
you a lasting dynasty as I did for David. I hereby give Israel to
you;

verses.hebrew: וַאעַנֶּה אֶת־זֶרַע דָּוִד לְמַעַן זֹאת אַךְ לֹא כל־הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַאעַנֶּה אֶת־זֶרַע דָּוִד לְמַעַן זֹאת אַךְ לֹא כל־הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
and I will chastise David’s descendants for that [sin], though not
forever.”

translation.text: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.

verses.english:
and I will chastise David’s descendants for that [sin], though not
forever.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְבַקֵּשׁ שְׁלֹמֹה לְהָמִית אֶת־יָרבְעָם וַיָּקם יָרבְעָם וַיִּבְרַח מִצְרַיִם אֶל־שִׁישַׁק מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם וַיְהִי בְמִצְרַיִם עַד־מוֹת שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְבַקֵּשׁ שְׁלֹמֹה לְהָמִית אֶת־יָרבְעָם וַיָּקם יָרבְעָם וַיִּבְרַח מִצְרַיִם אֶל־שִׁישַׁק מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם וַיְהִי בְמִצְרַיִם עַד־מוֹת שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
Solomon sought to put Jeroboam to death, but Jeroboam promptly
fled to King Shishak of Egypt; and he remained in Egypt till the
death of Solomon.

translation.text: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

verses.english:
Solomon sought to put Jeroboam to death, but Jeroboam promptly
fled to King Shishak of Egypt; and he remained in Egypt till the
death of Solomon.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְחכְמָתוֹ הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתֻבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְחכְמָתוֹ הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתֻבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
The other events of Solomon’s reign, and all his actions and his
wisdom, are recorded in the book of the Annals of Solomon.

translation.text: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

verses.english:
The other events of Solomon’s reign, and all his actions and his
wisdom, are recorded in the book of the Annals of Solomon.

verses.hebrew: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
The length of Solomon’s reign in Jerusalem, over all Israel, was
forty years.

translation.text: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

verses.english:
The length of Solomon’s reign in Jerusalem, over all Israel, was
forty years.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב שְׁלֹמֹה עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּעִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ רְחַבְעָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב שְׁלֹמֹה עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּעִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ רְחַבְעָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Solomon slept with his fathers and was buried in the city of his
father David; and his son Rehoboam succeeded him as king.

translation.text: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Solomon slept with his fathers and was buried in the city of his
father David; and his son Rehoboam succeeded him as king.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם שְׁכֶם כִּי שְׁכֶם בָּא כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַמְלִיךְ אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם שְׁכֶם כִּי שְׁכֶם בָּא כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַמְלִיךְ אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to
acclaim him as king.

translation.text: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.

verses.english:
Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to
acclaim him as king.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט וְהוּא עוֹדֶנּוּ בְמִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר בָּרַח מִפְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיֵּשֶׁב יָרבְעָם בְּמִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט וְהוּא עוֹדֶנּוּ בְמִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר בָּרַח מִפְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיֵּשֶׁב יָרבְעָם בְּמִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
Jeroboam son of Nebat learned of it while he was still in Egypt;
for Jeroboam had fled from King Solomon, and had settled in Egypt.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard of it, (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)

verses.english:
Jeroboam son of Nebat learned of it while he was still in Egypt;
for Jeroboam had fled from King Solomon, and had settled in Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ־לוֹ (ויבאו) [וַיָּבֹא] יָרבְעָם וְכל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֶל־רְחַבְעָם לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ־לוֹ (ויבאו) [וַיָּבֹא] יָרבְעָם וְכל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֶל־רְחַבְעָם לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
They sent for him; and Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel
came and spoke to Rehoboam as follows:

translation.text: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,

verses.english:
They sent for him; and Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel
came and spoke to Rehoboam as follows:

verses.hebrew: אָבִיךָ הִקְשָׁה אֶת־עֻלֵּנוּ וְאַתָּה עַתָּה הָקֵל מֵעֲבֹדַת אָבִיךָ הַקָּשָׁה וּמֵעֻלּוֹ הַכָּבֵד אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן עָלֵינוּ וְנַעַבְדֶךָּ׃

hebrew.text: אָבִיךָ הִקְשָׁה אֶת־עֻלֵּנוּ וְאַתָּה עַתָּה הָקֵל מֵעֲבֹדַת אָבִיךָ הַקָּשָׁה וּמֵעֻלּוֹ הַכָּבֵד אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן עָלֵינוּ וְנַעַבְדֶךָּ׃

english.text:
“Your father made our yoke heavy. Now lighten the harsh labor and
the heavy yoke which your father laid on us, and we will serve
you.”

translation.text: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.

verses.english:
“Your father made our yoke heavy. Now lighten the harsh labor and
the heavy yoke which your father laid on us, and we will serve
you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם לְכוּ־עֹד שְׁלֹשָׁה יָמִים וְשׁוּבוּ אֵלָי וַיֵּלְכוּ הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם לְכוּ־עֹד שְׁלֹשָׁה יָמִים וְשׁוּבוּ אֵלָי וַיֵּלְכוּ הָעָם׃

english.text:
He answered them, “Go away for three days and then come back to
me.” So the people went away.

translation.text: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.

verses.english:
He answered them, “Go away for three days and then come back to
me.” So the people went away.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּעַץ הַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם אֶת־הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר־הָיוּ עֹמְדִים אֶת־פְּנֵי שְׁלֹמֹה אָבִיו בִּהְיֹתוֹ חַי לֵאמֹר אֵיךְ אַתֶּם נוֹעָצִים לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־הָעָם־הַזֶּה דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּוָּעַץ הַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם אֶת־הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר־הָיוּ עֹמְדִים אֶת־פְּנֵי שְׁלֹמֹה אָבִיו בִּהְיֹתוֹ חַי לֵאמֹר אֵיךְ אַתֶּם נוֹעָצִים לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־הָעָם־הַזֶּה דָּבָר׃

english.text:
King Rehoboam took counsel with the elders who had served his
father Solomon during his lifetime. He said, “What answer do you
advise [me] to give to this people?”

translation.text: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?

verses.english:
King Rehoboam took counsel with the elders who had served his
father Solomon during his lifetime. He said, “What answer do you
advise [me] to give to this people?”

verses.hebrew: (וידבר) [וַיְדַבְּרוּ] אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר אִם־הַיּוֹם תִּהְיֶה־עֶבֶד לָעָם הַזֶּה וַעֲבַדְתָּם וַעֲנִיתָם וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם דְּבָרִים טוֹבִים וְהָיוּ לְךָ עֲבָדִים כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: (וידבר) [וַיְדַבְּרוּ] אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר אִם־הַיּוֹם תִּהְיֶה־עֶבֶד לָעָם הַזֶּה וַעֲבַדְתָּם וַעֲנִיתָם וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם דְּבָרִים טוֹבִים וְהָיוּ לְךָ עֲבָדִים כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
They answered him, “If you will be a servant to those people today
and serve them, and if you respond to them with kind words, they
will be your servants always.”

translation.text: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.

verses.english:
They answered him, “If you will be a servant to those people today
and serve them, and if you respond to them with kind words, they
will be your servants always.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת־עֲצַת הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר יְעָצֻהוּ וַיִּוָּעַץ אֶת־הַיְלָדִים אֲשֶׁר גָּדְלוּ אִתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר הָעֹמְדִים לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת־עֲצַת הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר יְעָצֻהוּ וַיִּוָּעַץ אֶת־הַיְלָדִים אֲשֶׁר גָּדְלוּ אִתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר הָעֹמְדִים לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
But he ignored the advice that the elders gave him, and took
counsel with the young men who had grown up with him and were
serving him.

translation.text: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:

verses.english:
But he ignored the advice that the elders gave him, and took
counsel with the young men who had grown up with him and were
serving him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מָה אַתֶּם נוֹעָצִים וְנָשִׁיב דָּבָר אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ אֵלַי לֵאמֹר הָקֵל מִן־הָעֹל אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן אָבִיךָ עָלֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מָה אַתֶּם נוֹעָצִים וְנָשִׁיב דָּבָר אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ אֵלַי לֵאמֹר הָקֵל מִן־הָעֹל אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן אָבִיךָ עָלֵינוּ׃

english.text:
“What,” he asked, “do you advise that we reply to the people who
said to me, ‘Lighten the yoke that your father placed upon us’?”

translation.text: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?

verses.english:
“What,” he asked, “do you advise that we reply to the people who
said to me, ‘Lighten the yoke that your father placed upon us’?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו הַיְלָדִים אֲשֶׁר גָּדְלוּ אִתּוֹ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־תֹאמַר לָעָם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר אָבִיךָ הִכְבִּיד אֶת־עֻלֵּנוּ וְאַתָּה הָקֵל מֵעָלֵינוּ כֹּה
תְּדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם קטנִּי עָבָה מִמּתְנֵי אָבִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו הַיְלָדִים אֲשֶׁר גָּדְלוּ אִתּוֹ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־תֹאמַר לָעָם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר אָבִיךָ הִכְבִּיד אֶת־עֻלֵּנוּ וְאַתָּה הָקֵל מֵעָלֵינוּ כֹּה
תְּדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם קטנִּי עָבָה מִמּתְנֵי אָבִי׃

english.text:
And the young men who had grown up with him answered, “Speak thus
to the people who said to you, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy,
now you make it lighter for us.’ Say to them, ‘My little finger is
thicker than my father’s loins.

translation.text: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.

verses.english:
And the young men who had grown up with him answered, “Speak thus
to the people who said to you, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy,
now you make it lighter for us.’ Say to them, ‘My little finger is
thicker than my father’s loins.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אָבִי הֶעְמִיס עֲלֵיכֶם עֹל כָּבֵד וַאֲנִי אוֹסִיף עַל־עֻלְּכֶם אָבִי יִסַּר אֶתְכֶם בַּשּׁוֹטִים וַאֲנִי אֲיַסֵּר אֶתְכֶם בָּעַקְרַבִּים׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אָבִי הֶעְמִיס עֲלֵיכֶם עֹל כָּבֵד וַאֲנִי אוֹסִיף עַל־עֻלְּכֶם אָבִי יִסַּר אֶתְכֶם בַּשּׁוֹטִים וַאֲנִי אֲיַסֵּר אֶתְכֶם בָּעַקְרַבִּים׃

english.text:
My father imposed a heavy yoke on you, and I will add to your
yoke; my father flogged you with whips, but I will flog you with
scorpions.’”

translation.text: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

verses.english:
My father imposed a heavy yoke on you, and I will add to your
yoke; my father flogged you with whips, but I will flog you with
scorpions.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבוֹ יָרבְעָם וְכל־הָעָם אֶל־רְחַבְעָם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר שׁוּבוּ אֵלַי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבוֹ יָרבְעָם וְכל־הָעָם אֶל־רְחַבְעָם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר שׁוּבוּ אֵלַי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי׃

english.text:
Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day,
since the king had told them: “Come back on the third day.”

translation.text: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.

verses.english:
Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day,
since the king had told them: “Come back on the third day.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הָעָם קָשָׁה וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת־עֲצַת הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר יְעָצֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הָעָם קָשָׁה וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת־עֲצַת הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר יְעָצֻהוּ׃

english.text:
The king answered the people harshly, ignoring the advice that the
elders had given him.

translation.text: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men’s counsel that they gave him;

verses.english:
The king answered the people harshly, ignoring the advice that the
elders had given him.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם כַּעֲצַת הַיְלָדִים לֵאמֹר אָבִי הִכְבִּיד אֶת־עֻלְּכֶם וַאֲנִי אֹסִיף עַל־עֻלְּכֶם אָבִי יִסַּר אֶתְכֶם בַּשּׁוֹטִים וַאֲנִי אֲיַסֵּר אֶתְכֶם בָּעַקְרַבִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם כַּעֲצַת הַיְלָדִים לֵאמֹר אָבִי הִכְבִּיד אֶת־עֻלְּכֶם וַאֲנִי אֹסִיף עַל־עֻלְּכֶם אָבִי יִסַּר אֶתְכֶם בַּשּׁוֹטִים וַאֲנִי אֲיַסֵּר אֶתְכֶם בָּעַקְרַבִּים׃

english.text:
He spoke to them in accordance with the advice of the young men,
and said, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your
yoke; my father flogged you with whips, but I will flog you with
scorpions.”

translation.text: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father also chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

verses.english:
He spoke to them in accordance with the advice of the young men,
and said, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your
yoke; my father flogged you with whips, but I will flog you with
scorpions.”

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־שָׁמַע הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הָעָם כִּי־הָיְתָה סִבָּה מֵעִם יְהֹוָה לְמַעַן הָקִים אֶת־דְּבָרוֹ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד אֲחִיָּה הַשִּׁילֹנִי אֶל־יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־שָׁמַע הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הָעָם כִּי־הָיְתָה סִבָּה מֵעִם יְהֹוָה לְמַעַן הָקִים אֶת־דְּבָרוֹ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד אֲחִיָּה הַשִּׁילֹנִי אֶל־יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט׃

english.text:
(The king did not listen to the people; for YHWH had brought it
about in order to fulfill the promise that YHWH had made through
Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam son of Nebat.)

translation.text: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from the LORD, that he might perform his saying, which the LORD spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

verses.english:
(The king did not listen to the people; for YHWH had brought it
about in order to fulfill the promise that YHWH had made through
Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam son of Nebat.)

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּרְא כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי לֹא־שָׁמַע הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲלֵהֶם וַיָּשִׁבוּ הָעָם אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר לֵאמֹר מַה־לָּנוּ חֵלֶק בְּדָוִד וְלֹא־נַחֲלָה בְּבֶן־יִשַׁי לְאֹהָלֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל
עַתָּה רְאֵה בֵיתְךָ דָּוִד וַיֵּלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאֹהָלָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּרְא כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי לֹא־שָׁמַע הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲלֵהֶם וַיָּשִׁבוּ הָעָם אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר לֵאמֹר מַה־לָּנוּ חֵלֶק בְּדָוִד וְלֹא־נַחֲלָה בְּבֶן־יִשַׁי לְאֹהָלֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל
עַתָּה רְאֵה בֵיתְךָ דָּוִד וַיֵּלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאֹהָלָיו׃

english.text:
When all Israel saw that the king had not listened to them, the
people answered the king: “We have no portion in David, No share
in Jesse’s son! To your tents, O Israel! Now look to your own
House, O David.” So the Israelites returned to their homes.

translation.text: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.

verses.english:
When all Israel saw that the king had not listened to them, the
people answered the king: “We have no portion in David, No share
in Jesse’s son! To your tents, O Israel! Now look to your own
House, O David.” So the Israelites returned to their homes.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם רְחַבְעָם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם רְחַבְעָם׃

english.text:
But Rehoboam continued to reign over the Israelites who lived in
the towns of Judah.

translation.text: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

verses.english:
But Rehoboam continued to reign over the Israelites who lived in
the towns of Judah.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם אֶת־אֲדֹרָם אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמַּס וַיִּרְגְּמוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בּוֹ אֶבֶן וַיָּמֹת וְהַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם הִתְאַמֵּץ לַעֲלוֹת בַּמֶּרְכָּבָה לָנוּס
יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם אֶת־אֲדֹרָם אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמַּס וַיִּרְגְּמוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בּוֹ אֶבֶן וַיָּמֹת וְהַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם הִתְאַמֵּץ לַעֲלוֹת בַּמֶּרְכָּבָה לָנוּס
יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was in charge of the forced labor,
but all Israel pelted him to death with stones. Thereupon King
Rehoboam hurriedly mounted his chariot and fled to Jerusalem.

translation.text: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute; and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

verses.english:
King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was in charge of the forced labor,
but all Israel pelted him to death with stones. Thereupon King
Rehoboam hurriedly mounted his chariot and fled to Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְשְׁעוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּבֵית דָּוִד עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְשְׁעוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּבֵית דָּוִד עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
