Thus Israel revolted against the House of David, as is still the
case.

translation.text: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

verses.english:
Thus Israel revolted against the House of David, as is still the
case.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־שָׁב יָרבְעָם וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־הָעֵדָה וַיַּמְלִיכוּ אֹתוֹ עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא הָיָה אַחֲרֵי בֵית־דָּוִד זוּלָתִי
שֵׁבֶט־יְהוּדָה לְבַדּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־שָׁב יָרבְעָם וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־הָעֵדָה וַיַּמְלִיכוּ אֹתוֹ עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא הָיָה אַחֲרֵי בֵית־דָּוִד זוּלָתִי
שֵׁבֶט־יְהוּדָה לְבַדּוֹ׃

english.text:
When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent
messengers and summoned him to the assembly and made him king over
all Israel. Only the tribe of Judah remained loyal to the House of
David.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.

verses.english:
When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent
messengers and summoned him to the assembly and made him king over
all Israel. Only the tribe of Judah remained loyal to the House of
David.

verses.hebrew:
(ויבאו) [וַיָּבֹא] רְחַבְעָם יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיַּקְהֵל אֶת־כּל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־שֵׁבֶט בִּנְיָמִן מֵאָה וּשְׁמֹנִים אֶלֶף בָּחוּר עֹשֵׂה מִלְחָמָה לְהִלָּחֵם עִם־בֵּית
יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־הַמְּלוּכָה לִרְחַבְעָם בֶּן־שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text:
(ויבאו) [וַיָּבֹא] רְחַבְעָם יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיַּקְהֵל אֶת־כּל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־שֵׁבֶט בִּנְיָמִן מֵאָה וּשְׁמֹנִים אֶלֶף בָּחוּר עֹשֵׂה מִלְחָמָה לְהִלָּחֵם עִם־בֵּית
יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־הַמְּלוּכָה לִרְחַבְעָם בֶּן־שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
On his return to Jerusalem, Rehoboam mustered all the House of
Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, 180,000 picked warriors, to fight
against the House of Israel, in order to restore the kingship to
Rehoboam son of Solomon.

translation.text: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

verses.english:
On his return to Jerusalem, Rehoboam mustered all the House of
Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, 180,000 picked warriors, to fight
against the House of Israel, in order to restore the kingship to
Rehoboam son of Solomon.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְּבַר הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־שְׁמַעְיָה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דְּבַר הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־שְׁמַעְיָה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: But the word of God came to Shemaiah, the man of God:

translation.text: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

verses.english: But the word of God came to Shemaiah, the man of God:

verses.hebrew: אֱמֹר אֶל־רְחַבְעָם בֶּן־שְׁלֹמֹה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וְאֶל־כּל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה וּבִנְיָמִין וְיֶתֶר הָעָם לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: אֱמֹר אֶל־רְחַבְעָם בֶּן־שְׁלֹמֹה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וְאֶל־כּל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה וּבִנְיָמִין וְיֶתֶר הָעָם לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
“Say to King Rehoboam son of Solomon of Judah, and to all the
House of Judah and Benjamin and the rest of the people:

translation.text: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

verses.english:
“Say to King Rehoboam son of Solomon of Judah, and to all the
House of Judah and Benjamin and the rest of the people:

verses.hebrew:
כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה לֹא־תַעֲלוּ וְלֹא־תִלָּחֲמוּן עִם־אֲחֵיכֶם בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שׁוּבוּ אִישׁ לְבֵיתוֹ כִּי מֵאִתִּי נִהְיָה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה
וַיָּשֻׁבוּ לָלֶכֶת כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה לֹא־תַעֲלוּ וְלֹא־תִלָּחֲמוּן עִם־אֲחֵיכֶם בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל שׁוּבוּ אִישׁ לְבֵיתוֹ כִּי מֵאִתִּי נִהְיָה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה
וַיָּשֻׁבוּ לָלֶכֶת כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Thus said YHWH: You shall not set out to make war on your kinsmen
the Israelites. Let every man return to his home, for this thing
has been brought about by Me.” They heeded the word of YHWH and
turned back, in accordance with the word of YHWH.

translation.text: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of the LORD, and returned to depart, according to the word of the LORD.

verses.english:
Thus said YHWH: You shall not set out to make war on your kinsmen
the Israelites. Let every man return to his home, for this thing
has been brought about by Me.” They heeded the word of YHWH and
turned back, in accordance with the word of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן יָרבְעָם אֶת־שְׁכֶם בְּהַר אֶפְרַיִם וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהּ וַיֵּצֵא מִשָּׁם וַיִּבֶן אֶת־פְּנוּאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן יָרבְעָם אֶת־שְׁכֶם בְּהַר אֶפְרַיִם וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהּ וַיֵּצֵא מִשָּׁם וַיִּבֶן אֶת־פְּנוּאֵל׃

english.text:
Jeroboam fortified Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and
resided there; he moved out from there and fortified Penuel.

translation.text: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.

verses.english:
Jeroboam fortified Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and
resided there; he moved out from there and fortified Penuel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יָרבְעָם בְּלִבּוֹ עַתָּה תָּשׁוּב הַמַּמְלָכָה לְבֵית דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יָרבְעָם בְּלִבּוֹ עַתָּה תָּשׁוּב הַמַּמְלָכָה לְבֵית דָּוִד׃

english.text:
Jeroboam said to himself, “Now the kingdom may well return to the
House of David.

translation.text: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:

verses.english:
Jeroboam said to himself, “Now the kingdom may well return to the
House of David.

verses.hebrew:
אִם־יַעֲלֶה הָעָם הַזֶּה לַעֲשׂוֹת זְבָחִים בְּבֵית־יְהֹוָה בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְשָׁב לֵב הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיהֶם אֶל־רְחַבְעָם מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַהֲרָגֻנִי וְשָׁבוּ אֶל־רְחַבְעָם
מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text:
אִם־יַעֲלֶה הָעָם הַזֶּה לַעֲשׂוֹת זְבָחִים בְּבֵית־יְהֹוָה בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וְשָׁב לֵב הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיהֶם אֶל־רְחַבְעָם מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַהֲרָגֻנִי וְשָׁבוּ אֶל־רְחַבְעָם
מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
If these people still go up to offer sacrifices at the House of
YHWH in Jerusalem, the heart of these people will turn back to
their master, King Rehoboam of Judah; they will kill me and go
back to King Rehoboam of Judah.”

translation.text: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.

verses.english:
If these people still go up to offer sacrifices at the House of
YHWH in Jerusalem, the heart of these people will turn back to
their master, King Rehoboam of Judah; they will kill me and go
back to King Rehoboam of Judah.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּעַץ הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁנֵי עֶגְלֵי זָהָב וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם רַב־לָכֶם מֵעֲלוֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם הִנֵּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלוּךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּוָּעַץ הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁנֵי עֶגְלֵי זָהָב וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם רַב־לָכֶם מֵעֲלוֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם הִנֵּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלוּךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english.text:
So the king took counsel and made two golden calves. He said to
the people, “You have been going up to Jerusalem long enough. This
is your god, O Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt!”

translation.text: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.english:
So the king took counsel and made two golden calves. He said to
the people, “You have been going up to Jerusalem long enough. This
is your god, O Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt!”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־הָאֶחָד בְּבֵית־אֵל וְאֶת־הָאֶחָד נָתַן בְּדָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־הָאֶחָד בְּבֵית־אֵל וְאֶת־הָאֶחָד נָתַן בְּדָן׃

english.text: He set up one in Bethel and placed the other in Dan.

translation.text: And he set the one in Bethel, and the other put he in Dan.

verses.english: He set up one in Bethel and placed the other in Dan.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְחַטָּאת וַיֵּלְכוּ הָעָם לִפְנֵי הָאֶחָד עַד־דָּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְחַטָּאת וַיֵּלְכוּ הָעָם לִפְנֵי הָאֶחָד עַד־דָּן׃

english.text:
That proved to be a cause of guilt, for the people went to worship
[the calf at Bethel and] the one at Dan.

translation.text: And this thing became a sin: for the people went to worship before the one, even unto Dan.

verses.english:
That proved to be a cause of guilt, for the people went to worship
[the calf at Bethel and] the one at Dan.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־בֵּית בָּמוֹת וַיַּעַשׂ כֹּהֲנִים מִקְצוֹת הָעָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָיוּ מִבְּנֵי לֵוִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־בֵּית בָּמוֹת וַיַּעַשׂ כֹּהֲנִים מִקְצוֹת הָעָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָיוּ מִבְּנֵי לֵוִי׃

english.text:
He also made cult places and appointed priests from the ranks of
the people who were not of Levite descent.

translation.text: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.

verses.english:
He also made cult places and appointed priests from the ranks of
the people who were not of Levite descent.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַשׂ יָרבְעָם חָג בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִי בַחֲמִשָּׁה־עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ כֶּחָג אֲשֶׁר בִּיהוּדָה וַיַּעַל עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כֵּן עָשָׂה בְּבֵית־אֵל לְזַבֵּחַ לָעֲגָלִים
אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה וְהֶעֱמִיד בְּבֵית אֵל אֶת־כֹּהֲנֵי הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַשׂ יָרבְעָם חָג בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִי בַחֲמִשָּׁה־עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ כֶּחָג אֲשֶׁר בִּיהוּדָה וַיַּעַל עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כֵּן עָשָׂה בְּבֵית־אֵל לְזַבֵּחַ לָעֲגָלִים
אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה וְהֶעֱמִיד בְּבֵית אֵל אֶת־כֹּהֲנֵי הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

english.text:
He stationed at Bethel the priests of the shrines that he had
appointed to sacrifice to the calves that he had made. And
Jeroboam established a festival on the fifteenth day of the eighth
month; in imitation of the festival in Judah, he established one
at Bethel, and he ascended the altar [there].

translation.text: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Judah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Bethel, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places which he had made.

verses.english:
He stationed at Bethel the priests of the shrines that he had
appointed to sacrifice to the calves that he had made. And
Jeroboam established a festival on the fifteenth day of the eighth
month; in imitation of the festival in Judah, he established one
at Bethel, and he ascended the altar [there].

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַל עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה בְּבֵית־אֵל בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִי בַּחֹדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּדָא (מלבד) [מִלִּבּוֹ] וַיַּעַשׂ חָג לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
וַיַּעַל עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לְהַקְטִיר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַל עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה בְּבֵית־אֵל בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִי בַּחֹדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּדָא (מלבד) [מִלִּבּוֹ] וַיַּעַשׂ חָג לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
וַיַּעַל עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לְהַקְטִיר׃

english.text:
On the fifteenth day of the eighth month—the month in which he had
contrived of his own mind to establish a festival for the
Israelites—Jeroboam ascended the altar that he had made in Bethel.
As he ascended the altar to present an offering,

translation.text: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Bethel the fifteenth day of the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.

verses.english:
On the fifteenth day of the eighth month—the month in which he had
contrived of his own mind to establish a festival for the
Israelites—Jeroboam ascended the altar that he had made in Bethel.
As he ascended the altar to present an offering,

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים בָּא מִיהוּדָה בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֶל־בֵּית־אֵל וְיָרבְעָם עֹמֵד עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לְהַקְטִיר׃

hebrew.text: וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים בָּא מִיהוּדָה בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֶל־בֵּית־אֵל וְיָרבְעָם עֹמֵד עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לְהַקְטִיר׃

english.text:
a man of God arrived at Bethel from Judah at the command of YHWH.
While Jeroboam was standing on the altar to present the offering,

translation.text: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the LORD unto Bethel: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.

verses.english:
a man of God arrived at Bethel from Judah at the command of YHWH.
While Jeroboam was standing on the altar to present the offering,

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְרָא עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר מִזְבֵּחַ מִזְבֵּחַ כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הִנֵּה־בֵן נוֹלָד לְבֵית־דָּוִד יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ שְׁמוֹ וְזָבַח עָלֶיךָ אֶת־כֹּהֲנֵי
הַבָּמוֹת הַמַּקְטִרִים עָלֶיךָ וְעַצְמוֹת אָדָם יִשְׂרְפוּ עָלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְרָא עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר מִזְבֵּחַ מִזְבֵּחַ כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הִנֵּה־בֵן נוֹלָד לְבֵית־דָּוִד יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ שְׁמוֹ וְזָבַח עָלֶיךָ אֶת־כֹּהֲנֵי
הַבָּמוֹת הַמַּקְטִרִים עָלֶיךָ וְעַצְמוֹת אָדָם יִשְׂרְפוּ עָלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
the man of God, at the command of YHWH, cried out against the
altar: “O altar, altar! Thus said YHWH: A son shall be born to the
House of David, Josiah by name; and he shall slaughter upon you
the priests of the shrines who bring offerings upon you. And human
bones shall be burned upon you.”

translation.text: And he cried against the altar in the word of the LORD, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the LORD; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men’s bones shall be burnt upon thee.

verses.english:
the man of God, at the command of YHWH, cried out against the
altar: “O altar, altar! Thus said YHWH: A son shall be born to the
House of David, Josiah by name; and he shall slaughter upon you
the priests of the shrines who bring offerings upon you. And human
bones shall be burned upon you.”

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא מוֹפֵת לֵאמֹר זֶה הַמּוֹפֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה הִנֵּה הַמִּזְבֵּחַ נִקְרָע וְנִשְׁפַּךְ הַדֶּשֶׁן אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַן בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא מוֹפֵת לֵאמֹר זֶה הַמּוֹפֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה הִנֵּה הַמִּזְבֵּחַ נִקְרָע וְנִשְׁפַּךְ הַדֶּשֶׁן אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו׃

english.text:
He gave a portent on that day, saying, “Here is the portent that
YHWH has decreed: This altar shall break apart, and the ashes on
it shall be spilled.”

translation.text: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which the LORD hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.

verses.english:
He gave a portent on that day, saying, “Here is the portent that
YHWH has decreed: This altar shall break apart, and the ashes on
it shall be spilled.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־דְּבַר אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר קָרָא עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בְּבֵית־אֵל וַיִּשְׁלַח יָרבְעָם אֶת־יָדוֹ מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֵאמֹר תִּפְשֻׂהוּ וַתִּיבַשׁ
יָדוֹ אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח עָלָיו וְלֹא יָכֹל לַהֲשִׁיבָהּ אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־דְּבַר אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר קָרָא עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בְּבֵית־אֵל וַיִּשְׁלַח יָרבְעָם אֶת־יָדוֹ מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֵאמֹר תִּפְשֻׂהוּ וַתִּיבַשׁ
יָדוֹ אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח עָלָיו וְלֹא יָכֹל לַהֲשִׁיבָהּ אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
When the king heard what the man of God had proclaimed against the
altar in Bethel, Jeroboam stretched out his arm above the altar
and cried, “Seize him!” But the arm that he stretched out against
him became rigid, and he could not draw it back.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Bethel, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.

verses.english:
When the king heard what the man of God had proclaimed against the
altar in Bethel, Jeroboam stretched out his arm above the altar
and cried, “Seize him!” But the arm that he stretched out against
him became rigid, and he could not draw it back.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמִּזְבֵּחַ נִקְרָע וַיִּשָּׁפֵךְ הַדֶּשֶׁן מִן־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כַּמּוֹפֵת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהַמִּזְבֵּחַ נִקְרָע וַיִּשָּׁפֵךְ הַדֶּשֶׁן מִן־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כַּמּוֹפֵת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The altar broke apart and its ashes were spilled—the very portent
that the man of God had announced at YHWH’s command.

translation.text: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the LORD.

verses.english:
The altar broke apart and its ashes were spilled—the very portent
that the man of God had announced at YHWH’s command.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים חַל־נָא אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעֲדִי וְתָשֹׁב יָדִי אֵלָי וַיְחַל אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה
וַתָּשׁב יַד־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו וַתְּהִי כְּבָרִאשֹׁנָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים חַל־נָא אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעֲדִי וְתָשֹׁב יָדִי אֵלָי וַיְחַל אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה
וַתָּשׁב יַד־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו וַתְּהִי כְּבָרִאשֹׁנָה׃

english.text:
Then the king spoke up and said to the man of God, “Please entreat
YHWH your God and pray for me that I may be able to draw back my
arm.” The man of God entreated YHWH and the king was able to draw
his arm back; it became as it was before.

translation.text: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the LORD thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored him again, and became as it was before.

verses.english:
Then the king spoke up and said to the man of God, “Please entreat
YHWH your God and pray for me that I may be able to draw back my
arm.” The man of God entreated YHWH and the king was able to draw
his arm back; it became as it was before.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בֹּאָה־אִתִּי הַבַּיְתָה וּסְעָדָה וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ מַתָּת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בֹּאָה־אִתִּי הַבַּיְתָה וּסְעָדָה וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ מַתָּת׃

english.text:
The king said to the man of God, “Come with me to my house and
have some refreshment; and I shall give you a gift.”

translation.text: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.

verses.english:
The king said to the man of God, “Come with me to my house and
have some refreshment; and I shall give you a gift.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־תִּתֶּן־לִי אֶת־חֲצִי בֵיתֶךָ לֹא אָבֹא עִמָּךְ וְלֹא־אֹכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא אֶשְׁתֶּה־מַּיִם בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־תִּתֶּן־לִי אֶת־חֲצִי בֵיתֶךָ לֹא אָבֹא עִמָּךְ וְלֹא־אֹכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא אֶשְׁתֶּה־מַּיִם בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה׃

translation.text: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:

verses.hebrew: כִּי־כֵן צִוָּה אֹתִי בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר לֹא־תֹאכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא תִשְׁתֶּה־מָּיִם וְלֹא תָשׁוּב בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלָכְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־כֵן צִוָּה אֹתִי בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר לֹא־תֹאכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא תִשְׁתֶּה־מָּיִם וְלֹא תָשׁוּב בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלָכְתָּ׃

english.text:
for so I was commanded by the word of YHWH: You shall eat no bread
and drink no water, nor shall you go back by the road by which you
came.”

translation.text: For so was it charged me by the word of the LORD, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.

verses.english:
for so I was commanded by the word of YHWH: You shall eat no bread
and drink no water, nor shall you go back by the road by which you
came.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אַחֵר וְלֹא־שָׁב בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר בָּא בָהּ אֶל־בֵּית־אֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אַחֵר וְלֹא־שָׁב בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר בָּא בָהּ אֶל־בֵּית־אֵל׃

english.text:
So he left by another road and did not go back by the road on
which he had come to Bethel.

translation.text: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Bethel.

verses.english:
So he left by another road and did not go back by the road on
which he had come to Bethel.

verses.hebrew:
וְנָבִיא אֶחָד זָקֵן יֹשֵׁב בְּבֵית־אֵל וַיָּבוֹא בְנוֹ וַיְסַפֶּר־לוֹ אֶת־כּל־הַמַּעֲשֶׂה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים הַיּוֹם בְּבֵית־אֵל אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר
אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְסַפְּרוּם לַאֲבִיהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וְנָבִיא אֶחָד זָקֵן יֹשֵׁב בְּבֵית־אֵל וַיָּבוֹא בְנוֹ וַיְסַפֶּר־לוֹ אֶת־כּל־הַמַּעֲשֶׂה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים הַיּוֹם בְּבֵית־אֵל אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר
אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְסַפְּרוּם לַאֲבִיהֶם׃

english.text:
There was an old prophet living in Bethel; and his sons came and
told him all the things that the man of God had done that day in
Bethel [and] the words that he had spoken to the king. When they
told it to their father,

translation.text: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Bethel; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.

verses.english:
There was an old prophet living in Bethel; and his sons came and
told him all the things that the man of God had done that day in
Bethel [and] the words that he had spoken to the king. When they
told it to their father,

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם אֲבִיהֶם אֵי־זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ הָלָךְ וַיִּרְאוּ בָנָיו אֶת־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־בָּא מִיהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם אֲבִיהֶם אֵי־זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ הָלָךְ וַיִּרְאוּ בָנָיו אֶת־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־בָּא מִיהוּדָה׃

english.text:
their father said to them, “Which road did he leave by?” His sons
had seen the road taken by the man of God who had come from Judah.

translation.text: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.

verses.english:
their father said to them, “Which road did he leave by?” His sons
had seen the road taken by the man of God who had come from Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בָּנָיו חִבְשׁוּ־לִי הַחֲמוֹר וַיַּחְבְּשׁוּ־לוֹ הַחֲמוֹר וַיִּרְכַּב עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בָּנָיו חִבְשׁוּ־לִי הַחֲמוֹר וַיַּחְבְּשׁוּ־לוֹ הַחֲמוֹר וַיִּרְכַּב עָלָיו׃

english.text:
“Saddle the ass for me,” he said to his sons. They saddled the ass
for him, and he mounted it

translation.text: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,

verses.english:
“Saddle the ass for me,” he said to his sons. They saddled the ass
for him, and he mounted it

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּמְצָאֵהוּ יֹשֵׁב תַּחַת הָאֵלָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הַאַתָּה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־בָּאתָ מִיהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר אָנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּמְצָאֵהוּ יֹשֵׁב תַּחַת הָאֵלָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הַאַתָּה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־בָּאתָ מִיהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר אָנִי׃

english.text:
and rode after the man of God. He came upon him sitting under a
terebinth and said to him, “Are you the man of God who came from
Judah?” “Yes, I am,” he answered.

translation.text: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.

verses.english:
and rode after the man of God. He came upon him sitting under a
terebinth and said to him, “Are you the man of God who came from
Judah?” “Yes, I am,” he answered.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לֵךְ אִתִּי הַבָּיְתָה וֶאֱכֹל לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לֵךְ אִתִּי הַבָּיְתָה וֶאֱכֹל לָחֶם׃

english.text: “Come home with me,” he said, “and have something to eat.”

translation.text: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.

verses.english: “Come home with me,” he said, “and have something to eat.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אוּכַל לָשׁוּב אִתָּךְ וְלָבוֹא אִתָּךְ וְלֹא־אֹכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא־אֶשְׁתֶּה אִתְּךָ מַיִם בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אוּכַל לָשׁוּב אִתָּךְ וְלָבוֹא אִתָּךְ וְלֹא־אֹכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא־אֶשְׁתֶּה אִתְּךָ מַיִם בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
He replied, “I may not go back with you and enter your home; and I
may not eat bread or drink water in this place;

translation.text: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:

verses.english:
He replied, “I may not go back with you and enter your home; and I
may not eat bread or drink water in this place;

verses.hebrew: כִּי־דָבָר אֵלַי בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה לֹא־תֹאכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא־תִשְׁתֶּה שָׁם מָיִם לֹא־תָשׁוּב לָלֶכֶת בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַכְתָּ בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־דָבָר אֵלַי בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה לֹא־תֹאכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא־תִשְׁתֶּה שָׁם מָיִם לֹא־תָשׁוּב לָלֶכֶת בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַכְתָּ בָּהּ׃

english.text:
the order I received by the word of YHWH was: You shall not eat
bread or drink water there; nor shall you return by the road on
which you came.”

translation.text: For it was said to me by the word of the LORD, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.

verses.english:
the order I received by the word of YHWH was: You shall not eat
bread or drink water there; nor shall you return by the road on
which you came.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ גַּם־אֲנִי נָבִיא כָּמוֹךָ וּמַלְאָךְ דִּבֶּר אֵלַי בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הֲשִׁבֵהוּ אִתְּךָ אֶל־בֵּיתֶךָ וְיֹאכַל לֶחֶם וְיֵשְׁתְּ מָיִם כִּחֵשׁ לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ גַּם־אֲנִי נָבִיא כָּמוֹךָ וּמַלְאָךְ דִּבֶּר אֵלַי בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הֲשִׁבֵהוּ אִתְּךָ אֶל־בֵּיתֶךָ וְיֹאכַל לֶחֶם וְיֵשְׁתְּ מָיִם כִּחֵשׁ לוֹ׃

english.text:
“I am a prophet, too,” said the other, “and an angel said to me by
command of YHWH: Bring him back with you to your house, that he
may eat bread and drink water.” He was lying to him.

translation.text: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the LORD, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.

verses.english:
“I am a prophet, too,” said the other, “and an angel said to me by
command of YHWH: Bring him back with you to your house, that he
may eat bread and drink water.” He was lying to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב אִתּוֹ וַיֹּאכַל לֶחֶם בְּבֵיתוֹ וַיֵּשְׁתְּ מָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב אִתּוֹ וַיֹּאכַל לֶחֶם בְּבֵיתוֹ וַיֵּשְׁתְּ מָיִם׃

english.text:
So he went back with him, and he ate bread and drank water in his
house.

translation.text: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.

verses.english:
So he went back with him, and he ate bread and drank water in his
house.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הֵם יֹשְׁבִים אֶל־הַשֻּׁלְחָןוַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר הֱשִׁיבוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הֵם יֹשְׁבִים אֶל־הַשֻּׁלְחָןוַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר הֱשִׁיבוֹ׃

english.text:
While they were sitting at the table, the word of YHWH came to the
prophet who had brought him back.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the LORD came unto the prophet that brought him back:

verses.english:
While they were sitting at the table, the word of YHWH came to the
prophet who had brought him back.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־בָּא מִיהוּדָה לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה יַעַן כִּי מָרִיתָ פִּי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־בָּא מִיהוּדָה לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה יַעַן כִּי מָרִיתָ פִּי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

english.text:
He cried out to the man of God who had come from Judah: “Thus said
YHWH: Because you have flouted the word of YHWH and have not
observed what YHWH your God commanded you,

translation.text: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the LORD, and hast not kept the commandment which the LORD thy God commanded thee,

verses.english:
He cried out to the man of God who had come from Judah: “Thus said
YHWH: Because you have flouted the word of YHWH and have not
observed what YHWH your God commanded you,

verses.hebrew: וַתָּשׁב וַתֹּאכַל לֶחֶם וַתֵּשְׁתְּ מַיִם בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֵלֶיךָ אַל־תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם וְאַל־תֵּשְׁתְּ מָיִם לֹא־תָבוֹא נִבְלָתְךָ אֶל־קֶבֶר אֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּשׁב וַתֹּאכַל לֶחֶם וַתֵּשְׁתְּ מַיִם בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֵלֶיךָ אַל־תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם וְאַל־תֵּשְׁתְּ מָיִם לֹא־תָבוֹא נִבְלָתְךָ אֶל־קֶבֶר אֲבֹתֶיךָ׃

english.text:
but have gone back and eaten bread and drunk water in the place of
which He said to you, ‘Do not eat bread or drink water [there],’
your corpse shall not come to the grave of your fathers.”

translation.text: But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which the Lord did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.

verses.english:
but have gone back and eaten bread and drunk water in the place of
which He said to you, ‘Do not eat bread or drink water [there],’
your corpse shall not come to the grave of your fathers.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי אכְלוֹ לֶחֶם וְאַחֲרֵי שְׁתוֹתוֹ וַיַּחֲבשׁ־לוֹ הַחֲמוֹר לַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר הֱשִׁיבוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי אכְלוֹ לֶחֶם וְאַחֲרֵי שְׁתוֹתוֹ וַיַּחֲבשׁ־לוֹ הַחֲמוֹר לַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר הֱשִׁיבוֹ׃

english.text:
After he had eaten bread and had drunk, he saddled the ass for
him—for the prophet whom he had brought back.

translation.text: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.

verses.english:
After he had eaten bread and had drunk, he saddled the ass for
him—for the prophet whom he had brought back.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּמְצָאֵהוּ אַרְיֵה בַּדֶּרֶךְ וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַתְּהִי נִבְלָתוֹ מֻשְׁלֶכֶת בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְהַחֲמוֹר עֹמֵד אֶצְלָהּ וְהָאַרְיֵה עֹמֵד אֵצֶל הַנְּבֵלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּמְצָאֵהוּ אַרְיֵה בַּדֶּרֶךְ וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַתְּהִי נִבְלָתוֹ מֻשְׁלֶכֶת בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְהַחֲמוֹר עֹמֵד אֶצְלָהּ וְהָאַרְיֵה עֹמֵד אֵצֶל הַנְּבֵלָה׃

english.text:
He set out, and a lion came upon him on the road and killed him.
His corpse lay on the road, with the ass standing beside it, and
the lion also standing beside the corpse.

translation.text: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.

verses.english:
He set out, and a lion came upon him on the road and killed him.
His corpse lay on the road, with the ass standing beside it, and
the lion also standing beside the corpse.

verses.hebrew:
וְהִנֵּה אֲנָשִׁים עֹבְרִים וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת־הַנְּבֵלָה מֻשְׁלֶכֶת בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְאֶת־הָאַרְיֵה עֹמֵד אֵצֶל הַנְּבֵלָה וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיְדַבְּרוּ בָעִיר אֲשֶׁר הַנָּבִיא הַזָּקֵן יֹשֵׁב
בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִנֵּה אֲנָשִׁים עֹבְרִים וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת־הַנְּבֵלָה מֻשְׁלֶכֶת בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְאֶת־הָאַרְיֵה עֹמֵד אֵצֶל הַנְּבֵלָה וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיְדַבְּרוּ בָעִיר אֲשֶׁר הַנָּבִיא הַזָּקֵן יֹשֵׁב
בָּהּ׃

english.text:
Some men who passed by saw the corpse lying on the road and the
lion standing beside the corpse; they went and told it in the town
where the old prophet lived.

translation.text: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.

verses.english:
Some men who passed by saw the corpse lying on the road and the
lion standing beside the corpse; they went and told it in the town
where the old prophet lived.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁמַע הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר הֱשִׁיבוֹ מִן־הַדֶּרֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים הוּא אֲשֶׁר מָרָה אֶת־פִּי יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ יְהֹוָה לָאַרְיֵה וַיִּשְׁבְּרֵהוּ וַיְמִתֵהוּ
כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר־לוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁמַע הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר הֱשִׁיבוֹ מִן־הַדֶּרֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים הוּא אֲשֶׁר מָרָה אֶת־פִּי יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ יְהֹוָה לָאַרְיֵה וַיִּשְׁבְּרֵהוּ וַיְמִתֵהוּ
כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר־לוֹ׃

english.text:
And when the prophet who had brought him back from the road heard
it, he said, “That is the man of God who flouted YHWH’s command;
YHWH gave him over to the lion, which mauled him and killed him in
accordance with the word that YHWH had spoken to him.”

translation.text: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the LORD: therefore the LORD hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake unto him.

verses.english:
And when the prophet who had brought him back from the road heard
it, he said, “That is the man of God who flouted YHWH’s command;
YHWH gave him over to the lion, which mauled him and killed him in
accordance with the word that YHWH had spoken to him.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל־בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר חִבְשׁוּ־לִי אֶת־הַחֲמוֹר וַיַּחֲבֹשׁוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל־בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר חִבְשׁוּ־לִי אֶת־הַחֲמוֹר וַיַּחֲבֹשׁוּ׃

english.text: He said to his sons, “Saddle the ass for me,” and they did so.

translation.text: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.

verses.english: He said to his sons, “Saddle the ass for me,” and they did so.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־נִבְלָתוֹ מֻשְׁלֶכֶת בַּדֶּרֶךְ וַחֲמוֹר וְהָאַרְיֵה עֹמְדִים אֵצֶל הַנְּבֵלָה לֹא־אָכַל הָאַרְיֵה אֶת־הַנְּבֵלָה וְלֹא שָׁבַר אֶת־הַחֲמוֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־נִבְלָתוֹ מֻשְׁלֶכֶת בַּדֶּרֶךְ וַחֲמוֹר וְהָאַרְיֵה עֹמְדִים אֵצֶל הַנְּבֵלָה לֹא־אָכַל הָאַרְיֵה אֶת־הַנְּבֵלָה וְלֹא שָׁבַר אֶת־הַחֲמוֹר׃

english.text:
He set out and found the corpse lying on the road, with the ass
and the lion standing beside the corpse; the lion had not eaten
the corpse nor had it mauled the ass.

translation.text: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.

verses.english:
He set out and found the corpse lying on the road, with the ass
and the lion standing beside the corpse; the lion had not eaten
the corpse nor had it mauled the ass.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא הַנָּבִיא אֶת־נִבְלַת אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּנִּחֵהוּ אֶל־הַחֲמוֹר וַיְשִׁיבֵהוּ וַיָּבֹא אֶל־עִיר הַנָּבִיא הַזָּקֵן לִסְפֹּד וּלְקבְרוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא הַנָּבִיא אֶת־נִבְלַת אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּנִּחֵהוּ אֶל־הַחֲמוֹר וַיְשִׁיבֵהוּ וַיָּבֹא אֶל־עִיר הַנָּבִיא הַזָּקֵן לִסְפֹּד וּלְקבְרוֹ׃

english.text:
The prophet lifted up the corpse of the man of God, laid it on the
ass, and brought it back; it was brought to the town of the old
prophet for lamentation and burial.

translation.text: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.

verses.english:
The prophet lifted up the corpse of the man of God, laid it on the
ass, and brought it back; it was brought to the town of the old
prophet for lamentation and burial.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּנַּח אֶת־נִבְלָתוֹ בְּקִבְרוֹ וַיִּסְפְּדוּ עָלָיו הוֹי אָחִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּנַּח אֶת־נִבְלָתוֹ בְּקִבְרוֹ וַיִּסְפְּדוּ עָלָיו הוֹי אָחִי׃

english.text:
He laid the corpse in his own burial place; and they lamented over
it, “Alas, my brother!”

translation.text: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, Alas, my brother!

verses.english:
He laid the corpse in his own burial place; and they lamented over
it, “Alas, my brother!”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי קבְרוֹ אֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר בְּמוֹתִי וּקְבַרְתֶּם אֹתִי בַּקֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים קָבוּר בּוֹ אֵצֶל עַצְמֹתָיו הַנִּיחוּ אֶת־עַצְמֹתָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי קבְרוֹ אֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר בְּמוֹתִי וּקְבַרְתֶּם אֹתִי בַּקֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים קָבוּר בּוֹ אֵצֶל עַצְמֹתָיו הַנִּיחוּ אֶת־עַצְמֹתָי׃

english.text:
After burying him, he said to his sons, “When I die, bury me in
the grave where the man of God lies buried; lay my bones beside
his.

translation.text: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:

verses.english:
After burying him, he said to his sons, “When I die, bury me in
the grave where the man of God lies buried; lay my bones beside
his.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הָיֹה יִהְיֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר קָרָא בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־אֵל וְעַל כּל־בָּתֵּי הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הָיֹה יִהְיֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר קָרָא בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־אֵל וְעַל כּל־בָּתֵּי הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
For what he announced by the word of YHWH against the altar in
Bethel, and against all the cult places in the towns of Samaria,
shall surely come true.”

translation.text: For the saying which he cried by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.

verses.english:
For what he announced by the word of YHWH against the altar in
Bethel, and against all the cult places in the towns of Samaria,
shall surely come true.”

verses.hebrew: אַחַר הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לֹא־שָׁב יָרבְעָם מִדַּרְכּוֹ הָרָעָה וַיָּשׁב וַיַּעַשׂ מִקְצוֹת הָעָם כֹּהֲנֵי בָמוֹת הֶחָפֵץ יְמַלֵּא אֶת־יָדוֹ וִיהִי כֹּהֲנֵי בָמוֹת׃

hebrew.text: אַחַר הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לֹא־שָׁב יָרבְעָם מִדַּרְכּוֹ הָרָעָה וַיָּשׁב וַיַּעַשׂ מִקְצוֹת הָעָם כֹּהֲנֵי בָמוֹת הֶחָפֵץ יְמַלֵּא אֶת־יָדוֹ וִיהִי כֹּהֲנֵי בָמוֹת׃

english.text:
Even after this incident, Jeroboam did not turn back from his evil
way, but kept on appointing priests for the shrines from the ranks
of the people. He ordained as priests of the shrines any who so
desired.

translation.text: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.

verses.english:
Even after this incident, Jeroboam did not turn back from his evil
way, but kept on appointing priests for the shrines from the ranks
of the people. He ordained as priests of the shrines any who so
desired.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְחַטַּאת בֵּית יָרבְעָם וּלְהַכְחִיד וּלְהַשְׁמִיד מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְחַטַּאת בֵּית יָרבְעָם וּלְהַכְחִיד וּלְהַשְׁמִיד מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
Thereby the House of Jeroboam incurred guilt—to their utter
annihilation from the face of the earth.

translation.text: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.

verses.english:
Thereby the House of Jeroboam incurred guilt—to their utter
annihilation from the face of the earth.

verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא חָלָה אֲבִיָּה בֶן־יָרבְעָם׃

hebrew.text: בָּעֵת הַהִיא חָלָה אֲבִיָּה בֶן־יָרבְעָם׃

english.text: At that time, Abijah, a son of Jeroboam, fell sick.

translation.text: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.

verses.english: At that time, Abijah, a son of Jeroboam, fell sick.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יָרבְעָם לְאִשְׁתּוֹ קוּמִי נָא וְהִשְׁתַּנִּית וְלֹא יֵדְעוּ כִּי־[אַתְּ] (אתי) אֵשֶׁת יָרבְעָם וְהָלַכְתְּ שִׁלֹה הִנֵּה־שָׁם אֲחִיָּה הַנָּבִיא הוּא־דִבֶּר עָלַי
לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־הָעָם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יָרבְעָם לְאִשְׁתּוֹ קוּמִי נָא וְהִשְׁתַּנִּית וְלֹא יֵדְעוּ כִּי־[אַתְּ] (אתי) אֵשֶׁת יָרבְעָם וְהָלַכְתְּ שִׁלֹה הִנֵּה־שָׁם אֲחִיָּה הַנָּבִיא הוּא־דִבֶּר עָלַי
לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־הָעָם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Jeroboam said to his wife, “Go and disguise yourself, so that you
will not be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife, and go to Shiloh. The
prophet Ahijah lives there, the one who predicted that I would be
king over this people.

translation.text: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that I should be king over this people.

verses.english:
Jeroboam said to his wife, “Go and disguise yourself, so that you
will not be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife, and go to Shiloh. The
prophet Ahijah lives there, the one who predicted that I would be
king over this people.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחַתְּ בְּיָדֵךְ עֲשָׂרָה לֶחֶם וְנִקֻּדִים וּבַקְבֻּק דְּבַשׁ וּבָאת אֵלָיו הוּא יַגִּיד לָךְ מַה־יִּהְיֶה לַנָּעַר׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַחַתְּ בְּיָדֵךְ עֲשָׂרָה לֶחֶם וְנִקֻּדִים וּבַקְבֻּק דְּבַשׁ וּבָאת אֵלָיו הוּא יַגִּיד לָךְ מַה־יִּהְיֶה לַנָּעַר׃

english.text:
Take with you ten loaves, some wafers, and a jug of honey, and go
to him; he will tell you what will happen to the boy.”

translation.text: And take with thee ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child.

verses.english:
Take with you ten loaves, some wafers, and a jug of honey, and go
to him; he will tell you what will happen to the boy.”

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעַשׂ כֵּן אֵשֶׁת יָרבְעָם וַתָּקם וַתֵּלֶךְ שִׁלֹה וַתָּבֹא בֵּית אֲחִיָּה וַאֲחִיָּהוּ לֹא־יָכֹל לִרְאוֹת כִּי קָמוּ עֵינָיו מִשֵּׂיבוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעַשׂ כֵּן אֵשֶׁת יָרבְעָם וַתָּקם וַתֵּלֶךְ שִׁלֹה וַתָּבֹא בֵּית אֲחִיָּה וַאֲחִיָּהוּ לֹא־יָכֹל לִרְאוֹת כִּי קָמוּ עֵינָיו מִשֵּׂיבוֹ׃

translation.text: And Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

verses.hebrew:
וַיהֹוָה אָמַר אֶל־אֲחִיָּהוּ הִנֵּה אֵשֶׁת יָרבְעָם בָּאָה לִדְרֹשׁ דָּבָר מֵעִמְּךָ אֶל־בְּנָהּ כִּי־חֹלֶה הוּא כָּזֹה וְכָזֶה תְּדַבֵּר אֵלֶיהָ וִיהִי כְבֹאָהּ וְהִיא
מִתְנַכֵּרָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיהֹוָה אָמַר אֶל־אֲחִיָּהוּ הִנֵּה אֵשֶׁת יָרבְעָם בָּאָה לִדְרֹשׁ דָּבָר מֵעִמְּךָ אֶל־בְּנָהּ כִּי־חֹלֶה הוּא כָּזֹה וְכָזֶה תְּדַבֵּר אֵלֶיהָ וִיהִי כְבֹאָהּ וְהִיא
מִתְנַכֵּרָה׃

english.text:
but YHWH had said to Ahijah, “Jeroboam’s wife is coming to inquire
of you concerning her son, who is sick. Speak to her thus and
thus. When she arrives, she will be in disguise.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her: for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall feign herself to be another woman.

verses.english:
but YHWH had said to Ahijah, “Jeroboam’s wife is coming to inquire
of you concerning her son, who is sick. Speak to her thus and
thus. When she arrives, she will be in disguise.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ אֲחִיָּהוּ אֶת־קוֹל רַגְלֶיהָ בָּאָה בַפֶּתַח וַיֹּאמֶר בֹּאִי אֵשֶׁת יָרבְעָם לָמָּה זֶּה אַתְּ מִתְנַכֵּרָה וְאָנֹכִי שָׁלוּחַ אֵלַיִךְ קָשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ אֲחִיָּהוּ אֶת־קוֹל רַגְלֶיהָ בָּאָה בַפֶּתַח וַיֹּאמֶר בֹּאִי אֵשֶׁת יָרבְעָם לָמָּה זֶּה אַתְּ מִתְנַכֵּרָה וְאָנֹכִי שָׁלוּחַ אֵלַיִךְ קָשָׁה׃

english.text:
Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came through the door,
and he said, “Come in, wife of Jeroboam. Why are you disguised? I
have a harsh message for you.

translation.text: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself to be another? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings.

verses.english:
Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came through the door,
and he said, “Come in, wife of Jeroboam. Why are you disguised? I
have a harsh message for you.

verses.hebrew: לְכִי אִמְרִי לְיָרבְעָם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הֲרִמֹתִיךָ מִתּוֹךְ הָעָם וָאֶתֶּנְךָ נָגִיד עַל עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: לְכִי אִמְרִי לְיָרבְעָם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הֲרִמֹתִיךָ מִתּוֹךְ הָעָם וָאֶתֶּנְךָ נָגִיד עַל עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

translation.text: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,

verses.hebrew:
וָאֶקְרַע אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה מִבֵּית דָּוִד וָאֶתְּנֶהָ לָךְ וְלֹא־הָיִיתָ כְּעַבְדִּי דָוִד אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַר מִצְוֺתַי וַאֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ אַחֲרַי בְּכל־לְבָבוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת רַק הַיָּשָׁר
בְּעֵינָי׃

hebrew.text:
וָאֶקְרַע אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה מִבֵּית דָּוִד וָאֶתְּנֶהָ לָךְ וְלֹא־הָיִיתָ כְּעַבְדִּי דָוִד אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַר מִצְוֺתַי וַאֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ אַחֲרַי בְּכל־לְבָבוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת רַק הַיָּשָׁר
בְּעֵינָי׃

english.text:
I tore away the kingdom from the House of David and gave it to
you. But you have not been like My servant David, who kept My
commandments and followed Me with all his heart, doing only what
was right in My sight.

translation.text: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes;

verses.english:
I tore away the kingdom from the House of David and gave it to
you. But you have not been like My servant David, who kept My
commandments and followed Me with all his heart, doing only what
was right in My sight.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּרַע לַעֲשׂוֹת מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־הָיוּ לְפָנֶיךָ וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתַּעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וּמַסֵּכוֹת לְהַכְעִיסֵנִי וְאֹתִי הִשְׁלַכְתָּ אַחֲרֵי גַוֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּרַע לַעֲשׂוֹת מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־הָיוּ לְפָנֶיךָ וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתַּעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וּמַסֵּכוֹת לְהַכְעִיסֵנִי וְאֹתִי הִשְׁלַכְתָּ אַחֲרֵי גַוֶּךָ׃

translation.text: But hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:

verses.hebrew:
לָכֵן הִנְנִי מֵבִיא רָעָה אֶל־בֵּית יָרבְעָם וְהִכְרַתִּי לְיָרבְעָם מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר עָצוּר וְעָזוּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִעַרְתִּי אַחֲרֵי בֵית־יָרבְעָם כַּאֲשֶׁר יְבַעֵר הַגָּלָל
עַד־תֻּמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
לָכֵן הִנְנִי מֵבִיא רָעָה אֶל־בֵּית יָרבְעָם וְהִכְרַתִּי לְיָרבְעָם מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר עָצוּר וְעָזוּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִעַרְתִּי אַחֲרֵי בֵית־יָרבְעָם כַּאֲשֶׁר יְבַעֵר הַגָּלָל
עַד־תֻּמּוֹ׃

english.text:
Therefore I will bring disaster upon the House of Jeroboam and
will cut off from Jeroboam every male, bond and free, in Israel. I
will sweep away the House of Jeroboam utterly, as dung is swept
away.

translation.text: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.

verses.english:
Therefore I will bring disaster upon the House of Jeroboam and
will cut off from Jeroboam every male, bond and free, in Israel. I
will sweep away the House of Jeroboam utterly, as dung is swept
away.

verses.hebrew: הַמֵּת לְיָרבְעָם בָּעִיר יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים וְהַמֵּת בַּשָּׂדֶה יֹאכְלוּ עוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם כִּי יְהֹוָה דִּבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: הַמֵּת לְיָרבְעָם בָּעִיר יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים וְהַמֵּת בַּשָּׂדֶה יֹאכְלוּ עוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם כִּי יְהֹוָה דִּבֵּר׃

english.text:
Anyone belonging to Jeroboam who dies in the town shall be
devoured by dogs; and anyone who dies in the open country shall be
eaten by the birds of the air; for YHWH has spoken.

translation.text: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the LORD hath spoken it.

verses.english:
Anyone belonging to Jeroboam who dies in the town shall be
devoured by dogs; and anyone who dies in the open country shall be
eaten by the birds of the air; for YHWH has spoken.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתְּ קוּמִי לְכִי לְבֵיתֵךְ בְּבֹאָה רַגְלַיִךְ הָעִירָה וּמֵת הַיָּלֶד׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתְּ קוּמִי לְכִי לְבֵיתֵךְ בְּבֹאָה רַגְלַיִךְ הָעִירָה וּמֵת הַיָּלֶד׃

english.text:
As for you, go back home; as soon as you set foot in the town, the
child will die.

translation.text: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house: and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.

verses.english:
As for you, go back home; as soon as you set foot in the town, the
child will die.

verses.hebrew: וְסָפְדוּ־לוֹ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְקָבְרוּ אֹתוֹ כִּי־זֶה לְבַדּוֹ יָבֹא לְיָרבְעָם אֶל־קָבֶר יַעַן נִמְצָא־בוֹ דָּבָר טוֹב אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּבֵית יָרבְעָם׃

hebrew.text: וְסָפְדוּ־לוֹ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְקָבְרוּ אֹתוֹ כִּי־זֶה לְבַדּוֹ יָבֹא לְיָרבְעָם אֶל־קָבֶר יַעַן נִמְצָא־בוֹ דָּבָר טוֹב אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּבֵית יָרבְעָם׃

english.text:
And all Israel shall lament over him and bury him; he alone of
Jeroboam’s family shall be brought to burial, for in him alone of
the House of Jeroboam has some devotion been found to YHWH, the
God of Israel.

translation.text: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.

verses.english:
And all Israel shall lament over him and bury him; he alone of
Jeroboam’s family shall be brought to burial, for in him alone of
the House of Jeroboam has some devotion been found to YHWH, the
God of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵקִים יְהֹוָה לוֹ מֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יַכְרִית אֶת־בֵּית יָרבְעָם זֶה הַיּוֹם וּמֶה גַּם־עָתָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהֵקִים יְהֹוָה לוֹ מֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יַכְרִית אֶת־בֵּית יָרבְעָם זֶה הַיּוֹם וּמֶה גַּם־עָתָּה׃

english.text:
Moreover, YHWH will raise up a king over Israel who will destroy
the House of Jeroboam, this day and even now.

translation.text: Moreover the LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.

verses.english:
Moreover, YHWH will raise up a king over Israel who will destroy
the House of Jeroboam, this day and even now.

verses.hebrew:
וְהִכָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר יָנוּד הַקָּנֶה בַּמַּיִם וְנָתַשׁ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לַאֲבוֹתֵיהֶם וְזֵרָם מֵעֵבֶר לַנָּהָר
יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֶת־אֲשֵׁרֵיהֶם מַכְעִיסִים אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִכָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר יָנוּד הַקָּנֶה בַּמַּיִם וְנָתַשׁ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל הָאֲדָמָה הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לַאֲבוֹתֵיהֶם וְזֵרָם מֵעֵבֶר לַנָּהָר
יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֶת־אֲשֵׁרֵיהֶם מַכְעִיסִים אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“YHWH will strike Israel until it sways like a reed in water. He
will uproot Israel from this good land that He gave to their
fathers, and will scatter them beyond the Euphrates, because they
have provoked YHWH by the sacred posts that they have made for
themselves.

translation.text: For the LORD shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the LORD to anger.

verses.english:
“YHWH will strike Israel until it sways like a reed in water. He
will uproot Israel from this good land that He gave to their
fathers, and will scatter them beyond the Euphrates, because they
have provoked YHWH by the sacred posts that they have made for
themselves.

verses.hebrew: וְיִתֵּן אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּגְלַל חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וַאֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיִתֵּן אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּגְלַל חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וַאֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
He will forsake Israel because of the sins that Jeroboam committed
and led Israel to commit.”

translation.text: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.

verses.english:
He will forsake Israel because of the sins that Jeroboam committed
and led Israel to commit.”

verses.hebrew: וַתָּקם אֵשֶׁת יָרבְעָם וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתָּבֹא תִרְצָתָה הִיא בָּאָה בְסַף־הַבַּיִת וְהַנַּעַר מֵת׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּקם אֵשֶׁת יָרבְעָם וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתָּבֹא תִרְצָתָה הִיא בָּאָה בְסַף־הַבַּיִת וְהַנַּעַר מֵת׃

english.text:
Jeroboam’s wife got up and left, and she went to Tirzah. As soon
as she stepped over the threshold of her house, the child died.

translation.text: And Jeroboam’s wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;

verses.english:
Jeroboam’s wife got up and left, and she went to Tirzah. As soon
as she stepped over the threshold of her house, the child died.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ וַיִּסְפְּדוּ־לוֹ כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד־עַבְדּוֹ אֲחִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ וַיִּסְפְּדוּ־לוֹ כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד־עַבְדּוֹ אֲחִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא׃

english.text:
They buried him and all Israel lamented over him, in accordance
with the word that YHWH had spoken through His servant the prophet
Ahijah.

translation.text: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.

verses.english:
They buried him and all Israel lamented over him, in accordance
with the word that YHWH had spoken through His servant the prophet
Ahijah.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם וַאֲשֶׁר מָלָךְ הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם וַאֲשֶׁר מָלָךְ הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Jeroboam’s reign, how he fought and how he
ruled, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.english:
The other events of Jeroboam’s reign, how he fought and how he
ruled, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ יָרבְעָם עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ נָדָב בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ יָרבְעָם עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ נָדָב בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Jeroboam reigned twenty-two years; then he slept with his fathers,
and his son Nadab succeeded him as king.

translation.text: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Jeroboam reigned twenty-two years; then he slept with his fathers,
and his son Nadab succeeded him as king.

verses.hebrew:
וּרְחַבְעָם בֶּן־שְׁלֹמֹה מָלַךְ בִּיהוּדָה בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה רְחַבְעָם בְּמלְכוֹ וּשְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־בָּחַר יְהֹוָה לָשׂוּם
אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שָׁם מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ נַעֲמָה הָעַמֹּנִית׃

hebrew.text:
וּרְחַבְעָם בֶּן־שְׁלֹמֹה מָלַךְ בִּיהוּדָה בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה רְחַבְעָם בְּמלְכוֹ וּשְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־בָּחַר יְהֹוָה לָשׂוּם
אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שָׁם מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ נַעֲמָה הָעַמֹּנִית׃

english.text:
Meanwhile, Rehoboam son of Solomon had become king in Judah.
Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he became king, and he
reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem—the city YHWH had chosen out
of all the tribes of Israel to establish His name there. His
mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

translation.text: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD did choose out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

verses.english:
Meanwhile, Rehoboam son of Solomon had become king in Judah.
Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he became king, and he
reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem—the city YHWH had chosen out
of all the tribes of Israel to establish His name there. His
mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוּדָה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְקַנְאוּ אֹתוֹ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָם בְּחַטֹּאתָם אֲשֶׁר חָטָאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוּדָה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיְקַנְאוּ אֹתוֹ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָם בְּחַטֹּאתָם אֲשֶׁר חָטָאוּ׃

english.text:
Judah did what was displeasing to YHWH, and angered Him more than
their fathers had done by the sins that they committed.

translation.text: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.

verses.english:
Judah did what was displeasing to YHWH, and angered Him more than
their fathers had done by the sins that they committed.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְנוּ גַם־הֵמָּה לָהֶם בָּמוֹת וּמַצֵּבוֹת וַאֲשֵׁרִים עַל כּל־גִּבְעָה גְבֹהָה וְתַחַת כּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְנוּ גַם־הֵמָּה לָהֶם בָּמוֹת וּמַצֵּבוֹת וַאֲשֵׁרִים עַל כּל־גִּבְעָה גְבֹהָה וְתַחַת כּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן׃

english.text:
They too built for themselves shrines, pillars, and sacred posts
on every high hill and under every leafy tree;

translation.text: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.

verses.english:
They too built for themselves shrines, pillars, and sacred posts
on every high hill and under every leafy tree;

verses.hebrew: וְגַם־קָדֵשׁ הָיָה בָאָרֶץ עָשׂוּ כְּכֹל הַתּוֹעֲבֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם־קָדֵשׁ הָיָה בָאָרֶץ עָשׂוּ כְּכֹל הַתּוֹעֲבֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
there were also male prostitutes in the land. [Judah] imitated all
the abhorrent practices of the nations that YHWH had dispossessed
before the Israelites.

translation.text: And there were also sodomites in the land: and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

verses.english:
there were also male prostitutes in the land. [Judah] imitated all
the abhorrent practices of the nations that YHWH had dispossessed
before the Israelites.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּשָּׁנָה הַחֲמִישִׁית לַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם עָלָה (שושק) [שִׁישַׁק] מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּשָּׁנָה הַחֲמִישִׁית לַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם עָלָה (שושק) [שִׁישַׁק] מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, King Shishak of Egypt marched
against Jerusalem

translation.text: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:

verses.english:
In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, King Shishak of Egypt marched
against Jerusalem

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־אֹצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־אוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־הַכֹּל לָקָח וַיִּקַּח אֶת־כּל־מָגִנֵּי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה שְׁלֹמֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־אֹצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־אוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־הַכֹּל לָקָח וַיִּקַּח אֶת־כּל־מָגִנֵּי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה שְׁלֹמֹה׃

english.text:
and carried off the treasures of the House of YHWH and the
treasures of the royal palace. He carried off everything; he even
carried off all the golden shields that Solomon had made.

translation.text: And he took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king’s house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

verses.english:
and carried off the treasures of the House of YHWH and the
treasures of the royal palace. He carried off everything; he even
carried off all the golden shields that Solomon had made.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם תַּחְתָּם מָגִנֵּי נְחֹשֶׁת וְהִפְקִיד עַל־יַד שָׂרֵי הָרָצִים הַשֹּׁמְרִים פֶּתַח בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם תַּחְתָּם מָגִנֵּי נְחֹשֶׁת וְהִפְקִיד עַל־יַד שָׂרֵי הָרָצִים הַשֹּׁמְרִים פֶּתַח בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
King Rehoboam had bronze shields made instead, and he entrusted
them to the officers of the guard who guarded the entrance to the
royal palace.

translation.text: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king’s house.

verses.english:
King Rehoboam had bronze shields made instead, and he entrusted
them to the officers of the guard who guarded the entrance to the
royal palace.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִדֵּי־בֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ בֵּית יְהֹוָה יִשָּׂאוּם הָרָצִים וֶהֱשִׁיבוּם אֶל־תָּא הָרָצִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִדֵּי־בֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ בֵּית יְהֹוָה יִשָּׂאוּם הָרָצִים וֶהֱשִׁיבוּם אֶל־תָּא הָרָצִים׃

english.text:
Whenever the king went into the House of YHWH, the guards would
carry them and then bring them back to the armory of the guards.

translation.text: And it was so, when the king went into the house of the LORD, that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.

verses.english:
Whenever the king went into the House of YHWH, the guards would
carry them and then bring them back to the armory of the guards.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי רְחַבְעָם וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵמָּה כְתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי רְחַבְעָם וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵמָּה כְתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Rehoboam’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.english:
The other events of Rehoboam’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

verses.hebrew: וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵין־רְחַבְעָם וּבֵין יָרבְעָם כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵין־רְחַבְעָם וּבֵין יָרבְעָם כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

english.text: There was continual war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.

translation.text: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.

verses.english: There was continual war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב רְחַבְעָם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ נַעֲמָה הָעַמֹּנִית וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֲבִיָּם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב רְחַבְעָם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ נַעֲמָה הָעַמֹּנִית וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֲבִיָּם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Rehoboam slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in
the City of David; his mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
His son Abijam succeeded him as king.

translation.text: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Rehoboam slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in
the City of David; his mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
His son Abijam succeeded him as king.

verses.hebrew: וּבִשְׁנַת שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה לַמֶּלֶךְ יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט מָלַךְ אֲבִיָּם עַל־יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבִשְׁנַת שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה לַמֶּלֶךְ יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט מָלַךְ אֲבִיָּם עַל־יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam son of Nebat, Abijam
became king over Judah.

translation.text: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.

verses.english:
In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam son of Nebat, Abijam
became king over Judah.

verses.hebrew: שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ מַעֲכָה בַּת־אֲבִישָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ מַעֲכָה בַּת־אֲבִישָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
He reigned three years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Maacah
daughter of Abishalom.

translation.text: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. and his mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

verses.english:
He reigned three years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Maacah
daughter of Abishalom.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכל־חַטֹּאות אָבִיו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְפָנָיו וְלֹא־הָיָה לְבָבוֹ שָׁלֵם עִם־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו כִּלְבַב דָּוִד אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכל־חַטֹּאות אָבִיו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לְפָנָיו וְלֹא־הָיָה לְבָבוֹ שָׁלֵם עִם־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו כִּלְבַב דָּוִד אָבִיו׃

english.text:
He continued in all the sins that his father before him had
committed; he was not wholehearted with YHWH his God, like his
father David.

translation.text: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.

verses.english:
He continued in all the sins that his father before him had
committed; he was not wholehearted with YHWH his God, like his
father David.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לְמַעַן דָּוִד נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו לוֹ נִיר בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם לְהָקִים אֶת־בְּנוֹ אַחֲרָיו וּלְהַעֲמִיד אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לְמַעַן דָּוִד נָתַן יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו לוֹ נִיר בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם לְהָקִים אֶת־בְּנוֹ אַחֲרָיו וּלְהַעֲמִיד אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
Yet, for the sake of David, YHWH his God gave him a lamp in
Jerusalem, by raising up his descendant after him and by
preserving Jerusalem.

translation.text: Nevertheless for David’s sake did the LORD his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:

verses.english:
Yet, for the sake of David, YHWH his God gave him a lamp in
Jerusalem, by raising up his descendant after him and by
preserving Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה דָוִד אֶת־הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא־סָר מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּהוּ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיָּיו רַק בִּדְבַר אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי׃

hebrew.text: אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה דָוִד אֶת־הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וְלֹא־סָר מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּהוּ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיָּיו רַק בִּדְבַר אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי׃

english.text:
For David had done what was pleasing to YHWH and never turned
throughout his life from all that He had commanded him, except in
the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

translation.text: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

verses.english:
For David had done what was pleasing to YHWH and never turned
throughout his life from all that He had commanded him, except in
the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

verses.hebrew: וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵין־רְחַבְעָם וּבֵין יָרבְעָם כּל־יְמֵי חַיָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵין־רְחַבְעָם וּבֵין יָרבְעָם כּל־יְמֵי חַיָּיו׃

english.text:
There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam all the days of his
life.

translation.text: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

verses.english:
There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam all the days of his
life.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֲבִיָּם וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵּין אֲבִיָּם וּבֵין יָרבְעָם׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֲבִיָּם וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵּין אֲבִיָּם וּבֵין יָרבְעָם׃

english.text:
The other events of Abijam’s reign and all his actions are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah; there was war
between Abijam and Jeroboam.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

verses.english:
The other events of Abijam’s reign and all his actions are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah; there was war
between Abijam and Jeroboam.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֲבִיָּם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ אָסָא בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֲבִיָּם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ אָסָא בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Abijam slept with his fathers; he was buried in the City of David,
and his son Asa succeeded him as king.

translation.text: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Abijam slept with his fathers; he was buried in the City of David,
and his son Asa succeeded him as king.

verses.hebrew: וּבִשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים לְיָרבְעָם מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ אָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבִשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים לְיָרבְעָם מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ אָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
In the twentieth year of King Jeroboam of Israel, Asa became king
over Judah.

translation.text: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.

verses.english:
In the twentieth year of King Jeroboam of Israel, Asa became king
over Judah.

verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעִים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ מַעֲכָה בַּת־אֲבִישָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַרְבָּעִים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ מַעֲכָה בַּת־אֲבִישָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
He reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was
Maacah daughter of Abishalom.

translation.text: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

verses.english:
He reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was
Maacah daughter of Abishalom.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אָסָא הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּדָוִד אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אָסָא הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּדָוִד אָבִיו׃

english.text: Asa did what was pleasing to YHWH, as his father David had done.

translation.text: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, as did David his father.

verses.english: Asa did what was pleasing to YHWH, as his father David had done.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֵר הַקְּדֵשִׁים מִן־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּסַר אֶת־כּל־הַגִּלֻּלִים אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֵר הַקְּדֵשִׁים מִן־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּסַר אֶת־כּל־הַגִּלֻּלִים אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָיו׃

english.text:
He expelled the male prostitutes from the land, and he removed all
the idols that his ancestors had made.

translation.text: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

verses.english:
He expelled the male prostitutes from the land, and he removed all
the idols that his ancestors had made.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֶת־מַעֲכָה אִמּוֹ וַיְסִרֶהָ מִגְּבִירָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשְׂתָה מִפְלֶצֶת לָאֲשֵׁרָה וַיִּכְרֹת אָסָא אֶת־מִפְלַצְתָּהּ וַיִּשְׂרֹף בְּנַחַל קִדְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם אֶת־מַעֲכָה אִמּוֹ וַיְסִרֶהָ מִגְּבִירָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשְׂתָה מִפְלֶצֶת לָאֲשֵׁרָה וַיִּכְרֹת אָסָא אֶת־מִפְלַצְתָּהּ וַיִּשְׂרֹף בְּנַחַל קִדְרוֹן׃

english.text:
He also deposed his mother Maacah from the rank of queen mother,
because she had made an abominable thing for [the goddess]
Asherah. Asa cut down her abominable thing and burnt it in the
Wadi Kidron.

translation.text: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.

verses.english:
He also deposed his mother Maacah from the rank of queen mother,
because she had made an abominable thing for [the goddess]
Asherah. Asa cut down her abominable thing and burnt it in the
Wadi Kidron.

verses.hebrew: וְהַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ רַק לְבַב־אָסָא הָיָה שָׁלֵם עִם־יְהֹוָה כּל־יָמָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ רַק לְבַב־אָסָא הָיָה שָׁלֵם עִם־יְהֹוָה כּל־יָמָיו׃

english.text:
The shrines, indeed, were not abolished; however, Asa was
wholehearted with YHWH his God all his life.

translation.text: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa’s heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.

verses.english:
The shrines, indeed, were not abolished; however, Asa was
wholehearted with YHWH his God all his life.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֵא אֶת־קדְשֵׁי אָבִיו (וקדשו) [וְקדְשֵׁי] בֵּית יְהֹוָה כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וְכֵלִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֵא אֶת־קדְשֵׁי אָבִיו (וקדשו) [וְקדְשֵׁי] בֵּית יְהֹוָה כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וְכֵלִים׃

english.text:
He brought into the House of YHWH all the consecrated things of
his father and his own consecrated things —silver, gold, and
utensils.

translation.text: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD, silver, and gold, and vessels.

verses.english:
He brought into the House of YHWH all the consecrated things of
his father and his own consecrated things —silver, gold, and
utensils.

verses.hebrew: וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵּין אָסָא וּבֵין בַּעְשָׁא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל־יְמֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵּין אָסָא וּבֵין בַּעְשָׁא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל־יְמֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
There was war between Asa and King Baasha of Israel all their
days.

translation.text: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

verses.english:
There was war between Asa and King Baasha of Israel all their
days.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל בַּעְשָׁא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־יְהוּדָה וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הָרָמָה לְבִלְתִּי תֵּת יֹצֵא וָבָא לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל בַּעְשָׁא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־יְהוּדָה וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הָרָמָה לְבִלְתִּי תֵּת יֹצֵא וָבָא לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
King Baasha of Israel advanced against Judah, and he fortified
Ramah to prevent anyone belonging to King Asa from going out or
coming in.

translation.text: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

verses.english:
King Baasha of Israel advanced against Judah, and he fortified
Ramah to prevent anyone belonging to King Asa from going out or
coming in.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח אָסָא אֶת־כּל־הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב הַנּוֹתָרִים בְּאוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־אוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית (מלך) [הַמֶּלֶךְ] וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־עֲבָדָיו וַיִּשְׁלָחֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ
אָסָא אֶל־בֶּן־הֲדַד בֶּן־טַבְרִמֹּן בֶּן־חֶזְיוֹן מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם הַיֹּשֵׁב בְּדַמֶּשֶׂק לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח אָסָא אֶת־כּל־הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב הַנּוֹתָרִים בְּאוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־אוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית (מלך) [הַמֶּלֶךְ] וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־עֲבָדָיו וַיִּשְׁלָחֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ
אָסָא אֶל־בֶּן־הֲדַד בֶּן־טַבְרִמֹּן בֶּן־חֶזְיוֹן מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם הַיֹּשֵׁב בְּדַמֶּשֶׂק לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
So Asa took all the silver and gold that remained in the
treasuries of the House of YHWH as well as the treasuries of the
royal palace, and he entrusted them to his officials. King Asa
sent them to King Ben-hadad son of Tabrimmon son of Hezion of
Aram, who resided in Damascus, with this message:

translation.text: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Benhadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

verses.english:
So Asa took all the silver and gold that remained in the
treasuries of the House of YHWH as well as the treasuries of the
royal palace, and he entrusted them to his officials. King Asa
sent them to King Ben-hadad son of Tabrimmon son of Hezion of
Aram, who resided in Damascus, with this message:

verses.hebrew: בְּרִית בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ בֵּין אָבִי וּבֵין אָבִיךָ הִנֵּה שָׁלַחְתִּי לְךָ שֹׁחַד כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב לֵךְ הָפֵרָה אֶת־בְּרִיתְךָ אֶת־בַּעְשָׁא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיַעֲלֶה מֵעָלָי׃

hebrew.text: בְּרִית בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ בֵּין אָבִי וּבֵין אָבִיךָ הִנֵּה שָׁלַחְתִּי לְךָ שֹׁחַד כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב לֵךְ הָפֵרָה אֶת־בְּרִיתְךָ אֶת־בַּעְשָׁא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיַעֲלֶה מֵעָלָי׃

english.text:
“There is a pact between you and me, and between your father and
my father. I herewith send you a gift of silver and gold: Go and
break your pact with King Baasha of Israel, so that he may
withdraw from me.”

translation.text: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

verses.english:
“There is a pact between you and me, and between your father and
my father. I herewith send you a gift of silver and gold: Go and
break your pact with King Baasha of Israel, so that he may
withdraw from me.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁמַע בֶּן־הֲדַד אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אָסָא וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת־שָׂרֵי הַחֲיָלִים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ עַל־עָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּךְ אֶת־עִיּוֹן וְאֶת־דָּן וְאֵת אָבֵל בֵּית־מַעֲכָה וְאֵת
כּל־כִּנְרוֹת עַל כּל־אֶרֶץ נַפְתָּלִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁמַע בֶּן־הֲדַד אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אָסָא וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת־שָׂרֵי הַחֲיָלִים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ עַל־עָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּךְ אֶת־עִיּוֹן וְאֶת־דָּן וְאֵת אָבֵל בֵּית־מַעֲכָה וְאֵת
כּל־כִּנְרוֹת עַל כּל־אֶרֶץ נַפְתָּלִי׃

english.text:
Ben-hadad responded to King Asa’s request; he sent his army
commanders against the towns of Israel and captured Ijon, Dan,
Abel-beth-maacah, and all Chinneroth, as well as all the land of
Naphtali.

translation.text: So Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelbethmaachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

verses.english:
Ben-hadad responded to King Asa’s request; he sent his army
commanders against the towns of Israel and captured Ijon, Dan,
Abel-beth-maacah, and all Chinneroth, as well as all the land of
Naphtali.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ בַּעְשָׁא וַיֶּחְדַּל מִבְּנוֹת אֶת־הָרָמָה וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּתִרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ בַּעְשָׁא וַיֶּחְדַּל מִבְּנוֹת אֶת־הָרָמָה וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּתִרְצָה׃

english.text:
When Baasha heard about it, he stopped fortifying Ramah and
remained in Tirzah.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.

verses.english:
When Baasha heard about it, he stopped fortifying Ramah and
remained in Tirzah.

verses.hebrew:
וְהַמֶּלֶךְ אָסָא הִשְׁמִיעַ אֶת־כּל־יְהוּדָה אֵין נָקִי וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־אַבְנֵי הָרָמָה וְאֶת־עֵצֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה בַּעְשָׁא וַיִּבֶן בָּם הַמֶּלֶךְ אָסָא אֶת־גֶּבַע בִּנְיָמִן
וְאֶת־הַמִּצְפָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וְהַמֶּלֶךְ אָסָא הִשְׁמִיעַ אֶת־כּל־יְהוּדָה אֵין נָקִי וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־אַבְנֵי הָרָמָה וְאֶת־עֵצֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה בַּעְשָׁא וַיִּבֶן בָּם הַמֶּלֶךְ אָסָא אֶת־גֶּבַע בִּנְיָמִן
וְאֶת־הַמִּצְפָּה׃

english.text:
