Then King Asa mustered all Judah, with no exemptions; and they
carried away the stones and timber with which Baasha had fortified
Ramah. With these King Asa fortified Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

translation.text: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

verses.english:
Then King Asa mustered all Judah, with no exemptions; and they
carried away the stones and timber with which Baasha had fortified
Ramah. With these King Asa fortified Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

verses.hebrew:
וְיֶתֶר כּל־דִּבְרֵי־אָסָא וְכל־גְּבוּרָתוֹ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְהֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה הֲלֹא־הֵמָּה כְתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה רַק לְעֵת זִקְנָתוֹ
חָלָה אֶת־רַגְלָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וְיֶתֶר כּל־דִּבְרֵי־אָסָא וְכל־גְּבוּרָתוֹ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְהֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה הֲלֹא־הֵמָּה כְתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה רַק לְעֵת זִקְנָתוֹ
חָלָה אֶת־רַגְלָיו׃

english.text:
All the other events of Asa’s reign, and all his exploits, and all
his actions, and the towns that he fortified, are recorded in the
Annals of the Kings of Judah. However, in his old age he suffered
from a foot ailment.

translation.text: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

verses.english:
All the other events of Asa’s reign, and all his exploits, and all
his actions, and the towns that he fortified, are recorded in the
Annals of the Kings of Judah. However, in his old age he suffered
from a foot ailment.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אָסָא עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָט בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אָסָא עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָט בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Asa slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the
city of his father David. His son Jehoshaphat succeeded him as
king.

translation.text: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Asa slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the
city of his father David. His son Jehoshaphat succeeded him as
king.

verses.hebrew: וְנָדָב בֶּן־יָרבְעָם מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁנָתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָדָב בֶּן־יָרבְעָם מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁנָתָיִם׃

english.text:
Nadab son of Jeroboam had become king over Israel in the second
year of King Asa of Judah, and he reigned over Israel for two
years.

translation.text: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.

verses.english:
Nadab son of Jeroboam had become king over Israel in the second
year of King Asa of Judah, and he reigned over Israel for two
years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אָבִיו וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אָבִיו וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; he continued in the ways of
his father, in the sins which he caused Israel to commit.

translation.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; he continued in the ways of
his father, in the sins which he caused Israel to commit.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו בַּעְשָׁא בֶן־אֲחִיָּה לְבֵית יִשָּׂשכָר וַיַּכֵּהוּ בַעְשָׁא בְּגִבְּתוֹן אֲשֶׁר לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים וְנָדָב וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל צָרִים עַל־גִּבְּתוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו בַּעְשָׁא בֶן־אֲחִיָּה לְבֵית יִשָּׂשכָר וַיַּכֵּהוּ בַעְשָׁא בְּגִבְּתוֹן אֲשֶׁר לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים וְנָדָב וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל צָרִים עַל־גִּבְּתוֹן׃

english.text:
Then Baasha son of Ahijah, of the House of Issachar, conspired
against him; and Baasha struck him down at Gibbethon of the
Philistines, while Nadab and all Israel were laying siege to
Gibbethon.

translation.text: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.

verses.english:
Then Baasha son of Ahijah, of the House of Issachar, conspired
against him; and Baasha struck him down at Gibbethon of the
Philistines, while Nadab and all Israel were laying siege to
Gibbethon.

verses.hebrew: וַיְמִתֵהוּ בַעְשָׁא בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלֹשׁ לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמִתֵהוּ בַעְשָׁא בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלֹשׁ לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Baasha killed him in the third year of King Asa of Judah and
became king in his stead.

translation.text: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Baasha killed him in the third year of King Asa of Judah and
became king in his stead.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְמלְכוֹ הִכָּה אֶת־כּל־בֵּית יָרבְעָם לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר כּל־נְשָׁמָה לְיָרבְעָם עַד־הִשְׁמִדוֹ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד־עַבְדּוֹ אֲחִיָּה הַשִּׁילֹנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְמלְכוֹ הִכָּה אֶת־כּל־בֵּית יָרבְעָם לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר כּל־נְשָׁמָה לְיָרבְעָם עַד־הִשְׁמִדוֹ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד־עַבְדּוֹ אֲחִיָּה הַשִּׁילֹנִי׃

english.text:
As soon as he became king, he struck down all the House of
Jeroboam; he did not spare a single soul belonging to Jeroboam
until he destroyed it—in accordance with the word that YHWH had
spoken through His servant Ahijah the Shilonite—

translation.text: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:

verses.english:
As soon as he became king, he struck down all the House of
Jeroboam; he did not spare a single soul belonging to Jeroboam
until he destroyed it—in accordance with the word that YHWH had
spoken through His servant Ahijah the Shilonite—

verses.hebrew: עַל־חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וַאֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכַעְסוֹ אֲשֶׁר הִכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: עַל־חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וַאֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכַעְסוֹ אֲשֶׁר הִכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
because of the sins which Jeroboam committed and which he caused
Israel to commit, thereby vexing YHWH, the God of Israel.

translation.text: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger.

verses.english:
because of the sins which Jeroboam committed and which he caused
Israel to commit, thereby vexing YHWH, the God of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי נָדָב וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי נָדָב וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Nadab’s reign and all his actions are recorded
in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.english:
The other events of Nadab’s reign and all his actions are recorded
in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵּין אָסָא וּבֵין בַּעְשָׁא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל־יְמֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵּין אָסָא וּבֵין בַּעְשָׁא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל־יְמֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
There was war between Asa and King Baasha of Israel all their
days.

translation.text: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

verses.english:
There was war between Asa and King Baasha of Israel all their
days.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלֹשׁ לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ בַּעְשָׁא בֶן־אֲחִיָּה עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתִרְצָה עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלֹשׁ לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ בַּעְשָׁא בֶן־אֲחִיָּה עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתִרְצָה עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
In the third year of King Asa of Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah
became king in Tirzah over all Israel—for twenty-four years.

translation.text: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.

verses.english:
In the third year of King Asa of Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah
became king in Tirzah over all Israel—for twenty-four years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ יָרבְעָם וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ יָרבְעָם וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; he followed the ways of
Jeroboam and the sins which he caused Israel to commit.

translation.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; he followed the ways of
Jeroboam and the sins which he caused Israel to commit.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־יֵהוּא בֶן־חֲנָנִי עַל־בַּעְשָׁא לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־יֵהוּא בֶן־חֲנָנִי עַל־בַּעְשָׁא לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: The word of YHWH came to Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha:

translation.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

verses.english: The word of YHWH came to Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha:

verses.hebrew: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הֲרִימֹתִיךָ מִן־הֶעָפָר וָאֶתֶּנְךָ נָגִיד עַל עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ יָרבְעָם וַתַּחֲטִא אֶת־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיסֵנִי בְּחַטֹּאתָם׃

hebrew.text: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הֲרִימֹתִיךָ מִן־הֶעָפָר וָאֶתֶּנְךָ נָגִיד עַל עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ יָרבְעָם וַתַּחֲטִא אֶת־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיסֵנִי בְּחַטֹּאתָם׃

english.text:
“Because I lifted you up from the dust and made you a ruler over
My people Israel, but you followed the way of Jeroboam and caused
My people Israel to sin, vexing Me with their sins—

translation.text: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;

verses.english:
“Because I lifted you up from the dust and made you a ruler over
My people Israel, but you followed the way of Jeroboam and caused
My people Israel to sin, vexing Me with their sins—

verses.hebrew: הִנְנִי מַבְעִיר אַחֲרֵי בַעְשָׁא וְאַחֲרֵי בֵיתוֹ וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־בֵּיתְךָ כְּבֵית יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט׃

hebrew.text: הִנְנִי מַבְעִיר אַחֲרֵי בַעְשָׁא וְאַחֲרֵי בֵיתוֹ וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־בֵּיתְךָ כְּבֵית יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט׃

english.text:
I am going to sweep away Baasha and his house. I will make your
house like the House of Jeroboam son of Nebat.

translation.text: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

verses.english:
I am going to sweep away Baasha and his house. I will make your
house like the House of Jeroboam son of Nebat.

verses.hebrew: הַמֵּת לְבַעְשָׁא בָּעִיר יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים וְהַמֵּת לוֹ בַּשָּׂדֶה יֹאכְלוּ עוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: הַמֵּת לְבַעְשָׁא בָּעִיר יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים וְהַמֵּת לוֹ בַּשָּׂדֶה יֹאכְלוּ עוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
Anyone belonging to Baasha who dies in the town shall be devoured
by dogs, and anyone belonging to him who dies in the open country
shall be devoured by the birds of the sky.”

translation.text: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.

verses.english:
Anyone belonging to Baasha who dies in the town shall be devoured
by dogs, and anyone belonging to him who dies in the open country
shall be devoured by the birds of the sky.”

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי בַעְשָׁא וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי בַעְשָׁא וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Baasha’s reign and his actions and his
exploits are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.english:
The other events of Baasha’s reign and his actions and his
exploits are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּעְשָׁא עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּתִרְצָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֵלָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּעְשָׁא עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּתִרְצָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֵלָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Baasha slept with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah. His son
Elah succeeded him as king.

translation.text: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Baasha slept with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah. His son
Elah succeeded him as king.

verses.hebrew:
וְגַם בְּיַד־יֵהוּא בֶן־חֲנָנִי הַנָּבִיא דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה הָיָה אֶל־בַּעְשָׁא וְאֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וְעַל כּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו
לִהְיוֹת כְּבֵית יָרבְעָם וְעַל אֲשֶׁר־הִכָּה אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וְגַם בְּיַד־יֵהוּא בֶן־חֲנָנִי הַנָּבִיא דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה הָיָה אֶל־בַּעְשָׁא וְאֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וְעַל כּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו
לִהְיוֹת כְּבֵית יָרבְעָם וְעַל אֲשֶׁר־הִכָּה אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
But the word of YHWH had come through the prophet Jehu son of
Hanani against Baasha and against his house, that it would fare
like the House of Jeroboam, which he himself had struck down,
because of all the evil he did which was displeasing to YHWH,
vexing him with his deeds.

translation.text: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the LORD against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD, in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.

verses.english:
But the word of YHWH had come through the prophet Jehu son of
Hanani against Baasha and against his house, that it would fare
like the House of Jeroboam, which he himself had struck down,
because of all the evil he did which was displeasing to YHWH,
vexing him with his deeds.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֵׁשׁ שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ אֵלָה בֶן־בַּעְשָׁא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתִרְצָה שְׁנָתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֵׁשׁ שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ אֵלָה בֶן־בַּעְשָׁא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתִרְצָה שְׁנָתָיִם׃

english.text:
In the twenty-sixth year of King Asa of Judah, Elah son of Baasha
became king over Israel, at Tirzah—for two years.

translation.text: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.

verses.english:
In the twenty-sixth year of King Asa of Judah, Elah son of Baasha
became king over Israel, at Tirzah—for two years.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו עַבְדּוֹ זִמְרִי שַׂר מַחֲצִית הָרָכֶב וְהוּא בְתִרְצָה שֹׁתֶה שִׁכּוֹר בֵּית אַרְצָא אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַבַּיִת בְּתִרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו עַבְדּוֹ זִמְרִי שַׂר מַחֲצִית הָרָכֶב וְהוּא בְתִרְצָה שֹׁתֶה שִׁכּוֹר בֵּית אַרְצָא אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַבַּיִת בְּתִרְצָה׃

english.text:
His officer Zimri, commander of half the chariotry, committed
treason against him while he was at Tirzah drinking himself drunk
in the house of Arza, who was in charge of the palace at Tirzah.

translation.text: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah.

verses.english:
His officer Zimri, commander of half the chariotry, committed
treason against him while he was at Tirzah drinking himself drunk
in the house of Arza, who was in charge of the palace at Tirzah.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא זִמְרִי וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיְמִיתֵהוּ בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא זִמְרִי וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיְמִיתֵהוּ בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Zimri entered, struck him down, and killed him; he succeeded him
as king in the twenty-seventh year of King Asa of Judah.

translation.text: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Zimri entered, struck him down, and killed him; he succeeded him
as king in the twenty-seventh year of King Asa of Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְמלְכוֹ כְּשִׁבְתּוֹ עַל־כִּסְאוֹ הִכָּה אֶת־כּל־בֵּית בַּעְשָׁא לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר לוֹ מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר וְגֹאֲלָיו וְרֵעֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְמלְכוֹ כְּשִׁבְתּוֹ עַל־כִּסְאוֹ הִכָּה אֶת־כּל־בֵּית בַּעְשָׁא לֹא־הִשְׁאִיר לוֹ מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר וְגֹאֲלָיו וְרֵעֵהוּ׃

english.text:
No sooner had he become king and ascended the throne than he
struck down all the House of Baasha; he did not leave a single
male of his, nor any kinsman or friend.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.

verses.english:
No sooner had he become king and ascended the throne than he
struck down all the House of Baasha; he did not leave a single
male of his, nor any kinsman or friend.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁמֵד זִמְרִי אֵת כּל־בֵּית בַּעְשָׁא כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֶל־בַּעְשָׁא בְּיַד יֵהוּא הַנָּבִיא׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁמֵד זִמְרִי אֵת כּל־בֵּית בַּעְשָׁא כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֶל־בַּעְשָׁא בְּיַד יֵהוּא הַנָּבִיא׃

english.text:
Thus Zimri destroyed all the House of Baasha, in accordance with
the word that YHWH had spoken through the prophet Jehu—

translation.text: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet.

verses.english:
Thus Zimri destroyed all the House of Baasha, in accordance with
the word that YHWH had spoken through the prophet Jehu—

verses.hebrew: אֶל כּל־חַטֹּאות בַּעְשָׁא וְחַטֹּאות אֵלָה בְנוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטְאוּ וַאֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיאוּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַבְלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: אֶל כּל־חַטֹּאות בַּעְשָׁא וְחַטֹּאות אֵלָה בְנוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטְאוּ וַאֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיאוּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַבְלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
because of the sinful acts which Baasha and his son Elah
committed, and which they caused Israel to commit, vexing YHWH,
the God of Israel, with their false gods.

translation.text: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

verses.english:
because of the sinful acts which Baasha and his son Elah
committed, and which they caused Israel to commit, vexing YHWH,
the God of Israel, with their false gods.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֵלָה וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֵלָה וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Elah’s reign and all his actions are recorded
in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.english:
The other events of Elah’s reign and all his actions are recorded
in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ זִמְרִי שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בְּתִרְצָה וְהָעָם חֹנִים עַל־גִּבְּתוֹן אֲשֶׁר לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ זִמְרִי שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בְּתִרְצָה וְהָעָם חֹנִים עַל־גִּבְּתוֹן אֲשֶׁר לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים׃

english.text:
During the twenty-seventh year of King Asa of Judah, Zimri reigned
in Tirzah for seven days. At the time, the troops were encamped at
Gibbethon of the Philistines.

translation.text: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

verses.english:
During the twenty-seventh year of King Asa of Judah, Zimri reigned
in Tirzah for seven days. At the time, the troops were encamped at
Gibbethon of the Philistines.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע הָעָם הַחֹנִים לֵאמֹר קָשַׁר זִמְרִי וְגַם הִכָּה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּמְלִכוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־עמְרִי שַׂר־צָבָא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע הָעָם הַחֹנִים לֵאמֹר קָשַׁר זִמְרִי וְגַם הִכָּה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּמְלִכוּ כל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־עמְרִי שַׂר־צָבָא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

english.text:
When the troops who were encamped there learned that Zimri had
committed treason and had struck down the king, that very day, in
the camp, all Israel acclaimed the army commander Omri king over
Israel.

translation.text: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.

verses.english:
When the troops who were encamped there learned that Zimri had
committed treason and had struck down the king, that very day, in
the camp, all Israel acclaimed the army commander Omri king over
Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלֶה עמְרִי וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִגִּבְּתוֹן וַיָּצֻרוּ עַל־תִּרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלֶה עמְרִי וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִגִּבְּתוֹן וַיָּצֻרוּ עַל־תִּרְצָה׃

english.text:
Omri and all Israel then withdrew from Gibbethon and laid siege to
Tirzah.

translation.text: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

verses.english:
Omri and all Israel then withdrew from Gibbethon and laid siege to
Tirzah.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת זִמְרִי כִּי־נִלְכְּדָה הָעִיר וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אַרְמוֹן בֵּית־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׂרֹף עָלָיו אֶת־בֵּית־מֶלֶךְ בָּאֵשׁ וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת זִמְרִי כִּי־נִלְכְּדָה הָעִיר וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אַרְמוֹן בֵּית־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׂרֹף עָלָיו אֶת־בֵּית־מֶלֶךְ בָּאֵשׁ וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
When Zimri saw that the town was taken, he went into the citadel
of the royal palace and burned down the royal palace over himself.
And so he died—

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king’s house, and burnt the king’s house over him with fire, and died.

verses.english:
When Zimri saw that the town was taken, he went into the citadel
of the royal palace and burned down the royal palace over himself.
And so he died—

verses.hebrew: עַל־חַטֹּאתָיו אֲשֶׁר חָטָא לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לָלֶכֶת בְּדֶרֶךְ יָרבְעָם וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְהַחֲטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: עַל־חַטֹּאתָיו אֲשֶׁר חָטָא לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לָלֶכֶת בְּדֶרֶךְ יָרבְעָם וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְהַחֲטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
because of the sins which he committed and caused Israel to
commit, doing what was displeasing to YHWH and following the ways
of Jeroboam.

translation.text: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.

verses.english:
because of the sins which he committed and caused Israel to
commit, doing what was displeasing to YHWH and following the ways
of Jeroboam.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי זִמְרִי וְקִשְׁרוֹ אֲשֶׁר קָשָׁר הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי זִמְרִי וְקִשְׁרוֹ אֲשֶׁר קָשָׁר הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Zimri’s reign, and the treason which he
committed, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.english:
The other events of Zimri’s reign, and the treason which he
committed, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: אָז יֵחָלֵק הָעָם יִשְׂרָאֵל לַחֵצִי חֲצִי הָעָם הָיָה אַחֲרֵי תִבְנִי בֶן־גִּינַת לְהַמְלִיכוֹ וְהַחֲצִי אַחֲרֵי עמְרִי׃

hebrew.text: אָז יֵחָלֵק הָעָם יִשְׂרָאֵל לַחֵצִי חֲצִי הָעָם הָיָה אַחֲרֵי תִבְנִי בֶן־גִּינַת לְהַמְלִיכוֹ וְהַחֲצִי אַחֲרֵי עמְרִי׃

english.text:
Then the people of Israel split into two factions: a part of the
people followed Tibni son of Ginath to make him king, and the
other part followed Omri.

translation.text: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.

verses.english:
Then the people of Israel split into two factions: a part of the
people followed Tibni son of Ginath to make him king, and the
other part followed Omri.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחֱזַק הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵי עמְרִי אֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵי תִּבְנִי בֶן־גִּינַת וַיָּמת תִּבְנִי וַיִּמְלֹךְ עמְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּחֱזַק הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵי עמְרִי אֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵי תִּבְנִי בֶן־גִּינַת וַיָּמת תִּבְנִי וַיִּמְלֹךְ עמְרִי׃

english.text:
Those who followed Omri proved stronger than those who followed
Tibni son of Ginath; Tibni died and Omri became king.

translation.text: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

verses.english:
Those who followed Omri proved stronger than those who followed
Tibni son of Ginath; Tibni died and Omri became king.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ עמְרִי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בְּתִרְצָה מָלַךְ שֵׁשׁ־שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ עמְרִי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בְּתִרְצָה מָלַךְ שֵׁשׁ־שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
In the thirty-first year of King Asa of Judah, Omri became king
over Israel—for twelve years. He reigned in Tirzah six years.

translation.text: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.

verses.english:
In the thirty-first year of King Asa of Judah, Omri became king
over Israel—for twelve years. He reigned in Tirzah six years.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקֶן אֶת־הָהָר שֹׁמְרוֹן מֵאֶת שֶׁמֶר בְּכִכְּרַיִם כָּסֶף וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הָהָר וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שֵׁם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה עַל שֶׁם־שֶׁמֶר אֲדֹנֵי הָהָר שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקֶן אֶת־הָהָר שֹׁמְרוֹן מֵאֶת שֶׁמֶר בְּכִכְּרַיִם כָּסֶף וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הָהָר וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שֵׁם הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה עַל שֶׁם־שֶׁמֶר אֲדֹנֵי הָהָר שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
Then he bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of
silver; he built [a town] on the hill and named the town which he
built Samaria, after Shemer, the owner of the hill.

translation.text: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.

verses.english:
Then he bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of
silver; he built [a town] on the hill and named the town which he
built Samaria, after Shemer, the owner of the hill.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשֶׂה עמְרִי הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיָּרַע מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשֶׂה עמְרִי הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיָּרַע מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
Omri did what was displeasing to YHWH; he was worse than all who
preceded him.

translation.text: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD, and did worse than all that were before him.

verses.english:
Omri did what was displeasing to YHWH; he was worse than all who
preceded him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכל־דֶּרֶךְ יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט (ובחטאתיו) [וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ] אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַבְלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכל־דֶּרֶךְ יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט (ובחטאתיו) [וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ] אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַבְלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
He followed all the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat and the sins
which he committed and caused Israel to commit, vexing YHWH, the
God of Israel, with their futilities.

translation.text: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

verses.english:
He followed all the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat and the sins
which he committed and caused Israel to commit, vexing YHWH, the
God of Israel, with their futilities.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי עמְרִי אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי עמְרִי אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Omri’s reign, [and] his actions, and the
exploits he performed, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of
Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.english:
The other events of Omri’s reign, [and] his actions, and the
exploits he performed, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of
Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב עמְרִי עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ אַחְאָב בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב עמְרִי עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ אַחְאָב בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Omri slept with his fathers and was buried in Samaria; and his son
Ahab succeeded him as king.

translation.text: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Omri slept with his fathers and was buried in Samaria; and his son
Ahab succeeded him as king.

verses.hebrew:
וְאַחְאָב בֶּן־עמְרִי מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ אַחְאָב בֶּן־עמְרִי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עֶשְׂרִים
וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְאַחְאָב בֶּן־עמְרִי מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה לְאָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ אַחְאָב בֶּן־עמְרִי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עֶשְׂרִים
וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
Ahab son of Omri became king over Israel in the thirty-eighth year
of King Asa of Judah, and Ahab son of Omri reigned over Israel in
Samaria for twenty-two years.

translation.text: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.

verses.english:
Ahab son of Omri became king over Israel in the thirty-eighth year
of King Asa of Judah, and Ahab son of Omri reigned over Israel in
Samaria for twenty-two years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אַחְאָב בֶּן־עמְרִי הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אַחְאָב בֶּן־עמְרִי הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
Ahab son of Omri did what was displeasing to YHWH, more than all
who preceded him.

translation.text: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all that were before him.

verses.english:
Ahab son of Omri did what was displeasing to YHWH, more than all
who preceded him.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הֲנָקֵל לֶכְתּוֹ בְּחַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט וַיִּקַּח אִשָּׁה אֶת־אִיזֶבֶל בַּת־אֶתְבַּעַל מֶלֶךְ צִידֹנִים וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבַּעַל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הֲנָקֵל לֶכְתּוֹ בְּחַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט וַיִּקַּח אִשָּׁה אֶת־אִיזֶבֶל בַּת־אֶתְבַּעַל מֶלֶךְ צִידֹנִים וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבַּעַל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לוֹ׃

english.text:
Not content to follow the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, he took
as wife Jezebel daughter of King Ethbaal of the Phoenicians, and
he went and served Baal and worshiped him.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.

verses.english:
Not content to follow the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, he took
as wife Jezebel daughter of King Ethbaal of the Phoenicians, and
he went and served Baal and worshiped him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם מִזְבֵּחַ לַבָּעַל בֵּית הַבַּעַל אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֶם מִזְבֵּחַ לַבָּעַל בֵּית הַבַּעַל אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
He erected an altar to Baal in the temple of Baal which he built
in Samaria.

translation.text: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

verses.english:
He erected an altar to Baal in the temple of Baal which he built
in Samaria.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אַחְאָב אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה וַיּוֹסֶף אַחְאָב לַעֲשׂוֹת לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אַחְאָב אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה וַיּוֹסֶף אַחְאָב לַעֲשׂוֹת לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
Ahab also made a sacred post. Ahab did more to vex YHWH, the God
of Israel, than all the kings of Israel who preceded him.

translation.text: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.

verses.english:
Ahab also made a sacred post. Ahab did more to vex YHWH, the God
of Israel, than all the kings of Israel who preceded him.

verses.hebrew:
בְּיָמָיו בָּנָה חִיאֵל בֵּית הָאֱלִי אֶת־יְרִיחֹה בַּאֲבִירָם בְּכֹרוֹ יִסְּדָהּ (ובשגיב) [וּבִשְׂגוּב] צְעִירוֹ הִצִּיב דְּלָתֶיהָ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד
יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן׃

hebrew.text:
בְּיָמָיו בָּנָה חִיאֵל בֵּית הָאֱלִי אֶת־יְרִיחֹה בַּאֲבִירָם בְּכֹרוֹ יִסְּדָהּ (ובשגיב) [וּבִשְׂגוּב] צְעִירוֹ הִצִּיב דְּלָתֶיהָ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד
יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן׃

english.text:
During his reign, Hiel the Bethelite fortified Jericho. He laid
its foundations at the cost of Abiram his first-born, and set its
gates in place at the cost of Segub his youngest, in accordance
with the words that YHWH had spoken through Joshua son of Nun.

translation.text: In his days did Hiel the Bethelite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.english:
During his reign, Hiel the Bethelite fortified Jericho. He laid
its foundations at the cost of Abiram his first-born, and set its
gates in place at the cost of Segub his youngest, in accordance
with the words that YHWH had spoken through Joshua son of Nun.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּי מִתֹּשָׁבֵי גִלְעָד אֶל־אַחְאָב חַי־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עָמַדְתִּי לְפָנָיו אִם־יִהְיֶה הַשָּׁנִים הָאֵלֶּה טַל וּמָטָר כִּי
אִם־לְפִי דְבָרִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּי מִתֹּשָׁבֵי גִלְעָד אֶל־אַחְאָב חַי־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עָמַדְתִּי לְפָנָיו אִם־יִהְיֶה הַשָּׁנִים הָאֵלֶּה טַל וּמָטָר כִּי
אִם־לְפִי דְבָרִי׃

english.text:
Elijah the Tishbite, an inhabitant of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As
YHWH lives, the God of Israel whom I serve, there will be no dew
or rain except at my bidding.”

translation.text: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As the LORD God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.

verses.english:
Elijah the Tishbite, an inhabitant of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As
YHWH lives, the God of Israel whom I serve, there will be no dew
or rain except at my bidding.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: The word of YHWH came to him:

translation.text: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,

verses.english: The word of YHWH came to him:

verses.hebrew: לֵךְ מִזֶּה וּפָנִיתָ לְּךָ קֵדְמָה וְנִסְתַּרְתָּ בְּנַחַל כְּרִית אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: לֵךְ מִזֶּה וּפָנִיתָ לְּךָ קֵדְמָה וְנִסְתַּרְתָּ בְּנַחַל כְּרִית אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
“Leave this place; turn eastward and go into hiding by the Wadi
Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.

translation.text: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

verses.english:
“Leave this place; turn eastward and go into hiding by the Wadi
Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה מֵהַנַּחַל תִּשְׁתֶּה וְאֶת־הָעֹרְבִים צִוִּיתִי לְכַלְכֶּלְךָ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה מֵהַנַּחַל תִּשְׁתֶּה וְאֶת־הָעֹרְבִים צִוִּיתִי לְכַלְכֶּלְךָ שָׁם׃

english.text:
You will drink from the wadi, and I have commanded the ravens to
feed you there.”

translation.text: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.

verses.english:
You will drink from the wadi, and I have commanded the ravens to
feed you there.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּעַשׂ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּנַחַל כְּרִית אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּעַשׂ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּנַחַל כְּרִית אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
He proceeded to do as YHWH had bidden: he went, and he stayed by
the Wadi Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.

translation.text: So he went and did according unto the word of the LORD: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

verses.english:
He proceeded to do as YHWH had bidden: he went, and he stayed by
the Wadi Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וְהָעֹרְבִים מְבִאִים לוֹ לֶחֶם וּבָשָׂר בַּבֹּקֶר וְלֶחֶם וּבָשָׂר בָּעָרֶב וּמִן־הַנַּחַל יִשְׁתֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעֹרְבִים מְבִאִים לוֹ לֶחֶם וּבָשָׂר בַּבֹּקֶר וְלֶחֶם וּבָשָׂר בָּעָרֶב וּמִן־הַנַּחַל יִשְׁתֶּה׃

english.text:
The ravens brought him bread and meat every morning and every
evening, and he drank from the wadi.

translation.text: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.

verses.english:
The ravens brought him bread and meat every morning and every
evening, and he drank from the wadi.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ יָמִים וַיִּיבַשׁ הַנָּחַל כִּי לֹא־הָיָה גֶשֶׁם בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ יָמִים וַיִּיבַשׁ הַנָּחַל כִּי לֹא־הָיָה גֶשֶׁם בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
After some time the wadi dried up, because there was no rain in
the land.

translation.text: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.

verses.english:
After some time the wadi dried up, because there was no rain in
the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: And the word of YHWH came to him:

translation.text: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,

verses.english: And the word of YHWH came to him:

verses.hebrew: קוּם לֵךְ צָרְפַתָה אֲשֶׁר לְצִידוֹן וְיָשַׁבְתָּ שָׁם הִנֵּה צִוִּיתִי שָׁם אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה לְכַלְכְּלֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: קוּם לֵךְ צָרְפַתָה אֲשֶׁר לְצִידוֹן וְיָשַׁבְתָּ שָׁם הִנֵּה צִוִּיתִי שָׁם אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה לְכַלְכְּלֶךָ׃

english.text:
“Go at once to Zarephath of Sidon, and stay there; I have
designated a widow there to feed you.”

translation.text: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.

verses.english:
“Go at once to Zarephath of Sidon, and stay there; I have
designated a widow there to feed you.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ צָרְפַתָה וַיָּבֹא אֶל־פֶּתַח הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה־שָׁם אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה מְקֹשֶׁשֶׁת עֵצִים וַיִּקְרָא אֵלֶיהָ וַיֹּאמַר קְחִי־נָא לִי מְעַט־מַיִם בַּכְּלִי
וְאֶשְׁתֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ צָרְפַתָה וַיָּבֹא אֶל־פֶּתַח הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה־שָׁם אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה מְקֹשֶׁשֶׁת עֵצִים וַיִּקְרָא אֵלֶיהָ וַיֹּאמַר קְחִי־נָא לִי מְעַט־מַיִם בַּכְּלִי
וְאֶשְׁתֶּה׃

english.text:
So he went at once to Zarephath. When he came to the entrance of
the town, a widow was there gathering wood. He called out to her,
“Please bring me a little water in your pitcher, and let me
drink.”

translation.text: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.

verses.english:
So he went at once to Zarephath. When he came to the entrance of
the town, a widow was there gathering wood. He called out to her,
“Please bring me a little water in your pitcher, and let me
drink.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ לָקַחַת וַיִּקְרָא אֵלֶיהָ וַיֹּאמַר לִקְחִי־נָא לִי פַּת־לֶחֶם בְּיָדֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶךְ לָקַחַת וַיִּקְרָא אֵלֶיהָ וַיֹּאמַר לִקְחִי־נָא לִי פַּת־לֶחֶם בְּיָדֵךְ׃

english.text:
As she went to fetch it, he called out to her, “Please bring along
a piece of bread for me.”

translation.text: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.

verses.english:
As she went to fetch it, he called out to her, “Please bring along
a piece of bread for me.”

verses.hebrew:
וַתֹּאמֶר חַי־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אִם־יֶשׁ־לִי מָעוֹג כִּי אִם־מְלֹא כַף־קֶמַח בַּכַּד וּמְעַט־שֶׁמֶן בַּצַּפָּחַת וְהִנְנִי מְקֹשֶׁשֶׁת שְׁנַיִם עֵצִים וּבָאתִי וַעֲשִׂיתִיהוּ לִי
וְלִבְנִי וַאֲכַלְנֻהוּ וָמָתְנוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַתֹּאמֶר חַי־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אִם־יֶשׁ־לִי מָעוֹג כִּי אִם־מְלֹא כַף־קֶמַח בַּכַּד וּמְעַט־שֶׁמֶן בַּצַּפָּחַת וְהִנְנִי מְקֹשֶׁשֶׁת שְׁנַיִם עֵצִים וּבָאתִי וַעֲשִׂיתִיהוּ לִי
וְלִבְנִי וַאֲכַלְנֻהוּ וָמָתְנוּ׃

english.text:
“As YHWH your God lives,” she replied, “I have nothing baked,
nothing but a handful of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug.
I am just gathering a couple of sticks, so that I can go home and
prepare it for me and my son; we shall eat it and then we shall
die.”

translation.text: And she said, As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.

verses.english:
“As YHWH your God lives,” she replied, “I have nothing baked,
nothing but a handful of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug.
I am just gathering a couple of sticks, so that I can go home and
prepare it for me and my son; we shall eat it and then we shall
die.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אֵלִיָּהוּ אַל־תִּירְאִי בֹּאִי עֲשִׂי כִדְבָרֵךְ אַךְ עֲשִׂי־לִי־מִשָּׁם עֻגָה קְטַנָּה בָרִאשֹׁנָה וְהוֹצֵאת לִי וְלָךְ וְלִבְנֵךְ תַּעֲשִׂי בָּאַחֲרֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אֵלִיָּהוּ אַל־תִּירְאִי בֹּאִי עֲשִׂי כִדְבָרֵךְ אַךְ עֲשִׂי־לִי־מִשָּׁם עֻגָה קְטַנָּה בָרִאשֹׁנָה וְהוֹצֵאת לִי וְלָךְ וְלִבְנֵךְ תַּעֲשִׂי בָּאַחֲרֹנָה׃

english.text:
“Don’t be afraid,” said Elijah to her. “Go and do as you have
said; but first make me a small cake from what you have there, and
bring it out to me; then make some for yourself and your son.

translation.text: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.

verses.english:
“Don’t be afraid,” said Elijah to her. “Go and do as you have
said; but first make me a small cake from what you have there, and
bring it out to me; then make some for yourself and your son.

verses.hebrew: כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּד הַקֶּמַח לֹא תִכְלָה וְצַפַּחַת הַשֶּׁמֶן לֹא תֶחְסָר עַד יוֹם (תתן) [תֵּת־]יְהֹוָה גֶּשֶׁם עַל־פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּד הַקֶּמַח לֹא תִכְלָה וְצַפַּחַת הַשֶּׁמֶן לֹא תֶחְסָר עַד יוֹם (תתן) [תֵּת־]יְהֹוָה גֶּשֶׁם עַל־פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
For thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: The jar of flour shall not
give out and the jug of oil shall not fail until the day that YHWH
sends rain upon the ground.”

translation.text: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.

verses.english:
For thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: The jar of flour shall not
give out and the jug of oil shall not fail until the day that YHWH
sends rain upon the ground.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתַּעֲשֶׂה כִּדְבַר אֵלִיָּהוּ וַתֹּאכַל (הוא והיא) [הִיא־וָהוּא] וּבֵיתָהּ יָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתַּעֲשֶׂה כִּדְבַר אֵלִיָּהוּ וַתֹּאכַל (הוא והיא) [הִיא־וָהוּא] וּבֵיתָהּ יָמִים׃

english.text:
She went and did as Elijah had spoken, and she and he and her
household had food for a long time.

translation.text: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.

verses.english:
She went and did as Elijah had spoken, and she and he and her
household had food for a long time.

verses.hebrew: כַּד הַקֶּמַח לֹא כָלָתָה וְצַפַּחַת הַשֶּׁמֶן לֹא חָסֵר כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: כַּד הַקֶּמַח לֹא כָלָתָה וְצַפַּחַת הַשֶּׁמֶן לֹא חָסֵר כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
The jar of flour did not give out, nor did the jug of oil fail,
just as YHWH had spoken through Elijah.

translation.text: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.

verses.english:
The jar of flour did not give out, nor did the jug of oil fail,
just as YHWH had spoken through Elijah.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה חָלָה בֶּן־הָאִשָּׁה בַּעֲלַת הַבָּיִת וַיְהִי חלְיוֹ חָזָק מְאֹד עַד אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נוֹתְרָה־בּוֹ נְשָׁמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה חָלָה בֶּן־הָאִשָּׁה בַּעֲלַת הַבָּיִת וַיְהִי חלְיוֹ חָזָק מְאֹד עַד אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נוֹתְרָה־בּוֹ נְשָׁמָה׃

english.text:
After a while, the son of the mistress of the house fell sick, and
his illness grew worse, until he had no breath left in him.

translation.text: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.

verses.english:
After a while, the son of the mistress of the house fell sick, and
his illness grew worse, until he had no breath left in him.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ מַה־לִּי וָלָךְ אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בָּאתָ אֵלַי לְהַזְכִּיר אֶת־עֲוֺנִי וּלְהָמִית אֶת־בְּנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ מַה־לִּי וָלָךְ אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בָּאתָ אֵלַי לְהַזְכִּיר אֶת־עֲוֺנִי וּלְהָמִית אֶת־בְּנִי׃

english.text:
She said to Elijah, “What harm have I done you, O man of God, that
you should come here to recall my sin and cause the death of my
son?”

translation.text: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?

verses.english:
She said to Elijah, “What harm have I done you, O man of God, that
you should come here to recall my sin and cause the death of my
son?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ תְּנִי־לִי אֶת־בְּנֵךְ וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ מֵחֵיקָהּ וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ אֶל־הָעֲלִיָּה אֲשֶׁר־הוּא יֹשֵׁב שָׁם וַיַּשְׁכִּבֵהוּ עַל־מִטָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ תְּנִי־לִי אֶת־בְּנֵךְ וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ מֵחֵיקָהּ וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ אֶל־הָעֲלִיָּה אֲשֶׁר־הוּא יֹשֵׁב שָׁם וַיַּשְׁכִּבֵהוּ עַל־מִטָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
“Give me the boy,” he said to her; and taking him from her arms,
he carried him to the upper chamber where he was staying, and laid
him down on his own bed.

translation.text: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.

verses.english:
“Give me the boy,” he said to her; and taking him from her arms,
he carried him to the upper chamber where he was staying, and laid
him down on his own bed.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי הֲגַם עַל־הָאַלְמָנָה אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי מִתְגּוֹרֵר עִמָּהּ הֲרֵעוֹתָ לְהָמִית אֶת־בְּנָהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי הֲגַם עַל־הָאַלְמָנָה אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי מִתְגּוֹרֵר עִמָּהּ הֲרֵעוֹתָ לְהָמִית אֶת־בְּנָהּ׃

english.text:
He cried out to YHWH and said, “O LORD my God, will You bring
calamity upon this widow whose guest I am, and let her son die?”

translation.text: And he cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?

verses.english:
He cried out to YHWH and said, “O LORD my God, will You bring
calamity upon this widow whose guest I am, and let her son die?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְמֹדֵד עַל־הַיֶּלֶד שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי תָּשׁב נָא נֶפֶשׁ־הַיֶּלֶד הַזֶּה עַל־קִרְבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְמֹדֵד עַל־הַיֶּלֶד שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָי תָּשׁב נָא נֶפֶשׁ־הַיֶּלֶד הַזֶּה עַל־קִרְבּוֹ׃

english.text:
Then he stretched out over the child three times, and cried out to
YHWH, saying, “O LORD my God, let this child’s life return to his
body!”

translation.text: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, I pray thee, let this child’s soul come into him again.

verses.english:
Then he stretched out over the child three times, and cried out to
YHWH, saying, “O LORD my God, let this child’s life return to his
body!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה בְּקוֹל אֵלִיָּהוּ וַתָּשׁב נֶפֶשׁ־הַיֶּלֶד עַל־קִרְבּוֹ וַיֶּחִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה בְּקוֹל אֵלִיָּהוּ וַתָּשׁב נֶפֶשׁ־הַיֶּלֶד עַל־קִרְבּוֹ וַיֶּחִי׃

english.text:
YHWH heard Elijah’s plea; the child’s life returned to his body,
and he revived.

translation.text: And the LORD heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

verses.english:
YHWH heard Elijah’s plea; the child’s life returned to his body,
and he revived.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶת־הַיֶּלֶד וַיֹּרִדֵהוּ מִן־הָעֲלִיָּה הַבַּיְתָה וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ לְאִמּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ רְאִי חַי בְּנֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶת־הַיֶּלֶד וַיֹּרִדֵהוּ מִן־הָעֲלִיָּה הַבַּיְתָה וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ לְאִמּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ רְאִי חַי בְּנֵךְ׃

english.text:
Elijah picked up the child and brought him down from the upper
room into the main room, and gave him to his mother. “See,” said
Elijah, “your son is alive.”

translation.text: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.

verses.english:
Elijah picked up the child and brought him down from the upper
room into the main room, and gave him to his mother. “See,” said
Elijah, “your son is alive.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ עַתָּה זֶה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים אָתָּה וּדְבַר־יְהֹוָה בְּפִיךָ אֱמֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ עַתָּה זֶה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים אָתָּה וּדְבַר־יְהֹוָה בְּפִיךָ אֱמֶת׃

english.text:
And the woman answered Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of
God and that the word of YHWH is truly in your mouth.”

translation.text: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in thy mouth is truth.

verses.english:
And the woman answered Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of
God and that the word of YHWH is truly in your mouth.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יָמִים רַבִּים וּדְבַר־יְהֹוָה הָיָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁלִישִׁית לֵאמֹר לֵךְ הֵרָאֵה אֶל־אַחְאָב וְאֶתְּנָה מָטָר עַל־פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי יָמִים רַבִּים וּדְבַר־יְהֹוָה הָיָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁלִישִׁית לֵאמֹר לֵךְ הֵרָאֵה אֶל־אַחְאָב וְאֶתְּנָה מָטָר עַל־פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃

english.text:
Much later, in the third year, the word of YHWH came to Elijah:
“Go, appear before Ahab; then I will send rain upon the earth.”

translation.text: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.

verses.english:
Much later, in the third year, the word of YHWH came to Elijah:
“Go, appear before Ahab; then I will send rain upon the earth.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֵלִיָּהוּ לְהֵרָאוֹת אֶל־אַחְאָב וְהָרָעָב חָזָק בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֵלִיָּהוּ לְהֵרָאוֹת אֶל־אַחְאָב וְהָרָעָב חָזָק בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
Thereupon Elijah set out to appear before Ahab. The famine was
severe in Samaria.

translation.text: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.

verses.english:
Thereupon Elijah set out to appear before Ahab. The famine was
severe in Samaria.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אַחְאָב אֶל־עֹבַדְיָהוּ אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַבָּיִת וְעֹבַדְיָהוּ הָיָה יָרֵא אֶת־יְהֹוָה מְאֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אַחְאָב אֶל־עֹבַדְיָהוּ אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַבָּיִת וְעֹבַדְיָהוּ הָיָה יָרֵא אֶת־יְהֹוָה מְאֹד׃

english.text:
Ahab had summoned Obadiah, the steward of the palace. (Obadiah
revered YHWH greatly.

translation.text: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly:

verses.english:
Ahab had summoned Obadiah, the steward of the palace. (Obadiah
revered YHWH greatly.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּהַכְרִית אִיזֶבֶל אֵת נְבִיאֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּקַּח עֹבַדְיָהוּ מֵאָה נְבִיאִים וַיַּחְבִּיאֵם חֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ בַּמְּעָרָה וְכִלְכְּלָם לֶחֶם וָמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּהַכְרִית אִיזֶבֶל אֵת נְבִיאֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּקַּח עֹבַדְיָהוּ מֵאָה נְבִיאִים וַיַּחְבִּיאֵם חֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ בַּמְּעָרָה וְכִלְכְּלָם לֶחֶם וָמָיִם׃

english.text:
When Jezebel was killing off the prophets of YHWH, Obadiah had
taken a hundred prophets and hidden them, fifty to a cave, and
provided them with food and drink.)

translation.text: For it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

verses.english:
When Jezebel was killing off the prophets of YHWH, Obadiah had
taken a hundred prophets and hidden them, fifty to a cave, and
provided them with food and drink.)

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַחְאָב אֶל־עֹבַדְיָהוּ לֵךְ בָּאָרֶץ אֶל־כּל־מַעְיְנֵי הַמַּיִם וְאֶל כּל־הַנְּחָלִים אוּלַי נִמְצָא חָצִיר וּנְחַיֶּה סוּס וָפֶרֶד וְלוֹא נַכְרִית מֵהַבְּהֵמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַחְאָב אֶל־עֹבַדְיָהוּ לֵךְ בָּאָרֶץ אֶל־כּל־מַעְיְנֵי הַמַּיִם וְאֶל כּל־הַנְּחָלִים אוּלַי נִמְצָא חָצִיר וּנְחַיֶּה סוּס וָפֶרֶד וְלוֹא נַכְרִית מֵהַבְּהֵמָה׃

english.text:
And Ahab had said to Obadiah, “Go through the land, to all the
springs of water and to all the wadis. Perhaps we shall find some
grass to keep horses and mules alive, so that we are not left
without beasts.”

translation.text: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.

verses.english:
And Ahab had said to Obadiah, “Go through the land, to all the
springs of water and to all the wadis. Perhaps we shall find some
grass to keep horses and mules alive, so that we are not left
without beasts.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַלְּקוּ לָהֶם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לַעֲבר־בָּהּ אַחְאָב הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶחָד לְבַדּוֹ וְעֹבַדְיָהוּ הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ־אֶחָד לְבַדּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחַלְּקוּ לָהֶם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לַעֲבר־בָּהּ אַחְאָב הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶחָד לְבַדּוֹ וְעֹבַדְיָהוּ הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ־אֶחָד לְבַדּוֹ׃

english.text:
They divided the country between them to explore it, Ahab going
alone in one direction and Obadiah going alone in another
direction.

translation.text: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

verses.english:
They divided the country between them to explore it, Ahab going
alone in one direction and Obadiah going alone in another
direction.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עֹבַדְיָהוּ בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְהִנֵּה אֵלִיָּהוּ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיַּכִּרֵהוּ וַיִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הַאַתָּה זֶה אֲדֹנִי אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי עֹבַדְיָהוּ בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְהִנֵּה אֵלִיָּהוּ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיַּכִּרֵהוּ וַיִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הַאַתָּה זֶה אֲדֹנִי אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
Obadiah was on the road, when Elijah suddenly confronted him.
[Obadiah] recognized him and flung himself on his face, saying,
“Is that you, my lord Elijah?”

translation.text: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Art thou that my lord Elijah?

verses.english:
Obadiah was on the road, when Elijah suddenly confronted him.
[Obadiah] recognized him and flung himself on his face, saying,
“Is that you, my lord Elijah?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אָנִי לֵךְ אֱמֹר לַאדֹנֶיךָ הִנֵּה אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אָנִי לֵךְ אֱמֹר לַאדֹנֶיךָ הִנֵּה אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

english.text: “Yes, it is I,” he answered. “Go tell your lord: Elijah is here!”

translation.text: And he answered him, I am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.

verses.english: “Yes, it is I,” he answered. “Go tell your lord: Elijah is here!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה חָטָאתִי כִּי־אַתָּה נֹתֵן אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ בְּיַד־אַחְאָב לַהֲמִיתֵנִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה חָטָאתִי כִּי־אַתָּה נֹתֵן אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ בְּיַד־אַחְאָב לַהֲמִיתֵנִי׃

english.text:
But he said, “What wrong have I done, that you should hand your
servant over to Ahab to be killed?

translation.text: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?

verses.english:
But he said, “What wrong have I done, that you should hand your
servant over to Ahab to be killed?

verses.hebrew: חַי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אִם־יֶשׁ־גּוֹי וּמַמְלָכָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁלַח אֲדֹנִי שָׁם לְבַקֶּשְׁךָ וְאָמְרוּ אָיִן וְהִשְׁבִּיעַ אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה וְאֶת־הַגּוֹי כִּי לֹא יִמְצָאֶכָּה׃

hebrew.text: חַי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אִם־יֶשׁ־גּוֹי וּמַמְלָכָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁלַח אֲדֹנִי שָׁם לְבַקֶּשְׁךָ וְאָמְרוּ אָיִן וְהִשְׁבִּיעַ אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה וְאֶת־הַגּוֹי כִּי לֹא יִמְצָאֶכָּה׃

english.text:
As YHWH your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom to which my
lord has not sent to look for you; and when they said, ‘He is not
here,’ he made that kingdom or nation swear that you could not be
found.

translation.text: As the LORD thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.

verses.english:
As YHWH your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom to which my
lord has not sent to look for you; and when they said, ‘He is not
here,’ he made that kingdom or nation swear that you could not be
found.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אַתָּה אֹמֵר לֵךְ אֱמֹר לַאדֹנֶיךָ הִנֵּה אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אַתָּה אֹמֵר לֵךְ אֱמֹר לַאדֹנֶיךָ הִנֵּה אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

english.text: And now you say, ‘Go tell your lord: Elijah is here!’

translation.text: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.

verses.english: And now you say, ‘Go tell your lord: Elijah is here!’

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אֲנִי אֵלֵךְ מֵאִתָּךְ וְרוּחַ יְהֹוָה יִשָּׂאֲךָ עַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־אֵדָע וּבָאתִי לְהַגִּיד לְאַחְאָב וְלֹא יִמְצָאֲךָ וַהֲרָגָנִי וְעַבְדְּךָ יָרֵא אֶת־יְהֹוָה מִנְּעֻרָי׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה אֲנִי אֵלֵךְ מֵאִתָּךְ וְרוּחַ יְהֹוָה יִשָּׂאֲךָ עַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־אֵדָע וּבָאתִי לְהַגִּיד לְאַחְאָב וְלֹא יִמְצָאֲךָ וַהֲרָגָנִי וְעַבְדְּךָ יָרֵא אֶת־יְהֹוָה מִנְּעֻרָי׃

english.text:
When I leave you, the spirit of YHWH will carry you off I don’t
know where; and when I come and tell Ahab and he does not find
you, he will kill me. Yet your servant has revered YHWH from my
youth.

translation.text: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the LORD shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the LORD from my youth.

verses.english:
When I leave you, the spirit of YHWH will carry you off I don’t
know where; and when I come and tell Ahab and he does not find
you, he will kill me. Yet your servant has revered YHWH from my
youth.

verses.hebrew:
הֲלֹא־הֻגַּד לַאדֹנִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי בַּהֲרֹג אִיזֶבֶל אֵת נְבִיאֵי יְהֹוָה וָאַחְבִּא מִנְּבִיאֵי יְהֹוָה מֵאָה אִישׁ חֲמִשִּׁים חֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ בַּמְּעָרָה וָאֲכַלְכְּלֵם
לֶחֶם וָמָיִם׃

hebrew.text:
הֲלֹא־הֻגַּד לַאדֹנִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי בַּהֲרֹג אִיזֶבֶל אֵת נְבִיאֵי יְהֹוָה וָאַחְבִּא מִנְּבִיאֵי יְהֹוָה מֵאָה אִישׁ חֲמִשִּׁים חֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ בַּמְּעָרָה וָאֲכַלְכְּלֵם
לֶחֶם וָמָיִם׃

english.text:
My lord has surely been told what I did when Jezebel was killing
the prophets of YHWH, how I hid a hundred of the prophets of YHWH,
fifty men to a cave, and provided them with food and drink.

translation.text: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the LORD, how I hid an hundred men of the LORD’s prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

verses.english:
My lord has surely been told what I did when Jezebel was killing
the prophets of YHWH, how I hid a hundred of the prophets of YHWH,
fifty men to a cave, and provided them with food and drink.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אַתָּה אֹמֵר לֵךְ אֱמֹר לַאדֹנֶיךָ הִנֵּה אֵלִיָּהוּ וַהֲרָגָנִי׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה אַתָּה אֹמֵר לֵךְ אֱמֹר לַאדֹנֶיךָ הִנֵּה אֵלִיָּהוּ וַהֲרָגָנִי׃

english.text:
And now you say, ‘Go tell your lord: Elijah is here.’ Why, he will
kill me!”

translation.text: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.

verses.english:
And now you say, ‘Go tell your lord: Elijah is here.’ Why, he will
kill me!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ חַי יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָמַדְתִּי לְפָנָיו כִּי הַיּוֹם אֵרָאֶה אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ חַי יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָמַדְתִּי לְפָנָיו כִּי הַיּוֹם אֵרָאֶה אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
Elijah replied, “As YHWH of Hosts lives, whom I serve, I will
appear before him this very day.”

translation.text: And Elijah said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.

verses.english:
Elijah replied, “As YHWH of Hosts lives, whom I serve, I will
appear before him this very day.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ עֹבַדְיָהוּ לִקְרַאת אַחְאָב וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחְאָב לִקְרַאת אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ עֹבַדְיָהוּ לִקְרַאת אַחְאָב וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחְאָב לִקְרַאת אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
Obadiah went to find Ahab, and informed him; and Ahab went to meet
Elijah.

translation.text: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

verses.english:
Obadiah went to find Ahab, and informed him; and Ahab went to meet
Elijah.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת אַחְאָב אֶת־אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אַחְאָב אֵלָיו הַאַתָּה זֶה עֹכֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת אַחְאָב אֶת־אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אַחְאָב אֵלָיו הַאַתָּה זֶה עֹכֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
When Ahab caught sight of Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is that you,
you troubler of Israel?”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?

verses.english:
When Ahab caught sight of Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is that you,
you troubler of Israel?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא עָכַרְתִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי אִם־אַתָּה וּבֵית אָבִיךָ בַּעֲזבְכֶם אֶת־מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה וַתֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי הַבְּעָלִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא עָכַרְתִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי אִם־אַתָּה וּבֵית אָבִיךָ בַּעֲזבְכֶם אֶת־מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה וַתֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי הַבְּעָלִים׃

english.text:
He retorted, “It is not I who have brought trouble on Israel, but
you and your father’s House, by forsaking the commandments of YHWH
and going after the Baalim.

translation.text: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father’s house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD, and thou hast followed Baalim.

verses.english:
He retorted, “It is not I who have brought trouble on Israel, but
you and your father’s House, by forsaking the commandments of YHWH
and going after the Baalim.

verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה שְׁלַח קְבֹץ אֵלַי אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַר הַכַּרְמֶל וְאֶת־נְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים וּנְבִיאֵי הָאֲשֵׁרָה אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אֹכְלֵי שֻׁלְחַן
אִיזָבֶל׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה שְׁלַח קְבֹץ אֵלַי אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַר הַכַּרְמֶל וְאֶת־נְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים וּנְבִיאֵי הָאֲשֵׁרָה אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אֹכְלֵי שֻׁלְחַן
אִיזָבֶל׃

english.text:
Now summon all Israel to join me at Mount Carmel, together with
the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred
prophets of Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.”

translation.text: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel’s table.

verses.english:
Now summon all Israel to join me at Mount Carmel, together with
the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred
prophets of Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַחְאָב בְּכל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּקְבֹּץ אֶת־הַנְּבִיאִים אֶל־הַר הַכַּרְמֶל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַחְאָב בְּכל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּקְבֹּץ אֶת־הַנְּבִיאִים אֶל־הַר הַכַּרְמֶל׃

english.text:
Ahab sent orders to all the Israelites and gathered the prophets
at Mount Carmel.

translation.text: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.

verses.english:
Ahab sent orders to all the Israelites and gathered the prophets
at Mount Carmel.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּגַּשׁ אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־כּל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר עַד־מָתַי אַתֶּם פֹּסְחִים עַל־שְׁתֵּי הַסְּעִפִּים אִם־יְהֹוָה הָאֱלֹהִים לְכוּ אַחֲרָיו וְאִם־הַבַּעַל לְכוּ אַחֲרָיו וְלֹא־עָנוּ
הָעָם אֹתוֹ דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּגַּשׁ אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־כּל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר עַד־מָתַי אַתֶּם פֹּסְחִים עַל־שְׁתֵּי הַסְּעִפִּים אִם־יְהֹוָה הָאֱלֹהִים לְכוּ אַחֲרָיו וְאִם־הַבַּעַל לְכוּ אַחֲרָיו וְלֹא־עָנוּ
הָעָם אֹתוֹ דָּבָר׃

english.text:
Elijah approached all the people and said, “How long will you keep
hopping between two opinions? If YHWH is God, follow Him; and if
Baal, follow him!” But the people answered him not a word.

translation.text: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.

verses.english:
Elijah approached all the people and said, “How long will you keep
hopping between two opinions? If YHWH is God, follow Him; and if
Baal, follow him!” But the people answered him not a word.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־הָעָם אֲנִי נוֹתַרְתִּי נָבִיא לַיהֹוָה לְבַדִּי וּנְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל אַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־הָעָם אֲנִי נוֹתַרְתִּי נָבִיא לַיהֹוָה לְבַדִּי וּנְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל אַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ׃

english.text:
Then Elijah said to the people, “I am the only prophet of YHWH
left, while the prophets of Baal are four hundred and fifty men.

translation.text: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of the LORD; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred and fifty men.

verses.english:
Then Elijah said to the people, “I am the only prophet of YHWH
left, while the prophets of Baal are four hundred and fifty men.

verses.hebrew:
וְיִתְּנוּ־לָנוּ שְׁנַיִם פָּרִים וְיִבְחֲרוּ לָהֶם הַפָּר הָאֶחָד וִינַתְּחֻהוּ וְיָשִׂימוּ עַל־הָעֵצִים וְאֵשׁ לֹא יָשִׂימוּ וַאֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־הַפָּר הָאֶחָד וְנָתַתִּי
עַל־הָעֵצִים וְאֵשׁ לֹא אָשִׂים׃

hebrew.text:
וְיִתְּנוּ־לָנוּ שְׁנַיִם פָּרִים וְיִבְחֲרוּ לָהֶם הַפָּר הָאֶחָד וִינַתְּחֻהוּ וְיָשִׂימוּ עַל־הָעֵצִים וְאֵשׁ לֹא יָשִׂימוּ וַאֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־הַפָּר הָאֶחָד וְנָתַתִּי
עַל־הָעֵצִים וְאֵשׁ לֹא אָשִׂים׃

english.text:
Let two young bulls be given to us. Let them choose one bull, cut
it up, and lay it on the wood, but let them not apply fire; I will
prepare the other bull, and lay it on the wood, and will not apply
fire.

translation.text: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:

verses.english:
Let two young bulls be given to us. Let them choose one bull, cut
it up, and lay it on the wood, but let them not apply fire; I will
prepare the other bull, and lay it on the wood, and will not apply
fire.

verses.hebrew: וּקְרָאתֶם בְּשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וַאֲנִי אֶקְרָא בְשֵׁם־יְהֹוָה וְהָיָה הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲנֶה בָאֵשׁ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַן כּל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ טוֹב הַדָּבָר׃

hebrew.text: וּקְרָאתֶם בְּשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וַאֲנִי אֶקְרָא בְשֵׁם־יְהֹוָה וְהָיָה הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲנֶה בָאֵשׁ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַן כּל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ טוֹב הַדָּבָר׃

english.text:
You will then invoke your god by name, and I will invoke YHWH by
name; and let us agree: the god who responds with fire, that one
is God.” And all the people answered, “Very good!”

translation.text: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD: and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.

verses.english:
You will then invoke your god by name, and I will invoke YHWH by
name; and let us agree: the god who responds with fire, that one
is God.” And all the people answered, “Very good!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לִנְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל בַּחֲרוּ לָכֶם הַפָּר הָאֶחָד וַעֲשׂוּ רִאשֹׁנָה כִּי אַתֶּם הָרַבִּים וְקִרְאוּ בְּשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְאֵשׁ לֹא תָשִׂימוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לִנְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל בַּחֲרוּ לָכֶם הַפָּר הָאֶחָד וַעֲשׂוּ רִאשֹׁנָה כִּי אַתֶּם הָרַבִּים וְקִרְאוּ בְּשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְאֵשׁ לֹא תָשִׂימוּ׃

english.text:
Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull and prepare
it first, for you are the majority; invoke your god by name, but
apply no fire.”

translation.text: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for ye are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under.

verses.english:
Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull and prepare
it first, for you are the majority; invoke your god by name, but
apply no fire.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־הַפָּר אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן לָהֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְשֵׁם־הַבַּעַל מֵהַבֹּקֶר וְעַד־הַצּהֳרַיִם לֵאמֹר הַבַּעַל עֲנֵנוּ וְאֵין קוֹל וְאֵין עֹנֶה וַיְפַסְּחוּ
עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־הַפָּר אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן לָהֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְשֵׁם־הַבַּעַל מֵהַבֹּקֶר וְעַד־הַצּהֳרַיִם לֵאמֹר הַבַּעַל עֲנֵנוּ וְאֵין קוֹל וְאֵין עֹנֶה וַיְפַסְּחוּ
עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

english.text:
They took the bull that was given them; they prepared it, and
invoked Baal by name from morning until noon, shouting, “O Baal,
answer us!” But there was no sound, and none who responded; so
they performed a hopping dance about the altar that had been set
up.

translation.text: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.

verses.english:
They took the bull that was given them; they prepared it, and
invoked Baal by name from morning until noon, shouting, “O Baal,
answer us!” But there was no sound, and none who responded; so
they performed a hopping dance about the altar that had been set
up.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַצּהֳרַיִם וַיְהַתֵּל בָּהֶם אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר קִרְאוּ בְקוֹל־גָּדוֹל כִּי־אֱלֹהִים הוּא כִּי שִׂיחַ וְכִי־שִׂיג לוֹ וְכִי־דֶרֶךְ לוֹ אוּלַי יָשֵׁן הוּא וְיִקָץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַצּהֳרַיִם וַיְהַתֵּל בָּהֶם אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר קִרְאוּ בְקוֹל־גָּדוֹל כִּי־אֱלֹהִים הוּא כִּי שִׂיחַ וְכִי־שִׂיג לוֹ וְכִי־דֶרֶךְ לוֹ אוּלַי יָשֵׁן הוּא וְיִקָץ׃

english.text:
When noon came, Elijah mocked them, saying, “Shout louder! After
all, he is a god. But he may be in conversation, he may be
detained, or he may be on a journey, or perhaps he is asleep and
will wake up.”

translation.text: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.

verses.english:
When noon came, Elijah mocked them, saying, “Shout louder! After
all, he is a god. But he may be in conversation, he may be
detained, or he may be on a journey, or perhaps he is asleep and
will wake up.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל וַיִּתְגֹּדְדוּ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם בַּחֲרָבוֹת וּבָרְמָחִים עַד־שְׁפךְ־דָּם עֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל וַיִּתְגֹּדְדוּ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם בַּחֲרָבוֹת וּבָרְמָחִים עַד־שְׁפךְ־דָּם עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
So they shouted louder, and gashed themselves with knives and
spears, according to their practice, until the blood streamed over
them.

translation.text: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.

verses.english:
So they shouted louder, and gashed themselves with knives and
spears, according to their practice, until the blood streamed over
them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּעֲבֹר הַצּהֳרַיִם וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ עַד לַעֲלוֹת הַמִּנְחָה וְאֵין־קוֹל וְאֵין־עֹנֶה וְאֵין קָשֶׁב׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּעֲבֹר הַצּהֳרַיִם וַיִּתְנַבְּאוּ עַד לַעֲלוֹת הַמִּנְחָה וְאֵין־קוֹל וְאֵין־עֹנֶה וְאֵין קָשֶׁב׃

english.text:
When noon passed, they kept raving until the hour of presenting
the meal offering. Still there was no sound, and none who
responded or heeded.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.

verses.english:
When noon passed, they kept raving until the hour of presenting
the meal offering. Still there was no sound, and none who
responded or heeded.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לְכל־הָעָם גְּשׁוּ אֵלַי וַיִּגְּשׁוּ כל־הָעָם אֵלָיו וַיְרַפֵּא אֶת־מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה הֶהָרוּס׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לְכל־הָעָם גְּשׁוּ אֵלַי וַיִּגְּשׁוּ כל־הָעָם אֵלָיו וַיְרַפֵּא אֶת־מִזְבַּח יְהֹוָה הֶהָרוּס׃

english.text:
Then Elijah said to all the people, “Come closer to me”; and all
the people came closer to him. He repaired the damaged altar of
YHWH.

translation.text: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD that was broken down.

verses.english:
Then Elijah said to all the people, “Come closer to me”; and all
the people came closer to him. He repaired the damaged altar of
YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֵלִיָּהוּ שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה אֲבָנִים כְּמִסְפַּר שִׁבְטֵי בְנֵי־יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר הָיָה דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיֶה שְׁמֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֵלִיָּהוּ שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה אֲבָנִים כְּמִסְפַּר שִׁבְטֵי בְנֵי־יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר הָיָה דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיֶה שְׁמֶךָ׃

english.text:
Then Elijah took twelve stones, corresponding to the number of the
tribes of the sons of Jacob—to whom the word of YHWH had come:
“Israel shall be your name”—

translation.text: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:

verses.english:
Then Elijah took twelve stones, corresponding to the number of the
tribes of the sons of Jacob—to whom the word of YHWH had come:
“Israel shall be your name”—

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְנֶה אֶת־הָאֲבָנִים מִזְבֵּחַ בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה וַיַּעַשׂ תְּעָלָה כְּבֵית סָאתַיִם זֶרַע סָבִיב לַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבְנֶה אֶת־הָאֲבָנִים מִזְבֵּחַ בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה וַיַּעַשׂ תְּעָלָה כְּבֵית סָאתַיִם זֶרַע סָבִיב לַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
and with the stones he built an altar in the name of YHWH. Around
the altar he made a trench large enough for two seahs of seed.

translation.text: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.

verses.english:
and with the stones he built an altar in the name of YHWH. Around
the altar he made a trench large enough for two seahs of seed.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲרֹךְ אֶת־הָעֵצִים וַיְנַתַּח אֶת־הַפָּר וַיָּשֶׂם עַל־הָעֵצִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲרֹךְ אֶת־הָעֵצִים וַיְנַתַּח אֶת־הַפָּר וַיָּשֶׂם עַל־הָעֵצִים׃

english.text:
He laid out the wood, and he cut up the bull and laid it on the
wood.

translation.text: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.

verses.english:
He laid out the wood, and he cut up the bull and laid it on the
wood.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִלְאוּ אַרְבָּעָה כַדִּים מַיִם וְיִצְקוּ עַל־הָעֹלָה וְעַל־הָעֵצִים וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁנוּ וַיִּשְׁנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר שַׁלֵּשׁוּ וַיְשַׁלֵּשׁוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מִלְאוּ אַרְבָּעָה כַדִּים מַיִם וְיִצְקוּ עַל־הָעֹלָה וְעַל־הָעֵצִים וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁנוּ וַיִּשְׁנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר שַׁלֵּשׁוּ וַיְשַׁלֵּשׁוּ׃

english.text:
And he said, “Fill four jars with water and pour it over the burnt
offering and the wood.” Then he said, “Do it a second time”; and
they did it a second time. “Do it a third time,” he said; and they
did it a third time.

translation.text: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time.

verses.english:
And he said, “Fill four jars with water and pour it over the burnt
offering and the wood.” Then he said, “Do it a second time”; and
they did it a second time. “Do it a third time,” he said; and they
did it a third time.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ הַמַּיִם סָבִיב לַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְגַם אֶת־הַתְּעָלָה מִלֵּא־מָיִם׃
