hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ הַמַּיִם סָבִיב לַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְגַם אֶת־הַתְּעָלָה מִלֵּא־מָיִם׃

english.text:
The water ran down around the altar, and even the trench was
filled with water.

translation.text: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.

verses.english:
The water ran down around the altar, and even the trench was
filled with water.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בַּעֲלוֹת הַמִּנְחָה וַיִּגַּשׁ אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל הַיּוֹם יִוָּדַע כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲנִי
עַבְדֶּךָ (ובדבריך) [וּבִדְבָרְךָ] עָשִׂיתִי אֵת כּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בַּעֲלוֹת הַמִּנְחָה וַיִּגַּשׁ אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל הַיּוֹם יִוָּדַע כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲנִי
עַבְדֶּךָ (ובדבריך) [וּבִדְבָרְךָ] עָשִׂיתִי אֵת כּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
When it was time to present the meal offering, the prophet Elijah
came forward and said, “O LORD, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel!
Let it be known today that You are God in Israel and that I am
Your servant, and that I have done all these things at Your
bidding.

translation.text: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word.

verses.english:
When it was time to present the meal offering, the prophet Elijah
came forward and said, “O LORD, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel!
Let it be known today that You are God in Israel and that I am
Your servant, and that I have done all these things at Your
bidding.

verses.hebrew: עֲנֵנִי יְהֹוָה עֲנֵנִי וְיֵדְעוּ הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי־אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הָאֱלֹהִים וְאַתָּה הֲסִבֹּתָ אֶת־לִבָּם אֲחֹרַנִּית׃

hebrew.text: עֲנֵנִי יְהֹוָה עֲנֵנִי וְיֵדְעוּ הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי־אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הָאֱלֹהִים וְאַתָּה הֲסִבֹּתָ אֶת־לִבָּם אֲחֹרַנִּית׃

english.text:
Answer me, O LORD, answer me, that this people may know that You,
O LORD, are God; for You have turned their hearts backward.”

translation.text: Hear me, O LORD, hear me, that this people may know that thou art the LORD God, and that thou hast turned their heart back again.

verses.english:
Answer me, O LORD, answer me, that this people may know that You,
O LORD, are God; for You have turned their hearts backward.”

verses.hebrew: וַתִּפֹּל אֵשׁ־יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הָעֵצִים וְאֶת־הָאֲבָנִים וְאֶת־הֶעָפָר וְאֶת־הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר־בַּתְּעָלָה לִחֵכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּפֹּל אֵשׁ־יְהֹוָה וַתֹּאכַל אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הָעֵצִים וְאֶת־הָאֲבָנִים וְאֶת־הֶעָפָר וְאֶת־הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר־בַּתְּעָלָה לִחֵכָה׃

english.text:
Then fire from YHWH descended and consumed the burnt offering, the
wood, the stones, and the earth; and it licked up the water that
was in the trench.

translation.text: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.

verses.english:
Then fire from YHWH descended and consumed the burnt offering, the
wood, the stones, and the earth; and it licked up the water that
was in the trench.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא כּל־הָעָם וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא כּל־הָעָם וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
When they saw this, all the people flung themselves on their faces
and cried out: “YHWH alone is God, YHWH alone is God!”

translation.text: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, The LORD, he is the God; the LORD, he is the God.

verses.english:
When they saw this, all the people flung themselves on their faces
and cried out: “YHWH alone is God, YHWH alone is God!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לָהֶם תִּפְשׂוּ אֶת־נְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל אִישׁ אַל־יִמָּלֵט מֵהֶם וַיִּתְפְּשׂוּם וַיּוֹרִדֵם אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־נַחַל קִישׁוֹן וַיִּשְׁחָטֵם שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לָהֶם תִּפְשׂוּ אֶת־נְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל אִישׁ אַל־יִמָּלֵט מֵהֶם וַיִּתְפְּשׂוּם וַיּוֹרִדֵם אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־נַחַל קִישׁוֹן וַיִּשְׁחָטֵם שָׁם׃

english.text:
Then Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal, let not a
single one of them get away.” They seized them, and Elijah took
them down to the Wadi Kishon and slaughtered them there.

translation.text: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.

verses.english:
Then Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal, let not a
single one of them get away.” They seized them, and Elijah took
them down to the Wadi Kishon and slaughtered them there.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לְאַחְאָב עֲלֵה אֱכֹל וּשְׁתֵה כִּי־קוֹל הֲמוֹן הַגָּשֶׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לְאַחְאָב עֲלֵה אֱכֹל וּשְׁתֵה כִּי־קוֹל הֲמוֹן הַגָּשֶׁם׃

english.text:
Elijah said to Ahab, “Go up, eat and drink, for there is a
rumbling of [approaching] rain,”

translation.text: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.

verses.english:
Elijah said to Ahab, “Go up, eat and drink, for there is a
rumbling of [approaching] rain,”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלֶה אַחְאָב לֶאֱכֹל וְלִשְׁתּוֹת וְאֵלִיָּהוּ עָלָה אֶל־רֹאשׁ הַכַּרְמֶל וַיִּגְהַר אַרְצָה וַיָּשֶׂם פָּנָיו בֵּין בִּרְכָּו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲלֶה אַחְאָב לֶאֱכֹל וְלִשְׁתּוֹת וְאֵלִיָּהוּ עָלָה אֶל־רֹאשׁ הַכַּרְמֶל וַיִּגְהַר אַרְצָה וַיָּשֶׂם פָּנָיו בֵּין בִּרְכָּו׃

english.text:
and Ahab went up to eat and drink. Elijah meanwhile climbed to the
top of Mount Carmel, crouched on the ground, and put his face
between his knees.

translation.text: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,

verses.english:
and Ahab went up to eat and drink. Elijah meanwhile climbed to the
top of Mount Carmel, crouched on the ground, and put his face
between his knees.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־נַעֲרוֹ עֲלֵה־נָא הַבֵּט דֶּרֶךְ־יָם וַיַּעַל וַיַּבֵּט וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין מְאוּמָה וַיֹּאמֶר שֻׁב שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־נַעֲרוֹ עֲלֵה־נָא הַבֵּט דֶּרֶךְ־יָם וַיַּעַל וַיַּבֵּט וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין מְאוּמָה וַיֹּאמֶר שֻׁב שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים׃

english.text:
And he said to his servant, “Go up and look toward the Sea.” He
went up and looked and reported, “There is nothing.” Seven times
[Elijah] said, “Go back,”

translation.text: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.

verses.english:
And he said to his servant, “Go up and look toward the Sea.” He
went up and looked and reported, “There is nothing.” Seven times
[Elijah] said, “Go back,”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּשְּׁבִעִית וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־עָב קְטַנָּה כְּכַף־אִישׁ עֹלָה מִיָּם וַיֹּאמֶר עֲלֵה אֱמֹר אֶל־אַחְאָב אֱסֹר וָרֵד וְלֹא יַעֲצרְכָה הַגָּשֶׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּשְּׁבִעִית וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־עָב קְטַנָּה כְּכַף־אִישׁ עֹלָה מִיָּם וַיֹּאמֶר עֲלֵה אֱמֹר אֶל־אַחְאָב אֱסֹר וָרֵד וְלֹא יַעֲצרְכָה הַגָּשֶׁם׃

english.text:
and the seventh time, [the servant] reported, “A cloud as small as
a man’s hand is rising in the west.” Then [Elijah] said, “Go say
to Ahab, ‘Hitch up [your chariot] and go down before the rain
stops you.’”

translation.text: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man’s hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down that the rain stop thee not.

verses.english:
and the seventh time, [the servant] reported, “A cloud as small as
a man’s hand is rising in the west.” Then [Elijah] said, “Go say
to Ahab, ‘Hitch up [your chariot] and go down before the rain
stops you.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עַד־כֹּה וְעַד־כֹּה וְהַשָּׁמַיִם הִתְקַדְּרוּ עָבִים וְרוּחַ וַיְהִי גֶּשֶׁם גָּדוֹל וַיִּרְכַּב אַחְאָב וַיֵּלֶךְ יִזְרְעֶאלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי עַד־כֹּה וְעַד־כֹּה וְהַשָּׁמַיִם הִתְקַדְּרוּ עָבִים וְרוּחַ וַיְהִי גֶּשֶׁם גָּדוֹל וַיִּרְכַּב אַחְאָב וַיֵּלֶךְ יִזְרְעֶאלָה׃

english.text:
Meanwhile the sky grew black with clouds; there was wind, and a
heavy downpour fell; Ahab mounted his chariot and drove off to
Jezreel.

translation.text: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

verses.english:
Meanwhile the sky grew black with clouds; there was wind, and a
heavy downpour fell; Ahab mounted his chariot and drove off to
Jezreel.

verses.hebrew: וְיַד־יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיְשַׁנֵּס מתְנָיו וַיָּרץ לִפְנֵי אַחְאָב עַד־בֹּאֲכָה יִזְרְעֶאלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיַד־יְהֹוָה הָיְתָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיְשַׁנֵּס מתְנָיו וַיָּרץ לִפְנֵי אַחְאָב עַד־בֹּאֲכָה יִזְרְעֶאלָה׃

english.text:
The hand of YHWH had come upon Elijah. He tied up his skirts and
ran in front of Ahab all the way to Jezreel.

translation.text: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

verses.english:
The hand of YHWH had come upon Elijah. He tied up his skirts and
ran in front of Ahab all the way to Jezreel.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד אַחְאָב לְאִיזֶבֶל אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֵלִיָּהוּ וְאֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר הָרַג אֶת־כּל־הַנְּבִיאִים בֶּחָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֵּד אַחְאָב לְאִיזֶבֶל אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֵלִיָּהוּ וְאֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר הָרַג אֶת־כּל־הַנְּבִיאִים בֶּחָרֶב׃

english.text:
When Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done and how he had put
all the prophets to the sword,

translation.text: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.

verses.english:
When Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done and how he had put
all the prophets to the sword,

verses.hebrew: וַתִּשְׁלַח אִיזֶבֶל מַלְאָךְ אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־יַעֲשׂוּן אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִפוּן כִּי־כָעֵת מָחָר אָשִׂים אֶת־נַפְשְׁךָ כְּנֶפֶשׁ אַחַד מֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּשְׁלַח אִיזֶבֶל מַלְאָךְ אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־יַעֲשׂוּן אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִפוּן כִּי־כָעֵת מָחָר אָשִׂים אֶת־נַפְשְׁךָ כְּנֶפֶשׁ אַחַד מֵהֶם׃

english.text:
Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “Thus and more may the
gods do if by this time tomorrow I have not made you like one of
them.”

translation.text: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.

verses.english:
Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “Thus and more may the
gods do if by this time tomorrow I have not made you like one of
them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־נַפְשׁוֹ וַיָּבֹא בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה וַיַּנַּח אֶת־נַעֲרוֹ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־נַפְשׁוֹ וַיָּבֹא בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה וַיַּנַּח אֶת־נַעֲרוֹ שָׁם׃

english.text:
Frightened, he fled at once for his life. He came to Beer-sheba,
which is in Judah, and left his servant there;

translation.text: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.

verses.english:
Frightened, he fled at once for his life. He came to Beer-sheba,
which is in Judah, and left his servant there;

verses.hebrew:
וְהוּא־הָלַךְ בַּמִּדְבָּר דֶּרֶךְ יוֹם וַיָּבֹא וַיֵּשֶׁב תַּחַת רֹתֶם (אחת) [אֶחָד] וַיִּשְׁאַל אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת וַיֹּאמֶר רַב עַתָּה יְהֹוָה קַח נַפְשִׁי כִּי־לֹא־טוֹב
אָנֹכִי מֵאֲבֹתָי׃

hebrew.text:
וְהוּא־הָלַךְ בַּמִּדְבָּר דֶּרֶךְ יוֹם וַיָּבֹא וַיֵּשֶׁב תַּחַת רֹתֶם (אחת) [אֶחָד] וַיִּשְׁאַל אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת וַיֹּאמֶר רַב עַתָּה יְהֹוָה קַח נַפְשִׁי כִּי־לֹא־טוֹב
אָנֹכִי מֵאֲבֹתָי׃

english.text:
he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness. He came to a
broom bush and sat down under it, and prayed that he might die.
“Enough!” he cried. “Now, O LORD, take my life, for I am no better
than my fathers.”

translation.text: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O LORD, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.

verses.english:
he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness. He came to a
broom bush and sat down under it, and prayed that he might die.
“Enough!” he cried. “Now, O LORD, take my life, for I am no better
than my fathers.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב וַיִּישַׁן תַּחַת רֹתֶם אֶחָד וְהִנֵּה־זֶה מַלְאָךְ נֹגֵעַ בּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ קוּם אֱכוֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב וַיִּישַׁן תַּחַת רֹתֶם אֶחָד וְהִנֵּה־זֶה מַלְאָךְ נֹגֵעַ בּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ קוּם אֱכוֹל׃

english.text:
He lay down and fell asleep under a broom bush. Suddenly an angel
touched him and said to him, “Arise and eat.”

translation.text: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.

verses.english:
He lay down and fell asleep under a broom bush. Suddenly an angel
touched him and said to him, “Arise and eat.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּבֵּט וְהִנֵּה מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו עֻגַת רְצָפִים וְצַפַּחַת מָיִם וַיֹּאכַל וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיָּשׁב וַיִּשְׁכָּב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּבֵּט וְהִנֵּה מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו עֻגַת רְצָפִים וְצַפַּחַת מָיִם וַיֹּאכַל וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיָּשׁב וַיִּשְׁכָּב׃

english.text:
He looked about; and there, beside his head, was a cake baked on
hot stones and a jar of water! He ate and drank, and lay down
again.

translation.text: And he looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.

verses.english:
He looked about; and there, beside his head, was a cake baked on
hot stones and a jar of water! He ate and drank, and lay down
again.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה שֵׁנִית וַיִּגַּע־בּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר קוּם אֱכֹל כִּי רַב מִמְּךָ הַדָּרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה שֵׁנִית וַיִּגַּע־בּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר קוּם אֱכֹל כִּי רַב מִמְּךָ הַדָּרֶךְ׃

english.text:
The angel of YHWH came a second time and touched him and said,
“Arise and eat, or the journey will be too much for you.”

translation.text: And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for thee.

verses.english:
The angel of YHWH came a second time and touched him and said,
“Arise and eat, or the journey will be too much for you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם וַיֹּאכַל וַיִּשְׁתֶּה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכֹחַ הָאֲכִילָה הַהִיא אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לַיְלָה עַד הַר הָאֱלֹהִים חֹרֵב׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם וַיֹּאכַל וַיִּשְׁתֶּה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכֹחַ הָאֲכִילָה הַהִיא אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לַיְלָה עַד הַר הָאֱלֹהִים חֹרֵב׃

english.text:
He arose and ate and drank; and with the strength from that meal
he walked forty days and forty nights as far as the mountain of
God at Horeb.

translation.text: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.

verses.english:
He arose and ate and drank; and with the strength from that meal
he walked forty days and forty nights as far as the mountain of
God at Horeb.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא־שָׁם אֶל־הַמְּעָרָה וַיָּלֶן שָׁם וְהִנֵּה דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מַה־לְּךָ פֹה אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא־שָׁם אֶל־הַמְּעָרָה וַיָּלֶן שָׁם וְהִנֵּה דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מַה־לְּךָ פֹה אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
There he went into a cave, and there he spent the night. Then the
word of YHWH came to him. He said to him, “Why are you here,
Elijah?”

translation.text: And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of the LORD came to him, and he said unto him, What doest thou here, Elijah?

verses.english:
There he went into a cave, and there he spent the night. Then the
word of YHWH came to him. He said to him, “Why are you here,
Elijah?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר קַנֹּא קִנֵּאתִי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת כִּי־עָזְבוּ בְרִיתְךָ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתֶיךָ הָרָסוּ וְאֶת־נְבִיאֶיךָ הָרְגוּ בֶחָרֶב וָאִוָּתֵר אֲנִי לְבַדִּי
וַיְבַקְשׁוּ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי לְקַחְתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר קַנֹּא קִנֵּאתִי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת כִּי־עָזְבוּ בְרִיתְךָ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתֶיךָ הָרָסוּ וְאֶת־נְבִיאֶיךָ הָרְגוּ בֶחָרֶב וָאִוָּתֵר אֲנִי לְבַדִּי
וַיְבַקְשׁוּ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי לְקַחְתָּהּ׃

english.text:
He replied, “I am moved by zeal for YHWH, the God of Hosts, for
the Israelites have forsaken Your covenant, torn down Your altars,
and put Your prophets to the sword. I alone am left, and they are
out to take my life.”

translation.text: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

verses.english:
He replied, “I am moved by zeal for YHWH, the God of Hosts, for
the Israelites have forsaken Your covenant, torn down Your altars,
and put Your prophets to the sword. I alone am left, and they are
out to take my life.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר צֵא וְעָמַדְתָּ בָהָר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְהִנֵּה יְהֹוָה עֹבֵר וְרוּחַ גְּדוֹלָה וְחָזָק מְפָרֵק הָרִים וּמְשַׁבֵּר סְלָעִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא בָרוּחַ יְהֹוָה וְאַחַר
הָרוּחַ רַעַשׁ לֹא בָרַעַשׁ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר צֵא וְעָמַדְתָּ בָהָר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְהִנֵּה יְהֹוָה עֹבֵר וְרוּחַ גְּדוֹלָה וְחָזָק מְפָרֵק הָרִים וּמְשַׁבֵּר סְלָעִים לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא בָרוּחַ יְהֹוָה וְאַחַר
הָרוּחַ רַעַשׁ לֹא בָרַעַשׁ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Come out,” He called, “and stand on the mountain before YHWH.”
And lo, YHWH passed by. There was a great and mighty wind,
splitting mountains and shattering rocks by the power of YHWH; but
YHWH was not in the wind. After the wind—an earthquake; but YHWH
was not in the earthquake.

translation.text: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before the LORD.

verses.english:
“Come out,” He called, “and stand on the mountain before YHWH.”
And lo, YHWH passed by. There was a great and mighty wind,
splitting mountains and shattering rocks by the power of YHWH; but
YHWH was not in the wind. After the wind—an earthquake; but YHWH
was not in the earthquake.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר הָרַעַשׁ אֵשׁ לֹא בָאֵשׁ יְהֹוָה וְאַחַר הָאֵשׁ קוֹל דְּמָמָה דַקָּה׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחַר הָרַעַשׁ אֵשׁ לֹא בָאֵשׁ יְהֹוָה וְאַחַר הָאֵשׁ קוֹל דְּמָמָה דַקָּה׃

english.text:
After the earthquake—fire; but YHWH was not in the fire. And after
the fire—a soft murmuring sound.

verses.english:
After the earthquake—fire; but YHWH was not in the fire. And after
the fire—a soft murmuring sound.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיָּלֶט פָּנָיו בְּאַדַּרְתּוֹ וַיֵּצֵא וַיַּעֲמֹד פֶּתַח הַמְּעָרָה וְהִנֵּה אֵלָיו קוֹל וַיֹּאמֶר מַה־לְּךָ פֹה אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיָּלֶט פָּנָיו בְּאַדַּרְתּוֹ וַיֵּצֵא וַיַּעֲמֹד פֶּתַח הַמְּעָרָה וְהִנֵּה אֵלָיו קוֹל וַיֹּאמֶר מַה־לְּךָ פֹה אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his mantle about his face and
went out and stood at the entrance of the cave. Then a voice
addressed him: “Why are you here, Elijah?”

translation.text: And it was so, when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold, there came a voice unto him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?

verses.english:
When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his mantle about his face and
went out and stood at the entrance of the cave. Then a voice
addressed him: “Why are you here, Elijah?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר קַנֹּא קִנֵּאתִי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת כִּי־עָזְבוּ בְרִיתְךָ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתֶיךָ הָרָסוּ וְאֶת־נְבִיאֶיךָ הָרְגוּ בֶחָרֶב וָאִוָּתֵר אֲנִי לְבַדִּי
וַיְבַקְשׁוּ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי לְקַחְתָּהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר קַנֹּא קִנֵּאתִי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת כִּי־עָזְבוּ בְרִיתְךָ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתֶיךָ הָרָסוּ וְאֶת־נְבִיאֶיךָ הָרְגוּ בֶחָרֶב וָאִוָּתֵר אֲנִי לְבַדִּי
וַיְבַקְשׁוּ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי לְקַחְתָּהּ׃

english.text:
He answered, “I am moved by zeal for YHWH, the God of Hosts; for
the Israelites have forsaken Your covenant, torn down Your altars,
and have put Your prophets to the sword. I alone am left, and they
are out to take my life.”

translation.text: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

verses.english:
He answered, “I am moved by zeal for YHWH, the God of Hosts; for
the Israelites have forsaken Your covenant, torn down Your altars,
and have put Your prophets to the sword. I alone am left, and they
are out to take my life.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵךְ שׁוּב לְדַרְכְּךָ מִדְבַּרָה דַמָּשֶׂק וּבָאתָ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת־חֲזָאֵל לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־אֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו לֵךְ שׁוּב לְדַרְכְּךָ מִדְבַּרָה דַמָּשֶׂק וּבָאתָ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת־חֲזָאֵל לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־אֲרָם׃

english.text:
YHWH said to him, “Go back by the way you came, [and] on to the
wilderness of Damascus. When you get there, anoint Hazael as king
of Aram.

translation.text: And the LORD said unto him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when thou comest, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria:

verses.english:
YHWH said to him, “Go back by the way you came, [and] on to the
wilderness of Damascus. When you get there, anoint Hazael as king
of Aram.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת יֵהוּא בֶן־נִמְשִׁי תִּמְשַׁח לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־אֱלִישָׁע בֶּן־שָׁפָט מֵאָבֵל מְחוֹלָה תִּמְשַׁח לְנָבִיא תַּחְתֶּיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת יֵהוּא בֶן־נִמְשִׁי תִּמְשַׁח לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־אֱלִישָׁע בֶּן־שָׁפָט מֵאָבֵל מְחוֹלָה תִּמְשַׁח לְנָבִיא תַּחְתֶּיךָ׃

english.text:
Also anoint Jehu son of Nimshi as king of Israel, and anoint
Elisha son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah to succeed you as prophet.

translation.text: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint to be king over Israel: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abelmeholah shalt thou anoint to be prophet in thy room.

verses.english:
Also anoint Jehu son of Nimshi as king of Israel, and anoint
Elisha son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah to succeed you as prophet.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַנִּמְלָט מֵחֶרֶב חֲזָאֵל יָמִית יֵהוּא וְהַנִּמְלָט מֵחֶרֶב יֵהוּא יָמִית אֱלִישָׁע׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה הַנִּמְלָט מֵחֶרֶב חֲזָאֵל יָמִית יֵהוּא וְהַנִּמְלָט מֵחֶרֶב יֵהוּא יָמִית אֱלִישָׁע׃

english.text:
Whoever escapes the sword of Hazael shall be slain by Jehu, and
whoever escapes the sword of Jehu shall be slain by Elisha.

translation.text: And it shall come to pass, that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.

verses.english:
Whoever escapes the sword of Hazael shall be slain by Jehu, and
whoever escapes the sword of Jehu shall be slain by Elisha.

verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁאַרְתִּי בְיִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים כּל־הַבִּרְכַּיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־כָרְעוּ לַבַּעַל וְכל־הַפֶּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נָשַׁק לוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִשְׁאַרְתִּי בְיִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים כּל־הַבִּרְכַּיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־כָרְעוּ לַבַּעַל וְכל־הַפֶּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נָשַׁק לוֹ׃

english.text:
I will leave in Israel only seven thousand—every knee that has not
knelt to Baal and every mouth that has not kissed him.”

translation.text: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which hath not kissed him.

verses.english:
I will leave in Israel only seven thousand—every knee that has not
knelt to Baal and every mouth that has not kissed him.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־אֱלִישָׁע בֶּן־שָׁפָט וְהוּא חֹרֵשׁ שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר צְמָדִים לְפָנָיו וְהוּא בִּשְׁנֵים הֶעָשָׂר וַיַּעֲבֹר אֵלִיָּהוּ אֵלָיו וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ
אַדַּרְתּוֹ אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־אֱלִישָׁע בֶּן־שָׁפָט וְהוּא חֹרֵשׁ שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר צְמָדִים לְפָנָיו וְהוּא בִּשְׁנֵים הֶעָשָׂר וַיַּעֲבֹר אֵלִיָּהוּ אֵלָיו וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ
אַדַּרְתּוֹ אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
He set out from there and came upon Elisha son of Shaphat as he
was plowing. There were twelve yoke of oxen ahead of him, and he
was with the twelfth. Elijah came over to him and threw his mantle
over him.

translation.text: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.

verses.english:
He set out from there and came upon Elisha son of Shaphat as he
was plowing. There were twelve yoke of oxen ahead of him, and he
was with the twelfth. Elijah came over to him and threw his mantle
over him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת־הַבָּקָר וַיָּרץ אַחֲרֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶשְּׁקָה־נָּא לְאָבִי וּלְאִמִּי וְאֵלְכָה אַחֲרֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ שׁוּב כִּי מֶה־עָשִׂיתִי לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת־הַבָּקָר וַיָּרץ אַחֲרֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶשְּׁקָה־נָּא לְאָבִי וּלְאִמִּי וְאֵלְכָה אַחֲרֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ שׁוּב כִּי מֶה־עָשִׂיתִי לָךְ׃

english.text:
He left the oxen and ran after Elijah, saying: “Let me kiss my
father and mother good-by, and I will follow you.” And he answered
him, “Go back. What have I done to you?”

translation.text: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray thee, kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow thee. And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to thee?

verses.english:
He left the oxen and ran after Elijah, saying: “Let me kiss my
father and mother good-by, and I will follow you.” And he answered
him, “Go back. What have I done to you?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשׁב מֵאַחֲרָיו וַיִּקַּח אֶת־צֶמֶד הַבָּקָר וַיִּזְבָּחֵהוּ וּבִכְלִי הַבָּקָר בִּשְּׁלָם הַבָּשָׂר וַיִּתֵּן לָעָם וַיֹּאכֵלוּ וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ
וַיְשָׁרְתֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשׁב מֵאַחֲרָיו וַיִּקַּח אֶת־צֶמֶד הַבָּקָר וַיִּזְבָּחֵהוּ וּבִכְלִי הַבָּקָר בִּשְּׁלָם הַבָּשָׂר וַיִּתֵּן לָעָם וַיֹּאכֵלוּ וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ
וַיְשָׁרְתֵהוּ׃

english.text:
He turned back from him and took the yoke of oxen and slaughtered
them; he boiled their meat with the gear of the oxen and gave it
to the people, and they ate. Then he arose and followed Elijah and
became his attendant.

translation.text: And he returned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave unto the people, and they did eat. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and ministered unto him.

verses.english:
He turned back from him and took the yoke of oxen and slaughtered
them; he boiled their meat with the gear of the oxen and gave it
to the people, and they ate. Then he arose and followed Elijah and
became his attendant.

verses.hebrew: וּבֶן־הֲדַד מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם קָבַץ אֶת־כּל־חֵילוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁנַיִם מֶלֶךְ אִתּוֹ וְסוּס וָרָכֶב וַיַּעַל וַיָּצַר עַל־שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּלָּחֶם בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: וּבֶן־הֲדַד מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם קָבַץ אֶת־כּל־חֵילוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁנַיִם מֶלֶךְ אִתּוֹ וְסוּס וָרָכֶב וַיַּעַל וַיָּצַר עַל־שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּלָּחֶם בָּהּ׃

english.text:
King Ben-hadad of Aram gathered his whole army; thirty-two kings
accompanied him with horses and chariots. He advanced against
Samaria, laid siege to it, and attacked it.

translation.text: And Benhadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots; and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.

verses.english:
King Ben-hadad of Aram gathered his whole army; thirty-two kings
accompanied him with horses and chariots. He advanced against
Samaria, laid siege to it, and attacked it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָעִירָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָעִירָה׃

english.text: And he sent messengers to Ahab inside the city

translation.text: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said unto him, Thus saith Benhadad,

verses.english: And he sent messengers to Ahab inside the city

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כֹּה אָמַר בֶּן־הֲדַד כַּסְפְּךָ וּזְהָבְךָ לִי־הוּא וְנָשֶׁיךָ וּבָנֶיךָ הַטּוֹבִים לִי־הֵם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כֹּה אָמַר בֶּן־הֲדַד כַּסְפְּךָ וּזְהָבְךָ לִי־הוּא וְנָשֶׁיךָ וּבָנֶיךָ הַטּוֹבִים לִי־הֵם׃

english.text:
to say to him, “Thus said Ben-hadad: Your silver and gold are
mine, and your beautiful wives and children are mine.”

translation.text: Thy silver and thy gold is mine; thy wives also and thy children, even the goodliest, are mine.

verses.english:
to say to him, “Thus said Ben-hadad: Your silver and gold are
mine, and your beautiful wives and children are mine.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר כִּדְבָרְךָ אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לְךָ אֲנִי וְכל־אֲשֶׁר־לִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר כִּדְבָרְךָ אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לְךָ אֲנִי וְכל־אֲשֶׁר־לִי׃

english.text:
The king of Israel replied, “As you say, my lord king: I and all I
have are yours.”

translation.text: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I am thine, and all that I have.

verses.english:
The king of Israel replied, “As you say, my lord king: I and all I
have are yours.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ כֹּה־אָמַר בֶּן־הֲדַד לֵאמֹר כִּי־שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר כַּסְפְּךָ וּזְהָבְךָ וְנָשֶׁיךָ וּבָנֶיךָ לִי תִתֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ כֹּה־אָמַר בֶּן־הֲדַד לֵאמֹר כִּי־שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר כַּסְפְּךָ וּזְהָבְךָ וְנָשֶׁיךָ וּבָנֶיךָ לִי תִתֵּן׃

english.text:
Then the messengers came again and said, “Thus said Ben-hadad:
When I sent you the order to give me your silver and gold, and
your wives and children,

translation.text: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Benhadad, saying, Although I have sent unto thee, saying, Thou shalt deliver me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;

verses.english:
Then the messengers came again and said, “Thus said Ben-hadad:
When I sent you the order to give me your silver and gold, and
your wives and children,

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־כָּעֵת מָחָר אֶשְׁלַח אֶת־עֲבָדַי אֵלֶיךָ וְחִפְּשׂוּ אֶת־בֵּיתְךָ וְאֵת בָּתֵּי עֲבָדֶיךָ וְהָיָה כּל־מַחְמַד עֵינֶיךָ יָשִׂימוּ בְיָדָם וְלָקָחוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם־כָּעֵת מָחָר אֶשְׁלַח אֶת־עֲבָדַי אֵלֶיךָ וְחִפְּשׂוּ אֶת־בֵּיתְךָ וְאֵת בָּתֵּי עֲבָדֶיךָ וְהָיָה כּל־מַחְמַד עֵינֶיךָ יָשִׂימוּ בְיָדָם וְלָקָחוּ׃

english.text:
I meant that tomorrow at this time I will send my servants to you
and they will search your house and the houses of your courtiers
and seize everything you prize and take it away.”

translation.text: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put it in their hand, and take it away.

verses.english:
I meant that tomorrow at this time I will send my servants to you
and they will search your house and the houses of your courtiers
and seize everything you prize and take it away.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְכל־זִקְנֵי הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאמֶר דְּעוּ־נָא וּרְאוּ כִּי רָעָה זֶה מְבַקֵּשׁ כִּי־שָׁלַח אֵלַי לְנָשַׁי וּלְבָנַי וּלְכַסְפִּי וְלִזְהָבִי וְלֹא
מָנַעְתִּי מִמֶּנּוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְכל־זִקְנֵי הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאמֶר דְּעוּ־נָא וּרְאוּ כִּי רָעָה זֶה מְבַקֵּשׁ כִּי־שָׁלַח אֵלַי לְנָשַׁי וּלְבָנַי וּלְכַסְפִּי וְלִזְהָבִי וְלֹא
מָנַעְתִּי מִמֶּנּוּ׃

english.text:
Then the king of Israel summoned all the elders of the land, and
he said, “See for yourselves how that man is bent on evil! For
when he demanded my wives and my children, my silver and my gold,
I did not refuse him.”

translation.text: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeketh mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.

verses.english:
Then the king of Israel summoned all the elders of the land, and
he said, “See for yourselves how that man is bent on evil! For
when he demanded my wives and my children, my silver and my gold,
I did not refuse him.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כּל־הַזְּקֵנִים וְכל־הָעָם אַל־תִּשְׁמַע וְלוֹא תֹאבֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כּל־הַזְּקֵנִים וְכל־הָעָם אַל־תִּשְׁמַע וְלוֹא תֹאבֶה׃

english.text:
All the elders and all the people said, “Do not obey and do not
submit!”

translation.text: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him, nor consent.

verses.english:
All the elders and all the people said, “Do not obey and do not
submit!”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לְמַלְאֲכֵי בֶן־הֲדַד אִמְרוּ לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַחְתָּ אֶל־עַבְדְּךָ בָרִאשֹׁנָה אֶעֱשֶׂה וְהַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲשׂוֹת וַיֵּלְכוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים
וַיְשִׁבֻהוּ דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לְמַלְאֲכֵי בֶן־הֲדַד אִמְרוּ לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַחְתָּ אֶל־עַבְדְּךָ בָרִאשֹׁנָה אֶעֱשֶׂה וְהַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲשׂוֹת וַיֵּלְכוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים
וַיְשִׁבֻהוּ דָּבָר׃

english.text:
So he said to Ben-hadad’s messengers, “Tell my lord the king: All
that you first demanded of your servant I shall do, but this thing
I cannot do.” The messengers went and reported this to him.

translation.text: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Benhadad, Tell my lord the king, All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.

verses.english:
So he said to Ben-hadad’s messengers, “Tell my lord the king: All
that you first demanded of your servant I shall do, but this thing
I cannot do.” The messengers went and reported this to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלָיו בֶּן־הֲדַד וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־יַעֲשׂוּן לִי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִפוּ אִם־יִשְׂפֹּק עֲפַר שֹׁמְרוֹן לִשְׁעָלִים לְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלָיו בֶּן־הֲדַד וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־יַעֲשׂוּן לִי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִפוּ אִם־יִשְׂפֹּק עֲפַר שֹׁמְרוֹן לִשְׁעָלִים לְכל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלָי׃

english.text:
Thereupon Ben-hadad sent him this message: “May the gods do thus
to me and even more, if the dust of Samaria will provide even a
handful for each of the men who follow me!”

translation.text: And Benhadad sent unto him, and said, The gods do so unto me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.

verses.english:
Thereupon Ben-hadad sent him this message: “May the gods do thus
to me and even more, if the dust of Samaria will provide even a
handful for each of the men who follow me!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר דַּבְּרוּ אַל־יִתְהַלֵּל חֹגֵר כִּמְפַתֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַן מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר דַּבְּרוּ אַל־יִתְהַלֵּל חֹגֵר כִּמְפַתֵּחַ׃

english.text:
The king of Israel replied, “Tell him: Let not him who girds on
his sword boast like him who ungirds it!”

translation.text: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.

verses.english:
The king of Israel replied, “Tell him: Let not him who girds on
his sword boast like him who ungirds it!”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְהוּא שֹׁתֶה הוּא וְהַמְּלָכִים בַּסֻּכּוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־עֲבָדָיו שִׂימוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל־הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְהוּא שֹׁתֶה הוּא וְהַמְּלָכִים בַּסֻּכּוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־עֲבָדָיו שִׂימוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל־הָעִיר׃

english.text:
On hearing this reply—while he and the other kings were drinking
together at Succoth—he commanded his followers, “Advance!” And
they advanced against the city.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Benhadad heard this message, as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, that he said unto his servants, Set yourselves in array. And they set themselves in array against the city.

verses.english:
On hearing this reply—while he and the other kings were drinking
together at Succoth—he commanded his followers, “Advance!” And
they advanced against the city.

verses.hebrew:
וְהִנֵּה נָבִיא אֶחָד נִגַּשׁ אֶל־אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הֲרָאִיתָ אֵת כּל־הֶהָמוֹן הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה הִנְנִי נֹתְנוֹ בְיָדְךָ הַיּוֹם וְיָדַעְתָּ
כִּי־אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְהִנֵּה נָבִיא אֶחָד נִגַּשׁ אֶל־אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הֲרָאִיתָ אֵת כּל־הֶהָמוֹן הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה הִנְנִי נֹתְנוֹ בְיָדְךָ הַיּוֹם וְיָדַעְתָּ
כִּי־אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Then a certain prophet went up to King Ahab of Israel and said,
“Thus said YHWH: Do you see that great host? I will deliver it
into your hands today, and you shall know that I am YHWH.”

translation.text: And, behold, there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into thine hand this day; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.

verses.english:
Then a certain prophet went up to King Ahab of Israel and said,
“Thus said YHWH: Do you see that great host? I will deliver it
into your hands today, and you shall know that I am YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַחְאָב בְּמִי וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה בְּנַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר מִי־יֶאְסֹר הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיֹּאמֶר אָתָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַחְאָב בְּמִי וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה בְּנַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר מִי־יֶאְסֹר הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיֹּאמֶר אָתָּה׃

english.text:
“Through whom?” asked Ahab. He answered, “Thus said YHWH: Through
the aides of the provincial governors.” He asked, “Who shall begin
the battle?” And he answered, “You.”

translation.text: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, Thou.

verses.english:
“Through whom?” asked Ahab. He answered, “Thus said YHWH: Through
the aides of the provincial governors.” He asked, “Who shall begin
the battle?” And he answered, “You.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקֹד אֶת־נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וַיִּהְיוּ מָאתַיִם שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וְאַחֲרֵיהֶם פָּקַד אֶת־כּל־הָעָם כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְקֹד אֶת־נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וַיִּהְיוּ מָאתַיִם שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וְאַחֲרֵיהֶם פָּקַד אֶת־כּל־הָעָם כּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים׃

english.text:
So he mustered the aides of the provincial governors, 232 strong,
and then he mustered all the troops—all the Israelites—7,000
strong.

translation.text: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.

verses.english:
So he mustered the aides of the provincial governors, 232 strong,
and then he mustered all the troops—all the Israelites—7,000
strong.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ בַּצּהֳרָיִם וּבֶן־הֲדַד שֹׁתֶה שִׁכּוֹר בַּסֻּכּוֹת הוּא וְהַמְּלָכִים שְׁלֹשִׁים־וּשְׁנַיִם מֶלֶךְ עֹזֵר אֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ בַּצּהֳרָיִם וּבֶן־הֲדַד שֹׁתֶה שִׁכּוֹר בַּסֻּכּוֹת הוּא וְהַמְּלָכִים שְׁלֹשִׁים־וּשְׁנַיִם מֶלֶךְ עֹזֵר אֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
They marched out at noon, while Ben-hadad was drinking himself
drunk at Succoth together with the thirty-two kings allied with
him.

translation.text: And they went out at noon. But Benhadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped him.

verses.english:
They marched out at noon, while Ben-hadad was drinking himself
drunk at Succoth together with the thirty-two kings allied with
him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת בָּרִאשֹׁנָה וַיִּשְׁלַח בֶּן־הֲדַד וַיַּגִּידוּ לוֹ לֵאמֹר אֲנָשִׁים יָצְאוּ מִשֹּׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת בָּרִאשֹׁנָה וַיִּשְׁלַח בֶּן־הֲדַד וַיַּגִּידוּ לוֹ לֵאמֹר אֲנָשִׁים יָצְאוּ מִשֹּׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
The aides of the provincial governors rushed out first. Ben-hadad
sent [scouts], who told him, “Some men have come out from
Samaria.”

translation.text: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Benhadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.

verses.english:
The aides of the provincial governors rushed out first. Ben-hadad
sent [scouts], who told him, “Some men have come out from
Samaria.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם־לְשָׁלוֹם יָצָאוּ תִּפְשׂוּם חַיִּים וְאִם לְמִלְחָמָה יָצָאוּ חַיִּים תִּפְשׂוּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם־לְשָׁלוֹם יָצָאוּ תִּפְשׂוּם חַיִּים וְאִם לְמִלְחָמָה יָצָאוּ חַיִּים תִּפְשׂוּם׃

english.text:
He said, “If they have come out to surrender, take them alive; and
if they have come out for battle, take them alive anyhow.”

translation.text: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.

verses.english:
He said, “If they have come out to surrender, take them alive; and
if they have come out for battle, take them alive anyhow.”

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה יָצְאוּ מִן־הָעִיר נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וְהַחַיִל אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵלֶּה יָצְאוּ מִן־הָעִיר נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וְהַחַיִל אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
But the others—the aides of the provincial governors, with the
army behind them—had already rushed out of the city,

translation.text: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.

verses.english:
But the others—the aides of the provincial governors, with the
army behind them—had already rushed out of the city,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכּוּ אִישׁ אִישׁוֹ וַיָּנֻסוּ אֲרָם וַיִּרְדְּפֵם יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמָּלֵט בֶּן־הֲדַד מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם עַל־סוּס וּפָרָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּכּוּ אִישׁ אִישׁוֹ וַיָּנֻסוּ אֲרָם וַיִּרְדְּפֵם יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמָּלֵט בֶּן־הֲדַד מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם עַל־סוּס וּפָרָשִׁים׃

english.text:
and each of them struck down his opponent. The Arameans fled, and
Israel pursued them; but King Ben-hadad of Aram escaped on a horse
with other horsemen.

translation.text: And they slew every one his man: and the Syrians fled; and Israel pursued them: and Benhadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen.

verses.english:
and each of them struck down his opponent. The Arameans fled, and
Israel pursued them; but King Ben-hadad of Aram escaped on a horse
with other horsemen.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַסּוּס וְאֶת־הָרָכֶב וְהִכָּה בַאֲרָם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַסּוּס וְאֶת־הָרָכֶב וְהִכָּה בַאֲרָם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה׃

english.text:
The king of Israel came out and attacked the horses and chariots,
and inflicted a great defeat on the Arameans.

translation.text: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.

verses.english:
The king of Israel came out and attacked the horses and chariots,
and inflicted a great defeat on the Arameans.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ הַנָּבִיא אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ הִתְחַזַּק וְדַע וּרְאֵה אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂה כִּי לִתְשׁוּבַת הַשָּׁנָה מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם עֹלֶה עָלֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגַּשׁ הַנָּבִיא אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ הִתְחַזַּק וְדַע וּרְאֵה אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂה כִּי לִתְשׁוּבַת הַשָּׁנָה מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם עֹלֶה עָלֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Then the prophet approached the king of Israel and said to him,
“Go, keep up your efforts, and consider well what you must do; for
the king of Aram will attack you at the turn of the year.”

translation.text: And the prophet came to the king of Israel, and said unto him, Go, strengthen thyself, and mark, and see what thou doest: for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee.

verses.english:
Then the prophet approached the king of Israel and said to him,
“Go, keep up your efforts, and consider well what you must do; for
the king of Aram will attack you at the turn of the year.”

verses.hebrew: וְעַבְדֵי מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם אָמְרוּ אֵלָיו אֱלֹהֵי הָרִים אֱלֹהֵיהֶם עַל־כֵּן חָזְקוּ מִמֶּנּוּ וְאוּלָם נִלָּחֵם אִתָּם בַּמִּישׁוֹר אִם־לֹא נֶחֱזַק מֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַבְדֵי מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם אָמְרוּ אֵלָיו אֱלֹהֵי הָרִים אֱלֹהֵיהֶם עַל־כֵּן חָזְקוּ מִמֶּנּוּ וְאוּלָם נִלָּחֵם אִתָּם בַּמִּישׁוֹר אִם־לֹא נֶחֱזַק מֵהֶם׃

english.text:
Now the ministers of the king of Aram said to him, “Their God is a
God of mountains; that is why they got the better of us. But if we
fight them in the plain, we will surely get the better of them.

translation.text: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him, Their gods are gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.

verses.english:
Now the ministers of the king of Aram said to him, “Their God is a
God of mountains; that is why they got the better of us. But if we
fight them in the plain, we will surely get the better of them.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עֲשֵׂה הָסֵר הַמְּלָכִים אִישׁ מִמְּקֹמוֹ וְשִׂים פַּחוֹת תַּחְתֵּיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עֲשֵׂה הָסֵר הַמְּלָכִים אִישׁ מִמְּקֹמוֹ וְשִׂים פַּחוֹת תַּחְתֵּיהֶם׃

english.text:
Do this: Remove all the kings from their posts and appoint
governors in their place.

translation.text: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:

verses.english:
Do this: Remove all the kings from their posts and appoint
governors in their place.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תִמְנֶה־לְךָ חַיִל כַּחַיִל הַנֹּפֵל מֵאוֹתָךְ וְסוּס כַּסּוּס וְרֶכֶב כָּרֶכֶב וְנִלָּחֲמָה אוֹתָם בַּמִּישׁוֹר אִם־לֹא נֶחֱזַק מֵהֶם וַיִּשְׁמַע לְקֹלָם וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וְאַתָּה תִמְנֶה־לְךָ חַיִל כַּחַיִל הַנֹּפֵל מֵאוֹתָךְ וְסוּס כַּסּוּס וְרֶכֶב כָּרֶכֶב וְנִלָּחֲמָה אוֹתָם בַּמִּישׁוֹר אִם־לֹא נֶחֱזַק מֵהֶם וַיִּשְׁמַע לְקֹלָם וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן׃

english.text:
Then muster for yourself an army equal to the army you lost, horse
for horse and chariot for chariot. And let us fight them in the
plain, and we will surely get the better of them.” He took their
advice and acted accordingly.

translation.text: And number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they. And he hearkened unto their voice, and did so.

verses.english:
Then muster for yourself an army equal to the army you lost, horse
for horse and chariot for chariot. And let us fight them in the
plain, and we will surely get the better of them.” He took their
advice and acted accordingly.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִתְשׁוּבַת הַשָּׁנָה וַיִּפְקֹד בֶּן־הֲדַד אֶת־אֲרָם וַיַּעַל אֲפֵקָה לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי לִתְשׁוּבַת הַשָּׁנָה וַיִּפְקֹד בֶּן־הֲדַד אֶת־אֲרָם וַיַּעַל אֲפֵקָה לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
At the turn of the year, Ben-hadad mustered the Arameans and
advanced on Aphek to fight Israel.

translation.text: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Benhadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.

verses.english:
At the turn of the year, Ben-hadad mustered the Arameans and
advanced on Aphek to fight Israel.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל התְפָּקְדוּ וְכלְכְּלוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ לִקְרָאתָם וַיַּחֲנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶגְדָּם כִּשְׁנֵי חֲשִׂפֵי עִזִּים וַאֲרָם מִלְאוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל התְפָּקְדוּ וְכלְכְּלוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ לִקְרָאתָם וַיַּחֲנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶגְדָּם כִּשְׁנֵי חֲשִׂפֵי עִזִּים וַאֲרָם מִלְאוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Now the Israelites had been mustered and provisioned, and they
went out against them; but when the Israelites encamped against
them, they looked like two flocks of goats, while the Arameans
covered the land.

translation.text: And the children of Israel were numbered, and were all present, and went against them: and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.

verses.english:
Now the Israelites had been mustered and provisioned, and they
went out against them; but when the Israelites encamped against
them, they looked like two flocks of goats, while the Arameans
covered the land.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּגַּשׁ אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ אֲרָם אֱלֹהֵי הָרִים יְהֹוָה וְלֹא־אֱלֹהֵי עֲמָקִים הוּא וְנָתַתִּי
אֶת־כּל־הֶהָמוֹן הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה בְּיָדֶךָ וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי־אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּגַּשׁ אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ אֲרָם אֱלֹהֵי הָרִים יְהֹוָה וְלֹא־אֱלֹהֵי עֲמָקִים הוּא וְנָתַתִּי
אֶת־כּל־הֶהָמוֹן הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה בְּיָדֶךָ וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי־אֲנִי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Then the man of God approached and spoke to the king of Israel,
“Thus said YHWH: Because the Arameans have said, ‘YHWH is a God of
mountains, but He is not a God of lowlands,’ I will deliver that
great host into your hands; and you shall know that I am YHWH.”

translation.text: And there came a man of God, and spake unto the king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the LORD, Because the Syrians have said, The LORD is God of the hills, but he is not God of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand, and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

verses.english:
Then the man of God approached and spoke to the king of Israel,
“Thus said YHWH: Because the Arameans have said, ‘YHWH is a God of
mountains, but He is not a God of lowlands,’ I will deliver that
great host into your hands; and you shall know that I am YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲנוּ אֵלֶּה נֹכַח־אֵלֶּה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַתִּקְרַב הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיַּכּוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־אֲרָם מֵאָה־אֶלֶף רַגְלִי בְּיוֹם אֶחָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּחֲנוּ אֵלֶּה נֹכַח־אֵלֶּה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַתִּקְרַב הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיַּכּוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־אֲרָם מֵאָה־אֶלֶף רַגְלִי בְּיוֹם אֶחָד׃

english.text:
For seven days they were encamped opposite each other. On the
seventh day, the battle was joined and the Israelites struck down
100,000 Aramean foot soldiers in one day.

translation.text: And they pitched one over against the other seven days. And so it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.

verses.english:
For seven days they were encamped opposite each other. On the
seventh day, the battle was joined and the Israelites struck down
100,000 Aramean foot soldiers in one day.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּנֻסוּ הַנּוֹתָרִים אֲפֵקָה אֶל־הָעִיר וַתִּפֹּל הַחוֹמָה עַל־עֶשְׂרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֶלֶף אִישׁ הַנּוֹתָרִים וּבֶן־הֲדַד נָס וַיָּבֹא אֶל־הָעִיר חֶדֶר בְּחָדֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּנֻסוּ הַנּוֹתָרִים אֲפֵקָה אֶל־הָעִיר וַתִּפֹּל הַחוֹמָה עַל־עֶשְׂרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֶלֶף אִישׁ הַנּוֹתָרִים וּבֶן־הֲדַד נָס וַיָּבֹא אֶל־הָעִיר חֶדֶר בְּחָדֶר׃

english.text:
The survivors fled to Aphek, inside the town, and the wall fell on
the 27,000 survivors. Ben-hadad also fled and took refuge inside
the town, in an inner chamber.

translation.text: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and there a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men that were left. And Benhadad fled, and came into the city, into an inner chamber.

verses.english:
The survivors fled to Aphek, inside the town, and the wall fell on
the 27,000 survivors. Ben-hadad also fled and took refuge inside
the town, in an inner chamber.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו עֲבָדָיו הִנֵּה־נָא שָׁמַעְנוּ כִּי מַלְכֵי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־מַלְכֵי חֶסֶד הֵם נָשִׂימָה נָּא שַׂקִּים בְּמתְנֵינוּ וַחֲבָלִים בְּרֹאשֵׁנוּ וְנֵצֵא
אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אוּלַי יְחַיֶּה אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו עֲבָדָיו הִנֵּה־נָא שָׁמַעְנוּ כִּי מַלְכֵי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־מַלְכֵי חֶסֶד הֵם נָשִׂימָה נָּא שַׂקִּים בְּמתְנֵינוּ וַחֲבָלִים בְּרֹאשֵׁנוּ וְנֵצֵא
אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אוּלַי יְחַיֶּה אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

english.text:
His ministers said to him, “We have heard that the kings of the
House of Israel are magnanimous kings. Let us put sackcloth on our
loins and ropes on our heads, and surrender to the king of Israel;
perhaps he will spare your life.”

translation.text: And his servants said unto him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel: peradventure he will save thy life.

verses.english:
His ministers said to him, “We have heard that the kings of the
House of Israel are magnanimous kings. Let us put sackcloth on our
loins and ropes on our heads, and surrender to the king of Israel;
perhaps he will spare your life.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּחְגְּרוּ שַׂקִּים בְּמתְנֵיהֶם וַחֲבָלִים בְּרָאשֵׁיהֶם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדְּךָ בֶן־הֲדַד אָמַר תְּחִי־נָא נַפְשִׁי וַיֹּאמֶר הַעוֹדֶנּוּ חַי
אָחִי הוּא׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּחְגְּרוּ שַׂקִּים בְּמתְנֵיהֶם וַחֲבָלִים בְּרָאשֵׁיהֶם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדְּךָ בֶן־הֲדַד אָמַר תְּחִי־נָא נַפְשִׁי וַיֹּאמֶר הַעוֹדֶנּוּ חַי
אָחִי הוּא׃

english.text:
So they girded sackcloth on their loins and wound ropes around
their heads, and came to the king of Israel and said, “Your
servant Ben-hadad says, ‘I beg you, spare my life.’” He replied,
“Is he still alive? He is my brother.”

translation.text: So they girded sackcloth on their loins, and put ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, Thy servant Benhadad saith, I pray thee, let me live. And he said, Is he yet alive? he is my brother.

verses.english:
So they girded sackcloth on their loins and wound ropes around
their heads, and came to the king of Israel and said, “Your
servant Ben-hadad says, ‘I beg you, spare my life.’” He replied,
“Is he still alive? He is my brother.”

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים יְנַחֲשׁוּ וַיְמַהֲרוּ וַיַּחְלְטוּ הֲמִמֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אָחִיךָ בֶן־הֲדַד וַיֹּאמֶר בֹּאוּ קָחֻהוּ וַיֵּצֵא אֵלָיו בֶּן־הֲדַד וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ עַל־הַמֶּרְכָּבָה׃

hebrew.text: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים יְנַחֲשׁוּ וַיְמַהֲרוּ וַיַּחְלְטוּ הֲמִמֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אָחִיךָ בֶן־הֲדַד וַיֹּאמֶר בֹּאוּ קָחֻהוּ וַיֵּצֵא אֵלָיו בֶּן־הֲדַד וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ עַל־הַמֶּרְכָּבָה׃

english.text:
The men divined his meaning and quickly caught the word from him,
saying, “Yes, Ben-hadad is your brother.” “Go, bring him,” he
said. Ben-hadad came out to him, and he invited him into his
chariot.

translation.text: Now the men did diligently observe whether any thing would come from him, and did hastily catch it: and they said, Thy brother Benhadad. Then he said, Go ye, bring him. Then Benhadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

verses.english:
The men divined his meaning and quickly caught the word from him,
saying, “Yes, Ben-hadad is your brother.” “Go, bring him,” he
said. Ben-hadad came out to him, and he invited him into his
chariot.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר־לָקַח־אָבִי מֵאֵת אָבִיךָ אָשִׁיב וְחֻצוֹת תָּשִׂים לְךָ בְדַמֶּשֶׂק כַּאֲשֶׁר־שָׂם אָבִי בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַאֲנִי בַּבְּרִית אֲשַׁלְּחֶךָּ
וַיִּכְרת־לוֹ בְרִית וַיְשַׁלְּחֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר־לָקַח־אָבִי מֵאֵת אָבִיךָ אָשִׁיב וְחֻצוֹת תָּשִׂים לְךָ בְדַמֶּשֶׂק כַּאֲשֶׁר־שָׂם אָבִי בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַאֲנִי בַּבְּרִית אֲשַׁלְּחֶךָּ
וַיִּכְרת־לוֹ בְרִית וַיְשַׁלְּחֵהוּ׃

english.text:
Ben-hadad said to him, “I will give back the towns that my father
took from your father, and you may set up bazaars for yourself in
Damascus as my father did in Samaria.” “And I, for my part,” [said
Ahab,] “will let you go home under these terms.” So he made a
treaty with him and dismissed him.

translation.text: And Benhadad said unto him, The cities, which my father took from thy father, I will restore; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then said Ahab, I will send thee away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.

verses.english:
Ben-hadad said to him, “I will give back the towns that my father
took from your father, and you may set up bazaars for yourself in
Damascus as my father did in Samaria.” “And I, for my part,” [said
Ahab,] “will let you go home under these terms.” So he made a
treaty with him and dismissed him.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֶחָד מִבְּנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים אָמַר אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה הַכֵּינִי נָא וַיְמָאֵן הָאִישׁ לְהַכֹּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ אֶחָד מִבְּנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים אָמַר אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה הַכֵּינִי נָא וַיְמָאֵן הָאִישׁ לְהַכֹּתוֹ׃

english.text:
A certain man, a disciple of the prophets, said to another, at the
word of YHWH, “Strike me”; but the man refused to strike him.

translation.text: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the LORD, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man refused to smite him.

verses.english:
A certain man, a disciple of the prophets, said to another, at the
word of YHWH, “Strike me”; but the man refused to strike him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה הִנְּךָ הוֹלֵךְ מֵאִתִּי וְהִכְּךָ הָאַרְיֵה וַיֵּלֶךְ מֵאֶצְלוֹ וַיִּמְצָאֵהוּ הָאַרְיֵה וַיַּכֵּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה הִנְּךָ הוֹלֵךְ מֵאִתִּי וְהִכְּךָ הָאַרְיֵה וַיֵּלֶךְ מֵאֶצְלוֹ וַיִּמְצָאֵהוּ הָאַרְיֵה וַיַּכֵּהוּ׃

english.text:
He said to him, “Because you have not obeyed YHWH, a lion will
strike you dead as soon as you leave me.” And when he left, a lion
came upon him and killed him.

translation.text: Then said he unto him, Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the LORD, behold, as soon as thou art departed from me, a lion shall slay thee.

verses.english:
He said to him, “Because you have not obeyed YHWH, a lion will
strike you dead as soon as you leave me.” And when he left, a lion
came upon him and killed him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצָא אִישׁ אַחֵר וַיֹּאמֶר הַכֵּינִי נָא וַיַּכֵּהוּ הָאִישׁ הַכֵּה וּפָצֹעַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְצָא אִישׁ אַחֵר וַיֹּאמֶר הַכֵּינִי נָא וַיַּכֵּהוּ הָאִישׁ הַכֵּה וּפָצֹעַ׃

english.text:
Then he met another man and said, “Come, strike me.” So the man
struck him and wounded him.

translation.text: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded him.

verses.english:
Then he met another man and said, “Come, strike me.” So the man
struck him and wounded him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַנָּבִיא וַיַּעֲמֹד לַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַדָּרֶךְ וַיִּתְחַפֵּשׂ בָּאֲפֵר עַל־עֵינָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַנָּבִיא וַיַּעֲמֹד לַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַדָּרֶךְ וַיִּתְחַפֵּשׂ בָּאֲפֵר עַל־עֵינָיו׃

english.text:
Then the prophet, disguised by a cloth over his eyes, went and
waited for the king by the road.

translation.text: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.

verses.english:
Then the prophet, disguised by a cloth over his eyes, went and
waited for the king by the road.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי הַמֶּלֶךְ עֹבֵר וְהוּא צָעַק אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר עַבְדְּךָ יָצָא בְקֶרֶב־הַמִּלְחָמָה וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ סָר וַיָּבֵא אֵלַי אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמֹר אֶת־הָאִישׁ הַזֶּה
אִם־הִפָּקֵד יִפָּקֵד וְהָיְתָה נַפְשְׁךָ תַּחַת נַפְשׁוֹ אוֹ כִכַּר־כֶּסֶף תִּשְׁקוֹל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי הַמֶּלֶךְ עֹבֵר וְהוּא צָעַק אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר עַבְדְּךָ יָצָא בְקֶרֶב־הַמִּלְחָמָה וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ סָר וַיָּבֵא אֵלַי אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמֹר אֶת־הָאִישׁ הַזֶּה
אִם־הִפָּקֵד יִפָּקֵד וְהָיְתָה נַפְשְׁךָ תַּחַת נַפְשׁוֹ אוֹ כִכַּר־כֶּסֶף תִּשְׁקוֹל׃

english.text:
As the king passed by, he cried out to the king and said, “Your
servant went out into the thick of the battle. Suddenly a man came
over and brought a man to me, saying, ‘Guard this man! If he is
missing, it will be your life for his, or you will have to pay a
talent of silver.’

translation.text: And as the king passed by, he cried unto the king: and he said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver.

verses.english:
As the king passed by, he cried out to the king and said, “Your
servant went out into the thick of the battle. Suddenly a man came
over and brought a man to me, saying, ‘Guard this man! If he is
missing, it will be your life for his, or you will have to pay a
talent of silver.’

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עַבְדְּךָ עֹשֵׂה הֵנָּה וָהֵנָּה וְהוּא אֵינֶנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֵּן מִשְׁפָּטֶךָ אַתָּה חָרָצְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי עַבְדְּךָ עֹשֵׂה הֵנָּה וָהֵנָּה וְהוּא אֵינֶנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֵּן מִשְׁפָּטֶךָ אַתָּה חָרָצְתָּ׃

english.text:
While your servant was busy here and there, [the man] got away.”
The king of Israel responded, “You have your verdict; you
pronounced it yourself.”

translation.text: And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Israel said unto him, So shall thy judgment be; thyself hast decided it.

verses.english:
While your servant was busy here and there, [the man] got away.”
The king of Israel responded, “You have your verdict; you
pronounced it yourself.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֵר וַיָּסַר אֶת־הָאֲפֵר (מעל) [מֵעֲלֵי] עֵינָיו וַיַּכֵּר אֹתוֹ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי מֵהַנְּבִיאִים הוּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיְמַהֵר וַיָּסַר אֶת־הָאֲפֵר (מעל) [מֵעֲלֵי] עֵינָיו וַיַּכֵּר אֹתוֹ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי מֵהַנְּבִיאִים הוּא׃

english.text:
Quickly he removed the cloth from his eyes, and the king
recognized him as one of the prophets.

translation.text: And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets.

verses.english:
Quickly he removed the cloth from his eyes, and the king
recognized him as one of the prophets.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה יַעַן שִׁלַּחְתָּ אֶת־אִישׁ־חֶרְמִי מִיָּד וְהָיְתָה נַפְשְׁךָ תַּחַת נַפְשׁוֹ וְעַמְּךָ תַּחַת עַמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה יַעַן שִׁלַּחְתָּ אֶת־אִישׁ־חֶרְמִי מִיָּד וְהָיְתָה נַפְשְׁךָ תַּחַת נַפְשׁוֹ וְעַמְּךָ תַּחַת עַמּוֹ׃

english.text:
He said to him, “Thus said YHWH: Because you have set free the man
whom I doomed, your life shall be forfeit for his life and your
people for his people.”

translation.text: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore thy life shall go for his life, and thy people for his people.

verses.english:
He said to him, “Thus said YHWH: Because you have set free the man
whom I doomed, your life shall be forfeit for his life and your
people for his people.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־בֵּיתוֹ סַר וְזָעֵף וַיָּבֹא שֹׁמְרוֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־בֵּיתוֹ סַר וְזָעֵף וַיָּבֹא שֹׁמְרוֹנָה׃

english.text:
Dispirited and sullen, the king of Israel left for home and came
to Samaria.

translation.text: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased, and came to Samaria.

verses.english:
Dispirited and sullen, the king of Israel left for home and came
to Samaria.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה כֶּרֶם הָיָה לְנָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי אֲשֶׁר בְּיִזְרְעֶאל אֵצֶל הֵיכַל אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה כֶּרֶם הָיָה לְנָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי אֲשֶׁר בְּיִזְרְעֶאל אֵצֶל הֵיכַל אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
[The following events] occurred sometime afterward: Naboth the
Jezreelite owned a vineyard in Jezreel, adjoining the palace of
King Ahab of Samaria.

translation.text: And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

verses.english:
[The following events] occurred sometime afterward: Naboth the
Jezreelite owned a vineyard in Jezreel, adjoining the palace of
King Ahab of Samaria.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְדַבֵּר אַחְאָב אֶל־נָבוֹת לֵאמֹר תְּנָה־לִּי אֶת־כַּרְמְךָ וִיהִי־לִי לְגַן־יָרָק כִּי הוּא קָרוֹב אֵצֶל בֵּיתִי וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ תַּחְתָּיו כֶּרֶם טוֹב מִמֶּנּוּ אִם טוֹב
בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֶתְּנָה־לְךָ כֶסֶף מְחִיר זֶה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְדַבֵּר אַחְאָב אֶל־נָבוֹת לֵאמֹר תְּנָה־לִּי אֶת־כַּרְמְךָ וִיהִי־לִי לְגַן־יָרָק כִּי הוּא קָרוֹב אֵצֶל בֵּיתִי וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ תַּחְתָּיו כֶּרֶם טוֹב מִמֶּנּוּ אִם טוֹב
בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֶתְּנָה־לְךָ כֶסֶף מְחִיר זֶה׃

english.text:
Ahab said to Naboth, “Give me your vineyard, so that I may have it
as a vegetable garden, since it is right next to my palace. I will
give you a better vineyard in exchange; or, if you prefer, I will
pay you the price in money.”

translation.text: And Ahab spake unto Naboth, saying, Give me thy vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near unto my house: and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it; or, if it seem good to thee, I will give thee the worth of it in money.

verses.english:
Ahab said to Naboth, “Give me your vineyard, so that I may have it
as a vegetable garden, since it is right next to my palace. I will
give you a better vineyard in exchange; or, if you prefer, I will
pay you the price in money.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נָבוֹת אֶל־אַחְאָב חָלִילָה לִּי מֵיְהֹוָה מִתִּתִּי אֶת־נַחֲלַת אֲבֹתַי לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר נָבוֹת אֶל־אַחְאָב חָלִילָה לִּי מֵיְהֹוָה מִתִּתִּי אֶת־נַחֲלַת אֲבֹתַי לָךְ׃

english.text:
But Naboth replied, “YHWH forbid that I should give up to you what
I have inherited from my fathers!”

translation.text: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.

verses.english:
But Naboth replied, “YHWH forbid that I should give up to you what
I have inherited from my fathers!”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא אַחְאָב אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ סַר וְזָעֵף עַל־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־אֶתֵּן לְךָ אֶת־נַחֲלַת אֲבוֹתָי וַיִּשְׁכַּב עַל־מִטָּתוֹ
וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־פָּנָיו וְלֹא־אָכַל לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא אַחְאָב אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ סַר וְזָעֵף עַל־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־אֶתֵּן לְךָ אֶת־נַחֲלַת אֲבוֹתָי וַיִּשְׁכַּב עַל־מִטָּתוֹ
וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־פָּנָיו וְלֹא־אָכַל לָחֶם׃

english.text:
Ahab went home dispirited and sullen because of the answer that
Naboth the Jezreelite had given him: “I will not give up to you
what I have inherited from my fathers!” He lay down on his bed and
turned away his face, and he would not eat.

translation.text: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him: for he had said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers. And he laid him down upon his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.

verses.english:
Ahab went home dispirited and sullen because of the answer that
Naboth the Jezreelite had given him: “I will not give up to you
what I have inherited from my fathers!” He lay down on his bed and
turned away his face, and he would not eat.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא אֵלָיו אִיזֶבֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלָיו מַה־זֶּה רוּחֲךָ סָרָה וְאֵינְךָ אֹכֵל לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּבֹא אֵלָיו אִיזֶבֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלָיו מַה־זֶּה רוּחֲךָ סָרָה וְאֵינְךָ אֹכֵל לָחֶם׃

english.text:
His wife Jezebel came to him and asked him, “Why are you so
dispirited that you won’t eat?”

translation.text: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said unto him, Why is thy spirit so sad, that thou eatest no bread?

verses.english:
His wife Jezebel came to him and asked him, “Why are you so
dispirited that you won’t eat?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיהָ כִּי־אֲדַבֵּר אֶל־נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי וָאֹמַר לוֹ תְּנָה־לִּי אֶת־כַּרְמְךָ בְּכֶסֶף אוֹ אִם־חָפֵץ אַתָּה אֶתְּנָה־לְךָ כֶרֶם תַּחְתָּיו וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־אֶתֵּן
לְךָ אֶת־כַּרְמִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיהָ כִּי־אֲדַבֵּר אֶל־נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי וָאֹמַר לוֹ תְּנָה־לִּי אֶת־כַּרְמְךָ בְּכֶסֶף אוֹ אִם־חָפֵץ אַתָּה אֶתְּנָה־לְךָ כֶרֶם תַּחְתָּיו וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־אֶתֵּן
לְךָ אֶת־כַּרְמִי׃

english.text:
So he told her, “I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite and proposed to
him, ‘Sell me your vineyard for money, or if you prefer, I’ll give
you another vineyard in exchange’; but he answered, ‘I will not
give my vineyard to you.’”

translation.text: And he said unto her, Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite, and said unto him, Give me thy vineyard for money; or else, if it please thee, I will give thee another vineyard for it: and he answered, I will not give thee my vineyard.

verses.english:
So he told her, “I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite and proposed to
him, ‘Sell me your vineyard for money, or if you prefer, I’ll give
you another vineyard in exchange’; but he answered, ‘I will not
give my vineyard to you.’”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אִיזֶבֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ אַתָּה עַתָּה תַּעֲשֶׂה מְלוּכָה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל קוּם אֱכל־לֶחֶם וְיִטַב לִבֶּךָ אֲנִי אֶתֵּן לְךָ אֶת־כֶּרֶם נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אִיזֶבֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ אַתָּה עַתָּה תַּעֲשֶׂה מְלוּכָה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל קוּם אֱכל־לֶחֶם וְיִטַב לִבֶּךָ אֲנִי אֶתֵּן לְךָ אֶת־כֶּרֶם נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי׃

english.text:
His wife Jezebel said to him, “Now is the time to show yourself
king over Israel. Rise and eat something, and be cheerful; I will
get the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite for you.”

translation.text: And Jezebel his wife said unto him, Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel? arise, and eat bread, and let thine heart be merry: I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.

verses.english:
His wife Jezebel said to him, “Now is the time to show yourself
king over Israel. Rise and eat something, and be cheerful; I will
get the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite for you.”

verses.hebrew: וַתִּכְתֹּב סְפָרִים בְּשֵׁם אַחְאָב וַתַּחְתֹּם בְּחֹתָמוֹ וַתִּשְׁלַח (הספרים) [סְפָרִים] אֶל־הַזְּקֵנִים וְאֶל־הַחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר בְּעִירוֹ הַיֹּשְׁבִים אֶת־נָבוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּכְתֹּב סְפָרִים בְּשֵׁם אַחְאָב וַתַּחְתֹּם בְּחֹתָמוֹ וַתִּשְׁלַח (הספרים) [סְפָרִים] אֶל־הַזְּקֵנִים וְאֶל־הַחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר בְּעִירוֹ הַיֹּשְׁבִים אֶת־נָבוֹת׃

english.text:
So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name and sealed them with his seal,
and sent the letters to the elders and the nobles who lived in the
same town with Naboth.

translation.text: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name, and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in his city, dwelling with Naboth.

verses.english:
So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name and sealed them with his seal,
and sent the letters to the elders and the nobles who lived in the
same town with Naboth.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּכְתֹּב בַּסְּפָרִים לֵאמֹר קִרְאוּ־צוֹם וְהֹשִׁיבוּ אֶת־נָבוֹת בְּרֹאשׁ הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּכְתֹּב בַּסְּפָרִים לֵאמֹר קִרְאוּ־צוֹם וְהֹשִׁיבוּ אֶת־נָבוֹת בְּרֹאשׁ הָעָם׃

english.text:
In the letters she wrote as follows: “Proclaim a fast and seat
Naboth at the front of the assembly.

translation.text: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people:

verses.english:
In the letters she wrote as follows: “Proclaim a fast and seat
Naboth at the front of the assembly.

verses.hebrew: וְהוֹשִׁיבוּ שְׁנַיִם אֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־בְלִיַּעַל נֶגְדּוֹ וִיעִדֻהוּ לֵאמֹר בֵּרַכְתָּ אֱלֹהִים וָמֶלֶךְ וְהוֹצִיאֻהוּ וְסִקְלֻהוּ וְיָמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וְהוֹשִׁיבוּ שְׁנַיִם אֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־בְלִיַּעַל נֶגְדּוֹ וִיעִדֻהוּ לֵאמֹר בֵּרַכְתָּ אֱלֹהִים וָמֶלֶךְ וְהוֹצִיאֻהוּ וְסִקְלֻהוּ וְיָמֹת׃

english.text:
And seat two scoundrels opposite him, and let them testify against
him: ‘You have reviled God and king!’ Then take him out and stone
him to death.”

translation.text: And set two men, sons of Belial, before him, to bear witness against him, saying, Thou didst blaspheme God and the king. And then carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.

verses.english:
And seat two scoundrels opposite him, and let them testify against
him: ‘You have reviled God and king!’ Then take him out and stone
him to death.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אַנְשֵׁי עִירוֹ הַזְּקֵנִים וְהַחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּעִירוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁלְחָה אֲלֵיהֶם אִיזָבֶל כַּאֲשֶׁר כָּתוּב בַּסְּפָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלְחָה אֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אַנְשֵׁי עִירוֹ הַזְּקֵנִים וְהַחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּעִירוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁלְחָה אֲלֵיהֶם אִיזָבֶל כַּאֲשֶׁר כָּתוּב בַּסְּפָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלְחָה אֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
His townsmen—the elders and nobles who lived in his town—did as
Jezebel had instructed them, just as was written in the letters
she had sent them:

translation.text: And the men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them, and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.

verses.english:
His townsmen—the elders and nobles who lived in his town—did as
Jezebel had instructed them, just as was written in the letters
she had sent them:

verses.hebrew: קָרְאוּ צוֹם וְהֹשִׁיבוּ אֶת־נָבוֹת בְּרֹאשׁ הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: קָרְאוּ צוֹם וְהֹשִׁיבוּ אֶת־נָבוֹת בְּרֹאשׁ הָעָם׃

english.text:
They proclaimed a fast and seated Naboth at the front of the
assembly.

translation.text: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

verses.english:
They proclaimed a fast and seated Naboth at the front of the
assembly.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹאוּ שְׁנֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־בְלִיַּעַל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ נֶגְדּוֹ וַיְעִדֻהוּ אַנְשֵׁי הַבְּלִיַּעַל אֶת־נָבוֹת נֶגֶד הָעָם לֵאמֹר בֵּרַךְ נָבוֹת אֱלֹהִים וָמֶלֶךְ וַיֹּצִאֻהוּ
מִחוּץ לָעִיר וַיִּסְקְלֻהוּ בָאֲבָנִים וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹאוּ שְׁנֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־בְלִיַּעַל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ נֶגְדּוֹ וַיְעִדֻהוּ אַנְשֵׁי הַבְּלִיַּעַל אֶת־נָבוֹת נֶגֶד הָעָם לֵאמֹר בֵּרַךְ נָבוֹת אֱלֹהִים וָמֶלֶךְ וַיֹּצִאֻהוּ
מִחוּץ לָעִיר וַיִּסְקְלֻהוּ בָאֲבָנִים וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
Then the two scoundrels came and sat down opposite him; and the
scoundrels testified against Naboth publicly as follows: “Naboth
has reviled God and king.” Then they took him outside the town and
stoned him to death.

translation.text: And there came in two men, children of Belial, and sat before him: and the men of Belial witnessed against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth did blaspheme God and the king. Then they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.

verses.english:
Then the two scoundrels came and sat down opposite him; and the
scoundrels testified against Naboth publicly as follows: “Naboth
has reviled God and king.” Then they took him outside the town and
stoned him to death.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אֶל־אִיזֶבֶל לֵאמֹר סֻקַּל נָבוֹת וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אֶל־אִיזֶבֶל לֵאמֹר סֻקַּל נָבוֹת וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text: Word was sent to Jezebel: “Naboth has been stoned to death.”

translation.text: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.

verses.english: Word was sent to Jezebel: “Naboth has been stoned to death.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אִיזֶבֶל כִּי־סֻקַּל נָבוֹת וַיָּמֹת וַתֹּאמֶר אִיזֶבֶל אֶל־אַחְאָב קוּם רֵשׁ אֶת־כֶּרֶם נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי אֲשֶׁר מֵאֵן לָתֶת־לְךָ בְכֶסֶף כִּי אֵין נָבוֹת
חַי כִּי־מֵת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אִיזֶבֶל כִּי־סֻקַּל נָבוֹת וַיָּמֹת וַתֹּאמֶר אִיזֶבֶל אֶל־אַחְאָב קוּם רֵשׁ אֶת־כֶּרֶם נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי אֲשֶׁר מֵאֵן לָתֶת־לְךָ בְכֶסֶף כִּי אֵין נָבוֹת
חַי כִּי־מֵת׃

english.text:
As soon as Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned to death, she
said to Ahab, “Go and take possession of the vineyard which Naboth
the Jezreelite refused to sell you for money; for Naboth is no
longer alive, he is dead.”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.

verses.english:
As soon as Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned to death, she
said to Ahab, “Go and take possession of the vineyard which Naboth
the Jezreelite refused to sell you for money; for Naboth is no
longer alive, he is dead.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אַחְאָב כִּי מֵת נָבוֹת וַיָּקם אַחְאָב לָרֶדֶת אֶל־כֶּרֶם נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי לְרִשְׁתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אַחְאָב כִּי מֵת נָבוֹת וַיָּקם אַחְאָב לָרֶדֶת אֶל־כֶּרֶם נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי לְרִשְׁתּוֹ׃

english.text:
When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab set out for the
vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite to take possession of it.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.

verses.english:
When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab set out for the
vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite to take possession of it.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּי לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּי לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: Then the word of YHWH came to Elijah the Tishbite:

translation.text: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

verses.english: Then the word of YHWH came to Elijah the Tishbite:

verses.hebrew: קוּם רֵד לִקְרַאת אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן הִנֵּה בְּכֶרֶם נָבוֹת אֲשֶׁר־יָרַד שָׁם לְרִשְׁתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: קוּם רֵד לִקְרַאת אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן הִנֵּה בְּכֶרֶם נָבוֹת אֲשֶׁר־יָרַד שָׁם לְרִשְׁתּוֹ׃

english.text:
“Go down and confront King Ahab of Israel who [resides] in
Samaria. He is now in Naboth’s vineyard; he has gone down there to
take possession of it.

translation.text: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, which is in Samaria: behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to possess it.

verses.english:
“Go down and confront King Ahab of Israel who [resides] in
Samaria. He is now in Naboth’s vineyard; he has gone down there to
take possession of it.

verses.hebrew:
וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הֲרָצַחְתָּ וְגַם־יָרָשְׁתָּ וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר לָקְקוּ הַכְּלָבִים אֶת־דַּם נָבוֹת
יָלֹקּוּ הַכְּלָבִים אֶת־דָּמְךָ גַּם־אָתָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הֲרָצַחְתָּ וְגַם־יָרָשְׁתָּ וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר לָקְקוּ הַכְּלָבִים אֶת־דַּם נָבוֹת
יָלֹקּוּ הַכְּלָבִים אֶת־דָּמְךָ גַּם־אָתָּה׃

english.text:
Say to him, ‘Thus said YHWH: Would you murder and take possession?
Thus said YHWH: In the very place where the dogs lapped up
Naboth’s blood, the dogs will lap up your blood too.’”

translation.text: And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou killed, and also taken possession? And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood, even thine.

verses.english:
Say to him, ‘Thus said YHWH: Would you murder and take possession?
Thus said YHWH: In the very place where the dogs lapped up
Naboth’s blood, the dogs will lap up your blood too.’”
