verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַחְאָב אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ הַמְצָאתַנִי אֹיְבִי וַיֹּאמֶר מָצָאתִי יַעַן הִתְמַכֶּרְךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַחְאָב אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ הַמְצָאתַנִי אֹיְבִי וַיֹּאמֶר מָצָאתִי יַעַן הִתְמַכֶּרְךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Ahab said to Elijah, “So you have found me, my enemy?” “Yes, I
have found you,” he replied. “Because you have committed yourself
to doing what is evil in the sight of YHWH,

translation.text: And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast thou found me, O mine enemy? And he answered, I have found thee: because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the LORD.

verses.english:
Ahab said to Elijah, “So you have found me, my enemy?” “Yes, I
have found you,” he replied. “Because you have committed yourself
to doing what is evil in the sight of YHWH,

verses.hebrew: הִנְנִי מֵבִי אֵלֶיךָ רָעָה וּבִעַרְתִּי אַחֲרֶיךָ וְהִכְרַתִּי לְאַחְאָב מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר וְעָצוּר וְעָזוּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: הִנְנִי מֵבִי אֵלֶיךָ רָעָה וּבִעַרְתִּי אַחֲרֶיךָ וְהִכְרַתִּי לְאַחְאָב מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר וְעָצוּר וְעָזוּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
I will bring disaster upon you. I will make a clean sweep of you,
I will cut off from Israel every male belonging to Ahab,bond and
free.

translation.text: Behold, I will bring evil upon thee, and will take away thy posterity, and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel,

verses.english:
I will bring disaster upon you. I will make a clean sweep of you,
I will cut off from Israel every male belonging to Ahab,bond and
free.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־בֵּיתְךָ כְּבֵית יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט וּכְבֵית בַּעְשָׁא בֶן־אֲחִיָּה אֶל־הַכַּעַס אֲשֶׁר הִכְעַסְתָּ וַתַּחֲטִא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־בֵּיתְךָ כְּבֵית יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט וּכְבֵית בַּעְשָׁא בֶן־אֲחִיָּה אֶל־הַכַּעַס אֲשֶׁר הִכְעַסְתָּ וַתַּחֲטִא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And I will make your house like the House of Jeroboam son of Nebat
and like the House of Baasha son of Ahijah, because of the
provocation you have caused by leading Israel to sin.

translation.text: And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked me to anger, and made Israel to sin.

verses.english:
And I will make your house like the House of Jeroboam son of Nebat
and like the House of Baasha son of Ahijah, because of the
provocation you have caused by leading Israel to sin.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם־לְאִיזֶבֶל דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַכְּלָבִים יֹאכְלוּ אֶת־אִיזֶבֶל בְּחֵל יִזְרְעֶאל׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם־לְאִיזֶבֶל דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַכְּלָבִים יֹאכְלוּ אֶת־אִיזֶבֶל בְּחֵל יִזְרְעֶאל׃

english.text:
And YHWH has also spoken concerning Jezebel: ‘The dogs shall
devour Jezebel in the field of Jezreel.

translation.text: And of Jezebel also spake the LORD, saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.

verses.english:
And YHWH has also spoken concerning Jezebel: ‘The dogs shall
devour Jezebel in the field of Jezreel.

verses.hebrew: הַמֵּת לְאַחְאָב בָּעִיר יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים וְהַמֵּת בַּשָּׂדֶה יֹאכְלוּ עוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: הַמֵּת לְאַחְאָב בָּעִיר יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים וְהַמֵּת בַּשָּׂדֶה יֹאכְלוּ עוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
All of Ahab’s line who die in the town shall be devoured by dogs,
and all who die in the open country shall be devoured by the birds
of the sky.’”

translation.text: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.

verses.english:
All of Ahab’s line who die in the town shall be devoured by dogs,
and all who die in the open country shall be devoured by the birds
of the sky.’”

verses.hebrew: רַק לֹא־הָיָה כְאַחְאָב אֲשֶׁר הִתְמַכֵּר לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־הֵסַתָּה אֹתוֹ אִיזֶבֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: רַק לֹא־הָיָה כְאַחְאָב אֲשֶׁר הִתְמַכֵּר לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־הֵסַתָּה אֹתוֹ אִיזֶבֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ׃

english.text:
Indeed, there never was anyone like Ahab, who committed himself to
doing what was displeasing to YHWH, at the instigation of his wife
Jezebel.

translation.text: But there was none like unto Ahab, which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the LORD, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.

verses.english:
Indeed, there never was anyone like Ahab, who committed himself to
doing what was displeasing to YHWH, at the instigation of his wife
Jezebel.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּתְעֵב מְאֹד לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי הַגִּלֻּלִים כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּתְעֵב מְאֹד לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי הַגִּלֻּלִים כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
He acted most abominably, straying after the fetishes just like
the Amorites, whom YHWH had dispossessed before the Israelites.

translation.text: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all things as did the Amorites, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

verses.english:
He acted most abominably, straying after the fetishes just like
the Amorites, whom YHWH had dispossessed before the Israelites.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ אַחְאָב אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּקְרַע בְּגָדָיו וַיָּשֶׂם־שַׂק עַל־בְּשָׂרוֹ וַיָּצוֹם וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּשָּׂק וַיְהַלֵּךְ אַט׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ אַחְאָב אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּקְרַע בְּגָדָיו וַיָּשֶׂם־שַׂק עַל־בְּשָׂרוֹ וַיָּצוֹם וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּשָּׂק וַיְהַלֵּךְ אַט׃

english.text:
When Ahab heard these words, he rent his clothes and put sackcloth
on his body. He fasted and lay in sackcloth and walked about
subdued.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.

verses.english:
When Ahab heard these words, he rent his clothes and put sackcloth
on his body. He fasted and lay in sackcloth and walked about
subdued.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּי לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּי לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: Then the word of YHWH came to Elijah the Tishbite:

translation.text: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

verses.english: Then the word of YHWH came to Elijah the Tishbite:

verses.hebrew: הֲרָאִיתָ כִּי־נִכְנַע אַחְאָב מִלְּפָנָי יַעַן כִּי־נִכְנַע מִפָּנַי לֹא־אָבִי הָרָעָה בְּיָמָיו בִּימֵי בְנוֹ אָבִיא הָרָעָה עַל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: הֲרָאִיתָ כִּי־נִכְנַע אַחְאָב מִלְּפָנָי יַעַן כִּי־נִכְנַע מִפָּנַי לֹא־אָבִי הָרָעָה בְּיָמָיו בִּימֵי בְנוֹ אָבִיא הָרָעָה עַל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
“Have you seen how Ahab has humbled himself before Me? Because he
has humbled himself before Me, I will not bring the disaster in
his lifetime; I will bring the disaster upon his house in his
son’s time.”

translation.text: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: but in his son’s days will I bring the evil upon his house.

verses.english:
“Have you seen how Ahab has humbled himself before Me? Because he
has humbled himself before Me, I will not bring the disaster in
his lifetime; I will bring the disaster upon his house in his
son’s time.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים אֵין מִלְחָמָה בֵּין אֲרָם וּבֵין יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים אֵין מִלְחָמָה בֵּין אֲרָם וּבֵין יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
There was a lull of three years, with no war between Aram and
Israel.

translation.text: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

verses.english:
There was a lull of three years, with no war between Aram and
Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁלִישִׁית וַיֵּרֶד יְהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁלִישִׁית וַיֵּרֶד יְהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
In the third year, King Jehoshaphat of Judah came to visit the
king of Israel.

translation.text: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

verses.english:
In the third year, King Jehoshaphat of Judah came to visit the
king of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הַיְדַעְתֶּם כִּי־לָנוּ רָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַאֲנַחְנוּ מַחְשִׁים מִקַּחַת אֹתָהּ מִיַּד מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הַיְדַעְתֶּם כִּי־לָנוּ רָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַאֲנַחְנוּ מַחְשִׁים מִקַּחַת אֹתָהּ מִיַּד מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם׃

english.text:
The king of Israel said to his courtiers, “You know that
Ramoth-gilead belongs to us, and yet we do nothing to recover it
from the hands of the king of Aram.”

translation.text: And the king of Israel said unto his servants, Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is ours, and we be still, and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?

verses.english:
The king of Israel said to his courtiers, “You know that
Ramoth-gilead belongs to us, and yet we do nothing to recover it
from the hands of the king of Aram.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט הֲתֵלֵךְ אִתִּי לַמִּלְחָמָה רָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּמוֹנִי כָמוֹךָ כְּעַמִּי כְעַמֶּךָ כְּסוּסַי כְּסוּסֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט הֲתֵלֵךְ אִתִּי לַמִּלְחָמָה רָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּמוֹנִי כָמוֹךָ כְּעַמִּי כְעַמֶּךָ כְּסוּסַי כְּסוּסֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And he said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you come with me to battle at
Ramoth-gilead?” Jehoshaphat answered the king of Israel, “I will
do what you do; my troops shall be your troops, my horses shall be
your horses.”

translation.text: And he said unto Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramothgilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I am as thou art, my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.

verses.english:
And he said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you come with me to battle at
Ramoth-gilead?” Jehoshaphat answered the king of Israel, “I will
do what you do; my troops shall be your troops, my horses shall be
your horses.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּרשׁ־נָא כַיּוֹם אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּרשׁ־נָא כַיּוֹם אֶת־דְּבַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
But Jehoshaphat said further to the king of Israel, “Please, first
inquire of YHWH.”

translation.text: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.

verses.english:
But Jehoshaphat said further to the king of Israel, “Please, first
inquire of YHWH.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְבֹּץ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַנְּבִיאִים כְּאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם הַאֵלֵךְ עַל־רָמֹת גִּלְעָד לַמִּלְחָמָה אִם־אֶחְדָּל וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲלֵה וְיִתֵּן אֲדֹנָי
בְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְבֹּץ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַנְּבִיאִים כְּאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם הַאֵלֵךְ עַל־רָמֹת גִּלְעָד לַמִּלְחָמָה אִם־אֶחְדָּל וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲלֵה וְיִתֵּן אֲדֹנָי
בְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
So the king of Israel gathered the prophets, about four hundred
men, and asked them, “Shall I march upon Ramoth-gilead for battle,
or shall I not?” “March,” they said, “and YHWH will deliver [it]
into Your Majesty’s hands.”

translation.text: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

verses.english:
So the king of Israel gathered the prophets, about four hundred
men, and asked them, “Shall I march upon Ramoth-gilead for battle,
or shall I not?” “March,” they said, “and YHWH will deliver [it]
into Your Majesty’s hands.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט הַאֵין פֹּה נָבִיא לַיהֹוָה עוֹד וְנִדְרְשָׁה מֵאֹתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט הַאֵין פֹּה נָבִיא לַיהֹוָה עוֹד וְנִדְרְשָׁה מֵאֹתוֹ׃

english.text:
Then Jehoshaphat asked, “Isn’t there another prophet of YHWH here
through whom we can inquire?”

translation.text: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?

verses.english:
Then Jehoshaphat asked, “Isn’t there another prophet of YHWH here
through whom we can inquire?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט עוֹד אִישׁ־אֶחָד לִדְרֹשׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָה מֵאֹתוֹ וַאֲנִי שְׂנֵאתִיו כִּי לֹא־יִתְנַבֵּא עָלַי טוֹב כִּי אִם־רָע מִיכָיְהוּ בֶּן־יִמְלָה
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט אַל־יֹאמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ כֵּן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט עוֹד אִישׁ־אֶחָד לִדְרֹשׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָה מֵאֹתוֹ וַאֲנִי שְׂנֵאתִיו כִּי לֹא־יִתְנַבֵּא עָלַי טוֹב כִּי אִם־רָע מִיכָיְהוּ בֶּן־יִמְלָה
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט אַל־יֹאמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ כֵּן׃

english.text:
And the king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, “There is one more
man through whom we can inquire of YHWH; but I hate him, because
he never prophesies anything good for me, but only
misfortune—Micaiah son of Imlah.” But King Jehoshaphat said,
“Don’t say that, Your Majesty.”

translation.text: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

verses.english:
And the king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, “There is one more
man through whom we can inquire of YHWH; but I hate him, because
he never prophesies anything good for me, but only
misfortune—Micaiah son of Imlah.” But King Jehoshaphat said,
“Don’t say that, Your Majesty.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־סָרִיס אֶחָד וַיֹּאמֶר מַהֲרָה מִיכָיְהוּ בֶן־יִמְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־סָרִיס אֶחָד וַיֹּאמֶר מַהֲרָה מִיכָיְהוּ בֶן־יִמְלָה׃

english.text:
So the king of Israel summoned an officer and said, “Bring Micaiah
son of Imlah at once.”

translation.text: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten hither Micaiah the son of Imlah.

verses.english:
So the king of Israel summoned an officer and said, “Bring Micaiah
son of Imlah at once.”

verses.hebrew: וּמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה יֹשְׁבִים אִישׁ עַל־כִּסְאוֹ מְלֻבָּשִׁים בְּגָדִים בְּגֹרֶן פֶּתַח שַׁעַר שֹׁמְרוֹן וְכל־הַנְּבִיאִים מִתְנַבְּאִים לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה יֹשְׁבִים אִישׁ עַל־כִּסְאוֹ מְלֻבָּשִׁים בְּגָדִים בְּגֹרֶן פֶּתַח שַׁעַר שֹׁמְרוֹן וְכל־הַנְּבִיאִים מִתְנַבְּאִים לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
The king of Israel and King Jehoshaphat of Judah were seated on
their thrones, arrayed in their robes, on the threshing floor at
the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were
prophesying before them.

translation.text: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

verses.english:
The king of Israel and King Jehoshaphat of Judah were seated on
their thrones, arrayed in their robes, on the threshing floor at
the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were
prophesying before them.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ צִדְקִיָּה בֶן־כְּנַעֲנָה קַרְנֵי בַרְזֶל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה בְּאֵלֶּה תְּנַגַּח אֶת־אֲרָם עַד־כַּלֹּתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ צִדְקִיָּה בֶן־כְּנַעֲנָה קַרְנֵי בַרְזֶל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה בְּאֵלֶּה תְּנַגַּח אֶת־אֲרָם עַד־כַּלֹּתָם׃

translation.text: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus saith the LORD, With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have consumed them.

verses.hebrew: וְכל־הַנְּבִאִים נִבְּאִים כֵּן לֵאמֹר עֲלֵה רָמֹת גִּלְעָד וְהַצְלַח וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה בְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־הַנְּבִאִים נִבְּאִים כֵּן לֵאמֹר עֲלֵה רָמֹת גִּלְעָד וְהַצְלַח וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה בְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
And all the other prophets were prophesying similarly, “March upon
Ramoth-gilead and triumph! YHWH will deliver it into Your
Majesty’s hands.”

translation.text: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the king’s hand.

verses.english:
And all the other prophets were prophesying similarly, “March upon
Ramoth-gilead and triumph! YHWH will deliver it into Your
Majesty’s hands.”

verses.hebrew:
וְהַמַּלְאָךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ לִקְרֹא מִיכָיְהוּ דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה־נָא דִּבְרֵי הַנְּבִיאִים פֶּה־אֶחָד טוֹב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהִי־נָא (דבריך) [דְבָרְךָ] כִּדְבַר אַחַד
מֵהֶם וְדִבַּרְתָּ טּוֹב׃

hebrew.text:
וְהַמַּלְאָךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ לִקְרֹא מִיכָיְהוּ דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה־נָא דִּבְרֵי הַנְּבִיאִים פֶּה־אֶחָד טוֹב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהִי־נָא (דבריך) [דְבָרְךָ] כִּדְבַר אַחַד
מֵהֶם וְדִבַּרְתָּ טּוֹב׃

english.text:
The messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him: “Look,
the words of the prophets are with one accord favorable to the
king. Let your word be like that of the rest of them; speak a
favorable word.”

translation.text: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak that which is good.

verses.english:
The messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him: “Look,
the words of the prophets are with one accord favorable to the
king. Let your word be like that of the rest of them; speak a
favorable word.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי אֶת־אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אֹתוֹ אֲדַבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ חַי־יְהֹוָה כִּי אֶת־אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר יְהֹוָה אֵלַי אֹתוֹ אֲדַבֵּר׃

english.text:
“As YHWH lives,” Micaiah answered, “I will speak only what YHWH
tells me.”

translation.text: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, what the LORD saith unto me, that will I speak.

verses.english:
“As YHWH lives,” Micaiah answered, “I will speak only what YHWH
tells me.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו מִיכָיְהוּ הֲנֵלֵךְ אֶל־רָמֹת גִּלְעָד לַמִּלְחָמָה אִם־נֶחְדָּל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו עֲלֵה וְהַצְלַח וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה בְּיַד
הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו מִיכָיְהוּ הֲנֵלֵךְ אֶל־רָמֹת גִּלְעָד לַמִּלְחָמָה אִם־נֶחְדָּל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו עֲלֵה וְהַצְלַח וְנָתַן יְהֹוָה בְּיַד
הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
When he came before the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah,
shall we march upon Ramoth-gilead for battle, or shall we not?” He
answered him, “March and triumph! YHWH will deliver [it] into Your
Majesty’s hands.”

translation.text: So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

verses.english:
When he came before the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah,
shall we march upon Ramoth-gilead for battle, or shall we not?” He
answered him, “March and triumph! YHWH will deliver [it] into Your
Majesty’s hands.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הַמֶּלֶךְ עַד־כַּמֶּה פְעָמִים אֲנִי מַשְׁבִּיעֶךָ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תְדַבֵּר אֵלַי רַק־אֱמֶת בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הַמֶּלֶךְ עַד־כַּמֶּה פְעָמִים אֲנִי מַשְׁבִּיעֶךָ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תְדַבֵּר אֵלַי רַק־אֱמֶת בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The king said to him, “How many times must I adjure you to tell me
nothing but the truth in the name of YHWH?”

translation.text: And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but that which is true in the name of the LORD?

verses.english:
The king said to him, “How many times must I adjure you to tell me
nothing but the truth in the name of YHWH?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר רָאִיתִי אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל נְפֹצִים אֶל־הֶהָרִים כַּצֹּאן אֲשֶׁר אֵין־לָהֶם רֹעֶה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לֹא־אֲדֹנִים לָאֵלֶּה יָשׁוּבוּ אִישׁ־לְבֵיתוֹ בְּשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר רָאִיתִי אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל נְפֹצִים אֶל־הֶהָרִים כַּצֹּאן אֲשֶׁר אֵין־לָהֶם רֹעֶה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה לֹא־אֲדֹנִים לָאֵלֶּה יָשׁוּבוּ אִישׁ־לְבֵיתוֹ בְּשָׁלוֹם׃

translation.text: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט הֲלוֹא אָמַרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לוֹא־יִתְנַבֵּא עָלַי טוֹב כִּי אִם־רָע׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט הֲלוֹא אָמַרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לוֹא־יִתְנַבֵּא עָלַי טוֹב כִּי אִם־רָע׃

english.text:
“Didn’t I tell you,” said the king of Israel to Jehoshaphat, “that
he would not prophesy good fortune for me, but only misfortune?”

translation.text: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?

verses.english:
“Didn’t I tell you,” said the king of Israel to Jehoshaphat, “that
he would not prophesy good fortune for me, but only misfortune?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָכֵן שְׁמַע דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה רָאִיתִי אֶת־יְהֹוָה יֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ וְכל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם עֹמֵד עָלָיו מִימִינוֹ וּמִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָכֵן שְׁמַע דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה רָאִיתִי אֶת־יְהֹוָה יֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ וְכל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם עֹמֵד עָלָיו מִימִינוֹ וּמִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ׃

english.text:
But [Micaiah] said, “I call upon you to hear the word of YHWH! I
saw YHWH seated upon His throne, with all the host of heaven
standing in attendance to the right and to the left of Him.

translation.text: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

verses.english:
But [Micaiah] said, “I call upon you to hear the word of YHWH! I
saw YHWH seated upon His throne, with all the host of heaven
standing in attendance to the right and to the left of Him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה מִי יְפַתֶּה אֶת־אַחְאָב וְיַעַל וְיִפֹּל בְּרָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמֶר זֶה בְּכֹה וְזֶה אֹמֵר בְּכֹה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה מִי יְפַתֶּה אֶת־אַחְאָב וְיַעַל וְיִפֹּל בְּרָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמֶר זֶה בְּכֹה וְזֶה אֹמֵר בְּכֹה׃

english.text:
YHWH asked, ‘Who will entice Ahab so that he will march and fall
at Ramoth-gilead?’ Then one said thus and another said thus,

translation.text: And the LORD said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.

verses.english:
YHWH asked, ‘Who will entice Ahab so that he will march and fall
at Ramoth-gilead?’ Then one said thus and another said thus,

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הָרוּחַ וַיַּעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי אֲפַתֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו בַּמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא הָרוּחַ וַיַּעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי אֲפַתֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו בַּמָּה׃

english.text:
until a certain spirit came forward and stood before YHWH and
said, ‘I will entice him.’ ‘How?’ YHWH asked him.

translation.text: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will persuade him.

verses.english:
until a certain spirit came forward and stood before YHWH and
said, ‘I will entice him.’ ‘How?’ YHWH asked him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵצֵא וְהָיִיתִי רוּחַ שֶׁקֶר בְּפִי כּל־נְבִיאָיו וַיֹּאמֶר תְּפַתֶּה וְגַם־תּוּכָל צֵא וַעֲשֵׂה־כֵן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵצֵא וְהָיִיתִי רוּחַ שֶׁקֶר בְּפִי כּל־נְבִיאָיו וַיֹּאמֶר תְּפַתֶּה וְגַם־תּוּכָל צֵא וַעֲשֵׂה־כֵן׃

english.text:
And he replied, ‘I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouth
of all his prophets.’ Then He said, ‘You will entice and you will
prevail. Go out and do it.’

translation.text: And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.

verses.english:
And he replied, ‘I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouth
of all his prophets.’ Then He said, ‘You will entice and you will
prevail. Go out and do it.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה נָתַן יְהֹוָה רוּחַ שֶׁקֶר בְּפִי כּל־נְבִיאֶיךָ אֵלֶּה וַיהֹוָה דִּבֶּר עָלֶיךָ רָעָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה נָתַן יְהֹוָה רוּחַ שֶׁקֶר בְּפִי כּל־נְבִיאֶיךָ אֵלֶּה וַיהֹוָה דִּבֶּר עָלֶיךָ רָעָה׃

english.text:
So YHWH has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these prophets
of yours; for YHWH has decreed disaster upon you.”

translation.text: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil concerning thee.

verses.english:
So YHWH has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these prophets
of yours; for YHWH has decreed disaster upon you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ צִדְקִיָּהוּ בֶן־כְּנַעֲנָה וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־מִיכָיְהוּ עַל־הַלֶּחִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵי־זֶה עָבַר רוּחַ־יְהֹוָה מֵאִתִּי לְדַבֵּר אוֹתָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגַּשׁ צִדְקִיָּהוּ בֶן־כְּנַעֲנָה וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־מִיכָיְהוּ עַל־הַלֶּחִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵי־זֶה עָבַר רוּחַ־יְהֹוָה מֵאִתִּי לְדַבֵּר אוֹתָךְ׃

english.text:
Thereupon Zedekiah son of Chenaanah stepped up and struck Micaiah
on the cheek, and demanded, “Which way did the spirit of YHWH pass
from me to speak with you?”

translation.text: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?

verses.english:
Thereupon Zedekiah son of Chenaanah stepped up and struck Micaiah
on the cheek, and demanded, “Which way did the spirit of YHWH pass
from me to speak with you?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ הִנְּךָ רֹאֶה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֲשֶׁר תָּבֹא חֶדֶר בְּחֶדֶר לְהֵחָבֵה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ הִנְּךָ רֹאֶה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֲשֶׁר תָּבֹא חֶדֶר בְּחֶדֶר לְהֵחָבֵה׃

english.text:
And Micaiah replied, “You’ll find out on the day when you try to
hide in the innermost room.”

translation.text: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

verses.english:
And Micaiah replied, “You’ll find out on the day when you try to
hide in the innermost room.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל קַח אֶת־מִיכָיְהוּ וַהֲשִׁיבֵהוּ אֶל־אָמֹן שַׂר־הָעִיר וְאֶל־יוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל קַח אֶת־מִיכָיְהוּ וַהֲשִׁיבֵהוּ אֶל־אָמֹן שַׂר־הָעִיר וְאֶל־יוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Then the king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah and turn him over to
Amon, the city’s governor, and to Prince Joash,

translation.text: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;

verses.english:
Then the king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah and turn him over to
Amon, the city’s governor, and to Prince Joash,

verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ כֹּה אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ שִׂימוּ אֶת־זֶה בֵּית הַכֶּלֶא וְהַאֲכִלֻהוּ לֶחֶם לַחַץ וּמַיִם לַחַץ עַד בֹּאִי בְשָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ כֹּה אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ שִׂימוּ אֶת־זֶה בֵּית הַכֶּלֶא וְהַאֲכִלֻהוּ לֶחֶם לַחַץ וּמַיִם לַחַץ עַד בֹּאִי בְשָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
and say, ‘The king’s orders are: Put this fellow in prison, and
let his fare be scant bread and scant water until I come home
safe.’”

translation.text: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.

verses.english:
and say, ‘The king’s orders are: Put this fellow in prison, and
let his fare be scant bread and scant water until I come home
safe.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ אִם־שׁוֹב תָּשׁוּב בְּשָׁלוֹם לֹא־דִבֶּר יְהֹוָה בִּי וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְעוּ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ אִם־שׁוֹב תָּשׁוּב בְּשָׁלוֹם לֹא־דִבֶּר יְהֹוָה בִּי וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְעוּ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם׃

english.text:
To which Micaiah retorted, “If you ever come home safe, YHWH has
not spoken through me.” He said further, “Listen, all you
peoples!”

translation.text: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the LORD hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.

verses.english:
To which Micaiah retorted, “If you ever come home safe, YHWH has
not spoken through me.” He said further, “Listen, all you
peoples!”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה רָמֹת גִּלְעָד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה רָמֹת גִּלְעָד׃

english.text:
So the king of Israel and King Jehoshaphat of Judah marched upon
Ramoth-gilead.

translation.text: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramothgilead.

verses.english:
So the king of Israel and King Jehoshaphat of Judah marched upon
Ramoth-gilead.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט הִתְחַפֵּשׂ וָבֹא בַמִּלְחָמָה וְאַתָּה לְבַשׁ בְּגָדֶיךָ וַיִּתְחַפֵּשׂ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּבוֹא בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט הִתְחַפֵּשׂ וָבֹא בַמִּלְחָמָה וְאַתָּה לְבַשׁ בְּגָדֶיךָ וַיִּתְחַפֵּשׂ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּבוֹא בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

english.text:
The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Disguise yourself and go
into the battle; but you, wear your robes.” So the king of Israel
went into the battle disguised.

translation.text: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.

verses.english:
The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Disguise yourself and go
into the battle; but you, wear your robes.” So the king of Israel
went into the battle disguised.

verses.hebrew: וּמֶלֶךְ אֲרָם צִוָּה אֶת־שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁנַיִם לֵאמֹר לֹא תִּלָּחֲמוּ אֶת־קָטֹן וְאֶת־גָּדוֹל כִּי אִם־אֶת־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַדּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וּמֶלֶךְ אֲרָם צִוָּה אֶת־שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁנַיִם לֵאמֹר לֹא תִּלָּחֲמוּ אֶת־קָטֹן וְאֶת־גָּדוֹל כִּי אִם־אֶת־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַדּוֹ׃

english.text:
Now the king of Aram had instructed his thirty-two chariot
officers: “Don’t attack anyone, small or great, except the king of
Israel.”

translation.text: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.

verses.english:
Now the king of Aram had instructed his thirty-two chariot
officers: “Don’t attack anyone, small or great, except the king of
Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב אֶת־יְהוֹשָׁפָט וְהֵמָּה אָמְרוּ אַךְ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא וַיָּסֻרוּ עָלָיו לְהִלָּחֵם וַיִּזְעַק יְהוֹשָׁפָט׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב אֶת־יְהוֹשָׁפָט וְהֵמָּה אָמְרוּ אַךְ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא וַיָּסֻרוּ עָלָיו לְהִלָּחֵם וַיִּזְעַק יְהוֹשָׁפָט׃

english.text:
So when the chariot officers saw Jehoshaphat, whom they took for
the king of Israel, they turned upon him to attack him, and
Jehoshaphat cried out.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.

verses.english:
So when the chariot officers saw Jehoshaphat, whom they took for
the king of Israel, they turned upon him to attack him, and
Jehoshaphat cried out.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב כִּי־לֹא־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא וַיָּשׁוּבוּ מֵאַחֲרָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב כִּי־לֹא־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא וַיָּשׁוּבוּ מֵאַחֲרָיו׃

english.text:
And when the chariot officers became aware that he was not the
king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.

verses.english:
And when the chariot officers became aware that he was not the
king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

verses.hebrew:
וְאִישׁ מָשַׁךְ בַּקֶּשֶׁת לְתֻמּוֹ וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל בֵּין הַדְּבָקִים וּבֵין הַשִּׁרְיָן וַיֹּאמֶר לְרַכָּבוֹ הֲפֹךְ יָדְךָ וְהוֹצִיאֵנִי מִן־הַמַּחֲנֶה כִּי
החֳלֵיתִי׃

hebrew.text:
וְאִישׁ מָשַׁךְ בַּקֶּשֶׁת לְתֻמּוֹ וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל בֵּין הַדְּבָקִים וּבֵין הַשִּׁרְיָן וַיֹּאמֶר לְרַכָּבוֹ הֲפֹךְ יָדְךָ וְהוֹצִיאֵנִי מִן־הַמַּחֲנֶה כִּי
החֳלֵיתִי׃

english.text:
Then a man drew his bow at random and he hit the king of Israel
between the plates of the armor; and he said to his charioteer,
“Turn the horses around and get me behind the lines; I’m wounded.”

translation.text: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

verses.english:
Then a man drew his bow at random and he hit the king of Israel
between the plates of the armor; and he said to his charioteer,
“Turn the horses around and get me behind the lines; I’m wounded.”

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲלֶה הַמִּלְחָמָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְהַמֶּלֶךְ הָיָה מעֳמָד בַּמֶּרְכָּבָה נֹכַח אֲרָם וַיָּמת בָּעֶרֶב וַיִּצֶק דַּם־הַמַּכָּה אֶל־חֵיק הָרָכֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעֲלֶה הַמִּלְחָמָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְהַמֶּלֶךְ הָיָה מעֳמָד בַּמֶּרְכָּבָה נֹכַח אֲרָם וַיָּמת בָּעֶרֶב וַיִּצֶק דַּם־הַמַּכָּה אֶל־חֵיק הָרָכֶב׃

english.text:
The battle raged all day long, and the king remained propped up in
the chariot facing Aram; the blood from the wound ran down into
the hollow of the chariot, and at dusk he died.

translation.text: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.

verses.english:
The battle raged all day long, and the king remained propped up in
the chariot facing Aram; the blood from the wound ran down into
the hollow of the chariot, and at dusk he died.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר הָרִנָּה בַּמַּחֲנֶה כְּבֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לֵאמֹר אִישׁ אֶל־עִירוֹ וְאִישׁ אֶל־אַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבֹר הָרִנָּה בַּמַּחֲנֶה כְּבֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לֵאמֹר אִישׁ אֶל־עִירוֹ וְאִישׁ אֶל־אַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
As the sun was going down, a shout went through the army: “Every
man to his own town! Every man to his own district.”

translation.text: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.

verses.english:
As the sun was going down, a shout went through the army: “Every
man to his own town! Every man to his own district.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיָּבוֹא שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיָּבוֹא שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
So the king died and was brought to Samaria. They buried the king
in Samaria,

translation.text: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

verses.english:
So the king died and was brought to Samaria. They buried the king
in Samaria,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁטֹף אֶת־הָרֶכֶב עַל בְּרֵכַת שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיָּלֹקּוּ הַכְּלָבִים אֶת־דָּמוֹ וְהַזֹּנוֹת רָחָצוּ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁטֹף אֶת־הָרֶכֶב עַל בְּרֵכַת שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיָּלֹקּוּ הַכְּלָבִים אֶת־דָּמוֹ וְהַזֹּנוֹת רָחָצוּ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃

english.text:
and they flushed out the chariot at the pool of Samaria. Thus the
dogs lapped up his blood and the whores bathed [in it], in
accordance with the word that YHWH had spoken.

translation.text: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the LORD which he spake.

verses.english:
and they flushed out the chariot at the pool of Samaria. Thus the
dogs lapped up his blood and the whores bathed [in it], in
accordance with the word that YHWH had spoken.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אַחְאָב וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּבֵית הַשֵּׁן אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה וְכל־הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אַחְאָב וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּבֵית הַשֵּׁן אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה וְכל־הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Ahab’s reign, and all his actions—the ivory
palace that he built and all the towns that he fortified—are all
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.english:
The other events of Ahab’s reign, and all his actions—the ivory
palace that he built and all the towns that he fortified—are all
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אַחְאָב עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֲחַזְיָהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אַחְאָב עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֲחַזְיָהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Ahab slept with his fathers, and his son Ahaziah succeeded him as
king.

translation.text: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Ahab slept with his fathers, and his son Ahaziah succeeded him as
king.

verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־אָסָא מָלַךְ עַל־יְהוּדָה בִּשְׁנַת אַרְבַּע לְאַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־אָסָא מָלַךְ עַל־יְהוּדָה בִּשְׁנַת אַרְבַּע לְאַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Jehoshaphat son of Asa had become king of Judah in the fourth year
of King Ahab of Israel.

translation.text: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

verses.english:
Jehoshaphat son of Asa had become king of Judah in the fourth year
of King Ahab of Israel.

verses.hebrew: יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה בְּמלְכוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ עֲזוּבָה בַּת־שִׁלְחִי׃

hebrew.text: יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה בְּמלְכוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ עֲזוּבָה בַּת־שִׁלְחִי׃

english.text:
Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he
reigned in Jerusalem for twenty-five years. His mother’s name was
Azubah daughter of Shilhi.

translation.text: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

verses.english:
Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he
reigned in Jerusalem for twenty-five years. His mother’s name was
Azubah daughter of Shilhi.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכל־דֶּרֶךְ אָסָא אָבִיו לֹא־סָר מִמֶּנּוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכל־דֶּרֶךְ אָסָא אָבִיו לֹא־סָר מִמֶּנּוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
He followed closely the course of his father Asa and did not
deviate from it, doing what was pleasing to YHWH.

translation.text: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of the LORD: nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.

verses.english:
He followed closely the course of his father Asa and did not
deviate from it, doing what was pleasing to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃

english.text:
However, the shrines did not cease to function; the people still
sacrificed and offered at the shrines.

translation.text: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

verses.english:
However, the shrines did not cease to function; the people still
sacrificed and offered at the shrines.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁלֵם יְהוֹשָׁפָט עִם־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁלֵם יְהוֹשָׁפָט עִם־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text: And further, Jehoshaphat submitted to the king of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.english: And further, Jehoshaphat submitted to the king of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹשָׁפָט וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה וַאֲשֶׁר נִלְחָם הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹשָׁפָט וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה וַאֲשֶׁר נִלְחָם הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
As for the other events of Jehoshaphat’s reign and the valor he
displayed in battle, they are recorded in the Annals of the Kings
of Judah.

translation.text: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.

verses.english:
As for the other events of Jehoshaphat’s reign and the valor he
displayed in battle, they are recorded in the Annals of the Kings
of Judah.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר הַקָּדֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁאַר בִּימֵי אָסָא אָבִיו בִּעֵר מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר הַקָּדֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁאַר בִּימֵי אָסָא אָבִיו בִּעֵר מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
(He also stamped out the remaining male prostitutes who had
survived in the land from the time of his father Asa.)

translation.text: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.

verses.english:
(He also stamped out the remaining male prostitutes who had
survived in the land from the time of his father Asa.)

verses.hebrew: וּמֶלֶךְ אֵין בֶּאֱדוֹם נִצָּב מֶלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וּמֶלֶךְ אֵין בֶּאֱדוֹם נִצָּב מֶלֶךְ׃

english.text: There was no king in Edom; a viceroy acted as king.

translation.text: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Eziongeber.

verses.english: There was no king in Edom; a viceroy acted as king.

verses.hebrew: יְהוֹשָׁפָט (עשר) [עָשָׂה] אֳנִיּוֹת תַּרְשִׁישׁ לָלֶכֶת אֹפִירָה לַזָּהָב וְלֹא הָלָךְ כִּי־[נִשְׁבְּרוּ] (נשברה) אֳנִיּוֹת בְּעֶצְיוֹן גָּבֶר׃

hebrew.text: יְהוֹשָׁפָט (עשר) [עָשָׂה] אֳנִיּוֹת תַּרְשִׁישׁ לָלֶכֶת אֹפִירָה לַזָּהָב וְלֹא הָלָךְ כִּי־[נִשְׁבְּרוּ] (נשברה) אֳנִיּוֹת בְּעֶצְיוֹן גָּבֶר׃

english.text:
Jehoshaphat constructed Tarshish ships to sail to Ophir for gold.
But he did not sail because the ships were wrecked at Ezion-geber.

translation.text: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.

verses.english:
Jehoshaphat constructed Tarshish ships to sail to Ophir for gold.
But he did not sail because the ships were wrecked at Ezion-geber.

verses.hebrew: אָז אָמַר אֲחַזְיָהוּ בֶן־אַחְאָב אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט יֵלְכוּ עֲבָדַי עִם־עֲבָדֶיךָ בּאֳנִיּוֹת וְלֹא אָבָה יְהוֹשָׁפָט׃

hebrew.text: אָז אָמַר אֲחַזְיָהוּ בֶן־אַחְאָב אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט יֵלְכוּ עֲבָדַי עִם־עֲבָדֶיךָ בּאֳנִיּוֹת וְלֹא אָבָה יְהוֹשָׁפָט׃

english.text:
Then Ahaziah son of Ahab proposed to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants
sail on the ships with your servants”; but Jehoshaphat would not
agree.

translation.text: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Then Ahaziah son of Ahab proposed to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants
sail on the ships with your servants”; but Jehoshaphat would not
agree.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹשָׁפָט עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹרָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹשָׁפָט עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹרָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers
in the city of his father David, and his son Jehoram succeeded him
as king.

translation.text: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.

verses.english:
Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers
in the city of his father David, and his son Jehoram succeeded him
as king.

verses.hebrew: אֲחַזְיָהוּ בֶן־אַחְאָב מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן בִּשְׁנַת שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה לִיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁנָתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: אֲחַזְיָהוּ בֶן־אַחְאָב מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן בִּשְׁנַת שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה לִיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁנָתָיִם׃

english.text:
[Meanwhile,] Ahaziah son of Ahab had become king of Israel, in
Samaria, in the seventeenth year of King Jehoshaphat of Judah; he
reigned over Israel two years.

translation.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:

verses.english:
[Meanwhile,] Ahaziah son of Ahab had become king of Israel, in
Samaria, in the seventeenth year of King Jehoshaphat of Judah; he
reigned over Israel two years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אָבִיו וּבְדֶרֶךְ אִמּוֹ וּבְדֶרֶךְ יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אָבִיו וּבְדֶרֶךְ אִמּוֹ וּבְדֶרֶךְ יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, following in the footsteps of
his father and his mother, and in those of Jeroboam son of Nebat
who had caused Israel to sin.

translation.text: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the LORD God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, following in the footsteps of
his father and his mother, and in those of Jeroboam son of Nebat
who had caused Israel to sin.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבַּעַל וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לוֹ וַיַּכְעֵס אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אָבִיו׃

english.text:
He worshiped Baal and bowed down to him; he vexed YHWH, the God of
Israel, just as his father had done.

translation.text: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

verses.english: After Ahab’s death, Moab rebelled against Israel.

Ahaziah fell through the lattice in his upper chamber at Samaria
and was injured. So he sent messengers, whom he instructed: “Go
inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I shall recover
from this injury.”

translation.text: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said unto them, Go, enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.

Ahaziah fell through the lattice in his upper chamber at Samaria

inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I shall recover
from this injury.”

Ekron?

Assuredly, thus said YHWH: You shall not rise from the bed you are

Assuredly, thus said YHWH: You shall not rise from the bed you are

come back?”

The messengers returned to Ahaziah; and he asked, “Why have you

They answered him, “A man came toward us and said to us, ‘Go back
to the king who sent you, and say to him: Thus said YHWH: Is there
no God in Israel that you must send to inquire of Baal-zebub, the
god of Ekron? Assuredly, you shall not rise from the bed you are
lying on, but shall die.’”

translation.text: And they said unto him, There came a man up to meet us, and said unto us, Go, turn again unto the king that sent you, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that thou sendest to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.

verses.english:
They answered him, “A man came toward us and said to us, ‘Go back
to the king who sent you, and say to him: Thus said YHWH: Is there
no God in Israel that you must send to inquire of Baal-zebub, the
god of Ekron? Assuredly, you shall not rise from the bed you are
lying on, but shall die.’”

“What sort of man was it,” he asked them, “who came toward you and

verses.english:
“What sort of man was it,” he asked them, “who came toward you and
said these things to you?”

english.text:

waist.” “That’s Elijah the Tishbite!” he said.

translation.text: And they answered him, He was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.

verses.english:

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשׁב וַיִּשְׁלַח שַׂר־חֲמִשִּׁים שְׁלִשִׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁיו וַיַּעַל וַיָּבֹא שַׂר־הַחֲמִשִּׁים הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וַיִּכְרַע עַל־בִּרְכָּיו לְנֶגֶד אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיִּתְחַנֵּן אֵלָיו
וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים תִּיקַר־נָא נַפְשִׁי וְנֶפֶשׁ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֵלֶּה חֲמִשִּׁים בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Then he sent a third captain of fifty with his fifty men. The
third captain of fifty climbed to the top, knelt before Elijah,
and implored him, saying, “Oh, man of God, please have regard for
my life and the lives of these fifty servants of yours!

translation.text: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him, and said unto him, O man of God, I pray thee, let my life, and the life of these fifty thy servants, be precious in thy sight.

verses.english:
Then he sent a third captain of fifty with his fifty men. The
third captain of fifty climbed to the top, knelt before Elijah,
and implored him, saying, “Oh, man of God, please have regard for
my life and the lives of these fifty servants of yours!

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה יָרְדָה אֵשׁ מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם וַתֹּאכַל אֶת־שְׁנֵי שָׂרֵי הַחֲמִשִּׁים הָרִאשֹׁנִים וְאֶת־חֲמִשֵּׁיהֶם וְעַתָּה תִּיקַר נַפְשִׁי בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה יָרְדָה אֵשׁ מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם וַתֹּאכַל אֶת־שְׁנֵי שָׂרֵי הַחֲמִשִּׁים הָרִאשֹׁנִים וְאֶת־חֲמִשֵּׁיהֶם וְעַתָּה תִּיקַר נַפְשִׁי בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
Already fire has come from heaven and consumed the first two
captains of fifty and their men; I beg you, have regard for my
life!”

translation.text: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight.

verses.english:
Already fire has come from heaven and consumed the first two
captains of fifty and their men; I beg you, have regard for my
life!”

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ רֵד אוֹתוֹ אַל־תִּירָא מִפָּנָיו וַיָּקם וַיֵּרֶד אוֹתוֹ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ רֵד אוֹתוֹ אַל־תִּירָא מִפָּנָיו וַיָּקם וַיֵּרֶד אוֹתוֹ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Then the angel of YHWH said to Elijah, “Go down with him, do not
be afraid of him.” So he rose and went down with him to the king.

translation.text: And the angel of the LORD said unto Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him. And he arose, and went down with him unto the king.

verses.english:
Then the angel of YHWH said to Elijah, “Go down with him, do not
be afraid of him.” So he rose and went down with him to the king.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַחְתָּ מַלְאָכִים לִדְרֹשׁ בְּבַעַל זְבוּב אֱלֹהֵי עֶקְרוֹן הֲמִבְּלִי אֵין־אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לִדְרֹשׁ בִּדְבָרוֹ לָכֵן
הַמִּטָּה אֲשֶׁר־עָלִיתָ שָּׁם לֹא־תֵרֵד מִמֶּנָּה כִּי־מוֹת תָּמוּת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַחְתָּ מַלְאָכִים לִדְרֹשׁ בְּבַעַל זְבוּב אֱלֹהֵי עֶקְרוֹן הֲמִבְּלִי אֵין־אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לִדְרֹשׁ בִּדְבָרוֹ לָכֵן
הַמִּטָּה אֲשֶׁר־עָלִיתָ שָּׁם לֹא־תֵרֵד מִמֶּנָּה כִּי־מוֹת תָּמוּת׃

english.text:
He said to him, “Thus said YHWH: Because you sent messengers to
inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron—as if there were no God in
Israel whose word you could seek—assuredly, you shall not rise
from the bed which you are lying on; but you shall die.”

translation.text: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron, is it not because there is no God in Israel to enquire of his word? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.

verses.english:
He said to him, “Thus said YHWH: Because you sent messengers to
inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron—as if there were no God in
Israel whose word you could seek—assuredly, you shall not rise
from the bed which you are lying on; but you shall die.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹרָם תַּחְתָּיובִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לִיהוֹרָם בֶּן־יְהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה כִּי לֹא־הָיָה לוֹ בֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹרָם תַּחְתָּיובִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לִיהוֹרָם בֶּן־יְהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה כִּי לֹא־הָיָה לוֹ בֵּן׃

english.text:
And [Ahaziah] died, according to the word of YHWH that Elijah had
spoken. Jehoram succeeded him as king, in the second year of King
Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat of Judah, for he had no son.

translation.text: So he died according to the word of the LORD which Elijah had spoken.

verses.english:
And [Ahaziah] died, according to the word of YHWH that Elijah had
spoken. Jehoram succeeded him as king, in the second year of King
Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat of Judah, for he had no son.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֲחַזְיָהוּ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵמָּה כְתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֲחַזְיָהוּ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵמָּה כְתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Ahaziah’s reign [and] his actions are recorded
in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.english:
The other events of Ahaziah’s reign [and] his actions are recorded
in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּהַעֲלוֹת יְהֹוָה אֶת־אֵלִיָּהוּ בַּסְעָרָה הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֵלִיָּהוּ וֶאֱלִישָׁע מִן־הַגִּלְגָּל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בְּהַעֲלוֹת יְהֹוָה אֶת־אֵלִיָּהוּ בַּסְעָרָה הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֵלִיָּהוּ וֶאֱלִישָׁע מִן־הַגִּלְגָּל׃

english.text:
When YHWH was about to take Elijah up to heaven in a whirlwind,
Elijah and Elisha had set out from Gilgal.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the LORD would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

verses.english:
When YHWH was about to take Elijah up to heaven in a whirlwind,
Elijah and Elisha had set out from Gilgal.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע שֵׁב־נָא פֹה כִּי יְהֹוָה שְׁלָחַנִי עַד־בֵּית־אֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶךָּ וַיֵּרְדוּ בֵּית־אֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע שֵׁב־נָא פֹה כִּי יְהֹוָה שְׁלָחַנִי עַד־בֵּית־אֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶךָּ וַיֵּרְדוּ בֵּית־אֵל׃

english.text:
Elijah said to Elisha, “Stay here, for YHWH has sent me on to
Bethel.” “As YHWH lives and as you live,” said Elisha, “I will not
leave you.” So they went down to Bethel.

translation.text: And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Bethel. And Elisha said unto him, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they went down to Bethel.

verses.english:
Elijah said to Elisha, “Stay here, for YHWH has sent me on to
Bethel.” “As YHWH lives and as you live,” said Elisha, “I will not
leave you.” So they went down to Bethel.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּצְאוּ בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִים אֲשֶׁר־בֵּית־אֵל אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו הֲיָדַעְתָּ כִּי הַיּוֹם יְהֹוָה לֹקֵחַ אֶת־אֲדֹנֶיךָ מֵעַל רֹאשֶׁךָ וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־אֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי
הֶחֱשׁוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּצְאוּ בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִים אֲשֶׁר־בֵּית־אֵל אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו הֲיָדַעְתָּ כִּי הַיּוֹם יְהֹוָה לֹקֵחַ אֶת־אֲדֹנֶיךָ מֵעַל רֹאשֶׁךָ וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־אֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי
הֶחֱשׁוּ׃

english.text:
Disciples of the prophets at Bethel came out to Elisha and said to
him, “Do you know that YHWH will take your master away from you
today?” He replied, “I know it, too; be silent.”

translation.text: And the sons of the prophets that were at Bethel came forth to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he said, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.

verses.english:
Disciples of the prophets at Bethel came out to Elisha and said to
him, “Do you know that YHWH will take your master away from you
today?” He replied, “I know it, too; be silent.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֵלִיָּהוּ אֱלִישָׁע שֵׁב־נָא פֹה כִּי יְהֹוָה שְׁלָחַנִי יְרִיחוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶךָּ וַיָּבֹאוּ יְרִיחוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֵלִיָּהוּ אֱלִישָׁע שֵׁב־נָא פֹה כִּי יְהֹוָה שְׁלָחַנִי יְרִיחוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶךָּ וַיָּבֹאוּ יְרִיחוֹ׃

english.text:
Then Elijah said to him, “Elisha, stay here, for YHWH has sent me
on to Jericho.” “As YHWH lives and as you live,” said Elisha, “I
will not leave you.” So they went on to Jericho.

translation.text: And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Jericho. And he said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they came to Jericho.

verses.english:
Then Elijah said to him, “Elisha, stay here, for YHWH has sent me
on to Jericho.” “As YHWH lives and as you live,” said Elisha, “I
will not leave you.” So they went on to Jericho.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּגְּשׁוּ בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִים אֲשֶׁר־בִּירִיחוֹ אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו הֲיָדַעְתָּ כִּי הַיּוֹם יְהֹוָה לֹקֵחַ אֶת־אֲדֹנֶיךָ מֵעַל רֹאשֶׁךָ וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־אֲנִי
יָדַעְתִּי הֶחֱשׁוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּגְּשׁוּ בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִים אֲשֶׁר־בִּירִיחוֹ אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו הֲיָדַעְתָּ כִּי הַיּוֹם יְהֹוָה לֹקֵחַ אֶת־אֲדֹנֶיךָ מֵעַל רֹאשֶׁךָ וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־אֲנִי
יָדַעְתִּי הֶחֱשׁוּ׃

english.text:
The disciples of the prophets who were at Jericho came over to
Elisha and said to him, “Do you know that YHWH will take your
master away from you today?” He replied, “I know it, too; be
silent.”

translation.text: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he answered, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.

verses.english:
The disciples of the prophets who were at Jericho came over to
Elisha and said to him, “Do you know that YHWH will take your
master away from you today?” He replied, “I know it, too; be
silent.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֵלִיָּהוּ שֵׁב־נָא פֹה כִּי יְהֹוָה שְׁלָחַנִי הַיַּרְדֵּנָה וַיֹּאמֶר חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶךָּ וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֵלִיָּהוּ שֵׁב־נָא פֹה כִּי יְהֹוָה שְׁלָחַנִי הַיַּרְדֵּנָה וַיֹּאמֶר חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶךָּ וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Elijah said to him, “Stay here, for YHWH has sent me on to the
Jordan.” “As YHWH lives and as you live, I will not leave you,” he
said, and the two of them went on.

translation.text: And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray thee, here; for the LORD hath sent me to Jordan. And he said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And they two went on.

verses.english:
Elijah said to him, “Stay here, for YHWH has sent me on to the
Jordan.” “As YHWH lives and as you live, I will not leave you,” he
said, and the two of them went on.

verses.hebrew: וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים הָלְכוּ וַיַּעַמְדוּ מִנֶּגֶד מֵרָחוֹק וּשְׁנֵיהֶם עָמְדוּ עַל־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים הָלְכוּ וַיַּעַמְדוּ מִנֶּגֶד מֵרָחוֹק וּשְׁנֵיהֶם עָמְדוּ עַל־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
Fifty men of the disciples of the prophets followed and stood by
at a distance from them as the two of them stopped at the Jordan.

translation.text: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.

verses.english:
Fifty men of the disciples of the prophets followed and stood by
at a distance from them as the two of them stopped at the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶת־אַדַּרְתּוֹ וַיִּגְלֹם וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־הַמַּיִם וַיֵּחָצוּ הֵנָּה וָהֵנָּה וַיַּעַבְרוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם בֶּחָרָבָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶת־אַדַּרְתּוֹ וַיִּגְלֹם וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־הַמַּיִם וַיֵּחָצוּ הֵנָּה וָהֵנָּה וַיַּעַבְרוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם בֶּחָרָבָה׃

english.text:
Thereupon Elijah took his mantle and, rolling it up, he struck the
water; it divided to the right and left, so that the two of them
crossed over on dry land.

translation.text: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.

verses.english:
Thereupon Elijah took his mantle and, rolling it up, he struck the
water; it divided to the right and left, so that the two of them
crossed over on dry land.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְעבְרָם וְאֵלִיָּהוּ אָמַר אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע שְׁאַל מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ בְּטֶרֶם אֶלָּקַח מֵעִמָּךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע וִיהִי נָא פִּי־שְׁנַיִם בְּרוּחֲךָ אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְעבְרָם וְאֵלִיָּהוּ אָמַר אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע שְׁאַל מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ בְּטֶרֶם אֶלָּקַח מֵעִמָּךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע וִיהִי נָא פִּי־שְׁנַיִם בְּרוּחֲךָ אֵלָי׃

english.text:
As they were crossing, Elijah said to Elisha, “Tell me, what can I
do for you before I am taken from you?” Elisha answered, “Let a
double portion of your spirit pass on to me.”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.

verses.english:
As they were crossing, Elijah said to Elisha, “Tell me, what can I
do for you before I am taken from you?” Elisha answered, “Let a
double portion of your spirit pass on to me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הִקְשִׁיתָ לִשְׁאוֹל אִם־תִּרְאֶה אֹתִי לֻקָּח מֵאִתָּךְ יְהִי־לְךָ כֵן וְאִם־אַיִן לֹא יִהְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הִקְשִׁיתָ לִשְׁאוֹל אִם־תִּרְאֶה אֹתִי לֻקָּח מֵאִתָּךְ יְהִי־לְךָ כֵן וְאִם־אַיִן לֹא יִהְיֶה׃

english.text:
“You have asked a difficult thing,” he said. “If you see me as I
am being taken from you, this will be granted to you; if not, it
will not.”

translation.text: And he said, Thou hast asked a hard thing: nevertheless, if thou see me when I am taken from thee, it shall be so unto thee; but if not, it shall not be so.

verses.english:
“You have asked a difficult thing,” he said. “If you see me as I
am being taken from you, this will be granted to you; if not, it
will not.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הֵמָּה הֹלְכִים הָלוֹךְ וְדַבֵּר וְהִנֵּה רֶכֶב־אֵשׁ וְסוּסֵי אֵשׁ וַיַּפְרִדוּ בֵּין שְׁנֵיהֶם וַיַּעַל אֵלִיָּהוּ בַּסְעָרָה הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הֵמָּה הֹלְכִים הָלוֹךְ וְדַבֵּר וְהִנֵּה רֶכֶב־אֵשׁ וְסוּסֵי אֵשׁ וַיַּפְרִדוּ בֵּין שְׁנֵיהֶם וַיַּעַל אֵלִיָּהוּ בַּסְעָרָה הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

english.text:
As they kept on walking and talking, a fiery chariot with fiery
horses suddenly appeared and separated one from the other; and
Elijah went up to heaven in a whirlwind.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

verses.english:
As they kept on walking and talking, a fiery chariot with fiery
horses suddenly appeared and separated one from the other; and
Elijah went up to heaven in a whirlwind.

verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִישָׁע רֹאֶה וְהוּא מְצַעֵק אָבִי אָבִי רֶכֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפָרָשָׁיו וְלֹא רָאָהוּ עוֹד וַיַּחֲזֵק בִּבְגָדָיו וַיִּקְרָעֵם לִשְׁנַיִם קְרָעִים׃

hebrew.text: וֶאֱלִישָׁע רֹאֶה וְהוּא מְצַעֵק אָבִי אָבִי רֶכֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפָרָשָׁיו וְלֹא רָאָהוּ עוֹד וַיַּחֲזֵק בִּבְגָדָיו וַיִּקְרָעֵם לִשְׁנַיִם קְרָעִים׃

english.text:
Elisha saw it, and he cried out, “Oh, father, father! Israel’s
chariots and horsemen!” When he could no longer see him, he
grasped his garments and rent them in two.

translation.text: And Elisha saw it, and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.

verses.english:
Elisha saw it, and he cried out, “Oh, father, father! Israel’s
chariots and horsemen!” When he could no longer see him, he
grasped his garments and rent them in two.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרֶם אֶת־אַדֶּרֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ אֲשֶׁר נָפְלָה מֵעָלָיו וַיָּשׁב וַיַּעֲמֹד עַל־שְׂפַת הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּרֶם אֶת־אַדֶּרֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ אֲשֶׁר נָפְלָה מֵעָלָיו וַיָּשׁב וַיַּעֲמֹד עַל־שְׂפַת הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

english.text:
He picked up Elijah’s mantle, which had dropped from him; and he
went back and stood on the bank of the Jordan.

translation.text: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;

verses.english:
He picked up Elijah’s mantle, which had dropped from him; and he
went back and stood on the bank of the Jordan.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח אֶת־אַדֶּרֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ אֲשֶׁר־נָפְלָה מֵעָלָיו וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־הַמַּיִם וַיֹּאמַר אַיֵּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ אַף־הוּא וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־הַמַּיִם וַיֵּחָצוּ הֵנָּה
וָהֵנָּה וַיַּעֲבֹר אֱלִישָׁע׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח אֶת־אַדֶּרֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ אֲשֶׁר־נָפְלָה מֵעָלָיו וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־הַמַּיִם וַיֹּאמַר אַיֵּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ אַף־הוּא וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־הַמַּיִם וַיֵּחָצוּ הֵנָּה
וָהֵנָּה וַיַּעֲבֹר אֱלִישָׁע׃

english.text:
Taking the mantle which had dropped from Elijah, he struck the
water and said, “Where is YHWH, the God of Elijah?” As he too
struck the water, it parted to the right and to the left, and
Elisha crossed over.

translation.text: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is the LORD God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.

verses.english:
Taking the mantle which had dropped from Elijah, he struck the
water and said, “Where is YHWH, the God of Elijah?” As he too
struck the water, it parted to the right and to the left, and
Elisha crossed over.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאֻהוּ בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִים אֲשֶׁר־בִּירִיחוֹ מִנֶּגֶד וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָחָה רוּחַ אֵלִיָּהוּ עַל־אֱלִישָׁע וַיָּבֹאוּ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ־לוֹ אָרְצָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאֻהוּ בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִים אֲשֶׁר־בִּירִיחוֹ מִנֶּגֶד וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָחָה רוּחַ אֵלִיָּהוּ עַל־אֱלִישָׁע וַיָּבֹאוּ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ־לוֹ אָרְצָה׃

english.text:
When the disciples of the prophets at Jericho saw him from a
distance, they exclaimed, “The spirit of Elijah has settled on
Elisha!” And they went to meet him and bowed low before him to the
ground.

translation.text: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

verses.english:
When the disciples of the prophets at Jericho saw him from a
distance, they exclaimed, “The spirit of Elijah has settled on
Elisha!” And they went to meet him and bowed low before him to the
ground.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו הִנֵּה־נָא יֵשׁ־אֶת־עֲבָדֶיךָ חֲמִשִּׁים אֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־חַיִל יֵלְכוּ נָא וִיבַקְשׁוּ אֶת־אֲדֹנֶיךָ פֶּן־נְשָׂאוֹ רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וַיַּשְׁלִכֵהוּ בְּאַחַד
הֶהָרִים אוֹ בְּאַחַת (הגיאות) [הַגֵּיאָיוֹת] וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תִשְׁלָחוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו הִנֵּה־נָא יֵשׁ־אֶת־עֲבָדֶיךָ חֲמִשִּׁים אֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־חַיִל יֵלְכוּ נָא וִיבַקְשׁוּ אֶת־אֲדֹנֶיךָ פֶּן־נְשָׂאוֹ רוּחַ יְהֹוָה וַיַּשְׁלִכֵהוּ בְּאַחַד
הֶהָרִים אוֹ בְּאַחַת (הגיאות) [הַגֵּיאָיוֹת] וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תִשְׁלָחוּ׃

english.text:
They said to him, “Your servants have fifty able men with them.
Let them go and look for your master; perhaps the spirit of YHWH
has carried him off and cast him upon some mountain or into some
valley.” “Do not send them,” he replied.

translation.text: And they said unto him, Behold now, there be with thy servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master: lest peradventure the Spirit of the LORD hath taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, Ye shall not send.

verses.english:
They said to him, “Your servants have fifty able men with them.
Let them go and look for your master; perhaps the spirit of YHWH
has carried him off and cast him upon some mountain or into some
valley.” “Do not send them,” he replied.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְצְרוּ־בוֹ עַד־בֹּשׁ וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁלָחוּ וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ חֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ וַיְבַקְשׁוּ שְׁלֹשָׁה־יָמִים וְלֹא מְצָאֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפְצְרוּ־בוֹ עַד־בֹּשׁ וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁלָחוּ וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ חֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ וַיְבַקְשׁוּ שְׁלֹשָׁה־יָמִים וְלֹא מְצָאֻהוּ׃

english.text:
But they kept pressing him for a long time, until he said, “Send
them.” So they sent out fifty men, who searched for three days but
did not find him.

translation.text: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.

verses.english:
But they kept pressing him for a long time, until he said, “Send
them.” So they sent out fifty men, who searched for three days but
did not find him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ אֵלָיו וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב בִּירִיחוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם הֲלֹא־אָמַרְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם אַל־תֵּלֵכוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ אֵלָיו וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב בִּירִיחוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם הֲלֹא־אָמַרְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם אַל־תֵּלֵכוּ׃

english.text:
They came back to him while he was still in Jericho; and he said
to them, “I told you not to go.”

translation.text: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?

verses.english:
They came back to him while he was still in Jericho; and he said
to them, “I told you not to go.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע הִנֵּה־נָא מוֹשַׁב הָעִיר טוֹב כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲדֹנִי רֹאֶה וְהַמַּיִם רָעִים וְהָאָרֶץ מְשַׁכָּלֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע הִנֵּה־נָא מוֹשַׁב הָעִיר טוֹב כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲדֹנִי רֹאֶה וְהַמַּיִם רָעִים וְהָאָרֶץ מְשַׁכָּלֶת׃

english.text:
The men of the town said to Elisha, “Look, the town is a pleasant
place to live in, as my lord can see; but the water is bad and the
land causes bereavement.”

translation.text: And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water is naught, and the ground barren.

verses.english:
The men of the town said to Elisha, “Look, the town is a pleasant
place to live in, as my lord can see; but the water is bad and the
land causes bereavement.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר קְחוּ־לִי צְלֹחִית חֲדָשָׁה וְשִׂימוּ שָׁם מֶלַח וַיִּקְחוּ אֵלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר קְחוּ־לִי צְלֹחִית חֲדָשָׁה וְשִׂימוּ שָׁם מֶלַח וַיִּקְחוּ אֵלָיו׃

english.text:
He responded, “Bring me a new dish and put salt in it.” They
brought it to him;

translation.text: And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they brought it to him.

verses.english:
He responded, “Bring me a new dish and put salt in it.” They
brought it to him;

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא אֶל־מוֹצָא הַמַּיִם וַיַּשְׁלֶךְ־שָׁם מֶלַח וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה רִפִּאתִי לַמַּיִם הָאֵלֶּה לֹא־יִהְיֶה מִשָּׁם עוֹד מָוֶת וּמְשַׁכָּלֶת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא אֶל־מוֹצָא הַמַּיִם וַיַּשְׁלֶךְ־שָׁם מֶלַח וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה רִפִּאתִי לַמַּיִם הָאֵלֶּה לֹא־יִהְיֶה מִשָּׁם עוֹד מָוֶת וּמְשַׁכָּלֶת׃

english.text:
he went to the spring and threw salt into it. And he said, “Thus
said YHWH: I heal this water; no longer shall death and
bereavement come from it!”

translation.text: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus saith the LORD, I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land.

verses.english:
he went to the spring and threw salt into it. And he said, “Thus
said YHWH: I heal this water; no longer shall death and
bereavement come from it!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָפוּ הַמַּיִם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּדְבַר אֱלִישָׁע אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרָפוּ הַמַּיִם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּדְבַר אֱלִישָׁע אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃

english.text:
The water has remained wholesome to this day, in accordance with
the word spoken by Elisha.

translation.text: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spake.

verses.english:
The water has remained wholesome to this day, in accordance with
the word spoken by Elisha.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מִשָּׁם בֵּית־אֵל וְהוּא עֹלֶה בַדֶּרֶךְ וּנְעָרִים קְטַנִּים יָצְאוּ מִן־הָעִיר וַיִּתְקַלְּסוּ־בוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ עֲלֵה קֵרֵחַ עֲלֵה קֵרֵחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל מִשָּׁם בֵּית־אֵל וְהוּא עֹלֶה בַדֶּרֶךְ וּנְעָרִים קְטַנִּים יָצְאוּ מִן־הָעִיר וַיִּתְקַלְּסוּ־בוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ עֲלֵה קֵרֵחַ עֲלֵה קֵרֵחַ׃

english.text:
From there he went up to Bethel. As he was going up the road, some
little boys came out of the town and jeered at him, saying, “Go
away, baldhead! Go away, baldhead!”

translation.text: And he went up from thence unto Bethel: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.

verses.english:
From there he went up to Bethel. As he was going up the road, some
little boys came out of the town and jeered at him, saying, “Go
away, baldhead! Go away, baldhead!”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן אַחֲרָיו וַיִּרְאֵם וַיְקַלְלֵם בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה וַתֵּצֶאנָה שְׁתַּיִם דֻּבִּים מִן־הַיַּעַר וַתְּבַקַּעְנָה מֵהֶם אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנֵי יְלָדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּפֶן אַחֲרָיו וַיִּרְאֵם וַיְקַלְלֵם בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה וַתֵּצֶאנָה שְׁתַּיִם דֻּבִּים מִן־הַיַּעַר וַתְּבַקַּעְנָה מֵהֶם אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנֵי יְלָדִים׃

english.text:
He turned around and looked at them and cursed them in the name of
YHWH. Thereupon, two she-bears came out of the woods and mangled
forty-two of the children.

translation.text: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of the LORD. And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tare forty and two children of them.

verses.english:
He turned around and looked at them and cursed them in the name of
YHWH. Thereupon, two she-bears came out of the woods and mangled
forty-two of the children.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם אֶל־הַר הַכַּרְמֶל וּמִשָּׁם שָׁב שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם אֶל־הַר הַכַּרְמֶל וּמִשָּׁם שָׁב שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
He went on from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned
to Samaria.

translation.text: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.

verses.english:
He went on from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned
to Samaria.

verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹרָם בֶּן־אַחְאָב מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן בִּשְׁנַת שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה לִיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וִיהוֹרָם בֶּן־אַחְאָב מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן בִּשְׁנַת שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה לִיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
Jehoram son of Ahab became king of Israel in Samaria in the
eighteenth year of King Jehoshaphat of Judah; and he reigned
twelve years.

translation.text: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.

verses.english:
Jehoram son of Ahab became king of Israel in Samaria in the
eighteenth year of King Jehoshaphat of Judah; and he reigned
twelve years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשֶׂה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה רַק לֹא כְאָבִיו וּכְאִמּוֹ וַיָּסַר אֶת־מַצְּבַת הַבַּעַל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשֶׂה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה רַק לֹא כְאָבִיו וּכְאִמּוֹ וַיָּסַר אֶת־מַצְּבַת הַבַּעַל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אָבִיו׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, yet not like his father and
mother, for he removed the pillars of Baal that his father had
made.

translation.text: And he wrought evil in the sight of the LORD; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, yet not like his father and
mother, for he removed the pillars of Baal that his father had
made.

verses.hebrew: רַק בְּחַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל דָּבֵק לֹא־סָר מִמֶּנָּה׃

hebrew.text: רַק בְּחַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל דָּבֵק לֹא־סָר מִמֶּנָּה׃

english.text:
However, he clung to the sins which Jeroboam son of Nebat caused
Israel to commit; he did not depart from them.

translation.text: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.

verses.english:
However, he clung to the sins which Jeroboam son of Nebat caused
Israel to commit; he did not depart from them.

verses.hebrew: וּמֵישַׁע מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב הָיָה נֹקֵד וְהֵשִׁיב לְמֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאָה־אֶלֶף כָּרִים וּמֵאָה אֶלֶף אֵילִים צָמֶר׃

hebrew.text: וּמֵישַׁע מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב הָיָה נֹקֵד וְהֵשִׁיב לְמֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאָה־אֶלֶף כָּרִים וּמֵאָה אֶלֶף אֵילִים צָמֶר׃

english.text:
Now King Mesha of Moab was a sheep breeder; and he used to pay as
tribute to the king of Israel a hundred thousand lambs and the
wool of a hundred thousand rams.

translation.text: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.

verses.english:
Now King Mesha of Moab was a sheep breeder; and he used to pay as
tribute to the king of Israel a hundred thousand lambs and the
wool of a hundred thousand rams.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּמוֹת אַחְאָב וַיִּפְשַׁע מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב בְּמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּמוֹת אַחְאָב וַיִּפְשַׁע מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב בְּמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But when Ahab died, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of
Israel.

translation.text: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

verses.english:
But when Ahab died, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of
Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוֹרָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא מִשֹּׁמְרוֹן וַיִּפְקֹד אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוֹרָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא מִשֹּׁמְרוֹן וַיִּפְקֹד אֶת־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
So King Jehoram promptly set out from Samaria and mustered all
Israel.

translation.text: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Israel.

verses.english:
So King Jehoram promptly set out from Samaria and mustered all
Israel.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב פָּשַׁע בִּי הֲתֵלֵךְ אִתִּי אֶל־מוֹאָב לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶעֱלֶה כָּמוֹנִי כָמוֹךָ כְּעַמִּי
כְעַמֶּךָ כְּסוּסַי כְּסוּסֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב פָּשַׁע בִּי הֲתֵלֵךְ אִתִּי אֶל־מוֹאָב לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶעֱלֶה כָּמוֹנִי כָמוֹךָ כְּעַמִּי
כְעַמֶּךָ כְּסוּסַי כְּסוּסֶיךָ׃

english.text:
At the same time, he sent this message to King Jehoshaphat of
