Judah: “The king of Moab has rebelled against me; will you come
with me to make war on Moab?” He replied, “I will go. I will do
what you do: my troops shall be your troops, my horses shall be
your horses.”

translation.text: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab hath rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up: I am as thou art, my people as thy people, and my horses as thy horses.

verses.english:
At the same time, he sent this message to King Jehoshaphat of
Judah: “The king of Moab has rebelled against me; will you come
with me to make war on Moab?” He replied, “I will go. I will do
what you do: my troops shall be your troops, my horses shall be
your horses.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵי־זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ נַעֲלֶה וַיֹּאמֶר דֶּרֶךְ מִדְבַּר אֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵי־זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ נַעֲלֶה וַיֹּאמֶר דֶּרֶךְ מִדְבַּר אֱדוֹם׃

english.text:
And he asked, “Which route shall we take?” [Jehoram] replied, “The
road through the wilderness of Edom.”

translation.text: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.

verses.english:
And he asked, “Which route shall we take?” [Jehoram] replied, “The
road through the wilderness of Edom.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה וּמֶלֶךְ אֱדוֹם וַיָּסֹבּוּ דֶּרֶךְ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְלֹא־הָיָה מַיִם לַמַּחֲנֶה וְלַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה וּמֶלֶךְ אֱדוֹם וַיָּסֹבּוּ דֶּרֶךְ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְלֹא־הָיָה מַיִם לַמַּחֲנֶה וְלַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
So the king of Israel, the king of Judah, and the king of Edom set
out, and they marched for seven days until they rounded [the tip
of the Dead Sea]; and there was no water left for the army or for
the animals that were with them.

translation.text: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom: and they fetched a compass of seven days’ journey: and there was no water for the host, and for the cattle that followed them.

verses.english:
So the king of Israel, the king of Judah, and the king of Edom set
out, and they marched for seven days until they rounded [the tip
of the Dead Sea]; and there was no water left for the army or for
the animals that were with them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲהָהּ כִּי־קָרָא יְהֹוָה לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה לָתֵת אוֹתָם בְּיַד־מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲהָהּ כִּי־קָרָא יְהֹוָה לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה לָתֵת אוֹתָם בְּיַד־מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
“Alas!” cried the king of Israel. “YHWH has brought these three
kings together only to deliver them into the hands of Moab.”

translation.text: And the king of Israel said, Alas! that the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab!

verses.english:
“Alas!” cried the king of Israel. “YHWH has brought these three
kings together only to deliver them into the hands of Moab.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט הַאֵין פֹּה נָבִיא לַיהֹוָה וְנִדְרְשָׁה אֶת־יְהֹוָה מֵאוֹתוֹ וַיַּעַן אֶחָד מֵעַבְדֵי מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר פֹּה אֱלִישָׁע בֶּן־שָׁפָט אֲשֶׁר־יָצַק
מַיִם עַל־יְדֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט הַאֵין פֹּה נָבִיא לַיהֹוָה וְנִדְרְשָׁה אֶת־יְהֹוָה מֵאוֹתוֹ וַיַּעַן אֶחָד מֵעַבְדֵי מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר פֹּה אֱלִישָׁע בֶּן־שָׁפָט אֲשֶׁר־יָצַק
מַיִם עַל־יְדֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there a prophet of YHWH here, through
whom we may inquire of YHWH?” One of the courtiers of the king of
Israel spoke up and said, “Elisha son of Shaphat, who poured water
on the hands of Elijah, is here.”

translation.text: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD, that we may enquire of the LORD by him? And one of the king of Israel’s servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, which poured water on the hands of Elijah.

verses.english:
But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there a prophet of YHWH here, through
whom we may inquire of YHWH?” One of the courtiers of the king of
Israel spoke up and said, “Elisha son of Shaphat, who poured water
on the hands of Elijah, is here.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט יֵשׁ אוֹתוֹ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה וַיֵּרְדוּ אֵלָיו מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוֹשָׁפָט וּמֶלֶךְ אֱדוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט יֵשׁ אוֹתוֹ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה וַיֵּרְדוּ אֵלָיו מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוֹשָׁפָט וּמֶלֶךְ אֱדוֹם׃

english.text:
“The word of YHWH is with him,” said Jehoshaphat. So the king of
Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

translation.text: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the LORD is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

verses.english:
“The word of YHWH is with him,” said Jehoshaphat. So the king of
Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מַה־לִּי וָלָךְ לֵךְ אֶל־נְבִיאֵי אָבִיךָ וְאֶל־נְבִיאֵי אִמֶּךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אַל כִּי־קָרָא יְהֹוָה לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת
הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה לָתֵת אוֹתָם בְּיַד־מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מַה־לִּי וָלָךְ לֵךְ אֶל־נְבִיאֵי אָבִיךָ וְאֶל־נְבִיאֵי אִמֶּךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אַל כִּי־קָרָא יְהֹוָה לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת
הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה לָתֵת אוֹתָם בְּיַד־מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
Elisha said to the king of Israel, “What have you to do with me?
Go to your father’s prophets or your mother’s prophets.” But the
king of Israel said, “Don’t [say that], for YHWH has brought these
three kings together only to deliver them into the hands of Moab.”

translation.text: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel, What have I to do with thee? get thee to the prophets of thy father, and to the prophets of thy mother.

verses.english:
Elisha said to the king of Israel, “What have you to do with me?
Go to your father’s prophets or your mother’s prophets.” But the
king of Israel said, “Don’t [say that], for YHWH has brought these
three kings together only to deliver them into the hands of Moab.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע חַי־יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָמַדְתִּי לְפָנָיו כִּי לוּלֵי פְּנֵי יְהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֲנִי נֹשֵׂא אִם־אַבִּיט אֵלֶיךָ וְאִם־אֶרְאֶךָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע חַי־יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָמַדְתִּי לְפָנָיו כִּי לוּלֵי פְּנֵי יְהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֲנִי נֹשֵׂא אִם־אַבִּיט אֵלֶיךָ וְאִם־אֶרְאֶךָּ׃

english.text:
“As YHWH of Hosts lives, whom I serve,” Elisha answered, “were it
not that I respect King Jehoshaphat of Judah, I wouldn’t look at
you or notice you.

translation.text: And Elisha said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee.

verses.english:
“As YHWH of Hosts lives, whom I serve,” Elisha answered, “were it
not that I respect King Jehoshaphat of Judah, I wouldn’t look at
you or notice you.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה קְחוּ־לִי מְנַגֵּן וְהָיָה כְּנַגֵּן הַמְנַגֵּן וַתְּהִי עָלָיו יַד־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה קְחוּ־לִי מְנַגֵּן וְהָיָה כְּנַגֵּן הַמְנַגֵּן וַתְּהִי עָלָיו יַד־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Now then, get me a musician.” As the musician played, the hand of
YHWH came upon him,

translation.text: But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the LORD came upon him.

verses.english:
Now then, get me a musician.” As the musician played, the hand of
YHWH came upon him,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה עָשֹׂה הַנַּחַל הַזֶּה גֵּבִים גֵּבִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה עָשֹׂה הַנַּחַל הַזֶּה גֵּבִים גֵּבִים׃

english.text: and he said, “Thus said YHWH: This wadi shall be full of pools.

translation.text: And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Make this valley full of ditches.

verses.english: and he said, “Thus said YHWH: This wadi shall be full of pools.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־כֹה אָמַר יְהֹוָה לֹא־תִרְאוּ רוּחַ וְלֹא־תִרְאוּ גֶשֶׁם וְהַנַּחַל הַהוּא יִמָּלֵא מָיִם וּשְׁתִיתֶם אַתֶּם וּמִקְנֵיכֶם וּבְהֶמְתְּכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־כֹה אָמַר יְהֹוָה לֹא־תִרְאוּ רוּחַ וְלֹא־תִרְאוּ גֶשֶׁם וְהַנַּחַל הַהוּא יִמָּלֵא מָיִם וּשְׁתִיתֶם אַתֶּם וּמִקְנֵיכֶם וּבְהֶמְתְּכֶם׃

english.text:
For thus said YHWH: You shall see no wind, you shall see no rain,
and yet the wadi shall be filled with water; and you and your
cattle and your pack animals shall drink.

translation.text: For thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.

verses.english:
For thus said YHWH: You shall see no wind, you shall see no rain,
and yet the wadi shall be filled with water; and you and your
cattle and your pack animals shall drink.

verses.hebrew: וְנָקַל זֹאת בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וְנָתַן אֶת־מוֹאָב בְּיֶדְכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָקַל זֹאת בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וְנָתַן אֶת־מוֹאָב בְּיֶדְכֶם׃

english.text:
And this is but a slight thing in the sight of YHWH, for He will
also deliver Moab into your hands.

translation.text: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the LORD: he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand.

verses.english:
And this is but a slight thing in the sight of YHWH, for He will
also deliver Moab into your hands.

verses.hebrew: וְהִכִּיתֶם כּל־עִיר מִבְצָר וְכל־עִיר מִבְחוֹר וְכל־עֵץ טוֹב תַּפִּילוּ וְכל־מַעְיְנֵי־מַיִם תִּסְתֹּמוּ וְכֹל הַחֶלְקָה הַטּוֹבָה תַּכְאִבוּ בָּאֲבָנִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהִכִּיתֶם כּל־עִיר מִבְצָר וְכל־עִיר מִבְחוֹר וְכל־עֵץ טוֹב תַּפִּילוּ וְכל־מַעְיְנֵי־מַיִם תִּסְתֹּמוּ וְכֹל הַחֶלְקָה הַטּוֹבָה תַּכְאִבוּ בָּאֲבָנִים׃

translation.text: And ye shall smite every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר כַּעֲלוֹת הַמִּנְחָה וְהִנֵּה־מַיִם בָּאִים מִדֶּרֶךְ אֱדוֹם וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ אֶת־הַמָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר כַּעֲלוֹת הַמִּנְחָה וְהִנֵּה־מַיִם בָּאִים מִדֶּרֶךְ אֱדוֹם וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ אֶת־הַמָּיִם׃

english.text:
And in the morning, when it was time to present the meal offering,
water suddenly came from the direction of Edom and the land was
covered by the water.

translation.text: And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

verses.english:
And in the morning, when it was time to present the meal offering,
water suddenly came from the direction of Edom and the land was
covered by the water.

verses.hebrew: וְכל־מוֹאָב שָׁמְעוּ כִּי־עָלוּ הַמְּלָכִים לְהִלָּחֶם בָּם וַיִּצָּעֲקוּ מִכֹּל חֹגֵר חֲגֹרָה וָמַעְלָה וַיַּעַמְדוּ עַל־הַגְּבוּל׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־מוֹאָב שָׁמְעוּ כִּי־עָלוּ הַמְּלָכִים לְהִלָּחֶם בָּם וַיִּצָּעֲקוּ מִכֹּל חֹגֵר חֲגֹרָה וָמַעְלָה וַיַּעַמְדוּ עַל־הַגְּבוּל׃

english.text:
Meanwhile, all the Moabites had heard that the kings were
advancing to make war on them; every man old enough to bear arms
rallied, and they stationed themselves at the border.

translation.text: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood in the border.

verses.english:
Meanwhile, all the Moabites had heard that the kings were
advancing to make war on them; every man old enough to bear arms
rallied, and they stationed themselves at the border.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ בַבֹּקֶר וְהַשֶּׁמֶשׁ זָרְחָה עַל־הַמָּיִם וַיִּרְאוּ מוֹאָב מִנֶּגֶד אֶת־הַמַּיִם אֲדֻמִּים כַּדָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ בַבֹּקֶר וְהַשֶּׁמֶשׁ זָרְחָה עַל־הַמָּיִם וַיִּרְאוּ מוֹאָב מִנֶּגֶד אֶת־הַמַּיִם אֲדֻמִּים כַּדָּם׃

english.text:
Next morning, when they rose, the sun was shining over the water,
and from the distance the water appeared to the Moabites as red as
blood.

translation.text: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood:

verses.english:
Next morning, when they rose, the sun was shining over the water,
and from the distance the water appeared to the Moabites as red as
blood.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ דָּם זֶה החֳרֵב נֶחֶרְבוּ הַמְּלָכִים וַיַּכּוּ אִישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ וְעַתָּה לַשָּׁלָל מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ דָּם זֶה החֳרֵב נֶחֶרְבוּ הַמְּלָכִים וַיַּכּוּ אִישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ וְעַתָּה לַשָּׁלָל מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
“That’s blood!” they said. “The kings must have fought among
themselves and killed each other. Now to the spoil, Moab!”

translation.text: And they said, This is blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.

verses.english:
“That’s blood!” they said. “The kings must have fought among
themselves and killed each other. Now to the spoil, Moab!”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־מַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּקֻמוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־מוֹאָב וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם (ויבו) [וַיַּכּוּ־]בָהּ וְהַכּוֹת אֶת־מוֹאָב׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־מַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּקֻמוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־מוֹאָב וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם (ויבו) [וַיַּכּוּ־]בָהּ וְהַכּוֹת אֶת־מוֹאָב׃

english.text:
They entered the Israelite camp, and the Israelites arose and
attacked the Moabites, who fled before them. They advanced,
constantly attacking the Moabites,

translation.text: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went forward smiting the Moabites, even in their country.

verses.english:
They entered the Israelite camp, and the Israelites arose and
attacked the Moabites, who fled before them. They advanced,
constantly attacking the Moabites,

verses.hebrew:
וְהֶעָרִים יַהֲרֹסוּ וְכל־חֶלְקָה טוֹבָה יַשְׁלִיכוּ אִישׁ־אַבְנוֹ וּמִלְאוּהָ וְכל־מַעְיַן־מַיִם יִסְתֹּמוּ וְכל־עֵץ־טוֹב יַפִּילוּ עַד־הִשְׁאִיר אֲבָנֶיהָ בַּקִּיר חֲרָשֶׂת
וַיָּסֹבּוּ הַקַּלָּעִים וַיַּכּוּהָ׃

hebrew.text:
וְהֶעָרִים יַהֲרֹסוּ וְכל־חֶלְקָה טוֹבָה יַשְׁלִיכוּ אִישׁ־אַבְנוֹ וּמִלְאוּהָ וְכל־מַעְיַן־מַיִם יִסְתֹּמוּ וְכל־עֵץ־טוֹב יַפִּילוּ עַד־הִשְׁאִיר אֲבָנֶיהָ בַּקִּיר חֲרָשֶׂת
וַיָּסֹבּוּ הַקַּלָּעִים וַיַּכּוּהָ׃

english.text:
and they destroyed the towns. Every man threw a stone into each
fertile field, so that it was covered over; and they stopped up
every spring and felled every fruit tree. Only the walls of
Kir-hareseth were left, and then the slingers surrounded it and
attacked it.

translation.text: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kirharaseth left they the stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about it, and smote it.

verses.english:
and they destroyed the towns. Every man threw a stone into each
fertile field, so that it was covered over; and they stopped up
every spring and felled every fruit tree. Only the walls of
Kir-hareseth were left, and then the slingers surrounded it and
attacked it.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב כִּי־חָזַק מִמֶּנּוּ הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּקַּח אוֹתוֹ שְׁבַע־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ שֹׁלֵף חֶרֶב לְהַבְקִיעַ אֶל־מֶלֶךְ אֱדוֹם וְלֹא יָכֹלוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב כִּי־חָזַק מִמֶּנּוּ הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּקַּח אוֹתוֹ שְׁבַע־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ שֹׁלֵף חֶרֶב לְהַבְקִיעַ אֶל־מֶלֶךְ אֱדוֹם וְלֹא יָכֹלוּ׃

english.text:
Seeing that the battle was going against him, the king of Moab led
an attempt of seven hundred swordsmen to break a way through to
the king of Edom; but they failed.

translation.text: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through even unto the king of Edom: but they could not.

verses.english:
Seeing that the battle was going against him, the king of Moab led
an attempt of seven hundred swordsmen to break a way through to
the king of Edom; but they failed.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־בְּנוֹ הַבְּכוֹר אֲשֶׁר־יִמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ עֹלָה עַל־הַחֹמָה וַיְהִי קֶצֶף־גָּדוֹל עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעָלָיו וַיָּשֻׁבוּ לָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־בְּנוֹ הַבְּכוֹר אֲשֶׁר־יִמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ עֹלָה עַל־הַחֹמָה וַיְהִי קֶצֶף־גָּדוֹל עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעָלָיו וַיָּשֻׁבוּ לָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
So he took his first-born son, who was to succeed him as king, and
offered him up on the wall as a burnt offering. A great wrath came
upon Israel, so they withdrew from him and went back to [their
own] land.

translation.text: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall. And there was great indignation against Israel: and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.

verses.english:
So he took his first-born son, who was to succeed him as king, and
offered him up on the wall as a burnt offering. A great wrath came
upon Israel, so they withdrew from him and went back to [their
own] land.

verses.hebrew:
וְאִשָּׁה אַחַת מִנְּשֵׁי בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִים צָעֲקָה אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע לֵאמֹר עַבְדְּךָ אִישִׁי מֵת וְאַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ כִּי עַבְדְּךָ הָיָה יָרֵא אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְהַנֹּשֶׁה בָּא לָקַחַת
אֶת־שְׁנֵי יְלָדַי לוֹ לַעֲבָדִים׃

hebrew.text:
וְאִשָּׁה אַחַת מִנְּשֵׁי בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִים צָעֲקָה אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע לֵאמֹר עַבְדְּךָ אִישִׁי מֵת וְאַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ כִּי עַבְדְּךָ הָיָה יָרֵא אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְהַנֹּשֶׁה בָּא לָקַחַת
אֶת־שְׁנֵי יְלָדַי לוֹ לַעֲבָדִים׃

english.text:
A certain woman, the wife of one of the disciples of the prophets,
cried out to Elisha: “Your servant my husband is dead, and you
know how your servant revered YHWH. And now a creditor is coming
to seize my two children as slaves.”

translation.text: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the LORD: and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.

verses.english:
A certain woman, the wife of one of the disciples of the prophets,
cried out to Elisha: “Your servant my husband is dead, and you
know how your servant revered YHWH. And now a creditor is coming
to seize my two children as slaves.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אֱלִישָׁע מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ הַגִּידִי לִי מַה־יֶּשׁ־[לָךְ] (לכי) בַּבָּיִת וַתֹּאמֶר אֵין לְשִׁפְחָתְךָ כֹל בַּבַּיִת כִּי אִם־אָסוּךְ שָׁמֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אֱלִישָׁע מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ הַגִּידִי לִי מַה־יֶּשׁ־[לָךְ] (לכי) בַּבָּיִת וַתֹּאמֶר אֵין לְשִׁפְחָתְךָ כֹל בַּבַּיִת כִּי אִם־אָסוּךְ שָׁמֶן׃

english.text:
Elisha said to her, “What can I do for you? Tell me, what have you
in the house?” She replied, “Your maidservant has nothing at all
in the house, except a jug of oil.”

translation.text: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.

verses.english:
Elisha said to her, “What can I do for you? Tell me, what have you
in the house?” She replied, “Your maidservant has nothing at all
in the house, except a jug of oil.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְכִי שַׁאֲלִי־לָךְ כֵּלִים מִן־הַחוּץ מֵאֵת כּל־[שְׁכֵנָיִךְ] (שכנכי) כֵּלִים רֵקִים אַל־תַּמְעִיטִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְכִי שַׁאֲלִי־לָךְ כֵּלִים מִן־הַחוּץ מֵאֵת כּל־[שְׁכֵנָיִךְ] (שכנכי) כֵּלִים רֵקִים אַל־תַּמְעִיטִי׃

english.text:
“Go,” he said, “and borrow vessels outside, from all your
neighbors, empty vessels, as many as you can.

translation.text: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.

verses.english:
“Go,” he said, “and borrow vessels outside, from all your
neighbors, empty vessels, as many as you can.

verses.hebrew: וּבָאת וְסָגַרְתְּ הַדֶּלֶת בַּעֲדֵךְ וּבְעַד־בָּנַיִךְ וְיָצַקְתְּ עַל כּל־הַכֵּלִים הָאֵלֶּה וְהַמָּלֵא תַּסִּיעִי׃

hebrew.text: וּבָאת וְסָגַרְתְּ הַדֶּלֶת בַּעֲדֵךְ וּבְעַד־בָּנַיִךְ וְיָצַקְתְּ עַל כּל־הַכֵּלִים הָאֵלֶּה וְהַמָּלֵא תַּסִּיעִי׃

english.text:
Then go in and shut the door behind you and your children, and
pour [oil] into all those vessels, removing each one as it is
filled.”

translation.text: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.

verses.english:
Then go in and shut the door behind you and your children, and
pour [oil] into all those vessels, removing each one as it is
filled.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ מֵאִתּוֹ וַתִּסְגֹּר הַדֶּלֶת בַּעֲדָהּ וּבְעַד בָּנֶיהָ הֵם מַגִּישִׁים אֵלֶיהָ וְהִיא (מיצקת) [מוֹצָקֶת]׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶךְ מֵאִתּוֹ וַתִּסְגֹּר הַדֶּלֶת בַּעֲדָהּ וּבְעַד בָּנֶיהָ הֵם מַגִּישִׁים אֵלֶיהָ וְהִיא (מיצקת) [מוֹצָקֶת]׃

english.text:
She went away and shut the door behind her and her children. They
kept bringing [vessels] to her and she kept pouring.

translation.text: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.

verses.english:
She went away and shut the door behind her and her children. They
kept bringing [vessels] to her and she kept pouring.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּמְלֹאת הַכֵּלִים וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־בְּנָהּ הַגִּישָׁה אֵלַי עוֹד כֶּלִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אֵין עוֹד כֶּלִי וַיַּעֲמֹד הַשָּׁמֶן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּמְלֹאת הַכֵּלִים וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־בְּנָהּ הַגִּישָׁה אֵלַי עוֹד כֶּלִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אֵין עוֹד כֶּלִי וַיַּעֲמֹד הַשָּׁמֶן׃

english.text:
When the vessels were full, she said to her son, “Bring me another
vessel.” He answered her, “There are no more vessels”; and the oil
stopped.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.

verses.english:
When the vessels were full, she said to her son, “Bring me another
vessel.” He answered her, “There are no more vessels”; and the oil
stopped.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא וַתַּגֵּד לְאִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר לְכִי מִכְרִי אֶת־הַשֶּׁמֶן וְשַׁלְּמִי אֶת־[נִשְׁיֵךְ] (נשיכי) וְאַתְּ (בניכי) [וּבָנַיִךְ] תִּחְיִי בַּנּוֹתָר׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּבֹא וַתַּגֵּד לְאִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר לְכִי מִכְרִי אֶת־הַשֶּׁמֶן וְשַׁלְּמִי אֶת־[נִשְׁיֵךְ] (נשיכי) וְאַתְּ (בניכי) [וּבָנַיִךְ] תִּחְיִי בַּנּוֹתָר׃

english.text:
She came and told the man of God, and he said, “Go sell the oil
and pay your debt, and you and your children can live on the
rest.”

translation.text: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.

verses.english:
She came and told the man of God, and he said, “Go sell the oil
and pay your debt, and you and your children can live on the
rest.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיַּעֲבֹר אֱלִישָׁע אֶל־שׁוּנֵם וְשָׁם אִשָּׁה גְדוֹלָה וַתַּחֲזֶק־בּוֹ לֶאֱכל־לָחֶם וַיְהִי מִדֵּי עבְרוֹ יָסֻר שָׁמָּה לֶאֱכל־לָחֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיַּעֲבֹר אֱלִישָׁע אֶל־שׁוּנֵם וְשָׁם אִשָּׁה גְדוֹלָה וַתַּחֲזֶק־בּוֹ לֶאֱכל־לָחֶם וַיְהִי מִדֵּי עבְרוֹ יָסֻר שָׁמָּה לֶאֱכל־לָחֶם׃

english.text:
One day Elisha visited Shunem. A wealthy woman lived there, and
she urged him to have a meal; and whenever he passed by, he would
stop there for a meal.

translation.text: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.

verses.english:
One day Elisha visited Shunem. A wealthy woman lived there, and
she urged him to have a meal; and whenever he passed by, he would
stop there for a meal.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־אִישָׁהּ הִנֵּה־נָא יָדַעְתִּי כִּי אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים קָדוֹשׁ הוּא עֹבֵר עָלֵינוּ תָּמִיד׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־אִישָׁהּ הִנֵּה־נָא יָדַעְתִּי כִּי אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים קָדוֹשׁ הוּא עֹבֵר עָלֵינוּ תָּמִיד׃

english.text:
Once she said to her husband, “I am sure it is a holy man of God
who comes this way regularly.

translation.text: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.

verses.english:
Once she said to her husband, “I am sure it is a holy man of God
who comes this way regularly.

verses.hebrew: נַעֲשֶׂה־נָּא עֲלִיַּת־קִיר קְטַנָּה וְנָשִׂים לוֹ שָׁם מִטָּה וְשֻׁלְחָן וְכִסֵּא וּמְנוֹרָה וְהָיָה בְּבֹאוֹ אֵלֵינוּ יָסוּר שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: נַעֲשֶׂה־נָּא עֲלִיַּת־קִיר קְטַנָּה וְנָשִׂים לוֹ שָׁם מִטָּה וְשֻׁלְחָן וְכִסֵּא וּמְנוֹרָה וְהָיָה בְּבֹאוֹ אֵלֵינוּ יָסוּר שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
Let us make a small enclosed upper chamber and place a bed, a
table, a chair, and a lampstand there for him, so that he can stop
there whenever he comes to us.”

translation.text: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.

verses.english:
Let us make a small enclosed upper chamber and place a bed, a
table, a chair, and a lampstand there for him, so that he can stop
there whenever he comes to us.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיָּבֹא שָׁמָּה וַיָּסַר אֶל־הָעֲלִיָּה וַיִּשְׁכַּב־שָׁמָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיָּבֹא שָׁמָּה וַיָּסַר אֶל־הָעֲלִיָּה וַיִּשְׁכַּב־שָׁמָּה׃

english.text:
One day he came there; he retired to the upper chamber and lay
down there.

translation.text: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.

verses.english:
One day he came there; he retired to the upper chamber and lay
down there.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־גֵּיחֲזִי נַעֲרוֹ קְרָא לַשּׁוּנַמִּית הַזֹּאת וַיִּקְרָא־לָהּ וַתַּעֲמֹד לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־גֵּיחֲזִי נַעֲרוֹ קְרָא לַשּׁוּנַמִּית הַזֹּאת וַיִּקְרָא־לָהּ וַתַּעֲמֹד לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
He said to his servant Gehazi, “Call that Shunammite woman.” He
called her, and she stood before him.

translation.text: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.

verses.english:
He said to his servant Gehazi, “Call that Shunammite woman.” He
called her, and she stood before him.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱמר־נָא אֵלֶיהָ הִנֵּה חָרַדְתְּ אֵלֵינוּ אֶת־כּל־הַחֲרָדָה הַזֹּאת מֶה לַעֲשׂוֹת לָךְ הֲיֵשׁ לְדַבֶּר־לָךְ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אוֹ אֶל־שַׂר הַצָּבָא וַתֹּאמֶר בְּתוֹךְ
עַמִּי אָנֹכִי יֹשָׁבֶת׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱמר־נָא אֵלֶיהָ הִנֵּה חָרַדְתְּ אֵלֵינוּ אֶת־כּל־הַחֲרָדָה הַזֹּאת מֶה לַעֲשׂוֹת לָךְ הֲיֵשׁ לְדַבֶּר־לָךְ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אוֹ אֶל־שַׂר הַצָּבָא וַתֹּאמֶר בְּתוֹךְ
עַמִּי אָנֹכִי יֹשָׁבֶת׃

english.text:
He said to him, “Tell her, ‘You have gone to all this trouble for
us. What can we do for you? Can we speak in your behalf to the
king or to the army commander?’” She replied, “I live among my own
people.”

translation.text: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among mine own people.

verses.english:
He said to him, “Tell her, ‘You have gone to all this trouble for
us. What can we do for you? Can we speak in your behalf to the
king or to the army commander?’” She replied, “I live among my own
people.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר וּמֶה לַעֲשׂוֹת לָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר גֵּיחֲזִי אֲבָל בֵּן אֵין־לָהּ וְאִישָׁהּ זָקֵן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר וּמֶה לַעֲשׂוֹת לָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר גֵּיחֲזִי אֲבָל בֵּן אֵין־לָהּ וְאִישָׁהּ זָקֵן׃

english.text:
“What then can be done for her?” he asked. “The fact is,” said
Gehazi, “she has no son, and her husband is old.”

translation.text: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.

verses.english:
“What then can be done for her?” he asked. “The fact is,” said
Gehazi, “she has no son, and her husband is old.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר קְרָא־לָהּ וַיִּקְרָא־לָהּ וַתַּעֲמֹד בַּפָּתַח׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר קְרָא־לָהּ וַיִּקְרָא־לָהּ וַתַּעֲמֹד בַּפָּתַח׃

english.text: “Call her,” he said. He called her, and she stood in the doorway.

translation.text: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.

verses.english: “Call her,” he said. He called her, and she stood in the doorway.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לַמּוֹעֵד הַזֶּה כָּעֵת חַיָּה (אתי) [אַתְּ] חֹבֶקֶת בֵּן וַתֹּאמֶר אַל־אֲדֹנִי אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אַל־תְּכַזֵּב בְּשִׁפְחָתֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לַמּוֹעֵד הַזֶּה כָּעֵת חַיָּה (אתי) [אַתְּ] חֹבֶקֶת בֵּן וַתֹּאמֶר אַל־אֲדֹנִי אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אַל־תְּכַזֵּב בְּשִׁפְחָתֶךָ׃

english.text:
And Elisha said, “At this season next year, you will be embracing
a son.” She replied, “Please, my lord, man of God, do not delude
your maidservant.”

translation.text: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.

verses.english:
And Elisha said, “At this season next year, you will be embracing
a son.” She replied, “Please, my lord, man of God, do not delude
your maidservant.”

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר הָאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן לַמּוֹעֵד הַזֶּה כָּעֵת חַיָּה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֵלֶיהָ אֱלִישָׁע׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּהַר הָאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן לַמּוֹעֵד הַזֶּה כָּעֵת חַיָּה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֵלֶיהָ אֱלִישָׁע׃

english.text:
The woman conceived and bore a son at the same season the
following year, as Elisha had assured her.

translation.text: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.

verses.english:
The woman conceived and bore a son at the same season the
following year, as Elisha had assured her.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְדַּל הַיָּלֶד וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיֵּצֵא אֶל־אָבִיו אֶל־הַקֹּצְרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְדַּל הַיָּלֶד וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיֵּצֵא אֶל־אָבִיו אֶל־הַקֹּצְרִים׃

english.text:
The child grew up. One day, he went out to his father among the
reapers.

translation.text: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.

verses.english:
The child grew up. One day, he went out to his father among the
reapers.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אָבִיו רֹאשִׁי רֹאשִׁי וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הַנַּעַר שָׂאֵהוּ אֶל־אִמּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אָבִיו רֹאשִׁי רֹאשִׁי וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הַנַּעַר שָׂאֵהוּ אֶל־אִמּוֹ׃

english.text:
[Suddenly] he cried to his father, “Oh, my head, my head!” He said
to a servant, “Carry him to his mother.”

translation.text: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.

verses.english:
[Suddenly] he cried to his father, “Oh, my head, my head!” He said
to a servant, “Carry him to his mother.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂאֵהוּ וַיְבִיאֵהוּ אֶל־אִמּוֹ וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל־בִּרְכֶּיהָ עַד־הַצּהֳרַיִם וַיָּמֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂאֵהוּ וַיְבִיאֵהוּ אֶל־אִמּוֹ וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל־בִּרְכֶּיהָ עַד־הַצּהֳרַיִם וַיָּמֹת׃

english.text:
He picked him up and brought him to his mother. And the child sat
on her lap until noon; and he died.

translation.text: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.

verses.english:
He picked him up and brought him to his mother. And the child sat
on her lap until noon; and he died.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעַל וַתַּשְׁכִּבֵהוּ עַל־מִטַּת אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַתִּסְגֹּר בַּעֲדוֹ וַתֵּצֵא׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּעַל וַתַּשְׁכִּבֵהוּ עַל־מִטַּת אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַתִּסְגֹּר בַּעֲדוֹ וַתֵּצֵא׃

english.text:
She took him up and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and
left him and closed the door.

translation.text: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door upon him, and went out.

verses.english:
She took him up and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and
left him and closed the door.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרָא אֶל־אִישָׁהּ וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁלְחָה נָא לִי אֶחָד מִן־הַנְּעָרִים וְאַחַת הָאֲתֹנוֹת וְאָרוּצָה עַד־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וְאָשׁוּבָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּקְרָא אֶל־אִישָׁהּ וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁלְחָה נָא לִי אֶחָד מִן־הַנְּעָרִים וְאַחַת הָאֲתֹנוֹת וְאָרוּצָה עַד־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וְאָשׁוּבָה׃

english.text:
Then she called to her husband: “Please, send me one of the
servants and one of the she-asses, so I can hurry to the man of
God and back.”

translation.text: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.

verses.english:
Then she called to her husband: “Please, send me one of the
servants and one of the she-asses, so I can hurry to the man of
God and back.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מַדּוּעַ (אתי) [אַתְּ] (הלכתי) [הֹלֶכֶת] אֵלָיו הַיּוֹם לֹא־חֹדֶשׁ וְלֹא שַׁבָּת וַתֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מַדּוּעַ (אתי) [אַתְּ] (הלכתי) [הֹלֶכֶת] אֵלָיו הַיּוֹם לֹא־חֹדֶשׁ וְלֹא שַׁבָּת וַתֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
But he said, “Why are you going to him today? It is neither new
moon nor sabbath.” She answered, “It’s all right.”

translation.text: And he said, Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day? it is neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, It shall be well.

verses.english:
But he said, “Why are you going to him today? It is neither new
moon nor sabbath.” She answered, “It’s all right.”

verses.hebrew: וַתַּחֲבֹשׁ הָאָתוֹן וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־נַעֲרָהּ נְהַג וָלֵךְ אַל־תַּעֲצר־לִי לִרְכֹּב כִּי אִם־אָמַרְתִּי לָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַתַּחֲבֹשׁ הָאָתוֹן וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־נַעֲרָהּ נְהַג וָלֵךְ אַל־תַּעֲצר־לִי לִרְכֹּב כִּי אִם־אָמַרְתִּי לָךְ׃

english.text:
She had the ass saddled, and said to her servant, “Urge [the
beast] on; see that I don’t slow down unless I tell you.”

translation.text: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not thy riding for me, except I bid thee.

verses.english:
She had the ass saddled, and said to her servant, “Urge [the
beast] on; see that I don’t slow down unless I tell you.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתָּבֹא אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־הַר הַכַּרְמֶל וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֹתָהּ מִנֶּגֶד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־גֵּיחֲזִי נַעֲרוֹ הִנֵּה הַשּׁוּנַמִּית הַלָּז׃

hebrew.text: וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתָּבֹא אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־הַר הַכַּרְמֶל וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֹתָהּ מִנֶּגֶד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־גֵּיחֲזִי נַעֲרוֹ הִנֵּה הַשּׁוּנַמִּית הַלָּז׃

english.text:
She went on until she came to the man of God on Mount Carmel. When
the man of God saw her from afar, he said to his servant Gehazi,
“There is that Shunammite woman.

translation.text: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:

verses.english:
She went on until she came to the man of God on Mount Carmel. When
the man of God saw her from afar, he said to his servant Gehazi,
“There is that Shunammite woman.

verses.hebrew: עַתָּה רוּץ־נָא לִקְרָאתָהּ וֶאֱמר־לָהּ הֲשָׁלוֹם לָךְ הֲשָׁלוֹם לְאִישֵׁךְ הֲשָׁלוֹם לַיָּלֶד וַתֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם׃

hebrew.text: עַתָּה רוּץ־נָא לִקְרָאתָהּ וֶאֱמר־לָהּ הֲשָׁלוֹם לָךְ הֲשָׁלוֹם לְאִישֵׁךְ הֲשָׁלוֹם לַיָּלֶד וַתֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם׃

english.text:
Go, hurry toward her and ask her, ‘How are you? How is your
husband? How is the child?’” “We are well,” she replied.

translation.text: Run now, I pray thee, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child? And she answered, It is well:

verses.english:
Go, hurry toward her and ask her, ‘How are you? How is your
husband? How is the child?’” “We are well,” she replied.

verses.hebrew:
וַתָּבֹא אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־הָהָר וַתַּחֲזֵק בְּרַגְלָיו וַיִּגַּשׁ גֵּיחֲזִי לְהדְפָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים הַרְפֵּה־לָהּ כִּי־נַפְשָׁהּ מָרָה־לָהּ וַיהֹוָה הֶעְלִים
מִמֶּנִּי וְלֹא הִגִּיד לִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַתָּבֹא אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־הָהָר וַתַּחֲזֵק בְּרַגְלָיו וַיִּגַּשׁ גֵּיחֲזִי לְהדְפָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים הַרְפֵּה־לָהּ כִּי־נַפְשָׁהּ מָרָה־לָהּ וַיהֹוָה הֶעְלִים
מִמֶּנִּי וְלֹא הִגִּיד לִי׃

english.text:
But when she came up to the man of God on the mountain, she
clasped his feet. Gehazi stepped forward to push her away; but the
man of God said, “Let her alone, for she is in bitter distress;
and YHWH has hidden it from me and has not told me.”

translation.text: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and the LORD hath hid it from me, and hath not told me.

verses.english:
But when she came up to the man of God on the mountain, she
clasped his feet. Gehazi stepped forward to push her away; but the
man of God said, “Let her alone, for she is in bitter distress;
and YHWH has hidden it from me and has not told me.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁאַלְתִּי בֵן מֵאֵת אֲדֹנִי הֲלֹא אָמַרְתִּי לֹא תַשְׁלֶה אֹתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁאַלְתִּי בֵן מֵאֵת אֲדֹנִי הֲלֹא אָמַרְתִּי לֹא תַשְׁלֶה אֹתִי׃

english.text:
Then she said, “Did I ask my lord for a son? Didn’t I say: ‘Don’t
mislead me’?”

translation.text: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?

verses.english:
Then she said, “Did I ask my lord for a son? Didn’t I say: ‘Don’t
mislead me’?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר לְגֵיחֲזִי חֲגֹר מתְנֶיךָ וְקַח מִשְׁעַנְתִּי בְיָדְךָ וָלֵךְ כִּי־תִמְצָא אִישׁ לֹא תְבָרְכֶנּוּ וְכִי־יְבָרֶכְךָ אִישׁ לֹא תַעֲנֶנּוּ וְשַׂמְתָּ מִשְׁעַנְתִּי
עַל־פְּנֵי הַנָּעַר׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר לְגֵיחֲזִי חֲגֹר מתְנֶיךָ וְקַח מִשְׁעַנְתִּי בְיָדְךָ וָלֵךְ כִּי־תִמְצָא אִישׁ לֹא תְבָרְכֶנּוּ וְכִי־יְבָרֶכְךָ אִישׁ לֹא תַעֲנֶנּוּ וְשַׂמְתָּ מִשְׁעַנְתִּי
עַל־פְּנֵי הַנָּעַר׃

english.text:
He said to Gehazi, “Tie up your skirts, take my staff in your
hand, and go. If you meet anyone, do not greet him; and if anyone
greets you, do not answer him. And place my staff on the face of
the boy.”

translation.text: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.

verses.english:
He said to Gehazi, “Tie up your skirts, take my staff in your
hand, and go. If you meet anyone, do not greet him; and if anyone
greets you, do not answer him. And place my staff on the face of
the boy.”

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵם הַנַּעַר חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶךָּ וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵם הַנַּעַר חַי־יְהֹוָה וְחֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶךָּ וַיָּקם וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֶיהָ׃

english.text:
But the boy’s mother said, “As YHWH lives and as you live, I will
not leave you!” So he arose and followed her.

translation.text: And the mother of the child said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And he arose, and followed her.

verses.english:
But the boy’s mother said, “As YHWH lives and as you live, I will
not leave you!” So he arose and followed her.

verses.hebrew: וְגֵחֲזִי עָבַר לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־הַמִּשְׁעֶנֶת עַל־פְּנֵי הַנַּעַר וְאֵין קוֹל וְאֵין קָשֶׁב וַיָּשׁב לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא הֵקִיץ הַנָּעַר׃

hebrew.text: וְגֵחֲזִי עָבַר לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־הַמִּשְׁעֶנֶת עַל־פְּנֵי הַנַּעַר וְאֵין קוֹל וְאֵין קָשֶׁב וַיָּשׁב לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא הֵקִיץ הַנָּעַר׃

english.text:
Gehazi had gone on before them and had placed the staff on the
boy’s face; but there was no sound or response. He turned back to
meet him and told him, “The boy has not awakened.”

translation.text: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.

verses.english:
Gehazi had gone on before them and had placed the staff on the
boy’s face; but there was no sound or response. He turned back to
meet him and told him, “The boy has not awakened.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֱלִישָׁע הַבָּיְתָה וְהִנֵּה הַנַּעַר מֵת מֻשְׁכָּב עַל־מִטָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֱלִישָׁע הַבָּיְתָה וְהִנֵּה הַנַּעַר מֵת מֻשְׁכָּב עַל־מִטָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
Elisha came into the house, and there was the boy, laid out dead
on his couch.

translation.text: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.

verses.english:
Elisha came into the house, and there was the boy, laid out dead
on his couch.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא וַיִּסְגֹּר הַדֶּלֶת בְּעַד שְׁנֵיהֶם וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא וַיִּסְגֹּר הַדֶּלֶת בְּעַד שְׁנֵיהֶם וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
He went in, shut the door behind the two of them, and prayed to
YHWH.

translation.text: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto the LORD.

verses.english:
He went in, shut the door behind the two of them, and prayed to
YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל וַיִּשְׁכַּב עַל־הַיֶּלֶד וַיָּשֶׂם פִּיו עַל־פִּיו וְעֵינָיו עַל־עֵינָיו וְכַפָּיו עַל־כַּפָּו וַיִּגְהַר עָלָיו וַיָּחם בְּשַׂר הַיָּלֶד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל וַיִּשְׁכַּב עַל־הַיֶּלֶד וַיָּשֶׂם פִּיו עַל־פִּיו וְעֵינָיו עַל־עֵינָיו וְכַפָּיו עַל־כַּפָּו וַיִּגְהַר עָלָיו וַיָּחם בְּשַׂר הַיָּלֶד׃

english.text:
Then he mounted [the bed] and placed himself over the child. He
put his mouth on its mouth, his eyes on its eyes, and his hands on
its hands, as he bent over it. And the body of the child became
warm.

translation.text: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.

verses.english:
Then he mounted [the bed] and placed himself over the child. He
put his mouth on its mouth, his eyes on its eyes, and his hands on
its hands, as he bent over it. And the body of the child became
warm.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב וַיֵּלֶךְ בַּבַּיִת אַחַת הֵנָּה וְאַחַת הֵנָּה וַיַּעַל וַיִּגְהַר עָלָיו וַיְזוֹרֵר הַנַּעַר עַד־שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וַיִּפְקַח הַנַּעַר אֶת־עֵינָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב וַיֵּלֶךְ בַּבַּיִת אַחַת הֵנָּה וְאַחַת הֵנָּה וַיַּעַל וַיִּגְהַר עָלָיו וַיְזוֹרֵר הַנַּעַר עַד־שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וַיִּפְקַח הַנַּעַר אֶת־עֵינָיו׃

english.text:
He stepped down, walked once up and down the room, then mounted
and bent over him. Thereupon, the boy sneezed seven times, and the
boy opened his eyes.

translation.text: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

verses.english:
He stepped down, walked once up and down the room, then mounted
and bent over him. Thereupon, the boy sneezed seven times, and the
boy opened his eyes.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־גֵּיחֲזִי וַיֹּאמֶר קְרָא אֶל־הַשֻּׁנַמִּית הַזֹּאת וַיִּקְרָאֶהָ וַתָּבֹא אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר שְׂאִי בְנֵךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־גֵּיחֲזִי וַיֹּאמֶר קְרָא אֶל־הַשֻּׁנַמִּית הַזֹּאת וַיִּקְרָאֶהָ וַתָּבֹא אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר שְׂאִי בְנֵךְ׃

english.text:
[Elisha] called Gehazi and said, “Call the Shunammite woman,” and
he called her. When she came to him, he said, “Pick up your son.”

translation.text: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.

verses.english:
[Elisha] called Gehazi and said, “Call the Shunammite woman,” and
he called her. When she came to him, he said, “Pick up your son.”

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא וַתִּפֹּל עַל־רַגְלָיו וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ אָרְצָה וַתִּשָּׂא אֶת־בְּנָהּ וַתֵּצֵא׃

hebrew.text: וַתָּבֹא וַתִּפֹּל עַל־רַגְלָיו וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ אָרְצָה וַתִּשָּׂא אֶת־בְּנָהּ וַתֵּצֵא׃

english.text:
She came and fell at his feet and bowed low to the ground; then
she picked up her son and left.

translation.text: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.

verses.english:
She came and fell at his feet and bowed low to the ground; then
she picked up her son and left.

verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִישָׁע שָׁב הַגִּלְגָּלָה וְהָרָעָב בָּאָרֶץ וּבְנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים יֹשְׁבִים לְפָנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לְנַעֲרוֹ שְׁפֹת הַסִּיר הַגְּדוֹלָה וּבַשֵּׁל נָזִיד לִבְנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים׃

hebrew.text: וֶאֱלִישָׁע שָׁב הַגִּלְגָּלָה וְהָרָעָב בָּאָרֶץ וּבְנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים יֹשְׁבִים לְפָנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לְנַעֲרוֹ שְׁפֹת הַסִּיר הַגְּדוֹלָה וּבַשֵּׁל נָזִיד לִבְנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים׃

english.text:
Elisha returned to Gilgal. There was a famine in the land, and the
disciples of the prophets were sitting before him. He said to his
servant, “Set the large pot [on the fire] and cook a stew for the
disciples of the prophets.”

translation.text: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him: and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.

verses.english:
Elisha returned to Gilgal. There was a famine in the land, and the
disciples of the prophets were sitting before him. He said to his
servant, “Set the large pot [on the fire] and cook a stew for the
disciples of the prophets.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא אֶחָד אֶל־הַשָּׂדֶה לְלַקֵּט אֹרֹת וַיִּמְצָא גֶּפֶן שָׂדֶה וַיְלַקֵּט מִמֶּנּוּ פַּקֻּעֹת שָׂדֶה מְלֹא בִגְדוֹ וַיָּבֹא וַיְפַלַּח אֶל־סִיר הַנָּזִיד כִּי־לֹא יָדָעוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּצֵא אֶחָד אֶל־הַשָּׂדֶה לְלַקֵּט אֹרֹת וַיִּמְצָא גֶּפֶן שָׂדֶה וַיְלַקֵּט מִמֶּנּוּ פַּקֻּעֹת שָׂדֶה מְלֹא בִגְדוֹ וַיָּבֹא וַיְפַלַּח אֶל־סִיר הַנָּזִיד כִּי־לֹא יָדָעוּ׃

english.text:
So one of them went out into the fields to gather sprouts. He came
across a wild vine and picked from it wild gourds, as many as his
garment would hold. Then he came back and sliced them into the pot
of stew, for they did not know [what they were];

translation.text: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.

verses.english:
So one of them went out into the fields to gather sprouts. He came
across a wild vine and picked from it wild gourds, as many as his
garment would hold. Then he came back and sliced them into the pot
of stew, for they did not know [what they were];

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְקוּ לַאֲנָשִׁים לֶאֱכוֹל וַיְהִי כְּאכְלָם מֵהַנָּזִיד וְהֵמָּה צָעָקוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ מָוֶת בַּסִּיר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לֶאֱכֹל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּצְקוּ לַאֲנָשִׁים לֶאֱכוֹל וַיְהִי כְּאכְלָם מֵהַנָּזִיד וְהֵמָּה צָעָקוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ מָוֶת בַּסִּיר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לֶאֱכֹל׃

english.text:
and they served it for the men to eat. While they were still
eating of the stew, they began to cry out: “O man of God, there is
death in the pot!” And they could not eat it.

translation.text: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O thou man of God, there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.

verses.english:
and they served it for the men to eat. While they were still
eating of the stew, they began to cry out: “O man of God, there is
death in the pot!” And they could not eat it.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר וּקְחוּ־קֶמַח וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶל־הַסִּיר וַיֹּאמֶר צַק לָעָם וְיֹאכֵלוּ וְלֹא הָיָה דָּבָר רָע בַּסִּיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר וּקְחוּ־קֶמַח וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶל־הַסִּיר וַיֹּאמֶר צַק לָעָם וְיֹאכֵלוּ וְלֹא הָיָה דָּבָר רָע בַּסִּיר׃

english.text:
“Fetch some flour,” [Elisha] said. He threw it into the pot and
said, “Serve it to the people and let them eat.” And there was no
longer anything harmful in the pot.

translation.text: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.

verses.english:
“Fetch some flour,” [Elisha] said. He threw it into the pot and
said, “Serve it to the people and let them eat.” And there was no
longer anything harmful in the pot.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ בָּא מִבַּעַל שָׁלִשָׁה וַיָּבֵא לְאִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים לֶחֶם בִּכּוּרִים עֶשְׂרִים־לֶחֶם שְׂעֹרִים וְכַרְמֶל בְּצִקְלֹנוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר תֵּן לָעָם וְיֹאכֵלוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאִישׁ בָּא מִבַּעַל שָׁלִשָׁה וַיָּבֵא לְאִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים לֶחֶם בִּכּוּרִים עֶשְׂרִים־לֶחֶם שְׂעֹרִים וְכַרְמֶל בְּצִקְלֹנוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר תֵּן לָעָם וְיֹאכֵלוּ׃

english.text:
A man came from Baal-shalishah and he brought the man of God some
bread of the first reaping—twenty loaves of barley bread, and some
fresh grain in his sack. And [Elisha] said, “Give it to the people
and let them eat.”

translation.text: And there came a man from Baalshalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.

verses.english:
A man came from Baal-shalishah and he brought the man of God some
bread of the first reaping—twenty loaves of barley bread, and some
fresh grain in his sack. And [Elisha] said, “Give it to the people
and let them eat.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מְשָׁרְתוֹ מָה אֶתֵּן זֶה לִפְנֵי מֵאָה אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר תֵּן לָעָם וְיֹאכֵלוּ כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אָכֹל וְהוֹתֵר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מְשָׁרְתוֹ מָה אֶתֵּן זֶה לִפְנֵי מֵאָה אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר תֵּן לָעָם וְיֹאכֵלוּ כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אָכֹל וְהוֹתֵר׃

english.text:
His attendant replied, “How can I set this before a hundred men?”
But he said, “Give it to the people and let them eat. For thus
said YHWH: They shall eat and have some left over.”

translation.text: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the LORD, They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.

verses.english:
His attendant replied, “How can I set this before a hundred men?”
But he said, “Give it to the people and let them eat. For thus
said YHWH: They shall eat and have some left over.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיּוֹתִרוּ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיּוֹתִרוּ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
So he set it before them; and when they had eaten, they had some
left over, as YHWH had said.

translation.text: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of the LORD.

verses.english:
So he set it before them; and when they had eaten, they had some
left over, as YHWH had said.

verses.hebrew: וְנַעֲמָן שַׂר־צְבָא מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם הָיָה אִישׁ גָּדוֹל לִפְנֵי אֲדֹנָיו וּנְשֻׂא פָנִים כִּי־בוֹ נָתַן־יְהֹוָה תְּשׁוּעָה לַאֲרָם וְהָאִישׁ הָיָה גִּבּוֹר חַיִל מְצֹרָע׃

hebrew.text: וְנַעֲמָן שַׂר־צְבָא מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם הָיָה אִישׁ גָּדוֹל לִפְנֵי אֲדֹנָיו וּנְשֻׂא פָנִים כִּי־בוֹ נָתַן־יְהֹוָה תְּשׁוּעָה לַאֲרָם וְהָאִישׁ הָיָה גִּבּוֹר חַיִל מְצֹרָע׃

english.text:
Naaman, commander of the army of the king of Aram, was important
to his lord and high in his favor, for through him YHWH had
granted victory to Aram. But the man, though a great warrior, was
a leper.

translation.text: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the LORD had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.

verses.english:
Naaman, commander of the army of the king of Aram, was important
to his lord and high in his favor, for through him YHWH had
granted victory to Aram. But the man, though a great warrior, was
a leper.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲרָם יָצְאוּ גְדוּדִים וַיִּשְׁבּוּ מֵאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל נַעֲרָה קְטַנָּה וַתְּהִי לִפְנֵי אֵשֶׁת נַעֲמָן׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲרָם יָצְאוּ גְדוּדִים וַיִּשְׁבּוּ מֵאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל נַעֲרָה קְטַנָּה וַתְּהִי לִפְנֵי אֵשֶׁת נַעֲמָן׃

english.text:
Once, when the Arameans were out raiding, they carried off a young
girl from the land of Israel, and she became an attendant to
Naaman’s wife.

translation.text: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman’s wife.

verses.english:
Once, when the Arameans were out raiding, they carried off a young
girl from the land of Israel, and she became an attendant to
Naaman’s wife.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־גְּבִרְתָּהּ אַחֲלֵי אֲדֹנִי לִפְנֵי הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן אָז יֶאֱסֹף אֹתוֹ מִצָּרַעְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־גְּבִרְתָּהּ אַחֲלֵי אֲדֹנִי לִפְנֵי הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן אָז יֶאֱסֹף אֹתוֹ מִצָּרַעְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
She said to her mistress, “I wish Master could come before the
prophet in Samaria; he would cure him of his leprosy.”

translation.text: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.

verses.english:
She said to her mistress, “I wish Master could come before the
prophet in Samaria; he would cure him of his leprosy.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא וַיַּגֵּד לַאדֹנָיו לֵאמֹר כָּזֹאת וְכָזֹאת דִּבְּרָה הַנַּעֲרָה אֲשֶׁר מֵאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא וַיַּגֵּד לַאדֹנָיו לֵאמֹר כָּזֹאת וְכָזֹאת דִּבְּרָה הַנַּעֲרָה אֲשֶׁר מֵאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
[Naaman] went and told his lord just what the girl from the land
of Israel had said.

translation.text: And one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel.

verses.english:
[Naaman] went and told his lord just what the girl from the land
of Israel had said.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם לֶךְ־בֹּא וְאֶשְׁלְחָה סֵפֶר אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּקַּח בְּיָדוֹ עֶשֶׂר כִּכְּרֵי־כֶסֶף וְשֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים זָהָב וְעֶשֶׂר חֲלִיפוֹת בְּגָדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם לֶךְ־בֹּא וְאֶשְׁלְחָה סֵפֶר אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּקַּח בְּיָדוֹ עֶשֶׂר כִּכְּרֵי־כֶסֶף וְשֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים זָהָב וְעֶשֶׂר חֲלִיפוֹת בְּגָדִים׃

english.text:
And the king of Aram said, “Go to the king of Israel, and I will
send along a letter.” He set out, taking with him ten talents of
silver, six thousand shekels of gold, and ten changes of clothing.

translation.text: And the king of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.

verses.english:
And the king of Aram said, “Go to the king of Israel, and I will
send along a letter.” He set out, taking with him ten talents of
silver, six thousand shekels of gold, and ten changes of clothing.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֵא הַסֵּפֶר אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר וְעַתָּה כְּבוֹא הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה אֵלֶיךָ הִנֵּה שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֶת־נַעֲמָן עַבְדִּי וַאֲסַפְתּוֹ מִצָּרַעְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֵא הַסֵּפֶר אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר וְעַתָּה כְּבוֹא הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה אֵלֶיךָ הִנֵּה שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֶת־נַעֲמָן עַבְדִּי וַאֲסַפְתּוֹ מִצָּרַעְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
He brought the letter to the king of Israel. It read: “Now, when
this letter reaches you, know that I have sent my courtier Naaman
to you, that you may cure him of his leprosy.”

translation.text: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now when this letter is come unto thee, behold, I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy.

verses.english:
He brought the letter to the king of Israel. It read: “Now, when
this letter reaches you, know that I have sent my courtier Naaman
to you, that you may cure him of his leprosy.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כִּקְרֹא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַסֵּפֶר וַיִּקְרַע בְּגָדָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הַאֱלֹהִים אָנִי לְהָמִית וּלְהַחֲיוֹת כִּי־זֶה שֹׁלֵחַ אֵלַי לֶאֱסֹף אִישׁ מִצָּרַעְתּוֹ כִּי
אַךְ־דְּעוּ־נָא וּרְאוּ כִּי־מִתְאַנֶּה הוּא לִי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כִּקְרֹא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַסֵּפֶר וַיִּקְרַע בְּגָדָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הַאֱלֹהִים אָנִי לְהָמִית וּלְהַחֲיוֹת כִּי־זֶה שֹׁלֵחַ אֵלַי לֶאֱסֹף אִישׁ מִצָּרַעְתּוֹ כִּי
אַךְ־דְּעוּ־נָא וּרְאוּ כִּי־מִתְאַנֶּה הוּא לִי׃

english.text:
When the king of Israel read the letter, he rent his clothes and
cried, “Am I God, to deal death or give life, that this fellow
writes to me to cure a man of leprosy? Just see for yourselves
that he is seeking a pretext against me!”

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said, Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me.

verses.english:
When the king of Israel read the letter, he rent his clothes and
cried, “Am I God, to deal death or give life, that this fellow
writes to me to cure a man of leprosy? Just see for yourselves
that he is seeking a pretext against me!”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אֱלִישָׁע אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי־קָרַע מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר לָמָּה קָרַעְתָּ בְּגָדֶיךָ יָבֹא־נָא אֵלַי וְיֵדַע כִּי
יֵשׁ נָבִיא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אֱלִישָׁע אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי־קָרַע מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר לָמָּה קָרַעְתָּ בְּגָדֶיךָ יָבֹא־נָא אֵלַי וְיֵדַע כִּי
יֵשׁ נָבִיא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
When Elisha, the man of God, heard that the king of Israel had
rent his clothes, he sent a message to the king: “Why have you
rent your clothes? Let him come to me, and he will learn that
there is a prophet in Israel.”

translation.text: And it was so, when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.

verses.english:
When Elisha, the man of God, heard that the king of Israel had
rent his clothes, he sent a message to the king: “Why have you
rent your clothes? Let him come to me, and he will learn that
there is a prophet in Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא נַעֲמָן בְּסוּסָו וּבְרִכְבּוֹ וַיַּעֲמֹד פֶּתַח־הַבַּיִת לֶאֱלִישָׁע׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא נַעֲמָן בְּסוּסָו וּבְרִכְבּוֹ וַיַּעֲמֹד פֶּתַח־הַבַּיִת לֶאֱלִישָׁע׃

english.text:
So Naaman came with his horses and chariots and halted at the door
of Elisha’s house.

translation.text: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

verses.english:
So Naaman came with his horses and chariots and halted at the door
of Elisha’s house.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלָיו אֱלִישָׁע מַלְאָךְ לֵאמֹר הָלוֹךְ וְרָחַצְתָּ שֶׁבַע־פְּעָמִים בַּיַּרְדֵּן וְיָשֹׁב בְּשָׂרְךָ לְךָ וּטְהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלָיו אֱלִישָׁע מַלְאָךְ לֵאמֹר הָלוֹךְ וְרָחַצְתָּ שֶׁבַע־פְּעָמִים בַּיַּרְדֵּן וְיָשֹׁב בְּשָׂרְךָ לְךָ וּטְהָר׃

english.text:
Elisha sent a messenger to say to him, “Go and bathe seven times
in the Jordan, and your flesh shall be restored and you shall be
clean.”

translation.text: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.

verses.english:
Elisha sent a messenger to say to him, “Go and bathe seven times
in the Jordan, and your flesh shall be restored and you shall be
clean.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְצֹף נַעֲמָן וַיֵּלַךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה אָמַרְתִּי אֵלַי יֵצֵא יָצוֹא וְעָמַד וְקָרָא בְּשֵׁם־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו וְהֵנִיף יָדוֹ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם וְאָסַף הַמְּצֹרָע׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְצֹף נַעֲמָן וַיֵּלַךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה אָמַרְתִּי אֵלַי יֵצֵא יָצוֹא וְעָמַד וְקָרָא בְּשֵׁם־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו וְהֵנִיף יָדוֹ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם וְאָסַף הַמְּצֹרָע׃

english.text:
But Naaman was angered and walked away. “I thought,” he said, “he
would surely come out to me, and would stand and invoke YHWH his
God by name, and would wave his hand toward the spot, and cure the
affected part.

translation.text: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.

verses.english:
But Naaman was angered and walked away. “I thought,” he said, “he
would surely come out to me, and would stand and invoke YHWH his
God by name, and would wave his hand toward the spot, and cure the
affected part.

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא טוֹב (אבנה) [אֲמָנָה] וּפַרְפַּר נַהֲרוֹת דַּמֶּשֶׂק מִכֹּל מֵימֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלֹא־אֶרְחַץ בָּהֶם וְטָהָרְתִּי וַיִּפֶן וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּחֵמָה׃

hebrew.text: הֲלֹא טוֹב (אבנה) [אֲמָנָה] וּפַרְפַּר נַהֲרוֹת דַּמֶּשֶׂק מִכֹּל מֵימֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלֹא־אֶרְחַץ בָּהֶם וְטָהָרְתִּי וַיִּפֶן וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּחֵמָה׃

english.text:
Are not the Amanah and the Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better
than all the waters of Israel? I could bathe in them and be
clean!” And he stalked off in a rage.

translation.text: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.

verses.english:
Are not the Amanah and the Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better
than all the waters of Israel? I could bathe in them and be
clean!” And he stalked off in a rage.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ עֲבָדָיו וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ אָבִי דָּבָר גָּדוֹל הַנָּבִיא דִּבֶּר אֵלֶיךָ הֲלוֹא תַעֲשֶׂה וְאַף כִּי־אָמַר אֵלֶיךָ רְחַץ וּטְהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ עֲבָדָיו וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ אָבִי דָּבָר גָּדוֹל הַנָּבִיא דִּבֶּר אֵלֶיךָ הֲלוֹא תַעֲשֶׂה וְאַף כִּי־אָמַר אֵלֶיךָ רְחַץ וּטְהָר׃

english.text:
But his servants came forward and spoke to him. “Sir,” they said,
“if the prophet told you to do something difficult, would you not
do it? How much more when he has only said to you, ‘Bathe and be
clean.’”

translation.text: And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father, if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing, wouldest thou not have done it? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?

verses.english:
But his servants came forward and spoke to him. “Sir,” they said,
“if the prophet told you to do something difficult, would you not
do it? How much more when he has only said to you, ‘Bathe and be
clean.’”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד וַיִּטְבֹּל בַּיַּרְדֵּן שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים כִּדְבַר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיָּשׁב בְּשָׂרוֹ כִּבְשַׂר נַעַר קָטֹן וַיִּטְהָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרֶד וַיִּטְבֹּל בַּיַּרְדֵּן שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים כִּדְבַר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיָּשׁב בְּשָׂרוֹ כִּבְשַׂר נַעַר קָטֹן וַיִּטְהָר׃

english.text:
So he went down and immersed himself in the Jordan seven times, as
the man of God had bidden; and his flesh became like a little
boy’s, and he was clean.

translation.text: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

verses.english:
So he went down and immersed himself in the Jordan seven times, as
the man of God had bidden; and his flesh became like a little
boy’s, and he was clean.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשׁב אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים הוּא וְכל־מַחֲנֵהוּ וַיָּבֹא וַיַּעֲמֹד לְפָנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־נָא יָדַעְתִּי כִּי אֵין אֱלֹהִים בְּכל־הָאָרֶץ כִּי אִם־בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַתָּה
קַח־נָא בְרָכָה מֵאֵת עַבְדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשׁב אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים הוּא וְכל־מַחֲנֵהוּ וַיָּבֹא וַיַּעֲמֹד לְפָנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־נָא יָדַעְתִּי כִּי אֵין אֱלֹהִים בְּכל־הָאָרֶץ כִּי אִם־בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַתָּה
קַח־נָא בְרָכָה מֵאֵת עַבְדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
Returning with his entire retinue to the man of God, he stood
before him and exclaimed, “Now I know that there is no God in the
whole world except in Israel! So please accept a gift from your
servant.”

translation.text: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray thee, take a blessing of thy servant.

verses.english:
Returning with his entire retinue to the man of God, he stood
before him and exclaimed, “Now I know that there is no God in the
whole world except in Israel! So please accept a gift from your
servant.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חַי־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־עָמַדְתִּי לְפָנָיו אִם־אֶקָּח וַיִּפְצַר־בּוֹ לָקַחַת וַיְמָאֵן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר חַי־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־עָמַדְתִּי לְפָנָיו אִם־אֶקָּח וַיִּפְצַר־בּוֹ לָקַחַת וַיְמָאֵן׃

english.text:
But he replied, “As YHWH lives, whom I serve, I will not accept
anything.” He pressed him to accept, but he refused.

translation.text: But he said, As the LORD liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take it; but he refused.

verses.english:
But he replied, “As YHWH lives, whom I serve, I will not accept
anything.” He pressed him to accept, but he refused.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נַעֲמָן וָלֹא יֻתַּן־נָא לְעַבְדְּךָ מַשָּׂא צֶמֶד־פְּרָדִים אֲדָמָה כִּי לוֹא־יַעֲשֶׂה עוֹד עַבְדְּךָ עֹלָה וָזֶבַח לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים כִּי אִם־לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר נַעֲמָן וָלֹא יֻתַּן־נָא לְעַבְדְּךָ מַשָּׂא צֶמֶד־פְּרָדִים אֲדָמָה כִּי לוֹא־יַעֲשֶׂה עוֹד עַבְדְּךָ עֹלָה וָזֶבַח לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים כִּי אִם־לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And Naaman said, “Then at least let your servant be given two
mule-loads of earth; for your servant will never again offer up
burnt offering or sacrifice to any god, except YHWH.

translation.text: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given to thy servant two mules’ burden of earth? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto the LORD.

verses.english:
And Naaman said, “Then at least let your servant be given two
mule-loads of earth; for your servant will never again offer up
burnt offering or sacrifice to any god, except YHWH.

verses.hebrew:
לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה יִסְלַח יְהֹוָה לְעַבְדֶּךָ בְּבוֹא אֲדֹנִי בֵית־רִמּוֹן לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת שָׁמָּה וְהוּא נִשְׁעָן עַל־יָדִי וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֵיתִי בֵּית רִמֹּן בְּהִשְׁתַּחֲוָיָתִי
בֵּית רִמֹּן יִסְלַח־(נא)־יְהֹוָה לְעַבְדְּךָ בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה יִסְלַח יְהֹוָה לְעַבְדֶּךָ בְּבוֹא אֲדֹנִי בֵית־רִמּוֹן לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת שָׁמָּה וְהוּא נִשְׁעָן עַל־יָדִי וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֵיתִי בֵּית רִמֹּן בְּהִשְׁתַּחֲוָיָתִי
בֵּית רִמֹּן יִסְלַח־(נא)־יְהֹוָה לְעַבְדְּךָ בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
But may YHWH pardon your servant for this: When my master enters
the temple of Rimmon to bow low in worship there, and he is
leaning on my arm so that I must bow low in the temple of
Rimmon—when I bow low in the temple of Rimmon, may YHWH pardon
your servant in this.”

translation.text: In this thing the LORD pardon thy servant, that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, the LORD pardon thy servant in this thing.

verses.english:
But may YHWH pardon your servant for this: When my master enters
the temple of Rimmon to bow low in worship there, and he is
leaning on my arm so that I must bow low in the temple of
Rimmon—when I bow low in the temple of Rimmon, may YHWH pardon
your servant in this.”

Gehazi, the attendant of Elisha the man of God, thought: “My
master has let that Aramean Naaman off without accepting what he
brought! As YHWH lives, I will run after him and get something
from him.”

translation.text: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but, as the LORD liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.

Gehazi, the attendant of Elisha the man of God, thought: “My
master has let that Aramean Naaman off without accepting what he
brought! As YHWH lives, I will run after him and get something
from him.”

after him, he alighted from his chariot to meet him and said, “Is
all well?”

“All is well,” he replied. “My master has sent me to say: Two
youths, disciples of the prophets, have just come to me from the
hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and
two changes of clothing.”

translation.text: And he said, All is well. My master hath sent me, saying, Behold, even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.

verses.english:
“All is well,” he replied. “My master has sent me to say: Two
youths, disciples of the prophets, have just come to me from the
hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and
two changes of clothing.”

english.text:
Naaman said, “Please take two talents.” He urged him, and he
wrapped the two talents of silver in two bags and gave them, along
with two changes of clothes, to two of his servants, who carried
them ahead of him.

translation.text: And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid them upon two of his servants; and they bare them before him.

verses.english:
Naaman said, “Please take two talents.” He urged him, and he
wrapped the two talents of silver in two bags and gave them, along
with two changes of clothes, to two of his servants, who carried
them ahead of him.

verses.english:
When [Gehazi] arrived at the citadel, he took [the things] from
them and deposited them in the house. Then he dismissed the men
and they went their way.

gone anywhere.”

translation.text: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence comest thou, Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither.

verses.english:
He entered and stood before his master; and Elisha said to him,
“Where have you been, Gehazi?” He replied, “Your servant has not
gone anywhere.”

money in order to buy clothing and olive groves and vineyards,
sheep and oxen, and male and female slaves?

translation.text: And he said unto him, Went not mine heart with thee, when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and maidservants?

Then [Elisha] said to him, “Did not my spirit go along when a man

money in order to buy clothing and olive groves and vineyards,
sheep and oxen, and male and female slaves?

Surely, the leprosy of Naaman shall cling to you and to your
descendants forever.” And as [Gehazi] left his presence, he was

translation.text: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee, and unto thy seed for ever. And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow.

verses.english:
Surely, the leprosy of Naaman shall cling to you and to your
descendants forever.” And as [Gehazi] left his presence, he was
snow-white with leprosy.

translation.text: Let us go, we pray thee, unto Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And he answered, Go ye.

verses.english:
Let us go to the Jordan, and let us each get a log there and build
quarters there for ourselves to live in.” “Do so,” he replied.

Then one of them said, “Will you please come along with your
servants?” “Yes, I will come,” he said;

translation.text: And one said, Be content, I pray thee, and go with thy servants. And he answered, I will go.

verses.english:
Then one of them said, “Will you please come along with your
servants?” “Yes, I will come,” he said;

and he accompanied them. So they went to the Jordan and cut

As one of them was felling a trunk, the iron ax head fell into the
water. And he cried aloud, “Alas, master, it was a borrowed one!”

translation.text: Therefore said he, Take it up to thee. And he put out his hand, and took it.

verses.english: “Pick it up,” he said; so he reached out and took it.

verses.hebrew: וּמֶלֶךְ אֲרָם הָיָה נִלְחָם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּוָּעַץ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו לֵאמֹר אֶל־מְקוֹם פְּלֹנִי אַלְמֹנִי תַּחֲנֹתִי׃

hebrew.text: וּמֶלֶךְ אֲרָם הָיָה נִלְחָם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּוָּעַץ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו לֵאמֹר אֶל־מְקוֹם פְּלֹנִי אַלְמֹנִי תַּחֲנֹתִי׃

english.text:
While the king of Aram was waging war against Israel, he took
counsel with his officers and said, “I will encamp in such and
such a place.”

translation.text: Then the king of Syria warred against Israel, and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place shall be my camp.

verses.english:
While the king of Aram was waging war against Israel, he took
counsel with his officers and said, “I will encamp in such and
such a place.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הִשָּׁמֶר מֵעֲבֹר הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי־שָׁם אֲרָם נְחִתִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הִשָּׁמֶר מֵעֲבֹר הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי־שָׁם אֲרָם נְחִתִּים׃

english.text:
But the man of God sent word to the king of Israel, “Take care not
to pass through that place, for the Arameans are encamped there.”

translation.text: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.

verses.english:
But the man of God sent word to the king of Israel, “Take care not
to pass through that place, for the Arameans are encamped there.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר־לוֹ אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים וְהִזְהִירֹה וְנִשְׁמַר שָׁם לֹא אַחַת וְלֹא שְׁתָּיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר־לוֹ אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים וְהִזְהִירֹה וְנִשְׁמַר שָׁם לֹא אַחַת וְלֹא שְׁתָּיִם׃

english.text:
So the king of Israel sent word to the place of which the man of
God had told him. Time and again he alerted such a place and took
precautions there.

translation.text: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.

verses.english:
So the king of Israel sent word to the place of which the man of
God had told him. Time and again he alerted such a place and took
precautions there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסָּעֵר לֵב מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם עַל־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־עֲבָדָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם הֲלוֹא תַּגִּידוּ לִי מִי מִשֶּׁלָּנוּ אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסָּעֵר לֵב מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם עַל־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־עֲבָדָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם הֲלוֹא תַּגִּידוּ לִי מִי מִשֶּׁלָּנוּ אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Greatly agitated about this matter, the king of Aram summoned his
officers and said to them, “Tell me! Who of us is on the side of
the king of Israel?”

translation.text: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said unto them, Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel?

verses.english:
Greatly agitated about this matter, the king of Aram summoned his
officers and said to them, “Tell me! Who of us is on the side of
the king of Israel?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַחַד מֵעֲבָדָיו לוֹא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־אֱלִישָׁע הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יַגִּיד לְמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר תְּדַבֵּר בַּחֲדַר מִשְׁכָּבֶךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַחַד מֵעֲבָדָיו לוֹא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־אֱלִישָׁע הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יַגִּיד לְמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר תְּדַבֵּר בַּחֲדַר מִשְׁכָּבֶךָ׃

english.text:
“No one, my lord king,” said one of the officers. “Elisha, that
prophet in Israel, tells the king of Israel the very words you
speak in your bedroom.”

translation.text: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber.

verses.english:
“No one, my lord king,” said one of the officers. “Elisha, that
prophet in Israel, tells the king of Israel the very words you
speak in your bedroom.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְכוּ וּרְאוּ אֵיכֹה הוּא וְאֶשְׁלַח וְאֶקָּחֵהוּ וַיֻּגַּד־לוֹ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה בְדֹתָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְכוּ וּרְאוּ אֵיכֹה הוּא וְאֶשְׁלַח וְאֶקָּחֵהוּ וַיֻּגַּד־לוֹ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה בְדֹתָן׃

english.text:
“Go find out where he is,” he said, “so that I can have him
seized.” It was reported to him that [Elisha] was in Dothan;

translation.text: And he said, Go and spy where he is, that I may send and fetch him.

verses.english:
“Go find out where he is,” he said, “so that I can have him
seized.” It was reported to him that [Elisha] was in Dothan;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח־שָׁמָּה סוּסִים וְרֶכֶב וְחַיִל כָּבֵד וַיָּבֹאוּ לַיְלָה וַיַּקִּפוּ עַל־הָעִיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח־שָׁמָּה סוּסִים וְרֶכֶב וְחַיִל כָּבֵד וַיָּבֹאוּ לַיְלָה וַיַּקִּפוּ עַל־הָעִיר׃

english.text:
so he sent horses and chariots there and a strong force. They
arrived at night and encircled the town.

translation.text: Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and compassed the city about.

verses.english:
so he sent horses and chariots there and a strong force. They
arrived at night and encircled the town.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם מְשָׁרֵת אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים לָקוּם וַיֵּצֵא וְהִנֵּה־חַיִל סוֹבֵב אֶת־הָעִיר וְסוּס וָרָכֶב וַיֹּאמֶר נַעֲרוֹ אֵלָיו אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנִי אֵיכָה נַעֲשֶׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם מְשָׁרֵת אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים לָקוּם וַיֵּצֵא וְהִנֵּה־חַיִל סוֹבֵב אֶת־הָעִיר וְסוּס וָרָכֶב וַיֹּאמֶר נַעֲרוֹ אֵלָיו אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנִי אֵיכָה נַעֲשֶׂה׃

english.text:
When the attendant of the man of God rose early and went outside,
he saw a force, with horses and chariots, surrounding the town.
“Alas, master, what shall we do?” his servant asked him.

translation.text: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?

verses.english:
When the attendant of the man of God rose early and went outside,
he saw a force, with horses and chariots, surrounding the town.
“Alas, master, what shall we do?” his servant asked him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־תִּירָא כִּי רַבִּים אֲשֶׁר אִתָּנוּ מֵאֲשֶׁר אוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־תִּירָא כִּי רַבִּים אֲשֶׁר אִתָּנוּ מֵאֲשֶׁר אוֹתָם׃

english.text:
“Have no fear,” he replied. “There are more on our side than on
theirs.”

translation.text: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.

verses.english:
“Have no fear,” he replied. “There are more on our side than on
theirs.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֱלִישָׁע וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה פְּקַח־נָא אֶת־עֵינָיו וְיִרְאֶה וַיִּפְקַח יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֵינֵי הַנַּעַר וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה הָהָר מָלֵא סוּסִים וְרֶכֶב אֵשׁ סְבִיבֹת
אֱלִישָׁע׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֱלִישָׁע וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה פְּקַח־נָא אֶת־עֵינָיו וְיִרְאֶה וַיִּפְקַח יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֵינֵי הַנַּעַר וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה הָהָר מָלֵא סוּסִים וְרֶכֶב אֵשׁ סְבִיבֹת
אֱלִישָׁע׃

english.text:
Then Elisha prayed: “LORD, open his eyes and let him see.” And
YHWH opened the servant’s eyes and he saw the hills all around
Elisha covered with horses and chariots of fire.

translation.text: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.

verses.english:
Then Elisha prayed: “LORD, open his eyes and let him see.” And
YHWH opened the servant’s eyes and he saw the hills all around
Elisha covered with horses and chariots of fire.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרְדוּ אֵלָיו וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֱלִישָׁע אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר הַךְ־נָא אֶת־הַגּוֹי־הַזֶּה בַּסַּנְוֵרִים וַיַּכֵּם בַּסַּנְוֵרִים כִּדְבַר אֱלִישָׁע׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּרְדוּ אֵלָיו וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֱלִישָׁע אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר הַךְ־נָא אֶת־הַגּוֹי־הַזֶּה בַּסַּנְוֵרִים וַיַּכֵּם בַּסַּנְוֵרִים כִּדְבַר אֱלִישָׁע׃

english.text:
