of his sons yesterday—declares YHWH. And I will requite you in
this plot—declares YHWH.’ So pick him up and throw him unto the
plot in accordance with the word of YHWH.”

translation.text: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith the LORD; and I will requite thee in this plat, saith the LORD. Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground, according to the word of the LORD.

verses.english:
‘I swear, I have taken note of the blood of Naboth and the blood
of his sons yesterday—declares YHWH. And I will requite you in
this plot—declares YHWH.’ So pick him up and throw him unto the
plot in accordance with the word of YHWH.”

verses.hebrew:
וַאֲחַזְיָה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה רָאָה וַיָּנס דֶּרֶךְ בֵּית הַגָּן וַיִּרְדֹּף אַחֲרָיו יֵהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־אֹתוֹ הַכֻּהוּ אֶל־הַמֶּרְכָּבָה בְּמַעֲלֵה־גוּר אֲשֶׁר אֶת־יִבְלְעָם
וַיָּנס מְגִדּוֹ וַיָּמת שָׁם׃

hebrew.text:
וַאֲחַזְיָה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה רָאָה וַיָּנס דֶּרֶךְ בֵּית הַגָּן וַיִּרְדֹּף אַחֲרָיו יֵהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־אֹתוֹ הַכֻּהוּ אֶל־הַמֶּרְכָּבָה בְּמַעֲלֵה־גוּר אֲשֶׁר אֶת־יִבְלְעָם
וַיָּנס מְגִדּוֹ וַיָּמת שָׁם׃

english.text:
On seeing this, King Ahaziah of Judah fled along the road to
Beth-haggan. Jehu pursued him and said, “Shoot him down too!” [And
they shot him] in his chariot at the ascent of Gur, which is near
Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo and died there.

translation.text: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot. And they did so at the going up to Gur, which is by Ibleam.

verses.english:
On seeing this, King Ahaziah of Judah fled along the road to
Beth-haggan. Jehu pursued him and said, “Shoot him down too!” [And
they shot him] in his chariot at the ascent of Gur, which is near
Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo and died there.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֹתוֹ עֲבָדָיו יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ְמָה וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בִקְבֻרָתוֹ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֹתוֹ עֲבָדָיו יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ְמָה וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בִקְבֻרָתוֹ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד׃

english.text:
His servants conveyed him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and they
buried him in his grave with his fathers, in the City of David.

translation.text: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.

verses.english:
His servants conveyed him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and they
buried him in his grave with his fathers, in the City of David.

verses.hebrew: וּבִשְׁנַת אַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לְיוֹרָם בֶּן־אַחְאָב מָלַךְ אֲחַזְיָה עַל־יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וּבִשְׁנַת אַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לְיוֹרָם בֶּן־אַחְאָב מָלַךְ אֲחַזְיָה עַל־יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
(Ahaziah had become king over Judah in the eleventh year of Joram
son of Ahab.)

translation.text: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.

verses.english:
(Ahaziah had become king over Judah in the eleventh year of Joram
son of Ahab.)

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבוֹא יֵהוּא יִזְרְעֶאלָה וְאִיזֶבֶל שָׁמְעָה וַתָּשֶׂם בַּפּוּךְ עֵינֶיהָ וַתֵּיטֶב אֶת־רֹאשָׁהּ וַתַּשְׁקֵף בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבוֹא יֵהוּא יִזְרְעֶאלָה וְאִיזֶבֶל שָׁמְעָה וַתָּשֶׂם בַּפּוּךְ עֵינֶיהָ וַתֵּיטֶב אֶת־רֹאשָׁהּ וַתַּשְׁקֵף בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן׃

english.text:
Jehu went on to Jezreel. When Jezebel heard of it, she painted her
eyes with kohl and dressed her hair, and she looked out of the
window.

translation.text: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.

verses.english:
Jehu went on to Jezreel. When Jezebel heard of it, she painted her
eyes with kohl and dressed her hair, and she looked out of the
window.

verses.hebrew: וְיֵהוּא בָּא בַשָּׁעַר וַתֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם זִמְרִי הֹרֵג אֲדֹנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְיֵהוּא בָּא בַשָּׁעַר וַתֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם זִמְרִי הֹרֵג אֲדֹנָיו׃

english.text:
As Jehu entered the gate, she called out, “Is all well, Zimri,
murderer of your master?”

translation.text: And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?

verses.english:
As Jehu entered the gate, she called out, “Is all well, Zimri,
murderer of your master?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא פָנָיו אֶל־הַחַלּוֹן וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אִתִּי מִי וַיַּשְׁקִיפוּ אֵלָיו שְׁנַיִם שְׁלֹשָׁה סָרִיסִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשָּׂא פָנָיו אֶל־הַחַלּוֹן וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אִתִּי מִי וַיַּשְׁקִיפוּ אֵלָיו שְׁנַיִם שְׁלֹשָׁה סָרִיסִים׃

english.text:
He looked up toward the window and said, “Who is on my side, who?”
And two or three eunuchs leaned out toward him.

translation.text: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.

verses.english:
He looked up toward the window and said, “Who is on my side, who?”
And two or three eunuchs leaned out toward him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר (שמטהו) [שִׁמְטוּהָ] וַיִּשְׁמְטוּהָ וַיִּז מִדָּמָהּ אֶל־הַקִּיר וְאֶל־הַסּוּסִים וַיִּרְמְסֶנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר (שמטהו) [שִׁמְטוּהָ] וַיִּשְׁמְטוּהָ וַיִּז מִדָּמָהּ אֶל־הַקִּיר וְאֶל־הַסּוּסִים וַיִּרְמְסֶנָּה׃

english.text:
“Throw her down,” he said. They threw her down; and her blood
spattered on the wall and on the horses, and they trampled her.

translation.text: And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.

verses.english:
“Throw her down,” he said. They threw her down; and her blood
spattered on the wall and on the horses, and they trampled her.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא וַיֹּאכַל וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיֹּאמֶר פִּקְדוּ־נָא אֶת־הָאֲרוּרָה הַזֹּאת וְקִבְרוּהָ כִּי בַת־מֶלֶךְ הִיא׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא וַיֹּאכַל וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיֹּאמֶר פִּקְדוּ־נָא אֶת־הָאֲרוּרָה הַזֹּאת וְקִבְרוּהָ כִּי בַת־מֶלֶךְ הִיא׃

english.text:
Then he went inside and ate and drank. And he said, “Attend to
that cursed woman and bury her, for she was a king’s daughter.”

translation.text: And when he was come in, he did eat and drink, and said, Go, see now this cursed woman, and bury her: for she is a king’s daughter.

verses.english:
Then he went inside and ate and drank. And he said, “Attend to
that cursed woman and bury her, for she was a king’s daughter.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ לְקבְרָהּ וְלֹא־מָצְאוּ בָהּ כִּי אִם־הַגֻּלְגֹּלֶת וְהָרַגְלַיִם וְכַפּוֹת הַיָּדָיִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ לְקבְרָהּ וְלֹא־מָצְאוּ בָהּ כִּי אִם־הַגֻּלְגֹּלֶת וְהָרַגְלַיִם וְכַפּוֹת הַיָּדָיִם׃

english.text:
So they went to bury her; but all they found of her were the
skull, the feet, and the hands.

translation.text: And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.

verses.english:
So they went to bury her; but all they found of her were the
skull, the feet, and the hands.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיַּגִּידוּ לוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה הוּא אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד־עַבְדּוֹ אֵלִיָּהוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּי לֵאמֹר בְּחֵלֶק יִזְרְעֶאל יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים אֶת־בְּשַׂר
אִיזָבֶל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיַּגִּידוּ לוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה הוּא אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד־עַבְדּוֹ אֵלִיָּהוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּי לֵאמֹר בְּחֵלֶק יִזְרְעֶאל יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים אֶת־בְּשַׂר
אִיזָבֶל׃

translation.text: Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This is the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:

verses.hebrew: (והית) [וְהָיְתָה] נִבְלַת אִיזֶבֶל כְּדֹמֶן עַל־פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה בְּחֵלֶק יִזְרְעֶאל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יֹאמְרוּ זֹאת אִיזָבֶל׃

hebrew.text: (והית) [וְהָיְתָה] נִבְלַת אִיזֶבֶל כְּדֹמֶן עַל־פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה בְּחֵלֶק יִזְרְעֶאל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יֹאמְרוּ זֹאת אִיזָבֶל׃

english.text:
and the carcass of Jezebel shall be like dung on the ground, in
the field of Jezreel, so that none will be able to say: ‘This was
Jezebel.’”

translation.text: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel; so that they shall not say, This is Jezebel.

verses.english:
and the carcass of Jezebel shall be like dung on the ground, in
the field of Jezreel, so that none will be able to say: ‘This was
Jezebel.’”

verses.hebrew: וּלְאַחְאָב שִׁבְעִים בָּנִים בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּכְתֹּב יֵהוּא סְפָרִים וַיִּשְׁלַח שֹׁמְרוֹן אֶל־שָׂרֵי יִזְרְעֶאל הַזְּקֵנִים וְאֶל־הָאֹמְנִים אַחְאָב לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וּלְאַחְאָב שִׁבְעִים בָּנִים בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּכְתֹּב יֵהוּא סְפָרִים וַיִּשְׁלַח שֹׁמְרוֹן אֶל־שָׂרֵי יִזְרְעֶאל הַזְּקֵנִים וְאֶל־הָאֹמְנִים אַחְאָב לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
Ahab had seventy descendants in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters and
sent them to Samaria, to the elders and officials of Jezreel and
to the guardians of [the children] of Ahab, as follows:

translation.text: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab’s children, saying,

verses.english:
Ahab had seventy descendants in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters and
sent them to Samaria, to the elders and officials of Jezreel and
to the guardians of [the children] of Ahab, as follows:

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה כְּבֹא הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה אֲלֵיכֶם וְאִתְּכֶם בְּנֵי אֲדֹנֵיכֶם וְאִתְּכֶם הָרֶכֶב וְהַסּוּסִים וְעִיר מִבְצָר וְהַנָּשֶׁק׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה כְּבֹא הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה אֲלֵיכֶם וְאִתְּכֶם בְּנֵי אֲדֹנֵיכֶם וְאִתְּכֶם הָרֶכֶב וְהַסּוּסִים וְעִיר מִבְצָר וְהַנָּשֶׁק׃

english.text:
“Now, when this letter reaches you—since your master’s sons are
with you and you also have chariots and horses, and a fortified
city and weapons—

translation.text: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you, seeing your master’s sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city also, and armour;

verses.english:
“Now, when this letter reaches you—since your master’s sons are
with you and you also have chariots and horses, and a fortified
city and weapons—

verses.hebrew: וּרְאִיתֶם הַטּוֹב וְהַיָּשָׁר מִבְּנֵי אֲדֹנֵיכֶם וְשַׂמְתֶּם עַל־כִּסֵּא אָבִיו וְהִלָּחֲמוּ עַל־בֵּית אֲדֹנֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וּרְאִיתֶם הַטּוֹב וְהַיָּשָׁר מִבְּנֵי אֲדֹנֵיכֶם וְשַׂמְתֶּם עַל־כִּסֵּא אָבִיו וְהִלָּחֲמוּ עַל־בֵּית אֲדֹנֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
select the best and the most suitable of your master’s sons and
set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s
house.”

translation.text: Look even out the best and meetest of your master’s sons, and set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.

verses.english:
select the best and the most suitable of your master’s sons and
set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s
house.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ מְאֹד מְאֹד וַיֹּאמְרוּ הִנֵּה שְׁנֵי הַמְּלָכִים לֹא עָמְדוּ לְפָנָיו וְאֵיךְ נַעֲמֹד אֲנָחְנוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּרְאוּ מְאֹד מְאֹד וַיֹּאמְרוּ הִנֵּה שְׁנֵי הַמְּלָכִים לֹא עָמְדוּ לְפָנָיו וְאֵיךְ נַעֲמֹד אֲנָחְנוּ׃

english.text:
But they were overcome by fear, for they thought, “If the two
kings could not stand up to him, how can we?”

translation.text: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?

verses.english:
But they were overcome by fear, for they thought, “If the two
kings could not stand up to him, how can we?”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַבַּיִת וַאֲשֶׁר עַל־הָעִיר וְהַזְּקֵנִים וְהָאֹמְנִים אֶל־יֵהוּא לֵאמֹר עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲנַחְנוּ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאמַר אֵלֵינוּ נַעֲשֶׂה לֹא־נַמְלִךְ אִישׁ
הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ עֲשֵׂה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַבַּיִת וַאֲשֶׁר עַל־הָעִיר וְהַזְּקֵנִים וְהָאֹמְנִים אֶל־יֵהוּא לֵאמֹר עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲנַחְנוּ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאמַר אֵלֵינוּ נַעֲשֶׂה לֹא־נַמְלִךְ אִישׁ
הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ עֲשֵׂה׃

english.text:
The steward of the palace and the governor of the city and the
elders and the guardians sent this message to Jehu: “We are your
subjects, and we shall do whatever you tell us to. We shall not
proclaim anyone king; do whatever you like.”

translation.text: And he that was over the house, and he that was over the city, the elders also, and the bringers up of the children, sent to Jehu, saying, We are thy servants, and will do all that thou shalt bid us; we will not make any king: do thou that which is good in thine eyes.

verses.english:
The steward of the palace and the governor of the city and the
elders and the guardians sent this message to Jehu: “We are your
subjects, and we shall do whatever you tell us to. We shall not
proclaim anyone king; do whatever you like.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּכְתֹּב אֲלֵיהֶם סֵפֶר שֵׁנִית לֵאמֹר אִם־לִי אַתֶּם וּלְקֹלִי אַתֶּם שֹׁמְעִים קְחוּ אֶת־רָאשֵׁי אַנְשֵׁי בְנֵי־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם וּבֹאוּ אֵלַי כָּעֵת מָחָר יִזְרְעֶאלָה וּבְנֵי
הַמֶּלֶךְ שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ אֶת־גְּדֹלֵי הָעִיר מְגַדְּלִים אוֹתָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּכְתֹּב אֲלֵיהֶם סֵפֶר שֵׁנִית לֵאמֹר אִם־לִי אַתֶּם וּלְקֹלִי אַתֶּם שֹׁמְעִים קְחוּ אֶת־רָאשֵׁי אַנְשֵׁי בְנֵי־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם וּבֹאוּ אֵלַי כָּעֵת מָחָר יִזְרְעֶאלָה וּבְנֵי
הַמֶּלֶךְ שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ אֶת־גְּדֹלֵי הָעִיר מְגַדְּלִים אוֹתָם׃

english.text:
He wrote them a second time: “If you are on my side and are ready
to obey me, take the heads of the attendants of your master’s sons
and come to me in Jezreel tomorrow at this time.” Now the princes,
seventy in number, were with the notables of the town, who were
rearing them.

translation.text: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If ye be mine, and if ye will hearken unto my voice, take ye the heads of the men your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, which brought them up.

verses.english:
He wrote them a second time: “If you are on my side and are ready
to obey me, take the heads of the attendants of your master’s sons
and come to me in Jezreel tomorrow at this time.” Now the princes,
seventy in number, were with the notables of the town, who were
rearing them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּבֹא הַסֵּפֶר אֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת־רָאשֵׁיהֶם בַּדּוּדִים וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אֵלָיו יִזְרְעֶאלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כְּבֹא הַסֵּפֶר אֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת־רָאשֵׁיהֶם בַּדּוּדִים וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אֵלָיו יִזְרְעֶאלָה׃

english.text:
But when the letter reached them, they took the princes and
slaughtered all seventy of them; they put their heads in baskets
and sent them to him in Jezreel.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king’s sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent him them to Jezreel.

verses.english:
But when the letter reached them, they took the princes and
slaughtered all seventy of them; they put their heads in baskets
and sent them to him in Jezreel.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַמַּלְאָךְ וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ לֵאמֹר הֵבִיאוּ רָאשֵׁי בְנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר שִׂימוּ אֹתָם שְׁנֵי צִבֻּרִים פֶּתַח הַשַּׁעַר עַד־הַבֹּקֶר׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא הַמַּלְאָךְ וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ לֵאמֹר הֵבִיאוּ רָאשֵׁי בְנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר שִׂימוּ אֹתָם שְׁנֵי צִבֻּרִים פֶּתַח הַשַּׁעַר עַד־הַבֹּקֶר׃

english.text:
A messenger came and reported to him: “They have brought the heads
of the princes.” He said, “Pile them up in two heaps at the
entrance of the gate before morning.”

translation.text: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king’s sons. And he said, Lay ye them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.

verses.english:
A messenger came and reported to him: “They have brought the heads
of the princes.” He said, “Pile them up in two heaps at the
entrance of the gate before morning.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַיֵּצֵא וַיַּעֲמֹד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־כּל־הָעָם צַדִּקִים אַתֶּם הִנֵּה אֲנִי קָשַׁרְתִּי עַל־אֲדֹנִי וָאֶהְרְגֵהוּ וּמִי הִכָּה אֶת־כּל־אֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַיֵּצֵא וַיַּעֲמֹד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־כּל־הָעָם צַדִּקִים אַתֶּם הִנֵּה אֲנִי קָשַׁרְתִּי עַל־אֲדֹנִי וָאֶהְרְגֵהוּ וּמִי הִכָּה אֶת־כּל־אֵלֶּה׃

english.text:
In the morning he went out and stood there; and he said to all the
people, “Are you blameless? True, I conspired against my master
and killed him; but who struck down all of these?

translation.text: And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, Ye be righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?

verses.english:
In the morning he went out and stood there; and he said to all the
people, “Are you blameless? True, I conspired against my master
and killed him; but who struck down all of these?

verses.hebrew: דְּעוּ אֵפוֹא כִּי לֹא יִפֹּל מִדְּבַר יְהֹוָה אַרְצָה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה עַל־בֵּית אַחְאָב וַיהֹוָה עָשָׂה אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד עַבְדּוֹ אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: דְּעוּ אֵפוֹא כִּי לֹא יִפֹּל מִדְּבַר יְהֹוָה אַרְצָה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה עַל־בֵּית אַחְאָב וַיהֹוָה עָשָׂה אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד עַבְדּוֹ אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
Know, then, that nothing that YHWH has spoken concerning the House
of Ahab shall remain unfulfilled, for YHWH has done what he
announced through His servant Elijah.”

translation.text: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the LORD, which the LORD spake concerning the house of Ahab: for the LORD hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah.

verses.english:
Know, then, that nothing that YHWH has spoken concerning the House
of Ahab shall remain unfulfilled, for YHWH has done what he
announced through His servant Elijah.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ יֵהוּא אֵת כּל־הַנִּשְׁאָרִים לְבֵית־אַחְאָב בְּיִזְרְעֶאל וְכל־גְּדֹלָיו וּמְיֻדָּעָיו וְכֹהֲנָיו עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לוֹ שָׂרִיד׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּךְ יֵהוּא אֵת כּל־הַנִּשְׁאָרִים לְבֵית־אַחְאָב בְּיִזְרְעֶאל וְכל־גְּדֹלָיו וּמְיֻדָּעָיו וְכֹהֲנָיו עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לוֹ שָׂרִיד׃

english.text:
And Jehu struck down all that were left of the House of Ahab in
Jezreel—and all his notables, intimates, and priests—till he left
him no survivor.

translation.text: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsfolks, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.

verses.english:
And Jehu struck down all that were left of the House of Ahab in
Jezreel—and all his notables, intimates, and priests—till he left
him no survivor.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקם וַיָּבֹא וַיֵּלֶךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן הוּא בֵּית־עֵקֶד הָרֹעִים בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקם וַיָּבֹא וַיֵּלֶךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן הוּא בֵּית־עֵקֶד הָרֹעִים בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

english.text:
He then set out for Samaria. On the way, when he was at Beth-eked
of the shepherds,

translation.text: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. And as he was at the shearing house in the way,

verses.english:
He then set out for Samaria. On the way, when he was at Beth-eked
of the shepherds,

verses.hebrew: וְיֵהוּא מָצָא אֶת־אֲחֵי אֲחַזְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אַתֶּם וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲחֵי אֲחַזְיָהוּ אֲנַחְנוּ וַנֵּרֶד לִשְׁלוֹם בְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבְנֵי הַגְּבִירָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֵהוּא מָצָא אֶת־אֲחֵי אֲחַזְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אַתֶּם וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲחֵי אֲחַזְיָהוּ אֲנַחְנוּ וַנֵּרֶד לִשְׁלוֹם בְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבְנֵי הַגְּבִירָה׃

english.text:
Jehu came upon the kinsmen of King Ahaziah of Judah. “Who are
you?” he asked. They replied, “We are the kinsmen of Ahaziah, and
we have come to pay our respects to the sons of the king and the
sons of the queen mother.”

translation.text: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who are ye? And they answered, We are the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen.

verses.english:
Jehu came upon the kinsmen of King Ahaziah of Judah. “Who are
you?” he asked. They replied, “We are the kinsmen of Ahaziah, and
we have come to pay our respects to the sons of the king and the
sons of the queen mother.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר תִּפְשׂוּם חַיִּים וַיִּתְפְּשׂוּם חַיִּים וַיִּשְׁחָטוּם אֶל־בּוֹר בֵּית־עֵקֶד אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנַיִם אִישׁ וְלֹא־הִשְׁאִיר אִישׁ מֵהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר תִּפְשׂוּם חַיִּים וַיִּתְפְּשׂוּם חַיִּים וַיִּשְׁחָטוּם אֶל־בּוֹר בֵּית־עֵקֶד אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנַיִם אִישׁ וְלֹא־הִשְׁאִיר אִישׁ מֵהֶם׃

english.text:
“Take them alive!” he said. They took them alive and then
slaughtered them at the pit of Beth-eked, forty-two of them; he
did not spare a single one.

translation.text: And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.

verses.english:
“Take them alive!” he said. They took them alive and then
slaughtered them at the pit of Beth-eked, forty-two of them; he
did not spare a single one.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־יְהוֹנָדָב בֶּן־רֵכָב לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֲיֵשׁ אֶת־לְבָבְךָ יָשָׁר כַּאֲשֶׁר לְבָבִי עִם־לְבָבֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָדָב יֵשׁ
וָיֵשׁ תְּנָה אֶת־יָדֶךָ וַיִּתֵּן יָדוֹ וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ אֵלָיו אֶל־הַמֶּרְכָּבָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־יְהוֹנָדָב בֶּן־רֵכָב לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֲיֵשׁ אֶת־לְבָבְךָ יָשָׁר כַּאֲשֶׁר לְבָבִי עִם־לְבָבֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָדָב יֵשׁ
וָיֵשׁ תְּנָה אֶת־יָדֶךָ וַיִּתֵּן יָדוֹ וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ אֵלָיו אֶל־הַמֶּרְכָּבָה׃

english.text:
He went on from there, and he met Jehonadab son of Rechab coming
toward him. He greeted him and said to him, “Are you as
wholehearted with me as I am with you?” “I am,” Jehonadab replied.
“If so,” [said Jehu,] “give me your hand.” He gave him his hand
and [Jehu] helped him into the chariot.

translation.text: And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is thine heart right, as my heart is with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give me thine hand. And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

verses.english:
He went on from there, and he met Jehonadab son of Rechab coming
toward him. He greeted him and said to him, “Are you as
wholehearted with me as I am with you?” “I am,” Jehonadab replied.
“If so,” [said Jehu,] “give me your hand.” He gave him his hand
and [Jehu] helped him into the chariot.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְכָה אִתִּי וּרְאֵה בְּקִנְאָתִי לַיהֹוָה וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֹתוֹ בְּרִכְבּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְכָה אִתִּי וּרְאֵה בְּקִנְאָתִי לַיהֹוָה וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֹתוֹ בְּרִכְבּוֹ׃

english.text:
“Come with me,” he said, “and see my zeal for YHWH.” And he was
taken along in the chariot.

translation.text: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD. So they made him ride in his chariot.

verses.english:
“Come with me,” he said, “and see my zeal for YHWH.” And he was
taken along in the chariot.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיַּךְ אֶת־כּל־הַנִּשְׁאָרִים לְאַחְאָב בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עַד־הִשְׁמִדוֹ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיַּךְ אֶת־כּל־הַנִּשְׁאָרִים לְאַחְאָב בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עַד־הִשְׁמִדוֹ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
Arriving in Samaria, [Jehu] struck down all the survivors of [the
House of] Ahab in Samaria, until he wiped it out, fulfilling the
word that YHWH had spoken to Elijah.

translation.text: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spake to Elijah.

verses.english:
Arriving in Samaria, [Jehu] struck down all the survivors of [the
House of] Ahab in Samaria, until he wiped it out, fulfilling the
word that YHWH had spoken to Elijah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבֹּץ יֵהוּא אֶת־כּל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַחְאָב עָבַד אֶת־הַבַּעַל מְעָט יֵהוּא יַעַבְדֶנּוּ הַרְבֵּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבֹּץ יֵהוּא אֶת־כּל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַחְאָב עָבַד אֶת־הַבַּעַל מְעָט יֵהוּא יַעַבְדֶנּוּ הַרְבֵּה׃

english.text:
Jehu assembled all the people and said to them, “Ahab served Baal
little; Jehu shall serve him much!

translation.text: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said unto them, Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu shall serve him much.

verses.english:
Jehu assembled all the people and said to them, “Ahab served Baal
little; Jehu shall serve him much!

verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה כל־נְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל כּל־עֹבְדָיו וְכל־כֹּהֲנָיו קִרְאוּ אֵלַי אִישׁ אַל־יִפָּקֵד כִּי זֶבַח גָּדוֹל לִי לַבַּעַל כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יִפָּקֵד לֹא יִחְיֶה וְיֵהוּא עָשָׂה
בְעקְבָּה לְמַעַן הַאֲבִיד אֶת־עֹבְדֵי הַבָּעַל׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה כל־נְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל כּל־עֹבְדָיו וְכל־כֹּהֲנָיו קִרְאוּ אֵלַי אִישׁ אַל־יִפָּקֵד כִּי זֶבַח גָּדוֹל לִי לַבַּעַל כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יִפָּקֵד לֹא יִחְיֶה וְיֵהוּא עָשָׂה
בְעקְבָּה לְמַעַן הַאֲבִיד אֶת־עֹבְדֵי הַבָּעַל׃

english.text:
Therefore, summon to me all the prophets of Baal, all his
worshipers, and all his priests: let no one fail to come, for I am
going to hold a great sacrifice for Baal. Whoever fails to come
shall forfeit his life.” Jehu was acting with guile in order to
exterminate the worshipers of Baal.

translation.text: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be wanting: for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal; whosoever shall be wanting, he shall not live. But Jehu did it in subtilty, to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal.

verses.english:
Therefore, summon to me all the prophets of Baal, all his
worshipers, and all his priests: let no one fail to come, for I am
going to hold a great sacrifice for Baal. Whoever fails to come
shall forfeit his life.” Jehu was acting with guile in order to
exterminate the worshipers of Baal.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא קַדְּשׁוּ עֲצָרָה לַבַּעַל וַיִּקְרָאוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא קַדְּשׁוּ עֲצָרָה לַבַּעַל וַיִּקְרָאוּ׃

english.text:
Jehu gave orders to convoke a solemn assembly for Baal, and one
was proclaimed.

translation.text: And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed it.

verses.english:
Jehu gave orders to convoke a solemn assembly for Baal, and one
was proclaimed.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יֵהוּא בְּכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל־עֹבְדֵי הַבַּעַל וְלֹא־נִשְׁאַר אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־בָא וַיָּבֹאוּ בֵּית הַבַּעַל וַיִּמָּלֵא בֵית־הַבַּעַל פֶּה לָפֶה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יֵהוּא בְּכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּבֹאוּ כּל־עֹבְדֵי הַבַּעַל וְלֹא־נִשְׁאַר אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־בָא וַיָּבֹאוּ בֵּית הַבַּעַל וַיִּמָּלֵא בֵית־הַבַּעַל פֶּה לָפֶה׃

english.text:
Jehu sent word throughout Israel, and all the worshipers of Baal
came, not a single one remained behind. They came into the temple
of Baal, and the temple of Baal was filled from end to end.

translation.text: And Jehu sent through all Israel: and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not. And they came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another.

verses.english:
Jehu sent word throughout Israel, and all the worshipers of Baal
came, not a single one remained behind. They came into the temple
of Baal, and the temple of Baal was filled from end to end.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמֶּלְתָּחָה הוֹצֵא לְבוּשׁ לְכֹל עֹבְדֵי הַבָּעַל וַיֹּצֵא לָהֶם הַמַּלְבּוּשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמֶּלְתָּחָה הוֹצֵא לְבוּשׁ לְכֹל עֹבְדֵי הַבָּעַל וַיֹּצֵא לָהֶם הַמַּלְבּוּשׁ׃

english.text:
He said to the man in charge of the wardrobe, “Bring out the
vestments for all the worshipers of Baal”; and he brought
vestments out for them.

translation.text: And he said unto him that was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.

verses.english:
He said to the man in charge of the wardrobe, “Bring out the
vestments for all the worshipers of Baal”; and he brought
vestments out for them.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יֵהוּא וִיהוֹנָדָב בֶּן־רֵכָב בֵּית הַבָּעַל וַיֹּאמֶר לְעֹבְדֵי הַבַּעַל חַפְּשׂוּ וּרְאוּ פֶּן־יֶשׁ־פֹּה עִמָּכֶם מֵעַבְדֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי אִם־עֹבְדֵי הַבַּעַל לְבַדָּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא יֵהוּא וִיהוֹנָדָב בֶּן־רֵכָב בֵּית הַבָּעַל וַיֹּאמֶר לְעֹבְדֵי הַבַּעַל חַפְּשׂוּ וּרְאוּ פֶּן־יֶשׁ־פֹּה עִמָּכֶם מֵעַבְדֵי יְהֹוָה כִּי אִם־עֹבְדֵי הַבַּעַל לְבַדָּם׃

english.text:
Then Jehu and Jehonadab son of Rechab came into the temple of
Baal, and they said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search and make
sure that there are no worshipers of YHWH among you, but only
worshipers of Baal.”

translation.text: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of the LORD, but the worshippers of Baal only.

verses.english:
Then Jehu and Jehonadab son of Rechab came into the temple of
Baal, and they said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search and make
sure that there are no worshipers of YHWH among you, but only
worshipers of Baal.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹאוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת זְבָחִים וְעֹלוֹת וְיֵהוּא שָׂם־לוֹ בַחוּץ שְׁמֹנִים אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִמָּלֵט מִן־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא עַל־יְדֵיכֶם נַפְשׁוֹ תַּחַת
נַפְשׁוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹאוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת זְבָחִים וְעֹלוֹת וְיֵהוּא שָׂם־לוֹ בַחוּץ שְׁמֹנִים אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִמָּלֵט מִן־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא עַל־יְדֵיכֶם נַפְשׁוֹ תַּחַת
נַפְשׁוֹ׃

english.text:
So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. But Jehu
had stationed eighty of his men outside and had said, “Whoever
permits the escape of a single one of the men I commit to your
charge shall forfeit life for life.”

translation.text: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said, If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape, he that letteth him go, his life shall be for the life of him.

verses.english:
So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. But Jehu
had stationed eighty of his men outside and had said, “Whoever
permits the escape of a single one of the men I commit to your
charge shall forfeit life for life.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת הָעֹלָה וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא לָרָצִים וְלַשָּׁלִשִׁים בֹּאוּ הַכּוּם אִישׁ אַל־יֵצֵא וַיַּכּוּם לְפִי־חָרֶב וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ הָרָצִים וְהַשָּׁלִשִׁים
וַיֵּלְכוּ עַד־עִיר בֵּית־הַבָּעַל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת הָעֹלָה וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא לָרָצִים וְלַשָּׁלִשִׁים בֹּאוּ הַכּוּם אִישׁ אַל־יֵצֵא וַיַּכּוּם לְפִי־חָרֶב וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ הָרָצִים וְהַשָּׁלִשִׁים
וַיֵּלְכוּ עַד־עִיר בֵּית־הַבָּעַל׃

english.text:
When Jehu had finished presenting the burnt offering, he said to
the guards and to the officers, “Come in and strike them down; let
no man get away!” The guards and the officers struck them down
with the sword and left them lying where they were; then they
proceeded to the interior of the temple of Baal.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in, and slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast them out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.

verses.english:
When Jehu had finished presenting the burnt offering, he said to
the guards and to the officers, “Come in and strike them down; let
no man get away!” The guards and the officers struck them down
with the sword and left them lying where they were; then they
proceeded to the interior of the temple of Baal.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּצִאוּ אֶת־מַצְּבוֹת בֵּית־הַבַּעַל וַיִּשְׂרְפוּהָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּצִאוּ אֶת־מַצְּבוֹת בֵּית־הַבַּעַל וַיִּשְׂרְפוּהָ׃

english.text:
They brought out the pillars of the temple of Baal and burned
them.

translation.text: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.

verses.english:
They brought out the pillars of the temple of Baal and burned
them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּצוּ אֵת מַצְּבַת הַבָּעַל וַיִּתְּצוּ אֶת־בֵּית הַבַּעַל וַיְשִׂמֻהוּ (למחראות) [לְמוֹצָאוֹת] עַד־הַיּוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּצוּ אֵת מַצְּבַת הַבָּעַל וַיִּתְּצוּ אֶת־בֵּית הַבַּעַל וַיְשִׂמֻהוּ (למחראות) [לְמוֹצָאוֹת] עַד־הַיּוֹם׃

english.text:
They destroyed the pillar of Baal, and they tore down the temple
of Baal and turned it into latrines, as is still the case.

translation.text: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.

verses.english:
They destroyed the pillar of Baal, and they tore down the temple
of Baal and turned it into latrines, as is still the case.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁמֵד יֵהוּא אֶת־הַבַּעַל מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּשְׁמֵד יֵהוּא אֶת־הַבַּעַל מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text: Thus Jehu eradicated the Baal from Israel.

translation.text: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

verses.english: Thus Jehu eradicated the Baal from Israel.

verses.hebrew: רַק חֲטָאֵי יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־סָר יֵהוּא מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶם עֶגְלֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר בֵּית־אֵל וַאֲשֶׁר בְּדָן׃

hebrew.text: רַק חֲטָאֵי יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־סָר יֵהוּא מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶם עֶגְלֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר בֵּית־אֵל וַאֲשֶׁר בְּדָן׃

english.text:
However, Jehu did not turn away from the sinful objects by which
Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to sin, namely, the golden
calves at Bethel and at Dan.

translation.text: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit, the golden calves that were in Bethel, and that were in Dan.

verses.english:
However, Jehu did not turn away from the sinful objects by which
Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to sin, namely, the golden
calves at Bethel and at Dan.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יֵהוּא יַעַן אֲשֶׁר־הֱטִיבֹתָ לַעֲשׂוֹת הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינַי כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבִי עָשִׂיתָ לְבֵית אַחְאָב בְּנֵי רְבִעִים יֵשְׁבוּ לְךָ עַל־כִּסֵּא
יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־יֵהוּא יַעַן אֲשֶׁר־הֱטִיבֹתָ לַעֲשׂוֹת הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינַי כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבִי עָשִׂיתָ לְבֵית אַחְאָב בְּנֵי רְבִעִים יֵשְׁבוּ לְךָ עַל־כִּסֵּא
יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
YHWH said to Jehu, “Because you have acted well and done what was
pleasing to Me, having carried out all that I desired upon the
House of Ahab, four generations of your descendants shall occupy
the throne of Israel.”

translation.text: And the LORD said unto Jehu, Because thou hast done well in executing that which is right in mine eyes, and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in mine heart, thy children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.

verses.english:
YHWH said to Jehu, “Because you have acted well and done what was
pleasing to Me, having carried out all that I desired upon the
House of Ahab, four generations of your descendants shall occupy
the throne of Israel.”

verses.hebrew: וְיֵהוּא לֹא שָׁמַר לָלֶכֶת בְּתוֹרַת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל־לְבָבוֹ לֹא סָר מֵעַל חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֵהוּא לֹא שָׁמַר לָלֶכֶת בְּתוֹרַת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל־לְבָבוֹ לֹא סָר מֵעַל חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But Jehu was not careful to follow the Teaching of YHWH, the God
of Israel, with all his heart; he did not turn away from the sins
that Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.

translation.text: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD God of Israel with all his heart: for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, which made Israel to sin.

verses.english:
But Jehu was not careful to follow the Teaching of YHWH, the God
of Israel, with all his heart; he did not turn away from the sins
that Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.

verses.hebrew: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם הֵחֵל יְהֹוָה לְקַצּוֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכֵּם חֲזָאֵל בְּכל־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם הֵחֵל יְהֹוָה לְקַצּוֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכֵּם חֲזָאֵל בְּכל־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
In those days YHWH began to reduce Israel; and Hazael harassed
them throughout the territory of Israel

translation.text: In those days the LORD began to cut Israel short: and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel;

verses.english:
In those days YHWH began to reduce Israel; and Hazael harassed
them throughout the territory of Israel

verses.hebrew: מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אֵת כּל־אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד הַגָּדִי וְהָראוּבֵנִי וְהַמְנַשִּׁי מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר־עַל־נַחַל אַרְנֹן וְהַגִּלְעָד וְהַבָּשָׁן׃

hebrew.text: מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אֵת כּל־אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד הַגָּדִי וְהָראוּבֵנִי וְהַמְנַשִּׁי מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר־עַל־נַחַל אַרְנֹן וְהַגִּלְעָד וְהַבָּשָׁן׃

english.text:
east of the Jordan, all the land of Gilead—the Gadites, the
Reubenites, and the Manassites—from Aroer, by the Wadi Arnon, up
to Gilead and Bashan.

translation.text: From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

verses.english:
east of the Jordan, all the land of Gilead—the Gadites, the
Reubenites, and the Manassites—from Aroer, by the Wadi Arnon, up
to Gilead and Bashan.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יֵהוּא וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְכל־גְּבוּרָתוֹ הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יֵהוּא וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְכל־גְּבוּרָתוֹ הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Jehu’s reign, and all his actions, and all his
exploits, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.english:
The other events of Jehu’s reign, and all his actions, and all his
exploits, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יֵהוּא עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹאָחָז בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יֵהוּא עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹאָחָז בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Jehu slept with his fathers and he was buried in Samaria; he was
succeeded as king by his son Jehoahaz.

translation.text: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Jehu slept with his fathers and he was buried in Samaria; he was
succeeded as king by his son Jehoahaz.

verses.hebrew: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ יֵהוּא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשְׂרִים־וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ יֵהוּא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשְׂרִים־וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text: Jehu reigned over Israel for twenty-eight years in Samaria.

translation.text: And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty and eight years.

verses.english: Jehu reigned over Israel for twenty-eight years in Samaria.

verses.hebrew: וַעֲתַלְיָה אֵם אֲחַזְיָהוּ (וראתה) [רָאֲתָה] כִּי מֵת בְּנָהּ וַתָּקם וַתְּאַבֵּד אֵת כּל־זֶרַע הַמַּמְלָכָה׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲתַלְיָה אֵם אֲחַזְיָהוּ (וראתה) [רָאֲתָה] כִּי מֵת בְּנָהּ וַתָּקם וַתְּאַבֵּד אֵת כּל־זֶרַע הַמַּמְלָכָה׃

english.text:
When Athaliah, the mother of Ahaziah, learned that her son was
dead, she promptly killed off all who were of royal stock.

translation.text: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.

verses.english:
When Athaliah, the mother of Ahaziah, learned that her son was
dead, she promptly killed off all who were of royal stock.

verses.hebrew:
וַתִּקַּח יְהוֹשֶׁבַע בַּת־הַמֶּלֶךְ־יוֹרָם אֲחוֹת אֲחַזְיָהוּ אֶת־יוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָה וַתִּגְנֹב אֹתוֹ מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ (הממותתים) [הַמּוּמָתִים] אֹתוֹ
וְאֶת־מֵינִקְתּוֹ בַּחֲדַר הַמִּטּוֹת וַיַּסְתִּרוּ אֹתוֹ מִפְּנֵי עֲתַלְיָהוּ וְלֹא הוּמָת׃

hebrew.text:
וַתִּקַּח יְהוֹשֶׁבַע בַּת־הַמֶּלֶךְ־יוֹרָם אֲחוֹת אֲחַזְיָהוּ אֶת־יוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָה וַתִּגְנֹב אֹתוֹ מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ (הממותתים) [הַמּוּמָתִים] אֹתוֹ
וְאֶת־מֵינִקְתּוֹ בַּחֲדַר הַמִּטּוֹת וַיַּסְתִּרוּ אֹתוֹ מִפְּנֵי עֲתַלְיָהוּ וְלֹא הוּמָת׃

english.text:
But Jehosheba, daughter of King Joram and sister of Ahaziah,
secretly took Ahaziah’s son Joash away from among the princes who
were being slain, and [put] him and his nurse in a bedroom. And
they kept him hidden from Athaliah so that he was not put to
death.

translation.text: But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king’s sons which were slain; and they hid him, even him and his nurse, in the bedchamber from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

verses.english:
But Jehosheba, daughter of King Joram and sister of Ahaziah,
secretly took Ahaziah’s son Joash away from among the princes who
were being slain, and [put] him and his nurse in a bedroom. And
they kept him hidden from Athaliah so that he was not put to
death.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אִתָּהּ בֵּית יְהֹוָה מִתְחַבֵּא שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וַעֲתַלְיָה מֹלֶכֶת עַל־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי אִתָּהּ בֵּית יְהֹוָה מִתְחַבֵּא שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וַעֲתַלְיָה מֹלֶכֶת עַל־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
He stayed with her for six years, hidden in the House of YHWH,
while Athaliah reigned over the land.

translation.text: And he was with her hid in the house of the LORD six years. And Athaliah did reign over the land.

verses.english:
He stayed with her for six years, hidden in the House of YHWH,
while Athaliah reigned over the land.

verses.hebrew:
וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִית שָׁלַח יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּקַּח אֶת־שָׂרֵי (המאיות) [הַמֵּאוֹת] לַכָּרִי וְלָרָצִים וַיָּבֵא אֹתָם אֵלָיו בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיִּכְרֹת לָהֶם בְּרִית וַיַּשְׁבַּע
אֹתָם בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה וַיַּרְא אֹתָם אֶת־בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִית שָׁלַח יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּקַּח אֶת־שָׂרֵי (המאיות) [הַמֵּאוֹת] לַכָּרִי וְלָרָצִים וַיָּבֵא אֹתָם אֵלָיו בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיִּכְרֹת לָהֶם בְּרִית וַיַּשְׁבַּע
אֹתָם בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה וַיַּרְא אֹתָם אֶת־בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
In the seventh year, Jehoiada sent for the chiefs of the hundreds
of the Carites and of the guards, and had them come to him in the
House of YHWH. He made a pact with them, exacting an oath from
them in the House of YHWH, and he showed them the king’s son.

translation.text: And the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over hundreds, with the captains and the guard, and brought them to him into the house of the LORD, and made a covenant with them, and took an oath of them in the house of the LORD, and shewed them the king’s son.

verses.english:
In the seventh year, Jehoiada sent for the chiefs of the hundreds
of the Carites and of the guards, and had them come to him in the
House of YHWH. He made a pact with them, exacting an oath from
them in the House of YHWH, and he showed them the king’s son.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַוֵּם לֵאמֹר זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּן הַשְּׁלִשִׁית מִכֶּם בָּאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת וְשֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַוֵּם לֵאמֹר זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּן הַשְּׁלִשִׁית מִכֶּם בָּאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת וְשֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

translation.text: And he commanded them, saying, This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;

verses.hebrew: וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית בְּשַׁעַר סוּר וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית בַּשַּׁעַר אַחַר הָרָצִים וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַבַּיִת מַסָּח׃

hebrew.text: וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית בְּשַׁעַר סוּר וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית בַּשַּׁעַר אַחַר הָרָצִים וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַבַּיִת מַסָּח׃

english.text:
another third shall be [stationed] at the Sur Gate; and the other
third shall be at the gate behind the guards; you shall keep guard
over the House on every side.

translation.text: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall ye keep the watch of the house, that it be not broken down.

verses.english:
another third shall be [stationed] at the Sur Gate; and the other
third shall be at the gate behind the guards; you shall keep guard
over the House on every side.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי הַיָּדוֹת בָּכֶם כֹּל יֹצְאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וּשְׁתֵּי הַיָּדוֹת בָּכֶם כֹּל יֹצְאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The two divisions of yours who are off duty this week shall keep
guard over the House of YHWH for the protection of the king.

translation.text: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of the LORD about the king.

verses.english:
The two divisions of yours who are off duty this week shall keep
guard over the House of YHWH for the protection of the king.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקַּפְתֶּם עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ סָבִיב אִישׁ וְכֵלָיו בְּיָדוֹ וְהַבָּא אֶל־הַשְּׂדֵרוֹת יוּמָת וִהְיוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּצֵאתוֹ וּבְבֹאוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהִקַּפְתֶּם עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ סָבִיב אִישׁ וְכֵלָיו בְּיָדוֹ וְהַבָּא אֶל־הַשְּׂדֵרוֹת יוּמָת וִהְיוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּצֵאתוֹ וּבְבֹאוֹ׃

english.text:
You shall surround the king on every side, every man with his
weapons at the ready; and whoever breaks through the ranks shall
be killed. Stay close to the king in his comings and goings.”

translation.text: And ye shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that cometh within the ranges, let him be slain: and be ye with the king as he goeth out and as he cometh in.

verses.english:
You shall surround the king on every side, every man with his
weapons at the ready; and whoever breaks through the ranks shall
be killed. Stay close to the king in his comings and goings.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲשׂוּ שָׂרֵי (המאיות) [הַמֵּאוֹת] כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן וַיִּקְחוּ אִישׁ אֶת־אֲנָשָׁיו בָּאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת עִם יֹצְאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְהוֹיָדָע
הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲשׂוּ שָׂרֵי (המאיות) [הַמֵּאוֹת] כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן וַיִּקְחוּ אִישׁ אֶת־אֲנָשָׁיו בָּאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת עִם יֹצְאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְהוֹיָדָע
הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
The chiefs of hundreds did just as Jehoiada ordered: Each took his
men—those who were on duty that week and those who were off duty
that week—and they presented themselves to Jehoiada the priest.

translation.text: And the captains over the hundreds did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that should go out on the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

verses.english:
The chiefs of hundreds did just as Jehoiada ordered: Each took his
men—those who were on duty that week and those who were off duty
that week—and they presented themselves to Jehoiada the priest.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן הַכֹּהֵן לְשָׂרֵי (המאיות) [הַמֵּאוֹת] אֶת־הַחֲנִית וְאֶת־הַשְּׁלָטִים אֲשֶׁר לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן הַכֹּהֵן לְשָׂרֵי (המאיות) [הַמֵּאוֹת] אֶת־הַחֲנִית וְאֶת־הַשְּׁלָטִים אֲשֶׁר לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The priest gave the chiefs of hundreds King David’s spears and
quivers that were kept in the House of YHWH.

translation.text: And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David’s spears and shields, that were in the temple of the LORD.

verses.english:
The priest gave the chiefs of hundreds King David’s spears and
quivers that were kept in the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַמְדוּ הָרָצִים אִישׁ וְכֵלָיו בְּיָדוֹ מִכֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית עַד־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַשְּׂמָאלִית לַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְלַבָּיִת עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ סָבִיב׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַמְדוּ הָרָצִים אִישׁ וְכֵלָיו בְּיָדוֹ מִכֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית עַד־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַשְּׂמָאלִית לַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְלַבָּיִת עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ סָבִיב׃

english.text:
The guards, each with his weapons at the ready, stationed
themselves—from the south end of the House to the north end of the
House, at the altar and the House—to guard the king on every side.

translation.text: And the guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, round about the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple, along by the altar and the temple.

verses.english:
The guards, each with his weapons at the ready, stationed
themselves—from the south end of the House to the north end of the
House, at the altar and the House—to guard the king on every side.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִא אֶת־בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת־הַנֵּזֶר וְאֶת־הָעֵדוּת וַיַּמְלִכוּ אֹתוֹ וַיִּמְשָׁחֻהוּ וַיַּכּוּ־כָף וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיּוֹצִא אֶת־בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת־הַנֵּזֶר וְאֶת־הָעֵדוּת וַיַּמְלִכוּ אֹתוֹ וַיִּמְשָׁחֻהוּ וַיַּכּוּ־כָף וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
[Jehoiada] then brought out the king’s son, and placed upon him
the crown and the insignia. They anointed him and proclaimed him
king; they clapped their hands and shouted, “Long live the king!”

translation.text: And he brought forth the king’s son, and put the crown upon him, and gave him the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, God save the king.

verses.english:
[Jehoiada] then brought out the king’s son, and placed upon him
the crown and the insignia. They anointed him and proclaimed him
king; they clapped their hands and shouted, “Long live the king!”

verses.hebrew: וַתִּשְׁמַע עֲתַלְיָה אֶת־קוֹל הָרָצִין הָעָם וַתָּבֹא אֶל־הָעָם בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַתִּשְׁמַע עֲתַלְיָה אֶת־קוֹל הָרָצִין הָעָם וַתָּבֹא אֶל־הָעָם בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
When Athaliah heard the shouting of the guards [and] the people,
she came out to the people in the House of YHWH.

translation.text: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the temple of the LORD.

verses.english:
When Athaliah heard the shouting of the guards [and] the people,
she came out to the people in the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew:
וַתֵּרֶא וְהִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ עֹמֵד עַל־הָעַמּוּד כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְהַשָּׂרִים וְהַחֲצֹצְרוֹת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־עַם הָאָרֶץ שָׂמֵחַ וְתֹקֵעַ בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וַתִּקְרַע עֲתַלְיָה
אֶת־בְּגָדֶיהָ וַתִּקְרָא קֶשֶׁר קָשֶׁר׃

hebrew.text:
וַתֵּרֶא וְהִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ עֹמֵד עַל־הָעַמּוּד כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְהַשָּׂרִים וְהַחֲצֹצְרוֹת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכל־עַם הָאָרֶץ שָׂמֵחַ וְתֹקֵעַ בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וַתִּקְרַע עֲתַלְיָה
אֶת־בְּגָדֶיהָ וַתִּקְרָא קֶשֶׁר קָשֶׁר׃

english.text:
She looked about and saw the king standing by the pillar, as was
the custom, the chiefs with their trumpets beside the king, and
all the people of the land rejoicing and blowing trumpets.
Athaliah rent her garments and cried out, “Treason, treason!”

translation.text: And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner was, and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.

verses.english:
She looked about and saw the king standing by the pillar, as was
the custom, the chiefs with their trumpets beside the king, and
all the people of the land rejoicing and blowing trumpets.
Athaliah rent her garments and cried out, “Treason, treason!”

verses.hebrew:
וַיְצַו יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־שָׂרֵי (המאיות) [הַמֵּאוֹת ] פְּקֻדֵי הַחַיִל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם הוֹצִיאוּ אֹתָהּ אֶל־מִבֵּית לַשְּׂדֵרֹת וְהַבָּא אַחֲרֶיהָ הָמֵת בֶּחָרֶב כִּי
אָמַר הַכֹּהֵן אַל־תּוּמַת בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְצַו יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־שָׂרֵי (המאיות) [הַמֵּאוֹת ] פְּקֻדֵי הַחַיִל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם הוֹצִיאוּ אֹתָהּ אֶל־מִבֵּית לַשְּׂדֵרֹת וְהַבָּא אַחֲרֶיהָ הָמֵת בֶּחָרֶב כִּי
אָמַר הַכֹּהֵן אַל־תּוּמַת בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Then the priest Jehoiada gave the command to the army officers,
the chiefs of hundreds, and said to them, “Take her out between
the ranks and, if anyone follows her, put him to the sword.” For
the priest thought: “Let her not be put to death in the House of
YHWH.”

translation.text: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the host, and said unto them, Have her forth without the ranges: and him that followeth her kill with the sword. For the priest had said, Let her not be slain in the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
Then the priest Jehoiada gave the command to the army officers,
the chiefs of hundreds, and said to them, “Take her out between
the ranks and, if anyone follows her, put him to the sword.” For
the priest thought: “Let her not be put to death in the House of
YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂמוּ לָהּ יָדַיִם וַתָּבוֹא דֶּרֶךְ־מְבוֹא הַסּוּסִים בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתּוּמַת שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשִׂמוּ לָהּ יָדַיִם וַתָּבוֹא דֶּרֶךְ־מְבוֹא הַסּוּסִים בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתּוּמַת שָׁם׃

english.text:
They cleared a passageway for her and she entered the royal palace
through the horses’ entrance: there she was put to death.

translation.text: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king’s house: and there was she slain.

verses.english:
They cleared a passageway for her and she entered the royal palace
through the horses’ entrance: there she was put to death.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹיָדָע אֶת־הַבְּרִית בֵּין יְהֹוָה וּבֵין הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבֵין הָעָם לִהְיוֹת לְעָם לַיהֹוָה וּבֵין הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבֵין הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹיָדָע אֶת־הַבְּרִית בֵּין יְהֹוָה וּבֵין הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבֵין הָעָם לִהְיוֹת לְעָם לַיהֹוָה וּבֵין הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבֵין הָעָם׃

english.text:
And Jehoiada solemnized the covenant between YHWH, on the one
hand, and the king and the people, on the other—as well as between
the king and the people—that they should be the people of YHWH.

translation.text: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD’s people; between the king also and the people.

verses.english:
And Jehoiada solemnized the covenant between YHWH, on the one
hand, and the king and the people, on the other—as well as between
the king and the people—that they should be the people of YHWH.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹאוּ כל־עַם הָאָרֶץ בֵּית־הַבַּעַל וַיִּתְּצֻהוּ אֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתָו וְאֶת־צְלָמָיו שִׁבְּרוּ הֵיטֵב וְאֵת מַתָּן כֹּהֵן הַבַּעַל הָרְגוּ לִפְנֵי הַמִּזְבְּחוֹת וַיָּשֶׂם
הַכֹּהֵן פְּקֻדֹּת עַל־בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹאוּ כל־עַם הָאָרֶץ בֵּית־הַבַּעַל וַיִּתְּצֻהוּ אֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתָו וְאֶת־צְלָמָיו שִׁבְּרוּ הֵיטֵב וְאֵת מַתָּן כֹּהֵן הַבַּעַל הָרְגוּ לִפְנֵי הַמִּזְבְּחוֹת וַיָּשֶׂם
הַכֹּהֵן פְּקֻדֹּת עַל־בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Thereupon all the people of the land went to the temple of Baal.
They tore it down and smashed its altars and images to bits, and
they slew Mattan, the priest of Baal, in front of the altars.
[Jehoiada] the priest then placed guards over the House of YHWH.

translation.text: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and brake it down; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
Thereupon all the people of the land went to the temple of Baal.
They tore it down and smashed its altars and images to bits, and
they slew Mattan, the priest of Baal, in front of the altars.
[Jehoiada] the priest then placed guards over the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח אֶת־שָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת וְאֶת־הַכָּרִי וְאֶת־הָרָצִים וְאֵת כּל־עַם הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּרִידוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ מִבֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיָּבוֹאוּ דֶּרֶךְ־שַׁעַר הָרָצִים בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ
וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא הַמְּלָכִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח אֶת־שָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת וְאֶת־הַכָּרִי וְאֶת־הָרָצִים וְאֵת כּל־עַם הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּרִידוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ מִבֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיָּבוֹאוּ דֶּרֶךְ־שַׁעַר הָרָצִים בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ
וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא הַמְּלָכִים׃

english.text:
He took the chiefs of hundreds, the Carites, the guards, and all
the people of the land, and they escorted the king from the House
of YHWH into the royal palace by the gate of the guards. And he
ascended the royal throne.

translation.text: And he took the rulers over hundreds, and the captains, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the house of the LORD, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.

verses.english:
He took the chiefs of hundreds, the Carites, the guards, and all
the people of the land, and they escorted the king from the House
of YHWH into the royal palace by the gate of the guards. And he
ascended the royal throne.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂמַח כּל־עַם־הָאָרֶץ וְהָעִיר שָׁקָטָה וְאֶת־עֲתַלְיָהוּ הֵמִיתוּ בַחֶרֶב בֵּית (מלך) [הַמֶּלֶךְ]׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׂמַח כּל־עַם־הָאָרֶץ וְהָעִיר שָׁקָטָה וְאֶת־עֲתַלְיָהוּ הֵמִיתוּ בַחֶרֶב בֵּית (מלך) [הַמֶּלֶךְ]׃

english.text:
All the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. As
for Athaliah, she had been put to the sword in the royal palace.

translation.text: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was in quiet: and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king’s house.

verses.english:
All the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. As
for Athaliah, she had been put to the sword in the royal palace.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים יְהוֹאָשׁ בְּמלְכוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים יְהוֹאָשׁ בְּמלְכוֹ׃

english.text: Jehoash was seven years old when he became king.

translation.text: Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign.

verses.english: Jehoash was seven years old when he became king.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת־שֶׁבַע לְיֵהוּא מָלַךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ וְאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ צִבְיָה מִבְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת־שֶׁבַע לְיֵהוּא מָלַךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ וְאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ צִבְיָה מִבְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃

english.text:
Jehoash began his reign in the seventh year of Jehu, and he
reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother’s name was Zibiah of
Beer-sheba.

translation.text: In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign; and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.

verses.english:
Jehoash began his reign in the seventh year of Jehu, and he
reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother’s name was Zibiah of
Beer-sheba.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוֹאָשׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כּל־יָמָיו אֲשֶׁר הוֹרָהוּ יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוֹאָשׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כּל־יָמָיו אֲשֶׁר הוֹרָהוּ יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן׃

english.text:
All his days Jehoash did what was pleasing to YHWH, as the priest
Jehoiada instructed him.

translation.text: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

verses.english:
All his days Jehoash did what was pleasing to YHWH, as the priest
Jehoiada instructed him.

verses.hebrew: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃

hebrew.text: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃

english.text:
The shrines, however, were not removed; the people continued to
sacrifice and offer at the shrines.

translation.text: But the high places were not taken away: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.

verses.english:
The shrines, however, were not removed; the people continued to
sacrifice and offer at the shrines.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹאָשׁ אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִים כֹּל כֶּסֶף הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־יוּבָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה כֶּסֶף עוֹבֵר אִישׁ כֶּסֶף נַפְשׁוֹת עֶרְכּוֹ כּל־כֶּסֶף אֲשֶׁר יַעֲלֶה עַל לֶב־אִישׁ
לְהָבִיא בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹאָשׁ אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִים כֹּל כֶּסֶף הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־יוּבָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה כֶּסֶף עוֹבֵר אִישׁ כֶּסֶף נַפְשׁוֹת עֶרְכּוֹ כּל־כֶּסֶף אֲשֶׁר יַעֲלֶה עַל לֶב־אִישׁ
לְהָבִיא בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money, current money,
brought into the House of YHWH as sacred donations—any money a man
may pay as the money equivalent of persons, or any other money
that a man may be minded to bring to the House of YHWH—

translation.text: And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the LORD, even the money of every one that passeth the account, the money that every man is set at, and all the money that cometh into any man’s heart to bring into the house of the LORD,

verses.english:
Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money, current money,
brought into the House of YHWH as sacred donations—any money a man
may pay as the money equivalent of persons, or any other money
that a man may be minded to bring to the House of YHWH—

verses.hebrew: יִקְחוּ לָהֶם הַכֹּהֲנִים אִישׁ מֵאֵת מַכָּרוֹ וְהֵם יְחַזְּקוּ אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבַּיִת לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִמָּצֵא שָׁם בָּדֶק׃

hebrew.text: יִקְחוּ לָהֶם הַכֹּהֲנִים אִישׁ מֵאֵת מַכָּרוֹ וְהֵם יְחַזְּקוּ אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבַּיִת לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִמָּצֵא שָׁם בָּדֶק׃

english.text:
let the priests receive it, each from his benefactor; they, in
turn, shall make repairs on the House, wherever damage may be
found.”

translation.text: Let the priests take it to them, every man of his acquaintance: and let them repair the breaches of the house, wheresoever any breach shall be found.

verses.english:
let the priests receive it, each from his benefactor; they, in
turn, shall make repairs on the House, wherever damage may be
found.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ לֹא־חִזְּקוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ לֹא־חִזְּקוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
But in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash, [it was found that]
the priests had not made the repairs on the House.

translation.text: But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.

verses.english:
But in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash, [it was found that]
the priests had not made the repairs on the House.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְרָא הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ לִיהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן וְלַכֹּהֲנִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מַדּוּעַ אֵינְכֶם מְחַזְּקִים אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת וְעַתָּה אַל־תִּקְחוּ־כֶסֶף מֵאֵת מַכָּרֵיכֶם
כִּי־לְבֶדֶק הַבַּיִת תִּתְּנֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְרָא הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ לִיהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן וְלַכֹּהֲנִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מַדּוּעַ אֵינְכֶם מְחַזְּקִים אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת וְעַתָּה אַל־תִּקְחוּ־כֶסֶף מֵאֵת מַכָּרֵיכֶם
כִּי־לְבֶדֶק הַבַּיִת תִּתְּנֻהוּ׃

english.text:
So King Jehoash summoned the priest Jehoiada and the other priests
and said to them, “Why have you not kept the House in repair? Now
do not accept money from your benefactors any more, but have it
donated for the repair of the House.”

translation.text: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the other priests, and said unto them, Why repair ye not the breaches of the house? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.

verses.english:
So King Jehoash summoned the priest Jehoiada and the other priests
and said to them, “Why have you not kept the House in repair? Now
do not accept money from your benefactors any more, but have it
donated for the repair of the House.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּאֹתוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים לְבִלְתִּי קְחַת־כֶּסֶף מֵאֵת הָעָם וּלְבִלְתִּי חַזֵּק אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּאֹתוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים לְבִלְתִּי קְחַת־כֶּסֶף מֵאֵת הָעָם וּלְבִלְתִּי חַזֵּק אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
The priests agreed that they would neither accept money from the
people nor make repairs on the House.

translation.text: And the priests consented to receive no more money of the people, neither to repair the breaches of the house.

verses.english:
The priests agreed that they would neither accept money from the
people nor make repairs on the House.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן אֲרוֹן אֶחָד וַיִּקֹּב חֹר בְּדַלְתּוֹ וַיִּתֵּן אֹתוֹ אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ (בימין) [מִיָּמִין] בְּבוֹא־אִישׁ בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְנָתְנוּ־שָׁמָּה
הַכֹּהֲנִים שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּף אֶת־כּל־הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּבָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן אֲרוֹן אֶחָד וַיִּקֹּב חֹר בְּדַלְתּוֹ וַיִּתֵּן אֹתוֹ אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ (בימין) [מִיָּמִין] בְּבוֹא־אִישׁ בֵּית יְהֹוָה וְנָתְנוּ־שָׁמָּה
הַכֹּהֲנִים שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּף אֶת־כּל־הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּבָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
And the priest Jehoiada took a chest and bored a hole in its lid.
He placed it at the right side of the altar as one entered the
House of YHWH, and the priestly guards of the threshold deposited
there all the money that was brought into the House of YHWH.

translation.text: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the LORD: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
And the priest Jehoiada took a chest and bored a hole in its lid.
He placed it at the right side of the altar as one entered the
House of YHWH, and the priestly guards of the threshold deposited
there all the money that was brought into the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹתָם כִּי־רַב הַכֶּסֶף בָּאָרוֹן וַיַּעַל סֹפֵר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וַיָּצֻרוּ וַיִּמְנוּ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹתָם כִּי־רַב הַכֶּסֶף בָּאָרוֹן וַיַּעַל סֹפֵר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וַיָּצֻרוּ וַיִּמְנוּ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Whenever they saw that there was much money in the chest, the
royal scribe and the high priest would come up and put the money
accumulated in the House of YHWH into bags, and they would count
it.

translation.text: And it was so, when they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags, and told the money that was found in the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
Whenever they saw that there was much money in the chest, the
royal scribe and the high priest would come up and put the money
accumulated in the House of YHWH into bags, and they would count
it.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנוּ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַמְתֻכָּן עַל־[יְדֵי] (יד) עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה (הפקדים) [הַמֻּפְקָדִים] בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיּוֹצִיאֻהוּ לְחָרָשֵׁי הָעֵץ וְלַבֹּנִים הָעֹשִׂים בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתְנוּ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַמְתֻכָּן עַל־[יְדֵי] (יד) עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה (הפקדים) [הַמֻּפְקָדִים] בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיּוֹצִיאֻהוּ לְחָרָשֵׁי הָעֵץ וְלַבֹּנִים הָעֹשִׂים בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Then they would deliver the money that was weighed out to the
overseers of the work, who were in charge of the House of YHWH.
These, in turn, used to pay the carpenters and the laborers who
worked on the House of YHWH,

translation.text: And they gave the money, being told, into the hands of them that did the work, that had the oversight of the house of the LORD: and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders, that wrought upon the house of the LORD,

verses.english:
Then they would deliver the money that was weighed out to the
overseers of the work, who were in charge of the House of YHWH.
These, in turn, used to pay the carpenters and the laborers who
worked on the House of YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וְלַגֹּדְרִים וּלְחֹצְבֵי הָאֶבֶן וְלִקְנוֹת עֵצִים וְאַבְנֵי מַחְצֵב לְחַזֵּק אֶת־בֶּדֶק בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וּלְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא עַל־הַבַּיִת לְחזְקָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלַגֹּדְרִים וּלְחֹצְבֵי הָאֶבֶן וְלִקְנוֹת עֵצִים וְאַבְנֵי מַחְצֵב לְחַזֵּק אֶת־בֶּדֶק בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וּלְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא עַל־הַבַּיִת לְחזְקָה׃

english.text:
and the masons and the stonecutters. They also paid for wood and
for quarried stone with which to make the repairs on the House of
YHWH, and for every other expenditure that had to be made in
repairing the House.

translation.text: And to masons, and hewers of stone, and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the LORD, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.

verses.english:
and the masons and the stonecutters. They also paid for wood and
for quarried stone with which to make the repairs on the House of
YHWH, and for every other expenditure that had to be made in
repairing the House.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ לֹא יֵעָשֶׂה בֵּית יְהֹוָה סִפּוֹת כֶּסֶף מְזַמְּרוֹת מִזְרָקוֹת חֲצֹצְרוֹת כּל־כְּלִי זָהָב וּכְלִי־כָסֶף מִן־הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּבָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ לֹא יֵעָשֶׂה בֵּית יְהֹוָה סִפּוֹת כֶּסֶף מְזַמְּרוֹת מִזְרָקוֹת חֲצֹצְרוֹת כּל־כְּלִי זָהָב וּכְלִי־כָסֶף מִן־הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּבָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה׃

translation.text: Howbeit there were not made for the house of the LORD bowls of silver, snuffers, basons, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the house of the LORD:

verses.hebrew: כִּי־לְעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה יִתְּנֻהוּ וְחִזְּקוּ־בוֹ אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־לְעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה יִתְּנֻהוּ וְחִזְּקוּ־בוֹ אֶת־בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
this was given only to the overseers of the work for the repair of
the House of YHWH.

translation.text: But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
this was given only to the overseers of the work for the repair of
the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יְחַשְּׁבוּ אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יִתְּנוּ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף עַל־יָדָם לָתֵת לְעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה כִּי בֶאֱמֻנָה הֵם עֹשִׂים׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא יְחַשְּׁבוּ אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יִתְּנוּ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף עַל־יָדָם לָתֵת לְעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה כִּי בֶאֱמֻנָה הֵם עֹשִׂים׃

english.text:
No check was kept on the men to whom the money was delivered to
pay the workers; for they dealt honestly.

translation.text: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.

verses.english:
No check was kept on the men to whom the money was delivered to
pay the workers; for they dealt honestly.

verses.hebrew: כֶּסֶף אָשָׁם וְכֶסֶף חַטָּאוֹת לֹא יוּבָא בֵּית יְהֹוָה לַכֹּהֲנִים יִהְיוּ׃

hebrew.text: כֶּסֶף אָשָׁם וְכֶסֶף חַטָּאוֹת לֹא יוּבָא בֵּית יְהֹוָה לַכֹּהֲנִים יִהְיוּ׃

english.text:
Money brought as a guilt offering or as a sin offering was not
deposited in the House of YHWH; it went to the priests.

translation.text: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the LORD: it was the priests’.

verses.english:
Money brought as a guilt offering or as a sin offering was not
deposited in the House of YHWH; it went to the priests.

verses.hebrew: אָז יַעֲלֶה חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיִּלָּחֶם עַל־גַּת וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ וַיָּשֶׂם חֲזָאֵל פָּנָיו לַעֲלוֹת עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: אָז יַעֲלֶה חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיִּלָּחֶם עַל־גַּת וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ וַיָּשֶׂם חֲזָאֵל פָּנָיו לַעֲלוֹת עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
At that time, King Hazael of Aram came up and attacked Gath and
captured it; and Hazael proceeded to march on Jerusalem.

translation.text: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

verses.english:
At that time, King Hazael of Aram came up and attacked Gath and
captured it; and Hazael proceeded to march on Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֵת כּל־הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־הִקְדִּישׁוּ יְהוֹשָׁפָט וִיהוֹרָם וַאֲחַזְיָהוּ אֲבֹתָיו מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־קֳדָשָׁיו וְאֵת כּל־הַזָּהָב
הַנִּמְצָא בְּאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וּבֵית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח לַחֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיַּעַל מֵעַל יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֵת כּל־הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־הִקְדִּישׁוּ יְהוֹשָׁפָט וִיהוֹרָם וַאֲחַזְיָהוּ אֲבֹתָיו מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־קֳדָשָׁיו וְאֵת כּל־הַזָּהָב
הַנִּמְצָא בְּאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וּבֵית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח לַחֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיַּעַל מֵעַל יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
Thereupon King Joash of Judah took all the objects that had been
consecrated by his fathers, Kings Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and
Ahaziah of Judah, and by himself, and all the gold that there was
in the treasuries of the Temple of YHWH and in the royal palace,
and he sent them to King Hazael of Aram, who then turned back from
his march on Jerusalem.

translation.text: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own hallowed things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and in the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria: and he went away from Jerusalem.

verses.english:
Thereupon King Joash of Judah took all the objects that had been
consecrated by his fathers, Kings Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and
Ahaziah of Judah, and by himself, and all the gold that there was
in the treasuries of the Temple of YHWH and in the royal palace,
and he sent them to King Hazael of Aram, who then turned back from
his march on Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יוֹאָשׁ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יוֹאָשׁ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Joash’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.english:
The other events of Joash’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ עֲבָדָיו וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ־קָשֶׁר וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־יוֹאָשׁ בֵּית מִלֹּא הַיֹּרֵד סִלָּא׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּקֻמוּ עֲבָדָיו וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ־קָשֶׁר וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־יוֹאָשׁ בֵּית מִלֹּא הַיֹּרֵד סִלָּא׃

english.text:
His courtiers formed a conspiracy against Joash and assassinated
him at Beth-millo that leads down to Silla.

translation.text: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in the house of Millo, which goeth down to Silla.

verses.english:
His courtiers formed a conspiracy against Joash and assassinated
him at Beth-millo that leads down to Silla.

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹזָכָר בֶּן־שִׁמְעָת וִיהוֹזָבָד בֶּן־שֹׁמֵר עֲבָדָיו הִכֻּהוּ וַיָּמֹת וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֲמַצְיָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וְיוֹזָכָר בֶּן־שִׁמְעָת וִיהוֹזָבָד בֶּן־שֹׁמֵר עֲבָדָיו הִכֻּהוּ וַיָּמֹת וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֲמַצְיָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
The courtiers who assassinated him were Jozacar son of Shimeath
and Jehozabad son of Shomer. He died and was buried with his
fathers in the City of David; and his son Amaziah succeeded him as
king.

translation.text: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
The courtiers who assassinated him were Jozacar son of Shimeath
and Jehozabad son of Shomer. He died and was buried with his
fathers in the City of David; and his son Amaziah succeeded him as
king.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה לְיוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ יְהוֹאָחָז בֶּן־יֵהוּא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה לְיוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ יְהוֹאָחָז בֶּן־יֵהוּא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
In the twenty-third year of King Joash son of Ahaziah of Judah,
Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king over Israel in Samaria—for
seventeen years.

translation.text: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned seventeen years.

verses.english:
In the twenty-third year of King Joash son of Ahaziah of Judah,
Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king over Israel in Samaria—for
seventeen years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחַר חַטֹּאת יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־סָר מִמֶּנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחַר חַטֹּאת יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־סָר מִמֶּנָּה׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH. He persisted in the sins
which Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit; he did
not depart from them.

translation.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH. He persisted in the sins
which Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit; he did
not depart from them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וּבְיַד בֶּן־הֲדַד בֶּן־חֲזָאֵל כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וּבְיַד בֶּן־הֲדַד בֶּן־חֲזָאֵל כּל־הַיָּמִים׃

english.text:
YHWH was angry with Israel and He repeatedly delivered them into
the hands of King Hazael of Aram and into the hands of Ben-hadad
son of Hazael.

translation.text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, all their days.

verses.english:
YHWH was angry with Israel and He repeatedly delivered them into
the hands of King Hazael of Aram and into the hands of Ben-hadad
son of Hazael.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַל יְהוֹאָחָז אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁמַע אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה כִּי רָאָה אֶת־לַחַץ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־לָחַץ אֹתָם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחַל יְהוֹאָחָז אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיִּשְׁמַע אֵלָיו יְהֹוָה כִּי רָאָה אֶת־לַחַץ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־לָחַץ אֹתָם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם׃

english.text:
But Jehoahaz pleaded with YHWH; and YHWH listened to him, for He
saw the suffering that the king of Aram inflicted upon Israel.

translation.text: And Jehoahaz besought the LORD, and the LORD hearkened unto him: for he saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.

verses.english:
But Jehoahaz pleaded with YHWH; and YHWH listened to him, for He
saw the suffering that the king of Aram inflicted upon Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מוֹשִׁיעַ וַיֵּצְאוּ מִתַּחַת יַד־אֲרָם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאהֳלֵיהֶם כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהֹוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מוֹשִׁיעַ וַיֵּצְאוּ מִתַּחַת יַד־אֲרָם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאהֳלֵיהֶם כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃

english.text:
So YHWH granted Israel a deliverer, and they gained their freedom
from Aram; and Israel dwelt in its homes as before.

translation.text: (And the LORD gave Israel a saviour, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians: and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents, as beforetime.

verses.english:
So YHWH granted Israel a deliverer, and they gained their freedom
from Aram; and Israel dwelt in its homes as before.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ לֹא־סָרוּ מֵחַטֹּאת בֵּית־יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּהּ הָלָךְ וְגַם הָאֲשֵׁרָה עָמְדָה בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ לֹא־סָרוּ מֵחַטֹּאת בֵּית־יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּהּ הָלָךְ וְגַם הָאֲשֵׁרָה עָמְדָה בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
However, they did not depart from the sins which the House of
Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit; they persisted in them. Even
the sacred post stood in Samaria.
