translation.text: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Israel sin, but walked therein: and there remained the grove also in Samaria.)

verses.english:
However, they did not depart from the sins which the House of
Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit; they persisted in them. Even
the sacred post stood in Samaria.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא הִשְׁאִיר לִיהוֹאָחָז עָם כִּי אִם־חֲמִשִּׁים פָּרָשִׁים וַעֲשָׂרָה רֶכֶב וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים רַגְלִי כִּי אִבְּדָם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיְשִׂמֵם כֶּעָפָר לָדֻשׁ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי לֹא הִשְׁאִיר לִיהוֹאָחָז עָם כִּי אִם־חֲמִשִּׁים פָּרָשִׁים וַעֲשָׂרָה רֶכֶב וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים רַגְלִי כִּי אִבְּדָם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיְשִׂמֵם כֶּעָפָר לָדֻשׁ׃

english.text:
In fact, Jehoahaz was left with a force of only fifty horsemen,
ten chariots, and ten thousand foot soldiers; for the king of Aram
had decimated them and trampled them like the dust under his feet.

translation.text: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.

verses.english:
In fact, Jehoahaz was left with a force of only fifty horsemen,
ten chariots, and ten thousand foot soldiers; for the king of Aram
had decimated them and trampled them like the dust under his feet.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹאָחָז וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹאָחָז וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Jehoahaz’s reign, and all his actions and his
exploits, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.english:
The other events of Jehoahaz’s reign, and all his actions and his
exploits, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹאָחָז עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ יוֹאָשׁ בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹאָחָז עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ יוֹאָשׁ בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Jehoahaz slept with his fathers and he was buried in Samaria; his
son Joash succeeded him as king.

translation.text: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Jehoahaz slept with his fathers and he was buried in Samaria; his
son Joash succeeded him as king.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְיוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְיוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
In the thirty-seventh year of King Joash of Judah, Jehoash son of
Jehoahaz became king of Israel in Samaria—for sixteen years.

translation.text: In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned sixteen years.

verses.english:
In the thirty-seventh year of King Joash of Judah, Jehoash son of
Jehoahaz became king of Israel in Samaria—for sixteen years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשֶׂה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא סָר מִכּל־חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּהּ הָלָךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשֶׂה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא סָר מִכּל־חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּהּ הָלָךְ׃

translation.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin: but he walked therein.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יוֹאָשׁ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם עִם אֲמַצְיָה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יוֹאָשׁ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם עִם אֲמַצְיָה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Joash’s reign, and all his actions, and his
exploits in his war with King Amaziah of Judah, are recorded in
the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.english:
The other events of Joash’s reign, and all his actions, and his
exploits in his war with King Amaziah of Judah, are recorded in
the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יוֹאָשׁ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וְיָרבְעָם יָשַׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ וַיִּקָּבֵר יוֹאָשׁ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עִם מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יוֹאָשׁ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וְיָרבְעָם יָשַׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ וַיִּקָּבֵר יוֹאָשׁ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עִם מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Joash slept with his fathers and Jeroboam occupied his throne;
Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

translation.text: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

verses.english:
Joash slept with his fathers and Jeroboam occupied his throne;
Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִישָׁע חָלָה אֶת־חלְיוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בּוֹ וַיֵּרֶד אֵלָיו יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּבְךְּ עַל־פָּנָיו וַיֹּאמַר אָבִי אָבִי רֶכֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפָרָשָׁיו׃

hebrew.text: וֶאֱלִישָׁע חָלָה אֶת־חלְיוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בּוֹ וַיֵּרֶד אֵלָיו יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּבְךְּ עַל־פָּנָיו וַיֹּאמַר אָבִי אָבִי רֶכֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפָרָשָׁיו׃

english.text:
Elisha had been stricken with the illness of which he was to die,
and King Joash of Israel went down to see him. He wept over him
and cried, “Father, father! Israel’s chariots and horsemen!”

translation.text: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died. And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him, and wept over his face, and said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof.

verses.english:
Elisha had been stricken with the illness of which he was to die,
and King Joash of Israel went down to see him. He wept over him
and cried, “Father, father! Israel’s chariots and horsemen!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלִישָׁע קַח קֶשֶׁת וְחִצִּים וַיִּקַּח אֵלָיו קֶשֶׁת וְחִצִּים׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלִישָׁע קַח קֶשֶׁת וְחִצִּים וַיִּקַּח אֵלָיו קֶשֶׁת וְחִצִּים׃

english.text:
Elisha said to him, “Get a bow and arrows”; and he brought him a
bow and arrows.

translation.text: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows. And he took unto him bow and arrows.

verses.english:
Elisha said to him, “Get a bow and arrows”; and he brought him a
bow and arrows.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַרְכֵּב יָדְךָ עַל־הַקֶּשֶׁת וַיַּרְכֵּב יָדוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם אֱלִישָׁע יָדָיו עַל־יְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַרְכֵּב יָדְךָ עַל־הַקֶּשֶׁת וַיַּרְכֵּב יָדוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם אֱלִישָׁע יָדָיו עַל־יְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Then he said to the king of Israel, “Grasp the bow!” And when he
had grasped it, Elisha put his hands over the king’s hands.

translation.text: And he said to the king of Israel, Put thine hand upon the bow. And he put his hand upon it: and Elisha put his hands upon the king’s hands.

verses.english:
Then he said to the king of Israel, “Grasp the bow!” And when he
had grasped it, Elisha put his hands over the king’s hands.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר פְּתַח הַחַלּוֹן קֵדְמָה וַיִּפְתָּח וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע יְרֵה וַיּוֹר וַיֹּאמֶר חֵץ־תְּשׁוּעָה לַיהֹוָה וְחֵץ תְּשׁוּעָה בַאֲרָם וְהִכִּיתָ אֶת־אֲרָם בַּאֲפֵק
עַד־כַּלֵּה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר פְּתַח הַחַלּוֹן קֵדְמָה וַיִּפְתָּח וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע יְרֵה וַיּוֹר וַיֹּאמֶר חֵץ־תְּשׁוּעָה לַיהֹוָה וְחֵץ תְּשׁוּעָה בַאֲרָם וְהִכִּיתָ אֶת־אֲרָם בַּאֲפֵק
עַד־כַּלֵּה׃

english.text:
“Open the window toward the east,” he said; and he opened it.
Elisha said, “Shoot!” and he shot. Then he said, “An arrow of
victory for YHWH! An arrow of victory over Aram! You shall rout
Aram completely at Aphek.”

translation.text: And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened it. Then Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the LORD’s deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou have consumed them.

verses.english:
“Open the window toward the east,” he said; and he opened it.
Elisha said, “Shoot!” and he shot. Then he said, “An arrow of
victory for YHWH! An arrow of victory over Aram! You shall rout
Aram completely at Aphek.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר קַח הַחִצִּים וַיִּקָּח וַיֹּאמֶר לְמֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַךְ־אַרְצָה וַיַּךְ שָׁלֹשׁ־פְּעָמִים וַיַּעֲמֹד׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר קַח הַחִצִּים וַיִּקָּח וַיֹּאמֶר לְמֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַךְ־אַרְצָה וַיַּךְ שָׁלֹשׁ־פְּעָמִים וַיַּעֲמֹד׃

english.text:
He said, “Now pick up the arrows.” And he picked them up. “Strike
the ground!” he said to the king of Israel; and he struck three
times and stopped.

translation.text: And he said, Take the arrows. And he took them. And he said unto the king of Israel, Smite upon the ground. And he smote thrice, and stayed.

verses.english:
He said, “Now pick up the arrows.” And he picked them up. “Strike
the ground!” he said to the king of Israel; and he struck three
times and stopped.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְצֹף עָלָיו אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר לְהַכּוֹת חָמֵשׁ אוֹ־שֵׁשׁ פְּעָמִים אָז הִכִּיתָ אֶת־אֲרָם עַד־כַּלֵּה וְעַתָּה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים תַּכֶּה אֶת־אֲרָם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְצֹף עָלָיו אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר לְהַכּוֹת חָמֵשׁ אוֹ־שֵׁשׁ פְּעָמִים אָז הִכִּיתָ אֶת־אֲרָם עַד־כַּלֵּה וְעַתָּה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים תַּכֶּה אֶת־אֲרָם׃

english.text:
The man of God was angry with him and said to him, “If only you
had struck five or six times! Then you would have annihilated
Aram; as it is, you shall defeat Aram only three times.”

translation.text: And the man of God was wroth with him, and said, Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it: whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice.

verses.english:
The man of God was angry with him and said to him, “If only you
had struck five or six times! Then you would have annihilated
Aram; as it is, you shall defeat Aram only three times.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת אֱלִישָׁע וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ וּגְדוּדֵי מוֹאָב יָבֹאוּ בָאָרֶץ בָּא שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת אֱלִישָׁע וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ וּגְדוּדֵי מוֹאָב יָבֹאוּ בָאָרֶץ בָּא שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
Elisha died and he was buried. Now bands of Moabites used to
invade the land at the coming of every year.

translation.text: And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

verses.english:
Elisha died and he was buried. Now bands of Moabites used to
invade the land at the coming of every year.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי הֵם קֹבְרִים אִישׁ וְהִנֵּה רָאוּ אֶת־הַגְּדוּד וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ אֶת־הָאִישׁ בְּקֶבֶר אֱלִישָׁע וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּגַּע הָאִישׁ בְּעַצְמוֹת אֱלִישָׁע וַיְחִי וַיָּקם
עַל־רַגְלָיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי הֵם קֹבְרִים אִישׁ וְהִנֵּה רָאוּ אֶת־הַגְּדוּד וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ אֶת־הָאִישׁ בְּקֶבֶר אֱלִישָׁע וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּגַּע הָאִישׁ בְּעַצְמוֹת אֱלִישָׁע וַיְחִי וַיָּקם
עַל־רַגְלָיו׃

english.text:
Once a man was being buried, when the people caught sight of such
a band; so they threw the corpse into Elisha’s grave and made off.
When the [dead] man came in contact with Elisha’s bones, he came
to life and stood up.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.

verses.english:
Once a man was being buried, when the people caught sight of such
a band; so they threw the corpse into Elisha’s grave and made off.
When the [dead] man came in contact with Elisha’s bones, he came
to life and stood up.

verses.hebrew: וַחֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם לָחַץ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּל יְמֵי יְהוֹאָחָז׃

hebrew.text: וַחֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם לָחַץ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּל יְמֵי יְהוֹאָחָז׃

english.text:
King Hazael of Aram had oppressed the Israelites throughout the
reign of Jehoahaz.

translation.text: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.

verses.english:
King Hazael of Aram had oppressed the Israelites throughout the
reign of Jehoahaz.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּחן יְהֹוָה אֹתָם וַיְרַחֲמֵם וַיִּפֶן אֲלֵיהֶם לְמַעַן בְּרִיתוֹ אֶת־אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא אָבָה הַשְׁחִיתָם וְלֹא־הִשְׁלִיכָם מֵעַל־פָּנָיו עַד־עָתָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּחן יְהֹוָה אֹתָם וַיְרַחֲמֵם וַיִּפֶן אֲלֵיהֶם לְמַעַן בְּרִיתוֹ אֶת־אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא אָבָה הַשְׁחִיתָם וְלֹא־הִשְׁלִיכָם מֵעַל־פָּנָיו עַד־עָתָּה׃

english.text:
But YHWH was gracious and merciful to them, and He turned back to
them for the sake of His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
He refrained from destroying them, and He still did not cast them
out from His presence.

translation.text: And the LORD was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.

verses.english:
But YHWH was gracious and merciful to them, and He turned back to
them for the sake of His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
He refrained from destroying them, and He still did not cast them
out from His presence.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמת חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וַיִּמְלֹךְ בֶּן־הֲדַד בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּמת חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וַיִּמְלֹךְ בֶּן־הֲדַד בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
When King Hazael of Aram died, his son Ben-hadad succeeded him as
king;

translation.text: So Hazael king of Syria died; and Benhadad his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
When King Hazael of Aram died, his son Ben-hadad succeeded him as
king;

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הֶעָרִים מִיַּד בֶּן־הֲדַד בֶּן־חֲזָאֵל אֲשֶׁר לָקַח מִיַּד יְהוֹאָחָז אָבִיו בַּמִּלְחָמָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים הִכָּהוּ יוֹאָשׁ
וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־עָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשׁב יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הֶעָרִים מִיַּד בֶּן־הֲדַד בֶּן־חֲזָאֵל אֲשֶׁר לָקַח מִיַּד יְהוֹאָחָז אָבִיו בַּמִּלְחָמָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים הִכָּהוּ יוֹאָשׁ
וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־עָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
and then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz recovered from Ben-hadad son of
Hazael the towns which had been taken from his father Jehoahaz in
war. Three times Joash defeated him, and he recovered the towns of
Israel.

translation.text: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities, which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash beat him, and recovered the cities of Israel.

verses.english:
and then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz recovered from Ben-hadad son of
Hazael the towns which had been taken from his father Jehoahaz in
war. Three times Joash defeated him, and he recovered the towns of
Israel.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְיוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יוֹאָחָז מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ אֲמַצְיָהוּ בֶן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְיוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יוֹאָחָז מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ אֲמַצְיָהוּ בֶן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
In the second year of King Joash son of Joahaz of Israel, Amaziah
son of King Joash of Judah became king.

translation.text: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah.

verses.english:
In the second year of King Joash son of Joahaz of Israel, Amaziah
son of King Joash of Judah became king.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמלְכוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ (יהועדין) [יְהוֹעַדָּן] מִן־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמלְכוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ (יהועדין) [יְהוֹעַדָּן] מִן־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned
twenty-nine years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of
Jerusalem.

translation.text: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

verses.english:
He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned
twenty-nine years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of
Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה רַק לֹא כְּדָוִד אָבִיו כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה יוֹאָשׁ אָבִיו עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה רַק לֹא כְּדָוִד אָבִיו כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה יוֹאָשׁ אָבִיו עָשָׂה׃

english.text:
He did what was pleasing to YHWH, but not like his ancestor David;
he did just as his father Joash had done.

translation.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, yet not like David his father: he did according to all things as Joash his father did.

verses.english:
He did what was pleasing to YHWH, but not like his ancestor David;
he did just as his father Joash had done.

verses.hebrew: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃

hebrew.text: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃

english.text:
However, the shrines were not removed; the people continued to
sacrifice and make offerings at the shrines.

translation.text: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places.

verses.english:
However, the shrines were not removed; the people continued to
sacrifice and make offerings at the shrines.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר חָזְקָה הַמַּמְלָכָה בְּיָדוֹ וַיַּךְ אֶת־עֲבָדָיו הַמַּכִּים אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר חָזְקָה הַמַּמְלָכָה בְּיָדוֹ וַיַּךְ אֶת־עֲבָדָיו הַמַּכִּים אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ אָבִיו׃

english.text:
Once he had the kingdom firmly in his grasp, he put to death the
courtiers who had assassinated his father the king.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand, that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father.

verses.english:
Once he had the kingdom firmly in his grasp, he put to death the
courtiers who had assassinated his father the king.

verses.hebrew:
וְאֶת־בְּנֵי הַמַּכִּים לֹא הֵמִית כַּכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר־תּוֹרַת־מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר לֹא־יוּמְתוּ אָבוֹת עַל־בָּנִים וּבָנִים לֹא־יוּמְתוּ עַל־אָבוֹת כִּי אִם־אִישׁ
בְּחֶטְאוֹ (ימות) [יוּמָת]׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֶת־בְּנֵי הַמַּכִּים לֹא הֵמִית כַּכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר־תּוֹרַת־מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר לֹא־יוּמְתוּ אָבוֹת עַל־בָּנִים וּבָנִים לֹא־יוּמְתוּ עַל־אָבוֹת כִּי אִם־אִישׁ
בְּחֶטְאוֹ (ימות) [יוּמָת]׃

english.text:
But he did not put to death the children of the assassins, in
accordance with what is written in the Book of the Teaching of
Moses, where YHWH commanded, “Parents shall not be put to death
for children, nor children be put to death for parents; a person
shall be put to death only for his own crime.”

translation.text: But the children of the murderers he slew not: according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, wherein the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

verses.english:
But he did not put to death the children of the assassins, in
accordance with what is written in the Book of the Teaching of
Moses, where YHWH commanded, “Parents shall not be put to death
for children, nor children be put to death for parents; a person
shall be put to death only for his own crime.”

verses.hebrew: הוּא־הִכָּה אֶת־אֱדוֹם בְּגֵי־[מֶלַח] (המלח) עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים וְתָפַשׂ אֶת־הַסֶּלַע בַּמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמָהּ יקְתְאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: הוּא־הִכָּה אֶת־אֱדוֹם בְּגֵי־[מֶלַח] (המלח) עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים וְתָפַשׂ אֶת־הַסֶּלַע בַּמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמָהּ יקְתְאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
He defeated ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and he
captured Sela in battle and renamed it Joktheel, as is still the
case.

translation.text: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.

verses.english:
He defeated ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and he
captured Sela in battle and renamed it Joktheel, as is still the
case.

verses.hebrew: אָז שָׁלַח אֲמַצְיָה מַלְאָכִים אֶל־יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז בֶּן־יֵהוּא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר לְכָה נִתְרָאֶה פָנִים׃

hebrew.text: אָז שָׁלַח אֲמַצְיָה מַלְאָכִים אֶל־יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז בֶּן־יֵהוּא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר לְכָה נִתְרָאֶה פָנִים׃

english.text:
Then Amaziah sent envoys to King Jehoash son of Jehoahaz son of
Jehu of Israel, with this message: “Come, let us confront each
other.”

translation.text: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.

verses.english:
Then Amaziah sent envoys to King Jehoash son of Jehoahaz son of
Jehu of Israel, with this message: “Come, let us confront each
other.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־אֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר הַחוֹחַ אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן שָׁלַח אֶל־הָאֶרֶז אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן לֵאמֹר תְּנָה־אֶת־בִּתְּךָ לִבְנִי
לְאִשָּׁה וַתַּעֲבֹר חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן וַתִּרְמֹס אֶת־הַחוֹחַ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־אֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר הַחוֹחַ אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן שָׁלַח אֶל־הָאֶרֶז אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן לֵאמֹר תְּנָה־אֶת־בִּתְּךָ לִבְנִי
לְאִשָּׁה וַתַּעֲבֹר חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן וַתִּרְמֹס אֶת־הַחוֹחַ׃

english.text:
King Jehoash of Israel sent back this message to King Amaziah of
Judah: “The thistle in Lebanon sent this message to the cedar in
Lebanon, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ But a wild
beast in Lebanon went by and trampled down the thistle.

translation.text: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.

verses.english:
King Jehoash of Israel sent back this message to King Amaziah of
Judah: “The thistle in Lebanon sent this message to the cedar in
Lebanon, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ But a wild
beast in Lebanon went by and trampled down the thistle.

verses.hebrew: הַכֵּה הִכִּיתָ אֶת־אֱדוֹם וּנְשָׂאֲךָ לִבֶּךָ הִכָּבֵד וְשֵׁב בְּבֵיתֶךָ וְלָמָּה תִתְגָּרֶה בְּרָעָה וְנָפַלְתָּה אַתָּה וִיהוּדָה עִמָּךְ׃

hebrew.text: הַכֵּה הִכִּיתָ אֶת־אֱדוֹם וּנְשָׂאֲךָ לִבֶּךָ הִכָּבֵד וְשֵׁב בְּבֵיתֶךָ וְלָמָּה תִתְגָּרֶה בְּרָעָה וְנָפַלְתָּה אַתָּה וִיהוּדָה עִמָּךְ׃

english.text:
Because you have defeated Edom, you have become arrogant. Stay
home and enjoy your glory, rather than provoke disaster and fall,
dragging Judah down with you.”

translation.text: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom, and thine heart hath lifted thee up: glory of this, and tarry at home: for why shouldest thou meddle to thy hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?

verses.english:
Because you have defeated Edom, you have become arrogant. Stay
home and enjoy your glory, rather than provoke disaster and fall,
dragging Judah down with you.”

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־שָׁמַע אֲמַצְיָהוּ וַיַּעַל יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְרָאוּ פָנִים הוּא וַאֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה בְּבֵית שֶׁמֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־שָׁמַע אֲמַצְיָהוּ וַיַּעַל יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְרָאוּ פָנִים הוּא וַאֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה בְּבֵית שֶׁמֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה׃

english.text:
But Amaziah paid no heed; so King Jehoash of Israel advanced, and
he and King Amaziah of Judah confronted each other at Beth-shemesh
in Judah.

translation.text: But Amaziah would not hear. Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Bethshemesh, which belongeth to Judah.

verses.english:
But Amaziah paid no heed; so King Jehoash of Israel advanced, and
he and King Amaziah of Judah confronted each other at Beth-shemesh
in Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּנָּגֶף יְהוּדָה לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּנֻסוּ אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּנָּגֶף יְהוּדָה לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּנֻסוּ אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָו׃

english.text:
The Judites were routed by Israel, and they all fled to their
homes.

translation.text: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel; and they fled every man to their tents.

verses.english:
The Judites were routed by Israel, and they all fled to their
homes.

verses.hebrew:
וְאֵת אֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה בֶּן־יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָהוּ תָּפַשׂ יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּבֵית שָׁמֶשׁ (ויבאו) [וַיָּבֹא] יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּפְרֹץ בְּחוֹמַת
יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בְּשַׁעַר אֶפְרַיִם עַד־שַׁעַר הַפִּנָּה אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אַמָּה׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֵת אֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה בֶּן־יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָהוּ תָּפַשׂ יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּבֵית שָׁמֶשׁ (ויבאו) [וַיָּבֹא] יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיִּפְרֹץ בְּחוֹמַת
יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בְּשַׁעַר אֶפְרַיִם עַד־שַׁעַר הַפִּנָּה אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אַמָּה׃

english.text:
King Jehoash of Israel captured King Amaziah son of Jehoash son of
Ahaziah of Judah at Beth-shemesh. He marched on Jerusalem, and he
made a breach of four hundred cubits in the wall of Jerusalem,
from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate.

translation.text: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Bethshemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

verses.english:
King Jehoash of Israel captured King Amaziah son of Jehoash son of
Ahaziah of Judah at Beth-shemesh. He marched on Jerusalem, and he
made a breach of four hundred cubits in the wall of Jerusalem,
from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח אֶת־כּל־הַזָּהָב־וְהַכֶּסֶף וְאֵת כּל־הַכֵּלִים הַנִּמְצְאִים בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וּבְאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֵת בְּנֵי הַתַּעֲרֻבוֹת וַיָּשׁב שֹׁמְרוֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְלָקַח אֶת־כּל־הַזָּהָב־וְהַכֶּסֶף וְאֵת כּל־הַכֵּלִים הַנִּמְצְאִים בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וּבְאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֵת בְּנֵי הַתַּעֲרֻבוֹת וַיָּשׁב שֹׁמְרוֹנָה׃

english.text:
He carried off all the gold and silver and all the vessels that
there were in the House of YHWH and in the treasuries of the royal
palace, as well as hostages; and he returned to Samaria.

translation.text: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.

verses.english:
He carried off all the gold and silver and all the vessels that
there were in the House of YHWH and in the treasuries of the royal
palace, as well as hostages; and he returned to Samaria.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹאָשׁ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם עִם אֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹאָשׁ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם עִם אֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Jehoash’s reign, and all his actions and
exploits, and his war with King Amaziah of Judah, are recorded in
the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.english:
The other events of Jehoash’s reign, and all his actions and
exploits, and his war with King Amaziah of Judah, are recorded in
the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹאָשׁ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עִם מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְלֹךְ יָרבְעָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹאָשׁ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עִם מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְלֹךְ יָרבְעָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the
kings of Israel; his son Jeroboam succeeded him as king.

translation.text: And Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the
kings of Israel; his son Jeroboam succeeded him as king.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי אֲמַצְיָהוּ בֶן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה אַחֲרֵי מוֹת יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחִי אֲמַצְיָהוּ בֶן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה אַחֲרֵי מוֹת יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
King Amaziah son of Joash of Judah lived fifteen years after the
death of King Jehoash son of Jehoahaz of Israel.

translation.text: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.

verses.english:
King Amaziah son of Joash of Judah lived fifteen years after the
death of King Jehoash son of Jehoahaz of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֲמַצְיָהוּ הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתֻבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֲמַצְיָהוּ הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתֻבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Amaziah’s reign are recorded in the Annals of
the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.english:
The other events of Amaziah’s reign are recorded in the Annals of
the Kings of Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ עָלָיו קֶשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיָּנס לָכִישָׁה וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אַחֲרָיו לָכִישָׁה וַיְמִתֻהוּ שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ עָלָיו קֶשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיָּנס לָכִישָׁה וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אַחֲרָיו לָכִישָׁה וַיְמִתֻהוּ שָׁם׃

english.text:
A conspiracy was formed against him in Jerusalem and he fled to
Lachish; but they sent men after him to Lachish, and they killed
him there.

translation.text: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem: and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.

verses.english:
A conspiracy was formed against him in Jerusalem and he fled to
Lachish; but they sent men after him to Lachish, and they killed
him there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֹתוֹ עַל־הַסּוּסִים וַיִּקָּבֵר בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֹתוֹ עַל־הַסּוּסִים וַיִּקָּבֵר בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד׃

english.text:
They brought back his body on horses, and he was buried with his
fathers in Jerusalem, in the City of David.

translation.text: And they brought him on horses: and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.

verses.english:
They brought back his body on horses, and he was buried with his
fathers in Jerusalem, in the City of David.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ כּל־עַם יְהוּדָה אֶת־עֲזַרְיָה וְהוּא בֶּן־שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וַיַּמְלִכוּ אֹתוֹ תַּחַת אָבִיו אֲמַצְיָהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְחוּ כּל־עַם יְהוּדָה אֶת־עֲזַרְיָה וְהוּא בֶּן־שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וַיַּמְלִכוּ אֹתוֹ תַּחַת אָבִיו אֲמַצְיָהוּ׃

english.text:
Then all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years
old, and proclaimed him king to succeed his father Amaziah.

translation.text: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, which was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.

verses.english:
Then all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years
old, and proclaimed him king to succeed his father Amaziah.

verses.hebrew: הוּא בָּנָה אֶת־אֵילַת וַיְשִׁבֶהָ לִיהוּדָה אַחֲרֵי שְׁכַב־הַמֶּלֶךְ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: הוּא בָּנָה אֶת־אֵילַת וַיְשִׁבֶהָ לִיהוּדָה אַחֲרֵי שְׁכַב־הַמֶּלֶךְ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו׃

english.text:
It was he who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah, after King
[Amaziah] slept with his fathers.

translation.text: He built Elath, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.

verses.english:
It was he who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah, after King
[Amaziah] slept with his fathers.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת חֲמֵשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַאֲמַצְיָהוּ בֶן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ יָרבְעָם בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן אַרְבָּעִים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת חֲמֵשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַאֲמַצְיָהוּ בֶן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ יָרבְעָם בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן אַרְבָּעִים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
In the fifteenth year of King Amaziah son of Joash of Judah, King
Jeroboam son of Joash of Israel became king in Samaria—for
forty-one years.

translation.text: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria, and reigned forty and one years.

verses.english:
In the fifteenth year of King Amaziah son of Joash of Judah, King
Jeroboam son of Joash of Israel became king in Samaria—for
forty-one years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא סָר מִכּל־חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא סָר מִכּל־חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; he did not depart from all
the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.

translation.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; he did not depart from all
the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.

verses.hebrew:
הוּא הֵשִׁיב אֶת־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מִלְּבוֹא חֲמָת עַד־יָם הָעֲרָבָה כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד־עַבְדּוֹ יוֹנָה בֶן־אֲמִתַּי הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר מִגַּת
הַחֵפֶר׃

hebrew.text:
הוּא הֵשִׁיב אֶת־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מִלְּבוֹא חֲמָת עַד־יָם הָעֲרָבָה כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד־עַבְדּוֹ יוֹנָה בֶן־אֲמִתַּי הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר מִגַּת
הַחֵפֶר׃

english.text:
It was he who restored the territory of Israel from Lebo-hamath to
the sea of the Arabah, in accordance with the promise that YHWH,
the God of Israel, had made through His servant, the prophet Jonah
son of Amittai from Gath-hepher.

translation.text: He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of the LORD God of Israel, which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which was of Gathhepher.

verses.english:
It was he who restored the territory of Israel from Lebo-hamath to
the sea of the Arabah, in accordance with the promise that YHWH,
the God of Israel, had made through His servant, the prophet Jonah
son of Amittai from Gath-hepher.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־רָאָה יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֳנִי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֹרֶה מְאֹד וְאֶפֶס עָצוּר וְאֶפֶס עָזוּב וְאֵין עֹזֵר לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־רָאָה יְהֹוָה אֶת־עֳנִי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֹרֶה מְאֹד וְאֶפֶס עָצוּר וְאֶפֶס עָזוּב וְאֵין עֹזֵר לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
For YHWH saw the very bitter plight of Israel, with neither bond
nor free left, and with none to help Israel.

translation.text: For the LORD saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter: for there was not any shut up, nor any left, nor any helper for Israel.

verses.english:
For YHWH saw the very bitter plight of Israel, with neither bond
nor free left, and with none to help Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־דִבֶּר יְהֹוָה לִמְחוֹת אֶת־שֵׁם יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם בְּיַד יָרבְעָם בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא־דִבֶּר יְהֹוָה לִמְחוֹת אֶת־שֵׁם יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם בְּיַד יָרבְעָם בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ׃

english.text:
And YHWH resolved not to blot out the name of Israel from under
heaven; and he delivered them through Jeroboam son of Joash.

translation.text: And the LORD said not that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven: but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.

verses.english:
And YHWH resolved not to blot out the name of Israel from under
heaven; and he delivered them through Jeroboam son of Joash.

verses.hebrew:
וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יָרבְעָם וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־נִלְחָם וַאֲשֶׁר הֵשִׁיב אֶת־דַּמֶּשֶׂק וְאֶת־חֲמָת לִיהוּדָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי
הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יָרבְעָם וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־נִלְחָם וַאֲשֶׁר הֵשִׁיב אֶת־דַּמֶּשֶׂק וְאֶת־חֲמָת לִיהוּדָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי
הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Jeroboam’s reign, and all his actions and
exploits, how he fought and recovered Damascus and Hamath for
Judah in Israel, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of
Israel.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which belonged to Judah, for Israel, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.english:
The other events of Jeroboam’s reign, and all his actions and
exploits, how he fought and recovered Damascus and Hamath for
Judah in Israel, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of
Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יָרבְעָם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו עִם מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְלֹךְ זְכַרְיָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יָרבְעָם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו עִם מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְלֹךְ זְכַרְיָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Jeroboam slept with his fathers, the kings of Israel, and his son
Zechariah succeeded him as king.

translation.text: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Jeroboam slept with his fathers, the kings of Israel, and his son
Zechariah succeeded him as king.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְיָרבְעָם מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ עֲזַרְיָה בֶן־אֲמַצְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְיָרבְעָם מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ עֲזַרְיָה בֶן־אֲמַצְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
In the twenty-seventh year of King Jeroboam of Israel, Azariah son
of King Amaziah of Judah became king.

translation.text: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign.

verses.english:
In the twenty-seventh year of King Jeroboam of Israel, Azariah son
of King Amaziah of Judah became king.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמלְכוֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ יְכלְיָהוּ מִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמלְכוֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ יְכלְיָהוּ מִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned
fifty-two years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Jecoliah of
Jerusalem.

translation.text: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.

verses.english:
He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned
fifty-two years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Jecoliah of
Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אֲמַצְיָהוּ אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אֲמַצְיָהוּ אָבִיו׃

english.text:
He did what was pleasing to YHWH, just as his father Amaziah had
done.

translation.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah had done;

verses.english:
He did what was pleasing to YHWH, just as his father Amaziah had
done.

verses.hebrew: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃

hebrew.text: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃

english.text:
However, the shrines were not removed; the people continued to
sacrifice and make offerings at the shrines.

translation.text: Save that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places.

verses.english:
However, the shrines were not removed; the people continued to
sacrifice and make offerings at the shrines.

verses.hebrew: וַיְנַגַּע יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְהִי מְצֹרָע עַד־יוֹם מֹתוֹ וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּבֵית הַחפְשִׁית וְיוֹתָם בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַבַּיִת שֹׁפֵט אֶת־עַם הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְנַגַּע יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְהִי מְצֹרָע עַד־יוֹם מֹתוֹ וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּבֵית הַחפְשִׁית וְיוֹתָם בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַבַּיִת שֹׁפֵט אֶת־עַם הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
YHWH struck the king with a plague, and he was a leper until the
day of his death; he lived in isolated quarters, while Jotham, the
king’s son, was in charge of the palace and governed the people of
the land.

translation.text: And the LORD smote the king, so that he was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house. And Jotham the king’s son was over the house, judging the people of the land.

verses.english:
YHWH struck the king with a plague, and he was a leper until the
day of his death; he lived in isolated quarters, while Jotham, the
king’s son, was in charge of the palace and governed the people of
the land.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי עֲזַרְיָהוּ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי עֲזַרְיָהוּ וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Azariah’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.english:
The other events of Azariah’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב עֲזַרְיָה עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ יוֹתָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב עֲזַרְיָה עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ יוֹתָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Azariah slept with his fathers, and he was buried with his fathers
in the City of David; his son Jotham succeeded him as king.

translation.text: So Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Azariah slept with his fathers, and he was buried with his fathers
in the City of David; his son Jotham succeeded him as king.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ זְכַרְיָהוּ בֶן־יָרבְעָם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ זְכַרְיָהוּ בֶן־יָרבְעָם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים׃

english.text:
In the thirty-eighth year of King Azariah of Judah, Zechariah son
of Jeroboam became king over Israel in Samaria—for six months.

translation.text: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.

verses.english:
In the thirty-eighth year of King Azariah of Judah, Zechariah son
of Jeroboam became king over Israel in Samaria—for six months.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָיו לֹא סָר מֵחַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָיו לֹא סָר מֵחַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, as his fathers had done; he
did not depart from the sins which Jeroboam son of Nebat had
caused Israel to commit.

translation.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his fathers had done: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, as his fathers had done; he
did not depart from the sins which Jeroboam son of Nebat had
caused Israel to commit.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו שַׁלֻּם בֶּן־יָבֵשׁ וַיַּכֵּהוּ קבל־עָם וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו שַׁלֻּם בֶּן־יָבֵשׁ וַיַּכֵּהוּ קבל־עָם וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against him and struck him down
before the people and killed him, and succeeded him as king.

translation.text: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against him and struck him down
before the people and killed him, and succeeded him as king.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי זְכַרְיָה הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי זְכַרְיָה הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Zechariah’s reign are recorded in the Annals
of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.english:
The other events of Zechariah’s reign are recorded in the Annals
of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: הוּא דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֶל־יֵהוּא לֵאמֹר בְּנֵי רְבִיעִים יֵשְׁבוּ לְךָ עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְהִי־כֵן׃

hebrew.text: הוּא דְבַר־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֶל־יֵהוּא לֵאמֹר בְּנֵי רְבִיעִים יֵשְׁבוּ לְךָ עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְהִי־כֵן׃

english.text:
This was in accord with the word that YHWH had spoken to Jehu:
“Four generations of your descendants shall occupy the throne of
Israel.” And so it came about.

translation.text: This was the word of the LORD which he spake unto Jehu, saying, Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation. And so it came to pass.

verses.english:
This was in accord with the word that YHWH had spoken to Jehu:
“Four generations of your descendants shall occupy the throne of
Israel.” And so it came about.

verses.hebrew: שַׁלּוּם בֶּן־יָבֵישׁ מָלַךְ בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה לְעֻזִּיָּה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ יֶרַח־יָמִים בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: שַׁלּוּם בֶּן־יָבֵישׁ מָלַךְ בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה לְעֻזִּיָּה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ יֶרַח־יָמִים בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
Shallum son of Jabesh became king in the thirty-ninth year of King
Uzziah of Judah, and he reigned in Samaria one month.

translation.text: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.

verses.english:
Shallum son of Jabesh became king in the thirty-ninth year of King
Uzziah of Judah, and he reigned in Samaria one month.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מְנַחֵם בֶּן־גָּדִי מִתִּרְצָה וַיָּבֹא שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיַּךְ אֶת־שַׁלּוּם בֶּן־יָבֵישׁ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל מְנַחֵם בֶּן־גָּדִי מִתִּרְצָה וַיָּבֹא שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיַּךְ אֶת־שַׁלּוּם בֶּן־יָבֵישׁ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃

translation.text: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי שַׁלּוּם וְקִשְׁרוֹ אֲשֶׁר קָשָׁר הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי שַׁלּוּם וְקִשְׁרוֹ אֲשֶׁר קָשָׁר הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Shallum’s reign, and the conspiracy that he
formed, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.english:
The other events of Shallum’s reign, and the conspiracy that he
formed, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: אָז יַכֶּה־מְנַחֵם אֶת־תִּפְסַח וְאֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ וְאֶת־גְּבוּלֶיהָ מִתִּרְצָה כִּי לֹא פָתַח וַיַּךְ אֵת כּל־הֶהָרוֹתֶיהָ בִּקֵּעַ׃

hebrew.text: אָז יַכֶּה־מְנַחֵם אֶת־תִּפְסַח וְאֶת־כּל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ וְאֶת־גְּבוּלֶיהָ מִתִּרְצָה כִּי לֹא פָתַח וַיַּךְ אֵת כּל־הֶהָרוֹתֶיהָ בִּקֵּעַ׃

english.text:
At that time, [marching] from Tirzah, Menahem subdued Tiphsah and
all who were in it, and its territory; and because it did not
surrender, he massacred [its people] and ripped open all its
pregnant women.

translation.text: Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that were therein, and the coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not to him, therefore he smote it; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up.

verses.english:
At that time, [marching] from Tirzah, Menahem subdued Tiphsah and
all who were in it, and its territory; and because it did not
surrender, he massacred [its people] and ripped open all its
pregnant women.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ מְנַחֵם בֶּן־גָּדִי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ מְנַחֵם בֶּן־גָּדִי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃

english.text:
In the thirty-ninth year of King Azariah of Judah, Menahem son of
Gadi became king over Israel in Samaria—for ten years.

translation.text: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel, and reigned ten years in Samaria.

verses.english:
In the thirty-ninth year of King Azariah of Judah, Menahem son of
Gadi became king over Israel in Samaria—for ten years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא סָר מֵעַל חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל־יָמָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא סָר מֵעַל חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כּל־יָמָיו׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; throughout his days he did
not depart from the sins which Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused
Israel to commit.

translation.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; throughout his days he did
not depart from the sins which Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused
Israel to commit.

verses.hebrew: בָּא פוּל מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עַל־הָאָרֶץ וַיִּתֵּן מְנַחֵם לְפוּל אֶלֶף כִּכַּר־כָּסֶף לִהְיוֹת יָדָיו אִתּוֹ לְהַחֲזִיק הַמַּמְלָכָה בְּיָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: בָּא פוּל מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עַל־הָאָרֶץ וַיִּתֵּן מְנַחֵם לְפוּל אֶלֶף כִּכַּר־כָּסֶף לִהְיוֹת יָדָיו אִתּוֹ לְהַחֲזִיק הַמַּמְלָכָה בְּיָדוֹ׃

english.text:
King Pul of Assyria invaded the land, and Menahem gave Pul a
thousand talents of silver that he might support him and
strengthen his hold on the kingdom.

translation.text: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

verses.english:
King Pul of Assyria invaded the land, and Menahem gave Pul a
thousand talents of silver that he might support him and
strengthen his hold on the kingdom.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּצֵא מְנַחֵם אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל כּל־גִּבּוֹרֵי הַחַיִל לָתֵת לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר חֲמִשִּׁים שְׁקָלִים כֶּסֶף לְאִישׁ אֶחָד וַיָּשׁב מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וְלֹא־עָמַד שָׁם
בָּאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּצֵא מְנַחֵם אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל כּל־גִּבּוֹרֵי הַחַיִל לָתֵת לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר חֲמִשִּׁים שְׁקָלִים כֶּסֶף לְאִישׁ אֶחָד וַיָּשׁב מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וְלֹא־עָמַד שָׁם
בָּאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
Menahem exacted the money from Israel: every man of means had to
pay fifty shekels of silver for the king of Assyria. The king of
Assyria withdrew and did not remain in the land.

translation.text: And Menahem exacted the money of Israel, even of all the mighty men of wealth, of each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and stayed not there in the land.

verses.english:
Menahem exacted the money from Israel: every man of means had to
pay fifty shekels of silver for the king of Assyria. The king of
Assyria withdrew and did not remain in the land.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי מְנַחֵם וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי מְנַחֵם וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Menahem’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.english:
The other events of Menahem’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב מְנַחֵם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ פְּקַחְיָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב מְנַחֵם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ פְּקַחְיָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Menahem slept with his fathers, and his son Pekahiah succeeded him
as king.

translation.text: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Menahem slept with his fathers, and his son Pekahiah succeeded him
as king.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ פְּקַחְיָה בֶן־מְנַחֵם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שְׁנָתָיִם׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ פְּקַחְיָה בֶן־מְנַחֵם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שְׁנָתָיִם׃

english.text:
In the fiftieth year of King Azariah of Judah, Pekahiah son of
Menahem became king over Israel in Samaria—for two years.

translation.text: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned two years.

verses.english:
In the fiftieth year of King Azariah of Judah, Pekahiah son of
Menahem became king over Israel in Samaria—for two years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא סָר מֵחַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא סָר מֵחַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; he did not depart from the
sins which Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.

translation.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; he did not depart from the
sins which Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ שָׁלִישׁוֹ וַיַּכֵּהוּ בְשֹׁמְרוֹן בְּאַרְמוֹן בֵּית־[הַמֶּלֶךְ] (מלך) אֶת־אַרְגֹּב וְאֶת־הָאַרְיֵה וְעִמּוֹ חֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי
גִלְעָדִים וַיְמִתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ שָׁלִישׁוֹ וַיַּכֵּהוּ בְשֹׁמְרוֹן בְּאַרְמוֹן בֵּית־[הַמֶּלֶךְ] (מלך) אֶת־אַרְגֹּב וְאֶת־הָאַרְיֵה וְעִמּוֹ חֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי
גִלְעָדִים וַיְמִתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
His aide, Pekah son of Remaliah, conspired against him and struck
him down in the royal palace in Samaria; with him were fifty
Gileadites, with men from Argob and Arieh; and he killed him and
succeeded him as king.

translation.text: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.

verses.english:
His aide, Pekah son of Remaliah, conspired against him and struck
him down in the royal palace in Samaria; with him were fifty
Gileadites, with men from Argob and Arieh; and he killed him and
succeeded him as king.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי פְקַחְיָה וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי פְקַחְיָה וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Pekahiah’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.english:
The other events of Pekahiah’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת חֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת חֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃

english.text:
In the fifty-second year of King Azariah of Judah, Pekah son of
Remaliah became king over Israel and Samaria—for twenty years.

translation.text: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned twenty years.

verses.english:
In the fifty-second year of King Azariah of Judah, Pekah son of
Remaliah became king over Israel and Samaria—for twenty years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא סָר מִן־חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לֹא סָר מִן־חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; he did not depart from the
sins which Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.

translation.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH; he did not depart from the
sins which Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.

verses.hebrew:
בִּימֵי פֶּקַח מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּא תִּגְלַת פִּלְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיִּקַּח אֶת־עִיּוֹן וְאֶת־אָבֵל בֵּית־מַעֲכָה וְאֶת־יָנוֹחַ וְאֶת־קֶדֶשׁ וְאֶת־חָצוֹר וְאֶת־הַגִּלְעָד
וְאֶת־הַגָּלִילָה כֹּל אֶרֶץ נַפְתָּלִי וַיַּגְלֵם אַשּׁוּרָה׃

hebrew.text:
בִּימֵי פֶּקַח מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּא תִּגְלַת פִּלְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיִּקַּח אֶת־עִיּוֹן וְאֶת־אָבֵל בֵּית־מַעֲכָה וְאֶת־יָנוֹחַ וְאֶת־קֶדֶשׁ וְאֶת־חָצוֹר וְאֶת־הַגִּלְעָד
וְאֶת־הַגָּלִילָה כֹּל אֶרֶץ נַפְתָּלִי וַיַּגְלֵם אַשּׁוּרָה׃

english.text:
In the days of King Pekah of Israel, King Tiglath-pileser of
Assyria came and captured Ijon, Abel- beth-maacah, Janoah, Kedesh,
Hazor—Gilead, Galilee, the entire region of Naphtali; and he
deported the inhabitants to Assyria.

translation.text: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abelbethmaachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.

verses.english:
In the days of King Pekah of Israel, King Tiglath-pileser of
Assyria came and captured Ijon, Abel- beth-maacah, Janoah, Kedesh,
Hazor—Gilead, Galilee, the entire region of Naphtali; and he
deported the inhabitants to Assyria.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשׁר־קֶשֶׁר הוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־אֵלָה עַל־פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים לְיוֹתָם בֶּן־עֻזִּיָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְשׁר־קֶשֶׁר הוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־אֵלָה עַל־פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים לְיוֹתָם בֶּן־עֻזִּיָּה׃

english.text:
Hoshea son of Elah conspired against Pekah son of Remaliah,
attacked him, and killed him. He succeeded him as king in the
twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah.

translation.text: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

verses.english:
Hoshea son of Elah conspired against Pekah son of Remaliah,
attacked him, and killed him. He succeeded him as king in the
twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי־פֶקַח וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי־פֶקַח וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The other events of Pekah’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

translation.text: And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.english:
The other events of Pekah’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְפֶקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ יוֹתָם בֶּן־עֻזִּיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְפֶקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ יוֹתָם בֶּן־עֻזִּיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
In the second year of King Pekah son of Remaliah of Israel, Jotham
son of King Uzziah of Judah became king.

translation.text: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign.

verses.english:
In the second year of King Pekah son of Remaliah of Israel, Jotham
son of King Uzziah of Judah became king.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמלְכוֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ יְרוּשָׁא בַּת־צָדוֹק׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמלְכוֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ יְרוּשָׁא בַּת־צָדוֹק׃

english.text:
He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned
sixteen years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Jerusha daughter
of Zadok.

translation.text: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.

verses.english:
He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned
sixteen years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Jerusha daughter
of Zadok.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה עֻזִּיָּהוּ אָבִיו עָשָׂה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה עֻזִּיָּהוּ אָבִיו עָשָׂה׃

english.text:
He did what was pleasing to YHWH, just as his father Uzziah had
done.

translation.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD: he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.

verses.english:
He did what was pleasing to YHWH, just as his father Uzziah had
done.

verses.hebrew: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת הוּא בָּנָה אֶת־שַׁעַר בֵּית־יְהֹוָה הָעֶלְיוֹן׃

hebrew.text: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת הוּא בָּנָה אֶת־שַׁעַר בֵּית־יְהֹוָה הָעֶלְיוֹן׃

english.text:
However, the shrines were not removed; the people continued to
sacrifice and make offerings at the shrines. It was he who built
the Upper Gate of the House of YHWH.

translation.text: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
However, the shrines were not removed; the people continued to
sacrifice and make offerings at the shrines. It was he who built
the Upper Gate of the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Jotham’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.english:
The other events of Jotham’s reign, and all his actions, are
recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

verses.hebrew: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם הֵחֵל יְהֹוָה לְהַשְׁלִיחַ בִּיהוּדָה רְצִין מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וְאֵת פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ׃

hebrew.text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם הֵחֵל יְהֹוָה לְהַשְׁלִיחַ בִּיהוּדָה רְצִין מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וְאֵת פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ׃

english.text:
In those days, YHWH began to incite King Rezin of Aram and Pekah
son of Remaliah against Judah.

translation.text: In those days the LORD began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.

verses.english:
In those days, YHWH began to incite King Rezin of Aram and Pekah
son of Remaliah against Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יוֹתָם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ אָחָז בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יוֹתָם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ אָחָז בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Jotham slept with his fathers, and he was buried with his fathers
in the city of his ancestor David; his son Ahaz succeeded him as
king.

translation.text: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Jotham slept with his fathers, and he was buried with his fathers
in the city of his ancestor David; his son Ahaz succeeded him as
king.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁבַע־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לְפֶקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ מָלַךְ אָחָז בֶּן־יוֹתָם מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁבַע־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לְפֶקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ מָלַךְ אָחָז בֶּן־יוֹתָם מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of King
Jotham of Judah became king.

translation.text: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

verses.english:
In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of King
Jotham of Judah became king.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה אָחָז בְּמלְכוֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְלֹא־עָשָׂה הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו כְּדָוִד אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה אָחָז בְּמלְכוֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְלֹא־עָשָׂה הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו כְּדָוִד אָבִיו׃

english.text:
Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned
sixteen years in Jerusalem. He did not do what was pleasing to
YHWH his God, as his ancestor David had done,

translation.text: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not that which was right in the sight of the LORD his God, like David his father.

verses.english:
Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned
sixteen years in Jerusalem. He did not do what was pleasing to
YHWH his God, as his ancestor David had done,

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגַם אֶת־בְּנוֹ הֶעֱבִיר בָּאֵשׁ כְּתֹעֲבוֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה אֹתָם מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגַם אֶת־בְּנוֹ הֶעֱבִיר בָּאֵשׁ כְּתֹעֲבוֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה אֹתָם מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
but followed the ways of the kings of Israel. He even consigned
his son to the fire, in the abhorrent fashion of the nations which
YHWH had dispossessed before the Israelites.

translation.text: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.

verses.english:
but followed the ways of the kings of Israel. He even consigned
his son to the fire, in the abhorrent fashion of the nations which
YHWH had dispossessed before the Israelites.

verses.hebrew: וַיְזַבֵּחַ וַיְקַטֵּר בַּבָּמוֹת וְעַל־הַגְּבָעוֹת וְתַחַת כּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיְזַבֵּחַ וַיְקַטֵּר בַּבָּמוֹת וְעַל־הַגְּבָעוֹת וְתַחַת כּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן׃

english.text:
He sacrificed and made offerings at the shrines, on the hills, and
under every leafy tree.

translation.text: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

verses.english:
He sacrificed and made offerings at the shrines, on the hills, and
under every leafy tree.

verses.hebrew: אָז יַעֲלֶה רְצִין מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וּפֶקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיָּצֻרוּ עַל־אָחָז וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהִלָּחֵם׃

hebrew.text: אָז יַעֲלֶה רְצִין מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וּפֶקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיָּצֻרוּ עַל־אָחָז וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהִלָּחֵם׃

english.text:
Then King Rezin of Aram and King Pekah son of Remaliah of Israel
advanced on Jerusalem for battle. They besieged Ahaz, but could
not overcome [him].

translation.text: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.

verses.english:
Then King Rezin of Aram and King Pekah son of Remaliah of Israel
advanced on Jerusalem for battle. They besieged Ahaz, but could
not overcome [him].

verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא הֵשִׁיב רְצִין מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם אֶת־אֵילַת לַאֲרָם וַיְנַשֵּׁל אֶת־הַיְּהוּדִים מֵאֵילוֹת (וארמים) [וַאֲדֹמִים] בָּאוּ אֵילַת וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: בָּעֵת הַהִיא הֵשִׁיב רְצִין מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם אֶת־אֵילַת לַאֲרָם וַיְנַשֵּׁל אֶת־הַיְּהוּדִים מֵאֵילוֹת (וארמים) [וַאֲדֹמִים] בָּאוּ אֵילַת וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
At that time King Rezin of Aram recovered Elath for Aram; he drove
out the Judites from Elath, and Edomites came to Elath and settled
there, as is still the case.

translation.text: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Jews from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there unto this day.

verses.english:
At that time King Rezin of Aram recovered Elath for Aram; he drove
out the Judites from Elath, and Edomites came to Elath and settled
there, as is still the case.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח אָחָז מַלְאָכִים אֶל־תִּגְלַת פְּלֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר לֵאמֹר עַבְדְּךָ וּבִנְךָ אָנִי עֲלֵה וְהוֹשִׁעֵנִי מִכַּף מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וּמִכַּף מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַקּוֹמִים
עָלָי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח אָחָז מַלְאָכִים אֶל־תִּגְלַת פְּלֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר לֵאמֹר עַבְדְּךָ וּבִנְךָ אָנִי עֲלֵה וְהוֹשִׁעֵנִי מִכַּף מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וּמִכַּף מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַקּוֹמִים
עָלָי׃

english.text:
Ahaz sent messengers to King Tiglath-pileser of Assyria to say, “I
am your servant and your son; come and deliver me from the hands
of the king of Aram and from the hands of the king of Israel, who
are attacking me.”

translation.text: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, saying, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, which rise up against me.

verses.english:
Ahaz sent messengers to King Tiglath-pileser of Assyria to say, “I
am your servant and your son; come and deliver me from the hands
of the king of Aram and from the hands of the king of Israel, who
are attacking me.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אָחָז אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב הַנִּמְצָא בֵּית יְהֹוָה וּבְאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח לְמֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר שֹׁחַד׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח אָחָז אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב הַנִּמְצָא בֵּית יְהֹוָה וּבְאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח לְמֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר שֹׁחַד׃

english.text:
Ahaz took the gold and silver that were on hand in the House of
YHWH and in the treasuries of the royal palace and sent them as a
gift to the king of Assyria.

translation.text: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.

verses.english:
Ahaz took the gold and silver that were on hand in the House of
YHWH and in the treasuries of the royal palace and sent them as a
gift to the king of Assyria.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֵלָיו מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיַּעַל מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר אֶל־דַּמֶּשֶׂק וַיִּתְפְּשֶׂהָ וַיַּגְלֶהָ קִירָה וְאֶת־רְצִין הֵמִית׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֵלָיו מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיַּעַל מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר אֶל־דַּמֶּשֶׂק וַיִּתְפְּשֶׂהָ וַיַּגְלֶהָ קִירָה וְאֶת־רְצִין הֵמִית׃

english.text:
The king of Assyria responded to his request; the king of Assyria
marched against Damascus and captured it. He deported its
inhabitants to Kir and put Rezin to death.

translation.text: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.

verses.english:
The king of Assyria responded to his request; the king of Assyria
marched against Damascus and captured it. He deported its
inhabitants to Kir and put Rezin to death.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז לִקְרַאת תִּגְלַת פִּלְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר דּוּמֶּשֶׂק וַיַּרְא אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר בְּדַמָּשֶׂק וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז אֶל־אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן
אֶת־דְּמוּת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת־תַּבְנִיתוֹ לְכל־מַעֲשֵׂהוּ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז לִקְרַאת תִּגְלַת פִּלְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר דּוּמֶּשֶׂק וַיַּרְא אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר בְּדַמָּשֶׂק וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז אֶל־אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן
אֶת־דְּמוּת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת־תַּבְנִיתוֹ לְכל־מַעֲשֵׂהוּ׃

english.text:
When King Ahaz went to Damascus to greet King Tiglath-pileser of
Assyria, he saw the altar in Damascus. King Ahaz sent the priest
Uriah a sketch of the altar and a detailed plan of its
construction.

translation.text: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.

verses.english:
When King Ahaz went to Damascus to greet King Tiglath-pileser of
Assyria, he saw the altar in Damascus. King Ahaz sent the priest
Uriah a sketch of the altar and a detailed plan of its
construction.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז מִדַּמֶּשֶׂק כֵּן עָשָׂה אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן עַד־בּוֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ־אָחָז מִדַּמָּשֶׂק׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז מִדַּמֶּשֶׂק כֵּן עָשָׂה אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן עַד־בּוֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ־אָחָז מִדַּמָּשֶׂק׃

english.text:
The priest Uriah did just as King Ahaz had instructed him from
Damascus; the priest Uriah built the altar before King Ahaz
returned from Damascus.

translation.text: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.

verses.english:
The priest Uriah did just as King Ahaz had instructed him from
Damascus; the priest Uriah built the altar before King Ahaz
returned from Damascus.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ מִדַּמֶּשֶׂק וַיַּרְא הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרַב הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיַּעַל עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ מִדַּמֶּשֶׂק וַיַּרְא הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרַב הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיַּעַל עָלָיו׃

english.text:
When the king returned from Damascus, and when the king saw the
altar, the king drew near the altar, ascended it,

translation.text: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.

verses.english:
When the king returned from Damascus, and when the king saw the
altar, the king drew near the altar, ascended it,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְטֵר אֶת־עֹלָתוֹ וְאֶת־מִנְחָתוֹ וַיַּסֵּךְ אֶת־נִסְכּוֹ וַיִּזְרֹק אֶת־דַּם־הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּקְטֵר אֶת־עֹלָתוֹ וְאֶת־מִנְחָתוֹ וַיַּסֵּךְ אֶת־נִסְכּוֹ וַיִּזְרֹק אֶת־דַּם־הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

english.text:
and offered his burnt offering and meal offering; he poured his
libation, and he dashed the blood of his offering of well-being
against the altar.

translation.text: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.

verses.english:
and offered his burnt offering and meal offering; he poured his
libation, and he dashed the blood of his offering of well-being
against the altar.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת הַמִּזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיַּקְרֵב מֵאֵת פְּנֵי הַבַּיִת מִבֵּין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמִבֵּין בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיִּתֵּן אֹתוֹ עַל־יֶרֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ צָפוֹנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת הַמִּזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיַּקְרֵב מֵאֵת פְּנֵי הַבַּיִת מִבֵּין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמִבֵּין בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיִּתֵּן אֹתוֹ עַל־יֶרֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ צָפוֹנָה׃

english.text:
As for the bronze altar which had been before YHWH, he moved it
from its place in front of the Temple, between the [new] altar and
the House of YHWH, and placed it on the north side of the [new]
altar.

translation.text: And he brought also the brasen altar, which was before the LORD, from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of the LORD, and put it on the north side of the altar.

verses.english:
As for the bronze altar which had been before YHWH, he moved it
from its place in front of the Temple, between the [new] altar and
the House of YHWH, and placed it on the north side of the [new]
altar.

verses.hebrew:
(ויצוהו) [וַיְצַוֶּה] הַמֶּלֶךְ־אָחָז אֶת־אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן לֵאמֹר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַגָּדוֹל הַקְטֵר אֶת־עֹלַת־הַבֹּקֶר וְאֶת־מִנְחַת הָעֶרֶב וְאֶת־עֹלַת הַמֶּלֶךְ
וְאֶת־מִנְחָתוֹ וְאֵת עֹלַת כּל־עַם הָאָרֶץ וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם וְכל־דַּם עֹלָה וְכל־דַּם־זֶבַח עָלָיו תִּזְרֹק וּמִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת יִהְיֶה־לִּי לְבַקֵּר׃

hebrew.text:
(ויצוהו) [וַיְצַוֶּה] הַמֶּלֶךְ־אָחָז אֶת־אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן לֵאמֹר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַגָּדוֹל הַקְטֵר אֶת־עֹלַת־הַבֹּקֶר וְאֶת־מִנְחַת הָעֶרֶב וְאֶת־עֹלַת הַמֶּלֶךְ
וְאֶת־מִנְחָתוֹ וְאֵת עֹלַת כּל־עַם הָאָרֶץ וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם וְכל־דַּם עֹלָה וְכל־דַּם־זֶבַח עָלָיו תִּזְרֹק וּמִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת יִהְיֶה־לִּי לְבַקֵּר׃

english.text:
And King Ahaz commanded the priest Uriah: “On the great altar you
shall offer the morning burnt offering and the evening meal
offering and the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with
the burnt offerings of all the people of the land, their meal
offerings and their libations. And against it you shall dash the
blood of all the burnt offerings and all the blood of the
