sacrifices. And I will decide about the bronze altar.”

translation.text: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king’s burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire by.

verses.english:
And King Ahaz commanded the priest Uriah: “On the great altar you
shall offer the morning burnt offering and the evening meal
offering and the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with
the burnt offerings of all the people of the land, their meal
offerings and their libations. And against it you shall dash the
blood of all the burnt offerings and all the blood of the
sacrifices. And I will decide about the bronze altar.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז׃

english.text: Uriah did just as King Ahaz commanded.

translation.text: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.

verses.english: Uriah did just as King Ahaz commanded.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְקַצֵּץ הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז אֶת־הַמִּסְגְּרוֹת הַמְּכוֹנֹת וַיָּסַר מֵעֲלֵיהֶם (ואת) [אֶת־]הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת־הַיָּם הוֹרִד מֵעַל הַבָּקָר הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֶּיהָ וַיִּתֵּן
אֹתוֹ עַל מַרְצֶפֶת אֲבָנִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְקַצֵּץ הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז אֶת־הַמִּסְגְּרוֹת הַמְּכוֹנֹת וַיָּסַר מֵעֲלֵיהֶם (ואת) [אֶת־]הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת־הַיָּם הוֹרִד מֵעַל הַבָּקָר הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֶּיהָ וַיִּתֵּן
אֹתוֹ עַל מַרְצֶפֶת אֲבָנִים׃

english.text:
King Ahaz cut off the insets—the laver stands—and removed the
lavers from them. He also removed the tank from the bronze oxen
that supported it and set it on a stone pavement—

translation.text: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it, and put it upon the pavement of stones.

verses.english:
King Ahaz cut off the insets—the laver stands—and removed the
lavers from them. He also removed the tank from the bronze oxen
that supported it and set it on a stone pavement—

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־[מוּסַךְ] (מיסך) הַשַּׁבָּת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנוּ בַבַּיִת וְאֶת־מְבוֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ הַחִיצוֹנָה הֵסֵב בֵּית יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־[מוּסַךְ] (מיסך) הַשַּׁבָּת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנוּ בַבַּיִת וְאֶת־מְבוֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ הַחִיצוֹנָה הֵסֵב בֵּית יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

english.text:
on account of the king of Assyria. He also extended to the House
of YHWH the sabbath passage that had been built in the palace and
the king’s outer entrance.

translation.text: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s entry without, turned he from the house of the LORD for the king of Assyria.

verses.english:
on account of the king of Assyria. He also extended to the House
of YHWH the sabbath passage that had been built in the palace and
the king’s outer entrance.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אָחָז אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אָחָז אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Ahaz’s reign, and his actions, are recorded in
the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.english:
The other events of Ahaz’s reign, and his actions, are recorded in
the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אָחָז עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אָחָז עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Ahaz slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the
City of David; his son Hezekiah succeeded him as king.

translation.text: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Ahaz slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the
City of David; his son Hezekiah succeeded him as king.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה לְאָחָז מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ הוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־אֵלָה בְשֹׁמְרוֹן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל תֵּשַׁע שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה לְאָחָז מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ הוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־אֵלָה בְשֹׁמְרוֹן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל תֵּשַׁע שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
In the twelfth year of King Ahaz of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah
became king over Israel in Samaria—for nine years.

translation.text: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.

verses.english:
In the twelfth year of King Ahaz of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah
became king over Israel in Samaria—for nine years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה רַק לֹא כְּמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה רַק לֹא כְּמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, though not as much as the
kings of Israel who preceded him.

translation.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, though not as much as the
kings of Israel who preceded him.

verses.hebrew: עָלָיו עָלָה שַׁלְמַנְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיְהִי־לוֹ הוֹשֵׁעַ עֶבֶד וַיָּשֶׁב לוֹ מִנְחָה׃

hebrew.text: עָלָיו עָלָה שַׁלְמַנְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיְהִי־לוֹ הוֹשֵׁעַ עֶבֶד וַיָּשֶׁב לוֹ מִנְחָה׃

english.text:
King Shalmaneser marched against him, and Hoshea became his vassal
and paid him tribute.

translation.text: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.

verses.english:
King Shalmaneser marched against him, and Hoshea became his vassal
and paid him tribute.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּמְצָא מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר בְּהוֹשֵׁעַ קֶשֶׁר אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־סוֹא מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם וְלֹא־הֶעֱלָה מִנְחָה לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר כְּשָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה וַיַּעְצְרֵהוּ מֶלֶךְ
אַשּׁוּר וַיַּאַסְרֵהוּ בֵּית כֶּלֶא׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּמְצָא מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר בְּהוֹשֵׁעַ קֶשֶׁר אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־סוֹא מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם וְלֹא־הֶעֱלָה מִנְחָה לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר כְּשָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה וַיַּעְצְרֵהוּ מֶלֶךְ
אַשּׁוּר וַיַּאַסְרֵהוּ בֵּית כֶּלֶא׃

english.text:
But the king of Assyria caught Hoshea in an act of treachery: he
had sent envoys to King So of Egypt, and he had not paid the
tribute to the king of Assyria, as in previous years. And the king
of Assyria arrested him and put him in prison.

translation.text: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.

verses.english:
But the king of Assyria caught Hoshea in an act of treachery: he
had sent envoys to King So of Egypt, and he had not paid the
tribute to the king of Assyria, as in previous years. And the king
of Assyria arrested him and put him in prison.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר בְּכל־הָאָרֶץ וַיַּעַל שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיָּצַר עָלֶיהָ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַל מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר בְּכל־הָאָרֶץ וַיַּעַל שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיָּצַר עָלֶיהָ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים׃

english.text:
Then the king of Assyria marched against the whole land; he came
to Samaria and besieged it for three years.

translation.text: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

verses.english:
Then the king of Assyria marched against the whole land; he came
to Samaria and besieged it for three years.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת הַתְּשִׁעִית לְהוֹשֵׁעַ לָכַד מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֶת־שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיֶּגֶל אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַשּׁוּרָה וַיֹּשֶׁב אוֹתָם בַּחְלַח וּבְחָבוֹר נְהַר גּוֹזָן וְעָרֵי מָדָי׃

hebrew.text: בִּשְׁנַת הַתְּשִׁעִית לְהוֹשֵׁעַ לָכַד מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֶת־שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיֶּגֶל אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַשּׁוּרָה וַיֹּשֶׁב אוֹתָם בַּחְלַח וּבְחָבוֹר נְהַר גּוֹזָן וְעָרֵי מָדָי׃

english.text:
In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria.
He deported the Israelites to Assyria and settled them in Halah,
at the [River] Habor, at the River Gozan, and in the towns of
Media.

translation.text: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

verses.english:
In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria.
He deported the Israelites to Assyria and settled them in Halah,
at the [River] Habor, at the River Gozan, and in the towns of
Media.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי־חָטְאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הַמַּעֲלֶה אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִתַּחַת יַד פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרָיִם וַיִּירְאוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּי־חָטְאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הַמַּעֲלֶה אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִתַּחַת יַד פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרָיִם וַיִּירְאוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

english.text:
This happened because the Israelites sinned against YHWH their
God, who had freed them from the land of Egypt, from the hand of
Pharaoh king of Egypt. They worshiped other gods

translation.text: For so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

verses.english:
This happened because the Israelites sinned against YHWH their
God, who had freed them from the land of Egypt, from the hand of
Pharaoh king of Egypt. They worshiped other gods

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּחֻקּוֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּחֻקּוֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ׃

english.text:
and followed the customs of the nations which YHWH had
dispossessed before the Israelites and the customs which the kings
of Israel had practiced.

translation.text: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.

verses.english:
and followed the customs of the nations which YHWH had
dispossessed before the Israelites and the customs which the kings
of Israel had practiced.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַפְּאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־כֵן עַל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיִּבְנוּ לָהֶם בָּמוֹת בְּכל־עָרֵיהֶם מִמִּגְדַּל נוֹצְרִים עַד־עִיר מִבְצָר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחַפְּאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־כֵן עַל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיִּבְנוּ לָהֶם בָּמוֹת בְּכל־עָרֵיהֶם מִמִּגְדַּל נוֹצְרִים עַד־עִיר מִבְצָר׃

translation.text: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the LORD their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּצִּבוּ לָהֶם מַצֵּבוֹת וַאֲשֵׁרִים עַל כּל־גִּבְעָה גְבֹהָה וְתַחַת כּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּצִּבוּ לָהֶם מַצֵּבוֹת וַאֲשֵׁרִים עַל כּל־גִּבְעָה גְבֹהָה וְתַחַת כּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן׃

english.text:
they set up pillars and sacred posts for themselves on every lofty
hill and under every leafy tree;

translation.text: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:

verses.english:
they set up pillars and sacred posts for themselves on every lofty
hill and under every leafy tree;

verses.hebrew: וַיְקַטְּרוּ־שָׁם בְּכל־בָּמוֹת כַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר־הֶגְלָה יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ דְּבָרִים רָעִים לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְקַטְּרוּ־שָׁם בְּכל־בָּמוֹת כַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר־הֶגְלָה יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ דְּבָרִים רָעִים לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
and they offered sacrifices there, at all the shrines, like the
nations whom YHWH had driven into exile before them. They
committed wicked acts to vex YHWH,

translation.text: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom the LORD carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger:

verses.english:
and they offered sacrifices there, at all the shrines, like the
nations whom YHWH had driven into exile before them. They
committed wicked acts to vex YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְדוּ הַגִּלֻּלִים אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה לָהֶם לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַבְדוּ הַגִּלֻּלִים אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה לָהֶם לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
and they worshiped fetishes concerning which YHWH had said to
them, “You must not do this thing.”

translation.text: For they served idols, whereof the LORD had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.

verses.english:
and they worshiped fetishes concerning which YHWH had said to
them, “You must not do this thing.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּעַד יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִיהוּדָה בְּיַד כּל־[נְבִיאֵי] (נביאו) כל־חֹזֶה לֵאמֹר שֻׁבוּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶם הָרָעִים וְשִׁמְרוּ מִצְוֺתַי חֻקּוֹתַי כְּכל־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר
צִוִּיתִי אֶת־אֲבֹתֵיכֶם וַאֲשֶׁר שָׁלַחְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם בְּיַד עֲבָדַי הַנְּבִיאִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּעַד יְהֹוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִיהוּדָה בְּיַד כּל־[נְבִיאֵי] (נביאו) כל־חֹזֶה לֵאמֹר שֻׁבוּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶם הָרָעִים וְשִׁמְרוּ מִצְוֺתַי חֻקּוֹתַי כְּכל־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר
צִוִּיתִי אֶת־אֲבֹתֵיכֶם וַאֲשֶׁר שָׁלַחְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם בְּיַד עֲבָדַי הַנְּבִיאִים׃

english.text:
YHWH warned Israel and Judah by every prophet [and] every seer,
saying: “Turn back from your wicked ways, and observe My
commandments and My laws, according to all the Teaching that I
commanded your fathers and that I transmitted to you through My
servants the prophets.”

translation.text: Yet the LORD testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.

verses.english:
YHWH warned Israel and Judah by every prophet [and] every seer,
saying: “Turn back from your wicked ways, and observe My
commandments and My laws, according to all the Teaching that I
commanded your fathers and that I transmitted to you through My
servants the prophets.”

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ וַיַּקְשׁוּ אֶת־ערְפָּם כְּעֹרֶף אֲבוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ וַיַּקְשׁוּ אֶת־ערְפָּם כְּעֹרֶף אֲבוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
But they did not obey; they stiffened their necks, like their
fathers who did not have faith in YHWH their God;

translation.text: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the LORD their God.

verses.english:
But they did not obey; they stiffened their necks, like their
fathers who did not have faith in YHWH their God;

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּמְאֲסוּ אֶת־חֻקָּיו וְאֶת־בְּרִיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם וְאֵת עֵדְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר הֵעִיד בָּם וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי הַהֶבֶל וַיֶּהְבָּלוּ וְאַחֲרֵי הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר
סְבִיבֹתָם אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתָם לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת כָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּמְאֲסוּ אֶת־חֻקָּיו וְאֶת־בְּרִיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם וְאֵת עֵדְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר הֵעִיד בָּם וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי הַהֶבֶל וַיֶּהְבָּלוּ וְאַחֲרֵי הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר
סְבִיבֹתָם אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתָם לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת כָּהֶם׃

english.text:
they spurned His laws and the covenant that He had made with their
fathers, and the warnings He had given them. They went after
delusion and were deluded; [they imitated] the nations that were
about them, which YHWH had forbidden them to emulate.

translation.text: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that were round about them, concerning whom the LORD had charged them, that they should not do like them.

verses.english:
they spurned His laws and the covenant that He had made with their
fathers, and the warnings He had given them. They went after
delusion and were deluded; [they imitated] the nations that were
about them, which YHWH had forbidden them to emulate.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־כּל־מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם מַסֵּכָה (שנים) [שְׁנֵי] עֲגָלִים וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֲשֵׁירָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְכל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיַּעַבְדוּ
אֶת־הַבָּעַל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־כּל־מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם מַסֵּכָה (שנים) [שְׁנֵי] עֲגָלִים וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֲשֵׁירָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְכל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיַּעַבְדוּ
אֶת־הַבָּעַל׃

english.text:
They rejected all the commandments of YHWH their God; they made
molten idols for themselves—two calves—and they made a sacred post
and they bowed down to all the host of heaven, and they worshiped
Baal.

translation.text: And they left all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.

verses.english:
They rejected all the commandments of YHWH their God; they made
molten idols for themselves—two calves—and they made a sacred post
and they bowed down to all the host of heaven, and they worshiped
Baal.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבִירוּ אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם בָּאֵשׁ וַיִּקְסְמוּ קְסָמִים וַיְנַחֵשׁוּ וַיִּתְמַכְּרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲבִירוּ אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם בָּאֵשׁ וַיִּקְסְמוּ קְסָמִים וַיְנַחֵשׁוּ וַיִּתְמַכְּרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ׃

english.text:
They consigned their sons and daughters to the fire; they
practiced augury and divination, and gave themselves over to what
was displeasing to YHWH and vexed Him.

translation.text: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.

verses.english:
They consigned their sons and daughters to the fire; they
practiced augury and divination, and gave themselves over to what
was displeasing to YHWH and vexed Him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְאַנַּף יְהֹוָה מְאֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְסִרֵם מֵעַל פָּנָיו לֹא נִשְׁאַר רַק שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה לְבַדּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְאַנַּף יְהֹוָה מְאֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְסִרֵם מֵעַל פָּנָיו לֹא נִשְׁאַר רַק שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה לְבַדּוֹ׃

english.text:
YHWH was incensed at Israel and He banished them from His
presence; none was left but the tribe of Judah alone.

translation.text: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

verses.english:
YHWH was incensed at Israel and He banished them from His
presence; none was left but the tribe of Judah alone.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־יְהוּדָה לֹא שָׁמַר אֶת־מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּחֻקּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: גַּם־יְהוּדָה לֹא שָׁמַר אֶת־מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּחֻקּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ׃

english.text:
Nor did Judah keep the commandments of YHWH their God; they
followed the customs that Israel had practiced.

translation.text: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the LORD their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.

verses.english:
Nor did Judah keep the commandments of YHWH their God; they
followed the customs that Israel had practiced.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְאַס יְהֹוָה בְּכל־זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְעַנֵּם וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־שֹׁסִים עַד אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלִיכָם מִפָּנָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמְאַס יְהֹוָה בְּכל־זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְעַנֵּם וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־שֹׁסִים עַד אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלִיכָם מִפָּנָיו׃

english.text:
So YHWH spurned all the offspring of Israel, and He afflicted them
and delivered them into the hands of plunderers, and finally He
cast them out from His presence.

translation.text: And the LORD rejected all the seed of Israel, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.

verses.english:
So YHWH spurned all the offspring of Israel, and He afflicted them
and delivered them into the hands of plunderers, and finally He
cast them out from His presence.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־קָרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל בֵּית דָּוִד וַיַּמְלִיכוּ אֶת־יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט (וידא) [וַיַּדַּח] יָרבְעָם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וְהֶחֱטִיאָם חֲטָאָה גְדוֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: כִּי־קָרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל בֵּית דָּוִד וַיַּמְלִיכוּ אֶת־יָרבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט (וידא) [וַיַּדַּח] יָרבְעָם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהֹוָה וְהֶחֱטִיאָם חֲטָאָה גְדוֹלָה׃

english.text:
For Israel broke away from the House of David, and they made
Jeroboam son of Nebat king. Jeroboam caused Israel to stray from
YHWH and to commit great sin,

translation.text: For he rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the LORD, and made them sin a great sin.

verses.english:
For Israel broke away from the House of David, and they made
Jeroboam son of Nebat king. Jeroboam caused Israel to stray from
YHWH and to commit great sin,

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל־חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לֹא־סָרוּ מִמֶּנָּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל־חַטֹּאות יָרבְעָם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לֹא־סָרוּ מִמֶּנָּה׃

english.text:
and the Israelites persisted in all the sins which Jeroboam had
committed; they did not depart from them.

translation.text: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;

verses.english:
and the Israelites persisted in all the sins which Jeroboam had
committed; they did not depart from them.

verses.hebrew: עַד אֲשֶׁר־הֵסִיר יְהֹוָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל פָּנָיו כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד כּל־עֲבָדָיו הַנְּבִיאִים וַיִּגֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל אַדְמָתוֹ אַשּׁוּרָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: עַד אֲשֶׁר־הֵסִיר יְהֹוָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל פָּנָיו כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד כּל־עֲבָדָיו הַנְּבִיאִים וַיִּגֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל אַדְמָתוֹ אַשּׁוּרָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
In the end, YHWH removed Israel from His presence, as He had
warned them through all His servants the prophets. So the
Israelites were deported from their land to Assyria, as is still
the case.

translation.text: Until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.

verses.english:
In the end, YHWH removed Israel from His presence, as He had
warned them through all His servants the prophets. So the
Israelites were deported from their land to Assyria, as is still
the case.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֵא מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר מִבָּבֶל וּמִכּוּתָה וּמֵעַוָּא וּמֵחֲמָת וּסְפַרְוַיִם וַיֹּשֶׁב בְּעָרֵי שֹׁמְרוֹן תַּחַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּרְשׁוּ אֶת־שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיֵּשְׁבוּ
בְּעָרֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֵא מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר מִבָּבֶל וּמִכּוּתָה וּמֵעַוָּא וּמֵחֲמָת וּסְפַרְוַיִם וַיֹּשֶׁב בְּעָרֵי שֹׁמְרוֹן תַּחַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּרְשׁוּ אֶת־שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיֵּשְׁבוּ
בְּעָרֶיהָ׃

english.text:
The king of Assyria brought [people] from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva,
Hamath, and Sepharvaim, and he settled them in the towns of
Samaria in place of the Israelites; they took possession of
Samaria and dwelt in its towns.

translation.text: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.

verses.english:
The king of Assyria brought [people] from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva,
Hamath, and Sepharvaim, and he settled them in the towns of
Samaria in place of the Israelites; they took possession of
Samaria and dwelt in its towns.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּתְחִלַּת שִׁבְתָּם שָׁם לֹא יָרְאוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהֹוָה בָּהֶם אֶת־הָאֲרָיוֹת וַיִּהְיוּ הֹרְגִים בָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּתְחִלַּת שִׁבְתָּם שָׁם לֹא יָרְאוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהֹוָה בָּהֶם אֶת־הָאֲרָיוֹת וַיִּהְיוּ הֹרְגִים בָּהֶם׃

english.text:
When they first settled there, they did not worship YHWH; so YHWH
sent lions against them which killed some of them.

translation.text: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they feared not the LORD: therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which slew some of them.

verses.english:
When they first settled there, they did not worship YHWH; so YHWH
sent lions against them which killed some of them.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר לֵאמֹר הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִגְלִיתָ וַתּוֹשֶׁב בְּעָרֵי שֹׁמְרוֹן לֹא יָדְעוּ אֶת־מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ וַיְשַׁלַּח־בָּם אֶת־הָאֲרָיוֹת וְהִנָּם
מְמִיתִים אוֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר אֵינָם יֹדְעִים אֶת־מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר לֵאמֹר הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִגְלִיתָ וַתּוֹשֶׁב בְּעָרֵי שֹׁמְרוֹן לֹא יָדְעוּ אֶת־מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ וַיְשַׁלַּח־בָּם אֶת־הָאֲרָיוֹת וְהִנָּם
מְמִיתִים אוֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר אֵינָם יֹדְעִים אֶת־מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
They said to the king of Assyria: “The nations which you deported
and resettled in the towns of Samaria do not know the rules of the
God of the land; therefore He has let lions loose against them
which are killing them—for they do not know the rules of the God
of the land.”

translation.text: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.

verses.english:
They said to the king of Assyria: “The nations which you deported
and resettled in the towns of Samaria do not know the rules of the
God of the land; therefore He has let lions loose against them
which are killing them—for they do not know the rules of the God
of the land.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר לֵאמֹר הֹלִיכוּ שָׁמָּה אֶחָד מֵהַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר הִגְלִיתֶם מִשָּׁם וְיֵלְכוּ וְיֵשְׁבוּ שָׁם וְיֹרֵם אֶת־מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר לֵאמֹר הֹלִיכוּ שָׁמָּה אֶחָד מֵהַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר הִגְלִיתֶם מִשָּׁם וְיֵלְכוּ וְיֵשְׁבוּ שָׁם וְיֹרֵם אֶת־מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
The king of Assyria gave an order: “Send there one of the priests
whom you have deported; let him go and dwell there, and let him
teach them the practices of the God of the land.”

translation.text: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.

verses.english:
The king of Assyria gave an order: “Send there one of the priests
whom you have deported; let him go and dwell there, and let him
teach them the practices of the God of the land.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֶחָד מֵהַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר הִגְלוּ מִשֹּׁמְרוֹן וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּבֵית־אֵל וַיְהִי מוֹרֶה אֹתָם אֵיךְ יִירְאוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֶחָד מֵהַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר הִגְלוּ מִשֹּׁמְרוֹן וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּבֵית־אֵל וַיְהִי מוֹרֶה אֹתָם אֵיךְ יִירְאוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
So one of the priests whom they had exiled from Samaria came and
settled in Bethel; he taught them how to worship YHWH.

translation.text: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the LORD.

verses.english:
So one of the priests whom they had exiled from Samaria came and
settled in Bethel; he taught them how to worship YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ עֹשִׂים גּוֹי גּוֹי אֱלֹהָיו וַיַּנִּיחוּ בְּבֵית הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ הַשֹּׁמְרֹנִים גּוֹי גּוֹי בְּעָרֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הֵם יֹשְׁבִים שָׁם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ עֹשִׂים גּוֹי גּוֹי אֱלֹהָיו וַיַּנִּיחוּ בְּבֵית הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ הַשֹּׁמְרֹנִים גּוֹי גּוֹי בְּעָרֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הֵם יֹשְׁבִים שָׁם׃

english.text:
However, each nation continued to make its own gods and to set
them up in the cult places which had been made by the people of
Samaria; each nation [set them up] in the towns in which it lived.

translation.text: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.

verses.english:
However, each nation continued to make its own gods and to set
them up in the cult places which had been made by the people of
Samaria; each nation [set them up] in the towns in which it lived.

verses.hebrew: וְאַנְשֵׁי בָבֶל עָשׂוּ אֶת־סֻכּוֹת בְּנוֹת וְאַנְשֵׁי־כוּת עָשׂוּ אֶת־נֵרְגַל וְאַנְשֵׁי חֲמָת עָשׂוּ אֶת־אֲשִׁימָא׃

hebrew.text: וְאַנְשֵׁי בָבֶל עָשׂוּ אֶת־סֻכּוֹת בְּנוֹת וְאַנְשֵׁי־כוּת עָשׂוּ אֶת־נֵרְגַל וְאַנְשֵׁי חֲמָת עָשׂוּ אֶת־אֲשִׁימָא׃

english.text:
The Babylonians made Succoth-benoth, and the men of Cuth made
Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

translation.text: And the men of Babylon made Succothbenoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

verses.english:
The Babylonians made Succoth-benoth, and the men of Cuth made
Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

verses.hebrew: וְהָעַוִּים עָשׂוּ נִבְחַז וְאֶת־תַּרְתָּק וְהַסְפַרְוִים שֹׂרְפִים אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם בָּאֵשׁ לְאַדְרַמֶּלֶךְ וַעֲנַמֶּלֶךְ (אלה) [אֱלֹהֵי] (ספרים) [סְפַרְוָיִם]׃

hebrew.text: וְהָעַוִּים עָשׂוּ נִבְחַז וְאֶת־תַּרְתָּק וְהַסְפַרְוִים שֹׂרְפִים אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם בָּאֵשׁ לְאַדְרַמֶּלֶךְ וַעֲנַמֶּלֶךְ (אלה) [אֱלֹהֵי] (ספרים) [סְפַרְוָיִם]׃

english.text:
and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burned
their children [as offerings] to Adrammelech and Anamelech, the
gods of Sepharvaim.

translation.text: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

verses.english:
and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burned
their children [as offerings] to Adrammelech and Anamelech, the
gods of Sepharvaim.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ יְרֵאִים אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַיַּעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם מִקְצוֹתָם כֹּהֲנֵי בָמוֹת וַיִּהְיוּ עֹשִׂים לָהֶם בְּבֵית הַבָּמוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ יְרֵאִים אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַיַּעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם מִקְצוֹתָם כֹּהֲנֵי בָמוֹת וַיִּהְיוּ עֹשִׂים לָהֶם בְּבֵית הַבָּמוֹת׃

english.text:
They worshiped YHWH, but they also appointed from their own ranks
priests of the shrines, who officiated for them in the cult
places.

translation.text: So they feared the LORD, and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.

verses.english:
They worshiped YHWH, but they also appointed from their own ranks
priests of the shrines, who officiated for them in the cult
places.

verses.hebrew: אֶת־יְהֹוָה הָיוּ יְרֵאִים וְאֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הָיוּ עֹבְדִים כְּמִשְׁפַּט הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר־הִגְלוּ אֹתָם מִשָּׁם׃

hebrew.text: אֶת־יְהֹוָה הָיוּ יְרֵאִים וְאֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הָיוּ עֹבְדִים כְּמִשְׁפַּט הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר־הִגְלוּ אֹתָם מִשָּׁם׃

english.text:
They worshiped YHWH, while serving their own gods according to the
practices of the nations from which they had been deported.

translation.text: They feared the LORD, and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.

verses.english:
They worshiped YHWH, while serving their own gods according to the
practices of the nations from which they had been deported.

verses.hebrew:
עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הֵם עֹשִׂים כַּמִּשְׁפָּטִים הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֵינָם יְרֵאִים אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְאֵינָם עֹשִׂים כְּחֻקֹּתָם וּכְמִשְׁפָּטָם וְכַתּוֹרָה וְכַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה
אֶת־בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם שְׁמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הֵם עֹשִׂים כַּמִּשְׁפָּטִים הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֵינָם יְרֵאִים אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְאֵינָם עֹשִׂים כְּחֻקֹּתָם וּכְמִשְׁפָּטָם וְכַתּוֹרָה וְכַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה
אֶת־בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם שְׁמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
To this day, they follow their former practices. They do not
worship YHWH [properly]. They do not follow the laws and
practices, the Teaching and Instruction that YHWH enjoined upon
the descendants of Jacob—who was given the name Israel—

translation.text: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the LORD, neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

verses.english:
To this day, they follow their former practices. They do not
worship YHWH [properly]. They do not follow the laws and
practices, the Teaching and Instruction that YHWH enjoined upon
the descendants of Jacob—who was given the name Israel—

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהֹוָה אִתָּם בְּרִית וַיְצַוֵּם לֵאמֹר לֹא תִירְאוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְלֹא־תִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם וְלֹא תַעַבְדוּם וְלֹא תִזְבְּחוּ לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהֹוָה אִתָּם בְּרִית וַיְצַוֵּם לֵאמֹר לֹא תִירְאוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְלֹא־תִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם וְלֹא תַעַבְדוּם וְלֹא תִזְבְּחוּ לָהֶם׃

english.text:
with whom He made a covenant and whom He commanded: “You shall
worship no other gods; you shall not bow down to them nor serve
them nor sacrifice to them.

translation.text: With whom the LORD had made a covenant, and charged them, saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:

verses.english:
with whom He made a covenant and whom He commanded: “You shall
worship no other gods; you shall not bow down to them nor serve
them nor sacrifice to them.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָה אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּכֹחַ גָּדוֹל וּבִזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה אֹתוֹ תִירָאוּ וְלוֹ תִשְׁתַּחֲווּ וְלוֹ תִזְבָּחוּ׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם־אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָה אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּכֹחַ גָּדוֹל וּבִזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה אֹתוֹ תִירָאוּ וְלוֹ תִשְׁתַּחֲווּ וְלוֹ תִזְבָּחוּ׃

english.text:
You must worship only YHWH your God, who brought you out of the
land of Egypt with great might and with an outstretched arm: to
Him alone shall you bow down and to Him alone shall you sacrifice.

translation.text: But the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm, him shall ye fear, and him shall ye worship, and to him shall ye do sacrifice.

verses.english:
You must worship only YHWH your God, who brought you out of the
land of Egypt with great might and with an outstretched arm: to
Him alone shall you bow down and to Him alone shall you sacrifice.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַחֻקִּים וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים וְהַתּוֹרָה וְהַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר כָּתַב לָכֶם תִּשְׁמְרוּן לַעֲשׂוֹת כּל־הַיָּמִים וְלֹא תִירְאוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶת־הַחֻקִּים וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים וְהַתּוֹרָה וְהַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר כָּתַב לָכֶם תִּשְׁמְרוּן לַעֲשׂוֹת כּל־הַיָּמִים וְלֹא תִירְאוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

translation.text: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.

verses.hebrew: וְהַבְּרִית אֲשֶׁר־כָּרַתִּי אִתְּכֶם לֹא תִשְׁכָּחוּ וְלֹא תִירְאוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

hebrew.text: וְהַבְּרִית אֲשֶׁר־כָּרַתִּי אִתְּכֶם לֹא תִשְׁכָּחוּ וְלֹא תִירְאוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃

english.text:
Do not forget the covenant that I made with you; do not worship
other gods.

translation.text: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget; neither shall ye fear other gods.

verses.english:
Do not forget the covenant that I made with you; do not worship
other gods.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם תִּירָאוּ וְהוּא יַצִּיל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד כּל־אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי אִם־אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם תִּירָאוּ וְהוּא יַצִּיל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד כּל־אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
Worship only YHWH your God, and He will save you from the hands of
all your enemies.”

translation.text: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.

verses.english:
Worship only YHWH your God, and He will save you from the hands of
all your enemies.”

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ כִּי אִם־כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם הָרִאשׁוֹן הֵם עֹשִׂים׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ כִּי אִם־כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם הָרִאשׁוֹן הֵם עֹשִׂים׃

english.text: But they did not obey; they continued their former practices.

translation.text: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.

verses.english: But they did not obey; they continued their former practices.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה יְרֵאִים אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־פְּסִילֵיהֶם הָיוּ עֹבְדִים גַּם־בְּנֵיהֶם וּבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָם הֵם עֹשִׂים עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּהְיוּ הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה יְרֵאִים אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־פְּסִילֵיהֶם הָיוּ עֹבְדִים גַּם־בְּנֵיהֶם וּבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָם הֵם עֹשִׂים עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
Those nations worshiped YHWH, but they also served their idols. To
this day their children and their children’s children do as their
ancestors did.

translation.text: So these nations feared the LORD, and served their graven images, both their children, and their children’s children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.

verses.english:
Those nations worshiped YHWH, but they also served their idols. To
this day their children and their children’s children do as their
ancestors did.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלֹשׁ לְהוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־אֵלָה מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ חִזְקִיָּה בֶן־אָחָז מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלֹשׁ לְהוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־אֵלָה מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ חִזְקִיָּה בֶן־אָחָז מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
In the third year of King Hoshea son of Elah of Israel, Hezekiah
son of King Ahaz of Judah became king.

translation.text: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

verses.english:
In the third year of King Hoshea son of Elah of Israel, Hezekiah
son of King Ahaz of Judah became king.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמלְכוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ אֲבִי בַּת־זְכַרְיָה׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמלְכוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ אֲבִי בַּת־זְכַרְיָה׃

english.text:
He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned
in Jerusalem twenty-nine years; his mother’s name was Abi daughter
of Zechariah.

translation.text: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.

verses.english:
He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned
in Jerusalem twenty-nine years; his mother’s name was Abi daughter
of Zechariah.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה דָּוִד אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה דָּוִד אָבִיו׃

english.text:
He did what was pleasing to YHWH, just as his father David had
done.

translation.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father did.

verses.english:
He did what was pleasing to YHWH, just as his father David had
done.

verses.hebrew:
הוּא הֵסִיר אֶת־הַבָּמוֹת וְשִׁבַּר אֶת־הַמַּצֵּבֹת וְכָרַת אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה וְכִתַּת נְחַשׁ הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה מֹשֶׁה כִּי עַד־הַיָּמִים הָהֵמָּה הָיוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל
מְקַטְּרִים לוֹ וַיִּקְרָא־לוֹ נְחֻשְׁתָּן׃

hebrew.text:
הוּא הֵסִיר אֶת־הַבָּמוֹת וְשִׁבַּר אֶת־הַמַּצֵּבֹת וְכָרַת אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה וְכִתַּת נְחַשׁ הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה מֹשֶׁה כִּי עַד־הַיָּמִים הָהֵמָּה הָיוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל
מְקַטְּרִים לוֹ וַיִּקְרָא־לוֹ נְחֻשְׁתָּן׃

english.text:
He abolished the shrines and smashed the pillars and cut down the
sacred post. He also broke into pieces the bronze serpent that
Moses had made, for until that time the Israelites had been
offering sacrifices to it; it was called Nehushtan.

translation.text: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.

verses.english:
He abolished the shrines and smashed the pillars and cut down the
sacred post. He also broke into pieces the bronze serpent that
Moses had made, for until that time the Israelites had been
offering sacrifices to it; it was called Nehushtan.

verses.hebrew: בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּטָח וְאַחֲרָיו לֹא־הָיָה כָמֹהוּ בְּכֹל מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וַאֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנָיו׃

hebrew.text: בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּטָח וְאַחֲרָיו לֹא־הָיָה כָמֹהוּ בְּכֹל מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וַאֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנָיו׃

english.text:
He trusted only in YHWH the God of Israel; there was none like him
among all the kings of Judah after him, nor among those before
him.

translation.text: He trusted in the LORD God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor any that were before him.

verses.english:
He trusted only in YHWH the God of Israel; there was none like him
among all the kings of Judah after him, nor among those before
him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּדְבַּק בַּיהֹוָה לֹא־סָר מֵאַחֲרָיו וַיִּשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּדְבַּק בַּיהֹוָה לֹא־סָר מֵאַחֲרָיו וַיִּשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
He clung to YHWH; he did not turn away from following Him, but
kept the commandments that YHWH had given to Moses.

translation.text: For he clave to the LORD, and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.english:
He clung to YHWH; he did not turn away from following Him, but
kept the commandments that YHWH had given to Moses.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה יְהֹוָה עִמּוֹ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא יַשְׂכִּיל וַיִּמְרֹד בְּמֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר וְלֹא עֲבָדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וְהָיָה יְהֹוָה עִמּוֹ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא יַשְׂכִּיל וַיִּמְרֹד בְּמֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר וְלֹא עֲבָדוֹ׃

english.text:
And YHWH was always with him; he was successful wherever he
turned. He rebelled against the king of Assyria and would not
serve him.

translation.text: And the LORD was with him; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.

verses.english:
And YHWH was always with him; he was successful wherever he
turned. He rebelled against the king of Assyria and would not
serve him.

verses.hebrew: הוּא־הִכָּה אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים עַד־עַזָּה וְאֶת־גְּבוּלֶיהָ מִמִּגְדַּל נוֹצְרִים עַד־עִיר מִבְצָר׃

hebrew.text: הוּא־הִכָּה אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים עַד־עַזָּה וְאֶת־גְּבוּלֶיהָ מִמִּגְדַּל נוֹצְרִים עַד־עִיר מִבְצָר׃

english.text:
He overran Philistia as far as Gaza and its border areas, from
watchtower to fortified town.

translation.text: He smote the Philistines, even unto Gaza, and the borders thereof, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

verses.english:
He overran Philistia as far as Gaza and its border areas, from
watchtower to fortified town.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי בַּשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִית לַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ הִיא הַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִית לְהוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־אֵלָה מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל עָלָה שַׁלְמַנְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עַל־שֹׁמְרוֹן
וַיָּצַר עָלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי בַּשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִית לַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ הִיא הַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִית לְהוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־אֵלָה מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל עָלָה שַׁלְמַנְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עַל־שֹׁמְרוֹן
וַיָּצַר עָלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
In the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of
King Hoshea son of Elah of Israel, King Shalmaneser of Assyria
marched against Samaria and besieged it,

translation.text: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.

verses.english:
In the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of
King Hoshea son of Elah of Israel, King Shalmaneser of Assyria
marched against Samaria and besieged it,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכְּדֻהָ מִקְצֵה שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים בִּשְׁנַת־שֵׁשׁ לְחִזְקִיָּה הִיא שְׁנַת־תֵּשַׁע לְהוֹשֵׁעַ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל נִלְכְּדָה שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּלְכְּדֻהָ מִקְצֵה שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים בִּשְׁנַת־שֵׁשׁ לְחִזְקִיָּה הִיא שְׁנַת־תֵּשַׁע לְהוֹשֵׁעַ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל נִלְכְּדָה שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

translation.text: And at the end of three years they took it: even in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that is in the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּגֶל מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַשּׁוּרָה וַיַּנְחֵם בַּחְלַח וּבְחָבוֹר נְהַר גּוֹזָן וְעָרֵי מָדָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֶּגֶל מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַשּׁוּרָה וַיַּנְחֵם בַּחְלַח וּבְחָבוֹר נְהַר גּוֹזָן וְעָרֵי מָדָי׃

english.text:
and the king of Assyria deported the Israelites to Assyria. He
settled them in Halah, along the Habor [and] the River Gozan, and
in the towns of Media.

translation.text: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:

verses.english:
and the king of Assyria deported the Israelites to Assyria. He
settled them in Halah, along the Habor [and] the River Gozan, and
in the towns of Media.

verses.hebrew: עַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־בְּרִיתוֹ אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ וְלֹא עָשׂוּ׃

hebrew.text: עַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־בְּרִיתוֹ אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהֹוָה וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ וְלֹא עָשׂוּ׃

english.text:
[This happened] because they did not obey YHWH their God; they
transgressed His covenant—all that Moses the servant of YHWH had
commanded. They did not obey and they did not fulfill it.

translation.text: Because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD their God, but transgressed his covenant, and all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear them, nor do them.

verses.english:
[This happened] because they did not obey YHWH their God; they
transgressed His covenant—all that Moses the servant of YHWH had
commanded. They did not obey and they did not fulfill it.

verses.hebrew: וּבְאַרְבַּע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּה עָלָה סַנְחֵרִיב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עַל כּל־עָרֵי יְהוּדָה הַבְּצֻרוֹת וַיִּתְפְּשֵׂם׃

hebrew.text: וּבְאַרְבַּע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּה עָלָה סַנְחֵרִיב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עַל כּל־עָרֵי יְהוּדָה הַבְּצֻרוֹת וַיִּתְפְּשֵׂם׃

english.text:
In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, King Sennacherib of
Assyria marched against all the fortified towns of Judah and
seized them.

translation.text: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah, and took them.

verses.english:
In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, King Sennacherib of
Assyria marched against all the fortified towns of Judah and
seized them.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח חִזְקִיָּה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֶל־מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר לָכִישָׁה לֵאמֹר חָטָאתִי שׁוּב מֵעָלַי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תִּתֵּן עָלַי אֶשָּׂא וַיָּשֶׂם מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עַל־חִזְקִיָּה
מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת כִּכַּר־כֶּסֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁים כִּכַּר זָהָב׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח חִזְקִיָּה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֶל־מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר לָכִישָׁה לֵאמֹר חָטָאתִי שׁוּב מֵעָלַי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תִּתֵּן עָלַי אֶשָּׂא וַיָּשֶׂם מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עַל־חִזְקִיָּה
מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת כִּכַּר־כֶּסֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁים כִּכַּר זָהָב׃

english.text:
King Hezekiah sent this message to the king of Assyria at Lachish:
“I have done wrong; withdraw from me; and I shall bear whatever
you impose on me.” So the king of Assyria imposed upon King
Hezekiah of Judah a payment of three hundred talents of silver and
thirty talents of gold.

translation.text: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

verses.english:
King Hezekiah sent this message to the king of Assyria at Lachish:
“I have done wrong; withdraw from me; and I shall bear whatever
you impose on me.” So the king of Assyria imposed upon King
Hezekiah of Judah a payment of three hundred talents of silver and
thirty talents of gold.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן חִזְקִיָּה אֶת־כּל־הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה וּבְאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּתֵּן חִזְקִיָּה אֶת־כּל־הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בֵית־יְהֹוָה וּבְאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was on hand in the House of
YHWH and in the treasuries of the palace.

translation.text: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king’s house.

verses.english:
Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was on hand in the House of
YHWH and in the treasuries of the palace.

verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא קִצַּץ חִזְקִיָּה אֶת־דַּלְתוֹת הֵיכַל יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־הָאֹמְנוֹת אֲשֶׁר צִפָּה חִזְקִיָּה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּתְּנֵם לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

hebrew.text: בָּעֵת הַהִיא קִצַּץ חִזְקִיָּה אֶת־דַּלְתוֹת הֵיכַל יְהֹוָה וְאֶת־הָאֹמְנוֹת אֲשֶׁר צִפָּה חִזְקִיָּה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּתְּנֵם לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

english.text:
At that time Hezekiah cut down the doors and the doorposts of the
Temple of YHWH, which King Hezekiah had overlaid [with gold], and
gave them to the king of Assyria.

translation.text: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the LORD, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

verses.english:
At that time Hezekiah cut down the doors and the doorposts of the
Temple of YHWH, which King Hezekiah had overlaid [with gold], and
gave them to the king of Assyria.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁלַח מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֶת־תַּרְתָּן וְאֶת־רַב־סָרִיס וְאֶת־רַבְשָׁקֵה מִן־לָכִישׁ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְּחֵיל כָּבֵד יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם
וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיַּעַמְדוּ בִּתְעָלַת הַבְּרֵכָה הָעֶלְיוֹנָה אֲשֶׁר בִּמְסִלַּת שְׂדֵה כֹבֵס׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁלַח מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֶת־תַּרְתָּן וְאֶת־רַב־סָרִיס וְאֶת־רַבְשָׁקֵה מִן־לָכִישׁ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְּחֵיל כָּבֵד יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם
וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיַּעַמְדוּ בִּתְעָלַת הַבְּרֵכָה הָעֶלְיוֹנָה אֲשֶׁר בִּמְסִלַּת שְׂדֵה כֹבֵס׃

english.text:
But the king of Assyria sent the Tartan, the Rabsaris, and the
Rabshakeh from Lachish with a large force to King Hezekiah in
Jerusalem. They marched up to Jerusalem; and when they arrived,
they took up a position near the conduit of the Upper Pool, by the
road of the Fuller’s Field.

translation.text: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rabshakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller’s field.

verses.english:
But the king of Assyria sent the Tartan, the Rabsaris, and the
Rabshakeh from Lachish with a large force to King Hezekiah in
Jerusalem. They marched up to Jerusalem; and when they arrived,
they took up a position near the conduit of the Upper Pool, by the
road of the Fuller’s Field.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּצֵא אֲלֵהֶם אֶלְיָקִים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּהוּ אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַבָּיִת וְשֶׁבְנָה הַסֹּפֵר וְיוֹאָח בֶּן־אָסָף הַמַּזְכִּיר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּצֵא אֲלֵהֶם אֶלְיָקִים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּהוּ אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַבָּיִת וְשֶׁבְנָה הַסֹּפֵר וְיוֹאָח בֶּן־אָסָף הַמַּזְכִּיר׃

english.text:
They summoned the king; and Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was in
charge of the palace, Shebna the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph the
recorder went out to them.

translation.text: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.

verses.english:
They summoned the king; and Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was in
charge of the palace, Shebna the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph the
recorder went out to them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם רַבְשָׁקֵה אִמְרוּ־נָא אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כֹּה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר מָה הַבִּטָּחוֹן הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בָּטָחְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם רַבְשָׁקֵה אִמְרוּ־נָא אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כֹּה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר מָה הַבִּטָּחוֹן הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בָּטָחְתָּ׃

english.text:
The Rabshakeh said to them, “You tell Hezekiah: Thus said the
Great King, the King of Assyria: What makes you so confident?

translation.text: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Speak ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?

verses.english:
The Rabshakeh said to them, “You tell Hezekiah: Thus said the
Great King, the King of Assyria: What makes you so confident?

verses.hebrew: אָמַרְתָּ אַךְ־דְּבַר־שְׂפָתַיִם עֵצָה וּגְבוּרָה לַמִּלְחָמָה עַתָּה עַל־מִי בָטַחְתָּ כִּי מָרַדְתָּ בִּי׃

hebrew.text: אָמַרְתָּ אַךְ־דְּבַר־שְׂפָתַיִם עֵצָה וּגְבוּרָה לַמִּלְחָמָה עַתָּה עַל־מִי בָטַחְתָּ כִּי מָרַדְתָּ בִּי׃

english.text:
You must think that mere talk is counsel and valor for war! Look,
on whom are you relying, that you have rebelled against me?

translation.text: Thou sayest, (but they are but vain words,) I have counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?

verses.english:
You must think that mere talk is counsel and valor for war! Look,
on whom are you relying, that you have rebelled against me?

verses.hebrew:
עַתָּה הִנֵּה בָטַחְתָּ לְּךָ עַל־מִשְׁעֶנֶת הַקָּנֶה הָרָצוּץ הַזֶּה עַל־מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יִסָּמֵךְ אִישׁ עָלָיו וּבָא בְכַפּוֹ וּנְקָבָהּ כֵּן פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם
לְכל־הַבֹּטְחִים עָלָיו׃

hebrew.text:
עַתָּה הִנֵּה בָטַחְתָּ לְּךָ עַל־מִשְׁעֶנֶת הַקָּנֶה הָרָצוּץ הַזֶּה עַל־מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יִסָּמֵךְ אִישׁ עָלָיו וּבָא בְכַפּוֹ וּנְקָבָהּ כֵּן פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם
לְכל־הַבֹּטְחִים עָלָיו׃

english.text:
You rely, of all things, on Egypt, that splintered reed of a
staff, which enters and punctures the palm of anyone who leans on
it! That’s what Pharaoh king of Egypt is like to all who rely on
him.

translation.text: Now, behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him.

verses.english:
You rely, of all things, on Egypt, that splintered reed of a
staff, which enters and punctures the palm of anyone who leans on
it! That’s what Pharaoh king of Egypt is like to all who rely on
him.

verses.hebrew:
וְכִי־תֹאמְרוּן אֵלַי אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בָּטָחְנוּ הֲלוֹא־הוּא אֲשֶׁר הֵסִיר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶת־בָּמֹתָיו וְאֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לִיהוּדָה וְלִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לִפְנֵי
הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַזֶּה תִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text:
וְכִי־תֹאמְרוּן אֵלַי אֶל־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בָּטָחְנוּ הֲלוֹא־הוּא אֲשֶׁר הֵסִיר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶת־בָּמֹתָיו וְאֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לִיהוּדָה וְלִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לִפְנֵי
הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַזֶּה תִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
And if you tell me that you are relying on YHWH your God, He is
the very one whose shrines and altars Hezekiah did away with,
telling Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You must worship only at this altar
in Jerusalem.’

translation.text: But if ye say unto me, We trust in the LORD our God: is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?

verses.english:
And if you tell me that you are relying on YHWH your God, He is
the very one whose shrines and altars Hezekiah did away with,
telling Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You must worship only at this altar
in Jerusalem.’

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִתְעָרֶב נָא אֶת־אֲדֹנִי אֶת־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אַלְפַּיִם סוּסִים אִם־תּוּכַל לָתֶת לְךָ רֹכְבִים עֲלֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה הִתְעָרֶב נָא אֶת־אֲדֹנִי אֶת־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אַלְפַּיִם סוּסִים אִם־תּוּכַל לָתֶת לְךָ רֹכְבִים עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Come now, make this wager with my master, the king of Assyria:
I’ll give you two thousand horses if you can produce riders to
mount them.

translation.text: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

verses.english:
Come now, make this wager with my master, the king of Assyria:
I’ll give you two thousand horses if you can produce riders to
mount them.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵיךְ תָּשִׁיב אֵת פְּנֵי פַחַת אַחַד עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנִי הַקְּטַנִּים וַתִּבְטַח לְךָ עַל־מִצְרַיִם לְרֶכֶב וּלְפָרָשִׁים׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵיךְ תָּשִׁיב אֵת פְּנֵי פַחַת אַחַד עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנִי הַקְּטַנִּים וַתִּבְטַח לְךָ עַל־מִצְרַיִם לְרֶכֶב וּלְפָרָשִׁים׃

english.text:
So how could you refuse anything even to the deputy of one of my
master’s lesser servants, relying on Egypt for chariots and
horsemen?

translation.text: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

verses.english:
So how could you refuse anything even to the deputy of one of my
master’s lesser servants, relying on Egypt for chariots and
horsemen?

verses.hebrew: עַתָּה הֲמִבַּלְעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה עָלִיתִי עַל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה לְהַשְׁחִתוֹ יְהֹוָה אָמַר אֵלַי עֲלֵה עַל־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וְהַשְׁחִיתָהּ׃

hebrew.text: עַתָּה הֲמִבַּלְעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה עָלִיתִי עַל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה לְהַשְׁחִתוֹ יְהֹוָה אָמַר אֵלַי עֲלֵה עַל־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וְהַשְׁחִיתָהּ׃

english.text:
And do you think I have marched against this land to destroy it
without YHWH? YHWH Himself told me: Go up against that land and
destroy it.”

translation.text: Am I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

verses.english:
And do you think I have marched against this land to destroy it
without YHWH? YHWH Himself told me: Go up against that land and
destroy it.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֶלְיָקִים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּהוּ וְשֶׁבְנָה וְיוֹאָח אֶל־רַבְשָׁקֵה דַּבֶּר־נָא אֶל־עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲרָמִית כִּי שֹׁמְעִים אֲנָחְנוּ וְאַל־תְּדַבֵּר עִמָּנוּ יְהוּדִית בְּאזְנֵי
הָעָם אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַחֹמָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֶלְיָקִים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּהוּ וְשֶׁבְנָה וְיוֹאָח אֶל־רַבְשָׁקֵה דַּבֶּר־נָא אֶל־עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲרָמִית כִּי שֹׁמְעִים אֲנָחְנוּ וְאַל־תְּדַבֵּר עִמָּנוּ יְהוּדִית בְּאזְנֵי
הָעָם אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַחֹמָה׃

english.text:
Eliakim son of Hilkiah, Shebna, and Joah replied to the Rabshakeh,
“Please, speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it;
do not speak to us in Judean in the hearing of the people on the
wall.”

translation.text: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and talk not with us in the Jews’ language in the ears of the people that are on the wall.

verses.english:
Eliakim son of Hilkiah, Shebna, and Joah replied to the Rabshakeh,
“Please, speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it;
do not speak to us in Judean in the hearing of the people on the
wall.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם רַבְשָׁקֵה הַעַל אֲדֹנֶיךָ וְאֵלֶיךָ שְׁלָחַנִי אֲדֹנִי לְדַבֵּר אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה הֲלֹא עַל־הָאֲנָשִׁים הַיֹּשְׁבִים עַל־הַחֹמָה לֶאֱכֹל אֶת־[צוֹאָתָם]
(חריהם) וְלִשְׁתּוֹת אֶת־[מֵימֵי רַגְלֵיהֶם] (שניהם) עִמָּכֶם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם רַבְשָׁקֵה הַעַל אֲדֹנֶיךָ וְאֵלֶיךָ שְׁלָחַנִי אֲדֹנִי לְדַבֵּר אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה הֲלֹא עַל־הָאֲנָשִׁים הַיֹּשְׁבִים עַל־הַחֹמָה לֶאֱכֹל אֶת־[צוֹאָתָם]
(חריהם) וְלִשְׁתּוֹת אֶת־[מֵימֵי רַגְלֵיהֶם] (שניהם) עִמָּכֶם׃

english.text:
But the Rabshakeh answered them, “Was it to your master and to you
that my master sent me to speak those words? It was precisely to
the men who are sitting on the wall—who will have to eat their
dung and drink their urine with you.”

translation.text: But Rabshakeh said unto them, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?

verses.english:
But the Rabshakeh answered them, “Was it to your master and to you
that my master sent me to speak those words? It was precisely to
the men who are sitting on the wall—who will have to eat their
dung and drink their urine with you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד רַבְשָׁקֵה וַיִּקְרָא בְקוֹל־גָּדוֹל יְהוּדִית וַיְדַבֵּר וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְעוּ דְּבַר־הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲמֹד רַבְשָׁקֵה וַיִּקְרָא בְקוֹל־גָּדוֹל יְהוּדִית וַיְדַבֵּר וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְעוּ דְּבַר־הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

english.text:
And the Rabshakeh stood and called out in a loud voice in Judean:
“Hear the words of the Great King, the King of Assyria.

translation.text: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and spake, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:

verses.english:
And the Rabshakeh stood and called out in a loud voice in Judean:
“Hear the words of the Great King, the King of Assyria.

verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ אַל־יַשִּׁא לָכֶם חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי־לֹא יוּכַל לְהַצִּיל אֶתְכֶם מִיָּדוֹ׃

hebrew.text: כֹּה אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ אַל־יַשִּׁא לָכֶם חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי־לֹא יוּכַל לְהַצִּיל אֶתְכֶם מִיָּדוֹ׃

english.text:
Thus said the king: Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will
not be able to deliver you from my hands.

translation.text: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:

verses.english:
Thus said the king: Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will
not be able to deliver you from my hands.

verses.hebrew: וְאַל־יַבְטַח אֶתְכֶם חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַצֵּל יַצִּילֵנוּ יְהֹוָה וְלֹא תִנָּתֵן אֶת־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת בְּיַד מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

hebrew.text: וְאַל־יַבְטַח אֶתְכֶם חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר הַצֵּל יַצִּילֵנוּ יְהֹוָה וְלֹא תִנָּתֵן אֶת־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת בְּיַד מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

english.text:
Don’t let Hezekiah make you rely on YHWH, saying: YHWH will surely
save us: this city will not fall into the hands of the king of
Assyria.

translation.text: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.english:
Don’t let Hezekiah make you rely on YHWH, saying: YHWH will surely
save us: this city will not fall into the hands of the king of
Assyria.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי כֹה אָמַר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר עֲשׂוּ־אִתִּי בְרָכָה וּצְאוּ אֵלַי וְאִכְלוּ אִישׁ־גַּפְנוֹ וְאִישׁ תְּאֵנָתוֹ וּשְׁתוּ אִישׁ מֵי־בֹרוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אַל־תִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי כֹה אָמַר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר עֲשׂוּ־אִתִּי בְרָכָה וּצְאוּ אֵלַי וְאִכְלוּ אִישׁ־גַּפְנוֹ וְאִישׁ תְּאֵנָתוֹ וּשְׁתוּ אִישׁ מֵי־בֹרוֹ׃

english.text:
Don’t listen to Hezekiah. For thus said the king of Assyria: Make
your peace with me and come out to me, so that you may all eat
from your vines and your fig trees and drink water from your
cisterns,

translation.text: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and then eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern:

verses.english:
Don’t listen to Hezekiah. For thus said the king of Assyria: Make
your peace with me and come out to me, so that you may all eat
from your vines and your fig trees and drink water from your
cisterns,

verses.hebrew:
עַד־בֹּאִי וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶתְכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ כְּאַרְצְכֶם אֶרֶץ דָּגָן וְתִירוֹשׁ אֶרֶץ לֶחֶם וּכְרָמִים אֶרֶץ זֵית יִצְהָר וּדְבַשׁ וִחְיוּ וְלֹא תָמֻתוּ וְאַל־תִּשְׁמְעוּ
אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי־יַסִּית אֶתְכֶם לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה יַצִּילֵנוּ׃

hebrew.text:
עַד־בֹּאִי וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶתְכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ כְּאַרְצְכֶם אֶרֶץ דָּגָן וְתִירוֹשׁ אֶרֶץ לֶחֶם וּכְרָמִים אֶרֶץ זֵית יִצְהָר וּדְבַשׁ וִחְיוּ וְלֹא תָמֻתוּ וְאַל־תִּשְׁמְעוּ
אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי־יַסִּית אֶתְכֶם לֵאמֹר יְהֹוָה יַצִּילֵנוּ׃

english.text:
until I come and take you away to a land like your own, a land of
grain [fields] and vineyards, of bread and wine, of olive oil and
honey, so that you may live and not die. Don’t listen to Hezekiah,
who misleads you by saying, ‘YHWH will save us.’

translation.text: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil olive and of honey, that ye may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, The LORD will deliver us.

verses.english:
until I come and take you away to a land like your own, a land of
grain [fields] and vineyards, of bread and wine, of olive oil and
honey, so that you may live and not die. Don’t listen to Hezekiah,
who misleads you by saying, ‘YHWH will save us.’

verses.hebrew: הַהַצֵּל הִצִּילוּ אֱלֹהֵי הַגּוֹיִם אִישׁ אֶת־אַרְצוֹ מִיַּד מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

hebrew.text: הַהַצֵּל הִצִּילוּ אֱלֹהֵי הַגּוֹיִם אִישׁ אֶת־אַרְצוֹ מִיַּד מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

english.text:
Did any of the gods of other nations save his land from the king
of Assyria?

translation.text: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.english:
Did any of the gods of other nations save his land from the king
of Assyria?

verses.hebrew: אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֵי חֲמָת וְאַרְפָּד אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֵי סְפַרְוַיִם הֵנַע וְעִוָּה כִּי־הִצִּילוּ אֶת־שֹׁמְרוֹן מִיָּדִי׃

hebrew.text: אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֵי חֲמָת וְאַרְפָּד אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֵי סְפַרְוַיִם הֵנַע וְעִוָּה כִּי־הִצִּילוּ אֶת־שֹׁמְרוֹן מִיָּדִי׃

english.text:
Where were the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where were the gods of
Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? [And] did they save Samaria from me?

translation.text: Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand?

verses.english:
Where were the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where were the gods of
Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? [And] did they save Samaria from me?

verses.hebrew: מִי בְּכל־אֱלֹהֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת אֲשֶׁר־הִצִּילוּ אֶת־אַרְצָם מִיָּדִי כִּי־יַצִּיל יְהֹוָה אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם מִיָּדִי׃

hebrew.text: מִי בְּכל־אֱלֹהֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת אֲשֶׁר־הִצִּילוּ אֶת־אַרְצָם מִיָּדִי כִּי־יַצִּיל יְהֹוָה אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם מִיָּדִי׃

english.text:
Which among all the gods of [those] countries saved their
countries from me, that YHWH should save Jerusalem from me?”

translation.text: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of mine hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand?

verses.english:
Which among all the gods of [those] countries saved their
countries from me, that YHWH should save Jerusalem from me?”

verses.hebrew: וְהֶחֱרִישׁוּ הָעָם וְלֹא־עָנוּ אֹתוֹ דָּבָר כִּי־מִצְוַת הַמֶּלֶךְ הִיא לֵאמֹר לֹא תַעֲנֻהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶחֱרִישׁוּ הָעָם וְלֹא־עָנוּ אֹתוֹ דָּבָר כִּי־מִצְוַת הַמֶּלֶךְ הִיא לֵאמֹר לֹא תַעֲנֻהוּ׃

english.text:
But the people were silent and did not say a word in reply; for
the king’s order was: “Do not answer him.”

translation.text: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

verses.english:
But the people were silent and did not say a word in reply; for
the king’s order was: “Do not answer him.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֶלְיָקִים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּה אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַבַּיִת וְשֶׁבְנָא הַסֹּפֵר וְיוֹאָח בֶּן־אָסָף הַמַּזְכִּיר אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ קְרוּעֵי בְגָדִים וַיַּגִּדוּ לוֹ דִּבְרֵי רַבְשָׁקֵה׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹא אֶלְיָקִים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּה אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַבַּיִת וְשֶׁבְנָא הַסֹּפֵר וְיוֹאָח בֶּן־אָסָף הַמַּזְכִּיר אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ קְרוּעֵי בְגָדִים וַיַּגִּדוּ לוֹ דִּבְרֵי רַבְשָׁקֵה׃

english.text:
And so Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the palace,
Shebna the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder came to
Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and they reported to him what
the Rabshakeh had said.

translation.text: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

verses.english:
And so Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the palace,
Shebna the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder came to
Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and they reported to him what
the Rabshakeh had said.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיִּתְכַּס בַּשָּׂק וַיָּבֹא בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיִּתְכַּס בַּשָּׂק וַיָּבֹא בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
When King Hezekiah heard this, he rent his clothes, and covered
himself with sackcloth, and went into the House of YHWH.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
When King Hezekiah heard this, he rent his clothes, and covered
himself with sackcloth, and went into the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת־אֶלְיָקִים אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַבַּיִת וְשֶׁבְנָא הַסֹּפֵר וְאֵת זִקְנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים מִתְכַּסִּים בַּשַּׂקִּים אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ הַנָּבִיא בֶּן־אָמוֹץ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת־אֶלְיָקִים אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַבַּיִת וְשֶׁבְנָא הַסֹּפֵר וְאֵת זִקְנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים מִתְכַּסִּים בַּשַּׂקִּים אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ הַנָּבִיא בֶּן־אָמוֹץ׃

english.text:
He also sent Eliakim, who was in charge of the palace, Shebna the
scribe, and the senior priests, covered with sackcloth, to the
prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.

translation.text: And he sent Eliakim, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

verses.english:
He also sent Eliakim, who was in charge of the palace, Shebna the
scribe, and the senior priests, covered with sackcloth, to the
prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר חִזְקִיָּהוּ יוֹם־צָרָה וְתוֹכֵחָה וּנְאָצָה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי בָאוּ בָנִים עַד־מַשְׁבֵּר וְכֹחַ אַיִן לְלֵדָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר חִזְקִיָּהוּ יוֹם־צָרָה וְתוֹכֵחָה וּנְאָצָה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי בָאוּ בָנִים עַד־מַשְׁבֵּר וְכֹחַ אַיִן לְלֵדָה׃

english.text:
They said to him, “Thus said Hezekiah: This day is a day of
distress, of chastisement, and of disgrace. The babes have reached
the birthstool, but the strength to give birth is lacking.

translation.text: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy; for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.

verses.english:
They said to him, “Thus said Hezekiah: This day is a day of
distress, of chastisement, and of disgrace. The babes have reached
the birthstool, but the strength to give birth is lacking.

verses.hebrew:
אוּלַי יִשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵת כּל־דִּבְרֵי רַבְשָׁקֵה אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֲדֹנָיו לְחָרֵף אֱלֹהִים חַי וְהוֹכִיחַ בַּדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ
וְנָשָׂאתָ תְפִלָּה בְּעַד הַשְּׁאֵרִית הַנִּמְצָאָה׃

hebrew.text:
אוּלַי יִשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵת כּל־דִּבְרֵי רַבְשָׁקֵה אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֲדֹנָיו לְחָרֵף אֱלֹהִים חַי וְהוֹכִיחַ בַּדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ
וְנָשָׂאתָ תְפִלָּה בְּעַד הַשְּׁאֵרִית הַנִּמְצָאָה׃

english.text:
Perhaps YHWH your God will take note of all the words of the
Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to
blaspheme the living God, and will mete out judgment for the words
that YHWH your God has heard—if you will offer up prayer for the
surviving remnant.”

translation.text: It may be the LORD thy God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left.

verses.english:
Perhaps YHWH your God will take note of all the words of the
Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to
blaspheme the living God, and will mete out judgment for the words
that YHWH your God has heard—if you will offer up prayer for the
surviving remnant.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ׃

english.text: When King Hezekiah’s ministers came to Isaiah,

translation.text: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

verses.english: When King Hezekiah’s ministers came to Isaiah,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם יְשַׁעְיָהוּ כֹּה תֹאמְרוּן אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אַל־תִּירָא מִפְּנֵי הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתָּ אֲשֶׁר גִּדְּפוּ נַעֲרֵי מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֹתִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם יְשַׁעְיָהוּ כֹּה תֹאמְרוּן אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה אַל־תִּירָא מִפְּנֵי הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתָּ אֲשֶׁר גִּדְּפוּ נַעֲרֵי מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֹתִי׃

english.text:
Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master as follows: Thus said YHWH:
Do not be frightened by the words of blasphemy against Me that you
have heard from the minions of the king of Assyria.

translation.text: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

verses.english:
Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master as follows: Thus said YHWH:
Do not be frightened by the words of blasphemy against Me that you
have heard from the minions of the king of Assyria.

verses.hebrew: הִנְנִי נֹתֵן בּוֹ רוּחַ וְשָׁמַע שְׁמוּעָה וְשָׁב לְאַרְצוֹ וְהִפַּלְתִּיו בַּחֶרֶב בְּאַרְצוֹ׃

hebrew.text: הִנְנִי נֹתֵן בּוֹ רוּחַ וְשָׁמַע שְׁמוּעָה וְשָׁב לְאַרְצוֹ וְהִפַּלְתִּיו בַּחֶרֶב בְּאַרְצוֹ׃

english.text:
I will delude him; he will hear a rumor and return to his land,
and I will make him fall by the sword in his land.”

translation.text: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

verses.english:
I will delude him; he will hear a rumor and return to his land,
and I will make him fall by the sword in his land.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁב רַבְשָׁקֵה וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר נִלְחָם עַל־לִבְנָה כִּי שָׁמַע כִּי נָסַע מִלָּכִישׁ׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּשׁב רַבְשָׁקֵה וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר נִלְחָם עַל־לִבְנָה כִּי שָׁמַע כִּי נָסַע מִלָּכִישׁ׃

english.text:
The Rabshakeh, meanwhile, heard that [the king] had left Lachish;
he turned back and found the king of Assyria attacking Libnah.

translation.text: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

verses.english:
The Rabshakeh, meanwhile, heard that [the king] had left Lachish;
he turned back and found the king of Assyria attacking Libnah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֶל־תִּרְהָקָה מֶלֶךְ־כּוּשׁ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה יָצָא לְהִלָּחֵם אִתָּךְ וַיָּשׁב וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֶל־תִּרְהָקָה מֶלֶךְ־כּוּשׁ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה יָצָא לְהִלָּחֵם אִתָּךְ וַיָּשׁב וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
But [the king of Assyria] learned that King Tirhakah of Nubia had
come out to fight him; so he again sent messengers to Hezekiah,
saying,

translation.text: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against thee: he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah, saying,

verses.english:
But [the king of Assyria] learned that King Tirhakah of Nubia had
come out to fight him; so he again sent messengers to Hezekiah,
saying,

verses.hebrew: כֹּה תֹאמְרוּן אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר אַל־יַשִּׁאֲךָ אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בֹּטֵחַ בּוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא תִנָּתֵן יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בְּיַד מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

hebrew.text: כֹּה תֹאמְרוּן אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר אַל־יַשִּׁאֲךָ אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בֹּטֵחַ בּוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא תִנָּתֵן יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בְּיַד מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃

english.text:
“Tell this to King Hezekiah of Judah: Do not let your God, on whom
you are relying, mislead you into thinking that Jerusalem will not
be delivered into the hands of the king of Assyria.

translation.text: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.english:
“Tell this to King Hezekiah of Judah: Do not let your God, on whom
you are relying, mislead you into thinking that Jerusalem will not
be delivered into the hands of the king of Assyria.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אַתָּה שָׁמַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ מַלְכֵי אַשּׁוּר לְכל־הָאֲרָצוֹת לְהַחֲרִימָם וְאַתָּה תִּנָּצֵל׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה אַתָּה שָׁמַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ מַלְכֵי אַשּׁוּר לְכל־הָאֲרָצוֹת לְהַחֲרִימָם וְאַתָּה תִּנָּצֵל׃

english.text:
You yourself have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all
the lands, how they have annihilated them; and can you escape?

translation.text: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?

verses.english:
You yourself have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all
the lands, how they have annihilated them; and can you escape?

verses.hebrew: הַהִצִּילוּ אֹתָם אֱלֹהֵי הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר שִׁחֲתוּ אֲבוֹתַי אֶת־גּוֹזָן וְאֶת־חָרָן וְרֶצֶף וּבְנֵי־עֶדֶן אֲשֶׁר בִּתְלַאשָּׂר׃

hebrew.text: הַהִצִּילוּ אֹתָם אֱלֹהֵי הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר שִׁחֲתוּ אֲבוֹתַי אֶת־גּוֹזָן וְאֶת־חָרָן וְרֶצֶף וּבְנֵי־עֶדֶן אֲשֶׁר בִּתְלַאשָּׂר׃

english.text:
Were the nations that my predecessors destroyed—Gozan, Haran,
Rezeph, and the Beth-edenites in Telassar—saved by their gods?

translation.text: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Thelasar?

verses.english:
Were the nations that my predecessors destroyed—Gozan, Haran,
Rezeph, and the Beth-edenites in Telassar—saved by their gods?

verses.hebrew: אַיּוֹ מֶלֶךְ־חֲמָת וּמֶלֶךְ אַרְפָּד וּמֶלֶךְ לָעִיר סְפַרְוָיִם הֵנַע וְעִוָּה׃

hebrew.text: אַיּוֹ מֶלֶךְ־חֲמָת וּמֶלֶךְ אַרְפָּד וּמֶלֶךְ לָעִיר סְפַרְוָיִם הֵנַע וְעִוָּה׃

english.text:
Where is the king of Hamath? And the king of Arpad? And the kings
of Lair, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?”

translation.text: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?

verses.english:
Where is the king of Hamath? And the king of Arpad? And the kings
of Lair, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶת־הַסְּפָרִים מִיַּד הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיִּקְרָאֵם וַיַּעַל בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיִּפְרְשֵׂהוּ חִזְקִיָּהוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃
