hebrew.text: וַיִּקַּח חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶת־הַסְּפָרִים מִיַּד הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיִּקְרָאֵם וַיַּעַל בֵּית יְהֹוָה וַיִּפְרְשֵׂהוּ חִזְקִיָּהוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Hezekiah took the letter from the messengers and read it. Hezekiah
then went up to the House of YHWH and spread it out before YHWH.

translation.text: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.

verses.english:
Hezekiah took the letter from the messengers and read it. Hezekiah
then went up to the House of YHWH and spread it out before YHWH.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל חִזְקִיָּהוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרֻבִים אַתָּה־הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים לְבַדְּךָ לְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ
אֶת־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל חִזְקִיָּהוּ לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֹּאמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרֻבִים אַתָּה־הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים לְבַדְּךָ לְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ
אֶת־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

english.text:
And Hezekiah prayed to YHWH and said, “O LORD of Hosts, Enthroned
on the Cherubim! You alone are God of all the kingdoms of the
earth. You made the heavens and the earth.

translation.text: And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD, and said, O LORD God of Israel, which dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.

verses.english:
And Hezekiah prayed to YHWH and said, “O LORD of Hosts, Enthroned
on the Cherubim! You alone are God of all the kingdoms of the
earth. You made the heavens and the earth.

verses.hebrew: הַטֵּה יְהֹוָה אזְנְךָ וּשְׁמָע פְּקַח יְהֹוָה עֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה וּשְׁמַע אֵת דִּבְרֵי סַנְחֵרִיב אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ לְחָרֵף אֱלֹהִים חָי׃

hebrew.text: הַטֵּה יְהֹוָה אזְנְךָ וּשְׁמָע פְּקַח יְהֹוָה עֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה וּשְׁמַע אֵת דִּבְרֵי סַנְחֵרִיב אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ לְחָרֵף אֱלֹהִים חָי׃

english.text:
O LORD, incline Your ear and hear; open Your eyes and see. Hear
the words that Sennacherib has sent to blaspheme the living God!

translation.text: LORD, bow down thine ear, and hear: open, LORD, thine eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent him to reproach the living God.

verses.english:
O LORD, incline Your ear and hear; open Your eyes and see. Hear
the words that Sennacherib has sent to blaspheme the living God!

verses.hebrew: אמְנָם יְהֹוָה הֶחֱרִיבוּ מַלְכֵי אַשּׁוּר אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם וְאֶת־אַרְצָם׃

hebrew.text: אמְנָם יְהֹוָה הֶחֱרִיבוּ מַלְכֵי אַשּׁוּר אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם וְאֶת־אַרְצָם׃

english.text:
True, O LORD, the kings of Assyria have annihilated the nations
and their lands,

translation.text: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,

verses.english:
True, O LORD, the kings of Assyria have annihilated the nations
and their lands,

verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם בָּאֵשׁ כִּי לֹא אֱלֹהִים הֵמָּה כִּי אִם־מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי־אָדָם עֵץ וָאֶבֶן וַיְאַבְּדוּם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָתְנוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם בָּאֵשׁ כִּי לֹא אֱלֹהִים הֵמָּה כִּי אִם־מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי־אָדָם עֵץ וָאֶבֶן וַיְאַבְּדוּם׃

english.text:
and have committed their gods to the flames and have destroyed
them; for they are not gods, but man’s handiwork of wood and
stone.

translation.text: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

verses.english:
and have committed their gods to the flames and have destroyed
them; for they are not gods, but man’s handiwork of wood and
stone.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ נָא מִיָּדוֹ וְיֵדְעוּ כּל־מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶּךָ׃

hebrew.text: וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ נָא מִיָּדוֹ וְיֵדְעוּ כּל־מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶּךָ׃

english.text:
But now, O LORD our God, deliver us from his hands, and let all
the kingdoms of the earth know that You alone, O LORD, are God.”

translation.text: Now therefore, O LORD our God, I beseech thee, save thou us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the LORD God, even thou only.

verses.english:
But now, O LORD our God, deliver us from his hands, and let all
the kingdoms of the earth know that You alone, O LORD, are God.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְשַׁעְיָהוּ בֶן־אָמוֹץ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הִתְפַּלַּלְתָּ אֵלַי אֶל־סַנְחֵרִב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר שָׁמָעְתִּי׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְשַׁעְיָהוּ בֶן־אָמוֹץ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הִתְפַּלַּלְתָּ אֵלַי אֶל־סַנְחֵרִב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר שָׁמָעְתִּי׃

english.text:
Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent this message to Hezekiah: “Thus said
YHWH, the God of Israel: I have heard the prayer you have offered
to Me concerning King Sennacherib of Assyria.

translation.text: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.

verses.english:
Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent this message to Hezekiah: “Thus said
YHWH, the God of Israel: I have heard the prayer you have offered
to Me concerning King Sennacherib of Assyria.

verses.hebrew: זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה עָלָיו בָּזָה לְךָ לָעֲגָה לְךָ בְּתוּלַת בַּת־צִיּוֹן אַחֲרֶיךָ רֹאשׁ הֵנִיעָה בַּת יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהֹוָה עָלָיו בָּזָה לְךָ לָעֲגָה לְךָ בְּתוּלַת בַּת־צִיּוֹן אַחֲרֶיךָ רֹאשׁ הֵנִיעָה בַּת יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
This is the word that YHWH has spoken concerning him: “Fair Maiden
Zion despises you, She mocks at you; Fair Jerusalem shakes Her
head at you.

translation.text: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

verses.english:
This is the word that YHWH has spoken concerning him: “Fair Maiden
Zion despises you, She mocks at you; Fair Jerusalem shakes Her
head at you.

verses.hebrew: אֶת־מִי חֵרַפְתָּ וְגִדַּפְתָּ וְעַל־מִי הֲרִימוֹתָ קּוֹל וַתִּשָּׂא מָרוֹם עֵינֶיךָ עַל־קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: אֶת־מִי חֵרַפְתָּ וְגִדַּפְתָּ וְעַל־מִי הֲרִימוֹתָ קּוֹל וַתִּשָּׂא מָרוֹם עֵינֶיךָ עַל־קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
Whom have you blasphemed and reviled? Against whom made loud your
voice And haughtily raised your eyes? Against the Holy One of
Israel!

translation.text: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.

verses.english:
Whom have you blasphemed and reviled? Against whom made loud your
voice And haughtily raised your eyes? Against the Holy One of
Israel!

verses.hebrew:
בְּיַד מַלְאָכֶיךָ חֵרַפְתָּ אֲדֹנָי וַתֹּאמֶר (ברכב) [בְּרֹב] רִכְבִּי אֲנִי עָלִיתִי מְרוֹם הָרִים יַרְכְּתֵי לְבָנוֹן וְאֶכְרֹת קוֹמַת אֲרָזָיו מִבְחוֹר בְּרֹשָׁיו וְאָבוֹאָה
מְלוֹן קִצֹּה יַעַר כַּרְמִלּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
בְּיַד מַלְאָכֶיךָ חֵרַפְתָּ אֲדֹנָי וַתֹּאמֶר (ברכב) [בְּרֹב] רִכְבִּי אֲנִי עָלִיתִי מְרוֹם הָרִים יַרְכְּתֵי לְבָנוֹן וְאֶכְרֹת קוֹמַת אֲרָזָיו מִבְחוֹר בְּרֹשָׁיו וְאָבוֹאָה
מְלוֹן קִצֹּה יַעַר כַּרְמִלּוֹ׃

english.text:
Through your envoys you have blasphemed my Lord. Because you
thought, ‘Thanks to my vast chariotry, It is I who have climbed
the highest mountains, To the remotest parts of the Lebanon, And
have cut down its loftiest cedars, Its choicest cypresses, And
have reached its remotest lodge, Its densest forest.

translation.text: By thy messengers thou hast reproached the LORD, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders, and into the forest of his Carmel.

verses.english:
Through your envoys you have blasphemed my Lord. Because you
thought, ‘Thanks to my vast chariotry, It is I who have climbed
the highest mountains, To the remotest parts of the Lebanon, And
have cut down its loftiest cedars, Its choicest cypresses, And
have reached its remotest lodge, Its densest forest.

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי קַרְתִּי וְשָׁתִיתִי מַיִם זָרִים וְאַחְרִב בְּכַף־פְּעָמַי כֹּל יְאֹרֵי מָצוֹר׃

hebrew.text: אֲנִי קַרְתִּי וְשָׁתִיתִי מַיִם זָרִים וְאַחְרִב בְּכַף־פְּעָמַי כֹּל יְאֹרֵי מָצוֹר׃

english.text:
It is I who have drawn and drunk the waters of strangers; I have
dried up with the soles of my feet All the streams of Egypt.’

translation.text: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.

verses.english:
It is I who have drawn and drunk the waters of strangers; I have
dried up with the soles of my feet All the streams of Egypt.’

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ לְמֵרָחוֹק אֹתָהּ עָשִׂיתִי לְמִימֵי קֶדֶם וִיצַרְתִּיהָ עַתָּה הֲבֵיאתִיהָ וּתְהִי לַהְשׁוֹת גַּלִּים נִצִּים עָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת׃

hebrew.text: הֲלֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ לְמֵרָחוֹק אֹתָהּ עָשִׂיתִי לְמִימֵי קֶדֶם וִיצַרְתִּיהָ עַתָּה הֲבֵיאתִיהָ וּתְהִי לַהְשׁוֹת גַּלִּים נִצִּים עָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת׃

english.text:
Have you not heard? Of old I planned that very thing, I designed
it long ago, And now have fulfilled it. And it has come to pass,
Laying waste fortified towns In desolate heaps.

translation.text: Hast thou not heard long ago how I have done it, and of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities into ruinous heaps.

verses.english:
Have you not heard? Of old I planned that very thing, I designed
it long ago, And now have fulfilled it. And it has come to pass,
Laying waste fortified towns In desolate heaps.

verses.hebrew: וְיֹשְׁבֵיהֶן קִצְרֵי־יָד חַתּוּ וַיֵּבֹשׁוּ הָיוּ עֵשֶׂב שָׂדֶה וִירַק דֶּשֶׁא חֲצִיר גַּגּוֹת וּשְׁדֵפָה לִפְנֵי קָמָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֹשְׁבֵיהֶן קִצְרֵי־יָד חַתּוּ וַיֵּבֹשׁוּ הָיוּ עֵשֶׂב שָׂדֶה וִירַק דֶּשֶׁא חֲצִיר גַּגּוֹת וּשְׁדֵפָה לִפְנֵי קָמָה׃

english.text:
Their inhabitants are helpless, Dismayed and shamed. They were but
grass of the field And green herbage, Grass of the roofs that is
blasted Before the standing grain.

translation.text: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the house tops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.

verses.english:
Their inhabitants are helpless, Dismayed and shamed. They were but
grass of the field And green herbage, Grass of the roofs that is
blasted Before the standing grain.

verses.hebrew: וְשִׁבְתְּךָ וְצֵאתְךָ וּבֹאֲךָ יָדָעְתִּי וְאֵת הִתְרַגֶּזְךָ אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וְשִׁבְתְּךָ וְצֵאתְךָ וּבֹאֲךָ יָדָעְתִּי וְאֵת הִתְרַגֶּזְךָ אֵלָי׃

english.text:
I know your stayings And your goings and comings, And how you have
raged against Me.

translation.text: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

verses.english:
I know your stayings And your goings and comings, And how you have
raged against Me.

verses.hebrew: יַעַן הִתְרַגֶּזְךָ אֵלַי וְשַׁאֲנַנְךָ עָלָה בְאזְנָי וְשַׂמְתִּי חַחִי בְּאַפֶּךָ וּמִתְגִּי בִּשְׂפָתֶיךָ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִיךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאתָ בָּהּ׃

hebrew.text: יַעַן הִתְרַגֶּזְךָ אֵלַי וְשַׁאֲנַנְךָ עָלָה בְאזְנָי וְשַׂמְתִּי חַחִי בְּאַפֶּךָ וּמִתְגִּי בִּשְׂפָתֶיךָ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִיךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאתָ בָּהּ׃

english.text:
Because you have raged against Me, And your tumult has reached My
ears, I will place My hook in your nose And My bit between your
jaws; And I will make you go back by the road By which you came.

translation.text: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

verses.english:
Because you have raged against Me, And your tumult has reached My
ears, I will place My hook in your nose And My bit between your
jaws; And I will make you go back by the road By which you came.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה־לְּךָ הָאוֹת אָכוֹל הַשָּׁנָה סָפִיחַ וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית סָחִישׁ וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁלִישִׁית זִרְעוּ וְקִצְרוּ וְנִטְעוּ כְרָמִים וְאִכְלוּ פִרְיָם׃

hebrew.text: וְזֶה־לְּךָ הָאוֹת אָכוֹל הַשָּׁנָה סָפִיחַ וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית סָחִישׁ וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁלִישִׁית זִרְעוּ וְקִצְרוּ וְנִטְעוּ כְרָמִים וְאִכְלוּ פִרְיָם׃

english.text:
“And this is the sign for you: This year you eat what grows of
itself, and the next year what springs from that; and in the third
year, sow and reap, and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

translation.text: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.

verses.english:
“And this is the sign for you: This year you eat what grows of
itself, and the next year what springs from that; and in the third
year, sow and reap, and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

verses.hebrew: וְיָסְפָה פְּלֵיטַת בֵּית־יְהוּדָה הַנִּשְׁאָרָה שֹׁרֶשׁ לְמָטָּה וְעָשָׂה פְרִי לְמָעְלָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיָסְפָה פְּלֵיטַת בֵּית־יְהוּדָה הַנִּשְׁאָרָה שֹׁרֶשׁ לְמָטָּה וְעָשָׂה פְרִי לְמָעְלָה׃

english.text:
And the survivors of the House of Judah that have escaped shall
regenerate its stock below and produce boughs above.

translation.text: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

verses.english:
And the survivors of the House of Judah that have escaped shall
regenerate its stock below and produce boughs above.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם תֵּצֵא שְׁאֵרִית וּפְלֵיטָה מֵהַר צִיּוֹן קִנְאַת יְהֹוָה [צְבָאוֹת] תַּעֲשֶׂה־זֹּאת׃

hebrew.text: כִּי מִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם תֵּצֵא שְׁאֵרִית וּפְלֵיטָה מֵהַר צִיּוֹן קִנְאַת יְהֹוָה [צְבָאוֹת] תַּעֲשֶׂה־זֹּאת׃

english.text:
For a remnant shall come forth from Jerusalem, Survivors from
Mount Zion. The zeal of YHWH of Hosts Shall bring this to pass.

translation.text: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.

verses.english:
For a remnant shall come forth from Jerusalem, Survivors from
Mount Zion. The zeal of YHWH of Hosts Shall bring this to pass.

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֶל־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר לֹא יָבֹא אֶל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת וְלֹא־יוֹרֶה שָׁם חֵץ וְלֹא־יְקַדְּמֶנָּה מָגֵן וְלֹא־יִשְׁפֹּךְ עָלֶיהָ סֹלְלָה׃

hebrew.text: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֶל־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר לֹא יָבֹא אֶל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת וְלֹא־יוֹרֶה שָׁם חֵץ וְלֹא־יְקַדְּמֶנָּה מָגֵן וְלֹא־יִשְׁפֹּךְ עָלֶיהָ סֹלְלָה׃

english.text:
Assuredly, thus said YHWH concerning the king of Assyria: He shall
not enter this city: He shall not shoot an arrow at it, Or advance
upon it with a shield, Or pile up a siege mound against it.

translation.text: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.

verses.english:
Assuredly, thus said YHWH concerning the king of Assyria: He shall
not enter this city: He shall not shoot an arrow at it, Or advance
upon it with a shield, Or pile up a siege mound against it.

verses.hebrew: בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־יָבֹא בָּהּ יָשׁוּב וְאֶל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת לֹא יָבֹא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־יָבֹא בָּהּ יָשׁוּב וְאֶל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת לֹא יָבֹא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
He shall go back By the way he came; He shall not enter this city
—declares YHWH.

translation.text: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.

verses.english:
He shall go back By the way he came; He shall not enter this city
—declares YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְגַנּוֹתִי אֶל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת לְהוֹשִׁיעָהּ לְמַעֲנִי וּלְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְגַנּוֹתִי אֶל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת לְהוֹשִׁיעָהּ לְמַעֲנִי וּלְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי׃

english.text:
I will protect and save this city for My sake, And for the sake of
My servant David.”

translation.text: For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

verses.english:
I will protect and save this city for My sake, And for the sake of
My servant David.”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיֵּצֵא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה וַיַּךְ בְּמַחֲנֵה אַשּׁוּר מֵאָה שְׁמוֹנִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה אָלֶף וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ בַבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה כֻלָּם פְּגָרִים מֵתִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיֵּצֵא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה וַיַּךְ בְּמַחֲנֵה אַשּׁוּר מֵאָה שְׁמוֹנִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה אָלֶף וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ בַבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה כֻלָּם פְּגָרִים מֵתִים׃

english.text:
That night an angel of YHWH went out and struck down one hundred
and eighty-five thousand in the Assyrian camp, and the following
morning they were all dead corpses.

translation.text: And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the LORD went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.

verses.english:
That night an angel of YHWH went out and struck down one hundred
and eighty-five thousand in the Assyrian camp, and the following
morning they were all dead corpses.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסַּע וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּשׁב סַנְחֵרִיב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּנִינְוֵה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּסַּע וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּשׁב סַנְחֵרִיב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּנִינְוֵה׃

english.text:
So King Sennacherib of Assyria broke camp and retreated, and
stayed in Nineveh.

translation.text: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

verses.english:
So King Sennacherib of Assyria broke camp and retreated, and
stayed in Nineveh.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי הוּא מִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה בֵּית נִסְרֹךְ אֱלֹהָיו וְאַדְרַמֶּלֶךְ וְשַׂרְאֶצֶר [בָּנָיו] הִכֻּהוּ בַחֶרֶב וְהֵמָּה נִמְלְטוּ אֶרֶץ אֲרָרָט וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֵסַר־חַדֹּן בְּנוֹ
תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי הוּא מִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה בֵּית נִסְרֹךְ אֱלֹהָיו וְאַדְרַמֶּלֶךְ וְשַׂרְאֶצֶר [בָּנָיו] הִכֻּהוּ בַחֶרֶב וְהֵמָּה נִמְלְטוּ אֶרֶץ אֲרָרָט וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֵסַר־חַדֹּן בְּנוֹ
תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
While he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, his sons
Adrammelech and Sarezer struck him down with the sword. They fled
to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon succeeded him as
king.

translation.text: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
While he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, his sons
Adrammelech and Sarezer struck him down with the sword. They fled
to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon succeeded him as
king.

verses.hebrew: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם חָלָה חִזְקִיָּהוּ לָמוּת וַיָּבֹא אֵלָיו יְשַׁעְיָהוּ בֶן־אָמוֹץ הַנָּבִיא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה צַו לְבֵיתֶךָ כִּי מֵת אַתָּה וְלֹא תִחְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם חָלָה חִזְקִיָּהוּ לָמוּת וַיָּבֹא אֵלָיו יְשַׁעְיָהוּ בֶן־אָמוֹץ הַנָּבִיא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה צַו לְבֵיתֶךָ כִּי מֵת אַתָּה וְלֹא תִחְיֶה׃

english.text:
In those days Hezekiah fell dangerously ill. The prophet Isaiah
son of Amoz came and said to him, “Thus said YHWH: Set your
affairs in order, for you are going to die; you will not get
well.”

translation.text: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.

verses.english:
In those days Hezekiah fell dangerously ill. The prophet Isaiah
son of Amoz came and said to him, “Thus said YHWH: Set your
affairs in order, for you are going to die; you will not get
well.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־פָּנָיו אֶל־הַקִּיר וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־פָּנָיו אֶל־הַקִּיר וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
Thereupon Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to YHWH.
He said,

translation.text: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto the LORD, saying,

verses.english:
Thereupon Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to YHWH.
He said,

verses.hebrew: אָנָּה יְהֹוָה זְכר־נָא אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת וּבְלֵבָב שָׁלֵם וְהַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ עָשִׂיתִי וַיֵּבְךְּ חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְּכִי גָדוֹל׃

hebrew.text: אָנָּה יְהֹוָה זְכר־נָא אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת וּבְלֵבָב שָׁלֵם וְהַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ עָשִׂיתִי וַיֵּבְךְּ חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְּכִי גָדוֹל׃

english.text:
“Please, O LORD, remember how I have walked before You sincerely
and wholeheartedly, and have done what is pleasing to You.” And
Hezekiah wept profusely.

translation.text: I beseech thee, O LORD, remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

verses.english:
“Please, O LORD, remember how I have walked before You sincerely
and wholeheartedly, and have done what is pleasing to You.” And
Hezekiah wept profusely.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יְשַׁעְיָהוּ לֹא יָצָא (העיר) [חָצֵר] הַתִּיכֹנָה וּדְבַר־יְהֹוָה הָיָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי יְשַׁעְיָהוּ לֹא יָצָא (העיר) [חָצֵר] הַתִּיכֹנָה וּדְבַר־יְהֹוָה הָיָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
Before Isaiah had gone out of the middle court, the word of YHWH
came to him:

translation.text: And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of the LORD came to him, saying,

verses.english:
Before Isaiah had gone out of the middle court, the word of YHWH
came to him:

verses.hebrew:
שׁוּב וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ נְגִיד־עַמִּי כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי דָּוִד אָבִיךָ שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת־תְּפִלָּתֶךָ רָאִיתִי אֶת־דִּמְעָתֶךָ הִנְנִי רֹפֶא לָךְ בַּיּוֹם
הַשְּׁלִישִׁי תַּעֲלֶה בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
שׁוּב וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ נְגִיד־עַמִּי כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי דָּוִד אָבִיךָ שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת־תְּפִלָּתֶךָ רָאִיתִי אֶת־דִּמְעָתֶךָ הִנְנִי רֹפֶא לָךְ בַּיּוֹם
הַשְּׁלִישִׁי תַּעֲלֶה בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
“Go back and say to Hezekiah, the ruler of My people: Thus said
YHWH, the God of your father David: I have heard your prayer, I
have seen your tears. I am going to heal you; on the third day you
shall go up to the House of YHWH.

translation.text: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
“Go back and say to Hezekiah, the ruler of My people: Thus said
YHWH, the God of your father David: I have heard your prayer, I
have seen your tears. I am going to heal you; on the third day you
shall go up to the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְהֹסַפְתִּי עַל־יָמֶיךָ חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וּמִכַּף מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אַצִּילְךָ וְאֵת הָעִיר הַזֹּאת וְגַנּוֹתִי עַל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת לְמַעֲנִי וּלְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי׃

hebrew.text: וְהֹסַפְתִּי עַל־יָמֶיךָ חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וּמִכַּף מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אַצִּילְךָ וְאֵת הָעִיר הַזֹּאת וְגַנּוֹתִי עַל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת לְמַעֲנִי וּלְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי׃

english.text:
And I will add fifteen years to your life. I will also rescue you
and this city from the hands of the king of Assyria. I will
protect this city for My sake and for the sake of My servant
David.”—

translation.text: And I will add unto thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

verses.english:
And I will add fifteen years to your life. I will also rescue you
and this city from the hands of the king of Assyria. I will
protect this city for My sake and for the sake of My servant
David.”—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַׁעְיָהוּ קְחוּ דְּבֶלֶת תְּאֵנִים וַיִּקְחוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל־הַשְּׁחִין וַיֶּחִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַׁעְיָהוּ קְחוּ דְּבֶלֶת תְּאֵנִים וַיִּקְחוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל־הַשְּׁחִין וַיֶּחִי׃

english.text:
Then Isaiah said, “Get a cake of figs.” And they got one, and they
applied it to the rash, and he recovered.—

translation.text: And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.

verses.english:
Then Isaiah said, “Get a cake of figs.” And they got one, and they
applied it to the rash, and he recovered.—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ מָה אוֹת כִּי־יִרְפָּא יְהֹוָה לִי וְעָלִיתִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ מָה אוֹת כִּי־יִרְפָּא יְהֹוָה לִי וְעָלִיתִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Hezekiah asked Isaiah, “What is the sign that YHWH will heal me
and that I shall go up to the House of YHWH on the third day?”

translation.text: And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah, What shall be the sign that the LORD will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of the LORD the third day?

verses.english:
Hezekiah asked Isaiah, “What is the sign that YHWH will heal me
and that I shall go up to the House of YHWH on the third day?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַׁעְיָהוּ זֶה־לְּךָ הָאוֹת מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה כִּי יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר הָלַךְ הַצֵּל עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת אִם־יָשׁוּב עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַׁעְיָהוּ זֶה־לְּךָ הָאוֹת מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה כִּי יַעֲשֶׂה יְהֹוָה אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר הָלַךְ הַצֵּל עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת אִם־יָשׁוּב עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת׃

english.text:
Isaiah replied, “This is the sign for you from YHWH that YHWH will
do the thing that He has promised: Shall the shadow advance ten
steps or recede ten steps?”

translation.text: And Isaiah said, This sign shalt thou have of the LORD, that the LORD will do the thing that he hath spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?

verses.english:
Isaiah replied, “This is the sign for you from YHWH that YHWH will
do the thing that He has promised: Shall the shadow advance ten
steps or recede ten steps?”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ נָקֵל לַצֵּל לִנְטוֹת עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת לֹא כִי יָשׁוּב הַצֵּל אֲחֹרַנִּית עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ נָקֵל לַצֵּל לִנְטוֹת עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת לֹא כִי יָשׁוּב הַצֵּל אֲחֹרַנִּית עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת׃

english.text:
Hezekiah said, “It is easy for the shadow to lengthen ten steps,
but not for the shadow to recede ten steps.”

translation.text: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.

verses.english:
Hezekiah said, “It is easy for the shadow to lengthen ten steps,
but not for the shadow to recede ten steps.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יְשַׁעְיָהוּ הַנָּבִיא אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־הַצֵּל בַּמַּעֲלוֹת אֲשֶׁר יָרְדָה בְּמַעֲלוֹת אָחָז אֲחֹרַנִּית עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְרָא יְשַׁעְיָהוּ הַנָּבִיא אֶל־יְהֹוָה וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־הַצֵּל בַּמַּעֲלוֹת אֲשֶׁר יָרְדָה בְּמַעֲלוֹת אָחָז אֲחֹרַנִּית עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת׃

english.text:
So the prophet Isaiah called to YHWH, and He made the shadow which
had descended on the dial of Ahaz recede ten steps.

translation.text: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.

verses.english:
So the prophet Isaiah called to YHWH, and He made the shadow which
had descended on the dial of Ahaz recede ten steps.

verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא שָׁלַח בְּרֹאדַךְ בַּלְאֲדָן בֶּן־בַּלְאֲדָן מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל סְפָרִים וּמִנְחָה אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי שָׁמַע כִּי חָלָה חִזְקִיָּהוּ׃

hebrew.text: בָּעֵת הַהִיא שָׁלַח בְּרֹאדַךְ בַּלְאֲדָן בֶּן־בַּלְאֲדָן מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל סְפָרִים וּמִנְחָה אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי שָׁמַע כִּי חָלָה חִזְקִיָּהוּ׃

english.text:
At that time, King Berodach-baladan son of Baladan of Babylon sent
[envoys with] a letter and a gift to Hezekiah, for he had heard
about Hezekiah’s illness.

translation.text: At that time Berodachbaladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

verses.english:
At that time, King Berodach-baladan son of Baladan of Babylon sent
[envoys with] a letter and a gift to Hezekiah, for he had heard
about Hezekiah’s illness.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּשְׁמַע עֲלֵיהֶם חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיַּרְאֵם אֶת־כּל־בֵּית נְכֹתֹה אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַבְּשָׂמִים וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַטּוֹב וְאֵת בֵּית כֵּלָיו וְאֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא
בְּאוֹצְרֹתָיו לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הֶרְאָם חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְּבֵיתוֹ וּבְכל־מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּשְׁמַע עֲלֵיהֶם חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיַּרְאֵם אֶת־כּל־בֵּית נְכֹתֹה אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַבְּשָׂמִים וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַטּוֹב וְאֵת בֵּית כֵּלָיו וְאֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא
בְּאוֹצְרֹתָיו לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הֶרְאָם חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְּבֵיתוֹ וּבְכל־מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ׃

english.text:
Hezekiah heard about them and he showed them all his
treasure-house—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fragrant
oil—and his armory, and everything that was to be found in his
storehouses. There was nothing in his palace or in all his realm
that Hezekiah did not show them.

translation.text: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

verses.english:
Hezekiah heard about them and he showed them all his
treasure-house—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fragrant
oil—and his armory, and everything that was to be found in his
storehouses. There was nothing in his palace or in all his realm
that Hezekiah did not show them.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא יְשַׁעְיָהוּ הַנָּבִיא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מָה אָמְרוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה וּמֵאַיִן יָבֹאוּ אֵלֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה
בָּאוּ מִבָּבֶל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא יְשַׁעְיָהוּ הַנָּבִיא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מָה אָמְרוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה וּמֵאַיִן יָבֹאוּ אֵלֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה
בָּאוּ מִבָּבֶל׃

english.text:
Then the prophet Isaiah came to King Hezekiah. “What,” he demanded
of him, “did those men say to you? Where have they come to you
from?” “They have come,” Hezekiah replied, “from a far country,
from Babylon.”

translation.text: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, even from Babylon.

verses.english:
Then the prophet Isaiah came to King Hezekiah. “What,” he demanded
of him, “did those men say to you? Where have they come to you
from?” “They have come,” Hezekiah replied, “from a far country,
from Babylon.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה רָאוּ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵיתִי רָאוּ לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הִרְאִיתִם בְּאֹצְרֹתָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה רָאוּ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֵת כּל־אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵיתִי רָאוּ לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הִרְאִיתִם בְּאֹצְרֹתָי׃

english.text:
Next he asked, “What have they seen in your palace?” And Hezekiah
replied, “They have seen everything that is in my palace. There
was nothing in my storehouses that I did not show them.”

translation.text: And he said, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All the things that are in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

verses.english:
Next he asked, “What have they seen in your palace?” And Hezekiah
replied, “They have seen everything that is in my palace. There
was nothing in my storehouses that I did not show them.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַׁעְיָהוּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ שְׁמַע דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַׁעְיָהוּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ שְׁמַע דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of YHWH:

translation.text: And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD.

verses.english: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of YHWH:

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה יָמִים בָּאִים וְנִשָּׂא כּל־אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵיתֶךָ וַאֲשֶׁר אָצְרוּ אֲבֹתֶיךָ עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בָּבֶלָה לֹא־יִוָּתֵר דָּבָר אָמַר יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: הִנֵּה יָמִים בָּאִים וְנִשָּׂא כּל־אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵיתֶךָ וַאֲשֶׁר אָצְרוּ אֲבֹתֶיךָ עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בָּבֶלָה לֹא־יִוָּתֵר דָּבָר אָמַר יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
A time is coming when everything in your palace which your
ancestors have stored up to this day will be carried off to
Babylon; nothing will remain behind, said YHWH.

translation.text: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.

verses.english:
A time is coming when everything in your palace which your
ancestors have stored up to this day will be carried off to
Babylon; nothing will remain behind, said YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וּמִבָּנֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יֵצְאוּ מִמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר תּוֹלִיד (יקח) [יִקָּחוּ] וְהָיוּ סָרִיסִים בְּהֵיכַל מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל׃

hebrew.text: וּמִבָּנֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יֵצְאוּ מִמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר תּוֹלִיד (יקח) [יִקָּחוּ] וְהָיוּ סָרִיסִים בְּהֵיכַל מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל׃

english.text:
And some of your sons, your own issue, whom you will have
fathered, will be taken to serve as eunuchs in the palace of the
king of Babylon.”

translation.text: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

verses.english:
And some of your sons, your own issue, whom you will have
fathered, will be taken to serve as eunuchs in the palace of the
king of Babylon.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ טוֹב דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא אִם־שָׁלוֹם וֶאֱמֶת יִהְיֶה בְיָמָי׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ טוֹב דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא אִם־שָׁלוֹם וֶאֱמֶת יִהְיֶה בְיָמָי׃

english.text:
Hezekiah declared to Isaiah, “The word of YHWH that you have
spoken is good.” For he thought, “It means that safety is assured
for my time.”

translation.text: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. And he said, Is it not good, if peace and truth be in my days?

verses.english:
Hezekiah declared to Isaiah, “The word of YHWH that you have
spoken is good.” For he thought, “It means that safety is assured
for my time.”

verses.hebrew:
וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי חִזְקִיָּהוּ וְכל־גְּבוּרָתוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶת־הַבְּרֵכָה וְאֶת־הַתְּעָלָה וַיָּבֵא אֶת־הַמַּיִם הָעִירָה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים
לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text:
וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי חִזְקִיָּהוּ וְכל־גְּבוּרָתוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶת־הַבְּרֵכָה וְאֶת־הַתְּעָלָה וַיָּבֵא אֶת־הַמַּיִם הָעִירָה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים
לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Hezekiah’s reign, and all his exploits, and
how he made the pool and the conduit and brought the water into
the city, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.english:
The other events of Hezekiah’s reign, and all his exploits, and
how he made the pool and the conduit and brought the water into
the city, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב חִזְקִיָּהוּ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ מְנַשֶּׁה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב חִזְקִיָּהוּ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ מְנַשֶּׁה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and his son Manasseh succeeded
him as king.

translation.text: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and his son Manasseh succeeded
him as king.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מְנַשֶּׁה בְמלְכוֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ חֶפְצִי־בָהּ׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מְנַשֶּׁה בְמלְכוֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ חֶפְצִי־בָהּ׃

english.text:
Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned
fifty-five years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Hephzibah.

translation.text: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hephzibah.

verses.english:
Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned
fifty-five years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Hephzibah.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּתוֹעֲבֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כְּתוֹעֲבֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, following the abhorrent
practices of the nations that YHWH had dispossessed before the
Israelites.

translation.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, after the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, following the abhorrent
practices of the nations that YHWH had dispossessed before the
Israelites.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשׁב וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר אִבַּד חִזְקִיָּהוּ אָבִיו וַיָּקֶם מִזְבְּחֹת לַבַּעַל וַיַּעַשׂ אֲשֵׁרָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ
לְכל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיַּעֲבֹד אֹתָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשׁב וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר אִבַּד חִזְקִיָּהוּ אָבִיו וַיָּקֶם מִזְבְּחֹת לַבַּעַל וַיַּעַשׂ אֲשֵׁרָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ
לְכל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיַּעֲבֹד אֹתָם׃

english.text:
He rebuilt the shrines that his father Hezekiah had destroyed; he
erected altars for Baal and made a sacred post, as King Ahab of
Israel had done. He bowed down to all the host of heaven and
worshiped them,

translation.text: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

verses.english:
He rebuilt the shrines that his father Hezekiah had destroyed; he
erected altars for Baal and made a sacred post, as King Ahab of
Israel had done. He bowed down to all the host of heaven and
worshiped them,

verses.hebrew: וּבָנָה מִזְבְּחֹת בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אָשִׂים אֶת־שְׁמִי׃

hebrew.text: וּבָנָה מִזְבְּחֹת בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אָשִׂים אֶת־שְׁמִי׃

english.text:
and he built altars for them in the House of YHWH, of which YHWH
had said, “I will establish My name in Jerusalem.”

translation.text: And he built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.

verses.english:
and he built altars for them in the House of YHWH, of which YHWH
had said, “I will establish My name in Jerusalem.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן מִזְבְּחוֹת לְכל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם בִּשְׁתֵּי חַצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּבֶן מִזְבְּחוֹת לְכל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם בִּשְׁתֵּי חַצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
He built altars for all the hosts of heaven in the two courts of
the House of YHWH.

translation.text: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
He built altars for all the hosts of heaven in the two courts of
the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְהֶעֱבִיר אֶת־בְּנוֹ בָּאֵשׁ וְעוֹנֵן וְנִחֵשׁ וְעָשָׂה אוֹב וְיִדְּעֹנִים הִרְבָּה לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְהַכְעִיס׃

hebrew.text: וְהֶעֱבִיר אֶת־בְּנוֹ בָּאֵשׁ וְעוֹנֵן וְנִחֵשׁ וְעָשָׂה אוֹב וְיִדְּעֹנִים הִרְבָּה לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה לְהַכְעִיס׃

english.text:
He consigned his son to the fire; he practiced soothsaying and
divination, and consulted ghosts and familiar spirits; he did much
that was displeasing to YHWH, to vex Him.

translation.text: And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.

verses.english:
He consigned his son to the fire; he practiced soothsaying and
divination, and consulted ghosts and familiar spirits; he did much
that was displeasing to YHWH, to vex Him.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־פֶּסֶל הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בַּבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד וְאֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה וּבִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתִּי מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי
יִשְׂרָאֵל אָשִׂים אֶת־שְׁמִי לְעוֹלָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־פֶּסֶל הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בַּבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֶל־דָּוִד וְאֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה וּבִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתִּי מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי
יִשְׂרָאֵל אָשִׂים אֶת־שְׁמִי לְעוֹלָם׃

english.text:
The sculptured image of Asherah that he made he placed in the
House concerning which YHWH had said to David and to his son
Solomon, “In this House and in Jerusalem, which I chose out of all
the tribes of Israel, I will establish My name forever.

translation.text: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the LORD said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

verses.english:
The sculptured image of Asherah that he made he placed in the
House concerning which YHWH had said to David and to his son
Solomon, “In this House and in Jerusalem, which I chose out of all
the tribes of Israel, I will establish My name forever.

verses.hebrew:
וְלֹא אֹסִיף לְהָנִיד רֶגֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לַאֲבוֹתָם רַק אִם־יִשְׁמְרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִים וּלְכל־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה אֹתָם עַבְדִּי
מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text:
וְלֹא אֹסִיף לְהָנִיד רֶגֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לַאֲבוֹתָם רַק אִם־יִשְׁמְרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִים וּלְכל־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה אֹתָם עַבְדִּי
מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
And I will not again cause the feet of Israel to wander from the
land that I gave to their fathers, if they will but faithfully
observe all that I have commanded them—all the Teachings with
which My servant Moses charged them.”

translation.text: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.

verses.english:
And I will not again cause the feet of Israel to wander from the
land that I gave to their fathers, if they will but faithfully
observe all that I have commanded them—all the Teachings with
which My servant Moses charged them.”

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ וַיַּתְעֵם מְנַשֶּׁה לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־הָרָע מִן־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁמִיד יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ וַיַּתְעֵם מְנַשֶּׁה לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־הָרָע מִן־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁמִיד יְהֹוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
But they did not obey, and Manasseh led them astray to do greater
evil than the nations that YHWH had destroyed before the
Israelites.

translation.text: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.

verses.english:
But they did not obey, and Manasseh led them astray to do greater
evil than the nations that YHWH had destroyed before the
Israelites.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־עֲבָדָיו הַנְּבִיאִים לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה בְּיַד־עֲבָדָיו הַנְּבִיאִים לֵאמֹר׃

english.text: Therefore YHWH spoke through His servants the prophets:

translation.text: And the LORD spake by his servants the prophets, saying,

verses.english: Therefore YHWH spoke through His servants the prophets:

verses.hebrew: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מְנַשֶּׁה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה הַתֹּעֵבוֹת הָאֵלֶּה הֵרַע מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו וַיַּחֲטִא גַם־אֶת־יְהוּדָה בְּגִלּוּלָיו׃

hebrew.text: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מְנַשֶּׁה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה הַתֹּעֵבוֹת הָאֵלֶּה הֵרַע מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו וַיַּחֲטִא גַם־אֶת־יְהוּדָה בְּגִלּוּלָיו׃

english.text:
“Because King Manasseh of Judah has done these abhorrent things—he
has outdone in wickedness all that the Amorites did before his
time—and because he led Judah to sin with his fetishes,

translation.text: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations, and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which were before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:

verses.english:
“Because King Manasseh of Judah has done these abhorrent things—he
has outdone in wickedness all that the Amorites did before his
time—and because he led Judah to sin with his fetishes,

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנְנִי מֵבִיא רָעָה עַל־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וִיהוּדָה אֲשֶׁר כּל־[שֹׁמְעָהּ] (שמעיו) תִּצַּלְנָה שְׁתֵּי אזְנָיו׃

hebrew.text: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנְנִי מֵבִיא רָעָה עַל־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וִיהוּדָה אֲשֶׁר כּל־[שֹׁמְעָהּ] (שמעיו) תִּצַּלְנָה שְׁתֵּי אזְנָיו׃

english.text:
assuredly, thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: I am going to bring
such a disaster on Jerusalem and Judah that both ears of everyone
who hears about it will tingle.

translation.text: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.

verses.english:
assuredly, thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: I am going to bring
such a disaster on Jerusalem and Judah that both ears of everyone
who hears about it will tingle.

verses.hebrew: וְנָטִיתִי עַל־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֵת קָו שֹׁמְרוֹן וְאֶת־מִשְׁקֹלֶת בֵּית אַחְאָב וּמָחִיתִי אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם כַּאֲשֶׁר־יִמְחֶה אֶת־הַצַּלַּחַת מָחָה וְהָפַךְ עַל־פָּנֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text: וְנָטִיתִי עַל־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֵת קָו שֹׁמְרוֹן וְאֶת־מִשְׁקֹלֶת בֵּית אַחְאָב וּמָחִיתִי אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם כַּאֲשֶׁר־יִמְחֶה אֶת־הַצַּלַּחַת מָחָה וְהָפַךְ עַל־פָּנֶיהָ׃

english.text:
I will apply to Jerusalem the measuring line of Samaria and the
weights of the House of Ahab; I will wipe Jerusalem clean as one
wipes a dish and turns it upside down.

translation.text: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it, and turning it upside down.

verses.english:
I will apply to Jerusalem the measuring line of Samaria and the
weights of the House of Ahab; I will wipe Jerusalem clean as one
wipes a dish and turns it upside down.

verses.hebrew: וְנָטַשְׁתִּי אֵת שְׁאֵרִית נַחֲלָתִי וּנְתַתִּים בְּיַד אֹיְבֵיהֶם וְהָיוּ לְבַז וְלִמְשִׁסָּה לְכל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְנָטַשְׁתִּי אֵת שְׁאֵרִית נַחֲלָתִי וּנְתַתִּים בְּיַד אֹיְבֵיהֶם וְהָיוּ לְבַז וְלִמְשִׁסָּה לְכל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And I will cast off the remnant of My own people and deliver them
into the hands of their enemies. They shall be plunder and prey to
all their enemies

translation.text: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;

verses.english:
And I will cast off the remnant of My own people and deliver them
into the hands of their enemies. They shall be plunder and prey to
all their enemies

verses.hebrew: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינַי וַיִּהְיוּ מַכְעִסִים אֹתִי מִן־הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ אֲבוֹתָם מִמִּצְרַיִם וְעַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינַי וַיִּהְיוּ מַכְעִסִים אֹתִי מִן־הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ אֲבוֹתָם מִמִּצְרַיִם וְעַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
because they have done what is displeasing to Me and have been
vexing Me from the day that their fathers came out of Egypt to
this day.”

translation.text: Because they have done that which was evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.

verses.english:
because they have done what is displeasing to Me and have been
vexing Me from the day that their fathers came out of Egypt to
this day.”

verses.hebrew: וְגַם דָּם נָקִי שָׁפַךְ מְנַשֶּׁה הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד עַד אֲשֶׁר־מִלֵּא אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם פֶּה לָפֶה לְבַד מֵחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יְהוּדָה לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם דָּם נָקִי שָׁפַךְ מְנַשֶּׁה הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד עַד אֲשֶׁר־מִלֵּא אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם פֶּה לָפֶה לְבַד מֵחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יְהוּדָה לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Moreover, Manasseh put so many innocent persons to death that he
filled Jerusalem [with blood] from end to end—besides the sin he
committed in causing Judah to do what was displeasing to YHWH.

translation.text: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of the LORD.

verses.english:
Moreover, Manasseh put so many innocent persons to death that he
filled Jerusalem [with blood] from end to end—besides the sin he
committed in causing Judah to do what was displeasing to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי מְנַשֶּׁה וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי מְנַשֶּׁה וְכל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Manasseh’s reign, and all his actions, and the
sins he committed, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of
Judah.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.english:
The other events of Manasseh’s reign, and all his actions, and the
sins he committed, are recorded in the Annals of the Kings of
Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב מְנַשֶּׁה עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּגַן־בֵּיתוֹ בְּגַן־עֻזָּא וַיִּמְלֹךְ אָמוֹן בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב מְנַשֶּׁה עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּגַן־בֵּיתוֹ בְּגַן־עֻזָּא וַיִּמְלֹךְ אָמוֹן בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
Manasseh slept with his fathers and was buried in the garden of
his palace, in the garden of Uzza; and his son Amon succeeded him
as king.

translation.text: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
Manasseh slept with his fathers and was buried in the garden of
his palace, in the garden of Uzza; and his son Amon succeeded him
as king.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה אָמוֹן בְּמלְכוֹ וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנִים מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ מְשֻׁלֶּמֶת בַּת־חָרוּץ מִן־יטְבָה׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה אָמוֹן בְּמלְכוֹ וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנִים מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ מְשֻׁלֶּמֶת בַּת־חָרוּץ מִן־יטְבָה׃

english.text:
Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned
two years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Meshullemeth
daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

translation.text: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

verses.english:
Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned
two years in Jerusalem; his mother’s name was Meshullemeth
daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מְנַשֶּׁה אָבִיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מְנַשֶּׁה אָבִיו׃

english.text:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, as his father Manasseh had
done.

translation.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his father Manasseh did.

verses.english:
He did what was displeasing to YHWH, as his father Manasseh had
done.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכל־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ אָבִיו וַיַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַגִּלֻּלִים אֲשֶׁר עָבַד אָבִיו וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכל־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ אָבִיו וַיַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַגִּלֻּלִים אֲשֶׁר עָבַד אָבִיו וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לָהֶם׃

english.text:
He walked in all the ways of his father, worshiping the fetishes
which his father had worshiped and bowing down to them.

translation.text: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:

verses.english:
He walked in all the ways of his father, worshiping the fetishes
which his father had worshiped and bowing down to them.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתָיו וְלֹא הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתָיו וְלֹא הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
He forsook YHWH, the God of his fathers, and did not follow the
way of YHWH.

translation.text: And he forsook the LORD God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the LORD.

verses.english:
He forsook YHWH, the God of his fathers, and did not follow the
way of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ עַבְדֵי־אָמוֹן עָלָיו וַיָּמִיתוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּבֵיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ עַבְדֵי־אָמוֹן עָלָיו וַיָּמִיתוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּבֵיתוֹ׃

english.text:
Amon’s courtiers conspired against him; and they killed the king
in his palace.

translation.text: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.

verses.english:
Amon’s courtiers conspired against him; and they killed the king
in his palace.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ עַם־הָאָרֶץ אֵת כּל־הַקֹּשְׁרִים עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אָמוֹן וַיַּמְלִיכוּ עַם־הָאָרֶץ אֶת־יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּךְ עַם־הָאָרֶץ אֵת כּל־הַקֹּשְׁרִים עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אָמוֹן וַיַּמְלִיכוּ עַם־הָאָרֶץ אֶת־יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
But the people of the land put to death all who had conspired
against King Amon, and the people of the land made his son Josiah
king in his stead.

translation.text: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

verses.english:
But the people of the land put to death all who had conspired
against King Amon, and the people of the land made his son Josiah
king in his stead.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אָמוֹן אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אָמוֹן אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
The other events of Amon’s reign [and] his actions are recorded in
the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

translation.text: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.english:
The other events of Amon’s reign [and] his actions are recorded in
the Annals of the Kings of Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבֹּר אֹתוֹ בִּקְבֻרָתוֹ בְּגַן־עֻזָּא וַיִּמְלֹךְ יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּקְבֹּר אֹתוֹ בִּקְבֻרָתוֹ בְּגַן־עֻזָּא וַיִּמְלֹךְ יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

english.text:
He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza; and his son
Josiah succeeded him as king.

translation.text: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.english:
He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza; and his son
Josiah succeeded him as king.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ בְמלְכוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ יְדִידָה בַת־עֲדָיָה מִבָּצְקַת׃

hebrew.text: בֶּן־שְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ בְמלְכוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ יְדִידָה בַת־עֲדָיָה מִבָּצְקַת׃

english.text:
Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned
thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jedidah
daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

translation.text: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.

verses.english:
Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned
thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jedidah
daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכל־דֶּרֶךְ דָּוִד אָבִיו וְלֹא־סָר יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהֹוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכל־דֶּרֶךְ דָּוִד אָבִיו וְלֹא־סָר יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול׃

english.text:
He did what was pleasing to YHWH and he followed all the ways of
his ancestor David; he did not deviate to the right or to the
left.

translation.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.

verses.english:
He did what was pleasing to YHWH and he followed all the ways of
his ancestor David; he did not deviate to the right or to the
left.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ שָׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־שָׁפָן בֶּן־אֲצַלְיָהוּ בֶן־מְשֻׁלָּם הַסֹּפֵר בֵּית יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ שָׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־שָׁפָן בֶּן־אֲצַלְיָהוּ בֶן־מְשֻׁלָּם הַסֹּפֵר בֵּית יְהֹוָה לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
In the eighteenth year of King Josiah, the king sent the scribe
Shaphan son of Azaliah son of Meshullam to the House of YHWH,
saying,

translation.text: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the LORD, saying,

verses.english:
In the eighteenth year of King Josiah, the king sent the scribe
Shaphan son of Azaliah son of Meshullam to the House of YHWH,
saying,

verses.hebrew: עֲלֵה אֶל־חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וְיַתֵּם אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּבָא בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר אָסְפוּ שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּף מֵאֵת הָעָם׃

hebrew.text: עֲלֵה אֶל־חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וְיַתֵּם אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּבָא בֵּית יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר אָסְפוּ שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּף מֵאֵת הָעָם׃

english.text:
“Go to the high priest Hilkiah and let him weigh the silver that
has been deposited in the House of YHWH, which the guards of the
threshold have collected from the people.

translation.text: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the LORD, which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:

verses.english:
“Go to the high priest Hilkiah and let him weigh the silver that
has been deposited in the House of YHWH, which the guards of the
threshold have collected from the people.

verses.hebrew: (ויתנה) [וְיִתְּנוּהוּ] עַל־יַד עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה הַמֻּפְקָדִים (בבית) [בֵּית] יְהֹוָה וְיִתְּנוּ אֹתוֹ לְעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה לְחַזֵּק בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: (ויתנה) [וְיִתְּנוּהוּ] עַל־יַד עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה הַמֻּפְקָדִים (בבית) [בֵּית] יְהֹוָה וְיִתְּנוּ אֹתוֹ לְעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה לְחַזֵּק בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
And let it be delivered to the overseers of the work who are in
charge at the House of YHWH, that they in turn may pay it out to
the workmen that are in the House of YHWH, for the repair of the
House:

translation.text: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD: and let them give it to the doers of the work which is in the house of the LORD, to repair the breaches of the house,

verses.english:
And let it be delivered to the overseers of the work who are in
charge at the House of YHWH, that they in turn may pay it out to
the workmen that are in the House of YHWH, for the repair of the
House:

verses.hebrew: לֶחָרָשִׁים וְלַבֹּנִים וְלַגֹּדְרִים וְלִקְנוֹת עֵצִים וְאַבְנֵי מַחְצֵב לְחַזֵּק אֶת־הַבָּיִת׃

hebrew.text: לֶחָרָשִׁים וְלַבֹּנִים וְלַגֹּדְרִים וְלִקְנוֹת עֵצִים וְאַבְנֵי מַחְצֵב לְחַזֵּק אֶת־הַבָּיִת׃

english.text:
to the carpenters, the laborers, and the masons, and for the
purchase of wood and quarried stones for repairing the House.

translation.text: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.

verses.english:
to the carpenters, the laborers, and the masons, and for the
purchase of wood and quarried stones for repairing the House.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ לֹא־יֵחָשֵׁב אִתָּם הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּתָּן עַל־יָדָם כִּי בֶאֱמוּנָה הֵם עֹשִׂים׃

hebrew.text: אַךְ לֹא־יֵחָשֵׁב אִתָּם הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּתָּן עַל־יָדָם כִּי בֶאֱמוּנָה הֵם עֹשִׂים׃

english.text:
However, no check is to be kept on them for the silver that is
delivered to them, for they deal honestly.”

translation.text: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.

verses.english:
However, no check is to be kept on them for the silver that is
delivered to them, for they deal honestly.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל עַל־שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה מָצָאתִי בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה וַיִּתֵּן חִלְקִיָּה אֶת־הַסֵּפֶר אֶל־שָׁפָן וַיִּקְרָאֵהוּ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל עַל־שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה מָצָאתִי בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה וַיִּתֵּן חִלְקִיָּה אֶת־הַסֵּפֶר אֶל־שָׁפָן וַיִּקְרָאֵהוּ׃

english.text:
Then the high priest Hilkiah said to the scribe Shaphan, “I have
found a scroll of the Teaching in the House of YHWH.” And Hilkiah
gave the scroll to Shaphan, who read it.

translation.text: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

verses.english:
Then the high priest Hilkiah said to the scribe Shaphan, “I have
found a scroll of the Teaching in the House of YHWH.” And Hilkiah
gave the scroll to Shaphan, who read it.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּבֹא שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר וַיֹּאמֶר הִתִּיכוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בַבַּיִת וַיִּתְּנֻהוּ עַל־יַד עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה
הַמֻּפְקָדִים בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּבֹא שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר וַיֹּאמֶר הִתִּיכוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בַבַּיִת וַיִּתְּנֻהוּ עַל־יַד עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה
הַמֻּפְקָדִים בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The scribe Shaphan then went to the king and reported to the king:
“Your servants have melted down the silver that was deposited in
the House, and they have delivered it to the overseers of the work
who are in charge at the House of YHWH.”

translation.text: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
The scribe Shaphan then went to the king and reported to the king:
“Your servants have melted down the silver that was deposited in
the House, and they have delivered it to the overseers of the work
who are in charge at the House of YHWH.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר לַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר סֵפֶר נָתַן לִי חִלְקִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן וַיִּקְרָאֵהוּ שָׁפָן לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּגֵּד שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר לַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר סֵפֶר נָתַן לִי חִלְקִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן וַיִּקְרָאֵהוּ שָׁפָן לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
The scribe Shaphan also told the king, “The high priest Hilkiah
has given me a scroll”; and Shaphan read it to the king.

translation.text: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

verses.english:
The scribe Shaphan also told the king, “The high priest Hilkiah
has given me a scroll”; and Shaphan read it to the king.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו׃

english.text:
When the king heard the words of the scroll of the Teaching, he
rent his clothes.

translation.text: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.

verses.english:
When the king heard the words of the scroll of the Teaching, he
rent his clothes.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־חִלְקִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת־אֲחִיקָם בֶּן־שָׁפָן וְאֶת־עַכְבּוֹר בֶּן־מִיכָיָה וְאֵת שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר וְאֵת עֲשָׂיָה עֶבֶד־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר׃

hebrew.text: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־חִלְקִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת־אֲחִיקָם בֶּן־שָׁפָן וְאֶת־עַכְבּוֹר בֶּן־מִיכָיָה וְאֵת שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר וְאֵת עֲשָׂיָה עֶבֶד־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר׃

english.text:
And the king gave orders to the priest Hilkiah, and to Ahikam son
of Shaphan, Achbor son of Michaiah, the scribe Shaphan, and Asaiah
the king’s minister:

translation.text: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king’s, saying,

verses.english:
And the king gave orders to the priest Hilkiah, and to Ahikam son
of Shaphan, Achbor son of Michaiah, the scribe Shaphan, and Asaiah
the king’s minister:

verses.hebrew:
לְכוּ דִרְשׁוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה בַּעֲדִי וּבְעַד־הָעָם וּבְעַד כּל־יְהוּדָה עַל־דִּבְרֵי הַסֵּפֶר הַנִּמְצָא הַזֶּה כִּי־גְדוֹלָה חֲמַת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־הִיא נִצְּתָה בָנוּ עַל אֲשֶׁר
לֹא־שָׁמְעוּ אֲבֹתֵינוּ עַל־דִּבְרֵי הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכל־הַכָּתוּב עָלֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text:
לְכוּ דִרְשׁוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה בַּעֲדִי וּבְעַד־הָעָם וּבְעַד כּל־יְהוּדָה עַל־דִּבְרֵי הַסֵּפֶר הַנִּמְצָא הַזֶּה כִּי־גְדוֹלָה חֲמַת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר־הִיא נִצְּתָה בָנוּ עַל אֲשֶׁר
לֹא־שָׁמְעוּ אֲבֹתֵינוּ עַל־דִּבְרֵי הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכל־הַכָּתוּב עָלֵינוּ׃

english.text:
“Go, inquire of YHWH on my behalf, and on behalf of the people,
and on behalf of all Judah, concerning the words of this scroll
that has been found. For great indeed must be the wrath of YHWH
that has been kindled against us, because our fathers did not obey
the words of this scroll to do all that has been prescribed for
us.”

translation.text: Go ye, enquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.

verses.english:
“Go, inquire of YHWH on my behalf, and on behalf of the people,
and on behalf of all Judah, concerning the words of this scroll
that has been found. For great indeed must be the wrath of YHWH
that has been kindled against us, because our fathers did not obey
the words of this scroll to do all that has been prescribed for
us.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּלֶךְ חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן וַאֲחִיקָם וְעַכְבּוֹר וְשָׁפָן וַעֲשָׂיָה אֶל־חֻלְדָּה הַנְּבִיאָה אֵשֶׁת שַׁלֻּם בֶּן־תִּקְוָה בֶּן־חַרְחַס שֹׁמֵר הַבְּגָדִים וְהִיא יֹשֶׁבֶת
בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בַּמִּשְׁנֶה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלֶיהָ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֵּלֶךְ חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן וַאֲחִיקָם וְעַכְבּוֹר וְשָׁפָן וַעֲשָׂיָה אֶל־חֻלְדָּה הַנְּבִיאָה אֵשֶׁת שַׁלֻּם בֶּן־תִּקְוָה בֶּן־חַרְחַס שֹׁמֵר הַבְּגָדִים וְהִיא יֹשֶׁבֶת
בִּירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בַּמִּשְׁנֶה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלֶיהָ׃

english.text:
So the priest Hilkiah, and Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah
went to the prophetess Huldah—the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah
son of Harhas, the keeper of the wardrobe—who was living in
Jerusalem in the Mishneh, and they spoke to her.

translation.text: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.

verses.english:
So the priest Hilkiah, and Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah
went to the prophetess Huldah—the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah
son of Harhas, the keeper of the wardrobe—who was living in
Jerusalem in the Mishneh, and they spoke to her.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִמְרוּ לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח אֶתְכֶם אֵלָי׃

hebrew.text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִמְרוּ לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח אֶתְכֶם אֵלָי׃

english.text:
She responded: “Thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: Say to the man
who sent you to me:

translation.text: And she said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,

verses.english:
She responded: “Thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: Say to the man
who sent you to me:

verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הִנְנִי מֵבִיא רָעָה אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְעַל־יֹשְׁבָיו אֵת כּל־דִּבְרֵי הַסֵּפֶר אֲשֶׁר קָרָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

hebrew.text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה הִנְנִי מֵבִיא רָעָה אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְעַל־יֹשְׁבָיו אֵת כּל־דִּבְרֵי הַסֵּפֶר אֲשֶׁר קָרָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃

english.text:
Thus said YHWH: I am going to bring disaster upon this place and
its inhabitants, in accordance with all the words of the scroll
which the king of Judah has read.

translation.text: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:

verses.english:
Thus said YHWH: I am going to bring disaster upon this place and
its inhabitants, in accordance with all the words of the scroll
which the king of Judah has read.

verses.hebrew: תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר עֲזָבוּנִי וַיְקַטְּרוּ לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לְמַעַן הַכְעִיסֵנִי בְּכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיהֶם וְנִצְּתָה חֲמָתִי בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְלֹא תִכְבֶּה׃

hebrew.text: תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר עֲזָבוּנִי וַיְקַטְּרוּ לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לְמַעַן הַכְעִיסֵנִי בְּכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיהֶם וְנִצְּתָה חֲמָתִי בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְלֹא תִכְבֶּה׃

english.text:
Because they have forsaken Me and have made offerings to other
gods and vexed Me with all their deeds, My wrath is kindled
against this place and it shall not be quenched.

translation.text: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.

verses.english:
Because they have forsaken Me and have made offerings to other
gods and vexed Me with all their deeds, My wrath is kindled
against this place and it shall not be quenched.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה הַשֹּׁלֵחַ אֶתְכֶם לִדְרֹשׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָה כֹּה תֹאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁמָעְתָּ׃

hebrew.text: וְאֶל־מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה הַשֹּׁלֵחַ אֶתְכֶם לִדְרֹשׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָה כֹּה תֹאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁמָעְתָּ׃

english.text:
But say this to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of
YHWH: Thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: As for the words which
you have heard—

translation.text: But to the king of Judah which sent you to enquire of the LORD, thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, As touching the words which thou hast heard;

verses.english:
But say this to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of
YHWH: Thus said YHWH, the God of Israel: As for the words which
you have heard—

verses.hebrew:
יַעַן רַךְ־לְבָבְךָ וַתִּכָּנַע מִפְּנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּשׁמְעֲךָ אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי עַל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְעַל־יֹשְׁבָיו לִהְיוֹת לְשַׁמָּה וְלִקְלָלָה וַתִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדֶיךָ
וַתִּבְכֶּה לְפָנָי וְגַם אָנֹכִי שָׁמַעְתִּי נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
יַעַן רַךְ־לְבָבְךָ וַתִּכָּנַע מִפְּנֵי יְהֹוָה בְּשׁמְעֲךָ אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי עַל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְעַל־יֹשְׁבָיו לִהְיוֹת לְשַׁמָּה וְלִקְלָלָה וַתִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדֶיךָ
וַתִּבְכֶּה לְפָנָי וְגַם אָנֹכִי שָׁמַעְתִּי נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
because your heart was softened and you humbled yourself before
YHWH when you heard what I decreed against this place and its
inhabitants—that it will become a desolation and a curse—and
because you rent your clothes and wept before Me, I for My part
have listened—declares YHWH.

translation.text: Because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the LORD, when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard thee, saith the LORD.

verses.english:
because your heart was softened and you humbled yourself before
YHWH when you heard what I decreed against this place and its
inhabitants—that it will become a desolation and a curse—and
because you rent your clothes and wept before Me, I for My part
have listened—declares YHWH.

verses.hebrew:
לָכֵן הִנְנִי אֹסִפְךָ עַל־אֲבֹתֶיךָ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ אֶל־קִבְרֹתֶיךָ בְּשָׁלוֹם וְלֹא־תִרְאֶינָה עֵינֶיךָ בְּכֹל הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי מֵבִיא עַל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וַיָּשִׁבוּ
אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text:
לָכֵן הִנְנִי אֹסִפְךָ עַל־אֲבֹתֶיךָ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ אֶל־קִבְרֹתֶיךָ בְּשָׁלוֹם וְלֹא־תִרְאֶינָה עֵינֶיךָ בְּכֹל הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי מֵבִיא עַל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וַיָּשִׁבוּ
אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר׃

english.text:
Assuredly, I will gather you to your fathers and you will be laid
in your tomb in peace. Your eyes shall not see all the disaster
which I will bring upon this place.” So they brought back the
reply to the king.

translation.text: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.

verses.english:
Assuredly, I will gather you to your fathers and you will be laid
in your tomb in peace. Your eyes shall not see all the disaster
which I will bring upon this place.” So they brought back the
reply to the king.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֵלָיו כּל־זִקְנֵי יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֵלָיו כּל־זִקְנֵי יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
At the king’s summons, all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem
assembled before him.

translation.text: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

verses.english:
At the king’s summons, all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem
assembled before him.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעַל הַמֶּלֶךְ בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וְכל־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וְכל־יֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אִתּוֹ וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַנְּבִיאִים וְכל־הָעָם לְמִקָּטֹן וְעַד־גָּדוֹל וַיִּקְרָא בְאזְנֵיהֶם
אֶת־כּל־דִּבְרֵי סֵפֶר הַבְּרִית הַנִּמְצָא בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעַל הַמֶּלֶךְ בֵּית־יְהֹוָה וְכל־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וְכל־יֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אִתּוֹ וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַנְּבִיאִים וְכל־הָעָם לְמִקָּטֹן וְעַד־גָּדוֹל וַיִּקְרָא בְאזְנֵיהֶם
אֶת־כּל־דִּבְרֵי סֵפֶר הַבְּרִית הַנִּמְצָא בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
The king went up to the House of YHWH, together with all the men
of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests and
prophets—all the people, young and old. And he read to them the
entire text of the covenant scroll which had been found in the
House of YHWH.

translation.text: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the LORD.

verses.english:
The king went up to the House of YHWH, together with all the men
of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests and
prophets—all the people, young and old. And he read to them the
entire text of the covenant scroll which had been found in the
House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew:
וַיַּעֲמֹד הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הָעַמּוּד וַיִּכְרֹת אֶת־הַבְּרִית לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לָלֶכֶת אַחַר יְהֹוָה וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְאֶת־עֵדְוֺתָיו וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתָיו בְּכל־לֵב וּבְכל־נֶפֶשׁ
לְהָקִים אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַבְּרִית הַזֹּאת הַכְּתֻבִים עַל־הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה וַיַּעֲמֹד כּל־הָעָם בַּבְּרִית׃

hebrew.text:
וַיַּעֲמֹד הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הָעַמּוּד וַיִּכְרֹת אֶת־הַבְּרִית לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לָלֶכֶת אַחַר יְהֹוָה וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְאֶת־עֵדְוֺתָיו וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתָיו בְּכל־לֵב וּבְכל־נֶפֶשׁ
לְהָקִים אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַבְּרִית הַזֹּאת הַכְּתֻבִים עַל־הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה וַיַּעֲמֹד כּל־הָעָם בַּבְּרִית׃

english.text:
The king stood by the pillar and solemnized the covenant before
YHWH: that they would follow YHWH and observe His commandments,
His injunctions, and His laws with all their heart and soul; that
they would fulfill all the terms of this covenant as inscribed
upon the scroll. And all the people entered into the covenant.

translation.text: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.

verses.english:
The king stood by the pillar and solemnized the covenant before
YHWH: that they would follow YHWH and observe His commandments,
His injunctions, and His laws with all their heart and soul; that
they would fulfill all the terms of this covenant as inscribed
upon the scroll. And all the people entered into the covenant.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וְאֶת־כֹּהֲנֵי הַמִּשְׁנֶה וְאֶת־שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּף לְהוֹצִיא מֵהֵיכַל יְהֹוָה אֵת כּל־הַכֵּלִים הָעֲשׂוּיִם לַבַּעַל
וְלָאֲשֵׁרָה וּלְכֹל צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיִּשְׂרְפֵם מִחוּץ לִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בְּשַׁדְמוֹת קִדְרוֹן וְנָשָׂא אֶת־עֲפָרָם בֵּית־אֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וְאֶת־כֹּהֲנֵי הַמִּשְׁנֶה וְאֶת־שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּף לְהוֹצִיא מֵהֵיכַל יְהֹוָה אֵת כּל־הַכֵּלִים הָעֲשׂוּיִם לַבַּעַל
וְלָאֲשֵׁרָה וּלְכֹל צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיִּשְׂרְפֵם מִחוּץ לִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בְּשַׁדְמוֹת קִדְרוֹן וְנָשָׂא אֶת־עֲפָרָם בֵּית־אֵל׃

english.text:
Then the king ordered the high priest Hilkiah, the priests of the
second rank, and the guards of the threshold to bring out of the
Temple of YHWH all the objects made for Baal and Asherah and all
the host of heaven. He burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields
of Kidron, and he removed the ashes to Bethel.

translation.text: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the LORD all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Bethel.

verses.english:
Then the king ordered the high priest Hilkiah, the priests of the
second rank, and the guards of the threshold to bring out of the
Temple of YHWH all the objects made for Baal and Asherah and all
the host of heaven. He burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields
of Kidron, and he removed the ashes to Bethel.

verses.hebrew:
וְהִשְׁבִּית אֶת־הַכְּמָרִים אֲשֶׁר נָתְנוּ מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וַיְקַטֵּר בַּבָּמוֹת בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וּמְסִבֵּי יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְאֶת־הַמְקַטְּרִים לַבַּעַל לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְלַיָּרֵחַ
