english.text:
I said to them in reply, “The God of Heaven will grant us success,
and we, His servants, will start building. But you have no share
or claim or stake in Jerusalem!”

verses.english:
I said to them in reply, “The God of Heaven will grant us success,
and we, His servants, will start building. But you have no share
or claim or stake in Jerusalem!”

verses.hebrew: אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה גִּדַּל הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ אֶת־הָמָן בֶּן־הַמְּדָתָא הָאֲגָגִי וַיְנַשְּׂאֵהוּ וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־כִּסְאוֹ מֵעַל כּל־הַשָּׂרִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה גִּדַּל הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ אֶת־הָמָן בֶּן־הַמְּדָתָא הָאֲגָגִי וַיְנַשְּׂאֵהוּ וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־כִּסְאוֹ מֵעַל כּל־הַשָּׂרִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

english.text:
Some time afterward, King Ahasuerus promoted Haman son of
Hammedatha the Agagite; he advanced him and seated him higher than
any of his fellow officials.

verses.english:
Some time afterward, King Ahasuerus promoted Haman son of
Hammedatha the Agagite; he advanced him and seated him higher than
any of his fellow officials.

verses.hebrew: וְכל־עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בְּשַׁעַר הַמֶּלֶךְ כֹּרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לְהָמָן כִּי־כֵן צִוָּה־לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ וּמרְדֳּכַי לֹא יִכְרַע וְלֹא יִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְכל־עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בְּשַׁעַר הַמֶּלֶךְ כֹּרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לְהָמָן כִּי־כֵן צִוָּה־לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ וּמרְדֳּכַי לֹא יִכְרַע וְלֹא יִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה׃

english.text:
All the king’s courtiers in the palace gate knelt and bowed low to
Haman, for such was the king’s order concerning him; but Mordecai
would not kneel or bow low.

verses.english:
All the king’s courtiers in the palace gate knelt and bowed low to
Haman, for such was the king’s order concerning him; but Mordecai
would not kneel or bow low.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בְּשַׁעַר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְמרְדֳּכָי מַדּוּעַ אַתָּה עוֹבֵר אֵת מִצְוַת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בְּשַׁעַר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְמרְדֳּכָי מַדּוּעַ אַתָּה עוֹבֵר אֵת מִצְוַת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
Then the king’s courtiers who were in the palace gate said to
Mordecai, “Why do you disobey the king’s order?”

verses.english:
Then the king’s courtiers who were in the palace gate said to
Mordecai, “Why do you disobey the king’s order?”

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי (באמרם) [כְּאמְרָם] אֵלָיו יוֹם וָיוֹם וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵיהֶם וַיַּגִּידוּ לְהָמָן לִרְאוֹת הֲיַעַמְדוּ דִּבְרֵי מרְדֳּכַי כִּי־הִגִּיד לָהֶם אֲשֶׁר־הוּא יְהוּדִי׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי (באמרם) [כְּאמְרָם] אֵלָיו יוֹם וָיוֹם וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵיהֶם וַיַּגִּידוּ לְהָמָן לִרְאוֹת הֲיַעַמְדוּ דִּבְרֵי מרְדֳּכַי כִּי־הִגִּיד לָהֶם אֲשֶׁר־הוּא יְהוּדִי׃

english.text:
When they spoke to him day after day and he would not listen to
them, they told Haman, in order to see whether Mordecai’s resolve
would prevail; for he had explained to them that he was a Jew.

verses.english:
When they spoke to him day after day and he would not listen to
them, they told Haman, in order to see whether Mordecai’s resolve
would prevail; for he had explained to them that he was a Jew.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא הָמָן כִּי־אֵין מרְדֳּכַי כֹּרֵעַ וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לוֹ וַיִּמָּלֵא הָמָן חֵמָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּרְא הָמָן כִּי־אֵין מרְדֳּכַי כֹּרֵעַ וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לוֹ וַיִּמָּלֵא הָמָן חֵמָה׃

english.text:
When Haman saw that Mordecai would not kneel or bow low to him,
Haman was filled with rage.

verses.english:
When Haman saw that Mordecai would not kneel or bow low to him,
Haman was filled with rage.

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּבֶז בְּעֵינָיו לִשְׁלֹחַ יָד בְּמרְדֳּכַי לְבַדּוֹ כִּי־הִגִּידוּ לוֹ אֶת־עַם מרְדֳּכָי וַיְבַקֵּשׁ הָמָן לְהַשְׁמִיד אֶת־כּל־הַיְּהוּדִים אֲשֶׁר בְּכל־מַלְכוּת אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ
עַם מרְדֳּכָי׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּבֶז בְּעֵינָיו לִשְׁלֹחַ יָד בְּמרְדֳּכַי לְבַדּוֹ כִּי־הִגִּידוּ לוֹ אֶת־עַם מרְדֳּכָי וַיְבַקֵּשׁ הָמָן לְהַשְׁמִיד אֶת־כּל־הַיְּהוּדִים אֲשֶׁר בְּכל־מַלְכוּת אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ
עַם מרְדֳּכָי׃

english.text:
But he disdained to lay hands on Mordecai alone; having been told
who Mordecai’s people were, Haman plotted to do away with all the
Jews, Mordecai’s people, throughout the kingdom of Ahasuerus.

verses.english:
But he disdained to lay hands on Mordecai alone; having been told
who Mordecai’s people were, Haman plotted to do away with all the
Jews, Mordecai’s people, throughout the kingdom of Ahasuerus.

verses.hebrew:
בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן הוּא־חֹדֶשׁ נִיסָן בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ הִפִּיל פּוּר הוּא הַגּוֹרָל לִפְנֵי הָמָן מִיּוֹם לְיוֹם וּמֵחֹדֶשׁ לְחֹדֶשׁ
שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר הוּא־חֹדֶשׁ אֲדָר׃

hebrew.text:
בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן הוּא־חֹדֶשׁ נִיסָן בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ הִפִּיל פּוּר הוּא הַגּוֹרָל לִפְנֵי הָמָן מִיּוֹם לְיוֹם וּמֵחֹדֶשׁ לְחֹדֶשׁ
שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר הוּא־חֹדֶשׁ אֲדָר׃

english.text:
In the first month, that is, the month of Nisan, in the twelfth
year of King Ahasuerus, pur—which means “the lot”—was cast before
Haman concerning every day and every month, [until it fell on] the
twelfth month, that is, the month of Adar.

verses.english:
In the first month, that is, the month of Nisan, in the twelfth
year of King Ahasuerus, pur—which means “the lot”—was cast before
Haman concerning every day and every month, [until it fell on] the
twelfth month, that is, the month of Adar.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֹּאמֶר הָמָן לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ יֶשְׁנוֹ עַם־אֶחָד מְפֻזָּר וּמְפֹרָד בֵּין הָעַמִּים בְּכֹל מְדִינוֹת מַלְכוּתֶךָ וְדָתֵיהֶם שֹׁנוֹת מִכּל־עָם וְאֶת־דָּתֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ
אֵינָם עֹשִׂים וְלַמֶּלֶךְ אֵין־שֹׁוֶה לְהַנִּיחָם׃

hebrew.text:
וַיֹּאמֶר הָמָן לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ יֶשְׁנוֹ עַם־אֶחָד מְפֻזָּר וּמְפֹרָד בֵּין הָעַמִּים בְּכֹל מְדִינוֹת מַלְכוּתֶךָ וְדָתֵיהֶם שֹׁנוֹת מִכּל־עָם וְאֶת־דָּתֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ
אֵינָם עֹשִׂים וְלַמֶּלֶךְ אֵין־שֹׁוֶה לְהַנִּיחָם׃

english.text:
Haman then said to King Ahasuerus, “There is a certain people,
scattered and dispersed among the other peoples in all the
provinces of your realm, whose laws are different from those of
any other people and who do not obey the king’s laws; and it is
not in Your Majesty’s interest to tolerate them.

verses.english:
Haman then said to King Ahasuerus, “There is a certain people,
scattered and dispersed among the other peoples in all the
provinces of your realm, whose laws are different from those of
any other people and who do not obey the king’s laws; and it is
not in Your Majesty’s interest to tolerate them.

verses.hebrew: אִם־עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב יִכָּתֵב לְאַבְּדָם וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים כִּכַּר־כֶּסֶף אֶשְׁקוֹל עַל־יְדֵי עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה לְהָבִיא אֶל־גִּנְזֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: אִם־עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב יִכָּתֵב לְאַבְּדָם וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים כִּכַּר־כֶּסֶף אֶשְׁקוֹל עַל־יְדֵי עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה לְהָבִיא אֶל־גִּנְזֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
If it please Your Majesty, let an edict be drawn for their
destruction, and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the
stewards for deposit in the royal treasury.”

verses.english:
If it please Your Majesty, let an edict be drawn for their
destruction, and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the
stewards for deposit in the royal treasury.”

verses.hebrew: וַיָּסַר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־טַבַּעְתּוֹ מֵעַל יָדוֹ וַיִּתְּנָהּ לְהָמָן בֶּן־הַמְּדָתָא הָאֲגָגִי צֹרֵר הַיְּהוּדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּסַר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־טַבַּעְתּוֹ מֵעַל יָדוֹ וַיִּתְּנָהּ לְהָמָן בֶּן־הַמְּדָתָא הָאֲגָגִי צֹרֵר הַיְּהוּדִים׃

english.text:
Thereupon the king removed his signet ring from his hand and gave
it to Haman son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the foe of the Jews.

verses.english:
Thereupon the king removed his signet ring from his hand and gave
it to Haman son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the foe of the Jews.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהָמָן הַכֶּסֶף נָתוּן לָךְ וְהָעָם לַעֲשׂוֹת בּוֹ כַּטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהָמָן הַכֶּסֶף נָתוּן לָךְ וְהָעָם לַעֲשׂוֹת בּוֹ כַּטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃

english.text:
And the king said, “The money and the people are yours to do with
as you see fit.”

verses.english:
And the king said, “The money and the people are yours to do with
as you see fit.”

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּקָּרְאוּ סֹפְרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם בּוֹ וַיִּכָּתֵב כְּכל־אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה הָמָן אֶל אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶל־הַפַּחוֹת אֲשֶׁר
עַל־מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה וְאֶל־שָׂרֵי עַם וָעָם מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה כִּכְתָבָהּ וְעַם וָעָם כִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ בְּשֵׁם הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֹשׁ נִכְתָּב וְנֶחְתָּם בְּטַבַּעַת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

hebrew.text:
וַיִּקָּרְאוּ סֹפְרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם בּוֹ וַיִּכָּתֵב כְּכל־אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה הָמָן אֶל אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶל־הַפַּחוֹת אֲשֶׁר
עַל־מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה וְאֶל־שָׂרֵי עַם וָעָם מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה כִּכְתָבָהּ וְעַם וָעָם כִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ בְּשֵׁם הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֹשׁ נִכְתָּב וְנֶחְתָּם בְּטַבַּעַת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

english.text:
On the thirteenth day of the first month, the king’s scribes were
summoned and a decree was issued, as Haman directed, to the king’s
satraps, to the governors of every province, and to the officials
of every people, to every province in its own script and to every
people in its own language. The orders were issued in the name of
King Ahasuerus and sealed with the king’s signet.

verses.english:
On the thirteenth day of the first month, the king’s scribes were
summoned and a decree was issued, as Haman directed, to the king’s
satraps, to the governors of every province, and to the officials
of every people, to every province in its own script and to every
people in its own language. The orders were issued in the name of
King Ahasuerus and sealed with the king’s signet.

verses.hebrew:
וְנִשְׁלוֹחַ סְפָרִים בְּיַד הָרָצִים אֶל־כּל־מְדִינוֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהַשְׁמִיד לַהֲרֹג וּלְאַבֵּד אֶת־כּל־הַיְּהוּדִים מִנַּעַר וְעַד־זָקֵן טַף וְנָשִׁים בְּיוֹם אֶחָד בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁה
עָשָׂר לְחֹדֶשׁ שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר הוּא־חֹדֶשׁ אֲדָר וּשְׁלָלָם לָבוֹז׃

hebrew.text:
וְנִשְׁלוֹחַ סְפָרִים בְּיַד הָרָצִים אֶל־כּל־מְדִינוֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהַשְׁמִיד לַהֲרֹג וּלְאַבֵּד אֶת־כּל־הַיְּהוּדִים מִנַּעַר וְעַד־זָקֵן טַף וְנָשִׁים בְּיוֹם אֶחָד בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁה
עָשָׂר לְחֹדֶשׁ שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר הוּא־חֹדֶשׁ אֲדָר וּשְׁלָלָם לָבוֹז׃

english.text:
Accordingly, written instructions were dispatched by couriers to
all the king’s provinces to destroy, massacre, and exterminate all
the Jews, young and old, children and women, on a single day, on
the thirteenth day of the twelfth month—that is, the month of
Adar—and to plunder their possessions.

verses.english:
Accordingly, written instructions were dispatched by couriers to
all the king’s provinces to destroy, massacre, and exterminate all
the Jews, young and old, children and women, on a single day, on
the thirteenth day of the twelfth month—that is, the month of
Adar—and to plunder their possessions.

verses.hebrew: פַּתְשֶׁגֶן הַכְּתָב לְהִנָּתֵן דָּת בְּכל־מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה גָּלוּי לְכל־הָעַמִּים לִהְיוֹת עֲתִדִים לַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: פַּתְשֶׁגֶן הַכְּתָב לְהִנָּתֵן דָּת בְּכל־מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה גָּלוּי לְכל־הָעַמִּים לִהְיוֹת עֲתִדִים לַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
The text of the document was to the effect that a law should be
proclaimed in every single province; it was to be publicly
displayed to all the peoples, so that they might be ready for that
day.

verses.english:

verses.hebrew: הָרָצִים יָצְאוּ דְחוּפִים בִּדְבַר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַדָּת נִתְּנָה בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה וְהַמֶּלֶךְ וְהָמָן יָשְׁבוּ לִשְׁתּוֹת וְהָעִיר שׁוּשָׁן נָבוֹכָה׃

hebrew.text: הָרָצִים יָצְאוּ דְחוּפִים בִּדְבַר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַדָּת נִתְּנָה בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה וְהַמֶּלֶךְ וְהָמָן יָשְׁבוּ לִשְׁתּוֹת וְהָעִיר שׁוּשָׁן נָבוֹכָה׃

english.text:
The couriers went out posthaste on the royal mission, and the
decree was proclaimed in the fortress Shushan. The king and Haman
sat down to feast, but the city of Shushan was dumfounded.

verses.english:

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּע הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בֶּעָרִיםוַיֵּאָסְפוּ הָעָם כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּגַּע הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בֶּעָרִיםוַיֵּאָסְפוּ הָעָם כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
When the seventh month arrived—the Israelites being settled in
their towns—the entire people assembled as one man in Jerusalem.

verses.english:

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקם יֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָק וְאֶחָיו הַכֹּהֲנִים וּזְרֻבָּבֶל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל וְאֶחָיו וַיִּבְנוּ אֶת־מִזְבַּח אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַעֲלוֹת עָלָיו עֹלוֹת כַּכָּתוּב
בְּתוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים׃

english.text:
Then Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brother priests, and Zerubbabel
son of Shealtiel and his brothers set to and built the altar of
the God of Israel to offer burnt offerings upon it as is written
in the Teaching of Moses, the man of God.

verses.english:

the God of Israel to offer burnt offerings upon it as is written

verses.hebrew: וַיָּכִינוּ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ עַל־מְכוֹנֹתָיו כִּי בְּאֵימָה עֲלֵיהֶם מֵעַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת (ויעל) [וַיַּעֲלוּ] עָלָיו עֹלוֹת לַיהֹוָה עֹלוֹת לַבֹּקֶר וְלָעָרֶב׃

hebrew.text: וַיָּכִינוּ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ עַל־מְכוֹנֹתָיו כִּי בְּאֵימָה עֲלֵיהֶם מֵעַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת (ויעל) [וַיַּעֲלוּ] עָלָיו עֹלוֹת לַיהֹוָה עֹלוֹת לַבֹּקֶר וְלָעָרֶב׃

english.text:
They set up the altar on its site because they were in fear of the
peoples of the land, and they offered burnt offerings on it to
YHWH, burnt offerings each morning and evening.

verses.english:

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת־חַג הַסֻּכּוֹת כַּכָּתוּב וְעֹלַת יוֹם בְּיוֹם בְּמִסְפָּר כְּמִשְׁפַּט דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ׃

english.text:
Then they celebrated the festival of Tabernacles as is written,
with its daily burnt offerings in the proper quantities, on each
day as is prescribed for it,

verses.english:

day as is prescribed for it,

verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן עֹלַת תָּמִיד וְלֶחֳדָשִׁים וּלְכל־מוֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה הַמְקֻדָּשִׁים וּלְכֹל מִתְנַדֵּב נְדָבָה לַיהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן עֹלַת תָּמִיד וְלֶחֳדָשִׁים וּלְכל־מוֹעֲדֵי יְהֹוָה הַמְקֻדָּשִׁים וּלְכֹל מִתְנַדֵּב נְדָבָה לַיהֹוָה׃

english.text:
followed by the regular burnt offering and the offerings for the
new moons and for all the sacred fixed times of YHWH, and whatever
freewill offerings were made to YHWH.

verses.english:

verses.hebrew: מִיּוֹם אֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי הֵחֵלּוּ לְהַעֲלוֹת עֹלוֹת לַיהֹוָה וְהֵיכַל יְהֹוָה לֹא יֻסָּד׃

hebrew.text: מִיּוֹם אֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי הֵחֵלּוּ לְהַעֲלוֹת עֹלוֹת לַיהֹוָה וְהֵיכַל יְהֹוָה לֹא יֻסָּד׃

english.text:
From the first day of the seventh month they began to make burnt
offerings to YHWH, though the foundation of the Temple of YHWH had
not been laid.

verses.english:

verses.hebrew:
וַיִּתְּנוּ־כֶסֶף לַחֹצְבִים וְלֶחָרָשִׁים וּמַאֲכָל וּמִשְׁתֶּה וָשֶׁמֶן לַצִּדֹנִים וְלַצֹּרִים לְהָבִיא עֲצֵי אֲרָזִים מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן אֶל־יָם יָפוֹא כְּרִשְׁיוֹן כּוֹרֶשׁ
מֶלֶךְ־פָּרַס עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
They paid the hewers and craftsmen with money, and the Sidonians
and Tyrians with food, drink, and oil to bring cedarwood from
Lebanon by sea to Joppa, in accord with the authorization granted
them by King Cyrus of Persia.

verses.english:

them by King Cyrus of Persia.

verses.hebrew:
וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית לְבוֹאָם אֶל־בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים לִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי הֵחֵלּוּ זְרֻבָּבֶל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל וְיֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָק וּשְׁאָר אֲחֵיהֶם
הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְכל־הַבָּאִים מֵהַשְּׁבִי יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם וַיַּעֲמִידוּ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה לְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מְלֶאכֶת בֵּית־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text:
וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית לְבוֹאָם אֶל־בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים לִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי הֵחֵלּוּ זְרֻבָּבֶל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל וְיֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָק וּשְׁאָר אֲחֵיהֶם

english.text:
In the second year after their arrival at the House of God, at
Jerusalem, in the second month, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and
Jeshua son of Jozadak, and the rest of their brother priests and
Levites, and all who had come from the captivity to Jerusalem, as
their first step appointed Levites from the age of twenty and
upward to supervise the work of the House of YHWH.

verses.english:
In the second year after their arrival at the House of God, at
Jerusalem, in the second month, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and
Jeshua son of Jozadak, and the rest of their brother priests and
Levites, and all who had come from the captivity to Jerusalem, as
their first step appointed Levites from the age of twenty and
upward to supervise the work of the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד יֵשׁוּעַ בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו קַדְמִיאֵל וּבָנָיו בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה כְּאֶחָד לְנַצֵּחַ עַל־עֹשֵׂה הַמְּלָאכָה בְּבֵית הָאֱלֹהִיםבְּנֵי חֵנָדָד בְּנֵיהֶם וַאֲחֵיהֶם הַלְוִיִּם׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲמֹד יֵשׁוּעַ בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו קַדְמִיאֵל וּבָנָיו בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה כְּאֶחָד לְנַצֵּחַ עַל־עֹשֵׂה הַמְּלָאכָה בְּבֵית הָאֱלֹהִיםבְּנֵי חֵנָדָד בְּנֵיהֶם וַאֲחֵיהֶם הַלְוִיִּם׃

english.text:
Jeshua, his sons and brothers, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of
Judah, together were appointed in charge of those who did the work
in the House of God; also the sons of Henadad, their sons and
brother Levites.

verses.english:
Jeshua, his sons and brothers, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of
Judah, together were appointed in charge of those who did the work
in the House of God; also the sons of Henadad, their sons and
brother Levites.

verses.hebrew:
וְיִסְּדוּ הַבֹּנִים אֶת־הֵיכַל יְהֹוָה וַיַּעֲמִידוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים מְלֻבָּשִׁים בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְהַלְוִיִּם בְּנֵי־אָסָף בַּמְצִלְתַּיִם לְהַלֵּל אֶת־יְהֹוָה עַל־יְדֵי דָּוִיד
מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וְיִסְּדוּ הַבֹּנִים אֶת־הֵיכַל יְהֹוָה וַיַּעֲמִידוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים מְלֻבָּשִׁים בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְהַלְוִיִּם בְּנֵי־אָסָף בַּמְצִלְתַּיִם לְהַלֵּל אֶת־יְהֹוָה עַל־יְדֵי דָּוִיד

english.text:
When the builders had laid the foundation of the Temple of YHWH,
priests in their vestments with trumpets, and Levites sons of
Asaph with cymbals were stationed to give praise to YHWH, as King
David of Israel had ordained.

verses.english:
When the builders had laid the foundation of the Temple of YHWH,
priests in their vestments with trumpets, and Levites sons of
Asaph with cymbals were stationed to give praise to YHWH, as King
David of Israel had ordained.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְּהַלֵּל וּבְהוֹדֹת לַיהֹוָה כִּי טוֹב כִּי־לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכל־הָעָם הֵרִיעוּ תְרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה בְהַלֵּל לַיהֹוָה עַל הוּסַד בֵּית־יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְּהַלֵּל וּבְהוֹדֹת לַיהֹוָה כִּי טוֹב כִּי־לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכל־הָעָם הֵרִיעוּ תְרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה בְהַלֵּל לַיהֹוָה עַל הוּסַד בֵּית־יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
They sang songs extolling and praising YHWH, “For He is good, His
steadfast love for Israel is eternal.” All the people raised a
great shout extolling YHWH because the foundation of the House of
YHWH had been laid.

verses.english:
They sang songs extolling and praising YHWH, “For He is good, His
steadfast love for Israel is eternal.” All the people raised a
great shout extolling YHWH because the foundation of the House of
YHWH had been laid.

verses.hebrew:
וְרַבִּים מֵהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ אֶת־הַבַּיִת הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּיסְדוֹ זֶה הַבַּיִת בְּעֵינֵיהֶם בֹּכִים בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל וְרַבִּים
בִּתְרוּעָה בְשִׂמְחָה לְהָרִים קוֹל׃

hebrew.text:
וְרַבִּים מֵהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ אֶת־הַבַּיִת הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּיסְדוֹ זֶה הַבַּיִת בְּעֵינֵיהֶם בֹּכִים בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל וְרַבִּים
בִּתְרוּעָה בְשִׂמְחָה לְהָרִים קוֹל׃

english.text:
Many of the priests and Levites and the chiefs of the clans, the
old men who had seen the first house, wept loudly at the sight of
the founding of this house. Many others shouted joyously at the
top of their voices.

verses.english:
Many of the priests and Levites and the chiefs of the clans, the
old men who had seen the first house, wept loudly at the sight of
the founding of this house. Many others shouted joyously at the
top of their voices.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵין הָעָם מַכִּירִים קוֹל תְּרוּעַת הַשִּׂמְחָה לְקוֹל בְּכִי הָעָם כִּי הָעָם מְרִיעִים תְּרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וְהַקּוֹל נִשְׁמַע עַד־לְמֵרָחוֹק׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵין הָעָם מַכִּירִים קוֹל תְּרוּעַת הַשִּׂמְחָה לְקוֹל בְּכִי הָעָם כִּי הָעָם מְרִיעִים תְּרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וְהַקּוֹל נִשְׁמַע עַד־לְמֵרָחוֹק׃

english.text:
The people could not distinguish the shouts of joy from the
people’s weeping, for the people raised a great shout, the sound
of which could be heard from afar.

verses.english:
The people could not distinguish the shouts of joy from the
people’s weeping, for the people raised a great shout, the sound
of which could be heard from afar.

verses.hebrew:
וַיָּקם אֶלְיָשִׁיב הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וְאֶחָיו הַכֹּהֲנִים וַיִּבְנוּ אֶת־שַׁעַר הַצֹּאן הֵמָּה קִדְּשׁוּהוּ וַיַּעֲמִידוּ דַּלְתֹתָיו וְעַד־מִגְדַּל הַמֵּאָה קִדְּשׁוּהוּ עַד
מִגְדַּל חֲנַנְאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וַיָּקם אֶלְיָשִׁיב הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וְאֶחָיו הַכֹּהֲנִים וַיִּבְנוּ אֶת־שַׁעַר הַצֹּאן הֵמָּה קִדְּשׁוּהוּ וַיַּעֲמִידוּ דַּלְתֹתָיו וְעַד־מִגְדַּל הַמֵּאָה קִדְּשׁוּהוּ עַד
מִגְדַּל חֲנַנְאֵל׃

english.text:
Then Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests set to and
rebuilt the Sheep Gate; they consecrated it and set up its doors,
consecrating it as far as the Hundred’s Tower, as far as the Tower
of Hananel.

verses.english:
Then Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests set to and
rebuilt the Sheep Gate; they consecrated it and set up its doors,
consecrating it as far as the Hundred’s Tower, as far as the Tower
of Hananel.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל־יָדוֹ בָנוּ אַנְשֵׁי יְרֵחוֹ וְעַל־יָדוֹ בָנָה זַכּוּר בֶּן־אִמְרִי׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל־יָדוֹ בָנוּ אַנְשֵׁי יְרֵחוֹ וְעַל־יָדוֹ בָנָה זַכּוּר בֶּן־אִמְרִי׃

english.text:
Next to him, the men of Jericho built. Next to them, Zaccur son of
Imri.

verses.english:
Next to him, the men of Jericho built. Next to them, Zaccur son of
Imri.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שַׁעַר הַדָּגִים בָּנוּ בְּנֵי הַסְּנָאָה הֵמָּה קֵרוּהוּ וַיַּעֲמִידוּ דַּלְתֹתָיו מַנְעוּלָיו וּבְרִיחָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שַׁעַר הַדָּגִים בָּנוּ בְּנֵי הַסְּנָאָה הֵמָּה קֵרוּהוּ וַיַּעֲמִידוּ דַּלְתֹתָיו מַנְעוּלָיו וּבְרִיחָיו׃

english.text:
The sons of Hassenaah rebuilt the Fish Gate; they roofed it and
set up its doors, locks, and bars.

verses.english:
The sons of Hassenaah rebuilt the Fish Gate; they roofed it and
set up its doors, locks, and bars.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק מְרֵמוֹת בֶּן־אוּרִיָּה בֶּן־הַקּוֹץוְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק מְשֻׁלָּם בֶּן־בֶּרֶכְיָה בֶּן־מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵלוְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק צָדוֹק בֶּן־בַּעֲנָא׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק מְרֵמוֹת בֶּן־אוּרִיָּה בֶּן־הַקּוֹץוְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק מְשֻׁלָּם בֶּן־בֶּרֶכְיָה בֶּן־מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵלוְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק צָדוֹק בֶּן־בַּעֲנָא׃

english.text:
Next to them, Meremoth son of Uriah son of Hakkoz repaired; and
next to him, Meshullam son of Berechiah son of Meshezabel. Next to
him, Zadok son of Baana repaired.

verses.english:
Next to them, Meremoth son of Uriah son of Hakkoz repaired; and
next to him, Meshullam son of Berechiah son of Meshezabel. Next to
him, Zadok son of Baana repaired.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַתְּקוֹעִים וְאַדִּירֵיהֶם לֹא־הֵבִיאוּ צַוָּרָם בַּעֲבֹדַת אֲדֹנֵיהֶם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַתְּקוֹעִים וְאַדִּירֵיהֶם לֹא־הֵבִיאוּ צַוָּרָם בַּעֲבֹדַת אֲדֹנֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
Next to him, the Tekoites repaired, though their nobles would not
take upon their shoulders the work of their lord.

verses.english:
Next to him, the Tekoites repaired, though their nobles would not
take upon their shoulders the work of their lord.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שַׁעַר הַיְשָׁנָה הֶחֱזִיקוּ יוֹיָדָע בֶּן־פָּסֵחַ וּמְשֻׁלָּם בֶּן־בְּסוֹדְיָה הֵמָּה קֵרוּהוּ וַיַּעֲמִידוּ דַּלְתֹתָיו וּמַנְעֻלָיו וּבְרִיחָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שַׁעַר הַיְשָׁנָה הֶחֱזִיקוּ יוֹיָדָע בֶּן־פָּסֵחַ וּמְשֻׁלָּם בֶּן־בְּסוֹדְיָה הֵמָּה קֵרוּהוּ וַיַּעֲמִידוּ דַּלְתֹתָיו וּמַנְעֻלָיו וּבְרִיחָיו׃

english.text:
Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah repaired the
Jeshanah Gate; they roofed it and set up its doors, locks, and
bars.

verses.english:
Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah repaired the
Jeshanah Gate; they roofed it and set up its doors, locks, and
bars.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק מְלַטְיָה הַגִּבְעֹנִי וְיָדוֹן הַמֵּרֹנֹתִי אַנְשֵׁי גִבְעוֹן וְהַמִּצְפָּה לְכִסֵּא פַּחַת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק מְלַטְיָה הַגִּבְעֹנִי וְיָדוֹן הַמֵּרֹנֹתִי אַנְשֵׁי גִבְעוֹן וְהַמִּצְפָּה לְכִסֵּא פַּחַת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר׃

english.text:
Next to them, Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite
repaired, [with] the men of Gibeon and Mizpah, under the
jurisdiction of the governor of the province of Beyond the River.

verses.english:
Next to them, Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite
repaired, [with] the men of Gibeon and Mizpah, under the
jurisdiction of the governor of the province of Beyond the River.

verses.hebrew: עַל־יָדוֹ הֶחֱזִיק עֻזִּיאֵל בֶּן־חַרְהֲיָה צוֹרְפִיםוְעַל־יָדוֹ הֶחֱזִיק חֲנַנְיָה בֶּן־הָרַקָּחִים וַיַּעַזְבוּ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם עַד הַחוֹמָה הָרְחָבָה׃

hebrew.text: עַל־יָדוֹ הֶחֱזִיק עֻזִּיאֵל בֶּן־חַרְהֲיָה צוֹרְפִיםוְעַל־יָדוֹ הֶחֱזִיק חֲנַנְיָה בֶּן־הָרַקָּחִים וַיַּעַזְבוּ יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם עַד הַחוֹמָה הָרְחָבָה׃

english.text:
Next to them, Uzziel son of Harhaiah, [of the] smiths, repaired.
Next to him, Hananiah, of the perfumers. They restored Jerusalem
as far as the Broad Wall.

verses.english:
Next to them, Uzziel son of Harhaiah, [of the] smiths, repaired.
Next to him, Hananiah, of the perfumers. They restored Jerusalem
as far as the Broad Wall.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק רְפָיָה בֶן־חוּר שַׂר חֲצִי פֶּלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק רְפָיָה בֶן־חוּר שַׂר חֲצִי פֶּלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם׃

english.text:
Next to them, Rephaiah son of Hur, chief of half the district of
Jerusalem, repaired.

verses.english:
Next to them, Rephaiah son of Hur, chief of half the district of
Jerusalem, repaired.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק יְדָיָה בֶן־חֲרוּמַף וְנֶגֶד בֵּיתוֹ וְעַל־יָדוֹ הֶחֱזִיק חַטּוּשׁ בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְנְיָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק יְדָיָה בֶן־חֲרוּמַף וְנֶגֶד בֵּיתוֹ וְעַל־יָדוֹ הֶחֱזִיק חַטּוּשׁ בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְנְיָה׃

english.text:
Next to him, Jedaiah son of Harumaph repaired in front of his
house. Next to him, Hattush son of Hashabneiah repaired.

verses.english:
Next to him, Jedaiah son of Harumaph repaired in front of his
house. Next to him, Hattush son of Hashabneiah repaired.

verses.hebrew: מִדָּה שֵׁנִית הֶחֱזִיק מַלְכִּיָּה בֶן־חָרִם וְחַשּׁוּב בֶּן־פַּחַת מוֹאָב וְאֵת מִגְדַּל הַתַּנּוּרִים׃

hebrew.text: מִדָּה שֵׁנִית הֶחֱזִיק מַלְכִּיָּה בֶן־חָרִם וְחַשּׁוּב בֶּן־פַּחַת מוֹאָב וְאֵת מִגְדַּל הַתַּנּוּרִים׃

english.text:
Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath-moab repaired a
second stretch, including the Tower of Ovens.

verses.english:
Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath-moab repaired a
second stretch, including the Tower of Ovens.

verses.hebrew: וְעַל־יָדוֹ הֶחֱזִיק שַׁלּוּם בֶּן־הַלּוֹחֵשׁ שַׂר חֲצִי פֶּלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם הוּא וּבְנוֹתָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְעַל־יָדוֹ הֶחֱזִיק שַׁלּוּם בֶּן־הַלּוֹחֵשׁ שַׂר חֲצִי פֶּלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם הוּא וּבְנוֹתָיו׃

english.text:
Next to them, Shallum son of Hallohesh, chief of half the district
of Jerusalem, repaired—he and his daughters.

verses.english:
Next to them, Shallum son of Hallohesh, chief of half the district
of Jerusalem, repaired—he and his daughters.

verses.hebrew: אֵת שַׁעַר הַגַּיְא הֶחֱזִיק חָנוּן וְיֹשְׁבֵי זָנוֹחַ הֵמָּה בָנוּהוּ וַיַּעֲמִידוּ דַּלְתֹתָיו מַנְעֻלָיו וּבְרִיחָיו וְאֶלֶף אַמָּה בַּחוֹמָה עַד שַׁעַר הָשְׁפוֹת׃

hebrew.text: אֵת שַׁעַר הַגַּיְא הֶחֱזִיק חָנוּן וְיֹשְׁבֵי זָנוֹחַ הֵמָּה בָנוּהוּ וַיַּעֲמִידוּ דַּלְתֹתָיו מַנְעֻלָיו וּבְרִיחָיו וְאֶלֶף אַמָּה בַּחוֹמָה עַד שַׁעַר הָשְׁפוֹת׃

english.text:
Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the Valley Gate; they
rebuilt it and set up its doors, locks, and bars. And [they also
repaired] a thousand cubits of wall to the Dung Gate.

verses.english:
Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the Valley Gate; they
rebuilt it and set up its doors, locks, and bars. And [they also
repaired] a thousand cubits of wall to the Dung Gate.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שַׁעַר הָאַשְׁפּוֹת הֶחֱזִיק מַלְכִּיָּה בֶן־רֵכָב שַׂר פֶּלֶךְ בֵּית־הַכָּרֶם הוּא יִבְנֶנּוּ וְיַעֲמִיד דַּלְתֹתָיו מַנְעֻלָיו וּבְרִיחָיו׃

hebrew.text: וְאֵת שַׁעַר הָאַשְׁפּוֹת הֶחֱזִיק מַלְכִּיָּה בֶן־רֵכָב שַׂר פֶּלֶךְ בֵּית־הַכָּרֶם הוּא יִבְנֶנּוּ וְיַעֲמִיד דַּלְתֹתָיו מַנְעֻלָיו וּבְרִיחָיו׃

english.text:
Malchijah son of Rechab, chief of the district of Beth-haccerem,
repaired the Dung Gate; he rebuilt it and set up its doors, locks,
and bars.

verses.english:
Malchijah son of Rechab, chief of the district of Beth-haccerem,
repaired the Dung Gate; he rebuilt it and set up its doors, locks,
and bars.

verses.hebrew:
וְאֵת שַׁעַר הָעַיִן הֶחֱזִיק שַׁלּוּן בֶּן־כּל־חֹזֶה שַׂר פֶּלֶךְ הַמִּצְפָּה הוּא יִבְנֶנּוּ וִיטַלְלֶנּוּ (ויעמידו) [וְיַעֲמִיד] דַּלְתֹתָיו מַנְעֻלָיו וּבְרִיחָיו וְאֵת חוֹמַת
בְּרֵכַת הַשֶּׁלַח לְגַן־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְעַד־הַמַּעֲלוֹת הַיּוֹרְדוֹת מֵעִיר דָּוִיד׃

hebrew.text:
וְאֵת שַׁעַר הָעַיִן הֶחֱזִיק שַׁלּוּן בֶּן־כּל־חֹזֶה שַׂר פֶּלֶךְ הַמִּצְפָּה הוּא יִבְנֶנּוּ וִיטַלְלֶנּוּ (ויעמידו) [וְיַעֲמִיד] דַּלְתֹתָיו מַנְעֻלָיו וּבְרִיחָיו וְאֵת חוֹמַת
בְּרֵכַת הַשֶּׁלַח לְגַן־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְעַד־הַמַּעֲלוֹת הַיּוֹרְדוֹת מֵעִיר דָּוִיד׃

english.text:
Shallun son of Col-hozeh, chief of the district of Mizpah,
repaired the Fountain Gate; he rebuilt it and covered it, and set
up its doors, locks, and bars, as well as the wall of the
irrigation pool of the King’s Garden as far as the steps going
down from the City of David.

verses.english:
Shallun son of Col-hozeh, chief of the district of Mizpah,
repaired the Fountain Gate; he rebuilt it and covered it, and set
up its doors, locks, and bars, as well as the wall of the
irrigation pool of the King’s Garden as far as the steps going
down from the City of David.

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק נְחֶמְיָה בֶן־עַזְבּוּק שַׂר חֲצִי פֶּלֶךְ בֵּית־צוּר עַד־נֶגֶד קִבְרֵי דָוִיד וְעַד־הַבְּרֵכָה הָעֲשׂוּיָה וְעַד בֵּית הַגִּבֹּרִים׃

hebrew.text: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק נְחֶמְיָה בֶן־עַזְבּוּק שַׂר חֲצִי פֶּלֶךְ בֵּית־צוּר עַד־נֶגֶד קִבְרֵי דָוִיד וְעַד־הַבְּרֵכָה הָעֲשׂוּיָה וְעַד בֵּית הַגִּבֹּרִים׃

english.text:
After him, Nehemiah son of Azbuk, chief of half the district of
Beth-zur, repaired, from in front of the graves of David as far as
the artificial pool, and as far as the House of the Warriors.

verses.english:
After him, Nehemiah son of Azbuk, chief of half the district of
Beth-zur, repaired, from in front of the graves of David as far as
the artificial pool, and as far as the House of the Warriors.

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַלְוִיִּם רְחוּם בֶּן־בָּנִיעַל־יָדוֹ הֶחֱזִיק חֲשַׁבְיָה שַׂר־חֲצִי־פֶלֶךְ קְעִילָה לְפִלְכּוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַלְוִיִּם רְחוּם בֶּן־בָּנִיעַל־יָדוֹ הֶחֱזִיק חֲשַׁבְיָה שַׂר־חֲצִי־פֶלֶךְ קְעִילָה לְפִלְכּוֹ׃

english.text:
After him, the Levites repaired: Rehum son of Bani. Next to him,
Hashabiah, chief of half the district of Keilah, repaired for his
district.

verses.english:
After him, the Levites repaired: Rehum son of Bani. Next to him,
Hashabiah, chief of half the district of Keilah, repaired for his
district.

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיקוּ אֲחֵיהֶם בַּוַּי בֶּן־חֵנָדָד שַׂר חֲצִי פֶּלֶךְ קְעִילָה׃

hebrew.text: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיקוּ אֲחֵיהֶם בַּוַּי בֶּן־חֵנָדָד שַׂר חֲצִי פֶּלֶךְ קְעִילָה׃

english.text:
After him, their brothers repaired: Bavvai son of Henadad, chief
of half the district of Keilah.

verses.english:
After him, their brothers repaired: Bavvai son of Henadad, chief
of half the district of Keilah.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַזֵּק עַל־יָדוֹ עֵזֶר בֶּן־יֵשׁוּעַ שַׂר הַמִּצְפָּה מִדָּה שֵׁנִית מִנֶּגֶד עֲלֹת הַנֶּשֶׁק הַמִּקְצֹעַ׃

hebrew.text: וַיְחַזֵּק עַל־יָדוֹ עֵזֶר בֶּן־יֵשׁוּעַ שַׂר הַמִּצְפָּה מִדָּה שֵׁנִית מִנֶּגֶד עֲלֹת הַנֶּשֶׁק הַמִּקְצֹעַ׃

english.text:
Next to him, Ezer son of Jeshua, the chief of Mizpah, repaired a
second stretch, from in front of the ascent to the armory [at] the
angle [of the wall].

verses.english:
Next to him, Ezer son of Jeshua, the chief of Mizpah, repaired a
second stretch, from in front of the ascent to the armory [at] the
angle [of the wall].

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱרָה הֶחֱזִיק בָּרוּךְ בֶּן־[זַכַּי] (זבי) מִדָּה שֵׁנִית מִן־הַמִּקְצוֹעַ עַד־פֶּתַח בֵּית אֶלְיָשִׁיב הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל׃

hebrew.text: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱרָה הֶחֱזִיק בָּרוּךְ בֶּן־[זַכַּי] (זבי) מִדָּה שֵׁנִית מִן־הַמִּקְצוֹעַ עַד־פֶּתַח בֵּית אֶלְיָשִׁיב הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל׃

english.text:
After him, Baruch son of Zaccai zealously repaired a second
stretch, from the angle to the entrance to the house of Eliashib,
the high priest.

verses.english:
After him, Baruch son of Zaccai zealously repaired a second
stretch, from the angle to the entrance to the house of Eliashib,
the high priest.

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק מְרֵמוֹת בֶּן־אוּרִיָּה בֶּן־הַקּוֹץ מִדָּה שֵׁנִית מִפֶּתַח בֵּית אֶלְיָשִׁיב וְעַד־תַּכְלִית בֵּית אֶלְיָשִׁיב׃

hebrew.text: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק מְרֵמוֹת בֶּן־אוּרִיָּה בֶּן־הַקּוֹץ מִדָּה שֵׁנִית מִפֶּתַח בֵּית אֶלְיָשִׁיב וְעַד־תַּכְלִית בֵּית אֶלְיָשִׁיב׃

english.text:
After him, Meremoth son of Uriah son of Hakkoz repaired a second
stretch, from the entrance to Eliashib’s house to the end of
Eliashib’s house.

verses.english:
After him, Meremoth son of Uriah son of Hakkoz repaired a second
stretch, from the entrance to Eliashib’s house to the end of
Eliashib’s house.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אַנְשֵׁי הַכִּכָּר׃

hebrew.text: וְאַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אַנְשֵׁי הַכִּכָּר׃

english.text: After him, the priests, inhabitants of the plain, repaired.

verses.english: After him, the priests, inhabitants of the plain, repaired.

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק בִּנְיָמִן וְחַשּׁוּב נֶגֶד בֵּיתָםאַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק עֲזַרְיָה בֶן־מַעֲשֵׂיָה בֶּן־עֲנָנְיָה אֵצֶל בֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק בִּנְיָמִן וְחַשּׁוּב נֶגֶד בֵּיתָםאַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק עֲזַרְיָה בֶן־מַעֲשֵׂיָה בֶּן־עֲנָנְיָה אֵצֶל בֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
After them, Benjamin and Hasshub repaired in front of their
houses. After them, Azariah son of Maaseiah son of Ananiah
repaired beside his house.

verses.english:
After them, Benjamin and Hasshub repaired in front of their
houses. After them, Azariah son of Maaseiah son of Ananiah
repaired beside his house.

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק בִּנּוּי בֶּן־חֵנָדָד מִדָּה שֵׁנִית מִבֵּית עֲזַרְיָה עַד־הַמִּקְצוֹעַ וְעַד־הַפִּנָּה׃

hebrew.text: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק בִּנּוּי בֶּן־חֵנָדָד מִדָּה שֵׁנִית מִבֵּית עֲזַרְיָה עַד־הַמִּקְצוֹעַ וְעַד־הַפִּנָּה׃

english.text:
After him, Binnui son of Henadad repaired a second stretch, from
the house of Azariah to the angle, to the corner.

verses.english:
After him, Binnui son of Henadad repaired a second stretch, from
the house of Azariah to the angle, to the corner.

verses.hebrew: פָּלָל בֶּן־אוּזַי מִנֶּגֶד הַמִּקְצוֹעַ וְהַמִּגְדָּל הַיּוֹצֵא מִבֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ הָעֶלְיוֹן אֲשֶׁר לַחֲצַר הַמַּטָּרָה אַחֲרָיו פְּדָיָה בֶן־פַּרְעֹשׁ׃

hebrew.text: פָּלָל בֶּן־אוּזַי מִנֶּגֶד הַמִּקְצוֹעַ וְהַמִּגְדָּל הַיּוֹצֵא מִבֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ הָעֶלְיוֹן אֲשֶׁר לַחֲצַר הַמַּטָּרָה אַחֲרָיו פְּדָיָה בֶן־פַּרְעֹשׁ׃

english.text:
Palal son of Uzai—from in front of the angle and the tower that
juts out of the house of the king, the upper [tower] of the prison
compound. After him, Pedaiah son of Parosh. (

verses.english:
Palal son of Uzai—from in front of the angle and the tower that

compound. After him, Pedaiah son of Parosh. (

verses.hebrew: וְהַנְּתִינִים הָיוּ יֹשְׁבִים בָּעֹפֶל עַד נֶגֶד שַׁעַר הַמַּיִם לַמִּזְרָח וְהַמִּגְדָּל הַיּוֹצֵא׃

hebrew.text: וְהַנְּתִינִים הָיוּ יֹשְׁבִים בָּעֹפֶל עַד נֶגֶד שַׁעַר הַמַּיִם לַמִּזְרָח וְהַמִּגְדָּל הַיּוֹצֵא׃

english.text:
The temple servants were living on the Ophel, as far as a point in
front of the Water Gate in the east, and the jutting tower.)

verses.english:
The temple servants were living on the Ophel, as far as a point in
front of the Water Gate in the east, and the jutting tower.)

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַתְּקֹעִים מִדָּה שֵׁנִית מִנֶּגֶד הַמִּגְדָּל הַגָּדוֹל הַיּוֹצֵא וְעַד חוֹמַת הָעֹפֶל׃

hebrew.text: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַתְּקֹעִים מִדָּה שֵׁנִית מִנֶּגֶד הַמִּגְדָּל הַגָּדוֹל הַיּוֹצֵא וְעַד חוֹמַת הָעֹפֶל׃

english.text:
After him, the Tekoites repaired a second stretch, from in front
of the great jutting tower to the wall of the Ophel.

verses.english:
After him, the Tekoites repaired a second stretch, from in front
of the great jutting tower to the wall of the Ophel.

verses.hebrew: מֵעַל שַׁעַר הַסּוּסִים הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אִישׁ לְנֶגֶד בֵּיתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: מֵעַל שַׁעַר הַסּוּסִים הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אִישׁ לְנֶגֶד בֵּיתוֹ׃

english.text:
Above the Horse Gate, the priests repaired, each in front of his
house.

verses.english:
Above the Horse Gate, the priests repaired, each in front of his
house.

verses.hebrew: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק צָדוֹק בֶּן־אִמֵּר נֶגֶד בֵּיתוֹוְאַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק שְׁמַעְיָה בֶן־שְׁכַנְיָה שֹׁמֵר שַׁעַר הַמִּזְרָח׃

hebrew.text: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק צָדוֹק בֶּן־אִמֵּר נֶגֶד בֵּיתוֹוְאַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק שְׁמַעְיָה בֶן־שְׁכַנְיָה שֹׁמֵר שַׁעַר הַמִּזְרָח׃

english.text:
After them, Zadok son of Immer repaired in front of his house.
After him, Shemaiah son of Shechaniah, keeper of the East Gate,
repaired.

verses.english:
After them, Zadok son of Immer repaired in front of his house.
After him, Shemaiah son of Shechaniah, keeper of the East Gate,
repaired.

verses.hebrew: (אחרי) [אַחֲרָיו] הֶחֱזִיק חֲנַנְיָה בֶן־שֶׁלֶמְיָה וְחָנוּן בֶּן־צָלָף הַשִּׁשִּׁי מִדָּה שֵׁנִיאַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק מְשֻׁלָּם בֶּן־בֶּרֶכְיָה נֶגֶד נִשְׁכָּתוֹ׃

hebrew.text: (אחרי) [אַחֲרָיו] הֶחֱזִיק חֲנַנְיָה בֶן־שֶׁלֶמְיָה וְחָנוּן בֶּן־צָלָף הַשִּׁשִּׁי מִדָּה שֵׁנִיאַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק מְשֻׁלָּם בֶּן־בֶּרֶכְיָה נֶגֶד נִשְׁכָּתוֹ׃

english.text:
After him, Hananiah son of Shelemiah and Hanun, the sixth son of
Zalaph, repaired a second stretch. After them, Meshullam son of
Berechiah repaired in front of his chamber.

verses.english:
After him, Hananiah son of Shelemiah and Hanun, the sixth son of
Zalaph, repaired a second stretch. After them, Meshullam son of
Berechiah repaired in front of his chamber.

verses.hebrew: (אחרי) [אַחֲרָיו] הֶחֱזִיק מַלְכִּיָּה בֶּן־הַצֹּרְפִי עַד־בֵּית הַנְּתִינִים וְהָרֹכְלִים נֶגֶד שַׁעַר הַמִּפְקָד וְעַד עֲלִיַּת הַפִּנָּה׃

hebrew.text: (אחרי) [אַחֲרָיו] הֶחֱזִיק מַלְכִּיָּה בֶּן־הַצֹּרְפִי עַד־בֵּית הַנְּתִינִים וְהָרֹכְלִים נֶגֶד שַׁעַר הַמִּפְקָד וְעַד עֲלִיַּת הַפִּנָּה׃

english.text:
After him, Malchijah of the smiths repaired as far as the house of
the temple servants and the merchants, [from] in front of the
Muster Gate to the corner loft.

verses.english:
After him, Malchijah of the smiths repaired as far as the house of
the temple servants and the merchants, [from] in front of the
Muster Gate to the corner loft.

verses.hebrew: וּבֵין עֲלִיַּת הַפִּנָּה לְשַׁעַר הַצֹּאן הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַצֹּרְפִים וְהָרֹכְלִים׃

hebrew.text: וּבֵין עֲלִיַּת הַפִּנָּה לְשַׁעַר הַצֹּאן הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַצֹּרְפִים וְהָרֹכְלִים׃

english.text:
And between the corner loft to the Sheep Gate the smiths and the
merchants repaired.

verses.english:
And between the corner loft to the Sheep Gate the smiths and the
merchants repaired.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע סַנְבַלַּט כִּי־אֲנַחְנוּ בוֹנִים אֶת־הַחוֹמָה וַיִּחַר לוֹ וַיִּכְעַס הַרְבֵּה וַיַּלְעֵג עַל־הַיְּהוּדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע סַנְבַלַּט כִּי־אֲנַחְנוּ בוֹנִים אֶת־הַחוֹמָה וַיִּחַר לוֹ וַיִּכְעַס הַרְבֵּה וַיַּלְעֵג עַל־הַיְּהוּדִים׃

english.text:
When Sanballat heard that we were rebuilding the wall, it angered
him, and he was extremely vexed. He mocked the Jews,

english.text:
saying in the presence of his brothers and the Samarian force,
“What are the miserable Jews doing? Will they restore, offer
sacrifice, and finish one day? Can they revive those stones out of
the dust heaps, burned as they are?”

taunts upon their heads! Let them be taken as spoil to a land of
captivity!

before You, for they hurled provocations at the builders.

height; for the people’s heart was in the work.

crying out loudly and bitterly,

reached, there was great mourning among the Jews, with fasting,
weeping, and wailing, and everybody lay in sackcloth and ashes.—

english.text:
“All the king’s courtiers and the people of the king’s provinces
know that if any person, man or woman, enters the king’s presence
in the inner court without having been summoned, there is but one
law for him—that he be put to death. Only if the king extends the
golden scepter to him may he live. Now I have not been summoned to
visit the king for the last thirty days.”

verses.english:
“All the king’s courtiers and the people of the king’s provinces
know that if any person, man or woman, enters the king’s presence
in the inner court without having been summoned, there is but one
law for him—that he be put to death. Only if the king extends the
golden scepter to him may he live. Now I have not been summoned to
visit the king for the last thirty days.”

בֵּהּ־זִמְנָא אֲתָה עֲלֵיהוֹן תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֲבַר־נַהֲרָה וּשְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וּכְנָוָתְהוֹן וְכֵן אָמְרִין לְהֹם מַן־שָׂם לְכֹם טְעֵם בַּיְתָא דְנָה לִבְּנֵא וְאֻשַּׁרְנָא דְנָה
לְשַׁכְלָלָה׃

hebrew.text:
בֵּהּ־זִמְנָא אֲתָה עֲלֵיהוֹן תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֲבַר־נַהֲרָה וּשְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וּכְנָוָתְהוֹן וְכֵן אָמְרִין לְהֹם מַן־שָׂם לְכֹם טְעֵם בַּיְתָא דְנָה לִבְּנֵא וְאֻשַּׁרְנָא דְנָה

At once Tattenai, governor of the province of Beyond the River,
Shethar-bozenai, and their colleagues descended upon them and said
this to them, “Who issued orders to you to rebuild this house and
complete its furnishing?”

english.text:
Then we said to them, “What are the names of the men who are
engaged in the building?”

verses.english:
Then we said to them, “What are the names of the men who are

verses.hebrew: וְעֵין אֱלָהֲהֹם הֲוָת עַל־שָׂבֵי יְהוּדָיֵא וְלָא־בַטִּלוּ הִמּוֹ עַד־טַעְמָא לְדָרְיָוֶשׁ יְהָךְ וֶאֱדַיִן יְתִיבוּן נִשְׁתְּוָנָא עַל־דְּנָה׃

hebrew.text: וְעֵין אֱלָהֲהֹם הֲוָת עַל־שָׂבֵי יְהוּדָיֵא וְלָא־בַטִּלוּ הִמּוֹ עַד־טַעְמָא לְדָרְיָוֶשׁ יְהָךְ וֶאֱדַיִן יְתִיבוּן נִשְׁתְּוָנָא עַל־דְּנָה׃

english.text:
But God watched over the elders of the Jews and they were not
stopped while a report went to Darius and a letter was sent back
in reply to it.

verses.english:
But God watched over the elders of the Jews and they were not
stopped while a report went to Darius and a letter was sent back
in reply to it.

verses.hebrew: פַּרְשֶׁגֶן אִגַּרְתָּא דִּי־שְׁלַח תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֲבַר־נַהֲרָה וּשְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וּכְנָוָתֵהּ אֲפַרְסְכָיֵא דִּי בַּעֲבַר נַהֲרָה עַל־דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא׃

hebrew.text: פַּרְשֶׁגֶן אִגַּרְתָּא דִּי־שְׁלַח תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֲבַר־נַהֲרָה וּשְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וּכְנָוָתֵהּ אֲפַרְסְכָיֵא דִּי בַּעֲבַר נַהֲרָה עַל־דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא׃

english.text:
This is the text of the letter that Tattenai, governor of the
province of Beyond the River, and Shethar-bozenai and his
colleagues, the officials of Beyond the River, sent to King
Darius.

verses.english:
This is the text of the letter that Tattenai, governor of the
province of Beyond the River, and Shethar-bozenai and his
colleagues, the officials of Beyond the River, sent to King
Darius.

verses.hebrew: פִּתְגָמָא שְׁלַחוּ עֲלוֹהִי וְכִדְנָה כְּתִיב בְּגַוֵּהּ לְדָרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא שְׁלָמָא כֹלָּא׃

hebrew.text: פִּתְגָמָא שְׁלַחוּ עֲלוֹהִי וְכִדְנָה כְּתִיב בְּגַוֵּהּ לְדָרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא שְׁלָמָא כֹלָּא׃

english.text:
They sent a message to him and this is what was written in it: “To
King Darius, greetings, and so forth.

verses.english:
They sent a message to him and this is what was written in it: “To
King Darius, greetings, and so forth.

verses.hebrew:
יְדִיעַ לֶהֱוֵא לְמַלְכָּא דִּי־אֲזַלְנָא לִיהוּד מְדִינְתָּא לְבֵית אֱלָהָא רַבָּא וְהוּא מִתְבְּנֵא אֶבֶן גְּלָל וְאָע מִתְּשָׂם בְּכֻתְלַיָּא וַעֲבִידְתָּא דָךְ אסְפַּרְנָא
מִתְעַבְדָא וּמַצְלַח בְּיֶדְהֹם׃

hebrew.text:
יְדִיעַ לֶהֱוֵא לְמַלְכָּא דִּי־אֲזַלְנָא לִיהוּד מְדִינְתָּא לְבֵית אֱלָהָא רַבָּא וְהוּא מִתְבְּנֵא אֶבֶן גְּלָל וְאָע מִתְּשָׂם בְּכֻתְלַיָּא וַעֲבִידְתָּא דָךְ אסְפַּרְנָא
מִתְעַבְדָא וּמַצְלַח בְּיֶדְהֹם׃

english.text:
Be it known to the king, that we went to the province of Judah, to
the house of the great God. It is being rebuilt of hewn stone, and
wood is being laid in the walls. The work is being done with
dispatch and is going well.

verses.english:

the house of the great God. It is being rebuilt of hewn stone, and
wood is being laid in the walls. The work is being done with
dispatch and is going well.

verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן שְׁאֵלְנָא לְשָׂבַיָּא אִלֵּךְ כְּנֵמָא אֲמַרְנָא לְּהֹם מַן־שָׂם לְכֹם טְעֵם בַּיְתָא דְנָה לְמִבְנְיָה וְאֻשַּׁרְנָא דְנָה לְשַׁכְלָלָה׃

hebrew.text: אֱדַיִן שְׁאֵלְנָא לְשָׂבַיָּא אִלֵּךְ כְּנֵמָא אֲמַרְנָא לְּהֹם מַן־שָׂם לְכֹם טְעֵם בַּיְתָא דְנָה לְמִבְנְיָה וְאֻשַּׁרְנָא דְנָה לְשַׁכְלָלָה׃

english.text:
Thereupon we directed this question to these elders, ‘Who issued
orders to you to rebuild this house and to complete its
furnishings?’

verses.english:
Thereupon we directed this question to these elders, ‘Who issued
orders to you to rebuild this house and to complete its
furnishings?’

verses.hebrew: וְאַף שְׁמָהָתְהֹם שְׁאֵלְנָא לְּהֹם לְהוֹדָעוּתָךְ דִּי נִכְתֻּב שֻׁם־גֻּבְרַיָּא דִּי בְרָאשֵׁיהֹם׃

hebrew.text: וְאַף שְׁמָהָתְהֹם שְׁאֵלְנָא לְּהֹם לְהוֹדָעוּתָךְ דִּי נִכְתֻּב שֻׁם־גֻּבְרַיָּא דִּי בְרָאשֵׁיהֹם׃

english.text:
We also asked their names so that we could write down the names of
their leaders for your information.

verses.english:
We also asked their names so that we could write down the names of
their leaders for your information.

verses.hebrew:
וּכְנֵמָא פִתְגָמָא הֲתִיבוּנָא לְמֵמַר אֲנַחְנָא הִמּוֹ עַבְדוֹהִי דִי־אֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא וְאַרְעָא וּבָנַיִן בַּיְתָא דִּי־הֲוָא בְנֵה מִקַּדְמַת דְּנָה שְׁנִין שַׂגִּיאָן וּמֶלֶךְ
לְיִשְׂרָאֵל רַב בְּנָהִי וְשַׁכְלְלֵהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וּכְנֵמָא פִתְגָמָא הֲתִיבוּנָא לְמֵמַר אֲנַחְנָא הִמּוֹ עַבְדוֹהִי דִי־אֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא וְאַרְעָא וּבָנַיִן בַּיְתָא דִּי־הֲוָא בְנֵה מִקַּדְמַת דְּנָה שְׁנִין שַׂגִּיאָן וּמֶלֶךְ

english.text:
This is what they answered us: ‘We are the servants of the God of
heaven and earth; we are rebuilding the house that was originally
built many years ago; a great king of Israel built it and
completed it.

verses.english:
This is what they answered us: ‘We are the servants of the God of
heaven and earth; we are rebuilding the house that was originally
built many years ago; a great king of Israel built it and
completed it.

verses.hebrew: לָהֵן מִן־דִּי הַרְגִּזוּ אֲבָהָתַנָא לֶאֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא יְהַב הִמּוֹ בְּיַד נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל (כסדיא) [כַּסְדָּאָה] וּבַיְתָה דְנָה סַתְרֵהּ וְעַמָּה הַגְלִי לְבָבֶל׃

hebrew.text: לָהֵן מִן־דִּי הַרְגִּזוּ אֲבָהָתַנָא לֶאֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא יְהַב הִמּוֹ בְּיַד נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל (כסדיא) [כַּסְדָּאָה] וּבַיְתָה דְנָה סַתְרֵהּ וְעַמָּה הַגְלִי לְבָבֶל׃

english.text:
But because our fathers angered the God of Heaven, He handed them
over to Nebuchadnezzar the Chaldean, king of Babylon, who
demolished this house and exiled the people to Babylon.

verses.english:

over to Nebuchadnezzar the Chaldean, king of Babylon, who
demolished this house and exiled the people to Babylon.

verses.hebrew: בְּרַם בִּשְׁנַת חֲדָה לְכוֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא דִּי בָבֶל כּוֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא שָׂם טְעֵם בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דְנָה לִבְּנֵא׃

hebrew.text: בְּרַם בִּשְׁנַת חֲדָה לְכוֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא דִּי בָבֶל כּוֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא שָׂם טְעֵם בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דְנָה לִבְּנֵא׃

english.text:
But in the first year of King Cyrus of Babylon, King Cyrus issued
an order to rebuild this House of God.

verses.english:
But in the first year of King Cyrus of Babylon, King Cyrus issued

verses.hebrew:
וְאַף מָאנַיָּא דִי־בֵית־אֱלָהָא דִּי דַהֲבָה וְכַסְפָּא דִּי נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר הַנְפֵּק מִן־הֵיכְלָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם וְהֵיבֵל הִמּוֹ לְהֵיכְלָא דִּי בָבֶל הַנְפֵּק הִמּוֹ כּוֹרֶשׁ
מַלְכָּא מִן־הֵיכְלָא דִּי בָבֶל וִיהִיבוּ לְשֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר שְׁמֵהּ דִּי פֶחָה שָׂמֵהּ׃

hebrew.text:
וְאַף מָאנַיָּא דִי־בֵית־אֱלָהָא דִּי דַהֲבָה וְכַסְפָּא דִּי נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר הַנְפֵּק מִן־הֵיכְלָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם וְהֵיבֵל הִמּוֹ לְהֵיכְלָא דִּי בָבֶל הַנְפֵּק הִמּוֹ כּוֹרֶשׁ

english.text:
Also the silver and gold vessels of the House of God that
Nebuchadnezzar had taken away from the temple in Jerusalem and
brought to the temple in Babylon—King Cyrus released them from the
temple in Babylon to be given to the one called Sheshbazzar whom
he had appointed governor.

verses.english:
Also the silver and gold vessels of the House of God that
Nebuchadnezzar had taken away from the temple in Jerusalem and
brought to the temple in Babylon—King Cyrus released them from the

he had appointed governor.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲמַר־לֵהּ (אלה) [אֵל] מָאנַיָּא שֵׂא אֵזֶל־אֲחֵת הִמּוֹ בְּהֵיכְלָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם וּבֵית אֱלָהָא יִתְבְּנֵא עַל־אַתְרֵהּ׃

hebrew.text: וַאֲמַר־לֵהּ (אלה) [אֵל] מָאנַיָּא שֵׂא אֵזֶל־אֲחֵת הִמּוֹ בְּהֵיכְלָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם וּבֵית אֱלָהָא יִתְבְּנֵא עַל־אַתְרֵהּ׃

english.text:
He said to him, “Take these vessels, go, deposit them in the
temple in Jerusalem, and let the House of God be rebuilt on its
original site.”

verses.english:
He said to him, “Take these vessels, go, deposit them in the
temple in Jerusalem, and let the House of God be rebuilt on its
original site.”

verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר דֵּךְ אֲתָא יְהַב אֻשַּׁיָּא דִּי־בֵית אֱלָהָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם וּמִן־אֱדַיִן וְעַד־כְּעַן מִתְבְּנֵא וְלָא שְׁלִם׃

english.text:
That same Sheshbazzar then came and laid the foundations for the
House of God in Jerusalem; and ever since then it has been under
construction, but is not yet finished.’

verses.english:

verses.hebrew:
וּכְעַן הֵן עַל־מַלְכָּא טָב יִתְבַּקַּר בְּבֵית גִּנְזַיָּא דִּי־מַלְכָּא תַמָּה דִּי בְּבָבֶל הֵן אִיתַי דִּי־מִן־כּוֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא שִׂים טְעֵם לְמִבְנֵא בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דֵךְ
בִּירוּשְׁלֶם וּרְעוּת מַלְכָּא עַל־דְּנָה יִשְׁלַח עֲלֶינָא׃

hebrew.text:
וּכְעַן הֵן עַל־מַלְכָּא טָב יִתְבַּקַּר בְּבֵית גִּנְזַיָּא דִּי־מַלְכָּא תַמָּה דִּי בְּבָבֶל הֵן אִיתַי דִּי־מִן־כּוֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא שִׂים טְעֵם לְמִבְנֵא בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דֵךְ
בִּירוּשְׁלֶם וּרְעוּת מַלְכָּא עַל־דְּנָה יִשְׁלַח עֲלֶינָא׃

english.text:
And now, if it please the king, let the royal archives there in
Babylon be searched to see whether indeed an order had been issued
by King Cyrus to rebuild this House of God in Jerusalem. May the
king convey to us his pleasure in this matter.”

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי צַעֲקַת הָעָם וּנְשֵׁיהֶם גְּדוֹלָה אֶל־אֲחֵיהֶם הַיְּהוּדִים׃

hebrew.text: וַתְּהִי צַעֲקַת הָעָם וּנְשֵׁיהֶם גְּדוֹלָה אֶל־אֲחֵיהֶם הַיְּהוּדִים׃

english.text:
There was a great outcry by the common folk and their wives
against their brother Jews.

verses.english:
There was a great outcry by the common folk and their wives

verses.hebrew: וְיֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר אֹמְרִים בָּנֵינוּ וּבְנֹתֵינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ רַבִּים וְנִקְחָה דָגָן וְנֹאכְלָה וְנִחְיֶה׃

hebrew.text: וְיֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר אֹמְרִים בָּנֵינוּ וּבְנֹתֵינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ רַבִּים וְנִקְחָה דָגָן וְנֹאכְלָה וְנִחְיֶה׃

english.text:
Some said, “Our sons and daughters are numerous; we must get grain
to eat in order that we may live!”

verses.english:
Some said, “Our sons and daughters are numerous; we must get grain
to eat in order that we may live!”

verses.hebrew: וְיֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר אֹמְרִים שְׂדֹתֵינוּ וּכְרָמֵינוּ וּבָתֵּינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ עֹרְבִים וְנִקְחָה דָגָן בָּרָעָב׃

hebrew.text: וְיֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר אֹמְרִים שְׂדֹתֵינוּ וּכְרָמֵינוּ וּבָתֵּינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ עֹרְבִים וְנִקְחָה דָגָן בָּרָעָב׃

english.text:
Others said, “We must pawn our fields, our vineyards, and our
homes to get grain to stave off hunger.”

verses.english:
Others said, “We must pawn our fields, our vineyards, and our
homes to get grain to stave off hunger.”

verses.hebrew: וְיֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר אֹמְרִים לָוִינוּ כֶסֶף לְמִדַּת הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׂדֹתֵינוּ וּכְרָמֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְיֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר אֹמְרִים לָוִינוּ כֶסֶף לְמִדַּת הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׂדֹתֵינוּ וּכְרָמֵינוּ׃

english.text:
Yet others said, “We have borrowed money against our fields and
vineyards to pay the king’s tax.

verses.english:
Yet others said, “We have borrowed money against our fields and

verses.hebrew:
וְעַתָּה כִּבְשַׂר אַחֵינוּ בְּשָׂרֵנוּ כִּבְנֵיהֶם בָּנֵינוּ וְהִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ כֹבְשִׁים אֶת־בָּנֵינוּ וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵינוּ לַעֲבָדִים וְיֵשׁ מִבְּנֹתֵינוּ נִכְבָּשׁוֹת וְאֵין לְאֵל
יָדֵנוּ וּשְׂדֹתֵינוּ וּכְרָמֵינוּ לַאֲחֵרִים׃

hebrew.text:
וְעַתָּה כִּבְשַׂר אַחֵינוּ בְּשָׂרֵנוּ כִּבְנֵיהֶם בָּנֵינוּ וְהִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ כֹבְשִׁים אֶת־בָּנֵינוּ וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵינוּ לַעֲבָדִים וְיֵשׁ מִבְּנֹתֵינוּ נִכְבָּשׁוֹת וְאֵין לְאֵל
יָדֵנוּ וּשְׂדֹתֵינוּ וּכְרָמֵינוּ לַאֲחֵרִים׃

english.text:
Now we are as good as our brothers, and our children as good as
theirs; yet here we are subjecting our sons and daughters to
slavery—some of our daughters are already subjected—and we are
powerless, while our fields and vineyards belong to others.”

verses.english:
Now we are as good as our brothers, and our children as good as
theirs; yet here we are subjecting our sons and daughters to
slavery—some of our daughters are already subjected—and we are
powerless, while our fields and vineyards belong to others.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר לִי מְאֹד כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת־זַעֲקָתָם וְאֵת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּחַר לִי מְאֹד כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת־זַעֲקָתָם וְאֵת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

english.text: It angered me very much to hear their outcry and these complaints.

verses.english: It angered me very much to hear their outcry and these complaints.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמָּלֵךְ לִבִּי עָלַי וָאָרִיבָה אֶת־הַחֹרִים וְאֶת־הַסְּגָנִים וָאֹמְרָה לָהֶם מַשָּׁא אִישׁ־בְּאָחִיו אַתֶּם (נשאים) [נֹשִׁים] וָאֶתֵּן עֲלֵיהֶם קְהִלָּה גְדוֹלָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּמָּלֵךְ לִבִּי עָלַי וָאָרִיבָה אֶת־הַחֹרִים וְאֶת־הַסְּגָנִים וָאֹמְרָה לָהֶם מַשָּׁא אִישׁ־בְּאָחִיו אַתֶּם (נשאים) [נֹשִׁים] וָאֶתֵּן עֲלֵיהֶם קְהִלָּה גְדוֹלָה׃

english.text:
After pondering the matter carefully, I censured the nobles and
the prefects, saying, “Are you pressing claims on loans made to
your brothers?” Then I raised a large crowd against them

verses.english:
After pondering the matter carefully, I censured the nobles and
the prefects, saying, “Are you pressing claims on loans made to
your brothers?” Then I raised a large crowd against them

verses.hebrew:
וָאֹמְרָה לָהֶם אֲנַחְנוּ קָנִינוּ אֶת־אַחֵינוּ הַיְּהוּדִים הַנִּמְכָּרִים לַגּוֹיִם כְּדֵי בָנוּ וְגַם־אַתֶּם תִּמְכְּרוּ אֶת־אֲחֵיכֶם וְנִמְכְּרוּ־לָנוּ וַיַּחֲרִישׁוּ וְלֹא
מָצְאוּ דָּבָר׃

hebrew.text:
וָאֹמְרָה לָהֶם אֲנַחְנוּ קָנִינוּ אֶת־אַחֵינוּ הַיְּהוּדִים הַנִּמְכָּרִים לַגּוֹיִם כְּדֵי בָנוּ וְגַם־אַתֶּם תִּמְכְּרוּ אֶת־אֲחֵיכֶם וְנִמְכְּרוּ־לָנוּ וַיַּחֲרִישׁוּ וְלֹא
מָצְאוּ דָּבָר׃

english.text:
and said to them, “We have done our best to buy back our Jewish
brothers who were sold to the nations; will you now sell your
brothers so that they must be sold [back] to us?” They kept
silent, for they found nothing to answer.

verses.english:
and said to them, “We have done our best to buy back our Jewish
brothers who were sold to the nations; will you now sell your
brothers so that they must be sold [back] to us?” They kept
silent, for they found nothing to answer.

verses.hebrew: (ויאמר) [וָאוֹמַר] לֹא־טוֹב הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּם עֹשִׂים הֲלוֹא בְּיִרְאַת אֱלֹהֵינוּ תֵּלֵכוּ מֵחֶרְפַּת הַגּוֹיִם אוֹיְבֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: (ויאמר) [וָאוֹמַר] לֹא־טוֹב הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּם עֹשִׂים הֲלוֹא בְּיִרְאַת אֱלֹהֵינוּ תֵּלֵכוּ מֵחֶרְפַּת הַגּוֹיִם אוֹיְבֵינוּ׃

english.text:
So I continued, “What you are doing is not right. You ought to act
in a God-fearing way so as not to give our enemies, the nations,
room to reproach us.

verses.english:
So I continued, “What you are doing is not right. You ought to act

room to reproach us.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם־אֲנִי אַחַי וּנְעָרַי נֹשִׁים בָּהֶם כֶּסֶף וְדָגָן נַעַזְבָה־נָּא אֶת־הַמַּשָּׁא הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וְגַם־אֲנִי אַחַי וּנְעָרַי נֹשִׁים בָּהֶם כֶּסֶף וְדָגָן נַעַזְבָה־נָּא אֶת־הַמַּשָּׁא הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
I, my brothers, and my servants also have claims of money and
grain against them; let us now abandon those claims!

verses.english:
I, my brothers, and my servants also have claims of money and
grain against them; let us now abandon those claims!

verses.hebrew: הָשִׁיבוּ נָא לָהֶם כְּהַיּוֹם שְׂדֹתֵיהֶם כַּרְמֵיהֶם זֵיתֵיהֶם וּבָתֵּיהֶם וּמְאַת הַכֶּסֶף וְהַדָּגָן הַתִּירוֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָר אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם נֹשִׁים בָּהֶם׃

hebrew.text: הָשִׁיבוּ נָא לָהֶם כְּהַיּוֹם שְׂדֹתֵיהֶם כַּרְמֵיהֶם זֵיתֵיהֶם וּבָתֵּיהֶם וּמְאַת הַכֶּסֶף וְהַדָּגָן הַתִּירוֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָר אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם נֹשִׁים בָּהֶם׃

english.text:
Give back at once their fields, their vineyards, their olive
trees, and their homes, and [abandon] the claims for the hundred
pieces of silver, the grain, the wine, and the oil that you have
been pressing against them!”

verses.english:
Give back at once their fields, their vineyards, their olive
trees, and their homes, and [abandon] the claims for the hundred
pieces of silver, the grain, the wine, and the oil that you have
been pressing against them!”

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָשִׁיב וּמֵהֶם לֹא נְבַקֵּשׁ כֵּן נַעֲשֶׂה כַּאֲשֶׁר אַתָּה אוֹמֵר וָאֶקְרָא אֶת־הַכֹּהֲנִים וָאַשְׁבִּיעֵם לַעֲשׂוֹת כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָשִׁיב וּמֵהֶם לֹא נְבַקֵּשׁ כֵּן נַעֲשֶׂה כַּאֲשֶׁר אַתָּה אוֹמֵר וָאֶקְרָא אֶת־הַכֹּהֲנִים וָאַשְׁבִּיעֵם לַעֲשׂוֹת כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
They replied, “We shall give them back, and not demand anything of
them; we shall do just as you say.” Summoning the priests, I put
them under oath to keep this promise.

verses.english:
They replied, “We shall give them back, and not demand anything of
them; we shall do just as you say.” Summoning the priests, I put
them under oath to keep this promise.

verses.hebrew:
גַּם־חצְנִי נָעַרְתִּי וָאֹמְרָה כָּכָה יְנַעֵר הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת־כּל־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָקִים אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה מִבֵּיתוֹ וּמִיגִיעוֹ וְכָכָה יִהְיֶה נָעוּר וָרֵק וַיֹּאמְרוּ
כל־הַקָּהָל אָמֵן וַיְהַלְלוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וַיַּעַשׂ הָעָם כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text:
גַּם־חצְנִי נָעַרְתִּי וָאֹמְרָה כָּכָה יְנַעֵר הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת־כּל־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָקִים אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה מִבֵּיתוֹ וּמִיגִיעוֹ וְכָכָה יִהְיֶה נָעוּר וָרֵק וַיֹּאמְרוּ

english.text:
I also shook out the bosom of my garment and said, “So may God
shake free of his household and property any man who fails to keep
this promise; may he be thus shaken out and stripped.” All the
assembled answered, “Amen,” and praised YHWH. The people kept this
promise.

verses.english:
I also shook out the bosom of my garment and said, “So may God
shake free of his household and property any man who fails to keep
this promise; may he be thus shaken out and stripped.” All the
assembled answered, “Amen,” and praised YHWH. The people kept this
promise.

verses.hebrew:
גַּם מִיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה אוֹתִי לִהְיוֹת פֶּחָם בְּאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה מִשְּׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וְעַד שְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׁנִים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה

גַּם מִיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה אוֹתִי לִהְיוֹת פֶּחָם בְּאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה מִשְּׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וְעַד שְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׁנִים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה

english.text:
Furthermore, from the day I was commissioned to be governor in the
land of Judah—from the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes until his
thirty-second year, twelve years in all—neither I nor my brothers
ever ate of the governor’s food allowance.

verses.hebrew:

hebrew.text:

english.text:

people, and took from them for bread and wine more than forty
shekels of silver. Their servants also tyrannized over the people.
But I, out of the fear of God, did not do so.

beam removed from his house, and he shall be impaled on it and his
house confiscated.

verses.hebrew:
וֵאלָהָא דִּי שַׁכִּן שְׁמֵהּ תַּמָּה יְמַגַּר כּל־מֶלֶךְ וְעַם דִּי יִשְׁלַח יְדֵהּ לְהַשְׁנָיָה לְחַבָּלָה בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דֵךְ דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם אֲנָה דָרְיָוֶשׁ שָׂמֶת טְעֵם
אסְפַּרְנָא יִתְעֲבִד׃

hebrew.text:
וֵאלָהָא דִּי שַׁכִּן שְׁמֵהּ תַּמָּה יְמַגַּר כּל־מֶלֶךְ וְעַם דִּי יִשְׁלַח יְדֵהּ לְהַשְׁנָיָה לְחַבָּלָה בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דֵךְ דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם אֲנָה דָרְיָוֶשׁ שָׂמֶת טְעֵם
אסְפַּרְנָא יִתְעֲבִד׃

english.text:
And may the God who established His name there cause the downfall
of any king or nation that undertakes to alter or damage that
House of God in Jerusalem. I, Darius, have issued the decree; let
it be carried out with dispatch.”

verses.english:
And may the God who established His name there cause the downfall
of any king or nation that undertakes to alter or damage that
House of God in Jerusalem. I, Darius, have issued the decree; let
it be carried out with dispatch.”

verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֲבַר־נַהֲרָה שְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וּכְנָוָתְהוֹן לקֳבֵל דִּי־שְׁלַח דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא כְּנֵמָא אסְפַּרְנָא עֲבַדוּ׃

hebrew.text: אֱדַיִן תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֲבַר־נַהֲרָה שְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וּכְנָוָתְהוֹן לקֳבֵל דִּי־שְׁלַח דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא כְּנֵמָא אסְפַּרְנָא עֲבַדוּ׃

english.text:
Then Tattenai, governor of the province of Beyond the River,
Shethar-bozenai, and their colleagues carried out with dispatch
what King Darius had written.

verses.english:
Then Tattenai, governor of the province of Beyond the River,
Shethar-bozenai, and their colleagues carried out with dispatch
what King Darius had written.

verses.hebrew:
וְשָׂבֵי יְהוּדָיֵא בָּנַיִן וּמַצְלְחִין בִּנְבוּאַת חַגַּי (נביאה) [נְבִיָּא] וּזְכַרְיָה בַּר־עִדּוֹא וּבְנוֹ וְשַׁכְלִלוּ מִן־טַעַם אֱלָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִטְּעֵם כּוֹרֶשׁ
וְדָרְיָוֶשׁ וְאַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתְּא מֶלֶךְ פָּרָס׃

hebrew.text:
וְשָׂבֵי יְהוּדָיֵא בָּנַיִן וּמַצְלְחִין בִּנְבוּאַת חַגַּי (נביאה) [נְבִיָּא] וּזְכַרְיָה בַּר־עִדּוֹא וּבְנוֹ וְשַׁכְלִלוּ מִן־טַעַם אֱלָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִטְּעֵם כּוֹרֶשׁ
וְדָרְיָוֶשׁ וְאַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתְּא מֶלֶךְ פָּרָס׃

english.text:
So the elders of the Jews progressed in the building, urged on by
the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah son of Iddo,
and they brought the building to completion under the aegis of the
God of Israel and by the order of Cyrus and Darius and King
Artaxerxes of Persia.

verses.english:
So the elders of the Jews progressed in the building, urged on by
the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah son of Iddo,
and they brought the building to completion under the aegis of the
God of Israel and by the order of Cyrus and Darius and King
Artaxerxes of Persia.

verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁיצִיא בַּיְתָה דְנָה עַד יוֹם תְּלָתָה לִירַח אֲדָר דִּי־הִיא שְׁנַת־שֵׁת לְמַלְכוּת דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא׃

hebrew.text: וְשֵׁיצִיא בַּיְתָה דְנָה עַד יוֹם תְּלָתָה לִירַח אֲדָר דִּי־הִיא שְׁנַת־שֵׁת לְמַלְכוּת דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא׃

english.text:
The house was finished on the third of the month of Adar in the
sixth year of the reign of King Darius.

verses.english:
The house was finished on the third of the month of Adar in the
sixth year of the reign of King Darius.

verses.hebrew: וַעֲבַדוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּהֲנַיָּא וְלֵוָיֵא וּשְׁאָר בְּנֵי־גָלוּתָא חֲנֻכַּת בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דְנָה בְּחֶדְוָה׃

hebrew.text: וַעֲבַדוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּהֲנַיָּא וְלֵוָיֵא וּשְׁאָר בְּנֵי־גָלוּתָא חֲנֻכַּת בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דְנָה בְּחֶדְוָה׃

english.text:
The Israelites, the priests, and the Levites, and all the other
exiles celebrated the dedication of the House of God with joy.

verses.english:
The Israelites, the priests, and the Levites, and all the other
exiles celebrated the dedication of the House of God with joy.

verses.hebrew:
וְהַקְרִבוּ לַחֲנֻכַּת בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דְנָה תּוֹרִין מְאָה דִּכְרִין מָאתַיִן אִמְּרִין אַרְבַּע מְאָה וּצְפִירֵי עִזִּין (לחטיא) [לְחַטָּאָה] עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּרֵי־עֲשַׂר
לְמִנְיָן שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
וְהַקְרִבוּ לַחֲנֻכַּת בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דְנָה תּוֹרִין מְאָה דִּכְרִין מָאתַיִן אִמְּרִין אַרְבַּע מְאָה וּצְפִירֵי עִזִּין (לחטיא) [לְחַטָּאָה] עַל־כּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּרֵי־עֲשַׂר
לְמִנְיָן שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
And they sacrificed for the dedication of this House of God one
hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and twelve
goats as a purification offering for all of Israel, according to
the number of the tribes of Israel.

verses.english:
And they sacrificed for the dedication of this House of God one
hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and twelve
goats as a purification offering for all of Israel, according to
the number of the tribes of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַהֲקִימוּ כָהֲנַיָּא בִּפְלֻגָּתְהוֹן וְלֵוָיֵא בְּמַחְלְקָתְהוֹן עַל־עֲבִידַת אֱלָהָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם כִּכְתָב סְפַר מֹשֶׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַהֲקִימוּ כָהֲנַיָּא בִּפְלֻגָּתְהוֹן וְלֵוָיֵא בְּמַחְלְקָתְהוֹן עַל־עֲבִידַת אֱלָהָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם כִּכְתָב סְפַר מֹשֶׁה׃

english.text:
They appointed the priests in their courses and the Levites in
their divisions for the service of God in Jerusalem, according to
the prescription in the Book of Moses.

verses.english:
They appointed the priests in their courses and the Levites in
their divisions for the service of God in Jerusalem, according to
the prescription in the Book of Moses.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־הַגּוֹלָה אֶת־הַפָּסַח בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־הַגּוֹלָה אֶת־הַפָּסַח בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן׃

english.text:
The returned exiles celebrated the Passover on the fourteenth day
of the first month,

verses.english:
The returned exiles celebrated the Passover on the fourteenth day
of the first month,

verses.hebrew: כִּי הִטַּהֲרוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם כְּאֶחָד כֻּלָּם טְהוֹרִים וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ הַפֶּסַח לְכל־בְּנֵי הַגּוֹלָה וְלַאֲחֵיהֶם הַכֹּהֲנִים וְלָהֶם׃

hebrew.text: כִּי הִטַּהֲרוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם כְּאֶחָד כֻּלָּם טְהוֹרִים וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ הַפֶּסַח לְכל־בְּנֵי הַגּוֹלָה וְלַאֲחֵיהֶם הַכֹּהֲנִים וְלָהֶם׃

english.text:
for the priests and Levites had purified themselves to a man; they
were all pure. They slaughtered the passover offering for all the
returned exiles, and for their brother priests and for themselves.

verses.english:
for the priests and Levites had purified themselves to a man; they
were all pure. They slaughtered the passover offering for all the
returned exiles, and for their brother priests and for themselves.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאכְלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַשָּׁבִים מֵהַגּוֹלָה וְכֹל הַנִּבְדָּל מִטֻּמְאַת גּוֹיֵ־הָאָרֶץ אֲלֵהֶם לִדְרֹשׁ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיֹּאכְלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַשָּׁבִים מֵהַגּוֹלָה וְכֹל הַנִּבְדָּל מִטֻּמְאַת גּוֹיֵ־הָאָרֶץ אֲלֵהֶם לִדְרֹשׁ לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
The children of Israel who had returned from the exile, together
with all who joined them in separating themselves from the
uncleanliness of the nations of the lands to worship YHWH God of
Israel, ate of it.

verses.english:
The children of Israel who had returned from the exile, together
with all who joined them in separating themselves from the
uncleanliness of the nations of the lands to worship YHWH God of
Israel, ate of it.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ חַג־מַצּוֹת שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בְּשִׂמְחָה כִּי שִׂמְּחָם יְהֹוָה וְהֵסֵב לֵב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עֲלֵיהֶם לְחַזֵּק יְדֵיהֶם בִּמְלֶאכֶת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ חַג־מַצּוֹת שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בְּשִׂמְחָה כִּי שִׂמְּחָם יְהֹוָה וְהֵסֵב לֵב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עֲלֵיהֶם לְחַזֵּק יְדֵיהֶם בִּמְלֶאכֶת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

english.text:
They joyfully celebrated the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven
days, for YHWH had given them cause for joy by inclining the heart
of the Assyrian king toward them so as to give them support in the
work of the House of God, the God of Israel.

verses.english:
They joyfully celebrated the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven
days, for YHWH had given them cause for joy by inclining the heart
of the Assyrian king toward them so as to give them support in the
work of the House of God, the God of Israel.

verses.hebrew:
וַיְהִי כַאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁמַע לְסַנְבַלַּט וְטוֹבִיָּה וּלְגֶשֶׁם הָעַרְבִי וּלְיֶתֶר אֹיְבֵינוּ כִּי בָנִיתִי אֶת־הַחוֹמָה וְלֹא־נוֹתַר בָּהּ פָּרֶץ גַּם עַד־הָעֵת הַהִיא דְּלָתוֹת
לֹא־הֶעֱמַדְתִּי בַשְּׁעָרִים׃

hebrew.text:
וַיְהִי כַאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁמַע לְסַנְבַלַּט וְטוֹבִיָּה וּלְגֶשֶׁם הָעַרְבִי וּלְיֶתֶר אֹיְבֵינוּ כִּי בָנִיתִי אֶת־הַחוֹמָה וְלֹא־נוֹתַר בָּהּ פָּרֶץ גַּם עַד־הָעֵת הַהִיא דְּלָתוֹת
לֹא־הֶעֱמַדְתִּי בַשְּׁעָרִים׃

english.text:
When word reached Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab, and the rest
of our enemies that I had rebuilt the wall and not a breach
remained in it—though at that time I had not yet set up doors in
the gateways—

verses.english:
When word reached Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab, and the rest
of our enemies that I had rebuilt the wall and not a breach
remained in it—though at that time I had not yet set up doors in
the gateways—

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח סַנְבַלַּט וְגֶשֶׁם אֵלַי לֵאמֹר לְכָה וְנִוָּעֲדָה יַחְדָּו בַּכְּפִירִים בְּבִקְעַת אוֹנוֹ וְהֵמָּה חֹשְׁבִים לַעֲשׂוֹת לִי רָעָה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח סַנְבַלַּט וְגֶשֶׁם אֵלַי לֵאמֹר לְכָה וְנִוָּעֲדָה יַחְדָּו בַּכְּפִירִים בְּבִקְעַת אוֹנוֹ וְהֵמָּה חֹשְׁבִים לַעֲשׂוֹת לִי רָעָה׃

english.text:
Sanballat and Geshem sent a message to me, saying, “Come, let us
get together in Kephirim in the Ono valley”; they planned to do me
harm.

verses.english:
Sanballat and Geshem sent a message to me, saying, “Come, let us
get together in Kephirim in the Ono valley”; they planned to do me
harm.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁלְחָה עֲלֵיהֶם מַלְאָכִים לֵאמֹר מְלָאכָה גְדוֹלָה אֲנִי עֹשֶׂה וְלֹא אוּכַל לָרֶדֶת לָמָּה תִשְׁבַּת הַמְּלָאכָה כַּאֲשֶׁר אַרְפֶּהָ וְיָרַדְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶשְׁלְחָה עֲלֵיהֶם מַלְאָכִים לֵאמֹר מְלָאכָה גְדוֹלָה אֲנִי עֹשֶׂה וְלֹא אוּכַל לָרֶדֶת לָמָּה תִשְׁבַּת הַמְּלָאכָה כַּאֲשֶׁר אַרְפֶּהָ וְיָרַדְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
I sent them messengers, saying, “I am engaged in a great work and
cannot come down, for the work will stop if I leave it in order to
come down to you.”

verses.english:
I sent them messengers, saying, “I am engaged in a great work and
cannot come down, for the work will stop if I leave it in order to
come down to you.”

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אֵלַי כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה אַרְבַּע פְּעָמִים וָאָשִׁיב אוֹתָם כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

hebrew.text: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אֵלַי כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה אַרְבַּע פְּעָמִים וָאָשִׁיב אוֹתָם כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

english.text:
They sent me the same message four times, and I gave them the same
answer.

verses.english:

Haman’s face was covered.

favor and the proposal seems right to Your Majesty, and if I am
pleasing to you—let dispatches be written countermanding those
which were written by Haman son of Hammedatha the Agagite,
embodying his plot to annihilate the Jews throughout the king’s
provinces.

with the king’s signet may not be revoked.”

english.text:

twenty-third day of the third month, that is, the month of Sivan;

to the satraps, the governors and the officials of the one hundred
and twenty-seven provinces from India to Nubia: to every province
in its own script and to every people in its own language, and to
the Jews in their own script and language.

מִתְיַהֲדִים כִּי־נָפַל פַּחַד־הַיְּהוּדִים עֲלֵיהֶם׃

english.text:
And in every province and in every city, when the king’s command
and decree arrived, there was gladness and joy among the Jews, a
feast and a holiday. And many of the people of the land professed
to be Jews, for the fear of the Jews had fallen upon them.

verses.english:
And in every province and in every city, when the king’s command
and decree arrived, there was gladness and joy among the Jews, a
feast and a holiday. And many of the people of the land professed
to be Jews, for the fear of the Jews had fallen upon them.

כִּי בֹשְׁתִּי לִשְׁאוֹל מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ חַיִל וּפָרָשִׁים לְעזְרֵנוּ מֵאוֹיֵב בַּדָּרֶךְ כִּי־אָמַרְנוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר יַד־אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל־כּל־מְבַקְשָׁיו לְטוֹבָה וְעֻזּוֹ

king, “The benevolent care of our God is for all who seek Him,

hebrew.text: וָאַבְדִּילָה מִשָּׂרֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר לְשֵׁרֵבְיָה חֲשַׁבְיָה וְעִמָּהֶם מֵאֲחֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה׃

english.text:
Then I selected twelve of the chiefs of the priests, namely
Sherebiah and Hashabiah with ten of their brothers,

verses.english:

verses.hebrew: (ואשקולה) [וָאֶשְׁקֳלָה] לָהֶם אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַכֵּלִים תְּרוּמַת בֵּית־אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַהֵרִימוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיֹעֲצָיו וְשָׂרָיו וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנִּמְצָאִים׃

hebrew.text: (ואשקולה) [וָאֶשְׁקֳלָה] לָהֶם אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַכֵּלִים תְּרוּמַת בֵּית־אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַהֵרִימוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיֹעֲצָיו וְשָׂרָיו וְכל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנִּמְצָאִים׃

english.text:
and I weighed out to them the silver, the gold, and the vessels,
the contribution to the House of our God which the king, his
counselors and officers, and all Israel who were present had made.

verses.english:
and I weighed out to them the silver, the gold, and the vessels,
the contribution to the House of our God which the king, his

verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁקְלָה עַל־יָדָם כֶּסֶף כִּכָּרִים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים וּכְלֵי־כֶסֶף מֵאָה לְכִכָּרִים זָהָב מֵאָה כִכָּר׃

hebrew.text: וָאֶשְׁקְלָה עַל־יָדָם כֶּסֶף כִּכָּרִים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים וּכְלֵי־כֶסֶף מֵאָה לְכִכָּרִים זָהָב מֵאָה כִכָּר׃

verses.hebrew: וּכְפֹרֵי זָהָב עֶשְׂרִים לַאֲדַרְכֹנִים אָלֶף וּכְלֵי נְחֹשֶׁת מֻצְהָב טוֹבָה שְׁנַיִם חֲמוּדֹת כַּזָּהָב׃

hebrew.text: וּכְפֹרֵי זָהָב עֶשְׂרִים לַאֲדַרְכֹנִים אָלֶף וּכְלֵי נְחֹשֶׁת מֻצְהָב טוֹבָה שְׁנַיִם חֲמוּדֹת כַּזָּהָב׃

english.text:
also, twenty gold bowls worth one thousand darics and two vessels
of good, shining bronze, as precious as gold.

verses.english:
also, twenty gold bowls worth one thousand darics and two vessels

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמְרָה אֲלֵהֶם אַתֶּם קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה וְהַכֵּלִים קֹדֶשׁ וְהַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב נְדָבָה לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

hebrew.text: וָאֹמְרָה אֲלֵהֶם אַתֶּם קֹדֶשׁ לַיהֹוָה וְהַכֵּלִים קֹדֶשׁ וְהַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב נְדָבָה לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

english.text:
I said to them, “You are consecrated to YHWH, and the vessels are
consecrated, and the silver and gold are a freewill offering to
YHWH God of your fathers.

verses.english:

verses.hebrew: שִׁקְדוּ וְשִׁמְרוּ עַד־תִּשְׁקְלוּ לִפְנֵי שָׂרֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְשָׂרֵי־הָאָבוֹת לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם הַלִּשְׁכוֹת בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

hebrew.text: שִׁקְדוּ וְשִׁמְרוּ עַד־תִּשְׁקְלוּ לִפְנֵי שָׂרֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְשָׂרֵי־הָאָבוֹת לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בִּירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם הַלִּשְׁכוֹת בֵּית יְהֹוָה׃

english.text:
Guard them diligently until such time as you weigh them out in the
presence of the officers of the priests and the Levites and the
officers of the clans of Israel in Jerusalem in the chambers of
the House of YHWH.”

verses.english:

verses.hebrew: וְקִבְּלוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם מִשְׁקַל הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב וְהַכֵּלִים לְהָבִיא לִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לְבֵית אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

hebrew.text: וְקִבְּלוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם מִשְׁקַל הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב וְהַכֵּלִים לְהָבִיא לִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם לְבֵית אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english.text:
So the priests and the Levites received the cargo of silver and
gold and vessels by weight, to bring them to Jerusalem to the
House of our God.

verses.english:

verses.hebrew: וַנִּסְּעָה מִנְּהַר אַהֲוָא בִּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן לָלֶכֶת יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְיַד־אֱלֹהֵינוּ הָיְתָה עָלֵינוּ וַיַּצִּילֵנוּ מִכַּף אוֹיֵב וְאוֹרֵב עַל־הַדָּרֶךְ׃

hebrew.text: וַנִּסְּעָה מִנְּהַר אַהֲוָא בִּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן לָלֶכֶת יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וְיַד־אֱלֹהֵינוּ הָיְתָה עָלֵינוּ וַיַּצִּילֵנוּ מִכַּף אוֹיֵב וְאוֹרֵב עַל־הַדָּרֶךְ׃

english.text:
We set out for Jerusalem from the Ahava River on the twelfth of
the first month. We enjoyed the care of our God, who saved us from
enemy ambush on the journey.

verses.english:

verses.hebrew: וַנָּבוֹא יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וַנֵּשֶׁב שָׁם יָמִים שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

hebrew.text: וַנָּבוֹא יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם וַנֵּשֶׁב שָׁם יָמִים שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

english.text: We arrived in Jerusalem and stayed there three days.

verses.english: We arrived in Jerusalem and stayed there three days.

verses.hebrew:

Jeshua, and Noadiah son of Binnui, the Levites, were with them.

english.text:

offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel,
ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs and twelve he-goats as a
purification offering, all this a burnt offering to YHWH.

hebrew.text: וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת־דָּתֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּפַחֲווֹת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וְנִשְּׂאוּ אֶת־הָעָם וְאֶת־בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים׃

governors of the province of Beyond the River who gave support to
the people and the House of God.

verses.english:
They handed the royal orders to the king’s satraps and the
governors of the province of Beyond the River who gave support to
the people and the House of God.

verses.hebrew:
וַיֵּאָסְפוּ כל־הָעָם כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד אֶל־הָרְחוֹב אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי שַׁעַר־הַמָּיִם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְעֶזְרָא הַסֹּפֵר לְהָבִיא אֶת־סֵפֶר תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהֹוָה
אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

hebrew.text:
